rr: Adamu, Seezi, Enosi
en: Adam, Sheth, Enosh,

rr: Kenani, Mahalaleeli, Yaredi
en: Kenan, Mahalaleel, Jered,

rr: Enoka, Mesuseela, Lameka
en: Henoch, Methuselah, Lamech,

rr: Noa, Sheemu, Haamu, Yafeesi.
en: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

rr: Batabani ba Yafeesi: Gomeri, Magogi, Madai, Yavani, Tubali, Mesheki na Tiraasi.
en: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.

rr: Batabani ba Gomeri: Ashikenaazi, Difaasi, Toguruma.
en: And the sons of Gomer; Ashchenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.

rr: Batabani ba Yavani: Elisha, Tarushiishi, Kitimu na Rodanimu.
en: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

rr: Batabani ba Haamu: Kuushi, Misri, Puuti na Kanaani.
en: The sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

rr: Batabani ba Kuushi: Seeba, Havila, Sabuta, Raama, na Sabuteeka. Batabani ba Raama: Sheeba na Dedani.
en: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabta, and Raamah, and Sabtecha. And the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.

rr: Kuushi yaazaara Nimuroodi; yaaba niwe yaabandize kuba ow'amaani rugambwa omu nsi.
en: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be mighty upon the earth.

rr: Misri yaazaara Ludimu, Anamimu, Lehabimu, Nafutuhimu
en: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,

rr: Patirusimu, Kasiluhimu, ou Abafilistia baakomookireho, na Kafutorimu.
en: and Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (of whom came the Philistines,) and Caphtorim.

rr: Kanaani yaajigaija Sidoni, bwanyima yaazaara Heesi
en: And Canaan begat Zidon his firstborn, and Heth,

rr: kandi yaakomookwamu Abayebusi, Abaamori Abagirugashi
en: the Jebusite also, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,

rr: Abahiivi, Abaaruki, Abasiini
en: and the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,

rr: Abaarivadi, Abazemari, n'Abahamasi.
en: and the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.

rr: Batabani ba Sheemu: Elamu, Ashuri, Arufakisaadi, Luudi, Aramu, Uuzi, Huuli, Geseri, na Mesheki.
en: The sons of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram, and Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Meshech.

rr: Arufakisaadi yaazaara Sheela, Sheela yaazaara Eberi.
en: And Arphaxad begat Shelah, and Shelah begat Eber.

rr: Eberi yaazaara aboojo babiri, omwe akaba naayetwa Pelegi, ahabw'okuba omu biro bye ensi nibwo yaabaganisibwa, kandi eiziina ry'omurumuna akaba ari Yokitaani.
en: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg; because in his days the earth was divided: and his brother's name was Joktan.

rr: Yokitaani yaazaara Alimodaadi, Shelefu, Hazarimaveesi, Yeera
en: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,

rr: Hadoramu, Uzali, Dikila
en: Hadoram also, and Uzal, and Diklah,

rr: Ebali, Abimaeli, Sheeba
en: and Ebal, and Abimael, and Sheba,

rr: Ofiri, Havila na Yobabu; abo boona bakaba bari batabani ba Yokitaani.
en: and Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

rr: Sheemu, Arufakisaadi, Sheela
en: Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,

rr: Eberi, Pelegi, Reu
en: Eber, Peleg, Reu,

rr: Serugi, Nahori, Teera
en: Serug, Nahor, Terah,

rr: Abraamu niwe Abarahamu.
en: Abram; the same is Abraham.

rr: Batabani ba Abrahamu: Isaaka na Ishimaeli.
en: The sons of Abraham; Isaac, and Ishmael.

rr: Orunirwo ruzaaro rwabo; omujigaijo gwa Ishimaeli, Nebayoosi, yaakuratwa Kedari, Adubeeli, Mibusaamu
en: These are their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,

rr: Mishuma, Duuma, Maasa, Hadadi, Teema
en: Mishma, and Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema,

rr: Yeturi, Nafishi, na Kedema. Abo nibo batabani ba Ishimaeli.
en: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.

rr: Batabani ba Ketura, ekinyashunju kya Abarahamu, akazaara Zimuraani, Yokishaani, Medani, Midiani, Ishibaaki na Shua.
en: Now the sons of Keturah, Abraham's concubine: she bare Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah.

rr: Batabani ba Yokishaani, Sheeba na Dedani.
en: And the sons of Jokshan; Sheba, and Dedan.

rr: Batabani ba Midiani: Eefa, Eferi, Hanoki, Abida, na Eludaya, abo boona bakaba bari batabani ba Ketura.
en: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Henoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these are the sons of Keturah.

rr: Abrahamu yaazaara Isaaka. Batabani ba Isaaka: Esau na Israeli.
en: And Abraham begat Isaac. The sons of Isaac; Esau and Israel.

rr: Batabani ba Esau: Elifaazi, Reueli, Yerushi, Yalamu na Koora.
en: The sons of Esau; Eliphaz, Reuel, and Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.

rr: Batabani ba Elifaazi: Temani, Omari, Zeefi, Gatamu, Kenazi, Timuna, na Amaleki.
en: The sons of Eliphaz; Teman, and Omar, Zephi, and Gatam, Kenaz, and Timna, and Amalek.

rr: Batabani ba Reueli: Nahasi, Zeera, Shama na Miiza.
en: The sons of Reuel; Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

rr: Batabani ba Seiri: Lotani, Shobali, Zibeoni, Aana, Dishoni, Ezeeri na Dishani.
en: And the sons of Seir; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah, and Dishon, and Ezar, and Dishan.

rr: Batabani ba Lotani: Hoori, na Homamu; munyaanya wa Lotani akaba ari Timuna.
en: And the sons of Lotan; Hori, and Homam: and Timna was Lotan's sister.

rr: Batabani ba Shobali: Alivani, Manahaasi, Ebali, Sheefi na Onamu. Batabani ba Zibeoni: Aaya na Aana.
en: The sons of Shobal; Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon; Aiah, and Anah.

rr: Mutabani wa Aana: Dishoni. Batabani ba Dishoni: Hamuraani, Eshibaani, Isuraani, na Keraani.
en: The sons of Anah; Dishon. And the sons of Dishon; Amram, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.

rr: Batabani ba Ezeeri: Biluhaani, Zaavani, na Yakani. Batabani ba Dishoni: Uuzi na Arani.
en: The sons of Ezer; Bilhan, and Zavan, and Jakan. The sons of Dishan; Uz, and Aran. Kings of Edom

rr: Aba nibo bagabe abaategyekire ensi ya Edomu, hatakabaireho mugabe weena ow'okutegyeka Abaisraeli: Beela mwene Beori, ou orurembo rwe rwabaire nirwetwa Dinihaba.
en: Now these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the children of Israel; Bela the son of Beor: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

rr: Beela ku yaafiire, Yobabu mwene Zeera owa Bozira yaategyeka omu mwanya gwe.
en: And when Bela was dead, Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.

rr: Oba Yobabu ku yaafiire, Hushamu ow'omu nsi y'Abatemaani yaategyeka omu mwanya gwe.
en: And when Jobab was dead, Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his stead.

rr: Hushamu ku yaafiire, Hadadi mwene Bedadi owaasingwire Abamidiani omu nsi ya Moabu yaategyeka omu mwanya gwe; eiziina ry'orurembo rwe rukaba nirwetwa Aviisi.
en: And when Husham was dead, Hadad the son of Bedad, which smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.

rr: Hadadi ku yaafiire, Samula owa Masireka yaategyeka omu mwanya gwe.
en: And when Hadad was dead, Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.

rr: Samula ku yaafiire, Shauli owa Rehoboosi ey'aha mugyera Furaati yaategyeka omu mwanya gwe.
en: And when Samlah was dead, Shaul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.

rr: Shauli ku yaafiire, Baali-hanani mwene Akiboori yaategyeka omu mwanya gwe.
en: And when Shaul was dead, Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.

rr: Baali-hanani ku yaafiire, Hadadi yaategyeka omu mwanya gwe; n'eiziina ry'orurembo rwe rukaba nirwetwa Pai, kandi omukazi we akaba naayetwa Mehetabeeli muhara wa Matireedi, omwijukuru wa Mezahaabu.
en: And when Baal-hanan was dead, Hadad reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pai; and his wife's name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

rr: Bwanyima Hadadi yaafa. Abaami ba Edomu bakaba bari aba: Omwami Timuna, Aliva, Yeseti
en: Hadad died also. And the dukes of Edom were; duke Timnah, duke Aliah, duke Jetheth,

rr: Oholibama, Eela, Pinoni
en: duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,

rr: Kenazi, Temani, Mibuzaari
en: duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,

rr: —30:24. Aba nibo batabani ba Israeli: Reubeni, Simeoni, Leevi, Yuda, Isakaari, Zebuluuni
en: These are the sons of Israel; Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun,

rr: Daani, Yosefu, Benyamiini, Nafutaali, Gaadi na Asheri.
en: Dan, Joseph, and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

rr: -5 , 7 ; 46:12 . Batabani ba Yuda: Eeri, Onani, na Sheela; abo bonshatu nibo Batishua Omunyakanaanikazi yaamuzaariire. Kwonka Eeri omujigaijo gwa Yuda akaba ari mubi omu maisho ga MUKA, A, yaamwita.
en: The sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah: which three were born unto him of the daughter of Shua the Canaanitess. And Er, the firstborn of Judah, was evil in the sight of the LORD ; and he slew him.

rr: Kandi mukaamwana Tamari nawe yaamuzaarira Pereezi na Zeera. Yuda akaba aine abatabani bataano.
en: And Tamar his daughter in law bare him Pharez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.

rr: Batabani ba Pereezi: Hezirooni na Hamuli.
en: The sons of Pharez; Hezron, and Hamul.

rr: Batabani ba Zeera: Zimuri, Esaani, Hemani, Kalukooli na Daara, boona bataano.
en: And the sons of Zerah; Zimri, and Ethan, and Heman, and Calcol, and Dara: five of them in all.

rr: Mutabani wa Karumi: Akani owaitsire kubi Abaisraeli akacumura omu byabiikiirwe MUKAMA
en: And the sons of Carmi; Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed in the thing accursed.

rr: kandi mwene Esaani akaba ari Azaria.
en: And the sons of Ethan; Azariah.

rr: Batabani ba Hezirooni abaamuzaariirwe: Yerameeli, Raamu na Kelubai.
en: The sons also of Hezron, that were born unto him; Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai.

rr: Raamu yaazaara Aminadabu, Aminadabu yaazaara Nahashooni, omukuru omuri beene Yuda.
en: And Ram begat Amminadab; and Amminadab begat Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;

rr: Nahashooni yaazaara Saluma, Saluma yaazaara Boazi
en: and Nahshon begat Salma, and Salma begat Boaz,

rr: Boazi yaazaara Obedi, Obedi yaazaara Yese
en: and Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse,

rr: Yese yaajigaija Eliabu, yaakuratwa Abinadabu, omwana we owa kashatu yaaba Shimea
en: and Jesse begat his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimma the third,

rr: owa kana Nesaneeli, owa kataano Radai
en: Nethaneel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,

rr: owa mukaaga Ozeemu, owa mushanju Daudi
en: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh:

rr: banyaanya baabo ni Zeruiya na Abigaili. Batabani ba Zeruiya: Abishai, Yoabu, na Asaheeli, bashatu.
en: whose sisters were Zeruiah, and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah; Abishai, and Joab, and Asahel, three.

rr: Abigaili yaazaara Amasa, kandi ishe wa Amasa akaba ari Yeseri Omuishimaeli.
en: And Abigail bare Amasa: and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmeelite.

rr: Kalebu mwene Hezirooni akazaara abaan aha mukazi we Azuuba n'ahari Yeriosi; kandi abaana be nibo aba: Yesheri, Shobabu na Aridooni.
en: And Caleb the son of Hezron begat children of Azubah his wife, and of Jerioth: her sons are these; Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.

rr: Azuuba ku yaafiire, Kalebu yaashwera Efuraata owaamuzaariire Huuri.
en: And when Azubah was dead, Caleb took unto him Ephrath, which bare him Hur.

rr: Huuri yaazaara Uuri, na Uuri yaazaara Bezaleeli.
en: And Hur begat Uri, and Uri begat Bezaleel.

rr: Bwanyima Hezirooni, ku yaahikize emyaka makumi mukaaga, yaataasya muhara wa Makiri ishe wa Gileadi, yaaba omukazi we; yaamuzaarira Seegebu.
en: And afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he was threescore years old; and she bare him Segub.

rr: Seegebu yaazaara Yairi, owaabaire naategyeka endembo makumi abiri na ishatu omu nsi ya Gileadi.
en: And Segub begat Jair, who had three and twenty cities in the land of Gilead.

rr: Kwonka Geshuri na Aramu yaanyagaho Havoosi-yairi, na Kenasi n'ebirorero byayo, tauni zoona makumi mukaaga.
en: And he took Geshur, and Aram, with the towns of Jair, from them, with Kenath, and the towns thereof, even threescore cities.

rr: Abo boona bakaba bari baijukuru ba Makiri ishe wa Gileadi.
en: All these belonged to the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.

rr: Hezirooni ku yaafiire, Kalebu yaabyama na Efuraata muka Hezirooni ishe, yaamuzaarira Ashihuuri, ishe wa Tekoa.
en: And after that Hezron was dead in Caleb-ephratah, then Abiah Hezron's wife bare him Ashur the father of Tekoa.

rr: Batabani ba Yerameeli omujigaijo gwa Hezirooni: Raamu omujigaijo gwe, Buna, Oreni, Ozemi na Ahiya.
en: And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were, Ram the firstborn, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, and Ahijah.

rr: Yerameeli akaba aine ondiijo mukazi orikwetwa Atara owaabaire ari nyina wa Onamu.
en: Jerahmeel had also another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.

rr: Batabani ba Raamu omujigaijo gwa Yerameeli: Maazi, Yamini na Ekeri.
en: And the sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were, Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker.

rr: Batabani ba Onamu: Shamai: Nadabu na Abishuri.
en: And the sons of Onam were, Shammai, and Jada. And the sons of Shammai; Nadab, and Abishur.

rr: Muka Abishuri akaba naayetwa Abihaili; yaamuzaarira Ahibaani na Molidi.
en: And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail, and she bare him Ahban, and Molid.

rr: Batabani ba Nadabu: Seleedi na Apayimu: Seleedi ogwo yaafa bucwekye.
en: And the sons of Nadab; Seled, and Appaim: but Seled died without children.

rr: Mutabani wa Apayimu: Iishi. Mutabani wa Iishi: Sheshani. Mutabani wa Sheshani: Ahilai.
en: And the sons of Appaim; Ishi. And the sons of Ishi; Sheshan. And the children of Sheshan; Ahlai.

rr: Batabani ba Yaada murumuna wa Shamai: Yeseri na Yonasaani. Yeseri ogwo yaafa bucwekye.
en: And the sons of Jada the brother of Shammai; Jether, and Jonathan: and Jether died without children.

rr: Batabani ba Yonasaani: Pelesi na Zaaza. Abo nibo baijukuru ba Yerameeli.
en: And the sons of Jonathan; Peleth, and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.

rr: Kandi Sheshani akaba atazaire boojo kureka abaishiki bonka; kwonka Sheshani akaba aine omuhuuku Omunyamisri owaabaire naayetwa Yaruha.
en: Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. And Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.

rr: Atyo Sheshani yaahingira muhara we ogwo muhuuku we Yaruha, yaamuzaarira Atai.
en: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant to wife; and she bare him Attai.

rr: Atai ogwo yaazaara Nasani, Nasani yaazaara Zabadi.
en: And Attai begat Nathan, and Nathan begat Zabad,

rr: Zabadi yaazaara Efulaali, Efulaali yaazaara Obedi
en: and Zabad begat Ephlal, and Ephlal begat Obed,

rr: Obedi yaazaara Yehu, Yehu yaazaara Azaria.
en: and Obed begat Jehu, and Jehu begat Azariah,

rr: Azaria yaazaara Helezi, Helezi yaazaara Eleasa.
en: and Azariah begat Helez, and Helez begat Eleasah,

rr: Eleasa yaazaara Sisumai, Sisumai yaazaara Shalumu
en: and Eleasah begat Sisamai, and Sisamai begat Shallum,

rr: Shalumu yaazaara Yekamia, na Yekamia yaazaara Elishaama.
en: and Shallum begat Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begat Elishama.

rr: Batabani ba Heburooni: Koora, Tapua, Rekemu na Sheema.
en: And the sons of Hebron; Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.

rr: Sheema yaazaara Rahamu, ishe wa Yorikeamu; kandi Rekemu yaazaara Shamai.
en: And Shema begat Raham, the father of Jorkoam: and Rekem begat Shammai.

rr: Mutabani wa Shamai: Maoni; kandi Maoni yaazaara Besizuuri.
en: And the son of Shammai was Maon: and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.

rr: Eefa ekinyanshunju kya Kalebu nawe yaazaara Harani, Mooza na Gazezi; kandi Harani yaazaara Gazezi.
en: And Ephah, Caleb's concubine, bare Haran, and Moza, and Gazez: and Haran begat Gazez.

rr: Batabani ba Yahidai: Regemu, Yosamu, Geshani, Peleti, Eefa, na Shaafi.
en: And the sons of Jahdai; Regem, and Jotham, and Gesham, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.

rr: Maaka ekinyanshunju kya Kalebu yaazaara Sheberi na Tiruhaana.
en: Maachah, Caleb's concubine, bare Sheber, and Tirhanah.

rr: Kandi yaazaara Shaafi ishe wa Madumaana, Sheeva ishe wa Makibeena na ishe wa Gibea; kandi muhara wa Kalebu akaba ari Akisha.
en: She bare also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah, and the father of Gibea: and the daughter of Caleb was Achsa.

rr: Saluma ishe wa Betelehemu, na Harefu ishe wa Besigadeeri.
en: Salma the father of Beth-lehem, Hareph the father of Beth-gader.

rr: Shobaali ishe wa Kiryasi-yearimu akazaara abandi baana b'aboojo, Harowe, ekicweka ky'Abamenuhosi.
en: And Shobal the father of Kirjath-jearim had sons; Haroeh, and half of the Manahethites.

rr: Emiryango ya Kiryasi-yearimu; aba Isuri, aba Puuti, aba Shumaasi, n'aba Mishura; omuri abo hakakomookamu aba Zoraasi, n'aba Eshitaoli.
en: And the families of Kirjath-jearim; the Ithrites, and the Puhites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zareathites, and the Eshtaulites.

rr: Batabani ba Saluma: Betelehemu, aba Netoofaasi, Atiroosi-besiyoabu, n'ekicweka ky'aba Manahaasi abarikwetwa aba zoori.
en: The sons of Salma; Beth-lehem, and the Netophathites, Ataroth, the house of Joab, and half of the Manahethites, the Zorites.

rr: Kandi emirayngo y'abahandiiki abaabaire batwire Yabezi: aba Tiraasi, aba Shimeasi n'aba Sukaasi.
en: And the families of the scribes which dwelt at Jabez; the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and Suchathites.

rr: Abo nibo ba Keeni, abaakomookire ahari Hamasi, ishenkuru w'enju ya Rekabu.
en: These are the Kenites that came of Hemath, the father of the house of Rechab.

rr: 2 Aba nibo batabani ba Daudi abaamuzaariirwe ari Heburooni: omujigaijo gwe akaba ari Amunoni, ou yaazaire ahari Ahinoamu owa Yezereeli; owa kabiri ni Danieli ou yaazaire ahari Abigaili owa Karumeeli
en: Now these were the sons of David, which were born unto him in Hebron; the firstborn Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess:

rr: owa kashatu ni Abusalomu, owaazairwe Maaka, muhara wa Talumai omugabe wa Geshuri: owa kana ni Adoniya, owaazairwe Hagisi
en: the third, Absalom the son of Maachah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur: the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith:

rr: owa kataano Shefatia owaazairwe Abitaali, owa mukaaga Itereamu owaazairwe omukazi we Egula
en: the fifth, Shephatiah of Abital: the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife.

rr: abo mukaaga bakamuzaarirwa ari Heburooni, ahu yaategyekyeire emyaka mushanju n'ameezi mukaaga. Kandi yaamara endiijo myaka makumi ashatu n'eshatu, naategyekyera Yerusaalemu.
en: These six were born unto him in Hebron; and there he reigned seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years.

rr: 2 -16 ; 1 Kandi aba nibo baamuzaariirwe ari Yerusaalemu: Shimea, Shobabu, Nasani, na Sulemaani, bana abu yaazaire ahari Batishua muhara wa Amieli
en: And these were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bath-shua the daughter of Ammiel:

rr: bwanyima yaazaara Ibuhaari, Elishaama, Elifeleti
en: Ibhar also, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,

rr: Nooga, Nefegi, Yafia
en: and Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

rr: Elishaama, Eliada na Elifeleti, boona mwenda.
en: and Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.

rr: Abo boona bakaba bari batabani ba Daudi, otabariiremu batabani b'ebinyanshunju bye; kandi munyaanya waabo akaba ari Tamari.
en: These were all the sons of David, beside the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.

rr: Baijukuru ba Sulemaani: Rehoboamu, owaazire Abiya, owaazaire Asa, owaazaire Yehoshafaati
en: And Solomon's son was Rehoboam, Abia his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,

rr: owaazaire Yehoraamu, owaazaire Ahazia, owaazaire Yoasi
en: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,

rr: owaazaire Amazia, owaazaire Uziya, owaazaire Yosamu
en: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,

rr: owaazaire Ahazi, owaazaire Hezekia, owaazaire Manaase
en: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,

rr: owaazaire Amoni, owaazaire Yosia.
en: Amon his son, Josiah his son.

rr: Batabani ba Yosia: omujigaijo gwe Yohanaani, owa kabiri Yehoyakimu, owa kashatu Zedekia, owa kana Shalumu.
en: And the sons of Josiah were , the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.

rr: Baijukuru ba Yehoyakimu, mutabani we Yekonia, ishe wa Zedekia
en: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.

rr: batabani ba Yekonia enkwatwa: Shealutieli
en: And the sons of Jeconiah; Assir, Salathiel his son,

rr: Malikiramu, Pedaaya, Shenazaari, Yekamia, Hoshama na Nedabia
en: Malchiram also, and Pedaiah, and Shenazar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.

rr: batabani ba Pedaaya: Zerubabeeli na Shimei; batabani ba Zerubabeeli: Meshulaamu na Hanania, kandi Shelomiisi akaba ari munyaanya
en: And the sons of Pedaiah were , Zerubbabel, and Shimei: and the sons of Zerubbabel; Meshullam, and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister:

rr: na Hashuba, Oheli, Berekia, Hasadia, na Yushabu-hesedi, boona bataano.
en: and Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushab-hesed, five.

rr: Batabani ba Hanania: Pelatia na Yeshaya, owaazaire Refaaya, owaazaire Arunani, owaazaire Obadia, owaazaire Shekania.
en: And the sons of Hananiah; Pelatiah, and Jesaiah: the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shechaniah.

rr: Mutabani wa Shekania: Shemaya. Batabani ba Shemaya, Hatushi, Igali, Baria, Nearia, na Shafati, boona mukaaga.
en: And the sons of Shechaniah; Shemaiah: and the sons of Shemaiah; Hattush, and Igeal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.

rr: Batabani ba Nearia: Elio-enai, Hizukia, na Azurikaamu, boona bashatu.
en: And the sons of Neariah; Elioenai, and Hezekiah, and Azrikam, three.

rr: Batabani ba Elio-enai: Hodavia, Eliashibu, Pelaaya, Akubu, Yohanaani, Delaya na Anani, mushanju.
en: And the sons of Elioenai were , Hodaiah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Dalaiah, and Anani, seven.

rr: Currently Selected: 1 Eby&x27;omu Busingye 3 : RR64 Highlight Share <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8 19c-2.828 0-4.243 0-5.121-.879C2 17.243 2 15.828 2 1
Batabani ba Yuda: Perezi, Hezirooni, Karumi, Huuri na Shobali.
en: The sons of Judah; Pharez, Hezron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.

rr: Reaya mwene Shobali akaba ari ishe wa Yahasi, Yahasi yaazaara Ahumai na Lahadi. Abo nibo b'emiryango y'aba Zorasi.
en: And Reaiah the son of Shobal begat Jahath; and Jahath begat Ahumai, and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.

rr: Aba nibo batabani ba Etamu: Yezereeli, Ishuma na Ibudashi, munyaanya waabo akaba naayetwa Hazalelipooni
en: And these were of the father of Etam; Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash: and the name of their sister was Hazelelponi:

rr: Penueli yaazara Gedori, na Ezeeri yaazaara Husha.
en: and Penuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah.

rr: Abo nibo batabani ba Huuri omujigaijo gwa Efuraata ishe wa Betelehemu.
en: These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah, the father of Beth-lehem.

rr: Ashihuri, ishe wa Tekoa akaba aine abakazi babiri, Heela na Naara
en: And Ashur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

rr: Naara yaamuzaarira Ahuzamu, Heferi, Temeni na Hahashitari. Abo nibo batabani ba Naara.
en: And Naarah bare him Ahuzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.

rr: Batabani ba Heela: Zeresi, Izuhari, na Esinaani.
en: And the sons of Helah were , Zereth, and Jezoar, and Ethnan.

rr: Koozi yaazaara Anubu, Zobeba n'emiryango ya Ahariheli mwene Harumu.
en: And Coz begat Anub, and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.

rr: Yabezi akaba ari omuntu orikusiimwa okukira beene ishe; nyina yaamweta Yabezi, naagira ati: Ahabw'okuba nkamuzaarira omu busaasi.
en: And Jabez was more honourable than his brethren: and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, Because I bare him with sorrow.

rr: Yabezi yaashaba Ruhanga wa Israeli naagira ati: Nkaabaasibwa ki, ompa omugisha, oirizayo emyatano yangye, omukono gwawe guguma naanye, ondinda akabi kareka kuunyita.
en: And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, Oh that thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my coast, and that thine hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep me from evil, that it may not grieve me!

rr: Ruhanga yaamuha eki yaashabire.
en: And God granted him that which he requested.

rr: Kelubu murumuna wa Shuuha yaazaara Mehiiri, nawe yaazaara Eshitoni.
en: And Chelub the brother of Shuah begat Mehir, which was the father of Eshton.

rr: Eshitoni yaazaara Besiraafa, Pasea na Tehina, ishe wa Irunahashi. Abo n'abashaija ba reeka.
en: And Eshton begat Beth-rapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Irnahash. These are the men of Rechah.

rr: Batabani ba Kenazi: Otinyeli na Seraaya; batabani ba Otinyeli: Hatasi na Meonosai.
en: And the sons of Kenaz; Othniel, and Seraiah: and the sons of Othniel; Hathath.

rr: Meonosai yaazaara Ofura; na Seraaya yaazaara Yoabu, ishe w'aba Gerashi, bakaba nibeetwa eryo iziina ahabw'okuba abanyamyoga.
en: And Meonothai begat Ophrah: and Seraiah begat Joab, the father of the valley of Charashim; for they were craftsmen.

rr: Batabani ba Kalebu mwene Yefune: Iiru, Ela, na naamu; mutabani wa Ela ni Kenazi.
en: And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh; Iru, Elah, and Naam: and the sons of Elah, even Kenaz.

rr: Batabani ba Yehaleleli: Ziifu, Ziifa, Tiria na Asareeli.
en: And the sons of Jehaleleel; Ziph, and Ziphah, Tiria, and Asareel.

rr: Batabani ba Ezira: Yeseri, Meredi, Eferi, na Yalooni. Abo nibo batabani wa Bisia muhara wa Faraho, ou Meredi yaashweire; yaagira enda, yaazaara Miriamu, Shamai na Ishuba ishe wa Eshitemoa.
en: And the sons of Ezra were , Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon: and she bare Miriam, and Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.

rr: Kandi omukazi we Omuyudaayakazi yaazaara Yeredi ishe Gedori, Heberi ishe wa Sooko na Yekusieli ishe wa Zanoa.
en: And his wife Jehudijah bare Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Socho, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. And these are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, which Mered took.

rr: Batabani ba muka Hodia, munyaanya wa Nahamu, bakazaara Keila owa Garumi na Eshitemoa owa Maakasi.
en: And the sons of his wife Hodiah the sister of Naham, the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maachathite.

rr: Batabani ba Shimoni: Amunoni, Riina, Benihanani na Tilooni.
en: And the sons of Shimon were , Amnon, and Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon.

rr: Batabani ba Iishi: Zohesi na Benizohesi.
en: And the sons of Ishi were , Zoheth, and Ben-zoheth.

rr: Batabani ba Sheela mwene Yuda: Eeri ishe wa Leeka, Laada ishe wa Maresha n'ab'emiryango y'enju y'abarikuruka emyenda ya kitaani ahari Betashibea
en: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah were , Er the father of Lecah, and Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of them that wrought fine linen, of the house of Ashbea,

rr: na Yokimu n'abashaija ba Kozeba, na Yoasi, na Sarafu owaabaire naategyeka Moabu, na Yashubilehemu.
en: and Jokim, and the men of Chozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had the dominion in Moab, and Jashubi-lehem.

rr: Ebyo bihandiiko n'ebya ira munonga.
en: And these are ancient things.

rr: Abo nibo baabaire bari ababumbi, batwire Netaimu na Gedera; bo bakaba batuurayo n'omugabe nibamukorera.
en: These were the potters, and those that dwelt among plants and hedges: there they dwelt with the king for his work. Sons of Simeon

rr: Batabani ba Simeoni: Nemueli, Yamini, Yaribu, Seera na Shauli
en: The sons of Simeon were , Nemuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul:

rr: kandi Shalumu n'omutabani, na Mibusamu na Mishima.
en: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.

rr: Batabani ba Mishima: omutabani Hamueli, mwene Hamueli ni zakuru, mwene Zakuri ni Shimei.
en: And the sons of Mishma; Hamuel his son, Zacchur his son, Shimei his son.

rr: Kandi Shimei ogwo akaba aine abaana b'aboojo ikumi na mukaaga n'ab'abaishiki mukaaga; kwonka beene ishe bakaba batazaire baana baingi, kandi oruganda rwabo rwona tirurakanyire nk'orwa Yuda.
en: And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brethren had not many children, neither did all their family multiply, like to the children of Judah.

rr: Bakaba batwire Beeri-sheba, Molada, Hazari-shuali
en: And they dwelt at Beer-sheba, and Moladah, and Hazar-shual,

rr: Biluha, Ezeemu, Toladi
en: and at Bilhah, and at Ezem, and at Tolad,

rr: Besueli, Horuma, zikulaagi
en: and at Bethuel, and at Hormah, and at Ziklag,

rr: Besi-marikaboosi, Hazarasusimu, Besibiri na Sharaimu.
en: and at Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susim, and at Beth-birei, and at Shaaraim.

rr: Ezo nizo zaabaire ziri endembo zaabo okuhitsya obu Daudi yaagiire aha ngoma.
en: These were their cities unto the reign of David.

rr: Ebirorero byabo bikaba biri Etamu, Aini, rimona, Tokemu na Ashani, endembo zoona itaano
en: And their villages were , Etam, and Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen, and Ashan, five cities:

rr: hamwe n'ebindi birorero byabo ebyabaire byehinguririize ezo ndembo okuhika Baali.
en: and all their villages that were round about the same cities, unto Baal.

rr: Aho niho baabaire batwire, kandi bakaba baine ekitabo ky'okuhandiikamu oruzaaro rwabo.
en: These were their habitations, and their genealogy.

rr: Meshobabu, Yamuleki, Yoosha mwene Amazia
en: And Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Joshah the son of Amaziah,

rr: Yoeli, Yehu mwene Yoshibia, mwijukuru wa Seraaya mwene Asieli
en: and Joel, and Jehu the son of Josibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,

rr: Elio-enai, Yakoba, Yeshohaaya, Asaaya, Adieli, Yesimieli, Benaaya
en: and Elioenai, and Jaakobah, and Jeshohaiah, and Asaiah, and Adiel, and Jesimiel, and Benaiah,

rr: Ziiza mwene Shiifi, Shiifi ya Alooni, Alooni ya Yedaaya, Yedaaya ya Shimuri, Shimuri ya Shemaaya.
en: and Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah;

rr: Abo abu amaziina gaabo gagambwa bakaba bari bakuru omu miryango yaabo, kandi amaju ga baishenkurubo gakakanya munonga.
en: these mentioned by their names were princes in their families: and the house of their fathers increased greatly.

rr: Baaza ahu orikutaahira nooza Gedori, aha bukiizi bw'oburugwa-izooba bw'oruhita, kutatira amasyo basbo obunyaatsi
en: And they went to the entrance of Gedor, even unto the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.

rr: baashangayo amariisizo marungi g'obunyaatsi, kandi ensi yaayo ekaba eri mpango munonga, eine obusingye, etuurize; ahabw'okuba abatuuzi baayo aba ira bakaba bari baijukuru ba Haamu.
en: And they found fat pasture and good, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceable; for they of Ham had dwelt there of old.

rr: 1 -38 ; 5:22 . Kandi aba, abu amaziina gaabo gahandiikirwe, bakija omu busingywe bwa Hezekia omugabe wa Yuda, baateera amahema g'aba Haamu, n'ag'aba Meuniimu abu baashangireyo, baabacwekyerereza kimwe, baahwaho, tibaagaruka kwimutsya mutwe n'okuhitsya hati, baakubuura ensi yaabo, ahabw'okuba hakaba hariyo amariisizo g'amasyo gaabo.
en: And these written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and smote their tents, and the habitations that were found there, and destroyed them utterly unto this day, and dwelt in their rooms: because there was pasture there for their flocks.

rr: Kandi abamwe aharibo, beene Simeoni, abashaija magana ataano baaza omu bibungo bya Seiri, baine abeebembezi baabo Pelatia, Nearia, Refaaya na Uzieli beene Iishi
en: And some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.

rr: baacwekyereza ekicweka ky'Abaameleki ekyabaire kihonokireho, baatuurayo okuruga obwo n'okuhitsya hati.
en: And they smote the rest of the Amalekites that were escaped, and dwelt there unto this day.

rr: -22 ; 49:3 , Beene Reubeeni omujigaijo gwa Israeli: (ahakuba niwe yaabaire ari omujigaijo, kwonka ahabw'okuhagara ekitabo kya ishe, yaayakwa obukuru bwe, bwaheebwa beene Yosefu mutabani wa Israeli; n'ahabw'ekyo omu kukuratana kw'amaziina tarahandiikirwe omu mwanya gw'obukuru
en: Now the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel, (for he was the firstborn; but, forasmuch as he defiled his father's bed, his birthright was given unto the sons of Joseph the son of Israel: and the genealogy is not to be reckoned after the birthright.

rr: -10 ; . kureka Yuda niwe yaakirize beene ishe amaani, kandi niwe yaakomookirwemu omutegyeki; kwonka obukuru bw'okuba omwana w'omujigaijo bwaguma buri obwa Yosefu.)
en: For Judah prevailed above his brethren, and of him came the chief ruler; but the birthright was Joseph's:)

rr: Batabani ba Reubeeni omujigaijo gwa Israeli: Hanoki, Palu, Hezirooni na Karumi.
en: the sons, I say , of Reuben the firstborn of Israel were , Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

rr: Batabani ba Yoeli: mutabani we ni Shemaaya, mwene Shemaaya ni Googi, mwene Googi ni Shimei
en: The sons of Joel; Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,

rr: mwene Shimei ni Niika, mwene Milka ni reaya, mwene Reaya ni Baali
en: Micah his son, Reaia his son, Baal his son,

rr: mwene Baali ni Beera; ogwo niwe Tigulaasi-pileseeri omugabe wa Asiria yaatwaire omu bukwatwa, kandi niwe yaabaire ari mukuru omu Bareubeeni.
en: Beerah his son, whom Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive: he was prince of the Reubenites.

rr: Beene waabo bakahandiikwa omu miryango yaabo, nk'okukuratana kw'oruzaaro rwabo oku kwabaire kuri; omukuru Yeyeli; na Zekaria
en: And his brethren by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was reckoned, were the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,

rr: na Beela, mwene Azazi mwijukuru wa Sheema mwene Yoeli owaabaire atwire Aroeri okuhika Neebo na Baali-meoni
en: and Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who dwelt in Aroer, even unto Nebo and Baal-meon:

rr: kandi akatuura aha bukiizi bw'oburugwa-izooba, ahu orikutaahira nooza omu ihamba seenu y'omugyera Furaati, ahakuba amatungo gaabo gakaba gakanyire omu nsi ya Gileadi.
en: and eastward he inhabited unto the entering in of the wilderness from the river Euphrates: because their cattle were multiplied in the land of Gilead.

rr: Bwanyima omu busingye bwa Saulo baarwana n'aba Hagari, baabaita; batyo baatuura omu mahema gaabo omu byanga byona eby'aha burugwa-izooba bwa Gileadi.
en: And in the days of Saul they made war with the Hagarites, who fell by their hand: and they dwelt in their tents throughout all the east land of Gilead.

rr: Beene Gaadi baatuura obuseeri bwabo omu nsi ya Bashani okuhika Saleka
en: And the children of Gad dwelt over against them, in the land of Bashan unto Salcah:

rr: Yoeli niwe yaabaire ari mukur, orikukurataho ari Shafamu, n'abandi Yanai na Shafati omuri Bashani.
en: Joel the chief, and Shapham the next, and Jaanai, and Shaphat in Bashan.

rr: Na beene waabo nk'amaju ga baishenkurubo oku gaabaire gari: Mikaeli, Meshulaamu, Sheeba, Yorai, Yakani, zia na Eberi, boona mushanju.
en: And their brethren of the house of their fathers were , Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jachan, and Zia, and Heber, seven.

rr: Aba nibo batabani ba Abihaili mwene Huuri, mwijukuru wa Yaroa, mwene Gileadi, Gileadi ya Mikaeli, Mikaeli ya Yeshishai, Yeshishai ya Yahudo, na Yahudo ya Buuzi
en: These are the children of Abihail the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;

rr: Ahi mwene Abudieli, mwijukuru wa Guuni, niwe yaabaire ari mukuru omu maju ga baishenkurubo.
en: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of the house of their fathers.

rr: abo bakaba batwire Gileadi n'omuri Bashani n'omu ndembo zaayo, kandi n'omu mariisizo goona ag'omuri Sharooni okuhika ahu garikugarukira.
en: And they dwelt in Gilead in Bashan, and in her towns, and in all the suburbs of Sharon, upon their borders.

rr: Abareubeeni n'Abagaadi n'ekicweka ky'oruganda rwa Manaase bakaba baine abashaija amamanzi, abaabaire bahagatira engabo na zaarurara, nibamanya kurwanisa amata, abarwani rukungwa, boona bari obukumi buna n'enkumi ina na magana mushanju na makumi mukaaga, abeeteekateekire kuhurura.
en: The sons of Reuben, and the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, and to shoot with bow, and skilful in war, were four and forty thousand seven hundred and threescore, that went out to the war.

rr: Baateera aba Hagari, aba Yeturi, aba Nafishi n'aba Nodabu.
en: And they made war with the Hagarites, with Jetur, and Nephish, and Nodab.

rr: Ku baabaire nibakirwana nabo, baakwerwa, aba Hagari na boona abu baabaire baine baaheebwayo omu mikono yaabo, ahakuba bakatakira Ruhanga omuri orwo rugamba, yaahurira okweshengyereza kwabo, ahabw'okuba bakamwesiga.
en: And they were helped against them, and the Hagarites were delivered into their hand, and all that were with them: for they cried to God in the battle, and he was intreated of them; because they put their trust in him.

rr: Baanyaga amatungo gaabo, engamira obukumi butaano, entaama obusiriira bubiri n'obukumi butaano, n'endogoya enkumi ibiri, kandi n'abashaija akasiriira abaakwatsirwe
en: And they took away their cattle; of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred and fifty thousand, and of asses two thousand, and of men an hundred thousand.

rr: ahakuba baingi bakaitwa, ahabw'okuba orwo rugamba rukaba rurugire ahari Ruhanga. Bwanyima baatuura omu nsi ya bari, okuhitsya obu baatwairwe omu bukwatwa.
en: For there fell down many slain, because the war was of God. And they dwelt in their steads until the captivity.

rr: Ab'ekicweka ky'oruganda rwa Manaase baatuura omuri egyo nsi, bari baingi munonga, okuruga Bashani okuhika Baali-herumooni, na Seniiri n'orushozi Herumooni.
en: And the children of the half tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land: they increased from Bashan unto Baal-hermon and Senir, and unto mount Hermon.

rr: Kandi aba nibo baabaire bari bakuru omu maju ga baishenkurubo: Eferi, Iishi, Elieli, Azurieli, Yeremia, Hodavia na Yahudieli, abarwani b'amaani, abashaija rugambwa, abaabaire bari bakuru omu maju ga baishenkurubo.
en: And these were the heads of the house of their fathers, even Epher, and Ishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty men of valour, famous men, and heads of the house of their fathers.

rr: Kwonka bakacumura ahari Ruhanga wa baishenkurubo, baakuratira baaruhanga b'amahanga g'omuri egyo nsi nk'abarikuraaya, agu Ruhanga yaabacwekyerereize omumaisho.
en: And they transgressed against the God of their fathers, and went a whoring after the gods of the people of the land, whom God destroyed before them.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo Ruhanga wa Israeli yaimutsya Puuli omugabe wa Asiria na Tigulaasi-pileseeri omugabe wa Asiria, yaatwara Abareubeeni, Abagaadi n'ekicweka ky'oruganda rwa Manaase bari enkwatwa, yaabata Haala, Habora, Haara n'aha mugyera ogw'omuri Gozani, baagumayo n'okuhitsya hati.
en: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried them away, even the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, and brought them unto Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and to the river Gozan, unto this day.

Batabani ba Leevi: Gereshoni, Kohasi na Meraei.
en: The sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

rr: Batabani ba Kohasi: Amuraamu, Izuhaari, Heburooni na Uzieli.
en: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.

rr: Abaana ba amuraamu: Arooni, Musa na Miriamu. Batabani ba Arooni: Nadabu, Abihu, Eleazaari na Itamaari.
en: And the children of Amram; Aaron, and Moses, and Miriam. The sons also of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

rr: 1 -14 ; -5 ; . Eleazaari yaazaara Finehaasi, Finehaasi yaazaara Abishua
en: Eleazar begat Phinehas, Phinehas begat Abishua,

rr: Abishua yaazaara Buuki, Buuki yaazaara Uuzi
en: and Abishua begat Bukki, and Bukki begat Uzzi,

rr: 1 -53 ; 9:11 ; . Uuzi yaazaara Zerahia, Zerahia yaazaara Merayoosi
en: and Uzzi begat Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begat Meraioth,

rr: Merayoosi yaazaara Amaria, Amaria yaazaara Ahitubu
en: Meraioth begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,

rr: Ahitubu yaazaara Zadoki, zadoki yaazaara Ahimaazi
en: and Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Ahimaaz,

rr: Ahimaazi yaazaara Azaria, Azaria yaazaara Yohanaani
en: and Ahimaaz begat Azariah, and Azariah begat Johanan,

rr: Yohanaani yaazaara Azaria, (ogwo niwe yaabaire akora omurimo gw'obunyamurwa omu nju ei Sulemaani yaayombekire Yerusaalemu).
en: and Johanan begat Azariah, (he it is that executed the priest's office in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem:)

rr: Azaria yaazaara, Amaria, Amaria yaazaara Ahitubu
en: and Azariah begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,

rr: Ahitubu yaazaara Zadoki, Zadoki yaazaara Shalumu
en: and Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Shallum,

rr: Shalumu yaazaara Hilukia, Hilukia yaazaara Azaria
en: and Shallum begat Hilkiah, and Hilkiah begat Azariah,

rr: Azaria yaazaara Seraaya, Seraaya yaazaara Yehozadaki
en: and Azariah begat Seraiah, and Seraiah begat Jehozadak,

rr: 2 -21 ; . owaatwairwe omu bukwatwa, obu MUKAMA yaimutsya Nebukadeneeza, akatwara Abayuda n'aba Yerusaalemu omu bukwatwa.
en: and Jehozadak went into captivity , when the LORD carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.

rr: Batabani ba Leevi: Gereshoni, Kohasi na Merari.
en: The sons of Levi; Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.

rr: Kandi aga nigo maziina ga batabani ba Gereshoni: Libuni na Shimei.
en: And these be the names of the sons of Gershom; Libni, and Shimei.

rr: Batabani ba Kohasi: Amuraamu, Isuhaari, Heburooni na Uzieli.
en: And the sons of Kohath were , Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.

rr: Batabani ba Merari: Mahili na Muushi. Egi niyo miryango y'Abaleevi nk'oku baishenkuru baabaire bari.
en: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. And these are the families of the Levites according to their fathers.

rr: 1 Aba Gereshoni: omutabani ni Libuni, mwene Libuni ni Yahasi, mwene Yahasi ni Ziima
en: Of Gershom; Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,

rr: mwene Ziima ni Yoa, mwene Yoa ni Iido, mwene Iido ni zeera, mwene Zeera ni Yeaserai.
en: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeaterai his son.

rr: mwene Asiri ni Elukaana, mwene Elukaana ni Ebiasaafu, mwene Ebiasaafu ni Asiri
en: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,

rr: mwene Ariri ni Tahasi, mwene Tahasi ni Urieli, mwene Urieli ni Uziya, mwene Uziya ni Shauli.
en: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.

rr: Batabani ba Elukaana: Amasai na Ahimoosi
en: And the sons of Elkanah; Amasai, and Ahimoth.

rr: omutabani ni Elukaana, mwene Elukaana ni Zofai, mwene Zofai ni Nahasi
en: As for Elkanah: the sons of Elkanah; Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,

rr: mwene Nahasi ni Eliabu, mwene Eliabu ni Yerohaamu, mwene Yerohaamu ni Elukaana.
en: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.

rr: Batabani ba Samueli: omujigaijo gwe ni Yoeli, n'omushubiro ni Abiya.
en: And the sons of Samuel; the firstborn Vashni, and Abiah.

rr: Batabani ba Merari: Mahili, mwene Mahili ni Libuni, mwene Libuni ni Shimei, mwene Shimei ni Uuza
en: The sons of Merari; Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzza his son,

rr: mwene Uuza ni Shimea, mwene Shimea ni Hagia, mwene Hagia ni Asaaya.
en: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.

rr: 2 -17 ; 1 —16:1. Abo nibo Daudi yaakwatsize omurimo gw'okweshongora omu nju ya MUKAMA, eshanduukye eherize kuza hamwe
en: And these are they whom David set over the service of song in the house of the LORD , after that the ark had rest.

rr: baaguma nibeeshongora omu maisho g'Obutaaho bw'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu omu kuheereza kwabo, okuhitsya obu Sulemaani yaaherize kwombeka enju ya MUKAMA omuri Yerusaalemu; kandi baakora omurimo gwabo, nk'oku embu zaabo zaabaire ziri.
en: And they ministered before the dwelling place of the tabernacle of the congregation with singing, until Solomon had built the house of the LORD in Jerusalem: and then they waited on their office according to their order.

rr: Aba nibo baabaire baheereza hamwe na batabani baabo.
en: And these are they that waited with their children.

rr: Omuri beene Kohasi: Hemani omweshongozi mwne Yoeli, Yoeli ya Samueli
en: Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman a singer, the son of Joel, the son of Shemuel,

rr: Samueli ya Elukaana, Elukaana ya Yerohaamu, Yerohaamu ya Elieli, Elieli ya Toa
en: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,

rr: Toa ya Zuufi, Zuufi ya Elukaana, Elukaana ya Mahasi, Mahasi ya Amasai
en: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,

rr: Amasai ya Elukaana, Elukaana ya Yoeli, Yoeli ya Azaria, Azaria ya Zefania
en: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,

rr: Zefania ya Tahasi, Tahasi ya Asiri, Asiri ya Ebiasaafu, Ebiasaafu ya Koora
en: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,

rr: Koora ya Izuhaari, Izuhaari ya Kohasi, mwene Leevi, omwana wa Israeli.
en: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.

rr: Murumuna wa Hemani ni Asafu owaabaire ayemerera aha rubaju rwe rwa buryo, niwe Asafu mwene Berekia, Berekia mwene Shimea
en: And his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berachiah, the son of Shimea,

rr: Shimea ya Mikaeli, Mikaeli ya Baseya, Baseyaya Malikiya
en: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchiah,

rr: Malikiya ya Esuni, Esuni ya Zeera, Zeera ya Adaaya
en: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,

rr: Adaaya ya Esaani, Esaani ya Ziima, Ziima ya Shimei
en: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,

rr: Shimei ya Yahasi, Yahasi mwene Gereshoni, omwana wa Leevi.
en: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.

rr: Maluki ya Hashabia, Hashabia ya Amazia, Amazia ya Hilukia
en: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,

rr: Hilukia ya Amuzi, amuzi ya Baani, Baani ya Shemeri
en: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shamer,

rr: Kandi beene waabo Abaleevi bakateebwaho kukora omurimo gwona ogw'omu Butaaho bw'enju ya Ruhanga.
en: Their brethren also the Levites were appointed unto all manner of service of the tabernacle of the house of God. Sons of Aaron

rr: -9 ; 4:20 . Kwonka Arooni n'abatabani bakaba batambira ebitambo aha itambiro ry'ebitambo by'okwotsya, n'aha itambiro ry'okwotereraho obubaane ahabw'omurimo gwona ogw'Aharikwera munonga, okurihiirira Abaisraeli, nk'ebi Musa omwiru wa Ruhanga yaaragiire byona oku byabaire biri.
en: But Aaron and his sons offered upon the altar of the burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, and were appointed for all the work of the place most holy, and to make an atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.

rr: 1 Abo nibo batabani ba Arooni: Eleazaari omutabani, mwene eleazaari ni Finehaasi, mwene Finehaasi ni Abishua
en: And these are the sons of Aaron; Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,

rr: mwene Abishua ni Buuki, mwene Buuki ni Uuzi, mwene Uuzi ni Zerahia
en: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,

rr: mwene Zerahia ni Merayosi, mwene Merayoosi na Amaria, mwene Amaria ni Ahitubu
en: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,

rr: mwene Ahitubu ni Zadoki, mwene Zadoki ni Ahimaazi.
en: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.

rr: Kandi ebi nibyo bibanja byabo ebi baabaire batwiremu, nk'oku baabahaire ah'okutuura omu nsi yaabo yoona; beene Arooni ab'omu miryango y'aba Kohasi, ahabw'okuba omugabo gw'okubanza gukaba guri ogwabo.
en: Now these are their dwelling places throughout their castles in their coasts, of the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites: for their's was the lot.

rr: bakabaha Heburooni omu ishaza rya Yuda n'amariisizo gaayo agaagyehinguririize
en: And they gave them Hebron in the land of Judah, and the suburbs thereof round about it.

rr: kwonka emisiri y'orurembo n'ebirorero byarwo baabiha Kalebu mwene Yefune.
en: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

rr: Beene Arooni abandi baabaha endembo ez'okuhungiramu- Heburooni, Libuna n'amariisizo gaayo, Yatiri, Eshitemoa n'amariisizo gaayo
en: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of Judah, namely , Hebron, the city of refuge, and Libnah with her suburbs, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa, with their suburbs,

rr: Hileeni n'amariisizo gaayo, Debira n'amarisiizo gaayo
en: and Hilen with her suburbs, Debir with her suburbs,

rr: Ashani n'amariisizo gaayo, na Beti-shemeshi n'amariisizo gaayo
en: and Ashan with her suburbs, and Beth-shemesh with her suburbs:

rr: kandi omu z'oruganda rwa Benyamiini baabaha Geeba n'amariisizo gaayo, Alemeesi n'amariisizo gaayo, na Anatoosi n'amariisizo gaayo.
en: and out of the tribe of Benjamin; Geba with her suburbs, and Alemeth with her suburbs, and Anathoth with her suburbs.

rr: Endembo zaabo zoona ezi baabagaine omu miryango yaabo yoona zaaba ikumi na ishatu.
en: All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.

rr: 1 -70 ; . Beene Kohasi abandi baaheebwa omugabo gw'endembo ikumi omu kicweka ky'oruganda rwa Manaase.
en: And unto the sons of Kohath, which were left of the family of that tribe, were cities given out of the half tribe, namely, out of the half tribe of Manasseh, by lot, ten cities.

rr: Beene Gereshoni, nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri, baaheebwa endembo ikumi na ishatu omu ruganda rwa Isakaari, orwa Asheri, orwa Nafutaali n'orwa Manaase omuri Bashani.
en: And to the sons of Gershom throughout their families out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

rr: Beene Merari nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri baabaha endembo ikumi na ibiri omu ruganda rwa Reubeeni, orwa Gaadi, n'orwa zebuluuni.
en: Unto the sons of Merari were given by lot, throughout their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

rr: Batyo Abaisraeli baaha Abaleevi ezo ndembo n'amariisizo gaazo.
en: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites these cities with their suburbs.

rr: 1 Kandi baagaruka baabahaisa enteenyu ezo ndembo ezaagambwaho ez'omu ruganda rwa Yuda, orwa Simeoni n'orwa Benyamiini.
en: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities, which are called by their names.

rr: Kandi bamwe ab'omu miryango y'aba Kohasi bakaba baine endembo omu ruganda rwa Efuraimu.
en: And the residue of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their coasts out of the tribe of Ephraim.

rr: Baaheebwa n'endembo z'okuhungiramu- Shekemu ey'omu nsi y'ebibungo eya Efuraimu n'amariisizo gaayo, Gezeri n'amariisizo gaayo
en: And they gave unto them, of the cities of refuge, Shechem in mount Ephraim with her suburbs; they gave also Gezer with her suburbs,

rr: Yokimeamu n'amariisizo gaayo, Besihoroni n'amariisizo gaayo
en: and Jokmeam with her suburbs, and Beth-horon with her suburbs,

rr: Ayalooni n'amariisizo gaayo, na Gaasi-rimoni n'amariisizo gaayo
en: and Aijalon with her suburbs, and Gath-rimmon with her suburbs:

rr: kandi omu kicweka ky'oruganda rwa Manaase Aneri n'amariisizo gaayo, na Bileamu n'amariisizo gaayo ahabw'emiryango y'aba Kohasi eyaatsigaireho.
en: and out of the half tribe of Manasseh; Aner with her suburbs, and Bileam with her suburbs, for the family of the remnant of the sons of Kohath.

rr: -33 ; . Beene Gereshoni baaheebwa endembo omu kicweka ky'oruganda rwa Manaase- Golani ey'omuri Bashani n'amariisizo gaayo, Ashitaroosi n'amariisizo gaayo
en: Unto the sons of Gershom were given out of the family of the half tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, and Ashtaroth with her suburbs:

rr: omu ruganda rwa Isakaari- Kedeshi n'amariisizo gaayo, Daberaasi n'amariisizo gaayo
en: and out of the tribe of Issachar; Kedesh with her suburbs, Daberath with her suburbs,

rr: Ramosi n'amariisizo gaayo, na Anemu n'amariisizo gaayo
en: and Ramoth with her suburbs, and Anem with her suburbs:

rr: omu ruganda rwa Asheri–Mashari n'amariisizo gaayo, Abudooni n'amariisizo gaayo
en: and out of the tribe of Asher; Mashal with her suburbs, and Abdon with her suburbs,

rr: Hukoki n'amariisizo gaayo, na Rehobu n'amariisizo gaayo
en: and Hukok with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs:

rr: omu ruganda rwa Nafutaali- Kedeshi ey'omuri Galilaaya n'amariisizo gaayo, na kiryasaimu n'amariisizo gaayo.
en: and out of the tribe of Naphtali; Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, and Hammon with her suburbs, and Kirjathaim with her suburbs.

rr: Beene Merari abandi baaheebwa omu ruganda rwa Zebuluuni rimono n'amariisizo gaayo, Tabori n'amariisizo gaayo
en: Unto the rest of the children of Merari were given out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmon with her suburbs, Tabor with her suburbs:

rr: na seeri ya Yorudani ahari Yeriko, aha rubaju rwayo rw'oburugwa-izooba omu ruganda rwa Reubeeni, Bezeeri ey'omu ihamba n'amariisizo gaayo, Yahuza n'amariisizo gaayo
en: and on the other side Jordan by Jericho, on the east side of Jordan, were given them out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness with her suburbs, and Jahzah with her suburbs,

rr: Kedemoosi n'amariisizo gaayo na Mefaasi n'amariisizo gaayo
en: Kedemoth also with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs:

rr: kandi omu ruganda rwa Gaadi Ramosi ey'omuri Gileadi n'amariisizo gaayo, Mahanaimu n'amariisizo gaayo
en: and out of the tribe of Gad; Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, and Mahanaim with her suburbs,

rr: Heshibooni n'amariisizo gaayo, na Yazeri n'amarisiizo gaayo.
en: and Heshbon with her suburbs, and Jazer with her suburbs.

rr: Batabani ba Isakaari: Toola, Pua, Yashubu, na Shimirooni, boona bana.
en: Now the sons of Issachar were , Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimrom, four.

rr: Batabani ba Toola: Uuzi, Refaaya, Yerieli, Yahumai, Ibusaamu na Shemueli, abakuru b'amaju ga baishenkurubo, nibo beene Toola, abaabaire bari abarwani b'amaani omu biro byabo; omu busingye bwa Daudi omubaro gwabo bakaba bari obukumi bubiri n'enkumi ibiri na magana mukaaga.
en: And the sons of Tola; Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Jibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their father's house, to wit , of Tola: they were valiant men of might in their generations; whose number was in the days of David two and twenty thousand and six hundred.

rr: Mutabani wa Uuzi: Izurahia. Batabani ba Izurahia: Mikaeli, Obadia, Yoeli na Ishia, boona bataano bakaba bari abantu bakuru
en: And the sons of Uzzi; Izrahiah: and the sons of Izrahiah; Michael, and Obadiah, and Joel, Ishiah, five: all of them chief men.

rr: kandi omuribo, nk'okukuratana kw'oruzaaro rw'amaju ga baishenkurubo oku kwabaire kuri, hakaba harimu emitwe y'engabo z'okuza aha rugamba obukumi bushantu n'enkumi mukaaga, ahabw'okuba bakaba baine abakazi baingi n'abaana b'aboojo baingi.
en: And with them, by their generations, after the house of their fathers, were bands of soldiers for war, six and thirty thousand men: for they had many wives and sons.

rr: Kandi beene waabo ab'omu miryango yoona y'Abaisakaari bakaba bari abarwani obukumi munaana n'enkumi mushanju, nk'oku baahandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'okuzaarwa kwabo.
en: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar were valiant men of might, reckoned in all by their genealogies fourscore and seven thousand. Benjamin and Naphtali

rr: Batabani ba Benyamiini: Beela, Bekeri na Yedieli, bashatu.
en: The sons of Benjamin; Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.

rr: Batabani ba Beela: Ezibooni, Uuzi, Uzieli, Yerimoosi na Iiri, bataano, abakuru b'amaju ga baishenkurubo, kandi abarwani b'amaani; bakaba bari obukumi bubiri n'enkumi ibiri na makumi mukaaga na bana, nk'oku baahandiikirwe omu kukuratana kw'oruzaaro rwabo.
en: And the sons of Bela; Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour; and were reckoned by their genealogies twenty and two thousand and thirty and four.

rr: Batabani ba Bekeri; Zemira, Yoasi, Eliezeeri, Elio-enai, Omuri, Yeremoosi, Abiya, Anatoosi na Alemeesi.
en: And the sons of Becher; Zemira, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jerimoth, and Abiah, and Anathoth, and Alameth. All these are the sons of Becher.

rr: Abo boona bakaba bari beene Bekeeri; omu kubarwa kw'okukuratana kw'oruzaaro rw'abakuru b'amaju ga baishenkurubo nk'oku kwabaire kuri, bakaba bari abarwani b'amaani obukumi bubiri na magana abiri.
en: And the number of them, after their genealogy by their generations, heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour, was twenty thousand and two hundred.

rr: Mutabani wa Yedieli: Biluhaani: Yeushi, Benyamiini, Ehudi, Kenaana, Zesaani, Tarushiishi na Ahishahaari.
en: The sons also of Jediael; Bilhan: and the sons of Bilhan; Jeush, and Benjamin, and Ehud, and Chenaanah, and Zethan, and Tharshish, and Ahishahar.

rr: Abo boona bakaba bari beene Yedieli; omu kubarwa kw'abakuru b'amaju ga baishenkurubo abashaija abarwani b'amaani baaba kakumi n'enkumi mushanju na magana abiri, abeeteekateekire kuza aha rugamba.
en: All these the sons of Jediael, by the heads of their fathers, mighty men of valour, were seventeen thousand and two hundred soldiers , fit to go out for war and battle.

rr: Shupimu na Hupimu beene Iiri, Hushimu mwene Aheri.
en: Shuppim also, and Huppim, the children of Ir, and Hushim, the sons of Aher.

rr: Batabani ba Nafutaali: Yahazieli, Guuni, Yezeri na Shalumu, ab'oruzaaro rwa Biluha.
en: The sons of Naphtali; Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah. Joseph's Family

rr: Batabani ba Manaase: Asirieli owaazairwe ekinyanshunju Omunyaaramu; kandi niwe yaazaire Makiri ishe wa Gileadi.
en: The sons of Manasseh; Ashriel, whom she bare: ( but his concubine the Aramitess bare Machir the father of Gilead:

rr: Makiri yaashwererera Hupimu na Shupimu. Munyaanya akaba naayetwa Zelofehaadi; kandi Zelofehaadi ogwo akazaara abaishiki bonka.
en: and Machir took to wife the sister of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister's name was Maachah;) and the name of the second was Zelophehad: and Zelophehad had daughters.

rr: Maaka muka Makiri yaazaara omwana w'omwojo, yaamweta Pereshi; n'omurumuna akaba naayetwa Shereshi; batabani be baaba Ulamu na Rakemu.
en: And Maachah the wife of Machir bare a son, and she called his name Peresh; and the name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.

rr: Mutabani wa Ulamu: Bedani. Abo nibo baabaire bari beene Gileadi mwene Makiri, mwijukuru wa Manaase.
en: And the sons of Ulam; Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.

rr: Hamolekesi munyaanya yaazaara Ishihoodi, Abiezeeri na Mahula.
en: And his sister Hammoleketh bare Ishod, and Abiezer, and Mahalah.

rr: Batabani ba Shemida bakaba bari Ahiani, Shekemu, Likuhi na Aniamu.
en: And the sons of Shemidah were, Ahian, and Shechem, and Likhi, and Aniam.

rr: Batabani ba Efuraimu: Shuseela, mwene Shuseela ni Beredi, mwne Beredi ni Tahasi, mwene Tahasi ni Eleada, mwene Eleada ni Tahasi
en: And the sons of Ephraim; Shuthelah, and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eladah his son, and Tahath his son,

rr: mwene Tahasi ni zabadi, mwene Zabadi ni Shuseela, kandi na Ezeri na Eleada abaitsirwe abashaija ba Gaasi abazaariirwe omuri egyo nsi, ahabw'okuba bakashuumayo kunyaga ente zaabo.
en: and Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath that were born in that land slew, because they came down to take away their cattle.

rr: Bwanyima Efuraimu ishebo yaamara ebiro bingi naabacurira, beene ishe baija kumugumya.
en: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.

rr: Ku haahingwireho ebiro, Efuraimu yaabyama n'omukazi we, omukazi yaagira enda, yaazaara omwana w'omwojo, yaamweta Beria, ahakuba enju ye ekaguubwaho akabi.
en: And when he went in to his wife, she conceived, and bare a son, and he called his name Beriah, because it went evil with his house.

rr: Muhara we akaba naayetwa Sheera owaayombekire Besi-horoni zombi, eya ifo n'eya uguru, na Uzene-sheera.
en: (And his daughter was Sherah, who built Beth-horon the nether, and the upper, and Uzzen-sherah.)

rr: Mutabani we ni Reefa, mwene Reefa ni Reshefu, mwene Reshefu ni Teela, mwene Teela ni Tahani
en: And Rephah was his son, also Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son,

rr: mwene Tahani ni Ladani, mwene Ladani ni Amihuudi, mwene Amihuudi ni Elishaama
en: Laadan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,

rr: mwene Elishaama ni Nuuni, mwene Nuuni ni Yoshua.
en: Non his son, Jehoshuah his son.

rr: Kandi ebibanja byabo n'ebi baabaire batungire bikaba biri Beseeli n'omu ndembo zaayo, aha bukiizi bw'oburugwa-izooba Narani, aha burengyerwa-izooba Gezeri n'endembo zaayo, Shekemu n'endembo zaayo na Aaza n'endembo zaayo
en: And their possessions and habitations were , Beth-el and the towns thereof, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer, with the towns thereof; Shechem also and the towns thereof, unto Gaza and the towns thereof:

rr: kandi n'aha myatano y'Abamanaase Besi-sheani n'endembo zaayo, Tanaki n'endembo zaayo na Doori n'endembo zaayo. Omuri ezo ndembo beene Yosefu mwene Israeli nimwo baabaire batwire.
en: and by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth-shean and her towns, Taanach and her towns, Megiddo and her towns, Dor and her towns. In these dwelt the children of Joseph the son of Israel. Sons of Asher

rr: Batabani ba Ashera: Imuna, Ishuva, Ishuvi, Beria na munyaanya waabo Seera.
en: The sons of Asher; Imnah, and Isuah, and Ishuai, and Beriah, and Serah their sister.

rr: Batabani ba Beria: Heberi na Malikieli owaabaire ari ishe wa Biruzaisi.
en: And the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel, who is the father of Birzavith.

rr: Heberi yaazaara Yafuleeti, Shomeri, Hosamu na munyaanya waabo Shua.
en: And Heber begat Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.

rr: Batabani ba Yafuleeti Pasaki, Bimuhaali na Ashuvaati. Abo nibo beene Yafuleeti.
en: And the sons of Japhlet; Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.

rr: Batabani ba Shemeri omurumuna: Rohuga, Yehuba, na Aramu.
en: And the sons of Shamer; Ahi, and Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.

rr: Batabani ba Helemu omurumuna: Zoofa, Imuna, Sheleshi na Amali.
en: And the sons of his brother Helem; Zophah, and Imna, and Shelesh, and Amal.

rr: Batabani ba Zoofa: Sia, Harunefeeri, Shuali, Beeri, Imura
en: The sons of Zophah; Suah, and Harnepher, and Shual, and Beri, and Imrah,

rr: Bezeeri, Hoodi, Shama, Shilusha, Ituraani na Beera.
en: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera.

rr: Batabani ba Yeseri: Yefune, Pisupa na Araa.
en: And the sons of Jether; Jephunneh, and Pispah, and Ara.

rr: Batabani ba Uula: Aara, Hanieli na Rizia.
en: And the sons of Ulla; Arah, and Haniel, and Rezia.

rr: Abo boona bakaba bari beene Asheri, abakuru b'amaju ga baishenkurubo, abashaija abarikusiimwa, abarwani b'amaani, abakuru b'abategyeki.
en: All these were the children of Asher, heads of their father's house, choice and mighty men of valour, chief of the princes.

rr: Kandi omubaro ogw'abahandiikirwe kuza aha rugamba, nk'okukuratana kw'oruzaaro rwabo oku kwabaire kuri, gukaba guri obukumi bubiri n'enkumi mukaaga.
en: And the number throughout the genealogy of them that were apt to the war and to battle was twenty and six thousand men.

rr: Benyamiini yaajigaija Beela, yaakuratsaho Ashubeeli, owa kashatu yaaba Ahara
en: Now Benjamin begat Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,

rr: owa kana yaaba Nooha n'owa kataano yaaba Raafa.
en: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

rr: Beela nawe yaazaara abaana b'aboojo: Adari, Geera, Abihuudi
en: And the sons of Bela were, Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,

rr: Abishua, Naamani, Ahoa
en: and Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,

rr: Geera, Shefufaani na Huraamu.
en: and Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.

rr: Kandi aba nibo batabani ba Ehudi, (nibo babaire bari abakuru b'amaju ga baishenkuru b'abatuuzi ba Geeba, abaatwairwe omu bukwatwa, bakabata Manahaasi)
en: And these are the sons of Ehud: these are the heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Geba, and they removed them to Manahath:

rr: Naamani, Ahiya na Geera, niwe Hegulaamu, ishe wa Uuza na Ahihuudi.
en: and Naaman, and Ahiah, and Gera, he removed them, and begat Uzza, and Ahihud.

rr: Shaharaimu, ku yaaherize kushenda abakazi be Hushimu na Baara, yaazaarira abaana b'aboojo omu nsi ya Moabu.
en: And Shaharaim begat children in the country of Moab, after he had sent them away; Hushim and Baara were his wives.

rr: Yaazaara aha mukazi we Hodeshi abatabani, Yobabu, Zibia, Mesha, Malukaamu
en: And he begat of Hodesh his wife, Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcham,

rr: Yeusi, Sakia na Miruma. Abo nibo batabani abaabaire bari abakuru b'amaju ga baishenkurubo.
en: and Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirma. These were his sons, heads of the fathers.

rr: Kandi Hushimu abaana b'aboojo Ahitubu na Elipaali
en: And of Hushim he begat Abitub, and Elpaal.

rr: Batabani ba Elipaali: Eberi, Mishamu, Shemedi owaayombekire Ono na Loodi n'endembo zaayo
en: The sons of Elpaal; Eber, and Misham, and Shamed, who built Ono, and Lod, with the towns thereof:

rr: Beria na Sheema abaabaire bari abakuru b'amaju ga baishenkurubo b'abatuuzi ba Ayalooni, abaagingire abatuuzi ba Gaasi
en: Beriah also, and Shema, who were heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who drove away the inhabitants of Gath:

rr: Ahio, Shashaki na Yeremoosi.
en: and Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth,

rr: Batabani ba Beria: Zebadia, Aradi, Ederi
en: and Zebadiah, and Arad, and Ader,

rr: Mikaeli, Ishupa na Yooha.
en: and Michael, and Ispah, and Joha, the sons of Beriah;

rr: Batabani ba Elipaali: Zebedia, Meshulaamu, Hizuki, Heberi
en: and Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hezeki, and Heber,

rr: Ishimerai, Izulia na Yobabu.
en: Ishmerai also, and Jezliah, and Jobab, the sons of Elpaal;

rr: Batabani ba Shimei: Yahimu, Zikuri, Zabudi
en: and Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,

rr: Elienai, zilesai, Elieli
en: and Elienai, and Zilthai, and Eliel,

rr: Adaya, Beraaya na Shimuraasi.
en: and Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath, the sons of Shimhi;

rr: Batabani ba Shashaki: Ishupaani, Eberi, Elieli
en: and Ishpan, and Heber, and Eliel,

rr: Abudooni, Zikuru, Hanani
en: and Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,

rr: Hanania, Elamu, Antosiya
en: and Hananiah, and Elam, and Antothijah,

rr: Ifodwa na Penueli.
en: and Iphedeiah, and Penuel, the sons of Shashak;

rr: Batabani ba Yerohaamu: Shamusherai, Sheharia, Atalia
en: and Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,

rr: Yareshia, Eliya na zikuri.
en: and Jaresiah, and Eliah, and Zichri, the sons of Jeroham.

rr: Abo nibo baabaire bari abakuru b'amaju ga baishenkurubo, nk'oku kuratana kw'oruzaaro rwabo oku kwabaire kuri, abantu bakuru. Abo bakaba batwire Yerusaalemu.
en: These were heads of the fathers, by their generations, chief men . These dwelt in Jerusalem.

rr: 1 Yeyeli ishe wa Gibeoni akaba atwire Gibeoni, omukazi we akaba naayetwa Maaka.
en: And at Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon; whose wife's name was Maachah:

rr: Omwana we w'omujigaijo akaba ari Abudooni, naakuratwa Zuuri, Kiishi, Baali, Nadabu
en: and his firstborn son Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,

rr: Gedori, Ahio, Zekeri
en: and Gedor, and Ahio, and Zacher.

rr: na Mikuloosi owaazaire Shimea. Abo nabo bakaba batwire na beene waabo omuri Yerusaalemu nibareebana.
en: And Mikloth begat Shimeah. And these also dwelt with their brethren in Jerusalem, over against them. House of Saul

rr: 1 Neeri yaazaara Kiishi, Kiishi yaazaara Saulo, Saulo yaazaara Yonasaani, Malikishua, Abinadabu na Eshibaali.
en: And Ner begat Kish, and Kish begat Saul, and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchi-shua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

rr: Yonasaani yaazaara Meribubaali, Meribu-baali yaazaara Miika.
en: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal; and Merib-baal begat Micah.

rr: Batabani ba Miika: Pisoni, Meleki, Tarea na Ahazi.
en: And the sons of Micah were , Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.

rr: Ahazi yaazaara Yehoada, Yehoada yaazaara Alemeesi, Azimaveesi na Zimuri, Zimuri yaazaara Mooza
en: And Ahaz begat Jehoadah; and Jehoadah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza,

rr: Mooza yaazaara Binea; mwene Binea ni Raafa, mwene Raafa ni Eleasa, mwene Eleasa ni Azeeli.
en: and Moza begat Binea: Rapha was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son:

rr: Azeeli akaba aine aboojo mukaaga, n'amaziina gaabo nigo aga, Azurikaamu, Bokeru, Ishimaeli, Shearia, Obadia na Hanani.
en: and Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan.

rr: Abo boona ni beene Azeeli.
en: All these were the sons of Azel.

rr: Beene Esheki omurumuna: Ulaamu omujigaijo gwe, omushubiro Yeushi, n'owa kashatu Elifeleti.
en: And the sons of Eshek his brother were , Ulam his firstborn, Jehush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

rr: Beene Ulaamu bakaba bari abarwani b'amaani, enkwata-mata, kandi bakaba baine abatabani n'abaijukuru baingi, omubaro gwabo guri igana na makumi ataano.
en: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valour, archers, and had many sons, and sons' sons, an hundred and fifty.

rr: Abo boona bakaba bari Ababenyamiini.
en: All these are of the sons of Benjamin.
