rr: Batyo Abaisraeli boona bakabarwa nk'okukuratana kw'oruzaaro rwabo oku kwabaire kuri; kandi bahandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'eby'omu busingye bw'abagabe ba Israeli. Bwanyima Abayuda baatwarwa Babulooni omu bukwatwa ahabw'ebicumuro byabo.
en: So all Israel were reckoned by genealogies; and, behold, they were written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah, who were carried away to Babylon for their transgression.

rr: Abaabandize kugaruka kutuura omu buhunguzi bwabo n'omu ndembo zaabo bakaba bari Abaisraeli, abanyamurwa, Abaleevi n'abaheereza b'omuri hekalu.
en: Now the first inhabitants that dwelt in their possessions in their cities were , the Israelites, the priests, Levites, and the Nethinims.

rr: Kandi bamwe aha Bayuda, Ababenyamiini, Abaefuraimu n'Abamanaase bakatuura omuri Yerusaalemu
en: And in Jerusalem dwelt of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim, and Manasseh;

rr: Usai mwene Amihuudi, Amihuudi ya Omuri, Omuri ya Baani, ab'omuri beene Pereezi mwene Yuda.
en: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Pharez the son of Judah.

rr: N'aba Shiilo: omujigaijo gwe ni Asaaya n'abatabani.
en: And of the Shilonites; Asaiah the firstborn, and his sons.

rr: Ab'omuri batabani ba Zeera: Yeuli na beene waabo magana mukaaga na makumi mwenda.
en: And of the sons of Zerah; Jeuel, and their brethren, six hundred and ninety.

rr: Ab'omuri beene Benyamiini: Saalu mwene Meshulaamu ya Hodavia, Hodavia ya Hasenua
en: And of the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hasenuah,

rr: na Ibunea mwene Yerohaamu, na Eela mwene Uuzi ya Makiri, na Meshulaamu mwene Shefatia ya Reuli mwene Ibunia
en: and Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri, and Meshullam the son of Shephathiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;

rr: na beene waabo nk'okukuratana kw'oruzaaro rwabo oku kwabaire kuri, bakaba bari magana mwenda na makumi ataano na mukaaga.
en: and their brethren, according to their generations, nine hundred and fifty and six.

rr: Abo boona bakaba bari abakuru b'amaju ga baishenkurubo, nk'oku gaabaire gari.
en: All these men were chief of the fathers in the house of their fathers.

rr: 1 -13 ; Ab'omu banyamurwa: Yedaaya, Yehoyaribu, Yakiini.
en: And of the priests; Jedaiah, and Jehoiarib, and Jachin,

rr: Azaria mwene Hilukia ya Meshulaamu, Meshulaamu ya Zadoki, Zadoki ya Merayosi, Merayosi ya Ahitubu, omukuru w'enju ya Ruhanga
en: and Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God;

rr: na Adaaya mwene Yerohaamu, Yerohaamu ya Pashihuuri, Pashihuuri ya Malikia; na Masai mwene Adieli ya Yahuzeera, Yahuzeera ya Meshulaamu, Meshulaamu ya Mehsilemiisi mwene Imeri
en: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasiai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;

rr: otabariiremu beene waabo, abakuru b'amaju ga baishenkurubo, rukumi na magana mushanju na makumi mukaaga, abashaija abarikubaasiza kimwe kukora omurimo gw'enju ya Ruhanga.
en: and their brethren, heads of the house of their fathers, a thousand and seven hundred and threescore; very able men for the work of the service of the house of God.

rr: Ab'omu Baleevi: Shemaaya mwene Hashubu ya Azurikaamu, Azurikaamu ya Hashabia ab'omuri beene Merari
en: And of the Levites; Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;

rr: na Bakubakari, Hereshi, Galali, na Matania mwene Miika ya zikuri mwene Asafu
en: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Micah, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;

rr: na Obadia mwene Shemaaya ya Galali, Galali ya Yedusiini, Yedusuuni ya Berekia, Berekia ya Aasa mwene Elukaana abaabaire batwire omu birorero by'aba Netofaasi.
en: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, that dwelt in the villages of the Netophathites.

rr: Abakumiirizi b'amarembo: Shalumu, Akubu, Talumooni, Ahimaanu na beene waabo, (kandi Shalumu niwe yaabaire ari mukuru)
en: And the porters were , Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brethren: Shallum was the chief;

rr: abaabaire batuura aha irembo ry'omugabe ery'aha buziizi bw'oburugwa-izooba n'okuhitsya hati. Kandi abo nibo baabaire bari abakumiirizi b'eirembo ry'orusiisira rw'Abaleevi.
en: who hitherto waited in the king's gate eastward: they were porters in the companies of the children of Levi.

rr: Shalumu mwene Koore ya Eliasafu mwene Koora na beene waabo ab'enju ya ishenkuru, aba Koora, nibo baabaire bakwatsiibwe omurimo gw'okuheereza, nigwo gw'okurinda omuryango gw'Eihema, nka baishenkurubo oku baabaire bakwatsiibwe orusiisira rwa MUKAMA nibarinda eirembo ryarwo.
en: And Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brethren, of the house of his father, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the gates of the tabernacle: and their fathers, being over the host of the LORD , were keepers of the entry.

rr: Na Finehaasi mwene Eleazaari niwe yaabaire naabategyeka omu bya ira; kandi MUKAMA akaba ari hamwe nawe.
en: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar was the ruler over them in time past, and the LORD was with him.

rr: Zekaria mwene Meshelemia niwe yaabaire ari omukumiirizi aha irembo ry'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu.
en: And Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was porter of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

rr: Abo boona abaatoorainwe kuba abakumiirizi b'amarembo bakaba bari magana abiri na ikumi na babiri. Kandi bakaba bahandiikirwe omu birorero byabo, nk'okukuratana kw'oruzaaro rwabo oku kwabaire kuri. Abo nibo Daudi na Samueli omuhanuuzi baahamize omu murimo gwabo ogw'obwesigwa.
en: All these which were chosen to be porters in the gates were two hundred and twelve. These were reckoned by their genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer did ordain in their set office.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo bo na batabani baabo baakwatsibwa omurimo gw'okurinda amarembo g'enju ya MUKAMA, niyo nju y'Eihema.
en: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the house of the LORD , namely , the house of the tabernacle, by wards.

rr: Abo bakumiirizi baaguma nibaza aha mbaju zaayo ina, orw'oburugwa-izooba, orw'oburengyerwa-izooba, orw'obukiizi-bwa-bumosho n'obwa-buryo
en: In four quarters were the porters, toward the east, west, north, and south.

rr: kandi beene waabo ab'omu birorero byabo bakaba nibaragiirwa kwija buri biro mushanju kuguma nabo
en: And their brethren, which were in their villages, were to come after seven days from time to time with them.

rr: ahabw'okuba abo bakumiirizi bakuru bana, abaabaire bari Abaleevi, bakaba baguma aha murimo gwabo batarikwihwa; kandi nibo baabaire bakwatsiibwe ebishengye n'amabiikoro eby'omu nju ya Ruhanga
en: For these Levites, the four chief porters, were in their set office, and were over the chambers and treasuries of the house of God.

rr: baraara beehinguririze egyo nju ya Ruhanga, ahakuba omurimo gwabo gukaba guri okugirinda n'okugiigura buri kasheeshe.
en: And they lodged round about the house of God, because the charge was upon them, and the opening thereof every morning pertained to them.

rr: Abamwe omuribo bakaba bakwatsiibwe ebintu by'obuheereza; ahakuba bakaba nibaragiirwa kubibara omu kubitaasya n'omu kubishohoza.
en: And certain of them had the charge of the ministering vessels, that they should bring them in and out by tale.

rr: Abandi omuribo bakaba bakwatsiibwe ebintu by'omu Butaaho n'ebintu byona ebirikwera eby'okukoresa, kandi n'esaano y'obunono, viinyo, amajuta, obubaane n'emigaju.
en: Some of them also were appointed to oversee the vessels, and all the instruments of the sanctuary, and the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.

rr: Abandi ab'omuri batabani b'abanyamurwa bakaba bajwanzya emigaju
en: And some of the sons of the priests made the ointment of the spices.

rr: kandi Matisia ow'omu Baleevi omujigaijo gwa Shalumu ow'omu ba Koora niwe yaabaire akwatsiibwe omurimo gw'okureeberera ebirikukarangwa aha byoma.
en: And Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the set office over the things that were made in the pans.

rr: Kandi n'abandi omuri beene waabo b'Abakohasi nibo baabaire bakwatsiibwe omurimo gw'emigaati y'okumurikwa, okugitebeekanisa buri Sabato.
en: And other of their brethren, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the shewbread, to prepare it every sabbath.

rr: Kandi hakaba hariho abeeshongozi, abakuru b'amaju ga baishenkuru b'Abaleevi, abaabaire bataaha omu bishengye by'omuri hekalu, bataine gundi murimo, ahabw'okuba bakaba bagira omurimo gwabo nyomushana na nyekiro.
en: And these are the singers, chief of the fathers of the Levites, who remaining in the chambers were free: for they were employed in that work day and night.

rr: Abo nibo baabaire bari bakuru b'amaju ga baishenkuru b'Abaleevi, nk'okukuratana kw'oruzaaro rwabo oku kwabaire kuri, abantu bakuru abaabaire batuura omuri Yerusaalemu.
en: These chief fathers of the Levites were chief throughout their generations; these dwelt at Jerusalem. In Gibeon

rr: 1 Omuri Gibeoni hakaba hatuuramu Yeyeli ishe wa Gibeoni, omukazi we akaba naayetwa Maaka
en: And in Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon, Jehiel, whose wife's name was Maachah:

rr: omutabani ow'omujigaijo akaba ari Abudooni, naakuratwa Zuuri, Kiishi, Baali, Neeri, Nadabu
en: and his firstborn son Abdon, then Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab,

rr: Gedori, Ahio, Zekaria na Mikuloosi
en: and Gedor, and Ahio, and Zechariah, and Mikloth.

rr: Mikuloosi yaazaara Shimeamu; abo nabo bakaba batwire na beene waabo omuri Yerusaalemu, amaka gaabo nigareebana.
en: And Mikloth begat Shimeam. And they also dwelt with their brethren at Jerusalem, over against their brethren.

rr: 1 Neeri yaazaara Kiishi, Kiishi yaazaara Saulo, Saulo yaazaara Yonasaani, Yonasaani yaazaara Melikishua, Abinadabu na Eshibaali
en: And Ner begat Kish; and Kish begat Saul; and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchi-shua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

rr: mwene Yonasaani akaba ari Meribu-baali, Meribu-baali yaazaara Miika.
en: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal: and Merib-baal begat Micah.

rr: Batabani ba Miika: Pisoni, Meleki, Tahurea na Ahazi
en: And the sons of Micah were , Pithon, and Melech, and Tahrea, and Ahaz .

rr: Ahazi yaazaara Yaara, Yaara yaazaara Alimeesi, Azimaveesi na Zimuri; Zimuri yaazaara Mooza.
en: And Ahaz begat Jarah; and Jarah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza;

rr: Mooza yaazaara Binea, Binea yaazaara Refaaya, Refaaya yaazaara Eleasa, Eleasa yaazaara Azeeli.
en: and Moza begat Binea; and Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.

rr: Azeeli yaazaara abaana b'aboojo mukaaga, n'amaziina gaabo nigo aga: Azurikaamu, Bokeru, Ishimaeli, Shearia, Obadia na Hanani; abo nibo beene Azeeli.
en: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan: these were the sons of Azel.

rr: 1 Omu biro ebyo Abafilitia bakarwanisa Abaisraeli, Abaisraeli baabahunga, baitirwa aha kibungo kya Giliboa.
en: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.

rr: Abafilista baahambya Saulo n'abatabani, baita Yonasaani, Abinadabu na Malikishua beene Saulo.
en: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul, and after his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchi-shua, the sons of Saul.

rr: Orugamba rwaba orw'amaani ahari Saulo, abarasi baamugwaho, baamuhutaaza.
en: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him, and he was wounded of the archers.

rr: Saulo nikwo kugira omukwatsi w'eby'okurwanisa bye, ati: Ihayo rurara yaawe, oginteere, bariya bashaija batashazirwe batakaija, bakanshungisa.
en: Then said Saul to his armourbearer, Draw thy sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me.

rr: Kwonka omukwatsi w'eby'okurwanisa bye yaayanga, ahabw'okuba akatiina mononga.
en: But his armourbearer would not; for he was sore afraid.

rr: Nikyo Saulo yaasyoreireyo rurara ye, akagyetungaho.
en: So Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.

rr: Ogwo mukwatsi w'eby'okurwanisa bye, ku yaareebire yaafa, nawe yaayetunga aha ye, yaafa.
en: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise on the sword, and died.

rr: Okwo nikwo Saulo yaafiire; we n'abatabani bonshatu n'ab'omu ka ye boona bakafeera hamwe.
en: So Saul died, and his three sons, and all his house died together.

rr: Kandi Abaisraeli boona abaabaire bari omu ruhita, ku baareebire eihe ryahunga, na Saulo n'abatabani baafa, baatsigaho endembo zaabo, baahunga, Abafilistia baija baazituuramu.
en: And when all the men of Israel that were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, then they forsook their cities, and fled: and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.

rr: Ku bwaseesire, Abafilistia baija kucwijura emitumbi, baashanga Saulo n'abatani bagwire aha kibungo kya Giliboa
en: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his sons fallen in mount Gilboa.

rr: baamucwijura, baamucwaho omutwe, baatwara eby'okurwanisa bye, baatuma entumwa omu nsi yaabo yoona kubuzya amakuru omuri hekalu z'ebishushani byabo ebirikuramibwa.
en: And when they had stripped him, they took his head, and his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to carry tidings unto their idols, and to the people.

rr: Eby'okurwanisa bye baabita omuri nyaruju za baaruhanga baabo, n'omutwe gwe baaguhanika omuri hekalu ya Dagoni.
en: And they put his armour in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon.

rr: Kwonka aba Yabeshi-gileadi boona, ku baahuriire oku Abafilistia baagizire Saulo
en: And when all Jabesh-gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,

rr: abashaija boona amamanzi baimuka, baihayo omutumbi gwa Saulo n'ey'abatabani, baagitwara Yabeshi. Bwanyima baaziika amagufa gaabo ahansi y'omwela ogw'omuri Yabeshi, baamara ebiro mushanju nibeesiibyakwo.
en: they arose, all the valiant men, and took away the body of Saul, and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

rr: Okwo nikwo Saulo yaafiire ahabw'ekicumuro kye, eki yaacumwire ahari MUKAMA; ahabw'okuba taroorobeire kigambo kya MUKAMA, kandi akeehanuuza aha muntu orikugambisa emizimu
en: So Saul died for his transgression which he committed against the LORD , even against the word of the LORD , which he kept not, and also for asking counsel of one that had a familiar spirit, to enquire of it ;

rr: yaayanga kwehanuuza ahari MUKAMA. Nikyo MUKAMA yaamwitiire, obugabe akabuha Daudi mwene Yese. Currently Selected: 1 Eby&x27;omu Busingye 10 : RR64 Highlight Share <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/20
en: and enquired not of the LORD : therefore he slew him, and turned the kingdom unto David the son of Jesse. rr: 2 -3 , 6-10 . Bwanyima Abaisraeli boona baateeranira ahari Daudi omuri Heburooni, baamugira bati: Reeba turi eigufa ryawe kandi omubiri gwawe.
en: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David unto Hebron, saying, Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh.

rr: Omu biro ebyahingwire, Saulo akiri omugabe, niiwe waabaire oyebembera Abaisraeli nibahurura kandi MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe akakugira ati: Niiwe oriba omuriisa w'abantu bangye Israeli, kandi niiwe oriba mugabe waabo.
en: And moreover in time past, even when Saul was king, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the LORD thy God said unto thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be ruler over my people Israel.

rr: Batyo abakuru ba Israeli boona baija aha mugabe omuri Heburooni, kandi okwo niyo yaaraganiire nabo endagaano omu maisho ga MUKAMA, bakamushukaho amajuta kuba omugabe wa Israeli, nk'ekigambo kya MUKAMA oku kyabaire kiri eki yaagambire naaraba omuri Samueli.
en: Therefore came all the elders of Israel to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD ; and they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of the LORD by Samuel.

rr: Bwanyima Daudi n'Abaisraeli boona baaza Yerusaalemu, niyo Yebusi, ahu Abayebusi abatuuzi b'omuri egyo nsi baabaire bari.
en: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which is Jebus; where the Jebusites were , the inhabitants of the land.

rr: Abayebusi baagira Daudi bati: Otaija aha.
en: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, Thou shalt not come hither.

rr: Kwonka Daudi yaakwata ekigo kya Saayuuni, nirwo rurembo rwa Daudi.
en: Nevertheless David took the castle of Zion, which is the city of David.

rr: Kandi Daudi akaba agizire ati: Oraabanze kuteera aba Yebusi, niwe araabe omutware kandi omukuru w'engabo.
en: And David said, Whosoever smiteth the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain.

rr: Yoabu mwene Zeruiya yaaba niwe yaabanza kwinamukayo; n'ahabw'ekyo yaaba omutware.
en: So Joab the son of Zeruiah went first up, and was chief.

rr: Daudi yaatuura omuri ekyo kigo, nikyo kyayeteirwe orurembo rwa Daudi.
en: And David dwelt in the castle; therefore they called it the city of David.

rr: Yaakyombekaho amaju okuruga Miilo n'okukyehinguriririza kimwe; kand Yoabu yaahunduuza ekicweka ky'orurembo ekyatsigaireho.
en: And he built the city round about, even from Millo round about: and Joab repaired the rest of the city.

rr: Daudi yaaguma naayeyongyera kugira ekitiinisa; ahakuba MUKAMA Ruhanga ow'amahe akaba ari hamwe nawe. Amamanzi ga Daudi
en: So David waxed greater and greater: for the LORD of hosts was with him. David's Mighty Men

rr: Ebi nibyo birikugambwa aha mamanzi agu Daudi yaabaire aine. Yashobeamu owa Hakimooni niwe yaabaire ari mukuru omuri abo abashatu; akakwata eicumu rye, yaariitsa abantu magana ashatu omurundi gumwe.
en: And this is the number of the mighty men whom David had; Jashobeam, an Hachmonite, the chief of the captains: he lifted up his spear against three hundred slain by him at one time.

rr: Owaabaire naamukurata omuri ago mamanzi ashatu ni Eleazaari mwene Dodo, mwijukuru wa Ahohi.
en: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighties.

rr: Akaba ari hamwe na Daudi Pasidamimu, obu Abafilistia baateeranirayo kurwana. Okwo hakaba hariyo omusiri gwa sayiri nyingi; Abaisraeli baahunga Abafilistia
en: He was with David at Pas-dammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where was a parcel of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.

rr: kwonka we yaayemerera omuri ogwo musiri, yaagurwanaho, yaita Abafilistia; MUKAMA yaabajunisa okusingura kw'amaani.
en: And they set themselves in the midst of that parcel, and delivered it, and slew the Philistines; and the LORD saved them by a great deliverance.

rr: Bashatu omu bashaija bakuru makumi ashatu baashuuma, baashanga Daudi aha rukiri omu nyanga ya Adulaamu; obwo eihe ry'Abafilistia rikaba risiisiire omu ruhita rwa Reefa
en: Now three of the thirty captains went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the host of the Philistines encamped in the valley of Rephaim.

rr: Daudi ari omu kigo, n'omutwe gw'engabo z'Abafilistia guri Betelehemu.
en: And David was then in the hold, and the Philistines' garrison was then at Beth-lehem.

rr: Daudi yaatenga, yaagira ati: Nkaabaasibwa ki, hagira owampa otwizi tw'omu iziba eriri aha irembo rya Betelehemu, ntunywa!
en: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Beth-lehem, that is at the gate!

rr: Ahonaaho ago mamanzi ashatu gaayataguza omu rusiira rw'Abafilistia, gaataha amaizi g'omuri eryo iziba rya Betelehemu, eryabaire riri aha irembo, baagatwarira Daudi. Kwonka Daudi yaayanga kuganywa, kureka yaagashuka omu maisho ga MUKAMA
en: And the three brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Beth-lehem, that was by the gate, and took it , and brought it to David: but David would not drink of it, but poured it out to the LORD ,

rr: yaagira ati: Nikikabure nyowe okukora eki omu maisho ga Ruhanga wangye! Nimbaasa kunywa eshagama y'aba bashaija baayoga amagara gaabo? Ahakuba baagareeta ahabw'okwoga amagara. Ekyo nikyo yaayangiire kuganywa. Ebyo nibyo ago mamanzi gaakozire.
en: and said, My God forbid it me, that I should do this thing: shall I drink the blood of these men that have put their lives in jeopardy? for with the jeopardy of their lives they brought it. Therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mightiest.

rr: Kandi Abishai mukuru wa Yoabu niwe yaabaire ari mukuru omu mamanzi makumi ashatu. Akakwata eicumu rye, yaarwana n'abashaija magana ashatu, yaabaita, yaarangaanwa nk'abo abashatu.
en: And Abishai the brother of Joab, he was chief of the three: for lifting up his spear against three hundred, he slew them , and had a name among the three.

rr: Omuri abo makumi ashatu niwe yaakizire kurangaanwa, akahinduka mukuru waabo; kwonka tiyaahika hari abo abashatu.
en: Of the three, he was more honourable than the two; for he was their captain: howbeit he attained not to the first three.

rr: Kandi Benaaya mwene Yehoyaada owa Kabuzieli, owaabaire ari emanzi, akakora eby'amaani, yaita bene Arieli babiri aba Moabu. Kandi aha izooba rimwe omu biro by'ebirika akashuuma, yaitira entare omu kiina.
en: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done many acts; he slew two lionlike men of Moab: also he went down and slew a lion in a pit in a snowy day.

rr: Kandi yaita Omunyamisri muraingwa munonga, oburaingwa bwe mikono etaano. Ogwo Munyamisri akaba aine eicumu omu ngaro, orubango rwaryo ruri nk'empimbi ei barukiraho emyenda; yaamushuumira n'enkoni, yaamusikura eryo icumu omu ngaro, yaarimwitsa.
en: And he slew an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high; and in the Egyptian's hand was a spear like a weaver's beam; and he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and slew him with his own spear.

rr: Ebyo nibyo Benaaya mwene Yehoyaada yaakozire, akarangaanwa nk'abo abashatu ab'amaani.
en: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among the three mighties.

rr: Yaarangaanwa omuri abo makumi ashatu, kwonka tiyaahika hari bari abashatu. Daudi yaamuhindura omukuru w'abarinzi be.
en: Behold, he was honourable among the thirty, but attained not to the first three: and David set him over his guard.

rr: Kandi ago mamanzi g'omu mahe nigo aga- Asaheeli murumuna wa Yoabu, Elihanani mwene Dodo owa Betelehemu
en: Also the valiant men of the armies were , Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Beth-lehem,

rr: Shamosi owa Harodi, Helezi owa Pelooni
en: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,

rr: Iira mwene Ikeshi owa Tekoa, Abiezeeri owa Anatoosi
en: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Antothite,

rr: Sibekai owa Hushati, Ilai owa Ahohi
en: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,

rr: Maharai owa Netofa, Heleda mwene Baana owa Netofa
en: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,

rr: Itai mwene Ribai owa Gibea ey'Ababenyamiini, Benaaya owa Piratooni
en: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah, that pertained to the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,

rr: Hurai ow'aha tugyera twa Gaashi, Abieli owa Arubaasi
en: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,

rr: Azimaveesi owa Baharamu, Eliahuba owa Shalibooni
en: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,

rr: Hashemi owa Gizooni, Yonasaani mwene Shageri owa Harari
en: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shage the Hararite,

rr: Ahiamu mwene Sakeri owa Harari, Elifaali mwene Uuri
en: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,

rr: Heferi owa Mekeraasi, Ahiya owa Peloni
en: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,

rr: Hezero owa Karumeeli, Narai mwene Ezubai
en: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,

rr: Yeli murumuna wa Nasani, Mibuhaari mwene Haguri
en: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Haggeri,

rr: Zeleki Omuano, Naharai owa Beeroosi, owaabaire ari omukwatsi w'eby'okurwanisa bya Yoabu mwene Zeruiya
en: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armourbearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah,

rr: Iira owa Ituri, Garebu owa Ituri
en: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

rr: Uriya Omuhiiti, Zabadi mwene Ahulai
en: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,

rr: Adina mwene Shiza Omureubeeni omwebembezi w'Abareubeeni, owaizire n'abantu makumi ashatu
en: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a captain of the Reubenites, and thirty with him,

rr: Hanani mwene Maaka, Yoshafati owa Misuuni
en: Hanan the son of Maachah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,

rr: Uziya owa Ashitaroosi, Shama na Yeyeli beene Hosamu owa Aroeri
en: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jehiel the sons of Hothan the Aroerite,

rr: Yediaeli mwene Shimuri, n'omurumuna Yooha owa Tiizi
en: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,

rr: Elieli owa Mahavi, Yeribai na Yoshavia beene Elunaamu, Ituma Omumoabu
en: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,

rr: Elieli, Obedi na Yasieli owa Mezoba.
en: Eliel, and Obed, and Jasiel the Mesobaite.

rr: 1 Aba nibo baashangire Daudi Zikulaagi, obu yaabaire ayesherekire Saulo mwene Kiishi; nabo bakaba bari ab'omu mamanzi agaamuhaire emikono omu bweme.
en: Now these are they that came to David to Ziklag, while he yet kept himself close because of Saul the son of Kish: and they were among the mighty men, helpers of the war.

rr: Bakaba nibamanya kurwanisa amata, kandi nibatwara emikono yombi omu kurekyera enjungu n'omu kurasha emyambi; bakaba bari Ababenyamiini beene waabo b'aba Saulo.
en: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in hurling stones and shooting arrows out of a bow, even of Saul's brethren of Benjamin.

rr: Omukuru waabo akaba ari Ahiezeeri, naakuratwa Yoasi, bombi bari beene Shemaya owa Gibea, na Yezieli na Peleti beene Azimaveesi; Beraaka, Yehu owa Anatoosi
en: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; and Jeziel, and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; and Berachah, and Jehu the Antothite,

rr: Ishumaaya owa Gibeoni, omushaija w'amaani omuri bari makumi ashatu, kandi omwebembezi waabo, Yeremia, Yahazieli, Yohanaani, Yozabadi owa Gedera
en: and Ismaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty, and over the thirty; and Jeremiah, and Jahaziel, and Johanan, and Josabad the Gederathite,

rr: Eluzai, Yerimoosi, Bealia, Shemaria, Shefatia owa Harufi
en: Eluzai, and Jerimoth, and Bealiah, and Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite,

rr: Elukaana, Ishia, Azareeli, Yoezeeri, Yashobeamu ow'aba Koora
en: Elkanah, and Jesiah, and Azareel, and Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korhites,

rr: na Yoeli na Zebadia beene Yerohaamu owa Gedori.
en: and Joelah, and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.

rr: Kandi omu Bagaadi haarugamu abashaija abarwani b'amaani abamanyiire eby'orugamba, amahano omu kutwara engabo n'amacumu, abu obuso bwabo bwabaire nibushusha obw'entare, abaabaire nibairuka nk'esirabo z'omu bibungo, baashanga Daudi omu kigo ky'omu ihamba.
en: And of the Gadites there separated themselves unto David into the hold to the wilderness men of might, and men of war fit for the battle, that could handle shield and buckler, whose faces were like the faces of lions, and were as swift as the roes upon the mountains;

rr: Omukuru akaba ari Ezeri, owa kabiri Obadia, owa kashatu Eliabu
en: Ezer the first, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,

rr: owa kana Mishimana, owa kataano Yeremia
en: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,

rr: owa mukaaga Atai, owa mushanju Elieli
en: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,

rr: owa munaana Yohanaani, owa mwenda Elizabadi
en: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,

rr: owa ikumi Yeremia, owa ikumi n'omwe Makubanai.
en: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbanai the eleventh.

rr: Abagaadi abo bakaba bari abakuru b'engabo, omuto omuribo akaba ari nk'abantu igana, n'omukuru nk'abantu rukumi.
en: These were of the sons of Gad, captains of the host: one of the least was over an hundred, and the greatest over a thousand.

rr: Abo nibo baayambukire Yorudani omu kwezi kw'okubanza, obu Yorudani yaabaire eijwire, amaizi garengyeire aha nkungu zaayo zoona, bakabinga ab'omu mpita z'oburugwa-izooba n'oburengyerwa-izooba boona.
en: These are they that went over Jordan in the first month, when it had overflown all his banks; and they put to flight all them of the valleys, both toward the east, and toward the west.

rr: Bwanyima abamwe omu Babenyamiini n'Abayuda baija, baashanga Daudi omu kigo.
en: And there came of the children of Benjamin and Judah to the hold unto David.

rr: Daudi yaashohora kubabugana, yaabagira ati: Ku muraabe mwaija kumpa emikono nk'abanywani bangye, omutima gwangye nigwija kukwatanisa n'eyaanyu; kwonka ku muraabe mwaija kundeebya aha bazigu bangye, haza ntaine ki nshobize, Ruhanga wa baatatenkuriitwe akireebe, kandi abahane.
en: And David went out to meet them, and answered and said unto them, If ye be come peaceably unto me to help me, mine heart shall be knit unto you: but if ye be come to betray me to mine enemies, seeing there is no wrong in mine hands, the God of our fathers look thereon , and rebuke it .

rr: Ahonaaho Omwoyo yaija ahari Amasai, omukuru wa bari makumi ashatu, yaagira ati: Turi abaawe, Daudi! Turi aha rubaju rwawe, iwe mwene Yese! Obusingye, obusingye bube ahariiwe, N'aha barikukuha emikono; Ahakuba Ruhanga waawe akuhwera. Ahonaaho Daudi yaabaakiira, yaabagira abakuru b'engabo ze.
en: Then the spirit came upon Amasai, who was chief of the captains, and he said , Thine are we , David, and on thy side, thou son of Jesse: peace, peace be unto thee, and peace be to thine helpers; for thy God helpeth thee. Then David received them, and made them captains of the band.

rr: 1 Kandi n'abamwe omu Bamanaase bakaimuura, baayehongyera Daudi, obu yaahurura n'Abafilistia kurwanisa Saulo. (Kwonka Daudi tarabahwereire, ahakuba abakuru omu Bafilistia bakaza omu naama, baamubinga nibagira bati: Naija kutureebya agarukire mukama we Saulo, atunagye omu kabi.)
en: And there fell some of Manasseh to David, when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle: but they helped them not: for the lords of the Philistines upon advisement sent him away, saying, He will fall to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.

rr: Ku yaabaire naakigaruka Zikulaagi, abashaija aba ab'omu Bamanaase baamwehongyera, Aduna, Yoazabadi, Yediaeli, Mikaeli, Yozabadi, Elihu na Zilesai, abaabaire bari abakuru b'emitwe y'engabo rukumi-rukumi y'eihe ry'Abamanaase
en: As he went to Ziklag, there fell to him of Manasseh, Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zilthai, captains of the thousands that were of Manasseh.

rr: bakaha Daudi emikono kurwanisa emitwe y'abanyagi.
en: And they helped David against the band of the rovers: for they were all mighty men of valour, and were captains in the host.

rr: Ahakuba abantu bakaba baija ahari Daudi buri izooba kumuha emikono, okuhitsya obu baabaire eihe rihango, nk'eihe rya Ruhanga.
en: For at that time day by day there came to David to help him, until it was a great host, like the host of God.

rr: Egi niyo mibaro y'emitwe y'engabo ezaashangire Daudi Heburooni, ziine eby'okurwanisa, kumukubuurira obugabe bwa Saulo, nk'ekigambo kya MUKAMA oku kyabaire kiri.
en: And these are the numbers of the bands that were ready armed to the war, and came to David to Hebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of the LORD .

rr: Abayuda abaabaire baine engabo n'amacumu, bakaba bari obukumi mukaaga na magana munaana abeeteekateekyeire orugamba
en: The children of Judah that bare shield and spear were six thousand and eight hundred, ready armed to the war.

rr: Abasimeoni abashaija abarwani b'amaani omu rugamba bari enkumi mushanju na igana
en: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valour for the war, seven thousand and one hundred.

rr: Abaleevi enkumi ina na magana mukaaga
en: Of the children of Levi four thousand and six hundred.

rr: Yehoyaada owaabaire ari omwebembezi w'enju ya Arooni yaija n'engabo enkumi ishatu na magana mushanju
en: And Jehoiada was the leader of the Aaronites, and with him were three thousand and seven hundred;

rr: Zadoki omutsigazi w'amaani emanzi yaija n'abakuru b'engabo makumi abiri na babiri ab'enju ya ishe.
en: and Zadok, a young man mighty of valour, and of his father's house twenty and two captains.

rr: Abaefuraimu abashaija b'amaani amamanzi, ba rugambwa omu maju ga baishenkurubo bari obukumi bubiri na magana munaana

en: Moreover they that were nigh them, even unto Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought bread on asses, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen, and meat, meal, cakes of figs, and bunches of raisins, and wine, and oil, and oxen, and sheep abundantly: for there was joy in Israel.

rr: Bwanyima Daudi yaaza omu naama n'abeebembezi boona, abakuru b'engabo rukumi-rukumi na igana-igana.
en: And David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds, and with every leader.

rr: Kandi yaagambira omutwe gw'Abaisraeli boona abaabaire bateeraine naagira ati: Ku muraabe nimukisiima, kandi kirugire ahari MUKAMA Ruhanga waitu, tutume hoona-hoona omuri beene waitu abatsigaire omu nsi ya Israeli yoona, abu abanyamurwa n'Abaleevi batwire nabo omu ndembo zaabo n'amariisizo gaazo, babone kuteeranira ahu turi
en: And David said unto all the congregation of Israel, If it seem good unto you, and that it be of the LORD our God, let us send abroad unto our brethren every where, that are left in all the land of Israel, and with them also to the priests and Levites which are in their cities and suburbs, that they may gather themselves unto us:

rr: bwanyima tuze kugarura eshanduukye ya Ruhanga waitu; ahabw'okuba omu biro bya Saulo tituragyeteireho.
en: and let us bring again the ark of our God to us: for we enquired not at it in the days of Saul.

rr: Omutwe gwona gwaikiriza kutwaza gutyo, ahakuba egyo naama ekasiimwa abantu boona.
en: And all the congregation said that they would do so: for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.

rr: Atyo Daudi yaateerana Abaisraeli boona okuruga Shihoori akagyera ka Misri okuhika ah'orikutaahira nooza Hamasi, ngu babone kwiha eshanduukye ya Ruhanga Kiryasi-yearimu.
en: So David gathered all Israel together, from Shihor of Egypt even unto the entering of Hemath, to bring the ark of God from Kirjath-jearim.

rr: 2 Daudi n'Abaisraeli boona bainamuka, baaza Baala niyo Kiryasi-yarimu ey'Abayuda, kwihayo eshanduukye ya Ruhanga, eyaabaire etakirirwaho Eiziina rya MUKAMA, oshutama aha kitebe kye ahaiguru ya baakerubi.
en: And David went up, and all Israel, to Baalah, that is , to Kirjath-jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up thence the ark of God the LORD , that dwelleth between the cherubims, whose name is called on it .

rr: Baatwarira eshanduukye ya Ruhanga aha kigaari kisya, baagiiha omu ka ya Abinadabu, kandi Uzza na Ahio nibo baabaire nibatwara ekyo kigaari.
en: And they carried the ark of God in a new cart out of the house of Abinadab: and Uzza and Ahio drave the cart.

rr: Daudi n'Abaisraeli boona baagyenda nibashemerererwa omu maisho ga MUKAMA n'amaani gaabo goona, nibeeshongora nibateera endingiri, n'enanga n'engarabi, n'amataari n'ebitaasa n'amakondere.
en: And David and all Israel played before God with all their might, and with singing, and with harps, and with psalteries, and with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.

rr: Ku baahikire aha mbuga ya Kidoni, Uzza yaatayo omukono gwe kuramira eshanduukye ya Ruhanga, ahabw'okuba ente zikateera entsibo.
en: And when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.

rr: MUKAMA yaagirira Uzza ekiniga; yaamwitira aho, naamutura okuramira eshanduukye n'omukono gwe; yaafeera aho omu maisho ga Ruhanga.
en: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzza, and he smote him, because he put his hand to the ark: and there he died before God.

rr: Daudi yaaguubwa kubi ahabwa MUKAMA kugwa ahari Uzza; ogwo mwanya gwayetwa Pereezi-uzza n'okuhitsya hati.
en: And David was displeased, because the LORD had made a breach upon Uzza: wherefore that place is called Perez-uzza to this day.

rr: Eryo izooba Daudi yaatiina Ruhanga yaagira ati: Nimbaasa nta kutwara eshanduukye ya MUKAMA omu ka yangye?
en: And David was afraid of God that day, saying, How shall I bring the ark of God home to me?

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo Daudi tiyaatwara shanduukye ya Ruhanga owe omu rurembo rwa Daudi, kureka yaagikiikamya, yaagita omu nju ya Obededomu Omunyagaasi.

en: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and timber of cedars, with masons and carpenters, to build him an house.

en: And David perceived that the LORD had confirmed him king over Israel, for his kingdom was lifted up on high, because of his people Israel. David's Family

rr: Ibuhaari, Elishua, Elipeleti
en: and Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpalet,

en: and Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

rr: Abafilistia boona ku baahuriire ngu Daudi ashukirweho amajuta kuba omugabe w'Abaisraeli boona, bainamuka baaza kusherura Daudi; Daudi ku yaabihuriire, yaahurura kubarwanisa.
en: And when the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David. And David heard of it , and went out against them.

rr: Omu bunaku obwo Abafilistia bakaba baizire, bateire oruhita rw'Abareefa.
en: And the Philistines came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

rr: Daudi yaayehanuuza ahari Ruhanga naabuuza ati: Nyinamukye ndwane n'Abafilistia? Noija kubahayo omu mikono yangye? MUKAMA yaamugarukamu ati: Inamuka, ahakuba niinyija kubahayo omu mikono yaawe.
en: And David enquired of God, saying, Shall I go up against the Philistines? and wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And the LORD said unto him, Go up; for I will deliver them into thine hand.

rr: Daudi nikwo kuza Baali-peraziimu, akabaitirayo. Bwanyima yaagira ati: Ruhanga ahigwire abazigu bangye, nk'oku amaizi gahigura omu cungiro. Nikyo baayeteire ogwo mwanya Baali-peraziimu.
en: So they came up to Baal-perazim; and David smote them there. Then David said, God hath broken in upon mine enemies by mine hand like the breaking forth of waters: therefore they called the name of that place Baal-perazim.

rr: Abafilistia baatsigayo ebishushani byabo ebirikuramibwa, Daudi yaaragiira, baabyotsya.
en: And when they had left their gods there, David gave a commandment, and they were burned with fire.

rr: Ku haahingwireho ebiro Abafilistia baagaruka baateera orwo ruhita.
en: And the Philistines yet again spread themselves abroad in the valley.

rr: Daudi yaagaruka yaayehanuuza ahari Ruhanga, Ruhanga yaamugarukamu ati: Otainamuka kubakurata; kureka obakiikuukye, obashangye ahashungaine n'akabira k'emitugunda.
en: Therefore David enquired again of God; and God said unto him, Go not up after them; turn away from them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.

rr: Bwanyima ku oraahurire okukaabuuza aha mitwe y'emitugunda, ahonaaho ogyende obateere; ahakuba Ruhanga naaba akwebembeire kwita engabo z'Abafilistia.
en: And it shall be, when thou shalt hear a sound of going in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then thou shalt go out to battle: for God is gone forth before thee to smite the host of the Philistines.

rr: Atyo Daudi yaatwaza nk'oku Ruhanga yaamuragiira, baagyenda baita Abafilistia okuruga Gibeoni okuhika Gezeri.
en: David therefore did as God commanded him: and they smote the host of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gazer.

rr: Okurangaanwa kwa Daudi kwabuga ensi zoona, MUKAMA yaareetera amahanga goona kumutiina.
en: And the fame of David went out into all lands; and the LORD brought the fear of him upon all nations.

en: and said unto them, Ye are the chief of the fathers of the Levites: sanctify yourselves, both ye and your brethren, that ye may bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel unto the place that I have prepared for it.

en: For because ye did it not at the first, the LORD our God made a breach upon us, for that we sought him not after the due order.

en: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel.

en: And David spake to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brethren to be the singers with instruments of musick, psalteries and harps and cymbals, sounding, by lifting up the voice with joy.

en: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was for song: he instructed about the song, because he was skilful.

rr: Berekia na Elukaana bakaba bari abakuumirizi b'eirembo ahabw'eshanduukye.
en: And Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.

rr: Shebania, Yoshafaati, Netaneeli, Amasai, Zekaria, Benaaya na Eliezeeri, abanyamurwa, nibo baabaire bari ab'okugyenda nibateerera amakondere omu maisho g'eshanduukye ya Ruhanga; Obededomu na Yehia nabo bari abakumiirizi b'eirembo ahabw'eshanduukye.
en: And Shebaniah, and Jehoshaphat, and Nethaneel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, did blow with the trumpets before the ark of God: and Obed-edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.

rr: Atyo Daudi n'abakuru ba Israeli, n'abakuru b'engabo rukumi-rukumi, baaza kwinamura eshanduukye y'endagaano ya MUKAMA, kugiiha owa Obededomu n'okushemererwa.
en: So David, and the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the house of Obed-edom with joy.

rr: Obwo Daudi akaba ajwaire ekanzu ya kitaani, kandi n'Abaleevi abaabaire baheekire eshanduukye, n'abeeshongozi, na Kenania omwebembezi waabo, nabo bakaba bajwaire batyo; kwonka Daudi we ajwariireho n'efodi ya kitaani.
en: And David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites that bare the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the master of the song with the singers: David also had upon him an ephod of linen.

rr: Bwanyima eshanduukye y'endagaano ya MUKAMA ku yaabaire neetaaha omu rurembo rwa Daudi, Mikaali muhara wa Saulo yaaringuririza omu dirisa, yaareba omugabe Daudi naazina naayemurika, yaamugayira aha mutima.
en: And it came to pass, as the ark of the covenant of the LORD came to the city of David, that Michal the daughter of Saul looking out at a window saw king David dancing and playing: and she despised him in her heart.

en: And he dealt to every one of Israel, both man and woman, to every one a loaf of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon of wine .

en: And he appointed certain of the Levites to minister before the ark of the LORD , and to record, and to thank and praise the LORD God of Israel:

en: Asaph the chief, and next to him Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obed-edom: and Jeiel with psalteries and with harps; but Asaph made a sound with cymbals;

rr: Benaaya na Yahazieli abanyamurwa baaba ab'okuguma nibateerera amkondere omu maisho g'eshanduukye y'endagaano ya Ruhanga. Zaaburi y'okusiima Ruhanga
en: Benaiah also and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God. Psalm of Praise

rr: Eryo izooba nibwo Daudi yaatandika kutaho Asafu na beene ishe kuba ab'okusingiza MUKAMA.
en: Then on that day David delivered first this psalm to thank the LORD into the hand of Asaph and his brethren.

rr: Musiime MUKAMA, murangaane eiziina rye, Mumanyise ebi yaakozire omu mahanga!
en: Give thanks unto the LORD , call upon his name, Make known his deeds among the people.

rr: Mumweshongorere, mweshongore eby'okumuhimbisa, Mugambire abantu eby'emirimo ye yoona ey'okutangaaza!
en: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him, Talk ye of all his wondrous works.

rr: Mwesiime ahabw'eiziina rye eririkwera; Emitima y'abarikusherura MUKAMA eshemererwe!
en: Glory ye in his holy name: Let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD .

rr: Musherure MUKAMA n'amaani ge, Mwetengye okuguma omu maisho ge obutoosha.
en: Seek the LORD and his strength, Seek his face continually.

rr: Mwijukye emirimo ye ey'okutangaaza N'ebitakareebwaga ebi yaakozire, n'emanja ezi yaacwire
en: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done, His wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;

rr: Imwe ab'oruzaaro rw'omwiru we Abrahamu, Abaana ba Yakobo abu yaatooraine.
en: O ye seed of Israel his servant, Ye children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

rr: Niwe MUKAMA Ruhanga waitu, Emicwere ye eri omu nsi yoona
en: He is the LORD our God; His judgments are in all the earth.

rr: Aijuka endagaano ye ebiro byona, Ekigambo eki yaaragiire ab'obusingye rukumi
en: Be ye mindful always of his covenant; The word which he commanded to a thousand generations;

rr: Niyo ndagaano ei yaaragaine na Abrahamu, Ei yaarahiire naaraganisa Isaaka
en: Even of the covenant which he made with Abraham, And of his oath unto Isaac;

rr: Akagihamiza Yakobo kuba ekiragiro, Na Israeli okuba endagaano etarihwaho
en: And hath confirmed the same to Jacob for a law, And to Israel for an everlasting covenant,

rr: Naagira ati: Niiwe ndiha ensi ya Kanaani, Kuba omugabo gw'obuhunguzi bwanyu.
en: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, The lot of your inheritance;

rr: Obu baabaire bakiri bakye, Eego bakye munonga kandi abashuhuuki omu nsi egyo
en: When ye were but few, Even a few, and strangers in it.

rr: Nibazengyerera omu mahanga agatari gamwe, Okuruga omu bugabe bumwe okuza omu bundi
en: And when they went from nation to nation, And from one kingdom to another people;

rr: Taraikiriize muntu weena kubakora kubi, Akateisa abagabe ahabwabo
en: He suffered no man to do them wrong: Yea, he reproved kings for their sakes,

rr: Naagira ati: Mutakora aha bu naashukireho amajuta, N'obu kwakuba okukora kubi baanabi bangye.
en: Saying , Touch not mine anointed, And do my prophets no harm.

rr: Imwe abari omu nsi mwena, mweshongorere MUKAMA, Mworekye okujuna kwe buri kasheeshe.
en: Sing unto the LORD , all the earth; Shew forth from day to day his salvation.

rr: Mumanyise ekitiinisa kye omu mahanga, Emirimo ye ey'okutangaaza omu mahanga goona.
en: Declare his glory among the heathen; His marvellous works among all nations.

rr: Ahakuba MUKAMA ni mukuru, ashamereire kuhimbisibwa munonga, Kandi n'okutiinwa okukira baaruhanga boona.
en: For great is the LORD , and greatly to be praised: He also is to be feared above all gods.

rr: Ahakuba baaruhanga boona ab'abantu baba ebishushani, Kwonka Ruhanga niwe yaahangire eiguru.
en: For all the gods of the people are idols: But the LORD made the heavens.

rr: Ekitiinisa n'obukuru bimwebembeire; Amaani n'okushemererwa biri ahi atuura.
en: Glory and honour are in his presence; Strength and gladness are in his place.

rr: Imwe enganda z'amahanga, mugambe, Mugambe ku MUKAMA aine ekitiinisa n'amaani
en: Give unto the LORD , ye kindreds of the people, Give unto the LORD glory and strength.

rr: Mugambe ku MUKAMA aine ekitiinisa ekishemereire eiziina rye, Mureete empongano, mwije omu maisho ge; Muramye MUKAMA mujwaire ebirikwera
en: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name: Bring an offering, and come before him: Worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.

rr: Muteteme omu maisho ge, imwe ab'omu nsi mwena; Eego, endi ehamire, terikubaasa kutengyetsibwa.
en: Fear before him, all the earth: The world also shall be stable, that it be not moved.

rr: Eiguru rishemererwe, n'ensi eyesiime; Bagambire omu mahanga nibagira bati: MUKAMA ari aha ngoma!
en: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice: And let men say among the nations, The LORD reigneth.

rr: Enyanja ehoorere, na byona ebiijwiremu, Emisiri eyesiime n'ebirimu byona!
en: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof: Let the fields rejoice, and all that is therein.

rr: Obwo nibwo emiti yoona ey'omu kibira eryeshongora Ahabw'okushemererwa omu maisho ga MUKAMA, Ahabw'okuba naija kucwera ensi orubanja.
en: Then shall the trees of the wood sing out at the presence of the LORD , Because he cometh to judge the earth.

rr: Musiime MUKAMA, ahabw'okuba ni murungi, Kandi embabazi ze n'ez'ebiro n'ebiro!
en: O give thanks unto the LORD ; for he is good; For his mercy endureth for ever.

rr: Kandi mugire muti: Otujune, ai Ruhanga ow'okujunwa kwaitu, Otutaaruure, otujune nootwiha omu mahanga, Tubone kusiima eiziina ryawe eririkwera, Twesiimire okuhimbisibwa kwawe.
en: And say ye, Save us, O God of our salvation, And gather us together, and deliver us from the heathen, That we may give thanks to thy holy name, And glory in thy praise.

rr: MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa Israeli, ahimbisibwe Okwiha ira ryona okuhitsya ebiro byona. Bwanyima abantu boona baagira bati: Amiina; baahimbisa MUKAMA.
en: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel For ever and ever. And all the people said, Amen, and praised the LORD .

rr: Atyo Daudi yaatsiga Asafu na beene ishe omu maisho g'eshanduukye y'endagaano ya MUKAMA kuguma nibakora omurimo gw'obuheereza omu maisho gaayo, nk'oku kyabaire nikyetengwa buri izooba
en: So he left there before the ark of the covenant of the LORD Asaph and his brethren, to minister before the ark continually, as every day's work required:

rr: yaatsigayo na Obededomu na beene ishe makumi mukaaga na munaana; kandi yaataho Obededomu mwnee Yedusuuni na Hoosa kuba abakumiirizi b'eirembo.
en: and Obed-edom with their brethren, threescore and eight; Obed-edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be porters:

rr: Kandi yaatsiga Zadoki omunyamurwa na beene ishe abanyamurwa omu maisho g'eihema rya MUKAMA eryabaire riri omu mwanya mukuru gw'okuramizamu, ogwabaire guri gibeoni
en: and Zadok the priest, and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of the LORD in the high place that was at Gibeon,

rr: -46 ; kuguma nibatambirira MUKAMA ebitambo by'okwotsya aha itambiro ryabyo omu kasheeshe n'omu mwabazyo, nk'oku byona byabaire bihandiikirwe omu biragiro bya MUKAMA ebi yaaragiire Abaisraeli.
en: to offer burnt offerings unto the LORD upon the altar of the burnt offering continually morning and evening, and to do according to all that is written in the law of the LORD , which he commanded Israel;

rr: Kandi hamwe n'abo yaataho Hemani na Yedusuuni n'abandi abaatoorainwe, abu amaziina gaabo gaagambirweho, kuba ab'okusiima MUKAMA ahabw'embabazi ze ezigumaho ebiro byona.
en: and with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest that were chosen, who were expressed by name, to give thanks to the LORD , because his mercy endureth for ever;

rr: Kandi Hemani na Yeduduuni abo bakaba bagira amakondere n'ebitaasa eby'okuteera, n'ebindi bintu by'okuteerwa ahabw'ebyeshongoro ebirikwera.
en: and with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should make a sound, and with musical instruments of God.

rr: Kandi baataho batabani ba Yedusuuni kuba ab'okurinda eirembo.
en: And the sons of Jeduthun were porters.

rr: Bwanyima abantu boona baayaabuuka, buri muntu yaaza owe, na Daudi yaagaruka owe kushabira eka ye omugisha.
en: And all the people departed every man to his house: and David returned to bless his house.

rr: 2 Bwanyima Daudi, ku yaataahire omu nju ye, yaagogyeera, yaagira Nasani nabi ati: Reeba, hati ndi omu nju y'emyereezi, kwonka eshanduukye y'endagaano ya MUKAMA eri omu ihema.
en: Now it came to pass, as David sat in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, Lo, I dwell in an house of cedars, but the ark of the covenant of the LORD remaineth under curtains.

rr: Nasani yaagira Daudi ati: Kora ekikuru aha mutima kyona, ahakuba Ruhanga ari hamwe naiwe.
en: Then Nathan said unto David, Do all that is in thine heart; for God is with thee.

rr: Kwonka ekyo kiro ekigambo kya MUKAMA kyaizira Nasani nikigira kiti
en: And it came to pass the same night, that the word of God came to Nathan, saying,

rr: Irooko ogire omwiru wangye Daudi oti: Oku nikwo MUKAMA arikugamba naagira ati: Toriinyombekyera nju y'okutuuramu
en: Go and tell David my servant, Thus saith the LORD , Thou shalt not build me an house to dwell in:

rr: ahakuba tinkatuuraga mu nju, okwiha aha izooba eri naihiireho Abaisraeli Misri n'okuhitsya hati, kureka nkaba ngyenda ninduga omu ihema nindigarukamu, ninduga omu butaaho nimbugaruakamu.
en: for I have not dwelt in an house since the day that I brought up Israel unto this day; but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tabernacle to another .

rr: Nimugira ngu omu myanya yoona ei naabaire ngyendamu n'Abaisraeli boona nkaba ndagizire omwe aha baramuzi ba Israeli, abu naaragiire kuriisa abantu bangye Israeli, nti: Ahabw'enki mutakaanyombekyeraga nju y'emyereezi?
en: Wheresoever I have walked with all Israel, spake I a word to any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people, saying, Why have ye not built me an house of cedars?

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo ogire omwiru wangye Daudi oti: Oku nikwo MUKAMA ow'amahe arikugamba naagira ati: Nkakwiha omu iriisizo nooriisa entaama, ngu nkuhindure omutegyeki w'abantu bangye Israeli
en: Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, even from following the sheep, that thou shouldest be ruler over my people Israel:

rr: kandi nkaba nguma naiwe ahu waabaire oza hoona, ncwekyerereza abazigu baawe omu maisho gaawe; kandi ndyakuha eiziina nk'ery'abantu rugambwa ab'omu nsi.
en: and I have been with thee whithersoever thou hast walked, and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee, and have made thee a name like the name of the great men that are in the earth.

rr: Ndyatooranira abantu bangye Israeli omwanya, mbabyaremu, babone kugira obutaka bw'okutuuramu, obu batariihwamu bundi; kandi abantu babi tibarigaruk kubaita kubi nk'obunyakare
en: Also I will ordain a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, and they shall dwell in their place, and shall be moved no more; neither shall the children of wickedness waste them any more, as at the beginning,

rr: obu naabaire ndagiira abaramuzi kutegyeka abantu bangye Israeli; kandi ndyagomoora abazigu baawe boona. N'ekindi ninkugambira nti: MUKAMA aryakwombekyera eka.
en: and since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. Moreover I will subdue all thine enemies. Furthermore I tell thee that the LORD will build thee an house.

rr: Kandi obunaku bwawe obw'okushanga bashwenkuru ku burihika, ndyaimutsya omu ruzaaro rwawe omwe ahari batabani baawe akuhungurire, mpamye obugabe bwe.
en: And it shall come to pass, when thy days be expired that thou must go to be with thy fathers, that I will raise up thy seed after thee, which shall be of thy sons; and I will establish his kingdom.

rr: Ogwo niwe ariinyombekyera enju, kandi ndyahamya ekitebe ky'obugabe bwe ebiro byona.
en: He shall build me an house, and I will stablish his throne for ever.

rr: Ndyaba ishe, nawe abe omwana wangye. Tindimwihaho mbabazi zangye, nk'oku naaziihire aha waakubandiize
en: I will be his father, and he shall be my son: and I will not take my mercy away from him, as I took it from him that was before thee:

rr: kureka ndyamuhamya omu nju yangye n'omu bugabe bwangye ebiro byona, kandi ekitebe ky'obugabe bwe kiryagumaho ebiro n'ebiro.
en: but I will settle him in mine house and in my kingdom for ever: and his throne shall be established for evermore.

rr: Ebyo bigambo byona n'okwo kworekwa kwona Nasani yaabiteekyerereza Daudi nk'oku byabaire biri. Okushaba kwa Daudi
en: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.

rr: Bwanyima omugabe Daudi yaataaha, yaashutama omu maisho ga MUKAMA, yaagira ati: Niinye oha, ai MUKAMA Ruhanga, kandi n'enju yangye nikyo ki, iwe okundinda okampitsya aha?
en: And David the king came and sat before the LORD , and said, Who am I, O LORD God, and what is mine house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?

rr: Kwonak ekyo ahariiwe ni kikye, ai Ruhanga; mbwenu waayongyeraho n'okugamba aha by'enju y'omwiru waawe, oku eriba omu biro bingi munonga ebiriija, kandi reeba, waanyinganisa n'omuntu w'ekitiinisa kihango, ai MUKAMA Ruhanga!
en: And yet this was a small thing in thine eyes, O God; for thou hast also spoken of thy servant's house for a great while to come, and hast regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree, O LORD God.

rr: Mbwenu shi, ekindi, nyowe Daudi, nkugambire ki ahabw'okuha omwiru waawe ekitiinisa? Ahabw'okuba niiwe orikumumanya.
en: What can David speak more to thee for the honour of thy servant? for thou knowest thy servant.

rr: Ai MUKAMA, ebikuru ebyo byona obikoreire omwiru waawe, nk'oku omutima gwawe gurikuteekateeka, ngu obone kworeka ebikuru ebyo byona.
en: O LORD , for thy servant's sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all this greatness, in making known all these great things.

rr: Ai MUKAMA, tihariho orikushushana naiwe; tihariho Ruhanga kureka Iwe, nk'ebi twahuriire byona oku biri.
en: O LORD , there is none like thee, neither is there any God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

rr: Kandi n'ihanga ki omu nsi eriri nk'abantu baawe Israeli, abu Ruhanga yaagiire kwecungurira kuba abantu be, ngu oyetungire eiziina ahabw'okubakorera ebikuru kandi ebirikutiinisa, noobinga amahanga omu maisho g'abantu baawe, abu waacungwire, okaiha Misri?
en: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people Israel, whom God went to redeem to be his own people, to make thee a name of greatness and terribleness, by driving out nations from before thy people, whom thou hast redeemed out of Egypt?

rr: Bwanyima abantu baawe Israeli okabagira abaawe buzima ebiro byona; naiwe MUKAMA, waaba Ruhanga waabo.
en: For thy people Israel didst thou make thine own people for ever; and thou, LORD , becamest their God.

rr: Mbwenu hati, ai MUKAMA, ekigambo eki waagamba aha mwiru waawe n'aha nju ye, kihamibwe ebiro byona, kandi okore nk'oku waagamba
en: Therefore now, LORD , let the thing that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant and concerning his house be established for ever, and do as thou hast said.

rr: n'eziina ryawe rihamibwe, kandi riheebwe ekitiinisa ebiro byona, nibagira bati: MUKAMA ow'amahe, Ruhanga wa Israeli, niwe Ruhanga wa Israeli; kandi enju y'omwiru waawe Daudi eryahamibwa omu maisho gaawe.
en: Let it even be established, that thy name may be magnified for ever, saying, The LORD of hosts is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel: and let the house of David thy servant be established before thee.

rr: Ahakuba Iwe, Ruhanga wangye, oshuuruuriire omwiru waawe, ku orimwombekyera eka; nikyo omwiru waawe yaagirira obumanzi kushaba omu maisho gaawe.
en: For thou, O my God, hast told thy servant that thou wilt build him an house: therefore thy servant hath found in his heart to pray before thee.

rr: Mbwenu hati, ai MUKAMA, niiwe Ruhanga, kandi waaraganisa omwiru waawe ekyo kigambo kirungi
en: And now, LORD , thou art God, and hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:

rr: n'ahabw'ekyo hati ikiriza kuha enju y'omwiru waawe omugisha, egumeho ebiro byona, eri omu maisho gaawe; ahakuba, MUKAMA, eki ohaire omugisha, kigugira ebiro byona.
en: now therefore let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may be before thee for ever: for thou blessest, O LORD , and it shall be blessed for ever.

rr: 2 Bwanyima y'ebyo Daudi yaasingura Abafilistia, yaabamara eishaija, yaakwata Gaasi, n'ebirorero byayo, yaagiiha omu mikono y'Abafilistia.
en: Now after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them, and took Gath and her towns out of the hand of the Philistines.

rr: Yaasingura n'Abamoabu, baaba abairu be, baaguma nibamutoijera.
en: And he smote Moab; and the Moabites became David's servants, and brought gifts.

rr: Kandi Daudi yaasingura Hadadezeeri omugabe wa Zooba, yaamubinga, yaamuhitsya Hamasi; obwo Hadadezeeri akaba naazakubyara ekiijutsyo kye aha mugyera Furaati.
en: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah unto Hamath, as he went to stablish his dominion by the river Euphrates.

rr: Daudi yaamunyagaho ebigaari rukumi, n'abarikugyendera aha mbaraasi enkumi mushanju, n'engabo ezirikugyendesa ebigyere obukumi bubiri. Bwanyima Daudi yaatema ebiteega by'embaraasi ezirikukurura ebigaari zoona, kwonka yaatsigaho ezirikubaasa kukurura ebigaari igana.
en: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: David also houghed all the chariot horses , but reserved of them an hundred chariots.

rr: Abasiria ba Damasiko ku baizire kuha Hadadezeeri omugabe wa Zooba emikono, Daudi yaabaitamu abantu obukumi bubiri n'enkumi ibiri.
en: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.

rr: Bwanyima Daudi yaata emitwe y'abarinzi omuri Siria eya Damasiko, n'Abasiria baahinduka abairu be, baaguma nibamutoijera.
en: Then David put garrisons in Syria-damascus; and the Syrians became David's servants, and brought gifts.

rr: Kandi MUKAMA yaaguma naaha Daudi obusinguzi ei yaabaire aza yoona.
en: Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.

rr: Daudi yaanyaga engabo z'ezaabu, ezi abagaragwa ba Hadadezeeri baabaire baine, yaazitwara Yerusaalemu.
en: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

rr: Kandi Daudi yaiha emiringa mingi munonga omuri Tibuhaasi na Kuuni, endembo za Hadadezeeri.
en: Likewise from Tibhath, and from Chun, cities of Hadarezer, brought David very much brass, wherewith Solomon made the brasen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.

rr: Bwanyima Tou omugabe wa Hamasi, ku yaahuriire ngu Daudi asingwire eihe ryona erya Hadadezeeri omugabe wa Zooba
en: Now when Tou king of Hamath heard how David had smitten all the host of Hadarezer king of Zobah;

rr: yaatuma Yoramu omutabani aha mugabe Daudi, kumuramutsya, n'okumutabarutsya, ahabw'okurwana na Hadadezeeri n'okumusingura; ahabw'okuba Hadadezeeri akaba atuura naarwana na Tou. Yaamutwekyera ebintu by'emiringo yoona eby'ezaabu, eby'efeeza n'eby'emiringa
en: he sent Hadoram his son to king David, to enquire of his welfare, and to congratulate him, because he had fought against Hadarezer, and smitten him; (for Hadarezer had war with Tou;) and with him all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass.

rr: ebyo nabyo omugabe Daudi yaabishoroorera MUKAMA, hamwe n'efeeza n'ezaabu ebi yaabiare anyagire omu mahanga aga goona, Edomu, Moabu, n'omu Baamoni, Abafilistia, na amaleki.
en: Them also king David dedicated unto the LORD , with the silver and the gold that he brought from all these nations; from Edom, and from Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek.

rr: Bwanyima Abishai mwene Zeruiya yaitira Abanyaedomu kakumi n'enkumi munaana omu ruhita rw'Omwonyo.
en: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah slew of the Edomites in the valley of salt eighteen thousand.

rr: Yaataho emitwe y'abarinzi omuri Edomu; Abanyaedomu boona baahinduka abairu ba Daudi.
en: And he put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became David's servants.

rr: Okwo nikwo MUKAMA yaahaire Daudi okusingura, ei yaabaire aza yoona.
en: Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.

rr: Atyo Daudi yaategyeka Israeli yoona; kandi yaacwera abantu be boona emanja z'oburyo omu bwinganisa.
en: So David reigned over all Israel, and executed judgment and justice among all his people.

rr: Obwo Yoabu mwene Zeruiya akaba ari omukuru w'eihe; Yehoshafaati mwene Ahiluudi ari omuhandiiki w'ebirikubaho
en: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, recorder.

rr: Zadoki mwene Ahitubu na Abimeleki mwene Abiasaari bari abanyamurwa; Shavusha ari omuhandiiki
en: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Shavsha was scribe;

rr: Benaaya mwene Yehoyaada ari omukuru w'Abakeresi n'Abapelesi; kandi batabani ba Daudi bari abategyeki bakuru b'omugabe.
en: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief about the king.

rr: 2 Bwanyima y'ebyo Nahashi omugabe w'Abaamoni yaafa, omutabani Hanuni yaategyeka omu mwanya gwe.
en: Now it came to pass after this, that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his stead.

rr: Daudi ku yaakihuriire, yaagira ati: Niinyija kukorera gye Hanuni mwene Nahashi, nk'oku ishe yankoreire.
en: And David said, I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father shewed kindness to me.

rr: Atyo Daudi yaayohereza entumwa kumuyaagira ahabw'okufeerwa ishe.
en: And David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father.

rr: Abagaragwa ba Daudi baahika owa Hanuni omu nsi y'Abaamoni kumuyaagira.
en: So the servants of David came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun, to comfort him.

rr: Kwonka abanyiginya b'Abaamoni baagira Hanuni bati: Noogira ngu Daudi okukwoherereza ab'okukuyaagira n'okuha sho ekitiinisa? Torikumanya ku ayohereize abagaragwa be kwetegyereza ensi n'okugitata, ngu abone kugicwekyereza?
en: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father, that he hath sent comforters unto thee? are not his servants come unto thee for to search, and to overthrow, and to spy out the land?

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo Hanuni yaakwata abagaragwa ba Daudi, yaabamwa ebireju by'orubaju rumwe, yaacegyeta ebijwaro byabo okugarukira aha bibunu, yaaboohereza; baagyenda.
en: Wherefore Hanun took David's servants, and shaved them, and cut off their garments in the midst hard by their buttocks, and sent them away.

rr: Ku baagambiire Daudi eby'abo bashaija, yaatuma ab'okubabugana, ahabw'okuba bakaba baine enshoni nyingi. Omugabe yaagira ati: Mugume Yeriko, okuhitsya ahu obureju bwanyu buraakurire, mukabona kwija.
en: Then there went certain , and told David how the men were served. And he sent to meet them: for the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and then return.

rr: Abaamoni ku baamanyire ngu beetamiise Daudi, Hanuni n'Abaamoni baayohereza etalanta z'efeeza rukumi kupangisa ebigaari n'okuguriirira abarikugyendera aha mbaraasi, ebya Mesopotamia, Aramu-maaka na Zooba.
en: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, and out of Syria-maachah, and out of Zobah.

rr: Baapangisa ebigaari obukumi bushatu n'enkumi ibiri, baaguriirira omugabe wa Maaka n'eihe rye, baija, baateera orusiisira aharikureeba Medeba.
en: So they hired thirty and two thousand chariots, and the king of Maachah and his people; who came and pitched before Medeba.

rr: Kandi Abaamoni baaruga omu ndembo zaabo, baateeranira hamwe kuza kurwana.
en: And the children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.

rr: Daudi ku yaakihuriire, yaayohereza Yoabu n'eihe ryona ey'amamanzi.
en: And when David heard of it , he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.

rr: Abaamoni baashohora, baatenga orugamba aha irembo ry'orurembo, kandi abagabe, abaabaire baizire kuhurura, bakaba bari ahakwabo omu ishwa.
en: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array before the gate of the city: and the kings that were come were by themselves in the field.

rr: Yoabu ku yaareebire engabo zimuri omumaisho n'enyima, yaatoorana abashaija entoore omu Baisraeli, yaabatengyesa orugamba kurwana n'Abaisira
en: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose out of all the choice of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians.

rr: abandi boona yaabaha omurumuna Abishai, nabo baatenga orugamba kurwana n'Abaamoni.
en: And the rest of the people he delivered unto the hand of Abishai his brother, and they set themselves in array against the children of Ammon.

rr: Yoabu yaagira ati: Abasiria ku barankize amaani, oije ompe emikono; kandi naiwe Abaamoni ku baarakukize amaani, naanye niinyija kugikuha.
en: And he said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, then I will help thee.

rr: Guma, turwane mashaija ahabw'eihanga ryaitu, n'ahabw'endembo za Ruhanga waitu; kandi MUKAMA akore eki arikusiima.
en: Be of good courage, and let us behave ourselves valiantly for our people, and for the cities of our God: and let the LORD do that which is good in his sight.

rr: Atyo Yoabu n'engabo ezi yaabaire aine bairira haihi kurwanisa Abasiria baahunga.
en: So Joab and the people that were with him drew nigh before the Syrians unto the battle; and they fled before him.

rr: Abaamoni ku baareebire Abasiria baahunga, nabo baahunga Abishai murumuna wa Yoabu, baayeroha omu rurembo.
en: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city.

rr: Bwanyima Yoabu yaatabaaruka, yaaza Yerusaalemu.
en: Then Joab came to Jerusalem.

rr: Kwonka Abasiria ku baareebire baabingwa Abaisraeli, baatuma entumwa, baahuruza Abasiria aba seeri y'omugyera Furaati, baija beebembeirwe Shofaki omukuru w'eihe ry'engabo za Hadadezeeri.
en: And when the Syrians saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they sent messengers, and drew forth the Syrians that were beyond the river: and Shophach the captain of the host of Hadarezer went before them.

rr: Ku baakigambiire Daudi, nawe yaateerana Israeli yoona, baayambuka Yorudani, baahika ahu Abasiria baabaire bari, baatenga orugamba kubarwanisa.
en: And it was told David; and he gathered all Israel, and passed over Jordan, and came upon them, and set the battle in array against them.

rr: Daudi ku yaatengire orugamba kurwanisa Abasiria, baarwana nawe.
en: So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.

rr: Abasiria baahunga Abaisraeli; Daudi yaabaitamu abantu abarikurwanira omu bigaari enkumi mushanju, n'arikugyendesa ebigyere obukumi buna, yaita na Shofaki omukuru w'eihe ryabo.
en: But the Syrians fled before Israel; and David slew of the Syrians seven thousand men which fought in chariots, and forty thousand footmen, and killed Shophach the captain of the host.

rr: Abagaragwa ba Hadadezeeri ku baareebire baasingurwa Abaisraeli baayehongyera Daudi, baahinduka abairu be. N'ahabw'ekyo Abasiria baayanga kugaruka kuha Abaamoni emikono obundi. Currently Selected: 1 Eby&x27;omu Busingye 19 : RR64 Highlight Share <path fill-rule="evenod
en: And when the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they made peace with David, and became his servants: neither would the Syrians help the children of Ammon any more. Currently Selected: 1 Chronicles 19 : KJV Highlight Share <path fil

rr: Omu kutandika kw'omwaka, omu bunaku obu abagabe baabaire bahururiramu, Yoabu akahurura, ayebembeireeihe, yaacwekyereza ensi y'Abaamoni, yaagyenda, yaagota Rabba; kwonka Daudi akaba ayetsigariire Yerusaalemu. Yoabu yaateera Rabba, yaagicwekyereza.
en: And it came to pass, that after the year was expired, at the time that kings go out to battle , Joab led forth the power of the army, and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried at Jerusalem. And Joab smote Rabbah, and destroyed it.

rr: Daudi yaiha omugabe waabo ekirunga aha mutwe; yaashanga kiine oburemeezi bw'etalanta emwe y'ezaabu, kandi kikaba kirimu eibaare ry'obuguzi bwingi; baakita ha mutwe gwa Daudi. Kandi omuri orwo rurembo yaanyagamu eminyago mingi munonga.
en: And David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it; and it was set upon David's head: and he brought also exceeding much spoil out of the city.

rr: Yaihamu abantu abaabaire barimu, yaabashara n'empango; okwo nikwo Daudi yaagizire endembo zoona ez'Abaamoni. Bwanyima Daudi n'engabo zoona baagaruka Yerusaalemu.
en: And he brought out the people that were in it, and cut them with saws, and with harrows of iron, and with axes. Even so dealt David with all the cities of the children of Ammon. And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.

rr: 2 Bwanyima y'ebyo haabaho orugamba n'Abafilistia Gezeri; omuri orwo rugamba Sibekai owa Husha yaita Sipai ow'omuri baijukuru b'ebikaaka; Abafilistia baacwa eishaija.
en: And it came to pass after this, that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines; at which time Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Sippai, that was of the children of the giant: and they were subdued.

rr: Haagaruka haabaho orugamba n'Abafilistia; Elihanani mwene Yairi yaitu Lahumi, murumuna wa Goliasi owa Gaasi, ou orubango rw'eicumu rye rwabaire nirwigangana empimbi ei barukiraho emyenda.
en: And there was war again with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, whose spear staff was like a weaver's beam.

rr: Kandi haagaruka haabaho orugamba Gaasi. Okwo hakaba hariyo omushaija muraingwa munonga, owaabaire aine enkumu mukaaga ahari buri ngaro, n'enkumu z'ebigyere mukaaga ahari buri kigyere, zoona makumi abiri na ina; nawe akaba ari ow'omuri baijukuru b'ebikaaka.
en: And yet again there was war at Gath, where was a man of great stature, whose fingers and toes were four and twenty, six on each hand , and six on each foot: and he also was the son of the giant.

rr: Ku yaahigire Abaisraeli, Yonasaani mwene Shimei mukuru wa Daudi yaamwita.
en: But when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea David's brother slew him.

rr: Abo boona bakaba bari baijukuru b'ebikaaka bya Gaasi; baitwa Daudi n'abashaija be.
en: These were born unto the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.
