rr: 2 Sitaane akeemerera kurwanisa Israeli, yaayosya Daudi kubara Abaisraeli. -12 ; 2:1
en: And Satan stood up against Israel, and provoked David to number Israel.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo Daudi yaagira Yoabu n'abakuru b'eihe ati: Mugyende, mubare Abaisraeli okuruga Beeri-sheba okuhika Daani, mwije mungambire, mbone kumanya omubaro gwabo.
en: And David said to Joab and to the rulers of the people, Go, number Israel from Beer-sheba even to Dan; and bring the number of them to me, that I may know it .

rr: Kwonka Yoabu yaagira ati: MUKAMA ayongyere aha bantu be okukira oku bari emirundi igana! Mukama wangye omugabe, abo boona t'abairu baawe? mbwenu eki nookyendera ki, mukama wangye? Ahabw'enki nooyenda kureetera Abaisraeli orubanja?
en: And Joab answered, The LORD make his people an hundred times so many more as they be: but, my lord the king, are they not all my lord's servants? why then doth my lord require this thing? why will he be a cause of trespass to Israel?

rr: Kwonka ekigambo ky'omugabe kyakiza ebya Yoabu amaani.
en: Nevertheless the king's word prevailed against Joab.

rr: Yoabu nikwo kugyenda naaraba omuri Israeli yoona, akagaruka Yerusaalemu.
en: Wherefore Joab departed, and went throughout all Israel, and came to Jerusalem.

rr: Ku yaahikireyo, Yoabu yaaha Daudi omubaro gw'abantu abu yaabazire.
en: And Joab gave the sum of the number of the people unto David.

rr: Omuri Israeli yoona hakaba harimu abashaija enkwata-rurara akakaikuru n'akasiriira kamwe, n'omuri Yuda abashaija enkwata-rurara obusiriira buna n'obukumi mushanju.
en: And all they of Israel were a thousand thousand and an hundred thousand men that drew sword: and Judah was four hundred threescore and ten thousand men that drew sword.

rr: Kwonka omuri okwo kubara tiyaabariramu Baleevi n'obu baakuba Ababenyamiini; ahakuba ekiragiro ky'omugabe kikaba kimutamire.
en: But Levi and Benjamin counted he not among them: for the king's word was abominable to Joab.

rr: Kwonka ekigambo ekyo kyagwisa kubi Ruhanga, n'ahabw'ekyo yaateera Israeli.
en: And God was displeased with this thing; therefore he smote Israel.

rr: Daudi yaagira Ruhanga ati: Ncumwire munonga ahabw'ekyo eki nkozire. Kwonka hati ninkweshengyereza iha aha mwiru waawe okutahikiirira, ahakuba ndengyesereize, naakora eky'obufa-mutima.
en: And David said unto God, I have sinned greatly, because I have done this thing: but now, I beseech thee, do away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Gaadi omuhanuuzi wa Daudi ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Gad, David's seer, saying,

rr: Gyenda ogambire Daudi oti: Oku nikwo MUKAMA arikugamba naagira ati: Naakuha ebintu bishatu, oiheho kimwe, mbe nikyo naakukora.
en: Go and tell David, saying, Thus saith the LORD , I offer thee three things: choose thee one of them, that I may do it unto thee.

rr: Atyo Gaadi yaija ahari Daudi, yaamugira ati: Oku nikwo MUKAMA arikugamba naagira ati: Ahari ebi byonshatu tooranaho kimwe eki orikwenda
en: So Gad came to David, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD , Choose thee

rr: emyaka eshatu y'enjara; nari okucwekyerezibwa abazigu baawe, noitwa rurara yaabo okumara ameezi ashatu, nari ebiro bishatu bya rurara ya MUKAMA, orufu okujuumikira ensi, kandi na maraika wa MUKAMA naacwekyereza ensi ya Israeli yoona.
en: either three years' famine; or three months to be destroyed before thy foes, while that the sword of thine enemies overtaketh thee ; or else three days the sword of the LORD , even the pestilence, in the land, and the angel of the LORD destroying throughout all the coasts of Israel.

rr: Mbwenu gira eki waihamu, ongambire eki ndaagarukyemu ontumire.
en: Now therefore advise thyself what word I shall bring again to him that sent me.

rr: Daudi yaagira Gaadi ati: Naashobererwa kimwe; ka ngwe omu mikono ya MUKAMA, ahakuba embabazi ze ni nyingi munonga; ndekye kugwa omu mikono y'abantu.
en: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let me fall now into the hand of the LORD ; for very great are his mercies: but let me not fall into the hand of man.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo MUKAMA yaajuumikiza Israeli orufu, haafa Abaisraeli obukumi mushanju.
en: So the LORD sent pestilence upon Israel: and there fell of Israel seventy thousand men.

rr: Ruhanga yaatuma maraika Yerusaalemu kugicwekyereza; kwonka ku yaabaire ari haihi kugicwekyereza, MUKAMA yaareeba, yaayegarukamu ahabw'ao kabi; yaagira maraika owaabaire naacwekyereza, ati: Ekyo nikimara; banguura omukono.
en: And God sent an angel unto Jerusalem to destroy it: and as he was destroying, the LORD beheld, and he repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed, It is enough, stay now thine hand.

rr: Obwo maraika wa MUKAMA akaba ari haihi n'embuga ya Orunaani Omuyebusi.
en: And the angel of the LORD stood by the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.

rr: Daudi yaimutsya amaisho, yaareeba maraika wa MUKAMA ayemereire ahagati y'ensi n'eiguru, asyoireyo rurara, agyorekyeize Yerusaalemu.
en: And David lifted up his eyes, and saw the angel of the LORD stand between the earth and the heaven, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem.

rr: Ahonaaho Daudi n'abakuru baagwa ahasni bajuumaire, bajwaire ebiguniya.
en: Then David and the elders of Israel, who were clothed in sackcloth, fell upon their faces.

rr: Daudi yaagira Ruhanga ati: Tiinye ndagiire kubara abantu? Niinye ncumwire, nkakora kuba munonga. Mbwenu entaama ezi zo zikozire ki? Ninkweshengyereza, MUKAMA Ruhanga wangye, ba niinye waarwanisa n'enju ya tata; kwonka orekye kureeta orufu aha bantu baawe.
en: And David said unto God, Is it not I that commanded the people to be numbered? even I it is that have sinned and done evil indeed; but as for these sheep, what have they done? let thine hand, I pray thee, O LORD my God, be on me, and on my father's house; but not on thy people, that they should be plagued. An Altar unto the Lord

rr: Bwanyima maraika wa MUKAMA yaaragiira Gaadi kugambira Daudi ngu ainamukye ayombekyere MUKAMA eitambiro aha mbuga ya Orunaani Omuyebusi.
en: Then the angel of the LORD commanded Gad to say to David, that David should go up, and set up an altar unto the LORD in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.

rr: Atyo Daudi yainamuka ahabw'ekigambo kya Gaadi, eki yaagamba omu iziina rya MUKAMA.
en: And David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spake in the name of the LORD .

rr: Obwo Orunaani akaba naahuura engano; yaahinduka, yaareeba maraika, batabani be bana, abu yaabaire aine, baayeshereka.
en: And Ornan turned back, and saw the angel; and his four sons with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.

rr: Daudi ku yaabaire naizira Orunaani, Orunaani yaimutsya amaisho, yaamureeba, ahonaaho yaaruga aha mbuga, yainama, yaamutangirira.
en: And as David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshingfloor, and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground.

rr: Daudi yaagira Orunaani ati: Mpa ekibanja eki embuga yaawe erimu, nyombekyeremu MUKAMA eitambiro, orufu rubone kuruga aha bantu; kandi okinguze aha buguzi bwakyo bwona obukishemereire.
en: Then David said to Ornan, Grant me the place of this threshingfloor, that I may build an altar therein unto the LORD : thou shalt grant it me for the full price: that the plague may be stayed from the people.

rr: Orunaani yaagira Daudi ati: Kitware, Nyakusinga omugabe! okore eki orikusiima kyona; reeba, naakuha ente z'ebitambo by'okwotsya, n'ebihuuzo obiihemu enkum n'engano ogiihemu empongano y'esaano. Byona naabikuha.
en: And Ornan said unto David, Take it to thee, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes: lo, I give thee the oxen also for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meat offering; I give it all.

rr: Kwonka omugabe Daudi yaagira Orunaani ati: Ngaaha! kureka niinyija kukigura aha buguzi bwakyo bwona obukishemereire. Tindikwija kuhongyera MUKAMA ebyawe, n'obu kwakuba okutamba ebitambo eby'okwotsya, ebi ntaheereire byangye.
en: And king David said to Ornan, Nay; but I will verily buy it for the full price: for I will not take that which is thine for the LORD , nor offer burnt offerings without cost.

rr: Atyo Daudi yaarenga shekeli z'ezaabu magana mukaaga, yaaziihura Orunaani ahabw'ekibanja.
en: So David gave to Ornan for the place six hundred shekels of gold by weight.

rr: Bwanyima Daudi yaayombekyerayo MUKAMA eitambiro, yaamuhongyera ebitambo by'okwotsya n'empongano z'okusiima ahabw'obusingye, yaashaba MUKAMA, nawe yaamugarukamu n'omuriro ogurikuruga omu iguru, gwagwa aha itambiro ry'ebitambo eby'okwotsya.
en: And David built there an altar unto the LORD , and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called upon the LORD ; and he answered him from heaven by fire upon the altar of burnt offering.

rr: Ahonaaho MUKAMA yaaragiira maraika; yaagarura rurara ye omu kyobati kyayo.
en: And the LORD commanded the angel; and he put up his sword again into the sheath thereof.

rr: Omu bunaku obwo Daudi ku yaareebire MUKAMA amugarukiiremu aha mbuga ya Orunaani Omuyebusi, yaatambirayo ebitambo.
en: At that time when David saw that the LORD had answered him in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.

rr: Ahakuba Eihema rya MUKAMA, eri Musa yaakoreire omu ihamba, n'eitambiro ry'ebitambo by'okwotsya omu biro ebyo bikaba biri Gibeoni omu mwanya mukru gw'okuramizamu.
en: For the tabernacle of the LORD , which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of the burnt offering, were at that season in the high place at Gibeon.

rr: Kwonka Daudi tiyaabaasa kuza omu maisho gaaryo kwehanuuza ahari Ruhanga, ahabw'okuba akaba atiinire rurara ya maraika wa MUKAMA.
en: But David could not go before it to enquire of God: for he was afraid because of the sword of the angel of the LORD .

rr: Currently Selected: 1 Eby&x27;omu Busingye 21 : RR64 Highlight Share <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8 19c-2.828 0-4.243
Bwanyima Daudi yaagira ati: Aha niho enju ya MUKAMA Ruhanga eriba, kandi n'eitambiro ry'okwokyezaho ebitambo ahabwa Israeli.
en: Then David said, This is the house of the LORD God, and this is the altar of the burnt offering for Israel.

rr: Daudi yaaragiira kuteeranira hamwe abanyamahanga abaabaire bari omu nsi ya Israeli, yaata ababaizi b'amabaare kubaija ag'okwombekyesa enju ya Ruhanga.
en: And David commanded to gather together the strangers that were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to hew wrought stones to build the house of God.

rr: Kandi yaateekateeka ebyoma bingi by'okuheeshamu emisumaari y'enyigi z'amarembo, n'emiringa mingi munonga erengire kigyero
en: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the joinings; and brass in abundance without weight;

rr: n'ebiti by'emyereez ebitarikubarwa; ahabw'okuba Abasidoni n'Abatuuro bakareetera Daudi emyereezi mingi.
en: also cedar trees in abundance: for the Zidonians and they of Tyre brought much cedar wood to David.

rr: Ahakuba Daudi akagira ati: Sulemaani mutabani wangye akiri muto, takahamire, kandi enju erikwija kwombekyerwa MUKAMA eshemereire kuba ey'ekitiinisa kingi munonga, ekarangaanwa, ekahimbisibwa omu nsi zoona; n'ahabw'ekyo niinyija kugiteekateekyera eby'okugyombeka.
en: And David said, Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be builded for the LORD must be exceeding magnifical, of fame and of glory throughout all countries: I will therefore now make preparation for it.

rr: Atyo Daudi yaateekateeka ebintu bingi munonga atakafiire.
en: So David prepared abundantly before his death.

rr: Bwanyima yaayeta omutabani Sulemaani, yaamwehanangiriza kwombekyera MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli enju.
en: Then he called for Solomon his son, and charged him to build an house for the LORD God of Israel.

rr: 2 Yaagira Sulemaani ati: Mwana wangye, nkashangwa nkiine aha mutima kwombekyera eiziina rya MUKAMA Ruhanga wangye enju.
en: And David said to Solomon, My son, as for me, it was in my mind to build an house unto the name of the LORD my God:

rr: Kwonka ekigambo kya MUKAMA kyanyizira, nikigira kiti: Okasheesha eshagama nyingi, waarwana engamba nyingi; toryombekyera iziina ryangye nju, ahabw'okuba okasheesha eshagama nyingi omu maisho gangye.
en: but the word of the LORD came to me, saying, Thou hast shed blood abundantly, and hast made great wars: thou shalt not build an house unto my name, because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight.

rr: Reeba, oryazaarirwa omwana, abe ow'obusingye; kandi ndyamuha obusingye aha bazigu be boona abariba bamwehinguririize; ahakuba ei ziina rye aryayetwa Sulemaani; kandi omu biro bye ndyaha Israeli obusingye n'okutuuza.
en: Behold, a son shall be born to thee, who shall be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about: for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness unto Israel in his days.

rr: Ogwo niwe aryombekyera eiziina ryangye enju. Aryaba omwana wangye, naanye mbe ishe; kandi ndyahamya ekitebe ky'obugabe bwe omuri Israeli ebiro byona.
en: He shall build an house for my name; and he shall be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever.

rr: Mbwenu, mwana wangye, MUKAMA agume naiwe, obone kwombeka enju ya MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe, ogiheze gye, nk'oku yaakugambireho.
en: Now, my son, the LORD be with thee; and prosper thou, and build the house of the LORD thy God, as he hath said of thee.

rr: Kwonka, MUKAMA akuhe obwengye n'okwetegyereza, ku araakutegyekyese Israeli, oyorobere ebiragiro bya MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe.
en: Only the LORD give thee wisdom and understanding, and give thee charge concerning Israel, that thou mayest keep the law of the LORD thy God.

rr: Obwo, ku orita omutima ha kworobera ebiragiro n'ebyatairweho ebi MUKAMA yaaragiira Musa ahabwa Israeli, oryaba gye. Ba ow'amaani, ogume; otatiina, kandi otahahaaza omutima.
en: Then shalt thou prosper, if thou takest heed to fulfil the statutes and judgments which the LORD charged Moses with concerning Israel: be strong, and of good courage; dread not, nor be dismayed.

rr: Reeba, omu kufa kubi kwangye nteekateekyeire enju ya MUKAMA etalanta z'ezaabu akasiriira kamwe, n'ez'efeeza akakaikuru, n'emiringa n'ebyoma ebirengire ekigyero, ahabw'okuba ni bingi munoga; kandi nteekateekire embaaho n'amabaare. Ahari ebyo naiwe oryayongyeraho.
en: Now, behold, in my trouble I have prepared for the house of the LORD an hundred thousand talents of gold, and a thousand thousand talents of silver; and of brass and iron without weight; for it is in abundance: timber also and stone have I prepared; and thou mayest add thereto.

rr: Kandi oine abakozi baingi munonga, ababaizi b'amabaare, abombeki, ababaizi, abanyamyoga b'emiringo yoona abatarikubarwa
en: Moreover there are workmen with thee in abundance, hewers and workers of stone and timber, and all manner of cunning men for every manner of work.

rr: abarikumanya kukoresa ezaabu, efeeza, emiringa n'ebyoma. Imuka okore! MUKAMA agume naiwe.
en: Of the gold, the silver, and the brass, and the iron, there is no number. Arise therefore , and be doing, and the LORD be with thee.

rr: 1 Kandi Daudi yaaragiira abakuru ba Israeli boona kuhwera omutabani Sulemaani naagira ati
en: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying ,

rr: Timurikumanya MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu, ku ari hamwe naimwe? Kandi tabahaire obusignye embaju zoona? Ahabw'okuba akahayo abatuuzi b'ensi egi omu mikono yangye; kandi ensi egomoirwe omu maisho ga MUKAMA n'omu maisho g'bantu be.
en: Is not the LORD your God with you? and hath he not given you rest on every side? for he hath given the inhabitants of the land into mine hand; and the land is subdued before the LORD , and before his people.

rr: Mbwenu mute omutima gwanyu gwona aha kusherura MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu. Mwimukye, mwombekye Omwanya ogurikwera ogwa MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu, mubone kureeta eshanduukye y'endagaano ya MUKAMA, n'ebintu ebirikwera bya Ruhanga, omu nju eryombekyerwa eiziina rye. en: Now set your heart and your soul to seek the LORD your God; arise therefore, and build ye the sanctuary of the LORD God, to bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD , and the holy vessels of God, into the house that is to be built to the name of the LORD . rr: 1 Daudi ku yaakuzire, yaahika omu ngingo zaabukuru, yaayemeka omutabani Sulemaani kuba omugabe wa Israeli. Daudi okubaganisiza Abaleevi emirimu
en: So when David was old and full of days, he made Solomon his son king over Israel. Priests and Levites

rr: Yaateeranira hamwe abakuru ba Israeli boona, n'abanyamurwa n'Abaleevi.
en: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.

rr: Batyo baabara Abaleevi abahikize emyaka makumi ashatu n'abagirengize, boona baaba abashaija obukumi bushatu n'enkumi munaana.
en: Now the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upward: and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty and eight thousand.

rr: Daudi yaagira ati: Omuri aba, obukumi bubiri n'enkumi ina bakwatsibwe omurimo gw'okuheereza omu nju ya MUKAMA, enkumi mukaaga babee abatware n'abaramuzi
en: Of which, twenty and four thousand were to set forward the work of the house of the LORD ; and six thousand were officers and judges:

rr: enkumi ina babe abarinzi b'amarembo, kandi enkumi ina babe ab'okuhimbisa MUKAMA n'ebintu ebi nkozire ahabw'okuhimbisa.
en: moreover four thousand were porters; and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments which I made, said David , to praise therewith .

rr: Daudi yaabacwamu ebicweka nk'oku batabani ba Leevi baabaire bari: Gereshoni, Kohasi na Merari.
en: And David divided them into courses among the sons of Levi, namely , Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

rr: Batabani ba Gereshoni bakaba bari Ladani na Shimei.
en: Of the Gershonites were , Laadan, and Shimei.

rr: Beene Ladani: omukuru Yehieli, naakuratwa Zesamu na Yoeli, boona bashatu.
en: The sons of Laadan; the chief was Jehiel, and Zetham, and Joel, three.

rr: Beene Shimei, Shelomiisi, Hazieli, na Harani, boona bashatu. Abo nibo baabaire bari abakuru b'amaju ga baishenkuru ba Ladani.
en: The sons of Shimei; Shelomith, and Haziel, and Haran, three. These were , the chief of the fathers of Laadan.

rr: Beene Shimei, Yahasi, Ziina, Yeushi na Beria. Abo bana bakaba bari beene Shimei.
en: And the sons of Shimei were , Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.

rr: Yahasi niwe yaabaire ari mukuru, naakuratwa Ziiza, kwonka Yeushi na Beria bakaba bataine baana b'aboojo baingi; nikyo kyabareeteire kubarwa nk'ab'enju emwe eya baishenkurubo.
en: And Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second: but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons; therefore they were in one reckoning, according to their father's house.

rr: Batabani ba Kohasi: Amuraamu, Izuhaari, Heburooni na Uzieli, boona bana.
en: The sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.

rr: Beene Amuraamu, Arooni na Musa. Kandi Arooni ogwo niwe yaashoroirwe kuba ow'okweza ebintu ebirikwera munonga, we n'oruzaaro rwe kuguma nibootera obubaane omu maisho ga MUKAMA nibamuheereza, kandi n'okushabira abantu omugisha omu iziina rye ebiro byona.
en: The sons of Amram; Aaron and Moses: and Aaron was separated, that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons for ever, to burn incense before the LORD , to minister unto him, and to bless in his name for ever.

rr: 1 -25 ; . Kwonka beene Musa omushaija wa Ruhanga bakaba nibabarirwa omu ruganda rwa leevi.
en: Now concerning Moses the man of God, his sons were named of the tribe of Levi.

rr: Beene Musa, Gereshoni na Eliezeeri.
en: The sons of Moses were , Gershom, and Eliezer.

rr: Beene Gereshoni omukuru ni Shebueli.
en: Of the sons of Gershom, Shebuel was the chief.

rr: Beene Eliezeeri; Rehabia, niwe yaabaire ari mukuru, kandi Eliezeeri akaba ataine bandi baana b'aboojo, kwonka beene Rehabia bakaba bari baingi munonga.
en: And the sons of Eliezer were , Rehabiah the chief. And Eliezer had none other sons; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.

rr: Beene Izuhaari, Shelomiisi niwe yaabaire ari mukuru.
en: Of the sons of Izhar; Shelomith the chief.

rr: Beene Heburooni, Yeria niwe yaabaire ari mukuru, owa kabiri Amaria, owa kashatu Yahazieli, n'owa kana Yekameamu.
en: Of the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

rr: Beene Uzieli, Miika niwe yaabaire ari mukuru, naakuratwa Ishia.
en: Of the sons of Uzziel; Micah the first, and Jesiah the second.

rr: Batabani ba Merari: Mahili na Muushi; beene Mahili, Eleazaari na Kiishi.
en: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. The sons of Mahli; Eleazar, and Kish.

rr: Eleazaari yaafa atazaire baana b'aboojo, kureka abaishiki bonka; beene waabo batabani ba Kiishi baabashwera.
en: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters: and their brethren the sons of Kish took them.

rr: Beene Muushi, Mahili, Ederi na Yeremoosi, boona bashatu.
en: The sons of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.

rr: Ahabw'okuba Daudi akagira ati: MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli ahaire abantu be obusingye; kandi atuura omuri Yerusaalemu ebiro byona.
en: For David said, The LORD God of Israel hath given rest unto his people, that they may dwell in Jerusalem for ever:

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo Abaleevi tibakyetenga kuheeka Iheka, n'obu kyakuba ekintu kyona eky'okukoresa omurimo gwaryo
en: and also unto the Levites; they shall no more carry the tabernacle, nor any vessels of it for the service thereof.

rr: (ahakuba ahabw'ekiragiro kya Daudi eky'aha muheru Abaleevi abahikize emayka makumi abiri n'abagirengize bakabarwa)
en: For by the last words of David the Levites were numbered from twenty years old and above:

rr: kureka omurimo gwabo guryaba okuhwera beene Arooni ahabw'obuheereza omu nju ya MUKAMA, bakwatsiibwe ebibuga, ebishengye, okushemeza ebintu byona ebirikwera, kandi n'omurimo gwona ogw'okukora aha nju ya Ruhanga
en: because their office was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the LORD , in the courts, and in the chambers, and in the purifying of all holy things, and the work of the service of the house of God;

rr: -8 ; kandi n'okuhwera omu by'emigaati ey'okumurikwa, omu by'esaano ahabw'empongano z'esaano, omu bya capati z'emigaati etatumbisiibwe, omu by'empongano eziteekire, omu by'empongano ezijwangizemu amajuta, n'omu bigyero byona eby'okurengyesa obwingi n'obuhango.
en: both for the shewbread, and for the fine flour for meat offering, and for the unleavened cakes, and for that which is baked in the pan, and for that which is fried, and for all manner of measure and size;

rr: Buri kasheeshe baryayemerera basiime MUKAMA, nibamuhimbisa, kandi n'omu mwabazyo batyo
en: and to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD , and likewise at even;

rr: kandi ku bariba nibahongyera MUKAMA ebitambo by'okwotsya ahari buri sabato, nari ahari buri kuboneka kw'okwezi, nari aha biro bikuru by'amagyenyi, nk'ebiragiro byabyo oku biri, bakore batyo obutoosha omu maisho ga MUKAMA.
en: and to offer all burnt sacrifices unto the LORD in the sabbaths, in the new moons, and on the set feasts, by number, according to the order commanded unto them, continually before the LORD :

rr: Okwo nikwo baririnda Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu, kandi bakaheereza beene waabo, beene Arooni, omu buheereza bw'omu nju ya MUKAMA.
en: and that they should keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the holy place , and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren, in the service of the house of the LORD .

rr: Embu za beene Arooni zikaba ziri ziti. Batabani ba Arooni: Nadabu, Abihu, Eleazaari na Itamaari.
en: Now these are the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

rr: Kwonka Nadabu na Abihu bakabandiza ishebo kufa, kandi bakaba bataine baana; nikyo Eleazaari na Itamaari baabeereire abanyamurwa.
en: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children: therefore Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest's office.

rr: Daudi yaahwerwa Zadoki ow'omuri beene Eleazaari, na Ahimeleki ow'omuri beene Itamaari, kubabaganisa omu buheereza bwabo nk'emirimo ei bateereirweho oku eri.
en: And David distributed them, both Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, according to their offices in their service.

rr: Ahabwa beene Eleazaari kugira abantu bakuru baingi okweshumba beene Itamaari, baataho abakuru b'amaju ga baishenkurubo ikumi na mukaaga omuri beene Eleazaari, na munaana omuri beene Itamaari.
en: And there were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and thus were they divided. Among the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen chief men of the house of their fathers, and eight among the sons of Ithamar according to the house of their fathers.

rr: Baababaganisa n'enteenyu, boona omu muringo gumwe; ahakuba omuri beene Eleazaari n'omuri beene Itamaari hakaba harimu abatware b'Omwanya Ogurikwera, n'abatware ba Ruhanga.
en: Thus were they divided by lot, one sort with another; for the governors of the sanctuary, and governors of the house of God, were of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.

rr: Bwanyima Shemaya mwene Netaneeli omuhandiiki ow'omu Baleevi yaabahandiikira omu maisho g'omugabe n'abanyiginya, na Zadoki omunyamurwa, na Ahimeleki mwne Abiasaari, n'abakuru b'amaju ga baishenkuru b'abanyamurwa n'Abaleevi, enju emwe yaatooranirwa Eleazaari, n'endiijo Itamaari nibakuratana.
en: And Shemaiah the son of Nethaneel the scribe, one of the Levites, wrote them before the king, and the princes, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and before the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites: one principal household being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.

rr: Orubu rw'okubanza rwaba orwa Yehoyaribu, orwa kabiri Yedaaya
en: Now the first lot came forth to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,

rr: orwa kashatu Harimu, orwa kana Serorimi
en: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,

rr: orwa kataano Malukiya, orwa mukaaga Miyamiinu
en: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,

rr: orwa mushanju Hakozi, orwa munaana Abiya
en: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,

rr: orwa mwenda Yeshua, orwa ikumi Shekaniya
en: the ninth to Jeshuah, the tenth to Shecaniah,

rr: orwa ikumi na rumwe Eliashibu, orwa ikumi na ibiri Yakimi
en: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,

rr: orwa ikumi na ishatu Huupa, orwa ikumi na ina Yeshebeabu
en: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,

rr: orwa ikumi na itaano Biluga, orwa ikumi na mukaaga Imeri
en: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,

rr: orwa ikumi na mushanju Heziri, orwa ikumi na munaana Hapizeezi
en: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Aphses,

rr: orwa ikumi na mwenda Pesahia, orwa makumi abiri Yehezekeeli
en: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezekel,

rr: orwa makumi abiri na rumwe Yakini, orwa makumi abiri na ibiri Gamuli
en: the one and twentieth to Jachin, the two and twentieth to Gamul,

rr: orwa makumi abiri na ishatu Delaaya, orwa makumi abiri na ina Maaziya.
en: the three and twentieth to Delaiah, the four and twentieth to Maaziah.

rr: Ezo nizo zaabaire ziri embu z'emirimo y'obuheereza bwabo okutaaha omu nju ya MUKAMA, nibakuratira emitwarize ei baateereirweho Arooni, ishenkurubo, nk'oku MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli yaamuragiire.
en: These were the orderings of them in their service to come into the house of the LORD , according to their manner, under Aaron their father, as the LORD God of Israel had commanded him.

rr: Kandi abandi b'omuri beene Leevi nibo aba: omuri beene Amuraamu, Shubaeli; omuri beene Shubaeli, Yehodea
en: And the rest of the sons of Levi were these: Of the sons of Amram; Shubael: of the sons of Shubael; Jehdeiah.

rr: Beene Rehabia; omuri beene Rehabia, omukuru Ishia.
en: Concerning Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, the first was Isshiah.

rr: Beene Izuhaari: Shelomoosi; omuri beene Shelomoosi, Yahasi
en: Of the Izharites; Shelomoth: of the sons of Shelomoth; Jahath.

rr: Beene Heburooni: omukuru Yeria, owa kabiri Amari; owa kashatu Yahazieli, owa kana Yekameamu.
en: And the sons of Hebron ; Jeriah the first , Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.

rr: Beene Uzieli, Muika; omuri beene Miika, Shamiri.
en: Of the sons of Uzziel; Michah: of the sons of Michah; Shamir.

rr: Murumuna wa Miika, Ishia; omuri beene Ishia, Zekaria.
en: The brother of Michah was Isshiah: of the sons of Isshiah; Zechariah.

rr: Beene Merari: Mahili na Muushi. Beene Yaaziya: Beno.
en: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi: the sons of Jaaziah; Beno.

rr: Beene Merari: aba Yaaziya, Beno, Shohamu, Zakuri, na Iburi.
en: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah; Beno, and Shoham, and Zaccur, and Ibri.

rr: Owa Mahili, Eleazaari, owaabaire ataine baana b'aboojo.
en: Of Mahli came Eleazar, who had no sons.

rr: Aba Kiishi, beene Kiishi Yerameeli.
en: Concerning Kish: the son of Kish was Jerahmeel.

rr: Beene Muushi, Mahili, Ederi na Yerimoosi.
en: The sons also of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jerimoth.

rr: Abo nibo batabani ba beene Leevi nk'amaju ga baishenkurubo oku gaabare gari.
en: These were the sons of the Levites after the house of their fathers.

These likewise cast lots over against their brethren the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites, even the principal fathers over against their younger brethren.

rr: Daudi n'abakuru b'omurimo gw'obuheereza omuri hekalu baashoroora bamwe omuri beene Asafu n'aba Hemani n'aba Yedusuuni ahabw'omurimo, ngu babe ab'okuragura n'enanga n'endingiri n'ebitaasa. Amaziina g'abaabaire nibakora ogwo murimo omu mbu zaabo nigo aga
en: Moreover David and the captains of the host separated to the service of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who should prophesy with harps, with psalteries, and with cymbals: and the number of the workmen according to their service was:

rr: Omuri beene Asafu, Zakuri, Yosefu, Netania, na Ashareela, beene Asafu, abaabaire nibeebemberwa Asafu, naaragura nk'ekiragiro ky'omugabe oku kyabaire kiri.
en: of the sons of Asaph; Zaccur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and Asarelah, the sons of Asaph under the hands of Asaph, which prophesied according to the order of the king.

rr: Aba Yedusuuni, beene Yedusuuni: Gedalia, Zeeri, Yeshaaya, Shiemei, Hashabia na Matisia, boona mukaaga nibeebemberwa ishebo Yedusuuni, owaabaire naaragura n'endingiri, naasiima MUKAMA kandi naamuhimbisa.
en: Of Jeduthun: the sons of Jeduthun; Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with a harp, to give thanks and to praise the LORD .

rr: Aba Hemani, beene Hemani: Bukia, Matania, Uzieli, Shebueli, na Yerimoosi, Hanania, Hanani, Eliata, Gidaliti, na Romamutiezeeri, Yoshibekasha, Maloosi, Hosiri na Mahaziosi.
en: Of Heman: the sons of Heman; Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth:

rr: Abo boona bakaba bari beene Hemani omuhanuuzi w'omugabe, owaabaire naaanuura ebigambo bya Ruhanga eby'okumuha ekitiinisa; kandi Ruhanga yaaha Hemani abaana b'aboojo ikumi na bana, n'ab'abaishiki bashatu.
en: all these were the sons of Heman the king's seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. And God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

rr: Abo boona bakaba beebemberwa ishebo, nibeeshongorera omu nju ya MUKAMA n'ebitaasa n'enanga n'endingiri, nibakora omurimo gw'obuheereza omu nju ya Ruhanga. Kandi Asafu na Yedusuuni na Hemani bakaba baragiirwa omugabe.
en: All these were under the hands of their father for song in the house of the LORD , with cymbals, psalteries, and harps, for the service of the house of God, according to the king's order to Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman.

rr: Omubaro gwabo hamwe na beene waabo abaabaire beegyesiibwe okweshongorera MUKAMA, boona abaabaire nibakumanya gye, bakaba bari magana abiri na makumi munaana na munaana.
en: So the number of them, with their brethren that were instructed in the songs of the LORD , even all that were cunning, was two hundred fourscore and eight.

rr: Bwanyima baateerera emirimo yaabo enteenyu, abakuru n'abato, abeegyesa n'abeegi boona hamwe.
en: And they cast lots, ward against ward , as well the small as the great, the teacher as the scholar.

rr: Enteenyu y'okubanza yaakwata Yosefu ahabwa Asafu; eya kabiri, Gedalia na beene ishe n'abatabani, boona ikumi na babiri
en: Now the first lot came forth for Asaph to Joseph: the second to Gedaliah, who with his brethren and sons were twelve:

rr: eya kashatu, Zakuri n'abatabani na beene ishe, boona ikumi na babiri
en: the third to Zaccur, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

rr: eya kana, Izuri, n'abatabani ba beene ishe, boona ikumi na babiri
en: the fourth to Izri, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

rr: eya kataano, Netania n'abatabani na beene ishe, boona ikumi na babiri
en: the fifth to Nethaniah, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

rr: eya mukaaga, Bukia n'abatabani ba beene ishe, boona ikumi na babiri
en: the sixth to Bukkiah, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

rr: eya mushanju, Yeshareela, n'abatabani na beene ishe, boona ikumi na babiri
en: the seventh to Jesharelah, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

rr: eya munaana, Yeshaaya n'abatabani na beene ishe, boona ikumi na babiri
en: the eighth to Jeshaiah, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

rr: eya mwenda, Matania n'abatabani na beene ishe, boona ikumi na babiri
en: the ninth to Mattaniah, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

rr: eya ikumi Shimei n'abatabani na beene ishe, boona ikumi na babiri
en: the tenth to Shimei, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

rr: eya ikumi n'emwe, Azareeli n'abatabani na beene ishe, boona ikumi na babiri
en: the eleventh to Azareel, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

rr: eya ikumi na ibiri, Hashabia, n'abatabani na beene ishe, boona ikumi na babiri
en: the twelfth to Hashabiah, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

rr: eya ikumi na ishatu, Shubaeli n'abatabani ba beene ishe, boona ikumi na babiri
en: the thirteenth to Shubael, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

rr: eya ikumi na ina, Matisia, n'abatabani na beene ishe, boona ikumi na babiri
en: the fourteenth to Mattithiah, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

rr: eya ikumi na itaano Yeremoosi, n'abatabani na beene ishe, boona ikumi na babiri
en: the fifteenth to Jeremoth, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

rr: eya ikumi na mukaaga, Hanania, n'abatabani na beene ishe, boona ikumi na babiri
en: the sixteenth to Hananiah, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

rr: eya ikumi na mushanju Yeshebekasha, n'abatabani na beene ishe, boona ikumi na babiri
en: the seventeenth to Joshbekashah, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

rr: eya ikumi na munaana, Hanani n'abatabani na beene ishe, boona ikumi na babiri
en: the eighteenth to Hanani, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

rr: eya ikumi na mwenda, Maloosi n'abatabani na beene ishe, boona ikumi na babiri
en: the nineteenth to Mallothi, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

rr: eya makumi abiri, Eliasa n'abatabani na beene ishe, boona ikumi na babiri
en: the twentieth to Eliathah, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

rr: eya makumi abiri n'emwe, Hosiri n'abatabani na beene ishe, boona ikumi na babiri
en: the one and twentieth to Hothir, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

rr: ey makumi abiri na ibiri, Gidaliti n'abatabani na beene ishe, boona ikumi na babiri
en: the two and twentieth to Giddalti, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

rr: eya makumi abiri na ishatu, Mahaziosi n'abatabani na beene ishe, boona ikumi na babiri
en: the three and twentieth to Mahazioth, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

rr: n'eya makumi abiri na ina, Romamutiezeeri n'abatabani na beene ishe, boona ikumi na babiri.
en: the four and twentieth to Romamti-ezer, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve.

rr: Eby'embu z'abakumiirizi b'amarembo; ab'omu ba Koora, Meshelemia mwene Koore, ow'omuri beene Asafu.
en: Concerning the divisions of the porters: Of the Korhites was Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.

rr: Kandi Meshelemia ogwo akaba aine abaana b'aboojo; ow'omujigaijo zekaria, owa kabiri Yedyaeli, owa kashatu Zebadia, owa kana Yatinyeli
en: And the sons of Meshelemiah were , Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,

rr: owa kataano Elamu, owa mukaaga Yehohanani, owa mushanju Elyeho-enai.
en: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Elioenai the seventh.

rr: Obededomu nawe akaba aine abatabani: ow'omujigaijo Shemaaya, owa kabiri Yehozabadi, owa kashatu Yoa, owa kana Skari, owa kataano Netaneeli
en: Moreover the sons of Obed-edom were , Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethaneel the fifth,

rr: owa mukaaga Amieli, owa mushanju Isakaari, owa munaana Peulesa; ahakuba Ruhanga akamuha omugisha.
en: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peulthai the eighth: for God blessed him.

rr: Kandi omutabani Shemaaya akazaara abaana b'aboojo, abaabaire bari abategyeki omu maju ga baishenkurubo; ahabw'okuba bakaba bari abashaija b'amaani amamanzi.
en: Also unto Shemaiah his son were sons born, that ruled throughout the house of their father: for they were mighty men of valour.

rr: Beene Shemaaya: otuni, Refaeli, Ebedi, Elizabaadi na beene ishe abaabaire bari amamanzi, Elihu na Semakia.
en: The sons of Shemaiah; Othni, and Rephael, and Obed, Elzabad, whose brethren were strong men, Elihu, and Semachiah.

rr: Abo boona bakaba bari beene Obededomu hamwe na batabani baabo na beene ishebo, abashaija b'amaani abaabaire nibabaasa ogwo murimo; aba Obededomu boona bakaba bari makumi mukaaga na babiri.
en: All these of the sons of Obed-edom: they and their sons and their brethren, able men for strength for the service, were threescore and two of Obed-edom.

rr: Kandi Meshelemia akaba aine abatabani na beene ishe, aqbashaija amamanzi ikumi na munaana.
en: And Meshelemiah had sons and brethren, strong men, eighteen.

rr: Na Hoosa ow'omuri beene Merari akaba aine abatabani: omukuru ari Shimuri, (ahakuba n'obu araabe yaabaire atari w'omujigaijo, ishe akamuhindura mukuru)
en: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons; Simri the chief, (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him the chief;)

rr: owa kabiri Hilukia, owa kashatu Tebalia, n'owa kana Zekaria; batabani ba Hoosa na beene ishe boona bakaba bari ikumi na bashatu.
en: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth: all the sons and brethren of Hosah were thirteen.

rr: Abakumiirizi b'amarembo omuri ezo mbu, nk'abakuru baabo oku baabaire bari, bakaba baine emirimo ei bakwatsiibwe, nka beene waabo abaabaire nibaheereza omu nju ya MUKAMA oku baabaire bagiine
en: Among these were the divisions of the porters, even among the chief men, having wards one against another, to minister in the house of the LORD .

rr: kandi baateerera amaju ga baishenkurubo enteenyu, amakye n'amahango, kumanya ab'okurinda amarembo gaabo.
en: And they cast lots, as well the small as the great, according to the house of their fathers, for every gate.

rr: Enteenyu yaakwata Shelemia kurinda eirembo ry'oburugwa-izooba.
en: And the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah.

rr: Bwanyima baateerera omutabani Zekaria enteenyu, omuhanuuzi w'obwengye; yaakwatwa ey'okurinda ery'aha bukiizi-bwa-bumosho.
en: Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counsellor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.

rr: Obededomu yaakwata ey'okurinda ery'aha bukiizi-bwa-buryo; kandi abatabani baakwatsibwa eibiikiro.
en: To Obed-edom southward; and to his sons the house of Asuppim.

rr: Shupimu na Hoosa baakwatwa ey'okurinda eirembo ry'oburengyerwa-izooba, n'eirembo rya Shalekesi aha muhanda ogurikwinamuka, ahu abakumiirizi barikureebanira.
en: To Shuppim and Hosah the lot came forth westward, with the gate Shallecheth, by the causeway of the going up, ward against ward.

rr: Aha burugwa-izooba haazaho mukaaga buri izooba, aha bukiizi-bwa-bumosho bana buri izooba; aha bukiizi-bwa-buryo bana, kandi n'aha ibiikiro babiri-babiri
en: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and toward Asuppim two and two.

rr: ahari Paribaari oburengyerwa-izooba bana ahari ogwo muhanda, na babiri ahari Paribaari.
en: At Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.

rr: Ezo nizo mbu z'abakumiirizi b'amarembo b'omuri beene Koore, na beene Merari.
en: These are the divisions of the porters among the sons of Kore, and among the sons of Merari.

rr: Kandi ab'omu Baleevi, Ahiya niwe yaabaire akwatsiibwe amabiikiro g'enju ya Ruhanga n'amabiikiro g'ebintu ebyeziibwe.
en: And of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of the house of God, and over the treasures of the dedicated things.

rr: Beene Ladani, beene Gereshon ab'omu ba Ladani, abakuru b'amaju ga baishenkurubo ba Ladani owa Gereshoni: Yahieli.
en: As concerning the sons of Laadan; the sons of the Gershonite Laadan, chief fathers, even of Laadan the Gershonite, were Jehieli.

rr: . Kandi ab'omu Baleevi, Ahiya niwe yaabaire akwatsiibwe amabiikiro g'enju ya Ruhanga n'amabiikiro g'ebintu ebyeziibwe. 21 Beene Ladani, beene Gereshon ab'omu ba Ladani, abakuru b'amaju ga baishenkurubo ba Ladani owa Gereshoni: Yahieli. 22 Beene Yehieli, Zetami na Yoeli omurumuna nibo baabaire bakwatsiibwe amabiikiro g'enju ya MUKAMA.
en: The sons of Jehieli; Zetham, and Joel his brother, which were over the treasures of the house of the LORD .

rr: Omu ba Amuraamu, Abaizuhaari, Abaheburooni n'Abauzieli-
en: Of the Amramites, and the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites:

rr: Beene ishe Eliezeeri akakomookwaho Rehabia omutabani, mwene Rehebia Yeshaaya, mwene Yeshaaya Yoramu, mwene Yoramu Zikuri, mwene Zikuri Shelomoosi
en: And his brethren by Eliezer; Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.

rr: Omu bintu ebi baanyagire omu ngamba bakashorooramu ebintu by'okuhunduuza enju ya MUKAMA.
en: Out of the spoils won in battles did they dedicate to maintain the house of the LORD .

rr: Kandi ebi Samueli omuhanuuzi na Saulo mwene Kiishi, na Abuneeri mwene Neeri, na Yoabu mwene Zeruiya baayerize byona, ebi omuntu weena yaabaire ahongyeire MUKAMA byona bikaba birindwa Shelomoosi na beene ishe.
en: And all that Samuel the seer, and Saul the son of Kish, and Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah, had dedicated; and whosoever had dedicated any thing, it was under the hand of Shelomith, and of his brethren.

rr: Omuri beene Izuhaari, Kanania n'abatabani nibo baabaire bakwatsiibwe omurimo gw'aheeru ahabw'Abaisraeli, bari abatware n'abaramuzi.
en: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were for the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.

rr: Omuri beene Heburooni, Hashabia ana beene ishe, abashaija amamanzi rukumi na magana mushanju, nibo baabaire nibareeberera Israeli oburengyerwa-izooba bwa Yorudani ahabw'omurimo gwa MUKAMA gwona, n'ahabw'omurimo gw'omugabe.
en: And of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brethren, men of valour, a thousand and seven hundred, were officers among them of Israel on this side Jordan westward in all the business of the LORD , and in the service of the king.

rr: Omu ba Heburooni abo Yeriya niwe yaabaire ari omukuru waabo, nk'okukuratana kw'oruzaaro rw'abakuru b'amaju ga baishenkurubo oku kwabaire kuri. (Omu mwaka gwa makumi ana ogw'omu busingye bwa Daudi bakasherura, baashanga omuri abo ba Heburooni abashaija b'amaani amamanzi, bari Yazeri omuri Gileadi.)
en: Among the Hebronites was Jerijah the chief, even among the Hebronites, according to the generations of his fathers. In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for, and there were found among them mighty men of valour at Jazer of Gilead.

rr: Omugabe Daudi yaataho Yeriya ogwo na beene ishe, abashaija amamanzi enkumi ibiri na magana mushanju, abakuru b'amaju ga baishenkurubo, kuba ab'okureeberera Abareubeeni, Abagaadi n'ekicweka ky'oruganda rwa Manaase, ahabw'ebintu bya Ruhanga byona, kandi n'eby'omugabe.
en: And his brethren, men of valour, were two thousand and seven hundred chief fathers, whom king David made rulers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, for every matter pertaining to God, and affairs of the king.

rr: Aga nigo maziina g'Abaisraeli, abakuru b'amaju ga baishenkurubo, abakuru b'engabo rukumi-rukumi n'aba igana-igana n'abatware baabo abaabaire nibaheereza omugabe omu murimo gw'okureeberera abantu omu by'okwihaihana kw'embu zaabo, buri rubu rukaba rurimu abantu obukumi bubiri n'enkumi ina.
en: Now the children of Israel after their number, to wit , the chief fathers and captains of thousands and hundreds, and their officers that served the king in any matter of the courses, which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year, of every course were twenty and four thousand.

rr: Yashobeamu mwene Zabudieli niwe yaabaire naareeberera orubu rw'okubanza omu kwezi kw'okubanza; ab'orubu rwe bakaba bari obukumi bubiri n'enkumi ina.
en: Over the first course for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

rr: Akaba ari ow'omuri baijukuru ba Pereezi, kandi ari omutegyeki mukuru w'abakuru b'amahe boona omu kwezi kw'okubanza.
en: Of the children of Perez was the chief of all the captains of the host for the first month.

rr: Dodai owa Ahohi niwe yaabaire naareeberera ab'orubu rw'okwezi kwa kabiri; ab'omu rubu rwe bakaba bari obukumi bubiri n'enkumi ina.
en: And over the course of the second month was Dodai an Ahohite, and of his course was Mikloth also the ruler: in his course likewise were twenty and four thousand.

rr: Omukuru wa kashatu omu kwezi kwa kashatu akaba ari Benaaya mwene Yehoyaada omunyamurwa mukuru; ab'omu rubu rwe bakaba bari obukumi bubiri n'enkumi ina.
en: The third captain of the host for the third month was Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, a chief priest: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

rr: Benaaya ogwo niwe yaabaire ari omushaija w'amaani ow'omuri bari amakumi ashatu, kandi ari omukuru waabo. Amizabaadi omutabani akaba ari omu rubu rwe.
en: This is that Benaiah, who was mighty among the thirty, and above the thirty: and in his course was Ammizabad his son.

rr: Asaheeli murumuna wa Yoabu niwe yaabaire ari omukuru wa kana omu kwezi kwa kana, naakuratwa omutabani Zebadia; ab'omu rubu rwe bakaba bari obukumi bubiri n'enkumi ina.
en: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

rr: Omukuru wa kataano omu kwezi kwa kataano akaba ari Shamuhuusi owa Izuraahi; ab'omu rubu rwe bakaba bari obukumi bubiri n'enkumi ina.
en: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

rr: Omukuru wa mukaaga omu kwezi kwa mukaaga akaba ari Iira mwene Ikeshi owa Tekoa; ab'omu rubu rwe bakaba bari obukumi bubiri n'enkumi ina.
en: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

rr: Omukuru wa mushanju omu kwezi kwa mushanju akaba ari Helezi owa Pelooni ow'omuri beene Efuraimu; ab'omu rubu rwe bakaba bari obukumi bubiri n'enkumi ina.
en: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

rr: Owa munaana omu kwezi kwa munaana akaba ari Sibekai, owa Huusha, ow'omu ba Zeera; ab'omu rubu rwe bakaba bari obukumi bubiri n'enkumi ina.
en: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

rr: Owa mwenda omu kwezi kwa mwenda akaba ari Abiezeeri owa Anatoosi, Omubenyamiini; ab'omu rubu rwe bakaba bari obukumi bubiri n'enkumi ina.
en: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anetothite, of the Benjamites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

rr: Owa ikumi, omu kwezi kwa ikumi akaba ari Maharai owa Netofa, ow'omu ba Zeera; ab'omu rubu rwe bakaba bari obukumi bubiri n'enkumi ina.
en: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

rr: Owa ikumi n'omwe omu kwezi kwa ikumi na kumwe akaba ari Benaaya owa Piratooni ow'omuri beene Efuraimu; ab'omu rubu rwe bakaba bari obukumi bubiri n'enkumi ina.
en: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

rr: Owa ikumi na babiri omu kwezi kwa ikumi n'abiri akaba ari Heludai owa Netofa mwene Otinyeli; ab'omu rubu rwe bakaba bari obukumi bubiri n'enkumi ina.
en: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

rr: Kandi abategyeki b'enganda za Israeli nibo aba; omukuru w'Abareubeeni akaba ari Eliezeeri mwene Zikuri; ow'Abasimeoni, Shefatia mwwene Maaka
en: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: the ruler of the Reubenites was Eliezer the son of Zichri: of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maachah:

rr: ow'Abaleevi, Hashabia mwene Kemueli; ow'aba Arooni, Zadoki
en: of the Levites, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel: of the Aaronites, Zadok:

rr: ow'Abayuda, Elihu omwe ahari bakuru ba Daudi; ow'Abaisakaari, Omuri mwene Mikaeli
en: of Judah, Elihu, one of the brethren of David: of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael:

rr: ow'Abazebuluuni, Ishimaaya, mwene Obadia; ow'Abanafutaali, Yeremoosi mwene Azurieli
en: of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah: of Naphtali, Jerimoth the son of Azriel:

rr: ow'Abaefuraimu, Hoshea mwene Azazia; ow'ekicweka ky'oruganda rwa Manaase, Yoeli mwene Pedaya
en: of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah: of the half tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah:

rr: ow'ekicweka ky'oruganda rwa Manaase eky'omuri Gileadi, Ido mwene Zekaria; ow'Ababenyamiini, Yaasieli mwene Abuneeri
en: of the half tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah: of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner:

rr: ow'Abadaani, Azareeli mwene Yerohaamu. Abo nibo baabaire bari abakuru b'enganda za Israeli.
en: of Dan, Azareel the son of Jeroham. These were the princes of the tribes of Israel.

rr: Kwonka Daudi tarabazire batakahikize myaka makumi abiri, ahakuba MUKAMA akagamba ku arikanyisa Abaisraeli, bakaba nk'enyonyoozi z'omu iguru.
en: But David took not the number of them from twenty years old and under: because the LORD had said he would increase Israel like to the stars of the heavens.

rr: 1 Yoabu mwene Zeruiya yaatandika kubara, kwonka tiyaaheza; nikyo ekiniga kyaiziire ahari Israeli, kandi omubaro ogwo tiguhandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'eby'omu busingye bw'omugabe Daudi.
en: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to number, but he finished not, because there fell wrath for it against Israel; neither was the number put in the account of the chronicles of king David.

rr: Omureeberezi w'amabiikiro g'omugabe akaba ari Azimaveesi mwene Adieli; ow'amabiikiro g'omu byaro, omu ndembo, omu birorero n'omu bigo, Yonasaani mwene Uziya
en: And over the king's treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel: and over the storehouses in the fields, in the cities, and in the villages, and in the castles, was Jehonathan the son of Uzziah:

rr: ow'abahingi b'omu misiri, Ezeri mwene Kelubu
en: and over them that did the work of the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub:

rr: ow'emisiri y'emizaabibu Shimei owa Raama; ow'ebirikuruga omu mizaabibu eby'okubiikwa omu mabiikiro ga viinyo, Zabudi owa Shiifu
en: and over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite: over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite:

rr: ow'emiti y'emizeituuni n'emisikamoori ey'omu ruhita, Baali-hanani owa Gederi; ow'amabiikiro g'amajuta, Yoashi
en: and over the olive trees and the sycomore trees that were in the low plains was Baal-hanan the Gederite: and over the cellars of oil was Joash:

rr: ow'amasyo agaabaire gagisiire Sharooni, Shiturai owa Sharooni; ow'amasyo agaabaire gagisiire omu mpita, Shafati mwene Adulai
en: and over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite: and over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai:

rr: ow'engamira, Ebili owa Ishimaeli; ow'endogoya, Yehedeeya owa Meranoosi; kandi ow'obusyo bw'entaama, Yazizi owa Hagiri.
en: over the camels also was Obil the Ishmaelite: and over the asses was Jehdeiah the Meronothite:

rr: Abo boona nibo baabaire bari ababiiki b'ebintu bya Daudi.
en: and over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagerite. All these were the rulers of the substance which was king David's.

rr: Yonasaani ishento wa Daudi niwe yaabaire ari omuhanuuzi, omushaija orikwetegyereza kandi omuhandiiki; we na Yehieli mwene Hakimooni nibo baabaire nibarera abaana b'omugabe.
en: Also Jonathan David's uncle was a counsellor, a wise man, and a scribe: and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king's sons:

rr: Ahisofeeli akaba ari omuhanuuzi w'omugabe, na Hushai owa Aruki ari munywani w'omugabe.
en: and Ahithophel was the king's counsellor: and Hushai the Archite was the king's companion:

rr: Ahisofeeli akakuratwa Yehoyaada mwene Benaaya, na Abiasaari. Kandi Yoabu niwe yaabaire ari omukuru w'eihe ry'omugabe. Currently Selected: 1 Eby&x27;omu Busingye 27 : RR64 Highlight Share <path d="M5 12a1 1 0 0 1

rr: 1 -47 ; 23:2 ; 27:1-15 , 16-22 , 25-31 . Daudi yaateeranira Yerusaalemu abakuru ba Israeli boona, ab'enganda n'abategyeki b'emitwe y'abantu abaabaire baheereza omugabe omu mbu, n'abakuru b'engabo rukumi-rukumi, n'aba igana-igana, n'ababiiki b'ebintu by'omugabe, abarikureeberera amasyo ge n'ag'abatabani, hamwe n'abakuru b'ekikaari, n'abashaija bari ab'amaani amamanzi boona.
en: And David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, and the captains of the companies that ministered to the king by course, and the captains over the thousands, and captains over the hundreds, and the stewards over all the substance and possession of the king, and of his sons, with the officers, and with the mighty men, and with all the valiant men, unto Jerusalem.

rr: Bwanyima Daudi yaimuka, yaagira ati: Imwe beene tata n'abashaija bangye, mumpurire. Nkashangwa nkiinie aha mutima kwombekyera eshanduukye y'endaagano ya MUKAMA enju y'okugitamu, n'okuba akatebe k'ebigyere ka Ruhanga; kandi nikwo naabaire nyetegwire ntyo.
en: Then David the king stood up upon his feet, and said, Hear me, my brethren, and my people: As for me , I had in mine heart to build an house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the LORD , and for the footstool of our God, and had made ready for the building:

rr: Kwonka Ruhanga yangira ati: Torikwija kwombekyera iziina ryangye nju, ahabw'okuba ori omushaija omurwani, kandi okasheesha eshagama nyingi.
en: but God said unto me, Thou shalt not build an house for my name, because thou hast been a man of war, and hast shed blood.

rr: N'obu kiraabe kyabaire kiri kityo, MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli akantoorana omu ruganda rwa baatatenkuru rwona kuba omugabe wa Israeli ebiro byona; ahabw'okuba akatoorana Yuda kuba omwebembezi, omu ruganda rwa Yuda yaatoorana enju ya tata, kandi omuri beene tata yaaba niinye yaihamu, yanshemerererwa, yangira omugabe wa Israeli yoona.
en: Howbeit the LORD God of Israel chose me before all the house of my father to be king over Israel for ever: for he hath chosen Judah to be the ruler; and of the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he liked me to make me king over all Israel:

rr: 1 -9 ; 22:9 . bwenu omuri batabani bangye boona, (ahabw'okuba Ruhanga akampa abaana b'aboojo baingi,) yaatooranamu mutabani wangye Sulemaani kuba niwe yaaza aha kitebe ky'obugabe bwa MUKAMA kutegyeka Israeli.
en: and of all my sons, (for the LORD hath given me many sons,) he hath chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the LORD over Israel.

rr: Yangira ati: Mutabani waawe Sulemaani niwe aryombeka enju yangye, n'ebikaari byangye, ahabw'okuba mmutooraine kuba omwana wangye, naanye nkaba ishe.
en: And he said unto me, Solomon thy son, he shall build my house and my courts: for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.

rr: Ku arigumizamu kworobera ebiragiro byangye n'ebi naataireho, nk'oku ari hati, ndyahamya obugabe bwe.
en: Moreover I will establish his kingdom for ever, if he be constant to do my commandments and my judgments, as at this day.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo hati omu maisho ga Israeli yoona, nigwo mutwe gw'abantu ba MUKAMA abateeraine, kandi omu maisho ga Ruhanga waitu orikutuhurira, mute omutima aha biragiro bya MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu byona, mubiijukye, mubone kukubuura ensi egi enungi, nyentsya mugitsigire abaana baanyu abaribakurata, ebe obuhunguzi bwabo ebiro byona.
en: Now therefore in the sight of all Israel the congregation of the LORD , and in the audience of our God, keep and seek for all the commandments of the LORD your God: that ye may possess this good land, and leave it for an inheritance for your children after you for ever.

rr: Naiwe Sulemaani mwana wangye, omanye Ruhanga wa sho, ogume omuheereze n'omutima gwawe gwona kandi ogwekundiire; ahabw'okuba MUKAMA acaaka emitima yoona, kandi amanya enaama zoona n'ebiteekateeko byona. Ku orimusherura, oryamubona; kwonka ku orimurugaho, aryakucwa obutagaruka.
en: And thou, Solomon my son, know thou the God of thy father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind: for the LORD searcheth all hearts, and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts: if thou seek him, he will be found of thee; but if thou forsake him, he will cast thee off for ever.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo mbwenu oyerinda; ahabw'okuba MUKAMA akutooraine kwombekyera Obutaaho bwe enju: ba ow'amaani, ogikore. Daido okuha Sulemaani eky'okureeberaho ky'enju
en: Take heed now; for the LORD hath chosen thee to build an house for the sanctuary: be strong, and do it .

rr: Bwanyima Daudi yaaha omutabani Sulemaani eky'okureeberaho ky'ekisasi kya hekalu, n'eky'amaju gaayo, n'eky'amabiikiro gaayo, n'eky'ebishengye byayo eby'ahaiguru, n'eby'omunda, n'eky'ekishengye ky'ekitebe ky'okusaasira
en: Then David gave to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch, and of the houses thereof, and of the treasuries thereof, and of the upper chambers thereof, and of the inner parlours thereof, and of the place of the mercy seat,

rr: kandi eky'okureeberaho ky'ebi yaabaire aine omu mutima byona, eky'ebikaari by'enju ya MUKAMA, n'ebishengye byona ebigyehinguririize, n'amabiikiro g'enju ya Ruhanga, n'ag'ebintu by'emitoijo ebyashoroirwe
en: and the pattern of all that he had by the spirit, of the courts of the house of the LORD , and of all the chambers round about, of the treasuries of the house of God, and of the treasuries of the dedicated things:

rr: kandi n'eby'embu z'abanyamurwa n'Abaleevi, n'eby'emirimo yoona ey'okukorerwa omu nju ya MUKAMA; n'eby'ebintu byona eby'okukoresibwa omu nju ya MUKAMA.
en: also for the courses of the priests and the Levites, and for all the work of the service of the house of the LORD , and for all the vessels of service in the house of the LORD .

rr: Kandi yaamugambira oburemeezi bw'ezaabu ahabw'ebintu by'ezaabu eby'okukoresa emirimo yoona, n'oburemeezi bw'efeeza ahabw'ebintu by'efeeza ahabw'emirimo yoona
en: He gave of gold by weight for things of gold, for all instruments of all manner of service; silver also for all instruments of silver by weight, for all instruments of every kind of service:

rr: n'oburemeezi bwe'ekikondo ky'amatabaaza n'amatabaaza gaakyo eby'ezaabu, n'oburemeezi bw'ezaabu ahabw'ekikondo kyona n'amataabaza gaakyo, nka buri kikondo oku kirikoresibwa omu buheereza bwabo
en: even the weight for the candlesticks of gold, and for their lamps of gold, by weight for every candlestick, and for the lamps thereof: and for the candlesticks of silver by weight, both for the candlestick, and also for the lamps thereof, according to the use of every candlestick.

rr: n'oburemeezi bw'ezaabu za buri meeza y'emigaati y'okumurikwa, n'obw'efeeza ahabw'emeeza z'efeeza
en: And by weight he gave gold for the tables of shewbread, for every table; and likewise silver for the tables of silver:

rr: n'obw'ezaabu eshemeziibwe ahabw'eby'okwihuza enyama, n'enyabya, n'ebikopo; n'obw'ezaabu za buru bakuri y'ezaabu, n'obw'efeeza za buri bakuri y'efeeza
en: also pure gold for the fleshhooks, and the bowls, and the cups: and for the golden basons he gave gold by weight for every bason; and likewise silver by weight for every bason of silver:

rr: 1 -28 ; -22 ; 30:1 . kandi n'eky'okureeberaho ky'eitambiro ry'okwotereraho obubaane, ery'okukorwa omu zaabu eshemeziibwe, n'oburemeezi bwayo; kandi n'eky'okureeberaho ky'ekigaari ky'ezaabu ekya baakerubi, abashashanwire amapapa gaabo, gakashweka eshanduukye y'endagaano ya MUKAMA.
en: and for the altar of incense refined gold by weight; and gold for the pattern of the chariot of the cherubims, that spread out their wings , and covered the ark of the covenant of the LORD .

rr: Kandi reeba, hariho embu z'abanyamurwa n'Abaleevi ahabw'omurimo gwona ogw'obuheereza bw'omu nju ya Ruhanga; kandi omuri egyo mirimo yoona, oryaba oine omuntu weena oyekundiire, omunyamwoga w'okukora omurimo gwa buri muringo; kandi n'abategyeki hamwe n'abantu boona baryaba bari omu bushoboorozi bwawe kuhurira eki orikubaragiira.
en: And, behold, the courses of the priests and the Levites, even they shall be with thee for all the service of the house of God: and there shall be with thee for all manner of workmanship every willing skilful man, for any manner of service: also the princes and all the people will be wholly at thy commandment.

rr: Bwanyima omugabe Daudi yaagambira omutwe gwona ogwabaire guteeraine ati: Mutabani wangye Sulemaani, ou Ruhanga atooraine wenka, akiri muto, takahamire, kandi omurimo ni muhango; ahabw'okuba enju teriba nju y'abantu, kureka eryaba eya MUKAMA Ruhanga.
en: Furthermore David the king said unto all the congregation, Solomon my son, whom alone God hath chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great: for the palace is not for man, but for the LORD God.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo ntegwire enju ya Ruhanga wangye, nk'oku ndikubaasa, naatunga ezaabu ahabw'ebintu by'ezaabu, efeeza ahabw'ebintu by'efeeza, emiringa ahabw'ebintu by'emiringa, ebyoma ahabw'ebintu by'ebyoma, n'ebiti ahabw'ebintu by'ebiti, otabariireho mabaare amaingi agarikwetwa shohamu, n'agandi mabaare maingi g'okuhunda, n'amabaare garikwengyengyeta ag'amabara maingi n'ag'obuguzi bwingi ag'emiringo yoona, n'agarikwetwa marimaari agatarikubarwa.
en: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for things to be made of gold, and the silver for things of silver, and the brass for things of brass, the iron for things of iron, and wood for things of wood; onyx stones, and stones to be set, glistering stones, and of divers colours, and all manner of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.

rr: Kandi ahabw'okukunda oku nyine aha nju ya Ruhanga wangye, nk'oku nyine obutungi bwangye ahabwangye obw'ezaabu n'efeeza, mbwenu naabuhayo ahabw'enju ya Ruhanga wangye, okwongyera ahari ebyo byona ebi naateekateekyeire egyo nju erikwera
en: Moreover, because I have set my affection to the house of my God, I have of mine own proper good, of gold and silver, which I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house,

rr: n'etalanta z'ezaabu za Ofiri enkumi ishatu, ez'efeeza eshemeziibwe enkumi mushanju ez'okushweka ebisiika by'enju
en: even three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the houses withal:

rr: ezaabu ahabw'ebintu by'ezaabu, n'efeeza ahabw'ebintu by'efeeza, ebirikukorwa abanyamyoga b'obwengye. Mbwenu eri izooba n'oha orikwikiriza kugira eki yaahayo, naayeyereza MUKAMA? Abakuru b'enganda nabo okureeta emitoijo yaabo
en: the gold for things of gold, and the silver for things of silver, and for all manner of work to be made by the hands of artificers. And who then is willing to consecrate his service this day unto the LORD ?

rr: 1 -31 ; 28:1 . Bwanyima abakuru b'amaju ga baishenkurubo, n'abeebembezi b'enganda za Israeli, n'abakuru b'engabo rukumi-rukumi, n'aba igana-igana, n'abategyeki b'emirimo y'omugabe, baahayo ebintu byabo n'omutima gwekundiire.
en: Then the chief of the fathers and princes of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers of the king's work, offered willingly,

rr: Baahayo etalanta z'ezaabu enkumi itaano na dariki kakumi, etalanta z'efeeza kakumi, ez'emiringa kakumi n'enkumi munaana, n'etalanta z'ebyoma akasiriira, ahabw'omurimo gw'enju ya Ruhanga.
en: and gave for the service of the house of God of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand drams, and of silver ten thousand talents, and of brass eighteen thousand talents, and one hundred thousand talents of iron.

rr: Kandi omuntu weena owaabaire aine amabaare g'obuguzi bwingi, yaagahayo, baagata omu ibikiro ry'enju ya MUKAMA kurindwa Yehieli owa Gereshoni.
en: And they with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of the house of the LORD , by the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.

rr: Bwanyima abantu baashemererwa, ahabw'okuba abo bantu bakahayo n'omutima ogwekundiire; ahakuba bakahongyera MUKAMA n'omutima gwabo gwona batarikugyemwa; kandi n'omugabe Daudi yaashemererwa munonga.
en: Then the people rejoiced, for that they offered willingly, because with perfect heart they offered willingly to the LORD : and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.

rr: Okushaba kwa Daudi
en: Gives Thanks to God

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo Daudi yaasiimire MUKAMA omu maisho g'omutwe gwona ogw'abantu abaabaire bateeraine, naagira ati: MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa Israeli tatenkuriitwe, osiimwe ebiro n'ebiro.
en: Wherefore David blessed the LORD before all the congregation: and David said, Blessed be thou, LORD God of Israel our father, for ever and ever.

rr: Ai MUKAMA, obukuru, obushoboorozi, ekitiinisa, obusinguzi n'okutiinwa n'ebyawe; ahakuba ebiri omu iguru n'eby'omu nsi byona n'ebyawe; obukam n'obwawe, ai MUKAMA, kandi ohimbisibwa ahabw'okuba Omutwe gwa byona.
en: Thine, O LORD , is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heaven and in the earth is thine ; thine is the kingdom, O LORD , and thou art exalted as head above all.

rr: Obutungi n'ekitiinisa niiwe bikomookaho, kandi otegyeka byona. Omu mukono gwawe harimu obushoboorozi n'amaani, kandi niiwe orikubaasa kukuza, n'okuha boona amaani.
en: Both riches and honour come of thee, and thou reignest over all; and in thine hand is power and might; and in thine hand it is to make great, and to give strength unto all.

rr: Mwenu hati, Ruhanga waitu, nitukusiima, kandi nitusingiza eiziina ryawe ery'ekitiinisa.
en: Now therefore, our God, we thank thee, and praise thy glorious name.

rr: Mbwenu nkaanye ndi oha, nyowe n'abantu bangye, okubaasa kukuhongyera tuti n'omutima gwekundiire? Ahakuba byona biruga ahariiwe, kandi ebi twakuha n'ebyawe.
en: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort? for all things come of thee, and of thine own have we given thee.

rr: Ahabw'okuba omu maisho gaawe turi abagyenyi n'abashuhuuki, nka baatatenkuriitwe boona oku baabaire bari; ebiro ebi tumara aha nsi ni nk'ekicuucu, tihariho matsiko g'okumereera.
en: For we are strangers before thee, and sojourners, as were all our fathers: our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is none abiding.

rr: Ai MUKAMA Ruhanga waitu, ebintu ebi byona ebingi, ebi tuteekateekire kukwombekyera enju ahabw'eiziina ryawe eririkwera, birugire omu mukono gwawe, kandi byona n'ebyawe.
en: O LORD our God, all this store that we have prepared to build thee an house for thine holy name cometh of thine hand, and is all thine own.

rr: Ruhanga wangye, nimmanya ngu ocaaka emitima, kandi oshemerererwa amazima; naanye ahabwangye naahonga ebintu ebi byona n'omutima gw'amazima ntarikugyemwa; kandi hati naareeba abantu baawe abari aha nibakuhongyera n'okushemererwa kwingi batarikugyemwa.
en: I know also, my God, that thou triest the heart, and hast pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of mine heart I have willingly offered all these things: and now have I seen with joy thy people, which are present here, to offer willingly unto thee.

rr: Ai MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa Abrahamu, owa Isaaka, kandi n'owa Israeli baatatenkuriitwe, ebi obihamye omu biteekateeko by'omu mitima y'abantu baawe; otebeekanise emitima yaabo, ebe niiwe yaazaho.
en: O LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this for ever in the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of thy people, and prepare their heart unto thee:

rr: Kandi mutabani wangye Sulemaani, omuhe kworobera ebiragiro byawe n'ebi waahamize n'ebyatairweho n'omutima gwe gwona, akore ebyo byona, kandi ayombekye nyaruju ei naateekateekire kwombeka.
en: and give unto Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep thy commandments, thy testimonies, and thy statutes, and to do all these things , and to build the palace, for the which I have made provision.

rr: Bwanyima Daudi yaagambira omutwe gwona ati: Musiime MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu.
en: And David said to all the congregation, Now bless the LORD your God.

rr: Batyo abantu boona abaabaire bateeraine baasiima MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa baishenkurubo, bainika emitwe yaabo, baaramya MUKAMA, kandi baatangirira omugabe.
en: And all the congregation blessed the LORD God of their fathers, and bowed down their heads, and worshipped the LORD , and the king.

rr: Ku bwaseesire, baatambira MUKAMA ebitambo, kandi baamuhongyera empongano z'ebitambo by'okwotsya, enimi rukumi, empaya z'entaama rukumi, n'abaana b'entaama rukumi, hamwe n'empongano zaabyo z'eby'okunywa n'ebindi bitambo bingi munonga ahabwa Israeli yoona
en: And they sacrificed sacrifices unto the LORD , and offered burnt offerings unto the LORD , on the morrow after that day, even a thousand bullocks, a thousand rams, and a thousand lambs, with their drink offerings, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel:

rr: 1 -39 ; 2:35 ; eryo izooba baarya, baanywa bashemereirwe, bari omu maisho ga MUKAMA. Baagaruka baayemeka Sulemaani mwene Daudi omugabe obwa kabiri, baamushukaho amajuta g'okumushoroorera MUKAMA kuba omugabe, na Zadoki kuba omunyamurwa. Sulemaani okwemekwa obwa kabiri
en: and did eat and drink before the LORD on that day with great gladness. And they made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed him unto the LORD to be the chief governor, and Zadok to be priest.

rr: Atyo Sulemaani yaaza aha kitebe ky'obugabe ekya MUKAMA, yaaba omugabe omu mwanya gwa Daudi ishe; yaaba gye, Abaisraeli boona baamutiina.
en: Then Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.

rr: Abeebembezi boona n'abashaija amamanzi, kandi na batabani b'omugabe Daudi boona baahiga omu maisho g'omugabe Sulemaani, ku barikwija kuba abashaija be.
en: And all the princes, and the mighty men, and all the sons likewise of king David, submitted themselves unto Solomon the king.

rr: MUKAMA yaakuza Sulemaani munonga omu maisho ga Israeli yoona, yaamuha ekitiinisa ky'obugabe ekitakabaga ha mugabe weena owaamubandiize omuri Israeli. Okufa kwa Daudi
en: And the LORD magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and bestowed upon him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.

rr: Okwo nikwo Daudi mwene Yese yaategyekire Israeli yoona.
en: Thus David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.

rr: Emyaka ei yaamazire naategyeka Israeli ekahika makumi ana; emyaka mushanju akagimara Heburooni, kandi emyaka makumi ashatu n'eshatu yaagimara Yerusaalemu.
en: And the time that he reigned over Israel was forty years; seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.

rr: Bwanyima yaafa, yaahikire omu ngingo zaabukuru, amazire ebiro bingi ari omutungi munonga, kandi aine ekitiinisa kingi; omutabani Sulemaani yaategyeka omu mwanya gwe.
en: And he died in a good old age, full of days, riches, and honour: and Solomon his son reigned in his stead.

rr: Ebi omugabe Daudi yaakozire byona, okwiha aha by'okubanza okuhitsya aha by'aha muheru, bihandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'ebyabaireho ekya Samueli omuhanuuzi, n'ekya Nasani nabi, kandi n'ekya Gaadi omuhanuuzi
en: Now the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of Samuel the seer, and in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the book of Gad the seer,

rr: hamwe n'eby'obutegyeki bwe bwona, n'eby'amaani ge, n'ebyamubaireho, n'ahari Israeli kandi n'aha bugabe bwona obw'ezo nsi.
en: with all his reign and his might, and the times that went over him, and over Israel, and over all the kingdoms of the countries.

rr: 1 Paulo owaayetsirwe kuba entumwa ya Yesu Kristo, nk'oku Ruhanga yaakunzire, na Soseene ow'eishe-emwe
en: 1 Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and Sosthenes our brother,

rr: 2 twabahandiikira imwe ab'omu kansia ya Ruhanga eri Korinso, abaayeziibwe omuri Kristo Yesu, bakeetwa kuba abarikwera hamwe na boona abari hoonahoona abatakira eiziina rya Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo, Mukama waabo kandi owaitu.
en: 2 unto the church of God which is at Corinth, to them that are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called to be saints, with all that in every place call upon the name of Jesus Christ our Lord, both their's and our's:

rr: 3 Nitubendeza embabazi n'obusingye ebirikuruga ahari Ruhanga Tataitwe na Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo.
en: 3 grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

rr: 4 Obutoosha nsiima Ruhanga wangye ahabwanyu, nimmusiimira embabazi ze ezi mwahairwe omuri Kristo Yesu
en: 4 I thank my God always on your behalf, for the grace of God which is given you by Jesus Christ;

rr: 5 ahabw'okuba omu miringo yoona mukahinduka abatungi omuriwe, omuri byona ebi mugamba kandi n'ebi mumanya
en: 5 that in every thing ye are enriched by him, in all utterance, and in all knowledge;

rr: 6 nk'okuhamya Kristo kwaitu oku kwahamiibwe omuriimwe.
en: 6 even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you:
7 so that ye come behind in no gift; waiting for the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ:
8 who shall also confirm you unto the end, that ye may be blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
9 God is faithful, by whom ye were called unto the fellowship of his Son Jesus Christ our Lord.

10 Now I beseech you, brethren, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you; but that ye be perfectly joined together in the same mind and in the same judgment.

rr: 11 Ahakuba mperize kumanyisibwa ab'owa Keloe ngu mwine empaka, B'eishe-emwe.
en: 11 For it hath been declared unto me of you, my brethren, by them which are of the house of Chloe, that there are contentions among you.
12 Now this I say, that every one of you saith, I am of Paul; and I of Apollos; and I of Cephas; and I of Christ.

rr: 13 Nimugira ngu Kristo abagansiibwemu? Paulo akababambirwa? Nari mukabatizibwa omu iziina rya Paulo?
en: 13 Is Christ divided? was Paul crucified for you? or were ye baptized in the name of Paul?

rr: 14 Ninsiima Ruhanga ahabw'okuba tindabatiize muntu omuriimwe, kureka Krispo na Gaayo
en: 14 I thank God that I baptized none of you, but Crispus and Gaius;

rr: 15 ahu mwakwekwatsize ngu mukabatizibwa omu iziina ryangye.
en: 15 lest any should say that I had baptized in mine own name.

rr: 16 (Kureka nkabatiza ab'omu ka ya Stefana; tindikwijuka yaaba hariho ondiijo weena ou naabatiize).
en: 16 And I baptized also the household of Stephanas: besides, I know not whether I baptized any other.
17 For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the gospel: not with wisdom of words, lest the cross of Christ should be made of none effect.
18 For the preaching of the cross is to them that perish foolishness; but unto us which are saved it is the power of God.
19 For it is written,
20 Where is the wise? where is the scribe? where is the disputer of this world? hath not God made foolish the wisdom of this world?
21 For after that in the wisdom of God the world by wisdom knew not God, it pleased God by the foolishness of preaching to save them that believe.
22 For the Jews require a sign, and the Greeks seek after wisdom:
23 but we preach Christ crucified, unto the Jews a stumblingblock, and unto the Greeks foolishness;

rr: 24 kwonka ahari abo abarikwetwa Abayudaaya n'Abagriika, ni Kristo, amaani ga Ruhanga kandi obwengye bwa Ruhanga.
en: 24 but unto them which are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ the power of God, and the wisdom of God.
25 Because the foolishness of God is wiser than men; and the weakness of God is stronger than men.
26 For ye see your calling, brethren, how that not many wise men after the flesh, not many mighty, not many noble, are called :

rr: 27 kwonka Ruhanga katoorana abashema b'ensi ngu akwatse enshoni abanyabwengye; kandi Ruhanga akatoorana eitaine maani ngu akwatse enshoni ebiine amaani
en: 27 but God hath chosen the foolish things of the world to confound the wise; and God hath chosen the weak things of the world to confound the things which are mighty;

rr: 28 n'eby'ahansi eby'ensi n'ebirikugaywa Ruhanga akabitoorana, kandi n'ebitariho, abone kuhindura busha ebiriho
en: 28 and base things of the world, and things which are despised, hath God chosen, yea , and things which are not, to bring to nought things that are:
29 that no flesh should glory in his presence.
30 But of him are ye in Christ Jesus, who of God is made unto us wisdom, and righteousness, and sanctification, and redemption:
31 that, according as it is written, He that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.
1 And I, brethren, when I came to you, came not with excellency of speech or of wisdom, declaring unto you the testimony of God.
2 For I determined not to know any thing among you, save Jesus Christ, and him crucified.
3 And I was with you in weakness, and in fear, and in much trembling.

rr: 4 Emigambire yangye n'obutumwa bwangye bikaba bitari bigambo by'obwengye eby'okwikiririsa abantu, kureka eby'okubooreka Omwoyo n'amaani
en: 4 And my speech and my preaching was not with enticing words of man's wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power:
5 that your faith should not stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of God.

rr: 6 Kwonka obwengye tubugamba n'abo abahikiriire, kwonka buba butari bwa nsi egi, n'obu bwakuba obw'abategyeki b'ensi egi ab'okuhwaho.
en: 6 Howbeit we speak wisdom among them that are perfect: yet not the wisdom of this world, nor of the princes of this world, that come to nought:

rr: 7 Itwe tugamba obwengye bwa Ruhanga, obwasherekirwe omu naama, ei Ruhanga yaataireho, ensi zoona zitakahangirwe, okutuhaisa ekitiinisa.
en: 7 but we speak the wisdom of God in a mystery, even the hidden wisdom , which God ordained before the world unto our glory:

rr: 8 Tihariho n'omwe omu bategyeki b'ensi egi owaabumanyire; ahakuba, kuri baabumanyire, tibaakubambire Mukama ow'ekitiinisa
en: 8 which none of the princes of this world knew: for had they known it , they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.
9 But as it is written,
