rr: 10 Ruhanga akabitushuuruurira, naabitumanyisisa Omwoyo we; ahabw'okuba arondoora byona, nangwa n'ebitarikumanywa bya Ruhanga.
en: 10 But God hath revealed them unto us by his Spirit: for the Spirit searcheth all things, yea, the deep things of God.

rr: 11 N'oha omu bantu orikumanya ebi omuntu ateekateeka, kureka omwoyo ogu omuntu aine. Na mbwenu tihariho orikumanya ebya Ruhanga kureka Omwoyo wa Ruhanga.
en: 11 For what man knoweth the things of a man, save the spirit of man which is in him? even so the things of God knoweth no man, but the Spirit of God.
12 Now we have received, not the spirit of the world, but the spirit which is of God; that we might know the things that are freely given to us of God.

rr: 13 Nibyo tugamba, tutarikubigambisa bigambo ebyegyesibwa n'obwengye bw'abantu, kureka ebyegyesiibwe Omwoyo, # 2:13 Nari: nitushoboorora eby'omwoyo, tubishobooroza ebindi by'Omwoyo. nitushobororera abaine Omwoyo eby'Omwoyo.
en: 13 Which things also we speak, not in the words which man's wisdom teacheth, but which the Holy Ghost teacheth; comparing spiritual things with spiritual.
14 But the natural man receiveth not the things of the Spirit of God: for they are foolishness unto him: neither can he know them , because they are spiritually discerned.
15 But he that is spiritual judgeth all things, yet he himself is judged of no man.
16 For who hath known the mind of the Lord, that he may instruct him? But we have the mind of Christ.
1 And I, brethren, could not speak unto you as unto spiritual, but as unto carnal, even as unto babes in Christ.
2 I have fed you with milk, and not with meat: for hitherto ye were not able to bear it , neither yet now are ye able.
3 For ye are yet carnal: for whereas there is among you envying, and strife, and divisions, are ye not carnal, and walk as men?

rr: 4 Omwe ku araabe naagira ati, Nyowe ndi owa Paulo; n'ondiijo ati, Nyowe ndi owa Apolo, obwo nimuba mutari abantu-buntu?
en: 4 For while one saith, I am of Paul; and another, I am of Apollos; are ye not carnal?

rr: 5 Mbwenu Apolo n'enki? Nari Paulo n'enki? N'abakozi abaabaikiririise, nka buri omwe oku Mukama yaamuhaire.
en: 5 Who then is Paul, and who is Apollos, but ministers by whom ye believed, even as the Lord gave to every man?
6 I have planted, Apollos watered; but God gave the increase.

rr: 7 N'ahabw'ekyo orikubyara ti kintu, n'obu yaakuba orikwitirira amaizi, kureka Ruhanga okuza.
en: 7 So then neither is he that planteth any thing, neither he that watereth; but God that giveth the increase.

rr: 8 Orikubyara n'orikwitirira amaizi nibaingana, kandi buri omwe aryaheebwa ebihembo nk'omurimo gwe oku guriba guri
en: 8 Now he that planteth and he that watereth are one: and every man shall receive his own reward according to his own labour.
9 For we are labourers together with God: ye are God's husbandry, ye are God's building.
10 According to the grace of God which is given unto me, as a wise masterbuilder, I have laid the foundation, and another buildeth thereon. But let every man take heed how he buildeth thereupon.
11 For other foundation can no man lay than that is laid, which is Jesus Christ.

rr: 12 Omuntu weena ku ayombeka aha musingi ogu n'ezaabu, n'efeeza, n'amabaare ag'obuguzi bwingi, n'emiganda, n'obunyaatsi n'ebikonko
en: 12 Now if any man build upon this foundation gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay, stubble;
13 every man's work shall be made manifest: for the day shall declare it, because it shall be revealed by fire; and the fire shall try every man's work of what sort it is.

rr: 14 Omurimo ogu omuntu weena yaayombekire aha musingi ogu, ku gurigumaho, aryaheebwa ebihembo.
en: 14 If any man's work abide which he hath built thereupon, he shall receive a reward.

rr: 15 Kandi omurimo gw'omuntu weena ku gurisya, aryafeerwa; kwonka we wenka aryajunwa, kwonka nk'orabire omu muriro.
en: 15 If any man's work shall be burned, he shall suffer loss: but he himself shall be saved; yet so as by fire.
16 Know ye not that ye are the temple of God, and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you?

rr: 17 Omuntu weena ku arihwerekyereza hekalu ya Ruhanga, nawe Ruhanga aryamuhwerekyereza, ahakuba hekalu ya Ruhanga n'erikwera, kandi hekalu egyo niimwe.
en: 17 If any man defile the temple of God, him shall God destroy; for the temple of God is holy, which temple ye are.
18 Let no man deceive himself. If any man among you seemeth to be wise in this world, let him become a fool, that he may be wise.
19 For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, He taketh the wise in their own craftiness.

rr: 20 Kandi ngu: Mukama naamanya ebiteekateeko by'abanyabwengye ku biba busha.
en: 20 And again, The Lord knoweth the thoughts of the wise, that they are vain.

rr: 21 N'ahabw'ekyo omuntu weena arekye kwehimbisa ahabw'abantu; ahakuba byona n'ebyanyu
en: 21 Therefore let no man glory in men. For all things are your's;

rr: 22 yaaba Paulo, yaaba Apolo, yaaba Keefa, nari ensi, nari amagara, nari rufu, nari ebiriho, nari ebiribaho; byona n'ebyanyu
en: 22 whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come; all are your's;

rr: 23 naimwe muri aba Kristo, na Kristo n'owa Ruhanga.
en: 23 and ye are Christ's; and Christ is God's.

rr: 1 Oku nikwo omuntu weena ashemereire kututeekateekaho, ku turi abaheereza ba Kristo n'ababiiki b'enaama za Ruhanga.
en: 1 Let a man so account of us, as of the ministers of Christ, and stewards of the mysteries of God.
2 Moreover it is required in stewards, that a man be found faithful.

rr: 3 Kwonka orubanja oru muncwera, nari oru ncwerwa abandi bantu, ahariinye n'akantu kakye munonga; kandi naanye nyenka tiinyine ru nyecwera.
en: 3 But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged of you, or of man's judgment: yea, I judge not mine own self.

rr: 4 Mumanye ngu tiinyine ki ndikwemanyaho; kwonka ekyo tikyo kiinyihaho rubanja, kureka Mukama niwe ancwera orubanja.
en: 4 For I know nothing by myself; yet am I not hereby justified: but he that judgeth me is the Lord.

5 Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord come, who both will bring to light the hidden things of darkness, and will make manifest the counsels of the hearts: and then shall every man have praise of God.

6 And these things, brethren, I have in a figure transferred to myself and to Apollos for your sakes; that ye might learn in us not to think of men above that which is written, that no one of you be puffed up for one against another.

rr: 7 Beitu n'oha orikukuhindura ow'omutaano aha bandi? Kandi oine ki eki otarahairwe? Mbwenu ku oraabe waakihaire, ahabw'enki oyehimbisa nk'otarakihairwe?
en: 7 For who maketh thee to differ from another ? and what hast thou that thou didst not receive? now if thou didst receive it , why dost thou glory, as if thou hadst not received it ?

rr: 8 Muherize kwiguta; muherize kutunga; muhindukire nk'abagabe ahu tutari; ku mwakuhinduka abagabe, tukaashemererwa, nangwa naitwe tutegyeka hamwe naimwe.
en: 8 Now ye are full, now ye are rich, ye have reigned as kings without us: and I would to God ye did reign, that we also might reign with you.
9 For I think that God hath set forth us the apostles last, as it were appointed to death: for we are made a spectacle unto the world, and to angels, and to men.

rr: 10 Itwe turi abashema ahabwa Kristo, kwonka imwe muri abanyabwengye omuri Kristo. Itwe turi abeeremwa, kwonka imwe muri ab'amaani. Imwe muri ab'ekitiinisa, kwonka itwe turi abarikugaywa.
en: 10 We are fools for Christ's sake, but ye are wise in Christ; we are weak, but ye are strong; ye are honourable, but we are despised.
11 Even unto this present hour we both hunger, and thirst, and are naked, and are buffeted, and have no certain dwellingplace;
12 and labour, working with our own hands: being reviled, we bless; being persecuted, we suffer it:

rr: 13 ku tubeihererwa, tugarukamu gye; tuhindwirwe ekumbwe omu nsi, nk'ebiragazibwa aha bintu byona, n'okuhitsya hati.
en: 13 being defamed, we intreat: we are made as the filth of the world, and are the offscouring of all things unto this day.

rr: 14 Ebi tinaabihandiika kubakwatsa enshoni, kureka okubahuguura nk'abaana bangye abarikukundwa.
en: 14 I write not these things to shame you, but as my beloved sons I warn you .
15 For though ye have ten thousand instructors in Christ, yet have ye not many fathers: for in Christ Jesus I have begotten you through the gospel.
16 Wherefore I beseech you, be ye followers of me.

17 For this cause have I sent unto you Timotheus, who is my beloved son, and faithful in the Lord, who shall bring you into remembrance of my ways which be in Christ, as I teach every where in every church.

rr: 18 Abamwe nibeehimbisa, nibagira ngu tindiija waanyu.
en: 18 Now some are puffed up, as though I would not come to you.

rr: 19 Kwonka ndyaija owaanyu juba, Mukama ku arikudna; obwo nibwo ndimanya amaani g'abo abarikwehimbisa, bitari bigambo byabo byonka.
en: 19 But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord will, and will know, not the speech of them which are puffed up, but the power.
20 For the kingdom of God is not in word, but in power.

rr: 21 Nimwenda ki? Nyije n'ekoni, nari omu kukunda n'omu mwoyo gw'obucureezi?
en: 21 What will ye? shall I come unto you with a rod, or in love, and in the spirit of meekness?
1 It is reported commonly that there is fornication among you, and such fornication as is not so much as named among the Gentiles, that one should have his father's wife.

rr: 2 Kandi nimwehimbisa! Timushemereire kushaasha, mukaiha omuriimwe ogwo okozire ekyo?
en: 2 And ye are puffed up, and have not rather mourned, that he that hath done this deed might be taken away from among you.
3 For I verily, as absent in body, but present in spirit, have judged already, as though I were present, concerning him that hath so done this deed,
4 in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, when ye are gathered together, and my spirit, with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ,
5 to deliver such an one unto Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.

rr: 6 Okwehimbisa kwanyu ti kurungi. Timurikumanya ngu akatumbisa kakye katumbisa ekiihuro kyona?
en: 6 Your glorying is not good. Know ye not that a little leaven leaveneth the whole lump?
7 Purge out therefore the old leaven, that ye may be a new lump, as ye are unleavened. For even Christ our passover is sacrificed for us:
8 therefore let us keep the feast, not with old leaven, neither with the leaven of malice and wickedness; but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.

rr: 9 Omu baruha ei naabahandiikiire nkabaragiira kutakwatanisa na bashambani
en: 9 I wrote unto you in an epistle not to company with fornicators:

rr: 10 kwonka tindagambire kutaanira kimwe n'abashambani b'ensi egi, nari abeetengi, nari abambuzi, nari abarikuramya ebishushani; ahabw'okuba ku kyakubaire kityo, mukaabaire mushemereire kuruga omu nsi.
en: 10 yet not altogether with the fornicators of this world, or with the covetous, or extortioners, or with idolaters; for then must ye needs go out of the world.

11 But now I have written unto you not to keep company, if any man that is called a brother be a fornicator, or covetous, or an idolater, or a railer, or a drunkard, or an extortioner; with such an one no not to eat.

rr: 12 Nyowe ninfa ki okucwera ab'aheeru orubanja? Ab'omu kanisa ti bo mushemereire kucwera orubanja?
en: 12 For what have I to do to judge them also that are without? do not ye judge them that are within?

rr: 13 Kwonka ab'aheeru Ruhanga niwe arirubacwera. Mwihe omuriimwe omuntu ogwo omubi.
en: 13 But them that are without God judgeth. Therefore put away from among yourselves that wicked person.

rr: 1 Omuntu weena omuriimwe, ku araabe aine eki arikufa na mutaahi we, tikirikumukwatsa enshoni kumutabaariza omu maisho g'abatahikiriire, omu mwanya gw'okumutabaariza omu maisho g'abarikwera?
en: 1 Dare any of you, having a matter against another, go to law before the unjust, and not before the saints?
2 Do ye not know that the saints shall judge the world? and if the world shall be judged by you, are ye unworthy to judge the smallest matters?

rr: 3 Timurikumanya ku turicwera baamaraika emanja? Reero kaashwa eby'amagara aga?
en: 3 Know ye not that we shall judge angels? how much more things that pertain to this life?

rr: 4 Mbwenu shi, ku muraabe nimugira emanja nk'ezo, ahabw'enki mutoorana abarikugaywa ekanisa kuba nibo baazicwa?
en: 4 If then ye have judgments of things pertaining to this life, set them to judge who are least esteemed in the church.

rr: 5 Ebi naabigamba kubakwatsa enshoni.
en: 5 I speak to your shame.

rr: Omuriimwe tiharimu n'omwe oine obwengye owaakubaasa kucwera beene ishe orubanja?
en: Is it so, that there is not a wise man among you? no, not one that shall be able to judge between his brethren?

rr: 6 Ahakuba ab'eishe-emwe nibatabaariza ab'eishe-emwe abandi, kandi batabaarizana aha batarikwikiriza!
en: 6 But brother goeth to law with brother, and that before the unbelievers.
7 Now therefore there is utterly a fault among you, because ye go to law one with another. Why do ye not rather take wrong? Why do ye not rather suffer yourselves to be defrauded?

rr: 8 Mbwenu omu mwanya gw'ebyo niimwe mukora kubi abandi, mukabagobeza, kandi abu mugobeza n'abeishe-emwe.
en: 8 Nay, ye do wrong, and defraud, and that your brethren.

rr: 9 Timurikumanya ngu abatahikiriire tibarihungura bukama bwa Ruhanga?
en: 9 Know ye not that the unrighteous shall not inherit the kingdom of God?

rr: Mutaribeihwa; abashambani, nari abarikuramya ebishushani, nari abeegira abakazi, nari ebitingwa
en: Be not deceived: neither fornicators, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor effeminate, nor abusers of themselves with mankind,
10 nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards, nor revilers, nor extortioners, shall inherit the kingdom of God.
11 And such were some of you: but ye are washed, but ye are sanctified, but ye are justified in the name of the Lord Jesus, and by the Spirit of our God.

rr: 12 Byona nimbiikirizibwa, kwonka ti byona ebirikungasira. Byona nimbiikirizibwa, kwonka tinditegyekwa kintu kyona.
en: 12 All things are lawful unto me, but all things are not expedient: all things are lawful for me, but I will not be brought under the power of any.
13 Meats for the belly, and the belly for meats: but God shall destroy both it and them. Now the body is not for fornication, but for the Lord; and the Lord for the body.
14 And God hath both raised up the Lord, and will also raise up us by his own power.

rr: 15 Timurikumanya ngu emibiri yaanyu eba engingo za Kristo? Mbwenu nimbaasa nta kutwara engingo za Kristo, nkazihindura engingo za maraaya? Rubuuza!
en: 15 Know ye not that your bodies are the members of Christ? shall I then take the members of Christ, and make them the members of an harlot? God forbid.

rr: 16 Nari shi, timurikumanya ngu orikuteerana na maraaya nibaba omubiri gumwe? Ahakuba kikahandiikwa ngu: Abo bombi baryaba omubiri gumwe.
en: 16 What? know ye not that he which is joined to an harlot is one body? for two, saith he, shall be one flesh.
17 But he that is joined unto the Lord is one spirit.

rr: 18 Mwetantare obushambani.
en: 18 Flee fornication.

rr: Ekibi ekindi kyona eki omuntu akora kiba aheeru y'omubiri gwe; kwonka orikushambana naaba akozire ekibi ky'okushiisha omubiri gwe wenka.
en: Every sin that a man doeth is without the body; but he that committeth fornication sinneth against his own body.

rr: 19 Timurikumanya ngu omubiri gwanyu niyo hekalu y'Omwoyo Orikwera ori omuriimwe, ou mwahairwe Ruhanga? Imwe timurikwetegyeka
en: 19 What? know ye not that your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost which is in you, which ye have of God, and ye are not your own?
20 For ye are bought with a price: therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit, which are God's.

rr: 1 Ebirikukwata aha bi mwampandiikiire, ekirungi n'omushaija kutakora ha mukazi.
en: 1 Now concerning the things whereof ye wrote unto me: It is good for a man not to touch a woman.

rr: 2 Kwonka ahabw'okwerinda obushambani, omushaija weena agire omukazi we; kandi omukazi weena agire omushaija we.
en: 2 Nevertheless, to avoid fornication, let every man have his own wife, and let every woman have her own husband.

rr: 3 Omushaija ahe omukazi we ekimushemereire, kandi omukazi nawe ahe iba ekimushemereire.
en: 3 Let the husband render unto the wife due benevolence: and likewise also the wife unto the husband.

rr: 4 Ahakuba omukazi tategyeka mubiri gwe, kureka gutegyekwa iba; kandi n'omushaija tategyeka mubiri gwe, kureka gutegyekwa omukazi we.
en: 4 The wife hath not power of her own body, but the husband: and likewise also the husband hath not power of his own body, but the wife.

rr: 5 Murekye kwimana, kureka mwaba muragaine omwanya, ngu mubone kwehayo omu kushaba, bwanyima mugarukye kuba hamwe, Sitaane arekye kubategyesa okuteezibira kwanyu.
en: 5 Defraud ye not one the other, except it be with consent for a time, that ye may give yourselves to fasting and prayer; and come together again, that Satan tempt you not for your incontinency.

rr: 6 Ebi naabigamba kubaha obusingye, ti kiragiro ngu nimbaragiira
en: 6 But I speak this by permission, and not of commandment.
7 For I would that all men were even as I myself. But every man hath his proper gift of God, one after this manner, and another after that.

rr: 8 Kwonka abatakashweire, n'abatakashweirwe, n'abafaakazi nimbagambira nti: Ekyakubaire kirungi aharibo n'okuba nkaanye.
en: 8 I say therefore to the unmarried and widows, It is good for them if they abide even as I.
9 But if they cannot contain, let them marry: for it is better to marry than to burn.

rr: 10 Kandi abashweire n'abashweirwe nimbaragiira, kwonka tiinye kureka Mukama waitu, omukazi arekye kutaana na iba
en: 10 And unto the married I command, yet not I, but the Lord, Let not the wife depart from her husband:

rr: 11 kandi ku araabe yaataine nawe, agumire aho ataashwerwa ondiijo, nari shi agarukane na iba, kandi omushaija atarishenda omukazi we.
en: 11 but and if she depart, let her remain unmarried, or be reconciled to her husband: and let not the husband put away his wife.

rr: 12 Abandi niinye ndikubagambira, ti Mukama nti: Ow'eishe-emwe weena, ku araabe aine omukazi otarikwikiriza, omukazi ogwo yaakunda kuguma nawe, arekye kumushenda.
en: 12 But to the rest speak I, not the Lord: If any brother hath a wife that believeth not, and she be pleased to dwell with him, let him not put her away.

rr: 13 Kandi omukazi weena, oine iba otarikwikiriza, iba yaakunda kuguma nawe, omukazi ogwo ataritaana n'omushaija we.
en: 13 And the woman which hath an husband that believeth not, and if he be pleased to dwell with her, let her not leave him.

rr: 14 Ahakuba omushaija otarikwikiriza ayezibwa ahabw'omukazi we; n'omukazi otarikwikiriza ayezibwa ahabw'ow'eishe-emwe ogwo. Kuri kitari kityo, abaana baanyu bakaabaire abatashemeziibwe, kwonka hati n'abarikwera.
en: 14 For the unbelieving husband is sanctified by the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified by the husband: else were your children unclean; but now are they holy.

rr: 15 Kwonka otarikwikiriza, ku araabe naayenda kutaana, ataane. Ku birikuba bityo, ow'eishe-emwe omushaija nari omukazi naaba atakibohwa. Ahakuba Ruhanga akatwetera obusingye.
en: 15 But if the unbelieving depart, let him depart. A brother or a sister is not under bondage in such cases : but God hath called us to peace.
16 For what knowest thou, O wife, whether thou shalt save thy husband? or how knowest thou, O man, whether thou shalt save thy wife?

rr: 17 Kwonka, nk'oku Mukama waitu yaahaire omuntu weena, kandi nk'oku Ruhanga yaayetsire buri muntu, abe niwko yaatwaza.
en: 17 But as God hath distributed to every man, as the Lord hath called every one, so let him walk.

rr: Naanye nikwo ndagiire omu makanisa goona.
en: And so ordain I in all churches.

rr: 18 Hariho omuntu owaayetsirwe ashazirwe? Arekye kuhinduka nk'otashazirwe. Nari shi hariho owaayetsirwe atashazirwe? Arekye kusharwa.
en: 18 Is any man called being circumcised? let him not become uncircumcised. Is any called in uncircumcision? let him not be circumcised.
19 Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but the keeping of the commandments of God.

rr: 20 Omuntu weena agume nk'oku yaabaire ari, obu yaayetwa.
en: 20 Let every man abide in the same calling wherein he was called.

rr: 21 Okeetwa ori omuhuuku? Kirekye kukusaasa; # 7:21 Nari: Kwonka ku oraabe noobaasa kuburugamu, oburugyemu. kandi n'obu waakuba noobaasa kuburugamu, haakiri obugumemu.
en: 21 Art thou called being a servant? care not for it: but if thou mayest be made free, use it rather.
22 For he that is called in the Lord, being a servant, is the Lord's freeman: likewise also he that is called, being free, is Christ's servant.

rr: 23 Mukagurwa obuguzi bwingi; murekye kuhinduka abahuuku b'abantu.
en: 23 Ye are bought with a price; be not ye the servants of men.

rr: 24 N'ahabw'ekyo, B'eishe-emwe, omuntu weena agume omuri Ruhanga ari nk'oku yaabaire ari, obu yaayetwa.
en: 24 Brethren, let every man, wherein he is called, therein abide with God.

rr: 25 Eby'abatakashweire n'abatakashweirwe, tiinyine kiragiro kya Mukama aharibyo. Kwonka ningamba eki ndikubiteekateekaho, nk'omuntu omwesigwa ahabw'embabazi za Mukama.
en: 25 Now concerning virgins I have no commandment of the Lord: yet I give my judgment, as one that hath obtained mercy of the Lord to be faithful.

rr: 26 Kandi ninteekateeka ngu, ahabw'obusaasi oburiho omu biro ebi, ni kirungi buri muntu okuguma nk'oku ari.
en: 26 I suppose therefore that this is good for the present distress, I say , that it is good for a man so to be.

rr: 27 Okateeranwa n'omukazi? Oteetenga kutaanisibwa. Okataanisibwa n'omukazi? Otashwera ondiijo.
en: 27 Art thou bound unto a wife? seek not to be loosed. Art thou loosed from a wife? seek not a wife.
28 But and if thou marry, thou hast not sinned; and if a virgin marry, she hath not sinned. Nevertheless such shall have trouble in the flesh: but I spare you.
29 But this I say, brethren, the time is short: it remaineth, that both they that have wives be as though they had none;

rr: 30 abarikurira babe nk'abatarikurira; abarikushemererwa babe nk'abatarikushemererwa; abarikugura babe nk'abataine ki baine
en: 30 and they that weep, as though they wept not; and they that rejoice, as though they rejoiced not; and they that buy, as though they possessed not;
31 and they that use this world, as not abusing it : for the fashion of this world passeth away.

rr: 32 Niinyenda ngu muteemereza omutima.
en: 32 But I would have you without carefulness.

rr: Otaine mukazi ota omutima aha bya Mukama oku araagwise gye Mukama
en: He that is unmarried careth for the things that belong to the Lord, how he may please the Lord:
33 but he that is married careth for the things that are of the world, how he may please his wife.

rr: 34 Kandi hariho omutaano gw'oine omushaija, n'otamwine.
en: 34 There is difference also between a wife and a virgin.

rr: Otaine mushaija ata omutima aha bya Mukama, ngu abone kuguma ayeziibwe omu mubiri n'omu mwoyo; kwonka oine omushaija ata omutima aha by'ensi, oku araagwise gye iba.
en: The unmarried woman careth for the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit: but she that is married careth for the things of the world, how she may please her husband.

rr: 35 Ebyo naabigamba ahabw'okubahwera, ti kubatega mutego, kureka kubooreka ebishemeire, ngu mubone kukorera Mukama mutaine mitima ebiri.
en: 35 And this I speak for your own profit; not that I may cast a snare upon you, but for that which is comely, and that ye may attend upon the Lord without distraction.

rr: 36 Omuntu weena ku araateekateekye ngu tarikukora gye mwishiki ou arikugamba obugyenyi, kandi # 7:36 Nari: yaaba ahikire kushwerwa. atarikubaasa kutegyeka mubiri gwe, akore eki arikusiima, ku kiraabe kiri kityo; amushwere; naaba atasiisire.
en: 36 But if any man think that he behaveth himself uncomely toward his virgin, if she pass the flower of her age , and need so require, let him do what he will, he sinneth not: let them marry.

rr: 37 Kwonka ohamire omu mutima gwe, otaine kirikumugyema, kandi orikubaasa kutegyeka omubiri gwe, akamariirira kumureka akaguma ari omwishiki, naaba akozire gye.
en: 37 Nevertheless he that standeth stedfast in his heart, having no necessity, but hath power over his own will, and hath so decreed in his heart that he will keep his virgin, doeth well.

rr: 38 N'ahabw'ekyo orikushwera omwishiki ou arikugamba obugyenyi, naaba akozire gye; kwonka orikureka kumushwera, naaba amweshumbize kukora gye.
en: 38 So then he that giveth her in marriage doeth well; but he that giveth her not in marriage doeth better.
39 The wife is bound by the law as long as her husband liveth; but if her husband be dead, she is at liberty to be married to whom she will; only in the Lord.

rr: 40 Kwonka ku yaakuguma aho nk'oku ari, obwo nibwo yaakukiraho kuba gye, nyowe nikwo ndikuteekateeka; kandi ningira ngu nyine Omwoyo wa Ruhanga.
en: 40 But she is happier if she so abide, after my judgment: and I think also that I have the Spirit of God.
1 Now as touching things offered unto idols, we know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffeth up, but charity edifieth.
2 And if any man think that he knoweth any thing, he knoweth nothing yet as he ought to know.

rr: 3 Kwonka omuntu ku akunda Ruhanga, niwe amanywa Ruhanga.
en: 3 But if any man love God, the same is known of him.
4 As concerning therefore the eating of those things that are offered in sacrifice unto idols, we know that an idol is nothing in the world, and that there is none other God but one.

rr: 5 N'obu haraabe hariho abarikwetwa baaruhanga, ahaiguru n'ahansi, nk'oku hariho baaruhanga baingi n'abakama baingi
en: 5 For though there be that are called gods, whether in heaven or in earth, (as there be gods many, and lords many,)
6 but to us there is but one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we in him; and one Lord Jesus Christ, by whom are all things, and we by him.

rr: 7 Kwonka okwetegyereza oku tikuri mu bantu boona. Abandi ahabw'okumanyiira kukorera ebishushani, n'okuhitsya ahati ku barya enyama z'ebibitambiirwe, bateekateeka ngu abu babitambiire ni baaruhanga buzima, emitima yaabo etahamire esiisikara.
en: 7 Howbeit there is not in every man that knowledge: for some with conscience of the idol unto this hour eat it as a thing offered unto an idol; and their conscience being weak is defiled.
8 But meat commendeth us not to God: for neither, if we eat, are we the better; neither, if we eat not, are we the worse.
9 But take heed lest by any means this liberty of your's become a stumblingblock to them that are weak.

rr: 10 Mbwenu omuntu, ku yaakukureeba, ori omuntu oyetegyereize, oshutami nooriira omuri hekalu y'ekishushani ekirikuramibwa, yaaba ataine maani, omutima gwe tigukaatiinuuka, akarya ebitambiirwe ebishushani ebirikuramibwa?
en: 10 For if any man see thee which hast knowledge sit at meat in the idol's temple, shall not the conscience of him which is weak be emboldened to eat those things which are offered to idols;
11 and through thy knowledge shall the weak brother perish, for whom Christ died?

rr: 12 Ku mukora ekibi aha b'eishe-emwe, mwahutaaza emitima yaabo etahamire, muba mukozire ekibi ahari Kristo.
en: 12 But when ye sin so against the brethren, and wound their weak conscience, ye sin against Christ.

rr: 13 N'ahabw'ekyo eby'okurya ku biraabe nibigwisa ow'eishe-emwe, tindirya nyama ebiro byona, ngu ndekye kugwisa ow'eishe-emwe.
en: 13 Wherefore, if meat make my brother to offend, I will eat no flesh while the world standeth, lest I make my brother to offend.
1 Am I not an apostle? am I not free? have I not seen Jesus Christ our Lord? are not ye my work in the Lord?
2 If I be not an apostle unto others, yet doubtless I am to you: for the seal of mine apostleship are ye in the Lord.

rr: 3 Eki nikyo ndikwetonganira ahari abo abarikumpakanisa.
en: 3 Mine answer to them that do examine me is this,

rr: 4 Titurikwikirizibwa kuheebwa eby'okurya n'eby'okunywa?
en: 4 Have we not power to eat and to drink?

rr: 5 Titurikwikirizibwa kutwara abakazi baitu, baaba bari ab'eishe-emwe, n'okugyenda nabo, nk'entumwa ezindi, na barumuna ba Mukama waitu, na Keefa?
en: 5 Have we not power to lead about a sister, a wife, as well as other apostles, and as the brethren of the Lord, and Cephas?

rr: 6 Nari nyowe na Barunaba niitwe twenka abatarikwikirizibwa kureka kukora eby'okwehwera?
en: 6 Or I only and Barnabas, have not we power to forbear working?

rr: 7 Ni muserukare ki oza aha rugamba, haza akeegurira eby'okukoresa? N'oha obyara omusiri gw'emizaabibu, atarye ha bijuma byayo? N'oha oriisa amasyo atanywe mate gaago?
en: 7 Who goeth a warfare any time at his own charges? who planteth a vineyard, and eateth not of the fruit thereof? or who feedeth a flock, and eateth not of the milk of the flock?

rr: 8 Ebi nimbigamba nk'oku abantu bagamba? Nari Ebiragiro byo tikwo bigamba?
en: 8 Say I these things as a man? or saith not the law the same also?
9 For it is written in the law of Moses, Thou shalt not muzzle the mouth of the ox that treadeth out the corn. Doth God take care for oxen?

rr: 10 Nari shi tarakigambire buzima ahabwaitu?
en: 10 Or saith he it altogether for our sakes?

rr: Eego, kikahandiikwa ahabwaitu, ahabw'okuba omuhingi ashemereire kuhinga aine amatsiko; kandi omuhuuzi ashemereire kuhuura aine amatsiko g'okutwara aha bi yaahuura.
en: For our sakes, no doubt, this is written: that he that ploweth should plow in hope; and that he that thresheth in hope should be partaker of his hope.
11 If we have sown unto you spiritual things, is it a great thing if we shall reap your carnal things?
12 If others be partakers of this power over you, are not we rather? Nevertheless we have not used this power; but suffer all things, lest we should hinder the gospel of Christ.
13 Do ye not know that they which minister about holy things live of the things of the temple? and they which wait at the altar are partakers with the altar?
14 Even so hath the Lord ordained that they which preach the gospel should live of the gospel.

rr: 15 Kwonka nyowe ahari ebyo tindakoreiseho na kimwe; kandi tinaahandiika ebi ngu mbone kukorerwa ntyo; ahakuba haakiri nyowe okufa, okukira omuntu weena kuhindura busha okwehimbisa kwangye oku.
en: 15 But I have used none of these things: neither have I written these things, that it should be so done unto me: for it were better for me to die, than that any man should make my glorying void.
16 For though I preach the gospel, I have nothing to glory of: for necessity is laid upon me; yea, woe is unto me, if I preach not the gospel!

rr: 17 Ahakuba ku ndaabe nimbuurira engiri nyeyendeire, nyine ebihembo; kwonka ku ndaabe ningibuurira ngyemirwe, na mbwenu nshemereire kubuurira ahabw'okukwatsibwa engiri egyo.
en: 17 For if I do this thing willingly, I have a reward: but if against my will, a dispensation of the gospel is committed unto me.

rr: 18 Mbwenu ebihembo byangye niki?
en: 18 What is my reward then?

rr: Nibyo ebi ngu, ku ndaabe nimbuurira engiri, ngibuurire ahabw'embabazi, ndekye kukoresa obushoboorozi bwangye bwona obu nyine omu murimo gw'engiri.
en: Verily that, when I preach the gospel, I may make the gospel of Christ without charge, that I abuse not my power in the gospel.
19 For though I be free from all men , yet have I made myself servant unto all, that I might gain the more.
20 And unto the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain the Jews; to them that are under the law, as under the law, that I might gain them that are under the law;

rr: 21 n'aha bataine Biragiro, nkaba nk'otabiine, ngu mbone abataine Biragiro; (ti nk'otaine biragiro ahari Ruhaga, kureka nk'orikutegyekwa ebiragiro bya Kristo).
en: 21 to them that are without law, as without law, (being not without law to God, but under the law to Christ,) that I might gain them that are without law.
22 To the weak became I as weak, that I might gain the weak: I am made all things to all men , that I might by all means save some.

rr: 23 Kandi ebyo byona mbikora ahabw'engiri, ngu ntungye aha migisha yaayo.
en: 23 And this I do for the gospel's sake, that I might be partaker thereof with you .
24 Know ye not that they which run in a race run all, but one receiveth the prize? So run, that ye may obtain.
25 And every man that striveth for the mastery is temperate in all things. Now they do it to obtain a corruptible crown; but we an incorruptible.

rr: 26 Nikyo nyirukira ntyo, ti nk'otarikumanya i arikuza; nteera entomi, ti nk'orikuteera busha
en: 26 I therefore so run, not as uncertainly; so fight I, not as one that beateth the air:
27 but I keep under my body, and bring it into subjection: lest that by any means, when I have preached to others, I myself should be a castaway.
1 Moreover, brethren, I would not that ye should be ignorant, how that all our fathers were under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;

rr: 2 kandi boona ku baabatiziibwe omu Kicu n'omu Nyanja okukwatanisa na Musa
en: 2 and were all baptized unto Moses in the cloud and in the sea;
3 and did all eat the same spiritual meat;
4 and did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Christ.

rr: 5 Kwonka abarikukira obwingi omuribo Ruhanga tarabasiimire, ahakuba bakahwerekyererezibwa omu ihamba.
en: 5 But with many of them God was not well pleased: for they were overthrown in the wilderness.
6 Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things, as they also lusted.
7 Neither be ye idolaters, as were some of them; as it is written, The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.
8 Neither let us commit fornication, as some of them committed, and fell in one day three and twenty thousand.
9 Neither let us tempt Christ, as some of them also tempted, and were destroyed of serpents.
10 Neither murmur ye, as some of them also murmured, and were destroyed of the destroyer.

rr: 11 Ebyo bikabahikaho kuba eby'okureeberaho, kandi bikahandiikwa kutuhuguura, itwe abariho omu biro by'aha muheru gw'ensi.
en: 11 Now all these things happened unto them for ensamples: and they are written for our admonition, upon whom the ends of the world are come.

rr: 12 N'ahabw'ekyo orikuteekateeka ngu ayemereire ayerinde atagwa.
en: 12 Wherefore let him that thinketh he standeth take heed lest he fall.

rr: 13 Tihariho kigyezo ekirababaireho ekitari kya bantu boona. Kwonka Ruhanga n'ow'okwesigwa; taribaikiriza kugyezibwa kigyezo eki mutarikubaasa; kureka omu kigyezo ekyo aryabateeraho oburyo bw'okuhunga, ngu mubaase kukigumisiririza.
en: 13 There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it .

rr: 14 N'ahabw'ekyo, abarikukundwa, mwetantare, okuramya ebishushani.
en: 14 Wherefore, my dearly beloved, flee from idolatry.

rr: 15 Nimbagambira nk'abantu abaine obwengye; mwetegyereze eki ndikugamba.
en: 15 I speak as to wise men; judge ye what I say.
16 The cup of blessing which we bless, is it not the communion of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, is it not the communion of the body of Christ?
17 For we being many are one bread, and one body: for we are all partakers of that one bread.

rr: 18 Mureebe Abaisraeli omu buzaare bw'omubiri, abarya aha bitambo tibateeranwa eitambiro?
en: 18 Behold Israel after the flesh: are not they which eat of the sacrifices partakers of the altar?

rr: 19 Mbwenu ngambe ki? Nti: Ekihongyeirwe ekishushani n'ekintu? Nari ekishushani kyo n'ekintu?
en: 19 What say I then? that the idol is any thing, or that which is offered in sacrifice to idols is any thing?
20 But I say , that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to devils, and not to God: and I would not that ye should have fellowship with devils.
21 Ye cannot drink the cup of the Lord, and the cup of devils: ye cannot be partakers of the Lord's table, and of the table of devils.

rr: 22 Mbwenu nitukwatwa Mukama waitu eihari? Nari shi nitumukiza amaani?
en: 22 Do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? are we stronger than he?
23 All things are lawful for me, but all things are not expedient: all things are lawful for me, but all things edify not.

rr: 24 Omuntu weena arekye kwesherurira ebye ahabwe, kureka asherure eby'okuhwera mutaahi we.
en: 24 Let no man seek his own, but every man another's wealth .

rr: 25 Ekirikugurwa omu itundiro ry'enyama kyona mukirye, mutaine ki mubuurize ahabw'okwiha okubanganisa omu mutima
en: 25 Whatsoever is sold in the shambles, that eat, asking no question for conscience sake:
26 for the earth is the Lord's, and the fulness thereof.
27 If any of them that believe not bid you to a feast , and ye be disposed to go; whatsoever is set before you, eat, asking no question for conscience sake.
28 But if any man say unto you, This is offered in sacrifice unto idols, eat not for his sake that shewed it, and for conscience sake: for the earth is the Lord's, and the fulness thereof:

rr: 29 (eiraka eri ndikugamba ti ryawe, n'ery'omuntu ogwo). Ahabw'enki obusingye bwangye nibucwerwa orubanja eiraka ry'omwoyo gw'ondiijo muntu?
en: 29 conscience, I say, not thine own, but of the other: for why is my liberty judged of another man's conscience?
30 For if I by grace be a partaker, why am I evil spoken of for that for which I give thanks?
31 Whether therefore ye eat, or drink, or whatsoever ye do, do all to the glory of God.
32 Give none offence, neither to the Jews, nor to the Gentiles, nor to the church of God:

rr: 33 naanye nk'oku nteeraho kushemeza abantu boona omuri byona ebi nkora, ntarikusherura by'okungasira nyenka, kureka eby'okugasira baingi, ngu bajunwe.
en: 33 even as I please all men in all things , not seeking mine own profit, but the profit of many, that they may be saved.
1 Be ye followers of me, even as I also am of Christ.

rr: 2 Nimbasiima ahabw'okuunyijuka omuri byona, n'okugumizamu omu migyenzo nk'oku naagibeegyeise.
en: 2 Now I praise you, brethren, that ye remember me in all things, and keep the ordinances, as I delivered them to you.
3 But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of Christ is God.

rr: 4 Omushaija weena orikushaba nari orikubuurira ayetwekyereire, naaba ahemwire omutwe gwe
en: 4 Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonoureth his head.

rr: 5 kwonka omukazi weena orikushaba nari orikubuurira ateetwekyereire, naaba ahemwire omutwe gwe; ahakuba ni nk'omweire enkomborora.
en: 5 But every woman that prayeth or prophesieth with her head uncovered dishonoureth her head: for that is even all one as if she were shaven.

rr: 6 Omukazi ku araabe atarikwenda kwetwekyerera, bamutegye eishokye; kwonka ku kiraabe kiri eky'enshoni omukazi okusharwa eishokye nari okutegwa, ayeetwekyerere.
en: 6 For if the woman be not covered, let her also be shorn: but if it be a shame for a woman to be shorn or shaven, let her be covered.

rr: 7 Mumanye ngu omushaija tashemereire kwetwekyerera, ahakuba n'ekishushani kya Ruhanga n'ekitiinisa kye; kwonka omukazi n'ekitiinisa ky'omushaija.
en: 7 For a man indeed ought not to cover his head, forasmuch as he is the image and glory of God: but the woman is the glory of the man.
8 For the man is not of the woman; but the woman of the man.
9 Neither was the man created for the woman; but the woman for the man.

rr: 10 N'ahabw'ekyo omukazi ahsemereire kugira eky'okwetwekyerera ahabwa baamaraika.
en: 10 For this cause ought the woman to have power on her head because of the angels.

rr: 11 Kwonka omuri Mukama omukazi tabaho hatari mushaija, n'omushaija tabaho hatari mukazi
en: 11 Nevertheless neither is the man without the woman, neither the woman without the man, in the Lord.

rr: 12 ahakuba nk'oku omukazi yaarugire omu mushaija, nikwo n'omushaija azaarwa omukazi; kandi byona biruga ahari Ruhanga.
en: 12 For as the woman is of the man, even so is the man also by the woman; but all things of God.

rr: 13 Naimwe mubiteekateekyeho. Ni kirungi omukazi kushaba Ruhanga ateetwekyereire?
en: 13 Judge in yourselves: is it comely that a woman pray unto God uncovered?

rr: 14 Nangwa n'emicwe y'obuntu tebeegyesa ngu omushaija okureka eishokye rye rikakura nikimuhemura?
en: 14 Doth not even nature itself teach you, that, if a man have long hair, it is a shame unto him?

rr: 15 Kwonka omukazi ku areka eishokye rye ryakura, kiba eky'ekitiinisa ahariwe; ahabw'okuba akaheebwa eishokye kumutwekyerera.
en: 15 But if a woman have long hair, it is a glory to her: for her hair is given her for a covering.

rr: 16 Kwonka ku haraabe hariho orikwenda kureeta empaka, amanye ngu omugyenzo nk'ogwo titugwine, kandi n'omu makanisa ga Ruhanga tigurimu.
en: 16 But if any man seem to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither the churches of God.

rr: 17 Omu bi ndikwenda kubaragiira, tindikubasiima, ahakuba ku mweteerana, tiharugamu kugyenda mumaisho, kureka okugaruka enyima.
en: 17 Now in this that I declare unto you I praise you not, that ye come together not for the better, but for the worse.
18 For first of all, when ye come together in the church, I hear that there be divisions among you; and I partly believe it.
19 For there must be also heresies among you, that they which are approved may be made manifest among you.

rr: 20 Ku muba muteeraine, ti kuba kurya By'okurya bya Mukama waitu
en: 20 When ye come together therefore into one place, this is not to eat the Lord's supper.

rr: 21 ahakuba omu kurya okwo omuntu weena abanza kurya eby'okurya bye ahabwe, omwe aguma aine enjara, ondiijo asinzire.
en: 21 For in eating every one taketh before other his own supper: and one is hungry, and another is drunken.
22 What? have ye not houses to eat and to drink in? or despise ye the church of God, and shame them that have not? What shall I say to you? shall I praise you in this? I praise you not.
23 For I have received of the Lord that which also I delivered unto you, That the Lord Jesus the same night in which he was betrayed took bread:

rr: 24 ku yaaherize kusiima, yaagubega, yaagira ati: Ogu nigwo mubiri gwangye oguheebwayo ahabwanyu; mugume mukore muti okuunyijukiraho.
en: 24 and when he had given thanks, he brake it , and said, Take, eat: this is my body, which is broken for you: this do in remembrance of me.
25 After the same manner also he took the cup, when he had supped, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood: this do ye, as oft as ye drink it , in remembrance of me.

rr: 26 Ahakuba ku murya aha mugaati ogu, kandi mwanywa n'aha kikopo eki, muba nimworeka okufa kwa Mukama waitu, okuhitsya obu ariija.
en: 26 For as often as ye eat this bread, and drink this cup, ye do shew the Lord's death till he come.
27 Wherefore whosoever shall eat this bread, and drink this cup of the Lord, unworthily, shall be guilty of the body and blood of the Lord.
28 But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of that bread, and drink of that cup.

rr: 29 Ahakuba omuntu ku arya yaanywa, ateetaire ha mubiri gwa Mukama, aba naayeriira kandi naayenywera orubanja.
en: 29 For he that eateth and drinketh unworthily, eateth and drinketh damnation to himself, not discerning the Lord's body.
30 For this cause many are weak and sickly among you, and many sleep.

rr: 31 Kuri twecwera orubanja twenka, titwakurucwereirwe.
en: 31 For if we would judge ourselves, we should not be judged.
32 But when we are judged, we are chastened of the Lord, that we should not be condemned with the world.

rr: 33 N'ahabw'ekyo, B'eishe-emwe, ku muraagume mwateerana kurya, mugume murindane
en: 33 Wherefore, my brethren, when ye come together to eat, tarry one for another.

rr: 34 (omuntu weena ku araabe aine enjara, arya omuka) murekye kweteerana mukeereetera orubanja.
en: 34 And if any man hunger, let him eat at home; that ye come not together unto condemnation.

rr: Ebindi ndyabibahabura naija.
en: And the rest will I set in order when I come.

rr: 1 Ebirikukwata aha biconco by'Omwoyo, B'eishe-emwe, tindikwenda ngu mutabimanya.
en: 1 Now concerning spiritual gifts , brethren, I would not have you ignorant.

rr: 2 Nimumanya ngu, obu mwabaire mukiri abakafiiri, mukaba muhabisibwa muhabira omu bishushani ebitarikubaasa kugamba, nk'oku mwabaire muhabisibwa hoona.
en: 2 Ye know that ye were Gentiles, carried away unto these dumb idols, even as ye were led.
3 Wherefore I give you to understand, that no man speaking by the Spirit of God calleth Jesus accursed: and that no man can say that Jesus is the Lord, but by the Holy Ghost.
4 Now there are diversities of gifts, but the same Spirit.
5 And there are differences of administrations, but the same Lord.

rr: 6 kandi hariho okukora kw'emiringo mingi, kwonka Ruhanga okoresa byona omuri boona n'omwe.
en: 6 And there are diversities of operations, but it is the same God which worketh all in all.

rr: 7 Kandi buri muntu ashuuruurirwa eby'Omwoyo kugasira boona.
en: 7 But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal.

rr: 8 Ahakuba omwe aheebwa Omwoyo ekigambo ky'obwengye, ondiijo aheebwa ekigambo ky'okwetegyereza omu buryo bw'Omwoyo ogwo
en: 8 For to one is given by the Spirit the word of wisdom; to another the word of knowledge by the same Spirit;

rr: 9 ondiijo aheebwa Omwoyo ogwo okwikiriza, ondiijo aheebwa Omwoyo ogwo omwe ebiconco eby'okutamba endwara
en: 9 to another faith by the same Spirit; to another the gifts of healing by the same Spirit;

rr: 10 ondiijo okukora eby'okutangaaza, ondiijo okubuurira, ondiijo obwengye obw'okutaanisa omu myoyo, ondiijo ekiconco “eky'okugamba endimi” ezitari zimwe, ondiijo eky'okushoboorora “endimi”.
en: 10 to another the working of miracles; to another prophecy; to another discerning of spirits; to another divers kinds of tongues; to another the interpretation of tongues:
11 but all these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit, dividing to every man severally as he will.

rr: 12 Mumanye ngu, nk'oku omubiri guba gumwe, gukagira engingo nyingi, kandi engingo ezo zoona ez'omubiri, n'obu ziraabe ziri nyingi, guba omubiri gumwe; na Kristo nikwo ari.
en: 12 For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also is Christ.
13 For by one Spirit are we all baptized into one body, whether we be Jews or Gentiles, whether we be bond or free; and have been all made to drink into one Spirit.

rr: 14 Ahakuba omubiri tiguba rugingo rumwe, kureka nyingi.
en: 14 For the body is not one member, but many.

rr: 15 Ekigyere ku kyakugira kiti: Obu ntari mukono, tindi rugingo rw'omubiri, ekyo tikikaakihindura kutaba ky'omubiri.
en: 15 If the foot shall say, Because I am not the hand, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?

rr: 16 N'okutu ku kwakugira kuti: Obu ntari riisho, tindi rugingo rw'omubiri, ekyo tikikaakuhindura kutaba kw'omubiri.
en: 16 And if the ear shall say, Because I am not the eye, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?

rr: 17 Omubiri gwona kuri gwabaire eriisho, gukaahuriire guta? Kandi kuri gwabaire okutu, gukaakagiise ki?
en: 17 If the whole body were an eye, where were the hearing? If the whole were hearing, where were the smelling?

rr: 18 Kwonka Ruhanga akataho engingo zoona omu mubiri, buri rugingo nk'oku yaasiimire.
en: 18 But now hath God set the members every one of them in the body, as it hath pleased him.

rr: 19 Engingo zoona kuri zaabaire orugingo rumwe, omubiri gukaabaire gurahi?
en: 19 And if they were all one member, where were the body?

rr: 20 Kwonka, nk'oku kiri, engingo ni nyingi, kwonka omubiri ni gumwe.
en: 20 But now are they many members, yet but one body.

rr: 21 Eriisho tiririkubaasa kugira omukono riti: Tonyiniire mugasho; nari shi omutwe kugira ebigyere guti: Timunyiniire mugasho.
en: 21 And the eye cannot say unto the hand, I have no need of thee: nor again the head to the feet, I have no need of you.

rr: 22 Nangwa n'ekindi, engingo z'omubiri ezi tuteekateekaho ngu tiziine maani, nizo ziba ezirikwetengwa
en: 22 Nay, much more those members of the body, which seem to be more feeble, are necessary:

rr: 23 n'engingo z'omubiri ezi tuteekateekaho ngu tiziine kitiinisa, nizo tuha ekitiinisa okukira ezindi; kandi engingo ziatu eziitsa enshoni nizo tujwarira
en: 23 and those members of the body, which we think to be less honourable, upon these we bestow more abundant honour; and our uncomely parts have more abundant comeliness.

rr: 24 kwonka ezitaitsa nshoni tizeetenga kujwekwa. Nikwo Ruhanga yaateeraine omubiri, orugingo orutaine kitiinisa yaaba nirwo yaaha ekitiinisa okukira ezindi
en: 24 For our comely parts have no need: but God hath tempered the body together, having given more abundant honour to that part which lacked:

rr: 25 ngu omu mubiri harekye kubamu okutaikirizana, kureka engingo zoona zisaasibwane.
en: 25 that there should be no schism in the body; but that the members should have the same care one for another.

rr: 26 Orugingo rumwe ku rushaasha, engingo zoona zisaasira hamwe; orugingo rumwe ku ruheebwa ekitiinisa, engingo zoona zishemerererwa hamwe.
en: 26 And whether one member suffer, all the members suffer with it; or one member be honoured, all the members rejoice with it.

rr: 27 Mbwenu naimwe muri omubiri gwa Kristo, kandi n'engingo zaagwo buri omwe.
en: 27 Now ye are the body of Christ, and members in particular.

rr: 28 Kandi Ruhanga akataho abantu omu kanisa, ab'okubanza entumwa, aba kabiri baanabi, aba kashatu abeegyesa, bwanyima abakora eby'okutangaaza; bwanyima yaataho ab'okutamba endwara, n'abahwezi, n'abategyeki, n'ab'okugmba “endimi” zitari zimwe.
en: 28 And God hath set some in the church, first apostles, secondarily prophets, thirdly teachers, after that miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, diversities of tongues.

rr: 29 Nimugira ngu boona n'entumwa? Boona ni baanabi? Boona n'abeegyesa? boona bakora eby'okutangaaza?
en: 29 Are all apostles? are all prophets? are all teachers? are all workers of miracles?

rr: 30 Boona baine ekiconco eky'okutamba endwara? Boona bagamba “endimi”? Boona bazishoboorora?
en: 30 Have all the gifts of healing? do all speak with tongues? do all interpret?

rr: 31 Kwonka mute omutima aha kusherura ebiconco ebirikukira oburungi. Kandi niinyija kubooreka omuhanda ogurikukira oburungi.
en: 31 But covet earnestly the best gifts: and yet shew I unto you a more excellent way.

rr: 1 N'obu naakugamba endimi z'abantu n'eza baamaraika, kwonka ntaine kukunda, nkaaba ndi nk'omuringa ogurikurangira n'ekyoma ekirikugamba.
en: 1 Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, and have not charity, I am become as sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal.
2 And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have not charity, I am nothing.

rr: 3 Kandi n'obu naakugaba ebintu byangye byona kuriisa abooro, kandi n'obu naakuhayo omubiri gwangye kwokibwa, kwonka ntaine kukunda, tikiine ki kyakungasira.
en: 3 And though I bestow all my goods to feed the poor , and though I give my body to be burned, and have not charity, it profiteth me nothing.

rr: 4 Okukunda kugumisiriza, kugira embabazi; okukunda tikugira ihari; okukunda tikwehimbisa, tikwetunguura
en: 4 Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,
5 doth not behave itself unseemly, seeketh not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil;

rr: 6 tikushemerererwa kutahikiirira, kureka kushemerererwa amazima.
en: 6 rejoiceth not in iniquity, but rejoiceth in the truth;
7 beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.
8 Charity never faileth: but whether there be prophecies, they shall fail; whether there be tongues, they shall cease; whether there be knowledge, it shall vanish away.

rr: 9 ahakuba nitumanyaho kakye; nituragura kakye
en: 9 For we know in part, and we prophesy in part.

rr: 10 kwonka ebihikire ku biriija, ebitahikire biryaihwaho.
en: 10 But when that which is perfect is come, then that which is in part shall be done away.

rr: 11 Obu naabaire ndi muto, nkaba ngamba nk'omuto, nyetegyereza nk'omuto, nteekateeka nk'omuto; ku naakuzire, naareka eby'obuto.
en: 11 When I was a child, I spake as a child, I understood as a child, I thought as a child: but when I became a man, I put away childish things.
12 For now we see through a glass, darkly; but then face to face: now I know in part; but then shall I know even as also I am known.
13 And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.
1 Follow after charity, and desire spiritual gifts , but rather that ye may prophesy.

rr: 2 Orikugamba “orurimi” naaba atarikugambira bantu, kureka Ruhanga; ahabw'okuba tihaine orikubishoborokyerwa; kwonka we Omwoyo naaba naamugambisa enaama.
en: 2 For he that speaketh in an unknown tongue speaketh not unto men, but unto God: for no man understandeth him ; howbeit in the spirit he speaketh mysteries.

rr: 3 Kwonka orikubuurira naaba naagambira abantu eby'okubombeka n'okubeezirikisa n'okubahuumuriza.
en: 3 But he that prophesieth speaketh unto men to edification, and exhortation, and comfort.

rr: 4 Orikugamba “orurimi” naaba naayeyombeka wenka; kwonka orikubuurira naaba naayombeka ekanisa.
en: 4 He that speaketh in an unknown tongue edifieth himself; but he that prophesieth edifieth the church.

5 I would that ye all spake with tongues, but rather that ye prophesied: for greater is he that prophesieth than he that speaketh with tongues, except he interpret, that the church may receive edifying.

rr: 6 Mbwenu, B'eishe-emwe, ku ndiija owaanyu ningamba “endimi”, ndyabagasira ki, ku ndiba ntagambire ki naashuuruurirwa, nari eky'okumanya, nari eky'okubuurira, nari eky'okubeegyesa?
en: 6 Now, brethren, if I come unto you speaking with tongues, what shall I profit you, except I shall speak to you either by revelation, or by knowledge, or by prophesying, or by doctrine?

rr: 7 Nangwa n'ebintu ebigamba, ebitaine magara, nk'emikuri nari enanga, ku birikuba bitataaniise maraka gaabyo, baryamanya bata eki birikugamba?
en: 7 And even things without life giving sound, whether pipe or harp, except they give a distinction in the sounds, how shall it be known what is piped or harped?

rr: 8 Enzamba ku egamba eiraka eritarikwetegyerezibwa, n'oha oyeteekateeka kuza aha rugamba?
en: 8 For if the trumpet give an uncertain sound, who shall prepare himself to the battle?

rr: 9 Mbwenu imwe, ku muraabe mutarikugamba mu “ndimi” ebigambo ebirikushobooroka, baryamanya bata ebirikugambwa? Ahakuba muryaba nimushusha nk'abarikugambira omuyaga.
en: 9 So likewise ye, except ye utter by the tongue words easy to be understood, how shall it be known what is spoken? for ye shall speak into the air.

rr: 10 Omu nsi yoona n'obu harimu endimi nyingi zita, tihariho na rumwe orutaine oku rushoboororwa.
en: 10 There are, it may be, so many kinds of voices in the world, and none of them is without signification.

rr: 11 Ku mba ntashoborokyeirwe rurimi, mba nk'omunyamahanga ahari ogwo orikugamba, nawe ambeera atyo.
en: 11 Therefore if I know not the meaning of the voice, I shall be unto him that speaketh a barbarian, and he that speaketh shall be a barbarian unto me.

rr: 12 Naimwe nk'oku mwine obweziriki aha biconco by'Omwoyo, mweshumbyeho okwezirika kwombeka ekanisa.
en: 12 Even so ye, forasmuch as ye are zealous of spiritual gifts , seek that ye may excel to the edifying of the church.

rr: 13 N'ahabw'ekyo orikugamba “orurimi”, ashabe kuheebwa okurushoboorora.
en: 13 Wherefore let him that speaketh in an unknown tongue pray that he may interpret.

rr: 14 Ahakuba ku mba ninshaba omu “rurimi”, omwoyo gwangye gushaba, kwonka obwengye bwangye tibugira ki bukora.
en: 14 For if I pray in an unknown tongue, my spirit prayeth, but my understanding is unfruitful.
15 What is it then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also: I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.

rr: 16 Ku oriba otatwarize otyo, haza waashabira omugisha omu Mwoyo wenka, omuntu ori aha rubaju rw'abatarikwetegyereza, aryaikiriza ara ati: Amiina, waaheza kusiima, haza we ataamanya ki waagamba?
en: 16 Else when thou shalt bless with the spirit, how shall he that occupieth the room of the unlearned say Amen at thy giving of thanks, seeing he understandeth not what thou sayest?

rr: 17 N'amazima, ahabwawe nooba osiimire gye: kwonka ogwo we tarikuhwerwa.
en: 17 For thou verily givest thanks well, but the other is not edified.

rr: 18 Ninsiima Ruhanga, ahakuba mwena nimbakiza kugamba “endimi”
en: 18 I thank my God, I speak with tongues more than ye all:

rr: 19 kwonka omu kanisa omu mwanya gw'okugamba ebigambo kakumi “omu rurimi”, nkaayenzire kugamba ebigambo bitaano n'obwengye bwangye, ngu nyegyese abandi.
en: 19 yet in the church I had rather speak five words with my understanding, that by my voice I might teach others also, than ten thousand words in an unknown tongue.
20 Brethren, be not children in understanding: howbeit in malice be ye children, but in understanding be men.
21 In the law it is written, With men of other tongues and other lips will I speak unto this people; and yet for all that will they not hear me, saith the Lord.

rr: 22 N'ahabw'ekyo “endimi” n'akamanyiso aha batarikwikiriza, ti ha barikwikiriza; kwonka okubuurira n'akamanyiso aha barikwikiriza, ti ha batarikwikiriza.
en: 22 Wherefore tongues are for a sign, not to them that believe, but to them that believe not: but prophesying serveth not for them that believe not, but for them which believe.

rr: 23 Ekanisa yoona ku yakauba eteeraine, boona baagamba “endimi”, ku haakutaahamu abatarikushoborokyerwa nari abatarikwikiriza? tibakaagira ngu mugwire eiraro?
en: 23 If therefore the whole church be come together into one place, and all speak with tongues, and there come in those that are unlearned, or unbelievers, will they not say that ye are mad?
24 But if all prophesy, and there come in one that believeth not, or one unlearned, he is convinced of all, he is judged of all:
25 and thus are the secrets of his heart made manifest; and so falling down on his face he will worship God, and report that God is in you of a truth.

rr: 26 Mbwenu, B'eishe-emwe, biri bita? Ku muteerana, buri muntu areeta ekye, omwe areeta zaaburi, ondiijo eky'okwegyesa, ondiijo eki ashuuruuriirwe, ondiijo “orurimi”, n'ondiijo eky'okushoboorora. Byona bigume bikorwe ahabw'okwombeka abantu.
en: 26 How is it then, brethren? when ye come together, every one of you hath a psalm, hath a doctrine, hath a tongue, hath a revelation, hath an interpretation. Let all things be done unto edifying.

rr: 27 Ku haraabe haabaireho abarikugamba “endimi”, hagambe babiri, kutarenga ahari bashatu, kandi bagambe omu mbu; habeho n'ow'okubishoboorora.
en: 27 If any man speak in an unknown tongue, let it be by two, or at the most by three, and that by course; and let one interpret.

rr: 28 Kwonka ku haraabe hatariho ow'okushoboorora, orikugamba “orurimi” ahuname omu kanisa, abigambe n'omutima gwe, kandi abigambire Ruhanga.
en: 28 But if there be no interpreter, let him keep silence in the church; and let him speak to himself, and to God.
29 Let the prophets speak two or three, and let the other judge.

rr: 30 Kwonka ku haraabe hariho oshutami, yaashuuruurirwa ekigambo, owaaba naagamba ahuname.
en: 30 If any thing be revealed to another that sitteth by, let the first hold his peace.

rr: 31 Ahakuba mwena nimubaasa kubuurira omwe omwe, ngu boona babone kwega, n'okwezirikisana.
en: 31 For ye may all prophesy one by one, that all may learn, and all may be comforted.

rr: 32 Emyoyo ya baanabi etegyekwa baanabi
en: 32 And the spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets.

rr: 33 ahakuba Ruhanga ti Ruhanga w'okujagarara, kureka n'ow'obusingye.
en: 33 For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.
34 Let your women keep silence in the churches: for it is not permitted unto them to speak; but they are commanded to be under obedience, as also saith the law.

rr: 35 Kandi baaba nibenda kushoborokyerwa ekigambo, bakibuurize abashaija baabo omuka, ahabw'okuba n'eky'enshoni omukazi kugamba omu kanisa.
en: 35 And if they will learn any thing, let them ask their husbands at home: for it is a shame for women to speak in the church.

rr: 36 Mbwenu, nimugira ngu niimwe ekigambo kya Ruhanga kyakomookiremu? Nari niimwe mwenka abu kyaiziire?
en: 36 What? came the word of God out from you? or came it unto you only?
37 If any man think himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him acknowledge that the things that I write unto you are the commandments of the Lord.

rr: 38 Kandi weena otarikukiikiriza tarikwikirizibwa.
en: 38 But if any man be ignorant, let him be ignorant.

rr: 39 N'ahabw'ekyo, Beene Tata, mwetengye munonga okubuurira, kandi mutazibira okugamba “endimi”
en: 39 Wherefore, brethren, covet to prophesy, and forbid not to speak with tongues.
40 Let all things be done decently and in order.

rr: 1 B'eishe-emwe, ningaruka kubamanyisa engiri, ei naababuuriire, mukaikiriza, kandi ei muhamiiremu
en: 1 Moreover, brethren, I declare unto you the gospel which I preached unto you, which also ye have received, and wherein ye stand;

rr: 2 niyo erikubajuna, ku muraabe nimugigumya, nk'oku naagibabuuriire, kureka okwikiriza kwanyu kube kwabaire kuri okwa busha.
en: 2 by which also ye are saved, if ye keep in memory what I preached unto you, unless ye have believed in vain.
3 For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received, how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures;
4 and that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures:

rr: 5 yaayeyoreka Keefa, bwanyima yaayeyoreka eikumi na babiri.
en: 5 and that he was seen of Cephas, then of the twelve:

rr: 6 Kandi bwanyima yaayeyorekyera hamwe ab'eishe-emwe okukira ahari magana ataano; abaingi aharibo baikiriho na hati, n'obu abamwe baraabe bagwejegyeire.
en: 6 after that, he was seen of above five hundred brethren at once; of whom the greater part remain unto this present, but some are fallen asleep.

rr: 7 Bwanyima yaayeyoreka Yakobo, na bwanyima entumwa zoona.
en: 7 After that, he was seen of James; then of all the apostles.
8 And last of all he was seen of me also, as of one born out of due time.
9 For I am the least of the apostles, that am not meet to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.
10 But by the grace of God I am what I am: and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain; but I laboured more abundantly than they all: yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.

rr: 11 Mbwenu yaaba nyowe, nari ezo ntumwa, okwo nikwo tubuurira, kandi nikwo mwaikiriize.
en: 11 Therefore whether it were I or they, so we preach, and so ye believed.

rr: 12 Mbwenu Kristo ku araabe naagambwa ngu akazooka omu bafu, abamwe omuriimwe nibahamya bata ngu tihariho kuzooka kw'abafu?
en: 12 Now if Christ be preached that he rose from the dead, how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead?

rr: 13 Ku haraabe hatariho kuzooka kw'abafu, na Kristo tarazookire.
en: 13 But if there be no resurrection of the dead, then is Christ not risen:

rr: 14 Kandi Kristo ku araabe atarazoirwe, biri okubuurira kwaitu n'okwa busha, n'okwikiriza kwanyu nakwo n'okwa busha.
en: 14 and if Christ be not risen, then is our preaching vain, and your faith is also vain.

rr: 15 Nangwa naitwe nituba tuhindukire baakareebi ba Ruhanga ab'ebishuba, ahabw'okuba tukahamya ngu Ruhanga akazoora Kristo, ou atarazoire, ku kiraabe kiri eky'amazima ngu abafu tibazooka.
en: 15 Yea, and we are found false witnesses of God; because we have testified of God that he raised up Christ: whom he raised not up, if so be that the dead rise not.
16 For if the dead rise not, then is not Christ raised:

rr: 17 Kandi Kristo ku araabe atarazoirwe, okwikiriza kwanyu n'okwa busha; nimuba mukiri omu bibi byanyu.
en: 17 and if Christ be not raised, your faith is vain; ye are yet in your sins.

rr: 18 Kandi n'abo abaagwejegyereire omuri Kristo nibaba bacwekyereire.
en: 18 Then they also which are fallen asleep in Christ are perished.

rr: 19 Ku turaabe twine amatsiko omuri Kristo omu biro by'amagara aga gonka, nituba turi ab'okusaasirwa okukira abandi boona.
en: 19 If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most miserable.
20 But now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the firstfruits of them that slept.
21 For since by man came death, by man came also the resurrection of the dead.

rr: 22 Nk'oku boona bafa omuri Adamu, nikwo n'omuri Kristo boona barihindurwa abahuriire.
en: 22 For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.
23 But every man in his own order: Christ the firstfruits; afterward they that are Christ's at his coming.
24 Then cometh the end, when he shall have delivered up the kingdom to God, even the Father; when he shall have put down all rule and all authority and power.
25 For he must reign, till he hath put all enemies under his feet.
26 The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.

rr: 27 Ahakuba kikahandiikwa ngu; Akamuha kutegyeka byona, abitaire ahandi y'ebigyere bye.
en: 27 For he hath put all things under his feet.

rr: Kwonka, ku kiraabe nikigira kityo, ngu byona bitairwe omu butegyeki bwe, nikimanywa ngu Ogwo owaamuhaire kutegyeka byona tabirimu.
en: But when he saith all things are put under him, it is manifest that he is excepted, which did put all things under him.

rr: 28 Kandi ebintu byona ku biriheza kuteebwa omu butegyeki bwe, obwo Omwana nawe aryateebwa omu butegyeki bw'Ogwo owaataire byona ahansi ye, Ruhanga abone kuba byona ahari boona.
en: 28 And when all things shall be subdued unto him, then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him, that God may be all in all.

rr: 29 Ku kiraabe kitari kityo, ababatizibwa ahabw'abaafiire baryaba bata? Abafiire ku baraabe batazooka buzima, n'enki ekibabatirisa ahabw'abaafiire?
en: 29 Else what shall they do which are baptized for the dead, if the dead rise not at all? why are they then baptized for the dead?
30 And why stand we in jeopardy every hour?
31 I protest by your rejoicing which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.
32 If after the manner of men I have fought with beasts at Ephesus, what advantageth it me, if the dead rise not? let us eat and drink; for to morrow we die.

rr: 33 Mutabeihwebeihwe; ekigombe kibi kishiisha emicwe mirungi.
en: 33 Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.

rr: 34 Musinduukye, mube abahikiriire, murekye kushiisha; ahakuba abamwe tibarikumanya Ruhanga. Ebi naabigamba kubakwatsa enshoni.
en: 34 Awake to righteousness, and sin not; for some have not the knowledge of God: I speak this to your shame.

rr: 35 Shana omwe akaabuuza ati: Abafu bazoorwa bata? Kandi baryazooka na mubiri ki?
en: 35 But some man will say, How are the dead raised up? and with what body do they come?
36 Thou fool, that which thou sowest is not quickened, except it die:

rr: 37 Kandi n'ei obyara tobyara mubiri ogu erigira, kureka enjuma kwonka, yaaba y'engano nari ey'enjuma ezindi.
en: 37 and that which thou sowest, thou sowest not that body that shall be, but bare grain, it may chance of wheat, or of some other grain :
38 but God giveth it a body as it hath pleased him, and to every seed his own body.

rr: 39 Nimumanya ngu emibiri yoona teshushana; hariho omuringo gumwe ogw'abantu, ogundi gw'enyamaishwa, ogundi gw'enyonyi, n'ogundi ogw'eby'enyanja.
en: 39 All flesh is not the same flesh: but there is one kind of flesh of men, another flesh of beasts, another of fishes, and another of birds.

rr: 40 Hariho eby'omu iguru, kandi n'eby'omu nsi; kwonka ekitiinisa ky'eby'omu iguru kiri okwakyo, n'ekitiinisa ky'eby'omu nsi nakyo kiri okwakyo.
en: 40 There are also celestial bodies, and bodies terrestrial: but the glory of the celestial is one, and the glory of the terrestrial is another.

rr: 41 Hariho ekitiinisa ky'eizooba, n'eky'okwezi, n'ekindi ky'enyonyoozi; kandi enyonyoozi nazo zikizakizana ekitiinisa.
en: 41 There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars: for one star differeth from another star in glory.

rr: 42 N'okuzooka kw'abafu nikwo kuri. Omubiri gubibwa guri ogw'okujunda, guzoorwa guri ogw'okutajunda.
en: 42 So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:
43 it is sown in dishonour; it is raised in glory: it is sown in weakness; it is raised in power:

rr: 44 Gubibwa guri omubiri gw'obuntu, guzoorw aguri ogw'omwoyo. Ku haraabe hariho omubiri gw'obungu, hariho n'ogw'omwoyo.
en: 44 it is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body.
45 And so it is written, The first man Adam was made a living soul; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit.

rr: 46 Kwonka Ow'omwoyo tiwe yaabandize, kureka ow'omubiri ogw'obuntu, bwanyima haakurataho Ow'omwoyo.
en: 46 Howbeit that was not first which is spiritual, but that which is natural; and afterward that which is spiritual.
47 The first man is of the earth, earthy: the second man is the Lord from heaven.

rr: 48 Nk'ow'omu itaka oku yaabaire ari, nikwo n'ab'omu itaka bari; kandi nk'Ow'omu iguru oku ari, n'ab'omu iguru nikwo bari
en: 48 As is the earthy, such are they also that are earthy: and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.

rr: 49 Kandi nk'oku twashushaine n'ow'omu itaka, nikwo turishushana n'Ow'omu iguru.
en: 49 And as we have borne the image of the earthy, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly.

rr: 50 Mbwenu, B'eishe-emwe, eki ndikugamba nikyo eki nti: Omubiri n'eshagama tibirikubaasa kuhungura bukama bwa Ruhanga, kandi n'ebijunda tibirihungura butajunda.
en: 50 Now this I say, brethren, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God; neither doth corruption inherit incorruption.
51 Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,
52 in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.
53 For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.

rr: 54 Ogujunda ogu kandi n'ogufa ogu ku guriba gwajwaire okutafa, obwo ekigambo ekyahandiikirwe kiryahikiirira ekirikugira kiti
en: 54 So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written, Death is swallowed up in victory.
55 O death, where is thy sting? O grave, where is thy victory?
56 The sting of death is sin; and the strength of sin is the law.

rr: 57 Kwonka Ruhanga asiimwe, otuha okusingura ahabwa Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo.
en: 57 But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
58 Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.
1 Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I have given order to the churches of Galatia, even so do ye.

rr: 2 Aha kiro ky'okubanza omu saabiiti, buri muntu omuriimwe agume abiikye omu ka ye ebi arikubaasa aha bi atungire, ku ndiba naizire, harekye kubaho okuteerana empiiha.
en: 2 Upon the first day of the week let every one of you lay by him in store, as God hath prospered him, that there be no gatherings when I come.

rr: 3 Ku ndihika okwo, abu muriha ebaruha z'okubasiima, nibo ndyohereza kutwara ebiconco byanyu Yerusaalemu.
en: 3 And when I come, whomsoever ye shall approve by your letters, them will I send to bring your liberality unto Jerusalem.

rr: 4 Kandi naanye ku kiriba kinshemereire kugyenda, turyagyendana.
en: 4 And if it be meet that I go also, they shall go with me.
5 Now I will come unto you, when I shall pass through Macedonia: for I do pass through Macedonia.

rr: 6 kandi shana ndyaguma naimwe, obundi nkaamarirayo n'ebiro by'embeho, mubone kunshendekyereza ahi ndiza hoona.
en: 6 And it may be that I will abide, yea, and winter with you, that ye may bring me on my journey whithersoever I go.

rr: 7 Ahakuba tindikwenda kubarabyaho amaguru hati; ahabw'okuba nyine amatsiko g'okumara naimwe ebiro, Mukama ku arikunda.
en: 7 For I will not see you now by the way; but I trust to tarry a while with you, if the Lord permit.

rr: 8 Kwonka ndyaguma omuri Efeso okuhitysa aha kiro kya Pentekoote
en: 8 But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost.
9 For a great door and effectual is opened unto me, and there are many adversaries.
10 Now if Timotheus come, see that he may be with you without fear: for he worketh the work of the Lord, as I also do .
11 Let no man therefore despise him: but conduct him forth in peace, that he may come unto me: for I look for him with the brethren.
12 As touching our brother Apollos, I greatly desired him to come unto you with the brethren: but his will was not at all to come at this time; but he will come when he shall have convenient time.
13 Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.

rr: 14 Byona ebi murikukora, mubikorese rukundo.
en: 14 Let all your things be done with charity.
15 I beseech you, brethren, (ye know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints,)
16 that ye submit yourselves unto such, and to every one that helpeth with us , and laboureth.

rr: 17 Kandi nyine okushemererwa ahabw'okwija kwa Stefana na Forutunaato na Akaiko; ahabw'okuba bammazire orushusho oru naabaire mbainiire
en: 17 I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for that which was lacking on your part they have supplied.
18 For they have refreshed my spirit and your's: therefore acknowledge ye them that are such.

rr: 19 Amakanisa g'omuri Asia gabaramutsya.
en: 19 The churches of Asia salute you.

rr: Akula na Pruskila n'ekanisa eteeranira omu ka yaabo baabaramutsya munonga omuri Mukama.
en: Aquila and Priscilla salute you much in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.

rr: 20 Ab'eishe-emwe boona baabaramutsya. Muramukanise okunywegyerana okurikwera.
en: 20 All the brethren greet you. Greet ye one another with an holy kiss.
21 The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand.
22 If any man love not the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be Anathema Maran-atha.

rr: 23 Embabazi zigume naimwe.
en: 23 The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

rr: 24 Okukunda kwangye kugume naimwe mwena omuri Kristo Yesu. Amiina.
en: 24 My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen.
1 That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, of the Word of life;
2 (for the life was manifested, and we have seen it , and bear witness, and shew unto you that eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us;)

rr: 3 eki twareebire kandi eki twahuriire, nikyo turikubagambira ngu naimwe mukwatainse naitwe; kandi naitwe tukwataniise na isheboona n'Omwana we Yesu Kristo
en: 3 that which we have seen and heard declare we unto you, that ye also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.
4 And these things write we unto you, that your joy may be full.
5 This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
6 If we say that we have fellowship with him, and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:
7 but if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.

rr: 8 Ku tugira ngu titwine kibi, tuba nitwebeiha, kandi tuba tutaine mazima.
en: 8 If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

rr: 9 Ku twatura ebibi byaitu, niwe w'okwesigwa kandi ohikiriire kutusaasira ebibi n'okutwozyaho eby'okutahikiirira byona.
en: 9 If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

rr: 10 Ku tugira ngu titukashiishaga, tumuhindura omubeihi, kandi ekigambo kye kiba kitari muriitwe.
en: 10 If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
1 My little children, these things write I unto you, that ye sin not. And if any man sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:
2 and he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for our's only, but also for the sins of the whole world.

rr: 3 Ahari eki niho turikuhamiza ngu nitumumanya, ku turaabe nitukora ebi aturagiira.
en: 3 And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.

rr: 4 Orikugira ati, Nimmumanya, atarikworobera biragiro bye, n'omubeihi, kandi naaba ataine mazima
en: 4 He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
5 But whoso keepeth his word, in him verily is the love of God perfected: hereby know we that we are in him.

rr: 6 orikugira ngu atuura omuriwe, ashemereire kutwaza nka We oku yaabaire atwaza.
en: 6 He that saith he abideth in him ought himself also so to walk, even as he walked.

rr: 7 Abarikukundwa, tindikubahandiikira kiragiro kisya, kureka ekya ira, eki mwabaire mwine okwiha iranaira; ekiragiro ekyo ekya ira nikyo kigambo eki mwahuriire.
en: 7 Brethren, I write no new commandment unto you, but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which ye have heard from the beginning.
8 Again, a new commandment I write unto you, which thing is true in him and in you: because the darkness is past, and the true light now shineth.
9 He that saith he is in the light, and hateth his brother, is in darkness even until now.
10 He that loveth his brother abideth in the light, and there is none occasion of stumbling in him.
11 But he that hateth his brother is in darkness, and walketh in darkness, and knoweth not whither he goeth, because that darkness hath blinded his eyes.

rr: 12 Nimgahandiikira, imwe abaana bato, ahakuba ebibi byanyu bibasaasiirwe ahabw'eiziina rye.
en: 12 I write unto you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name's sake.

rr: 13 Nimbahandiikira, imwe baishebo, ahakuba nimumanya Ogwo owaabaire ariho okwiha iranaira.
en: 13 I write unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning.

rr: Nimbahandiikira, imwe abatsigazi, ahakuba musingwire Omubi.
en: I write unto you, young men, because ye have overcome the wicked one.

rr: Naabahandiikira, imwe abaana bato, ahakuba nimumanya Isheboona.
en: I write unto you, little children, because ye have known the Father.

14 I have written unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the wicked one.
15 Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.

rr: 16 Ahakuba byona eby'omu nsi, ebi omubiri gwetegna, n'ebi amaisho geetenga, n'okwehimbisa ahabw'eby'amagara aga, tibiruga hari Isheboona, kureka biruga omu nsi egi.
