en: 16 For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.
17 And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.

rr: 18 Imwe abaana bato, ogu nigwo mwanya gw'aha muheru; nk'oku mwahuriire ngu nihenda kwija # 2:18 Antikristo, amakuru n'ekyebumbe ekirikweyeta Kristo. Antikristo, na mbwenu haizire baantikristo baingi; aho niho turikumanyira omwanya ogu ku guri ogw'aha muheru.
en: 18 Little children, it is the last time: and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come, even now are there many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last time.

19 They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us: but they went out , that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.

rr: 20 Kwonka imwe mukashukwaho amajuta Ogwo Orikwera, kandi mwena nimukimanya.
en: 20 But ye have an unction from the Holy One, and ye know all things.

rr: 21 Tinaabahandiikira nk'abatarikumanya mazima, kureka nk'abarikugamanya, kandi nimumanya ngu tihariho kishuba ekiruga omu mazima.
en: 21 I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and that no lie is of the truth.

rr: 22 Omubeihi n'oha? T'ogwo ohakana ku Yesu atari Kristo? Antikristo n'ogwo oyehakana Isheboona n'Omwana.
en: 22 Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ? He is antichrist, that denieth the Father and the Son.
23 Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: (but) he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also .

rr: 24 N'ahabw'ekyo eki mwahuriire okwiha iranaira kibe nikyo kyaguma omuriimwe.
en: 24 Let that therefore abide in you, which ye have heard from the beginning.

rr: Eki mwahuriire okwiha iranaira ku kiriguma omuriimwe, naimwe muryaguma omu Mwana n'omuri Isheboona.
en: If that which ye have heard from the beginning shall remain in you, ye also shall continue in the Son, and in the Father.

rr: 25 Kandi endagaano ei yaaturaganiise n'egi, okuheebwa amagara agatahwaho.
en: 25 And this is the promise that he hath promised us, even eternal life.

rr: 26 Ebi naabibahandiikira kubamanyisa eby'abarikwenda kubahabisa
en: 26 These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you.

27 But the anointing which ye have received of him abideth in you, and ye need not that any man teach you: but as the same anointing teacheth you of all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it hath taught you, ye shall abide in him.
28 And now, little children, abide in him; that, when he shall appear, we may have confidence, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
29 If ye know that he is righteous, ye know that every one that doeth righteousness is born of him.
1 Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.
2 Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.

rr: 3 Kandi omuntu weena omwineho amatsiko ago, ayeshemeze nka We oku ari oshemeire.
en: 3 And every man that hath this hope in him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.

rr: 4 Omuntu weena okora ekibi akora eby'obugomi; kandi ekibi nibwo bugomi.
en: 4 Whosoever committeth sin transgresseth also the law: for sin is the transgression of the law.
5 And ye know that he was manifested to take away our sins; and in him is no sin.
6 Whosoever abideth in him sinneth not: whosoever sinneth hath not seen him, neither known him.

rr: 7 Imwe abaana bato, hatagira omuntu weena owaabahabya. Okora eby'okuhikiirira niwe ahikiriire, nka We oku ahikiriire.
en: 7 Little children, let no man deceive you: he that doeth righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.
8 He that committeth sin is of the devil; for the devil sinneth from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil.
9 Whosoever is born of God doth not commit sin; for his seed remaineth in him: and he cannot sin, because he is born of God.

rr: 10 Ekyo nikyo kimanyisa abaana ba Ruhanga n'abaana ba Sitaane; weena otakora eby'okuhikiirira ti wa Ruhanga, n'obu yaakuba otakunda mwene ishe.
en: 10 In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.
11 For this is the message that ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.
12 Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother's righteous.
13 Marvel not, my brethren, if the world hate you.
14 We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren. He that loveth not his brother abideth in death.
15 Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.
16 Hereby perceive we the love of God , because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.
17 But whoso hath this world's good, and seeth his brother have need, and shutteth up his bowels of compassion from him, how dwelleth the love of God in him?
18 My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.

rr: 19 Aha niho turikumanyira ko turi ab'amazima, tukagarukwamu emitima omu maisho ge
en: 19 And hereby we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before him.

rr: 20 omuri byona ebi etushinja; ahakuba Ruhanga ni mukuru okukira emitima yaitu, kandi naamanya byona.
en: 20 For if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.

rr: 21 Abarikukundwa, emitima yaitu ku eraabe etarikutushinja, twine obumanzi omu maisho ga Ruhanga
en: 21 Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, then have we confidence toward God.
22 And whatsoever we ask, we receive of him, because we keep his commandments, and do those things that are pleasing in his sight.
23 And this is his commandment, That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, as he gave us commandment.
24 And he that keepeth his commandments dwelleth in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abideth in us, by the Spirit which he hath given us.
1 Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.
2 Hereby know ye the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God:

3 and every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not of God: and this is that spirit of antichrist, whereof ye have heard that it should come; and even now already is it in the world.
4 Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.

rr: 5 Bo n'ab'ensi; n'ahabw'ekyo nibagamba eby'ensi kandi n'ensi neebahurira.
en: 5 They are of the world: therefore speak they of the world, and the world heareth them.
6 We are of God: he that knoweth God heareth us; he that is not of God heareth not us. Hereby know we the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.

rr: 7 Abarikukundwa, tukundane, ahakuba okukunda kuruga ahari Ruhanga, kandi omuntu weena ogira rukundo aba azairwe Ruhanga.
en: 7 Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.

rr: 8 Otagira rukundo tamanya Ruhanga; ahakuba Ruhanga aba rukundo.
en: 8 He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.
9 In this was manifested the love of God toward us, because that God sent his only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through him.

rr: 10 Omuri eki nimwo okukunda kuri, tiitwe twakunzire Ruhanga, kureka niwe yaatukunzire, akatuma Omwana we kuba ekarabo ahabw'ebibi byaitu.
en: 10 Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.

rr: 11 Abarikukundwa, Ruhanga ku araabe yaatukunzire atyo, naitwe tushemereire kukundana.
en: 11 Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another.
12 No man hath seen God at any time. If we love one another, God dwelleth in us, and his love is perfected in us.

rr: 13 Aha niho tumanyira ngu tuguma omuriwe, nawe omuriitwe, ahabw'okuba akatuha aha Mwoyo we.
en: 13 Hereby know we that we dwell in him, and he in us, because he hath given us of his Spirit.
14 And we have seen and do testify that the Father sent the Son to be the Saviour of the world.
15 Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God dwelleth in him, and he in God.

rr: 16 Itwe nitumanya, kandi nitwikiriza okukunda oku Ruhanga atukunda.
en: 16 And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us.

rr: Ruhanga ni rukundo; kandi oguma omuri rukundo niwe aguma omuri Ruhanga, na Ruhanga akaguma omuriwe.
en: God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, and God in him.

rr: 17 Omuri eki nimwo okukunda kuhikiirizibwa omuriitwe, ngu tugire obumanzi tutaritiina aha kiro ky'orubanja, ahakuba nk'oku ari nikwo naitwe turi omu nsi egi.
en: 17 Herein is our love made perfect, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment: because as he is, so are we in this world.

rr: 18 Omu kukunda tihabamu bwoba, okukunda okuhikire kubingira aheeru obwoba; ahakuba obwoba bugyenda n'ekiheneso, kandi oine obwoba aba ataine kukunda okuhikire.
en: 18 There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.

rr: 19 Itwe nitukunda, ahakuba We akabanza kutukunda.
en: 19 We love him, because he first loved us.

rr: 20 Omuntu weena ku agira ati, Ninkunda Ruhanga, haza naayanga mugyenzi we, n'omubeihi; ahakuba otakunda mugyenzi we ou arareebire, tabaasa kukunda Ruhanga ou atakareebaga.
en: 20 If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath not seen?
21 And this commandment have we from him, That he who loveth God love his brother also.

rr: 1 Omuntu weena oikiriza ngu Yesu ni Kristo aba azairwe Ruhanga; kandi weena okunda omuzaire aba naakunda n'ou yaazaire.
en: 1 Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is born of God: and every one that loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him.

rr: 2 Aha niho turikumanyira ngu tukunda abaana ba Ruhanga, ku tukunda Ruhanga, twayorobera ebiragiro bye.
en: 2 By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God, and keep his commandments.
3 For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.
4 For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.

rr: 5 Mbwenu n'oha osingura ensi? T'ogwo oikiriza ngu Yesu n'Omwana wa Ruhanga?
en: 5 Who is he that overcometh the world, but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God?
6 This is he that came by water and blood, even Jesus Christ; not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that beareth witness, because the Spirit is truth.

rr: 7 kandi Omwoyo niwe abihamya, ahabw'okuba Omwoyo nigo mazima.
en: 7 For there are three that bear record in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost: and these three are one.

rr: 8 Hariho ebirikuhamya bishatu, Omwoyo n'amaizi n'eshagama; kandi ebishatu ebyo biikirizana.
en: 8 And there are three that bear witness in earth, the Spirit, and the water, and the blood: and these three agree in one.
9 If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater: for this is the witness of God which he hath testified of his Son.
10 He that believeth on the Son of God hath the witness in himself: he that believeth not God hath made him a liar; because he believeth not the record that God gave of his Son.

rr: 11 Kandi oku nikwo kuhamya okwo, ngu Ruhanga akatuha amagara agatahwaho, kandi amagara ago gari omu Mwana we.
en: 11 And this is the record, that God hath given to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
12 He that hath the Son hath life; and he that hath not the Son of God hath not life.
13 These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may know that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God.
14 And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:

rr: 15 Kandi ku turaabe nitumanya ngu atuhurira omuri byona ebi tushaba, nitumanya ngu tutungire ebi twamushabire.
en: 15 and if we know that he hear us, whatsoever we ask, we know that we have the petitions that we desired of him.

16 If any man see his brother sin a sin which is not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.

rr: 17 Ekitari ky'okuhikiirira kyona kiba ekibi; kwonka hariho ekibi ekitari ky'okwitsa.
en: 17 All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not unto death.

rr: 18 Nitumanya ngu omuntu weena ozairwe Ruhanga takora kibi; ahakuba Ogwo owaazairwe Ruhanga niwe amurinda, kandi Omubi tamukoraho.
en: 18 We know that whosoever is born of God sinneth not; but he that is begotten of God keepeth himself, and that wicked one toucheth him not.

rr: 19 Itwe nitumanya ku turi aba Ruhanga, kandi ensi yoona ku eri omu butegyeki bw'Omubi ogwo.
en: 19 And we know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in wickedness.

20 And we know that the Son of God is come, and hath given us an understanding, that we may know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, even in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.
21 Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Amen.

rr: Omugabe Daudi akaba akuzire munonga, ahikire omu ngingo zaabukuru; n'obu baabaire bamushweka ebeshweko, akaba atakibaasa kutagatirwa.
en: Now king David was old and stricken in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he gat no heat.

rr: Nikyo abagaragwa be baamugiire bati: Nyakusinga Omugabe, ka bakusherurire omwishiki empangare, agume akuheereze, kandi abyame omu kifuba kyawe, obone kutagatirwa.
en: Wherefore his servants said unto him, Let there be sought for my lord the king a young virgin: and let her stand before the king, and let her cherish him, and let her lie in thy bosom, that my lord the king may get heat.

rr: Batyo basherura omwishiki murungi omuri Israeli yoona, baabona Abishaagi owa Shuneemu, baamureetera omugabe.
en: So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the coasts of Israel, and found Abishag a Shunammite, and brought her to the king.

rr: Omwishiki ogwo akaba ari murungi munonga, yaaba omuranga w'omugabe, yaaguma naamuheereza; kwonka omugabe tiyaamumanya.
en: And the damsel was very fair, and cherished the king, and ministered to him: but the king knew her not. David's Successor

rr: Bwanyima Adoniya mutabani wa Hagisi yaayekuza, naagira ati: Niinyija kuba omugabe. Yaayeteeraho ebigaari n'ab'aha mbaraasi, kandi n'abashaija makumi ataano b'okumwebembera.
en: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, I will be king: and he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.

rr: Ishe akaba atakamugwisaga kubi naamugira ati: Ahabw'enki okozire oti n'oti? Akaba ari omushaija murungi munonga omu kureeba; kandi niwe yaabaire naakurata Abusalomu.
en: And his father had not displeased him at any time in saying, Why hast thou done so? and he also was a very goodly man; and his mother bare him after Absalom.

rr: Adonia ogwo yaahanuura na Yoabu mwene Zeruiya n'Abiasaari omunyamurwa; baakwatanisa nawe, baamuhwera.
en: And he conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah, and with Abiathar the priest: and they following Adonijah helped him .

rr: 2 Kwonka Zadoki omunyamurwa na Benaaya mwene Yehoyaada, na Nasani nabi, na Shemei, na Rei, na bari bashaija ba Daudi amamanzi bakaba batakwataniise na Adoniya.
en: But Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and Nathan the prophet, and Shimei, and Rei, and the mighty men which belonged to David, were not with Adonijah.

rr: Adoniya yaatambira entaama n'ente n'eby'ebishaju haihi n'eibaare rya Zoheleesi, erihereraine na Eni-rogeli; yaayeta beene ishe batabani b'omugabe, n'abategyeki boona ab'omuri Yuda ab'obugabe
en: And Adonijah slew sheep and oxen and fat cattle by the stone of Zoheleth, which is by En-rogel, and called all his brethren the king's sons, and all the men of Judah the king's servants:

rr: kwonka nka Nasani nabi na Benaaya n'abo bashaija amamanzi na Sulemaani mwene ishe tiyabeeta.
en: but Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother, he called not.

rr: Bwanyima Nasani yaagira Batisheba nyina wa Sulemaani ati: Tohuriire Adoniya mwene Hagisi ku abaire omugabe, haza mukama waitu Daudi atarikukumanya?
en: Wherefore Nathan spake unto Bath-sheba the mother of Solomon, saying, Hast thou not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith doth reign, and David our lord knoweth it not?

rr: Mbwenu nu, ija nkuhe obwengye, obone kukiza amagara gaawe n'aga mutabani waawe Sulemaani.
en: Now therefore come, let me, I pray thee, give thee counsel, that thou mayest save thine own life, and the life of thy son Solomon.

rr: Irooko oze ow'omugabe Daudi, omugire oti: Nyakusinga Omugabe, torikwijuka ku waaraganiise omuzaana waawe noorahira oti: Buzimazima mutabani waawe Sulemaani niwe ariza aha ngoma naarugaho; kandi oti: Niwe arishutama aha kitebe kyangye ky'obugabe? Mbwenu ahabw'enki heemire Adoniya?
en: Go and get thee in unto king David, and say unto him, Didst not thou, my lord, O king, swear unto thine handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne? why then doth Adonijah reign?

rr: Mbwenu ku oraabe nookigamba n'omugabe, naanye niinyija kutaahamu nkukuratiire, mpamye ebigambo byawe.
en: Behold, while thou yet talkest there with the king, I also will come in after thee, and confirm thy words.

rr: Atyo Batisheba yaataaha omu kishengye ky'omugabe; (obwo omugabe akaba akuzire munonga, kandi Abishaagi owa Shuneemu niwe yaabaire naamuheereza).
en: And Bath-sheba went in unto the king into the chamber: and the king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite ministered unto the king.

rr: Batisheba yainama, yaatangirira omugabe; omugabe yaamubuuza ati: Nooyenda ki?
en: And Bath-sheba bowed, and did obeisance unto the king. And the king said, What wouldest thou?

rr: Yaamugarukamu ati: Mukama wangye, okarahira MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe, noogira omuzaana waawe oti: Buzimazima Sulemaani mutabani waawe niwe ariza aha ngoma naarugaho; kandi oti: Niwe arishutama aha kitebe kyangye ky'obugabe.
en: And she said unto him, My lord, thou swarest by the LORD thy God unto thine handmaid, saying , Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne.

rr: Mbwenu reeba, Adoniya niwe ayemire, haza, Mukama wangye Omugabe, otarikukimanya.
en: And now, behold, Adonijah reigneth; and now, my lord the king, thou knowest it not:

en: and he hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the sons of the king, and Abiathar the priest, and Joab the captain of the host: but Solomon thy servant hath he not called.

en: And thou, my lord, O king, the eyes of all Israel are upon thee, that thou shouldest tell them who shall sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.

rr: Nyakusinga Omugabe, ku oraabe otakozire otyo, bwanyima ku ori gwejyegyera waashanga baashwenkuru, nyowe na mutabani wangye Sulemaani turyabarwa nk'abacumwire.
en: Otherwise it shall come to pass, when my lord the king shall sleep with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon shall be counted offenders.

rr: Batisheba ku yaabaire naakigamba n'omugabe, Nasani nabi yaataahamu.
en: And, lo, while she yet talked with the king, Nathan the prophet also came in.

rr: Baagambira omugabe bati: Reeba, Nasani nabi ari aha.
en: And they told the king, saying, Behold Nathan the prophet.

rr: Ku yaahikire omu maisho g'omugabe, yainama omu maisho ge.
en: And when he was come in before the king, he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.

rr: Nasani yaagira ati: Nyakusinga Omugabe, niiwe ogizire oti: Adoniya niwe ariza aha ngoma naarugaho, kandi niwe arishutama aha kitebe kyangye ky'obugabe?
en: And Nathan said, My lord, O king, hast thou said, Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne?

rr: Ahabw'okuba eri izooba yaashuuma, yaita ente n'eby'ebishaju n'entaama bingi munonga, yaabitamba, kandi yaayeta batabani b'omugabe boona na Yoabu omukuru w'eihe na Abiasaari omunyamurwa; mbwenu bari omu maisho ge nibarya nibanywa, nibagira bati: Omugabe Adoniya nakaramaare!
en: For he is gone down this day, and hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the king's sons, and the captains of the host, and Abiathar the priest; and, behold, they eat and drink before him, and say, God save king Adonijah.

rr: Kwonka nyowe omwiru waawe, na Zadoki omunyamurwa na Benaaya mwene Yehoyaada n'omwiru waawe Sulemaani tatwetsire.
en: But me, even me thy servant, and Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and thy servant Solomon, hath he not called.

rr: Ekyo kirugire ahari mukama wangye omugabe, kandi otagambiire abairu baawe orishutama aha kitebe kyawe ky'obugabe waarugaho.
en: Is this thing done by my lord the king, and thou hast not shewed it unto thy servant, who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?

rr: Omugabe Daudi yaagira ati: Nyetera Batisheba. Batisheba yaija, yaayemerera omu maisho ge.
en: Then king David answered and said, Call me Bath-sheba. And she came into the king's presence, and stood before the king.

rr: Omugabe yaarahira naagira ati: Nk'oku MUKAMA ari ohuriire, owaihire amagara gangye omu busaasi bw'emiringo yoona
en: And the king sware, and said, As the LORD liveth, that hath redeemed my soul out of all distress,

rr: Batisheba yainama, yaaramya omugabe naagira ati: Mukama wangye Omugabe Daudi nakaramaare!
en: Then Bath-sheba bowed with her face to the earth, and did reverence to the king, and said, Let my lord king David live for ever.

rr: Omugabe yaabagira ati: Mugyende n'abagaragwa ba mukama waanyu, mutembye mutabani wangye Sulemaani enyumbu yangye ahabwangye, mumushuumye Gihoni
en: The king also said unto them, Take with you the servants of your lord, and cause Solomon my son to ride upon mine own mule, and bring him down to Gihon:

rr: ku muraahikyeyo, Zadoki omunyamurwa na Nasani nabi bamushukyeho amajuta kuba omugabe wa Israeli; bwanyima muteere eikondere, mugire muti: Omugabe Sulemaani nakaramaare!
en: and let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel: and blow ye with the trumpet, and say, God save king Solomon.

rr: Bwanyima mwije enyima ye, aije ashutame aha kitebe kyangye ky'obugabe; ahakuba aryaba omugabe omu mwanya gwangye; kandi niwe naataho kuba omugabe wa Israeli na Yuda.
en: Then ye shall come up after him, that he may come and sit upon my throne; for he shall be king in my stead: and I have appointed him to be ruler over Israel and over Judah.

rr: Benaaya mwene Yehoyaada yaagarukamu omugabe ati: Amiina! MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa mukama wangye omugabe nawe agire atyo.
en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king, and said, Amen: the LORD God of my lord the king say so too .

rr: Nk'oku MUKAMA abaire ari na mukama wangye omugabe n'okuhitsya hati, abe nikwo yaaba na Sulemaani, atunguure ekitebe kye ky'obugabe okukira ekya mukama wangye omugabe Daudi.
en: As the LORD hath been with my lord the king, even so be he with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord king David.

rr: Atyo Zadoki omunyamurwa na Nasani nabi na Benaaya mwene Yehoyaada n'Abakeresi n'Abapelesi, baashuuma baatembya Sulemaani enyumbu y'omugabe Daudi, baamutwara Gihoni.
en: So Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, went down, and caused Solomon to ride upon king David's mule, and brought him to Gihon.

rr: -32 ; Zadoki omunyamurwa yaiha eihembe ry'amajuta omu Ihema, yaagashuka ahari Sulemaani.
en: And Zadok the priest took an horn of oil out of the tabernacle, and anointed Solomon.

rr: Baateera eikondere; abantu boona baagira bati: Omugabe Sulemaani nakaramaare!
en: And they blew the trumpet; and all the people said, God save king Solomon.

rr: Abantu boona baagyenda bamukuratiire, nibateera obunyamurera, nibashemererwa n'okushemererwa kwingi, n'ensi yaashatuka ahabw'akaari kaabo.
en: And all the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth rent with the sound of them.

rr: Adoniya n'abagyenyi boona abu yaabaire aine, ku baabaire nibaheza bati kurya, baakihurira.
en: And Adonijah and all the guests that were with him heard it as they had made an end of eating.

rr: Yoabu ku yaahuriire okugamba kw'eikondere, yaagira ati: Orwo rwari ruri omu rurembo n'orw'enki?
en: And when Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, Wherefore is this noise of the city being in an uproar?

rr: Ku yaabaire naakigamba, yaayecura Yonasaani mwene Abiasaari omunyamurwa; Adoniya yaamugira ati: Taaha omu nju, ahakuba ori omwesigwa, kandi oreetsire amakuru marungi.
en: And while he yet spake, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came: and Adonijah said unto him, Come in; for thou art a valiant man, and bringest good tidings.

rr: Yonasaani yaagarukamu Adoniya ati: Ngaaha! Mukama waitu omugabe Daudi yaayemeka Sulemaani
en: And Jonathan answered and said to Adonijah, Verily our lord king David hath made Solomon king.

rr: kandi omugabe yaamwohereza na Zadoki omunyamurwa, na Nasani nabi, na Benaaya mwene Yehoyaada, hamwe n'Abakeresi n'Abapelesi; baamutembya enyumbu y'omugabe
en: And the king hath sent with him Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and they have caused him to ride upon the king's mule:

en: and Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon: and they are come up from thence rejoicing, so that the city rang again.

rr: Ako niko kaari aku mwahurira.
en: This is the noise that ye have heard.

rr: Mbwenu Sulemaani ari aha kitebe ky'obugabe.
en: And also Solomon sitteth on the throne of the kingdom.

rr: Kandi abagaragwa b'omugabe baija kushabira mukama waitu omugabe Daudi mugisha, nibagira bati: Ruhanga waawe atunguure eiziina rya Sulemaani rirangaanwe okukira eryawe, kandi n'obugabe bwe abugire obwe'ekitiinisa okukira obwawe.
en: And moreover the king's servants came to bless our lord king David, saying, God make the name of Solomon better than thy name, and make his throne greater than thy throne.

rr: Bwanyima omugabe yainama aha kitanda kye, yaaramya.
en: And the king bowed himself upon the bed.

rr: Kandi omugabe yaagira ati: MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa Israeli, asiimwe, owampa omuntu ow'omu nda yangye kushutama aha kitebe kyangye ky'obugabe eri izooba, kandi n'amaisho gangye gakakireeba.
en: And also thus said the king, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, which hath given one to sit on my throne this day, mine eyes even seeing it .

rr: Bwanyima abagyenyi ba Adoniya boona baatiina, baimuka baagyenda, buri muntu yaatoora ogwe.
en: And all the guests that were with Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and went every man his way.

rr: Adoniya yaatiina Sulemaani; yaimuka, yaagyenda, yaakwata amahembe g'eitambiro.
en: And Adonijah feared because of Solomon, and arose, and went, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.

rr: Baagambira Sulemaani bati: Reeba, Adoniya atiinire omugabe Sulemaani; akwaitse amahembe g'eitambiro, naagira ati: Omugabe Sulemaani andahire eri izooba ku atarikwija kwita omwiru we na rurara.
en: And it was told Solomon, saying, Behold, Adonijah feareth king Solomon: for, lo, he hath caught hold on the horns of the altar, saying, Let king Solomon swear unto me to day that he will not slay his servant with the sword.

rr: Sulemaani yaagarukamu ati: ku araayeyorekye ari omushaija omwesigwa, tiharikwija kugira kashokye na kamwe ak'aha mutwe gwe akaagwa ahansi; kwonka ku araabonekiweho ekibi, naafa.
en: And Solomon said, If he will shew himself a worthy man, there shall not an hair of him fall to the earth: but if wickedness shall be found in him, he shall die.

rr: Obunaku bw'okufa kwa Daudi ku bwairiire haihi, yaayhangangiriza omutabani Sulemaani naamugira ati.
en: Now the days of David drew nigh that he should die; and he charged Solomon his son, saying,

rr: Ndi haihi kugyenda, nk'ab'ensi boona oku bagyenda. Ba ow'amaani, oyeyorekye ori omushaija
en: I go the way of all the earth: be thou strong therefore, and shew thyself a man;

rr: okwate ebi MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe arikukuragiira, okugyendera omu mihanda ye n'okukwata ebiragiro bye, n'ebi yaaragiire, n'ebyatairweho, kandi n'ebi yaahamize, nk'ebyahandiikirwe omu kitabo kya Musa oku biri, obone kuba gye omu bi orikukora byona, kandi n'ei oraagyende yoona
en: and keep the charge of the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and his testimonies, as it is written in the law of Moses, that thou mayest prosper in all that thou doest, and whithersoever thou turnest thyself:

rr: MUKAMA abone kuhamya ekigambo kye, eki yangambireho naagira ati: Abaana baawe ku baryerinda omu mitwarize yaabo, baagyendera omu maisho gangye omu mazima n'emitima yaabo yoona n'amagara gaabo goona, toribura oriza aha ngoma ya Israeli.
en: that the LORD may continue his word which he spake concerning me, saying, If thy children take heed to their way, to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail thee (said he) a man on the throne of Israel.

rr: Kandi noomanya oku Yoabu mwene Zeruiya yangizire, n'oku yaagizire abakuru babiri ab'amahe ga Israeli, Abuneeri, mwene Neeri, na Amasa mwene Yeseri, abu yaitsire naahoora enzigu, akasheesha eshagama omu biro by'obusingye nk'ori aha rugamba, akasiiga egyo shagama aha rukoba oru yaabaire ayezirikiise, n'aha nkaito ezi yaabaire ajwaire.
en: Moreover thou knowest also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, and what he did to the two captains of the hosts of Israel, unto Abner the son of Ner, and unto Amasa the son of Jether, whom he slew, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war upon his girdle that was about his loins, and in his shoes that were on his feet.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo otwaze nk'oku obwengye bwawe buri, kandi otarikiriza omutwe gwe gw'enju kushuuma okuzimu n'obusingye.
en: Do therefore according to thy wisdom, and let not his hoar head go down to the grave in peace.

rr: 2 -29 ; 19:31-38 . Kwonka oryagirira embabazi beene Baruzilai Omunyagileadi, babarirwe omu barikuriira aha meeza yaawe; ahakuba obu naabaire mpungire Abusalomu mwene sho, nikwo bangiriire.
en: But shew kindness unto the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be of those that eat at thy table: for so they came to me when I fled because of Absalom thy brother.

rr: Kandi reeba, hariho Shimei mwene Geera, Omubenyamiini owa Bahurimu, owankyeenire okukyeena kubi munonga aha izooba eri naagiiriireho Mahanaimu; kwonka akaija kuntangirira Yorudani, naamurahira MUKAMA nimmugira nti: Tindikwitsa rurara.
en: And, behold, thou hast with thee Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite of Bahurim, which cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim: but he came down to meet me at Jordan, and I sware to him by the LORD , saying, I will not put thee to death with the sword.

rr: Kwonka mbwenu otarimubara nk'otaine rubanja; ahakuba ori omushaija w'obwengye; oryamanya eki oshemereire kumukora; kandi oryashuumya omutwe gwe gw'enju okuzimu, guriho eshagama.
en: Now therefore hold him not guiltless: for thou art a wise man, and knowest what thou oughtest to do unto him; but his hoar head bring thou down to the grave with blood.

rr: Bwanyima Daudi yaagwejegyera, yaashanga baishenkuru, baamuziika omu rurembo rwa Daudi.
en: So David slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David.

rr: Emyaka ei Daudi yaamazire aha ngoma naategyeka Israeli ekahika makumi ana; emyaka mushanju akagitegyekyera Heburooni, kandi makumi ashatu n'eshatu, yaagitegyekyera Yerusaalemu.
en: And the days that David reigned over Israel were forty years: seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.

rr: Bwanyima Sulemaani yaashutama aha kitebe kya Daudi ishe; obugabe bwe bwahamibwa munonga. Sulemaani okwita Adoniya na Yoabu
en: Then sat Solomon upon the throne of David his father; and his kingdom was established greatly.

rr: Adoniya mwene Hagisi yaija ahari Batisheba nyina wa Sulemaani.
en: And Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bath-sheba the mother of Solomon.

rr: Batisheba yaamugira ati: Ni buhooro?
en: And she said, Comest thou peaceably?

rr: Onu yaamugarukamu ati: Ni buhooro.
en: And he said, Peaceably.

rr: Yaagaruka yaagira ati: Nyine eki ndikwenda kukugambira. Nyin'omugabe ati: Ngambira.
en: He said moreover, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And she said, Say on.

rr: 1 Yaamugira ati: Noomanya ku obugabe bwabaire buri obwangye, kandi Abaisraeli boona ku baabaire bantaireho amaisho, ngu mbategyekye; kwonka bwanyima kyahinduka bwaba obwa mwene tata, ahabw'okuba akabuheebwa MUKAMA.
en: And he said, Thou knowest that the kingdom was mine, and that all Israel set their faces on me, that I should reign: howbeit the kingdom is turned about, and is become my brother's: for it was his from the LORD .

rr: Mbwenu nyine eki ndikwenda kushaba; otakinyima. Onu yaamugarukamu ati: Kigambe.
en: And now I ask one petition of thee, deny me not. And she said unto him, Say on.

rr: Yaamugira ati: Nshabira omugabe Sulemaani, ahakuba tarikwija kukwangira, ampe Abishaagi owa Shuneemu, mmushwere.
en: And he said, Speak, I pray thee, unto Solomon the king, (for he will not say thee nay,) that he give me Abishag the Shunammite to wife.

rr: Betisheba yaamugarukamu ati: Eego, niinyija kumukugambirira.
en: And Bath-sheba said, Well; I will speak for thee unto the king.

rr: Atyo Betisheba yaaza ow'omugabe kumumugambirira.
en: Bath-sheba therefore went unto king Solomon, to speak unto him for Adonijah.

rr: Omugabe yaimuka kumubugana, yaamwinamira; bwanyima yaashutama aha kitebe kye ky'obugabe, yaaragiira ku bareetera nyina ekitebe, yaashutama aha rubaju rwe rwa buryo.
en: And the king rose up to meet her, and bowed himself unto her, and sat down on his throne, and caused a seat to be set for the king's mother; and she sat on his right hand.

rr: Yaamugira ati: Nyine ekintu kikye eki ndikwenda kukushaba; kandi otakinyima.
en: Then she said, I desire one small petition of thee; I pray thee , say me not nay.

rr: Omugabe yaamugira ati: Kinshabe, Mukaikuru wangye; tindikwija kukikwima.
en: And the king said unto her, Ask on, my mother: for I will not say thee nay.

rr: Onu ati: Mbwenu ninkushaba oikirize Abishaagi owa Shuneemu ashwerwe Adoniya mwene sho.
en: And she said, Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah thy brother to wife.

rr: Omugabe Sulemaani yaagarukamu nyina ati: Ahabw'enki nooshabira Adoniya Abishaagi owa Shuneemu? Mushabire nu n'obugabe; ahabw'okuba ni mukuru wangye; kandi shabira na Abiasaari omunyamurwa na Yoabu mwene Zeruiya.
en: And king Solomon answered and said unto his mother, And why dost thou ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? ask for him the kingdom also; for he is mine elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.

rr: Bwanyima omugabe Sulemaani yaarahira MUKAMA, naagira ati: Adoniya ku araabe atazizire eki kigambo, Ruhanga akinture n'okukiraho.
en: Then king Solomon sware by the LORD , saying, God do so to me, and more also, if Adonijah have not spoken this word against his own life.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo nindahira MUKAMA ohuriire, owantaireho, akaanyemeka omu mwanya gwa tata Daudi, kandi onyombekyeire eka nk'oku yaaraganiise, buzimazima eri izooba Adoniya naitwa.
en: Now therefore, as the LORD liveth, which hath established me, and set me on the throne of David my father, and who hath made me an house, as he promised, Adonijah shall be put to death this day.

rr: Atyo omugabe Sulemaani yaatuma Benaaya mwene Yehoyaada; yaamuteera yaafa.
en: And king Solomon sent by the hand of Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he fell upon him that he died.

rr: 1 -23 ; Kandi omugabe yaagira Abiasaari omunyamurwa ati: Irooko oze Anatoosi omu kibanja kyawe; ahakuba oshemereire kwitwa. Kwonka mbwenu tindikukwita, ahabw'eokuba okeekorera eshanduukye ya Mukama RUHANGA omu maisho ga tata Daudi, kandi okabonabona na tata omuri byona ebi yaabonabonesiibwemu.
en: And unto Abiathar the priest said the king, Get thee to Anathoth, unto thine own fields; for thou art worthy of death: but I will not at this time put thee to death, because thou barest the ark of the Lord GOD before David my father, and because thou hast been afflicted in all wherein my father was afflicted.

rr: 1 Atyo Sulemaani yaabinga Abiasaari omu bunyamurwa, ngu arekye kuba omunyamurwa wa MUKAMA; yaahikiiriza atyo ekigambo kya MUKAMA eki yaagambire ahari Eli omuri Shiilo.
en: So Solomon thrust out Abiathar from being priest unto the LORD ; that he might fulfil the word of the LORD , which he spake concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh.

rr: Egyo nkuru ku yaahikire Yoabu, yaahungira omu Ihema rya MUKAMA, yaakwata amahembe g'eitambiro; ahabw'okuba akaba akwataniise na Adoniya, n'obu araabe atarakwataniise na Abusalomu.
en: Then tidings came to Joab: for Joab had turned after Adonijah, though he turned not after Absalom. And Joab fled unto the tabernacle of the LORD , and caught hold on the horns of the altar.

rr: Kandi baagambira omugabe Sulemaani bati: Yoabu yaahungira omu Ihema rya MUKAMA; kandi reeba, ari aha itambiro.
en: And it was told king Solomon that Joab was fled unto the tabernacle of the LORD ; and, behold, he is by the altar.

rr: Sulemaani yaayohereza Benaaya mwene Yehoyaada, ati: Irooko omwite.
en: Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, Go, fall upon him.

rr: Atyo Benaaya yaahika aha Ihema rya MUKAMA, yaamugira ati: Omugabe yaagira ngu, Orugyeyo. Onu ati: Ngaaha! Ka ngwe aha. Benaaya yaagaruka yaagambira omugabe ati: Oku nikwo Yoabu yangira, kandi nikwo yangarukamu.
en: And Benaiah came to the tabernacle of the LORD , and said unto him, Thus saith the king, Come forth. And he said, Nay; but I will die here. And Benaiah brought the king word again, saying, Thus said Joab, and thus he answered me.

rr: Omugabe yaamugira ati: Okore nk'oku yaagamba; omwite, omuziikye, obone kwiha ahariinye n'aha nju ya tata orubanja rw'eshagama ei Yoabu yaaseeseire busha.
en: And the king said unto him, Do as he hath said, and fall upon him, and bury him; that thou mayest take away the innocent blood, which Joab shed, from me, and from the house of my father.

rr: MUKAMA naija kumuhoora, asheeshe eshagama ye, naamutura abantu babiri abu yaitsize rurara, omugurusi wangye Daudi atakimanyire, haza baabaire bari abantu abarikumukira oburungi n'okuhikiirira, nibo Abuneeri mwene Neeri, omukuru w'eihe rya Israeli, na Amasa mwene Yeseri, omukuru w'eihe rya Yuda.
en: And the LORD shall return his blood upon his own head, who fell upon two men more righteous and better than he, and slew them with the sword, my father David not knowing thereof, to wit , Abner the son of Ner, captain of the host of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, captain of the host of Judah.

en: And Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,

en: Now therefore command thou that they hew me cedar trees out of Lebanon; and my servants shall be with thy servants: and unto thee will I give hire for thy servants according to all that thou shalt appoint: for thou knowest that there is not among us any that can skill to hew timber like unto the Sidonians.

rr: Hiraamu, ku yaahuriire ebigambo bya Sulemaani, yaashemererwa munonga, yaagira ati: Eri izooba MUKAMA asiimwe, ahabw'okuha Daudi omwana w'obwengye kutegyeka eihanga eri erikuru.
en: And it came to pass, when Hiram heard the words of Solomon, that he rejoiced greatly, and said, Blessed be the LORD this day, which hath given unto David a wise son over this great people.

rr: Hiraamu yaatuma ahari Sulemaani ati: Mpuriire ebi ontumireho byona; niinyija kukora byona eby'emyereezi n'eby'emiberooshi, nk'oku orikwenda.
en: And Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, I have considered the things which thou sentest to me for: and I will do all thy desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning timber of fir.

en: Concerning this house which thou art in building, if thou wilt walk in my statutes, and execute my judgments, and keep all my commandments to walk in them; then will I perform my word with thee, which I spake unto David thy father:

en: and nets of checker work, and wreaths of chain work, for the chapiters which were upon the top of the pillars; seven for the one chapiter, and seven for the other chapiter.

rr: Kandi yaakora ebishushani by'ebijuma by'amakomamahanga; yaabyehinguririza obwo butimba omu mishorongo ebiri, kuza ahari ogwo mutwe ogw'aha nyomyo; yaatwza atyo n'ogw'aha ndiijo nyomyo.
en: And he made the pillars, and two rows round about upon the one network, to cover the chapiters that were upon the top, with pomegranates: and so did he for the other chapiter.

rr: Kandi emitwe ey'aha nyomyo z'ekisasi ekaba eri nk'ebirabyo by'emyangangye, oburaingwa bwayo mikono ena.
en: And the chapiters that were upon the top of the pillars were of lily work in the porch, four cubits.

rr: Emitwe egyo ekaba eri ahari ezo nyomyo, kandi ahaiguru y'engata ey'ahari buri nyomyo haihi n'obwo butimba; aho niho baahanikire ebishushani by'ebijuma by'amakomamahanga omu mishorongo ebiri; ebyo bijuma bikaba biri magana abiri.
en: And the chapiters upon the two pillars had pomegranates also above, over against the belly which was by the network: and the pomegranates were two hundred in rows round about upon the other chapiter.

rr: Atyo yaabyara ezo nyomyo omu maisho g'ekisasi kya hekalu, ey'aha rubaju rwa buryo yaagyeta Yakiini, n'ey'aha rwa bumosho yaagyeta Boazi.
en: And he set up the pillars in the porch of the temple: and he set up the right pillar, and called the name thereof Jachin: and he set up the left pillar, and called the name thereof Boaz.

rr: Aha mutwe gw'ezo nyomyo baakoraho ebishushani by'ebirabyo by'emyangangye. Okwo nikwo omurimo gw'ezo nyomyo gwahweire.
en: And upon the top of the pillars was lily work: so was the work of the pillars finished.

rr: 2 -5 ; Bwanyima yaakora ekitanka ky'amaizi ekikozirwe omu miringa eyagiibwe; kikaba kyezigore, okuruga aha mugoma okuhika aha gundi mikono ikumi, obwemi bwakyo mikono etaano, kandi okwehinguririza omugoma gwakyo mikono makumi ashatu.
en: And he made a molten sea, ten cubits from the one brim to the other: it was round all about, and his height was five cubits: and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.

rr: Kandi omu bugyenyero bwakyo hakaba hakiikiizemu ebishushani by'ebisisi biri omu mishorongo ebiri, biheesherainwe nakyo.
en: And under the brim of it round about there were knops compassing it, ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about: the knops were cast in two rows, when it was cast.

rr: Ekyo kitanka kikaba kiteekirwe aha bishushani by'enimi ikumi na ibiri, bishatu nibireeba aha bukiizbwa-bumosho, bishatu oburengyerwa-izooba, bishatu aha bwa-buryo, na bishatu aha burugwa-izooba; ekyo kitanka kiteekirwe ahaiguru yaabyo, biteeraine ebibunu.
en: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.

rr: Omubiri gwakyo gukaba guri ekita kimwe; eminwa yaakyo ekaba ekozirwe nk'ey'ekikopo, nari nk'ey'ekirabyo ky'emyangangye; nikigiibwamu encuro enkumi ibiri z'ebunyungu bihango.
en: And it was an hand breadth thick, and the brim thereof was wrought like the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies: it contained two thousand baths.

rr: Yaakora ebitebe ikumi omu miringa; ekitebe kimwe oburaingwa bwakyo mikono ena, obuhango bwakyo mikono ena, n'obwemi bwakyo mikono eshatu.
en: And he made ten bases of brass; four cubits was the length of one base, and four cubits the breadth thereof, and three cubits the height of it.

rr: Oku nikwo ebyo bitebe byabaire bikozirwe; bikaba biine ebiremu ebishensheize omu mbaaho zaabyo.
en: And the work of the bases was on this manner: they had borders, and the borders were between the ledges:

rr: Ahari ebyo biremu ebishensheize omuri ezo mbaaho hakaba hasharwirweho ebishushani by'entare, n'eby'enimi, n'ebya baakerubi; kandi ahari ezo mbaaho, ahaiguru n'ahansi y'ebishushani by'entare n'enimi, hasharwirweho ebitaako.
en: and on the borders that were between the ledges were lions, oxen, and cherubims: and upon the ledges there was a base above: and beneath the lions and oxen were certain additions made of thin work.

rr: Kandi buri kitebe kikaba kiine enziga ina z'emiringa, n'ebyoma ebirikuhindukirwaho ezo nziga; nabyo biri eby'emiringa; kandi aha nshonda zaakyo ina hariho ebirikuhamya ekinaabiro. Ebirikuhamya ebyo bikaba biheesherainwe n'ebitaako aha rubaju rwa buri kimwe.
en: And every base had four brasen wheels, and plates of brass: and the four corners thereof had undersetters: under the laver were undersetters molten, at the side of every addition.

rr: Kandi ekyo kitebe kikaba kiine omugoma aha munwa gwakyo, obwemi bwagwo mikono gumwe n'ekicweka; ahari ogwo mugoma bakaba bagyenyireho; kandi ebiremu byabyo bikaba nibingana embaju zoona biteebumburukire.
en: And the mouth of it within the chapiter and above was a cubit: but the mouth thereof was round after the work of the base, a cubit and an half: and also upon the mouth of it were gravings with their borders, foursquare, not round.

rr: Ezo nziga ina ziri ahansi y'ebyo biremu, n'ebirikuhindukirwaho enziga biheesherainwe n'ekyo kitebe; obwemi bw'enziga emwe bukaba buri mukono gumwe n'ekicweka.
en: And under the borders were four wheels; and the axletrees of the wheels were joined to the base: and the height of a wheel was a cubit and half a cubit.

rr: Enziga ezo zikaba nizishusha nk'ez'ebigaari by'orugamba; ebyoma byazo ebi zirikwehinduriraho, n'ebyoma byazo by'enziga, n'enyomyo zaazo, n'emigongo yaazo, n'engata zaazo, byona bikozirwe omu miringa eyagiibwe.
en: And the work of the wheels was like the work of a chariot wheel: their axletrees, and their naves, and their felloes, and their spokes, were all molten.

rr: Aha nshonda zoona ina eza buri kitebe hakaba hariho ebirikuhamya bina biheesherainwe nakyo.
en: And there were four undersetters to the four corners of one base: and the undersetters were of the very base itself.

rr: Aha mutwe gwa buri kitebe hakaba hariho ekintu kyebumburikire, obwemi bwakyo ekicweka kya mukono gumwe, kandi enyomyo zaakyo n'ebiremu byakyo bikwataine.
en: And in the top of the base was there a round compass of half a cubit high: and on the top of the base the ledges thereof and the borders thereof were of the same.

rr: Ahari ezo nyomyo n'ebyo biremu yaasharuraho ebishushani bya baakerubi n'eby'entare n'eby'emikindo, nk'omwanya gwa buri kimwe oku gwabaire guri, yaakitaho ekitaako okukyehinguririza.
en: For on the plates of the ledges thereof, and on the borders thereof, he graved cherubims, lions, and palm trees, according to the proportion of every one, and additions round about.

rr: Okwo nikwo yaakozire ebitebe ikumi; byona bikaba biheesirwe omu muringo gumwe, biri orugyero rumwe, kandi nibishushana.
en: After this manner he made the ten bases: all of them had one casting, one measure, and one size.

rr: Bwanyima yaakora ebinaabiro ikumi by'emiringa; buri kinaabiro nikigiibwamu amaizi g'ebinyungu bihango makumi ana; buri kimwe kiine oburaingwa bwa mikono ena; byona ikumi buri kinaabiro kyagira ekitebe kyakyo.
en: Then made he ten lavers of brass: one laver contained forty baths: and every laver was four cubits: and upon every one of the ten bases one laver.

rr: Yaata ebitebe bitaano aha rubaju rw'obukiizi-bwa-buryo obw'egyo nju, n'ebindi bitaano aha bukiizi-bwa-bumosho. Kandi ekitanka yaakita aha nshonda y'orubaju rwa buryo orw'oburugwa-izooba bw'egyo nju.
en: And he put five bases on the right side of the house, and five on the left side of the house: and he set the sea on the right side of the house eastward over against the south.

rr: 2 —5:1; . Kandi Hiraamu yaakora ebinaabiro n'ebyoma by'okuyooza eiju, n'enyungu. Okwo nikwo Hiraamu yaaherize omurimo ogu yaabaire naakorera omugabe Sulemaani aha nju ya MUKAMA
en: And Hiram made the lavers, and the shovels, and the basons. So Hiram made an end of doing all the work that he made king Solomon for the house of the LORD :

rr: 1 enyomyo ibiri, enyabya ibiri, emitwe y'aha mitwe y'enyomyo, n'obutimba bw'okushweka enyabya ibiri ez'aha mitwe eyaabaire eri ahari ezo nyomyo
en: the two pillars, and the two bowls of the chapiters that were on the top of the two pillars; and the two networks, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters which were upon the top of the pillars;

rr: n'ebishushani by'ebijuma by'amakomamahanga eby'okuhunda ha butimba bwombi, emishorongo ebiri ahari buri katimba, kushweka ahari ezo nyabya eziri ha mitwe y'enyomyo
en: and four hundred pomegranates for the two networks, even two rows of pomegranates for one network, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters that were upon the pillars;

rr: ebitebe ikumi n'ebinaabiro ikumi ebyabaire biri ahari ebyo bitebe
en: and the ten bases, and ten lavers on the bases;

rr: ekitanka kimwe n'ebishushani by'enimi ikumi na ibiri, ebyabaire biri ahansi yaakyo.
en: and one sea, and twelve oxen under the sea;

rr: Kandi ezo nyungu n'ebyoma by'okuyoora eiju n'ebinaabiro, ebyo bintu byona ebi Hiraamu yaakoreire omugabe Sulemaani ahabw'enju ya MUKAMA, akabikora omu miringa ekuubirwe.
en: and the pots, and the shovels, and the basons: and all these vessels, which Hiram made to king Solomon for the house of the LORD , were of bright brass.

rr: Omugabe akaba abiyagiza omu ruhita rwa Yorudani ahaabaire haine eitaka ry'eibumba ahagati ya Sukoosi na Zaretaani.
en: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarthan.

rr: Kandi Sulemaani tareeruhize kupima ebyo bintu byona, ahabw'okuba bikaba biri bingi munonga; n'ahabw'ekyo oburemeezi bw'emiringa tiburamanyirwe.
en: And Solomon left all the vessels unweighed , because they were exceeding many: neither was the weight of the brass found out.

rr: -29 ; Atyo Sulemaani yaakora ebintu byona eby'omu nju ya MUKAMA; eitambiro ry'ezaabu, emeeza y'ezaabu ey'emigaati y'okumurikwa
en: And Solomon made all the vessels that pertained unto the house of the LORD : the altar of gold, and the table of gold, whereupon the shewbread was ,

rr: eby'okutaho amatabaaza by'ezaabu eshemeziibwe bitaano aha rubaju rwa buryo n'ebindi bitaano aha rwa bumosho omu maisho g'Omwanya ogurikwera ogw'omunda. Yaakora ebirabyo, amatabaaza n'empana eby'ezaabu
en: and the candlesticks of pure gold, five on the right side , and five on the left, before the oracle, with the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs of gold,

rr: ebikopo, makansi, enyabya, esohaani z'obubaane, n'eby'okuguhisa omuriro by'ezaabu eshemeziibwe, epata z'enyigi ez'ekishengye ky'omunda eky'Omwanya ogurikwera munonga, kandi ez'enyigi z'ekishengye kya hekalu, zikaba ziri ez'ezaabu.
en: and the bowls, and the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers of pure gold; and the hinges of gold, both for the doors of the inner house, the most holy place, and for the doors of the house, to wit , of the temple. The Dedication

rr: Okwo nikwo omurimo gwona, ogu omugabe Sulemaani yaakozire aha nju ya MUKAMA gwahweire.
en: So was ended all the work that king Solomon made for the house of the LORD .

rr: Bwanyima Sulemaani yaataasyamu ebintu ebi Daudi ishe yaabaire ashoroire, efeeza, ezaabu, n'ebindi bintu; yaabita omu mabiikiro g'enju ya MUKAMA.
en: And Solomon brought in the things which David his father had dedicated; even the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, did he put among the treasures of the house of the LORD .

rr: 2 -10 ; . Bwanyima Sulemaani yaateeranira hamwe abakuru ba Israeli n'abakuru b'enganda boona, abakuru b'emiryango ya baishenkurubo, baateeranira Yerusaalemu omu maisho ga Sulemaani, kwinamura eshanduukye y'endagaano ya MUKAMA nibagiiha omu rurembo rwa Daudi, Saayuuni.
en: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel, unto king Solomon in Jerusalem, that they might bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the city of David, which is Zion.

rr: 2 -10 ; . Abashaija boona Abaisraeli baateeranira ow'omugabe Sulemaani omu kwezi kwa Etanimu, nikwo kwezi kwa mushanju, baizire aha bugyenyi.
en: And all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto king Solomon at the feast in the month Ethanim, which is the seventh month.

rr: Abakuru ba Israeli boona baija, abanyamurwa baakiriza eshanduukye.
en: And all the elders of Israel came, and the priests took up the ark.

rr: Bainamura egyo shanduukye ya MUKAMA, n'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu, n'ebintu byona ebirikwera ebyabaire biri omuri eryo ihema; abanyamurwa n'Abaleevi baabitwara.
en: And they brought up the ark of the LORD , and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle, even those did the priests and the Levites bring up.

rr: Kandi omugabe Sulemaani n'eihanga ryona ery'Abaisraeli, abaabaire bateeraniire omu maisho ge, bakaba bari hamwe nawe omu maisho g'eshanduukye, nibatamba ebitambo by'entaama n'ente, ezitarikubaasa kubarwa ahabw'obwingi.
en: And king Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel, that were assembled unto him, were with him before the ark, sacrificing sheep and oxen, that could not be told nor numbered for multitude.

rr: Bwanyima abanyamurwa baareeta eshanduukye y'endagaano ya MUKAMA, baagita omu mwanya gwayo, omu mwanya ogurikwera ogw'omunda omuri hekalu, aharikwetwa Aharikwera munonga, ahansi y'amapapa g'ebishushani bya baakerubi.
en: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the LORD unto his place, into the oracle of the house, to the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubims.

rr: Ahabw'okuba ebyo bishushani bya baakerubi bikaba bishashaanwire amapapa gaabyo ahaiguru y'omwanya gw'okutamu eshanduukye; amapapa gaabyo gaashweka eshanduukye n'emigamba yaayo.
en: For the cherubims spread forth their two wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.

rr: Kandi emigamba ekaba eri miraingwa munonga; n'ahabw'ekyo emitwe yaayo ekaba ereebekyera omu mwanya ogurikwera oguri omu maisho g'Omwanya ogurikwera ogw'omunda; kwonka ekaba etarikubaasa kureeberwa aheeru; kandi na hati ekiriyo.
en: And they drew out the staves, that the ends of the staves were seen out in the holy place before the oracle, and they were not seen without: and there they are unto this day.

rr: Omuri egyo shanduukye tihaine kindi ekyabaire kibamu kureka ebishate by'amabaare bibiri, ebi Musa yaateereiremu ha rushozi Horebu, n'Abaisraeli endagaano, nibaruga omu nsi ya Misri.
en: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables of stone, which Moses put there at Horeb, when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of the land of Egypt.

rr: Bwanyima abanyamurwa ku baarugire omu Mwanya ogurikwera, ekicu kyaijura enju ya MUKAMA
en: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy place , that the cloud filled the house of the LORD ,

rr: batyo abanyamurwa tibaabaasa kwemereramu kuheereza ahabw'ekyo kicu; ahabw'okuba ekitiinisa kya MUKAMA kikaba kiijwire enju ye.
en: so that the priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud: for the glory of the LORD had filled the house of the LORD .

rr: 2 Bwanyima Sulemaani yaagira ati: MUKAMA akagira ati: Ndyaguma omu mwirima ndindindi.
en: Then spake Solomon, The LORD said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.

rr: Buzimazima nkwombekyeire enju y'ekitiinisa, omwanya gwawe gw'okutuuramu ebiro n'ebiro.
en: I have surely built thee an house to dwell in, a settled place for thee to abide in for ever.

rr: Omugabe yaahindukira eihanga ryona ery'Abaisraeli beemereire, yaabashabira omugisha
en: And the king turned his face about, and blessed all the congregation of Israel: (and all the congregation of Israel stood;)

rr: naagira ati: MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli asiimwe, owaahikiiriza n'omukono gwe eki yaaraganiise tata Daudi n'akanwa ke, naagira ati
en: and he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, which spake with his mouth unto David my father, and hath with his hand fulfilled it , saying,

rr: -16 , Okwiha obu naiha abantu bangye omuri Misri, tinkatooranaga rurembo kwombekamu enju, ngu eiziina ryangye ribe nimwo ryaguma; kureka nkatoorana Daudi kutegyeka abantu bangye Israeli.
en: Since the day that I brought forth my people Israel out of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build an house, that my name might be therein; but I chose David to be over my people Israel.

rr: Mbwenu kikaba kiri omu mutima gwa tata Daudi kwombekyera eiziina rya MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli enju.
en: And it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.

rr: Kwonka MUKAMA yaagira tata Daudi ati: Obaire okozire gye ahabw'enaama ei obaire oine kwombekyera eiziina ryangye enju.
en: And the LORD said unto David my father, Whereas it was in thine heart to build an house unto my name, thou didst well that it was in thine heart.

rr: Kwonka tiiwe oryombeka egyo nju, kureka mutabani waawe ou orizaara, niwe aryombekyera eiziina ryangye enju.
en: Nevertheless thou shalt not build the house; but thy son that shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house unto my name.

rr: Mbwenu MUKAMA yaahikiiriza eki yaaraganiise; ahabw'okuba naaza omu mwanya gwa tata Daudi, naagaruka aha kitebe ky'obugabe bwa Israeli, nk'oku MUKAMA yaaraganiise; kandi nyombekire egi nju ahabw'eiziina rya MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli.
en: And the LORD hath performed his word that he spake, and I am risen up in the room of David my father, and sit on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.

rr: Omwo nimwo ntaire omwanya ahabw'eshanduukye, erimu endagaano ya MUKAMA, ei yaaragaine na baatatenkuriitwe obu yaabaiha omu nsi ya Misri.
en: And I have set there a place for the ark, wherein is the covenant of the LORD , which he made with our fathers, when he brought them out of the land of Egypt.

rr: Okushaba kwa Sulemaani
en: Solomon's Prayer

rr: Atyo Sulemaani yaayemerera omu maisho g'eitambiro rya MUKAMA, eihanga ryona ery'Abaisraeli riri aho, yaimutsya emikono ye ahaiguru
en: And Solomon stood before the altar of the LORD in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven:

rr: yaagira ati: Ai MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli, tihariho ruhanga omu iguru ahaiguru n'omu nsi ahansi orikushushana naiwe, omu kurinda endagaano, n'omu kugirira embabazi abairu baawe abarikugyendera omu maisho gaawe n'emitima yaabo yoona
en: and he said, LORD God of Israel, there is no God like thee, in heaven above, or on earth beneath, who keepest covenant and mercy with thy servants that walk before thee with all their heart:

rr: kandi okahamya eki waaraganiise omwiru waawe tata Daudi; nk'oku waagambire n'akanwa kaawe, mbwenu waakihikiiriza n'omukono gwawe eri izooba.
en: who hast kept with thy servant David my father that thou promisedst him: thou spakest also with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled it with thine hand, as it is this day.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo hati, MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli, hamya eki waaraganiise omwiru waawe tata Daudi, noogira oti: Batabani baawe ku barigira emicwe mirungi, baagyendera omu maisho gangye nk'oku waabaire ogyenderamu, tiharibura muntu w'okushutama aha kitebe ky'ogabe bwa Israeli.
en: Therefore now, LORD God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that thou promisedst him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel; so that thy children take heed to their way, that they walk before me as thou hast walked before me.

rr: Mbwenu hati, Ruhanga wa Israeli, ninkweshengyereza ekigambo kyawe eki waagambiire omwiru waawe tata Daudi okihamye.
en: And now, O God of Israel, let thy word, I pray thee, be verified, which thou spakest unto thy servant David my father.

rr: Beitu kwo, n'eky'amazima Ruhanga aryatuura omu nsi? Reeba eiguru, nangwa n'eiguru eririkukirira kimwe kuba ahaiguru y'agandi torikubaasa kuhikamu; kaashwa egi nju ei nyombekire!
en: But will God indeed dwell on the earth? behold, the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house that I have builded?

rr: kwonka MUKAMA Ruhanga wangye, ta omutima aha kushanba n'okweshengyereza kw'omwiru waawe, noohurira okutaka kwe n'okushaba oku arikushaba omu maisho gaawe eri izooba.
en: Yet have thou respect unto the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O LORD my God, to hearken unto the cry and to the prayer, which thy servant prayeth before thee to day:

rr: obone kuguma otaire amaisho gaawe ahari egi nju nyomushana na nyekiro, omu mwanya ogu waagizire oti: Eiziina ryangye nimwo ririguma; obone kuguma noohurira okushaba oku omwiru waawe araagume naashaba naareeba omwanya ogu.
en: that thine eyes may be open toward this house night and day, even toward the place of which thou hast said, My name shall be there: that thou mayest hearken unto the prayer which thy servant shall make toward this place.

rr: Kandi ogume ohurire okweshengyereza kw'omwiru waawe n'okw'abantu baawe Abaisraeli, oku bariguma nibakushaba, nibareeba omwanya ogu; ogume ohurire ori omu iguru, omu mwanya gwawe ogu otuuramu; kandi ku oraahurire, osaasire.
en: And hearken thou to the supplication of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, when they shall pray toward this place: and hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place: and when thou hearest, forgive.

rr: Omuntu ku arikora ekibi ahari mutaahi we, baamurahiza, nawe yaija yaarahirira omu maisho g'eitambiro ryawe omu nju egi
en: If any man trespass against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to cause him to swear, and the oath come before thine altar in this house:

rr: ohurire ori omu iguru, ogire eki waakora, ocwere abairu baawe emanja, zisingye okozire kubi, aturwe okutahikiirira kwe, oihe orubanja ahari ohikiriire, omuzimuurire nk'okuhikiirira kwe oku kuri.
en: then hear thou in heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, condemning the wicked, to bring his way upon his head; and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.

rr: Kandi abantu baawe Abaisraeli ku baribingwa abazigu baabo ahabw'okukucumuraho, bwanyima baakuhindukira, baikiriza eiziina ryawe, baakushaba nibeeshengyerereza omu nju egi
en: When thy people Israel be smitten down before the enemy, because they have sinned against thee, and shall turn again to thee, and confess thy name, and pray, and make supplication unto thee in this house:

rr: ohurire ori omu iguru ryawe, osaasire abantu baawe Abaisraeli ekibi kyabo, obagarure omu nsi ei waahaire baishenkurubo.
en: then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest unto their fathers.

en: Blessed be the LORD thy God, which delighted in thee, to set thee on the throne of Israel: because the LORD loved Israel for ever, therefore made he thee king, to do judgment and justice.

en: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices very great store, and precious stones: there came no more such abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon.

rr: Kandi n'eigana rye'emeeri za Hiraamu, ezaabaire zireeta ezaabu za Ofira, zikareeta n'embaaho z'alumuugi nyingi munonga, n'amabaare g'obuguzi bwingi.
en: And the navy also of Hiram, that brought gold from Ophir, brought in from Ophir great plenty of almug trees, and precious stones.

rr: Ezo mbaaho z'alumuugi omugabe yaazibaijamu enyomyo z'enju ya MUKAMA n'eye, kandi yaazibaijamu endongo n'enanga ahabw'abeeshongozi; tihariho biti by'alumuugi ebyagarukire kureetwa nari okureebwa ebiri nk'ebyo n'okuhitsya hati.
en: And the king made of the almug trees pillars for the house of the LORD , and for the king's house, harps also and psalteries for singers: there came no such almug trees, nor were seen unto this day.

rr: Omugabe Sulemaani yaaha omugabekazi wa Sheeba ebi yaabaire naayenda byona, n'ebi yaashabire byona, otabariiremu bi Sulemaani yaamuhaisize obufura nk'omugabe.
en: And king Solomon gave unto the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty.

rr: Bwanyima yaakuba, yaagaruka omu nsi ye n'abagaragwa be.
en: So she turned and went to her own country, she and her servants.

rr: Obutungi bwa Sulemaani
en: Wealth and Splendour

rr: 2 Ezaabu eyaabaire ereetwa owa Sulemaani buri mwaka ekaba eba etalanta magana mukaaga na makumi mukaaga na mukaaga
en: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred threescore and six talents of gold,

rr: otabariiremu eyaabaire eruga omu bashuubuzi n'enshaagi ezaabaire ziruga omu batungi n'abagabe boona ba Buharabu, n'abategyeki b'omu nsi egyo.
en: beside that he had of the merchantmen, and of the traffick of the spice merchants, and of all the kings of Arabia, and of the governors of the country.

rr: Omugabe Sulemaani yaaheeshesa engabo z'ezaabu magana abiri, engabo emwe neeheeshwa omu zaabu ya shekeli magana mukaaga.
en: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred shekels of gold went to one target.

rr: Kandi yaaheeshesa engabo nkye magana ashatu z'ezaabu; miina ishatu z'ezaabu niziheeshwamu engabo emwe; omugabe yaazita omu nu y'ekibira kya Lebanooni.
en: And he made three hundred shields of beaten gold; three pound of gold went to one shield: and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.

rr: Kandi yaabaijesa ekibebe kihango ky'obugabe omu miino y'enjojo, yaakishweka ezaabu eshemeziibwe.
en: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the best gold.

rr: Ekyo kitebe ky'omugabe kikaba kiine amatembero mukaaga; kandi enyima yaakyo hariyo ekishushani ky'omutwe gw'enyana; ahari buri rubaju rw'ekyo kitebe hariho ah'okuta emikono, n'ebishushani bibiri by'entare, kimwe aha rubaju rumwe, n'ekindi aha rundi rubaju
en: The throne had six steps, and the top of the throne was round behind: and there were stays on either side on the place of the seat, and two lions stood beside the stays.

rr: kandi n'ebindi bishushani by'entare ikumi na bibiri byemereire bibiri bibiri ahari buri itembero ahari ago matembero mukaaga, kimwe aha rubaju rumwe rwaryo, n'ekindi aha rundi. Omu bugabe obundi bwona tihariho kitebe ekyabaire nikishushana nakyo.
en: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps: there was not the like made in any kingdom.

rr: Eby'okunywaisa byona eby'omugabe Sulemaani bikaba biri eby'ezaabu, n'ebintu byona eby'omu nju y'ekibira kya Lebanooni bikaba biri eby'ezaabu eshemeziibwe; tihariho kintu na kimwe ekyabaire kikozirwe omu feeza, ahabw'okuba omu biro bya Sulemaani efeeza ekaba etarikubarwa kuba ekintu.
en: And all king Solomon's drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold; none were of silver: it was nothing accounted of in the days of Solomon.

rr: Ahakuba omugabe akaba aine eigana ry'emeeri aha nyanja ya Tarushiishi hamwe n'erya Hiraamu. Omurundi gumwe omu myaka eshatu, ago magana g'emeeri gakaba gaija gareetsire ezaabu, efeeza, emiino y'enjojo, enkobe na zaanyamunyonyi.
en: For the king had at sea a navy of Tharshish with the navy of Hiram: once in three years came the navy of Tharshish, bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.

rr: Okwo nikwo omugabe Sulemaani yaakirize abagabe boona ab'omu nsi obutungi n'obwengye.
en: So king Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth for riches and for wisdom.

rr: Abantu boona ab'omu nsi bakaba beetenga kureeba Sulemaani, ngu bahurire obwengye bwe, obu Ruhanga yaamuhaire.
en: And all the earth sought to Solomon, to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.

rr: Kandi weena owaabaire aija akaba areeta omutoijo, ebintu by'efeeza nari eby'ezaabu, ebijwaro, eby'okurwanisa, emigaju, embaraasi n'enyumbu; ebyo byona nikwo byabaire biija buri mwaka.
en: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and garments, and armour, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.

rr: 1 Kandi Sulemaani akateeranira hamwe ebigaari n'abarikugyendera aha mbaraasi; ebigaari bye byaba rukumi na magana ana, n'abarikugyendera aha mbaraasi kakumi n'enkumi ibiri; yaabata omu ndembo z'ebigaari n'omuri Yerusaalemu ahu yaabaire ari.
en: And Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, whom he bestowed in the cities for chariots, and with the king at Jerusalem.

rr: Omugabe yaareetera Yerusaalemu okugira efeeza nyingi nk'amabaare, n'ebiti by'emyereezi byaba nk'emisikamoori y'omu mpita.
en: And the king made silver to be in Jerusalem as stones, and cedars made he to be as the sycomore trees that are in the vale, for abundance.

rr: Embaraasi ezi Sulemaani yaabaire aine bakaba baziiha omuri Misri; abashuubuzi b'omugabe bakaba bazigura omu busyo, buri busyo bwine obuguzi bwabwo.
en: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king's merchants received the linen yarn at a price.

rr: Kandi ekigaari kikaba kiihwa Misri ahabwa shekeli z'efeeza magana mukaaga, n'embaraasi ahari igana na makumi ataano; kandi abashuubuzi ku baabaire bazireeta, baziguza abagabe boona ab'Abahiiti n'ab'Abasiria.
en: And a chariot came up and went out of Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, did they bring them out by their means.
