rr: Bwanyima omugabe Sulemaani yaakunda abakazi baingi b'endugamahanga; muhara wa Faraho, Abamoabukazi, Abaamonikazi, Abanyaedomukazi, Abasidonikazi n'Abahiitikazi
en: But king Solomon loved many strange women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh, women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Zidonians, and Hittites;

rr: abaarugire omu mahanga agu MUKAMA yaagambiire Abaisraeli naagira ati: Mutarishwererana nabo; ahakuba buzimazima baryahindura emitima yaanyu, mukuratire baaruhanga baabo. Kwonka Sulemaani ahabw'okubakunda yaababaho akaramata.
en: of the nations concerning which the LORD said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall not go in to them, neither shall they come in unto you: for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods: Solomon clave unto these in love.

rr: Akaba aine abakazi magana mushanju abanyiginyakazi, n'ebinyansunju magana ashatu; abakazi be abo baahindura omutima gwe.
en: And he had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines: and his wives turned away his heart.

rr: Ahakuba Sulemaani ku yaakuzire, baahindura omutima gwe, yaakuratira baaruhanga abandi; ahabw'okuba omutima gwe tigurabeereire kimwe gw'amazima ahari MUKAMA Ruhanga we nk'ogwa Daudi ishe.
en: For it came to pass, when Solomon was old, that his wives turned away his heart after other gods: and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as was the heart of David his father.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo Sulemaani akakuratira Ashitaroosi ruhanga-omukazi ow'Abasidoni, na Milikomu ekihagaro eky'Abaamoni.
en: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.

rr: Atyo Sulemaani yaakora ebirikwangwa MUKAMA, tiyaakuratirira kimwe MUKAMA nk'oku Daudi ishe yaakozire.
en: And Solomon did evil in the sight of the LORD , and went not fully after the LORD , as did David his father.

rr: 2 -4 ; . Bwanyima Sulemaani yaayombekyera Kemoshi ekihagaro kya Moabu, na Moleki ekihagaro ky'Abaamoni omwanya gw'okuramizamu aha kabungo k'oburugwa-izooba bwa Yerusaalemu.
en: Then did Solomon build an high place for Chemosh, the abomination of Moab, in the hill that is before Jerusalem, and for Molech, the abomination of the children of Ammon.

rr: Kandi nikwo yaakoreire atyo abakazi be boona ab'endugamahanga, abaabaire bootera obubaane, bakatambira baaruhanga baabo. Ruhanga okuhana Sulemaani
en: And likewise did he for all his strange wives, which burnt incense and sacrificed unto their gods.

rr: Kandi MUKAMA yaagirira Sulemaani ekiniga, ahabw'okuba omutima gwe gukaba gurugire ahari MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli, owaabaire amweyorekire kabiri
en: And the LORD was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned from the LORD God of Israel, which had appeared unto him twice,

rr: kandi amuragiire naamwehanangiriza aha kintu eki, kutakuratira baaruhanga abandi; kwonka tiyaakora nk'oku MUKAMA yaamuragiire.
en: and had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods: but he kept not that which the LORD commanded.

rr: Nikyo MUKAMA yaagiriire Sulemaani ati: Nk'oku okozire eki, okiihire aha mutima, okanga kurinda endagaano n'ebyatairweho ebi naakuragiire, buzimazima niinyija kukwaka obugabe bwawe, mbuhe omugaragwa waawe.
en: Wherefore the LORD said unto Solomon, Forasmuch as this is done of thee, and thou hast not kept my covenant and my statutes, which I have commanded thee, I will surely rend the kingdom from thee, and will give it to thy servant.

rr: Kwonka ahabwa sho Daudi tindikikora omu biro byawe, ndyabwaka mutabani waawe.
en: Notwithstanding in thy days I will not do it for David thy father's sake: but I will rend it out of the hand of thy son.

rr: Kandi tindibumwaka bwona, kureka ndyamuhaho oruganda rumwe ahabw'omwiru wangye Daudi, n'ahabwa Yerusaalemu ei naayetooraniire. Okufa kwa Sulemaani
en: Howbeit I will not rend away all the kingdom; but will give one tribe to thy son for David my servant's sake, and for Jerusalem's sake which I have chosen.

rr: MUKAMA yaimukiza Sulemaani omuzigu w'okumurwanisa, orikwetwa Hadadi Omunyaedomu, owaabaire ari ow'omu ruganda rw'obugabe bwa Edomu.
en: And the LORD stirred up an adversary unto Solomon, Hadad the Edomite: he was of the king's seed in Edom.

rr: Ahakuba Daudi ku yaabaire ari Edomu, Yoabu owaabaire ari omukuru w'engabo yaimuka yaaza kuziika abaitsirwe, yaita oyetwa omushaija weena omuri Edomu
en: For it came to pass, when David was in Edom, and Joab the captain of the host was gone up to bury the slain, after he had smitten every male in Edom;

rr: (ahakuba Yoabu n'Abaisraeli boona bakamarayo ameezi mukaaga, okuhitsya obu yaacwekyereize oyetwa omushaija weena omuri Edomu)
en: (for six months did Joab remain there with all Israel, until he had cut off every male in Edom:)

rr: kwonka Hadadi yaahungira Misri n'abamwe aha Banyaedomu abaabaire bari abairu ba ishe, we akiri muto.
en: that Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father's servants with him, to go into Egypt; Hadad being yet a little child.

rr: Batyo baaruga Midiani, baahika Parani, baihayo abashaija, baabatwara, baaza Misri owa Faraho omugabe wa Misri, Faraho yaamuha enju, n'ab'okumutoijera eby'okurya, kandi yaamuha n'obutaka.
en: And they arose out of Midian, and came to Paran: and they took men with them out of Paran, and they came to Egypt, unto Pharaoh king of Egypt; which gave him an house, and appointed him victuals, and gave him land.

rr: Hadadi ogwo yaagira obushongore bwingi ahari Faraho, ekyarugiremu yaamuhingira muramu we, murumuna wa Tapeneesi omukazi we nyeiteeka.
en: And Hadad found great favour in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him to wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.

rr: Murumuna wa Tapeneesi yaamuzaarira omwana w'omwojo orikwetwa Genubaasi, ou Tapeneesi yaacuukiize omu ka ya Faraho n'abaana be.
en: And the sister of Tahpenes bare him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh's house: and Genubath was in Pharaoh's household among the sons of Pharaoh.

rr: Kwonka Hadadi ku yaabaire ari Misri, yaahurira ngu Daudi agwejegyeire, yaashaga baishenkuru, kandi ngu na Yoabu omukuru w'eihe afiire, Hadadi yaagira Faraho ati: Reka ngyende, ngarukye omu ihanga ryaitu.
en: And when Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers, and that Joab the captain of the host was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, Let me depart, that I may go to mine own country.

rr: Kwonka Faraho yaamubuuza at: Waaza kwenda kugaruka owaanyu mbuzire ki?
en: Then Pharaoh said unto him, But what hast thou lacked with me, that, behold, thou seekest to go to thine own country?

rr: Onu yaamugarukamu ati: Tikiriho; kwona fa okundeka ngyende.
en: And he answered, Nothing: howbeit let me go in any wise.

rr: Kandi Ruhanga yaagaruka yaamwimukiza omuzigu orikwetwa Rezoni mwene Eliada, owaabaire acwire hari mukama we Hadadezeeri omugabe wa Zooba.
en: And God stirred him up another adversary, Rezon the son of Eliadah, which fled from his lord Hadadezer king of Zobah:

rr: Daudi ku yaabaire aherize kwita aba Zooba, Rezoni yaateerana hamwe abantu, yaaba omwebembezi w'omutwe gw'abambuzi; baataha Damasiko, baatuurayo, bwanyima baamugira omugabe omuri Damasiko.
en: and he gathered men unto him, and became captain over a band, when David slew them of Zobah: and they went to Damascus, and dwelt therein, and reigned in Damascus.

rr: Yaaba omuzigu w'Abaisraeli ebiro byona ebya Sulemaani, naakora kubi nka Hadadi, naayangira kimwe Israeli, kandi naategyeka Siria.
en: And he was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon, beside the mischief that Hadad did: and he abhorred Israel, and reigned over Syria.

rr: Yeroboamu okuragurwaho ku aritwara obugabe bwa Israeli
en: Jeroboam's Revolt

rr: Bwanyima Yeroboamu mwene Nebati Omuefuraimu owa Zereda, omugaragwa wa Sulemaani, mwene Zerua omufaakazi, nawe yaimuka, yaarwanisa omugabe.
en: And Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephrathite of Zereda, Solomon's servant, whose mother's name was Zeruah, a widow woman, even he lifted up his hand against the king.

rr: Kandi eki nikyo yaarwanisiize omugabe. Sulemaani akaba naayombeka Miilo, naahunduuza ekishenshero ky'orurembo rwa Daudi ishe.
en: And this was the cause that he lifted up his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, and repaired the breaches of the city of David his father.

rr: Kandi Yeroboamu akaba ari omushaija orikwebaasa; n'ahabw'ekyo Sulemaani ku yaareebire ogwo mutsigazi ari omukozi, yaamuha obukuru bw'okureeberera abapakasi boona ab'mu muryango gwa Yosefu.
en: And the man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valour: and Solomon seeing the young man that he was industrious, he made him ruler over all the charge of the house of Joseph.

rr: Omu bunaku obwo, Yeroboamu ku yaabaire naaruga Yerusaalemu, nabi Ahiya owa Shiilo yaamubugana. Obwo Ahiya akaba ajwaire omwenda musya; bari bombi omu bwerere.
en: And it came to pass at that time when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, that the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him in the way; and he had clad himself with a new garment; and they two were alone in the field:

rr: Ahiya yaakwata ekyo kijwaro kye, yaakitaaguramu emitanda ikumi n'ebiri.
en: and Ahijah caught the new garment that was on him, and rent it in twelve pieces:

rr: kwonak naija kuguma n'oruganda rumwe ahabw'omwiru wangye Daudi, n'ahabwa Yerusaalemu, orurembo oru naatooraine omu nganda zoona eza Israeli
en: (but he shall have one tribe for my servant David's sake, and for Jerusalem's sake, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel:)

rr: Kwonka tindimwaka bugabe bwona, kureka ndyamureka agume ari omutegyeki omu biro bye byona, ahabwa Daudi omwiru wangye ou naatooraine akoorobera ebiragiro byangye n'ebi naataireho
en: Howbeit I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand: but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant's sake, whom I chose, because he kept my commandments and my statutes:

rr: omwana we niwe ndyaka obugabe, nkakuha engada ikumi.
en: but I will take the kingdom out of his son's hand, and will give it unto thee, even ten tribes.

rr: Kwonka omwana we ndyamuha oruganda rumwe, ngu Daudi omwiru wangye agume n'etabaaza obutoosha omu maisho gangye omuri Yerusaalemu, orurembo oru naatooraine kugumyamu eiziina ryangye.
en: And unto his son will I give one tribe, that David my servant may have a light alway before me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen me to put my name there.

rr: Kandi ndyakutwara otegyekye nk'oku orikwenda kwona, obe omugabe wa Israeli.
en: And I will take thee, and thou shalt reign according to all that thy soul desireth, and shalt be king over Israel.

rr: Kandi ku orihurira ebi ndikukuragiira, waagyendera omu mihanda yangye, waakora ebihikire omu maisho gangye, nooyorobera ebi naataireho n'ebiragiro byangye, nk'omwiru wangye Daudi oku yaabaire atwaza, ndyaguma naiwe, nkwombekyere enju ehamire, nk'ei naayombekyeire Daudi; kandi nkuhe Israeli.
en: And it shall be, if thou wilt hearken unto all that I command thee, and wilt walk in my ways, and do that is right in my sight, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did; that I will be with thee, and build thee a sure house, as I built for David, and will give Israel unto thee.

rr: Kandi ahabw'ekyo ndyabonabonesa baijukuru ba Daudi, kwonka ti biro byona.
en: And I will for this afflict the seed of David, but not for ever.

rr: Ekyo kyareetera Sulemaani kwenda kwita Yeroboamau; kwona Yeroboamu yaimuka, yaahungira Misri owa Shishaki omugabe wa Misri, yaagumayo okuhitsya obu Sulemaani yaafiire.
en: Solomon sought therefore to kill Jeroboam. And Jeroboam arose, and fled into Egypt, unto Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.

rr: 2 Endiijo mirimo ya Sulemaani n'ebi yaakozire byona, n'obwengye bwe, tibihandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'ebyakozirwe Sulemaani?
en: And the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and his wisdom, are they not written in the book of the acts of Solomon?

rr: Kandi omwanya gwona ogu Sulemaani yaamazire aha ngoma Yerusaalemu, naategyeka Israeli yoona, gukahika emyaka makumi ana.
en: And the time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.

rr: Atyo Sulemaani yaagwejegyera, yaashanga baishenkuru, yaaziikwa omu rurembo rwa Daudi ishe, Rehoboamu omutabani yaategyeka omu mwanya gwe.
en: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.

rr: 2 Bwanyima Rehoboamu yaaza Shekemu, ahakuba Abaisraeli boona niyo baabaire bagiire kumwemeka.
en: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for all Israel were come to Shechem to make him king.

rr: Omu bunaku obwo Yeroboamu mwene Nebati akaba akiri Misri, ei yaabaire ahungiire omugabe Sulemaani. Ku yaakihuriire, yaarugayo.
en: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who was yet in Egypt, heard of it , (for he was fled from the presence of king Solomon, and Jeroboam dwelt in Egypt;)

rr: Baamutumaho ab'okumweta; atyo Yeroboamu n'omutwe gw'Abaisraeli boona baija, baagira Rehoboamu bati
en: that they sent and called him. And Jeroboam and all the congregation of Israel came, and spake unto Rehoboam, saying,

rr: 1 Sho akongyera oburemeezi aha kutegyekwa kwaitu. Mbwenu otutuubize aha mirimo erikurusya ei sho yaabaire naatukoresa, n'aha buremeezi bw'okutegyeka kwe, naitwe nitwija kukuheereza.
en: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore make thou the grievous service of thy father, and his heavy yoke which he put upon us, lighter, and we will serve thee.

rr: Yaabagarukamu ati: Mbwenu mugarukyeyo, mumareyo kashatu; haza mugarukye. Batyo abantu baayaabuuka, baagyenda.
en: And he said unto them, Depart yet for three days, then come again to me. And the people departed.

rr: Bwanyima omugabe Rehoboamu yaaza omu naama n'abagurusi abaabaire batabaarira Sulemaani ishe akiriho, yaabagira ati: Nimumpa bwengye ki okugarukamu abo bashaija?
en: And king Rehoboam consulted with the old men, that stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, and said, How do ye advise that I may answer this people?

rr: Baamugira bati: ku oraikirize kuba omuheereza w'eri ihanga eri izooba, waabaheereza, kandi waabagarukamu ebigambo ebirikubagwisa gye, obwo nibwo bariba abairu baawe ebiro byona.
en: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou wilt be a servant unto this people this day, and wilt serve them, and answer them, and speak good words to them, then they will be thy servants for ever.

rr: Kwonka we yaayanga enaama ei abo bagurusi baamuha, bwanyima yaaza omu naama n'abatsigazi abaanyeetsire nawe, kandi abaabaire nibamutabaarira.
en: But he forsook the counsel of the old men, which they had given him, and consulted with the young men that were grown up with him, and which stood before him:

rr: Yaababuuza ati: Nimumpa bwengye ki okugarukamu abo bantu abangizire ngu mbatuubize aha buremeezi bw'obutegyeki obu tata yaabataireho?
en: and he said unto them, What counsel give ye that we may answer this people, who have spoken to me, saying, Make the yoke which thy father did put upon us lighter?

rr: Abo batsigazi abaanyeetsire nawe baamugira bati: Oku nikwo oraagarukyemu abantu abakushabire nibagira bati: Sho akongyera oburemeezi aha kutegyekwa kwaitu; mbwenu iwe otutuubizeho; obagire oti: Akakumu kangye akahera nikakira obuhango enyugunyu ya tata.
en: And the young men that were grown up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou speak unto this people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou it lighter unto us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little finger shall be thicker than my father's loins.

rr: Irooko ogambire Yeroboamu oti: Oku nikwo MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa Israeli, arikugamba, naagira ati: Nkakwiha omu bandi bantu, naakukuza, naakugira omwebembezi w'eihanga ryangye Israeli
en: Go, tell Jeroboam, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Forasmuch as I exalted thee from among the people, and made thee prince over my people Israel,

rr: naayaka enju ya Daudi obugabe, naabukuha; kwonka iwe tiwambeera nk'omwiru wangye Daudi, owaabaire ayorobera ebiragiro byangye, nankuratira n'omutima gwe gwona, naakora ebi ndikusiima byonka
en: and rent the kingdom away from the house of David, and gave it thee: and yet thou hast not been as my servant David, who kept my commandments, and who followed me with all his heart, to do that only which was right in mine eyes;

rr: kureka waakora kubi okukira abaakubandiize boona, waagyenda, waayekorera baaruhanga abandi n'ebishushani ebiyagiibwe, wangwisa kubi, wannaga enyima.
en: but hast done evil above all that were before thee: for thou hast gone and made thee other gods, and molten images, to provoke me to anger, and hast cast me behind thy back:

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo niinyija kureeta akabi aha nju ya Yeroboamu, mmumareho oyetwa omushaija weena, omuhuuku n'ow'obusingye omu Baisraeli, mmarireho kimwe enju ya Yeroboamu, nk'oku omuntu aheha amazi, akamariraho kimwe.
en: therefore, behold, I will bring evil upon the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel, and will take away the remnant of the house of Jeroboam, as a man taketh away dung, till it be all gone.

rr: Omuntu wa Yeroboamu weena, origwa omu rurembo, aryariibwa embwa; kandi origwa omu ishwa, aryariibwa amahungu; ahabw'okuba MUKAMA niwe akigambire.
en: Him that dieth of Jeroboam in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat: for the LORD hath spoken it .

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo imuka, oyetaahire. Kwonka ebigyere byawe ku biraaribate biti omu rurembo, omwana naafa.
en: Arise thou therefore, get thee to thine own house: and when thy feet enter into the city, the child shall die.

rr: Abaisraeli boona nibaija kumucurira, bamuziikye; ogwo niwe wenka omu ba Yeroboamu oriziikwa omu kituuro, ahabw'okuba omu nju ya Yeroboamu niwe wenka oreebirwemu ekirungi ekirikusiimwa MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa Israeli.
en: And all Israel shall mourn for him, and bury him: for he only of Jeroboam shall come to the grave, because in him there is found some good thing toward the LORD God of Israel in the house of Jeroboam.

rr: 1 Kandi MUKAMA aryayeimukiza omugabe okutegyeka Israeli; niwe arimaraho enju ya Yeroboamu aha izooba eryo. Hariho obundi bunaku? Tibwo obu?
en: Moreover the LORD shall raise him up a king over Israel, who shall cut off the house of Jeroboam that day: but what? even now.

rr: Ahakuba MUKAMA aryateera Abaisraeli, babe nk'ekifunjo ekirikutengyetsibwa amaizi, abarandure omuri egi nsi nungi e i yaahaire baishenkurubo, abataataanisize seeri y'omugyera Fraati, ahabw'okuba bakeekorera Asherimu, baagwisa kubi MUKAMA.
en: For the LORD shall smite Israel, as a reed is shaken in the water, and he shall root up Israel out of this good land, which he gave to their fathers, and shall scatter them beyond the river, because they have made their groves, provoking the LORD to anger.

rr: Aryatsigaho Israeli, abature ebibi bya Yeroboamu ebi yaakozire, n'ebi yaasiisiise Abaisraeli.
en: And he shall give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, who did sin, and who made Israel to sin.

rr: Atyo muka Yeroboamu yaimuka, yaagyenda, yaagaruka Tiruza. Ku yaahikire ati aha muryango gw'enju, omwana yaakaba.
en: And Jeroboam's wife arose, and departed, and came to Tirzah: and when she came to the threshold of the door, the child died;

rr: Abaisraeli boona baamuziika, baamucurira nk'ekigambo kya MUKAMA eki yaarabize omu mwiru we nabi Ahiya oku kyabaire kiri.
en: and they buried him; and all Israel mourned for him, according to the word of the LORD , which he spake by the hand of his servant Ahijah the prophet.

rr: 2 Kandi ebindi byona ebi Yeroboamu yaakozire, oku yaarwaine engamba, n'oku yaategyekire, reeba bihandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'eby'omu busingye bw'abagabe ba Israeli.
en: And the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he warred, and how he reigned, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

rr: Emyaka ei Yeroboamu yaamazire aha ngoma ekaba makumi abiri n'ebiri; yaagwejegyera, yaashanga baishenkuru, omutabani Nadabu yaategyeka omu mwanya gwe.
en: And the days which Jeroboam reigned were two and twenty years: and he slept with his fathers, and Nadab his son reigned in his stead.

rr: Ebyabaireho omu busingye bwa Rehoboamu
en: Judah Rehoboam

rr: Rehoboamu mwene Sulemaani akategyekyera omuri Yuda.
en: And Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah.

rr: Obu yaaza aha ngoma, akaba ahikize emyaka makumi ana na gumwe, yaamara emyaka ikumi na mushanju naategyeka omuri Yerusaalemu, orurembo oru MUKAMA yaatooraine omu nganda za Israeli zoona, ngu abe nimwo yaata eiziina rye.
en: Rehoboam was forty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD did choose out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there.

rr: Kandi nyina akaba naayetwa Naama Omwamonikazi.
en: And his mother's name was Naamah an Ammonitess.

rr: Bwanyima aba Yuda baakora ebirikwangwa MUKAMA, baamwitsa eihari ahabw'ebibi ebi baabaire nibakora, byakira ebibi byona ebi baishenkurubo baakozire.
en: And Judah did evil in the sight of the LORD , and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they had committed, above all that their fathers had done.

rr: Ahabw'okuba bakeeyombekyera amaju omu myanya mikuru ey'okuramizamu, n'nyomyo, na Asherimu, ahari buri kibungo kiraingwa, n'ahansi ya buri kiti ekyetwa omurinzi
en: For they also built them high places, and images, and groves, on every high hill, and under every green tree.

rr: kandi omu nsi egyo hakaba harimu ebitingwa. Abantu bakaba nibakora ebihagaro byona eby'abanyamahanga abu MUKAMA yaabingire omu maisho g'Abaisraeli.
en: And there were also sodomites in the land: and they did according to all the abominations of the nations which the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.

rr: 2 Omu mwaka gwa kataano ogw'omu busingye bw'omugabe Rehoboamu, Shishaki omugabe wa Misri akainamuka, yaateera Yerusaalemu
en: And it came to pass in the fifth year of king Rehoboam, that Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem:

rr: yaanyaga ebintu by'obuguzi bwingi eby'omu nju ya MUKAMA, n'eby'omu nju y'omugabe; yaabitwara byona. Kandi yaatwara n'engabo zoona ez'ezaabu ezi Sulemaani yaabaire aheesire.
en: and he took away the treasures of the house of the LORD , and the treasures of the king's house; he even took away all: and he took away all the shields of gold which Solomon had made.

rr: Bwanyima omugabe Rehoboamu yaaheesesa engabo omu miringa omu mwanya gwa ziri, yaazibiitsya abakuru b'abarinzi, abaabaire nibakumiirira aha rwigi rw'enju y'omugabe.
en: And king Rehoboam made in their stead brasen shields, and committed them unto the hands of the chief of the guard, which kept the door of the king's house.

rr: Kandi omugabe ku yaabaire ataaha omu nju ya MUKAMA, abo barinzi bakaba bazihagatira, bwanyima bazigarura omu nju y'abarinzi.
en: And it was so , when the king went into the house of the LORD , that the guard bare them, and brought them back into the guard chamber.

rr: Mbwenu endiijo mirimo ya Rehoboamu n'ebi yaakozire byona, tibihandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'eby'omu busingye bw'abagabe ba Yuda?
en: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

rr: 1 Kandi haaguma nihabaho engamba ahagati ya Rehoboamu na Yeroboamu.
en: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all their days.

en: But the high places were not removed: nevertheless Asa's heart was perfect with the LORD all his days.

rr: Yaareeta omu nju ya MUKAMA ebintu ebi ishe yaashoroire, n'ebindi ebi yaashoroire ahabwe, efeeza, ezaabu n'ebintu by'okukoresa.
en: And he brought in the things which his father had dedicated, and the things which himself had dedicated, into the house of the LORD , silver, and gold, and vessels.

rr: Kandi haaguma nihabaho obweme ahagati ya Asa na Baasha omugabe wa Israeli ebiro byabo byona.
en: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.

rr: 2 Baasha ogwo omugabe wa Israeli yainamuka, yaateera Yuda, yaayombeka Raama, ngu azibire omuntu weena okuruga omu bugabe bwa Asa omugabe wa Yuda, nari okubwijamu.
en: And Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not suffer any to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

rr: Bwanyima Asa yaatwara efeeza n'ezaabu zoona, ezaabaire zitsigaire omu bintu by'obuguzi bwingi ebibiikirwe omu nju ya MUKAMA, n'ebindi ebibiikirwe omu nju y'omugabe, yaabiha abagaragwa be; yaabatuma ahari Benihadadi mwene Taburimooni, mwijukuru wa Hezioni, omugabe wa Siria, owaabaire atwire Damasiko, naagira ati
en: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that were left in the treasures of the house of the LORD , and the treasures of the king's house, and delivered them into the hand of his servants: and king Asa sent them to Ben-hadad, the son of Tabrimon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,

rr: Ka tukore endagaano y'okukwatanisa nyowe naiwe, nk'oku tata na sho baabaire bagiine. Kandi reeba naakutwekyera ekiconco ky'efeeza n'ezaabu; irooko oite endagaano yaawe na Baasha omugabe wa Israeli, abone kundugaho.
en: There is a league between me and thee, and between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent unto thee a present of silver and gold; come and break thy league with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.

rr: Benihadadi yaikiriza eki omugabe Asa yaamushaba, yaayohereza abakuru b'amahe ge kuteera endembo za Israeli, yaakubuura Iyooni, Daani, Abeeli-besimaaka, na Kineroosi yoona hamwe n'ensi yoona eya Nafutaali.
en: So Ben-hadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of the hosts which he had against the cities of Israel, and smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abel-beth-maachah, and all Cinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.

rr: Baasha ku yaakihuriire, yaarekyera aho kwombeka Raama, yaaguma Tiruza.
en: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard thereof , that he left off building of Ramah, and dwelt in Tirzah.

rr: Bwanyima omugabe Asa yaarangirira omu Bayuda boona, tiyaagira u yaatsiga, baaza Raama, baihayo amabaare n'ebiti ebi Baasha yaabaire ayombekyeise; omugabe Asa yaabyombekyesa Geeba ya Benyamiini na Mizipa.
en: Then king Asa made a proclamation throughout all Judah; none was exempted: and they took away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha had builded; and king Asa built with them Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.

rr: 2 Mbwenu endiijo mirimo yoona eya Asa, amaani ge goona, ebi yaakozire byona, n'endembo ezi yaayombekire, tibihandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'eby'omu binsigye bw'abagabe ba Yuda?
en: The rest of all the acts of Asa, and all his might, and all that he did, and the cities which he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

rr: Kwonka omu bugurusi bwe ebigyere bye bikarwara.
en: Nevertheless in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.

rr: Bwanyima Asa yaagwejegyera, yaashanga baishenkuru, yaaziikwa hamwe nabo omu rurembo rwa Daudi ishenkuru; Yehoshafaati omutabani yaategyeka omu mwanya gwe.
en: And Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead.

rr: Ebya Nadabu na Baasha, abagabe ba Israeli

en: And Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned over Israel two years.

en: And Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha smote him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Israel laid siege to Gibbethon.

rr: Omu mwaka gwa kashatu ogw'omu busingye bwa Asa omugabe wa Yuda nibwo yaamwita, akategyeka omu mwanya gwe.
en: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah did Baasha slay him, and reigned in his stead.

rr: Ku yaaherize ati kuza aha ngoma, yaita ab'enju ya Yeroboamu muntu weena orikwitsya, okuhitsya obu yaagicwekyereize, nk'ekigambo kya MUKAMA eki yaarabize omu mwiru we Ahiya owa Shiilo oku kyabaire kiri
en: And it came to pass, when he reigned, that he smote all the house of Jeroboam; he left not to Jeroboam any that breathed, until he had destroyed him, according unto the saying of the LORD , which he spake by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite:

rr: ahabw'ebibi ebi Yeroboamu yaakozire, n'ebi yaasiisiise Abaisraeli, n'ahabw'okwitsa ekiniga MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa Israeli.
en: because of the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, and which he made Israel sin, by his provocation wherewith he provoked the LORD God of Israel to anger.

rr: Mbwenu endiijo mirimo ya Nadabu n'ebi yaakozire byona, tibihandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'eby'omu busingye bw'abagabe ba Israeli?
en: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

rr: Kandi haaguma nihabaho obweme ahagati ya Asa na Baasha omugabe wa Israeli ebiro byabo byona.

en: In the third year of Asa king of Judah began Baasha the son of Ahijah to reign over all Israel in Tirzah, twenty and four years.

rr: Yaakora ebirikwanga MUKAMA, naagyendera omu muhanda gwa Yeroboamu, n'omu kibi kye eki yaasiisiise Abaisraeli.
en: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD , and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin.

en: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha, and what he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

en: So Baasha slept with his fathers, and was buried in Tirzah: and Elah his son reigned in his stead.

And also by the hand of the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani came the word of the LORD against Baasha, and against his house, even for all the evil that he did in the sight of the LORD , in provoking him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam; and because he killed him.

rr: Omu mwaka gwa makumi abiri na mukaaga ogw'omu busingye bwa Asa omugabe wa Yuda, Ela mwene Baasha akatandika kutegyekyera Israeli omuri Tiruza, yaamara aha ngoma emyaka ebiri.
en: In the twenty and sixth year of Asa king of Judah began Elah the son of Baasha to reign over Israel in Tirzah, two years.

en: And his servant Zimri, captain of half his chariots, conspired against him, as he was in Tirzah, drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza steward of his house in Tirzah.

rr: Zimuri yaatahamu, yaamuteera, yaamugwisaho, omu mwaka gwa makumi abiri na mushanju ogw'omu busingye bwa Asa omugabe wa Yuda, yaategyeka omu mwanya gwe.
en: And Zimri went in and smote him, and killed him, in the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his stead.

rr: Ku yaatandikire kutegyeka, aherize ati kuza aha ngoma, yaita ab'enju ya Baasha boona; tiyaamutsigira oyetwa omwojo omuri beene waabo nari omuri banywani be.
en: And it came to pass, when he began to reign, as soon as he sat on his throne, that he slew all the house of Baasha: he left him not one that pisseth against a wall, neither of his kinsfolks, nor of his friends.

rr: Okwo nikwo Zimuri yaacwekyereize ab'enju ya Baasha boona, nk'ekigambo kya MUKAMA eki yaarabize omuri nabi Yehu naahana Baasha, oku kyabaire kiri
en: Thus did Zimri destroy all the house of Baasha, according to the word of the LORD , which he spake against Baasha by Jehu the prophet,

rr: ahabw'ebibi bya Baasha byona, n'eby'omutabani Ela ebi baakozire, kandi ebi baasiisiise Abaisraeli, bakaitsa MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli ekiniga n'eby'obufamutima byabo.
en: for all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, by which they sinned, and by which they made Israel to sin, in provoking the LORD God of Israel to anger with their vanities.

rr: Mbwenu endiijo mirimo ya Ela yoona n'ebi yaakozire byona, tibihandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'eby'omu busingye bw'abagabe ba Israeli?
en: Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

rr: Omu mwaka gwa makumi abiri na mushanju ogw'omu busingye bwa Asa omugabe wa Yuda, Zimuri akategyekyera ebiro mushanju omuri Tiruza.
en: In the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah did Zimri reign seven days in Tirzah.

rr: Obwo engabo zikaba ziteire orusiisira kurwanisa Gibesooni ey'Abafilistia
en: And the people were encamped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines.

rr: bwanyima engabo ezaabaire ziri omuri orwo rusiisira zikahurira nibagira bati: Zimuri agiire omu naama, yaita omugabe; nikyo Abaisraeli boona bahinduriire Omuri omukuru w'eihe omugabe wa Israeli aha izooba eryo bakiri omu rusiisira.
en: And the people that were encamped heard say, Zimri hath conspired, and hath also slain the king: wherefore all Israel made Omri, the captain of the host, king over Israel that day in the camp.

rr: Atyo Omuri yainamuka kuruga Gibesooni n'Abaisraeli boona, baagota Tiruza.
en: And Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged Tirzah.

rr: Zimuri ku yaareebire orurembo rwanyagwa, yaataaha omu kigo ky'omu kikaari ky'omugabe, yaayeyokeza omu nju y'omugabe, yaafa
en: And it came to pass, when Zimri saw that the city was taken, that he went into the palace of the king's house, and burnt the king's house over him with fire, and died,

rr: ahabw'ebibi ebi yaakozire, naakora kubi omu maisho ga MUKAMA, naagyendera omu muhanda gwa Yeroboamu, n'ahabw'ekibi eki yaasiisiise Abaisraeli
en: for his sins which he sinned in doing evil in the sight of the LORD , in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he did, to make Israel to sin.

rr: Mbwenu endijo mirimo ya Zimuri yoona n'obugomi obu yaagomire, tibihandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'eby'omu busingye bw'abagabe ba Israeli?
en: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and his treason that he wrought, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel? Omri

rr: Bwanyima Abaisraeli baayecwamu habiri, ekicweka kimwe kyakuratira Tibuni mwene Ginaasi kumuhindura omugabe, n'ekindi kyakuratira Omuri.
en: Then were the people of Israel divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king; and half followed Omri.

rr: Kwonka abantu abaakuratiire Omuri baasingura abaakuratiire Tibuni mwene Ginaasi; atyo Tibuni yaafa, Omuri yaaba omugabe.
en: But the people that followed Omri prevailed against the people that followed Tibni the son of Ginath: so Tibni died, and Omri reigned.

rr: Omu mwaka gwa makumi ashatu na gumwe ogw'omu busingye bwa Asa omugabe wa Yuda, Omuri akatandika kutegyeka Israeli, yaategyekyera emyaka ikumi n'ebiri; omuri egyo yaamara emyaka mukaaga naategyekyera Tiruza.
en: In the thirty and first year of Asa king of Judah began Omri to reign over Israel, twelve years: six years reigned he in Tirzah.

rr: Bwanyima yaagura ahari Shemeri ekibungo ekirikwetwa Samaria etalanta ibiri z'efeeza, yaakyombekaho orurembo, n'orurembo orwo yaarweta Samaria, naarweterera Shemeri mukama w'ekyo kibungo.
en: And he bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver, and built on the hill, and called the name of the city which he built, after the name of Shemer, owner of the hill, Samaria.

rr: Omuri yaakora ebirikwangwa MUKAMA, kandi yaakora kubi okukira boona abaamubandiize
en: But Omri wrought evil in the eyes of the LORD , and did worse than all that were before him.

rr: ahabw'okuba akagyendera omu muhanda gwona ogwa Yeroboamu mwene Nebati, n'omu bibi ebi yaasiisiise Abaisraeli, bakaitsa MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa Israeli, ekiniga ahabw'eby'obufamutima byabo.
en: For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin, to provoke the LORD God of Israel to anger with their vanities.

rr: Mbwenu endiijo miromo ei Omuri yaakozire yoona, n'eby'amaani agu yaayorekire, tibihandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'eby'omu busingye bw'abagabe ba Israeli?
en: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and his might that he shewed, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

rr: Bwanyima Omuri yaagwejegyera, yaashanga baishenkuru, yaaziikwa omuri Samaria; Ahabu omutabani yaategyeka omu mwanya gwe. Ebya Ahabu omugabe wa Israeli
en: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria: and Ahab his son reigned in his stead. Ahab

rr: Omu mwaka gwa makumi ashatu na munaana gw'omu busingye bwa Asa omugabe wa Yuda, Ahabu mwene Omuri akatandika kutegyeka Israeli; yaategyekyera Israeli omuri Samaria emyaka makumi abiri n'ebiri.
en: And in the thirty and eighth year of Asa king of Judah began Ahab the son of Omri to reign over Israel: and Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty and two years.

rr: Omu busingye bwe yaakora ebirikwangwa MUKAMA okukira boona abaamubandiize.
en: And Ahab the son of Omri did evil in the sight of the LORD above all that were before him.

rr: Kandi tiyaakyeta kintu kibi okugyendera omu muhanda gwa Yeroboamu mwene Nebati, yaagaruka yaashwera Yezebeeli muhara wa Isi-baali, omugabe w'Abasidoni, yaagyenda yaaheereza Baali, kandi yaaguma naamuramya.
en: And it came to pass, as if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, that he took to wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Zidonians, and went and served Baal, and worshipped him.

rr: Yaayombekyera Baali ogwo eitambiro omu nju ei yaabaire amwombekyeire Samaria.
en: And he reared up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.

rr: Kandi Ahabu yaakora Ashera. Yaakira abagabe ba Israeli boona abaamubandiize okwitsa MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa Israeli, ekiniga.
en: And Ahab made a grove; and Ahab did more to provoke the LORD God of Israel to anger than all the kings of Israel that were before him.

rr: Omu busingye bwe Hieli owa Beseeli akombeka Yeriko; ku yaayombekire ati omusingi gwarwo, omwana we w'omujigaijo Abiramu yaafa; kandi ku yaatairemu ati ebiti by'eirembo ryarwo, omwana we wa bucuranda Seguba nawe yaafa, nk'ekigambo kya MUKAMA eki yaarabize omuri Yoshua mwene Nuuni, oku kyabaire kiri.
en: In his days did Hiel the Beth-elite build Jericho: he laid the foundation thereof in Abiram his firstborn, and set up the gates thereof in his youngest son Segub, according to the word of the LORD , which he spake by Joshua the son of Nun.

rr: Omu biro ebyo Eliya owa Tishubi, omwe aha bashuhuuki ba Gileadi, yaagira Ahabu ati: Nindahira MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli, ou mpeereza, tiharibaho rume nari enjura omuri egi myaka okuhitsya obu ndibiragiira.
en: And Elijah the Tishbite, who was of the inhabitants of Gilead, said unto Ahab, As the LORD God of Israel liveth, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word.

rr: Bwanyima ekigambo kya MUKAMA kyamwizira nikigira kiti
en: And the word of the LORD came unto him, saying,

rr: Ruga aha, otoore oburugwa-izooba, oyesherekye aha rubaju rw'akagyera akarikwetwa Kerisi, aharikureebana na Yorudani.
en: Get thee hence, and turn thee eastward, and hide thyself by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.

rr: Noija kuguma noonywa amaizi ahari ako kagyera, kandi naaragiira ebikoona kuguma nibikugyemurirayo.
en: And it shall be, that thou shalt drink of the brook; and I have commanded the ravens to feed thee there.

rr: Atyo yaagyenda, yaatwaza nk'oku MUKAMA yaamugambira; yaaza ahari ako kagyera Kerisi, akateegaine na Yorudani, yaagumayo.
en: So he went and did according unto the word of the LORD : for he went and dwelt by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.

rr: Ebikoona byaguma nibimureetera emigaati n'enyama buri kasheeshe n'omu mwabazyo; kandi yaaguma naanywa amaizi ahari ako kagyera.
en: And the ravens brought him bread and flesh in the morning, and bread and flesh in the evening; and he drank of the brook.

rr: Ku haahingwireho ebiro, ako kagyera kaayoma, ahabw'okuba enjura ekaba etarikugwa muri egyo nsi. Eliya okuraara omw'omufaakazi owa Zarefaasi
en: And it came to pass after a while, that the brook dried up, because there had been no rain in the land. At Zarephath

rr: Bwanyima ekigambo kya MUKAMA kyamwizira nikigira kiti
en: And the word of the LORD came unto him, saying,

rr: Imuka oze Zarefaasi ey'Abasidoni, obe niyo waaguma. Reeba, niyo ndagiire omufaakazi kuguma naakugaburira.
en: Arise, get thee to Zarephath, which belongeth to Zidon, and dwell there: behold, I have commanded a widow woman there to sustain thee.

rr: Atyo yaimuka, yaaza Zarefaasi; ku yaahikire aha irembo ry'orurembo, yaashanga omukazi omufaakazi naatorotoora otuku; yaamweta, yaamugira ati: Ninkweshengyereza, ndeetera otwizi omu nkyeka, ntunywe.
en: So he arose and went to Zarephath. And when he came to the gate of the city, behold, the widow woman was there gathering of sticks: and he called to her, and said, Fetch me, I pray thee, a little water in a vessel, that I may drink.

rr: Ku yaabaire naaza kugenda, Eliya yaamweta, yaamugira ati: Ondeetere n'akagaati omu ngaro.
en: And as she was going to fetch it , he called to her, and said, Bring me, I pray thee, a morsel of bread in thine hand.

rr: Onu yaamugira ati: Ninkurahira MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe, tiinyine kagaati, kureka oruhi rw'esaano omu kanyungu n'amajuta makye omu katsimbo; mbwenu nintorotoora obuyaayo bubiri, mbone kugaruka omuka, nkeeteekyere na mutabani wangye, tukarye, tufe.
en: And she said, As the LORD thy God liveth, I have not a cake, but an handful of meal in a barrel, and a little oil in a cruse: and, behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and dress it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.

rr: Eliya yaamugira ati: Otatiina; irooko otwaze nk'oku waagamba; kwonka banza onteekyereho kakye, okandeetere, bwanyima obone kweteekyera n'omwana waawe
en: And Elijah said unto her, Fear not; go and do as thou hast said: but make me thereof a little cake first, and bring it unto me, and after make for thee and for thy son.

rr: ahabw'okuba oku nikwo MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli arikugamba naagira ati: Esaano y'omuri ako kanyungu terikwija kuhwaho, n'amajuta ag'omuri ako katsimbo tigarikwija kuhwamu, okuhitsya aha izooba eri MUKAMA arigwisizaho enjura ahansi.
en: For thus saith the LORD God of Israel, The barrel of meal shall not waste, neither shall the cruse of oil fail, until the day that the LORD sendeth rain upon the earth.

rr: Ogwo mukazi yaagyenda, yaatwaza nk'oku Eliya yaamugira; bwanyima we na Eliya n'ab'omu ka ye baamara ebiro bingi nibarya
en: And she went and did according to the saying of Elijah: and she, and he, and her house, did eat many days.

rr: esaano y'omuri ako kanyungu tiyaahwaho, n'amajuta g'omuri ako katsimbo tigaahwamu, nk'ekigambo kya MUKAMA eki yaarabize omuri Eliya, oku kyabaire kiri. Eliya okuhimbuura omwana w'omufaakazi
en: And the barrel of meal wasted not, neither did the cruse of oil fail, according to the word of the LORD , which he spake by Elijah.

rr: Bwanyima y'ebyo, omwana w'ogwo mukazi nyineeka yaarwara; endwara yaamurembya, okuhitsya obu omwitsyo gwamuhweereiremu kimwe.
en: And it came to pass after these things, that the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, fell sick; and his sickness was so sore, that there was no breath left in him.

rr: Nyina yaagira Eliya ati: Iwe muntu wa Ruhanga 'we, noofa ki naanye? Okaija omwangye kunyijutsya ekibi kyangye, n'okuunyitira omwana!
en: And she said unto Elijah, What have I to do with thee, O thou man of God? art thou come unto me to call my sin to remembrance, and to slay my son?

rr: Eliya yaamugira ati: Mpa omwana waawe.
en: And he said unto her, Give me thy son.

rr: Atyo yaamumwiha omu kifuba, yaamwinamura omu kishengye kya kaanyinaibiri eki yaabaire naaraaramu, yaamurambika aha kitanda kye.
en: And he took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into a loft, where he abode, and laid him upon his own bed.

rr: Yaatakira MUKAMA ati: Ai MUKAMA Ruhanga wangye, niiwe oreetsire akabi n'aha mufaakazi ogu orikundaaza, ak'okwita omwana we?
en: And he cried unto the LORD , and said, O LORD my God, hast thou also brought evil upon the widow with whom I sojourn, by slaying her son?

rr: Bwanyima yaayegororera ahari ogwo mwana kashatu, naatakira MUKAMA ati: Ai MUKAMA Ruhanga wangye, ninkweshengyereza, ikiriza amagara g'ogu mwana gamugarukyemu.
en: And he stretched himself upon the child three times, and cried unto the LORD , and said, O LORD my God, I pray thee, let this child's soul come into him again.

rr: MUKAMA yaahurira okushaba kwa Eliya, amagara g'ogwo mwana gaamugarukamu, yaahimbuuka.
en: And the LORD heard the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.

rr: Eliya yaatwara ogwo mwana, yaamwiha omu kishengye kya kaanyinaibiri, yaamushuumya, yaamutaasya omu nju, yaamuha nyina; yaamugira ati: Reeba, omwana waawe ahuriire.
en: And Elijah took the child, and brought him down out of the chamber into the house, and delivered him unto his mother: and Elijah said, See, thy son liveth.

rr: Ogwo mukazi yaagira Eliya ati: Mbwenu naamanya ku ori omushaija wa Ruhanga, kandi n'ekigambo kya Ruhanga eki orikugamba ku kiri eky'amazima.
en: And the woman said to Elijah, Now by this I know that thou art a man of God, and that the word of the LORD in thy mouth is truth.

rr: Ku haahingwireho ebiro bingi ekigambo kya MUKAMA kyaizira Eliya omu mwaka gwa kashatu, nikigira kiti: Irooko, oyeyorekye Ahabu; naanye niinyija kugwisa enjura aha nsi.
en: And it came to pass after many days, that the word of the LORD came to Elijah in the third year, saying, Go, shew thyself unto Ahab; and I will send rain upon the earth.

rr: Atyo Eliya yaaza kweyoreka Ahabu. Obwo enjura ekaba eri nyingi omuri Samaria.
en: And Elijah went to shew himself unto Ahab. And there was a sore famine in Samaria.

rr: Ahabu yaayeta Obadia owaabaire ari omukuru w'eka ye. (Obadia ogwo akaba naatiina munonga MUKAMA
en: And Ahab called Obadiah, which was the governor of his house. (Now Obadiah feared the LORD greatly:

rr: kandi obu Yezebeeli yaita baanabi ba MUKAMA, Obadia akatwara baanabi igana, yaashereka makumi ataano-ataano omu nyanga, yaaguma naabaheeramu eby'okurya n'amaizi.)
en: for it was so , when Jezebel cut off the prophets of the LORD , that Obadiah took an hundred prophets, and hid them by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water.)

rr: Ahabu yaagira Obadia ati: Irooko ogyendagyende omu nsi aha nshur zoona ez'amaizi n'omu mpanga zoona; obundi tukaareeba obunyaatsi, tutambira embaraasi n'enyumbu, amatungo goona gareka kufa.
en: And Ahab said unto Obadiah, Go into the land, unto all fountains of water, and unto all brooks: peradventure we may find grass to save the horses and mules alive, that we lose not all the beasts.

rr: Batyo baagaba ensi ebirari, ngu babone kugirabamu yoona; Ahabu yaagyenda okwe, na Obadia okwe.
en: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it: Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.

rr: Obadia ku yaabaire naakigyenda, yaabugaabugana na Eliya; Obadia yaamumanya, yaajuumara ahansi, yaagira ati: Niiwe, Mukama wangye Eliya?
en: And as Obadiah was in the way, behold, Elijah met him: and he knew him, and fell on his face, and said, Art thou that my lord Elijah?

rr: Yaamugarukamu ati: Niinye. Gyenda ogambire mukama waawe oti: Reeba, Eliya ari aha.
en: And he answered him, I am: go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here .

rr: Onu yaamugarukamu ati: Ncumwire ki okuhayo omwiru waawe ahari Ahabu, ngu anyite?
en: And he said, What have I sinned, that thou wouldest deliver thy servant into the hand of Ahab, to slay me?

rr: Ninkurahira MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe, tihariho ihanga n'obu bwakuba obugabe, ei mukama wangye atatumire bantu b'okukusherura; kandi ku baakugizire ngu tari kunu, akaarahiize obwo bugabe nari eryo ihanga, ku batakureebire.
en: As the LORD thy God liveth, there is no nation or kingdom, whither my lord hath not sent to seek thee: and when they said, He is not there ; he took an oath of the kingdom and nation, that they found thee not.

rr: Mbwenu noogira oti: Gyenda ogambire mukama waawe, oti: Reeba, Eliya ari aha.
en: And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here .

rr: Kandi ku ndaabe naakurugaho nti, Omwoyo wa MUKAMA naija kukutwara ei ntarikumanya; ku ndaagyende naagambira Ahabu, yaija, ataakureeba, naija kuunyita, n'obu ndaabe nyowe omwiru waawe ntiina Ruhanga okwiha omu buto bwangye.
en: And it shall come to pass, as soon as I am gone from thee, that the Spirit of the LORD shall carry thee whither I know not; and so when I come and tell Ahab, and he cannot find thee, he shall slay me: but I thy servant fear the LORD from my youth.

rr: Mukama wangye, tokahuriraga eki naakozire, obu Yezebeeli yaita baanabi ba MUKAMA, ku naasherekire abashaija igana, baanabi ba MUKAMA, makumi ataano-ataano omu nyanga, kandi nkaguma nimbaheeramu eby'okurya n'amaizi?
en: Was it not told my lord what I did when Jezebel slew the prophets of the LORD , how I hid an hundred men of the LORD 's prophets by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water?

rr: Mbwenu noogira oti: Irooko ogambire mukama waawe, oti: Reeba, Eliya ari aha; ekiraarugyemu naija kuunyita.
en: And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here: and he shall slay me.

rr: Eliya yaamugira ati: Ninkurahira MUKAMA ow'amahe, ou mpeereza, buzimazima nimmweyoreka eri izooba.
en: And Elijah said, As the LORD of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, I will surely shew myself unto him to day.

rr: Atyo Obadia yaagyenda kubugana Ahabu, na Ahabu yaaza kubugana Eliya. Eliya okureebana na Ahabu
en: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him: and Ahab went to meet Elijah.

rr: Ahabu ku yaareebire Eliya, yaamugira ati: Niiwe, iwe orikunyangaraza Israeli?
en: And it came to pass, when Ahab saw Elijah, that Ahab said unto him, Art thou he that troubleth Israel?

rr: Onu yaamugarukamu ati: Nyowe tinkanyangaraize Israeli, kureka niiwe n'enju ya sho, ahabw'okuba mukareka ebiragiro bya MUKAMA, mwakuratira baabali.
en: And he answered, I have not troubled Israel; but thou, and thy father's house, in that ye have forsaken the commandments of the LORD , and thou hast followed Baalim.

rr: Mbwenu nu ntumira Abaisraeli boona, bateeranire aha kibungo Karumeeli na baanabi ba Baali magana ana na makumi ataano, kandi n'abandi magana ana ba Ashera, abariira aha meeza ya Yezebeeli.
en: Now therefore send, and gather to me all Israel unto mount Carmel, and the prophets of Baal four hundred and fifty, and the prophets of the groves four hundred, which eat at Jezebel's table. Mount Carmel

rr: Atyo Ahabu yaatuma aha Baisraeli boona, kandi yaateeranira baanabi abo aha kibungo Karumeeli.
en: So Ahab sent unto all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together unto mount Carmel.

rr: Abo boona ku baahikireyo, Eliya yaabairira haihi, yaabagira ati: Muryahitsya hi n'okugira emitima ebiri? MUKAMA ku araabe ari Ruhanga, mumukuratire; nari Baali ku araabe ari Ruhanga, mube niwe mwakuratira. Abantu tibaagira ki baamugarukamu.
en: And Elijah came unto all the people, and said, How long halt ye between two opinions? if the LORD be God, follow him: but if Baal, then follow him. And the people answered him not a word.

rr: Eliya yaagaruka yaagira abantu ati: Nyowe, nyowe nyenka niinye nabi wa MUKAMA otsigaireho; kwonka baanabi ba Baali n'abashaija magana ana na makumi ataano.
en: Then said Elijah unto the people, I, even I only, remain a prophet of the LORD ; but Baal's prophets are four hundred and fifty men.

rr: Mbwenu ka batuhe enimi ibiri, bo baiheho emwe ahabwabo, bagitematememu ebicweka, babite aha nku, kwonka batatamu omuriro; naanye niinyija kubaaga eya kabiri, ngite aha nku, ndekye kutamu omuriro.
en: Let them therefore give us two bullocks; and let them choose one bullock for themselves, and cut it in pieces, and lay it on wood, and put no fire under: and I will dress the other bullock, and lay it on wood, and put no fire under:

rr: Imwe mwete eiziina rya ruhanga waanyu, naanye niinyija kweta eiziina rya MUKAMA; kandi Ruhanga oraagarukisemu omuriro, biri ogwo niwe Ruhanga.
en: and call ye on the name of your gods, and I will call on the name of the LORD : and the God that answereth by fire, let him be God.

rr: Abantu boona baagarukamu bati: Eki waagamba nikwo.
en: And all the people answered and said, It is well spoken.

rr: Bwanyima Eliya yaagira baanabi ba Baali ati: Mwetooranireho enimi emwe, mube niimwe mwabanza kubaaga, ahabw'okuba muri baingi; haza mwete eiziina rya ruhanga waanyu, kwonka mutatamu omuriro.
en: And Elijah said unto the prophets of Baal, Choose you one bullock for yourselves, and dress it first; for ye are many; and call on the name of your gods, but put no fire under .

rr: Batyo baatwara enimi ei baaheebwa, baagibaaga, baayeta eiziina rya Baali okwiha omu kasheeshe okuhitsya omu ihangwe, nibagira bati: Ai Baali, otuhurire!
en: And they took the bullock which was given them, and they dressed it , and called on the name of Baal from morning even until noon, saying, O Baal, hear us.

rr: Kwonka tihaabaho iraka, nari owaabagarukamu.
en: But there was no voice, nor any that answered.

rr: Baaguma nibagurukagurukira aha itambiro eri baayombeka.
en: And they leaped upon the altar which was made.

rr: Omu ihangwe Eliya yaabateerera enaku naagira ati: Nimwete munonga; ahabw'okuba ni ruhanga; nooshusha oti naateekateeka, nari aine ah'ari, nari azindukire, nari shi agwejegyeire, ashemereire kusisiimurwa.
en: And it came to pass at noon, that Elijah mocked them, and said, Cry aloud: for he is a god; either he is talking, or he is pursuing, or he is in a journey, or peradventure he sleepeth, and must be awaked.

rr: Batyo baayeta nibaamuza, baayeshara na zaarurara n'emisyo nk'oku baabaire bagira, okuhitsya obu eshagama yaajwire n'amaani.
en: And they cried aloud, and cut themselves after their manner with knives and lancets, till the blood gushed out upon them.

rr: Bwanyima y'eihangwe baagumizamu nibaamuza okuhitsya obunaku bw'okutamba ekitambo ky'omu mwabazyo; kwonka tihaabaho iraka, nari ow'okubagarukamu, n'obu yaakuba ow'okubeetaho.
en: And it came to pass, when midday was past, and they prophesied until the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that there was neither voice, nor any to answer, nor any that regarded.

rr: Bwanyima Eliya yaagira abantu boona ati: Nimumpikye haihi.
en: And Elijah said unto all the people, Come near unto me.

rr: Abantu boona baamuhika haihi.
en: And all the people came near unto him.

rr: Yaagaruka yaayombeka eitambiro rya MUKAMA, eryabaire risheenyirwe
en: And he repaired the altar of the LORD that was broken down.

rr: yaihaho amabaare ikumi n'abiri, agarikwingana n'omubaro gw'enganda za batabani ba Yakobo, ou ekigambo kya MUKAMA kyaiziire nikigira kiti: Israeli niryo riraabe eiziina ryawe
en: And Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, unto whom the word of the LORD came, saying, Israel shall be thy name:

rr: ago mabaare yaagombekyesa eitambiro omu iziina rya MUKAMA. Yaateera oruhazo okwehinguririza eitambiro orurikuhikwamu encuro ibiri z'embibo.
en: and with the stones he built an altar in the name of the LORD : and he made a trench about the altar, as great as would contain two measures of seed.

rr: Yaateekyeraho enku, yaatematema enimi, yaagita aha nku, yaagira ati: Mwijuze enyungu z'amaizi ina, mugashukye aha kitambo ky'okwotsya n'aha nku.
en: And he put the wood in order, and cut the bullock in pieces, and laid him on the wood, and said, Fill four barrels with water, and pour it on the burnt sacrifice, and on the wood.

rr: Yaagaruka yaagira ati: Mukore mutyo obwa kabiri; baakikora obwa kabiri; yaagaruka yaagira ati: Mukore mutyo obwa kashatu; baakikora obwa kashatu
en: And he said, Do it the second time. And they did it the second time. And he said, Do it the third time. And they did it the third time.

rr: amaizi gaahimintika, gaayehinguririza eitambiro, gaijuza n'oruhazo.
en: And the water ran round about the altar; and he filled the trench also with water.

rr: Omu bunaku bw'okutamba ekitambo ky'omu mwabazyo, Eliya nabi yairira haihi, yaagira ati: Ai MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Abrahamu, owa Isaaka, kandi owa Israeli, ka kimanywe eri izooba ku niiwe Ruhanga omuri Israeli, naanye ku ndi omuheereza waawe, kandi ku nkozire ebi byona ahabw'ekigambo kyawe.
en: And it came to pass at the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that Elijah the prophet came near, and said, LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known this day that thou art God in Israel, and that I am thy servant, and that I have done all these things at thy word.

rr: Ngarukamu, ai MUKAMA; ngarukamu, abantu aba bamanye ku niiwe, ai MUKAMA, ori Ruhanga, kandi ku niiwe ohindwire emitima yaabo, ekakugarukira.
en: Hear me, O LORD , hear me, that this people may know that thou art the LORD God, and that thou hast turned their heart back again.

rr: Abantu boona ku baakireebire, baajuumara ahansi, baagira bati: MUKAMA niwe Ruhanga! MUKAMA niwe Ruhanga! Eliya okwita baanabi ba Baali, n'okuhanguka kw'enjura
en: And when all the people saw it , they fell on their faces: and they said, The LORD , he is the God; the LORD , he is the God.

rr: Eliya yaabagira ati: Mukwate baanabi ba Baali; hatagira n'omwe owagyenda.
en: And Elijah said unto them, Take the prophets of Baal; let not one of them escape.

rr: Baabakwata; Eliya yaabashuumya aha kagyera Kishoni, yaabaitiraho.
en: And they took them: and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon, and slew them there.

rr: Bwanyima yaagira Ahabu ati: Imuka, orye, onywe; ahakuba hariho okuhoorera kw'enjura nyingi munonga.
en: And Elijah said unto Ahab, Get thee up, eat and drink; for there is a sound of abundance of rain.

rr: Atyo Ahabu yainamuka kurya n'okunywa.
en: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink.

rr: Na Eliya yainamuka aha mutwe gw'ekibungo Karumeeli; yaajuumara, omutwe yaaguta omu maguru.
en: And Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he cast himself down upon the earth, and put his face between his knees,

rr: Yaagira omuheereza we ati: Inamuka, onagye amaisho aha nyanja.
en: and said to his servant, Go up now, look toward the sea.

rr: Yainamuka, yaareebayo, yaagira ati: Tihaine kiriyo.
en: And he went up, and looked, and said, There is nothing.

rr: Onu ati: Garukayo emirundi mushanju.
en: And he said, Go again seven times.

rr: Aha murundi gwa mushanju omuheereza yaagira ati: Reeba ekicu ekirikushusha ekiganja ky'omuntu nikiimuka omu nyanja.
en: And it came to pass at the seventh time, that he said, Behold, there ariseth a little cloud out of the sea, like a man's hand.

rr: Eliya yaamugira ati: Irooko ogire Ahabu oti: Tebeekanisa ekigaari kyawe, oshuume, enjura etakaakutangira aho.
en: And he said, Go up, say unto Ahab, Prepare thy chariot , and get thee down, that the rain stop thee not.

rr: Omu kaanya kakye eiguru ryairirimba ahabw'ebicu n'omuyaga, haagwa enjura nyingi.
en: And it came to pass in the mean while, that the heaven was black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain.

rr: Ahabu yaatemba ekigaari, yaaza Yezereeli.
en: And Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.

rr: Kandi omukono gwa MUKAMA gwaza ahari Eliya, yaayezirika, yairukanga omu maisho ga Ahabu, yaahika aha irembo rya Yezereeli.
en: And the hand of the LORD was on Elijah; and he girded up his loins, and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.

rr: Currently Selected: 1 Abagabe 18 : RR64 Highlight Share <path d="M5 12a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h3a
Ahabu yaateekyerereza Yezebeeli byona ebi Eliya yaakora, n'oku yaita baanabi boona na rurara.
en: And Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and withal how he had slain all the prophets with the sword.

rr: Bwanyima Yezebeeli yaatuma ahari Eliya naagira ati: Nyencakare nk'aga magingo ku ndaabe ntagizire magara gaawe nk'oku waagira agaabo, baaruhanga bakinture n'okukiraho.
en: Then Jezebel sent a messenger unto Elijah, saying, So let the gods do to me , and more also, if I make not thy life as the life of one of them by to morrow about this time.

rr: Eliya nikwo kutiina, akaimuka, akahunzya amagara, akahika Beerisheba eya Yuda, akatsigayo omuheereza we.
en: And when he saw that , he arose, and went for his life, and came to Beer-sheba, which belongeth to Judah, and left his servant there.

rr: We akagyenda orugyendo rw'eizooba ryona, akaza omu ihamba. Ku yaahikireyo, yaashutama ahansi y'omukinga, yaashaba Ruhanga ngu afe, naagira ati: Mperere hi! mbwenu, ai MUKAMA, nyita; ahakuba tiinyine ki ndikuhitsa baatatenkuru.
en: But he himself went a day's journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree: and he requested for himself that he might die; and said, It is enough; now, O LORD , take away my life; for I am not better than my fathers.

rr: Yaabyama ahansi y'omukinga, yaagwejegyera; bwanyima maraika yaija, yaamukoraho, yaamugira ati: Imuka orye.
en: And as he lay and slept under a juniper tree, behold, then an angel touched him, and said unto him, Arise and eat.

rr: Onu ku yaamagamagire, yaareeba aha mutwe gwe omugaati oguteekirwe aha mabaare garikwotsya, n'orunywero rw'amaizi.
en: And he looked, and, behold, there was a cake baken on the coals, and a cruse of water at his head.

rr: Yaarya, yaanywa, yaagaruka yaabyama.
en: And he did eat and drink, and laid him down again.

rr: Maraika wa MUKAMA yaija obwa kabiri, yaamukoraho, yaagira ati: Imuka orye, orugyendo ni ruhango, rutakaakurema.
en: And the angel of the LORD came again the second time, and touched him, and said, Arise and eat; because the journey is too great for thee.

rr: Atyo yaimuka, yaarya, yaanywa, yaagyendera aha mwiguto gw'ebyo by'okurya ebiro makumi ana nyomushana na nyekiro, yaahika ahari Horebu orushozi rwa Ruhanga.
en: And he arose, and did eat and drink, and went in the strength of that meat forty days and forty nights unto Horeb the mount of God.

rr: Ku yaahikire okwo, yaataaha omu nyanga, yaaraaramu; kandi reeba, ekigambo kya MUKAMA kyamwizira; yaamugira ati: Eliya, nookora ki aha?
en: And he came thither unto a cave, and lodged there; and, behold, the word of the LORD came to him, and he said unto him, What doest thou here, Elijah?

rr: Onu yaagira ati: Ngizire eihari ringi ahabwa MUKAMA, Ruhanga ow'amahe; ahabw'okuba Abaisraeli baitsire endagaano yaawe, baasheenya amatambiro gaawe, baita baanabi baawe na rurara; nyowe, nyowe nyenka, niinye ntsigaireho; kandi naanye nibeenda kuunyita.
en: And he said, I have been very jealous for the LORD God of hosts: for the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant, thrown down thine altars, and slain thy prophets with the sword; and I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.

rr: MUKAMA yaamugira ati: Shohora, oyemerere ahari oru rushozi omu maisho ga MUKAMA. MUKAMA yaarabaho, omuyaga mwingi gw'amaani gwashatura enshozi, gwayatagura enkiri omu maisho ga MUKAMA; kwonka MUKAMA akaba atagurimu. Bwanyima y'omuyaga haija omutsitsa, kwonka MUKAMA akaba atagurimu
en: And he said, Go forth, and stand upon the mount before the LORD . And, behold, the LORD passed by, and a great and strong wind rent the mountains, and brake in pieces the rocks before the LORD ; but the LORD was not in the wind: and after the wind an earthquake; but the LORD was not in the earthquake:

rr: bwanyima y'omutsitsa haija omuriro, kwonka MUKAMA akaba atagurimu; bwanyima y'omuriro haija akaraka kakye kandi koorobi.
en: and after the earthquake a fire; but the LORD was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice.

rr: Eliya ku yaakahuriire, yaayeshweka omunagiro aha maisho, yaashohora, yaayemerera aha munwa gw'enyanga.
en: And it was so , when Elijah heard it , that he wrapped his face in his mantle, and went out, and stood in the entering in of the cave.

rr: Haija eiraka, ryamugira riti: Eliya nookora ki aha?
en: And, behold, there came a voice unto him, and said, What doest thou here, Elijah?

rr: Yaagarukamu ati: Ngizire eihari ringi ahabwa MUKAMA, Ruhanga ow'amahe; ahabw'eokuba Abaisraeli baitsire endagaano yaawe, baasheenya amatambiro gaawe, na baanabi baawe baabaitsa rurara; nyowe, nyowe nyeka, niinye ntsigaireho; kandi naanye nibansherura kuunyita.
en: And he said, I have been very jealous for the LORD God of hosts: because the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant, thrown down thine altars, and slain thy prophets with the sword; and I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.

rr: MUKAMA yaamugira ati: Irooko ogarukyeyo, otoore omuhanga gurikuza omu ihamba rya Damasiko; ku oraahikyeyo, oshukye amajuta ahari Hazaeli kuba omugabe wa Siria
en: And the LORD said unto him, Go, return on thy way to the wilderness of Damascus: and when thou comest, anoint Hazael to be king over Syria:

rr: 2 kandi na Yehu mwene Nimushi omushukyeho amajuta kuba omugabe wa Israeli, na Elisa mwene Shafati owa Abeeli-mehoola, omushukyeho amajuta kuba nabi omu mwanya gwawe.
en: and Jehu the son of Nimshi shalt thou anoint to be king over Israel: and Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abel-meholah shalt thou anoint to be prophet in thy room.

rr: Oriba yaakizire rurara ya Hazaeli, aryaitwa Yehu; kandi oriba yaakizire rurara ya Yehu, aryaitwa Elisa.
en: And it shall come to pass, that him that escapeth the sword of Hazael shall Jehu slay: and him that escapeth from the sword of Jehu shall Elisha slay.

rr: Kwonka ndyayetsigiraho abantu enkumi mushanju omuri Israeli, abatakatsimbiraga Baali maju, n'obu kwakuba okumunywegyera.
en: Yet I have left me seven thousand in Israel, all the knees which have not bowed unto Baal, and every mouth which hath not kissed him.

rr: Elisa okuhinduka omuheereza wa Eliya
en: The Call of Elisha

rr: Atyo yaarugayo, yaashanga Elisa mwene Shafati naahingisa ente makumi abiri na ina ezikomeraine ibiri-ibiri omu mishorongo ebiri, zimuri omumaisho, kwonka we aine ibiri ezirikuhereerukayo; Eliya yaakiikama; ku yaabaire naamurabaho, yaamunagaho omunagiro gwe.
en: So he departed thence, and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him, and he with the twelfth: and Elijah passed by him, and cast his mantle upon him.

rr: Elisa yaatsigaho ente, yaamwirukaho, yaamugira ati: Reka mbanze nnywegyere tata na maawe, mbone kukukuratira.
en: And he left the oxen, and ran after Elijah, and said, Let me, I pray thee, kiss my father and my mother, and then I will follow thee.

rr: Yaamugarukamu ati: Garukayo; mbwenu waareeba naakugira nta?
en: And he said unto him, Go back again: for what have I done to thee?

rr: Tiyaamukuratira, yaagarukayo, yaatwara ente ibiri, yaaziita, yaaziteekyesa ebiti ebyaba bizikomire, yaagaburira abantu, baarya.
en: And he returned back from him, and took a yoke of oxen, and slew them, and boiled their flesh with the instruments of the oxen, and gave unto the people, and they did eat.

rr: Bwanyima yaimuka, yaakurata Eliya, yaaguma naamuhereza.
en: Then he arose, and went after Elijah, and ministered unto him.
