Benihadadi, omugabe wa Siria, yaateerana hamwe eihe rye ryona, yaakwatanisa n'abandi bagabe makumi ashatu na babiri, abaabaire baine embaraasi n'ebigaari; yainamuka, yaagota Samaria, yaagirwanisa.
en: And Ben-hadad the king of Syria gathered all his host together: and there were thirty and two kings with him, and horses, and chariots: and he went up and besieged Samaria, and warred against it.

rr: Yaatuma entumwa omu rurembo ahari Ahabu omugabe wa Israeli, yaamugira ati: Oku nikwo Benihadadi arikugamba naagira ati
en: And he sent messengers to Ahab king of Israel into the city, and said unto him, Thus saith Ben-hadad,

rr: Efeeza zaawe n'ezaabu zaawe n'ebyangye; abakazi baawe abarikuhita abandi boona, n'abaana baawe, nabo n'abangye.
en: Thy silver and thy gold is mine; thy wives also and thy children, even the goodliest, are mine.

rr: Omugabe wa Israeli yaamugarukamu ati: Nk'oku waagira, Nyakusinga Omugabe, ndi owaawe n'ebyangye byona.
en: And the king of Israel answered and said, My lord, O king, according to thy saying, I am thine, and all that I have.

rr: Bwanyima ezo ntumwa zaagaruka ahari Ahabu, zaamugira ziti: Oku nikwo Benihadadi arikugamba naagira ati: Nkutumireho ningira nti: Nyoherereza efeeza zaawe n'ezaabu zaawe, abakazi baawe n'abaana baawe
en: And the messengers came again, and said, Thus speaketh Ben-hadad, saying, Although I have sent unto thee, saying, Thou shalt deliver me thy silver, and thy gold, and thy wives, and thy children;

rr: mbwenu nyencakare nk'aga magingo niinyija kukutumaho abashaija bangye, nibacaaka enju yaawe n'amaju g'abagaragwa baawe; eki baraagweho kyona ekirikubashemeza, nibakitwara.
en: yet I will send my servants unto thee to morrow about this time, and they shall search thine house, and the houses of thy servants; and it shall be, that whatsoever is pleasant in thine eyes, they shall put it in their hand, and take it away.

rr: Okuruga aho omugabe wa Israeli yaayeta abakuru b'ensi ye, yaabagira ati: Mbwenu mwetegyereze, mureebe omushaija ogu, ku arikutaara akabi; ahabw'okuba abaire yantumireho abakazi bangye, n'abaana, n'efeeza, n'ezaabu, kandi timmwangiire.
en: Then the king of Israel called all the elders of the land, and said, Mark, I pray you, and see how this man seeketh mischief: for he sent unto me for my wives, and for my children, and for my silver, and for my gold; and I denied him not.

rr: Abakuru boona n'abantu boona baamugira bati: Otakitaho omutima, kandi otaikiriza.
en: And all the elders and all the people said unto him, Hearken not unto him , nor consent.

rr: Atyo yaagira entumwa za Benihadadi ati: Mugambire mukama wangye omugabe muti: Byona ebi obandize kutuma aha mwiru waawe, niinyija kubikora; kwona eki tindikwija kukikora.
en: Wherefore he said unto the messengers of Ben-hadad, Tell my lord the king, All that thou didst send for to thy servant at the first I will do: but this thing I may not do.

rr: Entumwa zaagyenda, zaamugambira ebi Ahabu yaazituma.
en: And the messengers departed, and brought him word again.

rr: Benihadadi yaamutumaho naamugira ati: Engabo zangye zoona ezirikunkuratira ku ziraahikwe omucuucu gwa Samaria, buri muntu yaabona ogurikwijuza oruhi, baaruhanga bakinture n'okukiraho.
en: And Ben-hadad sent unto him, and said, The gods do so unto me, and more also, if the dust of Samaria shall suffice for handfuls for all the people that follow me.

rr: Omugabe wa Israeli yaagarukamu ati: Orikujwara eby'okurwanisa naaza aha rugamba, arekye kwehimbisa nk'orikubijuura yaatabaarukire.
en: And the king of Israel answered and said, Tell him , Let not him that girdeth on his harness boast himself as he that putteth it off.

rr: Obwo Benihadadi akaba ari omu rusiisira naanywa n'abandi bagabe; ku yaahuriire obwo butumwa, yaagira engabo ze ati: Mutengye orugamba. Batyo baatenga orugamba kurwanisa orurembo. Nabi okugambira Ahabu ku arikwija kusingura
en: And it came to pass, when Ben-hadad heard this message, as he was drinking, he and the kings in the pavilions, that he said unto his servants, Set yourselves in array . And they set themselves in array against the city.

rr: Ahonaaho nabi yairira haihi Ahabu omugabe wa Israeli, yaamugira ati: Oku nikwo MUKAMA arikugamba naagira ati: Waareeba engabo ziriya zoona oku ziri nyingi? Eri izooba niinyija kuzihayo omu mikono yaawe, omanye ku ndi MUKAMA.
en: And, behold, there came a prophet unto Ahab king of Israel, saying, Thus saith the LORD , Hast thou seen all this great multitude? behold, I will deliver it into thine hand this day; and thou shalt know that I am the LORD .

rr: Ahabu yaamubuuza ati: Ou araakorese n'oha?
en: And Ahab said, By whom?

rr: Onu ati: Oku nikwo MUKAMA arikugamba naagira ati: N'abashaija b'abategyeki b'amashaza.
en: And he said, Thus saith the LORD , Even by the young men of the princes of the provinces.

rr: Yaagaruka yaamubuuza ati: oraatandikye orwo rugamba n'oha?
en: Then he said, Who shall order the battle?

rr: Yaamugarukamu ati: Niiwe.
en: And he answered, Thou.

rr: Atyo yaateerana abashaija b'abategyeki b'amashaza; baaba magana abiri na makumi ashatu na babiri; bwanyima yaabo yaateerana Abaisraeli boona, baaba enkumi mushanju.
en: Then he numbered the young men of the princes of the provinces, and they were two hundred and thirty two: and after them he numbered all the people, even all the children of Israel, being seven thousand.

rr: Baahurura omu ihangwe, Benihadadi ari omu rusiisira naayenywera asinzire, we n'abo bagabe makumi ashatu na babiri abaabaire baizire kumuha emikono.
en: And they went out at noon. But Ben-hadad was drinking himself drunk in the pavilions, he and the kings, the thirty and two kings that helped him.

rr: Abashaija b'abategyeki b'amashaza baaba nibo baabanza kuhurura. Bwanyima Benihadadi yaatuma entatsi, zaamugira ziti: Twareeba abashaija nibaruga omuri Samaria.
en: And the young men of the princes of the provinces went out first; and Ben-hadad sent out, and they told him, saying, There are men come out of Samaria.

rr: Yaagira ati: Ku baraabe bareetwa obusingye, mubakwate bahuriire; kandi ku baraabe bareetwa okurwana, nabwo mubakwate bahuriire.
en: And he said, Whether they be come out for peace, take them alive; or whether they be come out for war, take them alive.

rr: Batyo abo bashaija b'abategyeki b'amashaza baaruga omu rurembo n'eihe ribakuratiire.
en: So these young men of the princes of the provinces came out of the city, and the army which followed them.

rr: Buri muntu yaayeitira omuntu we; Abasiria baahunga, Abaisraeli baababinga, kwonka Benihadadi omugabe wa Siria yaahungira aha mbaraasi n'abatembire embaraasi, yaakira.
en: And they slew every one his man: and the Syrians fled; and Israel pursued them: and Ben-hadad the king of Syria escaped on an horse with the horsemen.

rr: Omugabe wa Israeli nawe yaahurura, yaakwata embaraasi n'ebigaari, yaita Abasiria baingi munonga.
en: And the king of Israel went out, and smote the horses and chariots, and slew the Syrians with a great slaughter.

rr: Bwanyima nabi ogwo yairira haihi omugabe wa Israeli, yaamugira ati: Irooko oyehamye, oteekateekye oku oshemereire kutwaza; ahabw'okuba omu kutandika kw'omwaka omugabe wa Siria aryagaruka kukurwanisa. Ahabu okugaruka kusingura Benihadadi
en: And the prophet came to the king of Israel, and said unto him, Go, strengthen thyself, and mark, and see what thou doest: for at the return of the year the king of Syria will come up against thee.

rr: Bwanyima abagaragwa b'omugabe wa Siria baamugira bati: Manya baaruhanga baabo ni baaruhanga b'ebibungo; nikyo baatukiriize amaani; mbwenu murekye turwanire nabo omu mpita, buzima nitwija kubakiza emikono.
en: And the servants of the king of Syria said unto him, Their gods are gods of the hills; therefore they were stronger than we; but let us fight against them in the plain, and surely we shall be stronger than they.

rr: Hati twaza oti; ihaho abo bagabe, buri omwe omwihe omu mwanya gwe, omu myanya yaabo otemu abakuru b'engabo
en: And do this thing, Take the kings away, every man out of his place, and put captains in their rooms:

rr: kandi oteerane eihe eririkwingana n'eihe eri ofeereirwe, ogarure embaraasi omu mwanya gw'embaraasi, n'ekigaari omu mwanya gw'ekigaari; haza turwanire nabo omu mpita; buzima nitwija kubakiza emikono.
en: and number thee an army, like the army that thou hast lost, horse for horse, and chariot for chariot: and we will fight against them in the plain, and surely we shall be stronger than they.

rr: Yaahurira ebi barikugamba, yaatwaza atyo.
en: And he hearkened unto their voice, and did so.

rr: Omwaka ku gwabaire nigutandika, Benihadadi yaateerana hamwe Abasiria, yainamuka Afeki kurwanisa Abaisraeli.
en: And it came to pass at the return of the year, that Ben-hadad numbered the Syrians, and went up to Aphek, to fight against Israel.

rr: N'Abaisraeli baateeranirwa hamwe, baaheebwa entanda, baaza kubarwanisa. Abaisraeli baateera orusiisira omu maisho gaabo nibashusha nk'obusyo bukye bubiri bw'embuzi, kwonka Abasiria bo baashweka ensi.
en: And the children of Israel were numbered, and were all present, and went against them: and the children of Israel pitched before them like two little flocks of kids; but the Syrians filled the country.

rr: Omushaija wa Ruhanga yairira haihi, yaagambira omugabe wa Israeli, ati: Oku nikwo MUKAMA arikugamba naagira ati: Ahabw'Abasiria okugira ngu, MUKAMA ni Ruhanga w'ebibungo, ti ruhanga w'empita, nikyo ndaaheereyo engabo ziriya enyingi munonga omu mikono yaanyu; nibwo muraamanye ku ndi MUKAMA.
en: And there came a man of God, and spake unto the king of Israel, and said, Thus saith the LORD , Because the Syrians have said, The LORD is God of the hills, but he is not God of the valleys, therefore will I deliver all this great multitude into thine hand, and ye shall know that I am the LORD .

rr: Baamara ebiro mushanju bari omu nsiisira ezirikureebana.
en: And they pitched one over against the other seven days.

rr: Bwanyima aha izooba rya mushanju orugamba rwatandika; Abaisraeli baita omu ngabo z'Abasiria abantu akasiriira kamwe omu izooba rimwe.
en: And so it was, that in the seventh day the battle was joined: and the children of Israel slew of the Syrians an hundred thousand footmen in one day.

rr: Abandi baahungira omu rurembo rwa Afeki; orugo rwarwo rw'amabaare rwagwera ababaire baahonokaho obukumi bubiri n'enkumi mushanju.
en: But the rest fled to Aphek, into the city; and there a wall fell upon twenty and seven thousand of the men that were left.

rr: Benihadadi nawe yaahunga, yaataah omu rurembo, yaaza omu kishengye ky'omunda.
en: And Ben-hadad fled, and came into the city, into an inner chamber.

rr: Abagaragwa be baamugira bati: Reeba, tuhuriire ngu abagabe b'enju ya Israeli n'abagabe b'embabazi. Nitukweshengyereza, twikirize twezirikye ebiguniya, twekome emigoye omu mitwe, tushohore, tuze aha mugabe wa Israeli; obundi akaakiza amagara gaawe, oreka kufa.
en: And his servants said unto him, Behold now, we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel are merciful kings: let us, I pray thee, put sackcloth on our loins, and ropes upon our heads, and go out to the king of Israel: peradventure he will save thy life.

rr: Batyo baayezirika ebiguniya omunda, baayekoma emigoye omu mitwe, baaza aha mugabe wa Israeli, baagira bati: Omwiru waawe Benihadadi naagira ati: Ninkweshengyereza, ndeka, ngumeho. Onu yaagira ati: Biri akiriho? Ni mwene tata.
en: So they girded sackcloth on their loins, and put ropes on their heads, and came to the king of Israel, and said, Thy servant Ben-hadad saith, I pray thee, let me live. And he said, Is he yet alive? he is my brother.

rr: Obwo abo bashaija bakaba bamutaireho eriisho, ngu bamanye ekiri omu biteekateeko bye; ku baakihuriire bati, baakiijaho, bati: Eego, Benihadadi ni mwene sho.
en: Now the men did diligently observe whether any thing would come from him, and did hastily catch it: and they said, Thy brother Ben-hadad.

rr: Ahabu yaagira ati: Mugyende mumureete.
en: Then he said, Go ye, bring him.

rr: Bwanyima Benihadadi yaashohora, yaija ah'ari, yaamutembesa omu kigaari kye.
en: Then Ben-hadad came forth to him; and he caused him to come up into the chariot.

rr: Benihadadi yaamugira ati: Endembo ezi tata yaanyagire sho, niinyija kuzigarura; kandi oryayegirira amaduuka omuri Damasiko, nk'oku sho yaagagizire omuri Samaria. Ahabu yaagira ati: ku oraagire otyo, ninkurekura. Atyo yaakora nawe endagaano, yaamurekura. MUKAMA okugwerwa kubi Ahabu ahabw'okurekura Benihadadi
en: And Ben-hadad said unto him, The cities, which my father took from thy father, I will restore; and thou shalt make streets for thee in Damascus, as my father made in Samaria. Then said Ahab , I will send thee away with this covenant. So he made a covenant with him, and sent him away.

rr: Omushaija omwe ow'omuri batabani ba baanabi yaagambira mugyenzi we ekigambo eki MUKAMA amuragiire ati: Ninkweshengyereza, nteera.
en: And a certain man of the sons of the prophets said unto his neighbour in the word of the LORD , Smite me, I pray thee.

rr: Onu yaayanga kumuteera.
en: And the man refused to smite him.

rr: Bwanyima yaamugira ati: Ahabw'okutahurira iraka rya MUKAMA, ku oraabe wandugaho oti, entare neekwita.
en: Then said he unto him, Because thou hast not obeyed the voice of the LORD , behold, as soon as thou art departed from me, a lion shall slay thee.

rr: Atyo ku yaabaire yaamurugaho, entare yaamubugana, yaamwita.
en: And as soon as he was departed from him, a lion found him, and slew him.

rr: Yaagaruka yaareeba ondiijo mushaija, yaamugira ati: Ninkweshengyereza, nteera. Ogwo mushaija yaamuteera, yaamuhutaaza.
en: Then he found another man, and said, Smite me, I pray thee. And the man smote him, so that in smiting he wounded him .

rr: Atyo nabi ogwo yaagyenda, yaategyereza omugabe aha rubaju rw'omuhanda, yaayehindura okundi ayekomire ekitambaara aha maisho.
en: So the prophet departed, and waited for the king by the way, and disguised himself with ashes upon his face.

rr: Omugabe ku yaabaire naahinguraho, nabi ogwo yaamweta, yaagira ati: Nyowe omwiru waawe ngiire omu rugamba; bwanyima reeba, omushaija yaakubuuka, yandeetera omushaija, yangira ati: Rinda omushaija ogu. Ku araabure, noomuzira; nari noija kuriha etalanta emwe y'efeeza.
en: And as the king passed by, he cried unto the king: and he said, Thy servant went out into the midst of the battle; and, behold, a man turned aside, and brought a man unto me, and said, Keep this man: if by any means he be missing, then shall thy life be for his life, or else thou shalt pay a talent of silver.

rr: Kwonka nyowe omwiru waawe ku mbaire nindabanamu ninkora oku n'oku, yaabura.
en: And as thy servant was busy here and there, he was gone.

rr: Omugabe wa Israeli yaamugira ati: Orubanja rwawe nikwo ruraabe rutyo; niiwe waarwecwera.
en: And the king of Israel said unto him, So shall thy judgment be ; thyself hast decided it .

rr: Nabi ogwo yaarahuka yaiha ekitambaara aha maisho; omugabe wa Israeli yaamumanya ku ari ow'omuri baanabi.
en: And he hasted, and took the ashes away from his face; and the king of Israel discerned him that he was of the prophets.

rr: Yaagaruka yaamugira ati: Oku nikwo MUKAMA arikugamba naagira ati: Ahabw'okurekura omushaija ou mbaire mpaireyo kwitirwa kimwe, amagara gaawe nigaija kuzira age, n'abantu baawe bazire abe.
en: And he said unto him, Thus saith the LORD , Because thou hast let go out of thy hand a man whom I appointed to utter destruction, therefore thy life shall go for his life, and thy people for his people.

rr: Omugabe wa Israeli yaagaruka Samaria, yaataaha omu nju ye aine enaku kandi agwirwe kubi.
en: And the king of Israel went to his house heavy and displeased, and came to Samaria.

rr: Kandi hakaba hariho omushaija orikwetwa Nabosi owa Yezereeli, owaabaire aine omusiri gw'emizaabibu haihi n'ekikaari kya Ahabu omugabe wa Samaria.
en: And it came to pass after these things, that Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard, which was in Jezreel, hard by the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.

rr: Bwanyima Ahabu yaagira Nabosi ati: Mpa omusiri gwawe gw'emizaabibu, ngugire ogw'okuhingamu emboga, ahabw'okuba guri haihi n'eka yangye; naanye niinyija kukuha ogundi musiri gw'emizaabibu ogurikuguhita; nari shi, ku oraabe nookisiima, nkuhe empiiha ezigushemereire.
en: And Ahab spake unto Naboth, saying, Give me thy vineyard, that I may have it for a garden of herbs, because it is near unto my house: and I will give thee for it a better vineyard than it; or , if it seem good to thee, I will give thee the worth of it in money.

rr: Nabosi yaagira Ahabu ati: Nikikabure nyowe okukuha obuhunguzi bwa baatatenkuru.
en: And Naboth said to Ahab, The LORD forbid it me, that I should give the inheritance of my fathers unto thee.

rr: Ahabu yaagaruka omuka aine enaku, kandi agwirwe kubi ahabw'ekigambo eki Nabosi owa Yezereeli yaamugambira; ahakuba akamugira ati: Tindikwija kukuha buhunguzi bwa baatatenkuru.
en: And Ahab came into his house heavy and displeased because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him: for he had said, I will not give thee the inheritance of my fathers.

rr: Yaabyama aha kitanda kye, ahugikire omushaya, yaayanga n'okurya.
en: And he laid him down upon his bed, and turned away his face, and would eat no bread.

rr: Bwanyima Yezebeeli omukazi we yaija, yaamubuuza ati: N'enki ekikugwisize kubi, kikakuzibira kurya?
en: But Jezebel his wife came to him, and said unto him, Why is thy spirit so sad, that thou eatest no bread?

rr: Onu yaamugarukamu ati: Ahabw'okuba naagira Nabosi owa Yezereeli nti: Mpa omusiri gwawe gw'emizaabibu, ngugure empiiha, nari hsi, ku oraabe nokisiima, nkuhe ogundi omu mwanya gwagwo; nawe yangarukamu ati: Tindikwija kukuha musiri gwangye.
en: And he said unto her, Because I spake unto Naboth the Jezreelite, and said unto him, Give me thy vineyard for money; or else, if it please thee, I will give thee another vineyard for it: and he answered, I will not give thee my vineyard.

rr: Omukazi we Yezebeeli yaamugarukamu ati: Reeba mihi, tiiwe orikutegyeka Israeli? Imuka orye, omutima gwawe gushemererwe. Nyowe niinyija kukuha ogwo musiri gwa Nabosi owa Yezereeli.
en: And Jezebel his wife said unto him, Dost thou now govern the kingdom of Israel? arise, and eat bread, and let thine heart be merry: I will give thee the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.

rr: Atyo Yezebeeli yaahandiika ebaruha omu iziina rya Ahabu, yaazitaho akamanyiso ka Ahabu, yaazitwekyera abakuru b'orurembo n'abakungu abaabaire batwire na Nabosi omuri orwo rurembo.
en: So she wrote letters in Ahab's name, and sealed them with his seal, and sent the letters unto the elders and to the nobles that were in his city, dwelling with Naboth.

rr: Yaahandiika omuri ezo baruha ati: Murangirire abantu boona, beesiibyekwo, mute Nabosi omu maisho g'abantu omu mwanya ogurikureebwa
en: And she wrote in the letters, saying, Proclaim a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people:

rr: omu maisho ge mutemu abashaija babiri abataine ku bari, bamwomesereze nibagira bati: Okyeenire Ruhanga n'omugabe.
en: and set two men, sons of Belial, before him, to bear witness against him, saying, Thou didst blaspheme God and the king.

rr: Bwanyima mumushohoze aheeru, mumuteere amabaare, afe.
en: And then carry him out, and stone him, that he may die.

rr: Abashaija b'omuri orwo rurembo, abakuru baarwo n'abakungu abaabaire barutwiremu, baakora nk'oku Yezebeeli abatumireho omu baruha ze ezi abatwekyeire.
en: And the men of his city, even the elders and the nobles who were the inhabitants in his city, did as Jezebel had sent unto them, and as it was written in the letters which she had sent unto them.

rr: Baarangirira abantu okwesiibyakwo, baata Nabosi omu maisho g'abantu omu mwanya ogurikureebwa.
en: They proclaimed a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.

rr: Bwanyima abo bashaija babiri abataine ku bari baija, baashutama omu maisho ga Nabosi, baamwomeserereza omu maisho g'abantu, nibagira bati: Nabosi akyeenire Ruhanga n'omugabe.
en: And there came in two men, children of Belial, and sat before him: and the men of Belial witnessed against him, even against Naboth, in the presence of the people, saying, Naboth did blaspheme God and the king.

rr: Omuri ako kaanya baamushohoza aheeru y'orurembo, baamuteera amabaare, yaafa.
en: Then they carried him forth out of the city, and stoned him with stones, that he died.

rr: Bwanyima baatuma ahari Yezebeeli bati: Nabosi baamuteera amabaare, yaafa.
en: Then they sent to Jezebel, saying, Naboth is stoned, and is dead.

rr: Yezebeeli, ku yaahuriire ngu Nabosi baamuteera amabaare, yaafa, yaagira Ahabu ati: Imuka, otware omusiri gw'emizaabibu ogu Nabosi owa Yezereeli abaire ayangire kukuguza; ahabw'okuba Nabosi yaafa, takiriho.
en: And it came to pass, when Jezebel heard that Naboth was stoned, and was dead, that Jezebel said to Ahab, Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he refused to give thee for money: for Naboth is not alive, but dead.

rr: Ahonaaho Ahabu ku yaahuriire ngu Nabosi yaafa, yaimuka, yaashuuma omuri ogwo musiri gw'emizaabibu ogwa Nabosi owa Yezereeli kugutwara.
en: And it came to pass, when Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, that Ahab rose up to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, to take possession of it.

rr: Eliya okutumwa kukyeena Ahabu
en: Elijah denounces Ahab

rr: Bwanyima ekigambo kya MUKAMA kyaija ahari Eliya owa Tishubi, nikigira kiti
en: And the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

rr: Imuka oshuume, obugane Ahabu omugabe wa Israeli, otwire Samaria; reeba, ari omu musiri gwa Nabosi gw'emizaabibu, ogu yaashuuma kutwara
en: Arise, go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, which is in Samaria: behold, he is in the vineyard of Naboth, whither he is gone down to possess it.

rr: omugire oti: Oku nikwo MUKAMA arikugamba naagira ati: Oitsire, kandi waataho nokunyaga? Kandi omugire oti: Oku nikwo MUKAMA arikugamba. Omu mwanya ogu embwa zikombeiremu eshagama ya Nabosi, nimwo zirikombera eshagama yaawe wenka.
en: And thou shalt speak unto him, saying, Thus saith the LORD , Hast thou killed, and also taken possession? And thou shalt speak unto him, saying, Thus saith the LORD , In the place where dogs licked the blood of Naboth shall dogs lick thy blood, even thine.

rr: Ahabu yaagira Eliya ati: Iwe muzigu wangye 'we, wandeeba?
en: And Ahab said to Elijah, Hast thou found me, O mine enemy?

rr: Yaamugarukamu ati: Naakureeba, ahakuba okeehayo kukora ebirikwangwa MUKAMA.
en: And he answered, I have found thee: because thou hast sold thyself to work evil in the sight of the LORD .

rr: Niinyija kukureetaho akabi, nkwihireho kimwe, nkumareho buri mwana weena ow'omwojo, yaaba muhuuku nari ow'obusingye omuri Israeli
en: Behold, I will bring evil upon thee, and will take away thy posterity, and will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel,

rr: ndyagira enju yaawe nk'eya Yeroboamu mwene Nebati, kandi nk'eya Baasha mwene Ahiya, ahabw'okungwisa kubi, n'okucumuza Abaisraeli.
en: and will make thine house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah, for the provocation wherewith thou hast provoked me to anger, and made Israel to sin.

rr: Kandi ebya Yezebeeli nabyo, MUKAMA yaabigambaho ati: Embwa ziryariira Yezebeeli haihi n'orugo rw'amabaare orw'orurembo Yezereeli.
en: And of Jezebel also spake the LORD , saying, The dogs shall eat Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel.

rr: Omuntu wa Ahabu weena origwa omu rurembo aryariibwa embwa; kandi origwa omu ishwa aryashokoorwa amahungu.
en: Him that dieth of Ahab in the city the dogs shall eat; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat.

rr: 1 Tihariho n'omwe owaayehaireyo kukora ebirikwangwa MUKAMA nka Ahabu, ou Yezebeeli omukazi we yaayohize.
en: But there was none like unto Ahab, which did sell himself to work wickedness in the sight of the LORD , whom Jezebel his wife stirred up.

rr: Akakora ebihagaro bingi munonga omu kukuratira ebishushani ebirikuramibwa, nk'ebi Abaamori baakozire byona, abu MUKAMA yaabingire omu maisho g'Abaisraeli, oku byabaire biri.
en: And he did very abominably in following idols, according to all things as did the Amorites, whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.

rr: Ahabu ku yaahuriire ebigambo ebyo, yaataagura ebijwaro bye, yaajwara ebiguniya, yaayesiibyakwo abyami omu biguniya, yaagyenda ayeinamiriire.
en: And it came to pass, when Ahab heard those words, that he rent his clothes, and put sackcloth upon his flesh, and fasted, and lay in sackcloth, and went softly.

rr: Bwanyima ekigambo kya MUKAMA kyaija ahari Eliya owa Tishubi, nikigira kiti
en: And the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

rr: Oreebire Ahabu oku ayecureize omu maisho gangye? Ahabw'okwecureeza omu maisho gangye, tindireeta kabii omu busingye bwe; kureka omu busingye bw'omutabani nimwo ndireetera akabi aha nju ye. rr: 2 Kandi Abasiria n'Abaisraeli bakamara emyaka eshatu batarikurwana.
en: And they continued three years without war between Syria and Israel.

rr: Kwonka omu mwaka gwa kashatu Yehoshafaati omugabe wa Yuda yaashuuma ow' omugabe wa Israeli.
en: And it came to pass in the third year, that Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel.

rr: Omugabe wa Israeli yaagira abagaragwa be ati: Timurikumanya Ramosi-gileadi ku eri eyaitu? Mbwenu twetsirize titwagiiha mu mikono y'omugabe wa Siria.
en: And the king of Israel said unto his servants, Know ye that Ramoth in Gilead is ours, and we be still, and take it not out of the hand of the king of Syria?

rr: Yaabuuza Yehoshafaati ati: Noija kuhurura naanye, tuteere Ramosi-gileadi?
en: And he said unto Jehoshaphat, Wilt thou go with me to battle to Ramoth-gilead?

rr: Yehoshafaati yaagira omugabe wa Israeli ati: Nyowe naiwe turi bamwe, abantu bangye nibo baawe, n'embaraasi zangye nizo zaawe.
en: And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, I am as thou art , my people as thy people, my horses as thy horses.

rr: Yehoshafaati yaagira omugabe wa Israeli ati: Ninkweshengyereza, banza oyehanuuze ahari MUKAMA, oreebe eki arikugamba eri izooba.
en: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel, Enquire, I pray thee, at the word of the LORD to day.

rr: Atyo omugabe wa Israeli yaateeranira ahamwe baanabi, abashaija magana ana, yaababuuza ati: Nteere Ramosi-gileadi, nari ndereere?
en: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, about four hundred men, and said unto them, Shall I go against Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall I forbear?

rr: Baamugarukamu bati: Irooko ohurure, ahakuba MUKAMA naija kugihayo omu mikono y'omugabe.
en: And they said, Go up; for the Lord shall deliver it into the hand of the king.

rr: Kwonka Yehoshafaati yaagaruka yaabuuza ati: Beitu shi aha, tihariho nabi wa MUKAMA, tukamubuuza?
en: And Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of the LORD besides, that we might enquire of him?

rr: Omugabe wa Israeli yaagira Yehoshafaati ati: Hakiriho omushaija omwe ou turikubaasa kwehanuuzaho ebya MUKAMA, niwe Mikaaya mwene Imula; kwonka nimmwanga, ahabw'okuba tandagurira birungi kureka ebibi.
en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, There is yet one man, Micaiah the son of Imlah, by whom we may enquire of the LORD : but I hate him; for he doth not prophesy good concerning me, but evil.

rr: Yehoshafaati yaagira ati: Nyakusinga, reka kugamba otyo.
en: And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.

rr: Atyo omugabe wa Israeli yaayeta omukuru w'abaserukare, yaamugira ati: Ndahukiza Mikaaya mwene Imula.
en: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, Hasten hither Micaiah the son of Imlah.

rr: Obwo omugabe wa Israeli na Yehoshafaati omugabe wa Yuda bakaba bashutami aha bitebe byabo eby'obugabe, bajwaire zaabushuuti zaabo, bari aha mbuga omu irembo rya Samaria, baanabi boona babari omumaisho nibaragura.
en: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah sat each on his throne, having put on their robes, in a void place in the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.

rr: Zedekia mwene Kenaana yaayekorera amahembe g'ekyoma, yaaragura ati: Oku nikwo MUKAMA arikugamba naagira ati: Aga mahembe nigo oraabingise Abasiria okuhitsya obu baraacwekyerere.
en: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made him horns of iron: and he said, Thus saith the LORD , With these shalt thou push the Syrians, until thou have consumed them.

rr: Kandi na baanabi boona baaragura batyo, nibagira bati: Irooko oteere Ramosi-gileadi, osingure; MUKAMA naija kugihayo omu mikono y'omugabe. Okuragura kwa Mikaaya
en: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramoth-gilead, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver it into the king's hand.

rr: Entumwa eyaaza kweta Mikaaya yaamugira eti: Reeba, ebigambo bya baanabi nibiikirizana biragura gye ah mugabe; naiwe ebigambo byawe bibe nk'ebyabo, oragure gye.
en: And the messenger that was gone to call Micaiah spake unto him, saying, Behold now, the words of the prophets declare good unto the king with one mouth: let thy word, I pray thee, be like the word of one of them, and speak that which is good.

rr: Kwonka Mikaaya yaagira ati: Nindahira MUKAMA, eki MUKAMA arangambire, nikyo ndaagambe.
en: And Micaiah said, As the LORD liveth, what the LORD saith unto me, that will I speak.

rr: Ku yaahikire omugabe, omugabe yaamubuuza ati: Mikaaya, tuteere Ramosi-gileadi, nari turereere? Yaamugarukamu ati: Hurura osingure; MUKAMA naija kugihayo omu mikono y'omugabe.
en: So he came to the king. And the king said unto him, Micaiah, shall we go against Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall we forbear? And he answered him, Go, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver it into the hand of the king.

rr: Omugabe yaamugira ati: Niinyija kukurahiza kangahi otarikungambira kindi omu iziina rya MUKAMA kureka amazima?
en: And the king said unto him, How many times shall I adjure thee that thou tell me nothing but that which is true in the name of the LORD ?

rr: Onu yaamugarukamu ati: Ndeebire Abaisraeli boona bataataaniire aha bibungo nk'entaama ezitaine muriisa; MUKAMA yaagira ati: Aba tibaine mukama waabo; boona bagarukyeyo n'obusingye, buri muntu omu ka ye.
en: And he said, I saw all Israel scattered upon the hills, as sheep that have not a shepherd: and the LORD said, These have no master: let them return every man to his house in peace.

rr: Omugabe wa Israeli yaagira Yehoshafaati ati: Tinakugambira nti: Tarikwija kundagurira birungi kureka ebibi?
en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell thee that he would prophesy no good concerning me, but evil?

rr: Mikaaya yaagaruka yaagira ati: Mbwenu hurira ekigambo kya MUKAMA. Naareeba MUKAMA ashutami aha kitebe kye, n'ehe ryona ery'omu iguru ryemereire aha rubaju rwe rwa buryo n'orwa bumosho
en: And he said, Hear thou therefore the word of the LORD : I saw the LORD sitting on his throne, and all the host of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira ati: N'oha oraabeihabeihe Ahabu, akateera Ramosi-gileadi, akagwayo.
en: And the LORD said, Who shall persuade Ahab, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth-gilead?

rr: Omwe yaagamba okundi, n'ondi okundi.
en: And one said on this manner, and another said on that manner.

rr: Bwanyima haija omwoyo, gwayemerera omu maisho ga MUKAMA, gwagira guti: Niinye ndaamubeihabeihe.
en: And there came forth a spirit, and stood before the LORD , and said, I will persuade him.

rr: MUKAMA yaagugira ati: Noomubeihabeihesa ki?
en: And the LORD said unto him, Wherewith?

rr: Gwagira guti: Niinyija kugyenda, mpindukye omwoyo gw'ebishuba, nambire omuri baanabi be boona.
en: And he said, I will go forth, and I will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira ati: Niiwe oraamubeihabeihe; kandi noija kukibaasa; irooko okore otyo.
en: And he said, Thou shalt persuade him , and prevail also: go forth, and do so.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo reeba, MUKAMA ataire omwoyo gw'ebishuba omuri baanabi baawe aba boona. Kandi MUKAMA akugambireho kubi.
en: Now therefore, behold, the LORD hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these thy prophets, and the LORD hath spoken evil concerning thee.

rr: Bwanyima Zedekia mwene Kenaana yairira haihi, yaateera Mikaaya oruhi rw'omushaaya, naagira ati: Omwoyo wa MUKAMA andabireho ata kugamba naiwe?
en: But Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah went near, and smote Micaiah on the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of the LORD from me to speak unto thee?

rr: Mikaaya yaagira ati: Mbwenu oryakireeba ahari eryo izooba ku oriba nooza kweshereka omu kishengye ky'omunda.
en: And Micaiah said, Behold, thou shalt see in that day, when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.

rr: Omugabe wa Israeli yaagira ati: Twara Mikaaya, omugarure ahari Amoni omukuru w'orurembo, na Yoasi mutabani w'omugabe
en: And the king of Israel said, Take Micaiah, and carry him back unto Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king's son;

rr: omugire oti: Oku nikwo omugabe arikugamba naagira ati: Mute ekishaija eki omu kihome, mukiriise eby'okurya kandi mukinywaise amaizi eby'akahenano, okuhitsya obu ndaagarukye n'obusingye.
en: and say, Thus saith the king, Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I come in peace.

rr: Mikaaya yaagira ati: Ku oraagarukye n'obusingye, biri MUKAMA tagambire naaraba omuriinye. Yaagaruka yaagira ati: Naimwe bantu 'mwe mwena, mukihurire! Okufa kwa Ahabu
en: And Micaiah said, If thou return at all in peace, the LORD hath not spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, O people, every one of you.

rr: Bwanyima omugabe wa Israeli na Yehoshafaati omugabe wa Yuda bainamuka, baateera Ramosi-gileadi.
en: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth-gilead.

rr: Omugabe wa Israeli yaagira Yehoshafaati ati: Nyowe naaza kwehindura, nze kurwana, kwonka iwe ogume ojwaire eby'okujwara byawe by'obugabe.
en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and enter into the battle; but put thou on thy robes.

rr: Omugabe wa Israeli yaayehindura, yaaza aha rugamba.
en: And the king of Israel disguised himself, and went into the battle.

rr: Kandi omugabe wa Siria akaba aragiire abakuru makumi ashatu na babiri b'ebigaari bye by'okurwanisa, ati: Mutarwana n'abato n'obu baakuba abakuru, kureka omugabe wa Israeli wenka.
en: But the king of Syria commanded his thirty and two captains that had rule over his chariots, saying, Fight neither with small nor great, save only with the king of Israel.

rr: Abo bakuru b'ebigaari ku baareebire Yehoshafaati, baagira bati: Buzima oriya niwe mugabe wa Israeli.
en: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, Surely it is the king of Israel.

rr: Baakubuuka kurwana nawe; Yehoshafaati yaateera enduuru.
en: And they turned aside to fight against him: and Jehoshaphat cried out.

rr: Abakuru b'ebigaari ku baareebire atari mugabe wa Israeli, baagarukayo, baareka kumubinga.
en: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Israel, that they turned back from pursuing him.

rr: Kwonka omushaija yaananuura obuta, yaafa okurasha omwambi, yaateera omugabe wa Israeli ahu ebijwaro bye by'okurwanisa n'eky'aha kifuba birikuteeranira; nawe nikwo kugambira omuvugi w'ekigaari kye ati: Hinduka, onyihe omu rugamba, ahabw'okuba naahutaara munonga.
en: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness: wherefore he said unto the driver of his chariot, Turn thine hand, and carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.

rr: Eryo izooba orugamba rwayeyongyera amaani, omugabe baamuhigika omu kigaari kye naareeba Abasiria, okuhitsya obu yaafiire omu mwabazyo; n'eshagama yaaruga omu buhuta, yaahimintika yaatarama omu kigaari.
en: And the battle increased that day: and the king was stayed up in his chariot against the Syrians, and died at even: and the blood ran out of the wound into the midst of the chariot.

rr: Eizooba ku ryabaire nirirengarenga, haabaho okurangirira omu ihe ryona nibagira bati: Buri muntu agarukye omu rurembo rwabo n'omu nsi yaabo.
en: And there went a proclamation throughout the host about the going down of the sun, saying, Every man to his city, and every man to his own country.

rr: Atyo omugabe yaafa, baamureeta Samaria, baamuziikayo.
en: So the king died, and was brought to Samaria; and they buried the king in Samaria.

rr: Kandi ekigaari kye baakyogyeza aha kiyanja kya Samaria, n'embwa zaakombera eshagama ye, ahu baamaraaya baabaire boogyera, nk'ekigambo eki MUKAMA yaagambire oku kyabaire kiri.
en: And one washed the chariot in the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked up his blood; and they washed his armour; according unto the word of the LORD which he spake.

rr: Endiijo mirimo ya Ahabu n'ebi yaakozire byona, na nyaruju ye ei yaayombekyeise emiino, n'endembo zoona ezi yaayombekire, tibihandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'eby'omu busingye bw'abagabe ba Israeli?
en: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that he did, and the ivory house which he made, and all the cities that he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

rr: Atyo Ahabu yaagwejegyerea, yaashanga baishenkuru, omutabani Ahazia yaategyeka omu mwanya gwe. Ebya Yehoshafaati
en: So Ahab slept with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead. The Two Kingdoms

rr: 2 —33:19. Yehoshafaati mwene Asa akatandika kutegyeka Yuda omu mwaka gwa kana ogw'omu busingye bwa Ahabu omugabe wa Israeli.
en: And Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.

rr: Obu yaatandika kutegyeka, akaba ahikize emyaka makumi ashatu n'etaano; yaategyekyera emyaka makumi abiri n'etaano omuri Yerusaalemu; kandi nyina akaba naayetwa Azuuba, muhara wa Shiluhi.
en: Jehoshaphat was thirty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.

rr: Yaagyendera omu mihanda yoona eya Asa ishe, tiyaateishuka kugirugamu, kureka yaakora ebirikusiimwa MUKAMA; kwonka emyanya mikuru ey'okuramizamu tiyaihwaho, kureka abantu baaguma nibatambirirayo ebitambo, n'okwotererayo obubaane.
en: And he walked in all the ways of Asa his father; he turned not aside from it, doing that which was right in the eyes of the LORD : nevertheless the high places were not taken away; for the people offered and burnt incense yet in the high places.

rr: Kandi Yehoshafaati yaaragaan endagaano y'obusingye n'omugabe wa Israeli.
en: And Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.

rr: Endiijo mirimo ya Yehoshafaati n'amaani agu yaayorekire n'oku yaarwaine engamba, tibihandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'eby'omu busingye bw'abagabe ba Yuda?
en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his might that he shewed, and how he warred, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

rr: Kandi ebitingwa ebyatsigaireho omu busingye bwa Asa ishe, yaabimara omu nsi.
en: And the remnant of the sodomites, which remained in the days of his father Asa, he took out of the land.

rr: Omu biro ebyo Edomu hakaba hatarimu mugabe, kureka omutsigire.
en: There was then no king in Edom: a deputy was king.

rr: Yehoshafaati akakora emeeri za Tarushiishi ez'okuza Ofiri kwihayo ezaabu; kwonka tizaahikayo, ahakuba zikafeera Ezioni-geberi.
en: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tharshish to go to Ophir for gold: but they went not; for the ships were broken at Ezion-geber.

rr: Bwanyima Ahazia mwene Ahabu yaagira Yehoshafaati ati: Reka abashaija bangye bagyende n'abaawe omu meeri; kwonka Yehoshafaati tiyaakisiima.
en: Then said Ahaziah the son of Ahab unto Jehoshaphat, Let my servants go with thy servants in the ships. But Jehoshaphat would not.

rr: Bwanyima Yehoshafaati yaagwejegyera, yaashanga baishenkuru, yaaziikwa nabo omu rurembo rwa Daudi ishenkuru; Yehoraamu omutabani yaategyeka omu mwanya gwe. Ebya Ahazia omugabe wa Israeli
en: And Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.

rr: Ahazia mwene Ahabu akatandika kutegyeka Israeli omuri Samaria omu mwaka gwa ikumi na mushanju ogw'omu busingye bwa Yehoshafaati omugabe wa Yuda; yaamara emyaka ebiri naategyeka Israeli.
en: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned two years over Israel.

rr: Yaakora ebirikwangwa MUKAMA, naagyendera omu mihanda ya ishe na nyina, n'omu muhanda gwa Yeroboamu mwene Nebati owaasiisiise Abaisraeli.
en: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD , and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin:

rr: 1 Yaaguma naaheereza Baali, naamuramya, yaitsa MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli ekiniga omu muringo gwona ogu ishe yaatwarizemu.
en: for he served Baal, and worshipped him, and provoked to anger the LORD God of Israel, according to all that his father had done.

en: 1 Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
2 elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace unto you, and peace, be multiplied.

rr: 3 Ruhanga, Ishe wa Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo, asiimwe! Ahabw'embabazi ze nyingi akatuzaara obwa kabiri ngu tugire amatsiko agatahwaho ahabw'okuzooka omu bafu kwa Yesu Kristo
en: 3 Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

rr: 4 ngu tutungye obuhunguzi obutarikubaasa kuhwerekyerera, obutarikusiisikara, kandi obutarikuhunduuka, obwababiikiirwe omu iguru
en: 4 to an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,
5 who are kept by the power of God through faith unto salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
6 Wherein ye greatly rejoice, though now for a season, if need be, ye are in heaviness through manifold temptations:
7 that the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perisheth, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ:
8 whom having not seen, ye love; in whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory:

rr: 9 nimuheebwa okujunwa kw'amagara gaanyu, nk'ebihembo by'okwikiriza kwanyu.
en: 9 receiving the end of your faith, even the salvation of your souls.
10 Of which salvation the prophets have enquired and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you:
11 searching what, or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did signify, when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ, and the glory that should follow.

rr: 12 Kandi nabo bakashuuruurirwa, baamanya ngu ti habw'abo bonka, kureka n'ahabwanyu, baaragura ebigambo, ebi mugambiirwe omu biro ebi abantu abaababuuriire ebigambo birungi ahabw'Omwoyo Orikwera owaatumirwe naaruga omu iguru; kandi ebigambo ebyo na baamaraika nibeetenga kubyetegyereza.
en: 12 Unto whom it was revealed, that not unto themselves, but unto us they did minister the things, which are now reported unto you by them that have preached the gospel unto you with the Holy Ghost sent down from heaven; which things the angels desire to look into.
13 Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind, be sober, and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;
14 as obedient children, not fashioning yourselves according to the former lusts in your ignorance:

rr: 15 kureka nk'Ogwo owaabeetsire oku ari orikwera, naimwe mube nikwo mwaba abarikwera omu micwe yaanyu yoona
en: 15 but as he which hath called you is holy, so be ye holy in all manner of conversation;

rr: 16 ahakuba kikahandiikwa ngu: Muryaba abarikwera, ahabw'okuba nyowe ndi orikwera.
en: 16 because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
17 And if ye call on the Father, who without respect of persons judgeth according to every man's work, pass the time of your sojourning here in fear:
18 forasmuch as ye know that ye were not redeemed with corruptible things, as silver and gold, from your vain conversation received by tradition from your fathers;
19 but with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot:

rr: 20 owaamanyirwe ira ensi etakahangirwe, kwonka akoorekwa omu bunaku bw'aha mperu ahabwanyu
en: 20 who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,
21 who by him do believe in God, that raised him up from the dead, and gave him glory; that your faith and hope might be in God.
22 Seeing ye have purified your souls in obeying the truth through the Spirit unto unfeigned love of the brethren, see that ye love one another with a pure heart fervently:
23 being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of God, which liveth and abideth for ever.
24 For

rr: 25 Kwonka ekigambo kya Ruhanga kigumaho ebiro byona. Kandi ekigambo ekyo nibwo butumwa burungi obu mwagambiirwe.
en: 25 But the word of the Lord endureth for ever.
1 Wherefore laying aside all malice, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, and all evil speakings,
2 as newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word, that ye may grow thereby:
3 if so be ye have tasted that the Lord is gracious.
4 To whom coming, as unto a living stone, disallowed indeed of men, but chosen of God, and precious,

rr: 5 kandi naimwe nk'amabaare agahuriire mwombekirwe okuba enju y'omwoyo, n'oruganda rw'abanyamurwa abarikwera ab'okutamba ebitambo by'omwyo ebirikusiimwa Ruhanga ahabwa Yesu Kristo.
en: 5 ye also, as lively stones, are built up a spiritual house, an holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God by Jesus Christ.

rr: 6 Ahakuba omu Byahandiikirwe kikahandiikwa ngu
en: 6 Wherefore also it is contained in the scripture,

rr: 7 N'ahabw'ekyo ahariimwe abarikwikiriza n'Ow'obuguzi bwingi, kwonka aha batarikwikiriza kikahandiikwa ngu
en: 7 Unto you therefore which believe he is precious: but unto them which be disobedient,
8 and
9 But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:
10 which in time past were not a people, but are now the people of God: which had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
11 Dearly beloved, I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;
12 having your conversation honest among the Gentiles: that, whereas they speak against you as evildoers, they may by your good works, which they shall behold, glorify God in the day of visitation.
13 Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord's sake: whether it be to the king, as supreme;

rr: 14 nari obw'abategyeki nk'abatairweho Ogwo kuhana enkozi z'ebibi, n'okusiima abarikukora gye.
en: 14 or unto governors, as unto them that are sent by him for the punishment of evildoers, and for the praise of them that do well.
15 For so is the will of God, that with well doing ye may put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:
16 as free, and not using your liberty for a cloke of maliciousness, but as the servants of God.

rr: 17 Muhe abantu boona ekitiinisa. Mukunde ab'eishe-emwe. Mutiine Ruhanga. Muhe omugabe ekitiinisa.
en: 17 Honour all men . Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honour the king.
18 Servants, be subject to your masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the froward.

rr: 19 Ahakuba omuntu asiimwe, yaagumisiririza obusaasi naaturwa busha, ahabw'okugira omutima murungi ahari Ruhanga.
en: 19 For this is thankworthy, if a man for conscience toward God endure grief, suffering wrongfully.
20 For what glory is it , if, when ye be buffeted for your faults, ye shall take it patiently? but if, when ye do well, and suffer for it , ye take it patiently, this is acceptable with God.
21 For even hereunto were ye called: because Christ also suffered for us, leaving us an example, that ye should follow his steps:
22 who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth:

rr: 23 Ku yaajumirwe, tiyaabagarurira; ku yaabonabonesiibwe, tiyaabahayira, kureka kaeehayo ahari Ogwo ocwa emanja z'amazima.
en: 23 who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered, he threatened not; but committed himself to him that judgeth righteously:
24 who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree, that we, being dead to sins, should live unto righteousness: by whose stripes ye were healed.
25 For ye were as sheep going astray; but are now returned unto the Shepherd and Bishop of your souls.
1 Likewise, ye wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives;

rr: 2 ahabw'okureeba emitwarize yaanyu mirungi ey'okutiina Ruhanga.
en: 2 while they behold your chaste conversation coupled with fear.
3 Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel;

rr: 4 kureka okwecuma kwanyu kube okw'omunda omu mutima, okw'ekijwaro ekitasiisikara eky'omwoyo omucureezi ogutuurize ogw'obuguzi bwingi omu maisho ga Ruhanga.
en: 4 but let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.

rr: 5 N'abakazi abarikwera aba ira, abaabaire baine amatsiko ahari Ruhanga, nikwo baabaire beecuma, niboorobera baibabo
en: 5 For after this manner in the old time the holy women also, who trusted in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection unto their own husbands:
6 even as Sara obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose daughters ye are, as long as ye do well, and are not afraid with any amazement.

7 Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered.

rr: 8 Eky'aha muheru mwena mukwatanise omu mwoyo, musaasirane, mukundane nk'eishe-emwe, mugirirane embabazi n'omutima omucureezi.
en: 8 Finally, be ye all of one mind, having compassion one of another, love as brethren, be pitiful, be courteous:
9 not rendering evil for evil, or railing for railing: but contrariwise blessing; knowing that ye are thereunto called, that ye should inherit a blessing.
10 For

rr: 11 Kandi ahindukye arugye omu bubi, akore ebirungi
en: 11 Let him eschew evil, and do good;
12 For the eyes of the Lord are over the righteous,

rr: 13 Mbwenu n'oha oribakora kubi, ku muraabe nimwezirika kukora ebirungi?
en: 13 And who is he that will harm you, if ye be followers of that which is good?
14 But and if ye suffer for righteousness' sake, happy are ye : and be not afraid of their terror, neither be troubled;

rr: 15 kureka muhe Kristo ekitiinisa nka Mukama omu mitima yaanyu. Mugume mweteekateekire kushobororera omuntu weena orikubashobooroza eby'amatsiko agu mwine, kwonka mubashobororere n'obucureezi n'okutiina Ruhanga
en: 15 but sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:

rr: 16 n'omutima ogutarikweshinja, ngu omuri ebyo ebi murikugambwaho kubi, abarikujuma emitwarize yaanyu mirungi ey'omuri Kristo bakwatwe enshoni.
en: 16 having a good conscience; that, whereas they speak evil of you, as of evildoers, they may be ashamed that falsely accuse your good conversation in Christ.
17 For it is better, if the will of God be so, that ye suffer for well doing, than for evil doing.
18 For Christ also hath once suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to God, being put to death in the flesh, but quickened by the Spirit:

rr: 19 ou yaagyendeiremu okubuurira emyoyo ey'omu kihome
en: 19 by which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison;

rr: 20 ey'abantu abatarahuriire Ruhanga ira, obu yaagumisiriza omu biro bya Noa, nibakikora emeeri, ei abantu bakye munaana bakiriiremu amaizi.
en: 20 which sometime were disobedient, when once the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls were saved by water.

rr: 21 Amaizi ago nikyo kishushani ky'ago agabakiza omu kubatizibwa, ti kwihaho nziro z'omubiri, kureka n'endagaano y'omutima ogutarikweshinja ahari Ruhanga, kandi ebajuna ahabw'okuzooka kwa Yesu Kristo
en: 21 The like figure whereunto even baptism doth also now save us (not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God,) by the resurrection of Jesus Christ:
22 who is gone into heaven, and is on the right hand of God; angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him.
1 Forasmuch then as Christ hath suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves likewise with the same mind: for he that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin;
2 that he no longer should live the rest of his time in the flesh to the lusts of men, but to the will of God.
3 For the time past of our life may suffice us to have wrought the will of the Gentiles, when we walked in lasciviousness, lusts, excess of wine, revellings, banquetings, and abominable idolatries:

rr: 4 Ekirikubatangaaza n'okureeba mutarikurahuka kukwatanisa nabo omu burare obuhinguraine; nikyo barikubajumira.
en: 4 wherein they think it strange that ye run not with them to the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you :
5 who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the quick and the dead.
6 For for this cause was the gospel preached also to them that are dead, that they might be judged according to men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.

rr: 7 Emperu ya byona eri haihi; n'ahabw'ekyo mwerinde, muhuguukye, mwezirikire kushaba.
en: 7 But the end of all things is at hand: be ye therefore sober, and watch unto prayer.
8 And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.

rr: 9 Mukunirane mutarikunyomwa
en: 9 Use hospitality one to another without grudging.
10 As every man hath received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.

11 If any man speak, let him speak as the oracles of God; if any man minister, let him do it as of the ability which God giveth: that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

rr: 12 Abarikukundwa, mutatangaazibwa omuriro ogwizire kubagyeza, nk'abahikwaho eihano
en: 12 Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you, as though some strange thing happened unto you:
13 but rejoice, inasmuch as ye are partakers of Christ's sufferings; that, when his glory shall be revealed, ye may be glad also with exceeding joy.
14 If ye be reproached for the name of Christ, happy are ye ; for the spirit of glory and of God resteth upon you: on their part he is evil spoken of, but on your part he is glorified.

rr: 15 Kwonka hatarigira omuntu omuriimwe owaabonabonesibwa ahabw'okwita, nari okwiba, nari okukora kubi, nari okweta omu by'abandi
en: 15 But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or as a thief, or as an evildoer, or as a busybody in other men's matters.
16 Yet if any man suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God on this behalf.
17 For the time is come that judgment must begin at the house of God: and if it first begin at us, what shall the end be of them that obey not the gospel of God?

rr: 18 Kqandi abahikiriire ku baraagumirwe okujunwa, abatatiina Ruhanga n'abasiisi baryaba bata?
en: 18 And if the righteous scarcely be saved, where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear?

rr: 19 N'ahabw'ekyo abarikubonabona nk'oku Ruhanga akunda, bagume nibakora gye, kandi bakwatse amagara gaabo Omuhangi orikwesigwa.
en: 19 Wherefore let them that suffer according to the will of God commit the keeping of their souls to him in well doing, as unto a faithful Creator.
1 The elders which are among you I exhort, who am also an elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed:
2 feed the flock of God which is among you, taking the oversight thereof , not by constraint, but willingly; not for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;
3 neither as being lords over God's heritage, but being ensamples to the flock.

rr: 4 Bwanyima Omuriisa omukuru ku aryorekwa, muryaheebwa ekirunga ky'ekitiinisa ekitarikuhunduuka.
en: 4 And when the chief Shepherd shall appear, ye shall receive a crown of glory that fadeth not away.
5 Likewise, ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. Yea, all of you be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for God resisteth the proud, and giveth grace to the humble.
6 Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time:
7 casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
8 Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:

rr: 9 Mumurwanise, muhamire omu kwikiriza kwanyu, nimumanya ngu ab'eishe-emwe abari omu nsi yoona nabo bahikwaho obusaasi nk'obwanyu.
en: 9 whom resist stedfast in the faith, knowing that the same afflictions are accomplished in your brethren that are in the world.
10 But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you .

rr: 11 Aheebwe obutegyeki ebiro n'ebiro. Amiina.
en: 11 To him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

rr: 12 Naabahandiikira nincwera ahagufu, nimpandiikisa Siluwano, ow'eishe-emwe orikwesigwa, nk'oku ndikuteekateeka; nimbeehanangiriza, kandi nimpamya ngu ezi nizo mbabazi za Ruhanga ez'amazima; mube nizo mwahamiramu.
en: 12 By Silvanus, a faithful brother unto you, as I suppose, I have written briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God wherein ye stand.

rr: 13 Ekanisa ya Babulooni eyaatooraimwe nkaimwe yaabaramutsya; kandi na Mako omwana wangye yaabaramutsya.
en: 13 The church that is at Babylon, elected together with you , saluteth you; and so doth Marcus my son.

rr: 14 Muramukanise okunywegyera kw'okukunda. Mugume n'obusingye, imwe mwena abari omuri Kristo.
en: 14 Greet ye one another with a kiss of charity.

rr: Hakaba hariho omushaija owa Ramasaimu-zofimu omu nsi y'ebibungo eya Efuraimu, eiziina rye Elukaana, mwene Yerohaamu, mwijukuru wa Elihu, mwene Tobu ya Zuufi, Omuefuraimu.
en: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim-zophim, of mount Ephraim, and his name was Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephrathite:

rr: Akaba aine abakazi babiri, omwe naayetwa Hanna, n'ondiijo Penina; Penina akaba naazaara, kwonka Hanna ari engumba.
en: and he had two wives; the name of the one was Hannah, and the name of the other Peninnah: and Peninnah had children, but Hannah had no children.

rr: Omushaija ogwo akaba aruga omu rurembo rw'owaabo buri mwaka, ainamuka Shiilo kuramizayo MUKAMA ow'amahe n'okumutambira ebitambo.
en: And this man went up out of his city yearly to worship and to sacrifice unto the LORD of hosts in Shiloh.

rr: Kandi beene Eli bombi, Hofuni na Finehaasi, niyo baabaire nibakora omurimo gwa MUKAMA ogw'obunyamurwa.
en: And the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, the priests of the LORD , were there.

rr: Aha izooba eri Elukaana yaabaire atambiraho ebitambo, akaba agira emigabo, agiha Penina omukazi we n'abaana be b'aboojo n'ab'abaishiki
en: And when the time was that Elkanah offered, he gave to Peninnah his wife, and to all her sons and her daughters, portions:

rr: kwonka Hanna amuha emigabo ebiri, ahabw'okuba akaba naamukunda, n'obu MUKAMA yaabaire amwimire oruzaaro.
en: but unto Hannah he gave a worthy portion; for he loved Hannah: but the LORD had shut up her womb.

rr: Kandi muka iba akaba amuteerera enaku, ngu amugwise kubi, ahakuba MUKAMA akaba amwimire oruzaaro.
en: And her adversary also provoked her sore, for to make her fret, because the LORD had shut up her womb.

rr: Okwo nikwo byabaire biba buri mwaka; Hanna ku yaabaire aza omu nju ya MUKAMA, muka iba amuteerera enaku. Ekyo kimuriza, ayanga n'okurya.
en: And as he did so year by year, when she went up to the house of the LORD , so she provoked her; therefore she wept, and did not eat.

rr: Kandi Elukaana iba akaba amubuuza ati: Beitu shi, Hanna, orizibwa ki? N'enki ekikuzibira kurya? Ahabw'enki omutima gwawe gutuura n'amaganya? Tindikukukirira abaana b'aboojo ikumi?
en: Then said Elkanah her husband to her, Hannah, why weepest thou? and why eatest thou not? and why is thy heart grieved? am not I better to thee than ten sons? Hannah's Prayer

rr: Eizooba rimwe ku baaherize kurya n'okunywa, Hanna yaimuka ahu baabaire bari omuri Shiilo.
en: So Hannah rose up after they had eaten in Shiloh, and after they had drunk.

rr: Obwo Eli omunyamurwa akaba ashutami aha kitebe kye aha kiti ky'omuryango gwa hekalu ya MUKAMA.
en: Now Eli the priest sat upon a seat by a post of the temple of the LORD .

rr: Hanna yaatandika kushaba MUKAMA, aine obusaasi bwingi omu mutima, naarira munonga
en: And she was in bitterness of soul, and prayed unto the LORD , and wept sore.

rr: yaaragaanisa naahiga omu maisho ga MUKAMA, naagira ati: Ai MUKAMA ow'amahe, ku oraareebe okubonabona kw'omuzaana waawe, waanyijuka, otaanyebwa, wampa omwana w'omwojo, ndyamukuhongyera, abe owaawe ebiro byona ebi arimara omu nsi, kandi orumweiso tirurimuraba ha mutwe.
en: And she vowed a vow, and said, O LORD of hosts, if thou wilt indeed look on the affliction of thine handmaid, and remember me, and not forget thine handmaid, but wilt give unto thine handmaid a man child, then I will give him unto the LORD all the days of his life, and there shall no razor come upon his head.

rr: Ku yaagumiizemu naashaba atyo omu maisho ga MUKAMA, Eli yaaguma naamureeba aha minwa.
en: And it came to pass, as she continued praying before the LORD , that Eli marked her mouth.

rr: Kwonka Hanna we akaba naashabira aha mutima, eminwa ye neimuka, eiraka rye ritarikuhurirwa; nikyo Eli yaateekateekyeire ngu asinzire.
en: Now Hannah, she spake in her heart; only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard: therefore Eli thought she had been drunken.

rr: Eli nikwo kumubuuza ati: Oryahitsya hi n'esindo? Ku ocwa viinyo?
en: And Eli said unto her, How long wilt thou be drunken? put away thy wine from thee.

rr: Hanna yaamugarukamu ati: Tikwo kiri, Mukama wangye; ndi omukazi oine omutima gw'obusaasi; tiinyweire viinyo nari ekirikusinza kyona, kureka ninshuka amaganya g'omu mutima gwangye omu maisho ga MUKAMA.
en: And Hannah answered and said, No, my lord, I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit: I have drunk neither wine nor strong drink, but have poured out my soul before the LORD .

rr: Otateekateeka ngu omuzaana waawe n'ekifa-mutima; ahakuba ebi naaba ningamba n'okuhitsya hati, mbireeteirwe amaganya maingi n'okugwisibwa kubi.
en: Count not thine handmaid for a daughter of Belial: for out of the abundance of my complaint and grief have I spoken hitherto.

rr: Eli yaamugira ati: Yegyendere n'obusingye; MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli akuhe eki waamushaba.
en: Then Eli answered and said, Go in peace: and the God of Israel grant thee thy petition that thou hast asked of him.

rr: Onu yaagira ati: Omuzaana waawe agirirwe embabazi omu maisho gaawe. Atyo ogwo mukazi yaayegyendera yaarya, tiyaagaruka kureebwa aine enaku. Okuzaarwa kwa Samueli
en: And she said, Let thine handmaid find grace in thy sight. So the woman went her way, and did eat, and her countenance was no more sad .

rr: Baimuka kare omu kasheeshe, baaza omu maisho ga MUKAMA, baaramya; bwanyima baagarukayo, baataaha omu ka yaabo Raama; ku baahikireyo, Elukaana yaamanya omukazi we Hanna, MUKAMA yaamwijuka.
en: And they rose up in the morning early, and worshipped before the LORD , and returned, and came to their house to Ramah: and Elkanah knew Hannah his wife; and the LORD remembered her.

rr: Obunaku ku bwahikire, Hanna yaagira enda, yaazaara omwana w'omwojo, yaamweta Samueli; ahakuba akagira ati: Nkamushaba MUKAMA.
en: Wherefore it came to pass, when the time was come about after Hannah had conceived, that she bare a son, and called his name Samuel, saying , Because I have asked him of the LORD .

rr: Bwanyima omushaija ogwo Elukaana yainamuka n'eka ye yoona kutambira MUKAMA ekitambo kya buri mwaka, kandi n'okuhikiiriza eki yaaraganiise
en: And the man Elkanah, and all his house, went up to offer unto the LORD the yearly sacrifice, and his vow.

rr: kwonka Hanna tiyainamukayo; ahakuba akagira iba ati: Tindizayo, okuhitsya obu omwana aricuuka, nkabona kumutwara, nkamumurikira MUKAMA, akagumayo ebiro byona.
en: But Hannah went not up; for she said unto her husband, I will not go up until the child be weaned, and then I will bring him, that he may appear before the LORD , and there abide for ever.

rr: Iba Elukaana yaamugira ati: Kora eki orikusiima; otegyereze okuhitsya obu orimucuutsya; kwonka MUKAMA ahamye ekigambo kye.
en: And Elkanah her husband said unto her, Do what seemeth thee good; tarry until thou have weaned him; only the LORD establish his word.

rr: Atyo ogwo mukazi yaaguma aho naayontsya omwana we, okuhitsya obu yaamucuukize.
en: So the woman abode, and gave her son suck until she weaned him.

rr: Ku yaaherize kumucuutsya, yaamwinamura n'enimi ishatu, na eefa emwe y'esaano y'obunono, n'efureebe ya viinyo; yaamutwara Shiilo omu nju ya MUKAMA; kandi ogwo mwana akaba akiri muto.
en: And when she had weaned him, she took him up with her, with three bullocks, and one ephah of flour, and a bottle of wine, and brought him unto the house of the LORD in Shiloh: and the child was young.

rr: Batyo baita enimi, baareetera Eli omwana.
en: And they slew a bullock, and brought the child to Eli.

rr: Ogwo mukazi yaagira ati: Mukama wangye, buzimazima nk'oku okiriho, niinye mukazi ori, owaabaire ayemereire aha omu maisho gaawe naashaba MUKAMA.
en: And she said, Oh my lord, as thy soul liveth, my lord, I am the woman that stood by thee here, praying unto the LORD .

rr: Omwana ogu nkamushaba MUKAMA; kandi agarukiremu okushaba kwangye
en: For this child I prayed; and the LORD hath given me my petition which I asked of him:

rr: nikyo naamuhongyerera MUKAMA; ebiro byona ebi arimara omu nsi, aryaguma ahongyeirwe MUKAMA.
en: therefore also I have lent him to the LORD ; as long as he liveth he shall be lent to the LORD .

rr: Baaramizayo MUKAMA.
en: And he worshipped the LORD there.

rr: Bwanyima Hanna yaasiima naagira ati: Omutima gwangye nigwesiimira omuri MUKAMA; Eihembe ryangye ritunguuriirwe omuri MUKAMA; N'akanwa kangye nikashekyerera abazigu bangye, Ahakuba ninshemerererwa okujuna kwawe.
en: And Hannah prayed, and said, My heart rejoiceth in the LORD , Mine horn is exalted in the LORD : My mouth is enlarged over mine enemies; Because I rejoice in thy salvation.

rr: Tihariho orikwera nka MUKAMA, Tihariho ondiijo kureka Iwe wenka; Kandi tihariho Rukiri ori nka Ruhanga waitu.
en: There is none holy as the LORD : For there is none beside thee: Neither is there any rock like our God.

rr: Mutagaruka kugamba eby'okwehimbisa; N'eby'amaryo birekye kuruga omu kanwa kaanyu; Ahakuba MUKAMA ni Ruhanga orikumanya byona; Kandi niwe arenga ebi abantu bakora.
en: Talk no more so exceeding proudly; Let not arrogancy come out of your mouth: For the LORD is a God of knowledge, And by him actions are weighed.

rr: Amata g'amamanzi gahendekire; Kwonka abarikutsibaaza beezirikire amaani.
en: The bows of the mighty men are broken, And they that stumbled are girded with strength.

rr: Abaabaire nibaiguta, hati nibakorera eby'okurya; N'abaabaire baine enjara, tibakigiine. Eego, engumba ezaire mushanju, N'ow'abaana baingi atentebukire.
en: They that were full have hired out themselves for bread; And they that were hungry ceased: So that the barren hath born seven; And she that hath many children is waxed feeble.

rr: MUKAMA aita, kandi akiza; Ashuumya okuzimu, kandi aihayo.
en: The LORD killeth, and maketh alive: He bringeth down to the grave, and bringeth up.

rr: MUKAMA ainaza, kandi atungisa; Agarura ahansi, kandi atunguura.
en: The LORD maketh poor, and maketh rich: He bringeth low, and lifteth up.

rr: Aimutsya abooro omu mucuucu, Aiha abakyene omu rubungo, Kubashutamya n'abanyiginya, Kandi n'okuhungura ekitebe ky'ekitiinisa; Ahakuba enyomyo z'ensi n'eza MUKAMA, Kandi nizo yaagihangiriize.
en: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, And lifteth up the beggar from the dunghill, To set them among princes, And to make them inherit the throne of glory: For the pillars of the earth are the LORD 's, And he hath set the world upon them.

rr: Aryarinda ebigyere by'abarikwera be, Kwonka ababi baryahwerekyererera omu mwirima; Ahakuba tihariho muntu orisinguza amaani ge.
en: He will keep the feet of his saints, And the wicked shall be silent in darkness; For by strength shall no man prevail.

rr: Abarwanisa MUKAMA baryacwanyagurika; Abahindireho naayema omu iguru. MUKAMA aryacwera emperu z'ensi orubanja. Aryaheereza omugabe we amaani, Atunguure eihembe ry'ou yaashukireho amajuta.
en: The adversaries of the LORD shall be broken to pieces; Out of heaven shall he thunder upon them: The LORD shall judge the ends of the earth; And he shall give strength unto his king, And exalt the horn of his anointed.

rr: Bwanyima Elukaana yaagaruka omu ka ye Raama; kandi omwana yaaguma naaheereza MUKAMA omu maisho ga Eli omunyamurwa. Ebibi bya beene Eli
en: And Elkanah went to Ramah to his house. And the child did minister unto the LORD before Eli the priest. The Sons of Eli

rr: Kandi batabani ba Eli bakaba bari abantu abataine mugasho, abatarikumanya MUKAMA.
en: Now the sons of Eli were sons of Belial; they knew not the LORD .

rr: Ogu nigwo gwabaire guri omucwe gw'abo banyamurwa omu mitwarize yaabo n'abantu. Omuntu weena ku yaabaire atamba ekitambo, omuheereza w'omunyamurwa aija bakiteekire enyama, aine orwoma rw'amaino ashatu omu ngaro
en: And the priests' custom with the people was, that , when any man offered sacrifice, the priest's servant came, while the flesh was in seething, with a fleshhook of three teeth in his hand;

rr: arucumita omu safuriya, nari omu binika, nari omu nyungu, nari omu rwabya; ekintu kyona eki orwoma rwabaire rujaburamu, nikyo omunyamurwa yaabaire atwara.
en: and he struck it into the pan, or kettle, or caldron, or pot; all that the fleshhook brought up the priest took for himself.

rr: Okwo nikwo baabaire batwaza Abaisraeli boona abaabaire baza Shiilo.
en: So they did in Shiloh unto all the Israelites that came thither.

rr: Kandi ebishaju ku byabaire biba bitakookiibwe, omuheereza w'omunyamurwa akaba aija, agira orikutamba ati: Mpa enyama y'okwokyeza omunyamurwa; ahabw'okuba tarikwenda eteekire, kureka embisi.
en: Also before they burnt the fat, the priest's servant came, and said to the man that sacrificed, Give flesh to roast for the priest; for he will not have sodden flesh of thee, but raw.

rr: Kandi ogwo muntu akimugarukamu ati: Ka babanze bootsye ebishaju, obone kutwara ei orikwenda yoona, onu amugarukamu ati: Ngaaha! gimpe hati; kandi ku oraayangye, ningitwaza amaani.
en: And if any man said unto him, Let them not fail to burn the fat presently, and then take as much as thy soul desireth; then he would answer him, Nay ; but thou shalt give it me now: and if not, I will take it by force.

rr: Okwo nikwo ekibi ky'abo batsigazi kyabaire kihango omu maisho ga MUKAMA; ahabw'okuba bikareetera abantu kutambira MUKAMA ebitambo babitamirwe.
en: Wherefore the sin of the young men was very great before the LORD : for men abhorred the offering of the LORD .

rr: Samueli okutandika kuheereza MUKAMA
en: Samuel and Eli

rr: Samueli akatandika kuheereza MUKAMA akiri omwana muto, ajwaire efodi ya kitaani.
en: But Samuel ministered before the LORD , being a child, girded with a linen ephod.

rr: Kandi nyina akaba amubaziirira akakooti, akamutwarira buri mwaka, nainamuka na iba kutamba ekitambo kya buri mwaka.
en: Moreover his mother made him a little coat, and brought it to him from year to year, when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice.

rr: Kandi Eli akaba ashabira Elukaana n'omukazi we omugisha naagira ati: MUKAMA akuhe oruzaaro omuri ogu mukazi omu mwanya gw'ogu ou yaahongyeire MUKAMA.
en: And Eli blessed Elkanah and his wife, and said, The LORD give thee seed of this woman for the loan which is lent to the LORD .

rr: Batyo bagaruka owaabo.
en: And they went unto their own home.

rr: Bwanyima MUKAMA yaataayaayira Hanna, yaagira enda, yaazaara abaana b'aboojo bashatu n'abaishiki babiri. Omwana ogwo Samueli yaakurira omu maisho ga MUKAMA. Ebya beene Eli n'ekifubiro kyabo
en: And the LORD visited Hannah, so that she conceived, and bare three sons and two daughters. And the child Samuel grew before the LORD .

rr: Omu bunaku obwo Eli akaba ahikire omu ngingo zaabukuru; yaaguma naahurira byona ebi abatabani baabaire nibakora omu Baisraeli boona, kandi n'oku barikushambana n'abakazi, abaabaire baheereza aha muryango gw'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu.
en: Now Eli was very old, and heard all that his sons did unto all Israel; and how they lay with the women that assembled at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

rr: Yaababuuza ati: N'enki ekirikubakoresa ebirikushusha bityo? Ahakuba nimpurira omu bantu boona eby'emicwe yaanyu emibi.
en: And he said unto them, Why do ye such things? for I hear of your evil dealings by all this people.

rr: Ngaaha, baana bangye! Ebi ndikuhurira abantu nibabagambaho ti birungi; nimusiisisa abantu ba MUKAMA.
en: Nay, my sons; for it is no good report that I hear: ye make the LORD 's people to transgress.

rr: Omuntu ku arikushiisha ahari mugyenzi we, Ruhanga naamucwera orubanja; mbwenu omuntu ku arikushiisha ahari Ruhanga, n'oha orikubaasa kumweshengyerereza?
en: If one man sin against another, the judge shall judge him: but if a man sin against the LORD , who shall intreat for him?

rr: Kwonka baayanga kuhurira ishebo, ahakuba MUKAMA akaba naayenda kubaita.
en: Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto the voice of their father, because the LORD would slay them.

rr: Ogwo mwana Samueli yaagumizamu naakura, naasiimwa MUKAMA n'abantu.
en: And the child Samuel grew on, and was in favour both with the LORD , and also with men.

rr: Bwanyima haija omuntu wa Ruhanga ahari Eli, yaamugira ati: MUKAMA naagira ati: Noomanya ku naayeyorekire eka ya sho, obu baabaire bari omu buhuuku bw'enju ya Faraho.
en: And there came a man of God unto Eli, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD , Did I plainly appear unto the house of thy father, when they were in Egypt in Pharaoh's house?

rr: Niwe naatooraine omu nganda zoona eza Israeli kuba omunyamurwa wangye, okuza aha itambiro ryangye, okwotera obubaane, n'okujwara efodi omu maisho gangye. Kandi nkaha oruganda rwa sho empongano z'Abaisraeli zoona ez'ebitambo by'okwotsya omu muriro.
en: And did I choose him out of all the tribes of Israel to be my priest, to offer upon mine altar, to burn incense, to wear an ephod before me? and did I give unto the house of thy father all the offerings made by fire of the children of Israel?

rr: Mbwenu ahabw'enki nimureebesa omururu ebitambo byangye n'empongano zangye, ezi naaragiire kumpongyera, okaha batabani baawe ekitiinisa okunkira, ngu mweyitirire n'ebicweka ebirikukira oburungi by'empongano zoona ezi abantu bangye Abaisraeli barikumpongyera?
en: Wherefore kick ye at my sacrifice and at mine offering, which I have commanded in my habitation; and honourest thy sons above me, to make yourselves fat with the chiefest of all the offerings of Israel my people?

rr: Nikyo MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa Israeli, arikugirira ati: N'ekya buzima nkaba ngizire nti; Ab'enju yaawe n'ab'enju ya sho nibo bariguma nibaheereza omu maisho gangye ebiro byona; mbwenu hati MUKAMA naagira ati: Nikikabure! ahakuba abarikumpa ekitiinisa, nibo ndikiha; kwonka abarikungaya, baryagaywa.
en: Wherefore the LORD God of Israel saith, I said indeed that thy house, and the house of thy father, should walk before me for ever: but now the LORD saith, Be it far from me; for them that honour me I will honour, and they that despise me shall be lightly esteemed.

rr: Reeba, ebiro nibiija, obu ndimaraho amaani gaawe n'ag'enju ya sho, hakabura omugurusi omu nju yaawe.
en: Behold, the days come, that I will cut off thine arm, and the arm of thy father's house, that there shall not be an old man in thine house.

rr: Kandi omu kubonabona kwawe oryareebesa eihari ebirungi byona ebi Abaisraeli bariheebwa omu Butaaho bwangye; n'omu nju yaawe tiharibamu mugurusi ebiro byona.
en: And thou shalt see an enemy in my habitation, in all the wealth which God shall give Israel: and there shall not be an old man in thine house for ever.

rr: Ku harigira omuntu waawe owaahonokaho, akatsigara aha itambiro ryangye, aryaba ow'okukuhwereza amaisho noorira, n'okukusaasa omutima; oruzaaro rw'enju yaawe rwona ruryahenderwa omunyeeto.
en: And the man of thine, whom I shall not cut off from mine altar, shall be to consume thine eyes, and to grieve thine heart: and all the increase of thine house shall die in the flower of their age.

rr: Ako kagwe akarigwera batabani baawe bombi, Hofuni na Finehaasi, karyakubeera akamanyiso; bombi baryafa eizooba rimwe.
en: And this shall be a sign unto thee, that shall come upon thy two sons, on Hophni and Phinehas; in one day they shall die both of them.

rr: 1 -28 ; Naanye ndyayeimukiza omunyamurwa orikwesigwa, orikora nk'ebindi aha mutima n'omu biteekateeko oku biri. Ndyamwombekyera enju ehamire; kandi aryaheerereza omu maisho g'ou naashukireho amajuta ebiro byona.
en: And I will raise me up a faithful priest, that shall do according to that which is in mine heart and in my mind: and I will build him a sure house; and he shall walk before mine anointed for ever.

rr: Bwanyima weena oriba yaatsigaireho omu nju yaawe, aryaija, amukwate amaguru ngu amuhe akacweka k'efeeza nari omugaati, amushabe ati: Ninkweshengyereza, mpa omurimo gumwe aha y'abanyamurwa, beitu nkaabona ak'okurya.
en: And it shall come to pass, that every one that is left in thine house shall come and crouch to him for a piece of silver and a morsel of bread, and shall say, Put me, I pray thee, into one of the priests' offices, that I may eat a piece of bread.
