rr: Eizooba rimwe Yonasaani mwene Saulo akagambira omutsigazi, omukwatsi w'eby'okurwanisa bye ati: Ija twambukye seeri omu kigo ky'Abafilistia.
en: Now it came to pass upon a day, that Jonathan the son of Saul said unto the young man that bare his armour, Come, and let us go over to the Philistines' garrison, that is on the other side.

rr: Kwonka tiyaagambira ishe.
en: But he told not his father.

rr: Kandi Saulo akaba ari omu kicweka kya Gibea ekirikuheererukayo ahansi y'omukoma-mahanga ogwabaire guri Migirooni; n'abashaija abu yaabaire aine bakaba bari nka magana mukaaga
en: And Saul tarried in the uttermost part of Gibeah under a pomegranate tree which is in Migron: and the people that were with him were about six hundred men;

rr: kandi hakaba hariho na Ahiya, mwene Ahitubu, mukuru wa Ikabodi, mwene Finehaasi, mwijukuru wa Eli, omunyamurwa wa MUKAMA omuri Shiilo, ajwaire efodi.
en: and Ahiah, the son of Ahitub, I-chabod's brother, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eli, the LORD 's priest in Shiloh, wearing an ephod.

rr: Kandi n'abo bantu tibaramanyire ku Yonasaani agyenzire.
en: And the people knew not that Jonathan was gone.

rr: Omuri egyo nkiro ahu Yonasaani yaabaire naayenda kucwekanisiza kuhika omu kigo ky'Abafilistia, hakaba hariho ebibaare bihango embaju zombi; ekimwe nikyetwa Bozezi, n'ekindi nikyetwa Senehi.
en: And between the passages, by which Jonathan sought to go over unto the Philistines' garrison, there was a sharp rock on the one side, and a sharp rock on the other side: and the name of the one was Bozez, and the name of the other Seneh.

rr: Ekibaare kimwe kikaba kirumbaire aha bukiizi-bwa-bumosho, ahashungaine na Mikimaashi; n'ekindi aha bukiizi-bwa-buryo ahashungaine na Geeba.
en: The forefront of the one was situate northward over against Michmash, and the other southward over against Gibeah.

rr: Yonasaani yaagambira ogwo mutsigazi omukwatsi w'eby'okurwanisa bye ati: Ija twambukye omuri kiriya kigo kyabatashazirwe; obundi MUKAMA akaagira eki yaatukorera, ahakuba tihariho kirikubaasa kuzibira MUKAMA kujuna, okujunisa baingi nari bakye.
en: And Jonathan said to the young man that bare his armour, Come, and let us go over unto the garrison of these uncircumcised: it may be that the LORD will work for us: for there is no restraint to the LORD to save by many or by few.

rr: Omukwatsi w'eby'okurwanisa bye yaamugarukamu ati: Kora ekikuri aha mutima kyona. Reeba ndi hamwe naiwe; oku omutima gwawe guri, n'ogwangye nikwo guri.
en: And his armourbearer said unto him, Do all that is in thine heart: turn thee; behold, I am with thee according to thy heart.

rr: Yonasaani yaagira ati: Ka twambukye omuri abo bashaija, tubeeyorekye.
en: Then said Jonathan, Behold, we will pass over unto these men, and we will discover ourselves unto them.

rr: Ku baraatugire ngu, mube murekire, okuhitsya obu turaabashangye aho, obwo nitwija kuguma twemereire omu mwanya gwaitu; titurikwija kwinamuka ei bari.
en: If they say thus unto us, Tarry until we come to you; then we will stand still in our place, and will not go up unto them.

rr: Kwonka ku baraagire ngu, mwinamukye mwije, obwo nitwija kwinamuka; ibiri MUKAMA naaba abahaireyo omu mikono yaitu. Ako niko karaatubeere akamanyiso.
en: But if they say thus, Come up unto us; then we will go up: for the LORD hath delivered them into our hand: and this shall be a sign unto us.

rr: Batyo bombi baayeyoreka ab'omu kigo ky'Abafilistia; Abafilistia ku baabareebire, baagira bati; Reeba, Abaheburaayo nibaruga omu biina omu babaire beesherekire.
en: And both of them discovered themselves unto the garrison of the Philistines: and the Philistines said, Behold, the Hebrews come forth out of the holes where they had hid themselves.

rr: Ab'omu kigo baagambira Yonasaani n'omukwatsi w'eby'okurwanisa bye bati: Nimwinamukye, tuboorekye.
en: And the men of the garrison answered Jonathan and his armourbearer, and said, Come up to us, and we will shew you a thing.

rr: Yonasaani yaagira omukwatsi w'eby'okurwanisa bye ati: Nkurata; ahabw'okuba MUKAMA yaabahayo omu mikono y'Abaisraeli.
en: And Jonathan said unto his armourbearer, Come up after me: for the LORD hath delivered them into the hand of Israel.

rr: Atyo Yonasaani yaatemba naayajura, n'omukwatsi w'eby'okurwanisa bye amuri enyima. Abafilistia baagwa omu maisho ga Yonasaani; kandi omukwatsi w'eby'okurwanisa bye yaabaita amukuratiire.
en: And Jonathan climbed up upon his hands and upon his feet, and his armourbearer after him: and they fell before Jonathan; and his armourbearer slew after him.

rr: Omuri okwo kwita kw'okubanza Yonasaani n'omukwatsi w'eby'okurwanisa bye bakaita abashaija nka makumi abiri omu mwanya ogurikwingana ekicweka ky'omusiri.
en: And that first slaughter, which Jonathan and his armourbearer made, was about twenty men, within as it were an half acre of land, which a yoke of oxen might plow .

rr: Bwanyima haabaho obwoba bwingi omu rusiisira, omu ishwa n'omu bantu boona; kandi ab'omu kigo n'abanyagi bari nabo baatetema; n'ensi yaatengyeta; haabaho okutengyeta kwingi munonga.
en: And there was trembling in the host, in the field, and among all the people: the garrison, and the spoilers, they also trembled, and the earth quaked: so it was a very great trembling.

rr: Kandi abarinzi ba Saulo, abaabaire bari Gibea eya Benyamiini, ku baanagireyo amaisho, baareeba emitwe y'abantu neegaba ebirari.
en: And the watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked; and, behold, the multitude melted away, and they went on beating down one another .

rr: Saulo nikwo kugambira abantu abu yaabaire aine ati; Mubare abantu, mureebe ku haraabe haine oturugiremu.
en: Then said Saul unto the people that were with him, Number now, and see who is gone from us.

rr: Ku baaherize kubara, baashanga Yonasaani n'omukwatsi w'eby'okurwanisa bye batabarimu.
en: And when they had numbered, behold, Jonathan and his armourbearer were not there .

rr: Saulo yaagira Ahiya ati: Reeta eshanduukye ya Ruhanga; ahabw'okuba omuri ebyo biro eshanduukye ya Ruhanga ekaba eri omu Baisraeli.
en: And Saul said unto Ahiah, Bring hither the ark of God. For the ark of God was at that time with the children of Israel.

rr: Saulo, ku yaabaire naakigamba n'omunyamurwa, orwari orwabaire ruri omu rusiisira rw'Abafilistia rwaguma nirweyongyera; Saulo yaagira omunyamurwa ati: Ihayo omukono gwawe.
en: And it came to pass, while Saul talked unto the priest, that the noise that was in the host of the Philistines went on and increased: and Saul said unto the priest, Withdraw thine hand.

rr: Atyo Saulo n'abantu boona abu yaabaire aine, baayeteerana, baaza omu rugamba; baashanga nibaitana bonka na rurara, buri muntu na mugyenzi we; haabaho omurabanamu muhango munonga.
en: And Saul and all the people that were with him assembled themselves, and they came to the battle: and, behold, every man's sword was against his fellow, and there was a very great discomfiture.

rr: Kandi Abaheburaayo, abaabaire bari hamwe n'Abafilistia obunyakare, abaagyenzire nabo omu rusiisira, nabo baagarukira Abaisraeli abaabaire bari hamwe na Saulo na Yonasaani, baakwatanisa nabo.
en: Moreover the Hebrews that were with the Philistines before that time, which went up with them into the camp from the country round about, even they also turned to be with the Israelites that were with Saul and Jonathan.

rr: Kandi n'Abaisraeli boona abaabaire beesherekire omu nsi y'ebibungo eya Efuraimu, ku baahuriire ngu Abafilistia baahunga, baababinga babahambize.
en: Likewise all the men of Israel which had hid themselves in mount Ephraim, when they heard that the Philistines fled, even they also followed hard after them in the battle.

rr: Atyo MUKAMA yaajuna Abaisraeli eryo izooba; bwanyima orugamba rwagumizamu, rwahika seeri ya Besaveeni. Saulo okurahiza abantu
en: So the LORD saved Israel that day: and the battle passed over unto Beth-aven.

rr: Eryo izooba Abaisraeli baaruha munonga, ahabw'okuba Saulo akaba arahiize abantu naagira ati: Omuntu weena oraagire eki yaarya butakahikire mu mwabazyo, kandi ntakahoire bazigu bangye, akyeenwe.
en: And the men of Israel were distressed that day: for Saul had adjured the people, saying, Cursed be the man that eateth any food until evening, that I may be avenged on mine enemies.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo tihaagira n'omwe owaagira eki yaatamira.
en: So none of the people tasted any food.

rr: Abantu boona baahika aha kibira ekyabaire kirimu obwoki ahansi

rr: Saulo yaahuruza engabo ze zoona kushuuma Keila kugota Daudi n'abantu be.
en: And Saul called all the people together to war, to go down to Keilah, to besiege David and his men.

rr: Daudi yaamanya ku Saulo ari omu naama y'okumukora kubi, yaagira Abiasaari omunyamurwa ati: Reeta efodi.
en: And David knew that Saul secretly practised mischief against him; and he said to Abiathar the priest, Bring hither the ephod.

rr: Daudi yaashaba naagira ati: Ai MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa Israeli, nyowe omwiru waawe mpuriire ku Saulo arikwenda kuteera Keila, kugicwekyereza ahabwangye.
en: Then said David, O LORD God of Israel, thy servant hath certainly heard that Saul seeketh to come to Keilah, to destroy the city for my sake.

rr: Abantu ba Keila nibaija kumpayo omu mikono ye? N'eky'amazima Saulo naija kushuuma kunu, nk'oku omwiru waawe ahuriire? MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa Israeli, ninkweshengyereza, manyisa omwiru waawe. MUKAMA yaagarukamu ati: Naija kushuuma.
en: Will the men of Keilah deliver me up into his hand? will Saul come down, as thy servant hath heard? O LORD God of Israel, I beseech thee, tell thy servant. And the LORD said, He will come down.

rr: Daudi yaagaruka yaabuuza ati: Aba Keila nibaija kumpayo n'abantu bangye omu mikono ya Saulo?
en: Then said David, Will the men of Keilah deliver me and my men into the hand of Saul?

rr: MUKAMA yaagarukamu ati: Nibaija kukuhayo.
en: And the LORD said, They will deliver thee up.

rr: Atyo Daudi n'abantu be nka magana mukaaga baimuka, baaruga Keila, baaza hoona ahu barikubaasa.
en: Then David and his men, which were about six hundred, arose and departed out of Keilah, and went whithersoever they could go.

rr: Bwanyima baagambira Saulo ku Daudi acwire, akaruga Keila, yaareka kuhurura.
en: And it was told Saul that David was escaped from Keilah; and he forbare to go forth.

rr: Daudi yaaguma omu bigo by'omu ihamba, omu nsi y'ebibungo omu ihamba rya Ziifu. Saulo yaaguma naamusherura obutoosha, kwonka Ruhanga tiyaamuhayo mu mikono ye. Daudi na Yonasaani okugaruka kuragaana
en: And David abode in the wilderness in strong holds, and remained in a mountain in the wilderness of Ziph. And Saul sought him every day, but God delivered him not into his hand.

rr: Daudi ku yaareebire Saulo aizire kumuhiiga kumwiita, yaaguma omu ihamba rya Ziifu omu kibira.
en: And David saw that Saul was come out to seek his life: and David was in the wilderness of Ziph in a wood.

rr: Bwanyima Yonasaani mwene Saulo yaimuka, yaashanga Daudi omuri ekyo kibira, yaamugumya omuri Ruhanga.
en: And Jonathan Saul's son arose, and went to David into the wood, and strengthened his hand in God.

rr: Yaamugira ati: Otatiina; ahakuba tata Saulo tarikubona, kandi oryaba omugabe wa Israeli, naanye nkubeho owa kabiri; kandi ekyo na Saulo tata naakimanya.
en: And he said unto him, Fear not: for the hand of Saul my father shall not find thee; and thou shalt be king over Israel, and I shall be next unto thee; and that also Saul my father knoweth.

rr: Bombi baaragaana endagaano omu maisho ga MUKAMA. Daudi yaaguma omuri ekyo kibira, Yonasaani yaagaruka owe.
en: And they two made a covenant before the LORD : and David abode in the wood, and Jonathan went to his house.

rr: Omu biro ebyo aba Ziifu bainamuka owa Saulo Gibea, baagira bati: Ebyo noomanya ku Daudi ayesherekire omuriitwe omu kibira ky'omu kibungo kya Hakila, ekiri aha bukiizi-bwa-buryo bw'eihamba?
en: Then came up the Ziphites to Saul to Gibeah, saying, Doth not David hide himself with us in strong holds in the wood, in the hill of Hachilah, which is on the south of Jeshimon?

rr: Mbwenu Nyakusinga, shuuma, oyemare ekikuri aha mutima; ekyaitu n'okumuhayo omu mikono y'omugabe.
en: Now therefore, O king, come down according to all the desire of thy soul to come down; and our part shall be to deliver him into the king's hand.

rr: Saulo yaagira ati: MUKAMA abahe omugisha; ahakuba mwangirira esaasi.
en: And Saul said, Blessed be ye of the LORD ; for ye have compassion on me.

rr: Mwirooko, mwongyere kuhamya, mwetegyereze mureebe omwanya ogu ayesherekiremu, kandi mumanye n'omureebire; ahakuba nibangambira omushaija ogwo ku aba omunyabwengye.
en: Go, I pray you, prepare yet, and know and see his place where his haunt is, and who hath seen him there: for it is told me that he dealeth very subtilly.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo mureebe, mwetegyereze obweshereko bwe bwona, ahu ayesherekire, haza mugarukye mundeetere enkuru ehamire, naanye niinyija kugyenda naimwe; ku araabe ari omuri egyo nsi, niinyija kumusherura omu nkumi zoona ez'Abayuda.
en: See therefore, and take knowledge of all the lurking places where he hideth himself, and come ye again to me with the certainty, and I will go with you: and it shall come to pass, if he be in the land, that I will search him out throughout all the thousands of Judah.

rr: Batyo baimuka, baaza Ziifu, baatangayo Saulo. Omu bunaku obwo Daudi n'abashaija be bakaba bari omu ihamba rya Maoni omuri Araba, aha bukiizi-bwa-buryo bwa Yeshimooni.
en: And they arose, and went to Ziph before Saul: but David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, in the plain on the south of Jeshimon.

rr: Saulo n'abantu be baaza kumusherura; haabaho abaagambira Daudi; n'ahabw'ekyo yaaza aha ibaare rihango ery'omu ihamba rya Maoni, yaagumayo. Saulo ku yaakihuriire, yaamukurata omuri eryo ihamba.
en: Saul also and his men went to seek him . And they told David: wherefore he came down into a rock, and abode in the wilderness of Maon. And when Saul heard that , he pursued after David in the wilderness of Maon.

rr: Saulo yaareetwa aha rubaju rumwe rw'ekibungo, na Daudi n'abantu be aha rundi; obwo Daudi akaba nairuka naahunga Saulo, ahakuba Saulo n'engabo ze bakaba nibenda kubakubira ahagati kubakwata.
en: And Saul went on this side of the mountain, and David and his men on that side of the mountain: and David made haste to get away for fear of Saul; for Saul and his men compassed David and his men round about to take them.

rr: 2 -51 ; Kwonka haija entumwa ahari Saulo, yaamugira eti: Rahuka ogarukye; ahakuba Abafilistia baahurura kuteera ensi yaitu.
en: But there came a messenger unto Saul, saying, Haste thee, and come; for the Philistines have invaded the land.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo Saulo yaagarukayo, yaarereera kukurata Daudi, yaaza kurwanisa Abafilistia. Nikyo baayeteire ogwo mwanya Sela-hama-lekoosi.
en: Wherefore Saul returned from pursuing after David, and went against the Philistines: therefore they called that place Sela-hammahlekoth.

rr: Bwanyima Daudi yaarugayo, yainamuka, yaaguma omu bigo bya Enigeedi.
en: And David went up from thence, and dwelt in strong holds at En-gedi.

rr: Saulo ku yaatabaarukire naaruga kubinga Abafilistia, abantu baamugira bati: Reeba, Daudi ari omu ihamba rya Eni-geedi.
en: And it came to pass, when Saul was returned from following the Philistines, that it was told him, saying, Behold, David is in the wilderness of En-gedi.

rr: Saulo nikwo kutoorana engabo enkumi ishatu omuri Israeli yoona, akazitwara, akaza kusherura Daudi n'abantu be aha nkiri z'aha izaagiriro ry'enzaza.
en: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and went to seek David and his men upon the rocks of the wild goats.

rr: Ku yaahikire aha ngombe z'entaama ezaabaire ziri aha rubaju rw'omuhanda, yaashangaho enyanga, yaagitaahamu kuza aha ishaazi. Kandi Daudi n'abashaija be bakaba bari hare omunda y'egyo nyanga.
en: And he came to the sheepcotes by the way, where was a cave; and Saul went in to cover his feet: and David and his men remained in the sides of the cave.

rr: Abashaija ba Daudi baamugira bati: Eri niryo izooba eri MUKAMA yaakugambiire naagira ati: Reeba, ndyahayo omuzigu waawe omu mikono yaawe, omugire nk'oku orikwenda.
en: And the men of David said unto him, Behold the day of which the LORD said unto thee, Behold, I will deliver thine enemy into thine hand, that thou mayest do to him as it shall seem good unto thee.

rr: Bwanyima Daudi yaimuka, yaagyenda naashooba, yaashara aha mukugiro gw'omunagiro gwa Saulo.
en: Then David arose, and cut off the skirt of Saul's robe privily.

rr: Kwonka ku yaaherize kukora atyo, yaashinjwa omu mutima ahabw'okushara ahari ogwo munagiro
en: And it came to pass afterward, that David's heart smote him, because he had cut off Saul's skirt.

rr: yaagira abashaija be ati: Nikikabure nyowe okukora ntyo mukama wangye, ou MUKAMA yaashukireho amajuta, okumubangira omukono, haza MUKAMA yaamushukireho amajuta.
en: And he said unto his men, The LORD forbid that I should do this thing unto my master, the LORD 's anointed, to stretch forth mine hand against him, seeing he is the anointed of the LORD .

rr: Atyo Daudi yaazibira abashaija be, tiyaabaikiriza kwita Saulo.
en: So David stayed his servants with these words, and suffered them not to rise against Saul.

rr: Bwanyima Saulo yaimuka, yaaruga omu nyanga, yaagyenda.
en: But Saul rose up out of the cave, and went on his way.

rr: Bwanyima Daudi nawe yaimuka, yaaruga omu nyanga, yaayeta Saulo naagira ati: Nyakusinga mukama wangye.
en: David also arose afterward, and went out of the cave, and cried after Saul, saying, My lord the king.

rr: Saulo ku yaagarwire amaisho enyima, Daudi yainama, yaamutangirira.
en: And when Saul looked behind him, David stooped with his face to the earth, and bowed himself.

rr: Daudi yaabuuza Saulo ati: Ahabw'enki noohurira ebi abantu barikukugambira ngu, Daudi naayenda kukukora kubi?
en: And David said to Saul, Wherefore hearest thou men's words, saying, Behold, David seeketh thy hurt?

rr: Mbwenu tiwaayereebera ku MUKAMA yaaba akuhaireyo omu mikono yangye eri izooba, obu waaba ori omu nyanga? Nangwa hariho abamwe abangambira kukwita, kwonka nyowe naakusaasira, naagira nti: Tindikwija kugorora mukono gwangye ahari mukama wangye, ahakuba niwe MUKAMA yaashukireho amajuta.
en: Behold, this day thine eyes have seen how that the LORD had delivered thee to day into mine hand in the cave: and some bade me kill thee: but mine eye spared thee; and I said, I will not put forth mine hand against my lord; for he is the LORD 's anointed.

rr: Kandi Taata, reeba omukugiro gw'omunagiro gwawe; nk'oku naashara omukugiro gw'omunagiro gwawe, ntakwite, ekyo kikumanyise kandi oreebe ku hatariho kibi nari obugomi omuriinye; kandi ku ntakakucumurahoga, n'obu oraabe otuura noohiiga amagara gangye kugaihaho.
en: Moreover, my father, see, yea, see the skirt of thy robe in my hand: for in that I cut off the skirt of thy robe, and killed thee not, know thou and see that there is neither evil nor transgression in mine hand, and I have not sinned against thee; yet thou huntest my soul to take it.

rr: MUKAMA abe niwe yaatucwera orubanja twembi, kandi abe niwe yaakumpoorera; kwonka omukono gwangye gurekye kuba nigwo gwakwita.
en: The LORD judge between me and thee, and the LORD avenge me of thee: but mine hand shall not be upon thee.

rr: Nk'oku enfumu y'aba kare egira eti, Ebibi biruga omu babi; kwonka omukono gwangye tigurikukoraho.
en: As saith the proverb of the ancients, Wickedness proceedeth from the wicked: but mine hand shall not be upon thee.

rr: Beitu omugabe wa Israeli aizire kuteera oha? Ou ohiigire n'oha? Ohiigire embwa efiire, ohiigire omura.
en: After whom is the king of Israel come out? after whom dost thou pursue? after a dead dog, after a flea.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo MUKAMA abe omuramuzi waitu twembi, atucwere orubanja, areebe, antonganire, akunjune.
en: The LORD therefore be judge, and judge between me and thee, and see, and plead my cause, and deliver me out of thine hand.

rr: Daudi ku yaaherize kugambira Saulo ebigambo ebyo, Saulo yaagira ati: Mwana wangye Daudi, eryo n'eiraka ryawe?
en: And it came to pass, when David had made an end of speaking these words unto Saul, that Saul said, Is this thy voice, my son David?

rr: Saulo yaayeha eboroogo, yaarira.
en: And Saul lifted up his voice, and wept.

rr: Yaagaruka yaagira Daudi ati: Wankiza okuhikiirira; ahakuba waanyihura ebirungi, haza nyowe nkwihwire ebibi.
en: And he said to David, Thou art more righteous than I: for thou hast rewarded me good, whereas I have rewarded thee evil.

rr: Kandi eri izooba waayoreka butunu ku wankora gye, ahabw'okuba tiwaanyita n'obu MUKAMA yampayo omu mikono yaawe.
en: And thou hast shewed this day how that thou hast dealt well with me: forasmuch as when the LORD had delivered me into thine hand, thou killedst me not.

rr: Noogira ngu omuntu akaareeba omuzigu we, amureka, agyenda? N'ahabw'ekyo MUKAMA akuzimuurire ebirungi ahabw'eki wankorera eri izooba.
en: For if a man find his enemy, will he let him go well away? wherefore the LORD reward thee good for that thou hast done unto me this day.

rr: 1 Sam Kandi reeba, hati nimmanya ku otaribura kuba omugabe, n'obugabe bwa Israeli ku burihamibwa omu mikono yaawe.
en: And now, behold, I know well that thou shalt surely be king, and that the kingdom of Israel shall be established in thine hand.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo ndahira MUKAMA ku otaricwekyereza ruzaaro rwangye naarugaho, kandi ku otarimaraho iziina ryangye omu nju ya tata.
en: Swear now therefore unto me by the LORD , that thou wilt not cut off my seed after me, and that thou wilt not destroy my name out of my father's house.

rr: Daudi yaamurahira.
en: And David sware unto Saul.

rr: Saulo yaagaruka owe; kwonka Daudi yainamuka yaagaruka omu kigo n'abantu be.
en: And Saul went home; but David and his men gat them up unto the hold.

rr: Ebiro ku byahingwireho, Samueli yaafa; Abaisraeli boona baateeranira hamwe, baamucurira, baamuziika omu nju ye Raama. Bwanyima Daudi yaimuka, yaashuuma, yaaza omu ihamba rya Parani. Ebya Nabali
en: And Samuel died; and all the Israelites were gathered together, and lamented him, and buried him in his house at Ramah. And David arose, and went down to the wilderness of Paran.

rr: Omuri Maoni hakaba harimu omushaija, ou amatungo ge gaabaire gari Karumeeli; akaba ari omutungi munonga, aine entama enkumi ishatu, n'embuzi rukumi; omuri obwo bunaku akaba naakyemurira ebyoya by'entaama ze Karumeeli.
en: And there was a man in Maon, whose possessions were in Carmel; and the man was very great, and he had three thousand sheep, and a thousand goats: and he was shearing his sheep in Carmel.

rr: Ogwo mushaija akaba naayetwa Nabali, n'eiziina ry'omukazi we ari Abigaili. Ogwo mukazi akaba ari omukazi orikwetegyereza, kandi murungi; kwonka iba akaba ari omunyamwaga, aine emicwe mibi; kandi akaba ari ow'omu muryango gwa Kalebu.
en: Now the name of the man was Nabal; and the name of his wife Abigail: and she was a woman of good understanding, and of a beautiful countenance: but the man was churlish and evil in his doings; and he was of the house of Caleb.

rr: Daudi ku yaabaire akiri omu ihamba, yaahurira ngu Nabali naakyemura ebyoya by'entaama ze.
en: And David heard in the wilderness that Nabal did shear his sheep.

rr: Daudi yaatuma abatsigazi ikumi, yaabagira ati: Mwinamukye Karumeeli, muze owa Nabali, mumundamukize
en: And David sent out ten young men, and David said unto the young men, Get you up to Carmel, and go to Nabal, and greet him in my name:

rr: mugire ogwo mutungi muti: Obusingye bugume ahariiwe, n'aha ka yaawe, n'ahari byona ebi oine.
en: and thus shall ye say to him that liveth in prosperity , Peace be both to thee, and peace be to thine house, and peace be unto all that thou hast.

rr: Mpuriire ku oine abarikukyemura ebyoya; kandi ebi biro tubaire turi hamwe n'abariisa baawe; omwanya gwona ogu baamazire Karumeeli, titwine ki tubaitsize, kandi tibaine kintu kyona eki baafeereirwe.
en: And now I have heard that thou hast shearers: now thy shepherds which were with us, we hurt them not, neither was there ought missing unto them, all the while they were in Carmel.

rr: Buuza abatsigazi baawe, nibaija kukugambira. Ninkweshengyereza abatsigazi bangye bagirirwe embabazi omu maisho gaawe, ahakuba twaija aha izooba rirungi ry'obugyenyi. N'ahabw'ekyo eki oraabe oine kyona obe nikyo waaha abairu baawe n'omwana waawe Daudi.
en: Ask thy young men, and they will shew thee. Wherefore let the young men find favour in thine eyes: for we come in a good day: give, I pray thee, whatsoever cometh to thine hand unto thy servants, and to thy son David.

rr: Abatsigazi ba Daudi ku baahikire aho, baagambira Nabali byona nk'oku Daudi yaabibatuma; baaguma bategyereize.
en: And when David's young men came, they spake to Nabal according to all those words in the name of David, and ceased.

rr: Nabali yaagarukamu abo baheereza ba Daudi, ati: Daudi ogwo niwe oha? Kandi mwene Yese niwe oha? Ebi biro hariho abahuuku baingi abacwire ahari bakama baabo.
en: And Nabal answered David's servants, and said, Who is David? and who is the son of Jesse? there be many servants now a days that break away every man from his master.

rr: Mbwenu nyeyakye eby'okurya byangye, n'amaizi gangye, n'enyama ei mbaagiire abakyemuzi bangye b'ebyoya, mbihe abantu abu ntarikumanya i barikuruga?
en: Shall I then take my bread, and my water, and my flesh that I have killed for my shearers, and give it unto men, whom I know not whence they be?

rr: Batyo abatsigazi ba Daudi baahinduka, baagarukayo, baamuteekyerereza ebyo byona.
en: So David's young men turned their way, and went again, and came and told him all those sayings.

rr: Daudi nikwo kugira abashaija be ati: Buri muntu ahagatire rurara ye.
en: And David said unto his men, Gird ye on every man his sword.

rr: Batyo buri muntu yaahagatira rurara ye, na Daudi yaahagatira eye; abantu nka magana ana bainamuka bakuratiire Daudi; na magana abiri baatsigara aha bintu.
en: And they girded on every man his sword; and David also girded on his sword: and there went up after David about four hundred men; and two hundred abode by the stuff.

rr: Omwe aha batsigazi ba Nabali yaagambira Abigaili muka mukama we ati: Reeba, Daudi atumire entumwa, zaaruga omu ihamba kuramutsya mukama waitu; ku baizire, yaabajuukirira.
en: But one of the young men told Abigail, Nabal's wife, saying, Behold, David sent messengers out of the wilderness to salute our master; and he railed on them.

rr: Haza abo bashaija bakatubeera efura; tibaine ki baatwitsize nari eki twafeereirwe, omwanya gwona ogu twamazire nabo turi omu mariisizo.
en: But the men were very good unto us, and we were not hurt, neither missed we any thing, as long as we were conversant with them, when we were in the fields:

rr: Bakatubeera orugo nyomushana na nyekiro, omwanya gwona ogu twamazire nabo nituriisa entaama.
en: they were a wall unto us both by night and day, all the while we were with them keeping the sheep.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo hati okimanye, oteekateekye eki oraakore, ahakuba bamaririire kukora kubi mukama waitu n'eka ye yoona; noomanya omuntu mubi nk'ogwo tihaine orikubaasa kugamba nawe.
en: Now therefore know and consider what thou wilt do; for evil is determined against our master, and against all his household: for he is such a son of Belial, that a man cannot speak to him.

rr: Abigaili yaakoresa obwira, yaagira emigaati magana abiri, n'efurebe ibiri za viinyo, n'enyama y'entaama itaano eteekire gye, n'encuro itaano z'engano ezikarangire, n'emitsitsa igana y'emizaabibu eyomire, kandi n'ebiihuro magana abiri by'ebijuma by'emitiini, yaabita aha ndogoya
en: Then Abigail made haste, and took two hundred loaves, and two bottles of wine, and five sheep ready dressed, and five measures of parched corn , and an hundred clusters of raisins, and two hundred cakes of figs, and laid them on asses.

rr: yaagira abatsigazi be ati: Muunyebembere; niinyija kubakurata. Kwonka tiyaabigambira iba Nabali.
en: And she said unto her servants, Go on before me; behold, I come after you. But she told not her husband Nabal.

rr: Ku yaabaire ari aha ndogoya naashuuma omu rukiizi rw'ekibungo, reeba Daudi n'abantu be nabo baashuuma nibareebana nawe, baabugaabugana.
en: And it was so, as she rode on the ass, that she came down by the covert of the hill, and, behold, David and his men came down against her; and she met them.

rr: Kandi Daudi akaba agizire ati: Buzimazima nkahendekyera busha kurinda ebintu ebi ekyo kishaija kyabaire kiine omu ihamba byona; tihaagira kintu kyona omu bintu byakyo ekyabura; nkamukorera gye, mbwenu yanzimuurira ebibi.
en: Now David had said, Surely in vain have I kept all that this fellow hath in the wilderness, so that nothing was missed of all that pertained unto him: and he hath requited me evil for good.

rr: Nyowe Daudi ku ndaahitsye omu kasheeshe hakiriho ekyetwa omwojo omu bantu be boona, Ruhanga akinture n'okukiraho.
en: So and more also do God unto the enemies of David, if I leave of all that pertain to him by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall.

rr: Abigaili ku yaareebire Daudi, yaarahuka yaaruga aha ndogoya ye, yaajuumara omu maisho ga Daudi, yainama ahansi.
en: And when Abigail saw David, she hasted, and lighted off the ass, and fell before David on her face, and bowed herself to the ground,

rr: Yaamukwata amaguru naagira ati: Mukama wangye, ekyo kibi kibe niinye kyabarirwa. Ninkweshengyereza ikiriza omuzaana waawe agire eki yaakugambira, naiwe ohurire ebigambo by'omuzaana waawe.
en: and fell at his feet, and said, Upon me, my lord, upon me let this iniquity be: and let thine handmaid, I pray thee, speak in thine audience, and hear the words of thine handmaid.

rr: Mukama wangye, ninkweshengyereza, reka kweta ahari ogwo mushaija mubi Nabali; ahakuba oku arikwetwa, nikwo arikushusha; 25:25 Nabali amakuru ngu omushema. Nabali niryo iziina rye, n'obushema butuura bumwezingiriire; kwonka nyowe omuzaana waawe tindeebire batsigazi baawe abu otumire, mukama wangye; nindahira MUKAMA otahwaho, kandi ninkurahira, timbareebire.
en: Let not my lord, I pray thee, regard this man of Belial, even Nabal: for as his name is , so is he; Nabal is his name, and folly is with him: but I thine handmaid saw not the young men of my lord, whom thou didst send.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo mukama wangye, nk'oku MUKAMA akuzibiire kwehoorera enzigu n'omukono gwawe, okagiibwaho orubanja rw'eshagama, reka abazigu baawe n'abarikukutengyera kubi, mukama wangye, babe nka Nabali.
en: Now therefore, my lord, as the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, seeing the LORD hath withholden thee from coming to shed blood, and from avenging thyself with thine own hand, now let thine enemies, and they that seek evil to my lord, be as Nabal.

rr: Mbwenu ngugu omutoijo ogu omuzaana waawe yaakureetera, mukama wangye, guheebwe abatsigazi abarikugyendana mukama wangye.
en: And now this blessing which thine handmaid hath brought unto my lord, let it even be given unto the young men that follow my lord.

rr: Ninkweshengyereza saasira omuzaana waawe ekyo kibi, ahakuba MUKAMA taribura kukwombekyera enju ehamire; ahabw'okuba mukama wangye, niiwe orwana engamba za MUKAMA, kandi torireebwaho kibi ebiro byona ebi orimara omu nsi.
en: I pray thee, forgive the trespass of thine handmaid: for the LORD will certainly make my lord a sure house; because my lord fighteth the battles of the LORD , and evil hath not been found in thee all thy days.

rr: Kandi n'obu abantu baimukire kukuhiiga n'okwenda kukwita, mukama wangye, amagara gaawe garyakomwa hamwe na MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe omu mutwaro gumwe gw'abahuriire; kwonka amagara g'abazigu baawe aryagarekyera nk'eibaare ry'enjungu.
en: Yet a man is risen to pursue thee, and to seek thy soul: but the soul of my lord shall be bound in the bundle of life with the LORD thy God; and the souls of thine enemies, them shall he sling out, as out of the middle of a sling.

rr: Mbwenu MUKAMA ku ariba yaaherize kuhikiiriza ebirungi byona ebi yaakugambireho, akakugira omugabe wa Israeli
en: And it shall come to pass, when the LORD shall have done to my lord according to all the good that he hath spoken concerning thee, and shall have appointed thee ruler over Israel;

rr: nyetsya eki kitarikusaasa nari okukureetera okwefuuza ahabw'okusheesha eshagama y'abataine rubanja nari okwehoorera enzigu. Kandi MUKAMA ku ariba yaakukoreire ebirungi, Nyakusinga, oijukye omuzaana waawe.
en: that this shall be no grief unto thee, nor offence of heart unto my lord, either that thou hast shed blood causeless, or that my lord hath avenged himself: but when the LORD shall have dealt well with my lord, then remember thine handmaid.

rr: Daudi yaagarukamu Abigaili ati: MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli, owaakwohereza kumbugana eri izooba, asiimwe.
en: And David said to Abigail, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, which sent thee this day to meet me:

rr: Kandi obwengye bwawe busiimwe, naiwe osiimwe ahabw'okunzibira eri izooba kwehoorera enzigu n'omukono gwangye, nkagiibwaho orubanja.
en: and blessed be thy advice, and blessed be thou, which hast kept me this day from coming to shed blood, and from avenging myself with mine own hand.

rr: Ninkurahira MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli owanzibira kukukora kubi, kuri noogira ngu tiwaarahuka kwija kumbugana, bwaba nibuza kusheesha hatakiriho ekyetwa omwojo omu bantu ba Nabali.
en: For in very deed, as the LORD God of Israel liveth, which hath kept me back from hurting thee, except thou hadst hasted and come to meet me, surely there had not been left unto Nabal by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall.

rr: Atyo Daudi yaayakiira ebi yaamutoijera, yaamugira ati: Yeinamukire owaawe n'obusingye; ebi waagamba naabihurira, n'ebi waashaba naabiikiriza.
en: So David received of her hand that which she had brought him, and said unto her, Go up in peace to thine house; see, I have hearkened to thy voice, and have accepted thy person.

rr: Bwanyima Abigaili yaagaruka owa Nabali, yaashanga ateekire obugyenyi omu nju ye, oburikushusha nk'obw'omugabe; kandi agwirwe gye omu mutima, ahabw'okuba akaba asinzire munonga; n'ahabw'ekyo Abigaili tiyaagira ki yaamugambira kyona okuhitsya omu kasheeshe.
en: And Abigail came to Nabal; and, behold, he held a feast in his house, like the feast of a king; and Nabal's heart was merry within him, for he was very drunken: wherefore she told him nothing, less or more, until the morning light.

rr: Ku bwaseesire, Nabali amaarwa gaamurugaho, omukazi we yaamuteekyerereza ebyo byona, omutima gwa Nabali gwamuhwa omunda, yaaba nk'ekiti.
en: But it came to pass in the morning, when the wine was gone out of Nabal, and his wife had told him these things, that his heart died within him, and he became as a stone.

rr: Ku haahingwireho ebiro ikumi, MUKAMA yaamuteera, yaafa.
en: And it came to pass about ten days after , that the LORD smote Nabal, that he died.

rr: Daudi ku yaahuriire ngu Nabali yaafa, yaagira ati: MUKAMA asiimwe, owaanyihaho ekijumo eki Nabali anjumire, akazibira omwiru we kukora ekibi; kandi MUKAMA azimuuriire Nabali obubi bwe.
en: And when David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, Blessed be the LORD , that hath pleaded the cause of my reproach from the hand of Nabal, and hath kept his servant from evil: for the LORD hath returned the wickedness of Nabal upon his own head.

rr: Bwanyima Daudi yaatuma ahari Abigaili, naamuresya kumutwara, ngu abe omukazi we.
en: And David sent and communed with Abigail, to take her to him to wife.

rr: Abagaragwa ba Daudi ku baahikire Karumeeli owa Abigaili, baamugira bati: Daudi yaakututumaho kumukutwarira, ngu obe omukazi we.
en: And when the servants of David were come to Abigail to Carmel, they spake unto her, saying, David sent us unto thee, to take thee to him to wife.

rr: Yaabandatuka, yainika omutwe ahansi, yaagira ati: Reeba, nyowe omuzaana we ndi ow'okunaabisa ebigyere by'abagaragwa ba mukama wangye.
en: And she arose, and bowed herself on her face to the earth, and said, Behold, let thine handmaid be a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord.

rr: Ahonaaho Abigaili yaimuka, yaatemba endogoya, aine abazaana be bataano bamukuratiire; yaakurata entumwa za Daudi, yaaba omukazi we.
en: And Abigail hasted, and arose, and rode upon an ass, with five damsels of her's that went after her; and she went after the messengers of David, and became his wife.

rr: Kandi Daudi yaashwera Ahinoamu owa Yezereeli; bombi baaba abakazi be.
en: David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel; and they were also both of them his wives.

rr: Kwonka Saulo akaba yaahingiire Paluti mwene Laishi owa Galimu muhara we Mikaali, owaabaire ari muka Daudi.
en: But Saul had given Michal his daughter, David's wife, to Phalti the son of Laish, which was of Gallim.

Bwanyima aba Ziifu baaza Gibea owa Saulo, baamugira bati: Waamanyire Daudi ku ayesherekire omu kibungo kya Hakila aha burugwa-izooba bwa Yeshimooni?
en: And the Ziphites came unto Saul to Gibeah, saying, Doth not David hide himself in the hill of Hachilah, which is before Jeshimon?

rr: Ahonaaho Saulo yaimuka, yaashuuma omu ihamba rya Ziifu, aine engabo enkumi ishatu ezitoorainwe omuri Israeli, kuza kusherura Daudi omuri eryo ihamba.
en: Then Saul arose, and went down to the wilderness of Ziph, having three thousand chosen men of Israel with him, to seek David in the wilderness of Ziph.

rr: Saulo yaateera orusiisira aha kibungo kya Hakila, ekiri aha rubaju rw'omuhanda aha burugwa-izooba bwa Yeshimooni.
en: And Saul pitched in the hill of Hachilah, which is before Jeshimon, by the way.

rr: Kwonka Daudi yaaguma omu ihamba; ku yaareebire Saulo aizire omu ihamba kumusherura
en: But David abode in the wilderness, and he saw that Saul came after him into the wilderness.

rr: yaatuma entatsi, zaahamiza kimwe Saulo ku aizire.
en: David therefore sent out spies, and understood that Saul was come in very deed.

rr: Daudi yaimuka, yaija omu mwanya ogu Saulo ateiremu orusiisira; yaayetegyereza ahu Saulo abyami hamwe na Abuneeri mwene Neeri, omukuru w'engabo z'eihe rye; kandi Saulo akaba abyami omu mwanya gw'ahagati y'ebigaari, abantu bateire orusiisira bamwehinguririize.
en: And David arose, and came to the place where Saul had pitched: and David beheld the place where Saul lay, and Abner the son of Ner, the captain of his host: and Saul lay in the trench, and the people pitched round about him.

rr: Daudi yaagambira Ahimeleki Omuhiiti na Abishai murumuna wa Yoabu mwene Zeruiya, ati: N'oha orikwija kushuuma naanye omu rusiisira ahu Saulo ari?
en: Then answered David and said to Ahimelech the Hittite, and to Abishai the son of Zeruiah, brother to Joab, saying, Who will go down with me to Saul to the camp?

rr: Abishai yaagira ati: Niinye ndaashuumeyo naiwe.
en: And Abishai said, I will go down with thee.

rr: Daudi na Abishai baahika omuri ezo ngabo nyekiro omu rusiisira, baahika ahu Saulo yaabaire abyami agwejegyeire, omu mwanya gw'ahagati y'ebigaari, eicumu rye ritsimbire aha mushego, Abuneeri n'engabo ze babyami bamwehinguririize.
en: So David and Abishai came to the people by night: and, behold, Saul lay sleeping within the trench, and his spear stuck in the ground at his bolster: but Abner and the people lay round about him.

rr: Abishai yaagira Daudi ati: Eri izooba Ruhanga yaahayo omuzigu waawe omu mikono yaawe; mbwenu reka mmuteere eicumu rimwe, rimwogyemu, rikwate omu itaka, tindikwija kumuteera rya kabiri.
en: Then said Abishai to David, God hath delivered thine enemy into thine hand this day: now therefore let me smite him, I pray thee, with the spear even to the earth at once, and I will not smite him the second time.

rr: Kwonka Daudi yaagira Abishai ati: Reka, otamwita; mbwenu n'oha orikubaasa kubangira omukono ou MUKAMA yaashukireho amajuta, atagiibweho rubanja?
en: And David said to Abishai, Destroy him not: for who can stretch forth his hand against the LORD 's anointed, and be guiltless?

rr: Daudi yaagaruka yaagira ati: Ninkurahira MUKAMA otahwaho, MUKAMA niwe arimweyitira; nari shi obunaku bwe ku burihika, aryafa; nari aryashuuma omu rugamba, agweyo.
en: David said furthermore, As the LORD liveth, the LORD shall smite him; or his day shall come to die; or he shall descend into battle, and perish.

rr: Rubuuza nyowe okubanga omukono gwangye aha muntu ou MUKAMA yaashukireho amajuta; kureka iha eicumu n'orunywero rw'amaizi aha mushego gwe, tugyende.
en: The LORD forbid that I should stretch forth mine hand against the LORD 's anointed: but, I pray thee, take thou now the spear that is at his bolster, and the cruse of water, and let us go.

rr: Atyo Daudi yaiha eicumu n'orunywero rw'amaizi aha mushego gwa Saulo, baagyenda. Tihaagira owaakireeba, nari owaakimanya, n'obu yaakuba owaasisiimuka, ahabw'okuba MUKAMA akaba abagwejegyeize obutasisiimuka.
en: So David took the spear and the cruse of water from Saul's bolster; and they gat them away, and no man saw it , nor knew it , neither awaked: for they were all asleep; because a deep sleep from the LORD was fallen upon them.

rr: Bwanyima Daudi yaayambuka seeri, yaayemerera hare aha mutwe gw'ekibungo, ahagati yaabo haaba kaanya.
en: Then David went over to the other side, and stood on the top of an hill afar off; a great space being between them:

rr: Daudi yaayeta engabo na Abuneeri mwene Neeri, naagira ati: Abuneeri, ku otarikuteeza?
en: and David cried to the people, and to Abner the son of Ner, saying, Answerest thou not, Abner?

rr: Abuneeri yaamugarukamu ati: Iwe orikweta omugabe ori oha?
en: Then Abner answered and said, Who art thou that criest to the king?

rr: Daudi yaagira Abuneeri ati: Tori emanzi? N'oha orikwingana naiwe omuri Israeli? Mbwenu ekikuzibiire kurinda mukama waawe omugabe n'enki? Ahakuba omuntu aizire omuriimwe kwita omugabe mukama waawe.
en: And David said to Abner, Art not thou a valiant man? and who is like to thee in Israel? wherefore then hast thou not kept thy lord the king? for there came one of the people in to destroy the king thy lord.

rr: Eki okozire ti kirungi.
en: This thing is not good that thou hast done.

rr: Ninkurahira MUKAMA otahwaho, mushemereire kufa, ahabw'okuba timurinzire gye mukama waanyu, ou MUKAMA yaashukireho amajuta.
en: As the LORD liveth, ye are worthy to die, because ye have not kept your master, the LORD 's anointed.

rr: Mbwenu reeba eicumu ry'omugabe n'orunywero rw'amaizi orubaire ruri aha mushego gwe.
en: And now see where the king's spear is , and the cruse of water that was at his bolster.

rr: Saulo yaamanya eiraka rya Daudi, yaagira ati: Beitu eryo iraka n'eryawe, mwana wangye Daudi? Daudi yaagira ati: N'eryangye, mukama wangye omugabe.
en: And Saul knew David's voice, and said, Is this thy voice, my son David? And David said, It is my voice, my lord, O king.

rr: Yaagaruka yaagira ati: Beitu shi, mukama wangye ahiigira ki omwiru we? Nkakora ki? Nari shi ni kibi ki eki nyine?
en: And he said, Wherefore doth my lord thus pursue after his servant? for what have I done? or what evil is in mine hand?

rr: Mbwenu ninkweshengyereza, Nyakusinga omugabe, hurira ebigambo by'omwiru waawe.
en: Now therefore, I pray thee, let my lord the king hear the words of his servant.

rr: MUKAMA ku araabe niwe anteeraine naiwe, aikirize empongano; kwonka ku baraabe bari abantu, bakyeenwe omu maisho ga MUKAMA, ahakuba eri izooba bambinga ngu ntagira omugabo omu buhunguzi bwa MUKAMA, nibagira bati: Irooko oheereze baaruhanga abandi.
en: If the LORD have stirred thee up against me, let him accept an offering: but if they be the children of men, cursed be they before the LORD ; for they have driven me out this day from abiding in the inheritance of the LORD , saying, Go, serve other gods.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo hati otaikiriza eshagama yangye kugwa ahansi, ahu MUKAMA atari; ahabw'okuba omugabe wa Israeli aizire kusherura omura, nk'ohiigire endahi omu bibungo.
en: Now therefore, let not my blood fall to the earth before the face of the LORD : for the king of Israel is come out to seek a flea, as when one doth hunt a partridge in the mountains.

rr: Saulo yaagira ati: Nkashiisha; garuka, mwana wangye Daudi. Tindigaruka kukukora kubi, ahakuba amagara gangye gaaba ag'obuguzi bwingi omu maisho gaawe eri izooba. Reeba, nkakora eby'obufa-mutima, naahaba munonga.
en: Then said Saul, I have sinned: return, my son David: for I will no more do thee harm, because my soul was precious in thine eyes this day: behold, I have played the fool, and have erred exceedingly.

rr: Daudi yaamugira ati: Reeba eicumu ryawe ndiri, Nyakusinga! Hagire omwe aha batsigazi baawe, aije aryakiire.
en: And David answered and said, Behold the king's spear! and let one of the young men come over and fetch it.

rr: MUKAMA azimuurira omuntu nk'okuhikiirira kwe n'obwesigwa bwe oku biri. Omanye ku MUKAMA yaakuhayo omu mikono yangye eri izooba, nkanga kubanga omukono gwangye ahariiwe ou MUKAMA yaashukireho amajuta.
en: The LORD render to every man his righteousness and his faithfulness: for the LORD delivered thee into my hand to day, but I would not stretch forth mine hand against the LORD 's anointed.

rr: Kandi nk'oku amagara gaawe gaaba ag'obuguzi bwingi omu maisho gangye eri izooba, n'agangye gabe nikwo gaaba ag'obuguzi bwingi omu maisho ga MUKAMA, anjune omu kutuntuzibwa kwona.
en: And, behold, as thy life was much set by this day in mine eyes, so let my life be much set by in the eyes of the LORD , and let him deliver me out of all tribulation.

rr: Bwanyima Saulo yaagira Daudi ati: Oheebwe omugisha, mwana wangye Daudi; oryakora bikuru, kandi n'okusingura oryasingura.
en: Then Saul said to David, Blessed be thou, my son David: thou shalt both do great things , and also shalt still prevail.

rr: Atyo Daudi yaayegyendera, Saulo nawe yaagaruka owe.
en: So David went on his way, and Saul returned to his place.

rr: Bwanyima Daudi yaagira omu mutima gwe ati: Hoona eizooba rimwe Saulo aryarugaho anyite; tihariho kirikunkirira okuhungira omu nsi y'Abafilistia, kikaareetera Saulo kumpwa amatsiko, akareka kugaruka kunsherurira omu byaro bya Israeli byona; nkamukira ntyo.
en: And David said in his heart, I shall now perish one day by the hand of Saul: there is nothing better for me than that I should speedily escape into the land of the Philistines; and Saul shall despair of me, to seek me any more in any coast of Israel: so shall I escape out of his hand.

rr: Daudi yaimuka n'abashaija be magana mukaaga abu yaabaire aine, baayambuka, baayehongyera Akishi mwene Maoki, omugabe wa Gaasi.
en: And David arose, and he passed over with the six hundred men that were with him unto Achish, the son of Maoch, king of Gath.

rr: Daudi n'abashaija be baatuura na Akishi omuri Gaasi, buri muntu n'ab'omu ka ye, na Daudi n'abakazi be bombi, Ahinoamu owa Yezereeli, na Abigaili owa Karumeeli, owaabaire ari muka Nabali.
en: And David dwelt with Achish at Gath, he and his men, every man with his household, even David with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the Carmelitess, Nabal's wife.

rr: Abantu baagambira Saulo ku Daudi ahungiire Gaasi; tiyaagaruka kumusherura bundi.
en: And it was told Saul that David was fled to Gath: and he sought no more again for him.

rr: Bwanyima Daudi yaagira Akishi ati: Ku ndaabe ngiriirwe embabazi omu maisho gaawe, bampe ekibanja omu rurembo rumwe aha ndembo z'omu byaro, mbe nimwo naatuura; mbwenu omwiru waawe atuuzibwe ki naiwe omu rurembo rw'omugabe?
en: And David said unto Achish, If I have now found grace in thine eyes, let them give me a place in some town in the country, that I may dwell there: for why should thy servant dwell in the royal city with thee?

rr: Atyo Akishi yaamuha orurembo Zikulaagi eryo izooba; nikyo Zikulaagi yaabeereire ey'abagabe ba Yuda okwiha obwo n'okuhitsya hati.
en: Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day: wherefore Ziklag pertaineth unto the kings of Judah unto this day.

rr: Ebiro ebi Daudi yaamazire omu nsi y'Abafilistia bikahika omwaka n'ameezi ana.
en: And the time that David dwelt in the country of the Philistines was a full year and four months.

rr: Bwanyima Daudi n'abashaija be bainamuka, baateera aba Geshuri n'aba Giruzi n'Abaamaleki; ahakuba ago mahanga ira nigo gaabaire gatwire omuri egyo nsi erikugarukira Shuuri n'aha mwatano gw'ensi ya Misri.
en: And David and his men went up, and invaded the Geshurites, and the Gezrites, and the Amalekites: for those nations were of old the inhabitants of the land, as thou goest to Shur, even unto the land of Egypt.

rr: Daudi yaacwekyereza egyo nsi, tihaarokokamu mushaija nari omukazi; yaanyaga entaama n'ente n'endogoya n'engamira kandi n'ebijwaro; bwanyima yaatabaaruka, yaaza owa Akishi.
en: And David smote the land, and left neither man nor woman alive, and took away the sheep, and the oxen, and the asses, and the camels, and the apparel, and returned, and came to Achish.

rr: Akishi akaba amubuuza ati: Eri izooba waateera hi?
en: And Achish said, Whither have ye made a road to day?

rr: Daudi amugarukamu ati: Naateera Negebu eya Yuda, nari Negebu ey'aba Yerameeli, nari ey'aba Keeni.
en: And David said, Against the south of Judah, and against the south of the Jerahmeelites, and against the south of the Kenites.

rr: Kwonka Daudi akaba atarokora mushaija nari omukazi, ngu abatware Gaasi; ahabw'okuba akaba agira ngu nibaija kubarega bati: Daudi atukozire ati n'ati. Kandi ebiro byona ebi yaamazire omu nsi y'Abafilistia nikwo yaabaire atwaza.
en: And David saved neither man nor woman alive, to bring tidings to Gath, saying, Lest they should tell on us, saying, So did David, and so will be his manner all the while he dwelleth in the country of the Philistines.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo Akishi akeesiga Daudi, yaaguma naagira ati: Ayetamiise munonga beene waabo Abaisraeli; n'ahabw'ekyo naija kuguma ari omugaragwa wangye ebiro byona.
en: And Achish believed David, saying, He hath made his people Israel utterly to abhor him; therefore he shall be my servant for ever.

en: And it came to pass in those days, that the Philistines gathered their armies together for warfare, to fight with Israel.

rr: Akishi yaagira Daudi ati: Omanyire kimwe iwe n'abashaija baawe ku murikwija kuhurura naanye omu ihe ryaitu.
en: And Achish said unto David, Know thou assuredly, that thou shalt go out with me to battle, thou and thy men.

rr: Daudi yaamugira ati: Eego, aho niho oraamanyire eki omwiru waawe arikubaasa kukora. Akishi yaagira Daudi ati: Eego, naanye niinyija kukugira omurinzi w'amagara gangye ebiro byona. Saulo okuraguza aha mukazi orikubandwa emizimu
en: And David said to Achish, Surely thou shalt know what thy servant can do. And Achish said to David, Therefore will I make thee keeper of mine head for ever.

rr: Omu bunaku obwo Samueli akaba amazire omwanya afiire; kandi omu kufa kwe Abaisraeli boona bakamucurira, baamuziika omu rurembo rwe Raama.
en: Now Samuel was dead, and all Israel had lamented him, and buried him in Ramah, even in his own city.

rr: Kandi Saulo akaba aherize kucwa abarikugambisa emizimu n'abarogi omu nsi ye.
en: And Saul had put away those that had familiar spirits, and the wizards, out of the land.

rr: Omu biro ebyo Abafilistia bakateerana, baaza Shuneemu, baateerayo orusiisira. Saulo nawe yaateerana Abaisraeli boona, baateera orusiisira Giliboa.
en: And the Philistines gathered themselves together, and came and pitched in Shunem: and Saul gathered all Israel together, and they pitched in Gilboa.

rr: Saulo ku yaareebire eihe ry'Abafilistia, yaatiina, omutima gwamuhwa omunda, yaatetema munonga.
en: And when Saul saw the host of the Philistines, he was afraid, and his heart greatly trembled.

rr: Ku yaayehanwize ahari MUKAMA, MUKAMA tiyaagira ki yaamugarukamu, yaaba mu birooto nari omuri Urimu, n'obu haakuba omuri baanabi.
en: And when Saul enquired of the LORD , the LORD answered him not, neither by dreams, nor by Urim, nor by prophets. The Witch of En-dor

rr: Saulo nikwo kugira abagaragwa be ati: Munsherurire omugirwakazi w'emizimu, nze kumuraguzaho.
en: Then said Saul unto his servants, Seek me a woman that hath a familiar spirit, that I may go to her, and enquire of her.

rr: Abagaragwa be baamugarukamu bati: Reeba, hariho omurogikazi ari Endoori.
en: And his servants said to him, Behold, there is a woman that hath a familiar spirit at En-dor.

rr: Saulo yaayehindura, yaajwara ebindi bijwaro, yaagyenda n'abashaija babiri, baaza ow'ogwo mukazi nyekiro, yaamugira ati: Ninkweshengyereza, ndagurira n'omuzimu ogu obandwa, ondeetere ou ndaakugambire.
en: And Saul disguised himself, and put on other raiment, and he went, and two men with him, and they came to the woman by night: and he said, I pray thee, divine unto me by the familiar spirit, and bring me him up, whom I shall name unto thee.

rr: Ogwo mukazi yaamugira ati: Noomanyira kimwe eki Saulo yaakozire, ku yaacwire abarikubandwa emizimu n'abarogi omu nsi ye. Mbwenu ahabw'enki nootega amagara gangye omutego ngu baanyite?
en: And the woman said unto him, Behold, thou knowest what Saul hath done, how he hath cut off those that have familiar spirits, and the wizards, out of the land: wherefore then layest thou a snare for my life, to cause me to die?

rr: Saulo yaamurahira MUKAMA naagira ati: Ninkurahira MUKAMA atahwaho, ekyo torikiturwa.
en: And Saul sware to her by the LORD , saying, As the LORD liveth, there shall no punishment happen to thee for this thing.

rr: Omukazi yaamubuuza ati: Nkuzoorere oha? Onu ati: Nzoorera Samueli.
en: Then said the woman, Whom shall I bring up unto thee? And he said, Bring me up Samuel.

rr: Ogwo mukazi ku yaareebire Samueli, yaayamuza n'eiraka rihango; yaagira Saulo ati: Wambeihera ki? Kunu ori Saulo.
en: And when the woman saw Samuel, she cried with a loud voice: and the woman spake to Saul, saying, Why hast thou deceived me? for thou art Saul.

rr: Omugabe yaamugira ati: Otatiina! Ngambira eki orikureeba. Omukazi yaagira Saulo ati: Nindeeba ruhanga naaruga okuzimu.
en: And the king said unto her, Be not afraid: for what sawest thou? And the woman said unto Saul, I saw gods ascending out of the earth.

rr: Yaamubuuza ati: Naashusha ki?
en: And he said unto her, What form is he of?

rr: Onu ati: N'omugurusi orikwinamuka, kandi ayehumbikire omwenda.
en: And she said, An old man cometh up; and he is covered with a mantle.

rr: Saulo yaamanya ku ari Samueli, yainama, yaamutangirira.
en: And Saul perceived that it was Samuel, and he stooped with his face to the ground, and bowed himself.

rr: Samueli yaabuuza Saulo ati: Ahabw'enki waanyomberera, okarugaho okanyiha okuzimu? Saulo yaagarukamu ati: Nshobeirwe munonga; ahabw'okuba Abafilistia nibandwanisa, kandi Ruhanga andugireho; takingarukiramu muri baanabi nari omu birooto. Nikyo naakwetera, ngu ommanyise eki ndaakore.
en: And Samuel said to Saul, Why hast thou disquieted me, to bring me up? And Saul answered, I am sore distressed; for the Philistines make war against me, and God is departed from me, and answereth me no more, neither by prophets, nor by dreams: therefore I have called thee, that thou mayest make known unto me what I shall do.

rr: Samueli yaagira ati: Ku oraabe noomanya ngu MUKAMA akurugireho, yaahinduka omuzigu waawe, nombuuriza ki?
en: Then said Samuel, Wherefore then dost thou ask of me, seeing the LORD is departed from thee, and is become thine enemy?

rr: MUKAMA akugizire nk'oku yaagambire naaraba omuriinye, ahakuba MUKAMA akakutaaguraho obugabe, yaabuha mutaahi waawe Daudi.
en: And the LORD hath done to him, as he spake by me: for the LORD hath rent the kingdom out of thine hand, and given it to thy neighbour, even to David:

rr: Ahabw'okutoorobera iraka rya MUKAMA, n'okutahikiiriza kiniga kye kingi aha Baamaleki, nikyo MUKAMA yaakugirira atyo eri izooba.
en: because thou obeyedst not the voice of the LORD , nor executedst his fierce wrath upon Amalek, therefore hath the LORD done this thing unto thee this day.

rr: N'ekindi MUKAMA naija kukuhayo hamwe n'Abaisraeli omu mikono y'Abafilistia, kandi nyencakare iwe na batabani baawe nimwija kunshanga ei ndi. MUKAMA naija kuhayo eihe ry'Abaisraeli omu mikono y'Abafilistia.
en: Moreover the LORD will also deliver Israel with thee into the hand of the Philistines: and to morrow shalt thou and thy sons be with me: the LORD also shall deliver the host of Israel into the hand of the Philistines.

rr: Ahonaaho Saulo yaagwa ahansi arambiire, aine obwoba bwingi ahabw'ebigambo bya Samueli; amaani gaamuhwamu, ahabw'okuba akaba asiibirekwo kandi arairekwo.
en: Then Saul fell straightway all along on the earth, and was sore afraid, because of the words of Samuel: and there was no strength in him; for he had eaten no bread all the day, nor all the night.

rr: Bwanyima ogwo mukazi yaija ahari Saulo; ku yaareebire atiinire munonga, yaamugira ati: Reeba, nyowe omuzaana waawe naakuhurira, naayoga amagara, naakora eki wandagiira.
en: And the woman came unto Saul, and saw that he was sore troubled, and said unto him, Behold, thine handmaid hath obeyed thy voice, and I have put my life in my hand, and have hearkened unto thy words which thou spakest unto me.

rr: Mbwenu ninkweshengyereza, naiwe ohurire omuzaana waawe, onyikirize nkureetere ak'okurya, orye, obone agagyenda.
en: Now therefore, I pray thee, hearken thou also unto the voice of thine handmaid, and let me set a morsel of bread before thee; and eat, that thou mayest have strength, when thou goest on thy way.

rr: Yaayanga, yaagira ati: Tindikwija kurya.
en: But he refused, and said, I will not eat.

rr: Kwonka abagaragwa be hamwe n'ogwo mukazi baamugyema, yaikiriza ebi baamugambira.
en: But his servants, together with the woman, compelled him; and he hearkened unto their voice.

rr: Yaabandatuka ahansi, yaashutama aha kitanda.
en: So he arose from the earth, and sat upon the bed.

rr: Ogwo mukazi akaba aine enyana y'ebishaju omu nju; yaakoresa obwira, yaagiita, yaagira esaano, yaagibumbabumba, yaagiteekamu omugaati ogutatumbisiibwe
en: And the woman had a fat calf in the house; and she hasted, and killed it, and took flour, and kneaded it , and did bake unleavened bread thereof:

rr: yaabireetera Saulo n'abagaragwa be, baarya.
en: and she brought it before Saul, and before his servants; and they did eat.

en: Then they rose up, and went away that night.

en: Then Achish called David, and said unto him, Surely, as the LORD liveth, thou hast been upright, and thy going out and thy coming in with me in the host is good in my sight: for I have not found evil in thee since the day of thy coming unto me unto this day: nevertheless the lords favour thee not.

en: And David said unto Achish, But what have I done? and what hast thou found in thy servant so long as I have been with thee unto this day, that I may not go fight against the enemies of my lord the king?

en: And Achish answered and said to David, I know that thou art good in my sight, as an angel of God: notwithstanding the princes of the Philistines have said, He shall not go up with us to the battle.

en: And David was greatly distressed; for the people spake of stoning him, because the soul of all the people was grieved, every man for his sons and for his daughters: but David encouraged himself in the LORD his God.

rr: Atyo Abiasaari yaagimureetera.

en: And David enquired at the LORD , saying, Shall I pursue after this troop? shall I overtake them?

rr: MUKAMA yaamugarukamu ati: Zikurate; ahakuba torikwija kubura kuzihika, kandi torikwija kuremwa kugarura ebintu byona.
en: And he answered him, Pursue: for thou shalt surely overtake them , and without fail recover all .

en: And David said unto him, To whom belongest thou? and whence art thou? And he said, I am a young man of Egypt, servant to an Amalekite; and my master left me, because three days agone I fell sick.

en: We made an invasion upon the south of the Cherethites, and upon the coast which belongeth to Judah, and upon the south of Caleb; and we burned Ziklag with fire.

rr: Daudi yaamubuuza ati: Okaanyebembera, ompitsya omuri ezo ngabo?
en: And David said to him, Canst thou bring me down to this company?

rr: Onu ati: Ndahira Ruhanga ku otarikwija kuunyita, n'obu kwakuba okumpayo omu mikono ya mukama wangye, mbone kuzikuhitsyamu.
en: And he said, Swear unto me by God, that thou wilt neither kill me, nor deliver me into the hands of my master, and I will bring thee down to this company.

en: And when he had brought him down, behold, they were spread abroad upon all the earth, eating and drinking, and dancing, because of all the great spoil that they had taken out of the land of the Philistines, and out of the land of Judah.

rr: Daudi yaabaita okwiha omu rwita-waabo okuhitsya omu mwabazyo gw'erindi izooba; tihaahonokaho n'omwe omuribo, kureka abatsigazi magana ana, abaatembire engamira bakahunga.
en: And David smote them from the twilight even unto the evening of the next day: and there escaped not a man of them, save four hundred young men, which rode upon camels, and fled.

en: And there was nothing lacking to them, neither small nor great, neither sons nor daughters, neither spoil, nor any thing that they had taken to them: David recovered all.

en: And David took all the flocks and the herds, which they drave before those other cattle, and said, This is David's spoil. Dividing the Spoil

en: And David came to the two hundred men, which were so faint that they could not follow David, whom they had made also to abide at the brook Besor: and they went forth to meet David, and to meet the people that were with him: and when David came near to the people, he saluted them.

en: Then answered all the wicked men and men of Belial, of those that went with David, and said, Because they went not with us, we will not give them ought of the spoil that we have recovered, save to every man his wife and his children, that they may lead them away, and depart.

en: Then said David, Ye shall not do so, my brethren, with that which the LORD hath given us, who hath preserved us, and delivered the company that came against us into our hand.

en: For who will hearken unto you in this matter? but as his part is that goeth down to the battle, so shall his part be that tarrieth by the stuff: they shall part alike.

en: And when David came to Ziklag, he sent of the spoil unto the elders of Judah, even to his friends, saying, Behold a present for you of the spoil of the enemies of the LORD ;

rr: Okwo nikwo Saulo yaafiire n'abatabani bonshatu, n'omukwatsi w'eby'okurwanisa bye, n'engabo ze zoona; bakafeera hamwe eryo izooba.
en: So Saul died, and his three sons, and his armourbearer, and all his men, that same day together.

rr: Kandi Abaisraeli abaabaire bari seeri y'oruhita, n'abaabaire bari seeri ya Yorudani, ku baareebire Abaisraeli baahunga, na Saulo n'abatabani baafa, baatsigaho endembo zaabo, baahunga; Abafilistia baija, baazituuramu.
en: And when the men of Israel that were on the other side of the valley, and they that were on the other side Jordan, saw that the men of Israel fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they forsook the cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.

rr: Ku bwaseesire, Abafilistia baija kucwijura emitumbi, baashanga Saulo n'abatabani bonshatu bagwire aha kibungo kya Giliboa
en: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his three sons fallen in mount Gilboa.

rr: baamutemaho omutwe, baamucwijura eby'okurwanisa bye, baatuma entumwa omu nsi y'Abafilistia kubuzya hoona amakuru omuri hekalu z'ebishushani byabo ebirikuramibwa, n'omu bantu boona.
en: And they cut off his head, and stripped off his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to publish it in the house of their idols, and among the people.

rr: Eby'okurwanisa bye baabita omuri hekalu ya Ashitaroosi, n'omutumbi gwe baaguhanika aha rugo rw'amabaare rwa Besi-shaani.
en: And they put his armour in the house of Ashtaroth: and they fastened his body to the wall of Beth-shan.

rr: Abanyayabeshi-gileadi ku baahuriire oku Abafilistia bagizire Saulo
en: And when the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead heard of that which the Philistines had done to Saul;

rr: 1 -11 ; 2 abashaija boona amamanzi baimuka, baagyenda ekiro kyona, baahanura omutumbi gwa Saulo n'ey'abatabani aha rugo rwa Besi-shaani, baagaruka Yabeshi; ku baahikireyo, baagyotsya.
en: all the valiant men arose, and went all night, and took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Beth-shan, and came to Jabesh, and burnt them there.
