1 Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians which is in God the Father and in the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

rr: 2 Ebiro byona tusiima Ruhanga ahabwanyu mwena, nitugamba aha maziina gaanyu omu kushaba kwaitu
en: 2 We give thanks to God always for you all, making mention of you in our prayers;
3 remembering without ceasing your work of faith, and labour of love, and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, in the sight of God and our Father;

rr: 4 B'eishe-emwe abarikukundwa Ruhanga, nitumanya ku yaabatooraine
en: 4 knowing, brethren beloved, your election of God.
5 For our gospel came not unto you in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Ghost, and in much assurance; as ye know what manner of men we were among you for your sake.

rr: 6 kandi obu mwayakiira ekigambo omu busaasi bwingi mwine okushemererwa okurikuruga omu Mwoyo Orikwera, mukatooreza emitwarize yaitu n'eya Mukama
en: 6 And ye became followers of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Ghost:
7 so that ye were ensamples to all that believe in Macedonia and Achaia.

rr: 8 Ahakuba ekigambo kya Mukama nimwo kyarugire nikigambwa, ti muri Makedonia na Akaya zonka, kureka hoonahoona okwikiriza Ruhanga kwanyu kurangainwe; n'ahabw'ekyo titwine kindi eki tushemereire kubigambaho.
en: 8 For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith to God-ward is spread abroad; so that we need not to speak any thing.
9 For they themselves shew of us what manner of entering in we had unto you, and how ye turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God;
10 and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, even Jesus, which delivered us from the wrath to come.

rr: 1 Ahakuba naimwe, B'eishe-emwe, nimumanya ngu okubataayaayira kwaitu tikurabaire kwa busha
en: 1 For yourselves, brethren, know our entrance in unto you, that it was not in vain:
2 but even after that we had suffered before, and were shamefully entreated, as ye know, at Philippi, we were bold in our God to speak unto you the gospel of God with much contention.

rr: 3 Mumanye ngu okubuurira kwaitu ti kw'okuhabya, ti kw'ebihagaro, kandi tikurimu bugobya
en: 3 For our exhortation was not of deceit, nor of uncleanness, nor in guile:
4 but as we were allowed of God to be put in trust with the gospel, even so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God, which trieth our hearts.
5 For neither at any time used we flattering words, as ye know, nor a cloke of covetousness; God is witness:
6 nor of men sought we glory, neither of you, nor yet of others, when we might have been burdensome, as the apostles of Christ.

rr: 7 Kwonka tukatwaza gye omuriimwe, nk'oku omurezi arera abaana be.
en: 7 But we were gentle among you, even as a nurse cherisheth her children:

rr: 8 N'ahabw'ekyo, ahabw'okubasaasibwa munonga, tukashemerererwa okubaha, ti ngiri ya Ruhanga yonka, kureka n'okuhayo amagara gaitu, ahabw'okuba mukahinduka abaitu ab'aha mara.
en: 8 so being affectionately desirous of you, we were willing to have imparted unto you, not the gospel of God only, but also our own souls, because ye were dear unto us.
9 For ye remember, brethren, our labour and travail: for labouring night and day, because we would not be chargeable unto any of you, we preached unto you the gospel of God.

rr: 10 Imwe muri baakareebi, hamwe na Ruhanga, abarikuhamya emitwarize yaitu ahariimwe abarikwikiriza, ku yaabaire eri erikwera, ey'okuhikiirira, kandi etarikugaywa
en: 10 Ye are witnesses, and God also , how holily and justly and unblameably we behaved ourselves among you that believe:
11 as ye know how we exhorted and comforted and charged every one of you, as a father doth his children,
12 that ye would walk worthy of God, who hath called you unto his kingdom and glory.

rr: 13 Kandi hoona eki tusiimira Ruhanga obutoosha n'eki; ahakuba, ku mwahuriire ekigambo ky'engiri ya Ruhanga eki twabagambiire, mwakyakiira; kandi timwakyakiira nk'ekigambo ky'abantu, kureka nk'ekigambo kya Ruhanga ekirikukora omuriimwe abarikwikiriza; kandi omu mazima nikwo kiri.
en: 13 For this cause also thank we God without ceasing, because, when ye received the word of God which ye heard of us, ye received it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, the word of God, which effectually worketh also in you that believe.

rr: 14 Kandi, B'eishe-emwe, mukakuratira amakanisa ga Ruhanga aga Buyudaaya agari omuri Kristo Yesu; ahakuba ebi mwabonabonesiibwe beene waanyu bikashusha nk'ebi ab'ago makanisa baabonabonesiibwe Abayudaaya
en: 14 For ye, brethren, became followers of the churches of God which in Judæa are in Christ Jesus: for ye also have suffered like things of your own countrymen, even as they have of the Jews:
15 who both killed the Lord Jesus, and their own prophets, and have persecuted us; and they please not God, and are contrary to all men:
16 forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they might be saved, to fill up their sins alway: for the wrath is come upon them to the uttermost.

rr: 17 Kwonka itwe, B'eishe-emwe, ku twabaihirweho okumara omwanya mukye, omu mubiri ti mu mutima, twayeyongyera munonga kugira orushusho rw'okwenda kureebana naimwe
en: 17 But we, brethren, being taken from you for a short time in presence, not in heart, endeavoured the more abundantly to see your face with great desire.

rr: 18 ahakuba tukamariirira kwija owaanyu, nangwa nyowe Paulo nkenda kwija, ti rimwe ni kabiri; kwonka Sitaane yaatuzibira.
en: 18 Wherefore we would have come unto you, even I Paul, once and again; but Satan hindered us.
19 For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Are not even ye in the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ at his coming?

rr: 20 Ahakuba niimwe kitiinisa kyaitu n'okushemererwa kwaitu.
en: 20 For ye are our glory and joy.
1 Wherefore when we could no longer forbear, we thought it good to be left at Athens alone;

rr: 2 twatuma ow'eishe-emwe Timoseo, omuheereza wa Ruhanga omu ngiri ya Kristo, kubagumya n'okubeezirikisa omu kwikiriza kwanyu
en: 2 and sent Timotheus, our brother, and minister of God, and our fellowlabourer in the gospel of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you concerning your faith:
3 that no man should be moved by these afflictions: for yourselves know that we are appointed thereunto.
4 For verily, when we were with you, we told you before that we should suffer tribulation; even as it came to pass, and ye know.

rr: 5 N'ahabw'ekyo, ku naaremirwe kugumisiriza, naabatumaho kumanya okwikiriza kwanyu oku kuri, twine obwoba, ngu shana obundi omutegi akaaba yaabategire, naitwe okukora kwaitu kufa busha.
en: 5 For this cause, when I could no longer forbear, I sent to know your faith, lest by some means the tempter have tempted you, and our labour be in vain.

6 But now when Timotheus came from you unto us, and brought us good tidings of your faith and charity, and that ye have good remembrance of us always, desiring greatly to see us, as we also to see you:

rr: 7 N'ahabw'ekyo, B'eishe-emwe, tuhuumwire ahabwanyu omu kushoberwa n'omu kubonabona kwaitu ahabw'okwikiriza kwanyu
en: 7 therefore, brethren, we were comforted over you in all our affliction and distress by your faith:

rr: 8 mbwenu hati turiyo gye, ahabw'okuba mwemereire muhamiire omuri Mukama.
en: 8 for now we live, if ye stand fast in the Lord.

rr: 9 Ni kusiima ki oku turaabasiimire Ruhanga ahabw'okushemererwa kwona oku twine ahabwanyu omu maisho ga Ruhanga waitu
en: 9 For what thanks can we render to God again for you, for all the joy wherewith we joy for your sakes before our God;

rr: 10 tukashaba n'obweziriki nyomushana na nyekiro, ngu tureebane, kandi tuhikiirize ekibuzire omu kwikiriza kwanyu?
en: 10 night and day praying exceedingly that we might see your face, and might perfect that which is lacking in your faith?

rr: 11 Mbwenu Ruhanga Tataitwe ahabwe na Mukama waitu Yesu atuhe oburyo bw'okwija owaanyu
en: 11 Now God himself and our Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way unto you.

rr: 12 Mukama abongyere kandi abakanyisize okukunda oku murikukundana, kandi oku murikukunda abantu boona, nk'oku turikubakunda imwe
en: 12 And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men , even as we do toward you:
13 to the end he may stablish your hearts unblameable in holiness before God, even our Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all his saints.
1 Furthermore then we beseech you, brethren, and exhort you by the Lord Jesus, that as ye have received of us how ye ought to walk and to please God, so ye would abound more and more.

rr: 2 Ahakuba nimumanya ebiragiro ebi twbahaire omu iziina rya Mukama waitu Yesu.
en: 2 For ye know what commandments we gave you by the Lord Jesus.
3 For this is the will of God, even your sanctification, that ye should abstain from fornication:

rr: 4 omuntu weena omuriimwe amanye # 4:4 Nari: okushwera omukazi omu kwera n'omu kitiinisa. kutegyeka omubiri gwe omu kwera n'omu kitiinisa
en: 4 that every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour;
5 not in the lust of concupiscence, even as the Gentiles which know not God:

rr: 6 omuntu weena arekye kushiisha akashaagiza mugyenzi we omu kigambo ekyo, ahakuba Mukama niwe muhoozi w'enzigu ow'ebyo byona, nk'oku twabaire twabahabwire nitubahamiiriza.
en: 6 that no man go beyond and defraud his brother in any matter: because that the Lord is the avenger of all such, as we also have forewarned you and testified.

rr: 7 Ahakuba Ruhanga taratweteire kukora bihagaro, kureka akatwetera okuba abarikwera.
en: 7 For God hath not called us unto uncleanness, but unto holiness.
8 He therefore that despiseth, despiseth not man, but God, who hath also given unto us his holy Spirit.
9 But as touching brotherly love ye need not that I write unto you: for ye yourselves are taught of God to love one another.

rr: 10 kandi buzima nimukunda ab'eishe-emwe boona ab'omuri Makedonia yoona. Kwonka nitubeehanangiriza, B'eishe-emwe, mugume mweyongyere kukundana
en: 10 And indeed ye do it toward all the brethren which are in all Macedonia: but we beseech you, brethren, that ye increase more and more;
11 and that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you;
12 that ye may walk honestly toward them that are without, and that ye may have lack of nothing.
13 But I would not have you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning them which are asleep, that ye sorrow not, even as others which have no hope.
14 For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him.
15 For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord, that we which are alive and remain unto the coming of the Lord shall not prevent them which are asleep.

rr: 16 Ahakuba Mukama aryayeimukira ashuume naaruga omu iguru agambe munonga n'eiraka rya maraika omukuru n'enzamba ya Ruhanga; kandi abaafeereire omuri Kristo nibo baribanza kuzooka
en: 16 For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first:
17 then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.

rr: 18 N'ahabw'ekyo muhuumurizane n'ebigambo ebyo.
en: 18 Wherefore comfort one another with these words.
1 But of the times and the seasons, brethren, ye have no need that I write unto you.

rr: 2 ahabw'okuba imwe ahabwanyu nimumanya gye ngu ekiro kya Mukama kiryaija nk'omushuma wa nyekiro.
en: 2 For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.
3 For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape.

rr: 4 Kwonka imwe, B'eishe-emwe, timuri omu mwirima, ekiro ekyo kubagwaho nk'omushuma
en: 4 But ye, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief.
5 Ye are all the children of light, and the children of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness.

rr: 6 N'ahabw'ekyo turekye kugwejegyera nk'abandi; kureka tugume nitureeba, tutasina
en: 6 Therefore let us not sleep, as do others; but let us watch and be sober.

rr: 7 ahakuba abagwejegyera bagwejegyera nyekiro, n'abasinda basinda nyekiro
en: 7 For they that sleep, sleep in the night; and they that be drunken are drunken in the night.
8 But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation.

rr: 9 Mumanye ngu Ruhanga taratuteereireho kiniga kureka okutunga okujunwa ahabwa Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo
en: 9 For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ,
10 who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.

rr: 11 N'ahabw'ekyo mugumyane, kandi mwombekane, nk'oku murikukora.
en: 11 Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.
12 And we beseech you, brethren, to know them which labour among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you;

rr: 13 mubahe ekitiinisa munonga omuri rukundo ahabw'omurimo gwabo. Mugume mwine obusingye, omuntu na mugyenzi we.
en: 13 and to esteem them very highly in love for their work's sake. And be at peace among yourselves.
14 Now we exhort you, brethren, warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all men .
15 See that none render evil for evil unto any man ; but ever follow that which is good, both among yourselves, and to all men .

rr: 16 Mugume mushemererwe ebiro byona
en: 16 Rejoice evermore.
17 Pray without ceasing.
18 In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
19 Quench not the Spirit.

rr: 20 mutagaya ebya baanabi
en: 20 Despise not prophesyings.
21 Prove all things; hold fast that which is good.

rr: 22 mwetantare kyona ekirikushusha ekibi.
en: 22 Abstain from all appearance of evil.

rr: 23 Ruhanga mukama w'obusingye we wenka abeereza kimwe; kandi emyoyo yaanyu n'amagara gaanyu n'emibiri yaanyu birindwe gye, bishangwe bitaine ki birikuhanwa aha kiro ky'okwija kwa Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo.
en: 23 And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
24 Faithful is he that calleth you, who also will do it .

rr: 25 B'eishe-emwe, mutushabire.
en: 25 Brethren, pray for us.

rr: 26 Muramutsye ab'eishe-emwe boona n'okunywegyera okurikwera.
en: 26 Greet all the brethren with an holy kiss.

rr: 27 Nimbarahiza Mukama mushomere ab'eishe-emwe boona ebaruha egi.
en: 27 I charge you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the holy brethren.

rr: 28 Embabazi za Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo zigume naimwe.
en: 28 The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.

rr: 1 Nyowe Paulo, entumwa ya Kristo Yesu ahabw'okuragiirwa Ruhanga Omujuni waitu, na Kristo Yesu amatsiko gaitu
en: 1 Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Saviour, and Lord Jesus Christ, which is our hope;

rr: 2 naakuhandiikira, Timoseo omwana wangye buzima omu kwikiriza; ninkwendeza embabazi n'okusaasirwa n'obusingye ebirikuruga ahari Ruhanga Isheboona na Kristo Yesu Mukama waitu.
en: 2 unto Timothy, my own son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.

rr: 3 Ku naabaire ninza Makedonia, nkatsiga naakwehanangiriza ku oguma Efeso, ngu obone kuhana abantu bamwe barekye kwegyesa endiijo nyegyesa
en: 3 As I besought thee to abide still at Ephesus, when I went into Macedonia, that thou mightest charge some that they teach no other doctrine,
4 neither give heed to fables and endless genealogies, which minister questions, rather than godly edifying which is in faith: so do .
5 Now the end of the commandment is charity out of a pure heart, and of a good conscience, and of faith unfeigned:

rr: 6 Hariho abantu bamwe abateishukire ebyo, bakahabira omu mpaka ezitaine mugasho
en: 6 from which some having swerved have turned aside unto vain jangling;

rr: 7 nibenda kuba abeegyesa b'Ebiragiro, haza batarikwetegyereza ki barikugamba, n'obu byakuba ebi barikuhamya.
en: 7 desiring to be teachers of the law; understanding neither what they say, nor whereof they affirm.
8 But we know that the law is good, if a man use it lawfully;

rr: 9 naashoborokyerwa ngu Ebiragiro tibiratairweho habw'abahikiriire, kureka ahabw'abagomi n'abatarikuhurira, ahabw'abatatiina Ruhanga n'abasiisi, ahabw'abatarikwera n'abateeta ha bya Ruhanga, ahabw'abaita baishebo na baanyinabo, n'abaitsi b'abandi
en: 9 knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,

rr: 10 n'abashambani, n'abashaija abakorana eby'enshoni, n'abanyaga abantu bakabatunda, n'ababeihi, n'abarahira ebishuba, n'ebindi byona ebirikurwanisa enyegyesa ehikire
en: 10 for whoremongers, for them that defile themselves with mankind, for menstealers, for liars, for perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine;

rr: 11 erikukuratira engiri y'ekitiinisa eya Ruhanga orikusiimwa, ei naakwatsiibwe.
en: 11 according to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.
12 And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who hath enabled me, for that he counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry;

rr: 13 n'obu ndaabe obunyakare naamurogotsireho, nkamujuma, ndi omuntu enshaarizi; kwonka nkasaasirwa ahabw'okubikorera omu butamanya n'omu butaikiriza
en: 13 who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: but I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.

rr: 14 kandi embabazi za Mukama waitu zikaba nyingi munonga hariinye hamwe n'okwikiriza n'okukunda okuri omuri Kristo Yesu.
en: 14 And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
15 This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.

rr: 16 kwonka eki naasaasiriirwe, Yesu Kristo akenda kworekyera omuriinye, omusiisi w'okubanza, eky'okureeberaho ahari abo abarimwikiriza kutunga amagara agatahwaho.
en: 16 Howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might shew forth all longsuffering, for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting.

rr: 17 Mukama otahwaho, otafa, otareebwa, Ruhanga Nyamuhanga, aheebwe ekitiinisa, ahimbisibwe ebiro n'ebiro. Amiina.
en: 17 Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only wise God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.
18 This charge I commit unto thee, son Timothy, according to the prophecies which went before on thee, that thou by them mightest war a good warfare;
19 holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck:
20 of whom is Hymenæus and Alexander; whom I have delivered unto Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme.
1 I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men;

rr: 2 mushabire abagabe n'abategyeki boona tubone kugira obusingye tutebeekane, nitutiina Ruhanga kandi nitwerinda omu buryo bwona.
en: 2 for kings, and for all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty.

rr: 3 Eki nikyo kirungi kandi ekishemeire omu maisho ga Ruhanga Omujuni waitu
en: 3 For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Saviour;
4 who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.
5 For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;
6 who gave himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.
7 Whereunto I am ordained a preacher, and an apostle, (I speak the truth in Christ, and lie not;) a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and verity.

rr: 8 N'ahabw'ekyo niinyenda ngu abashaija babe nibo baashaba omu myanya yoona, nibaimutsya emikono erikwera bataine kiniga nari empaka.
en: 8 I will therefore that men pray every where, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.
9 In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety; not with broided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array;

rr: 10 kureka bakore emirimo miringu eshemereire abakazi abeeyeta abarikutiina Ruhanga.
en: 10 but (which becometh women professing godliness) with good works.

rr: 11 Omukazi agume ayegye ahunami omu kworoba kwona.
en: 11 Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.
12 But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence.

rr: 13 Ahakuba Adamu niwe yaabandize kuhangwa, haakurataho Haawa
en: 13 For Adam was first formed, then Eve.
14 And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.

rr: 15 Kwonka omukazi ku ariguma omu kwikiriza, omu kukunda, omu kwera, hamwe n'omu kwerinda, aryaguma atabaarukye gye omu kuzaara abaana.
en: 15 Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety.
1 This is a true saying, If a man desire the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work.
2 A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behaviour, given to hospitality, apt to teach;

rr: 3 otarikusinda, otarikurwana, kureka orikutwaza gye, otarikutongana, otarikukunda mpiiha
en: 3 not given to wine, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre; but patient, not a brawler, not covetous;
4 one that ruleth well his own house, having his children in subjection with all gravity;

rr: 5 (omuntu otarikumanya kutegyeka ab'omu ka ye, naabaasa ata kutegyeka ekanisa ya Ruhanga?)
en: 5 (for if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?)

rr: 6 tashemereire kuba Mukristaayo musya, obundi atakaayetunguura, akagwa, akacwerwa orubanja nk'oru Sitaane yaacwereirwe
en: 6 Not a novice, lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the condemnation of the devil.
7 Moreover he must have a good report of them which are without; lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.

rr: 8 Kandi abadiikoni nabo bashemereire kuba abeerinzi abatarikugambira habiri, abatarikunywa viinyo nyingi, abatarikwetenga nshaagi
en: 8 Likewise must the deacons be grave, not doubletongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of filthy lucre;

rr: 9 abarikurinda enaama y'okwikiriza, abaine omutima ogutarikweshinja.
en: 9 holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.

rr: 10 Kandi abo babanze bagyezibwe; ku baraashangwe bataine ki barikugaywaho, babone kukora omurimo gw'obudiikoni.
en: 10 And let these also first be proved; then let them use the office of a deacon, being found blameless.
11 Even so must their wives be grave, not slanderers, sober, faithful in all things.

rr: 12 Abadiikoni babe abashaija abaine omukazi omwe, abarikutegyeka gye abaana baabo n'abamaka gaabo
en: 12 Let the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.

rr: 13 ahakuba abaheereza gye omu murimo gw'obudiikono beetungira eiziina rirungi n'obumanzi bwingi omu kwikiriza okuri omuri Kristo Yesu.
en: 13 For they that have used the office of a deacon well purchase to themselves a good degree, and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.
14 These things write I unto thee, hoping to come unto thee shortly:

rr: 15 ngu, ku ndiba ntarahukire kwija, omanye oku abantu bashemereire kutwaza omu nju ya Ruhanga, niyo kanisa ya Ruhanga ohuriire, enyomyo kandi obuhamizo bw'amazima.
en: 15 But if I tarry long, that thou mayest know how thou oughtest to behave thyself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.

16 And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of angels, preached unto the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory.
1 Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils;

rr: 2 bahabisibwe oburyarya bw'abantu abarikubeiha ebishuba, abaine emitima etakihuriira, nk'esiriiziibwe ekyoma ekirukwotsya
en: 2 speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron;
3 forbidding to marry, and commanding to abstain from meats, which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth.
4 For every creature of God is good, and nothing to be refused, if it be received with thanksgiving:

rr: 5 ahakuba nikiba kyeziibwe ekigambo kya Ruhanga n'okushaba.
en: 5 for it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.

rr: 6 Ku orishobororera ab'eishe-emwe ebigambo ebyo, oryaguma ori omuheereza murungi wa Kristo Yesu, orikutungwa ebigambo by'okwikiriza n'eby'enyegyesa nungi ei waakuratiire.
en: 6 If thou put the brethren in remembrance of these things, thou shalt be a good minister of Jesus Christ, nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine, whereunto thou hast attained.
7 But refuse profane and old wives' fables, and exercise thyself rather unto godliness.
8 For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.

rr: 9 Ekigambo ekyo n'eky'okwesigwa, kandi kishemereire kwikiririzibwa kimwe.
en: 9 This is a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation.
10 For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living God, who is the Saviour of all men, specially of those that believe.

rr: 11 Ebyo obiragiire kandi obyegyese.
en: 11 These things command and teach.

rr: 12 Hatagira owaagaya obutsigazi bwawe, kureka obe eky'okureeberaho aha barikwikiriza omu kugamba n'omu mitwarize, omu kukunda, omu kwikiriza n'omu kugira omutima ogushemeire.
en: 12 Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.

rr: 13 Oyezirikye kushomera abantu Ebyahandiikirwe, n'okubuurira, n'okwegyesa, okuhitsya obu ndiija.
en: 13 Till I come, give attendance to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine.
14 Neglect not the gift that is in thee, which was given thee by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.

rr: 15 Ebyo obyezirikire, obe nibyo waataho omutima, boona bareebe oku orikweyongyera kugyenda omumaisho.
en: 15 Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy profiting may appear to all.

rr: 16 Oyerinde iwe wenka, kandi n'omu bi orikwegyesa. Ogumizemu n'ebyo; ahakuba omu kukora otyo, noija kwejuna, kandi ojune n'abarikukuhurira.
en: 16 Take heed unto thyself, and unto the doctrine; continue in them: for in doing this thou shalt both save thyself, and them that hear thee.
1 Rebuke not an elder, but intreat him as a father; and the younger men as brethren;

rr: 2 abakazi bakuru nka nyoko, abakazi bato n'abaishiki nka banyaanyoko, obaineho omutima ogushemeire.
en: 2 the elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all purity.

rr: 3 Abafaakazi enshoberwa buzima obahe ekitiinisa.
en: 3 Honour widows that are widows indeed.

rr: 4 Omufaakazi, ku araabe aine abaana nari abaijukuru, babanze beegye kworeka okutiina Ruhanga kwabo omu bi barikukorera ab'omu maka gaabo, nibaihura ebi abazaire baabo baabakoreire, ahabw'okuba ekyo nikyo kishemeire omu maisho ga Ruhanga.
en: 4 But if any widow have children or nephews, let them learn first to shew piety at home, and to requite their parents: for that is good and acceptable before God.
5 Now she that is a widow indeed, and desolate, trusteth in God, and continueth in supplications and prayers night and day.

rr: 6 kwonka oyehayo kweshemeza, aba afiire n'obu aba ahuriire.
en: 6 But she that liveth in pleasure is dead while she liveth.

rr: 7 Obaragiire otyo, barekye kugira eki barikugaywaho.
en: 7 And these things give in charge, that they may be blameless.

rr: 8 Kwonka omuntu weena, otarikuhwera banyabuzaare, n'okukira munonga ab'omu ka ye, biri ayehakaine okwikiriza, kandi naaba ari mubi okukira otarikwikiriza.
en: 8 But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel.

rr: 9 Hatarigira omufaakazi owaabarirwa omu b'okuhwerwa atakahikize myaka makumi mukaaga ey'obukuru, kandi ashemereire kuba omukazi owaashweirwe omushaija omwe
en: 9 Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old, having been the wife of one man,

10 well reported of for good works; if she have brought up children, if she have lodged strangers, if she have washed the saints' feet, if she have relieved the afflicted, if she have diligently followed every good work.

rr: 11 Kwonka abafaakazi abakiri bato otariikiriza kubataasya omu mutwe gw'abafaakzi, ahakuba ku barema kwerinda n'okworobera Kristo, benda kushwerwa
en: 11 But the younger widows refuse: for when they have begun to wax wanton against Christ, they will marry;

rr: 12 batyo basingwa orubanja, ahabw'okwita endagaano yaabo ey'okubanza.
en: 12 having damnation, because they have cast off their first faith.
13 And withal they learn to be idle, wandering about from house to house; and not only idle, but tattlers also and busybodies, speaking things which they ought not.
14 I will therefore that the younger women marry, bear children, guide the house, give none occasion to the adversary to speak reproachfully.

rr: 15 Ahakuba na hati hariho bamwe abahabire bakakuratira Sitaane.
en: 15 For some are already turned aside after Satan.

rr: 16 Omukazi weena orikwikiriza ku araabe aine abafaakazi abanyabuzaare, abe niwe yaabahwera, barekye kurusya ekanisa, ebone kuhwera abafaakazi enshoberwa.
en: 16 If any man or woman that believeth have widows, let them relieve them, and let not the church be charged; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed.
17 Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour, especially they who labour in the word and doctrine.
18 For the scripture saith, Thou shalt not muzzle the ox that treadeth out the corn. And, The labourer is worthy of his reward.
19 Against an elder receive not an accusation, but before two or three witnesses.
20 Them that sin rebuke before all, that others also may fear.

rr: 21 Ninkwehanangiriza omu maisho ga Ruhanga na Kristo Yesu na baamaraika abaatoorainwe, oyerinde ebyo biragiro, okutagira rubaju ru waagwera, n'obu kwakuba okukorera omuntu weena ekintu ahabw'obuganzi.
en: 21 I charge thee before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the elect angels, that thou observe these things without preferring one before another, doing nothing by partiality.

rr: 22 Otarirahukiriza kuta engaro aha muntu weena, n'obu kwakuba okukwatanisa n'abandi omu bibi; oyerinde ogume ori oshemeire.
en: 22 Lay hands suddenly on no man, neither be partaker of other men's sins: keep thyself pure.

rr: 23 Okuruga hati otarinywa amaizi gonka; kureka onywe viinyo nkye ahabw'enda yaawe, n'ahabw'okurwararwara kwawwe.
en: 23 Drink no longer water, but use a little wine for thy stomach's sake and thine often infirmities.

rr: 24 Ebibi by'abantu abamwe nibireebwa butunu, biri eby'okureeta orubanja; kwonka eby'abandi bireebwa bwanyima.
en: 24 Some men's sins are open beforehand, going before to judgment; and some men they follow after.

rr: 25 Okwo nikwo n'emirimo mirungi ereebwa butunu; kwonka n'obu biba bitari bityo, tibibaasa kuguma bisherekirwe.
en: 25 Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand; and they that are otherwise cannot be hid.
1 Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour, that the name of God and his doctrine be not blasphemed.

2 And they that have believing masters, let them not despise them , because they are brethren; but rather do them service, because they are faithful and beloved, partakers of the benefit. These things teach and exhort.
3 If any man teach otherwise, and consent not to wholesome words, even the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness;

rr: 4 aba ayekurize, kandi ataine ki arikumanya; arwaire endwara y'empaka n'okuhakana aha bigambo, ezriugwamu eihari n'okutongana n'okugambuurana n'okurengyerera
en: 4 he is proud, knowing nothing, but doting about questions and strifes of words, whereof cometh envy, strife, railings, evil surmisings,
5 perverse disputings of men of corrupt minds, and destitute of the truth, supposing that gain is godliness: from such withdraw thyself.
6 But godliness with contentment is great gain.
7 For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can carry nothing out.
8 And having food and raiment let us be therewith content.
9 But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and into many foolish and hurtful lusts, which drown men in destruction and perdition.

rr: 10 Ahakuba okwetenga empiiha n'omuzi gw'ebibi byona; hariho bamwe abaagiriire ebyo omururu, bakahaba, bakaruga omu kwikiriza, bakeecumitira kimwe n'enaku nyingi.
en: 10 For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

rr: 11 Kwonka iwe omuntu wa Ruhanga, oyetantare ebyo; okuratire okuhikiirira n'okutiina Ruhanga, okwikiriza, okukunda, okugumisiriza, n'obucureezi.
en: 11 But thou, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.
12 Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.

rr: 13 Ninkwehanangiriza omu maisho ga Ruhanga oha ebintu byona amagara, na Kristo Yesu, owaahamize okuhamya okurungi omu maisho ga Pontio Pilaato
en: 13 I give thee charge in the sight of God, who quickeneth all things, and before Christ Jesus, who before Pontius Pilate witnessed a good confession;

rr: 14 oyorobere ekiragiro otaine kamogo, kandi otaine ki orikugaywaho okuhitsya aha kworekwa kwa Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo
en: 14 that thou keep this commandment without spot, unrebukeable, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ:
15 which in his times he shall shew, who is the blessed and only Potentate, the King of kings, and Lord of lords;

rr: 16 niwe wenka oine okutafa, otuura omu mushana ogutahikwaho, otakareebwaga muntu weena, kandi otabaasa kureebwa. Ekitiinisa n'obutegyeki obutahwaho bibe ebye. Amiina.
en: 16 who only hath immortality, dwelling in the light which no man can approach unto; whom no man hath seen, nor can see: to whom be honour and power everlasting. Amen.
17 Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy;

rr: 18 Kandi bakore ebirungi, babe abatungi omu micwe mirungi, babe efura omu kugaba, bagire omutima gw'okukwatanisa n'abandi
en: 18 that they do good, that they be rich in good works, ready to distribute, willing to communicate;

rr: 19 batyo beebiikire obutungi obu baryegamira omu biro ebiriija, babone kutunga amagara aga buzima.
en: 19 laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold on eternal life.
20 O Timothy, keep that which is committed to thy trust, avoiding profane and vain babblings, and oppositions of science falsely so called:

rr: 21 ahakuba bamwe ahabw'okwegira ngu babwine, bakahaba baaruga omu kwikiriza.
en: 21 which some professing have erred concerning the faith. Grace be with thee. Amen.

rr: Sulemaani mwene Daudi akahamibwa omu bugabe bwe, MUKAMA Ruhanga we yaaguma nawe, yamukuza munonga.
en: And Solomon the son of David was strengthened in his kingdom, and the LORD his God was with him, and magnified him exceedingly.

rr: Sulemaani yaagamba na Israeli yoona, abakuru b'engabo rukumi-rukumi n'aba igana-igana, abaramuzi, n'abeembezi ba Israeli boona, abakuru b'amaju ga baishenkurubo.
en: Then Solomon spake unto all Israel, to the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and to the judges, and to every governor in all Israel, the chief of the fathers.

rr: Kandi Sulemaani hamwe n'omutwe gwona ogw'abantu baaza Gibeoni omu mwanya, mukuru gw'okuramizamu; ahabw'okuba niyo Eihema rya Ruhanga ry'okubugaabuganiramu, eri Musa omwiru wa MUKAMA yaakozire omu ihamba, ryabaire riri.
en: So Solomon, and all the congregation with him, went to the high place that was at Gibeon; for there was the tabernacle of the congregation of God, which Moses the servant of the LORD had made in the wilderness.

rr: 1 —16:1; 2 (Kwonka eshanduukye ya Ruhanga, Daudi akaba agiinamwire, agiihire Kiryasi-yearimu, agitwaire omu mwanya ogu yaabaire agibonereize; ahakuba akaba agiteereire eihema Yerusaalemu.)
en: But the ark of God had David brought up from Kirjath-jearim to the place which David had prepared for it: for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem.

rr: Kandi eitambiro ry'emiringa eryakozirwe Bezaleeli mwene Uuri, mwijukuru wa Huuri, niyo ryabaire riri omu maisho g'Obutaaho bwa MUKAMA. Okwo niyo Sulemaani n'omutwe gw'abantu baabaire baza kusherura MUKAMA.
en: Moreover the brasen altar, that Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made, he put before the tabernacle of the LORD : and Solomon and the congregation sought unto it.

rr: Ku baahikireyo, Sulemaani yaaza aha itambiro ry'emiringa omu maisho ga MUKAMA, eryabaire riri omu maisho g'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu, yaaritambiraho ebitambo rukumi by'okwotsya.
en: And Solomon went up thither to the brasen altar before the LORD , which was at the tabernacle of the congregation, and offered a thousand burnt offerings upon it.

rr: 1 Ekyo kiro Ruhanga yaayeyoreka Sulemaani, yaamugira ati: Shaba eki orikwenda ngu nkuhe.
en: In that night did God appear unto Solomon, and said unto him, Ask what I shall give thee.

rr: Sulemaani yaagira Ruhanga ati: Okagirira tata Daudi embabazi nyingi, wangira omugabe omu mwanya gwe.
en: And Solomon said unto God, Thou hast shewed great mercy unto David my father, and hast made me to reign in his stead.

rr: Mbwenu MUKAMA Ruhanga, eki waaraganiise tata Daudi kihikiirizibwe; ahakuba ongizire omugabe w'abantu abarikwingana omucuucu gw'aha nsi.
en: Now, O LORD God, let thy promise unto David my father be established: for thou hast made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo hati ninkushaba obwengye n'okwetegyereza oku ndaagume nintwaza omu maisho g'aba bantu omu kushohora n'omu kutaaha; ahatari ekyo, n'oha orikubaasa kutegyeka abantu baawe aba abarikwingana bati?
en: Give me now wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people: for who can judge this thy people, that is so great?

rr: Ruhanga yaamugira ati: Ahabw'okuba ekyo nikyo kibairi kikuri aha mutima, kandi tiwaayeshabira bintu, nari obutungi, nari ekitiinisa, nari okushabira abazigu baawe kufa, n'obu kwakuba okweshabire okuramaara, kureka waayeshabira obwengye n'okwetegyereza, ngu obone kutegyeka abantu bangye, abu nkwemekyeire
en: And God said to Solomon, Because this was in thine heart, and thou hast not asked riches, wealth, or honour, nor the life of thine enemies, neither yet hast asked long life; but hast asked wisdom and knowledge for thyself, that thou mayest judge my people, over whom I have made thee king:

rr: mbwenu obwengye n'okwetegyereza waabiheebwa, kandi ndyakuha obutungi, ebintu n'ekitiinisa, ebitakagirwaga mugabe weena omu baakubandiize, kandi n'omu barikukurata tihaine oribigira.
en: wisdom and knowledge is granted unto thee; and I will give thee riches, and wealth, and honour, such as none of the kings have had that have been before thee, neither shall there any after thee have the like.

rr: Bwanyima Sulemaani yaaruga Gibeoni omu maisho g'eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu, eryabaire riri omu mwanya mukuru gw'okuramizamu, yaagaruka Yerusaalemu; yaategyeka Israeli.
en: Then Solomon came from his journey to the high place that was at Gibeon to Jerusalem, from before the tabernacle of the congregation, and reigned over Israel.

rr: 1 -29 ; 2 Bwanyima Sulemaani yaateeranira hamwe ebigaari n'abarikugyendera aha mbaraasi; ebigaari bye bikaba biri rukumi n'amagana ana, n'abarikugyendera aha mbaraasi kakumi n'enkumi ibiri; yaabata omu ndembo z'ebigaari n'omuri Yerusaalemu ahu yaabaire ari.
en: And Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, which he placed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.

rr: Omugabe yaareetera Yerusaalemu okugira efeeza n'ezaabu nyingi nk'amabaare, n'ebiti by'emyereezi byaba nk'emisikamoori y'omu mpita.
en: And the king made silver and gold at Jerusalem as plenteous as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the vale for abundance.

rr: Embaraasi ezi Sulemaani yaabaire atungire, bakaba baziiha Misri; abashuubuzi b'omugabe bakaba bazigura omu busyo, buri busyo bwine obuguzi bwabwo.
en: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king's merchants received the linen yarn at a price.

rr: Kandi ekigaari kikaba kiihwa Misri ahari shekeli z'efeeza magana mukaaga, n'embaraasi ahari igana na makumi ataano; kandi abashuubuzi ku baabaire bazireeta, baziguza abagabe boona ab'Abahiiti n'ab'Abasiria.
en: And they fetched up, and brought forth out of Egypt a chariot for six hundred shekels of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so brought they out horses for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, by their means.

rr: Omu biro ebyo Sulemaani akamariira kwombekyera eiziina rya MUKAMA hekalu, kandi n'okweyombekyera nyaruju y'obugabe.
en: And Solomon determined to build an house for the name of the LORD , and an house for his kingdom.

rr: Yaataho abantu obukumi mushanju b'okwekorera, obukumi munaan b'okuhigura amabaare omu nshozi, n'enkumi ishatu na magana mukaaga b'okubareeberera.
en: And Solomon told out threescore and ten thousand men to bear burdens, and fourscore thousand to hew in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred to oversee them.

rr: 1 Kandi Sulemaani yaatuma ahari Hiraamu omugabe wa Tuuro, ati: Nk'oku waabaire ogirira tata Daudi, okamutwekyera emyereezi y'okweyombekyera enju y'okutaahamu, naanye obe nikwo wangirira.
en: And Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, As thou didst deal with David my father, and didst send him cedars to build him an house to dwell therein, even so deal with me .

rr: -8 ; -8 ; 28:9 , Reeba, niinyenda kwombekyera eiziina rya MUKAMA Ruhanga wangye enju, n'okugimushoroorera, ngu mbone kugyotereramu obubaane oburikutaamirana omu maisho ge n'okuguma nimpongyeramu emigaati y'okumurikwa, n'okutambiramu ebitambo by'okwotsya obutoosha omu kasheeshe n'omu mwabazyo, ahari sabato, aha kuboneka kw'okwezi, n'aha magyenyi ga MUKAMA Ruhanga waitu agatairweho, nk'oku byaragiirwe Abaisraeli kuguma nibabikora ebiro byona.
en: Behold, I build an house to the name of the LORD my God, to dedicate it to him, and to burn before him sweet incense, and for the continual shewbread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts of the LORD our God. This is an ordinance for ever to Israel.

rr: Enju ei ndikwenda kwombeka neija kuba mpango munonga; ahabw'okuba Ruhanga waitu ni mukuru okukira baaruhanga boona.
en: And the house which I build is great: for great is our God above all gods.

rr: Mbwenu n'oha orikubaasa kumwombekyera enju, ku araabe atarikuhika mu iguru, n'obu ryakuba iguru eririkweshumba agandi? Mbwenu niinye oha kumwombekyera enju, kureka ebe ey'okwotereramu obubaane omu maisho ge?
en: But who is able to build him an house, seeing the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain him? who am I then, that I should build him an house, save only to burn sacrifice before him?

rr: Mbwenu nyoherereza omushaija omunyamyoga, ow'okukora eby'ezaabu, eby'efeeza, eby'emiringa, n'eby'ebyoma, kandi n'eby'emyenda ya bujwa, eya karari, n'eya bururu, kandi orikumanya kusharura amabara, agume n'abanyamyoga abu nyine omuri Yuda na Yerusaalemu, abu tata Daudi yaataireho.
en: Send me now therefore a man cunning to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass, and in iron, and in purple, and crimson, and blue, and that can skill to grave with the cunning men that are with me in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom David my father did provide.

rr: Kandi ontwekyere embaaho z'emyereezi n'emiberooshi n'emiti ya aligumu ebya Lebanooni; ahakuba nimmanya abashaija baawe ku barikumanya kushara ebiti by'embaaho omuri Lebanooni. Kandi abashaija bangye baryakwatanisa n'abaawe
en: Send me also cedar trees, fir trees, and algum trees, out of Lebanon: for I know that thy servants can skill to cut timber in Lebanon; and, behold, my servants shall be with thy servants,

rr: babone kunteekateekyera embaaho nyingi munonga; ahakuba enju ei ndikwenda kwombeka neija kuba mpango kandi erikutangaaza.
en: even to prepare me timber in abundance: for the house which I am about to build shall be wonderful great.

en: Now it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.

rr: Kwonka MUKAMA yaagira tata Daudi ati: Obaire okozire gye ahabw'enaama ei obaire one kwombekyera eiziina ryangye enju
en: But the LORD said to David my father, Forasmuch as it was in thine heart to build an house for my name, thou didst well in that it was in thine heart:

en: notwithstanding thou shalt not build the house; but thy son which shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house for my name.

rr: Mbwenu MUKAMA yaahikiriza eki yaaraganiise, ahabw'okuba naaza omu mwanya gwa tata Daudi, naagaruka aha kitebe ky'obugabe bwa Israeli, nk'oku MUKAMA yaaraganiise, kandi nyombekire egi nju ahabw'eiziina rya MUKAMA Ruhanga wa israeli.

en: for Solomon had made a brasen scaffold, of five cubits long, and five cubits broad, and three cubits high, and had set it in the midst of the court: and upon it he stood, and kneeled down upon his knees before all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven,

rr: yaagira ati: Ai MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli, tihariho ruhanga omu iguru nari omu nsi, orikushushan naiwe, omu kurinda endagaano, n'omu kigirira embabazi abairu baawe abarikugyendera omu maisho gaawe n'emitima yaabo yoona

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo, MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa Israeli, hamya eki waaraganiise omwiru waawe tata Daudi, noogira oti: Batabani baawe ku barigira emicwe mirungi, baagyendera omu biragiro byangye, nk'oku iwe obaire noobigyenderamu, tiharibura muntu w'okushutama aha kitebe ky'obugabe bwa Israel.
en: Now therefore, O LORD God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit upon the throne of Israel; yet so that thy children take heed to their way to walk in my law, as thou hast walked before me.

rr: Mbwenu hati, MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli, ekigambo kyawe eki waagambiire omwiru waawe Daudi, okihamye.
en: Now then, O LORD God of Israel, let thy word be verified, which thou hast spoken unto thy servant David.

rr: Beitu kwo, n'eky'amazima Ruhanga oryatuura n'abantu omu nsi?
en: But will God in very deed dwell with men on the earth?

en: Behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house which I have built!

rr: Kwonka MUKAMA Ruhanga wangye, ta omutima aha kushaba n'okweshengyereza kw'omwiru waawe, noohurira okutaka kwe n'okushaba oku arikushaba omu maisho gaawe
en: Have respect therefore to the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O LORD my God, to hearken unto the cry and the prayer which thy servant prayeth before thee:

rr: obone kuguma otaire amaisho gaawe ahari egi nju nyomushana na nyekiro, omwanya ogu waaraganiise kutamu eiziina ryawe, obone kuguma noohurira okushaba oku omwiru waawe arishaba naareeba omwanya ogu.
en: that thine eyes may be open upon this house day and night, upon the place whereof thou hast said that thou wouldest put thy name there; to hearken unto the prayer which thy servant prayeth toward this place.

rr: Kandi ogum e ohurire okweshengyereza kw'omwiru waawe n'okw'abantu baawe Israeli, baaba nibakushaba nibareeba omwanya ogu; ogume ohurire nooyema omu iguru, omu mwanya gwawe ogu otuuramu; kandi ku oraahurire, osaasire.
en: Hearken therefore unto the supplications of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, which they shall make toward this place: hear thou from thy dwelling place, even from heaven; and when thou hearest, forgive.

en: If a man sin against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to make him swear, and the oath come before thine altar in this house;

en: then hear thou from heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, by requiting the wicked, by recompensing his way upon his own head; and by justifying the righteous, by giving him according to his righteousness.

rr: Kandi abantu baawe Abaisraeli ku baribingwa abazigu baabo ahabw'okukucumuraho, bwanyima baakugarukira, baikiriza eiziina ryawe, baakushaba nibeeshengyerereza omu nju egi
en: And if thy people Israel be put to the worse before the enemy, because they have sinned against thee; and shall return and confess thy name, and pray and make supplication before thee in this house;

en: When the heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against thee; yet if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin, when thou dost afflict them;

rr: ohurire ori omu iguru, osaasire abairu baawe, eihanga ryawe Israeli, ekibi kyabo, obeegyese emitwarize mirungi ei bashemereire kugyenderamu; kandi ogwisize ensi yaawe enjura, ei waahaire abantu baawe kuba obuhunguzi.
en: then hear thou from heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, when thou hast taught them the good way, wherein they should walk; and send rain upon thy land, which thou hast given unto thy people for an inheritance.

rr: Kandi enjara ku eriteera ensi, nari orufu, okututa, nari okusya-nyamwenga, nari enzigye, nari kanyaananga; nari abazigu okubagotera omuri ibara rurembo rwabo; nari ku haribaho kahumpuri nari endiijo ndwara yoona
en: If there be dearth in the land, if there be pestilence, if there be blasting, or mildew, locusts, or caterpillers; if their enemies besiege them in the cities of their land; whatsoever sore or whatsoever sickness there be:

en: then what prayer or what supplication soever shall be made of any man, or of all thy people Israel, when every one shall know his own sore and his own grief, and shall spread forth his hands in this house:

rr: ohurire nooyema omu iguru omu mwanya gwawe ogu otuuramu, osaasire, oihure buri muntu, ou orikumanya omutima, nk'oku emitwarize ye eri; (niiwe wenka orikumanya emitima y'abaana b'abantu;)
en: then hear thou from heaven thy dwelling place, and forgive, and render unto every man according unto all his ways, whose heart thou knowest; (for thou only knowest the hearts of the children of men:)

en: Moreover concerning the stranger, which is not of thy people Israel, but is come from a far country for thy great name's sake, and thy mighty hand, and thy stretched out arm; if they come and pray in this house;

en: then hear thou from the heavens their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.

en: if they return to thee with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their captivity, whither they have carried them captives, and pray toward their land, which thou gavest unto their fathers, and toward the city which thou hast chosen, and toward the house which I have built for thy name:

en: And on the three and twentieth day of the seventh month he sent the people away into their tents, glad and merry in heart for the goodness that the LORD had shewed unto David, and to Solomon, and to Israel his people. The Divine Covenant

rr: 1 Atyo Sulemaani yaaheza enju ya MUKAMA n'ey'omugabe; byona ebi Sulemaani yaabaire ateekateekire kukora omu nju ya MUKAMA n'omu nju ye, yaabiheza gye. MUKAMA okugaruka kweyoreka Sulemaani
en: Thus Solomon finished the house of the LORD , and the king's house: and all that came into Solomon's heart to make in the house of the LORD , and in his own house, he prosperously effected.

rr: Ku ndikinga eiguru, enjura yaabura, nari naaragiira enzigye kukunuura ensi, nari naayohereza orufu omu bantu bangye
en: If I shut up heaven that there be no rain, or if I command the locusts to devour the land, or if I send pestilence among my people;

en: For now have I chosen and sanctified this house, that my name may be there for ever: and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually.

en: And as for thee, if thou wilt walk before me, as David thy father walked, and do according to all that I have commanded thee, and shalt observe my statutes and my judgments;

en: then will I stablish the throne of thy kingdom, according as I have covenanted with David thy father, saying, There shall not fail thee a man to be ruler in Israel.

rr: Kwonka ku muriteishuka, mwayanga kworobera ebiragiro byangye n'ebyatairweho ebi naataire omu maisho gaanyu, mwagyenda mwaheereza baaruhanga abandi, kandi mwabaramya
en: But if ye turn away, and forsake my statutes and my commandments, which I have set before you, and shall go and serve other gods, and worship them;

en: then will I pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them; and this house, which I have sanctified for my name, will I cast out of my sight, and will make it to be a proverb and a byword among all nations.

rr: Kandi egi nju erikuhimbisibwa etyo, buri muntu oriba naarabaho aryatangaara, naagira ati: Beitu shi MUKAMA akatura ki egi nsi n'egi nju?
en: And this house, which is high, shall be an astonishment to every one that passeth by it; so that he shall say, Why hath the LORD done thus unto this land, and unto this house?

en: and Baalath, and all the store cities that Solomon had, and all the chariot cities, and the cities of the horsemen, and all that Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and throughout all the land of his dominion.

rr: Abantu boona abaahonokire aha Bahiiti, Abaamori, Abaperizi, Abahiivi n'Abayebusi abaabaire batari Baisraeli
en: As for all the people that were left of the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which were not of Israel,

rr: baijukuru baabo abaahonokireho omuri egyo nsi, abu Abaisraeli bataracwekyerereize kimwe,–abo nibo Sulemaani yaahindwire abahuuku b'okubakorera emirimo, bakaguma batyo n'okuhitsya hati.
en: but of their children, who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel consumed not, them did Solomon make to pay tribute until this day.

rr: Kwonka Abaisraeli bo Sulemaani tarahindwire bahuuku b'okumukorera; kureka bakaba abaserukare, abandi baaba abatware be, abandi abakuru b'ebigaari bye, n'abandi baaba engabo ze ezirikugyendera aha mbaraasi.
en: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no servants for his work; but they were men of war, and chief of his captains, and captains of his chariots and horsemen.

rr: Kandi abatware abo abakuru b'omugabe Sulemaani, abaabaire nibategyeka abantu, baaba magana abiri na makumi ataano.
en: And these were the chief of king Solomon's officers, even two hundred and fifty, that bare rule over the people.

rr: Sulemaani yaiha muhara wa Faraho omu rurembo rwa Daudi, yaamuta omu nju ei yaamwombekyeire; ahakuba akagira ati: Omukazi wangye tashemereire kuguma omu nju ya Daudi omugabe wa Israeli, ahabw'okuba emyanya ei eshanduukye ya MUKAMA eiziremu n'erikwera.
en: And Solomon brought up the daughter of Pharaoh out of the city of David unto the house that he had built for her: for he said, My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Israel, because the places are holy, whereunto the ark of the LORD hath come.

rr: Bwanyima Sulemaani yaatandika kutambira MUKAMA ebitambo by'okwotsya aha itambiro rya MUKAMA, eri yaayombekire omu maisho g'ekisasi kya hekalu
en: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings unto the LORD on the altar of the LORD , which he had built before the porch,

rr: nk'omurimo gwa buri izooba oku gwabaire nigwetengwa, naahonga nk'oku Musa yaaragiire ebya sabato, ebya buri kuboneka kw'okwezi, n'eby'amagyenyi ashatu aga buri mwaka–obugyenyi bw'emigaati etatumbisiibwe, obugyenyi bwa saabiiti, n'obugyenyi bw'ensiisira.
en: even after a certain rate every day, offering according to the commandment of Moses, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts, three times in the year, even in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles.

rr: 1 -23 ; 24:1-31 ; 25:1-30 ; 26:1 . Nk'ekiragiro kya Daudi ishe oku kyabaire kiri, yaataho abanyamurwa b'okukora omurimo gw'obuheereza omu mbu, n'Abaleevi ahabw'omurimo gwabo ogw'okuhimbisa, n'ogw'okuheereza omu maisho g'abanyamurwa, nk'omurimo gwa buri izooba oku gwabaire nigwetengwa, kandi n'abakumiirizi b'amarembo ab'okurinda amarembo goona omu mbu; ahabw'okuba okwo nikwo Daudi omushaija wa Ruhanga yaabaire aragiire.
en: And he appointed, according to the order of David his father, the courses of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their charges, to praise and minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required: the porters also by their courses at every gate: for so had David the man of God commanded.

rr: Kandi tibaateishuka kureka ebi omugabe yaaragiire abanyamurwa n'Abaleevi ebirikukwata aha kintu kyona n'aha by'amabiikiro.
en: And they departed not from the commandment of the king unto the priests and Levites concerning any matter, or concerning the treasures.

rr: Okwo nikwo omurimo gwona ogwa Sulemaaani gwahweire, okwiha aha izooba eri omusingi gw'enju ya MUKAMA gwateereirweho, okuhitsya ahu yaahwereire.
en: Now all the work of Solomon was prepared unto the day of the foundation of the house of the LORD , and until it was finished.

rr: Batyo baahereza kimwe enju ya MUKAMA.
en: So the house of the LORD was perfected.

rr: Bwanyima Sulemaani yaaza Ezioni-geberi na Eloosi aha rubaju rw'enyanja omu nsi ya Edomu.
en: Then went Solomon to Ezion-geber, and to Eloth, at the sea side in the land of Edom.

rr: Hiraamu yaayohereza abagaragwa be kumutwarira emeeri n'abarimbi be abamanyiire enyanja, baaza Ofiri hamwe n'abashaija ba Sulemaani, baihayo etalanta z'ezaabu magana ana na makumi ataano, baazireetera omugabe Sulemaani.
en: And Huram sent him by the hands of his servants ships, and servants that had knowledge of the sea; and they went with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and took thence four hundred and fifty talents of gold, and brought them to king Solomon.

rr: 1 Omugabekazi wa Sheeba ku yaahuriire okurangaanwa kwa Sulemaani, yaija Yerusaalemu kumubuuza ebibuuzo bigumire naamugyeza; yaija ashendekyereziibwe abantu baingi munonga, n'engamira zeekoreire emigaju, n'ezaabu nyingi munonga, kandi n'amabaare ag'obuguzi bwingi. en: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to prove Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem, with a very great company, and camels that bare spices, and gold in abundance, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.

rr: Sulemaani yaagarukamu ebi yaamubuurize byona; tihariho kigambo na kimwe ekyayeshobire Sulemaani, eki ataramushobororeire.
en: And Solomon told her all her questions: and there was nothing hid from Solomon which he told her not.

rr: Omugabekazi wa Sheeba ku yaareebire obwengye bwa Sulemaani, enju ei yaayombekire
en: And when the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, and the house that he had built,

en: and the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel; his cupbearers also, and their apparel; and his ascent by which he went up into the house of the LORD ; there was no more spirit in her.

rr: Yaagira omugabe ati: Ebigambo ebi naahuriire ndi omu nsi yangye ebirikugamba aha by'emitwarize yaawe n'obwengye bwawe bikaba biri eby'amazima
en: And she said to the king, It was a true report which I heard in mine own land of thine acts, and of thy wisdom:

rr: kwonka tindabiikiriize okuhitsya obu nyeiziire, eriisho ryangye rikabyereebera; nkashanga batarangambiire n'obu kyakuba ekicweka kimwe kya kabiri ky'obwingi bw'obwengye bwawe; nookirira kimwe ebi naahuriire.
en: howbeit I believed not their words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen it: and, behold, the one half of the greatness of thy wisdom was not told me: for thou exceedest the fame that I heard.

rr: Abashaija baawe bahiiriirwe! N'abaheereza baawe, abeemerera obutoosha omu maisho gaawe, bakahurira obwengye bwawe, nabo bahiiriirwe!
en: Happy are thy men, and happy are these thy servants, which stand continually before thee, and hear thy wisdom.

rr: MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe ahimbisibwe, owaakusiimire, akakuta aha kitebe ky'obugabe bwe, kuba omugabe ahabwa MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe! en: Blessed be the LORD thy God, which delighted in thee to set thee on his throne, to be king for the LORD thy God: because thy God loved Israel, to establish them for ever, therefore made he thee king over them, to do judgment and justice.

rr: Bwanyima yaaha omugabe etalanta z'ezaabu igana na makumi abiri, emigaju mingi munonga, n'amabaare g'obuguzi bwingi; tihakabahoga migaju nk'ei omugabekazi wa Sheeba yaahaire omugabe Sulemaani.
en: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices great abundance, and precious stones: neither was there any such spice as the queen of Sheba gave king Solomon.

rr: Kandi abashaija ba Hiraamu n'aba Sulemaani, abaabaire bareeta ezaabu okuruga Ofiri, bakareeta embaaho za alumuugi n'amabaare g'obuguzi bwingi.
en: And the servants also of Huram, and the servants of Solomon, which brought gold from Ophir, brought algum trees and precious stones.

rr: Ezo mbaaho za alumuugi omugabe yaazibaijamu amatembero g'enju ya MUKAMA n'ag'enju ye ahabwe, n'endingiri n'enanga ahabw'abeeshongozi; hakaba hatakareebwaga mbaahoza alumuugi ezirikushusha nk'ezo omu nsi ya Yuda.
en: And the king made of the algum trees terraces to the house of the LORD , and to the king's palace, and harps and psalteries for singers: and there were none such seen before in the land of Judah.

rr: Omugabe Sulemaani yaaha omugabekazi wa Sheeba ebi yaabaire naayenda byona, n'ebi yaamushabire byona, okwohaho ebi yaamureeteire.
en: And king Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside that which she had brought unto the king.

rr: Bwanyima yaakuba, yaagaruka omu nsi ye n'abagaragwa be.
en: So she turned, and went away to her own land, she and her servants.

rr: Obutungi bwa Sulemaani
en: Solomon's Wealth

rr: 1 Ezaabu eyaabaire ereetwa owa Sulemaani buri mwaka ekaba eba etalanta magana mukaaga na makumi mukaaga na mukaaga
en: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred and threescore and six talents of gold;

rr: otabariiremu eyaabaire eruga omu bashuubuzi n'omu batunzi; kandi abagabe ba Buharabu boona n'abategyeki b'omu nsi bakaba bareetera Sulemaani ezaabu n'efeeza.
en: beside that which chapmen and merchants brought. And all the kings of Arabia and governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.

rr: Omugabe Sulemaani yaaheeshesa engabo z'ezaabu magana abiri, engabo emwe neeheeshwa omu zaabu ya shekeli magana mukaaga.
en: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one target.

rr: Kandi yaaheeshesa ezindi ngabo z'ezaabu magana ashatu; engabo emwe neeheeshwa omu zaabu ya shekeli magana ashatu; omugabe yaazita omu nju y'ekibira kya Lebanooni.
en: And three hundred shields made he of beaten gold: three hundred shekels of gold went to one shield. And the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.

rr: Kandi yaabaijesa ekitebe ky'obugabe kihango omu miino y'enjojo, yaakishweka ezaabu eshemeziibwe.
en: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.

rr: Ekyo kitebe ky'obugabe kikaba kiine amatembero mukaaga, n'akatebe ky'ebigyere k'ezaabu, ebyabaire bikoreirwe hamwe n'ekyo kitebe; aha buri rubaju rw'ekyo kitebe hariho ah'okuta emikono, n'ebishushani bibiri by'entare ezeemereire aha rubaju rw'ah'okuta emikono
en: And there were six steps to the throne, with a footstool of gold, which were fastened to the throne, and stays on each side of the sitting place, and two lions standing by the stays:

rr: kandi n'ebindi bishushani by'entare ikumi na bibiri byemereire bibiri bibiri ahari buri itembero ahari ago matembero mukaaga.
en: and twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps.

rr: Omu bugabe obundi bwona tihariho kitebe ekyabaire nikishushana nakyo.
en: There was not the like made in any kingdom.

rr: Eby'okunywaisa eby'omugabe Sulemaani byona bikaba biri eby'ezaabu, kandi n'ebintu byona eby'omu nju y'omu kibira kya Lebanooni bikaba biri eby'ezaabu eshemeziibwe; omu biro bya Sulemaani efeeza ekaba etarikuteekateekwaho kuba ekintu.
en: And all the drinking vessels of king Solomon were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold: none were of silver; it was not any thing accounted of in the days of Solomon.

rr: Ahakuba emeeri z'omugabe zikaba ziza Tarushiishi n'abashaija ba Hiraamu; omurundi gumwe omu myaka eshatu ezo meeri za Tarushiishi zikaba ziija, zireetsire ezaabu, efeeza, emiino y'enjojo, enkobe na zaanyamunyonyi.
en: For the king's ships went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram: every three years once came the ships of Tarshish bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks. His Wisdom

rr: Okwo nikwo omugabe Sulemaani yaakirize abagabe boona ab'omu nsi obutungi n'obwengye.
en: And king Solomon passed all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.

rr: Abagabe boona ab'omu nsi bakaba beetenga kureeba Sulemaani, ngu bahurire obwengye bwe, obu Ruhanga yaamuhaire.
en: And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon, to hear his wisdom, that God had put in his heart.

rr: Kandi weena owaabaire aija akaba areeta omutoijo, ebintu by'efeeza n'eby'ezaabu, ebijwaro, sumuruna, emigaju, embaraasi n'enyumbu; ebyo byona nikwo byabaire biija buri mwaka.
en: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and raiment, harness, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.

rr: Kandi Sulemaani akaba aine emyanya obukumi buna ei embaraasi ze ezirikukurura ebigaari zaabaire ziraaramu, kandi aine abashaija abarikugyendera aha mbaraasi kakumi n'enkumi ibiri, abu yaataire omu ndembo z'ebigaari bye, n'omuri Yerusaalemu owa omugabe.
en: And Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen; whom he bestowed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.

rr: Kandi yaategyeka abagabe boona okuruga aha mugyera Furaati okuhika omu nsi y'Abafilistia n'aha mwatano gwa Misri.
en: And he reigned over all the kings from the river even unto the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.

rr: Omugabe yaareetera Yerusaalemu kugira efeeza nyingi nk'amabaare, n'ebiti by'emyereezi byaba nk'emisikamoori y'omu mpita.
en: And the king made silver in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the low plains in abundance.

rr: Kandi bakaba bareetera Sulemaani embaraasi nibaziiha Misri n'omu nsi ezindi zoona. Okufa kwa Sulemaani
en: And they brought unto Solomon horses out of Egypt, and out of all lands.

rr: 1 Mbwenu endiijo mirimo ya Sulemaani, okwiha aha kutandika okuhitsya aha muheru, tibihandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'ebyabaireho ekya Nasani nabi, n'omu kitabo ky'obunabi ekya Ahiya owa Shiilo, n'omu kitabo ky'okworekwa ekya Ido omuhanuuzi, aha bya Yeroboamu mwene Nebati?
en: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, are they not written in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer against Jeroboam the son of Nebat?

rr: Sulemaani yaamara aha ngoma emyaka makumi ana naategyekyera Israeli yoona omuri Yerusaalemu.
en: And Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.

rr: Bwanyima Sulemaani yaagwejegyera, yaashanga baishenkuru, yaaziikwa omu rurembo rwa Daudi ishe; Rehoboamu omutabani yaategyeka omu mwanya gwe.
en: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.

rr: 1 Rehoboamu akaza Shekemu, ahakuba Abaisraeli boona niyo baabaire bagiire kumwemeka.
en: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for to Shechem were all Israel come to make him king.

en: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who was in Egypt, whither he had fled from the presence of Solomon the king, heard it , that Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.

rr: Baatuma kumweta; atyo Yeroboamu n'Abaisraeli boona baija ahari Rehoboamu, baamugira bati
en: And they sent and called him. So Jeroboam and all Israel came and spake to Rehoboam, saying,

en: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore ease thou somewhat the grievous servitude of thy father, and his heavy yoke that he put upon us, and we will serve thee.

rr: Yaabagarukamu ati: Mugarukye aha bwanyima y'ebiro bishatu. Batyo abantu baayaabuuka, baagyenda.
en: And he said unto them, Come again unto me after three days. And the people departed. King Rehoboam

rr: Bwanyima omugabe Rehoboamu yaaza omu naama n'abagurusi abaabaire batabaarira Sulemaani ishe akiriho, yaabagira ati: Nimumpa bwengye ki okugarukamu abo bantu?
en: And king Rehoboam took counsel with the old men that had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, What counsel give ye me to return answer to this people?

rr: Baamugira bati: Ku oraatwaze gye abo bantu, waabagwisa gye, obwo nibwo bariba abairu baawe ebiro byona.
en: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou be kind to this people, and please them, and speak good words to them, they will be thy servants for ever.

rr: Kwonka we yaayanga enaama ei abo bagurusi baamuhaire, yaaza omu naama n'abatsigazi abaanyeetsire nawe, kandi abaabaire nibamutabaarira.
en: But he forsook the counsel which the old men gave him, and took counsel with the young men that were brought up with him, that stood before him.

rr: Yaababuuza ati: Nimumpa bwengye ki okugarukamu abo bantu, abangizire ngu mbatuubize aha buremeezi bw'obutegyeki obu tata yaabataireho?
en: And he said unto them, What advice give ye that we may return answer to this people, which have spoken to me, saying, Ease somewhat the yoke that thy father did put upon us?

rr: Abo batsigazi abaanyeetsire nawe baamugira bati: Oku nikwo oraagarukyemu abantu abakushabire nibagira bati: Sho akongyera oburemeezi aha kutegyekwa kwaitu; mbwenu iwe otutuubieho; obagire oti: Akakumu kangye akahera nikakira obuhango enyugunyu ya tata.
en: And the young men that were brought up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou answer the people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou it somewhat lighter for us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little finger shall be thicker than my father's loins.

rr: Mbwenu nk'oku tata yaabeekoreize omugamba guremeire, nyowe niinyija kukizaho. Tata akabateeza enkoba, nyowe niinyija kubateeza skorupio.
en: For whereas my father put a heavy yoke upon you, I will put more to your yoke: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

rr: Aha kiro kya kashatu Yeroboamu n'abantu boona baija aha mugabe Rehoboamu, nk'oku yaabagizire ati: Mugarukye aha kiro kya kashatu.
en: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day, as the king bade, saying, Come again to me on the third day.

rr: Omugabe Rehoboamu yaabagarukamu n'amaani, naayanga obwengye obu abagurusi babaire bamuhaire
en: And the king answered them roughly; and king Rehoboam forsook the counsel of the old men,

rr: yaabagarukamu nk'obwengye bw'abatsigazi obu bamuhaire oku bwabaire buri, ati: Tata akabeekoreza omugamba guremeire, kwonka nyowe niinyija kukizaho; akabateeza enkoba, kwonka nyowe niinyija kubateeza skorupio.
en: and answered them after the advice of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add thereto: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

rr: 1 Atyo omugabe tiyaabahurira, ahabw'okuba kikaba kirugire ahari Ruhanga, ngu MUKAMA ahikiirize ekigambo eki yaagambiire Yeroboamu mwene Nebati, naakirabya omuri Ahiya owa Shiilo.
en: So the king hearkened not unto the people: for the cause was of God, that the LORD might perform his word, which he spake by the hand of Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat. Revolt of Ten Tribes

rr: Abaisraeli boona ku baareebire omugabe yaayanga kubahurira, baamugira bati: Twine kakwate ki na Daudi? Titwine buhunguzi omuri mwene Yese. Imwe Baisraeli 'mwe, nimugarukye omu mahema gaanyu! Naimwe aba Daudi mugume mwemarire ebyanyu n'oruganda rwanyu! Batyo Abaisraeli boona baagaruka omu maka gaabo.
en: And when all Israel saw that the king would not hearken unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? and we have none inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to your tents, O Israel: and now, David, see to thine own house. So all Israel went to their tents.

rr: Kwonka Rehoboamu yaagumizamu naategyeka Abaisraeli abaabaire batwire omu ndembo za Yuda.
en: But as for the children of Israel that dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

rr: Bwanyima omugabe Rehoboamu yaatuma Hadoraamu, owaabaire ari omukuru w'abakozi b'emirimo y'okuhatwa; Abaisraeli boona baamuteerar amabaare, yaafa.
en: Then king Rehoboam sent Hadoram that was over the tribute; and the children of Israel stoned him with stones, that he died.

rr: Omugabe ku yaabihuriire, ahonaaho yaaza omu kigaari kye kuhungira Yerusaalemu.
en: But king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

rr: Okwo nikwo Abaisraeli baagomeire enju ya Daudi n'okuhitsya hati.
en: And Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day.
