rr: 1 Rehoboamu ku yaahikire Yerusaalemu, yaateeranira hamwe enju ya Yuda yoona n'oruganda rwa Benyamiini, yaatooranamu abashaija emanzi akasiriira n'obukumi munaana ab'okurwanisa Israeli, ngu babone kumugarurira obugabe.
en: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he gathered of the house of Judah and Benjamin an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men , which were warriors, to fight against Israel, that he might bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.

rr: Kwonka ekigambo kya MUKAMA kyaija ahari Shemaaya, omushaija wa Ruhanga, nikigira kiti: Gambira Rehoboamu mwene Sulemaani omugabe wa Yuda n'Abaisraeli boona ab'omuri Yuda na Benyamiini, oti
en: But the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

rr: Oku nikwo MUKAMA arikugamba naagira ati: Mutahurura, n'obu kwakuba okurwanisa beene waanyu. Buri muntu agarukye omu ka ye, ahakuba ekintu eki niinye kirugireho. Batyo baahurira ekigambo kya MUKAMA, baagarukayo, tibaarwanisa Yeroboamu.
en: Thus saith the LORD , Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren: return every man to his house: for this thing is done of me. And they obeyed the words of the LORD , and returned from going against Jeroboam.

rr: Rehoboamu yaatuura Yerusaalemu, kandi yaayombeka omuri Yuda endembo z'okwerinda abazigu.
en: And Rehoboam dwelt in Jerusalem, and built cities for defence in Judah.

rr: Yaayombeka Betelehemu, Etamu, Tekoa
en: He built even Beth-lehem, and Etam, and Tekoa,

rr: Besi-zuuri, Sooko, Adulaamu
en: and Beth-zur, and Shoco, and Adullam,

rr: Gaasi, Mareesha, Ziifu
en: and Gath, and Mareshah, and Ziph,

rr: Adoraimu, Lakishi, Azeka
en: and Adoraim, and Lachish, and Azekah,

rr: Zoora, Ayalooni, na Heburooni, endembo z'omuri Yuda na Benyamiini ezeehinguririziibwe engo z'amabaare.
en: and Zorah, and Aijalon, and Hebron, which are in Judah and in Benjamin fenced cities.

rr: N'ebigo byazo yaabigumya, yaabitamu abakuru b'engabo, yaabibiikamu eby'okurya n'amajuta na viinyo.
en: And he fortified the strong holds, and put captains in them, and store of victual, and of oil and wine.

rr: Kandi omuri ezo ndembo zoona yaatamu engabo n'amacumu, yaazihindura ez'amaani maingi munonga. Atyo yaagumya Abayuda n'Ababenyamiini bari abe.
en: And in every several city he put shields and spears, and made them exceeding strong, having Judah and Benjamin on his side.

rr: Bwanyima abanyamurwa n'Abaleevi, abaabaire batwire omuri Israeli yoona, baaruga omu myanya yoona ei baabaire batwiremu, baija ah'ari.
en: And the priests and the Levites that were in all Israel resorted to him out of all their coasts.

rr: Ahakuba Abaleevi bakareka amariisizo gaabo n'obutaka bwabo, baija omuri Yuda na Yerusaalemu, ahabw'okuba Yeroboamu n'abatabani bakabaiha omu murimo gw'obuheereza bw'abanyamurwa ba MUKAMA
en: For the Levites left their suburbs and their possession, and came to Judah and Jerusalem: for Jeroboam and his sons had cast them off from executing the priest's office unto the LORD :

rr: yaataho abanyamurwa abe kuheereza omu myanya mikuru y'okuramizamu, n'okukora omurimo gw'okuheereza baadaimoni, n'ebishushani by'enyana bibiri ebi yaakozire.
en: and he ordained him priests for the high places, and for the devils, and for the calves which he had made.

rr: Ab'omu nganda zoona eza Israeli, abaataire emitima yaabo aha kusherura MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli, baija bakuratiire abo Baleevi, baahika Yerusaalemu, baatambirirayo MUKAMA Ruhanga wa baishenkurubo ebitambo.
en: And after them out of all the tribes of Israel such as set their hearts to seek the LORD God of Israel came to Jerusalem, to sacrifice unto the LORD God of their fathers.

rr: Batyo baahamya obugabe bwa Yuda, kandi baamara emyka eshatu nibagumiza kimwe Rehoboamu mwene Sulemaani; ahabw'okuba omuri egyo myaka eshatu bakaguma nibagyendera omu muhanda gwa Daudi na Sulemaani.
en: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah, and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong, three years: for three years they walked in the way of David and Solomon.

rr: Rehoboamu akashwera Mahalaasi muhara wa Yerimoosi mwene Daudi na Abihaili muhara wa Eliabu mwene Yese
en: And Rehoboam took him Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David to wife, and Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse;

rr: yaamuzaarira abaana b'aboojo, Yeushi, Shemaria na Zahaamu.
en: which bare him children; Jeush, and Shemariah, and Zaham.

rr: Bwanyima y'ogwo yaashwera Maaka, muhara wa Abusalomu, yaamuzaarira Abiya, Atai, ziiza na Shelomiisi.
en: And after her he took Maachah the daughter of Absalom; which bare him Abijah, and Attai, and Ziza, and Shelomith.

rr: (Kandi Rehoboamu akashwera abakazi ikumi na munaana n'ebinyanshunju makumi mukaaga; yaazaara abaana b'aboojo makumi abiri na munaana, n'ab'abaishiki makumi mukaaga); kwonka akaba akunda Maaka muhara wa Abusalomu okukira abakazi be boona n'ebinyanshunju bye
en: And Rehoboam loved Maachah the daughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines: (for he took eighteen wives, and threescore concubines; and begat twenty and eight sons, and threescore daughters.)

rr: 1 n'ahabw'ekyo yaagira Abiya mwene Maaka omwana mukuru omuri beene ishe, ahakuba akaba naayenda kumuhindura omugabe.
en: And Rehoboam made Abijah the son of Maachah the chief, to be ruler among his brethren: for he thought to make him king.

rr: Yaakoresa obwengye, yaata abatabani omu byanga byona eby'omuri Yuda na Benyamiini omu ndembo zoona ezirimu ebigo; yaabaha eby'okurya bingi munonga, kandi yaabashwererera abakazi. Currently Selected: 2 Eby&x27;omu Busingye 11 : RR64 Highlight Share <path fill-rule="eve
en: And he dealt wisely, and dispersed of all his children throughout all the countries of Judah and Benjamin, unto every fenced city: and he gave them victual in abundance. And he desired many wives. Currently Selected: 2 Chronicles 11 : KJV Highlight Share <path fill-rul

rr: 1 -24 ; Obugabe bwa Rehoboamu ku bwaherize kuhama n'okuba obw'amaani, we n'Abaisraeli boona baareka kukuratira ebiragiro bya MUKAMA.
en: And it came to pass, when Rehoboam had established the kingdom, and had strengthened himself, he forsook the law of the LORD , and all Israel with him.

rr: Bwanyima omu mwaka gwa kataano ogw'omu busingye bwe Shishaki omugabe wa Misri akainamuka, yaateera Yerusaalemu
en: And it came to pass, that in the fifth year of king Rehoboam Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had transgressed against the LORD ,

rr: aine ebigaari rukumi na magana abiri, n'abarikugyendera aha mbaraasi obukumi mukaaga; n'abantu abarugire nawe Misri bakaba batarikubarwa, bari aba Libya, aba Sukimu n'aba Esiopia.
en: with twelve hundred chariots, and threescore thousand horsemen: and the people were without number that came with him out of Egypt; the Lubims, the Sukkiims, and the Ethiopians.

rr: 2 Yaakwata endembo ezeehinguririziibwe engo z'amabaare, yaahika Yerusaalemu.
en: And he took the fenced cities which pertained to Judah, and came to Jerusalem.

rr: Ku yaahikireyo, Shemaaya nabi yaija ahari Rehoboamu n'aha bategyeki ba Yuda, abaabaire bateeraniire Yerusaalemu ahabwa Shishaki, yaabagira ati: Oku nikwo MUKAMA arikugamba naagira ati: Ondugireho, mbwenu naanye naakurekurira Shishaki.
en: Then came Shemaiah the prophet to Rehoboam, and to the princes of Judah, that were gathered together to Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said unto them, Thus saith the LORD , Ye have forsaken me, and therefore have I also left you in the hand of Shishak.

rr: Ahonaaho abategyeki ba Israeli n'omugabe baayecureeza, nibagira bati: MUKAMA niwe ahikiriire.
en: Whereupon the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves; and they said, The LORD is righteous.

rr: MUKAMA ku yaareebire baayecureeza, ekigambo kye kyaizira Shemaaya nikigira kiti: Beecureize; n'ahabw'ekyo tinkibahwerekyereza; kureka niinyija kugira eki naabajuna, kandi ekiniga kyangye tikirikwija kushukwa hari Yerusaalemu kuteerwa Shishaki.
en: And when the LORD saw that they humbled themselves, the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah, saying, They have humbled themselves; therefore I will not destroy them, but I will grant them some deliverance; and my wrath shall not be poured out upon Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.

rr: Kwonka nibaija kuba abairu be, babone kumanya obutegyeki bwangye, n'obw'abagabe b'ezo nsi.
en: Nevertheless they shall be his servants; that they may know my service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.

rr: 1 Atyo Shishaki omugabe wa Misri yaateera Yerusaalemu, yaanyaga ebintu by'obuguzi bwingi eby'omu nju ya MUKAMA, n'eby'omu nju ya MUKAMA, n'eby'omu nju y'omugabe; yaatwara ebintu byona. Kandi yaatwara n'engabo z'ezaabu ezi Sulemaani yaabaire aheesire
en: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, and took away the treasures of the house of the LORD , and the treasures of the king's house; he took all: he carried away also the shields of gold which Solomon had made.

rr: bwanyima omugabe Rehoboamu yaaheesha ezindi z'emiringa omu mwanya gwazo, yaazibiitsya abakuru b'abarinzi, abaabaire barinda orwigi rw'enju y'omugabe.
en: Instead of which king Rehoboam made shields of brass, and committed them to the hands of the chief of the guard, that kept the entrance of the king's house.

rr: Obutoosha omugabe ku yaabaire aza omu nju ya MUKAMA, abo barinzi baija, bazihagatira, bwanyima bazigarura omuri egyo nju y'abarinzi.
en: And when the king entered into the house of the LORD , the guard came and fetched them, and brought them again into the guard chamber.

rr: Ku yaayecureize, ekiniga kya MUKAMA kyamurugaho, ngu arekye kumucwekyerereza kimwe; kandi omuri Yuda ebintu bikaba biriho gye.
en: And when he humbled himself, the wrath of the LORD turned from him, that he would not destroy him altogether: and also in Judah things went well.

rr: Atyo omugabe Rehoboamu yaayegaruramu amaani, yaategyeka. Rehoboamu akaba aine emyaka makumi ana na gumwe, obu yaatandika kutegyeka; yaategyekyera emyaka ikumi na mushanju omuri Yerusaalemu, orurembo oru MUKAMA yaatooraine omu nganda zoona ez'Abaisraeli kuba nimwo yaata eiziina rye. Nyina akaba naayetwa Naama omuamoni.
en: So king Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem, and reigned: for Rehoboam was one and forty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. And his mother's name was Naamah an Ammonitess.

rr: Akakora kubi, ahabw'okuba tarataire mutima aha kusherura MUKAMA.
en: And he did evil, because he prepared not his heart to seek the LORD .

rr: Mbwenu ebi Rehoboamu yaakozire okwiha aha kutandika okuhitsya aha muheru, tibihandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'ebyabaireho ekya Shemaaya nabi, n'ekya Ido omuhanuuzi?
en: Now the acts of Rehoboam, first and last, are they not written in the book of Shemaiah the prophet, and of Iddo the seer concerning genealogies?

rr: Kandi hakaba habaho obweme ahagati ya Rehoboamu na Yeroboamu.
en: And there were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.

rr: Bwanyima Rehoboamu yaagwejegyera, yaashanga baishenkuru, yaaziikwa omu rurembo rwa Daudi; Abiya omutabani yaategyeka omu mwanya gwe.
en: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David: and Abijah his son reigned in his stead.

rr: Omu mwaka gwa ikumi na munaana ogw'omu busingye bw'omugabe Yeroboamu, Abiya akatandika kutegyeka Yuda.
en: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam began Abijah to reign over Judah.

rr: Yaategyekyera emyaka eshatu omuri Yerusaalemu. Nyina akaba naayetwa Mikaya, muhara wa Urieli owa Gibea.
en: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also was Michaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.

rr: Omuri obwo bunaku hakabaho obweme ahagati ya Abiya na Yeroboamu. Abiya yaahurura n'abashaija amamanzi abamanyiire engamba, abashaija entoore obusiriira buna; Yeroboamu we yaatenga orugamba kumurwanisa n'abashaija entoore abarwani b'amaani obusiriira munaana.
en: And Abijah set the battle in array with an army of valiant men of war, even four hundred thousand chosen men: Jeroboam also set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, being mighty men of valour.

rr: Bwanyima Abiya yaayemerera aha kibungo Zemaraimu, ekiri omu nsi y'ebibungo eya Efuraimu, yaagira ati: Muntegye amatu, iwe Yeroboamu n'Abaisraeli mwena.
en: And Abijah stood up upon mount Zemaraim, which is in mount Ephraim, and said, Hear me, thou Jeroboam, and all Israel;

rr: Timushemereire kumanya ku MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli yaahaire Daudi n'abatabani obugabe kutegyeka Israeli, naabaraganisa endagaano y'omwonyo?
en: ought ye not to know that the LORD God of Israel gave the kingdom over Israel to David for ever, even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt?

rr: N'obu kiraabe kyabaire kityo, Yeroboamu mwene Nebati, omugaragwa wa Sulemaani mwene Daudi, akaimuka yaagomera mukama we
en: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, is risen up, and hath rebelled against his lord.

rr: abashaija bamwe abataine mugasho baija, baakwatanisa nawe, baahiga Rehoboamu mwene Sulemaani akiri muto, atakahamire, atarikubaasa kubazibira.
en: And there are gathered unto him vain men, the children of Belial, and have strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon, when Rehoboam was young and tenderhearted, and could not withstand them.

rr: Mbwenu nimuteekateeka ngu nimwija kuzibira obugabe bwa MUKAMA oburi omu mikono ya beene Daudi, ngu niho muri omutwe muhango munonga, kandi ngu niho mwine enyana z'ezaabu ezi Yeroboamu yaabaheesheire kuba baaruhanga baanyu?
en: And now ye think to withstand the kingdom of the LORD in the hand of the sons of David; and ye be a great multitude, and there are with you golden calves, which Jeroboam made you for gods.

rr: Timurabingire abanyamurwa ba MUKAMA beene Arooni, n'Abaleevi, mukeeteeraho abandi nk'abantu b'agandi mahanga? Omuntu weena orikwija kweyeza, areetsire enimi y'ekimasha nari empaya z'entaama mushanju, ahinduka omunyamurwa w'abatari baaruhanga.
en: Have ye not cast out the priests of the LORD , the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and have made you priests after the manner of the nations of other lands? so that whosoever cometh to consecrate himself with a young bullock and seven rams, the same may be a priest of them that are no gods.

rr: Kwonka itwe, MUKAMA niwe Ruhanga waitu, kandi titukamutsigahoga. Abanyamurwa abu twine, arikuheereza MUKAMA, ni batabani ba Arooni, kandi twine Abaleevi b'okubaheereza.
en: But as for us, the LORD is our God, and we have not forsaken him; and the priests, which minister unto the LORD , are the sons of Aaron, and the Levites wait upon their business:

rr: -39 ; 27:20 , 21 ; -4 ; . Buri kasheeshe na buri mwabazyo bahongyera MUKAMA ebitambo by'okwotsya, bamwoterera obubaane bw'emigaju erikutaamirana, batebeekanisa emigaati ey'okumurikwa aha meeza y'ezaabu eshemeziibwe, kandi bareeberera ekikondo ky'amatabaaza ky'ezaabu, ngu amatabaaza gaakyo gabone kwaka buri mwabazyo; ahakuba itwe tukuratira ebi MUKAMA Ruhanga waitu yaaturagiire, kwonka imwe mumutsigireho.
en: and they burn unto the LORD every morning and every evening burnt sacrifices and sweet incense: the shewbread also set they in order upon the pure table; and the candlestick of gold with the lamps thereof, to burn every evening: for we keep the charge of the LORD our God; but ye have forsaken him.

rr: Reeba, Ruhanga ari hamwe naitwe, naatwebembera, kandi n'abanyamurwa be bari aha, baine enzamba z'okuhuruza ab'okubarwanisa.
en: And, behold, God himself is with us for our captain, and his priests with sounding trumpets to cry alarm against you.

rr: Imwe beene Israeli 'mwe, murekye kurwanisa MUKAMA Ruhanga wa baashwenkuriimwe; ahabw'okuba timurikubaasa kusingura.
en: O children of Israel, fight ye not against the LORD God of your fathers; for ye shall not prosper.

rr: Obwo Yeroboamu akaba ayohereize ab'okubagwera, ngu babateere nibabareetwa enyima; n'ahabw'ekyo engabo ze zikaba ziri omu maisho g'Abayuda, n'ab'okubagwera babari enyima.
en: But Jeroboam caused an ambushment to come about behind them: so they were before Judah, and the ambushment was behind them.

rr: Abayuda ku baanagire amaisho, baashanga orugamba rubaturukire omumaisho n'enyima; baatakira MUKAMA, abanyamurwa baateera enzamba
en: And when Judah looked back, behold, the battle was before and behind: and they cried unto the LORD , and the priests sounded with the trumpets.

rr: n'abashaija ba Yuda baateera orwari; ku baaruteire, Ruhanga yaasingura Yeroboamu n'Abaisraeli boona omu maisho ga Abiya n'Abayuda.
en: Then the men of Judah gave a shout: and as the men of Judah shouted, it came to pass, that God smote Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.

rr: Abaisraeli baahunga Abayuda, Ruhanga yaabahayo omu mikono yaabo.
en: And the children of Israel fled before Judah: and God delivered them into their hand.

rr: Abiya n'abantu be baabaitamu abantu baingi munonga; batyo Abaisraeli baafamu abashaija entoore obusiriira butaano.
en: And Abijah and his people slew them with a great slaughter: so there fell down slain of Israel five hundred thousand chosen men.

rr: Okwo nikwo Abaisraeli baahweire eishaija omu bunaku obwo, Abayuda bakabasingura, ahabw'okwesiga MUKAMA Ruhanga wa baishenkurubo.
en: Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time, and the children of Judah prevailed, because they relied upon the LORD God of their fathers.

rr: Bwanyima Abiya yaakurata Yeroboamu, yaamunyaga endembo ezi, Beseeli n'ebirorero byayo, Yeshana n'ebirorero byayo na Efurooni n'ebirorero byayo.
en: And Abijah pursued after Jeroboam, and took cities from him, Beth-el with the towns thereof, and Jeshanah with the towns thereof, and Ephrain with the towns thereof.

rr: Omu busingye wa Abiya Yeroboamu taragizire bu agaruka kugira amaani; bwanyima MUKAMA yaamurwaza, yaafa.
en: Neither did Jeroboam recover strength again in the days of Abijah: and the LORD struck him, and he died.

rr: Kwonka Abiya yaayeyongyera amaani. Yaashwera abakazi ikumi na bana, yaazaara abatabani makumi abiri na babiri, na bahara ikumi na mukaaga.
en: But Abijah waxed mighty, and married fourteen wives, and begat twenty and two sons, and sixteen daughters.

rr: Endiijo mirimo ya Abiya, emicwe ye n'ebigambo bye bihandiikirwe omu kitabo kya nabi Ido.
en: And the rest of the acts of Abijah, and his ways, and his sayings, are written in the story of the prophet Iddo.

Bwanyima Abiya yaagwejegyera, yaashanga baishenkuru, yaaziikwa omu rurembo rwa Daudi; Asa omutabani yaategyeka omu mwanya gwe.
en: So Abijah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead.

rr: Omu biro bye esni ekamara emyaka ikumi eine obusingye.
en: In his days the land was quiet ten years.

rr: Asa yaakora ebirungi kandi ebirikusiimwa MUKAMA.
en: And Asa did that which was good and right in the eyes of the LORD his God:

rr: Akaihaho amatambiro g'enduga-mahanga n'emyanya mikuru y'okuramizamu, yaasheenya enyomyo z'amabaare, yaatema Ashera
en: for he took away the altars of the strange gods , and the high places, and brake down the images, and cut down the groves:

rr: kandi yaaragiira Abayuda kusherura MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa baishenkurubo, n'okworobera ebiragiro n'ebyatairweho.
en: and commanded Judah to seek the LORD God of their fathers, and to do the law and the commandment.

rr: Kandi yaiha omu ndembo zoona eza Yuda emyanya mikuru y'okuramizamu, n'ebyoterero by'okwotereraho obubaane. Obugabe bwagira obuhuumure omu busingye bwe.
en: Also he took away out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the images: and the kingdom was quiet before him.

rr: Yaayombeka endembo ezeehinguririziibwe amabaare omuri Yuda, ahakuba ensi ekaba eine obusingye. Omuri egyo myaka tiyaagira ngamba; ahabw'okuba MUKAMA akamuha obusingye.
en: And he built fenced cities in Judah: for the land had rest, and he had no war in those years; because the LORD had given him rest.

rr: Yaagira Abayuda ati: Ka twombekye endembo ezi, tuzeehinguririze engo z'amabaare, tuzombekyeho eminaara, n'amarembo againe enyigi ezirikukingwa empimbi; ensi ekiri eyaitu, ahabw'okuba tusherwire MUKAMA Ruhanga waitu; tumusherwire, nawe yaatuha obusingye embaju zoona.
en: Therefore he said unto Judah, Let us build these cities, and make about them walls, and towers, gates, and bars, while the land is yet before us; because we have sought the LORD our God, we have sought him , and he hath given us rest on every side.

rr: Batyo baayombeka, baaba gye.
en: So they built and prospered.

rr: Kandi Asa akaba aine eihe ry'abashaija obusiriira bushatu b'abarugire Yuda abaine engabo n'amacumu, n'abarugire Benyamiini obusiriira bubiri n'obukumi munaana, ab'engabo n'amata; abo boona bakaba bari abashaija b'amaani amamanzi.
en: And Asa had an army of men that bare targets and spears, out of Judah three hundred thousand; and out of Benjamin, that bare shields and drew bows, two hundred and fourscore thousand: all these were mighty men of valour.

rr: Bwanyima Zeera owa Esiopia yaija kubarwanisa n'eihe ry'engabo akakaikuru n'ebigaari magana ashatu, yaahika Mareesha.
en: And there came out against them Zerah the Ethiopian with an host of a thousand thousand, and three hundred chariots; and came unto Mareshah.

rr: Asa yaashohora kumubugana, baatenga orugamba omu ruhita rwa Zefasa ahari Mareesha.
en: Then Asa went out against him, and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.

rr: Asa yaatakira MUKAMA Ruhanga we, naagira ati: Ai MUKAMA, tihaine orikwingana naiwe omu kuhwera abataine maani baateerwa ab'amaani. MUKAMA Ruhanga waitu, otuhe emikono, ahabw'okuba niiwe turikwesiga, kandi omu iziina ryawe twizire kurwanisa omutwe ogu muhango munonga ogw'engabo. Ai MUKAMA, niiwe Ruhanga waitu, otaikiriza omuntu kukusingura.
en: And Asa cried unto the LORD his God, and said, LORD , it is nothing with thee to help, whether with many, or with them that have no power: help us, O LORD our God; for we rest on thee, and in thy name we go against this multitude. O LORD , thou art our God; let not man prevail against thee.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo MUKAMA yaasingura Abaesiopia omu maisho ga Asa n'Abayuda, Abaesiopia baahunga.
en: So the LORD smote the Ethiopians before Asa, and before Judah; and the Ethiopians fled.

rr: Asa n'abantu abu yaabaire aine baababinga, baabahitsya Geera, Abaesiopia baafa baingi munonga, tibaabaasa kugaruka kweyunga; ahabw'okuba bakacwekyerezibwa omu maisho ga MUKAMA n'eihe rya. Abashaija ba Yuda baatwara eminyago mingi munonga
en: And Asa and the people that were with him pursued them unto Gerar: and the Ethiopians were overthrown, that they could not recover themselves; for they were destroyed before the LORD , and before his host; and they carried away very much spoil.

rr: bwanyima baacwekyereza endembo zoona ezaabaire zeehinguririize Geera, ahabw'okuba Abaesiopia bakaba baitsirwe obwoba obwareetsirwe MUKAMA. Baanyaga ezo ndembo zoona, ahakuba zikaba zirimu eminyago mingi.
en: And they smote all the cities round about Gerar; for the fear of the LORD came upon them: and they spoiled all the cities; for there was exceeding much spoil in them.

rr: Kandi baacwekyereza amahema g'abaabaire batungire ente, baanyaga entaama n'engamira nyingi munonga. Bwanyima baagaruka Yerusaalemu. Currently Selected: 2 Eby&x27;omu Busingye 14 : RR64 Highlight Share <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8 19c-2.828 0-4.2
en: They smote also the tents of cattle, and carried away sheep and camels in abundance, and returned to Jerusalem. Currently Selected: 2 Chronicles 14 : KJV Highlight Share <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8 19c-2.828 0-4.243 0-5.121-.879C2 17.243 2 15.82

rr: Omwoyo wa Ruhanga yaija ahari Azaria mwene Odedi
en: And the Spirit of God came upon Azariah the son of Oded:

rr: yaashohora kubugana Asa, yaamugira ati: Iwe n'Abayuda n'Ababenyamiini, mumpurire. Ruhanga ari hamwe naimwe, mwaba muri hamwe nawe. Ku murikumusherura, nimumuzoora; kwonak ku murikumutsigaho, nawe naabatsigaho.
en: and he went out to meet Asa, and said unto him, Hear ye me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin; The LORD is with you, while ye be with him; and if ye seek him, he will be found of you; but if ye forsake him, he will forsake you.

rr: Nimumanya ku Abaisraeli baamazire omwanya muhango bataine Ruhanga nyamuhanga, n'obu yaakuba omunyamurwa orikubeegyesa, kandi bataine biragiro
en: Now for a long season Israel hath been without the true God, and without a teaching priest, and without law.

rr: kwonka ku baahindukiire MUKAMA Ruhanga wa israeli omu busaasi bwabo, baamusherura, baamuzoora.
en: But when they in their trouble did turn unto the LORD God of Israel, and sought him, he was found of them.

rr: Omu biro ebyo hakaba hatariho busingye aha muntu weena orikushohora, nari orikutaaha, ahabw'okuba emirabanamu mingi ekagwisa kubi munonga abatuuzi boona ab'omuri ago mahanga.
en: And in those times there was no peace to him that went out, nor to him that came in, but great vexations were upon all the inhabitants of the countries.

rr: Baataanamu, eihanga ryarwana n'erindi, n'orurembo rwarwana n'orundi, ahakuba Ruhanga akabatuntuza n'obusaasi bw'emiringo yoona.
en: And nation was destroyed of nation, and city of city: for God did vex them with all adversity.

rr: Kwonka imwe, mugume! Mutacweka emikono; ahabw'okuba emirimo yaanyu eryazimurirwa.
en: Be ye strong therefore, and let not your hands be weak: for your work shall be rewarded.

rr: Asa ku yaahuriire ebyo bigambo by'obunabi bwa Azaria mwene Odedi, yaagu, yaiha ebishushani ebirikunugwa omu nsi yoona eya Yuda n'eya Benyamiini n'omu ndembo ezi yaakubwire omu nsi y'ebibungo eya Efuraimu, kandi yaahunduuza eitambiro rya MUKAMA eryabaire riri omu maisho g'ekisasi eky'omu maisho ga hekalu ya MUKAMA.
en: And when Asa heard these words, and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominable idols out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from mount Ephraim, and renewed the altar of the LORD , that was before the porch of the LORD .

rr: Bwanyima yaateeranira hamwe Abayuda n'Ababenyamiini boona, n'abaarugire omuri Efuraimu, Manaase na Simeoni, abaabaire baabashuhuukiiremu; ahakuba abantu baingi, ku baareebire MUKAMA Ruhanga we ari hamwe nawe, baacwa omuri Israeli, baija, baamwehongyera.
en: And he gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and the strangers with them out of Ephraim and Manasseh, and out of Simeon: for they fell to him out of Israel in abundance, when they saw that the LORD his God was with him.

rr: Omu kwezi kwa kashatu kw'omu mwaka gwa ikumi n'etaano ogw'omu busingye bwa Asa, nibwo baateeranira Yerusaalemu.
en: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa.

rr: 2 Ahari eryo izooba baatambira MUKAMA ente magana mushanju n'entaama obukumi mushanju, nibaziiha omu minyago ei baabaire bareetsire.
en: And they offered unto the LORD the same time, of the spoil which they had brought, seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep.

rr: Baaragaana endagaano kusherura MUKAMA Ruhanga wa baishenkurubo n'omutima gwabo gwona n'amagara gaabo goona
en: And they entered into a covenant to seek the LORD God of their fathers with all their heart and with all their soul;

rr: kandi ngu, omuntu weena oraayangye kusherura MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa israeli, yaaba muto, yaaba mukuru, yaaba mushaija, yaaba mukazi, aitwe.
en: that whosoever would not seek the LORD God of Israel should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.

rr: Baarahira omu maisho ga MUKAMA n'eiraka rihango, nibateera akaari, n'amakondere n'enzamba.
en: And they sware unto the LORD with a loud voice, and with shouting, and with trumpets, and with cornets.

rr: Abayuda boona baashemerererwa egyo ndahiro; ahakuba bakarahira n'omutima gwabo gwona, kandi baamusherura n'okwetenga kwabo kwona, baamuzoora; MUKAMA yaabaha obuhuumure embaju zoona.
en: And all Judah rejoiced at the oath: for they had sworn with all their heart, and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found of them: and the LORD gave them rest round about.

rr: 1 -15 ; . Kandi omugabe Asa yaabinga Maaka nyina, yaamwiha aha bwanyin'omugabe, naamutura okukorera Ashara ekishushani ekirikunugwa. Asa yaatema ekyo kishushani, yaakihondahonda, yaakyokyeza aha mugyera Kidirooni.
en: And also concerning Maachah the mother of Asa the king, he removed her from being queen, because she had made an idol in a grove: and Asa cut down her idol, and stamped it , and burnt it at the brook Kidron.

rr: Kwonka emyanya mikuru ey'okuramizamu teraihirwe muri Israeli. N'obu kiraabe kyabaire kityo, omutima gwa Asa gukaba gutaine ky'okuhanywa ebiro bye byona.
en: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel: nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.

rr: Kandi yaareeta omu nju ya Ruhanga ebintu ebi ishe yaashoroire, efeeza, n'ezaabu, n'ebintu by'okukoresa.
en: And he brought into the house of God the things that his father had dedicated, and that he himself had dedicated, silver, and gold, and vessels.

rr: Tihaabaho bundi bweme okuhitsya omu mwaka gwa makumi ashatu n'etaano ogw'omu busingye bwe.
en: And there was no more war unto the five and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa.

1 Omu mwaka gwa makumi ashatu na mukaaga ogw'omu busingye bwa Asa, Baasha omugabe wa Israeli akainamuka, yaateera Yuda, yaayombeka Raama, ngu abone kuzibira omuntu weena kuruga owa Asa omugabe wa Yuda, nari okutaaha owe.
en: In the six and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa Baasha king of Israel came up against Judah, and built Ramah, to the intent that he might let none go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

rr: Asa nikwo kwiha efeeza n'ezaabu omu mabiikiro g'omu nju ya MUKAMA, n'ag'omu nju y'omugabe, akabitwekyera Benihadadi omugabe wa Siria, owaabaire atwire Damasiko, naagira ati
en: Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of the house of the LORD and of the king's house, and sent to Ben-hadad king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,

rr: Ka turagaane endagaano y'okukwatanisa, nk'oku tata aaragaine na sho. Reeba, naakutwekyera efeeza n'ezaabu. Gyenda, oite endagaano ei waaragaine na Baasha omugabe wa Israeli, abone kundugira omu nsi.
en: There is a league between me and thee, as there was between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent thee silver and gold; go, break thy league with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.

rr: Benihadadi yaikiriza eby'omugabe Asa, yaatuma abakuru b'amahe ge kuteera endembo za Israeli, baakwata Iyooni, Daani, Abeeli-maimu n'endembo z'amabiikiro zoona ez'omuri Nafutaali.
en: And Ben-hadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel; and they smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abel-maim, and all the store cities of Naphtali.

rr: Baasha ku yaakihuriire, yaarekyera aho kwombeka Raama, yaayemereza omurimo.
en: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard it , that he left off building of Ramah, and let his work cease.

rr: Bwanyima omugabe Asa yaatwara Abayuda boona, baiha omuri Raama amabaare n'embaaho, ebi Baasha yaabaire naayombekyersa; yaabyombekyesa Geeba na Mizipa.
en: Then Asa the king took all Judah; and they carried away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha was building; and he built therewith Geba and Mizpah.

rr: Omu bunaku obwo Hanania omuhanuuzi yaija ahari Asa omugabe wa Yuda, yaamugira ati: Ahabw'okuba oyesigire omugabe wa Siria, tiwaayesiga MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe, nikyo eihe ry'omugabe wa Siria rikukiriireho.
en: And at that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah, and said unto him, Because thou hast relied on the king of Syria, and not relied on the LORD thy God, therefore is the host of the king of Syria escaped out of thine hand.

rr: 2 Abaesiopia n'Abalibya bakaba batari eihe rihango munonga, eriine ebigaari bingi n'abarikugyendera aha mbaraasi baingi? N'obu kiraabe kyabaire kiri kityo, kwonka ahabw'okwesiga MUKAMA akabahayo omu mikono yaawe.
en: Were not the Ethiopians and the Lubims a huge host, with very many chariots and horsemen? yet, because thou didst rely on the LORD , he delivered them into thine hand.

rr: Ahabw'okuba amaisho ga MUKAMA gairuka oku n'oku nigabuga ensi yoona, okweyoreka ku ari ow'amaani kuhwera abaine emitima eshugaine ahariwe.
en: For the eyes of the LORD run to and fro throughout the whole earth, to shew himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him.

rr: Omuri eki okozire eby'obushema; n'ahabw'ekyo okuruga hati noija kuguma noogira obweme.
en: Herein thou hast done foolishly: therefore from henceforth thou shalt have wars.

rr: Ahonaaho Asa yaagirira omuhanuuzi ekiniga, yaamuta omu nkomo, yaamutwara omu kihome; ahabw'okuba akamugwerwa kubi munonga ahabw'ekyo.
en: Then Asa was wroth with the seer, and put him in a prison house; for he was in a rage with him because of this thing .

rr: Kandi omu bunaku obwo Asa yaabonabonesa abantu bamwe.
en: And Asa oppressed some of the people the same time.

rr: Ebi Asa yaakozire, okwiha aha kutandika okuhitsya aha muheru, bihandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'abagabe ba Yuda na Israeli.
en: And, behold, the acts of Asa, first and last, lo, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

rr: Bwanyima omu mwanka gwa makumi ashatu na mwenda ogw'omu busingye bwe, Asa yaarwara ebigyere, egyo ndwara yaaba ey'amaani munonga; hoona n'obu yaarwaire, tarasherwire buhwezi ahari MUKAMA, kureka akabusherura aha bafumu.
en: And Asa in the thirty and ninth year of his reign was diseased in his feet, until his disease was exceeding great: yet in his disease he sought not to the LORD , but to the physicians.

rr: Bwanyima Asa yaafa omu mwaka gwa makumi ana na gumwe ogw'omu busingye bwe, yaagwejegyera, yaashanga baishenkuru.
en: And Asa slept with his fathers, and died in the one and fortieth year of his reign.

rr: Baamuziika omu kituuro, eki yaayetimbiire omu rurembo rwa Daudi. Baarambika omutumbi gwe aha kitanda, ekiijwire emigaju ey'emiringo etari emwe, ejwangiibwe abanyamyoga, kandi baacumika omuriro mwingi kumuhaisa ekitiinisa. rr: Yehoshafaati omutabani akategyeka omu mwanya gwa Asa ishe, yaakora eby'okwehamya ngu ayerinde Israeli.
en: And Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead, and strengthened himself against Israel.

rr: Yaata emitwe y'engabo omu ndembo zoona eza Yuda ezeehinguririziibwe engo z'amabaare, yaata abarinzi omu nsi ya Yuda, n'omu ndembo za Efuraimu, ezi Asa ishe yaakubwire.
en: And he placed forces in all the fenced cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah, and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.

rr: MUKAMA yaaguma na Yehoshafaati, ahabw'okuba akagyendera omu micwe ya ishe ey'okubanza; tiyaakuratira Baabaali
en: And the LORD was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the first ways of his father David, and sought not unto Baalim;

rr: kureka yaakuratira Ruhanga wa ishe, yaaguma naayorobera ebiragiro bye, tiyaakuratira mitwarize ya Israeli.
en: but sought to the LORD God of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not after the doings of Israel.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo MUKAMA yaahamya obugabe bwe; Abayuda boona baaguma nibatoijera Yehoshafaati, yaatunga munonga, kandi yaagira ekitiinisa kingi.
en: Therefore the LORD stablished the kingdom in his hand; and all Judah brought to Jehoshaphat presents; and he had riches and honour in abundance.

rr: Yaagyendera omu muhanda ya MUKAMA n'omutima gutaine bwoba; kandi yaihaho emyanya mikuru y'okuramizamu na Ashera omuri Yuda.
en: And his heart was lifted up in the ways of the LORD : moreover he took away the high places and groves out of Judah.

rr: Omu mwaka gwa kashatu ogw'omu busingye bwe, yaatuma abatware be Benihaili, Obadia, Zekaria, Netaneeli na Mikaaya kwegyesa omu ndembo za Yuda
en: Also in the third year of his reign he sent to his princes, even to Ben-hail, and to Obadiah, and to Zechariah, and to Nethaneel, and to Michaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah.

rr: yaabatuma n'Abaleevi aba, Shemaya, Netania, Zebadia, Asaheeli, Shemiramoosi, Yehonasaani, Adoniya, Tobiya na Tobadoniya; hamwe n'abo Baleevi yaatuma abanyamurwa Elishaama na Yehoraamu.
en: And with them he sent Levites, even Shemaiah, and Nethaniah, and Zebadiah, and Asahel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehonathan, and Adonijah, and Tobijah, and Tob-adonijah, Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, priests.

rr: Baayegyesa omuri Yuda, baine ekitabo kya MUKAMA eky'ebiragiro; baaraba omu ndembo zaaona eza Yuda, nibeegyesa abantu.
en: And they taught in Judah, and had the book of the law of the LORD with them, and went about throughout all the cities of Judah, and taught the people.

rr: MUKAMA yaitsa obwoba abagabe b'amahanga goona ag'ensi ezaabaire zeehinguririize Yuda, tibaarwanisa Yehoshafaati.
en: And the fear of the LORD fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that were round about Judah, so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.

rr: Abamwe aha Bafilistia baareetera Yehoshafaati ebiconco, kandi baaguma nibamutoijera efeeza; kandi n'Abaharabu baamureetera empaya z'entaama enkumi mushanju na magana mushanju, n'empaya z'embuzi enkumi mushanju na magana mushanju.
en: Also some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents, and tribute silver; and the Arabians brought him flocks, seven thousand and seven hundred rams, and seven thousand and seven hundred he goats.

rr: Yehoshafaati yaaguma naayeyongyera ekitiinisa; yaayombeka omuri Yuda ebigo n'endembo z'amabiikiro
en: And Jehoshaphat waxed great exceedingly; and he built in Judah castles, and cities of store.

rr: kandi yaabiika ebintu bingi omu ndembo zaayo. N'omuri Yerusaalemu yaagira u abaserukare, abashaija b'amaani amamanzi.
en: And he had much business in the cities of Judah: and the men of war, mighty men of valour, were in Jerusalem.

rr: Ogu nigwo mubaro gwabo, nk'amaju ga baishenkurubo oku gaabaire gari; omu Bayuda, abakuru b'amahe bakaba bari aba: Aduna, omukuru w'engabo owaabaire aine abashaija b'amaani amamanzi obusiriira bushatu
en: And these are the numbers of them according to the house of their fathers: Of Judah, the captains of thousands; Adnah the chief, and with him mighty men of valour three hundred thousand.

rr: orikumukurata akaba ari Yehohanani omukuru w'engabo owaabaire aine abashaija obusiriira bubiri n'obukumi munaana
en: And next to him was Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred and fourscore thousand.

rr: n'orikutaho akaba ari amasia mwene Zikuri, owaayehaireyo kuheereza MUKAMA n'omutima gwekundiire; we akaba aine abashaija b'amaani amamanzi obusiriira bubiri.
en: And next him was Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself unto the LORD ; and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valour.

rr: Omu Babenyamiini abakuru b'amahe bakaba bari aba: Eliada omushaija ow'amaani emanzi, owaabaire aine abashaija b'amata n'engabo obusiriira bubiri
en: And of Benjamin; Eliada a mighty man of valour, and with him armed men with bow and shield two hundred thousand.

rr: n'orikumukurata Yehozabadi, owaabaire aine abashaija akasiriira n'obukumi munaana abeeteekateekyeire orugamba.
en: And next him was Jehozabad, and with him an hundred and fourscore thousand ready prepared for the war.

rr: Abo nibo baabaire nibakorera omugabe, otabariireho abo abu omugabe yaataire omu ndembo zeehinguririziibwe engo z'amabaare omuri Yuda yoona.
en: These waited on the king, beside those whom the king put in the fenced cities throughout all Judah.

Yehoshafaati akaba atungire munonga, kandi aine ekitiinisa kingi; yaashwererana na Ahabu, baagira obuzaare.
en: Now Jehoshaphat had riches and honour in abundance, and joined affinity with Ahab.

rr: 1 Emyaka ku yaahingwireho, yaashuuma, yaashanga Ahabu omuri Samaria; Ahabu yaamubaagira entaama n'ente nyingi, n'abu yaabaire aine, yaamubeihabeiha kuhurura nawe kuteera Ramosi-gileadi.
en: And after certain years he went down to Ahab to Samaria. And Ahab killed sheep and oxen for him in abundance, and for the people that he had with him, and persuaded him to go up with him to Ramoth-gilead.

rr: Ahabu omugabe wa Israeli yaagira Yehoshafaati omugabe wa Yuda ati: Noija kuhurura naanye Ramosi-gileadi?
en: And Ahab king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat king of Judah, Wilt thou go with me to Ramoth-gilead?

rr: Yaamugarukamu ati: Nyowe naiwe turi bamwe, abantu bangye nibo baawe.
en: And he answered him, I am as thou art , and my people as thy people; and we will be with thee in the war.

rr: Nitwija kukwatanisa naiwe omu rugamba.
en: The Prophecy of Micaiah

rr: Yehoshafaati yaagira omugabe wa Israeli ati: Ninkweshengyereza, banza oyehanuuze ahari MUKAMA, oreebe eki arikugamba eri izooba.
en: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel, Enquire, I pray thee, at the word of the LORD to day.

rr: Atyo omugabe wa Israeli yaateerana baanabi abashaija magana ana, yaababuuza ati: Tuteere Ramosi-gileadi, nari ndereere?
en: Therefore the king of Israel gathered together of prophets four hundred men, and said unto them, Shall we go to Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall I forbear?

rr: Baamugarukamu bati: Irooko, ohurure, ahakuba MUKAMA naija kugihayo omu mikono y'omugabe.
en: And they said, Go up; for God will deliver it into the king's hand.

rr: Kwonka Yehoshafaati yaagira ati: Beitu shi aha, tihariho nabi wa MUKAMA, tukamubuuza?
en: But Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of the LORD besides, that we might enquire of him?

rr: Omugabe wa Israeli yaagira Yehoshafaati ati: hakiriho omushaija omwe, ou turikubaasa kweheanuuzaho ebya MUKAMA, niwe Mikaaya mwene Imula; kwonka nimmwanga, ahabw'okuba tandagurira birungi, kureka ebibi.
en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, There is yet one man, by whom we may enquire of the LORD : but I hate him; for he never prophesied good unto me, but always evil: the same is Micaiah the son of Imla.

rr: Yehoshafaati yaagira ati: Nyakusinga, reka kugamba otyo.
en: And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.

rr: Atyo omugabe wa Israeli yaayeta omukuru w'abaserukare, yaamugira ati: Ndahukiza Mikaaya mwene Imula.
en: And the king of Israel called for one of his officers, and said, Fetch quickly Micaiah the son of Imla.

rr: Obwo omugabe wa israeli na Yehoshafaati omugabe wa Yuda bakaba bashutami aha bitebe byabo eby'obugabe, bajwaire zaabushuuti zaabo, bari aha mbuga omu irembo rya Samaria, baanabi boona babari omumaisho nibaragura.
en: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah sat either of them on his throne, clothed in their robes, and they sat in a void place at the entering in of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.

rr: Zedekia mwene Kenaana yaayekorera amahembe g'ekyoma, yaaragura ati: Oku nikwo MUKAMA arikugamba naagira ati: Aga mahembe nigo oraabingise Abasiria okuhitsya obu baraacwekyerere.
en: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah had made him horns of iron, and said, Thus saith the LORD , With these thou shalt push Syria until they be consumed.

rr: Kandi na baanabi boona baaragura batyo nibagira bati: Irooko oteere Ramosi-gileadi, osingure; MUKAMA naija kugihayo omu mikono y'omugabe.
en: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramoth-gilead, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver it into the hand of the king.

rr: Entumwa eyaaza kweta Mikaaya yaamugira eti: Reeba, ebigambo bya baanabi nibiikirizana, biragura gye aha mugabe; naiwe ebigambo byawe bibe nk'ebyabo, oragure gye.
en: And the messenger that went to call Micaiah spake to him, saying, Behold, the words of the prophets declare good to the king with one assent; let thy word therefore, I pray thee, be like one of their's, and speak thou good.

rr: Kwonka Mikaaya yaagira ati: Nindahira MUKAMA, eki MUKAMA arangambire, nikyo ndaagambe.
en: And Micaiah said, As the LORD liveth, even what my God saith, that will I speak.

rr: Ku yaahikire omugabe, omugabe yaamubuuza ati: Mikaaya, tuteere Ramosi-gileadi, nari ndereere?
en: And when he was come to the king, the king said unto him, Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall I forbear?

rr: Yaamugarukamu ati: Hurura, osingure; nibaija kuheebwayo omu mikono y'omugabe.
en: And he said, Go ye up, and prosper, and they shall be delivered into your hand.

rr: Kwonka omugabe yaamugira ati: Nkurahize kangahi okutangambira kindi omu iziina rya MUKAMA kureka amazima?
en: And the king said to him, How many times shall I adjure thee that thou say nothing but the truth to me in the name of the LORD ?

rr: Onu yaamugarukamu ati: Ndeebire Abaisraeli boona bataataaniire aha bibungo nk'entaama ezitaine muriisa; MUKAMA yaagira ati: Aba tibaine mukama; boona bagarukyeyo n'obusingye, buri muntu omu ka ye.
en: Then he said, I did see all Israel scattered upon the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd: and the LORD said, These have no master; let them return therefore every man to his house in peace.

rr: Omugabe wa Israeli yaagira Yehoshafaati ati: Tinaakugambira nti: Tarikwija kundagurira birungi kureka ebibi?
en: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell thee that he would not prophesy good unto me, but evil?

rr: Mikaaya yaagira ati: Mbwenu hurira ekigambo kya MUKAMA. Naareeba MUKAMA ashutami aha kitebe kye, n'eihe ryona ery'omu iguru ryemereire aha rubaju rwe rwa buryo n'orwa bumosho
en: Again he said, Therefore hear the word of the LORD ; I saw the LORD sitting upon his throne, and all the host of heaven standing on his right hand and on his left.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira ati: N'oha oraabeihabeihe Ahabu, akateera Ramosi-gileadi, akagwayo?
en: And the LORD said, Who shall entice Ahab king of Israel, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth-gilead?

rr: Omwe yaagamba okundi, n'ondi okundi.
en: And one spake saying after this manner, and another saying after that manner.

rr: Bwanyima haija omwoyo, gwayemerera omu maisho ga MUKAMA, gwagira guti: Niinye ndaamubeihabeihe.
en: Then there came out a spirit, and stood before the LORD , and said, I will entice him.

rr: MUKAMA yaagubuuza ati: Noomubeihabeihesa ki?
en: And the LORD said unto him, Wherewith?

rr: Gwagira guti: niinyija kugyenda, mpindukye omwoyo gw'ebishuba, ngambire omuri baanabi be boona.
en: And he said, I will go out, and be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira ati: niiwe oraamubeihabeihe, kandi noija kukibaasa; irooko okore otyo.
en: And the LORD said, Thou shalt entice him , and thou shalt also prevail: go out, and do even so.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo MUKAMA ataire omwoyo gw'ebishuba omuri baanabi baawe aba boona; kandi MUKAMA akugambireho kubi.
en: Now therefore, behold, the LORD hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of these thy prophets, and the LORD hath spoken evil against thee.

rr: Bwanyima Zedekia mwene Kenaana yairira haihi, yaateera Mikaaya oruhi rw'omushaaya, naagira ati: Omwoyo wa MUKAMA arabire hi kundugaho kugamba naiwe?
en: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near, and smote Micaiah upon the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of the LORD from me to speak unto thee?

rr: Mikaaya yaagira ati: Mbwenu oryakireeba ahari eryo izooba ku oriba nooza kweshereka omu kishengye ky'omunda.
en: And Micaiah said, Behold, thou shalt see on that day when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.

rr: Omugabe wa Israeli yaagira ati: Twara Mikaaya, omugarure ahari Amoni omukuru w'orurembo na Yoasi mutabani w'omugabe
en: Then the king of Israel said, Take ye Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king's son;

rr: omugire oti: oku nikwo omugabe arikugamba naagira ati: Mute ekishaija eki omu kihome, mukiriise eby'okurya kandi mukinywaise amaizi eby'akahenano, okuhitsya obu ndaagarukye n'obusingye.
en: and say, Thus saith the king, Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I return in peace.

rr: Mikaaya yaagira ati: Ku oraagarukye n'obusingye, biri MUKAMA tagambiire muriinye. Yaagaruka yaagira ati: Naimwe bantu 'mwe mwena, mukihurire! Okufa kwa Ahabu
en: And Micaiah said, If thou certainly return in peace, then hath not the LORD spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, all ye people.

rr: Bwanyima omugabe wa Israeli na Yehoshafaati omugabe wa Yuda bainamuka, baateera Ramosi-gileadi.
en: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth-gilead.

rr: Omugabe wa Israeli yaagira Yehoshafaati ati: Nyowe naaza kwehindura, nze kurwana, kwonka iwe ogume ojwaire ebijwaro byawe by'obugabe.
en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and will go to the battle; but put thou on thy robes.

rr: Atyo omugabe wa Israeli yaayehindura, yaaza aha rugamba.
en: So the king of Israel disguised himself; and they went to the battle.

rr: Kandi omugabe wa Siria akaba aragiire abakuru b'ebigaari bye ati: Mutarwana n'abato, n'obu baakuba abakuru, kureka omugabe wa Israeli wenka.
en: Now the king of Syria had commanded the captains of the chariots that were with him, saying, Fight ye not with small or great, save only with the king of Israel.

rr: Abo bakuru b'ebigaari, ku baareebire Yehoshafaati, baagira bati: Buzima niwe mugabe wa Israeli. Baakubuuka kurwana nawe. Yehoshafaati yaateera enduuru, MUKAMA yaamuhwera; Ruhanga yaabamwihaho
en: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, It is the king of Israel. Therefore they compassed about him to fight: but Jehoshaphat cried out, and the LORD helped him; and God moved them to depart from him.

rr: abakuru b'ebigaari, ku baareebire atari mugabe wa Israeli, baagarukayo, baareka kumubinga.
en: For it came to pass, that, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back again from pursuing him.

rr: Kwonka haarugaho omushaija yaananuura obuta, yaafa okurasha omwambi, yaateera omugabe wa Israeli, ahu ebijwaro bye eby'okurwanisa n'eky'aha kifuba birikuteeranira; omugabe nikwo kugambira omuvugi w'ekigaari kye ati: Hinduka, onyihe omu rugamba, ahabw'okuba naahutaara munonga.
en: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness: therefore he said to his chariot man, Turn thine hand, that thou mayest carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.

rr: Eryo izooba orugamba rwayeyongyera amaani, omugabe baamuhigika omu kigaari kye naareebana n'Abasiria, okuhitsya omu mwabazyo; eizooba ku ryabaire nirirengarenga, yaafa.
en: And the battle increased that day: howbeit the king of Israel stayed himself up in his chariot against the Syrians until the even: and about the time of the sun going down he died.

rr: Bwanyima Yehoshafaati omugabe wa Yuda yaagaruka buhooro omu kikaari kye omuri Yerusaalemu.
en: And Jehoshaphat the king of Judah returned to his house in peace to Jerusalem.

rr: Ku yaabaire atakataahire, Yehu mwene Hanani omuhanuuzi yaaza kumubugana, yaamugira ati: Oshemereire kuha ababi emikono, n'okukunda abarikwanga MUKAMA? N'ahabw'ekyo ekiniga kya MUKAMA kyakwijaho.
en: And Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him, and said to king Jehoshaphat, Shouldest thou help the ungodly, and love them that hate the LORD ? therefore is wrath upon thee from before the LORD .

rr: Kwonka, n'obu kiraabe kiri kityo, omuriiwe harimu n'ebirungi, ahakuba okacwekyereza Ashera omu nsi, kandi omutima gwawe waaguta aha kusherura MUKAMA. Yehoshafaati okutaho abaramuzi, n'okubashobororera omurimo gwabo
en: Nevertheless there are good things found in thee, in that thou hast taken away the groves out of the land, and hast prepared thine heart to seek God.

rr: Bwanyima Yehoshafaati yaatuura Yerusaalemu; yaagaruka yaagyendagyenda omu bantu, okuruga Beeri-sheba okuhika omu nsi y'ebibungo eya Efuraimu, yaabagarura ahari MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa baishenkurubo.
en: And Jehoshaphat dwelt at Jerusalem: and he went out again through the people from Beer-sheba to mount Ephraim, and brought them back unto the LORD God of their fathers.

rr: Yaata abaramuzi omu nsi, omu ndembo zoona eza Yuda ezeehinguririziibwe engo z'amabaare, omuri buri rumwe
en: And he set judges in the land throughout all the fenced cities of Judah, city by city,

rr: yaagambira abaramuzi ati: Muteekateekye eki murikukora; ahakuba timurikuramurira bantu, kureka MUKAMA; kandi ari hamwe naimwe omu kucwa emanja.
en: and said to the judges, Take heed what ye do: for ye judge not for man, but for the LORD , who is with you in the judgment.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo mugume mutiine MUKAMA; kandi mwerinde omu bi murikukora; ahakuba MUKAMA Ruhanga waitu taita manja, tashoroora mu bantu, kandi tarya nguzi.
en: Wherefore now let the fear of the LORD be upon you; take heed and do it: for there is no iniquity with the LORD our God, nor respect of persons, nor taking of gifts.

rr: Kandi omuri Yerusaalemu Yehoshafaati yaataho Abaleevi bamwe n'abanyamurwa, n'abakuru b'emiryango ya Israeli, kuguma nibacwa emanja ahabwa MUKAMA, kandi n'okumarira abarikujurira emanja zaabo. Abo baramuzi bakaba batuura Yerusaalemu.
en: Moreover in Jerusalem did Jehoshaphat set of the Levites, and of the priests, and of the chief of the fathers of Israel, for the judgment of the LORD , and for controversies, when they returned to Jerusalem.

rr: Yaabeehanangiriza ati: Oku nikwo muritwaza omu kutiina MUKAMA, omu bwesigwa, mutaireho emitima yaanyu yoona.
en: And he charged them, saying, Thus shall ye do in the fear of the LORD , faithfully, and with a perfect heart.

rr: Kandi reeba, Amaria omunyamurwa omukuru niwe arikubategyeka omu bigambo byona ebya MUKAMA, na Zebedia mwene Ishimaeli omutegyeki w'enju ya Yuda, omu bigambo byona eby'omugabe; kandi Abaleevi baryaguma nibabaheereza nk'abakuru.
en: And, behold, Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of the LORD ; and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael, the ruler of the house of Judah, for all the king's matters: also the Levites shall be officers before you.

rr: Mukore n'obumanzi; kandi MUKAMA agume n'abarikukora eby'oburyo.
en: Deal courageously, and the LORD shall be with the good.

rr: Bwanyima y'ebyo Abamoabu, Abaamoni n'abamwe aha Bameuni bakaija kurwanisa Yehoshafaati.
en: It came to pass after this also, that the children of Moab, and the children of Ammon, and with them other beside the Ammonites, came against Jehoshaphat to battle.

rr: Haija abantu baagambira Yehoshafaati bati: Omutwe muhango gw'engabo guri omu muhanda niguruga Edomu, seeri y'enyanja, gwizire kukuteera; reeba, baahika Hazazoni-tamaari, niyo Enigeedi.
en: Then there came some that told Jehoshaphat, saying, There cometh a great multitude against thee from beyond the sea on this side Syria; and, behold, they be in Hazazon-tamar, which is Engedi.

rr: Ahonaaho Yehoshafaati yaatiina, yaamariirira kusherura MUKAMA, kandi yaaragiira Abayuda boona kwesiibyakwo.
en: And Jehoshaphat feared, and set himself to seek the LORD , and proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah.

rr: Abayuda baayeteerana kusherura obuhwezi ahari MUKAMA; baaruga omu ndembo z'omuri Yuda zoona kuza kusherura MUKAMA.
en: And Judah gathered themselves together, to ask help of the LORD : even out of all the cities of Judah they came to seek the LORD . Jehoshaphat's Prayer

rr: Yehoshafaati yaayemerera ahagati y'omutwe gw'Abayuda n'aba Yerusaalemu, abateeraniire omu nju ya MUKAMA omu maisho g'ekikaari kisya
en: And Jehoshaphat stood in the congregation of Judah and Jerusalem, in the house of the LORD , before the new court,

rr: yaagira ati: Ai MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa baatatenkuriitwe, tiiwe Ruhanga ow'omu iguru? Tiiwe orikutegyeka obugabe bwona obw'amahanga? Omu mukono gwawe harimu obushoboorozi n'amaani, tihariho orikubaasa kukuza omu kaso.
en: and said, O LORD God of our fathers, art not thou God in heaven? and rulest not thou over all the kingdoms of the heathen? and in thine hand is there not power and might, so that none is able to withstand thee?

rr: Ai Ruhanga waitu, torabingire abatuuzi b'omuri egi nsi omu maisho g'abantu baawe Israeli, okagiha baijukuru ba Abrahamu munywani waawe kuba eyaabo ebiro byona?
en: Art not thou our God, who didst drive out the inhabitants of this land before thy people Israel, and gavest it to the seed of Abraham thy friend for ever?

rr: Kandi kwo bakagituuramu, baayombekyeramu eiziina ryawe Omwanya ogurikwera, nibagira bati
en: And they dwelt therein, and have built thee a sanctuary therein for thy name, saying,

rr: 1 -30 ; . Akabi ku karituhikaho, rurara, okugira orubanja, orufu, nari enjara, turyayemerera omu maisho g'enju egi n'omu maisho gaawe, ahakuba eiziina ryawe rituura omuri egi nju, tukutakire omu kubonabona kwaitu; naiwe ohurire kandi ojune.
en: If, when evil cometh upon us, as the sword, judgment, or pestilence, or famine, we stand before this house, and in thy presence, (for thy name is in this house,) and cry unto thee in our affliction, then thou wilt hear and help.

rr: Mbwenu reeba, Abaamoni, Abamoabu n'ab'omu bibungo bya Seiri, abu waayangire Abaisraeli ku bateera ensi yaabo, obu baabaire nibaruga omu nsi ya Misri, kureka bakabaraba hangahari, batabacwekyererze
en: And now, behold, the children of Ammon and Moab and mount Seir, whom thou wouldest not let Israel invade, when they came out of the land of Egypt, but they turned from them, and destroyed them not;

rr: reeba oku barikutuzimuurira, nibaza kutubinga omu buhunguzi bwawe, obu waatuhaire kuhungura.
en: behold, I say, how they reward us, to come to cast us out of thy possession, which thou hast given us to inherit.

rr: Ai Ruhanga waitu, torikwija kubacwera orubanja, okabafubira? Ahakuba titwine maani g'okurwanisa eri ihe rihango eriizire kuturwanisa; kandi titurikumanya oku turaagire; kureka niiwe tuhangire amaisho.
en: O our God, wilt thou not judge them? for we have no might against this great company that cometh against us; neither know we what to do: but our eyes are upon thee.

rr: Omuri obwo bunaku abashaija ba Yuda boona bakaba beemereire omu maisho ga MUKAMA n'abeereere baabo n'abakzi baabo n'abaana baabo.
en: And all Judah stood before the LORD , with their little ones, their wives, and their children.

rr: Ahonaaho Omwoyo wa MUKAMA yaija ahari Yahazieli mwene Zekaria, mwijukuru wa Benaaya, ya Yayeli mwene Matania, Omuleevi ow'omuri beene Asafu, ahu yaabaire ari ahagati y'ogwo mutwe.
en: Then upon Jahaziel the son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, a Levite of the sons of Asaph, came the Spirit of the LORD in the midst of the congregation;

rr: Yaagira ati: Muhurire, imwe Abayuda, n'abatuuzi ba Yerusaalemu n'omugabe Yehoshafaati, oku nikwo MUKAMA arikubagambira naagira ati: Mutatiina ogu mutwe muhango gw'engabo, kandi mutahahaaza emitima; ahakuba orugamba ti rwanyu, n'orwa MUKAMA.
en: and he said, Hearken ye, all Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem, and thou king Jehoshaphat, Thus saith the LORD unto you, Be not afraid nor dismayed by reason of this great multitude; for the battle is not your's, but God's.

rr: Nyencakare mushuume, mubateere; nibaija kwinamukira ahu orikutembera nooza Ziizi; nimwija kubashanga aha muheru gw'oruhanga aha burugwa-izooba bw'eihamba rya Yerueli.
en: To morrow go ye down against them: behold, they come up by the cliff of Ziz; and ye shall find them at the end of the brook, before the wilderness of Jeruel.

rr: Omuri orwo rugamba timurikwija kwetenga kurwana; muze omu myanya yaanyu, mwemerere kwonka, mureebe oku MUKAMA araabasingurire, imwe Abayuda n'aba Yerusaalemu. Mutatiina, kandi mutahahaaza emitima; nyencakare muhurure mubateere; MUKAMA naija kuba hamwe naimwe.
en: Ye shall not need to fight in this battle: set yourselves, stand ye still , and see the salvation of the LORD with you, O Judah and Jerusalem: fear not, nor be dismayed; to morrow go out against them: for the LORD will be with you.

rr: Bwanyima Yehoshafaati yainika omutwe ahansi, yaaramya, n'Abayuda n'abatuuzi ba Yerusaalemu boona nabo baagwa omu maisho ga MUKAMA bajuumaire, nibamuramya.
en: And Jehoshaphat bowed his head with his face to the ground: and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell before the LORD , worshipping the LORD .

rr: Abaleevi ab'omuryango gwa Kohasi, n'ab'omu gwa Koora, baayemerera kuhimbisa MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli n'eiraka rihango munonga.
en: And the Levites, of the children of the Kohathites, and of the children of the Korhites, stood up to praise the LORD God of Israel with a loud voice on high.

rr: Omu kasheeshe munonga baimuka, baaza omu ihamba rya Tekoa; ku baabaire nibakigyenda, Yehoshafaati yaayemerera, yaagira ati: Mumpurire, imwe Abayuda n'abatuuzi ba Yerusaalemu, Mwesigye MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu, nibwo muraahamibwe; mwikirize baanabi be, nibwo muraabe gye.
en: And they rose early in the morning, and went forth into the wilderness of Tekoa: and as they went forth, Jehoshaphat stood and said, Hear me, O Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem; Believe in the LORD your God, so shall ye be established; believe his prophets, so shall ye prosper.

rr: Ku yaaherize kuhanuura n'abantu, yaataho ab'okweshongorera MUKAMA, n'okumuhimbisa bajwaire ebirikwera, kugyenda beebembeire eihe, nibagira bati: Musiime MUKAMA, Ahakuba embabazi ze n'ez'ebiro byona.
en: And when he had consulted with the people, he appointed singers unto the LORD , and that should praise the beauty of holiness, as they went out before the army, and to say, Praise the LORD ; for his mercy endureth for ever.

rr: Ku baatandikire kweshongora n'okuhimbisa, MUKAMA yaataho ab'okugwera Abaamoni, n'Abamoabu n'ab'omu bibungo bya Seiri abaizire kurwanisa Abayuda; baabarabanisamu.
en: And when they began to sing and to praise, the LORD set ambushments against the children of Ammon, Moab, and mount Seir, which were come against Judah; and they were smitten.

rr: Ahakuba Abaamoni n'Abamoabu bakagurukana abatuuzi b'omu bibungo bya Seiri, baabacwekyerereza kimwe; ku baaherize kucwekyereza aba Seiri, baayehindukiririzana, baatandika kwitana bonka, buri muntu yaita mugyenzi we.
en: For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of mount Seir, utterly to slay and destroy them: and when they had made an end of the inhabitants of Seir, every one helped to destroy another.

rr: Abayuda ku baahikire aha munaara gw'abarinzi omu ihamba, baanaga amaisho ei ogwo mutwe gw'engabo gwabaire guri, baashanga boona baabaire emitumbi barambiire ahansi, hataine ohonokireho.
en: And when Judah came toward the watch tower in the wilderness, they looked unto the multitude, and, behold, they were dead bodies fallen to the earth, and none escaped.

rr: Yehooshafaati n'abantu be ku baahikiireyo kubanyaga, baashangayo amatungo maingi munonga, ebintu, ebijwaro n'ebindi bintu eby'obuguzi bwingi, baabyetwarira okuhitsya obu byabaremeireho. Ahabw'okuba bingi munonga, baamara ebiro bishatu nibanyaga.
en: And when Jehoshaphat and his people came to take away the spoil of them, they found among them in abundance both riches with the dead bodies, and precious jewels, which they stripped off for themselves, more than they could carry away: and they were three days in gathering of the spoil, it was so much.

rr: Aha kiro kya kana baateeranira omu ruhanga rwa Beraaka, baasiimirayo MUKAMA; nikyo ogwo mwanya gurikweterwa Beraaka n'okuhitsya hati.
en: And on the fourth day they assembled themselves in the valley of Berachah; for there they blessed the LORD : therefore the name of the same place was called, The valley of Berachah, unto this day.

rr: Bwanyima buri muntu ow'omu Bayuda n'aba Yerusaalemu hamwe na Yehoshafaati abeebembeire baagaruka Yerusaalemu bashemereirwe, ahakuba MUKAMA akabaha okweraata aha bazigu baabo.
en: Then they returned, every man of Judah and Jerusalem, and Jehoshaphat in the forefront of them, to go again to Jerusalem with joy; for the LORD had made them to rejoice over their enemies.

rr: Baahika Yerusaalemu aha nju ya MUKAMA, baine enanga n'endingiri n'amakondere.
en: And they came to Jerusalem with psalteries and harps and trumpets unto the house of the LORD .

rr: Ab'omu bugabe bw'amahanga goona, ku baahuriire ngu MUKAMA arwaniise abazigu ba Israeli baashwekwa obwoba ahabw'okutiina Ruhanga.
en: And the fear of God was on all the kingdoms of those countries, when they had heard that the LORD fought against the enemies of Israel.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo obugabe bwa Yehoshafaati bwatuuza, ahakuba Ruhanga we akamuha obuhuumure embaju zoona.
en: So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet: for his God gave him rest round about.

rr: 1 Okwo nikwo Yehoshafaati yaategyekire Yuda. Akatandika kutegyeka aine emyaka makumi ashatu n'etaano; yaategyekyera Yerusaalemu emyaka makumi abiri n'etaano. Nyina akaba naayetwa Azuubu muhara wa Shiluhi.
en: And Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah: he was thirty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.

rr: Yaagyendera omu muhanda gwa Asa ishe, tiyaagira bu aguteishukire; kureka yaakora ebirikusiimwa MUKAMA.
en: And he walked in the way of Asa his father, and departed not from it, doing that which was right in the sight of the LORD .

rr: Kwonka emyanya mikuru ey'okuramizamu tiyaihwaho, ahakuba abantu bakaba batakataire mitima yaabo ahari Ruhanga wa baishenkurubo.
en: Howbeit the high places were not taken away: for as yet the people had not prepared their hearts unto the God of their fathers.

rr: Endiijo mirimo ya Yehoshafaati, okwiha aha kutandika okuhitsya aha muheru, ehandiikirwe omu kitabo kya Yeehu mwene Hanani eky'eby'omu busingye, ebyahandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'abagabe ba Israeli.
en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of Jehu the son of Hanani, who is mentioned in the book of the kings of Israel.

rr: Bwanyima y'ebyo Yehoshafaati omugabe wa Yuda yaayeteerana na Ahazia omugabe wa Israeli, owaabaire naakora kubi.
en: And after this did Jehoshaphat king of Judah join himself with Ahaziah king of Israel, who did very wickedly:

rr: Yaakwatanisa nawe kubaija emeeri z'okuza Tarushiishi, baazibaijera Ezioni-geberi.
en: and he joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish: and they made the ships in Ezion-geber.

rr: Bwanyima Eliezeeri mwene Dodavahu owa Mareesha, yaaragura ahari Yehoshafaati naagira ati: Ahabw'okweteerana na Ahazia, MUKAMA naija kucwekyereza eki obaizire.
en: Then Eliezer the son of Dodavah of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, Because thou hast joined thyself with Ahaziah, the LORD hath broken thy works.

rr: Ezo meeri zaahendagurika, tizaabaasa kuza Tarushiishi.
en: And the ships were broken, that they were not able to go to Tarshish.

rr: Yehoshafaati yaagwejegyera, yaashanga baishenkuru, yaazikwa hamwe nabo omu rurembo rwa Daudi; Yehoraamu omutabani yaategyeka omu mwanya gwe.
en: Now Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.

rr: Akaba aine abarumuna, abaana ba Yehoshafaati, Azaria, Yehieli, Zekaria, Azaria, Mikaeli na Shefatia; abo boona bakaba bari batabani ba Yehoshafaati omugabe wa Yuda.
en: And he had brethren the sons of Jehoshaphat, Azariah, and Jehiel, and Zechariah, and Azariah, and Michael, and Shephatiah: all these were the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel.

rr: Ishebo akabaha ebiconco bingi, by'efeeza, n'ezaabu n'ebintu by'obuguzi bwingi hamwe n'endembo omuri Yuda ezeehinguririziibwe engo z'amabaare; kwonka obugabe yaabuha Yehoraamu, ahabw'okuba omwana w'omujigaijo.
en: And their father gave them great gifts of silver, and of gold, and of precious things, with fenced cities in Judah: but the kingdom gave he to Jehoram; because he was the firstborn.

rr: Yehoraamu ku yaagiire aha kitebe ky'obugabe bwa ishe, yaahamibwa, yaita abarumuna boona na rurara, n'abandi banyiginya b'omuri Yuda.
en: Now when Jehoram was risen up to the kingdom of his father, he strengthened himself, and slew all his brethren with the sword, and divers also of the princes of Israel.

rr: 2 Yehoraamu akaba ahikize emyaka makumi ashatu n'ebiri, obu yaaza aha ngoma, yaategyekyera Yerusaalemu emyaka munaana.
en: Jehoram was thirty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

rr: 1 -30 ; 16:31-33 ; Yaagyendera omu mihanda y'abagabe ba Israeli, nk'ab'enju ya Ahabu ashweire muhara wa Ahabu. Yaakora ebirikwangwa MUKAMA.
en: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, like as did the house of Ahab: for he had the daughter of Ahab to wife: and he wrought that which was evil in the eyes of the LORD .

rr: N'obu biraabe byabaire biri bityo, MUKAMA akanga kucwekyerereza kimwe enju ya Daudi, ahabw'endagaano ei yaaragaine na Daudi, n'ahabw'okumuraganisa we n'oruzaaro rwe, kubaha etabaaza ebiro byona.
en: Howbeit the LORD would not destroy the house of David, because of the covenant that he had made with David, and as he promised to give a light to him and to his sons for ever.

rr: Omu biro bye Abanyaedomu bakagoma, baaruga omu butegyeki bwa Yuda, baayeteeraho owaabo mugabe.
en: In his days the Edomites revolted from under the dominion of Judah, and made themselves a king.

rr: Bwanyima Yehoraamu yaayambuka n'abakuru b'engabo n'ebigaari bye byona; yaimuka nyekiro, yaateera Abanyaedomu, abaabaire bamwehinguririize n'abakuru b'ebigaari bye.
en: Then Jehoram went forth with his princes, and all his chariots with him: and he rose up by night, and smote the Edomites which compassed him in, and the captains of the chariots.

rr: Okwo nikwo Edomu yaagomire, ekaruga omu butegyeki bwa Yuda n'okuhitsya hati.
en: So the Edomites revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day.

rr: Omu bunaku obwo Libuna nayo yaamugomera, ahabw'okuba akaba atsigireho MUKAMA Ruhanga wa baishenkuru.
en: The same time also did Libnah revolt from under his hand; because he had forsaken the LORD God of his fathers.

rr: Kandi akata emyanya mikuru y'okuramizamu omu nsi y'ebibungo eya Yuda, yaareetera abatuuzi ba Yerusaalemu okuruga ahari MUKAMA, kandi yaahabisa n'Abayuda.
en: Moreover he made high places in the mountains of Judah, and caused the inhabitants of Jerusalem to commit fornication, and compelled Judah thereto .

rr: 2 -5 ; 17:3 . Bwanyima yaatunga ebaruha erikuruga ahari nabi Eliya, neegira eti: Oku nikwo MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Daudi shwenkuru arikugamba naagira ati: Ahabw'okuba togyendeire mu mihanda ya sho Yehoshafaati, n'obu yaakuba eya Asa omugabe wa Yuda
en: And there came a writing to him from Elijah the prophet, saying, Thus saith the LORD God of David thy father, Because thou hast not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat thy father, nor in the ways of Asa king of Judah,

rr: ogyendeire omu mihanda y'abagabe ba Israeli, waareetera Abayuda n'abatuuzi ba Yerusaalemu okuruga ahari Ruhanga, kandi waataho n'okwita barumuna baawe, ab'enju ya sho, abaabaire nibakuhita
en: but hast walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and hast made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to go a whoring, like to the whoredoms of the house of Ahab, and also hast slain thy brethren of thy father's house, which were better than thyself:

rr: reeba, MUKAMA naija kureeta ekibonaboneso kihango aha bantu baawe, aha baana baawe, aha bakazi baawe n'aha bintu byawe byona
en: behold, with a great plague will the LORD smite thy people, and thy children, and thy wives, and all thy goods:

rr: kandi naiwe wenka noija kurwara endwara mbi munonga omu mara, okuhitsya obu oraagume nooreeta omwoyo buri izooba.
en: and thou shalt have great sickness by disease of thy bowels, until thy bowels fall out by reason of the sickness day by day.

rr: Bwanyima MUKAMA yaareetera Abafilistia n'Abaharabu, abahereraine na Abaesiopia kugirira Yehoraamu ekiniga
en: Moreover the LORD stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines, and of the Arabians, that were near the Ethiopians:

rr: baija kurwanisa Yuda, baagiteera, baanyagayo ebintu byona ebi baashangire omu nju y'omugabe, kandi n'abatabani n'abakazi be, tiyaatsigaza mwana weena ow'omwojo kureka Yehoahazi omwana we wa bucuranda.
en: and they came up into Judah, and brake into it, and carried away all the substance that was found in the king's house, and his sons also, and his wives; so that there was never a son left him, save Jehoahaz, the youngest of his sons.

rr: Bwanyima y'ebyo byona, MUKAMA yaamurwaza endwara etarikukira omu mara.
en: And after all this the LORD smote him in his bowels with an incurable disease.

rr: Ebiro ku byahingwireho, aha muheru gw'emyaka ebiri, yaatandika kureeta omwoyo ahabw'egyo ndwara, yaafa aine obuhuruzi bwingi munonga.
en: And it came to pass, that in process of time, after the end of two years, his bowels fell out by reason of his sickness: so he died of sore diseases.

rr: Abantu be tibaacumika muriro gw'okumuhaisa ekitiinisa, nk'oku baagiriire baishenkuru.
en: And his people made no burning for him, like the burning of his fathers.

rr: Obu yaatandika kutegyeka, akaba aine emyaka makumi ashatu n'ebiri, yaategyekyera Yerusaalemu emyaka munaana, yaafa atakiine orikumwenda.
en: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years, and departed without being desired.

rr: Baamuziika omu rurembo rwa Daudi, kwonka ti mu bituuro by'abagabe.
en: Howbeit they buried him in the city of David, but not in the sepulchres of the kings.

2 Abatuuzi ba Yerusaalemu baagira Ahazia mutabani wa Yehoraamu omuto omugabe omu mwanya gwa ishe; ahabw'okuba omutwe gw'abashaija, abaizire omu rusiisira n'Abaharabu, bakaba baitsire abaana bakuru boona.
en: And the inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his stead: for the band of men that came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the eldest.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo Ahazia mwene Yehoraamu omugabe wa Yuda yaategyeka.
en: So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned.

rr: Ahazia akaba aine emyaka makumi ana n'ebiri, obu yaatandika kutegyeka, yaategyekyera Yerusaalemu omwaka gumwe.
en: Forty and two years old was Ahaziah when he began to reign, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem.

rr: Nyina akaba naayetwa Atalia mwijukuru wa Omuri.
en: His mother's name also was Athaliah the daughter of Omri.

rr: Ahazia nawe yaagyendera omu micwe y'ab'enju ya Ahabu, ahabw'okuba nyina niwe yaabaire amuha obwegye kukora kubi.
en: He also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab: for his mother was his counsellor to do wickedly.

rr: Yaakora ebirikwangwa MUKAMA, nk'oku ab'enju ya Ahabu baakozire; ahakuba ishe ku yaaherize kufa, baaguma nibamuha obwengye obwamucwekyereize.
en: Wherefore he did evil in the sight of the LORD like the house of Ahab: for they were his counsellors after the death of his father to his destruction.

rr: Kandi akakuratira obwengye bwabo, yaagyenda na Yoramu mwene Ahabu omugabe wa Israeli kurwanisa Hazaeli omugabe wa Siria ahari Ramosi-gileadi. Abasiria baahutaaza Yoramu
en: He walked also after their counsel, and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth-gilead: and the Syrians smote Joram.

rr: yagaruka Yezereeli kurwarirayo obuhuta, obu baamuhutaariize Raama, obu baarwana na Hazaeli omugabe wa Siria.
en: And he returned to be healed in Jezreel because of the wounds which were given him at Ramah, when he fought with Hazael king of Syria.

rr: Bwanyima Ahazia mwene Yehoraamu omugabe wa Yuda yaashuuma Yezereeli kureeba Yoramu mwene Ahabu, ahakuba akaba arwaire.
en: And Azariah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Jehoram the son of Ahab at Jezreel, because he was sick.

rr: Kwonka kikaba kiteekateekirwe Ruhanga, ngu okufa kwa Ahazia kubeho agiire kureeba Yoramu. Ahakuba ku yaahikireyo, yaagyenda na Yoramu kubugana Yehu mwene Nimushi, ou MUKAMA yaashukireho amajuta kucwekyereza enju ya Ahabu.
en: And the destruction of Ahaziah was of God by coming to Joram: for when he was come, he went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi, whom the LORD had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab.

rr: 2 -14 ; Ku yaabaire naaha ab'enju ya Ahabu ekifubiro, yaabugana abanyiginya ba Yuda na batabani ba barumuna ba Ahazia, abaabaire nibaheereza Amazia, yaabaita.
en: And it came to pass, that, when Jehu was executing judgment upon the house of Ahab, and found the princes of Judah, and the sons of the brethren of Ahaziah, that ministered to Ahaziah, he slew them.

rr: Bwanyima yaasherura Ahazia, baamukwata ayesherekire omuri Samaria, baamureetera Yehu, yaamwita.
en: And he sought Ahaziah: and they caught him, (for he was hid in Samaria,) and brought him to Jehu: and when they had slain him, they buried him: Because, said they, he is the son of Jehoshaphat, who sought the LORD with all his heart.

rr: Baamuziika, ahabw'okuba bakagira ngu ni mwijukuru wa Yehoshafaati, owaabaire naasherura MUKAMA n'omutima gwe gwona.
en: So the house of Ahaziah had no power to keep still the kingdom.

rr: Okuruga aho enju ya Ahazia yaabura omuntu orikubaasa kutwara engoma.
en: Athaliah

rr: 2 Atalia nyina wa Ahazia, ku yaareebire omutabani yaafa, yaimuka yaacwekyereza ab'oruganda rw'omugabe wa Yuda boona.
en: But when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal of the house of Judah.

rr: Kwonka Yehoshabeasi muhara w'omugabe yaatwara Yoasi mwene Ahazia, yaamwiba omuri batabani b'omugabe, abaabaire bari haihi kwitwa, we n'omurezi we yaabata omu kishengye ky'okuraaramu.
en: But Jehoshabeath, the daughter of the king, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among the king's sons that were slain, and put him and his nurse in a bedchamber.

rr: Atyo Yehoshabeasi, muhara w'omugabe Yehoraamu, kandi muka Yehoyaada omunyamurwa, ahabw'okuba munyaanya wa Ahazia, yaamushereka Atalia, tiyaamwita.
en: So Jehoshabeath, the daughter of king Jehoram, the wife of Jehoiada the priest, (for she was the sister of Ahaziah,) hid him from Athaliah, so that she slew him not.

rr: Yaamara nabo emyaka mukaaga, asherekirwe omu nju ya Ruhanga; obwo Atalia naategyeka ensi.
en: And he was with them hid in the house of God six years: and Athaliah reigned over the land.
