rr: 2 Kwonka omu mwaka gwa mushanju Yehoyaada akeegumya, yaaragaana endagaano n'abakuru b'engabo igana-igana, Azaria mwene Yerohaamu, Ishimaeli mwene Yehohanani, Azaria mwene Obedi, Maaseya mwene Adaaya na Elishafaati mwene Zikuri.
en: And in the seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds, Azariah the son of Jeroham, and Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, and Azariah the son of Obed, and Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri, into covenant with him.

rr: Baaraba omuri Yuda yoona, baateerana Abaleevi, nibabaiha omu ndembo zoona eza Yuda, n'abakuru b'amaju ga baishenkuru b'Abaisraeli, baija Yerusaalemu.
en: And they went about in Judah, and gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Judah, and the chief of the fathers of Israel, and they came to Jerusalem.

rr: Abateeraine boona baaragaana endagaano n'omugabe bari omu nju ya Ruhanga. Yehoyaada yaabagira ati: Omwana w'omugabe ngugu! K'ategyekye, nk'oku MUKAMA yaagambire ahari beene Daudi.
en: And all the congregation made a covenant with the king in the house of God. And he said unto them, Behold, the king's son shall reign, as the LORD hath said of the sons of David.

rr: Mbwenu oku nikwo muraatwaze. Omuriimwe abanyamurwa n'Abaleevi abarikwihwa aha murimo ahari sabato, ekicweka kimwe kya kashatu kibe eky'ab'okuridna amarembo
en: This is the thing that ye shall do; A third part of you entering on the sabbath, of the priests and of the Levites, shall be porters of the doors;

rr: kimwe kya kashatu kibe eky'aha nju y'omugabe, na kimwe kya kashatu ekindi kibe eky'aha irembo ry'omusingi; kandi abantu boona baze omu bikaari bye'nju ya MUKAMA.
en: and a third part shall be at the king's house; and a third part at the gate of the foundation: and all the people shall be in the courts of the house of the LORD .

rr: 1 Hatagira ondiijo weena owaataaha omu nju ya MUKAMA, kureka abanyamurwa n'Abaleevi abarikuheereza; bo bataahemu, ahabw'okuba n'abarikwera; kwonka abandi boona bategyereze okuragiira kwa MUKAMA.
en: But let none come into the house of the LORD , save the priests, and they that minister of the Levites; they shall go in, for they are holy: but all the people shall keep the watch of the LORD .

rr: Abaleevi beehinguririze omugabe, buri muntu aine eby'okurwanisa bye omu ngaro; kandi omuntu weena oraataahe omu nju aitwe. Mugume n'omugabe, yaaba naataahamu, nari naashohora.
en: And the Levites shall compass the king round about, every man with his weapons in his hand; and whosoever else cometh into the house, he shall be put to death: but be ye with the king when he cometh in, and when he goeth out.

rr: Abaleevi n'Abayuda boona baakora nk'ebi Yehoyaada omunyamurwa yaabaragiira byona. Buri omwe yaareeta abantu be ab'okwihwa aha murimo ahari sabato, n'ab'okwija aha murimo ahari sabato; ahabw'okuba Yehoyaada omunyamurwa tararagiire baabaire bari aha rubu kutaaha.
en: So the Levites and all Judah did according to all things that Jehoiada the priest had commanded, and took every man his men that were to come in on the sabbath, with them that were to go out on the sabbath: for Jehoiada the priest dismissed not the courses.

rr: Bwanyima Yehoyaada omunyamurwa yaaha abakuru b'engabo amacumu n'engabo mpango n'enkye, ezaabaire ziri ez'omugabe Daudi, nizibiikwa omu nju ya Ruhanga
en: Moreover Jehoiada the priest delivered to the captains of hundreds spears, and bucklers, and shields, that had been king David's, which were in the house of God.

rr: yaataho abantu boona kuba abarinzi b'omugabe, buri muntu aine eky'okurwanisa kye omu ngaro, okuruga aha rubaju rw'obukiizi-bwa-buryo bw'enju, okuhika aha rw'obwa bumosho, baayehinguririza eitambiro n'enju.
en: And he set all the people, every man having his weapon in his hand, from the right side of the temple to the left side of the temple, along by the altar and the temple, by the king round about.

rr: Bwanyima yaashohoza omwana w'omugabe, yaamujweka ekirunga, yaamuha Eby'okuhamya; baamuranga ku yaaba omugabe, Yehoyaada n'abatabani baamushukaho amajuta, baagira bati: Omugabe nakaramaare!
en: Then they brought out the king's son, and put upon him the crown, and gave him the testimony, and made him king. And Jehoiada and his sons anointed him, and said, God save the king.

rr: Atalia ku yaahuriire orwari rw'abantu nibairuka nibahimbisa omugabe, yaataaha omu nju ya MUKAMA ahu bantu bari
en: Now when Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king, she came to the people into the house of the LORD :

rr: ku yaanagire amaisho, yaareeba omugabe ayemereire aha rubaju rw'nyomyo ye aha irembo, n'abakuru b'engabo n'abakondere bamwemereire aha rubaju, n'abantu boona ab'omuri egyo nsi nibashemererwa nibateera amakondere, kandi n'abeeshongozi baine ebintu byabo by'okuteera nibeebembera abarikweshongora. Ahonaaho Atalia yaataagura ebijwaro bye, yaagira ati: Okwebumba! Okwebumba!
en: and she looked, and, behold, the king stood at his pillar at the entering in, and the princes and the trumpets by the king: and all the people of the land rejoiced, and sounded with trumpets, also the singers with instruments of musick, and such as taught to sing praise. Then Athaliah rent her clothes, and said, Treason, Treason.

rr: Yehoyaada omunyamurwa yaashohoza abakuru b'engabo abaatairweho kutegyeka eihe, yaabagira ati: Mumurabye omu ngabo, mumushohoze; oraamukurate weena, mumwite na rurara.
en: Then Jehoiada the priest brought out the captains of hundreds that were set over the host, and said unto them, Have her forth of the ranges: and whoso followeth her, let him be slain with the sword.

rr: Ahakuba omunyamurwa akaragiira ati: Mutamwitira omu nju ya MUKAMA.
en: For the priest said, Slay her not in the house of the LORD .

rr: Batyo baamutaho engaro, baamurabya omu irembo ry'embaraasi aha irembo ry'enju y'omugabe, baamwitirayo.
en: So they laid hands on her; and when she was come to the entering of the horse gate by the king's house, they slew her there.

rr: Bwanyima Yehoyaada yaaragaana endagaano n'abantu boona kandi n'omugabe kuba abantu ba MUKAMA.
en: And Jehoiada made a covenant between him, and between all the people, and between the king, that they should be the LORD 's people.

rr: Okuruga aho abantu boona baaza ahari nyaruju ya Baali, baagisheenya; amatambiro ge n'ebishushani bye baabisheenyagurira kimwe, baitira Mataani omunyamurwa wa Baali omu maisho g'ago matambiro.
en: Then all the people went to the house of Baal, and brake it down, and brake his altars and his images in pieces, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.

rr: -6 , 26-32 ; 25:1 , Bwanyima Yehoyaada yaataho abantu b'okurinda enju ya MUKAMA kuguma nibareebererwa abanyamurwa Abaleevi, n'abandi Baleevi, abu Daudi yaataireho kuguma nibareeberera enju ya MUKAMA, kuhongyera MUKAMA ebitambo by'okwotsya, nk'oku kihandiikirwe omu biragiro bya Musa, ngu babihongye nibashemererwa nibeeshongora, nk'oku Daudi yaaragiire.
en: Also Jehoiada appointed the offices of the house of the LORD by the hand of the priests the Levites, whom David had distributed in the house of the LORD , to offer the burnt offerings of the LORD , as it is written in the law of Moses, with rejoicing and with singing, as it was ordained by David.

rr: Abarinzi b'amarembo yaabata aha marembo g'enju ya MUKAMA, ngu omuntu weena otashemeire omu muringo gwona arekye kutaahamu.
en: And he set the porters at the gates of the house of the LORD , that none which was unclean in any thing should enter in.

rr: Bwanyima yaatwara abakuru b'engabo, n'ab'ekitiinisa, n'abategyeki b'abantu, hamwe n'abantu boona ab'omuri egyo nsi, baashuumya omugabe nibamwiha omu irembo rya ruguru, baamutaasya omu nju y'omugabe, baamuta aha kitebe ky'obugabe.
en: And he took the captains of hundreds, and the nobles, and the governors of the people, and all the people of the land, and brought down the king from the house of the LORD : and they came through the high gate into the king's house, and set the king upon the throne of the kingdom.

rr: Batyo abantu boona ab'omuri egyo nsi baashemererwa; kandi bwanyima y'okwita Atalia na rurara, orurembo rwatuuza.
en: And all the people of the land rejoiced: and the city was quiet, after that they had slain Athaliah with the sword.

Joash was seven years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem.

rr: Yoasi akaba aine emyaka mushanju, obu yaatandika kutegyeka; yaategyekyera Yerusaalemu emyaka makumi ana; nyina akaba naayetwa Zibia owa Beeri-sheba.
en: His mother's name also was Zibiah of Beer-sheba.

rr: Omu biro byona ebya Yehoyaada omunyamurwa Yoasi akakora ebirikusiimwa MUKAMA.
en: And Joash did that which was right in the sight of the LORD all the days of Jehoiada the priest.

rr: Yehoyaada yaamushwererera abakazi babiri, yaazaara abaana b'aboojo n'ab'abaishiki.
en: And Jehoiada took for him two wives; and he begat sons and daughters.

rr: Bwanyima y'ekyo Yoasi yaamariirira kuhunduuza enju ya MUKAMA.
en: And it came to pass after this, that Joash was minded to repair the house of the LORD .

rr: Yaateerana abanyamurwa n'Abaleevi, yaabagira ati: Mwirooko muze omu ndembo za Yuda, muteerane omu Baisraeli boona empiiha z'okuhunduuza enju ya Ruhanga waanyu buri mwaka; kandi mukirahutsye.
en: And he gathered together the priests and the Levites, and said to them, Go out unto the cities of Judah, and gather of all Israel money to repair the house of your God from year to year, and see that ye hasten the matter.

rr: Kwonka Abaleevi tibaakirahutsya.
en: Howbeit the Levites hastened it not.

rr: Omugabe nikwo kweta Yehoyaada omukuru, akamugira ati: Ahabw'enki toragiire Baleevi kwiha omu Bayuda n'aba Yerusaalemu emitoijo, ei Musa omugaragwa wa MUKAMA yaaragiire eihanga ryona erya Israeli kuha, ngw ebi ey'Eihema ry'Eby'okuhamya?
en: And the king called for Jehoiada the chief, and said unto him, Why hast thou not required of the Levites to bring in out of Judah and out of Jerusalem the collection, according to the commandment of Moses the servant of the LORD , and of the congregation of Israel, for the tabernacle of witness?

rr: Ahakuba batabani ba Atalia, ogwo mukazi mubi, bakataaha omu nju ya Ruhanga, kandi ebintu byona eby'omu nju ya MUKAMA ebyashoroirwe, baabikoresa ahabwa Baabaali.
en: For the sons of Athaliah, that wicked woman, had broken up the house of God; and also all the dedicated things of the house of the LORD did they bestow upon Baalim.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo omugabe yaaragiira, baabaija eshanduukye, baagita aheeru y'eirembo ry'enju ya MUKAMA.
en: And at the king's commandment they made a chest, and set it without at the gate of the house of the LORD .

rr: Baaranga omuri Yuda n'omuri Yerusaalemu yoona, ku baareetera MUKAMA emitoijo ei Musa omugaragwa wa Ruhanga yaaragiire Abaisraeli bari omu ihamba.
en: And they made a proclamation through Judah and Jerusalem, to bring in to the LORD the collection that Moses the servant of God laid upon Israel in the wilderness.

rr: Abanyiginya boona n'abantu boona baashemererwa, baareeta emitoijo yaabo, baagita omuri egyo shanduukye okuhitsya obu baaherize.
en: And all the princes and all the people rejoiced, and brought in, and cast into the chest, until they had made an end.

rr: Abaleevi ku baabaire bareetera abatware b'omugabe egyo shanduukye, baareeba erimu empiiha nyingi, omuhandiiki w'omugabe n'omutware w'omunyamurwa mukuru baija, baihamu ebirimu byona, bagitwara, bagigarura omu mwanya gwayo.
en: Now it came to pass, that at what time the chest was brought unto the king's office by the hand of the Levites, and when they saw that there was much money, the king's scribe and the high priest's officer came and emptied the chest, and took it, and carried it to his place again.

rr: Okwo nikwo baabaire bakora buri izooba, bakateerana empiiha nyingi munonga.
en: Thus they did day by day, and gathered money in abundance.

rr: Omugabe na Yehoyaada baziha abarikureeberera omurimo gw'enju ya MUKAMA, bagurira abombeki n'ababaizi kuhunduuza egyo nju, hamwe n'abaheesi b'ebyoma n'ab'emiringa.
en: And the king and Jehoiada gave it to such as did the work of the service of the house of the LORD , and hired masons and carpenters to repair the house of the LORD , and also such as wrought iron and brass to mend the house of the LORD .

rr: Batyo abaakwatsiibwe omurimo baakora n'amaani, baaguhereza kimwe, enju ya Ruhanga baagihunduuza, baagigarura omu buteeka, baagihamya.
en: So the workmen wrought, and the work was perfected by them, and they set the house of God in his state, and strengthened it.

rr: Ku baagiherize, baareetera omugabe na Yehoyaada empiiha ezashaagireho, baazikoramu ebintu by'enju ya MUKAMA, eby'okuheerezesa, eby'ebitambo by'okwotsya, eshohaani z'obubaane, n'ebintu by'efeeza n'ezaabu.
en: And when they had finished it , they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada, whereof were made vessels for the house of the LORD , even vessels to minister, and to offer withal , and spoons, and vessels of gold and silver.

rr: Kandi omu biro bya Yehoyaada byona bakaguma nibatambira ebitambo by'okwotsya omu nju ya MUKAMA.
en: And they offered burnt offerings in the house of the LORD continually all the days of Jehoiada.

rr: Kwonka Yehoyaada yaakura, yaahika omu ngingo zaabukuru, yaafa; kandi akafa ahikize emyaka igana na makumi ashatu.
en: But Jehoiada waxed old, and was full of days when he died; an hundred and thirty years old was he when he died.

rr: Baamuziika omu bagabe omu rurembo rwa Daudi, ahabw'okuba akakora gye omuri Israeli ahari Ruhanga n'aha b'enju ye.
en: And they buried him in the city of David among the kings, because he had done good in Israel, both toward God, and toward his house.

rr: Yehoyaada ku yaaherize kufa, abanyiginya ba Yuda baija, baatangirira omugabe.
en: Now after the death of Jehoiada came the princes of Judah, and made obeisance to the king.

rr: Okuruga aho omugabe yaaguma naahurira ebi barikumugambira.
en: Then the king hearkened unto them.

rr: Baareka enju ya MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa baishenkurubo, baaheereza Ashera n'ebishushani ebirikuramibwa. Ahabw'eikyo kicumuro kyabo, ekiniga kya Ruhanga kyaija aha Bayuda n'aba Yerusaalemu.
en: And they left the house of the LORD God of their fathers, and served groves and idols: and wrath came upon Judah and Jerusalem for this their trespass.

rr: Hoona, n'obu kiraabe kyabaire kityo, akaguma naabatumaho baanabi kubagarura ahari MUKAMA; baanabi abo baaboomesereza, kwonka baayanga kuhurira.
en: Yet he sent prophets to them, to bring them again unto the LORD ; and they testified against them: but they would not give ear.

rr: Bwanyima Omwoyo wa Ruhanga yaija ahari Zekaria mwene Yehoyaada omunyamurwa, yaayemerera eruguru y'abantu, yaabagira ati: Ahabw'enki mugomeire ebiragiro bya MUKAMA, kikabareetera kutaba gye? Mutsigireho MUKAMA, nawe nikyo abatsigiireho.
en: And the Spirit of God came upon Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest, which stood above the people, and said unto them, Thus saith God, Why transgress ye the commandments of the LORD , that ye cannot prosper? because ye have forsaken the LORD , he hath also forsaken you.

rr: Kwonka baamugirira enaama, baamuteerera amabaare omu kikaari ky'enju ya MUKAMA ahabw'ekiragiro ky'omugabe.
en: And they conspired against him, and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of the house of the LORD .

rr: Okwo nikwo Yoasi omugabe yaayebirwe embabazi, ezi Yehoyaada, ishe wa Zekaria, yaamugiriire, akamwitira omwana.
en: Thus Joash the king remembered not the kindness which Jehoiada his father had done to him, but slew his son.

rr: Zekaria ku yaabaire naafa, yaagira ati: MUKAMA akireebe, kandi ahoore!
en: And when he died, he said, The LORD look upon it , and require it .

rr: Aha muheru gw'omwaka eihe ry'Abasiria ryaija kuteera Yoasi. Baahika omuri Yuda na Yerusaalemu, baacwekyereza abategyeki boona ab'abantu, baabamaramu, baatwekyera omugabe wa Damasiko ebi baanyagire byona.
en: And it came to pass at the end of the year, that the host of Syria came up against him: and they came to Judah and Jerusalem, and destroyed all the princes of the people from among the people, and sent all the spoil of them unto the king of Damascus.

rr: N'obu eihe ry'Abasiria ryaizire n'abantu bakye, MUKAMA akahayo omu mikono yaabo eihe rihango munonga, ahabw'okuba Abayuda abo bakatsigaho MUKAMA Ruhanga wa baishenkurubo.
en: For the army of the Syrians came with a small company of men, and the LORD delivered a very great host into their hand, because they had forsaken the LORD God of their fathers.

rr: Okwo nikwo Abasiria baahaire Yoasi ekifubiro.
en: So they executed judgment against Joash.

rr: Abasiria ku baamurugireho, baatsiga ahutaire munonga, abaheereza be baamugirira enaama nibahoorera eshagama ya mwene Yehoyaada omunyamurwa, baamwitira aha kitanda kye. Atyo yaafa, baamuziika omu rurembo rwa Daudi; kwonka tibaamuziika mu bituuro by'abagabe.
en: And when they were departed from him, (for they left him in great diseases,) his own servants conspired against him for the blood of the sons of Jehoiada the priest, and slew him on his bed, and he died: and they buried him in the city of David, but they buried him not in the sepulchres of the kings.

rr: Abaamugiriire enaama bakaba bari Zabadi mwene Shineasi Omuamonikazi, na Yehozabadi mwene Shimuriisi Omumoabukazi.
en: And these are they that conspired against him; Zabad the son of Shimeath an Ammonitess, and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith a Moabitess.

rr: Eby'abatabani, n'ebi baanabi baamuhanire, n'eby'okuhunduuza enju ya Ruhanga, bihandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'ebirikushoboorora eby'omu kitabo ky'abagabe.
en: Now concerning his sons, and the greatness of the burdens laid upon him, and the repairing of the house of God, behold, they are written in the story of the book of the kings.

rr: Amazia omutabani yaategyeka omu mwanya gwe.
en: And Amaziah his son reigned in his stead.

rr: 2 Amazia akaba aine emyaka makumi abiri n'etaano, obu yaatandika kutegyeka; yaategyekyera Yerusaalemu emyaka makumi abiri na mwenda.
en: Amaziah was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem.

rr: Nyina akaba naayetwa Yehoadaani, owa Yerusaalemu.
en: And his mother's name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.

rr: Yaakora ebirikusiimwa MUKAMA, kwonka ataine mutima guhikire.
en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD , but not with a perfect heart.

rr: Ku yaaherize kuhamibwa ati omu omu bugabe bwe, yaita abaheereza be abaitsire omugabe ishe
en: Now it came to pass, when the kingdom was established to him, that he slew his servants that had killed the king his father.

rr: kwonka tiyaita baana baabo, nk'oku kihandiikirwe omu kitabo kya Musa ey'ebiragiro, omu MUKAMA yaaragiriire ati: Baishe b'abaana batariitwa nibaturwa abaana baabo, kandi n'abaana batariitwa nibaturwa baishebo; kureka omuntu weena aryaitwa ahabw'ekibi kye.
en: But he slew not their children, but did as it is written in the law in the book of Moses, where the LORD commanded, saying, The fathers shall not die for the children, neither shall the children die for the fathers, but every man shall die for his own sin.

rr: Bwanyima Amazia yaateerana abashaija ba Yuda, yaabataho kutegyekwa abakuru b'engabo rukumi-rukumi n'aba igana-igana, nk'amaju ga baishenkurubo oku gaabaire gari, ahabwa Yuda na Benyamiini yoona. Yaateerana abahikize emyaka makumi abiri n'okukiraho, yaashanga bari obusiriira bushatu, abashaija entoore, abarikubaasa eby'engamba, bakamanya kurwanaisa amacumu n'engabo.
en: Moreover Amaziah gathered Judah together, and made them captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, according to the houses of their fathers, throughout all Judah and Benjamin: and he numbered them from twenty years old and above, and found them three hundred thousand choice men, able to go forth to war, that could handle spear and shield.

rr: Yaagaruka yaagurira abashaja b'amaani amamanzi aba Israeli akasiriira kamwe n'etalanta z'efeeza igana.
en: He hired also an hundred thousand mighty men of valour out of Israel for an hundred talents of silver.

rr: Kwonka omushaija wa Ruhanga yaija ah'ari, yaamugira ati: Nyakusinga omugabe, otaikiriza eihe rya Israeli kuhurura naiwe, ahabw'okuba MUKAMA tari hamwe na Israeli, Abaefuraimu aba boona.
en: But there came a man of God to him, saying, O king, let not the army of Israel go with thee; for the LORD is not with Israel, to wit, with all the children of Ephraim.

rr: Ku oraabe noogira ngu oine amaani g'okurwana, omanye ngu Ruhanga naija kukuteera ahansi omu maisho g'abazigu baawe; ahakuba Ruhanga aine obushoboorozi bw'okuhwera, nari obw'okutuura ahansi.
en: But if thou wilt go, do it , be strong for the battle: God shall make thee fall before the enemy: for God hath power to help, and to cast down.

rr: Amazia yaagira ogwo mushaija wa Ruhanga ati: Mbwenu shi tugire tuta ezo talanta igana, ezi mpaire eihe rya Israeli?
en: And Amaziah said to the man of God, But what shall we do for the hundred talents which I have given to the army of Israel?

rr: Omushaija wa Ruhanga yaamugarukamu ati: MUKAMA naabaasa kukuha nyingi munonga ezirikukira ezo.
en: And the man of God answered, The LORD is able to give thee much more than this.

rr: Bwanyima Amazia yaaragiira eihe, eryamwizireho niriruga Efuraimu, kugaruka omuka. Baagwerwa kubi munonga Abayuda, baagaruka omuka baine ekiniga kingi.
en: Then Amaziah separated them, to wit , the army that was come to him out of Ephraim, to go home again: wherefore their anger was greatly kindled against Judah, and they returned home in great anger.

rr: Kwonka Amazia we yaaguma, yaahuruza abantu be, baaza omu ruhita rw'omwonyo, baita omu bashaija ba Seiri abantu kakumi.
en: And Amaziah strengthened himself, and led forth his people, and went to the valley of salt, and smote of the children of Seir ten thousand.

rr: Kandi Abayuda baakwata abandi kakumi bahuriire, baabatwara aha mutwe gw'ekibaare kihango, baabatambika, baayetuura ahansi, baacwagacwagurika boona.
en: And other ten thousand left alive did the children of Judah carry away captive, and brought them unto the top of the rock, and cast them down from the top of the rock, that they all were broken in pieces.

rr: Kwonka abashaija b'eryo ihe, abu Amazia yaagarwireyo, akanga ku bahurura nawe, baateera endembo za Yuda okuruga Samaria okuhika Besi-horoni, baaziitamu abantu enkumi ishatu, baanyaga eminyago mingi.
en: But the soldiers of the army which Amaziah sent back, that they should not go with him to battle, fell upon the cities of Judah, from Samaria even unto Beth-horon, and smote three thousand of them, and took much spoil.

rr: Nikyo MUKAMA yaagwereirwe kubi Amazia, akamutumaho nabi, akamugira ati: Ahabw'enki oyehongyeire baaruhanga abatarabaasize kujuna abantu baabo omu mikono yaawe?
en: Wherefore the anger of the LORD was kindled against Amaziah, and he sent unto him a prophet, which said unto him, Why hast thou sought after the gods of the people, which could not deliver their own people out of thine hand?

rr: Ku yaabaire naakigamba, omugabe yaamugira ati: Beitu shi tukugizire omuhanuuzi w'omugabe? Hunama! Mbwenu oitirwe ki? Atyo nabi yaahunama; kwonka yaagira ati: Nimmanya ngu Ruhanga amaririire kukucwekyereza, ahabw'okukora eki, okanga kuhurira eki nkuhabwire.
en: And it came to pass, as he talked with him, that the king said unto him, Art thou made of the king's counsel? forbear; why shouldest thou be smitten? Then the prophet forbare, and said, I know that God hath determined to destroy thee, because thou hast done this, and hast not hearkened unto my counsel.

rr: 2 Bwanyima Amazia yaaza omu naama, yaatuma ahari Yehoashi mwene Yehoahazi, mwijukuru wa Yehu omugabe wa Israeli, naamugira ati: Rugayo, twereebanire akaso omu kandi.
en: Then Amaziah king of Judah took advice, and sent to Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, Come, let us see one another in the face.

rr: Yehoashi omugabe wa Israeli yaatuma ahari Amazia omugabe wa Yuda naagira ati: Eitojo rya Lebanooni rikatuma aha mwereezi gwa Lebanooni nirigira riti: Ha mutabani wangye muhara waawe, amushwere. Ku bwaseesire, enyamaishwa y'omu ihamba rya Lebanooni yaija neerabaho, yaariribata.
en: And Joash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, Give thy daughter to my son to wife: and there passed by a wild beast that was in Lebanon, and trode down the thistle.

rr: Ogizire oti: Reeba, nteire Abanyaedomu, naabasingura; omutima gwawe gwakureetera eishaija, waayehimbisa. Kwonka ogume omuka; ahabw'enki nootaara akabi, ngu ofe, na Yuda nayo efe.
en: Thou sayest, Lo, thou hast smitten the Edomites; and thine heart lifteth thee up to boast: abide now at home; why shouldest thou meddle to thine hurt, that thou shouldest fall, even thou, and Judah with thee?

rr: Kwonka Amazia yaayanga kuhurira, ahabw'okuba kikaba kirugire ahari MUKAMA, ngu abone kubahayo omu mikono y'abazigu baabo ahabw'okwehongyera baaruhanga ba Edomu.
en: But Amaziah would not hear; for it came of God, that he might deliver them into the hand of their enemies , because they sought after the gods of Edom.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo Yehoashi omugabe wa Israeli, yainamuka; we na Amazia omugabe wa Yuda baabugaabuganira Beti-shemeshi eya Yuda, baarwanirayo.
en: So Joash the king of Israel went up; and they saw one another in the face, both he and Amaziah king of Judah, at Beth-shemesh, which belongeth to Judah.

rr: Abayuda baabingwa Abaisraeli, buri muntu yaahungira omu ka ye.
en: And Judah was put to the worse before Israel, and they fled every man to his tent.

rr: Yehoashi omugabe wa Israeli yaakwata Amazia omugabe wa Yuda, mwene Yoasi, mwijukuru wa Ahazia; yaamukwatira Beti-shemeshi, bwanyima yaamureeta Yerusaalemu, yaasheenya orugo rwayo rw'amabaare ekicweka kya mikono magana ana okuruga aha irembo rya Efuraimu okuhika aha irembo ry'aha keekubo.
en: And Joash the king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, at Beth-shemesh, and brought him to Jerusalem, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.

rr: Kandi yaanyaga ezaabu n'efeeza zoona n'ebintu byona ebyashangirwe omu nju ya Ruhanga hawe na Obededomu; yaagaruka yaanyaga eby'omu mabiikiro g'eju y'omugabe, kandi yaabaihamu abantu, yaabagira omukwato; bwanyima yaagaruka Samaria.
en: And he took all the gold and the silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of God with Obed-edom, and the treasures of the king's house, the hostages also, and returned to Samaria.

rr: 2 Amazia mwene Yoasi omugabe wa Yuda akamara emyaka ikumi n'etaano bwanyima y'okufa kwa Yehoashi mwene Yehoahazi omugabe wa Israeli.
en: And Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel fifteen years.

rr: Mbwenu endiijo mirimo ya Amazia, okuruga aha kutandika okuhika aha muheru, tehandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'abagabe ba Yuda na Israeli?
en: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah, first and last, behold, are they not written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel?

rr: Okuruga omu bunaku obu yaarugiiremu ahari MUKAMA, bakamugirira enaama y'okumugomera omuri Yerusaalemu; yaahungira Lakishi; kwonak baamukuratsa abantu Lakishi, baamwitirayo.
en: Now after the time that Amaziah did turn away from following the LORD they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem; and he fled to Lachish: but they sent to Lachish after him, and slew him there.

rr: Baamureetera aha mbaraasi, baamuziika omu rurembo rwa Daudi hamwe na baishenkuru.
en: And they brought him upon horses, and buried him with his fathers in the city of Judah.

rr: Abayuda boona baatwara Uziya, owaabaire aine emyaka ikumi na mukaaga, baamwemeka omu mwanya gwa ishe.
en: Then all the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in the room of his father Amaziah.

rr: Yaayombeka Eloosi, yaagigarurira Abayuda, omugabe ishe aharize kugwejegyera kushanga baishenkuru.
en: He built Eloth, and restored it to Judah, after that the king slept with his fathers.

rr: Uziya akaba aine emyaka ikumi na mukaaga, obu yaatandiak kutegyeka, yaategyekyera Yerusaalemu emyaka makumi ataano n'ebiri.
en: Sixteen years old was Uzziah when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty and two years in Jerusalem.

rr: Nyina akaba naayetwa Yekolia owa Yerusaalemu.
en: His mother's name also was Jecoliah of Jerusalem.

rr: Yaakora ebirikusiimwa MUKAMA, nk'ebi Amazia ishe yaakozire byona.
en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD , according to all that his father Amaziah did.

rr: Omu biro bya Zekaria, owaabaire naamwegyesa okutiina Ruhanga, akamariirira kusherura Ruhanga; kandi omwanya gwona ogu yaamazire naasherura MUKAMA, Ruhanga akamuha omugisha.
en: And he sought God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the visions of God: and as long as he sought the LORD , God made him to prosper.

rr: Bwanyima yaahurura, yaaza kurwana n'Abafilistia, yaasheenya orugo rw'amabaare orwa Gaasi, orwa Yabune n'orwa Ashidoodi; yaayombeka endembo omu ishaza rya Ashidoodi n'aahandi omu nsi y'Abafilistia.
en: And he went forth and warred against the Philistines, and brake down the wall of Gath, and the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod, and built cities about Ashdod, and among the Philistines.

rr: Kandi Ruhanga yaamuhwera omu kurwanisa Abafilistia n'Abaharabu, abaabaire batwire Gurubaali, n'Abameuni.
en: And God helped him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians that dwelt in Gur-baal, and the Mehunims.

rr: Abaamoni baareetera Uziya emitoijo; kandi okurangaanwa kwe kwabuga, kwahika n'aha mwatano gwa Misri; ahakuba akaba ow'amaani munonga.
en: And the Ammonites gave gifts to Uzziah: and his name spread abroad even to the entering in of Egypt; for he strengthened himself exceedingly.

rr: Kandi Uziya yaayombeka eminaara omuri Yerusaalemu aha Irembo ry'aha keekubo, aha Irembo ry'oruhanga, n'aha Keekubo, yaagihamya.
en: Moreover Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the corner gate, and at the valley gate, and at the turning of the wall , and fortified them.

rr: Yaagaruka yaayombeka eminaara omu ihamba, yaatimba amaziba maingi, ahakuba akaba aine amasyo maingi omu mirambi n'omu mpita; kandi aine abahingi n'abasharizi b'emizaabibu omu bibungo n'omu byanga ebirikweza; ahabw'okuba akaba akunda munonga eby'okuhinga.
en: Also he built towers in the desert, and digged many wells: for he had much cattle, both in the low country, and in the plains: husbandmen also , and vine dressers in the mountains, and in Carmel: for he loved husbandry.

rr: Kandi Uziya akaba aine eihe ry'abaserukare, abahikire kuza aha rugamba, bari omu mitwe y'engabo, nk'oku omubaro gwabaire guri ogw'abaabazirwe Yeyeli omuhandiiki na Maaseya omutware, nibareebererwa Hanania, omwe aha bakuru b'engabo b'omugabe.
en: Moreover Uzziah had an host of fighting men, that went out to war by bands, according to the number of their account by the hand of Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the ruler, under the hand of Hananiah, one of the king's captains.

rr: Omubaro gwona ogw'abakuru b'amaju ga baishenkurubo, abashaija b'amaani amamanzi, gukaba guri enkumi ibiri na magana mukaaga.
en: The whole number of the chief of the fathers of the mighty men of valour were two thousand and six hundred.

rr: Bakaba nibategyeka eihe ry'abashaija obusiriira bushatu n'enkumi mushanju na magana ataano, abaabaire nibabaasa kurwanisa amaani maingi, bakahwera omugabe kumujuna abazigu.
en: And under their hand was an army, three hundred thousand and seven thousand and five hundred, that made war with mighty power, to help the king against the enemy.

rr: Kandi Uziya yaateekateekyera eihe ryona engabo, amacumu, enkofiira z'orugamba, ebizibaho by'ebyoma, amata n'amabaare g'enjungu.
en: And Uzziah prepared for them throughout all the host shields, and spears, and helmets, and habergeons, and bows, and slings to cast stones.

rr: Omuri Yerusaalemu yaakoreramu ebyoma, ebyagunzirwe abanyamyoga, eby'okuta aha minaara n'aha bwekubo bw'engo z'amabaare, okurasisa emyambi n'okurekyeza amabaare mahango.
en: And he made in Jerusalem engines, invented by cunning men, to be on the towers and upon the bulwarks, to shoot arrows and great stones withal.

rr: Okurangaanwa kwe kwabuga hoona; ahakuba akahwerwa okutakareebwaga, okuhitsya obu yaahamire.
en: And his name spread far abroad; for he was marvellously helped, till he was strong.

rr: Kwonka ku yaaherize kuhama, yaagira amaryo, gaamwita; ahakub aakacumura ahari MUKAMA Ruhanga we, yaataaha omuri hekalu ya MUKAMA kwoterera obubaane aha kyoterero kyabwo.
en: But when he was strong, his heart was lifted up to his destruction: for he transgressed against the LORD his God, and went into the temple of the LORD to burn incense upon the altar of incense.

rr: Kwonka Azaria omunyamurwa yaataahamu amukuratiire, n'abanyamurwa ba MUKAMA makumi munaana, abashaija amamanzi
en: And Azariah the priest went in after him, and with him fourscore priests of the LORD , that were valiant men:

rr: baamuzibira nibamugira bati: Ti murimo gwawe, Uziya, kwoterera MUKAMA obubaane, kureka n'ogw'abanyamurwa beene Aooni abashorooreirwe okwotera obubaane. Ruga omu Mwanya ogurikwera; ahakuba waacumura, kandi tikirikwija kukuhaisa kitiinisa ahari MUKAMA Ruhanga.
en: and they withstood Uzziah the king, and said unto him, It appertaineth not unto thee, Uzziah, to burn incense unto the LORD , but to the priests the sons of Aaron, that are consecrated to burn incense: go out of the sanctuary; for thou hast trespassed; neither shall it be for thine honour from the LORD God.

rr: Uziya yaagira ekiniga. Obwo akaba aine akooterero k'obubaane omu ngaro, naaza kubwotera; ku yaagiriire ati abanyamurwa ekiniga, ahonaaho ebibembe byamusheesha aha buso omu maisho g'abanyamurwa omu nju ya MUKAMA, ahu yaabaire ayemereire aha rubaju rw'ekyoterero ky'obubaane.
en: Then Uzziah was wroth, and had a censer in his hand to burn incense: and while he was wroth with the priests, the leprosy even rose up in his forehead before the priests in the house of the LORD , from beside the incense altar.

rr: Azaria omunyamurwa omukuru n'abandi banyamurwa baoona ku baagiire kumwetegyereza bati, baashanga aine ebibembe aha buso. Baamutsindika n'amaani kumushohoza, kandi nawe yairuka, yaashohora, ahabw'okuba MUKAMA akaba amuteire.
en: And Azariah the chief priest, and all the priests, looked upon him, and, behold, he was leprous in his forehead, and they thrust him out from thence; yea, himself hasted also to go out, because the LORD had smitten him.

rr: 1 Omugabe Uziya yaaguma ari omubembe okuhitsya aha izooba eri yaafeereireho; ahabw'okubemba yaaguma hangahari naaraara omu nganyo, ahabw'okuba akacuubwa omu nju ya MUKAMA. Bwanyima Yosamu omutabani yaaguma naareeberera ekikaari ky'omugabe, kandi naategyeka abantu b'omuri egyo nsi.
en: And Uzziah the king was a leper unto the day of his death, and dwelt in a several house, being a leper; for he was cut off from the house of the LORD : and Jotham his son was over the king's house, judging the people of the land.

rr: Endiijo mirimo ya Uziya, okuruga aha kutandika, okuhika aha muheru ekahandiikwa Isaaya nabi mwene Amozi.
en: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah, first and last, did Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, write.

rr: Uziya yaagwejegyera, yaashanga baishenkuru, baamuziika omu iziikiro eryabaire riri ery'abagabe; ahabw'okuba bakagira bati: N'omubembe. Yosamu omutabani yaategyeka omu mwanya gwe. Currently Selected: 2 Eby&x27;omu Busingye 26 : RR64 Highlight Share <path fill-rule="eve
en: So Uzziah slept with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in the field of the burial which belonged to the kings; for they said, He is a leper: and Jotham his son reigned in his stead. rr: 2 Yosamu akaba aine emyaka makumi abiri n'etaano, obu yaatandika kutegyeka; yaategyekyera Yerusaalemu emyaka ikumi na mukaaga.
en: Jotham was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem.

rr: Nyina akaba naayetwa Yerusha muhara wa Zadoki.
en: His mother's name also was Jerushah, the daughter of Zadok.

rr: Yaakora ebirikusiimwa MUKAMA, nk'ebi Uziya ishe yaakozire byona, okwihaho eky'okutaahisa amaani omuri hekalu ya MUKAMA.
en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD , according to all that his father Uzziah did: howbeit he entered not into the temple of the LORD .

rr: Kwonka abantu baagumizamu nibakora ebibi.
en: And the people did yet corruptly.

rr: Yaayombeka eirembo rya ruguru ery'enju ya MUKAMA, kandi yaayombeka ebyombeko bingi aha rugo rw'amabaare rwa Ofeli.
en: He built the high gate of the house of the LORD , and on the wall of Ophel he built much.

rr: Kandi yaayombeka endembo omu nsi y'ebibungo eya Yuda, hamwe n'ebigo n'eminaara aha bubungo bw'ebibira.
en: Moreover he built cities in the mountains of Judah, and in the forests he built castles and towers.

rr: Yaarwanisa abagabe b'Abaamoni, yaabasingura.
en: He fought also with the king of the Ammonites, and prevailed against them.

rr: Omu mwka ogwo Abaamoni baamutoijera etalanta z'efeeza igana, n'ebitenga by'engano kakumi, n'ebya sayiri kakumi.
en: And the children of Ammon gave him the same year an hundred talents of silver, and ten thousand measures of wheat, and ten thousand of barley.

rr: Kandi omu mwaka gwa kabiri n'ogwa kashatu Abaamoni baamutoijera batyo.
en: So much did the children of Ammon pay unto him, both the second year, and the third.

rr: Atyo Yosamu yaahinduka ow'amaani, ahabw'okushemeza emitwarize ye omu maisho ga MUKAMA Ruhanga we.
en: So Jotham became mighty, because he prepared his ways before the LORD his God.

rr: Endiijo miriyo ya Yosamu, n'engamba ze zoona, n'emitwarize ye, reeba bihandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'abagabe ba Israeli n'aba Yuda.
en: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars, and his ways, lo, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

rr: Akaba aine emyaka makumi abiri n'etaano, obu yaatandika kutegyeka, yaategyekyera Yerusaalemu emyaka ikumi na mukaaga.
en: He was five and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem.

rr: Yosamu yaagwejegyera, yaashanga baishenkuru, yaaziikwa omu rurembo rwa Daudi. Ahazi omutabani yaategyeka omu mwanya gwe. Currently Selected: 2 Eby&x27;omu Busingye 27 : RR64 Highlight Share <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8 19c-2.828 0-4.243 0-5.121-.8

rr: 2 Ahazi akaba aine emyaka makumi abiri, obu yaatandika kutegyeka, yaategyekyera Yerusaalemu emyaka ikumi na mukaaga. Tiyaakora birikusiimwa MUKAMA nka Daudi ishenkuru
en: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem: but he did not that which was right in the sight of the LORD , like David his father:

rr: kureka yaakuratira emicwe y'abagabe ba Israeli. Kandi yaaheesha n'ebishushani ebirikuramibwa ahabwa Baabaali
en: for he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, and made also molten images for Baalim.

rr: yaaguma naayoterera obubaane omu ruhanga rwa mwene Hinoomu, yaarabya abaana be omu muriro, naakuratira emigyenzo erikunugwa ey'abanyamahanga, abu MUKAMA yaabingire omu maisho g'Abaisraeli.
en: Moreover he burnt incense in the valley of the son of Hinnom, and burnt his children in the fire, after the abominations of the heathen whom the LORD had cast out before the children of Israel.

rr: Yaaguma naatambira omu myanya mikuru y'okuramizamu, aha bibungo, n'ahansi ya buri kiti ekyetwa omurinzi, kandi naayotererayo obubaane.
en: He sacrificed also and burnt incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

rr: Nikyo MUKAMA Ruhanga we yaamuheereireyo omu mikono y'omugabe wa Siria, ogwo mugabe akamusingura, akakwata abantu be baingi munonga, akabatwara Damasiko bari enkwatwa.
en: Wherefore the LORD his God delivered him into the hand of the king of Syria; and they smote him, and carried away a great multitude of them captives, and brought them to Damascus.

rr: Kandi yaaheebwayo omu mikono y'omugabe wa Israeli, yaita abantu be baingi munonga, yaamusingura.
en: And he was also delivered into the hand of the king of Israel, who smote him with a great slaughter.

rr: Ahakuba Peeka mwene Remalia omu izooba rimwe akaita omuri Yuda abashaija amamanzi akasiriira n'obukumi bubiri, ahabw'okuba bakatsigaho MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa baishenkurubo.
en: For Pekah the son of Remaliah slew in Judah an hundred and twenty thousand in one day, which were all valiant men; because they had forsaken the LORD God of their fathers.

rr: Na Zikuri, omushaija rugambwa owa Efuraimu yaita Maaseya mutabani w'omugabe, na Azurikaamu omukuru w'ekikaari ky'omugabe, na Elukaana enganzi y'omugabe.
en: And Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, slew Maaseiah the king's son, and Azrikam the governor of the house, and Elkanah that was next to the king.

rr: Abaisraeli baakwata omuri beene waabo abantu obusiriira bubiri, abakazi, abaana b'aboojo n'ab'abaishiki; kandi baabanyaga eminyago mingi, baagitwara Samaria.
en: And the children of Israel carried away captive of their brethren two hundred thousand, women, sons, and daughters, and took also away much spoil from them, and brought the spoil to Samaria.

rr: Kwonka okwo hakaba hariyo nabi wa MUKAMA owaabaire naayetwa Odedi; nabi ogwo yaashohora kubugana eihe eryabaire niritabaaruka, niriza Samaria; yaabagira ati: Nimumanya ku MUKAMA Ruhanga wa baashwenkuriimwe yaagwereirwe kubi Abayuda, akabahayo omu mikono yaanyu; kwonka imwe murengyesereize, mwabaita mwine ekiniga kingi ekihinguraine munonga.
en: But a prophet of the LORD was there, whose name was Oded: and he went out before the host that came to Samaria, and said unto them, Behold, because the LORD God of your fathers was wroth with Judah, he hath delivered them into your hand, and ye have slain them in a rage that reacheth up unto heaven.

rr: Mbwenu nimwenda kugira Abayuda n'aba Yerusaalemu abahuuku n'abazaanz. Imwe timwine ebibi byanyu, ebi mucumwire ahari MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu?
en: And now ye purpose to keep under the children of Judah and Jerusalem for bondmen and bondwomen unto you: but are there not with you, even with you, sins against the LORD your God?

rr: Mbwenu mumpurire, mugarureyo aba bantu, abu mukwatsire omuri beene waanyu, ei mubaihire, ahakuba MUKAMA abagiriire ekiniga kingi munonga.
en: Now hear me therefore, and deliver the captives again, which ye have taken captive of your brethren: for the fierce wrath of the LORD is upon you.

rr: Kandi n'abakuru bamwe b'Abaefuraimu, Azaria, mwene Yohanani, Berekia mwene Meshilemoosi, Mehizikia mwene Shalumu na Amasa mwene Hadulai, baayemerera kukumiirira abaabaire nibaruga aha rugamba
en: Then certain of the heads of the children of Ephraim, Azariah the son of Johanan, Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth, and Jehizkiah the son of Shallum, and Amasa the son of Hadlai, stood up against them that came from the war,

rr: baabagira bati: Timurikwija kureeta aha nkwatwa, ahabw'okuba nimwenda kutureetera orubanja rw'okucumura ahari MUKAMA, kwongyera aha bibi n'orubanja ebi twine; haza orubanja oru twine ruri ruhango, kandi ahari Israeli hariho ekiniga kingi.
en: and said unto them, Ye shall not bring in the captives hither: for whereas we have offended against the LORD already , ye intend to add more to our sins and to our trespass: for our trespass is great, and there is fierce wrath against Israel.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo abo bashaija abaabaire baine eby'okurwanisa baatsiga enkwatwa n'eminyago omu maisho g'abakuru n'omutwe gwona ogw'abateeraine.
en: So the armed men left the captives and the spoil before the princes and all the congregation.

rr: Abo bakuru, abu amaziina gaabo gaagambwaho, baimuka, baayakiira enkwatwa, boona abaabire bajwaire busha omuribo baabajweka eby'omu minyago; batyo baabajweka, baabaha enkaito, baabaha eby'okurya n'eby'okunywa, baabasiiga amajuta, boona abaabaire bataine maani omuribo baabaheeka aha ndogoya, baabahitsya omuri beene waabo ahari Yeriko, orurembo rw'emikindo. Bwanyima baagaruka Samaria.
en: And the men which were expressed by name rose up, and took the captives, and with the spoil clothed all that were naked among them, and arrayed them, and shod them, and gave them to eat and to drink, and anointed them, and carried all the feeble of them upon asses, and brought them to Jericho, the city of palm trees, to their brethren: then they returned to Samaria.

rr: Omu bunaku obwo omugabe Ahazi akatuma aha mugabe wa Asiria kumuha emikono
en: At that time did king Ahaz send unto the kings of Assyria to help him.

rr: ahabw'okuba Abanyaedomu bakaba batabaire Yuda, bagisingwire, bakwatsireyo enkwatwa.
en: For again the Edomites had come and smitten Judah, and carried away captives.

rr: Kandi n'Abafilistia bakaba bateire endembo z'omu mirambi n'omuri Negebu eya Yuda, bakwatsire Beti-shemeshi, Ayalooni, Gederoosi, Sooko n'ebirorero byayo, Timuna n'ebirorero byayo, na Gimuzo n'ebirorero byayo; bwanyima baazituuramu.
en: The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the low country, and of the south of Judah, and had taken Beth-shemesh, and Ajalon, and Gederoth, and Shocho with the villages thereof, and Timnah with the villages thereof, Gimzo also and the villages thereof: and they dwelt there.

rr: Ahakuba MUKAMA akabaagarwire Abayuda ahansi, naabatura Ahazi omugabe wa Israeli, ahabw'okuba akakorera omuri Yuda ebitahikire, yaacumura munonga ahari MUKAMA.
en: For the LORD brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel; for he made Judah naked, and transgressed sore against the LORD .

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo Tigulaasi-peleseeri omugabe wa Asiria yaija yaamuteera, yaamubonabonesa omu mwanya gw'okumugumya.
en: And Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria came unto him, and distressed him, but strengthened him not.

rr: Ahakuba Ahazi akaiha ebintu omu nju ya MUKAMA n'omu y'omugabe n'omu maju g'abanyiginya, yaabitoijera omugabe wa Asiria; kwonka tibyagira ki baymugasira.
en: For Ahaz took away a portion out of the house of the LORD , and out of the house of the king, and of the princes, and gave it unto the king of Assyria: but he helped him not.

rr: Kandi omu biro by'obusaasi bwe akeeyongyera kucumura ahari MUKAMA, ogwo mugabe weena Ahazi
en: And in the time of his distress did he trespass yet more against the LORD : this is that king Ahaz.

rr: ahakuba akatambira baaruhanga ba Damasikio ebitambo, abaabaire bamusingwire, yaagira ati: Ahabw'okuba baaruhanga b'abagabe ba Siria bakabahwera, naanye niinyija kubatambira ebitambo, babone kumpwera.
en: For he sacrificed unto the gods of Damascus, which smote him: and he said, Because the gods of the kings of Syria help them, therefore will I sacrifice to them, that they may help me.

rr: Kwonka bakaba bari ab'okumucwekyereza hamwe na Israeli yoona.
en: But they were the ruin of him, and of all Israel.

rr: Ahazi yaateeranira hamwe ebintu by'omu nju ya Ruhanga, yaabitematemamu ebicweka, yaakinga enyigi z'enju ya MUKAMA, yaayeyombekyera amatambiro buri hantu omuri Yerusaalemu.
en: And Ahaz gathered together the vessels of the house of God, and cut in pieces the vessels of the house of God, and shut up the doors of the house of the LORD , and he made him altars in every corner of Jerusalem.

rr: Endiijo mirimo ye n'emitwarize ye yoona, okwiha aha kutandika okuhitsya aha muheru, reeba, bihandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'abagabe ba Yuda n'aba Israeli.
en: Now the rest of his acts and of all his ways, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

rr: Bwanyima Ahazi yaagwejegyera, yaashanga baishenkuru, yaaziikwa omu rurembo Yerusaalemu, ahabw'okuba tibaramuziikire mu bituuro by'abagabe ba Israeli. Hezekia omutabani yaategyeka omu mwanya gwe. Currently Selected: 2 Eby&x27;omu Busingye 28 : RR64 Highlight Share <pat
en: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city, even in Jerusalem: but they brought him not into the sepulchres of the kings of Israel: and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead. rr: 2 Hezekia akatandika kutegyeka aine emyaka makumi abiri n'etaano; yaategyekyera Yerusaalemu emyaka makumi abiri na mwenda.
en: Hezekiah began to reign when he was five and twenty years old, and he reigned nine and twenty years in Jerusalem.

rr: Nyina akaba naayetwa Abiya muhara wa Zekaria.
en: And his mother's name was Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.

rr: Akakora ebirikusiimwa MUKAMA, nk'ebi Daudi, ishe, yaakozire byona.
en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD , according to all that David his father had done.

rr: Omu mwaka gw'okubanza ogw'omu busingye bwe, omu kwezi kw'okubanza, akaigura enyigi z'enju ya MUKAMA, yaazihunduuza.
en: He in the first year of his reign, in the first month, opened the doors of the house of the LORD , and repaired them.

rr: Yaataasyamu abanyamurwa n'Abaleevi, yaabateeranira omu mwanya omuhango aha rubaju rw'oburugwa-izooba
en: And he brought in the priests and the Levites, and gathered them together into the east street,

rr: yaabagira ati: Imwe Baleevi 'mwe, nimupurire! Mweyeze hati, mweze n'enju ya MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa baashwekuriimwe, mwihe oburofa omu Mwanya ogurikwera.
en: and said unto them, Hear me, ye Levites, sanctify now yourselves, and sanctify the house of the LORD God of your fathers, and carry forth the filthiness out of the holy place .

rr: Ahakuba batatenkuriitwe bakacumura, baakora ebirikwangwa MUKAMA, Ruhanga waitu; baamutsigaho, baagaruka baiha amaisho aha Butaaho bwa MUKAMA, baamuteera amabega.
en: For our fathers have trespassed, and done that which was evil in the eyes of the LORD our God, and have forsaken him, and have turned away their faces from the habitation of the LORD , and turned their backs.

rr: Kandi baakinga enyigi z'ekisasi, baaraaza amatabaaza, kandi tibaayoterera Ruhanga wa Israeli bubaane, n'obu kwakuba okumutambira ebitambo by'okwotsya omu Mwanya ogurikwera.
en: Also they have shut up the doors of the porch, and put out the lamps, and have not burned incense nor offered burnt offerings in the holy place unto the God of Israel.

rr: Nikyo kyareeteire MUKAMA kugirira Abayuda n'aba Yerusaalemu ekiniga, akabahayo kuba eky'okutiinisa, n'eky'okutangarirwa, kandi n'eky'okweshaanya, nk'oku murikubireebesa amaisho gaanyu.
en: Wherefore the wrath of the LORD was upon Judah and Jerusalem, and he hath delivered them to trouble, to astonishment, and to hissing, as ye see with your eyes.

rr: Reeba, ebyo bikareetera baatatenkuriitwe kwitwa rurara, kandi batabani baitu na bahara baitu n'abakazi baitu baaba enkwtwa.
en: For, lo, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives are in captivity for this.

rr: Mbwenu ekindi aha mutima n'okuragaana endagaano na MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa Israeli, ngu ekiniga kye kingi kibone kuturugaho.
en: Now it is in mine heart to make a covenant with the LORD God of Israel, that his fierce wrath may turn away from us.

rr: Baana bangye, murekye kweganda, ahabw'okuba MUKAMA akabatoorana kwemerera omu maisho ge, okumuheereza, okuba abaheezera be, n'okumwoterera obubaane.
en: My sons, be not now negligent: for the LORD hath chosen you to stand before him, to serve him, and that ye should minister unto him, and burn incense.

rr: Bwanyima Abaleevi baimuka, Mahasi mwene Amasai, Yoeli mwene Azaria, ab'omuri beene Kohasi; ab'omuri beene Merari, Kiishi mwene Abudi, Azaria mwene Yehaleleeli; ab'omuri beene Gereshoni, Yoa mwene Zima, na Edeni mwene Yoa
en: Then the Levites arose, Mahath the son of Amasai, and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites: and of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi, and Azariah the son of Jehalelel: and of the Gershonites; Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah:

rr: ab'omuri beene Elizafaani, Shimuri na Yeueli; ab'omuri beene Asafu, Zekaria na Matania
en: and of the sons of Elizaphan; Shimri, and Jeiel: and of the sons of Asaph; Zechariah, and Mattaniah:

rr: ab'omuri beene Hemani, Yehueli na Shimei; n'ab'omuri beene Yedusuuni, Shemaaya na Uzieli.
en: and of the sons of Heman; Jehiel, and Shimei: and of the sons of Jeduthun; Shemaiah, and Uzziel.

rr: Baateerana beene waabo, baayeyeza, baataaha omu nju ya MUKAMA kugishemeza, nk'omugabe oku yaaragiire naakuratira ebigambo bya MUKAMA.
en: And they gathered their brethren, and sanctified themselves, and came, according to the commandment of the king, by the words of the LORD , to cleanse the house of the LORD . Cleansed the Temple

rr: Abanyamurwa baaza omu nju ya MUKAMA aha muheru kuhashemeza, baahsohoza oburofa bwona obu baashangire omuri hekalu ya MUKAMA, baabuhitsya omu kikaari ky'enju ya MUKAMA; bwanyima Abaleevi baabutwara, baabuhitsya aha kagyera Kidirooni.
en: And the priests went into the inner part of the house of the LORD , to cleanse it , and brought out all the uncleanness that they found in the temple of the LORD into the court of the house of the LORD . And the Levites took it , to carry it out abroad into the brook Kidron.

rr: Baatandika kugyeeza aha kiro ky'okubanza ky'okwezi kw'okubanza, aha kiro kya munaana ky'okwo kwezi baahika aha kisasi kya MUKAMA; bwanyima baamara ebiro munaana nibeeza enju ya MUKAMA, baagiheza aha kiro kya ikumi na mukaaga ky'okwo kwezi.
en: Now they began on the first day of the first month to sanctify, and on the eighth day of the month came they to the porch of the LORD : so they sanctified the house of the LORD in eight days; and in the sixteenth day of the first month they made an end.

rr: Bwanyima baataaha ow'omugabe Hezekia, baamugira bati: Twaheza kushemeza enju ya MUKAMA yoona, n'eitambiro ry'ebitambo by'okwotsya n'ebintu byaryo byona, n'emeeza y'emigaati y'okumurikwa n'ebintu byayo byona.
en: Then they went in to Hezekiah the king, and said, We have cleansed all the house of the LORD , and the altar of burnt offering, with all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread table, with all the vessels thereof.

rr: Kandi n'ebintu byona, ebi omugabe Ahazi yaanagire omu kucumura kwe ari aha ngoma, twabishemeza, twabyeza. Mbwenu biri omu maisho g'eitambiro rya MUKAMA. Hezekia okugaruraho emigyenzo y'omuri hekalu
en: Moreover all the vessels, which king Ahaz in his reign did cast away in his transgression, have we prepared and sanctified, and, behold, they are before the altar of the LORD .

rr: Ku bwaseesire, omugabe Hezekia yaimuka kare, yaateerana abakuru b'orurembo, yainamuka omu nju ya MUKAMA.
en: Then Hezekiah the king rose early, and gathered the rulers of the city, and went up to the house of the LORD .

rr: Baareeta enimi mushanju, empaya z'entaama mushanju, abaana b'entaama mushanju, kandi n'empaya z'embuzi mushanju aha bugabe, n'aha Mwanya ogurikwera, kandi n'ahari Yuda.
en: And they brought seven bullocks, and seven rams, and seven lambs, and seven he goats, for a sin offering for the kingdom, and for the sanctuary, and for Judah.

rr: Yaaragiira abanyamurwa beene Arooni kubitambira aha itambiro rya MUKAMA.
en: And he commanded the priests the sons of Aaron to offer them on the altar of the LORD .

rr: Batyo ezo nimi baaziita, abanyamurwa baatangiriza eshagama yaazo, baagishukyeera eitambiro; baita empaya z'entaama, eshagama yaazo baagishukyera eitambiro; baita n'abaana b'entaama, n'eshagama yaabo baagishukyera eitambiro
en: So they killed the bullocks, and the priests received the blood, and sprinkled it on the altar: likewise, when they had killed the rams, they sprinkled the blood upon the altar: they killed also the lambs, and they sprinkled the blood upon the altar.

rr: bwanyima ezo mpaya z'embuzi ez'okuba empongano y'ekibi zaareetwa omu maisho g'omugabe n'omu maisho g'omutwe gwona oguteeraine, baazitaho engaro zaabo
en: And they brought forth the he goats for the sin offering before the king and the congregation; and they laid their hands upon them:

rr: abanyamurwa baaziita, baatambira eshagama yaazo aha itambiro kuba empongano y'ekibi, okurihiirira Abaisraeli boona; ahakuba omugabe akaragiira ngu batambe ekitmbo ky'okwotsya n'empongano y'ekibi ahabwa Israeli yoona.
en: and the priests killed them, and they made reconciliation with their blood upon the altar, to make an atonement for all Israel: for the king commanded that the burnt offering and the sin offering should be made for all Israel.

rr: Kandi yaata Abaleevi omu nju ya MUKAMA, baine ebitaasa n'enanga n'endingiri, nk'oku kyaragiirwe Daudi na Gaadi omuhanuuzi w'omugabe na Nasani nabi; ahabw'okuba ekiragiro kikaruga ahari MUKAMA, kyaraba omuri baanabi be.
en: And he set the Levites in the house of the LORD with cymbals, with psalteries, and with harps, according to the commandment of David, and of Gad the king's seer, and Nathan the prophet: for so was the commandment of the LORD by his prophets.

rr: Batyo Abaleevi baayemerera, baine ebintu bya Daudi eby'okweshongoza, n'abanyamurwa baine amakondere.
en: And the Levites stood with the instruments of David, and the priests with the trumpets.

rr: Bwanyima Hezekia yaaragiira kutambira ekitambo ky'okwotsya aha itambiro.
en: And Hezekiah commanded to offer the burnt offering upon the altar.

rr: Ekitambo ky'okwotsya ku kyatandikire kutambwa, ekyeshongoro ky'okweshongorera MUKAMA nakyo kyatandika, hamwe n'amakondere n'ebindi bintu by'okweshongoza bya Daudi omugabe wa Israeli.
en: And when the burnt offering began, the song of the LORD began also with the trumpets, and with the instruments ordained by David king of Israel.

rr: Omutwe gwona ogw'abantu gwaramya, abeeshongozi baayeshongora, n'abateezi b'amakondere baagateera; ebyo byona byagumizamu, okuhitsya obu ekitambo ky'okwotsya kyahweire.
en: And all the congregation worshipped, and the singers sang, and the trumpeters sounded: and all this continued until the burnt offering was finished.

rr: Ekitambo ku kyaherize kutambwa, omugabe n'abaabaire bari hamwe nawe boona bainama, baaramya.
en: And when they had made an end of offering, the king and all that were present with him bowed themselves, and worshipped.

rr: Omugabe Hezekia n'abanyiginya baaragiira Abaleevi kweshongorera MUKAMA eby'okuhimbisa, ebi Daudi na Asafu omuhanuuzi baagunzire.
en: Moreover Hezekiah the king and the princes commanded the Levites to sing praise unto the LORD with the words of David, and of Asaph the seer.

rr: Baayeshongora eby'okuhimbisa bashemereirwe, bainama ahansi, baaramya.
en: And they sang praises with gladness, and they bowed their heads and worshipped.

rr: Bwanyima Hezekia yaagira ati: Mbwenu obu mwayohongyera MUKAMA, mwirire haihi, mureete ebitambo n'empongano z'okusiima omu nju ya MUKAMA.
en: Then Hezekiah answered and said, Now ye have consecrated yourselves unto the LORD , come near and bring sacrifices and thank offerings into the house of the LORD .

rr: Batyo abantu baareeta ebitambo n'empongano z'okusiima; kandi n'abaabaire baine emitima eyekundiire boona baareeta ebitambo by'okwotsya.
en: And the congregation brought in sacrifices and thank offerings; and as many as were of a free heart burnt offerings.

rr: Omubaro gw'ebitambo by'okwotsya ebi abantu baareetsire gukaba guri enimi makumi mushanju, empaya z'entaama igana, n'abaana b'entaama magana abiri; ebyo byona bikaba biri ebitambo by'okwokyeza MUKAMA.
en: And the number of the burnt offerings, which the congregation brought, was threescore and ten bullocks, an hundred rams, and two hundred lambs: all these were for a burnt offering to the LORD .

rr: Kandi empongano ezeeziibwe zikaba ziri enimi magana mukaaga n'entaama enkumi ishatu.
en: And the consecrated things were six hundred oxen and three thousand sheep.

rr: Kwonka abanyamurwa bakaba bakye, tibaabaasa kubaaga bitambo by'okwotsya byona; nikyo kyareeteire beene waabo Abaleeevi kubahwera, okuhitsya obu omurimo gwahweire, abandi banyamurwa batakeeyerize; ahabw'okuba Abaleevi bakba nibakiza abanyamurwa omutima gw'okwezirikira okweyeza.
en: But the priests were too few, so that they could not flay all the burnt offerings: wherefore their brethren the Levites did help them, till the work was ended, and until the other priests had sanctified themselves: for the Levites were more upright in heart to sanctify themselves than the priests.

rr: Okwongyera ahari ebyo bitambo by'okwotsya ebingi munonga, hakaba hariho n'ebishaju by'empongano z'okusiima ahabw'obusingye, n'ez'eby'okunywa ebirikuhongwa na buri kitambo kyona eky'okwotsya.
en: And also the burnt offerings were in abundance, with the fat of the peace offerings, and the drink offerings for every burnt offering.

rr: Okwo nikwo omurimo gw'obuheereza bw'omu nju ya MUKAMA gwagarwireho.
en: So the service of the house of the LORD was set in order.

rr: Hezekia n'abantu boona baashemerererwa ebi Ruhanga yaakoreire abantu; ahabw'okuba bikakorwa ahonaaho.
en: And Hezekiah rejoiced, and all the people, that God had prepared the people: for the thing was done suddenly.

Bwanyima Hezekia yaatuma aha Baisraeli n'aha Bayuda boona, kandi yaahandiikira Abaefuraimu n'Abamanaase ebaruha, kwija omu nju ya MUKAMA Yerusaalemu, kukorera MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli obugyenyi bw'Okuhingurwaho.
en: And Hezekiah sent to all Israel and Judah, and wrote letters also to Ephraim and Manasseh, that they should come to the house of the LORD at Jerusalem, to keep the passover unto the LORD God of Israel.

rr: Ahabw'okuba omugabe n'abanyiginya be, n'abantu boona abaateeraniire Yerusaalemu bakaba bahanwire kutaho obugyenyi bw'Okuhingurwaho omu kwezi kwa kabiri
en: For the king had taken counsel, and his princes, and all the congregation in Jerusalem, to keep the passover in the second month.

rr: ahabw'okuba tibarabaasize kubutaho mu bunaku bwabwo ahabw'omubaro gw'abanyamurwa abeeyerize kutahika, kandi n'ahabw'abantu kushangwa batateeraniire Yerusaalemu.
en: For they could not keep it at that time, because the priests had not sanctified themselves sufficiently, neither had the people gathered themselves together to Jerusalem.

rr: Egyo naama yaasiimwa omugabe n'abantu boona.
en: And the thing pleased the king and all the congregation.

rr: Batyo baataho ekirangiriro, baakirangirira omuri Israeli yoona, okutandikira Beeri-sheba okuhika Daani, ngu abantu baije Yerusaalemu, bakorere MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa Israeli, obugyenyi bw'Okuhingurwaho; ahabw'okuba bakaba batakibukora bari baingi munonga, nk'oku kyabaire kihandiikirwe.
en: So they established a decree to make proclamation throughout all Israel, from Beer-sheba even to Dan, that they should come to keep the passover unto the LORD God of Israel at Jerusalem: for they had not done it of a long time in such sort as it was written.

rr: Batyo baamatarisi baatwara ebaruha ezirikuruga aha mugabe n'abanyiginya be, baazibuzya Israeli na Yuda yoona, ezirikugamba ekiragiro ky'omugabe naagira ati: Imwe Baisraeli 'mwe, mugarukire MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Abrahamu, owa Isaaka kandi owa Israeli, nawe abone kubagarukira, imwe abatsigaireho, abaahonokire omu mikono y'omugabe wa Asiria.
en: So the posts went with the letters from the king and his princes throughout all Israel and Judah, and according to the commandment of the king, saying, Ye children of Israel, turn again unto the LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, and he will return to the remnant of you, that are escaped out of the hand of the kings of Assyria.

rr: Mutaba nka baashwenkuriimwe nari beene waanyu, abaabaire bacumura ahari MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa baishenkurubo, kikamureetera kubahayo, bakahwerekyerera, nk'oku murikureeba.
en: And be not ye like your fathers, and like your brethren, which trespassed against the LORD God of their fathers, who therefore gave them up to desolation, as ye see.

rr: 2 Yer 17 ; 23 ; . N'ahabw'ekyo mbwenu mutagira ebitsya bigangaire nka baashwenkuriimwe, kureka mwehongyere MUKAMA, mutaahe omu Mwanya gwe ogurikwera, ogu yaayerize kuba ogurikwera ebiro byona, muheereze MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu, ekiniga kye kingi kibone kubarugaho.
en: Now be ye not stiffnecked, as your fathers were, but yield yourselves unto the LORD , and enter into his sanctuary, which he hath sanctified for ever: and serve the LORD your God, that the fierceness of his wrath may turn away from you.

rr: Ahakuba ku muraagarukire MUKAMA, beene wanyu n'abaana baanyu nibaija kugirirwa embabazi abaabatwaire bari enkwatwa, bagarukye omu nsi egi. Ahabw'okuba MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu agira embabazi n'esaasi; kandi ku muraamugarukire, tarikwija kubaima maisho.
en: For if ye turn again unto the LORD , your brethren and your children shall find compassion before them that lead them captive, so that they shall come again into this land: for the LORD your God is gracious and merciful, and will not turn away his face from you, if ye return unto him.

rr: Batyo baamatarisi baaraba omu nsi ya Efuraimu n'eya Manaase, nibaruga omu rurembo nibaza omu rundi, baahika n'omu nsi ya Zebuluuni; abaayo baabashekyerera munonga, baabateerera enaku.
en: So the posts passed from city to city through the country of Ephraim and Manasseh, even unto Zebulun: but they laughed them to scorn, and mocked them.

rr: Kwonka abamwe aha Baasheri n'Abamanaase n'Abazebuluuni baayoroba, baija Yerusaalemu.
en: Nevertheless divers of Asher and Manasseh and of Zebulun humbled themselves, and came to Jerusalem.

rr: Kandi n'omuri Yuda omukono gwa MUKAMA gwabaha kugira omutima gumwe, baayorobera ekiragiro ky'omugabe n'abanyiginya eki baaragiirwe ekigambo kya MUKAMA. Okwijuka Okuhingurwaho
en: Also in Judah the hand of God was to give them one heart to do the commandment of the king and of the princes, by the word of the LORD .

rr: Bwanyima abantu baingi baateeranira Yerusaalemu kwijuka obugyenyi bw'emigaati etatumbisiibwe omu kwezi kwa kabiri, bari omutwe muhango munonga.
en: And there assembled at Jerusalem much people to keep the feast of unleavened bread in the second month, a very great congregation.

rr: Baimuka, baiha Yerusaalemu amatambiro agaabaire gariyo, n'ebyoterero by'okwotereraho obubaane byona baabitwara, baabinaga omu kagyera Kidirooni.
en: And they arose and took away the altars that were in Jerusalem, and all the altars for incense took they away, and cast them into the brook Kidron.

rr: Batyo baita omwana gw'entaama gw'Okuhingurwaho aha kiro kya ikumi na bina omu kwezi kwa kabiri. Abanyamurwa n'Abaleevi baakwatwa enshoni, baayeyeza, baareeta ebitambo by'okwotsya omu nju ya MUKAMA.
en: Then they killed the passover on the fourteenth day of the second month: and the priests and the Levites were ashamed, and sanctified themselves, and brought in the burnt offerings into the house of the LORD .

rr: Baayemerera omu myanya yaabo nk'emigyenzo yaabo oku yaabaire eri, nibakuratira ekiragiro kya Musa omushaija wa Ruhanga; abanyamurwa baamiisha eshagama ei baahairwe Abaleevi.
en: And they stood in their place after their manner, according to the law of Moses the man of God: the priests sprinkled the blood, which they received of the hand of the Levites.

rr: Ahabw'okuba hakaba hariho baingi omu mutwe ogwo abaabaire bateeyerize; nikyo kyareeteire Abaleevi kwita omwana gw'entaama gw'Okuhingurwaho ahabwa buri muntu weena owaabaire atashemeire, okubeereza MUKAMA.
en: For there were many in the congregation that were not sanctified: therefore the Levites had the charge of the killing of the passovers for every one that was not clean, to sanctify them unto the LORD .

rr: Ahakuba abantu bainti munonga omu Baefuraimu, Abamanaase, Abaisakaari n'Abazebuluuni bakaba bateeyerize, baafa okurya omwana gw'entaama gw'Okuhingurwaho omu muringo ogutarikwikirizibwa biragiro.
en: For a multitude of the people, even many of Ephraim, and Manasseh, Issachar, and Zebulun, had not cleansed themselves, yet did they eat the passover otherwise than it was written. But Hezekiah prayed for them, saying, The good LORD pardon every one

rr: Ahabw'okuba Hezekia akaba abashabiire naagira ati: MUKAMA omurungi asaasire buri muntu, omaririire kusherura Ruhanga, MUKAMA Ruhanga wa baishenkuru, n'obu araabe ateeziibwe nk'emigyenzo y'Omwanya ogurikwera oku eri.
en: that prepareth his heart to seek God, the LORD God of his fathers, though he be not cleansed according to the purification of the sanctuary.

rr: MUKAMA yaahurira Hezekia, yaakiza abantu.
en: And the LORD hearkened to Hezekiah, and healed the people.

rr: Bwanyima Abaisraeli abo abaabaire bari Yerusaalemu baamara ebiro mushanju nibaijuka obugyenyi bw'emigaati etatumbisiibwe n'okushemererwa kwingi munonga; kandi Abaleevi n'abanyamurwa baaguma nibahimbisa MUKAMA buri izooba, nibamweshongorera n'amaani gaabo goona.
en: And the children of Israel that were present at Jerusalem kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with great gladness: and the Levites and the priests praised the LORD day by day, singing with loud instruments unto the LORD .

rr: Kandi Hezekia yaagamba ebigambo by'okwezirikisa Abaleevi boona abayorekire obwengye omu murimo gw'okuheereza MUKAMA. Batyo abantu baarya eby'okurya by'obugyenyi okumara ebiro mushanju, nibahonga empongano z'okusiima ahabw'obusingye, nibasiima MUKAMA Ruhanga wa baishenkurubo.
en: And Hezekiah spake comfortably unto all the Levites that taught the good knowledge of the LORD : and they did eat throughout the feast seven days, offering peace offerings, and making confession to the LORD God of their fathers.

rr: Bwanyima omutwe gwona gwasiima kweyongyera ebindi biro mushanju omu bugyenyi; batyo baamara ebyo biro nibashemererwa.
en: And the whole assembly took counsel to keep other seven days: and they kept other seven days with gladness.

rr: Ahabw'okuba Hezekia omugabe wa Yuda akaha omutwe gw'abantu enimi rukumi n'entaama enkumi mushanju kuba ebitambo; abanyiginya nabo baaha ogwo mutwe enimi rukumi n'entaama kakumi; n'abanyamurwa baingi baayeyeza.
en: For Hezekiah king of Judah did give to the congregation a thousand bullocks and seven thousand sheep; and the princes gave to the congregation a thousand bullocks and ten thousand sheep: and a great number of priests sanctified themselves.

rr: Omutwe gwona ogw'Abayuda n'abanyamurwa n'Abaleevi, n'omutwe gwona ogwarugire omuri Israeli n'abashuhuuki abaarugire omu nsi ya Israeli n'abashuhuuki abaabaire batwire omuri Yuda, baashemererwa.
en: And all the congregation of Judah, with the priests and the Levites, and all the congregation that came out of Israel, and the strangers that came out of the land of Israel, and that dwelt in Judah, rejoiced.

rr: 2 N'ahabw'ekyo haabaho okushemererwa kwingi munonga omuri Yerusaalemu, ahabw'okuba okwiha obu obusingye bwa Sulemaani mwene Daudi omugabe wa Israeli bwarugaho hakaba hatakabahoga bugyenyi nk'obwo omuri Yerusaalemu.
en: So there was great joy in Jerusalem: for since the time of Solomon the son of David king of Israel there was not the like in Jerusalem.

rr: -27 ; . Bwanyima abanyamurwa n'Abaleevi baimuka, baashabira abantu omugisha; eiraka ryabo ryahurirwa, kandi okushaba kwabo kwahika omu mwanya gwe ogurikwera ogu atuuramu omu iguru. Currently Selected: 2 Eby&x27;omu Busingye 30 : RR64 Highlight Share <svg width="24" h

rr: Ebyo byona ku byahweire, Abaisraeli boona abaabaire bari aho baaza omu ndembo za Yuda, baashenyagura enyomyo, baatemagura Ashera, baasheenya ebyombeko by'omu myanya mikuru y'okuramizamu n'amatambiro omuri Yuda yoona, omuri Benyamiini, Efuraimu na Manaase, okuhitsya obu baabicwekyereize byona.
en: Now when all this was finished, all Israel that were present went out to the cities of Judah, and brake the images in pieces, and cut down the groves, and threw down the high places and the altars out of all Judah and Benjamin, in Ephraim also and Manasseh, until they had utterly destroyed them all.

rr: Batyo Abaisraeli boona baagaruka omu ndembo zaabo, buri muntu omu butaka bwe.
en: Then all the children of Israel returned, every man to his possession, into their own cities.

rr: Bwanyima Hezekia yaabaganisa abanyamurwa n'Abaleevi omu bicweka, buri kicweka nk'omurimo gwakyo gw'okuheereza oku gwabaire guri, abanyamurwa n'Abaleevi okuguma nibatamba ebitambo by'okwotsya, okuhonga empongano z'okusiima ahabw'obusingye, okuheereza, okusiima n'okuhimbisiza omu marembo g'orusiisira rwa MUKAMA.
en: And Hezekiah appointed the courses of the priests and the Levites after their courses, every man according to his service, the priests and Levites for burnt offerings and for peace offerings, to minister, and to give thanks, and to praise in the gates of the tents of the LORD .

rr: 2 —29:40. Kandi omugabo ogu omugabe yaihire omu bintu bye kuguma naaha gukaba guri ogw'ebitambo by'okwotsya,–ebitambo by'okwotsya omu kasheeshe n'omu mwabazyo, ebya sabato, eby'okuboneka kw'ameezi n'eby'amagyenyi agaatairweho, nk'oku bihandiikirwe omu biragiro bya MUKAMA.
en: He appointed also the king's portion of his substance for the burnt offerings, to wit , for the morning and evening burnt offerings, and the burnt offerings for the sabbaths, and for the new moons, and for the set feasts, as it is written in the law of the LORD .

rr: Yaagaruka yaaragiira abantu abaabaire batwire Yerusaalemu kuguma nibaha abanyamurwa n'Abaleevi emigabo ebashemereire, ngu nabo babone kwehayo omu biragiro bya MUKAMA.
en: Moreover he commanded the people that dwelt in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and the Levites, that they might be encouraged in the law of the LORD . Encouraged the People

rr: Ekiragiro ekyo ku kyaherize kiti kubuga, Abaisraeli baareeta emiganuro mingi munonga, engano, viinyo, amajuta, obwoki n'ebindi byona ebyarugire omu misiri; kandi baareeta ana kimwe kya ikumi ekya buri kintu, byaba bingi munonga.
en: And as soon as the commandment came abroad, the children of Israel brought in abundance the firstfruits of corn, wine, and oil, and honey, and of all the increase of the field; and the tithe of all things brought they in abundantly.

rr: Abaisraeli n'Abayuda abaabaire batwire omu ndembo za Yuda nabo baareeta kimwe kya ikumi eky'ente n'entaama, n'ebintu ebyeziibwe, ebyabaire bishorooreirwe MUKAMA Ruhanga waabo, ebintu ebyo baabituuma emituumo.
en: And concerning the children of Israel and Judah, that dwelt in the cities of Judah, they also brought in the tithe of oxen and sheep, and the tithe of holy things which were consecrated unto the LORD their God, and laid them by heaps.

rr: Omu kwezi kwa kashatu nibwo baatandika kutuuma egyo mituumo, bakaheza omu kwezi kwa mushanju.
en: In the third month they began to lay the foundation of the heaps, and finished them in the seventh month.

rr: Hezekia n'abanyiginya ku baizire, baareeba egyo mituumo, baasiima MUKAMA n'abantu be Idraeli.
en: And when Hezekiah and the princes came and saw the heaps, they blessed the LORD , and his people Israel.

rr: Bwanyima Hezekia yaabuuza abanyamurwa n'Abaleevi eby'egyo mituumo.
en: Then Hezekiah questioned with the priests and the Levites concerning the heaps.

rr: Azaria omunyamurwa omukuru, ow'omu nju ya Zadoki, yaamugarukamu ati: Obu abantu baatandika kureeta emitoijo omu nju ya MUKAMA, tukatandika obwo kurya n'okuhaaga, n'okushaazya bingi; ahabw'okuba MUKAMA akaha abantu be omugisha, nikyo ebi ebyashaagire bibeereire bingi biti.
en: And Azariah the chief priest of the house of Zadok answered him, and said, Since the people began to bring the offerings into the house of the LORD , we have had enough to eat, and have left plenty: for the LORD hath blessed his people; and that which is left is this great store.

rr: Bwanyima Hezekia yaaragiira ku bateguura ebishenye by'enju ya MUKAMA; baabiteguura.
en: Then Hezekiah commanded to prepare chambers in the house of the LORD ; and they prepared them ,

rr: Baatamu emitoijo, ebicweka bya kimwe kya ikumi, n'ebintu ebyashoroirwe n'obwesigwa. Omukuru waabo owaabaire naabareeberera akaba ari Konania Omuleevi, owa kabiri ari Shimei omurumuna
en: and brought in the offerings and the tithes and the dedicated things faithfully: over which Cononiah the Levite was ruler, and Shimei his brother was the next.

rr: Yehieli, Azazia, Nahasi, Asaheeli, Yerimoosi, Yozabaadi, Elieli, Ismakia, Mahasi na Benaaya, nibo baabaire bari abareeberezi nibahwera Konania na Shimei omurumuna, nk'oku kyaragiirwe Hezekia omugabe na Azaria omukuru w'enju ya Ruhanga.
en: And Jehiel, and Azaziah, and Nahath, and Asahel, and Jerimoth, and Jozabad, and Eliel, and Ismachiah, and Mahath, and Benaiah, were overseers under the hand of Cononiah and Shimei his brother, at the commandment of Hezekiah the king, and Azariah the ruler of the house of God.

rr: Kandi Koore mwene Imuna Omuleevi, omurinzi w'eirembo ry'oburugwa-izooba niwe yaabaire naategyeka emitoijo etoijeirwe Ruhanga n'omutima gwekundiire, naabaganisa ebintu ebibiikiirwe MUKAMA ahabw'empongano ezrikwera munonga.
en: And Kore the son of Imnah the Levite, the porter toward the east, was over the freewill offerings of God, to distribute the oblations of the LORD , and the most holy things.

rr: Edeni, Minyamiini, Yeshua, Shemaaya, Amaria na Shekania bakaba bari abeesigwa nibamuhwera omu ndembo z'abanyamurwa, kubaganisiza beene waabo emigabo, abakuru n'abato nibabainganisa, nk'oku ebicweka byabo byabaire biri
en: And next him were Eden, and Miniamin, and Jeshua, and Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah, in the cities of the priests, in their set office, to give to their brethren by courses, as well to the great as to the small:

rr: otaireho abaabaire nibahandiikwa nk'oku oruzaaro rwabo rwabaire nirukuratana, abeetwa abashija okuru ga aha myaka eshatu n'okukiraho, boona abaabaire bataaha omu nju ya MUKAMA, nk'okwetenga kw'omurimo gwa buri izooba oku kwabaire kuri, ngu babone kukora omurimo gwabo, nk'oku embu zaabo zaabaire nizikuratana.
en: beside their genealogy of males, from three years old and upward, even unto every one that entereth into the house of the LORD , his daily portion for their service in their charges according to their courses;

rr: 1 Abanyamurwa bakahandiikwa, nk'oku amaju ga baishenkurubo gaabaire gari; n'Abaleevi abaabaire baine emyaka makumi abiri n'okukiraho baahandiikwa omu bicweka byabo, nk'oku omurimo gwabo gwabaire guri.
en: both to the genealogy of the priests by the house of their fathers, and the Levites from twenty years old and upward, in their charges by their courses;

rr: Abanyamurwa baahandiikwa n'abaana baabo abato boona n'abakazi baabo na batabani baabo na bahara baabo, okumarayo oruganda rwona; ahabw'okuba bakaba bari abeesigwa omu kwerinda kuguma bari abarikwera.
en: and to the genealogy of all their little ones, their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, through all the congregation: for in their set office they sanctified themselves in holiness:

rr: Kandi ahabw'abanyamurwa beene Arooni, abaabaire batwire omu byaro ebyehinguririize endembo zaabo, omuri buri rurembo hakaba harimu abantu abagambirweho amaziina kuba ab'okugaburira oyetwa omushaija weena omu banyamurwa, n'omuntu weena ow'omu Baleevi owaahandiikirwe.
en: also of the sons of Aaron the priests, which were in the fields of the suburbs of their cities, in every several city, the men that were expressed by name, to give portions to all the males among the priests, and to all that were reckoned by genealogies among the Levites.

rr: Okwo nikwo Hezekia yaabitwarize omuri Yuda yoona, akakora ebirikusiimwa MUKAMA n'eby'oburyo kandi n'eby'obwesigwa.
en: And thus did Hezekiah throughout all Judah, and wrought that which was good and right and truth before the LORD his God.

rr: Ebi yaakozire byona omu murimo gw'okuheereza omu nju ya Ruhanga, naakuratira ebiragiro n'ebyaragiirwe, omu kusherura Ruhanga we, akaba abikora n'omutima gwe gwona, kandi abigiriramu omugisha.
en: And in every work that he began in the service of the house of God, and in the law, and in the commandments, to seek his God, he did it with all his heart, and prospered.
