rr: 2 —19:37; —37:38. Hezekia ku yaaherize kukora ebyo n'okworeka obwesigwa bwe, Senakeribu omugabe wa Asiria yaija yaateera Yuda, yaateera orusiisira kurwanisa endembo ezeehinguririziibwe engo z'amabaare, naateekateeka ngu naija kuzeekubuurira zoona.
en: After these things, and the establishment thereof, Sennacherib king of Assyria came, and entered into Judah, and encamped against the fenced cities, and thought to win them for himself.

rr: Hezekia ku yaareebire Senakeribu yaija amaririire kuteera Yerusaalemu
en: And when Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib was come, and that he was purposed to fight against Jerusalem,

rr: yaahanuura n'abakuru b'engabo ze n'abashaija be ab'amaani kwita enshuro ezaabaire ziri enyima y'orurembo; baamuhwera.
en: he took counsel with his princes and his mighty men to stop the waters of the fountains which were without the city: and they did help him.

rr: Abantu baingi munonga baateerana, baita enshuro zoona, n'akagyera akaabaire nikaraba omuri egyo nsi, ahakuba bakagira bati: Ebyo nikwo kwona Abaasiria baije, bashangye egi amaizi maingi?
en: So there was gathered much people together, who stopped all the fountains, and the brook that ran through the midst of the land, saying, Why should the kings of Assyria come, and find much water?

rr: Yaayezirika kukora, yaayombeka busya orugo rw'amabaare orwakumbagaziibwe, yaarwombekaho eminaara, kandi enyima yaarwo yaayombekayo orundi rugo, yaahamya Miilo omu rurembo rwa Daudi. Kandi yaaheesesa eby'okurwanisa n'engabo bingi munonga.
en: Also he strengthened himself, and built up all the wall that was broken, and raised it up to the towers, and another wall without, and repaired Millo in the city of David, and made darts and shields in abundance.

rr: Yaataho abakuru b'engabo kutegyeka abantu, yaabateeranira ah'ari omu kubuga eky'aha irembo ry'orurembo, yaabagambira ebigambo by'okubagumya, naagira ati
en: And he set captains of war over the people, and gathered them together to him in the street of the gate of the city, and spake comfortably to them, saying,

rr: Mube ab'amaani, mugume; mutatiina, kandi mutahahaaza emitima ahabw'omugabe wa Asiria n'engabo ze nyingi ezi aine; ahabw'okuba ori hamwe naitwe naakira ori hamwe nabo.
en: Be strong and courageous, be not afraid nor dismayed for the king of Assyria, nor for all the multitude that is with him: for there be more with us than with him:

rr: Aha rubaju rwe aine emikono y'abantu-buntu, kwonka aha rubaju rwaitu twine MUKAMA Ruhanga waitu kutuhwera n'omkuturwanira engamba zaitu. Abantu baayesiga ebigambo bya Hezekia omugabe wa Yuda. Senakeribu okutiinisa aba Yerusaalemu
en: with him is an arm of flesh; but with us is the LORD our God to help us, and to fight our battles. And the people rested themselves upon the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.

rr: Bwanyima y'ebyo Senakeribu omugabe wa Asiria, owaabaire agotsire Lakishi n'engabo ze zoona, yaatuma abagaragwa be Yerusaalemu ahari Hezekia omugabe wa Yuda n'aha bantu ba Yuda boona abaabaire bari Yerusaalemu, naagira ati
en: After this did Sennacherib king of Assyria send his servants to Jerusalem, (but he himself laid siege against Lachish, and all his power with him,) unto Hezekiah king of Judah, and unto all Judah that were at Jerusalem, saying,

rr: Oku nikwo Senakeribu omugabe wa Asiria arikugamba naagira ati: Mbwenu mwesigire ki okutegyereza kugoterwa omuri Yerusaalemu?
en: Thus saith Sennacherib king of Assyria, Whereon do ye trust, that ye abide in the siege in Jerusalem?

rr: Hezekia, orikubagira ati: MUKAMA Ruhanga waitu naija kutujuna omu mikono y'omugabe wa Asiria, tarikubabeiha, ngu mwitwe enjara n'eiriho?
en: Doth not Hezekiah persuade you to give over yourselves to die by famine and by thirst, saying, The LORD our God shall deliver us out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

rr: Hezekia ogwo tiwe yaihireho emyanya ye mikuru ey'okuramizamu n'amatambiro, naaragiira Abayuda n'aba Yerusaalemu ati: Mushemereire kuguma nimuramiza omu masiho g'eitambiro rimwe ryonka, kandi n'okuritambiraho ebitambo byanyu?
en: Hath not the same Hezekiah taken away his high places and his altars, and commanded Judah and Jerusalem, saying, Ye shall worship before one altar, and burn incense upon it?

rr: Timurikumanya oku nyowe ana baatatenkuru twagizire abantu boona ab'omu gandi mahanga? Baaruhanga b'ago mahanga bakabaasa kujuna ensi zaabo omu mikono yangye?
en: Know ye not what I and my fathers have done unto all the people of other lands? were the gods of the nations of those lands any ways able to deliver their lands out of mine hand?

rr: N'oha omuri baaruhanga boona ab'ago mahanga agu baatatenkuru baacwekyerereize kimwe owaabasize kujuna abantu be omu mikono yangye, naimwe mukabona kwesiga ku Ruhanga waanyu arikwija kubakiza?
en: Who was there among all the gods of those nations that my fathers utterly destroyed, that could deliver his people out of mine hand, that your God should be able to deliver you out of mine hand?

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo murekye kwikiriza Hezekia kubabeihabeiha n'okubahabya atyo, kandi murekye kumwesiga, ahabw'okuba tihariho ruhanga ow'eihanga ryona nari obugabe bwona orabaasize kujuna abantu be omu mikono yangye nari eya baatatenkuru, reero kaashwa Ruhanga waanyu!
en: Now therefore let not Hezekiah deceive you, nor persuade you on this manner, neither yet believe him: for no god of any nation or kingdom was able to deliver his people out of mine hand, and out of the hand of my fathers: how much less shall your God deliver you out of mine hand?

rr: Bwanyima abagaragwa be baayeyongyereraho ebindi bigambo baajuma Mukama RUHANGA n'omwiru we Hezekia.
en: And his servants spake yet more against the LORD God, and against his servant Hezekiah.

rr: Kandi Senakeribu yaahandiika ebaruha z'okugayisa MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli n'okumujuma, naagira ati: Nk'oku baaruhanga b'amahanga g'omu nsi batarajunire bantu baabo mu mikono yangye, nikwo na Ruhanga wa Hezekia atarikwija kujuna abe.
en: He wrote also letters to rail on the LORD God of Israel, and to speak against him, saying, As the gods of the nations of other lands have not delivered their people out of mine hand, so shall not the God of Hezekiah deliver his people out of mine hand.

rr: Ebyo bigambo baabigambira aba Yerusaalemu abaabaire bari aha rugo rw'amabaare n'eiraka rihango omu rurimi rw'Abayudaaya, ngu babatiinise, babahahaaze emitima, babone kukwata orurembo.
en: Then they cried with a loud voice in the Jews' speech unto the people of Jerusalem that were on the wall, to affright them, and to trouble them; that they might take the city.

rr: Baagamba ahari Ruhanga wa Yerusaalemu, nk'oku bagamba ahari baaruhanga b'ensi abakozirwe emikono y'abantu. Hezekia okutakira Ruhanga
en: And they spake against the God of Jerusalem, as against the gods of the people of the earth, which were the work of the hands of man.

rr: Ekyo kyareetera Hezekia omugabe na Isaaya nabi mwene Amozi kushaba nibatakira eiguru.
en: And for this cause Hezekiah the king, and the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz, prayed and cried to heaven. Jerusalem Delivered

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo MUKAMA yaayohereza maraika, yaacwekyereza abarwani boona ab'amaani, n'abakuru b'amahe n'abakuru b'engabo abaabaire bari omu rusiisira rw'omugabe wa Asiria.
en: And the LORD sent an angel, which cut off all the mighty men of valour, and the leaders and captains in the camp of the king of Assyria.

rr: Atyo yaagaruka omu nsi ye aine enshoni.
en: So he returned with shame of face to his own land.

rr: Ku yaahikire omuri hekalu ya ruhanga we, abu yaayezaariire baamwitiramu na rurara.
en: And when he was come into the house of his god, they that came forth of his own bowels slew him there with the sword.

rr: Okwo nikwo MUKAMA yaajunire Hezekia n'abatuuzi ba Yerusaaklemu omu mikono ya Senakeribu omugabe wa Asiria, n'omu mikono y'abandi bazigu be boona; bwanyima akabaha okuhuumura embaju zoona.
en: Thus the LORD saved Hezekiah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib the king of Assyria, and from the hand of all other , and guided them on every side.

rr: Kandi abantu baingi baareetera MUKAMA emitoijo Yerusaalemu, na Hezekia omugabe wa Yuda baamutoijera ebintu by'obuguzi bwingi; okwiha obwo kyamureetera okurangaanwa omu mahanga goona. Okurwara kwa Hezekia
en: And many brought gifts unto the LORD to Jerusalem, and presents to Hezekiah king of Judah: so that he was magnified in the sight of all nations from thenceforth.

rr: 2 -11 ; Omu biro ebyo Hezekia akarwara, yaahika aha ncwamba za rufu, yaashaba MUKAMA, yaamugarukamu, kandi yaamuha akamanyiso.
en: In those days Hezekiah was sick to the death, and prayed unto the LORD : and he spake unto him, and he gave him a sign.

rr: Kwonka Hezekia tiyaakora nk'embabazi ezi yaagiriirwe oku zaabaire ziri; ahabw'okuba omutima gwe gukagira amaryo. Ekyarugiremu ekiniga kya MUKAMA kyamwijaho, we n'Abayuda na Yerusaalemu.
en: But Hezekiah rendered not again according to the benefit done unto him; for his heart was lifted up: therefore there was wrath upon him, and upon Judah and Jerusalem.

rr: Kwonka Hezekia yaayecureeza, yaayeteisa amaryo g'omu mutima gwe, we n'abatuuzi ba Yerusaalemu; na'ahabw'ekyo ekiniga kya MUKAMA tikyabaijaho omu busingye bwa Hezekia.
en: Notwithstanding Hezekiah humbled himself for the pride of his heart, both he and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so that the wrath of the LORD came not upon them in the days of Hezekiah.

rr: Kandi Hezekia akaba atungire munonga, aine ekitiinisa kingi; yaayekorera amabiikiro g'efeeza, ezaabu, amabaare g'obuguzi bwingi, emigaju, engabo n'ebintu by'obuguzi bwingi eby'emiringo yoona
en: And Hezekiah had exceeding much riches and honour: and he made himself treasuries for silver, and for gold, and for precious stones, and for spices, and for shields, and for all manner of pleasant jewels;

rr: yaayombeka n'ebitara by'okuhunikamu engano, n'amabiikiro ga viinyo n'amajuta, kandi n'emyanya y'okuraazamu amatungo g'emiringo yoona, n'amaka g'amasyo g'entaama.
en: storehouses also for the increase of corn, and wine, and oil; and stalls for all manner of beasts, and cotes for flocks.

rr: Kandi yaayetungira endembo, n'amasyo g'ente n'ag'entaama nyingi munonga; ahabw'okuba Ruhanga akamuha ebintu bingi munonga.
en: Moreover he provided him cities, and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance: for God had given him substance very much.

rr: Hezekia ogwo yaacungira ahu amizi ga Gihoni aga ruguru gaabaire nigareetwa, yaagahaburira, yaagatooza aha rubaju rw'orurembo rwa Daudi orw'oburegyerwa-izooba.
en: This same Hezekiah also stopped the upper watercourse of Gihon, and brought it straight down to the west side of the city of David.

rr: Hezekia yaagira omugisha omu bi yaabaire naakora byona.
en: And Hezekiah prospered in all his works.

rr: Kwonka omu bigambo by'entumwa z'abategyeki ba Babulooni, ezi baamutumireho kumubuuza eby'akamanyiso akaakozirwe omu nsi ye, Ruhanga akabimurekyera kumugyeza, ngu amanye ebiri omu mutima gwe byona.
en: Howbeit in the business of the ambassadors of the princes of Babylon, who sent unto him to enquire of the wonder that was done in the land, God left him, to try him, that he might know all that was in his heart.

rr: —39:8. Endiijo mirimo ya Hezekia n'ebirungi ebi yaakozire, reeba, bihandiikirwe omu bi nabi Isaaya mwene Amzi yaayorekirwe, n'omu kitabo ky'abagabe ba Yuda n'aba Israeli.
en: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and his goodness, behold, they are written in the vision of Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, and in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

rr: Bwanyima Hezekia yaagwejegyera, yaashanga baishenkuru, yaaziikwa aha rubaju rwa ruguru rw'ebituuro bya batabani ba Daudi; aha kufa kwe Abayuda boona n'abatuuzi ba Yerusaalemu baamuha ekitiinisa.
en: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the chiefest of the sepulchres of the sons of David: and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem did him honour at his death.

rr: Bwanyima omutabani Manaase yaategyeka omu mwanya gwe.
en: And Manasseh his son reigned in his stead.

rr: 2 Manaase akaba aine emyaka ikumi n'ebiri, obu yaatandika kutegyeka; yaategyekyera emyaka makumi ataano n'etaano Yerusaalemu.
en: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem:

rr: Yaakora ebirikwangwa MUKAMA, naakuratira emitwarize erikunugwa ey'amahanga agu MUKAMA yaabingire omu maisho g'Abaisraeli.
en: but did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD , like unto the abominations of the heathen, whom the LORD had cast out before the children of Israel.

rr: Ahabw'okuba akagaruka yaayombeka ebyombeko by'emyanya mikuru y'okuramizamu ebi Hezekia ishe yaasheenyire, yaayombekyera Baali amatambiro, yaakora Ashera, yaaguma naaramya eihe ry'omu iguru ryona, naariheereza.
en: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had broken down, and he reared up altars for Baalim, and made groves, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.

rr: Kandi yaakora n'amatambiro omu nju ya MUKAMA, ei MUKAMA yaagambireho ati: Omuri Yerusaalemu nimwo eiziina ryangye ririguma ebiro byona.
en: Also he built altars in the house of the LORD , whereof the LORD had said, In Jerusalem shall my name be for ever.

rr: Kandi yaayombekyera eihe ry'omu iguru ryona amatambiro omu bikaari byombi eby'enju ya MUKAMA.
en: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the LORD .

rr: Yaarabya abatabani omu muriro omu ruhanga rwa mwene Hinoomu; yaaguma naaraguza abafumu ebiribaho, naarogyesa, naakoresa abateezi b'ebyatsi, naayehanuuza aha barikugambisa emizimu n'aha barogi. Yaakora ebibi bingi omu maisho ga MUKAMA, yaamugwisa kubi.
en: And he caused his children to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom: also he observed times, and used enchantments, and used witchcraft, and dealt with a familiar spirit, and with wizards: he wrought much evil in the sight of the LORD , to provoke him to anger.

rr: Kandi yaata ekishushani ekirikuramibwa eki yaakozire omu nju ya Ruhanga, ei Ruhanga yaagambiire Daudi n'omutabani Sulemaani, naagira ati: omuri egi nju n'omuri Yerusaalemu, ei naatooraine omu nganda za Israeli zoona, nimweo ndita eiziina ryangye kugumamu ebiro byona
en: And he set a carved image, the idol which he had made, in the house of God, of which God had said to David and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen before all the tribes of Israel, will I put my name for ever:

rr: kandi Abaisraeli ku barita omutima aha kworobera ebi naabaragiire byona, n'ebiragiro ebyatairweho, n'emigyenzo yoona, ebyaragiirwe nibiraba omuri Musa, tindigaruka kwiha bigyere byabo omu nsi ei naateereireho baishenkurubo.
en: neither will I any more remove the foot of Israel from out of the land which I have appointed for your fathers; so that they will take heed to do all that I have commanded them, according to the whole law and the statutes and the ordinances by the hand of Moses.

rr: Atyo Manaase yaahabya Abayuda n'abatuuzi ba Yerusaalemu, kyabareetera kukora ebibi ebirikukira eby'amahanga agu MUKAMA yaacwekyerereize omu maisho g'Abaisraeli.
en: So Manasseh made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to err, and to do worse than the heathen, whom the LORD had destroyed before the children of Israel.

rr: Kandi MUKAMA yaagamba na Manaase n'abantu be, kwonka tibakyetaho.
en: And the LORD spake to Manasseh, and to his people: but they would not hearken.

rr: Nikyo MUKAMA yaabateereize abakuru by'eihe ry'omugabe wa Asiria, bakakwata Manaase, bakamubohesa enjegyere n'emihama y'emiringa, bakamutwra Babulooni.
en: Wherefore the LORD brought upon them the captains of the host of the king of Assyria, which took Manasseh among the thorns, and bound him with fetters, and carried him to Babylon.

rr: Ku yaabaire ari omu busaasi, yaashaba MUKAMA Ruhanga we kumugirira embabazi, yaayecureeza munonga omu maisho ga Ruhanga wa baishenkuru.
en: And when he was in affliction, he besought the LORD his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers,

rr: Atyo yaashaba Ruhanga, nawe yaikiriza okweshengyereza kwe, kandi yaahurira okushaba kwe, yaamugarura Yerusaalemu omu bugabe bwe.
en: and prayed unto him: and he was intreated of him, and heard his supplication, and brought him again to Jerusalem into his kingdom.

rr: Manaase yaamanyira aho MUKAMA ku niwe Ruhanga.
en: Then Manasseh knew that the LORD he was God.

rr: Bwanyima y'ebyo yaayombeka orugo rw'amabaare enyima y'orurembo rwa Daudi aha rubaju rwa Gihoni orw'oburengyerwa-izooba omu ruhanga, yaaruhitsya aha irembo ry'eby'enyanja, yaaruziguza Ofeli, yaarutunguura, rwahika ahaiguru munonga; kandi yaata abakuru b'amahe omu ndembo za Yuda zoona ezeehinguririziibwe engo z'amabaare.
en: Now after this he built a wall without the city of David, on the west side of Gihon, in the valley, even to the entering in at the fish gate, and compassed about Ophel, and raised it up a very great height, and put captains of war in all the fenced cities of Judah.

rr: Yaihaho baaruhanga b'abanyamahanga, n'ekishushani kiri ekirikuramibwa yaakiiha omu nju ya MUKAMA, n'amatambiro goona agu yaabaire ayombekire aha kabungo k'enju ya MUKAMA n'omuri Yerusaalemu, yaabinaga aheeru y'orurembo.
en: And he took away the strange gods, and the idol out of the house of the LORD , and all the altars that he had built in the mount of the house of the LORD , and in Jerusalem, and cast them out of the city.

rr: Kandi yaahunduuza eitambiro rya MUKAMA, yaaritambiraho ebitambo by'empongano z'okusiima ahabw'obusingye n'eby'okuhimbisa; kandi yaaragiira Abayuda boona kuheereza MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli.
en: And he repaired the altar of the LORD , and sacrificed thereon peace offerings and thank offerings, and commanded Judah to serve the LORD God of Israel.

rr: N'obu kiraabe kyabaire kityo, abantu baaguma nibatambira ebitambo omu myanya mikuru y'okuramizamu, kwonka nibabitambira MUKAMA Ruhanga waabo wenka.
en: Nevertheless the people did sacrifice still in the high places, yet unto the LORD their God only.

rr: Endiijo mirimo ya Manaase, n'okushaba oku yaashabire Ruhanga we, n'ebigambo ebi abahanuuzi baabaire bamugambira omu iziina rya MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli, reeba bihandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'ebyakozirwe abagabe ba Israeli.
en: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and his prayer unto his God, and the words of the seers that spake to him in the name of the LORD God of Israel, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel.

rr: Kandi n'okushaba kwe n'oku Ruhanga yaikiriize kuhurira okweshengyereza kwe, n'ekibi kye kyona, n'okucumura kwe, n'ahu yaayombekire ebyombeko omu myany amikuru y'okuramizamu, akatamu Ashera n'ebishushani ebirikuramibwa, obu yaabaire atakeeteisize, ebyo byona bihandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'ebyagambirwe abahanuuzi.
en: His prayer also, and how God was intreated of him, and all his sins, and his trespass, and the places wherein he built high places, and set up groves and graven images, before he was humbled: behold, they are written among the sayings of the seers.

rr: Bwanyima Manaase yaagwejegyera, yaashanga baishenkuru, yaaziikwa omu nju ye, Amoni omutabani yaategyeka omu mwanya gwe.
en: So Manasseh slept with his fathers, and they buried him in his own house: and Amon his son reigned in his stead. Amon

rr: 2 Amoni akaba aine emyaka makumi abiri n'ebiri, obu yaatandika kutegyeka; yaategyekyera Yerusaalemu emyaka ebiri.
en: Amon was two and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned two years in Jerusalem.

rr: Yaakora ebirikwangwa MUKAMA, nk'ebi Manaase ishe yaakozire. Yaatambira ebishushani byona ebi Manaase ishe yaakozire, yaabiheereza.
en: But he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD , as did Manasseh his father: for Amon sacrificed unto all the carved images which Manasseh his father had made, and served them;

rr: Kandi Amoni ogwo tiyaayecureeza mu maisho ga MUKAMA, nk'oku Manaase ishe yaagizire, kureka yaaguma naayeyongyera kushiisha.
en: and humbled not himself before the LORD , as Manasseh his father had humbled himself; but Amon trespassed more and more.

rr: Bwanyima abagaragwa be baamugirira enaama, baamwitira omu nju ye.
en: And his servants conspired against him, and slew him in his own house.

rr: Kwonka abantu b'omuri egyo nsi baita abaamugiriire enaama boona; baayemeka Yosia omutabani omu mwanya gwe.
en: But the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.

rr: Currently Selected: 2 Eby&x27;omu Busingye 33 : RR64 Highlight Share <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8 19c-2.828 0-4.243 0-5.121-.879C2 17.243
en: Currently Selected: 2 Chronicles 33 : KJV Highlight Share <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8 19c-2.828 0-4.

rr: Yosia akaba aine emyaka munaana obu yaatandika kutegyeka, yaategyekyera Yerusaalemu emyaka makumi ashatu na gumwe.
en: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem one and thirty years.

rr: Yaakora ebirikusiimwa MUKAMA, yaatwaza nka Daudi ishenkuru, tiyaateishuka kutoora aha rubaju rwa buryo nari orwa bumosho.
en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD , and walked in the ways of David his father, and declined neither to the right hand, nor to the left.

rr: Ahakuba omu mwaka gwe gwa munaana ari aha ngoma, akiri muto, akatandika kusherura Ruhanga wa Daudi ishenkuru; kandi omu mwaka gwe gwa ikumi n'ebiri yaatandika kushemeza Yuda na Yerusaalemu, yaamaramu emyanya mukuru y'okuramizamu, na Ashera, n'ebishushani ebibaizire n'ebiheesire.
en: For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet young, he began to seek after the God of David his father: and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places, and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images.

rr: Baasheenyera omu maisho ge amatambiro ga Baabaali, yaatema ebishushani by'eizooba ebyabaire biri ahaiguru yaago, byagwa ahansi; yaasheenyagura Ashera, n'ebishushani ebibaizire n'ebiheesire, yaabicwa esingo, egyo singo yaagishuka aha bituuro by'abaabaire babitambira.
en: And they brake down the altars of Baalim in his presence; and the images, that were on high above them, he cut down; and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images, he brake in pieces, and made dust of them , and strowed it upon the graves of them that had sacrificed unto them.

rr: Yaagaruka yaayokyeza amafuga g'abanyamurwa aha matambiro gaabyo; yaashemeza atyo Yuda na Yerusaalemu.
en: And he burnt the bones of the priests upon their altars, and cleansed Judah and Jerusalem.

rr: Kandi yaatwaza atyo n'omu ndembo za Manaase, Efuraimu na Simeoni ezaabaire zaabaire amatongo, nangwa n'okuhika Nafutaali
en: And so did he in the cities of Manasseh, and Ephraim, and Simeon, even unto Naphtali, with their mattocks round about.

rr: yaasheenya amatambiro, yaahondahonda Ashera, n'ebishushani yaabicwa esingo, yaatemagura ebishushani by'eizooba byona, ebyabaire biri omu nsi ya Israeli yoona, yaabinaga ahansi. Bwanyima yaagaruka Yerusaalemu.
en: And when he had broken down the altars and the groves, and had beaten the graven images into powder, and cut down all the idols throughout all the land of Israel, he returned to Jerusalem.

rr: 2 Omu mwaka gwe gwa ikumi na munaana, ku yaaherize kushemeza ensi na hekalu, yaayohereza Shafani mwene Azalia, Maaseya omukru w'orurembo na Yoa mwene Yoahazi omuhandiiki w'ebirikubaho, kuhunduuza enju ya MUKAMA Ruhanga we.
en: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign, when he had purged the land, and the house, he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, and Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder, to repair the house of the LORD his God.

rr: Baahika owa Hilukia omunyamurwa omukuru, baahayo empiiha ezaareetsirwe omu nju ya Ruhanga, ezi Abaleevi abakumiirizi baabaire bashoroize omu Bamanaase, Abaefuraimu, n'omu Baisraeli boona abaabaire batsigaireho, n'omu Bayuda n'Ababenyamiini boona, kandi n'omu batuuzi ba Yerusaalemu.
en: And when they came to Hilkiah the high priest, they delivered the money that was brought into the house of God, which the Levites that kept the doors had gathered of the hand of Manasseh and Ephraim, and of all the remnant of Israel, and of all Judah and Benjamin; and they returned to Jerusalem.

rr: Baaziha abakozi abarikureeberera enju ya MUKAMA; bwanyima abakozi abarikukora omu nju ya MUKAMA baatandika kuzikoresa kuhunduuza enju n'okugigira nsya.
en: And they put it in the hand of the workmen that had the oversight of the house of the LORD , and they gave it to the workmen that wrought in the house of the LORD , to repair and amend the house:

rr: Baaziha ababaizi n'abombeki kugura amabaare agabaizire, embaaho z'okuteerana, n'emitambiko y'ebyombeko ebi abagabe ba Yuda baarekire bikasiisikara.
en: even to the artificers and builders gave they it , to buy hewn stone, and timber for couplings, and to floor the houses which the kings of Judah had destroyed.

rr: Abo bashaija baakora omurimo n'obwesigwa. Abaabaire nibabareeberera bakaba bari Yahasi na Obadia Abaleevi ab'omuri beene Merari, na Zekaria na Meshulaamu ab'omuri beene Kohasi.
en: And the men did the work faithfully: and the overseers of them were Jahath and Obadiah, the Levites, of the sons of Merari; and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to set it forward; and other of the Levites, all that could skill of instruments of musick.

rr: Abandi Baleevi, abaabaire bari abanyabwengye omu kuteera ebirikugamba, baareeberera abeekorezi, kandi baaguma nibeezirikisa boona abaabaire nibakora emirimo y'emiringo yoona ey'okuheereza. Kandi abandi omu Baalevi bakaba bari abahandiiki, abatware n'abakumiirizi. Okuzoorwa kw'ekitabo ky'Ebiragiro
en: Also they were over the bearers of burdens, and were overseers of all that wrought the work in any manner of service: and of the Levites there were scribes, and officers, and porters. The Book of the Law Found

rr: Ku baabaire nibashohoza empiiha ezaaretsirwe omu nju ya MUKAMA, Hilukia omunyamurwa yaazoora ekitabo ky'Ebiragiro bya MUKAMA, ekyahandiikirwe Musa.
en: And when they brought out the money that was brought into the house of the LORD , Hilkiah the priest found a book of the law of the LORD given by Moses.

rr: Hilukia yaagambira Shafani omuhandiiki ati: Nzoire ekitambo ky'Ebiragiro omu nju ya MUKAMA.
en: And Hilkiah answered and said to Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD .

rr: Atyo yaakiha Shafani.
en: And Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan.

rr: Shafani yaakitwarira omugabe, kandi yaagambira omugabe eby'omurimo ati: Ebi abairu baawe bakwatsiibwe babikozire byona
en: And Shaphan carried the book to the king, and brought the king word back again, saying, All that was committed to thy servants, they do it .

rr: batwaire empiiha zoona ezibaire ziri omu nju ya MUKAMA, baaziha abarikureeberera omurimo n'abakozi.
en: And they have gathered together the money that was found in the house of the LORD , and have delivered it into the hand of the overseers, and to the hand of the workmen.

rr: Kandi Shafani omuhandiiki yaagaruka yaagambira omugabe ati: Hilukia omunyamurwa yampa ekitabo.
en: Then Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest hath given me a book.

rr: Atyo yaakishomera omugabe.
en: And Shaphan read it before the king.

rr: Omugabe ku yaahuriire ebigambo by'ebiragiro, yaataagura ebijwaro bye
en: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the law, that he rent his clothes.

rr: yaaragiira Hilukia, Ahikaamu mwene Shafani, Abudooni mwene Miika, Shafani omuhandiiki na Asaaya omugaragwa w'omugabe, naagira ati
en: And the king commanded Hilkiah, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Abdon the son of Micah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah a servant of the king's, saying,

rr: Mwirooko mumbuurize ahari MUKAMA, hamwe n'abatsigaire omuri Israeli na Yuda eby'ebigambo by'omuri eki kitabo ekizoirwe; ahabw'okuba ekiniga kya MUKAMA ekituriho ni kingi, ahakuba baatatenkuriitwe tibaroorobeire kigambo kya MUKAMA kukora ebihandiikirwe omuri eki kitabo byona.
en: Go, enquire of the LORD for me, and for them that are left in Israel and in Judah, concerning the words of the book that is found: for great is the wrath of the LORD that is poured out upon us, because our fathers have not kept the word of the LORD , to do after all that is written in this book.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo Hilukia n'abu omugabe yaabaire atumire, baaza owa Hulida nabikazi muka Shalumu, mwene Tokuhaasi, mwijukuru wa Hasira, omubiiki w'ebijwaro, (kandi ogwo mukazi akaba atwire Yerusaalemu omu kicweka kyayo kya kabiri), baabimuteekyerereza.
en: And Hilkiah, and they that the king had appointed , went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvath, the son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college:) and they spake to her to that effect .

rr: Yaabagarukamu ati: Oku nikwo MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli arikugamba naagira ati: Mugambire omushaija obantumireho muti
en: And she answered them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Tell ye the man that sent you to me,

rr: Oku nikwo MUKAMA arikugamba naagira ati: Reeba, ndyareeta akabi aha mwanya ogu n'aha batuuzi baamwo, n'emikyeeno yoona ehandiikirwe omu kitabo ekishomeirwe omugabe wa Yuda.
en: Thus saith the LORD , Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof, even all the curses that are written in the book which they have read before the king of Judah:

rr: Ahabw'okuba bakanfuruka, baayoterera baaruhanga abandi obubaane, ngu bangwise kubi n'ebi barikukora n'emikono yaabo byona, nikyo ekiniga kyangye kirishukirwa ahari ogu mwanya, kitaraazibwe.
en: because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be poured out upon this place, and shall not be quenched.

rr: Kwonka omugabe wa Yuda, obatumire kumbuuza, mumugire muti: Oku nikwo MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli arikugamba aha bigambo ebi ohuriire, naagira ati
en: And as for the king of Judah, who sent you to enquire of the LORD , so shall ye say unto him, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel concerning the words which thou hast heard;

rr: Ahabw'okugira omutima gworobi, ku ohuriire ebi ngambire aha mwanya ogu n'aha batuuzi baamwo, waayecureeza omu maisho gangye, waataagura ebijwaro byawe, wandirira omumaisho; n'ahabw'ekyo nanaye nkuhuriire; nikwo MUKAMA arikugamba.
en: because thine heart was tender, and thou didst humble thyself before God, when thou heardest his words against this place, and against the inhabitants thereof, and humbledst thyself before me, and didst rend thy clothes, and weep before me; I have even heard thee also, saith the LORD .

rr: Reeba, ndyakushangisa baashwenkuru, oziikwe omu kituuro kyawe n'obusingye, kandi amaisho gaawe tigarireeba kabi koona aku ndireeta aha mwanya ogu n'abagutwiremu.
en: Behold, I will gather thee to thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered to thy grave in peace, neither shall thine eyes see all the evil that I will bring upon this place, and upon the inhabitants of the same.

rr: Batyo baagyenda, baabigambira omugabe.
en: So they brought the king word again.

rr: Omugabe Yosia okuragaana endagaano na Ruhanga
en: The Covenant Renewed

rr: 2 Bwanyima omugabe yaatuma, yaateeranira hamwe abakuru boona aba Yuda na Yerusaalemu.
en: Then the king sent and gathered together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.

rr: Omugabe yainamuka omu nju ya MUKAMA hamwe n'abashaija ba Yuda boona n'abatuuzi ba Yerusaalemu, abanyamurwa n'Abaleevi, abantu boona abakuru n'abato; yaabashomera ebigambo byona eby'omu kitabo ky'endagaano ekizoirwe omu nju ya MUKAMA.
en: And the king went up into the house of the LORD , and all the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the priests, and the Levites, and all the people, great and small: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in the house of the LORD .

rr: Omugabe yaayemerera omu mwanya gwe, yaaragaana endagaano omu maisho ga MUKAMA, okumukuratira n'okworebera ebiragiro bye n'ebi yaahamize kandi n'ebi yaataireho, n'omutima gwe gwona n'amagara ge goona, n'okuhikiiriza ebigambo by'egyo ndagaano ehandiikirwe omuri ekyo kitabo.
en: And the king stood in his place, and made a covenant before the LORD , to walk after the LORD , and to keep his commandments, and his testimonies, and his statutes, with all his heart, and with all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant which are written in this book.

rr: Bwanyima yaareetera abaabaire bari Yerusaalemu na Benyamiini boona kwemera egyo ndagaano.
en: And he caused all that were present in Jerusalem and Benjamin to stand to it .

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo abatuuzi ba Yerusaalemu baakora nk'endagaano ya Ruhanga, Ruhanga wa baishenkurubo, oku eri.
en: And the inhabitants of Jerusalem did according to the covenant of God, the God of their fathers.

rr: Kandi Yosia yaihaho ebirikunugwa byona omu nsi yoona ey'Abaisraeli, n'abaabaire bari omuri Israeli boona yaabagyema kuheereza MUKAMA Ruhanga waabo.
en: And Josiah took away all the abominations out of all the countries that pertained to the children of Israel, and made all that were present in Israel to serve, even to serve the LORD their God.

rr: Omu busingye bwe bwona tibararekire kukuratira MUKAMA Ruhanga wa baishenkurubo.
en: And all his days they departed not from following the LORD , the God of their fathers.

rr: Currently Selected: 2 Eby&x27;omu Busingye 34 : RR64 Highlight Share <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" x
2 -23 ; . Bwanyima Yosia yaagaruriraho MUKAMA obugyenyi bw'Okuhingurwaho omuri Yerusaalemu; baita omwana gw'entaama gw'Okuhingurwaho aha kiro kya ikumi na bina eky'okwezi kw'okubanza.
en: Moreover Josiah kept a passover unto the LORD in Jerusalem: and they killed the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.

rr: Yaagarura abanyamurwa aha murimo gwabo, yaabeezirikisa kukora omurimo gw'obuheereza omu nju ya MUKAMA.
en: And he set the priests in their charges, and encouraged them to the service of the house of the LORD ,

rr: Kandi yaagambira Abaleevi abaabaire beegyesa Abaisraeli, akndi abayereziibwe MUKAMA, ati: Mute eshanduukye erikwera omu nju ei Sulemaani mwene Daudi omugabe wa Israeli yaayombekire; tihaakiriho kirigibaheekyesa obundi. Mbwenu muheereze MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu, n'abantu be Israeli.
en: and said unto the Levites that taught all Israel, which were holy unto the LORD , Put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the son of David king of Israel did build; it shall not be a burden upon your shoulders: serve now the LORD your God, and his people Israel,

rr: Mweteekateekye omu mbu zaanyu, nk'oku amaju ga baashwenkuriimwe gari, nimukuratira ebyaragiirwe Daudi omugabe wa Israeli, na Sulemaani omutabani.
en: and prepare yourselves by the houses of your fathers, after your courses, according to the writing of David king of Israel, and according to the writing of Solomon his son.

rr: Kandi mwemerere omu mwanya ogurikwera nk'emitwe y'amaju ga baishenkuru ba beene waanyu abatari Baleevi oku eri, buri mutwe gugire ekicweka ky'enju ya baashwenkuriimwe Abaleevi.
en: And stand in the holy place according to the divisions of the families of the fathers of your brethren the people, and after the division of the families of the Levites.

rr: Bwanyima mwite omwana gw'entaama gw'Okuhingurwaho, mweyeze, mweteekateekyere beene waanyu, mubone kukora nk'ekigambo kya MUKAMA ekyagambirwe Musa oku kiri.
en: So kill the passover, and sanctify yourselves, and prepare your brethren, that they may do according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

rr: Ku baaherize, Yosia yaaha abantu abatari Baleevi abaana b'entaama n'ab'embuzi obukumi bushatu n'enimi enkumi ishatu okuruga omu masyo, kuba empongano z'Okuhingurwaho ahabwa boona abaabaire bari aho; ebyo byona bikaruga omu matungo g'omugabe.
en: And Josiah gave to the people, of the flock, lambs and kids, all for the passover offerings, for all that were present, to the number of thirty thousand, and three thousand bullocks: these were of the king's substance.

rr: Kandi abanyiginya nabo baaha abantu b'abanyamurwa n'Abaleevi eby'okuhonga, baabiha n'omutima ogwekundiire. Hilukia, Zekaria na Yehieli, abakuru b'enju ya Ruhanga, baaha abanyamurwa abaana be'entaama n'ab'embuzi enkumi ibiri na magana mukaaga, n'enimi magana ashatu, kuba empongano z'Okuhingurwaho.
en: And his princes gave willingly unto the people, to the priests, and to the Levites: Hilkiah and Zechariah and Jehiel, rulers of the house of God, gave unto the priests for the passover offerings two thousand and six hundred small cattle , and three hundred oxen.

rr: Kandi Konania n'abarumuna Shemaaya na Netaneeli, hamwe na Hashabia, Yeyeli na Yozabaadi, abakuru b'Abaleevi, baaha Abaleevi abaana b'entaama n'ab'embuzi enkumi itaano, n'enimi magana ataano, kuba empongano z'Okuhingurwaho.
en: Conaniah also, and Shemaiah and Nethaneel, his brethren, and Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jozabad, chief of the Levites, gave unto the Levites for passover offerings five thousand small cattle , and five hundred oxen.

rr: Ku baaherize kweteekateekyera okwo kuheereza, abanyamurwa baayemerera omu mwanya gwabo, n'Abaleevi omu bicweka byabo, nk'oku omugabe yaaragiire.
en: So the service was prepared, and the priests stood in their place, and the Levites in their courses, according to the king's commandment.

rr: Batyo baita omwana gw'entaama gw'Okuhingurwaho, abanyamurwa baamiisiira eshagama ei baahairwe Abaleevi, abaabaire nibabaaga.
en: And they killed the passover, and the priests sprinkled the blood from their hands, and the Levites flayed them .

rr: Baihaho ebitambo by'okwotsya, baabibaganisa nk'emitwe y'amaju ga baishenkuru b'abatari Baleevi oku yaabaire eri ngu babone kubihongyera MUKAMA, nk'oku kyahandiikirwe omu kitabo kya Musa.
en: And they removed the burnt offerings, that they might give according to the divisions of the families of the people, to offer unto the LORD , as it is written in the book of Moses.

rr: Kandi n'enimi baazitwaza batyo.
en: And so did they with the oxen.

rr: Bwanyima baayotsya omwana gw'entaama gw'Okuhingurwaho nk'oku kirikuragiirwa; kandi n'empongano ezirikwera baaziteeka omu nyabya, omu nyungu n'omu safuriya, ahonaaho baabitwara, baagaburira abantu boona.
en: And they roasted the passover with fire according to the ordinance: but the other holy offerings sod they in pots, and in caldrons, and in pans, and divided them speedily among all the people.

rr: Bwanyima baayeteekateekyera ebyabo ahabwabo n'ahabw'abanyamurwa, ahabw'okuba abanyamurwa beene Arooni bakaba bahugiire omu kutamba ebitambo by'okwotsya n'ebishaju okuhitsya obu bwaizire; batyo Abaleevi baateekateeka ebyabo ahabwabo n'ahabw'abanyamurwa beene Arooni.
en: And afterward they made ready for themselves, and for the priests: because the priests the sons of Aaron were busied in offering of burnt offerings and the fat until night; therefore the Levites prepared for themselves, and for the priests the sons of Aaron.

rr: 1 -29 ; 26:1-19 . Kandi abeeshongozi beene Asafu bakaba bari omu mwanya gwabo, nk'oku kyaragiirwe Daudi na Asafu, Hemani na Yedusuuni, omuhanuuzi w'omugabe; n'abakumiirizi bakaba bari aha marembo goona; abo boona bakaba batarikwenda kuruga aha mirimo yaabo, ahabw'okuba beene waabo Abaleevi bakaba nibabateekateekyera ebyabo.
en: And the singers the sons of Asaph were in their place, according to the commandment of David, and Asaph, and Heman, and Jeduthun the king's seer; and the porters waited at every gate; they might not depart from their service; for their brethren the Levites prepared for them.

rr: Okwo nikwo omurimo gw'okuheereza MUKAMA gwona gwateekateekirwe eryo izooba kwijuka obugyenyi bw'Okuhingurwaho n'okutambira ebitambo by'okwotsya aha itambo rya MUKAMA, nk'oku omugabe Yosia yaaragiirre.
en: So all the service of the LORD was prepared the same day, to keep the passover, and to offer burnt offerings upon the altar of the LORD , according to the commandment of king Josiah.

rr: Omu bunaku obwo Abaisraeli, abaabaire bari aho, baijuka obugyenyi bw'Okuhingurwaho, n'obw'emigaati etatumbisiibwe okumara ebiro mushanju.
en: And the children of Israel that were present kept the passover at that time, and the feast of unleavened bread seven days.

rr: Kandi okwiha omu biro bya nabi Samueli omuri Israeli hakaba hatakabahoga bugyenyi bw'Okuhingurwaho nk'obwo; kandi tihariho mugabe omu bagabe ba Israeli boona owaijukire obugyenyi bw'Okuhingurwaho nk'oku Yosia yaijukire, akwataniise n'abanyamurwa n'Abaleevi, n'aba Yuda na Israeli boona abaabaire bari aho, hamwe n'abatuuzi ba Yerusaalemu.
en: And there was no passover like to that kept in Israel from the days of Samuel the prophet; neither did all the kings of Israel keep such a passover as Josiah kept, and the priests, and the Levites, and all Judah and Israel that were present, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

rr: Omu mwaka gwa ikumi na munaana ogw'omu busingye bwa Yosia, nibwo baijuka obwo bugyenyi bw'Okuhingurwaho. Okufa kwa Yosia
en: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah was this passover kept. Death of Josiah

rr: Bwanyima y'ebyo byona, Yosia ku yaaherize kushemeza hekalu, Neeko omugabe wa Misri yainamuka kuteera Kakemeshi aha mugyera Furaati, na Yosia yaahurura kurwana nawe.
en: After all this, when Josiah had prepared the temple, Necho king of Egypt came up to fight against Carchemish by Euphrates: and Josiah went out against him.

rr: Kwonka Neeko yaamutumaho entumwa, naamugira ati: Mbwenu nyowe naiwe nitufa ki, iwe omugabe wa Yuda? Hati tiiwe nyizire kurwanisa, kureka nyine enju ei ndikurwana nayo; kandi Ruhanga andagiire ngu nyehuute. Ruga Ruhanga omu kaso ori hamwe naanye, atakaakucwekyereza.
en: But he sent ambassadors to him, saying, What have I to do with thee, thou king of Judah? I come not against thee this day, but against the house wherewith I have war: for God commanded me to make haste: forbear thee from meddling with God, who is with me, that he destroy thee not.

rr: Kwonka Yosia yaayanga kumurugaho, kureka yaayehindura ngu arwane nawe; tiyaahurira bigambo bya Neeko ebirugire omu kanwa ka Ruhanga, yaaza omu rugamba omu ruhita rwa Megido.
en: Nevertheless Josiah would not turn his face from him, but disguised himself, that he might fight with him, and hearkened not unto the words of Necho from the mouth of God, and came to fight in the valley of Megiddo.

rr: Abarasi baarasha omugabe Yosia; nawe nikwo kugira abashaija be ati: Muunyiha omu rugamba ahakuba naahutaara munonga.
en: And the archers shot at king Josiah; and the king said to his servants, Have me away; for I am sore wounded.

rr: Batyo abashaija be baamwiha omu kigaari, baamuta omu kigaari kye ekya kabiri, baamutwara Yerusaalemu. Yaafa, yaaziikwa omu bituuro bya baihsenkuru. Abayuda n'aba Yerusaalemu boona baamucurira.
en: His servants therefore took him out of that chariot, and put him in the second chariot that he had; and they brought him to Jerusalem, and he died, and was buried in one of the sepulchres of his fathers. And all Judah and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah.

rr: Na Yeremia yaamucurira; kandi abeeshongozi boona, abashaija n'abakazi, baaguma nibamugambaho omu kutonzya kwabo n'okuhitsya hati. Baakihindura omugyenzo omuri Israeli; reeba, bihandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'Okutonzya.
en: And Jeremiah lamented for Josiah: and all the singing men and the singing women spake of Josiah in their lamentations to this day, and made them an ordinance in Israel: and, behold, they are written in the lamentations.

rr: Endiijo mirimo ya Yosia, n'ebirungi ebi yaakozire naakuratira ebihandiikirwe omu biragiro bya MUKAMA
en: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and his goodness, according to that which was written in the law of the LORD ,

rr: n'ebi yaakozire okwiha aha kutandika okuhitsya aha muheru, reeba, bihandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'Abagabe ba Israeli n'aba Yuda.
en: and his deeds, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

2 Bwanyima abantu b'omu nsi egyo baatwara Yehoahazi mwene Yosia, baamwemeka omu mwanya gwa ishe omuri Yerusaalemu.
en: Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and made him king in his father's stead in Jerusalem.

rr: Yehoahazi akaba aine emyaka makumi abiri n'eshatu, obu yaatandika kutegyeka; yaategyekyera Yerusaalemu ameezi ashatu.
en: Jehoahaz was twenty and three years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months in Jerusalem.

rr: Bwanyima y'ago meezi ashatu omugabe wa Misri yaamwiha aha ngoma omuri Yerusaalemu, yaacwera ab'omuri egyo nsi etalanta z'efeeza igana n'etalanta emwe y'ezaabu.
en: And the king of Egypt put him down at Jerusalem, and condemned the land in an hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.

rr: Bwanyima omugabe wa Misri ogwo Neeko yaayemeka Eliakimu mukuru we kuba omugabe wa Yuda na Yerusaalemu, yaahindura eiziina rye, yaamweta Yehoyakimu; kandi yaakwata Yehoahazi omurumuna, yaamutwara Misri.
en: And the king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem, and turned his name to Jehoiakim. And Necho took Jehoahaz his brother, and carried him to Egypt. Attacked by Babylon

rr: Yehoyakimu kaba aine emyaka makumi abiri n'etaano obu yaatandika kutegyeka, yaategyekyera Yerusaalemu emyaka ikumi na gumwe. Yaakora ebirikwangwa MUKAMA Ruhanga we.
en: Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem: and he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD his God.

rr: Bwanyima Nebukadeneeza omugabe wa Babulooni yainamuka, yaamuteera, yaamubohesa emihama kumutwara Babulooni.
en: Against him came up Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and bound him in fetters, to carry him to Babylon.

rr: Kandi Nebukadeneeza ogwo yaatwara Babulooni bimwe aha bintu by'enju ya MUKAMA, yaabita omu kikaari kye.
en: Nebuchadnezzar also carried of the vessels of the house of the LORD to Babylon, and put them in his temple at Babylon.

rr: Endiijo mirimo ya Yehoyakimu, n'ebirikunugwa ebi yaakozire, n'ebyabaire bimureebwaho, bihandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'abagabe ba Israeli n'aba Yuda; bwanyima omutabani Yehoyakiini yaategyeka omu mwanya gwe.
en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and his abominations which he did, and that which was found in him, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah: and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead.

rr: 2 Yehoyakiini akaba aine emyaka ikumi na munaan, obu yaatandika kutegyeka; yaategyekyera Yerusaalemu ameezi ashatu n'ebiro ikumi. Yaakora ebirikwangwa MUKAMA.
en: Jehoiachin was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem: and he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD .

rr: 2 -20 ; . Aha kutandika kw'omwaka Nebukadeneeza yaatuma, baamutwara Babulooni n'ebintu by'obuguzi bwingi eby'enju ya MUKAMA, yaayemeka mukuru we Zedekia kuba omugabe wa Yuda na Yerusaalemu.
en: And when the year was expired, king Nebuchadnezzar sent, and brought him to Babylon, with the goodly vessels of the house of the LORD , and made Zedekiah his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem.

rr: Zedekia akaba aine emyaka makumi abiri na gumwe, obu yaatandika kutegyeka; yaategyekyera Yerusaalemu emyaka ikumi na gumwe.
en: Zedekiah was one and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned eleven years in Jerusalem.

rr: -7 ; 27:12-22 ; 32:1-5 ; 37:6-10 ; 38:17-26 . Yaakora ebirikwangwa MUKAMA Ruhanga we; tiyaayecureeza mu maisho ga Yeremia nabi, owaabaire amugambira ebigambo bya MUKAMA.
en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD his God, and humbled not himself before Jeremiah the prophet speaking from the mouth of the LORD .

rr: 2 Kandi yaagomera omugabe Nebukadeneeza owaamurahiize ahari Ruhanga; yaagaruka yaagangaaza ebitsya, yaagumya omutima gwe, yaayanga kuhindukira MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli.
en: And he also rebelled against king Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by God: but he stiffened his neck, and hardened his heart from turning unto the LORD God of Israel.

rr: Kandi abanyamurwa abakuru boona n'abantu nabo bakaba barengyesereize omu kucumura nibakuratira ebirikunugwa byona eby'abanyamahanga, baashiisha enju ya MUKAMA ei yaabaire ayereize Yerusaalemu.
en: Moreover all the chief of the priests, and the people, transgressed very much after all the abominations of the heathen; and polluted the house of the LORD which he had hallowed in Jerusalem.

rr: MUKAMA Ruhanga wa baishenkurubo akaba atuura naabatumaho entumwa ze, ahabw'okugirira abantu be, n'obutaaho bwe, esaasi
en: And the LORD God of their fathers sent to them by his messengers, rising up betimes, and sending; because he had compassion on his people, and on his dwelling place:

rr: kwonka baaguma nibateerera enaku entumwa za Ruhanga, nibagaya ebigambo bye, nibashekyerera baanabi be, okuhitsya obu ekiniga kya MUKAMA kyaizire aha bantu be, bakabura oku baraakikire.
en: but they mocked the messengers of God, and despised his words, and misused his prophets, until the wrath of the LORD arose against his people, till there was no remedy.

rr: Abayuda okutwarwa Babulooni
en: The Captivity

rr: 2 -7 ; . N'ahabw'ekyo MUKAMA yaabateeza omugabe w'Abakaludaaya, yaitira abatsigazi baabo omu nju y'Obutaaho bwabo oburikwera na rurara, tiyaagirira muntu weena saasi, omutsigazi nari empangare, omugurusi nari owaahikire omu ngingo zaabukuru; yaabahayo boona omu mikono y'ogwo mugabe.
en: Therefore he brought upon them the king of the Chaldees, who slew their young men with the sword in the house of their sanctuary, and had no compassion upon young man or maiden, old man, or him that stooped for age: he gave them all into his hand.

rr: 2 Kandi ebintu byona eby'enju ya MUKAMA, ebihango n'ebikye, n'eby'obutungi by'omuri egyo nju, n'eby'omugabe n'eby'abanyiginya be, ebyo byona yaabitwara Babulooni.
en: And all the vessels of the house of God, great and small, and the treasures of the house of the LORD , and the treasures of the king, and of his princes; all these he brought to Babylon.

rr: Bwanyima baayotsya enju ya Ruhanga, baasheenya orugo rw'amabaare rwa Yerusaalemu, baayotsya zaanyaruju zaayo zoona, baacwekyereza n'ebintu byayo ebirungi.
en: And they burnt the house of God, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem, and burnt all the palaces thereof with fire, and destroyed all the goodly vessels thereof.

rr: Abaahonokire ahari rurara Nebukadeneeza yaabatwara Babulooni, baaba abahuuku be n'aba'abatabani, okuhitsya aha kutandika kw'obugabe bwa Perisi
en: And them that had escaped from the sword carried he away to Babylon; where they were servants to him and his sons until the reign of the kingdom of Persia:

rr: -12 ; . okuhikiiriza ekigambo kya MUKAMA ekyagambirwe Yeremia, ngu ensi eryaguma etyo okuhitsya obu eriheza kushemerererwa sabato zaayo; ahabw'okuba ebiro ebi yaamazire eri omushaka byona, ekaba eijuka sabato okumara emyaka makumi mushanju.
en: to fulfil the word of the LORD by the mouth of Jeremiah, until the land had enjoyed her sabbaths: for as long as she lay desolate she kept sabbath, to fulfil threescore and ten years.

rr: Ebya Kuuro omugabe wa Perisi
en: The Return

rr: -3 ; Bwanyima omu mwaka gw'okubanza ogw'omu busingye bwa Kuuro omugabe wa Perisi, MUKAMA akaimutsya omutima gwa Kuuro, ngu ekigambo kye ekyagambirwe Yeremia kihikiirire, yaaragiira kuranga ebigambo ebi omu bugabe bwe bwona, kandi n'okubihandiika, naagira ati
en: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the LORD spoken by the mouth of Jeremiah might be accomplished, the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,

rr: Oku nikwo Kuuro omugabe wa Perisi arikugamba naagira ati: MUKAMA, Ruhanga w'eiguru, ampaire obugabe bwona obw'omu nsi, kandi anyehanangiriize kumwombekyera enju omuri Yerusaalemu ey'omuri Yuda. Mbwenu omuntu weena omuriimwe ow'omu bantu be, MUKAMA Ruhanga we agume nawe; kandi ainamukye.
