rr: 1 Paulo, entumwa ya Kristo Yesu nk'oku Ruhanga yaakunzire, na Timoseo ow'eishe-emwe, twabahandiikira imwe abari omu kanisa ya Ruhanga ey'omuri Korinso, hamwe n'abarikwera boona abari omuri Akaya yoona
en: 1 Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, unto the church of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints which are in all Achaia:

rr: 2 nitubendeza embabazi n'obusingye ebirikuruga ahari Ruhanga Tataitwe, na Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo.
en: 2 grace be to you and peace from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

rr: 3 Ruhanga asiimwe, Ishe wa Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo, Tataitwe ow'okusaasira, kandi Ruhanga ow'okuhuumuza kwona
en: 3 Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort;

rr: 4 otuhuumuza omu busaasi bwaitu bwona, ngu naitwe tubone kubaasa kuhuumuza abo abari omu busaasi bwona, nitubahuumuza n'obuhuumure obu tihuumuzibwa Ruhanga.
en: 4 who comforteth us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God.
5 For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us, so our consolation also aboundeth by Christ.

6 And whether we be afflicted, it is for your consolation and salvation, which is effectual in the enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer: or whether we be comforted, it is for your consolation and salvation.

rr: 7 Kandi tubainemu amatsiko tutarikubanganisa; ahakuba nitumanya ngu, nk'oku mukwatanisa naitwe omu kubonabonesibwa, nikwo mukwatanisa naitwe n'omu buhuumure.
en: 7 And our hope of you is stedfast, knowing, that as ye are partakers of the sufferings, so shall ye be also of the consolation.
8 For we would not, brethren, have you ignorant of our trouble which came to us in Asia, that we were pressed out of measure, above strength, insomuch that we despaired even of life:

rr: 9 twateekateeka omu mitima yaitu ku tucwereirwe orubanja rw'okufa, ngu turekye kwesiga amaani gaitu twenka, kureka twesigye Ruhanga ozoora abafu.
en: 9 but we had the sentence of death in ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God which raiseth the dead:
10 who delivered us from so great a death, and doth deliver: in whom we trust that he will yet deliver us ;

rr: 11 Naimwe mushemereire kukwatanisa kutuhwera omu kushaba kwanyu; ngu omugisha ogu twahairwe ahabw'okushaba kwa baingi, baingi bagusiimire Ruhanga ahabwaitu.
en: 11 ye also helping together by prayer for us, that for the gift bestowed upon us by the means of many persons thanks may be given by many on our behalf.

12 For our rejoicing is this, the testimony of our conscience, that in simplicity and godly sincerity, not with fleshly wisdom, but by the grace of God, we have had our conversation in the world, and more abundantly to you-ward.

rr: 13 Titurikubahandiikira bindi kureka ebyo ebi murikuhsoma, mukashoborokyerwa; kandi nyine amatisko ngu nimwija kubishoborokyerwa byona
en: 13 For we write none other things unto you, than what ye read or acknowledge; and I trust ye shall acknowledge even to the end;
14 as also ye have acknowledged us in part, that we are your rejoicing, even as ye also are our's in the day of the Lord Jesus.

rr: 15 Omu matsiko ago nkaba niinyenda kuba niimwe naabanza kutaayaayira, ngu muheebwe omugisha kabiri
en: 15 And in this confidence I was minded to come unto you before, that ye might have a second benefit;
16 and to pass by you into Macedonia, and to come again out of Macedonia unto you, and of you to be brought on my way toward Judæa.

rr: 17 Ku naateekateekire kukora ntyo, nkaba nk'orikugambira habiri? Nari ebi nteekateeka kukora, mbiteekateeka omu bwengye bw'abantu, ngu mbe orikwikiririza eryo, nti, Eego, Eego, nari Ngaaha, Ngaaha?
en: 17 When I therefore was thus minded, did I use lightness? or the things that I purpose, do I purpose according to the flesh, that with me there should be yea yea, and nay nay?

rr: 18 Nk'oku Ruhanga ari omwesigwa, ekigambo eki tubagambira tikiri Eego, kandi na Ngaaha
en: 18 But as God is true, our word toward you was not yea and nay.

rr: 19 ahakuba Omwana wa Ruhanga Yesu Kristo, ou twabarangiire, nyowe na Siluwaano na Timoseo, akaba atari Eego kandi no Ngaaha, kureka omuriwe obutoosha ni Eego.
en: 19 For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us, even by me and Silvanus and Timotheus, was not yea and nay, but in him was yea.
20 For all the promises of God in him are yea, and in him Amen, unto the glory of God by us.
21 Now he which stablisheth us with you in Christ, and hath anointed us, is God;
22 who hath also sealed us, and given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.

rr: 23 Kwonka Ruhanga niwe kareebi wangye, orikumanya omutima gwangye, ngu ekyanzibiire kwija Korinso n'ahabw'okubasaasira
en: 23 Moreover I call God for a record upon my soul, that to spare you I came not as yet unto Corinth.
24 Not for that we have dominion over your faith, but are helpers of your joy: for by faith ye stand.
1 But I determined this with myself, that I would not come again to you in heaviness.

rr: 2 Mbwenu, ku ndaabagwise kubi, n'oha orangwise gye? T'ogwo ou ngwisize kubi?
en: 2 For if I make you sorry, who is he then that maketh me glad, but the same which is made sorry by me?

rr: 3 Ekyo nkakihandiika ngu, ku ndiba naizire, ndekye kugwisibwa kubi abaakunshemeize, ahakuba nimbeesiga mwena ngu okushemererwa kwangye kukaabaire okwanyu mwena.
en: 3 And I wrote this same unto you, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is the joy of you all.
4 For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears; not that ye should be grieved, but that ye might know the love which I have more abundantly unto you.

rr: 5 Ku haraabe hariho owaareetsire okushaasha, tiinye yaasaasize, kureka haihi mwena, ntakaarengyesereza nti, kasaasa mwena.
en: 5 But if any have caused grief, he hath not grieved me, but in part: that I may not overcharge you all.

rr: 6 Ekiheneso omushaija ogwo eki yaahairwe abarikukira obwingi nikimara
en: 6 Sufficient to such a man is this punishment, which was inflicted of many.

rr: 7 nikyo kibashemerereire kumusaasira n'okumuhuumuza, ngu shana atakaarengwa obusaasi.
en: 7 So that contrariwise ye ought rather to forgive him , and comfort him , lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow.

rr: 8 N'ahabw'ekyo nimbeeshengyereza ngu mugarukye muhamye ku murikumukunda.
en: 8 Wherefore I beseech you that ye would confirm your love toward him.
9 For to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether ye be obedient in all things.

rr: 10 Omuntu weena ou musaasira, naanye mmusaasira; naanye eki naasaasiire, ku kiraabe kiriho, nkakimusaasira ahabwanyu omu maisho ga Kristo
en: 10 To whom ye forgive any thing, I forgive also: for if I forgave any thing, to whom I forgave it , for your sakes forgave I it in the person of Christ;
11 lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.
12 Furthermore, when I came to Troas to preach Christ's gospel, and a door was opened unto me of the Lord,

rr: 13 kwonka tindagizire kuhuumura omu mutima gwangye ahabw'okutashangayo ow'eishe-emwe Tito. Nikwo kubaraga, nkagumizamu kutaaha Makedonia.
en: 13 I had no rest in my spirit, because I found not Titus my brother: but taking my leave of them, I went from thence into Macedonia.

rr: 14 Ruhanga asiimwe, otutabaarura obutoosha, turi abasinguzi omuri Kristo, kandi otuha okubuzya hoona eby'okumumanya, ngu bibe nk'okutaamirana kw'omugaju.
en: 14 Now thanks be unto God, which always causeth us to triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place.
15 For we are unto God a sweet savour of Christ, in them that are saved, and in them that perish:
16 to the one we are the savour of death unto death; and to the other the savour of life unto life. And who is sufficient for these things?
17 For we are not as many, which corrupt the word of God: but as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God speak we in Christ.
1 Do we begin again to commend ourselves? or need we, as some others , epistles of commendation to you, or letters of commendation from you?
2 Ye are our epistle written in our hearts, known and read of all men:

3 forasmuch as ye are manifestly declared to be the epistle of Christ ministered by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tables of stone, but in fleshy tables of the heart.

rr: 4 Obu nibwo bwesigye obu twesiga Ruhanga ahabwa Kristo
en: 4 And such trust have we through Christ to God-ward:

rr: 5 ahakuba itwe titwine ki turikwebaasiza twenka, kuteekateeka ekintu kyona ngu niitwe kirugireho; kureka okubaasa kwaitu kuruga ahari Ruhanga
en: 5 not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think any thing as of ourselves; but our sufficiency is of God;
6 who also hath made us able ministers of the new testament; not of the letter, but of the spirit: for the letter killeth, but the spirit giveth life.

7 But if the ministration of death, written and engraven in stones, was glorious, so that the children of Israel could not stedfastly behold the face of Moses for the glory of his countenance; which glory was to be done away:

rr: 8 nimugira ngu obuheereza obw'Omwoyo tiburiija n'ekitiinisa ekirikukiraho?
en: 8 how shall not the ministration of the spirit be rather glorious?
9 For if the ministration of condemnation be glory, much more doth the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory.
10 For even that which was made glorious had no glory in this respect, by reason of the glory that excelleth.

rr: 11 Oburikuhwaho ku buraabe bwagizire ekitiinisa, obutahwaho buryagira ekitiinisa ekirikukiraho.
en: 11 For if that which is done away was glorious, much more that which remaineth is glorious.

rr: 12 Nk'oku twine amatsiko agarikwingana gatyo, nitugamba n'obumanzi bwingi
en: 12 Seeing then that we have such hope, we use great plainness of speech:
13 and not as Moses, which put a vail over his face, that the children of Israel could not stedfastly look to the end of that which is abolished:
14 but their minds were blinded: for until this day remaineth the same vail untaken away in the reading of the old testament; which vail is done away in Christ.

rr: 15 ahakuba obutoosha ku bashoma ebya Musa, eky'okwetwekyerera ekyo kiguma aha mitima yaabo n'okuhitsya hati.
en: 15 But even unto this day, when Moses is read, the vail is upon their heart.
16 Nevertheless when it shall turn to the Lord, the vail shall be taken away.
17 Now the Lord is that Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is , there is liberty.

rr: 18 Itwe twena ku turaabe nitworeka ekitiinisa kya Mukama ahamaisho gaitu, twaba nk'endeeberwamu, obwo ahamaisho gaitu ahatatwekyereire, tuguma nituhindurwa okushushana nawe, nituruga omu kitiinisa kuza omu kitiinisa ekindi ekirikukiraho; ebyo nibirunga ahari Mukama niwe Mwoyo.
en: 18 But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the Spirit of the Lord.

rr: 1 N'ahabw'ekyo, nk'oku tuhairwe obuheereza obu ahabw'embabazi za Ruhanga, titurikuhwa matsiko.
en: 1 Therefore seeing we have this ministry, as we have received mercy, we faint not;

2 but have renounced the hidden things of dishonesty, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully; but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man's conscience in the sight of God.
3 But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost:
4 in whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not, lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine unto them.

rr: 5 Mumanye ngu titurikwegambaho nk'abakama, kureka nitugamba Yesu Kristo ku niwe Mukama, kandi itwe turi abahuuku baanyu ahabwa Yesu.
en: 5 For we preach not ourselves, but Christ Jesus the Lord; and ourselves your servants for Jesus' sake.

rr: 6 Ahakuba Ruhanga, owaaragiire ati: Omushana gujwe omu mwirima, Ogwo niwe yaajwire omu mitima yaitu kutuha okuhsoborokyerwa ekitiinisa kya Ruhanga ekirikureeberwa omuri Yesu Kristo.
en: 6 For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, hath shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
7 But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.
8 We are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we are perplexed, but not in despair;

rr: 9 nituhiigwa, kwonka titurikutsigwaho; twikarirwa, kwonka titugwaho
en: 9 persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed;

rr: 10 obutoosha tugyenda twine okufa kwa Yesu omu mibiri yaitu, ngu amagara ge gareebekyere omu mibiri yaitu.
en: 10 always bearing about in the body the dying of the Lord Jesus, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our body.
11 For we which live are alway delivered unto death for Jesus' sake, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our mortal flesh.

rr: 12 N'ahabw'ekyo okufa kukorera omuriitwe, kwonka amagara gakorera omuriimwe.
en: 12 So then death worketh in us, but life in you.
13 We having the same spirit of faith, according as it is written, I believed, and therefore have I spoken; we also believe, and therefore speak;
14 knowing that he which raised up the Lord Jesus shall raise up us also by Jesus, and shall present us with you.

rr: 15 Ahakuba byona biri ahabwanyu, ngu, nk'oku emababazi zibugire omu bantu abarikweyongyera kuba baingi, zibe nikwo zaakanyisa okusiima, Ruhanga abone kuhimbisibwa.
en: 15 For all things are for your sakes, that the abundant grace might through the thanksgiving of many redound to the glory of God.
16 For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.
17 For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory;
18 while we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.
1 For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.
2 For in this we groan, earnestly desiring to be clothed upon with our house which is from heaven:

rr: 3 ku turiba nitugijwekwa, turekye kushangwa tujwaire busha.
en: 3 if so be that being clothed we shall not be found naked.
4 For we that are in this tabernacle do groan, being burdened: not for that we would be unclothed, but clothed upon, that mortality might be swallowed up of life.

rr: 5 Kandi owaatuteekateekyeire ekyo ni Ruhanga, kandi niwe yaatuhaire omukwato gw'Omwoyo.
en: 5 Now he that hath wrought us for the selfsame thing is God, who also hath given unto us the earnest of the Spirit.
6 Therefore we are always confident, knowing that, whilst we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord:

rr: 7 (ahakuba tugyenda ahabw'okwikiriza, ti habw'okureeba.)
en: 7 (for we walk by faith, not by sight:)
8 we are confident, I say , and willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be present with the Lord.

rr: 9 Nikyo twezirikira kumushemeza, yaaba turi owaitu omuka, yaaba tutariyo.
en: 9 Wherefore we labour, that, whether present or absent, we may be accepted of him.
10 For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad.

rr: 11 Ahabw'okumanya ku Mukama aba ow'okutiinwa, twikiririsa abantu; kwonka Ruhanga niwe amanya oku turi; kandi nyine amatsiko ngu naimwe nimumanya oku turi omu mitima yaanyu.
en: 11 Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord, we persuade men; but we are made manifest unto God; and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences.

rr: 12 Titurikugaruka kwehimbisa ahariimwe, kureka nitubaha oburyo bw'okwehimbisa ahabwaitu, ngu mubaase kugarukamu abarikwehimbisiza aha birikureebwa kwonka, bitari by'omu mutima.
en: 12 For we commend not ourselves again unto you, but give you occasion to glory on our behalf, that ye may have somewhat to answer them which glory in appearance, and not in heart.

rr: 13 Ku turaabe tugwire eiraro, turigwire ahabwa Ruhanga; ku turaabe tuhuriire, tuhuriire ahabwanyu.
en: 13 For whether we be beside ourselves, it is to God: or whether we be sober, it is for your cause.

rr: 14 Ahakuba okukunda kwa Kristo nikwo kutugyema, nitumanyira kimwe ngu Omwe akafeera boona; nahabw'ekyo boona bakafa.
en: 14 For the love of Christ constraineth us; because we thus judge, that if one died for all, then were all dead:
15 and that he died for all, that they which live should not henceforth live unto themselves, but unto him which died for them, and rose again.

rr: 16 Mbwenu okuruga hati titukimanya muntu weena omu buzaare bw'omubiri. N'obu turaabe twamanyire Kristo, nk'oku abantu baamumanyire, mbwenu titukimumanya tutyo.
en: 16 Wherefore henceforth know we no man after the flesh: yea, though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now henceforth know we him no more.
17 Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.
18 And all things are of God, who hath reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ, and hath given to us the ministry of reconciliation;
19 to wit, that God was in Christ, reconciling the world unto himself, not imputing their trespasses unto them; and hath committed unto us the word of reconciliation.

rr: 20 Mbwenu turi entumwa omu mwanya gwa Kristo, Ruhanga naashusha nk'orikweshengyereza abantu omuriitwe. Naitwe nitubeeshengyereza omu iziina rya Kristo, mugarukane na Ruhanga
en: 20 Now then we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God did beseech you by us: we pray you in Christ's stead, be ye reconciled to God.
21 For he hath made him to be sin for us, who knew no sin; that we might be made the righteousness of God in him.

rr: 1 Naitwe, nk'oku turi abarikukora nawe, nitubeeshengyereza, murekye kufiisa busha embabazi za Ruhanga
en: 1 We then, as workers together with him , beseech you also that ye receive not the grace of God in vain.
2 (For he saith,

rr: 3 Nikyo twerindira kutateeza omuntu weena ntsibo, ngu obuheereza bwaitu burekye kugaywa
en: 3 Giving no offence in any thing, that the ministry be not blamed:

rr: 4 kureka omuri byona nitweyoreka nk'abashemereire kuba abaheereza ba Ruhanga, nitugumisiriza munonga omu kubonabona, omu bworo, omu busaasi
en: 4 But in all things approving ourselves as the ministers of God, in much patience, in afflictions, in necessities, in distresses,
5 in stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labours, in watchings, in fastings;
6 by pureness, by knowledge, by longsuffering, by kindness, by the Holy Ghost, by love unfeigned,

rr: 7 omu kigambo ky'amazima, n'omu maani ga Ruhanga; tukwaitse eby'okurwanisa by'okuhikiirira omu mukono gwa buryo n'ogwa bumohso
en: 7 by the word of truth, by the power of God, by the armour of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,

rr: 8 omu kitiinisa n'omu kugaywa, omu kagambwaho kubi n'omu kugambwaho gye; nituteekyerezibwaho nk'abanyabishuba, kunu turi ab'amazima
en: 8 by honour and dishonour, by evil report and good report: as deceivers, and yet true;
9 as unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and, behold, we live; as chastened, and not killed;

rr: 10 nk'abaine obusaasi, kwonka nitushemererwa obutoosha; nk'abooro, haza nitutungisa baingi; nk'abataine kantu, haza twine byona.
en: 10 as sorrowful, yet alway rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.
11 O ye Corinthians, our mouth is open unto you, our heart is enlarged.

rr: 12 Timufunzire muriitwe, kureka mufunzire omu mitima yaanyu.
en: 12 Ye are not straitened in us, but ye are straitened in your own bowels.

rr: 13 Nimbagambira nk'abaana bangye, naimwe mushashaanukye, mukore nk'oku mwagiriirwe.
en: 13 Now for a recompence in the same, (I speak as unto my children,) be ye also enlarged.
14 Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness?

rr: 15 Nari Kristo naakwatanisa ata na Beliali? Orikwikiriza aine mugabo ki n'otarikwikiriza?
en: 15 And what concord hath Christ with Belial? or what part hath he that believeth with an infidel?

16 And what agreement hath the temple of God with idols? for ye are the temple of the living God; as God hath said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them ; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
17 Wherefore
18 And will be a Father unto you,

rr: 1 Nk'oku twine ebyaraganisiibwe ebyo, abarikukundwa, tweyozyeho oburofa bwona obw'aha mubiri n'obw'omu mwoyo, nituhikiiriza okwera omu kutiina Ruhanga.
en: 1 Having therefore these promises, dearly beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
2 Receive us; we have wronged no man, we have corrupted no man, we have defrauded no man.

rr: 3 Tindikugamba ekyo kubacwera orubanja; ahakuba nkabagambira kare, ku muri omu mitima yaitu okufa hamwe naitwe, kandi n'okuguma naitwe turi abahuriire.
en: 3 I speak not this to condemn you : for I have said before, that ye are in our hearts to die and live with you .

rr: 4 Nimbeesiga buzima; niinyehimbisa munonga ahabwanyu; nyijwire obuhuumure; nangwa n'omu busaasi bwaitu bwona nyine okushemererwa okushaagire.
en: 4 Great is my boldness of speech toward you, great is my glorying of you: I am filled with comfort, I am exceeding joyful in all our tribulation.

rr: 5 N'obu twahikire Makedonia, emibiri yaitu teraboine kuhuumura na kakye, kureka tukagira obusaasi embaju zoona; aheeru hakaba hariyo engamba, omunda harimu obwoba.
en: 5 For, when we were come into Macedonia, our flesh had no rest, but we were troubled on every side; without were fightings, within were fears.
6 Nevertheless God, that comforteth those that are cast down, comforted us by the coming of Titus;

rr: 7 kandi ti kwija kwe kwonka, kureka n'okuhuumuzibwa oku yaahuumuziibwe omuriimwe, ku yaatuteekyerereize orushusho rwanyu oru munyiniire, n'okurira kwanyu n'obweziriki bwanyu ahabwangye; nikyo kyandeeteire kweyongyera kushemererwa.
en: 7 and not by his coming only, but by the consolation wherewith he was comforted in you, when he told us your earnest desire, your mourning, your fervent mind toward me; so that I rejoiced the more.
8 For though I made you sorry with a letter, I do not repent, though I did repent: for I perceive that the same epistle hath made you sorry, though it were but for a season.

rr: 9 Kwonka hati ninshemererwa, ti habw'okushaasha kwanyu, kureka ahabw'okushaasha oku mwagizire kukabareetera okweteisa; ahakuba mukashaasha omu buryo bwa Ruhanga, ngu mutagira eki mwafeerwa ahabwaitu.
en: 9 Now I rejoice, not that ye were made sorry, but that ye sorrowed to repentance: for ye were made sorry after a godly manner, that ye might receive damage by us in nothing.
10 For godly sorrow worketh repentance to salvation not to be repented of: but the sorrow of the world worketh death.

rr: 11 Mbwenu mureebe okwefuuza oku okw'omu buryo bwa Ruhanga oku kwabareeteire okutaho munonga omutima, kukabareetera okwetonganira, n'okutamwa, n'obwoba, n'okwetenga, n'obweziriki, n'okuhana abarikushobya!
en: 11 For behold this selfsame thing, that ye sorrowed after a godly sort, what carefulness it wrought in you, yea, what clearing of yourselves, yea, what indignation, yea, what fear, yea, what vehement desire, yea, what zeal, yea, what revenge!

rr: Omuri byona mukeeyoreka ku mutaine rubanja omu kigambo ekyo.
en: In all things ye have approved yourselves to be clear in this matter.

rr: 12 N'obu naabahandiikiire, tindabahandiikiire ahabw'ogwo owaasiisire, nari shi ahabw'ogwo owaasiisirwe, kureka ngu mushuuruurirwe obweziriki bwanyu oku buri ahabwaitu omu maisho ga Ruhanga.
en: 12 Wherefore, though I wrote unto you, I did it not for his cause that had done the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered wrong, but that our care for you in the sight of God might appear unto you.

rr: 13 N'ahabw'ekyo tukahuumuzibwa; kandi omu buhuumure obwo twayeyongyera kushemererwa munonga ahabw'okushemererwa kwa Tito, ahakuba mwena mukaruhuura omwoyo gwe.
en: 13 Therefore we were comforted in your comfort: yea, and exceedingly the more joyed we for the joy of Titus, because his spirit was refreshed by you all.

rr: 14 Ku ndaabe naamugambiire ekigambo kyona eky'okwehimbisa ahabwanyu, tindakwatsirwe nshoni; kwonka nk'oku twabagambiire byona omu mazima, nikwo n'okwehimbisa kwaitu ahari Tito kwashangirwe kuri okw'amazima.
en: 14 For if I have boasted any thing to him of you, I am not ashamed; but as we spake all things to you in truth, even so our boasting, which I made before Titus, is found a truth.

rr: 15 Ku aijuka oku mwamworobeire mwena, mukamwakiira mwine obwoba n'okutetema, omutima gwe gweyongyera kubakunda.
en: 15 And his inward affection is more abundant toward you, whilst he remembereth the obedience of you all, how with fear and trembling ye received him.

rr: 16 Naanye ninshemererwa, ahabw'okuba omuri byona ngumire omutima ahabwanyu.
en: 16 I rejoice therefore that I have confidence in you in all things .
1 Moreover, brethren, we do you to wit of the grace of God bestowed on the churches of Macedonia;

rr: 2 Ku baabaire nibakigyezibwa okubonabonesibwa kwingi, okushemererwa kwabo okuhinguraine, n'obworo bwabo bwingi, bikakanya, byabareetera okugaba bingi munonga nk'abatungi.
en: 2 how that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto the riches of their liberality.

rr: 3 Ahakuba nimpamya ngu, bakagaba beekundiire nk'oku baabaasize, nangwa n'okukiraho
en: 3 For to their power, I bear record, yea, and beyond their power they were willing of themselves;
4 praying us with much intreaty that we would receive the gift, and take upon us the fellowship of the ministering to the saints.

rr: 5 Kandi tibarakozire nk'oku twabaire nituteekateeka, kureka bakabanza kwehayo ahari Mukama n'ahariitwe, nk'oku Ruhanga yaakunzire.
en: 5 And this they did , not as we hoped, but first gave their own selves to the Lord, and unto us by the will of God.

rr: 6 Nikyo twayehanangiririize Tito ngu, nk'oku yaatandikire ira, abe nikwo yaahikiiriza omuriimwe omurimo ogu ogw'embabazi.
en: 6 Insomuch that we desired Titus, that as he had begun, so he would also finish in you the same grace also.
7 Therefore, as ye abound in every thing, in faith, and utterance, and knowledge, and in all diligence, and in your love to us, see that ye abound in this grace also.

rr: 8 Ekyo tindikukigamba nk'orikuragiira, kureka niinyenda kuhamya okukunda kwanyu ku kuraabe kuri okw'amazima, niinyihirira aha bweziriki bw'abandi.
en: 8 I speak not by commandment, but by occasion of the forwardness of others, and to prove the sincerity of your love.
9 For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that ye through his poverty might be rich.

rr: 10 Omuri eki nimbagambira eki ndikuteekateeka; imwe abaabandiize abandi kutandika, hahingwire omwaka, kibashemereire kukora; kandi ti kukora kwonka, kureka okukora n'okukunda.
en: 10 And herein I give my advice: for this is expedient for you, who have begun before, not only to do, but also to be forward a year ago.

rr: 11 Kwonka hati mbwenu mwongyereho kuhikiiriza okukora okwo; nk'oku mwayeteekateekire kukikunda, mube nikwo mwakihikiiriza n'ei mwine.
en: 11 Now therefore perform the doing of it ; that as there was a readiness to will, so there may be a performance also out of that which ye have.
12 For if there be first a willing mind, it is accepted according to that a man hath, and not according to that he hath not.

rr: 13 Tindikugamba ntyo kwanguhiza abandi, ngu imwe muremeerwe
en: 13 For I mean not that other men be eased, and ye burdened:
14 but by an equality, that now at this time your abundance may be a supply for their want, that their abundance also may be a supply for your want: that there may be equality:
15 as it is written, He that had gathered much had nothing over; and he that had gathered little had no lack.

rr: 16 Kwonka Ruhanga asiimwe, owaataire omu mutima gwa Tito obweziriki nk'obu nyine ahabwanyu.
en: 16 But thanks be to God, which put the same earnest care into the heart of Titus for you.

rr: 17 Ahakuba taraikiriize kwija ahabw'okushaba kwaitu kwonka, kureka ahabw'obweziriki obu aine ahabwe naija kwija owaanyu ahabw'okwekundira.
en: 17 For indeed he accepted the exhortation; but being more forward, of his own accord he went unto you.

rr: 18 Kandi nitwija kumutuma hamwe n'ow'eishe-emwe, orikusiimwa omu makanisa goona ahabw'okubuurira engiri kwe.
en: 18 And we have sent with him the brother, whose praise is in the gospel throughout all the churches;

rr: 19 T'ekyo kyonka; kandi hoona akatooranwa amakanisa kugyenda naitwe omu murimo ogu ogw'embabazi, itwe ogu turikukora kuhaisa Mukama ekitiinisa, kandi n'okworeka okukunda kwaitu.
en: 19 and not that only, but who was also chosen of the churches to travel with us with this grace, which is administered by us to the glory of the same Lord, and declaration of your ready mind:

rr: 20 Nitwerinda ngu hatagira owaatubeiherera ahabw'ekiconco eki ekihango, eki turikuheereza
en: 20 avoiding this, that no man should blame us in this abundance which is administered by us:
21 providing for honest things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.

rr: 22 Kandi hamwe nabo nitutuma ow'eishe-emwe ondiijo ou tugyerize kaingi, tukashanga ari omweziriki omuri bingi, kandi hati n'omweziriki okukira oku yaabaire ari, ahabw'okuba naabeesiga munonga.
en: 22 And we have sent with them our brother, whom we have oftentimes proved diligent in many things, but now much more diligent, upon the great confidence which I have in you.
23 Whether any do enquire of Titus, he is my partner and fellowhelper concerning you: or our brethren be enquired of, they are the messengers of the churches, and the glory of Christ.

rr: 24 N'ahabw'ekyo muboorekye ebirikuhamya okukunda kwanyu, kandi n'okwehimbisa kwaitu ahabwanyu omu maisho g'amakanisa.
en: 24 Wherefore shew ye to them, and before the churches, the proof of your love, and of our boasting on your behalf.

rr: 1 Aha by'okuhwera abarikwera tindikureeba ki ndikubahandiikirira
en: 1 For as touching the ministering to the saints, it is superfluous for me to write to you:

rr: 2 ahakuba nimmanya okukunda kwanyu, oku ndikweraata ahabwanyu omu Bamakedonia, ningira nti: Abaakaya bamazire omwaka beeteekateekire; kandi obweziriki bwanyu bwezirikiise baingi munonga aharibo.
en: 2 for I know the forwardness of your mind, for which I boast of you to them of Macedonia, that Achaia was ready a year ago; and your zeal hath provoked very many.

rr: 3 Kwonka nintuma ab'eishe-emwe abo ngu okwehimbisa kwaitu ahabwanyu omu kigambo ekyo kutaba kwa busha, kureka babashangye mweteekateekire, nk'oku naagambire
en: 3 Yet have I sent the brethren, lest our boasting of you should be in vain in this behalf; that, as I said, ye may be ready:

rr: 4 ahakuba tindikwenda itwe, (tutagizire imwe) kukwatwa nshoni z'ebyo ebi tubainemu matsiko, Abamakedonia bamwe batakaija naanye, bakashanga muteeteekateekire.
en: 4 lest haply if they of Macedonia come with me, and find you unprepared, we (that we say not, ye) should be ashamed in this same confident boasting.

rr: 5 Nikyo naateekateekyeire ngu kishemereire kweshengyereza ab'eishe-emwe abo kumbandiza okwo, ngu bateekateekye kare ekiconco kyanyu eki mwaraganiise, ira, ngu kishangwe kyatebeekanisiibwe, kiri eky'embabazi, kitari ky'okugyemwa.
en: 5 Therefore I thought it necessary to exhort the brethren, that they would go before unto you, and make up beforehand your bounty, whereof ye had notice before, that the same might be ready, as a matter of bounty, and not as of covetousness.
6 But this I say , He which soweth sparingly shall reap also sparingly; and he which soweth bountifully shall reap also bountifully.
7 Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give ; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.

rr: 8 Ruhanga naabaasa kubakanyisiza emigisha yoona, ngu imwe, ku muraatungye obutoosha ebirikubamara, mubone kugira bingi eby'okuhwera omurimo gwona omurungi.
en: 8 And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things , may abound to every good work:
9 (As it is written,
10 Now he that ministereth seed to the sower both minister bread for your food, and multiply your seed sown, and increase the fruits of your righteousness;)

rr: 11 Naimwe omuri byona muryatungisibwa munonga, mubone kugira obufura oburisiimisa Ruhanga ahabwaitu
en: 11 being enriched in every thing to all bountifulness, which causeth through us thanksgiving to God.

rr: 12 ahakuba okuheereza eby'okuhwera ebyo tikurikumara bworo bw'abarikwera kwonka, beitu kandi nikureetera baingi okukiraho kusiima Ruhanga
en: 12 For the administration of this service not only supplieth the want of the saints, but is abundant also by many thanksgivings unto God;

rr: 13 ahabw'okuba omu kugyezibwa okw'okuheereza oku, Ruhanga naija kuhimbisibwa ahabw'okworoba kwanyu oku mwayorobeire engiri ya Kristo, kandi n'obufura bwanyu omu bintu ebi mwahaire ahabw'abo n'ahabw'abandi boona
en: 13 whiles by the experiment of this ministration they glorify God for your professed subjection unto the gospel of Christ, and for your liberal distribution unto them, and unto all men ;

rr: 14 kandi baryabagirira orushusho, nibabashabira ahabw'embabazi za Ruhanga ezihinguraine omuriimwe.
en: 14 and by their prayer for you, which long after you for the exceeding grace of God in you.

rr: 15 Ruhanga asiimwe ahabw'ekiconco kye ekitarikubaasa kushoboororwa.
en: 15 Thanks be unto God for his unspeakable gift.
1 Now I Paul myself beseech you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ, who in presence am base among you, but being absent am bold toward you:

rr: 2 Nimbeeshengyereza nti: Ku ndiija owaanyu, ndekye kugyemwa kukoresa obumanzi, nk'oku nshemereire kubukoresa aha bantu bamwe abarikututeekateekaho ngu tutwaza nk'abantu nyabuntu.
en: 2 but I beseech you , that I may not be bold when I am present with that confidence, wherewith I think to be bold against some, which think of us as if we walked according to the flesh.

rr: 3 Ahakuba n'obu turaabe ntigyenda, turi abantu abaine omubiri, kwonka titurikurwana nitutwaza nk'abanyamubiri
en: 3 For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh:
4 (for the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;)

rr: 5 nitumaraho tutyo empaka n'ekintu kyona ekirikwetunguura kurwanisa okumanya Ruhanga, kandi nitugomoora ekiteekateeko kyona, ngu kyorobere Kristo
en: 5 casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ;

rr: 6 kandi nikwo tweteekateekire kuhana okutahurira kwona, okworoba kwanyu ku kuraabe kuhikire.
en: 6 and having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.

rr: 7 Mureebe ebiri omu maisho gaanyu.
en: 7 Do ye look on things after the outward appearance?

rr: Omuntu weena ku araabe naayesiga ngu n'owa Kristo, aikukye ngu, nk'oku we ari owa Kristo, naitwe nikwo turi.
en: If any man trust to himself that he is Christ's, let him of himself think this again, that, as he is Christ's, even so are we Christ's.
8 For though I should boast somewhat more of our authority, which the Lord hath given us for edification, and not for your destruction, I should not be ashamed:

rr: 9 Nyowe tinkwenzire kushusha nk'orikubatiinisa n'ebaruha zangye.
en: 9 that I may not seem as if I would terrify you by letters.

rr: 10 Ahakuba nibagira bati: Ebaruha ze zigumire kandi n'ez'amaani; kwonka ku aba ariho, areebeka ari omweremwa, n'ebigambo bye biri ebirikugaywa.
en: 10 For his letters, say they, are weighty and powerful; but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech contemptible.
11 Let such an one think this, that, such as we are in word by letters when we are absent, such will we be also in deed when we are present.

rr: 12 Itwe titurikwehanga kwebarira omu bantu bamwe abarikwehimbisa, nari okweringaaniza nabo; bo ku beegyera aha rugyero rwabo bonka, kandi bayegyeranisa bonka, baba bataine ki barikumanya.
en: 12 For we dare not make ourselves of the number, or compare ourselves with some that commend themselves: but they measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves among themselves, are not wise.
13 But we will not boast of things without our measure, but according to the measure of the rule which God hath distributed to us, a measure to reach even unto you.

rr: 14 Titurikukununkirira okurenga orugyero orwo, nk'abatarabahikire; ahakuba niitwe twabandize kuhika ahariimwe, tubareeteire engiri ya Kristo.
en: 14 For we stretch not ourselves beyond our measure , as though we reached not unto you: for we are come as far as to you also in preaching the gospel of Christ:
15 not boasting of things without our measure, that is , of other men's labours; but having hope, when your faith is increased, that we shall be enlarged by you according to our rule abundantly,
16 to preach the gospel in the regions beyond you, and not to boast in another man's line of things made ready to our hand.

rr: 17 Mbwenu orikwehimbisa ayehimbisize omuri Mukama
en: 17 But he that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.
18 For not he that commendeth himself is approved, but whom the Lord commendeth.

rr: 1 Nkaayenzire ngu mungumisiririze kakye omu bushema bwangye; na mbwenu mungumisiririze!
en: 1 Would to God ye could bear with me a little in my folly: and indeed bear with me.
2 For I am jealous over you with godly jealousy: for I have espoused you to one husband, that I may present you as a chaste virgin to Christ.

rr: 3 Kwonka nyine obwoba nti: Nk'oku enjoka yaategire Haawa n'obugobya bwayo, ebiteekateeko byanyu bikaahabisibwa, muruga omu muhanda ogurikurahuka kandi ogurikwera oguri omuri Kristo.
en: 3 But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.

4 For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached, or if ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received, or another gospel, which ye have not accepted, ye might well bear with him .
5 For I suppose I was not a whit behind the very chiefest apostles.

rr: 6 N'obu ndaabe ndi omushema omu kugamba, kwonka tindi mushema mu bwengye; ahakuba omuri byona tukabubooreka butunu omu maisho g'abantu boona.
en: 6 But though I be rude in speech, yet not in knowledge; but we have been throughly made manifest among you in all things.
7 Have I committed an offence in abasing myself that ye might be exalted, because I have preached to you the gospel of God freely?
8 I robbed other churches, taking wages of them , to do you service.

rr: 9 Ku naabaire ndi owaanyu nkyenire, tindaruhize muntu weena omuriimwe, ahakuba ab'eishe-emwe abaarugire Makedonia nibo bampaire ebi naabaire nkyenire. N'ahabw'ekyo nkeerinda kutabarusya omu muringo gwona; na mbwenu niinyija kuguma niinyerinda.
en: 9 And when I was present with you, and wanted, I was chargeable to no man: for that which was lacking to me the brethren which came from Macedonia supplied: and in all things I have kept myself from being burdensome unto you, and so will I keep myself .
10 As the truth of Christ is in me, no man shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia.

rr: 11 Ahabw'enki? N'ahabw'okutabakunda? Ruhanga naabimanya.
en: 11 Wherefore? because I love you not? God knoweth.

rr: 12 Kandi oku nkora, nikwo ndigumizamu ninkora, ngu mbone kwiha orwekwatso ahari abo abarikwenda kuhamya ngu batwaza nkaitwe omu murimo gwabo ogu barikwehimbisizamu.
en: 12 But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from them which desire occasion; that wherein they glory, they may be found even as we.

rr: 13 Mumanye ngu abantu nk'abo n'entumwa z'ebishuba, n'abakozi engobya, abeehindura nk'entumwa za Kristo.
en: 13 For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.

rr: 14 Kwonka ekyo ti ky'okutangaaza; ahakuba na Sitaane ayehindura nka maraika w'omushana.
en: 14 And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.

rr: 15 N'ahabw'ekyo ti ky'okutangaaza abaheereza be kwehindura nk'abaheereza b'okuhikiirira; emperu yaabo eryashemerera ebi baakozire.
en: 15 Therefore it is no great thing if his ministers also be transformed as the ministers of righteousness; whose end shall be according to their works.
16 I say again, Let no man think me a fool; if otherwise, yet as a fool receive me, that I may boast myself a little.

rr: 17 Eki naaza kugamba, tindikukigamba nk'ekigambo kya Mukama, kureka ninkigamba nk'omushema, niinyesiga ngu nyine eki ndikwehimbisiza.
en: 17 That which I speak, I speak it not after the Lord, but as it were foolishly, in this confidence of boasting.

rr: 18 Nk'oku baingi beehimbisa omu by'obuntu nyabuntu, naanye ka nyehimbise.
en: 18 Seeing that many glory after the flesh, I will glory also.

rr: 19 Ahakuba imwe nk'abanyabwengye mugumisiririza abashema n'okushemererwa!
en: 19 For ye suffer fools gladly, seeing ye yourselves are wise.

rr: 20 Mugumisiririza omuntu ku abagira abahuuku, yaabanyaga, yaabakwata n'amaani, yaabeekuzaho, yaabateera empi z'emishaya.
en: 20 For ye suffer, if a man bring you into bondage, if a man devour you , if a man take of you , if a man exalt himself, if a man smite you on the face.

rr: 21 Ebi naabigamba nyine enshoni, ahakuba itwe tukabibaho abeeremwa.
en: 21 I speak as concerning reproach, as though we had been weak. Howbeit whereinsoever any is bold, (I speak foolishly,) I am bold also.
22 Are they Hebrews? so am I. Are they Israelites? so am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I.

rr: 23 Bo n'abaheereza ba Kristo? Ningamba nk'omushazi, nyowe nimbakira; nimbakira omu kukora munonga, omu kubohwa kaingi omu kihome, omu kuteerwa enkoba okutarikubarwa, omu kabi k'okufa emirundi mingi.
en: 23 Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as a fool) I am more; in labours more abundant, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequent, in deaths oft.
24 Of the Jews five times received I forty stripes save one.
25 Thrice was I beaten with rods, once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, a night and a day I have been in the deep;

rr: 26 omu ngyendo nyingi nkareeba akabi omu migyera, omu bambuzi, omu b'eihanga ryaitu, omu Banyamahanga, omu rurembo, omu ihamba, omu nyanja, omu b'eishe-emwe ab'ebishuba
en: 26 in journeyings often, in perils of waters, in perils of robbers, in perils by mine own countrymen, in perils by the heathen, in perils in the city, in perils in the wilderness, in perils in the sea, in perils among false brethren;

rr: 27 omu kuruha n'omu kufa kubi, omu kuraara aha kiro kaingi, omu njara n'eiriho, omu kubura eby'okurya kaingi, omu mbeho n'okubura eky'okujwara.
en: 27 in weariness and painfulness, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.
28 Beside those things that are without, that which cometh upon me daily, the care of all the churches.

rr: 29 N'oha obura amaani, naanye ntabure maani? N'oha ogwisibwa, kitangwise kubi?
en: 29 Who is weak, and I am not weak? who is offended, and I burn not?
30 If I must needs glory, I will glory of the things which concern mine infirmities.

rr: 31 Ruhanga, Ishe wa Mukama waitu Yesu, orikusiimwa ebiro byona, naamanya ku ntarikubeiha.
en: 31 The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which is blessed for evermore, knoweth that I lie not.

rr: 32 Omuri Damasiko, omutegyeki w'omugabe Areta akarinda orurembo orwo, ngu ankwate
en: 32 In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king kept the city of the Damascenes with a garrison, desirous to apprehend me:
33 and through a window in a basket was I let down by the wall, and escaped his hands.

rr: 1 Kinshemereire kwehimbisa, n'obu kuraabe kutaine mugasho; kwonka niinyija kugamba eby'okworekwa n'ebi Mukama yanshuururiire.
en: 1 It is not expedient for me doubtless to glory. I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.

rr: 2 Nimmanya omuntu ow'omuri Kristo, owaakwatsire akatwarwa omu iguru rya kashatu, emyaka ikumi n'ena ehingwire; (yaaba yaabaire ari omu mubiri, nari atari mu mubiri, tindikukimanya; nikimanywa Ruhanga.)
en: 2 I knew a man in Christ above fourteen years ago, (whether in the body, I cannot tell; or whether out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;) such an one caught up to the third heaven.

rr: 3 Kandi nimmanya ngu omuntu ogwo akakwatwa yaatwarwa omuri # 12:3 Paradiso: reeba Luk 23:43. Paradiso, (yaaba yaabaire ari omu mubiri nari atari mu mubiri, tindikumanya; nikimanywa Ruhanga)
en: 3 And I knew such a man, (whether in the body, or out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;)
4 how that he was caught up into paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.

rr: 5 Ka nyehimbise ahabw'omuntu ogwo; kwonka ahabwangye tindikwija kwehimbisa, kureka ahabw'obweremwa bwangye.
en: 5 Of such an one will I glory: yet of myself I will not glory, but in mine infirmities.

rr: 6 Ku naakwenda kwehimbisa, tinkaaba mushema, ahakuba nkaaba ningamba amazima. Kwonka tinkikora, ngu hatagira omuntu owanteekateekaho okukira ebi arikundeebamu n'ebi arikumpuriraho.
en: 6 For though I would desire to glory, I shall not be a fool; for I will say the truth: but now I forbear, lest any man should think of me above that which he seeth me to be , or that he heareth of me.

7 And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.
8 For this thing I besought the Lord thrice, that it might depart from me.

rr: 9 Yangarukamu ati: Embabazi zangye nizikumara, ahabw'okuba amaani gangye gahikiiririzibwa omu bweremwa.
en: 9 And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo niinyija kwehimbisa n'okuhsmererwa kwingi ahabw'obweremwa bwangye, ngu amaani ga Kristo gabone kungumaho.
en: Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
10 Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ's sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.

rr: 11 Mbaire omushema, kwonka niimwe mwakingyemire; ahabw'okuba niimwe mwabaire mushemereire kumpimbisa. Mumanye ngu, n'obu ndaabe ntari kintu, ezo ntumwa nkuru munonga tiziine ki zankirize na kakye.
en: 11 I am become a fool in glorying; ye have compelled me: for I ought to have been commended of you: for in nothing am I behind the very chiefest apostles, though I be nothing.

rr: 12 Buzimazima ebirikuhamya entumwa nkabikorera omuriimwe omu kugumisiriza kwingi, ninkora obumanyiso n'eby'okutangaaza n'eby'amaani.
en: 12 Truly the signs of an apostle were wrought among you in all patience, in signs, and wonders, and mighty deeds.

rr: 13 Amakanisa agandi gakabakiza ki? kureka nyowe okutabarusya. Munsaasire ekishobyo ekyo!
en: 13 For what is it wherein ye were inferior to other churches, except it be that I myself was not burdensome to you? forgive me this wrong.

rr: 14 Mbwenu nyeteekateekire kwija owaanyu omurundi gwa kashatu; kwonka tindibarusya, ahakuba tindikwenda byanyu, kureka niimwe ndikwenda; nimumanya ngu abaana tibo bashemereire kubiikira abazire baabo, kureka abazaire nibo babiikira abaana.
en: 14 Behold, the third time I am ready to come to you; and I will not be burdensome to you: for I seek not your's, but you: for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.

rr: 15 Ahabwangye ndyashemererwa munonga kuhayo ebyangye, kandi n'okwehayo nyeheyo ahabw'amagara gaanyu. Obu mbakunzire munonga, nibwo nkunzirwe kakye.
en: 15 And I will very gladly spend and be spent for you; though the more abundantly I love you, the less I be loved.

rr: 16 Imwe nimugira ngu okubarusya tindabaruhize; ngu kwonka nkabaitsa obwengye, naabagobeza.
en: 16 But be it so, I did not burden you: nevertheless, being crafty, I caught you with guile.

rr: 17 Beitu shi, omuri abo abu naabatumireho hariho oine eki yaabaanyihiireho?
en: 17 Did I make a gain of you by any of them whom I sent unto you?
18 I desired Titus, and with him I sent a brother. Did Titus make a gain of you? walked we not in the same spirit? walked we not in the same steps?

rr: 19 Okuruga ira n'okuhitsya hati muteekateeka ngu nitwerwanaho ahariimwe? Mumanye ngu ebi tugamba tubigambira omuri Kristo omu maisho ga Ruhanga, kandi byona, abarikukundwa munonga, tubigamba ahabw'okubombeka.
en: 19 Again, think ye that we excuse ourselves unto you? we speak before God in Christ: but we do all things, dearly beloved, for your edifying.

20 For I fear, lest, when I come, I shall not find you such as I would, and that I shall be found unto you such as ye would not: lest there be debates, envyings, wraths, strifes, backbitings, whisperings, swellings, tumults:

rr: 21 kandi ngu, ku ndiija, Ruhanga wangye aryancureeza omu maisho gaanyu, naanye nsaasibwe baingi abaasiisire kare, bateeteise bihagaro n'obushambani n'okurigirana okubi, ebi baakozire.
en: 21 and lest, when I come again, my God will humble me among you, and that I shall bewail many which have sinned already, and have not repented of the uncleanness and fornication and lasciviousness which they have committed.
1 This is the third time I am coming to you. In the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.

rr: 2 Obu naabaire ndi owaanyu obwa kabiri, nkabateisa; na mbwenu n'obu ntari okwo, nimbateisa ntakaizire, nti: Abo abaasiisire n'abandi boona, ku ndiba naizire, tindibasaasira
en: 2 I told you before, and foretell you, as if I were present, the second time; and being absent now I write to them which heretofore have sinned, and to all other, that, if I come again, I will not spare:

rr: 3 ahakuba musherura ekirikuhamya ngu Kristo niwe angambisa. We ti mweremwa ahariimwe, kureka n'Ow'amaani omuriimwe
en: 3 since ye seek a proof of Christ speaking in me, which to you-ward is not weak, but is mighty in you.
4 For though he was crucified through weakness, yet he liveth by the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we shall live with him by the power of God toward you.
5 Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves. Know ye not your own selves, how that Jesus Christ is in you, except ye be reprobates?

rr: 6 Kwonka nyine amatsiko ngu nimwija kumanya ku tutari batarikwikirizibwa.
en: 6 But I trust that ye shall know that we are not reprobates.

rr: 7 Kandi nitushaba Ruhanga ngu murekye kukora ekibi, ti habwe okugira ngu itwe tureebekye nitusiimwa, kureka n'okubendeza ngu mukore ebihikire, n'obu twakureebeka nk'abatarikwikirizibwa.
en: 7 Now I pray to God that ye do no evil; not that we should appear approved, but that ye should do that which is honest, though we be as reprobates.

rr: 8 Mumanye ngu titurikubaasa kurwanisa amazima, kureka okugarwanirira.
en: 8 For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.

rr: 9 Nikitushemeza itwe kuba abeeremwa, imwe mukaba ab'amaani; eki turikubashabira n'eki, ngu mube abarikuhikiririzibwa kimwe.
en: 9 For we are glad, when we are weak, and ye are strong: and this also we wish, even your perfection.
10 Therefore I write these things being absent, lest being present I should use sharpness, according to the power which the Lord hath given me to edification, and not to destruction.

rr: 11 Eky'aha muheru, B'eishe-emwe, mugumeho.
en: 11 Finally, brethren, farewell.

rr: Muhikiririzibwe kimwe, muhuguurane, mugire omutima gumwe, mugume n'obusingye; obwo nibwo Ruhanga ow'okukunda n'obusingye ariguma naimwe.
en: Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace shall be with you.

rr: 12 Muramukanise okunywegyera okurikwera.
en: 12 Greet one another with an holy kiss.

rr: 13 Abarikwera boona baabaramutsya.
en: 13 All the saints salute you.

rr: 14 Embabazi za Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo, n'okukunda kwa Ruhanga, n'okukwatanisa kw'Omwoyo Orikwera bigume naimwe mwena.
en: 14 The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Ghost, be with you all. Amen.

rr: 1 Nyowe nk'omukuru naakuhandiikira, iwe Omuzaire owaatoorainwe n'abaana baawe, abu ndikukunda omu mazima, kandi tiinye nyenka kureka n'abandi boona abarikumanya amazima
en: 1 The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth;

rr: 2 ahabw'amazima agatuura omuriitwe, kandi agariguma naitwe ebiro byona
en: 2 for the truth's sake, which dwelleth in us, and shall be with us for ever.

rr: 3 embabazi n'okusaasira n'obusingye ebirikuruga ahari Ruhanga Isheboona na Yesu Kristo Omwana we, biryaguma naitwe omu mazima n'okukunda.
en: 3 Grace be with you, mercy, and peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

rr: 4 Nkashemererwa munonga ahakuba nkashanga abamwe aha baana baawe nibagyendera omu mazima nk'oku twaragiirwe Isheboona.
en: 4 I rejoiced greatly that I found of thy children walking in truth, as we have received a commandment from the Father.
5 And now I beseech thee, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment unto thee, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.

rr: 6 Kandi oku nikwo kukunda, itwe okugyendera omu biragiro bye.
en: 6 And this is love, that we walk after his commandments.

rr: Eki nikyo kiragiro, nk'oku mwahuriire okuruga iranaira, ngu mube nikyo mwagyenderamu.
en: This is the commandment, That, as ye have heard from the beginning, ye should walk in it.
7 For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.
8 Look to yourselves, that we lose not those things which we have wrought, but that we receive a full reward.

rr: 9 Omuntu weena orikurenzya aha nyengyesa ya Kristo atagigumiremu, naaba ataine Ruhanga; orikugumira omu nyegyesa egyo, ogwo naaba aine Isheboona kandi n'Omwana.
en: 9 Whosoever transgresseth, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Son.
10 If there come any unto you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into your house, neither bid him God speed:

rr: 11 ahakuba orimuramutsya, aryaba akwataniise nawe omu micwe ye emibi.
en: 11 for he that biddeth him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds.

rr: 12 N'obu ndaabe nyine bingi kubahandiikira, kwonka tindikusiima kubihandiikisa bwino aha rupapura; ahakuba nyine amatsiko kwija okwo kugaaniira naimwe nitureebana, tubone kuhitsya okushemererwa kwaitu.
en: 12 Having many things to write unto you, I would not write with paper and ink: but I trust to come unto you, and speak face to face, that our joy may be full.

rr: 13 Abaana ba murumuna waawe baakuramutsya.
en: 13 The children of thy elect sister greet thee. Amen.

rr: Ahabu ku yaaherize kufa, Abamoabu baagomera Abaisraeli.
en: Then Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab.

rr: Omu biro ebyo Ahazia akooga omu dirisa ey'ekishengye kye ky'ahaiguru omuri Samaria, yaagwa, yaarwara; atyo yaatuma entumwa naazigira ati: Mwirooko, muraguze ahari Baali-zebubi, ruhanga wa Ekurooni, yaaba ndikira egi ndwara.
en: And Ahaziah fell down through a lattice in his upper chamber that was in Samaria, and was sick: and he sent messengers, and said unto them, Go, enquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron whether I shall recover of this disease. Elijah and the Messengers

rr: Kwonka maraika wa MUKAMA yaagira Eliya owa Tishubi ati: Imuka oinamukye, obugane entumwa z'omugabe wa Samaria, ozigire oti: Ekirikuza kukuragurizisa ahari Baali-zebubi, ruhanga wa Ekurooni, n'ahabw'okuba omuri Israeli tiharimu Ruhanga?
en: But the angel of the LORD said to Elijah the Tishbite, Arise, go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria, and say unto them, Is it not because there is not a God in Israel, that ye go to enquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron?

rr: Mbwenu oku nikwo MUKAMA arikugamba naagira ati: Torikwija kuruga ha kishego ki oriho; buzimazima noija kufa.
en: Now therefore thus saith the LORD , Thou shalt not come down from that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die.

rr: Atyo Eliya yaazayo.
en: And Elijah departed.

rr: Ezo ntumwa ku zaagarukire aha mugabe, yaazibuuza ati: Mwagarurwa ki?
en: And when the messengers turned back unto him, he said unto them, Why are ye now turned back?

rr: Baamugarukamu bati: Tubugainwe omushaija, yaatugira ati: Mwirooko mugarukye aha mugabe obatumire, mumugire muti: Oku nikwo MUKAMA arikugamba naagira ati: Ekirikuza kukuragurizisa ahari Baali-zebubi, ruhanga wa Ekurooni, n'ahabw'okuba omuri Israeli tiharimu Ruhanga? N'ahabw'ekyo torikwija kuruga ha kishego eki oriho; buzimazima noija kufa.
en: And they said unto him, There came a man up to meet us, and said unto us, Go, turn again unto the king that sent you, and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD , Is it not because there is not a God in Israel, that thou sendest to enquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron? therefore thou shalt not come down from that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die.

rr: Yaababuuza ati: Ni muntu ki obabugaine, akabagambira ebigambo ebyo?
en: And he said unto them, What manner of man was he which came up to meet you, and told you these words?

rr: Baamugarukamu bati: Abaire ajwaire ekijwaro ky'ebyoya, ayezirikiise orukoba.
en: And they answered him, He was an hairy man, and girt with a girdle of leather about his loins.

rr: Onu yaagira ati: Ni Eliya owa Tishubi.
en: And he said, It is Elijah the Tishbite.

rr: Bwanyima omugabe yaamutumaho omukuru w'engabo makumi ataano hamwe n'ezo ngabo ze. Yainamuka, yaashanga Eliya ashutami aha mutwe gw'ekibungo, yaamugira ati: Iwe mushaija wa Ruhanga 'we, omugabe naakugira ngu oshuume.
en: Then the king sent unto him a captain of fifty with his fifty. And he went up to him: and, behold, he sat on the top of an hill. And he spake unto him, Thou man of God, the king hath said, Come down.

rr: Eliya yaagarukamu ogwo mukuru w'engabo ataano ati: Ku ndaabe ndi omushaija wa Ruhanga, omuriro nigurugye omu iguru, gukumareho n'engabo zaawe makumi ataano.
en: And Elijah answered and said to the captain of fifty, If I be a man of God, then let fire come down from heaven, and consume thee and thy fifty.

rr: Ahonaaho omuriro gwaruga omu iguru, gwamumaraho n'engabo ze makumi ataano.
en: And there came down fire from heaven, and consumed him and his fifty.

rr: Omugabe yaagaruka yaamutumaho ondiijo mukuru w'engabo makumi ataano hamwe n'engabo ze.
en: Again also he sent unto him another captain of fifty with his fifty.

rr: Yainamuka, yaamugira ati: Iwe mushaija wa Ruhanga 'we, ekiragiro ky'omugabe nikigira kiti: Shuuma ahonaaho.
en: And he answered and said unto him, O man of God, thus hath the king said, Come down quickly.

rr: Eliya yaabagarukamu ati: Ku ndaabe ndi omushaija wa Ruhanga, omuriro gurugye omu iguru, gukumareho n'engabo zaawe makumi ataano.
en: And Elijah answered and said unto them, If I be a man of God, let fire come down from heaven, and consume thee and thy fifty.

rr: Ahonaaho omuriro gwa Ruhanga gwaruga omu iguru, gwamumaraho n'engabo ze makumi ataano.
en: And the fire of God came down from heaven, and consumed him and his fifty.

rr: Omugabe yaagaruka yaatuma ondiijo mukuru w'engabo makumi ataano obwa kashatu hamwe n'ezo ngabo ze.
en: And he sent again a captain of the third fifty with his fifty.

rr: Ogwo mukuru w'engabo wa kashatu yainamuka, yaashanga Eliya, yaamutsimbira amaju, yaamweshengyereza naagira ati: Ai bambe, iwe mushaija wa Ruhanga 'we, ninkweshengyereza, reka amagara gangye n'ag'abairu baawe makumi ataano gabe ag'obuguzi bwingi omu maisho gaawe.
en: And the third captain of fifty went up, and came and fell on his knees before Elijah, and besought him, and said unto him, O man of God, I pray thee, let my life, and the life of these fifty thy servants, be precious in thy sight.

rr: Reeba, omuriro gurugire omu iguru, gwamaraho abakuru b'engabo abambandiize hamwe n'engabo zaabo makumi ataano-ataano; kwonka mbwenu reka amagara gangye gabe ag'obuguzi bwingi omu maisho gaawe.
en: Behold, there came fire down from heaven, and burnt up the two captains of the former fifties with their fifties: therefore let my life now be precious in thy sight.

rr: Bwanyima maraika wa MUKAMA yaagira Eliya ati: Shuuma nawe; otamutiina.
en: And the angel of the LORD said unto Elijah, Go down with him: be not afraid of him.

rr: Atyo yaimuka, yaashuuma nawe aha mugabe
en: And he arose, and went down with him unto the king.

rr: yaamugira ati: Oku nikwo MUKAMA arikugamba naagira ati: Waaza kutuma entumwa kukuragurizisa ahari Baali-zebubi, ruhanga wa Ekurooni, omuri Israeli habaire hatarimu Ruhanga w'okwehanuuzaho? Ahabw'ekyo torikwija kuruga aha kishego eki oriho; buzimazima noija kufa.
en: And he said unto him, Thus saith the LORD , Forasmuch as thou hast sent messengers to enquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron, is it not because there is no God in Israel to enquire of his word? therefore thou shalt not come down off that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die.

rr: Atyo omugabe yaafa, nk'ekigambo kya MUKAMA eki Eliya yaagambire oku kyabaire kiri.
en: So he died according to the word of the LORD which Elijah had spoken.

rr: Omu mwaka gwa kabiri ogw'omu busingye bwa Yehoraamu mwene Yehoshafaati omugabe wa Yuda, Yehoraamu omurumuna yaaba omugabe omu mwanya gwe, ahabw'okuba Ahazia ogwo akaba ataine mutabani.
en: And Jehoram reigned in his stead in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah; because he had no son.

rr: Mbwenu endiijo mirimo ei Ahazia yaakozire tehandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'eby'omu busingye bw'abagabe ba Israeli?
en: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaziah which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

1 -21 ; . MUKAMA ku yaabaire ari haihi kutwara Eliya omu iguru n'omuyaga gw'akasooroora, Eliya na Elisa bakaba bari omu muhanda nibaruga Gilugaali.
en: And it came to pass, when the LORD would take up Elijah into heaven by a whirlwind, that Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.

rr: Eliya yaagira Elisa ati: Ninkweshengyereza, guma aha; ahakuba MUKAMA yantuma Beseeli.
en: And Elijah said unto Elisha, Tarry here, I pray thee; for the LORD hath sent me to Beth-el.

rr: Kwonka Elisa yaagira ati: Nindahira MUKAMA, kandi ninkurahira, tindikwija kukurugaho.
en: And Elisha said unto him , As the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee.

rr: Batyo baashuuma, baaza Beseeli.
en: So they went down to Beth-el.

rr: Abaana ba baanabi, abaabaire bari Beseeli, baashohora, baashanga Elisa, baamugira bati: Noomanya ku eri izooba MUKAMA arikwija kutwara mukama waawe, akamukwihaho?
en: And the sons of the prophets that were at Beth-el came forth to Elisha, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the LORD will take away thy master from thy head to day?

rr: Onu ati: Eego ninkimanya; kwonka, nimwetsize.
en: And he said, Yea, I know it ; hold ye your peace.

rr: Eliya yaagira Elisa ati: Elisa, ninkweshengyereza guma aha, ahakuba MUKAMA yantuma Yeriko.
en: And Elijah said unto him, Elisha, tarry here, I pray thee; for the LORD hath sent me to Jericho.

rr: Kwonka Elisa yaagira ati: Nindahira MUKAMA, kandi ninkurahira, tindikwija kukurugaho.
en: And he said, As the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee.

rr: Batyo baahika Yeriko.
en: So they came to Jericho.

rr: Abaana ba baanabi abaabaire bari Yeriko, bairirira Elisa, baamugira bati: Noomanya ku eri izooba MUKAMA arikwija kutwara mukama waawe, akamukwihaho?
en: And the sons of the prophets that were at Jericho came to Elisha, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the LORD will take away thy master from thy head to day?

rr: Yaagarukamu ati: Eego, ninkimanya; kwonka nimwetsize.
en: And he answered, Yea, I know it ; hold ye your peace.

rr: Bwanyima Eliya yaamugira ati: Ninkweshengyereza guma aha; ahakuba MUKAMA yantuma Yorudani.
en: And Elijah said unto him, Tarry, I pray thee, here; for the LORD hath sent me to Jordan.

rr: Kwonka Elisa yaagira ati: Nindahira MUKAMA, kandi ninkurahira, tindikwija kukurugaho.
en: And he said, As the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee.

rr: Batyo baagumizamu bombi.
en: And they two went on.

rr: Abashaija makumi ataano ab'omu baana ba baanabi nabo baagyenda, baabeemerera hangahari, nibareeba Eliya na Elisa beemereire aha rubaju rwa Yorudani.
en: And fifty men of the sons of the prophets went, and stood to view afar off: and they two stood by Jordan.

rr: Bwanyima Eliya yaajuura omunagiro gwe, yaagukubamu, yaateera amaizi; ahonaaho amaizi gaayecwamu habiri oku n'oku, bombi baayambukira ahoomire.
en: And Elijah took his mantle, and wrapped it together, and smote the waters, and they were divided hither and thither, so that they two went over on dry ground.

rr: Ku baaherize kwambuka, Eliya yaagira Elisa ati: Shaba eki ndaakukorere, ntakakwihirweho.
en: And it came to pass, when they were gone over, that Elijah said unto Elisha, Ask what I shall do for thee, before I be taken away from thee.

rr: Elisa yaagira ati: Ninkweshengyereza, ndaga emigabo ebiri y'omwoyo gwawe.
en: And Elisha said, I pray thee, let a double portion of thy spirit be upon me.

rr: Onu yaagira ati: Waashaba ekigumire; kwonka ku orandeebe ninkwihwaho, noija kukitunga; ku oraabe otandeebire, tikirikwija kuba kityo.
en: And he said, Thou hast asked a hard thing: nevertheless , if thou see me when I am taken from thee, it shall be so unto thee; but if not, it shall not be so .

rr: Ku baabaire nibakigyenda nibagaaniira, ahonaaho haija ekigaari ky'omuriro n'embaraasi z'omuriro, byabataanisa. Eliya yaatwarwa omuyaga gw'akasooroora, yaatemba omu iguru.
en: And it came to pass, as they still went on, and talked, that, behold, there appeared a chariot of fire, and horses of fire, and parted them both asunder; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.

rr: Elisa ku yaakireebire, yaagamba munonga, naagira ati: Taata! Taata! Ebigaari bya Israeli n'embaraasi zaayo! Tiyaagaruka kumureeba. Ahonaaho yaakwata ebijwaro bye, yaabitaaguramu ebicweka bibiri.
en: And Elisha saw it , and he cried, My father, my father, the chariot of Israel, and the horsemen thereof. And he saw him no more: and he took hold of his own clothes, and rent them in two pieces.

rr: Bwanyima yaihaho omunagiro gwa Eliya ogwamuragara, yaagarukayo, yaayemerera aha rubaju rwa Yorudani.
en: He took up also the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and went back, and stood by the bank of Jordan;

rr: Yaakwata ogwo munagiro gwa Eliya ogwamuragara, yaateera amaizi naagira ati: MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa Eliya, arahi?
en: and he took the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and smote the waters, and said, Where is the LORD God of Elijah? and when he also had smitten the waters, they parted hither and thither: and Elisha went over.

rr: Ku yaateire amaizi, gaayebaganisamu habiri, yaayambuka.
en: Elisha

rr: Abaana ba baanabi abaabaire bari Yeriko, ku baamureebire abari omumaisho, baagira bati: Omwoyo gwa Eliya guri ahari Elisa.
en: And when the sons of the prophets which were to view at Jericho saw him, they said, The spirit of Elijah doth rest on Elisha.

rr: Baija kumubugana, baamwinamira
en: And they came to meet him, and bowed themselves to the ground before him.

rr: baamugira bati: Reeba, itwe abairu baawe twine abashaija b'amaani makumi ataano; nitukweshengyereza, ka bagyende, basherure mukama waawe. Obundi Omwoyo wa MUKAMA akaaba amukiriize, amunagire omu kibungo nari omu ruhanga ahatarikumanywa. Onu ati: Mutabatuma.
en: And they said unto him, Behold now, there be with thy servants fifty strong men; let them go, we pray thee, and seek thy master: lest peradventure the Spirit of the LORD hath taken him up, and cast him upon some mountain, or into some valley. And he said, Ye shall not send.

rr: Kwonka ku baamweshengyereize munonga, yaarugaho yaakwatwa enshoni, yaabagira ati: Mubatume.
en: And when they urged him till he was ashamed, he said, Send.

rr: Batyo baatuma abashaija makumi ataano, baamara ebiro bishatu nibamusherura, tibaamubona.
en: They sent therefore fifty men; and they sought three days, but found him not.

rr: Ku baamugarukireho, baashanga akiri Yeriko, yaabagira ati: Timbagizire nti: Mutagyenda?
en: And when they came again to him, (for he tarried at Jericho,) he said unto them, Did I not say unto you, Go not?

rr: Elisa okushemeza amaizi
en: Healed the Waters

rr: Abashaija b'orwo rurembo baagira Elisa bati: Reeba Mukama waitu, naiwe nk'oku orikureeba, ahu orurembo rwombekirwe ni harungi, kwonka amaizi gaaho ni mabi, n'eitaka ryaho tiririkweza.
en: And the men of the city said unto Elisha, Behold, I pray thee, the situation of this city is pleasant, as my lord seeth: but the water is naught, and the ground barren.

rr: Yaagira ati: Mundeetere akaabya kasya, mukatemu omwonyo. Batyo bakamureetera.
en: And he said, Bring me a new cruse, and put salt therein. And they brought it to him.

rr: Yaaza aha nshuro y'amaizi, yaaginagamu omwonyo, yaagira ati: Oku nikwo MUKAMA arikugamba naagira ati: Naatambira aga maizi; okuruga hati tigakirugwamu rufu nari okutorooga.
en: And he went forth unto the spring of the waters, and cast the salt in there, and said, Thus saith the LORD , I have healed these waters; there shall not be from thence any more death or barren land .

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo ago maizi gaashemera okwiha obwo n'okuhitsya eri izooba, nk'ekigambo eki Elisa yaagambire oku kyabaire kiri.
en: So the waters were healed unto this day, according to the saying of Elisha which he spake.

rr: Yaarugayo, yainamuka, yaaza Beseeli; ku yaabaire naakigyenda, haija abatsigazi bato nibaruga omu rurembo, baamugaaniiza nibagira bati: Iwe mushaija w'oruhara 'we, inamuka! Iwe mushaija w'oruhara 'we, inamuka!
en: And he went up from thence unto Beth-el: and as he was going up by the way, there came forth little children out of the city, and mocked him, and said unto him, Go up, thou bald head; go up, thou bald head.

rr: Yaahinduka; ku yaabareebire, yaabakyeena omu iziina rya MUKAMA; ahonaaho haija edubu ibiri z'enkazi zaaruga omu kibira, zaabataagataaguramu abatsigazi makumi ana na babiri.
en: And he turned back, and looked on them, and cursed them in the name of the LORD . And there came forth two she bears out of the wood, and tare forty and two children of them.

rr: Okuruga aho yaagumizamu, yaaza aha kibungo kya Karumeeli; yaarugayo, yaagaruka Samaria.
en: And he went from thence to mount Carmel, and from thence he returned to Samaria.
