rr: Omu mwaka gwa ikumi na munaana gw'omu busingye bwa Yehoshafaati omugabe wa Yuda, Yehoraamu mwene Ahabu akaba omugabe wa Israeli omuri Samaria, yaamara aha ngoma emyaka ikumi n'ebiri.
en: Now Jehoram the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned twelve years.

rr: Yaakora ebirikwangwa MUKAMA, n'obu araabe atarabaire mubi nka ishe na nyina; ahakuba akihaho enyomyo ya Baali, ei ishe yaakozire.
en: And he wrought evil in the sight of the LORD ; but not like his father, and like his mother: for he put away the image of Baal that his father had made.
Nevertheless he cleaved unto the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which made Israel to sin; he departed not therefrom.

rr: Kwonka yaagumira omu kibi kya Yeroboamu mwene Nebati, eki yaasiisiise Abaisraeli; tiyaakireka.
en: Fills the Water Trenches

rr: Mesha omugabe wa Moabu akaba ari omworozi w'entaama. Buri mwaka akaba aragiirwe kuha omugabe wa Israeli abaana b'entaama akasiriira.
en: And Mesha king of Moab was a sheepmaster, and rendered unto the king of Israel an hundred thousand lambs, and an hundred thousand rams, with the wool.

rr: Kwonka Ahabu ku yaafiire, omugabe wa Moabu yaagomera omugabe wa Israeli.
en: But it came to pass, when Ahab was dead, that the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo omugabe Yehoraamu yaaruga Samaria omu bunaku obwo, yaateerana Abaisraeli boona kuhurura.
en: And king Jehoram went out of Samaria the same time, and numbered all Israel.

rr: Yaagyenda, yaatuma ahari Yehoshafaati omugabe wa Yuda, naamugira ati: Omugabe wa Moabu angomeire; noikiriza kuhurura naanye, tukateera Moabu?
en: And he went and sent to Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, saying, The king of Moab hath rebelled against me: wilt thou go with me against Moab to battle?

rr: Onu yaamugarukamu ati: Eego, niinyija kuhurura; nyowe naiwe turi bamwe; abantu bangye nibo baawe, n'embaraasi zangye nizo zaawe.
en: And he said, I will go up: I am as thou art , my people as thy people, and my horses as thy horses.

rr: Yaagaruka yaagira ati: Tutoore guuha nituhurura? Yehoraamu yaamugarukamu ati: Tutoore ogw'eihamba rya Edomu.
en: And he said, Which way shall we go up? And he answered, The way through the wilderness of Edom.

rr: Atyo omugabe wa Israeli yaahurura n'omugabe wa Yuda n'owa Edomu. Ku baaherize orugyendo rw'ebiro mushanju nibeekiikuura, haabura amaizi g'eihe n'obu gaakuba ag'enyamaishwa ezi baagyenzire nazo.
en: So the king of Israel went, and the king of Judah, and the king of Edom: and they fetched a compass of seven days' journey: and there was no water for the host, and for the cattle that followed them.

rr: Omugabe wa Israeli nikwo kugira ati: Ai bambe! MUKAMA atureetsire twenshatu kutuhayo omu mikono y'Abamoabu.
en: And the king of Israel said, Alas! that the LORD hath called these three kings together, to deliver them into the hand of Moab!

rr: Yehoshafaati yaamubuuza ati: Aha tihariho nabi wa MUKAMA, ou twakwehanuuzaho ahari MUKAMA.
en: But Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of the LORD , that we may enquire of the LORD by him?

rr: Omwe aha bagaragwa b'omugabe wa Israeli yaagarukamu ati: Aha hariho Elisa mwene Shafati, owaabaire anaabisa Eliya engaro.
en: And one of the king of Israel's servants answered and said, Here is Elisha the son of Shaphat, which poured water on the hands of Elijah.

rr: Yehoshafaati yaagira ati: Ekigambo kya MUKAMA kiri omuriwe.
en: And Jehoshaphat said, The word of the LORD is with him.

rr: Atyo omugabe wa Israeli yaashuuma ahari Elisa hamwe na Yehoshafaati n'omgabe wa Edomu.
en: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.

rr: Elisa yaagira omugabe wa Israeli ati: Nyine kakwate ki naiwe? Irooko oyehanuuze ahari baanabi ba sho n'aha ba nyoko. Omugabe wa Israeli yaagira ati: Ngaaha! MUKAMA niwe atuhurwize twenshatu, ngu atuheyo omu mikono y'Abamoabu.
en: And Elisha said unto the king of Israel, What have I to do with thee? get thee to the prophets of thy father, and to the prophets of thy mother. And the king of Israel said unto him, Nay: for the LORD hath called these three kings together, to deliver them into the hand of Moab.

rr: Elisa yaagira ati: Nindahira MUKAMA ow'amahe, ou mpeereza, kuri ntaagirira Yehoshafaati omugabe wa Yuda eshoni, tinkukucwire ryera, n'obu kwakuba okukureeba.
en: And Elisha said, As the LORD of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, surely, were it not that I regard the presence of Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, I would not look toward thee, nor see thee.

rr: Kwonka mbwenu mundeetere omuteezi w'enanga. Omuteezi w'enanga ku yaagiteire, amaani ga MUKAMA gaamwijaho.
en: But now bring me a minstrel. And it came to pass, when the minstrel played, that the hand of the LORD came upon him.

rr: Yaagira ati: Oku nikwo MUKAMA arikugamba naagira ati: 3:16 nari: Niinyija kwijuza omukura ogu ogwomire amaizi. Mwijuze oru ruhanga emikura
en: And he said, Thus saith the LORD , Make this valley full of ditches.

rr: ahakuba oku nikwo MUKAMA arikugamba naagira ati: Timurikwija kureeba muyaga n'obu yaakuba enjura, kwonka oru ruhanga nirwija kwijura amaizi, mubone kunywa, n'ente zaanyu n'enyamaishwa zaanyu.
en: For thus saith the LORD , Ye shall not see wind, neither shall ye see rain; yet that valley shall be filled with water, that ye may drink, both ye, and your cattle, and your beasts.

rr: Ekyo n'ekigambo kikye ahari MUKAMA; kandi naija kuhayo n'Abamoabu omu mikono yaanyu
en: And this is but a light thing in the sight of the LORD : he will deliver the Moabites also into your hand.

rr: kandi nimwija kucwekyereza orurembo rwona oruriho orugo orwehinguririziibwe orugo rw'amabaare, n'orurembo rwona orurungi, kandi muteme omuti gwona omurungi, mwigare enshuro zoona ez'amaizi, mushiishe omusiri gwona omurungi n'amabaare.
en: And ye shall smite every fenced city, and every choice city, and shall fell every good tree, and stop all wells of water, and mar every good piece of land with stones.

rr: Ku bwaseesire, omu bunaku bw'okuhayo ekitambo, ahonaaho amaizi gaija nigaruga Edomu, ensi yaijura amaizi.
en: And it came to pass in the morning, when the meat offering was offered, that, behold, there came water by the way of Edom, and the country was filled with water.

rr: Abamoabu boona ku baahuriire ngu abo bagabe baizire kurwana nabo, baahuruza boona abaabaire nibabaasa kujwara eby'okurwanisa, okwiha aha muto okuhika aha mukuru, baayemerera aha mwatano.
en: And when all the Moabites heard that the kings were come up to fight against them, they gathered all that were able to put on armour, and upward, and stood in the border.

rr: Ku baimukire kare omu kasheeshe, eizooba ryarasha aha maizi, Abamoabu baareeba amaizi omu maisho gaabo nigatukura nk'eshagama.
en: And they rose up early in the morning, and the sun shone upon the water, and the Moabites saw the water on the other side as red as blood:

rr: Baagira bati: Eriya n'eshagama; buzimazima abo bagabe barwaine, baitana. Mbwenu imwe Abamoabu, murahukye tuze kunyaga.
en: and they said, This is blood: the kings are surely slain, and they have smitten one another: now therefore, Moab, to the spoil.

rr: Kwonka ku baahikire omu rusiisira rw'Abaisraeli, Abaisraeli baimuka baabarwanisa, okuhitsya obu baabahungire; bakagyenda nibabaita, bakarugaho bakahika n'omu nsi yaabo.
en: And when they came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and smote the Moabites, so that they fled before them: but they went forward smiting the Moabites, even in their country.

rr: Baasheenya endembo, kandi omusiri gwona omurungi buri muntu yaagunagamu eibaare rye, okuhitsya obu baagishwekire yoona; baigara buri nshuro y'amaizi, baatema emiti yoona emirungi, okuhitsya obu aha ndembo z'amabaare haatsigare Kiruhareseesi yonka; bwanyima ab'enjungu baagigota, baagicwekyereza.
en: And they beat down the cities, and on every good piece of land cast every man his stone, and filled it; and they stopped all the wells of water, and felled all the good trees: only in Kir-hareseth left they the stones thereof; howbeit the slingers went about it , and smote it.

rr: Omugabe wa Moabu ku yaareebire orugamba nirumugyendera kubi, yaatwara abashaija magana mushanju abarikurwanisa zaarurara, ngu baataguze bahikye omugabe wa Edomu; kwonka tibaabaasa.
en: And when the king of Moab saw that the battle was too sore for him, he took with him seven hundred men that drew swords, to break through even unto the king of Edom: but they could not.

rr: Bwanyima yaatwara omutabani ow'omujigaijo, owaabaire naaza kumuhungurira kuza aha ngoma, yaamutambira aha mutwe gw'orugo rw'amabaare kuba ekitambo ekyokize.
en: Then he took his eldest son that should have reigned in his stead, and offered him for a burnt offering upon the wall.

rr: Kyareetera abantu okugirira Abaisraeli ekiniga kingi; baamurugaho, baagaruka omu nsi yaabo.
en: And there was great indignation against Israel: and they departed from him, and returned to their own land.

rr: -41 ; 2 -6 ; . Omu biro ebyo omwe ahari bakaamwana ba baanabi akatakira Elisa, naagira ati: Omwiru waawe ibanye akafa; kandi noomanya ku omwiru waawe yaabaire atiina Ruhanga; kwonka orikwihuza aizire kutwara abaana bangye bombi kuba abahuuku be.
en: Now there cried a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets unto Elisha, saying, Thy servant my husband is dead; and thou knowest that thy servant did fear the LORD : and the creditor is come to take unto him my two sons to be bondmen.

rr: Elisa yaamubuuza ati: Mbwenu nooyenda ku nkukorera ki? Ngambira eki otungire omuka. Onu ati: Omuzaana waawe taine ki atungire, kureka ecupa emwe y'amajuta.
en: And Elisha said unto her, What shall I do for thee? tell me, what hast thou in the house? And she said, Thine handmaid hath not any thing in the house, save a pot of oil.

rr: Elisa yaagira ati: Irookooze omuri bangyenzi baawe boona, otiizemu ecupa ezirimu busha, kwona zitari nkye.
en: Then he said, Go, borrow thee vessels abroad of all thy neighbours, even empty vessels; borrow not a few.

rr: Bwanyima ogarukye omuka, oyekingirane na batabani baawe, oshukye ago majuta omuri ezo ecupa zoona; eraijure, ogibiikye.
en: And when thou art come in, thou shalt shut the door upon thee and upon thy sons, and shalt pour out into all those vessels, and thou shalt set aside that which is full.

rr: Atyo yaamurugaho, yaayekingirana n'abatabani, baamureetera ecupa, yaazishukamu.
en: So she went from him, and shut the door upon her and upon her sons, who brought the vessels to her; and she poured out.

rr: Ecupa zoona ku zaaherize kwijura, yaagira omutabani ati: Ndeetera endiijo.
en: And it came to pass, when the vessels were full, that she said unto her son, Bring me yet a vessel.

rr: Yaamugira ati: Tihakiriho ndiijo.
en: And he said unto her, There is not a vessel more.

rr: Ahonaaho amajuta gaarekyeraho kwija.
en: And the oil stayed.

rr: Yaija yaagambira omushaija wa Ruhanga; nawe yaamugira ati: Irooko otunde ahari ago majuta, oihure amabanja gaawe; bwanyima iwe na batabani baawe mutungwe agaraatsigareho. Ebyomukazi wa Shuneemu
en: Then she came and told the man of God. And he said, Go, sell the oil, and pay thy debt, and live thou and thy children of the rest. The Shunammite's Son

rr: Eizooba rimwe Elisa akaimuka, yaaza Shuneemu, ei omukazi omutungi yaabaire atwire; omukazi ogwo yaamugyemesereza kurya eby'okurya.
en: And it fell on a day, that Elisha passed to Shunem, where was a great woman; and she constrained him to eat bread.

rr: Okwiha obwo, ku yaabaire arabayo, ahungukayo kurya ak'okurya.
en: And so it was, that as oft as he passed by, he turned in thither to eat bread.

rr: Ogwo mukazi yaagira iba ati: Mbwenu nyetegyereize ogu mushaija orikuturabaho obutoosha ku ari omushaija orikwera wa Ruhanga.
en: And she said unto her husband, Behold now, I perceive that this is an holy man of God, which passeth by us continually.

rr: Ka tumwombekyere akashengye kakye aha mutwe gw'enju, tumuteeremu ekitanda, emeeza, entebe n'etabaaza; ku araagume yaatuhungukaho, abe nimwo yaaza.
en: Let us make a little chamber, I pray thee, on the wall; and let us set for him there a bed, and a table, and a stool, and a candlestick: and it shall be, when he cometh to us, that he shall turn in thither.

rr: Eizooba rimwe akahungukayo, yaaza omuri ako kashengye, yaahuumuiramu.
en: And it fell on a day, that he came thither, and he turned into the chamber, and lay there.

rr: Yaagira Gehazi omuheereza we ati: Nyetera ogwo mukazi wa Shuneemu. Ku yaamwetsire, yaayemerera omu maisho ge.
en: And he said to Gehazi his servant, Call this Shunammite. And when he had called her, she stood before him.

rr: Elisa yaagira Gehazi ati: Mugire oti: Mbwenu, obu otufeereire kubi oti, tukaakukorera ki? Nooyenda ku tugira eki twakugambirira omugabe, nari omukuru w'amahe? Ogwo mukazi yaagarukamu ati: Ngaaha! Ndi omu baitu.
en: And he said unto him, Say now unto her, Behold, thou hast been careful for us with all this care; what is to be done for thee? wouldest thou be spoken for to the king, or to the captain of the host? And she answered, I dwell among mine own people.

rr: Elisa yaabuuza ati: Mbwenu shi, ekindi tumukorere ki? Gehazi yaagarukamu ati: Manya taine mwana w'omwojo, kandi na iba n'omugurusi.
en: And he said, What then is to be done for her? And Gehazi answered, Verily she hath no child, and her husband is old.

rr: Elisa yaagira ati: Mwete. Ku yaamwetsire, ogwo mukazi yaayemerera omu muryango.
en: And he said, Call her. And when he had called her, she stood in the door.

rr: Elisa yaamugira ati: Omu bunaku nk'obu omu mwaka ogurikwija oryakiikira omwana w'omwojo.
en: And he said, About this season, according to the time of life, thou shalt embrace a son.

rr: Onu ati: Ngaaha, mukama wangye, iwe mushaija wa Ruhanga 'we, reka kubeiha omuzaana waawe.
en: And she said, Nay, my lord, thou man of God, do not lie unto thine handmaid.

rr: Bwanyima ogwo mukazi yaabaka enda, yaazaara omwana w'omwojo omu bunaku nk'obwo omu kutandika kw'omwaka, nk'oku Elisa yaamugambiire.
en: And the woman conceived, and bare a son at that season that Elisha had said unto her, according to the time of life.

rr: Ogwo mwana ku yaakuzire, eizooba rimwe yaaza kureeba ishe omu bagyesi.
en: And when the child was grown, it fell on a day, that he went out to his father to the reapers.

rr: Yaagira ishe ati: Ai bambe! Omutwe gwanyita! Omutwe gwanyita! Ishe yaagira omuhuuku we ati: Mutwarire nyina.
en: And he said unto his father, My head, my head. And he said to a lad, Carry him to his mother.

rr: Ku yaamuheekire, yaamutwarira nyina, omwana yaamushutama aha bibero okuhitsya omu ihangwe, yaakaba.
en: And when he had taken him, and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees till noon, and then died.

rr: Nyina yainamuka, yaamurambika aha kitanda ky'omushaija wa Ruhanga, yaamukingirana, yaashohora.
en: And she went up, and laid him on the bed of the man of God, and shut the door upon him, and went out.

rr: Yaayeta iba, yaamugira ati: Nyoherereza omwe aha bambari baawe, n'endogoya emwe, ngyende ahonaaho nze ow'omushaija wa Ruhanga, ngarukye.
en: And she called unto her husband, and said, Send me, I pray thee, one of the young men, and one of the asses, that I may run to the man of God, and come again.

rr: Iba ati: Ekirikukuhuuta owe eri izooba niki? Okwezi tikukabonekire, kandi ti sabato. Onu ati: Ni kirungi nzeyo.
en: And he said, Wherefore wilt thou go to him to day? it is neither new moon, nor sabbath. And she said, It shall be well.

rr: Atyo yaatandiika endogoya, yaagira omwambari we ati: Irukanzya endogoya; oteetwara ntakugambiire.
en: Then she saddled an ass, and said to her servant, Drive, and go forward; slack not thy riding for me, except I bid thee.

rr: Atyo yaagyenda yaahika aha mushaija wa Ruhanga aha kibungo Karumeeli.
en: So she went and came unto the man of God to mount Carmel.

rr: Ogwo mushaija wa Ruhanga ku yaamureebeire hare naakiija, yaagira Gehazi omuheereza we ati: Reeba, oriya ga n'omukazi ori owa Shuneemu
en: And it came to pass, when the man of God saw her afar off, that he said to Gehazi his servant, Behold, yonder is that Shunammite:

rr: gyenda noiruka, omubugane, omubuuze oti: ni buhooro? Baro ari buhooro? N'omwana waawe ari buhooro? Omukazi yaamugarukamu ati: Ni buhooro.
en: run now, I pray thee, to meet her, and say unto her, Is it well with thee? is it well with thy husband? is it well with the child? And she answered, It is well.

rr: Ku yaahikire aha mushaija wa Ruhanga omu kibungo, yaayaija kumutsindika.
en: And when she came to the man of God to the hill, she caught him by the feet: but Gehazi came near to thrust her away.

rr: Kwonka omushaija wa Ruhanga yaagira ati: Mrekye, ahakuba omutima gwe gwine enaku nyingi; kandi MUKAMA akinsherekire, tiyaakingambira.
en: And the man of God said, Let her alone; for her soul is vexed within her: and the LORD hath hid it from me, and hath not told me.

rr: Omukazi yaamugira ati: Niinye naashabire mukama wangye omwana w'omwojo? Tindakugizire nti: Otambeiha?
en: Then she said, Did I desire a son of my lord? did I not say, Do not deceive me?

rr: Elisa yaagira Gehazi ati: Yezirikye, otware enkoni yangye, ogyende. Ku oraabugane omuntu, otamuramutsya; kandi ku haraagire owaakuramutsya, owetsize; orambikye egi nkono aha maisho g'omwana.
en: Then he said to Gehazi, Gird up thy loins, and take my staff in thine hand, and go thy way: if thou meet any man, salute him not; and if any salute thee, answer him not again: and lay my staff upon the face of the child.

rr: Nyina w'omwana yaamugira ati: Nindahira MUKAMA, kandi ninkurahira, tindikwija kukutsiga aha.
en: And the mother of the child said, As the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee.

rr: Atyo yaimuka, yaamukuratira.
en: And he arose, and followed her.

rr: Gehazi yaagyenda abeebembeire, yaarambika egyo nkoni aha maisho g'omwana; tihaabaho kateezo n'obu kwakuba okwetengyetsa.
en: And Gehazi passed on before them, and laid the staff upon the face of the child; but there was neither voice, nor hearing.

rr: Nikyo yaagarukiireyo kumubugana, akamugira ati: omwana tiyaahimbuuka.
en: Wherefore he went again to meet him, and told him, saying, The child is not awaked.

rr: Elisa ku yaatahire omu nju, yaareeba omwana abyami aha kitanda kye afiire.
en: And when Elisha was come into the house, behold, the child was dead, and laid upon his bed.

rr: 1 -23 ; . Atyo yaataahamu, yaayekingiranamu n'omwana, yaashaba MUKAMA.
en: He went in therefore, and shut the door upon them twain, and prayed unto the LORD .

rr: Bwanyima yaaza aha kitanda, yaayegororera aha mwana, yaata omunwa aha munwa gwe, n'amaisho aha maisho ge, n'engaro aha ngaro ze; ku yaamwegororeireho, omubiri gw'omwana gwatandika kutagata.
en: And he went up, and lay upon the child, and put his mouth upon his mouth, and his eyes upon his eyes, and his hands upon his hands: and he stretched himself upon the child; and the flesh of the child waxed warm.

rr: Yaagaruka yaimuka, yaagyendagyendaho omu nju rimwe, yaagaruka yaaza aha kitanda, yaamwegororeraho, omwana yaayetsyamura emirundi mushanju, yaabuuruura amaisho.
en: Then he returned, and walked in the house to and fro; and went up, and stretched himself upon him: and the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.

rr: Yaayeta Gehazi, yaamugira ati: Yeta ogwo mukazi wa Shuneemu.
en: And he called Gehazi, and said, Call this Shunammite.

rr: Atyo yaamweta.
en: So he called her.

rr: Ku yaamuhikire, yaagira ati: Ihaho omwana waawe.
en: And when she was come in unto him, he said, Take up thy son.

rr: 2 -6 ; . Yaija, yaagwa aha bigyere bye, yaajuumara ahansi, yaihaho omwana we, yaashohora. Elisa okushemesa emboga z'abaana ba baanabi
en: Then she went in, and fell at his feet, and bowed herself to the ground, and took up her son, and went out.

rr: Bwanyima Elisa yaagaruka Gilugaali; kandi hakaba hatereyo enjara. Abaana ba baanabi ku baabaire bamushutami omu maisho, yaagira omuheereza we ati: Ta enyungu mpango aha mahega, oteekyere abaana ba baanabi ekicumbe.
en: And Elisha came again to Gilgal: and there was a dearth in the land; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him: and he said unto his servant, Set on the great pot, and seethe pottage for the sons of the prophets.

rr: Omwe aharibo yaaza omu ishwa kushoroma emboga, yaashangayo omutanga, yaagushoromaho entanga, yaaziijuza omwenda gwe, yaija, yaazikyeka, yaazita omu nyungu eri ey'ekicumbe, atazimanyire.
en: And one went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered thereof wild gourds his lap full, and came and shred them into the pot of pottage: for they knew them not.

rr: Batyo baihura kugaburira abantu.
en: So they poured out for the men to eat.

rr: Kwonka ku baabaire nibarya ekyo kicumbe, baagamba munonga nibagira bati: Ai bambe, mushaija wa Ruhanga, omu nyungu harimu rufu.
en: And it came to pass, as they were eating of the pottage, that they cried out, and said, O thou man of God, there is death in the pot.

rr: Tibaabaawsa kukirya.
en: And they could not eat thereof .

rr: Elisa yaagira ati: Mureete esaano.
en: But he said, Then bring meal.

rr: Yaaginaga omu nyungu, yaagira ati: Mwihurire abantu, barye.
en: And he cast it into the pot; and he said, Pour out for the people, that they may eat.

rr: Baashanga omu nyungu hatakirimu kabi.
en: And there was no harm in the pot.

rr: -21 ; 15:32-38 . Haija omushaija naaruga Baali-shaliisha, areeteire omushaija wa Ruhanga eby'okurya by'omuganuro, emigaati ya sayiri makumi abiri n'enshaho y'obushiisha bubisi bw'engano. Elisa yaagira omuheereza we ati: Gaburira abantu, barye.
en: And there came a man from Baal-shalisha, and brought the man of God bread of the firstfruits, twenty loaves of barley, and full ears of corn in the husk thereof. And he said, Give unto the people, that they may eat.

rr: Kwonka ogwo muheereza yaagira ati: Ebi nimbaasa nta kubigaburira abashaija igana?
en: And his servitor said, What, should I set this before an hundred men?

rr: Elisa yaagaruka yaamugambira ati: Bigaburire abantu, barye; ahakuba oku nikwo MUKAMA arikugamba naagira ati: Nibaija kurya, batsigazeho.
en: He said again, Give the people, that they may eat: for thus saith the LORD , They shall eat, and shall leave thereof .

rr: Atyo yaabibata omumaisho, baarya, ebindi byatsigaraho, nk'ekigambo kya MUKAMA oku kyabaire kiri.
en: So he set it before them, and they did eat, and left thereof , according to the word of the LORD .

rr: Naamani omukuru w'eihe ry'omugabe wa Siria akaba ari omushaija orikusiimwa munonga mukama we, ahabw'okuba ahabwe MUKAMA akaha Abasiria okusingura. Kandi akaba ari omushaija rugambwa emanzi, kwonka akaba ari omubembe.
en: Now Naaman, captain of the host of the king of Syria, was a great man with his master, and honourable, because by him the LORD had given deliverance unto Syria: he was also a mighty man in valour, but he was a leper.

rr: Omu hururu emwe Abasiria bakahurura omu nsi ya Israeli, baanyagayo omwishiki muto, yaaguma naaheereza muka Naamani.
en: And the Syrians had gone out by companies, and had brought away captive out of the land of Israel a little maid; and she waited on Naaman's wife.

rr: Eizooba rimwe yaagira mugore we ati: Mukama wangye ku yaakuza owa nabi ow'omuri Samaria! Akaamutambira ebibembe bye.
en: And she said unto her mistress, Would God my lord were with the prophet that is in Samaria! for he would recover him of his leprosy.

rr: Atyo Naamani yaataahamu, yaagambira mukama we ati: Omwishiki ori owaanyagirwe omu nsi ya Israeli yaagira ati n'ati.
en: And one went in, and told his lord, saying, Thus and thus said the maid that is of the land of Israel.

rr: Omugabe wa Siria yaamugira ati: Mbwenu irooko, ogyende, niinyija kutwekyera omugabe wa Israeli ebaruha.
en: And the king of Syria said, Go to, go, and I will send a letter unto the king of Israel.

rr: Naamani yaagyenda, yaatwara etalanta z'efeeza ikumi, na shekeli z'ezaabu enkumi mukaaga, n'ebijwaro eby'okwihaihanisa ikumi.
en: And he departed, and took with him ten talents of silver, and six thousand pieces of gold, and ten changes of raiment.

rr: Atyo yaatwarira omugabe wa Israeli ebaruha, erikugira eti: Ebaruha egi ku eraakuhikye, reeba naakwoherereza omushaija wangye Naamani, omutambire ebibembe.
en: And he brought the letter to the king of Israel, saying, Now when this letter is come unto thee, behold, I have therewith sent Naaman my servant to thee, that thou mayest recover him of his leprosy.

rr: Omugabe wa Israeli ku yaashomire ebaruha, yaataagura ebijwaro bye naagira ati: Niinye Ruhanga orikwita akakiza, omushaija ogu okuntumaho ngu ntambire omuntu ebibembe?
en: And it came to pass, when the king of Israel had read the letter, that he rent his clothes, and said, Am I God, to kill and to make alive, that this man doth send unto me to recover a man of his leprosy?

rr: Muteekateekye, mureebe ku arikutaara ah'okutonganira naanye.
en: Wherefore consider, I pray you, and see how he seeketh a quarrel against me.

rr: Kwonka Elisa omushaija wa Ruhanga, ku yaahuriire ngu omugabe wa Israeli ataagwire ebijwaro bye, yaamutumaho naagira ati: Ahabw'enki otaagwire ebijwaro byawe? Murekye anyijeho hati, abone kumanya omuri Israeli ku harimu nabi.
en: And it was so , when Elisha the man of God had heard that the king of Israel had rent his clothes, that he sent to the king, saying, Wherefore hast thou rent thy clothes? let him come now to me, and he shall know that there is a prophet in Israel.

rr: Atyo Naamani yaija, n'embaraasi ze n'ebigaari bye, yaayemerera aha muryango gw'enju ya Elisa.
en: So Naaman came with his horses and with his chariot, and stood at the door of the house of Elisha.

rr: Elisa yaamutumaho entumwa naagira ati: Irooko oze omuri Yorudani, oyogyemu emirundi mushanju, omubiri gwawe nigwija kuba nk'oku gwabaire guri, nooshemera.
en: And Elisha sent a messenger unto him, saying, Go and wash in Jordan seven times, and thy flesh shall come again to thee, and thou shalt be clean.

rr: Naamani ku yaakihuriire, yaaguubwa kubi, yaagyenda naagira ati: Nyowe mbaire ningira ngu buzimazima naija kushohora, nampikaho, naayeta eiziina rya MUKAMA Ruhanga we, naasiisirira aharwaire, nantambira ebibembe.
en: But Naaman was wroth, and went away, and said, Behold, I thought, He will surely come out to me, and stand, and call on the name of the LORD his God, and strike his hand over the place, and recover the leper.

rr: Emigyera ya Damasiko, Abana na Faapa, terikuhita amaizi goona ag'omuri Israeli? Tinkubaasize kwoga omuri ago, nkashemera? Atyo yaakuba yaagarukayo agwirwe kubi munonga.
en: Are not Abana and Pharpar, rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? may I not wash in them, and be clean? So he turned and went away in a rage.

rr: Abaheereza be baamwirira haihi, baamugira bati: Taata, kuri nabi ogu yaakuragiira ekintu kihango, tokukikozire? Kaashwa okukugira ati: Yoga, oshemere?
en: And his servants came near, and spake unto him, and said, My father, if the prophet had bid thee do some great thing, wouldest thou not have done it? how much rather then, when he saith to thee, Wash, and be clean?

rr: Atyo yaashuuma, yaayejabika omuri Yorudani emirundi mushanju, nk'ekigambo ky'omushaija wa Ruhanga oku kyabaire kiri; omubiri gwe gwaba nk'ogw'omwana muto, yaashemera.
en: Then went he down, and dipped himself seven times in Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God: and his flesh came again like unto the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.

rr: Bwanyima yaagaruka ahari ogwo mushaija wa Ruhanga, we n'abantu be boona, yaija, yaayemerera omu maisho ge, yaamugira ati: Mbwenu naamanya ku hatabaho Ruhanga omu nsi yoona kureka omuri Israeli; n'ahabw'ekyo ninkweshengyereza yakiira omukimbo gw'omwiru waawe.
en: And he returned to the man of God, he and all his company, and came, and stood before him: and he said, Behold, now I know that there is no God in all the earth, but in Israel: now therefore, I pray thee, take a blessing of thy servant.

rr: Kwonka Elisa yaagira ati: Nindahira Ruhanga otahwaho, ou mpeereza, tindikwija kugira kintu kyona eki naayakiira. Yaamweshengyereza kukitwara, onu yaayanga.
en: But he said, As the LORD liveth, before whom I stand, I will receive none. And he urged him to take it ; but he refused.

rr: Naamani yaagira ati: Ku oraabe waayanga, ninkweshengyereza, nyowe omwiru waawe, mpeebwe eitaka eririkwekorerwa enyumbu ibiri; ahabw'okuba okuruga hati tindikwija kutamba kitambo ky'okwotsya nari ekindi kitambo ahari ruhanga ondiijo weena, kureka MUKAMA wenka.
en: And Naaman said, Shall there not then, I pray thee, be given to thy servant two mules' burden of earth? for thy servant will henceforth offer neither burnt offering nor sacrifice unto other gods, but unto the LORD .

rr: Omu kigambo eki MUKAMA agume asaasire omwiru waawe; mukama wangye ku ariguma yaaza omu nju ya Ramoni okuramizamu, naanye nainama omuri egyo nju, nainama omu nju ya Ramoni, MUKAMA asaasire omwiru waawe omu kigambo ekyo.
en: In this thing the LORD pardon thy servant, that when my master goeth into the house of Rimmon to worship there, and he leaneth on my hand, and I bow myself in the house of Rimmon: when I bow down myself in the house of Rimmon, the LORD pardon thy servant in this thing.

rr: Elisa yaamugira ati: Gyenda n'obusingye. Gehazi okubeiha, akabemba Kwonka Naamani ku yaabaire yaamurugaho akaanya kakye
en: And he said unto him, Go in peace. So he departed from him a little way. Elisha's Servant

rr: Gehazi omuheereza wa Elisa omushaija wa Ruhanga yaagira ati: Mbwenu mukama wangye Elisa yaayangire kutwara eki ogu Musiria Naamani yaamureetera. Nindahira MUKAMA, naaza kwiruka, ngire eki naamwihaho.
en: But Gehazi, the servant of Elisha the man of God, said, Behold, my master hath spared Naaman this Syrian, in not receiving at his hands that which he brought: but, as the LORD liveth, I will run after him, and take somewhat of him.

rr: Atyo Gehazi yaakurata Naamani.
en: So Gehazi followed after Naaman.

rr: Naamani ku yaareebire omuntu amukuratiire, yaaruga omu kigaari kumubugana, yaagira ati: Ni buhooro?
en: And when Naaman saw him running after him, he lighted down from the chariot to meet him, and said, Is all well?

rr: Onu ati: Ni buhooro.
en: And he said, All is well.

rr: Mukama wangye yantuma kukugambira naagira ati: Omuri aka kaanya haija abatsigazi babiri abaana ba baanabi, nibaruga omu nsi y'ebibungo eya Efuraimu; mbwenu ninkweshengyereza obampeere etalanta y'efeeza, kandi n'ebijwaro bibir by'okwihaihanisa.
en: My master hath sent me, saying, Behold, even now there be come to me from mount Ephraim two young men of the sons of the prophets: give them, I pray thee, a talent of silver, and two changes of garments.

rr: Naamani yaamugira ati: Ikiriza, otware etalanta ibiri.
en: And Naaman said, Be content, take two talents.

rr: Atyo yaamweshengyereza, yaamukomera etalanta z'efeeza ibiri omu nshaho ibiri, n'ebijwaro bibiri by'okwihaihanisa, yaabikorera abairu be babiri, baagyenda beebembeire Gehazi.
en: And he urged him, and bound two talents of silver in two bags, with two changes of garments, and laid them upon two of his servants; and they bare them before him.

rr: Gehazi ku yaahikire aha kabungo k'owaabo, yaabibaihaho, yaabitaasya omu nju; yaaboohereza, baagyenda.
en: And when he came to the tower, he took them from their hand, and bestowed them in the house: and he let the men go, and they departed.

rr: Yaatahamu, yaayemerera omu maisho ga mukama we. Elisa yaamubuuza ati: Waaba ogiire hi, Gehazi?
en: But he went in, and stood before his master. And Elisha said unto him, Whence comest thou , Gehazi? And he said, Thy servant went no whither.

rr: Onu yaamugarukamu ati: Omwiru waawe taine hu yaaba agiire. Elisa yaagaruka yaamugira ati: Omutima gwangye tigwagyenda naiwe, obu omushaija yaaruga omu kigaari kukubugana? Noogira ngu obwo nibwo bwaba buri obunaku bw'okwakiiriramu empiiha, ebijwaro, emisiri y'emizeituuni n'ey'emizaabibu, entaama, ente, abahuuku n'abazaana?
en: And he said unto him, Went not mine heart with thee , when the man turned again from his chariot to meet thee? Is it a time to receive money, and to receive garments, and oliveyards, and vineyards, and sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and maidservants?

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo ebibembe bya Naamani byaza kukwomaho iwe n'oruzaaro rwawe ebiro byona.
en: The leprosy therefore of Naaman shall cleave unto thee, and unto thy seed for ever.

rr: Atyo yaamuruga omu maisho abembire naayera nk'orubaare.
en: And he went out from his presence a leper as white as snow.

en: Let us go, we pray thee, unto Jordan, and take thence every man a beam, and let us make us a place there, where we may dwell.

en: And he answered, Go ye.

en: And one said, Be content, I pray thee, and go with thy servants. And he answered, I will go.

rr: Atyo yaagyenda nabo. Ku baahikire Yorudani, baatema emiti.
en: So he went with them. And when they came to Jordan, they cut down wood.

rr: Kwonka omwe ku yaabaire naatema, empango yaakuuka, yaagwa omu maizi; yaayamuza ati: Ai bambe, Mukama wangye! ebaire eri entiizano.
en: But as one was felling a beam, the axe head fell into the water: and he cried, and said, Alas, master! for it was borrowed.

rr: Omushaija wa Ruhanga yaamubuuza ati: Yaagwa hi? Ku yaamworekire omwanya, etyo yaatuuhuuka.
en: And the man of God said, Where fell it? And he shewed him the place. And he cut down a stick, and cast it in thither; and the iron did swim.

rr: Yaagira ati: Giihemu. Yaagikununkirira, yaagiihamu. Ruhanga okworeka omuheereza wa Elisa eihe ry'omu iguru
en: Therefore said he, Take it up to thee. And he put out his hand, and took it. Elisha and the Syrians

rr: Omugabe wa Siria ku yaabaire naarwanisa Israeli, yaahanuura n'abashaija be naagira ati: Omu mwanya nanka na nanka nimwo ndita orusiisira rwangye.
en: Then the king of Syria warred against Israel, and took counsel with his servants, saying, In such and such a place shall be my camp.

rr: Omushaija wa Ruhanga yaatuma aha mugabe wa Israeli naagira ati: Oyerinde, otaraba omu mwanya nanka, ahabw'okuba Abasiria niyo barikushuuma kukugwera.
en: And the man of God sent unto the king of Israel, saying, Beware that thou pass not such a place; for thither the Syrians are come down.

rr: Omugabe wa Israeli yaatuma omuri ogwo mwanya ogu omushaija wa Ruhanga yaamugambiire. Okwo nikwo Elisa yaabaire ateisa omugabe, akakira ti rimwe, kandi ti kabire.
en: And the king of Israel sent to the place which the man of God told him and warned him of, and saved himself there, not once nor twice.

rr: Ekyo kyareetera omugabe wa Siria kwemereza omutima munonga, yaayeta abashaija be, yaabagira ati: Timukaanyoreka omuntu omuriitwe ori aha rubaju rw'omugabe wa Israeli?
en: Therefore the heart of the king of Syria was sore troubled for this thing; and he called his servants, and said unto them, Will ye not shew me which of us is for the king of Israel?

rr: Omwe aha bashaija be yaagira ati: Ngaaha, Mukama wangye omugabe; kureka Elisa nabi ow'omuri Israeli niwe agambira omugabe wa Israeli ebigambo ebi ogambira omu kishengye eki oraaramu.
en: And one of his servants said, None, my lord, O king: but Elisha, the prophet that is in Israel, telleth the king of Israel the words that thou speakest in thy bedchamber.

rr: Yaamugira ati: Irooko oreebe ei ari, ntumeyo bamukwate.
en: And he said, Go and spy where he is , that I may send and fetch him.

rr: Baamugira bati: Manya, ari Dosani.
en: And it was told him, saying, Behold, he is in Dothan.

rr: Atyo yaatumayo embaraasi n'ebigaari n'eihe rihango, baahikayo nyekiro, baagota orurembo.
en: Therefore sent he thither horses, and chariots, and a great host: and they came by night, and compassed the city about.

rr: Omuheereza w'omushaija wa Ruhanga ku yaimukire kare omu kasheeshe, yaashohora, yaareeba eihe n'embaraasi n'ebigaari byehinguririize orurembo. Ogwo muheereza yaagira ati: Ai bambe Mukama wangye! Mbwenu tugire tuta?
en: And when the servant of the man of God was risen early, and gone forth, behold, an host compassed the city both with horses and chariots. And his servant said unto him, Alas, my master! how shall we do?

rr: Onu yaagira ati: Otatiina; ahabw'okuba abari hamwe naitwe ni baingi okukira abo abari hamwe nabo.
en: And he answered, Fear not: for they that be with us are more than they that be with them.

rr: Bwanyima Elisa yaashaba naagira ati: Ai MUKAMA, ninkweshengyereza, mwigure amaisho, areebe.
en: And Elisha prayed, and said, LORD , I pray thee, open his eyes, that he may see.

rr: Atyo MUKAMA yaigura amaisho g'ogwo mutsigazi, yaareeba; kandi reeba ogwo mugongo gukaba gwijwire embaraasi n'ebigaari by'omuriro byehinguririize Elisa.
en: And the LORD opened the eyes of the young man; and he saw: and, behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha.

rr: Abasiria ku baahikire Elisa, yaashaba MUKAMA naagira ati: Ninkweshengyereza humya amaisho g'aba bantu.
en: And when they came down to him, Elisha prayed unto the LORD , and said, Smite this people, I pray thee, with blindness.

rr: Atyo MUKAMA yaahumya amaisho amaisho gaabo, nk'oku Elisa yaamushabire.
en: And he smote them with blindness according to the word of Elisha.

rr: Elisa yaabagira ati: Ogu tigwo muhanda, kandi oru tirwo rurembo. Munkuratire, mbatwarire omushaija ou murikusherura. Yaabeembera, yaabahitsya Samaria.
en: And Elisha said unto them, This is not the way, neither is this the city: follow me, and I will bring you to the man whom ye seek. But he led them to Samaria.

rr: Ku baataahire bati omuri Samaria, Elisa yaashaba ati: Ai MUKAMA, humuura amaisho g'aba bashaija, bareebe.
en: And it came to pass, when they were come into Samaria, that Elisha said, LORD , open the eyes of these men , that they may see.

rr: MUKAMA yaahumuura amaisho gaabo, baareeba; ku baagiire kureeba, baashanga bari ahagati ya Samaria.
en: And the LORD opened their eyes, and they saw; and, behold, they were in the midst of Samaria.

rr: Omugabe wa Israeli ku yaabareebire, yaabuuza Elisa ati: Taata, mbaite? Mbaite?
en: And the king of Israel said unto Elisha, when he saw them, My father, shall I smite them? shall I smite them?

rr: Yaagarukamu ati: Otabaita. Nooyenda kwita abu oyekwatiire na rurara n'obuta bwawe? Bahe eby'okurya n'amaizi, barye, banywe, bagarukye ahari mukama waabo.
en: And he answered, Thou shalt not smite them: wouldest thou smite those whom thou hast taken captive with thy sword and with thy bow? set bread and water before them, that they may eat and drink, and go to their master.

rr: Atyo yaabateekyera eby'okurya bingi; ku baaherize kurya n'okunywa, yaaboohereza, baagaruka ahari mukama waabo.
en: And he prepared great provision for them: and when they had eaten and drunk, he sent them away, and they went to their master.

rr: Emitwe y'engabo z'Abasiria yaarekyera aho kuguma neija kuteera ensi ya Israeli.
en: So the bands of Syria came no more into the land of Israel.

rr: Abasamaria okugotwa Abasiria n'okwitwa enjara
en: The Siege of Samaria

rr: Bwanyima Benihadadi omugabe wa Siria yaateeranira hamwe eihe rye ryona, yainamuka, yaateera Samaria, yaagigota.
en: And it came to pass after this, that Ben-hadad king of Syria gathered all his host, and went up, and besieged Samaria.

rr: Enjara nyingi yaateera Samaria ahabw'okugotwa, okuhitsya obu omutwe gw'endogoya gwaguzire shekeli z'efeeza makumi munaana, na kimwe kya kana ky'akaabya k'amaizi g'enkombe kikagura shekeli z'efeeza itaano.
en: And there was a great famine in Samaria: and, behold, they besieged it, until an ass's head was sold for fourscore pieces of silver, and the fourth part of a cab of dove's dung for five pieces of silver.

rr: Eizooba rimwe omugabe wa Israeli ku yaabaire naahingura aha mutwe gw'orugo rw'amabaare, omukazi yaamutakira naagira ati: Njuna, Mukama wangye omugabe.
en: And as the king of Israel was passing by upon the wall, there cried a woman unto him, saying, Help, my lord, O king.

rr: Onu yaagira ati: MUKAMA ku araabe atakujunire, nyowe niinyiha hi eby'okukujuna? Mbiihe aha mbuga y'okuhuuriraho nari omu inyuukiro rya viinyo?
en: And he said, If the LORD do not help thee, whence shall I help thee? out of the barnfloor, or out of the winepress?

rr: Omugabe yaamubuuza ati: Obaire ota?
en: And the king said unto her, What aileth thee?

rr: Onu yaamugarukamu ati: Omukazi ogu angizire ati: Reeba mutabani waawe, tumurye eri izooba, nyencakare turye owangye.
en: And she answered, This woman said unto me, Give thy son, that we may eat him to day, and we will eat my son to morrow.

rr: -57 ; . Atyo twateeka omwana wangye, twamurya. Ku buseesire, naamugira nti: Reeta omwana waawe tumurye; mbwenu owe amusherekire.
en: So we boiled my son, and did eat him: and I said unto her on the next day, Give thy son, that we may eat him: and she hath hid her son.

rr: Omugabe ku yaahuriire ebigambo by'ogwo mukazi, yaataagura ebijwaro bye (obwo omugabe akaba naahingura ari aha mutwe gw'orugo rw'amabaare; abantu ku baamureebire, baashanga abandize ekiguniya aha mubiri gwe).
en: And it came to pass, when the king heard the words of the woman, that he rent his clothes; and he passed by upon the wall, and the people looked, and, behold, he had sackcloth within upon his flesh.

rr: Omugabe yaagira ati: Eizooba ku riraarengye Elisa mwene Shafati akiine omutwe, Ruhanga akinture n'okukiraho.
en: Then he said, God do so and more also to me, if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat shall stand on him this day.

rr: Obwo Elisa akaba ashutami omu nju ye, n'abakuru bashutami hamwe nawe. Omugabe yaamutumaho entumwa omu bu yaabaire aine; kwonka egyo ntumwa ku yaabaire etakahikireyo, Elisa yaagira abo bakuru ati: Nimureeba oku ogwo mwitsi yaatuma kucwaho omutwe? Mbwenu egyo ntumwa ku eraije, mukingye orwigi, murugumyeho engaro, erekye kutaahamu. Emitsindo ya mukama we temuri enyima?
en: But Elisha sat in his house, and the elders sat with him; and the king sent a man from before him: but ere the messenger came to him, he said to the elders, See ye how this son of a murderer hath sent to take away mine head? look, when the messenger cometh, shut the door, and hold him fast at the door: is not the sound of his master's feet behind him?

rr: Ku yaabaire naakigamba nabo, omugabe yaashuuma, yaamuhikaho, yaagira ati: Ezi naku zirugire ahari MUKAMA. Mbwenu nkimwiniireho ki amatsiko? Currently Selected: 2 Abagabe 6 : RR64 Highlight Share <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8 19c-2.828 0-4.243 0-5.1
en: And while he yet talked with them, behold, the messenger came down unto him: and he said, Behold, this evil is of the LORD ; what should I wait for the LORD any longer? rr: Kwonka Elisa yaagira ati: Muhurire ekigambo kya MUKAMA. Oku nikwo MUKAMA arikugamba naagira ati: Nyencakare nk'aga magingo encuro y'esaano y'obunono neija kugura shekeli, emwe, n'encuro ibiri za sayiri zigure shekeli emwe, aha irembo rya Samaria.
en: Then Elisha said, Hear ye the word of the LORD ; Thus saith the LORD , To morrow about this time shall a measure of fine flour be sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, in the gate of Samaria.

rr: Omukuru w'engabo, ou omugabe yaabaire ayegamira omukono gwe yaagira omushaija wa Ruhanga ati: Noogira ngu n'obu MUKAMA wenka yaakuta amadirisa omu iguru, ekigambo eki kikaabaho?
en: Then a lord on whose hand the king leaned answered the man of God, and said, Behold, if the LORD would make windows in heaven, might this thing be?

rr: Onu ati: Noija kukireeba n'amaisho gaawe, kwonka torikwija kubiryaho.
en: And he said, Behold, thou shalt see it with thine eyes, but shalt not eat thereof.

rr: Ababembe okugarura amakuru marungi
en: Flight of the Syrians

rr: Kandi obwo hakaba hariho abashaija bana ababembire bari aha irembo; baagambirana bonka bati: N'enki ekitushutamiise aha, okuhitsya obu turaafe?
en: And there were four leprous men at the entering in of the gate: and they said one to another, Why sit we here until we die?

rr: Ahakuba ku turaagire tuti, Ka tutaahe omu rurembo, orurembo rurimu enjara nitwija kugwamu; kandi hoona n'obu turaagume tushutami aha, nabwo nitwija kufa.
en: If we say, We will enter into the city, then the famine is in the city, and we shall die there: and if we sit still here, we die also.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo mwije twambukye twegyeme orusiisira rw'Abasiria; ku baraaturekye, tugumeho; ku baraatwite, biri twafiire.
en: Now therefore come, and let us fall unto the host of the Syrians: if they save us alive, we shall live; and if they kill us, we shall but die.

rr: Batyo baimuka omu rwita-waabo kuza omu rusiisira rw'Abasiria. Ku baahikire ahu orusiisira rurikutandikira, baashanga hatarimu muntu
en: And they rose up in the twilight, to go unto the camp of the Syrians: and when they were come to the uttermost part of the camp of Syria, behold, there was no man there.

rr: ahakuba MUKAMA akaba areeteire engabo z'Abasiria kuhurira okuhinda kw'ebigaari n'embaraasi, n'endigito y'eihe rihango, kyabareetera kugambirana bati: Yeimwe, omugabe wa Israeli aguririire abagabe b'Abahiiti n'ab'Abanyamisri kututeera.
en: For the LORD had made the host of the Syrians to hear a noise of chariots, and a noise of horses, even the noise of a great host: and they said one to another, Lo, the king of Israel hath hired against us the kings of the Hittites, and the kings of the Egyptians, to come upon us.

rr: Batyo baimuka omu rwita-waabo, baacwa, baatsigaho amahema gaabo, embaraasi zaabo n'endogoya zaabo, orusiisira rwona nk'oku rwabaire ruri, baahunga ngu bakize amagara.
en: Wherefore they arose and fled in the twilight, and left their tents, and their horses, and their asses, even the camp as it was , and fled for their life.

rr: Abo babembe ku baahikire ahu orusiisira rurikutandikira, baataaha omu ihema rimwe, baarya, baanywa, baihamu efeeza n'ezaabu n'ebijwaro, baagyenda, baabishereka; baagaruka baataaha omu rindi ihema, baihamu ebindi, baagyenda, baabishereka.
en: And when these lepers came to the uttermost part of the camp, they went into one tent, and did eat and drink, and carried thence silver, and gold, and raiment, and went and hid it ; and came again, and entered into another tent, and carried thence also , and went and hid it .

rr: Bwanyima baagambirana bati: Ebi turikukora tibihikire. Eizooba eri n'eizooba ry'amakuru marungi, haza tuhunami; ku turaarekye bukataagurukana, nitwija kugiibwaho ekiheneso. N'ahabw'ekyo mwije tugyende, tugambire ab'omu nju y'omugabe.
en: Then they said one to another, We do not well: this day is a day of good tidings, and we hold our peace: if we tarry till the morning light, some mischief will come upon us: now therefore come, that we may go and tell the king's household.

rr: Batyo baagyenda; ku baahikire aha irembo, baayeta omurinzi w'eirembo, baamugira bati: Twahika omu rusiisira rw'Abasiria, twashanga rutarimu muntu n'obu kaakuba akateezo, kureka embaraasi n'endogoya azitsibikire, kandi n'amahema gari nk'oku gabaire gari.
en: So they came and called unto the porter of the city: and they told them, saying, We came to the camp of the Syrians, and, behold, there was no man there, neither voice of man, but horses tied, and asses tied, and the tents as they were .

rr: Ogwo murinzi yaayeta abandi, baabigambira ab'omu nju y'omugabe.
en: And he called the porters; and they told it to the king's house within.

rr: Omugabe yaimuka nyekiro, yaagambira abaheereza be ati: Ka mbagambire enaama ei Abasiria batugiriire.
en: And the king arose in the night, and said unto his servants, I will now shew you what the Syrians have done to us.

rr: Bamanyire ku enjara etwitsire; nikyo barugiire omu rusiisira, bakeeshereka omu ishwa, nibateekateeka bati: Ku baraashohore omu rurembo, nitwija kubagurukana, tubakwate bahuriire, tweshukye n'omu rurembo.
en: They know that we be hungry; therefore are they gone out of the camp to hide themselves in the field, saying, When they come out of the city, we shall catch them alive, and get into the city.

rr: Omwe aha baheereza be yaagira ati: Ka batware embaraasi itaano ahari ezo ezitsigaire omu rurembo; mbwenu torikumanya ku zirembire nk'Abaisraeli boona abatsigaire omu rurembo, abahonokire ahari abao abafiire; tutumeyo, tureebe.
en: And one of his servants answered and said, Let some take, I pray thee, five of the horses that remain, which are left in the city, (behold, they are as all the multitude of Israel that are left in it: behold, I say , they are even as all the multitude of the Israelites that are consumed:) and let us send and see.

rr: Baareeta abashaija babiri b'embaraasi, omugabe yaaboohereza kukurata eihe ry'Abasiria, naagira ati: Mugyende mureebe.
en: They took therefore two chariot horses; and the king sent after the host of the Syrians, saying, Go and see.

rr: Baabakurata okuhika Yorudani, baashanga omuhanda gwona gwijwire ebijwaro n'ebintu ebi Abasiria banagire nibairuka.
en: And they went after them unto Jordan: and, lo, all the way was full of garments and vessels, which the Syrians had cast away in their haste.

rr: Ezo ntumwa zaagaruka zaagambira omugabe.
en: And the messengers returned, and told the king.

rr: Bwanyima abantu baashohora, baanyaga orusiisira rw'Abasiria.
en: And the people went out, and spoiled the tents of the Syrians.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo encuro y'esaano y'obunono yaagura shekeli emwe, n'encuro ebiri za sayiri zaagura shekeli emwe, nk'ekigambo kya MUKAMA oku kyabaire kiri.
en: So a measure of fine flour was sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, according to the word of the LORD .

rr: Eryo izooba omugabe yaaragiira omukuru w'engabo, ou yaabaire ayegamira omukono, kurinda eirembo. Abantu baamuribatiiririra omu irembo, yaafa, nk'oku omushaija wa Ruhanga agambire, obu omugabe amwizireho.
en: And the king appointed the lord on whose hand he leaned to have the charge of the gate: and the people trode upon him in the gate, and he died, as the man of God had said, who spake when the king came down to him.

rr: Ahakuba omushaija wa Ruhanga ku yaagambiire omugabe ati: Nyencakare nk'aga magingo, encuro ibiri za sayiri niziija kugura shekeli emwe, n'encuro y'esaano y'obunono egure shekeli emwe omu rurembo rya Samaria
en: And it came to pass as the man of God had spoken to the king, saying, Two measures of barley for a shekel, and a measure of fine flour for a shekel, shall be to morrow about this time in the gate of Samaria:

rr: ogwo mukuru w'engabo yaagarukamu omushaija wa Ruhanga naagira ati: Noogira ngu n'obu MUKAMA wenka yaakuta amadirisa omu iguru, ekigambo eki kikaabaho?
en: and that lord answered the man of God, and said, Now, behold, if the LORD should make windows in heaven, might such a thing be?

rr: Onu yaamugira ati: Noija kukireeba n'amaisho gaawe, kwonka torikwija kubiryaho.
en: And he said, Behold, thou shalt see it with thine eyes, but shalt not eat thereof.

rr: Kyaba nikwo kyamubaho kityo; ahabw'okuba abantu bakamuribatiiririra omu irembo, yaafa.
en: And so it fell out unto him: for the people trode upon him in the gate, and he died.

rr: Kandi Elisa akaba agambiire omukazi, ou yaazoire omwana we ati: Imuka ogyende, iwe n'ab'eka yaawe, oshuhuukire ahu orikubaasa hoona; ahabw'okuba MUKAMA aragiire enjara kuteera, kandi neija kumara omu nsi emyaka mushanju.
en: Then spake Elisha unto the woman, whose son he had restored to life, saying, Arise, and go thou and thine household, and sojourn wheresoever thou canst sojourn: for the LORD hath called for a famine; and it shall also come upon the land seven years.

rr: Omukazi yaimuka, yaakora nk'oku omushaija wa Ruhanga yaamugambiire; yaagyenda n'ab'eka ye, yaashuhuukira omu nsi y'Abafilistia okumara emyaka mushanju.
en: And the woman arose, and did after the saying of the man of God: and she went with her household, and sojourned in the land of the Philistines seven years.

rr: Emyaka mushanju ku yaahweire, ogwo mukazi yaagaruka naaruga omu nsi y'Abafilistia, yaaza owa omugabe kumwetongyeza ahabw'enju ye n'obutaka bwe.
en: And it came to pass at the seven years' end, that the woman returned out of the land of the Philistines: and she went forth to cry unto the king for her house and for her land.

rr: Kandi obwo omugabe akaba naagaaniira na Gehazi omuheereza w'omushaija wa Ruhanga, naagira ati: nteekyerereza ebikuru byona ebi Elisa yaakozire.
en: And the king talked with Gehazi the servant of the man of God, saying, Tell me, I pray thee, all the great things that Elisha hath done.

rr: Ku yaabaire naakiteekyerereza omugabe oku Elisa yaahimbwire ofiire, omukazi ou yaahimbwire omutabani, yaija yaayetongyeza omugabe ahabw'enju ye n'obutaka bwe.
en: And it came to pass, as he was telling the king how he had restored a dead body to life, that, behold, the woman, whose son he had restored to life, cried to the king for her house and for her land.

rr: Gehazi yaagira ati: Mukama wangye omugabe, ogu niwe mukazi n'ogu niwe mutabani ou Elisa yaahimbwire.
en: And Gehazi said, My lord, O king, this is the woman, and this is her son, whom Elisha restored to life.

rr: Kandi omugabe ku yaabuurize ogwo mukazi, nawe yaabimushobororera.
en: And when the king asked the woman, she told him.

rr: Atyo omugabe yaamukwatsa omwe aha batware be, yaamugira ati: Omugarurire ebye byona, n'ebyayezire omu misiri ye okwiha obu yaaruga omuri egi nsi n'okuhitsya hati.
en: So the king appointed unto her a certain officer, saying, Restore all that was her's, and all the fruits of the field since the day that she left the land, even until now.

rr: Okufa kwa Benihadadi, na Hazaeli okurya obugabe bwe
en: Elisha and Hazael

rr: Bwanyima Elisa yaaza Damasiko. Omu bunaku obwo Benihadadi omugabe wa Siria akaba arwaire; baamugira bati: Omushaija wa Ruhanga ori yaija.
en: And Elisha came to Damascus; and Ben-hadad the king of Syria was sick; and it was told him, saying, The man of God is come hither.

rr: Omugabe yaagira Hazaeli ati: Twara omukimbo, obugane ogwo mushaija wa Ruhanga, omushabe, akubuurize ahari MUKAMA, naagira ati: Ebyo omugabe naija kukira egi ndwara?
en: And the king said unto Hazael, Take a present in thine hand, and go, meet the man of God, and enquire of the LORD by him, saying, Shall I recover of this disease?

rr: Atyo Hazaeli yaaza kumubugana, aine omukimbo gw'ebintu by'emiringo yoona ebya Damasiko, ebirikwekorerwa engamira makumi ana. Ku yaamuhikire, yaayemerera omu maisho ge, yaagira ati: Omwana waawe Benihadadi omugabe wa Siria yaakuntumaho naabuuza ati: Niinyija kukira egi ndwara?
en: So Hazael went to meet him, and took a present with him, even of every good thing of Damascus, forty camels' burden, and came and stood before him, and said, Thy son Ben-hadad king of Syria hath sent me to thee, saying, Shall I recover of this disease?

rr: Elisa yaamugarukamu ati: Irooko omugire oti: Buzima egyo ndwara noija kugikira. Kwonka kandi MUKAMA anyorekire ngu, buzima naija kufa.
en: And Elisha said unto him, Go, say unto him, Thou mayest certainly recover: howbeit the LORD hath shewed me that he shall surely die.

rr: Yaamugumyaho eriisho, okuhitsya obu yaakwatsirwe enshoni. Omushaija wa Ruhanga yaarira.
en: And he settled his countenance stedfastly, until he was ashamed: and the man of God wept.

rr: Hazaeli yaamubuuza ati: Mukama wangye, noorizibwa ki?
en: And Hazael said, Why weepeth my lord?

rr: Yaagarukamu ati: Ahabw'okuba nimmanya oku orikora kubi Abaisraeli; ebigo byabo oryabyotsya n'omuriro, abatsigazi baabo oryabaitsa rurara, oryateera ahansi abaana baabo, bacwagagurikye, n'abakazi baabo abaine enda obashature aha nda.
en: And he answered, Because I know the evil that thou wilt do unto the children of Israel: their strong holds wilt thou set on fire, and their young men wilt thou slay with the sword, and wilt dash their children, and rip up their women with child.

rr: Hazaeli yaagira ati: Mbwenu nkaanye omwiru waawe embwa, niinye oha okukora ekigambo ekyo ekikuru?
en: And Hazael said, But what, is thy servant a dog, that he should do this great thing?

rr: Elisa yaamugarukamu ati: MUKAMA anyorekire ku orikwija kuba omugabe wa Siria.
en: And Elisha answered, The LORD hath shewed me that thou shalt be king over Syria.

rr: Omu mwaka gwa kataano ogw'omu busingye bwa Yoramu mwene Ahabu omugabe wa Israeli, Yehoraamu mwene Yehoshafaati omugabe wa Yuda akatandika kutegyeka.
en: And in the fifth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel, Jehoshaphat being then king of Judah, Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah began to reign.

rr: 2 Yaaza aha ngoma ahikize emyaka makumi ashatu n'ebiri, yaategyekyera emyaka munaana omuri Yerusaalemu.
en: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign; and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

rr: Yaagyendera omu mitwarize y'abagabe ba Israeli, nk'ab'enju ya Ahabu oku baakozire, ahabw'okuba akashwera muhara wa Ahabu. Kandi yaakora ebirikwangwa MUKAMA.
en: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did the house of Ahab: for the daughter of Ahab was his wife: and he did evil in the sight of the LORD .

rr: Kwonka MUKAMA tarenzire kuhwerekyereza Yuda ahabwa Daudi omwiru we, nk'oku yaaraganiise kuguma naamuha etabaaza n'oruzaaro rwe ebiro byona.
en: Yet the LORD would not destroy Judah for David his servant's sake, as he promised him to give him alway a light, and to his children.

rr: Omu biro bye Abanyaedomu bakagoma, baaruga omu butegyeki bwa Yuda, baayeteeraho omugabe.
en: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves.

rr: Bwanyima Yehoraamu yaayambuka, yaaza Zairi n'ebigaari bye byona. Yaimuka nyekiro, we n'abakuru b'ebigaari bye baateera Abanyaedomu, abaabaire bamwehinguririize; kandi engabo ze zoona zaahunga, zaataaha.
en: So Joram went over to Zair, and all the chariots with him: and he rose by night, and smote the Edomites which compassed him about, and the captains of the chariots: and the people fled into their tents.

rr: Okwo nikwo Edomu yaagomire, ekaruga omu butegyeki bwa Yuda n'okuhitsya hati. Omu bunaku obwo Libuna nayo yaagoma.
en: Yet Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time.

rr: Mbwenu endiijo mirimo ya Yehoraamu n'ebi yaakozire, tibihandiikirwe omu kitabyoky'oby'omu busingye bw'abagabe ba Yuda?
en: And the rest of the acts of Joram, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

rr: Yehoraamu yaagwejegyera, yaashanga baishenkuru, yaaziikwa hamwe na baishenkuru omu rurembo rwa Daudi; Ahazia omutabani yaategyeka omu mwanya gwe. Eby'omu busingye bwa Ahazia omugabe wa Yuda
en: And Joram slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.

rr: Omu mwaka gwa ikumi n'ebiri ogw'omu busingye bwa Yoramu mwene Ahabu omugabe wa Israeli, Ahazia mwene Yerohaamu omugabe wa Yuda akatandika kutegyeka.
en: In the twelfth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel did Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah begin to reign.

rr: Ahazia akaba ahikize emyaka makumi abiri n'ebiri, obu yaatandika kutegyeka.
en: Two and twenty years old was Ahaziah when he began to reign; and he reigned one year in Jerusalem.

rr: Yaategyekyera omwaka gumwe omuri Yerusaalemu; kandi eiziina rya nyina akaba ari Atalia, mwijukuru wa Omuri omugabe wa Israeli.
en: And his mother's name was Athaliah, the daughter of Omri king of Israel.

rr: Nawe yaagyendera omu mitwarize y'ab'enju ya Ahabu, yaakora ebirikwangwa MUKAMA, nk'ab'enju ya Ahabu oku baakozire; ahabw'okuba akaba ari mukwe w'ab'enju ya Ahabu.
en: And he walked in the way of the house of Ahab, and did evil in the sight of the LORD , as did the house of Ahab: for he was the son in law of the house of Ahab.

rr: Bwanyima yaahurura na Yoramu mwene Ahabu kurwanisa Hazaeli omugabe wa Siria omuri Ramosi-gileadi. Abasiria baahutaarizayo Yoramu.
en: And he went with Joram the son of Ahab to the war against Hazael king of Syria in Ramoth-gilead; and the Syrians wounded Joram.

rr: Omugabe Yoramu yaagaruka Yezereeli kurwarizibwayo obuhuta obu Abasiria baamuhutaariize Raama, obu yaarwana na Hazaeli omugabe wa Siria.
en: And king Joram went back to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria.

rr: Kandi Ahazia mwene Yehoraamu omugabe wa Yuda yaashuuma kureeba Yoramu mwene Ahabu omuri Yezereeli, ahabw'okuba akaba arwaire.
en: And Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Joram the son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.

Bwanyima Elisa nabi yaayeta omwe aha batabani ba baanabi, yaamugira ati: Yezirikye, otware eri ihembe ry'amajuta, oze Ramosi-gileadi.
en: And Elisha the prophet called one of the children of the prophets, and said unto him, Gird up thy loins, and take this box of oil in thine hand, and go to Ramoth-gilead:

rr: Ku oraahikyeyo, osherure Yehu mwene Yehoshafaati, mwijukuru wa Nimushi; ku oraamanye omu ati, otaahemu, omwimutsye omuri beene ishe, omutware omu kishengye ky'omunda.
en: and when thou comest thither, look out there Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi, and go in, and make him arise up from among his brethren, and carry him to an inner chamber;

rr: Bwanyima okwate eri ihembe ry'amajuta, ogamushukye aha mutwe, ogire oti: Oku nikwo MUKAMA arikugamba naagira ati: Naakushukaho amajuta kuba omugabe wa Israeli.
en: then take the box of oil, and pour it on his head, and say, Thus saith the LORD , I have anointed thee king over Israel.

rr: Ku oraaheze, oigure orwigi, ohungye, oteeziringa.
en: Then open the door, and flee, and tarry not.

rr: Atyo ogwo mutsigazi nabi yaagyenda, yaaza Ramosi-gileadi.
en: So the young man, even the young man the prophet, went to Ramoth-gilead.

rr: Ku yaahikireyo, yaashanga abakuru b'eihe nibahanuura; yaagira ati: Nyine obutumwa ahariiwe, Omukuru w'engabo.
en: And when he came, behold, the captains of the host were sitting; and he said, I have an errand to thee, O captain.

rr: Yehu yaamubuuza ati: Ahari oha omuriitwe twena?
en: And Jehu said, Unto which of all us?

rr: Yaamugarukamu ati: Ahariiwe, Omukuru w'engabo.
en: And he said, To thee, O captain.

rr: Atyo Yehu yaimuka, baataaha omu nju; ogwo mutsigazi yaamushuka amajuta aha mutwe, naamugira ati: Oku nikwo MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa Israeli arikugamba naagira ati: Naakushukaho amajuta kuba omugabe w'eihanga rya MUKAMA Israeli.
en: And he arose, and went into the house; and he poured the oil on his head, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I have anointed thee king over the people of the LORD , even over Israel.

rr: 1 Oryaita ab'enju ya Ahabu mukama waawe, mbone kuhoora Yezebeeli enzigu y'eshagama y'abairu bangye baanabi, kandi n'eshagama y'abandi bairu ba MUKAMA boona.
en: And thou shalt smite the house of Ahab thy master, that I may avenge the blood of my servants the prophets, and the blood of all the servants of the LORD , at the hand of Jezebel.

rr: Ahakuba ab'enju ya Ahabu boona nibaija kuhwerekyerera, mmare ahari Ahabu oyetwa omushaija weena, omuhuuku nari ow'obusingye, omuri Israeli.
en: For the whole house of Ahab shall perish: and I will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel:

rr: Kandi ndyahindura enju ya Ahabu nk'eya Yeroboamu mwene Nebati, kandi nk'eya Baasha mwene Ahiya.
en: and I will make the house of Ahab like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah:

rr: Embwa ziryariira Yezebeeli omu kibanja kya Yezereeli, abure owaamuziika.
en: and the dogs shall eat Jezebel in the portion of Jezreel, and there shall be none to bury her .

rr: Ahonaaho yaigura orwigi, yairuka.
en: And he opened the door, and fled.

rr: Bwanyima Yehu yaashohora, yaagaruka aha bashaija ba mukama we, baamubuuza bati: Ni buhooro? Ogwo mushaija omugwairaro yaaba areetsirwe ki ahariiwe? Yaabagarukamu ati: Ogwo mushaija nimumumanya n'ebigambo bye.
en: Then Jehu came forth to the servants of his lord: and one said unto him, Is all well? wherefore came this mad fellow to thee? And he said unto them, Ye know the man, and his communication.

rr: Baagira bati: Ngaaha, noobeiha; tugambire amazima.
en: And they said, It is false; tell us now.

rr: Onu ati: Yaagamba naanye naagira ati: Oku nikwo MUKAMA arikugamba naagira ati: Naakushukaho amajuta kuba omugabe wa Israeli.
en: And he said, Thus and thus spake he to me, saying, Thus saith the LORD , I have anointed thee king over Israel.

rr: Batyo baarahuka, buri muntu yaakwata ekijwaro kye, baabyara ahansi ye aha mutwe gw'amatembero, baateera eikondere nibagira bati: Yehu yaaba omugabe. Yehu okwita Yoramu na Ahazia
en: Then they hasted, and took every man his garment, and put it under him on the top of the stairs, and blew with trumpets, saying, Jehu is king.

rr: Oku nikwo Yehu mwene Yehoshafaati mwijukuru wa Nimushi, yaagomeire Yoramu. (Omu bunaku obwo Yoramu n'Abaisraeli boona bakaba nibarinda Ramosi-gileadi Hazaeli omugabe wa Siria
en: So Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi conspired against Joram. (Now Joram had kept Ramoth-gilead, he and all Israel, because of Hazael king of Syria.

rr: kwonka omugabe Yoramu akaba agarukire Yezereeli kurwarizibwayo obuhuta obu Abasiria baamuhutaize, obu yaarwana na Hazaeli omugabe wa Siria.) Atyo Yehu yaagira ati: Eki ku muraabe nikyo murikwenda, hatagira omuntu weena owairuka kuruga omu rurembo, kutwara enkuru omuri Yezereeli.
en: But king Joram was returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him, when he fought with Hazael king of Syria.) And Jehu said, If it be your minds, then let none go forth nor escape out of the city to go to tell it in Jezreel.

rr: Atyo Yehu yaatemba ekigaari, yaaza Yezereeli, ahakuba Yoramu niyo yaabaire arwariire; kandi obwo Ahazia omugabe wa Yuda akaba ashuumireyo kureeba Yoramu.
en: So Jehu rode in a chariot, and went to Jezreel; for Joram lay there. And Ahaziah king of Judah was come down to see Joram.

rr: Obwo omurinzi akaba ayemereire aha munaara gw'omuri Yezereeli, naareebera ahare omutwe gw'engabo za Yehu nigwija; yaagira ati: Nindeeba omutwe gw'engabo nigwija.
en: And there stood a watchman on the tower in Jezreel, and he spied the company of Jehu as he came, and said, I see a company.

rr: Yoramu yaagira ati: Tuma omuntu aha mbaraasi ababugane, ababuuze ati: Ni buhooro?
en: And Joram said, Take an horseman, and send to meet them, and let him say, Is it peace?

rr: Atyo ow'aha mbaraasi yaaza kumubugana, yaagira ati: Omugabe naabuuza ngu, Ni buhooro? Yehu yaagira ati: Ebya buhooro noofa ki nabyo? Hingura, okubuukye, onkurate. Ogwo murinzi yaagira ati: Entumwa yaabahika, kwonka tindikureeba neegaruka.
en: So there went one on horseback to meet him, and said, Thus saith the king, Is it peace? And Jehu said, What hast thou to do with peace? turn thee behind me. And the watchman told, saying, The messenger came to them, but he cometh not again.

rr: Omugabe yaagaruka yaatuma ondiijo aha mbaraasi; nawe yaabahika, yaabagira ati: Omugabe naabuuza ngu, Ni buhooro? Yehu yaagarukamu ati: Ebya buhooro, noofa ki nabyo? Hingura, okubuukye, onkurate.
en: Then he sent out a second on horseback, which came to them, and said, Thus saith the king, Is it peace? And Jehu answered, What hast thou to do with peace? turn thee behind me.

rr: Omurinzi yaagaruka yaagira ati: Nawe yaabahika, kwonka tindikureeba naagaruka. Kandi emivugire neeshusha eya Yehu mwene Nimushi, ahakuba naavugisa amaani.
en: And the watchman told, saying, He came even unto them, and cometh not again: and the driving is like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi; for he driveth furiously.

rr: Yoramu yaagira ati: Muboneze ekigaari kyangye.
en: And Joram said, Make ready.

rr: Baakiboneza.
en: And his chariot was made ready.

rr: Yoramu omugabe wa Israeli na Ahazia omugabe wa Yuda baashohora, buri omwe omu kigaari kye, baaza kubugana Yehu, baamubugana aha kibanja kya Nabosi owa Yezereeli.
en: And Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah went out, each in his chariot, and they went out against Jehu, and met him in the portion of Naboth the Jezreelite.

rr: Yoramu ku yaareebire Yehu, yaamubuuza ati: Ni buhooro, Yehu?
en: And it came to pass, when Joram saw Jehu, that he said, Is it peace, Jehu?

rr: Onu yamugarukau ati: Ni buhooro ki, obushambani bwa nyoko Yezebeeli, n'oburugo bwe bikiri bingi biti?
en: And he answered, What peace, so long as the whoredoms of thy mother Jezebel and her witchcrafts are so many?

rr: Yoramu yaahinduza embaraasi orukoba, yaahunga, naagira Ahazia ati: Ahazia, hariho okureebyana!
en: And Joram turned his hands, and fled, and said to Ahaziah, There is treachery, O Ahaziah.

rr: Yehu yaananuura obuta bwe n'amaani ge goona, yaateeera Yoramu omwambi omu buteeraniro bw'amabega, gwamwata omutima, gwayogamu, yaagwa omu kigaari kye
en: And Jehu drew a bow with his full strength, and smote Jehoram between his arms, and the arrow went out at his heart, and he sunk down in his chariot.

rr: Yehu yaagira Bidukaari omukuru w'engabo ze, ati: Mukirize, omunagye omu musiri gw'ekibanja kya Nabosi owa Yezereeli; ahakuba noijuka, obu nyowe naiwe twakurata Ahabu ishe, turi aha mbaraasi, MUKAMA akamuraguraho ekigambo eki ati
en: Then said Jehu to Bidkar his captain, Take up, and cast him in the portion of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite: for remember how that, when I and thou rode together after Ahab his father, the LORD laid this burden upon him;

rr: Buzimazima, nk'oku nyomwabazyo ndeebire eshagama ya Nabosi n'abatabani, naanye ndyakuhoorera omuri ogu musiri; nikwo MUKAMA arikugira.
en: surely I have seen yesterday the blood of Naboth, and the blood of his sons, saith the LORD ; and I will requite thee in this plat, saith the LORD .

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo mukirize, omunagye omuri ogwo musiri, nk'oku MUKAMA yaagambire.
en: Now therefore take and cast him into the plat of ground , according to the word of the LORD .

rr: Ahazia omugabe wa Yuda ku yaakireebire, yaahungira omu muhanda ogurikuza Besi-hagani.
en: But when Ahaziah the king of Judah saw this , he fled by the way of the garden house.

rr: Yehu yaamubinga, naagira ati: Nawe mumurashe.
en: And Jehu followed after him, and said, Smite him also in the chariot.

rr: Baamurasira omu kigaari kye yaahika aharikweinamuka Guuri, eri haihi na Ibuleamu.
en: And they did so at the going up to Gur, which is by Ibleam.

rr: Yaahungira Megido, yaagwayo.
en: And he fled to Megiddo, and died there.

rr: Abagaragwa be baamuta omu kigaari, baamutwara Yerusaalemu, baamuziika omu kituuro omu rurembo rwa Daudi, baamushangisa baishenkuru.
en: And his servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and buried him in his sepulchre with his fathers in the city of David.

rr: Kandi omu mwaka gwa ikumi na gumwe ogw'omu busingye bwa Yoramu mwene Ahabu, Ahazia akatandika kutegyeka Yuda. Okufa kwa Yezebeeli
en: And in the eleventh year of Joram the son of Ahab began Ahaziah to reign over Judah.

rr: Yehu ku yaahikire Yezereeli, Yezebeeli yaakihurira, yaaziga amaisho ge, yaaboneza eishokye rye, yaaringuririza omu dirisa.
en: And when Jehu was come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it ; and she painted her face, and tired her head, and looked out at a window.

rr: 1 Yehu ku yaabaire yaahika ati omu rurembo, Yezebeeli yaamugira ati: Iwe Zimuri, owaita mukama waawe, ni buhooro?
en: And as Jehu entered in at the gate, she said, Had Zimri peace, who slew his master?

rr: Yehu yaimutsya amaisho, yaareeba omu dirisa, yaagira ati: Ori aha rubaju rwangye n'oha? N'oha? Abakonwa bashatu nari babiri baamuringuriza.
en: And he lifted up his face to the window, and said, Who is on my side? who? And there looked out to him two or three eunuchs.

rr: Yaabagira ati: Mumunagye ahansi.
en: And he said, Throw her down.

rr: Batyo baamunaga ahansi, eshagama ye yaataraakira ekisiika n'embaraasi, zaamuribatiirira.
en: So they threw her down: and some of her blood was sprinkled on the wall, and on the horses: and he trode her under foot.

rr: Yehu yaataaha omu nju, yaarya, yaanywa; bwanyima yaagira ati: Mwirooko mureebe ogwo mukazi okyeenirwe, mumuziikye, ahakuba ni muhara w'omugabe.
en: And when he was come in, he did eat and drink, and said, Go, see now this cursed woman , and bury her: for she is a king's daughter.

rr: kandi omutumbi gwe guryaba nk'amasha agari ahansi omu musiri gwa Yezereeli, habure owaagira ati: Ogu ni Yezebeeli.
en: And the carcase of Jezebel shall be as dung upon the face of the field in the portion of Jezreel; so that they shall not say, This is Jezebel.

rr: Kandi Ahabu akaba aine abatabani makumi mushanju omuri Samaria.
en: And Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria.

rr: Yehu yaahandiika ebaruha, yaazitwekyera abategyeki b'orurembo Samaria, n'abakuru baarwo, kandi n'abarezi ba beene Ahabu, naabagira ati
en: And Jehu wrote letters, and sent to Samaria, unto the rulers of Jezreel, to the elders, and to them that brought up Ahab's children , saying,

rr: Egi baruha ku eraabahikye eti, nk'oku mwine batabani ba mukama waanyu, kandi mukagira ebigaari n'embaraasi n'endembo ezeehinguririziibwe engo z'amabaare n'eby'okurwanisa
en: Now as soon as this letter cometh to you, seeing your master's sons are with you, and there are with you chariots and horses, a fenced city also, and armour;

rr: mutoorane omuri batabani ba mukama waanyu orikukira abandi boona, kandi ohikire, mumute aha kitebe ky'obugabe bwa ishe, murwanirire enju ya mukama waanyu.
en: look even out the best and meetest of your master's sons, and set him on his father's throne, and fight for your master's house.

rr: Kwonka baatiina munonga, baagira bati. Ku araabe atabaasiibwe abo bagabe bombi, itwe nitubaasa tuta kumuza omu kaso?
en: But they were exceedingly afraid, and said, Behold, two kings stood not before him: how then shall we stand?

rr: Atyo omutegyeki w'ekikaari n'ow'orurembo hamwe n'abakuru n'abo barezi b'abaana, baatuma ahari Yehu nibagira bati: Turi abairu baawe; nitwija kukora ebi oraaturagiire byona; kandi titwine muntu weena ou turaayemekye; kureka iwe okore eki orikusiima.
en: And he that was over the house, and he that was over the city, the elders also, and the bringers up of the children , sent to Jehu, saying, We are thy servants, and will do all that thou shalt bid us; we will not make any king: do thou that which is good in thine eyes.

rr: Yaagaruka yaabahandiikira ebaruha ya kabiri, naagira ati: Ku muraabe muri abangye, kandi mweteekateekire kuunyorobera, mutemeho batabani ba mukama waanyu emitwe, nyencakare nk'aga magingo muginshangise Yezereeli.
en: Then he wrote a letter the second time to them, saying, If ye be mine, and if ye will hearken unto my voice, take ye the heads of the men your master's sons, and come to me to Jezreel by to morrow this time.

rr: Obwo bunaku batabani b'omugabe boona makumi mushanju bakaba bari hamwe n'abakuru b'orurembo, abaabaire nibabarera.
en: Now the king's sons, being seventy persons, were with the great men of the city, which brought them up.

rr: Egyo baruha ku yaabahikire, baakwata batabani b'omugabe, baabaita boona makumi mushanju, emitwe yaabo baagita omu bitukuru, baagimutwekyera Yezereeli.
en: And it came to pass, when the letter came to them, that they took the king's sons, and slew seventy persons, and put their heads in baskets, and sent him them to Jezreel.

rr: Entumwa yaija, yaamugira eti: Emitwe y'abaana b'omugabe baagireeta.
en: And there came a messenger, and told him, saying, They have brought the heads of the king's sons.

rr: Yaagira ati: Mugirunde ebirundo bibiri aha irembo egumeho okuhitsya omu kasheeshe.
en: And he said, Lay ye them in two heaps at the entering in of the gate until the morning.

rr: Omu kasheeshe ku yaashohoire, yaayemerera omu maisho g'abantu boona, yaabagira ati: Imwe timwine urbanja; niinye ngomeire mukama wangye, nkamwita; mbwenu nimugira ngu oitsire aba boona, n'oha?
en: And it came to pass in the morning, that he went out, and stood, and said to all the people, Ye be righteous: behold, I conspired against my master, and slew him: but who slew all these?

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo mumanye ku hatariho kigambo na kimwe eki MUKAMA yaagambire aha nju ya Ahabu ekiribura; ahabw'okuba MUKAMA ahikiriize eki yaagambire naaraba omu mwiru we Eliya.
en: Know now that there shall fall unto the earth nothing of the word of the LORD , which the LORD spake concerning the house of Ahab: for the LORD hath done that which he spake by his servant Elijah.

rr: Bwanyima Yehu yaita boona abaabaire batsigaire omu nju ya Ahabu omuri Yezereeli, abashaija be ab'aha mara, n'abanyamurwa be; tiyaatsigaho na waakizira.
en: So Jehu slew all that remained of the house of Ahab in Jezreel, and all his great men, and his kinsfolks, and his priests, until he left him none remaining.

en: Jehu met with the brethren of Ahaziah king of Judah, and said, Who are ye?

en: And he said, Take them alive. And they took them alive, and slew them at the pit of the shearing house, even two and forty men; neither left he any of them.

rr: 1 -10 , 14 , 16 , Ku yaarugire aho, yaabugana Yehonadabu mwene Rekabu, aizire kumubugana, yaamuramutsya, yaamubuuza ati: Omutima gwawe ni mwere, nk'oku ogwagye guri mwere ahariiwe? en: And when he was departed thence, he lighted on Jehonadab the son of Rechab coming to meet him: and he saluted him, and said to him, Is thine heart right, as my heart is with thy heart? And Jehonadab answered, It is. If it be, give me thine hand. And he gave him his hand; and he took him up to him into the chariot.

rr: yaamugira ati: Ija tugyende, oreebe obweziriki bwangye ahabwa MUKAMA. Atyo yaamutwara omu kigaari kye.
en: And he said, Come with me, and see my zeal for the LORD . So they made him ride in his chariot.

rr: Ku yaahikire Samaria, yaita aba Ahabu boona abaabaire batsigaire Samaria, okuhitsya obu yaabamazireho, nk'ekigambo kya MUKAMA, eki yaagambiire Eliya, oku kyabaire kiri.
en: And when he came to Samaria, he slew all that remained unto Ahab in Samaria, till he had destroyed him, according to the saying of the LORD , which he spake to Elijah.

rr: Bwanyima Yehu yaateeranira hamwe abantu boona, yaabagira ati: Ahabu akaheereza Baali mpora, kwonka Yehu naija kumuheereza munonga.
en: And Jehu gathered all the people together, and said unto them, Ahab served Baal a little; but Jehu shall serve him much.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo hati muunyetere baanabi ba Baali boona, boona abarikumuramya, n'abanyamurwa be boona, hatagira n'omwe owaaburaho; ahabw'okuba nyine ekitambo kihango ky'okutambira Baali; weena oraabureho tarikwija kugumaho.
en: Now therefore call unto me all the prophets of Baal, all his servants, and all his priests; let none be wanting: for I have a great sacrifice to do to Baal; whosoever shall be wanting, he shall not live.

rr: Kwoha Yehu ekyo akakikoresa obwengye oburimu obugobya, ngu abone kucwekyereza abarikuramya Baali.
en: But Jehu did it in subtilty, to the intent that he might destroy the worshippers of Baal.

rr: Yehu yaaragiira ati: Murangye, habeho okuteerana okurikwera ahabwa Baali. Batyo baakuranga.
en: And Jehu said, Proclaim a solemn assembly for Baal. And they proclaimed it .

rr: Yehu yaatuma omuri Israeli yoona; abaabaire nibaramya Baali boona baija, tihaagira muntu n'omwe owaatsigarayo ataizire.
en: And Jehu sent through all Israel: and all the worshippers of Baal came, so that there was not a man left that came not.

rr: Baataaha omuri nyaruju ya Baali, yaijura n'aha bunwa.
en: And they came into the house of Baal; and the house of Baal was full from one end to another.

rr: Yehu yaagambira orikutegyeka enju erikubikwamu ebijwaro, ati: Reetera abaramya Baali boona ebijwaro.
en: And he said unto him that was over the vestry, Bring forth vestments for all the worshippers of Baal.

rr: Atyo yaabibareetera.
