rr: Bwanyima Yehu yaataaha omuri nyaruju ya Baali na Yehonadabu mwene Rekabu, yaagambira abarikuramya Baali ati: Mwetegyereze, muhamye ngu omuriimwe tiharimu mwiru wa MUKAMA, kureka abarikuramya Baali bonka.
en: And Jehu went, and Jehonadab the son of Rechab, into the house of Baal, and said unto the worshippers of Baal, Search, and look that there be here with you none of the servants of the LORD , but the worshippers of Baal only.

rr: Atyo yaataahamu kuhayo ebitambo n'okutamba ebitambo by'okwotsya. Kwonka Yehu akaba ataire aheeru abashaija makumi munaana, yaabagira ati: Omuntu oraikirize omwe ahari aba, abu naata omu mikono yaanyu, kubura, naamuzira.
en: And when they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings, Jehu appointed fourscore men without, and said, If any of the men whom I have brought into your hands escape, he that letteth him go , his life shall be for the life of him.

rr: Batyo baabaitsa rurara; bwanyima abarinzi n'abakuru b'engabo baabanaga aheeru, baataaha omu kishengye ky'omunda omuri nyaruju ya Baali
en: And they smote them with the edge of the sword; and the guard and the captains cast them out, and went to the city of the house of Baal.

rr: baashohoza enyomyo ezaabaire ziri omuri nyaruju ya Baali, baazootsya.

en: And they brake down the image of Baal, and brake down the house of Baal, and made it a draught house unto this day.

rr: Okwo nikwo Yehu yaamazireho Baali, akamwiha omuri Israeli

rr: 1 -31 ; 14:16 . Kwonka Yehu tararekire kukora bibi bya Yeroboamu mwene Nebati ebi yaasiisiise Abaisraeli, nibyo bishushani by'enyana eby'ezaabu ebyabaire biri Beseeli na Daani.
en: Howbeit from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, Jehu departed not from after them, to wit , the golden calves that were in Beth-el, and that were in Dan.

en: And the LORD said unto Jehu, Because thou hast done well in executing that which is right in mine eyes, and hast done unto the house of Ahab according to all that was in mine heart, thy children of the fourth generation shall sit on the throne of Israel.

rr: Kwonka Yehu tiyaayeta aha kugyendera omu biragiro bya MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli n'omutima gwe gwona; tiyaaruga mu bibi ebi Yeroboamu yaakoreise Abaisraeli, bakacumura.
en: But Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of the LORD God of Israel with all his heart: for he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam, which made Israel to sin.

rr: Omu biro ebyo MUKAMA yaatandika kutuubya ensi ya Israeli. Hazaeli yaabasingura omu myatano ya Israeli yoona

en: from Jordan eastward, all the land of Gilead, the Gadites, and the Reubenites, and the Manassites, from Aroer, which is by the river Arnon, even Gilead and Bashan.

en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehu, and all that he did, and all his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

rr: Kandi emyaka ei Yehu yaamazire aha ngoma naategyeka Israeli omuri Samaria ekahika makumi abiri na munaana.
en: And the time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty and eight years.

en: And to the captains over hundreds did the priest give king David's spears and shields, that were in the temple of the LORD .

en: And the guard stood, every man with his weapons in his hand, round about the king, from the right corner of the temple to the left corner of the temple, along by the altar and the temple.

en: And when Athaliah heard the noise of the guard and of the people, she came to the people into the temple of the LORD .

en: And they laid hands on her; and she went by the way by the which the horses came into the king's house: and there was she slain.

en: And all the people of the land went into the house of Baal, and brake it down; his altars and his images brake they in pieces thoroughly, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.

rr: Kandi omunyamurwa yaata abarinzi aha nju ya MUKAMA.
en: And the priest appointed officers over the house of the LORD .

en: And he took the rulers over hundreds, and the captains, and the guard, and all the people of the land; and they brought down the king from the house of the LORD , and came by the way of the gate of the guard to the king's house. And he sat on the throne of the kings.

en: And all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was in quiet: and they slew Athaliah with the sword beside the king's house.

en: And Jehoash said to the priests, All the money of the dedicated things that is brought into the house of the LORD , even the money of every one that passeth the account , the money that every man is set at, and all the money that cometh into any man's heart to bring into the house of the LORD ,

rr: abanyamurwa bazitware, buri omwe aziihe ahari mugyenzi we, bazihunduuze enju, ahi esiisikaire hoona.
en: let the priests take it to them, every man of his acquaintance: and let them repair the breaches of the house, wheresoever any breach shall be found.

en: Then king Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest, and the other priests, and said unto them, Why repair ye not the breaches of the house? now therefore receive no more money of your acquaintance, but deliver it for the breaches of the house.

en: And the priests consented to receive no more money of the people, neither to repair the breaches of the house.

rr: Bwanyima Yehoyaada omunyamurwa yaareeta eshanduukye, yaafumura ekifundikizo kyayo, yaagita haihi n'eitambiro aha rubaju rwa buryo omuntu yaaba naataaha omu nju ya MUKAMA; kandi abanyamurwa abaabaire barinda eirembo baaguma nibatamu empiiha zoona ezaabaire nizireetwa omu nju ya MUKAMA.
en: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest, and bored a hole in the lid of it, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one cometh into the house of the LORD : and the priests that kept the door put therein all the money that was brought into the house of the LORD .

en: And it was so , when they saw that there was much money in the chest, that the king's scribe and the high priest came up, and they put up in bags, and told the money that was found in the house of the LORD .

en: and to masons, and hewers of stone, and to buy timber and hewed stone to repair the breaches of the house of the LORD , and for all that was laid out for the house to repair it .

en: Howbeit there were not made for the house of the LORD bowls of silver, snuffers, basons, trumpets, any vessels of gold, or vessels of silver, of the money that was brought into the house of the LORD :

en: but they gave that to the workmen, and repaired therewith the house of the LORD .

en: Moreover they reckoned not with the men, into whose hand they delivered the money to be bestowed on workmen: for they dealt faithfully.

en: The trespass money and sin money was not brought into the house of the LORD : it was the priests'.

en: Then Hazael king of Syria went up, and fought against Gath, and took it: and Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem.

en: And Jehoash king of Judah took all the hallowed things that Jehoshaphat, and Jehoram, and Ahaziah, his fathers, kings of Judah, had dedicated, and his own hallowed things, and all the gold that was found in the treasures of the house of the LORD , and in the king's house, and sent it to Hazael king of Syria: and he went away from Jerusalem.

rr: Omu mwaka gwa makumi ashatu na mwenda ogw'omu busingye bwa Uziya omugabe wa Yuda, Shalumu mwene Yabeshi akatandika kutegyeka; yaategyekyera okwezi kumwe omuri Samaria.
en: Shallum the son of Jabesh began to reign in the nine and thirtieth year of Uzziah king of Judah; and he reigned a full month in Samaria.

rr: Bwanyima Menahemu mwene Gaadi yaaruga Tiruza, yaija Samaria, yaitirayo Shalumu mwene Yabeshi, yaategyeka omu mwanya gwe.
en: For Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah, and came to Samaria, and smote Shallum the son of Jabesh in Samaria, and slew him, and reigned in his stead.

rr: Endiijo mirimo ya Shalumu yoona, n'okugoma oku yaagomire, reeba bihandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'eby'omu busingye bw'abagabe ba Israeli.
en: And the rest of the acts of Shallum, and his conspiracy which he made, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

rr: Bwanyima omu biro ebyo Menahemu akateera Tifusa, yaagicwekyereza n'abaabaire barimu boona, n'ebyaro byayo byona okuruga Tiruza okuhika aha myatano yaayo; eki yaagicwekyerereize n'ahabw'okuba bakanga kumwigurira amarembo, kandi n'abakazi baamwo abaabaire baine enda yaabashatura aha nda.
en: Then Menahem smote Tiphsah, and all that were therein, and the coasts thereof from Tirzah: because they opened not to him , therefore he smote it; and all the women therein that were with child he ripped up.

rr: Omu mwaka gwa makumi ashatu na mwenda ogw'omu busingye bwa Uziya omugabe wa Yuda, Menahemu mwene Gaadi akatandika kutegyeka Israeli, yaategyekyera emyaka ikumi omuri Samaria.
en: In the nine and thirtieth year of Azariah king of Judah began Menahem the son of Gadi to reign over Israel, and reigned ten years in Samaria.

rr: Yaakora ebirikwangwa MUKAMA; omu biro bye byona tiyaareka bibi bya Yeroboamu mwene Nebati ebi yaasiisiise Israeli.
en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD : he departed not all his days from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.

rr: Eizooba rimwe Puuli omugabe wa Asiria yaateera egyo nsi; Menahemu yaamuhongyera etalanta z'efeeza rukumi, ngu amuhwere abone kuhama omu bugabe bwe.
en: And Pul the king of Assyria came against the land: and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver, that his hand might be with him to confirm the kingdom in his hand.

rr: Kandi ezo mpiiha Menahemu akaba aziihire omu batungi boona ab'omuri Israeli, buri muntu omuribo shekeli z'efeeza makumi ataano, ngu abone kuziha ogwo mugabe wa Asiria.
en: And Menahem exacted the money of Israel, even of all the mighty men of wealth, of each man fifty shekels of silver, to give to the king of Assyria.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo omugabe wa Asiria yaakuba yaagarukayo, tiyaaguma muri egyo nsi.
en: So the king of Assyria turned back, and stayed not there in the land.

rr: Mbwenu endiijo mirimo ya Menahemu n'ebi yaakozire byona, tibihandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'eby'omu busingye bw'abagabe ba Israeli?
en: And the rest of the acts of Menahem, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

rr: Menahemu yaagwejegyera, yaashanga baishenkuru; omutabani Pekahia yaategyeka omu mwanya gwe.
en: And Menahem slept with his fathers; and Pekahiah his son reigned in his stead.

rr: Omu mwaka gwa makumi ataano ogw'omu busingye bwa Uziya omugabe wa Yuda Pekahia mwne Menahemu akatandika kutegyekyera Israeli omuri Samaria; yaamar aemyaka ebiri ari aha ngoma.
en: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah Pekahiah the son of Menahem began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned two years.

rr: Yaakora ebirikwangwa MUKAMA, tiyaareka bibi bya Yeroboamu mwene Nebati, ebi yaasiisiise Israeli.
en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD : he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.

rr: Bwanyima Peeka mwene Remalia, omukru w'engabo ze, yaamugiira omu naama, yaamwitira Samaria omu kigo ky'omu kikaari ky'omugabe. Ku yaaherize kumwita, yaategyeka omu mwanya gwe.
en: But Pekah the son of Remaliah, a captain of his, conspired against him, and smote him in Samaria, in the palace of the king's house, with Argob and Arieh, and with him fifty men of the Gileadites: and he killed him, and reigned in his room.

rr: Mbwenu endiijo mirimo ya Pekahia n'ebi yaakozire byona, bikahandiikwa omu kitabo ky'eby'omu busingye bw'abagabe ba Israeli.
en: And the rest of the acts of Pekahiah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

rr: Omu mwaka gwa makumi ataano ogw'omu busingye bwa Uziya omugabe wa Yuda Peeka mwene Remalia akatandika kutegyekyera Israeli omuri Samaria, yaamara emyaka makumi abiri ari aha ngoma.
en: In the two and fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah Pekah the son of Remaliah began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned twenty years.

rr: Yaakora ebirikwangwa MUKAMA, tiyaareka bibi bya Yeroboamu, ebi yaasiisiise Israeli.
en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD : he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.

rr: Omu biro bya Peeka omugabe wa Israeli Tigulaasi-pileseeri omugabe wa Asiria yaija, yaakwata Iyooni, Abeelibesi-maaka, Yanoa, Kedeshi, Hazori, Gileadi na Galilaaya, ensi yoona eya Nafutaali; kandi abantu yaabatwara Asiria bari enkwatwa.
en: In the days of Pekah king of Israel came Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, and took Ijon, and Abel-beth-maachah, and Janoah, and Kedesh, and Hazor, and Gilead, and Galilee, all the land of Naphtali, and carried them captive to Assyria.

rr: Bwanyima Hoshea mwene Ela yaagiira Peeka mwene Remalia omu naama, yaamuteera, yaamwita; yaatandika kutegyeka omu mwanya gwe omu mwaka gwa makumi abiri ogw'omu busingye bwa Yosamu mwene Uziya.
en: And Hoshea the son of Elah made a conspiracy against Pekah the son of Remaliah, and smote him, and slew him, and reigned in his stead, in the twentieth year of Jotham the son of Uzziah.

rr: Mbwenu endiijo mirimo ya Peeka n'ebi yaakozire byona bikahandiikwa omu kitabo ky'eby'omu busingye bw'abagabe ba Israeli.
en: And the rest of the acts of Pekah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel. Jotham

rr: Omu mwaka gwa kabiri ogw'omu busingye bwa Peeka mwene Remalia omugabe wa Israeli Yosamu mwene Uziya omugabe wa Yuda akatandika kutegyeka.
en: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Israel began Jotham the son of Uzziah king of Judah to reign.

rr: Obu yaatandikire kutegyeka, akaba ahikize emyaka makumi abiri n'etaano, yaamara emyaka ikumi na mukaaga ari aha ngoma omuri Yerusaalemu.
en: Five and twenty years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem.

rr: Kandi nyina akaba naayetwa Yerusha mwne Zadoki.
en: And his mother's name was Jerusha, the daughter of Zadok.

rr: Akakora ebirikusiimwa MUKAMA, nk'ebi Uziya ishe yaakozire byona.
en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD : he did according to all that his father Uzziah had done.

rr: Kwonka emyanya mikuru ey'okuramizamu tiyaasheenywa; kureka abantu bakaguma bagitambiramu ebitambo, bagyotereramu obubaane.
en: Howbeit the high places were not removed: the people sacrificed and burned incense still in the high places.

rr: Kandi yaayombeka eirembo ry'ekikaari kya MUKAMA ery'aharuguru.
en: He built the higher gate of the house of the LORD .

rr: Mbwenu endiijo mirimo ya Yosamu n'ebi yaakozire byona tibihandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'eby'omu busingye bw'abagabe ba Yuda?
en: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

rr: Omu biro ebyo MUKAMA akatandika kutuma Rezini omugabe wa Siria na Peeka mwene Remalia kurwanisa Yuda.
en: In those days the LORD began to send against Judah Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah.

rr: Bwanyima Yosamu yaagwejegyera, yaashanga baishenkuru, baamuziika hamwe nabo omu rurembo rwa Daudi ishenkuru; Ahazi omutabani yaategyeka omu mwanya gwe.
en: And Jotham slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead.

rr: Omu mwaka gwa ikumi na mushanju ogw'omu busingye bwa Peeka mwene Remalia, Ahazi mwene Yosamu omugabe wa Yuda akatandika kutegyeka.
en: In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah Ahaz the son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign.

rr: 2 Akaba ahikize emyaka makumi abiri, obu yaatandika kutegyeka; yaategyekyera emyaka ikumi na mukaaga omuri Yerusaalemu. Tiyaakora birikusiimwa MUKAMA Ruhanga we, nk'oku ishenkuru Daudi yaakozire
en: Twenty years old was Ahaz when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem, and did not that which was right in the sight of the LORD his God, like David his father.

rr: kureka yaagyendera omu mitwarize y'abagabe ba Israeli; kandi yaarabya n'omutabani omu muriro, naakuratira ebirikunugwa eby'abanyamahanga, abu MUKAMA yaabingire omu maisho g'Abaisraeli.
en: But he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, yea, and made his son to pass through the fire, according to the abominations of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel.

rr: Kandi yaaguma naatambira ebitambo, naayoterera obubaane omu myanya mikuru ey'okuramizamu n'aha bibungo kandi n'ahansi ya buri kiti ekyetwa omurinzi.
en: And he sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

rr: Bwanyima Rezini omugabe wa Siria na Peeka mwene Remalia omugabe wa Israeli bainamuka kuteera Yerusaalemu; baagota Ahazi, kwonka tibaabaasa kumusingura.
en: Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to Jerusalem to war: and they besieged Ahaz, but could not overcome him .

rr: Omu biro ebyo nimwo omugabe wa Edomu yaagaruriire Elaasi omuri Edomu, akabingamu abashaija ba Yuda; Abanyaedomu bakaija omuri Elaasi; bakagumamu n'okuhitsya hati.
en: At that time Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria, and drave the Jews from Elath: and the Syrians came to Elath, and dwelt there unto this day.

rr: Atyo Ahazi yaatuma entumwa ahari Tigulaasi-pileseeri omugabe wa Asiria, naagira ati: Ndi omwiru waawe kandi omwana waawe. Rugayo onjune omugabe wa Siria n'owa Israeli, abanteire.
en: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, saying, I am thy servant and thy son: come up, and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria, and out of the hand of the king of Israel, which rise up against me.

rr: Kandi yaatwara efeeza n'ezaabu ezaashangirwe omu nju ya MUKAMA n'omu mabikiro g'enju y'omugabe, yaabitoijera omugabe wa Asiria.
en: And Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the house of the LORD , and in the treasures of the king's house, and sent it for a present to the king of Assyria.

rr: Omugabe wa Asiria yaamwikiriza, yaahurura, yaateera Damasiko, yaagikwata, n'abantu baamwo yaabatwara Kiiri bari enkwatwa, kandi yaita na Reziini.
en: And the king of Assyria hearkened unto him: for the king of Assyria went up against Damascus, and took it, and carried the people of it captive to Kir, and slew Rezin.

rr: Omugabe Ahazi ku yaagiire Damasiko kubugana Tigulaasi-pileseeri omugabe wa Asiria, yaareebayo eitambiro. Yaatwekyera Uriya omunyamurwa eky'okureeberaho ky'eryo itambiro, ekyabaire nikishushanira kimwe naryo omu miringo yoona.
en: And king Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, and saw an altar that was at Damascus: and king Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest the fashion of the altar, and the pattern of it, according to all the workmanship thereof.

rr: Uriya omunyamurwa yaayombeka eryo itambiro, naarishushanisiza kimwe n'ebi omugabe Ahazi yaatwekire ari Damasiko byona; atyo ogwo munyamurwa yaarikora, omugabe Ahazi atakagarukire naaruga Damasiko.
en: And Urijah the priest built an altar according to all that king Ahaz had sent from Damascus: so Urijah the priest made it against king Ahaz came from Damascus.

rr: 2 Omugabe ku yaarugire Damasiko, yaareeba eitambiro; bwanyima yaariirira haihi, yaaritembaho.
en: And when the king was come from Damascus, the king saw the altar: and the king approached to the altar, and offered thereon.

rr: yaaryokyezaho ekitambo kye ky'okwotsya n'empongano ye y'esaano, yaarishukaho empongano ye y'eky'okunywa, kandi yaarishukyera eshagama y'empongano ze ez'okusiima ahabw'obusingye.
en: And he burnt his burnt offering and his meat offering, and poured his drink offering, and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings, upon the altar.

rr: Kandi eitambiro ry'emiringa eryabaire rituura omu maisho ga MUKAMA, yaariiha omu maisho g'enju omu mwanya gwaryo ahagati y'eitambiro rye n'enju ya MUKAMA, yaarita aha rubaju rw'obukiizi-bwa-bumosho obw'eitambiro rye.
en: And he brought also the brasen altar, which was before the LORD , from the forefront of the house, from between the altar and the house of the LORD , and put it on the north side of the altar.

rr: Omugabe Ahazi yaaragiira Uriya omunyamurwa naagira ati: Aha itabiro erihango obe niho waaguma nooyokyeza ekitambo ekyokibwa omu kasheeshe, n'empongano y'esaano ey'omumwabazyo, n'ekitambo ky'omugabe eky'okwotsya n'empongano ye ey'esaano, hamwe n'ekitambo ky'okwotsya eky'abantu boona ab'eryo ihanga n'empongano yaabyo ey'esaano n'ey'ebyokunywa; kandi orishukyere eshangama yoona ey'ekitambo ky'okwotsya n'ey'ebindi bitambo; kwonka eitambiro ry'emiringa rigume ribe eryangye ery'okwehanuurizaho.
en: And king Ahaz commanded Urijah the priest, saying, Upon the great altar burn the morning burnt offering, and the evening meat offering, and the king's burnt sacrifice, and his meat offering, with the burnt offering of all the people of the land, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings; and sprinkle upon it all the blood of the burnt offering, and all the blood of the sacrifice: and the brasen altar shall be for me to enquire by .

rr: Uriya omunyamurwa yaakora ebyo byona, nk'oku omugabe Ahazi yaamuragiire.
en: Thus did Urijah the priest, according to all that king Ahaz commanded.

rr: Bwanyima omugabe Ahazi yaashara aha binaabiro ebiremu by'ebitebe byabyo, yaiha ahari buri kimwe ekinaabiro kyakyo; kandi yaiha ekitanka aha nimi z'emiringa ezaabaire ziri ahansi yaakyo, yaakita aha mabaare agaariire.
en: And king Ahaz cut off the borders of the bases, and removed the laver from off them; and took down the sea from off the brasen oxen that were under it, and put it upon a pavement of stones.

rr: Kandi omuhanda ogushakaire ogw'okurabamu ahari Sabato, ogwabaire gwombekire okuruga omu kikaari okuhika aha irembo ry'omugabe ery'aheeru eririkutaaha omuri hekalu, yaagwiha aha nju ya MUKAMA ahabw'omugabe wa Asiria.
en: And the covert for the sabbath that they had built in the house, and the king's entry without, turned he from the house of the LORD for the king of Assyria.

rr: Mbwenu endiijo mirimo ya Ahazi n'ebi yaakozire byona tibihandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'eby'omu busingye bw'abagabe ba Yuda?
en: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

rr: Ahazi yaagwejegyera, yaashanga baishenkuru, baamuziika hamwe nabo omu rurembo rwa Daudi; Hezekia omutabani yaategyeka omu mwanya gwe.
en: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.

rr: Omu mwaka gwa ikumi n'ebiri ogw'omu busingye bwa Ahazi omugabe wa Yuda Hoshea mutabani wa Ela akatandika kutegyekyera Israeli omuri Samaria, yaamara emaka mwenda aha ngoma.
en: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah began Hoshea the son of Elah to reign in Samaria over Israel nine years.

rr: Yaakora ebirikwangwa MUKAMA, kwonka tiyaashushana na bagabe ba Israeli abaamubandiize.
en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD , but not as the kings of Israel that were before him.

rr: 2 Shalumaneseeri omugabe wa Asiria yainamuka, yaamuteera; Hoshea yaahinduka omwiru we, yaaguma naamutoijera.
en: Against him came up Shalmaneser king of Assyria; and Hoshea became his servant, and gave him presents.

rr: Bwanyima omugabe wa Asiria yaashanga Hoshea amugiriire enaama; ahakuba akaba atumire entumwa ahari So omugabe wa Misri, kandi ayangire kutwekyera omugabe wa Asiria emitoijo, nk'oku yaabaire amutoijera buri mwaka. Nikyo omugabe wa Asiria yaamuteereire omu kihome akamuboha.
en: And the king of Assyria found conspiracy in Hoshea: for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt, and brought no present to the king of Assyria, as he had done year by year: therefore the king of Assyria shut him up, and bound him in prison.

rr: Bwanyima omugabe wa Asira yainamuka, yaaraba omuri egyo nsi yoona, yaahika Samaria, yaagigota okumara emyaka eshatu.
en: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land, and went up to Samaria, and besieged it three years.

rr: Omu mwaka gwa mwenda ogw'omu busingye bwa Hoshea, omugabe wa Asiria yaakwata Samaria, yaatwara Abaisraeli Asiria bari enkwatwa, yaabata omuri Haala n'aha mugyera Habora ogw'omuri Gozani, n'omu ndembo z'Abameedi.
en: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Israel away into Assyria, and placed them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.

rr: Ekyo kikabaho ahabw'okuba Abaisraeli bakacumura ahari MUKAMA Ruhanga waabo, owabaihire omu nsi ya Misri omu mikono ya Faraho omugabe waayo, baatiina baaruhanga abandi
en: For so it was, that the children of Israel had sinned against the LORD their God, which had brought them up out of the land of Egypt, from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and had feared other gods,

rr: baagyendera omu micwe y'ago mahanga agu MUKAMA yaabingire omu maisho gaabo, kandi n'omu micwe ei abagabe ba Israeli baabaire bareetsire.
en: and walked in the statutes of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel, and of the kings of Israel, which they had made.

rr: Kandi Abaisraeli baaguma nibakorera omu mubonano ebitahikire nibacumura ahari MUKAMA Ruhanga waabo. Baayeyombekyera emyanya mikuru ey'okuramizamu omuri tauni zaabo zoona, okuruga aha minaara y'abarinzi, okuhika aha ndembo ezeehinguririziibwe engo z'amabaare
en: And the children of Israel did secretly those things that were not right against the LORD their God, and they built them high places in all their cities, from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city.

rr: kandi baayebyarira enyomyo z'amabaare na Ashera ahari buri kibungo kyona ekiraingwa, n'ahansi ya buri kiti ekyetwa omurinzi
en: And they set them up images and groves in every high hill, and under every green tree:

rr: okwo niyo baayoterereire obubaane omu myanya yoona emikuru y'okuramizamu, nk'oku ago mahanga gaakozire agu MUKAMA yaatwaire akaiha omu maisho gaabo. Baakora ebindi bibi, baagwisa kubi MUKAMA
en: and there they burnt incense in all the high places, as did the heathen whom the LORD carried away before them; and wrought wicked things to provoke the LORD to anger:

rr: baaheereza ebishushani ebirikuramibwa ebi MUKAMA yaabaire abagizire ati; Eki mutarikikora.
en: for they served idols, whereof the LORD had said unto them, Ye shall not do this thing.

rr: N'obu biraabe byabaire biba bityo, hoona MUKAMA akaba ateisa Israeli na Yuda, naagambira omuri buri nabi na buri muhanuuzi, naagira ati: Muhindukye murekye emicwe yaanyu emibi, mworobere ebiragiro byangye n'ebi naataireho, nk'ebiragiro byona ebi naaragiire baashwenkuriimwe, kandi n'ebi naabatumireho nimbirabya omu bairu bangye bombi, oku byabaire biri.
en: Yet the LORD testified against Israel, and against Judah, by all the prophets, and by all the seers, saying, Turn ye from your evil ways, and keep my commandments and my statutes, according to all the law which I commanded your fathers, and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets.

rr: Kwonka banga kuhurira, bagangaara, nka baishenkurubo abaabaire bataikiriza MUKAMA Ruhanga waabo.
en: Notwithstanding they would not hear, but hardened their necks, like to the neck of their fathers, that did not believe in the LORD their God.

rr: Bagaya ebi yaataireho, n'endagaano ei yaaragaine na baishenkurubo n'okuteisa oku yaabaire abateisa. Bakuratira ebitaine mugasho, nabo bahinduka ebataine mugasho, batooreza emicwe y'amahanga agabeehinguririze, agu MUKAMA yaabeehanangiriize kutakora nkago.
en: And they rejected his statutes, and his covenant that he made with their fathers, and his testimonies which he testified against them; and they followed vanity, and became vain, and went after the heathen that were round about them, concerning whom the LORD had charged them, that they should not do like them.

rr: Batyo baareka ebiragiro bya MUKAMA Ruhanga waabo, baayekorera ebishushani bibiri by'enyana ebiheesire, kandi baaguma nibakora ana Ashera, baramya eihe ryona ery'omu iguru, nibaheereza Baali.
en: And they left all the commandments of the LORD their God, and made them molten images, even two calves, and made a grove, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served Baal.

rr: Barabya batabani baabo na bahara baabo omu muriro nk'ebitambo, baragura, baroga, beehayo kukora ebirikwangwa MUKAMA, nibamugwisa kubi.
en: And they caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire, and used divination and enchantments, and sold themselves to do evil in the sight of the LORD , to provoke him to anger.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo MUKAMA yaagwerwa kubi munonga Abaisraeli yaababinga omu maisho ge, tiyaagira u yaatsigaho kureka oruganda rwa Yuda rwonka.
en: Therefore the LORD was very angry with Israel, and removed them out of his sight: there was none left but the tribe of Judah only.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo MUKAMA yaacwa baijukuru b'Abaisraeli boona, yaababurabuza, yaabahayo omu mikono y'abanyagi, okuhitsya obu yaababingiire kimwe omu maisho ge.
en: And the LORD rejected all the seed of Israel, and afflicted them, and delivered them into the hand of spoilers, until he had cast them out of his sight.

rr: Ahakuba akacwa Israeli aha nju ya Daudi, baahindura Yeroboamu mwene Nebati omugabe. Kandi Yeroboamu yaazibira Abaisraeli kukuratira MUKAMA, yaabakoresa ekibi kihango.
en: For he rent Israel from the house of David; and they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king: and Jeroboam drave Israel from following the LORD , and made them sin a great sin.

rr: Batyo Abaisraeli baagyendera omu bibi byona ebi Yeroboamu yaakozire, tibaabireka
en: For the children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did; they departed not from them;

rr: okuhitsya obu MUKAMA yaabingira Israeli omu maisho ge, nk'oku yaashangirwe agambire naaraba omu bairu be boona baanabi. Okwo nikwo Abaisraeli baabingirwe omu nsi yaabo, bakatwarwa Asiria, bakagumayo n'okuhitsya hati. Omugabe wa Asiria okufururira abantu be omu ndembo za Israeli
en: until the LORD removed Israel out of his sight, as he had said by all his servants the prophets. So was Israel carried away out of their own land to Assyria unto this day.

rr: Bwanyima omugabe wa Asiria yaiha abantu Babulooni, Kuusa, Ava, Hamasi, na Sefavaimu, yaabata omu ndembo za Samaria omu mwanya gw'Abaisraeli; baagikubuura, baatuura omu ndembo zaayo.
en: And the king of Assyria brought men from Babylon, and from Cuthah, and from Ava, and from Hamath, and from Sepharvaim, and placed them in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Israel: and they possessed Samaria, and dwelt in the cities thereof.

rr: Ku baabaire bakitandikire kutuurayo, tibaatiina MUKAMA; n'ahabw'ekyo yaabooherereza entare, zaabaitamu abantu.
en: And so it was at the beginning of their dwelling there, that they feared not the LORD : therefore the LORD sent lions among them, which slew some of them.

rr: Batyo baagambira omugabe wa Asiria bati: Amahanga agu otwaire kuta omu ndembo za Samaria tigarikumanya biragiro bya ruhanga w'egyo nsi; n'ahabw'ekyo abooherereize entare; mbwenu reeba, nizibaita, ahabw'okuba tibarikumanya biragiro bya ruhanga w'ensi egyo.
en: Wherefore they spake to the king of Assyria, saying, The nations which thou hast removed, and placed in the cities of Samaria, know not the manner of the God of the land: therefore he hath sent lions among them, and, behold, they slay them, because they know not the manner of the God of the land.

rr: Omugabe wa Asiria nikwo kuragiira ati: Mugarureyo omunyamurwa omwe aha bu mwaihireyo, agyende atuureyo, abeegyese ebiragiro bya ruhanga w'egyo nsi.
en: Then the king of Assyria commanded, saying, Carry thither one of the priests whom ye brought from thence; and let them go and dwell there, and let him teach them the manner of the God of the land.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo omwe aha banyamurwa abu baihire Samaria yaija, yaatuura Beseeli, yaaguma naabeegyesa oku bashemereire kutiina MUKAMA.
en: Then one of the priests whom they had carried away from Samaria came and dwelt in Beth-el, and taught them how they should fear the LORD .

rr: Kwonka buri ihanga ryaguma niryekorera baaruhanga baaryo, niribata omuri zaanyaruju z'omu myanya mikuru ey'okuramizamu, ezi Abasamaria baabaire bombekire, buri ihanga omu ndembo ezi ryabaire ritwiremu.
en: Howbeit every nation made gods of their own, and put them in the houses of the high places which the Samaritans had made, every nation in their cities wherein they dwelt.

rr: Aba Babulooni baakora Sukoosi-benosi; aba Kuusi baakora Neregaali; aba Hamasi baakora Ashima
en: And the men of Babylon made Succoth-benoth, and the men of Cuth made Nergal, and the men of Hamath made Ashima,

rr: aba Ava baakora Nibuhazi na Tarutaaki; n'aba Sefavaimu baaguma nibootsya abaana omu muriro, nibabatambira Adrameleki na Anameleki, baaruhanga ba Sefavaimu.
en: and the Avites made Nibhaz and Tartak, and the Sepharvites burnt their children in fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.

rr: Kandi bakaba batiina MUKAMA, batoorana omuribo abantu b'emiringo yoona kuba abanyamurwa b'emyanya mikuru; abo nibo baabaire babatambirira ebitambo omuri zaanyaruju z'omuri egyo myanya.
en: So they feared the LORD , and made unto themselves of the lowest of them priests of the high places, which sacrificed for them in the houses of the high places.

rr: Batyo batiina MUKAMA, kwonka baaguma nibaheereza baaruhanga baabo, nibakuratira emitwarize y'amahanga agu baarugiremu.
en: They feared the LORD , and served their own gods, after the manner of the nations whom they carried away from thence.

rr: Na hati nibakitwaza nk'oku baabaire batwaza ira. Tibarikutiina MUKAMA, tibarikukuratira byatairweho nari emigyenzo, nari ebiragiro ebi MUKAMA yaaragiire beene Yakobo ou yaayetsire Israeli.
en: Unto this day they do after the former manners: they fear not the LORD , neither do they after their statutes, or after their ordinances, or after the law and commandment which the LORD commanded the children of Jacob, whom he named Israel;

rr: Abo nibo MUKAMA yaaragaine nabo endagaano akabeehanangiriza naagira ati: Mutaritiina baaruhanga abandi, mutaribainamira, mutaribaheereza n'obu kwakuba okubatambira ebitambo
en: with whom the LORD had made a covenant, and charged them, saying, Ye shall not fear other gods, nor bow yourselves to them, nor serve them, nor sacrifice to them:

rr: Kandi ebyatairweho n'emigyenzo n'ebiragiro, ebi yaaragiire akabibahandiikira, mugume mubiteho omutima, mubyorobere; mutarigira baaruhanga abandi abu mwatiina.
en: And the statutes, and the ordinances, and the law, and the commandment, which he wrote for you, ye shall observe to do for evermore; and ye shall not fear other gods.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo endagaano ei naaragaine naimwe mutarigyebwa; mutaritiina baaruhanga abandi
en: And the covenant that I have made with you ye shall not forget; neither shall ye fear other gods.

rr: kureka mugume mutiine MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu; niwe aribajuna omu mikono y'abazigu baanyu boona.
en: But the LORD your God ye shall fear; and he shall deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies.

rr: Kwonka bo baayanga kuhurira, baagumizamu n'emicwe yaabo eya ira.
en: Howbeit they did not hearken, but they did after their former manner.

rr: Batyo abantu b'ago mahanga baaguma nibatiina MUKAMA, kandi nibaheereza ebishushani byabo ebibaizire; abaana baabo na baijukuru baano nabo baagumizamu baakora nk'oku baishekurubo baabaire bakora, n'okuhitsya hati.
en: So these nations feared the LORD , and served their graven images, both their children, and their children's children: as did their fathers, so do they unto this day.

rr: Currently Selected: 2 Abagabe 17 : RR64 Highlight Share
Omu mwaka gwa kashatu ogw'omu busingye bwa Hoshea mwene Ela, omugabe wa Israeli, Hezekia mutabani wa Ahazi omugabe wa Yuda akatandika kutegyeka.
en: Now it came to pass in the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, that Hezekiah the son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign.

rr: Yaatandika aine emyaka makumi abiri n'etaano, yaategyekyera emyaka makumi abiri na mwenda omuri Yerusaalemu.
en: Twenty and five years old was he when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem.

rr: Nyina akaba naayetwa Abi muhara wa Zekaria.
en: His mother's name also was Abi, the daughter of Zachariah.

rr: Yaakora ebirikusiimwa MUKAMA nk'ebi Daudi ishenkuru yaakozire byona oku byabaire biri.
en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD , according to all that David his father did.

rr: Yaihaho emyanya mikuru ey'okuramizamu, yaasheenya enyomyo z'amabaare, yaatema Ashara; kandi yaacwagacwagura enjoka y'omuringa ei Musa yaabaire akozire, ahabw'okuba okuhitsya omu bunaku obwo Abaisraeli bakaba nibakigyoterera obubaane; neeyetwa Nehushitaane.
en: He removed the high places, and brake the images, and cut down the groves, and brake in pieces the brasen serpent that Moses had made: for unto those days the children of Israel did burn incense to it: and he called it Nehushtan.

rr: Akaba naayesiga MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli; n'ahabw'ekyo tihariho mugabe weena owaabaire naamushusha omu bagabe ba Yuda boona abaamukuratiire, n'obu baakuba abaamubandiize.
en: He trusted in the LORD God of Israel; so that after him was none like him among all the kings of Judah, nor any that were before him.

rr: Ahabw'okuba akagumira ahari MUKAMA, tiyaareka kumukuratira, yaaguma naayorobera ebiragiro ebi MUKAMA yaaragiire Musa.
en: For he clave to the LORD , and departed not from following him, but kept his commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses.

rr: MUKAMA yaaguma nawe; ei yaabaire ahurura yoona, aba gye. Kandi yaagomera omugabe wa Asiria, yaayanga kumuheereza.
en: And the LORD was with him; and he prospered whithersoever he went forth: and he rebelled against the king of Assyria, and served him not.

rr: Kandi yaateera Abafilistia okuruga aha munaara gw'abarinzi okuhika aha ndembo ezizitiire n'engo z'amabaare, yaabahitsya Gaaza n'omu byanga byayo.
en: He smote the Philistines, even unto Gaza, and the borders thereof, from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city.

rr: 2 Omu mwaka gwa kana ogw'omu busingye bw'omugabe Hezekia, ogwabaire guri omwaka gwa mushanju ogwa Hoshea mwene Ela omugabe wa Israeli, Shalumaneseeri omugabe wa Asiria akainamuka, yaateera Samaria, yaagigota
en: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Hezekiah, which was the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, that Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against Samaria, and besieged it.

rr: aha muheru gw'omwaka gwa kashatu yaagikwata. Omu mwaka gwa mukaaga ogwa Hezekia, ogwabaire guri omwaka gwa mwenda ogwa Hoshea omugabe wa Israeli, nimwo Samaria yaakwatiirwe.
en: And at the end of three years they took it: even in the sixth year of Hezekiah, that is the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel, Samaria was taken.

rr: Bwanyima omugabe wa Asiria yaatwara Abaisraeli omu nsi ye bari enkwatwa, yaabata omuri Haala, n'aha mugyera Habora ogw'omuri Gozani, n'omu ndembo z'Abameedi
en: And the king of Assyria did carry away Israel unto Assyria, and put them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes:

rr: ahakuba tibarahuriire iraka rya MUKAMA Ruhanga waabo, kureka bakaita endagaano ye, nangwa n'ebi Musa omugaragwa wa MUKAMA yaaragiire byona, baayanga kubihurira, n'obu kwakuba okubyorobera.
en: because they obeyed not the voice of the LORD their God, but transgressed his covenant, and all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded, and would not hear them , nor do them .

rr: Omugabe wa Asiria okuteera Yuda
en: Assyria's Threat

rr: 2 -20 ; Omu mwaka gwa ikumi n'ena ogw'omu busingye bw'omugabe Hezekia, Senakeribu omugabe wa Asiria akainamuka, yaateera endembo zoona eza Yuda ezaabaire zizitiirwe n'engo z'amabaare, yaazikwata.
en: Now in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah did Sennacherib king of Assyria come up against all the fenced cities of Judah, and took them.

rr: Hezekia omugabe wa Yuda yaatuma aha mugabe wa Asiria ari Lakishi, ati: Nshobize; ndeka; kyona eki orancwe ninkyemera.
en: And Hezekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Assyria to Lachish, saying, I have offended; return from me: that which thou puttest on me will I bear.

rr: Omugabe wa Asiria yaacwa Hezekia omugabe wa Yuda etalanta magana ashatu z'efeeza, kandi n'ez'ezaabu makumi ashatu.
en: And the king of Assyria appointed unto Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.

rr: Hezekia yaamuha efeeza yoona eyaashangirwe omu nju ya MUKAMA, n'omu mabiikiro g'enju y'omugabe.
en: And Hezekiah gave him all the silver that was found in the house of the LORD , and in the treasures of the king's house.

rr: Omu biro ebyo Hezekia omugabe wa Yuda akaiha ezaabu aha nyigi za hekalu ya MUKAMA, n'aha biti by'emiryango, ei yaabaire abishwekire, yaagiha omugabe wa Asiria.
en: At that time did Hezekiah cut off the gold from the doors of the temple of the LORD , and from the pillars which Hezekiah king of Judah had overlaid, and gave it to the king of Assyria.

rr: Omugabe wa Asiria, ku yaabaire akiri Lakishi, yaatuma abatware be Tarutaani, Rabusaari, na Rabushaake, n'eihe rihango aha mugabe Hezekia omuri Yerusaalemu.
en: And the king of Assyria sent Tartan and Rabsaris and Rab-shakeh from Lachish to king Hezekiah with a great host against Jerusalem.

rr: Bainamuka, baaza Yerusaalemu.
en: And they went up and came to Jerusalem.

rr: Ku baahikireyo, baayemerera aha mukura gw'ekiyanja ky'eruguru, ekiri aha muhanda rugyendwa ogurikuza aha kibanja ky'omwozi.
en: And when they were come up, they came and stood by the conduit of the upper pool, which is in the highway of the fuller's field.

rr: Ku baayetsire omugabe, haija Eliakimu mwene Hilukia, owaabaire ari omukuru w'ekikaari, na Shebuna omuhandiiki, na Yoa mwene Asafu omuhandiiki w'ebirikubaho, baabashanga aho.
en: And when they had called to the king, there came out to them Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder.

rr: Omutware Rabushaake yaabagira ati: Mwirooko mugire Hezekia muti: Oku nikwo omugabe rugambwa, omugabe wa Asiria arikugamba naagira ati: Mbwenu ou orikwesiga n'oha?
en: And Rab-shakeh said unto them, Speak ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein thou trustest?

rr: Noogira ngu ebigambo bugambo nibyo naama n'amaani eby'okurwanisa?
en: Thou sayest, (but they are but vain words,) I have counsel and strength for the war.

rr: Hari ou oyegamiire hati n'oha, waaza kungomera?
en: Now on whom dost thou trust, that thou rebellest against me?

rr: Reeba, hati oyegamiire Misri, orubango oruri nk'ekibungo kihndekire, ekirikwija kucumita ekiganja ky'omuntu weena orikukihimbagiriraho. Okwo nikwo na Faraho omugabe wa Misri ari ahari boona abarikumwesiga.
en: Now, behold, thou trustest upon the staff of this bruised reed, even upon Egypt, on which if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so is Pharaoh king of Egypt unto all that trust on him.

rr: Mbwenu ija okwatirizane na mukama wangye omugabe wa Asiria. Nkuhe embaraasi enkumi ibiri; ku oraabone ab'okuzitemba, ongire kwo!
en: Now therefore, I pray thee, give pledges to my lord the king of Assyria, and I will deliver thee two thousand horses, if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them.

rr: Noija kubaasa ota kubinga omwe aha bakuru bangye b'engabo ab'amaani makye okukira abandi, ku oraabe oyesigire Misri kuba nibo baakuha ebigaari n'ab'aha mbaraasi?
en: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master's servants, and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?

rr: Kandi noogira ngu nyizire kuteera omwanya ogu n'okugucwekyereza ntaragiirwe MUKAMA?
en: Am I now come up without the LORD against this place to destroy it?

rr: Omanye ngu MUKAMA niwe angambiire ati: Inamuka, oteere egyo nsi, ogicwekyereze.
en: The LORD said to me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.

rr: Bwanyima Eliakimu mwene Hilukia na Shebuna na Yoa baagira omutware Rabushaake bati: Twakweshengyereza, gamba n'abairu baawe omu rurimi rw'Abasiria; ahakuba itwe niturumanya; reka kugamba omu rurimi rw'Abayuda, abantu abari ha rugo rw'amabaare babihuriire.
en: Then said Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, and Shebna, and Joah, unto Rab-shakeh, Speak, I pray thee, to thy servants in the Syrian language; for we understand it: and talk not with us in the Jews' language in the ears of the people that are on the wall.

rr: Kwonka omutware Rabushaake yaabagarukamu ati: Nimugira ngu mukama wangye antumire ahari mukama waanyu naimwe kuba niimwe naagambira ebigambo ebi mwenka? Tantumire kubigambira n'abashaija bariya abashutami aha rugo, abarikwija kurya naimwe amazi gaabo, n'okunywa naimwe enkari yaago?
en: But Rab-shakeh said unto them, Hath my master sent me to thy master, and to thee, to speak these words? hath he not sent me to the men which sit on the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own piss with you?

rr: Ahonaaho omutware Rabushaake yaayemerera, yaagamba n'eiraka rihango omu rurimi rw'Abayuda, naagira ati: Muhurire obutumwa bw'omugabe rugambwa, omugabe wa Asiria.
en: Then Rab-shakeh stood and cried with a loud voice in the Jews' language, and spake, saying, Hear the word of the great king, the king of Assyria:

rr: Oku nikwo omugabe arikugamba naagira ati: Mutaikiriza Hezekia kubabeiha; ahabw'okuba tarikwija kubaasa kubajuna abaihe omu mikono yangye.
en: Thus saith the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you out of his hand:

rr: Mutaikiriza Hezekia kubeesigisa MUKAMA naabagira ati: Buzimazima MUKAMA naija kutujuna, kandi orurembo oru tirurikwija kuheebwayo mu mikono y'omugabe wa Asiria.
en: neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD , saying, The LORD will surely deliver us, and this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.

rr: Mutahurira Hezekia; ahakuba oku nikwo omugabe wa Asiria arikugamba naagira ati: Mugarukane naanye; mwije munshangye aha; obwo buri omwe omuriimwe nibwo araarye ahamuzaabibu gwe, akarya ahamutiini gwe, kandi akanya amaizi g'omu iziba rye
en: Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus saith the king of Assyria, Make an agreement with me by a present, and come out to me, and then eat ye every man of his own vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink ye every one the waters of his cistern:

rr: okuhitsya obu ndiija, nkabatwra omu nsi erikushushana n'eyaanyu, ensi y'engano na viinyo, ey'emigaati n'emizaabibu, kandi ey'emizeituuni n'obwoki, mukabona kugumaho, mutafe. N'ahabw'ekyo mutahurira Hezekia orikubabeihabeiha naabagira ati: MUKAMA naija kutujuna.
en: until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of oil olive and of honey, that ye may live, and not die: and hearken not unto Hezekiah, when he persuadeth you, saying, The LORD will deliver us.

rr: Nimugira ngu hariho ruhanga omuri baaruhanga b'abanyamahanga orajunire ensi ye omu mikono y'omugabe wa Asiria?
en: Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered at all his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

rr: Mbwenu baaruhanga ba Hamasi na Arupaadi barahi? na baaruhanga ba Sefavaimu, ba Hena n'aba Iiva barahi? Barajunire Samaria omu mikono yangye?
en: Where are the gods of Hamath, and of Arpad? where are the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah? have they delivered Samaria out of mine hand?

rr: Ni baahi omuri baaruhanga boona ab'ezo nsi abarajunire ensi yaabo omu mikono yangye, mukabona kwesiga ku MUKAMA arikwija kwiha Yerusaalemu omu mijono yangye?
en: Who are they among all the gods of the countries, that have delivered their country out of mine hand, that the LORD should deliver Jerusalem out of mine hand?

rr: Abantu baahunama, tibaagira ki baamugarukamu, ahabw'okuba ekiragiro ky'omugabe kikaba nikigira kiti: Mutamugarukamu.
en: But the people held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king's commandment was, saying, Answer him not.

rr: Bwanyima Eliakimu mwene Hilukia omukuru w'ekikaari, na Shebuna omuhandiiki, na Yoa mwene Asafu omuhandiiki w'ebirikubaho baija ahari Hezekia bataagwire ebijwaro byabo, baamuteekyerereza ebigambo bya Rabushaake.
en: Then came Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder, to Hezekiah with their clothes rent, and told him the words of Rab-shakeh.

rr: 2 -22 ; Omugabe Hezekia ku yaabihuriire, yaataagura ebijwaro bye, yaajwara ekiguniya, yaaza omu nju ya MUKAMA.
en: And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard it , that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the LORD .

rr: Yaatuma Eliakimu omukuru w'ekikaari na Shebuna omuhandiiki n'abanyamurwa abakuru ahari nabi Isaaya mwene Amozi bajwaire ebiguniya.
en: And he sent Eliakim, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.

rr: Baamugira bati: Oku nikwo Hezekia arikugamba naagira ati: Eri izooba n'eizooba ry'obusaasi n'okuhanwa n'okuteererwa enaku, ahakuba abaana bahikire kuzaarwa, kwona amaani g'okubazaara tigariho.
en: And they said unto him, Thus saith Hezekiah, This day is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and blasphemy: for the children are come to the birth, and there is not strength to bring forth.

rr: Shana MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe ahuriire ebigambo byona ebigambirwe Rabushaake, ou mukama we omugabe wa Asiria atumire kugaya Ruhanga otahwaho, obundi MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe akaamuhana ahabw'ebigambo ebyo ebi ahuriire; na'ahabw'ekyo imutsya eiraka ryawe oshabire abantu abakiriho abaahonokireho.
en: It may be the LORD thy God will hear all the words of Rab-shakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God; and will reprove the words which the LORD thy God hath heard: wherefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that are left. Isaiah's Counsel

rr: Abaheereza b'omugabe Hezekia ku baahikire owa Isaaya
en: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.

rr: 2 -25 , 30-35 . Isaaya yaabagira ati: Mugambire mukama waanyu muti: Oku nikwo MUKAMA arikugamba naagira ati: Otatiina ebyo bigambo bi ohuriire, ebi abaheereza b'omugabe wa Asiria banjumire.
en: And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall ye say to your master, Thus saith the LORD , Be not afraid of the words which thou hast heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.

rr: Reeba, niinyija kumutamu ogundi mutima, ahurire orukuru, agarukye omu nsi ye; kandi ku araahikyeyo, mmwitse rurara.
en: Behold, I will send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a rumour, and shall return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.

rr: Bwanyima Rabushaake yaagarukayo, yaashanga omugabe wa Asiria naarwanisa Libuna; ahabw'okuba akaba ahuriire ku arugire Lakishi.
en: So Rab-shakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.

rr: Omugabe ku yaahuriire ebya Tiruhaaka omugabe wa Esiopia nibagira ngu, Reeba aizire kukuteera, yaagaruka yaatuma ahari Hezekia naagira ati
en: And when he heard say of Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, Behold, he is come out to fight against thee: he sent messengers again unto Hezekiah, saying,

rr: Mwirooko mugire Hezekia omugabe wa Yuda muti: Otaikiriza Ruhanga waawe ogwo ou orikwesiga kukubeiha naakuraganisa ati: Yerusaalemu teriheebwayo mu mikono y'omugabe wa Asiria.
en: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, Let not thy God in whom thou trustest deceive thee, saying, Jerusalem shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.

rr: Reeba, ohuriire oku abagabe ba Asiria baagizire ensi zoona, bakazicwekyerereza kimwe. Noogira ngu niiwe orikwija kukira?
en: Behold, thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly: and shalt thou be delivered?

rr: Amahanga aga, Gozani, Harani, Rzefu, n'ab'omuri Edeni abaabaire batwire Telasaari, agu baatatenkuru baacwekyereize, noogira ngu baaruhanga baago bakagajuna?
en: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed; as Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden which were in Thelasar?

rr: Nyoreka omugabe wa Hamasi, n'owa Arupaadi, n'ow'orurembo Sefavaimu, n'owa Hena, n'owa Iiva!
en: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivah?

rr: Hezekia yaayakiira ebaruha eyaareetwa ezo ntumwa, yaagishoma; bwanyima yainamuka, yaija omu nju ya MUKAMA, yaagishashaanura omu maisho ge.
en: And Hezekiah received the letter of the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up into the house of the LORD , and spread it before the LORD .

rr: Hezekia yaashabira omu maisho ga MUKAMA naagira ati: Ai MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli, otuura aha kitebe ky'obukama ahagati ya baakerubi, Iwe wenka niiwe Ruhanga ow'obugabe bwona obw'omu nsi; niiwe waahangire eiguru n'ensi.
en: And Hezekiah prayed before the LORD , and said, O LORD God of Israel, which dwellest between the cherubims, thou art the God, even thou alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth; thou hast made heaven and earth.

rr: N'ekya buzima, MUKAMA, abagabe ba Asiria bakacwekyereza abantu b'ago mahanga n'ensi zaabo
en: Of a truth, LORD , the kings of Assyria have destroyed the nations and their lands,

rr: baanaga baaruhanga baabo omu muriro, ahabw'okuba bakaba batari baaruhanga nyamuhanga, kureka bakaba bakozirwe engaro z'abantu omu biti n'omu mabaare; nikyo baabacwekyerereize.
en: and have cast their gods into the fire: for they were no gods, but the work of men's hands, wood and stone: therefore they have destroyed them.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo hati, ai MUKAMA Ruhanga waitu, ninkweshengyereza otujune, otwihe omu mikono ye, obugabe bwona obw'omu nsi, ai MUKAMA, bumanye ku niiwe wenka oba Ruhanga. Isaaya okuragura ebiriba aha mugabe wa Asiria
en: Now therefore, O LORD our God, I beseech thee, save thou us out of his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou art the LORD God, even thou only.

rr: Bwanyima Isaaya mwene Amozi yaatuma ahari Hezekia naagira ati: Oku nikwo MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli arikugamba naagira ati: Nk'oku onshabire kukuhwera aha bya Senakeribu omugabe wa Asiria, naakwikiriza.
en: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, That which thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria I have heard.

rr: Eki nikyo kigambo eki MUKAMA amugambirieho naagira ati: Omwishiki wa Saayuuni otakamanyaga mushaija Naakugaya, naakushekyerera; Kandi Yerusaalemu neekuzongoreza omutwe.
en: This is the word that the LORD hath spoken concerning him; The virgin the daughter of Zion hath despised thee, and laughed thee to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee.

rr: 2 -6 ; . N'oha ou ojumire, okarogotaho? Kandi ou okabukiire, okateera ekitsyori n'oha? N'Orikwera wa Israeli!
en: Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed? and against whom hast thou exalted thy voice, and lifted up thine eyes on high? even against the Holy One of Israel.

rr: Ojumiise MUKAMA entumwa zaawe, Noogira oti: Nyinamukire n'ebigaari byangye bingi Aha mitwe y'enshozi, Hare munonga ahagati ya Lebanooni. Niinyija kutema emyereezi yaayo emiraingwa, N'emiberooshi yaayo emirungi munonga; Niinyija kuhika omu bweshereko bwayo hare munonga, Omu kibira kyayo ekikwataine.
en: By thy messengers thou hast reproached the Lord, and hast said, With the multitude of my chariots I am come up to the height of the mountains, to the sides of Lebanon, and will cut down the tall cedar trees thereof, and the choice fir trees thereof: and I will enter into the lodgings of his borders, and into the forest of his Carmel.

rr: Nkatimba amaziba g'abanyamahanga, Naanywa amaizi gaago; Naaribatiirira emigyera ya Misiri yoona, Naagyomya.
en: I have digged and drunk strange waters, and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of besieged places.

rr: Torahuriire ku naamaririire ira kukikora? Omu biro bya ira nkacuma enaama y'okukora Ebi ndikuhikiiriza omu biro ebi, Ngu ocwekyereze endembo ezeehinguririziibwe engo z'amabaare, Ozihindure amatongo.
en: Hast thou not heard long ago how I have done it, and of ancient times that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that thou shouldest be to lay waste fenced cities into ruinous heaps.

rr: Nikyo kyareeteire abazitwiremu kucweka entegye, Bakahahaaza omutima, bakarimbagirirwa, Bakaba nk'obunyaatsi bw'omu ishwa, Nk'obunyaatsi buto, Bakahotoka nk'obunyaatsi obumezire aha mutwe gw'enju, Nk'engano ezooma zitakakuzire.
en: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded; they were as the grass of the field, and as the green herb, as the grass on the housetops, and as corn blasted before it be grown up.

rr: Kwonka nimmanya emishutamire yaawe, Emihururire yaawe, n'emitabaarukire yaawe, Kandi n'ekiniga eki wangiriire.
en: But I know thy abode, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy rage against me.

rr: 2 -36 ; . Ahabw'okungirira ekiniga, Kandi nkahurira eby'amaryo gaawe, Niinyija kukuta eirobo ryangye omu nyindo, N'ekyoma kyangye omu kanwa, Nkugarure omuhanda ogwakureetsire.
en: Because thy rage against me and thy tumult is come up into mine ears, therefore I will put my hook in thy nose, and my bridle in thy lips, and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest.

rr: Kandi aka karyakubeera akamanyiso; omu mwaka ogu nimwija kurya ebyemerize; omu gwa kabiri murye ebemerize eby'emiragarika y'ebyo, bwanyima omu mwaka gwa kashatu muryabiba mugyeshe, mubyare emizaabibu, murye ebijuma byayo.
en: And this shall be a sign unto thee, Ye shall eat this year such things as grow of themselves, and in the second year that which springeth of the same; and in the third year sow ye, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruits thereof.

rr: Abatsigaire aha b'enju ya Yuda abaahonokireho baryagaruka batsimbe emizi okuzimu, n'ahaiguru baane ebyana
en: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall yet again take root downward, and bear fruit upward.

rr: ahakuba omuri Yerusaalemu haryarugamu ekicweka ekiriba kitsigaireho, n'aha rushozi Saayuuni harugyeho omutwe gw'abahonokireho. Obweziriki bwa MUKAMA buryakihikiiriza.
en: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that escape out of mount Zion: the zeal of the LORD of hosts shall do this.

rr: Nikyo MUKAMA arikugambira aha mugabe wa Asiria naagira ati: Tarihika muri oru rurembo, nari okurwemurikira omumaisho aine engabo ye, n'obu kwakuba okurutuumaho omutuumo gw'eitaka.
en: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before it with shield, nor cast a bank against it.

rr: Omuhanda ogwamureetsire nigwo gurimugarurayo; kandi taritaaha muri oru rurembo; nikwo MUKAMA arikugira
en: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, saith the LORD .

rr: ahakuba ndyarinda oru rurembo, ndujune ahabwangye, n'ahabw'omwiru wangye Daudi. Okucwekyerera kw'engabo za Senakeribu
en: For I will defend this city, to save it, for mine own sake, and for my servant David's sake. Jerusalem Delivered

rr: Ekyo kiro maraika wa MUKAMA yaija, yaateera orusiisira rw'Abaasiria, yaitamu engabo z'Abaasiria akasiriira n'obukumi munaana n'enkumi itaano. Abantu ku baimukire omu kasheeshe, baashanga ezo ngabo zoona ziri emitumbi.
en: And it came to pass that night, that the angel of the LORD went out, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians an hundred fourscore and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they were all dead corpses.

rr: Bwanyima Senakeribu omugabe wa Asiria yaarugayo, yaagaruka Nineeve, yaatuurayo.
en: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.

rr: Ku yaabaire ari omuri nyaruju ya ruhanga we Nisirooki naamuramya, Adurameleki na Sharezeeri abatabani baija baamwitsa rurara, baacwa, baahungira omu nsi ya Araraati.
en: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword: and they escaped into the land of Armenia.

rr: Esari-hadooni omutabani yaategyeka omu mwanya gwe.
en: And Esarhaddon his son reigned in his stead.

rr: Currently Selected: 2 Abagabe 19 : RR64 Highlight Share <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3
Omu biro ebyo Hezekia akarwara, yaahika aha ncwamba za rufu.
en: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death.

rr: Nabi Isaaya mwene Amozi yaija ah'ari, yaamugira ati: Oku nikwo MUKAMA arikugamba naagira ati: Tebeekanisa eby'eka yaawe; ahabw'okuba noija kufa, tori w'okukira.
en: And the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz came to him, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD , Set thine house in order; for thou shalt die, and not live.

rr: Ahonaaho Hezekia yaahinduka, yaareba ekisiika, yaashaba MUKAMA naagira ati
en: Then he turned his face to the wall, and prayed unto the LORD , saying,

rr: Ai MUKAMA, ninkweshengyereza, mbwenu ijuka oku ngyendeire omu maisho gaawe omu bwesigwa n'omutima oguhikire, ninkora ebi orikusiima.
en: I beseech thee, O LORD , remember now how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in thy sight.

rr: Yaarira munonga.
en: And Hezekiah wept sore.

rr: Kwonka Isaaya ku yaabaire atakashohoire kuruga omu kibuga ky'ahagati omu kikaari, ekigambo kya MUKAMA kyamwijaho nikigira kiti
en: And it came to pass, afore Isaiah was gone out into the middle court, that the word of the LORD came to him, saying,

rr: Garukayo, ogambire Hezekia omukuru w'abantu bangye oti: Oku nikwo MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa Daudi shwenkuru, arikugamba naagira ati: Naahurira okushaba kwawe, kandi naareeba n'amarira gaawe. Reeba, niinyija kukukiza; aha kiro kya kashatu oinamukye omu nju ya MUKAMA.
en: Turn again, and tell Hezekiah the captain of my people, Thus saith the LORD , the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will heal thee: on the third day thou shalt go up unto the house of the LORD .

rr: Kandi ndyayongyera aha biro byawe emyaka ikumi n'etaano. Ndyakujuna, iwe n'oru rurembo, omu mikono y'omugabe wa Asiria, kandi ndurinde ahabwangye, n'ahabw'omwiru wangye Daudi.
en: And I will add unto thy days fifteen years; and I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria; and I will defend this city for mine own sake, and for my servant David's sake.

rr: Isaaya yaagira ati: Mureete ekitongye ky'emitiini. Baakireeta, baakibatika aha kizimba eki yaabaire arwaire, yaakira.
en: And Isaiah said, Take a lump of figs. And they took and laid it on the boil, and he recovered.

rr: Obwo Hezekia akaba yaabuurize Isaaya ati: Ni kamanyiso ki akarikworeka ku MUKAMA arikwija kuntambira, kandi ku ndikwija kwinamuka omu nju ya MUKAMA aha kiro kya kashatu?
en: And Hezekiah said unto Isaiah, What shall be the sign that the LORD will heal me, and that I shall go up into the house of the LORD the third day?

rr: Isaaya yaamugarukamu ati: Aka niko kamanyiso aku MUKAMA yaakuha, akarikuhamya ku arikwija kuhikiiriza eki yaagamba. Nooyenda ngu ekicuucu kigyende omumaisho entambwe ikumi, nari kigarukye enyima entambwe ikumi?
en: And Isaiah said, This sign shalt thou have of the LORD , that the LORD will do the thing that he hath spoken: shall the shadow go forward ten degrees, or go back ten degrees?

rr: Hezekia yaamugarukamu ati: Nikirahuka ekicuucu kugyenda omumaisho entambwe ikumi; haakiri kigarukye enyima ezo ntambwe ikumi.
en: And Hezekiah answered, It is a light thing for the shadow to go down ten degrees: nay, but let the shadow return backward ten degrees.

rr: Atyo nabi Isaaya yaashaba MUKAMA; nawe yaagarura ekicuucu enyima entambwe ikumi okuruga ahu kyabaire kyahika aha ky'okugyeresa kya Ahazi.
en: And Isaiah the prophet cried unto the LORD : and he brought the shadow ten degrees backward, by which it had gone down in the dial of Ahaz.

rr: Hezekia okworeka entumwa za Babulooni obutungi bwe
en: Letters from Babylon

rr: Omu biro ebyo Merodaakibaladaani mwene Baladaani omugabe wa Babulooni akatuma ahari Hezekia entumwa, zaamutwarira ebaruha n'ekiconco, ahabw'okuba akaba ahuriire ngu arwaire.
en: At that time Berodach-baladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present unto Hezekiah: for he had heard that Hezekiah had been sick.

rr: Hezekia yaazaakiira n'okushemererwa, yaazooreka enju ye yoona omu abiika ebintu bye eby'obuguzi bwingi, efeeza, ezaabu, emigaju, amajuta ag'obuguzi bwingi, n'ahu abiika eby'okurwanisa bye, n'ebyashangirwe omu mabiikiro ge byona; tihariho kintu kyona omu nju ye nari omu bugabe bwe bwona, eki atarazoorekirre.
en: And Hezekiah hearkened unto them, and shewed them all the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and all the house of his armour, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah shewed them not. Isaiah's Prophecy

rr: Bwanyima nabi Isaaya yaija aha mugabe Hezekia, yaamugira ati: Abashaija abo bagambire ki? kandi baizire owaawe nibaruga hi?
en: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him, What said these men? and from whence came they unto thee?

rr: Hezekia yaagira ati: Barugire omu nsi ya hare Babulooni.
en: And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country, even from Babylon.

rr: Onu ati: Bareebire ki omwawe?
en: And he said, What have they seen in thine house?

rr: Hezekia yaagira ati: Byona ebiri omwangye babireebire; tihariho kintu kyona omu mabiikiro gangye eki ntaboorekire.
en: And Hezekiah answered, All the things that are in mine house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them.

rr: Isaaya yaagira Hezekia ati: Mbwenu hurira ekigambo kya MUKAMA.
en: And Isaiah said unto Hezekiah, Hear the word of the LORD .

rr: 2 Reeba, obunaku buryahika, ebintu by'omu nju yaawe byona, n'ebi baashwenkuru baabiikire okuhitsya hati, bitwarwe Babulooni, harekye kugira ekyatsigaraho, nikwo MUKAMA arikugamba.
en: Behold, the days come, that all that is in thine house, and that which thy fathers have laid up in store unto this day, shall be carried into Babylon: nothing shall be left, saith the LORD .

rr: Kandi bamwe ahari batabani baawe, abu oriba oyezaariire, baryatwarwa, bahindukye abakonwa omu kikaari ky'omugabe wa Babulooni.
en: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee, which thou shalt beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.

rr: Bwanyima Hezekia yaagira Isaaya ati: Ekigambo kya MUKAMA eki waagamba ni kirungi.
en: Then said Hezekiah unto Isaiah, Good is the word of the LORD which thou hast spoken.

rr: Ahakuba akagira ati: Mbwenu shi ti kirungi, ku haraabe nihaija kubaho obusingye n'obuhooro omu biro byangye?
en: And he said, Is it not good , if peace and truth be in my days?

rr: Mbwenu endiijo mirimo ya Hezekia n'eby'amaani ge goona n'oku yaakozire ekiyanja, akateera omukura gw'okureeta amaizi omu rurembo, tibihandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'eby'omu busingye bw'Abagabe ba Yuda?
en: And the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and all his might, and how he made a pool, and a conduit, and brought water into the city, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

rr: Bwanyima Hezekia yaagwejegyera, yaashanga baishenkuru; Manaase omutabani yaategyeka omu mwanya gwe.
en: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers: and Manasseh his son reigned in his stead.

rr: 2 Manaase akaza aha ngoma aine emyaka ikumi n'ebiri, yaamara aha ngoma emyaka makumi ataano n'etaano naategyekyera Yerusaalemu.
en: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem.

rr: Nyina akaba naayetwa Hefuziba.
en: And his mother's name was Hephzi-bah.

rr: Kwonka yaakora ebirikwangwa MUKAMA, naatooreza emicwe erikunugwa ey'abanyamahanga, abu MUKAMA yaabingire omu maisho g'Abaisraeli
en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD , after the abominations of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.

rr: ahabwo'okuba akagaruka yaayombeka zaanyaruju z'omu myanya mikuru y'okuramizamu, ezi Hezekia ishe yaabaire asheenyire; yaayombekyera Baali amatambiro, yaakora Ashera nk'oku Ahabu omugabe wa Israeli yaabaire akora, kandi yaaguma naaramya eihe ryona ery'omu iguru, naariheereza.
en: For he built up again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed; and he reared up altars for Baal, and made a grove, as did Ahab king of Israel; and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.

rr: Kandi yaayombeka amatambiro omu nju ya MUKAMA, ei MUKAMA yaabaire agambireho ati: Omuri Yerusaalemu nimwo ndita eiziina ryangye.
en: And he built altars in the house of the LORD , of which the LORD said, In Jerusalem will I put my name.

rr: Kandi yaayombekyera eihe ryona ery'omu iguru amatambiro omu bikaari byombi eby'enju ya MUKAMA.
en: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the LORD .

rr: Yaarabya omutabani omu muriro, yaaguma naakora eby'okumanyisa ebiribaho n'okuragura, kandi yaaraguza aha barikugambisa emizimu n'abarogi. Yaakora ebibi bingi omu maisho ga MUKAMA, yaamugwisa kubi.
en: And he made his son pass through the fire, and observed times, and used enchantments, and dealt with familiar spirits and wizards: he wrought much wickedness in the sight of the LORD , to provoke him to anger.

rr: Yaata ekishushani kya Ashera ekibaizire omu nju ei MUKAMA yaagambiire Daudi n'omutabani Sulemaani ati: Omu nju egi n'omuri Yerusaalemu ebi naatooraine omu nganda zoona eza Israeli, nimwo ndita eiziina ryangye kugumamu ebiro byona
en: And he set a graven image of the grove that he had made in the house, of which the LORD said to David, and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all tribes of Israel, will I put my name for ever:

rr: kandi Abaisraeli ku barita omutima aha kworobera ebi naabaragiire byona, n'ebi omwiru wangye Musa yaabaragiire, tindigaruka kubazengyereza kubaiha omu nsi ei naahaire baishenkurubo.
en: neither will I make the feet of Israel move any more out of the land which I gave their fathers; only if they will observe to do according to all that I have commanded them, and according to all the law that my servant Moses commanded them.

rr: Kwonka tibaahurira, kandi Manaase yaababeihabeiha kukora ebibi ebirikukira obubi ebi amahanga gaakozire, agu MUKAMA yaacwekyerereize omu maisho g'Abaisraeli.
en: But they hearkened not: and Manasseh seduced them to do more evil than did the nations whom the LORD destroyed before the children of Israel.

rr: Bwanyima MUKAMA yaagamba naaraba omu bairu be baanabi ati
en: And the LORD spake by his servants the prophets, saying,

rr: Ahabwa Manaase omugabe wa Yuda kukora ebirikunugwa ebyo, akakora ebibi ebirikukira obubi ebi Abaamori abaamubandiize baakozire byona, akasiisisa Abayuda ebishushani bye ebirikuramibwa
en: Because Manasseh king of Judah hath done these abominations, and hath done wickedly above all that the Amorites did, which were before him, and hath made Judah also to sin with his idols:

rr: nikyo MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli arikugambira naagira ati: Reeba, naaza kureeta akabai ahari Yerusaalemu na Yuda, aku omuntu weena araahurire, amatu gakateera enduuru.
en: therefore thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Behold, I am bringing such evil upon Jerusalem and Judah, that whosoever heareth of it, both his ears shall tingle.

rr: Ndyagyeresa Yerusaalemu akagoye nk'aku naagyereise Samaria, na kariisho ei naashwijumiise enju ya Ahabu; kandi ndyaragaza Yerusaalemu, nk'oku omuntu aragaza eshuhaani, akgijuumika.
en: And I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria, and the plummet of the house of Ahab: and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipeth a dish, wiping it , and turning it upside down.

rr: Ndyanaga ekicweka ekitsigaire aha buhunguzi bwangye, mbaheyo omu mikono y'abazigu baabo, bahindukye omuhiigo n'omunyago aharibo
en: And I will forsake the remnant of mine inheritance, and deliver them into the hand of their enemies; and they shall become a prey and a spoil to all their enemies;

rr: ahakuba bakozire ebi ndikwanga, bangwisa kubi okwiha obu baishenkurubo baaruga Misri n'okuhitsya hati.
en: because they have done that which was evil in my sight, and have provoked me to anger, since the day their fathers came forth out of Egypt, even unto this day.

rr: 2 Mbwenu endiijo mirimo ya Manaase, n'ebi yaakozire byona, n'ekibi eki yaakozire, tibihandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'eby'omu busingye bw'abagabe ba Yuda?
en: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and all that he did, and his sin that he sinned, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

rr: 2 Manaase yaagwejegyera, yaashanga baishenkuru, yaaziikwa omu musiri gw'aha nju ye, ogwa Uzza; Amoni omutabani yaategyeka omu mwanya gwe.
en: And Manasseh slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.

rr: Eby'omu busingye bwa Amoni
en: Amon

rr: Amoni akaba aine emyaka makumi abiri n'ebiri, obu yaatandika kutegyeka, yaategyekyera emyaka ebiri omuri Yerusaalemu, Nyina akaba naayetwa Meshulemeesi, muhara wa Haruzi owa Yotiba.
en: Amon was twenty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Meshullemeth, the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.

rr: Yaakora ebirikwangwa MUKAMA nka Manaase ishe.
en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD , as his father Manasseh did.

rr: Yaagyendera omu muhanda gwona ogu ishe yaagyendeiremu, yaaheereza ebishushani ebi ishe yaaheereize, kandi yaabiramya
en: And he walked in all the way that his father walked in, and served the idols that his father served, and worshipped them:

rr: yaimuura MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa baishenkuru, tiyaagyendera mu mihanda ye.
en: and he forsook the LORD God of his fathers, and walked not in the way of the LORD .

rr: Bwanyima abaheereza b'omugabe Amoni baamugirira enaama, baamwitira omu nju ye.
en: And the servants of Amon conspired against him, and slew the king in his own house.

rr: Kwonka abantu b'omuri egyo nsi baita abamugiriire enaama boona, baata omutabani Yosia aha ngoma omu mwanya gwe.
en: And the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.

rr: Mbwenu endiijo mirimo ya Amoni ei yaakozire, tehandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'eby'omu busingye bw'abagabe ba Yuda?
en: Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

rr: Yaaziikwa omu kituuro kye omu musiri gwa Uzza; Yosia omutabani yaategyeka omu mwanya gwe.
en: And he was buried in his sepulchre in the garden of Uzza: and Josiah his son reigned in his stead.
