rr: Yosia akaba aine emyaka munaana, obu yaatandika kutegyeka; yaategyekyera emyaka makumi ashatu na gumwe omuri Yerusaalemu.
en: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem.

rr: Nyina akaba naayetwa Yedida, muhara wa Adaaya owa Bozikaasi.
en: And his mother's name was Jedidah, the daughter of Adaiah of Boscath.

rr: Yaakora ebirikusiimwa MUKAMA naagyendera omu muhanda gwa Daudi ishenkuru, tiyaateishuka kutoora aha rubaju rwa buryo nari rwa bumosho.
en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD , and walked in all the way of David his father, and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left. The Repair of the Temple

rr: Omu mwaka gwa ikumi na munaana gw'omu busingye gw'omugabe Yosia, aktuma Shafani mwene Azaliya mwijukuru wa Meshulaamu omuhandiiki, omu nju ya MUKAMA, yaamugira ati
en: And it came to pass in the eighteenth year of king Josiah, that the king sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, the son of Meshullam, the scribe, to the house of the LORD , saying,

rr: Inamuka oze owa Hilukia omunyamurwa omukuru, omugambire abare empiiha ezireetsirwe omu nju ya MUKAMA, ezi abarinzi b'eirembo bashoroize omu bantu
en: Go up to Hilkiah the high priest, that he may sum the silver which is brought into the house of the LORD , which the keepers of the door have gathered of the people:

rr: 2 bazihe abarikureeberera enju ya MUKAMA, nabo bazihe abakozi abari omu nju ya MUKAMA abarikugihunduura ahi esiisikaire
en: and let them deliver it into the hand of the doers of the work, that have the oversight of the house of the LORD : and let them give it to the doers of the work which is in the house of the LORD , to repair the breaches of the house,

rr: nibo babaizi, abombeki n'abarikwombekyesa amabaare; kandi ezindi zibe ez'okugura embaaho n'amabaare agahigwire eby'okuhunduuza enju.
en: unto carpenters, and builders, and masons, and to buy timber and hewn stone to repair the house.

rr: Kandi ezo mpiiha ezi baabaire babaha, bakaba batababuuza oku zikoresiibwe; ahabw'okuba bakaba bazikoresa n'obwesigwa.
en: Howbeit there was no reckoning made with them of the money that was delivered into their hand, because they dealt faithfully.

rr: Hilukia omunyamurwa okuzoora ekitabo ky'Ebiragiro
en: The Book of the Law

rr: 2 Hilukia omunyamurwa omukuru yaagira Shafani omuhandiiki ati: Naazoora ekitabo ky'Ebiragiro omu nju ya MUKAMA.
en: And Hilkiah the high priest said unto Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD .

rr: Atyo Hilukia yaaha Shafani ekyo kitabo, yaakishoma.
en: And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, and he read it.

rr: Bwanyima Shafani omuhandiiki yaija ow'omugabe, yaamugambira ati: Abairu baawe baihire omu nju ya MUKAMA empiiha ezishangirwemu; baaziha abarikugireeberera.
en: And Shaphan the scribe came to the king, and brought the king word again, and said, Thy servants have gathered the money that was found in the house, and have delivered it into the hand of them that do the work, that have the oversight of the house of the LORD .

rr: Shafani omuhandiiki yaagaruka yaagira omugabe ati: Hilukia omunyamurwa yampa ekitabo.
en: And Shaphan the scribe shewed the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest hath delivered me a book.

rr: Atyo Shafani yaakimushomera.
en: And Shaphan read it before the king.

rr: Omugabe ku yaahuriire ebigambo by'omu kitabo ky'Ebiragiro, yaataagura ebijwaro bye.
en: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the book of the law, that he rent his clothes.

rr: Ahonaaho yaaragiira Hilukia omunyamurwa, Ahikaamu mwene Shafani, Akiboora mwene Mikaaya, Shafani omuhandiiki na Asaaya omugaragwa w'omugabe, naagira ati
en: And the king commanded Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Achbor the son of Michaiah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asahiah a servant of the king's, saying,

rr: Mwirooko muhanuuze ahari MUKAMA ahabwangye n'abantu bangye kandi na Yuda yoona eby'ebigambo by'ekitabo eki ekizoirwe; ahakuba ekiniga kya Ruhanga ekituriho ni kingi munonga, ahabw'okuba baatatenkuriitwe tibaroorobeire bigambo by'eki kitabo, okukora ebyahandiikirwe byona ebirikutukwataho.
en: Go ye, enquire of the LORD for me, and for the people, and for all Judah, concerning the words of this book that is found: for great is the wrath of the LORD that is kindled against us, because our fathers have not hearkened unto the words of this book, to do according unto all that which is written concerning us.

rr: Atyo Hilukia omunyamurwa, Ahikaamu, Akiboora, Shafani na Asaaya baaza owa Hulida nabikazi muka Shalumu mwene Tikuva, mwijukuru wa Harihaasi, omubiiki w'ebijwaro; (omu biro ebyo ogwo mukazi akaba atwire Yerusaalemu omu kicweka kyayo kya kabiri) baagamba nawe.
en: So Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam, and Achbor, and Shaphan, and Asahiah, went unto Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college;) and they communed with her.

rr: Yaabagira ati: Oku nikwo MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa Israeli, arikugamba naagira ati: Mugambire omushaija obantumireho muti
en: And she said unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Tell the man that sent you to me,

rr: Oku nikwo MUKAMA arikugamba naagira ati: Reeba, ndyareeta akabi aha mwanya ogu n'aha batuuzi baamwo, nk'ebigambo byona ebihandiikirwe omu kitabo eki omugabe wa Yuda ashomire oku biri.
en: Thus saith the LORD , Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof, even all the words of the book which the king of Judah hath read:

rr: Ahabw'okuba bakanyimuura, baayoterera baaruhanga abandi obubaane, ngu bangwise kubi n'ebi baakozire n'emikono yaabo byona, n'ahabw'ekyo ekiniga kyangye kiryayaka aha mwanya ogu, kandi tikiriraazibwa.
en: because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be kindled against this place, and shall not be quenched.

rr: Kwonka omugabe wa Yuda obatumire kuhanuuza ahari MUKAMA, mumugire muti: Oku nikwo MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli arikugamba naagira ati: Ebirikukwata aha bigambo ebi ohuriire
en: But to the king of Judah which sent you to enquire of the LORD , thus shall ye say to him, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, As touching the words which thou hast heard;

rr: ahabw'okugira omutima gworobi, ku ohuriire ebi ngambire aha mwanya ogu n'aha batuuzi baamwo, ku barihinduka amatongo n'omukyeeno, waayecureeza omu maisho ga MUKAMA, waataagura ebijwaro byawe, waaririra omu maisho gangye, n'ahabw'ekyo naanye nkuhuriire; nikwo MUKAMA arikugamba.
en: because thine heart was tender, and thou hast humbled thyself before the LORD , when thou heardest what I spake against this place, and against the inhabitants thereof, that they should become a desolation and a curse, and hast rent thy clothes, and wept before me; I also have heard thee , saith the LORD .

rr: Reeba nikyo ndikusaangisiza baashwenkuru, okaziikwa omu kituuro kyawe n'obusingye, kandi amaisho gaawe tigarireeba kabi koona aku ndireeta aha mwanya ogu.
en: Behold therefore, I will gather thee unto thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered into thy grave in peace; and thine eyes shall not see all the evil which I will bring upon this place.

rr: Batyo baagaruka, baabiteekyerereza omugabe.
en: And they brought the king word again.

rr: 2 Bwanyima omugabe yaatuma, abakuru ba Yuda n'aba Yerusaalemu boona baateeranira ah'ari.
en: And the king sent, and they gathered unto him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem.

rr: Omugabe yainamuka omu nju ya MUKAMA hamwe n'abashaija b'omuri Yuda boona, abatuuzi b'omuri Yerusaalemu boona, abanyamurwa, na baanabi, abantu boona abakuru n'abato; yaabashomera ebigambo byona eby'omu kitabo ky'endagaano ekizoirwe omu nju ya MUKAMA.
en: And the king went up into the house of the LORD , and all the men of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the people, both small and great: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in the house of the LORD .

rr: Omugabe yaayemerera aha rubaju rw'enyomyo, yaaragaana endagaano omu maisho ga MUKAMA, naaraganisa ku mukuratira, okworobera ebiragiro bye, n'ebi yaahamize, n'ebi yaataireho, n'omutima gwe gwona n'amagara ge goona, kandi n'okuhikiiriza ebigambo by'omuri egyo ndagaano ebihandiikirwe omu kitabo ekyo; n'abantu boona baakwatanisa nawe omuri egyo ndagaano.
en: And the king stood by a pillar, and made a covenant before the LORD , to walk after the LORD , and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his statutes with all their heart and all their soul, to perform the words of this covenant that were written in this book. And all the people stood to the covenant. Josiah's Reforms

rr: Bwanyima omugabe yaaragiira Hilukia omunyamurwa omukuru, n'abanyamurwa abarikukurataho, kandi n'abarinzi b'eirembo, kwiha omu nju ya MUKAMA ebintu byona ebyakoreirwe Baali na Ashera n'eihe ryona ery'omu iguru; yaabyokyeza aheeru ya Yerusaalemu omu kahanga ka Kidirooni, eiju ryabyo yaaritwara Beseeli.
en: And the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, and the priests of the second order, and the keepers of the door, to bring forth out of the temple of the LORD all the vessels that were made for Baal, and for the grove, and for all the host of heaven: and he burned them without Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron, and carried the ashes of them unto Beth-el.

rr: Yaabinga abanyamurwa b'ebishushani ebirikuramibwa ebyatairweho abagabe ba Yuda kuguma nibabyoterera obubaane omu myanya mikuru y'okuramizamu ey'omu ndembo za Yuda n'eyeehinguririize Yerusaalemu; kandi yaabinga n'abandi abaabaire nibooterera Baali obubaane, n'eizooba n'okwezi n'eigana ry'enyonyoozi n'eihe ryona ery'omu iguru.
en: And he put down the idolatrous priests, whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah, and in the places round about Jerusalem; them also that burned incense unto Baal, to the sun, and to the moon, and to the planets, and to all the host of heaven.

rr: Kandi yaiha Ashera omu nju ya MUKAMA, yaagitwara aheeru ya Yerusaalemu aha kagyera Kidirooni, yaagyokyezaho, yaagihondahonda, yaagicwa omucuucu, ogwo mucuucu yaagushuka aha bituuro by'abantu b'obutoosha.
en: And he brought out the grove from the house of the LORD , without Jerusalem, unto the brook Kidron, and burned it at the brook Kidron, and stamped it small to powder, and cast the powder thereof upon the graves of the children of the people.

rr: Kandi yaasheenya amaju ga baamaraya agaabaire gari omu nju ya MUKAMA, ahu abakazi baabaire barukira enyegamo z'okukingira Ashera.
en: And he brake down the houses of the sodomites, that were by the house of the LORD , where the women wove hangings for the grove.

rr: Yaiha abanyamurwa boona omu ndembo za Yuda, yaashiisha emyanya mikuru y'okuramizamu, ahu abanyamurwa baabaire booterera obubaane, okuruga Geeba okuhika Beeri sheba; yaasheenya zaanyaruju z'emyanya mikuru eyaabaire eri aha irembo ahu orikutaahira nooza omu nju ya Yoshua omukru w'orurembo, emyanya egyo ekaba eri aha rubaju rwa bumosho rw'eryo irembo.
en: And he brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah, and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beer-sheba, and brake down the high places of the gates that were in the entering in of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which were on a man's left hand at the gate of the city.

rr: Kwonka abanyamurwa b'emyanya mikuru ey'okuramizamu tibainamuka ha itambiro rya MUKAMA omuri Yerusaalemu, kureka baaguma nibariira emigaati etatumbisiibwe omuri bagyenzi baabo.
en: Nevertheless the priests of the high places came not up to the altar of the LORD in Jerusalem, but they did eat of the unleavened bread among their brethren.

rr: Kandi yaashiisha Tofesi ey'omu ruhanga rwa beene Hinoomu, ngu hatagira omuntu weena owaarabya omutabani nari muhara we omu muriro kumutambira Moleki.
en: And he defiled Topheth, which is in the valley of the children of Hinnom, that no man might make his son or his daughter to pass through the fire to Molech.

rr: Yaihaho ebishushani by'embaraasi, ebi abagabe ba Yuda baabaire bahongyeire eizooba, ebyabaire biri ahu orikutaahira nooza omu nju ya MUKAMA, haihi n'ekishengye kya Nasani-meleki omukuru w'enju ekyabaire kihereraine na hekalu; yaayotsya n'ebigaari by'eizooba.
en: And he took away the horses that the kings of Judah had given to the sun, at the entering in of the house of the LORD , by the chamber of Nathan-melech the chamberlain, which was in the suburbs, and burned the chariots of the sun with fire.

rr: Kandi amatambiro agaabaire gari aha mutwe gw'ekishengye kya Ahazi eki abagabe ba Yuda baayombekire, n'amatambiro agu Manaase yaabaire akozire omu bikaari bibiri eby'enju ya MUKAMA, yaagahanantura, yaagatuura ahansi, yaagasheenyagura, omucuucu gwago yaagunaga omu kagyera Kidirooni.
en: And the altars that were on the top of the upper chamber of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of the house of the LORD , did the king beat down, and brake them down from thence, and cast the dust of them into the brook Kidron.

rr: Kandi omugabe yaashiisha emyanya mikuru ey'okuramizamu eyaabaire eri aha burugwa-izooba bwa Yerusaalemu, aha rubaju rwa buryo rw'akabungo k'eijundiro, ei Sulemaani omugabe wa Israeli yaabaire ayombekyeire Ashitaroosi ekirikunugwa ky'Abasidoni, na Kemoshi ekirikunugwa ky'Abamoabu, na Milikomu ekririkunugwa ky'Abaamoni.
en: And the high places that were before Jerusalem, which were on the right hand of the mount of corruption, which Solomon the king of Israel had builded for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Zidonians, and for Chemosh the abomination of the Moabites, and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon, did the king defile.

rr: Yaasheenyagura enyomyo, yaatema ebishushani bya Ashera, kandi omu myanya yaabyo yaijuzamu amafuga g'abantu. Yosia okuhikiiriza ebyahanwirwe omu busingye bwa Yerobaomu mwene Nebati
en: And he brake in pieces the images, and cut down the groves, and filled their places with the bones of men.

rr: Kandi eitambiro rya Beseeli riri na nyaruju ey'omwanya mukuru ebi Yeroboamu mwene Nebati owaassissise Israeli yaabaire ayombekire, yaabikumbagaza, yaayatagura amabaare gaabyo, yaagacwa omucuucu; yaagaruka yaayotsya Ashera.
en: Moreover the altar that was at Beth-el, and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, had made, both that altar and the high place he brake down, and burned the high place, and stamped it small to powder, and burned the grove.

rr: Yosia ku yaahindukire ati, yaareeba ebituuro hangahari aha kabungo; yaatuma, baiha amagufa omuri ebyo bituuro, yaagookyeza aha itambiro, yaarishiisha nk'ekigambo kya MUKAMA eki omushaija wa Ruhanga ori yaarangire naaragura oku kyabaire kiri.
en: And as Josiah turned himself, he spied the sepulchres that were there in the mount, and sent, and took the bones out of the sepulchres, and burned them upon the altar, and polluted it, according to the word of the LORD which the man of God proclaimed, who proclaimed these words.

rr: Bwanyima yaagira ati: Kiriya kiijutsyo eki ndikureeba obuseeri n'eky'enki?
en: Then he said, What title is that that I see?

rr: Abashaija b'omuri orwo rurembo baamugarukamu bati: N'ekituuro ky'omushaija wa Ruhanga owaarugire Yuda, akaragura ahari ebi ebi waakora eri itambiro.
en: And the men of the city told him, It is the sepulchre of the man of God, which came from Judah, and proclaimed these things that thou hast done against the altar of Beth-el.

rr: Omugabe yaagira ati: Mumurekye; hatagira owaaziikuura amagufa ge.
en: And he said, Let him alone; let no man move his bones.

rr: Batyo baareka amagufa ge hamwe n'aga nabi owaarugire Samaria.
en: So they let his bones alone, with the bones of the prophet that came out of Samaria.

rr: Kandi zaanyaruju zoona ez'omu myanya mikuru y'okuramizamu ey'omu ndembo za Samaria, ezaabaire zombekirwe abagabe ba Israeli nibagwisa kubi MUKAMA, Yosia yaazigira nk'ebi yaagizire nyaruju ya Beseeli byona oku byabaire biri.
en: And all the houses also of the high places that were in the cities of Samaria, which the kings of Israel had made to provoke the LORD to anger, Josiah took away, and did to them according to all the acts that he had done in Beth-el.

rr: Kandi abanyamurwa b'egyo myanya mikuru boona abaabaire bariyo, yaabaitira aha matambiro, yaayokyezaho n'amagufa g'abantu. Bwanyima yaagaruka Yerusaalemu. Yosia okugaruraho obugyenyi bw'Okuhingurwaho
en: And he slew all the priests of the high places that were there upon the altars, and burned men's bones upon them, and returned to Jerusalem.

rr: -11 ; -8 ; -4 ; -8 ; 2 Bwanyima omugabe yaaragiira abantu boona ati: Mukorere MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu obugyenyi bw'Okuhingurwaho, nk'oku kihandiikirwe omuri eki kitabo ky'endagaano.
en: And the king commanded all the people, saying, Keep the passover unto the LORD your God, as it is written in the book of this covenant.

rr: Buzimazima okwiha omu biro by'abaramuzi abaabaire bacwera Abaisraeli emanja n'omu biro byona eby'abagabe ba Israeli n'aba Yuda; tihakabahoga bungyenyi bw'Okuhingurwaho oburikushusha nk'obwo
en: Surely there was not holden such a passover from the days of the judges that judged Israel, nor in all the days of the kings of Israel, nor of the kings of Judah;

rr: kureka omu mwaka gwa ikumi na munaana ogw'omu busingye bw'omugabe Yosia nibwo baakorera MUKAMA obugyenyi obwo omuri Yerusaalemu.
en: but in the eighteenth year of king Josiah, wherein this passover was holden to the LORD in Jerusalem.

rr: Kandi Yosia yaihaho abarikugambisa emizimu n'abarogi, na baateraafi n'ebishushani ebirikuramibwa n'ebirikunugwa byona ebyashangirwe omuri Yuda na Yerusaalemu, ngu abone kuhikiiriza ebigambo by'Ebiragiro ebihandiikirwe omu kitabo eki Hilukia omunyamurwa yaazoire omu nju ya MUKAMA.
en: Moreover the workers with familiar spirits, and the wizards, and the images, and the idols, and all the abominations that were spied in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, did Josiah put away, that he might perform the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in the house of the LORD .

rr: Omu bagabe boona abaamubandiize tihaine owaashushaine nawe, owaahindukiire MUKAMA n'omutima gwe gwona, n'amagara ge goona, n'amaani ge goona, nk'ebiragiro bya Musa byona oku biri; kandi n'omu baamukuratiire tihaine waashushaine nawe.
en: And like unto him was there no king before him, that turned to the LORD with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses; neither after him arose there any like him.

rr: N'obu biraabe byabaire biri bityo MUKAMA tarahindukire kureka ekiniga kye kingi, eki yaagiriire Yuda, naabatura byona ebi Manaase yaakozire naamugwisa kubi.
en: Notwithstanding the LORD turned not from the fierceness of his great wrath, wherewith his anger was kindled against Judah, because of all the provocations that Manasseh had provoked him withal.

rr: 2 -20 ; 18:11 ; 21:4 , Ekyarugiremu MUKAMA yaagira ati: Ndyaiha Abayuda omu maisho gangye, nk'oku naihiremu Abaisraeli, kandi nyogye oru rurembo Yerusaalemu oru naatooraine, n'enju ei naagizire nti: Nimwo eiziina ryangye ririguma. Okufa kwa Yosia
en: And the LORD said, I will remove Judah also out of my sight, as I have removed Israel, and will cast off this city Jerusalem which I have chosen, and the house of which I said, My name shall be there.

rr: Nbwenu endiijo mirimo ya Yosia n'ebi yaakozire byona, tibihandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'eby'omu busingye bw'abagabe ba Yuda?
en: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

rr: -24 ; . Kandi omu busingye bwe Faraho Neeko omugabe wa Misri akainamuka aha mugyera Furaati kurwanisa omugabe wa Asiria; omugabe Yosia nawe yaaza kumurwanisa. Faraho Neeko ku yaamureebire, yaamwitira Megido.
en: In his days Pharaoh-nechoh king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates: and king Josiah went against him; and he slew him at Megiddo, when he had seen him.

rr: 2 Abaheereza be baiha omutumbi gwe Megido, baaguta omu kigaari, baagutwara Yerusaalemu, baamuziika omu kituuro kye. Abantu b'omuri egyo sni baatwara Yehoahazi mwene Yosia, baamushukaho amajuta, baamwemeka omu mwanya gwa ishe.
en: And his servants carried him in a chariot dead from Megiddo, and brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own sepulchre. And the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and anointed him, and made him king in his father's stead. Jehoahaz

rr: Yehoahazi akaba aine emyaka makumi abiri n'eshatu, obu yaatandika kutegyeka, yaategyekyera ameezi ashatu omuri Yerusaalemu.
en: Jehoahaz was twenty and three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem.

rr: Nyina akaba naayetwa Hamutaali muhara wa Yeremia owa Libuna.
en: And his mother's name was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

rr: Yaakora ebirikwangwa MUKAMA, nk'ebi baishenkuru baakozire byona.
en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD , according to all that his fathers had done.

rr: Bwanyima Faraho Neeko yaamubohera Ribula omu nsi ya Hamasi, ngu arekye kuguma Yerusaalemu aha ngoma, n'abantu b'omuri egyo nsi yaabacwera omutoijo gw'etalanta z'efeeza igana, n'etalanta emwe y'ezaabu.
en: And Pharaoh-nechoh put him in bands at Riblah in the land of Hamath, that he might not reign in Jerusalem; and put the land to a tribute of an hundred talents of silver, and a talent of gold.

rr: Faraho Neeko yaagira Eliakimu mwene Yosia omugabe omu mwanya gwa ishe, yaahindura eiziina rye, yaamweta Yehoyakimu; kandi yaihayo Yehoahazi; Yehoahazi ogwo ku yaahikire Misri, yaagwayo.
en: And Pharaoh-nechoh made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the room of Josiah his father, and turned his name to Jehoiakim, and took Jehoahaz away: and he came to Egypt, and died there.

rr: Yehoyakimu yaaha Faraho ezo feeza n'ezaabu; kwonka yaacwera ensi omushoro, ngu bareete empiiha nk'ekiragiro kya Faraho oku kyabaire kiri. Yaashoroza efeeza n'ezaabu aha bantu b'omuri egyo nsi, buri muntu nk'oku yaabaire acwereirwe, kubiha Faraho Neeko.
en: And Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh; but he taxed the land to give the money according to the commandment of Pharaoh: he exacted the silver and the gold of the people of the land, of every one according to his taxation, to give it unto Pharaoh-nechoh.

rr: Yehoyakimu akaba aine emyaka makumi abiri n'etaano, obu yaatandika kutegyeka, yaategyekyera emyaka ikumi na gumwe Yerusaalemu.
en: Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem.

rr: Nyina akaba naayetwa Zebida muhara wa Pedaaya owa Ruma.
en: And his mother's name was Zebudah, the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.

rr: Yaakora ebirikwangwa MUKAMA nk'ebi baishenkuru baakozire byona.
en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD , according to all that his fathers had done.

rr: Omu busingye bwa Yehoyakimu, Nebukadeneeza omugabe wa Babulooni akainamuka, Yehoyakimu yaamwehongyera, yaamara emyaka eshatu ari omwiru we; bwanyima yaamuhinduka, yaamugomera.
en: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant three years: then he turned and rebelled against him.

rr: 2 -14 ; 23:27 ; 25:4 ; . MUKAMA yaamwoherereza emtwe y'engabo z'Abakaludaaya, n'ez'Abasiria, n'ez'Abamoabu kandi n'ez'Abaamoni, ngu bateere Yuda bagicwekyereze, nk'oku MUKAMA yaagambire naaraba omu bairu be baanabi.
en: And the LORD sent against him bands of the Chaldees, and bands of the Syrians, and bands of the Moabites, and bands of the children of Ammon, and sent them against Judah to destroy it, according to the word of the LORD , which he spake by his servants the prophets.

rr: Buzimazima ekyo kikaba ahari Yuda ahabw'ekiragiro kya MUKAMA, ngu abone kubaiha omu maisho ge, naabatura ebibi bya Manaase nk'oku yaabikozire byona
en: Surely at the commandment of the LORD came this upon Judah, to remove them out of his sight, for the sins of Manasseh, according to all that he did;

rr: kandi n'eshagama y'abataine rubanja ei yaaseesire; ahabw'okuba akagiijuza Yerusaalemu, na'ahabw'ekyo MUKAMA yaayanga kubimusaasira.
en: and also for the innocent blood that he shed: for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood; which the LORD would not pardon.

rr: Mbwenu endiijo mirimo ya Yehoyakimu n'ebi yaakozire byona tibihandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'eby'omu busingye bw'abagabe ba Yuda?
en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

rr: Bwanyima Yehoyakimu yaagwejegyera, yaashanga baishenkuru, Yehoyakiini omutabani yaategyeka omu mwanya gwe.
en: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers: and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead.

rr: Kandi omugabe wa Misri taragarukire kuruga mu nsi ye, ahakuba omugabe wa Babulooni akaba akubwire ensi yoona eyaabaire eri ey'omugabe wa Misri, okuruga aha kagyera ka Misri okuhika aha mugyera Furaati.
en: And the king of Egypt came not again any more out of his land: for the king of Babylon had taken from the river of Egypt unto the river Euphrates all that pertained to the king of Egypt. Jehoiachin

rr: Yehoyakiini akaza aha ngoma aine emyaka ikumi na munaana, yaategyekyera Yerusaalemu ameezi ashatu.
en: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months.

rr: Nyina akaba naayetwa Nehushiita, muhara wa Elinasani owa Yerusaalemu.
en: And his mother's name was Nehushta, the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.

rr: Naawe yaakora ebirikwangwa MUKAMA, nk'ebi ishe yaakozire byona.
en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD , according to all that his father had done. Fall of Jerusalem

rr: Omu biro ebyo abashaija ba Nebukadeneeza omugabe wa Babulooni bakainamuka, baateera Yerusaalemu, baagota orurembo.
en: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against Jerusalem, and the city was besieged.

rr: Bwanyima Nebukadeneeza omugabe wa Babulooni yaijayo, abashaija be bakirugotsire.
en: And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came against the city, and his servants did besiege it.

rr: Yehoyakiini omugabe wa Yuda yaashohora, yaayehayo omu mikono y'omugabe wa Babulooni, we na nyina n'abagaragwa be n'abanyiginya be, n'abakuru b'ekikaari kye. Ogwo mugabe wa Babulooni omu mwaka gwe gwa munaana nibwo yaakwata Yehoyakiini, akamutwara ari enkwatwa
en: And Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon, he, and his mother, and his servants, and his princes, and his officers: and the king of Babylon took him in the eighth year of his reign.

rr: 1 -50 ; kandi yaanyaga eby'obutungi by'omu nju ya MUKAMA byona n'eby'omu nju y'omgabe, yaatematema ebintu by'ezaabu byona eby'omuri hekalu ya MUKAMA, ebi Sulemaani omugabe wa Israeli yaakozire, nk'oku MUKAMA yaabaire agambire.
en: And he carried out thence all the treasures of the house of the LORD , and the treasures of the king's house, and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in the temple of the LORD , as the LORD had said.

rr: Kandi yaatwara ab'omuri Yerusaalemu boona bari enkwatwa n'abanyiginya boona, n'amamanzi goona ag'amaani; enkwatwa zoona hamwe n'abanyamyoga boona n'abaheesi zaaba kakumi; tihaagira owaatsigarayo, kureka abantu abarikuhereerukayo omu bworo bonka omuri egyo nsi.
en: And he carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valour, even ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and smiths: none remained, save the poorest sort of the people of the land.

rr: Atyo yaatwara Yehoyakiini Babulooni; na nyin'omugabe n'abakazi be n'abatware be n'abakuru b'ensi ye, yaabaiha Yerusaalemu, yaabatwara Babulooni bari enkwatwa.
en: And he carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon, and the king's mother, and the king's wives, and his officers, and the mighty of the land, those carried he into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon.

rr: Abashaija boona amamanzi enkumi mushanju, abanyamyoga hamwe n'abaheesi rukumi, boona ab'amaani abarikumanya eby'engamba, omugabe wa Babulooni yaabatwara Babulooni bari enkwatwa.
en: And all the men of might, even seven thousand, and craftsmen and smiths a thousand, all that were strong and apt for war, even them the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon.

rr: 2 Bwanyima yaata Matania, ishento wa Yehoyakiini, aha ngoma omu mwanya gwe, yaahindura eiziina rye, yaamweta Zedekia. Eby'omu busingye bwa Zedekia
en: And the king of Babylon made Mattaniah his father's brother king in his stead, and changed his name to Zedekiah.

rr: Zedekia akaza aha ngoma aine emyaka makumi abiri na gumwe, yaategyekyera Yerusaalemu emyaka ikumi na gumwe.
en: Zedekiah was twenty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem.

rr: Nyina akaba naayetwa Hamutaali muhara wa Yeremia owa Libuna.
en: And his mother's name was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

rr: Yaakora ebirikwangwa MUKAMA nk'ebi Yehoyakiini yaakozire byona oku byabaire biri.
en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD , according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

rr: Ahakuba ekiniga kya MUKAMA kikaba kingi munonga ahari Yerusaalemu na Yuda, okuhitsya obu yaababingiire kimwe omu maisho ge. Bwanyima Zedekia yaagomera omugabe wa Babulooni. en: For through the anger of the LORD it came to pass in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence, that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon. rr: 2 Omu mwaka gwa mwenda ogw'omu busingye bwa Zedekia omu kwezi kwa ikumi aha kiro kyakwo kya ikumi, Nebukadeneeza omugabe wa Babulooni akaija n'eihe rye ryona kuteera Yerusaalemu, yaagigota; baagyombekaho eby'okugirwanisizaho okugyehinguririza. -7 ; 34:1 , 2 ; 39:1 , 2 ; 52:4-11 ; .
en: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he, and all his host, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it; and they built forts against it round about.

rr: Batyo baagota orwo rurembo okuhitsya omu mwaka gwa ikumi na gumwe ogw'omu busingye bwa Zedekia.
en: And the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.

rr: Aha kiro kya mwenda omu kwezi kwa kana enjara yaaba nyingi munonga omuri orwo rurembo, abantu baamwo baarura eky'okurya.
en: And on the ninth day of the fourth month the famine prevailed in the city, and there was no bread for the people of the land.

rr: Bwanyima Abakaludaaya baafumura orugo rw'orurembo. Ahonaaho omugabe Zedekia n'engabo ze zoona baacwa ekyo kiro, baaraba omu irembo eryabaire riri haihi n'omusiri gw'omugabe ahagati y'engo zaagwo zombi, baatoora ogurikuza Araba. (Obwo Abakaludaaya bagotsire orurembo embaju zoona).
en: And the city was broken up, and all the men of war fled by night by the way of the gate between two walls, which is by the king's garden: (now the Chaldees were against the city round about:) and the king went the way toward the plain.

rr: Kwonka eihe ry'Abakaludaaya ryakurata omugabe, ryamuhikira omu mpita za Yeriko, engabo ze zoona zaamuhungaho, zaataataana.
en: And the army of the Chaldees pursued after the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho: and all his army were scattered from him.

rr: Batyo baakwata ogwo mugabe, baamureetera omugabe wa Babulooni ahari Ribula, yaamucwera orubanja.
en: So they took the king, and brought him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they gave judgment upon him.

rr: Baitira batabani ba Zedekia ogwo omu maisho ge, bwanyima nawe baamwihamu amaisho, baamukom n'emihama, baamutwara Babulooni.
en: And they slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, and put out the eyes of Zedekiah, and bound him with fetters of brass, and carried him to Babylon.

rr: Omu kwezi kwa kataano aha kiro kya mushanju ky'okwo kwezi, omu mwaka gwa ikumi na mwenda omu busingye bwa Nebukadeneeza omugabe wa Babulooni, Nebuzaradaani omukuru w'abarinzi, omushaija w'omugabe wa Babulooni, akaija Yerusaalemu.
en: And in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, which is the nineteenth year of king Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzar-adan, captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, unto Jerusalem:

rr: Yaayotsya enju ya MUKAMA n'enju y'omugabe n'amaju goona ag'omuri Yerusaalemu; buri nju yoona empango yaagyotsya.
en: and he burnt the house of the LORD , and the king's house, and all the houses of Jerusalem, and every great man's house burnt he with fire.

rr: Eihe ryona ey'Abakaludaaya, abaizire n'omukiru w'abarinzi, baasheenya engo z'amabaare ezaabaire zeehinguririize Yerusaalemu.
en: And all the army of the Chaldees, that were with the captain of the guard, brake down the walls of Jerusalem round about.

rr: Bwanyima abantu abaabaire batsigaire omu rurembo, n'abaabaire baimwire omugabe waabo beehongyeire omugabe wa Babulooni, n'abandi bantu b'obutoosha, abo boona Nebuzaradaani omukuru w'abarinzi yaabatawara bari enkwatwa.
en: Now the rest of the people that were left in the city, and the fugitives that fell away to the king of Babylon, with the remnant of the multitude, did Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard carry away.

rr: Kwonka yaatsigamu abantu bamwe abarikuhereerukayo kuba abooro kuguma nibasharira emizaabibu kandi n'ab'okuhinga.
en: But the captain of the guard left of the poor of the land to be vinedressers and husbandmen.

rr: 2 -20 ; 1 Kandi enyomyo z'emiringa ezaabaire ziri omu nju ya MUKAMA, n'ebitebe by'ebinaabiro n'ekitanka ky'emiringa ebyabaire biri omu nju ya MUKAMA, Abakaludaaya baabisheenyagura, baatwara emiringa yaabyo Babulooni.
en: And the pillars of brass that were in the house of the LORD , and the bases, and the brasen sea that was in the house of the LORD , did the Chaldees break in pieces, and carried the brass of them to Babylon.

rr: Kandi baatwara enyungu n'ebyoma by'okuyooza eiju, na makansi, n'enyabya z'obubaane, n'ebindi bintu bye'miringa byona ebyabaire bikoresibwa omu murimo gwa hekalu
en: And the pots, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.

rr: n'eby'okuguhisa omuriro, n'enyabya. Ebintu ebyabaire bikozire omu zaabu omukuru w'abarinzi yaabitwara biri efeeza.
en: And the firepans, and the bowls, and such things as were of gold, in gold, and of silver, in silver, the captain of the guard took away.

rr: Enyomyo zombi ziri, n'ekitanka, n'ebitebe ebi Sulemaani yaakoreire enju ya MUKAMA, emiringa y'ebyo bintu byona ekaba erengire ekigyero.
en: The two pillars, one sea, and the bases which Solomon had made for the house of the LORD ; the brass of all these vessels was without weight.

rr: 1 Obwemi bw'enyomyo emwe bukaba buri mikono ikumi na munaana, kandi eriho omutwe gw'emiringa, obwemi bwagwo mikono eshatu; omutwe ogwo gwehinguririziibwe otugoye tw'emiringa otushobeekaine nk'akatimba, n'ebishushani by'ebijuma by'amakomamahanga, byona biri eby'emiringa; kandi enyomyo ya kabiri ekaba eine nk'ebyo, nabyo biriho ekatimba.
en: The height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits, and the chapiter upon it was brass: and the height of the chapiter three cubits; and the wreathen work, and pomegranates upon the chapiter round about, all of brass: and like unto these had the second pillar with wreathen work.

rr: Bwanyima ogwo mukuru w'abarinzi yaakwata Seraaya omunyamurwa omukuru, na Zefania orikukurataho, n'abarinzi b'eirembo bonshatu
en: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:

rr: kandi omu rurembo yihamu omutware owaabaire ari omukuru w'engabo, n'abashaija bataano abaabaire bari bamwe aha bashaija empikamugabe abaashangirwe omu rurembo, n'omuhandiiki w'omukuru w'eihe, owaabaire ahuruza engabo z'omuri egyo nsi, n'abashaija makumi mukaaga b'omu bantu b'obutoosha abaashangirew omu rurembo.
en: and out of the city he took an officer that was set over the men of war, and five men of them that were in the king's presence, which were found in the city, and the principal scribe of the host, which mustered the people of the land, and threescore men of the people of the land that were found in the city:

rr: Atyo Nebuzaradaani ogwo, omukuru w'abarinzi, yaabakukumba, yaabatwara Ribula aha mugabe wa Babulooni.
en: and Nebuzar-adan captain of the guard took these, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah:

rr: Omugabe wa Babulooni yaabateera, yaabaitira Ribula omu nsi ya Hamasi.
en: and the king of Babylon smote them, and slew them at Riblah in the land of Hamath.

rr: Okwo nikwo Abayuda baihirwe omu nsi yaabo, bakatwarwa bari enkwatwa.
en: So Judah was carried away out of their land.

rr: Kandi abantu abaatsigaire omu nsi ya Yuda, abu Nebukadeneeza omugabe wa Babulooni yaatisigiremu, yaataho Gedalia mwene Ahikaamu, mwijukuru wa Shafani, kuba omutegyeki waabo.
en: And as for the people that remained in the land of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, even over them he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, ruler.

rr: Banyima abakuru b'engabo boona hamwe n'engabo zaabo, ku baahuriire ngu omugabe wa Babulooni ataireho Gedalia kuba omutegyeki, baija Mizipa, ahu yaabaire ari n'engabo zaabo; haija Ishimaeli mwene Nesania, Yohanaani mwene Yanihumeesi owa Netofa, na Yazania mutabani w'omushaija wa Maaka.
en: And when all the captains of the armies, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor, there came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan the son of Careah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of a Maachathite, they and their men.

rr: Gedalia yaabarahira n'abashaija baabo naagira ati: Mutatiina abakuru b'Abakaludaaya; mugume omuri egi nsi, mukorere omugabe wa Babulooni, nimwija kuba gye.
en: And Gedaliah sware to them, and to their men, and said unto them, Fear not to be the servants of the Chaldees: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon; and it shall be well with you.

rr: Kwonka omu kwezi kwa mushanju Ishimaeli mwene Nesania, mwijukuru wa Elishaama ow'omuryango gw'omugabe, yaija n'abashaija ikumi, baarwanisa Gedalia, baamwita hamwe n'Abayudaaya n'Abakaludaaya, abu yaabaire aine Mizipa.
en: But it came to pass in the seventh month, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the seed royal, came, and ten men with him, and smote Gedaliah, that he died, and the Jews and the Chaldees that were with him at Mizpah.

rr: Ahonaaho abantu boona, abakuru n'abato, na'bo bakuru b'engabo, baimuka, baahungira Misri ahabw'okutiina Abakaludaaya.
en: And all the people, both small and great, and the captains of the armies, arose, and came to Egypt: for they were afraid of the Chaldees.

rr: Yehoyakiini omugabe wa Yuda ku yaabaire amazire emyaka makumi ashatu na mushanju ari omu bukwatwa, omu kwezi kwa ikumi n'abiri aha kiro kya makumi abiri na mushanju ky'okwo kwezi, omu mwaka ogu Evili-merodaaki omugabe wa Babulooni yaatandikiiremu kutegyeka, yaiha Yehoyakiini omu kihome
en: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, that Evil-merodach king of Babylon in the year that he began to reign did lift up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison;

rr: yaagamba gye nawe, yaamuha ekitebe ekirikukira eby'abandi bagabe abaabaire bari hamwe nawe Babulooni.
en: and he spake kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that were with him in Babylon;

rr: Atyo Yehoyakiini yaajuura ebijwaro bye'ekihome. Okuruga aho yaaguma naariira aha meeza y'omugabe ebiro bye byona
en: and changed his prison garments: and he did eat bread continually before him all the days of his life.

rr: kandi eby'okumutunga omugabe yaaguma naabimuha, buri izooba naamuha omugabo gwaryo, ebiro byona ebi yaamazire akihuriire.
en: And his allowance was a continual allowance given him of the king, a daily rate for every day, all the days of his life.

1 Nyowe Simooni Petero, omuhuuku kandi entumwa ya Yesu Kristo, naabahandiikira imwe, abaahairwe okwikiriza kw'obuguzi bwingi nk'okwaitu, omu kuhikiirira kwa Ruhanga waitu kandi Omujuni waitu Yesu Kristo
en: 1 Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ, to them that have obtained like precious faith with us through the righteousness of God and our Saviour Jesus Christ:

rr: 2 embabazi n'obusingye byongyerwe omuriimwe omu kumanya Ruhanga na Yesu Mukama waitu.
en: 2 grace and peace be multiplied unto you through the knowledge of God, and of Jesus our Lord,
3 according as his divine power hath given unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue:

rr: 4 ebyamureeteire kuturaganisa eby'obuguzi bwingi kandi ebikuru munonga, ngu ahabw'ebyo murugye omu kujunda okw'omu nsi okurikureetwa okwetenga okubi, mubone kukwatanisa na Ruhanga omu buteeka bwe.
en: 4 whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these ye might be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust.

rr: 5 N'ahabw'ekyo mugire obweziriki bwingi; aha kwikiriza kwanyu mwongyereho emicwe emirungi; aha micwe emirungi yaanyu mwongyereho okwetegyereza
en: 5 And beside this, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue; and to virtue knowledge;

rr: 6 aha kwetegyereza mwongyereho kwerinda; aha kwerinda mwongyreho okugumisiriza; aha kugumisiriza mwongyereho okutiina Ruhanga
en: 6 and to knowledge temperance; and to temperance patience; and to patience godliness;
7 and to godliness brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness charity.

rr: 8 Kandi ebyo ku muraabe mubiine, byayongyera kuba bingi munonga, nibibazibira kuba abeeremwa nari abatarikwana byana omu by'okumanya Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo.
en: 8 For if these things be in you, and abound, they make you that ye shall neither be barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
9 But he that lacketh these things is blind, and cannot see afar off, and hath forgotten that he was purged from his old sins.

rr: 10 N'ahabw'ekyo, B'eishe-emwe, mwongyere kwezirika kuhamya okwetwa kwanyu n'okutooranwa kwanyu; ahakuba ku muraatwaze mutyo, timurigwa biro byona
en: 10 Wherefore the rather, brethren, give diligence to make your calling and election sure: for if ye do these things, ye shall never fall:
11 for so an entrance shall be ministered unto you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.

rr: 12 Nikyo nyendera kubaijutsya obutoosha ebigambo ebyo, n'obu muraabe nimubimanya, kandi muhamiire omu mazima agu mwine.
en: 12 Wherefore I will not be negligent to put you always in remembrance of these things, though ye know them , and be established in the present truth.
13 Yea, I think it meet, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting you in remembrance;

rr: 14 nimmanya ngu okwihwaho okw'orusiisira rwangye kuri haihi, nka Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo oku yammanyiise.
en: 14 knowing that shortly I must put off this my tabernacle, even as our Lord Jesus Christ hath shewed me.

rr: 15 Kandi niinyija kwezirika ngu, ku ndiheza kufa, mubaase kuguma nimweyijutsya ebyo buri mwanya gwona.
en: 15 Moreover I will endeavour that ye may be able after my decease to have these things always in remembrance.

rr: 16 Mumanye ngu titurakuratiire nfumu ezaagunzirwe n'obwengye, obu twabamanyisa obushoboorozi bwa Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo n'okwija kwe, kureka tukaba turi baakareebi b'ekitiinisa ky'obukama bwe.
en: 16 For we have not followed cunningly devised fables, when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
17 For he received from God the Father honour and glory, when there came such a voice to him from the excellent glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

rr: 18 kandi eryo iraka tukarihurira niriruga omu iguru, obu twabaire turi hamwe nawe aha rushozi orwo orurikwera.
en: 18 And this voice which came from heaven we heard, when we were with him in the holy mount.

rr: 19 Kandi twine ekigambo ky'obunabi ekirikukira kuhamibwa. Ku murikyetaho, muryaba mukozire gye, ahakuba kiri nk'etabaaza erikwaka omu mwirima, okuhitsya obu buritaagurikana, n'enyonyoozi ey'omu kasheeshe ekaaka omu mitima yaanyu.
en: 19 We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts:

rr: 20 Mubanze mumanye eki ngu tihariho kigambo ky'obunabi eky'omu Byahandiikirwe ekirikubaasa kushoboororwa omuntu nk'oku arikweyendera
en: 20 knowing this first, that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation.
21 For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of God spake as they were moved by the Holy Ghost.

1 But there were false prophets also among the people, even as there shall be false teachers among you, who privily shall bring in damnable heresies, even denying the Lord that bought them, and bring upon themselves swift destruction.

rr: 2 Kandi baingi baryakuratira emicwe yaabo ey'obushambani; abo baryajumisa omuhanda gw'amazima.
en: 2 And many shall follow their pernicious ways; by reason of whom the way of truth shall be evil spoken of.
3 And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you: whose judgment now of a long time lingereth not, and their damnation slumbereth not.
4 For if God spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;
5 and spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person , a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly;
6 and turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes condemned them with an overthrow, making them an ensample unto those that after should live ungodly;

rr: 7 akakiza looti ohikiriire, owaabaire ashobeirwe ahabw'emicwe mibi y'abashambani
en: 7 and delivered just Lot, vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked:
8 (for that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing and hearing, vexed his righteous soul from day to day with their unlawful deeds;)
9 the Lord knoweth how to deliver the godly out of temptations, and to reserve the unjust unto the day of judgment to be punished:
10 but chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness, and despise government. Presumptuous are they , selfwilled, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities.

rr: 11 kunu baamaraika, n'obu baraabe babakiza amaani n'obushoboorozi, tibacwera b'ekitiinisa abo rubanja omu maisho ga Mukama, nibabajuma.
en: 11 Whereas angels, which are greater in power and might, bring not railing accusation against them before the Lord.

rr: 12 Kwonka abo bashusha nk'enyamaishwa ezitaine bwengye, ezaahangiirwe kutegwa n'okwitwa, kandi basheka ebi batarikumanya; aha muheru okuherekyerera kwabo nabo kuryabahwerekyereza
en: 12 But these, as natural brute beasts, made to be taken and destroyed, speak evil of the things that they understand not; and shall utterly perish in their own corruption;

rr: 13 bakorwe kubi, nibaihurwa ebihembo by'okukora kubi kwabo.
en: 13 and shall receive the reward of unrighteousness, as they that count it pleasure to riot in the daytime.

rr: Beesiimira ebinoomo nyomushana; n'abantu b'amabara mabi n'obumogo, bazaana kubi omu magyenyi gaabo, nibariira hamwe naimwe
en: Spots they are and blemishes, sporting themselves with their own deceivings while they feast with you;

rr: 14 baine amaisho agaijwire obushambani, kandi agataruha kushiisha; niboosya ab'emitima etahamire, baine omutima ogumanyiire okwetenga okubi; n'abaana bakyeenirwe
en: 14 having eyes full of adultery, and that cannot cease from sin; beguiling unstable souls: an heart they have exercised with covetous practices; cursed children:
15 which have forsaken the right way, and are gone astray, following the way of Balaam the son of Bosor, who loved the wages of unrighteousness;

rr: 16 kwonka akahanwa ahabw'okushiisha kwe, obu endogoya etagamba yaagamba nk'omuntu, ekazibira eiraro rya nabi ogwo.
en: 16 but was rebuked for his iniquity: the dumb ass speaking with man's voice forbad the madness of the prophet.
17 These are wells without water, clouds that are carried with a tempest; to whom the mist of darkness is reserved for ever.

rr: 18 bagamba ebigambo ebikuru eby'okwetunguura ebitaine mugasho; boosya abantu ababa bahungire abatuura omu buhabe, nibababeihabeihesa okwetenga okubi okw'omubiri.
en: 18 For when they speak great swelling words of vanity, they allure through the lusts of the flesh, through much wantonness, those that were clean escaped from them who live in error.
19 While they promise them liberty, they themselves are the servants of corruption: for of whom a man is overcome, of the same is he brought in bondage.

20 For if after they have escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, they are again entangled therein, and overcome, the latter end is worse with them than the beginning.
21 For it had been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than, after they have known it , to turn from the holy commandment delivered unto them.
22 But it is happened unto them according to the true proverb, The dog is turned to his own vomit again; and the sow that was washed to her wallowing in the mire.

rr: 1 Abarikukundwa, egi n'ebaruha ya kabiri ei naabahandiikira; omu baruha ezo zombi eki naagyendereire n'okusisiimura emitima yaanyu etarimu buryarya nimbaijutsya
en: 1 This second epistle, beloved, I now write unto you; in both which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance:

rr: 2 ngu mwijukye ebigambo ebyagambirwe ira baanabi abarikwera, n'ekiragiro kya Mukama kandi Omujuni waitu eki mwagambiirwe entumwa ezaabatumirweho.
en: 2 that ye may be mindful of the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and of the commandment of us the apostles of the Lord and Saviour:
3 knowing this first, that there shall come in the last days scoffers, walking after their own lusts,
4 and saying, Where is the promise of his coming? for since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.
5 For this they willingly are ignorant of, that by the word of God the heavens were of old, and the earth standing out of the water and in the water:
6 whereby the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished:

rr: 7 kwonka eiguru n'ensi ebiriho hati, ahabw'ekigambo ekyo, bibiikiirwe omuriro, nibirindwa okuhitsya aha kiro ky'orubanja eki abantu abatatiina Ruhanga baricwekyererezibwaho.
en: 7 but the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word are kept in store, reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men.
8 But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.
9 The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

10 But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat, the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.

rr: 11 Ebyo byona ku biraabe biri eby'okuyaga bityo, mureebe oku mushemereire kuba abarikwera kandi abarikutiina Ruhanga omu mitwarize yaanyu
en: 11 Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness,
12 looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of God, wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat?
13 Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness.

rr: 14 N'ahabw'ekyo, abarikukundwa, nk'oku mutegyereize ebyo, mwezirikye abashangye mwine obusingye, mutaine ibara ribi n'obu kaakuba akamogo omu maisho ge.
en: 14 Wherefore, beloved, seeing that ye look for such things, be diligent that ye may be found of him in peace, without spot, and blameless.
15 And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given unto him hath written unto you;

rr: 16 naagamba atyo omu baruha ze zoona. Omuri ezo harimu ebigambo bimwe ebigumire kwetegyerezibwa, ebi abatarikwetegyereza n'abatahamire bakiikamya, nk'oku bagira ebyahandiikirwe ebindi, bakeereetaho okuhwerekyerera.
en: 16 as also in all his epistles, speaking in them of these things; in which are some things hard to be understood, which they that are unlearned and unstable wrest, as they do also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction.

rr: 17 N'ahabw'ekyo naimwe, abarikukundwa, nk'oku mushangirwe nimumanya ebyo, mwerinde mutahabisibwa obuhabe bw'abantu babi, mukaruga omu kuhama kwanyu.
en: 17 Ye therefore, beloved, seeing ye know these things before, beware lest ye also, being led away with the error of the wicked, fall from your own stedfastness.

rr: 18 Kureka mukurire omu mbabazi za Mukama waitu kandi Omujuni Yesu Kristo, n'omu kumumanya.
en: 18 But grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.

rr: Aheebwe ekitiinisa hati n'ebiro byona.
en: To him be glory both now and for ever.

rr: Amiina.
en: Amen.

rr: Bwanyima y'okufa kwa Saulo, Daudi akatabaaruka naaruga kwita Abaamaleki; ku yaahikire Zikulaagi, yaamarayo ebiro bibiri.
en: Now it came to pass after the death of Saul, when David was returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites, and David had abode two days in Ziklag;

rr: Aha kiro kya kashatu haija omushaija naaruga omu rusiisira rwa Saulo, emyenda ye etaagukire, aine eitaka omu mutwe; ku yaahikire ahari Daudi, yaajuumara ahansi, yaamutangirira.
en: it came even to pass on the third day, that, behold, a man came out of the camp from Saul with his clothes rent, and earth upon his head: and so it was, when he came to David, that he fell to the earth, and did obeisance.

rr: Daudi yaamubuuza ati: Nooruga hi? Onu yaamugarukamu ati: Naacwa omu rusiisira rw'Abaisraeli.
en: And David said unto him, From whence comest thou? And he said unto him, Out of the camp of Israel am I escaped.

rr: Daudi yaamubuuza ati: Bibaire bita?
en: And David said unto him, How went the matter?

rr: Ninkweshengyereza, ngambira.
en: I pray thee, tell me.

rr: Onu yaamugarukamu ati: Abantu bahungire aha rugamba, baingi omuribo bagwire, baafa, kandi Saulo n'omutabani Yonasaani nabo bafiire.
en: And he answered, That the people are fled from the battle, and many of the people also are fallen and dead; and Saul and Jonathan his son are dead also.

rr: Daudi yaabuuza ogwo mutsigazi owaamubikira ati: Beitu shi omanyisiibwe ki Saulo n'omutabani Yonasaani ku bafiire?
en: And David said unto the young man that told him, How knowest thou that Saul and Jonathan his son be dead?

rr: 1 Ogwo mutsigazi owaabaire naamubikira yaagira ati: Ku mbaire niinyegyendera, naahika aha kibungo Giliboa, naareeba Saulo ayegamiire eicumu rye; kandi naareeba ab'ebigaari n'ab'embaraasi bamubingire bamuhambize.
en: And the young man that told him said, As I happened by chance upon mount Gilboa, behold, Saul leaned upon his spear; and, lo, the chariots and horsemen followed hard after him.

rr: Ku agarwire amaisho enyima, yandeeba, yaanyeta, naanye naamwetaba nti: Ndi aha, Nyakusinga!
en: And when he looked behind him, he saw me, and called unto me. And I answered, Here am I.

rr: Yambuuza ati: Ori oha? Naamugarukamu nti: Ndi Omuamaleki.
en: And he said unto me, Who art thou? And I answered him, I am an Amalekite.

rr: Yangira ati: Mpika haihi, onyite; ahakuba nyine obusaasi bwingi, kandi tinkakabire.
en: He said unto me again, Stand, I pray thee, upon me, and slay me: for anguish is come upon me, because my life is yet whole in me.

rr: Ntyo naamuhika haihi, naamwita, ahakuba mmanyiire kimwe ku atari w'okukira yaagwire; bwanyima naamucwijura ekirunga ky'aha mutwe gwe n'engoro ebaire emuri aha mukono; mbwenu mbibi, mbikureeteire, mukama wangye.
en: So I stood upon him, and slew him, because I was sure that he could not live after that he was fallen: and I took the crown that was upon his head, and the bracelet that was on his arm, and have brought them hither unto my lord.

rr: Daudi yaataagura emyenda ye, n'abashaija boona abu yaabaire aine baakora batyo.
en: Then David took hold on his clothes, and rent them; and likewise all the men that were with him:

rr: Baacura nibaborooga, baayesiibyakwo okuhitsya omu mwabazyo, ahabwa Saulo n'omutabani Yonasaani, n'ahabw'abantu ba MUKAMA n'enju ya Israeli okumarwa rurara.
en: and they mourned, and wept, and fasted until even, for Saul, and for Jonathan his son, and for the people of the LORD , and for the house of Israel; because they were fallen by the sword.

rr: Daudi yaabuuza omutsigazi owaamubikira ati: Nooruga hi?
en: And David said unto the young man that told him, Whence art thou?

rr: Onu ati: Ndi omwana w'omunyaihanga, Omuamaleki.
en: And he answered, I am the son of a stranger, an Amalekite.

rr: Daudi ati: Kirugire hi iwe okutatiina kubanga omukono kwita ou MUKAMA yaashukireho amajuta?
en: And David said unto him, How wast thou not afraid to stretch forth thine hand to destroy the LORD 's anointed?

rr: Daudi yaayeta omwe aha batsigazi, yaamugira ati: Irooko omuhikye haihi, omugurukire. Yaamucumita, yaafa.
en: And David called one of the young men, and said, Go near, and fall upon him. And he smote him that he died.

rr: Daudi yaamugira ati: Orubanja rw'eshagama yaawe rube niiwe rwabaho, ahabw'okuba akanwa kaawe niko mushinja ku waahamya noogira oti: Nyitsire ou MUKAMA yaashukireho amajuta.
en: And David said unto him, Thy blood be upon thy head; for thy mouth hath testified against thee, saying, I have slain the LORD 's anointed.

rr: Ekyeshongoro ky'okucurira Saulo na Yonasaani
en: David's Lament

rr: Bwanyima Daudi yaacurira Saulo n'omutabani Yonasaani n'ekyoshongoro eki
en: And David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son:

rr: (kandi yaaragiira kukyegyesa Abayuda; reeba kihandiikirwe omu kitabo kya Yashari.) naagira ati
en: (Also he bade them teach the children of Judah the use of the bow: behold, it is written in the book of Jasher.)

rr: Ai bambe Israeli, ekitiinisa kyawe kiitiirwe aha bibungo byawe. Amamanzi ka gagwire!
en: The beauty of Israel is slain upon thy high places: How are the mighty fallen!

rr: Mutakigamba omuri Gaasi; Mutakibuzya omu mihanda ya Ashikelooni, Abaishiki b'Abafilistia bakeesima, N'abaishiki b'abatashazirwe bakeehimbisa.
en: Tell it not in Gath, Publish it not in the streets of Askelon; Lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice, Lest the daughters of the uncircumcised triumph.

rr: Imwe ebibungo bya Giliboa, Mutatondwaho orume, mukaguubwaho enjura, N'obu kwakuba okugira emisiri y'empongano! Ahakuba okwo niyo engabo y'emanzi enagirwe kubi, Engabo ya Saulo, nk'otarashukirweho majuta.
en: Ye mountains of Gilboa, Let there be no dew, neither let there be rain, upon you, nor fields of offerings: For there the shield of the mighty is vilely cast away, The shield of Saul, as though he had not been anointed with oil.

rr: Obuta bwa Yonasaani bukaba butagaruka nyima Kuruga aha shagama y'abaitsirwe, n'aha mamanzi ebikaaka; Kandi rurara ya Saulo ekaba etagaruka busha.
en: From the blood of the slain, from the fat of the mighty, The bow of Jonathan turned not back, And the sword of Saul returned not empty.

rr: Saulo na Yonasaani bakaba bari barungi kandi abarikukundwa bakiriho, N'omu kufa kwabo tibataanisiibwe. Bakaba barahuka okukira empungu, Kandi baine amaani okukira entare.
en: Saul and Jonathan were lovely and pleasant in their lives, And in their death they were not divided: They were swifter than eagles, They were stronger than lions.

rr: Imwe abaishiki ba Israeli mucurire Saulo, Owaabaire abajweka emyenda ya karari erikunekaneka, Akahunda emyenda yaanyu ezaabu.
en: Ye daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, Who clothed you in scarlet, with other delights, Who put on ornaments of gold upon your apparel.

rr: Amamanzi ka gagwire Ahagati y'orugamba! Yonasaani aitiirwe aha bibungo byawe.
en: How are the mighty fallen in the midst of the battle! O Jonathan, thou wast slain in thine high places.

rr: Ninshaasha munonga ahabwawe, mwene waitu Yonasaani; Okaba onshemeza munonga. Okukunda kwawe ahariinye kukaba kuri okw'okutangaaza, Okukira okukunda kw'abakazi.
en: I am distressed for thee, my brother Jonathan: Very pleasant hast thou been unto me: Thy love to me was wonderful, Passing the love of women.

rr: Amamanzi ka gagwire, N'eby'okurwanisa ka bicwekyereire!
en: How are the mighty fallen, And the weapons of war perished!

rr: Bwanyima y'ebyo Daudi yaayehanuuza ahari MUKAMA naagira ati; Nyinamukye omu rurembo rumwe aha ndembo za Yuda?
en: And it came to pass after this, that David enquired of the LORD , saying, Shall I go up into any of the cities of Judah?

rr: MUKAMA yaamugira ati: Inamuka.
en: And the LORD said unto him, Go up.

rr: Daudi yaamubuuza ati: Nyinamukye omuri ruuha?
en: And David said, Whither shall I go up?

rr: Yaamugarukamu ati: Omuri Heburooni.
en: And he said, Unto Hebron.

rr: Atyo Daudi yainamukayo n'abakazi be bombi, Ahinoamu owa Yezereeli, na Abigaili owaabaire ari muka Nabali owa Karumeeli.
en: So David went up thither, and his two wives also, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail Nabal's wife the Carmelite.

rr: Kandi Daudi yainamuka n'abantu abu yaabaire aine, buri muntu n'ab'omu ka ye; baatuura omu ndembo za Heburooni.
en: And his men that were with him did David bring up, every man with his household: and they dwelt in the cities of Hebron.

rr: Abayuda baija, baashukiraho okwo Daudi amajuta kuba omugabe w'enju ya Yuda.
en: And the men of Judah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah.

rr: Bwanyima baagambira Daudi ngu, Aba Yabeshi-gileadi nibo baziikire Saulo.
en: And they told David, saying, That the men of Jabesh-gilead were they that buried Saul.

rr: Daudi nikwo kubatumaho entumwa naabagira ati: MUKAMA abahe omugisha, ahabw'okuba mugiriire mukama waanyu Saulo embabazi, mwamuziika.
en: And David sent messengers unto the men of Jabesh-gilead, and said unto them, Blessed be ye of the LORD , that ye have shewed this kindness unto your lord, even unto Saul, and have buried him.

rr: Mbwenu MUKAMA abagirire embabazi, kandi abakorere eby'obwesigwa; naanye ndabazimuurira ahabw'eby'embabazi ebyo ebi mukozire.
en: And now the LORD shew kindness and truth unto you: and I also will requite you this kindness, because ye have done this thing.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo emikono yaanyu egire amaani, mube amamanzi; ahakuba Saulo mukama waanyu afiire, kandi ab'enju ya Yuda banshukireho amajuta kuba omugabe waabo.
en: Therefore now let your hands be strengthened, and be ye valiant: for your master Saul is dead, and also the house of Judah have anointed me king over them.

rr: Abagaragwa ba Saulo okurwana n'aba Daudi
en: The End of Saul's House

rr: Omu bunaku obwo Abuneeri mwene Neeri, omukuru w'engabo za Saulo, akaba atwaire Isheboshesi, mwene Saulo, amwambukize Mahanaimu
en: But Abner the son of Ner, captain of Saul's host, took Ish-bosheth the son of Saul, and brought him over to Mahanaim;

rr: amwemekire kuba omugabe wa Gileadi na Ashura na Yezereeli na Efuraimu na Benyamiini na Israeli yoona.
en: and made him king over Gilead, and over the Ashurites, and over Jezreel, and over Ephraim, and over Benjamin, and over all Israel.

rr: Kandi Isheboshesi mwene Saulo akaba ahikize emyaka makumi ana obu yaaza aha ngoma kutegyeka Israeli, yaamara aha ngoma emyaka ebiri.
en: Ish-bosheth Saul's son was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel, and reigned two years.

rr: Kwonka enju ya Yuda yaakurata Daudi.
en: But the house of Judah followed David.

rr: Omwanya ogu Daudi yaamazire Heburooni ari aha ngoma naategyeka enju ya Yuda gukahika emyaka mushanju n'ameezi mukaaga.
en: And the time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.

rr: Bwanyima Abuneeri mwene Neeri, n'abagaragwa ba Isheboshesi mwene Saulo, baaruga Mahanaimu, baaza Gibeoni.
en: And Abner the son of Ner, and the servants of Ish-bosheth the son of Saul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.

rr: Na Yoabu mwene Zeruiya n'abagaragwa ba Daudi baashohora, baabugabugana nabo aha kiyanja kya Gibeoni; abamwe baashutama seeri yaacyo, abandi seenu.
en: And Joab the son of Zeruiah, and the servants of David, went out, and met together by the pool of Gibeon: and they sat down, the one on the one side of the pool, and the other on the other side of the pool.

rr: Abuneeri yaagira Yoabu ati: Abatsigazi baimukye, batuzaanire. Yoabu yaamugarukamu ati: Nibaimukye.
en: And Abner said to Joab, Let the young men now arise, and play before us. And Joab said, Let them arise.

rr: Batyo baimuka, baayambuka, baababara; ab'orubaju rwa Benyamiini na Isheboshesi mwene Saulo baaba ikumi na babiri, kandi ab'orubaju rwa Daudi nabo baaba ikumi na babiri.
en: Then there arose and went over by number twelve of Benjamin, which pertained to Ish-bosheth the son of Saul, and twelve of the servants of David.

rr: Buri omwe yaagwa omuzigu we omu maraka, yaamutimbura rurara omu rubaju; boona baagwera kyarimwe, baafa. Nikyo omwanya ogwo gwayeteirwe Helukasi-hazurimu, oguri haihi na Gibeoni.
en: And they caught every one his fellow by the head, and thrust his sword in his fellow's side; so they fell down together: wherefore that place was called Helkath-hazzurim, which is in Gibeon.

rr: Eryo izooba orugamba rwaba orw'amaani munonga; Abuneeri n'abashaija ba Israeli baasingurwa abagaragwa ba Daudi.
en: And there was a very sore battle that day; and Abner was beaten, and the men of Israel, before the servants of David.

rr: Kandi batabani ba Zeruiya bonshatu, Yoabu, Abishai na Asaheeli, bakaba bariyo; kandi Asaheeli ogwo akaba atarikwiruka, akaba ari esirabo.
en: And there were three sons of Zeruiah there, Joab, and Abishai, and Asahel: and Asahel was as light of foot as a wild roe.

rr: Bwanyima Asaheeli yaakurata Abuneeri amubingire; kandi omu kumubinga tiyaareeba ha rubaju rwa buryo nari orwa bumosho kuteishuka Abuneeri.
en: And Asahel pursued after Abner; and in going he turned not to the right hand nor to the left from following Abner.

rr: Abuneeri ku yaareebire enyima, yaagira ati: Biri niiwe, Asaheeli? Onu ati: Niinye.
en: Then Abner looked behind him, and said, Art thou Asahel? And he answered, I am .

rr: Abuneeri yaamugira ati: Kikaama, otoore aha rubaju rwawe rwa buryo nari orwa bumosho, okwate omwe aha batsigazi, obe niwe waanyaga eby'okurwanisa.
en: And Abner said to him, Turn thee aside to thy right hand or to thy left, and lay thee hold on one of the young men, and take thee his armour.

rr: Kwonka Asaheeli yaayanga kumurugaho.
en: But Asahel would not turn aside from following of him.

rr: Abuneeri yaagaruka yaagira Asaheeri ati: Toora ahandi orekye kunkurata; mbwenu ku naakucumita, naakutuura aha, okaazira ki? Kandi nkaareebana nta na Yoabu mwene sho?
en: And Abner said again to Asahel, Turn thee aside from following me: wherefore should I smite thee to the ground? how then should I hold up my face to Joab thy brother?

rr: Nabwo hoona yaayanga kumurugaho; nikyo Abuneeri yaamuteereire omuhunda gw'eicumu rye aha nda, gukamwogamu, akeetuura ahansi, akagwaho; kandi abantu boona ku baabaire bahika ahu Asaheeli yaabaire agwire, beemereraho.
en: Howbeit he refused to turn aside: wherefore Abner with the hinder end of the spear smote him under the fifth rib , that the spear came out behind him; and he fell down there, and died in the same place: and it came to pass, that as many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still.

rr: Kwonka Yoabu na Abishai baagyenda, babingire Abuneeri; eizooba ku ryabaire nirirengarenga, baahika aha kibungo Amma ekishungaine na Giya omu muhanda ogurikuza omu ihamba rya Gibeoni.
en: Joab also and Abishai pursued after Abner: and the sun went down when they were come to the hill of Ammah, that lieth before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon.

rr: Ababenyamiini baayeteeranira ahari Abuneeri, baaba omutwe gumwe, baayemerera aha mutwe gw'ekibungo.
en: And the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after Abner, and became one troop, and stood on the top of an hill.

rr: Bwanyima Abuneeri yaayeta Yoabu, yaamubuuza ati: Rurara eryaguma neerya busha obutoosha? Torikumanya omuheru gw'ekyo ku guriba okushaarira? Mbwenu oryahitsya hi okutaragiira bantu baawe kureka kukuratirira beene waabo?
en: Then Abner called to Joab, and said, Shall the sword devour for ever? knowest thou not that it will be bitterness in the latter end? how long shall it be then, ere thou bid the people return from following their brethren?

rr: Yoabu yaamugarukamu ati: Nindahira Ruhanga otahwaho, kuri noogira ngu tiwaagamba ekyo kigambo, buzimazima abantu baaba nibaija kuseesa ekiro, buri muntu akuratiriire mwene ishe.
en: And Joab said, As God liveth, unless thou hadst spoken, surely then in the morning the people had gone up every one from following his brother.

rr: Atyo Yoabu yaateera enzamba, abantu boona baayemerera, tibaagumizamu kukuratirira Abaisraeli, n'obu kwakuba okubarwanisa obundi.
en: So Joab blew a trumpet, and all the people stood still, and pursued after Israel no more, neither fought they any more.

rr: Abuneeri n'engabo ze baagyenda ekiro kyona, baaraba omuri Araba, baayambuka Yorudani, baahika Mahanaimu.
en: And Abner and his men walked all that night through the plain, and passed over Jordan, and went through all Bithron, and they came to Mahanaim.

rr: Yoabu yaatabaaruka, yaareka kukuratirira Abuneeri; ku yaaherize kuteeranira abantu boona hamwe, yaashanga omu bagaragwa ba Daudi nihaburamu abantu ikumi na mwenda, otabariiremu Asaheeli.
en: And Joab returned from following Abner: and when he had gathered all the people together, there lacked of David's servants nineteen men and Asahel.

rr: Kwonka abagaragwa ba Daudi bakaba baitsire omu Babenyamiini engabo za Abuneeri magana ashatu na makumi mukaaga.
en: But the servants of David had smitten of Benjamin, and of Abner's men, so that three hundred and threescore men died.

rr: Bwanyima baatwara Asaheeli, baamuziika Betelehemu omu kituuro kya ishe.
en: And they took up Asahel, and buried him in the sepulchre of his father, which was in Beth-lehem.

rr: Kandi Yoabu, n'engabo ze baaraara nibagyenda, bwasheesha baahika Heburooni.
en: And Joab and his men went all night, and they came to Hebron at break of day.
