rr: Bwanyima haabaho obweme buhango ahagati y'enju ya Saulo n'eya Daudi; kwonka Daudi yaaguma naayeyongyera amaani, enju ya Daulo yo yaagyenda neehwa amaani.
en: Now there was long war between the house of Saul and the house of David: but David waxed stronger and stronger, and the house of Saul waxed weaker and weaker.

rr: Kandi Daudi yaazaarira Heburooni abaana b'aboojo; ow'omujigaijo akaba ari Amunooni, ou yaazaire ahari Ahinoamu owa Yezereeli
en: And unto David were sons born in Hebron: and his firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;

rr: owa kabiri Kileaba owa Abigaili, owaabaire ari muka Nabali owa Karumeeli; owa kashatu Abusalomu ou yaazaire ahari Maaka omuhara wa Talumai, omugabe wa Geshuri
en: and his second, Chileab, of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;

rr: 1 owa kana Adoniya mutabani wa Hagisi; owa kataano Shefatia mutabani wa Abitaali
en: and the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; and the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;

rr: kandi owa mukaaga akaba ari Itereamu owa Egula muka Daudi. Abo boona nibo Daudi yaazaariire Heburooni. Abuneeri okwangana na Isheboshesi
en: and the sixth, Ithream, by Eglah David's wife. These were born to David in Hebron.

rr: Obweme ku bwabaire bukiri ahagati y'enju ya Saulo n'eya Daudi, Abuneeri yaayehindura ow'amaani omu nju ya Saulo.
en: And it came to pass, while there was war between the house of Saul and the house of David, that Abner made himself strong for the house of Saul.

rr: Omu bunaku obwo hakaba hariho omukazi orikwetwa Rizipa, muhara wa Ayiya, owaabaire ari omukazi wa Saulo w'ekinyanshunju. Eizooba rimwe Isheboshesi yaagira Abuneeri ati: Ahabw'enki otembire ekitabo kya muka tata?
en: And Saul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah: and Ish-bosheth said to Abner, Wherefore hast thou gone in unto my father's concubine?

rr: Okuruga aho Abuneeri yaagira ekiniga ahabw'ebigambo ebi Isheboshesi yaamugambira, yaamugarukamu ati: Beitu shi onyetsire omutwe gw'embwa y'Abayuda? Okuhitsya hati ninkiha enju ya sho Saulo ekitiinisa, na beene ishe na bagyenzi be, kandi tinkakuhayoga mu mikono ya Daudi; haza eri izooba oza kuntaho ekibi ky'okuraara n'ogwo mukazi?
en: Then was Abner very wroth for the words of Ish-bosheth, and said, Am I a dog's head, which against Judah do shew kindness this day unto the house of Saul thy father, to his brethren, and to his friends, and have not delivered thee into the hand of David, that thou chargest me to day with a fault concerning this woman?

rr: Nyowe Abuneeri, ku ndaabe ntakoreire Daudi nk'oku MUKAMA yaamurahiire
en: So do God to Abner, and more also, except, as the LORD hath sworn to David, even so I do to him;

rr: nkaiha obugabe aha nju ya Saulo, nkata Daudi aha kitebe ky'obugabe, akategyeka Israeli na Yuda, okuruga Daani okuhika Beeri-sheba, Ruhanga akinture n'okukiraho.
en: to translate the kingdom from the house of Saul, and to set up the throne of David over Israel and over Judah, from Dan even to Beer-sheba.

rr: Isheboshesi tiyaabaasa kugarukamu Abuneeri kigambo kyona, ahabw'okumutiina.
en: And he could not answer Abner a word again, because he feared him. David, Abner, and Joab

rr: Bwanyima Abuneeri yaatuma entumwa ahari Daudi, ari Heburooni, naagira ati: Mukama w'ensi egi n'oha? Ragaana naanye endagaano, nkwatanise naiwe, nkukubuurire Israeli yoona.
en: And Abner sent messengers to David on his behalf, saying, Whose is the land? saying also , Make thy league with me, and, behold, my hand shall be with thee, to bring about all Israel unto thee.

rr: Daudi yaamugarukamu ati: Ni kirungi; niinyija kuragaana naiwe endagaano; kwonka eki ndikwenda ahariiwe ni kimwe. Omanye ku otarincwa ryera, kureka biri waabanza kundeetera Mikaali muhara wa Saulo, oizire kundeeba.
en: And he said, Well; I will make a league with thee: but one thing I require of thee, that is, Thou shalt not see my face, except thou first bring Michal Saul's daughter, when thou comest to see my face.

rr: Bwanyima Daudi yaatuma entumwa ahari Isheboshesi mwene Saulo, naagira ati: Mpa omukazi wangye Mikaali, ou naajugire ebishushu igana by'Abafilistia.
en: And David sent messengers to Ish-bosheth Saul's son, saying, Deliver me my wife Michal, which I espoused to me for an hundred foreskins of the Philistines.

rr: Isheboshesi nikwo kumutuma, akamwaka iba Palutieli, mwene Laishi.
en: And Ish-bosheth sent, and took her from her husband, even from Phaltiel the son of Laish.

rr: Kwonka iba yaagyenda naarira omuhanda gwona, amukuratiire, okuhitsya obu baahikire Bahurimu. Abuneeri yaamugira ati: Garukayo. Onu yaagarukayo. Yoabu okuhoorera Asaheeli
en: And her husband went with her along weeping behind her to Bahurim. Then said Abner unto him, Go, return. And he returned.

rr: Bwanyima Abuneeri yaagira enaama n'abakuru ba Israeli, naagira ati: Obunaku obwahingwire, mukaba nimwenda Daudi ngu abe omugabe waanyu.
en: And Abner had communication with the elders of Israel, saying, Ye sought for David in times past to be king over you:

rr: Mbwenu mukikore; ahakuba MUKAMA akaraganisa Daudi naagira ati: Omukono gw'omugaragwa wangye Daudi nigwo ndijunisa abantu bangye Israeli okuruga omu mikono y'Abafilistia, n'okuruga omu mikono y'abazigu baabo boona.
en: now then do it: for the LORD hath spoken of David, saying, By the hand of my servant David I will save my people Israel out of the hand of the Philistines, and out of the hand of all their enemies.

rr: Abuneeri yaagaruka yaabigambira Ababenyamiini; kandi yaaza Heburooni kugambira Daudi byona ebi Israeli n'ab'enju ya Benyamiini yoona basiimire kukora.
en: And Abner also spake in the ears of Benjamin: and Abner went also to speak in the ears of David in Hebron all that seemed good to Israel, and that seemed good to the whole house of Benjamin.

rr: Atyo Abuneeri n'abashaija makumi abiri baashanga Daudi Heburooni. Daudi yaateekyera Abuneeri obugyenyi n'abashaija abu yaabaire aine.
en: So Abner came to David to Hebron, and twenty men with him. And David made Abner and the men that were with him a feast.

rr: Abuneeri yaagira Daudi ati: Niinyija kwimuka, nteeranire Abaisraeli boona ahari mukama wangye omu gabe, baragaane naiwe endagaano, obone kutegyeka abu omutima gwawe gurikwenda boona.
en: And Abner said unto David, I will arise and go, and will gather all Israel unto my lord the king, that they may make a league with thee, and that thou mayest reign over all that thine heart desireth.

rr: Atyo Daudi yaayohereza Abuneeri; yaagyenda n'obusingye.
en: And David sent Abner away; and he went in peace.

rr: Ago maguru abagaragwa ba Daudi na Yoabu, abaabaire bahurwire, baatabaaruka n'eminyago mingi; kwonka baashanga Abuneeri atakiri na Daudi, ahakuba akaba yaamwohereize, yayengyendeire n'obusingye.
en: And, behold, the servants of David and Joab came from pursuing a troop, and brought in a great spoil with them: but Abner was not with David in Hebron; for he had sent him away, and he was gone in peace.

rr: Yoabu ku yaahikire aho, naatabaaruka n'engabo ze zoona ezi yaabaire aine, baamugira bati: Abuneeri mwene Neeri aizire ow'omugabe; yaamwohereza, yaagyenda n'obusingye.
en: When Joab and all the host that was with him were come, they told Joab, saying, Abner the son of Ner came to the king, and he hath sent him away, and he is gone in peace.

rr: Atyo Yoabu yaaza ow'omugabe, yaamubuuza ati: Eki okozire ki? Abuneeri mwene okwija owaawe, okamureka akagyenda?
en: Then Joab came to the king, and said, What hast thou done? behold, Abner came unto thee; why is it that thou hast sent him away, and he is quite gone?

rr: Omanyire kimwe Abuneeri mwene Neeri ku aizire kukubeihabeiha, n'okukutata ngu amanye oku ohurura n'oku otabaaruka, n'okwetegyereza ebi orikukora byona.
en: Thou knowest Abner the son of Ner, that he came to deceive thee, and to know thy going out and thy coming in, and to know all that thou doest.

rr: Yoabu ku yaarugire owa Daudi kutabaara, yaatuma entumwa, zaakurata Abuneeri, zaamugarurira aha iziba rya Siira; kwonka Daudi atarikukimanya.
en: And when Joab was come out from David, he sent messengers after Abner, which brought him again from the well of Sirah: but David knew it not.

rr: Abuneeri ku yaagarukire Heburooni, Yoabu yaamutwara hangahari omu irembo ahagati, ngu agambe nawe omu mubonano; ku baahikireho, yaamuteera aha nda, yaamugwisaho naamuhoorera eshagama y'omurumuna Asaheeli.
en: And when Abner was returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside in the gate to speak with him quietly, and smote him there under the fifth rib , that he died, for the blood of Asahel his brother.

rr: Daudi ku yaakihuriire, yaagira ati: Nyowe n'engoma yangye titurigiibwaho rubanja rw'eshagama ya Abuneeri mwene Neeri omu maisho ga Ruhanga okuhitsya ebiro byona.
en: And afterward when David heard it , he said, I and my kingdom are guiltless before the LORD for ever from the blood of Abner the son of Ner:

rr: Kureka ruryaguma ahari Yoabu n'aha ka ya ishe; kandi eka ye teribura kubamu orikurugwamu amahira, nari omubembe, nari okugyendera aha kibango, nari ow'okwitwa rurara, nari omukuuhuzi.
en: let it rest on the head of Joab, and on all his father's house; and let there not fail from the house of Joab one that hath an issue, or that is a leper, or that leaneth on a staff, or that falleth on the sword, or that lacketh bread.

rr: Okwo nikwo Yoabu na Abishai baitsire Abuneeri, nibamuhoorera murumuna waabu ou yaitiire omu rugamba rwa Gibeoni. Daudi okuririra Abuneeri
en: So Joab and Abishai his brother slew Abner, because he had slain their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle.

rr: Bwanyima Daudi yaagambira Yoabu n'abantu boona abu yaabaire aine ati: Mutaagurre ebijwaro byanyu, mwezirikye ebiguniya, mucurire Abuneeri.
en: And David said to Joab, and to all the people that were with him, Rend your clothes, and gird you with sackcloth, and mourn before Abner.

rr: Kandi omugabe Daudi yaagyenda akuratiire akatanda.
en: And king David himself followed the bier.

rr: Baaziika Abuneeri Heburooni; omugabe yaimutsya eiraka rye, yaacurira aha kituuro kya Abuneeri; n'abantu boona baacura.
en: And they buried Abner in Hebron: and the king lifted up his voice, and wept at the grave of Abner; and all the people wept.

rr: Omugabe yaacurira Abuneeri, naagira ati: Abuneeri akaafiire nk'omushema?
en: And the king lamented over Abner, and said, Died Abner as a fool dieth?

rr: Emikono yaawe tebohirwe N'ebigyere byawe tibikomirwe na byoma; Nk'omuntu oku agwa omu maisho g'ababi, Naiwe nikwo ofiire.
en: Thy hands were not bound, nor thy feet put into fetters: As a man falleth before wicked men, so fellest thou.

rr: N'abantu boona baagaruka baamucurira.
en: And all the people wept again over him.

rr: Bwanyima abantu boona baija kweshengyereza Daudi kurya ak'okurya bukiri kare; kwonka yaarahira naagira ati: Ku ndaarye aha mugaati nari ekindi kyona, izooba ritakarengire, Ruhanga akinture n'okukiraho.
en: And when all the people came to cause David to eat meat while it was yet day, David sware, saying, So do God to me, and more also, if I taste bread, or ought else, till the sun be down.

rr: Abantu boona baakyetegyereza, kyabashemeza; kandi ebi omugabe yaabaire akora byona bikaba bishemeza abantu boona.
en: And all the people took notice of it , and it pleased them: as whatsoever the king did pleased all the people.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo aha izooba eryo abantu boona n'Abaisraeli boona baamanya ku kitarugire ha mugabe kwita Abuneeri mwene Neeri.
en: For all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to slay Abner the son of Ner.

rr: Omugabe yaagira abagaragwa be ati: Ebyo nimumanya hati omuri Israeli ku hafiiremu omunyiginya, kandi obaire ari omushaija rugambwa?
en: And the king said unto his servants, Know ye not that there is a prince and a great man fallen this day in Israel?

rr: Kandi nyowe, n'obu ndaabe ndi omugabe oshukirweho amajuta, kwonka ndi busha; n'abashaija aba, batabani ba Zeruiya, bagumire, tindikubabaasa. MUKAMA azimuurire enkozi y'ebibi nk'obubi bwayo oku buri. Currently Selected: 2 Samueli 3 : RR64 Highlight Share <div
en: And I am this day weak, though anointed king; and these men the sons of Zeruiah be too hard for me: the LORD shall reward the doer of evil according to his wickedness. rr: Bwanyima Isheboshesi mwene Saulo ku yaahurire ngu Abuneeri agwire Heburooni, emikono ye yaahwa amaani, n'Abaisraeli boona baashoberwa.
en: And when Saul's son heard that Abner was dead in Hebron, his hands were feeble, and all the Israelites were troubled.

rr: Kandi Isheboshesi ogwo mutabani wa Saulo akaba aine abakuru b'engabo ze babiri; omwe akaba naayetwa Baana, n'ondiijo ari Rekabu, beene Rimona owa Beeroosi, ow'omu ruganda rwa Benyamiini; (ahakuba Beeroosi ekaba neebarirwa ahari Benyamiini
en: And Saul's son had two men that were captains of bands: the name of the one was Baanah, and the name of the other Rechab, the sons of Rimmon a Beerothite, of the children of Benjamin: (for Beeroth also was reckoned to Benjamin:

rr: kandi aba Beeroosi bakahungira Gitaimu, baashuhuukirayo n'okuhitsya hati).
en: and the Beerothites fled to Gittaim, and were sojourners there until this day.)

rr: Kandi Yonasaani mwene Saulo akaba aine omwana oremaire ebigyere. Obu omubiki yaaruga Yezereeli kubika Saulo na Yonasaani, ogwo mwana akaba ahikize emyaka etaano. Omurezi we yaamubakura, yaahunga; ku yaabaire nairuka nawe naahunga, yaamusyoka omu mikono, yaagwa ahansi, yaaremara. Eiziina ry'ogwo mwana akaba naayetwa Mefiboshesi. Okufa kwa Isheboshesi
en: And Jonathan, Saul's son, had a son that was lame of his feet. He was five years old when the tidings came of Saul and Jonathan out of Jezreel, and his nurse took him up, and fled: and it came to pass, as she made haste to flee, that he fell, and became lame. And his name was Mephibosheth.

rr: Eizooba rimwe beene Rimona owa Beeroosi, Rekabu na Baana bakaija, baahika owa Isheboshesi omu ihangwe, baashanga abyami ahuumwireho
en: And the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, Rechab and Baanah, went, and came about the heat of the day to the house of Ish-bosheth, who lay on a bed at noon.

rr: kandi omurinzi w'enju owaabaire naashemeza engano, baashanga yaakwatwa oturo, yaagwejegyera. N'ahabw'ekyo Rekabu na Baana omurumuna baataahamu.
en: And they came thither into the midst of the house, as though they would have fetched wheat; and they smote him under the fifth rib: and Rechab and Baanah his brother escaped.

rr: Ku baahikire omu nju, baashanga Isheboshesi abyami aha kitanda kye omu kishengye ky'okuraaramu, baamucumita, baamwita, baamutemaho omutwe. Baagutwara, baagyenda ekiro kyona nibatoora omuhanda ogw'omuri Araba.
en: For when they came into the house, he lay on his bed in his bedchamber, and they smote him, and slew him, and beheaded him, and took his head, and gat them away through the plain all night.

rr: Ogwo mutwe gwa Isheboshesi baagutwarira Daudi Heburooni, baagira omugabe bati: Ngugu omutwe gwa Isheboshesi mwene Saulo omuzigu waawe, owaabaire akuhiiga kukwita. Eri izooba MUKAMA yaahoorera mukama waitu omugabe Saulo n'oruzaaro rwe.
en: And they brought the head of Ish-bosheth unto David to Hebron, and said to the king, Behold the head of Ish-bosheth the son of Saul thine enemy, which sought thy life; and the LORD hath avenged my lord the king this day of Saul, and of his seed.

rr: Daudi yaagarukamu, naagira Rekabu na Baana omurumuna beene Rimona owa Beeroosi, ati: Nindahira MUKAMA otahwaho, owaakirize amagara gangye omu kabi koona
en: And David answered Rechab and Baanah his brother, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, and said unto them, As the LORD liveth, who hath redeemed my soul out of all adversity,

rr: obu omuntu yaija, akangira ati: Reeba, Saulo afiire; akaba naagira ngu andeeteire enkuru nungu; ahonaaho naamukwata, naamwita Zikulaagi; ebyo nibyo bihembo ebi naamuhaire ahabw'enkuru ze.
en: when one told me, saying, Behold, Saul is dead, thinking to have brought good tidings, I took hold of him, and slew him in Ziklag, who thought that I would have given him a reward for his tidings:

rr: Mbwenu shi, nk'abantu babi abaitira ohikiriire omu nju ye abyami aha kitanda, nimugira ngu tindikwija kubahoorera eshagama ye, nkabacwekyereza, nkabaiha omu nsi, okukira ogwo?
en: how much more, when wicked men have slain a righteous person in his own house upon his bed? shall I not therefore now require his blood of your hand, and take you away from the earth?

rr: Bwanyima Daudi yaaragiira abatsigazi be, baabaita, baabatemaho engaro n'ebigyere, baabahanika aha rubaju rw'eiziba rya Heburooni.
en: And David commanded his young men, and they slew them, and cut off their hands and their feet, and hanged them up over the pool in Hebron.

rr: Kandi omutwe gwa Isheboshesi baagutwara, baaguziika omu kituuro kya Abuneeri Heburooni.
en: But they took the head of Ish-bosheth, and buried it in the sepulchre of Abner in Hebron.

rr: Bwanyima enganda zoona eza Israeli zaashanga Daudi Heburooni; zaamugira ziti: Reeba, turi abaanyu ab'aha mara.
en: Then came all the tribes of Israel to David unto Hebron, and spake, saying, Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh.

rr: Omu biro ebyahingwire, obu Saulo yaabaire ari omugabe waitu, niiwe waabaire oyebembera Abaisraeli nibahurura kandi nibatabaaruka; kandi MUKAMA akakugira ati: Niiwe oririisa abantu bangye Israeli, kandi niiwe oriba omugabe waabo.
en: Also in time past, when Saul was king over us, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the LORD said to thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be a captain over Israel.

rr: Batyo abakuru ba Israeli boona baashanga omugabe Daudi Heburooni; kandi okwo niyo yaaraganiire nabo endagaano omu maisho ga MUKAMA, bakamushukaho amajuta kuba omugabe wa Israeli.
en: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and king David made a league with them in Hebron before the LORD : and they anointed David king over Israel.

rr: Kandi Daudi, obu yaaza aha ngoma, akaba ahikize emyaka makumi ashatu, yaamara emyaka makumi ana ari aha ngoma.
en: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.

rr: Omuri Heburooni akamaramu emyaka mushanju n'ameezi mukaaga naategyeka Yuda; kandi omuri Yerusaalemu yaamaramu emyaka makumi ashatu n'eshatu, naategyeka Israeli yoona na Yuda.
en: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years over all Israel and Judah.

rr: Daudi okukubuura Yerusaalemu
en: Capture of Jerusalem

rr: Bwanyima omugabe yaimuka n'engabo ze, baaza Yerusaalemu, baarwanisa aba Yebusi, abatuuzi b'omuri egyo nsi, abaagizire Daudi bati: Ku oriba otamazireho mpumi n'ebirema, torihika aha; ahabw'okuba bakaba niba teekateeka ngu Daudi tarikubaasa kuhikayo.
en: And the king and his men went to Jerusalem unto the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land: which spake unto David, saying, Except thou take away the blind and the lame, thou shalt not come in hither: thinking, David cannot come in hither.

rr: N'obu kiraabe kyabaire kityo, Daudi akakwata ekigo kya Saayuuni, nirwo rurembo rwa Daudi.
en: Nevertheless David took the strong hold of Zion: the same is the city of David.

rr: Kandi ahari eryo izooba Daudi akaba agizire ati: Orikwenda kuteera aba Yebusi, atembe ahu amaizi garikwerekyerera, abone kwita biri birema n'empumi, ebi Daudi arikwanga.
en: And David said on that day, Whosoever getteth up to the gutter, and smiteth the Jebusites, and the lame and the blind, that are hated of David's soul, he shall be chief and captain .

rr: Nikyo bagirira bati: Empumi n'ebirema bitaritaaha omu nju.
en: Wherefore they said, The blind and the lame shall not come into the house.

rr: Atyo Daudi yaatuura omuri ekyo kigo, yaakyeta orurembo rwa Daudi. Yaakyombekaho amaju okukyehinguririza, okuruga Miilo n'okugaruka omunda.
en: So David dwelt in the fort, and called it the city of David. And David built round about from Millo and inward.

rr: Daudi yaaguma naayeyongyera kugira ekitiinisa; ahakuba MUKAMA Ruhanga ow'amahe akaba ari hamwe nawe.
en: And David went on, and grew great, and the LORD God of hosts was with him.

rr: Bwanyima Hiraamu omugabe wa Tuuro yaayohereza entumwa ahari Daudi n'ebiti by'emyereezi, n'ababaizi n'abarikwombekyesa amabaare; baayombekyera Daudi enju.
en: And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar trees, and carpenters, and masons: and they built David an house.

rr: Daudi yaamanyira aho ku MUKAMA amuhamize kuba omugabe wa Israeli, kandi ku aimukize obugabe bwe ahabw'abantu be Israeli.
en: And David perceived that the LORD had established him king over Israel, and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel's sake.

rr: Daudi ku yaarugire Heburooni, yaahika Yerusaalemu, yaashwererayo ebindi binyanshunju n'abandi bakazi; kandi baamuzaarira abandi baana b'aboojo n'ab'abaishiki.
en: And David took him more concubines and wives out of Jerusalem, after he was come from Hebron: and there were yet sons and daughters born to David.

rr: Aga nigo maziina g'abaana abu baamuzaariire ari Yerusaalemu– Shamua, Shobabu, Nasani, Sulemaani
en: And these be the names of those that were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shammua, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon,

rr: Ibuhaari, Elishua, Nefegi, Yafia
en: Ibhar also, and Elishua, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

rr: Elishaama, Eliada na Elifeleti. Daudi okugaruka kusingura Abafilistia
en: and Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphalet.

rr: Abafilistia ku baahuriire ngu Daudi ashukirweho amajuta kuba omugabe w'Abaisraeli, boona baimuka, baaza kusherura Daudi. Daudi ku yaabihuriire, yaashuuma, yaaza omu kigo.
en: But when the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel, all the Philistines came up to seek David; and David heard of it , and went down to the hold.

rr: Omu bunaku obwo Abafilistia bakaba baizire, bajanjaire oruhita rw'Abareefa rwona.
en: The Philistines also came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

rr: Daudi yaayehanuuza ahari MUKAMA naabuuza ati: Nyinamukye, ndwane n'Abafilistia? Noija kubahayo omu mikono yangye? MUKAMA yaagarukamu Daudi ati: Inamuka, ahakuba buzimazima niinyija kuhayo Abafilistia omu mikono yaawe.
en: And David enquired of the LORD , saying, Shall I go up to the Philistines? wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And the LORD said unto David, Go up: for I will doubtless deliver the Philistines into thine hand.

rr: Atyo Daudi yaaza Baali-peraziimu, yaabaitirayo. Bwanyima yaagira ati: MUKAMA ahigwire abazigu bangye omu maisho gangye, nk'oku amizi gahigura omucungiro. Nikyo yaayeteire ogwo mwanya Baali-peraziimu.
en: And David came to Baal-perazim, and David smote them there, and said, The LORD hath broken forth upon mine enemies before me, as the breach of waters. Therefore he called the name of that place Baal-perazim.

rr: Abafilistia baatsigayo ebishushani byabo ebirikuramibwa, Daudi n'abashaija be baabitwara.
en: And there they left their images, and David and his men burned them.

rr: Ku haahingwire ebiro, Abafilistia baagaruka bainamuka, baajanjaara oruhita rw'Abareefa.
en: And the Philistines came up yet again, and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

rr: Daudi ku yaayehanwize ahari MUKAMA, MUKAMA yaamugarukamu ati: Otainamukayo; kureka obakiikuukye, obareetwe enyima ahashungaine n'akabira k'emitugunda.
en: And when David enquired of the LORD , he said, Thou shalt not go up; but fetch a compass behind them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.

rr: Bwanyima ku oraahurire enshwagara aha mitwe y'emitugunda, ahonaaho oyehuute, ahabw'okuba obwo MUKAMA naaba akwebembeire kuteera engabo z'Abafilistia.
en: And let it be, when thou hearest the sound of a going in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then thou shalt bestir thyself: for then shall the LORD go out before thee, to smite the host of the Philistines.

rr: Daudi yaatwaza nk'oku MUKAMA yaamuragiira, yaagyenda naita Abafilistia okuruga Geeba, okuhika Gezeri.
en: And David did so, as the LORD had commanded him; and smote the Philistines from Geba until thou come to Gazer.

1 Daudi yaagaruka yaateerana engabo zoona ezitoorainwe omuri Israeli, abantu obukumi bushatu.
en: Again, David gathered together all the chosen men of Israel, thirty thousand.

rr: Yaimuka, yaagyenda n'ezo ngabo zoona ezi yaabaire aine, baaza Baale eya Yuda, kwihayo eshanduukye ya Ruhanga, erikwetererwa Eiziina rya MUKAMA ow'amahe, oshutama ahari baakerubi.
en: And David arose, and went with all the people that were with him from Baale of Judah, to bring up from thence the ark of God, whose name is called by the name of the LORD of hosts that dwelleth between the cherubims.

rr: Baatwarira eshanduukye ya Ruhanga aha kigaari kisya; baagiiha omu ka ya Abinadabu eyaabaire eri aha kibungo; kandi Uzaa na Ahio batabani ba Abinadabu nibo baabaire nibatwara ekyo kigaari kisya
en: And they set the ark of God upon a new cart, and brought it out of the house of Abinadab that was in Gibeah: and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, drave the new cart.

rr: ekyabaire kiriho eshanduukye ya Ruhanga, Ahio agyebembeire.
en: And they brought it out of the house of Abinadab which was at Gibeah, accompanying the ark of God: and Ahio went before the ark.

rr: Daudi n'ab'enju ya Israeli boona baagyenda nibashemererwa omu maisho ga MUKAMA, nibeeshongora n'amaani gaabo goona, nibateera endingiri, n'enanga n'engarabi n'amataari n'ebitaasa.
en: And David and all the house of Israel played before the LORD on all manner of instruments made of fir wood, even on harps, and on psalteries, and on timbrels, and on cornets, and on cymbals.

rr: Ku baahikire aha mbuga ya Nakoni, Uzza yaatayo omukono gwe, yaaramira eshanduukye ya Ruhanga, ahabw'okuba ente zikateera entsibo.
en: And when they came to Nachon's threshingfloor, Uzzah put forth his hand to the ark of God, and took hold of it; for the oxen shook it .

rr: MUKAMA yaagirira Uzaa ekiniga; Ruhanga yaamwitira aho, naamutura okuramira eshanduukye n'omukono gwe; yaafeera aho aha rubaju rw'eshanduukye ya Ruhanga.
en: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzzah; and God smote him there for his error; and there he died by the ark of God.

rr: Daudi yaaguubwa kubi ahabwa MUKAMA kugwa ahari Uzaa; omwanya ogwo yaagweta Pereezi-uzaa, n'okuhitsya hati.
en: And David was displeased, because the LORD had made a breach upon Uzzah: and he called the name of the place Perez-uzzah to this day.

rr: Eryo izooba Daudi yaatiina MUKAMA, yaagira ati: Mbwenu eshanduukye ya MUKAMA neebaasa eta kuza owangye?
en: And David was afraid of the LORD that day, and said, How shall the ark of the LORD come to me?

rr: N'ahabwe'ekyo Daudi yaayanga kwihayo eshanduukye ya MUKAMA kugitwara owe omu rurembo rwa Daudi; yaagikiikamya, yaagitaasya omu nju ya Obededomu owa Gaasi.
en: So David would not remove the ark of the LORD unto him into the city of David: but David carried it aside into the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.

rr: Eshanduukye ya MUKAMA yaamara ameezi ashatu omu nju ya Obededamu owa Gaasi; MUKAMA yaamuha omugisha n'ab'omu ka ye boona.
en: And the ark of the LORD continued in the house of Obed-edom the Gittite three months: and the LORD blessed Obed-edom, and all his household.

rr: 1 —16:3; Bwanyima baagambira omugabe Daudi bati: MUKAMA ahaire eka ya Obededamu omugisha n'ebi aine byona ahabw'eshanduukye ya Ruhanga.
en: And it was told king David, saying, The LORD hath blessed the house of Obed-edom, and all that pertaineth unto him, because of the ark of God.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo Daudi yaagyenda, yaiha eshanduukye ya Ruhanga omu nju ya Obededamu, yaagiinamura omu rurembo rwa Daudi n'okushemererwa.
en: So David went and brought up the ark of God from the house of Obed-edom into the city of David with gladness.

rr: Oku nikwo byatwaziibwe; abaheekire eshanduukye ya MUKAMA ku baagyenzireho entambwe mukaaga, Daudi yaatambiraho enimi y'ekimasha n'enyana y'ebishaju.
en: And it was so , that when they that bare the ark of the LORD had gone six paces, he sacrificed oxen and fatlings.

rr: Daudi yaayemurikira omu maisho ga MUKAMA n'amaani ge goona, ayezirikire efodi ya kitaani.
en: And David danced before the LORD with all his might; and David was girded with a linen ephod.

rr: Atyo Daudi n'ab'enju ya Israeli boona bainamura eshanduukye ya MUKAMA, nibateera akaari n'amakondere.
en: So David and all the house of Israel brought up the ark of the LORD with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet.

rr: Bwanyima eshanduukye ya MUKAMA ku yaabaire neetaaha omu rurembo rwa Daudi, Mikaali muhara wa Saulo yaaringuririza omu dirisa, yaareeba omugabe Daudi naayemurika kandi naazinira omu maisho ga MUKAMA, yamugayira aha mutima.
en: And as the ark of the LORD came into the city of David, Michal Saul's daughter looked through a window, and saw king David leaping and dancing before the LORD ; and she despised him in her heart.

rr: Baataasya eshanduukye ya MUKAMA, baagita omu mwanya gwayo omu ihema eri Daudi agiteereireho; Daudi yaatamba ebitambo by'okwotsya n'empongano z'okusiima ahabw'obusingye omu maisho ga MUKAMA.
en: And they brought in the ark of the LORD , and set it in his place, in the midst of the tabernacle that David had pitched for it: and David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD .

rr: Kandi ku yaaherize kutamba ebyo bitambo by'okwotsya n'ezo mpongano z'okusiima ahabw'obusingye, yaashabira abantu omugisha omu iziina rya MUKAMA ow'amahe
en: And as soon as David had made an end of offering burnt offerings and peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD of hosts.

rr: yaagaburira abantu boona, ab'eihanga ryona erya Israeli, abashaija n'abakazi, buri muntu omugaati, entongo y'enyama n'omwate gw'emizaabibu eyomire.
en: And he dealt among all the people, even among the whole multitude of Israel, as well to the women as men, to every one a cake of bread, and a good piece of flesh , and a flagon of wine .

rr: Okuruga aho abantu boona baarugayo, buri muntu yaataaha owe.
en: So all the people departed every one to his house.

rr: Bwanyima Daudi yaagarukayo kushabira ab'omu ka ye omugisha.
en: Then David returned to bless his household.

rr: Mikaali muhara wa Saulo yaashohora kubugana Daudi, yaagira ati: Eshi eri izooba omugabe wa Israeli yaagira ekitiinisa, obu yaaba naayejwekyera busha omu maisho g'abazaana b'abairu be, nk'omuntu otaine ku ari oku ayejweka busha ataine nshoni!
en: And Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David, and said, How glorious was the king of Israel to day, who uncovered himself to day in the eyes of the handmaids of his servants, as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovereth himself!

rr: Daudi yaagarukamu Mikaali ati: Ekyo naakikorera omu maisho ga MUKAMA owantooraine akanyeshumbya sho n'ab'omu ka ye boona, akangira omugabe w'abantu be Israeli; nikyo ndigumira niinyemurikira omu maisho ga MUKAMA.
en: And David said unto Michal, It was before the LORD , which chose me before thy father, and before all his house, to appoint me ruler over the people of the LORD , over Israel: therefore will I play before the LORD .

rr: Kandi niinyija kwongyera kwehindura orikugaywa okukira aho, n'okwegarura ahansi omu maisho gaawe; kwonka abo bazaana abu waagambaho, bo baryampa ekitiinisa.
en: And I will yet be more vile than thus, and will be base in mine own sight: and of the maidservants which thou hast spoken of, of them shall I be had in honour.

rr: Okuruga aho Mikaali muhara wa Saulo tiyaagira bu azaara okuhitsya aha izooba eri yaafeereireho.
en: Therefore Michal the daughter of Saul had no child unto the day of her death.

rr: 1 -27 ; Atyo omugabe yaaguma omu ka ye, kandi MUKAMA yaamuha okuhuumura abazibu be boona embaju zoona.
en: And it came to pass, when the king sat in his house, and the LORD had given him rest round about from all his enemies;

rr: Bwanyima omugabe yaagira nabi Nasani ati: Reeba hati, ndi omu nju y'emyereezi, kwonka eshanduukye ya Ruhanga eri omu ihema.
en: that the king said unto Nathan the prophet, See now, I dwell in an house of cedar, but the ark of God dwelleth within curtains.

rr: Nasani yaagira omugabe ati: Irooko okore ekikuri aha mutima kyona, ahakuba MUKAMA ari hamwe naiwe.
en: And Nathan said to the king, Go, do all that is in thine heart; for the LORD is with thee.

rr: Ekyo kiro ekigambo kya MUKAMA kyaizira Nasani nikigira kiti
en: And it came to pass that night, that the word of the LORD came unto Nathan, saying,

rr: Irooko ogambire omwiru wangye Daudi oti: MUKAMA naagira ati: Ebyo oryanyombekyera enju y'okutaahamu?
en: Go and tell my servant David, Thus saith the LORD , Shalt thou build me an house for me to dwell in?

rr: Noomanya ku ntakatuuragu mu nju, okwiha obu naiha Abaisraeli Misiri n'okuhitsya hati, kureka nkaba ngyendagyenda nintaaha omu ihema.
en: Whereas I have not dwelt in any house since the time that I brought up the children of Israel out of Egypt, even to this day, but have walked in a tent and in a tabernacle.

rr: Nimugira ngu omu myanya yoona ei naabaire ngyendamu n'Abaisraeli boona, nkaba ndagizire omwe aha baramuzi ba Israeli, abu naaragiire kuriisa abantu bangye Israeli nti: Ahabw'enki mutakanyombekyeraga nju y'emyereezi?
en: In all the places wherein I have walked with all the children of Israel spake I a word with any of the tribes of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people Israel, saying, Why build ye not me an house of cedar?

rr: N'habw'ekyo ogire omwiru wangye Daudi oti: MUKAMA ow'amahe naagira ati: Nkakwiha omu iriisizo nooriisa entaama, ngu nkuhindure omutegyeki w'abantu bangye Israeli
en: Now therefore so shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, from following the sheep, to be ruler over my people, over Israel:

rr: kandi nkaba nguma naiwe ahu waabaire oza hoona, ncwekyerereza abazigu baawe omu maisho gaawe; kandi ndyakuha eiziina rikuru nk'ery'abantu rugambwa ab'omu nsi.
en: and I was with thee whithersoever thou wentest, and have cut off all thine enemies out of thy sight, and have made thee a great name, like unto the name of the great men that are in the earth.

rr: Ndyatooranira abantu bangye Israeli omwanya, mbabyaremu, babone kugira obutaka bw'okutuuramu, obu batariihwamu bundi. Kandi abantu babi tibarigaruka kubaita kubi nk'obunyakare
en: Moreover I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in a place of their own, and move no more; neither shall the children of wickedness afflict them any more, as beforetime,

rr: -16 ; obu naabaire ndagiira abaramuzi kutegyeka abantu bangye Israeli; kandi ndyakuha okuhuumura abazigu baawe boona.
en: and as since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel, and have caused thee to rest from all thine enemies.

rr: N'ekindi, MUKAMA naakugambira ku arikuhindura oruganda.
en: Also the LORD telleth thee that he will make thee an house.

rr: Kandi obunaku bwawe ku burihika, waagwejegyera, waashanga baashwenkuru, ndyayemeka omwana waawe ou oryezaarira, akuhungurire, kandi mpamye obugabe bwe.
en: And when thy days be fulfilled, and thou shalt sleep with thy fathers, I will set up thy seed after thee, which shall proceed out of thy bowels, and I will establish his kingdom.

rr: Ogwo niwe aryombekyera eiziina ryangye enju; kandi ndyahamya ekitebe ky'obugabe bwe ebiro byona.
en: He shall build an house for my name, and I will stablish the throne of his kingdom for ever.

rr: Ndyaba ishe, nawe abe omwana wangye; ku aricumura, ndyamuhanisa enkoni z'abantu, babe nibo baamuteera
en: I will be his father, and he shall be my son. If he commit iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men, and with the stripes of the children of men:

rr: kwonka embabazi zangye tizirimurugaho, nk'oku naaziihire ahari Saulo, ou naacwire nkaiha omu maisho gaawe.
en: but my mercy shall not depart away from him, as I took it from Saul, whom I put away before thee.

rr: Enju yaawe n'obugabe bwawe biryahamibwa ebiro byona, n'ekitebe ky'obugabe bwawe kiryaba eky'ebiro byona.
en: And thine house and thy kingdom shall be established for ever before thee: thy throne shall be established for ever.

rr: Ebyo bigambo byona n'okwo kworekwa kwona, Nasani yaabiteekyerereza Daudi nk'oku byabaire biri. Okushaba kwa Daudi
en: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.

rr: Bwanyima Daudi omugabe yaataaha omu Ihema, yaashutama omu maisho ga MUKAMA, yaagira ati: Niinye oha, ai MUKAMA Ruhanga? Kandi n'enju yangye nikyo ki, iwe okundinda okampitsya aha?
en: Then went king David in, and sat before the LORD , and he said, Who am I, O Lord GOD ? and what is my house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?

rr: Kwonka ekyo ahariiwe ni kikye, MUKAMA Ruhanga; mbwenu waayongyeraho n'okugamba aha by'enju y'omwiru waawe, oku eriba omu biro bingi munonga ebiriija, nk'oku kiba omu biragiro by'abantu, ai MUKAMA Ruhanga.
en: And this was yet a small thing in thy sight, O Lord GOD ; but thou hast spoken also of thy servant's house for a great while to come. And is this the manner of man, O Lord GOD ?

rr: Mbwenu shi, ekindi Daudi akugambire ki? Ahabw'okuba noomanya omwiru waawe, MUKAMA Ruhanga.
en: And what can David say more unto thee? for thou, Lord GOD , knowest thy servant.

rr: Ahabw'endagaano yaawe okakora ebikuru ebyo byona, kubimanyisa omwiru waawe, nk'oku omutima gwawe gwateekateekire.
en: For thy word's sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all these great things, to make thy servant know them .

rr: Nikyo obeera mukuru, MUKAMA Ruhanga; ahakuba tihariho orikushushana naiwe, kandi tihariho Ruhanga ondiijo kureka Iwe, nk'ebi twahuriire byona oku biri.
en: Wherefore thou art great, O LORD God: for there is none like thee, neither is there any God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

rr: Kandi na ihanga ki omu nsi eriri nk'abantu baawe Israeli, abu Ruhanga yaagiire kwecungurira kuba abantu be, ngu ayetungire eiziina, ahabw'okubakorera ebikuru kandi ebirikutiinisa, naabinga omu maisho gaabo eihanga na baaruhanga baaryo?
en: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people, even like Israel, whom God went to redeem for a people to himself, and to make him a name, and to do for you great things and terrible, for thy land, before thy people, which thou redeemedst to thee from Egypt, from the nations and their gods?

rr: Bwanyima okeehamiza abantu baawe Israeli, ngu babe eihnaga eri waayetooraniire ebiro byona; naiwe, MUKAMA, okaba Ruhanga waabo.
en: For thou hast confirmed to thyself thy people Israel to be a people unto thee for ever: and thou, LORD , art become their God.

rr: Mbwenu hati, MUKAMA Ruhanga, ekigambo eki waagamba aha mwiru waawe n'aha nju ye, okihamye ebiro byona, kandi okore nk'oku waagamba
en: And now, O LORD God, the word that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant, and concerning his house, establish it for ever, and do as thou hast said.

rr: n'eiziina ryawe riryahimbisibwa ebiro byona, bagire bati: MUKAMA ow'amahe niwe Ruhanga wa Israeli; kandi enju y'omwiru waawe Daudi eryahamibwa omu maisho gaawe.
en: And let thy name be magnified for ever, saying, The LORD of hosts is the God over Israel: and let the house of thy servant David be established before thee.

rr: Ahakuba Iwe, MUKAMA ow'amahe, Ruhanga wa Israeli, oshuuruuriire omwiru waawe, noogira oti: Ndyakwombekyera enju; nikyo omwiru waawe agiriire obumanzi bw'okukushaba ebigambo ebi.
en: For thou, O LORD of hosts, God of Israel, hast revealed to thy servant, saying, I will build thee an house: therefore hath thy servant found in his heart to pray this prayer unto thee.

rr: Mbwenu hati, ai MUKAMA Ruhanga, niiwe Ruhanga, n'ebigambo byawe n'eby'amazima, kandi oraganiise omwiru waawe, ekigambo ekyo ekirungi.
en: And now, O Lord GOD , thou art that God, and thy words be true, and thou hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo hati ikiriza kuha enju y'omwiru waawe omugisha, egumeho ebiro byona omu maisho gaawe, ahakuba niiwe waakigamba, MUKAMA Ruhanga; kandi omugisha gwawe gugume guheebwe enju y'omwiru waawe ebiro byona.
en: therefore now let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may continue for ever before thee: for thou, O Lord GOD , hast spoken it: and with thy blessing let the house of thy servant be blessed for ever.

rr: 1 -17 ; Zab Bwanyima y'ebyo Daudi yaasingura Abafilistia, yaabamara eishaija, yaiha Mesegama omu mikono yaabo.
en: And after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them: and David took Metheg-ammah out of the hand of the Philistines.

rr: Bwanyima yaasingura Abamoabu, yaabarambika ahansi, yaabagyeresa omuguha; emishorongo ebiri yaaba ey'okwitwa, n'omushorongo gumwe gwaba ogw'okukira.
en: And he smote Moab, and measured them with a line, casting them down to the ground; even with two lines measured he to put to death, and with one full line to keep alive.

rr: Okuruga aho Abamoabu baahinduka abahuuku ba Daudi, baaguma nibamutoijera.
en: And so the Moabites became David's servants, and brought gifts.

rr: Kandi Daudi yaasingura Hadadezeeri mwene Rehobu omugabe wa Zooba, naaza kugarura ensi eyaabaire eri omu bugabe bwe aha mugyera Furaati.
en: David smote also Hadadezer, the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his border at the river Euphrates.

rr: Daudi yaamunyagaho engabo z'abarikugyendera aha mbaraasi rukumi na magana mushanju, n'abarikugyendesa ebigyere obukumi bubiri; bwanyima Daudi yaatema ebiteega by'embaraasi ezirikukurura ebigaari zoona; kwonka yaatsigaho ezirikubaasa kukurura ebigaari igana.
en: And David took from him a thousand chariots , and seven hundred horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: and David houghed all the chariot horses , but reserved of them for an hundred chariots.

rr: 1 Abasiria ba Damasiko ku baizire kuha Hadadezeeri omugabe wa Zooba emikono, Daudi yaabaitamu abantu obukumi bubiri n'enkumi ibiri.
en: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to succour Hadadezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.

rr: Daudi yaanyaga engabo z'ezaabu ezi abagaragwa ba Hadadezeeri baabaire baine, yaazitwara Yerusaalemu.
en: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

rr: Kandi omugabe Daudi yaiha emiringa mingi munonga omuri Beeta na Berosai, endembo za Hadadezeri.
en: And from Betah, and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, king David took exceeding much brass.

rr: Toi omugabe wa Hamasi ku yaahuriire ngu Daudi asingwire eihe ryaona erya Hadadezeeri
en: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had smitten all the host of Hadadezer,

rr: yaatuma Yoramu omutabani aha mugabe Daudi kumuramutsya n'okumutabaarutsya ahabw'okurwana na Hadadezeeri n'okumusingura; ahabw'okuba Hadadezeeri akaba atuura naarwana na Toi.
en: then Toi sent Joram his son unto king David, to salute him, and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer, and smitten him: for Hadadezer had wars with Toi.

rr: Yoramu ogwo yaijana ebintu by'efeeza, eby'ezaabu n'eby'emiringa.
en: And Joram brought with him vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and vessels of brass:

rr: Ebyo nabyo omugabe Daudi yaabishoroorera MUKAMA hamwe n'efeeza n'ezaabu ebi yaabaire ashorore, abaihire omu mahanga goona agu yaabaire asingwire
en: which also king David did dedicate unto the LORD , with the silver and gold that he had dedicated of all nations which he subdued;

rr: ebya Siria, ebya Moabu, eby'Abaamoni, eby'Abafilistia, ebya Amaleki, n'eby'eminyago ya Hadadezeeri mwene Rehobu omugabe wa Zooba.
en: of Syria, and of Moab, and of the children of Ammon, and of the Philistines, and of Amalek, and of the spoil of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.

rr: Daudi yaayetungira atyo eiziina. Ku yaabaire naagaruka, yaitura omu ruhita rw'omwonyo Abanyaedomu kakumi n'enkumi munaana.
en: And David gat him a name when he returned from smiting of the Syrians in the valley of salt, being eighteen thousand men .

rr: Atyo Daudi yaategyeka Israeli yoona, kandi yaacwera abantu be boona emanja z'oburyo omu bwinganisa.
en: And David reigned over all Israel; and David executed judgment and justice unto all his people.

rr: 2 Obwo Yoabu mwene Zeruiya akaba ari omukuru w'eihe, Yehoshafaati mwene Ahiluudi ari omuhandiiki w'ebirikubaho
en: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;

rr: Zadoki mwene Ahitubu na Ahimeleki mwene Abiasaari bari abanyamurwa; Seraaya ari omuhandiiki
en: and Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Seraiah was the scribe;

rr: Benaaya mwene Yehoyaada ari omukuru w'aba Keresi n'aba Pelesi; kandi batabani ba Daudi bari abategyeki bakuru.
en: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over both the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David's sons were chief rulers.

Bwanyima Daudi yaabuuza ati: Ebyo haine owaatsigaireho omu nju ya Saulo, nkamukorera eby'embabazi ahabwa Yonasaani?
en: And David said, Is there yet any that is left of the house of Saul, that I may shew him kindness for Jonathan's sake?

rr: 2 -4 ; 19:17 , Omu biro ebyo hakaba hariho omuheereza ow'omu nju ya Saulo orikwetwa Ziiba; baamwetera Daudi omugae, yaamubuuza ati: Niiwe Ziiba? Onu ati: Niinye omwiru waawe.
en: And there was of the house of Saul a servant whose name was Ziba. And when they had called him unto David, the king said unto him, Art thou Ziba? And he said, Thy servant is he .

rr: Omugabe yaamubuuza ati: Omu nju ya Saulo haine okiriho nkamukorera eby'embabazi za Ruhanga?
en: And the king said, Is there not yet any of the house of Saul, that I may shew the kindness of God unto him?

rr: Ziiba yaamugarukamu ati: Hakiriho mutabani wa Yonasaani, oremaire ebigyere.
en: And Ziba said unto the king, Jonathan hath yet a son, which is lame on his feet.

rr: Omugabe yaamubuuza ati: Arahi?
en: And the king said unto him, Where is he?

rr: Ziiba yaamugarukamu ati: Ari Lodebaari omu nju ya Makiri mwene Amieli.
en: And Ziba said unto the king, Behold, he is in the house of Machir, the son of Ammiel, in Lo-debar.

rr: Omugabe Daudi nikwo kutuma, bakamwiha Lodebaari omu nju ya Makiri mwene Amieli.
en: Then king David sent, and fetched him out of the house of Machir, the son of Ammiel, from Lo-debar.

rr: Atyo Mefiboshesi mwene Yonasaani, mwijukuru wa Saulo yaija owa Daudi, yaajuumara omu maisho ge, yaamutangirira.
en: Now when Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, was come unto David, he fell on his face, and did reverence.

rr: Daudi yaamugira ati: Mefioshesi!
en: And David said, Mephibosheth.

rr: Onu yaamugarukamu ati: Omwiru waawe ari aha.
en: And he answered, Behold thy servant!

rr: Daudi yaamugira ati: Otatiina, ahabw'okuba buzimazima niinyija kukukorera eby'embabazi ahabwa Yonasaani sho, nkugarurire ebibanja bya shwenkuru byona; kandi oryaguma nooriira aha meeza yangye obutoosha.
en: And David said unto him, Fear not: for I will surely shew thee kindness for Jonathan thy father's sake, and will restore thee all the land of Saul thy father; and thou shalt eat bread at my table continually.

rr: Mefiboshesi yaagaruka yaamwinamira, yaagira ati: omwiru waawe ni kintu ki, iwe okuunyetaho, nyowe embwa efiire?
en: And he bowed himself, and said, What is thy servant, that thou shouldest look upon such a dead dog as I am?

rr: Bwanyima omugabe yaayeta Ziiba omuheereza wa Saulo, yaamugira ati: Ebyabaire biri ebya Saulo byona n'eby'ab'omu ka ye boona, naabiha mutabani wa mukama waawe.
en: Then the king called to Ziba, Saul's servant, and said unto him, I have given unto thy master's son all that pertained to Saul and to all his house.

rr: Kandi iwe na batabani baawe n'abairu baawe mugume mumuhingire emisiri, mumureetere ebyezire, mutabani wa mukama waawe abone kutunga eby'okurya; kwonka Mefiboshesi mutabani wa mukama waawe aryaguma naariira aha meeza yangye obutoosha.
en: Thou therefore, and thy sons, and thy servants, shall till the land for him, and thou shalt bring in the fruits , that thy master's son may have food to eat: but Mephibosheth thy master's son shall eat bread alway at my table.

rr: Kandi Ziiba ogwo akaba aine abatabani ikumi na bataano, n'abairu makumi abiri.
en: Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.

rr: Ziiba yaagira omugabe ati: Ebi Nyakusinga omugabe yaaragiira omwiru we byona, omwiru we nikwo araagume naabitwaza.
en: Then said Ziba unto the king, According to all that my lord the king hath commanded his servant, so shall thy servant do.

rr: Okuruga aho Mefiboshesi yaaguma naariira aha meeza y'omugabe, nk'omwana w'omugabe.
en: As for Mephibosheth, said the king , he shall eat at my table, as one of the king's sons.

rr: Kandi Mefiboshesi akaba aine omutabani muto orikwetwa Miika; ab'omu ka ya Ziiba boona bakaba bari abairu ba Mefiboshesi.
en: And Mephibosheth had a young son, whose name was Micha. And all that dwelt in the house of Ziba were servants unto Mephibosheth.

rr: Atyo Mefiboshesi yaaguma Yerusaalemu, ahakuba akaba ariira aha meeza y'omugabe obutoosha; kandi akaba aremaire ebigyere byombi.
en: So Mephibosheth dwelt in Jerusalem: for he did eat continually at the king's table; and was lame on both his feet.

rr: 1 Bwanyima y'ebyo omugabe w'Abaamoni yaafa, omutabani Hanuni yaategyeka omu mwanya gwe.
en: And it came to pass after this, that the king of the children of Ammon died, and Hanun his son reigned in his stead.

rr: Daudi ku yaakihuriire, yaagira ati: Niinyija kukorera gye Hanuni mwene Nahashi, nk'oku ishe yankoreire gye.
en: Then said David, I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, as his father shewed kindness unto me.

rr: Atyo Daudi yaayohereza abagaragwa be kumuyaagira ahabw'okufeerwa ishe.
en: And David sent to comfort him by the hand of his servants for his father.

rr: Abagaragwa ba Daudi baahika omu nsi y'Abaamoni.
en: And David's servants came into the land of the children of Ammon.

rr: Kwonka abategyeki b'Abaamoni baagira Hanuni mukama waabo bati: Noogira ngu Daudi okukwoherereza ab'okukuyaagira n'okuha sho ekitiinisa? Torikumanya ku Daudi ayohereize abagaragwa be kwetegyereza orurembo n'okurutata, ngu arumareho?
en: And the princes of the children of Ammon said unto Hanun their lord, Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father, that he hath sent comforters unto thee? hath not David rather sent his servants unto thee, to search the city, and to spy it out, and to overthrow it?

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo Hanuni yaakwata abagaragwa ba Daudi, yaabamwa ebireju by'orubaju rumwe, yaahirimburira rwagati ekicweka kya ifo eky'ebijwaro byabo okugarukira aha bibunu, yaaboohereza.
en: Wherefore Hanun took David's servants, and shaved off the one half of their beards, and cut off their garments in the middle, even to their buttocks, and sent them away.

rr: Ku baabigambiire Daudi, yaayohereza ab'okubabugana, ahabw'okuba bakaba baine enshoni nyingi munonga. Omugabe yaabatumaho ati: Mugume Yeriko okuhitsya obu obureju burikura, mukaija.
en: When they told it unto David, he sent to meet them, because the men were greatly ashamed: and the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and then return.

rr: Abaamoni ku baamanyire ngu beetamiise Daudi, baatuma aha Basiria ba Besi-rehobu n'aba Zooba kubagurira ngu babahe engabo ezirikugyendesa ebigyere obukumi bubiri, n'omugabe wa Maaka kureeta engabo rukumi, n'aba Tobu kureeta kakumi n'enkumi ibiri.
en: And when the children of Ammon saw that they stank before David, the children of Ammon sent and hired the Syrians of Beth-rehob, and the Syrians of Zoba, twenty thousand footmen, and of king Maacah a thousand men, and of Ish-tob twelve thousand men.

rr: Daudi ku yaakihuriire, yaayohereza Yoabu n'eihe ryona ery'amamanzi.
en: And when David heard of it , he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.

rr: Abaamoni baashohora, baatenga orugamba aha irembo; kandi Abasiria ba Zooba n'aba Rehobu n'engabo za Tobu na Maaka bakaba bari ahakwabo omu ishwa.
en: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the entering in of the gate: and the Syrians of Zoba, and of Rehob, and Ish-tob, and Maacah, were by themselves in the field.

rr: Yoabu ku yaareebire engabo zimuri omumaisho n'enyima, yaatoorana abashaija entoore omu Baisraeli boona, yaabatengyesa orugamba kurwana n'Abasiria
en: When Joab saw that the front of the battle was against him before and behind, he chose of all the choice men of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians:

rr: abandi boona yaabaha omurumuna Abishai, nawe yaabatengyesa orugamba kurwana n'Abaamoni.
en: and the rest of the people he delivered into the hand of Abishai his brother, that he might put them in array against the children of Ammon.

rr: Yaamugira ati: Abasiria ku barankize amaani, oije ompe emikono; kandi naiwe Abaamoni ku baraakukize amaani, naanye niinyija kugikuha.
en: And he said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, then I will come and help thee.

rr: Guma omutima, turwane mashaija ahabw'eihanga ryaitu n'ahabw'endembo za Ruhanga waitu; kandi MUKAMA akore eki arikusiima.
en: Be of good courage, and let us play the men for our people, and for the cities of our God: and the LORD do that which seemeth him good.

rr: Atyo Yoabu n'engabo ezi yaabaire aine, bairira haihi kurwanisa Abasiria; Abasiria baabahunga.
en: And Joab drew nigh, and the people that were with him, unto the battle against the Syrians: and they fled before him.

rr: Abaamoni ku baareebire Abasiria baahunga, nabo baahunga Abishai, baataaha omu rurembo rwabo.
en: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, then fled they also before Abishai, and entered into the city.

rr: Bwanyima Yoabu yaareka Abaamoni, yaagaruka Yerusaalemu.
en: So Joab returned from the children of Ammon, and came to Jerusalem.

rr: Kwonka Abasiria ku baareebire babingirwe Abaisraeli baayeteerana.
en: And when the Syrians saw that they were smitten before Israel, they gathered themselves together.

rr: Hadadezeeri yaatuma aha Basiria abaabaire batwire seeri y'omugyera Furaati baarugayo, baaza Helamu, beebembeirwe Shobaki omukuru w'eihe rya Hadadezeeri.
en: And Hadarezer sent, and brought out the Syrians that were beyond the river: and they came to Helam; and Shobach the captain of the host of Hadarezer went before them.

rr: Ku baagambiire Daudi, nawe yaateerana Israeli yoona, baayambuka Yorudani, baaza Helamu, Abasiria baatenga orugamba, baarwana na Daudi.
en: And when it was told David, he gathered all Israel together, and passed over Jordan, and came to Helam. And the Syrians set themselves in array against David, and fought with him.

rr: Abasiria baahunga Abaisraeli, Daudi yaita omu Basiria abantu abarikurwanira aha bigaari magana mushanju, n'ab'aha mbaraasi obukumi buna, kandi baacumita Shobaki omukuru w'eihe ryabo, baamugwisaho.
en: And the Syrians fled before Israel; and David slew the men of seven hundred chariots of the Syrians, and forty thousand horsemen, and smote Shobach the captain of their host, who died there.

rr: Abo bagabe boona abaabaire nibaheereza Hadadezeeri, ku baareebire baasingurwa Abaisraeli, baabeehongyera, baabatabaarira.
en: And when all the kings that were servants to Hadarezer saw that they were smitten before Israel, they made peace with Israel, and served them.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo Abasiria baatiina kugaruka kuha Abaamoni emikono.
en: So the Syrians feared to help the children of Ammon any more.

rr: Omu kutandika kw'omwaka, omu bunaku obu abagabe baabaire bahururiramu, Daudi akoohereza Yoabu kuhurura n'abagaragwa be n'Abaisraeli, baacwekyereza Abaamoni, bwanyima baagota Rabba.
en: And it came to pass, after the year was expired, at the time when kings go forth to battle , that David sent Joab, and his servants with him, and all Israel; and they destroyed the children of Ammon, and besieged Rabbah.

rr: Kwonka Daudi we akaba ayetsigariire Yerusaalemu.
en: But David tarried still at Jerusalem.

rr: Eizooba rimwe omu mwabazyo, Daudi yaimuka aha kitanda kye, yaagyendagyenda aha mutwe gwa nyaruju y'omugabe. Ku yaabaire ayemereireho, yaareeba omukazi naayoga; kandi omukazi ogwo akaba ari murungi munonga w'okurigira.
en: And it came to pass in an eveningtide, that David arose from off his bed, and walked upon the roof of the king's house: and from the roof he saw a woman washing herself; and the woman was very beautiful to look upon.

rr: Daudi yaatuma kumubuuririza.
en: And David sent and enquired after the woman.

rr: Omuntu omwe yaagira ati: Beitu ogwo ti Batisheba muhara wa Eliamu, muka Uriya Omuhiiti?
en: And one said, Is not this Bath-sheba, the daughter of Eliam, the wife of Uriah the Hittite?

rr: Daudi yaatuma entumwa, zaamureeta, yaija owe, Daudi yaabyama nawe; ahakuba akaba azirukire; bwanyima yaagaruka omuka.
en: And David sent messengers, and took her; and she came in unto him, and he lay with her; for she was purified from her uncleanness: and she returned unto her house.

rr: Ku haahingwireho ebiro bikye, yaagira enda, yaatuma ahari Daudi ati: Nyine enda.
en: And the woman conceived, and sent and told David, and said, I am with child.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo Daudi yaatuma ahari Yoabu ati: nyoherereza Uriya Omuhiiti. Atyo Yoabu yaamumwoherereza.
en: And David sent to Joab, saying , Send me Uriah the Hittite. And Joab sent Uriah to David.

rr: Uriya ku yaahikire Daudi, Daudi yaamubuuza oku Yoabu ari n'engabo ze, n'ahu obweme bwahika.
en: And when Uriah was come unto him, David demanded of him how Joab did, and how the people did, and how the war prospered.

rr: Bwanyima Daudi yaamugira ati: Irooko oshuume owaawe, onaabe aha bigyere.
en: And David said to Uriah, Go down to thy house, and wash thy feet.

rr: Atyo Uriya yaaruga omuri nyaruju y'omugabe, omugabe yaamukuratsa eky'okumufungurira.
en: And Uriah departed out of the king's house, and there followed him a mess of meat from the king.

rr: Kwonka Uriya yaabyama aha irembo rya nyaruju hamwe n'abaheereza ba mukama we, tiyaataaha mu ka ye.
en: But Uriah slept at the door of the king's house with all the servants of his lord, and went not down to his house.

rr: Ku baagambiire Daudi ku Uriya atataahire muka, Daudi yaabuuza Uriya ati: Beitu shi torikuruga omu rugyendo? N'enki ekikuzibiire kutaaha omuka?
en: And when they had told David, saying, Uriah went not down unto his house, David said unto Uriah, Camest thou not from thy journey? why then didst thou not go down unto thine house?

rr: Uriya yaagarukamu Daudi ati: Eshanduukye ya Ruhanga n'Abaisraeli n'Abayuda nibaraara omu nsiisira; kandi mukama wangye Yoabu n'abagaragwa ba mukama wangye basiisiire omu ishwa. Mbwenu nyowe nze omuka kurya, kunywa n'okuraara n'omukazi wangye? Buso bwawe, ninkurahira tindikwija kukikora.
en: And Uriah said unto David, The ark, and Israel, and Judah, abide in tents; and my lord Joab, and the servants of my lord, are encamped in the open fields; shall I then go into mine house, to eat and to drink, and to lie with my wife? as thou livest, and as thy soul liveth, I will not do this thing.

rr: Daudi yaagira Uriya ati: Siiba aha n'eri izooba, nyencakare nkuragye ogyende.
en: And David said to Uriah, Tarry here to day also, and to morrow I will let thee depart.

rr: Atyo Uriya yaasiiba Yerusaalemu eryo izooba n'eryakuratsireho.
en: So Uriah abode in Jerusalem that day, and the morrow.

rr: Daudi yaamweta, yaarya, yaanywera omu maisho ge, yaamusinza. Nyekiro Uriya yaashohora, yaaza kubyama aha kitanda kye hamwe n'abagaragwa ba mukama we, tiyaagira bu agiire omuka.
en: And when David had called him, he did eat and drink before him; and he made him drunk: and at even he went out to lie on his bed with the servants of his lord, but went not down to his house.

rr: Ku bwaseesire, Daudi yaahandiikira Yoabu ebaruha, yaagitweka Uriya.
en: And it came to pass in the morning, that David wrote a letter to Joab, and sent it by the hand of Uriah.

rr: Omuri egyo baruha yaahandiikamu ati: Mute Uriya omu kaso k'orugamba, ahu ruhamire, mumutsigyeho, bamucumite, afe.
en: And he wrote in the letter, saying, Set ye Uriah in the forefront of the hottest battle, and retire ye from him, that he may be smitten, and die.

rr: Bwanyima Yoabu ku yaabaire agotsire orurembo, yaata Uriya ahu arikumanya ku niho amamanzi gari.
en: And it came to pass, when Joab observed the city, that he assigned Uriah unto a place where he knew that valiant men were .

rr: Abanyarurembo baashohora, baarwana na Yoabu, abamwe aha bagaragwa ba Daudi baafa, na Uriya Omuhiiti nwe yaafa.
en: And the men of the city went out, and fought with Joab: and there fell some of the people of the servants of David; and Uriah the Hittite died also.

rr: Yoabu yaayehereza entumwa kugambira Daudi amakuru goona ag'orugamba
en: Then Joab sent and told David all the things concerning the war;

rr: yaayehanangiriza entumwa, naagira ati: ku oraaheze kugambira omugabe amakuru g'orugamba
en: and charged the messenger, saying, When thou hast made an end of telling the matters of the war unto the king,

rr: yaaguubwa kubi, yaakugira ati: Ahabw'enki murwaine mukahika haihi n'orurembo? Mubaire mutarikumanya ku barikubaasa kubarasha, beemereire aha rugo rw'amabaare?
en: and if so be that the king's wrath arise, and he say unto thee, Wherefore approached ye so nigh unto the city when ye did fight? knew ye not that they would shoot from the wall?

rr: Nimugira ngu owaitsire Abimeleki mwene Yerubeshesi n'oha? T'omukazi owaamuteereire eseiso Tebeza ayemereire aha rugo, akamugwisaho? Ahabw'enki muhikire haihi n'orugo mutyo? naiwe omugarukyemu oti: Manya omushaija waawe Uriya Omuhiiti nawe afiire.
en: Who smote Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth? did not a woman cast a piece of a millstone upon him from the wall, that he died in Thebez? why went ye nigh the wall? then say thou, Thy servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also.

en: Then David said unto the messenger, Thus shalt thou say unto Joab, Let not this thing displease thee, for the sword devoureth one as well as another: make thy battle more strong against the city, and overthrow it: and encourage thou him.

en: And he came unto him, and said unto him, There were two men in one city; the one rich, and the other poor.

rr: Ogwo mutungi akaba aine amasyo maingi g'entaama n'ag'ente
en: The rich man had exceeding many flocks and herds:

en: but the poor man had nothing, save one little ewe lamb, which he had bought and nourished up: and it grew up together with him, and with his children; it did eat of his own meat, and drank of his own cup, and lay in his bosom, and was unto him as a daughter.

rr: Eizooba rimwe ogwo mutungi yaaraarirwa omugyenyi; kwonka tiyaayenda kubaagira ogwo muhinguzi owaamuraarira omu masyo ge g'entaama nari ag'ente, kureka yaatwara ako kataama k'ori mworo, yaaba niko yaamubaagira.
en: And there came a traveller unto the rich man, and he spared to take of his own flock and of his own herd, to dress for the wayfaring man that was come unto him; but took the poor man's lamb, and dressed it for the man that was come to him.

rr: Daudi ku yaakihuriire, yaagirira ogwo mushaija ekiniga kingi munonga, yaagira Nasani ati: Nindahira MUKAMA otahwaho, omushaija okozire ekyo kintu akaabaire ow'okufa
en: And David's anger was greatly kindled against the man; and he said to Nathan, As the LORD liveth, the man that hath done this thing shall surely die:

rr: mbwenu arihe ako kataama kana ahabw'okukora ekyo n'ahabw'okutagira saasi.
en: and he shall restore the lamb fourfold, because he did this thing, and because he had no pity.

rr: Nasani yaagira Daudi ati: Manya ogwo mushaija niiwe.
en: And Nathan said to David, Thou art the man.

rr: MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli naakugira ati: Nkakushukaho amajuta kuba omugabe wa Israeli, naakwiha omu mikono ya Saulo
en: Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I anointed thee king over Israel, and I delivered thee out of the hand of Saul;

en: and I gave thee thy master's house, and thy master's wives into thy bosom, and gave thee the house of Israel and of Judah; and if that had been too little, I would moreover have given unto thee such and such things.

rr: Ahabw'enki ogayire ekigambo kya MUKAMA, okakora ekirikwangwa omu maisho ge? Oitsire Uriya Omuhiiti na rurara, waatwara omukazi we, waamushwera; waamwitsa rurara y'Abaamoni.
en: Wherefore hast thou despised the commandment of the LORD , to do evil in his sight? thou hast killed Uriah the Hittite with the sword, and hast taken his wife to be thy wife, and hast slain him with the sword of the children of Ammon.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo rurara teriruga mu ka yaawe, ahabw'okungaya, okatwara muka Uriya Omuhiiti kuba omukazi waawe.
en: Now therefore the sword shall never depart from thine house; because thou hast despised me, and hast taken the wife of Uriah the Hittite to be thy wife.

rr: Kandi MUKAMA naakugira ati: Ndyaimutsya ebihikiirizi omu ka yaawe, nkwakye abakazi baawe nooreeba, mbahe mutaahi waawe, abyame nabo nyomushana.
en: Thus saith the LORD , Behold, I will raise up evil against thee out of thine own house, and I will take thy wives before thine eyes, and give them unto thy neighbour, and he shall lie with thy wives in the sight of this sun.

rr: Okakikora bwesherekye, kwonka ekyangye ndyakikora nyomushana omu maisho ga Israeli yoona.
en: For thou didst it secretly: but I will do this thing before all Israel, and before the sun.

rr: Daudi yaagira Nasani ati: Ncumwire ahari MUKAMA.
en: And David said unto Nathan, I have sinned against the LORD .

rr: Naasani yaagira Daudi ati: MUKAMA nawe yihaho ekibi kyawe; tokifa.

rr: Kwonka ahabw'ekyo eki okozire, okareetera abazigu ba MUKAMA kumujuma, omwana ogwo ozairwe buzimazima naija kufa. Okweteisa kwa Daudi
en: Howbeit, because by this deed thou hast given great occasion to the enemies of the LORD to blaspheme, the child also that is born unto thee shall surely die.

rr: Bwanyima Nasani yaagarukayo owe.
en: And Nathan departed unto his house.

rr: MUKAMA yaarwza ogwo mwana, ou muka Uriya yaazaariire Daudi, yaaremba munonga.
en: And the LORD struck the child that Uriah's wife bare unto David, and it was very sick.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo Daudi yaayeshengyereza MUKAMA ahabwe; Daudi yaayesiibyakwo, yaataaha omu nju, yaabyama ahansi, bwarugaho bwasheesha.
en: David therefore besought God for the child; and David fasted, and went in, and lay all night upon the earth.

rr: Abakuru b'enju ye baamwemerera aha rubaju kumwimutsya ahansi, yaabangira, kandi tiyaarya nabo.
en: And the elders of his house arose, and went to him, to raise him up from the earth: but he would not, neither did he eat bread with them.

en: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that the child died. And the servants of David feared to tell him that the child was dead: for they said, Behold, while the child was yet alive, we spake unto him, and he would not hearken unto our voice: how will he then vex himself, if we tell him that the child is dead?

rr: Kwonka Daudi, ku yaareebire abagaragwa nibagambirana omu kutu, yaamanyira aho ku omwana yaakaba. Daudi yaababuuza ati: Omwana yaakaba? Baamugarukamu bati: Yaakaba.
en: But when David saw that his servants whispered, David perceived that the child was dead: therefore David said unto his servants, Is the child dead? And they said, He is dead.

rr: Daudi yaimuka ahansi, yaayoga, yaayesiiga, yaahindura ebijwaro bye, yaataaha omu nju ya MUKAMA, yaaramya. Ku yaaherize, yaataaha omwe, yaashaba eby'okurya, baabimuta omumaisho, yaarya.
en: Then David arose from the earth, and washed, and anointed himself , and changed his apparel, and came into the house of the LORD , and worshipped: then he came to his own house; and when he required, they set bread before him, and he did eat.

rr: Abagaragwa be baamubuuza bati: Eki waakora ki? Oyesiibizekwo, waaririra omwana akihuriire; mbwenu omwana ku yaaheza kufa, waimuka waarya!
en: Then said his servants unto him, What thing is this that thou hast done? thou didst fast and weep for the child, while it was alive; but when the child was dead, thou didst rise and eat bread.

en: And he said, While the child was yet alive, I fasted and wept: for I said, Who can tell whether GOD will be gracious to me, that the child may live?

rr: Mbwenu ka yaafiire, niinyesiibizakwo ki? Nimbaasa kumuhimbuura? Ndyamukurata, kwonka we taringarukira.
en: But now he is dead, wherefore should I fast? can I bring him back again? I shall go to him, but he shall not return to me.

rr: Bwanyima Daudi yaagumya omukazi we Betisheba, yaamuraarira; ebiro ku byahingwireho, yaamuzaarira omwana w'omwojo, yaamweta Sulemaani. Omwana ogwo MUKAMA yaamukunda
en: And David comforted Bath-sheba his wife, and went in unto her, and lay with her: and she bare a son, and he called his name Solomon: and the LORD loved him.

en: And he sent by the hand of Nathan the prophet; and he called his name Jedidiah, because of the LORD .

rr: Yoabu yaatuma entumwa ahari Daudi, naagira ati: Ndwaniise Rabba, kandi naakwata orurembo rw'amaizi.
en: And Joab sent messengers to David, and said, I have fought against Rabbah, and have taken the city of waters.

en: And he took their king's crown from off his head, the weight whereof was a talent of gold with the precious stones: and it was set on David's head.

en: And he brought forth the people that were therein, and put them under saws, and under harrows of iron, and under axes of iron, and made them pass through the brickkiln: and thus did he unto all the cities of the children of Ammon.

rr: Bwanyima Daudi n'engabo zoona baagaruka Yerusaalemu.
en: So David and all the people returned unto Jerusalem.

rr: Reeba, niinyija kuguma aha nyambukiro y'omu ihamba, ntegyereize okuhitsya obu murantumeho kungambira.
en: See, I will tarry in the plain of the wilderness, until there come word from you to certify me.

rr: Zadoki na Abiasaari nikwo kuheeka eshanduukye ya Ruhanga, bakagigarura Yerusaalemu, bakagumayo.
en: Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried the ark of God again to Jerusalem: and they tarried there. David's Flight

rr: Bwanyima Daudi yaatemba aharikwinamuka omu kibungo kya Zeituuni, yaagyenda naarira, ayetwekyereire, atajwaire nkaito; kandi n'abaabaire bari hamwe nawe boona baayetwekyerera, bainamuka nibarira.
en: And David went up by the ascent of mount Olivet, and wept as he went up, and had his head covered, and he went barefoot: and all the people that was with him covered every man his head, and they went up, weeping as they went up.

rr: Daudi ku yaahikire aha mutwe gw'ekibungo ahu baabaire bashabira Ruhanga, Hushai mwene Aruki yaija kumubugana, ebijwaro bye bitaagukire, n'eitaka rimuri omu mutwe.
en: And it came to pass, that when David was come to the top of the mount , where he worshipped God, behold, Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his coat rent, and earth upon his head:

rr: Daudi yaamugira ati: Ku oraagyende naanye, noija kundusya
en: unto whom David said, If thou passest on with me, then thou shalt be a burden unto me:

rr: kwonka ku oraagaarukye omu rurembo, waagira Abusalomu oti: Nyakusinga, niinyija kuba omwiru waawe; nk'oku naabaire ndi omwiru wa sho omu biro ebyahweire, na hati nikwo ndikwija kuba ahariiwe; noija kunsiisira enaama za Ahisofeeli.
en: but if thou return to the city, and say unto Absalom, I will be thy servant, O king; as I have been thy father's servant hitherto, so will I now also be thy servant: then mayest thou for me defeat the counsel of Ahithophel.

rr: Beitu torikwija kuba oineyo Zadoki na Abiasaari abanyamurwa? N'ahabw'ekyo eki oraahurire kyona ekirikuruga omu ka y'omugabe, okigambire Zadoki na Abiasaari abanyamurwa.
en: And hast thou not there with thee Zadok and Abiathar the priests? therefore it shall be, that what thing soever thou shalt hear out of the king's house, thou shalt tell it to Zadok and Abiathar the priests.

rr: Kandi noomanya ku baineyo batabani baabo bombi, Ahimaazi mwene Zadoki na Yonasaani mwene Abiasaari; abo nibo murantumeho kungambira ebi muraabe mwahuriire byona.
en: Behold, they have there with them their two sons, Ahimaaz Zadok's son , and Jonathan Abiathar's son ; and by them ye shall send unto me every thing that ye can hear.

rr: Atyo Hushai munywani wa Daudi yaaza omu rurembo, yaashanga Abusalomu naataaha Yerusaalemu.
en: So Hushai David's friend came into the city, and Absalom came into Jerusalem.
