rr: 2 -13 ; 15:30 , Daudi ku yaabaire yaahika aha mutwe gw'ekibungo, yaarengaho kakye, yaabugana Ziiba omugaragwa wa Mefiboshesi, aine endogoya ibiri eziriho amatandiiko, zeekoreire emigaati magana abiri, n'emitsitsa igana y'emizaabibu eyomire, n'endiijo igana ey'ebijuma by'omu kyanda, n'efurebe ya viinyo.
en: And when David was a little past the top of the hill , behold, Ziba the servant of Mephibosheth met him, with a couple of asses saddled, and upon them two hundred loaves of bread, and an hundred bunches of raisins, and an hundred of summer fruits, and a bottle of wine.

rr: Omugabe yaabuuza Ziiba ati: Ebi n'ebya ki?
en: And the king said unto Ziba, What meanest thou by these?

rr: Ziiba yaamugarukamu ati: Endogoya n'ez'okuheeka ab'omu ka y'omugabe, emigaati n'ebijuma by'omu kyanda n'eby'okufugurira abatsigazi, kandi na viinyo n'ey'okunywebwa abaraagwere enshazi omu ihamba.
en: And Ziba said, The asses be for the king's household to ride on; and the bread and summer fruit for the young men to eat; and the wine, that such as be faint in the wilderness may drink.

rr: Omugabe yaagaruka yaamubuuza ati: Beitu shi, mutabani wa mukama waawe arahi?
en: And the king said, And where is thy master's son?

rr: Ziiba yaamugarukamu ati: Reeba, atsigaire Yerusaalemu; ahakuba agizire ati: Eri izooba enju ya Israeli neija kungarura aha ngoma ya tata.
en: And Ziba said unto the king, Behold, he abideth at Jerusalem: for he said, To day shall the house of Israel restore me the kingdom of my father.

rr: Omugabe yaagira Ziiba ati: Reeba, ebibaire biri ebya Mefiboshesi byona, hati n'ebyawe. Ziiba yaagira ati: Kasingye, Nyakusinga omugabe. Ngume ngirirwe ntyo embabazi omu maisho gaawe. Shimei okujuma Daudi
en: Then said the king to Ziba, Behold, thine are all that pertained unto Mephibosheth. And Ziba said, I humbly beseech thee that I may find grace in thy sight, my lord, O king.

rr: 2 Omugabe Daudi ku yaahikire haihi na Bahurimu, haarugayo omushaija ow'omu muryango gw'enju ya Saulo orikwetwa Shimei mwene Geera; yaija naamukyeena
en: And when king David came to Bahurim, behold, thence came out a man of the family of the house of Saul, whose name was Shimei, the son of Gera: he came forth, and cursed still as he came.

rr: yaarekyera Daudi n'abagaragwa be boona amabaare; abantu boona n'abashaija be amamanzi bakaba bamushagatiire aha rubaju rwa buryo n'orwa bumosho.
en: And he cast stones at David, and at all the servants of king David: and all the people and all the mighty men were on his right hand and on his left.

rr: Shimei ku yaabaire naamukyeena, yaaguma naagira ati: Rugaho, rugaho, iwe mwitani 'we, ekishaija kitaine mugasho.
en: And thus said Shimei when he cursed, Come out, come out, thou bloody man, and thou man of Belial:

rr: MUKAMA akutuzire eshagama y'enju ya Saulo yoona, ou waahunguriire, okaza aha ngoma ye; mbwenu MUKAMA ahaire Abusalomu mutabani waawe obugabe bwawe; reeba, otuzirwe eitima ryawe, ahakuba ori omwitani.
en: the LORD hath returned upon thee all the blood of the house of Saul, in whose stead thou hast reigned; and the LORD hath delivered the kingdom into the hand of Absalom thy son: and, behold, thou art taken in thy mischief, because thou art a bloody man.

rr: Abishai mwene Zeruiya yaagira omugabe ati: Ahabw'enki nitureka egi mbwa efiire kujuma mukama wangye omugabe? Ninkweshengyereza, reka nyambukye, mmutemeho omutwe.
en: Then said Abishai the son of Zeruiah unto the king, Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king? let me go over, I pray thee, and take off his head.

rr: Omugabe yaati ati: Nyine kakwate ki naimwe, imwe beene Zeruiya?
en: And the king said, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Zeruiah? so let him curse, because the LORD hath said unto him, Curse David.

rr: MUKAMA ku araabe niwe amugizire ati: Kyeena Daudi, mbwenu n'oha oraamugire ati: Ahabw'enki waakora otyo?
en: Who shall then say, Wherefore hast thou done so?

rr: Daudi yaagira Abishai n'abagaragwa be boona ati: Nimureeba mutabani wangye ou nyezaariire nampiiga kuunyita; kaashwa ogu Mubenyamiini. Nimumurekye akyeene, ahakuba MUKAMA amuragiire.
en: And David said to Abishai, and to all his servants, Behold, my son, which came forth of my bowels, seeketh my life: how much more now may this Benjamite do it? let him alone, and let him curse; for the LORD hath bidden him.

rr: Obundi MUKAMA akaareeba oku ndikwitwa kubi, arugaho anzimuurira ebirungi ahabw'oku kukyeenwa oku naakyeenwa eri izooba.
en: It may be that the LORD will look on mine affliction, and that the LORD will requite me good for his cursing this day.

rr: Atyo Daudi n'abashaija be baagumya omuhanda, na Shimei yaakiikama omu rukiizi rw'ekibungo seeri yaabo naamukyeena, naamurekyera amabaare n'omucuucu.
en: And as David and his men went by the way, Shimei went along on the hill's side over against him, and cursed as he went, and threw stones at him, and cast dust.

rr: Bwanyima omugabe n'abantu boona abu yaabaire aine, baahika Yorudani baruhire; omugabe yaaruhuukirayo. Abusalomu okwehanuuza ahari Ahisofeeli na Hushai
en: And the king, and all the people that were with him, came weary, and refreshed themselves there.

rr: Abusalomu n'Abaisraeli boona baahika Yerusaalemu hamwe na Ahisofeeli.
en: And Absalom, and all the people the men of Israel, came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel with him.

rr: Kandi Hushai mwene Aruki, munywani wa Daudi, yaija owa Abusalomu, yaamugira ati: Omugabe nakaramaare! Omugabe nakaramaare!
en: And it came to pass, when Hushai the Archite, David's friend, was come unto Absalom, that Hushai said unto Absalom, God save the king, God save the king.

rr: Abusalomu yaabuuza Hushai ati: Obwo nibwo bwesigwa obu oine ahari munywani waawe? Ekikuzibiire kugyenda nawe n'enki?
en: And Absalom said to Hushai, Is this thy kindness to thy friend? why wentest thou not with thy friend?

rr: Hushai yaagira Abusalomu ati: Ngaaha! kureka omuntu otoorainwe MUKAMA n'aba bantu n'Abaisraeli boona, niwe ndiba owe, kandi niwe ndiguma nawe.
en: And Hushai said unto Absalom, Nay; but whom the LORD , and this people, and all the men of Israel, choose, his will I be, and with him will I abide.

rr: Kandi ekindi, n'oha ou nshemereire kuheereza? T'omutabani? Nk'oku naabaire mpeereza sho, naiwe nikwo ndikuheereza.
en: And again, whom should I serve? should I not serve in the presence of his son? as I have served in thy father's presence, so will I be in thy presence.

rr: Bwanyima Abusalomu yaagira Ahisofeeli ati: Tuhe obwengye, oku turaatwaze.
en: Then said Absalom to Ahithophel, Give counsel among you what we shall do.

rr: Ahisofeeli yaagira Abusalomu ati: Irooko obyame n'ebinyanshunju bya sho, ebi atsigiire eka ye kugirinda; haza Abaisraeli boona nibaija kumanyira aho ku otamirwe sho; n'ahabw'ekyo abu oine boona nibaija kuhama.
en: And Ahithophel said unto Absalom, Go in unto thy father's concubines, which he hath left to keep the house; and all Israel shall hear that thou art abhorred of thy father: then shall the hands of all that are with thee be strong.

rr: Batyo baateerera Abusalomu eihema aha mutwe gw'enju; Abusalomu yaaritaahamu, yaabyama n'ebinyanshunju bya ishe, Abaisraeli boona nibakireeba.
en: So they spread Absalom a tent upon the top of the house; and Absalom went in unto his father's concubines in the sight of all Israel.

rr: Kandi omu biro ebyo obwengye obu Ahisofeeli yaabaire aha, bukaba buba nk'obu omuntu ahairwe Ruhanga; okwo nikwo obwengye bwa Ahisofeeli bwabaire busiimwa Daudi, kandi na Abusalomu.
en: And the counsel of Ahithophel, which he counselled in those days, was as if a man had enquired at the oracle of God: so was all the counsel of Ahithophel both with David and with Absalom.

rr: Kandi Ahisofeeli yaagaruka yaagira Abusalomu ati: Ka ntoorane engabo kakumi n'enkumi ibiri, nyimukye, nkurate Daudi eki kiro
en: Moreover Ahithophel said unto Absalom, Let me now choose out twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue after David this night:

rr: niinyija kumugwaho aruhire, atakiine maani, mmutiinise, abantu boona abu aine bahungye, nyite omugabe wenka
en: and I will come upon him while he is weary and weak handed, and will make him afraid: and all the people that are with him shall flee; and I will smite the king only:

rr: haza abantu boona mbakugarurire. Manya eki orikwenda n'okwita omuntu omwe, reero abantu boona bakagira obusingye.
en: and I will bring back all the people unto thee: the man whom thou seekest is as if all returned: so all the people shall be in peace.

rr: Enaama egyo yaasiimwa Abusalomu n'abakuru ba Israeli boona.
en: And the saying pleased Absalom well, and all the elders of Israel.

rr: 2 Bwanyima Abusalomu yaagira ati: Mwete Hushai mwene Aruki, nawe tuhurire eki arikugamba.
en: Then said Absalom, Call now Hushai the Archite also, and let us hear likewise what he saith.

rr: Hushai ku yaahikire ahari Abusalomu, Abusalomu yaamugira ati: Ahisofeeli yaatugambira ati n'ati; mbwenu tukore nk'oku yaagamba? Ku oraabe otarikukisiima, naiiwe otugambire.
en: And when Hushai was come to Absalom, Absalom spake unto him, saying, Ahithophel hath spoken after this manner: shall we do after his saying? if not; speak thou.

rr: Hushai yaagarukamu Abusalomu ati: Obwengye obu Ahisofeeli yaaha eri izooba ti burungi.
en: And Hushai said unto Absalom, The counsel that Ahithophel hath given is not good at this time.

rr: Kandi yaagaruka yaagira ati: noomanya sho n'engabo ze ku bari amamanzi; kandi hati bashaariire nk'edubu eyaayakwa ebyana byayo omu ihamba; kandi sho aba rugambwa omu kurwana, tarikwenda kuraara mu bantu.
en: For, said Hushai, thou knowest thy father and his men, that they be mighty men, and they be chafed in their minds, as a bear robbed of her whelps in the field: and thy father is a man of war, and will not lodge with the people.

rr: Mbwenu ayesherekire omu kiina nari ahandi. N'ahabw'ekyo ku haraagire abaafa nibakitandika kurwana, oraakihurire weena naija kugira ati: Hafiire abantu baingi omu ba Abusalomu.
en: Behold, he is hid now in some pit, or in some other place: and it will come to pass, when some of them be overthrown at the first, that whosoever heareth it will say, There is a slaughter among the people that follow Absalom.

rr: Ekyo nikyija kureetera omuntu weena kuhahaara, n'obu yaakuba ari emanzi aine omutima nk'ogw'entare, ahabw'okuba Abaisraeli boona nibamanya sho ku ari emanzi, kandi n'abu aine boona ku bari amamanzi.
en: And he also that is valiant, whose heart is as the heart of a lion, shall utterly melt: for all Israel knoweth that thy father is a mighty man, and they which be with him are valiant men.

rr: Kureka nyowe obwengye obu ndikukuha n'obu. Teeranira hamwe Abaisraeli boona, okutandikira Daani okuhika Beeri-sheba, bangane n'omusheenyi gw'aha rubaju rw'enyanja obwingi, kandi naiwe wenka ohurure nabo.
en: Therefore I counsel that all Israel be generally gathered unto thee, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, as the sand that is by the sea for multitude; and that thou go to battle in thine own person.

rr: Tutyo nitwija kumugwaho ahu turaamushangye hoona, tumutondeho nk'oku orume rutonda ahansi; we n'abantu abu aine boona, titurikwija kutsigaho n'omwe.
en: So shall we come upon him in some place where he shall be found, and we will light upon him as the dew falleth on the ground: and of him and of all the men that are with him there shall not be left so much as one.

rr: Kandi ku araahungire omu rurembo, nabwo Abaisraeli boona nibaija kureeta emirunga, turukumbagaze omu ruhanga, okuhitsya obu ruraahweho, hatatsigareho kabaare na kamwe.
en: Moreover, if he be gotten into a city, then shall all Israel bring ropes to that city, and we will draw it into the river, until there be not one small stone found there.

rr: Abusalomu n'Abaisraeli boona baagira bati: obwengye bwa Hushai mwene Aruki bwakira obwa Ahisofeeli. Ahabw'okuba MUKAMA akaba ataireho enaama y'okushiisha obwengye burungi bwa Ahisofeeli, ngu abone kureetera Abusalomu akabi. Batabani b'abanyamurwa okugambira Daudi enaama za Abusalomu
en: And Absalom and all the men of Israel said, The counsel of Hushai the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel. For the LORD had appointed to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel, to the intent that the LORD might bring evil upon Absalom.

rr: Bwanyima Hushai yaagira Zadoki na Abiasaari abanyamurwa ati: Obwengye obu Ahisofeeli ahaire Abusalomu n'abakuru ba israeli n'obu; kwonka nyowe obu mmuhaire ni buti na buti.
en: Then said Hushai unto Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, Thus and thus did Ahithophel counsel Absalom and the elders of Israel; and thus and thus have I counselled.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo mutume juba ahari Daudi muti: Eki kiro otaraara aha nyambukiro y'eihamba; oyambukye, hatagira ekyakuzibira, omugabe atakaamirwa n'abantu abu aine boona.
en: Now therefore send quickly, and tell David, saying, Lodge not this night in the plains of the wilderness, but speedily pass over; lest the king be swallowed up, and all the people that are with him.

rr: Kandi Yonasaani na Ahimaazi bakaba bari Eni-rogeli bategyereize; omuzaana yaaguma naija naabibagambira, nabo nibaza kubigambira omugabe Daudi; ahakuba bakaba batarikwikirizibwa kutaaha omu rurembo nibareebwa.
en: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz stayed by En-rogel; for they might not be seen to come into the city: and a wench went and told them; and they went and told king David.

rr: kwonka haagira omwojo owaabareeba, yaagambira Abusalomu. Abo batsigazi bombi baagyenda nibeehuta, baahika Bahurimu, baataaha omu nju y'omushaija owaabaire aine eiziba omu kibuga kye; baarizamu.
en: Nevertheless a lad saw them, and told Absalom: but they went both of them away quickly, and came to a man's house in Bahurim, which had a well in his court; whither they went down.

rr: Omukazi yaagira ekifundikizo, yaakita aha munwa gwaryo, yaakyanikaho omushekure gw'engano; tikyamanywa.
en: And the woman took and spread a covering over the well's mouth, and spread ground corn thereon; and the thing was not known.

rr: Abambari ba Abusalomu baahika aha nju, baabuuza omukazi bati: Ahimaazi na Yonasaani barahi?
en: And when Absalom's servants came to the woman to the house, they said, Where is Ahimaaz and Jonathan?

rr: Omukazi yaabagarukamu ati: Baayambuka akagyera.
en: And the woman said unto them, They be gone over the brook of water.

rr: Ku baabasherwire, baabura, baagaruka Yerusaalemu.
en: And when they had sought and could not find them , they returned to Jerusalem.

rr: Ku baaherize kugyenda, abo batsigazi baaruga omu iziba, baagyenda, baagambira Daudi ebi batumirwe; baamugira bati: Mwimukye, murahukye kwambuka omugyera, ahakuba Ahisofeeli aine enaama eti n'eti y'okubarwanisa.
en: And it came to pass, after they were departed, that they came up out of the well, and went and told king David, and said unto David, Arise, and pass quickly over the water: for thus hath Ahithophel counselled against you.

rr: Atyo Daudi yaimuka n'abantu abu yaabaire aine boona, baayambuka Yorudani; omushekye ku gwagiire kujuguta, haashangwa hatakiine n'omwe otakambukire.
en: Then David arose, and all the people that were with him, and they passed over Jordan: by the morning light there lacked not one of them that was not gone over Jordan.

rr: Ahisofeeli ku yaareebire obwengye bwe butaikirizibwa, yaatandiika endogoya ye, yaimuka, yaataaha owe omu rurembo rw'owaabo; yaatebeekanisa eby'omu ka ye, yaayehanika, yaafa, baamuziika omu kituuro kya ishe.
en: And when Ahithophel saw that his counsel was not followed, he saddled his ass, and arose, and gat him home to his house, to his city, and put his household in order, and hanged himself, and died, and was buried in the sepulchre of his father.

rr: Bwanyima Daudi yaahika Mahanaimu. Abusalomu nawe yaayambuka Yorudani n'Abaisraeli boona.
en: Then David came to Mahanaim. And Absalom passed over Jordan, he and all the men of Israel with him.

rr: Kandi Abusalomu akaba ataireho Amasa kuba omukuru w'eihe omu mwanya gwa Yoabu. Kandi Amasa ogwo akaba ari mutabani w'omushaija orikwetwa Itura Omuishimaeli, owaashweire Abigaili muhara wa Nahashi, murumuna wa Zeruiya nyina wa Yoabu.
en: And Absalom made Amasa captain of the host instead of Joab: which Amasa was a man's son, whose name was Ithra an Israelite, that went in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash, sister to Zeruiah Joab's mother.

rr: Bwanyima Abaisraeli na Abusalomu baasiisira omu nsi ya Gileadi.
en: So Israel and Absalom pitched in the land of Gilead.

rr: Daudi ku yaahikire Mahanaimu, Shobi mwene Nahashi owa Rabba ey'Abaamoni, na Makiri mwene Amieli owa Lodebaari, na Baruzilai Omunyagileadi owa Rogelimu
en: And it came to pass, when David was come to Mahanaim, that Shobi the son of Nahash of Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and Machir the son of Ammiel of Lo-debar, and Barzillai the Gileadite of Rogelim,

rr: baareeta ebitanda, enyabya, enyungu, engano, sayiri, esaano, engano zikarangire, ebihimba, enkoore zikarangire
en: brought beds, and basons, and earthen vessels, and wheat, and barley, and flour, and parched corn , and beans, and lentiles, and parched pulse ,

rr: obwoki, amajuta, entaama n'encumate za ciizi, baabireetera Daudi n'abantu abu yaabaire aine kubafungurira; ahakuba bakagira bati: Abantu baine enjara, baruhire, kandi baitiirwe eiriho omu ihamba.
en: and honey, and butter, and sheep, and cheese of kine, for David, and for the people that were with him, to eat: for they said, The people is hungry, and weary, and thirsty, in the wilderness.

rr: Currently Selected: 2 Samueli 17 : RR64 Highlight Share <path d="M5 12a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h3a1 1 0 1 1 0 2H6a1 1 0 0 1-1-1ZM5
en: Currently Selected: 2 Samuel 17 : KJV Highlight Share <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.

rr: Daudi yaabara abantu abu yaabaire aine, yaataho abantu kuba abakuru b'engabo rukumi-rukumi n'aba igana-igana.
en: And David numbered the people that were with him, and set captains of thousands and captains of hundreds over them.

rr: Yaagaba engabo, ekicweka kimwe kya kashatu yaakiha Yoabu, ekindi yaakiha Abishai mwene Zeruiya, murumuna wa Yoabu, n'ekindi yaakiha Itaayi owa Gaasi.
en: And David sent forth a third part of the people under the hand of Joab, and a third part under the hand of Abishai the son of Zeruiah, Joab's brother, and a third part under the hand of Ittai the Gittite.

rr: Omugabe yaagira abantu ati: Naanye ahabwangye niinyija kuhurura naimwe.
en: And the king said unto the people, I will surely go forth with you myself also.

rr: Kwonka abantu baamugira bati: Iwe torikwija kuhurura; ahabw'okuba ku turaahungye, tibarikwija kutufaho; nangwa n'obu ekicweka kimwe kya kabiri ky'abantu baintu kyakufa, nabwo tibakaatufaho; ahakube iwe noingana n'abantu baitu kakumi; n'ahabw'ekyo haakiri ogume omu rurembo, otwoherereze ab'okutuha emikono.
en: But the people answered, Thou shalt not go forth: for if we flee away, they will not care for us; neither if half of us die, will they care for us: but now thou art worth ten thousand of us: therefore now it is better that thou succour us out of the city.

rr: Omugabe yaabagira ati: Eki murikusiima nikyo ndaakore.
en: And the king said unto them, What seemeth you best I will do.

rr: Bwanyima omugabe yaayemerera aha irembo, engabo zoona nizishohora omu mitwe ya igana-igana na rukumi-rukumi.
en: And the king stood by the gate side, and all the people came out by hundreds and by thousands.

rr: Omugabe yaayehangangiriza Yoabu na Abishai na Itaayi ati: Mutwaze gye ogwo mwojo Abusalomu ahabwangye.
en: And the king commanded Joab and Abishai and Ittai, saying, Deal gently for my sake with the young man, even with Absalom.

rr: Kandi abantu boona baahurira omugabe naayehanangiriza abakuru b'engabo ebya Abusalomu.
en: And all the people heard when the king gave all the captains charge concerning Absalom.

rr: Batyo abantu baaza kurwanira n'Abaisraeli omu ishwa; orugamba rwatengyerwa omu kibira kya Efuraimu.
en: So the people went out into the field against Israel: and the battle was in the wood of Ephraim;

rr: Abaisraeli baasingurirwayo abashaija ba Daudi; kandi eryo izooba haafa abantu obukumi bubiri
en: where the people of Israel were slain before the servants of David, and there was there a great slaughter that day of twenty thousand men .

rr: ahakuba orugamba rukaba rujanjaire omuri egyo ensi yoona; eryo izooba ekibira kyamara abantu baingi okukira abaitsirwe rurara.
en: For the battle was there scattered over the face of all the country: and the wood devoured more people that day than the sword devoured. Death of Absalom

rr: Abusalomu yaabugaabugana n'abashaija ba Daudi atakimanyire.
en: And Absalom met the servants of David.

rr: Kandi Abusalomu akaba atembire enyumbu ye; egyo nyumbu yaamurabya ahansi y'amataagi g'omwela muhango agakwataine; omutwe gwe gwakwatirwa omuri ago mataagi, yaaguma, naareereetera omu mwanya, enyumbu ei yaabaire atembire yaagumizamu.
en: And Absalom rode upon a mule, and the mule went under the thick boughs of a great oak, and his head caught hold of the oak, and he was taken up between the heaven and the earth; and the mule that was under him went away.

rr: Omushaija yaamureeba, yaagambira Yoabu ati: Naareeba Abusalomu ari omu mwela naareereeta.
en: And a certain man saw it , and told Joab, and said, Behold, I saw Absalom hanged in an oak.

rr: Yoabu yaabuuza owaamugambira ati: Ot'enki! Waamureeba! Ahabw'enki otaamucumita, okamutuura ahansi? Naaba ninkuha ebicweka by'efeeza ikumi n'orukoba.
en: And Joab said unto the man that told him, And, behold, thou sawest him , and why didst thou not smite him there to the ground? and I would have given thee ten shekels of silver, and a girdle.

rr: Kandi hoona kuri naabitwaza okundi, nkamureebya, (manya omugabe tagira ki asherekwa,) iwe waaba noija kubyejuura.
en: Otherwise I should have wrought falsehood against mine own life: for there is no matter hid from the king, and thou thyself wouldest have set thyself against me .

rr: Yoabu yaagira ati: Tinaaza kusiisira mwanya gwangye busha ningamba naiwe.
en: Then said Joab, I may not tarry thus with thee.

rr: Yaakwata emyambi eshatu omu ngaro, yaagitimbura Abusalomu omu mutima, akiri omu mwela ahuriire.
en: And he took three darts in his hand, and thrust them through the heart of Absalom, while he was yet alive in the midst of the oak.

rr: Bwanyima abatsigazi ikumi abatwazi b'eby'okurwanisa bya Yoabu baayehinguririza Abusalomu, baamurezya, yaafa.
en: And ten young men that bare Joab's armour compassed about and smote Absalom, and slew him.

rr: Yoabu yaateera enzamba, engabo zaagaruka, zaareereera kukurata Abaisraeli, ahabw'okuzibirwa Yoabu.
en: And Joab blew the trumpet, and the people returned from pursuing after Israel: for Joab held back the people.

rr: Kandi Abusalomu, obu yaabaire akihuriire, akatwara enyomyo, yaagibyara omu ruhanga rw'omugabe; ahabw'okuba akagira ati: Tiinyine mwana w'omwojo, ou bariijukiraho eiziina ryangye; kandi egyo nyomyo yaagyeyeterera; n'okuhitsya hati neekyetwa enyomo y'ekiijutsyo kya Abusalomu. Omugabe okubikirwa Abusalomu
en: Now Absalom in his lifetime had taken and reared up for himself a pillar, which is in the king's dale: for he said, I have no son to keep my name in remembrance: and he called the pillar after his own name: and it is called unto this day, Absalom's place.

rr: Bwanyima Ahimaazi mwene Zadoki yaagira ati: ka nyirukye ngambire omugabe ag'aha rugamba, n'oku MUKAMA yaamuhoorera enzigu aha bazigu be.
en: Then said Ahimaaz the son of Zadok, Let me now run, and bear the king tidings, how that the LORD hath avenged him of his enemies.

rr: Yoabu yaamugira ati: Otaza kugamba amakuru eri izooba, kureka ogagambe obundi. Kwonka eri izooba orekye kugagamba, ahabw'okuba omwana w'omugabe yaafa.
en: And Joab said unto him, Thou shalt not bear tidings this day, but thou shalt bear tidings another day: but this day thou shalt bear no tidings, because the king's son is dead.

rr: Yoabu yaagira Omukuushi ati: Irooko ogyende, ogambire omugabe ebi waareeba. Atyo Omukuushi yainama omu maisho ga Yoabu, yairuka.
en: Then said Joab to Cushi, Go tell the king what thou hast seen. And Cushi bowed himself unto Joab, and ran.

rr: Ahimaazi mwene Zadoki yaagaruka yaagira Yoabu ati: Ninkweshengyereza, ka nyirukye nkurate oriya Mukuushi, oku biraabe bibekwo.
en: Then said Ahimaaz the son of Zadok yet again to Joab, But howsoever, let me, I pray thee, also run after Cushi.

rr: Yoabu yaagira ati: Noirukibwa ki, mwana wangye, ka noomanya ku otakiheebwa bihembo ahabw'ago makuru?
en: And Joab said, Wherefore wilt thou run, my son, seeing that thou hast no tidings ready?

rr: Onu yaagira ati: Ekiraabe kyabaire kibe, naaza kugyenda.
en: But howsoever, said he , let me run.

rr: Yoabu ati: Iruka.
en: And he said unto him, Run.

rr: Atyo Ahimaazi yairuka, yaatoora ogw'oruhita, yaatangayo Omukuushi.
en: Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the plain, and overran Cushi.

rr: Kandi Daudi akaba ashutami ahagati y'amarembo abiri; omurinzi yaatemba aha mutwe gw'eirembo, yaayemerera aha rugo rw'amabaare; ku yaanagire amaisho, yaareeba omuntu nairuka wenka.
en: And David sat between the two gates: and the watchman went up to the roof over the gate unto the wall, and lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold a man running alone.

rr: Omurinzi yaayeta, yaagambira omugabe.
en: And the watchman cried, and told the king.

rr: Omugabe yaagira ati: ku araabe ari wenka, aine amakuru agu areetsire.
en: And the king said, If he be alone, there is tidings in his mouth.

rr: Ogwo muntu yaija naayehuuta, yaahika haihi.
en: And he came apace, and drew near.

rr: Bwanyima omurinzi yaareeba ondiijo mushaija nairuka; yaayeta omukumiirizi, yaamugira ati: Reeba ondiijo mushaija nairuka wenka.
en: And the watchman saw another man running: and the watchman called unto the porter, and said, Behold another man running alone.

rr: Omugabe yaagira ati: Nawe areetsire amakuru.
en: And the king said, He also bringeth tidings.

rr: Omurinzi yaagira ati: Okundikureeba, okwiruka kw'oyebembeire nikushusha okwa Ahimaazi mwene Zadoki.
en: And the watchman said, Me thinketh the running of the foremost is like the running of Ahimaaz the son of Zadok.

rr: Omugabe yaagira ati: Ava omushaija murungi, naija kureeta amakuru marungi.
en: And the king said, He is a good man, and cometh with good tidings.

rr: Ahimaazi yaagambira omugabe n'eiraka rihango, ati: Huumura, ni buhooro.
en: And Ahimaaz called, and said unto the king, All is well.

rr: Yainama omu maisho g'omugabe, yaagira ati: MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe ahimbisibwe, ohaireyo abashaija ababaire babangire emikono kurwanisa mukama wangye omugabe.
en: And he fell down to the earth upon his face before the king, and said, Blessed be the LORD thy God, which hath delivered up the men that lifted up their hand against my lord the king.

rr: Omugabe yaamubuuza ati: Omwojo ori Abusalomu ari buhooro?
en: And the king said, Is the young man Absalom safe?

rr: Ahimaazi yaagarukamu ati: Yoabu obu yantuma, nyowe omwiru waawe naareeba abantu nibayogoorekana; kwonka tinaamanya kyaba kiriho.
en: And Ahimaaz answered, When Joab sent the king's servant, and me thy servant, I saw a great tumult, but I knew not what it was .

rr: Omugabe yaamugira ati: Hingura, oyemerere aha. Atyo yaahingura, yaayemerera.
en: And the king said unto him , Turn aside, and stand here. And he turned aside, and stood still.

rr: Omugabe yaabuuza Omukuushi ati: Omwojo ori Abusalomu ari buhooro?
en: And the king said unto Cushi, Is the young man Absalom safe?

rr: Omukuushi yaamugarukamu ati: Abazigu ba mukama wangye omugabe, n'abantu boona abaimukire kukukora kubi, nibakabe nk'ogwo mwojo.
en: And Cushi answered, The enemies of my lord the king, and all that rise against thee to do thee hurt, be as that young man is .

rr: Omugabe yaashaasha munonga, yaatemba omu kishengye ky'aha mutwe gw'eirembo, yaarira; ku yaabaire naagyenda, yaagyenda naagira ati: Ai bambe omwana wangye Abusalomu! Omwana wangye, Omwana wangye Abusalomu! Kuri niinye naafa omu mwanya gwawe, ai bambe Abusalomu, mwana wangye, mwana wangye! rr: Bwanyima baagira Yoabu bati: Reeba, omugabe naacurira Abusalomu.
en: And it was told Joab, Behold, the king weepeth and mourneth for Absalom.

rr: Eryo izooba okwesiima kw'obusinguzi kwahinduka okucura omu bantu boona; ahakuba eryo izooba abantu bakahurira ngu omugabe ari omu naku ahabw'omwana we.
en: And the victory that day was turned into mourning unto all the people: for the people heard say that day how the king was grieved for his son.

rr: Kandi abantu baagaruka omu rurembo nibashobooka, nk'abantu abacwire aha rugamba oku bashoobooka baine enshoni.
en: And the people gat them by stealth that day into the city, as people being ashamed steal away when they flee in battle.

rr: Omugabe yaayetwekyerera ahamaisho, yaacura n'eiraka rihango ati: Ai bambe omwana wangye Abusalomu, Abusalomu, mwana wangye, mwana wangye!
en: But the king covered his face, and the king cried with a loud voice, O my son Absalom, O Absalom, my son, my son!

rr: Yoabu yaataaha omu nju, yaahika omugabe, yaamugira ati: Eri izooba waahemura abagaragwa baawe boona, abakirize amagara gaawe hati, n'aga batabani baawe na bahara baawe, kandi n'ag'abakazi baawe n'ebinyanshunju byawe
en: And Joab came into the house to the king, and said, Thou hast shamed this day the faces of all thy servants, which this day have saved thy life, and the lives of thy sons and of thy daughters, and the lives of thy wives, and the lives of thy concubines;

rr: ahabw'eokuba nookunda abarikukwanga, nooyanga abarikukunda.
en: in that thou lovest thine enemies, and hatest thy friends.

rr: Mbwenu waayorekyera kimwe ku abakuru b'engabo n'abagaragwa baawe bari busha ahariiwe; hati naamanya ngu, kuri Abusalomu agumireho, abandi twena tukafa eri izooba, kuri nooyesiima munonga.
en: For thou hast declared this day, that thou regardest neither princes nor servants: for this day I perceive, that if Absalom had lived, and all we had died this day, then it had pleased thee well.

rr: Mbwenu hati imuka, oshohore, ogambe gye n'abairu baawe; ahakuba nindahira MUKAMA, ku oraabe otashohoire, tihariho mushaija n'omwe, oraatsigare naiwe eki kiro; kandi kiryakurugiramu akabi okukira akabi koona aku orareebire okwiha omu buto bwawe n'okuhitsya hati.
en: Now therefore arise, go forth, and speak comfortably unto thy servants: for I swear by the LORD , if thou go not forth, there will not tarry one with thee this night: and that will be worse unto thee than all the evil that befell thee from thy youth until now.

rr: Omugabe nikwo kwimuka, akashutama aha irembo, bakagambira abantu boona bati: Reeba, omugabe ashutami aha irembo.
en: Then the king arose, and sat in the gate.

rr: Bwanyima abantu boona baija kutabaarira omugabe.
en: And they told unto all the people, saying, Behold, the king doth sit in the gate.

rr: Abaisraeli n'Abayuda okucuma enaama y'okugarura Daudi Obwo Abaisraeli boona bakaba bahungire, buri muntu agarukire omu ka ye.
en: And all the people came before the king: for Israel had fled every man to his tent.

rr: 2 -14 ; 15:14 . Bwanyima abantu boona ab'enganda zoona z'Abaisraeli baagarukanamu nibagira bati: Omugabe niwe yaatwihire omu mikono y'abazigu baitu, akatukiza Abafilistia; mbwenu ahungire Abusalomu yaaruga aha ngoma.
en: And all the people were at strife throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, The king saved us out of the hand of our enemies, and he delivered us out of the hand of the Philistines; and now he is fled out of the land for Absalom.

rr: Na Abusalomu ou twashukireho amajuta kututegyeka, agwire omu rugamba.
en: And Absalom, whom we anointed over us, is dead in battle.

rr: Mbwenu nimuzibirwa ki kuhanuura aha by'okugarura omugabe?
en: Now therefore why speak ye not a word of bringing the king back?

rr: Bwanyima omugabe Daudi yaatuma ahari Zadoki na Abiasaari abanyamurwa naagira ati: Mubuuze abakuru b'Abayuda muti: Ahabw'enki niiwe mwaza kuheererukira abandi kugarura omugabe omu ka ye, haza enaama, ei Abaisraeli boona bacumire kumugarura, emuhikire.
en: And king David sent to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, saying, Speak unto the elders of Judah, saying, Why are ye the last to bring the king back to his house? seeing the speech of all Israel is come to the king, even to his house.

rr: Niimwe beene tata; niimwe baitu ab'aha mara; mbwenu ahabw'enki mwaza kuheererukira abandi kugarura omugabe?
en: Ye are my brethren, ye are my bones and my flesh: wherefore then are ye the last to bring back the king?

rr: Kandi mugambire na Amasa muti: Torikumanya iwe naanye ku turi ab'enda emwe?
en: And say ye to Amasa, Art thou not of my bone, and of my flesh?

rr: Ku oraabe otabaire omukuru w'eihe ryangye okuruga hati omu mwanya gwa Yoabu, Ruhanga akinture n'okukiraho.
en: God do so to me, and more also, if thou be not captain of the host before me continually in the room of Joab.

rr: Yaayekubuurira emitima y'Abayuda boona nk'omutima gw'omuntu omwe. Ekyarugiremu baatuma aha mugabe bati: Garuka n'abagaragwa baawe boona.
en: And he bowed the heart of all the men of Judah, even as the heart of one man; so that they sent this word unto the king, Return thou, and all thy servants.

rr: Atyo omugabe yaagaruka, yaahika ahari Yorudani.
en: So the king returned, and came to Jordan.

rr: Abayuda baaza Gilugaali kumubugana kumwabutsya Yorudani.
en: And Judah came to Gilgal, to go to meet the king, to conduct the king over Jordan.

rr: Shimei okushaba omugabe kumusaasira
en: David's Return

rr: Bwanyima Shimei mwene Geera Omubenyamiini owa Bahurimu yaayehuuta, yaashuuma n'Abayuda kubugana omugabe Daudi
en: And Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite, which was of Bahurim, hasted and came down with the men of Judah to meet king David.

rr: 2 aine abashaija rukumi b'Ababenyamiini, na Ziiba omugaragwa w'enju ya Saulo n'abatabani n'abairu be makumi abiri; baayambuka Yorudani omugabe naabareeba.
en: And there were a thousand men of Benjamin with him, and Ziba the servant of the house of Saul, and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him; and they went over Jordan before the king.

rr: Obwato bwasiiba nibwambutsya ab'omu ka y'omugabe, n'okukora eki arikwenda.
en: And there went over a ferry boat to carry over the king's household, and to do what he thought good.

rr: Omugabe ku yaaherize kwambuka Yorudani, Shimei mwene Geera yaajuumara ahansi omu maisho ge.
en: And Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king, as he was come over Jordan;

rr: Yaagira omugabe ati: Nyakusinga omugabe, otambarira okutahikiirira, kandi otaijuka eki omwiru waawe yaakozire n'obugomi aha izooba eri waarugiireho Yerusaalemu, mukama wangye, kandi birekye kukusaasa.
en: and said unto the king, Let not my lord impute iniquity unto me, neither do thou remember that which thy servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem, that the king should take it to his heart.

rr: Ahakuba nyowe, omwiru waawe, nimmanya ku naacumwire; nikyo eri izooba naabandiza ab'enju ya Yosefu boona kushuuma kubugana mukama wangye omugabe.
en: For thy servant doth know that I have sinned: therefore, behold, I am come the first this day of all the house of Joseph to go down to meet my lord the king.

rr: Kwonka Abishai mwene Zeruiya yaagira ati: Beitu Shimei tarikwija kwitwa, ahabw'okujuma ou MUKAMA yaashukireho amajuta?
en: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered and said, Shall not Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed the LORD 's anointed?

rr: Daudi yaagira ati: Mbwenu imwe beene Zeruiya, nyine kakwate ki naimwe, mwaza kuunyimukiza obuzigu eri izooba? Nimugira ngu hariho ow'okwitwa omuri Israeli eri izooba? Nari shi tindikumanya ku ndi omugabe wa Israeli eri izooba?
en: And David said, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Zeruiah, that ye should this day be adversaries unto me? shall there any man be put to death this day in Israel? for do not I know that I am this day king over Israel?

rr: Omugabe yaagira Shimei ati: Torikwija kufa. Yaamurahira. Ebya Mefiboshesi
en: Therefore the king said unto Shimei, Thou shalt not die. And the king sware unto him.

rr: Bwanyima Mefiboshesi mwene Saulo yaashuuma kubugana omugabe; kandi okwiha obu omugabe yaagyenda okuhitsya aha izooba eri yaagarukiireho omuka n'obusingye, akaba atakanaabaga bigyere, nari okutuubya aha bireju, n'obu kwakuba okwozya ebijwaro bye.
en: And Mephibosheth the son of Saul came down to meet the king, and had neither dressed his feet, nor trimmed his beard, nor washed his clothes, from the day the king departed until the day he came again in peace.

rr: Ku yaahikire Yerusaalemu kubugana omugabe, omugabe yaamubuuza ati: Beitu Mefiboshesi, n'enki ekyakuzibiire kugyenda naanye?
en: And it came to pass, when he was come to Jerusalem to meet the king, that the king said unto him, Wherefore wentest not thou with me, Mephibosheth?

rr: Yaamugarukamu ati: Nyakusinga omugabe, omwiru wangye akambeiha; ahakuba nyowe omwiru waawe nkaba ngizire nti: Niinyija kutandiika endogoya, ngizeho, ngyende n'omugabe, ahakuba omwiru waawe ndi ekimuga.
en: And he answered, My lord, O king, my servant deceived me: for thy servant said, I will saddle me an ass, that I may ride thereon, and go to the king; because thy servant is lame.

rr: Kandi akambeiherera ahari mukama wangye; kwonka mukama wangye omugabe ni nka maraika wa Ruhanga; omugabe n'ahabw'ekyo okore eki orikusiima.
en: And he hath slandered thy servant unto my lord the king; but my lord the king is as an angel of God: do therefore what is good in thine eyes.

rr: Ahakuba ab'omu ka ya tata boona bakaba bacwereirwe orubanja rw'okufa omu maisho ga mukama wangye omugabe; haza wanshutamya n'abarikuriira aha meeza yaawe.
en: For all of my father's house were but dead men before my lord the king: yet didst thou set thy servant among them that did eat at thine own table.

rr: Mbwenu nimbaasa nta kugaruka kutakira omugabe?
en: What right therefore have I yet to cry any more unto the king?

rr: Omugabe yaamugira ati: Ahabw'enki noogaruka omu bigambo? Naabiheza. Iwe na Ziiba mubagane ekibanja.
en: And the king said unto him, Why speakest thou any more of thy matters? I have said, Thou and Ziba divide the land.

rr: Mefiboshesi yaagira omugabe ati: Iwe, reka akitware kyona, niho mukama wangye omugabe yaagaruka omu ka ye n'obusingye. Daudi okusiima Baruzilai
en: And Mephibosheth said unto the king, Yea, let him take all, forasmuch as my lord the king is come again in peace unto his own house.

rr: Kandi Baruzilai Omunyagileadi yaashuuma naaruga Rogelimu, yaayambua Yorudani n'omugabe kumuhitsya seeri.
en: And Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim, and went over Jordan with the king, to conduct him over Jordan.

rr: 2 Baruzilai ogwo akaba ari omugurusi munonga aine emyaka makumi munaana; kandi niwe yaabaire agyemurira omugabe obu yaabaire ari Mahanaimu; ahakuba akaba ari omushaija ohamire.
en: Now Barzillai was a very aged man, even fourscore years old: and he had provided the king of sustenance while he lay at Mahanaim; for he was a very great man.

rr: Omugabe yaagira Baruzilai ati: Ija twambukane, tuze Yerusaalemu; niinyija kugama ninkuriisa.
en: And the king said unto Barzillai, Come thou over with me, and I will feed thee with me in Jerusalem.

rr: Kwonka Baruzilai yaagira omugabe ati: Ntsigaizeyo emyaka engahi, eyaakungyema kwinamuka n'omugabe Yerusaalemu?
en: And Barzillai said unto the king, How long have I to live, that I should go up with the king unto Jerusalem?

rr: Eri izooba naahitsya emyaka makumi munaana. Mbwenu ninkibaasa kutaanisa ekirungi n'ekibi? Omwiru waawe naakinurirwa ebi arikurya nari ebi arikunywa? Nkiine agahurira amaraka g'abashaija nari abakazi abarikweshongora? Mbwenu omwiru waawe asiibe naaruhiza ki mukama wangye omugabe?
en: I am this day fourscore years old: and can I discern between good and evil? can thy servant taste what I eat or what I drink? can I hear any more the voice of singing men and singing women? wherefore then should thy servant be yet a burden unto my lord the king?

rr: Omwiru waawe k'afe okwambuka n'omugabe Yorudani, amuhitsye hariya seeri. Ahabw'enki omugabe ashemereire kumpa ebihembo ebirikwinga bityo?
en: Thy servant will go a little way over Jordan with the king: and why should the king recompense it me with such a reward?

rr: Ninkweshengyereza, nyowe omwiru waawe ka ngarukyeyo, ngwe omu rurembo rw'owaitu, ahu ekituuro kya tata na maawe kiri.
en: Let thy servant, I pray thee, turn back again, that I may die in mine own city, and be buried by the grave of my father and of my mother.

rr: Kwonka reeba omwiru waawe Kimuhaamu ngugu; abe niwe yaayambuka na mukama wangye omugabe, omutwaze nk'oku orikwenda.
en: But behold thy servant Chimham; let him go over with my lord the king; and do to him what shall seem good unto thee.

rr: Omugabe yaamugarukamu ati: Mbwenu Kimuhaamu naarabeho twambukye; niinyija kuguma nimmukorera, eki orikwenda kyona; kandi naiwe eki orinshaba kyona, ndaykikukorera.
en: And the king answered, Chimham shall go over with me, and I will do to him that which shall seem good unto thee: and whatsoever thou shalt require of me, that will I do for thee.

rr: Batyo abantu boona baayambuka Yorudani; n'omugabe nawe yaayambuka.
en: And all the people went over Jordan.

rr: Omugabe yaanywegyera Baruzilai, yaamushabira omugisha; bwanyima onu yaagaruka owaabo.
en: And when the king was come over, the king kissed Barzillai, and blessed him; and he returned unto his own place.

rr: Okwo nikwo omugabe yaayambukire, akaza Giligaali, na Kimuhaamu akambuka nawe. Batyo Abayuda boona hamwe n'ekicweka ky'Abaisraeli baayambutsya omugabe.
en: Then the king went on to Gilgal, and Chimham went on with him: and all the people of Judah conducted the king, and also half the people of Israel.

rr: Bwanyima Abaisraeli boona baija aha mugabe, baamugira bati: Ahabw'enki beene waitu Abayuda baakutwaire bwesherekye, bakakwambutsya Yorudaani n'ab'eka yaawe boona n'abagaragwa baawe boona?
en: And, behold, all the men of Israel came to the king, and said unto the king, Why have our brethren the men of Judah stolen thee away, and have brought the king, and his household, and all David's men with him, over Jordan?

rr: Abayuda boona baagarukamu Abaisraeli bati: N'ahabw'okuba omugabe aine obuzaare bwa haihi naitwe. Beitu shi imwe kibagwisiize ki kubi? Nimugira ngu twine eky'omugabe eki turiire? Nari shi hariho ekiconco kyona eki atuhaire?
en: And all the men of Judah answered the men of Israel, Because the king is near of kin to us: wherefore then be ye angry for this matter? have we eaten at all of the king's cost? or hath he given us any gift?

rr: Abaisraeli baagarukamu Abayuda bati: Itwe twine emigabo ikumi omu mugabe, kandi Daudi n'owaitu kukira imwe. Mbwenu shi mutugayiire ki? Tiitwe tubandize kuhanuura eby'okugarura omugabe waitu? Kwonka ebigambo by'Abayuda byashaarira okukira eby'Abaisraeli. Currently Selected: 2 Samueli 19 : RR64 Highlight Share <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24"
en: And the men of Israel answered the men of Judah, and said, We have ten parts in the king, and we have also more right in David than ye: why then did ye despise us, that our advice should not be first had in bringing back our king? And the words of the men of Judah were fiercer than the words of the men of Israel. Currently Selected: 2 Samuel 19 : KJV Highlight Share <path d="M5 12a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h3a1 1 0

rr: Omu bunaku obwo hakabaho omushaija otaine ku ari, orikwetwa Sheeba mwene Bikuri Omubenyamiini; yaateera enzamba naagira ati: Titwine mugabo omuri Daudi N'obu bwakuba obuhunguzi omuri mwene Yese. Imwe Baisraeli 'mwe, buri muntu agarukye omu ihema rye!
en: And there happened to be there a man of Belial, whose name was Sheba, the son of Bichri, a Benjamite: and he blew a trumpet, and said, We have no part in David, neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to his tents, O Israel.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo Abaisraeli boona baarereera kukuratira Daudi, baakuratira Sheeba mwene Bikuri; kwonka Abayuda, okuruga Yorudani okuhika Yerusaalemu baahamira aha mugabe waabo.
en: So every man of Israel went up from after David, and followed Sheba the son of Bichri: but the men of Judah clave unto their king, from Jordan even to Jerusalem.

rr: Bwanyima omugabe Daudi yaataha omu nju ye omuri Yerusaalemu; yaatwara abakazi be b'ebinyanshunju, abu yaabaire atsigiire eka ye kugirinda, yaataba omu nju y'okurindirwamu, yaaguma naabaha eby'okubatunga, kwonka tiyaagaruka kubaraarira.
en: And David came to his house at Jerusalem; and the king took the ten women his concubines, whom he had left to keep the house, and put them in ward, and fed them, but went not in unto them.

rr: Batyo baaguma nibarindwa okuhitsya obu baafiire, bari nk'abafaakazi.
en: So they were shut up unto the day of their death, living in widowhood.

rr: Bwanyima omugabe yaagira Amasa ati: Nyetera Abayuda, bateeranire aha ebiro bishatu bitakahweire, haza naiwe obeho.
en: Then said the king to Amasa, Assemble me the men of Judah within three days, and be thou here present.

rr: Atyo Amasa yaaza kuhuruza Abayuda; kwonka yaarenzya ebiro ebi omugabe yaamuragiire.
en: So Amasa went to assemble the men of Judah: but he tarried longer than the set time which he had appointed him.

rr: Daudi nikwo kugira Abishai ati: Mbwenu ho Sheeba mwene Bikuri yaaza kutukora kubi okukira Abusalomu; irooko otware abashaija ba mukama waawe, mumukurate, atakaakubuura endembo ezizitiirwe n'engo z'amabaare, akaguma naatuganzya.
en: And David said to Abishai, Now shall Sheba the son of Bichri do us more harm than did Absalom: take thou thy lord's servants, and pursue after him, lest he get him fenced cities, and escape us.

rr: Abishai yaahurura akuratiirwe abashaija ba Yoabu n'aba Keresi n'aba Pelesi n'amamanzi goona; baaruga Yerusaalemu, kukurata Sheeba mwene Bikuri.
en: And there went out after him Joab's men, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and all the mighty men: and they went out of Jerusalem, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.

rr: Ku baahikire aha ibaare rihango rya Gibeoni, Amasa yaija kubabugana.
en: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa went before them.

rr: Obwo Yoabu akaba ajwaire ebijwaro by'orugamba, abyezirikiise orukoba, oruriho rurara eri aha nyugunyu omu kyobati kyayo; ku yairiireho omumaisho, rurara yaaragara.
en: And Joab's garment that he had put on was girded unto him, and upon it a girdle with a sword fastened upon his loins in the sheath thereof; and as he went forth it fell out.

rr: Yoabu yaagira Amasa ati: Ni buhooro, mwana wa tata?
en: And Joab said to Amasa, Art thou in health, my brother?

rr: Yoabu yaakwata ekireju kya Amasa n'omukono gwe gwa buryo kumunywegyera.
en: And Joab took Amasa by the beard with the right hand to kiss him.

rr: Kwonka Amasa tiyaayeta hari rurara ei Yoabu yaabaire akwaitse; Yoabu nikwo kugimutimbura aha nda, amara ge gakeeshuka ahansi, atagarukye kugimuteera bundi. Atyo Amasa yaafa. Bwanyima Yoabu na Abishai omurumuna baagumizamu kukurata Sheeba mwene Bikuri.
en: But Amasa took no heed to the sword that was in Joab's hand: so he smote him therewith in the fifth rib , and shed out his bowels to the ground, and struck him not again; and he died. So Joab and Abishai his brother pursued after Sheba the son of Bichri.

rr: Omwe aha bashaija ba Yoabu yaayemerera aha rubaju rwa Amasa, yaagira ati: Orikukunda Yoabu, kandi ori aha rubaju rwa Daudi, akuratire Yoabu.
en: And one of Joab's men stood by him, and said, He that favoureth Joab, and he that is for David, let him go after Joab.

rr: Obwo Amasa akaba agarami omu shagama naashamba, ahagati y'omuhanda rugyendwa.
en: And Amasa wallowed in blood in the midst of the highway.

rr: Ogwo mushaija ku yaareebire abantu boona baayemerera aho, yaakiriza Amasa, yaamwiha omu muhanda, yaamurambika omu kishaka, yaamushweka ekijwaro.
en: And when the man saw that all the people stood still, he removed Amasa out of the highway into the field, and cast a cloth upon him, when he saw that every one that came by him stood still.

rr: Ku baamwihire omu muhanda, abantu boona baakuratira Yoabu kuza kusherura Sheeba mwene Bikuri.
en: When he was removed out of the highway, all the people went on after Joab, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.

rr: Sheeba ogwo yaaraba omu nganda za Israeli zoona, yaahika Abeeli eya Besi-maaka, aba Bikuri boona baateerana, baamukurata.
en: And he went through all the tribes of Israel unto Abel, and to Beth-maachah, and all the Berites: and they were gathered together, and went also after him.

rr: Abashaija boona aba Yoabu baamugotera Abeeli eya Besi-maaka; baatuuma omutuumo gw'eitaka aha rugo rw'amabaare rw'orurembo; baatandika kuteera orugo kurukumbagaza.
en: And they came and besieged him in Abel of Beth-maachah, and they cast up a bank against the city, and it stood in the trench: and all the people that were with Joab battered the wall, to throw it down.

rr: Bwanyima omukazi omunyabwengye w'omuri orwo rurembo yaagamba n'eiraka rihango ati: Yeimwe nimuhurire, mbagambire! Mungirire Yoabu muti: Ija kunu, akugambire.
en: Then cried a wise woman out of the city, Hear, hear; say, I pray you, unto Joab, Come near hither, that I may speak with thee.

rr: Yoabu yaamuhika haihi; ogwo mukazi yaamubuuza ati: Ori Yoabu?
en: And when he was come near unto her, the woman said, Art thou Joab?

rr: Onu ati: Ndi we.
en: And he answered, I am he .

rr: Omukazi yaamugira ati: Hurira ebigambo by'omuzaana waawe.
en: Then she said unto him, Hear the words of thine handmaid.

rr: Onu ati: Nimpurira.
en: And he answered, I do hear.

rr: Yaagira ati: ira bakaba bagira ngu, Ka baze kwehanuuza omuri Abeeli. Batyo bamarirayo ekibashobeire.
en: Then she spake, saying, They were wont to speak in old time, saying, They shall surely ask counsel at Abel: and so they ended the matter .

rr: Nyowe ndi omwe ahari abo abakunda obusingye, kandi abarikwesigwa omuri Israeli. Mbwenu nooyenda kucwekyereza orurembo n'omuzaire omuri Israeli. Ahabw'enki nooyenda kumaraho obuhunguzi bwa MUKAMA?
en: I am one of them that are peaceable and faithful in Israel: thou seekest to destroy a city and a mother in Israel: why wilt thou swallow up the inheritance of the LORD ?

rr: Yoabu yaamugarukamu ati: nikikabure! Nikikabure nyowe okumaraho nari okucwekyereza.
en: And Joab answered and said, Far be it, far be it from me, that I should swallow up or destroy.

rr: Ekyo tikwo kiri. Kureka hariho omushaija ow'omu nsi y'ebibungo eya Efuraimu, orikwetwa Sheeba mwene Bikuri, owaabangire omukono gwe kurwanisa omugabe Daudi. Mube niwe mwahayo wenka, mbone kubarugira aha rurembo. Ogwo mukazi yaagira Yoabu ati: Reeba, omutwe gwe twaza kugukutambikira, tugurenzye orugo.
en: The matter is not so: but a man of mount Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, hath lifted up his hand against the king, even against David: deliver him only, and I will depart from the city. And the woman said unto Joab, Behold, his head shall be thrown to thee over the wall.

rr: Ahonaaho ogwo mukazi yaagaruka aha bantu baamwo boona n'obwo bwengye bwe, baatemaho Sheeba mwene Bikuri omutwe, baagutambikira Yoabu. Yoabu yaateera enzamba, abantu boona baataataana, baaruga aha rurembo, buri muntu yaagaruka omu ka ye. Na Yoabu yaatabaaruka, yaaza Yerusaalemu ow'omugabe.
en: Then the woman went unto all the people in her wisdom. And they cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and cast it out to Joab. And he blew a trumpet, and they retired from the city, every man to his tent. And Joab returned to Jerusalem unto the king.

rr: 2 -18 ; 1 Omu bunaku obwo Yoabu niwe yaabaire ari omukuru w'eihe ryona erya Israeli; na Benaaya mwene Yehoyaada ari omukuru w'aba Keresi n'aba Pelesi
en: Now Joab was over all the host of Israel: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites:

rr: Adoraamu ari omushorooza mukuru w'omushoro, Yehoshafaati mwene Ahiluudi ari omuhandiiki w'ebirikubaho
en: and Adoram was over the tribute: and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder:

rr: Sheeva ari omuhandiiki; Zadoki na Abiasaari bari abanyamurwa
en: and Sheva was scribe: and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests:

rr: na Iira owa Yayiri ari enganzi ya Daudi.
en: and Ira also the Jairite was a chief ruler about David.

rr: Omu biro bya Daudi hakabaho enjara okumara emyaka eshatu: Daudi yaayehanuuza ahari MUKAMA.
en: Then there was a famine in the days of David three years, year after year; and David enquired of the LORD .

rr: MUKAMA yaagarukamu ati: Enjara egi eteire ahabwa Saulo n'enju ye y'enyitsi y'abantu, ahabw'okuba akaita aba Gibeoni.
en: And the LORD answered, It is for Saul, and for his bloody house, because he slew the Gibeonites.

rr: Omugabe yaatuma kweta aba Gibeoni. (Aba Gibeoni abo bakaba batari b'eihanga ry'Abaisraeli, kureka bakaba bari ab'Abaamori, abaatsigaireho. N'obu Abaisraeli baarahiire kutabaita, kwonka Saulo akaba naayenda kubaita ahabw'eihato eri yaabaire ainiire Abaisraeli n'Abayuda.)
en: And the king called the Gibeonites, and said unto them; (now the Gibeonites were not of the children of Israel, but of the remnant of the Amorites; and the children of Israel had sworn unto them: and Saul sought to slay them in his zeal to the children of Israel and Judah.)

rr: Daudi yaabuuza aba Gibeoni ati: Mbwenu mbakorere ki? Nkaakaraba ki, mukabona kushabira obuhunguzi bwa MUKAMA omugisha?
en: Wherefore David said unto the Gibeonites, What shall I do for you? and wherewith shall I make the atonement, that ye may bless the inheritance of the LORD ?

rr: Aba Gibeoni baamugarukamu abti: Eki turikwenda ahari Saulo n'enju ye ti feeza, nari ezaabu; kandi okwita omuntu omuri Israeli ti kyaitu.
en: And the Gibeonites said unto him, We will have no silver nor gold of Saul, nor of his house; neither for us shalt thou kill any man in Israel.

rr: Onu yaagira ati: Eki murikwenda, nikyo ndaabakorere.
en: And he said, What ye shall say, that will I do for you.

rr: Baagira omugabe bati: Ogwo mushaija waatucwekyereize, akacuma enaama y'okutumariraho kimwe, ngu tutagira ah'okutuura omu nsi ya Israeli yoona
en: And they answered the king, The man that consumed us, and that devised against us that we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the coasts of Israel,

rr: mbwenu mutuhe abashaija mushanju omu batabani, tubahanikye omu maisho ga MUKAMA omuri Gibea ya Saulo owaatoorainwe MUKAMA.
en: let seven men of his sons be delivered unto us, and we will hang them up unto the LORD in Gibeah of Saul, whom the LORD did choose.

rr: Omugabe yaagira ati: Niinyija kubabaha.
en: And the king said, I will give them .

rr: Kwonka omugabe yaarokora Mefiboshesi mwene Yonasaani mutabani wa Saulo, ahabw'endahiro ei Daudi na Yonasaani mwene Saulo baarahiriraine ahari MUKAMA.
en: But the king spared Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan the son of Saul, because of the LORD 's oath that was between them, between David and Jonathan the son of Saul.

rr: Omugabe yaatwara batabani ba Rizipa muhara wa Aya bombi, abu yaazaariire Saulo, Arumooni na Mefiboshesi, kandi na batabani ba Merabu muhara wa Saulo bataano, abu yaazaariire Adurieli mwene Baruzilai owa Mehola
en: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bare unto Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Saul, whom she brought up for Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite:

rr: yaabahayo omu mikono y'aba Gibeoni, baabahanika omu kibungo omu maisho ga MUKAMA; boona mushanju baafeera hamwe. Baitwa omu itogyera, nibatandika kugyesha sayiri.
en: and he delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites, and they hanged them in the hill before the LORD : and they fell all seven together, and were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first days , in the beginning of barley harvest.

rr: Rizipa muhara wa Aya yaatwara ekiguniya, yaaguma naakyeyarira aha rukiri okwiha omu itogyera okuhitsya obu enjura ya katumba yaagwire ahari egyo mintumbi; omu bunaku obwo bwona Rizipa tiyaikiriza mahungu g'omu mwanya kugizaho nyomushana, nari enyamaishwa z'omu ihamba nyekiro.
en: And Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth, and spread it for her upon the rock, from the beginning of harvest until water dropped upon them out of heaven, and suffered neither the birds of the air to rest on them by day, nor the beasts of the field by night.

rr: Baagambira Daudi eki Rizipa muhara wa Aya, ekinyanshunju kya Saulo, akozire.
en: And it was told David what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done.

rr: 1 Daudi yaagyenda, yaiha amagufa ga Saulo n'aga Yonasaani omutabani omu bantu ba Yabeshi-gileadi, abaabaire bagaibire omu muhanda gwa Besi-shaani, ei Abafilistia baabaire babahanikire, aha izooba eri Abafilistia baitiireho Saulo omuri Giliboa.
en: And David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabesh-gilead, which had stolen them from the street of Beth-shan, where the Philistines had hanged them, when the Philistines had slain Saul in Gilboa:

rr: Yaihayo amagufa ga Saulo n'aga Yonasaani omutabani, kandi baateerana n'amagufa g'ababaire bahanikirwe.
en: and he brought up from thence the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son; and they gathered the bones of them that were hanged.

rr: Batyo baaziika amagufa ga Saulo na Yonasaani omutabani Zeela omu nsi ya Benyamiini omu kituuro kya Kiishi ishe; baahikiiriza ebi omugabe yaabaragiire byona. Bwanyima y'ebyo Ruhanga yaabona kuhurira okushaba kwabo ahabw'ensi. Amamanzi ga Daudi n'ebi gaakozire
en: And the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son buried they in the country of Benjamin in Zelah, in the sepulchre of Kish his father: and they performed all that the king commanded. And after that God was intreated for the land.

rr: Abafilistia baagaruka kurwana n'Abaisraeli. Daudi yaashuuma n'abashaija be, baarwana n'Abafilistia; ku baabaire nibakirwana, Daudi yaatandika kuruha.
en: Moreover the Philistines had yet war again with Israel; and David went down, and his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines: and David waxed faint.

rr: Ishubi-benobu, mwijukuru w'ebikaaka biri, ou eicumu rye ryabaire riine oburemeezi bwa shekeli z'emiringa magana ashatu, ahagatiire rurara nsya, yaayenda kwita Daudi.
en: And Ishbi-benob, which was of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose spear weighed three hundred shekels of brass in weight, he being girded with a new sword , thought to have slain David.

rr: Kwonka Abishai mwene Zeruiya yaija kumuha emikono, yaarwana n'Omufilistia ogwo, yaamwita.
en: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah succoured him, and smote the Philistine, and killed him.

rr: Bwanyima engabo za Daudi baamurahiza, nibagira bati: otarigaruka kuhurura naitwe, nyentsya otakaaraaza etabaaza ya Israeli.
en: Then the men of David sware unto him, saying, Thou shalt go no more out with us to battle, that thou quench not the light of Israel.

rr: . Ishubi-benobu, mwijukuru w'ebikaaka biri, ou eicumu rye ryabaire riine oburemeezi bwa shekeli z'emiringa magana ashatu, ahagatiire rurara nsya, yaayenda kwita Daudi. 17 Kwonka Abishai mwene Zeruiya yaija kumuha emikono, yaarwana n'Omufilistia ogwo, yaamwita. Bwanyima engabo za Daudi baamurahiza, nibagira bati: otarigaruka kuhurura naitwe, nyentsya otakaaraaza etabaaza ya Israeli. 18 1 -8 ; 27:11 . Bwanyima y'ebyo haagaruka kubaho orugamba n'Abafilistia Gobu; Sibekai owa Husha yaita Saafu ow'omuri baijukuru b'ebikaaka.
en: And it came to pass after this, that there was again a battle with the Philistines at Gob: then Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Saph, which was of the sons of the giant.

rr: Haagaruka haabaho orugamba n'Abafilistia Gobu; Elihanani mwene Yaare-oregimu owa Betelehemu, yaita Goliasi owa Gaasi, ou orubango rw'eicumu rye rwabaire ruri nk'empimbi ei barukiraho emyenda.
en: And there was again a battle in Gob with the Philistines, where Elhanan the son of Jaare-oregim, a Beth-lehemite, slew the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver's beam.

rr: Ku yaahigire Abaisraeli, Yonasaani mwene Shimei mukuru wa Daudi yaamwita.
en: And when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimeah the brother of David slew him.

rr: -50 ; 31:3 ; 71:3 ; 91:3 . Aha izooba eri MUKAMA yaajuniireho Daudi omu mikono y'abazigu be boona, n'omu mukono gwa Saulo, Daudi akagambira MUKAMA ebigambo by'ekyeshongoro eki
en: And David spake unto the LORD the words of this song in the day that the LORD had delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul:

rr: naagira ati: MUKAMA n'orukiri rwangye, orugo rwangye orugumire, kandi Omujuni wangye
en: and he said, The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer;

rr: Ruhanga wangye, orukiri rwangye, ou nyesiga, Omunaara gwangye omuraingwa, n'obuhungiro bwangye; Omujuni wangye, niiwe onkiza omwaga.
en: The God of my rock; in him will I trust: He is my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge, My saviour; thou savest me from violence.

rr: Ndyatakira MUKAMA oshemereire kuhimbisibwa; Obwo nibwo ndikira abazigu bangye.
en: I will call on the LORD , who is worthy to be praised: So shall I be saved from mine enemies.

rr: Ebingonzi bya Rufu bikanzingazinga, N'emyegyemure y'okuhwerekyerera yantiinisa
en: When the waves of death compassed me, The floods of ungodly men made me afraid;

rr: Emigoye y'Okuzimu ekanzingazinga, Emitego ya Rufu yantanga omumaisho.
en: The sorrows of hell compassed me about; The snares of death prevented me;

rr: Omu busaasi bwangye naayeta MUKAMA, Naatakira Ruhanga wangye; Yaahurira eiraka ryangye ari omuri hekalu ye, N'okurira kwangye kwahika omu matu ge.
en: In my distress I called upon the LORD , And cried to my God: And he did hear my voice out of his temple, And my cry did enter into his ears.

rr: Bwanyima ensi yaatengyeta, yaatetema; N'emisingi y'eiguru yaanyiganyiga, Yaatengyetsibwa ekiniga kye.
en: Then the earth shook and trembled; The foundations of heaven moved And shook, because he was wroth.

rr: Omwika gukaruga omu nyindo ze, N'omu kanwa ke haarugamu omuriro ogurikurya busha, Gwayatsya amakara.
en: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, And fire out of his mouth devoured: Coals were kindled by it.

rr: Kandi akainamya eiguru, yaashuuma, Omwirima ndindindi guri ahansi y'ebigyere bye.
en: He bowed the heavens also, and came down; And darkness was under his feet.

rr: Yaagaruka aheekirwe kerubi, Yaareebwa ari aha mapapa g'omuyaga.
en: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: And he was seen upon the wings of the wind.

rr: Akahindura omwirima obweshereko, nk'eihema erimwehinguririize, N'ebicu ebikwaitse ebirimu amaizi yaabigira eky'okumusangira
en: And he made darkness pavilions round about him, Dark waters, and thick clouds of the skies.

rr: Omu kumurinkana okwabaire kuri omu maisho ge Haarugamu amakara garikwaka.
en: Through the brightness before him Were coals of fire kindled.

rr: MUKAMA yaahindira omu iguru, Rukira-boona yaagamba n'eiraka rye.
en: The LORD thundered from heaven, And the Most High uttered his voice.

rr: Yaarasha emyambi ye, yaabataataanisa, Niyo mirabyo ye mingi, yaababinga.
en: And he sent out arrows, and scattered them; Lightning, and discomfited them.

rr: Obwo nibwo empanga z'ahansi y'enyanja zaareebwa, N'emisingi y'ensi ekashuuruuka Ahabw'okukabuka kwa MUKAMA, Ahabw'okuhuuha kw'amaani okw'omwitsyo gw'omu nyindo zaawe.
en: And the channels of the sea appeared, The foundations of the world were discovered, At the rebuking of the LORD , At the blast of the breath of his nostrils.

rr: Yankununkirira ari ahaiguru, yankwata, Yaanyiha omu maizi maingi.
en: He sent from above, he took me; He drew me out of many waters;

rr: Yankiza omuzigu wangye ow'amaani, N'abo abaabaire nibaanyanga, ahakuba bakaba nibankiza amaani.
en: He delivered me from my strong enemy, And from them that hated me: for they were too strong for me.

rr: Bakampururira aha izooba ry'okureeberaho enaku; Kwonka MUKAMA yaaba obwegamo bwangye.
en: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: But the LORD was my stay.

rr: Yaaziinyihamu, yanta omu mwanya ogugarami, Yanjuna, ahabw'okuba akaba nanshemerererwa.
en: He brought me forth also into a large place: He delivered me, because he delighted in me.

rr: MUKAMA akampa ebihembo nk'okuhikiirira kwangye oku kuri, Yanzimuurira nk'okushemera kw'emikono yangye oku kuri.
en: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness: According to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.

rr: Ahakuba nkagumira omu mihanda ya MUKAMA, Kandi tinkacumuraga kuruga ahari Ruhanga wangye.
en: For I have kept the ways of the LORD , And have not wickedly departed from my God.

rr: Ebiragiro bye byona bikaba biri omu maisho gangye; Tinkeetantaraga bi yaaragiire.
en: For all his judgments were before me: And as for his statutes, I did not depart from them.

rr: Nkaba ntaine ky'okuhanwa omu maisho ge, Kandi nkeerinda okushiisha.
en: I was also upright before him, And have kept myself from mine iniquity.

rr: Nikyo MUKAMA yaanyihuriire, nk'okuhikiirira kwangye oku kuri, Akanzimuurira ebishemereire okushemera kw'emikono yangye omu maisho ge.
en: Therefore the LORD hath recompensed me according to my righteousness; According to my cleanness in his eye sight.

rr: Aha munyambabazi oyeyoreka ori ow'embabazi, Ahari ohikire oyeyoreka ori ohikire
en: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful, And with the upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright.

rr: Ahari oshemeire oyeyoreka ori oshemeire, Aha mugomi oyeyoreka ogumire.
en: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; And with the froward thou wilt shew thyself unsavoury.

rr: Ojuna abacureezi, Kwonka amaisho gaawe gari aha banyamaryo okubagarura ahansi.
en: And the afflicted people thou wilt save: But thine eyes are upon the haughty, that thou mayest bring them down.

rr: Eego, niiwe okongyeza etabaaza yangye, ai MUKAMA; Ruhanga wangye ayakira omwirima gwangye.
en: For thou art my lamp, O LORD : And the LORD will lighten my darkness.

rr: Eego, ahabwawe nimbaasa kurwanisa omutwe gw'engabo; Ahabw'okuhwerwa Ruhanga wangye nimbaasa kuguruka orugo.
en: For by thee I have run through a troop: By my God have I leaped over a wall.

rr: Mbwenu n'oha oba Ruhanga, otari MUKAMA? N'oha oba Rukiri, otari Ruhanga waitu?
en: For who is God, save the LORD ? And who is a rock, save our God?

rr: Ruhanga ogu n'obuhungiro bwangye obugumire; Niwe ahabura abahikire omu mihanda yaabo.
en: God is my strength and power: And he maketh my way perfect.

rr: Agira ebigyere byangye nk'eby'empara, Anyemereza aha nengo mpamire.
en: He maketh my feet like hinds' feet: And setteth me upon my high places.

rr: Ayegyesa engaro zangye okurwana, Ngu emikono yangye ebaase kureega obuta bw'emiringa.
en: He teacheth my hands to war; So that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.

rr: Ompaire engabo y'okujuna kwawe, Okutwaza gye kwawe kunkurize.
en: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: And thy gentleness hath made me great.

rr: Ompanguhiize ah'okuraba, Ebigyere byangye tibyaterera.
en: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me; So that my feet did not slip.

rr: Nkakurata abazigu bangye, naabahwerekyereza; Kandi tindagarukire okuhitsya obu baahweireho.
en: I have pursued mine enemies, and destroyed them; And turned not again until I had consumed them.

rr: Naabamaraho nimbacumita, tibaabaasa kwimuka; Baagwa ahansi y'ebigyere byangye.
en: And I have consumed them, and wounded them, that they could not arise: Yea, they are fallen under my feet.

rr: Ahakuba okanzirika amaani g'okurwana, Waagomoora abaabaire nibaija kundwanisa.
en: For thou hast girded me with strength to battle: Them that rose up against me hast thou subdued under me.

rr: Okareetera abazigu bangye kumpunga, Kandi n'abaabaire nibaanyanga naabacwekyereza.
en: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies, That I might destroy them that hate me.

rr: Baamagamaga, kwonka baabura kijuna; Baatakira MUKAMA, tiyaabagarukamu.
en: They looked, but there was none to save; Even unto the LORD , but he answered them not.

rr: Naabateera, naabagira omucuucu gw'ahansi; Naabaribatiirira nk'ebyondo by'omu nguuto.
en: Then did I beat them as small as the dust of the earth, I did stamp them as the mire of the street, and did spread them abroad.

rr: 2 Okankiza okurwana n'amahanga, Wandinda ngu mbe mukuru waago; Naaheerezibwa eihanga eri ntakamanyaga.
en: Thou also hast delivered me from the strivings of my people, Thou hast kept me to be head of the heathen: A people which I knew not shall serve me.

rr: Abanyamahanga baija ahi ndi nibaajura; Ku bampuriire bati, ahonaaho baanyorobera.
en: Strangers shall submit themselves unto me: As soon as they hear, they shall be obedient unto me.

rr: Abo banyamahanga bakeehwa amatsiko, Baaruga omu bigo byabo nibatetema.
en: Strangers shall fade away, And they shall be afraid out of their close places.

rr: MUKAMA n'ohuriirre; Rukiri wangye ahimbisibwe! Ruhanga orukiri rw'okujunwa kwangye aheebwe ekitiinisa!
en: The LORD liveth; and blessed be my rock; And exalted be the God of the rock of my salvation.

rr: Niwe Ruhanga owampooreire, Akangomoorera amahanga
en: It is God that avengeth me, And that bringeth down the people under me,

rr: Akaanyiha omu mikono y'abazigu bangye. Eego, okanta ahaiguru y'abarikundwanisa, Waanyiha omu mikono y'abanyamwaga.
en: And that bringeth me forth from mine enemies: Thou also hast lifted me up on high above them that rose up against me: Thou hast delivered me from the violent man.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo, ai MUKAMA, ndyakusiimira omu mahanga, Nyeshongore eby'okuhimbisa eiziina ryawe.
en: Therefore I will give thanks unto thee, O LORD , among the heathen, And I will sing praises unto thy name.

rr: Omugabe ou yaataireho, amuha obusinguzi bwingi, Kandi ayoreka ou yaashukireho amajuta embabazi, Niwe Daudi n'abaijukuru ebiro n'ebiro.
en: He is the tower of salvation for his king: And sheweth mercy to his anointed, Unto David, and to his seed for evermore.

rr: Ebi nibyo bigambo bya Daudi eby'aha muheru.
en: Now these be the last words of David.

rr: Okuhanuura kwa Daudi mwene Yese, Okuhanuura kw'omushaija owaatungwirwe, Okuhanuura kw'owaashukirweho Ruhanga wa Yakobo amajuta, Omuhimbi murungi wa zaaburi za Israeli.
en: David the son of Jesse said, And the man who was raised up on high, The anointed of the God of Jacob, And the sweet psalmist of Israel, said,

rr: Omwoyo wa MUKAMA naagambira omuriinye; Ekigambo kye tikinguga ha rurimi.
en: The Spirit of the LORD spake by me, And his word was in my tongue.

rr: Ruhanga wa Israeli agambire, Rukiri wa Israeli angambiire, ati: Omuntu ku ategyeka abantu omu buryo buhikire, Naategyekyera omu kutiina Ruhanga
en: The God of Israel said, The Rock of Israel spake to me, He that ruleth over men must be just, Ruling in the fear of God.

rr: Abaakira nk'omushekye oku gujuguta omu kasheeshe, Nk'oku eizoba ryaka omu kasheeshe akataine kibunda, Aba nk'enjura erikumeza obunyatsi omu itaka.
en: And he shall be as the light of the morning, when the sun riseth, Even a morning without clouds; As the tender grass springing out of the earth By clear shining after rain.

rr: N'ekya buzima, enju yangye tikwo eri na Ruhanga, Kwonka We andaganiise endagaano etarihwaho, Etebeekanisiibwe gye omuri byona, kandi ehamire. Tarikwija kuhikiiriza Okuhwerwa kwangye kwona n'ebi ndikwetenga?
en: Although my house be not so with God; Yet he hath made with me an everlasting covenant, Ordered in all things , and sure: For this is all my salvation, and all my desire, Although he make it not to grow.

rr: Kwonka abataine Ruhanga boona baryaba nk'amahwa g'okunagwa, Ahakuba tigarikubaasa kukwatwa n'engaro
en: But the sons of Belial shall be all of them as thorns thrust away, Because they cannot be taken with hands:

rr: Kureka orikwenda kugakoraho Ashemereire kugakoresaho ekyoma n'orubango rw'eicumu; Kandi baryabookyeza kimwe n'omuriro.
en: But the man that shall touch them Must be fenced with iron and the staff of a spear; And they shall be utterly burned with fire in the same place.

rr: Amaziina g'amamanzi ga Daudi
en: His Mighty Men

rr: 1 -47 ; 27:2 , Aga nigo maziina g'amamanzi agu Daudi yaabaire aine; Yehoshebashebesi owa Takimooni niwe yaabaire ari mukuru omuri abo abashatu; akakwata eicumu rye, yaariitsa abantu magana munaana omurundi gumwe.
en: These be the names of the mighty men whom David had: the Tachmonite that sat in the seat, chief among the captains; the same was Adino the Eznite: he lift up his spear against eight hundred, whom he slew at one time.

rr: Owaabaire naamukurata omuri ago mamanzi ashatu ni Eleazaari mwene Dodo, mwijukuru wa Ahohi. Akaba ari hamwe na Daudi, obu baahiga Abafilistia abaabaire beeteeraniireyo kurwana, Abaisraeli bakabahunga.
en: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo the Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David, when they defied the Philistines that were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Israel were gone away:

rr: Yaimuka, yaita Abafilistia okuhitsya obu omukono gwe gwaruhire, engaro ye ekaramatana na rurara; eryo izooba MUKAMA yaabaha okusingura kuhango, abandi baamugarukira ahabw'okucwijura abaitsirwe kwonka.
en: he arose, and smote the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand clave unto the sword: and the LORD wrought a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to spoil.

rr: Kandi ogwo akaba naakuratwa Shama, mwene Ageye, owa Harari.
en: And after him was Shammah the son of Agee the Hararite.

rr: Abafilistia bakaba bateeraniire Leehi, ahu omusiri ogwijwire enkoore gwabaire guri; abashaija boona baahunga Abafilistia
en: And the Philistines were gathered together into a troop, where was a piece of ground full of lentiles: and the people fled from the Philistines.

rr: kwonka we yaayemerera ahagati y'ogwo musiri, yaagurinda, yaita Abafilistia; MUKAMA yaabaha okusingura kuhango.
en: But he stood in the midst of the ground, and defended it, and slew the Philistines: and the LORD wrought a great victory.

rr: Omu igyesha abo bashaija bonshatu ab'omu mamanzi makumi ashatu bakashuuma, baashanga Daudi omu nyanga ya Adulaamu. Obwo omutwe gw'engabo z'Abafilistia gukaba gusiisiire omu ruhanga rwa Reefa
en: And three of the thirty chief went down, and came to David in the harvest time unto the cave of Adullam: and the troop of the Philistines pitched in the valley of Rephaim.

rr: Daudi ari omu kigo, n'Abafilistia bari Betelehemu.
en: And David was then in an hold, and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Beth-lehem.

rr: Daudi yaatenga, yaagira ati: Nkaabaasibwa ki hagira owampa otwizi tw'omu kiziba eriri aha irembo rya Betelehemu, ntunywa!
en: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Beth-lehem, which is by the gate!

rr: Ahonaaho ago mamanzi ashatu gaayataguza omu rusiisira rw'Abafilistia, gaataha amaizi g'omuri eryo iziba rya Betelehemu, eryabaire riri aha irembo, baagatwarira Daudi; kwonka we yaayanga kuganywa, kureka yaagashuka omu maisho ga MUKAMA
en: And the three mighty men brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Beth-lehem, that was by the gate, and took it , and brought it to David: nevertheless he would not drink thereof, but poured it out unto the LORD .

rr: yaagira ati: Ai MUKAMA, rubuuza nyowe okukora eki. Nimbaasa kunywa eshagama y'abashaija abaayoga amagara gaabo? Ekyo nikyo yaayangiire kuganywa. Ebyo nibyo ago mamanzi ashatu gaakozire.
en: And he said, Be it far from me, O LORD , that I should do this: is not this the blood of the men that went in jeopardy of their lives? therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mighty men.

rr: Kandi Abishai mukuru wa Yoabu mwene Zeruiya niwe yaabaire ari mukuru w'abo makumi ashatu.
en: And Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief among three.

rr: Akakwata eicumu rye, yaarwana n'abashaija magana ashatu, yaabaita, yaarangaanwa nk'abo abashatu.
en: And he lifted up his spear against three hundred, and slew them , and had the name among three.

rr: Omuri abo makumi ashatu niwe yaakizire kurangaanwa, akahinduka mukuru waabo; kwonka tiyaahika hari abo abashatu.
en: Was he not most honourable of three? therefore he was their captain: howbeit he attained not unto the first three.

rr: Kandi Benaaya mwene Yehoyaada owa Kabuzieli, owaabaire ari emanzi, akakora eby'amaani; yaita beene Arieli babiri aba Moabu. Kandi aha izooba rimwe omu biro by'ebirika akashuuma, yaitira entare omu kiina.
en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man, of Kabzeel, who had done many acts, he slew two lionlike men of Moab: he went down also and slew a lion in the midst of a pit in time of snow:

rr: Kandi yaita Omunyamisri murungi ahamaisho. Omunyamisri ogwo akaba aine eicumu omu ngaro, kwonka Benaaya yaamushuumira n'enkoni, yaamusikura eicumu omu ngaro, yaarimwitsa.
en: and he slew an Egyptian, a goodly man: and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and slew him with his own spear.

rr: Ebyo nibyo Benaaya mwene Yehoyaada yaakozire, akarangaanwa nk'abo abashatu ab'amaani.
en: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among three mighty men.

rr: Yaarangaanwa omuri abo makumi ashatu, kwonka tiyaahika hari bari abashatu. Daudi yaamuhindura omukuru w'abarinzi be.
en: He was more honourable than the thirty, but he attained not to the first three. And David set him over his guard.

rr: Asaheeli murumuna wa Yoabu akaba ari omwe ahari abo makumi ashatu, na Elihanani mwene Doodo owa Betelehemu
en: Asahel the brother of Joab was one of the thirty; Elhanan the son of Dodo of Beth-lehem,

rr: Shama owa Harodi, Elika owa Harodi
en: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,

rr: Helezi owa Paluti, Iira mwene Ikishi owa Tekoa
en: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,

rr: Abiezeeri owa Anatoosi, Mebunai owa Huusha
en: Abiezer the Anethothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,

rr: Zalumooni owa Ahohi, Maharai owa Netofa
en: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,

rr: Helebu mwene Baana owa Netofa, Itayi, mwene Ribai owa Gibea eya Benyamiini
en: Heleb the son of Baanah, a Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai out of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,

rr: Benaaya owa Piratooni, Hidai ow'omu tugyera twa Gaashi
en: Benaiah the Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash,

rr: Abialiboni owa Arubasi, Azimaveesi owa Bahurimu
en: Abi-albon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,

rr: Eliahuba owa Shalibooni, beene Yasheni, Yonasaani
en: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, of the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,

rr: Shama owa Harari, Ahiamu mwene Sharari owa Arari
en: Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Hararite,

rr: Elifeleti mwene Ahasibai mwijukuru wa Maaka, Eliamu mwene Ahisofeeli owa Giilo
en: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maachathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,

rr: Hezero owa Karumeeli, Parati owa Arubi
en: Hezrai the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,

rr: Igaali mwene Nasani owa Zooba, Baani owa Gaadi
en: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,

rr: Zeleki Omuamoni, Naharai owa Beeroosi, Yoabu mwene Zeruiya
en: Zelek the Ammonite, Nahari the Beerothite, armourbearer to Joab the son of Zeruiah,

rr: Iira owa Ituri, Garebu owa Ituri
en: Ira an Ithrite, Gareb an Ithrite,

rr: na Uriya Omuhiiti boona makumi ashatu na mushanju.
en: Uriah the Hittite: thirty and seven in all.
