rr: 1 -28 ; 27:23 , Kandi MUKAMA yaagaruka, yaagirira Israeli ekiniga, yaimutsya Daudi kubakora kubi, naagira ati: Gyenda obare Abaisraeli n'Abayuda.
en: And again the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel, and he moved David against them to say, Go, number Israel and Judah.

rr: Omugabe yaagira Yoabu omukuru w'eihe rye, ou yaabaire aine, ati: Gyenda orabe omu nganda za Israeli zoona, okuruga Daani okuhika Beeri-sheba, mubare abantu, mbone kumanya omubaro gwabo.
en: For the king said to Joab the captain of the host, which was with him, Go now through all the tribes of Israel, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, and number ye the people, that I may know the number of the people.

rr: Yoabu yaagira omugabe ati: MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe ayongyere aha bantu okukira oku bari emirundi igana, kandi omugabe akyereebere. Beitu shi, Nyakusinga omugabe, ahabw'enki nooshemerererwa ekintu ekyo?
en: And Joab said unto the king, Now the LORD thy God add unto the people, how many soever they be, an hundredfold, and that the eyes of my lord the king may see it: but why doth my lord the king delight in this thing?

rr: Kwonka ekigambo ky'omugabe kyakiza ebya Yoabu n'abakuru b'engabo ze amaani.
en: Notwithstanding the king's word prevailed against Joab, and against the captains of the host.

rr: Bwanyima Yoabu n'abo bakuru b'engabo baaruga omumaisho g'omugabe, baaza kubara Abaisraeli.
en: And Joab and the captains of the host went out from the presence of the king, to number the people of Israel.

rr: Baayambuka Yorudani, baatandikira omuri Aroeli, n'omu rurembo orwabaire ruri ahagati y'oruhita, baaza Gaadi, baagumizamu, baahika Yazeri.
en: And they passed over Jordan, and pitched in Aroer, on the right side of the city that lieth in the midst of the river of Gad, and toward Jazer:

rr: Bwanyima baahika Gileadi, na Kadeshi ey'omu nsi y'Abahiiti; bwanyima baahika Daani, baagumizamu, baaziguuruka baahika Sidoni
en: then they came to Gilead, and to the land of Tahtim-hodshi; and they came to Dan-jaan, and about to Zidon,

rr: okuruga aho baahika omu kigo kya Tuuro, n'omu ndembo zoona ez'Abahiivi n'Abanyakanaani. Bwanyima baaza omuri Negebu eya Yuda, baahika Beeri-sheba.
en: and came to the strong hold of Tyre, and to all the cities of the Hivites, and of the Canaanites: and they went out to the south of Judah, even to Beer-sheba.

rr: Ku baaherize kubara omu nsi yoona, baagaruka Yerusaalemu, bamazire ameezi mwenda n'ebiro makumi abiri.
en: So when they had gone through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.

rr: Yoabu yaaha omugabe omubaro gw'abantu abu yaabazire; omuri Israeli hakaba harimu abashaija amamanzi enkwata-rurara obusiriira munaana; kandi Abayuda bakaba bari obusiriira butaano. MUKAMA okuha Daudi n'Abaisraeli ekifubiro
en: And Joab gave up the sum of the number of the people unto the king: and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men that drew the sword; and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men.

rr: Kwonka ku yaaherize kubara abantu, omutima gwe gwamushinja; yaagira MUKAMA ati: Ncumwire munonga ahabw'ekyo eki nkozire.
en: And David's heart smote him after that he had numbered the people.

rr: Kwonka mbwenu ninkweshengyereza, ai MUKAMA, iha aha mwiru waawe okutahikiirira; ahakuba ndengyesereize, naakora eky'obufa-mutima.
en: And David said unto the LORD , I have sinned greatly in that I have done: and now, I beseech thee, O LORD , take away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.

rr: Daudi ku yaimukire omu kasheeshe, ekigambo kya MUKAMA kyaizira nabi Gaadi, omuhanuuzi wa Daudi, nikigira kiti
en: For when David was up in the morning, the word of the LORD came unto the prophet Gad, David's seer, saying,

rr: Gyenda ogire Daudi oti: Oku nikwo MUKAMA arikugamba, naagira ati: Naakuha ebintu bishatu, oiheho kimwe, mbe nikyo naakukora.
en: Go and say unto David, Thus saith the LORD , I offer thee three things ; choose thee one of them, that I may do it unto thee.

rr: Atyo Gaadi yaija ahari Daudi, yaakimugambira; yaamugira ati: Ahari ebi bishatu ihaho kimwe, ensi yaawe okuteerwa enjara emyaka mushanju; nari okuguma noohunga abazigu baawe bakubingire okumara ameezi ashatu; nari ensi yaawe okujuumikirwa orufu okumara ebiro bishatu. Mbwenu teekateeka, ongambire eki ndaagarukyemu Ontumire.
en: So Gad came to David, and told him, and said unto him, Shall seven years of famine come unto thee in thy land? or wilt thou flee three months before thine enemies, while they pursue thee? or that there be three days' pestilence in thy land? now advise, and see what answer I shall return to him that sent me.

rr: Daudi yaagira Gaadi ati: Naashobererwa kimwe; ka tugwe omu mikono ya MUKAMA, ahakuba embabazi ze ni nyingi; ndekye kugwa omu mikono y'abantu.
en: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let us fall now into the hand of the LORD ; for his mercies are great: and let me not fall into the hand of man.

rr: Kwonka maraika ku yaabangiire Yerusaalemu omukono kugicwekyereza, MUKAMA yaayegarukamu ahabw'ako kabi, yaagira maraika owaabaire naacwekyereza abantu ati: Ekyo nikimara. Banguura omukono. Obwo maraika wa MUKAMA akaba ari haihi n'embuga ya Arauna Omuyebusi.
en: And when the angel stretched out his hand upon Jerusalem to destroy it, the LORD repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed the people, It is enough: stay now thine hand. And the angel of the LORD was by the threshingplace of Araunah the Jebusite.

rr: Daudi ku yaareebire maraika owaabaire naita abantu, yaagira MUKAMA ati: Reeba, niinye ncumwire, nkashiisha mononga; mbwenu entaama ezi zo zikozire ki? Ninkweshengyereza, omukono gwawe gube niinye gwarwanisa n'enju ya tata. Okuhonga kwa Daudi
en: And David spake unto the LORD when he saw the angel that smote the people, and said, Lo, I have sinned, and I have done wickedly: but these sheep, what have they done? let thine hand, I pray thee, be against me, and against my father's house. An Altar unto the Lord

rr: Eryo izooba Gaadi yaija ahari Daudi, yaamugira ati: Inamuka, oyombekyere MUKAMA eitambiro aha mbuga ya Arauna Omuyebusi.
en: And Gad came that day to David, and said unto him, Go up, rear an altar unto the LORD in the threshingfloor of Araunah the Jebusite.

rr: Atyo Daudi yainamuka, ahabw'ekigambo kya Gaadi eki MUKAMA amuragiire.
en: And David, according to the saying of Gad, went up as the LORD commanded.

rr: Arauna ku yaanagire amaisho, yaareeba omugabe n'abagaragwa be nibaija ah'ari; yaashohora, yainama omu maisho g'omugabe
en: And Araunah looked, and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him: and Araunah went out, and bowed himself before the king on his face upon the ground.

rr: Arauna yaabuuza ati: N'enki ekyareeta mukama wangye omugabe aha mwiru we?
en: And Araunah said, Wherefore is my lord the king come to his servant?

rr: Daudi yaamugarukamu ati: Naareetwa okugura embuga yaawe, kwombekyera MUKAMA eitambiro, ngu orufu rurugye omu bantu.
en: And David said, To buy the threshingfloor of thee, to build an altar unto the LORD , that the plague may be stayed from the people.

rr: Arauna yaagira Daudi ati: Mukama wangye omugabe atware eki arikwenda kyona, akihongye; reeba ente ez'ekitambo ky'okwotsya nzizi, n'ebihuuzo n'emigamba y'ente mubiihemu enku.
en: And Araunah said unto David, Let my lord the king take and offer up what seemeth good unto him: behold, here be oxen for burnt sacrifice, and threshing instruments and other instruments of the oxen for wood.

rr: Ebyo byona, Nyakusinga, nyowe Arauna naabiha omugabe.
en: All these things did Araunah, as a king, give unto the king.

rr: Yaagaruka yaagira omugabe ati: MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe akwikirize.
en: And Araunah said unto the king, The LORD thy God accept thee.

rr: Kwonka omugabe yaagira Arauna ati: Ngaaha; buzimazima niinyija kubigura naiwe, nkuhe obuguzi bwabyo. Tindikwija kuhongyera MUKAMA Ruhanga wangye ebitambo by'okwotsya, ebi ntaheereire byangye. Atyo Daudi yaagura egyo mbuga n'ezo nte shekeli z'efeeza makumi ataano.
en: And the king said unto Araunah, Nay; but I will surely buy it of thee at a price: neither will I offer burnt offerings unto the LORD my God of that which doth cost me nothing. So David bought the threshingfloor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.

rr: Daudi yaayombekyerayo MUKAMA eitambiro, yaatamba ebitambo by'okwotsya n'empongano z'okusiima ahabw'obusingye.
en: And David built there an altar unto the LORD , and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.

rr: Atyo MUKAMA yaahurira ebi yaayeshengyereziibwe ahabw'ensi; orufu rwaruga omuri Israeli.
en: So the LORD was intreated for the land, and the plague was stayed from Israel.

rr: 1 Paulo na Siluwaano na Timoseo twabahandiikira imwe ab'ekanisa y'Abatesalonika abari omuri Ruhanga Isheboona na Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo
en: 1 Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

rr: 2 nitubendeza embabazi n'obusingye ebirikuruga ahari Ruhanga Tataitwe na Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo.
en: 2 grace unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
3 We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth;
4 so that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure:
5 which is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God, that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which ye also suffer:
6 seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you;
7 and to you who are troubled rest with us, when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels,
8 in flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God, and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ:
9 who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord, and from the glory of his power;
10 when he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be admired in all them that believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that day.

rr: 11 Nikyo tubashabirira obutoosha, ngu Ruhanga waitu abaikirize okuba abashemereire okweta kwe, kandi ahikiirize n'amaani ge ebirungi byona ebi murikwetenga n'emirimo y'okwikiriza
en: 11 Wherefore also we pray always for you, that our God would count you worthy of this calling, and fulfil all the good pleasure of his goodness, and the work of faith with power:
12 that the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you, and ye in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

rr: 1 Ebirkukwata aha by'ikwija kwa Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo n'okuteerana kwaitu okumubugana, nitubeeshengyereza, B'eishe-emwe
en: 1 Now we beseech you, brethren, by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and by our gathering together unto him,

rr: 2 mutarahuka kuhahaaza emitima mukabura obwengye, mutajagarazibwa yaaba mwoyo nari ekigambo nari ebaruha, ei barikugira ngu ekahandiikwa itwe, ebirikuranga ngu ekiro kya Mukama kiiriire haihi.
en: 2 that ye be not soon shaken in mind, or be troubled, neither by spirit, nor by word, nor by letter as from us, as that the day of Christ is at hand.
3 Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come , except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition;
4 who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.

rr: 5 Timurikwijuka ku naabagambiire ebyo, nkiri owaanyu?
en: 5 Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?

rr: 6 Kandi nimumanya ekirikumuzibira hati n'eki, ngu arekye kushuuruurwa obunaku bwe butakahikire.
en: 6 And now ye know what withholdeth that he might be revealed in his time.

rr: 7 Ahakuba enaama y'obugomi na mbwenu etandikire kukora; kwonka orikuzibira hati naija kugumizamu okuhitsya obu ariihwaho.
en: 7 For the mystery of iniquity doth already work: only he who now letteth will let , until he be taken out of the way.
8 And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:
9 even him , whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,

rr: 10 n'obugobya bwona obubi obw'okuhabya ab'okuhwerekyerera, ahabw'okuba bakanga kukunda amazima ngu bajumwe.
en: 10 and with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.
11 And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie:

rr: 12 ngu boona abatarikiriize mazima, bakashemerererwa okutahikiirira, basingwe orubanja.
en: 12 that they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.

13 But we are bound to give thanks alway to God for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:

rr: 14 Nikyo yaabeeteire n'engiri yaitu, ngu mutungye ekitiinisa kya Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo.
en: 14 whereunto he called you by our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

rr: 15 N'ahabw'ekyo, B'eishe-emwe, mwemerere muhamire, mugumye emitwarize ei twabeegyeise, yaaba mu bigambo, nari omu baruha zaitu.
en: 15 Therefore, brethren, stand fast, and hold the traditions which ye have been taught, whether by word, or our epistle.

rr: 16 Kandi Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo na Ruhanga Tataitwe, owaatukunzire akatuha okuhuumura okutahwaho n'amatsiko marungi ahabw'embabazi ze
en: 16 Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, which hath loved us, and hath given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,

rr: 17 ahuumuze emitima yaanyu, agigumye gye omu mirimo yoona emirungi n'ebigambo byona ebirungi.
en: 17 comfort your hearts, and stablish you in every good word and work.
1 Finally, brethren, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may have free course, and be glorified, even as it is with you:

rr: 2 kandi naitwe tukire abantu babi abahabire; ahakuba abaine okwikiriza ti boona.
en: 2 and that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men: for all men have not faith.
3 But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.
4 And we have confidence in the Lord touching you, that ye both do and will do the things which we command you.

rr: 5 Mukama waitu atebeekanise emitima yaanyu omu kukunda kwa Ruhanga n'omu kugumisiriza kwa Kristo.
en: 5 And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patient waiting for Christ.
6 Now we command you, brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly, and not after the tradition which he received of us.
7 For yourselves know how ye ought to follow us: for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you;
8 neither did we eat any man's bread for nought; but wrought with labour and travail night and day, that we might not be chargeable to any of you:

rr: 9 ti habw'okugira ngu tukaba tutashemereire kubikorerwa, kwonka tukenda ngu tube eky'okureeberaho, mubone kutooreza emitwarize yaitu.
en: 9 not because we have not power, but to make ourselves an ensample unto you to follow us.
10 For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, that if any would not work, neither should he eat.

rr: 11 Ahakuba tuhuriire ngu omuriimwe harimu abeeremwa abatarikukora na kakye, kureka okwetaasya omu by'abandi.
en: 11 For we hear that there are some which walk among you disorderly, working not at all, but are busybodies.

rr: 12 Abantu nk'abo nitubaragiira, kandi nitubeehanangiriza omuri Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo kukora emirimo yaabo batuurize, babone kugira eby'okubatunga.
en: 12 Now them that are such we command and exhort by our Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.
13 But ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing.

rr: 14 Omuntu weena otarikuhurira eki turikugamba omu baruha egi, mumumanye, mutakwatanisa nawe, abone kukwatwa enshoni.
en: 14 And if any man obey not our word by this epistle, note that man, and have no company with him, that he may be ashamed.

rr: 15 Kwonka mutamuteekateekaho nk'omuzigu, kureka mumuhabure nk'ow'eishe-emwe.
en: 15 Yet count him not as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.

rr: 16 Kandi Mukama w'obusingye we wenka agume abahe obusingye ebiro byona n'omu miringo yoona. Mukama agume naimwe mwena.
en: 16 Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all.

rr: 17 Nyowe Paulo, naahandiika endamutsyo egi n'omukono gwangye nyenka. Niko kamanyiso omu baruha yangye yoona; okwo nikwo mpandiika.
en: 17 The salutation of Paul with mine own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.

rr: 18 Embabazi za Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo zigume naimwe mwena.
en: 18 The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

rr: 1 Paulo, entumwa ya Kriso Yesu, nk'oku Ruhanga yaayenzire, eyaatumirwe kugamba eby'amagara agaraganisiibwe omuri Kristo Yesu
en: 1 Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus,

rr: 2 naakuhandiikira, Timoseo omwana wangye orikukundwa; ninkwendeza embabazi n'okusaasirwa n'obusingye ebirikuruga ahari Ruhanga Isheboona, na Kristo Yesu Mukama waitu.
en: 2 To Timothy, my dearly beloved son: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
3 I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day;

rr: 4 Ku nyijuka okurira kwawe, ngira orushusho kukureeba ngu nyijure okushemererwa.
en: 4 greatly desiring to see thee, being mindful of thy tears, that I may be filled with joy;
5 when I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.
6 Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.
7 For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
8 Be not thou therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but be thou partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of God;
9 who hath saved us, and called us with an holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before the world began,
10 but is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ, who hath abolished death, and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:

rr: 11 Engiri egyo niyo naateereirweho kuba omubuurizi waayo, n'okuba entumwa kandi omwegyesa
en: 11 whereunto I am appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.

rr: 12 kandi ahabwayo ninshaasha, nk'oku ndikushaasha hati; kwonka tindikwitwa nshoni; ahabw'okuba nimmanya ou naikiriize, kandi nimpamiza kimwe ngu naabaasa kurinda # 1:12 Nari: eki naamubiikize. meki yankwatsize okuhitsya aha kiro ekyo.
en: 12 For the which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day.

rr: 13 Eky'okureeberaho ky'ebigambo by'amazima ebi waahuriire ningamba, okikuratire omu kwikiriza n'okukunda ebiri omuri Kristo Yesu
en: 13 Hold fast the form of sound words, which thou hast heard of me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

rr: 14 orinde ekyo kirungi eki waakwatsiibwe Omwoyo Orikwera otuura omuriitwe.
en: 14 That good thing which was committed unto thee keep by the Holy Ghost which dwelleth in us.
15 This thou knowest, that all they which are in Asia be turned away from me; of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.

rr: 16 Mukama agirire embabazi ab'omuka ya Onesifooro, ahabw'okuba kaingi akaba angarura omutima omunda; kandi taraitsirwe nshoni ahabw'enjegyere zangye.
en: 16 The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus; for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain:

rr: 17 Ku yaahikire Rooma, yaataho omutima kunsherura, yambona.
en: 17 but, when he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently, and found me .

rr: 18 Mukama amuhe okusaasirwa omu maisho ge aha kiro ekyo. Kandi noomanya gye ebi yankoreire byona omuri Efeso.
en: 18 The Lord grant unto him that he may find mercy of the Lord in that day: and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.

rr: 1 Mbwenu nu, mwana wangye, guma ori ow'amaani omu mbabazi eziri omuri Kristo Yesu
en: 1 Thou therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

rr: 2 kandi ebi waahuriire ningamba omu maisho ga baakareebi baingi, obikwatse abantu abarikwesigwa, abaribaasa kubyegyesa abandi.
en: 2 And the things that thou hast heard of me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.
3 Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.

rr: 4 Tihariho muserukare oza kurwana, akeetaasya omu mirabanamu ey'amagara aga, ngu asiimwe owaamuhandiikiire obuserukare.
en: 4 No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.
5 And if a man also strive for masteries, yet is he not crowned, except he strive lawfully.
6 The husbandman that laboureth must be first partaker of the fruits.

rr: 7 Ta omutima aha bi ndikugamba; ahakuba Mukama naija kukuha okushoborokyerwa byona.
en: 7 Consider what I say; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things.

rr: 8 Guma oijukye Yesu Kristo owaazookire omu bafu, mwijukuru wa Daudi, nk'engiri ei naahairwe oku egamba
en: 8 Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel:
9 wherein I suffer trouble, as an evil doer, even unto bonds; but the word of God is not bound.
10 Therefore I endure all things for the elect's sakes, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
11 It is a faithful saying: For if we be dead with him , we shall also live with him :

rr: 12 Ku turigumisiriza, turyayema tutegyekye nawe
en: 12 if we suffer, we shall also reign with him : if we deny him , he also will deny us:
13 if we believe not, yet he abideth faithful: he cannot deny himself.

rr: 14 Ebyo ogume obibaijutsye, noobeehanangiriza omu maisho ga Mukama kwetantara okuhakana aha bigambo okutaine mugasho, kureka okurikugwisa abarikukuhurira.
en: 14 Of these things put them in remembrance, charging them before the Lord that they strive not about words to no profit, but to the subverting of the hearers.
15 Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.

rr: 16 Oyetantare okuregyeta okutarimu kutiina Ruhanga, ahakuba nikwongyera kureetera abantu kutamutiina
en: 16 But shun profane and vain babblings: for they will increase unto more ungodliness.
17 And their word will eat as doth a canker: of whom is Hymenæus and Philetus;

rr: 18 abaateishukire amazima, nibahamya ngu okuzooka kukaheza kuhwaho, bakajuumikirira kimwe okwikiriza kw'abamwe.
en: 18 who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already; and overthrow the faith of some.
19 Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.

rr: 20 Omuri nyaruju tihabamu bintu by'ezaabu n'efeeza byonka, kureka n'eby'ebiti n'eby'eibumba; ebimwe bikoresibwa emirimo y'ekitiinisa, ebindi erikugaywa.
en: 20 But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.
21 If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master's use, and prepared unto every good work.
22 Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

rr: 23 Kwonka empaka z'obushema ezitaine buryo ozeetantare, noomanya ku zizaarukwamu okutongana.
en: 23 But foolish and unlearned questions avoid, knowing that they do gender strifes.
24 And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle unto all men , apt to teach, patient,

rr: 25 orikuhana n'obucureezi abarikumuhakanisa, ngu ku kiraabe nikibaasika, Ruhanga abahe okweteisa, bamanyire kiwme amazima
en: 25 in meekness instructing those that oppose themselves; if God peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth;

rr: 26 basinduukye barugye omu mutego gwa Sitaane, owaabaire abakwatsire, babone kukora ebi Ruhanga akunda.
en: 26 and that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, who are taken captive by him at his will.

rr: 1 Kwonka omanye eki ngu, omu biro by'aha mperu, haryabaho ebiro by'akabi kaingi
en: 1 This know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come.
2 For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

rr: 3 abatarikukunda baabo, abatarikwenda kugarukana n'abandi, abarikubeihererana, abatarikweyangisa, enshaarizi, abarikwanga ebirungi
en: 3 without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good,

rr: 4 abarikureebyana, engangaazi, abarikwekuza, abarikukunda kweshemeza bonka okukira Ruhanga
en: 4 traitors, heady, highminded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God;
5 having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.
6 For of this sort are they which creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins, led away with divers lusts,

rr: 7 abeega obutoosha, kwonka batahikye ha kumanyira kimwe amazima.
en: 7 ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.
8 Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also resist the truth: men of corrupt minds, reprobate concerning the faith.

rr: 9 Kwonka tibaribaasa kurengaho, ahakuba obushema bwabo buryareebwa butunu abantu boona, nk'obw'abashaija abo bombi oku bumanyirwe.
en: 9 But they shall proceed no further: for their folly shall be manifest unto all men , as theirs also was.

rr: 10 Kwonka iwe, okakuratira enyegyesa yangye, emitwarize yangye, eki ndikugyenderera, okwikiriza kwangye, okugumisiriza kwangye, okukunda kwangye, okuhamya kwangye
en: 10 But thou hast fully known my doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, longsuffering, charity, patience,
11 persecutions, afflictions, which came unto me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: but out of them all the Lord delivered me.
12 Yea, and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.
13 But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse, deceiving, and being deceived.

rr: 14 Kwonka iwe, ogumizemu omu bi waayegire okamanyira kimwe, ahakuba noomanya abaabikwegyeise
en: 14 But continue thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing of whom thou hast learned them ;
15 and that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
16 All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:

rr: 17 ngu omuntu wa Ruhanga abone kuba ohikire buzima, oine byona ebishemereire omurimo gwona omurungi.
en: 17 that the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.
1 I charge thee therefore before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, who shall judge the quick and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom;
2 preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine.
3 For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears;
4 and they shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables.

rr: 5 Kwonka iwe, oyerinde omuri byona, ogumisiririze obusaasi, okore omurimo gw'omubuurizi w'engiri, ohikize kimwe okuheereza kwawe.
en: 5 But watch thou in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist, make full proof of thy ministry.
6 For I am now ready to be offered, and the time of my departure is at hand.
7 I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:
8 henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.

rr: 9 Oteereho, nk'oku orikubaasa, kwija kundeeba juba
en: 9 Do thy diligence to come shortly unto me:
10 for Demas hath forsaken me, having loved this present world, and is departed unto Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus unto Dalmatia.

rr: 11 Luka wenka niwe ntsigaire nawe. Reeba Mako, mwijane; ahakuba nangasira munonga omu kuheereza.
en: 11 Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee: for he is profitable to me for the ministry.
12 And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus.

rr: 13 Omu kwija ondeetere eky'okwefubika eki naatsigire Troa owa Kaapo, n'ebitabo, kandi okukira munonga oreete eby'empu.
en: 13 The cloke that I left at Troas with Carpus, when thou comest, bring with thee , and the books, but especially the parchments.
14 Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Lord reward him according to his works:

rr: 15 Naiwe omwerinde; ahakuba akarwanisa munonga ebigambo byaitu.
en: 15 of whom be thou ware also; for he hath greatly withstood our words.

rr: 16 Omu kwetonganira kwangye okw'okubanza tihaine waanyemereireho, boona bakantsigaho. Ninshaba ngu batarikiturwa.
en: 16 At my first answer no man stood with me, but all men forsook me: I pray God that it may not be laid to their charge.
17 Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me, and strengthened me; that by me the preaching might be fully known, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

rr: 18 Mukama waitu aryaguma ankize omu kabi koon, anjune okuhitsya obu nditaaha omu bukama bwe bw'omu iguru. Aheebwe ekitiinisa ebiro byona. Amiina.
en: 18 And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

rr: 19 Ondamukize Priska na Akula kandi n'ab'omu ka ya Onesifooro.
en: 19 Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.

rr: 20 Erasto akaguma Korinso; kandi Trofimo nkamutsiga Mileeto arwaire.
en: 20 Erastus abode at Corinth: but Trophimus have I left at Miletum sick.

rr: 21 Oteho omutima munonga, oije ebiro by'embeho bitakahikire. Yubulo, Pudenti, Liino, Kulaudio n'ab'eishe-emwe boona baabaramutsya.
en: 21 Do thy diligence to come before winter.

rr: 22 Mukama agume n'omwoyo gwawe. Embabazi zibe naimwe.
en: 22 The Lord Jesus Christ be with thy spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.

rr: 1 Nyowe nk'omukuru naakuhandiikira, iwe Gaayo orikukundwa, ou nkunda omu mazima.
en: 1 The elder unto the wellbeloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth.

rr: 2 Orikukundwa, ninshaba ngu obe gye omuri byona, kandi ngu ogire amagara omu mubiri, nk'oku ori gye omu mwoyo.
en: 2 Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.

rr: 3 Ahakuba nkashemererwa munonga obu abamwe aha b'eishe-emwe baija, nibahamya amazima gaawe, kandi n'oku orikugagyenderamu.
en: 3 For I rejoiced greatly, when the brethren came and testified of the truth that is in thee, even as thou walkest in the truth.

rr: 4 Tihariho ki ndikushemerererwa okukira eki, okuhurira ngu abaana bangye nibagyendera omu mazima.
en: 4 I have no greater joy than to hear that my children walk in truth.

rr: 5 Orikukundwa, nookora omurimo gw'obwesigwa omuri byona ebi orikukorera ab'eishe-emwe, haza kandi bari abagyenyi abu otarikumanya
en: 5 Beloved, thou doest faithfully whatsoever thou doest to the brethren, and to strangers;

rr: 6 abahamize okukunda kwawe omu maisho g'ekanisa. Kandi ku oribaraga gye omu rugyendo rwabo omu muringo ogurikusiimisa Ruhanga, oryaba okozire gye.
en: 6 which have borne witness of thy charity before the church: whom if thou bring forward on their journey after a godly sort, thou shalt do well:
7 because that for his name's sake they went forth, taking nothing of the Gentiles.
8 We therefore ought to receive such, that we might be fellowhelpers to the truth.

rr: 9 Hariho eki naahandiikiire ekanisa; kwonka Diotorefe, okunda kwekuza, tarikutwikiriza.
en: 9 I wrote unto the church: but Diotrephes, who loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth us not.

rr: 10 N'ahabw'ekyo, ku ndiija, ndyabaijutsya ebi arikukora, naatujuma, kandi naatugambaho ebigambo bibi. Kandi tagarukira hari ebyo byonka, kureka ataho n'okwanga kwakiira ab'eishe-emwe, n'abarikwenda kubaakiira abazibira, agaruka abacwa omu kanisa.
en: 10 Wherefore, if I come, I will remember his deeds which he doeth, prating against us with malicious words: and not content therewith, neither doth he himself receive the brethren, and forbiddeth them that would, and casteth them out of the church.

rr: 11 Orikukundwa, otaritooreza orikukora ekibi, kureka orikukora ekirungi.
en: 11 Beloved, follow not that which is evil, but that which is good.

rr: Orikukora gye n'owa Ruhanga; orikukora kubi, takareebaga Ruhanga.
en: He that doeth good is of God: but he that doeth evil hath not seen God.

rr: 12 Demeterio naasiimwa boona, kandi n'amazima nigakihamya; naitwe noomanya ngu okuhamya kwaitu n'okw'amazima.
en: 12 Demetrius hath good report of all men , and of the truth itself: yea, and we also bear record; and ye know that our record is true.

rr: 13 Nkaba nyine bingi kukuhandiikira; kwonka tindikusiima kubihandiikisa akacumu na bwino.
en: 13 I had many things to write, but I will not with ink and pen write unto thee:

rr: 14 Kwonka nyine amatsiko kukureeba juba; obwo turyagaaniira nitureebana.
en: 14 but I trust I shall shortly see thee, and we shall speak face to face. Peace be to thee. Our friends salute thee. Greet the friends by name.
1 The former treatise have I made, O Theophilus, of all that Jesus began both to do and teach,

rr: 2 okuhitsya aha izooba eri yaatwariirweho omu igur, aherize kuragiira entumwa ezi yaatooraine, naazitumaho Omwoyo Orikwera.
en: 2 until the day in which he was taken up, after that he through the Holy Ghost had given commandments unto the apostles whom he had chosen:

rr: 3 Ku yaaherize kubonabonesibwa, yaabeeyoreka ahuriire, yaakihamisa obumanyiso bwingi, yaamara ebiro makumi ana naabeeyoreka, naabagambira eby'obukama bwa Ruhanga.
en: 3 to whom also he shewed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs, being seen of them forty days, and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of God:
4 and, being assembled together with them , commanded them that they should not depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which, saith he , ye have heard of me.
5 For John truly baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost not many days hence.

rr: 6 Ku baabaire bateeraniire hamwe, baamubuuza bati: Mukama waitu, obu nibwo bunaku obu orikwenda kugaruriramu obugabe bwa Israeli?
en: 6 When they therefore were come together, they asked of him, saying, Lord, wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel?
7 And he said unto them, It is not for you to know the times or the seasons, which the Father hath put in his own power.

rr: 8 kwonka muryaheebwa amaani, Omwoyo Orikwera ku ariheza kubaijaho, kandi muryaba baakareebi bangye omuri Yerusaalemu, n'omuri Buyudaaya yoona, n'omuri Samaria, n'okuhitsya aha muheru gw'ensi.
en: 8 But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.

rr: 9 Ku yaaherize kugamba atyo, yaatwarwa ahaiguru nibamureeba, ekicu kyamubakingira.
en: 9 And when he had spoken these things, while they beheld, he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight.

rr: 10 Ku baabaire bakihangire eiguru amaisho, We naakigyenda, reeba abashaija babiri baabeemerera haihi, bajwaire ebirikwera
en: 10 And while they looked stedfastly toward heaven as he went up, behold, two men stood by them in white apparel;
11 which also said, Ye men of Galilee, why stand ye gazing up into heaven? this same Jesus, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven.

rr: 12 Batyo baagaruka Yerusaalemu nibaruga omu kibungo kya Zeituuni, ekyabaire kiri ahihi na Yerusaalemu orugyendo orutarikuzira kugyendwa ahari Sabato.
en: 12 Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day's journey.

rr: 13 Ku baahikireyo, baatemba, baaza omu kishengye kya kanyinaibiri, omu aba boona baagumire, Petero, Yohaana, Yakobo, Anderea, Filipo, Tomasi, Batolomayo, Matayo, Yakobo mwene Alifaayo, Simooni Zeloote na Yuda mwene Yakobo.
en: 13 And when they were come in, they went up into an upper room, where abode both Peter, and James, and John, and Andrew, Philip, and Thomas, Bartholomew, and Matthew, James the son of Alphæus, and Simon Zelotes, and Judas the brother of James.

rr: 14 Abo boona hamwe n'abakazi na Mariamu nyina wa Yesu n'abarumuna, baayezirika kuguma nibashaba n'omutima gumwe.
en: 14 These all continued with one accord in prayer and supplication, with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brethren.

rr: 15 Omu biro ebyo Petero akeemerera ahagati y'ab'eishe-emwe, abaabaire bateeraine, bari nka igana na makumi abiri, yaabagira ati
en: 15 And in those days Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples, and said, (the number of names together were about an hundred and twenty,)
16 Men and brethren, this scripture must needs have been fulfilled, which the Holy Ghost by the mouth of David spake before concerning Judas, which was guide to them that took Jesus.

rr: 17 Ahabw'okuba akaba naabarirwa hamwe naitwe, yaaheebwa omugabo gw'obuheereza obu.
en: 17 For he was numbered with us, and had obtained part of this ministry.
18 Now this man purchased a field with the reward of iniquity; and falling headlong, he burst asunder in the midst, and all his bowels gushed out.

rr: 19 Ekyo kyamanywa boona abaabaire batwire Yerusaalemu, n'ahabw'ekyo omusiri ogwo gukeetwa Akeludaama omu rurimi rwabo, amakuru ngu, omusiri gw'eshagama.
en: 19 And it was known unto all the dwellers at Jerusalem; insomuch as that field is called in their proper tongue, Aceldama, that is to say, The field of blood.
20 For it is written in the book of Psalms,

rr: 21 Mwenu omu bashaija abaabaire bagyenda naitwe ebiro byona ebi Mukama waitu Yesu yaamazire naitwe
en: 21 Wherefore of these men which have companied with us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,

rr: 22 okuruga aha kubatiza kwa Yohaana okuhitsya aha izooba eri yaatwihiirweho okutwarwa omu iguru, omuri abo omwe ashemereire kuba kareebi hamwe naitwe ow'okuhamya okuzooka kwe.
en: 22 beginning from the baptism of John, unto that same day that he was taken up from us, must one be ordained to be a witness with us of his resurrection.

rr: 23 Baatoorana babiri, Yosefu orikwetwa Barusaba, ou baayetsire Yusito, n'ondiijo Matiya.
en: 23 And they appointed two, Joseph called Barsabas, who was surnamed Justus, and Matthias.

rr: 24 Baashaba nibagira bati: Mukama waitu, Iwe orikumanya emitima y'abantu boona omuri aba bombi otworekyemu omwe ou waatoorana
en: 24 And they prayed, and said, Thou, Lord, which knowest the hearts of all men , shew whether of these two thou hast chosen,

rr: 25 atware omwanya gw'obuheereza obu n'obutumwa, obu Yuda yaarugiremu akeegyendera.
en: 25 that he may take part of this ministry and apostleship, from which Judas by transgression fell, that he might go to his own place.
26 And they gave forth their lots; and the lot fell upon Matthias; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles.

rr: 1 Eizooba rya Pentekoote obu ryahika, boona bakaba bateeraniire omu mwanya gumwe.
en: 1 And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.
2 And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.
3 And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire, and it sat upon each of them.
4 And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.

rr: 5 Omu biro ebyo omuri Yerusaalemu hakaba harimu Abayudaaya, abashaija abanyadiini abaarugire omu mahanga goona agari ahansi y'eiguru.
en: 5 And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven.

rr: 6 Omutwe muhango gw'abantu, ku baahuriire okuhoorera okwo, baateeranira hamwe bashobeirwe ahabw'okuba buri muntu akahurira entumwa nizigamba omu rurimi rw'owaabo.
en: 6 Now when this was noised abroad, the multitude came together, and were confounded, because that every man heard them speak in his own language.

rr: 7 Boona baatangaara nibagira bati: Beitu aba boona abarikugamba t'Abagalilaaya?
en: 7 And they were all amazed and marvelled, saying one to another, Behold, are not all these which speak Galilæans?

rr: 8 Mbwenu kyaruga hi itwe twena okuhurira nibagamba endimi z'owaitu ei twazaariirwe?
en: 8 And how hear we every man in our own tongue, wherein we were born?

rr: 9 Haza turi Abapaazi, Abameedi, Abelamiti n'abatuura Mesopotamia, omuri Buyudaaya, omuri Kapadokia, omuri Ponto, omuri Asia
en: 9 Parthians, and Medes, and Elamites, and the dwellers in Mesopotamia, and in Judæa, and Cappadocia, in Pontus, and Asia,

rr: 10 omuri Furugia na Pamfulia, omuri Misri n'omu mashaza ga Libya agahereraine na Kureene, n'abagyenyi abarugire Rooma, by'Abayudaaya n'abahindukire bakataaha omu diini yaabo
en: 10 Phrygia, and Pamphylia, in Egypt, and in the parts of Libya about Cyrene, and strangers of Rome, Jews and proselytes,

rr: 11 n'Abakureete n'Abaharabu; nitubahurira nibagamba omu ndimi ziatu eby'amaani ebikozirwe Ruhanga.
en: 11 Cretes and Arabians, we do hear them speak in our tongues the wonderful works of God.

rr: 12 Boona baatangaara nibabanganisa, nibabuuzana bati: Eki n'enki?
en: 12 And they were all amazed, and were in doubt, saying one to another, What meaneth this?

rr: 13 Kwonka abandi baabashekyerera, nibagira bati: Basinzire viinyo y'omutahe.
en: 13 Others mocking said, These men are full of new wine.

rr: 14 Bwanyima Petero yaayemerera hamwe na bari ikumi n'omwe, yaagamba n'eiraka rihango naabagira ati: Imwe bashaija ba Buyudaaya 'mwe n'abari Yerusaalemu mwena, mumanye eki, kandi mutegye amatu, muhurire ebigambo byangye.
en: 14 But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and said unto them, Ye men of Judæa, and all ye that dwell at Jerusalem, be this known unto you, and hearken to my words:

rr: 15 Mumanye ku aba batasinzire, nk'oku murikuteekateeka, ahakuba hati n'eshaaha ishatu za nyomushana
en: 15 For these are not drunken, as ye suppose, seeing it is but the third hour of the day.
16 But this is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel;

rr: 17 Ruhanga akagira ati: Omu biro by'aha muheru
en: 17 And it shall come to pass in the last days, saith God,

rr: 18 Kandi omu biro ebyo ndyashuka Omwoyo wangye
en: 18 And on my servants and on my handmaidens

rr: 19 Ndyayoreka eby'okutangaaza omu iguru ahaiguru
en: 19 And I will shew wonders in heaven above,

rr: 20 Eizooba riryahinduka omwirima
en: 20 The sun shall be turned into darkness,

rr: 21 Kandi omuntu weena oritakira eiziina rya Mukama aryajunwa.
en: 21 And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved.

rr: 22 Imwe bashaija ba Israeli 'mwe, muhurire ebigambo ebi. Yesu owa Nazareesi, omushaija ou Ruhanga yaabahamiize n'emirimo mikuru n'eby'okutangaaza n'obumanyiso, ebi yaamukoreise ahagati yaanyu, nk'oku mwabyereebeire
en: 22 Ye men of Israel, hear these words; Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved of God among you by miracles and wonders and signs, which God did by him in the midst of you, as ye yourselves also know:
23 him, being delivered by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, ye have taken, and by wicked hands have crucified and slain:

rr: 24 Kwonka Ruhanga akamuzoora, aherize kubohoororwa omu kuhururwa kw'okufa, ahabw'okuba tikurabaasize kumuhamiza kimwe.
en: 24 whom God hath raised up, having loosed the pains of death: because it was not possible that he should be holden of it.
25 For David speaketh concerning him,

rr: 26 Nikyo omutima gwangye gwashemerereirwe, n'orurimi rwangye rukeesiiam
en: 26 Therefore did my heart rejoice, and my tongue was glad;

rr: 27 Ahakuba toritsiga magara gangye kuzimu
en: 27 Because thou wilt not leave my soul in hell,

rr: 28 Okampabura emihanda y'amagara
en: 28 Thou hast made known to me the ways of life;
29 Men and brethren, let me freely speak unto you of the patriarch David, that he is both dead and buried, and his sepulchre is with us unto this day.
30 Therefore being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him, that of the fruit of his loins, according to the flesh, he would raise up Christ to sit on his throne;

rr: 31 Ku yaamanyire ekyo kitakabaireho, yaagamba aha kuzooka kwa Kristo, ku ataratsigirwe kuzimu, kandi n'omubiri gwe ku gutarajunzire.
en: 31 he seeing this before spake of the resurrection of Christ, that his soul was not left in hell, neither his flesh did see corruption.

rr: 32 Yesu ogwo Ruhanga akamuzoora, itwe twena turi baakareebi baakyo.
en: 32 This Jesus hath God raised up, whereof we all are witnesses.

rr: 33 N'ahabw'ekyo, ku yaaherize kutunguurwa omukono gwa buryo gwa Ruhanga, n'okuheebwa Omwoyo Orikwera, ou Isheboona yaaraganiise, yaashuka eki, eki murikureeba, kandi eki murikuhurira.
en: 33 Therefore being by the right hand of God exalted, and having received of the Father the promise of the Holy Ghost, he hath shed forth this, which ye now see and hear.
34 For David is not ascended into the heavens: but he saith himself,

rr: 35 Okuhitsya obu ndigira abazigu baawe
en: 35 Until I make thy foes thy footstool.
36 Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly, that God hath made that same Jesus, whom ye have crucified, both Lord and Christ.
37 Now when they heard this , they were pricked in their heart, and said unto Peter and to the rest of the apostles, Men and brethren, what shall we do?

rr: 38 Petero yaabagarukamu ati: Mweteise, mwena mubatizibwe omu iziina rya Yesu Kristo, mubone kusaasirwa ebibi byanyu; kandi nimwija kuheebwa ekiconco ky'Omwoyo Orikwera.
en: 38 Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.

rr: 39 Ahakuba okuraganisibwa oku n'okwanyu n'okw'abaana baanyu, n'okwa boona abari hare, omuntu weena oryetwa Mukama Ruhanga waitu.
en: 39 For the promise is unto you, and to your children, and to all that are afar off, even as many as the Lord our God shall call.
40 And with many other words did he testify and exhort, saying, Save yourselves from this untoward generation.
41 Then they that gladly received his word were baptized: and the same day there were added unto them about three thousand souls.

rr: 42 Baaguma nibeezirikira okwegyesa kw'entumwa, n'okukwatanisa nazo omu kubega omugaati n'omu kushaba.
en: 42 And they continued stedfastly in the apostles' doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.

rr: 43 Abantu boona baagira obwoba; eby'okutangaaza n'obumanyiso bingi byakorwa entumwa.
en: 43 And fear came upon every soul: and many wonders and signs were done by the apostles.
44 And all that believed were together, and had all things common;

rr: 45 nibatunda amatungo gaabo n'ebintu byabo, nibabigabira boona nk'okukyena kw'omuntu oku kwabaire kuri.
en: 45 and sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all men , as every man had need.

rr: 46 Obutoosha baaguma nibeezirika kuteeranira omuri hekalu n'omutima gumwe, kandi n'okubega omugaati omu maka gaabo; kandi nibarya eby'okurya baine okushemererwa n'emitima etaine buryarya
en: 46 And they, continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, did eat their meat with gladness and singleness of heart,
47 praising God, and having favour with all the people. And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved.

rr: 1 Petero na Yohaana bakaba nibainamuka omuri hekalu omu shaaha ey'okushaba, niyo ya mwenda.
en: 1 Now Peter and John went up together into the temple at the hour of prayer, being the ninth hour .

rr: 2 Kandi hakaba hariho omuntu owaazairwe aremaire ebigyere; ebiro byona bakaba bamuheeka, bamubyamya aha irembo rya hekalu eririkwetwa Erirungi, okushabiriza abarikutaaha omuri hekalu.
en: 2 And a certain man lame from his mother's womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask alms of them that entered into the temple;

rr: 3 Ku yaareebire Petero na Yohana nibataaha omuri hekalu, yaabashaba empiiha.
en: 3 who seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple asked an alms.
4 And Peter, fastening his eyes upon him with John, said, Look on us.

rr: 5 Onu yaagabataho, aine amatsiko ngu baza kugira eki baamuha.
en: 5 And he gave heed unto them, expecting to receive something of them.

rr: 6 Petero yaagira ati: Efeeza n'ezaabu tinziine; kwonka eki nyine, nikyo ndikukuha. Omu iziina rya Yesu Kristo owa Nazareesi, imuka ogyende.
en: 6 Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk.

rr: 7 Yaamukwata omukono gwa buryo, yaamwimutsya; ahonaaho ebigyere bye n'obugomba-mburi bwe byatunga amaani.
en: 7 And he took him by the right hand, and lifted him up: and immediately his feet and ankle bones received strength.

rr: 8 Yaabandatuka, yaayemerera, yaatandika kugyenda; yaataaha nabo omuri hekalu, naagyenda, naagaruka, naahimbisa Ruhanga.
en: 8 And he leaping up stood, and walked, and entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.

rr: 9 Abantu boona baamureeba naagyenda naahimbisa Ruhanga
en: 9 And all the people saw him walking and praising God:

rr: 10 bamanya ku ari ogwo owaabaire atuura aha irembo erirungi rya hekalu, naashabiriza; baashoberwa munonga, batangaarira ekyo ekyamubaho.
en: 10 and they knew that it was he which sat for alms at the Beautiful gate of the temple: and they were filled with wonder and amazement at that which had happened unto him.

rr: 11 Ku yaabaire akwaitwe Petero na Yohaana, abantu boona bairukira ahu baabaire bari omu ksiasi ekirikwetwa ekya Sulemaani, nibatangaara munonga.
en: 11 And as the lame man which was healed held Peter and John, all the people ran together unto them in the porch that is called Solomon's, greatly wondering.

rr: 12 Petero ku yaabareebire, yaabagambira ati: Imwe bashaija ba Israeli 'mwe, ahabw'enki nimutangaarira omushaija ogu? Nari nimutushamaaririra ki nk'abarikuteekateeka ngu amaani gaitu nari shi okutiina Ruhanga kwaitu nibyo byagyendesa omushaija ogu?
en: 12 And when Peter saw it , he answered unto the people, Ye men of Israel, why marvel ye at this? or why look ye so earnestly on us, as though by our own power or holiness we had made this man to walk?

13 The God of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Jacob, the God of our fathers, hath glorified his Son Jesus; whom ye delivered up, and denied him in the presence of Pilate, when he was determined to let him go.

rr: 14 Kwonka imwe mwayehakana Orikwera kandi Ohikiriire, mwashaba kuheebwa omwitsi
en: 14 But ye denied the Holy One and the Just, and desired a murderer to be granted unto you;

rr: 15 kandi Mukama w'amagara mwamwita; kwonka Ruhanga yaamuzoora omu bafu; naitwe turi baakareebi ab'okukihamya.
en: 15 and killed the Prince of life, whom God hath raised from the dead; whereof we are witnesses.

rr: 16 Kandi omushaija ogu, ou murikureeba, kandi ou murikumanya, ahabw'okwikiriza eiziina rya Yesu, eiziina eryo niryo ryamuha amaani; kandi okwikiriza kimwe omu maisho gaanyu mwena.
en: 16 And his name through faith in his name hath made this man strong, whom ye see and know: yea, the faith which is by him hath given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.
17 And now, brethren, I wot that through ignorance ye did it , as did also your rulers.
18 But those things, which God before had shewed by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he hath so fulfilled.
19 Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;

rr: 20 atume Kristo owaabateereirweho, niwe Yesu
en: 20 and he shall send Jesus Christ, which before was preached unto you:

rr: 21 ou eiguru rihsemereire kwakiira, okuhitsya obunaku bw'okugaruramu ebintu byona obusya, obu Ruhanga yaabaire agambira omu kanwa ka baanabi be abarikwera abaabire bariho okuruga aha kuhangwa kw'ensi.
en: 21 whom the heaven must receive until the times of restitution of all things, which God hath spoken by the mouth of all his holy prophets since the world began.
22 For Moses truly said unto the fathers, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear in all things whatsoever he shall say unto you.
23 And it shall come to pass, that every soul, which will not hear that prophet, shall be destroyed from among the people.

rr: 24 Kandi na baanabi boona abaaragwire okuruga ahari Samueli n'abaamukuratiire, nabo nikwo baagambire aha biro ebi.
en: 24 Yea, and all the prophets from Samuel and those that follow after, as many as have spoken, have likewise foretold of these days.
25 Ye are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying unto Abraham, And in thy seed shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed.

rr: 26 Niimwe Ruhanga yaabandize kutumaho Omugaragwa we, aherize kumuzoora, ngu abahe omugisha naabahindura, omuntu weena omuriimwe arugye omu bibi bye.
en: 26 Unto you first God, having raised up his Son Jesus, sent him to bless you, in turning away every one of you from his iniquities.
1 And as they spake unto the people, the priests, and the captain of the temple, and the Sadducees, came upon them,

rr: 2 babagwereirwe kubi, ahabw'okwegyesa abantu, nibabagambira ngu omuri Yesu nimwo okuzooka omu bafu kubonekyeire.
en: 2 being grieved that they taught the people, and preached through Jesus the resurrection from the dead.

rr: 3 Baabakwata, baabata omu kihome okuhitsya omu kasheeshe, ahakuba bukaba buri omu mwabazyo.
en: 3 And they laid hands on them, and put them in hold unto the next day: for it was now eventide.

rr: 4 Kwonka baingi ahari abo abaahuriire ekigambo ekyo bakaikiriza; n'omubaro gw'abashaija gwayeyongyera, twahika nk'enkumi itaano.
en: 4 Howbeit many of them which heard the word believed; and the number of the men was about five thousand.

rr: 5 Ku bwaseesire, abategyeki baabo n'abakuru b'abantu na'bahandiiki baateeranira Yerusaalemu
en: 5 And it came to pass on the morrow, that their rulers, and elders, and scribes,

rr: 6 na Aana omunyamurwa omukuru na Kayaafa na Yohaana na Alegizanda, n'abandi boona ab'omuryango gw'omunyamurwa omukuru.
en: 6 and Annas the high priest, and Caiaphas, and John, and Alexander, and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest, were gathered together at Jerusalem.
7 And when they had set them in the midst, they asked, By what power, or by what name, have ye done this?
8 Then Peter, filled with the Holy Ghost, said unto them, Ye rulers of the people, and elders of Israel,

rr: 9 ku turaabe nitubuuzibwa hati ahabw'ekirungi eki tukoreire omuntu ogwo ekirema, n'ekimukirize
en: 9 if we this day be examined of the good deed done to the impotent man, by what means he is made whole;

rr: 10 imwe mwena n'abantu boona Abaisraeli mumanye ngu omu iziina rya Yesu Kristo owa Nazareesi, ou mwabambire aha musharaba, kandi ou Ruhanga yaazoire omu bafu, ahabw'Ogwo omushaija ogu ayemereire omu maisho gaanyu akizire.
en: 10 be it known unto you all, and to all the people of Israel, that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom ye crucified, whom God raised from the dead, even by him doth this man stand here before you whole.
11 This is the stone which was set at nought of you builders, which is become the head of the corner.

rr: 12 Kandi tihariho ondiijo ou twakuboneramu okujunwa, ahakuba tihariho rindi iziina ahansi y'eiguru eryahairwe abantu, erishemereire kutujuna.
en: 12 Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.

rr: 13 Ku baareebire obumanzi bwa Petero na Yohaana, haza nibamanya ku bari abantu babisi abateegyesiibwe, baatangaara; bwanyima baijuka ku baabaire batuura na Yesu.
en: 13 Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marvelled; and they took knowledge of them, that they had been with Jesus.

rr: 14 Kandi ku baareebire omushaija ogwo okizire ayemereire hamwe nabo, baabura oku baraabahakanise.
en: 14 And beholding the man which was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.

rr: 15 Ku baaherize kubaragiira kushohora aheeru y'eishengyero, baahanuura bonka
en: 15 But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,
16 saying, What shall we do to these men? for that indeed a notable miracle hath been done by them is manifest to all them that dwell in Jerusalem; and we cannot deny it .

rr: 17 Mbwenu okukizibira kubuga omu bantu, murekye tubakangise, okuruga hati batagira omuntu ou baagaruka kugambira omu iziina eryo.
en: 17 But that it spread no further among the people, let us straitly threaten them, that they speak henceforth to no man in this name.

rr: 18 Nikwo kubeeta, bakabeehanangiriza kutagaruka kuteeza n'obu kwakuba owkegyesa omu iziina rya Yesu.
en: 18 And they called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.

rr: 19 Kwonka Petero na Yohaana baagarukamu, nibabaigira bati: Ku kiraabe kihikire omu maisho ga Ruhanga kuhurira imwe okukira Ruhanga, naimwe mukireebe
en: 19 But Peter and John answered and said unto them, Whether it be right in the sight of God to hearken unto you more than unto God, judge ye.

rr: 20 kwonka itwe titurikubaasa kuhunama kutagamba ebi twareebire, n'ebi twahuriire.
en: 20 For we cannot but speak the things which we have seen and heard.

rr: 21 Ku baaherize kugaruka kubakangisa, baabarekura, ahabw'okuba bakabura oku baraabahane ahabw'okutiina abantu; ahakuba boona bakaba nibahimbisa Ruhanga ahabw'ekyo ekikozirwe.
en: 21 So when they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding nothing how they might punish them, because of the people: for all men glorified God for that which was done.

rr: 22 Kandi omushaija ogwo, owaakoreirwe eky'okutangaaza ekyo eky'okukizibwa, akaba ahingwize emyaka makumi ana.
en: 22 For the man was above forty years old, on whom this miracle of healing was shewed.

rr: 23 Ku baarekwirwe, baagyenda baashanga bagyenzi baabo, baabatekyerereza byona ebi abanyamurwa abakuru n'abakuru b'abantu baabagambira.
en: 23 And being let go, they went to their own company, and reported all that the chief priests and elders had said unto them.
24 And when they heard that, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord, and said, Lord, thou art God, which hast made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all that in them is:
25 Who by the mouth of thy servant David hast said,

rr: 26 Abagabe b'ensi bakatenga orugamba
en: 26 The kings of the earth stood up,

rr: 27 N'eky'amazima omu rurembo oru Heroode na Pontio Pilaato hamwe n'abanyamahanga n'enganda za Israeli bakeeteerana kurwanisa Omuheereza waawe orikwera Yesu, ou waashukireho amajuta
en: 27 For of a truth against thy holy child Jesus, whom thou hast anointed, both Herod, and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles, and the people of Israel, were gathered together,
28 for to do whatsoever thy hand and thy counsel determined before to be done.
29 And now, Lord, behold their threatenings: and grant unto thy servants, that with all boldness they may speak thy word,

rr: 30 iwe ogoroire omukono gwawe kukiza, haza obumanyiso n'eby'okutangaaza bikorwe omu iziina ry'Omuheereza waawe orikwera Yesu.
en: 30 by stretching forth thine hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done by the name of thy holy child Jesus.
31 And when they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were assembled together; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they spake the word of God with boldness.

rr: 32 Abo boona baikiriize bakaba baine omutima gumwe n'enaama emwe; omuribo tihariho owaabaire aine obunyakantu aha bintu bye, bakaba nibakwatirana omu bintu byabo byona.
en: 32 And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and of one soul: neither said any of them that ought of the things which he possessed was his own; but they had all things common.

rr: 33 Kandi entumwa zikagira amaani maingi g'okuhamya okuzooka kwa Mukama waitu Yesu; n'embabazi nyingi zaabagumaho boona.
en: 33 And with great power gave the apostles witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus: and great grace was upon them all.
34 Neither was there any among them that lacked: for as many as were possessors of lands or houses sold them, and brought the prices of the things that were sold,

rr: 35 baazita aha bigyere by'entumwa; baazibabaganisiza nk'okwetunga kwa buri muntu oku kwabaire kuri.
en: 35 and laid them down at the apostles' feet: and distribution was made unto every man according as he had need.
36 And Joses, who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas, (which is, being interpreted, The son of consolation,) a Levite, and of the country of Cyprus,

rr: 37 akaba aine omusiri, yaagutunda, yaareeta empiiha, yaazita aha bigyere by'entumwa.
en: 37 having land, sold it , and brought the money, and laid it at the apostles' feet.

rr: 1 Kwonka omushaija orikwetwa Anania n'omukazi we Safira baatunda ekibanja
en: 1 But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,

rr: 2 yaayetsigariza ekicweka ky'obuguzi bwakyo, n'omukazi we naakimanya, yaareeta ekyatsigaireho, yaakita aha bigyere by'entumwa.
en: 2 and kept back part of the price, his wife also being privy to it , and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles' feet.

rr: 3 Petero yaagira ati: Beitu Anania, ahabw'enki Sitaane aijwire omutima gwawe okubeiha Omwoyo Orikwera, okeetsigariza ekicweka ky'obuguzi bw'ekibanja?
en: 3 But Peter said, Ananias, why hath Satan filled thine heart to lie to the Holy Ghost, and to keep back part of the price of the land?

rr: 4 Otakakitundize, kikaba kitari kyawe? Hoona na waaherize kukitunda, obuguzi bwakyo tiburagumire omu bushoboorozi bwawe? N'enki ekikuteekateekyeise omu mutima gwawe okukora otyo? Tobeihire bantu, obeihire Ruhanga.
en: 4 Whiles it remained, was it not thine own? and after it was sold, was it not in thine own power? why hast thou conceived this thing in thine heart? thou hast not lied unto men, but unto God.

rr: 5 Anania, ku yaahuriire ebigambo ebyo, yaagwa ahansi, yaafa. Boona abaakihuriire baakwatwa obwoba bwingi.
en: 5 And Ananias hearing these words fell down, and gave up the ghost: and great fear came on all them that heard these things.

rr: 6 Abatsigazi baimuka, baamuzinga, baamutwara, baamuziika.
en: 6 And the young men arose, wound him up, and carried him out, and buried him .

rr: 7 Ku haahingwireho omwanya gw'eshaaha nka ishatu, omukazi we yaija ataine ki arikumanya.
en: 7 And it was about the space of three hours after, when his wife, not knowing what was done, came in.

rr: 8 Petero yaamubuuza ati: Ngambira; obuguzi obu nibwo mwatunzire omu kibanja? Yaamugarukamu ati: Eego, nibwo obwo.
en: 8 And Peter answered unto her, Tell me whether ye sold the land for so much? And she said, Yea, for so much.

rr: 9 Petero yaamugira ati: Ahabw'enki mwaikirizaine kugyeza Omwoyo wa Mukama? Hurira emitsindo y'abarikuruga kuziika baro, bari aha rwigi, naiwe bakushohoze.
en: 9 Then Peter said unto her, How is it that ye have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? behold, the feet of them which have buried thy husband are at the door, and shall carry thee out.

rr: 10 Ahonaaho yaagwa ahansi aha bigyere bye, yaakinuka. Abatsigazi abo, ku baataahiremu, baashanga yaafiire, baamushohoza aheeru, baamuziika aha rubaju rwa iba.
en: 10 Then fell she down straightway at his feet, and yielded up the ghost: and the young men came in, and found her dead, and, carrying her forth, buried her by her husband.

rr: 11 Obwoba bwingi bwakwata ekanisa yoona, na boona abaabihuriire.
en: 11 And great fear came upon all the church, and upon as many as heard these things.
12 And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people; (and they were all with one accord in Solomon's porch.

rr: 13 Aha bandi tihariho n'omwe owaayehangire kuteerana nabo; kwonka abantu boona bakaba babahimbisa munonga
en: 13 And of the rest durst no man join himself to them: but the people magnified them.

rr: 14 n'abaikiriize baingi, abashaija n'abakazi, baayeyongyera munonga kukanya, nibeehongyera Mukama
en: 14 And believers were the more added to the Lord, multitudes both of men and women.)
15 Insomuch that they brought forth the sick into the streets, and laid them on beds and couches, that at the least the shadow of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them.

rr: 16 Kandi abantu baaruga omuri tauni eziri haihi na Yerusaalemu, baateeranira aho, bareetsire abarwaire n'abariho baadaimoni; boona baatambirwa.
en: 16 There came also a multitude out of the cities round about unto Jerusalem, bringing sick folks, and them which were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed every one.

rr: 17 Bwanyima omunyamurwa omukuru yaimuka n'abo abu yaabaire aine, ab'omu kicweka ky'Abasadukaayo, baijwire eihari
en: 17 Then the high priest rose up, and all they that were with him, (which is the sect of the Sadducees,) and were filled with indignation,

rr: 18 baakwata entumwa, baazita omu kihome zoona.
en: 18 and laid their hands on the apostles, and put them in the common prison.
19 But the angel of the Lord by night opened the prison doors, and brought them forth, and said,

rr: 20 Mugyende mwemerere omuri hekalu, mugambire abantu ebigambo byona eby'Amagara aga.
en: 20 Go, stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.

rr: 21 Ku baakihuriire, baataaha omuri hekalu omu kasheeshe, baayegyesa.
en: 21 And when they heard that , they entered into the temple early in the morning, and taught.

rr: Ku baabaire bakiriyo, omunyamurwa omukuru yaija hamwe n'abo abu yaabaire aine, yaateerana eishengyero n'abakuru boona b'Abaisraeli, yaatuma omu kihome kubareeta.
en: But the high priest came, and they that were with him, and called the council together, and all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.

rr: 22 Abakuru b'abaserukare ku baahikireyo, tibaabashangamu, baagaruka, baabamanyisa, bati
en: 22 But when the officers came, and found them not in the prison, they returned, and told,

rr: 23 Ekihome twashanga kikingirwe gye buzima, n'abarinzi beemereire aha nyigi; kwonka ku twaiguraho, titwashangamu muntu.
en: 23 saying, The prison truly found we shut with all safety, and the keepers standing without before the doors: but when we had opened, we found no man within.

rr: 24 Omurinzi wa hekalu n'abanyamurwa abakuru ku baahuriire ebigambo ebyo, baashoberwa munonga, baayebuuza ahu biraagarukire.
en: 24 Now when the high priest and the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these things, they doubted of them whereunto this would grow.

rr: 25 Omu mwanya ogwo haija omuntu yaabagambira ati: Reeba, abashaija abo abu mutaire omu kihome, beemereire omuri hekalu nibeegyesa abantu.
en: 25 Then came one and told them, saying, Behold, the men whom ye put in prison are standing in the temple, and teaching the people.

rr: 26 Omurinzi ogwo hamwe n'abakuru b'abaserukare nikwo kugyenda bakabareeta, batarikubaita kubi, ahakuba bakaba nibatiina abantu ngu batabateera amabaare.
en: 26 Then went the captain with the officers, and brought them without violence: for they feared the people, lest they should have been stoned.

rr: 27 Ku baabahikize aho, baabeemereza omu maisho g'eishengyero, omunyamurwa omukuru yaababuuza ati
en: 27 And when they had brought them, they set them before the council: and the high priest asked them,
28 saying, Did not we straitly command you that ye should not teach in this name? and, behold, ye have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine, and intend to bring this man's blood upon us.
29 Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said, We ought to obey God rather than men.

rr: 30 Ruhanga wa baatatenkuriitwe akazoora Yesu ou mwaitsire muhanikire aha muti.
en: 30 The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom ye slew and hanged on a tree.
31 Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour, for to give repentance to Israel, and forgiveness of sins.
32 And we are his witnesses of these things; and so is also the Holy Ghost, whom God hath given to them that obey him.
33 When they heard that , they were cut to the heart , and took counsel to slay them.
34 Then stood there up one in the council, a Pharisee, named Gamaliel, a doctor of the law, had in reputation among all the people, and commanded to put the apostles forth a little space;

rr: 35 Yaabagira ati: Imwe bashaija ba Israeli 'mwe, mwerinde; ebi murikwenda kukora aba bantu, mubigyendeho mpora.
en: 35 and said unto them, Ye men of Israel, take heed to yourselves what ye intend to do as touching these men.

rr: 36 Nimumanya ngu omu biro bihingwire, hakaimuka omushaija orikwetwa Teuda, yaayegambaho ku ari omuntu mukuru; kandi abantu nka magana ana baakwatanisa nawe; kwonka omushaija ogwo akaitwa, n'abaamukuratiire boona baataataana, baahwaho.
en: 36 For before these days rose up Theudas, boasting himself to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered, and brought to nought.
37 After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing, and drew away much people after him: he also perished; and all, even as many as obeyed him, were dispersed.
38 And now I say unto you, Refrain from these men, and let them alone: for if this counsel or this work be of men, it will come to nought:
39 but if it be of God, ye cannot overthrow it; lest haply ye be found even to fight against God.

rr: 40 Batyo baikiriza obwengye obu yaabaha; baayeta entumwa, baaziteera; baazeehanangiriza kutagaruka kugamba omu iziina rya Yesu, baazirekura.
en: 40 And to him they agreed: and when they had called the apostles, and beaten them , they commanded that they should not speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.
41 And they departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for his name.

rr: 42 Kandi ebiro byona, omuri hekalu n'omu maka gaabo tibararekire kwegyesa bya Yesu n'okubuurira abantu ku ari Kristo.
en: 42 And daily in the temple, and in every house, they ceased not to teach and preach Jesus Christ.
1 And in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplied, there arose a murmuring of the Grecians against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration.

rr: 2 Bari ikumi na babiri baayeta omutwe gwona ogw'abeegi, baagira bati: tikihikire itwe kurereera kugamba ekigambo kya Ruhanga ahabw'okugabura.
en: 2 Then the twelve called the multitude of the disciples unto them , and said, It is not reason that we should leave the word of God, and serve tables.
3 Wherefore, brethren, look ye out among you seven men of honest report, full of the Holy Ghost and wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.

rr: 4 Reero itwe nitwija kwezirikira okushaba n'okuheereza ekigambo kya Ruhanga.
en: 4 But we will give ourselves continually to prayer, and to the ministry of the word.

rr: 5 Ekigambo ekyo kyasiimwa omutwe gwona; baatoorana Stefano, omushaija oijwire okwikiriza n'Omwoyo Orikwera, na Filipo, na Porokoro, na Nikanoori, na Timoni, na Pamena, na Nikola owa Antiokia, owaahindukiire omu diini y'Abayudaaya.
en: 5 And the saying pleased the whole multitude: and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Ghost, and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolas a proselyte of Antioch:
6 whom they set before the apostles: and when they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.

rr: 7 Ekigambo kya Ruhanga kyayeyongyera kubuga; omubaro gw'abeegi gwakanya munonga omuri Yerusaalemu; kandi abanyamurwa baingi baayorobera okwikiriza.
en: 7 And the word of God increased; and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem greatly; and a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.

rr: 8 Kandi Stefano, aijwire embabazi n'obushoboorozi, yaakora eby'okutangaaza n'obumanyiso bikuru omu bantu.
en: 8 And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and miracles among the people.

rr: 9 Kwonka bamwe ab'omuri # 6:9 sinagogi n'ekanisa y'ekiyudaaya. sinagogi y'Abaliberitiino n'Abanyakureene n'aba Alegizanderia, n'ey'aba Kilikia n'aba Asia, baimuka baahakanisa Stefano.
en: 9 Then there arose certain of the synagogue, which is called the synagogue of the Libertines, and Cyrenians, and Alexandrians, and of them of Cilicia and of Asia, disputing with Stephen.

rr: 10 Kwonka tibaabaasa kusinga obwengye n'Omwoyo ebyabaire nibumugambisa.
en: 10 And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the spirit by which he spake.

rr: 11 Nikwo kuguriirira abantu, abaagizire bati: Tukahurira naagamba ebigambo by'okurogota ahari Musa n'ahari Ruhanga
en: 11 Then they suborned men, which said, We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses, and against God.

rr: 12 Baayosya abantu n'abakuru baabo n'abahandiiki, baamugurukira, baamukwata, baamutwara omu maisho g'eishengyero.
en: 12 And they stirred up the people, and the elders, and the scribes, and came upon him , and caught him, and brought him to the council,
13 and set up false witnesses, which said, This man ceaseth not to speak blasphemous words against this holy place, and the law:

rr: 14 ahakuba tukahurira naagira ati: Yesu ogwo owa Nazareesi aryahwerekyereza omwanya ogu, ahindure emigyenzo ei Musa yaatuhaire.
en: 14 for we have heard him say, that this Jesus of Nazareth shall destroy this place, and shall change the customs which Moses delivered us.

rr: 15 Boona abaabaire bashutami omu ishengyero, ku baamutaireho amaisho, baareeba ahamaisho ge nihashusha aha maraika.
en: 15 And all that sat in the council, looking stedfastly on him, saw his face as it had been the face of an angel.

rr: 1 Omunyamurwa omukuru yaamubuuza ati: Ebyo nikwo biri bityo?
en: 1 Then said the high priest, Are these things so?
2 And he said,

rr: 3 yaamuragiira ati: Ruga omu nsi y'owaanyu n'omuri beene waanyu, oze omu nsi ei ndikworeka.
en: 3 and said unto him, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and come into the land which I shall shew thee.

rr: 4 Nawe nikwo kuruga omu nsi y'Abakaludaaya, akatuura Harani. Bwanyima ishe ku yaafiire, Ruhanga yaamwihayo, yaamutaasya omu nsi egi, ei mutwiremu na hati mbwenu.
en: 4 Then came he out of the land of the Chaldæans, and dwelt in Charran: and from thence, when his father was dead, he removed him into this land, wherein ye now dwell.
5 And he gave him none inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on: yet he promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his seed after him, when as yet he had no child.
6 And God spake on this wise, That his seed should sojourn in a strange land; and that they should bring them into bondage, and entreat them evil four hundred years.

rr: 7 Eihanga eryo eriribahindura abahuuku, nyowe Ruhanga ndyaricwera orubanja; bwanyima y'ebyo baryarugayo, bandamize omu mwanya ogu.
en: 7 And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge, said God: and after that shall they come forth, and serve me in this place.
8 And he gave him the covenant of circumcision: and so Abraham begat Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat the twelve patriarchs.
9 And the patriarchs, moved with envy, sold Joseph into Egypt: but God was with him,
10 and delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favour and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and he made him governor over Egypt and all his house.
11 Now there came a dearth over all the land of Egypt and Chanaan, and great affliction: and our fathers found no sustenance.
12 But when Jacob heard that there was corn in Egypt, he sent out our fathers first.

rr: 13 Aha murundi gwa kabiri Yosefu yaayemanyisa bakuru be; na Faraho yaamanyira aho oruganda rwa Yosefu.
en: 13 And at the second time Joseph was made known to his brethren; and Joseph's kindred was made known unto Pharaoh.
14 Then sent Joseph, and called his father Jacob to him , and all his kindred, threescore and fifteen souls.

rr: 15 Yakobo yaashuuma, yaaza Misri; okwo niyo yaagwire, na baatatenkuriitwe
en: 15 So Jacob went down into Egypt, and died, he, and our fathers,
16 and were carried over into Sychem, and laid in the sepulchre that Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Emmor the father of Sychem.

rr: 17 Kwonka obunaku bw'endagaano ei Ruhanga yaaraganiise Abrahamu ku bwahikire, Abaisraeli baakanya, baaba baingi omuri Misri
en: 17 But when the time of the promise drew nigh, which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,

rr: 18 okuhitsya obu haayemire omugabe ondiijo, owaabaire atarikumanya Yosefu.
en: 18 Till another king arose, which knew not Joseph.
19 The same dealt subtilly with our kindred, and evil entreated our fathers, so that they cast out their young children, to the end they might not live.
20 In which time Moses was born, and was exceeding fair, and nourished up in his father's house three months:
21 and when he was cast out, Pharaoh's daughter took him up, and nourished him for her own son.

rr: 22 Musa yaayegyesibwa obwengye bwona obw'Abanyamisri; yaaba ow'amaani omu bigambo bye n'omu bi yaabaire naakora.
en: 22 And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and was mighty in words and in deeds.

rr: 23 Ku yaahikize emyaka makumi ana, yaizirwa ekitekateeko ky'okutaayaayira beene ishe Abaisraeli.
en: 23 And when he was full forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brethren the children of Israel.

rr: 24 Ku yaareebire omwe aharibo naaturwa busha, yaamurwanaho, yaamuhoorera, yaita Omunyamisri.
en: 24 And seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him , and avenged him that was oppressed, and smote the Egyptian:

rr: 25 Yaagira ngu beene ishe bakaayetegyereza ku Ruhanga arikwenda kubajunisa omukono gwe; kwonka bo tibaakimanya.
en: 25 for he supposed his brethren would have understood how that God by his hand would deliver them: but they understood not.
