rr: 26 Ku bwaseesire, yaashanga babiri nibarwana, yaayenda ngu abaramure abateerane, yaabagira ati: Bashaija 'mwe, ahabw'enki nimukorana kubi, haza muri ab'oruganda rumwe?
en: 26 And the next day he shewed himself unto them as they strove, and would have set them at one again, saying, Sirs, ye are brethren; why do ye wrong one to another?

rr: 27 Ogwo owaabaire naashaagiza mugyenzi we, yaatsindika Musa naagira ati: N'oha owaakugizire omutegyeki kandi omuramuzi waitu?
en: 27 But he that did his neighbour wrong thrust him away, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge over us?

rr: 28 Nooyenda kuunyita, nk'oku oitsire Omunyamisri nyomwabazyo?
en: 28 Wilt thou kill me, as thou diddest the Egyptian yesterday?
29 Then fled Moses at this saying, and was a stranger in the land of Madian, where he begat two sons.
30 And when forty years were expired, there appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sina an angel of the Lord in a flame of fire in a bush.

rr: 31 Musa ku yaagureebire, yaagutangaarira; ku yairiire haihi kureeba, eiraka rya Mukama ryamugira riti
en: 31 When Moses saw it , he wondered at the sight: and as he drew near to behold it , the voice of the Lord came unto him,

rr: 32 Ndi Ruhanga wa baashwenkuru, Ruhanga wa Abrahamu, owa Isaaka, kandi owa Yakobo.
en: 32 saying , I am the God of thy fathers, the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.

rr: Musa yaatetema, yaatiina kugumyayo amaisho.
en: Then Moses trembled, and durst not behold.

rr: 33 Mukama yaamugira ati: Iha enkaito omu bigyere, ahakuba omwanya ogu oyemereiremu n'ogurikwera.
en: 33 Then said the Lord to him, Put off thy shoes from thy feet: for the place where thou standest is holy ground.

rr: 34 Buzimazima ndeebire okubonabonesibwa kw'abantu bangye abari omuri Misri, naahurira okutsinda kwabo; mbwenu nshuumire kubajuna.
en: 34 I have seen, I have seen the affliction of my people which is in Egypt, and I have heard their groaning, and am come down to deliver them.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo ija hati, nkutume Misri.
en: And now come, I will send thee into Egypt.
35 This Moses whom they refused, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge? the same did God send to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel which appeared to him in the bush.
36 He brought them out, after that he had shewed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, and in the Red sea, and in the wilderness forty years.
37 This is that Moses, which said unto the children of Israel, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear.

rr: 38 Hoona niwe yaabaire ari ahagati y'omutwe gw'abantu omu ihamba, ari hamwe na maraika owaamugambiriire aha rushozi Sinai, kandi ari hamwe na baatatenkuriitwe; niwe yaahairwe ebigambo by'amagara ngu abituhe.
en: 38 This is he, that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel which spake to him in the mount Sina, and with our fathers: who received the lively oracles to give unto us:
39 to whom our fathers would not obey, but thrust him from them, and in their hearts turned back again into Egypt,
40 saying unto Aaron, Make us gods to go before us: for as for this Moses, which brought us out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.

rr: 41 Omu biro ebyo baaheesha ekishushani ky'enyana, baakihongyera ekitambo, baashemerererwa emirimo y'emikono yaabo.
en: 41 And they made a calf in those days, and offered sacrifice unto the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their own hands.
42 Then God turned, and gave them up to worship the host of heaven; as it is written in the book of the prophets,

rr: 43 Ngaaha; omu mazima ebi mwabaire nimuheeka n'eihema rya Moloki, n'enyonyoozi ya ruhanga Refani, ebishushani ebi mwayekoreire kuramya. Naanye ndyabatwara, mbarengyeze Babulooni.
en: 43 Yea, ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch,
44 Our fathers had the tabernacle of witness in the wilderness, as he had appointed, speaking unto Moses, that he should make it according to the fashion that he had seen.

rr: 45 Eihema eryo niryo baatatenkuriitwe baahairwe baishebo, bakaritaasya omu nsi egi, obu baija na Yoshua, bakakubuura ensi y'Abanyamahanga abu Ruhanga yaabingire omu maisho gaabo okuhitsya aha busingye bwa Daudi.
en: 45 Which also our fathers that came after brought in with Jesus into the possession of the Gentiles, whom God drave out before the face of our fathers, unto the days of David;
46 who found favour before God, and desired to find a tabernacle for the God of Jacob.
47 But Solomon built him an house.

rr: 48 Haza Rukira-boona atatuura mu maju agombekirwe emikono, nk'oku nabi yaagizire ati
en: 48 Howbeit the most High dwelleth not in temples made with hands; as saith the prophet,

rr: 49 Eiguru nikyo kitebe kyangye ky'obukama
en: 49 Heaven is my throne,

rr: 50 Omukono gwangye tigwo gwahangire ebyo byona?
en: 50 Hath not my hand made all these things?
51 Ye stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, ye do always resist the Holy Ghost: as your fathers did , so do ye.
52 Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted? and they have slain them which shewed before of the coming of the Just One; of whom ye have been now the betrayers and murderers:
53 who have received the law by the disposition of angels, and have not kept it .

rr: 54 Ku baahuriire ebyo, baagira ekiniga kingi, baamunenera amaino.
en: 54 When they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed on him with their teeth.
55 But he, being full of the Holy Ghost, looked up stedfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,

rr: 56 yaagira ati: Reeba, nindeeba eiguru rikinguukire, n'Omwana w'omuntu ayemereire aha rubaju rwa buryo rwa Ruhanga.
en: 56 and said, Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God.

rr: 57 Baayomba munonga, baayekwata aha matu, baamweshukaho
en: 57 Then they cried out with a loud voice, and stopped their ears, and ran upon him with one accord,
58 and cast him out of the city, and stoned him : and the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young man's feet, whose name was Saul.
59 And they stoned Stephen, calling upon God , and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.
60 And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.

rr: 1 Kandi Saulo akasiima okwitwa kwe.
en: 1 And Saul was consenting unto his death.

rr: Aha izooba eryo baatandika kuhiiga munonga ekanisa y'omuri Yerusaalemu; boona baataataanira omu byanga bya Buyudaaya na Samaria, okwihaho entumwa zonka.
en: And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judæa and Samaria, except the apostles.

rr: 2 Abashaija abarikutiina Ruhanga baaziika Stefano, baamucurira munonga.
en: 2 And devout men carried Stephen to his burial , and made great lamentation over him.
3 As for Saul, he made havock of the church, entering into every house, and haling men and women committed them to prison.

rr: 4 N'ahabw'ekyo abaataataine baagyenda boona nibabuurira ekigambo.
en: 4 Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching the word.
5 Then Philip went down to the city of Samaria, and preached Christ unto them.

rr: 6 Emitwe mingi y'abantu, ku baabaire bahurira ebi Filipo arikugamba, baareeba obumanyiso obu arikukora, baabiikiriza n'omutima gumwe.
en: 6 And the people with one accord gave heed unto those things which Philip spake, hearing and seeing the miracles which he did.

rr: 7 Ahabw'okuba baingi aharibo abaabaire bariho baadaimoni, baadaimoni bakaba babarugaho nibaamuza munonga; kandi baingu abaabaire bazingazingirwe, n'abaremaire, bakizibwa.
en: 7 For unclean spirits, crying with loud voice, came out of many that were possessed with them : and many taken with palsies, and that were lame, were healed.

rr: 8 Haabaho okushemererwa kwingi omu rurembo orwo.
en: 8 And there was great joy in that city.

rr: 9 Kandi hakaba hariho omushaija orikwetwa Simooni, owaabaire akora eby'obufumu omu rurembo orwo, naatangaaza eihanga ry'Abasamaria, naayeyeta omuntu mukuru.
en: 9 But there was a certain man, called Simon, which beforetime in the same city used sorcery, and bewitched the people of Samaria, giving out that himself was some great one:

rr: 10 Abantu boona, okuruga aha muto okuhika aha mukuru, bakaba bamutiina, nibagira bati: Omushaija ogu niwe naani ga Ruhanga ageetwa Rugambwa.
en: 10 to whom they all gave heed, from the least to the greatest, saying, This man is the great power of God.

rr: 11 Bakaba bamutiina, ahabw'okuba akaba amazire omwanya muhango naabatangaaza n'obufumu bwe.
en: 11 And to him they had regard, because that of long time he had bewitched them with sorceries.

rr: 12 Kwonka ku baikiriize Filipo owaababuuriire ebigambo birungi eby'obukama bwa Ruhanga n'eiziina rya Yesu Kristo, baabatizibwa, abashija n'abakazi.
en: 12 But when they believed Philip preaching the things concerning the kingdom of God, and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.

rr: 13 Kandi Simooni nawe yaikiriza; ku yaaherize kubatizibwa, yaaguma na Filipo; ku yaareebire naakora obumanyiso n'eby'okutangaaza bikuru, yaatangaara munonga.
en: 13 Then Simon himself believed also: and when he was baptized, he continued with Philip, and wondered, beholding the miracles and signs which were done.

rr: 14 Kandi entumwa ezaabaire ziri Yerusaalemu, ku zaahuriire ngu aba Samaria baikiriize ekigambo kya Ruhanga, zaabatumaho Petero na Yohaana.
en: 14 Now when the apostles which were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent unto them Peter and John:

rr: 15 Nabo, ku baahikireyo, baabashabira ngu baheebwe Omwoyo Orikwera
en: 15 who, when they were come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Ghost:

rr: 16 ahakuba Omwoyo akaba atakaizire aha muntu weena omuribo, kureka bakaba babatiziibwe omu iziina rya Mukama waitu Yesu.
en: 16 (for as yet he was fallen upon none of them: only they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.)
17 Then laid they their hands on them, and they received the Holy Ghost.

rr: 18 Simooni, ku yaareebire baaheebwa Omwoyo Orikwera ahabw'okuteebwaho engaro z'entumwa, yaazireetera empiiha
en: 18 And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles' hands the Holy Ghost was given, he offered them money,

rr: 19 naagira ati: Naanye mumpe amaani aga, weena ou ndaateho engaro aheebwe Omwoyo Orikwera.
en: 19 saying, Give me also this power, that on whomsoever I lay hands, he may receive the Holy Ghost.

rr: 20 Kwonka Petero yaamugarukamu ati: Efeeza yaawe ebure naiwe, ahabw'okuba waateekateeka kugura ekiconco kya Ruhanga n'empiiha.
en: 20 But Peter said unto him, Thy money perish with thee, because thou hast thought that the gift of God may be purchased with money.

rr: 21 Toine mugabo n'obu kwakuba okukwatanisa naitwe omu kigambo eki; ahabw'okuba omutima gwawe tiguri gye mu maisho ga Ruhanga.
en: 21 Thou hast neither part nor lot in this matter: for thy heart is not right in the sight of God.

rr: 22 N'ahabw'ekyo oyeteise obubi bwawe obu, oshabe Mukama, shana akaakusaasira ekiteekateeko ky'omu mutima gwawe.
en: 22 Repent therefore of this thy wickedness, and pray God, if perhaps the thought of thine heart may be forgiven thee.

rr: 23 Nindeeba ku ori omu ndurwe erikushaarira n'omu nkomo z'obubi.
en: 23 For I perceive that thou art in the gall of bitterness, and in the bond of iniquity.

rr: 24 Simooni yaagarukamu naagira ati: Munshabire ahari Mukama, byona ebi mwagamba bitampikaho.
en: 24 Then answered Simon, and said, Pray ye to the Lord for me, that none of these things which ye have spoken come upon me.

rr: 25 Bwanyima entumwa, ku zaaherize kuhamya ekigambo kya Mukama n'okukigamba, zaagaruka Yerusaalemu, nizibuurira engiri omu birorero bingi eby'Abasamaria.
en: 25 And they, when they had testified and preached the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the gospel in many villages of the Samaritans.

rr: 26 Maraika wa Mukama yaagambira Filipo ati: Imuka ogyende, otoore omuhanda gw'eihamba ogw'obukiizi-bwa-buryo ogurikushuuma, okuruga Yerusaalemu okuhika Gaaza.
en: 26 And the angel of the Lord spake unto Philip, saying, Arise, and go toward the south unto the way that goeth down from Jerusalem unto Gaza, which is desert.

rr: 27 Yaimuka, yaagyenda. Kandi hakaba hariho omushaija omukonwa owa Esiopia, ow'obushoboorozi bwingi, obu yaahairwe Kandake, omugabekazi wa Esiopia, owaabaire ari omubiiki w'ebintu bye byona; ogwo akaba agiire Yerusaalemu kuramya.
en: 27 And he arose and went: and, behold, a man of Ethiopia, an eunuch of great authority under Candace queen of the Ethiopians, who had the charge of all her treasure, and had come to Jerusalem for to worship,

rr: 28 Ku yaabaire naagaruka owaabo, ashutami omu kigaari kye, naashoma ekitabo kya nabi Isaaya
en: 28 was returning, and sitting in his chariot read Esaias the prophet.

rr: 29 Omwoyo yaagambira Filipo, ati: Hika ekigaari kiriya, ogyende nakyo.
en: 29 Then the Spirit said unto Philip, Go near, and join thyself to this chariot.

rr: 30 Filipo yairuka, yaamuhika, yaahurira naashoma omu kitabo kya nabi Isaaya, yaamubuuza ati: Nooshoborokyerwa ebi orikushoma?
en: 30 And Philip ran thither to him , and heard him read the prophet Esaias, and said, Understandest thou what thou readest?

rr: 31 Yaamugarukamu ati: Nimbaasa nta, ntaine w'okunshobororera?
en: 31 And he said, How can I, except some man should guide me?

rr: Yaashaba Filipo ngu atembe omu kigaari, ashutame nawe.
en: And he desired Philip that he would come up and sit with him.
32 The place of the scripture which he read was this,

rr: 33 Omu kugarurwa ahansi kwe bakamwitira orubanja
en: 33 In his humiliation his judgment was taken away:

rr: 34 Omukonwa yaabuuza Filipo naagira ati: Ninkushaba onshobororere, nabi ogwo akagamba ahari oha? Akeegambaho, nari akagamba aha muntu ondiijo?
en: 34 And the eunuch answered Philip, and said, I pray thee, of whom speaketh the prophet this? of himself, or of some other man?

rr: 35 Filipo yaatandika kugamba naihirira aha Byahandiikirwe ebyo, yaamugambira ebya Yesu.
en: 35 Then Philip opened his mouth, and began at the same scripture, and preached unto him Jesus.
36 And as they went on their way, they came unto a certain water: and the eunuch said, See, here is water; what doth hinder me to be baptized?

rr: 37 Filipo yaamugira ati: Ku oraabe waikiriza n'omutima gwawe gwona, nikibaasika.
en: 37 And Philip said, If thou believest with all thine heart, thou mayest.

rr: Yaagarukamu ati: Niinyikiriza ku Yesu Kristo ari Omwana wa Ruhanga.
en: And he answered and said, I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God.

rr: 38 Atyo yaaragiira ku beemereza ekigaari; bombi Filipo n'omukonwa baashuuma omu maizi; yaamubatiza.
en: 38 And he commanded the chariot to stand still: and they went down both into the water, both Philip and the eunuch; and he baptized him.
39 And when they were come up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught away Philip, that the eunuch saw him no more: and he went on his way rejoicing.
40 But Philip was found at Azotus: and passing through he preached in all the cities, till he came to Cæsarea.
1 And Saul, yet breathing out threatenings and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went unto the high priest,

rr: 2 yaamushaba kuhandiikira sinagogi za Damasiko ebaruha ngu, ku araashangyeyo abarikwikiriza eby'Omuhanda ogwo, yaaba abashaija nari abakazi, abatware Yerusaalemu babohirwe.
en: 2 and desired of him letters to Damascus to the synagogues, that if he found any of this way, whether they were men or women, he might bring them bound unto Jerusalem.
3 And as he journeyed, he came near Damascus: and suddenly there shined round about him a light from heaven:

rr: 4 yaagwa ahansi, yaahurira eiraka nirimugira riti: Saulo, Saulo, nompiigira ki?
en: 4 and he fell to the earth, and heard a voice saying unto him, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?

rr: 5 Yaagarukamu ati: Ori oha, Mukama wangye?
en: 5 And he said, Who art thou, Lord?

rr: We ati: Niinye Yesu ou orikuhiiga.
en: And the Lord said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest: it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.

rr: 6 Taatetema ashobeirwe, yaabuuza ati: Mukama wangye, nooyenda ngu ngire nta?
en: 6 And he trembling and astonished said, Lord, what wilt thou have me to do?

rr: Mukama yaamugarukamu ati: Imuka, otaahe omu rurembo, noija kugambirwa ebi oshemereire kukora.
en: And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the city, and it shall be told thee what thou must do.

rr: 7 Abashaija abaabire nibagyenda nawe baayemerera bahunami, nibahurira eiraka, kwonka batarikureeba muntu.
en: 7 And the men which journeyed with him stood speechless, hearing a voice, but seeing no man.

rr: 8 Saulo yaimuka ahansi; ku yaabuurwire amaisho, tiyaahweza kintu; baamukwata omukono, baamutwara Damasiko.
en: 8 And Saul arose from the earth; and when his eyes were opened, he saw no man: but they led him by the hand, and brought him into Damascus.

rr: 9 Yaamarayo ebiro bishatu atarikuhweza, kandi atarikurya n'obu kwakuba okunywa.
en: 9 And he was three days without sight, and neither did eat nor drink.

rr: 10 Kandi Damasiko hakaba hariyo omwegi orikwetwa Anania. Mukama waitu yaamugambira omu kworekwa ati: Anania! Yaamugarukamu ati: Ndi aha, Mukama wangye.
en: 10 And there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and to him said the Lord in a vision, Ananias . And he said, Behold, I am here , Lord.

rr: 11 Mukama waitu yaamugira ati: Imuka oze omu muhanda ogurikwetwa Ogugororokire, obuuze omu nju ya Yuda omuntu orikwetwa Saulo owa Taruso; ahakuba hati naashaba.
en: 11 And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the street which is called Straight, and enquire in the house of Judas for one called Saul, of Tarsus: for, behold, he prayeth,

rr: 12 Kandi areebire omu kworekwa omushaija orikwetwa Anania naija kumutaho engaro ngu ahumuukye.
en: 12 and hath seen in a vision a man named Ananias coming in, and putting his hand on him, that he might receive his sight.

rr: 13 Kwonka Anania yaagarukamu ati: Mukama wangye, nkahurira baingi nibagamba aha mushaija ogwo, ku yaakozire kubi munonga abarikwera baawe omuri Yerusaalemu
en: 13 Then Ananias answered, Lord, I have heard by many of this man, how much evil he hath done to thy saints at Jerusalem:
14 and here he hath authority from the chief priests to bind all that call on thy name.

rr: 15 Kwonka Mukama yaamugira ati: Irooko ogyende; ahakuba omushaija ogwo n'ekintu kyangye eki ntooraine okutwara eiziina ryangye omu maisho g'Abanyamahanga n'abagabe n'Abaisraeli
en: 15 But the Lord said unto him, Go thy way: for he is a chosen vessel unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the children of Israel:
16 for I will shew him how great things he must suffer for my name's sake.

rr: 17 Anania nikwo kugyenda, akataaha omu nju egyo; akmutaho engaro, akamugira ati: Ow'eishe-emwe Saulo, Mukama waitu Yesu, okweyorekyeire omu muhanda ogu oreetsirwemu, yantuma ngu ohumuukye, oijure Omwoyo Orikwera.
en: 17 And Ananias went his way, and entered into the house; and putting his hands on him said, Brother Saul, the Lord, even Jesus, that appeared unto thee in the way as thou camest, hath sent me, that thou mightest receive thy sight, and be filled with the Holy Ghost.

rr: 18 Ahonaaho ebintu ebiri nk'ebikoko byamuruga aha maisho, yaahumuuka; yaayemerera, yaabatizibwa.
en: 18 And immediately there fell from his eyes as it had been scales: and he received sight forthwith, and arose, and was baptized.

rr: 19 Ku yaaherize kurya eby'okurya, yaagarukwamu amaani. Bwanyima yaamara ebiro bikye n'abeegi Damasiko.
en: 19 And when he had received meat, he was strengthened.

rr: 20 Ahonaaho yaatandika kugamba Yesu omuri sinagogi, ku ari Omwana wa Ruhanga.
en: 20 And straightway he preached Christ in the synagogues, that he is the Son of God.

rr: 21 Boona abaamuhuriire baatangaara nibagira bati: ogu t'omushaija owaabaire anyangaraza aba Yerusaalemu abaabaire batakira eiziina eryo? Kandi ekyo nikyo kibaire kimureetsire n'aha, ngu abatware babohirwe omu maisho g'abanyamurwa abakuru.
en: 21 But all that heard him were amazed, and said; Is not this he that destroyed them which called on this name in Jerusalem, and came hither for that intent, that he might bring them bound unto the chief priests?

rr: 22 Kwonka Saulo yaayeyongyera kutunga amaani, yaakwatsa enshoni Abayudaaya abaabaire batwire Damasiko, naahamiza kimwe ku Yesu ari Kristo.
en: 22 But Saul increased the more in strength, and confounded the Jews which dwelt at Damascus, proving that this is very Christ.
23 And after that many days were fulfilled, the Jews took counsel to kill him:

rr: 24 kwonka enaama yaabo Saulo yaagimanya. Baamugwera aha marembo nyomushana na nyekiro, ngu bamwite
en: 24 but their laying await was known of Saul. And they watched the gates day and night to kill him.
25 Then the disciples took him by night, and let him down by the wall in a basket.
26 And when Saul was come to Jerusalem, he assayed to join himself to the disciples: but they were all afraid of him, and believed not that he was a disciple.

rr: 27 Kwonka Barunaba yaamutwara, yaamuhitsya entumwa, yaabashobororera oku yaareebire Mukama akiri omu muhanda, Mukama akagamba nawe, kandi n'oku yaabuuriire n'obumanzi omu iziina rya Yesu omuri Damasiko.
en: 27 But Barnabas took him, and brought him to the apostles, and declared unto them how he had seen the Lord in the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how he had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of Jesus.

rr: 28 Yaaguma naataayaayira ab'omuri Yerusaalemu
en: 28 And he was with them coming in and going out at Jerusalem.

rr: 29 naabuurira n'obumanzi omu iziina rya Mukama. Kandi yaahakanisa Abahelenesti; nabo baasherura oku baraamwite.
en: 29 And he spake boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus, and disputed against the Grecians: but they went about to slay him.
30 Which when the brethren knew, they brought him down to Cæsarea, and sent him forth to Tarsus.

rr: 31 N'ahabw'ekyo ekanisa y'omuri Buyudaaya yoona na Galilaaya na Samaria yaagira obusingye yahamibwa; abantu baayeyongyera kukanya nibagyendera omu kutiina Mukama, bahangainwe Omwoyo Orikwera.
en: 31 Then had the churches rest throughout all Judæa and Galilee and Samaria, and were edified; and walking in the fear of the Lord, and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost, were multiplied.

rr: 32 Omu biro ebyo Petero, ku yaabaire naataayaayira hoona, yaashuuma, yaataayaayira n'abarikwera abaabaire batwire Luuda.
en: 32 And it came to pass, as Peter passed throughout all quarters , he came down also to the saints which dwelt at Lydda.

rr: 33 Yaashangayo omushaija orikwetwa Ainea, owaabaire amazire emyaka munaana abyami aha kitanda ahabw'okuzingazingwa.
en: 33 And there he found a certain man named Æneas, which had kept his bed eight years, and was sick of the palsy.

rr: 34 Petero yaamugira ati: Ainea, Yesu Kristo yaakutambira; imuka, oyeyarire. Ahonaaho yaimuka.
en: 34 And Peter said unto him, Æneas, Jesus Christ maketh thee whole: arise, and make thy bed. And he arose immediately.

rr: 35 Abaabaire batwire Luuda na Sharooni boona ku baamureebire, baahndukira Mukama.
en: 35 And all that dwelt at Lydda and Saron saw him, and turned to the Lord.

rr: 36 Omuri Yoopa hakaba harimu omwegi orikwetwa Tabisa, amakuru gaaryo ni Doruka, nari Esirabo; omukazi ogwo akaba akora emirimo mingi mirungi n'eby'embabazi eby'okuhwera abooro.
en: 36 Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which by interpretation is called Dorcas: this woman was full of good works and almsdeeds which she did.

rr: 37 Omu biro ebyo akarwara, yaafa. Ku baaherize kwozya omutumbi gwe, baagubyamya omuri kanyinaibiri.
en: 37 And it came to pass in those days, that she was sick, and died: whom when they had washed, they laid her in an upper chamber.

rr: 38 Kandi ahabwa Luuda kuba haihi na Yoopa, abeegi ku baahuriire ngu Petero niyo ari, baamutumaho abashaija babiri, baamweshengyereza nibagira bati: Orahukye, oije otureebe.
en: 38 And forasmuch as Lydda was nigh to Joppa, and the disciples had heard that Peter was there, they sent unto him two men, desiring him that he would not delay to come to them.

rr: 39 Petero yaimuka, yaagyenda nabo.
en: 39 Then Peter arose and went with them.

rr: Ku yaahikireyo, baamutembya omuri kanyinaibiri; n'abafaakazi boona baija, baamwemerera haihi nibarira, nibooreka amakanzu n'ebijwaro ebi Doruka yaakozire akiriho.
en: When he was come, they brought him into the upper chamber: and all the widows stood by him weeping, and shewing the coats and garments which Dorcas made, while she was with them.

rr: 40 Petero yaabashohoza, yaatsimba amaju, yaashaba; yaahindukira omutumbi, yaagira ati: Tabisa, imuka.
en: 40 But Peter put them all forth, and kneeled down, and prayed; and turning him to the body said, Tabitha, arise.

rr: Yaabuuruura amaisho; ku yaareebire Petero yaashutama.
en: And she opened her eyes: and when she saw Peter, she sat up.

rr: 41 Petero yaamuha omukono, yaamwimutsya, yaayeta abarikwera n'abafaakazi, yaamubooreka ahuriire.
en: 41 And he gave her his hand, and lifted her up, and when he had called the saints and widows, presented her alive.

rr: 42 Ekyo kyamanywa omuri Yoopa yoona; baingi baikiriza Mukama.
en: 42 And it was known throughout all Joppa; and many believed in the Lord.

rr: 43 Bwanyima yaamara ebiro bingi omuri Yoopa omu nju ya Simooni omuhazi w'empu.
en: 43 And it came to pass, that he tarried many days in Joppa with one Simon a tanner.
1 There was a certain man in Cæsarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the band called the Italian band ,

rr: 2 akaba ari omunyadiini, orikutiina Ruhanga hamwe n'ab'omu ka ye boona, owaabaire ahwera abooro n'ebintu bye bingi, kandi naashaba Ruhanga obutoosha.
en: 2 a devout man , and one that feared God with all his house, which gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God alway.

rr: 3 Eizooba rimwe aha shaaha nk'eya mwenda akareeba maraika wa Ruhanga omu kworekwa naija ah'ari, yaamugira ati: Koruneelio.
en: 3 He saw in a vision evidently about the ninth hour of the day an angel of God coming in to him, and saying unto him, Cornelius.

rr: 4 We yaamuhanga amaisho aine obwoba, yaamubuuza ati: N'enki, Mukama wangye?
en: 4 And when he looked on him, he was afraid, and said, What is it, Lord?

rr: Yaamugarukamu ati: Okushaba kwawe n'obuhwezi bwawe bitembire okuba ekiijutsyo ahari Ruhanga.
en: And he said unto him, Thy prayers and thine alms are come up for a memorial before God.

rr: 5 Mbwenu tuma abashaija Yoopa, beeteyo omuntu Simooni orikwetwa Petero
en: 5 And now send men to Joppa, and call for one Simon, whose surname is Peter:

rr: 6 orikuraara owa Simooni omuhazi w'empu, enju ye eri aha rubaju rw'enyanja.
en: 6 he lodgeth with one Simon a tanner, whose house is by the sea side: he shall tell thee what thou oughtest to do.

rr: 7 Maraika owaabarize nawe ku yaagyenzire, Koruneelio yaatuma abambari be babiri, n'omuserukare omunyadiini w'omuri abo abaabaire bamuheereza obutoosha
en: 7 And when the angel which spake unto Cornelius was departed, he called two of his household servants, and a devout soldier of them that waited on him continually;

rr: 8 ku yaaherize kubateekyerereza byona, yaabatuma Yoopa.
en: 8 and when he had declared all these things unto them, he sent them to Joppa.

rr: 9 Omu kasheeshe, abo abaatumirwe ku baabaire bahika haihi na tauni egyo, bakiri omu rugyendo rwabo, Petero yaatembas aha utwe gw'enju kushaba aha shaaha nk'eya muakaga
en: 9 On the morrow, as they went on their journey, and drew nigh unto the city, Peter went up upon the housetop to pray about the sixth hour:

rr: 10 yaagira enjara, yaayenda kurya; ku baabaire nibaihura, yaaba nk'orikuroota
en: 10 and he became very hungry, and would have eaten: but while they made ready, he fell into a trance,

rr: 11 yaareeba eiguru rikinguukire, n'ekintu ekirikushusha nk'omwenda muhango munonga, ogukwatsirwe aha nshonda ina, nikishuuma ahansi
en: 11 and saw heaven opened, and a certain vessel descending unto him, as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners, and let down to the earth:

rr: 12 kirimu enganda zoona z'enyamaishwa n'ebirikugyendesa enda n'ebirikuguruka omu mwanya.
en: 12 wherein were all manner of fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.

rr: 13 Yaahurira eiraka nirimugira riti: Petero, imuka, oite orye.
en: 13 And there came a voice to him, Rise, Peter; kill, and eat.
14 But Peter said, Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten any thing that is common or unclean.
15 And the voice spake unto him again the second time, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.

rr: 16 Ebyo byabaho bityo kashatu; ahonaaho ekintu ekyo kyagarurwa omu iguru.
en: 16 This was done thrice: and the vessel was received up again into heaven.

rr: 17 Petero ku yaabaire arimbagiriirwe, akishobeirwe amakuru g'okworekwa okwo oku yaareeba, abashaija abo, abatumirwe Koruneelio, ku baaherize kuhabuza enju ya Simooni, baija, baayemerera aha irembo
en: 17 Now while Peter doubted in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean, behold, the men which were sent from Cornelius had made enquiry for Simon's house, and stood before the gate,

rr: 18 baayeta nibabuuza bati: Simooni orikwetwa Petero naaraara aha?
en: 18 and called, and asked whether Simon, which was surnamed Peter, were lodged there.

rr: 19 Petero ku yaabaire naakiteekateeka aha kworekwa, Omwoyo yaamugira ati: Reeba, abashaija bashatu nibakusherura
en: 19 While Peter thought on the vision, the Spirit said unto him, Behold, three men seek thee.

rr: 20 imuka oshuume, ogyende nabo otarikubanganisa; ahakuba niinye naabatuma.
en: 20 Arise therefore, and get thee down, and go with them, doubting nothing: for I have sent them.

rr: 21 Petero nikwo kushuuma, akabahika, akabagira ati: Niinye ou murikusherura. Muhuutsirwe ki?
en: 21 Then Peter went down to the men which were sent unto him from Cornelius; and said, Behold, I am he whom ye seek: what is the cause wherefore ye are come?

rr: 22 Baamugira bati: Koruneelio, omukuru w'abaserukare, omushaija ohikiriire, orikutiina Ruhanga, kandi orikusiimwa eihanga ry'Abayudaaya ryona, aragiirwe maraika orikwera kukweta kwija omu ka ye, ngu ahurire ebi oraamugambire.
en: 22 And they said, Cornelius the centurion, a just man, and one that feareth God, and of good report among all the nation of the Jews, was warned from God by an holy angel to send for thee into his house, and to hear words of thee.
23 Then called he them in, and lodged them . And on the morrow Peter went away with them, and certain brethren from Joppa accompanied him.

rr: 24 Aha kiro ekindi baataaha Kaisarea.
en: 24 And the morrow after they entered into Cæsarea.

rr: Baashanga Koruneelio abategyereize n'abanywani be buzima.
en: And Cornelius waited for them, and had called together his kinsmen and near friends.

rr: 25 Petero ku yaabaire naakitaaha, Koruneelio yaamubugana, yaamugwa aha bigyere, yaamuramya.
en: 25 And as Peter was coming in, Cornelius met him, and fell down at his feet, and worshipped him .
26 But Peter took him up, saying, Stand up; I myself also am a man.

rr: 27 Ku yaabaire naakigamba nawe, yaataahamu, yaashanga baingi bateeraine
en: 27 And as he talked with him, he went in, and found many that were come together.

rr: 28 yaabagira ati: Imwe nimumanya ku kizira Omuyudaaya okukwatanisa n'omuntu w'eihanga erindi, n'obu kwakuba kumutaayaayira; kwonka nyowe Ruhanga akaanyoreka ku ntashemereire kunuga muntu weena nari shi okumweta otashemeire.
en: 28 And he said unto them, Ye know how that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Jew to keep company, or come unto one of another nation; but God hath shewed me that I should not call any man common or unclean.

rr: 29 N'ahabw'ekyo, ku nyetsirwe, tinaayanga kwija. Nikyo ndikubuuriza eki muunyeteire.
en: 29 Therefore came I unto you without gainsaying, as soon as I was sent for: I ask therefore for what intent ye have sent for me?

rr: 30 Koruneelio yaagira ati: Ebiro bina ebihingwire mbaire ninshabira omu nju yangye aha shaaha y'okushaba eya mwnea; ku mbaire ninshaba, naareeba omushaija anyemereire omumaisho, ajwaire ebijwaro ebirikwengyengyeta
en: 30 And Cornelius said, Four days ago I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour I prayed in my house, and, behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing,

rr: 31 yaagira ati: Koruneelio, okushaba kwawe kuhuriirwe, n'obuhwezi bwawe bwijukirwe ahari Ruhanga.
en: 31 and said, Cornelius, thy prayer is heard, and thine alms are had in remembrance in the sight of God.

rr: 32 N'ahabw'ekyo tuma Yoopa, oyeteyo Simooni orikwetwa Petero; hati naaraara omu nju ya Simooni omuhazi w'empu aha rubaju rw'enyanja.
en: 32 Send therefore to Joppa, and call hither Simon, whose surname is Peter; he is lodged in the house of one Simon a tanner by the sea side: who, when he cometh, shall speak unto thee.

rr: 33 Ahonaaho naakutumaho; kandi naiwe waakora gye kwija.
en: 33 Immediately therefore I sent to thee; and thou hast well done that thou art come.

rr: Mbwenu hati turi aha twena omu maisho ga Ruhanga okuhurira byona ebi oragiirwe Mukama.
en: Now therefore are we all here present before God, to hear all things that are commanded thee of God.
34 Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons:
35 but in every nation he that feareth him, and worketh righteousness, is accepted with him.
36 The word which God sent unto the children of Israel, preaching peace by Jesus Christ: (he is Lord of all:)

rr: 37 Ekigambo ekyo naimwe nimukimanya, nikyo kyagambirwe omuri Buyudaaya yoona, okutandikira Galilaaya, bwanyima y'okubuurira kwa Yohaana okw'okubatiza
en: 37 that word, I say , ye know, which was published throughout all Judæa, and began from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;
38 how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power: who went about doing good, and healing all that were oppressed of the devil; for God was with him.

rr: 39 Naitwe turi baakareebi by'ebyo byona ebi yaakozire omu nsi y'Abayudaaya n'omuri Yerusaalemu. Yesu ogwo bakamwita, bamuhanikire aha muti
en: 39 And we are witnesses of all things which he did both in the land of the Jews, and in Jerusalem; whom they slew and hanged on a tree:

rr: 40 kwonka Ruhanga yaamuzoora aha kiro kya kashatu yaamworeka butunu
en: 40 him God raised up the third day, and shewed him openly;

rr: 41 ti mu bantu boona, kureka ahari baakareebi, abaatoorainwe Ruhanga ira, nibo itwe abaariire kandi abaanyweire nawe aherize kuzooka omu bafu.
en: 41 not to all the people, but unto witnesses chosen before of God, even to us, who did eat and drink with him after he rose from the dead.
42 And he commanded us to preach unto the people, and to testify that it is he which was ordained of God to be the Judge of quick and dead.
43 To him give all the prophets witness, that through his name whosoever believeth in him shall receive remission of sins.

rr: 44 Petero ku yaabaire naakigamba ebigambo ebyo, Omwoyo Orikwera yaashuuma ahari boona abaabaire nibahurira ekigambo.
en: 44 While Peter yet spake these words, the Holy Ghost fell on all them which heard the word.

rr: 45 Abaikiriize ab'omu bashazirwe, abaizire na Petero boona, baatangaara ahabw'Abanyamahanga nabo kushukwaho ekiconco ky'Omwoyo Orikwera.
en: 45 And they of the circumcision which believed were astonished, as many as came with Peter, because that on the Gentiles also was poured out the gift of the Holy Ghost.
46 For they heard them speak with tongues, and magnify God. Then answered Peter,

rr: 47 Abantu aba abaaheebwa Omwoyo Orikwera nkaitwe, hariho orikubaasa kubaima amaizi ngu batabatizibwa?
en: 47 Can any man forbid water, that these should not be baptized, which have received the Holy Ghost as well as we?

rr: 48 Yaaragiira ngu babatizibwe omu iziina rya Yesu Kristo. Bwanyima baamweshengyereza kumarayo ebiro bikye.
en: 48 And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord. Then prayed they him to tarry certain days.

rr: 1 Entumwa n'ab'eishe-emwe abaabaire bari Buyudaaya bakahurira ngu Abanyamahanga nabo baikiriize ekigambo kya Ruhanga.
en: 1 And the apostles and brethren that were in Judæa heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.

rr: 2 Petero ku yaagarukire Yerusaalemu, ab'omu kigombe ky'abashazirwe baahakana nawe
en: 2 And when Peter was come up to Jerusalem, they that were of the circumcision contended with him,
3 saying, Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised, and didst eat with them.

rr: 4 Petero yaatandika kubashobororera byona oku byakurataine, naagira ati
en: 4 But Peter rehearsed the matter from the beginning, and expounded it by order unto them, saying,

rr: 5 Nyowe nkaba ndi omuri tauni Yoopa, ninshaba; naashusha nk'orikuroota, naayorekwa ekintu, ekirikushusha nk'omwenda muhango munonga ogukwatsirwe aha nshonda ina, nikishuuma okuruga omu iguru; kyampikaho.
en: 5 I was in the city of Joppa praying: and in a trance I saw a vision, A certain vessel descend, as it had been a great sheet, let down from heaven by four corners; and it came even to me:

rr: 6 Ku naakigumizeho amaisho, naayetegyereza, naareeba enyamaishwa z'omu nsi z'amaguru ana, n'endi z'abantu, n'ebirikugyendesa enda, n'ebirikuguruka omu mwanya.
en: 6 upon the which when I had fastened mine eyes, I considered, and saw fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.

rr: 7 Kandi naahurira n'eiraka eririkungambira riti: Petero, imuka oite orye.
en: 7 And I heard a voice saying unto me, Arise, Peter; slay and eat.

rr: 8 Kwonka nyowe naagira nti: Ngaaha, Mukama wangye! Ahabw'okuba ekintu ekirikuzira nari ekitashemeire tikikahikaga mu kanwa kangye.
en: 8 But I said, Not so, Lord: for nothing common or unclean hath at any time entered into my mouth.

rr: 9 Kwonka eiraka ryangarukamu obwa kabiri, niriruga omu iguru riti: Eki Ruhanga yashemeize, otarikihindura ekirikuzira.
en: 9 But the voice answered me again from heaven, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.

rr: 10 Ekyo kyabaho kashatu; bwanyima byona byagarurwa omu iguru.
en: 10 And this was done three times: and all were drawn up again into heaven.

rr: 11 Omu shaaha egyo abashaija bashatu baayemerera omu maisho g'enju, ei twabaire turimu, batumirwe ahariinye nibaruga Kaisarea.
en: 11 And, behold, immediately there were three men already come unto the house where I was, sent from Cæsarea unto me.

rr: 12 Omwoyo yandagiira kugyenda nabo ntarikubanganisa.
en: 12 And the Spirit bade me go with them, nothing doubting.

rr: Nikwo kugyenda n'ab'eishe-emwe mukaaga, tukataaha omu nju y'omushaija ogwo.
en: Moreover these six brethren accompanied me, and we entered into the man's house:

rr: 13 Nawe akatuteekyerereza oku yaareebire maraika ayemereire omu nju ye, naagira ati: Tuma Yoopa, oyeteyo Simooni orikwetwa Petero
en: 13 and he shewed us how he had seen an angel in his house, which stood and said unto him, Send men to Joppa, and call for Simon, whose surname is Peter;

rr: 14 ogwo aryakugambira ebigambo ebirikujunisa n'ab'omu ka yaawe boona.
en: 14 who shall tell thee words, whereby thou and all thy house shall be saved.

rr: 15 Ku naatandikire kugamba, Omwoyo Orikwera yaabashuumaho, nk'oku yaizire ahariitwe bwa mbere.
en: 15 And as I began to speak, the Holy Ghost fell on them, as on us at the beginning.

rr: 16 Ahonaaho naijuka ekigambo kya Mukama, eki yaagambire ati: Buzimazima Yohaana akabatiza n'amaizi; kwonka imwe muryabatizibwa n'Omwoyo Orikwera.
en: 16 Then remembered I the word of the Lord, how that he said, John indeed baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost.

rr: 17 Mbwenu, Ruhanga ku araabe yaabahaire ekiconco nk'eki yaatuhaire obu twaikiriza Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo, nyowe nkaba ndi oha okurwanisa Ruhanga?
en: 17 Forasmuch then as God gave them the like gift as he did unto us, who believed on the Lord Jesus Christ; what was I, that I could withstand God?
18 When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life.
19 Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phenice, and Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word to none but unto the Jews only.

rr: 20 Kwonka hakaba hariho bamwe aharibo, abashaija ba Kupuro na Kureene; abo ku baahikire Antiokia, baagambira n'Abagriika, nibababuurira ebya Mukama waitu Yesu.
en: 20 And some of them were men of Cyprus and Cyrene, which, when they were come to Antioch, spake unto the Grecians, preaching the Lord Jesus.

rr: 21 Omukono gwa Mukama gukaba guri aharibo, omutwe mwingi gw'abantu abaikiriize baahindukira Mukama.
en: 21 And the hand of the Lord was with them: and a great number believed, and turned unto the Lord.

rr: 22 Enkuru zaabyo zaahurirwa ekanisa ey'omuri Yerusaalemu, baatuma Barunaba Antiokia.
en: 22 Then tidings of these things came unto the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem: and they sent forth Barnabas, that he should go as far as Antioch.

rr: 23 Ku yaahikireyo, yaareeba embabazi za Ruhanga, yaashemererwa; yaabeehanangiriza boona kuguma ahari Mukama n'omutima oguhamire.
en: 23 Who, when he came, and had seen the grace of God, was glad, and exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord.

rr: 24 Barunaba ogwo akaba ari omushaija murungi, oijwire Omwoyo Orikwera n'okwikiriza; kandi abantu baingi baija, baayehongyera Mukama.
en: 24 For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Ghost and of faith: and much people was added unto the Lord.

rr: 25 Bwanyima yaarugayo, yaaza Taruso kusherura Saulo
en: 25 Then departed Barnabas to Tarsus, for to seek Saul:

26 and when he had found him, he brought him unto Antioch. And it came to pass, that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church, and taught much people. And the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch.

rr: 27 Omu biro ebyo baanabi aba Yerusaalemu baija Antiokia.
en: 27 And in these days came prophets from Jerusalem unto Antioch.
28 And there stood up one of them named Agabus, and signified by the Spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world: which came to pass in the days of Claudius Cæsar.
29 Then the disciples, every man according to his ability, determined to send relief unto the brethren which dwelt in Judæa:
30 Which also they did, and sent it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.
1 Now about that time Herod the king stretched forth his hands to vex certain of the church.

rr: 2 Yakobo mukuru wa Yohaana yaamwitsa rurara.
en: 2 And he killed James the brother of John with the sword.

rr: 3 Ku yaareebire Abayudaaya baakisiima, yaagaruka yaakwata na Petero. (Ebiro ebyo bikaba biri eby'Emigaati etatumbisiibwe.)
en: 3 And because he saw it pleased the Jews, he proceeded further to take Peter also. (Then were the days of unleavened bread.)

rr: 4 Ku yaaherize kumukwata, yaamuta omu kihome, yaamutaho abaserukare ikumi na mukaaga kumurinda bana-bana, amaririire kumureeta omu maisho g'abantu bwanyima y'Okuhingurwaho.
en: 4 And when he had apprehended him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four quaternions of soldiers to keep him; intending after Easter to bring him forth to the people.
5 Peter therefore was kept in prison: but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto God for him.

rr: 6 Heroode ku yaabaire naayenda kumubareetera omu kasheeshe, ekiro ekyo Petero akaba agwejegyeire ari ahagati y'abaserukare babiri, n'abarinzi bari aha rwigi barinzire ekihome.
en: 6 And when Herod would have brought him forth, the same night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains: and the keepers before the door kept the prison.

7 And, behold, the angel of the Lord came upon him , and a light shined in the prison: and he smote Peter on the side, and raised him up, saying, Arise up quickly. And his chains fell off from his hands.

rr: 8 Maraika yaamugira ati: Yezirikye, ojware enkaito zaawe.
en: 8 And the angel said unto him, Gird thyself, and bind on thy sandals.

rr: Yaakora atyo.
en: And so he did.

rr: Kandi ati: Jwara omunagiro gwawe, onkurate.
en: And he saith unto him, Cast thy garment about thee, and follow me.

rr: 9 Yaashohora, yaamukuratira; kwonka tiyaamanya ekyakorwa maraika yaaba kiri eky'amazima, kureka yaateekateeka ngu n'okworekwa.
en: 9 And he went out, and followed him; and wist not that it was true which was done by the angel; but thought he saw a vision.

rr: 10 Ku baahingwire aha barinzi b'okubanza n'aba kabiri, baahika aha rwigi rw'ekyoma, orurikuza omu irembo. Orwigi orwo rwabaigukira rwonka; baashohora, baahingura omu muhanda gumwe; ahonaaho maraika yaamutsigaho.
en: 10 When they were past the first and the second ward, they came unto the iron gate that leadeth unto the city; which opened to them of his own accord: and they went out, and passed on through one street; and forthwith the angel departed from him.

rr: 11 Petero ku yaagarukirwe omutima omunda, yaagira ati: Mbwenu naamanyira kimwe ku Mukama yaatuma maraika we kunjuna omu mikono ya Heroode, n'okunkiza omuri byona ebi Abayudaaya baabaire baineho amatsiko.
en: 11 And when Peter was come to himself, he said, Now I know of a surety, that the Lord hath sent his angel, and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews.
12 And when he had considered the thing , he came to the house of Mary the mother of John, whose surname was Mark; where many were gathered together praying.

rr: 13 Ku yaakongootsire aha rwigi rw'eirembo, omwishiki orikwetwa Rooda yaija kwetaba.
en: 13 And as Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a damsel came to hearken, named Rhoda.

rr: 14 Ku yaamanyire eiraka rya petero, okushemererwa kwamuzibira kwiguraho orwigi, yaagaruka omu nju nairuka, yaabagira ati: Petero ayemereire aha irembo.
en: 14 And when she knew Peter's voice, she opened not the gate for gladness, but ran in, and told how Peter stood before the gate.
15 And they said unto her, Thou art mad. But she constantly affirmed that it was even so. Then said they, It is his angel.

rr: 16 Kwonka Petero yaagumizamu naakongoota; ku baigwireho, baamureeba, baatangaara munonga.
en: 16 But Peter continued knocking: and when they had opened the door , and saw him, they were astonished.

rr: 17 Yaabacureeza n'omukono, yaabateekyerereza oku Mukama yaamwiha omu kihome.
en: 17 But he, beckoning unto them with the hand to hold their peace, declared unto them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison.

rr: Kandi yaagira ati: Mubigambire Yakobo n'ab'eishe-emwe.
en: And he said, Go shew these things unto James, and to the brethren.

rr: Atyo yaarugayo, yaaza ahandi.
en: And he departed, and went into another place.

rr: 18 Ku bwaseesire, haabaho okujagarara kwingi omu baserukare ahabw'okushoberwa oku Petero abaire.
en: 18 Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers, what was become of Peter.

rr: 19 Heroode ku yaatumire kumweta, yaashanga abuzire, yaabuuza munonga abarinzi; atyo yaaragiira ku babaita.
en: 19 And when Herod had sought for him, and found him not, he examined the keepers, and commanded that they should be put to death.

rr: Bwanyima yaaruga Buyudaaya, yaaza Kaisarea, yaagumayo.
en: And he went down from Judæa to Cæsarea, and there abode.

rr: 20 Heroose akaba agwereirwe kubi munonga aba Tuuro na Sidoni. Nabo baija ah'ari n'omutima gumwe; ku baaherize kunywana na Bulasto omukuru w'abambari b'omugabe, baashaba obusingye, ahakuba ensi yaabo ekaba neeshaka omu nsi y'omugabe.
en: 20 And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon: but they came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus the king's chamberlain their friend, desired peace; because their country was nourished by the king's country .

rr: 21 Aha kiro eki yaataireho, Heroode yaajwara ebijwaro by'obugabe, yaashutama aha kitebe kye, yaabagambira ebigambo bye.
en: 21 And upon a set day Herod, arrayed in royal apparel, sat upon his throne, and made an oration unto them.
22 And the people gave a shout, saying, It is the voice of a god, and not of a man.
23 And immediately the angel of the Lord smote him, because he gave not God the glory: and he was eaten of worms, and gave up the ghost.
24 But the word of God grew and multiplied.
25 And Barnabas and Saul returned from Jerusalem, when they had fulfilled their ministry, and took with them John, whose surname was Mark.

rr: 1 Omu kanisa eyaabaire eri Antiokia hakaba harimu baanabi n'abeegyesa, Barunaba na Simeoni orikwetwa Niga na Lukio owa Kureene na Manaeni owaarezirwe hamwe n'Oweishaza Heroode, na Saulo.
en: 1 Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers; as Barnabas, and Simeon that was called Niger, and Lucius of Cyrene, and Manaen, which had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.

rr: 2 Ku baabaire nibaheereza Mukama nibeesiibyakwo, Omwoyo Orikwera yaagira ati: Muntooranire Barunaba na Saulo, bakore omurimo ogu mbeeteire.
en: 2 As they ministered to the Lord, and fasted, the Holy Ghost said, Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them.
3 And when they had fasted and prayed, and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.

rr: 4 Ku baatumirwe Omwoyo Orikwera, baashuuma Selukia; okwo baaragarirayo omu meeri, baayambuka Kupuro.
en: 4 So they, being sent forth by the Holy Ghost, departed unto Seleucia; and from thence they sailed to Cyprus.

rr: 5 Ku baabaire bari Salami, baabuurira ekigambo kya Ruhanga omuri sinagogi z'Abayudaaya; kandi bakaba baine Yohaana nk'omuhereza waabo.
en: 5 And when they were at Salamis, they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews: and they had also John to their minister.

rr: 6 Ku baaherize kuraba omuri ekyo kirwa kyona, baahika Paafo; okwo baashangayo omushaija omurogi, nabi w'ebishuba, Omuyudaaya, orikwetwa Bayesu
en: 6 And when they had gone through the isle unto Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name was Bar-jesus:

rr: 7 kandi akaba atwire n'Oweishaza Omutegyeki, orikwetwa Serugiro Paulo, omushaija w'omunyabwengye. Ogwo yaayeta Barunaba na Saulo, naayenda kuhurira ekigambo kya Ruhanga.
en: 7 which was with the deputy of the country, Sergius Paulus, a prudent man; who called for Barnabas and Saul, and desired to hear the word of God.

rr: 8 Kwonka Eluma omurogi (ahakuba nigo makuru g'eiziina rye) yaabahakanisa, ngu abone kuhabisa Oweishaza ataikiriza.
en: 8 But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn away the deputy from the faith.

rr: 9 Kwonka Saulo, niwe Paulo, aijwire Omwoyo Orikwera, yaamutaho amaisho
en: 9 Then Saul, (who also is called Paul,) filled with the Holy Ghost, set his eyes on him,

rr: 10 naagira ati: Iwe oijwire obugobya bwona n'obubi bwona, iwe mwana wa Sitaane 'we, omuzigu w'okuhikiirira kwona, torireka kukiikamya emihanda ya Mukama egororokire?
en: 10 and said, O full of all subtilty and all mischief, thou child of the devil, thou enemy of all righteousness, wilt thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?

rr: 11 Mbwenu hati omukono gwa Mukama nigukuhana, noija kuhuma, noomara omwanya otarikureeba mushana.
en: 11 And now, behold, the hand of the Lord is upon thee, and thou shalt be blind, not seeing the sun for a season.

rr: Ahonaaho oruho n'omwirima byamushweka; yaabandagira, naasherura ow'okumwebembera amukwaitse omukono.
en: And immediately there fell on him a mist and a darkness; and he went about seeking some to lead him by the hand.

rr: 12 Okuruga aho oweishaza, ku yaareebire ebyakorwa, yaikiriza, ahabw'okuba akatangaarira okwegyesa kwa Mukama.
en: 12 Then the deputy, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the doctrine of the Lord.

rr: 13 Bwanyima Paulo n'abagyenzi be baaruga Paafo omu meeri, baayambuka, baahika Peruga ey'omuri Pamfulia. Yohaana yaabatsigayo, yaagaruka Yerusaalemu
en: 13 Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos, they came to Perga in Pamphylia: and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem.

rr: 14 kwonka bo ku baahingwire nibaruga Peruga, baahika Antiokia ey'omuri Pisidia. Baataaha omuri sinagogi aha izooba rya Sabato, baashutama.
en: 14 But when they departed from Perga, they came to Antioch in Pisidia, and went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and sat down.
15 And after the reading of the law and the prophets the rulers of the synagogue sent unto them, saying, Ye men and brethren, if ye have any word of exhortation for the people, say on.

rr: 16 Paulo nikwo kwimuka, akaimutsya omukono, naagira ati
en: 16 Then Paul stood up, and beckoning with his hand said, Men of Israel, and ye that fear God, give audience.

rr: 17 Ruhanga ow'eihanga eri ry'Israeli akatoorana baatatenkuriitwe, yaakuza abantu abo obu baabaire batwire omu nsi ya Misri; bwanyima yaabaihisayo omukono gw'amaani.
en: 17 The God of this people of Israel chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt, and with an high arm brought he them out of it.
18 And about the time of forty years suffered he their manners in the wilderness.
19 And when he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Chanaan, he divided their land to them by lot.
20 And after that he gave unto them judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years, until Samuel the prophet.
21 And afterward they desired a king: and God gave unto them Saul the son of Cis, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, by the space of forty years.

22 And when he had removed him, he raised up unto them David to be their king; to whom also he gave testimony, and said, I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after mine own heart, which shall fulfil all my will.
23 Of this man's seed hath God according to his promise raised unto Israel a Saviour, Jesus:

rr: 24 Yesu ogwo atakaizire, Yohaana kabuurira Abaisraeli boona okubatizibwa okw'okweteisa.
en: 24 when John had first preached before his coming the baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.
25 And as John fulfilled his course, he said, Whom think ye that I am? I am not he . But, behold, there cometh one after me, whose shoes of his feet I am not worthy to loose.

rr: 26 B'eishe-emwe, abaana b'oruganda rwa Abrahamu, n'abari omuriimwe abarikutiina Ruhanga, ekigambo ky'okujunwa oku niitwe kyatumirweho.
en: 26 Men and brethren, children of the stock of Abraham, and whosoever among you feareth God, to you is the word of this salvation sent.
27 For they that dwell at Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they knew him not, nor yet the voices of the prophets which are read every sabbath day, they have fulfilled them in condemning him .

rr: 28 Kandi n'obu baraabe baabuzire orubanja rw'okumwitsa, bakashaba Pilaato ngu aitwe.
en: 28 And though they found no cause of death in him , yet desired they Pilate that he should be slain.

rr: 29 Ku baaherize kuhikiiriza byona ebyamuhandiikirweho, baamuhanura aha muti, baamuziika omu kituuro.
en: 29 And when they had fulfilled all that was written of him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a sepulchre.

rr: 30 Kwonka Ruhanga yaamuzoora omu bafu
en: 30 But God raised him from the dead:

rr: 31 yaamara ebiro bingi naareebwa abo abaarugire nawe Galilaaya nibaza Yerusaalemu; nibo baakareebi abarikumuhamya hati omu bantu.
en: 31 and he was seen many days of them which came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses unto the people.

rr: 32 Naitwe tubareeteire ebigambo birungi eby'endagaano, ei Ruhanga yaaraganiise baatatenkuriitwe
en: 32 And we declare unto you glad tidings, how that the promise which was made unto the fathers,
33 God hath fulfilled the same unto us their children, in that he hath raised up Jesus again; as it is also written in the second psalm, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee.
34 And as concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he said on this wise, I will give you the sure mercies of David.
35 Wherefore he saith also in another psalm , Thou shalt not suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.

rr: 36 Nimumanya Daudi ku yaaherize kuhikiiriza enaama ya Ruhanga omu biro bye, yaagwejegyera, yaaziikwa na baishenkuru, yaajunda
en: 36 For David, after he had served his own generation by the will of God, fell on sleep, and was laid unto his fathers, and saw corruption:

rr: 37 kwonka Ogwo ou Ruhanga yaazoire tarajunzire.
en: 37 but he, whom God raised again, saw no corruption.
38 Be it known unto you therefore, men and brethren, that through this man is preached unto you the forgiveness of sins:
39 and by him all that believe are justified from all things, from which ye could not be justified by the law of Moses.
40 Beware therefore, lest that come upon you, which is spoken of in the prophets;

rr: 41 Imwe abagaya, mureebe, mutangaare, muhweho; ahakuba ninkora omurimo omu biro byanyu, omurimo ogu mutariikiriza na kakye, n'obu omuntu yaakuba naagubashobororera.
en: 41 Behold, ye despisers, and wonder, and perish:

rr: 42 Ku baabaire nibashohora, abantu baayeshengyereza ngu ebigambo ebyo bagarukye babigambirwe ahari Sabato erikwija.
en: 42 And when the Jews were gone out of the synagogue, the Gentiles besought that these words might be preached to them the next sabbath.

rr: 43 Ku baaherize kushohora, Abayudaaya baingi n'abahindukiire omu diini yaabo baakuratira Paulo na Barunaba; bo baabeehanangiriza nibabagambira kugumizamu omu mbabazi za Ruhanga.
en: 43 Now when the congregation was broken up, many of the Jews and religious proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas: who, speaking to them, persuaded them to continue in the grace of God.

rr: 44 Ahari Sabato egyo ab'omu rurembo haihi boona baateerana kuhurira ekigambo kya Ruhanga.
en: 44 And the next sabbath day came almost the whole city together to hear the word of God.

rr: 45 Kwonka Abayudaaya ku baareebire emitwe y'abantu, baagira eihari ringi, baahakanisa ebigambo ebyagambirwe Paulo, baamujuma.
en: 45 But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with envy, and spake against those things which were spoken by Paul, contradicting and blaspheming.

46 Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold, and said, It was necessary that the word of God should first have been spoken to you: but seeing ye put it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, lo, we turn to the Gentiles.
47 For so hath the Lord commanded us, saying ,
48 And when the Gentiles heard this, they were glad, and glorified the word of the Lord: and as many as were ordained to eternal life believed.

rr: 49 Ekigambo kya Mukama kyabuga omu nsi egyo yoona.
en: 49 And the word of the Lord was published throughout all the region.

rr: 50 Kwonka Abayudaaya baayosya abakazi abanyadiini ab'ekitiinisa n'abashaija bakuru ab'omu rurembo, baahiiga Paulo na Barunaba, baababinga omu ishaza ryabo.
en: 50 But the Jews stirred up the devout and honourable women, and the chief men of the city, and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them out of their coasts.
51 But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came unto Iconium.

rr: 52 Abeegi baijura okushemererwa n'Omwoyo Orikwera.
en: 52 And the disciples were filled with joy, and with the Holy Ghost.

rr: 1 Ku baahikire Ikonio, baataaha omuri sinagogi y'Abayudaaya, baagamba ebigambo birungi ebyareeteire omutwe gw'Abayudaaya n'Abagriika baingi okwikiriza.
en: 1 And it came to pass in Iconium, that they went both together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spake, that a great multitude both of the Jews and also of the Greeks believed.
2 But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles, and made their minds evil affected against the brethren.
3 Long time therefore abode they speaking boldly in the Lord, which gave testimony unto the word of his grace, and granted signs and wonders to be done by their hands.

rr: 4 Kwonka ab'omu rurembo baayebaganisamu; abamwe baaza aha rubaju rw'Abayudaaya, abandi aha rw'entumwa.
en: 4 But the multitude of the city was divided: and part held with the Jews, and part with the apostles.
5 And when there was an assault made both of the Gentiles, and also of the Jews with their rulers, to use them despitefully, and to stone them,
6 they were ware of it , and fled unto Lystra and Derbe, cities of Lycaonia, and unto the region that lieth round about:

rr: 7 okwo baaruurirayo engiri.
en: 7 and there they preached the gospel.

rr: 8 Omuri Lusitura hakaba harimu omushaija, owaabaire atarikubaasa kugyendesa maguru, owaazairwe ari ekirema, otakagyendahoga.
en: 8 And there sat a certain man at Lystra, impotent in his feet, being a cripple from his mother's womb, who never had walked:
9 the same heard Paul speak: who stedfastly beholding him, and perceiving that he had faith to be healed,

rr: 10 yaagamba n'eiraka rihango, ati: Imuka, oyemerere n'ebigyere byawe. Yaabandatuka, yaagyenda.
en: 10 said with a loud voice, Stand upright on thy feet. And he leaped and walked.

rr: 11 Ab'emitwe ku baareebire eki Paulo yaakora, baayombera ahaiguru, nibagamba omu rurimi rwa Lukaonia, bati: Baaruhanga baatushuumamu omu nshusha y'abantu.
en: 11 And when the people saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voices, saying in the speech of Lycaonia, The gods are come down to us in the likeness of men.

rr: 12 Barunaba baamweta Zeu, na Paulo baamweta Herume, ahabw'okuba niwe yaabaire ari mukuru omu kugamba.
en: 12 And they called Barnabas, Jupiter; and Paul, Mercurius, because he was the chief speaker.

rr: 13 Omunyamurwa wa hekalu ya Zeu, eyaabaire eri omu maisho g'orurembo, yaareeta ente n'ebishaba by'ebirabyo aha irembo, yaija n'abantu kutamba ekitambo.
en: 13 Then the priest of Jupiter, which was before their city, brought oxen and garlands unto the gates, and would have done sacrifice with the people.

rr: 14 Kwonka entumwa, Barunaba na Paulo, ku baahuriire ekyo, baataagura ebijwaro byabo, baayeshuka omu bantu, nibagamba n'eiraka rihango bati
en: 14 Which when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of , they rent their clothes, and ran in among the people, crying out,

15 and saying, Sirs, why do ye these things? We also are men of like passions with you, and preach unto you that ye should turn from these vanities unto the living God, which made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all things that are therein:
16 who in times past suffered all nations to walk in their own ways.

rr: 17 Kwonka tararekyeire aho kubura eky'okumuhamya, ahakuba akaguma naabakora gye, naabagwisiza enjura okuruga omu iguru, naabeereza emyaka omu bunaku bwayo, naabahaazya eby'okurya, naijuza emitima yaanyu okushemererwa.
en: 17 Nevertheless he left not himself without witness, in that he did good, and gave us rain from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.

rr: 18 Batyo baazibira abantu kubatambira ebitambo n'ebigambo ebyo, kwonka kyabarusya munonga.
en: 18 And with these sayings scarce restrained they the people, that they had not done sacrifice unto them.
19 And there came thither certain Jews from Antioch and Iconium, who persuaded the people, and, having stoned Paul, drew him out of the city, supposing he had been dead.

rr: 20 Kwonka abeegi ku baayemereire bamwehinguririize, yaimuka, yaagaruka omu rurembo; ku bwaseesire, yaashohora na Barunaba, baaza Derube.
en: 20 Howbeit, as the disciples stood round about him, he rose up, and came into the city: and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe.

rr: 21 Ku baaherize kubuurira engiri ah'omuri tauni egyo n'okuhindura abeegi baingi, baagaruka Lusitura na Ikonio na Antiokia
en: 21 And when they had preached the gospel to that city, and had taught many, they returned again to Lystra, and to Iconium, and Antioch,
22 confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.
23 And when they had ordained them elders in every church, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord, on whom they believed.

rr: 24 Bwanyima baaraba omuri Pisidia, baahika Pamufulia.
en: 24 And after they had passed throughout Pisidia, they came to Pamphylia.

rr: 25 Ku baaherize kugamba ekigambo omuri Peruga, baashuuma, baataaha Atalia.
en: 25 And when they had preached the word in Perga, they went down into Attalia:

rr: 26 Omu kurugayo baaza omu meeri, baahika Antiokia, ahu baatsigiriirwe embabazi za Ruhanga ahabw'omurimo, ogu baaheza kuhikiiriza.
en: 26 and thence sailed to Antioch, from whence they had been recommended to the grace of God for the work which they fulfilled.
27 And when they were come, and had gathered the church together, they rehearsed all that God had done with them, and how he had opened the door of faith unto the Gentiles.

rr: 28 Baagumayo n'abeegi ebiro bitari bikye.
en: 28 And there they abode long time with the disciples.
1 And certain men which came down from Judæa taught the brethren, and said , Except ye be circumcised after the manner of Moses, ye cannot be saved.

2 When therefore Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them, they determined that Paul and Barnabas, and certain other of them, should go up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and elders about this question.

rr: 3 N'ahabw'ekyo abo, ku baaherize kushendekyerezibwa ab'ekanisa, baaraba omuri Foiniike na Samaria, nibagambira ab'eishe-emwe eby'okuhinduka kw'Abanyamahanga, byareetera boona okushemererwa kwingi.
en: 3 And being brought on their way by the church, they passed through Phenice and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles: and they caused great joy unto all the brethren.

rr: 4 Ku baahikire Yerusaalemu, baayakiirwa ab'ekanisa n'entumwa n'abakuru, baabateekyerereza byona ebi Ruhanga yaakozire hamwe nabo.
en: 4 And when they were come to Jerusalem, they were received of the church, and of the apostles and elders, and they declared all things that God had done with them.

rr: 5 Kwonka haayemerera bamwe ab'omu kigombe ky'Abafarisaayo abaikiriize, baagira bati: Ekirikwetengwa n'okubashara, kandi n'okubaragiira okuhitsya Ebiragiro bya Musa.
en: 5 But there rose up certain of the sect of the Pharisees which believed, saying, That it was needful to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.

rr: 6 Entumwa n'abakuru baateerana hamwe kuteekateeka aha kigambo ekyo.
en: 6 And the apostles and elders came together for to consider of this matter.

7 And when there had been much disputing, Peter rose up, and said unto them, Men and brethren, ye know how that a good while ago God made choice among us, that the Gentiles by my mouth should hear the word of the gospel, and believe.

rr: 8 Kandi Ruhanga orikumanya emitima yaabahamya, naabaha Omwoyo Orikwera nk'oku yaamutuhaire
en: 8 And God, which knoweth the hearts, bare them witness, giving them the Holy Ghost, even as he did unto us;

rr: 9 tiyaatutaansia nabo, yaashemeze emitima yaabo ahabw'okwikiriza.
en: 9 and put no difference between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith.
10 Now therefore why tempt ye God, to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples, which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?
11 But we believe that through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ we shall be saved, even as they.

rr: 12 Abantu boona baamucureera, baahurira Barunaba na Paulo nibabateekyerereza obumanyiso n'eby'okutangaaza ebi Ruhanga yaabakoreise omu Banyamahanga.
en: 12 Then all the multitude kept silence, and gave audience to Barnabas and Paul, declaring what miracles and wonders God had wrought among the Gentiles by them.
13 And after they had held their peace, James answered, saying, Men and brethren, hearken unto me:

rr: 14 Simooni yaaheza kubateekyerereza oku Ruhanga yaatandikire kutaayaayira Abanyamahanga okutoorana abantu omuribo kuba eihanga eririkwetererwa eiziina rye.
en: 14 Simeon hath declared how God at the first did visit the Gentiles, to take out of them a people for his name.

rr: 15 Kandi ebigambo bya baanabi nibiikirizana nabyo, nk'oku kyahandiikirwe ngu
en: 15 And to this agree the words of the prophets; as it is written,

rr: 16 Bwanyima y'ebyo ndyagaruka
en: 16 After this I will return,

rr: 17 Ngu abantu abaahonokireho basherure Mukama
en: 17 That the residue of men might seek after the Lord,

rr: 18 Nikwo Mukama arikugira, okora ebyo byona
en: 18 Known unto God are all his works from the beginning of the world.

rr: 19 N'ahabw'ekyo nindagiira nti: Turekye kurusya abarikuruga omu Banyamahanga bakahindukira Ruhanga
en: 19 Wherefore my sentence is, that we trouble not them, which from among the Gentiles are turned to God:
20 but that we write unto them, that they abstain from pollutions of idols, and from fornication, and from things strangled, and from blood.

rr: 21 Ahakuba okuruga ira Musa aine omu ndembo zoona abarikumugambaho, kandi buri Sabato ebitabo bye bishomerwa omuri sinagogi.
en: 21 For Moses of old time hath in every city them that preach him, being read in the synagogues every sabbath day.

rr: 22 Bwanyima entumwa n'abakuru hamwe n'ekanisa yoona baasiima kutoorana omuribo abashaija ab'okutuma na Paulo na Barunaba omuri Antiokia. Baatuma Yuda orikwetwa Barusaba na Siila, abantu bakuru omu b'eishe-emwe
en: 22 Then pleased it the apostles and elders, with the whole church, to send chosen men of their own company to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas; namely , Judas surnamed Barsabas, and Silas, chief men among the brethren:

rr: 23 baahandiika ebaruha, baagibaha, ehandiikirwe eti: Itwe entumwa n'ab'eishe-emwe abakuru nitubahandiikira imwe ab'eishe-emwe ab'omu Banyamahanga abari Antiokia na Siria na Kilikia, nitubaramutysa.
en: 23 and they wrote letters by them after this manner; The apostles and elders and brethren send greeting unto the brethren which are of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia:

rr: 24 Tukahurirangu bamwe abaarugire omuriitwe bakabagambira ebigambo by'okubeemereza emitima n'okubabanganisisa, haza tutarabaragiire.
en: 24 forasmuch as we have heard, that certain which went out from us have troubled you with words, subverting your souls, saying, Ye must be circumcised, and keep the law: to whom we gave no such commandment:

rr: 25 N'ahabw'ekyo ku twateeraine, twasiimira hamwe kutoorana abashaija n'okubabatumaho hamwe na Barunaba na Paulo, abu turikukunda
en: 25 it seemed good unto us, being assembled with one accord, to send chosen men unto you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,

rr: 26 abashaija abaayogire amagara gaabo ahabw'eiziina rya Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo.
en: 26 men that have hazarded their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

rr: 27 Mbwenu abu twatuma ni Yuda na Siila, nibo baraabashobororere ebigambo ebyo n'akanwa.
en: 27 We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who shall also tell you the same things by mouth.
28 For it seemed good to the Holy Ghost, and to us, to lay upon you no greater burden than these necessary things;

rr: 29 okureka kurya ebihongyeirwe ebishushani, n'eshagama, n'ebinigirwe, n'obushambani; ku muraayerinde ebyo, muryaguma muri gye.
en: 29 that ye abstain from meats offered to idols, and from blood, and from things strangled, and from fornication: from which if ye keep yourselves, ye shall do well.

rr: Mugumeho.
en: Fare ye well.

rr: 30 Ku baaherize kuragwa, baashuuma, baaza Antiokia. Ku baahikireyo, baateerana ab'omutwe boona, baabaha ebaruha.
en: 30 So when they were dismissed, they came to Antioch: and when they had gathered the multitude together, they delivered the epistle:

rr: 31 Ku baagishomire, baashemererwa ahabw'okuhuumurizibwa okwo.
en: 31 which when they had read, they rejoiced for the consolation.

rr: 32 Kandi Yuda na Siila, ahabw'okuba nabo bakaba bari baanabi, baayehanangiriza ab'eishe-emwe n'ebigambo bingi, baabagumya.
en: 32 And Judas and Silas, being prophets also themselves, exhorted the brethren with many words, and confirmed them .

rr: 33 Ku baamazireyo ebiro ebitari bikye, baaragwa n'obusingye ab'eishe-emwe kugaruka ahari abo abaabatumire.
en: 33 And after they had tarried there a space, they were let go in peace from the brethren unto the apostles.

rr: 34 Kwonka Siila we yaasiima kutsigarayo.
en: 34 Notwithstanding it pleased Silas to abide there still.

rr: 35 Kandi Paulo na Barunaba nabo baajuma Antiokia, nibeegyesa, nibabuurira ekigambo kya Ruhanga hamwe n'abandi baingi.
en: 35 Paul also and Barnabas continued in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.
36 And some days after Paul said unto Barnabas, Let us go again and visit our brethren in every city where we have preached the word of the Lord, and see how they do.

rr: 37 Barunaba akaba naakunda ngu bagyende na Yohaana orikwetwa Mako
en: 37 And Barnabas determined to take with them John, whose surname was Mark.
38 But Paul thought not good to take him with them, who departed from them from Pamphylia, and went not with them to the work.

rr: 39 Haabaho empaka nyingi, ahabw'ekyo baataana; Barunaba yaatwara Mako, baaza omu meeri, baayambuka Kupuro.
en: 39 And the contention was so sharp between them, that they departed asunder one from the other: and so Barnabas took Mark, and sailed unto Cyprus;

rr: 40 Paulo we yaatoorana Siila; ab'eishe-emwe ku baaherize kumutsigira embabazi za Mukama, yaagyenda.
en: 40 and Paul chose Silas, and departed, being recommended by the brethren unto the grace of God.

rr: 41 Yaaraba omuri Siria na Kilikia, naagumya amakanisa.
en: 41 And he went through Syria and Cilicia, confirming the churches.
1 Then came he to Derbe and Lystra: and, behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timotheus, the son of a certain woman, which was a Jewess, and believed; but his father was a Greek:

rr: 2 Timoseo ogwo akaba asiimwa ab'eishe-emwe aba Lusitura na Ikonio.
en: 2 which was well reported of by the brethren that were at Lystra and Iconium.

rr: 3 Pauli yaayenda ngu bagyendane; yaamutwara, yaamushara ahabw'Abayudaaya abaabaire bari omu myanya egyo; ahakuba boona bakaba nibamanya ngu ishe n'Omugriika.
en: 3 Him would Paul have to go forth with him; and took and circumcised him because of the Jews which were in those quarters: for they knew all that his father was a Greek.

rr: 4 Ku baabaire nibaraba omuri tauni ezo, baabaha ebiragiro ebyatairweho entumwa n'abakuru abaabaire bateeraniire Yerusaalemu, ngu babikwate.
en: 4 And as they went through the cities, they delivered them the decrees for to keep, that were ordained of the apostles and elders which were at Jerusalem.

rr: 5 N'ahabw'ekyo amakanisa gaagumibwa omu kwikiriza, abantu baayeyongyera kukanya obutoosha.
en: 5 And so were the churches established in the faith, and increased in number daily.

rr: 6 Ku baazibiirwe Omwoyo Orikwera kugamba ekigambo omuri Asia, baaraba omu byanga bya Furugia na Galatia
en: 6 Now when they had gone throughout Phrygia and the region of Galatia, and were forbidden of the Holy Ghost to preach the word in Asia,

rr: 7 ku baahikire haihi na Musia, baayenda ngu baze Bisunia; kwonka Omwoyo wa Yesu tiyaabaikiriza.
en: 7 after they were come to Mysia, they assayed to go into Bithynia: but the Spirit suffered them not.

rr: 8 Batyo baaraba Musia, baashuuma baahika Troa.
en: 8 And they passing by Mysia came down to Troas.

rr: 9 Nyekiro Paulo yaayorekwa, yaareeba omushaija owa Makedonia, ayemereire, naamweshengyereza ati: Yambuka, oije Makedonia, otuhwere.
en: 9 And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us.

rr: 10 Ku yaareebire okworekwa okwo, ahonaaho twayenda kuza Makedonia, twahamiza kimwe ngu Ruhanga atwetsire kubabuurira engiri.
en: 10 And after he had seen the vision, immediately we endeavoured to go into Macedonia, assuredly gathering that the Lord had called us for to preach the gospel unto them.

rr: 11 N'ahabw'ekyo twaruga Troa omu meeri, twagyema ogurikwambuka Samoserakia; aha izooba erindi twahika Neapooli
en: 11 Therefore loosing from Troas, we came with a straight course to Samothracia, and the next day to Neapolis;

rr: 12 ku twarugireyo, twahika Filipi, orurembo orukuru orwa Makedonia, orwayombekirwe Abarooma abaafurukiireyo; twamara ebiro omu rurembo orwo.
en: 12 and from thence to Philippi, which is the chief city of that part of Macedonia, and a colony: and we were in that city abiding certain days.

rr: 13 Aha izooba rya Sabato twashohora twaraba omu irembo ryarwo, twaza aha rubaju rw'omugyera, ahu twateekateekire ngu hariho omwanya gw'okushabiramu; twahsutama ahansi, twagamba n'abakazi abaateeraniireyo.
en: 13 And on the sabbath we went out of the city by a river side, where prayer was wont to be made; and we sat down, and spake unto the women which resorted thither .

14 And a certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, which worshipped God, heard us : whose heart the Lord opened, that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul.

rr: 15 Ku yaaherize kubatizibwa n'ab'omu ka ye, yaatweshengyereza, naagira ati: Ku muraabe mwansiima ngu ndi omwesigwa ahari Mukama, mwije omu nju yangye, mucumbikyemu.
en: 15 And when she was baptized, and her household, she besought us , saying, If ye have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house, and abide there .

rr: Yaatugyemesereza.
en: And she constrained us.

rr: 16 Ku twabaire nituza omuri ogwo mwanya gw'okushabiramu, twabuganwa omuzaana oriho daimoni orikuragura, owaabaire atungisa bakama be munonga n'emikimbo ei yaabaire akimbirwa.
en: 16 And it came to pass, as we went to prayer, a certain damsel possessed with a spirit of divination met us, which brought her masters much gain by soothsaying:
17 The same followed Paul and us, and cried, saying, These men are the servants of the most high God, which shew unto us the way of salvation.
18 And this did she many days. But Paul, being grieved, turned and said to the spirit, I command thee in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her. And he came out the same hour.

rr: 19 Bakama be ku baareebire baahwa amatsiko g'okumutungaho ebintu, baakwata Paulo na Siila, baabakurura, baabatwara omu katare omu maisho g'abategyeki
en: 19 And when her masters saw that the hope of their gains was gone, they caught Paul and Silas, and drew them into the marketplace unto the rulers,

rr: 20 ku baabahikize abaramuzi, baagiba bati: Abashaija aba n'Abayudaaya, nibarabanisamu orurembo rwaitu.
en: 20 and brought them to the magistrates, saying, These men, being Jews, do exceedingly trouble our city,

rr: 21 Nibeegyesa emicwe ei ebiragiro bituzibira kwikiriza n'obu kwakuba okukora, ahakuba turi Abarooma.
en: 21 and teach customs, which are not lawful for us to receive, neither to observe, being Romans.
22 And the multitude rose up together against them: and the magistrates rent off their clothes, and commanded to beat them .

rr: 23 Ku baaherize kubateera enkoni nyingi, baabaroha omu kihome, baaragiira omurinzi w'embohe kubarinda munonga.
en: 23 And when they had laid many stripes upon them, they cast them into prison, charging the jailor to keep them safely:

rr: 24 Ku yaaragiirwe atyo, yaabatsindika omu kishengye kya hagati eky'omu kihome, yaaboha amaguru gaabo omu # 16:24 Enkomo nizo mpimbi ezi babohesa amaguru g'embohe. nkomo.
en: 24 who, having received such a charge, thrust them into the inner prison, and made their feet fast in the stocks.

rr: 25 Nyekiro nk'omu itumbi Paulo na Siila bakaba nibashaba, nibeeshongorera Ruhanga, n'embohe zibategire amatu
en: 25 And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them.
