rr: 26 omu mwanya ogwo haabaho omutistsa mwingi, omusingu gw'ekihome gwatengyetsibwa; ahonaaho enyigi zoona zaiguka, n'emihama ya buri muntu yaakomoroka.
en: 26 And suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken: and immediately all the doors were opened, and every one's bands were loosed.

rr: 27 Omurinzi w'ekihome ku yaasisiimukire, yaareeba enyigi ziigukire, yaasyorayo rurara ye, yaayenda kwerezya, ahabw'okuba akateekateeka ngu embohe zicwire.
en: 27 And the keeper of the prison awaking out of his sleep, and seeing the prison doors open, he drew out his sword, and would have killed himself, supposing that the prisoners had been fled.

rr: 28 Kwonka Paulo yaagamba n'eiraka rihango, naagira ati: Oteekora kubi, ahakuba twena turi aha.
en: 28 But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, Do thyself no harm: for we are all here.

rr: 29 Yaatuma amatabaaza, yaayetuura omu nju, yaajuumara omu maisho ga Paulo na Siila, naatetema aine obwoba
en: 29 Then he called for a light, and sprang in, and came trembling, and fell down before Paul and Silas,
30 and brought them out, and said, Sirs, what must I do to be saved?

rr: 31 Baagarukamu bati: Ikiriza Mukama waitu Yesu, noija kujunwa, iwe n'eka yaawe.
en: 31 And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.

rr: 32 Kandi baamugambira ekigambo kya Mukama hamwe na boona abaabaire bari omu ka ye.
en: 32 And they spake unto him the word of the Lord, and to all that were in his house.

rr: 33 Yaabatwara omu shaaha egyo nyekiro, yaabanaabisa emihiriirizi; ahonaaho yaabatizibwa n'abomu ka ye boona.
en: 33 And he took them the same hour of the night, and washed their stripes; and was baptized, he and all his, straightway.

rr: 34 Bwanyima yaabatwara omu nju ye, yaabareetera eby'okurya, ashemereirwe munonga n'ab'omu nju ye ahabw'okwikiriza Ruhanga.
en: 34 And when he had brought them into his house, he set meat before them, and rejoiced, believing in God with all his house.

rr: 35 Ku bwaseesire, abaramuzi baatuma abaserukare, nibagira bati: Murekure abashaija abo.
en: 35 And when it was day, the magistrates sent the serjeants, saying, Let those men go.

rr: 36 Omurinzi w'embohe yaagambira Paulo ebigambo ebyo, ati: Abaramuzi baatuma ngu tubarekure; mbwenu hati mushohore, mugyende n'obusingye.
en: 36 And the keeper of the prison told this saying to Paul, The magistrates have sent to let you go: now therefore depart, and go in peace.

37 But Paul said unto them, They have beaten us openly uncondemned, being Romans, and have cast us into prison; and now do they thrust us out privily? nay verily; but let them come themselves and fetch us out.

rr: 38 Abo baserukare baagambira abaramuzi ebigambo ebyo; ku baahuriire ngu n'Abarooma, baatiina.
en: 38 And the serjeants told these words unto the magistrates: and they feared, when they heard that they were Romans.
39 And they came and besought them, and brought them out, and desired them to depart out of the city.

rr: 40 Batyo baaruga omu kihome, baataaha omu nju ya Ludia; ku baareebaine n'ab'eishe-emwe, baabagumya, baarugayo.
en: 40 And they went out of the prison, and entered into the house of Lydia: and when they had seen the brethren, they comforted them, and departed.

rr: 1 Ku baarabire omuri Amfipooli na Apolonia, baahika Tesalonika; aho hakaba hariho sinagogi y'Abayudaaya.
en: 1 Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where was a synagogue of the Jews:

rr: 2 Paulo, nk'omucwe gwe oku gwabaire guri, yaabataahamu, yaabahakanisa omu Byahandiikirwe okumara amazooba ashatu ga Sabato
en: 2 and Paul, as his manner was, went in unto them, and three sabbath days reasoned with them out of the scriptures,
3 opening and alleging, that Christ must needs have suffered, and risen again from the dead; and that this Jesus, whom I preach unto you, is Christ.

rr: 4 Abamwe aharibo baikiriza, baakwatanisa na Paulo na Siila; kandi haikiriza omutwe muhango gw'Abagriika abanyadiini, n'abakazi bw'ekitiinisa abatari bakye.
en: 4 And some of them believed, and consorted with Paul and Silas; and of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and of the chief women not a few.

rr: 5 Kwonka Abayudaaya bo baakwatwa eihari, baatwara abashaija babi b'ebizengyerezi, baateerana omutwe muhango, baateerera orwari omu rurembo; baakuba enju ya Yasooni, nibenda kushohoza Paulo na Siila, ngu babareete omu maisho g'abantu.
en: 5 But the Jews which believed not, moved with envy, took unto them certain lewd fellows of the baser sort, and gathered a company, and set all the city on an uproar, and assaulted the house of Jason, and sought to bring them out to the people.
6 And when they found them not, they drew Jason and certain brethren unto the rulers of the city, crying, These that have turned the world upside down are come hither also;
7 whom Jason hath received: and these all do contrary to the decrees of Cæsar, saying that there is another king, one Jesus.

rr: 8 Omutwe gw'abantu n'abategyeki b'orurembo, ku baabihuriire, baayemereza emitima.
en: 8 And they troubled the people and the rulers of the city, when they heard these things.

rr: 9 Ku baaherize kwiha ahari Yasooni n'abandi omusingo, baabarekura.
en: 9 And when they had taken security of Jason, and of the other, they let them go.

rr: 10 Ahonaaho ab'eishe-emwe baayohereza Paulo na Siila nyekiro ngu bataahe Beroya. Ku baahikireyo, baaza omuri sinagogi y'Abayudaaya.
en: 10 And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea: who coming thither went into the synagogue of the Jews.
11 These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so.

rr: 12 N'ahabw'ekyo baingi aharibo baikiriza, n'Abagriikakazi ab'ekitiinisa n'abashaija abatari bakye.
en: 12 Therefore many of them believed; also of honourable women which were Greeks, and of men, not a few.

rr: 13 Kwonka Abayudaaya ba Tesalonika ku baamanyire ngu Paulo agambire ekigambo kya Ruhanga n'omuri Beroya, nayo baazayo, baayosya abantu, baabajagaraza emitima.
en: 13 But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was preached of Paul at Berea, they came thither also, and stirred up the people.

rr: 14 Ahonaaho ab'eishe-emwe baayohereza Paulo kugyenda ngu ahikye aha nyanja; Siila na Timoseo baatsigarayo.
en: 14 And then immediately the brethren sent away Paul to go as it were to the sea: but Silas and Timotheus abode there still.

rr: 15 Abaashendekyereize Paulo baamuhitsya Aseene; ku yaaherize kubaragiira kugambira Siila na Timoseo ngu beehuute bamushangyeyo, baagyenda.
en: 15 And they that conducted Paul brought him unto Athens: and receiving a commandment unto Silas and Timotheus for to come to him with all speed, they departed.

rr: 16 Paulo ku yaabaire akibategyerereize Aseene, omutima gwe gwashaasha munonga ahabw'okureeba orurembo rwijwire ebishushani ebirikuramibwa.
en: 16 Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was stirred in him, when he saw the city wholly given to idolatry.

rr: 17 Atyo yaahakanisa Abayudaaya n'abanyadiini omuri sinagogi, kandi n'omu katare yaahakana n'abu yaabaire ashangamu obutoosha.
en: 17 Therefore disputed he in the synagogue with the Jews, and with the devout persons, and in the market daily with them that met with him.

rr: 18 Kandi bamwe aha banyabwengye Abaepikureyo n'Abastoyiko baamubugana. Abamwe baagira bati: Mbwenu reero naayenda kugamba ki, egi ngambi y'amaingi? Abandi bati: Naashusha nk'orikugamba ebya baaruhanga abasya; ahakuba akaba naagamba ebya Yesu n'eby'okuzooka.
en: 18 Then certain philosophers of the Epicureans, and of the Stoicks, encountered him. And some said, What will this babbler say? other some, He seemeth to be a setter forth of strange gods: because he preached unto them Jesus, and the resurrection.

rr: 19 Baamukwata, baamutwara Areopaago, nibagira bati: Nitwenda kumanya eby'okwegyesa oku okusya, oku orikugamba, oku kuri.
en: 19 And they took him, and brought him unto Areopagus, saying, May we know what this new doctrine, whereof thou speakest, is ?

rr: 20 Ahakuba oreetsire ebigambo bisya omu matu gaitu; nikyo turikwendera kumanya amakuru gaabyo.
en: 20 For thou bringest certain strange things to our ears: we would know therefore what these things mean.

rr: 21 Kandi aba Aseene boona n'abagyenyi abaabaire bariyo bakaba batakiine kindi eki barikukora kureka okugamba, n'okuhurira ebigambo bisya ebihangire.
en: 21 (For all the Athenians and strangers which were there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell, or to hear some new thing.)

rr: 22 Paulo nikwo kwemerera ahagati ya Areopaago, akagira ati: Imwe abashaija ba Aseene, ndeebire omuri byona ku murengyesereize okuba abanyadiini.
en: 22 Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars' hill, and said,

rr: 23 Ahakuba ku mbaire nimpungura, naareeba ebi murikuramya, naashanga eitambiro erihandiikirweho ngu, N'ERYA RUHANGA OTARIKUMANYWA.
en: 23 For as I passed by, and beheld your devotions, I found an altar with this inscription, TO THE UNKNOWN GOD.

rr: Haza mbwenu eki muramya nk'ekitarikumanya, nikyo ndikwenda kubagambira.
en: Whom therefore ye ignorantly worship, him declare I unto you.
24 God that made the world and all things therein, seeing that he is Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in temples made with hands;
25 neither is worshipped with men's hands, as though he needed any thing, seeing he giveth to all life, and breath, and all things;
26 and hath made of one blood all nations of men for to dwell on all the face of the earth, and hath determined the times before appointed, and the bounds of their habitation;
27 that they should seek the Lord, if haply they might feel after him, and find him, though he be not far from every one of us:

rr: 28 ahakuba omuriwe tuba abahuriire, tugyenda, kandi tugumaho; nk'abamwe aha bahimbi baanyu b'ebyoshongoro oku baagambire nibagira bati: Ahakuba naitwe turi oruzaaro rwe.
en: 28 for in him we live, and move, and have our being; as certain also of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.
29 Forasmuch then as we are the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Godhead is like unto gold, or silver, or stone, graven by art and man's device.
30 And the times of this ignorance God winked at; but now commandeth all men every where to repent:

31 because he hath appointed a day, in the which he will judge the world in righteousness by that man whom he hath ordained; whereof he hath given assurance unto all men , in that he hath raised him from the dead.

rr: 32 Ku baahuriire aha by'okuzooka omu bafu, abamwe baabishekyerera, abandi baagira bati: Turyakuhurira obundi, obutugambire.
en: 32 And when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked: and others said, We will hear thee again of this matter .

rr: 33 Atyo Paulo yaabarugaho.
en: 33 So Paul departed from among them.

rr: 34 Kwonka abashaija bamwe baaguma nawe, baikiriza; omuribo hakaba harimu Dionisio ow'omu ba Areopaago, n'omukazi orikweta Damari, hamwe n'abandi.
en: 34 Howbeit certain men clave unto him, and believed: among the which was Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.

rr: 1 Bwanyima y'ebyo yaaruga Aseene yaaza Korinso.
en: 1 After these things Paul departed from Athens, and came to Corinth;
2 and found a certain Jew named Aquila, born in Pontus, lately come from Italy, with his wife Priscilla; (because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome:) and came unto them.
3 And because he was of the same craft, he abode with them, and wrought: for by their occupation they were tentmakers.

rr: 4 Buri Sabato yaaguma naahakanisa Abayudaaya n'Abagriika omuri sinagogi, naabaikiririsa.
en: 4 And he reasoned in the synagogue every sabbath, and persuaded the Jews and the Greeks.

rr: 5 Siila na Timoseo ku baarugire Makedonisa, Paulo yaagyemwa ekigambo kya Ruhanga, naahamiza Abayudaaya ku Yesu ari Kristo.
en: 5 And when Silas and Timotheus were come from Macedonia, Paul was pressed in the spirit, and testified to the Jews that Jesus was Christ.
6 And when they opposed themselves, and blasphemed, he shook his raiment, and said unto them, Your blood be upon your own heads; I am clean: from henceforth I will go unto the Gentiles.

rr: 7 Yaarugayo, yaataaha omu nju y'omuntu orikwetwa Tito Yusto, owaabaire aramya Ruhanga, enju ye ekaba eri haihi na sinagogi.
en: 7 And he departed thence, and entered into a certain man's house, named Justus, one that worshipped God, whose house joined hard to the synagogue.
8 And Crispus, the chief ruler of the synagogue, believed on the Lord with all his house; and many of the Corinthians hearing believed, and were baptized.

rr: 9 Mukama waitu yaagambira Paulo nyekiro omu kworekwa ati: Otatiina, ogume ogambe, orekye kuhunama
en: 9 Then spake the Lord to Paul in the night by a vision, Be not afraid, but speak, and hold not thy peace:
10 for I am with thee, and no man shall set on thee to hurt thee: for I have much people in this city.

rr: 11 Bwanyima yaamarayo omwaka n'ameezi mukaaga, naabeegyesamu ekigambo kya Ruhanga.
en: 11 And he continued there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.

rr: 12 Galio ku yaabaire ari omutegyeki wa Akaya, Abayudaaya baimukirira Paulo n'omutima gumwe, baamutwara omu maisho g'ekitebe ky'eiramuriro
en: 12 And when Gallio was the deputy of Achaia, the Jews made insurrection with one accord against Paul, and brought him to the judgment seat,

rr: 13 nibagira bati: Omushaija ogu naikiririsa abantu kuramya Ruhanga omu buryo oburikuhakanisa Ebiragiro.
en: 13 saying, This fellow persuadeth men to worship God contrary to the law.
14 And when Paul was now about to open his mouth, Gallio said unto the Jews, If it were a matter of wrong or wicked lewdness, O ye Jews, reason would that I should bear with you:
15 but if it be a question of words and names, and of your law, look ye to it ; for I will be no judge of such matters .

rr: 16 Yaababinga omu maisho g'ekitebe ky'eiramuriro.
en: 16 And he drave them from the judgment seat.
17 Then all the Greeks took Sosthenes, the chief ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. And Gallio cared for none of those things.

18 And Paul after this tarried there yet a good while, and then took his leave of the brethren, and sailed thence into Syria, and with him Priscilla and Aquila; having shorn his head in Cenchrea: for he had a vow.

rr: 19 Ku baahikire Efeso, yaabatsigayo; yaataaha omuri sinagogi wenka, yaahakansia Abayudaaya.
en: 19 And he came to Ephesus, and left them there: but he himself entered into the synagogue, and reasoned with the Jews.

rr: 20 Ku baamushabire kuguma nabo ebiro ebindi, tiyaabaikiriza
en: 20 When they desired him to tarry longer time with them, he consented not;
21 but bade them farewell, saying, I must by all means keep this feast that cometh in Jerusalem: but I will return again unto you, if God will. And he sailed from Ephesus.

rr: 22 Ku yaayambukire Kaisarea, yainamuka, yaaramutsya ekanisa; bwanyima yaaza Antiokia.
en: 22 And when he had landed at Cæsarea, and gone up, and saluted the church, he went down to Antioch.

rr: 23 Ku yaamazireyo ebiro, yaarugayo, yaaraba omu mashaza ga Galatia na Furugia, naareeba emyanya yaamwo nk'oku yaabaire ekurataine, naagumya abeegi boona.
en: 23 And after he had spent some time there , he departed, and went over all the country of Galatia and Phrygia in order, strengthening all the disciples.
24 And a certain Jew named Apollos, born at Alexandria, an eloquent man, and mighty in the scriptures, came to Ephesus.
25 This man was instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in the spirit, he spake and taught diligently the things of the Lord, knowing only the baptism of John.

rr: 26 Yaatandika kubuurira n'obumanzi omuri sinagogi. Kwonka Priskila na Akula, ku baamuhuriire, baamutwara owaabo, baayongyera kumushobororera gye omuhanda gwa Ruhanga.
en: 26 And he began to speak boldly in the synagogue: whom when Aquila and Priscilla had heard, they took him unto them , and expounded unto him the way of God more perfectly.
27 And when he was disposed to pass into Achaia, the brethren wrote, exhorting the disciples to receive him: who, when he was come, helped them much which had believed through grace:

rr: 28 ahakuba akaba ahakanisa Abayudaaya n'amaani omu maisho ga boona, abasinga, naabahamiza omu Byahandiikirwe ku Yesu ari Kristo.
en: 28 for he mightily convinced the Jews, and that publickly, shewing by the scriptures that Jesus was Christ.

rr: 1 Apolo ku yaabaire akiri Korinso, Paulo yaaraba omu kyanga kya ruguru, yaahika Efeso, yaashangayo abeegi bamwe
en: 1 And it came to pass, that, while Apollos was at Corinth, Paul having passed through the upper coasts came to Ephesus: and finding certain disciples,

rr: 2 yaababuuza ati: Obu mwaikiriza, mukaheebwa Omwyoyo Orikwera?
en: 2 he said unto them, Have ye received the Holy Ghost since ye believed?

rr: Baamugarukamu bati: Ngaaha, n'okuhurira titukahuriraga, yaaba habaho Omwoyo Orikwera.
en: And they said unto him, We have not so much as heard whether there be any Holy Ghost.

rr: 3 Yaagira ati: Mukabatizibwa omu kubatizibwa ki? Bati: Omu kubatuza kwa Yohaana.
en: 3 And he said unto them, Unto what then were ye baptized? And they said, Unto John's baptism.
4 Then said Paul, John verily baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying unto the people, that they should believe on him which should come after him, that is, on Christ Jesus.

rr: 5 Ku baahuriire ekyo, baabatizibwa omu iziina rya Mukama waitu Yesu.
en: 5 When they heard this , they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
6 And when Paul had laid his hands upon them, the Holy Ghost came on them; and they spake with tongues, and prophesied.

rr: 7 Boona bakaba bari ikumi na babiri.
en: 7 And all the men were about twelve.

rr: 8 Yaataaha omuri sinagogi, yaamara ameezi ashatu naagamba n'obumanzi, naahakanisa abantu, kandi naabaikiririsa eby'obukama bwa Ruhanga.
en: 8 And he went into the synagogue, and spake boldly for the space of three months, disputing and persuading the things concerning the kingdom of God.

rr: 9 Kwonka bamwe ku baagangaize emitima, baayanga kuhurira nibajuma Omuhanda ogwo omu maisho g'abantu, yaabarugaho, yaashorooramu abeegi, yaaguma naahakanira omu ishomero rya Turaano.
en: 9 But when divers were hardened, and believed not, but spake evil of that way before the multitude, he departed from them, and separated the disciples, disputing daily in the school of one Tyrannus.

rr: 10 Yaagumizamu naakora atyo okumara emyaka ebiri; n'ahabw'ekyo boona abaabaire batwire Asia, Abayudaaya n'Abagriika, baahurira ekigambo kya Mukama.
en: 10 And this continued by the space of two years; so that all they which dwelt in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.

rr: 11 Ruhanga yaakoresa emikono ya Paulo eby'okutangaaza ebitari by'obutoosha
en: 11 And God wrought special miracles by the hands of Paul:

rr: 12 kandi ebitambaara n'emyenda ebyarugire aha mubiri gwe baabitwarira abarwaire, baakira endwara zaabo, n'abariho baadaimoni baabarugaho.
en: 12 so that from his body were brought unto the sick handkerchiefs or aprons, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out of them.
13 Then certain of the vagabond Jews, exorcists, took upon them to call over them which had evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preacheth.

rr: 14 Hakaba hariho abashaija mushanju, batabani ba Skewa Omuyudaaya, omunyamurwa omukuru, abaabaire nibakora batyo.
en: 14 And there were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jew, and chief of the priests, which did so.
15 And the evil spirit answered and said, Jesus I know, and Paul I know; but who are ye?

rr: 16 Omushaija owaabaire ariho daimoni yaabagurukira boona, yaabakiza amaani, yaababinga, baahunga omu nju egyo bajwaire busha, bahutaire.
en: 16 And the man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, and overcame them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.
17 And this was known to all the Jews and Greeks also dwelling at Ephesus; and fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.

rr: 18 Kandi baingi ahari abo abaikiriize baija, baayatura ebibi byabo, baagamba n'ebi baakozire.
en: 18 And many that believed came, and confessed, and shewed their deeds.

rr: 19 Baingi ahari abo, abaabaire bakora eby'obufumu baateeranira hamwe ebitabo byabo eby'okuragura, baabyokeza omu maisho g'abantu boona; baabariirira obuguzi bwabyo, baashanga nibuhika ebicweka by'efeeza obukumi butaano.
en: 19 Many of them also which used curious arts brought their books together, and burned them before all men : and they counted the price of them, and found it fifty thousand pieces of silver.

rr: 20 Okwo nikwo ekigambo kya Mukama kyayeyongyeire kityo amaani, kikasingura.
en: 20 So mightily grew the word of God and prevailed.
21 After these things were ended, Paul purposed in the spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, After I have been there, I must also see Rome.
22 So he sent into Macedonia two of them that ministered unto him, Timotheus and Erastus; but he himself stayed in Asia for a season.
23 And the same time there arose no small stir about that way.

rr: 24 Ahakuba omushaija orikwetwa Demeterio, omuheesi w'efeeza, owaabaire aheesha ebishushani bya hekalu ya Atemi omu feeza, naatungisa abaheesi be munonga
en: 24 For a certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith, which made silver shrines for Diana, brought no small gain unto the craftsmen;

rr: 25 akabateerana hamwe n'abandi abaabaire bakora omwoga ogwo, yaabagira ati: Bashaija 'mwe, nimumanya omwoga ogu ku nigwo gubaire nigututungisa.
en: 25 whom he called together with the workmen of like occupation, and said, Sirs, ye know that by this craft we have our wealth.

rr: 26 Mbwenu nimureeba, kandi nimuhurira ku kitari muri Efeso yonka, kureka n'omuri Asia haihi yoona, Paulo ogwo ayohize abantu baingi, naabahindura, naagira ati: Baaruhanga abakozirwe n'emikono, ti baaruhanga b'amazima.
en: 26 Moreover ye see and hear, that not alone at Ephesus, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul hath persuaded and turned away much people, saying that they be no gods, which are made with hands:

rr: 27 Mbwenu nu hariho akabi, ti habw'omwoga gwaitu kugaywa kwonka, kureka n'ahabwa hekalu na ruhangakazi rugambwa Atemi kuhindurwa busha; kandi na ruhanga-kazi ogwo, orikuramibwa ab'omu nsi zoona, kwihwaho ekitiinisa kye.
en: 27 so that not only this our craft is in danger to be set at nought; but also that the temple of the great goddess Diana should be despised, and her magnificence should be destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worshippeth.

rr: 28 Ku baahuriire ekyo, baakwatwa ekiniga kingi, baayomba munonga bati: Atemi wa Efeso ni mukuru!
en: 28 And when they heard these sayings , they were full of wrath, and cried out, saying, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.
29 And the whole city was filled with confusion: and having caught Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul's companions in travel, they rushed with one accord into the theatre.

rr: 30 Paulo yaayenda kubataahamu, kwonka abeegi be tibaamwikiriza
en: 30 And when Paul would have entered in unto the people, the disciples suffered him not.

rr: 31 kandi bamwe aha bakungu bakuru ba Asia, abaabaire bari banywani be, baamutumaho, baamweshengyereza ngu arekye kweroha omu iteeraniro.
en: 31 And certain of the chief of Asia, which were his friends, sent unto him, desiring him that he would not adventure himself into the theatre.

rr: 32 Ab'omu mutwe ogwo abamwe baayomba okwabo, n'abandi okwabo, ahakuba boona bakaba nibayoogoorekana, kandi abaingi batamanyire ekyabateerana.
en: 32 Some therefore cried one thing, and some another: for the assembly was confused; and the more part knew not wherefore they were come together.

rr: 33 Baiha Alegizanda omu mutwe, Abayudaaya baaba nibo baamwebembeza.
en: 33 And they drew Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward.

rr: Alegizanda yaabacureeza n'omukono, ngu abone kwetonganira aha bantu.
en: And Alexander beckoned with the hand, and would have made his defence unto the people.

rr: 34 Kwonka ku baamanyire ku ari Omuyudaaya, boona baayombera hamwe okumara nk'eshaaha ibiri nibagira bati: Atemi wa Efeso ni mukuru!
en: 34 But when they knew that he was a Jew, all with one voice about the space of two hours cried out, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.

rr: 35 Bwanyima omuhandiiki omukuru ow'omu rurembo yaacureeza abantu naagira ati: Imwe bashaija ba Efeso 'mwe, ni muntu ki otarikumanya ngu orurembo rwa Efeso nirwo rurinda hekalu ya Atemi omukuru, n'ekishushabni ekyarugire omu iguru?
en: 35 And when the townclerk had appeased the people, he said, Ye men of Ephesus, what man is there that knoweth not how that the city of the Ephesians is a worshipper of the great goddess Diana, and of the image which fell down from Jupiter?

rr: 36 Mbwenu, nk'oku hatariho orikubaasa kubyehakana, mushemereire kuhunama, mutakora ekintu kyona nimurahukiriza.
en: 36 Seeing then that these things cannot be spoken against, ye ought to be quiet, and to do nothing rashly.

rr: 37 Ahakuba abashaija abo tibaibire by'omuri hekalu zaitu, n'obu kwakuba okurogota ahari ruhanga-kazi waitu; mbwenu mwabareeta aha.
en: 37 For ye have brought hither these men, which are neither robbers of churches, nor yet blasphemers of your goddess.

rr: 38 N'ahabw'ekyo Demeterio n'abaheesi bagyenzi be, ku baraabe baine eki barikutabaariza omuntu weena, amaramuriro gariho, n'abategyeki barihp; babe niyo baatabaarizana.
en: 38 Wherefore if Demetrius, and the craftsmen which are with him, have a matter against any man, the law is open, and there are deputies: let them implead one another.

rr: 39 Kwonka ku muraabe mwine ekindi eki murikushobooroza, biryamarirwa omu ishengyero ry'obutoosha.
en: 39 But if ye enquire any thing concerning other matters, it shall be determined in a lawful assembly.

rr: 40 Mumanye ku turi omu kabi k'okuregwa ahabw'okuyoogoorekana kw'eri izooba; ahakuba tihariho buryo obu turaayetonganire bukashoboorora okuteerana oku.
en: 40 For we are in danger to be called in question for this day's uproar, there being no cause whereby we may give an account of this concourse.

rr: 41 Ku yaaherize kugamba ekyo, yaagambira abantu, baayabuuka.
en: 41 And when he had thus spoken, he dismissed the assembly.

rr: 1 Okurabanamu ku kwahweireho, Paulo yaatuma abeegi; ku yaaherize kubagumya, yaabaraga, yaarugayo kuza Makedonia.
en: 1 And after the uproar was ceased, Paul called unto him the disciples, and embraced them , and departed for to go into Macedonia.

rr: 2 Ku yaaherize kuraba omu bicweka ebyo, n'okubagumya omuri bingi, yaahika Bugriika.
en: 2 And when he had gone over those parts, and had given them much exhortation, he came into Greece,

rr: 3 Okwo yaamarayo ameezi ashatu; ku yaabaire naayenda kugyendera omu meeri kuza Siria, Abayudaaya baacuma enaama y'okumwita; n'ahabw'ekyo yaamariirira kugaruka ogwa Makedonia.
en: 3 and there abode three months. And when the Jews laid wait for him, as he was about to sail into Syria, he purposed to return through Macedonia.
4 And there accompanied him into Asia Sopater of Berea; and of the Thessalonians, Aristarchus and Secundus; and Gaius of Derbe, and Timotheus; and of Asia, Tychicus and Trophimus.

rr: 5 Abo baatwebembera, baatutegyerereza Troa
en: 5 These going before tarried for us at Troas.

rr: 6 kwonka itwe, bwanyima y'ebiro by'Emigaati etatumbisiibwe, twaruga Filipi, twaza omu meeri, twabashanga Troa, tumazire ebiro bitaano; okwo twamarayo ebiro mushanju.
en: 6 And we sailed away from Philippi after the days of unleavened bread, and came unto them to Troas in five days; where we abode seven days.
7 And upon the first day of the week, when the disciples came together to break bread, Paul preached unto them, ready to depart on the morrow; and continued his speech until midnight.

rr: 8 Omuri kanyinaishatu omu twabaire tuteeraniire, hakaba harimu amatabaaza maingi
en: 8 And there were many lights in the upper chamber, where they were gathered together.

rr: 9 kandi omutsigazi orikwetwa Yutuko akaba ashutami omu dirisa; yaagira oturo twingi; Paulo ku yaagumiizemu naagamba, Yutuko ogwo yaarembibwa oturo, yaahanantuka omuri kanyinaishatu, yaagwa ahansi, baamwihaho akabire.
en: 9 And there sat in a window a certain young man named Eutychus, being fallen into a deep sleep: and as Paul was long preaching, he sunk down with sleep, and fell down from the third loft, and was taken up dead.
10 And Paul went down, and fell on him, and embracing him said, Trouble not yourselves; for his life is in him.

rr: 11 Paulo yaagaruka yaatemba, yaabega omugaati, yaarya, bwanyima yaagumizamu naagaaniira nabo omwanya muhango okuhitsya omu kasheeshe; atyo yaagyenda.
en: 11 When he therefore was come up again, and had broken bread, and eaten, and talked a long while, even till break of day, so he departed.

rr: 12 Omutsigazi ogwo baamwihayo ahuriire, baagarukwa emitima omunda.
en: 12 And they brought the young man alive, and were not a little comforted.

rr: 13 Itwe twayebembera kuza aha meeri, twagizamu, twayambuka Asosi, ei twayenzire ngu twakiirire Paulo; ahakuba akaba aturagiire atyo, ngu we arabe ogw'ebigyere.
en: 13 And we went before to ship, and sailed unto Assos, there intending to take in Paul: for so had he appointed, minding himself to go afoot.

rr: 14 Ku yaatubugaine Asosi, twamutaasya omu meeri, twaija Mituleene.
en: 14 And when he met with us at Assos, we took him in, and came to Mitylene.

rr: 15 Ku twarugireyo, omu kasheeshe twahika aharikureeba Kio; aha kiro kya kashatu twahika Samo; aha kiro kya kana twahika Mileeto.
en: 15 And we sailed thence, and came the next day over against Chios; and the next day we arrived at Samos, and tarried at Trogyllium; and the next day we came to Miletus.

rr: 16 Paulo akaba amaririire kuhingura Efeso ari omu meeri, ngu atakyerererwa Asia; ahabw'okuba akaba naayehuuta ngu, ku kiraabe nikibaasika, ekiro kya Pentekoote kimushangye Yerusaalemu.
en: 16 For Paul had determined to sail by Ephesus, because he would not spend the time in Asia: for he hasted, if it were possible for him, to be at Jerusalem the day of Pentecost.

rr: 17 Ku yaabaire ari Mileeto, yaatuma omuri Efeso kwetayo abakuru b'ekanisa.
en: 17 And from Miletus he sent to Ephesus, and called the elders of the church.

rr: 18 Ku baamuhikireho, yaabagira ati: Imwe nimumanya oku naatwire naimwe ebiro byona okuruga aha izooba eri naahikiireho omuri Asia
en: 18 And when they were come to him, he said unto them, Ye know, from the first day that I came into Asia, after what manner I have been with you at all seasons,

rr: 19 nkaba nkorera Mukama n'obucureezi bwingi nindira, omu by'okugyezibwa ebyambaireho ahabw'enaama mbi z'Abayudaaya.
en: 19 serving the Lord with all humility of mind, and with many tears, and temptations, which befell me by the lying in wait of the Jews:

rr: 20 Nimumanya ku ntaratiinire kubagambira kigambo kyona eky'omugasho, nimbeegyeseza omu maisho ga boona, kandi n'omu maju gaanyu emwe-emwe
en: 20 and how I kept back nothing that was profitable unto you , but have shewed you, and have taught you publickly, and from house to house,

rr: 21 nimpamiza Abayudaaya n'Abagriika okweteisiza Ruhanga, n'okwikiriza Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo.
en: 21 testifying both to the Jews, and also to the Greeks, repentance toward God, and faith toward our Lord Jesus Christ.

rr: 22 Kandi mbwenu, reeba niinyinamuka Yerusaalemu, ngyemirwe Omwoyo, ntarikumanya birambeho naahikayo
en: 22 And now, behold, I go bound in the spirit unto Jerusalem, not knowing the things that shall befall me there:
23 save that the Holy Ghost witnesseth in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions abide me.

24 But none of these things move me, neither count I my life dear unto myself, so that I might finish my course with joy, and the ministry, which I have received of the Lord Jesus, to testify the gospel of the grace of God.

rr: 25 Hati mbwenu nimmanya ngu imwe mwena abu naabaire ndabamu nimbuurira eby'obukama, timurindeeba bundi.
en: 25 And now, behold, I know that ye all, among whom I have gone preaching the kingdom of God, shall see my face no more.
26 Wherefore I take you to record this day, that I am pure from the blood of all men .

rr: 27 ahakuba tindatiinire kubagambira naama yoona eya Ruhanga.
en: 27 For I have not shunned to declare unto you all the counsel of God.
28 Take heed therefore unto yourselves, and to all the flock, over the which the Holy Ghost hath made you overseers, to feed the church of God, which he hath purchased with his own blood.
29 For I know this, that after my departing shall grievous wolves enter in among you, not sparing the flock.
30 Also of your own selves shall men arise, speaking perverse things, to draw away disciples after them.

rr: 31 N'ahabw'ekyo mugume nimureeba, kandi mwijukye ku ntararekire kuhana muntu weena n'amarira, okumara emyaka eshatu nyomushana na nyekiro.
en: 31 Therefore watch, and remember, that by the space of three years I ceased not to warn every one night and day with tears.

rr: 32 Kandi na hati mbwenu, B'eishe-emwe, nimbatsigira Ruhanga n'ekigambo ky'embabazi ze, ekirikubaasa kubombeka n'okubaha obuhunguzi hamwe na boona abeeziibwe.
en: 32 And now, brethren, I commend you to God, and to the word of his grace, which is able to build you up, and to give you an inheritance among all them which are sanctified.
33 I have coveted no man's silver, or gold, or apparel.
34 Yea, ye yourselves know, that these hands have ministered unto my necessities, and to them that were with me.

rr: 35 Omuri byona mbabeereire eky'okureeberaho, ngu mubone kukora mutyo emirimo, kuhwera abataine maani, n'okwijuka ebigambo ebi Mukama waitu Yesu yaagambire naagira ati: Okugaba kuhaisa omugisha okukira okuheebwa.
en: 35 I have shewed you all things, how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how he said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.
36 And when he had thus spoken, he kneeled down, and prayed with them all.

rr: 37 Boona baarira munonga, baagwa Paulo omu bitsya, baamunywegyera
en: 37 And they all wept sore, and fell on Paul's neck, and kissed him,

rr: 38 nibashaasha, n'okukira byona ahabw'ekigambo eki yaabaragisa, ati: Amaisho n'aga.
en: 38 sorrowing most of all for the words which he spake, that they should see his face no more.

rr: Baamushendekyereza okuhika aha meeri.
en: And they accompanied him unto the ship.

rr: 1 Ku twataine nabo, twaza omu meeri, twagyema ogurikuza Koosi; ku bwaseesire, twahika Roodo; twarugayo twahika Patara.
en: 1 And it came to pass, that after we were gotten from them, and had launched, we came with a straight course unto Coos, and the day following unto Rhodes, and from thence unto Patara:

rr: 2 Ku twashangire emeeri neeyenda kuza Foiniike, twagizamu, twagyenda.
en: 2 and finding a ship sailing over unto Phenicia, we went aboard, and set forth.

rr: 3 Ku twarangiza Kupuro, twagitsiga aha rubaju rwa bumosho, twaza Siria, twahika aha nkungu ya Tuuro, ahakuba niho baabaire nibaza kuteekururira ebintu omu meeri.
en: 3 Now when we had discovered Cyprus, we left it on the left hand, and sailed into Syria, and landed at Tyre: for there the ship was to unlade her burden.

rr: 4 Ku twareebire abeegi, twamarayo ebiro mushanju. Abo baateisa Paulo nibagambisibwa Omwoyo, kutaza Yerusaalemu.
en: 4 And finding disciples, we tarried there seven days: who said to Paul through the Spirit, that he should not go up to Jerusalem.

rr: 5 Ku twamazireyo ebyo biro, twarugayo, twahamya orugyendo rwaitu; boona hamwe n'abakazi baabo n'abaan baatushendekyereza, okuhitsya obu baatwogize omu rurembo; ku twahikire aha nyanja, twatsimba amaju, twashaba, twaragana.
en: 5 And when we had accomplished those days, we departed and went our way; and they all brought us on our way, with wives and children, till we were out of the city: and we kneeled down on the shore, and prayed.

rr: 6 Ku twataahire omu meeri, baagaruka owaabo.
en: 6 And when we had taken our leave one of another, we took ship; and they returned home again.

rr: 7 Ku twaherize orugyendo rw'okuruga Tuuro, twahika Potolemai; twaramutsya ab'eishe-emwe, twaraarayo nabo.
en: 7 And when we had finished our course from Tyre, we came to Ptolemais, and saluted the brethren, and abode with them one day.
8 And the next day we that were of Paul's company departed, and came unto Cæsarea: and we entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, which was one of the seven; and abode with him.

rr: 9 Kandi akaba aine abaishiki bana b'empangare, abaabaire baragura.
en: 9 And the same man had four daughters, virgins, which did prophesy.
10 And as we tarried there many days, there came down from Judæa a certain prophet, named Agabus.

rr: 11 Ku yaatuhikire, yaakwata orukoba rwa Paulo, yaarwekomesa ebigyere n'emikono, yaagira ati: Oku nikwo Omwoyo Orikwera arikugira ati: Abayudaaya ba Yerusaalemu nikwo barikoma mukama w'orukoba oru, bakamuhayo omu mikono y'Abanyamahanga.
en: 11 And when he was come unto us, he took Paul's girdle, and bound his own hands and feet, and said, Thus saith the Holy Ghost, So shall the Jews at Jerusalem bind the man that owneth this girdle, and shall deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.
12 And when we heard these things, both we, and they of that place, besought him not to go up to Jerusalem.

rr: 13 Paulo yaagarukamu ati: Nimukora ki okurira n'okuncwa omutima? Mumanye ngu tiinyeteekateekire kuboherwa Yerusaalemu kwonka, kureka n'okufeerayo ahabw'eiziina rya Mukama waitu Yesu.
en: 13 Then Paul answered, What mean ye to weep and to break mine heart? for I am ready not to be bound only, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.

rr: 14 Ku yaayangire kutuhurira, twarereera, twagira tuti: Eki Mukama arikwenda kibe nikyo kyakorwa.
en: 14 And when he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, The will of the Lord be done.

rr: 15 Bwanyima y'ebiro ebyo twakoma ebyaitu, twainamuka Yerusaalemu
en: 15 And after those days we took up our carriages, and went up to Jerusalem.

rr: 16 n'abeegi bamwe aba Kaisarea baagyenda naitwe, baija n'omwegi owa ira orikwetwa Munasooni owa Kupuro, owaabaire naayenda kuturaaza.
en: 16 There went with us also certain of the disciples of Cæsarea, and brought with them one Mnason of Cyprus, an old disciple, with whom we should lodge.

rr: 17 Ku twahikire Yerusaalemu, ab'eishe-emwe baatwakiira n'okushemererwa.
en: 17 And when we were come to Jerusalem, the brethren received us gladly.
18 And the day following Paul went in with us unto James; and all the elders were present.

rr: 19 Ku yaaherize kubaramutsya, yaabateekyerereza byona buri kimwe, ebi Ruhanga yaakozire omu Banyamahanga omu kuheereza kwe.
en: 19 And when he had saluted them, he declared particularly what things God had wrought among the Gentiles by his ministry.
20 And when they heard it , they glorified the Lord, and said unto him, Thou seest, brother, how many thousands of Jews there are which believe; and they are all zealous of the law:

21 and they are informed of thee, that thou teachest all the Jews which are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, saying that they ought not to circumcise their children, neither to walk after the customs.

rr: 22 Mbwenu tigure tuta? Ahakuba tibaribura kuhurira ku oizire.
en: 22 What is it therefore? the multitude must needs come together: for they will hear that thou art come.

rr: 23 N'ahabw'ekyo kora eki turikukugambira. Aha twineho abashaija bana abaayerahiriire endahiro
en: 23 Do therefore this that we say to thee: We have four men which have a vow on them;

24 them take, and purify thyself with them, and be at charges with them, that they may shave their heads: and all may know that those things, whereof they were informed concerning thee, are nothing; but that thou thyself also walkest orderly, and keepest the law.

rr: 25 Kandi eby'Abanyamahanga abaikiriize, tukabahandiikira ebaruha, nitubaragiira kwerinda ebihongyirwe ebishushani ebirikuramibwa, n'eshagama, n'ebinigirwe, n'obushambani.
en: 25 As touching the Gentiles which believe, we have written and concluded that they observe no such thing, save only that they keep themselves from things offered to idols, and from blood, and from strangled, and from fornication.

26 Then Paul took the men, and the next day purifying himself with them entered into the temple, to signify the accomplishment of the days of purification, until that an offering should be offered for every one of them.

rr: 27 Ebiro ebyo mushanju ku byabaire biri haihi kuhwa, Abayudaaya abaarugire Asia, ku baamureebire omuri hekalu, baajagaraza omutwe gwona ogw'abantu, baamuyookyera, baamukwata
en: 27 And when the seven days were almost ended, the Jews which were of Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the people, and laid hands on him,

28 crying out, Men of Israel, help: This is the man, that teacheth all men every where against the people, and the law, and this place: and further brought Greeks also into the temple, and hath polluted this holy place.
29 (For they had seen before with him in the city Trophimus an Ephesian, whom they supposed that Paul had brought into the temple.)

rr: 30 Orurembo rwona rwatengatenga, abantu baayooka, baakwata Paulo, baamukurura omuri hekalu; ahonaaho enyigi zaakingwa.
en: 30 And all the city was moved, and the people ran together: and they took Paul, and drew him out of the temple: and forthwith the doors were shut.

rr: 31 Ku baabaire nibenda kumwita, enkuru yaahika aha mukuru w'engabo, ngu Yerusaalemu yoona neerabanamu.
en: 31 And as they went about to kill him, tidings came unto the chief captain of the band, that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.

rr: 32 Ahonaaho yaahurura n'abaserukare n'abakuru baabo, yaabashuumira nairuka; bo, ku baamureebire n'abaserukare, baarekyeraho kuteera Paulo.
en: 32 Who immediately took soldiers and centurions, and ran down unto them: and when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, they left beating of Paul.

rr: 33 Omukuru w'engabo yairira haihi, yaakwata Paulo, yaaragiira kumukomesa enjegyere ibiri; bwanyima yaamubuuza eiziina rye, n'eki akozire.
en: 33 Then the chief captain came near, and took him, and commanded him to be bound with two chains; and demanded who he was, and what he had done.

rr: 34 Abamwe aha b'omu mutwe baayomba okwabo, n'abandi okwabo; ku yaareebire ataabaasa kushoborokyerwa amazima ahabw'okuyomba, yaaragiira kumutwara omu kigo ky'abaserukare.
en: 34 And some cried one thing, some another, among the multitude: and when he could not know the certainty for the tumult, he commanded him to be carried into the castle.

rr: 35 Ku yaahikire aha matembero, abaserukare baamukiriza ahabw'ekiniga ky'abantu
en: 35 And when he came upon the stairs, so it was, that he was borne of the soldiers for the violence of the people.
36 For the multitude of the people followed after, crying, Away with him.

rr: 37 Paulo, ku yaabaire ari haihi kutaaha omu kigo, yaashaba omukuru w'engabo ati: Nkaagira eki naagamba?
en: 37 And as Paul was to be led into the castle, he said unto the chief captain, May I speak unto thee?

rr: Yaamubuuza ati: Noomanya Orugriika?
en: Who said, Canst thou speak Greek?

rr: 38 Tori Omunyamisri ori owaagomeise abantu omu biro bihingwire, akatwara omu ihamba abashaija enkumi ina abaitsi b'abantu?
en: 38 Art not thou that Egyptian, which before these days madest an uproar, and leddest out into the wilderness four thousand men that were murderers?

rr: 39 Paulo yaamugarukamu ati: Ndi Omuyudaaya owa Taruso ey'omuri Kilikia, ow'omu rurembo orutarikugaywa; ninkweshengyereza, onyikirize ngambire aba bantu.
en: 39 But Paul said, I am a man which am a Jew of Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, a citizen of no mean city: and, I beseech thee, suffer me to speak unto the people.

rr: 40 Ku yaamwikiriize, Paulo yaayemerera aha matembero, yaacureeza abantu n'omukono; ku haabaireho okucureera kwingi yaabagambira omu Ruheburaayo ati
en: 40 And when he had given him licence, Paul stood on the stairs, and beckoned with the hand unto the people. And when there was made a great silence, he spake unto them in the Hebrew tongue, saying,

rr: 1 Beene waitu kandi Baataata, muhurire ebigambo ebi ndikwetonganira omu maisho gaanyu.
en: 1 Men, brethren, and fathers, hear ye my defence which I make now unto you.

rr: 2 Ku baahuriire yaabagambira omu Ruheburaayo, baayeyongyera kucureera. Yaagira ati
en: 2 (And when they heard that he spake in the Hebrew tongue to them, they kept the more silence: and he saith,)

3 I am verily a man which am a Jew, born in Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, yet brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, and taught according to the perfect manner of the law of the fathers, and was zealous toward God, as ye all are this day.

rr: 4 kandi nkaba mpiiga ab'Omuhanda ogu ngu baitwe, nimboha abashaija n'abakazi, nimbataisa omu kihome.
en: 4 And I persecuted this way unto the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women.

rr: 5 N'omunyamurwa omukuru niwe kareebi wangye, hamwe n'abakuru b'eishengyero boona; nibo bampaire ebaruha ezi baahandikiire beene waitu aba Damasiko, ntwairweyo okukwata abaayo n'okubareeta Yerusaalemu babohirwe, ngu baheebwe ekiheneso.
en: 5 As also the high priest doth bear me witness, and all the estate of the elders: from whom also I received letters unto the brethren, and went to Damascus, to bring them which were there bound unto Jerusalem, for to be punished.

rr: 6 Ku naabaire ningyenda, naahika haihi na Damasiko, nk'omu ihangwe ahonaaho naayakirwa omushana mwingi niguruga omu iguru gwanyehinguririza.
en: 6 And it came to pass, that, as I made my journey, and was come nigh unto Damascus about noon, suddenly there shone from heaven a great light round about me.

rr: 7 Naagwa ahansi, naahurira eiraka niringira riti: Saulo, Saulo, ompiigira ki?
en: 7 And I fell unto the ground, and heard a voice saying unto me, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?

rr: 8 Naagarukamu nti: Ori oha, Mukama wangye? Yangira ati: Niinye Yesu owa Nazareesi, ou orikuhiiga.
en: 8 And I answered, Who art thou, Lord? And he said unto me, I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom thou persecutest.

rr: 9 Abu naabaire ngyenzire nabo baareeba omushana ogwo, kwonka tibaahurira iraka ry'ogwo owaabaire naagamba naanye.
en: 9 And they that were with me saw indeed the light, and were afraid; but they heard not the voice of him that spake to me.

rr: 10 Naabuuza nti: Ngire nta, Mukama wangye?
en: 10 And I said, What shall I do, Lord?

rr: Mukama yangarukamu ati: Imuka oze Damasiko; niyo oraagambirirwe byona ebi oragiirwe kukora.
en: And the Lord said unto me, Arise, and go into Damascus; and there it shall be told thee of all things which are appointed for thee to do.

rr: 11 Okumurinkana kw'omushana ogwo kwampumya; n'ahabw'ekyo naakwatirirwa abo abu naabaire nyine, naahika Damasiko.
en: 11 And when I could not see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of them that were with me, I came into Damascus.

rr: 12 Omushaija orikwetwa Anania, omunyadiini omu Biragiro, orikusiimwa Abayudaaya boona abaabaire batwire okwo
en: 12 And one Ananias, a devout man according to the law, having a good report of all the Jews which dwelt there ,

rr: 13 yaija, yaanyemerera aha rubaju, yangambira ati: ow'eishe-emwe Saulo, humuuka. Omu kaanya ako naahumuuka, naamureeba.
en: 13 came unto me, and stood, and said unto me, Brother Saul, receive thy sight. And the same hour I looked up upon him.

rr: 14 Yaagira ati: Ruhanga wa baatatenkuriitwe akutooraine ngu omanye ebi akunda, oreebe Ogwo Ohikiriire, kandi ohurire eiraka eririkuruga omu kanwa ke.
en: 14 And he said, The God of our fathers hath chosen thee, that thou shouldest know his will, and see that Just One, and shouldest hear the voice of his mouth.

rr: 15 Ahakuba oryaba kareebi we ow'okuhamiza abantu boona ebi oreebire n'ebi ohuriire.
en: 15 For thou shalt be his witness unto all men of what thou hast seen and heard.

rr: 16 Mbwenu otegyereize ki? Imuka, obatizibwe, oyogye ebibi byawe, otakire eiziina rye.
en: 16 And now why tarriest thou? arise, and be baptized, and wash away thy sins, calling on the name of the Lord.
17 And it came to pass, that, when I was come again to Jerusalem, even while I prayed in the temple, I was in a trance;

rr: 18 naamureeba yangira ati: Otakyerererwa; rahuka orugye Yerusaalemu, ahabw'okuba tibarikwija kwikiriza okuhamya oku orikumpamya.
en: 18 and saw him saying unto me, Make haste, and get thee quickly out of Jerusalem: for they will not receive thy testimony concerning me.

rr: 19 Naanye naagira nti: Mukama wangye, bo bonka nibamanya ngu nkaba nkwata abarikukwikiriza, mbata omu bihome, kandi mbateerera omuri sinagogi zoona
en: 19 And I said, Lord, they know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue them that believed on thee:
20 and when the blood of thy martyr Stephen was shed, I also was standing by, and consenting unto his death, and kept the raiment of them that slew him.
21 And he said unto me, Depart: for I will send thee far hence unto the Gentiles.

rr: 22 Baaguma bamuhurikiize okuhitsya obu yaagambire ekigambo ekyo; okuruga aho baayomba munonga nibagira bati: Mwihe omu nsi ekishaija ekyo; tikishemereire kugumaho.
en: 22 And they gave him audience unto this word, and then lifted up their voices, and said, Away with such a fellow from the earth: for it is not fit that he should live.

rr: 23 Ku baabaire nibayomba munonga, nibatambika emyenda yaabo, kandi nibanaga n'omucuucu ahaiguru
en: 23 And as they cried out, and cast off their clothes, and threw dust into the air,

rr: 24 omukuru w'engabo yaaragiira kumutaasya omu kigo, n'okumwasha nibamutatsya, ngu abone kwetegyereza eki baamuteererera enduuru.
en: 24 the chief captain commanded him to be brought into the castle, and bade that he should be examined by scourging; that he might know wherefore they cried so against him.
25 And as they bound him with thongs, Paul said unto the centurion that stood by, Is it lawful for you to scourge a man that is a Roman, and uncondemned?

rr: 26 Omukuru ogwo, ku yaakihuriire, yaaza aha mukuru w'engabo, yaamugira ati: Nooyenda kukora ki? Ahakuba omushaija ogu n'Omurooma.
en: 26 When the centurion heard that , he went and told the chief captain, saying, Take heed what thou doest: for this man is a Roman.

rr: 27 Omukuru w'engabo yaija, yaamubuuza ati: Ngambira; ori Omurooma? Paulo ati: Eego.
en: 27 Then the chief captain came, and said unto him, Tell me, art thou a Roman? He said, Yea.

rr: 28 Omukuru w'engabo yaagira ati: Nyowe nkatunga Oburooma obu n'empiiha nyingi. Paulo ati: Kwonka nyowe nibwo naazairwemu.
en: 28 And the chief captain answered, With a great sum obtained I this freedom. And Paul said, But I was free born.

rr: 29 Ahonaaho abo abaabaire nibenda kumutatsya baamurugaho; kandi omukuru w'engabo nawe yaatiina, ahabw'okumanya ku Paulo ari Omurooma, kandi yaamubohire.
en: 29 Then straightway they departed from him which should have examined him: and the chief captain also was afraid, after he knew that he was a Roman, and because he had bound him.

rr: 30 Ku bwaseesire, yaayenda kumanya amazima g'ekigambo eki Abayudaaya bamutabaaririize, yaamubohoorora, yaaragiira abanyamurwa abakuru n'ab'eishengyero boona kuteeranira hamwe, yaashuumya Paulo, yaamuta omu maisho gaabo.
en: 30 On the morrow, because he would have known the certainty wherefore he was accused of the Jews, he loosed him from his bands, and commanded the chief priests and all their council to appear, and brought Paul down, and set him before them.
1 And Paul, earnestly beholding the council, said, Men and brethren, I have lived in all good conscience before God until this day.
2 And the high priest Ananias commanded them that stood by him to smite him on the mouth.
3 Then said Paul unto him, God shall smite thee, thou whited wall: for sittest thou to judge me after the law, and commandest me to be smitten contrary to the law?

rr: 4 Abeemereire haihi baagira bati: Okaajumire omunyamurwa wa Ruhanga omukuru?
en: 4 And they that stood by said, Revilest thou God's high priest?
5 Then said Paul, I wist not, brethren, that he was the high priest: for it is written, Thou shalt not speak evil of the ruler of thy people.

6 But when Paul perceived that the one part were Sadducees, and the other Pharisees, he cried out in the council, Men and brethren, I am a Pharisee, the son of a Pharisee: of the hope and resurrection of the dead I am called in question.

rr: 7 Ku yaaherize kugamba atyo, haabaho okutongana kw'Abafarisaayo n'Abasadukaayo; eishengyero ryayebaganisamu habiri.
en: 7 And when he had so said, there arose a dissension between the Pharisees and the Sadducees: and the multitude was divided.
8 For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, neither angel, nor spirit: but the Pharisees confess both.

rr: 9 Haabaho okuyoogoorekana kwingi; abamwe ab'omu kigombe ky'abahandiiki b'Abafarisaayo baayemerera, baahakana nibagira bati: Tihariho kibi eki twareeba aha mushaija ogu. Shana omwoyo nari maraika akaaba amugambiire?
en: 9 And there arose a great cry: and the scribes that were of the Pharisees' part arose, and strove, saying, We find no evil in this man: but if a spirit or an angel hath spoken to him, let us not fight against God.

rr: 10 Empaka zaabo ku zaabire ez'amaani maingi munonga, omukuru w'engabo yaatiina ngu baaza kutaanyagura Paulo, nikwo kuragiira abaserukare kushuuma kumubaihamu n'amaani, n'okumureeta omu kigo.
en: 10 And when there arose a great dissension, the chief captain, fearing lest Paul should have been pulled in pieces of them, commanded the soldiers to go down, and to take him by force from among them, and to bring him into the castle.
11 And the night following the Lord stood by him, and said, Be of good cheer, Paul: for as thou hast testified of me in Jerusalem, so must thou bear witness also at Rome.

rr: 12 Ku bwaseesire, Abayudaaya baateeranira hamwe, baahiga nibarahira okutarya n'obu kwakuba okunywa okuhitsya obu baraite Paulo.
en: 12 And when it was day, certain of the Jews banded together, and bound themselves under a curse, saying that they would neither eat nor drink till they had killed Paul.

rr: 13 Abaacumire egyo naama bakaba nibakira makumi ana.
en: 13 And they were more than forty which had made this conspiracy.

rr: 14 Baaza aha banyamurwa abakuru n'abakuru b'abantu, baabagira bati: Turahiire endahiro mpango munonga kutaroza ha by'okurya, okuhitsya obu turaite Paulo.
en: 14 And they came to the chief priests and elders, and said, We have bound ourselves under a great curse, that we will eat nothing until we have slain Paul.

rr: 15 N'habw'ekyo imwe n'ab'eishengyero mugambire omukuru w'engabo hati, amubashuumize, nk'abarikwenda kwongyera kwetegyerereza kimwe eby'orubanja rwe; itwe tweteekateekire kumwita, atakabahikire.
en: 15 Now therefore ye with the council signify to the chief captain that he bring him down unto you to morrow, as though ye would enquire something more perfectly concerning him: and we, or ever he come near, are ready to kill him.

rr: 16 Kwonka mwihwa wa Paulo yaahurira enaama yaabo ey'okumugwera, yaagyenda yaataaha omu kigo, yaakigambira Paulo.
en: 16 And when Paul's sister's son heard of their lying in wait, he went and entered into the castle, and told Paul.

rr: 17 Paulo nikwo kweta omwe aha bakuru b'abaserukare, akagira ati: Twara omutsigazi ogu, omuhitsye omukuru w'engabo; ahakuba aine eki arikwenda kumugambira.
en: 17 Then Paul called one of the centurions unto him , and said, Bring this young man unto the chief captain: for he hath a certain thing to tell him.

rr: 18 Yaamutwara, yaamuhitsya omukuru w'engabo, yaagira ati: Paulo embohe yaanyeta, yanshaba kukureetera omutsigazi ogu, ngu aine eki arikwenda kukugambira.
en: 18 So he took him, and brought him to the chief captain, and said, Paul the prisoner called me unto him , and prayed me to bring this young man unto thee, who hath something to say unto thee.

rr: 19 Omukuru w'engabo yaamukwata omukono, yaamukiika aha rubaju, yaamubuuza omu mubonano ati: Nooyenda kungambira ki?
en: 19 Then the chief captain took him by the hand, and went with him aside privately, and asked him , What is that thou hast to tell me?

rr: 20 Onu yaagira ati: Abayudaaya bacumire enaama emwe kukushaba, ngu nyencakare oshuumye Paulo omu ishengyero, nk'abarikwenda kwongyera kubuuza ebye.
en: 20 And he said, The Jews have agreed to desire thee that thou wouldest bring down Paul to morrow into the council, as though they would enquire somewhat of him more perfectly.

rr: 21 Kwonka otabaikiriza; ahabw'okuba abashaija baabo abarikukira ahari makumi ana bamugwereire, kandi barahiire endahiro okutarya n'obu kwakuba okunywa batakamwitsire; mbwenu beeteekateekire, bategyereize ekigambo kyawe.
en: 21 But do not thou yield unto them: for there lie in wait for him of them more than forty men, which have bound themselves with an oath, that they will neither eat nor drink till they have killed him: and now are they ready, looking for a promise from thee.

rr: 22 Omukuru w'engabo yaaraga omutsigazi, naamwehanangiriza ati: Otagira ou waamanyisa ku waabingambira.
en: 22 So the chief captain then let the young man depart, and charged him, See thou tell no man that thou hast shewed these things to me.

rr: 23 Atyo yaayeta abakuru b'abaserukare babiri, yaabaragiira ati: Muteekateekye abaserukare magana abiri n'ab'embaraasi makumi mushanju n'ab'amacumu magana abiri, baimukye eshaaha ishatu za nyekiro baze Kaisarea
en: 23 And he called unto him two centurions, saying, Make ready two hundred soldiers to go to Cæsarea, and horsemen threescore and ten, and spearmen two hundred, at the third hour of the night;

rr: 24 kandi yaabaragiira kusherura enyamaishwa ezirikuheeka kuheeka Paulo, babone kumuhitsya gye Felikisi omutegyeki.
en: 24 and provide them beasts, that they may set Paul on, and bring him safe unto Felix the governor.

rr: 25 Yaahandiika n'ebaruha erikugira eti
en: 25 And he wrote a letter after this manner:

rr: 26 Ow'ekitiinisa Felikisi Omutegyeki, nyowe Kulaudio Lusia ninkuramutsya munonga.
en: 26 Claudius Lysias unto the most excellent governor Felix sendeth greeting.
27 This man was taken of the Jews, and should have been killed of them: then came I with an army, and rescued him, having understood that he was a Roman.

rr: 28 Kandi ku naayenzire kwetegyereza ebi barikumutabaariza, naamureeta omu ishengyero ryabo.
en: 28 And when I would have known the cause wherefore they accused him, I brought him forth into their council:
29 whom I perceived to be accused of questions of their law, but to have nothing laid to his charge worthy of death or of bonds.

rr: 30 Ku naagambiirwe ku hariho enaama y'okumwita, ahonaaho naamukwoherereza, naaragiira n'abaamutabaariize okugambira omu maisho gaawe eki barikufa nawe.
en: 30 And when it was told me how that the Jews laid wait for the man, I sent straightway to thee, and gave commandment to his accusers also to say before thee what they had against him. Farewell.

rr: 31 Batyo abaserukare batwara Paulo, nk'oku baaragiirwe, baamuhitsya Antipatiri nyekiro.
en: 31 Then the soldiers, as it was commanded them, took Paul, and brought him by night to Antipatris.

rr: 32 Ju bwaseesire, abaserukare baamutsigira ab'embaraasi kugumizamu nawe, bo baagaruka omu kigo.
en: 32 On the morrow they left the horsemen to go with him, and returned to the castle:

rr: 33 Kandi abo, ku baahikire Kaisarea, baahereza Omutegyeki ebaruha, baamumurikira na Paulo
en: 33 who, when they came to Cæsarea, and delivered the epistle to the governor, presented Paul also before him.
34 And when the governor had read the letter , he asked of what province he was. And when he understood that he was of Cilicia;

rr: 35 yaagira ati: Abaakutabaariize ku baraije, niinyija kuhurira orubanja rwawe.
en: 35 I will hear thee, said he, when thine accusers are also come.

rr: Yaaragiira kumurindira omu kikaari kya Heroode.
en: And he commanded him to be kept in Herod's judgment hall.

rr: 1 Ku haahingwireho ebiro bitaano, omunyamurwa omukuru Anania yaashuma n'abakuru b'abantu bamwe n'omushija orikwetwa Terituulo ow'okubatonganira. Batyo baatabaariza Paulo aha Mutegyeki.
en: 1 And after five days Ananias the high priest descended with the elders, and with a certain orator named Tertullus, who informed the governor against Paul.

rr: 2 Ku baamwetsire, Terituulo yaatandika kumutabaariza, naagira ati
en: 2 And when he was called forth, Tertullus began to accuse him , saying, Seeing that by thee we enjoy great quietness, and that very worthy deeds are done unto this nation by thy providence,

rr: 3 Ebyo nitubiikiriza omu buryo bwona n'omu myanya yoona, kandi nitubikusiimira munonga.
en: 3 we accept it always, and in all places, most noble Felix, with all thankfulness.

rr: 4 Kwonka, ka ndekye kwongyera kukurusya, ninkushaba ahabw'embabazi zaawe kutuhurira omu bigambo bikye.
en: 4 Notwithstanding, that I be not further tedious unto thee, I pray thee that thou wouldest hear us of thy clemency a few words.
5 For we have found this man a pestilent fellow , and a mover of sedition among all the Jews throughout the world, and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes:

rr: 6 Ekindi akateeraho kushiisha hekalu, twamukwata, twayenda ngu tumucwere orubanja nk'ebiragiro byaitu oku biri
en: 6 who also hath gone about to profane the temple: whom we took, and would have judged according to our law.

rr: 7 kwonka omukuru w'engabo Lusia yaija, yaamutwakisa amaani maingi
en: 7 But the chief captain Lysias came upon us , and with great violence took him away out of our hands,

rr: 8 yaaragiira abaamutabaariize kwija ah'ori. Na mbwenu ku oraamubuuze, noija kumanya ebi byona ebi turikumutabaaririza.
en: 8 commanding his accusers to come unto thee: by examining of whom thyself mayest take knowledge of all these things, whereof we accuse him.

rr: 9 Abayudaaya nabo baakwatanisa nawe omuribyo, baahamya ku byona nikwo biri.
en: 9 And the Jews also assented, saying that these things were so.

rr: 10 Omutegyeki ku yaamwikiriize kugamba, Paulo yaagarukamu ati: Nimmanya ngu omazire emyaka mingi ori omuramuzi w'eihanga eri; n'ahabw'ekyo naaza kwetonganira nshemereirwe.
en: 10 Then Paul, after that the governor had beckoned unto him to speak, answered, Forasmuch as I know that thou hast been of many years a judge unto this nation, I do the more cheerfully answer for myself:
11 because that thou mayest understand, that there are yet but twelve days since I went up to Jerusalem for to worship.

rr: 12 Tibaranshangire nimpakana n'omuntu weena, nari shi ninjagaraza abantu omuri hekalu nari omuri sinagogi nari omu rurembo.
en: 12 And they neither found me in the temple disputing with any man, neither raising up the people, neither in the synagogues, nor in the city:

rr: 13 Kandi tibakaabaasa kukuhamiza ebi barikuntabaaririza hati.
en: 13 neither can they prove the things whereof they now accuse me.

rr: 14 Kwonka eki ndikwemera omu maisho gaawe n'eki: Omuhanda ogwo, ogu aba barikweta ekigombe, nigwo ngyederamu nimpeereza Ruhanga wa baatatenkuriitwe, niinyikiriza ebyahandiikirwe omu Biragiro n'omu bya Baanabi byona
en: 14 But this I confess unto thee, that after the way which they call heresy, so worship I the God of my fathers, believing all things which are written in the law and in the prophets:

rr: 15 kandi nyine amatsiko ahari Ruhanga, nk'oku nabo barikwikiriza, ngu haryabaho okuzooka kw'abahikiriire n'abatahikiriire.
en: 15 and have hope toward God, which they themselves also allow, that there shall be a resurrection of the dead, both of the just and unjust.

rr: 16 Omuri ebyo nyezirika obutoosha kuguma n'omutima ogutariho rubanja ahari Ruhanga n'aha bantu.
en: 16 And herein do I exercise myself, to have always a conscience void of offence toward God, and toward men.
17 Now after many years I came to bring alms to my nation, and offerings.

rr: 18 Nkiri omuri ebyo, banshanga omuri hekalu nyeziibwe, ntaine mutwe gw'abantu abu nteeraine, n'obu rwakuba orwari. Kwonka hakaba hariho Abayudaaya bamwe abaarugire omuri Asia
en: 18 Whereupon certain Jews from Asia found me purified in the temple, neither with multitude, nor with tumult.

rr: 19 nangwa kuri nibo baizire omu maisho gaawe kuntabaariza, ku baraabe baine ekigambo ahariinye.
en: 19 Who ought to have been here before thee, and object, if they had ought against me.

rr: 20 Nari shi reka abantu aba bagambe ekibi eki bandeebireho, obu naayemerera omu maisho g'eishengyero
en: 20 Or else let these same here say, if they have found any evil doing in me, while I stood before the council,
21 except it be for this one voice, that I cried standing among them, Touching the resurrection of the dead I am called in question by you this day.

rr: 22 Kwonka Felikisi, ahabw'okushoborokyerwa gye eby'Omuhanda ogwo, yaabooshesa, naagira ati: Lusia omukuru w'engabo ku ariija, nibwo ndicwa orubanja rwanyu.
en: 22 And when Felix heard these things, having more perfect knowledge of that way, he deferred them, and said, When Lysias the chief captain shall come down, I will know the uttermost of your matter.
23 And he commanded a centurion to keep Paul, and to let him have liberty, and that he should forbid none of his acquaintance to minister or come unto him.

rr: 24 Ku haahingwireho ebiro, Felikisi yaija n'omukazi we Durusila Omuyudaayakazi; yaayeta Paulo, yaahurira ebi arikugamba aha by'okwikiriza Kristo Yesu.
en: 24 And after certain days, when Felix came with his wife Drusilla, which was a Jewess, he sent for Paul, and heard him concerning the faith in Christ.

rr: 25 Ku yaabaire naagamba aha by'okuhikiirira n'eby'okwerinda n'eby'orubanja oruriija, Felikisi yaatiina munonga, yaagira ati: Hati rekera aho! Ku ndibona omwanya, ndyakweta.
en: 25 And as he reasoned of righteousness, temperance, and judgment to come, Felix trembled, and answered, Go thy way for this time; when I have a convenient season, I will call for thee.

rr: 26 Kandi akaba aine amatsiko ngu Paulo aryamuha enguzi. Nikyo yaabaire amwetera kaingi kugaaniira nawe.
en: 26 He hoped also that money should have been given him of Paul, that he might loose him: wherefore he sent for him the oftener, and communed with him.

rr: 27 Kwonka ku haahingwireho emyaka ebiri, Felikisi yaahungurirwa Porokio Festo; kandi Felikisi, ahabw'okwenda kusiimwa Abayudaaya, yaatsiga Paulo omu kihome.
en: 27 But after two years Porcius Festus came into Felix' room: and Felix, willing to shew the Jews a pleasure, left Paul bound.

rr: 1 Festo ku yaahikire omu butegyeki bwe, bwanyima y'ebiro bishatu yaaruga Kaisarea, yainamuka Yerusaalemu.
en: 1 Now when Festus was come into the province, after three days he ascended from Cæsarea to Jerusalem.

rr: 2 Abanyamurwa abakuru n'abakuru b'Abayudaaya baamuregyera Paulo
en: 2 Then the high priest and the chief of the Jews informed him against Paul, and besought him,
3 and desired favour against him, that he would send for him to Jerusalem, laying wait in the way to kill him.

rr: 4 Kwonka Festo yaagarukamu ati: Paulo arindiirwe Kaisarea, kandi niinyenda kugarukayo juba.
en: 4 But Festus answered, that Paul should be kept at Cæsarea, and that he himself would depart shortly thither .

rr: 5 Yaagaruka yaagira ati: N'ahabw'ekyo abakuru omuriimwe bashuume tugyendane; omushaija ogwo ku araabe aine ekibi eki yaakozire, bamutabaarize.
en: 5 Let them therefore, said he, which among you are able, go down with me , and accuse this man, if there be any wickedness in him.

rr: 6 Ku yaamazire owaabo ebiro ebitarikukira ahari munaana nari ikumi, yaashuuma Kaisarea; ku bwaseesire, yaashutama aha kitebe ky'eiramuriro, yaaragiira kureeta Paulo.
en: 6 And when he had tarried among them more than ten days, he went down unto Cæsarea; and the next day sitting on the judgment seat commanded Paul to be brought.

rr: 7 Ku yaizire, Abayudaaya abarugire Yerusaalemu baayemerera bamwehinguririize, nibamutabaariza emanja nyingi ez'eihano, ezi batarabaasize kuhamya mu mazima.
en: 7 And when he was come, the Jews which came down from Jerusalem stood round about, and laid many and grievous complaints against Paul, which they could not prove.

rr: 8 Paulo yaayetonganira ati: Tihariho kibi eki naakozire okushobya ebiragiro by'Abayudaaya, nari okushiisha hekalu, nari okugomera Kaisaari.
en: 8 While he answered for himself, Neither against the law of the Jews, neither against the temple, nor yet against Cæsar, have I offended any thing at all.

rr: 9 Kwonka Festo, ku yaayenzire kusiimwa Abayudaaya, yaamubuuza ati: Nooyenda kwinamuka Yerusaalemu, ngu obe niyo waacwererwa emanja ezi omu maisho gangye?
en: 9 But Festus, willing to do the Jews a pleasure, answered Paul, and said, Wilt thou go up to Jerusalem, and there be judged of these things before me?

rr: 10 Paulo yaagarukamu ati: Nyemereire omu maisho g'ekitebe ky'eiramuriro ekya Kaisaari; niho nshemereire kucwererwa orubanja. Aha Bayudaaya tihariho kibi eki naakozire, kandi naiwe nookimanya gye.
en: 10 Then said Paul, I stand at Cæsar's judgment seat, where I ought to be judged: to the Jews have I done no wrong, as thou very well knowest.

rr: 11 Ku ndaabe nkozire kubi, nari shi nkozire ekishemereire kuunyitsa, tindikwanga kufa; kwonka omuri ebyo ebi barikuntabaariza, ku haraabe hatarimu na kimwe ekihikire, tihariho muntu orikubaasa kubampa.
en: 11 For if I be an offender, or have committed any thing worthy of death, I refuse not to die: but if there be none of these things whereof these accuse me, no man may deliver me unto them.

rr: Ninjurira ahari Kaisaari.
en: I appeal unto Cæsar.

rr: 12 Festo, ku yaaherize kuhanuura n'ab'eishengyeo rye, yaagira ati: Waajurira ahari Kaisaari; owa Kaisaari obe niyo waaza.
en: 12 Then Festus, when he had conferred with the council, answered, Hast thou appealed unto Cæsar? unto Cæsar shalt thou go.

rr: 13 Bwanyima ku haahingwireho ebiro, Aguripa omugabe na Bereniike baahika Kaisarea, baaramutsya Festo.
en: 13 And after certain days king Agrippa and Bernice came unto Cæsarea to salute Festus.

rr: 14 Ku baamazireyo ebiro bingi, Festo yaateekyerereza omugabe orubanja rwa Paulo, naagira ati: Hariho omushaija ou Felikisi yaatsigire omu kihome.
en: 14 And when they had been there many days, Festus declared Paul's cause unto the king, saying, There is a certain man left in bonds by Felix:

rr: 15 Ku naabaire ndi Yerusaalemu, abanyamurwa abakuru n'abakuru b'Abayudaaya banteekyerereza ebye, nibanshaba kumucwera orubanja.
en: 15 about whom, when I was at Jerusalem, the chief priests and the elders of the Jews informed me , desiring to have judgment against him.

rr: 16 Naabagarukamu nti: Timucwe gw'Abarooma kuhayo omuntu oregirwe, atakeemereire n'abarikumurega, akaheebwa omwanya gw'okwetonganira ebi bamuregire.
en: 16 To whom I answered, It is not the manner of the Romans to deliver any man to die, before that he which is accused have the accusers face to face, and have licence to answer for himself concerning the crime laid against him.

rr: 17 N'ahabw'ekyo ku baateeraniire aha, tinaabiraariza; ku bwaseesire, naashutama aha kitebe ky'eiramuriro, naaragiira kureeta ogwo mushaija.
en: 17 Therefore, when they were come hither, without any delay on the morrow I sat on the judgment seat, and commanded the man to be brought forth.

rr: 18 Baakitabaaza ku baayemereire, tibaareeta rubanja rw'ebigambo bibi, nk'oku naabaire ninteekateeka
en: 18 Against whom when the accusers stood up, they brought none accusation of such things as I supposed:
19 but had certain questions against him of their own superstition, and of one Jesus, which was dead, whom Paul affirmed to be alive.

rr: 20 Ku naashobeirwe, naabura kwetegyereza empaka ezo, naamubuuza ku araabe naayenda kwinamuka Yerusaalemu, n'okucwererwayo orubanja rw'ezo mpaka.
en: 20 And because I doubted of such manner of questions, I asked him whether he would go to Jerusalem, and there be judged of these matters.

rr: 21 Kwonka Paulo ku yaashabire kwemereza orubanja okuhitsya obu ruricuubwa Augusto, naaragiira ngu bamurinde, okuhitsya obu ndimwoherereza Kaisaari.
en: 21 But when Paul had appealed to be reserved unto the hearing of Augustus, I commanded him to be kept till I might send him to Cæsar.
22 Then Agrippa said unto Festus, I would also hear the man myself. To morrow, said he, thou shalt hear him.

rr: 23 Ku bwaseesire, Aguripa na Bereniike baija n'ekitiinisa kingi, baataaha omu iramuriro n'abakuru b'engabo n'abakungu b'orurembo. Festo yaaragiira ku bareeta Paulo.
en: 23 And on the morrow, when Agrippa was come, and Bernice, with great pomp, and was entered into the place of hearing, with the chief captains, and principal men of the city, at Festus' commandment Paul was brought forth.

24 And Festus said, King Agrippa, and all men which are here present with us, ye see this man, about whom all the multitude of the Jews have dealt with me, both at Jerusalem, and also here, crying that he ought not to live any longer.

rr: 25 Kwonka nkareeba atakozire kibi ekishemereire kumwitsa; kandi nawe ku yaajuriire ahari Augusto, naamariirira kumumutwekyera.
en: 25 But when I found that he had committed nothing worthy of death, and that he himself hath appealed to Augustus, I have determined to send him.

rr: 26 Mbwenu mbuzire ekigambo kihikire ahariwe eky'okuhandiikira mukama wangye.
en: 26 Of whom I have no certain thing to write unto my lord.

rr: Nikyo naamureetera omu maisho gaanyu, n'okukira munonga omu maisho gaawe, Nyakusinga Aguripa, ngu ku turaaheze kumutonganisa, mbone eky'okuhandiika.
en: Wherefore I have brought him forth before you, and specially before thee, O king Agrippa, that, after examination had, I might have somewhat to write.

rr: 27 Ahakuba ninteekateeka ngu n'eky'obushema kwohereza embohe, haza ntoorekye rubanja rwe.
en: 27 For it seemeth to me unreasonable to send a prisoner, and not withal to signify the crimes laid against him.

rr: 1 Aguripa yaagambira Paulo ati: Noikirizibwa kwetonganira. Paulo yaimutsya omukono, yaayetonganira naagira ati
en: 1 Then Agrippa said unto Paul, Thou art permitted to speak for thyself.

rr: 2 Nyakusinga Aguripa, naahiirwa ahakuba ebi naatabaariziibwe Abayudaaya byona niiwe naaza kubitonganaho
en: 2 I think myself happy, king Agrippa, because I shall answer for myself this day before thee touching all the things whereof I am accused of the Jews:

rr: 3 kandi okukira munonga ahabw'okuba noomanyira kimwe emicwe yoona n'empaka zoona eby'Abayudaaya; n'ahabw'ekyo ninkweshengyereza ogumisirize ompurire.
en: 3 especially because I know thee to be expert in all customs and questions which are among the Jews: wherefore I beseech thee to hear me patiently.

rr: 4 Okwiha omu buto bwangye emicwe yangye, ei naakuriiremu omu ihanga ryaitu na Yerusaalemu, Abayudaaya boona nibagimanya.
en: 4 My manner of life from my youth, which was at the first among mine own nation at Jerusalem, know all the Jews;
5 which knew me from the beginning, if they would testify, that after the most straitest sect of our religion I lived a Pharisee.

rr: 6 Mbwenu nyemereire aha kucwerwa orubanja ahabw'amatsiko ag'eki Ruhanga yaaraganiise baatatenkuriitwe
en: 6 And now I stand and am judged for the hope of the promise made of God unto our fathers:

rr: 7 kandi n'enganda zaitu ikumi na ibiri, ezirikwezirika kuheereza Ruhanga nyomushana na nyekiro, nazo nikyo zitegyereize kuhikaho.
en: 7 unto which promise our twelve tribes, instantly serving God day and night, hope to come.

rr: Kandi naanye, ahabw'amatsiko ago, nikyo ntabaaririziibwe Abayudaaya, Nyakusinga Aguripa!
en: For which hope's sake, king Agrippa, I am accused of the Jews.

rr: 8 N'enki ekirikubateekateekyesa ekigambo eki ku kitarikubaasika Ruhanga kuzoora abafiire?
en: 8 Why should it be thought a thing incredible with you, that God should raise the dead?
9 I verily thought with myself, that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth.

rr: 10 N'okukora nkabikora Yerusaalemu; naata abarikwera baingi omu bihome, mpairwe obushoboorozi abanyamurwa abakuru; t'ekyo kyonka, kandi n'abaabaire baitwa, nkaba nsiima ngu baitwe.
en: 10 Which thing I also did in Jerusalem: and many of the saints did I shut up in prison, having received authority from the chief priests; and when they were put to death, I gave my voice against them .

rr: 11 Kaingi omuri sinagogi zoona nkaba mbaha ebiheneso, mbagyemesereza kurogota; kandi ku naabaire mbagirira ekiniga kunshaza, mbahiiga nangwa n'okuhika mpika omu ndembo z'Abanyamahanga.
en: 11 And I punished them oft in every synagogue, and compelled them to blaspheme; and being exceedingly mad against them, I persecuted them even unto strange cities.

rr: 12 Mbwenu ku naabaire ninza Damasiko nyine obushoboorozi n'obutumwa bw'abanyamurwa abakuru
en: 12 Whereupon as I went to Damascus with authority and commission from the chief priests,

rr: 13 Nyakusinga Omugabe, nkiri omu muhanda omu ihangwe, naareeba omushana niguruga omu iguru, nigumurinkana okukira eizooba, gwanjwera guunyehinguririize n'abo abu twagyendaine.
en: 13 at midday, O king, I saw in the way a light from heaven, above the brightness of the sun, shining round about me and them which journeyed with me.

rr: 14 Ku twagwire ahansi twena, naahurira eiraka niringambira omu Ruheburaayo riti: Saulo, Saulo, ompiigira ki? Nooyerusya kuteera emigyere aha mihunda.
en: 14 And when we were all fallen to the earth, I heard a voice speaking unto me, and saying in the Hebrew tongue, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me? it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.

rr: 15 Naamubuuza nti: Ori oha, Mukama wangye? Mukama waitu yaagira ati: Ndi Yesu ou orikuhiiga.
en: 15 And I said, Who art thou, Lord? And he said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest.

rr: 16 Kwonka imuka, oyemerere; ahakuba nikyo naakubonekyerera, ngu nkutoorane nkugire omuheereza na kareebi w'okuhamya ebi ebi wandeeberamu, n'ebindi ebi ndikweyorekyeramu
en: 16 But rise, and stand upon thy feet: for I have appeared unto thee for this purpose, to make thee a minister and a witness both of these things which thou hast seen, and of those things in the which I will appear unto thee;
17 delivering thee from the people, and from the Gentiles, unto whom now I send thee,

18 to open their eyes, and to turn them from darkness to light, and from the power of Satan unto God, that they may receive forgiveness of sins, and inheritance among them which are sanctified by faith that is in me.
19 Whereupon, O king Agrippa, I was not disobedient unto the heavenly vision:

rr: 20 naatandikira aho kugambira aba Damasiko, bwanyima aba Yerusaalemu n'ab'omu ishaza ryona erya Buyudaaya, kandi n'Abanyamahanga, ngu beeteise, bahindukire Ruhanga, bakore ebishemereire okweteisa kwabo.
en: 20 but shewed first unto them of Damascus, and at Jerusalem, and throughout all the coasts of Judæa, and then to the Gentiles, that they should repent and turn to God, and do works meet for repentance.

rr: 21 Nikyo Abayudaaya bankwatiire ndi omuri hekalu, bakenda kuunyita.
en: 21 For these causes the Jews caught me in the temple, and went about to kill me .
22 Having therefore obtained help of God, I continue unto this day, witnessing both to small and great, saying none other things than those which the prophets and Moses did say should come:

rr: 23 bati: Kristo ashemereire kubonabonesibwa; kandi ahabw'okuba ow'okubanza kuzooka omu bafu, amanyise eihanga eri n'Abanyamahanga eby'omushana.
en: 23 that Christ should suffer, and that he should be the first that should rise from the dead, and should shew light unto the people, and to the Gentiles.
