rr: Nitwinamuka hi? Beene waitu batumazire omutima omunda nibagira bati: Abo bantu ni bahango kandi ni baraingwa nibatukira; endembo zaabo ni mpango, kandi zeehinguririziibwe engo ezizitiire okuhika ahaiguru munonga; kandi tureebireyo beene Anaki.
en: Whither shall we go up? our brethren have discouraged our heart, saying, The people is greater and taller than we; the cities are great and walled up to heaven; and moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakims there.

rr: Naanye nikwo kubagumya nimbagira nti: Mutagira obwoba, kandi mutabatiina.
en: Then I said unto you, Dread not, neither be afraid of them.

rr: MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu orikubeebembera niwe araabarwanirire, nk'ebi yaabakoreire omuri Misri byona nimureeba, oku byabaire biri
en: The LORD your God which goeth before you, he shall fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes;

rr: kandi n'omu ihamba ahu mwareebeire oku MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu yaabaheekire, omu muhanda gwona ogu mwarabiremu okuhika aha, nk'oku omuntu aheeka omwana we.
en: and in the wilderness, where thou hast seen how that the LORD thy God bare thee, as a man doth bear his son, in all the way that ye went, until ye came into this place.

rr: Kwonka n'obu ndaabe naabagambiire ekyo, timuraikiriize MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu
en: Yet in this thing ye did not believe the LORD your God,

rr: owaabeebembeire omu muhanda kubasherurira omwanya gw'okuteeramu amahema gaanyu, ari omu muriro nyekiro n'omu kicu nyomushana, kubahabura omuhanda ogu muraatooremu.
en: who went in the way before you, to search you out a place to pitch your tents in , fire by night, to shew you by what way ye should go, and in a cloud by day.

rr: MUKAMA yaahurira ebigambo byanyu, yaagira ekiniga, yaarahira ati
en: And the LORD heard the voice of your words, and was wroth, and sware, saying,

rr: Buzimazima tihariho n'omwe omuri aba bantu ab'obusingye obu obubi orireeba egyo nsi nungi ei naarahiire kuha baashwenkuriimwe
en: Surely there shall not one of these men of this evil generation see that good land, which I sware to give unto your fathers,

rr: kureka Kalebu mwene Yefune niwe arigireeba; kandi ensi ei yaaribatsiremu ndyagimuha n'abaana be, ahabw'okuba kakuratirira kimwe MUKAMA.
en: save Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, and to him will I give the land that he hath trodden upon, and to his children, because he hath wholly followed the LORD .

rr: Kandi naanye MUKAMA akangwerwa kubi ahabwanyu, yaagira ati: Naiwe torigihikamu.
en: Also the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, saying, Thou also shalt not go in thither.

rr: Kwonka Yoshua mwene Nuuni, omuheereza waawe niwe aritaahamu; omugumye, ahakuba niwe arihunguza Abaisraeli egyo nsi.
en: But Joshua the son of Nun, which standeth before thee, he shall go in thither: encourage him: for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.

rr: Kandi abaana baanyu abato abu mwagizire ngu baryaba eminyago, n'abaana baanyu abatakamanyire kirungi nari kibi, nibo barigitaahamu, kandi nibo ndigiha bakagikubuura.
en: Moreover your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, and your children, which in that day had no knowledge between good and evil, they shall go in thither, and unto them will I give it, and they shall possess it.

rr: Kwonka imwe muhindukye mugarukye omu ihamba, mutoore omuhanda ogurikuza aha Nyanja erikutukura.
en: But as for you, turn you, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.

rr: Bwanyima mwangarukamu nimugira muti: Tucumwire ahari MUKAMA; nitwija kwinamuka, turwane nk'ebi MUKAMA Ruhanga waitu yaaturagiire byona oku biri.
en: Then ye answered and said unto me, We have sinned against the LORD , we will go up and fight, according to all that the LORD our God commanded us.

rr: Buri omuntu weena omuriimwe yaahagatira eby'okurwanisa bye, mwateekateeka ngu nikirahuka kwinamuka omu nsi y'ebibungo.
en: And when ye had girded on every man his weapons of war, ye were ready to go up into the hill.

rr: MUKAMA yangira ati: Obangirire oti: Mutainamuka, kandi mutarwana; ahakuba tindi muriimwe, mutakaitwa bazigu baanyu.
en: And the LORD said unto me, Say unto them, Go not up, neither fight; for I am not among you; lest ye be smitten before your enemies.

rr: Ntyo naabibagambira, kwonka timwabihurira, mwagomera ekiragiro kya MUKAMA, mwainamuka n'ekigaazo omuri egyo nsi y'ebibungo.
en: So I spake unto you; and ye would not hear, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD , and went presumptuously up into the hill.

rr: Abaamori abaabaire bagitwiremu baija kubarwanisa, baababinga nk'enjoki, baabaitira Seiri, baabahitsya Horuma.
en: And the Amorites, which dwelt in that mountain, came out against you, and chased you, as bees do, and destroyed you in Seir, even unto Hormah.

rr: Mwagaruka, mwarira omu maisho ga MUKAMA; kwonka MUKAMA tiyaabeetaho n'obu kwakuba okubatega okutu.
en: And ye returned and wept before the LORD ; but the LORD would not hearken to your voice, nor give ear unto you.

rr: Mutyo mwamara ebiro bingi muri Kadeshi, nk'ebiro ebi mwamazireyo oku byabaire nibiingana.
en: So ye abode in Kadesh many days, according unto the days that ye abode there .

Bwanyima twahinduka, twaimutsya orugyendo nituza omu ihamba, twatoora omuhanda ogurikuza aha Nyanja erikutukura, nk'oku MUKAMA yandagiire; twamara ebiro bingi nitwehinguririza orushozi Seiri.
en: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea, as the LORD spake unto me: and we compassed mount Seir many days.

rr: MUKAMA yangira ati
en: And the LORD spake unto me, saying,

rr: Omwanya ogu mumazire nimwehinguririza oru rushozi ni muhango munonga; mukiikame mutoore aha bukiizi-bwa-bumosho.
en: Ye have compassed this mountain long enough: turn you northward.

rr: Kandi oragiire abantu oti: Mwaza kuraba omu nsi ya beene waanyu aba Esau, abatwire Seiri; bo baryabatiina; n'ahabw'ekyo mwerinde munonga
en: And command thou the people, saying, Ye are to pass through the coast of your brethren the children of Esau, which dwell in Seir; and they shall be afraid of you: take ye good heed unto yourselves therefore:

rr: 2 mutaribarwanisa; ahakuba tindibaha ha nsi yaabo, n'obu haakuba ah'okuribata ekigyere; ahabw'okuba nkaha Esau orushozi Seiri kuba orwe.
en: meddle not with them; for I will not give you of their land, no, not so much as a foot breadth; because I have given mount Seir unto Esau for a possession.

rr: Muryaguma mubashakyemu eby'okurya, mubone kurya, kandi mugure nabo amaizi, mubone kunywa.
en: Ye shall buy meat of them for money, that ye may eat; and ye shall also buy water of them for money, that ye may drink.

rr: Ahakuba MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe akakuha omugisha omu mirimo yoona ey'emikono yaawe, yaamanya engyendo zaawe ez'omuri eri ihamba rihango; kandi emyaka egi yoona makumi ana MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe agumire naiwe, otaine ki obuzire.
en: For the LORD thy God hath blessed thee in all the works of thy hand: he knoweth thy walking through this great wilderness: these forty years the LORD thy God hath been with thee; thou hast lacked nothing.

rr: Tutyo twagumizamu, twayetantara beene waitu aba Esau, abatwire Seiri, twayetantara n'omuhanda ogurikuraba Araba niguruga Elaasi na Ezionigeberi; twakuba, twatoora omuhanda ogurikuza omu ihamba rya Moabu.
en: And when we passed by from our brethren the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, through the way of the plain from Elath, and from Ezion-gaber, we turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.

rr: MUKAMA yangira ati: Mutarahura Abamoabu, mukabarwanisa; ahakuba tindibaha buhunguzi mu nsi yaabo, ahabw'okuba nkaha aba Looti ensi ya Aari kuba eyaabo.
en: And the LORD said unto me, Distress not the Moabites, neither contend with them in battle: for I will not give thee of their land for a possession; because I have given Ar unto the children of Lot for a possession.

rr: (Obunyakare aba Emimu bakaba batwireyo, n'eihanga ry'amaani ery'abantu baingi kandi baraingwa nk'aba Anaki
en: The Emims dwelt therein in times past, a people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims;

rr: kandi bakaba nibeetwa aba Reefa nk'aba Anaki; kwonka Abamoabu bakabeeta aba Emimu.
en: which also were accounted giants, as the Anakims; but the Moabites call them Emims.

rr: Kandi obunyakare Abahoori nabo bakaba batwire Seiri, baabanyaga, baabaita, baatuura omu nsi yaabo, nk'Abaisraeli oku baakubwire ensi yaabo ei MUKAMA yaabahaire.)
en: The Horims also dwelt in Seir beforetime; but the children of Esau succeeded them, when they had destroyed them from before them, and dwelt in their stead; as Israel did unto the land of his possession, which the LORD gave unto them.

rr: MUKAMA yaagaruka yaagira ati: Mbwenu mwimukye, mwambukye akagyera Zeredi. Ako kagyera Zeredi twakambuka.
en: Now rise up, said I , and get you over the brook Zered. And we went over the brook Zered.

rr: Emyaka ei twamazire okwiha obu twaruga Kadeshi-barunea okuhitsya obu twayambukire ako kagyera Zeredi, ekahika makumi ashatu na munaana; okuhitsya obu abarwani boona ab'obusingye obwo baahwereire kimwe omu nsiisira zaitu, nk'oku MUKAMA yaabagambiire naarahira.
en: And the space in which we came from Kadesh-barnea, until we were come over the brook Zered, was thirty and eight years; until all the generation of the men of war were wasted out from among the host, as the LORD sware unto them.

rr: -19 ; 4:1-5 . Buzimazima omukono gwa MUKAMA gukabarwanisa okubahwerekyerereza omu nsiisira zaitu, okuhitsya obu baahweireho.
en: For indeed the hand of the LORD was against them, to destroy them from among the host, until they were consumed.

rr: Bwanyima abarwani boona ku baaherize kufa, baahwa omu bantu
en: So it came to pass, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,

rr: MUKAMA yangira ati
en: that the LORD spake unto me, saying,

rr: Eri izooba nimwija kuraba omuri Aari, mucwekanise omwatano gwa Moabu
en: Thou art to pass over through Ar, the coast of Moab, this day:

rr: kandi ku oraahikye haihi n'Abaamoni, otabarahura, n'obu kwakuba okubarwanisa; ahakuba tindikuha buhunguzi omu nsi y'Abaamoni, ahabw'okuba nkagiha aba Looti kuba eyaabo. (
en: and when thou comest nigh over against the children of Ammon, distress them not, nor meddle with them: for I will not give thee of the land of the children of Ammon any possession; because I have given it unto the children of Lot for a possession.

rr: Ensi egyo nayo neeyetwa ey'aba Reefa; obunyakare aba Reefa bakaba bagitwiremu; kwonka Abaamoni hati nibabeeta Abazamuzumi
en: (That also was accounted a land of giants: giants dwelt therein in old time; and the Ammonites call them Zamzummims;

rr: rikaba riri eihanga ry'amaani, ery'abantu baingi kandi baraingwa nk'aba Anaki; kwonka MUKAMA akabacwekyerereza omu maisho g'Abaamoni, baabanyaga, baatuura omu nsi yaabo
en: a people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims; but the LORD destroyed them before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead:

rr: nk'oku yaagiriire aba Esau, abatwire Seiri, obu yaacwekyerereza aba Hoori omu maisho gaabo, bakabanyaga, bakatuura omu nsi yaabo n'okuhitsya hati.
en: as he did to the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, when he destroyed the Horims from before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead even unto this day:

rr: Kandi n'aba Avimu, abaabaire batwire omu birorero okuhika Gaaza, aba Kafutoori, abaarugire Kafutoori, bakabacwekyereza, baatuura omu nsi yaabo.)
en: and the Avims which dwelt in Hazerim, even unto Azzah, the Caphtorims, which came forth out of Caphtor, destroyed them, and dwelt in their stead.)

rr: MUKAMA yaagaruka yangira ati: Mwimukye mugyende, mwambukye oruhanga rwa Arunooni; reeba naahayo Sihooni Omuamori, omugabe wa Heshibooni, n'ensi ye omu mikono yaawe; otandikye kumurwanisa n'okukubuura ensi ye.
en: Rise ye up, take your journey, and pass over the river Arnon: behold, I have given into thine hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land: begin to possess it , and contend with him in battle.

rr: Eri izooba niinyija kwitsa amahanga agari ahansi y'eiguru obwoba n'okugatiinisa ahabwawe; nibaija kuhurira okurangaanwa kwawe, bateteme, bagire amaganya maingi ahabwawe.
en: This day will I begin to put the dread of thee and the fear of thee upon the nations that are under the whole heaven, who shall hear report of thee, and shall tremble, and be in anguish because of thee.

rr: Ku twabaire tukiri omu ihamba rya Kedemoosi, naatuma entumwa ahari Sihooni omugabe wa Heshibooni ebigambo by'obusingye, ningira nti
en: And I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth unto Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,

rr: Onyikirize, ndabe omu nsi yaawe; niinyija kutoora omuhanda rugyendwa, tindikwija kukiikama aha rubaju rwa buryo nari orwa bumosho.
en: Let me pass through thy land: I will go along by the high way, I will neither turn unto the right hand nor to the left.

rr: Eby'okurya oryabinguza nkuhe empiiha, mbone kurya; n'amaizi oganguze nkuhe empiiha, mbone kunywa; kwonka ondekye, ndabemu n'ebigyere
en: Thou shalt sell me meat for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink: only I will pass through on my feet;

rr: nk'aba Esau abatwire Seiri, n'Abamoabu abatwire Aari, oku bangiriire, okuhitsya obu ndyambuka Yorudani, nkahika omu nsi ei MUKAMA Ruhanga waitu arikutuha.
en: (as the children of Esau which dwell in Seir, and the Moabites which dwell in Ar, did unto me;) until I shall pass over Jordan into the land which the LORD our God giveth us.

rr: Kwonka Sihooni omugabe wa Heshibooni yaayanga kutureka kuraba omu nsi ye, ahakuba MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe akamugangaaza omutima, yaamutizya, ngu abone kumuhayo omu mukono gwawe, nk'oku kiri na hati.
en: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him: for the LORD thy God hardened his spirit, and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into thy hand, as appeareth this day.

rr: MUKAMA yangira ati: Reeba, naatandika kuhayo Sihooni n'ensi ye omumaisho gaawe; naiwe otandikye kugikubuura, obone kugihungura.
en: And the LORD said unto me, Behold, I have begun to give Sihon and his land before thee: begin to possess, that thou mayest inherit his land.

rr: Bwanyima Sihooni yaija n'engabo ze zoona kuturwanisiza ahari Yahazi.
en: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to fight at Jahaz.

rr: MUKAMA Ruhanga waitu yaamuhayo omu maisho gaitu, twamwita n'abatabani n'abantu be boona.
en: And the LORD our God delivered him before us; and we smote him, and his sons, and all his people.

rr: Omu bunaku obwo twakwata endembo ze zoona, twazicwekyerereza kimwe, abashaija, n'abakazi n'abaana; titwatsigamu na wa kizira.
en: And we took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed the men, and the women, and the little ones, of every city, we left none to remain:

rr: Kureka amatungo gonka nigo twayenyagiire hamwe n'ebi twanyagire omu ndembo ezi twakwatsire.
en: only the cattle we took for a prey unto ourselves, and the spoil of the cities which we took.

rr: Okuruga Aroeri eri aha rubaju rw'oruhanga rwa Arunooni, n'okuruga aha rurembo oruri omuri orwo ruhanga, okuhika Gileadi, tihaagira rurembo rwaturema ahabw'oburaingwa bwarwo. MUKAMA Ruhanga waitu yaazihayo zoona omu maisho gaitu.
en: From Aroer, which is by the brink of the river of Arnon, and from the city that is by the river, even unto Gilead, there was not one city too strong for us: the LORD our God delivered all unto us:

rr: Kwonka tiwaahika haihi n'ensi y'Abaamoni, n'obu haakuba aha nkungu z'omugyera Yaboki, nari endembo z'omu nsi y'ebibungo, n'ahandi hoona ahu MUKAMA Ruhanga waitu yaatuzibiire.
en: only unto the land of the children of Ammon thou camest not, nor unto any place of the river Jabbok, nor unto the cities in the mountains, nor unto whatsoever the LORD our God forbad us.

rr: Bwanyima twakuba, twatoora omuhanda ogurikwinamuka Bashani; Ogi omugabe wa Bashani yaija n'engabo ze zoona kuturwanisiza omuri Edurei.
en: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.

rr: MUKAMA yangira ati: Otamutiina; ahakuba naamuhayo n'abantu be boona n'ensi ye omu mukono gwawe; omugire nk'oku waagizire Sihooni omugabe w'Abaamori owaabaire atwire Heshibooni.
en: And the LORD said unto me, Fear him not: for I will deliver him, and all his people, and his land, into thy hand; and thou shalt do unto him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.

rr: Atyo MUKAMA Ruhanga waitu yaahayo na Ogi omugabe wa Bashani n'abantu be boona omu mikono yaitu; twabaita, tiyaahonoraho n'omwe.
en: So the LORD our God delivered into our hands Og also, the king of Bashan, and all his people: and we smote him until none was left to him remaining.

rr: Omu bunaku obwo twakwata endembo ze zoona; tihaatsigaraho rurembo na rumwe oru tutarabanyagire – endembo makumi mukaaga, ekyaro kyona ekya Arugoobi, obugabe bwa Ogi omuri Bashani.
en: And we took all his cities at that time, there was not a city which we took not from them, threescore cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

rr: Ezo zoona zikaba ziri endembo ezizitiire n'engo ndaingwa, ziine amarembo g'enyigi ezirikukingwa empimbi, otabariireho birorero bingi munonga ebitaine ngo.
en: All these cities were fenced with high walls, gates, and bars; beside unwalled towns a great many.

rr: Twazicwekyerereza kimwe, nk'oku twagizire Sihooni omugabe wa Heshibooni, nitucwekyereza buri rurembo, abashaija n'abakazi n'abaana.
en: And we utterly destroyed them, as we did unto Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying the men, women, and children, of every city.

rr: Kwonka amatungo goona, n'ebi twanyagire omu rurembo, twabyetwarira kuba eminyago.
en: But all the cattle, and the spoil of the cities, we took for a prey to ourselves.

rr: Tutyo omuri obwo bunaku twakubuura ensi z'abo bagabe b'Abaamori bombi, abaabaire batwire seenu ya Yorudani, okwiha aha ruhanga rwa Arunooni, okuhika aha rushozi Herumooni
en: And we took at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites the land that was on this side Jordan, from the river of Arnon unto mount Hermon;

rr: (orwo rushozi Herumooni Abasidoni bakaba barweta Sirioni, n'Abaamori barweta Seniiri;)
en: ( which Hermon the Sidonians call Sirion; and the Amorites call it Shenir;)

rr: kandi twakwata endembo zoona ez'omu ruhita, na Gileadi yoona, na Bashani yoona okuhika Saleka n'omuri Edurei, endembo z'omu bugabe bwa Ogi omuri Bashani.
en: all the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, unto Salchah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

rr: (Ahabw'okuba Ogi omugabe wa Bashani niwe wenka owaabaire akiriho omu ba Reefa abaatsigaireho; ekitanda kye kikaba kiri ky'ebyoma; tikiri omuri Rabba ey'Abaamoni? Oburaingwa bwakyo bukaba buri mikono mwenda, n'obuhango bwakyo mikono ena, nk'orugyero rw'abantu orwa mukono gumwe oku ruri.)
en: For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of giants; behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron; is it not in Rabbath of the children of Ammon? nine cubits was the length thereof, and four cubits the breadth of it, after the cubit of a man.

rr: Ku twakubwire egyo nsi omu bunaku obwo, naaha aba Reubeeni n'aba Gaadi ekyanga ekirikutandikira Aroeri eri aha rubaju rw'oruhanga rwa Arunooni n'ekicweka ky'ensi y'ebibungo ya Gileadi n'endembo zaamwo.
en: And this land, which we possessed at that time, from Aroer, which is by the river Arnon, and half mount Gilead, and the cities thereof, gave I unto the Reubenites and to the Gadites.

rr: Ekicweka kya Gileadi ekyatsigaireho na Bashani yoona, obugabe bwa Ogi, naabiha ekicweka ky'oruganda rwa Manaase, ekyanga kyona kya Arugoobi, niyo Bashani yoona. (Egyo nsi ekaba neeyetwa ensi y'aba Reefa.
en: And the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, being the kingdom of Og, gave I unto the half tribe of Manasseh; all the region of Argob, with all Bashan, which was called the land of giants.

rr: Yairi mwene Manaase yaatwara ekyaro kyona ekya Arugoobi, niyo Bashani, okuhika aha mwatano gw'aba Geshuri n'aba Maakasi, yaakyeyeterera, kyayetwa Havosi-yairi n'okuhitsya hati.)
en: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the country of Argob unto the coasts of Geshuri and Maachathi; and called them after his own name, Bashan-havoth-jair, unto this day.

rr: Kandi naaha Makiri Gileadi.
en: And I gave Gilead unto Machir.

rr: Aba Reubeeni n'aba Gaadi naabaha okuruga ahari Gileadi okuhika aha ruhanga rwa Arunooni, omwatano gwayo gwaraba ahagati y'orwo ruhanga, gwahika aha mugyera Yaboki, ogurikubaatanisa n'Abaamoni
en: And unto the Reubenites and unto the Gadites I gave from Gilead even unto the river Arnon half the valley, and the border even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;

rr: kandi naabaha Araba, omwatano gwayo gwaba Yorudani, okuruga Kinereesi okuhika aha nyanja ya Araba, niyo Nyanja y'Omwonyo, ahansi y'orushozi Pisiga aha rubaju rw'oburugwa-izooba.
en: the plain also, and Jordan, and the coast thereof , from Chinnereth even unto the sea of the plain, even the salt sea, under Ashdoth-pisgah eastward.

rr: Omu bunaku obwo nkabaragiira, ningira nti: MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu abahaire ensi egi kugikubuura; abashaija baanyu amamanzi baryayambuka bakwaitse eby'okurwanisa beebembeire beene waanyu Abaisraeli.
en: And I commanded you at that time, saying, The LORD your God hath given you this land to possess it: ye shall pass over armed before your brethren the children of Israel, all that are meet for the war.

rr: Kwonka abakazi baanyu n'abaana baanyu n'amatungo gaanyu, – (nimmanya ku mwine amatungo maingi) biryaguma omu ndembo zaanyu, ezi naabahaire
en: But your wives, and your little ones, and your cattle, ( for I know that ye have much cattle,) shall abide in your cities which I have given you;

rr: okuhitsya obu MUKAMA ariha beene waanyu okuhuumura, nk'oku yaakubahaire, nabo bakakubuura ensi ei MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu arikubaha seeri ya Yorudani; bwanyima muryagaruka buri muntu omu butaka bwe obu mbahaire.
en: until the LORD have given rest unto your brethren, as well as unto you, and until they also possess the land which the LORD your God hath given them beyond Jordan: and then shall ye return every man unto his possession, which I have given you.

rr: Omu bunaku obwo nkaragiira Yoshua ningira nti: Amaisho gaawe geereebeire byona ebi MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu akozire abo bagabe bombi; kandi nikwo MUKAMA arigira obugabe bwona omu nsi ei murikwambukamu.
en: And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, Thine eyes have seen all that the LORD your God hath done unto these two kings: so shall the LORD do unto all the kingdoms whither thou passest.

rr: Mutaribatiina; ahabw'okuba MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu niwe abarwanirira.
en: Ye shall not fear them: for the LORD your God he shall fight for you.

rr: Omu bunaku obwo nkeeshengyereza MUKAMA ningira nti
en: And I besought the LORD at that time, saying,

rr: -21 ; . Ai Mukama RUHANGA, otandikire kworeka omwiru waawe obukuru bwawe n'omukono gwawe ogw'amaani; ahakuba ni ruhanga ki omu iguru nari aha nsi, orikubaasa kukora emirimo nk'eyaawe, kandi n'eby'amaani ebi waakozire oku biri?
en: O Lord GOD , thou hast begun to shew thy servant thy greatness, and thy mighty hand: for what God is there in heaven or in earth, that can do according to thy works, and according to thy might?

rr: Ninkweshengyereza onyikirize nyambukye, ndeebe ensi egyo enungi eri seeri ya Yorudani, n'ebyo bibungo birungi na Lebanooni.
en: I pray thee, let me go over, and see the good land that is beyond Jordan, that goodly mountain, and Lebanon.

rr: Kwonka MUKAMA yangwerwa kubi ahabwanyu, tiyaanyikiriza; yangira ati: Rekyera aho, otagaruka kungambira ahari ekyo kigambo.
en: But the LORD was wroth with me for your sakes, and would not hear me: and the LORD said unto me, Let it suffice thee; speak no more unto me of this matter.

rr: Inamuka oze aha mutwe gwa Pisiga, onagye amaisho oburengyerwa-izooba, n'aha bukiizi-bwa-bumosho, n'aha bwa buryo, n'oburugwa-izooba, oreebe n'amaisho gaawe; ahakuba toryambuka Yorudani egi.
en: Get thee up into the top of Pisgah, and lift up thine eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and behold it with thine eyes: for thou shalt not go over this Jordan.

rr: Kwonka oyehanangirize Yoshua, omwezirikise, omugumye; ahabw'okuba niwe aryambuka ayebembeire aba bantu, akabahunguza ensi ei oraareebe.
en: But charge Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him: for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which thou shalt see.

rr: Tutyo twaguma omu ruhanga orushungaine na Besi-peori.
en: So we abode in the valley over against Beth-peor.

rr: Mbwenu, Baisraeli 'mwe, muhurire ebiragiro ebyatairweho n'ebyaragiirwe, ebi ndikubeegyesa, mubyorobere, mubone kugumaho n'okutaaha omu nsi ei MUKAMA Ruhanga wa baashwenkuriimwe arikubaha, mugikubuure.
en: Now therefore hearken, O Israel, unto the statutes and unto the judgments, which I teach you, for to do them , that ye may live, and go in and possess the land which the LORD God of your fathers giveth you.

rr: Mutaryongyera aha kigambo eki ndikubaragiira, kandi mutarikicwaho, mubone kukwata ebiragiro bya MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu ebi ndikubaragiira.
en: Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall ye diminish ought from it, that ye may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you.

rr: Amaisho gaanyu gakeereebera ebi MUKAMA yaakozire ahabw'ebya Baali-peori; ahabw'okuba abashaija boona, abaakuratiire Baali-peori, MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe akabacwekyereza, yaabamara omuriimwe.
en: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did because of Baal-peor: for all the men that followed Baal-peor, the LORD thy God hath destroyed them from among you.

rr: Kwonka imwe, abahamiire ahari MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu, mukiriho mwena n'eri izooba.
en: But ye that did cleave unto the LORD your God are alive every one of you this day.

rr: Reeba, naabeegyesa ebiragiro ebyatairweho n'ebyaragiirwe, nk'oku MUKAMA Ruhanga wangye yandagiire, ngu mube nikwo mwatwaza omu nsi ei murikuza kukubuura.
en: Behold, I have taught you statutes and judgments, even as the LORD my God commanded me, that ye should do so in the land whither ye go to possess it.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo mugume mubikwate, mubyorobere; obwo nibwo bwengye bwanyu n'okwetegyereza kwanyu omu maisho g'amahanga agarihurira ebyo biragiro byona, gakagira gati: N'ekya buzima eri ihanga rikuru n'eihanga ry'abantu b'obwengye kandi abarikwetegyereza.
en: Keep therefore and do them ; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations, which shall hear all these statutes, and say, Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.

rr: Ni ihanga ki erikuru eriine ruhanga oriri haihi nka MUKAMA Ruhanga waitu oku atuba haihi, twamutakira?
en: For what nation is there so great, who hath God so nigh unto them, as the LORD our God is in all things that we call upon him for?

rr: Kandi ni ihanga ki erikuru eriine ebiragiro ebyatairweho n'ebyaragiirwe ebihikire nk'Ebiragiro ebi byona ebi naata omu maisho gaanyu eri izooba?
en: And what nation is there so great, that hath statutes and judgments so righteous as all this law, which I set before you this day?

rr: Kwonka oyerinde, oteho omutima orinde amagara gaawe, orekye kwebwa ebi amaisho gaawe gaareebire, bitarikuruga aha mutima ebiro byona ebi oriba okiriho; kureka obimanyise abaana baawe na baijukuru baawe.
en: Only take heed to thyself, and keep thy soul diligently, lest thou forget the things which thine eyes have seen, and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life: but teach them thy sons, and thy sons' sons;

rr: Ogume oijukye eizooba eri waayemerereireho omu maisho ga MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe ahari Horebu, obu MUKAMA yangira ati: Nteeranira abantu, mbagambire ebigambo byangye, babone kwega kuntiina ebiro byona ebi barimara omu nsi, kandi beegyese n'abaana baabo.
en: specially the day that thou stoodest before the LORD thy God in Horeb, when the LORD said unto me, Gather me the people together, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they shall live upon the earth, and that they may teach their children.

rr: Naimwe mwairira haihi, mwayemerera ahansi y'orushozi; orwo rushozi rwayaka omuriro, gwahika ahagati y'eiguru, rwashwekwa omwirima, n'ekicu, kandi omwirima ndindindi.
en: And ye came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire unto the midst of heaven, with darkness, clouds, and thick darkness.

rr: MUKAMA yaabagambira naayema omu muriro; mwahurira ebyagambwa, kwonka timwagira ki mwareeba, kureka eiraka ryonka.
en: And the LORD spake unto you out of the midst of the fire: ye heard the voice of the words, but saw no similitude; only ye heard a voice.

rr: Yaabagambira endagaano ye, ei yaabaragiire kuhitsya, nibyo biragiro ikumi; yaabihandiika aha bishate bibiri by'amabaare.
en: And he declared unto you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even ten commandments; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone.

rr: Omu bunaku obwo MUKAMA yandagiira kubeegyesa ebiragiro ebyatairweho n'ebyaragiirwe ngu mubone kubyoroberera omu nsi ei murikuza kukubuura.
en: And the LORD commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess it.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo mwerinde munonga. Nk'oku mutarareebire kishushani kyona ekya MUKAMA, obu yaabagambirira omu muriro ahari Horebu
en: Take ye therefore good heed unto yourselves; for ye saw no manner of similitude on the day that the LORD spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire:

rr: mwerinde mutakaashiisha, mukeekorera ekishushani ekirikushusha ekintu kyona, ekishushani ky'ekishaija nari eky'ekikazi
en: lest ye corrupt yourselves , and make you a graven image, the similitude of any figure, the likeness of male or female,

rr: ekishushani ky'enyamaishwa yoona eri omu nsi, nari eky'ekintu kyona ekiine amapapa ekirikuguruka omu mwanya
en: the likeness of any beast that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged fowl that flieth in the air,

rr: ekishushani ky'ekintu kyona ekirikugyendesa enda ahansi nari eky'eky'enyanja kyona ekiri omu maizi okuzimu.
en: the likeness of any thing that creepeth on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth:

rr: Kandi mwerinde, mutakaimutsya amaisho ahaiguru, mukireeba eizooba n'okwezi n'enyonyoozi, nigo mahe goona ag'omu iguru, mukabeihwabeihwa, mukabiramya, mukabiheereza, haza biri ebintu ebi MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe yaahaire amahanga goona agari ahansi y'eiguru.
en: and lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, shouldest be driven to worship them, and serve them, which the LORD thy God hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.

rr: Ahabw'okuba imwe nimumanya ku MUKAMA yaabakwatsire, akabashahura omu iziiko ry'ebyoma eririkubugumwamu omuriro, niyo Misri, kuba abantu be buzima, nk'oku muri na hati.
en: But the LORD hath taken you, and brought you forth out of the iron furnace, even out of Egypt, to be unto him a people of inheritance, as ye are this day.

rr: Kandi MUKAMA akangwerwa kubi ahabwanyu, yaarahira ku ntaryambuka Yorudani kuza omu nsi egyo enungi, ei MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe arikukuha kuba obuhunguzi.
en: Furthermore the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, and sware that I should not go over Jordan, and that I should not go in unto that good land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance:

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo nshemereire kufeera omu nsi egi; tinshemereire kwambuka Yorudani; kwonka imwe muryayambuka, mukubuure ensi egyo nungi.
en: but I must die in this land, I must not go over Jordan: but ye shall go over, and possess that good land.

rr: Mwerinde, mutaryebwa endagaano ya MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu, ei yaaragaine naimwe, mukeekorera ekishushani ekibaizire, ekirikushusha ekintu kyona, MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu eki yaabazibiire
en: Take heed unto yourselves, lest ye forget the covenant of the LORD your God, which he made with you, and make you a graven image, or the likeness of any thing , which the LORD thy God hath forbidden thee.

rr: ahakuba MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu n'omuriro ogurikurya busha, Ruhanga ow'eihato.
en: For the LORD thy God is a consuming fire, even a jealous God.

rr: Ku murizaara abaana, nabo baazaara abandi, mwamara omwanya muhango mutwire omu nsi egyo, bwanyima ku murishiisha, mwakora ekishushani ekibaizire, ekirikushusha ekintu kyona, mwakora ebirikwangwa MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu kumugwisa kubi
en: When thou shalt beget children, and children's children, and ye shall have remained long in the land, and shall corrupt yourselves , and make a graven image, or the likeness of any thing , and shall do evil in the sight of the LORD thy God, to provoke him to anger:

rr: eri izooba niinyeta eiguru n'ensi kuba baamushinja, kuhamya ku murihwerekyerera juba, mukahwa omu nsi ei muryambuka Yorudani kuza kukubuura; timurigimaramu mwanya muhango, kureka muryagicwekyerereramu kimwe.
en: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that ye shall soon utterly perish from off the land whereunto ye go over Jordan to possess it; ye shall not prolong your days upon it, but shall utterly be destroyed.

rr: MUKAMA aryabataataanisa, abanagye omu banyamahanga, mutsigare muri bakye omu mahanga, agu MUKAMA aribatwaramu.
en: And the LORD shall scatter you among the nations, and ye shall be left few in number among the heathen, whither the LORD shall lead you.

rr: Okwo muryaheererezayo baaruhanga abaakozirwe emikono y'abantu omu biti n'omu mabaare, abatarikureeba, abatarikuhurira, nari okurya, n'obu kwakuba okukaga.
en: And there ye shall serve gods, the work of men's hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.

rr: Kwonka okwo ku murisherurirayo MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu, muryamureeba, ku murimusherura n'omutima gwanyu gwona n'amagara gaanyu goona.
en: But if from thence thou shalt seek the LORD thy God, thou shalt find him , if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul.

rr: Ku origira obusaasi, ebyo byona byakuhikaho, omu biro bya bwanyima oryagarukira MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe, oyorobere eiraka rye
en: When thou art in tribulation, and all these things are come upon thee, even in the latter days, if thou turn to the LORD thy God, and shalt be obedient unto his voice;

rr: ahabw'okuba MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe ni Ruhanga orikusaasira; tarikuhemukaho, kandi tarikucwekyereza, n'obu kwakuba okwebwa endagaano ei yaaragaine na baashwenkuru naarahira.
en: (for the LORD thy God is a merciful God;) he will not forsake thee, neither destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them.

rr: Obuuze eby'ebiro ebyahingwire ebyakubandiize, okwiha aha kiro eki Ruhanga yaahangiireho omuntu omu nsi, kandi n'okuruga aha muheru gw'eiguru okuhika aha gundi, ku haraabe harabaireho ekintu kyona ekikuru nk'eki, nari ku haraabe harahuriirweho ekirikushushana nakyo.
en: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before thee, since the day that God created man upon the earth, and ask from the one side of heaven unto the other, whether there hath been any such thing as this great thing is , or hath been heard like it?

rr: Hariho abantu abarahuriire eiraka rya Ruhanga nirigambira omu muriro, nkaimwe oku mwarihuriire, bakagumaho bari abahuriire?
en: Did ever people hear the voice of God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as thou hast heard, and live?

rr: Nari shi hariho ruhanga orateireho kuza kwetwarira eihanga, naariihisa omu rindi ebigyezo n'obumanyiso n'eby'okutangaaza n'engamba n'omukono gw'amaani n'omukono ogubangire, kandi n'ebirikutiinisa munonga, nk'ebi MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu yaakoreire omuri Misri byona omu maisho gaanyu oku byabaire biri?
en: Or hath God assayed to go and take him a nation from the midst of another nation, by temptations, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by a stretched out arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?

rr: Niiwe waayorekirwe ebyo, ngu obone kumanya ku MUKAMA ari Ruhanga; ku hatariho ondiijo kureka We wenka.
en: Unto thee it was shewed, that thou mightest know that the LORD he is God; there is none else beside him.

rr: Akeema omu iguru, yaakuhuriza eiraka rye, ngu abone kukwegyesa; n'omu nsi yaakworeka omuriro gwe omwingi; kandi waahurira ebigambo bye nibigurugamu.
en: Out of heaven he made thee to hear his voice, that he might instruct thee: and upon earth he shewed thee his great fire; and thou heardest his words out of the midst of the fire.

rr: Kandi ahabw'okukunda baashwenkuru, nikyo yaatooraniire baijukuru baabo abaakuratsireho, akakweihira omuri Misri n'amaani ge maingi
en: And because he loved thy fathers, therefore he chose their seed after them, and brought thee out in his sight with his mighty power out of Egypt;

rr: ngu abingye amahanga agarikukukiza ekitiinisa n'amaani, garugye omu maisho gaawe, akutaasye omu nsi yaabo, agikuhe kuba obuhunguzi, nk'oku kiri n'eri izooba.
en: to drive out nations from before thee greater and mightier than thou art , to bring thee in, to give thee their land for an inheritance, as it is this day.

rr: Mbwenu eri izooba omanye eki kandi okite aha mutima, ku MUKAMA ari Ruhanga ori omu iguru ahaiguru n'omu nsi ahansi; tihariho ondiijo weena.
en: Know therefore this day, and consider it in thine heart, that the LORD he is God in heaven above, and upon the earth beneath: there is none else.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo ogume okwate ebiragiro bye ebyatairweho n'ebi yaaragiire, ebi ndikukuragiira eri izooba, obone kuba gye n'abaana baawe abarikurataho, n'okuhangaarira omu nsi, ei MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe arikukuha kuba eyaawe ebiro byona.
en: Thou shalt keep therefore his statutes, and his commandments, which I command thee this day, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, and that thou mayest prolong thy days upon the earth, which the LORD thy God giveth thee, for ever.

rr: Bwanyima Musa yaatoorana endembo ishatu aha rubaju rw'oburugwa-izooba seeri ya Yorudani
en: Then Moses severed three cities on this side Jordan toward the sun rising;

rr: ngu oriita omuntu weena ahungireyo, oriba aitsire mutaahi we, atamwitsire nkana, oshangirwe ataine buzigu nawe omu biro ebihingwire, akize amagara ge ahabw'okuhungira omu rurembo rumwe ahari ezo
en: that the slayer might flee thither, which should kill his neighbour unawares, and hated him not in times past; and that fleeing unto one of these cities he might live:

rr: endembo ezo nizo ezi–Bezeeri omu ihamba eriri omu nsi y'empita ahabw'aba Reubeeni, Ramosi omuri Gileadi ahabw'aba Gaadi, na Golani omuri Bashani ahabw'aba Manaase.
en: namely , Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, of the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, of the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, of the Manassites. This is the Law

rr: Ebi nibyo biragiro ebi Musa yaataire omu maisho g'Abaisraeli
en: And this is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel:

rr: n'ebirikuhamya, n'ebiragiro ebyatairweho, n'ebyaragiirwe, ebi Musa yaagambiire Abaisraeli obu baaruga Misri
en: these are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which Moses spake unto the children of Israel, after they came forth out of Egypt,

rr: bakiri seeri ya Yorudani omu ruhanga orushungaine na Besi-peori, omu nsi ya Sihooni omugabe w'Abaamori, owaabaire atwire Heshibooni, ou Musa n'Abaisraeli baitsire, obu baaruga Misri
en: on this side Jordan, in the valley over against Beth-peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel smote, after they were come forth out of Egypt:

rr: bakakubuura ensi ye n'eya Ogi omugabe wa Bashani, kandi abo nibo bagabe bombi b'Abaamori, abaabaire batwire seeri ya Yorudani aha rubaju rw'oburugwa-izooba
en: and they possessed his land, and the land of Og king of Bashan, two kings of the Amorites, which were on this side Jordan toward the sun rising;

rr: okuruga Aroeri eri aha rubaju rw'oruhanga rwa Arunooni okuhika aha rushozi Sioni (egyo niyo Herumooni)
en: from Aroer, which is by the bank of the river Arnon, even unto mount Sion, which is Hermon,

rr: kandi na Araba yoona seeri ya Yorudani aha rubaju rw'oburugwa-izooba, n'okuhika aha nyanja ya Araba ahansi y'orushozi Pisiga.
en: and all the plain on this side Jordan eastward, even unto the sea of the plain, under the springs of Pisgah.

rr: Musa yaayeta Abaisraeli boona, yaabagira ati: Imwe Baisraeli 'mwe, muhurire ebiragiro ebyatairweho n'ebyaragiirwe, ebi ndikugamba muhuriire eri izooba, mubone kubyega n'okubyorobera.
en: And Moses called all Israel, and said unto them, Hear, O Israel, the statutes and judgments which I speak in your ears this day, that ye may learn them, and keep, and do them.

rr: MUKAMA Ruhanga waitu akaragaanira naitwe endagaano ahari Horebu.
en: The LORD our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.

rr: Baatatenkuriitwe tibo MUKAMA yaaragaine nabo egyo ndagaano, kureka akaragaana naitwe abari aha, abakiriho eri izooba.
en: The LORD made not this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive this day.

rr: MUKAMA akagamba naimwe nimureebana, ari aha rushozi ahagati omu muriro.
en: The LORD talked with you face to face in the mount out of the midst of the fire,

rr: (Omu bunaku obwo nkeemerera ahagati ya MUKAMA naimwe okubagambira ekigambo kya MUKAMA; ahabw'okuba mukaba mutiinire ogwo muriro, timwainamuka ahari orwo rushozi.) Yaagira ati
en: (I stood between the LORD and you at that time, to shew you the word of the LORD : for ye were afraid by reason of the fire, and went not up into the mount;) saying,

rr: Niinye MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe owaakwihire omu nsi ya Misri, omu nju y'obuhuuku
en: I am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.

rr: otarigira baaruhanga abandi nyowe ndiho.
en: Thou shalt have none other gods before me.

rr: Otaryekorera ekishushani kyona ekibaizire, n'obu kyakuba ekishushani ky'ekintu kyona ekiri ahaiguru omu iguru nari ekiri omu nsi ahansi, nari ekiri omu maizi okuzimu
en: Thou shalt not make thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the waters beneath the earth:

rr: otaribiinamira, kandi otaribiheereza; ahakuba nyowe MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe ndi Ruhanga w'eihato, ntura abaana eby'okushiisha bya baishebo abarikuunyanga okuhitsya aha b'obusingye bwa kashatu n'obwa kana
en: thou shalt not bow down thyself unto them, nor serve them: for I the LORD thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me,

rr: kwonka abaana b'abarikunkunda bakoorobera ebiragiro byangye, mbagirira embabazi okuhitsya obusingye enkumi n'enkumi.
en: and shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments.

rr: Otarizaanisa eiziina rya MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe; ahakuba MUKAMA tarimubara nk'otaine rubanja orikuzaanisa eiziina rye.
en: Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain: for the LORD will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.

rr: Ijuka okweza ekiro kya sabato; nk'oku MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe yaakuragiire.
en: Keep the sabbath day to sanctify it, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee.

rr: Omu biro mukaaga ogume okore; obe nimwo waakorera emirimo yaawe yoona
en: Six days thou shalt labour, and do all thy work:

rr: kwonka ekiro kya mushanju niyo sabato ahari MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe; otarikoreraho omurimo gwona, iwe nari mutabani waawe, nari muhara waawe, nari omuhuuku waawe, nari omuzaana waawe, nari ente yaawe, nari endogoya yaawe, nari eki otungire kyona omu matungo gaawe, nari omunyaihanga ori omu ka yaawe; omuhuuku waawe n'omuzaana waawe bahuumure nkaiwe.
en: but the seventh day is the sabbath of the LORD thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, nor thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thine ox, nor thine ass, nor any of thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates; that thy manservant and thy maidservant may rest as well as thou.

rr: Kandi oryaguma oijukye ku waabaire ori omuhuuku omu nsi ya Misri, MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe akakwihayo n'omukono gw'amaani kandi ogubangire. Nikyo MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe yaakuragiriire kurinda sabato.
en: And remember that thou wast a servant in the land of Egypt, and that the LORD thy God brought thee out thence through a mighty hand and by a stretched out arm: therefore the LORD thy God commanded thee to keep the sabbath day.

rr: Otiine sho na nyoko, nk'oku MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe yaakuragiire, obone kuhangaara n'okuba gye omu nsi ei MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe arikukuha.
en: Honour thy father and thy mother, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee; that thy days may be prolonged, and that it may go well with thee, in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.

rr: Otariita
en: Thou shalt not kill.

rr: Kandi otarishambana
en: Neither shalt thou commit adultery.

rr: Kandi otariiba
en: Neither shalt thou steal.

rr: Kandi otaribeiherera mutaahi waawe
en: Neither shalt thou bear false witness against thy neighbour.

rr: Kandi otaryetenga omukazi wa mutaahi waawe, otaryetenga enju ya mutaahi waawe, n'obu gwakuba omusiri gwe, nari omuhuuku we, nari omuzaana we, nari ente ye, nari endogoya ye n'obu kyakuba ekintu kyona ekya mutaahi waawe.
en: Neither shalt thou desire thy neighbour's wife, neither shalt thou covet thy neighbour's house, his field, or his manservant, or his maidservant, his ox, or his ass, or any thing that is thy neighbour's.

rr: Ebyo nibyo bigambo ebi MUKAMA yaagambiire eihanga ryanyu ryona aha rushozi ruri, ari ahagati omu muriro, n'omu kicu, n'omu mwirima ndindindi, naabigamba n'eiraka rihango; tiyaagira kindi eki yaayongyeraho.
en: These words the LORD spake unto all your assembly in the mount out of the midst of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice: and he added no more.

rr: Yaabihandiika aha bishate bibiri by'amabaare, yaabimpa.
en: And he wrote them in two tables of stone, and delivered them unto me.

rr: Ku mwahuriire eiraka eririkuruga omu mwirima, mwareeba orushozi nirwaka omuriro, abeebembezi b'enganda zaanyu boona n'abakuru baanyu baanyirira haihi
en: And it came to pass, when ye heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness, (for the mountain did burn with fire,) that ye came near unto me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;

rr: mwangira muti: Reeba MUKAMA Ruhanga waitu yaatworeka ekitiinisa kye n'obukuru bwe, kandi twahurira eiraka rye niriruga omu muriro; eri izooba twareeba Ruhanga ku arikugamba n'omuntu, akagumaho.
en: and ye said, Behold, the LORD our God hath shewed us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire: we have seen this day that God doth talk with man, and he liveth.

rr: Mbwenu twaza kwitirwa ki? Guriya muriro mwingi ka gwaza kutumaraho. Ku turaagarukye kuhurira eiraka rya MUKAMA Ruhanga waitu, nitwija kufa.
en: Now therefore why should we die? for this great fire will consume us: if we hear the voice of the LORD our God any more, then we shall die.

rr: Mbwenu n'oha omu bantu boona orahuriire eiraka rya Ruhanga otahwaho naagambira ahagati omu muriro, nk'oku twarihurira, akagumaho?
en: For who is there of all flesh, that hath heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as we have , and lived?

rr: Ba niiwe wairira haihi, ohurire ebi MUKAMA Ruhanga waitu arikugamba byona, otugambire ebi MUKAMA Ruhanga waitu araakugambire byona; naitwe nitwija kubihurira, tubyorobere.
en: Go thou near, and hear all that the LORD our God shall say: and speak thou unto us all that the LORD our God shall speak unto thee; and we will hear it , and do it .

rr: Ku mwangambiire ebigambo byanyu, MUKAMA yaabihurira; yangira ati: Mpuriire ebigambo ebi abantu abo bakugambiire; ebi bagambire byona, babigambire gye.
en: And the LORD heard the voice of your words, when ye spake unto me; and the LORD said unto me, I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they have spoken unto thee: they have well said all that they have spoken.

rr: Nangwa ku baakugira omutima nk'ogwo gukabareetera kuntiina obutoosha n'okworobera ebiragiro byangye byona, bakaaba gye, n'oruzaaro rwabo ebiro byona.
en: O that there were such an heart in them, that they would fear me, and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them, and with their children for ever!

rr: Irooko obagire oti: Mugarukye omu mahema gaanyu.
en: Go say to them, Get you into your tents again.

rr: Kwonka iwe, ogume aha, ahu ndi, naanye nkugambire eki ndikuragiira kyona n'ebiragiro ebyatairweho n'ebyaragiirwe, ebi oshemereire kubeegyesa, babone kubyoroberera omu nsi ei ndikubaha kuba eyaabo.
en: But as for thee, stand thou here by me, and I will speak unto thee all the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which thou shalt teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess it.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo muteho omutima, mukore, nk'oku MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu abaragiire; mutariteishukira aha mukono gwa buryo nari ogwa bumosho.
en: Ye shall observe to do therefore as the LORD your God hath commanded you: ye shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.

rr: Mugume mugyendere omu muhanda gwona ogu MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu abahabwire, mubone kugumaho muri gye, muhangaarire omu nsi ei murikubuura.
en: Ye shall walk in all the ways which the LORD your God hath commanded you, that ye may live, and that it may be well with you, and that ye may prolong your days in the land which ye shall possess.

rr: Mbwenu eki nikyo kyaragiirwe n'ebiragiro ebyatairweho n'ebyaragiirwe, ebi MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu yandagiire kubeegyesa, ngu mubone kubyoroberera omu nsi ei murikwambukamu kukubuura
en: Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the judgments, which the LORD your God commanded to teach you, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go to possess it:

rr: otiine MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe, oyorobere ebiragiro bye byona ebyatairweho, ebi ndikukuragiira, iwe na mutabani waawe na mwijukuru waawe, ebiro byona ebi orimara omu nsi, haza obone kuhangaara.
en: that thou mightest fear the LORD thy God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command thee, thou, and thy son, and thy son's son, all the days of thy life; and that thy days may be prolonged.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo, hurira, iwe Israeli, oteho omutima, obyorobere, obone kuba gye, n'okukanyira munonga omuri egyo nsi y'amate n'obwoki, nka MUKAMA Ruhanga wa baashwenkuru oku yaakuraganiise.
en: Hear therefore, O Israel, and observe to do it ; that it may be well with thee, and that ye may increase mightily, as the LORD God of thy fathers hath promised thee, in the land that floweth with milk and honey.

rr: Hurira, iwe Israeli! MUKAMA Ruhanga waitu n'omwe
en: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD :

rr: kandi ogume okunde MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe n'omutima gwawe gwona, n'amagara gaawe goona, n'amaani gaawe goona.
en: and thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.

rr: Kandi ebigambo ebi, ebi ndikukuragiira eri izooba, bishemereire kukuguma aha mutima
en: And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be in thine heart:

rr: ogume oyezirikye kubyegyesa abaana baawe, ogume obigaaniireho oshutami omu nju yaawe, nari noogyenda omu muhanda, kandi waaba nooza kubyama, kandi noimuka.
en: and thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.

rr: Obikome aha mukono gwawe, bibe akamanyiso, obite aha buso bwawe ahagati y'amaisho gaawe.
en: And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thine hand, and they shall be as frontlets between thine eyes.

rr: Oryabihandiika aha biti by'omuryango gw'enju yaawe n'aha nyigi z'amarembo gaawe.
en: And thou shalt write them upon the posts of thy house, and on thy gates.

rr: Bwanyima MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe ku arikuhitsya omu nsi ei yaarahiire kuha baashwenkuru, Abrahamu, Isaaka na Yakobo, yaakuha endembo mpango kandi nungi, ezi otarombekire
en: And it shall be, when the LORD thy God shall have brought thee into the land which he sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give thee great and goodly cities, which thou buildedst not,

rr: n'amaju agaijwire ebirungi byona, agu otaraijwize, n'amaziba g'amaizi agu otarafukwire, n'emisiri y'emizaabibu n'emizeituuni ei otarabyaire, waarya, waahaaga
en: and houses full of all good things , which thou filledst not, and wells digged, which thou diggedst not, vineyards and olive trees, which thou plantedst not; when thou shalt have eaten and be full;

rr: oyerinde otaryebwa MUKAMA owaakwihire omu nsi ya Misri, omu nju y'obuhuuku.
en: then beware lest thou forget the LORD , which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.

rr: Ogume otiine MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe, omuheereze, n'eiziina rye obe niryo waarahira.
en: Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God, and serve him, and shalt swear by his name.

rr: Mutarikuratira baaruhanga abandi ab'abanyamahanga, abahereraine naimwe
en: Ye shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the people which are round about you;

rr: ahakuba MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe obari ahagati ni Ruhanga w'eihato; MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe nyentsya atarikugirira ekiniga, akakuhwerekyereza, akakwiha omu nsi.
en: (for the LORD thy God is a jealous God among you) lest the anger of the LORD thy God be kindled against thee, and destroy thee from off the face of the earth.

rr: Mutarigyeza MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu, nk'oku mwamugyereize Maasa.
en: Ye shall not tempt the LORD your God, as ye tempted him in Massah.

rr: Mugume mwezirikye kworobera ebiragiro bya MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu, n'ebi yaahamize, n'ebiragiro ebyatairweho ebi yaabaragiire.
en: Ye shall diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he hath commanded thee.

rr: Kandi ogume okore ebihikire n'ebirungi omu maisho ga MUKAMA, obone kuba gye, oze omuri egyo nsi nungi ei MUKAMA yaarahiire kuha baashwenkuru, ogikubuure
en: And thou shalt do that which is right and good in the sight of the LORD : that it may be well with thee, and that thou mayest go in and possess the good land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers,

rr: ahabw'okubinga abazigu baawe boona omu maisho gaawe, nk'oku yaagambire.
en: to cast out all thine enemies from before thee, as the LORD hath spoken.

rr: Mutabani waawe ku arikubuuza omu biro ebiriija, naagira ati: Amakuru g'ebirikuhamya n'ebiragiro ebyatairweho n'ebyaragiirwe ebi MUKAMA Ruhanga waitu yaabaragiire n'enki?
en: And when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What mean the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which the LORD our God hath commanded you?

rr: oryamugarukamu oti: Tukaba turi abahuuku ba Faraho omuri Misri; MUKAMA yaatwiha omuri Misri n'omukono gw'amaani
en: Then thou shalt say unto thy son, We were Pharaoh's bondmen in Egypt; and the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand:

rr: yaayoreka obumanyiso n'eby'okutangaaza eby'amaani ebirikusaasa, naabikora ahari Misri na Faraho n'eka ye yoona omu maisho gaitu
en: and the LORD shewed signs and wonders, great and sore, upon Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his household, before our eyes:

rr: yaatwihayo, ngu atureete omu nsi ei yaaraganiise baatatenkuriitwe ku arigituha.
en: and he brought us out from thence, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he sware unto our fathers.

rr: Kandi MUKAMA yaaturagiira kworobera ebyo biragiro byona, n'okutiina MUKAMA Ruhanga waitu, ngu tubone kuba gye ebiro byona, kandi ngu akize amagara gaitu okufa, nk'oku kiri n'eri izooba.
en: And the LORD commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear the LORD our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as it is at this day.

rr: Ku turitaho omutima, twayorobera ebyo biragiro byona omu maisho ga MUKAMA Ruhanga waitu, nk'oku yaaturagiire, kiryatubarirwa kuba okuhikiirira.
en: And it shall be our righteousness, if we observe to do all these commandments before the LORD our God, as he hath commanded us.

rr: Currently Selected: Eky&x27;Ebiragiro 6 : RR64 Highlight Share <path d="M5 12a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h3a1 1 0 1 1 0 2H6a1 1 0 0 1-1-1ZM5 15a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h3a1 1 0 1 1 0 2H6a1 1 0 0 1-1-

MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe ku arikuhitsya omu nsi ei orikuza kukubuura, yaabinga amahanga maingi omu maisho gaawe, Abahiiti, Abagirugashi, Abaamori, Abanyakanaani, Abaperizi, Abahiivi n'Abayebusi, amahanga mushanju agarikubakira obuhango n'amaani
en: When the LORD thy God shall bring thee into the land whither thou goest to possess it, and hath cast out many nations before thee, the Hittites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, seven nations greater and mightier than thou;

rr: kandi MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe ku ariheza kugahayo omu maisho gaawe, waagasingura, ogacwekyerereze kimwe; otarigira endagaano yoona ei waaragaana nabo, kandi otaribagirira esaasi
en: and when the LORD thy God shall deliver them before thee; thou shalt smite them, and utterly destroy them; thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor shew mercy unto them:

rr: otarishwererana nabo, kuhingira muhara waawe mutabani waabo, nari mutabani waawe kumushwererera muhara waabo
en: neither shalt thou make marriages with them; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son, nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son.

rr: ahabw'okuba baryahindura mutabani waawe arekye kunkurata, kureka aheereze baaruhanga abandi; haza kireetere MUKAMA kukugirira ekiniga, n'okurahuka kukucwekyereza.
en: For they will turn away thy son from following me, that they may serve other gods: so will the anger of the LORD be kindled against you, and destroy thee suddenly.

rr: Kwonka oku nikwo muribatwaza; muryasheenya amatambiro gaabo, musheenyagure enyomyo zaabo z'amabaare ezi baayombekire, mutemagure Ashera zaabo, kandi mwotsye ebishushani byabo ebibaizire.
en: But thus shall ye deal with them; ye shall destroy their altars, and break down their images, and cut down their groves, and burn their graven images with fire.

rr: Omanye ngu ori eihanga eryereziibwe MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe; kandi MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe akakutoorana omu mahanga goona agari omu nsi, kuba eihanga eri yaayetooraniire.
en: For thou art an holy people unto the LORD thy God: the LORD thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself, above all people that are upon the face of the earth.

rr: Ekyareeteire MUKAMA kubakunda n'okubatoorana, ti habw'okugira ngu mukaba muri eihanga eririkukira agandi obuhango; ahakuba mukaba muri eihanga eririkukira obukye omu gandi goona
en: The LORD did not set his love upon you, nor choose you, because ye were more in number than any people; for ye were the fewest of all people:

rr: kureka akabatoorana ahabw'okubakunda, yaayenda ngu ahikiirize endahiro ei yaarahiire baashwenkuriimwe. Nikyo MUKAMA yaabaihiireyo n'omukono gw'amaani, akabacungura okubaiha omu nju y'obuhuuku n'omu mukono gwa Faraho omugabe wa Misri.
en: but because the LORD loved you, and because he would keep the oath which he had sworn unto your fathers, hath the LORD brought you out with a mighty hand, and redeemed you out of the house of bondmen, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo omanye ngu MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe niwe Ruhanga, Ruhanga omwesigwa, orikurinda endagaano, akagirira embabazi abarikumukunda, bakoorobera ebiragiro bye okuhitsya obusingye rukumi
en: Know therefore that the LORD thy God, he is God, the faithful God, which keepeth covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations;

rr: oihura abamwanga okubacwekyereza nibareebana; taryeganda kwihura orikumwanga, kureka aryamwihura nibareebana.
en: and repayeth them that hate him to their face, to destroy them: he will not be slack to him that hateth him, he will repay him to his face.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo ogume oyorobere ekiragiro kye, n'ebiragiro ebyatairweho n'ebyaragiirwe, ebi ndikukuragiira eri izooba.
en: Thou shalt therefore keep the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which I command thee this day, to do them.

rr: Bwanyima ahabw'okuhurira ebirikuragiirwa ebyo, n'okubirinda noobyorobera, MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe aryagumizamu ahitsye endagaano n'okukugirira embabazi, ebi yaaragaine na baashwenkuru
en: Wherefore it shall come to pass, if ye hearken to these judgments, and keep, and do them, that the LORD thy God shall keep unto thee the covenant and the mercy which he sware unto thy fathers:

rr: kandi aryakukunda, akuhe omugisha, akukanyise; kandi aryaha omugisha abaana b'enda yaawe, n'ebyana by'eitaka ryawe, n'engano zaawe, na viinyo yaawe, n'amajuta gaawe g'emizeituuni, n'okukanya kw'ente zaawe n'okw'abaana b'obusyo bw'entaama zaawe omu nsi ei yaaragaine na baashwenkuru kukuha.
en: and he will love thee, and bless thee, and multiply thee: he will also bless the fruit of thy womb, and the fruit of thy land, thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep, in the land which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee.

rr: Oryaheebwa omugisha okukira agandi mahanga goona; tiharibaho mushaija nari omukazi oriba engumba omuriimwe, nari omu matungo gaanyu.
en: Thou shalt be blessed above all people: there shall not be male or female barren among you, or among your cattle.

rr: MUKAMA aryakwihaho endwara zoona; kandi tarikurwaza ndwara mbi yoona aha ndwara za Misri, ezi murikumanya; kureka aryazirwaza boona abarikukwanga.
en: And the LORD will take away from thee all sickness, and will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which thou knowest, upon thee; but will lay them upon all them that hate thee.

rr: Oryacwekyereza amahanga goona, agu MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe arihayo ahariiwe; amaisho gaawe gatarigasaasira; kandi naimwe mutariheereza baaruhanga baabo, ahabw'okuba ekyo kiryababeera omutego.
en: And thou shalt consume all the people which the LORD thy God shall deliver thee; thine eye shall have no pity upon them: neither shalt thou serve their gods; for that will be a snare unto thee.

rr: Ku origira omu mutima gwawe oti: Amahanga aga nigankiza amaani; nimbaasa nta kuganyaga?
en: If thou shalt say in thine heart, These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?

rr: otarigatiina, kureka oijukye ebi MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe yaakoreire Faraho na Misri yoona
en: Thou shalt not be afraid of them: but shalt well remember what the LORD thy God did unto Pharaoh, and unto all Egypt;

rr: ebigyezo by'amaani ebi amaisho gaawe gaareebire, obumanyiso, eby'okutangaaza, n'omukono gw'amaani kandi ogubangire, ebi MUKAMA yaakwihiiseyo; nikwo MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe arigira amahanga goona agu orikutiina.
en: the great temptations which thine eyes saw, and the signs, and the wonders, and the mighty hand, and the stretched out arm, whereby the LORD thy God brought thee out: so shall the LORD thy God do unto all the people of whom thou art afraid.

rr: Kandi MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe aryayohereza enwa, zibateere, okuhitsya obu abo, abariba batsigaireho babeesherekire, baricwekyererezibwa omu maisho gaawe.
en: Moreover the LORD thy God will send the hornet among them, until they that are left, and hide themselves from thee, be destroyed.

rr: Otaribatiina, ahabw'okuba MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe ari omuriiwe, Ruhanga omukuru kandi orikutiinisa.
en: Thou shalt not be affrighted at them: for the LORD thy God is among you, a mighty God and terrible.

rr: MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe aryabingamu ago mahanga, gakurugyeho mporampora; orekye kugamaraho ahonaaho, enyamaishwa z'omu ihamba zikakukanyaho, zikarengyesereza.
en: And the LORD thy God will put out those nations before thee by little and little: thou mayest not consume them at once, lest the beasts of the field increase upon thee.

rr: Kureka MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe aryagahayo omu maisho gaawe, agarabanisemu munonga, okuhitsya obu garihwerekyerera.
en: But the LORD thy God shall deliver them unto thee, and shall destroy them with a mighty destruction, until they be destroyed.

rr: Kandi n'abagabe baabo aryabahayo omu mukono gwawe, naiwe oryabacwekyereza, eiziina ryabo ryebere kimwe ahansi y'eiguru; tihariho muntu weena oribaasa kukuza omu kaso, okuhitsya obu oribamariraho kimwe.
en: And he shall deliver their kings into thine hand, and thou shalt destroy their name from under heaven: there shall no man be able to stand before thee, until thou have destroyed them.

rr: Ebishushani bya baaruhanga baabo ebibaizire oryabyotsya omu muriro; otaryetenga efeeza nari ezaabu eriba ebiriho, n'obu kwakuba okugyetwarira, nyentsya okagwa omu mutego gwayo; ahabw'okuba n'ekihagaro ahari MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe.
en: The graven images of their gods shall ye burn with fire: thou shalt not desire the silver or gold that is on them, nor take it unto thee, lest thou be snared therein: for it is an abomination to the LORD thy God.

rr: Kandi otarireeta ekihagaro omu nju yaawe, okakyeenwa nkakyo; oryakyangira kimwe, okinugire kimwe, ahakuba n'ekintu ekikyeenirwe.
en: Neither shalt thou bring an abomination into thine house, lest thou be a cursed thing like it: but thou shalt utterly detest it, and thou shalt utterly abhor it; for it is a cursed thing.

rr: Ebiragiro byona ebi ndikubaragiira eri izooba, muryabitaho omutima, mubyorobere, mubone kugumaho mukakanya, mukaza omu nsi ei MUKAMA yaarahiire kuha baashwenkuriimwe, mukagikubuura.
en: All the commandments which I command thee this day shall ye observe to do, that ye may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers.

rr: Oryaguma oijukye omuhanda gwona ogu MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe yaakurabizemu omu ihamba emyaka egi yoona makumi ana, kukucwa eishaija, naakugyeza ngu amanye ebiri omu mutima gwawe, yaaba oraayorobere ebiragiro bye, nari otarikwija kubyorobera.
en: And thou shalt remember all the way which the LORD thy God led thee these forty years in the wilderness, to humble thee, and to prove thee, to know what was in thine heart, whether thou wouldest keep his commandments, or no.

rr: Yaakucureeza, yaakureka waagira enjara, yaakugaburira emaanu, ei waabaire otakamanyaga, n'obu baakuba baashwenkuru, ngu akumanyise ku omuntu atatungwa by'okurya byonka, kureka ku atungwa ekigambo kyona ekiruga omu kanwa ka Ruhanga.
en: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD doth man live.

rr: Ebijwaro byawe tibirakukuriireho, n'ekigyere kyawe tikirazimbire, emyaka egyo yoona makumi ana.
en: Thy raiment waxed not old upon thee, neither did thy foot swell, these forty years.

rr: Kandi omanye omu mutima gwawe, ku MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe akuhana, nk'oku omuntu ahana omwana we.
en: Thou shalt also consider in thine heart, that, as a man chasteneth his son, so the LORD thy God chasteneth thee.

rr: Oryakwata ebiragiro bya MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe noogyendera omu mihanda ye, noomutiina
en: Therefore thou shalt keep the commandments of the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.

rr: ahakuba MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe naakutwara omu nsi enungi, erimu otugyera tw'amaizi, n'enshuro n'ebiyanja by'amaizi maraingwa, agarikuhimintika nigaruga omu mpanga n'omu bibungo
en: For the LORD thy God bringeth thee into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains and depths that spring out of valleys and hills;

rr: ensi ey'engano na sayiri n'emizaabibu n'emitiini kandi n'amakomamahanga; ensi y'amajuta g'emizeituuni n'obwoki
en: a land of wheat, and barley, and vines, and fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of oil olive, and honey;

rr: ensi ei oriryamu eby'okurya bitatuube, kandi ei otarikyeneramu kintu kyona; ei amabaare gaayo gari obutare, kandi ei oritimba emiringa omu bibungo byayo.
en: a land wherein thou shalt eat bread without scarceness, thou shalt not lack any thing in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills thou mayest dig brass.

rr: Oryarya, oigute, osiime MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe ahabw'ensi nungi ei akuhaire.
en: When thou hast eaten and art full, then thou shalt bless the LORD thy God for the good land which he hath given thee.

rr: Oyerinde otaryebwa MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe, okanga kworobera ebiragiro bye, n'ebi yaaragiire, n'ebiragiro ebyatairweho, ebi ndikubaragiira eri izooba.
en: Beware that thou forget not the LORD thy God, in not keeping his commandments, and his judgments, and his statutes, which I command thee this day:

rr: Ku oriba waariire waigutsire, waayombekire enju nungi, waazitwiremu
en: lest when thou hast eaten and art full, and hast built goodly houses, and dwelt therein ;

rr: amasyo gaawe g'ente n'ag'entaama ku gariba gaakanyire, efeeza n'ezaabu zaawe nazo zaakanya, n'ebi otungire byona byakanya
en: and when thy herds and thy flocks multiply, and thy silver and thy gold is multiplied, and all that thou hast is multiplied;

rr: oyerinde omutima gwawe gutaryehimbisa, okeebwa MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe owaakwihire omu nsi ya Misri, omu nju y'obuhuuku
en: then thine heart be lifted up, and thou forget the LORD thy God, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage;

rr: akakurabya omuri eryo ihamba rihango kandi eririkutiinisa, eri waashangiremu enjoka z'obushegu oburikubabiirira na skorupio, n'ensi y'empaama etarimu maizi, owaakwihiire amaizi omu rukiri rugumire munonga
en: who led thee through that great and terrible wilderness, wherein were fiery serpents, and scorpions, and drought, where there was no water; who brought thee forth water out of the rock of flint;

rr: owaakugabuririire emaanu omu ihamba, ei baashwenkuru baabaire batakamanyaga; ngu akucwe eishaija, akugyeze abone kukukora gye aha muheru.
en: who fed thee in the wilderness with manna, which thy fathers knew not, that he might humble thee, and that he might prove thee, to do thee good at thy latter end;

en: and thou say in thine heart, My power and the might of mine hand hath gotten me this wealth.

rr: Oryaguma oijukye MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe, ahakuba niwe akubaasisa kutunga eitungo ngu abone kuhamya endagaano, ei yaaragaine na baashwenkuru naarahira, nk'oku kiri eri izooba.
en: But thou shalt remember the LORD thy God: for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers, as it is this day.

rr: Kwonka ku oryebwa MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe, waakuratira baaruhanga abandi, waabaheereza, kandi waabaramya, ninkumanyisiza kimwe eri izooba ku otaribura kuhwerekyerera.
en: And it shall be, if thou do at all forget the LORD thy God, and walk after other gods, and serve them, and worship them, I testify against you this day that ye shall surely perish.

rr: Nk'amahanga agu MUKAMA arikuhwerekyerereza omu maisho gaanyu, nikwo naimwe murihwerekyerera, ahabw'okwanga kuhurira eiraka rya MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu.
en: As the nations which the LORD destroyeth before your face, so shall ye perish; because ye would not be obedient unto the voice of the LORD your God.
