rr: Hurira, iwe Israeli! Noija kwambuka Yorudani eri izooba kunyaga amahanga agarikukukira ekitiinisa n'amaani, endembo mpango, ezeehinguririziibwe engo ezizitiire okuhika ahaiguru munonga
en: Hear, O Israel: Thou art to pass over Jordan this day, to go in to possess nations greater and mightier than thyself, cities great and fenced up to heaven,

rr: n'abantu bahango kandi baraingwa beene Anaki, abu orikumanya, kandi abu orahuriire nibagambaho bati: N'oha orikubaasa kuza aba Anaki omu kaso?
en: a people great and tall, the children of the Anakims, whom thou knowest, and of whom thou hast heard say , Who can stand before the children of Anak!

rr: Eri izooba omanye ngu MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe niwe ogwo oraayambukye, akwebembeire nk'omuriro gurikurya busha; niwe araabacwekyereze, akabagomoorera omu maisho gaawe; naiwe oryababingamu, obahwerekyereze ahonaaho, nk'oku MUKAMA yaakugambiire.
en: Understand therefore this day, that the LORD thy God is he which goeth over before thee; as a consuming fire he shall destroy them, and he shall bring them down before thy face: so shalt thou drive them out, and destroy them quickly, as the LORD hath said unto thee.

rr: MUKAMA Ruhanga ku ariheza kubabinga, baakuruga omu maisho, otarigira omu mutima gwawe oti: MUKAMA andeetsire omu nsi egi kugikubuura ahabw'okuhikiirira kwangye; haza kunu MUKAMA abingire ago mahanga omu maisho gaanyu ahab'wobubi bwago.
en: Speak not thou in thine heart, after that the LORD thy God hath cast them out from before thee, saying, For my righteousness the LORD hath brought me in to possess this land: but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD doth drive them out from before thee.

rr: Torikuza omu nsi yaabo kugikubuura ahabw'okuhikiirira kwawe nari okugororoka kw'omutima gwawe, kureka ahabw'obubi bw'ago mahanga nikyo MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe arikubabingira omu maisho gaawe, kandi ngu abone kuhamya ekigambo eki yaarahiire naaraganisa baashwenkuru, Abrahamu, Isaaka na Yakobo.
en: Not for thy righteousness, or for the uprightness of thine heart, dost thou go to possess their land: but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD thy God doth drive them out from before thee, and that he may perform the word which the LORD sware unto thy fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo omanye MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe ku atarikukuha nsi egi kugikubuura ahabw'okuhikiirira kwawe; ahabw'okuba ori eihanga ery'ebitsya bigangaire.
en: Understand therefore, that the LORD thy God giveth thee not this good land to possess it for thy righteousness; for thou art a stiffnecked people.

rr: Oijukye, kandi oteebwa oku waitsize MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe ekiniga omu ihamba; okwiha aha izooba eri waarugiireho omu nsi ya Misri, n'okuhitsya obu muhikire aha, mukaba mugomera MUKAMA.
en: Remember, and forget not, how thou provokedst the LORD thy God to wrath in the wilderness: from the day that thou didst depart out of the land of Egypt, until ye came unto this place, ye have been rebellious against the LORD .

rr: Kandi n'ahari Horebu mukaitsizaho MUKAMA ekiniga, yaabagirira ekiniga, yaayenda kubacwekyereza.
en: Also in Horeb ye provoked the LORD to wrath, so that the LORD was angry with you to have destroyed you.

rr: Ku nainamukire aha rushozi kwakiira ebishate biri eby'amabaare, nibyo bishate by'endagaano ei MUKAMA yaaragaine naimwe, naamara ahari orwo rushozi ebiro makumi ana nyomushana na nyekiro; nkaba ntarya kintu kyona, n'obu kwakuba okunywa amaizi.
en: When I was gone up into the mount to receive the tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant which the LORD made with you, then I abode in the mount forty days and forty nights, I neither did eat bread nor drink water:

rr: MUKAMA yampa ebyo bishate bibiri by'amabaare ebihandiiikirweho orukumu rwa Ruhanga; bikaba biriho ebigambo byona ebi MUKAMA agambiire naimwe ahari orwo rushozi, ari ahagati omu muriro, aha izooba ry'okuteeraniraho.
en: and the LORD delivered unto me two tables of stone written with the finger of God; and on them was written according to all the words, which the LORD spake with you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly.

rr: Ebyo biro makumi ana ku byahweire, MUKAMA yampa ebyo bishate bibiri by'amabaare, nibyo bishate by'endagaano
en: And it came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights, that the LORD gave me the two tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant.

rr: yangira ati: Imuka, orugye aha, orahukye oshuume; ahabw'okuba abantu baawe abu waihire Misri, beesiisire; baarahuka kuteishuka omuhanda, ogu naabaragiire kutoora; baayeheeshera ekishushani.
en: And the LORD said unto me, Arise, get thee down quickly from hence; for thy people which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt have corrupted themselves ; they are quickly turned aside out of the way which I commanded them; they have made them a molten image.

rr: Kandi MUKAMA yangira ati: Ndeebire eihanga eri, reeba n'eihanga ry'ebitsya bigangaire
en: Furthermore the LORD spake unto me, saying, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:

rr: reka mbacwekyereze, eiziina ryabo ryebere kimwe ahansi y'eiguru, nkuhindure eihanga eririkubakiza amaani n'ekitiinisa.
en: let me alone, that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under heaven: and I will make of thee a nation mightier and greater than they.

rr: Naanye naahinduka, naaruga aha rushozi, kandi orwo rushozi rukaba nirwaka omuriro; ebyo bishate bibiri by'amabaare nkaba mbiine omu ngaro zombi.
en: So I turned and came down from the mount, and the mount burned with fire: and the two tables of the covenant were in my two hands.

rr: Ku naayetegyereize, naareeba mucumwire ahari MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu, mweheesheire ekishushani ky'enyana omu zaabu, muteishukire omuhanda ogu MUKAMA yaabaire abaragiire kutoora.
en: And I looked, and, behold, ye had sinned against the LORD your God, and had made you a molten calf: ye had turned aside quickly out of the way which the LORD had commanded you.

rr: Naakwata ebyo bishate bibiri by'amabaare, ebyabaire bindi omu ngaro zombi, naabiteera ahansi, naabyatira omu maisho gaanyu.
en: And I took the two tables, and cast them out of my two hands, and brake them before your eyes.

rr: Naagwa ahansi omu maisho ga MUKAMA nk'okubanza, okumara ebiro makumi ana nyomushana na nyekiro; tinaarya kintu kyona, n'obu kwakuba okunywa amaizi, ahabw'ekibi kyanyu kyona eki mwakozire, nimukora ekirikwangwa MUKAMA, kumwitsa ekiniga.
en: And I fell down before the LORD , as at the first, forty days and forty nights: I did neither eat bread, nor drink water, because of all your sins which ye sinned, in doing wickedly in the sight of the LORD , to provoke him to anger.

rr: Ahakuba nkatiina ahabw'ekiniga n'okubiihirwa kwingi, ebi MUKAMA yaabagiriire, akenda kubacwekyereza.
en: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure, wherewith the LORD was wroth against you to destroy you.

rr: Kwonka omuri obwo bunaku nabwo MUKAMA yampurira.
en: But the LORD hearkened unto me at that time also.

rr: Kandi MUKAMA yaagirira Arooni ekiniga kingi, yaayenda kumwita; omuri obwo bunaku na Arooni nawe naamushabira.
en: And the LORD was very angry with Aaron to have destroyed him: and I prayed for Aaron also the same time.

rr: Naakwata ekibi kyanyu, nikyo kishushani ky'enyana eki mwaheesire, naakyotsya omu muriro, naakihondahonda, naakisa, naakicwa obunono; esaano yaakyo naaginaga omu kagyera, akaabaire nikaruga omu rushozi.
en: And I took your sin, the calf which ye had made, and burnt it with fire, and stamped it, and ground it very small, even until it was as small as dust: and I cast the dust thereof into the brook that descended out of the mount.

rr: Kandi n'ahari Tabera na Maasa na Kibiroosi-hatava mukaitsa MUKAMA ekiniga.
en: And at Taberah, and at Massah, and at Kibroth-hattaavah, ye provoked the LORD to wrath.

rr: Kandi n'obu MUKAMA yaabatumira Kadeshi-barunea, naagira ati: Mwinamukye, mukubuure ensi ei mbahaire; nabwo mukagomera ekiragiro kya MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu, timwamwikiriza, n'obu kwakuba okumuhurira.
en: Likewise when the LORD sent you from Kadesh-barnea, saying, Go up and possess the land which I have given you; then ye rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God, and ye believed him not, nor hearkened to his voice.

rr: Mukaba mugomera MUKAMA, okwiha aha izooba eria naatandikiireho kubamanya.
en: Ye have been rebellious against the LORD from the day that I knew you.

rr: Ntyo naajuumara ahansi omu maisho ga MUKAMA, okumara ebiro makumi ana nyomushana na nyekiro, ahakuba MUKAMA akagamba ku arikwija kubacwekyereza.
en: Thus I fell down before the LORD forty days and forty nights, as I fell down at the first ; because the LORD had said he would destroy you.

rr: Naashaba MUKAMA nti: Ai Mukama RUHANGA, otacwekyereza abantu baawe, nibwo buhunguzi bwawe, abu waacungwize ekitiinisa kyawe, okabaiha omuri Misri n'omukono gw'amaani.
en: I prayed therefore unto the LORD , and said, O Lord GOD , destroy not thy people and thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed through thy greatness, which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

rr: Ijuka abairu baawe Abarahamu, Isaaka na Yakobo; oteeta aha bugangaazi bw'aba bantu, nari aha bubi bwabo n'ekibi kyabo
en: Remember thy servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; look not unto the stubbornness of this people, nor to their wickedness, nor to their sin:

rr: -9 ; . abantu b'omu nsi ei waatwihiremu batakaagira ngu: MUKAMA akaremwa kubahitsya omu nsi ei yaabaraganiise, kandi ngu, ahabw'okubanga, akabaihayo kubaitira omu ihamba.
en: lest the land whence thou broughtest us out say, Because the LORD was not able to bring them into the land which he promised them, and because he hated them, he hath brought them out to slay them in the wilderness.

rr: Haza kunu bari abantu baawe, kandi obuhunguzi bwawe, abu waihireyo n'omukono gwawe ogw'amaani kandi ogubangire.
en: Yet they are thy people and thine inheritance, which thou broughtest out by thy mighty power and by thy stretched out arm.

en: For the LORD your God is God of gods, and Lord of lords, a great God, a mighty, and a terrible, which regardeth not persons, nor taketh reward:

rr: Oryaguma otiine MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe; obe niwe waaheereza, omuhamireho, kandi eiziina rye obe niryo waarahira.
en: Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God; him shalt thou serve, and to him shalt thou cleave, and swear by his name.

rr: Niwe kwesiima kwawe kandi Ruhanga waawe, owaakukoreire ebikuru biri kandi ebirikutiinisa, ebi waayereebeire.

en: Thy fathers went down into Egypt with threescore and ten persons; and now the LORD thy God hath made thee as the stars of heaven for multitude.

en: and what he did unto Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben: how the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their households, and their tents, and all the substance that was in their possession, in the midst of all Israel:

en: a land which the LORD thy God careth for: the eyes of the LORD thy God are always upon it, from the beginning of the year even unto the end of the year.

rr: Ku muryezirika kworobera ebiragiro byangye, ebi ndikubaragiira eri izooba, okukunda MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu, n'okumuheereza n'omutima gwanyu gwona n'amagara gaanyu goona
en: And it shall come to pass, if ye shall hearken diligently unto my commandments which I command you this day, to love the LORD your God, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul,

rr: naanye ndyagwisiza ensi yaanyu enjura omu bunaku bwayo, ey'eibiba n'eya katumba, mubone kushaaruura engano zaanyu, na viinyo yaanyu n'amajuta gaanyu g'emizeituuni.
en: that I will give you the rain of your land in his due season, the first rain and the latter rain, that thou mayest gather in thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil.

rr: Ndyameza obunyaatsi omu mariisizo gaanyu ahabw'amatungo gaanyu, murye, mwigute.
en: And I will send grass in thy fields for thy cattle, that thou mayest eat and be full.

rr: Mwerinde, emitima yaanyu etaribeihwa-beihwa, mukateishuka, mukaheereza baaruhanga abandi, mukabaramya
en: Take heed to yourselves, that your heart be not deceived, and ye turn aside, and serve other gods, and worship them;

rr: MUKAMA akabagirira ekiniga kingi, akakinga eiguru, enjura ekabura, ensi ekareka kweza emyaka yaayo, mukarahuka kuhwerekyerera, mukahwa omu nsi enungi ei MUKAMA arikubaha.
en: and then the LORD 's wrath be kindled against you, and he shut up the heaven, that there be no rain, and that the land yield not her fruit; and lest ye perish quickly from off the good land which the LORD giveth you.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo mute ebigambo byangye ebi aha mitima yaanyu n'omu magara gaanyu, mubikome aha mikono yaanyu, bibe akamanyiso, mubite aha buso bwanyu ahagati y'amaisho gaanyu.
en: Therefore shall ye lay up these my words in your heart and in your soul, and bind them for a sign upon your hand, that they may be as frontlets between your eyes.

rr: Mugume mubyegyese abaana baanyu, mubigaaniireho mushutami omu maka gaanyu, nimugyenda omu muhanda, nimuza kubyama, kandi nimwimuka.
en: And ye shall teach them your children, speaking of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.

rr: Muryabihandiika aha biti by'emiryango y'amaju gaanyu n'aha nyigi z'amarembo gaanyu
en: And thou shalt write them upon the door posts of thine house, and upon thy gates:

rr: ebiro byanyu n'eby'abaana baanyu bibone kukanya omu nsi ei MUKAMA yaarahiire kuha baashwenkuriimwe omwanya gwona ogu eiguru ririmara riri ahaiguru y'ensi.
en: that your days may be multiplied, and the days of your children, in the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers to give them, as the days of heaven upon the earth.

rr: Ahakuba ku muryezirika kukwata ebiragiro ebi byona ebi ndikubaragiira, mwabyorobera, okukunda MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu, n'okugyendera omu mihanda ye yoona, n'okumuhamiraho
en: For if ye shall diligently keep all these commandments which I command you, to do them, to love the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, and to cleave unto him;

rr: obwo MUKAMA aryabinga amahanga ago goona omu maisho gaanyu, kandi muryakubuura amahanga agarikubakira obukuru n'amaani.
en: then will the LORD drive out all these nations from before you, and ye shall possess greater nations and mightier than yourselves.

rr: Omwanya gwona ogu muriribatamu n'ebigyere byanyu guryaba ogwanyu; omwatano gwanyu guryatandikira aha ihamba na Lebanooni, n'aha mugyera Furaati, guhikye aha Nyanja y'oburengyerwa-izooba.
en: Every place whereon the soles of your feet shall tread shall be your's: from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates, even unto the uttermost sea shall your coast be.

rr: Tihaine muntu weena oribaasa kubaza omu kaso; MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu aryaitsa obwoba ensi yoona ei muriribatamu, kandi agireetere okutiina ahabwanyu, nk'oku yaabaraganiise.
en: There shall no man be able to stand before you: for the LORD your God shall lay the fear of you and the dread of you upon all the land that ye shall tread upon, as he hath said unto you.

rr: Reeba, eri izooba ninta omu maisho gaanyu omugisha n'omukyeeno
en: Behold, I set before you this day a blessing and a curse;

rr: omugisha ku muryorobera ebiragiro bya MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu, ebi ndikubaragiira eri izooba
en: a blessing, if ye obey the commandments of the LORD your God, which I command you this day:

rr: n'omukyeeno ku muryanga kworobera ebiragiro bya MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu, mwateishuka omuhanda ogu ndikubaragiira eri izooba, mwakuratira baaruhanga abandi, abu mutakamanyaga.
en: and a curse, if ye will not obey the commandments of the LORD your God, but turn aside out of the way which I command you this day, to go after other gods, which ye have not known.

rr: Kandi MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu ku aribahitsya omu nsi, ei murikuza kukubuura, muryata omugisha aha rushozi Gerizimu n'omukyeeno aha rushozi Ebali.
en: And it shall come to pass, when the LORD thy God hath brought thee in unto the land whither thou goest to possess it, that thou shalt put the blessing upon mount Gerizim, and the curse upon mount Ebal.

rr: Enshozi ezo tiziri seeri ya Yorudani, oburengyerwa-izooba bw'omuhanda omu nsi y'Abanyakanaani, abatwire omuri Araba, ahashungaine na Gilugaali, aha rubaju rw'emyela ya Moore?
en: Are they not on the other side Jordan, by the way where the sun goeth down, in the land of the Canaanites, which dwell in the champaign over against Gilgal, beside the plains of Moreh?

rr: Ahakuba nimwija kwambuka Yorudani kuza omu nsi ei MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu arikubaha kukubuura, kandi kwo muryagikubuura, mugituuremu.
en: For ye shall pass over Jordan to go in to possess the land which the LORD your God giveth you, and ye shall possess it, and dwell therein.

rr: Kandi muryaguma mute omutima aha biragiro ebyatairweho n'ebyaragiirwe byona, ebi ndikuta omu maisho gaanyu eri izooba, mubyorobere.
en: And ye shall observe to do all the statutes and judgments which I set before you this day.

rr: Ebi nibyo biragiro ebyatairweho n'ebyaragiirwe, ebi mushemereire kutaho omutima, mukabyorobera muri omu nsi ei MUKAMA Ruhanga wa baashwenkuriimwe yaabahaire kukubuura, ebiro byona ebi murimara omu nsi.
en: These are the statutes and judgments, which ye shall observe to do in the land, which the LORD God of thy fathers giveth thee to possess it, all the days that ye live upon the earth. Religious Statutes

rr: Mutaribura kusheenya emyanya yoona, ei amahanga, agu murikwija kunyaga, gaabaire gaheererezamu baaruhanga baago, ey'aha nshozi ndaingwa, n'aha bibungo, n'ey'ahansi ya buri kiti ekyetwa omurinzi
en: Ye shall utterly destroy all the places, wherein the nations which ye shall possess served their gods, upon the high mountains, and upon the hills, and under every green tree:

rr: kandi muryasheenya amatambiro gaabo, musheenyagure enyomyo zaabo z'amabaare ezi baayombekire, mwotsye Ashera zaabo n'omuriro, mutemagure ebishushani bya baaruhanga baabo ebibaizire; mumareho eiziina ryabo omu mwanya ogwo.
en: and ye shall overthrow their altars, and break their pillars, and burn their groves with fire; and ye shall hew down the graven images of their gods, and destroy the names of them out of that place.

rr: Kwonka imwe tikwo murigirira MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu
en: Ye shall not do so unto the LORD your God.

rr: kureka muryasherura omwanya, ogu MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu aritoorana omu nganda zaanyu zoona, kuba nigwo yaatamu eiziina rye, akagugira Obutaaho bwe
en: But unto the place which the LORD your God shall choose out of all your tribes to put his name there, even unto his habitation shall ye seek, and thither thou shalt come:

rr: okwo niyo muriguma nimuza, kandi okwo niyo muriguma nimureeta ebitambo byanyu eby'okwotsya n'ebindi bitambo, na kimwe kya ikumi kyanyu, n'empongano ezi muhonga, n'ebi muhayo ahabw'okuhiga, n'ebi muhayo mweyendeire, n'emijigaijo y'amasyo gaanyu g'ente n'ag'entaama
en: and thither ye shall bring your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, and your tithes, and heave offerings of your hand, and your vows, and your freewill offerings, and the firstlings of your herds and of your flocks:

rr: okwo niyo muririira omu maisho ga MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu, niyo imwe n'ab'omu maka gaanyu murishemerererwa ekintu kyona eki muritaho engaro, eki MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu ariba abaheereiremu omugisha.
en: and there ye shall eat before the LORD your God, and ye shall rejoice in all that ye put your hand unto, ye and your households, wherein the LORD thy God hath blessed thee.

rr: Mutarikora nk'ebi byona ebi turikukora omu bunaku obu, obu buri muntu arikukora eki arikusiima
en: Ye shall not do after all the things that we do here this day, every man whatsoever is right in his own eyes.

rr: ahabw'okuba timukahikire h'okuhuumurira n'omu buhunguzi, obu MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu arikubaha.
en: For ye are not as yet come to the rest and to the inheritance, which the LORD your God giveth you.

rr: Kwonka ku muryambuka Yorudani, mwatuura omu nsi ei MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu arikubaha kuhungura, yaabahuumuza engamba z'abazigu baanyu boona abariba babeehinguririize, ngu mubone kugituuramu buhooro
en: But when ye go over Jordan, and dwell in the land which the LORD your God giveth you to inherit, and when he giveth you rest from all your enemies round about, so that ye dwell in safety;

rr: obwo muryaguma nimureeta ebi ndikubaragiira byona omu mwanya ogu MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu aritoorana kugumyamu eiziina rye, ebitambo byanyu eby'okwotsya n'ebindi bitambo, na kimwe kya ikumi kyanyu, n'empongano ezi muhonga n'ebi muritoorana kuragaanisa kuhayo ahari MUKAMA
en: then there shall be a place which the LORD your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there; thither shall ye bring all that I command you; your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, your tithes, and the heave offering of your hand, and all your choice vows which ye vow unto the LORD :

rr: kandi muryayesiimira omu maisho ga MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu, imwe na batabani baanyu na bahara baanyu n'abahuuku baanyu n'abazaana baanyu, n'Abaleevi abari omu maka gaanyu, ahakuba tibaine mugabo n'obu bwakuba obuhunguzi omuriimwe.
en: and ye shall rejoice before the LORD your God, ye, and your sons, and your daughters, and your menservants, and your maidservants, and the Levite that is within your gates; forasmuch as he hath no part nor inheritance with you.

rr: Mwerinde mutaritambira ebitambo byanyu ahu murishanga hoona
en: Take heed to thyself that thou offer not thy burnt offerings in every place that thou seest:

rr: kureka omu mwanya ogu MUKAMA aritoorana omuri rumwe aha nganda zaanyu, mube nimwo mwatambira ebitambo byanyu by'okwotsya, kandi mube nimwo mwakorera ebi ndikubaragiira byona.
en: but in the place which the LORD shall choose in one of thy tribes, there thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings, and there thou shalt do all that I command thee.

rr: Kwonka nimwikirizibwa kwita enyamaishwa n'okurya enyama yaazo, nk'oku murikwenda, omu maka gaanyu goona, nk'oku MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu ariba abahaire omugisha; abatashemeire n'abashemeire boona nibaikirizibwa kugiryaho, nk'oku barya esirabo n'empara.
en: Notwithstanding thou mayest kill and eat flesh in all thy gates, whatsoever thy soul lusteth after, according to the blessing of the LORD thy God which he hath given thee: the unclean and the clean may eat thereof, as of the roebuck, and as of the hart.

rr: Kwonka mutarirya eshagama, kureka muryagyata ahansi nk'amaizi.
en: Only ye shall not eat the blood; ye shall pour it upon the earth as water.

rr: Kandi kimwe kya ikumi ky'engano zaanyu n'ekya viinyo yaanyu n'eky'amajuta gaanyu g'emizeituuni, n'emijigaijo y'amasyo gaanyu g'ente n'ag'entaama, n'ekintu kyona eki mwaraganiise kuhayo, n'eki murihayo n'omutima ogweyendeire, n'empongano ezi murihonga, ebyo byona mutaribiriira omu maka gaanyu
en: Thou mayest not eat within thy gates the tithe of thy corn, or of thy wine, or of thy oil, or the firstlings of thy herds or of thy flock, nor any of thy vows which thou vowest, nor thy freewill offerings, or heave offering of thine hand:

rr: kureka muryabiriira omu maisho ga MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu omu mwanya ogu aritoorana, imwe na batabani baanyu na bahara baanyu n'abahuuku baanyu n'abazaana baanyu n'Abaleevi abari omu maka gaanyu; kandi muryayesiimira omu maisho ga MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu omuri byona ebi muritaho engaro.
en: but thou must eat them before the LORD thy God in the place which the LORD thy God shall choose, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite that is within thy gates: and thou shalt rejoice before the LORD thy God in all that thou puttest thine hands unto.

rr: Mwerinde mutaryebwa Omuleevi ebiro byona ebi murimara omu nsi yaanyu.
en: Take heed to thyself that thou forsake not the Levite as long as thou livest upon the earth.

rr: MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe ku arihangusya ensi yaawe nk'oku yaakuraganiise, waagira oti: Niinyenda kurya enyama, ahakuba amagara gangye niyo gakunda; oryaikirizibwa kurya enyama nk'oku orikwenda.
en: When the LORD thy God shall enlarge thy border, as he hath promised thee, and thou shalt say, I will eat flesh, because thy soul longeth to eat flesh; thou mayest eat flesh, whatsoever thy soul lusteth after.

rr: Omwanya ogu MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe ariba atooraine kugumyamu eiziina rye, ku guriba gukuri hare, oryaita omu masyo gaawe g'ente n'ag'entaama, agu MUKAMA yaakuhaire, nk'oku naakuragiire; oryariira omu ka yaawe, nk'oku orikwenda kwona.
en: If the place which the LORD thy God hath chosen to put his name there be too far from thee, then thou shalt kill of thy herd and of thy flock, which the LORD hath given thee, as I have commanded thee, and thou shalt eat in thy gates whatsoever thy soul lusteth after.

rr: Nk'oku barya esirabo n'empara, nikwo orirya egyo nyama; abatashemeire n'abashemeire boona nibaikirizibwa kugirya.
en: Even as the roebuck and the hart is eaten, so thou shalt eat them: the unclean and the clean shall eat of them alike.

rr: Kwonka eki oryerinda, n'okurya eshagama; ahakuba eshagama n'amagara; n'ahabw'ekyo otarirya enyama n'amagara gaayo.
en: Only be sure that thou eat not the blood: for the blood is the life; and thou mayest not eat the life with the flesh.

rr: Otarigirya, kureka oryagyata ahansi nk'amaizi.
en: Thou shalt not eat it; thou shalt pour it upon the earth as water.

rr: Otarigirya, obone kuba gye, hamwe n'abaana baawe abarikurataho, ku oriba waakozire ebirikusiimwa MUKAMA.
en: Thou shalt not eat it; that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, when thou shalt do that which is right in the sight of the LORD .

rr: Kwonka ebintu byanyu ebirikwera, ebi oshemereire kuhonga, n'empongano zaawe z'ebi oragaanisa noohiga, oryabitwara, oze omu mwanya ogu MUKAMA aritoorana
en: Only thy holy things which thou hast, and thy vows, thou shalt take, and go unto the place which the LORD shall choose:

rr: otambire ebitambo byawe eby'okwotsya, enyama n'eshagama, aha itambiro rya MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe; eshagama y'ebitambo byawe eryashukwa aha itambiro rya MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe, reero enyama ogirye.
en: and thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings, the flesh and the blood, upon the altar of the LORD thy God: and the blood of thy sacrifices shall be poured out upon the altar of the LORD thy God, and thou shalt eat the flesh.

rr: Ogume oteho omutima kuhurira ebigambo ebi byona, ebi ndikukuragiira, obone kuba gye ebiro byona hamwe n'abaana baawe abarikurataho, ku oriba waakozire ebirungi kandi ebirikusiimwa MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe.
en: Observe and hear all these words which I command thee, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee for ever, when thou doest that which is good and right in the sight of the LORD thy God.

rr: MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe ku arihwerekyereza amahanga omu maisho gaawe omu nsi ei orikuza kukubuura, waagikubuura, waagituuramu
en: When the LORD thy God shall cut off the nations from before thee, whither thou goest to possess them, and thou succeedest them, and dwellest in their land;

rr: oyerinde otaritegwa kugakuratira, gaherize kuhwerekyerezibwa omu maisho gaawe, okabuuririza ebya baaruhanga baabo noogira oti: Amahanga aga gakaba gaheereza gata baaruhanga baago? naanye nkabona kutwaza ntyo.
en: take heed to thyself that thou be not snared by following them, after that they be destroyed from before thee; and that thou enquire not after their gods, saying, How did these nations serve their gods? even so will I do likewise.

rr: Kwonka iwe tikwo origirira MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe; ahakuba bo bakaba bakorera baaruhanga baabo buri kintu kyona ekirikunugwa eki MUKAMA ayanga; nangwa na batabani baabo na bahara baabo nabo babookyeza baaruhanga baabo omu muriro.
en: Thou shalt not do so unto the LORD thy God: for every abomination to the LORD , which he hateth, have they done unto their gods; for even their sons and their daughters they have burnt in the fire to their gods.

rr: Eki ndikubaragiira kyona, nikyo mushemereire kutaho omutima kukora; mutarikyongyeraho, kandi mutarikicwaho.
en: What thing soever I command you, observe to do it: thou shalt not add thereto, nor diminish from it.

rr: Omuriimwe ku hariimukamu nabi nari omurootsi w'ebirooto, yaabakorera akamanyiso nari eky'okutangaaza
en: If there arise among you a prophet, or a dreamer of dreams, and giveth thee a sign or a wonder,

rr: kandi ako kamanyiso nari eky'okutangaaza ekyo eki abagagambiireho kyahikiirira, yagaruka yaagira ati: Ka tukuratire baaruhanga abandi abu mutakamanyaga, tubaheereze
en: and the sign or the wonder come to pass, whereof he spake unto thee, saying, Let us go after other gods, which thou hast not known, and let us serve them;

rr: mutarihurira ebigambo bya nabi ogwo nari eby'ogwo murootsi w'ebirooto; ahakuba MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu aryaba naabagyeza, kumanya ku muraabe nimukunda MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu n'omutima gwanyu gwona n'amagara gaanyu goona.
en: thou shalt not hearken unto the words of that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams: for the LORD your God proveth you, to know whether ye love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

rr: Muryaguma mukuratire MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu, mumutiine, mukwate ebiragiro bye, muhurire eiraka rye, mumuheereze, kandi mumuhamireho.
en: Ye shall walk after the LORD your God, and fear him, and keep his commandments, and obey his voice, and ye shall serve him, and cleave unto him.

rr: 1 Kandi nabi ogwo, nari ogwo murootsi w'ebirooto, aryaitwa, ahabw'okubagambira eby'okugomera MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu, owaabaihire omu nsi ya Misri, akabacungura omu nju y'obuhuuku, n'ahabw'okubateishura omuhanda ogu MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu yaabaragiire kugyenderamu.
en: And that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, shall be put to death; because he hath spoken to turn you away from the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, to thrust thee out of the way which the LORD thy God commanded thee to walk in.

rr: Ku muritwaza mutyo, muryaiha ekibi omuriimwe.
en: So shalt thou put the evil away from the midst of thee.

rr: Murumuna waawe, omwana wa nyoko, nari mutabani waawe, nari muhara waawe, nari omukazi waawe ow'aha mukono, nari munywani waawe ow'aha mara, ku arikwosyosya omu mubonano naagira ati: Ija, tuze kuheereza baaruhanga abandi, abu otakamanyaga, n'obu baakuba baashwenkuru
en: If thy brother, the son of thy mother, or thy son, or thy daughter, or the wife of thy bosom, or thy friend, which is as thine own soul, entice thee secretly, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which thou hast not known, thou, nor thy fathers;

rr: baaruhanga b'amahanga agabeehinguririize, agari haihi naimwe, nari agabari hare, okuruga aha muheru gw'ensi, okuhika aha gundi
en: namely , of the gods of the people which are round about you, nigh unto thee, or far off from thee, from the one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth;

rr: otarimwikiriza n'obu kwakuba okumuhurira; otarimureebesa eriisho ry'esaasi, otarimusaasira, kandi otarimushereka
en: thou shalt not consent unto him, nor hearken unto him; neither shall thine eye pity him, neither shalt thou spare, neither shalt thou conceal him:

rr: kureka buzimazima oryamwita; omukono gwawe gube nigwo gwamubanza, bwanyima hateho ey'abandi boona
en: but thou shalt surely kill him; thine hand shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterwards the hand of all the people.

rr: oryamuteera amabaare, afe, ahabw'okuba ayenzire kukubeihabeiha, ngu akwihe ahari MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe, owaakwihire omu nsi ya Misri, omu nju y'obuhuuku.
en: And thou shalt stone him with stones, that he die; because he hath sought to thrust thee away from the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.

rr: Kandi Abaisraeli boona baryakihurira, batiine, tibarigaruka kukora kibi ekirikwingana kityo omuriimwe.
en: And all Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall do no more any such wickedness as this is among you.

rr: Ku orihurira amakuru ahari rumwe aha ndembo zaawe, ezi MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe yaakuhaire kutuuramu, ngu
en: If thou shalt hear say in one of thy cities, which the LORD thy God hath given thee to dwell there, saying,

rr: hariho abantu babi abarugire omuriimwe, bakoosyosya abatwire omu rurembo rwabo, nibagira bati: Ka tugyende tuheereze baaruhanga abandi, abu mutakamanyaga
en: Certain men, the children of Belial, are gone out from among you, and have withdrawn the inhabitants of their city, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which ye have not known;

rr: obibuuririze, obikuratirire, obicondooze; ku orishanga biri eby'amazima bitarikubanganisibwa, ku ekihagaro ekirikushusha kityo kikoreirwe omuriimwe
en: then shalt thou enquire, and make search, and ask diligently; and, behold, if it be truth, and the thing certain, that such abomination is wrought among you;

rr: otaribura kwitsa ab'omuri orwo rurembo rurara, okarucwekyerereza kimwe n'ebirimu byona hamwe n'amatungo gaamwo.
en: thou shalt surely smite the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword, destroying it utterly, and all that is therein, and the cattle thereof, with the edge of the sword.

rr: Eminyago yaamwo yoona oryagirunda ahu emihanda erikuteeranira, oyotsye orwo rurembo n'eminyago yaamwo yoona, nk'oku bootsya ekitambo eky'okwokyeza kimwe ekitambiirwe MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu; orwo rurembo ruryaguma ruri omutuumo ebiro byona; tiruryombekwa bundi.
en: And thou shalt gather all the spoil of it into the midst of the street thereof, and shalt burn with fire the city, and all the spoil thereof every whit, for the LORD thy God: and it shall be an heap for ever; it shall not be built again.

rr: Otarigira ekintu kyona eki waagumya omu ngaro ahari ebyo ebyashorooreirwe MUKAMA, abone kureka ekiniga kye kingi, akugirire embabazi n'esaasi, akukanyise, nk'oku yaaraganiise baashwenkuru naarahira
en: And there shall cleave nought of the cursed thing to thine hand: that the LORD may turn from the fierceness of his anger, and shew thee mercy, and have compassion upon thee, and multiply thee, as he hath sworn unto thy fathers;

rr: ku origuma noohurira eiraka rya MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe, nookwata ebiragiro bye byona, ebi ndikukuragiira eri izooba, nookora ebirikusiimwa MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe.
en: when thou shalt hearken to the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep all his commandments which I command thee this day, to do that which is right in the eyes of the LORD thy God.

en: Currently Selected: Deuteronomy 13 : KJV Highlight Share <div class="flex w-full items-center gap-1 rtl:flex-row-reverse hove

rr: Muri abaana ba MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu; mutaryesharashara n'obu kwakuba okwemwa omu buso, nari okumwa bahungu ahabw'okuba omu rufu.
en: Ye are the children of the LORD your God: ye shall not cut yourselves, nor make any baldness between your eyes for the dead.

rr: Ahakuba muri eihanga eryereziibwe MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu, kandi MUKAMA akabatoorana omu mahanga goona ag'omu nsi kuba eihanga rye, eri yaayetooraniire.
en: For thou art an holy people unto the LORD thy God, and the LORD hath chosen thee to be a peculiar people unto himself, above all the nations that are upon the earth.

rr: Otarirya ekintu kyona ekirikuzira.
en: Thou shalt not eat any abominable thing.

rr: Ezi nizo nyamaishwa ezi murikwikirizibwa kurya-ente, entaama, embuzi
en: These are the beasts which ye shall eat: the ox, the sheep, and the goat,

rr: empara, esirabo, esa, enkorongo, enyemera, n'ekihondamabaare.
en: the hart, and the roebuck, and the fallow deer, and the wild goat, and the pygarg, and the wild ox, and the chamois.

rr: Omu nyamaishwa zoona buri nyamaishwa eyatsizemu ebyara, eine ebigyere by'ebyara bibiri, kandi erikwekuuma, mube niyo mwaguma nimurya.
en: And every beast that parteth the hoof, and cleaveth the cleft into two claws, and cheweth the cud among the beasts, that ye shall eat.

rr: Kwonka omuri ezo ezirikwekuuma, nari ezaatsizemu ebyara, ezi mutarizirya; engamira, orumi n'endirira ahabw'okuba zeekuuma, kwonka tizaatsizemu byara; zibe ezirikuzira ahariimwe
en: Nevertheless these ye shall not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the cloven hoof; as the camel, and the hare, and the coney: for they chew the cud, but divide not the hoof; therefore they are unclean unto you.

rr: kandi empunu, ahabw'okuba eyatsizemu ebyara, kwonka teyekuuma; ahariimwe nikizira; mutarirya enyama yaazo, n'obu kwakuba okukora aha mitumbi yaazo.
en: And the swine, because it divideth the hoof, yet cheweth not the cud, it is unclean unto you: ye shall not eat of their flesh, nor touch their dead carcase.

rr: Ahari byona eby'omu maizi ebi nibyo murikwikirizibwa kurya; ebiine amapapa n'engamba, mube nibyo mwarya
en: These ye shall eat of all that are in the waters: all that have fins and scales shall ye eat:

rr: ekitaine mapapa na ngamba mutarikirya; ahariimwe nikizira.
en: and whatsoever hath not fins and scales ye may not eat; it is unclean unto you.

rr: Enyonyi zoona ezitarikuzira nimwikirizibwa kuzirya.
en: Of all clean birds ye shall eat.

rr: Kwonka ezi nizo mutarikwikirizibwa kurya–eishamba, empungumareere, kaamushungu-shungu
en: But these are they of which ye shall not eat: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the ospray,

rr: ekyanira, nyakabaka n'oruganda rwayo
en: and the glede, and the kite, and the vulture after his kind,

rr: ekikoona kyona n'oruganda rwakyo
en: and every raven after his kind,

rr: maaya, ekishoma-bwire, enyangi, akaca n'oruganda rwako
en: and the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk after his kind,

rr: ekihihizi ekikye n'ekihango, enyawaawa
en: the little owl, and the great owl, and the swan,

rr: nyamunyonyi, ekihuhura-bahuta, ekiyoyo
en: and the pelican, and the gier eagle, and the cormorant,

rr: enkongoro, oruyongoyongo n'oruganda rwarwo, enkooherwa, n'orubaka.
en: and the stork, and the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.

rr: Ebikooko byona ebiine amapapa, ebirikugyendesa amaguru ahariimwe nikizira; mutaribirya
en: And every creeping thing that flieth is unclean unto you: they shall not be eaten.

rr: kureka enyonyi zoona ezitarikuzira nizo murikwikirizibwa kurya.
en: But of all clean fowls ye may eat.

rr: Mutarirya ekintu kyona ekyefeereire; nimwikirizibwa kukiha omunyaihanga otwire naimwe, akirye; nari shi nimwikirizibwa kukiguza omunyaihanga; ahakuba muri eihanga eryereziibwe MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu. Mutariteeka omwana gw'embuzi omu mahenehene ga nyinagwo. Ebiragiro by'ekicweka kimwe kya ikumi
en: Ye shall not eat of any thing that dieth of itself: thou shalt give it unto the stranger that is in thy gates, that he may eat it; or thou mayest sell it unto an alien: for thou art an holy people unto the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother's milk.

rr: Otaribura kuha kimwe kya ikumi eky'ebi oyeza omu misiri yaawe buri mwaka.
en: Thou shalt truly tithe all the increase of thy seed, that the field bringeth forth year by year.

rr: Kandi oryaguma oriire omu maisho ga MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe, omu mwanya ogu aritoorana kugumyamu eiziina rye, kimwe kya ikumi ky'engano zaawe, n'ekya viinyo yaawe n'eky'amajuta gaawe g'emizeituuni, n'emijigaijo y'amasyo gaawe g'ente n'ag'entaama, obone kwega kuguma nootiina MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe.
en: And thou shalt eat before the LORD thy God, in the place which he shall choose to place his name there, the tithe of thy corn, of thy wine, and of thine oil, and the firstlings of thy herds and of thy flocks; that thou mayest learn to fear the LORD thy God always.

rr: Obundi MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe ku ariheza kukuha omugisha, orugyendo ruryakubeera ruraingwa, oremwe kukitwarayo ahabw'omwanya kukuba hare ogu MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe ariba atooraine kugumyamu eiziina rye.
en: And if the way be too long for thee, so that thou art not able to carry it; or if the place be too far from thee, which the LORD thy God shall choose to set his name there, when the LORD thy God hath blessed thee:

rr: Ku kiriba kyabaire kityo, oryabiihamu efeeza, ozizingirire, ozitware omu mwanya ogu MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe ariba atooraine
en: then shalt thou turn it into money, and bind up the money in thine hand, and shalt go unto the place which the LORD thy God shall choose:

rr: oziguremu ebi orikwenda byona, yaaba nte, nari entaama, nari viinyo, nari eky'okunywa eky'amaani, nari ekindi kyona eki omutima gwawe gurikwenda; obiriire omu maisho ga MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe n'ab'omu ka yaawe boona, mushemererwe.
en: and thou shalt bestow that money for whatsoever thy soul lusteth after, for oxen, or for sheep, or for wine, or for strong drink, or for whatsoever thy soul desireth: and thou shalt eat there before the LORD thy God, and thou shalt rejoice, thou, and thine household,

rr: 1 Kandi n'Omuleevi otwire naiwe otarimwebwa, ahabw'okuba taine mugabo n'obu bwakuba obuhunguzi omuriimwe.
en: and the Levite that is within thy gates; thou shalt not forsake him; for he hath no part nor inheritance with thee.

rr: Aha muheru gwa buri myaka eshatu oryaiha aha bi oyerize omuri ogwo mwaka kimwe kya ikumi, okibiikye omu ka yaawe
en: At the end of three years thou shalt bring forth all the tithe of thine increase the same year, and shalt lay it up within thy gates:

rr: -12 ; reero Omuleevi ahabw'okutagira mugabo n'obu bwakuba obuhunguzi omuriimwe, n'omunyaihanga, n'efuuzi, n'omufaakazi, abatwire naiwe, nabo baije, barye, bahaagye, MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe abone kukuha omugisha omu mirimo yoona ei oriba nookora n'emikono yaawe.
en: and the Levite, (because he hath no part nor inheritance with thee,) and the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, which are within thy gates, shall come, and shall eat and be satisfied; that the LORD thy God may bless thee in all the work of thine hand which thou doest.

rr: Aha muheru gwa buri myaka mushanju oryaha abantu obusingye.
en: At the end of every seven years thou shalt make a release.

rr: Ogu nigwo muringo ogu murihamu obusingye; buri muntu weena oriba aine ou arikwihuza, aryareka ekyo eki yaagurize mutaahi we; atarikiihuza mutaahi we nari mwene ishe; ahabw'okuba okuha obusingye, okuragiirwe MUKAMA, kuherize kurangwa.
en: And this is the manner of the release: Every creditor that lendeth ought unto his neighbour shall release it ; he shall not exact it of his neighbour, or of his brother; because it is called the LORD 's release.

rr: Noikirizibwa kwihuza omunyaihanga; kwonka ekintu kyawe kyona ekiinwe mwene waanyu, oryakimurekyera.
en: Of a foreigner thou mayest exact it again: but that which is thine with thy brother thine hand shall release;

rr: Kwonka ku orihurira eiraka rya MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe, waataho omutima kworobera ebiragiro ebyo byona ebi ndikukuragiira eri izooba
en: save when there shall be no poor among you; for the LORD shall greatly bless thee in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance to possess it:

rr: tiharibaho booro omuriimwe; ahakuba MUKAMA taribura kukuha omugisha omu nsi ei MUKAMA arikukuha kukubuura kuba obuhunguzi
en: only if thou carefully hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to observe to do all these commandments which I command thee this day.

rr: ahabw'okuba MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe aryakuha omugisha, nk'oku yaakuraganiise; oryaguza amahanga maingi, kwonka iwe torigeeguzaho; oryategyeka amahanga maingi, kwonka go tigarikutegyeka.
en: For the LORD thy God blesseth thee, as he promised thee: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, but thou shalt not borrow; and thou shalt reign over many nations, but they shall not reign over thee.

rr: Ku haribaho omworo omuri beene waanyu omu ka emwe aha maka gaanyu omu nsi ei MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe arikukuha, otarigangaaza omutima, okaba engumya ahari mwene waanyu omworo
en: If there be among you a poor man of one of thy brethren within any of thy gates in thy land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, thou shalt not harden thine heart, nor shut thine hand from thy poor brother:

rr: kureka omushashaanurire engaro, omuguze ekirikubaasa kumumarira obukyene bw'ekyo eki akyenire.
en: but thou shalt open thine hand wide unto him, and shalt surely lend him sufficient for his need, in that which he wanteth.

rr: Oyerinde otarigira ekiteekateeko ky'obufura bukye omu mutima gwawe, okagira oti: Omwaka gwa mushanju ogw'okuha obusingye guri haihi; okareeba mwene waanyu eriisho ribi, okanga kugira eki waamuha, nawe akatakira MUKAMA naakutabaariza, haza kikakurugiramu ekibi.
en: Beware that there be not a thought in thy wicked heart, saying, The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand; and thine eye be evil against thy poor brother, and thou givest him nought; and he cry unto the LORD against thee, and it be sin unto thee.

rr: -11 ; Otaribura kumuha; kandi ku orimuha, otaritsigara noonyomwa omu mutima; ahabw'okuba ahabw'ekigambo ekyo MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe aryakuha omugisha omu mirimo yaawe yoona n'omuri byona ebi orikora n'emikono yaawe.
en: Thou shalt surely give him, and thine heart shall not be grieved when thou givest unto him: because that for this thing the LORD thy God shall bless thee in all thy works, and in all that thou puttest thine hand unto.

rr: Mumanye ngu abooro tibarihwa mu nsi; nikyo ndikukuragiirira nti: Otaribura kushashaanurira mwene waanyu engaro, omukyene n'omworo abari omu nsi yaawe.
en: For the poor shall never cease out of the land: therefore I command thee, saying, Thou shalt open thine hand wide unto thy brother, to thy poor, and to thy needy, in thy land.

rr: Ku barikuguza mwene waanyu Omuheburaayo nari Omuheburaayokazi, akukorere emyaka mukaaga; omu gwa mushanju omurekure, agyende n'obusingye.
en: And if thy brother, an Hebrew man, or an Hebrew woman, be sold unto thee, and serve thee six years; then in the seventh year thou shalt let him go free from thee.

rr: Kandi ku orimurekura, otarimureka, akagyenda engaro nsha
en: And when thou sendest him out free from thee, thou shalt not let him go away empty:

rr: kureka oryamuha aha bi otungire omu masyo gaawe, n'eby'aha mbuga yaawe, n'omu inyuukiro ryawe otarikunyomwa; nk'oku MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe ariba akuhaire omugisha, naiwe nikwo orimuha.
en: thou shalt furnish him liberally out of thy flock, and out of thy floor, and out of thy winepress: of that wherewith the LORD thy God hath blessed thee thou shalt give unto him.

rr: Oryaijuka naiwe ku waabaire ori omuhuuku omu nsi ya Misri, MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe akakucungura; nikyo ndikukuragiirira eki eri izooba.
en: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in the land of Egypt, and the LORD thy God redeemed thee: therefore I command thee this thing to day.

rr: Kwonka ku arikugambira ahabw'okukukunda n'eka yaawe, kandi n'okuba gye naiwe, ati: Tindikwija kukurugaho
en: And it shall be, if he say unto thee, I will not go away from thee; because he loveth thee and thine house, because he is well with thee;

rr: oryareeta empindu, ogimufumuze okutu, eyogyemu, ekwate orwigi; obwo aryaguma ari omuhuuku waawe ebiro byona.
en: then thou shalt take an aul, and thrust it through his ear unto the door, and he shall be thy servant for ever.

rr: Kandi n'omuzaana waawe nikwo orimutwaza otyo.
en: And also unto thy maidservant thou shalt do likewise.

rr: Ku orimurekura yaakurugaho n'obusingye, otaritsigara n'akangonongono; ahabw'okuba aryaba akukoreire emyaka mukaaga, iwe omwihwire kimwe kya kabiri eky'ebihembo by'omupakasi. Ku oritwaza otyo, MUKAMA aryakuha omugisha omu bi orikukora byona.
en: It shall not seem hard unto thee, when thou sendest him away free from thee; for he hath been worth a double hired servant to thee , in serving thee six years: and the LORD thy God shall bless thee in all that thou doest.

rr: Emijigaijo yoona ey'enimi n'empaya erizaarwa omu masyo gaawe g'ente n'ag'entaama, oryaguma ogyereze MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe; otarikoresa omujigaijo gw'ente yaawe, kandi otarikyemura ebyoya by'omujigaijo gw'entaama yaawe.
en: All the firstling males that come of thy herd and of thy flock thou shalt sanctify unto the LORD thy God: thou shalt do no work with the firstling of thy bullock, nor shear the firstling of thy sheep.

rr: Kureka iwe n'ab'omu ka yaawe muryaguriira omu maisho ga MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe buri mwaka omu mwanya ogu MUKAMA aritoorana.
en: Thou shalt eat it before the LORD thy God year by year in the place which the LORD shall choose, thou and thy household.

rr: Kwonka ku guriba gwine akamogo, oburema nari obuhumi, nari akandi kamogo koona akabi, otarigutambira MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe.
en: And if there be any blemish therein, as if it be lame, or blind, or have any ill blemish, thou shalt not sacrifice it unto the LORD thy God.

rr: Oryaguriira omu ka yaawe; abatashemeire n'abashemeire boona nibaikirizibwa kuguryaho, nk'oku barya esirabo n'empara.
en: Thou shalt eat it within thy gates: the unclean and the clean person shall eat it alike, as the roebuck, and as the hart.

rr: Kwonka otarirya eshagama yaagwo, kureka oryagyata ahansi nk'amaizi.
en: Only thou shalt not eat the blood thereof; thou shalt pour it upon the ground as water.

rr: Oryaguma oijukye okwezi kwa Abibu, orinde obugyenyi bw'Okuhingurwaho ahari MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe; ahabw'okuba omu kwezi kwa Abibu nibwo MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe yaakwiha omuri Misri nyekiro.
en: Observe the month of Abib, and keep the passover unto the LORD thy God: for in the month of Abib the LORD thy God brought thee forth out of Egypt by night.

rr: Kandi oryatambira MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe ekitambo ky'Okuhingurwaho, nookiiha omu masyo g'entaama nari ag'ente, okitambire omu mwanya ogu MUKAMA aritoorana kugumyamu eiziina rye.
en: Thou shalt therefore sacrifice the passover unto the LORD thy God, of the flock and the herd, in the place which the LORD shall choose to place his name there.

rr: Otarikiriisa omugaati gutumbisiibwe; oryamara ebiro mushanju nookiriisa omugaati gutatumbisiibwe, nigwo mugaati gw'okubonabona,–ahabw'okuba okaruga omu nsi ya Misri n'obwira,–obone kwijuka eizooba eri waarugiireho omu nsi ya Misri ebiro byawe byona.
en: Thou shalt eat no leavened bread with it; seven days shalt thou eat unleavened bread therewith, even the bread of affliction; for thou camest forth out of the land of Egypt in haste: that thou mayest remember the day when thou camest forth out of the land of Egypt all the days of thy life.

rr: Otarireebwa oine ekitumbisa kyona omu nsi yaawe yoona okumara ebiro mushanju; kandi hatarigira enyama yoona ey'eikitambo, eki oritamba aha izooba ry'okubanza omu mwabazyo, eyaaraaraho okuhitsya omu kasheeshe.
en: And there shall be no leavened bread seen with thee in all thy coast seven days; neither shall there any thing of the flesh, which thou sacrificedst the first day at even, remain all night until the morning.

rr: Otaritambira ekitambo ky'Okuhingurwaho omu rurembo rwona aha ndembo ezi MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe arikukuha
en: Thou mayest not sacrifice the passover within any of thy gates, which the LORD thy God giveth thee:

rr: kureka omu mwanya ogu MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe aritoorana kugumyamu eiziina rye, nimwo oritambira omwana gw'entaama gw'Okuhingurwaho omu mwabazyo, eizooba nirirengarenga, omu bunaku obu waarugiiremu Misri.
en: but at the place which the LORD thy God shall choose to place his name in, there thou shalt sacrifice the passover at even, at the going down of the sun, at the season that thou camest forth out of Egypt.

rr: Oryagwotsya, oguriire omu mwanya ogu MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe aritoorana; kandi omu kasheeshe ohindukye ogarukye omu mahema gaawe.
en: And thou shalt roast and eat it in the place which the LORD thy God shall choose: and thou shalt turn in the morning, and go unto thy tents.

rr: Oryamara ebiro mukaaga noorya emigaati etatumbisiibwe, kandi aha kiro kya mushanju habeho okuteerana okwereziibwe MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe; otarikikoreraho omurimo gwona.
en: Six days thou shalt eat unleavened bread: and on the seventh day shall be a solemn assembly to the LORD thy God: thou shalt do no work therein .

rr: Oryayebarira saabiiti mushanju; ozibare noihirira aha bunaku obu oritandikiraho kuta omusyo gw'engyesho aha ngano zaawe.
en: Seven weeks shalt thou number unto thee: begin to number the seven weeks from such time as thou beginnest to put the sickle to the corn.

rr: Oryarinda obugyenyi bwa saabiiti mushanju ahari MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe nooreeta omutoijo gw'empongano yaawe ogu oritoija n'omutima ogwekundiire, nk'oku MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe ariba akuhaire omugisha
en: And thou shalt keep the feast of weeks unto the LORD thy God with a tribute of a freewill offering of thine hand, which thou shalt give unto the LORD thy God , according as the LORD thy God hath blessed thee:

rr: kandi oryayesiimira omu maisho ga MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe omu mwanya ogu MUKAMA aritoorana kugumyamu eiziina rye, iwe na mutabani waawe na muhara waawe n'omuhuuku waawe n'omuzaana waawe n'Omuleevi otwire omu marembo gaawe n'omunyaihanga n'efuuzi n'omufaakazi abatwire naimwe
en: and thou shalt rejoice before the LORD thy God, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite that is within thy gates, and the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, that are among you, in the place which the LORD thy God hath chosen to place his name there.

rr: kandi oryaijuka ku waabaire ori omuhuuku omuri Misiri; ote omutima aha biragiro ebi ebyatairweho, kandi obyorobere.
en: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in Egypt: and thou shalt observe and do these statutes.

rr: Kandi oryarinda obugyenyi bw'Ensiisira, okumara ebiro mushanju, ku oriheza kuhunika eby'aha mbuga yaawe n'eby'omu inyuukiro ryawe
en: Thou shalt observe the feast of tabernacles seven days, after that thou hast gathered in thy corn and thy wine:

rr: oryashemererwa aha bugyenyi bwawe, iwe na mutabani waawe na muhara waawe n'omuhuuku waawe n'omuzaana waawe n'Omuleevi n'omunyaihanga n'efuuzi n'omufaakazi abatwire naiwe.
en: and thou shalt rejoice in thy feast, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite, the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, that are within thy gates.

rr: Oryamara ebiro mushanju noorinda obwo bugyenyi ahari MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe, ori omu mwanya ogu aritoorana; ahakuba MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe aryakuha omugisha omu bi oriba oyerize byona, n'omu bi oriba okozire n'emikono yaawe byona; kandi oshemerererwe kimwe.
en: Seven days shalt thou keep a solemn feast unto the LORD thy God in the place which the LORD shall choose: because the LORD thy God shall bless thee in all thine increase, and in all the works of thine hands, therefore thou shalt surely rejoice.

rr: Buri mwaka abantu baawe boona abeetwa abashaija baryaguma bareebwe kashatu omu maisho ga MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe omu mwanya ogu aritoorana-aha bugyenyi bw'emigaati etatumbisiibwe, aha bugyenyi bwa saabiiti mushanju, n'aha bugyenyi bw'Ensiisira; kandi batarireebwa omu maisho ga MUKAMA engaro nsha
en: Three times in a year shall all thy males appear before the LORD thy God in the place which he shall choose; in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles: and they shall not appear before the LORD empty:

rr: buri muntu aryaguma ahe nk'oku arikubaasa, nk'omugisha ogu MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe ariba amuhaire oku guri.
en: every man shall give as he is able, according to the blessing of the LORD thy God which he hath given thee. Civil Statutes

rr: Oryataho abaramuzi n'abategyeki omu ndembo zaawe zoona ezi MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe arikukuha, nk'enganda zaawe oku ziri, bagume bacwere abantu emanja z'oburyo.
en: Judges and officers shalt thou make thee in all thy gates, which the LORD thy God giveth thee, throughout thy tribes: and they shall judge the people with just judgment.

rr: Otariita orubanja; otarishoroora omu bantu; kandi otarirya enguzi, ahakuba enguzi eita amaisho g'abanyabwengye, kandi eita emanja z'abahikiriire.
en: Thou shalt not wrest judgment; thou shalt not respect persons, neither take a gift: for a gift doth blind the eyes of the wise, and pervert the words of the righteous.

rr: Eby'oburyo, eby'oburyo byonka, obe nibyo waakuratira, obone kugumaho, ohungure ensi, ei MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe arikukuha.
en: That which is altogether just shalt thou follow, that thou mayest live, and inherit the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.

rr: Otaribyara ekiti kyona eky'omurinzi aha rubaju rw'eitambiro rya MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe, eri orikora.
en: Thou shalt not plant thee a grove of any trees near unto the altar of the LORD thy God, which thou shalt make thee.

rr: Kandi otaryebyarira enyomyo y'eibaare, ei MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe ayanga.
en: Neither shalt thou set thee up any image; which the LORD thy God hateth.

rr: Otaritambira MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe enimi nari entaama, eine akamogo nari akacokore koona; ahabw'okuba ekyo ne'kihagaro ahari MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe. Eby'okuzibira abantu kuramya ekishushani kyona
en: Thou shalt not sacrifice unto the LORD thy God any bullock, or sheep, wherein is blemish, or any evilfavouredness: for that is an abomination unto the LORD thy God.

rr: Omuriimwe, omuri ibara rurembo aha ndembo zaanyu, ezi MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu arikubaha, ku harireebekamu omushaija nari omukazi orikukora ekirikwangwa MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu, ekirikwita endagaano ye
en: If there be found among you, within any of thy gates which the LORD thy God giveth thee, man or woman, that hath wrought wickedness in the sight of the LORD thy God, in transgressing his covenant,

rr: akaza kuheereza baaruhanga abandi, akabaramya, nari shi akaramya eizooba nari okwezi nari ekintu kyona eky'omu ihe ry'eby'omu iguru, eki ntarabaragiire
en: and hath gone and served other gods, and worshipped them, either the sun, or moon, or any of the host of heaven, which I have not commanded;

rr: ku baribikugambira, waabihurira, oyezirikye kubibuuririza; ku orishanga biri eby'amazima, bitarikubanganisibwa, ku ekyo kihagaro kikoreirwe omuri Israeli
en: and it be told thee, and thou hast heard of it , and enquired diligently, and, behold, it be true, and the thing certain, that such abomination is wrought in Israel:

rr: muryashohoza ogwo mushaija nari ogwo mukazi okozire ekyo kihagaro, mumutware omu irembo ry'orurembo rwanyu, yaaba mushaija nari omukazi, mumuteere amabaare, afe.
en: then shalt thou bring forth that man or that woman, which have committed that wicked thing, unto thy gates, even that man or that woman, and shalt stone them with stones, till they die.

rr: Ow'okufa aryaitwa ahabwa baamushinja babiri nari bashatu; atariitwa ahabwa mushinja omwe.
en: At the mouth of two witnesses, or three witnesses, shall he that is worthy of death be put to death; but at the mouth of one witness he shall not be put to death.

rr: Emikono ya baamushinja ebe niyo yaamubanza, bwanyima hateho ey'abandi boona. Ku muritwaza mutyo, muryaiha ekibi omuriimwe. Okuramura emanja kw'abanyamurwa n'abaramuzi
en: The hands of the witnesses shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterward the hands of all the people. So thou shalt put the evil away from among you.

rr: Ku haribaho orubanja rwakurema, yaaba rw'obwitani bw'emiringo etari emwe, nari orw'entongane, nari orw'endwano, ebi barikufa omu marembo gaanyu, bwanyima oryaimuka, oze omu mwanya ogu MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe ariba atooraine
en: If there arise a matter too hard for thee in judgment, between blood and blood, between plea and plea, and between stroke and stroke, being matters of controversy within thy gates: then shalt thou arise, and get thee up into the place which the LORD thy God shall choose;

rr: ohikye aha Baleevi abanyamurwa, n'aha muramuzi oriba ariho omu biro ebyo, obeebuuzeho, babone kukumanyisa oku orubanja rushemereire kucuubwa
en: and thou shalt come unto the priests the Levites, and unto the judge that shall be in those days, and enquire; and they shall shew thee the sentence of judgment:

rr: bwanyima oryatwaza nk'okucwa kwabo oku kuri, oku barikuhaburira omuri ogwo mwanya gu MUKAMA ariba atooraine, oteho omutima kukora byona ebi barikwegyesa.
en: and thou shalt do according to the sentence, which they of that place which the LORD shall choose shall shew thee; and thou shalt observe to do according to all that they inform thee:

rr: Oryakora nk'ebi bariba bakuhabwire oku biri, kandi nk'okucwa oku bariba bakugambiire oku kuri; otariza aha rubaju rwa buryo nari orwa bumosho, okateishuka aha rubanja nk'oku bariba bakuhabwire.
en: according to the sentence of the law which they shall teach thee, and according to the judgment which they shall tell thee, thou shalt do: thou shalt not decline from the sentence which they shall shew thee, to the right hand, nor to the left.

rr: Kandi omuntu origira amaryo, akanga kuhurira omunyamurwa, oriba naayemerera okwo omu maisho ga MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu, nari omuramuzi, ogwo muntu aryaitwa, obone kwiha ekibi omuri Israeli.
en: And the man that will do presumptuously, and will not hearken unto the priest that standeth to minister there before the LORD thy God, or unto the judge, even that man shall die: and thou shalt put away the evil from Israel.

rr: N'abantu boona baryahurira, batiine, barekye kugaruka kugira amaryo. Eby'okutaho omugabe n'oku ashemereire kutwaza
en: And all the people shall hear, and fear, and do no more presumptuously.

rr: Ku muriba mwahikire omu nsi ei MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu arikubaha, mwagikubuura, mwagituuramu, mwagira muti, Ka tweteereho omugabe atutegyekye, nk'amahanga goona agatwehinguririize oku gari
en: When thou art come unto the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, and shalt possess it, and shalt dwell therein, and shalt say, I will set a king over me, like as all the nations that are about me;

rr: buzimazima mutaribura kweteeraho omugabe ou MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu aritoorana. Ou muritaho aryaba ow'omuri beene waanyu; mutaritaho omunyaihanga otari w'omuri beene waanyu.
en: thou shalt in any wise set him king over thee, whom the LORD thy God shall choose: one from among thy brethren shalt thou set king over thee: thou mayest not set a stranger over thee, which is not thy brother.

rr: Kwonka ataritunga embaraasi nyingi, n'obu kwakuba okugarura abantu omuri Misri, ngu abone kwetungirayo embaraasi nyingi; ahabw'okuba MUKAMA akabagira ati: Mutarigaruka kutoora ogwo muhanda.
en: But he shall not multiply horses to himself, nor cause the people to return to Egypt, to the end that he should multiply horses: forasmuch as the LORD hath said unto you, Ye shall henceforth return no more that way.

rr: Kandi arekye kushwera abakazi baingi, omutima gwe gukahinduka gukaruga ahari MUKAMA; kandi ataryekanyisiza efeeza n'ezaabu nyingi.
en: Neither shall he multiply wives to himself, that his heart turn not away: neither shall he greatly multiply to himself silver and gold.

rr: Kandi ku ariheza kuza aha ngoma, aryayehandiikira ebiragiro ebi omu kitabo, naabiiha omu kitabo ky'Abaleevi abanyamurwa.
en: And it shall be, when he sitteth upon the throne of his kingdom, that he shall write him a copy of this law in a book out of that which is before the priests the Levites:

rr: Ekyo kitabo agume nakyo, agume akishomemu ebiro byona ebi arimara akiriho, abone kwega kutiina MUKAMA Ruhanga we, n'okukwata ebigambo byona eby'ebiragiro n'ebyatairweho, n'okubyorobera
en: and it shall be with him, and he shall read therein all the days of his life: that he may learn to fear the LORD his God, to keep all the words of this law and these statutes, to do them:

rr: omutima gwe gurekye kwehimbisiza ahari beene waabo, akateishuka aha biragiro, akatoora aha rubaju rwa buryo nari orwa bumosho, haza obwo abone kuhangaarira omu bugabe bwe omuri Israeli, we n'oruzaaro rwe.
en: that his heart be not lifted up above his brethren, and that he turn not aside from the commandment, to the right hand, or to the left: to the end that he may prolong his days in his kingdom, he, and his children, in the midst of Israel.

rr: Abaleevi abanyamurwa nirwo ruganda rwona orwa Leevi, batarigira omugabo nari obuhunguzi omu Baisraeli, kureka baryaguma nibarya aha mpongano z'okwokibwa omu muriro, ezihongyeirwe MUKAMA, n'ebindi ebi bashemereire kuheebwa.
en: The priests the Levites, and all the tribe of Levi, shall have no part nor inheritance with Israel: they shall eat the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and his inheritance.

rr: Batarigira obuhunguzi omuri beene waabo. MUKAMA niwe buhunguzi bwabo, nk'oku yaabagambiire.
en: Therefore shall they have no inheritance among their brethren: the LORD is their inheritance, as he hath said unto them.

rr: Kandi ogwo nigwo mugabo gw'abanyamurwa ogushemereire kwihwa omu bantu; abarikutamba ebitambo, yaaba nte nari entaama, baryaguma nibaihiraho omunyamurwa ekivune ky'omukono, n'emishaya yombi, n'ekishansha.
en: And this shall be the priest's due from the people, from them that offer a sacrifice, whether it be ox or sheep; and they shall give unto the priest the shoulder, and the two cheeks, and the maw.

rr: Kandi omunyamurwa muryamuha aha miganuro y'ebi mwerize, engano zaanyu, na viinyo yaanyu, n'amajuta gaanyu ag'emizeituuni, kandi n'ebyoya by'okubanza eby'entaama zaanyu.
en: The firstfruit also of thy corn, of thy wine, and of thine oil, and the first of the fleece of thy sheep, shalt thou give him.

rr: Ahakuba niwe MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu yaatooraine omu nganda zaanyu zoona, ngu ayemerere kuheereza omu iziina rya MUKAMA, we n'abatabani ebiro byona.
en: For the LORD thy God hath chosen him out of all thy tribes, to stand to minister in the name of the LORD , him and his sons for ever.

rr: Kandi Omuleevi ku arifuruka omuri ibara rurembo aha ndembo zaanyu, ahu ariba atwire hoona omuri Israeli, yaaza omu mwanya ogu MUKAMA aritoorana akyekundiire
en: And if a Levite come from any of thy gates out of all Israel, where he sojourned, and come with all the desire of his mind unto the place which the LORD shall choose;

rr: nawe aryaikirizibwa kuheereza omu iziina rya MUKAMA Ruhanga we, nka bagyenzi be boona Abaleevi, abeemerera okwo omu maisho ga MUKAMA, oku baheereza.
en: then he shall minister in the name of the LORD his God, as all his brethren the Levites do , which stand there before the LORD .

rr: Aryatunga omugabo gw'eby'okurya ogurikwingana n'ey'abandi, otabariireho ebyarugire omu kutunda ebi ishe yaamuragire.
en: They shall have like portions to eat, beside that which cometh of the sale of his patrimony.

rr: Ku murihika omu nsi ei MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu arikubaha, mutaritooreza emicwe y'amahanga ago erikwangwa.
en: When thou art come into the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, thou shalt not learn to do after the abominations of those nations.

rr: Hatarigira omuntu weena omuriimwe owaarabya mutabani we nari muhara we omu muriro, nari owaaba omufumu, nari orikuragura ebiribaho, nari omuteezi w'ebyatsi, nari omucecezi
en: There shall not be found among you any one that maketh his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, or that useth divination, or an observer of times, or an enchanter, or a witch,

rr: nari omuhi w'engisha, nari orikubandwa emizimu, nari omurogi, nari orikubuuza abafu.
en: or a charmer, or a consulter with familiar spirits, or a wizard, or a necromancer.

rr: Ahakuba orikukora ebyo weena n'ekirikunugwa ahari MUKAMA, kandi ahabw'ebirikunugwa ebyo MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu nikyo arikubingira amahanga ago omu maisho gaanyu.
en: For all that do these things are an abomination unto the LORD : and because of these abominations the LORD thy God doth drive them out from before thee.

rr: Mube abahikire omu maisho ga MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu
en: Thou shalt be perfect with the LORD thy God.

rr: ahakuba amahanga ago, agu murikubuura, gata omutima aha barikuragura ebiribaho n'aha bafumu; kwonka imwe MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu takabaikirizaga kukora mutyo. Okuragura kw'okwija kwa nabi omukuru Masiya
en: For these nations, which thou shalt possess, hearkened unto observers of times, and unto diviners: but as for thee, the LORD thy God hath not suffered thee so to do .

rr: -26 ; . MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu aryabaimukiza nabi nkaanye, arugye omuriimwe omuri beene waanyu; ogwo niwe murihurira
en: The LORD thy God will raise up unto thee a Prophet from the midst of thee, of thy brethren, like unto me; unto him ye shall hearken;

rr: buzima kiryaba nk'ebi mwashabire MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu byona, muri ahari Horebu aha izooba riri eri mwabaire muteeraine, nimugira muti: Nitukweshengyereza tutagaruka kuhurira eiraka rya MUKAMA Ruhanga waitu, n'obu kwakuba okureeba ogu muriro mwingi obundi, tutakaafa.
en: according to all that thou desiredst of the LORD thy God in Horeb in the day of the assembly, saying, Let me not hear again the voice of the LORD my God, neither let me see this great fire any more, that I die not.

rr: MUKAMA yangira ati: Ebi bagambire byona, bihikire.
en: And the LORD said unto me, They have well spoken that which they have spoken.

rr: Ndyabaimukiza nabi nkaiwe omuribo omuri beene waabo, nte ebigambo byangye omu kanwa ke, abagambire ebi ndimuragiira byona.
en: I will raise them up a Prophet from among their brethren, like unto thee, and will put my words in his mouth; and he shall speak unto them all that I shall command him.

rr: Kandi weena oryanga kuhurira ebigambo byangye ebi arigamba omu iziina ryangye, ndyakimutura.
en: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever will not hearken unto my words which he shall speak in my name, I will require it of him.

rr: Kwonka nabi oryetuma kugamba ekigambo omu iziina ryangye eki ntamuragiire kugamba, nari shi origamba omu iziina rya baaruhanga abandi, nabi ogwo aryafa.
en: But the prophet, which shall presume to speak a word in my name, which I have not commanded him to speak, or that shall speak in the name of other gods, even that prophet shall die.

rr: Kandi ku muryebuuza omu mitima yaanyu muti: Nitubaasa tuta kumanya ekigambo eki MUKAMA atagambire?
en: And if thou say in thine heart, How shall we know the word which the LORD hath not spoken?

rr: Nabi ku arigamba omu iziina rya MUKAMA, eki yaagamba kitaabaho, nari kitaabakwo, biri ekigambo ekyo MUKAMA tiwe akigambire; kureka nabi ogwo niwe akyetumire; mutarimutiina.
en: When a prophet speaketh in the name of the LORD , if the thing follow not, nor come to pass, that is the thing which the LORD hath not spoken, but the prophet hath spoken it presumptuously: thou shalt not be afraid of him.

rr: MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu ku ariheza kucwekyereza amahanga agu arikubaha ensi yaago, mwagakubuura, mwatuura omu ndembo zaabo n'omu maka gaabo
en: When the LORD thy God hath cut off the nations, whose land the LORD thy God giveth thee, and thou succeedest them, and dwellest in their cities, and in their houses;

rr: muryayetooranira endembo ishatu omu nsi ei MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu arikubaha kukubuura
en: thou shalt separate three cities for thee in the midst of thy land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee to possess it.

rr: mweteereho emihanda, mubaganise ensi yaanyu ei MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu arikubaha omu bicweka bishatu, oriita omuntu weena ahungireyo.
en: Thou shalt prepare thee a way, and divide the coasts of thy land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee to inherit, into three parts, that every slayer may flee thither.

rr: Ebi nibyo byatairweho ahabw'oriita omuntu, ngu ahungireyo, akire. Omuntu weena oriita omuntu, atamwitsire nkana, kandi ashangirwe atarikumwanga
en: And this is the case of the slayer, which shall flee thither, that he may live: Whoso killeth his neighbour ignorantly, whom he hated not in time past;

rr: (nk'oku omuntu agyenda na mugyenzi we omu kibira kutiganda, akeereeza empango kutema ekiti, ekasyoka omu muhini, ekateera mugyenzi we ogwo, ekamwita), ahungire omuri rumwe ahari ezo ndembo, akire
en: as when a man goeth into the wood with his neighbour to hew wood, and his hand fetcheth a stroke with the axe to cut down the tree, and the head slippeth from the helve, and lighteth upon his neighbour, that he die; he shall flee unto one of those cities, and live:

rr: orikuhoorera kiitwa atarikurata kiita akiine ekiniga, akamukwatira omu muhanda ahabw'okuba hare, akamuteera, akamugwisaho; haza kunu yaaba atashemereire kwitwa, ahabw'okuba abaire atarikumwanga.
en: lest the avenger of the blood pursue the slayer, while his heart is hot, and overtake him, because the way is long, and slay him; whereas he was not worthy of death, inasmuch as he hated him not in time past.

rr: Nikyo ndikubaragiirira nti: Muryayetooranira endembo ishatu.
en: Wherefore I command thee, saying, Thou shalt separate three cities for thee.

rr: Kandi MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu ku arihangusya ensi yaanyu, nk'oku yaarahiire kuha baashwenkuriimwe, yaabaha ensi yoona ebi yaaraganiise baashwenkuriimwe kubaha
en: And if the LORD thy God enlarge thy coast, as he hath sworn unto thy fathers, and give thee all the land which he promised to give unto thy fathers;

rr: kandi ku murigumizamu kukwata ebiragiro ebi byona ebi ndikubaragiira eri izooba, okukunda MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu n'okugyendera omu mihanda ye ebiro byona, ahari ezo ndembo ishatu muryayongyeraho ezindi ishatu
en: if thou shalt keep all these commandments to do them, which I command thee this day, to love the LORD thy God, and to walk ever in his ways; then shalt thou add three cities more for thee, beside these three:

rr: eshagama y'abataine rubanja erekye kusheesherwa omu nsi yaanyu, ei MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu arikubaha kuba obuhunguzi, mukagiibwaho orubanja rwayo.
en: that innocent blood be not shed in thy land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance, and so blood be upon thee.

rr: Kwonka omuntu ku ariba naayanga mugyenzi we, yaamugwera, yaamugurukira, yaamuteera munonga, yaafa; bwanyima yaahungira omuri rumwe ahari ezo ndembo
en: But if any man hate his neighbour, and lie in wait for him, and rise up against him, and smite him mortally that he die, and fleeth into one of these cities:

rr: abakuru b'orurembo rwe baryatuma, bamwiheyo, bamuheyo aha muhoozi w'enzigu, aitwe.
en: then the elders of his city shall send and fetch him thence, and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood, that he may die.

rr: Amaisho gaanyu gatarimusaasira, kureka muryaiha omuri Israeli eshagama y'otaine rubanja, mubone kuba gye. Ekifubiro ky'abajurizi abarikujurira ebishuba
en: Thine eye shall not pity him, but thou shalt put away the guilt of innocent blood from Israel, that it may go well with thee.

rr: Otarikuura ekiti ky'omwatano gwa mutaahi waawe, ekyabyairwe aba ira omu buhunguzi obu oriheebwa omu nsi ei MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe arikukuha kukubuura.
en: Thou shalt not remove thy neighbour's landmark, which they of old time have set in thine inheritance, which thou shalt inherit in the land that the LORD thy God giveth thee to possess it.

rr: Mushinja omwe atariikirizibwa kushinja omuntu eki ashobize nari ekibi kyona eki akozire; kureka okushinja kwa baamushinja babiri nari bashatu nikwo kurihamya ekigambo kyona.
en: One witness shall not rise up against a man for any iniquity, or for any sin, in any sin that he sinneth: at the mouth of two witnesses, or at the mouth of three witnesses, shall the matter be established.

rr: Mushinja w'ebishuba ku ariimuka kushinja omuntu ekibi
en: If a false witness rise up against any man to testify against him that which is wrong;

rr: abarikutongana bombi baryayemerera omu maisho ga MUKAMA, omu maisho g'abanyamurwa n'abaramuzi abariba bariho omu biro ebyo
en: then both the men, between whom the controversy is , shall stand before the LORD , before the priests and the judges, which shall be in those days;

rr: abaramuzi babuuririze munonga; mushinja ku ariba ari ow'ebishuba, abeihereire mugyenzi we
en: and the judges shall make diligent inquisition: and, behold, if the witness be a false witness, and hath testified falsely against his brother;

rr: mumugire nk'oku abaire naayenda kugira mugyenzi we; ku muritwaza mutyo, muryaiha ekibi omuriimwe.
en: then shall ye do unto him, as he had thought to have done unto his brother: so shalt thou put the evil away from among you.

rr: Abaritsigaraho baryabihurira, batiine; okuruga aho tibarigaruka kukorera omuriimwe ekibi nk'ekyo.
en: And those which remain shall hear, and fear, and shall henceforth commit no more any such evil among you.

rr: Amaisho gaanyu gatarigira esaasi; amagara garyaguma garihwe agandi, eriisho ririhwe erindi, eriino ririhwe erindi, engaro erihwe endiijo, n'ekigyere kirihwe ekindi.
en: And thine eye shall not pity; but life shall go for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.
