en: Currently Selected: Deuteronomy 30 : KJV Highlight

rr: Musa yaagyenda, yaagambira Abaisraeli boona ebigambo ebi.
en: And Moses went and spake these words unto all Israel.

rr: Yaabagira ati: Eri izooba naahitsya emyaka igana na makumi abiri; tinkibaasa kushohora n'okutaaha; kandi MUKAMA akangira ati: Toryambuka Yorudani egi.
en: And he said unto them, I am an hundred and twenty years old this day; I can no more go out and come in: also the LORD hath said unto me, Thou shalt not go over this Jordan.

rr: MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu niwe aribeebembera kwambuka, kandi niwe arihwerekyereza amahanga ago omu maisho gaanyu, mukagakubuura; kandi Yoshua niwe aribeebembera kwambuka, nk'oku MUKAMA yaagambire.
en: The LORD thy God, he will go over before thee, and he will destroy these nations from before thee, and thou shalt possess them: and Joshua, he shall go over before thee, as the LORD hath said.

rr: MUKAMA aryagagira, nk'oku yaagizire Sihooni na Ogi, abagabe b'Abaamori, abu yaacwekyereize, n'ensi yaabo.
en: And the LORD shall do unto them as he did to Sihon and to Og, kings of the Amorites, and unto the land of them, whom he destroyed.

rr: MUKAMA aryagahayo omu maisho gaanyu, mugagire nk'ebiragiro byona ebi naabaragiire oku biri.
en: And the LORD shall give them up before your face, that ye may do unto them according unto all the commandments which I have commanded you.

rr: Mube ab'amaani, mugume omutima; mutagira obwoba, kandi mutabatiina; ahabw'okuba MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu niwe arikubeebembera; taribahemukaho, kandi taribatsigaho.
en: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for the LORD thy God, he it is that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.

rr: Musa yaayeta Yoshua, yaamugambirira omu maisho g'Abaisraeli boona ati: Ba ow'amaani, ogume omutima, ahakuba oryagyenda n'abantu aba omu nsi ei MUKAMA yaarahiire kuha baishenkurubo; kandi niiwe origibahunguza.
en: And Moses called unto Joshua, and said unto him in the sight of all Israel, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou must go with this people unto the land which the LORD hath sworn unto their fathers to give them; and thou shalt cause them to inherit it.

rr: MUKAMA niwe arikukwebembera; aryaguma naiwe, tarikuhemukaho, kandi tarikutsigaho; otatiina, n'obu kwakuba okuhahaaza omutima.
en: And the LORD , he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.

rr: Musa yaahandiika ebyo biragiro, yaabiha abanyamurwa beene Leevi, abaabaire baheeka eshanduukye y'endagaano ya MUKAMA, n'abakuru b'Abaisraeli boona.
en: And Moses wrote this law, and delivered it unto the priests the sons of Levi, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD , and unto all the elders of Israel.

rr: Musa yaabaragiira naagira ati: Aha muheru gwa buri myaka mushanju, omu bunaku obwatairweho omu mwaka gw'okuha obusingye, aha bugyenyi bw'Ensiisira
en: And Moses commanded them, saying, At the end of every seven years, in the solemnity of the year of release, in the feast of tabernacles,

rr: Abaisraeli boona ku bariba baizire kumurikwa omu maisho ga MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu omu mwanya ogu aritoorana, oryaguma oshomere ebiragiro ebi omu maisho g'Abaisraeli boona, nibabihurira.
en: when all Israel is come to appear before the LORD thy God in the place which he shall choose, thou shalt read this law before all Israel in their hearing.

rr: Oryateerana abantu, abashaija n'abakazi n'abaana n'abashuhuuki abariba batwire naimwe, babihurire, beegye kutiina MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu, bateho omutima kworobera ebigambo byona eby'ebi biragiro
en: Gather the people together, men, and women, and children, and thy stranger that is within thy gates, that they may hear, and that they may learn, and fear the LORD your God, and observe to do all the words of this law:

rr: kandi n'abaana baabo, abatakabimanyaga, babihurire, beegye kutiina MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu ebiro byona ebi murimara omu nsi, ei murikwambuka Yorudani kuza kukubuura. MUKAMA okugambira Musa eby'okufa kwe, n'ebiriba aha Baisraeli bwanyima
en: and that their children, which have not known any thing , may hear, and learn to fear the LORD your God, as long as ye live in the land whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati: Reeba, obunaku bw'okufa kwawe buri haihi; yeta Yoshua, mwije mweyorekye omu Ihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu, mbone kumukwatsa omurimo.
en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Behold, thy days approach that thou must die: call Joshua, and present yourselves in the tabernacle of the congregation, that I may give him a charge.

rr: Musa na Yoshua baagyenda, baayemurika omu Ihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu.
en: And Moses and Joshua went, and presented themselves in the tabernacle of the congregation.

rr: MUKAMA yaayeyoreka omuri eryo Ihema, ari omu nyomyo y'ekicu, kandi egyo nyomyo y'ekicu yaayemerera ahaiguru y'omuryango gwaryo.
en: And the LORD appeared in the tabernacle in a pillar of a cloud: and the pillar of the cloud stood over the door of the tabernacle.

rr: 1 -33 ; . MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati: Reeba, noija kufa, oshangye baashwenkuru; bwanyima aba bantu baryaimuka, baraaye nibakurata baaruhanga b'abanyamahanga ab'omu nsi, ei barikuza kutuuramu, banyimuure, baite endagaano yangye ei naaragaine nabo.
en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Behold, thou shalt sleep with thy fathers; and this people will rise up, and go a whoring after the gods of the strangers of the land, whither they go to be among them, and will forsake me, and break my covenant which I have made with them.

rr: Obwo bunaku ekiniga kyangye kiryabaakaho nk'omuriro, mbarugyeho, mbaime amaisho, bamarweho, bahikweho ebibi bingi n'eminyangararo; n'ahabw'ebyo omu bunaku obwo baryagira bati: Ekitureeteire kuhikwaho ebibi ebi, t'ahabw'okuba Ruhanga tari muriitwe?
en: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall befall them; so that they will say in that day, Are not these evils come upon us, because our God is not among us?

rr: Buzimazima omu bunaku obwo ndyabaima amaisho, mbature ebibi byona ebi bariba bakozire, omu kwehongyera baaruhanga abandi.
en: And I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evils which they shall have wrought, in that they are turned unto other gods.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo muhandiikye ekyeshongoro eki, iwe okyegyese Abaisraeli, kandi okibeeshongoze, kimbeere obujurizi bw'okushinja Abaisraeli
en: Now therefore write ye this song for you, and teach it the children of Israel: put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel.

rr: ahabw'okuba ku ndiheza kubahitsya omu nsi ei naarahiire kuha baishenkurubo, ensi y'amate n'obwoki, baaheza kurya n'okuhaaga, baagomoka, baryayehongyera baaruhanga abandi, babakorere, bangaye, baite endagaano yangye.
en: For when I shall have brought them into the land which I sware unto their fathers, that floweth with milk and honey; and they shall have eaten and filled themselves, and waxen fat; then will they turn unto other gods, and serve them, and provoke me, and break my covenant.

rr: Bwanyima ku barihikwaho ebibi bingi n'eminyangararo, ekyeshongoro eki kiryaba mushinja w'okuhamya omu maisho gaabo, ahabw'okuba tikiryeba, kiryaguma nikyeshongorwa oruzaaro rwabo. Ahakuba nimmanya ebiteekateeko byabo, ebi baine na hati, ntakabahikize mu nsi ei naarahiire kubaha.
en: And it shall come to pass, when many evils and troubles are befallen them, that this song shall testify against them as a witness; for it shall not be forgotten out of the mouths of their seed: for I know their imagination which they go about, even now, before I have brought them into the land which I sware.

rr: Atyo Musa yaahandiika ekyeshongoro ekyo ahari eryo izooba, yaakyegyesa Abaisraeli.
en: Moses therefore wrote this song the same day, and taught it the children of Israel.

rr: Kandi MUKAMA yaayehanangiriza Yoshua mwene Nuuni, naagira ati: Ba ow'amaani, ogume omutima, ahakuba niiwe orihitsya Abaisraeli omu nsi ei naarahiire kubaha; kandi ndyaguma naiwe.
en: And he gave Joshua the son of Nun a charge, and said, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou shalt bring the children of Israel into the land which I sware unto them: and I will be with thee. The Written Word

rr: Musa ku yaaherize kuhandiika ebigambo by'ebyo biragiro omu kitabo, yaabimariramu
en: And it came to pass, when Moses had made an end of writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,

rr: yaaragiira Abaleevi abaabaire baheeka eshanduukye y'endagaano ya MUKAMA, naagira ati
en: that Moses commanded the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD , saying,

rr: Mwakiire eki kitabo ky'ebiragiro, mukite aha rubaju rw'eshanduukye y'endagaano ya MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu, kigume kiri omujurizi w'okubashinja.
en: Take this book of the law, and put it in the side of the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, that it may be there for a witness against thee.

rr: Ahakuba nimmanya obugomi bwanyu n'ebitsya byanyu ebigangaire. Reeba, eri izooba mwagomera MUKAMA nkibaine; kaashwa ku ndiba naafiire, muryashura ki?
en: For I know thy rebellion, and thy stiff neck: behold, while I am yet alive with you this day, ye have been rebellious against the LORD ; and how much more after my death?

rr: Munteeranire abakuru b'enganda zaanyu boona n'abategyeki baanyu, mbone kugamba ebigambo ebi, babihurire, n'okweta eiguru n'ensi kubashinja.
en: Gather unto me all the elders of your tribes, and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and call heaven and earth to record against them.

rr: Ahabw'okuba nimmanya ngu, ku ndiheza kufa, muryayesiisira kimwe, muteishukye omuhanda ogu naabaragiire; kandi omu biro ebirikurataho muryahikwaho ebibi bingi, ahabw'okuba muryakora ebirikwangwa MUKAMA, kumugwisa kubi n'ebi murikora n'emikono yaanyu.
en: For I know that after my death ye will utterly corrupt yourselves , and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will befall you in the latter days; because ye will do evil in the sight of the LORD , to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.

rr: Atyo Musa yaagamba ebigambo by'ekyeshongoro eki, Abaisraeli boona babihuriire, okuhitsya obu yaabiherize.
en: And Moses spake in the ears of all the congregation of Israel the words of this song, until they were ended.

rr: Iwe iguru 'we, tega amatu, ngambe; N'ensi ehuriire ebigambo by'omu kanwa kangye.
en: Give ear, O ye heavens, and I will speak; And hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.

rr: Eby'okwegyesa byangye nibiija kugwa nk'enjura, N'ebigambo byangye bitonde nk'orume, Nk'orutoonyerera aha bunyaatsi bubisi, Nk'orujura aha bishaka.
en: My doctrine shall drop as the rain, My speech shall distil as the dew, As the small rain upon the tender herb, And as the showers upon the grass:

rr: Ahakuba naaza kuranga eiziina rya MUKAMA. Muhamye Ruhanga waitu ku ari mukuru rugambwa.
en: Because I will publish the name of the LORD : Ascribe ye greatness unto our God.

rr: Rukiri, omurimo gwe guhikire; Ahakuba emitwarize ye yoona n'ey'oburyo; Ni Ruhanga ow'okwesigwa, otagira kutahikiirira; N'ow'amazima, kandi ohikiriire.
en: He is the Rock, his work is perfect: For all his ways are judgment: A God of truth and without iniquity, Just and right is he.

rr: Bamukoreire ebitahikire; Tibakiri baana be ahabw'obumogo bwabo; N'ab'obusingye oburikwehabagiza kandi obukiikami.
en: They have corrupted themselves, their spot is not the spot of his children: They are a perverse and crooked generation.

rr: Imwe bashema 'mwe, abataine bwengye, Okwo nikwo murikuzimuurira MUKAMA?
en: Do ye thus requite the LORD , O foolish people and unwise?

rr: Tiwe Shoimwe owaabacungwire?
en: Is not he thy father that hath bought thee?

rr: Niwe yaabahangire, akabagumyaho.
en: Hath he not made thee, and established thee?

rr: Mwijukye ebiro ebya ira, Muteekateekye aha myaka y'obusingye bwingi obwa baashwenkuriimwe. Mubuuze baashoimwe, nibaija kubibashobororera; Mubuuze abakuru baanyu, nibaija kubibagambira.
en: Remember the days of old, Consider the years of many generations: Ask thy father, and he will shew thee; Thy elders, and they will tell thee.

rr: Rukira-boona obu yaaha amahanga obuhunguzi bwago, Akataanisa enganda z'abantu, Obwo akataho emyatano y'amahanga, Nk'omubaro gw'Abaisraeli oku gwabaire guri.
en: When the Most High divided to the nations their inheritance, When he separated the sons of Adam, He set the bounds of the people According to the number of the children of Israel.

rr: Ahakuba abantu ba MUKAMA nigwo mugabo gwe; Yakobo niwe mugabo gw'obuhunguzi bwe.
en: For the LORD 's portion is his people; Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.

rr: Akamushanga omu nsi erimu busha, Omu ihamba ei enyamaishwa zigambira; Yaamwehinguririza, yaamutaho omutima, Yaamurinda nk'emboni y'eriisho rye.
en: He found him in a desert land, And in the waste howling wilderness; He led him about, he instructed him, He kept him as the apple of his eye.

rr: Nk'oku empungu esisiimura ebyana byayo, Ekaimutsya amapapa ahaiguru yaabyo, Ekagajanjamura, ekabitwara, Ekabiheeka aha mapapa gaayo
en: As an eagle stirreth up her nest, Fluttereth over her young, Spreadeth abroad her wings, taketh them, Beareth them on her wings:

rr: Nikwo MUKAMA wenka yaamwebembeire atyo, Hatariho ruhanga ondiijo w'abanyamahanga owaakwataniise nawe.
en: So the LORD alone did lead him, And there was no strange god with him.

rr: Akamutunguura, yaamugyendesa omu myanya y'ahaiguru ey'omu nsi, Yaarya aha byezire omu misiri, Yaamunyuunyutisa obwoki bw'omu rukiri, N'amajuta omu rukiri orugumire munonga
en: He made him ride on the high places of the earth, That he might eat the increase of the fields; And he made him to suck honey out of the rock, And oil out of the flinty rock;

rr: Amate g'ente g'amakamo, n'amate g'entaama, N'ebishaju by'abaana b'entaama, n'empaya z'entaama, Amasyo ga Bashani g'ente n'ag'embuzi, N'engano ezirikukira oburungi; Kandi yaakunywaisa viinyo erikuruga omu shande y'emizaabibu.
en: Butter of kine, and milk of sheep, With fat of lambs, And rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, With the fat of kidneys of wheat; And thou didst drink the pure blood of the grape.

rr: Bwanyima Yeshuruuni yaagomoka, yaatera omugyere. K'ogomokire, okahanguha, okabengyeya! Yaimuura Ruhanga owaamuhangire, Yaagaya Rukiri w'okujunwa kwe.
en: But Jeshurun waxed fat, and kicked: Thou art waxen fat, thou art grown thick, thou art covered with fatness ; Then he forsook God which made him, And lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation.

rr: Baamwitsa eihari ahari baaruhanga b'abanyamahanga; Baamukwatsa ekiniga ahabw'ebirikunugwa byabo.
en: They provoked him to jealousy with strange gods , With abominations provoked they him to anger.

rr: Baatambira baadaimoni, abatari Ruhanga Nyamuhanga, Baaruhanga abu batakamanyaga, Baaruhanga abasya, abahangire, Abu baashwenkuriimwe baabaire batakamanyaga.
en: They sacrificed unto devils, not to God; To gods whom they knew not, To new gods that came newly up, Whom your fathers feared not.

rr: Rukiri owaabakire enda yaawe, toramutaireho mutima, Waayebwa Ruhanga owaakuzaire.
en: Of the Rock that begat thee thou art unmindful, And hast forgotten God that formed thee.

rr: MUKAMA yaakireeba, yaabatamirwa kimwe, Ahabw'okwitsibwa ekiniga batabani be na bahara be.
en: And when the LORD saw it , he abhorred them , Because of the provoking of his sons, and of his daughters.

rr: Yaagira ati: Ndyabaima amaisho, Ndeebe omuheru gwabo oku guriba; Ahabw'okuba n'ab'obusingye bw'obugomi, N'abaana abataine bwesigwa.
en: And he said, I will hide my face from them, I will see what their end shall be: For they are a very froward generation, Children in whom is no faith.

rr: Banyitsize eihari aha kitari Ruhanga Nyamuhanga; Bankwatsize ekiniga n'ebishushani byabo ebirikuramibwa; Naanye ndyabaitsa eihari aha bantu abatari ihanga buzima; Mbakwatse ekiniga n'eihanga eritaine bwengye
en: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God; They have provoked me to anger with their vanities: And I will move them to jealousy with those which are not a people; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.

rr: Ahakuba ekiniga kyangye kyakize omuriro, Kandi nigwaka okuhika okuzimu owa Nyamuteza, Nigubuguma omu nsi n'ebigyeziremu, Kandi nigwotsya emisingi y'enshozi.
en: For a fire is kindled in mine anger, And shall burn unto the lowest hell, And shall consume the earth with her increase, And set on fire the foundations of the mountains.

rr: Ndyabarundaho obubi bwingi, Mbamarireho emyambi yangye.
en: I will heap mischiefs upon them; I will spend mine arrows upon them.

rr: Baryakuuhuzibwa enjara, Bamarweho ekibabo ky'omuriro n'orufu orurikwita; Ndyabahayo omu maino g'enyamaishwa, N'aha biine obushegu ebirikugyendesa enda omu mucuucu.
en: They shall be burnt with hunger, and devoured with burning heat, And with bitter destruction: I will also send the teeth of beasts upon them, With the poison of serpents of the dust.

rr: Aheeru rurara eryabamaraho abaabo, N'omu nju bashangwemu ebirikutiinisa, Bicwekyereze abatsigazi n'empangare, Abarikwonka n'abagurusi b'enju.
en: The sword without, And terror within, Shall destroy both the young man and the virgin, The suckling also with the man of gray hairs.

rr: Nkaagizire nti: Ndyabataataanisa, mbanagye hare, Mbamareho, barekye kwijukwa omu bantu
en: I said, I would scatter them into corners, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men:

rr: Kuri ntaratiinire kurahurwa abazigu, bakankwatsa ekiniga, Ngu ababisha baabo barekye kwebeiha nibagira bati: Emikono yaitu niyo eriho; MUKAMA tiwe akozire ebi byona.
en: Were it not that I feared the wrath of the enemy, Lest their adversaries should behave themselves strangely, And lest they should say, Our hand is high, And the LORD hath not done all this.

rr: Ahakuba n'eihanga ry'abantu abatagira naama; Kandi abataine kwetegyereza.
en: For they are a nation void of counsel, Neither is there any understanding in them.

rr: Kuri baabaire baine obwengye, bakaayetegyereize eki, Bateekateeka aha by'omuheru gwabo.
en: O that they were wise, that they understood this, That they would consider their latter end!

rr: Omwe akaabaasize ata kubinga rukumi, N'ababiri okubinga kakumi, Kuri Rukiri waabo atarabarekwire, Kuri MUKAMA atarabahaireyo?
en: How should one chase a thousand, And two put ten thousand to flight, Except their Rock had sold them, And the LORD had shut them up?

rr: Ahakuba Rukiri waabo tari nka Rukiri waitu, Nangwa n'abazigu baitu ahabwabo nibakihamya.
en: For their rock is not as our Rock, Even our enemies themselves being judges.

rr: Kandi omuzaabibu gwabo gukakomooka aha gwa Sodoma, N'omu misiri ya Gomora; Ebijuma by'emizaabibu yaabo n'endurwe, Emitsitsa y'ebijuma byayo neeshaarira
en: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, And of the fields of Gomorrah: Their grapes are grapes of gall, Their clusters are bitter:

rr: Viinyo yaabo n'obushegu bw'ebijoka, N'obushegu bw'encwera oburikwita.
en: Their wine is the poison of dragons, And the cruel venom of asps.

rr: Ebyo tibibiikirwe owangye, Bikakomwa n'akamanyiso omu mabiikiro gangye?
en: Is not this laid up in store with me, And sealed up among my treasures?

rr: Okuhoora enzigu n'okwangye, n'okuzimuura n'okwangye, Omu bunaku obu ebigyere byabo biriterereramu; Ahabw'okuba ekiro kyabo eky'okuhikwaho akabi kiri haihi; N'ekifubiro kyabo kiryarahuka
en: To me belongeth vengeance, and recompence; Their foot shall slide in due time: For the day of their calamity is at hand, And the things that shall come upon them make haste.

rr: Ahakuba MUKAMA ku arireeba abantu be bahweirwemu amaani, Kandi hataine otsigaireho, yaaba muhuuku, nari ow'obusingye, Aryabaihaho orubanja, Agirire abairu be esaasi.
en: For the LORD shall judge his people, And repent himself for his servants, When he seeth that their power is gone, And there is none shut up, or left.

rr: Kandi aryagira ati: Baaruhanga baabo bari nkahi, Rukiri waabo ou baayesigire
en: And he shall say, Where are their gods, Their rock in whom they trusted,

rr: Abaabaire barya ebishaju by'ebitambo byabo, Bakanywa viinyo y'empongano zaabo z'eby'okunywa?
en: Which did eat the fat of their sacrifices, And drank the wine of their drink offerings?

rr: Mbwenu nibaimukye, babahwere, Babe nibo baabarinda.
en: Let them rise up and help you, And be your protection.

rr: Mureebe hati, Nyowe, Nyowe ekiti, ku ndi We, Ku hatariho ruhanga ondiijo, kureka Nyowe. Niinye nyita, nkazoora; Kandi niinye mputaaza, nkatamba. Tihaine orikubaasa kwiha omu mukono gwangye ou naakwatsire.
en: See now that I, even I, am he, And there is no god with me: I kill, and I make alive; I wound, and I heal: Neither is there any that can deliver out of my hand.

rr: Ahakuba niinyimutsya omukono gwangye ahaiguru, Nindahira, nk'oku mbaho ebiro byona
en: For I lift up my hand to heaven, And say, I live for ever.

rr: Ku ndityaza rurara yangye erikumurinkana, Omukono gwangye gwagikwata kucwa emanja; Ndyahoora abazigu bangye, Nzimuurire abarikuunyanga
en: If I whet my glittering sword, And mine hand take hold on judgment; I will render vengeance to mine enemies, And will reward them that hate me.

rr: Emyambi yangye ndyagisinza n'eshagama, Na rurara yangye erye enyama- Eshagama y'abaitsirwe n'ey'enkwatwa, Okwiha aha bakuru b'abategyeki b'abazigu.
en: I will make mine arrows drunk with blood, And my sword shall devour flesh; And that with the blood of the slain and of the captives, From the beginning of revenges upon the enemy.

rr: Imwe mahanga 'mwe, nimusiime abantu be; Ahakuba aryahoorera eshagama y'abairu be, Ahoore abazigu be, Kandi ahongyerere ensi y'abantu be.
en: Rejoice, O ye nations, with his people: For he will avenge the blood of his servants, And will render vengeance to his adversaries, And will be merciful unto his land, and to his people.

rr: Musa yaija, we na Yoshua mwene Nuuni baagamba ebigambo byona eby'ekyo kyeshongoro, abantu babihuriire.
en: And Moses came and spake all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he, and Hoshea the son of Nun.

rr: Musa ku yaaherize kugambira Abaisraeli boona ebyo bigambo byona
en: And Moses made an end of speaking all these words to all Israel:

rr: yaabagira ati: Mute emitima yaanyu aha bigambo byona, ebi naabeehanangiriza eri izooba, mubiragiire abaana baanyu, babone kworobera ebigambo byona eby'ebi biragiro.
en: and he said unto them, Set your hearts unto all the words which I testify among you this day, which ye shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.

rr: Ahakuba okubyorobera ti ky'okufa busha, kureka nigo magara gaanyu, kandi nikyo kiribahaisa okuhangaarira omu nsi ei murikwambuka Yorudani kuza kukubuura.
en: For it is not a vain thing for you; because it is your life: and through this thing ye shall prolong your days in the land, whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.

rr: Ahari eryo izooba MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses that selfsame day, saying,

rr: Temba oru rushozi Neebo ya Abariimu orw'omu nsi ya Moabu, orushungaine na Yeriko, oreebe ensi ya Kanaani, ei ndikuha Abaisraeli kuba eyaabo
en: Get thee up into this mountain Abarim, unto mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is over against Jericho; and behold the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel for a possession:

rr: ofeere ahari orwo rushozi oru waaza kutemba, oshangye abaanyu, nk'oku Arooni mukuru waawe yaafeereire aha rushozi Hoori, akashanga abaabo
en: and die in the mount whither thou goest up, and be gathered unto thy people; as Aaron thy brother died in mount Hor, and was gathered unto his people:

rr: ahabw'okuba mukancumuraho omu maisho g'Abaisraeli, muri aha maizi ga Meriba ahari Kadeshi omu ihamba rya Ziini; kandi timwampaisa kitiinisa omu Baisraeli.
en: because ye trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah-Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because ye sanctified me not in the midst of the children of Israel.

rr: Noija kureeba egyo nsi ei ndikuha Abaisraeli omu maisho gaawe, kwonka torigihikamu.
en: Yet thou shalt see the land before thee ; but thou shalt not go thither unto the land which I give the children of Israel.

rr: Currently Selected: Eky&x27;Ebiragiro 32 : RR64 Highlight Share <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8 19c-2.828 0-4.243 0-5.121-.879C2 17.243 2 15.828 2 13v-2c0-2.828 0-4
Ogu nigwo mugisha, ogu Musa omushaija wa Ruhanga yaashabire Abaisraeli, atakafiire.
en: And this is the blessing, wherewith Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.

rr: Naagira ati: MUKAMA akaruga Sinai; Yaabajugutira nk'omushekye, naaruga Seiri, Yaayakira aha rushozi Parani; Yaaruga omu bukumi bw'abarikwera, Omuriro guri aha rubaju rwe rwa buryo.
en: And he said, The LORD came from Sinai, And rose up from Seir unto them; He shined forth from mount Paran, And he came with ten thousands of saints: From his right hand went a fiery law for them.

rr: Eego, akakunda abantu be, Abarikwera be boona bakaba bari omu mukono gwe, Bashutami aha bigyere bye, Nibahurira ebi arikubahabura.
en: Yea, he loved the people; All his saints are in thy hand: And they sat down at thy feet; Every one shall receive of thy words.

rr: Musa akaturagiira ebiragiro Kuba obuhunguzi bw'eihanga rya Yakobo.
en: Moses commanded us a law, Even the inheritance of the congregation of Jacob.

rr: Atyo MUKAMA yaaba omukama omuri Yeshuruuni, Obu abakuru b'eihanga baateerana hamwe N'enganda za Israeli zoona.
en: And he was king in Jeshurun, When the heads of the people And the tribes of Israel were gathered together.

rr: Reubeeni agumeho, arekye kufa; N'abantu be barekye kuba bakye.
en: Let Reuben live, and not die; And let not his men be few.

rr: Ebi nibyo yaagambire ahari Yuda, naagira ati: Ai MUKAMA, hurira eiraka rya Yuda, Omureete omu bantu be; Akeerwanirira n'emikono ye, Naiwe omuhe emikono kurwanisa abazigu be.
en: And this is the blessing of Judah: and he said, Hear, LORD , the voice of Judah, And bring him unto his people: Let his hands be sufficient for him; And be thou an help to him from his enemies.

rr: Ahari Leevi yaagira ati: Ohe Leevi Tumimu yaawe, Kandi Urimu yaawe ogihe omuntu waawe orikutiina Ruhanga, Ou waagyereize ahari Maasa, Ou waahakanisiize aha maizi ga Meriba
en: And of Levi he said, Let thy Thummim and thy Urim be with thy holy one, Whom thou didst prove at Massah, And with whom thou didst strive at the waters of Meribah;

rr: Owaagambire ahari ishe na nyina, Ati: Tindikubamanya; Akooga beene ishe, kandi ateete aha baana be; Ahakuba Abaleevi bakoorobera ekigambo kyawe, Baakwata endagaano yaawe.
en: Who said unto his father and to his mother, I have not seen him; Neither did he acknowledge his brethren, Nor knew his own children: For they have observed thy word, And kept thy covenant.

rr: Baryayegyesa Yakobo eby'oburyo byawe, Beegyese na Israeli ebiragiro byawe; Baryaguma nibata obubaane omu maisho gaawe, Batambire aha itambiro ryawe ekitambo ky'okwokyeza kimwe.
en: They shall teach Jacob thy judgments, And Israel thy law: They shall put incense before thee, And whole burnt sacrifice upon thine altar.

rr: Ai MUKAMA, ogume ohe omugisha ebi atungire, Oikirize ebi arikukora n'emikono ye; Ohondahonde obwezirikiro bw'abarikwimuka kumurwanisa, Kandi n'obw'abarikumwanga, barekye kugaruka kwimuka.
en: Bless, LORD , his substance, And accept the work of his hands: Smite through the loins of them that rise against him, And of them that hate him, that they rise not again.

rr: Ahari Benyamiini yaagira ati: Orikukundwa MUKAMA aryatuura nawe buhooro; Agume naamusangira eizooba ryona, Obutaaho bwe bube amabega ge.
en: And of Benjamin he said, The beloved of the LORD shall dwell in safety by him; And the LORD shall cover him all the day long, And he shall dwell between his shoulders.

rr: Ahari Yosefu yaagira ati: Ensi ye MUKAMA agihe omugisha Gw'eby'obuguzi bwingi eby'ahaiguru omu iguru, N'eby'ahansi okuzimu
en: And of Joseph he said, Blessed of the LORD be his land, For the precious things of heaven, for the dew, And for the deep that coucheth beneath,

rr: Ogw'ebijuma by'obuguzi bwingi ebirikwezibwa eizooba, N'ogw'omweru mwingi ogw'emyaka eya buri kwezi
en: And for the precious fruits brought forth by the sun, And for the precious things put forth by the moon,

rr: Ogw'ebintu ebirikukira oburungi ebirikuruga omu nshozi eza ira, N'ogw'eby'obuguzi bwingi ebirikuruga omu bibungo ebitahwaho
en: And for the chief things of the ancient mountains, And for the precious things of the lasting hills,

rr: Ogw'eby'obuguzi bwingi eby'omu nsi n'ebigirimu, N'obuganzi ahari Ogwo owaabaire ari omu rushaka ruri. Emigisha egyo eze aha mutwe gwa Yosefu, Aha kazingiro k'ogwo owaashoroirwe omuri beene ishe, akaba omutegyeki waabo.
en: And for the precious things of the earth and fulness thereof, And for the good will of him that dwelt in the bush: Let the blessing come upon the head of Joseph, And upon the top of the head of him that was separated from his brethren.

rr: Enimi ye y'omujigaijo ekitiinisa n'ekyayo; Amahembe gaayo n'ag'embogo; Eryagabingisa amahanga goona Gahikye aha muheru gw'ensi; Ago mahembe nibwo bukumi bwingi bwa Efuraimu, N'enkumi nyingi za Manaase.
en: His glory is like the firstling of his bullock, And his horns are like the horns of unicorns: With them he shall push the people together to the ends of the earth: And they are the ten thousands of Ephraim, And they are the thousands of Manasseh.

rr: Ahari Zebuluuni yaagira ati: Iwe Zebuluuni, oyesiimire amagyenda gaawe, Naiwe Isakaari, oyesiimire amahema gaawe.
en: And of Zebulun he said, Rejoice, Zebulun, in thy going out; And, Issachar, in thy tents.

rr: Baryayeta amahanga, gaije aha rushozi rwabo, Batambireyo ebitambo by'abahikiriire; Ahakuba banyuunyuuta ebintu bingi ebirikuruga omu nyanja, N'eby'obutungi ebitarikumanywa ebiri omu musheenyi.
en: They shall call the people unto the mountain; There they shall offer sacrifices of righteousness: For they shall suck of the abundance of the seas, And of treasures hid in the sand.

rr: Ahari Gaadi yaagira ati: Orikuhangusya Gaadi aheebwe omugisha; Gaadi abundama nk'entare, Ataagura omukono n'akazingiro k'eishokye.
en: And of Gad he said, Blessed be he that enlargeth Gad: He dwelleth as a lion, And teareth the arm with the crown of the head.

rr: Akeetooranira ekicweka ky'ensi ekirikukira oburungi, Ahakuba okwo niyo omugabo gw'omukuru w'engabo gwabaire gubiikirwe. Yaija n'abandi bakuru b'eihanga, Yaakwatanisa na Israeli okuhikiiriza ebiragiro bya MUKAMA, N'eby'oburyo bye ebi yaaragiire.
en: And he provided the first part for himself, Because there, in a portion of the lawgiver, was he seated; And he came with the heads of the people, He executed the justice of the LORD , And his judgments with Israel.

rr: Ahari Daani yaagira ati: Daani n'ekyana ky'entare, Ekirikuguruka nikiruga Bashani.
en: And of Dan he said, Dan is a lion's whelp: He shall leap from Bashan.

rr: Ahari Nafutaali yaagira ati: Iwe Nafutaali, ohaagire obuganzi bwa MUKAMA, Oigutsi omugisha gwe, Kubuura ensi y'oburengyerwa-izooba n'ey'obukiizi-bwa-buryo.
en: And of Naphtali he said, O Naphtali, satisfied with favour, And full with the blessing of the LORD : Possess thou the west and the south.

rr: N'ahari Asheri yaagira ati: Asheri aheebwe omugisha gw'okuzaara abaana; Akundwe beene ishe; Ajabikye ekigyere kye omu majuta.
en: And of Asher he said, Let Asher be blessed with children; Let him be acceptable to his brethren, And let him dip his foot in oil.

rr: Empimbi zaawe zibe ebyoma n'emiringa; Nk'oku ebiro byawe biriingana, N'amaani gaawe nikwo gariba.
en: Thy shoes shall be iron and brass; And as thy days, so shall thy strength be .

rr: Iwe Yeshuruuni, tihariho ondiijo orikushushana na Ruhanga. Oritemba eiguru, naarirabamu kuza kukuhwera, Naaraba omu kaabunga n'ekitiinisa kye kingi.
en: There is none like unto the God of Jeshurun, Who rideth upon the heaven in thy help, And in his excellency on the sky.

rr: Ruhanga otahwaho niwe butaaho bwawe, Kandi ahansi yaawe hariho emikono etahwaho. Akabinga abazigu omu maisho gaawe, Yaagira ati: Bacwekyereze.
en: The eternal God is thy refuge, And underneath are the everlasting arms: And he shall thrust out the enemy from before thee; And shall say, Destroy them .

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo Israeli atuura buhooro, Eiziba rya Yakobo erituura ryonka Omu nsi y'engano na viinyo; Eego, eiguru rye ritoonyereza orume.
en: Israel then shall dwell in safety alone: The fountain of Jacob Shall be upon a land of corn and wine; Also his heavens shall drop down dew.

rr: Iwe Israeli, ohiiriirwe! N'oha orikushushana naiwe, Eihanga eryajunirwe MUKAMA, Engabo y'okuhwerwa kwawe, Kandi rurara y'okusingura kwawe! Abazigu baawe baryakugomookyera, Oribatiirire emyanya yaabo mikuru ey'okuramizamu. Currently Selected: Eky&x27;Ebiragiro 33 : RR64 Highlight <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="even
en: Happy art thou, O Israel: Who is like unto thee, O people saved by the LORD , The shield of thy help, And who is the sword of thy excellency! And thine enemies shall be found liars unto thee; And thou shalt tread upon their high places. Currently Selected: Deuteronomy 33 : KJV Highlight </di

rr: Musa yaaruga omu mpita za Moabu, yaatemba orushozi Neebo, yaahika aha mutwe gwa Pisiga, ahashungaine na Yeriko.
en: And Moses went up from the plains of Moab unto the mountain of Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is over against Jericho.

rr: MUKAMA yaamworeka ensi ya Gileadi yoona okuhika Daani
en: And the LORD shewed him all the land of Gilead, unto Dan,

rr: na Nafutaali yoona, n'ensi ya Efuraimu na Manaase n'ensi yoona eya Yuda okuhika aha Nyanja y'oburengyerwa-izooba
en: and all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim, and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, unto the utmost sea,

rr: yaamworeka na Negebu, n'oruhita rwa Yorudani, nirwo ruhanga rwa Yeriko orurembo rw'emikindo, okuhika Zoari.
en: and the south, and the plain of the valley of Jericho, the city of palm trees, unto Zoar.

rr: MUKAMA yaamugira ati: Eriya niyo nsi ei naarahiire ningira Abrahamu, Isaaka na Yakobo nti: Ndyagiha oruzaaro rwawe. Mbwenu naakwikiriza kugireeba n'amaisho, kwonka toryambuka kugizamu.
en: And the LORD said unto him, This is the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, saying, I will give it unto thy seed: I have caused thee to see it with thine eyes, but thou shalt not go over thither.

rr: Atyo Musa omugaragwa wa MUKAMA yaafeera okwo omu nsi ya Moabu, nk'oku MUKAMA yaagambire.
en: So Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab, according to the word of the LORD .

rr: Yaamuziika omu ruhanga omu nsi ya Moabu ahashungaine na Besi-peori; kwonka tihariho orikumanya ahu ekituuro kye kiri n'okuhitsya hati.
en: And he buried him in a valley in the land of Moab, over against Beth-peor: but no man knoweth of his sepulchre unto this day.

rr: Musa ogwo yaafa ahikize emyaka igana na makumi abiri, amaisho ge gatakagiirwemu ruho, n'amaani ge gatakatuubire.
en: And Moses was an hundred and twenty years old when he died: his eye was not dim, nor his natural force abated.

rr: Abaisraeli baamara ebiro makumi ashatu, nibacurira Musa omu mpita za Moabu. Bwanyima ebiro by'okuba omu rufu rwa Musa n'okumucurira byahwa.
en: And the children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days: so the days of weeping and mourning for Moses were ended.

rr: Yoshua mwene Nuuni akaba aijwire omwoyo gw'obwengye; ahabw'okuba Musa akaba yaamutaireho engaro. Abaisraeli baamuhurira, baakora nk'oku MUKAMA yaaragiire Musa.
en: And Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom; for Moses had laid his hands upon him: and the children of Israel hearkened unto him, and did as the LORD commanded Moses.

rr: Okuruga obwo tiharagarukire kubaho nabi ori nka Musa, ou MUKAMA yaabaire amanya, kandi akareebana nawe
en: And there arose not a prophet since in Israel like unto Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face,

rr: kandi tihariho owaakugyeragyeranisibwa nawe omu by'obumanyiso n'eby'okutangaaza byona, ebi MUKAMA yaamutumire kukora omu nsi ya Misri, ahari Faraho n'abaheereza be boona, n'ensi ye yoona
en: in all the signs and the wonders, which the LORD sent him to do in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,

rr: n'omu by'amaani maingi byona, n'ebirikutiinisa byona, ebi Musa yaakoreire omu maisho g'Abaisraeli boona.
en: and in all that mighty hand, and in all the great terror which Moses shewed in the sight of all Israel.
