rr: Bwanyima y'ebyo omugabe Ahasuero yaakuza Hamani mwene Hamedasa Omugagi, yaamugira omutegyeki mukuru, ekitebe kye yaakiha omwanya gw'ahaiguru okukira eby'abanyiginya bagyenzi be boona.
en: After these things did king Ahasuerus promote Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, and advanced him, and set his seat above all the princes that were with him.

rr: Abashaija b'omugabe boona, abaabaire batuura aha irembo ry'omugabe bakaba bamwinamira, bamutangirira; ahakuba omugabe nikwo yaabaire aragiire.
en: And all the king's servants, that were in the king's gate, bowed, and reverenced Haman: for the king had so commanded concerning him.

rr: Kwonka Morodekai we akaba atamwinamira, n'obu kwakuba okumutangirira.
en: But Mordecai bowed not, nor did him reverence.

rr: Bwanyima abo bashiaja b'omugabe baabuuza Morodekai ogwo bati: Ahabw'enki noohenda ekiragiro ky'omugabe?
en: Then the king's servants, which were in the king's gate, said unto Mordecai, Why transgressest thou the king's commandment?

en: Now it came to pass, when they spake daily unto him, and he hearkened not unto them, that they told Haman, to see whether Mordecai's matters would stand: for he had told them that he was a Jew.

rr: Hamani ku yaareebire Morodekai ataamwinamira, n'obu kwakuba okumutangirira, yaagira ekiniga kingi.
en: And when Haman saw that Mordecai bowed not, nor did him reverence, then was Haman full of wrath.

rr: Kwonka yaareeba okukwata Morodekai wenka, ku kitaine mugasho; ahabw'okuba bakaba bamugambiire eihanga rya Morodekai. N'ahabw'ekyo yaasherura oburyo bw'okucwekyereza Abayudaaya boona, abaabaire bari omu bugabe bwona obwa Ahasuero, eihanga rya Morodekai.
en: And he thought scorn to lay hands on Mordecai alone; for they had shewed him the people of Mordecai: wherefore Haman sought to destroy all the Jews that were throughout the whole kingdom of Ahasuerus, even the people of Mordecai.

rr: Bwanyima omu mwaka gwa ikumi n'ebiri ogw'omu busingye bw'omugabe Ahasuero, omu kwezi kw'okubanza okurikwetwa Nisani, baaragurisa Puuri, nikwo kuteera enteenyu, baaguma nibakikorera omu maisho ga Hamani buri izooba, ngu babone kumanya ekiro n'okwezi nibakuratanisa ebiro n'ameezi byona okuhitsya obu enteenyu yaakwatsire ekiro kya ikumi na bishatu ky'okwezi kwa ikumi n'abiri okurikwetwa Adari.
en: In the first month, that is , the month Nisan, in the twelfth year of king Ahasuerus, they cast Pur, that is , the lot, before Haman from day to day, and from month to month, to the twelfth month , that is , the month Adar.

rr: Bwanyima Hamani yaagambira omugabe Ahasuero ati: Hariho eihanga eyataataine rikajanjaara omu mashaza g'omu bugabe bwawe goona; ebiragiro byaryo tibiri nk'eby'agandi mahanga, kandi tibarikworobera biragiro by'omugabe; n'ahabw'ekyo tikiine ki kirikugasira omugabe kurigumisiririza.
en: And Haman said unto king Ahasuerus, There is a certain people scattered abroad and dispersed among the people in all the provinces of thy kingdom; and their laws are diverse from all people; neither keep they the king's laws: therefore it is not for the king's profit to suffer them.

rr: Nyakusinga omugabe, ku oraabe nookisiima, hateebweho ekiragiro kihandiikwe, bacwekyerezibwe; nyowe niinyija kuha etalanta z'efeeza kakumi, zaakiirwe abarikureeberera omurimo gw'omugabe, bazite omu mabiikiro ge.
en: If it please the king, let it be written that they may be destroyed: and I will pay ten thousand talents of silver to the hands of those that have the charge of the business, to bring it into the king's treasuries.

rr: Atyo omugabe yaajuura empeta ya'kamanyiso ke, yaagiha Hamani mwene Hamedasa Omuagagi, omuzigu w'Abayudaaya.
en: And the king took his ring from his hand, and gave it unto Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, the Jews' enemy.

rr: Omugabe yaagira Hamani ati: Efeeza zaawe yegumire nazo, kandi eryo ihanga naarikuha, origire nk'oku orikwenda.
en: And the king said unto Haman, The silver is given to thee, the people also, to do with them as it seemeth good to thee.

rr: -10 ; Bwanyima aha kiro kya ikumi na bishatu ky'okwezi kw'okubanza abahandiiki b'omugabe baayetwa, baahandiika ebi Hamani yaaragiira byona, baabitwekyera abategyeki b'omugabe, n'abategyeki abaabaire nibatwara amashaza g'omu bugabe bwe bwona, n'abanyiginya b'amahanga goona, omuri buri ishaza omu mihandiikire yaaryo, n'omuri buri ihanga omu rurimi rwaryo. en: Then were the king's scribes called on the thirteenth day of the first month, and there was written according to all that Haman had commanded unto the king's lieutenants, and to the governors that were over every province, and to the rulers of every people of every province according to the writing thereof, and to every people after their language; in the name of king Ahasuerus was it written, and sealed with the king's ring.

rr: Ezo baruha zaatwarwa baamatarisi omu mashaza g'omugabe goona, nizigamba kucwekyereza, okwita n'okumaraho Abayudaaya boona, abato n'abakuru, abaana n'abakazi, aha izooba rimwe, aha kiro kya ikumi na bishatu kw'okwezi kwa ikumi n'abiri okurikwetwa Adari, kandi n'okunyaga ebintu byabo
en: And the letters were sent by posts into all the king's provinces, to destroy, to kill, and to cause to perish, all Jews, both young and old, little children and women, in one day, even upon the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar, and to take the spoil of them for a prey.

rr: kandi ngu ebihandiikirwe omuri egyo baruha bishemereire kubugibwa omuri buri ishaza nk'ekiragiro, nibagambira amahanga goona kweteekatekyera eryo izooba.
en: The copy of the writing for a commandment to be given in every province was published unto all people, that they should be ready against that day.

rr: Baamatarisi baagyenda nibeehuta ahabw'ekiragiro ky'omugabe, kandi ekyo kiragiro kyabugibwa omu rurembo rukuru Shushani.
en: The posts went out, being hastened by the king's commandment, and the decree was given in Shushan the palace.

rr: Omugabe na Hamani baashutama kwenywera, kwonka ab'omuri orwo rurembo Shushani baashoberwa.
en: And the king and Haman sat down to drink; but the city Shushan was perplexed.

en: And in every province, whithersoever the king's commandment and his decree came, there was great mourning among the Jews, and fasting, and weeping, and wailing; and many lay in sackcloth and ashes.

en: So Esther's maids and her chamberlains came and told it her. Then was the queen exceedingly grieved; and she sent raiment to clothe Mordecai, and to take away his sackcloth from him: but he received it not.

en: Then called Esther for Hatach, one of the king's chamberlains, whom he had appointed to attend upon her, and gave him a commandment to Mordecai, to know what it was , and why it was .

en: And Mordecai told him of all that had happened unto him, and of the sum of the money that Haman had promised to pay to the king's treasuries for the Jews, to destroy them.

en: Also he gave him the copy of the writing of the decree that was given at Shushan to destroy them, to shew it unto Esther, and to declare it unto her, and to charge her that she should go in unto the king, to make supplication unto him, and to make request before him for her people.

rr: Hasaki yaagaruka ahari Esteeri, yaamugambira obutumwa bwa Morodekai.

en: Again Esther spake unto Hatach, and gave him commandment unto Mordecai;

rr: Baagambira Morodekai ebigambo bya Esteeri.
en: And they told to Mordecai Esther's words.

en: Then Mordecai commanded to answer Esther, Think not with thyself that thou shalt escape in the king's house, more than all the Jews.

rr: Omanye ngu, ku oraahuname omu biro ebi, eky'okuhuumuriza n'okukiza Abayudaaya nikiija kureetwa ahandi, kwonak iwe n'enju ya sho muryacwekyerera. N'oha orikumanya ekyakutaire aha ngoma, ku kutari kuhwera omu bunaku bw'akabi nk'obu?
en: For if thou altogether holdest thy peace at this time, then shall there enlargement and deliverance arise to the Jews from another place; but thou and thy father's house shall be destroyed: and who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this?

en: Then Esther bade them return Mordecai this answer ,

en: So Mordecai went his way, and did according to all that Esther had commanded him.

en: So Esther drew near, and touched the top of the sceptre.

en: And the king said unto Esther at the banquet of wine, What is thy petition? and it shall be granted thee: and what is thy request? even to the half of the kingdom it shall be performed.

en: if I have found favour in the sight of the king, and if it please the king to grant my petition, and to perform my request, let the king and Haman come to the banquet that I shall prepare for them, and I will do to morrow as the king hath said.

en: Then went Haman forth that day joyful and with a glad heart: but when Haman saw Mordecai in the king's gate, that he stood not up, nor moved for him, he was full of indignation against Mordecai.

rr: Kwonka yaagumisiriza, yaataaha omuka, yaatuma kweta banywani be n'omukazi we Zereshi
en: Nevertheless Haman refrained himself: and when he came home, he sent and called for his friends, and Zeresh his wife.

en: And Haman told them of the glory of his riches, and the multitude of his children, and all the things wherein the king had promoted him, and how he had advanced him above the princes and servants of the king.

en: Haman said moreover, Yea, Esther the queen did let no man come in with the king unto the banquet that she had prepared but myself; and to morrow am I invited unto her also with the king.

en: Then said Zeresh his wife and all his friends unto him, Let a gallows be made of fifty cubits high, and to morrow speak thou unto the king that Mordecai may be hanged thereon: then go thou in merrily with the king unto the banquet.

rr: Egyo naama yaashemeza Hamani; yaabyara ekyo kiti.

rr: Ekyo kiro omugabe yaabura oturo; yaaragiira ku bamureetera ekitabo ekirikwijutsya ebyabaireho, baakimushomera.
en: On that night could not the king sleep, and he commanded to bring the book of records of the chronicles; and they were read before the king.

en: And it was found written, that Mordecai had told of Bigthana and Teresh, two of the king's chamberlains, the keepers of the door, who sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus.

en: Then said the king's servants that ministered unto him, There is nothing done for him.

rr: Omugabe yaababuuza ati: N'oha ori omu kibuga?

en: Now Haman was come into the outward court of the king's house, to speak unto the king to hang Mordecai on the gallows that he had prepared for him.

en: So Haman came in. And the king said unto him, What shall be done unto the man whom the king delighteth to honour? Now Haman thought in his heart, To whom would the king delight to do honour more than to myself?

rr: Hamani nikwo kugarukamu omugabe ati: Omushaija ou omugabe arikusiima kuha ekitiinisa
en: And Haman answered the king, For the man whom the king delighteth to honour,

en: let the royal apparel be brought which the king useth to wear, and the horse that the king rideth upon, and the crown royal which is set upon his head:

en: and let this apparel and horse be delivered to the hand of one of the king's most noble princes, that they may array the man withal whom the king delighteth to honour, and bring him on horseback through the street of the city, and proclaim before him, Thus shall it be done to the man whom the king delighteth to honour.

rr: Ahonaaho omugabe yaagira Hamani ati: Rahuka oreete ebijwaro n'embaraasi, nk'oku waagamba, otwaze otyo Morodekai Omuyudaaya, oshutama aha irembo ry'omugabe. Otagira eki waatsiga ahari ebyo byona ebi waagamba.
en: Then the king said to Haman, Make haste, and take the apparel and the horse, as thou hast said, and do even so to Mordecai the Jew, that sitteth at the king's gate: let nothing fail of all that thou hast spoken.

rr: Atyo Hamani yaihayo bushuuti n'embaraasi, yaajweka Morodekai, yaamurabya omu kibuga kihango ky'orurembo, naaranga ati: Oku nikwo omushaija weena aritwazibwa ou omugabe arisiima kuha ekitiinisa.
en: Then took Haman the apparel and the horse, and arrayed Mordecai, and brought him on horseback through the street of the city, and proclaimed before him, Thus shall it be done unto the man whom the king delighteth to honour.

rr: Bwanyima Morodekai yaagaruka aha irembo ry'omugabe; kwonka Hamani yaayehuuta, yaataaha owe ayetwekyereire aha mutwe naarira.
en: And Mordecai came again to the king's gate. But Haman hasted to his house mourning, and having his head covered.

en: And Haman told Zeresh his wife and all his friends every thing that had befallen him.

en: Then said his wise men and Zeresh his wife unto him, If Mordecai be of the seed of the Jews, before whom thou hast begun to fall, thou shalt not prevail against him, but shalt surely fall before him.

rr: ahabw'okuba nyowe eihanga ryaitu, tuguzirwe ngu twitwe, tucwekyerezibwe, tumarweho.
en: for we are sold, I and my people, to be destroyed, to be slain, and to perish.

rr: Nangwa kuri tuguzirwe ngu tube abahuuku n'abazaana, tiinyine ki naakugambire, n'obu omuzigu waitu atakubaasize kuriha ebi omugabe yaakufeereirwe.
en: But if we had been sold for bondmen and bondwomen, I had held my tongue, although the enemy could not countervail the king's damage.

rr: Ahonaaho omugabe Ahaseuro yaabuuza omwigarire Esteeri ati: N'oha oyehangire kukora ekyo, kandi arahi?
en: Then the king Ahasuerus answered and said unto Esther the queen, Who is he, and where is he, that durst presume in his heart to do so?

rr: Esteeri yaagarukamu ati: Omuzigu waitu orikuturwanisa n'eri ihano Hamani. Hamani yaatetemera omu maisho g'omugabe n'omwigarire.
en: And Esther said, The adversary and enemy is this wicked Haman. Then Haman was afraid before the king and the queen.

rr: Ahonaaho omugabe yaimuka, yaaruga aha bugyenyi asambisiirwe, yaashohora, yaaza omu musiri gw'ekikaari; kwonka Hamani yaimuka kushaba omwigarire ngu ataitwa; ahabw'okuba akareeba ku omugabe amaririire kumukora kubi.
en: And the king arising from the banquet of wine in his wrath went into the palace garden: and Haman stood up to make request for his life to Esther the queen; for he saw that there was evil determined against him by the king.

rr: Bwanyima omugabe yaagaruka naaruga omu musiri gw'ekikaari, yaataaha omu kishengye omu baabaire nibanywera viinyo, yaashanga Hamani ajuumaire aha kitabo ahu Esteeri yaabaire ari; omugabe yaagira ati: Kandi yaaza kuhambira omwigarire omu maisho gangye omu nju yangye? Ebigambo ebyo ku byarugire biti omu kwnwa k'omugabe, abantu baashweka Hamani ahamaisho.
en: Then the king returned out of the palace garden into the place of the banquet of wine; and Haman was fallen upon the bed whereon Esther was . Then said the king, Will he force the queen also before me in the house? As the word went out of the king's mouth, they covered Haman's face.

rr: Bwanyima Harabona, omwe aha bakonwa abaabaire nibaheereza omugabe, yaagira ati: Manya, omu kibuga kya Hamani habyairwemu ekiti kiraingwa kya mikono makumi ataano, eki Hamani ateekateekire kuhanikaho Morodekai, owaagambire ekigambo ky'okukiza omugabe.
en: And Harbonah, one of the chamberlains, said before the king, Behold also, the gallows fifty cubits high, which Haman had made for Mordecai, who had spoken good for the king, standeth in the house of Haman. Then the king said, Hang him thereon.

rr: Omugabe nikwo kuragiira ati: Mube nikyo mwamuhanikaho. Batyo baahanika Hamani aha kiti eki yaabaire ateekateekyeire Morodekai. Okuruga aho ekiniga ky'omugabe kyaikaikana. en: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then was the king's wrath pacified. Currently Selected: Esther 7 : KJV Highlight Share <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8 19c-2.828 0-4.243 0-5.121-.879C2 17.243 2 15.828 2 13v-2c0-2

rr: Eryo izooba omugabe Ahasuero yaaha omwigarire Esteeri enju ya Hamani omuzigu w'Abayudaaya.
en: On that day did the king Ahasuerus give the house of Haman the Jews' enemy unto Esther the queen.

rr: Kandi Morodekai yaija omu maisho g'omugabe, ahabw'okuba Esteeri akaba agambire oku ari nawe.
en: And Mordecai came before the king; for Esther had told what he was unto her.

rr: Omugabe yaajuura empeta y'akamanyiso ke ei ayakire Hamani, yaagiha Morodekai.
en: And the king took off his ring, which he had taken from Haman, and gave it unto Mordecai.

rr: Na Esteeri yaataho Morodekai kutegyeka enju ya Hamani.
en: And Esther set Mordecai over the house of Haman.

rr: Bwanyima Esteeri yaagaruka yaagamba n'omugabe; yaamukwata amaguru, yaamweshengyereza naarira, ngu amareho enaama mbi ya Hamani Omuagagi, n'obwengye obu yaabaire acwire kucwekyereza Abayudaaya.
en: And Esther spake yet again before the king, and fell down at his feet, and besought him with tears to put away the mischief of Haman the Agagite, and his device that he had devised against the Jews.

rr: Omugabe yaimukiza Esteeri enkoni ye y'ezaabu
en: Then the king held out the golden sceptre toward Esther. So Esther arose, and stood before the king,

rr: Esteeri yaimuka, yaayemerera omu maisho ge, yaagira ati: Omugabe ku araabe naakisiima akanshemerererwa, n'ebi ndaagambe bikamugwisa gye, kandi nkaba orikumushemeza, nimmweshengyereza, ku bahandiika ebaruha y'okuhindura busha ezi Hamani mwene Hamedasa Omuagagi yaahandiikire kucwekyereza Abayudaaya abari omu mashaza g'omugabe goona.
en: and said, If it please the king, and if I have found favour in his sight, and the thing seem right before the king, and I be pleasing in his eyes, let it be written to reverse the letters devised by Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, which he wrote to destroy the Jews which are in all the king's provinces:

rr: Mbwenu nimbaasa nta kugumisiririza akabai akarihika aha ihanga ryaitu? Nari shi nimbaasa nta kugumisiririza aokureeba beene waitu nibacwekyerezibwa?
en: for how can I endure to see the evil that shall come unto my people? or how can I endure to see the destruction of my kindred?

rr: Omugabe Ahasuero yaagarukamu omwigarire Esteeri na Morodekai Omuyudaaya ati: Reeba, mpaire Esteeri enju ya Hamani, kandi Hamani bamuhanikire aha kti nimmutura okubangira Abayudaaya omukono.
en: Then the king Ahasuerus said unto Esther the queen and to Mordecai the Jew, Behold, I have given Esther the house of Haman, and him they have hanged upon the gallows, because he laid his hand upon the Jews.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo naimwe muhandiikire Abayudaaya, nk'oku murikwenda, omu iziina ry'omugabe, muteho akamanyiso k'empeta ye; ahabw'okuba ekiragiro ekihandiikirwe omu iziina ry'omguabe, kikaamibwa akamanyiso k'empeta ye, tihariho muntu orikubaasa kukiihaho.
en: Write ye also for the Jews, as it liketh you, in the king's name, and seal it with the king's ring: for the writing which is written in the king's name, and sealed with the king's ring, may no man reverse.

rr: Batyo omu bunaku obwo, aha kiro kya makumi abiri na bishatu omu kwezi kwa kashatu okurikwetwa Sivani, abahandiiki b'omugabe baayetwa, baahandiika ebi Morodekai aragiire aha by'Abayudaaya byona, baabitwekyera abategyeki b'omugabe, n'abandi bategyeki, n'abanyiginya b'omu mashaza goona, oku gari igana na makumi abiri na mushanju, okuruga Buhindi okuhika Esiopia, buri ishaza ryona nk'emihandiikire yaaryo oku yaabaire eri, na buri ihanga omu rurimi rwaryo; baabihandiikira n'Abayudaaya omu mihandiikire yaabo n'omu rurimi rwabo.
en: Then were the king's scribes called at that time in the third month, that is , the month Sivan, on the three and twentieth day thereof; and it was written according to all that Mordecai commanded unto the Jews, and to the lieutenants, and the deputies and rulers of the provinces which are from India unto Ethiopia, an hundred twenty and seven provinces, unto every province according to the writing thereof, and unto every people after their language, and to the Jews according to their writing, and according to their language.

rr: Ebyo byona Morodekai yaabihandiika omu iziina ry'omugabe, yaabihamisa akamanyiso k'empeta y'omugabe, ebaruha yaazikwatsa baamatarisi, abaabaire bagyendera aha mbaraasi ezirikwiruka munonga, ezaabaire zizaaziibwe omu masho g'omugabe, nizikora emirimo ye.
en: And he wrote in the king Ahasuerus' name, and sealed it with the king's ring, and sent letters by posts on horseback, and riders on mules, camels, and young dromedaries:

rr: Omuri ezo baruha omugabe yaikiriza Abayudaaya b'omu ndembo zoona, ngu bateeranire hamwe, beerwaneho bahamire, babone kwita n'okucwekyereza n'okumaraho engabo zoona z'eihanga ryona nari ez'eishaza ryona, eziribateera, baite n'abaana baabo abato n'abakazi baabo, kandi banyagye ebintu byabo
en: wherein the king granted the Jews which were in every city to gather themselves together, and to stand for their life, to destroy, to slay, and to cause to perish, all the power of the people and province that would assault them, both little ones and women, and to take the spoil of them for a prey,

rr: kandi ngu ebyo byona bikorerwe aha izooba rimwe, aha kiro kya ikumi na bishatu omu kwezi kwa ikumi n'abiri okurikwetwa Adari, omu mashaza goona ag'omugabe Ahasuero
en: upon one day in all the provinces of king Ahasuerus, namely , upon the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar.

rr: kandi ngu ebihandiikirwe omuri ezo baruha bibugibwe nk'ekiragiro omuri buri ishaza, kandi birangwe omu mahanga goona, nibimanyisa Abayudaaya ku bashemereire kweteekateeka kwerwanaho ahari eryo izooba, nibahoora abazigu baabo.
en: The copy of the writing for a commandment to be given in every province was published unto all people, and that the Jews should be ready against that day to avenge themselves on their enemies.

rr: Batyo baamatarisi baatemba embaraasi ezirikwiruka munonga, ezaabaire zikora emirimo y'omugabe, baashohora nibeehuuta, nibagyemwa ekiragiro ky'omugabe.
en: So the posts that rode upon mules and camels went out, being hastened and pressed on by the king's commandment.

rr: Kandi ekyo kiragiro kyabugibwa omu rurembo Shushani.
en: And the decree was given at Shushan the palace.

rr: Bwanyima Morodekai yaaruga omu maisho g'omugabe, yaashohora ajwaire bushuuti y'omugabe eya bururu kandi erikwera, ajwaire ekirunga kihango ky'ezaabu, kandi anagiire omunagiro gwa bafuta na bujwa; batyo ab'omu rurembo Shushani baateera akaari baashemererwa.
en: And Mordecai went out from the presence of the king in royal apparel of blue and white, and with a great crown of gold, and with a garment of fine linen and purple: and the city of Shushan rejoiced and was glad.

rr: N'Abayudaaya baajwerwa omushana, baatunga okushemererwa n'okwesiima n'ekitiinisa.
en: The Jews had light, and gladness, and joy, and honour.

rr: Kandi omuri buri ishaza n'omu buri rurembo ahu ekiragiro ky'omugabe n'ekihandiiko kye byabaire bihika, Abayudaaya bakaba bashemererwa, beesiima, baagira obugyenyi n'ekiro kikuru ky'okuhuumuriraho.
en: And in every province, and in every city, whithersoever the king's commandment and his decree came, the Jews had joy and gladness, a feast and a good day.

rr: Baingi omu mahanga g'omuri egyo nsi baayehindura Abayudaaya, ahabw'okuba Abayudaaya bakabatiinisa.
en: And many of the people of the land became Jews; for the fear of the Jews fell upon them.

rr: Currently Selected: Esiteeri 8 : RR64 Highlight Share <div class="flex w-full items-center gap-1 rtl:flex-row-reverse hove

Aha kiro kya ikumi na bishatu ky'okwezi kwa ikumi n'abiri okurikwetwa Adari, ekiragiro ky'omugabe n'ekihandiiko kye bikaba nibyenda kuhikiirizibwa. Eryo izooba niryo abazigu b'Abayudaaya baabaire nibagira ngu nibaija kugira obushoboorozi aha Bayudaaya, kwonak kyahinduka, Abayudaaya baaba nibo baabugira aha bazigu baabo.
en: Now in the twelfth month, that is , the month Adar, on the thirteenth day of the same, when the king's commandment and his decree drew near to be put in execution, in the day that the enemies of the Jews hoped to have power over them, (though it was turned to the contrary, that the Jews had rule over them that hated them;)

rr: Batyo Abayudaaya baateeranira omu ndembo zaabo z'omu mashaza g'omugabe Ahasuero goona, kukwata abaabaire nibenda kubakora kubi. Tihariho muntu n'omwe owaabaire naabaasa kubaza omu kaso, ahabw'okuba amahanga goona gakaba gabatiinire.
en: the Jews gathered themselves together in their cities throughout all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus, to lay hand on such as sought their hurt: and no man could withstand them; for the fear of them fell upon all people.

rr: Kandi abategyeki ba'amshaza boona, n'abategyeki b'omugabe n'abandi bategyeki, n'abatware b'omu kikaari ky'omugabe, baaha Abayudaaya emikono, ahabw'okuba nabo bakaba batiinire Morodekai.
en: And all the rulers of the provinces, and the lieutenants, and the deputies, and officers of the king, helped the Jews; because the fear of Mordecai fell upon them.

rr: Morodekai ogwo akaba ahindukire rugambwa omu ka y'omugabe, kandi okurangaanwa kwe kubugire omu mashaza goona; ahabw'okuba akaguma naayeyongyera kuhama.
en: For Mordecai was great in the king's house, and his fame went out throughout all the provinces: for this man Mordecai waxed greater and greater.

rr: Batyo Abayudaaya baitsa abazigu baabo rurara, baabacwekyereza, baabamaraho; abaabaire nibabanga, baabagira nk'oku barikwenda.
en: Thus the Jews smote all their enemies with the stroke of the sword, and slaughter, and destruction, and did what they would unto those that hated them.

rr: Omu rurembo rukuru Shushani Abayudaaya baitamu abashaija magana ataano, baabamaraho
en: And in Shushan the palace the Jews slew and destroyed five hundred men.

rr: kandi baita na Parishanidasa, Dalifooni, Asipaasa
en: And Parshandatha, and Dalphon, and Aspatha,

rr: poraasa, Adalia, Aridasa
en: and Poratha, and Adalia, and Aridatha,

rr: Parimashiita, Arisai, Aridai na Vaizaasa
en: and Parmashta, and Arisai, and Aridai, and Vajezatha,

rr: boona ikumi beene Hamani mwene Hamedasa, omuzigu w'Abayudaaya; kwonka tibaagira ki baanyaga.
en: the ten sons of Haman the son of Hammedatha, the enemy of the Jews, slew they; but on the spoil laid they not their hand.

rr: Eryo izooba omubaro gw'abaitwa omu rurembo rukuru Shushani gwagambirwa omugabe.
en: On that day the number of those that were slain in Shushan the palace was brought before the king.

rr: Omugabe yaagira omwigarire Esteeri ati: Abayudaaya baita abashaija magana ataano omu rurembo Shushani, baabamaraho; baita na beene Hamani ikumi. Mbwenu noogira ngu omu gandi mashaza g'omu bugabe bakozire ebirikwingana ki? Hariho ekindi eki orikushaba, okakiheebwa? nari hariho ekindi eki orikwenda, ngu kihikiirizibwe?
en: And the king said unto Esther the queen, The Jews have slain and destroyed five hundred men in Shushan the palace, and the ten sons of Haman; what have they done in the rest of the king's provinces? now what is thy petition? and it shall be granted thee: or what is thy request further? and it shall be done.

rr: Esteeri yaamugarukamu ati: Omugabe ku araabe naasiima, aikirize Abayudaaya abari omuri Shushani nyencakare batwaze nk'ekiragiro ky'eri izooba oku yaba; kandi beene Hamani abo, oku bari ikumi, bahanikwe aha biti.
en: Then said Esther, If it please the king, let it be granted to the Jews which are in Shushan to do to morrow also according unto this day's decree, and let Haman's ten sons be hanged upon the gallows.

rr: Atyo omugabe yaaragiira ku kiba kityo; ekiragiro kyabugibwa omuri Shushani, na beene Hamani oku bari ikumi baahanikwa.
en: And the king commanded it so to be done: and the decree was given at Shushan; and they hanged Haman's ten sons.

rr: Ku bwaseesire aha kiro kya ikumi na bina ky'okwezi Adari, Abayudaaya abaabaire bari omuri Shushani baateeranira hamwe, baita abashaija magana ashatu, kwonka nabwo tibaagira ki baanyaga.
en: For the Jews that were in Shushan gathered themselves together on the fourteenth day also of the month Adar, and slew three hundred men at Shushan; but on the prey they laid not their hand.

rr: N'bandi Bayudaaya b'omu mashaza g'omugabe baateeranira hamwe, baayerwanaho, baita omu bazigu baabo abantu obukumi mushanju n'enkumi itaano, baahuumura ahabw'abazigu baabo, kandi nabwo tibaagira ki baanyaga.
en: But the other Jews that were in the king's provinces gathered themselves together, and stood for their lives, and had rest from their enemies, and slew of their foes seventy and five thousand, but they laid not their hands on the prey,

rr: Okwo nikwo byabaire aha kiro kya ikumi na bishatu ky'okwezi Adari; aha kiro kya ikumi na bina baahuumura, baakigira ekiro kikuru ky'obugyenyi ky'okuriira hamwe n'okushemererwa.
en: on the thirteenth day of the month Adar; and on the fourteenth day of the same rested they, and made it a day of feasting and gladness.

rr: Kwonka Abayudaaya ab'omuri Shushani baateeranira hamwe aha kiro kya ikumi na bishatu n'ekya ikumi na bina eby'okwo kwezi; bwanyima aha kya ikumi na bitaano baahuumura, baakigira ekiro kikuru ky'obugyenyi ky'okuriira hamwe n'okushemererwa.
en: But the Jews that were at Shushan assembled together on the thirteenth day thereof, and on the fourteenth thereof; and on the fifteenth day of the same they rested, and made it a day of feasting and gladness.

rr: Nikyo Abayudaaya ab'omu byaro, abatuura omuri tauni ezitaine ngo z'amabaare, baijukira ekiro kya ikumi na bina ky'okwezi Adari, bakakigira eizooba ry'okushemerererwaho n'okuriira hamwe, n'eizooba rirungi ry'okutwekyereraniraho eby'okurya.
en: Therefore the Jews of the villages, that dwelt in the unwalled towns, made the fourteenth day of the month Adar a day of gladness and feasting, and a good day, and of sending portions one to another.

rr: Ebyo biro okuhinduka ebiro bikuru aha Bayudaaya
en: The Feast of Purim

rr: Bwanyima Morodekai yaahandiika ebyo byona, kandi yaahandiika n'ebaruha, yaazitwekyera Abayudaaya boona, abaabaire bari omu mashaza g'omugabe Ahasuero goona, aba haihi n'aba hare
en: And Mordecai wrote these things, and sent letters unto all the Jews that were in all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus, both nigh and far,

rr: naabeehangiriza kwijuka ekiro kya ikumi na bina n'ekya ikumi na bitaano eby'okwezi Adari, kubigira ebiro bikuru buri mwaka
en: to stablish this among them, that they should keep the fourteenth day of the month Adar, and the fifteenth day of the same, yearly,

rr: ahabw'okuba ahari ebyo biro nibwo Abayudaaya baahuumura abazigu baabo, kandi okwo kwezi nikwo kwababeereire okw'okushemererwa omu mwanya gw'obusaasi, kukaba okw'okuhuumuriramu omu mwanya gw'okuganya; kandi yaabaragiira ku babigira ebiro by'okuriira hamwe n'okushemererwa, n'eby'okutwekyereraniraho eby'okurya, n'okuha abooro ebiconco.
en: as the days wherein the Jews rested from their enemies, and the month which was turned unto them from sorrow to joy, and from mourning into a good day: that they should make them days of feasting and joy, and of sending portions one to another, and gifts to the poor.

rr: Batyo Abayudaaya baaragaana ku bariguma nibabitwaza nk'oku baabitandika, kandi nk'oku Morodekai abahandiikiire.
en: And the Jews undertook to do as they had begun, and as Mordecai had written unto them;

rr: Ahabw'okuba Hamani mwene Hamedasa Omuagagi, omuzigu w'Abayudaaya boona, akaba abagiriire enaama y'okubacwekyereza, kandi akaba aragwize enteenyu ezirikwetwa Puuri, kubasingyeera n'okubamaraho
en: because Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, the enemy of all the Jews, had devised against the Jews to destroy them, and had cast Pur, that is , the lot, to consume them, and to destroy them;

rr: Oba kwonka egyo naama ku yaahikire aha mugabe, omugabe yaaragiirira omu baruha ati: Egyo naama mbi y'okwita Abayudaaya ebe niwe yaagarukana, kandi ngu we n'abatabani bahanikwe aha biti.
en: but when Esther came before the king, he commanded by letters that his wicked device, which he devised against the Jews, should return upon his own head, and that he and his sons should be hanged on the gallows.

rr: Nikyo ebyo biro babyetera Purimu, nibagyeterera Puuri.
en: Wherefore they called these days Purim after the name of Pur.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo ahabw'ebyahandiikirwe omuri egyo baruha, n'ebi Abayudaaya bareebire omuri ako kabi, kandi n'ebyabahikireho
en: Therefore for all the words of this letter, and of that which they had seen concerning this matter, and which had come unto them,

rr: bakaragiira, kandi baaragaana ahabwabo n'ahaba baijukuru baabo, n'ahabwa boona abaakwataniise nabo, ku batarireka kwijuka ebyo biro bibiri, nk'ekihandiiko kyabyo oku kyabaire kiri, n'obunaku bwabyo obwataireho buri mwaka.
en: the Jews ordained, and took upon them, and upon their seed, and upon all such as joined themselves unto them, so as it should not fail, that they would keep these two days according to their writing, and according to their appointed time every year;

rr: Kandi baragiira ngu, omu miryango yoona, n'omuri buri ishaza, n'omuri buri rurembo bagume baijukye ebyo biro, babigire ebiro bikuru omu busingye bwona, kandi ngu ebyo biro bya Purimu, bitarihugwaho omu Bayudaaya, nari ekiijutsyo kyabyo okweba omu ruzaro rwabo.
en: and that these days should be remembered and kept throughout every generation, every family, every province, and every city; and that these days of Purim should not fail from among the Jews, nor the memorial of them perish from their seed.

rr: Bwanyima omwigarire Esteeri, muhara wa Abihaili, na Morodeaki Omuyudaaya, baahandiika n'obushoboorozi nibahamya egyo baruha ya kabiri eya Purimu.
en: Then Esther the queen, the daughter of Abihail, and Mordecai the Jew, wrote with all authority, to confirm this second letter of Purim.

rr: Ebaruha zaatwekyerwa Abayudaaya boona ab'omu mashaza igana na makumi abiri na mushanju ag'omu bugabe bwa Ahasuero, ezabaire zirimu ebigambo by'obusingye n'amazima
en: And he sent the letters unto all the Jews, to the hundred twenty and seven provinces of the kingdom of Ahasuerus, with words of peace and truth,

rr: ngu zibone kuhamya ebyo biro bikuru bya Purimu omu bunaku obutairweho, nk'oku Morodekai Omuyudaaya n'omwigarire Esteeri baabiragiire Abayudaaya, bakabiragaana ahabwabo n'oruzaaro rwabo, eby'okwesiibyakwo n'amaganya gaabo.
en: to confirm these days of Purim in their times appointed , according as Mordecai the Jew and Esther the queen had enjoined them, and as they had decreed for themselves and for their seed, the matters of the fastings and their cry.

rr: Kityo ekiragiro ky'omwigarire Esteeri kyahamya egyo migyenzo ya Purimu, kyahandiikwa n'omu kitabo.
en: And the decree of Esther confirmed these matters of Purim; and it was written in the book.

rr: Bwanyima omugabe Ahasuero yaacwera ensi n'ebirwa by'omu mayanja omushoro.
en: And the king Ahasuerus laid a tribute upon the land, and upon the isles of the sea.

rr: Mbwenu emirimo yoona ei yaakozire n'obushoboorozi bwe n'amaani ge, n'ebirikworeka ekitiinisa eki yaahaire Morodekai, akaba omuntu rugambwa, tibihandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'eby'omu busingye bw'abagabe ba Bumeedi na Buperisi?
en: And all the acts of his power and of his might, and the declaration of the greatness of Mordecai, whereunto the king advanced him, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia?

rr: Ahabw'okuba ogwo Muyudaaya Morodekai niwe yaabaire ari owa kabiri aha mugabe Ahasuero; kandi akaba ari rugambwa omu Bayudaaya, naasiimwa beene waabo boona, ahabw'okuba akaba asherurira eihanga rye eby'okurikiza, kandi n'okwendeza abantu be obusingye.
en: For Mordecai the Jew was next unto king Ahasuerus, and great among the Jews, and accepted of the multitude of his brethren, seeking the wealth of his people, and speaking peace to all his seed.

rr: Aga nigo maziina ga batabani ba Israeli abaizire omuri Misri na Yakobo, buri muntu n'eka ye.
en: Now these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt; every man and his household came with Jacob.

rr: Reubeeni, Simeoni, Leevi, Yuda
en: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,

rr: Isakaari, Zebuluuni, Benyamiini
en: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,

rr: Daani, Nafutaali, Gaadi na Asheri.
en: Dan, and Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

rr: Abantu boona abaarugire omu nda ya Yakobo bakaba bari makumi mushanju kwonka Yosefu we akashangwa ari omuri Misri.
en: And all the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob were seventy souls: for Joseph was in Egypt already .

rr: Bwanyima Yosefu yaafa na beene ishe boona, n'ab'omu busingye obwo boona.
en: And Joseph died, and all his brethren, and all that generation.

rr: Abaisraeli baazaara, baayeyongyera munonga, baakanya, baaba ab'amaani maingi munonga; n'ahabw'ekyo baijura ensi.
en: And the children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and waxed exceeding mighty; and the land was filled with them.

rr: Bwanyima haayema omugabe musya omuri Misri, owaabaire atarikumanya Yosefu.
en: Now there arose up a new king over Egypt, which knew not Joseph.

rr: Yaagira abantu be ati: Reeba, Abaisraeli ni baingi kandi n'ab'amaani okutukira
en: And he said unto his people, Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we:

rr: mwije tubacwere obwengye, barekye kukanya; nyentsya tukiguubwaho orugamba, bakeeteerana n'abazigu baitu, bakaturwanisa, bakacwa, bakaruga omuri omuri egi nsi.
en: come on, let us deal wisely with them; lest they multiply, and it come to pass, that, when there falleth out any war, they join also unto our enemies, and fight against us, and so get them up out of the land.

rr: Nikyo baabateereireho abanyampara, ngu babareebese enaku nibabeekoreza emitwaro erikuremeera.
en: Therefore they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens.

rr: Baayombekyera Faraho endembo z'okuhunikamu, Pisomu na Ramaseesi.
en: And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities, Pithom and Raamses.

rr: Kwonka ei baagarukiire kubabonabonesa, nabo niyo baagarukiire kukanya n'okubuga hoona.
en: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and grew.

rr: Ekyo kyareetera Abanyamisri kugira obwoba bwingi ahabw'Abaisraeli.
en: And they were grieved because of the children of Israel.

rr: Abanyamisri baakoresa Abaisraeli emirimo y'amaani
en: And the Egyptians made the children of Israel to serve with rigour:

rr: baabatamisa amagara gaabo ahabw'okubakoresa emirimo y'obuhuuku, nibabakaatisa obudongo n'okubabumbisa amatafaari, kandi baabakoresa emirimo y'emiringo yoona omu misiri; buri murimo gwona ogu baabaire babakoresa, baagubakoresa n'amaani.
en: and they made their lives bitter with hard bondage, in morter, and in brick, and in all manner of service in the field: all their service, wherein they made them serve, was with rigour.

rr: Bwanyima omugabe wa Misri yaagambira abazaarisa b'Abaheburaayo, omwe orikwetwa Shifira, n'ondiijo orikwetwa Pua
en: And the king of Egypt spake to the Hebrew midwives, of which the name of the one was Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah:

rr: naagira ati: Ku muraabe nimuzaarisa Abaheburaayokazi, mwareeba bari aha butebe oburikuzaarirwaho, haazaarwa omwojo, mumwite; ku araabe ari omwishiki, agumeho.
en: and he said, When ye do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see them upon the stools; if it be a son, then ye shall kill him: but if it be a daughter, then she shall live.

rr: Kwonka abazaarisa baatiina Ruhanga, tibaakora nk'oku omugabe wa Misri abaragiire, baaguma kureka abaana b'aboojo bahuriire.
en: But the midwives feared God, and did not as the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the men children alive.

rr: Omugabe wa Misri yaayeta abazaarisa, yaababuuza ati: Ahabw'enki mukozire muti okureka abaana b'aboojo bakagumaho?
en: And the king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said unto them, Why have ye done this thing, and have saved the men children alive?

rr: Abazaarisa baagarukamu Faraho bati: Manya Abaheburaayokazi tibari nk'Abanyamisrikazi, ahakuba baine amaani, omuzaarisa ku aza kwija, ashanga baazaire.
en: And the midwives said unto Pharaoh, Because the Hebrew women are not as the Egyptian women; for they are lively, and are delivered ere the midwives come in unto them.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo Ruhanga yaakorera gye abo bazaarisa; eihanga ry'Ahaheburaayo ryakanya, ryaba ery'amaani maingi.
en: Therefore God dealt well with the midwives: and the people multiplied, and waxed very mighty.

rr: Kandi abo bazaarisa ahabw'okutiina Ruhanga, yaabaha oruzaaro, baarugwamu enganda.
en: And it came to pass, because the midwives feared God, that he made them houses.

rr: Bwanyima Faraho yaaragiira abantu be boona ati: Buri mwojo weena oraazaarwe Omuheburaayokazi, mumunagye omu mugyera; kwonka omwishiki weena agumeho.
en: And Pharaoh charged all his people, saying, Every son that is born ye shall cast into the river, and every daughter ye shall save alive.

rr: Omushaija ow'omu ruganda rwa Leevi akagyenda, yaashwera omwishiki w'omu Baleevi.
en: And there went a man of the house of Levi, and took to wife a daughter of Levi.

rr: Omukazi ogwo yaagira enda, yaazaara omwana w'omwojo; ku yaareebire ari omwana murungi, yaamushereka okumara ameezi ashatu.
en: And the woman conceived, and bare a son: and when she saw him that he was a goodly child , she hid him three months.

rr: Bwanyima ku yaareebire atakibaasa kuguma amusherekire, yaareeta akagozi k'omubimbiri k'okumutamu, yaakasiiga eibumba na koroto, yaamutamu; ako kagozi yaakata ahagati y'ebifunjo omu nkungu y'omugyera
en: And when she could not longer hide him, she took for him an ark of bulrushes, and daubed it with slime and with pitch, and put the child therein; and she laid it in the flags by the river's brink.

rr: munyaanya yaayemerera hangahari kureeba ekiraamubeho.
en: And his sister stood afar off, to wit what would be done to him.

rr: Muhara wa Faraho yaashuuma aha mugyera kwoga, abazaana be baagyendagyenda aha rubaju rw'omugyera; ku yaareebire akagozi ahagati y'ebifunjo, yaatuma omuzaana kukareeta.
en: And the daughter of Pharaoh came down to wash herself at the river; and her maidens walked along by the river's side; and when she saw the ark among the flags, she sent her maid to fetch it.

rr: Ku yaakafundwire, yaashangamu omwana, ogwo mwana yaarira.
en: And when she had opened it , she saw the child: and, behold, the babe wept.

rr: Yaamugirira esaasi, yaagira ati: Ogu n'omwe aha baana b'Abaheburaayo.
en: And she had compassion on him, and said, This is one of the Hebrews' children.

rr: Ahonaaho munyaanya yaabuuza muhara wa Faraho ati: Nze kukwetera omurezi omu bakazi b'Abaheburaayo, akurerere ogu mwana?
en: Then said his sister to Pharaoh's daughter, Shall I go and call to thee a nurse of the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for thee?

rr: Muhara wa Faraho yaamugira ati: Irooko. Omwishiki yaagyenda, yaayeta nyina.
en: And Pharaoh's daughter said to her, Go. And the maid went and called the child's mother.

rr: Muhara wa Faraho yaamugira ati: Twara omwana ogu, omunderere, ndyakuha ebihembo.
en: And Pharaoh's daughter said unto her, Take this child away, and nurse it for me, and I will give thee thy wages.

rr: Omukazi nikwo kutwara omwana, akamurera.
en: And the woman took the child, and nursed it.

rr: Bwanyima omwana ku yaakuzire, nyina yaamureetera muhara wa Faraho, yaaba omwana we. Yaamweta Musa, naagira ati: Ahabw'okuba nkamwiha omu maizi. Musa okusaasibwa beene waabo
en: And the child grew, and she brought him unto Pharaoh's daughter, and he became her son. And she called his name Moses: and she said, Because I drew him out of the water.

rr: Eizooba rimwe Musa, ku yaakuzire, yaaza kureeba beene waabo, yaareeba obuhuuku obu barimu; kandi yaareeba Omunyamisri naateera Omuheburaayo, omwe ahari beene waabo.
en: And it came to pass in those days, when Moses was grown, that he went out unto his brethren, and looked on their burdens: and he spied an Egyptian smiting an Hebrew, one of his brethren.

rr: Yaamagamaga; ku yaareebire hataine oriho, yaita ogwo Munyamisri, yaashereka omutumbi gwe omu musheenyi.
en: And he looked this way and that way, and when he saw that there was no man, he slew the Egyptian, and hid him in the sand.

rr: Ku bwaseesire, yaagarukayo, yaashanga Abaheburaayo babiri nibarwana, yaagambira owaashaagiza mugyenzi we ati: Ahabw'enki nooteera mugyenzi waawe?
en: And when he went out the second day, behold, two men of the Hebrews strove together: and he said to him that did the wrong, Wherefore smitest thou thy fellow?

rr: Onu ati: N'oha owaakuhaire obushoboorozi bw'okututegyeka n'okutucwera emanja? Nooyenda kunkuratsa Omunyamisri ou oitsire? Musa yaatiina, yaagira ati: Buzima eki nkozire kimanyirwe.
en: And he said, Who made thee a prince and a judge over us? intendest thou to kill me, as thou killedst the Egyptian? And Moses feared, and said, Surely this thing is known.

rr: Bwanyima Faraho ku yaakihuriire, yaasherura oku araite Musa.
en: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to slay Moses.

rr: Okuhunga kwa Musa Kwonka Musa yaahunga Faraho, yaaza omu nsi ya Midiani; ku yaahikireyo, yaashutama aha rubaju rw'eiziba.
en: But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and dwelt in the land of Midian: and he sat down by a well.

rr: Hakaba hariyo omunyamurwa wa Midiani, aine bahara be mushanju; baija, baataha amaizi, baijuza amaato kweshera obusyo bwa ishebo.
en: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters: and they came and drew water , and filled the troughs to water their father's flock.

rr: Haija abariisa, baababinga, kwonka Musa yaimuka, yaabarwanaho, yaayeshera obusyo bwabo.
en: And the shepherds came and drove them away: but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.

rr: Ku baataahire, Reueli ishebo yaagira ati: Byaba bita eri izooba? Ka mwarahukayo!
en: And when they came to Reuel their father, he said, How is it that ye are come so soon to day?

rr: Baagarukamu bati: Omunyamisri niwe yaatujuna abariisa, akatutahira amaizi, kandi akatwesherera n'obusyo.
en: And they said, An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds, and also drew water enough for us, and watered the flock.

rr: Yaabuuza bahara be ati: Mbwenu shi ogwo mushaija arahi? Ahabw'enki mwamutsigayo? Mumwete, tumufungurire.
en: And he said unto his daughters, And where is he? why is it that ye have left the man? call him, that he may eat bread.

rr: Okuruga aho Musa yaasiima kuguma n'ogwo mushaija; bwanyima omusahaija ogwo yaamuhingira muhara we Zipora.
en: And Moses was content to dwell with the man: and he gave Moses Zipporah his daughter.

rr: Yaazaara omwana w'omwojo, ishe yaamweta Gereshomu; ahakuba akagira ati: Nkashuhuukira omu nsi etari yaitu. Okutaka kw'Abaisraeli
en: And she bare him a son, and he called his name Gershom: for he said, I have been a stranger in a strange land.

rr: Ku haahingwireho ebiro bingi, omugabe wa Misri yaafa. Abaisraeli baatsinda ahabw'emirimo y'obuhuuku, baataka, n'okutaka kwabo ahabw'obuhuuku kwahika ahari Ruhanga.
en: And it came to pass in process of time, that the king of Egypt died: and the children of Israel sighed by reason of the bondage, and they cried, and their cry came up unto God by reason of the bondage.

rr: Ruhanga yaahurira okutsinda kwabo, Ruhanga yaijuka endagaano ei yaaragaine na Abrahamu na Isaaka na Yakobo.
en: And God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.

rr: Ruhanga yaareeba Abaisraeli, Ruhanga yaamanya oku bari.
en: And God looked upon the children of Israel, and God had respect unto them .

rr: Currently Selected: Okuruga 2 : RR64 Highlight Share <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8 19c-2.828 0-4.243 0-5.121-.879C2 17.243 2 15.828 2 13v-2c0-2.828 0-4.243.879-5.121C3.757 5 5.172 5 8 5h8c2.82
Omu biro ebyo Musa akaba naariisa obusyo bwa ishezaara Yesero omunyamurwa wa Midiani; yaatwara obusyo aha rubaju rw'oburengyerwa-izooba bw'eihamba, yaahika aha rushozi rwa Ruhanga orurikwetwa Horebu.
en: Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law, the priest of Midian: and he led the flock to the backside of the desert, and came to the mountain of God, even to Horeb.

rr: Maraika wa MUKAMA yaamweyorekyera omu rurimi rw'omuriro nigunaga enkobe ahagati y'orushaka; yaayetegyereza, yaareeba orushaka nirwaka, kwonka rutarikusya.
en: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.

rr: Musa yaagira ati: Ka nkiikame, ndeebe eri ihano, orushaka okwaka rutasye.
en: And Moses said, I will now turn aside, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burnt.

rr: MUKAMA ku yaareebire yaakiikama kureeba, Ruhanga yaamweta naayema ahagati omu rushaka, naagira ati: Musa, Musa!
en: And when the LORD saw that he turned aside to see, God called unto him out of the midst of the bush, and said, Moses, Moses.

rr: Yaamwetaba ati: Ndi aha, Mukama wangye.
en: And he said, Here am I.

rr: Ruhanga yaagira ati: Otairira haihi; juura enkaito omu bigyere byawe, ahakuba omwanya ogu oyemereiremu n'ogurikwera.
en: And he said, Draw not nigh hither: put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.

rr: Kandi yaagira ati: Ndi Ruhanga wa sho, Ruhanga wa Abrahamu, Ruhanga wa Yakobo.
en: Moreover he said, I am the God of thy father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.

rr: Musa yaayekwata aha maisho, ahakuba akatiina kureeba Ruhanga.
en: And Moses hid his face; for he was afraid to look upon God.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira ati: Buzimazima ndeebire okubonabonesibwa kw'abantu bangye abari omuri Misri, naahurira okutaka kwabo oku barikutakisibwa abanyampara; ahabw'okuba nimmanya obusaasi bwabo
en: And the LORD said, I have surely seen the affliction of my people which are in Egypt, and have heard their cry by reason of their taskmasters; for I know their sorrows;

rr: kandi naashuuma kubajuna, kubaiha omu mikono y'Abanyamisri, barugye omu nsi egyo, mbatware omu nsi enungi kandi egarami, ensi ey'amate n'obwoki, ensi ey'Abanyakanaani, ey'Abahiiti, ey'Abaamori, ey'Abaperizi, ey'abahiivi n'ey'Abayebusi.
en: and I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large, unto a land flowing with milk and honey; unto the place of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

rr: Na mbwenu reeba, okutaka kw'Abaisraeli kumpikireho, kandi ndeebire okuhatwa oku Abanyamisri barikubahata.
en: Now therefore, behold, the cry of the children of Israel is come unto me: and I have also seen the oppression wherewith the Egyptians oppress them.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo ija, nkutume ahari Faraho, oihe abantu bangye Abaisraeli omuri Misri.
en: Come now therefore, and I will send thee unto Pharaoh, that thou mayest bring forth my people the children of Israel out of Egypt.

rr: Musa yaagira Ruhanga ati: Niinye oha kuturukirira Faraho nkaiha Abaisraeli omuri Misri?
en: And Moses said unto God, Who am I, that I should go unto Pharaoh, and that I should bring forth the children of Israel out of Egypt?

rr: Yaamugira ati: Buzimazima ndyaba nkwine. Akamanyiso akarihamya ku niinye naakutumire n'aka; ku oriba waihire abantu omuri Misri, muryaheerereza Ruhanga aha rushozi oru.
en: And he said, Certainly I will be with thee; and this shall be a token unto thee, that I have sent thee: When thou hast brought forth the people out of Egypt, ye shall serve God upon this mountain.

rr: Musa yaagarukamu Ruhanga ati: Ku ndihika Abaisraeli, naabagira nti: Ruhanga wa baashwenkuriimwe abantumireho; bambuuza bati: Eiziina rye n'oha? ndyabagarukamu nta?
en: And Moses said unto God, Behold, when I come unto the children of Israel, and shall say unto them, The God of your fathers hath sent me unto you; and they shall say to me, What is his name? what shall I say unto them?

rr: Ruhanga yaagira Musa ati: Ndi MBAHO; kandi yaagira ati: Oku nikwo origambira Abaisraeli, oti: MBAHO niwe abantumireho.
en: And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.

rr: Kandi Ruhanga yaagambira Musa ati: Oku nikwo origambira Abaisraeli, oti: MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa baashwenkuriimwe, Ruhanga wa Abrahamu, Ruhanga wa Isaaka, Ruhanga wa Yakobo niwe abantumireho; eryo niryo iziina ryangye ebiro byona, kandi okwo nikwo nshemereire kwijukwa obusingye bwona.
en: And God said moreover unto Moses, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, The LORD God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath sent me unto you: this is my name for ever, and this is my memorial unto all generations.

rr: Irooko oteeranire hamwe abakuru b'Abaisraeli, obagire oti: MUKAMA Ruhanga wa baashwenkuriimwe, Ruhanga wa Abrahamu na Isaaka na Yakobo akanyeyoreka naagira ati: Mbareebire, naareeba n'okubarikubagira omuri Misri
en: Go, and gather the elders of Israel together, and say unto them, The LORD God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, appeared unto me, saying, I have surely visited you, and seen that which is done to you in Egypt:

rr: mbwenu nindaganisa okubaiha omu kubonabona kwa Misri, mbatware omu nsi y'Abanyakanaani, ey'Abahiiti, ey'Abaamori, ey'Abaperizi, ey'Abahiivi kandi n'ey'Abayebusi, ensi ey'amate n'obwoki.
en: and I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt unto the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, unto a land flowing with milk and honey.

rr: Nabo baryakuhurira; bwanyima oryagyenda n'abakuru b'Abaisraeli ow'omugabe wa Misri mumugire muti: MUKAMA Ruhanga w'Abaheburaayo atutaayaayiire; mbwenu nitukweshengyereza, orekye tugyende orugyendo rw'ebiro bishatu omu ihamba tutambiririreyo MUKAMA Ruhanga waitu ebitambo.
en: And they shall hearken to thy voice: and thou shalt come, thou and the elders of Israel, unto the king of Egypt, and ye shall say unto him, The LORD God of the Hebrews hath met with us: and now let us go, we beseech thee, three days' journey into the wilderness, that we may sacrifice to the LORD our God.

rr: Kandi nimmanya ku omugabe wa Misri ataribaikiriza kugyenda, kureka yaagyemwa omukono gw'amaani.
en: And I am sure that the king of Egypt will not let you go, no, not by a mighty hand.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo ndyabanga omukono gwangye, nteere Misri n'eby'okutangaaza byangye byona, ebi ndigikoreramu; bwanyima aryabarekura.
en: And I will stretch out my hand, and smite Egypt with all my wonders which I will do in the midst thereof: and after that he will let you go.

rr: Kandi aba bantu ndyabaha okukundwa Abanyamisri; n'ahabw'ekyo ku muriba nimurugayo, timurirugayo ngaro nsha
en: And I will give this people favour in the sight of the Egyptians: and it shall come to pass, that, when ye go, ye shall not go empty:

rr: kureka buri mukazi aryashaba mutaahi we, ashabe n'oriba acumbikire omu nju ye, ebintu by'obuguzi bwingi eby'efeeza n'eby'ezaabu, n'ebijwaro, mubijwekye abaana baanyu b'aboojo n'ab'abaishiki; okwo nikwo murinyaga Abanyamisri.
en: but every woman shall borrow of her neighbour, and of her that sojourneth in her house, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment: and ye shall put them upon your sons, and upon your daughters; and ye shall spoil the Egyptians.

en: Currently Selected: Exodus 3 : KJV Highlight Share <path d="M5 12a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h3a1 1 0 1 1 0 2H6a1 1 0 0 1-1-1ZM5 15a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h3a1 1 0 1 1 0 2H6a1 1 0 0 1-1-1ZM5 9a1

rr: Musa yaagarukamu naagira ati: Kwonka nimmanya ngu tibariinyikiriza, n'obu kwakuba okumpurira; ahakuba baryagira bati: MUKAMA tarakweyorekire.
en: And Moses answered and said, But, behold, they will not believe me, nor hearken unto my voice: for they will say, The LORD hath not appeared unto thee.

rr: MUKAMA yaamugira ati: Ekyo eki oine omu ngaro niki? Onu ati: N'enkoni.
en: And the LORD said unto him, What is that in thine hand? And he said, A rod.

rr: Ruhanga yaamugira ati: Ginagye ahansi.
en: And he said, Cast it on the ground.

rr: Yaaginaga ahansi; enkoni yaahinduka enjoka; Musa yaagihunga.
en: And he cast it on the ground, and it became a serpent; and Moses fled from before it.

rr: MUKAMA yaamugira ati: Tayo omukono gwawe, ogikwate omukira, (yaatayo omukono, yaagikwata, yaagaruka yaahinduka enkoni omu ngaro ze)
en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Put forth thine hand, and take it by the tail. And he put forth his hand, and caught it, and it became a rod in his hand:

rr: okwo nikwo orikora, bakabona kwikiriza ku MUKAMA Ruhanga wa baishenkurubo, Ruhanga wa Abrahamu, Ruhanga wa Isaaka, kandi Ruhanga wa Yakobo, yaakweyorekire.
en: that they may believe that the LORD God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath appeared unto thee.

rr: Kandi MUKAMA yaamugira ati: Ta omukono gwawe omu kifuba.
en: And the LORD said furthermore unto him, Put now thine hand into thy bosom.

rr: Yaagutamu; ku yaagwihiremu, yaashanga gubembire nigwera nk'orubaare.
en: And he put his hand into his bosom: and when he took it out, behold, his hand was leprous as snow.

rr: Yaagaruka yaamugira ati: Garura omukono gwawe omu kifuba.
en: And he said, Put thine hand into thy bosom again.

rr: Yaagugaruramu; ku yaagwihiremu, yaashanga guri nk'omubiri gwe ogundi.
en: And he put his hand into his bosom again; and plucked it out of his bosom, and, behold, it was turned again as his other flesh.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira ati: Ku bariba batakwikiriize, n'obu kwakuba okwikiririsibwa akamanyiso k'okubanza, baryaikiririsibwa aka kabiri.
en: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe thee, neither hearken to the voice of the first sign, that they will believe the voice of the latter sign.

rr: Kandi ku bariba bataikiririsiibwe obwo bumanyiso bwombi, n'obu kwakuba okuhurira ebi orikubagambira, oryatwara aha maizi g'omu mugyera, ogashukye hansi; amaizi ago agu oritaha omu mugyera, garyahinduka eshagama ahari eryo itaka. Arooni okutumwa kukora na Musa
en: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe also these two signs, neither hearken unto thy voice, that thou shalt take of the water of the river, and pour it upon the dry land: and the water which thou takest out of the river shall become blood upon the dry land .

rr: Musa yaagira MUKAMA ati: Mukama wangye, na ira ryona omwiru waawe nshangwa ntaba mugambi murungi, nangwa n'ahu waatandikira kugamba naanye, ahabw'okuba nyetwara omu kugamba, n'orurimi rwangye runaamuuka.
en: And Moses said unto the LORD , O my Lord, I am not eloquent, neither heretofore, nor since thou hast spoken unto thy servant: but I am slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.

rr: MUKAMA yaamugira ati: N'oha owaahangire akanwa k'omuntu? Nari n'oha ohindura omuntu ekiteta, nari ekifamatu, nari shi n'oha omureebesa, nari omuhumya? Tiinye MUKAMA?
en: And the LORD said unto him, Who hath made man's mouth? or who maketh the dumb, or deaf, or the seeing, or the blind? have not I the LORD ?

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo irooko ogyende, ndyaba ndi hamwe n'akanwa kaawe, nkuhabure ebi origamba.
en: Now therefore go, and I will be with thy mouth, and teach thee what thou shalt say.

rr: Musa yaagarukamu ati: Mukama wangye, ninkweshengyereza, ou orikwenda kutuma, mutume.
en: And he said, O my Lord, send, I pray thee, by the hand of him whom thou wilt send.

rr: MUKAMA yaagirira Musa ekiniga kingi, yaagira ati: Arooni mwene sho Omuleevi tariho?
en: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Moses, and he said, Is not Aaron the Levite thy brother?

rr: Nimmanya we ku arikubaasa kugamba gye.
en: I know that he can speak well.

rr: Kandi reeba, hati naija kukubugana; ku araakureebe, naija kwesiimira aha mutima.
en: And also, behold, he cometh forth to meet thee: and when he seeth thee, he will be glad in his heart.

rr: Oryaguma omugambire, ote ebigambo omu kanwa ke; naanye ndyaba ndi hamwe n'akanwa kaawe n'ake, mbahabure ebi murikora.
en: And thou shalt speak unto him, and put words in his mouth: and I will be with thy mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach you what ye shall do.

rr: Aryaba ow'okukugambirira abantu, abe akanwa kaawe, naiwe omubeere nka Ruhanga.
en: And he shall be thy spokesman unto the people: and he shall be, even he shall be to thee instead of a mouth, and thou shalt be to him instead of God.

rr: Kandi oryaguma otware enkoni egi omu ngaro, ei orikoresa obumanyiso. Musa okugaruka Misri
en: And thou shalt take this rod in thine hand, wherewith thou shalt do signs. Return to Egypt

rr: Musa yaagaruka ahari Yesero ishezaara, yaamugira ati: Ninkweshengyereza, reka ngyende, ngarukye ahari beene waitu abari omuri Misri, ndeebe ku baraabe bakibaho.
en: And Moses went and returned to Jethro his father in law, and said unto him, Let me go, I pray thee, and return unto my brethren which are in Egypt, and see whether they be yet alive.

rr: Yesero yaagira Musa ati: Gyenda n'obusingye.
en: And Jethro said to Moses, Go in peace.

rr: Kandi MUKAMA yaagambira Musa akiri omuri Midianai ati: Irooko ogarukye Misri, ahabw'okuba abaabaire nibenda kukwita bafiire.
en: And the LORD said unto Moses in Midian, Go, return into Egypt: for all the men are dead which sought thy life.

rr: Musa yaatwara omukazi we n'abatabani, yaabata aha ndogoya, yaagaruka omu nsi ya Misri; kandi yaatwara egyo nkoni ya Ruhanga omu ngaro ze.
en: And Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them upon an ass, and he returned to the land of Egypt: and Moses took the rod of God in his hand.

rr: -23 ; MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati: Ku oraagarukye Misri, otarireka kukorera omu maisho ga Faraho eby'okutangaaza byona ebi nkuhaire kukora; kwonka ndyagangaaza omutima gwe, tarireka bantu kugyenda.
en: And the LORD said unto Moses, When thou goest to return into Egypt, see that thou do all those wonders before Pharaoh, which I have put in thine hand: but I will harden his heart, that he shall not let the people go.

rr: Kandi oryagambira Faraho to: Oku nikwo MUKAMA arikugamba, naagira ati: Israeli n'omwana wangye w'omujigaijo
en: And thou shalt say unto Pharaoh, Thus saith the LORD , Israel is my son, even my firstborn:

rr: kandi ninkugambira nti: Reka omwana wangye agyende, ampeereze; ku oraayangye kumurekura, niinyija kwita omwana waawe ow'omujigaijo.
en: and I say unto thee, Let my son go, that he may serve me: and if thou refuse to let him go, behold, I will slay thy son, even thy firstborn.

rr: Ku baabaire nibakigyenda, baahika omu icumbi, MUKAMA yaamushangamu, yaayenda kumwita.
en: And it came to pass by the way in the inn, that the LORD met him, and sought to kill him.

rr: Zipora yaakwata eibaare ry'obwogi, yaashara ekishushu ky'omubiri gw'omwana we, yaakinaga aha bigyere bya Musa, yaamugira ati: Wampindukira omugore orikujwisa eshagama.
en: Then Zipporah took a sharp stone, and cut off the foreskin of her son, and cast it at his feet, and said, Surely a bloody husband art thou to me.

rr: MUKAMA nikwo kumureka. Zipora akagira ati: Ori omugore orikujwisa eshagama! ahabw'okushara.
en: So he let him go: then she said, A bloody husband thou art , because of the circumcision.

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Arooni ati: Irooko oze kubugana Musa omu ihamba.
en: And the LORD said to Aaron, Go into the wilderness to meet Moses.

rr: Yaagyenda, yaamubugana aha rushozi rwa Ruhanga, yaamunywegyera.
en: And he went, and met him in the mount of God, and kissed him.

rr: Musa yaagambira Arooni ebigambo byona ebi MUKAMA yaamutumire, n'obumanyiso bwona obu yaamuragiire kukora.
en: And Moses told Aaron all the words of the LORD who had sent him, and all the signs which he had commanded him.

rr: Musa na Arooni baagyenda, baateeranira hamwe abakuru b'Abaisraeli boona
en: And Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel:

rr: Arooni yaabagambira ebigambo byona, ebi MUKAMA yaagambiire Musa, kandi yaakorera obwo bumanyiso omu maisho g'abantu.
en: and Aaron spake all the words which the LORD had spoken unto Moses, and did the signs in the sight of the people.

rr: Abantu baikiriza; kandi ku baahuriire ngu MUKAMA ataayaayiire Abaisraeli, yaareeba okubonabonesibwa kwabo, bainika emitwe yaabo, baaramya.
en: And the people believed: and when they heard that the LORD had visited the children of Israel, and that he had looked upon their affliction, then they bowed their heads and worshipped.

rr: Bwanyima Musa na Arooni baija ahari Faraho, baamugira bati: Oku nikwo MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa Israeli arikugamba naagira ati: Reka abantu bangye bagyende omu ihamba, bankorereyo obugyenyi.
en: And afterward Moses and Aaron went in, and told Pharaoh, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Let my people go, that they may hold a feast unto me in the wilderness.

rr: Faraho yaabagira ati: MUKAMA niwe oha, ou nyowe nshemereire kuhurira, nkarekura Abaisraeli bakagyenda?
en: And Pharaoh said, Who is the LORD , that I should obey his voice to let Israel go?

rr: MUKAMA ogwo tindikumumanya; kandi n'ekindi tindikwija kubarekura, bakagyenda.
en: I know not the LORD , neither will I let Israel go.

rr: Baagira bati: Ruhanga w'Abaheburaayo atutaayaayiire; mbwenu nitukweshengyereza, orekye tugyende orugyendo rw'ebiro bishatu omu ihamba, tutambirireyo MUKAMA Ruhanga waitu ebitambo, atakaatwitsa orufu nari rurara.
en: And they said, The God of the Hebrews hath met with us: let us go, we pray thee, three days' journey into the desert, and sacrifice unto the LORD our God; lest he fall upon us with pestilence, or with the sword.

rr: Omugabe wa Misri yaabagira ati: Iwe Musa na Arooni, ahabw'enki nimwiha abantu aha mirimo yaabo? Mwirooko mugarukye aha mirimo yaanyu.
en: And the king of Egypt said unto them, Wherefore do ye, Moses and Aaron, let the people from their works? get you unto your burdens.

rr: Faraho yaagaruka yaagira ati: Reeba, abantu bakanyire omu nsi; haza imwe nimwenda kubaiha omu buhuuku bwabo.
en: And Pharaoh said, Behold, the people of the land now are many, and ye make them rest from their burdens.

rr: Eizooba eryo Faraho yaaragiira abanyampara b'abantu n'abatware baabo, naagira ati
en: And Pharaoh commanded the same day the taskmasters of the people, and their officers, saying,

rr: Mutagaruka kuha abantu embuba z'engano z'okukoresa amatafaari nka ira; murekye bagyende bazeesherurire.
en: Ye shall no more give the people straw to make brick, as heretofore: let them go and gather straw for themselves.

rr: Omubaro gw'amatafaari, ogu baabaire nibabumba n'okuhitsya hati, mube nigwo mwabagumyaho; mutagutuubyaho na kakye; ahakuba n'abeeremwa; nikyo kirikubatakisa nibagira bati: Ka tuze kutambira Ruhanga waitu ebitambo.
en: And the tale of the bricks, which they did make heretofore, ye shall lay upon them; ye shall not diminish ought thereof: for they be idle; therefore they cry, saying, Let us go and sacrifice to our God.

rr: Abashaija abo mubahe emirimo erikukiraho amaani, bagikore; barekye kuta omutima aha bigambo by'ebishuba.
en: Let there more work be laid upon the men, that they may labour therein; and let them not regard vain words.

rr: Abanyampara b'abantu n'abatware baabo nikwo kushohora, bakagambira abantu bati: Oku nikwo Faraho arikugamba naagira ati: Tindibaha mbuba z'engano
en: And the taskmasters of the people went out, and their officers, and they spake to the people, saying, Thus saith Pharaoh, I will not give you straw.

rr: mwirooko mugyende, muzeesherurire ahu muraazishangye hoona, mumanye ngu omurimo gwanyu tiguricuubwaho na kakye.
en: Go ye, get you straw where ye can find it: yet not ought of your work shall be diminished.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo abantu baabugibwa omu nsi yoona eya Misri kutorotoora ebitsintsi by'engano omu mwanya gw'embuba zaazo.
en: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble instead of straw.

rr: Abanyampara baabeezirikisa munonga nibagira bati: Muhitsye emirimo yaanyu eya buri izooba, nk'oku mubaire nimugikora mwine embuba z'engano.
en: And the taskmasters hasted them , saying, Fulfil your works, your daily tasks, as when there was straw.

rr: Abanyampara b'Abaisraeli, abatairweho abanyampara ba Faraho, baaterwa, kandi baabuuzibwa bati: N'enki ekibazibiire kuhitsya omubaro gw'amatafaari, ogu mucwereirwe nyomwabazyo n'eri izooba, nk'oku mubaire nimukora?
en: And the officers of the children of Israel, which Pharaoh's taskmasters had set over them, were beaten, and demanded, Wherefore have ye not fulfilled your task in making brick both yesterday and to day, as heretofore?

rr: Bwanyima abanyampara b'Abaisraeli baija ahari Faraho kwetonganira nibagira bati: Ahabw'enki otukozire oti, itwe abairu baawe?
en: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried unto Pharaoh, saying, Wherefore dealest thou thus with thy servants?

rr: Tibakituha mbuba z'engano; kandi bagarukire batugira bati: Mubumbe amatafaari; haza obwo bwona itwe abairu baawe nituteerwa, kandi orubanja ruri orw'abantu baawe.
en: There is no straw given unto thy servants, and they say to us, Make brick: and, behold, thy servants are beaten; but the fault is in thine own people.

rr: Kwonka yaagarukamu ati: Muri abeeremwa; muri abeeremwa! nikyo kirikubagirisa muti: Ka tugyende tutambire MUKAMA ebitambo.
en: But he said, Ye are idle, ye are idle: therefore ye say, Let us go and do sacrifice to the LORD .

rr: Mwirooko mugarukye aha mirimo yaanyu, mukore; ahakuba timurigaruka kuheebwa mbuba z'engano, kandi mugume muhitsye omubaro gw'amatafaari ogu mwacwereirwe.
en: Go therefore now, and work; for there shall no straw be given you, yet shall ye deliver the tale of bricks.

rr: Ku baagambiirwe ngu tibaricwerwaho mubaro gw'amatafaari ogwa buri izooba na kakye, abanyampara b'Abaisraeli baamanya ku bagwereirwe akagwe.
en: And the officers of the children of Israel did see that they were in evil case , after it was said, Ye shall not minish ought from your bricks of your daily task.

rr: Ku baabaire nibaruga owa Faraho, baashanga Musa na Arooni beemereire omu muhanda
en: And they met Moses and Aaron, who stood in the way, as they came forth from Pharaoh:

rr: baabagira bati: MUKAMA abareebe, kandi abacwere orubanja, ahabw'okuba niimwe mureeteire Faraho n'abashaija be kutwangira kimwe, n'okukwata rurara kutwita.
en: and they said unto them, The LORD look upon you, and judge; because ye have made our savour to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants, to put a sword in their hand to slay us.

rr: Musa yaagaruka ahari MUKAMA, yaagira ati: Ai bambe MUKAMA, abantu aba abakoreire ki kubi? Okaba wantumira ki?
en: And Moses returned unto the LORD , and said, Lord, wherefore hast thou so evil entreated this people? why is it that thou hast sent me?

rr: Ahakuba kwiha naaza owa Faraho kugamba omu iziina ryawe, akozire kubi aba bantu; kandi naiwe tiwaajuna bantu baawe na kakye.
en: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in thy name, he hath done evil to this people; neither hast thou delivered thy people at all.

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati: Hati noija kureeba oku ndaagire Faraho; ahakuba, ahabw'okugyemwa omukono gw'amaani, aryabarekura, nangwa n'okubabinga ababingye omu nsi ye ahabw'ogwo mukono.
en: Then the LORD said unto Moses, Now shalt thou see what I will do to Pharaoh: for with a strong hand shall he let them go, and with a strong hand shall he drive them out of his land.

rr: Ruhanga yaagamba na Musa naamugira ati: Niinye Yehova.
en: And God spake unto Moses, and said unto him, I am the LORD :

rr: Kandi nkeeyoreka Abrahamu na Isaaka na Yakobo, ndi Ruhanga Ow'obushoboorozi bwona; kwonka tindabeemanyiise mu iziina ryangye erya Yehova.
en: and I appeared unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, by the name of God Almighty, but by my name JEHOVAH was I not known to them.

rr: Nkahamya endagaano yangye nabo, ku ndibaha ensi ya Kanaani, ensi ei baatwiremu nk'abashuhuuki.
en: And I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their pilgrimage, wherein they were strangers.

rr: Kandi mpuriire okutsinda kw'Abaisraeli, abu Abanyamisri baagizire abahuuku; naanye naijuka endagaano yangye.
en: And I have also heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage; and I have remembered my covenant.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo gambira Abaisraeli ku ndi Yehova, kandi ku ndibatuura emitwaro ei Abanyamisri baabakoreire, nkabaiha omu buhuuku bwabo, nkabacunguza omukono gubangire n'ebifubiro by'amaani.
en: Wherefore say unto the children of Israel, I am the LORD , and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rid you out of their bondage, and I will redeem you with a stretched out arm, and with great judgments:

rr: Bwanyima ndyabeetwarira mube abantu bangye, kandi naanye mbe Ruhanga waanyu; aho niho murimanyira ku ndi Yehova Ruhanga waanyu, obatwire emitwaro ei Abanyamisri baabeekoreize
en: and I will take you to me for a people, and I will be to you a God: and ye shall know that I am the LORD your God, which bringeth you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.

rr: kandi ndyabatwara omu nsi, ei naimukiize omukono kuha Abrahamu na Isaaka na Yakobo; ngibahe kuba obuhunguzi bwanyu. Nyowe Yehova.
en: And I will bring you in unto the land, concerning the which I did swear to give it to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it you for an heritage: I am the LORD .

rr: Musa yaagambira Abaisraeli ebigambo ebyo; kwonka baayanga kumuhurira ahabw'obusaasi bw'omu mitima yaabo, n'ahabw'obuhuuku bubi.
en: And Moses spake so unto the children of Israel: but they hearkened not unto Moses for anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage.

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Za owa Faraho omugabe wa Misri, omugambire arekye Abaisraeli barugye omu nsi ye.
en: Go in, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.

rr: Musa yaagambira MUKAMA ati: Reeba, Abaisraeli tibampuriire; mbwenu Faraho we naabaasa ata kumpurira, nyowe ow'eminwa etashazirwe?
en: And Moses spake before the LORD , saying, Behold, the children of Israel have not hearkened unto me; how then shall Pharaoh hear me, who am of uncircumcised lips?

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Musa na Arooni, naabatuma aha Baisraeli n'ahari Faraho omugabe wa Misri, kwiha Abaisraeli omu nsi ya Misri.
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, and gave them a charge unto the children of Israel, and unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.

rr: Baishenkuru ba Musa na Arooni
en: Heads of the Families

rr: Aba nibo bakuru b'emiryango ya baishenkurubo; Batabani ba Reubeeni omujigaijo gwa Israeli, ni Hanoki, Palu, Hezirooni na Karumi; egyo niyo miryango ya Reubeeni.
en: These be the heads of their fathers' houses: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel; Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi: these be the families of Reuben.

rr: Batabani ba Simeoni ni Yemueli, Yamini, Ohadi, Yakini, Zohari, na Shauli omutabani, ow'Omunyakanaanikazi; egyo niyo miryango ya Simeoni.
en: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman: these are the families of Simeon.

rr: Kandi aga nigo maziina ga batabani ba Leevi, nk'oku baagyenzire nibakuratana omu kuzaara; Gereshoni, Kohasi na Merari. Emyaka ei Leevi yaahikize ekaba eri igana na makumi ashatu na mushanju.
en: And these are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari: and the years of the life of Levi were an hundred thirty and seven years.

rr: Batabani ba Gereshoni ni Libuni na Shimei, nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri
en: The sons of Gershon; Libni, and Shimi, according to their families.

rr: na batabani ba Kohasi ni Amuraamu, Izuhaari, Heburooni, na Uzieli; kandi emyaka ei Kohasi yaahikize ekaba eri igana na makumi ashatu n'eshatu
en: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel: and the years of the life of Kohath were an hundred thirty and three years.

rr: kandi na batabani ba Merari ni Mahili na Muushi. Egyo niyo miryango y'Abaleevi nk'oku baagyenzire nibakuratana omu kuzaara.
en: And the sons of Merari; Mahali and Mushi: these are the families of Levi according to their generations.

rr: Amuraamu yaashwera Yokebedi ishenkazi, yaamuzaarira Arooni na Musa; emyaka ei Amuraamu yaahikize ekaba eri igana na makumi ashatu na mushanju.
en: And Amram took him Jochebed his father's sister to wife; and she bare him Aaron and Moses: and the years of the life of Amram were an hundred and thirty and seven years.

rr: Batabani ba Izuhaari ni Koora, Nefegi na Zikiri.
en: And the sons of Izhar; Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.

rr: Batabani ba Uzieli ni Mishaeli, Elizafani na Zitiri.
en: And the sons of Uzziel; Mishael, and Elzaphan, and Zithri.

rr: Arooni yaashwera Elisheba, muhara wa Aminadabu, munyaanya wa Nahashooni; yaamuzaarira Nadabu, Abihu, Eleazaari na Itamaari.
en: And Aaron took him Elisheba, daughter of Amminadab, sister of Naashon, to wife; and she bare him Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

rr: batani ba Koora ni Asiri, Elukaana na Abiasaafu; egyo niyo miryango y'aba Koora.
en: And the sons of Korah; Assir, and Elkanah, and Abiasaph: these are the families of the Korhites.

rr: Eleazaari mwene Arooni yaashwera omwe ahari bahara ba Putieli; yaamuzaarira Finehaasi. Abo nibo bakuru b'emiryango ya baishenkuru b'Abaleevi nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri.
en: And Eleazar Aaron's son took him one of the daughters of Putiel to wife; and she bare him Phinehas: these are the heads of the fathers of the Levites according to their families.

rr: Abo nibo ba Arooni na Musa abu MUKAMA yaagambiire kwiha Abaisraeli omu nsi ya Misri, nk'oku amahe gaabo gaabaire gari.
en: These are that Aaron and Moses, to whom the LORD said, Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies.

rr: Abo nibo baagambiire Faraho omugabe wa Misri eby'okwiha Abaisraeli omuri Misri; abo nibo Musa na Arooni bari.
en: These are they which spake to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt: these are that Moses and Aaron. Pharaoh's Refusal

rr: Aha izooba eri MUKAMA yaagambiriireho Musa omu nsi ya Misri
en: And it came to pass on the day when the LORD spake unto Moses in the land of Egypt,

rr: akamugira ati: Niinye MUKAMA; gambira Faraho omugabe wa Misri ebigambo byona ebi ndikukugambira.
en: that the LORD spake unto Moses, saying, I am the LORD : speak thou unto Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I say unto thee.

rr: Musa yaagambira MUKAMA ati: Nyowe ndi omuntu w'eminwa etashazirwe; Faraho aryabaasa ata kumpurira?
en: And Moses said before the LORD , Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh hearken unto me?
