rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati: Reeba, naakugira nka Ruhanga ahari Faraho, na mukuru waawe Arooni naija kuba nabi waawe.
en: And the LORD said unto Moses, See, I have made thee a god to Pharaoh: and Aaron thy brother shall be thy prophet.

rr: Oryagamba byona ebi ndikuragiira; na mukuru waawe Arooni abigambire Faraho, naamuragiira kureka Abaisraeli kuruga omu nsi ye.
en: Thou shalt speak all that I command thee: and Aaron thy brother shall speak unto Pharaoh, that he send the children of Israel out of his land.

rr: Kwonka ndyagangaaza omutima gwa Faraho, nkanyise obumanyiso bwangye n'eby'okutangaaza byangye omu nsi ya Misri.
en: And I will harden Pharaoh's heart, and multiply my signs and my wonders in the land of Egypt.

rr: Faraho taribahurira; haza nyowe mbone kuta omukono gwangye ahari Misri, nyiheyo amahe gangye, nibo bantu bangye Abaisraeli, nimbajuna Abanyamisri n'ebifubiro by'amaani.
en: But Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you, that I may lay my hand upon Egypt, and bring forth mine armies, and my people the children of Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great judgments.

rr: Ku ndibanga omukono gwangye ahari Misri, naiha Abaisraeli omuribo, obwo nibwo Abanyamisri barimanya ku ndi MUKAMA.
en: And the Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD , when I stretch forth mine hand upon Egypt, and bring out the children of Israel from among them.

rr: Musa na Arooni baakora batyo; nk'oku MUKAMA yaabaragiire, baaba nikwo baakora.
en: And Moses and Aaron did as the LORD commanded them, so did they.

rr: Obwo Musa akaba ahikize emyaka makumi munaana, kandi mukuru we Arooni akaba aine emyaka makumi munaana n'eshatu, obu baagamba na Faraho.
en: And Moses was fourscore years old, and Aaron fourscore and three years old, when they spake unto Pharaoh.

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Musa na Arooni ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

rr: Faraho ku araabagire ati: Mukore eky'okutangaaza ky'okubahamya, obwo ogire Arooni oti: Twara enkoni yaawe, oginagye ahansi omu maisho ga Faraho, ehindukye enjoka.
en: When Pharaoh shall speak unto you, saying, Shew a miracle for you: then thou shalt say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and cast it before Pharaoh, and it shall become a serpent.

rr: Batyo Musa na Arooni baataaha owa Faraho, baakora nk'oku MUKAMA yaabaragiira; Arooni yaanaga enkoni ye ahansi omu maisho ga Faraho n'abaheereza be, yaahinduka enjoka.
en: And Moses and Aaron went in unto Pharaoh, and they did so as the LORD had commanded: and Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh, and before his servants, and it became a serpent.

rr: Faraho nawe yaayeta abanyabwengye n'abarogi, kandi n'abafumu ba Misri, baakora batyo n'oburogo bwabo
en: Then Pharaoh also called the wise men and the sorcerers: now the magicians of Egypt, they also did in like manner with their enchantments.

rr: ahakuba nabo bakanaga ahansi, buri muntu enkoni ye zaahinduka enjoka; kwonka enkoni ya Arooni yaamira ezaabo.
en: For they cast down every man his rod, and they became serpents: but Aaron's rod swallowed up their rods.

rr: Omutima gwa Faraho gwagangaara, tiyaabahurira, nk'oku MUKAMA yaagambire. Ekibonaboneso ky'okubanza. Amaizi okuhinduka eshagama
en: And he hardened Pharaoh's heart, that he hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had said. The Plagues

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati: Omutima gwa Faraho gugangaire, ayangire kurekura abantu.
en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Pharaoh's heart is hardened, he refuseth to let the people go.

rr: Omu kasheeshe oze owa Faraho; naija kuba naaza aha mugyera; iwe oyemerere aha nkungu y'omugyera, akushangyeho; kandi n'enkoni eyaahindukire enjoka ogigyendane
en: Get thee unto Pharaoh in the morning; lo, he goeth out unto the water; and thou shalt stand by the river's brink against he come; and the rod which was turned to a serpent shalt thou take in thine hand.

rr: omugire oti: MUKAMA Ruhanga w'Abaheburaayo akuntumireho, naagira ati: Reka abantu bangye bagyende, bampeerereze omu ihamba; kandi n'okuhitsya hati oyangire kuhurira.
en: And thou shalt say unto him, The LORD God of the Hebrews hath sent me unto thee, saying, Let my people go, that they may serve me in the wilderness: and, behold, hitherto thou wouldest not hear.

rr: Oku nikwo MUKAMA arikugamba, naagira ati: Aha niho oraamanyire ku ndi MUKAMA; niinyija kuteera amaizi g'omu mugyera n'enkoni ei nyine omu ngaro, gahindukye eshagama
en: Thus saith the LORD , In this thou shalt know that I am the LORD : behold, I will smite with the rod that is in mine hand upon the waters which are in the river, and they shall be turned to blood.

rr: eby'enyanja by'omu mugyera bife, omugyera gunuukye ekijunde; Abanyamisri banugye amaizi g'omuri ogwo mugyera, bangye kuganywa.
en: And the fish that is in the river shall die, and the river shall stink; and the Egyptians shall lothe to drink of the water of the river.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati: enkoni yaawe, obangye omukono gwawe ahaiguru y'amaizi g'omuri Misri, emigyera yaabo n'otugyera twabo n'ebiyanja byabo n'ahu amaizi gateeraniire hoona, gahindukye eshagama; kandi omu nsi ya Misri yoona omu bintu byabo eby'ebiti n'eby'amabaare nihaija kubamu eshagama.
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and stretch out thine hand upon the waters of Egypt, upon their streams, upon their rivers, and upon their ponds, and upon all their pools of water, that they may become blood; and that there may be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, both in vessels of wood, and in vessels of stone.

rr: Musa na Arooni baakora nk'oku MUKAMA abaragiire; yaimutsya egyo nkoni, yaateera amaizi g'omu mugyera omu maisho ga Faraho n'abaheereza be; amaizi goona ag'omu mugyera gaahinduka eshagama.
en: And Moses and Aaron did so, as the LORD commanded; and he lifted up the rod, and smote the waters that were in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood.

rr: Eby'enyanja ebyabaire biri omu mugyera byafa; omugyera gwanuuka ekijunde, Abanyamisri tibaabaasa kunywa maizi gaagwo; haabaho eshagama omu nsi ya Misri yoona.
en: And the fish that was in the river died; and the river stank, and the Egyptians could not drink of the water of the river; and there was blood throughout all the land of Egypt.

rr: Faraho yaarugayo, yaagaruka omuka, n'ekyo tiyaakyetaho.
en: And Pharaoh turned and went into his house, neither did he set his heart to this also.

rr: Abanyamisri boona baatimba haihi n'omugyera, ngu batungye amaizi g'okunywa; ahakuba tibarabaasize kunywa ha maizi g'omuri ogwo mugyera.
en: And all the Egyptians digged round about the river for water to drink; for they could not drink of the water of the river.

rr: Haahinguraho ebiro mushanju, MUKAMA aherize kuteera ogwo mugyera.
en: And seven days were fulfilled, after that the LORD had smitten the river.

rr: Kandi muryaguma mwijukye obugyenyi bw'emigaati etatumbisiibwe; ahabw'okuba ahari ekyo kiro nikyo ndikwija kwihiraho amahe gaanyu omu nsi ya Misri; n'ahabw'ekyo muryaguma mwijukye ekyo kiro omu busingye bwanyu bwona, gube omugyenzo ogubateereirweho ebiro byona.
en: And ye shall observe the feast of unleavened bread; for in this selfsame day have I brought your armies out of the land of Egypt: therefore shall ye observe this day in your generations by an ordinance for ever.

rr: Omu kwezi kw'okubanza, aha kiro kya ikumi na bina omu mwabazyo, muryarya emigaati etatumbisiibwe, okuhitsya aha kiro kya makumi abiri na kimwe eky'okwo kwezi omu mwabazyo.
en: In the first month , on the fourteenth day of the month at even, ye shall eat unleavened bread, until the one and twentieth day of the month at even.

rr: Omu biro mushanju ekitumbisa kyona kitarireebwa omu maka gaanyu; ahakuba omuntu weena orirya ekitumbisiibwe aryacuubwa omu ihanga rya Israeli, n'obu ariba ari omunyaihanga obashuhuukiiremu, nari enzaarwa.
en: Seven days shall there be no leaven found in your houses: for whosoever eateth that which is leavened, even that soul shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether he be a stranger, or born in the land.

rr: Mutarirya ekitumbisiibwe kyona; omu maka gaanyu goona mugume murye emigaati etatumbisiibwe. Musa okuragiira Abaisraeli eby'Okuhingurwaho
en: Ye shall eat nothing leavened; in all your habitations shall ye eat unleavened bread.

rr: Bwanyima Musa yaatuma abakuru boona ab'Abaisraeli, yaabagira ati: Mwetooranire abaana b'entaama, nk'emiryango yaanyu oku eri, mubaite ahabw'obugyenyi bw'Okuhingurwaho
en: Then Moses called for all the elders of Israel, and said unto them, Draw out and take you a lamb according to your families, and kill the passover.

rr: mutware enganda y'enyaweera, mugijabikye omu shagama eri omu rwabya, mugimiisiire aha kisasi n'aha biti by'omuryango; kandi hatarigira n'omwe omuriimwe owaaruga omu nju ye okuhitsya omu kasheeshe.
en: And ye shall take a bunch of hyssop, and dip it in the blood that is in the bason, and strike the lintel and the two side posts with the blood that is in the bason; and none of you shall go out at the door of his house until the morning.

rr: Ahakuba MUKAMA aryaraba omuriimwe naija kuteera Abanyamisri; ku arireeba eshagama aha kisasi n'aha biti by'emiryango byombi, aryaraba ahaiguru y'orwo rwigi, kandi tariikiriza Muhwerekyerezi kutaaha omu maju gaanyu kubaita.
en: For the LORD will pass through to smite the Egyptians; and when he seeth the blood upon the lintel, and on the two side posts, the LORD will pass over the door, and will not suffer the destroyer to come in unto your houses to smite you .

rr: Kandi muryaguma mwijukye eki, gube omugyenzo ogubateereirweho n'abaana baanyu ebiro byona.
en: And ye shall observe this thing for an ordinance to thee and to thy sons for ever.

rr: Kandi ku muriba mwahikire omu nsi ei MUKAMA aribaha nk'oku yaaraganiise, muryakora omugyenzo ogu ogurikwera.
en: And it shall come to pass, when ye be come to the land which the LORD will give you, according as he hath promised, that ye shall keep this service.

rr: Bwanyima abaana baanyu ku baribabuuza bati: Ogu mugyenzo, ogu murikukora, nigumanyisa ki?
en: And it shall come to pass, when your children shall say unto you, What mean ye by this service?

rr: Naimwe muryabagarukamu muti: N'ekitambo ky'Okuhinguraho kwa MUKAMA, ahakuba akahingura ahaiguru y'amaju g'Abaisraeli omuri Misri, obu yaita Abanyamisri, akakiza amaka gaitu.
en: That ye shall say, It is the sacrifice of the LORD 's passover, who passed over the houses of the children of Israel in Egypt, when he smote the Egyptians, and delivered our houses.

rr: Abantu bainika emitwe yaabo, baaramya.
en: And the people bowed the head and worshipped.

rr: Abaisraeli baagyenda, baakora batyo; nk'oku MUKAMA yaaragiire Musa na Arooni, baaba nikwo baatwaza. Ekibonaboneso kya ikumi, okwita emijigaijo
en: And the children of Israel went away, and did as the LORD had commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.

rr: Ku bwabaire buri omu itumbi, MUKAMA yaita emijigaijo yoona omu nsi ya Misri, okwiha aha mujigaijo gwa Faraho, owaabaire ari aha ngoma okuhika aha mujigaijo gw'enkwatwa, eyaabaire eri omu kihome, kandi n'emijigaijo yoona ey'amatungo.
en: And it came to pass, that at midnight the LORD smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sat on his throne unto the firstborn of the captive that was in the dungeon; and all the firstborn of cattle.

rr: Ahonaaho Faraho n'abaheereza be boona n'Abanyamisri boona baimuka nyekiro; haabaho okuborooga kuhango omuri Misri, ahabw'okuba tiharabaireho nju yoona etarafiiremu muntu.
en: And Pharaoh rose up in the night, he, and all his servants, and all the Egyptians; and there was a great cry in Egypt; for there was not a house where there was not one dead.

rr: Yaatuma Musa na Arooni ekyo kiro, yaabagira ati: Mwimukye, murugye omu bantu bangye, imwe n'Abaisraeli; mugyende muheereze MUKAMA nk'oku mwagambire.
en: And he called for Moses and Aaron by night, and said, Rise up, and get you forth from among my people, both ye and the children of Israel; and go, serve the LORD , as ye have said.

rr: Kandi mutware amasyo gaanyu ag'entaama n'ag'ente, nk'oku mwagambire, mwegyendere; naanye munshabire omugisha.
en: Also take your flocks and your herds, as ye have said, and be gone; and bless me also.

rr: Abanyamisri baateera Abaisraeli obwira, ngu babone kubarahutsya kuruga omu nsi; ahakuba bakagira bati: Twena twafiire!
en: And the Egyptians were urgent upon the people, that they might send them out of the land in haste; for they said, We be all dead men .

rr: Abaisraeli baatwara eisyanga ryabo ritakatumbisiibwe, baakoma ebintu byabo eby'okugoyeramu emigaati omu minagiro yaabo, baabyekorera aha mabega.
en: And the people took their dough before it was leavened, their kneadingtroughs being bound up in their clothes upon their shoulders.

rr: Baakora nk'oku Musa abaragiire; baashaba Abanyamisri ebintu by'efeeza n'eby'ezaabu n'eby'okujwara.
en: And the children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they borrowed of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment:

rr: MUKAMA yaaha abantu okukundwa Abanyamisri, baikiriza kubaha ebi baabaire nibabashaba byona. Okwo nikwo baanyagire Abanyamisri. Abaisraeli okutandika orugyendo rwabo
en: and the LORD gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they lent unto them such things as they required . And they spoiled the Egyptians.

rr: Abaisraeli baaruga Rameseesi, baahika Sukoosi, abashaija nk'obusiriira mukaaga nibagyendesa ebigyere, otabariiremu bakazi n'abaana.
en: And the children of Israel journeyed from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand on foot that were men, beside children.

rr: Kandi omutwe muhango gw'ebijwangye by'abantu bainamuka, baagyenda nabo n'amatungo maingi munonga g'entaama n'ag'ente.
en: And a mixed multitude went up also with them; and flocks, and herds, even very much cattle.

rr: Baateeka emigaati etatumbisiibwe omu isyanga eri baihire Misri, ahakuba rikaba ritatumbisiibwe; ahabw'okuba bakabingwa omuri Misri, tibaabaasa kwetwara n'obu kwakuba okwekomera entanda.
en: And they baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they brought forth out of Egypt, for it was not leavened; because they were thrust out of Egypt, and could not tarry, neither had they prepared for themselves any victual.

rr: Emyaka ei Abaisraeli baamazire omuri Misri bashuhuukire, ekaba eri magana ana na makumi ashatu.
en: Now the sojourning of the children of Israel, who dwelt in Egypt, was four hundred and thirty years.

rr: Aha kiro eki egyo myaka magana ana na makumi ashatu yaahikiireho, ahari ekyo kiro kyonka amahe goona aga MUKAMA gakaruga omuri Misri.
en: And it came to pass at the end of the four hundred and thirty years, even the selfsame day it came to pass, that all the hosts of the LORD went out from the land of Egypt.

rr: Ekyo kiro nikyo MUKAMA yaaraire naareeba abantu be, ngu abone kubaiha omu nsi ya Misri; n'ahabw'ekyo ekiro ekyo kishemereire kwijukwa Abaisraeli boona ahari MUKAMA omu busingye bwabo bwona.
en: It is a night to be much observed unto the LORD for bringing them out from the land of Egypt: this is that night of the LORD to be observed of all the children of Israel in their generations.

rr: Ebindi ebiragiro by'Okuhingurwaho
en: Ordinance of the Passover

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Musa na Arooni ati: Ogu nigwo mugyenzo ogutairweho ahabw'Okuhingurwaho. Omunyaihanga tariikirizibwa kukuryaho
en: And the LORD said unto Moses and Aaron, This is the ordinance of the passover: there shall no stranger eat thereof:

rr: kwonka omuhuuku weena oguzirwe empiiha naikirizibwa kukuryaho, mwaherize kumushara.
en: but every man's servant that is bought for money, when thou hast circumcised him, then shall he eat thereof.

rr: Omushuhuuki n'orikukorera ebihembo tarikwikirizibwa kukuryaho.
en: A foreigner and an hired servant shall not eat thereof.

rr: Kuryaguma kuriirwe omu nju emwe; otarishohoza akanyama koona aheeru y'enju; kandi mutarihenda eigufa ryayo.
en: In one house shall it be eaten; thou shalt not carry forth ought of the flesh abroad out of the house; neither shall ye break a bone thereof.

rr: Eihanga ryona ery'Abaisraeli riryaguma rikwijukye.
en: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it.

rr: Omunyaihanga ku ariija kutuura naimwe, yaayenda kukwatanisa naimwe omu bugyenyi bw'Okuhingurwaho ahari MUKAMA, oyetwa omushaija weena omuribo asharwe, abone kwija kubutaaha; obwo aryaba nk'enzaarwa omu nsi yaanyu; kwonka omuntu weena otashazirwe atariburyaho.
en: And when a stranger shall sojourn with thee, and will keep the passover to the LORD , let all his males be circumcised, and then let him come near and keep it; and he shall be as one that is born in the land: for no uncircumcised person shall eat thereof.

rr: Enzaarwa n'omunyaihanga obatwiremu baryategyekwa ekiragiro kimwe.
en: One law shall be to him that is homeborn, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among you.

rr: Okwo nikwo Abaisraeli boona baakozire; nk'oku MUKAMA yaaragiire Musa na Arooni, nikwo baatwarize.
en: Thus did all the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.

rr: Ahari ekyo kiro kyonka MUKAMA akaiha Abaisraeli omu nsi ya Misri, nk'oku amahe gaabo gaabaire gari.
en: And it came to pass the selfsame day, that the LORD did bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies.

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Munyereze emijigaijo yoona; ekiigura-nda kyona omu Baisareli, yaaba mu bantu nari omu matungo, n'ekyangye.
en: Sanctify unto me all the firstborn, whatsoever openeth the womb among the children of Israel, both of man and of beast: it is mine.

rr: Musa yaagambira abantu ati: Muryaguma mwijukye eizooba eri, eri mwarugiireho Misri, omu nju y'obuhuuku; ahakuba MUKAMA akabaiha omu mwanya ogwo n'omukono gw'amaani; hatarigira omugaati gwona ogutumbisiibwe ogwariibwa.
en: And Moses said unto the people, Remember this day, in which ye came out from Egypt, out of the house of bondage; for by strength of hand the LORD brought you out from this place: there shall no leavened bread be eaten.

rr: Eizooba eri ery'omu kwezi Abibu niryo mwaza kurugiramu.
en: This day came ye out in the month Abib.

rr: Kandi MUKAMA ku arikuhitsya omu nsi y'Abanyakanaani, n'Abahiiti n'Abaamori n'Abahiivi n'ey'Abayebusi, ensi ey'amate n'obwoki, ei yaagambiire baashwenkuru naarahira kugikuha, oryaguma oijukye kukora omugyenzo ogu omu kwezi oku.
en: And it shall be when the LORD shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee, a land flowing with milk and honey, that thou shalt keep this service in this month.

rr: Oryamara ebiro mushanju noorya emigaati etatumbisiibwe; kandi aha kiro kya mushanju haryabaho obugyenyi bw'ekiro kikuru kya MUKAMA.
en: Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, and in the seventh day shall be a feast to the LORD .

rr: Omuri ebyo biro mushanju muryaguma nimurya emigaati etatumbisiibwe; mutarireebwa mwine omugaati gwona ogutumbisiibwe, n'obu kyakuba ekitumbisa kyona, omu nsi yaanyu yoona.
en: Unleavened bread shall be eaten seven days; and there shall no leavened bread be seen with thee, neither shall there be leaven seen with thee in all thy quarters.

rr: Kandi ahari eryo izooba oryagambira omwana waawe oti: Eki ninkikora ahabw'eki MUKAMA yankoreire, obu naaruga omuri Misri.
en: And thou shalt shew thy son in that day, saying, This is done because of that which the LORD did unto me when I came forth out of Egypt.

rr: Kandi kiryakubeera akamanyiso aha mukono gwawe, n'ekiijutsyo ahagati y'amaisho gaawe, ekiragiro kya MUKAMA kirekye kukuruga omu kanwa; ahakuba MUKAMA akakwiha omuri Misri n'omukono gw'amaani.
en: And it shall be for a sign unto thee upon thine hand, and for a memorial between thine eyes, that the LORD 's law may be in thy mouth: for with a strong hand hath the LORD brought thee out of Egypt.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo oryaguma oijukye omugyenzo ogu omu bunaku bwagwo buri mwaka.
en: Thou shalt therefore keep this ordinance in his season from year to year.

rr: Kandi MUKAMA ku arikuhitsya omu nsi ya Kanaani, yaagikuha, nk'oku yaaraganiise na baashwenkuru naarahira
en: And it shall be when the LORD shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites, as he sware unto thee and to thy fathers, and shall give it thee,

rr: oryashoroorera MUKAMA ekiigura-nda kyona. Emijigaijo yoona ey'omu matungo gaawe, ekyetwa ekishaija kyona, kiryaba ekya MUKAMA.
en: that thou shalt set apart unto the LORD all that openeth the matrix, and every firstling that cometh of a beast which thou hast; the males shall be the LORD 's.

rr: Omujigaijo gwona ogw'endogoya oryagucunguza omwana gw'entaama; ku oriba otarikwenda kugucungura, oryaguhenda ebitsya; kandi emijigaijo yoona ey'abantu omu baana baawe oryagicungura.
en: And every firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb; and if thou wilt not redeem it, then thou shalt break his neck: and all the firstborn of man among thy children shalt thou redeem.

rr: Kandi omwana waawe ku arikubuuza omu biro ebiriija naagira ati: Eki nikimanyisa ki? oryamugarukamu oti: MUKAMA akatwiha omuri Misri, omu nju y'obuhuuku, n'omukono gw'amaani
en: And it shall be when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What is this? that thou shalt say unto him, By strength of hand the LORD brought us out from Egypt, from the house of bondage:

rr: ahakuba Faraho akaba agangaire, ayangire kuturekura, MUKAMA yaita emijigaijo yoona omu nsi ya Misri, ey'abantu n'ey'amatungo. Nikyo ntambirira MUKAMA ebiigura-nda byona, ebyetwa ebishaija; kwonka emijigaijo yoona omuri batabani bangye, nkagicungura.
en: and it came to pass, when Pharaoh would hardly let us go, that the LORD slew all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn of man, and the firstborn of beast: therefore I sacrifice to the LORD all that openeth the matrix, being males; but all the firstborn of my children I redeem.

rr: Eki kiryaba akamanyiso aha mukono gwawe, n'ekiijutsyo aha buso bwawe; ahabw'okuba MUKAMA akatwiha omuri Misri n'omukono gw'amaani.
en: And it shall be for a token upon thine hand, and for frontlets between thine eyes: for by strength of hand the LORD brought us forth out of Egypt.

rr: Abaisraeli okugumizamu orugyendo
en: The Exodus

rr: Faraho ku yaaherize kurekura abantu kugyenda, Ruhanga tiyaabarabya mu muhanda ogurikuraba omu nsi y'Abafilistia, n'obu guraabe gwabaire guri haihi; ahakuba Ruhanga akagira ati: Nyentsya abantu ku barishangayo orugamba, bataryefuuza, bakagaruka Misri.
en: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh had let the people go, that God led them not through the way of the land of the Philistines, although that was near; for God said, Lest peradventure the people repent when they see war, and they return to Egypt:

rr: Kureka Ruhanga akabakiikuura omu muhanda ogw'omu ihamba aha rubaju rw'Enyanja erikutukura. Abaisraeli baaruga Misri, bahagatiire eby'okurwanisa.
en: but God led the people about, through the way of the wilderness of the Red sea: and the children of Israel went up harnessed out of the land of Egypt.

rr: Musa yaatwara amagufa ga Yosefu; ahabw'okuba Yosefu akaba arahiize Abaisraeli naabahamiza ati: Buzimazima Ruhanga aryabataayaayira; naimwe muryaiha amagufa gangye omu nsi egi, mugagyendane.
en: And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him: for he had straitly sworn the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you; and ye shall carry up my bones away hence with you.

rr: Baaruga Sukoosi, baateera amahema Esamu aha munwa gw'eihamba.
en: And they took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.

rr: MUKAMA akaba abeebembera nyomushana, ari omu nyomyo y'ekicu, ngu abahabure, kandi nyekiro omu nyomyo y'omuriro, ngu abamurikire, babone kugyenda nyomushana na nyekiro.
en: And the LORD went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way; and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light; to go by day and night:

rr: Egyo nyomyo y'ekicu nyomushana, kandi ey'omuriro nyekiro, ekaba etabaruga mumaisho.
en: he took not away the pillar of the cloud by day, nor the pillar of fire by night, from before the people.

MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Gambira Abaisraeli bagarukye enyima, bateere amahema omu maisho ga Pihahiroosi ahagati ya Migidooli n'enyanja, omu maisho ga Baalizefooni; muteere amahema ahashungaine naho aha rubaju rw'enyanja.
en: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they turn and encamp before Pi-hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, over against Baal-zephon: before it shall ye encamp by the sea.

rr: Kandi Faraho naija kugamba aha Baisraeli ati: Bashobereirwe omu nsi, eihamba ribatangire.
en: For Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, They are entangled in the land, the wilderness hath shut them in.

rr: Naanye niinyija kugangaaza omutima gwa Faraho, abakurate; nyetungire ekitiinisa ahari Faraho n'aha ihe rye ryona, Abanyamisri baamanye ku ndi MUKAMA.
en: And I will harden Pharaoh's heart, that he shall follow after them; and I will be honoured upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host; that the Egyptians may know that I am the LORD .

rr: Abaisraeli baakora batyo.
en: And they did so.

rr: Baagambira omugabe wa Misri ku Abaisraeli bacwire; omutima gwa Faraho n'ey'abaheereza be yaahinduka, baayefuuza ahabwabo, nibagira bati: Beitu eki, tukozire ki, okwikiriza Abaisraeli kugyenda bakareka kutukorera?
en: And it was told the king of Egypt that the people fled: and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was turned against the people, and they said, Why have we done this, that we have let Israel go from serving us?

rr: Yaatebeekanisa ekigaari kye eky'okurwanisa, yaagyenda n'engabo ze
en: And he made ready his chariot, and took his people with him:

rr: yaatwara ebigaari magana mukaaga ebitoorainwe, n'ebindi bigaari bya Misri byona eby'okurwanisa, buri kimwe n'omukuru waakyo.
en: and he took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt, and captains over every one of them.

rr: MUKAMA yaagangaaza omutima gwa Faraho omugabe wa Misri, yaakurata Abaisraeli; ahakuba Abaisraeli bakaruga Misri nibeemurika.
en: And the LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he pursued after the children of Israel: and the children of Israel went out with an high hand.

rr: Abanyamisri baabakurata n'embaraasi n'ebigaari bya Faraho byona, n'ab'aha mbaraasi n'engabo ze, baabahika, baashanga bateire amahema haihi n'enyanja aha rubaju rwa Pihahiroosi, ahashungaine na Baali-zefooni.
en: But the Egyptians pursued after them, all the horses and chariots of Pharaoh, and his horsemen, and his army, and overtook them encamping by the sea, beside Pi-hahiroth, before Baal-zephon.

rr: Faraho ku yaahikire haihi, Abaisraeli baanaga amaisho, baareeba Abanyamisri nibaija babakuratiire, baatiina munonga; baatakira MUKAMA.
en: And when Pharaoh drew nigh, the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and, behold, the Egyptians marched after them; and they were sore afraid: and the children of Israel cried out unto the LORD .

rr: Baagambira Musa bati: Beitu shi, ebituuro bikaba bibuzire omuri Misri, waaza kutureeta kugwa omu ihamba? Eki okatukorera ki, okutwiha omuri Misri?
en: And they said unto Moses, Because there were no graves in Egypt, hast thou taken us away to die in the wilderness? wherefore hast thou dealt thus with us, to carry us forth out of Egypt?

rr: Eki tikyo twakugambiire, obu twabaire tukiri Misri tuti: Fa okutureka, tugume tukorere Abanyamisri?
en: Is not this the word that we did tell thee in Egypt, saying, Let us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians?

rr: Haakiri tukorera Abanyamisri okukira okugwa omu ihamba.
en: For it had been better for us to serve the Egyptians, than that we should die in the wilderness.

rr: 2 Musa yaagambira abantu ati: Mutatiina mwemerere muhamire, haza mureebe okujunwa oku MUKAMA araabareetere eri izooba; ahakuba Abanyamisri abu murikureeba eri izooba, timurigaruka kubareeba bundi.
en: And Moses said unto the people, Fear ye not, stand still, and see the salvation of the LORD , which he will shew to you to day: for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day, ye shall see them again no more for ever.

rr: MUKAMA niwe araabarwanirire; ekyanyu n'okwemerera kwonka.
en: The LORD shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati: Ahabw'enki nontakira? Gambira Abaisraeli bagumizemu bagyende.
en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Wherefore criest thou unto me? speak unto the children of Israel, that they go forward:

rr: Naiwe oyereeze enkoni yaawe, ogorore omukono gwawe aha nyanja, ogibaganise, Abaisraeli barabe ahagati y'enyanja aha itaka ryomire.
en: but lift thou up thy rod, and stretch out thine hand over the sea, and divide it: and the children of Israel shall go on dry ground through the midst of the sea.

rr: Naanye niinyija kugangaaza emitima y'Abanyamisri bazemu babakurate, nyetungire ekitiinisa ahari Faraho n'aha ihe rye ryona n'aha bigaari bye n'aha bantu be ab'aha mbaraasi.
en: And I, behold, I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they shall follow them: and I will get me honour upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.

rr: Kandi Abanyamisri nibaija kumanya ku ndi MUKAMA, ku ndaaheze kwetungira ekitiinisa ahari Faraho n'ebigaari bye n'aha bantu be ab'aha mbaraasi.

en: And he said unto them, This is that which the LORD hath said, To morrow is the rest of the holy sabbath unto the LORD : bake that which ye will bake to day , and seethe that ye will seethe; and that which remaineth over lay up for you to be kept until the morning.

rr: Atyo Arooni yaagibiika omu maisho g'Ebirikuhamya, ngu egumeho, nk'oku MUKAMA yaaragiire Musa.
en: As the LORD commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.

rr: Kandi Abaisraeli bakamara emyaka makumi ana nibarya emaanu, okuhitsya obu baahikire omu nsi etwirwemu abantu; baagumizamu nibarya emaanu okuhitsya obu baahikire aha myatano y'ensi ya Kanaani.
en: And the children of Israel did eat manna forty years, until they came to a land inhabited; they did eat manna, until they came unto the borders of the land of Canaan.

rr: Kandi homeri emwe ekaba eri ekicweka kya ikumi kya 16:36 Eefa emwe neingana nka galloni munaana. eefa emwe.
en: Now an omer is the tenth part of an ephah.

rr: Eihanga ryona ery'Abaisraeli ryaruga omu ihamba rya Siini, baagyenda nibaraarira nk'oku MUKAMA yaabaire abaragiira. Ku baahikire Refidimu, baateerayo amahema; kwonka abantu baaburayo amaizi g'okunywa.
en: And all the congregation of the children of Israel journeyed from the wilderness of Sin, after their journeys, according to the commandment of the LORD , and pitched in Rephidim: and there was no water for the people to drink.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo abantu baatonganisa Musa nibagira bati: Tuhe amaizi g'okunywa. Musa yaabagira ati: Nimuntonganisiza ki? Ahabw'enki nimugyeza MUKAMA?
en: Wherefore the people did chide with Moses, and said, Give us water that we may drink. And Moses said unto them, Why chide ye with me? wherefore do ye tempt the LORD ?

rr: Abantu baagirirayo eiriho, baayetomboitera Musa nibagira bati: Okatwihira ki Misri kutwitsa eiriho, itwe n'abaana baitu n'amatungo gaitu?
en: And the people thirsted there for water; and the people murmured against Moses, and said, Wherefore is this that thou hast brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us and our children and our cattle with thirst?

rr: Musa yaatakira MUKAMA, naagira ati: Abantu aba mbagire nta? Bari hakye kunteera amabaare.
en: And Moses cried unto the LORD , saying, What shall I do unto this people? they be almost ready to stone me.

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati: Raba omu maisho g'abantu, otware abamwe aha bakuru b'Abaisraeli, otware n'enkoni, ei waateire omugyera guri, ogyende.
en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go on before the people, and take with thee of the elders of Israel; and thy rod, wherewith thou smotest the river, take in thine hand, and go.

rr: Reeba, niinyija kwemerera omu maisho gaawe aha rukiri rw'ahari Horebu; oteere orwo rukiri, harugyemu amaizi, abantu banywe.
en: Behold, I will stand before thee there upon the rock in Horeb; and thou shalt smite the rock, and there shall come water out of it, that the people may drink.

rr: Musa yaakora atyo omu maisho g'abakuru b'Abaisraeli.
en: And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.

rr: Omwanya ogwo yaagweta 17:7 Maasa amakuru n'Okugyeza. Maasa na 17:7 Meriba, amakuru n'Okutongana. Meriba ahabw'okutongana oku Abaisraeli baamutonganiise, kandi ahabw'okuba bakagyeza MUKAMA nibagira bati: Ebyo MUKAMA ari ahagati omuriitwe, nari tariho? Abaamaleki okurwanisa Abaisraeli
en: And he called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because of the chiding of the children of Israel, and because they tempted the LORD , saying, Is the LORD among us, or not?

rr: Bwanyima haija Abaamaleki, baarwanisiza Abaisraeli ahari Refidimu.
en: Then came Amalek, and fought with Israel in Rephidim.

rr: Musa yaagambira Yoshua ati: Tutooranire engabo, mugyende murwanise Abaamaleki; nyencakare niinyija kwemerera aha mutwe gw'ekibungo, nkwaitse enkoni ya Ruhanga omu ngaro.
en: And Moses said unto Joshua, Choose us out men, and go out, fight with Amalek: to morrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of God in mine hand.

rr: Yoshua yaakora nk'oku Musa amuragiire, yaarwanisa Abaamaleki; Musa na Arooni na Huuri bainamuka, baahika aha mutwe gw'ekyo kibungo.
en: So Joshua did as Moses had said to him, and fought with Amalek: and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.

rr: Musa ku yaabaire aimutsya omukono, Abaisraeli babinga; akigugwisa, Abaamaleki babinga.
en: And it came to pass, when Moses held up his hand, that Israel prevailed: and when he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.

rr: Kwonka emikono ya Musa yaaruha; baareeta eibaare, baarita ahansi ye, yaarishutamaho; Arooni na Huuri baaramira emikono ye, omwe aha rubaju rumwe n'ondi aha rundi; emikono ye yaahama okuhitsya obu eizooba ryarengire.
en: But Moses' hands were heavy; and they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat thereon; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.

rr: Yoshua yaasingura Amaleki n'engabo ze na rurara.
en: And Joshua discomfited Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati: Ekyo okihandiikye omu kitabo, kibe ekiijutsyo, okiteekyerereze Yoshua, ku ndimariraho kimwe Amaleki, atagarukye kwijukwa ahansi y'eiguru.
en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: for I will utterly put out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven.

rr: Kandi Musa yaayombeka eitambiro, yaaryeta 17:15 Yehova-niisi amakuru ngu MUKAMA n'orurango rwangye. Yehova-niisi
en: And Moses built an altar, and called the name of it Jehovah-nissi:

rr: yaagira ati: MUKAMA yaarahira ku ariguma naarwanisa Abaamaleki, nk'oku obusingye burigyenda nibwihaihana.
en: for he said, Because the LORD hath sworn that the LORD will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.

rr: Yesero omunyamurwa wa Midiani, ishezaara wa Musa, akahurira byona ebi Ruhanga yaakoreire Musa n'abantu be Abaisraeli, kandi n'oku yaihire Abaisraeli omuri Misri.
en: When Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses' father in law, heard of all that God had done for Moses, and for Israel his people, and that the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt;

rr: Kandi Yesero, ishezaara wa Musa, akaba atwaire Zipora muka Musa, ou Musa yaabaire ayohereizeyo n'abatabani bombi.
en: then Jethro, Moses' father in law, took Zipporah, Moses' wife, after he had sent her back,

rr: Eiziina ry'omwe akaba ari Gereshomu, (ahakuba ishe akagira ati: Nkaba ndi omushuhuuki omu nsi etari yaitu
en: and her two sons; of which the name of the one was Gershom; for he said, I have been an alien in a strange land:

rr: n'ondiijo akaba naayetwa Eliezeeri, ahakuba ishe akagira ati: Ruhanga wa taata akambeera Omuhwezi, yankiza rurara ya Faraho.)
en: and the name of the other was Eliezer; for the God of my father, said he, was mine help, and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh:

rr: Yesero ishezaara wa Musa yaareetera Musa abatabani n'omukazi we, yaamushanga omuri eryo ihamba, ahu yaabaire ari omu rusiisira aha rushozi rwa Ruhanga.
en: and Jethro, Moses' father in law, came with his sons and his wife unto Moses into the wilderness, where he encamped at the mount of God:

rr: Yaagambira Musa ati: Nyowe shozaara Yesero naakureetera omukazi waawe na batabani be bombi.
en: and he said unto Moses, I thy father in law Jethro am come unto thee, and thy wife, and her two sons with her.

rr: Musa yaashohora kubugana ishezaara, yainama omu maisho ge, yaamunywegyera; baabuuzana oku barikuraara; baataaha omu ihema.
en: And Moses went out to meet his father in law, and did obeisance, and kissed him; and they asked each other of their welfare; and they came into the tent.

rr: Musa yaateekyerereza ishezaara byona ebi MUKAMA yaakozire ahari Faraho n'Abanyamisri ahabw'Abaisraeli, n'enaku zoona ezi baareebire omu muhanda, kandi n'oku MUKAMA yaabakirize.
en: And Moses told his father in law all that the LORD had done unto Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel's sake, and all the travail that had come upon them by the way, and how the LORD delivered them.

rr: Yesero yaashemererwa ahabw'ebirungi byona ebi MUKAMA yaakoreire Abaisraeli, ahabw'okubajuna omu mikono y'Abanyamisri.
en: And Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the LORD had done to Israel, whom he had delivered out of the hand of the Egyptians.

rr: Yesero yaagira ati: MUKAMA owaabakirize Abanyamisri na Faraho ahimbisibwe!
en: And Jethro said, Blessed be the LORD , who hath delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh, who hath delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.

rr: -20 ; . Mbwenu naamanya ku MUKAMA arikukira baaruhanga abandi boona, ahakuba akaiha abantu omu mikono y'Abanyamisri, obu baabaire nibabaita kubi babaineho amaryo.
en: Now I know that the LORD is greater than all gods: for in the thing wherein they dealt proudly he was above them.

rr: Yesero ishezaara wa Musa yaatwara ekitambo ky'okwotsya n'ebindi bitambo by'okutambira Ruhanga; Arooni n'abakuru b'Abaisraeli boona baija kuriira hamwe na ishezaara wa Musa omu maisho ga Ruhanga.
en: And Jethro, Moses' father in law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God: and Aaron came, and all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses' father in law before God.

rr: Ku bwaseesire, Musa yaashutama kucwera abantu emanja; abantu baayemerera beehinguririize Musa okwiha omu kasheeshe okuhitsya omu mwabazyo.
en: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses sat to judge the people: and the people stood by Moses from the morning unto the evening.

rr: Ishezaara wa Musa ku yaareebire byona ebi arikukorera abantu, yaagira ati: Eki eki orikukorera abantu niki? Ahabw'enki nooshutama wenka, abantu boona bakakwehinguririza okwiha omu kasheeshe okuhitsya omu mwabazyo?
en: And when Moses' father in law saw all that he did to the people, he said, What is this thing that thou doest to the people? why sittest thou thyself alone, and all the people stand by thee from morning unto even?

rr: Musa yaagarukamu ishezaara ati: N'ahabw'okuba abantu nibaija ahariinye, ngu mbabuurize ahari Ruhanga.
en: And Moses said unto his father in law, Because the people come unto me to enquire of God:

rr: Omuntu na mutaahi we ku baba baine eki barikufa, baija ahariinye, mbaramura, kandi mbamanyisa ebiragiro bya Ruhanga n'ebi arikuragiira.
en: when they have a matter, they come unto me; and I judge between one and another, and I do make them know the statutes of God, and his laws.

rr: Ishezaara wa Musa yaamugira ati: Eki eki orikukora ti kirungi.
en: And Moses' father in law said unto him, The thing that thou doest is not good.

rr: Noija kwomera ahaiguru, iwe n'aba bantu abu oine; ahakuba omurimo ogu nigukukira; torikubaasa kugukora wenka.
en: Thou wilt surely wear away, both thou, and this people that is with thee: for this thing is too heavy for thee; thou art not able to perform it thyself alone.

rr: Mbwenu hurira eki ndikukugambira, nkuhe obwengye; kandi Ruhanga agume naiwe. Obe niiwe waaguma noohikira abantu ahari Ruhanga, kandi ogume obahikizeyo emanja zaabo
en: Hearken now unto my voice, I will give thee counsel, and God shall be with thee: Be thou for the people to God-ward, that thou mayest bring the causes unto God:

rr: kandi oryabeegyesa ebiragiro n'ebi Ruhanga arikuragiira, oboorekye oku bashemereire kutwaza n'ebi bashemereire kukora.
en: and thou shalt teach them ordinances and laws, and shalt shew them the way wherein they must walk, and the work that they must do.

rr: Kandi otoorane omu bantu boona abashaij b'oburyo, abarikutiina Ruhanga, ab'amazima, kandi abarikwanga enguzi; abantu nk'abo obateho bategyekye abantu, abamwe bategyekye buri omwe rukumi, abandi igana, abandi ataano, n'abandi ikumi
en: Moreover thou shalt provide out of all the people able men, such as fear God, men of truth, hating covetousness; and place such over them, to be rulers of thousands, and rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens:

rr: babe nibo baaguma nibacwera abantu emanja obutoosha. Orubanja orugumire rwona baryarukureetera, kwonka emanja ezoorobi babe nibo baazicwa; obwo nibwo oryanguhirwa, nabo bakaguma nibakwatanisa naiwe oburemeezi.
en: and let them judge the people at all seasons: and it shall be, that every great matter they shall bring unto thee, but every small matter they shall judge: so shall it be easier for thyself, and they shall bear the burden with thee.

rr: Ku oraakore ekigambo ekyo, kandi Ruhanga yaaba niwe yaakikuragiira, obwo oryabaasa kugumaho, kandi n'aba bantu baryaguma nibagaruka owaabo n'obusingye.
en: If thou shalt do this thing, and God command thee so , then thou shalt be able to endure, and all this people shall also go to their place in peace.

rr: Musa yaahurira ebigambo bya ishezaara, yaakora ebi yaamugambira byona.
en: So Moses hearkened to the voice of his father in law, and did all that he had said.

rr: Yaatoorana omu Baisraeli boona abashaija b'oburyo, yaabahindura abakuru b'abantu, abamwe kutegyeka buri omwe rukumi, abandi igana, abandi ataano n'abandi ikumi.
en: And Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.

rr: Baaguma nibacwera abantu emanja obutoosha; emanja ezigumire bazireetera Musa, kwonka ezoorobi zoona bazeemarira.
en: And they judged the people at all seasons: the hard causes they brought unto Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.

rr: Bwanyima Musa yaaraga ishezaara, yaagaruka owaabo.
en: And Moses let his father in law depart; and he went his way into his own land.

rr: Omu kwezi kwa kashatu Abaisraeli baherize kuruga omu nsi ya Misri, aha kiro eki okwezi okwo kwabonekyeireho, bakahika omu ihamba rya Sinai.
en: In the third month, when the children of Israel were gone forth out of the land of Egypt, the same day came they into the wilderness of Sinai.

rr: Ku baarugire Refidimu, baahika omu ihamba rya Sinai, baateera amahema omuri eryo ihamba; kandi Abaisraeli baaguma omu rusiisira omu maisho g'orushozi.
en: For they were departed from Rephidim, and were come to the desert of Sinai, and had pitched in the wilderness; and there Israel camped before the mount.

rr: Musa yainamuka ahari Ruhanga, MUKAMA yaamweta naayema aha rushozi, yaagira ati: Oku nikwo oraagambire enju ya Yakobo, noogambira Abaisraeli, oti
en: And Moses went up unto God, and the LORD called unto him out of the mountain, saying, Thus shalt thou say to the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel;

rr: Mukareeba ebi naakozire Abanyamisri, kandi naimwe oku naabatwariire aha mapapa nk'empungu, nkabareeta ahariinye.
en: ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and how I bare you on eagles' wings, and brought you unto myself.

rr: N'ahabwekyo ku murihurira eiraka ryangye, mwarinda endagaano yangye, muryaba abantu bangye ahabwangye abatoorainwe omu mahanga goona; ahakuba ensi yoona n'eyangye
en: Now therefore, if ye will obey my voice indeed, and keep my covenant, then ye shall be a peculiar treasure unto me above all people: for all the earth is mine:

rr: kandi muryambeera obukama bw'abanyamurwa n'eihanga eririkwera.
en: and ye shall be unto me a kingdom of priests, and an holy nation.

rr: Ebyo nibyo bigambo ebi oraagambire Abaisraeli.
en: These are the words which thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel.

rr: Musa yaija, yaayeta abakuru b'abantu, yaata omu maisho gaabo ebigambo ebyo byona ebi MUKAMA yaamuragiire.
en: And Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and laid before their faces all these words which the LORD commanded him.

rr: Abantu boona baagarukiramu hamwe, nibagira bati: Byona ebi MUKAMA yaagamba, nitwija kubikora.
en: And all the people answered together, and said, All that the LORD hath spoken we will do.

rr: Musa yaagambira MUKAMA ebigambo ebyo ebi abantu baagamba.
en: And Moses returned the words of the people unto the LORD .

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati: Reeba, niinyija ahariiwe omu kicu kikwaitse, ngu abantu bahurire ningamba naiwe, babone kukwikiriza ebiro byona.
en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Lo, I come unto thee in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with thee, and believe thee for ever.

rr: Bwanyima Musa yaagambira MUKAMA ebigambo by'abantu.
en: And Moses told the words of the people unto the LORD .

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati: Irooko oze omu bantu, obeeze eri izooba na nyencakare, boozye ebijwaro byabo
en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go unto the people, and sanctify them to day and to morrow, and let them wash their clothes,

rr: aha kiro kya kashatu bashangwe beeteekateekire; ahakuba ahari ekyo kiro kya kashatu MUKAMA naija kushuuma aha rushozi Sinai omu maisho g'abantu boona.
en: and be ready against the third day: for the third day the LORD will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai.

rr: Oteereho abantu obugarukiro okwehinguririza orushozi, obagire oti: Mwerinde, mutainamuka aha rushozi, n'obu kwakuba okukora aha bugarukiro bwarwo; omuntu weena oraakore aha rushozi, buzimazima naija kwitwa
en: And thou shalt set bounds unto the people round about, saying, Take heed to yourselves, that ye go not up into the mount, or touch the border of it: whosoever toucheth the mount shall be surely put to death:

rr: kandi hatagira omuntu weena owaamukoraho, kureka bamwitse amabaare, nari bamurashe; n'obu eraabe enyamaishwa nari omuntu, atagumaho. Enzamba ku eraagambe akasirikiriro, bainamukye, bahikye aha rushozi.
en: there shall not an hand touch it, but he shall surely be stoned, or shot through; whether it be beast or man, it shall not live: when the trumpet soundeth long, they shall come up to the mount.

rr: Bwanyima Musa yaashuuma orushozi, yaaza omu bantu, yaabeeza, baayozya ebijwaro byabo
en: And Moses went down from the mount unto the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.

rr: yaagambira abantu ati: Ekiro kya kashatu kishangye mweteekateekire; mutagira obu muhikire abakazi baanyu.
en: And he said unto the people, Be ready against the third day: come not at your wives.

rr: Ku bwaseesire aha kiro kya kashatu, enkuba zaahinda, emirabyo yaatyankana, ekicu kikwaitse kyaija ahari orwo rushozi, eiraka ry'enzamba ryagamba munonga, abantu boona, abaabaire bari omu rusiisira, baatetema.
en: And it came to pass on the third day in the morning, that there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud upon the mount, and the voice of the trumpet exceeding loud; so that all the people that was in the camp trembled.

rr: Musa yaashohoza abantu omu rusiisira kubugana Ruhanga, baayemerera ahansi y'orushozi.
en: And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet with God; and they stood at the nether part of the mount.

rr: Orwo rushozi Sinai rwona rwacumba omwika, ahakuba MUKAMA akarushuumaho naizira omu muriro; omwika gwagwo gwacumbuuka nk'ogw'ekikoomi, orushozi rwona rwatengyeta munonga.
en: And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke, because the LORD descended upon it in fire: and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount quaked greatly.

rr: Eiraka ry'enzamba ku ryayeyongyeire kugamba munonga, Musa yaagamba, MUKAMA yaamugarukamu n'eiraka.
en: And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long, and waxed louder and louder, Moses spake, and God answered him by a voice.

rr: MUKAMA yaashuuma aha rushozi Sinai, aha mutwe gwarwo, yaayeta Musa kwinamuka aha mutwe gw'orwo rushozi; Musa yainamuka.
en: And the LORD came down upon mount Sinai, on the top of the mount: and the LORD called Moses up to the top of the mount; and Moses went up.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati: Irooko oshuume, oyehanangirize abantu, batakaayoga aha bugarukiro kuhika ahu MUKAMA ari kumushamaarira, baingi omuribo bakacwekyerera.
en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go down, charge the people, lest they break through unto the LORD to gaze, and many of them perish.

rr: Kandi n'abanyamurwa abairira haihi MUKAMA beeyeze, MUKAMA atakaabagwaho.
en: And let the priests also, which come near to the LORD , sanctify themselves, lest the LORD break forth upon them.

rr: Musa yaagambira MUKAMA ati: Abantu tibarikubaasa kwinamuka ahari oru rushozi Sinai; ahakuba okaturagiira oti: Oteho obugarukiro okwehinguririza orushozi, orweze.
en: And Moses said unto the LORD , The people cannot come up to mount Sinai: for thou chargedst us, saying, Set bounds about the mount, and sanctify it.

rr: MUKAMA yaamugira ati: Irooko oshuume, haza oinamukye na Arooni; kwonka abanyamurwa n'abantu barekye kwoga aha bugarukiro kuhika ahu MUKAMA ari, atakaabagwaho.
en: And the LORD said unto him, Away, get thee down, and thou shalt come up, thou, and Aaron with thee: but let not the priests and the people break through to come up unto the LORD , lest he break forth upon them.

rr: Musa nikwo kushuuma, akaza ahu abantu bari, akabibagambira.
en: So Moses went down unto the people, and spake unto them.

en: And God spake all these words, saying,

rr: Niinye MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe, owaakwihire omu nsi ya Misri, omu nju y'obuhuuku.
en: I am the LORD thy God, which have brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

rr: Otarigira baaruhanga abandi, nyowe ndiho.
en: Thou shalt have no other gods before me.

rr: Otaryekorera ekishushani kyona ekibaizire, n'obu kyakuba ekishushani ky'ekintu kyona ekiri ahaiguru omu iguru, nari ekiri omu nsi ahansi, nari ekiri omu maizi okuzimu
en: Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:

rr: Otaribiinamira, kandi otaribiheereza; ahakuba nyowe MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe ndi Ruhanga ow'eihato, ntura abaana eby'okushiisha bya baishebo abarikuunyanga, okuhitsya aha b'obusingye bwa kashatu n'obwa kana
en: thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the LORD thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me;

rr: kwonka abaana b'abarikunkunda bakoorobera ebiragiro byangye, mbagirira embabazi okuhitsya obusingye enkumi n'enkumi.
en: and shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me, and keep my commandments.

rr: Otarizaanisa eiziina rya MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe; ahakuba MUKAMA tarimubara nk'otaine rubanja orikuzaanisa eiziina rye.
en: Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain; for the LORD will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.

rr: Ijuka kweza ekiro kya sabato
en: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.

rr: omu biro mukaaga ogume okore; obe nimwo waakorera emirimo yaawe yoona
en: Six days shalt thou labour, and do all thy work:

rr: kwonka ekiro kya mushanju niyo sabato ahari MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe; otarikoreraho omurimo gwona, iwe nari mutabani waawe, nari muhara waawe, nari omuhuuku waawe, nari omuzaana waawe, nari amatungo gaawe, nari omunyaihanga ori omu ka yaawe
en: but the seventh day is the sabbath of the LORD thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates:

rr: ahabw'okuba omu biro mukaaga nimwo MUKAMA yaahangiire eiguru n'ensi, enyanja n'ebirimu byona, akahuumura aha kiro kya mushanju; nikyo MUKAMA yaaheereire omugisha ekiro kya mushanju, akakyeza.
en: for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that in them is , and rested the seventh day: wherefore the LORD blessed the sabbath day, and hallowed it.

rr: Otiine sho na nyoko, obone kumara ebiro bingi omu nsi, ei MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe arikukuha.
en: Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.

rr: Otariita.
en: Thou shalt not kill.

rr: Otarishambana.
en: Thou shalt not commit adultery.

rr: Otariiba.
en: Thou shalt not steal.

rr: Otaribeiherera mutaahi waawe.
en: Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbour.

rr: Otaryetenga enju ya mutaahi waawe; otaryetenga muka mutaahi waawe, n'obu yaakuba omuhuuku we, nari omuzaana we, nari ente ye, nari endogoya ye, n'obu kyakuba ekintu kyona ekya mutaahi waawe.
en: Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour's house, thou shalt not covet thy neighbour's wife, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any thing that is thy neighbour's.

rr: Abantu boona ku baahuriire okuhinda kw'enkuba, baareeba okutyankana kw'emirabyo, baahurira eiraka ry'enzamba, kandi baareeba orushozi nirucumba omwika, baatetema, baayemerera hare munonga.
en: And all the people saw the thunderings, and the lightnings, and the noise of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking: and when the people saw it , they removed, and stood afar off.

rr: Baagira Musa bati: Obe niiwe waagamba naitwe, nitwija kuhurira; kwonka Ruhanga arekye kugamba naitwe, tutakaafa.
en: And they said unto Moses, Speak thou with us, and we will hear: but let not God speak with us, lest we die.

rr: Musa yaagarukamu abantu ati: Mutatiina; ahakuba Ruhanga yaija kubagyeza, ngu okutiinwa kwe kubagume omumaisho, murekye kushiisha.
en: And Moses said unto the people, Fear not: for God is come to prove you, and that his fear may be before your faces, that ye sin not.

rr: Abantu baayemerera hare munonga; reero Musa we yairira haihi omwirima ndindindi, ahu Ruhanga yaabaire ari.
en: And the people stood afar off, and Moses drew near unto the thick darkness where God was . The Book of the Covenant Worship and Justice

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati: Oku nikwo orangambirire Abaisraeli ebi ndikubagambira nti: Imwe ahabwanyu mwayereebera oku naagamba naimwe niinyema omu iguru.
en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Thus thou shalt say unto the children of Israel, Ye have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.

rr: Mutaryekorera baaruhanga abandi kubamparika; baaruhanga b'efeeza nari ab'ezaabu mutaribeekorera.
en: Ye shall not make with me gods of silver, neither shall ye make unto you gods of gold.

rr: Ombumbire eitambiro ry'eitaka, otambireho ebitambo byawe eby'okwotsya, n'empongano zaawe ez'okusiima ahabw'obusingye, entaama zaawe n'ente zaawe; omu mwanya gwona ogu eiziina ryangye ririijukirwaho, ndyaija ah' ori, nkuhe omugisha.
en: An altar of earth thou shalt make unto me, and shalt sacrifice thereon thy burnt offerings, and thy peace offerings, thy sheep, and thine oxen: in all places where I record my name I will come unto thee, and I will bless thee.

rr: Kandi ku orinkorera eitambiro ry'amabaare, otaririkoresa amabaare gabaizire; ahakuba ku oriribaizisaho oti ekyoma kyawe, oryaba orihagaire.
en: And if thou wilt make me an altar of stone, thou shalt not build it of hewn stone: for if thou lift up thy tool upon it, thou hast polluted it.

rr: Otarita amatembero aha itambiro ryangye kutemberaho, orekye kureebwa ojwariireho busha.
en: Neither shalt thou go up by steps unto mine altar, that thy nakedness be not discovered thereon.

rr: Ebi nibyo biragiro ebi oraate omu maisho gaabo.
en: Now these are the judgments which thou shalt set before them.

rr: Ku origura Omuheburaayo kuba omuhuuku waawe, akuheereze emyaka mukaaga; omu mwaka gwa mushanju agyende n'obusingye, ataine ki ayecungwize.
en: If thou buy an Hebrew servant, six years he shall serve: and in the seventh he shall go out free for nothing.

rr: Ku ariba aizire wenka, agyende wenka; ku ariba aizire n'omukazi, omukazi we agyende nawe.
en: If he came in by himself, he shall go out by himself: if he were married, then his wife shall go out with him.

rr: Mukama we ku arimushwererera omukazi, yaamuzaarira abaana b'aboojo nari ab'abaishiki, ogwo mukazi n'abaana be baryaba aba mukama we; we agyende wenka.
en: If his master have given him a wife, and she have born him sons or daughters; the wife and her children shall be her master's, and he shall go out by himself.

rr: Kwonka ogwo muhuuku ku aryegambira butunu ati: Ninkunda mukama wangye n'omukazi wangye kandi n'abaana bangye; tindikwenda kugyenda kuruga omu buhuuku
en: And if the servant shall plainly say, I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not go out free:

rr: mukama we aryamutwara omu maisho ga Ruhanga, amwemereze aha rwigi nari aha kiti ky'omuryango, amufumure okutu n'empindu; omuhuuku ogwo agume naamukorera ebiro byona.
en: then his master shall bring him unto the judges; he shall also bring him to the door, or unto the door post; and his master shall bore his ear through with an aul; and he shall serve him for ever.

rr: Omushaija ku aritunda muhara we kuba omuzaana, atariruga omu buzaana, nk'oku abahuuku batwazibwa.
en: And if a man sell his daughter to be a maidservant, she shall not go out as the menservants do.

rr: Ku ariba atashemeize mukama we, owaabaire amwereeteire kumushwera, amurekye acungurwe; tarigira bushoboorozi bw'okumutunza abanyamahanga, ahabw'okuba niwe ariba amureebize.
en: If she please not her master, who hath betrothed her to himself, then shall he let her be redeemed: to sell her unto a strange nation he shall have no power, seeing he hath dealt deceitfully with her.

rr: Kandi ku arimushwererera omutabani, amutwaze nka muhara we.
en: And if he have betrothed her unto his son, he shall deal with her after the manner of daughters.

rr: Ku arimuharika, atarituubya aha by'okurya bye, nari aha bijwaro bye, n'obu kwakuba okumwitira embu.
en: If he take him another wife ; her food, her raiment, and her duty of marriage, shall he not diminish.

rr: Ku ariba atamuhikiize ebyo byonshatu, aryagyenda atazimuuriirwe.
en: And if he do not these three unto her, then shall she go out free without money.

rr: Oriteera omuntu, akamwita, nawe aitwe.
en: He that smiteth a man, so that he die, shall be surely put to death.

rr: Kwonka omuntu ku ariita ondi atamugwereire, beitu kyaruga ahari Ruhanga kumugwa omu mikono, ndyakuteeraho omwanya, ogu ashemereire kuhungiramu.
en: And if a man lie not in wait, but God deliver him into his hand; then I will appoint thee a place whither he shall flee.

rr: 1 Omuntu ku aritaahirira mutaahi we, yaamureebya, yaamwita nkana, omwihe aha itambiro ryangye, aitwe.
en: But if a man come presumptuously upon his neighbour, to slay him with guile; thou shalt take him from mine altar, that he may die.

rr: Oriteera ishe nari nyina, aitwe.
en: And he that smiteth his father, or his mother, shall be surely put to death.

rr: Oriiba omuntu, akamutunda, nari bakamukwata akimwine, aitwe.
en: And he that stealeth a man, and selleth him, or if he be found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.

rr: Orijuma ishe nari nyina, aitwe.
en: And he that curseth his father, or his mother, shall surely be put to death.

rr: Abantu ku baritongana, omwe yaateera mugyenzi we eibaare nari entomi, ataafa, kwonka yaaguma aha kishegu arwaire
en: And if men strive together, and one smite another with a stone, or with his fist, and he die not, but keepeth his bed:

rr: ku ariimuka, yaashotookyera aha kibango, owaamuteire atarigiibwaho orubanja, kureka arihe ebiro ebi amazire arwaire, kandi amuragurize okuhitsya obu arikira gye.
en: if he rise again, and walk abroad upon his staff, then shall he that smote him be quit: only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall cause him to be thoroughly healed.

rr: Omuntu ku ariteera omuhuuku we nari omuzaana we enkoni, yaamugwisaho, aryaheebwa ekiheneso
en: And if a man smite his servant, or his maid, with a rod, and he die under his hand; he shall be surely punished.

rr: kwonka ogwo muhuuku ku arimaraho ekiro kimwe nari bibiri, tariheebwa kiheneso ahakuba ogwo muhuuku n'empiiha ze.
en: Notwithstanding, if he continue a day or two, he shall not be punished: for he is his money.

rr: Abashaija ku barirwana, baasaasa omukazi oine enda, enda yaarugamu, kwonka ataagira kundi oku yaaba, owaamusaasa aryariha iba w'ogwo mukazi, nk'oku arimurihisa; kandi aryariha, nk'oku abaramuzi barisiima.
en: If men strive, and hurt a woman with child, so that her fruit depart from her , and yet no mischief follow: he shall be surely punished, according as the woman's husband will lay upon him; and he shall pay as the judges determine .

rr: Kwonka ku arigira okundi oku yaaba, obwo amagara garyarihwa agandi
en: And if any mischief follow, then thou shalt give life for life,

rr: eriisho ririhwe erindi, eriino ririhwe erindi, ekiganja kirihwe ekindi, ekigyere kirihwe ekindi
en: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,

rr: okwotsya kuhoorerwe okundi, obuhuta buhoorerwe obundi, n'okuteerwa kuhoorerwe okundi.
en: burning for burning, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.

rr: Omuntu ku ariteera omuhuuku we nari omuzaana we, yaamwata eriisho, aryamurekura, arugye omu buhuuku ahabw'eryo riisho.
en: And if a man smite the eye of his servant, or the eye of his maid, that it perish; he shall let him go free for his eye's sake.

rr: Kandi ku ariteera omuhuuku we nari omuzaana we, yaamuhigura eriino, aryamurekura, arugye omu buhuuku ahabw'eryo riino.
en: And if he smite out his manservant's tooth, or his maidservant's tooth; he shall let him go free for his tooth's sake.

rr: Ente ku ericumita omushaija nari omukazi, yaamwita, egyo nte baryagiitsa amabaare, kandi etaririibwa; kwonka mukama waayo atarigiibwaho orubanja.
en: If an ox gore a man or a woman, that they die: then the ox shall be surely stoned, and his flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the ox shall be quit.

rr: Kwonka egyo nte ku eraabe yaabaire neecumita abantu, baagambira mukama waayo, yaayanga kugirinda, bwanyima yaita omushaija nari omukazi, egyo nte baryagiitsa amabaare, na mukama waayo bamwite.
en: But if the ox were wont to push with his horn in time past, and it hath been testified to his owner, and he hath not kept him in, but that he hath killed a man or a woman; the ox shall be stoned, and his owner also shall be put to death.

rr: Ku barimucwa eby'okwecunguza, ahe ebi barimucwa byona ahabw'okucungura amagara ge.
en: If there be laid on him a sum of money, then he shall give for the ransom of his life whatsoever is laid upon him.

rr: N'obu ericumita mutabani w'omuntu nari muhara w'omuntu, mukama w'ente aryatwazibwa, nk'ekiragiro ekyo oku kiri.
en: Whether he have gored a son, or have gored a daughter, according to this judgment shall it be done unto him.

rr: Kandi egyo nte ku ericumita omuhuuku nari omuzaana, mukama waayo aryariha mukama waabo shekeli makumi ashatu z'efeeza, n'egyo nte bagiitse amabaare.
en: If the ox shall push a manservant or a maidservant; he shall give unto their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned.

rr: Omuntu ku aritsiga ekiina kyashami, nari yaarima ekiina, ataakitinda, ente nari endogoya yaakigwamu
en: And if a man shall open a pit, or if a man shall dig a pit, and not cover it, and an ox or an ass fall therein;

rr: mukama w'ekyo kiina aryagiriha, ahe mukama waayo empiiha, kandi omutumbi gwayo guryaba ogwa mukama w'ekiina.
en: the owner of the pit shall make it good, and give money unto the owner of them; and the dead beast shall be his.

rr: Ente y'omuntu ku ericumita ey'ondiijo, yaagiita, baryatunda egyo ehuriire, babagane empiiha zaayo, kandi bagarukye babagane n'eyaitwa.
en: And if one man's ox hurt another's, that he die; then they shall sell the live ox, and divide the money of it; and the dead ox also they shall divide.

rr: Nari ku kirimanywa ngu ente egyo eshangwa ecumita, kandi mukama waayo tagirinda, aryariha endi omu mwanya gwayo, kandi omutumbi guryaba ogwa kiriha.
en: Or if it be known that the ox hath used to push in time past, and his owner hath not kept him in; he shall surely pay ox for ox; and the dead shall be his own.

rr: Omuntu ku ariiba ente nari entaama, yaagiita nari yaagitunda, egyo nte aryagiriha ente itaano, kandi egyo ntaama agirihe entaama ina. Aryariha; kwonka ku ariba ataine kantu, aryatundwa ahabw'obushuma bwe.
en: If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it; he shall restore five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.

rr: Omushuma ku arishangwa naafumura enju, baamuteera, yaafa, tihaine origiibwaho orubanja ahabw'eshagama ye
en: If a thief be found breaking up, and be smitten that he die, there shall no blood be shed for him.

rr: kwonka ku barimwita bwaseesire, baryagiibwaho orubanja ahabw'eshagama ye.
en: If the sun be risen upon him, there shall be blood shed for him; for he should make full restitution; if he have nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.

rr: Ekiibirwe ku barishanga akiine kikihuriire, yaaba nte, nari endogoya nari entaama, aryagiriha ibiri.
en: If the theft be certainly found in his hand alive, whether it be ox, or ass, or sheep; he shall restore double.

rr: Omuntu ku aryonesa nkana omusiri gw'ondi, nari omusiri gwe ogw'emizaabibu; nari ku aritsibura amatungo ge, gaayona omusiri gw'ondiijo, aryamuriha aha bi ahingire ebirikukira oburungi, nari amurihe aha byana by'emizaabibu eby'omu musiri gwe ebirikukira oburungi.
en: If a man shall cause a field or vineyard to be eaten, and shall put in his beast, and shall feed in another man's field; of the best of his own field, and of the best of his own vineyard, shall he make restitution.

rr: Omuriro ku guryaka, gwakwata amahwa, gwayotsya ebiba by'engano, nari ezikyemereire, nari omusiri gwona, owaatweka ogwo muriro aryariha byona ebyasya.
en: If fire break out, and catch in thorns, so that the stacks of corn, or the standing corn, or the field, be consumed therewith ; he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.

rr: Omuntu ku aribiitsya mutaahi we empiiha nari ebindi bintu, byaibirwa omu nju ye, obiibire ku ariboneka, amurihe kabiri.
en: If a man shall deliver unto his neighbour money or stuff to keep, and it be stolen out of the man's house; if the thief be found, let him pay double.

rr: Kwonka obiibire ku aribura, mukama w'enju aryairira Ruhanga haihi, kimanywe ku atarakwatsire ha bintu bya mutaahi we.
en: If the thief be not found, then the master of the house shall be brought unto the judges, to see whether he have put his hand unto his neighbour's goods.

rr: Ahakuba okuryangatanisa ekintu kyona, yaaba nte nari endogoya nari entaama, nari ekijwaro nari ekintu kyona ekibuzire, eki nyinakyo yaahamya ati: Nikyo eki; orubanja rwabo bombi ruryatonganirwa omu maisho ga Ruhanga; ou Ruhanga aricwera orubanja rukamusinga, aryariha mutaahi we kabiri.
en: For all manner of trespass, whether it be for ox, for ass, for sheep, for raiment, or for any manner of lost thing, which another challengeth to be his, the cause of both parties shall come before the judges; and whom the judges shall condemn, he shall pay double unto his neighbour.

rr: Omuntu ku arihereka mutaahi we endogoya nari ente nari entaama, nari ekitungirwe kyona ngu akiriise, kyafa, nari kyagira oku kyaba, nari kyatwarwa hataine okireebire
en: If a man deliver unto his neighbour an ass, or an ox, or a sheep, or any beast, to keep; and it die, or be hurt, or driven away, no man seeing it:

rr: habeho okurahira MUKAMA ahagati yaabo bombi, kiherekwa ku atarakwatsire ha kintu kya mutaahi we; mukama waakyo aryaikiriza okwo kurahira, onu arekye kuriha.
en: then shall an oath of the LORD be between them both, that he hath not put his hand unto his neighbour's goods; and the owner of it shall accept thereof , and he shall not make it good.

rr: Kwonka ku kiriibirwa owa kiherekwa, aryariha mukama waakyo.
en: And if it be stolen from him, he shall make restitution unto the owner thereof.

rr: Ku kiritaanyagurwa enyamaishwa, areete ekiriira kyakyo kibe eky'okuhamya ku kiri ekye; obwo taririha kitaanyagwirwe.
en: If it be torn in pieces, then let him bring it for witness, and he shall not make good that which was torn.

rr: Omuntu ku aritiiza ekintu kyona ekya mutaahi we, kyasiisikara, nari kyafa, mukama waakyo atariho, buzimazima nyakukitiizibwa aryakiriha.
en: And if a man borrow ought of his neighbour, and it be hurt, or die, the owner thereof being not with it, he shall surely make it good.

rr: Kwonka mukama waakyo ku ariba ariho, tarikiriha. Kandi ku kiriba kiguririirwe, kiryagwana n'eki baakiguririire.
en: But if the owner thereof be with it, he shall not make it good: if it be an hired thing , it came for his hire.

rr: Omuntu ku aribeihabeiha omwishiki otakamanyaga mushaija, kandi otarikugambwa bugyenyi, yaabyama nawe, aryamujuga, amushwere.
en: And if a man entice a maid that is not betrothed, and lie with her, he shall surely endow her to be his wife.

rr: Kwonka ishe ku aryangira kimwe kumumuhingira, aryariha enjugano nk'ezi bajuga omwishiki.
en: If her father utterly refuse to give her unto him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.

rr: Otariikiriza omurogikazi kugumaho.
en: Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live.

rr: Oribyama n'enyamaishwa weena, aitwe.
en: Whosoever lieth with a beast shall surely be put to death.

rr: Oritambira Ruhanga ondiijo weena ekitambo, atari MUKAMA, acwekyererezibwe kimwe.
en: He that sacrificeth unto any god, save unto the LORD only, he shall be utterly destroyed.

rr: Omunyaihanga otarimukora kubi, n'obu kwakuba okumuhata; ahakuba naimwe mukaba muri abanyaihanga omu nsi ya Misri.
en: Thou shalt neither vex a stranger, nor oppress him: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.

rr: Mutaribonabonesa omufaakazi weena nari efuuzi.
en: Ye shall not afflict any widow, or fatherless child.

rr: Ku murigira eki mwabaitsa, bantakira, buzimazima ndyahurira okutaka kwabo
en: If thou afflict them in any wise, and they cry at all unto me, I will surely hear their cry;

rr: ngirire imwe ekiniga kingi, mbaitse rurara; abakazi baanyu babe abafaakazi, n'abaana baanyu babe efuuzi.
en: and my wrath shall wax hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.

rr: Ku origuza omworo weena omu bantu bangye empiiha, otarimutwaza nk'abaihuza boona oku bagira, kandi otarimushaba enshaagi.
en: If thou lend money to any of my people that is poor by thee, thou shalt not be to him as an usurer, neither shalt thou lay upon him usury.

rr: Ku oriba waakwatiriziibwe omwenda gwa mutaahi waawe, otarirenzya eizooba otagumugaruriire
en: If thou at all take thy neighbour's raiment to pledge, thou shalt deliver it unto him by that the sun goeth down:

rr: ahabw'okuba nigwo ayeshweka gwonka; nikyo kijwaro ky'omubiri gwe. Noogira ngu aryayeshweka ki? Kandi ku arintakira, ndyamuhurira; ahakuba ndi omunyambabazi.
en: for that is his covering only, it is his raiment for his skin: wherein shall he sleep? and it shall come to pass, when he crieth unto me, that I will hear; for I am gracious.

rr: Otarijuma Ruhanga, n'obu kwakuba okukyeena omutegyeki w'eihanga ryawe.
en: Thou shalt not revile the gods, nor curse the ruler of thy people.

rr: Otarikyerererwa kuntoijera ahari byona ebi oshaarwire, kandi n'aha by'okunywa ebirugire omu manyuukiro gaawe. Omujigaijo omuri batabani baawe oryamumpa.
en: Thou shalt not delay to offer the first of thy ripe fruits, and of thy liquors: the firstborn of thy sons shalt thou give unto me.

rr: Kandi nikwo oritwaza ente zaawe n'entaama zaawe; omujigaijo gwayo guryamara ebiro mushanju na nyinagwo; aha kiro kya munaana oryaguntoijera.
en: Likewise shalt thou do with thine oxen, and with thy sheep: seven days it shall be with his dam; on the eighth day thou shalt give it me.

rr: Muryaba abantu abaanyereziibwe; n'ahabw'ekyo mutarirya enyama n'ekintu kyona eki enyamaishwa eriire, ekatsiga omu ishwa; muryaguma mukitambikire embwa.
en: And ye shall be holy men unto me: neither shall ye eat any flesh that is torn of beasts in the field; ye shall cast it to the dogs.
