rr: Otaritwara enkuru z'ebishuba; otarikwatanisa n'omubi okuba mushinja w'eitima.
en: Thou shalt not raise a false report: put not thine hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness.

rr: Otarikurata abaingi kukora ebibi; ku oryetwa kuba mushinja, otarigwera orubaju rw'abaingi okajurira eby'okusingisiriza orubanja
en: Thou shalt not follow a multitude to do evil; neither shalt thou speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest judgment:

rr: kandi otarigwera orubaju rw'omuntu, ngu ahabw'okuba n'omworo.
en: neither shalt thou countenance a poor man in his cause.

rr: Ku oribugana ente y'omuzigu waawe, nari endogoya ye ehabire, ogimutangire.
en: If thou meet thine enemy's ox or his ass going astray, thou shalt surely bring it back to him again.

rr: Ku orishanga endogoya y'orikukwanga egwire n'omutwaro, otaryehuzya, okatsiga naafa kubi atyo, kureka omuhwere kugiimutsya.
en: If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under his burden, and wouldest forbear to help him, thou shalt surely help with him.

rr: Otariita orubanja rw'omworo w'owaanyu, yaaba naatongana.
en: Thou shalt not wrest the judgment of thy poor in his cause.

rr: Oyetantare ekigambo kyona eky'ebishuba; kandi otariita otaine rubanja kandi ohikiriire; ahabw'okuba omubi tindimwihaho rubanja.
en: Keep thee far from a false matter; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not: for I will not justify the wicked.

rr: Otarirya enguzi, ahakuba enguzi eita amaisho g'abarikureeba, kandi ekiikamya ebigambo by'abataine rubanja.
en: And thou shalt take no gift: for the gift blindeth the wise, and perverteth the words of the righteous.

rr: Otariita kubi omunyaihanga, haza kunu noomanya omutima gw'omunyaihanga; ahabw'okuba naimwe mukaba muri abanyaihanga omu nsi ya Misri.
en: Also thou shalt not oppress a stranger: for ye know the heart of a stranger, seeing ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.

rr: Oryamara emyaka mukaaga noohinga emisiri yaawe, kandi nooshaaruura ebi oyerizemu
en: And six years thou shalt sow thy land, and shalt gather in the fruits thereof:

rr: kwonka omu mwaka gwa mushanju ogirekye eraare, abooro barye ebyemerizemu; kandi ebiritsigaramu biriibwe enyamaishwa.
en: but the seventh year thou shalt let it rest and lie still; that the poor of thy people may eat: and what they leave the beasts of the field shall eat.

rr: Okwo nikwo oritwaza omusiri gwawe ogw'emizaabibu, n'ogw'emizeituuni.
en: In like manner thou shalt deal with thy vineyard, and with thy oliveyard.

rr: Omu biro mukaaga obe nimwo waakorera emirimo yaawe; aha kiro kya mushanju ohuumure, ente yaawe n'endogoya yaawe zihuumure, mutabani w'omuzaana waawe n'omunyaihanga bagarukwemu amaani.
en: Six days thou shalt do thy work, and on the seventh day thou shalt rest: that thine ox and thine ass may rest, and the son of thy handmaid, and the stranger, may be refreshed.

rr: Mute omutima aha bi mbagambiire byona; mutarigira obu mugambire aha maziina ga baaruhanga abandi, kandi gatarihurirwa omu kanwa kaanyu. Ebiragiro by'amagyenyi makuru ashatu omu mwaka
en: And in all things that I have said unto you be circumspect: and make no mention of the name of other gods, neither let it be heard out of thy mouth.

rr: Oryaguma ogire obugyenyi bw'ebiro bikuru ahabwangye kashatu omu mwaka.
en: Three times thou shalt keep a feast unto me in the year.

rr: Oryagira obugyenyi bw'emigaati etatumbisiibwe; omare ebiro mushanju noorya emigaati etatumbisiibwe, nk'oku naakuragiire, omu bunaku obwatairweho omu kwezi Abibu, ahakuba nikwo waarugiiremu Misri; hatarigira owaija omu maisho gangye engaro nsha.
en: Thou shalt keep the feast of unleavened bread: (thou shalt eat unleavened bread seven days, as I commanded thee, in the time appointed of the month Abib; for in it thou camest out from Egypt: and none shall appear before me empty:)

rr: Kandi oryagira obugyenyi bw'eigyesha ry'ebi waahingire omu misiri, nigwo muganuro gw'ebi waahendekyeire; kandi ku oriheza kushaaruura byona eby'omu misiri yaawe ebi waahendekyeire aha muheru gw'omwaka, oryagira obugyenyi bw'eishaaruura.
en: and the feast of harvest, the firstfruits of thy labours, which thou hast sown in the field: and the feast of ingathering, which is in the end of the year, when thou hast gathered in thy labours out of the field.

rr: Oyetwa omushaija weena aryaija areebwe omu maisho ga MUKAMA Ruhanga kashatu omu mwaka.
en: Three times in the year all thy males shall appear before the Lord GOD .

rr: Otarihonga eshagama y'ekitambo, eki ntambiirwe, hamwe n'omugaati ogutumbisiibwe; kandi ebishaju by'obugyenyi bwangye otaribiraaza okuhitsya omu kasheeshe.
en: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain until the morning.

rr: Omuganuro gw'ebirikubanza kwera omu misiri yaawe, oryaguma ogureete omu nju ya MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe. Otariteeka omwana gw'embuzi omu mahenehene ga nyinagwo. Mukama okubaha maraika w'okubeebembera
en: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring into the house of the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother's milk.

rr: Reeba, nintuma maraika okukwebembera, n'okukurinda omu muhanda, akakuhitsya omu mwanya ogu naakuteekateekyeire.
en: Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.

rr: Omworobere, ohurire eiraka rye, otamugwisa kubi; ahakuba tarisaasira bicumuro byanyu; ahabw'okuba eiziina ryangye riri omuriwe.
en: Beware of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name is in him.

rr: Kwonka ku orihurira eiraka rye, otaireho omutima, waakora byona ebi ndikugamba, obwo ndyaba omuzigu w'abazigu baawe, n'omubisha w'ababisha baawe.
en: But if thou shalt indeed obey his voice, and do all that I speak; then I will be an enemy unto thine enemies, and an adversary unto thine adversaries.

rr: Ahakuba maraika wangye aryakwebembera, akuhitsye omu Baamori, Abahiiti, Abaperizi, Abanyakanaani, Abahiivi n'Abayebusi, mbamareho.
en: For mine Angel shall go before thee, and bring thee in unto the Amorites, and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites: and I will cut them off.

rr: Otariramya baaruhanga baabo, otaribaheereza, n'obu kwakuba okutwaza nkabo; kureka oryabahwerekyerereza kimwe, n'enyomyo zaabo ez'amabaare ozisheenyagure.
en: Thou shalt not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor do after their works: but thou shalt utterly overthrow them, and quite break down their images.

rr: Muryaheereza MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu, nawe aryaha eby'okurya byawe n'amaizi gaawe omugisha; kandi ndyaiha endwara omuriimwe.
en: And ye shall serve the LORD your God, and he shall bless thy bread, and thy water; and I will take sickness away from the midst of thee.

rr: Tihaine orirugwamu enda, nari oriba engumba omu nsi yaawe; kandi ndyahitsya omubaro gw'ebiro byawe.
en: There shall nothing cast their young, nor be barren, in thy land: the number of thy days I will fulfil.

rr: Ndyayohereza okutiinisa kwangye kukwebembere, mpahaaze emitima y'abantu boona abu orihikamu, ndeetere abazigu baawe boona kukuhunga.
en: I will send my fear before thee, and will destroy all the people to whom thou shalt come, and I will make all thine enemies turn their backs unto thee.

rr: Kandi ndyayohereza enwa, zikwebembere, nizo ziribinga Abahiivi n'Abanyakanaani n'Abahiiti omu maisho gaawe.
en: And I will send hornets before thee, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before thee.

rr: Kwonka tindibabinga mu maisho gaawe kuruga omu nsi omu mwaka gumwe gwonka, ensi etakaaba ekifurukwa, n'enyamaishwa z'omu ihamba zikakanya, zikakunyangaraza.
en: I will not drive them out from before thee in one year; lest the land become desolate, and the beast of the field multiply against thee.

rr: Kureka ndyababinga mporampora omu maisho gaawe, okuhitsya obu orikanya, okahungura ensi.
en: By little and little I will drive them out from before thee, until thou be increased, and inherit the land.

rr: Kandi ndyakuteeraho omwatano okuruga aha Nyanja erikutukura okuhika aha Nyanja y'Abafilistia, n'okuruga aha ihamba okuhika aha mugyera Furaati; ahakuba ndyahayo abantu abatwire omu nsi egyo omu mikono yaawe, obabingye barugye omu maisho gaawe.
en: And I will set thy bounds from the Red sea even unto the sea of the Philistines, and from the desert unto the river: for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand; and thou shalt drive them out before thee.

rr: Otariragaana nabo endagaano n'obu kwakuba okuragaana na baaruhanga baabo.
en: Thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.

rr: Batariguma omu nsi yaawe, nyentsya bakakuncumuzaho; ahabw'okuba ku oriheereza baaruhanga baabo, buzimazima kiryakubeera omutego.
en: They shall not dwell in thy land, lest they make thee sin against me: for if thou serve their gods, it will surely be a snare unto thee.

rr: Ruhanga yaagambira Musa ati: Inamuka, iwe na Arooni na Nadabu na Abihu n'abakuru b'Abaisraeli makumi mushanju, muze ei MUKAMA ari, mumuramize hangahari.
en: And he said unto Moses, Come up unto the LORD , thou, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship ye afar off.

rr: Musa wenka abe niwe yairira haihi MUKAMA, kwonka abandi batamwirira haihi; kandi abandi boona batainamuka nawe.
en: And Moses alone shall come near the LORD : but they shall not come nigh; neither shall the people go up with him.

rr: Musa yaaza omu bantu, yaabagambira ebigambo bya MUKAMA byona n'ebiragiro byona; abantu boona baagarukiramu hamwe, nibagira bati: Ebigambo byona ebi MUKAMA yaagamba, nitwija kubikora.
en: And Moses came and told the people all the words of the LORD , and all the judgments: and all the people answered with one voice, and said, All the words which the LORD hath said will we do.

rr: Musa yaahandika ebigambo bya MUKAMA byona; kandi yaimuka kare omu kasheeshe, yaayombeka eitambiro ahansi y'orushozi, n'enyomyo ikumi na ibiri, nk'enganda za Israeli ikumi na ibiri oku zaabaire ziri.
en: And Moses wrote all the words of the LORD , and rose up early in the morning, and builded an altar under the hill, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Israel.

rr: Yaatuma abatsigazi b'omu Baisraeli, baahongyera MUKAMA ebitambo by'okwotsya, baamutambira ebitambo by'ente eby'okusiima ahabw'obusingye.
en: And he sent young men of the children of Israel, which offered burnt offerings, and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen unto the LORD .

rr: Musa yaabaganisa eshagama omu bicweka bibiri ebirikwingana; kimwe yaakita omu nyabya, ekindi yaakimiisiira aha itambiro.
en: And Moses took half of the blood, and put it in basons; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.

rr: Bwanyima yaakwata ekitabo ky'endagaano, yaakishomera abantu; nabo baagarukamu bati: Byona ebi MUKAMA yaagamba, nitwija kuguma nitubikora, kandi tubyorobere.
en: And he took the book of the covenant, and read in the audience of the people: and they said, All that the LORD hath said will we do, and be obedient.

rr: Musa yaatwara eshagama, yaagimiisiira abantu, naagira ati: Mureebe eshagama y'endagaano, ei MUKAMA yaaragaana naimwe, nk'ebigambo ebyo byona oku biri.
en: And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which the LORD hath made with you concerning all these words.

rr: Bwanyima Musa yainamuka na Arooni na Nadabu na Abihu n'abakuru b'Abaisraeli makumi mushanju
en: Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel:

rr: baareeba Ruhanga wa Israeli; ahansi y'ebigyere bye nihashusha nk'amabaare ga safiro agaariire, agarikumurinkana nk'eiguru.
en: and they saw the God of Israel: and there was under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone, and as it were the body of heaven in his clearness.

rr: Abo bakuru b'Abaisraeli Ruhanga tiyaagira ku yaabagira; kureka baamureeba, baarya, baanywa. Musa okumara ebiro makumi ana ahari Sinai
en: And upon the nobles of the children of Israel he laid not his hand: also they saw God, and did eat and drink.

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati: Inamuka, onshangye aha rushozi, ogumeyo; Nyowe niinyija kukuha ebishate by'amabaare, ebiriho ebiragiro n'ebyaragiirwe, ebi mpandiikire ngu obyegyese.
en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Come up to me into the mount, and be there: and I will give thee tables of stone, and a law, and commandments which I have written; that thou mayest teach them.

rr: Musa yaimuka na Yoshua omuheereza we, yainamuka aha rushozi rwa Ruhanga.
en: And Moses rose up, and his minister Joshua: and Moses went up into the mount of God.

rr: Ku yaabaire atakagyenzire, yaagambira abo bakuru ati: Mututegyerereze aha, okuhitsya obu turigaruka, tukabashanga aha; kandi reeba, mwatsigara na Arooni na Huuri; omuntu weena oriba aine eki arikufa, abe nibo yaareeba.
en: And he said unto the elders, Tarry ye here for us, until we come again unto you: and, behold, Aaron and Hur are with you: if any man have any matters to do, let him come unto them.

rr: Bwanyima Musa yainamuka aha rushozi, ekicu kyarushweka.
en: And Moses went up into the mount, and a cloud covered the mount.

rr: Ekitiinisa kya MUKAMA kyaza aha rushozi Sinai, n'ekicu kyarushweka okumara ebiro mukaaga; aha kiro kya mushanju MUKAMA yaayeta Musa, naayema omuri ekyo kicu.
en: And the glory of the LORD abode upon mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days: and the seventh day he called unto Moses out of the midst of the cloud.

rr: Ekitiinisa kya MUKAMA kikaba nikishusha nk'omuriro ogurikurya busha aha mutwe gw'orushozi omu maisho g'Abaisraeli.
en: And the sight of the glory of the LORD was like devouring fire on the top of the mount in the eyes of the children of Israel.

rr: Musa yaataaha omu kicu, yainamuka aha rushozi; Musa yaamara ahari orwo rushozi ebiro makumi ana nyomushana na nyekiro.
en: And Moses went into the midst of the cloud, and gat him up into the mount: and Moses was in the mount forty days and forty nights.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Gambira Abaisareli bandeetere emitoijo; mwakiire omutoijo ogu omuntu weena arantoijere, ayekundiire.
en: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring me an offering: of every man that giveth it willingly with his heart ye shall take my offering.

rr: Egi niyo mitoijo yaabo ei muryakiira: ezaabu, efeeza, emiringa
en: And this is the offering which ye shall take of them; gold, and silver, and brass,

rr: emyenda ya bururu n'eya bujwa n'eya karari n'eya bafuta, obwoya bw'embuzi
en: and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' hair ,

rr: empu z'empaya z'entaama zizigirwe n'erangi erikutukura, empu z'engongi, embaaho z'eminyinya
en: and rams' skins dyed red, and badgers' skins, and shittim wood,

rr: amajuta g'etabaaza, eby'emigaju eby'okuta omu majuta ag'okushukaho, n'eby'okukoramu obubaane oburikutaamirana
en: oil for the light, spices for anointing oil, and for sweet incense,

rr: amabaare agarikwetwa shohamu, n'agandi mabaare ag'okuhundisa efodi n'eky'aha kifuba.
en: onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod, and in the breastplate.

rr: Kandi bankorere Omwanya ogurikwera, mbone kutuura ahagati omuribo.
en: And let them make me a sanctuary; that I may dwell among them.

rr: Nk'ebi ndikwija kukworeka byona oku biri, omuringo gw'eihema n'ogw'ebintu byaryo byona, mube nikwo mwabikora.
en: According to all that I shew thee, after the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all the instruments thereof, even so shall ye make it .

rr: Eshanduukye y'endagaano
en: The Pattern of the Tabernacle

rr: Baryakora eshanduukye omu munyinya; oburaingwa bwayo mikono eibiri n'ekicweka, obuhango bwayo mukono gumwe n'ekicweka, n'obwemi bwayo mukono gumwe n'ekicweka.
en: And they shall make an ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.

rr: Ogishekye n'ezaabu eshemeziibwe, ogishwekye omunda n'enyima, kandi ogyehinguririze omuguno gw'ezaabu.
en: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, within and without shalt thou overlay it, and shalt make upon it a crown of gold round about.

rr: Oyazye ezaabu, ogikoremu ebifunga bina, obite aha maguru gaayo ana, bibiri aha rubaju rumwe, kandi bibiri aha rundi.
en: And thou shalt cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in the four corners thereof; and two rings shall be in the one side of it, and two rings in the other side of it.

rr: Okore n'emigamba omu munyinya, ogishwekye n'ezaabu.
en: And thou shalt make staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.

rr: Ote egyo migamba omu bifunga by'omu mbaju z'eshanduukye, bagume bagiheekyese.
en: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, that the ark may be borne with them.

rr: Emigamba egyo egume omu bifunga by'eshanduukye, etariihwamu.
en: The staves shall be in the rings of the ark: they shall not be taken from it.

rr: Kandi omuri egyo shanduukye oryatamu Ebirikuhamya ebi ndikuha.
en: And thou shalt put into the ark the testimony which I shall give thee.

rr: Okore ekitebe ky'okusaasira omu zaabu eshemeziibwe; oburaingwa bwakyo mikono ebiri n'ekicweka, n'obuhango bwakyo mukono gumwe n'ekicweka.
en: And thou shalt make a mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof.

rr: Kandi okore ebishushani bya baakerubi babiri omu zaabu; omu kubikora obiheeshe aha mitwe yombi ey'ekyo kitebe ky'okusaasira.
en: And thou shalt make two cherubims of gold, of beaten work shalt thou make them, in the two ends of the mercy seat.

rr: Okore ekya kerubi omwe aha mutwe gumwe, n'eky'ondi aha gundi; mubiheesherane n'ekitebe ky'okusaasira aha mitwe yaakyo yombi.
en: And make one cherub on the one end, and the other cherub on the other end: even of the mercy seat shall ye make the cherubims on the two ends thereof.

rr: Baakerubi bashashaanure amapapa gaabo ahaiguru, bagasangize ekitebe ky'okusaasira, boorekyeraine nibareeba ekyo kitebe.
en: And the cherubims shall stretch forth their wings on high, covering the mercy seat with their wings, and their faces shall look one to another; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubims be.

rr: Ekitebe ky'okusaasira okite aha shanduukye, kandi omu shanduukye otemu Ebirikuhamya ebi ndikuha.
en: And thou shalt put the mercy seat above upon the ark; and in the ark thou shalt put the testimony that I shall give thee.

rr: Aho niho ndiguma nimbugaabuganira naimwe, nkagamba naiwe ahari byona, ebi ndikugambira kuragiira Abaisraeli, niinyema ahaiguru y'ekitebe ky'okusaasira, ahagati ya baakerubi abari aha shanduukye y'Ebirikuhamya. Eby'Emeeza y'emigaati y'okumurika
en: And there I will meet with thee, and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubims which are upon the ark of the testimony, of all things which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel.

rr: Kandi oryabaija emeeza omu munyinya; oburaingwa bwayo mikono ebiri, obuhango bwayo mukono gumwe, n'obwemi bwayo mukono gumwe n'ekicweka.
en: Thou shalt also make a table of shittim wood: two cubits shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.

rr: Ogishwekye n'ezaabu eshemeziibwe, ogiteho omuguno gw'ezaabu gugyehinguririze.
en: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, and make thereto a crown of gold round about.

rr: Ogikorere ebizingiti okugyehinguririza, obuhango bwabyo ekita kimwe, nabyo obiteho omuguno gw'ezaabu, gubyehinguririze.
en: And thou shalt make unto it a border of an hand breadth round about, and thou shalt make a golden crown to the border thereof round about.

rr: Ogikorere ebifunga bina by'ezaabu, obite aha maguru gaayo, aha nkokora zaayo ina.
en: And thou shalt make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that are on the four feet thereof.

rr: Ebifunga ebyo bize haihi n'ebizingiti, bibe eby'okutamu emigamba ey'okuheeka emeeza.
en: Over against the border shall the rings be for places of the staves to bear the table.

rr: Egyo migamba ogibaije omu munyinya, ogishwekye n'ezaabu, ebe ey'okuheekyesa emeeza.
en: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be borne with them.

rr: Okore enyabya zaayo n'ebikopo byayo, kandi okore emidumo yaayo n'ebakuri zaayo eby'okushukisibwa empongano; obiheeshe omu zaabu eshemeziibwe.
en: And thou shalt make the dishes thereof, and spoons thereof, and covers thereof, and bowls thereof, to cover withal: of pure gold shalt thou make them.

rr: Ogume ote ahari egyo meeza emigaati ey'okumurika, ebe omu maisho gangye obutoosha. Eby'ekikondo ky'etabaaza y'ezaabu
en: And thou shalt set upon the table shewbread before me alway.

rr: Kandi oryakora ekikondo ky'etabaaza omu zaabu eshemeziibwe; omu kukikora okiheeshere hamwe; ekibunu kyakyo n'omukono gwakyo n'ebikopo byakyo n'ebintu ebyebumburikire byakyo n'ebirabyo byakyo, biheesheranwe nakyo.
en: And thou shalt make a candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work shall the candlestick be made: his shaft, and his branches, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, shall be of the same.

en: three bowls made like unto almonds, with a knop and a flower in one branch; and three bowls made like almonds in the other branch, with a knop and a flower: so in the six branches that come out of the candlestick.

rr: Ogwo mukono gw'etabaaza gugire ebikopo bina ebirikushusha nk'ebirabyo by'endozi, n'ebintu ebyebumburikire n'ebirabyo byabyo.
en: And in the candlestick shall be four bowls made like unto almonds, with their knops and their flowers.

en: And there shall be a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches that proceed out of the candlestick.

rr: Ebyebumburikire n'amataagi eby'ogwo mukono bibe biheesherainwe nagwo omu zaabu eshemeziibwe.
en: Their knops and their branches shall be of the same: all it shall be one beaten work of pure gold.

rr: Oheeshe amatabaaza gaakyo mushanju; bagume bagate ahu garikubaasa kwakira, gakahwezesa omwanya ogugari omumaisho.
en: And thou shalt make the seven lamps thereof: and they shall light the lamps thereof, that they may give light over against it.

rr: Empana zaago n'otusohaani twago biryaba biheesirwe omu zaabu eshemeziibwe.
en: And the tongs thereof, and the snuffdishes thereof, shall be of pure gold.

rr: Ekikondo ky'amatabaaza n'ebintu byago byona biryakorwa omu zaabu eshemeziibwe ey'oburemeezi bw'etalanta emwe.
en: Of a talent of pure gold shall he make it, with all these vessels.

rr: Oteho omutima kubiheesha, nooreebera aha ky'okureeberaho kyabyo, eki oyorekyeirwe aha rushozi oru.
en: And look that thou make them after their pattern, which was shewed thee in the mount.

-5 ; . Kandi oryakora Obutaaho n'emikingo ikumi; ogikore n'emyenda ya kitaani n'eya bururu n'eya bujwa n'eya karari; ogitemu ebishushani bya baakerubi ebikozirwe abanyamwoga baabyo.
en: Moreover thou shalt make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubims of cunning work shalt thou make them.

rr: Oburaingwa bwa buri mukingo bube mikono makumi abiri na munaana, n'obuhango bwagwo mikono ena; emikingo ebe ey'orugyero rumwe.
en: The length of one curtain shall be eight and twenty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and every one of the curtains shall have one measure.

rr: Emikingo etaano eteeranwe hamwe, n'endiijo etaano eteeranwe okwayo.
en: The five curtains shall be coupled together one to another; and other five curtains shall be coupled one to another.

en: And thou shalt make loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling; and likewise shalt thou make in the uttermost edge of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.

en: Fifty loops shalt thou make in the one curtain, and fifty loops shalt thou make in the edge of the curtain that is in the coupling of the second; that the loops may take hold one of another.

rr: Kandi okore ebikwatsi by'ezaabu makumi ataano, obikwatanisise egyo mikingo; obutaaho bube bumwe.
en: And thou shalt make fifty taches of gold, and couple the curtains together with the taches: and it shall be one tabernacle.

rr: Kandi oryakora emikingo y'obwoya bw'embuzi ey'okushakaara; okore emikingo ikumi na gumwe.
en: And thou shalt make curtains of goats' hair to be a covering upon the tabernacle: eleven curtains shalt thou make.

rr: Oburaingwa bwa buri mukingo bube mikono makumi ashatu, n'obuhango bwagwo mikono ena; egyo mikingo yoona ikumi na gumwe ebe ey'orugyero rumwe.
en: The length of one curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and the eleven curtains shall be all of one measure.

rr: Emikingo etaano ogiteerane okwayo; n'emikingo mukaaga okwayo ogwa mukaaga ogukube, gureereetere omu maisho g'eihema.
en: And thou shalt couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shalt double the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tabernacle.

rr: Kandi okore obufunga makumi ataano aha mukugiro gw'omukingo ogurikuheererukayo omu y'okubanza, n'obundi makumi ataano aha mukugiro ogw'omukingo ogurikuheererukayo omu ya kabiri.
en: And thou shalt make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outmost in the coupling, and fifty loops in the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.

rr: Okore ebikwatsi by'emiringa makumi ataano, obite omu bufunga, oteerane eihema, ribe rimwe.
en: And thou shalt make fifty taches of brass, and put the taches into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.

rr: Ekicweka ky'omukingo ekiraatsigare aha mikingo y'eihema, nikyo kicweka ky'omukingo ekirikushaagaho, kireereetere enyima y'obutaaho.
en: And the remnant that remaineth of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remaineth, shall hang over the backside of the tabernacle.

rr: Mukono gumwe ogw'emikingo y'obwoya bw'embuzi ogurikushaaga aha rubaju oru n'oru aha buraingwa bw'emikingo y'eihema ereereetere aha mbaju zombi ez'obutaaho, erishwekye.
en: And a cubit on the one side, and a cubit on the other side of that which remaineth in the length of the curtains of the tent, it shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.

rr: Kandi okore eby'okushweka Eihema omu mpu z'empaya z'entaama ezizigirwe n'erangi erikutukura, kandi otungikyeho eky'okushakaara ekindi ekikozirwe omu mpu z'engongi.
en: And thou shalt make a covering for the tent of rams' skins dyed red, and a covering above of badgers' skins.

rr: Kandi oryabaija embaaho z'obutaaho omu munyinya, ozeemereze
en: And thou shalt make boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood standing up.

rr: oburaingwa bwa buri rubaaho rube mikono ikumi, obuhango bwarwo mukono gumwe n'ekicweka
en: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and a cubit and a half shall be the breadth of one board.

rr: okore endimi ibiri omuri buri rubaaho okuruteerana na rugyenzi rwarwo; obe nikwo waakora embaaho zoona ez'obutaaho.
en: Two tenons shall there be in one board, set in order one against another: thus shalt thou make for all the boards of the tabernacle.

rr: Aha rubaju rw'obukiizi-bwa-buryo oteho embaaho z'obutaaho makumi abiri
en: And thou shalt make the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards on the south side southward.

rr: kandi okore ebiina makumi ana omu feeza eby'okubyaramu ezo mbaaho makumi abiri; ebiina bibiri ahansi y'orubaaho rumwe ahabw'endimi zaarwo zombi, n'ebindi biina bibiri ahansi y'orundi rubaaho ahabw'endimi zaarwo.
en: And thou shalt make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.

rr: Aha rubaju rw'obutaaho orwa kabiri, oruri aha bukiizi-bwa-bumosho, habeho embaaho makumi abiri
en: And for the second side of the tabernacle on the north side there shall be twenty boards:

rr: n'ebiina byazo by'efeeza makumi ana, ebiina bibiri ahansi y'orubaaho rumwe, n'ebindi bibiri ahansi y'orundi.
en: and their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

rr: Kandi okore embaaho mukaaga ahabw'orubaju rw'obutaaho orw'enyima orurikureeba oburengyerwa-izooba
en: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward thou shalt make six boards.

rr: okore n'embaaho ibiri ez'enshonda z'obutaaho aha mbaju zombi ez'enyima.
en: And two boards shalt thou make for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.

rr: Ezo mbaaho ahansi zitaane, kwonka ahaiguru ziteeranire aha mpeta ey'okubanza; zombi zibe nikwo zaaba; zibe ez'okuhamya ezo nshonda zombi.
en: And they shall be coupled together beneath, and they shall be coupled together above the head of it unto one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.

en: And they shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

rr: Kandi okore embazi itaano omu munyinya ahabw'embaaho z'orubaju rumwe rw'obutaaho
en: And thou shalt make bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

rr: ezindi itaano ahabw'embaaho z'orundi rubaju; n'ezindi itaano ahabw'embaaho z'orubaju rw'obutaaho orw'enyima orurikureeba oburengyerwa-izooba.
en: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the two sides westward.

rr: Orubazi rw'ahagati y'ezindi rwogyemu, ruhikye oku n'oku.
en: And the middle bar in the midst of the boards shall reach from end to end.

rr: Ezo mbaaho ozishwekye n'ezaabu, oheeshe empeta z'ezaabu ez'okurabyamu ezo mbazi; nazo ozishewkye n'ezaabu.
en: And thou shalt overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars: and thou shalt overlay the bars with gold.

rr: Oryayemereza obutaaho bushushane n'eky'okureeberaho eki oyorekirwe aha rushozi oru. Eby'Omukingo
en: And thou shalt rear up the tabernacle according to the fashion thereof which was shewed thee in the mount.

rr: Kandi oryakora omukingo gwa bururu na bujwa na karari na kitaani, ogutemu ebishushani bya baakerubi ebikozirwe abanyamwoga baabyo.
en: And thou shalt make a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen of cunning work: with cherubims shall it be made:

rr: Oguhanikye aha nyomyo ez'eminyinya ina ezishwekirwe n'ezaabu, n'eby'okuhanikaho by'ezaabu; ezo nyomyo ina zibyarwe omu biina by'efeeza bina.
en: and thou shalt hang it upon four pillars of shittim wood overlaid with gold: their hooks shall be of gold, upon the four sockets of silver.

en: And thou shalt hang up the vail under the taches, that thou mayest bring in thither within the vail the ark of the testimony: and the vail shall divide unto you between the holy place and the most holy.

rr: Kandi ote ekitebe kiri ky'okusaasira aha shanduukye y'Ebirikuhamya omu Mwanya ogurikwera munonga.
en: And thou shalt put the mercy seat upon the ark of the testimony in the most holy place .

rr: Kandi emeeza eri ogite kunu y'omukingo; aharikureebana nayo omu butaaho oteho ekikondo ky'etabaaza, kize aha rubaju rw'obukiizi-bwa-buryo, kandi emeeza eze aha rubaju rw'obukiizi-bwa bumosho.
en: And thou shalt set the table without the vail, and the candlestick over against the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south: and thou shalt put the table on the north side.

rr: Kandi oryakora omukingo gw'okukinga aha muryango gw'eihema, ogukore omu myenda ya bururu, eya bujwa, eya karari n'eya kitaani, gutariizemu amabara gacwereraine.
en: And thou shalt make an hanging for the door of the tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework.

rr: Kandi ogwo mukingo ogukorere enyomyo z'eminyinya itaano, ozishwekye n'ezaabu; eby'okuhanikaho byazo bibe eby'ezaabu; kandi oyazye omuringa, ogukoremu ebiina byazo bitaano.
en: And thou shalt make for the hanging five pillars of shittim wood , and overlay them with gold, and their hooks shall be of gold: and thou shalt cast five sockets of brass for them.

en: And thou shalt make an altar of shittim wood, five cubits long, and five cubits broad; the altar shall be foursquare: and the height thereof shall be three cubits.

rr: Aha nshonda zaaryo ina oribaijeho amahembe ana; ago mahembe gabaiziranwe naryo; orishwekye n'emiringa.

en: And thou shalt make his pans to receive his ashes, and his shovels, and his basons, and his fleshhooks, and his firepans: all the vessels thereof thou shalt make of brass.

rr: Kandi obaijere eitambiro emigamba omu munyinya, ogishwekye n'emiringa.
en: And thou shalt make staves for the altar, staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with brass.

rr: Egyo migamba yaaryo ogite omu bifunga, eze embaju zombi z'eitambiro, ebe ey'okuriheekyesa.

en: Hollow with boards shalt thou make it: as it was shewed thee in the mount, so shall they make it .

en: And for the breadth of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits: their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.

rr: Orubaju rw'oburugwa-izooba narwo obuhango bwarwo bube mikono etaano.
en: And the breadth of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.

rr: Emikingo y'orugo rw'aha rubaju rumwe rw'eirembo ebe mikono ikumi n'etaano, enyomyo zaayo zibe ishatu, n'ebiina byazo nabyo bibe bishatu.

en: And on the other side shall be hangings fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.

rr: Kandi eirembo ry'orwo rugo rigire omukingo gwa mikono makumi abiri obuhango, ogukozirwe omu myenda ya bururu, eya bujwa, eya karari n'eya kitaani, gutariizemu amabara gacwereraine; enyomyo zaagwo zibe ina, n'ebiina byazo bibe bina.
en: And for the gate of the court shall be an hanging of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework: and their pillars shall be four, and their sockets four.

rr: Enyomyo zoona ez'orwo rugo ziteebweho obufunga bw'efeeza; eby'okuhanikaho byazo bibe eby'efeeza, n'ebiina byazo bibe eby'emiringa.
en: All the pillars round about the court shall be filleted with silver; their hooks shall be of silver, and their sockets of brass.

rr: Oburaingwa bw'ekibuga kyona bube mikono igana n'obukiika bwakyo mikono makumi ataano embaju zoona, n'obwemi bw'orugo bube mikono etaano; rube orw'emyenda ya kitaani, kandi ebiina by'enyomyo zaarwo bibe eby'emiringa.
en: The length of the court shall be an hundred cubits, and the breadth fifty every where, and the height five cubits of fine twined linen, and their sockets of brass.

en: All the vessels of the tabernacle in all the service thereof, and all the pins thereof, and all the pins of the court, shall be of brass.

rr: Egire ebiremu bibiri aha mabega, biteerane emikugiro yaayo yombi, efodi ebone kuteeranwa.
en: It shall have the two shoulderpieces thereof joined at the two edges thereof; and so it shall be joined together.

en: And the curious girdle of the ephod, which is upon it, shall be of the same, according to the work thereof; even of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.

rr: Kandi ogire amabaare abiri agarikwetwa shohamu, ogasharureho amaziina g'abaana ba Israeli
en: And thou shalt take two onyx stones, and grave on them the names of the children of Israel:

rr: Ogundi mwana gw'entaama oryaguhonga omu mwabazyo, nagwo oguhongye n'empongano y'esaano n'ey'eky'okunywa, nk'eby'omu kasheeshe, kuba ekisooroora ekirungi, empongano eyokiibwe omu muriro, ehongyeirwe MUKAMA.
en: And the other lamb thou shalt offer at even, and shalt do thereto according to the meat offering of the morning, and according to the drink offering thereof, for a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD .

rr: Omu busingye bwanyu bwona kiryaguma kibe ekitambo ky'okwotsya, nikitambirwa aha muryango gw'eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu omu maisho ga MUKAMA, ahu ndibugaabuganira naimwe, nkagamba naiwe.
en: This shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD : where I will meet you, to speak there unto thee.

rr: Aho niho ndibugaabuganira n'Abaisraeli; kandi eryo Ihema riryayezibwa ekitiinisa kyangye.
en: And there I will meet with the children of Israel, and the tabernacle shall be sanctified by my glory.

rr: Ndyayeza eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu, n'eitambiro; kandi Arooni n'abatabani ndyabeeza, babone kunkorera omurimo gw'obunyamurwa.
en: And I will sanctify the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar: I will sanctify also both Aaron and his sons, to minister to me in the priest's office.

rr: Kandi ndyaguma omu Baisraeli, mbe Ruhanga waabo.
en: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.

rr: Nabo baryamanya ku ndi MUKAMA Ruhanga waabo, owaabaihire omu nsi ya Misri, ngu ngume omuribo. Niinye MUKAMA Ruhanga waabo. Currently Selected: Okuruga 29 : RR64 Highlight Share <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8 19c-2.828 0-4.243 0-5.121-.879C2 17.243
en: And they shall know that I am the LORD their God, that brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, that I may dwell among them: I am the LORD their God. Currently Selected: Exodus 29 : KJV Highlight Share </d

rr: Kandi oryakora ekyoterero ky'obubaane, okibaije omu munyinya
en: And thou shalt make an altar to burn incense upon: of shittim wood shalt thou make it.

rr: oburaingwa bwakyo kibe mukono gumwe, obuhango bwakyo nabwo mukono gumwe, kiingaingane embaju zoona, obwemi bwakyo kibe mikono ebiri, kandi amahembe gaakyo gabaiziranwe nakyo.
en: A cubit shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof; foursquare shall it be: and two cubits shall be the height thereof: the horns thereof shall be of the same.

rr: Okishwekye n'ezaabu eshemeziibwe, ahaiguru n'omu mbaju zaakyo n'aha mahembe gaakyo; kandi okiteho omuguno gw'ezaabu gukyehinguririze.
en: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, the top thereof, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns thereof; and thou shalt make unto it a crown of gold round about.

rr: Okiheeshere ebifunga bibiri by'ezaabu, obite ahansi y'omuguno gwakyo aha mbaju zaakyo zombi, bibe eby'okutamu emigamba y'okukiheekyesa.
en: And two golden rings shalt thou make to it under the crown of it, by the two corners thereof, upon the two sides of it shalt thou make it ; and they shall be for places for the staves to bear it withal.

rr: Egyo migamba ogibaije omu minyinya, ogishwekye n'ezaabu.
en: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.

rr: Okite omu maisho g'omukingo ogukingiire eshanduukye y'Ebirikuhamya omu maisho g'ekitebe ky'okusaasira ekiri ahaiguru y'Ebirikuhamya, ahu ndiguma nimbugaabuganira naiwe.
en: And thou shalt put it before the vail that is by the ark of the testimony, before the mercy seat that is over the testimony, where I will meet with thee.

rr: Arooni aryayotereraho obubaane obw'emigaju erikutaamirana, abwotere buri kasheeshe, yaaba naashemeza amatabaaza
en: And Aaron shall burn thereon sweet incense every morning: when he dresseth the lamps, he shall burn incense upon it.

rr: kandi n'omu mwabazyo, Arooni yaaba naahemba amatabaaza, abwotere, bube obubaane oburiguma nibwoterwa omu maisho ga MUKAMA obutoosha omu busingye bwanyu bwona.
en: And when Aaron lighteth the lamps at even, he shall burn incense upon it, a perpetual incense before the LORD throughout your generations.

rr: Mutarikyotereraho obubaane obw'ogundi muringo, n'obu kyakuba ekitambo ekyokize, nari empongano y'esaano; kandi mutarikishukaho empongano yoona ey'ebyokunywa.
en: Ye shall offer no strange incense thereon, nor burnt sacrifice, nor meat offering; neither shall ye pour drink offering thereon.

rr: Rimwe omu mwaka Arooni aheere aha mahembe gaakyo eky'okurihiirira; eshagama y'empongano ey'okurihiirira ekibi abe niyo yaarihiirira eryo itambiro rimwe omu mwaka omu busingye bwanyu bwona; n'ekirikwera munonga ahari MUKAMA.
en: And Aaron shall make an atonement upon the horns of it once in a year with the blood of the sin offering of atonements: once in the year shall he make atonement upon it throughout your generations: it is most holy unto the LORD .

rr: Kandi MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Ku oribara Abaisraeli, buri muntu areetere MUKAMA eky'okucungura amagara ge omuri orwo rubaro, abantu batakaateerwa rufu noobabara.
en: When thou takest the sum of the children of Israel after their number, then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul unto the LORD , when thou numberest them; that there be no plague among them, when thou numberest them.

rr: Eki nikyo omuntu weena, ohikire kuza omu barikubarwa, ariha; ekicweka kimwe kya kabiri kya shekeli, nka shekeli ey'Omwanya ogurikwera oku erikwingana, (shekeli emwe neingana geera makumi abiri); ekyo kicweka kya shekeli kibe eky'okuhongyera MUKAMA.
en: This they shall give, every one that passeth among them that are numbered, half a shekel after the shekel of the sanctuary: (a shekel is twenty gerahs:) an half shekel shall be the offering of the LORD .

rr: Buri muntu weena ohikire kuza omu barikubarwa, ohikize emyaka makumi abiri n'okukiraho, aryaha MUKAMA eky'okuhonga ekyo
en: Every one that passeth among them that are numbered, from twenty years old and above, shall give an offering unto the LORD .

rr: abatungi batarirenzya aha kicweka kya shekeli, n'abooro batarikicwaho, mwaba nimuha MUKAMA eky'okurihiirira amagara gaanyu.
en: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less than half a shekel, when they give an offering unto the LORD , to make an atonement for your souls.

rr: Oryaiha aha Baisraeli efeeza ez'okubarihiirira, ozite aha murimo gw'eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu, zibeere Abaisraeli ekiijutsyo ky'okubaijukiraho omu maisho ga MUKAMA, okurihiirira amagara gaanyu. Eby'ekinaabiro
en: And thou shalt take the atonement money of the children of Israel, and shalt appoint it for the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; that it may be a memorial unto the children of Israel before the LORD , to make an atonement for your souls.

rr: Kandi MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Oryaheesha ekinaabiro omu miringa, n'ekibunu kyakyo obe nimwo waakiheesha, kibe eky'okunaabiramu; okite ahagati y'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu n'eitambiro; kandi okitemu amaizi.
en: Thou shalt also make a laver of brass, and his foot also of brass, to wash withal: and thou shalt put it between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar, and thou shalt put water therein.

rr: Omwo nimwo Arooni n'abatabani bariguma nibanaabira engaro zaabo n'ebigyere byabo
en: For Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat:

rr: baaba nibaza kutaaha omu ihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu, bagume banaabe amaizi batakaafa, nari baaba nibaza aha itambiro okukora omurimo gwabo gw'okwotsya empongano ey'okwotsya omu muriro ey'okuhongyera MUKAMA
en: when they go into the tabernacle of the congregation, they shall wash with water, that they die not; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn offering made by fire unto the LORD :

rr: banaabe engaro zaabo n'ebigyere byabo batakaafa; kibabeere ekiragiro ky'ebiro byona, we n'oruzaaro rwe omu busingye bwabo bwona. Ebindi biragiro
en: so they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they die not: and it shall be a statute for ever to them, even to him and to his seed throughout their generations.

rr: Kandi MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati
en: Moreover the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Otware eby'emigaju erikuhita endiijo yoona, shekeli magana ataano za sumuruna y'amaizi, shekeli magana abiri na makumi ataano z'omudarasiini ogurikutaamirana, shekeli magana abiri na makumi ataano za kaane erikutaamirana
en: Take thou also unto thee principal spices, of pure myrrh five hundred shekels , and of sweet cinnamon half so much, even two hundred and fifty shekels , and of sweet calamus two hundred and fifty shekels ,

rr: na shekeli magana ataano za kasiya, nka shekeli ey'Omwanya ogurikwera oku eri; kandi na hiini emwe y'amajuta g'emizeituuni.
en: and of cassia five hundred shekels , after the shekel of the sanctuary, and of oil olive an hin:

rr: Obijwanzye, bibe amajuta agarikwera ag'okushukaho ahabw'okushoroora, emigaju ejwangiibwe abanyamwoga; gabe amajuta agarikwera ag'okushukaho ahabw'okushoroora.
en: and thou shalt make it an oil of holy ointment, an ointment compound after the art of the apothecary: it shall be an holy anointing oil.

rr: Ogashukye aha ihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu, n'aha shanduukye y'Ebirikuhamya
en: And thou shalt anoint the tabernacle of the congregation therewith, and the ark of the testimony,

rr: n'aha meeza n'ebintu byayo byona, n'aha kikondo ky'etabaaza n'ebintu byakyo, n'aha kyoterero ky'obubaane
en: and the table and all his vessels, and the candlestick and his vessels, and the altar of incense,

rr: n'aha itambiro ry'okwokyezaho ebitambo n'ebintu byaryo byona, n'aha kinaabiro n'ekibunu kyakyo.
en: and the altar of burnt offering with all his vessels, and the laver and his foot.

rr: Obyeze, bibe ebirikwera munonga. Ekiribikoraho kyona kiryaba ekirikwera.
en: And thou shalt sanctify them, that they may be most holy: whatsoever toucheth them shall be holy.

rr: Kandi ogashukye ahari Arooni n'abatabani, obeeze, babone kunkorera omurimo gw'obunyamurwa.
en: And thou shalt anoint Aaron and his sons, and consecrate them, that they may minister unto me in the priest's office.

rr: Kandi ogambire Abaisraeli oti: Aga garyaba amajuta aganyereziibwe ag'okushukaho ahabw'okushoroora omu busingye bwanyu bwona.
en: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, This shall be an holy anointing oil unto me throughout your generations.

rr: Gatarishukwa aha mubiri gw'omuntu weena otari munyamurwa kandi mutarikora agandi agajwangize nkago; n'agarikwera, naimwe garyababeera agarikwera.
en: Upon man's flesh shall it not be poured, neither shall ye make any other like it, after the composition of it: it is holy, and it shall be holy unto you.

rr: Orijwanzya amajuta agarikushushana nago, nari origashuka aha muntu otari munyamurwa, aryacuubwa omu ihanga rye.
en: Whosoever compoundeth any like it, or whosoever putteth any of it upon a stranger, shall even be cut off from his people.

rr: Kandi MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati: Otware eby'emigaju egi erikutaamirana, natafi, shekelesi, na kelibena, eby'emigaju ebyo hamwe n'ogundi oguri kwetwa lebona; byona bibe nibinganisa oburemeezi.
en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take unto thee sweet spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum; these sweet spices with pure frankincense: of each shall there be a like weight:

rr: Obikoremu obubaane, nk'oku abanyamwoga baabwo babijwanzya, otemu omwonyo, bube obushemeire kandi oburikwera
en: and thou shalt make it a perfume, a confection after the art of the apothecary, tempered together, pure and holy:

rr: otwareho bukye, obuhonde, obunozye, obute omu maisho g'Ebirikuhamya omu ihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu, ahu ndibugaabuganira naiwe; naimwe buryababeera oburikwera munonga.
en: and thou shalt beat some of it very small, and put of it before the testimony in the tabernacle of the congregation, where I will meet with thee: it shall be unto you most holy.

rr: Kandi obubaane obu orikora bujwangire nk'obwo, otaribwejwangiza; buryakubeera obwereziibwe MUKAMA.
en: And as for the perfume which thou shalt make, ye shall not make to yourselves according to the composition thereof: it shall be unto thee holy for the LORD .

rr: Orijwanzya obubaane oburikushushana nabwo, kubukoresa nk'omugaju, acuubwe omu ihanga rye.
en: Whosoever shall make like unto that, to smell thereto, shall even be cut off from his people.

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Reeba, naayeta Bezaleeli omu iziina mutabani wa Uuri, mwene Huuri, ow'omuruganda rwa Yuda.
en: See, I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah:

rr: Naamwijuza Omwoyo wa Ruhanga n'obwengye n'okwetegyereza n'okumanya n'obuhangu bwona obw'okukora
en: and I have filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship,

rr: okugunja emirimo y'obuhangu, okuheesha ezaabu n'efeeza n'emiringa
en: to devise cunning works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,

rr: okubaija amabaare ag'okuhunda omu bintu, okusharura ebibaizirwe omu miti, n'okukora emirimo y'emiringo yoona.
en: and in cutting of stones, to set them , and in carving of timber, to work in all manner of workmanship.

rr: Kandi reeba, naamutaho Oholiabu, mwene Ahisamaaki, ow'omu ruganda rwa Daani. Kandi boona abaine omutima ogurikwetegyereza, naabaha obwengye, ngu bakore ebi naakuragiira byona
en: And I, behold, I have given with him Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan: and in the hearts of all that are wise hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded thee;

rr: Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu, eshanduukye y'Ebirikuhamya, ekitebe ky'okusaasira ekigifundikiire, n'ebintu byona eby'Eihema
en: the tabernacle of the congregation, and the ark of the testimony, and the mercy seat that is thereupon, and all the furniture of the tabernacle,

rr: n'emeeza n'ebintu byayo, n'ekikondo ky'etabaaza eky'ezaabu eshemeziibwe n'ebintu byakyo byona, n'ekyoterero ky'obubaane
en: and the table and his furniture, and the pure candlestick with all his furniture, and the altar of incense,

rr: n'eitambiro ry'okwokyezaho ebitambo n'ebintu byaryo byona, n'ekinaabiro n'ekibunu kyakyo
en: and the altar of burnt offering with all his furniture, and the laver and his foot,

rr: n'ebijwaro ebibaziirwe gye, n'ebijwaro ebirikwera ebya Arooni omunyamurwa n'eby'abatabani, eby'okujwara nibakora omurimo gw'obunyamurwa
en: and the cloths of service, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office,

rr: n'amajuta ag'okushukaho ahabw'okushoroora, n'obubaane bw'emigaju erikutaamirana ahabw'Omwanya ogurikwera. Nkebi naakuragiira byona oku biri, babe nikwo baabikora. Ekiragiro kya Sabato
en: and the anointing oil, and sweet incense for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded thee shall they do.

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Kandi ogambire Abaisraeli oti: Buzimazima mutaribura kurinda sabato zangye; ahabw'okuba niko kamanyiso ahagati yangye naimwe omu busingye bwanyu bwona, mubone kumanya ku niinye MUKAMA orikubeeza.
en: Speak thou also unto the children of Israel, saying, Verily my sabbaths ye shall keep: for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations; that ye may know that I am the LORD that doth sanctify you.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo muryaguma murinde sabato; ahabw'okuba n'erikwera ahariimwe; omuntu weena origishiisha, aryaitwa; omuntu weena origikoreraho omurimo gwona, acuubwe omu ihanga rye.
en: Ye shall keep the sabbath therefore; for it is holy unto you: every one that defileth it shall surely be put to death: for whosoever doeth any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

rr: Omu biro mukaaga emirimo ebe nimwo yaakorerwa; kwonka ekiro kya mushanju niyo sabato ey'okuruhuukiriraho kimwe, eyereziibwe MUKAMA. Orikora omurimo gwona aha izooba rya sabato, buzimazima aitwe.
en: Six days may work be done; but in the seventh is the sabbath of rest, holy to the LORD : whosoever doeth any work in the sabbath day, he shall surely be put to death.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo Abaisraeli baryarinda sabato, bagume nibahitsya emigyenzo yaayo omu busingye bwabo bwona, ebe endagaano etarihwaho.
en: Wherefore the children of Israel shall keep the sabbath, to observe the sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.

rr: Ako n'akamanyiso ahagati yangye n'Abaisraeli akarigumaho ebiro byona; ahabw'okuba omu biro mukaaga nimwo MUKAMA yaahangiire eiguru n'ensi, akahuumura aha kiro kya mushanju, akaruhuuka.
en: It is a sign between me and the children of Israel for ever: for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.

rr: MUKAMA ku yaaherize kugambira na Musa aha rushozi Sinai, yaamuha ebishate by'amabaare bibiri ebiriho Ebirikuhamya, ebihandiikirwe orukumu rwa Ruhanga.
en: And he gave unto Moses, when he had made an end of communing with him upon mount Sinai, two tables of testimony, tables of stone, written with the finger of God.

rr: Abantu ku baareebire Musa yaatuura aha rushozi atagarukire, baayeteeranira ahari Arooni, baamugira bati: Imuka, otukorere Ruhanga w'okutwebembera; ahabw'okuba omushaija ori Musa, owaatwihire omu nsi ya Misri, titurikumanya oku abaire.
en: And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down out of the mount, the people gathered themselves together unto Aaron, and said unto him, Up, make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.

rr: Arooni yaabagira ati: Mujuure empeta z'ezaabu eziri aha matu g'abakazi baanyu n'aga batabani baanyu na bahara baanyu, muzindeetere.
en: And Aaron said unto them, Break off the golden earrings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them unto me.

rr: Abantu boona baajuura empeta ezaabaire ziri aha matu gaabo, baazitwarira Arooni.
en: And all the people brake off the golden earrings which were in their ears, and brought them unto Aaron.

rr: Yaaziiha omu ngaro zaabo; ku yaaherize kuziheeshamu ekishushani ky'enimi, yaakishemeza n'ekyoma ekirikusharura. Baagira bati: Iwe Israeli, ogu niwe Ruhanga waawe owaakwihire omu nsi ya Misri.
en: And he received them at their hand, and fashioned it with a graving tool, after he had made it a molten calf: and they said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.

rr: Arooni ku yaakireebire, yaayombeka eitambiro omu maisho gaakyo; yaaranga, naagira ati: Nyencakare nihaija kubaho obugyenyi bw'ekiro kikuru kya MUKAMA.
en: And when Aaron saw it , he built an altar before it; and Aaron made proclamation, and said, To morrow is a feast to the LORD .

rr: Ku bwaseesire, baimuka kare, baatamba ebitambo by'okwotsya, baahonga empongano y'okusiima ahabw'obusingye. Abantu baashutama kurya n'okunywa, baimuka kuzaana.
en: And they rose up early on the morrow, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati: Irooko, oshuume; ahabw'okuba abantu baawe abu waihire omu nsi ya Misri beesiisire
en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go, get thee down; for thy people, which thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves:

rr: baarahuka kuteishuka omuhanda ogu naabaragiire; baayeheeshera ekishushani ky'enimi, baakiramya, baakitambira ebitambo nibagira bati: Iwe Israeli, ogu niwe Ruhanga waawe, owaakwihire omu nsi ya Misri.
en: they have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them: they have made them a molten calf, and have worshipped it, and have sacrificed thereunto, and said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which have brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.

rr: Kandi MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati: Naayetegyereza abantu aba; n'abantu b'ebitsya bigangaire.
en: And the LORD said unto Moses, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo ndeka, ekiniga kyangye kibaakyeho, mbamareho; haza iwe ndyakuhindura eihanga rihango.
en: now therefore let me alone, that my wrath may wax hot against them, and that I may consume them: and I will make of thee a great nation.

rr: -29 ; . Musa yaayeshengyereza MUKAMA Ruhanga we, naagira ati: MUKAMA, ahabw'enki ekiniga kyawe nikyaka aha bantu baawe, abu waihire omu nsi ya Misri n'obushoboorozi bwingi n'omukono gw'amaani?
en: And Moses besought the LORD his God, and said, LORD , why doth thy wrath wax hot against thy people, which thou hast brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power, and with a mighty hand?

rr: Ahabw'enki nooyenda kureetera Abanyamisri kwesiima nibagira bati: Akabaihayo kubakora kubi, ngu abaitire omu nshozi, abamare omu nsi?
en: Wherefore should the Egyptians speak, and say, For mischief did he bring them out, to slay them in the mountains, and to consume them from the face of the earth?

rr: Reka ekiniga kyawe kingi, oyegarukyemu, orekye kureeta akabi ako aha bantu baawe.
en: Turn from thy fierce wrath, and repent of this evil against thy people.

rr: Ijuka Abarahamu, isaaka na Israeli abairu baawe, abu waagambiire noorahira oti: Ndyakanyisa oruzaaro rwanyu, rube nk'enyonyoozi z'omu iguru, kandi ensi egi yoona ei naagambaho ndyagiha oruzaaro rwanyu, ebe obuhunguzi bwarwo ebiro byona.
en: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, thy servants, to whom thou swarest by thine own self, and saidst unto them, I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and all this land that I have spoken of will I give unto your seed, and they shall inherit it for ever.

rr: MUKAMA yaayegarukamu, yaareka akabi aku yaabaire naayenda kureeta aha bantu be.
en: And the LORD repented of the evil which he thought to do unto his people.

rr: Musa yaahinduka, yaashuuma naaruga aha rushozi, aine omu ngaro ze ebishate bibiri ebiriho Ebirikuhamya, ebihandiikire embaju zaabyo zombi omunda n'enyima.
en: And Moses turned, and went down from the mount, and the two tables of the testimony were in his hand: the tables were written on both their sides; on the one side and on the other were they written.

rr: Ebyo bishate bikaba bikozirwe Ruhanga okuhandiika okwo kukaba kuri okwa Ruhanga kusharwirwe aha bishate.
en: And the tables were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, graven upon the tables.

rr: Yoshua ku yaahuriire orwari rw'abantu nibayomba, yaagambira Musa ati: Orwo rwari oruri omu rusiisira n'orw'okurwana.
en: And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said unto Moses, There is a noise of war in the camp.

rr: Musa yaagira ati: Orwo rwari ti rwari rw'abarikuteera akaari ahabw'okubinga, nari orw'abarikuyomba ahabw'okubingwa; kureka oru ndikuhurira, n'orw'abarikweshongora.
en: And he said, It is not the voice of them that shout for mastery, neither is it the voice of them that cry for being overcome: but the noise of them that sing do I hear.

rr: Musa ku yaahikire haihi n'orusiisira, yaareeba ekishushani ky'enimi n'abarikuzina, yaagira ekiniga kingi, yaatambika ebishate ebi yaabaire aine omu ngaro, yaabyatira ahansi y'orushozi.
en: And it came to pass, as soon as he came nigh unto the camp, that he saw the calf, and the dancing: and Moses' anger waxed hot, and he cast the tables out of his hands, and brake them beneath the mount.

rr: Yaatwara ekishushani eki babaire baheesire, yaakyotsya omu muriro, yaakihondahonda, yaakicwa eiju, yaarinaganaga omu maizi, yaaganywaisa Abaisraeli.
en: And he took the calf which they had made, and burnt it in the fire, and ground it to powder, and strawed it upon the water, and made the children of Israel drink of it .

rr: Musa yaabuza Arooni ati: Aba bantu bakugizire bata, waaza kubareetera kukora ekibi kihango ekirikwingana kiti?
en: And Moses said unto Aaron, What did this people unto thee, that thou hast brought so great a sin upon them?

rr: Arooni yaagarukamu ati: Mukama wangye, reka kungirira ekiniga; noomanya aba bantu ku bamaririire kukora kubi
en: And Aaron said, Let not the anger of my lord wax hot: thou knowest the people, that they are set on mischief.

rr: ahakuba bangizire bati: Tukorere Ruhanga oraatwebembere, ahakuba omushaija ori Musa owaatwihire omu nsi ya Misri, titurikumanya oku abaire.
en: For they said unto me, Make us gods, which shall go before us: for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.

rr: Naanye naabagarukamu nti: Oine ezaabu weena, agijuure; nabo baazimpa naazinaga omu muriro, zaarugamu egyo nimi.
en: And I said unto them, Whosoever hath any gold, let them break it off. So they gave it me: then I cast it into the fire, and there came out this calf.

rr: Musa ku yaareebire abantu bagomire, (ahakuba Arooni akabaikiriza kugoma, baahinduka eky'okugaaniiza omu bazigu baabo)
en: And when Moses saw that the people were naked; (for Aaron had made them naked unto their shame among their enemies:)

rr: yaayemerera omu irembo ry'orusiisira, yaagira ati: Weena ori aha rubaju rwa MUKAMA, aije ahi ndi.
en: then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, Who is on the LORD 's side? let him come unto me.

rr: Abaleevi boona bateeranira ah'ari.
en: And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him.

rr: Yaabagira ati: Oku nikwo MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli arikugamba, naagira ati: Buri muntu ahagatire rurara ye, mugyendagyende hoonahoona omu rusiisira nimuruga aha irembo nimuza aha rindi, buri muntu aite mwene ishe, na mugyenzi we, na mutaahi we.
en: And he said unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Put every man his sword by his side, and go in and out from gate to gate throughout the camp, and slay every man his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbour.

rr: Abaleevi baakora nk'oku Musa yaabaragiira; aha izooba eryo omu Baisraeli haafa abashaija nk'enkumi ishatu.
en: And the children of Levi did according to the word of Moses: and there fell of the people that day about three thousand men.

rr: Musa yaagira ati: Eri izooba mweyeze ahari MUKAMA, ahakuba buri muntu arwaniise omutabani na mwene ishe, MUKAMA abone kubaha omugisha eri izooba.
en: For Moses had said, Consecrate yourselves to day to the LORD , even every man upon his son, and upon his brother; that he may bestow upon you a blessing this day. Repentance

rr: Ku bwaseesire, Musa yaagambira abantu ati: Mukozire ekibi kihango; mbwenu naaza kwinamuka ahari MUKAMA; obundi nkaabaasa kukora eky'okurihiirira ekibi kyanyu.
en: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses said unto the people, Ye have sinned a great sin: and now I will go up unto the LORD ; peradventure I shall make an atonement for your sin.

rr: Musa yaagaruka ahari MUKAMA, yaagira ati: Ai bambe, abantu aba bakozire ekibi kihango, baayekorera Ruhanga omu zaabu.
en: And Moses returned unto the LORD , and said, Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made them gods of gold.

rr: Mbwenu hati, ku oraabe noikiriza kubasaasira ekibi kyabo, obasaasire; kwonka ku oraabe otarikubasaasira, naakweshengyereza onyihe omu kitabo eki waahandiikire.
en: Yet now, if thou wilt forgive their sin–; and if not, blot me, I pray thee, out of thy book which thou hast written.

rr: MUKAMA yaagarukamu Musa ati: Weena oncumwireho, niwe ndaihe omu kitabo kyangye.
en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Whosoever hath sinned against me, him will I blot out of my book.

rr: Mbwenu irooko otware abantu abo omu mwanya ogu naakugambiire; reeba, maraika wangye naija kukwebembera. Kwonka aha izooba ry'okuhoora, ndyabatura ekibi kyabo.
en: Therefore now go, lead the people unto the place of which I have spoken unto thee: behold, mine Angel shall go before thee: nevertheless in the day when I visit I will visit their sin upon them.

rr: MUKAMA yaitsa abantu orufu, ahakuba bakakoresa ekishushani ky'enimi eki Arooni yaakozire.
en: And the LORD plagued the people, because they made the calf, which Aaron made.

MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati: Irooko orugye aha, iwe n'abantu abu waihire omu nsi ya Misri, muze omu nsi ei naarahiire Abrahamu, Isaaka na Yakobo, ningira nti: Ndyagiha oruzaaro rwawe.
en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Depart, and go up hence, thou and the people which thou hast brought up out of the land of Egypt, unto the land which I sware unto Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, Unto thy seed will I give it:

rr: Naanye ndyayohereza maraika akwebembere, kandi ndyabinga Abanyakanaani, Abaamori, Abahiiti, Abaperizi, Abahiivi n'Abayebusi
en: and I will send an angel before thee; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:

rr: mutaahe omu nsi y'amate n'obwoki; kwonka Nyowe tindigyenda naimwe, ntakaabaitira omu muhanda; ahabw'okuba muri abantu b'ebitsya bigangaire.
en: unto a land flowing with milk and honey: for I will not go up in the midst of thee; for thou art a stiffnecked people: lest I consume thee in the way.

rr: Abantu ku baahuriire ebyo bigambo bibi, baashaasha munonga, tihaagira n'omwe owaajwara eby'okweshemeza.
en: And when the people heard these evil tidings, they mourned: and no man did put on him his ornaments.

rr: Ahakuba MUKAMA akaba yaagambiire Musa ati: Gambira Abaisraeli oti: Muri abantu b'ebitsya bigangaire; ku naakugyenda naimwe nangwa n'akaanya kakye, nkaabamaraho. Mbwenu nu, mujuure eby'okweshemeza byanyu, mbone kumanya oku ndaabagire.
en: For the LORD had said unto Moses, Say unto the children of Israel, Ye are a stiffnecked people: I will come up into the midst of thee in a moment, and consume thee: therefore now put off thy ornaments from thee, that I may know what to do unto thee.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo Abaisraeli baajuura eby'okweshemeza, okutandikira aha rushozi Horebu n'okweyongyerayo.
en: And the children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments by the mount Horeb.

rr: Kandi okuruga obwo Musa yaaguma naatwara Eihema naariteera aheeru y'orusiisira hare narwo; yaaryeta Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu.
en: And Moses took the tabernacle, and pitched it without the camp, afar off from the camp, and called it the Tabernacle of the congregation.

rr: Kandi omuntu weena owaabaire aba naasherura MUKAMA, akaba ashohora aza aha Ihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu, eryabaire riri aheeru y'orusiisira.
en: And it came to pass, that every one which sought the LORD went out unto the tabernacle of the congregation, which was without the camp.

rr: Musa ku yaabaire aruga omu rusiisira, naaza aha Ihema, abantu boona baimuka, buri muntu ayemerera aha muryango gw'eihema rye, baguma nibamureeba okuhitsya obu araataahe omu Ihema.
en: And it came to pass, when Moses went out unto the tabernacle, that all the people rose up, and stood every man at his tent door, and looked after Moses, until he was gone into the tabernacle.

rr: Musa ku yaabaire aheza kutaahamu, enyomyo eri ey'ekicu eshuuma, eyemerera aha muryango gw'Eihema, MUKAMA agamba nawe.
en: And it came to pass, as Moses entered into the tabernacle, the cloudy pillar descended, and stood at the door of the tabernacle, and the LORD talked with Moses.

rr: Abantu boona bakireeba enyomyo y'ekicu eyemereire aha muryango gw'Eihema, baimuka, baramya, buri muntu ari aha muryango gw'eihema rye.
en: And all the people saw the cloudy pillar stand at the tabernacle door: and all the people rose up and worshipped, every man in his tent door.

rr: Okwo nikwo MUKAMA yaabaire agamba na Musa nibareebana, nk'oku omuntu agamba na mugyenzi we. Bwanyima Musa agaruka omu rusiisira; kwonka omuheereza we Yoshua mwene Nuuni, omutsigazi, akaba ataruga omuri eryo Hema. Musa okworekwa ekitiinisa kya MUKAMA
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses face to face, as a man speaketh unto his friend. And he turned again into the camp: but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, departed not out of the tabernacle.

rr: Musa yaagambira MUKAMA ati: Reeba, nongira oti: Twara abantu aba; kwonka tiwammanyisa u orantume nawe.
en: And Moses said unto the LORD , See, thou sayest unto me, Bring up this people: and thou hast not let me know whom thou wilt send with me.

rr: Kandi okagira oti: Ninkumanya eiziina, kandi ogiriirwe embabazi omu maisho gangye.
en: Yet thou hast said, I know thee by name, and thou hast also found grace in my sight.

rr: Mbwenu nu, ninkweshengyereza, ku ndaabe ngiriirwe embabazi omu maisho gaawe, hati onyorekye enaama zaawe, nkumanye, mbone kuguma ningirirwa embabazi omu maisho gaawe; kandi oijukye eihanga eri ku riri eihanga ryawe.
en: Now therefore, I pray thee, if I have found grace in thy sight, shew me now thy way, that I may know thee, that I may find grace in thy sight: and consider that this nation is thy people.

rr: MUKAMA yaamugarukamu ati: Nyowe nyenka ndyagyenda naiwe, kandi ndyakuha obuhuumure.
en: And he said, My presence shall go with thee , and I will give thee rest.

rr: Musa yaamugira ati: Iwe wenka ku oraabe otarikugyenda naanye, otatwiha aha.
en: And he said unto him, If thy presence go not with me , carry us not up hence.

rr: Mbwenu kiryamanywa kita, nyowe n'abantu baawe ku tugiriirwe embabazi omu maisho gaawe? Tiiwe kugyenda naitwe, kikareetera nyowe n'abantu baawe kugira omutaano n'amahanga goona agari omu nsi?
en: For wherein shall it be known here that I and thy people have found grace in thy sight? is it not in that thou goest with us? so shall we be separated, I and thy people, from all the people that are upon the face of the earth.

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati: Ekigambo eki eki waagamba nakyo niinyija kukikora; ahabw'okuba ogiriirwe embabazi omu maisho gangye, kandi ninkumanya eiziina.
en: And the LORD said unto Moses, I will do this thing also that thou hast spoken: for thou hast found grace in my sight, and I know thee by name.

rr: Musa yaagira ati: Ninkweshengyereza, nyoreka ekitiinisa kyawe.
en: And he said, I beseech thee, shew me thy glory.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira ati: Niinyija kurabya oburungi bwangye bwona omu maisho gaawe, ndangye eiziina ryangye YEHOVA omu maisho gaawe; ndyagirira embabazi ou ndigirira embabazi, kandi nsaasire, ou ndisaasira.
en: And he said, I will make all my goodness pass before thee, and I will proclaim the name of the LORD before thee; and will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will shew mercy on whom I will shew mercy.

rr: Kandi yaamugira ati: Torikubaasa kundeeba hamaisho; ahakuba tihariho muntu orindeeba, akagumaho.
en: And he said, Thou canst not see my face: for there shall no man see me, and live.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira ati: Reeba, aha rubaju rwangye hariho omwanya, ahu orikwija kwemerera aha rukiri.
en: And the LORD said, Behold, there is a place by me, and thou shalt stand upon a rock:

rr: Ekitiinisa kyangye ku kiraabe nikihinguraho, niinyija kukuta omu bwatika bwarwo, nkusangire n'ekiganja kyangye, okuhitsya obu ndaarabeho
en: and it shall come to pass, while my glory passeth by, that I will put thee in a clift of the rock, and will cover thee with my hand while I pass by:

rr: bwanyima nyiheho omukono gwangye, ondeebe omugongo; kwonka aha maisho gangye tiharikwija kureebwa.
en: and I will take away mine hand, and thou shalt see my back parts: but my face shall not be seen.

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati: Shatura ebishate bibiri by'amabaare nk'eby'okubanza; naanye niinyija kubihandiikaho ebigambo ebyabaire biri aha by'okubanza ebi waayatsire.
en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first: and I will write upon these tables the words that were in the first tables, which thou brakest.

rr: Nyencakare omu kasheeshe obe oyeteekateekire, oinamukye aha rushozi Sinai, oyeyorekye omu maisho gangye aha mutwe gwarwo.
en: And be ready in the morning, and come up in the morning unto mount Sinai, and present thyself there to me in the top of the mount.

rr: Hatagira omuntu owainamuka naiwe, kandi otaikiriza omuntu weena kureebwa aha rushozi rwona, n'obu gaakuba amasyo g'entaama nari ag'ente kuriira omu maisho gaarwo.
en: And no man shall come up with thee, neither let any man be seen throughout all the mount; neither let the flocks nor herds feed before that mount.

rr: Musa yaashatura ebishate bibiri by'amabaare nk'eby'okubanza, yaimuka kare omu kasheeshe, yainamuka aha rushozi Sinai nk'oku MUKAMA yaamuragiire, aine omu ngaro ebyo bishate byombi by'amabaare.
en: And he hewed two tables of stone like unto the first; and Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up unto mount Sinai, as the LORD had commanded him, and took in his hand the two tables of stone.

rr: MUKAMA yaashuumira omu kicu, yaayemererayo nawe, yaaranga eiziina rye YEHOVA.
en: And the LORD descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name of the LORD .

rr: MUKAMA yaaraba omu maisho ga Musa, yaaranga naagira ati: MUKAMA, MUKAMA, Ruhanga ow'okusaasira n'embabazi, otarahuka kugira ekiniga, oijwire embabazi n'amazima
en: And the LORD passed by before him, and proclaimed, The LORD , The LORD God, merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth,

rr: ogirira embabazi abantu enkumi n'enkumi, osaasira okutahikiirira n'okushiisha n'ekibi; otasingisiriza na kakye abaine orubanja; ohoora abaana ahabw'eby'okushiisha bya baishebo, n'abaijukuru baabo okuhitsya aha busingye bwa kashatu n'obwa kana.
en: keeping mercy for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, and that will by no means clear the guilty ; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the children's children, unto the third and to the fourth generation .

rr: Musa yaarahuka, yainika omutwe ahansi, yaaramya
en: And Moses made haste, and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshipped.

rr: yaagira ati: Ai MUKAMA, mbwenu ku ndaabe naagirirwa embabazi omu maisho gaawe, ninkweshengyereza, MUKAMA, ogyende ahagati yaitu, n'obu turaabe turi eihanga ry'ebitsya bigangaire, osaasire okutahikiirira kwaitu n'ekibi kyaitu, otwakiire tube obuhunguzi bwawe.
en: And he said, If now I have found grace in thy sight, O Lord, let my Lord, I pray thee, go among us; for it is a stiffnecked people; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for thine inheritance.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira ati: Reeba, nindagaana endagaano; omu maisho g'abantu baawe boona ndyakora eby'okutangaaza ebitakakorwaga mu nsi yoona nari omu ihanga ryona; kandi abantu boona, abu orimu, baryareeba eki MUKAMA arikora, ahakuba eki ndikora, kiryaba eky'okutiinisa.
en: And he said, Behold, I make a covenant: before all thy people I will do marvels, such as have not been done in all the earth, nor in any nation: and all the people among which thou art shall see the work of the LORD : for it is a terrible thing that I will do with thee.

rr: Ogume oyorobere eki ndikukuragiira eri izooba. Reeba, ndyabinga Abaamori omu maisho gaawe, n'Abanyakanaani, Abahiiti, Abaperizi, Abahiivi n'Abayebusi.
en: Observe thou that which I command thee this day: behold, I drive out before thee the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite.

rr: Oyerinde, otariragaana endagaano n'abatwire omu nsi ei orikuzamu, ekaba omutego omuriimwe
en: Take heed to thyself, lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land whither thou goest, lest it be for a snare in the midst of thee:

rr: kureka musheenye amatambiro gaabo, muhigure enyomyo zaabo, mutemagure na Ashera zaabo.
en: but ye shall destroy their altars, break their images, and cut down their groves:

rr: (Mumanye ngu timuriramya Ruhanga ondiijo weena; ahabw'okuba MUKAMA, ou eiziina rye ririkwetwa Ow'eihato, ni Ruhanga ow'eihato.)
en: for thou shalt worship no other god: for the LORD , whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God:

rr: Otariragaana endagaano n'abatwire omuri egyo nsi; ahakuba ku barikurata baaruhanga baabo nk'abarikuraaya, baabatambira ebitambo, nyentsya omwe aharibo akaakweta, orya aha kitambo kye
en: lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, and they go a whoring after their gods, and do sacrifice unto their gods, and one call thee, and thou eat of his sacrifice;

rr: oshwererera batabani baawe bahara baabo, bwanyima bahara baabo bakurata baaruhanga baabo nk'abarikuraaya, bareetera batabani baawe kukurata baaruhanga baabo omu muringo ogwo.
en: and thou take of their daughters unto thy sons, and their daughters go a whoring after their gods, and make thy sons go a whoring after their gods.

rr: Otaryekorera ebishushani bya baaruhanga ebiheesirwe. Eby'amagyenyi
en: Thou shalt make thee no molten gods.

rr: Oryaguma orinde obugyenyi bw'emigaati etatumbisiibwe.
en: The feast of unleavened bread shalt thou keep.

rr: Omu bunaku obwatairweho omu kwezi Abibu oryamara ebiro mushanju noorya emigaati etatumbisiibwe, nk'oku naakuragiire; ahabw'okuba omuri okwo kwezi Abibu nimwo waarugiire omuri Misri.
en: Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, as I commanded thee, in the time of the month Abib: for in the month Abib thou camest out from Egypt.

rr: Ekiigura-nda kyona n'ekyangye, ekyetwa ekishaija ky'omu matungo gaawe goona ag'ente n'ag'entaama.
en: All that openeth the matrix is mine; and every firstling among thy cattle, whether ox or sheep, that is male .

rr: Kwonka omujigaijo gw'endogoya oryagucunguza omwana gw'entaama; ku oriba otarikwenda kugucungura, oguhende ebitsya.
en: But the firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb: and if thou redeem him not, then shalt thou break his neck.

rr: Emijigaijo ya batabani baanyu yoona muryagicungura.
en: All the firstborn of thy sons thou shalt redeem.

rr: Hatarigira owaija omu maisho gangye engaro nsha.
en: And none shall appear before me empty.

rr: Omu biro mukaaga oryakora, kwonka aha kiro kya mushanju oryahuumura; omu ibiba n'omu igyesha oryahuumura.
en: Six days thou shalt work, but on the seventh day thou shalt rest: in earing time and in harvest thou shalt rest.

rr: Kandi oryarinda obugyenyi bwa saabiiti mushanju, ez'omuganuro gw'eigyesha ry'engano, kandi n'obugyenyi bw'eishaaruura ry'aha muheru gw'omwaka.
en: And thou shalt observe the feast of weeks, of the firstfruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of ingathering at the year's end.

rr: Kashatu omu mwaka abeetwa abashaija boona baryaguma baije, bareebwe omu maisho ga Mukama RUHANGA, Ruhanga wa Israeli.
en: Thrice in the year shall all your menchildren appear before the Lord GOD , the God of Israel.

rr: Ahakuba ndyabinga amahanga, garugye omu maisho gaawe, nyirizeyo emyatano yaawe; ku oriba ogiire kureebwa omu maisho ga MUKAMA kashatu omu mwaka, tihaine muntu weena oryetenga ensi yaawe.
en: For I will cast out the nations before thee, and enlarge thy borders: neither shall any man desire thy land, when thou shalt go up to appear before the LORD thy God thrice in the year.

rr: Otarihayo eshagama y'ekitambo ekintambiirwe hamwe n'omugaati ogutumbisiibwe, kandi ekitambo ky'obugyenyi bw'ekiro kikuru ky'Okuhingurwaho kitaritsigaraho okuhitsya omu kasheeshe.
en: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leaven; neither shall the sacrifice of the feast of the passover be left unto the morning.

rr: Emiganuro y'ebirikubanza kwera omu misiri yaawe oryagireeta omu nju ya MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe.
en: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring unto the house of the LORD thy God.

rr: Otariteeka omwana gw'embuzi omu mahenahene ga nyinagwo.
en: Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother's milk.

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati: Handiika ebigambo ebyo; ahakuba endagaano ei ndagaine naiwe n'Abaisraeli neehamira aha bigambo ebyo.
en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Write thou these words: for after the tenor of these words I have made a covenant with thee and with Israel.

rr: Musa yaamarayo ebiro makumi ana nyomushana na nyekiro, ari hamwe na MUKAMA; omu biro ebyo tarariire by'okurya n'obu kwakuba okunywa amaizi. Yaahandiika ahari ebyo bishate by'amabaare ebigambo by'endagaano egyo, nibyo biragiro ikumi. Musa okuruga aha rushozi Sinai
