en: 25 And there were windows in it and in the arches thereof round about, like those windows: the length was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.

rr: 26 Kandi amatembero agaabire nigarihikaho gakaba gari mushanju, n'ekisasi kyaryo kiri omunda; kandi ebiti byaryo bikaba biriho emikindo, gumwe aha rubaju rumwe, n'ogundi aha rundi.
en: 26 And there were seven steps to go up to it, and the arches thereof were before them: and it had palm trees, one on this side, and another on that side, upon the posts thereof.

rr: 27 Kandi aha rubaju rw'obukiizi-bwa-buryo obw'ekibuga eky'omunda hakaba hariho eirembo; yaagyera okuruga aha irembo okuhika aha rindi ery'aha bukiizi-bwa-buryo, haaba mikono igana.
en: 27 And there was a gate in the inner court toward the south: and he measured from gate to gate toward the south an hundred cubits.

rr: 28 Bwanyima yandyabya omu irembo ry'aha bukiizi-bwa-buryo, yantaasya omuri ekyo kibuga ky'omnda, yaagyera eryo irembo, ryaba ery'orugyero rumwe n'agandi.
en: 28 And he brought me to the inner court by the south gate: and he measured the south gate according to these measures;

rr: 29 Ebishengye by'aha mbaju zaaryo, n'ebiti byaryo, n'ekisasi kyaryo, bikaba biri eby'orugyero rumwe n'ebindi; kandi omuri eryo irembo n'omu kisasi kyaryo hakaba harimu amadirisa agarikwingana n'agandi okwehinguririza; oburaingwa bwaryo bwaba mikono makumi ataano, n'obukiika bwaryo mikono makumi abiri n'etaano.
en: 29 and the little chambers thereof, and the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, according to these measures: and there were windows in it and in the arches thereof round about: it was fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.

rr: 30 Kandi hakaba hariho ebisasi okwehinguririza, oburaingwa bwabyo buri mikono makumi abiri n'etaano, n'obukiika bwabyo mikono etaano.
en: 30 And the arches round about were five and twenty cubits long, and five cubits broad.

rr: 31 Ekisasi kyaryo kikaba nikireeba ekibuga ky'aheeru, n'amatembero agarikurihikaho gari munaaga.
en: 31 And the arches thereof were toward the utter court; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof: and the going up to it had eight steps.

rr: 32 Yaagaruka yantaasya omu kibuga ky'omunda aha rubaju rw'oburugwa-izooba, yaagyera eirembo ry'aho, ryaba ery'orugyero rumwe n'agandi.
en: 32 And he brought me into the inner court toward the east: and he measured the gate according to these measures.

rr: 33 Ebishengye byaryo eby'omu mbaju, ebiti byaryo, n'ekisasi kyaryo, byaba eby'orugyero rumwe n'ebindi; omuri eryo irembo n'omu kisasi kyaryo hakiikizemu amadirisa; oburaingwa bwaryo buri mikono makumi ataano, n'obukiika bwaryo mikono makumi abiri n'etaano.
en: 33 And the little chambers thereof, and the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, were according to these measures: and there were windows therein and in the arches thereof round about: it was fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.

rr: 34 Ekisasi kyaryo kikaba nikireeba ekibuga ky'aheeru, ebiti byaryo biriho emikindo, gumwe aha rubaju rumwe n'ogundi aha rundi; n'amatembero agarikurihikaho gari minaana.
en: 34 And the arches thereof were toward the outward court; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof, on this side, and on that side: and the going up to it had eight steps.

rr: 35 Bwanyima yantwara aha irembo ery'aha bukiizi-bwa-bumosho, yaarigyera; ryaba ery'orugyero rumwe n'agandi
en: 35 And he brought me to the north gate, and measured it according to these measures;

rr: 36 ebishengye byaryo eby'omu mbaju n'ebiti byaryo, n'ekisasi kyaryo, byaba eby'orugyero rumwe n'ebindi; rikiikiiziibwemu amadirisa; oburaingwa bwaryo buri mikono makumi ataano, n'obukiika bwaryo mikono makumi abiri n'etaano.
en: 36 the little chambers thereof, the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, and the windows to it round about: the length was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.

rr: 37 Ekisasi kyaryo kikaba nikireeba ekibuga ky'aheeru; ebiti byaryo bikaba biriho emikindo, gumwe aha rubaju rumwe n'ogundi aha rundi; n'amatembero agarikurihikaho gari munaana.
en: 37 And the posts thereof were toward the utter court; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof, on this side, and on that side: and the going up to it had eight steps.
38 And the chambers and the entries thereof were by the posts of the gates, where they washed the burnt offering.
39 And in the porch of the gate were two tables on this side, and two tables on that side, to slay thereon the burnt offering and the sin offering and the trespass offering.

rr: 40 Kandi aheeru y'ekisasi y'ah'orikutaahira nooza omu irembo ery'aha bukiizi-bwa-bumosho hakaba hariyo emeeza ibiri, n'aha rundi rubaju ezindi ibiri.
en: 40 And at the side without, as one goeth up to the entry of the north gate, were two tables; and on the other side, which was at the porch of the gate, were two tables.

rr: 41 Aha rubaju rw'omunda orw'eryo irembo hariho emeeza ina, n'aha rubaju rwaryo orw'aheeru ezindi ina, zoona munaana ziri ez'okwitiraho ebitambo.
en: 41 Four tables were on this side, and four tables on that side, by the side of the gate; eight tables, whereupon they slew their sacrifices .

rr: 42 Hakaba hariho n'ezindi meeza ina ezibaizirwe omu mabaare, ez'okutaho ebitambo by'okwotsya, oburaingwa bwazo mukono gumwe n'ekicweka, obukiika bwazo mukono gumwe n'ekicweka, n'obwemi bwazo mukono gumwe, ezaabaire ziteebwaho eby'okwitsa ebitambo by'okwotsya n'ebindi bitambo.
en: 42 And the four tables were of hewn stone for the burnt offering, of a cubit and an half long, and a cubit and an half broad, and one cubit high: whereupon also they laid the instruments wherewith they slew the burnt offering and the sacrifice.

rr: 43 Kandi omuri ekyo kisasi hakaba hateereiremu ebyoma by'okuhanikaho eby'oburaingwa bw'ekita kimwe, bikiikiize omunda. Ahari ezo meeza niho haabaire haba ah'okuta enyama z'empongano.
en: 43 And within were hooks, an hand broad, fastened round about: and upon the tables was the flesh of the offering.

44 And without the inner gate were the chambers of the singers in the inner court, which was at the side of the north gate; and their prospect was toward the south: one at the side of the east gate having the prospect toward the north.
45 And he said unto me, This chamber, whose prospect is toward the south, is for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the house.

46 And the chamber whose prospect is toward the north is for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the altar: these are the sons of Zadok among the sons of Levi, which come near to the LORD to minister unto him.
47 So he measured the court, an hundred cubits long, and an hundred cubits broad, foursquare; and the altar that was before the house.

rr: 48 Bwanyima yantwara aha kisasi kya hakelu, yaagyera enyomyo zaakyo zombi, ey'aha rubaju rumwe yaaba mikono etaano, n'ey'aha rubaju rundi nayo mikono etaano; obuhango bw'eirembo bwaba mikono ikumi n'ena, n'ebisiika by'omu rubaju rw'eirembo byaba mikono eshatu buri rubaju.
en: 48 And he brought me to the porch of the house, and measured each post of the porch, five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side: and the breadth of the gate was three cubits on this side, and three cubits on that side.

49 The length of the porch was twenty cubits, and the breadth eleven cubits; and he brought me by the steps whereby they went up to it: and there were pillars by the posts, one on this side, and another on that side.

rr: 1 Bwanyima yantwara omuri hekalu, yaagyera ebiti byayo by'emiryango; ahari buri rubaju obukiika bwabyo bwaba mikono mukaaga.
en: 1 Afterward he brought me to the temple, and measured the posts, six cubits broad on the one side, and six cubits broad on the other side, which was the breadth of the tabernacle.

2 And the breadth of the door was ten cubits; and the sides of the door were five cubits on the one side, and five cubits on the other side: and he measured the length thereof, forty cubits: and the breadth, twenty cubits.

rr: 3 Banyima yaataaha omu kishengye ky'omunda, yaagyera ebiti by'omuryango gwakyo, byaba mikono ebiri; obuhango bw'omuryango bwaba mikono mukaaga, n'ebisiika byagowo orubaju n'orubaju byaba mikono mushanju.
en: 3 Then went he inward, and measured the post of the door, two cubits; and the door, six cubits; and the breadth of the door, seven cubits.
4 So he measured the length thereof, twenty cubits; and the breadth, twenty cubits, before the temple: and he said unto me, This is the most holy place .
5 After he measured the wall of the house, six cubits; and the breadth of every side chamber, four cubits, round about the house on every side.

rr: 6 Ebyo bishengye by'omu mbaju za hekalu bikaba biri kaanyina-ishatu bitungamiraine; omuri buri mushorongo harimu ebishengye makumi ashatu. Okwehinguririza ekisiika kya hekalu hakaba hariho ah'okutaahiza ebishengye by'omu mbaju omuri ekyo kisiika kuhamiramu, kwonka bitarikwoga mu kisiika kya hekalu.
en: 6 And the side chambers were three, one over another, and thirty in order; and they entered into the wall which was of the house for the side chambers round about, that they might have hold, but they had not hold in the wall of the house.

rr: 7 Ebyo bishengye by'omu mbaju byagyenda nibiba bihango, nk'oku bigyenzire nibitembekyerana okuza ahaiguru, nk'obuhango bw'okutaaha omu kisiika okwa buri mushorongo oku buri; aha rubaju rwa hekalu hakaba hariho amatembero g'okutemberaho; kandi omuntu ku yaabaire aruga omu kishengye ky'ahansi, naaza omu kya kaanyina-ishatu, araba omu kya kaanyina-ibiri.
en: 7 And there was an enlarging, and a winding about still upward to the side chambers: for the winding about of the house went still upward round about the house: therefore the breadth of the house was still upward, and so increased from the lowest chamber to the highest by the midst.

rr: 8 Kandi naareeba hekalu eyehinguririziibwe ekicweka ky'omusingi ekitunguukire; emisingi y'ebishengye by'omu mbaju ekaba eri ey'orugyero rw'ekibingo kimwe kya mikono mukaaga emiraingwa.
en: 8 I saw also the height of the house round about: the foundations of the side chambers were a full reed of six great cubits.

rr: 9 Omuzimba gw'ebisiika by'aheeru eby'ebishengye ebikiikiize hekalu guri mikono etaano, kandi ekicweka ky'omusingi ekyatsigariire aho nakyo kiri mikono etaano.
en: 9 The thickness of the wall, which was for the side chamber without, was five cubits: and that which was left was the place of the side chambers that were within.

rr: 10 Okuruga aha muheru gw'ekyo kicweka ky'omusingi okuhika aha bishengye by'omu kibuga ekaba eri mikono makumi abiri okwehinguririza hekalu embaju zoona.
en: 10 And between the chambers was the wideness of twenty cubits round about the house on every side.

rr: 11 Emiryango y'ebyo bishengye ebikiikiize hekalu ekaba neereeba ahari ekyo kicweka ky'omusingi ekyatsigariire aho, ogumwe nigureeba aha bukiizi-bwa-bumosho, ogundi aha bwa-buryo; kandi obukiika bw'ekyo kicweka ky'omusingi ekyatsigariire aho embaju zoona bukaba buri mikono etaano.
en: 11 And the doors of the side chambers were toward the place that was left, one door toward the north, and another door toward the south: and the breadth of the place that was left was five cubits round about.

rr: 12 Ekyombeko ekyabaire nikireeba omu kibuga kya hekalu aha rubaju rw'oburengyerwa-izooba kikaba kiri mukono makumi mushanju obukiika; kandi omuzimba gw'ekisiika ky'ekyo kyombeko gukaba guri mikono etaano embaju zoona n'oburaingwa bwakyo mikono makumi mwenda.
en: 12 Now the building that was before the separate place at the end toward the west was seventy cubits broad; and the wall of the building was five cubits thick round about, and the length thereof ninety cubits.

rr: 13 Bwanyima yaagyera hekalu, oburaingwa bwayo bwaba mikono igana; ekibuga kyayo n'ekyombeko hamwe n'ebisiika byayo, oburaingwa bwabyo bwaba mikono igana
en: 13 So he measured the house, an hundred cubits long; and the separate place, and the building, with the walls thereof, an hundred cubits long;

rr: 14 kandi obukiika bw'omu maisho ga hekalu aha rubaju rw'oburugwa-izooba hamwe n'ekibuga kyaho bwaba mikono igana.
en: 14 also the breadth of the face of the house, and of the separate place toward the east, an hundred cubits.

rr: 15 Bwanyima yaagyera oburaingwa bw'ekyombeko ekirikureeba omu kibuga, eky'aha rubaju rw'oburengyerwa-izooba, hamwe n'ebisiika byakyo orubaju n'orubaju, bwaba mikono igana.
en: 15 And he measured the length of the building over against the separate place which was behind it, and the galleries thereof on the one side and on the other side, an hundred cubits, with the inner temple, and the porches of the court;

16 the door posts, and the narrow windows, and the galleries round about on their three stories, over against the door, cieled with wood round about, and from the ground up to the windows, and the windows were covered;

rr: 17 n'okuhika aha mwanya ogw'ahaiguru y'omuryango, kandi n'okuhika aha kishengye ky'omunda n'aheeru.
en: 17 to that above the door, even unto the inner house, and without, and by all the wall round about within and without, by measure.
18 And it was made with cherubims and palm trees, so that a palm tree was between a cherub and a cherub; and every cherub had two faces;
19 so that the face of a man was toward the palm tree on the one side, and the face of a young lion toward the palm tree on the other side: it was made through all the house round about.

rr: 20 Okwo nikwo byabaire bisharwirwe ahari hekalu yoona embaju zoona; okuruga ahansi okuhika ahaiguru y'omuryangohakba hasharwirweho baakerubi n'emikindo.
en: 20 From the ground unto above the door were cherubims and palm trees made, and on the wall of the temple.

rr: 21 Ebiti by'omuryango by'ekishengye ekya rwagati bikaba biine embaju ina ezirikwingaingana.
en: 21 The posts of the temple were squared, and the face of the sanctuary; the appearance of the one as the appearance of the other .

22 The altar of wood was three cubits high, and the length thereof two cubits; and the corners thereof, and the length thereof, and the walls thereof, were of wood: and he said unto me, This is the table that is before the LORD .
23 And the temple and the sanctuary had two doors.

rr: 24 kandi ezo mbari zikaba ziina ebishate bibiri ebirikukubwa buri emwe.
en: 24 And the doors had two leaves apiece , two turning leaves; two leaves for the one door, and two leaves for the other door .
25 And there were made on them, on the doors of the temple, cherubims and palm trees, like as were made upon the walls; and there were thick planks upon the face of the porch without.
26 And there were narrow windows and palm trees on the one side and on the other side, on the sides of the porch, and upon the side chambers of the house, and thick planks.

1 Then he brought me forth into the utter court, the way toward the north: and he brought me into the chamber that was over against the separate place, and which was before the building toward the north.

rr: 2 Oburaingwa bw'ekyo kyombeko ky'aha rubaju rw'obukiizi-bwa-bumohso bukaba buri mikono igana, n'obukiika bwakyo mikono makumi ataano.
en: 2 Before the length of an hundred cubits was the north door, and the breadth was fifty cubits.

rr: 3 Kandi hakaba hariho amabaraza ga kaanyina-ishatu gatungamiraine, gahereraine n'omwanya gwa mikono makumi abiri ogw'ekibuga ky'omunda, kandi nigareeban n'ekicweka ekyariirwe amabaare.
en: 3 Over against the twenty cubits which were for the inner court, and over against the pavement which was for the utter court, was gallery against gallery in three stories .

rr: 4 Omu maisho g'ebyo bishengye ahagati hakaba hariho omwanya gw'okurabamu gwa mikono ikumi obukiika, na mikono igana oburaingwa; n'emiryango y'ebyo bishengye neereeba aha bukiizi-bwa-bumosho.
en: 4 And before the chambers was a walk of ten cubits breadth inward, a way of one cubit; and their doors toward the north.

rr: 5 Ebishengye by'ahaiguru bikaba bifunzire okukira eby'ahagati n'eby'ahansi, ahabw'okuba ago mabaraza gakaba gabifundize okukira ebindi.
en: 5 Now the upper chambers were shorter: for the galleries were higher than these, than the lower, and than the middlemost of the building.

rr: 6 Ahakuba bikaba biri ebya kaanyina-ishatu, kandi bitaine nyomyo nk'ez'omu kibuga ky'aheeru; n'ahabw'ekyo ebishengye by'ahaiguru bikaba biri bikye okukira eby'ahagati n'eby'ahansi.
en: 6 For they were in three stories , but had not pillars as the pillars of the courts: therefore the building was straitened more than the lowest and the middlemost from the ground.

rr: 7 Kandi enyima y'ebyo bishengye hakaba hariyo ekisiika kiringaaniire nabyo, kandi kishungaine nabyo aha rubaju rw'ekibuga ky'aheeru, oburaingwa bwakyo mikono makumi ataano.
en: 7 And the wall that was without over against the chambers, toward the utter court on the forepart of the chambers, the length thereof was fifty cubits.

rr: 8 Ahakuba oburaingwa bw'ebishengye by'omu kibuga ky'aheeru bukaba buri mikono makumi ataano, kwonka obw'ebishungaine na hekalu buri mikono igana.
en: 8 For the length of the chambers that were in the utter court was fifty cubits: and, lo, before the temple were an hundred cubits.

rr: 9 Ahansi y'ebyo bishengye hakaba hariho omuryango aha rubaju rw'oburugwa-izooba, ogwabaire gutaahirwamu abarikuruga omu kibuga ky'enyima
en: 9 And from under these chambers was the entry on the east side, as one goeth into them from the utter court.

rr: 10 ahu orugo rw'aheeru rwabaire nirutandikira. Kandi aha rubaju rw'obukiizi-bwa-buryo, ahashingaine n'ekibuga kandi n'ekyo kyombeko, hakaba hariho ebishengye eibiine omuhanda gw'okurabamu omumaisho
en: 10 The chambers were in the thickness of the wall of the court toward the east, over against the separate place, and over against the building.

rr: 11 bikaba nibishushana n'eby'aha rubaju rw'obukiizi-bwa-bumosho, biri eby'orugyero rumwe oburaingwa n'obukiika, kandi nibishushanisa nabyo aharikushohorerwa, emyombekyere, n'emiryango.
en: 11 And the way before them was like the appearance of the chambers which were toward the north, as long as they, and as broad as they: and all their goings out were both according to their fashions, and according to their doors.

rr: 12 Kandi ahansi y'ebyo bishengye by'aha bukiizi-bwa-buryo, aha rubaju rw'oburugwa-izooba, hakaba hariho omuryango ogurikutaaha omu muhadna gw'ahagati gw'okurabamu; kandi ahashungaine nagwo hariho ekisiika ekirikubitaanisa.
en: 12 And according to the doors of the chambers that were toward the south was a door in the head of the way, even the way directly before the wall toward the east, as one entereth into them.

13 Then said he unto me, The north chambers and the south chambers, which are before the separate place, they be holy chambers, where the priests that approach unto the LORD shall eat the most holy things: there shall they lay the most holy things, and the meat offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; for the place is holy.

14 When the priests enter therein, then shall they not go out of the holy place into the utter court, but there they shall lay their garments wherein they minister; for they are holy; and shall put on other garments, and shall approach to those things which are for the people.

rr: 15 Ku yaaherize kugyera ekibuga kya hekalu omunda, yantwara yandabya omu irembo ry'oburugwa-izooba, yaagyera omwanya gwa hekalu embaju zoona.
en: 15 Now when he had made an end of measuring the inner house, he brought me forth toward the gate whose prospect is toward the east, and measured it round about.
16 He measured the east side with the measuring reed, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed round about.

rr: 17 yaahinduka yaakigyeresa orubaju rw'obukiizi-bwa-bumohso, byaba ebibingo magana ataano.
en: 17 He measured the north side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed round about.

rr: 18 Yaahinduka yaakigyeresa orubaju rw'obukiizi-bwa-buryo, byaba ebibingo magana ataano
en: 18 He measured the south side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed.

rr: 19 kandi yaahindukira orubaju rw'oburengyerwa-izooba, yaarukigyeresa, rwaba ebibingo magana ataano.
en: 19 He turned about to the west side, and measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.
20 He measured it by the four sides: it had a wall round about, five hundred reeds long, and five hundred broad, to make a separation between the sanctuary and the profane place.
1 Afterward he brought me to the gate, even the gate that looketh toward the east:
2 and, behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east: and his voice was like a noise of many waters: and the earth shined with his glory.

3 And it was according to the appearance of the vision which I saw, even according to the vision that I saw when I came to destroy the city: and the visions were like the vision that I saw by the river Chebar; and I fell upon my face.

rr: 4 Ekitiinisa kya MUKAMA ku kyabaire nikitaaha omuri hekalu, nikireetwa omu irembo ery'oburugwa-izooba
en: 4 And the glory of the LORD came into the house by the way of the gate whose prospect is toward the east.
5 So the spirit took me up, and brought me into the inner court; and, behold, the glory of the LORD filled the house.
6 And I heard him speaking unto me out of the house; and the man stood by me.

7 And he said unto me, Son of man, the place of my throne, and the place of the soles of my feet, where I will dwell in the midst of the children of Israel for ever, and my holy name, shall the house of Israel no more defile, neither they, nor their kings, by their whoredom, nor by the carcases of their kings in their high places.

rr: 8 n'obu kwakuba okuhikaanisa ekisasi kyabo n'ekyangye, n'enyomyo zaabo n'ezangye; ahagati yangye nabo hakabaho ekisiika kyonka. Ahabw'okuba bakasiisisa eiziina ryangye eririkwera ebihagaro byabo ebi baakozire; nikyo naabamariireho, mbainiire ekiniga.
en: 8 In their setting of their threshold by my thresholds, and their post by my posts, and the wall between me and them, they have even defiled my holy name by their abominations that they have committed: wherefore I have consumed them in mine anger.

rr: 9 Mbwenu hati baanyihe omumaisho okuramya ebishushani kwabo n'emitumbi y'abagabe baabo, babite hare, mbone kuguma omuribo ebiro byona.
en: 9 Now let them put away their whoredom, and the carcases of their kings, far from me, and I will dwell in the midst of them for ever.
10 Thou son of man, shew the house to the house of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their iniquities: and let them measure the pattern.

11 And if they be ashamed of all that they have done, shew them the form of the house, and the fashion thereof, and the goings out thereof, and the comings in thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the laws thereof: and write it in their sight, that they may keep the whole form thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and do them.
12 This is the law of the house; Upon the top of the mountain the whole limit thereof round about shall be most holy. Behold, this is the law of the house.

13 And these are the measures of the altar after the cubits: The cubit is a cubit and an hand breadth; even the bottom shall be a cubit, and the breadth a cubit, and the border thereof by the edge thereof round about shall be a span: and this shall be the higher place of the altar.

rr: 14 Obu nibwo buriba obwemi bw'eitambiro, okuruga ahansi aha kitebe kyaryo okuhika ah amukugiro gw'ahansi mikono ebiri, n'obukiika bwaryo mukono gumwe; kandi okuruga aha mukugiro omukye okuhika aha muhango mikono ena, n'obukiika mukono gumwe; n'amahega gaaryo mikono ena
en: 14 And from the bottom upon the ground even to the lower settle shall be two cubits, and the breadth one cubit; and from the lesser settle even to the greater settle shall be four cubits, and the breadth one cubit.

rr: 15 kandi okuruga aha mahega gaaryo habeho amahembe ana ageemereire bwemi, oburaingwa bwa buri ihembe mukono gumwe.
en: 15 So the altar shall be four cubits; and from the altar and upward shall be four horns.

rr: 16 Amahega g'eitambiro garyagira embaju ina ezirikwingaingana, oburaingwa mikono ikumi n'ebiri, n'obukiika mikono ikumi n'ebiri.
en: 16 And the altar shall be twelve cubits long, twelve broad, square in the four squares thereof.

17 And the settle shall be fourteen cubits long and fourteen broad in the four squares thereof; and the border about it shall be half a cubit; and the bottom thereof shall be a cubit about; and his stairs shall look toward the east.

18 And he said unto me, Son of man, thus saith the Lord GOD ; These are the ordinances of the altar in the day when they shall make it, to offer burnt offerings thereon, and to sprinkle blood thereon.
19 And thou shalt give to the priests the Levites that be of the seed of Zadok, which approach unto me, to minister unto me, saith the Lord GOD , a young bullock for a sin offering.
20 And thou shalt take of the blood thereof, and put it on the four horns of it, and on the four corners of the settle, and upon the border round about: thus shalt thou cleanse and purge it.
21 Thou shalt take the bullock also of the sin offering, and he shall burn it in the appointed place of the house, without the sanctuary.

rr: 22 Aha kiro kya kabiri oryahonga empaya y'embuzi etaine kamogo kuba empongano y'ekibi; rityo eitambiro riryashemezibwa, nk'oku barishemeize n'egyo nimi.
en: 22 And on the second day thou shalt offer a kid of the goats without blemish for a sin offering; and they shall cleanse the altar, as they did cleanse it with the bullock.
23 When thou hast made an end of cleansing it , thou shalt offer a young bullock without blemish, and a ram out of the flock without blemish.
24 And thou shalt offer them before the LORD , and the priests shall cast salt upon them, and they shall offer them up for a burnt offering unto the LORD .
25 Seven days shalt thou prepare every day a goat for a sin offering: they shall also prepare a young bullock, and a ram out of the flock, without blemish.

rr: 26 Baryamara ebiro mushanju nibarihiirira eitambiro n'okuryeza; batyo barihsoroore.
en: 26 Seven days shall they purge the altar and purify it; and they shall consecrate themselves.

27 And when these days are expired, it shall be, that upon the eighth day, and so forward, the priests shall make your burnt offerings upon the altar, and your peace offerings; and I will accept you, saith the Lord GOD .
1 Then he brought me back the way of the gate of the outward sanctuary which looketh toward the east; and it was shut.

2 Then said the LORD unto me; This gate shall be shut, it shall not be opened, and no man shall enter in by it; because the LORD , the God of Israel, hath entered in by it, therefore it shall be shut.
3 It is for the prince; the prince, he shall sit in it to eat bread before the LORD ; he shall enter by the way of the porch of that gate, and shall go out by the way of the same.
4 Then brought he me the way of the north gate before the house: and I looked, and, behold, the glory of the LORD filled the house of the LORD : and I fell upon my face.

5 And the LORD said unto me, Son of man, mark well, and behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears all that I say unto thee concerning all the ordinances of the house of the LORD , and all the laws thereof; and mark well the entering in of the house, with every going forth of the sanctuary.
6 And thou shalt say to the rebellious, even to the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD ; O ye house of Israel, let it suffice you of all your abominations,

7 in that ye have brought into my sanctuary strangers, uncircumcised in heart, and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in my sanctuary, to pollute it, even my house, when ye offer my bread, the fat and the blood, and they have broken my covenant because of all your abominations.
8 And ye have not kept the charge of mine holy things: but ye have set keepers of my charge in my sanctuary for yourselves.

rr: 9 Nikyo Mukama RUHANGA arikugirira ati: Tihariho munyaihanga otashazirwe mu mutima n'omu mubiri ow'omu banyamahanga boona ab'omu ihanga rya Israeli oriikirizibwa kutaah omu Mwanya gwangye ogurikwera.
en: 9 Thus saith the Lord GOD ; No stranger, uncircumcised in heart, nor uncircumcised in flesh, shall enter into my sanctuary, of any stranger that is among the children of Israel.
10 And the Levites that are gone away far from me, when Israel went astray, which went astray away from me after their idols; they shall even bear their iniquity.

11 Yet they shall be ministers in my sanctuary, having charge at the gates of the house, and ministering to the house: they shall slay the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to minister unto them.

12 Because they ministered unto them before their idols, and caused the house of Israel to fall into iniquity; therefore have I lifted up mine hand against them, saith the Lord GOD , and they shall bear their iniquity.

13 And they shall not come near unto me, to do the office of a priest unto me, nor to come near to any of my holy things, in the most holy place: but they shall bear their shame, and their abominations which they have committed.
14 But I will make them keepers of the charge of the house, for all the service thereof, and for all that shall be done therein.

15 But the priests the Levites, the sons of Zadok, that kept the charge of my sanctuary when the children of Israel went astray from me, they shall come near to me to minister unto me, and they shall stand before me to offer unto me the fat and the blood, saith the Lord GOD :
16 they shall enter into my sanctuary, and they shall come near to my table, to minister unto me, and they shall keep my charge.

17 And it shall come to pass, that when they enter in at the gates of the inner court, they shall be clothed with linen garments; and no wool shall come upon them, whiles they minister in the gates of the inner court, and within.

rr: 18 Baryaguma bajware ebikwemba bya kitaani omu mitwe, bajware n'empare za kitaani omunda; kandi tibaryezirika kintu kyona ekirikubareetera okutuutuka.
en: 18 They shall have linen bonnets upon their heads, and shall have linen breeches upon their loins; they shall not gird themselves with any thing that causeth sweat.

19 And when they go forth into the utter court, even into the utter court to the people, they shall put off their garments wherein they ministered, and lay them in the holy chambers, and they shall put on other garments; and they shall not sanctify the people with their garments.
20 Neither shall they shave their heads, nor suffer their locks to grow long; they shall only poll their heads.
21 Neither shall any priest drink wine, when they enter into the inner court.
22 Neither shall they take for their wives a widow, nor her that is put away: but they shall take maidens of the seed of the house of Israel, or a widow that had a priest before.
23 And they shall teach my people the difference between the holy and profane, and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean.

24 And in controversy they shall stand in judgment; and they shall judge it according to my judgments: and they shall keep my laws and my statutes in all mine assemblies; and they shall hallow my sabbaths.

25 And they shall come at no dead person to defile themselves: but for father, or for mother, or for son, or for daughter, for brother, or for sister that hath had no husband, they may defile themselves.
26 And after he is cleansed, they shall reckon unto him seven days.
27 And in the day that he goeth into the sanctuary, unto the inner court, to minister in the sanctuary, he shall offer his sin offering, saith the Lord GOD .
28 And it shall be unto them for an inheritance: I am their inheritance: and ye shall give them no possession in Israel: I am their possession.
29 They shall eat the meat offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; and every dedicated thing in Israel shall be their's.

30 And the first of all the firstfruits of all things , and every oblation of all, of every sort of your oblations, shall be the priest's: ye shall also give unto the priest the first of your dough, that he may cause the blessing to rest in thine house.
31 The priests shall not eat of any thing that is dead of itself, or torn, whether it be fowl or beast.

1 Moreover, when ye shall divide by lot the land for inheritance, ye shall offer an oblation unto the LORD , an holy portion of the land: the length shall be the length of five and twenty thousand reeds , and the breadth shall be ten thousand. This shall be holy in all the borders thereof round about.
2 Of this there shall be for the sanctuary five hundred in length , with five hundred in breadth , square round about; and fifty cubits round about for the suburbs thereof.
3 And of this measure shalt thou measure the length of five and twenty thousand, and the breadth of ten thousand: and in it shall be the sanctuary and the most holy place .

4 The holy portion of the land shall be for the priests the ministers of the sanctuary, which shall come near to minister unto the LORD : and it shall be a place for their houses, and an holy place for the sanctuary.
5 And the five and twenty thousand of length, and the ten thousand of breadth, shall also the Levites, the ministers of the house, have for themselves, for a possession for twenty chambers.

rr: 6 Aha rubaju rw'ekyo kicweka ekyaihirweho kuba ekyanga ekirikwera, muryahatooranira orurembo omwanya gwa mikono enkumi itaano obukiika, noburaingwa mikono obukimi n'enkumi itaano; guryaba ogw'enju ya Israeli yoona.
en: 6 And ye shall appoint the possession of the city five thousand broad, and five and twenty thousand long, over against the oblation of the holy portion: it shall be for the whole house of Israel.

7 And a portion shall be for the prince on the one side and on the other side of the oblation of the holy portion , and of the possession of the city, before the oblation of the holy portion , and before the possession of the city, from the west side westward, and from the east side eastward: and the length shall be over against one of the portions, from the west border unto the east border.
8 In the land shall be his possession in Israel: and my princes shall no more oppress my people; and the rest of the land shall they give to the house of Israel according to their tribes.
9 Thus saith the Lord GOD ; Let it suffice you, O princes of Israel: remove violence and spoil, and execute judgment and justice, take away your exactions from my people, saith the Lord GOD .
10 Ye shall have just balances, and a just ephah, and a just bath.

rr: 11 Eefa n'encuro bibe eby'orugyero rumwe; encuro egiibwemu ekicweka kya ikumi kya homeri, na eefa nayo ekicweka kimwe kya ikumi kya homeri; homeri nayo ebi niyo yaaguma neeba eky'okurengyesa.
en: 11 The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure, that the bath may contain the tenth part of an homer, and the ephah the tenth part of an homer: the measure thereof shall be after the homer.
12 And the shekel shall be twenty gerahs: twenty shekels, five and twenty shekels, fifteen shekels, shall be your maneh.

rr: 13 Egi niyo mpongano ei muriguma nimuhonga; ekicweka kimwe kya mukaaga kya eefa y'engano ekiihirwe omuri buri homeri; na kimwe kya mukaaga kya eefa ya sayriri omuri buri homeri
en: 13 This is the oblation that ye shall offer; the sixth part of an ephah of an homer of wheat, and ye shall give the sixth part of an ephah of an homer of barley:

rr: 14 n'encuro y'amajuta eyaatairweho, kimwe kya ikumi ky'enjoga omuri buri kooru (kooru emwe erimu enjoga ikumi, nk'oku kiri omuri homeri emwe)
en: 14 concerning the ordinance of oil, the bath of oil, ye shall offer the tenth part of a bath out of the cor, which is an homer of ten baths; for ten baths are an homer:

15 and one lamb out of the flock, out of two hundred, out of the fat pastures of Israel; for a meat offering, and for a burnt offering, and for peace offerings, to make reconciliation for them, saith the Lord GOD .

rr: 16 Abantu b'omu nsi boona baryaha omugabe wa Israeli egyo mpongano.
en: 16 All the people of the land shall give this oblation for the prince in Israel.

17 And it shall be the prince's part to give burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and drink offerings, in the feasts, and in the new moons, and in the sabbaths, in all solemnities of the house of Israel: he shall prepare the sin offering, and the meat offering, and the burnt offering, and the peace offerings, to make reconciliation for the house of Israel.
18 Thus saith the Lord GOD ; In the first month , in the first day of the month, thou shalt take a young bullock without blemish, and cleanse the sanctuary:

19 and the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering, and put it upon the posts of the house, and upon the four corners of the settle of the altar, and upon the posts of the gate of the inner court.

rr: 20 Kandi oryatwaza otyo aha kiro kya mushanju eky'okwo kwezi ahabw'omuntu weena oshobize nari omushema; okwo nikwo muririhiirira hekalu.
en: 20 And so thou shalt do the seventh day of the month for every one that erreth, and for him that is simple: so shall ye reconcile the house.
21 In the first month , in the fourteenth day of the month, ye shall have the passover, a feast of seven days; unleavened bread shall be eaten.
22 And upon that day shall the prince prepare for himself and for all the people of the land a bullock for a sin offering.
23 And seven days of the feast he shall prepare a burnt offering to the LORD , seven bullocks and seven rams without blemish daily the seven days; and a kid of the goats daily for a sin offering.
24 And he shall prepare a meat offering of an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and an hin of oil for an ephah.

25 In the seventh month , in the fifteenth day of the month, shall he do the like in the feast of the seven days, according to the sin offering, according to the burnt offering, and according to the meat offering, and according to the oil.

1 Thus saith the Lord GOD ; The gate of the inner court that looketh toward the east shall be shut the six working days; but on the sabbath it shall be opened, and in the day of the new moon it shall be opened.

2 And the prince shall enter by the way of the porch of that gate without, and shall stand by the post of the gate, and the priests shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, and he shall worship at the threshold of the gate: then he shall go forth; but the gate shall not be shut until the evening.
3 Likewise the people of the land shall worship at the door of this gate before the LORD in the sabbaths and in the new moons.
4 And the burnt offering that the prince shall offer unto the LORD in the sabbath day shall be six lambs without blemish, and a ram without blemish.
5 And the meat offering shall be an ephah for a ram, and the meat offering for the lambs as he shall be able to give, and an hin of oil to an ephah.
6 And in the day of the new moon it shall be a young bullock without blemish, and six lambs, and a ram: they shall be without blemish.

rr: 7 kandi ahongye empongano y'esaano eefa emwe ahabwa buri nimi, eefa emwe ahabwa buri mpaya y'entaama, n'esaano nyingi ezi arikubaasa ahabw'abaana b'entaama, hamwe na hiini emwe y'amajuta ahabwa buri eefa y'esaano.
en: 7 And he shall prepare a meat offering, an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and for the lambs according as his hand shall attain unto, and an hin of oil to an ephah.

rr: 8 Omugabe ku ariba naataaha omuri hekalu, aryaguma arabe omu kisasi ky'eirembo; kandi n'omu kushohora, abe nimwo yaaraba.
en: 8 And when the prince shall enter, he shall go in by the way of the porch of that gate, and he shall go forth by the way thereof.

9 But when the people of the land shall come before the LORD in the solemn feasts, he that entereth in by the way of the north gate to worship shall go out by the way of the south gate; and he that entereth by the way of the south gate shall go forth by the way of the north gate: he shall not return by the way of the gate whereby he came in, but shall go forth over against it.

rr: 10 Ku baritaahamu, omugabe aryataahamu nabo; kandi ku barishohora, nawe aryashohora.
en: 10 And the prince in the midst of them, when they go in, shall go in; and when they go forth, shall go forth.

rr: 11 Omu biro by'amagyenyi n'omu biro bikuru ebyatairweho, empongano eryaguma ebi eefa emwe ahabwa buri nimi nto, na eefa emwe ahabwa buri mpaya y'entaama, n'ahabw'abaana b'entaama omuntu ahe esaano nyingi nk'oku arikubaasa, hamwe na hiini y'amajuta ahabwa buri eefa y'esaano.
en: 11 And in the feasts and in the solemnities the meat offering shall be an ephah to a bullock, and an ephah to a ram, and to the lambs as he is able to give, and an hin of oil to an ephah.

12 Now when the prince shall prepare a voluntary burnt offering or peace offerings voluntarily unto the LORD , one shall then open him the gate that looketh toward the east, and he shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, as he did on the sabbath day: then he shall go forth; and after his going forth one shall shut the gate.
13 Thou shalt daily prepare a burnt offering unto the LORD of a lamb of the first year without blemish: thou shalt prepare it every morning.

rr: 14 Kandi aryahonga n'empongano y'esaano buri kasheeshe kimwe kya mukaaga kya eefa emwe, na kimwe kya kashatu kya hiini y'amajuta g'okworobya egyo saano, kuba empongano y'esaano ehongyeirwe MUKAMA; ekyo nikyo kiragiro ky'ekitambo ky'okwotsya ekiriguma nikitambwa.
en: 14 And thou shalt prepare a meat offering for it every morning, the sixth part of an ephah, and the third part of an hin of oil, to temper with the fine flour; a meat offering continually by a perpetual ordinance unto the LORD .

rr: 15 Kandi okwo nikwo bariteebeekanisa omwana gw'entaama n'empongano y'esaano n'amajuta kuba ekitambo ky'okwotsya ekriguma nikitambwa.
en: 15 Thus shall they prepare the lamb, and the meat offering, and the oil, every morning for a continual burnt offering.

rr: 16 Oku nikwo Mukama RUHANGA arikugamba naagira ati: Omugabe ku ariiha ekiconco omu buhunguzi bwe, yaakiha omwe aha batabani, kiryaba eky'abatabani; omu biragiro by'obuhunguzi n'ekyabo.
en: 16 Thus saith the Lord GOD ; If the prince give a gift unto any of his sons, the inheritance thereof shall be his sons'; it shall be their possession by inheritance.
17 But if he give a gift of his inheritance to one of his servants, then it shall be his to the year of liberty; after it shall return to the prince: but his inheritance shall be his sons' for them.

18 Moreover the prince shall not take of the people's inheritance by oppression, to thrust them out of their possession; but he shall give his sons inheritance out of his own possession: that my people be not scattered every man from his possession.

rr: 19 Bwanyima yandabya aharikutaahirwa aha rubaju rw'eirembo, yampitsya aha mushorongo gw'ebishengye ebirikwera eby'abanyamurwa eby'aha bukiizi-bwa-bumosho; naareebayo omwanya oguri aha muheru gwabyo aha rubaju rw'oburengyerwa-izooba.
en: 19 After he brought me through the entry, which was at the side of the gate, into the holy chambers of the priests, which looked toward the north: and, behold, there was a place on the two sides westward.

20 Then said he unto me, This is the place where the priests shall boil the trespass offering and the sin offering, where they shall bake the meat offering; that they bear them not out into the utter court, to sanctify the people.

rr: 21 Bwanyima yantwara omu kibuga ky'aheeru, yampitsya aha nshonda ina zaakyo; ahari buri nshonda hakaba hariho ekibuga
en: 21 Then he brought me forth into the utter court, and caused me to pass by the four corners of the court; and, behold, in every corner of the court there was a court.

rr: 22 omuri ezo nshonda ina z'ekibuga hakaba hariho obubuga bukye, buri kamwe mikono makumi ana oburaingwa, n'obukiika mikono makumi ashatu, bwona buna nibwingaingana.
en: 22 In the four corners of the court there were courts joined of forty cubits long and thirty broad: these four corners were of one measure.

rr: 23 Omunda y'obwo bubuga bwona, hakaba hombekirwemu omushorongo okwehinguririza ogurimu emyanya y'okuteekyeramu embaju zoona.
en: 23 And there was a row of building round about in them, round about them four, and it was made with boiling places under the rows round about.
24 Then said he unto me, These are the places of them that boil, where the ministers of the house shall boil the sacrifice of the people.

1 Afterward he brought me again unto the door of the house; and, behold, waters issued out from under the threshold of the house eastward: for the forefront of the house stood toward the east, and the waters came down from under from the right side of the house, at the south side of the altar.

rr: 2 Atyo yanshohoreza omu irembo ry'aha bukiizi-bwa-bumosho, yanziguurutsya, yampitsya aha iremb ry'aheeru eririkureeba oburugwa-izooba; naashanga ago maizi nigashohorera aha rubaju rwayo rwa buryo.
en: 2 Then brought he me out of the way of the gate northward, and led me about the way without unto the utter gate by the way that looketh eastward; and, behold, there ran out waters on the right side.
3 And when the man that had the line in his hand went forth eastward, he measured a thousand cubits, and he brought me through the waters; the waters were to the ankles.

rr: 4 Yaagaruka yaagyera mikono rukumi, yaanyambutsya, naashanga nigahika omu maju.
en: 4 Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through the waters; the waters were to the knees.

rr: Yaagaruka yaagyera mikono rukumi, aho naashanga nigakwata omunda.
en: Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through; the waters were to the loins.

rr: 5 Yaagaruka yaagyera mikono rukumi; aho gwaba omugyera ogu ntarikubaasa kwambuka; ahabw'okuba maizi gakaba gaijwire, gari ag'okuziha, omugyera ogutarikwambukwa n'amaguru.
en: 5 Afterward he measured a thousand; and it was a river that I could not pass over: for the waters were risen, waters to swim in, a river that could not be passed over.

rr: 6 Yangira ati: Mwana w'omuntu, ekyo waakireeba?
en: 6 And he said unto me, Son of man, hast thou seen this? Then he brought me, and caused me to return to the brink of the river.
7 Now when I had returned, behold, at the bank of the river were very many trees on the one side and on the other.
8 Then said he unto me, These waters issue out toward the east country, and go down into the desert, and go into the sea: which being brought forth into the sea, the waters shall be healed.

rr: 9 Ei ogwo mugyera gurihika yoona, ebihuriire byona biryagira amagara; kandi haryabamu eby'enyanja bingi munonga, ahabw'okuba amaizi ago nigaza omu nyanja, ngu ago maizi g'enyanja gabe marungi; n'ahabw'ekyo ei ogwo mugyera gurihika yoona, buri kintu kiryagira amagara.
en: 9 And it shall come to pass, that every thing that liveth, which moveth, whithersoever the rivers shall come, shall live: and there shall be a very great multitude of fish, because these waters shall come thither: for they shall be healed; and every thing shall live whither the river cometh.

10 And it shall come to pass, that the fishers shall stand upon it from En-gedi even unto En-eglaim; they shall be a place to spread forth nets; their fish shall be according to their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, exceeding many.

rr: 11 Kwonka amaizi g'omu bisharara byayo n'ag'omu myanya yaayo yorutenga tigariba marungi; garyatsigwaho kwihwamu omwonyo.
en: 11 But the miry places thereof and the marishes thereof shall not be healed; they shall be given to salt.

12 And by the river upon the bank thereof, on this side and on that side, shall grow all trees for meat, whose leaf shall not fade, neither shall the fruit thereof be consumed: it shall bring forth new fruit according to his months, because their waters they issued out of the sanctuary: and the fruit thereof shall be for meat, and the leaf thereof for medicine.
13 Thus saith the Lord GOD ; This shall be the border, whereby ye shall inherit the land according to the twelve tribes of Israel: Joseph shall have two portions.
14 And ye shall inherit it, one as well as another: concerning the which I lifted up mine hand to give it unto your fathers: and this land shall fall unto you for inheritance.
15 And this shall be the border of the land toward the north side, from the great sea, the way of Hethlon, as men go to Zedad;

rr: 16 Berosa, Siburaimu eri aha mwatano ogurikutaanisa Damasiko na Hamasi, n'okuhika Hazeri-hatikooni aha mwatano gwa Hauraani.
en: 16 Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim, which is between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath; Hazar-hatticon, which is by the coast of Hauran.

rr: 17 Kandi omwatano guryaruga aha nyanja, guhikye Hazarenooni eri aha mwatano gwa Damasiko ogw'aha bukiizi-bwa-bumosho, gwatane n'ogwa Hamasi aha bukiizi-bwa-bumosho.
en: 17 And the border from the sea shall be Hazar-enan, the border of Damascus, and the north northward, and the border of Hamath.

rr: Ogwo nigwo guriba omwatano ogw'aha rubaju rw'obukiizi-bwa-bumosho.
en: And this is the north side.

rr: 18 Aha rubaju rw'oburugwa-izooba omwatano guryaruga Hazarenooni eri ahagati ya Hauraani na Damasiko, guryende aha rubaju rwa Yorudani ahagati ya Gileadi n'ensi ya Israeli, guhikye aha nyanja y'oburugwa-izooba, gugumizemu guhikye Tamari.
en: 18 And the east side ye shall measure from Hauran, and from Damascus, and from Gilead, and from the land of Israel by Jordan, from the border unto the east sea.

rr: Ogwo nigwo mwatano gw'oburugwa-izooba.
en: And this is the east side.

rr: 19 Aha bukiizi-bwa-buryo guryaruga Tamari, guhikye aha maizi ga Meribati-kadeshi, gurugyeyo gurabe aha rubaju rw'akagyera ka Misri, guhikye aha Nyanja empango.
en: 19 And the south side southward, from Tamar even to the waters of strife in Kadesh, the river to the great sea.

rr: Ogwo nigwo mwatano gw'aha bukiizi-bwa-buryo.
en: And this is the south side southward.

rr: 20 Aha rubaju rw'oburengyerwa-izooba Enyanja empango niyo eriba omwatano, okuhika ahashungaine n'ah'orikutaahira nooza Hamasi.
en: 20 The west side also shall be the great sea from the border, till a man come over against Hamath.

rr: Orwo nirwo ruriba orubaju rw'oburengyerwa-izooba.
en: This is the west side.

rr: 21 Okwo nikwo muribaganisa egyo nsi, nk'oku enganda za Israeli ziri.
en: 21 So shall ye divide this land unto you according to the tribes of Israel.

22 And it shall come to pass, that ye shall divide it by lot for an inheritance unto you, and to the strangers that sojourn among you, which shall beget children among you: and they shall be unto you as born in the country among the children of Israel; they shall have inheritance with you among the tribes of Israel.

rr: 23 Oruganda rwona oru omunyaihanga ariba atwiremu, mube nimwo mwamuha obuhunguzi; nikwo Mukama RUHANGA arikugira.
en: 23 And it shall come to pass, that in what tribe the stranger sojourneth, there shall ye give him his inheritance, saith the Lord GOD .

1 Now these are the names of the tribes. From the north end to the coast of the way of Hethlon, as one goeth to Hamath, Hazar-enan, the border of Damascus northward, to the coast of Hamath; for these are his sides east and west; a portion for Dan.

rr: 2 Ahaheereraine n'ekyanga kya Daani, okuruga oburugwa-izooba okuhika oburengyerwa-izooba, guryaba omugabo gwa Ashera.
en: 2 And by the border of Dan, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Asher.

rr: 3 Ahaheereraine n'ekyanga kya Ashera, okuruga oburugwa-izooba okuhika oburengyerwa-izooba guryaba omugabo gwa Nafutaali.
en: 3 And by the border of Asher, from the east side even unto the west side, a portion for Naphtali.
4 And by the border of Naphtali, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Manasseh.

rr: 5 Ahaheereraine n'ekyanga kya Manaase, okuruga oburugwa-izooba okuhika oburengyerwa-izooba, guryaba omugabo gwa Efuraimu.
en: 5 And by the border of Manasseh, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Ephraim.

rr: 6 Ahaheereraine n'ekyanga kya Efuraimu, okuruga oburugwa-izooba okuhika oburengyerwa-izooba guryaba omugabo gwa Reubeeni.
en: 6 And by the border of Ephraim, from the east side even unto the west side, a portion for Reuben.

rr: 7 Ahaheereraine n'ekyanga kya Reubeeni, okuruga oburugwa-izooba okuhika oburengyerwa-izooba, guryaba omugabo gwa Yuda.
en: 7 And by the border of Reuben, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Judah.

8 And by the border of Judah, from the east side unto the west side, shall be the offering which ye shall offer of five and twenty thousand reeds in breadth, and in length as one of the other parts, from the east side unto the west side: and the sanctuary shall be in the midst of it.

rr: 9 Ekicweka eki muriihiraho MUKAMA kiryaba mikono obukumi bubiri n'enkumi itaano oburaingwa, n'obukiika mikono obukumi bubiri.
en: 9 The oblation that ye shall offer unto the LORD shall be of five and twenty thousand in length, and of ten thousand in breadth.

10 And for them, even for the priests, shall be this holy oblation; toward the north five and twenty thousand in length , and toward the west ten thousand in breadth, and toward the east ten thousand in breadth, and toward the south five and twenty thousand in length: and the sanctuary of the LORD shall be in the midst thereof.
11 It shall be for the priests that are sanctified of the sons of Zadok; which have kept my charge, which went not astray when the children of Israel went astray, as the Levites went astray.

rr: 12 Guryaba omugabo gwabo ogu bacumiirwe ogwihirwe omuri ekyo kicweka ky'enki ekirikwera, ekiheereraine n'ekicweka ky'Abaleevi.
en: 12 And this oblation of the land that is offered shall be unto them a thing most holy by the border of the Levites.

13 And over against the border of the priests the Levites shall have five and twenty thousand in length, and ten thousand in breadth: all the length shall be five and twenty thousand, and the breadth ten thousand.
14 And they shall not sell of it, neither exchange, nor alienate the firstfruits of the land: for it is holy unto the LORD .

15 And the five thousand, that are left in the breadth over against the five and twenty thousand, shall be a profane place for the city, for dwelling, and for suburbs: and the city shall be in the midst thereof.

rr: 16 Kandi ezi nizo ngyero zaarwo; aha rubaju rw'aha bukiizi-bwa-bumohso ruryaba mikono enkumi ina na magana ataano; orw'aha bukiizi-bwa-buryo mikono enkumi ina na magana ataano; orw'oburugwa-izooba mikono enkumi ina na magana ataano; n'orw'oburengyerwa-izooba narwo mikono enkumi ina na magana ataano.
en: 16 And these shall be the measures thereof; the north side four thousand and five hundred, and the south side four thousand and five hundred, and on the east side four thousand and five hundred, and the west side four thousand and five hundred.

rr: 17 Kandi orurembo ruryagira ogwo mwanya gw'akataajuure, aha rubaju rw'obukiizi-bwa-bumohso mikono magana abiri na makumi ataano, aha rw'obukiizi-bwa-buryo mikono magana abiri na makumi ataano, aha rw'oburugwa-izooba mikono magana abiri na amkumi ataano, naha buryengyerwa-izooba naho mikono magana abiri na makumi ataano.
en: 17 And the suburbs of the city shall be toward the north two hundred and fifty, and toward the south two hundred and fifty, and toward the east two hundred and fifty, and toward the west two hundred and fifty.

rr: 18 Ekicweka ekiritsigaraho, ekiheereraine n'ekicweka ky'omugabo ogurikwera, kiryaba mikono kakumi aha rubaju rw'orurembo orw'oburugwa-izooba, kandi mikono kakumi aha rubaju rwarwo orw'oburengyerwa-izooba; hoona haheererane n'ekyo kicweka ekirikwera. Kandi emyaka yaaho eryaguma ebe eby'okurya by'abakozi b'omu rurembo.
en: 18 And the residue in length over against the oblation of the holy portion shall be ten thousand eastward, and ten thousand westward: and it shall be over against the oblation of the holy portion ; and the increase thereof shall be for food unto them that serve the city.

rr: 19 Abakozi b'omu rurembo, abarikuruga omu nganda zoona eza Israeli, nibo bariguma nibahahinga.
en: 19 And they that serve the city shall serve it out of all the tribes of Israel.
20 All the oblation shall be five and twenty thousand by five and twenty thousand: ye shall offer the holy oblation foursquare, with the possession of the city.

21 And the residue shall be for the prince, on the one side and on the other of the holy oblation, and of the possession of the city, over against the five and twenty thousand of the oblation toward the east border, and westward over against the five and twenty thousand toward the west border, over against the portions for the prince: and it shall be the holy oblation; and the sanctuary of the house shall be in the midst thereof.

rr: 22 hamwe n'omwanya gw'orurembo, guryaba ahagati y'ekynaga ky'omugabe. Ekyo kyanga kirayaba ahagati y'omugabo gwa Yuda n'ogwa Benyamiini.
en: 22 Moreover from the possession of the Levites, and from the possession of the city, being in the midst of that which is the prince's, between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin, shall be for the prince.

rr: 23 Kandi eby'ezindi nganda, okuruga oburugwa-izooba okuhika oburengyerwa-izooba, guryaba omugabo gwa Benyamiini.
en: 23 As for the rest of the tribes, from the east side unto the west side, Benjamin shall have a portion .

rr: 24 Ahaheereraine n'ekyanga kya Benyamiini okuruga oburugwa-izooba okuhika oburengyerwa-izooba guryaba omugabo gwa Simeoni.
en: 24 And by the border of Benjamin, from the east side unto the west side, Simeon shall have a portion .

rr: 25 Ahaheereraine n'ekyanga kya Simeoni, okuruga oburugwa-izooba okuhika oburengyerwa-izooba, guryaba omugabo gwa Isakaari.
en: 25 And by the border of Simeon, from the east side unto the west side, Issachar a portion .

rr: 26 Ahaheereraine n'ekyanga kya Isakaari, okuruga oburugwa-izooba okuhika oburengyerwa-izooba, guryaba ekyanga kya Zebuluuni.
en: 26 And by the border of Issachar, from the east side unto the west side, Zebulun a portion .

rr: 27 Ahaheereraine n'ekyanga kya Zebuluuni, okuruga aha burugwa-izooba okuhika oburengyerwa-izooba, guryaba omugabo gwa Gaadi.
en: 27 And by the border of Zebulun, from the east side unto the west side, Gad a portion .

rr: 28 Ahaheereraine n'ekyanga kya Gaadi aha rubaju rw'obukiizi-bwa-buryo, omwatano guryaruga Tamari, guhikye aha maizi ga Meribati-kadeshi, gugumizemu gurabe aha rubaju rw'akagyera ka Misri, guhikye aha Nyanga empango.
en: 28 And by the border of Gad, at the south side southward, the border shall be even from Tamar unto the waters of strife in Kadesh, and to the river toward the great sea.
29 This is the land which ye shall divide by lot unto the tribes of Israel for inheritance, and these are their portions, saith the Lord GOD .

rr: 30 Kandi aga nigo gariba amarembo g'orurembo; aha rubaju rw'obukiizi-bwa-bumosho orwa mikono enkumi ina na magana ataano
en: 30 And these are the goings out of the city on the north side, four thousand and five hundred measures.
31 And the gates of the city shall be after the names of the tribes of Israel: three gates northward; one gate of Reuben, one gate of Judah, one gate of Levi.

rr: 32 Aha rubaju rw'oburugwa-izooba, orwa mikono enkumi ina na magana ataano, amarembo ashatu, erya Yosefu, erya Benyamiini, n'erya Daani
en: 32 And at the east side four thousand and five hundred: and three gates; and one gate of Joseph, one gate of Benjamin, one gate of Dan.

rr: 33 aha rubaju rw'obukiizi-bwa-buryo, orwa mikono enkumi ina na magana ataano, erya Simeoni, erya Isakaari n'erya Zebuluuni
en: 33 And at the south side four thousand and five hundred measures: and three gates; one gate of Simeon, one gate of Issachar, one gate of Zebulun.

rr: 34 n'aha rubaju rw'oburengyerwa-izooba, orwa mikono enkumi ina na magana ataano, narwo amarembo ashatu, erya Gaadi, erya Asheri n'erya Nafutaali.
en: 34 At the west side four thousand and five hundred, with their three gates; one gate of Gad, one gate of Asher, one gate of Naphtali.
35 It was round about eighteen thousand measures: and the name of the city from that day shall be , The LORD is there.

rr: Omu mwaka gw'okubanza ogw'omu busingye bwa Kuuro omugabe wa Perisi, MUKAMA akakora aha mutima gwa Kuuro ogwo, ngu ekigambo kye ekyagambirwe Yeremia kihikiirire, yaaragiira kuranga ebigambo ebi omu bugabe bwe bwona, kandi n'okubihandiika, naagira ati
en: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the LORD by the mouth of Jeremiah might be fulfilled, the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,

rr: Oku nikwo Kuuro omugabe wa Perisi arikugamba naagira ati: MUKAMA, Ruhanga w'eiguru, ampaire obugabe bwona obw'omu nsi, kandi anyehanangiriize kumwombekyera enju omuri Yerusaalemu ey'omuri Yuda.
en: Thus saith Cyrus king of Persia, The LORD God of heaven hath given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he hath charged me to build him an house at Jerusalem, which is in Judah.

rr: Mbwenu omuntu weena omuriimwe ow'omu bantu be, Ruhanga we agume nawe, ainamukye Yerusaalemu ey'omuri Yuda, ayombekye enju ya MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa Israeli, (niwe Ruhanga otuura omuri Yerusaalemu)
en: Who is there among you of all his people? his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and build the house of the LORD God of Israel, (he is the God,) which is in Jerusalem.

rr: kandi omuntu weena owaahonokireho, ori ei yaashuhuukiire, abantu baayo bamuhwere n'efeeza n'ezaabu, kandi n'ebintu n'amatungo, otabariireho mitoijo ahabw'enju ya Ruhanga ey'omuri Yerusaalemu, ei barikureeta n'omutima gwekundiire.
en: And whosoever remaineth in any place where he sojourneth, let the men of his place help him with silver, and with gold, and with goods, and with beasts, beside the freewill offering for the house of God that is in Jerusalem.

rr: Ahonaaho abakuru b'amaju ga baishenkuru b'Abayuda n'ab'Ababenyamiini baimuka n'abanyamurwa n'Abaleevi, hamwe na'abandi boona, abu Ruhanga yaakozire aha mutima kwinamuka kuza kwombeka enju ya MUKAMA ey'omuri Yerusaalemu
en: Then rose up the chief of the fathers of Judah and Benjamin, and the priests, and the Levites, with all them whose spirit God had raised, to go up to build the house of the LORD which is in Jerusalem.

rr: kandi abaabaire batwire nabo baabatwera ebintu by'efeeza, n'ezaabu n'ebindi bintu n'amatungo, n'ebintu by'obuguzi bwingi, otabariireho ebindi byona ebi baatoizire n'omutima gwekundiire.
en: And all they that were about them strengthened their hands with vessels of silver, with gold, with goods, and with beasts, and with precious things, beside all that was willingly offered.

rr: Kandi omugabe Kuuro yaashohoza ebintu by'enju ya MUKAMA, ebi Nebukadeneeza yaabaire anyagire Yerusaalemu, akata omu nju ya baaruhanga be.
en: Also Cyrus the king brought forth the vessels of the house of the LORD , which Nebuchadnezzar had brought forth out of Jerusalem, and had put them in the house of his gods;

rr: Kuuro omugabe wa Perisi yaaragiira Misiredaasi omubiiki kubiihamu, akabibarira Sheshebazaari omunyiginya wa Yuda.
en: even those did Cyrus king of Persia bring forth by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer, and numbered them unto Sheshbazzar, the prince of Judah.

rr: Kandi ogu nigwo mubaro gwabyo: eshohaani z'ezaabu makumi ashatu, n'ez'efeeza rukumi, ebyoterero makumi abiri na mwenda
en: And this is the number of them: thirty chargers of gold, a thousand chargers of silver, nine and twenty knives,

rr: enyabya z'ezaabu makumi ashatu, n'ez'efeeza enkumi ibiri na magana ana na ikumi, n'ebindi bintu ebirikukoresibwa rukumi
en: thirty basons of gold, silver basons of a second sort four hundred and ten, and other vessels a thousand.

rr: ebintu byona eby'ezaabu n'efeeza bikaba biri enkumi itaano na magana ana na makumi mukaaga na mwenda.
en: All the vessels of gold and of silver were five thousand and four hundred.

rr: Ebyo byona Sheshebazaari akabinamukama, obu enkwatwa zaihwa Babulooni kugarurwa Yerusaalemu.
en: All these did Sheshbazzar bring up with them of the captivity that were brought up from Babylon unto Jerusalem.

rr: Currently Selected: Ezera 1 : RR64 Highlight Share <path fill-rule="evenodd
en: Currently Selected: Ezra 1 : KJV Highlight Share <div class="flex w-full items-center gap-1 rtl:flex-row-reverse h

rr: Aba nibo bantu b'eryo ihanga abaarugire omu bantu abu Nebukadeneeza omugabe wa Babulooni yaatwaire Babulooni bari enkwatwa, bakagaruka Yerusaalemu na Yuda, buri muntu omu rurembo rw'owaabo. 2 -16 ; 25
en: Now these are the children of the province that went up out of the captivity, of those which had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away unto Babylon, and came again unto Jerusalem and Judah, every one unto his city;

rr: Bakaija na Zerubabeeli, Yeshua, Nehemia, Seraaya, Relaaya, Morodekai, Bilushaani, Misipaari, Biguvai, Rehumu na Baana.
en: which came with Zerubbabel: Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mizpar, Bigvai, Rehum, Baanah.

rr: Omubaro gw'abashaija b'Abaisraeli nigwo ogu
en: The number of the men of the people of Israel:

rr: beene Paroshi enkumi ibiri na igana na makumi mushanju na babiri.
en: the children of Parosh, two thousand an hundred seventy and two.

rr: Beene Shefatia, magana ashatu na makumi mushanju na babiri
en: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred seventy and two.

rr: Beene Aara, magana mushanju na makumi mushanju na bataano.
en: The children of Arah, seven hundred seventy and five.

rr: Beene Pahasimoabu, nibo beene Yeshua na Yoabu, enkumi ibiri na magana munaana na ikumi na babiri.
en: The children of Pahath-moab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand eight hundred and twelve.

rr: Beene Elamu, rukumi na magana abiri na makumi ataano na bana.
en: The children of Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.

rr: Beene Zaatu, magana mwenda na makumi ana na bataano.
en: The children of Zattu, nine hundred forty and five.

rr: Beene Zakai, magana mushanju na makumi mukaaga.
en: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred and threescore.

rr: Beene Baani, magana mukaaga na makumi ana na babiri.
en: The children of Bani, six hundred forty and two.

rr: Beene Bebai, magana mukaaga na makumi abiri na bashatu.
en: The children of Bebai, six hundred twenty and three.

rr: Beene Azigaadi, rukumi na magana abiri na makumi abiri na babiri.
en: The children of Azgad, a thousand two hundred twenty and two.

rr: Beene Adonikaamu, magana mukaaga na makumi mukaaga na mukaaga.
en: The children of Adonikam, six hundred sixty and six.

rr: Beene Biguvai, enkumi ibiri na makumi ataano na mukaaga.
en: The children of Bigvai, two thousand fifty and six.

rr: Beene Adini, maganaana na makumi ataano na bana.
en: The children of Adin, four hundred fifty and four.

rr: Beene Ateeri, nibo ba Hezekia, makumi mwenda na munaana.
en: The children of Ater of Hezekiah, ninety and eight.

rr: Beene Bezai, magana ashatu na makumi abiri na bashatu.
en: The children of Bezai, three hundred twenty and three.

rr: Beene Yoora, igana na ikumi na babiri.
en: The children of Jorah, an hundred and twelve.

rr: Beene Hashumu, magana abiri na bashatu.
en: The children of Hashum, two hundred twenty and three.

rr: Beene Gibaari makumi mwenda na bataano.
en: The children of Gibbar, ninety and five.

rr: Beene Betelehemu, igana na makumi abiri na bashatu.
en: The children of Beth-lehem, an hundred twenty and three.

rr: Abashaija ba Netofa, makumi ataano na mukaaga.
en: The men of Netophah, fifty and six.

rr: Abashaija ba Anatoosi, igana na makumi abiri na munaana.
en: The men of Anathoth, an hundred twenty and eight.

rr: Beene Azimaveesi, makumi ana na babiri.
en: The children of Azmaveth, forty and two.

rr: Beene Kiryasarimu, Kefira na Beeroosi, magana mushanju na makumi ana na bashatu.
en: The children of Kirjath-arim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred and forty and three.

rr: Beene Raama na Geeba, magana mukaaga na makumi abiri n'omwe.
en: The children of Ramah and Gaba, six hundred twenty and one.

rr: Abashaija ba Mikimaasi, igana na makumi abiri na babiri.
en: The men of Michmas, an hundred twenty and two.

rr: Abashaija ba Beseeli na Ai, magana abiri na makumi abiri na bashatu.
en: The men of Beth-el and Ai, two hundred twenty and three.

rr: Beene Neebo, makumi ataano na babiri.
en: The children of Nebo, fifty and two.

rr: Beene Magibihsi, igana na makumi ataano na mukaaga.
en: The children of Magbish, an hundred fifty and six.

rr: Beene Elamu ondiijo, rukumi na magana abiri na makumi ataano na bana.
en: The children of the other Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.

rr: Beene Harimu, magana ashatu na makumi abiri.
en: The children of Harim, three hundred and twenty.

rr: Beene Loodi, Hadidi na Ono, magana mushanju na makumi abiri na bataano.
en: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred twenty and five.

rr: Beene Yeriko, magana ashatu na makumi ana na bataano.
en: The children of Jericho, three hundred forty and five.

rr: Beene Senaha, enkumi ishatu na magana mukaaga na makumi ashatu.
en: The children of Senaah, three thousand and six hundred and thirty.

rr: Abanyamurwa n'aba: beene Yedaaya ab'omu nju ya Yeshua, magana mwenda na makumi mushanju na bashatu.
en: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy and three.

rr: Beene Imeri, rukumi na magana ataano na babiri.
en: The children of Immer, a thousand fifty and two.

rr: Beene Peshihuuri, rukumi na magana abiri na makumi ana na mushanju.
en: The children of Pashur, a thousand two hundred forty and seven.

rr: Beene Harimu, rukumi na ikumi na mushanju.
en: The children of Harim, a thousand and seventeen.

rr: Abaleevi n'aba: beene Yeshua na Kadimieli ab'omuri beene Hodavia, makumi mushanju na bana.
en: The Levites: the children of Jeshua and Kadmiel, of the children of Hodaviah, seventy and four.

rr: Abeeshongozi, beene Asafu igana na makumi abiri na munaana.
en: The singers: the children of Asaph, an hundred twenty and eight.

rr: Batabani b'abakumiirizi, beene Shalumu, Ateeri, Talumooni, Akubu, Hatita na Shobai, boona igana na makumi ashatu na mwenda.
en: The children of the porters: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, in all an hundred thirty and nine.

rr: Abaheereza b'omuri hekalu bakaba bari aba: beene Ziiha, beene Hasufa, beene Tabaosi
en: The Nethinims: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,

rr: beene Kerosi, beene Siaha, beene Padoni
en: the children of Keros, the children of Siaha, the children of Padon,

rr: beene Lebana, beene Hagaba, beene Akubu
en: the children of Lebanah, the children of Hagabah, the children of Akkub,

rr: beene Hagabu, beene Shamulai, beene Hanani
en: the children of Hagab, the children of Shalmai, the children of Hanan,

rr: beene Gideli, beene Gahaari, beene Reaya
en: the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar, the children of Reaiah,

rr: beene Rezini, beene Nekoda, beene Gazamu
en: the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda, the children of Gazzam,

rr: beene Uzza, beene Pasea, beene Besai
en: the children of Uzza, the children of Paseah, the children of Besai,

rr: beene Asina, beene Meunimu, beene Nefisimu
en: the children of Asnah, the children of Mehunim, the children of Nephusim,

rr: beene Bakibuki, beene Hakufa, beene Harihuri
en: the children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,

rr: beene Baziluusi, beene Mehida, beene Harisha
en: the children of Bazluth, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,

rr: beene Barikoosi, beene Sisera, beene Teema
en: the children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Thamah,

rr: beene Nezia na beene hatifa.
en: the children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.

rr: Batabani b'abagaragwa ba Sulemaani: beene Sotai, beene Hasoferesi, beene Peruda
en: The children of Solomon's servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Peruda,

rr: beene Yaala, beene Darikoni, beene Gideli
en: the children of Jaalah, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,

rr: beene Shefatia, beene Hatili, beene Pokeresi-hazebaimu na beene Ami.
en: the children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth of Zebaim, the children of Ami.

rr: Abaheereza b'omuri hekalu boona na batabani b'abagaragwa ba Sulemaani bakaba bari magana ashatu na makumi mwenda na babiri.
en: All the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon's servants, were three hundred ninety and two.

rr: Kandi aba nibo barugire Telimeela, Teliharasha, Kerubu, Adani na Imeri, kwonka tibaarabaasize kworeka amaju ga baishenkurubo, nari obukomooko bwabo, kuhamya ku bari Abaisraeli buzima
en: And these were they which went up from Tel-melah, Tel-harsa, Cherub, Addan, and Immer: but they could not shew their father's house, and their seed, whether they were of Israel:

rr: beene Delaaya, beene Tobia, na beene Nakoda, magana mukaaga na makumi ataano na babiri.
en: the children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred fifty and two.

rr: Kandi ab'omuri batabani ba'abanyamurwa, beene Habaaya, beene Hakozi, na beene Baruzilai, owaashweire omukazi ow'omuri bahara ba Baruzilai owa Gileadi, akeetererwa eiziina ryabo.
en: And of the children of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Koz, the children of Barzillai; which took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name:

rr: Abo bakasherura amaziina gaabo omu baahandiikirwe nk'okukuratana kw'oruzaaro rwa baishenkurubo oku kwabaire kuri, kwonka tigaareebekamu; nikyo baateekateekyeirwe kuba abatashemeire, bakazibirwa kukora omurimo gw'obunyamurwa
en: these sought their register among those that were reckoned by genealogy, but they were not found: therefore were they, as polluted, put from the priesthood.

rr: omutegyeki omukuru yaabaragiira ngu barekye kurya aha by'okurya ebirikwera, okuhitsya obu haribaho omunyamurwa oine Urimu na Tumimu.
en: And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and with Thummim.

rr: Omutwe gw'abo bantu boona gukaba guri obukumi buna n'enkumi ibiri na magana ashatu na makumi mukaaga
en: The whole congregation together was forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore,

rr: otabariiremu bahuuku baabo n'abazaana baabo, abu omubaro gwabo gwabaire guri enkumi mushanju na magana ashatu na makumi ashatu na mushanju; kandi bakaba baine abeeshongozi, abashaija n'abakazi, magana abiri.
en: beside their servants and their maids, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven: and there were among them two hundred singing men and singing women.

rr: Embaraasi zaabo zikaba ziri magana mushanju na makumi ashatu na mukaaga, enyumbu magana abiri na makumi ana na itaano
en: Their horses were seven hundred thirty and six; their mules, two hundred forty and five;

rr: engamira magana ana na mkumi ashatu na itaano, n'endogoya enkumi mukaaga na magana mushanju na makumi abiri.
en: their camels, four hundred thirty and five; their asses, six thousand seven hundred and twenty.

rr: Kandi bamwe ab'omu bakuru b'amaju ga baishenkurubo, ku baahikire aha nju ya MUKAMA ey'omuri Yerusaalemu baahonga empongano n'omutima gwekundiire ahabw'okwombeka enju ya Ruhanga omu kibanja kyayo
en: And some of the chief of the fathers, when they came to the house of the LORD which is at Jerusalem, offered freely for the house of God to set it up in his place:

rr: baahayo ebiconco nk'oku barikubaasa, nibabita omu ibiikiro ry'empiiha z'omurimo, dariki z'ezaabu obukumi mukaaga na rukumi, na miina z'efeeza enkumi itaano, n'ebijwaro by'abanyamurwa igana.
en: they gave after their ability unto the treasure of the work threescore and one thousand drams of gold, and five thousand pound of silver, and one hundred priests' garments.

rr: Kandi abanyamurwa n'Abaleevi na bamwe omu bantu, n'abeeshongozi n'abakumiirizi kandi n'abaheereza b'omuri hekalu batuura omu ndembo zaabo, n'Abaisraeli boona baatuura omu zaabo.
en: So the priests, and the Levites, and some of the people, and the singers, and the porters, and the Nethinims, dwelt in their cities, and all Israel in their cities.

rr: Currently Selected: Ezera 2 : RR64 Highlight Share <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="even
Okwezi kwa mushanju ku kwabonekire, Abaisraeli bari omu ndembo zaabo, abantu baayeteeranira Yerusaalemu nk'omuntu omwe.
en: And when the seventh month was come, and the children of Israel were in the cities, the people gathered themselves together as one man to Jerusalem.

rr: 1 -19 ; . Ku baahikireyo, Yeshua mwene Yozadaaki yaimuka na beene ishe abanyamurwa, na Zerubabeeli mwene Shealutieli na beene waabo, baayombeka eitambiro rya Ruhanga wa Israeli kutambiraho ebitambo by'okwotsya, nk'oku kihandiikirwe omu biragiro bya Musa omushaija wa Ruhanga.
en: Then stood up Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren the priests, and Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and his brethren, and builded the altar of the God of Israel, to offer burnt offerings thereon, as it is written in the law of Moses the man of God.

rr: Baata eryo itambiro omu mwanya gwaryo, ahabw'okuba bakaba baine obwoba ahabw'abantu b'omuri ezo nsi, baaritambiriraho MUKAMA ebitambo by'okwotsya, omu kasheeshe n'omu mwabazyo.
en: And they set the altar upon his bases; for fear was upon them because of the people of those countries: and they offered burnt offerings thereon unto the LORD , even burnt offerings morning and evening.

rr: -38 ; -17 ; . Kandi baijuka obugyenyi bwe'ebiro bikuru obw'Ensiisira, nk'oku kuhandiikirwe, baatamba ebitambo bya buri izooba, nk'omubaro gwabyo oku gwabaire guri, nibakuratira ekiragiro kya buri izooba
en: They kept also the feast of tabernacles, as it is written, and offered the daily burnt offerings by number, according to the custom, as the duty of every day required;

rr: -15 ; 29:39 . bwanyima baahayo ebitambo by'okwotsya eby'obutoosha, n'eby'okuboneka kw'ameezi, n'eby'amagyenyi ga MUKAMA goona agaatairweho, hamwe n'empongano z'omuntu weena owaahongyeire MUKAMA n'omutima gwekundiire.
en: and afterward offered the continual burnt offering, both of the new moons, and of all the set feasts of the LORD that were consecrated, and of every one that willingly offered a freewill offering unto the LORD .

rr: Aha izooba ry'okubanza ery'okwezi kwa mushanju niho baatandiikire kutambira MUKAMA ebitambo by'okwotsya.
en: From the first day of the seventh month began they to offer burnt offerings unto the LORD .

rr: Kwonka omusingi gwa hekalu ya MUKAMA gukaba gutakatairweho.
en: But the foundation of the temple of the LORD was not yet laid.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo baaha abombeki n'ababaizi empiiha, kandi baaha Abasidoni n'Abatuuro eby'okurya n'eby'okunywa n'amajuta, ngu bareete emiti y'emyerezi, kugiiha Lebanooni bakagireeta aha nyanja, bakagihitsya Yoopa, nk'oku Kuuro omugabe wa Perisi yaabaikiriize.
en: They gave money also unto the masons, and to the carpenters; and meat, and drink, and oil, unto them of Zidon, and to them of Tyre, to bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea of Joppa, according to the grant that they had of Cyrus king of Persia.

rr: Okutaho omusingi gwa hekalu
en: Rebuilding the Temple
