rr: Omu mwaka gwa kabiri baherize kuhika aha nju ya Ruhaga omuri Yerusaalemu, omu kwezi kwa kabiri, nibwo Zerubabeeli mwene Shealutieli na Yeshua mwene Yozadaaki baatandika kwombeka, nibakwatanisa na beene waabo abandi, abanyamurwa n'Abaleevi n'abaarugire omu bukwatwa boona, bakaija Yerusaalemu. Baataho Abaleevi abaine emyaka makumi abiri n'okukiraho okureeberera omurimo gw'enju ya MUKAMA.
en: Now in the second year of their coming unto the house of God at Jerusalem, in the second month, began Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and the remnant of their brethren the priests and the Levites, and all they that were come out of the captivity unto Jerusalem; and appointed the Levites, from twenty years old and upward, to set forward the work of the house of the LORD .

rr: Yeshua n'abatabani na beene waabo baimuka na Kadumieli n'abatabani beene Yuda kukoresa abakozi abarikukora enju ya Ruhanga nibakwatanisa na beene Henadaadi na beene waabo Abaleevi.
en: Then stood Jeshua with his sons and his brethren, Kadmiel and his sons, the sons of Judah, together, to set forward the workmen in the house of God: the sons of Henadad, with their sons and their brethren the Levites.

rr: 1 -6 ; 25:1 , Abomeki ku baataireho omusingi gwa hekalu ya MUKAMA, abanyamurwa baija bajwaire ebijwaro byabo baine amakondere, n'Abaleevi beene Asafu baija n'ebitaasa, kuhimbisa MUKAMA, nk'oku Daudi omugabe wa Israeli yaaragiire
en: And when the builders laid the foundation of the temple of the LORD , they set the priests in their apparel with trumpets, and the Levites the sons of Asaph with cymbals, to praise the LORD , after the ordinance of David king of Israel.

rr: baayeshongora nibaikirizana, nibahimbisa MUKAMA kandi nibamusiima bati: Ahakuba ni murungi, Kandi embabazi ze n'ez'ebiro byona ahari Israeli.
en: And they sang together by course in praising and giving thanks unto the LORD ; because he is good, for his mercy endureth for ever toward Israel.

rr: Ku baabaire nibahimbisa MUKAMA, abantu boona baateera akaari n'amaraka mahango, ahabw'okuheza kutaho omusingi gw'enju ya MUKAMA.
en: And all the people shouted with a great shout, when they praised the LORD , because the foundation of the house of the LORD was laid.

rr: Kwonka baingi omu banyamurwa n'Abaleevi n'abakuru b'amaju ga baishenkurubo, abagurusi abaareebire enju y'okubanza, ku baareebire omusingi gw'enju gwaheza kuteebwaho, baarira nibaborooga munonga, n'obu abandi baraabe baabaire nibateera akaari ahabw'okushemererwa
en: But many of the priests and Levites and chief of the fathers, who were ancient men, that had seen the first house, when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes, wept with a loud voice; and many shouted aloud for joy:

rr: kyareetera abantu kutabaasa kutaanisa amaraka, yaaba gari ag'okushemererwa nari ag'okucura; ahakuba abantu bakaba nibayomba munonga, n'orwari rwabo niruhuririrwa hare.
en: so that the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the weeping of the people: for the people shouted with a loud shout, and the noise was heard afar off.

rr: Bwanyima abazigu b'Abayuda n'Ababenyamiini ku baahuriire ngu abaarugire omu bukwatwa nibombekyera MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa Israeli, hekalu
en: Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity builded the temple unto the LORD God of Israel;

rr: baija ahari Zerubabeeli n'abakuru b'amaju ga baishenkurubo, baabagira bati: Ka twombekye hamwe naimwe; ahakuba naitwe turamya Ruhanga waanyu, nk'oku mumuranya, kandi tutuura nitumutambira ebitambo, okuruga omu busingye bwa Esari-hadoni, omugabe wa Asiria owaatureetsire aha.
en: then they came to Zerubbabel, and to the chief of the fathers, and said unto them, Let us build with you: for we seek your God, as ye do ; and we do sacrifice unto him since the days of Esarhaddon king of Assur, which brought us up hither.

rr: -3 ; . Kwonka Zerubabeeli na Yeshua n'abandi bakuru b'amaju ga baishenkuru b'Abaisraeli baabagarukamu bati: Timwine kakwate naitwe kwombekyera Ruhanga waitu enju; kureka itwe twenka nitwija kwombekyera MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa Israeli, nk'oku Nyakusinga Kuuro omugabe wa Perisi yaaturagiire.
en: But Zerubbabel, and Jeshua, and the rest of the chief of the fathers of Israel, said unto them, Ye have nothing to do with us to build an house unto our God; but we ourselves together will build unto the LORD God of Israel, as king Cyrus the king of Persia hath commanded us.

rr: Bwanyima abantu b'omuri egyo nsi baateera Abayuda aha mutwe, baabatiinisa kwombeka
en: Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah, and troubled them in building,

rr: baaguriirira abahi b'obwengye kubazibira kuhikiiriza eki barikwenda kukora; byaguma bityo omu busingye bwa Kuuro omugabe wa Perisi bwona okuhitsya omu busingye bwa Dario omugabe wa Perisi.
en: and hired counsellors against them, to frustrate their purpose, all the days of Cyrus king of Persia, even until the reign of Darius king of Persia.

rr: Kandi omu busingye bwa Ahasuero, ku yaabaire naakitandika, baahandiika ebaruha nibarega abatuuzi ba Yuda na Yerusaalemu.
en: And in the reign of Ahasuerus, in the beginning of his reign, wrote they unto him an accusation against the inhabitants of Judah and Jerusalem.

rr: Bwanyima omu busingye bwa Aruta-gizakiseeski, Bishulaamu, Mesiredaasi, abeeli na bagyenzi baabo abandi baahandiikira Aruta-gizakiseesi omugabe wa Perisi; egyo baruha baagihandiika omu rurimi rwa Siria, kandi baagihindura.
en: And in the days of Artaxerxes wrote Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and the rest of their companions, unto Artaxerxes king of Persia; and the writing of the letter was written in the Syrian tongue, and interpreted in the Syrian tongue.

rr: Rehumu omutegyeki na Shimushai omuhandiiki nabo baahandiikira Aruta-gizakiseesi ebaruha nibarega Yerusaalemu ni bagira bati
en: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king in this sort:

rr: Ebaruha ya Rehumu omutegyeki na Shimushai omuhandiiki na bagyenzi baabo abandi, n'abaramuzi, n'abategyeki, n'abatware, n'Abaperisi, n'aba Suusa nibo Baelami
en: then wrote Rehum the chancellor, and Shimshai the scribe, and the rest of their companions; the Dinaites, the Apharsathchites, the Tarpelites, the Apharsites, the Archevites, the Babylonians, the Susanchites, the Dehavites, and the Elamites,

rr: n'ab'amahanga agandi abu osinapaari omutegyeki omukuru rugambwa yaihire owaabo, akabata omu ndembo za Samaria, n'omu byaro ebindi ebiri omu nsi seeri y'Omugyera n'ebindi
en: and the rest of the nations whom the great and noble Asnapper brought over, and set in the cities of Samaria, and the rest that are on this side the river, and at such a time.

rr: (ebi nibyo bigambo by'ebaruha ei baatwekire;) Nyakusinga Omugabe Aruta-gizakiseesi, itwe abairu baawe ab'omu nsi ya seeri y'Omugyera nitukuramutsya.
en: This is the copy of the letter that they sent unto him, even unto Artaxerxes the king; Thy servants the men on this side the river, and at such a time.

rr: Mbwenu Nyakusinga omugabe, omanye Abayuda, abaarugire okwo, bakaija kunu Yerusaalemu, orurembo orugomi kandi orubi; mbwenu nibarwombeka, kandi baaherize engo z'amabaare n'omusingi.
en: Be it known unto the king, that the Jews which came up from thee to us are come unto Jerusalem, building the rebellious and the bad city, and have set up the walls thereof , and joined the foundations.

rr: Mbwenu Nyakusinga, omanye ngu, ku baraayombekye oru rurembo, baaheza n'engo zaarwo, tibarikutoijera, n'obu kwakuba okuha omushoro n'ehoozi; ekirirugamu empiiha z'obugabe ziryatuuba.
en: Be it known now unto the king, that, if this city be builded, and the walls set up again, then will they not pay toll, tribute, and custom, and so thou shalt endamage the revenue of the kings.

rr: Mbwenu ahabw'okuba tutungirwe obugabe, kandi n'ahabw'okutenda kureeba omugabe naihwaho ekitiinisa, nikyo twakutumiraho kukumanyisa
en: Now because we have maintenance from the king's palace, and it was not meet for us to see the king's dishonour, therefore have we sent and certified the king;

rr: ngu basherure omu kitabo ekirikwijutsya ebyabaireho omu busingye bwa baashwenkru. Ebyo noija kubishanga omuri ekyo kitabo, omanye ku orurembo oru ruba orugomi, orunyangaraza abagabe n'ensi zaabo, kandi okuruga ira ku rushangwa rugomesa abantu. Ekyo nikyo kyarureeteire kucwekyerezibwa.
en: that search may be made in the book of the records of thy fathers: so shalt thou find in the book of the records, and know that this city is a rebellious city, and hurtful unto kings and provinces, and that they have moved sedition within the same of old time: for which cause was this city destroyed.

rr: Nitumanyisa omugabe ngu, oru rurembo ku ruraayombekwe, engo zaarwo zaahwa, noija kubura eki waatunga omu nsi egi eya seeri y'Omugyera. Omugabe okuragiira kuba barekire kwombeka
en: We certify the king that, if this city be builded again , and the walls thereof set up, by this means thou shalt have no portion on this side the river.

rr: Omugabe yaatuma ahari Rehumu omutegyeki na Shimushai omuhandiiki na bagyenzi baabo abandi abaabaire batwire Samaria n'omu bindi byanga by'ensi eya seeri y'Omugyera, yaabagarukamu naagira ati: Muri buhooro, n'ebindi?
en: Then sent the king an answer unto Rehum the chancellor, and to Shimshai the scribe, and to the rest of their companions that dwell in Samaria, and unto the rest beyond the river, Peace, and at such a time.

rr: Ebaruha ei mwatutwekyeire, bagishomeire omu maisho gaitu, yaashobooroka.
en: The letter which ye sent unto us hath been plainly read before me.

rr: Naaragiira ku basherura, baashanga ngu okuruga ira orwo rurembo rukaba rwimukirira abagabe, kandi eby'obugomi n'okwebumba bikaba biruhanuurirwamu.
en: And I commanded, and search hath been made, and it is found that this city of old time hath made insurrection against kings, and that rebellion and sedition have been made therein.

rr: Kandi ngu rukaba rubamu abagabe b'amaani abaabaire bategyeka Yerusaalemu n'ebyanga byona ebya seeri y'Omugyera, kandi bakaba baheebwa emitoijo n'omushoro n'empooza.
en: There have been mighty kings also over Jerusalem, which have ruled over all countries beyond the river; and toll, tribute, and custom, was paid unto them.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo muteho ekiragiro abo bashaija barekyere aho, orwo rurembo rurekye kwombekwa, okuhitsya obu ndibaragiira ekindi.
en: Give ye now commandment to cause these men to cease, and that this city be not builded, until another commandment shall be given from me.

rr: Kandi mwerinde, muteeganda ahari ekyo, akabai katakaakura, kakareetera abagabe kufeerwa.
en: Take heed now that ye fail not to do this: why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings?

rr: Bwanyima ku baaherize kushomera ebaruha y'omugabe Aruta-gizakiseesi omu maisho ga Rehumu na Shimushai omuhandiiki na bagenzi baabo, ahonaaho baimuka, baaza Yerusaalemu ahu Abayuda baabaire bari, baabazibira kukora n'amaani n'obushoboorozi.
en: Now when the copy of king Artaxerxes' letter was read before Rehum, and Shimshai the scribe, and their companions, they went up in haste to Jerusalem unto the Jews, and made them to cease by force and power.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo omurimo gw'enju ya Ruhanga ey'omuri Yerusaalemu baagurekyera aho, okuhitsya omu busingye bwa Dario omugabe wa Perisi. Currently Selected: Ezera 4 : RR64 Highlight Share <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8 19c-2.828 0-4.243 0-5.121-.879C2
en: Then ceased the work of the house of God which is at Jerusalem. So it ceased unto the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia. rr: Bwanyima baanabi Hagai na Zekaria mwene Ido baahanuurira Abayudaaya abaabaire bari Yuda na Yerusaalemu omu iziina rya Ruhanga wa Israeli.
en: Then the prophets, Haggai the prophet, and Zechariah the son of Iddo, prophesied unto the Jews that were in Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God of Israel, even unto them.

rr: Ahonaaho Zerubabeeli mwwene Shealutieli na Yeshua mwene Yozadaaki baimuka, baatandika kugaruka kwombeka enju ya Ruhanga ey'omuri Yerusaalemu, nibahwerwa baanabi ba Ruhanga abo, abaabaire bari hamwe nabo.
en: Then rose up Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and began to build the house of God which is at Jerusalem: and with them were the prophets of God helping them.

rr: Omu biro ebyo Tatenai omutegyeki w'ensi egyo eya seeri y'Omugyera na Shesari-bozenai na bagyenzi baabo baabashanga ahu baabaire bari, baababuuza bati: N'oha obaragiire kwombeka enju egi n'okuheza oru rugo rw'amabaare?
en: At the same time came to them Tatnai, governor on this side the river, and Shethar-boznai, and their companions, and said thus unto them, Who hath commanded you to build this house, and to make up this wall?

rr: Baagaruka baababuuza bati: Abarikwombeka egi nju amaziina gaabo nibaahi?
en: Then said we unto them after this manner, What are the names of the men that make this building?

rr: Kwonka eriisho rya Ruhanga waabo ryaguma aha bategyeki b'Abayudaaya, tibaabazibira kwombeka, batakamanyise Dario, nwe akabagarukamu aha kigambo ekyo.
en: But the eye of their God was upon the elders of the Jews, that they could not cause them to cease, till the matter came to Darius: and then they returned answer by letter concerning this matter .

rr: Ebigambo by'ebaruha ei Tatenai omutegyeki w'ensi egyo eya seeri y'Omugyera na Shesari-bozenai na bagyenzi be abamashaza b'omuri egyo nsi, ebi baatwekyeire omugabe Dario nibyo ebi
en: The copy of the letter that Tatnai, governor on this side the river, and Shethar-boznai, and his companions the Apharsachites, which were on this side the river, sent unto Darius the king:

rr: Nyakusinga Dario omugabe, nitukwendeza obusingye bwonka!
en: they sent a letter unto him, wherein was written thus; Unto Darius the king, all peace.

rr: Nitukumanyisa ku tugiire omu ishaza rya Yuda, aha nju ya Ruhanga Nyamuhanga, erikwombekyesibwa amabaare mahango, bakatambika emitambiko mihango omu bisiika byayo; omurimo ogwo nibagukora n'obweziriki, kandi nigugyenda gye.
en: Be it known unto the king, that we went into the province of Judea, to the house of the great God, which is builded with great stones, and timber is laid in the walls, and this work goeth fast on, and prospereth in their hands.

rr: Mbwenu tubuurize abo bakuru, nitubagira tuti: N'oha obaragiire kwombeka enju egi, n'okuheza oru rugo rw'amabaare?
en: Then asked we those elders, and said unto them thus, Who commanded you to build this house, and to make up these walls?

rr: Kandi twababuuza n'amaziina gaabo, ngu tubone kugakumanyisa, kandi n'okukuhandiikira amaziina g'abarikubategyeka.
en: We asked their names also, to certify thee, that we might write the names of the men that were the chief of them.

rr: Oku nikwo baatugarukiremu, nibagira bati: Turi abairu ba Ruhanga w'eiguru n'ensi, kandi hati nitugaruka kwombeka enju eyaayombekirwe ira emyaka mingi ehingwire, ei omugabe wa Israeli rugambwa yaayombekire akaheza.
en: And thus they returned us answer, saying, We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth, and build the house that was builded these many years ago, which a great king of Israel builded and set up.

rr: 2 -11 ; Kwonka Ruhanga w'eiguru, ahabw'okugwisibwa kubi baatatenkuriitwe, akabahayo omu mikono ya Nebukadeneeza Omukaludaaya omugabe wa Babulooni, yaasheenya egyo nju, yaatwara abantu Babulooni bari enkwata.
en: But after that our fathers had provoked the God of heaven unto wrath, he gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, the Chaldean, who destroyed this house, and carried the people away into Babylon.

rr: Kwonka Kuuro omugabe wa Babulooni, omu mwaka gw'okubanza ogw'omu busingye bwe, akaragiira ku egi nju ya Ruhanga eshemereire kwombekwa.
en: But in the first year of Cyrus the king of Babylon the same king Cyrus made a decree to build this house of God.

rr: Kandi ebintu by'omu nju ya Ruhanga eby'ezaabu n'eby'efeeza, ebi Nebukadeneeza yaanyagire omuri hekalu ya Yerusaalemu, akabitwara omuri hekalu ya Babulooni, omugabe Kuuro yaabiiha omuri egyo hekalu ya Babulooni, baabiha omuntu orikwetwa Sheshebazaari, ou yaahindwire omutegyeki
en: And the vessels also of gold and silver of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple that was in Jerusalem, and brought them into the temple of Babylon, those did Cyrus the king take out of the temple of Babylon, and they were delivered unto one , whose name was Sheshbazzar, whom he had made governor;

rr: yaamuragiira ati: Twara ebintu ebi, ogyende, obite omuri hekalu y'omuri Yerusaaleumu, enju ya Ruhanga egarukye eyombekwe omu kibanja kyayo.
en: and said unto him, Take these vessels, go, carry them into the temple that is in Jerusalem, and let the house of God be builded in his place.

rr: Bwanyima Sheshebazaari ogwo yaija, yaataho emisingi y'enju ya Ruhanga omuri Yerusaalemu; mbwenu okwiha obwo n'okuhitsya hati neekyombekwa, tekahweire.
en: Then came the same Sheshbazzar, and laid the foundation of the house of God which is in Jerusalem: and since that time even until now hath it been in building, and yet it is not finished.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo, omugabe ku araakisiime, basherure omu nju y'eibiikiro ry'omugabe wa Babulooni, bareebe Kuuro ku araabe atararagiire kwombeka egi nju ya Ruhanga omuri Yerusaalemu. Haza obwo omugabe atutumeho eki arikusiima omu kigambo eki. en: Now therefore, if it seem good to the king, let there be search made in the king's treasure house, which is there at Babylon, whether it be so , that a decree was made of Cyrus the king to build this house of God at Jerusalem, and let the king send his pleasure to us concerning this matter. rr: Bwanyima Dario omugabe yaaragiira kusherura omu nju y'ebitabo by'ebyabaireho omuri Babulooni, omu baabaire babiika ebintu by'obuguzi bwingi.
en: Then Darius the king made a decree, and search was made in the house of the rolls, where the treasures were laid up in Babylon.

rr: Bwanyima baasherura omuri Akimeta, ekikaari ky'obugabe eky'omu ishaza rya Media, baazooramu omuzingo gw'ekitabo ogwahandiikirwemu ebigambo ebirikugira biti
en: And there was found at Achmetha, in the palace that is in the province of the Medes, a roll, and therein was a record thus written:

rr: Omugabe Kuuro, omu mwaka gw'okubanza ogw'omu busingye bwe, akataho ekiragiro eki: Ebirikukwata aha nju ya Ruhanga ey'omuri Yerusaalemu, enju egyo eyombekwe, ebe omwanya ogw'okutambiramu ebitambo, emisingi yaayo eteebweho gye, ehame; obwemi bwayo bube mikono makumi mukaaga, n'obukiika bwayo mikono makumi mukaaga
en: in the first year of Cyrus the king the same Cyrus the king made a decree concerning the house of God at Jerusalem, Let the house be builded, the place where they offered sacrifices, and let the foundations thereof be strongly laid; the height thereof threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof threescore cubits;

rr: egire emishorongo eshatu y'amabaare mahango n'omushorongo gumwe gw'emitambiko y'ebiti; eby'okugiihurira birugye omu ibiikiro ry'empiiha z'obugabe.
en: with three rows of great stones, and a row of new timber: and let the expenses be given out of the king's house:

rr: Kandi ebintu by'enju ya Ruhanga, eby'ezaabu n'eby'efeeza, ebi Nebukadeneeza yaanyagire omuri hekalu ey'omuri Yerusaalemu, akabitwara Babulooni, babigarureyo, babite omuri hekalu egyo, buri kintu kigarukye omu mwanya gwakyo; mubite omu nju ya Ruhanga.
en: and also let the golden and silver vessels of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took forth out of the temple which is at Jerusalem, and brought unto Babylon, be restored, and brought again unto the temple which is at Jerusalem, every one to his place, and place them in the house of God.

rr: Mbwenu iwe Tatenai omutegyeki w'ensi ya seeri y'Omugyera, na Shesari-bozenai, na bagyenzi baanyu abamashaza ab'ebyanga bya seeri y'Omugyera, mugume hangahari
en: Now therefore , Tatnai, governor beyond the river, Shethar-boznai, and your companions the Apharsachites, which are beyond the river, be ye far from thence:

rr: mutagira eki mwakora ekirikuzibira omurimo gw'egyo nju ya Ruhanga; omutegyeki w'Abayuda n'abakuru baabo babe nibo baayombeka egyo nju ya Ruhanga omu kibanja kyayo.
en: let the work of this house of God alone; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God in his place.

rr: Kandi naataho ekiragiro ky'ebi mushemereire kukorera abo bakuru b'Abayudaaya ahabw'okwombeka enju ya Ruhanga; mwihe aha mpiiha z'obugabe ezirugire omu mushoro gw'abantu b'ensi ya seeri y'Omugyera, muteho omutima kuha abo bashaija eby'okwihurira omurimo, barekye kgira ekyabazibira kukora.
en: Moreover I make a decree what ye shall do to the elders of these Jews for the building of this house of God: that of the king's goods, even of the tribute beyond the river, forthwith expenses be given unto these men, that they be not hindered.

rr: Kandi eki bariba nibeetenga kyona, yaaba nimi z'ebimasha, empaya z'entaama nari entaama ahabw'ebitambo by'okwotsya kutambira Ruhanga w'eiguru, nari engano, omwonyo, viinyo nari amajuta, ebi abanyamurwa ba Yerusaalemu bariba nibeetenga, bagume babiheebwe buri izooba bitaribura
en: And that which they have need of, both young bullocks, and rams, and lambs, for the burnt offerings of the God of heaven, wheat, salt, wine, and oil, according to the appointment of the priests which are at Jerusalem, let it be given them day by day without fail:

rr: babone kuguma nibatambira Ruhanga w'eiguru ebitambo by'ekisooroora kirungi, kandi bashabire omugabe n'abatabani okugira amagara.
en: that they may offer sacrifices of sweet savours unto the God of heaven, and pray for the life of the king, and of his sons.

rr: Kandi nintaho ekiragiro nti: Omuntu weena rorihindura ekigambo ekyo, baryahigura enyomyo omu nju ye, bagimuhanikyeho, n'enju ye bagihindure orubungo.
en: Also I have made a decree, that whosoever shall alter this word, let timber be pulled down from his house, and being set up, let him be hanged thereon; and let his house be made a dunghill for this.

rr: Kandi Ruhanga, owaagumizeyo eiziina rye, acwekyereze omugabe weena, nari abantu, abariimutsya emikono yaabo kuhindura ekiragiro eki, nari okusheenya egyo nju ya Ruhanga ey'omuri Yerusaalemu. Nyowe Dario, niinye naaragiira ekyo kiragiro; kihikiirizibwe n'obweziriki bwona. Abayuda okuheza hekalu n'okugitaaha
en: And the God that hath caused his name to dwell there destroy all kings and people, that shall put to their hand to alter and to destroy this house of God which is at Jerusalem. I Darius have made a decree; let it be done with speed.

rr: Bwanyima Tatenai omutegyeki w'ensi eya seeri y'Omugyera, na Shesari-bozenai na bagyenzi baabo baayezirika munonga kukora eki Dario omugabe yaaragiire, nk'ekigambo eki yaabatumireho oku kyabaire kiri.
en: Then Tatnai, governor on this side the river, Shethar-boznai, and their companions, according to that which Darius the king had sent, so they did speedily.

rr: Abakuru b'Abayudaaya baayombeka, byagyenda gye ahabw'okuhanuura kwa nabi Hagai na Zekaria mwene Ido.
en: And the elders of the Jews builded, and they prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo.

rr: Baayombeka, baaheza ahabw'okuragiirwa Ruhanga wa Israeli, kandi n'ahabw'ekiragiro ekyatairweho Kuuro na Dario na Aruta-gizakiseesi omugabe wa Perisi
en: And they builded, and finished it , according to the commandment of the God of Israel, and according to the commandment of Cyrus, and Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia.

rr: egyo nju yaahwa aha kiro kya kashatu ky'okwezi kwa Adari, omu mwaka gwa mukaaga ogw'omu busingye bw'omugabe Dario.
en: And this house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king. The Feast of Dedication

rr: Bwanyima Abaisraeli, abanyamurwa, Abaleevi n'abandi abaarugire omu bukwatwa, baagira obugyenyi bw'okushoroora egyo nju ya Ruhanga baine okushemererwa.
en: And the children of Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the rest of the children of the captivity, kept the dedication of this house of God with joy,

rr: Ku baabaire nibagishoroora, baahonga enimi igana, empaya z'entaama magana abiri, n'abaana b'entaama magana aha; kandi baatamba empaya z'embuzi ikumi na ibiri kuba empongano z'okurihiirira ekibi ahabw'Abaisraeli boona, nk'omubaro gw'enganda zaabo oku gwabaire guri.
en: and offered at the dedication of this house of God an hundred bullocks, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs; and for a sin offering for all Israel, twelve he goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.

rr: Baata abanyamurwa omu mbu zaabo, nk'oku baabaire nibakuratana, n'Abaleevi baaza omu myanya yaabo, kuheereza Ruhanga omuri Yerusaalemu, nk'oku kyahandiikirwe omu kitabo kya Musa.
en: And they set the priests in their divisions, and the Levites in their courses, for the service of God, which is at Jerusalem; as it is written in the book of Moses.

rr: Bwanyima abaarugire omu bukwatwa baijuka obugyenyi bw'Okuhingurwaho aha kiro kya ikumi na bina ky'okwezi kw'okubanza.
en: And the children of the captivity kept the passover upon the fourteenth day of the first month.

rr: Ahabw'okuba abanyamurwa n'Abaleevi bakaba beeyereize hamwe; boona bashemeire. N'ahabw'ekyo baita omwana gw'entaama gw'Okuhingurwaho ahabw'abaarugire omu bukwatwa boona, n'ahabwa beene waabo abanyamurwa, n'aabwabo bonka.
en: For the priests and the Levites were purified together, all of them were pure, and killed the passover for all the children of the captivity, and for their brethren the priests, and for themselves.

rr: Gwariibwa Abaisraeli abaarugire omu bukwatwa, n'abantu boona abaabaire beetaaniise n'ebihagaro by'abanyamahanga ab'omu nsi egyo, bakakwatanisa n'Abaisraeli kuramya MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli.
en: And the children of Israel, which were come again out of captivity, and all such as had separated themselves unto them from the filthiness of the heathen of the land, to seek the LORD God of Israel, did eat,

rr: Baijuka obugyenyi bw'emigaati etatumbisiibwe, baamara ebiro mushanju nibashemererwa; ahabw'okuba MUKAMA akabaha okushemererwa, kandi yaahindura omutima gw'omugabe wa Asiria, yaabakunda, yaabahwera omu murimo gw'okwombeka enju ya Ruhanga, Ruhanga wa Israeli.
en: and kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy: for the LORD had made them joyful, and turned the heart of the king of Assyria unto them, to strengthen their hands in the work of the house of God, the God of Israel.

rr: 1 Bwanyima y'ebyo omu busingye gwa Aruta-gizakiseesi, omugabe wa Perisi, hakaba hariho omushaija orikwetwa Ezera mwene Seraaya, mwijukuru wa Azaria, Azaria ya Hilukia
en: Now after these things, in the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra the son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,

rr: Hilukia ya Shalumu, Shalumu ya Zadoki, Zadoki ya Ahitubu
en: the son of Shallum, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub,

rr: Ahitubu ya Amaria, Amaria ya Azaria, Azaria ya Merayoosi
en: the son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,

rr: Merayoosi ya Zerahia, Zerahia ya Uuzi, Uuzi ya Buuki
en: the son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,

rr: Buuki ya Abishua, Abishua ya Finehaasi, Finehaasi ya Eleazaari, mwene Arooni omunyamurwa omukuru
en: the son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest:

rr: Ezera ogwo akaruga Babulooni, yainamuka kuza Yerusaalemu; kandi akaba ari omuhandiiki w'obwengye omu by'ebiragiro bya Musa, ebyahairwe MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli. Omugabe yaamuha ebi yaashabire byona, ahabw'okuba omukono gwa MUKAMA Ruhanga we gukaba gumuriho.
en: this Ezra went up from Babylon; and he was a ready scribe in the law of Moses, which the LORD God of Israel had given: and the king granted him all his request, according to the hand of the LORD his God upon him.

rr: Kandi n'abani omu Baisraeli bainamuka hamwe nawe n'abamwe aha banyamurwa, Abaleevi, abeeshongozi, abakumiirizi n'abaheereza b'omuri hekalu, baaza Yerusaalemu omu mwaka gwa mushanju ogw'omu busingye bw'omugabe Aruta-gizakiseesi.
en: And there went up some of the children of Israel, and of the priests, and the Levites, and the singers, and the porters, and the Nethinims, unto Jerusalem, in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king.

rr: Ezera yaahika Yerusaalemu omu kwezi kwa kataano omu mwaka gwa mushanju ogw'omu busingye bw'ogwo mugabe
en: And he came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, which was in the seventh year of the king.

rr: ahakuba aha kiro ky'okubanza eky'okwezi kw'okubanza akatandika kuruga Babulooni, kandi aha kiro ky'okubanza omu kwezi kwa kataano yaahika Yerusaalemu, ahabw'okuba omukono gwa Ruhanga we omurungi gukaba gumuriho.
en: For upon the first day of the first month began he to go up from Babylon, and on the first day of the fifth month came he to Jerusalem, according to the good hand of his God upon him.
For Ezra had prepared his heart to seek the law of the LORD , and to do it , and to teach in Israel statutes and judgments.

rr: Kandi Ezera ogwo akaba ataire omutima gwe aha kwega ebiragiro bya MUKAMA, n'okubyorobera, kandi n'okwegyesa Abaisraeli ebyo biragiro n'emigyenzo eyaatairweho.
en: Letter of Authority

rr: Egi niyo baruha ei omugabe Aruta-gizakiseesi yaahaire Ezera omunyamurwa, kandi omuhandiiki, owaabaire ari omunyabwengye omu by'ebiragiro bya MUKAMA n'ebi yaataireho ahabwa Israeli. Ebaruha ei omugabe yaahaire Ezera
en: Now this is the copy of the letter that the king Artaxerxes gave unto Ezra the priest, the scribe, even a scribe of the words of the commandments of the LORD , and of his statutes to Israel.

rr: Nyowe Aruta-gizakiseesi, omugabe w'abagabe, naakuhandiikira, Ezera omunyamurwa, kandi omuhandiiki w'ebiragiro bya Ruhanga w'eiguru, ninkuramutsya munonga, n'ebindi!
en: Artaxerxes, king of kings, unto Ezra the priest, a scribe of the law of the God of heaven, perfect peace , and at such a time.

rr: Mbwenu nintaho ekiragiro nti: Omuntu weena omu Baisraeli, nari omu banyamurwa baabo nari ow'omu Baleevi, abari omu bugabe bwangye, orikwenda kuza Yerusaalemu atagyemirwe, agyende naiwe.
en: I make a decree, that all they of the people of Israel, and of his priests and Levites, in my realm, which are minded of their own freewill to go up to Jerusalem, go with thee.

rr: Ahabw'okuba nyowe omugabe n'abahi b'obwengye bangye mushanju twakutuma ngu oze kubuuza ebya Yuda na Yerusaalemu, nk'ebiragiro bya Ruhanga waawe ebi oine oku biri
en: Forasmuch as thou art sent of the king, and of his seven counsellors, to enquire concerning Judah and Jerusalem, according to the law of thy God which is in thine hand;

rr: kandi otware efeeza n'ezaabu, ebi nyowe omugabe n'abahi b'obwengye bangye tutoijeire Ruhanga, otuura Yerusaalemu, ahabwaitu
en: and to carry the silver and gold, which the king and his counsellors have freely offered unto the God of Israel, whose habitation is in Jerusalem,

rr: hamwe n'efeeza yoona n'ezaabu ezi orishanga omu ishaza rya Babulooni ryona, hamwe n'emitoijo y'abantu n'abanyamurwa, ei baaraganiise kutoija n'omutima gwekundiire ahabw'enju ya Ruhanga waabo eri omuri Yerusaalemu.
en: and all the silver and gold that thou canst find in all the province of Babylon, with the freewill offering of the people, and of the priests, offering willingly for the house of their God which is in Jerusalem:

rr: -13 ; . N'ahabw'ekyo oyezirikye munonga kugura n'empiiha ezo enimi empaya z'entaama n'abaana b'entaama hamwe n'empongano z'esaano, n'ez'eby'okunywa eby'okuhongwa nazo, mubitambire aha itambiro ry'enju ya Ruhanga waanyu omuri Yerusaalemu.
en: that thou mayest buy speedily with this money bullocks, rams, lambs, with their meat offerings and their drink offerings, and offer them upon the altar of the house of your God which is in Jerusalem.

rr: Kandi ebirishaaga ahari ezo feeza n'ezaabu, iwe na beene waanyu, oku muryenda kubitwaza, mubitwaze kwo, nimukuratira ebi Ruhanga waanyu arikusiima.
en: And whatsoever shall seem good to thee, and to thy brethren, to do with the rest of the silver and the gold, that do after the will of your God.

rr: Kandi n'ebintu ebi ohairwe kukoresa omu nju ya Ruhanga waawe oryabimurikira omu maisho ga Ruhanga wa Yerusaalemu.
en: The vessels also that are given thee for the service of the house of thy God, those deliver thou before the God of Jerusalem.

rr: Kandi ekindi kyona ekiriba nikyetengwa ahabw'enju ya Ruhanga waawe, eki oryenda kuha, okiihe omu ibiikiro ry'omugabe, okihe.
en: And whatsoever more shall be needful for the house of thy God, which thou shalt have occasion to bestow, bestow it out of the king's treasure house.

rr: Kandi nyowe, omugabe Aruta-gizakiseesi, naaragiira ababiiki b'omu nsi eya seeri y'Omugyera boona nti: Kyona eki Ezera omunyamurwa, kandi omuhandiiki w'ebiragiro bya Ruhanga w'eiguru, aribashaba, mukikore n'obweziriki bwona
en: And I, even I Artaxerxes the king, do make a decree to all the treasurers which are beyond the river, that whatsoever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the God of heaven, shall require of you, it be done speedily,

rr: okutarenzya aha talanta z'efeeza igana, encuro z'engano igana, enjoga za viinyo igana, entsimbo z'amajuta igana, n'omwonyo ogurengire ekigyero.
en: unto an hundred talents of silver, and to an hundred measures of wheat, and to an hundred baths of wine, and to an hundred baths of oil, and salt without prescribing how much .

rr: Ekiriragiirwa Ruhanga w'eiguru kyona, kikorerwe kimwe ahabw'enju ye, ekiniga kye kitakaija aha mugabe n'abatabani.
en: Whatsoever is commanded by the God of heaven, let it be diligently done for the house of the God of heaven: for why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons?

rr: Kandi nitubamanyisa eby'abanyamurwa, Abaleevi, abeeshongozi, abakumiirizi, abaheereza b'omuri hekalu n'abandi bakozi b'omuri egyo nju ya Ruhanga boona oku baingana, ku mutarikwizibwa kubatoijesa emitoijo, nari okubahsoza omushoro, n'obu kwakuba okubahooza ehoozi.
en: Also we certify you, that touching any of the priests and Levites, singers, porters, Nethinims, or ministers of this house of God, it shall not be lawful to impose toll, tribute, or custom, upon them.

rr: Kandi weena otariikiriza kworobera biragiro bya Ruhanga waawe n'eby'omugabe, aheebwe ekifubiro, atarikusaasirwa, eky'okwitwa, nari okubingwa, nari okunyagwa ebintu bye, nari okuteebwa omu kihome.
en: And whosoever will not do the law of thy God, and the law of the king, let judgment be executed speedily upon him, whether it be unto death, or to banishment, or to confiscation of goods, or to imprisonment.

rr: Bwanyima Ezera yaagira ati: MUKAMA asiimwe, Ruhanga wa baatatenkuriitwe, ahabw'okuta ekintu nk'eki omu mutima gw'omugabe, okushemeza enju ya MUKAMA ey'omuri Yerusaalemu
en: Blessed be the LORD God of our fathers, which hath put such a thing as this in the king's heart, to beautify the house of the LORD which is in Jerusalem:

rr: kandi n'ahabw'okumpa okugirirwa embabazi omu maisho g'omugabe n'abahi b'obwengye be, n'omu maisho g'abategyeki be boona ab'obushoboorozi.
en: and hath extended mercy unto me before the king, and his counsellors, and before all the king's mighty princes.

rr: Nikyo naahamiire ahabw'omukono gwa MUKAMA Ruhanga wangye ogwabaire gundiho, nkateerana abakuru bamwe omuri Israeli ngu twinamukane.
en: And I was strengthened as the hand of the LORD my God was upon me, and I gathered together out of Israel chief men to go up with me.

rr: Aba nibo bakuru b'amaju ga baishenkurubo, kandi oku nikwo kukuratana kw'oruzaaro rw'abaarugire naanye Babulooni omu busingye bw'omugabe Aruta-gizakiseesi.
en: These are now the chief of their fathers, and this is the genealogy of them that went up with me from Babylon, in the reign of Artaxerxes the king.

rr: Omuri beene Finehaasi, Gereshoni; omuri beene Itamaari Danieli; omuri beene Daudi Hatushi
en: Of the sons of Phinehas; Gershom: of the sons of Ithamar; Daniel: of the sons of David; Hattush.

rr: omuri beene Shekania. Omuri beene Paroshi Zakaria owaahandiikirwe hamwe n'abashaija igana na makumi ataano.
en: Of the sons of Shechaniah, of the sons of Pharosh; Zechariah: and with him were reckoned by genealogy of the males an hundred and fifty.

rr: Omuri beene Pahasi-moabu Eliehoenai mwene Zerahia, kandi ogwo akaba ari hamwe n'abashaija magana abiri.
en: Of the sons of Pahath-moab; Elihoenai the son of Zerahiah, and with him two hundred males.

rr: Omuri beene Zatu Shekania mwene Yahazieli, hamwe n'abashaija magana ashatu.
en: Of the sons of Shechaniah; the son of Jahaziel, and with him three hundred males.

rr: Omuri beene Adini Ebedi mwene Yonasaani hamwe n'abashaija makumi ataano.
en: Of the sons also of Adin; Ebed the son of Jonathan, and with him fifty males.

rr: Omuri beene Elamu Yeshaya mwene Atalia hamwe n'abashaija makumi mushanju.
en: And of the sons of Elam; Jeshaiah the son of Athaliah, and with him seventy males.

rr: Omuri beene Shefatia Zebadia mwene Mikaeli hamwe n'abashaija makumi munaana.
en: And of the sons of Shephatiah; Zebadiah the son of Michael, and with him fourscore males.

rr: Omuri beene Yoabu Obadia mwene Yehieli, hamwe n'abashaija magana abiri na ikumi na munaana.
en: Of the sons of Joab; Obadiah the son of Jehiel, and with him two hundred and eighteen males.

rr: Omuri beene Baani Shelomiisi mwene Yosifia hamwe n'abashaija igana na makumi mukaaga.
en: And of the sons of Shelomith; the son of Josiphiah, and with him an hundred and threescore males.

rr: Omuri beene Bebai Zekaria mwene Bebai hamwe n'abashaija makumi abiri na munaana.
en: And of the sons of Bebai; Zechariah the son of Bebai, and with him twenty and eight males.

rr: Omuri beene Azigaadi Yohanaani mwene Hakataani hamwe n'abashaija igana na ikumi.
en: And of the sons of Azgad; Johanan the son of Hakkatan, and with him an hundred and ten males.

rr: Omuri beene Adonikaamu abaizire bwanyima, amaziina gaabo Elifeleti, Yeueli, na Shemaaya hamwe n'abashaija makumi mukaaga.
en: And of the last sons of Adonikam, whose names are these, Eliphelet, Jeiel, and Shemaiah, and with them threescore males.

rr: Omuri beene Biguvai Usai na Zakuri hamwe n'abashaija makumi mushanju. Ezera okweteekateekyera orugyendo n'okurushabira
en: Of the sons also of Bigvai; Uthai, and Zabbud, and with them seventy males. The Journey

rr: Abo boona nkabateeranira aha mugyera Ahava, twateeraho ensiisira, twamaraho kashatu. Ku naabaire niinyetegyereza abantu n'abanyamurwa, naashanga hatarimu n'omwe ow'omuri beene Leevi.
en: And I gathered them together to the river that runneth to Ahava; and there abode we in tents three days: and I viewed the people, and the priests, and found there none of the sons of Levi.

rr: Naatuma kweta Eliezeeri, Arieli, Shemaya, Elinasani, Yaribu, Elinasani, Nasani, Zekaria na Meshulaamu, abashaija bakuru, hamwe na Yoyaribu na Elinasani abaabaire bari abashaija abarikwetegyereza
en: Then sent I for Eliezer, for Ariel, for Shemaiah, and for Elnathan, and for Jarib, and for Elnathan, and for Nathan, and for Zechariah, and for Meshullam, chief men; also for Joiarib, and for Elnathan, men of understanding.

rr: naabatuma ahari Ido, omutegyeki w'ekyaro ekirikwetwa Kasifia, naabagambira ebi baraagambire Ido na beene ishe abaheereza b'omuri hekalu abaabaire bari omuri ekyo kyaro, ngu batwoherereze abaheereza by'okukora omu nju ya Ruhanga waitu.
en: And I sent them with commandment unto Iddo the chief at the place Casiphia, and I told them what they should say unto Iddo, and to his brethren the Nethinims, at the place Casiphia, that they should bring unto us ministers for the house of our God.

rr: Ahabw'omukono gwa Ruhanga waitu omurungi ogwabaire guturiho, baatureetera omushaija orikwetegyereza ow'omuri beene Mahili mwene Leevi mwijukuru wa Israeli, orikwetwa Sherebia hamwe n'abatabani na beene waabo, boona ikumi na munaana
en: And by the good hand of our God upon us they brought us a man of understanding, of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel; and Sherebiah, with his sons and his brethren, eighteen;

rr: na Hashabia hamwe na Yeshaaya ow'omuri beene Merari, na beene ishe na batabani baabo, boona makumi abiri
en: and Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, his brethren and their sons, twenty;

rr: otabariireho baheereza b'omuri hekalu magana abiri na makumi abiri, abu Daudi n'abatware be baatooraine kuheereza Abaleevi.
en: also of the Nethinims, whom David and the princes had appointed for the service of the Levites, two hundred and twenty Nethinims: all of them were expressed by name.

rr: Abo boona baagambwaho nk'oku amaziina gaabo gaabaire gari.
en: Prayer on the Way

rr: Bwanyima naarangira ahari ogwo mugyera Ahava, ku habaho okwesiibyakwo, ngu tubone kwecureeza omu maisho ga Ruhanga waitu, tumuhabuzeho omuhanda gugororokire ahabwaitu, ahabw'abaana baitu abato n'ahabw'ebintu byaitu byona
en: Then I proclaimed a fast there, at the river of Ahava, that we might afflict ourselves before our God, to seek of him a right way for us, and for our little ones, and for all our substance.

rr: ahabw'okuba nkagira enshoni z'okushaba omugabe omutwe gw'engabo z'abaserukare n'ab'aha mbaraasi kturinda abazigu omu muhanda, ahakuba tukaba twagambiire omugabe tuti: Omukono gwa Ruhanga waitu guri aha barikumusherura boona kubagirira gye; kwonka amaani ge n'ekiniga kye birwanisa abamutsigaho boona.
en: For I was ashamed to require of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy in the way: because we had spoken unto the king, saying, The hand of our God is upon all them for good that seek him; but his power and his wrath is against all them that forsake him.

rr: Tutyo twayesiibyakwo, twashaba Ruhanga waitu nitumweshengyereza; yaahurira okweshengyereza kwaitu.
en: So we fasted and besought our God for this: and he was intreated of us.

rr: Bwanyima naatoorana abakuru ikumi na babiri omu banyamurwa, Sherebia na Hashabia n'abandi ikumi omuri beene waabo.
en: Then I separated twelve of the chief of the priests, Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brethren with them,

rr: Naabapimira efeeza n'ezaabu n'ebintu, ebyatoizirwe omugabe n'abahi b'obwengye be n'abatware be n'Abaisraeli boona abaabaire bari aho, ahabw'enju ya Ruhanga waitu.
en: and weighed unto them the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, even the offering of the house of our God, which the king, and his counsellors, and his lords, and all Israel there present, had offered:

rr: Ntyo naabakwatsa etalanta z'efeeza magana mukaaga na makumi ataano, n'ebintu by'efeeza eby'etalanta igana n'etalanta z'ezaabu igana
en: I even weighed unto their hand six hundred and fifty talents of silver, and silver vessels an hundred talents, and of gold an hundred talents;

rr: n'enyabya z'ezaabu makumi abiri eza dariki rukumi, n'ebintu bibiri by'emiringa mirungi ekuubirwe eby'obuguzi bwingi nk'obw'ezaabu.
en: also twenty basons of gold, of a thousand drams; and two vessels of fine copper, precious as gold.

rr: Naabagira nti: Muri abeereziibwe MUKAMA, kandi ezi feeza n'ezaabu n'emitoijo ei baatoijeire MUKAMA Ruhanga wa baashwenkuriimwe n'omutima gwekundiire.
en: And I said unto them, Ye are holy unto the LORD ; the vessels are holy also; and the silver and the gold are a freewill offering unto the LORD God of your fathers.

rr: Mubibiikye kandi mubirinde, okuhitsya obu muribipimira omu maisho g'abanyamurwa abakuru n'Abaleevi n'abakuru b'amaju ga baishenkuru b'Abaisraeli omu bishengye by'enju ya MUKAMA omuri Yerusaalemu.
en: Watch ye, and keep them , until ye weigh them before the chief of the priests and the Levites, and chief of the fathers of Israel, at Jerusalem, in the chambers of the house of the LORD .

rr: Batyo abanyamurwa n'Abaleevi baayakiira efeeza n'ezaabu n'ebindi bintu, nk'oku oburemeezi bwabyo bwabaire buri, kubitwara Yerusaalemu omu nju ya Ruhanga waitu.
en: So took the priests and the Levites the weight of the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, to bring them to Jerusalem unto the house of our God.

rr: Ezera okuhika Yerusaalemu n'abu yaabaire aine
en: In Jerusalem

rr: Bwanyima aha kiro kya ikumi na bibiri ky'okwezi kw'okubanza twaruga aha mugyera Ahava kuza Yerusaalemu; omukono gwa Ruhanga waitu gwatugumaho, yaatujuna omu mikono y'abazigu baitu, n'abaabaire batugwereire omu muhanda.
en: Then we departed from the river of Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go unto Jerusalem: and the hand of our God was upon us, and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy, and of such as lay in wait by the way.

rr: Ku twahikire Yerusaalemu, twahamara ebiro bishatu
en: And we came to Jerusalem, and abode there three days.

rr: aha izooba rya kana twapimira efeeza n'ezaabu n'ebindi bintu omu nju ya Ruhanga waitu, twabikwatsa Meremoosi omunyamurwa mwene Uriya, owaabaire ari hamwe na Eleazaari mwene Finehaasi, bakwataniise n'Abaleevi Yozabaadi mene Yeshua na Noadia mwene Binui.
en: Now on the fourth day was the silver and the gold and the vessels weighed in the house of our God by the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest; and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas; and with them was Jozabad the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah the son of Binnui, Levites;

rr: Byona byabarwa, byapimwa, kandi oburemeezi bwa buri kintu bwahandiikwa.
en: by number and by weight of every one: and all the weight was written at that time. An Offering to God

rr: Bwanyima abaagarukire nibaruga omu bukwatwa baatambira Ruhanga wa Israeli ebitambo by'okwotsya, enimi ikumi na ibiri ahabwa Israeli yoona, empaya z'entaama makumi mwenda na mukaaga, abaana b'entaama makumi mushanju na mushanju, kandi baahonga empaya z'embuzi ikumi na ibiri kuba ekitambo ky'okurihiirira ekibi. Ebyo byona byaba ekitambo ky'okwokyeza MUKAMA.
en: Also the children of those that had been carried away, which were come out of the captivity, offered burnt offerings unto the God of Israel, twelve bullocks for all Israel, ninety and six rams, seventy and seven lambs, twelve he goats for a sin offering: all this was a burnt offering unto the LORD .

rr: Kandi baaha abategyeki b'omugabe n'abamashaza b'ensi ya seeri y'Omugyera ebiragiro by'omugabe; nabo baahwera abantu n'enju ya Ruhanga.
en: And they delivered the king's commissions unto the king's lieutenants, and to the governors on this side the river: and they furthered the people, and the house of God.

rr: Ebyo byona ku byahweire, abatware bampika haihi, bangira bati: Abantu ba Israeli n'abanyamurwa n'Abaleevi tibeetaaniise na bantu b'ensi ezi hamwe n'ebihagaro byabo, Abanyakanaani, Abahiiti, Abaperizi, Abayebusi, Abaamoni, Abamoabu, Abanyamisri n'Abaamori
en: Now when these things were done, the princes came to me, saying, The people of Israel, and the priests, and the Levites, have not separated themselves from the people of the lands, doing according to their abominations, even of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.

rr: ahabw'okuba bashweire bamwe omuri bahara baabo, kand baabashwererera na batabani baabo; n'ahabw'ekyo eihanga eririkwera ryejwangize n'abanyamahanga b'omuri ezi nsi. Kandi abategyeki n'abakuru nibo bakirize abandi kukora ekyo kicumuro.
en: For they have taken of their daughters for themselves, and for their sons: so that the holy seed have mingled themselves with the people of those lands: yea, the hand of the princes and rulers hath been chief in this trespass.

rr: Ku naahuriire ebyo, naataagura ebijwaro n'omunagiro gwangye, naayemaanyura eishokye omu mutwe, kandi n'obureju, naashutama ahansi nshobeirwe munonga.
en: And when I heard this thing, I rent my garment and my mantle, and plucked off the hair of my head and of my beard, and sat down astonied.

rr: Bwanyima abantu boona, abu ebigambo bya Ruhanga wa Israeli byareeteire kutetema ahabw'ekicumuro ky'abaarugire omu bukwatwa, baateeranira ahu naabaire nshutami nshobeirwe, okuhitsya aha bunaku bw'okutamba ekitambo ky'omu mwabazyo.
en: Then were assembled unto me every one that trembled at the words of the God of Israel, because of the transgression of those that had been carried away; and I sat astonied until the evening sacrifice.

rr: Obunaku bw'ekitambo ky'omu mwabazyo ku bwahikire, naimuka ahu naabaire nyecureereize, ebijwaro byange n'omunagiro gwangye bitaagukire, naatsimba amaju, naateega MUKAMA Ruhanga wangye emikono
en: And at the evening sacrifice I arose up from my heaviness; and having rent my garment and my mantle, I fell upon my knees, and spread out my hands unto the LORD my God,

rr: ningira nti: Ai Ruhanga wangye, nyine enshoni z'okwimutsya amaihso kukureeba, nimbwerabwera omu maisho gaawe, Ruhanga wangye; ahabw'okuba ebibi byaitu bikanyire, byatukira aha mutwe, n'orubanja rwaitu rwatuuma, rwahika omu iguru.
en: and said, O my God, I am ashamed and blush to lift up my face to thee, my God: for our iniquities are increased over our head, and our trespass is grown up unto the heavens.

rr: Okuruga omubiro bya baatatenkuriibwe tutuura twine orubanja ruhango n'okuhitsya hati; kandi ebicumuro byaitu nibyo byatureeteire hamwe n'abagabe baitu n'abanyamurwa baitu kuheebwayo omu mikono y'abagabe b'ezi nsi, okwitwa rurara, okutwarwa omu bukwatwa, okunyagwa n'okuhemuka, nk'oku kiri na hati.
en: Since the days of our fathers have we been in a great trespass unto this day; and for our iniquities have we, our kings, and our priests, been delivered into the hand of the kings of the lands, to the sword, to captivity, and to a spoil, and to confusion of face, as it is this day.

rr: Kwonka omu biro ebi ebikye MUKAMA Ruhanga waitu ayorekire embabazi ze, yaagira abu yaatutsigiraho, yaatuha omwanya guhamire omu Mwanya gwe ogurikwera, ngu abone kushemuura amaihso gaitu, n'okutugaruramu otugara omu buhuuku bwaitu
en: And now for a little space grace hath been shewed from the LORD our God, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a nail in his holy place, that our God may lighten our eyes, and give us a little reviving in our bondage.

rr: ahakuba kwo turi abahuuku; kwonka Ruhanga tatutsigireho mubuhuuku bwaitu, kureka atworekire embabazi ze omu maisho g'abagabe b'Abaperisi; yaatugaruramu otugara, ngu tubone agombeka enju ya Ruhanga waitu, okuhunduuza ahasiisikaire, n'okutubeera orugo rw'okuturinda omuri Yuda na Yerusaalemu.
en: For we were bondmen; yet our God hath not forsaken us in our bondage, but hath extended mercy unto us in the sight of the kings of Persia, to give us a reviving, to set up the house of our God, and to repair the desolations thereof, and to give us a wall in Judah and in Jerusalem.

rr: Mbwenu, ai Ruhanga waitu, ka waatutambiire oti, ekindi nitwenda kugamba ki? Ahabw'okuba tukareka kworobera ebiragiro byawe
en: And now, O our God, what shall we say after this? for we have forsaken thy commandments,

rr: -30 ; . ebi waaragiira nooraba omu bairu baawe baanabi, noogira oti: Ensi ei murikuzamu kukubuura n'ensi esiisikaire ahaba'ebihagaro by'abantu baamwo, n'ebirikunugwa byabo ebigiijwize, okutashemera kukshaagaana.
en: which thou hast commanded by thy servants the prophets, saying, The land, unto which ye go to possess it, is an unclean land with the filthiness of the people of the lands, with their abominations, which have filled it from one end to another with their uncleanness.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo mutarihingira bahara baanyu batabani baabo, nari kushwererera batabani baanyu bahara baabo, n'obu kwakuba okubendeza obusingye nari okuba gye, mubone kuba ab'amaani, n'okurya ebirungi by'ensi, kandi n'okugitsigira abaana baanyu, ekaba obuhunguzi bwabo obw'ebiro byona.
en: Now therefore give not your daughters unto their sons, neither take their daughters unto your sons, nor seek their peace or their wealth for ever: that ye may be strong, and eat the good of the land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children for ever.

rr: Mbwenu nk'oku ebi byona byatubaireho ahabw'ebibi ebi twakozire, n'ahabw'orubanja rwaitu ruhango, haza iwe, Ruhanga waitu, okatuha ekifubiro ekitakuuraine na bibi byaitu, kandi okatutsigiraho ekicweka kirikwingana kiti
en: And after all that is come upon us for our evil deeds, and for our great trespass, seeing that thou our God hast punished us less than our iniquities deserve , and hast given us such deliverance as this;

rr: mbwenu tugarukye tushiishe ebiragiro byawe, tushwererane n'amahanga agarikukora ebirikunugwa biti? Torikwija kutugirira ekiniga, okatumaraho, hakabura owaahonokaho, nari owaakira?
en: should we again break thy commandments, and join in affinity with the people of these abominations? wouldest not thou be angry with us till thou hadst consumed us , so that there should be no remnant nor escaping?

rr: Ai MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli, ori ow'amazima, ahabw'okuba tutsigaireho turi ekicweka ekyahonokireho, nk'oku kiri hati. Mbwenu reeba, turi aha omu maisho gaawe, tusingirwe orubanja; kandi tihaine orikubaasa kwemerera omu maisho gaawe ahabw'ekyo.
