rr: -6 ; . Ezera ku yaabaire naashaba, naayatura ebibi, naarira naayetuura ahansi omu maisho g'enju ya Ruhanga, omutwe muhango munonga gw'abashaija n'abakazi n'abaana gwaruga omuri Israeli, gwateeranira ah'ari; kandi abo bantu nabo baarira munonga.
en: Now when Ezra had prayed, and when he had confessed, weeping and casting himself down before the house of God, there assembled unto him out of Israel a very great congregation of men and women and children: for the people wept very sore.

rr: Bwanyima Shekania mwene Yehieli, ow'omuri beene Elamu, yaagambira Ezera ati: Tucumwire ahari Ruhanga waitu, twashwera abakazi b'abanyamahanga, kwonka n'obu kiraabe kiri kityo, na hati tukiine amatsiko ahabwa Israeli.
en: And Shechaniah the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, answered and said unto Ezra, We have trespassed against our God, and have taken strange wives of the people of the land: yet now there is hope in Israel concerning this thing.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo ka turagaane na Ruhanga waitu, tushende abakazi abo boona n'abaana baabo, nk'obwengye bwa mukama wangye n'obw'abarikutetema ahabw'ekiragiro kya Ruhanga waitu, oku buri; kandi ka kikorwe, nk'oku ebiragiro birikuragiira.
en: Now therefore let us make a covenant with our God to put away all the wives, and such as are born of them, according to the counsel of my lord, and of those that tremble at the commandment of our God; and let it be done according to the law.

rr: Imuka ahakuba n'omurimo gwawe, kandi naitwe tukwataniise naiwe; ba ow'amaani, okikore.
en: Arise; for this matter belongeth unto thee: we also will be with thee: be of good courage, and do it .

rr: Ahonaaho Ezera yaimuka, yaarahiza abakuru b'omu banyamurwa, n'Abaleevi, n'Abaisraeli boona, ku bakora nk'oku kigambirwe. Batyo baarahira.
en: Then arose Ezra, and made the chief priests, the Levites, and all Israel, to swear that they should do according to this word. And they sware. A Great Assembly

rr: Bwanyima Ezera yaaruga ahu yaabaire ari omu maisho g'enju ya Ruhanga, yaataaha omu kishengye kya Yehohanani mwene Eliashibu, yaaraaramu atariire n'obu kwakuba okunywa amaizi; ahakuba akaba naasaasibwa okucumura kw'abaarugire omu bukwatwa.
en: Then Ezra rose up from before the house of God, and went into the chamber of Johanan the son of Eliashib: and when he came thither, he did eat no bread, nor drink water: for he mourned because of the transgression of them that had been carried away.

rr: Bwanyima baaranga omuri Yuda yoona na Yerusaalemu, ngu abantu boona abaarugire omu bukwatwa bateeranire Yerusaalemu
en: And they made proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem unto all the children of the captivity, that they should gather themselves together unto Jerusalem;

rr: kandi ngu omuntu weena ku araabe atahikireyo omu biro bishatu, ebintu bye byona binyagwe, kandi nawe acuubwe omu mutwe gw'abaarugire omu bukwatwa, nk'oku abategyeki n'abakuru baaragiire.
en: and that whosoever would not come within three days, according to the counsel of the princes and the elders, all his substance should be forfeited, and himself separated from the congregation of those that had been carried away.

rr: Bwanyima abashaija ba Yuda na Benyamiini boona baateeranira Yerusaalemu, ebyo biro bishatu bitakahweire; obwo kukaba kuri okwezi kwa mwenda, aha kiro kyakwo kya makumi abiri.
en: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered themselves together unto Jerusalem within three days.

rr: Abantu boona baashutama omu kibuga ky'omu maisho g'enju ya Ruhanga, nibatetema ahabw'ekyo kigambo, n'ahabw'enjura nyingi.
en: It was the ninth month, on the twentieth day of the month; and all the people sat in the street of the house of God, trembling because of this matter, and for the great rain.

rr: Ezera omunyamurwa yaayemerera, yaabagira ati: Mukacumura, mwashwera abakazi b'abanyamahanga, mwayongyerera Israeli orubanja.
en: And Ezra the priest stood up, and said unto them, Ye have transgressed, and have taken strange wives, to increase the trespass of Israel.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo hati mwaturire MUKAMA Ruhanga wa baashwenkuriimwe ekibi kyanyu, mukore eki arikwenda; mwetaanise n'abantu b'omuri egi nsi kandi n'abanyamahangakazi.
en: Now therefore make confession unto the LORD God of your fathers, and do his pleasure: and separate yourselves from the people of the land, and from the strange wives.

rr: Ahonaaho abantu boona abaabaire bateeraniireyo baagarukamu n'eiraka rihango bati: Nikwo kiri; tushemereire kukora, nk'oku waagamba.
en: Then all the congregation answered and said with a loud voice, As thou hast said, so must we do.

rr: Kwonka abantu ni baingi; kandi n'obunaku bw'enjura nyingi; titurikubaasa kwemerera aheeru. Kandi omurimo ogu ti gw'ekiro kimwe nari bibiri; ahakuba tukacumura munonga omu kigambo eki.
en: But the people are many, and it is a time of much rain, and we are not able to stand without, neither is this a work of one day or two: for we are many that have transgressed in this thing.

rr: Abakuru baitu ka beemerere omu iziina ry'eihanga ryona; bwanyima ab'omu ndembo zaitu boona, abaashweire abanyamahangakazi, baije omu bunaku obu bateereirweho, hamwe n'abakuru n'abaramuzi aba buri rurembo, okuhitsya obu ekiniga kya Ruhanga waitu ekingi, eki atugiriire ahabw'ekigambo eki, kiraaturugyeho.
en: Let now our rulers of all the congregation stand, and let all them which have taken strange wives in our cities come at appointed times, and with them the elders of every city, and the judges thereof, until the fierce wrath of our God for this matter be turned from us.

rr: Kwonka Yonasaani mwene Asaheeli na Yahazeya mwene Tikuva baayanga egyo naama, kandi Meshulaamu na Shabesai Omuleevi baikirizana nabo.
en: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahaziah the son of Tikvah were employed about this matter: and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.

rr: Batyo abaarugire omu bukwatwa baaba nikwo baatwaza. Ezera omunyamurwa yaatoorana abashaija, abakuru b'amaju ga baishenkurubo, nk'oku ago maju gaabaire gari, kuba abajwekyerwa nk'oku amaziina gaabo gaabaire gari. Aha kiro ky'okubanza ky'okwezi kwa ikumi baashutama kwetegyereza ebyo bigambo
en: And the children of the captivity did so. And Ezra the priest, with certain chief of the fathers, after the house of their fathers, and all of them by their names, were separated, and sat down in the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.

rr: kandi aha kiro ky'okubanza eky'okwezi kw'okubanza baashangwa baaherize ebigambo by'abashaija boona abaabaire bashweire abanyamahangakazi.
en: And they made an end with all the men that had taken strange wives by the first day of the first month.

rr: Omuri batabani b'abanyamurwa abaashweire abanyamahangakazi baashangamu Maaseya, Eliezeeri, Yaribu, na Gedalia, ab'omuri beene Yeshua mwene Yozadaaki na beene ishe.
en: And among the sons of the priests there were found that had taken strange wives: namely , of the sons of Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren; Maaseiah, and Eliezer, and Jarib, and Gedaliah.

rr: Baarahira kushenda abakazi baabo, kandi empongano yaabo y'okwihaho ekibi ekaba eri empaya y'entaama ey'omu busyo ahabw'orubanja rwabo.
en: And they gave their hands that they would put away their wives; and being guilty, they offered a ram of the flock for their trespass.

rr: Omuri beene Imeri: Hanani na Zebadia.
en: And of the sons of Immer; Hanani, and Zebadiah.

rr: Omuri beene Harimu: Maaseya, Eliya, Shemaaya, Yehieli na Uziya.
en: And of the sons of Harim; Maaseiah, and Elijah, and Shemaiah, and Jehiel, and Uzziah.

rr: Omuri beene Pashihuuri: Elioenai, Maaseya, Ishimaeli, Netaneeli. Yozabaadi, na Elasa.
en: And of the sons of Pashur; Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethaneel, Jozabad, and Elasah.

rr: Omu Baleevi: Yozabaadi, Shimei, Kelaya (niwe Keliita), Pesahia, Yuda, na Eliezeeri.
en: Also of the Levites; Jozabad, and Shimei, and Kelaiah, (the same is Kelita,) Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.

rr: Omu beeshongozi, Eliashibu. Omu bakumiirizi, Shalumu, Telemu, na Uuri.
en: Of the singers also; Eliashib: and of the porters; Shallum, and Telem, and Uri.

rr: Ab'omuri Israeli: omuri beene Paroshi, Ramia, Izia, Malukiya, Miyamiini, Eleazaari, Hashabia na Benaaya.
en: Moreover of Israel: of the sons of Parosh; Ramiah, and Jeziah, and Malchiah, and Miamin, and Eleazar, and Malchijah, and Benaiah.

rr: Omuri beene Elamu: Matania, Zekaria, Yehieli, Abudi, Yeremoosi na Eliya.
en: And of the sons of Elam; Mattaniah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, and Abdi, and Jeremoth, and Eliah.

rr: Omuri beene Zaatu: Elio-enai, Eliashibu Matania, Yeremoosi, Zabadi na Aziza.
en: And of the sons of Zattu; Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, and Jeremoth, and Zabad, and Aziza.

rr: Omuri beene Bebai: Yehohanani, Hanania, Zabai, na Asulai.
en: Of the sons also of Bebai; Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai.

rr: Omuri beene Baani; Meshulaamu, Maluki, Adaya, Yashubu, Sheali na Yeremoosi.
en: And of the sons of Bani; Meshullam, Malluch, and Adaiah, Jashub, and Sheal, and Ramoth.

rr: Omuri beene Pehasi-moabu: Aduna, Kelali, Benaaya, Maaseya, Matania, Bezaleeli, Binui, na Manaase.
en: And of the sons of Pahath-moab; Adna, and Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezaleel, and Binnui, and Manasseh.

rr: Omuri beene Harimu: Eliezeeri, Ishiya, Malukiya, Shemaaya, Shimeoni
en: And of the sons of Harim; Eliezer, Ishijah, Malchiah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,

rr: Benyamiini, Maluki, na Shemaria.
en: Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah.

rr: Omuri beene Hashumu: Metanai, Matasa, Zabadi, Elifeleti, Yeremai, Manaase, na Shimei.
en: Of the sons of Hashum; Mattenai, Mattathah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei.

rr: Omuri beene Baani: Maadai, Amuraamu, Ueli
en: Of the sons of Bani; Maadai, Amram, and Uel,

rr: Benaaya, Bedeya, Keluhi
en: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Chelluh,

rr: Vania, Meremoosi, Eliashibu
en: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,

rr: Matania, Matenai, na Yaasu.
en: Mattaniah, Mattenai, and Jaasau,

rr: Omuri beene Binui: Shimei
en: and Bani, and Binnui, Shimei,

rr: Shelemia, Nasani, Adaaya
en: and Shelemiah, and Nathan, and Adaiah,

rr: Makundebai, Shashai, Sharai
en: Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,

rr: Azareeli, Shelemia, Shemaria
en: Azareel, and Shelemiah, Shemariah,

rr: Shalumu, Amaria na Yosefu.
en: Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph.

rr: Omuri beene Neebo; Yeyeli, Matitia, Zabadi, Zebina, Yadai Yoeli na Benaaya.
en: Of the sons of Nebo; Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jadau, and Joel, Benaiah.
1 Paul, an apostle, (not of men, neither by man, but by Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead;)

rr: 2 nyowe n'ab'eishe-emwe boona abu nyine twabahandiikire imwe ab'amakanisa g'omuri Galatia.
en: 2 and all the brethren which are with me, unto the churches of Galatia:

rr: 3 Nimbendeza embabazi n'obusingye ebirikuruga ahari Ruhanga Isheboona na Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo
en: 3 grace be to you and peace from God the Father, and from our Lord Jesus Christ,
4 who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us from this present evil world, according to the will of God and our Father:

rr: 5 aheebwe ekitiinisa ebiro n'ebiro. Amiina.
en: 5 to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

rr: 6 Ntangaariire oku murahukire kuruga ahari Ogwo owaabeetsire ahabw'embabazi za Kristo, mukaikiriza engiri etari nka i mwabandize kwikiriza
en: 6 I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel:
7 which is not another; but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.

rr: 8 Kwonka ku haakugira owaababuurira engiri etari nka i twababuuriire, yaaba itwe n'obu yaakuba maraika orugire omu iguru, akyeenwe.
en: 8 But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.

rr: 9 Nk'oku twagambire ira, na hati nikwo ndikugamba nti: Omuntu weena orikubabuurira endiijo ngiri etari i mwaikiriize, akyeenwe.
en: 9 As we said before, so say I now again, If any man preach any other gospel unto you than that ye have received, let him be accursed.
10 For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ.

rr: Gal 1:11
en: 11 But I certify you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man.

rr: Paulo entumwa, etaratumirwe bantu, kandi etareetsirwe muntu, kureka eyaatumirwe Yesu Kristo na Ruhanga Ishe owaamuzoire omu bafu
en: 12 For I neither received it of man, neither was I taught it , but by the revelation of Jesus Christ.

rr: 13 Nimpamya ngu mukahurira aha by'emitwarize yangye eya ira omu diini ey'Abayudaaya, oku naarengyesereize kuhiiga ekanisa ya Ruhanga, ngu ngiihireho kimwe
en: 13 For ye have heard of my conversation in time past in the Jews' religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God, and wasted it:
14 and profited in the Jews' religion above many my equals in mine own nation, being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of my fathers.
15 But when it pleased God, who separated me from my mother's womb, and called me by his grace,

rr: 16 ku yaasiimire kunshuuruurira Omwana we ngu mmurangye omu Banyamahanga, ahonaaho tindeehanwize ha bantu nyabuntu
en: 16 to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the heathen; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood:

rr: 17 n'obu kwakuba okwinamuka Yerusaalemu kwehanuuza aha ntumwa ezambandiize, kureka nkaza omuri Buharabu; bwanyima naagaruka Damasiko.
en: 17 neither went I up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before me; but I went into Arabia, and returned again unto Damascus.
18 Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter, and abode with him fifteen days.
19 But other of the apostles saw I none, save James the Lord's brother.

rr: 20 Ebyo ebi naabahandiikira, nindahira omu maisho ga Ruhanga, tindikubeiha.
en: 20 Now the things which I write unto you, behold, before God, I lie not.
21 Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia;

rr: 22 Kandi omu biro ebyo amakanisa ga Kristo ag'omuri Buyudaaya gakaba gatakandeebire
en: 22 and was unknown by face unto the churches of Judæa which were in Christ:

rr: 23 kwonka bakaba nibahurira buhurizi abarikugira bati: Omuntu ogwo owaabaire naatuhiiga ira, hati naabuurira eby'ediini ei yaabaire ayenda kuhwerekyereza.
en: 23 but they had heard only, That he which persecuted us in times past now preacheth the faith which once he destroyed.

rr: 24 Baahimbisa Ruhanga ahabwangye.
en: 24 And they glorified God in me.
1 Then fourteen years after I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, and took Titus with me also.

rr: 2 Nainamukayo ahabw'ebi naashuururiirwe; naabashobororera engiri ei mbuurira omu Banyamahanga, kwonka omu mubonano aha baabaire nibasiimwa ahabw'obukuru, ngu ndekye kushusha nk'orikwirukira busha, nari nk'owairukiire busha.
en: 2 And I went up by revelation, and communicated unto them that gospel which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately to them which were of reputation, lest by any means I should run, or had run, in vain.
3 But neither Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised:

rr: 4 Kwonka hakaba hariho ab'eishe-emwe ab'ebishuba, abaataahire omuriitwe bwesherekye kutata obusingye bwaitu obu twine omuri Kristo Yesu, ngu batugarure omu buhuuku.
en: 4 and that because of false brethren unawares brought in, who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage:

rr: 5 Abo tituraboorobeire nangwa n'akaingana busha, ngu amazima g'engiri gabone kurindwa ahabwanyu.
en: 5 to whom we gave place by subjection, no, not for an hour; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you.

rr: 6 Kandi abo abaabaire nibasiimwa ngu ni bakuru oku baabaire bari ira, ebyo timbyetaireho; Ruhanga tashoroora mu bantu ahabw'obuganzi abakuru abo tibaine ki baanyongyeireho
en: 6 But of these who seemed to be somewhat, (whatsoever they were, it maketh no matter to me: God accepteth no man's person:) for they who seemed to be somewhat in conference added nothing to me:
7 but contrariwise, when they saw that the gospel of the uncircumcision was committed unto me, as the gospel of the circumcision was unto Peter;

rr: 8 (Mumanye ngu Oawabaasize Petero kuba entumwa aha bashazirwe, naanye niwe yambaasize kuba entumwa aha Banyamahanga.)
en: 8 (for he that wrought effectually in Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision, the same was mighty in me toward the Gentiles:)

rr: 9 Ku baayetegyereize omugisha ogu naahairwe, Yakobo na Keefa na Yohaana, abaabire nibasiimwe kuba enyomyo, baatuha omukono gwa buryo, nyowe na Barunaba, okworeka ku bakwataniise naitwe, ngu itwe tugyenda omu Banyamahanga, nabo omu bashazirwe
en: 9 and when James, Cephas, and John, who seemed to be pillars, perceived the grace that was given unto me, they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship; that we should go unto the heathen, and they unto the circumcision.
10 Only they would that we should remember the poor; the same which I also was forward to do.

rr: 11 Kwonka Keefa ku yaahikire Antiokia, naamuhakanisiza kimwe nitureebana, ahakuba akaba ashobize butunu.
en: 11 But when Peter was come to Antioch, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed.
12 For before that certain came from James, he did eat with the Gentiles: but when they were come, he withdrew and separated himself, fearing them which were of the circumcision.

rr: 13 Kandi n'Abayudaaya abandi baamutooreza, baakwatanisa nawe omu buryarya, nangwa na Barunaba nawe yaatwarwa obwo buryarya bwabo.
en: 13 And the other Jews dissembled likewise with him; insomuch that Barnabas also was carried away with their dissimulation.

rr: 14 Kwonka ku naareebire bataakuratira mazima g'engiri, naagambira Petero omu maisho ga boona nti: Iwe ku oraabe nootwaza nk'Abanyamahanga, etari mitwarize y'ekiyudaaya, haza ori Omuyudaaya, ahabw'enki noogyema Abanyamahanga kutwaza nk'Abayudaaya?
en: 14 But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, I said unto Peter before them all, If thou, being a Jew, livest after the manner of Gentiles, and not as do the Jews, why compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews?

rr: 15 Itwe n'obu turaabe turi Abayudaaya enzaarwa, tutari basiisi b'Abanyamahanga
en: 15 We who are Jews by nature, and not sinners of the Gentiles,

16 knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law, but by the faith of Jesus Christ, even we have believed in Jesus Christ, that we might be justified by the faith of Christ, and not by the works of the law: for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.

rr: 17 Kwonka, ku turaabe twayenzire kwihwaho orubanja omuri Kristo, kandi tukashangwa turi abasiisi, mbwenu shi nimugira ngu Kristo naakwatsiza ekibi?
en: 17 But if, while we seek to be justified by Christ, we ourselves also are found sinners, is therefore Christ the minister of sin?

rr: Rubuuza!
en: God forbid.

rr: 18 Ahakuba ku ngaruka kwombeka ebi naasheenyire, mba nyeyorekire ku ndi omusiisi.
en: 18 For if I build again the things which I destroyed, I make myself a transgressor.

rr: 19 Ahakuba nyowe ahabw'Ebiragiro nkafa aha Biragiro, ngu mbone kuba ohuriire ahari Ruhanga.
en: 19 For I through the law am dead to the law, that I might live unto God.

20 I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.

rr: 21 Tindikuhindura busha mbabazi za Ruhanga; ahakuba kuri okwihwaho orubanja kuheebwa ahabw'okuhikiiriza Ebiragiro, Kristo akaabaire afeereire busha.
en: 21 I do not frustrate the grace of God: for if righteousness come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.

rr: 1 Imwe Bagalatia b'abashema 'mwe, n'oha owaabarogire, imwe abaayorekirwe butunu Yesu Kristo abambirwe?
en: 1 O foolish Galatians, who hath bewitched you, that ye should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth, crucified among you?

rr: 2 Reka mbabuuze eki kyonka. Mukaheebwa Omwoyo ahabw'okuhikiiriza Ebiragiro, nari ahabw'okuhurira mukaikiriza?
en: 2 This only would I learn of you, Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?

rr: 3 Nikwo muri abashema mutyo? Mukatandikira omu by'Omwoyo, mbwenu mwahereerukana eby'omubiri?
en: 3 Are ye so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are ye now made perfect by the flesh?

rr: 4 Obwo busaasi bwingi butyo obu mwagumisiririize, omu mazima bukaba buri obwa busha?
en: 4 Have ye suffered so many things in vain? if it be yet in vain.

rr: 5 Mbwenu Ogwo obaha Omwoyo, akakora eby'okutangaaza omuriimwe, abikora ahabw'okuba muhitsya Ebiragiro, nari ahabw'okuhurira mukaikiriza?
en: 5 He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit, and worketh miracles among you, doeth he it by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
6 Even as Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.

rr: 7 n'ahabw'ekyo mumanye ngu abaine okwikiriza nibo baana ba Abrahamu.
en: 7 Know ye therefore that they which are of faith, the same are the children of Abraham.
8 And the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the heathen through faith, preached before the gospel unto Abraham, saying , In thee shall all nations be blessed.
9 So then they which be of faith are blessed with faithful Abraham.
10 For as many as are of the works of the law are under the curse: for it is written, Cursed is every one that continueth not in all things which are written in the book of the law to do them.
11 But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of God, it is evident: for, The just shall live by faith.
12 And the law is not of faith: but, The man that doeth them shall live in them.
13 Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:

rr: 14 ngu ahabwa Kristo Yesu omugisha ogwahairwe Abrahamu guhikye n'aha Banyamahanga, okwikiriza kubone kutuhaisa Omwoyo owaaraganisiibwe.
en: 14 that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

rr: 15 B'eishe-emwe, ka ngambe nk'oku abantu bagamba. Endagaano, nangwa n'obu yaakuba ey'omuntu, ku eheza kuhamibwa, tihariho ondiijo ogiita nari ogyongyeraho.
en: 15 Brethren, I speak after the manner of men; Though it be but a man's covenant, yet if it be confirmed, no man disannulleth, or addeth thereto.
16 Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ.

17 And this I say, that the covenant, that was confirmed before of God in Christ, the law, which was four hundred and thirty years after, cannot disannul, that it should make the promise of none effect.

rr: 18 Ahakuba obuhunguzi, kuri bwahairwe ahabw'Ebiragiro, bukaabaire butakiri bw'okuraganisibwa; kwonka Ruhanga akabuha Abrahamu naamuraganisa.
en: 18 For if the inheritance be of the law, it is no more of promise: but God gave it to Abraham by promise.
19 Wherefore then serveth the law? It was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise was made; and it was ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator.

rr: 20 Kandi omuteerani taba w'omwe, kwonka Ruhanga n'omwe.
en: 20 Now a mediator is not a mediator of one, but God is one.
21 Is the law then against the promises of God? God forbid: for if there had been a law given which could have given life, verily righteousness should have been by the law.
22 But the scripture hath concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.

rr: 23 Kwonka okwikiriza kutakaizire, tukaba turindirwa omu butegyeki bw'Ebiragiro, tutegyereze okwikiriza okwabaire nikwenda kushuuruurwa.
en: 23 But before faith came, we were kept under the law, shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed.

rr: 24 N'ahabw'ekyo Ebiragiro bikatubeera omwegyesa w'okutuhitsya ahari Kristo, ngu tubone kwihwaho orubanja ahabw'okwikiriza.
en: 24 Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

rr: 25 Kwonka mbwenu, nk'oku okwikiriza kwizire, titwakiri mu butegyeki bw'omurezi
en: 25 But after that faith is come, we are no longer under a schoolmaster.
26 For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.
27 For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ.
28 There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.

rr: 29 Kandi ku muraabe muri aba Kristo, biri muri abahunguzi, nk'oku kyaraganisiibwe.
en: 29 And if ye be Christ's, then are ye Abraham's seed, and heirs according to the promise.

rr: 1 Kwonka ningira nti: Omuhunguzi, ku aba akiri omwana muto, taine ki akiza omuhuuku, n'obu araabe ari mukama wa byona
en: 1 Now I say, That the heir, as long as he is a child, differeth nothing from a servant, though he be lord of all;

rr: 2 kureka ategyekwa abarezi n'ababiiki okuhitsya aha bunaku obwaragiirwe ishe.
en: 2 but is under tutors and governors until the time appointed of the father.
3 Even so we, when we were children, were in bondage under the elements of the world:

rr: 4 Kwonka obunaku ku bwahikiire kimwe, Ruhanga yaatuma Omwana we, owaazairwe omukazi omu butegyeki bw'Ebiragiro
en: 4 but when the fulness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,
5 to redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.
6 And because ye are sons, God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.
7 Wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

rr: 8 Haza omu bunaku obwo, obu mwabaire mutarikumanya Ruhanga, mukaba muri abahuuku b'abo, abatari baaruhanga buzima omu buhangwa bwabo
en: 8 Howbeit then, when ye knew not God, ye did service unto them which by nature are no gods.

rr: 9 kwonka hati nk'oku muherize kumanya Ruhanga, nari okukira We nk'oku abamanyire, mugarukire muta enyima omu migyenzo ei mwabandiizeho, etaine maani n'obu gwakuba omugasho, okwenda ngu egarukye ebategyekye?
en: 9 But now, after that ye have known God, or rather are known of God, how turn ye again to the weak and beggarly elements, whereunto ye desire again to be in bondage?
10 Ye observe days, and months, and times, and years.

rr: 11 Nintiina nti, shana byona ebi naabakoreire, nkahendekyera busha.
en: 11 I am afraid of you, lest I have bestowed upon you labour in vain.

rr: 12 Nimbeeshengyereza, B'eishe-emwe, mube nkaanye, ahakuba naanye mbaire nkaimwe. Timurankozire kubi
en: 12 Brethren, I beseech you, be as I am ; for I am as ye are : ye have not injured me at all.
13 Ye know how through infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you at the first.

rr: 14 kandi endwara egyo, n'obu eraabe yaabaruhize, timurangayire, n'obu kwakuba okunnuga; kureka mukanyakiira nka maraika wa Ruhanga, nari nka Kristo Yesu.
en: 14 And my temptation which was in my flesh ye despised not, nor rejected; but received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.

rr: 15 Mbwenu okwesiima kwanyu oku mwabaire mwine, hati kuri nkahi? Ahakuba nimpamya ngu, kuri kyabaire nikibaasika, mukaabaire mwihiremu amaisho gaanyu, mugampa.
en: 15 Where is then the blessedness ye spake of? for I bear you record, that, if it had been possible, ye would have plucked out your own eyes, and have given them to me.
16 Am I therefore become your enemy, because I tell you the truth?

rr: 17 Abo nibabeekundisa, kwonka ti habw'okubendeza ebirungi; kureka nibenda kubakingirana aheeru, ngu mube nibo mwahakwaho.
en: 17 They zealously affect you, but not well; yea, they would exclude you, that ye might affect them.

rr: 18 Mumanye ngu obutoosha bwona ni kirungi okukundwa, kwonka mukundirwe ebirungi, t'obu ndi naimwe bwonka.
en: 18 But it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing , and not only when I am present with you.
19 My little children, of whom I travail in birth again until Christ be formed in you,

rr: 20 Nkaayenzire kuguma naimwe, n'okworobya aha migambire yangye; ahakuba ebyanyu binshobeire.
en: 20 I desire to be present with you now, and to change my voice; for I stand in doubt of you.

rr: 21 Imwe abarikwenda kutegyekwa Ebiragiro, nimungambire. Timuhurira Ebiragiro?
en: 21 Tell me, ye that desire to be under the law, do ye not hear the law?
22 For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, the one by a bondmaid, the other by a freewoman.
23 But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh; but he of the freewoman was by promise.

rr: 24 Ebyo biri nk'enfumu, ahakuba abakazi abo nibamanyisa endagaano ibiri, emwe ekaruga aha rushozi Sinai, eyaazaire abaana ab'obuhuuku, niwe Hagari
en: 24 Which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from the mount Sinai, which gendereth to bondage, which is Agar.

rr: 25 mbwenu Hagari ogwo naashushanisibwa nk'orushozi Sinai orw'omuri Buharabu, orurikugyeranisibwa na Yerusaalemu ekiriho na hati; ahakuba ari omu buhuuku hamwe n'abaana be.
en: 25 For this Agar is mount Sinai in Arabia, and answereth to Jerusalem which now is, and is in bondage with her children.

rr: 26 Kwonka Yerusaalemu ey'omu iguru niwe mukazi nyeiteeka, kandi niwe maaweitwe.
en: 26 But Jerusalem which is above is free, which is the mother of us all.
27 For it is written,

rr: 28 Mbwenu itwe, B'eishe-emwe, turi abaana b'endagaano nka Isaaka.
en: 28 Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are the children of promise.
29 But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit, even so it is now.

rr: 30 Beitu Ebyahandiikirwe bigira bita?
en: 30 Nevertheless what saith the scripture?

rr: Biti: Binga omuzaana n'omwana we; ahakuba omwana w'omuzaana tarihungura n'ow'omukazi nyeiteeka.
en: Cast out the bondwoman and her son: for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the freewoman.

rr: 31 Mbwenu, B'eishe-emwe, tituri baana b'omuzaana, kureka ab'omukazi nyeiteeka.
en: 31 So then, brethren, we are not children of the bondwoman, but of the free.
1 Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.

rr: 2 Reeba, nyowe Paulo nimbagambira nti: Ku muraikirize kusharwa, Kristo naaba atakibainiire mugasho.
en: 2 Behold, I Paul say unto you, that if ye be circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.

rr: 3 Ningaruka kuhamiza omuntu weena orisharwa, nti: Aine eibanja ry'okuhitsya ebiragiro byona.
en: 3 For I testify again to every man that is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

rr: 4 Imwe abarikwenda kwihwaho orubanja ahabw'Ebiragiro, mwecwire ahari Kristo, mwagwa mwaruga omu mbabazi.
en: 4 Christ is become of no effect unto you, whosoever of you are justified by the law; ye are fallen from grace.

rr: 5 Kwonka itwe, ahabw'Omwoyo n'ahabw'okwikiriza kwaitu tutegyereize, kandi twine amatsiko g'okuheebwa okuhikiirira.
en: 5 For we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.
6 For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision; but faith which worketh by love.

rr: 7 Ka mwabaire nimugyenda gye; n'oha owaabazibiire kworobera amazima?
en: 7 Ye did run well; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth?

rr: 8 Okwohibwa oku tikurarugire ahari Ogwo owaabeetsire.
en: 8 This persuasion cometh not of him that calleth you.
9 A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.

rr: 10 Nyowe nimbeesiga omuri Mukama ku mutariikiriza bindi ebitari byangye; kwonka ogwo orikubarabanisamu aryagyibwaho orubanja.
en: 10 I have confidence in you through the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.
11 And I, brethren, if I yet preach circumcision, why do I yet suffer persecution? then is the offence of the cross ceased.

rr: 12 Nkaayenzire ngu abo abarikubarabanisamu babarugyemu.
en: 12 I would they were even cut off which trouble you.
13 For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.

rr: 14 Ahakuba Ebiragiro bihikiirizibwa omu kigambo kimwe eki ngu: Kunda mutaahi waawe, nk'oku oyekunda.
en: 14 For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

rr: 15 Kwonka ku muraabe nimurumana, mwaryana, mwerinde mutamaranaho.
en: 15 But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.

rr: 16 Kwonka nyowe ningira nti: Mugume mugyendere omu Mwoyo; obwo nibwo mutarihikiiriza eby'okwetenga kw'omubiri
en: 16 This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.
17 For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other: so that ye cannot do the things that ye would.
18 But if ye be led of the Spirit, ye are not under the law.

rr: 19 Mbwenu emirimo y'obuzaarwa bw'omubiri neemanywa, niyo egi: obushambani, ebirikwitsa enshoni, okurigira okubi
en: 19 Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these ; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,

rr: 20 okuramya ebishushani, okuroga, obuzigu, okurwana, eihari, ekiniga, empaka, okwebaganisamu, okurwanira orubanju
en: 20 idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,

21 envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of the which I tell you before, as I have also told you in time past, that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.

rr: 22 Kwonka ebyana by'Omwoyo nibyo ebi: okukunda, okushemererwa, obusingye, okugumisiriza, embabazi, oburungi, obwesigwa
en: 22 But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,
23 meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
24 And they that are Christ's have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.

rr: 25 Ku turaabe turiho ahabw'Omwoyo, ka tugyendere omu Mwoyo.
en: 25 If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.
26 Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.
1 Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted.

rr: 2 Muhwerahwerane emitwaro yaanyu, mubone kuhikiiriza mutyo ekiragiro kya Kristo.
en: 2 Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.

rr: 3 Ahakuba omuntu orikweteekateekaho ngu n'ekintu, haza kunu ataine ku ari, naaba naayebeiha.
en: 3 For if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.
4 But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.

rr: 5 Ahabw'okuba omuntu weena aryayekorera omutwaro gwe wenka.
en: 5 For every man shall bear his own burden.
6 Let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things.

rr: 7 Mutabeihwebeihwa; Ruhanga tagaaniizibwa; ahakuba ebi omuntu abiba nibyo agyesha.

rr: Ahakuba ebiro mushanju ku biraahwe, niinyija kugwisa enjura aha nsi okumara ebiro makumi ana, nyomushana na nyekiro; kandi buri kintu kyona ekihuriire eki naahangire, ndyakimariraho kimwe aha nsi.
en: For yet seven days, and I will cause it to rain upon the earth forty days and forty nights; and every living substance that I have made will I destroy from off the face of the earth.

rr: Noa yaakora byona nk'oku MUKAMA yaamuragiire.
en: And Noah did according unto all that the LORD commanded him.

rr: Obu omwegyemure gw'amaizi gwaija aha nsi, Noa akaba ahikize emyaka magana mukaaga.
en: And Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters was upon the earth.

rr: Noa yaataaha omuri egyo meeri n'abatabani n'omukazi we na bakaamwana, ahabw'omwegyemure gw'amaizi.
en: And Noah went in, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him, into the ark, because of the waters of the flood.

rr: Aha nyamaishwa ezitarikuzira n'ezirikuzira n'aha birikuguruka, n'aha birikugyendesa enda byona
en: Of clean beasts, and of beasts that are not clean, and of fowls, and of every thing that creepeth upon the earth,

rr: haataaha bibiri bibiri, byashanga Noa omu meeri, ekishaija n'ekikazi, nk'oku Ruhanga yaaragiire Noa.
en: there went in two and two unto Noah into the ark, the male and the female, as God had commanded Noah.

rr: Ebiro mushanju ku byahingwire, omwegyemure gw'amaizi gwashandaara aha nsi.
en: And it came to pass after seven days, that the waters of the flood were upon the earth. The Great Flood

rr: Omu mwaka gwa Noa ogwa magana mukaaga omu kwezi kwa kabiri aha kiro kya ikumi na mushanju, eryo izooba enshuro zoona ez'okuzimu zikaiguka, n'amadirisa g'omu iguru gaigurwa.
en: In the six hundredth year of Noah's life, in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, the same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened.

rr: Enjura yaamara ebiro makumi ana neegwa nyomushana na nyekiro.
en: And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.

rr: Eryo izooba Noa n'abatabani, Sheemu, Haamu na Yafeesi, n'omukazi we na bakaamwana bashatu baataaha omu meeri.
en: In the selfsame day entered Noah, and Shem, and Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noah's wife, and the three wives of his sons with them, into the ark;

rr: Bo n'enyamaishwa zoona omu miringo yaazo, n'amatungo goona omu miringo yaago, n'ebirikugyendesa enda ahansi byona omu miringo yaabyo, n'ebirikuguruka byona, enyonyi z'emiringo yoona
en: they, and every beast after his kind, and all the cattle after their kind, and every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind, and every fowl after his kind, every bird of every sort.

rr: byona byashanga Noa omu meeri, bibiri bibiri ahari byona ebiine omubiri n'omwitsyo gw'amagara.
en: And they went in unto Noah into the ark, two and two of all flesh, wherein is the breath of life.

rr: Ebyataahiremu byona hakataaha ekishaija n'ekikazi, nk'oku Ruhanga yaamuragiire; MUKAMA yaamukingiranamu.
en: And they that went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God had commanded him: and the LORD shut him in.

rr: Omwegyemure gwamara aha nsi ebiro makumi ana; amaizi gaakanya, gaimutsya emeeri, yaaruga aha nsi.
en: And the flood was forty days upon the earth; and the waters increased, and bare up the ark, and it was lift up above the earth.

rr: Amaizi gaakanya, gaaba maingi munonga aha nsi; emeeri yaaguma neegazeereeraho.
en: And the waters prevailed, and were increased greatly upon the earth; and the ark went upon the face of the waters.

rr: Amaizi gaayeyongyera munonga kushandaara aha nsi; enshozi zoona ez'ahansi y'eiguru zaashwekwa amaizi.
en: And the waters prevailed exceedingly upon the earth; and all the high hills, that were under the whole heaven, were covered.

rr: Amaizi gaayeyongyera kwijura, gaahika ahaiguru mikono ikumi n'etaano okuruga aha mitwe y'enshozi.
en: Fifteen cubits upward did the waters prevail; and the mountains were covered.

rr: Ebiine omubiri byona ebirikwegyendesa byafa, ebirikuguruka n'amatungo n'enyamaishwa n'ebirikugyendesa enda ahansi byona, na buri muntu weena
en: And all flesh died that moved upon the earth, both of fowl, and of cattle, and of beast, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth, and every man:

rr: byona ebyabaire biri ahansi, ebiine omwitsyo gw'amagara, byafa.
en: all in whose nostrils was the breath of life, of all that was in the dry land , died.

rr: Buri kintu kyona ekihuriire ekyabaire kiri ahansi kyacwekyerezibwa, abantu, enyamaishwa, ebirikugyendesa enda n'ebirikuguruka omu mwanya; byamarirwaho kimwe omu nsi; Noa wenka yaaba niwe yaatsigaraho, n'abu yaabaire aine omu meeri.
en: And every living substance was destroyed which was upon the face of the ground, both man, and cattle, and the creeping things, and the fowl of the heaven; and they were destroyed from the earth: and Noah only remained alive , and they that were with him in the ark.

rr: Kandi amaizi gaamara ebiro igana na makumi ataano, gakishandaire aha nsi.
en: And the waters prevailed upon the earth an hundred and fifty days.

rr: Ruhanga yaijuka Noa n'ebiine amagara byona, n'amatungo goona agu yaabaire aine omu meeri; Ruhanga yaareeta omuyaga gwahuuha ensi, amaizi gaatandika kwijururuka.
en: And God remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the cattle that was with him in the ark: and God made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters asswaged;

rr: Enshuro z'okuzimu n'amadirisa g'omu iguru byaigarwa, n'enjura eyaabaire neeruga omu iguru yaazibirwa
en: the fountains also of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped, and the rain from heaven was restrained;

rr: amaizi gaaguma nigatuuba aha nsi; bwanyima y'ebiro igana na makumi ataano amaizi gaabaganukaho
en: and the waters returned from off the earth continually: and after the end of the hundred and fifty days the waters were abated.

rr: emeeri yaahika aha nshozi za Araraati aha kiro kya ikumi na mushanju ky'okwezi kwa mushanju.
en: And the ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of Ararat.

rr: Amaizi gaaguma nigatuuba okuhitsya omu kwezi kwa ikumi; aha kiro ky'okubanza eky'okwo kwezi emitwe y'ebibungo yaareebeka.
en: And the waters decreased continually until the tenth month: in the tenth month , on the first day of the month, were the tops of the mountains seen.

rr: Ku haahingwireho ebiro makumi ana, Noa yaigura edirisa y'emeeri ei yaakozire
en: And it came to pass at the end of forty days, that Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made:

rr: yaashohoza ekikoona, kyaguma nikizengyerera okuhitsya obu amaizi gaayomeire kimwe aha nsi.
en: and he sent forth a raven, which went forth to and fro, until the waters were dried up from off the earth.

rr: Kandi yaashohoza enkombe, ngu amanye amaizi ku garaabe gaayomire ahansi
en: Also he sent forth a dove from him, to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground;

rr: kwonka enkombe tiyaabona h'okuteekama, yaagaruka kumushanga omu meeri, ahabw'okuba amaizi gakaba gakishwekire ensi yoona; yaashohoza omukono gwe, yaagikwata, yaagitaasya omu meeri.
en: but the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot, and she returned unto him into the ark, for the waters were on the face of the whole earth: then he put forth his hand, and took her, and pulled her in unto him into the ark.

rr: Yaamara ebiro mushanju, yaagaruka yaashohoza egyo nkombe
en: And he stayed yet other seven days; and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark;

rr: egyo nkombe yaagaruka ahariwe omu mwabazyo; kandi reeba, ekaba eine akababi k'omuzeituuni omu kanwa. Ekyo kyamanyisa Noa ku amaizi gaatuubire aha nsi.
en: and the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth was an olive leaf pluckt off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.

rr: Noa yaamara ebindi biro mushanju, yaashohoza egyo nkombe; yaagyenderayo, tiyaagaruka.
en: And he stayed yet other seven days; and sent forth the dove; which returned not again unto him any more.

rr: Omu mwaka gwa magana mukaaga na gumwe, omu kwezi kw'okubanza, aha kiro ky'okubanza, amaizi gaayomera kimwe aha nsi; Noa yaihaho ekyabaire kishwekire emeeri, yaanaga amaisho aheeru, kandi reeba, ahansi hakaba hoomire.
en: And it came to pass in the six hundredth and first year, in the first month , the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from off the earth: and Noah removed the covering of the ark, and looked, and, behold, the face of the ground was dry.

rr: Kandi omu kwezi kwa kabiri, aha kiro kya makumi abiri na mushanju, ensi yaayomera kimwe.
en: And in the second month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, was the earth dried.

rr: Ruhanga yaagambira Noa ati
en: And God spake unto Noah, saying,

rr: Shohora orugye omu meeri, n'omukazi waawe na batabani baawe na bakaamwana baawe.
en: Go forth of the ark, thou, and thy wife, and thy sons, and thy sons' wives with thee.

rr: Kandi oshohoze byona ebiine amagara ebi obaire oine, ebiine omubiri byona, ebirikuguruka n'enyamaishwa n'ebirikwekurura ahansi, bibone kuzaara munonga omu nsi, bikanye, bigiijuremu.
en: Bring forth with thee every living thing that is with thee, of all flesh, both of fowl, and of cattle, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth; that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply upon the earth.

rr: Noa yaashohora n'abatabani n'omukazi we na bakaamwana
en: And Noah went forth, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him:

rr: enyamaishwa zoona, ebirikugyendesa enda byona, ebirikuguruka byona, na byona ebirikwegyendesa aha nsi, nk'enganda zaabyo oku zaabaire ziri, byaruga omu meeri.
en: every beast, every creeping thing, and every fowl, and whatsoever creepeth upon the earth, after their kinds, went forth out of the ark.

rr: Bwanyima Noa yaayombekyera MUKAMA eitambiro, yaatoorana enyamaishwa n'ebirikuguruka ebya buri ruganda orutarikuzira, yaabitambira aha itambiro kuba ebitambo byokize.
en: And Noah builded an altar unto the LORD ; and took of every clean beast, and of every clean fowl, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.

rr: MUKAMA yaahurira ekisooroora kirungi, yaagira omu mutima gwe ati: Tindikyeena nsi obundi ningitura omuntu, ahakuba ebiteekateeko by'omumutima gw'omuntu biba bibi okuruga omu buto bwe; kandi tindigaruka kwita kintu kyona ekiine amagara, nk'oku nkozire.
en: And the LORD smelled a sweet savour; and the LORD said in his heart, I will not again curse the ground any more for man's sake; for the imagination of man's heart is evil from his youth; neither will I again smite any more every thing living, as I have done.

rr: Omu bunaku bwona ensi ekiriho, eibiba n'eigyesha, embeho n'obutagatsi, ekyanda n'eitumba, nyomushana na nyekiro, tibirihwaho.
en: While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.

rr: Ruhanga yaaha Noa n'abatabani omugisha, yaabagira ati: Muzaare, mukanye, mwijure ensi.
en: And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth.

rr: Enyamaishwa zoona ez'omu nsi n'ebirikuguruka byona muryabiitsa obwoba, bibatiine, na byona ebirikugyendesa enda ahansi n'eby'omu nyanja byona; mubihairwe kubitegyeka.
en: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth, and upon every fowl of the air, upon all that moveth upon the earth, and upon all the fishes of the sea; into your hand are they delivered.

rr: Ebirikwegyendesa byona ebiine amagara biryaba eby'okurya byanyu; mbibahaire byona, nk'oku naabahaire ebirikumera.
en: Every moving thing that liveth shall be meat for you; even as the green herb have I given you all things.

rr: Kwonka mutarirya enyama n'amagara gaayo, niyo shagama yaayo.
en: But flesh with the life thereof, which is the blood thereof, shall ye not eat.

rr: Kandi buzima eshagama y'amagara gaanyu ndyagihoora, ngihoorere enyamaishwa yoona n'omuntu; amagara g'omuntu weena ndyagahoora ahabwa mugyenzi we.
en: And surely your blood of your lives will I require; at the hand of every beast will I require it, and at the hand of man; at the hand of every man's brother will I require the life of man.

rr: Orisheesha eshagama y'omuntu, n'eye baryagisheesha; ahakuba Ruhanga akahangira omuntu omu muringo gwe.
en: Whoso sheddeth man's blood, by man shall his blood be shed: for in the image of God made he man.

rr: Mbwenu muzaare, mukanye, muzaare munonga omu nsi, mugiijure.
en: And you, be ye fruitful, and multiply; bring forth abundantly in the earth, and multiply therein. The Rainbow

rr: Ruhanga yaagambira Noa n'abatabani, ati
en: And God spake unto Noah, and to his sons with him, saying,

rr: Reeba, nyowe naahamya endagaano yangye naimwe, kandi na baijukuru baanyu abaribakurata
en: And I, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your seed after you;

rr: n'ebihangirwe byona ebiine amagara ebiri hamwe naimwe, ebirikuguruka, amatungo n'enyamaishwa yoona eri hamwe naimwe omu nsi, nka byona ebirugire omu meeri oku biri.
en: and with every living creature that is with you, of the fowl, of the cattle, and of every beast of the earth with you; from all that go out of the ark, to every beast of the earth.

rr: Kandi nimpamya endagaano yangye naimwe, ebiine omubiri byona tibirigaruka kucwekyerezibwa maizi g'omwegyemure; kandi tiharigaruka kubaho mwegyemure kucwekyereza ensi.
en: And I will establish my covenant with you; neither shall all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of a flood; neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth.

rr: Ruhanga yaagira ati: Aka niko kamanyiso k'endagaano ei naaragaana naimwe na buri kihangirwe kyona ekiine amagara ekiri hamwe naimwe okuhitsya obusingye bwona
en: And God said, This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:

rr: naata omuhanganzima gwangye omu kicu, gugume guri akamanyiso k'endagaano ei naaragaana n'ensi.
en: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.

rr: Ahundihikisiza enjura hoona, omuhanganzima gwareebeka omu bicu
en: And it shall come to pass, when I bring a cloud over the earth, that the bow shall be seen in the cloud:

rr: ndyaijuka endagaano yangye naimwe n'ekihangirwe kyona ekiine omubiri; amaizi tigarigaruka kuba omwegyemure gw'okuhwerekyereza ebiine omubiri byona.
en: and I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.

rr: Omuhanganzima ku guriba guri omu bicu, ndyagureeba, nyijukye endagaano etarihwaho ey'Omuhangi n'ekihangirwe kyona ekiine amagara ekiri omu nsi.
en: And the bow shall be in the cloud; and I will look upon it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is upon the earth.

rr: Ruhanga yaagambira Noa ati: Aka niko kamanyiso ak'endagaano ei naaragaana n'ebiine omubiri byona, ebiri aha nsi. Ekibi kya Noa
en: And God said unto Noah, This is the token of the covenant, which I have established between me and all flesh that is upon the earth.

rr: Batabani ba Noa abaarugire omu meeri ni Sheemu, Haamu na Yafeesi; kandi Haamu niwe ishe wa Kanaani.
en: And the sons of Noah, that went forth of the ark, were Shem, and Ham, and Japheth: and Ham is the father of Canaan.

rr: Abo bonshatu nibo batabani ba Noa; kandi nibo baakomookirweho abaabugire ensi yoona.
en: These are the three sons of Noah: and of them was the whole earth overspread.

rr: Noa yaatandika kuhinga; yaabyara omusiri gw'emizaabibu
en: And Noah began to be an husbandman, and he planted a vineyard:

rr: yaanywa viinyo yaayo, yaasinda, yaabyama omu ihema rye ajwaire busha.
en: and he drank of the wine, and was drunken; and he was uncovered within his tent.

rr: Haamu ishe wa Kanaani ku yaareebire ishe ajwaire busha, yaashohora, yaagambira bakuru be aheeru.
en: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brethren without.

rr: Sheemu na Yafeesi baatwara ekijwaro, bakitaire aha mabega gaabo bombi, baagyenda ekisiganyima, baashweka ishebo ajwaire busha.
en: And Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it upon both their shoulders, and went backward, and covered the nakedness of their father; and their faces were backward, and they saw not their father's nakedness.

rr: Noa ku yaasinduukire, yaamanya eki omutabani omuto akozire
en: And Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his younger son had done unto him.

rr: yaagira ati: Kanaani akyeenwe; aryaba omuhuuku w'abahuuku ahari beene ishe.
en: And he said, Cursed be Canaan; A servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren.

rr: Kandi ati: MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Sheemu asiimwe; kandi Kanaani abe omuhuuku we.
en: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Shem; And Canaan shall be his servant.

rr: Ruhanga ahangusye Yafeesi; atuure omu mahema ga Sheemu, kandi Kanaani abe omuhuuku we.
en: God shall enlarge Japheth, And he shall dwell in the tents of Shem; And Canaan shall be his servant.

rr: Bwanyima y'omwegyemure Noa yaamara emyaka magana ashatu na makumi ataano.
en: And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.

rr: Emyaka yoona ei Noa yaamazire, yaahika magana mwenda na makumi ataano; yaafa.
en: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years: and he died.

rr: Oru nirwo ruzaaro rwa beene Noa, Sheemu, Haamu na Yafeesi; omwegyemure gw'amaizi ku gwahweireho, baazaara abaana b'aboojo.
en: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth: and unto them were sons born after the flood.

rr: 1 Aba nibo batabani ba Yafeesi, Gomeri, Magogi, Madai, Yavani, Tubalo, Mesheki na Tirasi.
en: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.

rr: Batabani ba Gomeri ni Ashikenaazi, Rifaasi, na Togaruma
en: And the sons of Gomer; Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.

rr: Batabani ba Yavani ni Elisha, Tarushiishi, Kitimu na Dodanimu.
en: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

rr: Abo nibo baakomookirweho abantu abaabugire ensi ez'aha rubaju rw'enyanja; kandi abo nibo beene Yafeesi, buri omwe nk'orurimi rwe oku ruri, omu miryango yaabo n'omumahanga gaabo.
en: By these were the isles of the Gentiles divided in their lands; every one after his tongue, after their families, in their nations.

rr: Aba nibo batabani ba Haamu, Kuushi, Miziraimu, Puuti na Kanaani.
en: And the sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, and Phut, and Canaan.

rr: Batabani ba Kuushi ni Seeba, Havila, Sabuta, Raama na Sabuteeka; na batabani ba Raama ni Sheeba na Dedani.
en: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabtah, and Raamah, and Sabtechah: and the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.

rr: Na Kuushi yaazaara Nimuroodi; yaatandika kuba emanzi omu nsi.
en: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be a mighty one in the earth.

rr: Akaba ari omuhiigi rugambwa omu maisho ga MUKAMA; nk'oku bagira ngu, N'omuhiigi rugambwa omu maisho ga MUKAMA nka Nimuroodi.
en: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD : wherefore it is said, Even as Nimrod the mighty hunter before the LORD .

rr: Ensi ei yaabandiizemu kuba omugabe ni Shinaari, eyaabaire erimu Babeeli, Ereki, Akadi na Kalune.
en: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel, and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

rr: Okuruga okwo yaagumizamu yaaza Ashuri, yaayombeka Nineeve, Rehoboosira, Kaala
en: Out of that land went forth Asshur, and builded Nineveh, and the city Rehoboth, and Calah,

rr: na Reseni ey'ahagati ya Nineeve na Kaala, (nirwo rurembo rukuru).
en: and Resen between Nineveh and Calah: the same is a great city.

rr: Miziraimu yaazaara Ludimu, Anamimu, Lehabimu, Nafutuhimu
en: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,

rr: Patirusimu, Kasiluhimu (owaakomookirweho Abafilistia) na Kafutorimu.
en: and Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (out of whom came Philistim,) and Caphtorim.

rr: Na Kanaani yaazaara Sidoni omwana w'omujigaijo na Heesi
en: And Canaan begat Sidon his firstborn, and Heth,

rr: n'Abayebusi, Abaamori, Abagirugashi
en: and the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgasite,

rr: Abahiivi, Abaaruki, Abasini
en: and the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,

rr: Abaarivadi, Abazemari, n'Abahamasi. Bwanyima emiryango y'Abanyakanaani yaabuga hoona.
en: and the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite: and afterward were the families of the Canaanites spread abroad.

rr: Omwatano gw'Abanyakanaani gukaba nigutandikira Sidoni, gugyema Gerari okuhika Gaaza, kandi gutoora Sodoma, Gomora, Aduma na Zeboimu okuhika Lasha.
en: And the border of the Canaanites was from Sidon, as thou comest to Gerar, unto Gaza; as thou goest, unto Sodom, and Gomorrah, and Admah, and Zeboim, even unto Lasha.

rr: Abo nibo beene Haamu nk'emiryango yaabo n'endimi zaabo, n'ensi zaabo n'amahanga gaabo oku byabaire biri.
en: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their countries, and in their nations.

rr: Na Sheemu mukuru wa Yafeesi, ishenkuru w'abaana ba Eberi boona, nawe yaazaara abaana.
en: Unto Shem also, the father of all the children of Eber, the brother of Japheth the elder, even to him were children born.

rr: Aba nibo beene Sheemu, Elamu, Ashuri, Arufakisaadi. Ludi na Aramu.
en: The children of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram.

rr: Aramu yaazaara Uzi, Huli, Geseri, na Maasha.
en: And the children of Aram; Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Mash.

rr: Arufakisaadi yaazaara Sheela, na Sheela yaazaara Eberi.
en: And Arphaxad begat Salah; and Salah begat Eber.

rr: Eberi yaazaara aboojo babiri; eiziina ry'omwe akaba ari Pelegi, ahabw'okuba omu bunaku bwe nibwo abantu b'omu nsi baabaganisibwamu; kandi omurumuna akaba naayetwa Yokitaani.
en: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of one was Peleg; for in his days was the earth divided; and his brother's name was Joktan.

rr: Yokitaani yaazaara Alimodaadi, Shelefu, Hazarimaveesi, Yeera
en: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,

rr: Hadoramu, Uzali, Dikila
en: and Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,

rr: Obali, Abimaeli, Sheeba
en: and Obal, and Abimael, and Sheba,

rr: Ofiri, Havila, na Yobabu; abo boona ni beene Yokitaani.
en: and Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab: all these were the sons of Joktan.

rr: Ensi ei baabaire batwiremu, ekaba neetandikira Meesha, etoora Sefari, ehika omu nsi y'ebibungo oburugwa-izooba.
en: And their dwelling was from Mesha, as thou goest unto Sephar a mount of the east.

rr: Abo nibo baana ba Sheemu nk'emiryango yaabo n'endimi zaabo n'ensi zaabo n'amahanga gaabo oku byabaire biri.
en: These are the sons of Shem, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, after their nations.

rr: Egyo niyo miryango ya beene Noa nk'oruzaaro rwabo n'amahanga gaabo oku byabaire biri; kandi nibo baakomookirweho amahanga agaabugire hoona omu nsi bwanyima y'omwegyemure.
en: These are the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations: and by these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.

rr: Currently Selected: Okutandika 10 : RR64 Highlight Share <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="even
Ensi yoona ekaba eine orurimi rumwe n'engambo emwe.
en: And the whole earth was of one language, and of one speech.

rr: Ku baafurukiire oburugwa-izooba, baareeba oruhita omu nsi ya Shinaari; baarutuuramu.
en: And it came to pass, as they journeyed from the east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar; and they dwelt there.

rr: Baagambirana bati: Mwije tubumbe, amatafaari, tugootsye gye.
en: And they said one to another, Go to, let us make brick, and burn them throughly.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo baagira amatafaari omu mwanya gw'amabaare, na koroto omu mwanya gw'obudongo.
en: And they had brick for stone, and slime had they for morter.

rr: Baagira bati: Mwije tweyombekyere orurembo n'omunaara, guhikye ahaiguru, tubone kurangaanwa, turekye kutaataanira hoona omu nsi yoona.
en: And they said, Go to, let us build us a city and a tower, whose top may reach unto heaven; and let us make us a name, lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.

rr: MUKAMA yaashuuma kureeba orurembo n'omunaara, ebi abantu baabaire nibombeka.
en: And the LORD came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men builded.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira ati: Reeba, abantu aba n'eihanga rimwe, kandi baine orurimi rumwe; ku baraabe baatandika kukora ebi, omu bi barikuteekateeka kukora, tihariho kiribarema.
en: And the LORD said, Behold, the people is one, and they have all one language; and this they begin to do: and now nothing will be restrained from them, which they have imagined to do.

rr: Katushuume tuhindahindure orurimi rwabo, barekye kuhurirana.
en: Go to, let us go down, and there confound their language, that they may not understand one another's speech.

rr: Atyo MUKAMA yaabataataanisa, baarugayo, baabuga ensi yoona; baarekyera aho kwombeka orurembo.
en: So the LORD scattered them abroad from thence upon the face of all the earth: and they left off to build the city.

rr: Nikyo rwayeteirwe Babeeli; ahakuba niho MUKAMA yaahindahindwire orurimi rw'ensi yoona; kandi okuruga obwo MUKAMA yaabataataanisa, baabuga ensi yoona.
en: Therefore is the name of it called Babel; because the LORD did there confound the language of all the earth: and from thence did the LORD scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth.

rr: Oruzaaro rwa Sheemu
en: Ancestors of Abraham

rr: Oru nirwo ruzaaro rwa Sheemu. Ku yaabaire aine emyaka igana, omwegyemure gumazire emyaka ebiri guhweireho, yaazaara Arufakisaadi.
en: These are the generations of Shem: Shem was an hundred years old, and begat Arphaxad two years after the flood:

rr: Ku yaaherize kuzaara Arufakisaadi, yaamara emyaka magana ataano, ei yaazaariiremu abaana b'aboojo n'ab'abaishiki.
en: and Shem lived after he begat Arphaxad five hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.

rr: Arufakisaadi, ku yaamazire emyaka makumi ashatu n'etaano, yaazaara Sheela
en: And Arphaxad lived five and thirty years, and begat Salah:

rr: ku yaaherize kuzaara Sheela, yaamara emyaka magana ana n'eshatu ei yaazaariiremu abaana b'aboojo n'ab'abaishiki.
en: and Arphaxad lived after he begat Salah four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.

rr: Sheela ku yaamazire emyaka makumi ashatu, yaazaara Eberi.
en: And Salah lived thirty years, and begat Eber:

rr: Ku yaaherize kuzaara Eberi, yaamara emyaka magana ana n'eshatu, ei yaazaariiremu abaana b'aboojo n'ab'abaishiki.
en: and Salah lived after he begat Eber four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.

rr: Eberi ku yaamazire emyaka makumi ashatu n'ena, yaazaara Pelegi.
en: And Eber lived four and thirty years, and begat Peleg:

rr: Ku yaaherize kuzaara Pelegi, yaamara emyaka magana ana na makumi ashatu, ei yaazaariiremu abaana b'aboojo n'ab'abaishiki.
en: and Eber lived after he begat Peleg four hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters.

rr: Pelegi ku yaamazire emyaka makumi ashatu, yaazaara Reu
en: And Peleg lived thirty years, and begat Reu:

rr: ku yaaherize kuzaara Reu, yaamara emyaka magana abiri na mwenda, ei yaazaariiremu abaana b'aboojo n'ab'abaishiki.
en: and Peleg lived after he begat Reu two hundred and nine years, and begat sons and daughters.

rr: Reu ku yaamazire emyaka makumi ashatu n'ebiri, yaazaara Serugi.
en: And Reu lived two and thirty years, and begat Serug:

rr: Ku yaaherize kuzaara Serugi, yaamara emyaka magana abiri na mushanju, ei yaazaariiremu abaana b'aboojo n'ab'abaishiki.
en: and Reu lived after he begat Serug two hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters.

rr: Serugi ku yaamazire emyaka makumi ashatu, yaazaara Nahori.
en: And Serug lived thirty years, and begat Nahor:

rr: Ku yaaherize kuzaara Nahori, yaamara emyaka magana abiri, ei yaazaariiremu abaana b'aboojo n'ab'abaishiki.
en: and Serug lived after he begat Nahor two hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.

rr: Nahori ku yaamazire emyaka makumi abiri na mwenda, yaazaara Teera
en: And Nahor lived nine and twenty years, and begat Terah:

rr: ku yaaherize kuzaara Teera, yaamara emyaka igana na ikumi na mwenda, ei yaazaariiremu abaana b'aboojo n'ab'abaishiki. Okuzaarwa kwa Abrahamu
en: and Nahor lived after he begat Terah an hundred and nineteen years, and begat sons and daughters.

rr: Teera ku yaamazire emyaka makumi mushanju, yaazaara Abramu, na Nahori na Harani.
en: And Terah lived seventy years, and begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran.

rr: Oru nirwo ruzaaro rwa Teera. Teera akazaara Abramu na Nahori na Harani; Harani yaazaara Looti
en: Now these are the generations of Terah: Terah begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran begat Lot.

rr: Harani yaafa ishe akiriho, yaagwa Uri ey'aba Kaludaaya, omu nsi ei yaazaariirwemu.
en: And Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his nativity, in Ur of the Chaldees.

rr: Abramu na Nahori baashwera; eiziina rya muka Abramu akaba ari Sarai; n'eiziina rya muka Nahori akaba ari Milika, muhara wa Harani, ishe wa Milika, na Isika.
en: And Abram and Nahor took them wives: the name of Abram's wife was Sarai; and the name of Nahor's wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah, and the father of Iscah.

rr: Kwonka Sarai akaba ari engumba, ataine mwana.
en: But Sarai was barren; she had no child.

rr: Teera yaatwara Abramu omutabani, na Looti mwene Harani omwijukuru, na Sarai omukaamwana, muka omutabani Abramu; baaruga kumwe Uri ey'aba Kaludaaya, kuza omu nsi ya Kanaani; kwonka ku baahikire Harani, baaba niyo baatuura.
en: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran his son's son, and Sarai his daughter in law, his son Abram's wife; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan; and they came unto Haran, and dwelt there.

rr: Emyaka yoona ei Teera yaamazire yaahika magana abiri n'etaano; yaafa, yaagwa Harani.
en: And the days of Terah were two hundred and five years: and Terah died in Haran.

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Abramu ati: Ruga omu nsi yaanyu, n'omu ruganda rwanyu n'omu nju ya sho, oze omu nsi ei ndikworeka
en: Now the LORD had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father's house, unto a land that I will shew thee:

rr: ndyakuhindura eihanga rihango; kandi ndyakuha omugisha, ndangaanise eiziina ryawe; naiwe oryahaisa abandi omugisha.
en: and I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing:

rr: Ndyaha omugisha abarikushabira omugisha, n'orikukyeena ndyamukyeena; kandi omuriiwe enganda zoona ez'omu nsi nimwo ziriheerwa omugisha.
en: and I will bless them that bless thee, and curse him that curseth thee: and in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed.

rr: Atyo Abramu yaagyenda, nk'oku MUKAMA yaamugambiire, na Looti yaagyenda nawe; kandi Abramu akaba ahikize emyaka makumi mushanju n'etaano, obu yaaruga Harani.
en: So Abram departed, as the LORD had spoken unto him; and Lot went with him: and Abram was seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran.

rr: Abramu yaagyenda na Sarai omukazi we, na Looti omwana w'omurumuna, n'ebi baabaire batungire byona, n'abantu abu baatungiire Haraani; baarugayo kuza omu nsi ya Kanaani. Ku baahikire omu nsi ya Kanaani
en: And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother's son, and all their substance that they had gathered, and the souls that they had gotten in Haran; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan; and into the land of Canaan they came.

rr: Abramu yaaraba omu nsi egyo, yaahika omu mwanya ogurikwetwa Shekemu aha mwela gwa Moore.
en: And Abram passed through the land unto the place of Sichem, unto the plain of Moreh.

rr: Omu bunaku obwo aba Kanaani bakaba bari omuri egyo nsi.
en: And the Canaanite was then in the land.

rr: MUKAMA yaayeyoreka Abramu, yaamugira ati: Ensi egi ndyagiha oruzaaro rwawe. Aho yaayombekyeraho MUKAMA, owaamweyorekire, eitambiro.
en: And the LORD appeared unto Abram, and said, Unto thy seed will I give this land: and there builded he an altar unto the LORD , who appeared unto him.

rr: Yaarugayo, yaaza omu kibungo aha rubaju rw'oburugwa-izooba bwa Beseeli, emuri oburengyerwa-izooba na Ai oburugwa-izooba; okwo nayo yaayombekyerayo MUKAMA eitambiro, yaatakira eiziina rye.
en: And he removed from thence unto a mountain on the east of Beth-el, and pitched his tent, having Beth-el on the west, and Hai on the east: and there he builded an altar unto the LORD , and called upon the name of the LORD .

rr: Abramu yaagumizamu, naatoora omu nsi ya Negebu. Abramu okuza Misri
en: And Abram journeyed, going on still toward the south.

rr: Bwanyima haabaho enjara omuri egyo nsi; Abramu yaashuuma Misri kushuhuukirayo; ahakuba enjara ekaba eri nyingi omu nsi egyo.
en: And there was a famine in the land: and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there; for the famine was grievous in the land.

rr: Ku yaabaire ari haihi kuhika Misri, yaagambira omukazi we Sarai ati: Reeba nimmanya ku ori omukazi murungi orikureebwa
en: And it came to pass, when he was come near to enter into Egypt, that he said unto Sarai his wife, Behold now, I know that thou art a fair woman to look upon:

rr: kandi aba Misri ku barikureeba, baryagira bati: Ogu n'omukazi we; baanyite, haza iwe bakurekye.
en: therefore it shall come to pass, when the Egyptians shall see thee, that they shall say, This is his wife: and they will kill me, but they will save thee alive.

rr: Mbwenu ninkweshengyereza, ogume ogire oti: Ni munyaanyazi mbone kutunga omugisha ahabwawe, ndekye kufa, nkaba niiwe naazira.
en: Say, I pray thee, thou art my sister: that it may be well with me for thy sake; and my soul shall live because of thee.

rr: Abramu ku yaahikire Misri, aba Misri baareeba omukazi ari murungi munonga.
en: And it came to pass, that, when Abram was come into Egypt, the Egyptians beheld the woman that she was very fair.

rr: Abanyiginya ba Faraho baamureeba, baamusiimira Faraho; bwanyima baamutwara omu nju ya Faraho.
en: The princes also of Pharaoh saw her, and commended her before Pharaoh: and the woman was taken into Pharaoh's house.

rr: Faraho yaatwaza gye Abramu ahabwa Sarai; kandi Abramu akaba aine entaama n'ente n'enimi z'endogoya n'abahuuku n'abazaana, ebuguma z'endogoya n'engamira.
en: And he entreated Abram well for her sake: and he had sheep, and oxen, and he asses, and menservants, and maidservants, and she asses, and camels.

rr: MUKAMA yaareetera Faraho n'eka ye ebibonaboneso bingi ahabwa Sarai muka Abramu.
en: And the LORD plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai Abram's wife.

rr: Faraho yaatuma Abramu, yaamugira ati: Beitu shi, ontuzire ki? Ahabw'enki tongambiire ku ari omukazi waawe?
en: And Pharaoh called Abram, and said, What is this that thou hast done unto me? why didst thou not tell me that she was thy wife?

rr: Ongiriire ki oti: Ni munyaanazi? Naanye nikyo mmutwariire kuba omukazi wangye. Mbwenu omukazi waawe ngugwo, omutware, oyegyendere.
en: Why saidst thou, She is my sister? so I might have taken her to me to wife: now therefore behold thy wife, take her , and go thy way.

rr: Faraho nikwo kuragiira abashaija be oku baraamutwaze; batyo bakamushendekyereza n'omukazi we n'ebi yaabaire aine byona.
en: And Pharaoh commanded his men concerning him: and they sent him away, and his wife, and all that he had.

rr: Currently Selected: Okutandika 12 : RR64 Highlight Share <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8 19c-2.828 0-4.243 0-5.121-.879C2 17.243
Abramu yaaruga Misri n'omukazi we n'ebi yaabaire aine byona, na Looti, baataaha Negebu.
en: And Abram went up out of Egypt, he, and his wife, and all that he had, and Lot with him, into the south.

rr: Kandi Abramu akaba ari omutungi munonga, aine amatungo maingi n'efeeza n'ezaabu.
en: And Abram was very rich in cattle, in silver, and in gold.

rr: Yaaruga omuri Negebu, yaagumizamu okuhika Beseeli, yaahika omu mwanya ahagati ya Beseeli na Ai, ahu yaabandize kuteera eihema omu kubanza
en: And he went on his journeys from the south even to Beth-el, unto the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Beth-el and Hai;

rr: kandi aho niho eitambiro eri yaabandize kwombeka, ryabaire riri. Okwo Abramu yaatakirirayo eiziina rya MUKAMA.
en: unto the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first: and there Abram called on the name of the LORD .

rr: Kandi Looti nawe, owaagyenzire na Abramu, akaba aine amasyo g'entaama n'ag'ente n'amahema.
en: And Lot also, which went with Abram, had flocks, and herds, and tents.

rr: Ensi egyo ekaba etabahikire kugituuranamu, ahakuba amatungo gaabo gakaba gari maingi; nikyo baabaire batarikubaasiza kutuura hamwe omuri obwo bunaku.
en: And the land was not able to bear them, that they might dwell together: for their substance was great, so that they could not dwell together.

rr: Abariisa b'Abramu n'aba Looti baagira empaka. Omu bunaku obwo Abanyakanaani n'Abaperizi bakaba batwire omu nsi egyo.
en: And there was a strife between the herdmen of Abram's cattle and the herdmen of Lot's cattle: and the Canaanite and the Perizzite dwelled then in the land.

rr: Abramu yaagambira Looti ati: Ninkweshengyereza, turekye kugirirana amahari, n'obu baakuba abariisa bangye n'abaawe; ahabw'okuba turi ishe-emwe.
en: And Abram said unto Lot, Let there be no strife, I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdmen and thy herdmen; for we be brethren.

rr: -18 ; . Ensi yoona tekuri omumaisho? Naakweshengyereza, reka tutaane; ku oraatware orubaju bumosho, naanye niinyija aha kuza aha rwa buryo; nari shi ku oraatware orwa buryo, nyowe niinyija kuza aha rwa bumosho.
en: Is not the whole land before thee? separate thyself, I pray thee, from me: if thou wilt take the left hand, then I will go to the right; or if thou depart to the right hand, then I will go to the left.

rr: Looti yaanaga amaisho, yaareeba oruhita rwa Yorudani rwona okuhika Zoari, nirufuka rwona nk'omusiri gwa MUKAMA, nari nk'ensi ya Misri, MUKAMA atakahwerekyereize Sodoma na Gomora.
en: And Lot lifted up his eyes, and beheld all the plain of Jordan, that it was well watered every where, before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, even as the garden of the LORD , like the land of Egypt, as thou comest unto Zoar.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo Looti yaihamu oruhita rwa Yorudani rwona; yaatoora oburugwa-izooba. Okwo nikwo baataine.
en: Then Lot chose him all the plain of Jordan; and Lot journeyed east: and they separated themselves the one from the other.

rr: Abramu yaatuura omu nsi ya Kanaani, na Looti yaatuura omu ndembo z'omu ruhita; yaafurura eihema rye, yaariteera haihi na Sodoma.
en: Abram dwelled in the land of Canaan, and Lot dwelled in the cities of the plain, and pitched his tent toward Sodom.

rr: Kwonka abantu ba Sodoma bakaba bari abanyabibi, nibacumura munonga ahari MUKAMA. Ruhanga okuragaana na Abramu endagaano
en: But the men of Sodom were wicked and sinners before the LORD exceedingly.

rr: Bwanyima MUKAMA yaagambira Abramu, aherize kutaana na Looti, ati: Yema omumwanya ogu orimu, onagye amaisho, oreebe obukiizi-bwa bumosho n'obwa-buryo, oburubwa-izooba n'oburengyerwa-izooba
en: And the LORD said unto Abram, after that Lot was separated from him, Lift up now thine eyes, and look from the place where thou art northward, and southward, and eastward, and westward:

rr: ahakuba ensi egi yoona ei orikureeba, ndyagikuha, ebe eyaawe kandi n'eya baijukuru baawe okuhitsya ebiro byona.
en: for all the land which thou seest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed for ever.

rr: Kandi oruzaaro rwawe ndyarukanyisa, rube nk'omucuucu gw'ahansi; omuntu ku araabe naabaasa kubara omucuucu gw'ahansi, na baijukuru baawe nabo aryabaasa kubabara.
en: And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth: so that if a man can number the dust of the earth, then shall thy seed also be numbered.

rr: Imuka ogyende, orabe omu nsi egi, oreebe oburaingwa n'obuhango bwayo; ahakuba niiwe ndigiha.
en: Arise, walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it; for I will give it unto thee.

rr: Abramu nikwo kufurura eihema rye, akagyenda, akatuura haihi n'emyela ya Mamure eyaabaire eri Heburooni, akombekyerayo MUKAMA eitambiro.
en: Then Abram removed his tent, and came and dwelt in the plain of Mamre, which is in Hebron, and built there an altar unto the LORD .

en: Currently Selected: Genesis 13 : KJV Highlight Share <div class="text-text-light dar

rr: Omu biro bya Amurafeli omugabe wa Shinaari, na Arioki omugabe wa Elasaari, na Kedolaomeeri omugabe wa Elamu, na Tidali omugabe wa Goyimu
en: And it came to pass in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of nations;

rr: abo bagabe bakarwanisa Beera omugabe wa Sodoma na Birusha omugabe wa Gomora, na Shinabu omugabe wa Aduma, na Shemebeeri omugabe wa Zeboimu, n'omugabe wa Beela (niyo Zoari).
en: that these made war with Bera king of Sodom, and with Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, and Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela, which is Zoar.

rr: Abo boona baateeranira engabo zaabo omu ruhita rwa Sidimu, niyo Nyanja y'omwonyo.
en: All these were joined together in the vale of Siddim, which is the salt sea.

rr: Bakaba bamazire emyaka ikumi n'ebiri nibakorera Kedolaomeeri; kwonka omu mwaka gwa ikumi n'eshatu baamugomera.
en: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.

rr: Bwanyima omu mwaka gwa ikumi n'ena Kedolaomeeri yaija n'abagabe abaahurwire nawe, baateera aba Reefa ab'omuri Ashetaroosi-karunaimu, n'aba Zuuzi omuri Haamu, n'aba Emimu omuri Shave-kiryasaimu
en: And in the fourteenth year came Chedorlaomer, and the kings that were with him, and smote the Rephaims in Ashteroth Karnaim, and the Zuzims in Ham, and the Emims in Shaveh Kiriathaim,

rr: n'aba Hoori, omu bibungo byabo bya Seiri, okuhika Eli-parani, haihi n'eihamba; baabagomoora.
en: and the Horites in their mount Seir, unto El-paran, which is by the wilderness.

rr: Bwanyima baagaruka, baahika Enimishipati (niyo Kadeshi), baakubuura ensi yoona ey'Abaamaleki, n'Abaamori abaabaire batwire Hazazori-tamaari.
en: And they returned, and came to En-mishpat, which is Kadesh, and smote all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that dwelt in Hazezon-tamar.

rr: Bwanyima haahurura omugabe wa Sodoma n'owa Gomora n'owa Aduma n'owa Zeboimu n'owa Beela (niyo Zoari), baatenga orugamba omu ruhita rwa Sidimu
