rr: MUKAMA yaayeyorekyera Abrahamu aha myela ya Mamure, ashutami omu muryango gw'eihema rye omu ihangwe
en: And the LORD appeared unto him in the plains of Mamre: and he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day;

rr: ku yaimukize amaisho, yaareeba abashaija bashatu beemereire hangahari. Ku yaabareebire, yaimuka omu muryango gw'eihema, yairuka kubabugana, yainama ahansi, yaagira ati
en: and he lift up his eyes and looked, and, lo, three men stood by him: and when he saw them , he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself toward the ground,

rr: Mukama wangye, ku ndaabe ningirirwa embabazi omu maisho gaawe, ninkweshengyereza otahingura omwiru waawe.
en: and said, My Lord, if now I have found favour in thy sight, pass not away, I pray thee, from thy servant:

rr: Kabareete otwizi, munaabe aha bigyere, mwije ahansi y'omuti, muhuumure
en: let a little water, I pray you, be fetched, and wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree:

rr: naanye ndeete akagaati, mugarukwemu amaani mubone kugumizamu, nk'oku mwahunguka aha mwiru waanyu.
en: and I will fetch a morsel of bread, and comfort ye your hearts; after that ye shall pass on: for therefore are ye come to your servant.

rr: Baagira bati: Kora nk'oku waagamba.
en: And they said, So do, as thou hast said.

rr: Abrahamu yaayehuuta, yaataaha omu ihema, yaashangamu Saara, yaamugira ati: Rahuka ogire encuro ishatu z'esaano y'obunono, okibumbabumbe, ogiihemu otugaati.
en: And Abraham hastened into the tent unto Sarah, and said, Make ready quickly three measures of fine meal, knead it , and make cakes upon the hearth.

rr: Kandi yairuka, yaaza omu masyo, yaihamu enyana nto nungi, yaagiha omushumba we, nawe yaagibaaga ahonaaho, yaagiteeka.
en: And Abraham ran unto the herd, and fetcht a calf tender and good, and gave it unto a young man; and he hasted to dress it.

rr: Abrahamu yaatwara amajuta n'amate n'enyama y'enyana ei yaateeka, yaabita omu maisho gaabo; yaaguma ayemereire aha rubaju rwabo ahansi y'omuti, nibarya.
en: And he took butter, and milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them; and he stood by them under the tree, and they did eat.

rr: Baamubuuza bati: Saara omukazi wawe arahi? Yaagarukamu ati: Ari omu ihema.
en: And they said unto him, Where is Sarah thy wife? And he said, Behold, in the tent.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira ati: Buzimazima, obunaku ku burihika, ndyagaruka; kandi reeba, Saara omukazi waawe aryazaara omwana w'omwojo.
en: And he said, I will certainly return unto thee according to the time of life; and, lo, Sarah thy wife shall have a son.

rr: Saara akaba ari omu muryango gw'eihema enyima ye, abihuriire.
en: And Sarah heard it in the tent door, which was behind him.

rr: (Obwo Abrahamu na Saara bakaba bakuzire, bahikire omu ngingo zaabukuru; kandi Saara akaba atakiza mu micwe y'abakazi.)
en: Now Abraham and Sarah were old and well stricken in age; and it ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo Saara yaashekyera aha mutima, naagira ati: Nimbaasa kushemererwa naakaikwire, na ibanye ari omugurusi?
en: Therefore Sarah laughed within herself, saying, After I am waxed old shall I have pleasure, my lord being old also?

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Abrahamu ati: N'enki ekyashetsya Saara, akagira ati: N'eky'amazima ndyazaara omwana nkaikwire?
en: And the LORD said unto Abraham, Wherefore did Sarah laugh, saying, Shall I of a surety bear a child, which am old?

rr: Hariho ekirema MUKAMA?
en: Is any thing too hard for the LORD ?

rr: Omu bunaku obwatairweho ndyagaruka; kandi ebiro bye ku birihika, Saara aryazaara omwana w'omwojo.
en: At the time appointed I will return unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son.

rr: Kwonka Saara yaayehakana ati: Tinaasheka; ahakuba akaba atiinire. Yaamugarukamu ati: Ngaaha! Okusheka kwo waasheka. Ruhanga okumanyisa Abrahamu eby'okuhwerekyereza Sodoma
en: Then Sarah denied, saying, I laughed not; for she was afraid. And he said, Nay; but thou didst laugh. The Cities of the Plain

rr: Abo bashaija baimuka, baarugayo, baagyenda bagyemire Sodoma; na Abrahamu yaabashendekyereza 17-18 MUKAMA yaayebuuza ati: Abrahamu ku araabe arihinduka eihanga rikuru ery'amaani, kandi n'amahanga goona ag'omu nsi gariheerwa omugisha omuriwe, nshemereire kumushereka eki ndikuza kukora?
en: And the men rose up from thence, and looked toward Sodom: and Abraham went with them to bring them on the way.

rr: Ngaaha! Ahakuba nkamutoorana, ngu abone kuragiira abaana be n'ab'omu ka ye abarimukurata, okuguma omu muhanda gwa MUKAMA, nibakora eby'okuhikiirira n'eby'oburyo, ngu MUKAMA abone kureetera Abrahamu ebi yaamugambiire.
en: For I know him, that he will command his children and his household after him, and they shall keep the way of the LORD , to do justice and judgment; that the LORD may bring upon Abraham that which he hath spoken of him.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira ati: Nk'oku okutaka kw'abarikurega Sodoma na Gomora kuri kwingi ahabw'ekibi kyabo ekihinguraine munonga
en: And the LORD said, Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous;

rr: nikyo naaza kushuumira hati, nkareeba kwo, ku baraabe bakozire nk'okutaka kw'abarikubarega, oku mpuriire, oku kuri; nari ku kiraabe kitari kityo, nakyo nkimanye.
en: I will go down now, and see whether they have done altogether according to the cry of it, which is come unto me; and if not, I will know.

rr: Abashaija abo baaruga aho, baagumizamu nibaza Sodoma; kwonka Abrahamu yaaguma ayemereire omu maisho ga MUKAMA. Abrahamu okweshengyerereza aba Sodomu
en: And the men turned their faces from thence, and went toward Sodom: but Abraham stood yet before the LORD .

rr: Abrahamu yaamwirira haihi, yaagira ati: Buzima noija kucwekyereza abahikiriire hamwe n'ababi
en: And Abraham drew near, and said, Wilt thou also destroy the righteous with the wicked?

rr: Mbwenu omu rurembo ku haakuba harimu abahikiriire makumi ataano, okaarucwekyereza, oyanga kurusaasira ahabw'abahikiriire makumi ataano abarimu?
en: Peradventure there be fifty righteous within the city: wilt thou also destroy and not spare the place for the fifty righteous that are therein?

rr: Nikikabure ekyo kukurugaho, okwita abahikiriire hamwe n'ababi, n'okureeba abahikiriire nibatwazibwa nk'ababi! Ekyo nikikabure! Omucwi w'emanja z'ensi yoona tarikora ebihikire?
en: That be far from thee to do after this manner, to slay the righteous with the wicked: and that the righteous should be as the wicked, that be far from thee: Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right?

rr: MUKAMA yaagarukamu ati: Omu rurembo rwa Sodoma ku ndaashangyemu abahikiriire makumi ataano, niinyija kurusaasira rwona ahabwabo.
en: And the LORD said, If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare all the place for their sakes.

rr: Abrahamu yaagaruka yaagira ati: Reeba, naayehanga kugamba na Mukama wangye, haza ndi omucuucu n'eiju.
en: And Abraham answered and said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord, which am but dust and ashes:

rr: Mbwenu shi, abahikiriire makumi ataano kuhaakuburaho bataano, okaacwekyereza orurembo rwona ahabw'abo abataano abaaburaho?
en: peradventure there shall lack five of the fifty righteous: wilt thou destroy all the city for lack of five?

rr: Yaagira ati: Ku ndaashangyeyo makumi ana na bataano, tindikwija kurucwekyereza.
en: And he said, If I find there forty and five, I will not destroy it .

rr: Abrahamu yaagaruka yaamugira ati: Ku haraabonekyeyo makumi ana!
en: And he spake unto him yet again, and said, Peradventure there shall be forty found there.

rr: Yaagarukamu ati: Tindikwija kurucwekyereza ahabw'abo makumi ana.
en: And he said, I will not do it for forty's sake.

rr: Kandi yaagaruka yaagira ati: Mukama wangye arekye kungwerwa kubi, ngarukye ngambe. Ku haraabonekyeyo makumi ashatu. Yaamugarukamu ati: Tindikwija kurucwekyereza, ku ndaashangyeyo makumi ashatu.
en: And he said unto him , Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak: Peradventure there shall thirty be found there. And he said, I will not do it , if I find thirty there.

rr: Yaagira ati: Reeba, naayehanga kugamba na Mukama wangye. Ku haraabonekyeyo makumi abiri. Yaagarukamu ati: Tindikwija kurucwekyereza ahabw'abo makumi abiri.
en: And he said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord: Peradventure there shall be twenty found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for twenty's sake.

rr: Bwanyima yaagira ati: Mukama wangye arekye kuguubwa kubi, ngarukye ngambe omurundi ogu gwonka.
en: And he said, Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak yet but this once: Peradventure ten shall be found there.

rr: Mbwenu shi ku haraabonekyemu ikumi.
en: And he said, I will not destroy it for ten's sake.

rr: Yaamugarukamu ati: Tindirucwekyereza ku hakubonekayo ikumi.
en: And the LORD went his way, as soon as he had left communing with Abraham: and Abraham returned unto his place. rr: Baamaraika abo bombi baahika Sodoma omu mwabazyo; baashanga Looti ashutami aha irembo rya Sodoma. Looti ku yaabareebire, yaimukakubabugana; yainama ahansi, yaagira ati
en: And there came two angels to Sodom at even; and Lot sat in the gate of Sodom: and Lot seeing them rose up to meet them; and he bowed himself with his face toward the ground;

rr: Bakama bangye, nimbeeshengyereza mukubuukye, mutaahe omu ka y'omwiru waanyu, munaabe aha bigyere, muraare; omu kasheeshe kare mwimukye, mugyende.
en: and he said, Behold now, my lords, turn in, I pray you, into your servant's house, and tarry all night, and wash your feet, and ye shall rise up early, and go on your ways.

rr: Baagarukamu bati: Ngaaha; kureka nitwija kuraara omu muhanda, burugyeho busheeshe.
en: And they said, Nay; but we will abide in the street all night.

rr: Yaabagyema munonga, baakubuuka, baataaha omu ka ye; yaabateekyera obugyenyi, yaateeka emigaati etatumbisiibwe, baarya.
en: And he pressed upon them greatly; and they turned in unto him, and entered into his house; and he made them a feast, and did bake unleavened bread, and they did eat.

rr: Kwonka ku baabaire batakabyamire, abashaija b'omu rurembo Sodoma, abato n'abakuru, abantu boona abaarugire embaju zoona baayehinguririza egyo nju
en: But before they lay down, the men of the city, even the men of Sodom, compassed the house round, both old and young, all the people from every quarter:

rr: baayeta Looti, nibagira bati: Abashaija abaija owaawe ogu mwabazyo barahi? Batureetere, tubamanye.
en: and they called unto Lot, and said unto him, Where are the men which came in to thee this night? bring them out unto us, that we may know them.

rr: Looti yaashohora, yaabashanga aha muryango, yaagaruraho orwigi
en: And Lot went out at the door unto them, and shut the door after him,

rr: yaabagira ati: Bagyenzi bangye, nimbeeshengyereza mutakora ekibi ekirikushusha kityo.
en: and said, I pray you, brethren, do not so wickedly.

rr: Reeba, nyine bahara bangye babiri abatakamanyaga mushaija; ka mbabashohoreze, mubakore, nk'oku murikwenda; kwonka mutagira eki mwakora ahari aba bashaija, ahakuba baizire kuraara omu nju yangye.
en: Behold now, I have two daughters which have not known man; let me, I pray you, bring them out unto you, and do ye to them as is good in your eyes: only unto these men do nothing; for therefore came they under the shadow of my roof.

rr: Baagira bati: Rugaho, tuhigize. Baagaruka baagira bati: Orushaija oru rukaija rushuhuukire, mbwenu nirwenda kwehindura omuramuzi? Hati twaza kukugira kubi okukira oku twakubagizire. Baamiganira ahari ogwo mushaija Looti, bairira haihi kucwa orwigi.
en: And they said, Stand back. And they said again , This one fellow came in to sojourn, and he will needs be a judge: now will we deal worse with thee, than with them. And they pressed sore upon the man, even Lot, and came near to break the door.

rr: Abashaija abaabaire bari omu nju, baashohoza emikono yaabo, baataasya Looti, baakinga orwigi.
en: But the men put forth their hand, and pulled Lot into the house to them, and shut to the door.

rr: Baahumya amaisho g'abashaija abaabaire bari aha rwigi, abato n'abakuru; nahabw'ekyo baafa kubi, nibakorakora nibasherura orwigi.
en: And they smote the men that were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great: so that they wearied themselves to find the door.

rr: Bwanyima abo bashaija baabuuza Looti bati: Oine abandi bantu aha? Mukwe waawe, na batabani baawe, na bahara baawe, n'omuntu weena ou oine omuri oru rurembo, obaihe omuri ogu mwanya
en: And the men said unto Lot, Hast thou here any besides? son in law, and thy sons, and thy daughters, and whatsoever thou hast in the city, bring them out of this place:

rr: ahakuba twaza kugucwekyereza, ahabw'okuba okutaka kw'abarikubarega kurengyesereize omu maisho ga MUKAMA; kandi MUKAMA atutumire kugucwekyereza.
en: for we will destroy this place, because the cry of them is waxen great before the face of the LORD ; and the LORD hath sent us to destroy it.

rr: Looti yaashohora, yaagambira abakwe, abaabaire nibenda kushwera bahara be, naagira ati: Mwimukye, murugye omu mwanya ogu; ahabw'okuba MUKAMA naayenda kucwekyereza orurembo. Kwonka omu maisho ga bakwe be yaashusha nk'orikuteera obuyaga. Okuhunga kwa Looti n'okucwekyereza kwa Sodoma
en: And Lot went out, and spake unto his sons in law, which married his daughters, and said, Up, get you out of this place; for the LORD will destroy this city. But he seemed as one that mocked unto his sons in law.

rr: Ku bwaseesire, baamaraika baateera Looti obwira, nibagira bati: Imuka otware omukazi waawe na bahara baawe bombi abari aha, mutakaagwa omu rubanja rw'orurembo.
en: And when the morning arose, then the angels hastened Lot, saying, Arise, take thy wife, and thy two daughters, which are here; lest thou be consumed in the iniquity of the city.

rr: Kwonka yaaguma naayeziringa; abashaija abo nikwo kumukwata omukono, n'omukono gw'omukazi we, n'emikono ya bahara be bombi, bakamushohoza aheeru y'orurembo, nk'oku MUKAMA yaamusaasiire.
en: And while he lingered, the men laid hold upon his hand, and upon the hand of his wife, and upon the hand of his two daughters; the LORD being merciful unto him: and they brought him forth, and set him without the city.

rr: Ku baaherize kubashohoreza kimwe, omwe yaagira ati: Hunga otafa; otareeba enyima, n'obu kwakuba okwemereraho omu ruhita rwona; hungira omu bibungo, otakaacwekyerezibwa.
en: And it came to pass, when they had brought them forth abroad, that he said, Escape for thy life; look not behind thee, neither stay thou in all the plain; escape to the mountain, lest thou be consumed.

rr: Looti yaabagira ati: Ngaaha, Mukama wangye.
en: And Lot said unto them, Oh, not so, my Lord:

rr: Reeba omwiru waawe naaheebwa omugisha omu maisho gaawe, waakanyisa embabazi zaawe ezi wangirira kunkiza okufa. Tindikubaasa kuhungira mu bibungo, ntakaahikwaho akabi, nkafa.
en: behold now, thy servant hath found grace in thy sight, and thou hast magnified thy mercy, which thou hast shewed unto me in saving my life; and I cannot escape to the mountain, lest some evil take me, and I die:

rr: Reeba, orurembo ruriya ruri haihi okuhungiramu, kandi ni rukye. Naakweshengyereza mbe nirwo naahungiramu (ti rukye?), amagara gangye nigaija kukiriramu.
en: behold now, this city is near to flee unto, and it is a little one: Oh, let me escape thither, ( is it not a little one?) and my soul shall live.

rr: Yaamugarukamu ati: Naakwikiriza n'ekyo nakyo, okutahwerekyereza rurembo oru waagambaho.
en: And he said unto him, See, I have accepted thee concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow this city, for the which thou hast spoken.

rr: Yehuute ohungireyo; ahakuba tindikubaasa kukora kintu kyona, otakahikireyo.
en: Haste thee, escape thither; for I cannot do any thing till thou be come thither.

rr: Orwo rurembo nikyo rwayeteirwe Zoari.
en: Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.

rr: Looti yaahika Zoari, akashana kaatagata.
en: The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot entered into Zoar.

rr: MUKAMA yaabona kunaga ahari Sodoma na Gomora omuriro n'obuganga bw'ekibiriiti, nibiruga ahari MUKAMA omu iguru
en: Then the LORD rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the LORD out of heaven;

rr: yaacwekyereza ezo ndembo, n'oruhita rwona n'abaatuuzi baamwo boona, n'ekyabaire kimezire ahansi.
en: and he overthrew those cities, and all the plain, and all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew upon the ground.

rr: Abrahamu yaimuka omu kasheeshe, yaaza ahu ayemereire omu maisho ga MUKAMA
en: And Abraham gat up early in the morning to the place where he stood before the LORD :

rr: yareeba aha bukiizi bwa Sodoma na Gomora n'oruhita rwona; kandi reeba, ensi ekaba neecumba omwika nk'ogw'ekikoomi.
en: and he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and beheld, and, lo, the smoke of the country went up as the smoke of a furnace.

rr: Kandi Ruhanga, ku yaabaire naacwekyereza endembo z'omuri orwo ruhita, yaijuka Abrahamu, yaatuma ahari Looti ngu azirugyemu, omu kucwekyereza ezo ndembo ezi Looti yaabaire atwiremu. Obukomooko bw'aba Moabu n'aba Amoni
en: And it came to pass, when God destroyed the cities of the plain, that God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in the which Lot dwelt.

rr: Bwanyima Looti yaaruga Zoari yainamuka omu bibungo na bahara be bombi; ahakuba akatiina kutuura Zoari; atyo yaataaha omu nyanga na bahara be bombi.
en: And Lot went up out of Zoar, and dwelt in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he feared to dwell in Zoar: and he dwelt in a cave, he and his two daughters.

rr: Omukuru yaagambira omuto ati: Tataitwe akuzire; kandi omu nsi tiharimu muntu oriija kutushwera, nk'emicwe y'ensi yoona oku eri.
en: And the firstborn said unto the younger, Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth:

rr: Ija tunywaise tataitwe viinyo, tumusinze, tubyame nawe, tutungye oruzaaro, turekye kufa bucwekye.
en: come, let us make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.

rr: Baasinza ishebo ekyo kiro; omukuru yaataahamu, yaabyama na ishe; kandi ishe tiyaamanya bunaku bu yaabyamiramu nawe, n'obu yaimukiramu.
en: And they made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.

rr: Ku bwaseesire, omukuru yaagira omuto ati: Reeba, nyekiro mbyamire na taata; ka tugarukye tumusinze eki kiro; naiwe otaahemu, obyame nawe, tutungye oruzaaro, turekye kufa bucwekye.
en: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the firstborn said unto the younger, Behold, I lay yesternight with my father: let us make him drink wine this night also; and go thou in, and lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.

rr: Batyo baagaruka baasinza ishebo na viinyo ekyo kiro; omuto yaimuka, yaabyama nawe; ishe tiyaamanya bunaku bu yaabyamiramu nawe, nobu yaimukiramu.
en: And they made their father drink wine that night also: and the younger arose, and lay with him; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.

rr: Okwo nikwo bahara ba Looti baatwekirwe ishebo.
en: Thus were both the daughters of Lot with child by their father.

rr: Omukuru yaazaara omwana w'omwojo, yaamweta Moabu; niwe ishe w'Abamoabu n'okuhitsya hati.
en: And the firstborn bare a son, and called his name Moab: the same is the father of the Moabites unto this day.

rr: Omuto nawe yaazaara omwana w'omwojo, yaamweta Ben-ami; niwe ishe w'Abaamoni n'okuhitsya hati.
en: And the younger, she also bare a son, and called his name Ben-ammi: the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day.

rr: -15 ; 26:7 . Abrahamu yaagamba ku omukazi we Saara ari munyaanya. Abimeleki omugabe wa Gerari yaatuma ahari Saara, yaamutwara.
en: And Abraham said of Sarah his wife, She is my sister: and Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.

rr: Kwonka Ruhanga yaija ahari Abimeleki nyekiro omu kirooto, yaamugira ati: Reeba, waafa, ahabw'okuba omukazi ou otwaire aine iba.
en: But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night, and said to him, Behold, thou art but a dead man, for the woman which thou hast taken; for she is a man's wife.

rr: Kwonka Abimeleki akaba atakamuhikire; Abimeleki nikwo kugarukamu ati: Nooyenda kwita eihanga eritaina rubanja?
en: But Abimelech had not come near her: and he said, Lord, wilt thou slay also a righteous nation?

rr: We wenka tarangizire ati: Ogu ni munyaanyazi? Kandi omukazi nawe akagira ati: Ndi munyaanya. Eki eki nkozire nkikozire, nyine omutima gw'amazima n'emikono etaine rubanja.
en: Said he not unto me, She is my sister? and she, even she herself said, He is my brother: in the integrity of my heart and innocency of my hands have I done this.

rr: Ruhanga yaamugarukamu omu kirooto, ati: Eego, nimmanya ngu okikozire, oine omutima gw'amazima; kandi naanye nkuzibiire kuncumuraho; nikyo ntakwikiririize kumukoraho.
en: And God said unto him in a dream, Yea, I know that thou didst this in the integrity of thy heart; for I also withheld thee from sinning against me: therefore suffered I thee not to touch her.

rr: Mbwenu nu garurira ogwo mushaija omukazi we, ahakuba ni nabi, akushabire orekye kufa; kwonka ku oraabe otamumugaruriire, omanyire kimwe ngu noija kufa hamwe n'abaawe boona.
en: Now therefore restore the man his wife; for he is a prophet, and he shall pray for thee, and thou shalt live: and if thou restore her not, know thou that thou shalt surely die, thou, and all that are thine.

rr: Abimeleki yaaguruka kare, yaatuma aha bairu be boona, yaabateekyerereza ebyo byona, baatiina munonga.
en: Therefore Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ears: and the men were sore afraid.

rr: Bwanyima yaatuma ahari Abrahamu, yaamubuuza ati: otutuzire ki? Nkucumwireho ki, waaza kundeetaho ekibi kihango, nyowe n'obugabe bwangye? Onkoreire ebitakorwa.
en: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said unto him, What hast thou done unto us? and what have I offended thee, that thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? thou hast done deeds unto me that ought not to be done.

rr: Kandi yaagaruka yaabuuza Abrahamu ati: Okareeba ki, ekyakureeteire kukora otyo?
en: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What sawest thou, that thou hast done this thing?

rr: Abrahamu yaagarukamu ati: Nkakikora ahabw'okuteekateeka ngu: Buzima omu mwanya ogu tiharimu kutiina Ruhanga; nibaija kuunyita ahabw'omukazi wangye.
en: And Abraham said, Because I thought, Surely the fear of God is not in this place; and they will slay me for my wife's sake.

rr: Kandi ekindi, ni munyaanyazi buzima, owa taata otari wa maawe; kwonka nkamushwera.
en: And yet indeed she is my sister; she is the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.

rr: Bwanyima Ruhanga ku yaanyihire omu ka ya taata, yampindura ow'okuzengyerera, naagira Saara nti: Eky'embabazi eki oshemereire kunkorera n'eki; buri mwanya gwona ogu turizamu, ogume ogire oti: Ogu ni munyaanyazi.
en: And it came to pass, when God caused me to wander from my father's house, that I said unto her, This is thy kindness which thou shalt shew unto me; at every place whither we shall come, say of me, He is my brother.

rr: Abimeleki yaareeta entaama n'ente n'abahuuku n'abazaana, yaabiha Abrahamu, yaamugarurira na Saara omukazi we.
en: And Abimelech took sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and womenservants, and gave them unto Abraham, and restored him Sarah his wife.

rr: Kandi yaamugira ati: Reeba, ensi yangye ekuri omumaisho; otuure ahu orikwenda hoona.
en: And Abimelech said, Behold, my land is before thee: dwell where it pleaseth thee.

rr: Yaagambira na Saara ati: Reeba, naaha munyaanyoko ebicweka by'efeeza rukumi, kukwihaho ekihemu omu maisho g'abari hamwe naiwe boona; kandi omu maisho g'abantu boona oryaguma ori ohikire.
en: And unto Sarah he said, Behold, I have given thy brother a thousand pieces of silver: behold, he is to thee a covering of the eyes, unto all that are with thee, and with all other: thus she was reproved.

rr: Bwanyima Abrahamu yaashaba Ruhanga; Ruhanga yaakiza Abimeleki n'omukazi we n'abazaana be; baazaara abaana
en: So Abraham prayed unto God: and God healed Abimelech, and his wife, and his maidservants; and they bare children .

rr: ahakuba MUKAMA akaba ayigariire kimwe enda z'ab'omu ka ya Abimeleki ahabwa Saara muka Abrahamu.
en: For the LORD had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah Abraham's wife.

rr: Currently Selected: Okutandika 20 : RR64 Highlight Share <path d="M5 12a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h3a1 1 0 1 1 0 2H6a1 1 0 0 1-1-1ZM5 15a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h3a1 1 0 1 1 0 2H6a1 1 0 0 1-1-1ZM5 9a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h3a1 1 0 0 1 0 2H6a1 1 0 0 1-1-1
MUKAMA yaataayaayira Saara nk'oku yaagambire, kandi MUKAMA yaakorera Saara nk'oku yaaraganiise.
en: And the LORD visited Sarah as he had said, and the LORD did unto Sarah as he had spoken.

rr: Saara yaagira enda, yaazaarira Abrahamu omwana w'omwojo yaakuzire, omu bunaku obu Ruhanga yaamugambiire.
en: For Sarah conceived, and bare Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.

rr: Abrahamu yaayeta ogwo mwana ou yaazaire Isaaka, ou Saara yaamuzaariire.
en: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him, whom Sarah bare to him, Isaac.

rr: Abrahamu yaashara omwana we Isaaka amazire ebiro munaana azairwe, nk'oku Ruhanga yaamuragiire.
en: And Abraham circumcised his son Isaac being eight days old, as God had commanded him.

rr: Kandi Abrahamu akaba ahikize emyaka igana, obu yaazaara ogwo mwana Isaaka.
en: And Abraham was an hundred years old, when his son Isaac was born unto him.

rr: Saara yaagira ati: Ruhanga anshekize; n'oraakihurire weena naija kusheka.
en: And Sarah said, God hath made me to laugh, so that all that hear will laugh with me.

rr: Yaagaruka yaagira ati: N'oha owaakugizire Abrahamu, ngu Saara nawe aryayontsya abaana? Ahakuba mmuzaariire omwana w'omwojo omu bugurusi bwe.
en: And she said, Who would have said unto Abraham, that Sarah should have given children suck? for I have born him a son in his old age.

rr: Omwana yaakura, yaacuuka; Abrahamu yaateeka obugyenyi bwingi aha izooba eri Isaaka yaacuukiireho. Saara okubingisa Hagari na Ishimaeli
en: And the child grew, and was weaned: and Abraham made a great feast the same day that Isaac was weaned.

rr: Saara yaareeba omwana wa Hagari Omunyamisrikazi, ou yaazairweho Abrahamu, naazaana n'omutabani.
en: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, which she had born unto Abraham, mocking.

rr: Nikyo yaagiriire Abrahamu ati: Binga ogu muzaana n'omwana we; ahakuba omwana w'ogu muzaanakazi tarihungura n'omwana wangye Isaaka.
en: Wherefore she said unto Abraham, Cast out this bondwoman and her son: for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son, even with Isaac.

rr: Ekigambo ekyo kyagwisa kubi Abrahamu ahabw'omwana we.
en: And the thing was very grievous in Abraham's sight because of his son.

rr: Ruhanga yaagambira Abrahamu ati: Otaguubwa kubi ahabw'omwana n'ahabw'omuzaanakazi waawe. Kyona eki Saara araakugambire, omworobere; ahabw'okuba baijukuru baawe baryayetererwa Isaaka.
en: And God said unto Abraham, Let it not be grievous in thy sight because of the lad, and because of thy bondwoman; in all that Sarah hath said unto thee, hearken unto her voice; for in Isaac shall thy seed be called.

rr: Kandi omwana w'omuzaana nawe ndyamuhindura eihanga, ahabw'okuba n'omwana waawe.
en: And also of the son of the bondwoman will I make a nation, because he is thy seed.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo Abrahamu yaimuka omu kasheeshe kare, yaagira eby'okurya n'efurebe y'amaizi, yaabiha Hagari, yaabimuta aha ibega, yaamuha n'ogwo mwana, yaamwohereza. Yaarugayo, yaaguma naagyendagyenda omu ihamba rya Beerisheba.
en: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread, and a bottle of water, and gave it unto Hagar, putting it on her shoulder, and the child, and sent her away: and she departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beer-sheba.

rr: Amaizi ku gaahweire omu furebe, yaarambika omwana ahansi y'ekishaka
en: And the water was spent in the bottle, and she cast the child under one of the shrubs.

rr: yaagyenda, yaashutama hangahari naamureeba, kaanya nk'aharikurashwa omwambi; ahabw'okuba akagira ati: Ka ndekye kureeba omwana wangye naakaba.
en: And she went, and sat her down over against him a good way off, as it were a bowshot: for she said, Let me not see the death of the child.

rr: Ku yaabaire ashutami naareeba ei ari, omwana yaimutsya eiraka, yaarira.
en: And she sat over against him , and lift up her voice, and wept.

rr: Ruhanga yaahurira eiraka ry'ogwo mwana; maraika wa Ruhanga yaayema omu iguru, yaayeta Hagari, yaamugira ati: Waaba ota, Hagari? Otatiina, ahabw'okuba Ruhanga yaahurira eiraka ry'omwojo ah' ari.
en: And God heard the voice of the lad; and the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven, and said unto her, What aileth thee, Hagar? fear not; for God hath heard the voice of the lad where he is .

rr: Imuka, oimutsye omwana, omweyegamize aha mukono; ahakuba ndyamuhindura eihanga rihango.
en: Arise, lift up the lad, and hold him in thine hand; for I will make him a great nation.

rr: Omuri ogwo mwanya Ruhanga yaigura amaisho ga Hagari, yaareeba eiziba ry'amaizi, yaagyenda, yaijuza efurebe amaizi, yaanywaisa omwana.
en: And God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water; and she went, and filled the bottle with water, and gave the lad drink.

rr: Okuruga aho Ruhanga yaaguma n'omwojo, yaakura, yaatuura omu ihamba, yaaba omurasi rugambwa.
en: And God was with the lad; and he grew, and dwelt in the wilderness, and became an archer.

rr: Yaaguma omu ihamba rya Parani; nyina yaamushwererera Omunyamisrikazi. Abrahamu okuragaana na Abimeleki
en: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran: and his mother took him a wife out of the land of Egypt.

rr: Omu biro ebyo Abimeleki na Fikooli omukuru w'engabo ze baagambira Abrahamu bati: Ruhanga ari hamwe naiwe omu bi orikukora byona.
en: And it came to pass at that time, that Abimelech and Phichol the chief captain of his host spake unto Abraham, saying, God is with thee in all that thou doest:

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo ondahire Ruhanga, ku otarimbeiha nari mutabani wangye, n'obu yaakuba mwijukuru wangye; kureka nk'embabazi ezi naakugiriire oku ziri, naiwe ku nikwo oringirira n'ensi, ei waashuhuukiiremu.
en: now therefore swear unto me here by God that thou wilt not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son's son: but according to the kindness that I have done unto thee, thou shalt do unto me, and to the land wherein thou hast sojourned.

rr: Abrahamu yaamugarukamu ati: Naaza kukurahira.
en: And Abraham said, I will swear.

rr: Bwanyima Abrahamu yaatonganisa Abimeleki ahabw'eiziba eri abairu ba Abimeleki baamwakire n'empaka.
en: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of a well of water, which Abimelech's servants had violently taken away.

rr: Abimeleki yaagarukamu ati: Tindikumanya owaakozire ekyo; naiwe tokabingambiraga, kandi tinkakihuriraga, kureka eri izooba.
en: And Abimelech said, I wot not who hath done this thing: neither didst thou tell me, neither yet heard I of it , but to day.

rr: Abrahamu yaatwara entaama n'ente, yaaziha Abimeleki; bombi baaragaana endagaano.
en: And Abraham took sheep and oxen, and gave them unto Abimelech; and both of them made a covenant.

rr: Abrahamu yaashoroora omu busyo abaagazi b'entaama mushanju.
en: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.

rr: Abimeleki yaabuuza Abrahamu ati: Abaagazi b'entaama aba mushanju abu waashoroora, n'aba ki?
en: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What mean these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves?

rr: Yaagarukamu ati: Aba baagazi b'entaama mushanju naabakuha, obatware, babe eky'okuhamya eiziba eri ku niinye naarifukwire.
en: And he said, For these seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that they may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well.

rr: Nikyo yaayeteire omwanya ogwo Beeri-sheba, ahakuba aho niho baarahiriire bombi.
en: Wherefore he called that place Beer-sheba; because there they sware both of them.

rr: Batyo baaragaanira endagaano Beeri-sheba; bwanyima Abimeleki na Fikooli omukuru w'engabo ze baimuka, baagaruka omu nsi y'Abafilistia.
en: Thus they made a covenant at Beer-sheba: then Abimelech rose up, and Phichol the chief captain of his host, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.

rr: Kandi Abrahamu yaabyara ekiti ky'omwesheli ahari Beeri-sheba; yaaramizaho eiziina rya MUKAMA Ruhanga otahwaho.
en: And Abraham planted a grove in Beer-sheba, and called there on the name of the LORD , the everlasting God.

rr: Bwanyima Abrahamu yaamara ebiro bingi, ashuhuukiire omu nsi y'Abafilistia.
en: And Abraham sojourned in the Philistines' land many days.

rr: Bwanyima y'ebyo Ruhanga yaagyeza Abrahamu, yaamweta ati: Abrahamu! Yaamweetaba ati: Nyamuhanga!
en: And it came to pass after these things, that God did tempt Abraham, and said unto him, Abraham: and he said, Behold, here I am .

rr: Yaamugira ati: Twara omwana waawe omwe nyamunegyere Isaaka, ou okunda, oze omu nsi ya Moria, omutambire aha kibungo kimwe omu bibungo by'aho, eki ndaakugambire, kuba ekitambo ekyokize.
en: And he said, Take now thy son, thine only son Isaac, whom thou lovest, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.

rr: Atyo Abrahamu yaimuka kare omu kasheeshe, yaatandiika endogoya ye, yaatwara babiri aha batsigazi be na Isaaka omwana we; yaashatura enku z'okwotsya ekitambo, yaimuka, yaaza omu mwanya ogu Ruhanga amugambiire.
en: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and saddled his ass, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son, and clave the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went unto the place of which God had told him.

rr: Aha kiro kya kashatu Abrahamu yaanaga amaisho, yaareeba omwanya gukiri hare.
en: Then on the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place afar off.

rr: Abrahamu yaagira abatsigazi be ati: Imwe mugume aha n'endogoya, nyowe n'omwojo tuze kuriya, turamye, haza tugarukye, tubashangye aha.
en: And Abraham said unto his young men, Abide ye here with the ass; and I and the lad will go yonder and worship, and come again to you.

rr: Abrahamu yaakwata enku z'okwotsya ekitambo, yaazikorera Isaaka omwana we; we yaatwara omuriro n'omusyo gw'endiga; baagyenda hamwe bombi.
en: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering, and laid it upon Isaac his son; and he took the fire in his hand, and a knife; and they went both of them together.

rr: Isaaka yaayeta Abrahamu ishe ati: Taata! Abrahamu yaamwetaba ati: N'enki, mwana wangye? Yaagira ati: Beitu shi ka twine omuriro n'enku; omwana gw'entaama ogw'okutamba gurahi?
en: And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I, my son. And he said, Behold the fire and the wood: but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?

rr: Abrahamu yaagarukamu ati: Mwana wangye, Ruhanga naija kwebonera omwana gw'entaama gw'ekitambo ky'okwotsya. Batyo baagumizamu bombi.
en: And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.

rr: Ku baahikire omu mwanya ogu Ruhanga amugambiire, Abrahamu yaayombekayo eitambiro, yaariteekyeraho enku, yaaboha Isaaka omwana we, yaamugarika aha itambiro aha nku.
en: And they came to the place which God had told him of; and Abraham built an altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar upon the wood.

rr: Abrahamu yaakununkirira omusyo kurezya omutabani.
en: And Abraham stretched forth his hand, and took the knife to slay his son.

rr: Maraika wa MUKAMA yaayema omu iguru, yaamweta ati: Abrahamu! Abrahamu! Yaayetaba ati: Nyamuhanga!
en: And the angel of the LORD called unto him out of heaven, and said, Abraham, Abraham: and he said, Here am I.

rr: Yaamugira ati: Otakora ahari ogwo mwana, nari kugira eki waamwitsa; ahabw'okuba hati naamanya ku orikutiina Ruhanga ahabw'okutaanyima mwana waawe omwe nyamunegyere.
en: And he said, Lay not thine hand upon the lad, neither do thou any thing unto him: for now I know that thou fearest God, seeing thou hast not withheld thy son, thine only son from me.

rr: Abrahamu yaimutsya amaisho, yaamagamaga, yaareeba enyima ye empaya y'entaama ekwatsirwe ebikamba omu mahembe; Abrahamu yaagyenda, yaihayo egyo mpaya, yaagitamba kuba ekitambo ekyokize omu mwanya gw'omwana we.
en: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son.

rr: Abrahamu yaayeta ogwo mwanya Yehovayire, nk'oku kirikugambwa na hati ngu, Aha kibungo kya MUKAMA kiryaheebwa. Ruhanga okugaruka kuragaanisa Abrahamu omugisha
en: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovah-jireh: as it is said to this day, In the mount of the LORD it shall be seen.

rr: Maraika wa MUKAMA yaagaruka yaayema omu iguru, yaayeta Abrahamu omurundi gwa kabiri
en: And the angel of the LORD called unto Abraham out of heaven the second time,

rr: yaamugira ati: Naayerahira, nikwo MUKAMA arikugira, ahabw'okukora eki, otanyime mwana waawe omwe nyamunegyere
en: and said, By myself have I sworn, saith the LORD , for because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thine only son :

rr: nti: Okukuha ndyakuha omugisha, kandi n'okukanyisa ndyakanyisa oruzaaro rwawe rube nk'enyonyoozi z'omu iguru, kandi nk'omusheenyi gw'aha rubaju rw'enyanja; n'oruzaaro rwawe ruryakubuura amarembo g'abazigu baarwo
en: that in blessing I will bless thee, and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heaven, and as the sand which is upon the sea shore; and thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies;

rr: kandi omurirwo amahanga goona ag'omu nsi nimwo gariheerwa omugisha, ahabw'okuba oyorobeire eiraka ryangye.
en: and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed; because thou hast obeyed my voice.

rr: Bwanyima Abrahamu yaagaruka aha batsigazi be; baimuka baagyenda hamwe Beeri-sheba; Abrahamu yaaba niyo yaatuura.
en: So Abraham returned unto his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beer-sheba; and Abraham dwelt at Beer-sheba.

rr: Bwanyima y'ebyo baagambira Abrahamu bati: Reeba, Milika nawe azaariire Nahori abaana
en: And it came to pass after these things, that it was told Abraham, saying, Behold, Milcah, she hath also born children unto thy brother Nahor;

rr: omujigaijo ni Uzi, n'omurumuna Buuzi, na Kemueli ishe wa Aramu
en: Huz his firstborn, and Buz his brother, and Kemuel the father of Aram,

rr: na Kesedi, Haazo, Piludashi, Yidulafu na Besueli.
en: and Chesed, and Hazo, and Pildash, and Jidlaph, and Bethuel.

rr: Besueli yaazaara Rebeka; abo omunaana nibo Milika yaazaariire Nahori, murumuna wa Abrahamu.
en: And Bethuel begat Rebekah: these eight Milcah did bear to Nahor, Abraham's brother.

rr: Kandi n'omukazi we w'ekinyanshunju orikwetwa Reuma, nawe yaazaara Teeba, Gahamu, Tahashi na Maaka.
en: And his concubine, whose name was Reumah, she bare also Tebah, and Gaham, and Thahash, and Maachah.

rr: Currently Selected: Okutandika 22 : RR64 Highlight Share <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8 19c-2.828 0-4.243 0-5.121-.879C2 17.243 2 15.828 2 13v-2c0
Saara akamara emyaka igana na makumi abiri na mushanju; egyo niyo myaka ei yaahikize.
en: And Sarah was an hundred and seven and twenty years old: these were the years of the life of Sarah.

rr: Yaafeera Kiryasiaraba (niyo Heburooni) omu nsi ya Kanaani; Abrahamu yaataaha omu ihema kuririra Saara n'okumucurira
en: And Sarah died in Kirjath-arba; the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan: and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.

rr: yaaruga aha mutumbi gwe, yaashohora, yaagambira aba Heesi ati
en: And Abraham stood up from before his dead, and spake unto the sons of Heth, saying,

rr: Ndi omunyaihanga kandi omushuhuuki omuriimwe; mumpe omwanya gw'okuziikamu, mbone kuziika omufu wangye, andugye omumaisho.
en: I am a stranger and a sojourner with you: give me a possession of a buryingplace with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.

rr: Aba Heesi baagarukamu Abrahamu bati
en: And the children of Heth answered Abraham, saying unto him,

rr: Mukama waitu, tuhurire; ori omuntu mukuru munonga omuriitwe; ziika omufu waawe omu kituuro eki oraatoorane omu bituuro byaitu byona; tihariho n'omwe omuriitwe oraakwime ekituuro kye, ngu otaziikamu omufu waawe.
en: Hear us, my lord: thou art a mighty prince among us: in the choice of our sepulchres bury thy dead; none of us shall withhold from thee his sepulchre, but that thou mayest bury thy dead.

rr: Abrahamu yaimuka, yainama omu maisho ga bakama b'ensi, aba Heesi.
en: And Abraham stood up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, even to the children of Heth.

rr: Yaabagira ati: Ku muraabe nimwikiriza ngu nziikye omufu wangye, andugye omumaisho, mumpurire, munyeshengyerereze Efurooni mwene Zohari
en: And he communed with them, saying, If it be your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight; hear me, and intreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,

rr: ampe enyanga ya Makipeela ei aine, eri aha muheru gw'ekibanja kye; agingurize omu maisho gaanyu nk'obuguzi bwayo oku buri, gube omwanya gwangye ogw'okuziikamu.
en: that he may give me the cave of Machpelah, which he hath, which is in the end of his field; for as much money as it is worth he shall give it me for a possession of a buryingplace amongst you.

rr: Kandi obwo Efurooni akaba ashutami omu ba Heesi; Efurooni ogwo Omuhiiti yaagarukamu Abrahamu, aba Heesi boona abaabaire nibataaha omu irembo ry'orurembo rwe bamuhuriire, naagira ati
en: And Ephron dwelt among the children of Heth: and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the audience of the children of Heth, even of all that went in at the gate of his city, saying,

rr: Ngaaha, Mukama wangye, mpurira. Ekyo kibanja naakikuha, n'enyanga yaamwo; naabikuheera omu maisho g'eihanga ryaitu. Oziikyemu omufu waawe.
en: Nay, my lord, hear me: the field give I thee, and the cave that is therein, I give it thee; in the presence of the sons of my people give I it thee: bury thy dead.

rr: Abrahamu yainama omu maisho ga bakama b'ensi.
en: And Abraham bowed down himself before the people of the land.

rr: Yaagambira Efurooni, boona bahuriire, ati: Ku oraabe nookisiima, naakweshengyereza, ompurire; nkuheereze obuguzi bw'ekibanja nk'oku buri; kandi ikiriza obutware, naanye mbone kuziikamu omufu wangye.
en: And he spake unto Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, But if thou wilt give it , I pray thee, hear me: I will give thee money for the field; take it of me, and I will bury my dead there.

rr: Efurooni yaagarukamu Abrahamu ati
en: And Ephron answered Abraham, saying unto him,

rr: Mukama wangye, mpurira. Akabanja akarikugurwa shekeli z'efeeza magana ana nikyo ki ahariiwe naanye? Mbwenu ziikamu omufu waawe.
en: My lord, hearken unto me: the land is worth four hundred shekels of silver; what is that betwixt me and thee? bury therefore thy dead.

rr: Abrahamu yaikiriza Efurooni, yaamurengyera efeeza ezi yaagambira omu maisho g'aba Heesi, shekeli magana ana z'efeeza, ezirikukoresibwa abashuubuzi.
en: And Abraham hearkened unto Ephron; and Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver, which he had named in the audience of the sons of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, current money with the merchant.

rr: Okwo nikwo Efurooni yaaguzire ekibanja kye, ekyabaire kiri Makipeela, aharikureeba Mamure, ekibanja n'enyanga yaamwo, n'emiti yoona eyaabaire erimu okuhika aha mwatano ogwabaire gukyehinguririize
en: And the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, and the cave which was therein, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all the borders round about, were made sure

rr: byahamibwa omu maisho b'aba Heesi n'ag'abaabaire nibataaha omu irembo ry'orurembo rwe kuba ebya Abrahamu.
en: unto Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all that went in at the gate of his city.

rr: Bwanyima y'ekyo, Abrahamu yaaziika omukazi we Saara omu nyanga y'omu kibanja kya Makipeela, aharikureeba Mamure (niyo Heburooni) omu nsi ya Kanaani.
en: And after this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre: the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan.

rr: Ekyo kibanja n'enyanga yaamwo byahamibwa aba Heesi kuba ebya Abrahamu n'okuba omwanya gwe gw'okuziikamu.
en: And the field, and the cave that is therein, were made sure unto Abraham for a possession of a buryingplace by the sons of Heth.

rr: Currently Selected: Okutandika 23 : RR64 Highlight Share <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8 19c-2.828 0-4.243 0-5.121-.879C2 17.243 2 15.828 2 13v-
Abrahamu akaba akuzire, ahikire omu ngingo zaabukuru; kandi MUKAMA akaba amuhaire omugisha omuri byona.
en: And Abraham was old, and well stricken in age: and the LORD had blessed Abraham in all things.

rr: Abrahamu yaagambira omugaragwa we mukuru owaabaire naategyeka eby'omu ka ye byona, ati: Ija ote omukono gwawe ahansi y'ekibero kyangye
en: And Abraham said unto his eldest servant of his house, that ruled over all that he had, Put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh:

rr: nkurahize MUKAMA Ruhanga w'eiguru n'ensi, ku otarishwererera mwana wangye omuri bahara b'Abanyakanaani, abu ntwiremu
en: and I will make thee swear by the LORD , the God of heaven, and the God of the earth, that thou shalt not take a wife unto my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I dwell:

rr: kureka ku ogigyenda omu ihanga ryaitu, kandi omuri beene waitu, okaba niyo waashwererera omwana wangye Isaaka omukazi.
en: but thou shalt go unto my country, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son Isaac.

rr: Omugaragwa yaamugarukamu ati: Shana akaayanga kwija naanye omu nsi egi. Ku kiriba kyabaire kityo, omwana waawe mmugarure omu nsi ei waarugiremu?
en: And the servant said unto him, Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land: must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest?

rr: Abrahamu yaamugira ati: Oyerinde, otarigarurayo omwana wangye.
en: And Abraham said unto him, Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again.

rr: MUKAMA Ruhanga w'eiguru owaanyihire omu ka ya taata n'omu nsi ei naazairwemu, kandi owangambiire naarahira ati: Oruzaaro rwawe ndyaruha ensi egi, Ogwo aryatuma maraika we akwebembere, oshwererereyo omwana wangye omukazi.
en: The LORD God of heaven, which took me from my father's house, and from the land of my kindred, and which spake unto me, and that sware unto me, saying, Unto thy seed will I give this land; he shall send his angel before thee, and thou shalt take a wife unto my son from thence.

rr: Omukazi ku aryanga kwija naiwe, orwo tiruriba rubanja rwawe ahabw'endahiro ei naakurahiza; kwonka eki ndikukwehanangiriza, otarigarurayo omwana wangye.
en: And if the woman will not be willing to follow thee, then thou shalt be clear from this my oath: only bring not my son thither again.

rr: Omugaragwa nikwo kuta omukono ahansi y'ekibero kya Abrahamu mukama we, akamurahira ku arikikora.
en: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and sware to him concerning that matter.

rr: Bwanyima omugaragwa yaatwara engamira ikumi aha za mukama we n'ebintu birungi eby'okuriimisa eby'emiringo yoona ebi yaahairwe mukama we, yaimuka yaaza Mesopotamia, yaahika haihi n'orurembo rwa Nahori.
en: And the servant took ten camels of the camels of his master, and departed; for all the goods of his master were in his hand: and he arose, and went to Mesopotamia, unto the city of Nahor.

rr: Yaateeza engamira ebikokora ahansi aheeru y'orurembo aha iziba ry'amaizi omu mwabazyo, ahu abakazi batahira amaizi.
en: And he made his camels to kneel down without the city by a well of water at the time of the evening, even the time that women go out to draw water .

rr: Yaashaba ati: Ai MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa mukama wangye Abrahamu, ninkweshengyereza, mpa omugisha hati, ogirire mukama wangye Abrahamu embabazi.
en: And he said, O LORD God of my master Abraham, I pray thee, send me good speed this day, and shew kindness unto my master Abraham.

rr: Reeba, nyemereire aha aha iziba; kandi abaishiki b'abanyarurembo nibaija kutaha amaizi.
en: Behold, I stand here by the well of water; and the daughters of the men of the city come out to draw water:

rr: Mbwenu kibe kiti; omwishiki, ou ndaagire nti, Tuura orunywero rwawe, nnyweho, naakweshengyereza, nawe akagarukamu ati, Nywaho, kandi naaza kweshera n'engamira zaawe, abe ogwo ou waatooraniire omwiru waawe Isaaka; kandi aho niho ndaamanyire ku waagirira mukama wangye embabazi.
en: and let it come to pass, that the damsel to whom I shall say, Let down thy pitcher, I pray thee, that I may drink; and she shall say, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: let the same be she that thou hast appointed for thy servant Isaac; and thereby shall I know that thou hast shewed kindness unto my master.

rr: Ku yaabaire atakaherize kushaba, reeba, haashohora Rebeka, muhara wa Besueli, mutabani wa Milika, muka Nahori murumuna wa Abrahamu, aine orunywero rwe aha ibega.
en: And it came to pass, before he had done speaking, that, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel, son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham's brother, with her pitcher upon her shoulder.

rr: Kandi omwishiki ogwo akaba ari murungi munonga orikureebwa, omwishiki otakamanyaga mushaija; yaashuuma aha iziba, yaijuza orunywero rwe amaizi, yainamuka.
en: And the damsel was very fair to look upon, a virgin, neither had any man known her: and she went down to the well, and filled her pitcher, and came up.

rr: Omugaragwa yairuka kumubugana, yaagira ati: Naakweshengyereza, mpa otwizi, nnywere aha runywero rwawe.
en: And the servant ran to meet her, and said, Let me, I pray thee, drink a little water of thy pitcher.

rr: Yaamugira ati: Nywaho, Mukama wangye. Yaarahuka, yaata orunywero rwe aha kiganja, yaamunywaisa.
en: And she said, Drink, my lord: and she hasted, and let down her pitcher upon her hand, and gave him drink.

rr: Ku yaaherize kumunywaisa, yaagira ati: Naaza kweshera n'engamira zaawe, nazo zinywe okuhitsya obu ziraakuukye.
en: And when she had done giving him drink, she said, I will draw water for thy camels also, until they have done drinking.

rr: Yaarahuka yaashuka amaizi omu bwato, yaagaruka omu iziba kutaha, yaayeshera engamira ze zoona.
en: And she hasted, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again unto the well to draw water , and drew for all his camels.

rr: Omushaija yaamugumyaho amaisho ahunami, kumanya ku MUKAMA araabe ahaire orugyendo rwe omugisha, nari shi ataruguhaire.
en: And the man wondering at her held his peace, to wit whether the LORD had made his journey prosperous or not.

rr: Engamira ku zaakuukire, omushaija yaihayo empeta y'ezaabu ey'oburemeezi bw'ekicweka kya shekeli, n'engoro ibiri ez'okumujweka aha mikono, ziine oburemeezi bwa shekeli ikumi z'ezaabu
en: And it came to pass, as the camels had done drinking, that the man took a golden earring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold;

rr: yaamugira ati: Ori muhara w'oha? Ngambira, naakweshengyereza. Kandi tukaabona oburaaro omu ka ya sho?
en: and said, Whose daughter art thou? tell me, I pray thee: is there room in thy father's house for us to lodge in?

rr: Yaamugarukamu ati: Ndi muhara wa Besueli, mutabani wa Milika, ou yaazairweho Nahori.
en: And she said unto him, I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, which she bare unto Nahor.

rr: Yaagaruka yaagira ati: Twine obunyaatsi n'eby'okurya byazo ebirikumara; kandi n'oburaaro buriyo.
en: She said moreover unto him, We have both straw and provender enough, and room to lodge in.

rr: Omushaija yainama, yaaramya MUKAMA
en: And the man bowed down his head, and worshipped the LORD .

rr: yaagira ati: MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa mukama wangye Abrahamu, ahimbisibwe, ahakuba tarekire kugirira mukama wangye embabazi n'obwesigwa; kandi naanye MUKAMA anyebembeire, yampitsya ahari beene ishe ba mukama wangye.
en: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of my master Abraham, who hath not left destitute my master of his mercy and his truth: I being in the way, the LORD led me to the house of my master's brethren.

rr: Omwishiki yairuka, yaagambira ab'omwa nyina ebigambo ebyo byona.
en: And the damsel ran, and told them of her mother's house these things.

rr: Kandi Rebeka akaba aine munyaanya orikwetwa Labaani; Labaani ogwo yaashohora, yairuka kubugana ogwo mushaija aha iziba.
en: And Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban: and Laban ran out unto the man, unto the well.

rr: Ku yaareebire empeta y'ezaabu n'engoro aha mikono ya munyaanya, kandi yaahurira Rebeka munyaanya naagamba ebi yaagambirwa ogwo mushaija, yaija ah' ari, yaashanga ayemereire aha rubaju rw'engamira aha iziba.
en: And it came to pass, when he saw the earring and bracelets upon his sister's hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, Thus spake the man unto me; that he came unto the man; and, behold, he stood by the camels at the well.

rr: Yaamugira ati: Ija otaahe, iwe ou MUKAMA ahaire omugisha. N'enki ekikwemereize aheeru? Ahakuba naakuteekateekyera enju, n'ahu engamira ziraaraare.
en: And he said, Come in, thou blessed of the LORD ; wherefore standest thou without? for I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.

rr: 43:24 . Atyo omushaija yaataaha omu nju, Labaani yaatandiikurura engamira, yaareeta obunyaatsi n'eby'okurya by'engamira, n'amaizi g'okunaabisa ebigyere bye n'eby'abashaija abu yaabaire aine.
en: And the man came into the house: and he ungirded his camels, and gave straw and provender for the camels, and water to wash his feet, and the men's feet that were with him.

rr: Bwanyima baamureetera eby'okurya; kwonka we yaagira ati: Tindikwija kurya, ntakagambire bi ntumirwe.
en: And there was set meat before him to eat: but he said, I will not eat, until I have told mine errand.

rr: Ndi Labaani ati: Bigambe.
en: And he said, Speak on.

rr: Yaagira ati: Ndi omugaragwa wa Abrahamu.
en: And he said, I am Abraham's servant.

rr: Kandi MUKAMA akaha mukama wangye omugisha mwingi munonga, yaahinduka omuntu rugambwa. Yaamuha amasyo g'entaama n'ag'ente, efeeza n'ezaabu, abahuuku n'abazaana, engamira n'endogoya.
en: And the LORD hath blessed my master greatly; and he is become great: and he hath given him flocks, and herds, and silver, and gold, and menservants, and maidservants, and camels, and asses.

rr: Na Saara muka mukama wangye yaamuzaarira omwana w'omwojo yaakuzire; n'omwana ogwo ishe amuhaire ebi aine byona.
en: And Sarah my master's wife bare a son to my master when she was old: and unto him hath he given all that he hath.

rr: Mbwenu mukama wangye akndahiza, naagira ati: Otarishwererera omwana wangye omukazi omu baishiki b'Abanyakanaani, abu ntwire omu nsi yaabo
en: And my master made me swear, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife to my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I dwell:

rr: kureka oryagaruka omu muryango gwa taata n'omuri beene waitu, obe niyo waashwererera omwana wangye omukazi.
en: but thou shalt go unto my father's house, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son.

rr: Naagambira mukama wangye nti: Shana omukazi tariikiriza kwija naanye.
en: And I said unto my master, Peradventure the woman will not follow me.

rr: Yangarukamu ati: MUKAMA ou ngyenda nandeeba, aryatuma maraika we, ahe orugyendo rwawe omugisha, obone kushwererera omwana wangye omukazi omuri beene waitu n'omu muryango gwa taata.
en: And he said unto me, The LORD , before whom I walk, will send his angel with thee, and prosper thy way; and thou shalt take a wife for my son of my kindred, and of my father's house:

rr: Ku orihika omuri beene waitu, oryaba otakiine rubanja ahabwendahiro ei naakurahiza; kandi n'obu bariba batamukuhaire, nabwo torigira rubanja ahabw'endahiro egyo.
en: then shalt thou be clear from this my oath, when thou comest to my kindred; and if they give not thee one , thou shalt be clear from my oath.

rr: Mbwenu eri izooba ku naahika aha iziba, naashaba nti: Ai MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa mukama wangye Abrahamu, ku oraabe ohaire omugisha orugyendo rwangye oru ndimu
en: And I came this day unto the well, and said, O LORD God of my master Abraham, if now thou do prosper my way which I go:

rr: reeba, naayemerera aha iziba; mbwenu kibe kiti; omwishiki oraije kutaha amaizi, ou ndaashabe nti, Mpa aha maizi g'omu runywero rwawe, nnyweho
en: behold, I stand by the well of water; and it shall come to pass, that when the virgin cometh forth to draw water , and I say to her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water of thy pitcher to drink;

rr: nawe akangira ati: Nywaho, kandi naaza kweshera n'engamira zaawe, abe niwe yaaba omukazi, ou MUKAMA yaateekateekyeire omwana wa mukama wangye.
en: and she say to me, Both drink thou, and I will also draw for thy camels: let the same be the woman whom the LORD hath appointed out for my master's son.

rr: Ku naaba ntakaherize bi naaba ninshaba omu mutima gwangye, naayecura Rebeka naashohora omu rurembo, aine orunywero rwe aha ibega; yaashuuma aha iziba, yaataha amaizi, naamugira nti: Mpa nnyweho, naakweshengyereza.
en: And before I had done speaking in mine heart, behold, Rebekah came forth with her pitcher on her shoulder; and she went down unto the well, and drew water: and I said unto her, Let me drink, I pray thee.

rr: Ahonaaho yaiha orunywero rwe aha ibega, yaagira ati: Nywaho; kandi ka nyeshere n'engamira zaawe. Ntyo naanywaho, kandi yaayeshera n'engamira.
en: And she made haste, and let down her pitcher from her shoulder , and said, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: so I drank, and she made the camels drink also.

rr: Naamubuuza nti: Ori muhara w'oha?
en: And I asked her, and said, Whose daughter art thou?

rr: Yaagarukamu ati: Ndi muhara wa Besueli, mutabani wa Nahori, ou yaazaire ahari Milika; naanye nikwo kumujweka empeta aha nyindo, n'engoro aha mikono ye.
en: And she said, The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor's son, whom Milcah bare unto him: and I put the earring upon her face, and the bracelets upon her hands.

rr: Bwanyima nainama, naaramya MUKAMA, kandi naasiima MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa mukama wangye Abrahamu, onyebembeire omu muhanda oguhikire kushwererera omwana wa mukama wangye omukazi omuri beene waabo.
en: And I bowed down my head, and worshipped the LORD , and blessed the LORD God of my master Abraham, which had led me in the right way to take my master's brother's daughter unto his son.

rr: Mbwenu ku muraabe nimwikiriza kukorera mukama wangye eby'embabazi n'eby'amazima, mungambire; nari shi, ku muraabe mutarikwikiriza, nabwo mungambire, mbone kugira orubaju oru naatoora, yaaba rwa buryo yaaba rwa bumosho.
en: And now if ye will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me: and if not, tell me; that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.

rr: Labaani na Besueli baagarukamu nibagira bati: Enaama egi n'eya MUKAMA; titwine ki turikubaasa kukugambira, yaaba kukwikiriza, nari kukwangira.
en: Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said, The thing proceedeth from the LORD : we cannot speak unto thee bad or good.

rr: Reeba, Rebeka akuri omu maisho, mutware, mugyende, abe muka omwana wa mukama waawe, nk'oku MUKAMA yaagambire.
en: Behold, Rebekah is before thee, take her , and go, and let her be thy master's son's wife, as the LORD hath spoken.

rr: Omugaragwa wa Abrahamu ku yaahuriire okugarukamu kwabo, yainama, yaaramya MUKAMA.
en: And it came to pass, that, when Abraham's servant heard their words, he worshipped the LORD , bowing himself to the earth.

rr: Ogwo mugaragwa yaihayo ebintu birungi by'efeeza n'ezaabu n'ebijwaro, yaabiha Rebeka; kandi yaaha munyaanya na nyina ebintu by'obuguzi bwingi.
en: And the servant brought forth jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment, and gave them to Rebekah: he gave also to her brother and to her mother precious things.

rr: Bwanyima baarya, baanywa, we n'abashaija abu yaabaire aine, baaraarayo; ku baimukire omu kasheeshe, yaagira ati; Mundagye, ngarukye owa mukama wangye.
en: And they did eat and drink, he and the men that were with him, and tarried all night; and they rose up in the morning, and he said, Send me away unto my master.

rr: Munyaanya na nyina baamugarukamu bati: Reka omwishiki agume naitwe okumara ebiro nka ikumi nari okukiraho, bwanyima abone kugyenda.
en: And her brother and her mother said, Let the damsel abide with us a few days, at the least ten; after that she shall go.

rr: Yaabagira ati: Nk'oku MUKAMA ahaire orugyendo rwangye omugisha, mutantuuza aha; kureka mundagye, ngarukye owa mukama wangye.
en: And he said unto them, Hinder me not, seeing the LORD hath prospered my way; send me away that I may go to my master.

rr: Baagira bati: Ka twete omwishiki, tumubuuze, ayegambire.
en: And they said, We will call the damsel, and enquire at her mouth.

rr: Baayeta Rebeka, baamubuuza bati: Noikiriza kugyenda n'ogu mushaija? Yaagira ati: Niinyikiriza.
en: And they called Rebekah, and said unto her, Wilt thou go with this man? And she said, I will go.

rr: Batyo baaraga Rebeka munyaanyabo n'omurezi we n'omugaragwa wa Abrahamu n'abashaija be.
en: And they sent away Rebekah their sister, and her nurse, and Abraham's servant, and his men.

rr: Baashabira Rebeka omugisha, nibagira bati: Munyaanyiitwe, obe nyina w'abantu enkumi n'obukumi; kandi oruzaaro rwawe rukubuure amarembo g'abarikurwanga.
en: And they blessed Rebekah, and said unto her, Thou art our sister, be thou the mother of thousands of millions, and let thy seed possess the gate of those which hate them.

rr: Rebeka yaimuka n'abazaana be, baatemba engamira, baagyenda n'ogwo mushaija. Okwo nikwo omugaragwa yaatwaire Rebeka, akeegyendera.
en: And Rebekah arose, and her damsels, and they rode upon the camels, and followed the man: and the servant took Rebekah, and went his way.

rr: Obwo Isaaka akaba yaarugire Beeri-lahairoi, atwire omu nsi ya Negebu.
en: And Isaac came from the way of the well Lahai-roi; for he dwelt in the south country.

rr: Omu mwabazyo Isaaka yaashohora, yaaza omu ishwa kutunga omwanya gw'okuteekateeka; ku yaanagire amaisho, yaareeba engamira niziija.
en: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the eventide: and he lifted up his eyes, and saw, and, behold, the camels were coming.

rr: Kandi Rebeka yaimutsya amaisho ge; ku yaareebire Isaaka, yaaruga aha ngamira.
en: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she lighted off the camel.

rr: Yaabuuza omugaragwa ati: Omushaija oriya orikwija kutubugana n'oha? Omugaragwa yaagira ati: Niwe mukama wangye. Rebeka yaakwata omwenda gwe, yaagwetwekyerera.
en: For she had said unto the servant, What man is this that walketh in the field to meet us? And the servant had said, It is my master: therefore she took a vail, and covered herself.

rr: Omugaragwa yaateekyerereza Isaaka ebi yaakozire byona.
en: And the servant told Isaac all things that he had done.

rr: Bwanyima Isaaka yaatwara Rebeka omu ihema rya Saara nyina yaaba omukazi we, yaamukunda, yaayebwa enaku z'okufa kwa nyina.
en: And Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah's tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife; and he loved her: and Isaac was comforted after his mother's death .

rr: Bwanyima Abrahamu yaashwera ondiijo mukazi orikwetwa Ketura.
en: Then again Abraham took a wife, and her name was Keturah.

rr: Yaazaara nawe Zimuraani, Yokishaani, Medani, Midiani, Ishibaaki na Shua.
en: And she bare him Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah.

rr: Yokishaani yaazaara Sheeba na Dedani. Kandi beene Dedani n'aba Ashuri n'aba Letushi n'aba Leumi.
en: And Jokshan begat Sheba, and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim, and Letushim, and Leummim.

rr: Kandi abaana ba Midiani ni Efa, Eferi, Hanoki, Abida na Elidaa. Abo boona n'oruzaaro rwa Ketura.
en: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abidah, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.

rr: Abrahamu yaaha Isaaka ebye byona.
en: And Abraham gave all that he had unto Isaac.

rr: Kwonka abaana b'ebinyanshunju bye ebi yaabaire aine, yaabaha ebiconco. Bwanyima yaaboohereza akiriho, ngu bataane n'omwana we Isaaka; baatoora oburugwa-izooba, baahika omu nsi y'obwo bukiizi.
en: But unto the sons of the concubines, which Abraham had, Abraham gave gifts, and sent them away from Isaac his son, while he yet lived, eastward, unto the east country.

rr: Emyaka ei Abrahamu yaahikize ekaba eri igana na makumi mushanju n'etaano.
en: And these are the days of the years of Abraham's life which he lived, an hundred threescore and fifteen years.

rr: Abrahamu ku yaahikire omu ngingo zaabukuru, omwitsyo gwamuhwamu, yaafa gye ari omugurusi w'emyaka mingi, yaakurata baishenkuru.
en: Then Abraham gave up the ghost, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full of years ; and was gathered to his people.

rr: Isaaka na Ishimaeli abatabani baamuziika omu nyanga ya Makipeela omu kibanja kya Efurooni mwene Zohari Omuhiiti, aharikureeba Mamure
en: And his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre;

rr: ekibanja eki Abrahamu yaaguzire ahari beene Heesi. Aho niho Abrahamu yaaziikirwe hamwe na Saara omukazi we.
en: the field which Abraham purchased of the sons of Heth: there was Abraham buried, and Sarah his wife.

rr: Bwanyima y'okufa kwa Abrahamu Ruhanga yaaha Isaaka omwana we omugisha. Isaaka yaatuura Beeri-lahairoi.
en: And it came to pass after the death of Abraham, that God blessed his son Isaac; and Isaac dwelt by the well Lahai-roi.

rr: Oru nirwo ruzaaro rwa Ishimaeli mwene Abrahamu, ou yaazaire ahari Hagari Omunyamisrikazi, omuzaana wa Saara.
en: Now these are the generations of Ishmael, Abraham's son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah's handmaid, bare unto Abraham:

rr: Kandi aga nigo maziina ga beene Ishimaeli, nk'oku baakurataine. Omujigaijo gwa Ishimaeli ni Nebayoosi; haataho Kedari, Adubeeli, Mibusamu
en: and these are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebajoth; and Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,

rr: Mishuma, Duma, Masa
en: and Mishma, and Dumah, and Massa,

rr: Hadadi, Teema, Yetura, Nafishi na Kedema.
en: Hadar, and Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah:

rr: Abo nibo batabani ba Ishimaeli, kandi ago nigo maziina gaabo, omu birorero byabo n'omu maka gaabo abategyeki ikumi na babiri nk'amahanga gaabo oku gaabaire gari.
en: these are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their towns, and by their castles; twelve princes according to their nations.

rr: Emyaka ei Ishimaeli yaahikize ekaba igana na makumi ashatu na mushanju; yaahwamu omwitsyo, yaafa, yaakurata baishenkuru.
en: And these are the years of the life of Ishmael, an hundred and thirty and seven years: and he gave up the ghost and died; and was gathered unto his people.

rr: Baatura okuruga Havila okuhika Shuuri eri omu maisho ga Misri, nootoora Asiria. Kandi Ishimaeli yaatuura beene ishe boona hangahari. Okuzaarwa kwa Esau na Yakobo
en: And they dwelt from Havilah unto Shur, that is before Egypt, as thou goest toward Assyria: and he died in the presence of all his brethren. Esau and Jacob

rr: Oru nirwo ruzaaro rwa Isaaka mwene Abrahamu. Abrahamu akazaara Isaaka
en: And these are the generations of Isaac, Abraham's son: Abraham begat Isaac:

rr: Isaaka ku yaahikize emyaka makumi ana, yaashwera Rebeka muhara wa Besueli Omusiria wa Padanaramu, munyaanya wa Labaani Omusiria.
en: and Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah to wife, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Padan-aram, the sister to Laban the Syrian.

rr: Isaaka yaayeshengyereza MUKAMA ahabw'omukazi we, ahakuba akaba ari engumba; MUKAMA yaahurira okweshengyereza kwe, Rebeka omukazi we yaagira enda.
en: And Isaac intreated the LORD for his wife, because she was barren: and the LORD was intreated of him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.

rr: Abaana baamurwanira omunda; yaagira ati: Ku kiraabe kiri kiti, ngumiireho ki?
en: And the children struggled together within her; and she said, If it be so, why am I thus?

rr: Yaayehanuuza ahari MUKAMA.
en: And she went to enquire of the LORD .

rr: MUKAMA yaamugarukamu ati: Enda yaawe erimu amahanga abiri, Enganda ibiri ezi orizaara ziryataanamu habiri; Oruganda rumwe ruryakiza orundi amaani, Kakuru aryaheereza Kato.
en: And the LORD said unto her, Two nations are in thy womb, And two manner of people shall be separated from thy bowels; And the one people shall be stronger than the other people; And the elder shall serve the younger.

rr: Ebiro bye eby'okuzaara ku byahikire, yaashangwa aine enda y'empasha.
en: And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.

rr: Kakuru yaazaarwa naatukura, aine obwoya aha mubiri gwe gwona nk'omwenda gw'ebyoya; baamweta Esau.
en: And the first came out red, all over like an hairy garment; and they called his name Esau.

rr: Haakurataho Kato, omukono gwe gukwaitse ekitsintsiino kya Esau; baamweta Yakobo. Obwo Isaaka akaba ahikize emyaka makumi mukaaga, obu omukazi we yaabazaara. Esau okuguza Yakobo obukuru bwe
en: And after that came his brother out, and his hand took hold on Esau's heel; and his name was called Jacob: and Isaac was threescore years old when she bare them.

rr: Abo boojo baakura; Esau yaaba omuhiigi w'obwengye ruraaramahamba; Yakobo yaaba omucureezi, yaaguma omuka.
en: And the boys grew: and Esau was a cunning hunter, a man of the field; and Jacob was a plain man, dwelling in tents.

rr: Kandi Isaaka akaba naakunda Esau, ahabw'okuba akaba arya aha nyama z'enyamaishwa ezi yaabaire ahiiga; kwonka Rebeka akaba akunda Yakobo.
en: And Isaac loved Esau, because he did eat of his venison: but Rebekah loved Jacob.

rr: Eizooba rimwe Yakobo akaba ateekire ekicumbe; Esau yaija naaruga kuhiiga, naakooza aine enjara.
en: And Jacob sod pottage: and Esau came from the field, and he was faint:

rr: Esau yaagira Yakobo ati: Mpa ekyo kicumbe ekirikutukura, ndyeho; ahakuba naaza kugwa enshazi. (Eiziina rye nikyo ryayeteirwe 25:30 Edomu amakuru ngu, Ekirikutukura. Edomu.)
en: and Esau said to Jacob, Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red pottage ; for I am faint: therefore was his name called Edom.

rr: Yakobo yaamugira ati: Kureka obanze onguze obukuru bwawe.
en: And Jacob said, Sell me this day thy birthright.

rr: Esau yaagira ati: Ndi haihi kwefeera. Eby'obukuru shi biryangasiraki?
en: And Esau said, Behold, I am at the point to die: and what profit shall this birthright do to me?

rr: Yakobo yaagira ati: Banza ondahire, Esau yaamurahira, yaamuguza obukuru bwe.
en: And Jacob said, Swear to me this day; and he sware unto him: and he sold his birthright unto Jacob.

rr: Bwanyima Yakobo yaaha Esau omugaati n'ekicumbe ky'ebihimba; yaarya, yaanywa, yaimuka, yaayegyendera. Okwo nikwo Esau yaagayire obukuru bwe.
