rr: Omu biro ebyo hakateera endiijo njara, etari eyaateire omu biro bya Abrahamu.
en: And there was a famine in the land, beside the first famine that was in the days of Abraham.

rr: Isaaka yaaza Gerari owa Abimeleki omugabe w'Abafilistia.
en: And Isaac went unto Abimelech king of the Philistines unto Gerar.

rr: MUKAMA yaayeyoreka Isaaka, yaamugira ati: Otashuuma Misri; ogume omu nsi, ei naaza kukugambira
en: And the LORD appeared unto him, and said, Go not down into Egypt; dwell in the land which I shall tell thee of:

rr: obe niyo waashuhuukiramu; naanye ndyaguma naiwe, nkuhe omugisha; ahabw'okuba iwe n'oruzaaro rwawe ndyabaha ensi ezi zoona, mpamye endahiro, ei naarahiire sho Abrahamu.
en: sojourn in this land, and I will be with thee, and will bless thee; for unto thee, and unto thy seed, I will give all these countries, and I will perform the oath which I sware unto Abraham thy father;

rr: Kandi ndyakanyisa oruzaaro rwawe, rube nk'enyonyoozi z'omu iguru, nduhe ezi nsi zoona; kandi omurirwo amahanga goona ag'omu nsi nimwo gariheerwa omugisha
en: and I will make thy seed to multiply as the stars of heaven, and will give unto thy seed all these countries; and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed;

rr: ahabw'okuba Abrahamu akanyorobera, yaahurira ebi naamwehanangiriize, n'ebi naamuragiire, n'ebi naataireho, n'ebiragiro byangye.
en: because that Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my charge, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.

rr: Isaaka yaatuura Gerari
en: And Isaac dwelt in Gerar:

rr: abantu baayo baamubuuza eby'omukazi we, yaabagarukamu ati: Ni munyaanyazi; ahakuba akatiina kugira ati, N'omukazi wangye, yaateekateeka ngu abashaija b'omuri ogwo mwanya nibaija kumwita azire Rebeka, ahakuba akaba ari murungi munonga orikureebwa.
en: And the men of the place asked him of his wife; and he said, She is my sister: for he feared to say, She is my wife; lest, said he , the men of the place should kill me for Rebekah; because she was fair to look upon.

rr: Bwanyima ku yaamazireyo ebiro bingi, Abimeleki omugabe w'Abafilistia yaayozya amaisho omu dirisa, yaareeba Isaaka naazaana n'omukazi we Rebeka.
en: And it came to pass, when he had been there a long time, that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, Isaac was sporting with Rebekah his wife.

rr: Abimeleki yaayeta Isaaka, yaamugira ati: Buzimazima, n'omukazi waawe. Ahanki ogizire oti, Ni munyaanyazi? Isaaka yaamugarukamu ati: Ahakuba nteekateekire ngu niinyija kwitwa ahabwe.
en: And Abimelech called Isaac, and said, Behold, of a surety she is thy wife: and how saidst thou, She is my sister? And Isaac said unto him, Because I said, Lest I die for her.

rr: Abimeleki yaagira ati: Mbwenu shi ekyo, otukozire ki? Obundi kikaarahukire omwe aha bashaija bangye kubyama n'omukazi waawe atakimanyire, haza obwo niiwe waakubaire otureeteire orubanja.
en: And Abimelech said, What is this thou hast done unto us? one of the people might lightly have lien with thy wife, and thou shouldest have brought guiltiness upon us.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo Abimeleki yaayehanangiriza abantu be boona, naagira ati: Orikora aha mushaija ogu nari aha mukazi we, buzimazima aryaitwa.
en: And Abimelech charged all his people, saying, He that toucheth this man or his wife shall surely be put to death.

rr: Isaaka yaahinga omu nsi egyo; omu mwaka ogwo yaashaaruura ebirikukira ebi yaabibire emirundi igana; MUKAMA yaamuha omugisha.
en: Then Isaac sowed in that land, and received in the same year an hundredfold: and the LORD blessed him.

rr: Yaaba omushaija omutungi, yaaguma naayeyongyera kutunga, okuhitsya obu yaabaire omutungi rugambwa
en: And the man waxed great, and went forward, and grew until he became very great:

rr: yaagira eitungo ringi ry'amasyo g'entaama n'ag'ente, n'eby'omuka bingi; Abafilistia baamugirira eihari (
en: for he had possession of flocks, and possession of herds, and great store of servants: and the Philistines envied him.

rr: Amaziba goona agaafukwirwe abairu ba ishe Abrahamu akiriho, Abafilistia bakaba baagatabire n'eitaka.)
en: For all the wells which his father's servants had digged in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped them, and filled them with earth.

rr: Abimeleki yaagira Isaaka ati: Turugyemu, ogyende, ahabw'okuba nootukiza munonga amaani.
en: And Abimelech said unto Isaac, Go from us; for thou art much mightier than we.

rr: Isaaka yaarugayo, yaagomberera omu ruhita rwa Gerari, yaatuurayo.
en: And Isaac departed thence, and pitched his tent in the valley of Gerar, and dwelt there.

rr: Isaaka yaagaruka, yaigura amaziba agaafukwirwe omu biro bya Abrahamu ishe; ahakuba Abafilistia bakaba baagatabire bwanyima y'okufa kwa Abrahamu; yaageeta amaziina agu ishe yaabaire ageetsire.
en: And Isaac digged again the wells of water, which they had digged in the days of Abraham his father; for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham: and he called their names after the names by which his father had called them.

rr: Bwanyima abairu ba Isaaka baafukura omu ruhita, baagwa aha iziba ry'enshuro y'amaizi.
en: And Isaac's servants digged in the valley, and found there a well of springing water.

rr: Abariisa ba Gerari baarwanisa aba Isaaka, nibagira bati: Amaizi aga n'agaitu. Yaayeta eryo iziba Eseki, ahakuba bakatongana nawe.
en: And the herdmen of Gerar did strive with Isaac's herdmen, saying, The water is our's: and he called the name of the well Esek; because they strove with him.

rr: Baagaruka, baafukura erindi iziba, naryo baaritonganira; yaaryeta Sitina.
en: And they digged another well, and strove for that also: and he called the name of it Sitnah.

rr: Okwo yaarugayo, yaafukura erindi iziba; eryo tibaaritonganira; yaaryeta Rehoboosi; yaagira ati: Ahakuba hati MUKAMA atuhaire ah'okweshanzira, nitwija kukanyira omuri egi nsi.
en: And he removed from thence, and digged another well; and for that they strove not: and he called the name of it Rehoboth; and he said, For now the LORD hath made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land.

rr: Yaarugayo, yainamuka Beerisheba.
en: And he went up from thence to Beer-sheba.

rr: Aha kiro ekyo MUKAMA yaamweyoreka, yaagira ati: Ndi Ruhanga wa sho Abrahamu; otatiina, ahabw'okuba ndi hamwe naiwe; ndyakuha omugisha, nkanyise oruzaaro rwawe ahabw'omwiru wangye Abrahamu.
en: And the LORD appeared unto him the same night, and said, I am the God of Abraham thy father: fear not, for I am with thee, and will bless thee, and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham's sake.

rr: Okwo yaayombekayo eitambiro, yaatakirirayo eiziina rya MUKAMA, yaateerayo eihema rye; okwo nayo abairu be baafukurayo eiziba.
en: And he builded an altar there, and called upon the name of the LORD , and pitched his tent there: and there Isaac's servants digged a well.

rr: Bwanyima Abimeleki yaaruga Gerari, hamwe na Ahuzaasi munywani we, na Fikooli omukuru w'engabo ze, baamushangayo.
en: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar, and Ahuzzath one of his friends, and Phichol the chief captain of his army.

rr: Isaaka yaababuuza ati: Mureetsirwe ki owangye, haza mwanyangire, kandi mukambinga owaanyu?
en: And Isaac said unto them, Wherefore come ye to me, seeing ye hate me, and have sent me away from you?

rr: Baamugarukamu bati: Tukareeba ku MUKAMA ari naiwe buzima; nikwo kugira tuti: Ka tugire endahiro ahagati yaitu naiwe, kandi turagaane n'endagaano
en: And they said, We saw certainly that the LORD was with thee: and we said, Let there be now an oath betwixt us, even betwixt us and thee, and let us make a covenant with thee;

rr: ku otaritukora kubi, nkaitwe oku tutarakukozireho, kandi nk'oku tutaine kintu kyona eki twakwitsize, kureka okukukorera ebirungi n'okukuraga n'obusingye. Mbwenu ori omuntu ou MUKAMA ahaire omugisha.
en: that thou wilt do us no hurt, as we have not touched thee, and as we have done unto thee nothing but good, and have sent thee away in peace: thou art now the blessed of the LORD .

rr: Bwanyima Isaaka yaabateekyera obugyenyi, baarya, baanywa.
en: And he made them a feast, and they did eat and drink.

rr: Baimuka nibutaagurukana, baarahirana na Isaaka, yaabaraga, baamurugaho n'obusingye.
en: And they rose up betimes in the morning, and sware one to another: and Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.

rr: Aha izooba eryo abairu ba Isaaka baija, baamugambira eby'eiziba eri bafukwire, nibagira bati: Tufumukire aha maizi.
en: And it came to pass the same day, that Isaac's servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had digged, and said unto him, We have found water.

rr: Yaaryeta Shiiba; nikyo orwo rurembo rwayeteirwe Beerisheba, n'okuhitsya hati.
en: And he called it Shebah: therefore the name of the city is Beer-sheba unto this day.

rr: Esau ku yaahikize emyaka makumi ana, yaashwera Yudeesi muhara wa Beeri Omuhiiti, na Basemaasi muhara wa Eloni Omuhiiti
en: And Esau was forty years old when he took to wife Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Bashemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite:

rr: abo bakazi baagwisa kubi Isaaka na Rebeka.
en: which were a grief of mind unto Isaac and to Rebekah.

rr: Bwanyima Isaaka ku yaakuzire, n'amaisho ge gaagiirweho oruho, atakibaasa kureeba gye, yaayeta omutabani Kakuru, Esau, yaamugira ati: Mwana wangye! Onu ati: Ndi aha, Taata.
en: And it came to pass, that when Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his eldest son, and said unto him, My son: and he said unto him, Behold, here am I.

rr: Yaamugira ati: reeba, nkuzire, tindikumanya izooba ri ndifeeraho.
en: And he said, Behold now, I am old, I know not the day of my death:

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo ninkweshengyereza, ihayo ebi ohiigisa, omutana gwawe n'obuta bwawe, oze omu ihamba, onyitireyo enyamaishwa
en: now therefore take, I pray thee, thy weapons, thy quiver and thy bow, and go out to the field, and take me some venison;

rr: onteekyere enyama, ozirungye nk'oku nkunda, ozindeetere, ndye, nkushabire omugisha ntakafiire.
en: and make me savoury meat, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat; that my soul may bless thee before I die.

rr: Isaaka ku yaabaire naagambira omutabani Esau, Rebeka yaashangwa amuhuriire. Atyo Esau yaaza omu ihamba kuhiiga enyamaishwa n'okugireeta.
en: And Rebekah heard when Isaac spake to Esau his son. And Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it .

rr: Rebeka yaagambira omutabani Yakobo ati: Naahurira sho naagambira mukuru waawe Esau ati
en: And Rebekah spake unto Jacob her son, saying, Behold, I heard thy father speak unto Esau thy brother, saying,

rr: Gyenda onyitire enyamaishwa, onteekyere enyama, ozirungye, ndye, nkushabire omugisha omu maisho ga MUKAMA natakafiire.
en: Bring me venison, and make me savoury meat, that I may eat, and bless thee before the LORD before my death.

rr: Mbwenu nu, mwana wangye, nyorobera okore eki ndikukuragiira.
en: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command thee.

rr: Irooko oze omu busyo bw'embuzi, onyihireyo ebyagazi bibiri bito birungi, naanye nteekyere sho enyama, ngirungye nk'oku akunda
en: Go now to the flock, and fetch me from thence two good kids of the goats; and I will make them savoury meat for thy father, such as he loveth:

rr: haza ogimutwarire, arye, akushabire omugisha atakafiire.
en: and thou shalt bring it to thy father, that he may eat, and that he may bless thee before his death.

rr: Yakobo yaagambira Rebeka nyina ati: Noomanya Esau mukuru wangye ku ari omushaija w'ebyoya, haza nyowe omubiri gwangye ku gurikuterera.
en: And Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man:

rr: Obundi taata akaankoraho, anteekateekaho ku ndi engobya, nyihayo omukyeeno omu mwanya gw'omugisha.
en: my father peradventure will feel me, and I shall seem to him as a deceiver; and I shall bring a curse upon me, and not a blessing.

rr: Nyina yaamugira ati: Omukyeeno gwawe gube niinye gwazaho, mwana wangye; iwe fa okunyorobera, obindeetere.
en: And his mother said unto him, Upon me be thy curse, my son: only obey my voice, and go fetch me them .

rr: Yakobo yaagyenda, yaabireetera nyina; nawe yaateeka enyama, yaagirunga, nk'oku ishe yaabaire naakunda.
en: And he went, and fetched, and brought them to his mother: and his mother made savoury meat, such as his father loved.

rr: Kandi Rebeka yaihayo ebijwaro birungi by'omutabani Esau kakuru; ebi Rebeka yaabaire aine omu nju, yaabijweka omutabani Yakobo kato
en: And Rebekah took goodly raiment of her eldest son Esau, which were with her in the house, and put them upon Jacob her younger son:

rr: kandi yaata empu z'ebyo byana by'embuzi aha mikono ye, n'aha bitsya bye aharikuterera
en: and she put the skins of the kids of the goats upon his hands, and upon the smooth of his neck:

rr: bwanyima yaamuha enyama zirungire n'omugaati ogu yaateekateeka.
en: and she gave the savoury meat and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.

rr: Yakobo yaija ahari ishe, yaagira ati: Taata! Onu ati: Ndi aha; ori oha, mwana wangye?
en: And he came unto his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I; who art thou, my son?

rr: Yakobo yaagarukamu ishe ati: Niinye Esau kakuru omwana waawe; naakora nk'oku wandagiira; mbwenu imuka oshutame, orye aha nyama ei naakureetera, obone kunshabira omugisha.
en: And Jacob said unto his father, I am Esau thy firstborn; I have done according as thou badest me: arise, I pray thee, sit and eat of my venison, that thy soul may bless me.

rr: Isaaka yaabuuza omwana we ati: Beitu shi, waagirahutsya ota, mwana wangye?
en: And Isaac said unto his son, How is it that thou hast found it so quickly, my son?

rr: Onu ati: Ahakuba MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe yampiira.
en: And he said, Because the LORD thy God brought it to me.

rr: Isaaka yaagira Yakobo ati: Irira aha, mwana wangye, nkukoreho, ndeebe ku oraabe ori omwana wangye Esau buzimazima, nari shi otari we.
en: And Isaac said unto Jacob, Come near, I pray thee, that I may feel thee, my son, whether thou be my very son Esau or not.

rr: Yakobo yairira haihi Isaaka ishe; Isaaka yaamukoraho, yaagira ati: Eiraka n'erya Yakobo, kwonka emikono n'eya Esau.
en: And Jacob went near unto Isaac his father; and he felt him, and said, The voice is Jacob's voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.

rr: Tiyaamumanya, ahabw'okuba engaro ze zikaba ziine ebyoya, nk'eza mukuru we Esau; yaiha aho, yaamushabira omugisha.
en: And he discerned him not, because his hands were hairy, as his brother Esau's hands: so he blessed him.

rr: Yaagaruka yaamubuuza ati: Beitu kwo buzima, ori omwana wangye Esau? Yaamugarukamu ati: Ndi we.
en: And he said, Art thou my very son Esau? And he said, I am .

rr: Isaaka yaagira ati: Ginyirize haihi, ndyeho, mwana wangye, nkushabire omugisha.
en: And he said, Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son's venison, that my soul may bless thee.

rr: Yaagimwiriza haihi, yaarya, yaamureetera na viinyo, yaanywa.
en: And he brought it near to him, and he did eat: and he brought him wine, and he drank.

rr: Isaaka ishe yaamugira ati: Irira haihi, onnywegyere, mwana wangye.
en: And his father Isaac said unto him, Come near now, and kiss me, my son.

rr: Yaamwirira haihi, yaamunywegyera. Isaaka yaahurira omugaju gw'ebijwaro bye, yaamushabira omugisha, naagira ati: Reeba, okutaamirana kw'omugaju gw'omwana wangye Nikushusha nk'okw'eishwa, eri MUKAMA ahaire omugisha.
en: And he came near, and kissed him: and he smelled the smell of his raiment, and blessed him, and said, See, the smell of my son Is as the smell of a field which the LORD hath blessed:

rr: Kandi Ruhanga akuhe aha rume orurikuruga omu iguru, N'aha mweru gw'ensi, n'engano nyingi na viinyo nyingi.
en: Therefore God give thee of the dew of heaven, And the fatness of the earth, And plenty of corn and wine:

rr: Enganda z'abantu zikuheereze, n'amahanga gakwinamire; Otegyekye beene sho, n'abaana ba nyoko bakwinamire. Weena orikukyeena, akyeenwe; Kandi weena orikushabira omugisha, nawe aheebwe omugisha. Esau okuririra omugisha gwe
en: Let people serve thee, And nations bow down to thee: Be lord over thy brethren, And let thy mother's sons bow down to thee: Cursed be every one that curseth thee, And blessed be he that blesseth thee.

rr: Bwanyima Isaaka ku yaabaire yaaheza kushabira Yakobo omugisha, Yakobo yaiha ati ebigyere omu maisho ga Isaaka ishe, Esau mukuru we yaija naaruga kuhiiga.
en: And it came to pass, as soon as Isaac had made an end of blessing Jacob, and Jacob was yet scarce gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came in from his hunting.

rr: Nawe yaateeka enyama, yaagirunga, yaagitwarira ishe; yaagira ishe ati: Taata, imuka orye aha nyama ei omwana waawe yaakureetera, obone kunshabira omugisha.
en: And he also had made savoury meat, and brought it unto his father, and said unto his father, Let my father arise, and eat of his son's venison, that thy soul may bless me.

rr: Isaaka ishe yaamubuuza ati: Kandi shi, iwe ori oha? Onu ati: Ndi omwana waawe w'omujigaijo Esau.
en: And Isaac his father said unto him, Who art thou? And he said, I am thy son, thy firstborn Esau.

rr: Isaaka yaatetema munonga, yaagira ati: Owaaruga aha, andeeteire enyama, nkarya ahari byona, nkamushabira omugisha otakaizire, n'oha? Kandi n'omugisha ogwo aryaguheebwa.
en: And Isaac trembled very exceedingly, and said, Who? where is he that hath taken venison, and brought it me, and I have eaten of all before thou camest, and have blessed him? yea, and he shall be blessed.

rr: Esau ku yaahuriire ebigambo bya ishe, yaarira, yaaborooga munonga n'obusaasi bwingi, yaagira ishe ati: Ai bambe, Taata, naanye nshabira omugisha.
en: And when Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with a great and exceeding bitter cry, and said unto his father, Bless me, even me also, O my father.

rr: Yaagira ati: Murumuna waawe yaija aha n'obugobya, yaatwara omugisha gwawe.
en: And he said, Thy brother came with subtilty, and hath taken away thy blessing.

rr: Esau yaagira ati: 27:36 Yakobo amakuru ngu, Okutaaha omu by'ondi; nari okugobeza ondi. Yakobo ni Yakobo kwo; eiziina niwe muntu. Eki n'ekya kabiri nangobeza; akanyihaho obukuru bwangye; mbwenu reeba kandi yaanyihaho n'omugisha gwangye. Yaagaruka yaamubuuza ati: Toine kagisha naanye aku wantsigiraho?
en: And he said, Is not he rightly named Jacob? for he hath supplanted me these two times: he took away my birthright; and, behold, now he hath taken away my blessing. And he said, Hast thou not reserved a blessing for me?

rr: Isaaka yaamugarukamu ati: Reeba, naamuhindura mukama waawe, na beene ishe boona naabamuha kuba abairu be; naamujarika, naamuha engano na viinyo eby'okumutunga; mbwenu shi, ninkikukorera ki, mwana wangye?
en: And Isaac answered and said unto Esau, Behold, I have made him thy lord, and all his brethren have I given to him for servants; and with corn and wine have I sustained him: and what shall I do now unto thee, my son?

rr: Esau yaabuuza ishe ati: Oine omugisha gumwe gwonka, Taata? Ai bambe Taata, naanye nshabira omugisha. Esau yaaborooga, yaarira.
en: And Esau said unto his father, Hast thou but one blessing, my father? bless me, even me also, O my father. And Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.

rr: Isaaka nikwo kumugira ati: Oryatuura hare n'omweru gw'ensi, N'orume orurikuruga omu iguru ahaiguru.
en: And Isaac his father answered and said unto him, Behold, thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, And of the dew of heaven from above;

rr: Rurara yaawe niyo erikubaisaho. Oryaheereza murumuna waawe; Kwonka ku orimwehindurira, Oryaruga omu butegyeki bwe.
en: And by thy sword shalt thou live, and shalt serve thy brother; And it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, That thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck.

rr: Okuruga aho Esau yaayanga Yakobo ahabw'omugisha ogu ishe yaamushabiire; Esau yaagira omu mutima gwe ati: Ebiro by'okucurira taata biri haihi; bwanyima yaabyo ndyaita murumuna wangye Yakobo.
en: And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him: and Esau said in his heart, The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob.

rr: Baagambira Rebeka ebi Esau omwana we mukuru agambire; yaatuma ow'okweta Yakobo omwana we omuto, yaamugira ati: Omanye mukuru waawe Esau ku amaririire kukwita, kwemara ekiniga.
en: And these words of Esau her elder son were told to Rebekah: and she sent and called Jacob her younger son, and said unto him, Behold, thy brother Esau, as touching thee, doth comfort himself, purposing to kill thee.

rr: Mbwenu nu, mwana wangye, hurira eki ndikukugambira; imuka ohungire Harani owa Labaani munyaanyazi
en: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice; and arise, flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran;

rr: obe oriyo omuri ebi biro, okuhitsya obu ekiniga kya mukuru waawe kiraahwe
en: and tarry with him a few days, until thy brother's fury turn away;

rr: n'enziika ye ekakurugaho, akeebwa eki omukozire; obwo ndyakutumaho, ogarukye. Ningasirwa ki, ku ndaabafiise mwembi eizooba rimwe?
en: until thy brother's anger turn away from thee, and he forget that which thou hast done to him: then I will send, and fetch thee from thence: why should I be deprived also of you both in one day?

rr: Rebeka yaagira Isaaka ati: Amagara gangye garuhire na bahara ba Heesi; Yakobo ku arishwera omwishiki omuri bahara ba Heesi, ori nk'aba ab'omu nsi egi, kiryagasira ki amagara gangye?
en: And Rebekah said to Isaac, I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth: if Jacob take a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these which are of the daughters of the land, what good shall my life do me?

rr: Isaaka yaayeta Yakobo, yaamushabira omugisha, yaamwehanangiriza ati: Otarishwera omu Bakanaanikazi.
en: And Isaac called Jacob, and blessed him, and charged him, and said unto him, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.

rr: Imuka oze Padanaramu owa Besueli shwenkuru, oshwereyo omukazi omuri bahara ba Labaani nyokoromi.
en: Arise, go to Padan-aram, to the house of Bethuel thy mother's father; and take thee a wife from thence of the daughters of Laban thy mother's brother.

rr: Kandi Ruhanga ow'obushoboorozi bwona akuhe omugisha, akuhe okuzaara munonga, akukanyise, obe omutwe muhango gw'amahanga
en: And God Almighty bless thee, and make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, that thou mayest be a multitude of people;

rr: kandi akuhe omugisha gwa Abrahamu, iwe n'oruzaaro rwawe, obone kuhungura ensi ei waashuhuukiiremu, ei Ruhanga yaahaire Abrahamu.
en: and give thee the blessing of Abraham, to thee, and to thy seed with thee; that thou mayest inherit the land wherein thou art a stranger, which God gave unto Abraham.

rr: Atyo Isaaka yaayohereza Yakobo, yaaza Padanaramu owa Labaani mwene Besueli Omusiria, munyaanya wa Rebeka, nyina wa Yakobo na Esau.
en: And Isaac sent away Jacob: and he went to Padan-aram unto Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob's and Esau's mother.

rr: Esau ku yaareebire Isaaka yaashabira Yakobo omugisha, kandi yaamwohereza Padanaramu kushwerayo omukazi; n'omu kumushabira omugisha yaamwehanangiriza ngu atarishwera omukazi omu baishiki ba Kanaani
en: When Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob, and sent him away to Padan-aram, to take him a wife from thence; and that as he blessed him he gave him a charge, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan;

rr: na Yakobo yaayorobera ishe na nyina, yaaza Padanaramu
en: and that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Padan-aram;

rr: Esau yaamanyira aho ku abaishiki ba Kanaani batarikugwisa gye Isaaka ishe
en: and Esau seeing that the daughters of Canaan pleased not Isaac his father;

rr: Esau nikwo kuza owa Ishimaeli, akashwera Mahalaasi muhara wa Ishimaeli mwene Abrahamu, kandi munyaanya Nebayoosi, akamwongyera aha bakazi abu yaabaire aine. Ruhanga okweyorekyera Yakobo omu kirooto
en: then went Esau unto Ishmael, and took unto the wives which he had Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael Abraham's son, the sister of Nebajoth, to be his wife.

rr: Yakobo yaaruga Beeri-sheba, naatoora Harani
en: And Jacob went out from Beer-sheba, and went toward Haran.

rr: yaahika omu mwanya, yaaguraaramu, ahakuba eizooba rikaba ryarengire; yaatwara eibaare rimwe aha mabaare agaabaire gari omu mwanya ogwo, yaaryeshegura, yaabyama, yaagwejegyera.
en: And he lighted upon a certain place, and tarried there all night, because the sun was set; and he took of the stones of that place, and put them for his pillows, and lay down in that place to sleep.

rr: Yaaroota, naareeba amatembero gatsimbire ahansi, omutwe gwago guhikire omu iguru, baamaraika ba Ruhanga nibagatemberaho, kandi nibagatemburukiraho.
en: And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of God ascending and descending on it.

rr: Kandi reeba, MUKAMA akaba ayemereire ahaiguru yaago, naagira ati: Ndi MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa Abrahamu shwenkuru, kandi Ruhanga wa Isaaka; ensi egi ei obyamiho ndyagikuha n'oruzaaro rwawe
en: And, behold, the LORD stood above it, and said, I am the LORD God of Abraham thy father, and the God of Isaac: the land whereon thou liest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed;

rr: n'oruzaaro rwawe ruryaba nk'omucuucu gw'ahansi, rubugye oburengyerwa-izooba, n'oburugwa-izooba, obukiizi-bwa-bumosho n'obwa-buryo; kandi omuriiwe n'omu ruzaaro rwawe enganda zoona ez'omu nsi nimwo ziriheerwa omugisha.
en: and thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth, and thou shalt spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south: and in thee and in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.

rr: Reeba ndi hamwe naiwe, ndyaguma ninkurinda ahu oriza hoona, kandi nkugarure omu nsi egi; ahakuba tindikutsigaho, okuhitsya obu ndiheza kukora ebi naakugambira.
en: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.

rr: Yakobo yaasisiimuka omu turo, yaagira ati: Buzimazima MUKAMA ari omu mwanya ogu, nyowe naaba ntakimanyire.
en: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep, and he said, Surely the LORD is in this place; and I knew it not.

rr: Yaatiina, yaagira ati: Omwanya ogu ka nigutiinisa!
en: And he was afraid, and said, How dreadful is this place! this is none other but the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven.

rr: Omwanya ogu ti kindi, n'enju ya Ruhanga, kandi n'eirembo ry'eiguru.
en: Beth-el

rr: Yakobo yaimuka nibutaagurukana, yaihaho eibaare, eri yaabaire ayeshegwire, yaaribyara kuba enyomyo, yaashuka amajuta aha mutwe gwaryo.
en: And Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put for his pillows, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil upon the top of it.

rr: Omwanya ogwo yaagweta Beseeli; kwonka eiziina ry'orurembo rwaho rikaba riri Luuzi obunyakare.
en: And he called the name of that place Beth-el: but the name of that city was called Luz at the first.

rr: Yakobo yaahiga naagira ati: Ruhanga ku ariguma naanye, yandinda omuri oru rugyendo oru ndimu, yaaguma nampa eby'okurya n'eby'okujwara
en: And Jacob vowed a vow, saying, If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and raiment to put on,

rr: bwanyima naagaruka owa taata n'obusingye, obwo MUKAMA aryaba Ruhanga wangye
en: so that I come again to my father's house in peace; then shall the LORD be my God:

rr: n'eri ibaare eri naabyara nk'enyomyo, eryaba enju ya Ruhanga; kandi ahari byona ebi origuma nompa, tindibura kukuha ekicweka kimwe kya ikumi.
en: and this stone, which I have set for a pillar, shall be God's house: and of all that thou shalt give me I will surely give the tenth unto thee.

rr: Currently Selected: Okutandika 28 : RR64 Highlight Share <path d="M5 12a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h3a1 1 0 1 1 0 2H6a1 1 0 0 1-1-1ZM5 15a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h3a1 1 0 1 1 0 2H6a1 1 0 0 1-1-1ZM5 9
Yakobo yaagumizamu orugyendo rwe, yaahika omu nsi y'abantu b'oburugwa-izooba.
en: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came into the land of the people of the east.

rr: Yaimutsya amaisho, yaareeba eiziba omu ishwa, n'amasyo ashatu g'entaama gabyami haihi naryo; ahabw'okuba aha iziba eryo niho baabaire bageeshera; eibaare eryabaire riri aha munwa gw'eiziba rikaba riri rihango munonga.
en: And he looked, and behold a well in the field, and, lo, there were three flocks of sheep lying by it; for out of that well they watered the flocks: and a great stone was upon the well's mouth.

rr: Amasyo goona ku gaabaire gateeranira aho, abariisa baiha eibaare aha munwa gw'eiziba, beeshera, bwanyima barigaruraho.
en: And thither were all the flocks gathered: and they rolled the stone from the well's mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone again upon the well's mouth in his place.

rr: Yakobo yaabuuza abariisa ati: Beene waitu, nimuruga hi? Baamugarukamu bati: Nituruga Harani.
en: And Jacob said unto them, My brethren, whence be ye? And they said, Of Haran are we.

rr: Yaababuuza ati: Nimumanya Labaani mwene Nahori? Banu bati: Nitumumanya.
en: And he said unto them, Know ye Laban the son of Nahor? And they said, We know him .

rr: Yaababuuza ati: Ariyo agumire? Banu bati: Agumire. Nangwa reeba, na Rakeeli muhara we, nguriya naija n'entaama.
en: And he said unto them, Is he well? And they said, He is well: and, behold, Rachel his daughter cometh with the sheep.

rr: Yakobo yaagira ati: Reeba, bukiri omu ihangwe, n'obunaku bw'okuzaagiza amasyo tibukahikire; mweshere entaama, mugyende muziriise.
en: And he said, Lo, it is yet high day, neither is it time that the cattle should be gathered together: water ye the sheep, and go and feed them .

rr: Baamugira bati: Titurikubaasa, amasyo goona gatakateeraine, bakaiha eibaare aha munwa gw'eiziba, tukabona kweshera entaama.
en: And they said, We cannot, until all the flocks be gathered together, and till they roll the stone from the well's mouth; then we water the sheep.

rr: Ku yaabaire naakigamba nabo, Rakeeli yaija n'entaama za ishe; ahakuba niwe yaabaire aziriisa.
en: And while he yet spake with them, Rachel came with her father's sheep: for she kept them.

rr: Yakobo ku yaareebire Rakeeli muhara wa Labaani nyinarumi n'entaama ze, yaahika aha iziba, yaiha eibaare aha munwa gwaryo, yaayeshera entaama za Labaani nyinarumi
en: And it came to pass, when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his mother's brother, and the sheep of Laban his mother's brother, that Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well's mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother's brother.

rr: Yakobo yaanywegyera Rakeeli, yaimutsya eiraka, yaarira naaborooga.
en: And Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.

rr: Yaayetondera Rakeeli ku aine obuzaare na ishe, kandi ku ari mutabani wa Rebeka. Rakeeli yairuka, yaabigambira ishe.
en: And Jacob told Rachel that he was her father's brother, and that he was Rebekah's son: and she ran and told her father.

rr: Labaani ku yaahuriire ebigambo bya Yakobo omwihwa, yairuka kumubugana, yaamubumbatira, yaamunywegyera, yaamutaasya omu ka ye.
en: And it came to pass, when Laban heard the tidings of Jacob his sister's son, that he ran to meet him, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house.

rr: Yakobo yaagambira Labaani ebyabaireho byona.
en: And he told Laban all these things.

rr: Labaani yaamugira ati: 29:14: Omu Ruheburaayo, ori eigufa ryangye kandi omubiri gwangye Buzimazima ori owangye ow'aha mara. Yaaguma nawe okumara okwezi kwona.
en: And Laban said to him, Surely thou art my bone and my flesh. And he abode with him the space of a month.

rr: Bwanyima Labaani yaamubuuza ati: Beitu shi, oshemereire kunkorerera busha, ngu ahakuba twine obuzaare? Okaayenzire ku nkuha bihembo ki?
en: And Laban said unto Jacob, Because thou art my brother, shouldest thou therefore serve me for nought? tell me, what shall thy wages be ?

rr: Kandi Labaani akaba aine abaishiki babiri; eiziina ry'omukuru akaba ari Lea, kandi ery'omuto ari Rakeeli.
en: And Laban had two daughters: the name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.

rr: Lea akaba ataine maisho garikwera; kwonka Rakeeli akaba ari murungi munonga w'okurigirwa.
en: Leah was tender eyed; but Rachel was beautiful and well favoured.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo Yakobo akakunda Rakeeli. Yakobo nikwo kugarukamu Labaani ati: Niinyija kukukorera emyaka mushanju, ompingire Rakeeli muhar waawe omuto.
en: And Jacob loved Rachel; and said, I will serve thee seven years for Rachel thy younger daughter.

rr: Labaani yaamugarukamu ati: Ni kirungi okumukuha okukira okumuha ondiijo muntu weena. Guma naanye.
en: And Laban said, It is better that I give her to thee, than that I should give her to another man: abide with me.

rr: . Atyo Yakobo yaakora emyaka mushanju ahabwa Rakeeli; kandi egyo myaka yaamubeera nk'ebiro bikye, ahabw'okukunda oku yaabaire naamukunda.
en: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel; and they seemed unto him but a few days, for the love he had to her.

rr: Bwanyima Yakobo yaagira Labaani ati: Mpingira omukazi wangye, mmushwere, ahabw'okuba mpikize ebiro byangye.
en: And Jacob said unto Laban, Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in unto her.

rr: Labaani yaateeka obugyenyi, yaayeta abantu boona ab'omuri ogwo mwanya.
en: And Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.

rr: Omu mwabazyo yaareeta muhara we Lea, yaamuhingira Yakobo, yaamushwera.
en: And it came to pass in the evening, that he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to him; and he went in unto her.

rr: Kandi Labaani yaaha muhara we Lea omuzaana we Zilupa kuba omuzaana we.
en: And Laban gave unto his daughter Leah Zilpah his maid for an handmaid.

rr: Omu kasheeshe Yakobo yashanga ari Lea; yaayetomboitera Labaani, naagira ati: Beitu shi, ongizire ota? Tindakukoreire ahabwa Rakeeli? Mbwenu ongobereize ki?
en: And it came to pass, that in the morning, behold, it was Leah: and he said to Laban, What is this thou hast done unto me? did not I serve with thee for Rachel? wherefore then hast thou beguiled me?

rr: Labaani yaagira ati: Owaitu tikwo tugira, okuhingira omuto omukuru atakashweirwe.
en: And Laban said, It must not be so done in our country, to give the younger before the firstborn.

rr: Banza omare saabiti n'ogwo, haza tukuhingire n'ogu, ogarukye onkorere endiijo myaka mushanju.
en: Fulfil her week, and we will give thee this also for the service which thou shalt serve with me yet seven other years.

rr: Yakobo yaakora atyo; yaamara saabiiti na Lea; bwanyima Labaani yaamuhingira Rakeeli muhara we.
en: And Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week: and he gave him Rachel his daughter to wife also.

rr: Kandi Labaani yaaha Rakeeli omuzaana we Biliha kuba omuzaana we.
en: And Laban gave to Rachel his daughter Bilhah his handmaid to be her maid.

rr: Atyo Yakobo yaashwera Rakeeli; kandi yaamukunda munonga okukira Lea; yaagaruka yaakorera Labaani endiijo myaka mushanju.
en: And he went in also unto Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him yet seven other years.

rr: MUKAMA ku yaareebire Lea yaaba enyangwakazi, yaigura enda ye; kwonka Rakeeli we yaaba engumba.
en: And when the LORD saw that Leah was hated, he opened her womb: but Rachel was barren.

rr: Lea yaagira enda, yaazaara omwana w'omwojo; yaamweta Reubeeni; ahakuba akagira ati: MUKAMA areebire okwitwa kubi kwangye; mbwenu ibanye naija kunkunda.
en: And Leah conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name Reuben: for she said, Surely the LORD hath looked upon my affliction; now therefore my husband will love me.

rr: Yaagaruka yaagira enda, yaazaara ondiijo mwojo; yaagira ati: MUKAMA ahuriire ku ndikwangwa, nikyo yampeera n'ogu; yaamweta Simeoni.
en: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Because the LORD hath heard that I was hated, he hath therefore given me this son also: and she called his name Simeon.

rr: Yaagaruka yaagira enda, yaazaara omwojo; yaagira ati: Aha murundi ogu ibanye naija kukwatanisa naanye, ahakuba mmuzaariire aboojo bashatu; n'ahabw'ekyo yaamweta Leevi.
en: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Now this time will my husband be joined unto me, because I have born him three sons: therefore was his name called Levi.

rr: Yaagaruka yaagira enda, yaazaara omwojo; yaagira ati: Omurundi ogu naaza kuhimbisa MUKAMA; nikyo yaamweteire Yuda; bwanyima oruzaaro rwayemerera.
en: And she conceived again, and bare a son: and she said, Now will I praise the LORD : therefore she called his name Judah; and left bearing.

Rakeeli ku yaareebire atazaariire Yakobo baana yaagirira mukuru we eihari; yaagambira Yakobo ati: Mpa abaana; ku oraabe otabampaire, ninfa.
en: And when Rachel saw that she bare Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister; and said unto Jacob, Give me children, or else I die.

rr: Yakobo yaagirira Rakeeli ekiniga, yaagira ati: Niinye waata omu mwanya gwa Ruhanga owaakwimire oruzaaro?
en: And Jacob's anger was kindled against Rachel: and he said, Am I in God's stead, who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb?

rr: Yaamugarukamu ati: Reeba omuzaana wangye Biliha, omushwere, abone kuzaarira aha maju gangye, naanye mmubonereho abaana.
en: And she said, Behold my maid Bilhah, go in unto her; and she shall bear upon my knees, that I may also have children by her.

rr: Yaamuha Biliha omuzaana we; Yakobo yaamushwera.
en: And she gave him Bilhah her handmaid to wife: and Jacob went in unto her.

rr: Biliha yaagira enda, yaazaarira Yakobo omwana w'omwojo.
en: And Bilhah conceived, and bare Jacob a son.

rr: Rakeeli yaagira ati: Ruhanga ancwereire orubanja, kandi yaahurira okushaba kwangye, yampa omwana w'omwojo. Nikyo yaamweteire Daani.
en: And Rachel said, God hath judged me, and hath also heard my voice, and hath given me a son: therefore called she his name Dan.

rr: Biliha omuzaana wa Rakeeli yaagaruka yaagira enda, yaazaarira Yakobo omwojo wa kabiri.
en: And Bilhah Rachel's maid conceived again, and bare Jacob a second son.

rr: Rakeeli yaagira ati: Nfukaine munonga na mukuru wangye, naamwikarira. Nikyo yaamweteire Nafutaali.
en: And Rachel said, With great wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister, and I have prevailed: and she called his name Naphtali.

rr: Lea ku yaareebire atagaruka kuzaara, yaatwara Zilupa omuzaana we, yaamuha Yakobo kuba omukazi we.
en: When Leah saw that she had left bearing, she took Zilpah her maid, and gave her Jacob to wife.

rr: Zilupa omuzaana wa Lea yaazaarira Yakobo omwana w'omwojo.
en: And Zilpah Leah's maid bare Jacob a son.

rr: Lea yaagira ati: Eshi naahiirwa! Yaamweta Gaadi.
en: And Leah said, A troop cometh: and she called his name Gad.

rr: Zilupa omuzaana wa Lea yaazaarira Yakobo omwojo wa kabiri
en: And Zilpah Leah's maid bare Jacob a second son.

rr: Lea yaagira ati: Eshi nyine omugisha! Ahakuba abakazi baryanyeta Ohiiriirwe; yaamweta Asheri.
en: And Leah said, Happy am I, for the daughters will call me blessed: and she called his name Asher.

rr: Omu igyesha ry'engano Reubeeni yaaza omu ishwa, yaagwa aha madudaimu, yaagareetera Lea nyina.
en: And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them unto his mother Leah.

rr: Rakeeli yaashaba Lea ati: Ninkweshengyereza, mpa aha madudaimu ga mutabani waawe.
en: Then Rachel said to Leah, Give me, I pray thee, of thy son's mandrakes.

rr: Lea yaamugarukamu ati: Iwe okyetsire ekigambo kikye okuncwa aha mushaija wange; mbwenu nooyenda kutwara n'amadudaimu g'omwana wangye?
en: And she said unto her, Is it a small matter that thou hast taken my husband? and wouldest thou take away my son's mandrakes also?

rr: Rakeeli yaagira ati: Mbwenu ku orampe amadudaimu g'omwana waawe, baro naija kukuraarira.
en: And Rachel said, Therefore he shall lie with thee to night for thy son's mandrakes.

rr: Omu mwabazyo Yakobo ku yaabaire naaruga omu ishwa naataaha, Lea yaashohora kumubugana, yaamugira ati: Oshemereire kundaarira, ahabw'okuba naaha amadudaimu g'omwana wangye ahabwawe.
en: And Jacob came out of the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, Thou must come in unto me; for surely I have hired thee with my son's mandrakes.

rr: Yakobo nikwo kumuraarira ekyo kiro.
en: And he lay with her that night.

rr: Ruhanga yaahurira okushaba kwa Lea, yaagira enda, yaazaarira Yakobo omojo wa kataano.
en: And God hearkened unto Leah, and she conceived, and bare Jacob the fifth son.

rr: Lea yaagira ati: Ruhanga yampa ebihembo, ahakuba nkaha ibanye omuzaana wangye; ogwo mwana yaamweta Isakaari.
en: And Leah said, God hath given me my hire, because I have given my maiden to my husband: and she called his name Issachar.

rr: Lea yaagaruka yaagira enda, yaazaarira Yakobo omwojo wa mukaaga.
en: And Leah conceived again, and bare Jacob the sixth son.

rr: Lea yaagira ati: Ruhanga yampa ekiconco kirungi eky'obugore; mbwenu ibanye naija kuguma naanye, ahakuba mmuzaariire aboojo mukaaga; omwana yaamweta Zebuluuni.
en: And Leah said, God hath endued me with a good dowry; now will my husband dwell with me, because I have born him six sons: and she called his name Zebulun.

rr: Bwanyima yaazaara omwishiki, yaamweta Dina.
en: And afterwards she bare a daughter, and called her name Dinah.

rr: Ruhanga yaijuka Rakeeli, yaahurira okushaba kwe, yaigura enda ye.
en: And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb.

rr: Yaagira enda, yaazaara omwana w'omwojo, yaagira ati: Ruhanga yaanyihaho ekihemu
en: And she conceived, and bare a son; and said, God hath taken away my reproach:

rr: yaamweta Yosefu, naagira ati: MUKAMA anyongyere akandi koojo. Yakobo okushaba kugaruka owaabo
en: and she called his name Joseph; and said, The LORD shall add to me another son. Jacob and Laban

rr: Rakeeli ku yaaherize kuzaara Yosefu, Yakobo yaagira Labaani ati: Ndaga, ngarukye omuka omu nsi y'owaitu.
en: And it came to pass, when Rachel had born Joseph, that Jacob said unto Laban, Send me away, that I may go unto mine own place, and to my country.

rr: Ompe abakazi bangye n'abaana bangye, abu naakukorereire, ngyende; ahakuba noomanya omurimo ogu naakukoreire.
en: Give me my wives and my children, for whom I have served thee, and let me go: for thou knowest my service which I have done thee.

rr: Labaani yaamugarukamu ati: Ku oraabe nongirira embabazi, ogume aha; ahakuba nyetegyereize ku MUKAMA ampaire omugisha ahabwawe.
en: And Laban said unto him, I pray thee, if I have found favour in thine eyes, tarry: for I have learned by experience that the LORD hath blessed me for thy sake.

rr: Yaagaruka yaagira ati: Oncwere ebihembo ebi orikwenda, niinyija kubikuha.
en: And he said, Appoint me thy wages, and I will give it .

rr: Yakobo yaamugarukamu ati: Noomanya oku naakukoreire, n'oku amatungo gaawe gaabaire, obu naabaire ninkigariisa.
en: And he said unto him, Thou knowest how I have served thee, and how thy cattle was with me.

rr: Ahakuba agu waabaire oine ntakaizire, gakaba gari makye; mbwenu gakanyire, gaaba maingi munonga; kandi MUKAMA akakuha omugisha, ahu naabaire nza hoona. Mbwenu nyowe ndyatunga ryari eby'okukwatsa eka yangye?
en: For it was little which thou hadst before I came , and it is now increased unto a multitude; and the LORD hath blessed thee since my coming: and now when shall I provide for mine own house also?

rr: Onu ati: Mbwenu nkuhe ki?
en: And he said, What shall I give thee?

rr: Yakobo yaagarukamu ati: Toine ki orampe; kureka ku oraabe noikiriza kunkorera eki, niinyija kugumizamu kuriisa amasyo gaawe n'okugarinda.
en: And Jacob said, Thou shalt not give me any thing: if thou wilt do this thing for me, I will again feed and keep thy flock.

rr: Onyikirize ndabe omu busyo bwawe bwona eri izooba, nyihemu entaama zoona ez'ebigabo n'ez'amayenje, n'abaana baazo abarikwiragura, n'embuzi z'obugondo n'ez'ebitanga; ezirikushusha zityo nizo ziriba ebihembo byangye.
en: I will pass through all thy flock to day, removing from thence all the speckled and spotted cattle, and all the brown cattle among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats: and of such shall be my hire.

rr: Bwanyima ku oraije kureeba ebihembo byangye, amazima gangye nigaija kweyoreka; embuzi yoona ei oraashangye etari y'ebitanga nari ey'obugondo, n'entaama yoona etari erikwiragura, biri n'enyibano.
en: So shall my righteousness answer for me in time to come, when it shall come for my hire before thy face: every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and brown among the sheep, that shall be counted stolen with me.

rr: Labaani yaagira ati: Ni kirungi; ka kibe nk'oku waagamba.
en: And Laban said, Behold, I would it might be according to thy word.

rr: Eryo izooba Labaani yaashorooramu empaya z'embuzi ez'ebihuuga n'ez'obugondo n'ebuguma zoona ez'ebitanga n'ez'obugondo n'eine ekigabo yoona, n'entaama ezirikwiragura zoona, yaaziha abatabani
en: And he removed that day the he goats that were ringstraked and spotted, and all the she goats that were speckled and spotted, and every one that had some white in it, and all the brown among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.

rr: yaatsiga ahagati ye na Yakobo omwanya gw'orugyendo rw'ebiro bishatu. Yakobo yaariisa amasyo ga Labaani agaatsigaraho.
en: And he set three days' journey betwixt himself and Jacob: and Jacob fed the rest of Laban's flocks.

rr: Yakobo yaatwara enkoni z'emilebeni mibisi, n'ez'emiluzi, n'ez'arumoni, yaazicwamu amabara agarikwera maraingwa, gaareebeka.
en: And Jacob took him rods of green poplar, and of the hazel and chesnut tree; and pilled white strakes in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.

rr: Yaazita omu mikura erikutwara amaizi omu bwato, ahu amasyo ganywera
en: And he set the rods which he had pilled before the flocks in the gutters in the watering troughs when the flocks came to drink, that they should conceive when they came to drink.

rr: ku gaabaire gaija kunywa, ezirikwenda kwema zaayema nizireeba ezo nkoni, zizaara ez'ebihuuga n'ez'ebigabo n'ez'amayenje.
en: And the flocks conceived before the rods, and brought forth cattle ringstraked, speckled, and spotted.

rr: Yakobo yaashoroora abo baana b'entaama, kandi amasyo yaagareebesa ez'ebihuuga n'ezirikwiragura zoona eziri omu busyo bwa Labaani; bwanyima eze yaazita aha kwazo, yaareka kuziteerana n'obusyo bwa Labaani.
en: And Jacob did separate the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the ringstraked, and all the brown in the flock of Laban; and he put his own flocks by themselves, and put them not unto Laban's cattle.

rr: Enungi ku zaabaire ziba nizeema, Yakobo ata enkoni omu mikura omu maisho gaazo, ngu zeemere ahagati y'ezo nkoni
en: And it came to pass, whensoever the stronger cattle did conceive, that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the cattle in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods.

rr: kwonka ku zaabaire ziba ziri mbi, areka kutaho enkoni; n'ahabw'ekyo embi ziri eza Labaani, enungi ziba eza Yakobo.
en: But when the cattle were feeble, he put them not in: so the feebler were Laban's, and the stronger Jacob's.

rr: Okwo nikwo ogwo mushaija yaayeyongyeire kutunga munonga, n'okugira amasyo maingi, abazaana n'abahuuku, engamira n'endogoya.
en: And the man increased exceedingly, and had much cattle, and maidservants, and menservants, and camels, and asses.

rr: Yakobo yaahurira batabani ba Labaani nibagira bati: Yakobo atwaire byona ebyabaire biri ebya tataitwe, kandi nimwo aihire eitungo eri ryona.
en: And he heard the words of Laban's sons, saying, Jacob hath taken away all that was our father's; and of that which was our father's hath he gotten all this glory.

rr: Kandi yaareeba Labaani atakimureeba gye nk'okubanza.
en: And Jacob beheld the countenance of Laban, and, behold, it was not toward him as before.

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Yakobo ati: Garuka omu nsi ya baashwenkuru n'omuri beene waanyu; kandi ndyaguma hamwe naiwe.
en: And the LORD said unto Jacob, Return unto the land of thy fathers, and to thy kindred; and I will be with thee.

rr: Yakobo yaatuma ahari Rakeeli na Lea kumushanga omu ishwa, ei amasyo ge gaabaire gari
en: And Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field unto his flock,

rr: yaabagira ati: Ndeebire shoimwe atakindeeba gye nk'okubanza; kwonka Ruhanga wa taata akaguma naanye.
en: and said unto them, I see your father's countenance, that it is not toward me as before; but the God of my father hath been with me.

rr: Naimwe nimumanya ku naakoreire shoimwe n'amaani gangye goona.
en: And ye know that with all my power I have served your father.

rr: Kandi shoimwe atuura nangobeza, ahindwire ebihembo byangye emirundi ikumi; kwonka Ruhanga taramwikiriize kunkora kubi.
en: And your father hath deceived me, and changed my wages ten times; but God suffered him not to hurt me.

rr: Ku yaabaire angira ati: Ez'obugondo nizo ziriba ebihembo byawe, obusyo bwona buzaara ez'obugondo; akigira ati; Ez'ebihuuga nizo ziriba ebihembo byawe, obusyo bwona buzaara ez'ebihuuga.
en: If he said thus, The speckled shall be thy wages; then all the cattle bare speckled: and if he said thus, The ringstraked shall be thy hire; then bare all the cattle ringstraked.

rr: Okwo nikwo Ruhanga yaayakire shoimwe amatungo, akagampa.
en: Thus God hath taken away the cattle of your father, and given them to me.

rr: Omu bunaku bu amasyo gaabaire geemeramu, nkanaga amaisho nindoota, naareeba empaya z'embuzi ezaabaire nizeemya obusyo ziri ez'ebihuuga, n'ez'obugondo, n'ez'ebihuura.
en: And it came to pass at the time that the cattle conceived, that I lifted up mine eyes, and saw in a dream, and, behold, the rams which leaped upon the cattle were ringstraked, speckled, and grisled.

rr: Maraika wa Ruhanga yangambirira omuri ekyo kirooto ati: Yakobo! Naagarukamu nti: Mukama wangye.
en: And the angel of God spake unto me in a dream, saying , Jacob: And I said, Here am I.

rr: Yangira ati: Imutsya amaisho gaawe, oreebe empaya z'embuzi zoona ezirikwemya obusyo ku ziri ez'ebihuuga n'ez'obugondo n'ez'ebihuura; ahakuba ndeebire ebi Labaani arikukwitsa.
en: And he said, Lift up now thine eyes, and see, all the rams which leap upon the cattle are ringstraked, speckled, and grisled: for I have seen all that Laban doeth unto thee.

rr: Niinye Ruhanga wa Beseeli, ei waashukiire amajuta aha ibaare, kandi ei waahigiire nondahira; mbwenu imuka orugye omu nsi egi, ogarukye omu nsi ei waazaariirwemu.
en: I am the God of Beth-el, where thou anointedst the pillar, and where thou vowedst a vow unto me: now arise, get thee out from this land, and return unto the land of thy kindred.

rr: Rakeeli na Lea baamugarukamu bati: Noogira ngu tukiine omugabo nari obuhunguzi owa tataitwe?
en: And Rachel and Leah answered and said unto him, Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father's house?

rr: Tarikutubara nk'abanyamahanga? Ahakuba akatutunda, kandi yaamariraho kimwe empiiha zaitu.
en: Are we not counted of him strangers? for he hath sold us, and hath quite devoured also our money.

rr: Atyo Yakobo yaimuka, yaata abatabani n'abakazi be aha ngamira
en: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives upon camels;

rr: yaatwara amatungo ge goona n'ebintu byona ebi yaayetungiire, nigo matungo agu yaihire omuri Padanaramu, okuza owa Isaaka ishe omu nsi ya Kanaani.
en: and he carried away all his cattle, and all his goods which he had gotten, the cattle of his getting, which he had gotten in Padan-aram, for to go to Isaac his father in the land of Canaan.

rr: Omuri ebyo biro Labaani akaba agiire kushara ebyoya by'entaama ze; Rakeeli yaiba ebishushani by'emandwa za ishe.
en: And Laban went to shear his sheep: and Rachel had stolen the images that were her father's.

rr: Yakobo yaayeiba ahari Labaani Omusiria, ahakuba taramugambiire ku arikwenda kuhunga.
en: And Jacob stole away unawares to Laban the Syrian, in that he told him not that he fled.

rr: Atyo yaacwa n'ebi yaabaire aine byona; yaimuka, yaayambuka omugyera Furaati, yaatoora omuhanda ogurikuza omu nsi y'ebibungo bya Gileadi
en: So he fled with all that he had; and he rose up, and passed over the river, and set his face toward the mount Gilead.

rr: Aha kiro kya kashatu baagambira Labaani ku Yakobo acwire.
en: And it was told Laban on the third day that Jacob was fled.

rr: Labaani nikwo kutwara beene ishe akamukurata; bwanyima y'ebiro mushanju akamushanga omu nsi y'ebibungo bya Gileadi.
en: And he took his brethren with him, and pursued after him seven days' journey; and they overtook him in the mount Gilead.

rr: Nyekiro Ruhanga yaizira Labaani Omusiria omu kirooto, yaamugira ati: Oyerinde, otagambira Yakobo ekigambo kyona, ekirungi nari ekibi. Labaani okutongana na Yakobo
en: And God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream by night, and said unto him, Take heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.

rr: Labaani yaahika Yakobo, yaashanga ateire eihema rye omu nsi y'ebibungo bya Geleadi; Labaani na beene ishe nabo baateerayo amahema gaabo.
en: Then Laban overtook Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mount: and Laban with his brethren pitched in the mount of Gilead.

rr: Labaani yaagambira Yakobo ati: Eki okozire ki okunyeibaho, okatwara bahara bangye nk'abu banyagire na rurara?
en: And Laban said to Jacob, What hast thou done, that thou hast stolen away unawares to me, and carried away my daughters, as captives taken with the sword?

rr: Ohungiire ki ntakimanyire, okanyeibaho, otangambiire nkabona kukuraga tushemereirwe, nitweshongora n'ebitaasa n'enanga?
en: Wherefore didst thou flee away secretly, and steal away from me; and didst not tell me, that I might have sent thee away with mirth, and with songs, with tabret, and with harp?

rr: Kandi ahabw'enki otaanyikiriize kunywegyera baijukuru bangye na bahara bangye nimbaraga? Eki okozire n'eky'obushema.
en: And hast not suffered me to kiss my sons and my daughters? thou hast now done foolishly in so doing.

rr: Naaba nimbaasa kukukora kubi; kwonka Ruhanga wa sho araire angambiire ati: Oyerinde, otagambira Yakobo ekigambo kyona ekirungi nari ekibi.
en: It is in the power of my hand to do you hurt: but the God of your father spake unto me yesternight, saying, Take thou heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.

rr: Nimmanya ku ogyenzire ahabw'okugirira eka ya sho orushusho; beitu shi oibiire ki emandwa zangye?
en: And now, though thou wouldest needs be gone, because thou sore longedst after thy father's house, yet wherefore hast thou stolen my gods?

rr: Yakobo yaagarukamu Labaani ati: Ahakuba nkatiina, naagira ngu noija kuunyaka bahara baawe n'empaka.
en: And Jacob answered and said to Laban, Because I was afraid: for I said, Peradventure thou wouldest take by force thy daughters from me.

rr: Kandi weena ou oraashangye aine emandwa zaawe, atakira. Tukiri aha omu maisho ga beene waitu, caaka, ekyawe eki oraashangye nyine okitware. Kwonka Yakobo akaba atarikumanya ku Rakeeli aziibire.
en: With whomsoever thou findest thy gods, let him not live: before our brethren discern thou what is thine with me, and take it to thee. For Jacob knew not that Rachel had stolen them.

rr: Labaani yaataaha omu ihema rya Yakobo n'erya Lea n'omu ihema ry'abazaana bombi; kwonka tiyaazishangamu.
en: And Laban went into Jacob's tent, and into Leah's tent, and into the two maidservants' tents; but he found them not.

rr: Yaaruga omu ihema rya Lea, yaataaha omu rya Rakeeli.
en: Then went he out of Leah's tent, and entered into Rachel's tent.

rr: Rakeeli ogwo akaba yaazitwaire, yaazitaire omu matandiiko g'engamira, azishutamiire, Labaani yaacaaka eihema ryona, tiyaazibona.
en: Now Rachel had taken the images, and put them in the camel's furniture, and sat upon them. And Laban searched all the tent, but found them not.

rr: Rakeeli yaagambira ishe ati: Mukama wangye, kitakugwisa kubi ahabw'okutakwimukira, ahakuba ndi omu kwezi.
en: And she said to her father, Let it not displease my lord that I cannot rise up before thee; for the custom of women is upon me.

rr: Labaani yaacaaka, kwonka tiyaazibona.
en: And he searched, but found not the images.

rr: Yakobo yaagira ekiniga, yaatonganisa Labaani, naagira ati: Nshobize ki? Nkozire kibi ki ekikureeteire okunkurata otyo n'ekiniga?
en: And Jacob was wroth, and chode with Laban: and Jacob answered and said to Laban, What is my trespass? what is my sin, that thou hast so hotly pursued after me?

rr: Mbwenu ku waacaaka omu bintu byangye byona, aha bintu by'omu nju yaawe byona waashangamu ki? Kite aha omu maisho ga beene waitu na beene waanyu, batucwere orubanja.
en: Whereas thou hast searched all my stuff, what hast thou found of all thy household stuff? set it here before my brethren and thy brethren, that they may judge betwixt us both.

rr: Mmazire naiwe emyaka makumi abiri; omuri egyo myaka entaama zaawe n'embuzi zaawe tizikatoroogaga, kandi tinkaryaga mpaya z'omu masyo gaawe.
en: This twenty years have I been with thee; thy ewes and thy she goats have not cast their young, and the rams of thy flock have I not eaten.

rr: Ezaabaire ziitwa enyamaishwa, nkaba ntazikureetera, niinye zaabaire zifeera; kandi eyaabaire eibwa nyomushana nari nyekiro okaba ogindihisa.
en: That which was torn of beasts I brought not unto thee; I bare the loss of it; of my hand didst thou require it, whether stolen by day, or stolen by night.

rr: Okwo nikwo naabaire nfa kubi; nyomushana nyitwa omushana, na nyekiro nyitwa embeho; ngurukwa oturo.
en: Thus I was; in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep departed from mine eyes.

rr: Mmazire egi myaka makumi abiri omu ka yaawe; ikumi n'ena nkagikukorera ahabwa bahara baawe bombi, n'omukaaga ahabw'obusyo bwawe; kandi ebihembo byangye okabihindura emirundi ikumi.
en: Thus have I been twenty years in thy house; I served thee fourteen years for thy two daughters, and six years for thy cattle: and thou hast changed my wages ten times.

rr: Kuri Ruhanga wa taata, Ruhanga wa Abrahamu, ou Isaaka yaabaire atiina, atarabaire hamwe naanye, buzimazima okaanyohereize ntaine kantu.
en: Except the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely thou hadst sent me away now empty.

rr: Ruhanga areebire okubonabona n'okufa kubi kwangye ninkora, yaakuteisa eki kiro.
en: God hath seen mine affliction and the labour of my hands, and rebuked thee yesternight.

rr: Labaani yaagarukamu Yakobo ati: Abaishiki aba ni bahara bangye, n'abaana aba n'abaana bangye, kandi n'amasyo aga n'amasyo gangye, n'ebi byona ebi orikureeba n'ebyangye. Mbwenu eri izooba ngire nta aba baishiki bangye n'abaana baabo abu baazaire?
en: And Laban answered and said unto Jacob, These daughters are my daughters, and these children are my children, and these cattle are my cattle, and all that thou seest is mine: and what can I do this day unto these my daughters, or unto their children which they have born?

rr: Mbwenu ija tukore endagaano, nyowe naiwe; ebe omujurizi ahagati yangye naiwe.
en: Now therefore come thou, let us make a covenant, I and thou; and let it be for a witness between me and thee.

rr: Yakobo yaatwara eibaare, yaaribyara kuba enyomyo.
en: And Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.

rr: Yaagamibira beene ishe ati: Mutorotoore amabaare. Ku baagatorotoire, baagarunda hamwe; baariira aha rubaju rw'ekirundo kyago.
en: And Jacob said unto his brethren, Gather stones; and they took stones, and made an heap: and they did eat there upon the heap.

rr: Labaani yaayeta ogwo mwanya Yegari-sahadusa; kwonka Yakobo yaagweta Galeedi.
en: And Laban called it Jegar-sahadutha: but Jacob called it Galeed.

rr: Labaani yaagira ati: Eri izooba ekirundo eki kyaba omujurizi ahagati yangye naiwe. Nikyo kyayeteirwe Galeedi
en: And Laban said, This heap is a witness between me and thee this day. Therefore was the name of it called Galeed;

rr: kandi na Mizipa; ahakuba akagira ati; MUKAMA agumye eriisho ahagati yangye naiwe, ku turiba twataine.
en: and Mizpah; for he said, The LORD watch between me and thee, when we are absent one from another.

rr: Ku oriita kubi abaishiki bangye, nari waabashwereraho abandi bakazi, n'obu hariba hataine oriho, omanye ngu Ruhanga niwe kareebi wangye naiwe.
en: If thou shalt afflict my daughters, or if thou shalt take other wives beside my daughters, no man is with us; see, God is witness betwixt me and thee.

rr: Kandi yaagira Yakobo ati: Omanye eki kirundo, n'egi nyomyo, ebi naata ahagati yangye naiwe.
en: And Laban said to Jacob, Behold this heap, and behold this pillar, which I have cast betwixt me and thee;

rr: Ekirundo eki n'eky'okuhamya, n'enyomyo egi n'ey'okuhamya, ku ntariraba aha kirundo eki kukukora kubi, kandi naiwe ku otarikirabaho nari egi nyomyo kunkora kubi.
en: this heap be witness, and this pillar be witness, that I will not pass over this heap to thee, and that thou shalt not pass over this heap and this pillar unto me, for harm.

rr: Ruhanga wa Abrahamu, Ruhanga wa Nahori, Ruhanga wa ishebo, atucwere orubanja.
en: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge betwixt us.

rr: Yakobo yaarahira Ou Isaaka ishe yaabaire atiina.
en: And Jacob sware by the fear of his father Isaac.

rr: Bwanyima Yakobo yaatambira ekitambo aha kibungo, yaayeta beene ishe kurya eby'okurya; baarya, baaraara aho, bwarugaho bwasheesha.
en: Then Jacob offered sacrifice upon the mount, and called his brethren to eat bread: and they did eat bread, and tarried all night in the mount.

rr: Ku bwabaire nibutaagurukana, Labaani yaimuka, yaanywegyera abaijukuru na bahara be, yaabashabira omugisha. Yaagyenda, yaagaruka owaabo. Currently Selected: Okutandika 31 : RR64 Highlight Share <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8 19c-2.828 0-4.243 0-5.12
en: And early in the morning Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them: and Laban departed, and returned unto his place. Currently Selected: Genesis 31 : KJV Highlight Share <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8 19c-2.828 0-4.243

rr: Yakobo yaagumizamu yaagyenda, baamaraika ba Ruhanga baamubugana.
en: And Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.

rr: Ku yaabareebire, yaagira ati: Aba n'eihe rya Ruhanga. Omwanya ogwo yaagweta Mahanaimu.
en: And when Jacob saw them, he said, This is God's host: and he called the name of that place Mahanaim.

rr: Yaatuma entumwa kumubandiza ahari Esau mukuru we omu nsi ya Seiri, niyo nsi ya Edomu
en: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother unto the land of Seir, the country of Edom.

rr: yaabaragiira ati: Mugambire mukama wangye Esau muti: Oku nikwo omwiru waawe Yakobo arikugamba, naagira ati: Nkashuhuukira owa Labaani naagumayo n'okuhitsya hati.
en: And he commanded them, saying, Thus shall ye speak unto my lord Esau; Thy servant Jacob saith thus, I have sojourned with Laban, and stayed there until now:

rr: Nyine ente n'endogoya n'amasyo g'entaama n'abahuuku n'abazaana. Mbwenu ntumire ahariiwe, mukama wangye, kukugambira, ngu okaangirira embabazi.
en: and I have oxen, and asses, flocks, and menservants, and womenservants: and I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find grace in thy sight.

rr: Entumwa zaagaruka ahari Yakobo, zaagira ziti: Esau mukuru waawe tumuhikireho; kandi naija n'abashaija magana ana kukubugana.
en: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, We came to thy brother Esau, and also he cometh to meet thee, and four hundred men with him.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo Yakobo yaatiina munonga, yaashoberwa. Abantu abu yaabaire aine n'amasyo g'entaama n'ag'ente n'engamira, yaabicwamu ebicweka bibiri
en: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed: and he divided the people that was with him, and the flocks, and herds, and the camels, into two bands;

rr: yaagira ati: Esau ku araahikye aha kicweka kimwe, yaakicwekyereza, ekindi kicweka nikiija kukira.
en: and said, If Esau come to the one company, and smite it, then the other company which is left shall escape.

rr: Yakobo yaashaba ati: Ai Ruhanga wa tatenkuru Abrahamu, Ruhanga wa taata Isaaka, MUKAMA owangizire oti: Garuka owaanyu omuri beene waanyu, ndyakukorera gye.
en: And Jacob said, O God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, the LORD which saidst unto me, Return unto thy country, and to thy kindred, and I will deal well with thee:

rr: Aha mbabazi zaawe zoona n'obwesigwa bwawe bwona ebi waayorekire omwiru waawe, tinshemereire kuheebwaho nangwa n'akati kaingana busha; ahakuba nkambuka Yorudani egi n'enkoni yonka; mbwenu ndugiremu emitwe ebiri.
en: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies, and of all the truth, which thou hast shewed unto thy servant; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan; and now I am become two bands.

rr: Ninkweshengyereza, onkize mukuru wangye Esau; ahakuba nimmutiina, ngu atakaija akanyita n'abaana bangye na baanyinabo.
en: Deliver me, I pray thee, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau: for I fear him, lest he will come and smite me, and the mother with the children.

rr: Kandi naiwe okandaganisa oti: Buzimazima ndyakukorera gye, mpindure oruzaaro rwawe rube nk'omusheenyi gw'aha nyanja, ogutarikubaasa kubarwa.
en: And thou saidst, I will surely do thee good, and make thy seed as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.

rr: Ekyo kiro yaaraara aho; yaiha omu bi yaabaire aine ekiconco ky'okuha Esau mukuru we
en: And he lodged there that same night; and took of that which came to his hand a present for Esau his brother;

rr: ebuguma z'embuzi magana abiri, n'empaya makumi abiri, ebuguma z'entaama magana abiri n'empaya makumi abiri
en: two hundred she goats, and twenty he goats, two hundred ewes, and twenty rams,

rr: engamira ezirikukamwa makumi ashatu n'enyana zaazo, ente z'ejigija makumi ana n'enimi ikumi, n'ebuguma z'endogoya makumi abiri n'abaana baazo ikumi.
en: thirty milch camels with their colts, forty kine, and ten bulls, twenty she asses, and ten foals.

rr: Yaaziha abairu be, buri busyo okwabwo, yaabagira ati: Munyebembere, mwambukye, mutsigye omwanya ahagati y'obusyo n'obundi.
en: And he delivered them into the hand of his servants, every drove by themselves; and said unto his servants, Pass over before me, and put a space betwixt drove and drove.

rr: Yaaragiira omwebembezi ati: Mukuru wangye Esau ku araakubugane, yaakubuuza ati: Ori ow'oha? Kandi, Nimuza hi? Kandi amatungo aga n'ag'oha?
en: And he commanded the foremost, saying, When Esau my brother meeteth thee, and asketh thee, saying, Whose art thou? and whither goest thou? and whose are these before thee?

rr: Omugire oti: N'ag'omwiru waawe Yakobo, mukama wangye Esau; n'ekiconco eki waatwekyerwa; kandi nawe atukuratiire.
en: Then thou shalt say, They be thy servant Jacob's; it is a present sent unto my lord Esau: and, behold, also he is behind us.

rr: Kandi yaaragiira atyo owa kabiri n'owa kashatu, n'abaabaire nibafunya amasyo boona, naabagira ati: Mube nikwo mwagira Esau, ku muraamubugane
en: And so commanded he the second, and the third, and all that followed the droves, saying, On this manner shall ye speak unto Esau, when ye find him.

rr: kandi mumugire muti: Reeba, n'omwiru waawe Yakobo atukuratiire.
en: And say ye moreover, Behold, thy servant Jacob is behind us.

rr: Ahakuba Yakobo akagira ati: Naaza kumucureeza n'ekiconco ekinyebembeire, bwanyima tureebane; shana akaanyikiriza.
en: For he said, I will appease him with the present that goeth before me, and afterward I will see his face; peradventure he will accept of me.

rr: Ekiconco nikwo kumwebembera, kikambuka; kwonka we akaraara aho ahu baagombekire ekyo kiro. Yakobo okufukaana na maraika
en: So went the present over before him: and himself lodged that night in the company.

rr: Ekyo kiro yaimuka, yaatwara abakazi be bombi n'abazaana be na'abaana be ikumi n'omwe, baayambukira aha nyambukiro ya Yaboki.
en: And he rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two womenservants, and his eleven sons, and passed over the ford Jabbok.

rr: Yaabambutsya ako kagyera n'ebi yaabaire aine byona.
en: And he took them, and sent them over the brook, and sent over that he had.

rr: Yakobo yaatsigarayo wenka; omushaija yaija, yaafukaana nawe bwarugaho bwatagurukana.
en: And Jacob was left alone; and there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day.

rr: Omushaija ogwo ku yaareebire yaamurema, yaamukora aha igufa ry'eitako eitako rya Yakobo ryateruka nibakifukaana.
en: And when he saw that he prevailed not against him, he touched the hollow of his thigh; and the hollow of Jacob's thigh was out of joint, as he wrestled with him.

rr: Omushaija yaamugira ati: Ndekura, ahakuba nibutaagurukana. Yakobo yaamugira ati: Tindikwija kkukurekura aotampaire mugisha.
en: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaketh. And he said, I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.

rr: Onu ati: Eiziina ryawe ori oha? Ati: Ndi Yakobo.
en: And he said unto him, What is thy name? And he said, Jacob.

rr: Onu ati: Okuruga hati torigaruka kwetwa Yakobo kureka Israeli; ahakuba ohakaine na Ruhanga n'abantu, waasinga.
en: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed.

rr: Bwanyima Yakobo yaamugira ati: Ninkweshengyereza, ngambira eiziina ryawe.
en: And Jacob asked him , and said, Tell me , I pray thee, thy name.

rr: Onu ati: Nooyendera ki kumanya eiziina ryangye?
en: And he said, Wherefore is it that thou dost ask after my name?

rr: Atyo yaamuheera aho omugisha.
en: And he blessed him there.

rr: Yakobo yaayeta ogwo mwanya Penueli, naagira ati: Nyereebaniire na Ruhanga amaisho n'amaisho, tinaafa.
en: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.

rr: Eizooba ryarasha naarengyera Penueli, naagyenda omunyugu aha bw'eigufa ry'eitako.
en: And as he passed over Penuel the sun rose upon him, and he halted upon his thigh.

rr: Abaisraeli nikyo bazirira enyama y'aha mutsi gw'eitako ry'ekibero n'okuhitsya hati; ahabw'okuba ogwo mushaija akakora aha mutsi gw'eitako ry'ekibero kya Yakobo.
en: Therefore the children of Israel eat not of the sinew which shrank, which is upon the hollow of the thigh, unto this day: because he touched the hollow of Jacob's thigh in the sinew that shrank.

rr: Yakobo yaimutsya amaisho, yaareeba Esau naija n'abashaija be magana ana; yaabaganisa abaana, yaaha Lea abe, na Rakeeli abe, n'abazaanakazi bombi abaabo.
en: And Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau came, and with him four hundred men. And he divided the children unto Leah, and unto Rachel, and unto the two handmaids.

rr: Yaayebembeza abazaanakazi n'abaana baabo, yaakuratsaho Lea n'abaana be, haahereeruka Rakeeli na Yosefu.
en: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost, and Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph hindermost.

rr: Yakobo yaabeebembera, yainama ahansi emirundi mushanju, okuhitsya obu yaahikire haihi na mukuru we.
en: And he passed over before them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.

rr: Esau yairuka kumubugana, yaamubumbatira, yaamugwa omu kifuba, yaamunywegyera; bombi baarira.
en: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him: and they wept.

rr: Esau ku yaimukize amaisho, yaareeba abakazi n'abaana, yaagira ati: Aba abu oine nibaahi?
en: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, Who are those with thee?

rr: Yakobo yaagarukamu ati: N'abaana abu Ruhanga yaahaire omwiru waawe ahabw'embabazi ze.
en: And he said, The children which God hath graciously given thy servant.

rr: Abazaanakazi n'abaana baabo bairira haihi, bainama.
en: Then the handmaidens came near, they and their children, and they bowed themselves.

rr: Lea nawe yaija n'abaana be, bainama; bwanyima Yosefu na Rakeeli nabo baija, bainama.
en: And Leah also with her children came near, and bowed themselves: and after came Joseph near and Rachel, and they bowed themselves.

rr: Esau yaabuuza ati: Ebintu byona ebi mbugaine bibaire biri ebya ki?
en: And he said, What meanest thou by all this drove which I met?

rr: Onu ati: N'ebi ntwekyeire mukama wangye, ngu angirire embabazi.
en: And he said, These are to find grace in the sight of my lord.

rr: Esau yaagira ati: Ebi nyine nibimmara, mwana wa maawe; ebyo ebi oine yegumire nabyo.
en: And Esau said, I have enough, my brother; keep that thou hast unto thyself.

rr: Yakobo yaamugira ati: Ngaaha! Naakweshengyereza, ku oraabe wangirira embabazi, ikiriza ekiconco eki nkureeteire; ahabw'okuba ku naareeba amaisho gaawe, naashusha nk'owaareeba amaisho ga Ruhanga, kandi wanshemerererwa.
en: And Jacob said, Nay, I pray thee, if now I have found grace in thy sight, then receive my present at my hand: for therefore I have seen thy face, as though I had seen the face of God, and thou wast pleased with me.

rr: Naakweshengyereza, yakiira ekiconco eki nkureeteire, ahakuba Ruhanga ankoreire eby'embabazi, kandi ebi nyine, nibimaara.
en: Take, I pray thee, my blessing that is brought to thee; because God hath dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough.

rr: Yaamweshengyereza munonga; yaakitwara.
en: And he urged him, and he took it .

rr: Bwanyima Esau yaagira ati: Ka tugumizemu tugyende, nyowe mbeebembere.
en: And he said, Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before thee.

rr: Yakobo yaamugarukamu ati: Mukama wangye, noomanya abaana ku bataine maani, kandi amasyo g'entaama n'ag'ente agu nyine nigontsya; ku baraagabindirane eizooba rimwe, goona nigafa.
en: And he said unto him, My lord knoweth that the children are tender, and the flocks and herds with young are with me: and if men should overdrive them one day, all the flock will die.

rr: Ninkweshengyereza, mukama wangye, orabe aha mwiru waawe, ogyende, nyowe niinyija kwija mpora, nk'oku amasyo agu nyine garikugyenda, kandi n'abaana oku barikugyenda, okuhitsya ahu ndaahikire Seiri owa mukama wangye.
en: Let my lord, I pray thee, pass over before his servant: and I will lead on softly, according as the cattle that goeth before me and the children be able to endure, until I come unto my lord unto Seir.

rr: Esau yaagira ati: Ka nkutsigire abashaija bamwe ahari aba abu nyine. Onu ati: Mbwenu n'ab'enki? Nsaasira, mukama wangye, obarekye.
en: And Esau said, Let me now leave with thee some of the folk that are with me. And he said, What needeth it? let me find grace in the sight of my lord.

rr: Atyo Esau yaagyenda eryo eizooba naagaruka Seiri.
en: So Esau returned that day on his way unto Seir.

rr: Kwonka Yakobo yaagyenda naaza Sukosi; ku yaahikireyo, yaayeyombekyera enju, kandi yaayombekyerayo amasyo ge ebiju. Omwanya ogwo nikyo gwayeteirwe Sukosi.
en: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built him an house, and made booths for his cattle: therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.

rr: Yakobo ku yaarugire Padanaramu, yaahika n'obusingye aha rurembo rwe Shekemu omu nsi ya Kanaani, yaasiisira omu maisho gaayo.
en: And Jacob came to Shalem, a city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Padan-aram; and pitched his tent before the city.

rr: Yaagura ekibanja ahari beene Hamori ishe wa Shekemu ebicweka by'efeeza igana, ahu yaateire eihema rye.
en: And he bought a parcel of a field, where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem's father, for an hundred pieces of money.

rr: Yaayombekayo eitambiro, yaaryeta Elelohe-Israeli.
en: And he erected there an altar, and called it El-elohe-Israel.
