rr: Omu biro ebyo Dina, muhara wa Lea, ou yaazaariire Yakobo, akaza kutaayaayira abaishiki b'omu nsi egyo.
en: And Dinah the daughter of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.

rr: Shekemu, mwene Hamori Omuhiivi omutegyeki w'ensi egyo, ku yaamureebire, yaamutwara, yaamuhamba, yaamushiisha.
en: And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the country, saw her, he took her, and lay with her, and defiled her.

rr: Ogwo mushaija yaamarira omutima gwe ahari Dina muhara wa Yakobo, yaamukunda, yaamugambira eby'okumugwisa gye.
en: And his soul clave unto Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the damsel, and spake kindly unto the damsel.

rr: Shekemu yaagambira Hamori ishe, ati: Nshwererera ogu mwishiki.
en: And Shechem spake unto his father Hamor, saying, Get me this damsel to wife.

rr: Yakobo yaahurira ku Shekemu asiisire Dina muhara we; obwo abatabani bakaba bariisize; Yakobo yaahunama, okuhitsya ahu baiziire.
en: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter: now his sons were with his cattle in the field: and Jacob held his peace until they were come.

rr: Hamori ishe wa Shekemu yaaruga omu rurembo, yaaza kuhanuura na Yakobo.
en: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out unto Jacob to commune with him.

rr: Beene Yakobo, ku baakihuriire, baaruga omu iriisizo, baataaha. Baashaasha, kandi baagira ekiniga kingi, ahabw'okuba akakora ekihagaro omu ba Israeli okubyama na muhara wa Yakobo, ekintu ekitashemereire kukorwa.
en: And the sons of Jacob came out of the field when they heard it: and the men were grieved, and they were very wroth, because he had wrought folly in Israel in lying with Jacob's daughter; which thing ought not to be done.

rr: Hamori yaahanuura nabo, ati: Omutima gwa mutabani wangye gukunzire muhara waanyu; naabeeshengyereza mumumuhe amushwere.
en: And Hamor communed with them, saying, The soul of my son Shechem longeth for your daughter: I pray you give her him to wife.

rr: Mushwererane naitwe, mutuhingire bahara baanyu, naimwe mushwere abaitu.
en: And make ye marriages with us, and give your daughters unto us, and take our daughters unto you.

rr: Haza mutuure naitwe; ensi ngigi ebari omumaisho, mugituuremu, mugikoreremu eby'obushuubuzi, kandi mugitungiremu.
en: And ye shall dwell with us: and the land shall be before you; dwell and trade ye therein, and get you possessions therein.

rr: Na Shekemu yaagambira ishe w'omwishiki na banyaanya ati: Mungirire embabazi; eki murancwe kyona, ninkibaha.
en: And Shechem said unto her father and unto her brethren, Let me find grace in your eyes, and what ye shall say unto me I will give.

rr: Enjugano n'ekiconco ebi murancwe, n'obu byakwingana ki, niinyija kubiha, nk'oku muraabincwe; beitu mumpingire ogu mwishiki.
en: Ask me never so much dowry and gift, and I will give according as ye shall say unto me: but give me the damsel to wife.

rr: Beene Yakobo baagarukamu Shekemu na Hamori ishe nibabaryarya, ahabw'okushiisha Dina munyaanyabo
en: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father deceitfully, and said, because he had defiled Dinah their sister:

rr: baabagira bati: Eki titurikubaasa kukikora, okuhingira munyaanyaitwe omuntu otashazirwe; ahakuba omuriitwe kikaaba ekihemu.
en: and they said unto them, We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised; for that were a reproach unto us:

rr: Hariho kimwe kyonka ekyakutureetera kubaikiriza, nikwo kwikiriza kuba nkaitwe, buri mushaija weena omuriimwe akasharwa
en: but in this will we consent unto you: If ye will be as we be , that every male of you be circumcised;

rr: obwo nibwo turibahingira bahara baitu, naitwe tukashwera bahara baanyu, tukatuura naimwe, tukaba eihabga rimwe.
en: then will we give our daughters unto you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.

rr: Ku muraabe mutatwikiriize mukasharwa, nitwija kutwara omwishiki waitu, twegyendere.
en: But if ye will not hearken unto us, to be circumcised; then will we take our daughter, and we will be gone.

rr: Ebigambo byabo byashemeza Hamori na Shekemu omutabani.
en: And their words pleased Hamor, and Shechem Hamor's son.

rr: Omutsigazi ogwo tiyaayeziringa, yaarahuka kukikora, ahabw'okukunda munonga omwishiki wa Yakobo; kandi akaba naasiimwa munonga okukira boona ab'omu ka ya ishe.
en: And the young man deferred not to do the thing, because he had delight in Jacob's daughter: and he was more honourable than all the house of his father.

rr: Hamori na Shekemu omutabani baaza aha irembo ry'orurembo rwabo, baahanuura n'abashaija b'omuri orwo rurembo, bati
en: And Hamor and Shechem his son came unto the gate of their city, and communed with the men of their city, saying,

rr: Abashaija abo twine nabo obusingye; n'ahabw'ekyo ka batuure omu nsi egi, bakoreremu eby'obushuubuzi; ahakuba ensi egi ni mpango, neebamara; tushwere bahara baabo, naitwe tubahingire abaitu.
en: These men are peaceable with us; therefore let them dwell in the land, and trade therein; for the land, behold, it is large enough for them; let us take their daughters to us for wives, and let us give them our daughters.

rr: Hariho kimwe kyonka ekyakureetera abashaija abo okutuura naitwe, tukaba eihanga rimwe, nikwo buri mushaija weena omuriitwe okusharwa, nkabo oku bashazirwe.
en: Only herein will the men consent unto us for to dwell with us, to be one people, if every male among us be circumcised, as they are circumcised.

rr: Nimugira ngu ente zaabo n'ebintu byabo n'amatungo gaabo goona tibirikwija kuba ebyaitu? Ka tufe okubaikiriza; nibwo baraatuure naitwe.
en: Shall not their cattle and their substance and every beast of their's be our's? only let us consent unto them, and they will dwell with us.

rr: Boona abaashohoire nibaraba omu irembo ry'orurembo rwe, baikiriza ebi Hamori na Shekemu omutabani baabagambira. Buri mushaija weena owaarabire omu irembo ry'orurembo rwe yaasharwa.
en: And unto Hamor and unto Shechem his son hearkened all that went out of the gate of his city; and every male was circumcised, all that went out of the gate of his city.

rr: Aha kiro kya kashatu, ku baabaire bakirwaire obuhuta, batabani ba Yakobo babiri, Simeoni na Leevi, banyaanya ba Dina, biru omwe yaihayo rurara ye, baateera orurembo kitamanyirwe, baita abashaija boona.
en: And it came to pass on the third day, when they were sore, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brethren, took each man his sword, and came upon the city boldly, and slew all the males.

rr: Baitsa Hamori na Shekemu omutabani rurara, baiha Dina omu nju ya Shekemu, baagyenda.
en: And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem's house, and went out.

rr: Beene Yakobo baija aha mitumbi, baagicwijura, baanyaga eby'omu rurembo, nibabatura okushiisha munyaanyabo.
en: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and spoiled the city, because they had defiled their sister.

rr: Baatwara n'amasyo gaabo ag'entaama n'ag'ente, n'endogoya zaabo, n'ebyabaire biri omu rurembo n'omu ishwa byona
en: They took their sheep, and their oxen, and their asses, and that which was in the city, and that which was in the field,

rr: baanyaga eitungo ryabo ryona, n'abaana baabo abato n'abakazi baabo, n'ebintu byona ebyabaire biri omu maju, byaba eminyago yaabo.
en: and all their wealth, and all their little ones, and their wives took they captive, and spoiled even all that was in the house.

rr: Bwanyima Yakobo yaagira Simeoni na Leevi ati: Mungwisiize akagwe, mwandeetera kwangirwa kimwe abantu abatwire omu nsi egi, Abanyakanaani n'Abaperizi; haza nimureeba ku turi bakye; ku baraayeteerane kundwanisa, niinyija kucwekyerezibwa n'eka yangye.
en: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, Ye have troubled me to make me to stink among the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites: and I being few in number, they shall gather themselves together against me, and slay me; and I shall be destroyed, I and my house.

rr: Baagira bati: Hoona tukaamurekire agira munyaanyaitwe nka maraaya?
en: And they said, Should he deal with our sister as with an harlot?

rr: Ruhanga yaagira Yakobo ati: Imuka, oinamukye Beseeli, otuureyo; kandi okwo oyombekyereyo Ruhanga eitambiro, owaakweyorekire noohunga mukuru waawe Esau.
en: And God said unto Jacob, Arise, go up to Beth-el, and dwell there: and make there an altar unto God, that appeared unto thee when thou fleddest from the face of Esau thy brother.

rr: Bwanyima Yakobo yaagambira ab'omu ka ye n'abandi boona abaabaire bari hamwe nawe, ati: Mwiheho baaruhanga b'abanyamahanga abari omuriimwe, mweyeze, mujware ebindi bijwaro
en: Then Jacob said unto his household, and to all that were with him, Put away the strange gods that are among you, and be clean, and change your garments:

rr: bwanyima mwimukye twinamukye Beseeli; niinyija kwombekyerayo Ruhanga eitambiro, owampuriire aha izooba ry'obusaasi bwangye, akaguma naanye omu muhanda ogu naarabiremu.
en: and let us arise, and go up to Beth-el; and I will make there an altar unto God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which I went.

rr: Nabo nikwo kuha Yakobo baaruhanga ba'banyamahanga abu baabaire baine, n'empeta ezi baabaire bajwaire aha matu gaabo; Yakobo akabishereka ahansi y'omwela ogwabaire guri haihi na Shekemu.
en: And they gave unto Jacob all the strange gods which were in their hand, and all their earrings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.

rr: Ku baabaire nibakigyenda, Ruhanga yaakwatsa obwoba ab'omu ndembo ezaabaire zibeehinguririize; n'ahabw'ekyo tibaakurata batabani ba Yakobo.
en: And they journeyed: and the terror of God was upon the cities that were round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob.

rr: Bwanyima Yakobo n'abu yaabaire aine boona baahika Luuzi, niyo Beseeli, ey'omu nsi ya Kanaani
en: So Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan, that is , Beth-el, he and all the people that were with him.

rr: yaayombekayo eitambiro, yaayeta ogwo mwanya Eli-Beseeli, ahabw'okuba niyo Ruhanga yaamweyorekyeire, obu yaahunga mukuru we.
en: And he built there an altar, and called the place El-beth-el: because there God appeared unto him, when he fled from the face of his brother.

rr: Kandi Debora, omurezi wa Rebeka, yaafa, yaaziikwa ifo ya Beseeli ahansi y'omwela; n'ahabw'ekyo baagweta 35:8 Aloni-bakuusi: amakuru ngu: Omwela gw'eiriro. Aloni-bakuusi.
en: But Deborah Rebekah's nurse died, and she was buried beneath Beth-el under an oak: and the name of it was called Allon-bachuth.

rr: Yakobo, ku yaarugire Padanaramu, Ruhanga yaagaruka yaamweyoreka, kandi yaamuha omugisha.
en: And God appeared unto Jacob again, when he came out of Padan-aram, and blessed him.

rr: Ruhanga yaamugira ati: Eiziina ryawe ori Yakobo; kwonka tokyetwa Yakobo obundi, kureka noija kwetwa Israeli. Ruhanga nikwo kumweta Israeli.
en: And God said unto him, Thy name is Jacob: thy name shall not be called any more Jacob, but Israel shall be thy name: and he called his name Israel.

rr: Ruhanga yaamugira ati: Ndi Ruhanga ow'obushoboorozi bwona; ozaare, okanye; eihanga n'omutwe gw'amahanga biryaruga omuriiwe, kandi n'abagabe baryakukomookamu.
en: And God said unto him, I am God Almighty: be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall be of thee, and kings shall come out of thy loins;

rr: Ndyakuha ensi ei naahaire Abrahamu na Isaaka, kandi bwanyima ngihe n'oruzaaro rwawe.
en: and the land which I gave Abraham and Isaac, to thee I will give it, and to thy seed after thee will I give the land.

rr: Ruhanga yaamutsiga omu mwanya ogu yaabaire naagaaniriramu nawe, yaatemba omu iguru.
en: And God went up from him in the place where he talked with him.

rr: Yakobo yaabyara enyomyo y'eibaare omu mwanya ogu yaagaaniriiremu nawe, yaagishukaho empongano y'eky'okunywa, kandi yaagishukaho n'amajuta.
en: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he talked with him, even a pillar of stone: and he poured a drink offering thereon, and he poured oil thereon.

rr: Yakobo yaayeta omwanya ogu Ruhanga yaagaaniriiremu nawe Beseeli. Okufa kwa Rakeeli na Isaaka
en: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spake with him, Beth-el.

rr: Bwanyima baaruga Beseeli; ku baabaire bakiri kaanya, batakahikire Efuraata, Rakeeli yaarumwa kuzaara, yaahangaanirwa.
en: And they journeyed from Beth-el; and there was but a little way to come to Ephrath: and Rachel travailed, and she had hard labour.

rr: Ku yaabaire akihangaaniirwe, omuzaarisa yaamugira ati: Otatiina; waaza kugaruka kuzaara omwojo.
en: And it came to pass, when she was in hard labour, that the midwife said unto her, Fear not; thou shalt have this son also.

rr: Ku yaabaire ari haihi kufa, omu kukaba kwe yaamweta 35:18 Benoni, amakuru ngu, Omwana w'obusaasi. Benoni; kwonka ishe yaamweta 35:18 Benyamiini, amakuru ngu, Omwana w'omukono gwa buryo Benyamiini.
en: And it came to pass, as her soul was in departing, (for she died) that she called his name Ben-oni: but his father called him Benjamin.

rr: Atyo Rakeeli yaafa, yaaziikwa aha muhanda ogurikuza Efuraata, niyo Betelehemu.
en: And Rachel died, and was buried in the way to Ephrath, which is Beth-lehem.

rr: Yakobo yaabyara enyomyo aha kituuro kye; niyo nyomyo y'aha kituuro kya Rakeeli; kandi ekiriho n'okuhitsya eri izooba.
en: And Jacob set a pillar upon her grave: that is the pillar of Rachel's grave unto this day.

rr: Israeli yaagumizamu, bwanyima yaateera eihema rye seeri y'omunaara gwa Ederi.
en: And Israel journeyed, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Edar.

rr: Israeli ku yaabaire akiri omuri ekyo kyanga, Reubeeni yaagyenda, yaabyama na Biliha muka ishe ow'ekinyanshunju; Israeli yaakimanya.
en: And it came to pass, when Israel dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father's concubine: and Israel heard it .

rr: Obwo batabani ba Yakobo bakaba baahikire ikumi na babiri.
en: Now the sons of Jacob were twelve:

rr: Batabani ba Lea, Reubeeni omujigaijo gwa Yakobo, Simeoni, Leevi, Yuda, Isakaari na Zebuluuni.
en: the sons of Leah; Reuben, Jacob's firstborn, and Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Zebulun:

rr: Batabani ba Rakeeli, Yosefu na Benyamiini.
en: the sons of Rachel; Joseph, and Benjamin:

rr: Batabani ba Biliha, omuzaana wa Rakeeli, Daani na Nafutaali.
en: and the sons of Bilhah, Rachel's handmaid; Dan, and Naphtali:

rr: Batabani ba Zilupa omuzaana wa Lea, Gaadi na Asheri. Abo nibo batabani ba Yakobo abaazaariirwe Padanaramu.
en: and the sons of Zilpah, Leah's handmaid; Gad, and Asher: these are the sons of Jacob, which were born to him in Padan-aram.

rr: Bwanyima Yakobo yaashanga ishe Mamure, nari Kiryasiaraba, niyo Heburooni, ei Abrahamu na Isaaka baabaire bashuhuukiire.
en: And Jacob came unto Isaac his father unto Mamre, unto the city of Arbah, which is Hebron, where Abraham and Isaac sojourned.

rr: Emyaka ya Isaaka ekahika igana na makumi munaana.
en: And the days of Isaac were an hundred and fourscore years.

rr: Atyo omwitsyo gwamuhwamu, yaafa, yaakurata abaabo, ari omugurusi ahwitsire; abatabani Esau na Yakobo baamuziika.
en: And Isaac gave up the ghost, and died, and was gathered unto his people, being old and full of days: and his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.

rr: Currently Selected: Okutandika 35 : RR64 Highlight Share <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8 19c-2.828 0-4.243 0-5.121-.879C2 17.243 2 15.82
Oru nirwo ruzaaro rwa Esau, niwe Edomu.
en: Now these are the generations of Esau, who is Edom.

rr: Esau akashwera abakazi omu baishiki ba Kanaani; Ada muhara wa Eloni Omuhiiti, Oholibama muhara wa Aana, kandi mwijukuru wa Zibeoni Omuhiivi
en: Esau took his wives of the daughters of Canaan; Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite;

rr: na Basemaasi muhara wa Ishimaeli, munyaanya wa Nebayoosi.
en: and Bashemath Ishmael's daughter, sister of Nebajoth.

rr: Ada yaazaarira Esau Elifaazi; Basemaasi yaazaara Reueli
en: And Adah bare to Esau Eliphaz; and Bashemath bare Reuel;

rr: na Oholibama yaazaara Yeushi, Yalamu na Koora. Abo nibo batabani ba Esau abaazaariirwe omu nsi ya Kanaani.
en: and Aholibamah bare Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah: these are the sons of Esau, which were born unto him in the land of Canaan.

rr: Esau yaatwara abakazi be, batabani be, bahara be, n'ab'omu ka ye boona n'ente ze n'amatungo ge goona kandi n'ebintu bye byona, ebi yaihire omu nsi ya Kanaani; yaaza omu nsi ya hare, ngu ataane n'omurumuna Yakobo
en: And Esau took his wives, and his sons, and his daughters, and all the persons of his house, and his cattle, and all his beasts, and all his substance, which he had got in the land of Canaan; and went into the country from the face of his brother Jacob.

rr: ahabw'okuba eitungo ryabo rikaba riri ringi, tibaabaasa kutuurana; ensi ei baabaire baashuhuukiiremu, terabaasize kubamara ahabw'amatungo gaabo.
en: For their riches were more than that they might dwell together; and the land wherein they were strangers could not bear them because of their cattle.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo Esau yaatuura omu nsi y'ebibungo eya Seiri; Esau ogwo niwe Edomu.
en: Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.

rr: Aba nibo baijukuru ba Esau, ishenkuru w'Abanyaedomu abaabaire batwire omu nsi y'ebibungo eya Seiri.
en: And these are the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in mount Seir:

rr: Aga nigo maziina ga batabani ba Esau: Elifaazi mutabani wa Ada muka Esau, Reueli mutabani wa Basemaasi muka Esau.
en: these are the names of Esau's sons; Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau, Reuel the son of Bashemath the wife of Esau.

rr: Na batabani ba Elifaazi bakaba bari Temani, Omari, Zeefo, Gatamu na Kenazi.
en: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.

rr: Kandi Timuna akaba ari omukaza wa Elifaazi mwene Esau ow'ekinyanshunju; yaazaarira Elifaazi Amaleki. Abo nibo baijukuru ba Ada muka Esau.
en: And Timna was concubine to Eliphaz Esau's son; and she bare to Eliphaz Amalek: these were the sons of Adah Esau's wife.

rr: Aba nibo baijukuru ba Basemaasi muka Esau.
en: And these are the sons of Reuel; Nahath, and Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah: these were the sons of Bashemath Esau's wife.

rr: Aba nibo batabani ba Oholibama muka Esau, muhara wa Aana mwijukuru wa Zibeoni; yaazaarira Esau Yeushi, Yalamu na Koora.
en: And these were the sons of Aholibamah, the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon, Esau's wife: and she bare to Esau Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.

rr: Aba nibo bakuru b'enganda beene Esau; batabani ba Elifaazi omujigaijo gwa Esau, omutware Temani, omutware Omari, omutware Zeefo, omutware Kenazi
en: These were dukes of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn son of Esau; duke Teman, duke Omar, duke Zepho, duke Kenaz,

rr: omutware Koora, omutware Gatamu n'omutware Amaleki; abo nibo bakuru b'enganda abaazairwe Elifaazi omu nsi ya Edomu, kandi nibo baijukuru ba Ada.
en: duke Korah, duke Gatam, and duke Amalek: these are the dukes that came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these were the sons of Adah.

rr: Aba nibo batabani ba Reueli mwene Esau: omutware Nahasi, omutware Zeera, omutware Shama n'omutware Miiza; abo nibo batware abaazairwe Reueli omu nsi ya Edomu, kandi nibo baijukuru ba Basemaasi muka Esau.
en: And these are the sons of Reuel Esau's son; duke Nahath, duke Zerah, duke Shammah, duke Mizzah: these are the dukes that came of Reuel in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Bashemath Esau's wife.

rr: Aba nibo batabani ba Oholibama muka Esau: omutware Yeushi, omutware Yalamu, n'omutware Koora; abo nibo batware abaazairwe Oholibama muka Esau, kandi muhara wa Aana.
en: And these are the sons of Aholibamah Esau's wife; duke Jeush, duke Jaalam, duke Korah: these were the dukes that came of Aholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau's wife.

rr: Abo nibo batabani ba Esau, niwe Edomu; kandi abo nibo batware baabo.
en: These are the sons of Esau, who is Edom, and these are their dukes.

rr: Aba nibo batabani ba Seiri Omuhoori, abaashangirwe batwire omuri egyo nsi: Lotani, Shobali, Zibeoni, Aaba
en: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, who inhabited the land; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah,

rr: Dishoni, Ezeeri na Dishani; abo nibo baami b'Abahoori beene Seiri ab'omu nsi ya Edomu.
en: and Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan: these are the dukes of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.

rr: Na batabani ba Lotani bakaba bari Hoori na Hemani; kandi Timuna akaba ari munyaanya wa Lotani.
en: And the children of Lotan were Hori and Hemam; and Lotan's sister was Timna.

rr: Aba nibo batabani ba Shobali: Alivani, Manahaasi Ebali, Sheefo na Onamu.
en: And the children of Shobal were these; Alvan, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.

rr: Aba nibo batabani ba Zibeoni: Aaya na Aana; Aana ogwo niwe yaazoire ekitagata omu ihamba, obu yaabaire ariisize endogoya za Zibeoni ishe.
en: And these are the children of Zibeon; both Ajah, and Anah: this was that Anah that found the mules in the wilderness, as he fed the asses of Zibeon his father.

rr: Aba nibo baana ba Aana: Dishoni na Oholibama muhara wa Aana.
en: And the children of Anah were these; Dishon, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah.

rr: Aba nibo batabani ba Dishoni: Hemidaani, Eshibaani, Isuraani, na Kerani.
en: And these are the children of Dishon; Hemdan, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.

rr: Aba nibo batabani ba Ezeeri: Biluhaani, Zaavani na Akani.
en: The children of Ezer are these; Bilhan, and Zaavan, and Akan.

rr: Aba nibo batabani ba Dishani: Uuzi na Arani.
en: The children of Dishan are these; Uz, and Aran.

rr: Aba nibo batware b'Abahoori; omutware Lotani, omutware Shobali, omutware Zibeoni, omutware Aana
en: These are the dukes that came of the Horites; duke Lotan, duke Shobal, duke Zibeon, duke Anah,

rr: omutware Dishoni, omutware Ezeri n'omutware Dishani; abo nibo batware b'Abahoori omu nsi ya Seiri, nk'emiryango yaabo oku yaabaire eri.
en: duke Dishon, duke Ezer, duke Dishan: these are the dukes that came of Hori, among their dukes in the land of Seir.

rr: Aba nibo bagabe abaategyekire omu nsi ya Edomu, Abaisraeli obu baabaire batakategyekirwe mugabe weena.
en: And these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there reigned any king over the children of Israel.

rr: Beela mwene Beori akategyeka Edomu, kandi eiziina ry'orurembo rwe rikaba riri Dinihaba.
en: And Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

rr: Beela yaafa, Yobabu mwene Zeera owa Bozira yaayema omu mwanya gwe.
en: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.

rr: Yobabu yaafa, Hushamu ow'omu nsi y'Abatemani yaayema omu mwanya gwe.
en: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of Temani reigned in his stead.

rr: Hushamu yaafa, Hadadi mwene Bedadi, owaabingire Abamidiani omu nsi ya Moabu, yaayema omu mwanya gwe; eiziina ry'orurembo rwe rikaba riri Aviisi.
en: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.

rr: Hadadi yaafa, Samula owa Masireka yaayema omu mwanya gwe.
en: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.

rr: Samula yaafa, Shauli owa Rehoboosi aha mugyera Furaati yaayema omu mwanya gwe.
en: And Samlah died, and Saul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.

rr: Shauli yaafa, Baali-hanani mwene Akiboori yaayema omu mwanya gwe.
en: And Saul died, and Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.

rr: Baali-hanani mwene Akiboori yaafa, Hadari yaayema omu mwanya gwe, n'eiziina ry'orurembo rwe rikaba riri Pau, kandi omukazi we akaba naayetwa Mehetabeeli, muhara wa Matireedi, kandi mwijukuru wa Mezahaabu.
en: And Baal-hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pau; and his wife's name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

rr: Aga nigo maziina g'abatware abaakomookire ahari Esau, n'emiryango yaabo n'emyanya yaabo n'amaziina gaabo; omutware Timuna, omutware aliva, omutware Yeseti
en: And these are the names of the dukes that came of Esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names; duke Timnah, duke Alvah, duke Jetheth,

rr: omutware Oholibama, omutware Eela, omutware Pinoni
en: duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,

rr: omutware Kenazi, omutware Temani, omutware Mibuzaari
en: duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,

rr: omutware Magudieli n'omutware Iraamu; abo nibo batware ba Edomu, niwe Esau ishenkuru w'Abanyaedomu, nk'emyanya yaabo ey'omu nsi ei baakubwire, oku yaabaire eri.
en: duke Magdiel, duke Iram: these be the dukes of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession: he is Esau the father of the Edomites.

rr: Yakobo akatuura omu nsi ya Kanaani, ei ishe yaashuhuukiiremu.
en: And Jacob dwelt in the land wherein his father was a stranger, in the land of Canaan.

rr: 1 Ebi nibyo byabaire aha ruzaaro rwa Yakobo.
en: These are the generations of Jacob.

rr: Yosefu akaba naariisa amasyo hamwe na bakuru be, aine emyaka ikumi na mushanju; omu kukura kwe akanyeeta na batabani ba Biliha n'aba Zilupa baka ishe; kandi Yosefu akaba agambira ishe ebibi ebi baabaire bakora.
en: Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brethren; and the lad was with the sons of Bilhah, and with the sons of Zilpah, his father's wives: and Joseph brought unto his father their evil report.

rr: Kandi Israeli akaba akunda Yosefu okukira abandi baana be boona, ahakuba akaba ari omwana ou yaazaire yaabaire omugurusi; n'ahabw'ekyo akamubaziiriza ekanzu ndaingwa y'amabara.
en: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of many colours.

rr: Bakuru be ku baareebire ishe naamukunda okubakira boona, baamwanga, tibaabaasa kugamba gye nawe.
en: And when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren, they hated him, and could not speak peaceably unto him.

rr: Yosefu yaaroota ekirooto; ku yaakigambiire bakuru be, baayeyongyera kumwanga.
en: And Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it his brethren: and they hated him yet the more.

rr: Yaabagira ati: Nimbeeshengyereza muhurire ekirooto eki ndootsire
en: And he said unto them, Hear, I pray you, this dream which I have dreamed:

rr: tubaire nituboha ebiba omu misiri; ekiba kyangye kyaimuka, kyayemerera; ebyanyu biba nabyo byayemerera byayehinguririza ekyangye, byakiinamira.
en: for, behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and, lo, my sheaf arose, and also stood upright; and, behold, your sheaves stood round about, and made obeisance to my sheaf.

rr: Bakuru be baamubuuza bati: Noogira ngu oryaba omugabe waitu? Buzima oryatutegyeka? Baayeyongyera kumwanga ahabw'ebirooto bye n'ebigambo bye.
en: And his brethren said to him, Shalt thou indeed reign over us? or shalt thou indeed have dominion over us? And they hated him yet the more for his dreams, and for his words.

rr: Yaagaruka yaaroota ekindi kirooto, yaakigambira bakuru be, naagira ati: Ngarukire naarota ekindi kirooto; eizooba n'okwezi n'enyonyoozi ikumi n'emwe nibiinyinamira.
en: And he dreamed yet another dream, and told it his brethren, and said, Behold, I have dreamed a dream more; and, behold, the sun and the moon and the eleven stars made obeisance to me.

rr: Omukuru w'abarinzi yaabakwatsa Yosefu kuguma naabaheereza; baamara ebiro bari omu kihome.

en: And they dreamed a dream both of them, each man his dream in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the butler and the baker of the king of Egypt, which were bound in the prison.

rr: Yosefu ku yaizire kubareeba omu kasheeshe, yaashanga bagwirwe kubi
en: And Joseph came in unto them in the morning, and looked upon them, and, behold, they were sad.

rr: yaabuuza abo bakuru ba Faraho abaabaire bakomeirwe omu nju ya mukama we hamwe nawe, ati: Ahabw'enki eri izooba mwaimuka mugwirwe kubi?
en: And he asked Pharaoh's officers that were with him in the ward of his lord's house, saying, Wherefore look ye so sadly to day?

rr: Baamugarukamu bati: Turootsire ebirooto, twabura ow'okubitushobororera. Yosefu yaabagira ati: Okushoboorora shi t'okwa Ruhanga? Nimbashaba mubindootororere.
en: And they said unto him, We have dreamed a dream, and there is no interpreter of it. And Joseph said unto them, Do not interpretations belong to God? tell me them , I pray you.

rr: Omugabuzi wa viinyo omukuru yaarootororera Yosefu ekirooto kye, naagira ati: Ndootsire omuzaabibu guri omu maisho gangye
en: And the chief butler told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, In my dream, behold, a vine was before me;

rr: ogwo muzaabibu gubaire gwine amataagi ashatu; ku guginire, gwarabya, gwaragaza ebijuma byagwo byahiisa.
en: and in the vine were three branches: and it was as though it budded, and her blossoms shot forth; and the clusters thereof brought forth ripe grapes:

rr: Obwo ekikopo kya Faraho kindi omu ngaro; naacwa ebyo bijuma, naabikamuurira omu kikopo kya Faraho, naakimukwatsa omu ngaro.
en: and Pharaoh's cup was in my hand: and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh's cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand.

rr: Yosefu yaamugira ati: Aga nigo makuru gaakyo: ago mataagi ashatu nibyo biro bishatu
en: And Joseph said unto him, This is the interpretation of it: The three branches are three days:

rr: omuri ebyo biro bishatu Faraho naija kwimutsya omutwe gwawe akugarure omu bugabuzi bwawe, oheereze Faraho ekikopo kye, nk'oku waabaire omuheereza okiri omugabuzi we wa viinyo.
en: yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thine head, and restore thee unto thy place: and thou shalt deliver Pharaoh's cup into his hand, after the former manner when thou wast his butler.

en: But think on me when it shall be well with thee, and shew kindness, I pray thee, unto me, and make mention of me unto Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house:

rr: Omanye ku naihirwe omu nsi y'Abaheburaayo; kandi na kunu tinkakorayoga ekyakuntaisize omu kihome.
en: for indeed I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews: and here also have I done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.

rr: Omuteeki w'emigaati omukuru ku yaareebire ebi yaamushobororera byaba birungi, yaagambira Yosefu ati: Naanye ndootsire nyekoreire ebitemere bishatu by'emigaati.
en: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said unto Joseph, I also was in my dream, and, behold, I had three white baskets on my head:

rr: Aha kitemere eky'aha mutwe gw'ebindi hariho emigaati y'emiringo yoona ningitwarira Faraho; enyonyi zaija, zaagindiira aha mutwe ahari ekyo kitemere.
en: and in the uppermost basket there was of all manner of bakemeats for Pharaoh; and the birds did eat them out of the basket upon my head.

rr: Yosefu yaamugarukamu ati: Aga nigo makuru gaakyo; ebitemere ebyo ebishatu nibyo biro bishatu
en: And Joseph answered and said, This is the interpretation thereof: The three baskets are three days:

rr: omuri ebyo biro bishatu Faraho naija kwimutsya omutwe gwawe, agucweho, akuhanikye aha muti, amahungu gakushokoorereho.
en: yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thy head from off thee, and shall hang thee on a tree; and the birds shall eat thy flesh from off thee.

rr: Aha kiro kya kashatu, aha izooba ry'okwijuka okuzaarwa kwa Faraho, yaateekyera abairu be boona obugyenyi; yaimutsya omutwe gw'omugabuzi wa viinyo omukuru n'ogw'omuteeki w'emigaati omukuru ahagati y'abairu be
en: And it came to pass the third day, which was Pharaoh's birthday, that he made a feast unto all his servants: and he lifted up the head of the chief butler and of the chief baker among his servants.

rr: yaagarura omukuru w'abagabuzi ba viinyo omu bugabuzi bwe, yaaguma naabonetsya Faraho omu kikopo kye.
en: And he restored the chief butler unto his butlership again; and he gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand:

rr: Kwonka omuteeki w'emigaati omukuru yaamuhanika, nk'oku Yosefu yaashoboroire amakuru g'ebirooto byabo.
en: but he hanged the chief baker: as Joseph had interpreted to them.

rr: Kwonka omugabuzi wa viinyo omukuru tiyaijuka Yosefu, yaamwebwa.
en: Yet did not the chief butler remember Joseph, but forgat him.

en: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon: and he shaved himself , and changed his raiment, and came in unto Pharaoh.

en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I have dreamed a dream, and there is none that can interpret it: and I have heard say of thee, that thou canst understand a dream to interpret it.

en: And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, It is not in me: God shall give Pharaoh an answer of peace.

en: and the lean and the ill favoured kine did eat up the first seven fat kine:

rr: Ku ziherize kuzirya, waashusha oti tizaazirya; zaaguma ziri mbi nk'okubanza.
en: and when they had eaten them up, it could not be known that they had eaten them; but they were still ill favoured, as at the beginning.

en: and, behold, seven ears, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them:

en: and the thin ears devoured the seven good ears: and I told this unto the magicians; but there was none that could declare it to me.

en: And Joseph said unto Pharaoh, The dream of Pharaoh is one: God hath shewed Pharaoh what he is about to do.

rr: Ente mushanju enungi niyo myaka mushanju; n'ebishiisha mushanju ebirungi nayo n'emyaka mushanju; ekirooto ni kimwe.
en: The seven good kine are seven years; and the seven good ears are seven years: the dream is one.

en: And the seven thin and ill favoured kine that came up after them are seven years; and the seven empty ears blasted with the east wind shall be seven years of famine.

rr: Ekyo nikyo naagambira Faraho nti: Ruhanga akworekire, iwe Faraho, eki arikwenda kukora.
en: This is the thing which I have spoken unto Pharaoh: What God is about to do he sheweth unto Pharaoh.

rr: Reeba nihaija kubaho emyaka mushanju ey'omweru mwingi omu nsi yoona eya Misri
en: Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt:

en: and there shall arise after them seven years of famine; and all the plenty shall be forgotten in the land of Egypt; and the famine shall consume the land;

rr: Omweru guryaba gutakiijukwa mu nsi ahabw'enjara erikurataho, ahabw'okuba eryaba nyingi munonga.
en: and the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine following; for it shall be very grievous.

en: And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice; it is because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.

rr: Mbwenu nu Faraho asherure omuntu orikwetegyereza kandi omunyabwengye, amuhe obushoboorozi bw'okutegyeka ensi ya Misri.
en: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.

en: Let Pharaoh do this , and let him appoint officers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years.

rr: bateeranire hamwe ebirikuhunikwa byona eby'omu myaka egyo emirungi eyaaza kwija, babihunikye omu ndembo, babirinde biri omu bushoboorozi bwa Faraho.

en: And that food shall be for store to the land against the seven years of famine, which shall be in the land of Egypt; that the land perish not through the famine.

rr: Ekyo kigambo kyasiimwa Faraho n'abaheereza be boona.
en: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.

rr: Farao yaabuuza abaheereza be ati: Ebyo tukaabaasa kubona omuntu orikushusha nk'ogu, oine Omwoyo wa Ruhanga?
en: And Pharaoh said unto his servants, Can we find such a one as this is , a man in whom the Spirit of God is ?

rr: Faraho yaagambira Yosefu ati: Nk'oku Ruhanga akworekire ebyo byona, tihariho ondiijo orikwetegyereza kandi omunyabwengye nkaiwe.
en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Forasmuch as God hath shewed thee all this, there is none so discreet and wise as thou art:

rr: Naakuha okutegyeka eka yangye, kandi abantu bangye boona baryatwaza nk'oku oribaragiira; kureka eki ndikweshumbya n'ekitebe ky'obugabe kyonka.
en: thou shalt be over my house, and according unto thy word shall all my people be ruled: only in the throne will I be greater than thou.

rr: Faraho yaagaruka yaamugira ati: Reeba, naakuha obushoboorozi bw'okutegyeka ensi yoona eya Misri.
en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, See, I have set thee over all the land of Egypt.

rr: Faraho yaajuura empeta ye eriho akamanyiso omu rukumu rwe, yaagijweka Yosefu omu rukumu; yaamujweka n'ebijwaro birungi bya kitaani, kandi n'omukuufu gw'ezaabu omu bitsya
en: And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand, and put it upon Joseph's hand, and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck;

rr: yaamugyendeseza omu kigaari ekya kabiri aha kye, baateera akaari omu maisho ge, nibagira bati: Mumutsimbire amaju. Yaamuha obushoboorozi kutegyeka ensi yoona eya Misri.
en: and he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had; and they cried before him, Bow the knee: and he made him ruler over all the land of Egypt.

rr: Faraho yaagambira Yosefu ati: Nk'oku ndi Faraho, tihariho muntu weena oriimutsya omukono n'obu kyakuba ekigyere omu nsi yoona eya Misri, otamwikiriize.
en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I am Pharaoh, and without thee shall no man lift up his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt.

rr: Faraho yaakubya Yosefu Zafunasi-panea; yaamuha Asenasi, muhara wa Potifeera omunyamurwa wa Oni kumushwera.
en: And Pharaoh called Joseph's name Zaphnath-paaneah; and he gave him to wife Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On.

rr: Okuruga aho Yosefu yaarambura ensi ya Misri.
en: And Joseph went out over all the land of Egypt.

rr: Yosefu akaba ahikize emyaka makumi ashatu, obu yaayemerera omu maisho ga Faraho omugabe wa Misri.
en: And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt.

rr: Yosefu yaaruga omu maisho ga Faraho, yaaza kurambura ensi yoona eya Misri.
en: And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.

rr: Omu myaka egyo mushanju ey'omweru ensi tiyaayeza, yaacwa ebintu.
en: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls.

rr: Yosefu yaateeranira hamwe eby'okurya ebirikuhunikwa byona ebi baasharwire omu myaka mushanju eyaabaireho omu nsi ya Misri, yaabihunikisa omu ndembo; eby'okurya by'omu misiri eyaabaire eba eyehinguririize buri rurembo, nimwo yaabaire abihunika.
en: And he gathered up all the food of the seven years, which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities: the food of the field, which was round about every city, laid he up in the same.

rr: Yosefu yaahunika eby'okurya bingi munonga ebirikwingana n'omusheenyi ogw'aha nyanja, okuhitsya obu yaarekire kubara; ahakuba bikaba bitakibaasa kubarwa.
en: And Joseph gathered corn as the sand of the sea, very much, until he left numbering; for it was without number.

rr: Enjara etakateire, Yosefu akazaara abaana b'aboojo babiri, abu Asenasi muhara wa Potifeera omunyamurwa wa Oni yaamuzaariire.
en: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came, which Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On bare unto him.

rr: O'womujigaijo yaamweta Manaase, naagira ati: Ahakuba Ruhanga akanyebesa okufa kubi kwangye kwona n'eka ya taata yoona.
en: And Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh: For God, said he , hath made me forget all my toil, and all my father's house.

rr: Owa kabiri yaamweta Efuraimu, naagira ati: Ahakuba Ruhanga ampeereire oruzaaro omu nsi ei naareebeiremu enaku.
en: And the name of the second called he Ephraim: For God hath caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction.

rr: Egyo myaka mushanju ey'omweru eyaabaireho omu nsi ya Misri yaahwa.
en: And the seven years of plenteousness, that was in the land of Egypt, were ended.

rr: Emyaka mushanju ey'enjara yaatandika, nk'oku Yosefu yaagambire; enjara yaabuga ensi zoona, kwonka omu nsi ya Misri yoona hakaba harimu eby'okurya.
en: And the seven years of dearth began to come, according as Joseph had said: and the dearth was in all lands; but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.

rr: Ensi yoona eya Misri ku yaateirwe enjara, baayetuurira Faraho ngu abahe eby'okurya. Faraho yaagambira Abanyamisri boona ati: Muze owa Yosefu; eki araabagambire kyona, mukikore.
en: And when all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread: and Pharaoh said unto all the Egyptians, Go unto Joseph; what he saith to you, do.

rr: Enjara yaabuga ensi yoona. Yosefu yaigura ebitara byona, yaashakisa Abanyamisri; enjara yaaba nyingi omu nsi ya Misri.
en: And the famine was over all the face of the earth: And Joseph opened all the storehouses, and sold unto the Egyptians; and the famine waxed sore in the land of Egypt.

rr: Ab'omu nsi zoona baija ahari Yosefu omuri Misri kushaka eby'okurya, ahakuba enjara ekaba eri nyingi omu nsi yoona.
en: And all countries came into Egypt to Joseph for to buy corn ; because that the famine was so sore in all lands.

en: And Judah said, What shall we say unto my lord? what shall we speak? or how shall we clear ourselves? God hath found out the iniquity of thy servants: behold, we are my lord's servants, both we, and he also with whom the cup is found.

rr: Kwonka Yosefu yaagira ati: Nikikabure nyowe okukora ntyo; kureka omushaija ou baashanga aine ekikopo, niwe araabe omuhuuku wangye; haza imwe mwegyendere n'obusingye, mugarukye owa shoimwe.
en: And he said, God forbid that I should do so: but the man in whose hand the cup is found, he shall be my servant; and as for you, get you up in peace unto your father.

rr: Yuda nikwo kumwirira haihi, akamugira ati: Mukama wangye, ninkweshengyereza reka omwiru waawe agire eki yaakugambira; kandi otagirira omwiru waawe ekiniga, Mukama wangye; ahakuba ori nka Faraho buzima.
en: Then Judah came near unto him, and said, Oh my lord, let thy servant, I pray thee, speak a word in my lord's ears, and let not thine anger burn against thy servant: for thou art even as Pharaoh.

rr: Mukama wangye akabuuza abairu be, naagira ati: Mwine shoimwe, nari murumuna waanyu ondiijo?
en: My lord asked his servants, saying, Have ye a father, or a brother?

rr: Twagarukamu mukama wangye tuti: Twine tataitwe, n'omugurusi, kandi na murumuna waitu ou yaazaire yaakuzire; mukuru we akafa, niwe atsigaireho omu nda ya nyina, kandi ishe naamukunda.
en: And we said unto my lord, We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother, and his father loveth him.

rr: Naiwe waagambira abairu baawe, oti: Mumundeetere, mmureebe
en: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Bring him down unto me, that I may set mine eyes upon him.

rr: naitwe twagambira mukama wangye tuti: Omwana ogwo tarikubaasa kutsigaho ishe; ahakuba ku yaakumutsigaho, ishe akaafa.
en: And we said unto my lord, The lad cannot leave his father: for if he should leave his father, his father would die.

rr: Waagarukamu abairu baawe oti: Murumuna waanyu omuto ku ariba ataizire naimwe, timuringaruka mumaisho.
en: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Except your youngest brother come down with you, ye shall see my face no more.

rr: Ku twagarukire aha mwiru waawe tataitwe, twamugambira ebigambo bya mukama wangye.
en: And it came to pass when we came up unto thy servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.

rr: Bwanyima tataitwe yaagira ati: Mugarukyeyo, mutugurire ak'okurya.
en: And our father said, Go again, and buy us a little food.

rr: Naitwe twagira tuti: Titurikubaasa kuzayo; murumuna waitu omuto ku araagyende naitwe, obwo naitwe nitwija kuzayo; ahakuba tituribaasa kugaruka ogwo mushaija mumaisho, kureka murumuna waitu omuto yaagyenda naitwe.
en: And we said, We cannot go down: if our youngest brother be with us, then will we go down: for we may not see the man's face, except our youngest brother be with us.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo omwiru waawe taata aktugira ati: Nimumanya ku omukazi wangye yanzaariire aboojo babiri
en: And thy servant my father said unto us, Ye know that my wife bare me two sons:

rr: omwe akandugaho, naateekateeka nti: Buzima akataagataagurwa; kandi n'okuhitsya hati tinkamureebaga.
en: and the one went out from me, and I said, Surely he is torn in pieces; and I saw him not since:

rr: Mbwenu ku muraanyiheho n'ogu, haagira ekyamubaho, nimwija kundeetera obujune bumpuhure, nshuume okuzimu nk'oku murikundeeba n'ezi nju.
en: and if ye take this also from me, and mischief befall him, ye shall bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo ku ndigaruka aha mwiru waawe taata, omwojo tutamwine, yaareeba tutaija nawe, aryafa
en: Now therefore when I come to thy servant my father, and the lad be not with us; seeing that his life is bound up in the lad's life;

rr: ahabw'okuba amagara ge gakwaitswe ag'ogu mwana; kandi itwe abairu baawe turyaba tureeteire omwiru waawe tataitwe obujune bw'okumuhuhura, ogwo mugurusi ashuume okuzimu n'ezo nju.
en: it shall come to pass, when he seeth that the lad is not with us , that he will die: and thy servants shall bring down the gray hairs of thy servant our father with sorrow to the grave.

rr: Omanye ngu nyowe omwiru waawe niinye naayemerereire ogu mwana ahari taata, ningira nti: Ku ndiba ntamukugaruriire, ndyagiibwaho orubanja orutarindugaho.
en: For thy servant became surety for the lad unto my father, saying, If I bring him not unto thee, then I shall bear the blame to my father for ever.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo ninkweshengyereza, Mukama wangye, mbe niinye naaguma aha, mbe omuhuuku waawe, haza omwana ogu we ataahe na bakuru be.
en: Now therefore, I pray thee, let thy servant abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord; and let the lad go up with his brethren.

rr: Mbwenu nimbaasa nta kugaruka ahari taata, ntaine ogu mwojo? Nintiina kureeba akabi akarihika ahari taata. Currently Selected: Okutandika 44 : RR64 Highlight Share <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8 19c-2.828 0-4.243 0-5.121-.879C2 17.243 2 15.828 2 13v
en: For how shall I go up to my father, and the lad be not with me? lest peradventure I see the evil that shall come on my father. Currently Selected: Genesis 44 : KJV Highlight Share <path d="M5 12a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h3a1 1 0 1 1 0 2H6a1 1 0 0 1-1-1ZM5 15a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h3a1 1 0 1 1 0 2H6a1 1 0 0 1-1-1ZM5 9a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h3a1 1 0 0 1 0 2H6a1 1 0 0 1-1-1ZM15 11a1 1 0 1 0 0 2h3a1 1 0 1 0 0-2h-3ZM15 14a1 1 0 1 0 0 2h

rr: Yosefu yaaremwa kwegumya omu maisho ga boona abaabaire bamwemereire haihi, yaagira ati: Ragiira abantu boona bashohore bampigize.
en: Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried, Cause every man to go out from me.

rr: Tihaagira muntu weena owaatsigara na Yosefu, omu kwegambira beene ishe.
en: And there stood no man with him, while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren.

rr: Yaarira naaborooga munonga; Abanyamisri n'ab'omu nju ya Faraho baamuhurira.
en: And he wept aloud: and the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard.

rr: Yosefu yaagambira beene ishe, ati: Niinye Yosefu. Taata akibaho? Beene ishe baabura eki baamugarukamu, ahakuba bakashobererwa omu maisho ge.
en: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I am Joseph; doth my father yet live? And his brethren could not answer him; for they were troubled at his presence.

rr: Yosefu yaagira beene ishe ati: Nimbeeshengyereza muunyirire haihi.
en: And Joseph said unto his brethren, Come near to me, I pray you.

rr: Baamwirira haihi.
en: And they came near.

rr: Yaagira ati: Niinye Yosefu murumuna waanyu, ou mwagurize kutwarwa Misri.
en: And he said, I am Joseph your brother, whom ye sold into Egypt.

rr: Mbwenu mutashaasha, n'obu kwakuba okwegwerwa kubi ahabw'okunguza nkaija kunu; ahabw'okuba Ruhanga niwe yantumire kubabandiza kunu kukiza amagara g'abantu.
en: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for God did send me before you to preserve life.

rr: Ahakuba hati enjara emazire emyaka ebiri omu nsi, kandi hakiriyo endiijo myaka etaano, ei abantu batarihingiramu, n'obu kwakuba okugyesha.
en: For these two years hath the famine been in the land: and yet there are five years, in the which there shall neither be earing nor harvest.

rr: Kandi Ruhanga akantuma kubabandiza kunu ngu abakwatire eihembe omu nsi, kandi abajune omu buryo bw'okutangaaza.
en: And God sent me before you to preserve you a posterity in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo tiimwe mwanyohereize kunu, ni Ruhanga; kandi angizire nk'omuzaire ahari Faraho, mukama w'eka ye yoona, kandi omutegyeki w'ensi yoona eya Misri.
en: So now it was not you that sent me hither, but God: and he hath made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and a ruler throughout all the land of Egypt.

rr: Nimwimukye mwehuute, muze owa taata, mumugire muti: Omwana waawe Yosefu atutumire naagira ati: Ruhanga angizire mukama wa wa Misri yoona; shuuma onshangye kunu, oteeziringa
en: Haste ye, and go up to my father, and say unto him, Thus saith thy son Joseph, God hath made me lord of all Egypt: come down unto me, tarry not:

rr: kandi noija kutuura omu kyanga kya Gosheni, onze haihi iwe n'abaana baawe na baijukuru baawe n'amasyo gaawe ag'entaama n'ag'ente, n'ebi oine byona.
en: and thou shalt dwell in the land of Goshen, and thou shalt be near unto me, thou, and thy children, and thy children's children, and thy flocks, and thy herds, and all that thou hast:

rr: Okwo ndyakuheerayo eby'okurya, ahabw'okuba hakitsigaireyo endiijo myaka etaano y'enjara, otakaitwa obworo, iwe n'ab'omu ka yaawe n'abu oine boona.
en: and there will I nourish thee; for yet there are five years of famine; lest thou, and thy household, and all that thou hast, come to poverty.

rr: Kandi reeba, hati imwe na murumuna wangye Benyamiini nimwereebera ku niinye ndikugamba naimwe.
en: And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaketh unto you.

rr: Mushemereire kugambira taata eby'ekitiinisa kyangye kyona eki nyine omuri Misri, n'ebi mureebire byona; kandi murahukye mureete taata kunu.
en: And ye shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that ye have seen; and ye shall haste and bring down my father hither.

rr: Yaagwa Benyamiini omurumuna omu bitsya, yaarira; na Benyamiini nawe yaarira amugwire omu bitsya.
en: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin's neck, and wept; and Benjamin wept upon his neck.

rr: Kandi yaanywegyera bakuru be boona naarira; bwanyima y'ebyo bakuru be baagaaniira nawe.
en: Moreover he kissed all his brethren, and wept upon them: and after that his brethren talked with him.

rr: Faraho okutuma Yakobo kwija
en: Pharaoh's Invitation

rr: Amakuru ku gaahikire owa Faraho ngu beene ishe wa Yosefu baizire, byashemeza Faraho n'abaheereza be.
en: And the fame thereof was heard in Pharaoh's house, saying, Joseph's brethren are come: and it pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.

rr: Faraho yaagira Yosefu ati: Gambira beene sho oti: Mugire muti: Mute emitwaro aha ndogoya zaanyu, mugyende, mugarukye omu nsi ya Kanaani
en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Say unto thy brethren, This do ye; lade your beasts, and go, get you unto the land of Canaan;

rr: mureete shoimwe n'ab'omu maka gaanyu, mwije owangye; naanye ndyabaha ebirungi by'omu nsi ya Misri, naimwe murye aha bishaju byayo.
en: and take your father and your households, and come unto me: and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and ye shall eat the fat of the land.

rr: Kandi obaragiire oti: Mutwaze muti: mutware ebigaari by'omu nsi ya Misri eby'okureetamu abaana baanyu abato n'abakazi baanyu, mureete na shoimwe, mwije.
en: Now thou art commanded, this do ye; take you wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.

rr: Kandi murekye kufa aha bintu byanyu, ahakuba ebirungi by'omu nsi yoona eya Misri n'ebyanyu.
en: Also regard not your stuff; for the good of all the land of Egypt is your's.

rr: Beene Israeli baatwaza batyo; Yosefu yaabaha ebigaari, nk'oku Faraho aragiire, yaabaha n'entanda y'okuriira omu muhanda.
en: And the children of Israel did so: and Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.

rr: Boona oku baingana, buri omwe yaamuha ebijwaro by'okwihaihanisa; kwonka Benyamiini we yaamuha ebicweka by'efeeza magana ashatu n'ebijwaro by'okwihaihanisa kataano.
en: To all of them he gave each man changes of raiment; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver, and five changes of raiment.

rr: Kandi ishe yaamutwekyera endamutsyo y'endogoya ikumi ezeekoreire ebintu birungi bya Misri, n'ezindi ndogoya ikumi z'ebuguma ezeekoreire engano n'emigaati n'entanda ya ishe y'okuriira omu muhanda.
en: And to his father he sent after this manner ; ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt, and ten she asses laden with corn and bread and meat for his father by the way.

rr: Atyo yaaraga beene ishe; ku baabaire nibaimuka kugyenda, yaabagira ati: Mwerinde, mutatonganira omu muhanda.
en: So he sent his brethren away, and they departed: and he said unto them, See that ye fall not out by the way.

rr: Bainamuka baaruga Misri, baahika omu nsi ya Kanaani ahari ishebo Yakobo
en: And they went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan unto Jacob their father,

rr: baamugambira bati: Yosefu abaho, kandi niwe mutegyeki w'ensi yoona eya Misri.
en: and told him, saying, Joseph is yet alive, and he is governor over all the land of Egypt.

rr: Omutima gwe gwagwa enshazi, ahakuba tarabaikiriize.
en: And Jacob's heart fainted, for he believed them not.

rr: Baamutekyerereza ebi Yosefu yaabagambiire byona; kandi ku yaareebire ebigaari, ebi Yosefu yaatwekire kumutwara, omutima gwe gwagaruka eruguru
en: And they told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said unto them: and when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob their father revived:

rr: Israeli nikwo kugira ati: Nikimara; Yosefu omwana wangye obu ariho; ka ngyende, ndeebane nawe ntakafiire.
en: and Israel said, It is enough; Joseph my son is yet alive: I will go and see him before I die.

rr: Currently Selected: Okutandika 45 : RR64 Highlight Share <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8 19c-2.828 0-4.243 0-5.121-.879C2 17.243 2 15.828 2 13v

rr: Atyo Israeli yaimuka, yaagyenda n'ebi yaabaire aine byona, yaahika Beerisheba, yaatambira Ruhanga wa Isaaka ishe ebitambo.
en: And Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beer-sheba, and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac.

rr: Ruhanga yaayeta Israeli omu kworekwa kwa nyekiro, ati: Yakobo! Yakobo! Onu ati: Ndi aha, Mukama wangye.
en: And God spake unto Israel in the visions of the night, and said, Jacob, Jacob. And he said, Here am I.

rr: Yaamugira ati: Ndi Ruhanga, Ruhanga wa sho; otatiina kushuuma Misri; ahakuba okwo niyo ndikuhindurira eihanga rihango
en: And he said, I am God, the God of thy father: fear not to go down into Egypt; for I will there make of thee a great nation:

rr: ndyashuuma naiwe Misri, kandi buzima ndyagaruka nkwiheyo; na Yosefu niwe arikukwata ahamaisho nookaba.
en: I will go down with thee into Egypt; and I will also surely bring thee up again: and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes.

rr: Yakobo yaimuka, yaaruga Beeri-sheba; abatabani baamutwara hamwe n'abaana baabo abato n'abakazi baabo omu bigaari ebi Faraho yaatwekire kumureetamu.
en: And Jacob rose up from Beer-sheba: and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.

rr: Kandi baatwara amatungo gaabo n'ebintu byabo ebi baatungiire omu nsi ya Kanaani, baaza omuri Misri, Yakobo n'oruzaaro rwe rwona
en: And they took their cattle, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt, Jacob, and all his seed with him:

rr: abatabani na batabani baabo, na bahara be, na bahara ba batabani be; orwonirwo ruzaaro rwe rwona oru yaagyenzire narwo Misri.
en: his sons, and his sons' sons with him, his daughters, and his sons' daughters, and all his seed brought he with him into Egypt. Jacob's Descendants

rr: Aga nigo maziina g'abaana ba Israeli abaagiire Misri, Yakobo n'abatabani; Reubeeni omujigaijo gwe
en: And these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob's firstborn.

rr: batabani ba Reubeeni, Hanoki, Palu, Hezirooni na Karumi.
en: And the sons of Reuben; Hanoch, and Phallu, and Hezron, and Carmi.

rr: Batabani ba Simeoni ni Yemueli, Yamini, Ohadi, Yakini, Zohari, na Shauli omutabani, w'Omunyakanaanikazi.
en: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman.

rr: Batabani ba Leevi ni Gereshoni, Kohasi na Merari.
en: And the sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

rr: Batabani ba Yuda ni Eeri, Onani, Sheela, Pereezi na Zeera; kwonka Eeri na Onani bakafeera omu nsi ya Kanaani; batabani ba Pereezi ni Hezirooni na Hamuli.
en: And the sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah, and Pharez, and Zarah: but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. And the sons of Pharez were Hezron and Hamul.

rr: Batabani ba Isakaari ni Toola, Puuva, Yobu na Shimirooni.
en: And the sons of Issachar; Tola, and Phuvah, and Job, and Shimron.

rr: Batabani ba Zebuluuni ni Seredi, Eloni na Yahaleeli.
en: And the sons of Zebulun; Sered, and Elon, and Jahleel.

rr: Abo nibo batabani ba Lea, abu yaazaariire Yakobo omuri Padanaramu hamwe na muhara we Dina; abaana be b'aboojo n'ab'abaishiki boona bakaba bari makumi ashatu na bashatu.
en: These be the sons of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob in Padan-aram, with his daughter Dinah: all the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty and three.

rr: Batabani ba Gaadi ni Zifioni, Haagi, Shuuni, Ezibooni, Eeri, Arodi na Areeli.
en: And the sons of Gad; Ziphion, and Haggi, Shuni, and Ezbon, Eri, and Arodi, and Areli.

rr: Batabani ba Asheri ni Imuna, Ishiva, Ishivi na Beeria na munyaanyabo Seera; batabani ba Beria ni Heberi na Malikieli.
en: And the sons of Asher; Jimnah, and Ishuah, and Isui, and Beriah, and Serah their sister: and the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel.

rr: Abo nibo baana ba Zilupa ou Labaani yaahaire Lea muhara we, kandi abo nibo yaazaariire Yakobo, abantu ikumi na mukaaga.
en: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter, and these she bare unto Jacob, even sixteen souls.

rr: Batabani ba Rakeeli muka Yakobo ni Yosefu na Benyamiini.
en: The sons of Rachel Jacob's wife; Joseph, and Benjamin.

rr: Kandi Yosefu yaazaarira Manaase na Efuraimu omu nsi ya Misri, abu Asenaasi muhara wa Potifeera omunyamurwa wa Oni yaamuzaariire.
en: And unto Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, which Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On bare unto him.

rr: Batabani ba Benyamiini ni Beela, Bekeri, Ashubeeli, Geera, Naamani, ehi, Roshi, Mupimu, Hupimu na Aridi.
en: And the sons of Benjamin were Belah, and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, Ehi, and Rosh, Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard.

rr: Abo nibo batabani ba Rakeeli abu yaazaariire Yakobo; boona bakaba bari ikumi na bana.
en: These are the sons of Rachel, which were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.

rr: Mutabani wa Daani ni Hushimu.
en: And the sons of Dan; Hushim.

rr: Batabani ba Nafutaali ni Yahazeeli, Guuni, Yezeri na Shileemu.
en: And the sons of Naphtali; Jahzeel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shillem.

rr: Abo nibo batabani ba Biliha ou Labaani yaahaire Rakeeli muhara we, abu yaazaariire Yakobo; boona bakaba bari mushanju.
en: These are the sons of Bilhah, which Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter, and she bare these unto Jacob: all the souls were seven.

rr: Abantu boona ab'omu nda ya Yakobo abaagyenzire nawe Misri, otabariiremu bakaamwana be, bakaba bari makumi mukaaga na mukaaga.
en: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt, which came out of his loins, besides Jacob's sons' wives, all the souls were threescore and six;

rr: Batabani ba Yosefu abu yaazaariire Misri bakaba bari babiri; abantu boona ab'omu ka ya Yakobo abaagiire Misri bakaba bari makumi mushanju.
en: and the sons of Joseph, which were born him in Egypt, were two souls: all the souls of the house of Jacob, which came into Egypt, were threescore and ten.

rr: Yakobo okureebana na Yosefu
en: Jacob Goes to Egypt

rr: Yakobo yaatuma Yuda ahari Yosefu ku amushanga Gosheni; batyo baahika omu kyanga kya Gosheni.
en: And he sent Judah before him unto Joseph, to direct his face unto Goshen; and they came into the land of Goshen.

rr: Yosefu yaaboneza ekigaari kye, yainamuka, yaaza kubugana Israeli ishe omuri Gosheni; yaamwetondera, yaamugwa omu bitsya, yaamara omwanya naarira akimuri omu bitsya.
en: And Joseph made ready his chariot, and went up to meet Israel his father, to Goshen, and presented himself unto him; and he fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.

rr: Israeli yaagira Yosefu ati: N'obu naakufa nka hati, niho naakureeba, nkamanya ku obaho.
en: And Israel said unto Joseph, Now let me die, since I have seen thy face, because thou art yet alive.

rr: Yosefu yaagambira beene ishe n'ab'omu ka ya ishe ati: Ka ngyende ngambire Faraho, mmugira nti: Beene taata n'ab'omu ka ye abaabaire batwire omu nsi ya Kanaani naatsiga baija
en: And Joseph said unto his brethren, and unto his father's house, I will go up, and shew Pharaoh, and say unto him, My brethren, and my father's house, which were in the land of Canaan, are come unto me;

rr: nti, kandi abo bashaija n'abariisa, ahakuba omurimo gwabo n'okuriisa; na mbwenu baareeta amasyo gaabo ag'entaama n'ag'ente, n'ebindi byona ebi baatungire.
en: and the men are shepherds, for their trade hath been to feed cattle; and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.

rr: Faraho ku araabeete, yaababuuza ati: Mukora murimo ki?
en: And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What is your occupation?

rr: Mumugire muti: Abairu baawe turi abariisa okwiha omu buto bwaitu n'okuhitsya hati, itwe na baatatenkuriitwe; mubone kutuura omu kyaro kya Gosheni; ahakuba omuriisa weena n'ekihagaro aha Banyamisri.
en: That ye shall say, Thy servants' trade hath been about cattle from our youth even until now, both we, and also our fathers: that ye may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination unto the Egyptians.

rr: Yosefu yaaza owa Faraho, yaamugira ati: Taata na beene taata n'amasyo gaabo ag'entaama n'ag'ente n'ebi baatungire byona barugire omu nsi ya Kanaani, hati bari omu kyanga kya Gosheni.
en: Then Joseph came and told Pharaoh, and said, My father and my brethren, and their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have, are come out of the land of Canaan; and, behold, they are in the land of Goshen.

rr: Omuri beene ishe yaatooranamu bataano, yaabatondera Faraho.
en: And he took some of his brethren, even five men, and presented them unto Pharaoh.

rr: Faraho yaababuuza ati: Mukora murimo ki?
en: And Pharaoh said unto his brethren, What is your occupation?

rr: Baamugarukamu bati: Abairu baawe turi abariisa, itwe na baatatenkuriitwe.
en: And they said unto Pharaoh, Thy servants are shepherds, both we, and also our fathers.

rr: Baagaruka baagambira Faraho bati: Twizire kushuhuukira omu nsi egi; ahakuba abairu baawe tukabura obunyaatsi bw'amasyo gaitu owaitu Kanaani, kandi hariyo n'enjara nyingi; mbwenu nitukweshengyereza, oikirize abairu baawe batuure omu kyaro kya Gosheni.
en: They said moreover unto Pharaoh, For to sojourn in the land are we come; for thy servants have no pasture for their flocks; for the famine is sore in the land of Canaan: now therefore, we pray thee, let thy servants dwell in the land of Goshen.

rr: Faraho yaagambira Yosefu ati: Sho na beene sho bakuhikire
en: And Pharaoh spake unto Joseph, saying, Thy father and thy brethren are come unto thee:

rr: ensi ya Misri ekuri omumaisho; ohe sho na beene sho ah'okutuura aharikukira oburungi; batuure omu kyanga kya Gosheni. Kandi ku oraabe oine abu orikumanyamu abarikumanya gye eby'ente, obahindure abakuru b'amasyo gangye.
en: the land of Egypt is before thee; in the best of the land make thy father and brethren to dwell; in the land of Goshen let them dwell: and if thou knowest any men of activity among them, then make them rulers over my cattle.

rr: Bwanyima Yosefu yaataasya Yakobo ishe owa Faraho, yaamuta omu maisho ge; Yakobo yaashabira Faraho omugisha.
en: And Joseph brought in Jacob his father, and set him before Pharaoh: and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.

rr: Faraho yaabuuza Yakobo ati: Mbwenu oine emyaka engahi?
en: And Pharaoh said unto Jacob, How old art thou?

rr: Yakobo yaamugarukamu ati: Ebiro by'emyaka ei mmazire ningyendagyenda nibihika emyaka igana na makumi ashatu; ebiro by'egyo myaka y'amagara gangye ni bikye kandi ni bibi; terikwingana n'ei baatatenkuru baamazire omu kugyendagyenda kwabo.
en: And Jacob said unto Pharaoh, The days of the years of my pilgrimage are an hundred and thirty years: few and evil have the days of the years of my life been, and have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.

rr: Yakobo ku yaaherize kushabira Faraho omugisha, yaashohora, yaaruga omumaisho ge.
en: And Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from before Pharaoh.

rr: Yosefu yaaha ishe na beene ishe ah'okuzingura omu nsi ya Misri omu kyaro kya Rameseesi aharikukira oburungi okuba obutaka bwabo, nk'oku Faraho yaaragiire.
en: And Joseph placed his father and his brethren, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.

rr: Kandi Yosefu yaaguma naaha ishe eby'okurya na beene ishe n'ab'omu ka ya ishe boona, nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri. Yosefu okugurira Faraho ensi ya Misri
en: And Joseph nourished his father, and his brethren, and all his father's household, with bread, according to their families.

rr: Kandi omuri egyo nsi yoona hakaba hatarimu by'okurya; ahakuba enjara ekaba eri nyingi munonga, kyareetera ab'omu nsi ya Misri n'eya Kanaani okukuuhura ahabw'egyo njara.
en: And there was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very sore, so that the land of Egypt and all the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.

rr: Yosefu yaateerana hamwe empiiha zoona ezaabaire ziri omu nsi ya Misri n'eya Kanaani, ezaarugire omu ngano ezi baaguzire; empiiha ezo zoona yaazireeta omu nju ya Faraho.
en: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the corn which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh's house.

rr: Empiiha ku zaahwereire kimwe omu nsi ya Misri n'eya Kanaani, Abanyamisri boona baayetuurira Yosefu, baagira bati: Tuhe eby'okurya. Mbwenu tukugwe omumaisho ahabw'okubura empiiha?
en: And when money failed in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came unto Joseph, and said, Give us bread: for why should we die in thy presence? for the money faileth.

rr: Yosefu yaagira ati: Empiiha ku ziraabe zihweire, mureete amatungo gaanyu, mbaguze eby'okurya.
en: And Joseph said, Give your cattle; and I will give you for your cattle, if money fail.

rr: Batyo baareetera Yosefu amatungo gaabo; yaabaguza eby'okurya, baamuha embaraasi n'entaama n'ente n'endogoya; omuri ogwo mwaka gwona yaabaha eby'okurya, nibabishakisa amatungo gaabo.
en: And they brought their cattle unto Joseph: and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for horses, and for the flocks, and for the cattle of the herds, and for the asses: and he fed them with bread for all their cattle for that year.

rr: Omwaka ogwo ku gwahweire, baamugarukaho omu gundi ogwakuratsireho, baamugira bati: Titurikubaasa kushereka mukama waitu ku empiiha zaitu zihwereire kimwe, kandi n'amatungo gaitu ku gabaire age; tihaine kitsigaireho omumaisho ga mukama waitu, kureka emibiri yaitu n'ebibanja byaitu.
en: When that year was ended, they came unto him the second year, and said unto him, We will not hide it from my lord, how that our money is spent; my lord also hath our herds of cattle; there is not ought left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands:

rr: Mbwenu tukugwe omumaisho n'ebibanja byaitu? Otugure n'ebibanja byaitu, otuhe eby'okurya; haza itwe turyaba abahuuku ba Faraho n'ebibanja byaitu; otuhe embibo, tukire tutafa, ensi erekye kuhinduka amatongo.
en: wherefore shall we die before thine eyes, both we and our land? buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants unto Pharaoh: and give us seed, that we may live, and not die, that the land be not desolate.

rr: Atyo Yosefu yaagurira Faraho ensi yoona eya Misri; ahakuba Omunyamisri weena akatunda omusiri gwe, ahabw'okuba enjara ekabateera munonga. Ensi yoona yaaba eya Faraho.
en: And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh; for the Egyptians sold every man his field, because the famine prevailed over them: so the land became Pharaoh's.

rr: Abantu boona yaabagira abahuuku, okuruga aha rubaju rumwe rwa Misri okuhika aha rundi.
en: And as for the people, he removed them to cities from one end of the borders of Egypt even to the other end thereof.

rr: Kwonka ebibanja by'abanyamurwa nibyo ataraguzire; ahabw'okuba abanyamurwa bakaba baine omugabo gwabo ogu baahairwe Faraho, kandi nigwo baabaire baryaho; nikyo bataratundiire bibanja byabo.
en: Only the land of the priests bought he not; for the priests had a portion assigned them of Pharaoh, and did eat their portion which Pharaoh gave them: wherefore they sold not their lands.

rr: Bwanyima Yosefu yaagambira abantu ati: Reeba, eri izooba naaheza kubagura n'ebibanja byanyu kuba ebya Faraho. Mbwenu reeba, naabaha embibo, mugyende mubibe omu misiri yaangu.
en: Then Joseph said unto the people, Behold, I have bought you this day and your land for Pharaoh: lo, here is seed for you, and ye shall sow the land.

rr: Omu ishaaruura muryaha Faraho ekicweka kimwe kya kataano, kandi ebicweka bina bibe ebyanyu, mwiheho embibo, ebindi bibe eby'okurya byanyu n'ab'omu maka gaanyu hamwe n'abaana baanyu abato.
en: And it shall come to pass in the increase, that ye shall give the fifth part unto Pharaoh, and four parts shall be your own, for seed of the field, and for your food, and for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.

rr: Baagarukamu bati: Otutambiire, titwafa; Mukama waitu, na mbwenu otugirire embabazi, nitwija kuguma turi abahuuku ba Faraho.
en: And they said, Thou hast saved our lives: let us find grace in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh's servants.

rr: Okuruga aho Yosefu yaataho ekiragiro ky'ebibanja omu nsi ya Misri, ekikiriho na hati, Faraho okutunga ekicweka kimwe kya kataano; kureka ebibanja by'abanyamurwa bonka nibyo bitarabaire bya Faraho. Yakobo okurahiza Yosefu
en: And Joseph made it a law over the land of Egypt unto this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth part ; except the land of the priests only, which became not Pharaoh's.

rr: Abaisraeli baatuura omu nsi ya Misri, omu kyanga kya Gosheni; baagitungiramu ebintu, baagizaariramu, baakanya munonga.
en: And Israel dwelt in the land of Egypt, in the country of Goshen; and they had possessions therein, and grew, and multiplied exceedingly.

rr: Yakobo yaamara emyaka ikumi na mushanju omu nsi ya Misri; n'ahabw'ekyo emyaka yoona ei yaamazire yaahika igana na makumi ana na mushanju.
en: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years: so the whole age of Jacob was an hundred forty and seven years.

rr: Obunaku bw'okufa kwa Israeli ku bwabaire buri haihi, yaayeta omutabani Yosefu, yaamugira ati: Ku oraabe nongirira embabazi, ninkweshengyereza ta omukono gwawe ahansi y'ekibero kyangye, onkorere eby'embabazi kandi eby'amazima; otarinziika Misri
en: And the time drew nigh that Israel must die: and he called his son Joseph, and said unto him, If now I have found grace in thy sight, put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me; bury me not, I pray thee, in Egypt:

rr: orekye nshangye baatatenkuru; onyihe Misri, onziikye omu kituuro kyabo.
en: but I will lie with my fathers, and thou shalt carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their buryingplace.

rr: Onu ati: Ndyakora nk'oku waagamba.
en: And he said, I will do as thou hast said.

rr: Yaagira ati: Ndahira.
en: And he said, Swear unto me.

rr: Yaamurahira.
en: And he sware unto him.

rr: Israeli yainama aha mushego gw'ekitabo kye.
en: And Israel bowed himself upon the bed's head.

rr: Bwanyima y'ebyo baagambira Yosefu ku ishe arwaire; yaatwara abatabani bombi, Manaase na Efuraimu.
en: And it came to pass after these things, that one told Joseph, Behold, thy father is sick: and he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.

rr: Baagambira Yakobo bati: Yosefu omwana waawe yaija kukureeba. Israeli yaayehangaana, yaashutama aha kitabo.
en: And one told Jacob, and said, Behold, thy son Joseph cometh unto thee: and Israel strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed.

rr: Yakobo yaagira Yosefu ati: Ruhanga ow'obushoboorozi bwona akanyeyorekyera Luuzi omu nsi ya Kanaani, yampa omugisha
en: And Jacob said unto Joseph, God Almighty appeared unto me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,

rr: yangira ati: Ndyakuha oruzaaro, nkukanyise, nkuhindure omutwe muhango gw'amahanga; kandi ensi egi ndyagiha oruzaaro rwawe orurikukurata kuba eyaabo ey'ebiro n'ebiro.
en: and said unto me, Behold, I will make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, and I will make of thee a multitude of people; and will give this land to thy seed after thee for an everlasting possession.

rr: Kandi mbwenu batabani baawe bombi, abu waazaariire Misri, ntakakushangireyo, n'abangye; Efuraimu na Manaase baryaba abangye nka Reubeeni na Simeoni oku bari.
en: And now thy two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, which were born unto thee in the land of Egypt before I came unto thee into Egypt, are mine; as Reuben and Simeon, they shall be mine.

rr: Abandi baana, abu orizaara bwanyima yaabo, baryaba baawe; baryayetererwa bakuru baabo omu by'obuhunguzi bwabo.
en: And thy issue, which thou begettest after them, shall be thine, and shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance.

rr: Eky'obusaasi, ku naabaire ninduga Padani, naahika Kanaani tukiri omu muhanda, naafeerwa Rakeeli, hakitsigaire omwanya okuhika Efuraata; naamuziika aho aha muhanda ogurikuza Efuraata, (niyo Betelehemu).
en: And as for me, when I came from Padan, Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan in the way, when yet there was but a little way to come unto Ephrath: and I buried her there in the way of Ephrath; the same is Beth-lehem.

rr: Bwanyima Israeli ku yaareebire beene Yosefu, yaamubuuza ati: Aba ni baahi?
en: And Israel beheld Joseph's sons, and said, Who are these?

rr: Yosefu yaagarukamu ishe ati: Ni batabani bangye, abu Ruhanga yampeereire kunu.
en: And Joseph said unto his father, They are my sons, whom God hath given me in this place .

rr: Ishe yaamugira ati: Ninkweshengyereza bampitsye, mbashabire omugisha.
en: And he said, Bring them, I pray thee, unto me, and I will bless them.

rr: Obwo Israeli akaba atakibaasa kuhweza ahabw'obukuru.
en: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, so that he could not see.

rr: Yosefu yaabamuhitsya, Israeli yaabanywegyera ababumbatiire
en: And he brought them near unto him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.

rr: yaagira Yosefu ati: Nkaba ntarikuteekateeka ngu turyareebana; mbwenu reeba Ruhanga yandeebesa n'oruzaaro rwawe.
en: And Israel said unto Joseph, I had not thought to see thy face: and, lo, God hath shewed me also thy seed.

rr: Yosefu yaabaiha aha maju ga ishe, yainama ahansi.
en: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.

rr: Yaabatwara bombi, akwaitse Efuraimu n'omukono gwe gwa buryo amugyemire omukono gwa Israeli ogwa bumosho, na Manaase amukwaitse n'omukono gwe gwa bumosho amugyemire omukono gwa Israeli ogwa buryo, yaabamuhitsya.
en: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel's left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel's right hand, and brought them near unto him.

rr: Israeli yaananuura omukono gwe ogwa buryo, yaata engaro ze aha mutwe gwa Efuraimu omuto, kandi ez'ogwa bumosho yaazita aha mutwe gwa Manaase, arabaniisemu emikono ye, akigyendereire; ahakuba Manaase niwe yaabaire ari omujigaijo.
en: And Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it upon Ephraim's head, who was the younger, and his left hand upon Manasseh's head, guiding his hands wittingly; for Manasseh was the firstborn.

rr: Yaashabira Yosefu omugisha, naagira ati: Ruhanga, ou tatenkuru Abrahamu na taata Isaaka baabaire bagyendera gye omu maisho; Ruhanga owantungire ebiro byona eby'amagara gangye n'okuhitsya hati
en: And he blessed Joseph, and said, God, before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk, the God which fed me all my life long unto this day,

rr: na maraika owancungwire omu bubi bwona, ahe aba boojo omugisha; kandi beetererwe eiziina ryangye n'amaziina g'abanzaire Abrahamu na Isaaka, kandi barugyemu omutwe muhango gw'abantu omu nsi.
en: the Angel which redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads; and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth.

rr: Yosefu ku yaareebire ishe ataire omukono gwe gwa buryo aha mutwe gwa Efuraimu, kyamugwisa kubi; yaakwata omukono gwa ishe kugwiha aha mutwe gwa Efuraimu kuguta aha gwa Manaase.
en: And when Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand upon the head of Ephraim, it displeased him: and he held up his father's hand, to remove it from Ephraim's head unto Manasseh's head.

rr: Yaagira ishe ati: Ngaaha, Taata; ogu niwe mujigaijo; ba niwe waataho omukono gwawe gwa buryo.
en: And Joseph said unto his father, Not so, my father: for this is the firstborn; put thy right hand upon his head.

rr: Kwonka ishe yaayanga, yaagira ati: Ninkimanya, mwana wangye, ninkimanya; ogu nawe aryahinduka eihanga, kandi aryaba mukuru; kwonka omurumuna aryamukiza obukuru, n'oruzaaro rwe ruryahinduka omutwe muhango gw'amahanga.
en: And his father refused, and said, I know it , my son, I know it: he also shall become a people, and he also shall be great: but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations.

rr: Atyo yaabashabira omugisha eryo izooba, naagira ati: Muryaba eky'okureeberaho aha Baisraeli, baaba nibashabirana emigisha, bagire bati: Ruhanga akugire nka Efuraimu na Manaase. Okwo nikwo yaatungwire Efuraimu okukira Manaase.
en: And he blessed them that day, saying, In thee shall Israel bless, saying, God make thee as Ephraim and as Manasseh: and he set Ephraim before Manasseh.

rr: Bwanyima Israeli yaagira Yosefu ati: Reeba, naaza kufa; kwonka Ruhanga aryaguma naimwe, kandi aryabagarura omu nsi ya baashwenkuriimwe
en: And Israel said unto Joseph, Behold, I die: but God shall be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers.

rr: kandi iwe naakuha omugabo gumwe okweshumba beene sho, ogu naanyagire Abaamori na rurara yangye n'obuta bwangye.
en: Moreover I have given to thee one portion above thy brethren, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.
