en: Currently Selected: Judges 3 : KJV Highlight Share <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8 19c-2.828 0-4.243 0-5.121-.879

rr: Ehudi ku yaaherize kufa, Abaisraeli baagaruka, baakora ebirikwangwa MUKAMA
en: And the children of Israel again did evil in the sight of the LORD , when Ehud was dead.

rr: kyareetera MUKAMA kubahayo omu mikono ya Yabini, omugabe wa Kanaani, owaabaire naategekyera omuri Hazori; kandi omukuru w'eihe rye akaba ari Sisera, owaabaire atuura Harosheesi ey'Abanyamahanga.
en: And the LORD sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, that reigned in Hazor; the captain of whose host was Sisera, which dwelt in Harosheth of the Gentiles.

rr: Abaisraeli baatakira MUKAMA; ahabw'okuba Yabini akaba aine ebigaari by'ebyoma magana mwenda, yaamara emyaka makumi abiri naita kubi Abaisraeli.
en: And the children of Israel cried unto the LORD : for he had nine hundred chariots of iron; and twenty years he mightily oppressed the children of Israel.

rr: Omu bunaku obwo Debora nabikazi, muka Lapidoosi, niwe yaabaire naacwera Abaisraeli emanja.
en: And Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lapidoth, she judged Israel at that time.

rr: Akaba ahimbisa kushutama ahansi y'omukindo gwa Debora ahagati ya Raama na Beseeli omu nsi y'ebibungo eya Efuraimu; kandi Abaisraeli bakaba baija ah' ari kubashoboorora.
en: And she dwelt under the palm tree of Deborah between Ramah and Beth-el in mount Ephraim: and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment.

rr: Bwanyima yaatuma kweta Baraki mwene Abinoamu omuri Kedeshi-nafutaali, yaamugira ati: MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli tarakuragiire kugyenda kuteeranira abantu kakumi aha kibungo Tabora, noobaiha omu ruganda rwa Nafutaali n'orwa Zebuluuni?
en: And she sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedesh-naphtali, and said unto him, Hath not the LORD God of Israel commanded, saying , Go and draw toward mount Tabor, and take with thee ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun?

rr: -14 ; . Kandi Ruhanga agizire ati: Naanye niinyija kukureetera Sisera omukuru w'eihe rya Yabini, akubugane aha mugyera Kishoni n'ebigaari bye n'engabo ze nyingi munonga, mmuheyo omu mikono yaawe.
en: And I will draw unto thee to the river Kishon Sisera, the captain of Jabin's army, with his chariots and his multitude; and I will deliver him into thine hand.

rr: Baraki yaamugarukamu ati: Ku oraagyende naanye, niinyija kugyenda; kwonka ku oraabe otagyenzire naanye, tindikwija kugyenda.
en: And Barak said unto her, If thou wilt go with me, then I will go: but if thou wilt not go with me, then I will not go.

rr: Yaamugira ati: N'ekya buzima niinyija kugyenda naiwe; kwonka orugyendo oru orikwija kugyenda tirurikwija kukuhaisa kitiinisa; ahabw'okuba MUKAMA naija kuhayo Sisera omu mikono y'omukazi.
en: And she said, I will surely go with thee: notwithstanding the journey that thou takest shall not be for thine honour; for the LORD shall sell Sisera into the hand of a woman.

rr: Debora yaimuka, yaagyenda na Baraki, baaza Kedeshi.
en: And Deborah arose, and went with Barak to Kedesh.

rr: Ku baahikireyo, Baraki yaahuruza Abazebuluuni n'Abanafutaali kuteeranira Kedeshi; haija abantu kakumi bamukuratiire; na Debora yaagyenda nawe.
en: And Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali to Kedesh; and he went up with ten thousand men at his feet: and Deborah went up with him.

rr: Obwo Heberi Omukeeni akaba ataine n'Abakeeni, nibo baijukuru ba Hobabu ishezaara wa Musa; kandi ateire eihema rye ahansi y'omwela oguri omuri Zaananimu, haihi na Kedeshi.
en: Now Heber the Kenite, which was of the children of Hobab the father in law of Moses, had severed himself from the Kenites, and pitched his tent unto the plain of Zaanaim, which is by Kedesh.

rr: Ku baagambiire Sisera ku Baraki mwene Abinoamu yainamuka omu kibungo Tabora
en: And they shewed Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam was gone up to mount Tabor.

rr: Sisera yaahuruza ebigaari bye byona, ebigaari by'ebyoma magana mwenda, n'engabo ze zoona ezaarugire Harosheesi ey'Abanyamahanga, yaabateeranira aha mugyera Kishoni.
en: And Sisera gathered together all his chariots, even nine hundred chariots of iron, and all the people that were with him, from Harosheth of the Gentiles unto the river of Kishon.

rr: Debora yaagambira Baraki ati: Imuka, ahakuba eri niryo izooba eri MUKAMA yaaheerayo Sisera omu mikono yaawe. Noogira ngu MUKAMA takwebembeire? Atyo Baraki yaaruga aha kibungo Tabora, yaashuuma n'engabo ze kakumi zimukuratiire.
en: And Deborah said unto Barak, Up; for this is the day in which the LORD hath delivered Sisera into thine hand: is not the LORD gone out before thee? So Barak went down from mount Tabor, and ten thousand men after him.

rr: MUKAMA yaaburanzya Sisera n'ebigaari bye byona n'engabo ze zoona na rurara, baahunga omu maisho ga Baraki; na Sisera yaasyoka omu kigaari kye, yairuka, yaahunga.
en: And the LORD discomfited Sisera, and all his chariots, and all his host, with the edge of the sword before Barak; so that Sisera lighted down off his chariot, and fled away on his feet.

rr: Baraki yaagyenda abingire ebyo bigaari n'ezo ngabo, okuhika Harosheesi ey'Abanyamahanga; engabo zoona eza Sisera zaahwera ahari rurara, tihaagira waahonokaho.
en: But Barak pursued after the chariots, and after the host, unto Harosheth of the Gentiles: and all the host of Sisera fell upon the edge of the sword; and there was not a man left.

rr: Kwonka Sisera yairuka, yaahunga, yaahika aha ihema rya Yayeli muka Heberi Omukeeni; ahabw'okuba Yabini omugabe wa Hazori n'ab'enju ya Heberi Omukeeni bakaba nibataahirana.
en: Howbeit Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite: for there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.

rr: Yayeli yaashohora kubugana Sisera, yaamugira ati: Kiikama, mukama wangye, otaahe omwangye; otatiina.
en: And Jael went out to meet Sisera, and said unto him, Turn in, my lord, turn in to me; fear not.

rr: Yaataaha omu ihema rye, yaamushweka burangiti.
en: And when he had turned in unto her into the tent, she covered him with a mantle.

rr: Onu yaamugira ati: Ninkweshengyereza mpa otwizi tw'okunywa, ahakuba nyine eiriho.
en: And he said unto her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water to drink; for I am thirsty.

rr: Yayeli yaafunduura ecupa y'amate, yaamuha, yaanywa, yaagaruka yaamushweka.
en: And she opened a bottle of milk, and gave him drink, and covered him.

rr: Sisera yaamugira ati: Yemerera aha muryango gw'eihema; ku haraije omuntu weena, yaakubuuza ati: Haine omuntu ori aha? omugire oti: Ngaaha!
en: Again he said unto her, Stand in the door of the tent, and it shall be, when any man doth come and enquire of thee, and say, Is there any man here? that thou shalt say, No.

rr: Bwanyima Yayeli muka Heberi yaihayo enkondo y'eihema n'enyondo, yaamwizira naashooba, yaamuteera egyo nkondo omu kanenero agwejegyeire munonga ahabw'okuruha, enkondo yaayogamu, yaahika omu itaka.
en: Then Jael Heber's wife took a nail of the tent, and took an hammer in her hand, and went softly unto him, and smote the nail into his temples, and fastened it into the ground: for he was fast asleep and weary.

rr: Atyo Sisera yaafa.
en: So he died.

rr: Kandi reeba, Baraki ku yaabaire akikuratiire Sisera, Yayeli yaashohora kumubugana, yaamugira ati: Ija nkworekye omushaija ou orikusherura.
en: And, behold, as Barak pursued Sisera, Jael came out to meet him, and said unto him, Come, and I will shew thee the man whom thou seekest.

rr: Yaataaha omu ihema ry'ogwo mukazi, yaashanga Sisera agangarami afiire, n'enkondo y'eihema ekimuri omu kanenero.
en: And when he came into her tent , behold, Sisera lay dead, and the nail was in his temples.

rr: Eryo izooba Ruhanga yaagomoora Yabini omugabe w'Abanyakanaani omu maisho g'Abaisraeli
en: So God subdued on that day Jabin the king of Canaan before the children of Israel.

rr: n'ahabw'ekyo omukono gw'Abaisraeli gwaguma nigweyongyera amaani ahari Yabini omugabe wa Kanaani, okuhitsya obu baamuhwerekyerereize kimwe.
en: And the hand of the children of Israel prospered, and prevailed against Jabin the king of Canaan, until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.

rr: Currently Selected: Abaramuzi 4 : RR64 Highlight Share <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8 19c-2.828 0-4.243 0-5.12
en: Currently Selected: Judges 4 : KJV Highlight Share <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8 19c-2.828 0-4.243 0-5.

rr: Eryo izooba Debora na Baraki mwene Abinoamu baayeshongora bati
en: Then sang Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam on that day, saying,

rr: Muhimbise MUKAMA, Ahabw'okuba abeebembezi beebembeire Israeli, N'abantu baayehayo beekundiire.
en: Praise ye the LORD For the avenging of Israel, When the people willingly offered themselves.

rr: Imwe bagabe 'mwe, nimuhurire; naimwe abanyiginya, mutegye amatu. Naaza kweshongorera MUKAMA, Nyeshongore eby'okuhimbisa MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli.
en: Hear, O ye kings; give ear, O ye princes; I, even I, will sing unto the LORD ; I will sing praise to the LORD God of Israel.

rr: MUKAMA obu waaruga omuri Seiri, Obu waashohora omu nsi ya Edomu noohurura, Ensi ekatengyeta, n'eiguru ryatengatenga, Ebicu byatoonya amaizi. -6 ; .
en: LORD , when thou wentest out of Seir, When thou marchedst out of the field of Edom, The earth trembled, and the heavens dropped, The clouds also dropped water.

rr: Enshozi zaahimintika amaizi omu maisho ga MUKAMA, Nangwa na Sinai yaaba etyo omu maisho ga MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli.
en: The mountains melted from before the LORD , Even that Sinai from before the LORD God of Israel.

rr: Omu biro bya Shamugaari mwene Anasi, n'omu bya Yayeli, Emihanda rugyendwa ekaba etarabwa, Abagyenzi bakaba bashenshebuka omu tuhanda tw'omu mbaju.
en: In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath, In the days of Jael, the highways were unoccupied, And the travellers walked through byways.

rr: Obwo abategyeki bahweire omuri Israeli, Okuhitsya obu nyowe Debora naimukire, Nkaimuka nk'omuzaire omuri Israeli.
en: The inhabitants of the villages ceased, they ceased in Israel, Until that I Deborah arose, That I arose a mother in Israel.

rr: Baaruhanga basya ku baatairweho, Engamba zaatengyerwa omu marembo. Ha ngabo, nari icumu, ebyabaireho Omu ngabo za Israeli obukumi buna.
en: They chose new gods; Then was war in the gates: Was there a shield or spear seen Among forty thousand in Israel?

rr: Omutima gwangye gwona guri aha beebembezi ba Israeli Abaayehaireyo omu bantu n'omutima gwekundiire. Muhimbise MUKAMA.
en: My heart is toward the governors of Israel, That offered themselves willingly among the people. Bless ye the LORD .

rr: Imwe abagyendera aha ndogoya za kisa, nimukibuzye, Naimwe abashutama aha mikyeeka y'ekikama, Kandi naimwe abagyendesa ebigyere omu mihanda.
en: Speak, ye that ride on white asses, Ye that sit in judgment, And walk by the way.

rr: Hare ei enduuru z'abarikurashana zirikureetwa, Ei bataha amaizi, Okwo niyo bariguma nibagambira eby'okuhikiirira ebi MUKAMA yaakozire, Eby'okuhikiirira kw'omu butegyeki bwe omuri Israeli. Nibwo abantu ba MUKAMA baashuuma, bakataaha omu marembo.
en: They that are delivered from the noise of archers in the places of drawing water, There shall they rehearse the righteous acts of the LORD , Even the righteous acts toward the inhabitants of his villages in Israel: Then shall the people of the LORD go down to the gates.

rr: Sisiimuka, sisiimuka, Debora! Sisiimuka, sisiimuka, oyeshongore ekyeshongoro. Imuka, Baraki, abaabaire bakukwatsire obatware bari enkwatwa, Iwe mutabani wa Abinoamu.
en: Awake, awake, Deborah: Awake, awake, utter a song: Arise, Barak, and lead thy captivity captive, thou son of Abinoam.

rr: Haashuuma ab'ekitiinisa abaabaire batsigaireho; Abantu ba MUKAMA baashuuma kumurwanira n'ab'amaani.
en: Then he made him that remaineth have dominion over the nobles among the people: The LORD made me have dominion over the mighty.

rr: Baaruga Efuraimu, baaza omu ruhanga, Bakukuratiire, iwe Benyamiini, na beene waanyu; Abakuru b'engabo baashuuma nibaruga Makiri, N'omuri Zebuluuni haarugayo abaabaire batwara enkoni y'omukuru w'engabo.
en: Out of Ephraim was there a root of them against Amalek; After thee, Benjamin, among thy people; Out of Machir came down governors, And out of Zebulun they that handle the pen of the writer.

rr: Abanyiginya ba Isakaari baija na Debora, N'abandi ba Isakaari abaabaire bari abeesigwa ahari Baraki; Bairukira omu ruhanga, bamuri omu ntegye.
en: And the princes of Issachar were with Deborah; Even Issachar, and also Barak: He was sent on foot into the valley.

rr: Aha migyera ya Reubeeni Baagiriraho enaama ehamire.
en: For the divisions of Reuben There were great thoughts of heart.

rr: N'enki ekikugumize omu bibuga by'entaama, Kuhurira emikuri ei barikuziteerera?
en: Why abodest thou among the sheepfolds, To hear the bleatings of the flocks?

rr: Aha migyera ya Reubeeni Haabaho okwebuuza kuhango munonga.
en: For the divisions of Reuben There were great searchings of heart.

rr: Abagileadi beegumiire obuseeri bwa Yorudani; Abadaani batsigaziibwe ki omu meeri?
en: Gilead abode beyond Jordan: And why did Dan remain in ships?

rr: Abaasheri bagumire beeshutamiire aha nyambukiro, Baayegumira omu mikono y'enyanja.
en: Asher continued on the sea shore, And abode in his breaches.

rr: Abazebuluuni n'abantu aboogire amagara gaabo, Tibatiinire kufa. N'Abanafutaali bagiire omu kaso k'orugamba.
en: Zebulun and Naphtali were a people that jeoparded their lives unto the death In the high places of the field.

rr: Abagabe baizire, baarwana, Abagabe ba Kanaani baarwanira Tanaki Aha migyera ya Megido; Kwonka tibaine feeza zi banyagire.
en: The kings came and fought, Then fought the kings of Canaan In Taanach by the waters of Megiddo; They took no gain of money.

rr: Eiguru rihurwire; Enyonyoozi omu ngyendo zaazo zaarwanisa Sisera. -14 ; .
en: They fought from heaven; The stars in their courses fought against Sisera.

rr: Omugyera Kishoni gwabatwara, Ogwo mugyera gwa ira Kishoni. Iwe magara gangye, oribatiriire ab'amaani.
en: The river of Kishon swept them away, That ancient river, the river Kishon. O my soul, thou hast trodden down strength.

rr: Obwo embaraasi zaabo zairuka nizishaayaguza, Nizishaayaguza n'amaani.
en: Then were the horsehoofs broken By the means of the pransings, the pransings of their mighty ones.

rr: Mukyeene Merozi, nikwo maraika wa MUKAMA arikugira; Mukyeene munonga abatwireyo, Ahakuba tibaizire kuha MUKAMA emikono, Kumuha emikono kurwanisa ab'amaani.
en: Curse ye Meroz, said the angel of the LORD , Curse ye bitterly the inhabitants thereof; Because they came not to the help of the LORD , To the help of the LORD against the mighty.

rr: Yayeli aheebwe omugisha okukira abakazi boona, Muka Heberi Omukeeni aheebwe omugisha okukira abakazi abatuura omu mahema.
en: Blessed above women shall Jael The wife of Heber the Kenite be, Blessed shall she be above women in the tent.

rr: Ashabire amaizi, yaamuha amate; Yaamureetera amate g'amakamo omu nkongooro y'ekitiinisa.
en: He asked water, and she gave him milk; She brought forth butter in a lordly dish.

rr: Yaatayo omukono, yaihayo enkondo, N'omukono gwe ogwa buryo yaihayo enyondo y'abakozi; Yaamuteera enkondo omu mutwe n'enyondo, Yaagimuteera omu kanenero, yaayogamu.
en: She put her hand to the nail, And her right hand to the workmen's hammer; And with the hammer she smote Sisera, she smote off his head, When she had pierced and stricken through his temples.

rr: Sisera yaayefunya, yaagwa; Yaagangarama aha bigyere bye; Ahu yaagwa, niho yaafeera.
en: At her feet he bowed, he fell, he lay down: At her feet he bowed, he fell: Where he bowed, there he fell down dead.

rr: Nyina wa Sisera yaaringuririza omu dirisa, Yaarabya amaisho omu tuhengyere, naagira ati: Ahabw'enki ekigaari kye kyasiibayo munonga?
en: The mother of Sisera looked out at a window, And cried through the lattice, Why is his chariot so long in coming?

rr: N'enki ekizibiire enyamuziga z'ebigaari bye kwija?
en: Why tarry the wheels of his chariots?

rr: Abaranga be b'obwengye baamugarukamu, Eki yaaba naateekateeka, bati
en: Her wise ladies answered her, Yea, she returned answer to herself,

rr: Ebyo tibaabona eminyago? Tibarikugibagana Buri muntu omuzaana omwe nari babiri? Sisera tarikubagana omunyago gw'emyenda y'ebicwererane by'amabara maingi; N'emyenda y'amabara maingi agacwereraine embaju zombi Ey'okukujweka omu bitsya?
en: Have they not sped? have they not divided the prey; To every man a damsel or two; To Sisera a prey of divers colours, A prey of divers colours of needlework, Of divers colours of needlework on both sides, meet for the necks of them that take the spoil?

rr: Ai MUKAMA, abazigu baawe boona bacwekyerere batyo, Kwonka abarikukukunda babe nk'oku eizooba rituruka n'amaani.
en: So let all thine enemies perish, O LORD : But let them that love him be as the sun when he goeth forth in his might.

rr: Okuruga aho ensi yaahuumura okumara emyaka makumi ana.
en: And the land had rest forty years.

rr: Currently Selected: Abaramuzi 5 : RR64 Highlight </pat
Abaisraeli baakora ebirikwangwa MUKAMA; MUKAMA yaabahayo omu mikono y'Abamidiani okumara emyaka mushanju.
en: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD : and the LORD delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years.

rr: Abamidiani baasingura Abaisraeli; ahabw'Abamidiani Abaisraeli baayetimbira amaaya omu nshozi, n'enyanga, kandi baayeyombekyera n'engo z'amabaare.
en: And the hand of Midian prevailed against Israel: and because of the Midianites the children of Israel made them the dens which are in the mountains, and caves, and strong holds.

rr: Ahakuba Abaisraeli ku baabaire babiba, Abamidiani n'Abaamaleki n'abandi bantu b'oburugwa-izooba baija babateera
en: And so it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites came up, and the Amalekites, and the children of the east, even they came up against them;

rr: basiisirayo kubarwanisa, bashiisha emyaka yaabo okuhika Gaaza, kandi bakaba batatsiga k'okurya koona omu nsi ya Israeli, n'obu yaakuba entaama, nari ente nari endogoya.
en: and they encamped against them, and destroyed the increase of the earth, till thou come unto Gaza, and left no sustenance for Israel, neither sheep, nor ox, nor ass.

rr: Ahakuba bakaba baija n'amatungo gaabo n'amahema gaabo, baija baingi nk'enzigye, bo n'engamira zaabo batarikubaasa kubarwa; bataaha omu nsi kugicwekyereza.
en: For they came up with their cattle and their tents, and they came as grasshoppers for multitude; for both they and their camels were without number: and they entered into the land to destroy it.

rr: Abaisraeli baayehwa munonga amatsiko ahabw'Abamidiani; baatakira MUKAMA.
en: And Israel was greatly impoverished because of the Midianites; and the children of Israel cried unto the LORD .

rr: Abaisraeli ku baatakiire MUKAMA ahabw'Abamidiani
en: And it came to pass, when the children of Israel cried unto the LORD because of the Midianites,

rr: MUKAMA yaabatumaho nabi; yaabagira ati: Oku nikwo MUKAMA Ruhanga w'Abaisraeli arikugamba naagira ati: nkabaiha Misri, naabaiha omu nju y'obuhuuku
en: that the LORD sent a prophet unto the children of Israel, which said unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I brought you up from Egypt, and brought you forth out of the house of bondage;

rr: naabaiha omu mikono y'Abamisri n'omu mikono y'abandi boona abaabaire nibabaita kubi, naababinga, baabaruga omu maisho, imwe naabaha ensi yaabo.
en: and I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all that oppressed you, and drave them out from before you, and gave you their land;

rr: Kandi naabagira nti: Niinye MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu, mutaritiina baaruhanga b'Abaamori, abu mutwire omu nsi yaabo; kwonka mwayanga kuhurira eiraka ryangye.
en: and I said unto you, I am the LORD your God; fear not the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but ye have not obeyed my voice.

rr: MUKAMA okutoorana Gideoni kujuna Abaisraeli
en: His Call

rr: Maraika wa MUKAMA yaija, yaashutama ahansi y'omwela ahari Ofura eya Yoashi owa Abiezeeri, kandi omutabani Gideoni akaba naahuura engano omu inyuukiro rya viinyo kugishereka Abamidiani.
en: And there came an angel of the LORD , and sat under an oak which was in Ophrah, that pertained unto Joash the Abi-ezrite: and his son Gideon threshed wheat by the winepress, to hide it from the Midianites.

rr: Maraika wa MUKAMA yaamweyoreka, yaamugira ati: MUKAMA ari hamwe naiwe, iwe omushaija w'amaani emanzi.
en: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him, and said unto him, The LORD is with thee, thou mighty man of valour.

rr: Gideoni yaamugira ati: Mukama wangye, MUKAMA ku araabe ari hamwe naitwe, ahabw'enki ebi byona bitubaireho? Kandi eby'okutangaaza bye byona birahi, ebi baatatenkuriitwe baabaire batugambira, nibagira bati: MUKAMA tiwe yaatwihire omuri Misri? Mbwenu atutsigireho, yaatuhayo omu mikono y'Abamidiani.
en: And Gideon said unto him, Oh my Lord, if the LORD be with us, why then is all this befallen us? and where be all his miracles which our fathers told us of, saying, Did not the LORD bring us up from Egypt? but now the LORD hath forsaken us, and delivered us into the hands of the Midianites.

rr: MUKAMA yaamutaho amaisho, yaamugira ati: Gyenda n'amaani gaawe aga, ojune Abaisraeli omu mikono y'Abamidiani. Tiinye naakutuma?
en: And the LORD looked upon him, and said, Go in this thy might, and thou shalt save Israel from the hand of the Midianites: have not I sent thee?

rr: Onu ati: Mukama wangye, nimbaasa nta kujuna Abaisraeli? Reeba, ab'omuryango gwaitu n'abooro okukira boona ab'omu ruganda rwa Manaase, kandi omu nju ya taata niinye muto.
en: And he said unto him, Oh my Lord, wherewith shall I save Israel? behold, my family is poor in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father's house.

rr: MUKAMA yaamugarukamu ati: Buzimazima ndyaba ndi hamwe naiwe, naiwe oryabinga Abamidiani nk'orikubinga omuntu omwe.
en: And the LORD said unto him, Surely I will be with thee, and thou shalt smite the Midianites as one man.

rr: Onu ati: Ku oraabe wangirira embabazi, nyoreka ak'okureeberaho akarikuhamya ku niiwe orikugamba naanye.
en: And he said unto him, If now I have found grace in thy sight, then shew me a sign that thou talkest with me.

rr: Ninkweshengyereza otaruga aha okuhitsya obu ndaagarukye, nkakureetera omutoijo nkaguta omu maisho gaawe.
en: Depart not hence, I pray thee, until I come unto thee, and bring forth my present, and set it before thee.

rr: Yaamugarukamu ati: Niinyija kuguma aha, okuhitsya ahu oraagarukire.
en: And he said, I will tarry until thou come again.

rr: Atyo Gideoni yaataaha omuka, yaabaaga akaana k'embuzi, yaagira na twakeeki otutatumbisiibwe twa eefa y'esaano; enyama yaagita omu kiibo, n'omucuuzi gwayo yaaguta omu rwabya, yaabimureetera ahansi y'ogwo mwela, yaabimuheereza.
en: And Gideon went in, and made ready a kid, and unleavened cakes of an ephah of flour: the flesh he put in a basket, and he put the broth in a pot, and brought it out unto him under the oak, and presented it .

rr: Maraika wa Ruhanga yaamugira ati: Twara egi nyama, na twakeeki otutatumbisiibwe, obite aha rukiri oru, obishukyeho n'ogwo mucuuzi.
en: And the angel of God said unto him, Take the flesh and the unleavened cakes, and lay them upon this rock, and pour out the broth.

rr: Onu yaakora atyo.
en: And he did so.

rr: Maraika wa MUKAMA yaagorora omukono gwe ogwabaire gukwaitse enkoni, yaakoza eifundo ryayo aha nyama na twakeeki otutatumbisiibwe; ahonaaho omuriro gwaruga omu rukiri, gwayotsya egyo nyama na twakeeki otwo otutatumbisiibwe; bwanyima maraika wa MUKAMA yaabura, Gideoni tiyaagaruka kumureeba.
en: Then the angel of the LORD put forth the end of the staff that was in his hand, and touched the flesh and the unleavened cakes; and there rose up fire out of the rock, and consumed the flesh and the unleavened cakes. Then the angel of the LORD departed out of his sight.

rr: Gideoni ku yaamanyire ku ari maraika wa MUKAMA, yaagira ati: Ntoore hi, Mukama RUHANGA, ahakuba naareebana na maraika wa MUKAMA butunu.
en: And when Gideon perceived that he was an angel of the LORD , Gideon said, Alas, O Lord GOD ! for because I have seen an angel of the LORD face to face.

rr: MUKAMA yaamugarukamu ati: Huumura, otatiina; torikwija kufa.
en: And the LORD said unto him, Peace be unto thee; fear not: thou shalt not die.

rr: Bwanyima Gideoni yaayombekyerayo MUKAMA eitambiro, yaaryeta Yehova-shaloomu. Rikiri Ofura ey'aba Abiezeeri n'okuhitsya hati. Gideoni okusheenya eitambiro rya Baali
en: Then Gideon built an altar there unto the LORD , and called it Jehovah-shalom: unto this day it is yet in Ophrah of the Abi-ezrites.

rr: Ekyo kiro MUKAMA yaamugira ati: Twara enimi ya sho, enimi eya kabiri eine emyaka mushanju, osheenye eitambiro rya Baali eriri owa sho, kandi oteme Ashera eri aha rubaju rwaryo
en: And it came to pass the same night, that the LORD said unto him, Take thy father's young bullock, even the second bullock of seven years old, and throw down the altar of Baal that thy father hath, and cut down the grove that is by it:

rr: bwanyima oyombekyere MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe eitambiro aha mutwe gw'akabungo akeehinguririziibwe orugo rw'amabaare, oryombekye gye; bwanyima otware egyo nimi ya kabiri, ogihongye kuba ekitambo ky'okwotsya, okyokyese enku ezi oraasheenye ahari Ashera.
en: and build an altar unto the LORD thy God upon the top of this rock, in the ordered place, and take the second bullock, and offer a burnt sacrifice with the wood of the grove which thou shalt cut down.

rr: Atyo Gideoni yaatwara abashaija ikumi ab'omu bairu be, yaakora nk'oku MUKAMA yaamuragiira; kwonka ahabw'okutiina ab'omu ka ya ishe, n'abantu ab'omuri orwo rurembo, yaakikora nyekiro, tiyaakikora nyomushana.
en: Then Gideon took ten men of his servants, and did as the LORD had said unto him: and so it was, because he feared his father's household, and the men of the city, that he could not do it by day, that he did it by night.

rr: Ab'omuri orwo rurembo ku baimukire kare omu kasheeshe, baashanga eryo itambiro rya Baali risheenyirwe, na Ashera eyaabaire eri aha rubaju rwaryo etemirwe, n'enimi eya kabiri ehongyeirwe aha itambiro eryombekirwe.
en: And when the men of the city arose early in the morning, behold, the altar of Baal was cast down, and the grove was cut down that was by it, and the second bullock was offered upon the altar that was built.

rr: Baabuuzana bati: Okozire eki n'oha?
en: And they said one to another, Who hath done this thing?

rr: Ku baaherize kubuuririza munonga, baagira bati: Gideoni mwene Yoashi niwe akikozire.
en: And when they enquired and asked, they said, Gideon the son of Joash hath done this thing.

rr: Bwanyima abantu b'omu rurembo baagira Yoashi bati: Shohoza mutabani waawe, afe, ahabw'okuba asheenyire eitambiro rya Baali, kandi yaatema Ashera ebaire eriri haihi.
en: Then the men of the city said unto Joash, Bring out thy son, that he may die: because he hath cast down the altar of Baal, and because he hath cut down the grove that was by it.

rr: Yoashi yaagarukamu boona abaabaire bamubambiire, ati: Nimwenda kurwanirira Baali, nari kumutonganira? Weena orikumurwanirira, naija kwitwa omuri aka kasheeshe. Baali ku araabe ari Ruhanga, murekye ayerwaniririre, ahakuba eitambiro erisheenyirwe n'erye.
en: And Joash said unto all that stood against him, Will ye plead for Baal? will ye save him? he that will plead for him, let him be put to death whilst it is yet morning: if he be a god, let him plead for himself, because one hath cast down his altar.

rr: Nikyo eryo izooba Gideoni yaayeteirwe Yeruba-baali, amakuru ngu, Reka Baali amurwanise, ahakuba asheenyire eitambiro rye. Gideoni okushaba ak'okureeberaho
en: Therefore on that day he called him Jerubbaal, saying, Let Baal plead against him, because he hath thrown down his altar.

rr: Bwanyima Abamidiani boona n'Abaamaleki kandi n'abantu b'oburugwa-izooba baateeranira hamwe, baayambuka, baasiisira omu ruhita rwa Yezereeli.
en: Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites and the children of the east were gathered together, and went over, and pitched in the valley of Jezreel.

rr: -11 ; . Omwoyo wa MUKAMA yaija ahari Gideoni, yaateera enzamba; Aba Abiezeeri baayeteerana, baamukurata.
en: But the Spirit of the LORD came upon Gideon, and he blew a trumpet; and Abi-ezer was gathered after him.

rr: Yaatuma entumwa kuhuruza Abamanaase boona; nabo baayeteerana, baamukurata; kandi yaatuma ezindi ntumwa kuhuruza Abaasheri n'Abazebuluuni n'Abanafutaali; bainamuka kubabugana.
en: And he sent messengers throughout all Manasseh; who also was gathered after him: and he sent messengers unto Asher, and unto Zebulun, and unto Naphtali; and they came up to meet them.

rr: Gideoni yaagambira Ruhanga ati: Ku oraabe noija kujunisa Abaisraeli omukono gwangye, nk'oku ogambire
en: And Gideon said unto God, If thou wilt save Israel by mine hand, as thou hast said,

rr: -7 ; . reeba naaza kuta ebyoya by'entaama omu ihuuriro; ku ndaashangye bitonzirweho orume byonka, haza ahabyehinguririize hoomire, obwo nimmanya ku orikwija kujunisa Abaisraeli omukono gwangye, nk'oku ogambire.
en: Behold, I will put a fleece of wool in the floor; and if the dew be on the fleece only, and it be dry upon all the earth beside , then shall I know that thou wilt save Israel by mine hand, as thou hast said.

rr: Kandi nikwo byabaire bityo; Gideoni ku yaimukire omu kasheeshe, yaakamuura ebyoya, byarugwamu orume rwingi, rwaijura orucuba.
en: And it was so: for he rose up early on the morrow, and thrust the fleece together, and wringed the dew out of the fleece, a bowl full of water.

rr: Gideoni yaagaruka yaagira Ruhanga ati: Otangirira ekiniga, ondekye ngarukye ngambe rimwe kwonka, ndekyere aho. Ninkweshengyereza, reka nteereho ogundi murundi n'ebyoya; mbwenu ebyoya ka bibe nibyo byaguma byomire, haza eitaka ryona ribe niryo ryagiibwaho orume.
en: And Gideon said unto God, Let not thine anger be hot against me, and I will speak but this once: let me prove, I pray thee, but this once with the fleece; let it now be dry only upon the fleece, and upon all the ground let there be dew.

rr: Ruhanga yaakora atyo ekyo kiro; ebyoya byonka byaguma byomire, orume rwaza aha itaka ryona.
en: And God did so that night: for it was dry upon the fleece only, and there was dew on all the ground.

rr: Bwanyima Yeruba-baali niwe Gideoni, n'abantu boona abu yaabaire aine, baimuka kare omu kasheeshe, baasiisira aha rubaju rw'eiziba rya Harodi; kandi orusiisira rw'Abamidiani rukaba ruri aha bukiizi bwabo obwa-bumosho, omu ruhanga haihi n'ekibungo kya Moore.
en: Then Jerubbaal, who is Gideon, and all the people that were with him, rose up early, and pitched beside the well of Harod: so that the host of the Midianites were on the north side of them, by the hill of Moreh, in the valley.

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Gideoni ati: Abantu abu oine bahinguraine obwingi; n'ahabw'ekyo tindikwija kuhayo Abamidiani omu mikono yaabo, Abaisraeli batakaanyehimbisaho nibagira bati: Emikono yaitu niyo etujunire.
en: And the LORD said unto Gideon, The people that are with thee are too many for me to give the Midianites into their hands, lest Israel vaunt themselves against me, saying, Mine own hand hath saved me.

rr: Mbwenu nu gyenda ogambire abantu oti: Orikutiina weena, kandi orikutetema, agarukye omuka.
en: Now therefore go to, proclaim in the ears of the people, saying, Whosoever is fearful and afraid, let him return and depart early from mount Gilead.

rr: Haagarukayo abantu obukumi bubiri n'enkumi ibiri; haatsigara kakumi.
en: And there returned of the people twenty and two thousand; and there remained ten thousand.

rr: MUKAMA yaagaruka yaagambira Gideoni ati: Abantu bakihinguraine; bashuumye aha mugyera, mbakugyererezeho; kandi ou ndaakugire nti, Ogu agyende naiwe, agyende naiwe; na weena ou ndaakugire nti, Atagyenda naiwe, atagyenda naiwe.
en: And the LORD said unto Gideon, The people are yet too many; bring them down unto the water, and I will try them for thee there: and it shall be, that of whom I say unto thee, This shall go with thee, the same shall go with thee; and of whomsoever I say unto thee, This shall not go with thee, the same shall not go.

rr: Atyo yaashuumya abo bashaija aha maizi; MUKAMA yaagira Gideoni ati: Omuntu weena oraanywaise amaizi orurimi nk'embwa, omwegyekye hangahari; kandi weena oraatsimbe amaju kunywa, omute ahakwe.
en: So he brought down the people unto the water: and the LORD said unto Gideon, Every one that lappeth of the water with his tongue, as a dog lappeth, him shalt thou set by himself; likewise every one that boweth down upon his knees to drink.

rr: Abaatahiise amaizi engaro, bakaganywaisa orurimi, baaba magana ashatu; kwonka abandi boona baanywa batsimbire amaju.
en: And the number of them that lapped, putting their hand to their mouth, were three hundred men: but all the rest of the people bowed down upon their knees to drink water.

rr: Kandi MUKAMA yaagambira Gideoni ati: Abashaija magana ashatu abaanywaisa amaizi orurimi nibo ndaabajunise, nkahayo Abamidiani omu mikono yaawe; reka abandi boona bagarukyeyo, buri muntu omu ka ye.
en: And the LORD said unto Gideon, By the three hundred men that lapped will I save you, and deliver the Midianites into thine hand: and let all the other people go every man unto his place.

rr: Atyo Gideoni yaayaka abo bantu entanda zaabo n'enzamba zaabo; bwanyima yaaboohereza boona, buri muntu omu ihema rye, kwonka yaaguma n'abo magana ashatu; kandi orusiisira rw'Abamidiani rukaba ruri ahaifo ye omu ruhita.
en: So the people took victuals in their hand, and their trumpets: and he sent all the rest of Israel every man unto his tent, and retained those three hundred men: and the host of Midian was beneath him in the valley.

rr: Ekyo kiro MUKAMA yaamugira ati: Imuka oshuume, oteere orusiisira, ahakuba nduhaireyo omu mikono yaawe.
en: And it came to pass the same night, that the LORD said unto him, Arise, get thee down unto the host; for I have delivered it into thine hand.

rr: Kwonka ku oraabe nootiina kushuumayo, gyenda n'omugaragwa waawe Puuri omuri orwo rusiisira
en: But if thou fear to go down, go thou with Phurah thy servant down to the host:

rr: noija kuhurira ebi barikugamba; bwanyima emikono yaawe neija kugira amaani g'okuruteera.
en: and thou shalt hear what they say; and afterward shall thine hands be strengthened to go down unto the host.

rr: Atyo yaashuuma n'omugaragwa we Puura, yaahika aha ngabo ezirikubandizibwaho ezaabaire ziiine eby'okurwanisa nizirinda orusiisira.
en: Then went he down with Phurah his servant unto the outside of the armed men that were in the host.

rr: Abamidiani n'Abaamaleki n'abantu boona ab'oburugwa-izooba bakaba bateekire enteeko omu ruhita, bari baingi nk'enzigye, n'engamira zaabo zikaba zitarikubaasa kubarwa, ziri nk'omusheenyi gw'aha rubaju rw'enyanja.
en: And the Midianites and the Amalekites and all the children of the east lay along in the valley like grasshoppers for multitude; and their camels were without number, as the sand by the sea side for multitude.

rr: Gideoni ku yaahikireyo, yaahurira omuntu omwe omuribo naarootororera mugyenzi we ekirooto, naagira ati: Reeba ndootsire ekirooto, ngu omugaati gwa sayiri gugwire omu rusiisira rw'Abamidiani, gwateera eihema, eryo ihema ryakumbagara, ryagwa rigarami.
en: And when Gideon was come, behold, there was a man that told a dream unto his fellow, and said, Behold, I dreamed a dream, and, lo, a cake of barley bread tumbled into the host of Midian, and came unto a tent, and smote it that it fell, and overturned it, that the tent lay along.

rr: Mugyenzi we yaamugarukamu ati: Ekyo ti kindi; ni rurara ya Gideoni mwene Yoashi, omushaija w'omu Baisraeli; Ruhanga ahaireyo Abamidiani n'eihe ryona omu mikono ye.
en: And his fellow answered and said, This is nothing else save the sword of Gideon the son of Joash, a man of Israel: for into his hand hath God delivered Midian, and all the host.

rr: Gideoni ku yaahuriire ekyo kirooto n'oku baakishoboorora, yaaramya Ruhanga, yaagaruka omu rusiisira rw'Abaisraeli, yaagira ati: Mwimukye, ahabw'okuba MUKAMA ahaireyo eihe rya Midiani omu mikono yaanyu.
en: And it was so , when Gideon heard the telling of the dream, and the interpretation thereof, that he worshipped, and returned into the host of Israel, and said, Arise; for the LORD hath delivered into your hand the host of Midian.

rr: Yaabaganisa abo bashaija magana ashatu omu mitwe eshatu, boona yaabakwatsa enzamba n'enyungu zirimu busha, n'emuri omuri ezo nyungu.
en: And he divided the three hundred men into three companies, and he put a trumpet in every man's hand, with empty pitchers, and lamps within the pitchers.

rr: Yaabagira ati: Mundeebereho; oku ndaagire, mube nikwo mwagira. Ku ndaahikye ahu orusiisira rurikutandikira, mukore eki ndaakore.
en: And he said unto them, Look on me, and do likewise: and, behold, when I come to the outside of the camp, it shall be that , as I do, so shall ye do.

rr: Ku ndaateere enzamba, n'abandi boona abari hamwe naanye, naimwe muteerere enzamba aha mbaju zoona ez'orusiisira rwona, nimugira muti: Ahabwa MUKAMA n'ahabwa Gideoni. Okubingwa kw'Abamidiani
en: When I blow with a trumpet, I and all that are with me, then blow ye the trumpets also on every side of all the camp, and say, The sword of the LORD , and of Gideon.

rr: Atyo Gideoni n'abashaija igana abu yaabaire aine baahika ahu orusiisira rurikutandikira, abantu baahirwayo, ahu abarinzi ba kabiri batandikira; baateera enzamba, baayata enyungu ezi baabaire baine omu ngaro.
en: So Gideon, and the hundred men that were with him, came unto the outside of the camp in the beginning of the middle watch; and they had but newly set the watch: and they blew the trumpets, and brake the pitchers that were in their hands.

rr: Egyo mitwe eshatu y'engabo baateerera hamwe enzamba, baayata enyungu, bakwaitse emuri omu ngaro zaabo za bumosho, n'enzamba z'okuteera ziri omu za buryo; baateera orwari nibagira bati: Rurara ya MUKAMA n'eya Gideoni.
en: And the three companies blew the trumpets, and brake the pitchers, and held the lamps in their left hands, and the trumpets in their right hands to blow withal: and they cried, The sword of the LORD , and of Gideon.

rr: Buri muntu yaayemerera omu mwanya gwe, beehinguriririize orusiisira; engabo zoona ez'Abamidiani zairuka niziyogoorekana, zaahunga.
en: And they stood every man in his place round about the camp: and all the host ran, and cried, and fled.

rr: Abantu abo magana ashatu baagumizamu nibateera enzamba, MUKAMA yaitanisa Abamidiani na rurara, buri muntu yaita mugyenzi we, eihe ryona ryaitana, ryahunga, ryahika Besi-shiita ehereraine na Zerera, baahika aha mwatano gwa Abeli-mehola haihi na Tabasi.
en: And the three hundred blew the trumpets, and the LORD set every man's sword against his fellow, even throughout all the host: and the host fled to Beth-shittah in Zererath, and to the border of Abel-meholah, unto Tabbath.

rr: Abashaija ba Israeli baahurura nibaruga Nafutaali na Ashera na Manaase yoona, baakurata Abamidiani.
en: And the men of Israel gathered themselves together out of Naphtali, and out of Asher, and out of all Manasseh, and pursued after the Midianites.

rr: Gideoni yaatuma entumwa omu nsi yoona ey'ebibungo eya Efuraimu, naagira ati: Mushuume, murwanise Abamidiani, mubatangire aha maizi okuhika Besi-baara, n'aha mugyera Yorudani.
en: And Gideon sent messengers throughout all mount Ephraim, saying, Come down against the Midianites, and take before them the waters unto Beth-barah and Jordan.

rr: Batyo abashaija boona aba Efuraimu baahurura, baakwata amaizi goona okuhika Besi-baara, n'omugyera Yorudani.
en: Then all the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together, and took the waters unto Beth-barah and Jordan.

rr: Kandi baakwata abanyiginya babiri ba Midiani, Orebu na Zeebu; Orebu baamwitira aha rukiri rwa Orebu, na Zeebu baamwitira aha inyuukiro rya Zeebu; baagumizamu baakurata Abamidiani; kandi baareetera Gideoni omutwe gwa Orebu n'ogwa Zeebu seeri ya Yorudani.
en: And they took two princes of the Midianites, Oreb and Zeeb; and they slew Oreb upon the rock Oreb, and Zeeb they slew at the winepress of Zeeb, and pursued Midian, and brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon on the other side Jordan.

rr: Currently Selected: Abaramuzi 7 : RR64 Highlight Share <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 2
Abashaija ba Efuraimu baamubuuza bati: Otutuzire ki okutatuhuruza, nooza kurwana n'Abamidiani?
en: And the men of Ephraim said unto him, Why hast thou served us thus, that thou calledst us not, when thou wentest to fight with the Midianites?

rr: Baamutonganisa munonga.
en: And they did chide with him sharply.

rr: Nawe yaabagarukamu ati: Nkozire ki ekirikwingana n'ebi mukozire?
en: And he said unto them, What have I done now in comparison of you?

rr: Emizaabibu y'empumbano eya Efuraimu terikuhita icwa ryona ery'emizaabibu ya Abiezeeri?
en: Is not the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abi-ezer?

rr: Ruhanga ahaireyo abanyiginya ba Midiani Orebu na Zeebu omu mikono yaanyu. Mbwenu shi nyowe eki nkozire ekirikukira ebi mukozire niki? Ku yaabagambiire ekyo, ekiniga kyabo kyaikaikana.
en: God hath delivered into your hands the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb: and what was I able to do in comparison of you? Then their anger was abated toward him, when he had said that.

rr: Gideoni yaija yaayambuka Yorudani n'abo bantu magana ashatu, abu yaabaire aine, bagwire enshazi kwonka babakuratiire.
en: And Gideon came to Jordan, and passed over, he, and the three hundred men that were with him, faint, yet pursuing them .

rr: Yaagira abantu ba Sukoosi ati: Naabeeshengyereza mumpeere aba bantu bankuratiire emigaati, ahakuba baagwa enshazi, kandi nkibingire Zeeba na Zalumuuna, abagabe ba Midiani.
en: And he said unto the men of Succoth, Give, I pray you, loaves of bread unto the people that follow me; for they be faint, and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna, kings of Midian.

rr: Abategyeki ba Sukoosi baagira bati: Zeeba na Zalumuuna waabakwatsire, tukabona kuheereza engabo zaawe ebyokurya?
en: And the princes of Succoth said, Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand, that we should give bread unto thine army?

rr: Gideoni yaagira ati: MUKAMA ku araaheyo Zeeba na Zalumuuna omu mikono yangye, emibiri yaanyu niinyija kugitaaguza amahwa g'omu ihamba n'ag'emikwata-ngwe.
en: And Gideon said, Therefore when the LORD hath delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into mine hand, then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers.

rr: Yaarugayo, yaaza Penueli, nabo yaabagambira ebigambo nk'ebyo; kandi aba Penueli bamugarukamu nk'eby'aba Sukoosi.
en: And he went up thence to Penuel, and spake unto them likewise: and the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered him .

rr: Yaagambira aba Penueli ati: Ku ndaabe naagarukire n'obusingye, niinyija kusheenya ogu munaara.
en: And he spake also unto the men of Penuel, saying, When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower.

rr: Obwo Zeeba na Zalumuuna bakaba bari Karikoori n'engabo zaabo akakumi kamwe n'enkumi itaano, abaahonokire aha ngabo zoona ez'eihe ry'ab'oburugwa-izooba; ahabw'okuba hakafa abantu akasiriira kamwe n'obukumi bubiri, enkwata-rurara.
en: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor, and their hosts with them, about fifteen thousand men , all that were left of all the hosts of the children of the east: for there fell an hundred and twenty thousand men that drew sword.

rr: Gideoni yainamuka, yaatoora omuhanda ogurikuraba omu bantu abaabaire batuura omu mahema aha rubaju rw'oburugwa-izooba bwa Nooba na Yogibeha, yaasingura eryo ihe; ahakuba rikaba ryehugiireho.
en: And Gideon went up by the way of them that dwelt in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and smote the host: for the host was secure.

rr: Zeeba na Zalumuuna abagabe bombi ba Midiani baahunga, yaababinga, yaabakwata, kandi engabo zaabo zoona yaazihahaaza emitima, zaataataana.

en: And Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem unto his mother's brethren, and communed with them, and with all the family of the house of his mother's father, saying,

en: And Abimelech fought against the city all that day; and he took the city, and slew the people that was therein, and beat down the city, and sowed it with salt.

en: And Abimelech gat him up to mount Zalmon, he and all the people that were with him; and Abimelech took an axe in his hand, and cut down a bough from the trees, and took it, and laid it on his shoulder, and said unto the people that were with him, What ye have seen me do, make haste, and do as I have done .

en: And all the people likewise cut down every man his bough, and followed Abimelech, and put them to the hold, and set the hold on fire upon them; so that all the men of the tower of Shechem died also, about a thousand men and women.

rr: Bwanyima Abimeleki yaaza Tebeza, yaagiteeraho orusiisira kugirwanisa, yaagikwata.
en: Then went Abimelech to Thebez, and encamped against Thebez, and took it.

rr: Kwonka omuri orwo rurembo hakaba harimu omunaara gugumire; abantu boona ab'omu rurembo, abashaija n'abakazi baaguhungiramu, baayekingirana, baatemba aha mutwe gwagwo.
en: But there was a strong tower within the city, and thither fled all the men and women, and all they of the city, and shut it to them, and gat them up to the top of the tower.

rr: Abimeleki yaahika aha munaara, yaaguteera, yairira haihi n'orwigi rwagwo kurwotsya n'omuriro.
en: And Abimelech came unto the tower, and fought against it, and went hard unto the door of the tower to burn it with fire.

rr: Omukazi yaarekyera eseiso, yaagiteera Abimeleki omutwe, yaagwata.
en: And a certain woman cast a piece of a millstone upon Abimelech's head, and all to brake his skull.

rr: Ahonaaho Abimeleki yaayeta omutsigazi owaabaire amutwarira eby'okurwanisa, yaamugira ati: Ihayo rurara yaawe, onyite, abantu batakaagira ngu yaitwa omukazi.
en: Then he called hastily unto the young man his armourbearer, and said unto him, Draw thy sword, and slay me, that men say not of me, A woman slew him.

rr: Ogwo mutsigazi we yaamutimbura, yaafa.
en: And his young man thrust him through, and he died.

rr: Abaisraeli ku baareebire Abimeleki yaafa, baarugayo, buri muntu yaataaha omu ka ye.
en: And when the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, they departed every man unto his place.

rr: Okwo nikwo Ruhanga yaahoire Abimeleki enzigu ahabw'ekibi eki yaakoreire ishe, obu yaita beene ishe makumi mushanju
en: Thus God rendered the wickedness of Abimelech, which he did unto his father, in slaying his seventy brethren:

rr: kandi ebibi byona ebi aba Shekemu baakozire Ruhanga yaabibazimuurira; baagiibwaho omukyeeno gwa Yosamu mwene Yeruba-baali.
en: and all the evil of the men of Shechem did God render upon their heads: and upon them came the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal.

rr: Bwanyima ya Abimeleki Toola mwene Pua, mwijukuru wa Dodo ow'omu ruganda rwa Isakaari yaimuka kujuna Israeli; akaba atuura Shamiri omu nsi y'ebibungo eya Efuraimu.
en: And after Abimelech there arose to defend Israel Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar; and he dwelt in Shamir in mount Ephraim.

rr: Yaamara emyaka makumi abiri n'eshatu naacwera Abaisraeli emanja; bwanyima yaafa, yaaziikwa omuri Shamiri.
en: And he judged Israel twenty and three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.

rr: Bwanyima ye haimuka Yairi Omugileadi, nawe yaamara emyaka makumi abiri ne'biri naacwera Abaisraeli emanja.
en: And after him arose Jair, a Gileadite, and judged Israel twenty and two years.

rr: Akaba aine abatabani makumi ashatu, abaabaire bagyendera aha ndogoya nto makumi ashatu, kandi baine endembo makumi ashatu omu nsi ya Gileadi ezaabaaire nizeetwa Havosi-yairi n'okuhitsya hati.
en: And he had thirty sons that rode on thirty ass colts, and they had thirty cities, which are called Havoth-jair unto this day, which are in the land of Gilead.

rr: Yairi yaafa, yaaziikwa Kamoni. Abaisraeli okwimuura Ruhanga n'okwitwa kubi Abaamoni
en: And Jair died, and was buried in Camon. Serving other Gods

rr: Abaisraeli baagaruka baakora ebirikwangwa MUKAMA, baaheereza Baabaali n'Ashitaroosi, na baaruhanga ba Siria, na Sidoni, na Moabu n'Abaamoni n'Abafilistia, baimuura MUKAMA, tibaamuheereza.
en: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD , and served Baalim, and Ashtaroth, and the gods of Syria, and the gods of Zidon, and the gods of Moab, and the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines, and forsook the LORD , and served not him.

rr: MUKAMA yaagirira Israeli ekiniga kingi, yaabahayo omu mikono y'Abafilistia n'ey'Abaamoni.
en: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he sold them into the hands of the Philistines, and into the hands of the children of Ammon.

rr: Omu mwaka ogwo baaburabuza Abaisraeli, baabaita kubi; baamara emyaka ikumi na munaana nibaita kubi Abaisraeli boona abaabaire batwire seeri ya Yorudani omu nsi y'Abaamori ey'omuri Gileadi.
en: And that year they vexed and oppressed the children of Israel: eighteen years, all the children of Israel that were on the other side Jordan in the land of the Amorites, which is in Gilead.

rr: Kandi Abaamoni baayambuka Yorudani kurwanisa Abayuda n'Ababenyamiini n'ab'oruganda rwa Efuraimu; n'ahabw'ekyo Abaisraeli baatuntuzibwa munonga.
en: Moreover the children of Ammon passed over Jordan to fight also against Judah, and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim; so that Israel was sore distressed.

rr: Abaisraeli baatakira MUKAMA, nibagira bati: Tukucumwireho, ahakuba tukaimuura Ruhanga waitu, twaheereza Baabaali.
en: And the children of Israel cried unto the LORD , saying, We have sinned against thee, both because we have forsaken our God, and also served Baalim.

rr: MUKAMA yaagarukamu Abaisraeli ati; Tindabajunire Abanyamisri n'Abaamori n'Abaamoni kandi n'Abafilistia?
en: And the LORD said unto the children of Israel, Did not I deliver you from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines?

rr: Kandi n'aba Sidoni n'Abaamaleki n'aba Maoni bakabaita kubi, mwantakira, naabaiha omu mikono yaabo.
en: The Zidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, did oppress you; and ye cried to me, and I delivered you out of their hand.

rr: Kwonka mwanyimuura, mwaheereza baaruhanga abandi; n'ahabw'ekyo tindigaruka kubajuna.
en: Yet ye have forsaken me, and served other gods: wherefore I will deliver you no more.

rr: Mugyende mutakire baaruhanga abu mwayetooraniire; babe nibo baabajuna omu biro by'okutuntuzibwa kwanyu.
en: Go and cry unto the gods which ye have chosen; let them deliver you in the time of your tribulation.

rr: Abaisraeli baagarukamu MUKAMA bati: N'ekya buzima tukashiisha; mbwenu otukore kyona eki orikwenda; kwonka nitukweshengyereza otujune eri izooba.
en: And the children of Israel said unto the LORD , We have sinned: do thou unto us whatsoever seemeth good unto thee; deliver us only, we pray thee, this day.

rr: Baiha baaruhanga b'abanyamahanga omuribo, baaheereza MUKAMA; omutima gwe gwashaasha munonga ahabw'obusaasi bw'Abaisraeli.
en: And they put away the strange gods from among them, and served the LORD : and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel. The Ammonites

rr: Bwanyima Abaamoni baayeteerana, bateera orusiisira omuri Gileadi; n'Abaisraeli nabo baayeteerana, baateera orusiisira omuri Mizipa.
en: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together, and encamped in Gilead. And the children of Israel assembled themselves together, and encamped in Mizpeh.

rr: Kandi abantu bakuru ba Gileadi, baagambirana bati: N'oha oraabanze kurwana n'Abaamoni? Ogwo niwe araabe mukuru w'abatwire omuri Gileadi boona. Currently Selected: Abaramuzi 10 : RR64 Highlight Share <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8 19c-2.828 0-4.243
en: And the people and princes of Gilead said one to another, What man is he that will begin to fight against the children of Ammon? he shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead. rr: Yefusa Omugileadi akaba ari emanzi rugambwa, kwonka akaba ari omwana wa maraaya; Gileadi niwe yaamumuzaireho.
en: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valour, and he was the son of an harlot: and Gilead begat Jephthah.

rr: Kandi muka Gileadi akaba amuzaariire abaana b'aboojo. Batabani b'omukazi we abo ku baakuzire, baabinga Yefusa, baamugira bati: Torigira buhunguzi mu ka ya tataitwe, ahabw'okuba ori omwana w'ondiijo mukazi.
en: And Gilead's wife bare him sons; and his wife's sons grew up, and they thrust out Jephthah, and said unto him, Thou shalt not inherit in our father's house; for thou art the son of a strange woman.

rr: Yefusa nikwo kuhunga beene ishe, akatuura omu nsi ya Toobu; abantu abaabaire bataine mugasho baaguma nibateeranira ahari Yefusa, nibahurura nawe.
en: Then Jephthah fled from his brethren, and dwelt in the land of Tob: and there were gathered vain men to Jephthah, and went out with him.

rr: Ku haahingwireho ebiro, Abaamoni baateera Abaisraeli.
en: And it came to pass in process of time, that the children of Ammon made war against Israel.

rr: Abaamoni ku baabateire, abakuru ba Gileadi baaza kuhuruza Yefusa omu nsi ya Toobu
en: And it was so, that when the children of Ammon made war against Israel, the elders of Gilead went to fetch Jephthah out of the land of Tob:

rr: baamugira bati: Ija obe omukuru w'eihe ryaitu, tubone kurwanisa Abaamoni.
en: and they said unto Jephthah, Come, and be our captain, that we may fight with the children of Ammon.

rr: Kwonka Yefusa yaabagarukamu ati: Tiimwe mwanyangire, mukambinga omu ka ya taata? Ahabw'enki mwaija kunsherura, obu muri omu busaasi?
en: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, Did not ye hate me, and expel me out of my father's house? and why are ye come unto me now when ye are in distress?

rr: Abakuru ba Gileadi baamugarukamu bati: Ekyatureetera kukugarukira, nitwenda ngu ogyende naitwe, turwanise Abaamoni, kandi obe omukuru w'abatwire omuri Gileadi boona.
en: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, Therefore we turn again to thee now, that thou mayest go with us, and fight against the children of Ammon, and be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.

rr: Yefusa yaabuuza abakuru ba Gileadi ati: Ku murangarure owaitu kurwanisa Abaamoni, MUKAMA yaabahayo omu mikono yangye, n'ekya buzima ndyaba omukuru waanyu?
en: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, If ye bring me home again to fight against the children of Ammon, and the LORD deliver them before me, shall I be your head?

rr: Abakuru ba Gileadi baamugarukamu bati: MUKAMA niwe ariba mushinja ahagati yaitu; buzimazima turyakora nk'oku waagamba.
en: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, The LORD be witness between us, if we do not so according to thy words.

rr: Atyo Yefusa yaagyenda n'abakuru ba Gileadi, abantu baamuhindura omukuru waabo w'okubeebembera. Yefusa yaagambira ebigambo bye byona omu maisho ga MUKAMA omuri Mizipa. Entumwa za Yefusa okubuuza Abaamoni ekirikwenda kubarwanisa nabo
en: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and captain over them: and Jephthah uttered all his words before the LORD in Mizpeh.

rr: Yefusa yaatuma entumwa aha mugabe w'Abaamoni, naamubuuza ati: Nontura ki okwija kuteera ensi yangye?
en: And Jephthah sent messengers unto the king of the children of Ammon, saying, What hast thou to do with me, that thou art come against me to fight in my land?

rr: Omugabe w'Abaamoni yaagarukamu entumwa za Yefusa ati: Ahakuba Abaisraeli ku baabaire nibaruga Misri, baanyaga ensi yangye okuruga Arunooni okuhika Yaboki na Yorudani; mbwenu gigarure n'obusingye.
en: And the king of the children of Ammon answered unto the messengers of Jephthah, Because Israel took away my land, when they came up out of Egypt, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and unto Jordan: now therefore restore those lands again peaceably.

rr: Yefusa yaagaruka yaatuma entumwa aha mugabe w'Abaamoni
en: And Jephthah sent messengers again unto the king of the children of Ammon:

rr: yaamugira ati: Oku nikwo Yefusa arikugira ati: Israeli taranyagire nsi ya Moabu n'obu yaakuba ey'Abaamoni
en: and said unto him, Thus saith Jephthah, Israel took not away the land of Moab, nor the land of the children of Ammon:

rr: kureka Abaisraeli bakaruga Misri, baaraba omu ihamba okuhika aha Nyanja erikutukura; bwanyima baahika Kadeshi.
en: but when Israel came up from Egypt, and walked through the wilderness unto the Red sea, and came to Kadesh;

rr: Okuruga aho Israeli yaatuma entumwa aha mugabe wa Edomu, naagira ati: Twakweshengyereza, reka turabe omu nsi yaawe; omugabe wa Edomu tiyaikiriza. Kandi yaatuma atyo aha mugabe wa Moabu; kwonka nawe tiyaikiriza. Israeli nikwo kuguma Kadeshi.
en: then Israel sent messengers unto the king of Edom, saying, Let me, I pray thee, pass through thy land: but the king of Edom would not hearken thereto . And in like manner they sent unto the king of Moab: but he would not consent: and Israel abode in Kadesh.

rr: Bwanyima baaraba omu ihamba, baayekiikuura ensi ya Edomu n'eya Moabu, baaraba aha rubaju rw'oburugwa-izooba rw'ensi ya Moabu, baateera amahema seeri ya Arunooni; kwonka tibaarenga mwatano gwa Moabu, ahakuba omwatano gwayo ni Arunooni.
en: Then they went along through the wilderness, and compassed the land of Edom, and the land of Moab, and came by the east side of the land of Moab, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, but came not within the border of Moab: for Arnon was the border of Moab.

rr: Bwanyima Israeli yaatuma entumwa ahari Sihooni omugabe w'Abaamori, omugabe wa Heshibooni, naamugira ati: Twakweshengyereza, reka turabe omu nsi yaawe, tuze owaitu.
en: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, the king of Heshbon; and Israel said unto him, Let us pass, we pray thee, through thy land into my place.

rr: Kwonka Sihooni tiyaayesiga Baisraeli kurenga omwatano gwe, kureka yaateerana abantu be boona, yaateera orusiisira Yahazi, yaarwanisa Abaisraeli.
en: But Sihon trusted not Israel to pass through his coast: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and pitched in Jahaz, and fought against Israel.

rr: MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli yaahayo Sihooni n'abantu be boona omu mikono y'Abaisraeli, baabasingura. Batyo Abaisraeli baakubuura ensi yoona ey'Abaamori abaabaire batwiremu.
en: And the LORD God of Israel delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel, and they smote them: so Israel possessed all the land of the Amorites, the inhabitants of that country.

rr: Baakubuura ensi yoona ey'Abaamori okuruga Arunooni okuhika Yaboki, kandi okuruga aha ihamba n'okuhika Yorudani.
en: And they possessed all the coasts of the Amorites, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and from the wilderness even unto Jordan.

rr: Atyo MUKAMA Ruhanga w'Abaisraeli yaabinga Abaamori omu maisho g'abantu be Abaisraeli. Mbwenu niimwe mwakushemereire kugikubuura?
en: So now the LORD God of Israel hath dispossessed the Amorites from before his people Israel, and shouldest thou possess it?

rr: Torikubuura ensi ei Kemoshi ruhanga waawe arikuha?
en: Wilt not thou possess that which Chemosh thy god giveth thee to possess?

rr: Naitwe abantu boona abu MUKAMA Ruhanga waitu yaabingire omu maisho gaitu, nibo turaakubuure ensi yaabo.
en: So whomsoever the LORD our God shall drive out from before us, them will we possess.

rr: Oine eki orikukiza Balaki mwene Zipori omugabe wa Moabu? Akaba arahakaniiseho Abaisraeli, nari akaba arabarwaniiseho?
en: And now art thou any thing better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? did he ever strive against Israel, or did he ever fight against them,

rr: Abaisraeli ka baamazire emyaka magana ashatu, batwire omuri Heshibooni n'omuri tauni zaayo, n'omuri Aroeri na tauni zaayo, n'omu ndembo zoona eziri aha mbaju za Arunooni! Ahabw'enki omuri egyo myaka yoona ezo ndembo timurazigarukaine?
en: while Israel dwelt in Heshbon and her towns, and in Aroer and her towns, and in all the cities that be along by the coasts of Arnon, three hundred years? why therefore did ye not recover them within that time?

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo tiinye nkukozire kubi, kureka niiwe onkozire kubi kundwanisa. MUKAMA Omucwi w'emanja abe niwe yaaramura Abaisraeli n'Abaamoni eri izooba.
en: Wherefore I have not sinned against thee, but thou doest me wrong to war against me: the LORD the Judge be judge this day between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon.

rr: Kwonka omugabe w'Abaamoni tiyaata mutima ha bigambo ebi Yefusa yaamutumireho.
en: Howbeit the king of the children of Ammon hearkened not unto the words of Jephthah which he sent him.

rr: Okuhiga kwa Yefusa n'okusingura Abaamoni
en: His Vow and Victory

rr: Omwoyo wa MUKAMA yaija ahari Yefusa; Yefusa yaaraba omuri Gileadi na Manaase, yaahika Mizipa eya Gileadi; yaarugayo yaahika omu Baamoni.
en: Then the Spirit of the LORD came upon Jephthah, and he passed over Gilead, and Manasseh, and passed over Mizpeh of Gilead, and from Mizpeh of Gilead he passed over unto the children of Ammon.

rr: Yefusa yaahiga ahari MUKAMA naagira ati: Buzimazima ku oraaheyo Abaamoni omu mikono yangye
en: And Jephthah vowed a vow unto the LORD , and said, If thou shalt without fail deliver the children of Ammon into mine hands,

rr: ku nditabaaruka gye ninduga kurwanisa Abaamoni, ekiribanza kushohora omu muryango gw'enju yangye kumbugana, kiryaba ekya MUKAMA, kandi ndyakihonga, kibe ekitambo ky'okwotsya.
en: then it shall be, that whatsoever cometh forth of the doors of my house to meet me, when I return in peace from the children of Ammon, shall surely be the LORD 's, and I will offer it up for a burnt offering.

rr: Atyo Yefusa yaayambuka aha Baamoni kubarwanisa; MUKAMA yaabahayo omu mikono ye.
en: So Jephthah passed over unto the children of Ammon to fight against them; and the LORD delivered them into his hands.

rr: Yaabateera okuruga Aroeri okuhika Miniisi, yaabaitamu abantu baingi munonga, yaakwata endembo makumi abiri okuhika ahari Abeeli-keramimu. Okwo nikwo Abaamoni baasingwirwe Abaisraeli. Yefusa okubugana muhara we n'okumuhayo
en: And he smote them from Aroer, even till thou come to Minnith, even twenty cities, and unto the plain of the vineyards, with a very great slaughter. Thus the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel.

rr: Yefusa yaatabaaruka, yaagaruka omu ka ye Mizipa; reeba, muhara we yaashohora kumubugana, naateera ebitaasa naazina; niwe yaabaire ari omwana we nyamunegyere; akaba ataine mwanda ondiijo weena, yaaba w'omwojo nari w'omwishiki, okwihaho ogwo.
en: And Jephthah came to Mizpeh unto his house, and, behold, his daughter came out to meet him with timbrels and with dances: and she was his only child; beside her he had neither son nor daughter.

rr: -38 ; 2 Yefusa ku yaamureebire, yaataagura ebijwaro bye, yaagira ati: Ai bambe, mwana wangye! ka wangwisiza akagwe, okandeetera amaganya maingi; ahakuba nkaashamya akanwa kangye ahari MUKAMA; tinkibaasa kukireka.
en: And it came to pass, when he saw her, that he rent his clothes, and said, Alas, my daughter! thou hast brought me very low, and thou art one of them that trouble me: for I have opened my mouth unto the LORD , and I cannot go back.

rr: Muhara we yaamugarukamu ati: Taata, ku oraabe waayashamize akanwa kaawe ahari MUKAMA, ongire nk'ekyarugire omu kanwa kaawe oku kiri, nk'oku MUKAMA akuhooreire Abaamoni abazigu baawe.
en: And she said unto him, My father, if thou hast opened thy mouth unto the LORD , do to me according to that which hath proceeded out of thy mouth; forasmuch as the LORD hath taken vengeance for thee of thine enemies, even of the children of Ammon.

rr: Yaagaruka yaagira ishe ati: Ninkushaba onyikirize eki; ondekye ameezi abiri, nze omu bibungo, ngyendagyende na bagyenzi bangye, ncurire obuhangare bwangye.
en: And she said unto her father, Let this thing be done for me: let me alone two months, that I may go up and down upon the mountains, and bewail my virginity, I and my fellows.

rr: Yaamugira ati: Irooko.
en: And he said, Go.

rr: Yaamwohereza okumara ameezi abiri; yaagyenda na bagyenzi be, yaacurira obuhangare bwe omu bibungo.
en: And he sent her away for two months: and she went with her companions, and bewailed her virginity upon the mountains.

rr: Ameezi abiri ku gaahweire, yaagaruka ahari ishe, yaamugira nk'oku yaaraganiise; kandi omwishiki ogwo akaba atakamanyaga mushaija.
en: And it came to pass at the end of two months, that she returned unto her father, who did with her according to his vow which he had vowed: and she knew no man. And it was a custom in Israel,

rr: Gwahinduka omugyenzo omuri Israeli, abaishiki ba Israeli okuguma nibagyenda buri mwaka kumara ebiro bina nibacurira muhara wa Yefusa Omugileadi.
en: that the daughters of Israel went yearly to lament the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in a year.

rr: Currently Selected: Abaramuzi 11 : RR64 Highlight Share <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8 19c-2.828 0-4.24
Abaefuraimu baahuruzibwa kurwana, baayambuka, baahika Zafoni, baayetomboitera Yefusa, nibagira bati: Ahabw'enki oyambukire kurwanisa Abaamoni, otatwete kuhurura naiwe? Nitwija kukwokyeza omu nju.
en: And the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together, and went northward, and said unto Jephthah, Wherefore passedst thou over to fight against the children of Ammon, and didst not call us to go with thee? we will burn thine house upon thee with fire.

rr: Yefusa yaabagarukamu ati: Nyowe n'abantu bangye tukaba twine empaka nyingi n'Abaamoni; kandi ku twabeetsire, timwabatujuna.
en: And Jephthah said unto them, I and my people were at great strife with the children of Ammon; and when I called you, ye delivered me not out of their hands.

rr: Ku naareebire mutaatujuna, naayoga amagara, naayambuka kurwanisa Abaamoni, kandi MUKAMA yaabahayo omu mikono yangye. Mbwenu ahabw'enki mwaija eri izooba kundwanisa?
en: And when I saw that ye delivered me not, I put my life in my hands, and passed over against the children of Ammon, and the LORD delivered them into my hand: wherefore then are ye come up unto me this day, to fight against me?

rr: Okuruga aho Yefusa yaahuruza Abagileadi boona, yaabarwanisiza Efuraimu; Abagileadi baasingura Abaefuraimu; ahakuba bakabatsyorera bati: Imwe Abagileadi, muri Abaefuraimu abaacwire omu nsi ya Efuraimu n'eya Manaase.
en: Then Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead, and fought with Ephraim: and the men of Gilead smote Ephraim, because they said, Ye Gileadites are fugitives of Ephraim among the Ephraimites, and among the Manassites.

rr: Abagileadi baakwata enyambukiro za Yorudani kutangaho Abaefuraimu ngu batambuka. Omuefuraimu weena ku yaabaire aba naahunga, yaahika aha nyambukiro, yaashaba kwambuka, Abagileadi bamubuuza bati: Ori Omuefuraimu? Ku yaabaire agira ati: Ngaaha
en: And the Gileadites took the passages of Jordan before the Ephraimites: and it was so , that when those Ephraimites which were escaped said, Let me go over; that the men of Gilead said unto him, Art thou an Ephraimite? If he said, Nay;

rr: bamugira bati: Gira oti, Shiboleesi, nawe agira Siboleesi, ahabw'okutabaasa kukigamba gye, bamukwata, bamwitira ahari ezo nyambukiro za Yorudani.
en: then said they unto him, Say now Shibboleth: and he said Sibboleth: for he could not frame to pronounce it right.

rr: Omu bunaku obwo haafa Abaefuraimu obukumi buna n'enkumi ibiri.
en: Then they took him, and slew him at the passages of Jordan: and there fell at that time of the Ephraimites forty and two thousand.

rr: Yefusa yaamara emyaka mukaaga naacwera Abaisraeli emanja. Bwanyima Yefusa Omugileadi yaafa, yaaziikwa omu rurembo rumwe aha ndembo z'omuri Gileadi.
en: And Jephthah judged Israel six years. Then died Jephthah the Gileadite, and was buried in one of the cities of Gilead. Minor Judges

rr: Bwanyima ye Ibuzaani owa Betelehemu yaaba omuramuzi w'Abaisraeli.
en: And after him Ibzan of Beth-lehem judged Israel.

rr: Akaba aine abatabani makumi ashatu na bahara be makumi ashatu abu yaahingiire omu zindi nganda; kandi akashwerererayo abatabani abakazi makumi ashatu.
en: And he had thirty sons, and thirty daughters, whom he sent abroad, and took in thirty daughters from abroad for his sons.

rr: Yaamara emyaka mushanju naacwera Abaisraeli emanja.
en: And he judged Israel seven years.

rr: Bwanyima Ibuzaani yaafa, yaaziikwa Betelehemu.
en: Then died Ibzan, and was buried at Beth-lehem.

rr: Bwanyima ye haazaho Elooni Omuzebuluuni, yaaba omuramuzi w'Abaisraeli; yaamara emyaka ikumi naabacwera emanja.
en: And after him Elon, a Zebulonite, judged Israel; and he judged Israel ten years.

rr: Bwanyima Elooni Omuzebuluuni yaafa, yaaziikwa Ayalooni omu ishaza rya Zebuluuni.
en: And Elon the Zebulonite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the country of Zebulun.

rr: Bwanyima ye haazaho Abudooni mwene Hileeli owa Piratooni, yaaba omuramuzi w'Abaisraeli.
en: And after him Abdon the son of Hillel, a Pirathonite, judged Israel.

rr: Akaba aine abatabani makumi ana n'abaijukuru b'aboojo makumi ashatu; boona makumi mushanju bakaba bagyendera aha ndogoya nto makumi mushanju. Yaamara emyaka munaana naacwera Abaisraeli emanja.
en: And he had forty sons and thirty nephews, that rode on threescore and ten ass colts: and he judged Israel eight years.

rr: Bwanyima Abudooni mwene Hileeli owa Piratooni yaafa, yaaziikwa Piratooni omu ishaza rya Efuraimu omu nsi y'ebibungo ey'Abaamaleki.
en: And Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died, and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the mount of the Amalekites.

en: Currently Selected: Judges 12 : KJV Highlight Share <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8 19c-2.828 0-4.243 0-5.121-.879C2

rr: Kandi Abaisraeli bakagaruka baakora ebirikwangwa MUKAMA; MUKAMA yaabahayo omu mikono y'Abafilistia okumara emyaka makumi ana.
en: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD ; and the LORD delivered them into the hand of the Philistines forty years.

rr: Hakaba hariho omushaija wa Zoora, ow'omu ruganda rwa Daani, orikwetwa Manoa; omukazi we akaba ari engumba, ataine mwana weena.
en: And there was a certain man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name was Manoah; and his wife was barren, and bare not.

rr: -13 ; -6 ; . Maraika wa MUKAMA yaayeyoreka ogwo mukazi, yaamugira ati: Reeba mbwenu ori engumba, torikuzaara; kwonka noija kugira enda, ozaare omwana w'omwojo.
en: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto the woman, and said unto her, Behold now, thou art barren, and bearest not: but thou shalt conceive, and bear a son.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo oyerinde, otarinywa viinyo nari ekirikusinza, kandi otarirya ekintu kyona ekirikuzira
en: Now therefore beware, I pray thee, and drink not wine nor strong drink, and eat not any unclean thing:

rr: ahabw'okuba reeba, noija kugira enda, ozaare omwana w'omwojo; kandi orumweiso tirurimuraba ha mutwe; ahakuba ogwo mwana aryaba 13:5 Omunaziiri reeba Okubara 6.2 amakuru ngu, omuntu oshoroirwe kukorera Ruhanga omu muringo ogutari gw'obutoosha. Omunaziiri ahari Ruhanga okuruga omu nda ya nyina; kandi niwe aritandika kujuna Abaisraeli omu mikono y'Abafilistia.
en: for, lo, thou shalt conceive, and bear a son; and no razor shall come on his head: for the child shall be a Nazarite unto God from the womb: and he shall begin to deliver Israel out of the hand of the Philistines.

rr: Bwanyima ogwo mukazi yaija, yaagambira iba ati: Omushaija wa Ruhanga yaanyijaho, enshusha ye yaaba eri nk'eya maraika wa Ruhanga orikutiinisa munonga; tinaamubuuza i yaaba naaruga, kandi tiyangambira iziina rye
en: Then the woman came and told her husband, saying, A man of God came unto me, and his countenance was like the countenance of an angel of God, very terrible: but I asked him not whence he was , neither told he me his name:

rr: kwonka yaangira ati: Reeba noija kugira enda, ozaare omwana w'omwojo; kandi ati: otarinywa viinyo nari ekirikusinza, n'obu kwakuba okurya ekintu kyona ekirikuzira; ahabw'okuba ogwo mwana aryaba Omunaziiri ahari Ruhanga okuruga omu nda ya nyina okuhitsya aha izooba eri arifeeraho.
en: but he said unto me, Behold, thou shalt conceive, and bear a son; and now drink no wine nor strong drink, neither eat any unclean thing: for the child shall be a Nazarite to God from the womb to the day of his death.

rr: Bwanyima Manoa yaayeshengyereza MUKAMA, naagira ati: Ai MUKAMA, ninkweshengyereza oikirize ogwo mushaija wa Ruhanga ou waatuma atugarukyeho, atushobororere oku turitwaza omwana orizaarwa.
en: Then Manoah intreated the LORD , and said, O my Lord, let the man of God which thou didst send come again unto us, and teach us what we shall do unto the child that shall be born.

rr: Ruhanga yaahurira okushaba kwa Manoa; maraika ori owa Ruhanga yaagaruka ahari ogwo mukazi, yaashanga ashutami omu musiri; kwonka Manoa iba atariho.
en: And God hearkened to the voice of Manoah; and the angel of God came again unto the woman as she sat in the field: but Manoah her husband was not with her.

rr: Omukazi yairukisa obwira, yaagambira iba ati: Reeba omushaija onyizireho omu biro ebihingwire yaagaruka yaanyeyoreka.
en: And the woman made haste, and ran, and shewed her husband, and said unto him, Behold, the man hath appeared unto me, that came unto me the other day.

rr: Manoa yaimuka, yaakurata omukazi we, yaahika ahari ogwo mushaija, yaamubuuza ati: Niiwe mushaija ogambire n'omukazi wangye?
en: And Manoah arose, and went after his wife, and came to the man, and said unto him, Art thou the man that spakest unto the woman?

rr: Onu ati: Niinye.
en: And he said, I am .

rr: Manoa yaagira ati: Mbwenu ebigambo byawe ku biriba byabaire kwo, aryaba omwana wa muringo ki, kandi aryakora murimo ki?
en: And Manoah said, Now let thy words come to pass. How shall we order the child, and how shall we do unto him?

rr: Maraika wa MUKAMA yaagira Manoa ati: Byona ebi ngambiire omukazi waawe, abyerinde.
en: And the angel of the LORD said unto Manoah, Of all that I said unto the woman let her beware.

rr: Tarikwikirizibwa kurya ekintu kyona ekirikuruga omu muzaabibu, n'obu kwakuba okunywa viinyo nari ekirikusinza, nari okurya ekintu kyona ekirikuzira; byona ebi mmuragiire, ashemereire kubyorobera.
en: She may not eat of any thing that cometh of the vine, neither let her drink wine or strong drink, nor eat any unclean thing: all that I commanded her let her observe.

rr: Manoa yaagira maraika wa MUKAMA ati: Reka tukukyerereze tukubaagire omwana gw'embuzi.
en: And Manoah said unto the angel of the LORD , I pray thee, let us detain thee, until we shall have made ready a kid for thee.

rr: Maraika wa MUKAMA yaagira Manoa ati: N'obu orankyerereze, tindikwija kurya by'okurya byawe; kandi ku oraayende kugira ekitambo ky'okwotsya, oshemereire kukihongyera MUKAMA; ahakuba Manoa taramanyire ku yaabaire ari maraika wa MUKAMA.
en: And the angel of the LORD said unto Manoah, Though thou detain me, I will not eat of thy bread: and if thou wilt offer a burnt offering, thou must offer it unto the LORD . For Manoah knew not that he was an angel of the LORD .

rr: Manoa yaabuuza maraika wa MUKAMA ati: Eiziina ryawe ori oha, ebigambo byawe ku biriba byabaire kwo, tubone kukuha ekitiinisa?
en: And Manoah said unto the angel of the LORD , What is thy name, that when thy sayings come to pass we may do thee honour?

rr: Maraika wa MUKAMA yaamugira ati: Nombuuriza ki eiziina? Ka n'ery'okutangaaza!
en: And the angel of the LORD said unto him, Why askest thou thus after my name, seeing it is secret?

rr: Manoa nikwo kureeta omwana gw'embuzi n'empongano y'esaano, akabihongyera MUKAMA aha rukiri; maraika akakora eby'okutangaaza, Manoa n'omukazi we nibamureeba.
en: So Manoah took a kid with a meat offering, and offered it upon a rock unto the LORD : and the angel did wondrously; and Manoah and his wife looked on.

rr: Endimi z'omuriro ku zaimukire ahaiguru niziruga aha itambiro, maraika wa MUKAMA yaatembera omuri ezo ndimi ezaaruga aha itambiro, Manoa n'omukazi we nibabireeba; ku baabireebire, baagwa ahansi bajuumaire.
en: For it came to pass, when the flame went up toward heaven from off the altar, that the angel of the LORD ascended in the flame of the altar. And Manoah and his wife looked on it , and fell on their faces to the ground.

rr: Maraika wa MUKAMA tiyaagaruka kweyoreka obundi ahari Manoa n'omukazi we.
en: But the angel of the LORD did no more appear to Manoah and to his wife.

rr: Okuruga aho Manoa yaamanya ku abaire ari maraika wa MUKAMA.
en: Then Manoah knew that he was an angel of the LORD .

rr: Bwanyima Manoa yaagambira omukazi we ati: Buzimazima nitwija kufa, ahabw'okuba twareeba Ruhanga.
en: And Manoah said unto his wife, We shall surely die, because we have seen God.

rr: Kwonka omukazi we yaagira ati: Kuri noogira ngu MUKAMA abaire naayenda kutwita, takwakiire kitambo ky'okwotsya n'empongano y'esaano ebi twamuhongyera, kandi takutworekire ebyo byona, n'obu kwakuba okutugambira ebigambo ebyo byona omu bunaku obu. Okuzaarwa kwa Samusooni
en: But his wife said unto him, If the LORD were pleased to kill us, he would not have received a burnt offering and a meat offering at our hands, neither would he have shewed us all these things , nor would as at this time have told us such things as these.

rr: Bwanyima ogwo mukazi yaazaara omwana w'omwojo, yaamweta Samusooni; omwana yaakura, kandi MUKAMA yaamuha omugisha.
en: And the woman bare a son, and called his name Samson: and the child grew, and the LORD blessed him.

rr: Omwoyo wa MUKAMA yaatandika kumukoresa omuri Mahane-daani ahagati ya Zoora na Eshitaoli.
en: And the Spirit of the LORD began to move him at times in the camp of Dan between Zorah and Eshtaol.
