Samusooni yaashuuma Timuna, yaareebayo omwishiki, muhara w'Abafilistia.
en: And Samson went down to Timnath, and saw a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines.

rr: Yainamuka, yaagambira ishe na nyina ati: Ndeebire omwishiki muhara w'Abafilistia omuri Timuna; mbwenu niinyenda ngu mumunshwererere.
en: And he came up, and told his father and his mother, and said, I have seen a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines: now therefore get her for me to wife.

rr: Ishe na nyina baamugira bati: Beitu shi omuri beene waitu nari omu ihanga ryaitu tiharimu omwishiki, iwe waaza kwenda kushwera omu Abafilistia abatashazirwe?
en: Then his father and his mother said unto him, Is there never a woman among the daughters of thy brethren, or among all my people, that thou goest to take a wife of the uncircumcised Philistines?

rr: Samusooni yaagarukamu ishe ati: Nyowe munshwererere, ahkuba nanshemeza munonga.
en: And Samson said unto his father, Get her for me; for she pleaseth me well.

rr: Kwonka ishe na nyina tibaramanyire ku yaabaire eri enaama ya MUKAMA, ahakuba akaba naasherura obwiho b'eokurwana n'Abafilistia. Ou bunaku obwo Abafilistia bakaba nibategyeka Abaisraeli.
en: But his father and his mother knew not that it was of the LORD , that he sought an occasion against the Philistines: for at that time the Philistines had dominion over Israel.

rr: Atyo Samusooni yaashuuma Timuna na ishe na nyina, yaahika omu misiri y'emizaabibu yaayo, yaateerateeraniramu n'ekitsigazi ky'entare, kyamutontomera
en: Then went Samson down, and his father and his mother, to Timnath, and came to the vineyards of Timnath: and, behold, a young lion roared against him.

rr: Omwoyo wa MUKAMA yaamwijaho n'amaani, yaakitaagataagura nk'orikutaagataagura omwana gw'embuzi, haza ataine ki akwaitse; kwonka tiyaagambira ishe na nyina ki yaakora.
en: And the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and he rent him as he would have rent a kid, and he had nothing in his hand: but he told not his father or his mother what he had done.

rr: Samusooni yaashuuma, yaagaaniira n'ogwo mwishiki, yaamushemeza munonga.
en: And he went down, and talked with the woman; and she pleased Samson well.

rr: Ku haahingwireho omwanya, yaagarukayo kumutwara; yaakiikama aha rubaju kureeba omutumbi gw'entare eri; ku yaahikireho, yaashanga gurimu omuzinga gw'enjoki n'obwoki.
en: And after a time he returned to take her, and he turned aside to see the carcase of the lion: and, behold, there was a swarm of bees and honey in the carcase of the lion.

rr: Yaabubomboora n'engaro, yaagyenda naaburya, yaagaruka ahari ishe na nyina; nabo yaabahaho, baarya; kwonka tiyaabagambira ku yaabwiha omu mutumbi gw'entare.
en: And he took thereof in his hands, and went on eating, and came to his father and mother, and he gave them, and they did eat: but he told not them that he had taken the honey out of the carcase of the lion.

rr: Ishe yaashuuma ei ogwo mwishiki yaabaire ari; Samusooni yaateekyerayo obugyenyi, nk'oku omucwe gw'abatsigazi gwabaire guri.
en: So his father went down unto the woman: and Samson made there a feast; for so used the young men to do.

rr: Ku baamureebire, baamureetera bagyenzi baabo makumi ashatu kumwikaza.
en: And it came to pass, when they saw him, that they brought thirty companions to be with him.

rr: Samusooni yaabagira ati: Ka mbahe ekishaakuzo; ku muraakiite ebiro mushanju by'obugyenyi bitakahweire, mawakimanya muti, nimbaha ebijwaro bya bafuta makumi ashatu, n'ebindi eby'ekitiinisa makumi ashatu.
en: And Samson said unto them, I will now put forth a riddle unto you: if ye can certainly declare it me within the seven days of the feast, and find it out, then I will give you thirty sheets and thirty change of garments:

rr: Kwonka ku muraabe mutakiitsire, nimumpa ebijwaro bya bafuta makumi ashatu n'ebindi eby'ekitiinisa makumi ashatu.
en: but if ye cannot declare it me, then shall ye give me thirty sheets and thirty change of garments.

rr: Baamugira bati: Kishaakuze, tukihurire.
en: And they said unto him, Put forth thy riddle, that we may hear it.

rr: Yaabagira ati: Omuri rurya harugiremu eby'okurya, Kandi omu w'amaani harugiremu obunuzi.
en: And he said unto them, Out of the eater came forth meat, And out of the strong came forth sweetness.

rr: Baamara ebiro bishatu batakiitsire.
en: And they could not in three days expound the riddle.

rr: Aha kiro kya kana baagambira muka Samusooni bati: Beihabeiha baro atwitire ekyo kishaakuzo, tutakwotsya n'enju ya sho. Mutwetsire kutuhindura abooro? Tikwo kiri?
en: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that they said unto Samson's wife, Entice thy husband, that he may declare unto us the riddle, lest we burn thee and thy father's house with fire: have ye called us to take that we have? is it not so?

rr: Muka Samusooni yaamuririra omumaisho, naagira ati: Biri onyanga, tonkunda. Ohaire ab'owaitu ekishaakuzo, haza tiwaakinyitira. Onu ati: Ku ndaabe ntakigambiire tata na maawe, nimbaasa nta kukikugambira?
en: And Samson's wife wept before him, and said, Thou dost but hate me, and lovest me not: thou hast put forth a riddle unto the children of my people, and hast not told it me. And he said unto her, Behold, I have not told it my father nor my mother, and shall I tell it thee?

rr: Yaamara ebyo biro by'obugyenyi byona naamuririra omumaisho; aha kiro kya mushanju yaakimugambira, ahabw'okuba akamutonga amagara; nawe yaakigambira beene waabo.
en: And she wept before him the seven days, while their feast lasted: and it came to pass on the seventh day, that he told her, because she lay sore upon him: and she told the riddle to the children of her people.

rr: Aha kiro kya mushanju eizooba ritakarengire, abantu b'omuri orwo rurembo baamugira bati: Ekirikukiza obwoki obunuzi niki?
en: And the men of the city said unto him on the seventh day before the sun went down, What is sweeter than honey?

rr: Kandi ekirikukiza entare amaani n'enki?
en: And what is stronger than a lion?

rr: Samusooni yaabagira ati: Kuri mutahingiise nyana yangye, Timwakwitsire kishaakuzo kyangye.
en: And he said unto them, If ye had not plowed with my heifer, Ye had not found out my riddle.

rr: Omwoyo wa MUKAMA yaamwijaho n'amaani, yaashuuma Ashikelooni, yaitayo abashaija makumi ashatu, yaabanyaga, yaaha abaitsire ekyo kiito ebijwaro by'ekitiinisa.
en: And the Spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he went down to Ashkelon, and slew thirty men of them, and took their spoil, and gave change of garments unto them which expounded the riddle.

rr: Yaagira ekiniga kingi, yainamuka, yaataaha omu ka ya ishe.
en: And his anger was kindled, and he went up to his father's house.

rr: Kwonka muka Samusooni baamuhingira mugyenzi we, owaamugambiire obugyenyi.
en: But Samson's wife was given to his companion, whom he had used as his friend.

rr: Currently Selected: Abaramuzi 14 : RR64 Highlight Share <path d="M5 12a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h3a1 1 0 1 1 0 2H6a1 1 0 0 1-1-1ZM5 15a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h3a1 1 0 1 1 0 2H6a1 1 0 0 1-1-1ZM5 9a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h3a1 1 0 0 1 0 2H6a1 1 0 0 1-1-1ZM15 11a1 1 0 1 0 0 2h3a1
Ku haahingwireho omwanya omu igyesha ry'engano, Samusooni yaaza kureeba omukazi we, yaamutwarira omwana gw'embuzi; yaagira ati: Ka nze ow'omukazi wangye omu kishengye.
en: But it came to pass within a while after, in the time of wheat harvest, that Samson visited his wife with a kid; and he said, I will go in to my wife into the chamber.

rr: Kwonka ishezaara tiyaamwikiriza kutaahamu.
en: But her father would not suffer him to go in.

rr: Ishezaara yaamugira ati: Buzimazima nkateekateeka ngu okamwangira kimwe; n'ahabw'ekyo nkamuhingira mugyenzi waawe. Omurumuna tarikumuhita? Naakweshengyereza, ba niwe waatwara omu mwanya gwe.
en: And her father said, I verily thought that thou hadst utterly hated her; therefore I gave her to thy companion: is not her younger sister fairer than she? take her, I pray thee, instead of her.

rr: Samusooni yaabagira ati: Mbwenu ku ndaabe naakozire Abafilistia kubi, tihaine orancwere orubanja.
en: And Samson said concerning them, Now shall I be more blameless than the Philistines, though I do them a displeasure.

rr: Samusooni yaagyenda, yaakwata zaamuha magana ashatu, yaatwara enkanza z'omuriro, yaakomerana emikira ya zaamuha, yaagyenda naata enkanza emwe ahagati y'emikira ebiri.
en: And Samson went and caught three hundred foxes, and took firebrands, and turned tail to tail, and put a firebrand in the midst between two tails.

rr: Ku yaaherize kwatsya enkanza, yaazirekura, zaaza omu misiri y'engano y'Abafilistia, zaayotsya ebiba by'engano n'engano zitakatemire, kandi n'omu misiri y'emizeituuni.
en: And when he had set the brands on fire, he let them go into the standing corn of the Philistines, and burnt up both the shocks, and also the standing corn, with the vineyards and olives.

rr: Abafilistia baabuuza bati: Okozire eki n'oha?
en: Then the Philistines said, Who hath done this?

rr: Baagarukamu bati: Ni Samusooni mukwe w'Omunyatimuna, ahakuba akamwaka omukazi we, yaamuha mugyenzi we.
en: And they answered, Samson, the son in law of the Timnite, because he had taken his wife, and given her to his companion.

rr: Abafilistia bainamuka, baayotsya ogwo mukazi na ishe, baafa.
en: And the Philistines came up, and burnt her and her father with fire.

rr: Samusooni yaabagira ati: Nk'oku mukozire mutyo, buzimazima niinyija kubahoora enzigu; ku ndaaheze, ndekyere aho.
en: And Samson said unto them, Though ye have done this, yet will I be avenged of you, and after that I will cease.

rr: Yaabateera, yaabacoocoora, yaita baingi munonga; bwanyima yaashuuma, yaaguma omu nyanga y'orukiri rwa Etamu.
en: And he smote them hip and thigh with a great slaughter: and he went down and dwelt in the top of the rock Etam.

rr: Abafilistia bainamuka, baateera orusiisira omu ishaza rya Yuda, baajanjaara omuri Leehi.
en: Then the Philistines went up, and pitched in Judah, and spread themselves in Lehi.

rr: Abantu ba Yuda baababuuza bati: Ahabw'enki mwaija kuturwanisa?
en: And the men of Judah said, Why are ye come up against us?

rr: Baagarukamu bati: Twaija kuboha Samusooni kumugira nk'oku atugizire.
en: And they answered, To bind Samson are we come up, to do to him as he hath done to us.

rr: Abashaija ba Yuda enkumi ishatu nikwo kushuuma aha nyanga y'orukiri rwa Etamu, bakagira Samusooni bati: Torikumanya ku Abafilistia barikututegyeka? mbwenu eki, otukozire ki?
en: Then three thousand men of Judah went to the top of the rock Etam, and said to Samson, Knowest thou not that the Philistines are rulers over us? what is this that thou hast done unto us?

rr: Samusooni yaabagarukamu ati: Nk'oku bangizire, naanye nikwo mbagizire.
en: And he said unto them, As they did unto me, so have I done unto them.

rr: Baamugira bati: Twizire kukuboha, tukuheyo omu mikono y'Abafilistia.
en: And they said unto him, We are come down to bind thee, that we may deliver thee into the hand of the Philistines.

rr: Samusooni yaabagira ati: Nimundahire imwe ku muraabe mutarikwija kunkombeera.
en: And Samson said unto them, Swear unto me, that ye will not fall upon me yourselves.

rr: Baamugarukamu bati: Ngaaha! kwonka itwe nitwija kukuboha, tukuhamye, tukuheyo omu mikono yaabo; buzimazima titurikwija kukwita.
en: And they spake unto him, saying, No; but we will bind thee fast, and deliver thee into their hand: but surely we will not kill thee.

rr: Batyo baamubohesa emirunga ebiri misya, baamwiha ahari orwo rukiri, baamwinamura.
en: And they bound him with two new cords, and brought him up from the rock.

rr: Ku yaahikire Leehi, Abafilistia baija kumubugana nibateera akaari; Omwoyo wa MUKAMA yaamwijaho n'amaani, emirunga eyaabaire emuri aha mikono yaaba nka furakisi eyaayokibwa omuriro; ebyabaire bimubohire byamuruga aha mikono, byaragara.
en: And when he came unto Lehi, the Philistines shouted against him: and the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and the cords that were upon his arms became as flax that was burnt with fire, and his bands loosed from off his hands.

rr: Ku yaagiire kugira ati, yaagwa aha igufa ry'oruba rusya rw'endogoya, yaarukununkirira, yaarwitsa abantu rukumi.
en: And he found a new jawbone of an ass, and put forth his hand, and took it, and slew a thousand men therewith.

rr: Bwanyima yaagira ati: N'oruba rw'endogoya, emirundo n'emirundo- N'oruba rw'endogoya nyitsire abantu rukumi.
en: And Samson said, With the jawbone of an ass, heaps upon heaps, With the jaw of an ass have I slain a thousand men.

rr: Ku yaaherize kugamba, yaanaga orwo ruba; kandi omwanya ogwo gukaba nigwetwa Ramasi-Leehi.
en: And it came to pass, when he had made an end of speaking, that he cast away the jawbone out of his hand, and called that place Ramath-lehi.

rr: Bwanyima yaagira eiriho ringi, yaatakira MUKAMA naagira ati: Otuhaire okujunwa oku okuhango, nootujunisa omukono gw'omwiru waawe; mbwenu nyitwe eiruho, ngwe omu mikono y'abatashazirwe?
en: And he was sore athirst, and called on the LORD , and said, Thou hast given this great deliverance into the hand of thy servant: and now shall I die for thirst, and fall into the hand of the uncircumcised?

rr: Ruhanga yaayashamura enonko eyaabaire eri omuri Leehi, haarugamu amaizi; ku yaaherize kuganywa, omutima gwamugaruka omunda, yaagarukwamu amaani. Nikyo omwanya ogwo gwayeteirwe Eni-hakore, amakuru ngu, eiziba ry'owaatakire; kandi eryo iziba rikiri omuri Leehi n'okuhitsya hati.
en: But God clave an hollow place that was in the jaw, and there came water thereout; and when he had drunk, his spirit came again, and he revived: wherefore he called the name thereof En-hakkore, which is in Lehi unto this day.

rr: Samusooni yaamara emyaka makumi abiri naacwera Abaisraeli emanja omu biro by'Abafilistia.
en: And he judged Israel in the days of the Philistines twenty years.

rr: Samusooni yaaza Gaaza, yaareebayo maraaya, yaataaha omu nju ye.
en: Then went Samson to Gaza, and saw there an harlot, and went in unto her.

rr: -12 ; . Baakigambira aba Gaaza bati: Samusooni ari aha. Baayehinguririza omwanya ogu yaabaire arimu, baamara ekiro kyona bamugwereire aha irembo ry'orurembo; ekyo kiro baakimara bahunami, nibagira bati: Murekye busheeshe, tumwite.
en: And it was told the Gazites, saying, Samson is come hither. And they compassed him in, and laid wait for him all night in the gate of the city, and were quiet all the night, saying, In the morning, when it is day, we shall kill him.

rr: Samusooni yaabyana okuhitsya omu itumbi; eitumbi ku ryahinzire, yaimuka, yaakwata enyigi z'eirembo ry'orurembo n'ebiti by'amarembo byombi, yaabikuurirana n'empimbi zaabyo, yaabita aha mabega, yaabitwara aha mutwe gw'ekibungo ekiri omu maisho ga Heburooni.
en: And Samson lay till midnight, and arose at midnight, and took the doors of the gate of the city, and the two posts, and went away with them, bar and all, and put them upon his shoulders, and carried them up to the top of an hill that is before Hebron. Delilah

rr: Bwanyima yaakunda omukazi ow'omu ruhita rwa Sooreki, owaabaire naayetwa Delila.
en: And it came to pass afterward, that he loved a woman in the valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.

rr: Abategyeki b'Abafilistia baija owe, baamugambira bati: Omubeihabeihe, omanye ei amaani ge maingi gakomooka, n'oku twakumubaasa, tukamuboha, tukamucwa eishaija; haza buri omwe omuriitwe naija kukuha ebicweka by'efeeza rukumi n'eigana.
en: And the lords of the Philistines came up unto her, and said unto her, Entice him, and see wherein his great strength lieth , and by what means we may prevail against him, that we may bind him to afflict him: and we will give thee every one of us eleven hundred pieces of silver.

rr: Delila yaagira Samusooni ati: Nyaabura 'we, ngambira ei amaani gaawe maingi gakomooka, kandi n'eki baakukubohesa, kikakucwa eishaija.
en: And Delilah said to Samson, Tell me, I pray thee, wherein thy great strength lieth , and wherewith thou mightest be bound to afflict thee.

rr: Samusooni yaamugira ati: Ku baakumbohesa enshuri mbisi mushanju ezitakoomire, obwo nkaahwa amaani, mba nk'abandi bantu.
en: And Samson said unto her, If they bind me with seven green withs that were never dried, then shall I be weak, and be as another man.

rr: Abategyeki b'Abafilistia nikwo kumureetera eshuri mbisi mushanju ezitakoomire, akazimubohesa.
en: Then the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven green withs which had not been dried, and she bound him with them.

rr: Kandi akaba aine abashaija abaabaire bagwereire omu kishengye ky'omunda.
en: Now there were men lying in wait, abiding with her in the chamber.

rr: Yaamugira ati: Samusooni, waafa, Abafilistia baakwita!
en: And she said unto him, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson.

rr: Samusooni yaacwa ezo nshuri, nk'akagoye k'obugoigo oku kacweka kaahikwaho omuriro.
en: And he brake the withs, as a thread of tow is broken when it toucheth the fire.

rr: Obwo tibaamanya i amaani ge gakomooka.
en: So his strength was not known.

rr: Delila yaagira Samusooni ati: Reeba wansungisa, tiwangambira mazima; mbwenu naakweshengyereza, ngambira eki baakukubohesa.
en: And Delilah said unto Samson, Behold, thou hast mocked me, and told me lies: now tell me, I pray thee, wherewith thou mightest be bound.

rr: Yaamugira ati: Ku baakumbohesa emirunga misya etakagizire ki yaaboha, obwo nkaahwa amaani, mba nk'abandi bantu.
en: And he said unto her, If they bind me fast with new ropes that never were occupied, then shall I be weak, and be as another man.

rr: Delila nikwo kureeta emirunga misya, akagimubohesa, akamugira ati: Samusooni, waafa, Abafilistia baakwita.
en: Delilah therefore took new ropes, and bound him therewith, and said unto him, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson.

rr: Kandi abashaija abaabaire bagwereiire bakaba bari omu kishengye ky'omunda.
en: And there were liers in wait abiding in the chamber.

rr: Egyo mirunga yaagicwa nk'ehuuzi, yaamuruga aha mikono.
en: And he brake them from off his arms like a thread.

rr: Delila yaagira Samusooni ati: N'okuhitsya hati nookinshungisa, torikungambira mazima; ngambira eki baakukubohesa.
en: And Delilah said unto Samson, Hitherto thou hast mocked me, and told me lies: tell me wherewith thou mightest be bound.

rr: Onu yaamugira ati: Ku waakutsiba obutsibo bwe'eishokye ryangye mushanju, waaburukirana n'omwenda ogurikurukirwa aha biti, waabuhamisa orubambo, obwo nkaahwa amaani, mba nk'abandi bantu.
en: And he said unto her, If thou weavest the seven locks of my head with the web.

rr: Atyo yaabuhamisa orubambo, yaamugira ati: Samusooni, waafa, Abafilistia baakwita!
en: And she fastened it with the pin, and said unto him, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson.

rr: Yaasisiimuka, yaakuura orwo rubambo n'ebyo biti n'ogwo mwenda.
en: And he awaked out of his sleep, and went away with the pin of the beam, and with the web.

rr: Delila yaamugira ati: Noobaasa ota kugira oti, Ninkukunda, haza omutima gwawe gutandiho?
en: And she said unto him, How canst thou say, I love thee, when thine heart is not with me?

rr: Onshungiise emirundi egi yoona eshatu, kandi otarikungambira i amaani gaawe maingi gakomooka.
en: Thou hast mocked me these three times, and hast not told me wherein thy great strength lieth .

rr: Ku yaamucondoorize munonga buri izooba, yaaguma naamujugutirira, Samusooni yaarugaho yaaremba
en: And it came to pass, when she pressed him daily with her words, and urged him, so that his soul was vexed unto death;

rr: nikwo kumugambira omubonano gwe gwona, akamugira ati: Orumweiso tirukandabaga ha mutwe, ahakuba okwiha obu naaruga omu nda ya maawe, ntuura ndi Omunaziiri ahari Ruhanga. Ku baakuumwa, obwo nkaahwamu amaani, mba otaine maani, nk'abandi bantu.
en: that he told her all his heart, and said unto her, There hath not come a razor upon mine head; for I have been a Nazarite unto God from my mother's womb: if I be shaven, then my strength will go from me, and I shall become weak, and be like any other man.

rr: Deila ku yaareebire yaamugambira omubonano gwe gwona, yaatuma kweta abategyeki b'Abafilistia naagira ati: Mwije obu bwonka, ahakuba yangambira omubonano gwe gwona.
en: And when Delilah saw that he had told her all his heart, she sent and called for the lords of the Philistines, saying, Come up this once, for he hath shewed me all his heart.

rr: Ahonaaho abategyeki b'Abafilistia baija owe, baine empiiha omu ngaro zaabo.
en: Then the lords of the Philistines came up unto her, and brought money in their hand.

rr: Delila yaamugwejegyereza aha maju ge; yaayeta omushaija, yaamugambira kumumwa obutsibo bw'eishokye rye mushanju; yaatandika kumwita kubi, amaani gaamuhweramu kimwe.
en: And she made him sleep upon her knees; and she called for a man, and she caused him to shave off the seven locks of his head; and she began to afflict him, and his strength went from him.

rr: Yaamugira ati: Samusooni, waafa, Abafilistia baakwita!
en: And she said, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson.

rr: Yaasisimuka, yaagira ati: Ka nshohore nyekunkumure nk'okwangye.
en: And he awoke out of his sleep, and said, I will go out as at other times before, and shake myself.

rr: Kwonka akaba atamanyire ku MUKAMA amurugireho.
en: And he wist not that the LORD was departed from him.

rr: Abafilistia baamukwata, baamwihamu amaisho, baamushuumya Gaaza, baamukomesa emihama y'emiringa; yaaguma naakora omurimo gw'okusa omu nju y'embohe.
en: But the Philistines took him, and put out his eyes, and brought him down to Gaza, and bound him with fetters of brass; and he did grind in the prison house.

rr: Kwonka eishokye rye ryagaruka ryamera bwanyima y'okumumwa. Okufa kwa Samusooni
en: Howbeit the hair of his head began to grow again after he was shaven.

rr: Abategyeki b'Abafilistia baateerana abantu okutambira Dagoni ruhanga waabo ekitambo kihango, n'okwesiima; ahakuba bakagira bati: Ruhanga waitu ahaireyo Samusooni omuzigu waitu omu mikono yaitu.
en: Then the lords of the Philistines gathered them together for to offer a great sacrifice unto Dagon their god, and to rejoice: for they said, Our god hath delivered Samson our enemy into our hand.

rr: 1 -8 ; . Abantu ku baamureebire, baasiima ruhanga waabo; ahakuba bakagira bati: Ruhanga waitu ahaireyo omu mikono yaitu omuzigu waitu obaire naahwerekyereza ensi yaitu, naatwitamu abantu baingi.
en: And when the people saw him, they praised their god: for they said, Our god hath delivered into our hands our enemy, and the destroyer of our country, which slew many of us.

rr: Bwanyima emitima yaabo ku yaashemerereirwe munonga, baagira bati: Mwete Samusooni, atuzaanire.
en: And it came to pass, when their hearts were merry, that they said, Call for Samson, that he may make us sport.

rr: Baayeta Samusooni kuruga omu nju y'embohe; yaabazaanira; baamuta ahagati y'enyomyo.
en: And they called for Samson out of the prison house; and he made them sport: and they set him between the pillars.

rr: Samusooni yaagambira omwojo owaabaire amukwaitse omukono, ati: Ka nkorakoze, nkwate enyomyo ezi enju ehamiizeho, nzeegamire.
en: And Samson said unto the lad that held him by the hand, Suffer me that I may feel the pillars whereupon the house standeth, that I may lean upon them.

rr: Obwo enju ekaba eijwire abashaija n'abakazi; n'abategyeki b'Abafilistia boona bakaba barimu; kandi n'aha mutwe gw'enju hakaba hariho abantu nk'enkumi ishatu, abashaija n'abakazi, abaabaire nibareeba Samusooni oku arikubazaanira.
en: Now the house was full of men and women; and all the lords of the Philistines were there; and there were upon the roof about three thousand men and women, that beheld while Samson made sport.

rr: Samusooni yaatakira MUKAMA ati: Ai MUKAMA Ruhanga, ninkweshengyereza mpa amaani omurundi ogu gwonka, mpoore Abafilistia ahabw'amaisho gangye gombi.
en: And Samson called unto the LORD , and said, O Lord GOD , remember me, I pray thee, and strengthen me, I pray thee, only this once, O God, that I may be at once avenged of the Philistines for my two eyes.

rr: Samusooni yaakwata ezo nyomyo ez'ahagati zombi, ezi enju yaabaire ehamiizeho; yaazeegamira, emwe yaagikwatsa omukono gwe gwa buryo, n'endiijo ogwa bumosho.
en: And Samson took hold of the two middle pillars upon which the house stood, and on which it was borne up, of the one with his right hand, and of the other with his left.

rr: Samusooni yaagira ati: Ka ngwane n'Abafilistia.
en: And Samson said, Let me die with the Philistines.

rr: Yainama n'amaani ge goona; ahonaaho enju yaagwera abategyeki n'abantu boona abaabaire bagirimu.
en: And he bowed himself with all his might; and the house fell upon the lords, and upon all the people that were therein.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo abu yaitsire omu kufa kwe baakira abu yaitsire akihuriire.
en: So the dead which he slew at his death were more than they which he slew in his life.

rr: Bwanyima beene waabo n'ab'enju ya ishe boona baashuuma, baamutwara, baamuziika omu kituuro kya Manoa ishe, ahagati ya Zoora na Eshitaoli; obwo akaba amazire emyaka makumi abiri naacwera Abaisraeli emanja. Currently Selected: Abaramuzi 16 : RR64 Highlight Share <path fi
en: Then his brethren and all the house of his father came down, and took him, and brought him up, and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the buryingplace of Manoah his father. rr: Hakaba hariho omushaija omu nsi y'ebibungo eya Efuraimu, owaabaire naayetwa Miika.
en: And there was a man of mount Ephraim, whose name was Micah.

rr: Yaagira nyina ati: Ebicweka by'efeeza biri rukumi na igana, ebi baakwibire, bikakureetera kukyeena, nkuhuriire, reeba niinye mbiine. Niinye naabiibire. Nyina yaamugarukamu ati: Mwana wangye, MUKAMA akuhe omugisha.
en: And he said unto his mother, The eleven hundred shekels of silver that were taken from thee, about which thou cursedst, and spakest of also in mine ears, behold, the silver is with me; I took it. And his mother said, Blessed be thou of the LORD , my son.

rr: Miika ku yaagaruriire nyina ebyo bicweka by'efeeza rukumi na igana, nyina yaagira ati: Ebi bicweka by'efeeza ebindi omu ngaro, naabishoroorera MUKAMA, ngu omwana wangye abiheeshemu ekishushani ekisharwire; na mbwenu niinyija kubikugarurira.
en: And when he had restored the eleven hundred shekels of silver to his mother, his mother said, I had wholly dedicated the silver unto the LORD from my hand for my son, to make a graven image and a molten image: now therefore I will restore it unto thee.

rr: Ku yaaherize kugarurira nyina ezo feeza, nyina yaatwaraho ebicweka magana abiri, yaabiha omuheesi, yaabiheeshamu ekishushani kisharwire; kyaguma omu nju ya Miika.
en: Yet he restored the money unto his mother; and his mother took two hundred shekels of silver, and gave them to the founder, who made thereof a graven image and a molten image: and they were in the house of Micah.

rr: Kandi omushaija ogwo Miika akaba aine endaaro ya baaruhanga be, yaakora efodi na 17:5 terafimu n'ebishushani by'emandwa. terafimu, kandi yaashoroora omwe aha batabani kuba omunyamurwa we.
en: And the man Micah had an house of gods, and made an ephod, and teraphim, and consecrated one of his sons, who became his priest.

rr: Omu bunaku obwo hakaba hatariho mugabe omuri Israeli, kureka buri muntu akaba naayekorera nk'oku arikwenda.
en: In those days there was no king in Israel, but every man did that which was right in his own eyes.

rr: Kandi hakaba hariho omutsigazi owa Betelehemu-yuda, ow'omu ruganda rwa Yuda, Omuleevi, owaabaire ashuhuukiireyo.
en: And there was a young man out of Beth-lehem-judah of the family of Judah, who was a Levite, and he sojourned there.

rr: Omushaija ogwo yaaruga omu rurembo rwa Betelehemu-yuda, yaaza kusherura ah'okutuura. Ku yaabaire naakigyenda, yaahika aha nju ya Miika omu nsi y'ebibungo eya Efuraimu.
en: And the man departed out of the city from Beth-lehem-judah to sojourn where he could find a place: and he came to mount Ephraim to the house of Micah, as he journeyed.

rr: Miika yaamubuuza ati: Nooruga hi?
en: And Micah said unto him, Whence comest thou?

rr: Onu ati: Ndi Omuleevi owa Betelehemu-yuda, ninza kusherura ah'okutuura.
en: And he said unto him, I am a Levite of Beth-lehem-judah, and I go to sojourn where I may find a place .

rr: Miika yaamugira ati: Tuura naanye, ombeere omuzaire kandi omunyamurwa; naanye ngume nkuhe ebicweka by'efeeza ikumi buri mwaka, nkujwekye kandi nkugaburire.
en: And Micah said unto him, Dwell with me, and be unto me a father and a priest, and I will give thee ten shekels of silver by the year, and a suit of apparel, and thy victuals.

rr: Atyo ogwo Muleevi yaataahamu.
en: So the Levite went in.

rr: Bwanyima yaasiima kuguma n'ogwo mushaija; ogwo mutsigazi yaamubeera nk'omwe aha batabani.
en: And the Levite was content to dwell with the man; and the young man was unto him as one of his sons.

rr: Miika yaashoroora ogwo Muleevi, yaaba omunyamurwa we, yaaguma omu nju ye.
en: And Micah consecrated the Levite; and the young man became his priest, and was in the house of Micah.

rr: Bwanyima Miika yaagira ati: Mbwenu nimmanya ngu MUKAMA naija kumpa omugisha, obu ngizire Omuleevi omunyamurwa wangye.
en: Then said Micah, Now know I that the LORD will do me good, seeing I have a Levite to my priest.

rr: Omu bunaku obwo hakaba hatariho mugabe omuri Israeli; kandi omu biro ebyo ab'oruganda rwa Daani bakaba nibasherura ensi y'okutuuramu; ahabw'okuba okuhitsya omu bunaku obwo bakaba batakatungire buhunguzi omu nganda za Israeli.
en: In those days there was no king in Israel: and in those days the tribe of the Danites sought them an inheritance to dwell in; for unto that day all their inheritance had not fallen unto them among the tribes of Israel.

rr: Abadaani baiha omu ruganda rwabo rwona abashaija bataano amamanzi, baabatuma okuruga Zoora na Eshitaoli kuza kutata ensi n'okugyetegyereza; baabagira bati: Nimwirooko mwetegyereze ensi. Baahika aha nju ya Miika omu nsi y'ebibungo eya Efuraimu, baaraarayo.
en: And the children of Dan sent of their family five men from their coasts, men of valour, from Zorah, and from Eshtaol, to spy out the land, and to search it; and they said unto them, Go, search the land: who when they came to mount Ephraim, to the house of Micah, they lodged there.

rr: Ku baabaire bari haihi n'enju ya Miika, baamanya eiraka ry'ogwo mutsigazi Omuleevi, baakiikama, baamubuuza bati: Okureetsire aha n'oha? Aha nookoraho ki, kandi oineho murimo ki?
en: When they were by the house of Micah, they knew the voice of the young man the Levite: and they turned in thither, and said unto him, Who brought thee hither? and what makest thou in this place? and what hast thou here?

rr: Onu ati: Oku nikwo Miika yantwarize, akandaganisa ebihembo kumukorera; naanye nkaba omunyamurwa we.
en: And he said unto them, Thus and thus dealeth Micah with me, and hath hired me, and I am his priest.

rr: Baamugira bati: Twakweshengyereza, buuza Ruhanga, tumanye yaaba nitwija kugira omugisha omuri orurugyendo rwaitu.
en: And they said unto him, Ask counsel, we pray thee, of God, that we may know whether our way which we go shall be prosperous.

rr: Omunyamurwa yaabagarukamu ati: Mugyende n'obusingye; MUKAMA naija kubarinda omu rugyendo rwanyu.
en: And the priest said unto them, Go in peace: before the LORD is your way wherein ye go.

rr: Abo bashaija bataano baagyenda, baahika Laishi, baareeba abantu abaabaire bariyo, beetuuriire n'obusingye, nk'oku omucwe gw'Abasidoni gwabaire guri, batuurize, bataine ki beetaireho; bakaba bari abatungi bataine ki bakyenire omu nsi; bari hare n'Abasidoni, bataine bandi boona abu barikukwatanisa nabo.
en: Then the five men departed, and came to Laish, and saw the people that were therein, how they dwelt careless, after the manner of the Zidonians, quiet and secure; and there was no magistrate in the land, that might put them to shame in any thing; and they were far from the Zidonians, and had no business with any man.

rr: Ku baagarukire ahari beene waabo omuri Zoora na Eshitaoli, beene waabo baababuuza bati: Nigaahi?
en: And they came unto their brethren to Zorah and Eshtaol: and their brethren said unto them, What say ye?

rr: -9 ; . Banu bati: Mwimukye tuze kubateera; ahakuba tureebire ensi, kandi ensi egyo ni nungi munonga. Mushutikirwe ki? Murekye kweziringa, muze omuri egyo nsi, mugikubuure.
en: And they said, Arise, that we may go up against them: for we have seen the land, and, behold, it is very good: and are ye still? be not slothful to go, and to enter to possess the land.

rr: Ku muraagyende, nimwija kushangayo abantu abeetuuriire n'obusingye, kandi n'ensi eri mpango; buzima Ruhanga agihaireyo omu mikono yaanyu; n'ensi etabuziremu kintu kyona eky'omu nsi.
en: When ye go, ye shall come unto a people secure, and to a large land: for God hath given it into your hands; a place where there is no want of any thing that is in the earth.

rr: Bwanyima abashaija magana mukaaga ab'omu ruganda rwa Daani, baaruga Zoora na Eshitaoli, bakwaitse eby'okurwanisa.
en: And there went from thence of the family of the Danites, out of Zorah and out of Eshtaol, six hundred men appointed with weapons of war.

rr: Bainamuka, baateera orusiisira Kiryasi-yearimu omuri Yuda; n'ahabw'ekyo omwanya ogwo baagweta Mahane-Daani n'okuhitsya hati; guri enyima ya Kiryasi-yearimu.
en: And they went up, and pitched in Kirjath-jearim, in Judah: wherefore they called that place Mahaneh-dan unto this day: behold, it is behind Kirjath-jearim.

rr: Baarugayo, baahika omu nsi y'ebibungo eya Efuraimu aha nju ya Miika.
en: And they passed thence unto mount Ephraim, and came unto the house of Micah.

rr: Ku baahikireyo, abo bashaija bataano abaabaire nibaza kutata ensi ya Laishi, baagira beene waabo bati: Nimumanya ku omuri aga maju harimu efodi na terafimu n'ekishushani kiheesire, kandi ekisharwire? N'ahabw'ekyo muteekateekye eki muraakore.
en: Then answered the five men that went to spy out the country of Laish, and said unto their brethren, Do ye know that there is in these houses an ephod, and teraphim, and a graven image, and a molten image? now therefore consider what ye have to do.

rr: Baakiikama, baataaha omu nju y'ogwo mutsigazi Omuleevi omu ka ya Miika, baamubuuza oku araire
en: And they turned thitherward, and came to the house of the young man the Levite, even unto the house of Micah, and saluted him.

rr: kandi abo bashaija magana mukaaga ab'omu ruganda rwa Daani baayemerera aha irembo, bakwaitse eby'okurwanisa byabo
en: And the six hundred men appointed with their weapons of war, which were of the children of Dan, stood by the entering of the gate.

rr: bwanyima abo bashaija bataano abaagiire kutata ensi, baazayo, baataahamu, baihamu ekyo kishushani kiheesire kandi ekisharwire, na efodi na terafimu; omunyamurwa yaayemerera omu irembo hamwe n'abo bashaija magana mukaaga abakwaitse eby'okurwanisa.
en: And the five men that went to spy out the land went up, and came in thither, and took the graven image, and the ephod, and the teraphim, and the molten image: and the priest stood in the entering of the gate with the six hundred men that were appointed with weapons of war.

rr: Abashaija bari ku baataahire omu nju ya Miika, baihamu ekishushani kiheesire kandi ekisharwire, na efodi na terafimu, omunyamurwa yaababuuza ati: Nimukora ki?
en: And these went into Micah's house, and fetched the carved image, the ephod, and the teraphim, and the molten image. Then said the priest unto them, What do ye?

rr: Baamugarukamu bati: Hurikiza, igara akanwa; gyenda naitwe otubeere omuzaire kandi omunyamurwa. Ekirikukukirira oburungi n'okuba omunyamurwa w'eka y'omuntu omwe, nari okuba omunyamurwa w'oruganda n'omuryango omuri Israeli?
en: And they said unto him, Hold thy peace, lay thine hand upon thy mouth, and go with us, and be to us a father and a priest: is it better for thee to be a priest unto the house of one man, or that thou be a priest unto a tribe and a family in Israel?

rr: Omunyamurwa yaashemererwa munonga omu mutima, yaatwara efodi na terafimu n'ekyo kishushani kisharwire, yaagyenda n'abo bashaija bamushagatiire.
en: And the priest's heart was glad, and he took the ephod, and the teraphim, and the graven image, and went in the midst of the people.

rr: Batyo baakiikama, baagyenda beebembeize abaana n'amatungo n'ebintu.
en: So they turned and departed, and put the little ones and the cattle and the carriage before them.

rr: Ku baabaire baagyendaho akaanya okuruga aha ka ya Miika, abantu abaabaire bari omu maju agari haihi n'eka ya Miika baayeteerana, baakurata Abadaani, baabahika haihi.
en: And when they were a good way from the house of Micah, the men that were in the houses near to Micah's house were gathered together, and overtook the children of Dan.

rr: Baabeeta nibabakubukira.
en: And they cried unto the children of Dan.

rr: Abadaani baahinduka, baabuuza Miika bati: Obaire ota okutuhururira n'omutwe ogurikwingana gutyo?
en: And they turned their faces, and said unto Micah, What aileth thee, that thou comest with such a company?

rr: Miika yaabagarukamu ati: Mwanyaga baaruhanga bangye abu naakozire, n'omunyamurwa wangye, mwayegyendera; kandi ekindi naatsigarana ki? Mbwenu nimumbuuriza ki ngu, Obaire ota?
en: And he said, Ye have taken away my gods which I made, and the priest, and ye are gone away: and what have I more? and what is this that ye say unto me, What aileth thee?

rr: Abadaani baamugira bati: Tutagaruka kukuhurira, abanyakiniga batakaakugwaho, bakakwita n'ab'omu ka yaawe.
en: And the children of Dan said unto him, Let not thy voice be heard among us, lest angry fellows run upon thee, and thou lose thy life, with the lives of thy household.

rr: Abadaani baayegyendera; Miika ku yaareebire bamukiza amaani, yaakuba yaagaruka owe.
en: And the children of Dan went their way: and when Micah saw that they were too strong for him, he turned and went back unto his house.

rr: Baatwara ebi Miika yaabaire akozire, n'omunyamurwa ou yaabaire aine, baaza Laishi, baahika omu bantu bari abatuurize, abataine ki beetaireho; baabaitsa rurara, baayotsya orurembo rwabo.
en: And they took the things which Micah had made, and the priest which he had, and came unto Laish, unto a people that were at quiet and secure: and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and burnt the city with fire.

rr: Abo bantu baabura kijuna, ahabw'okuba orurembo rwabo rukaba ruri hare na Sidoni, kandi bakaba batarikukwatanisa n'abandi; kandi orurembo rwabo ruri omu ruhanga oruri haihi na Besirehobu.
en: And there was no deliverer, because it was far from Zidon, and they had no business with any man; and it was in the valley that lieth by Beth-rehob.

rr: Bwanyima Abadaani baayombekayo orundi rurembo, baarutuuramu.
en: And they built a city, and dwelt therein.

rr: Orwo rurembo baarweta Daani, nibarweterera ishenkurubo Daani, owaazairwe Israeli; kwonka eiziina ry'orwo rurembo ery'okubanza rikaba riri Laishi.
en: And they called the name of the city Dan, after the name of Dan their father, who was born unto Israel: howbeit the name of the city was Laish at the first.

rr: Abadaani baayeteeraho ekyo kishushani; kandi Yonasaani mwene Gereshoni, mutabani wa Musa, we n'abatabani baaguma bari abanyamurwa b'oruganda rwa Daani okuhitsya aha izooba eri ensi yaanyagiirweho.
en: And the children of Dan set up the graven image: and Jonathan, the son of Gershom, the son of Manasseh, he and his sons were priests to the tribe of Dan until the day of the captivity of the land.

rr: Batyo baataho ekyo kishushani kisharwire, eki Miika yaakozire, kyagumaho ebiro byona ebi enju ya Ruhanga yaamazire omuri Shiilo.
en: And they set them up Micah's graven image, which he made, all the time that the house of God was in Shiloh.

rr: Omu biro ebi Abaisraeli baabaire bataine mugabe, hakaba hariho Omuleevi owaabaire ashuhuukiire enyima y'ensi y'ebibungo eya Efuraimu; yaashwera omukazi w'ekinyanshunju, ou yaihire omuri Betelehemu-yuda.
en: And it came to pass in those days, when there was no king in Israel, that there was a certain Levite sojourning on the side of mount Ephraim, who took to him a concubine out of Beth-lehem-judah.

rr: Omukazi we yaamugwerwa kubi, yaayangana, yaagaruka owa ishe omuri Betelehemu-yuda, yaamarayo ameezi ana.
en: And his concubine played the whore against him, and went away from him unto her father's house to Beth-lehem-judah, and was there four whole months.

rr: Bwanyima iba yaimuka, yaamukurata yaaza kumweshengyereza kumugarura, yaagyenda n'omugaragwa we n'endogoya ibiri; omukazi yaamutaasya omu ka ya ishe; ishezaara ku yaamureebire, yaija kumubugana ashemereirwe.
en: And her husband arose, and went after her, to speak friendly unto her, and to bring her again, having his servant with him, and a couple of asses: and she brought him into her father's house: and when the father of the damsel saw him, he rejoiced to meet him.

rr: Ishezaara, ishe w'ogwo mwishiki, yaamwosesa, yaamara nawe ebiro bishatu; baarya, baanywa, baaguma aho.
en: And his father in law, the damsel's father, retained him; and he abode with him three days: so they did eat and drink, and lodged there.

rr: Aha kiro kya kana baimuka omu kasheeshe kare, ogwo Muleevi yaimuka kurugayo; ishe w'omwishiki yaagambira omukwe ati: Banza orye akagaati, ogarukwemu amaani, bwanyima obone kugyenda.
en: And it came to pass on the fourth day, when they arose early in the morning, that he rose up to depart: and the damsel's father said unto his son in law, Comfort thine heart with a morsel of bread, and afterward go your way.

rr: Batyo baashutama bombi hamwe, baarya, baanywa; bwanyima ishe w'omwishiki yaagambira omukwe ati: Ninkweshengyereza, ikiriza ogarukye oraare, omutima gwawe gushemererwe.
en: And they sat down, and did eat and drink both of them together: for the damsel's father had said unto the man, Be content, I pray thee, and tarry all night, and let thine heart be merry.

rr: Ogwo mushaija ku yaimukire kugyenda, ishezaara yaamweshengyereza, okuhitsya obu yaagarukire akaraarayo.
en: And when the man rose up to depart, his father in law urged him: therefore he lodged there again.

rr: Aha izooba rya kataano yaimuka omu kasheeshe kare kugyenda; ishe w'omwishiki yaagira ati: Huumuza omutima, ninkweshengyereza, osiibe aha okuhitsya omu mwabazyo.
en: And he arose early in the morning on the fifth day to depart: and the damsel's father said, Comfort thine heart, I pray thee.

rr: Batyo baarya hamwe.
en: And they tarried until afternoon, and they did eat both of them.

rr: Omushaija ku yaimukire kugyenda, we n'omukazi we n'omugaragwa we, ishezaara, ishe w'ogwo mwishiki, yaamugira ati: Reeba, eizooba ryahendekire, nimbeeshengyereza mugarukye muraare; reeba, bwaizire, raara, omutima gwawe gushemererwe; nyencakare mugurukye kare, mutaahe.
en: And when the man rose up to depart, he, and his concubine, and his servant, his father in law, the damsel's father, said unto him, Behold, now the day draweth toward evening, I pray you tarry all night: behold, the day groweth to an end, lodge here, that thine heart may be merry; and to morrow get you early on your way, that thou mayest go home.

rr: Kwonka omushaija tiyaikiriza kuraara, yaimuka, yaagyenda, yaahika ahashungaine na Yebusi, niyo Yerusalemu; obwo aine endogoya ibiri eziriho amatandiiko, kandi aine n'omukazi we.
en: But the man would not tarry that night, but he rose up and departed, and came over against Jebus, which is Jerusalem; and there were with him two asses saddled, his concubine also was with him.

rr: Ku baahikire haihi na Yebusi, bwashangwa buri haihi kwira; omugaragwa yaagira mukama we ati: Ninkweshengyereza, ija tukiikame, turaare omuri oru rurembo rw'Abayebusi.
en: And when they were by Jebus, the day was far spent; and the servant said unto his master, Come, I pray thee, and let us turn in into this city of the Jebusites, and lodge in it.

rr: Mukama we yaamugira ati: Titurikwija kukiikama omu rurembo rw'abanyamahanga, orutari rw'Abaisraeli, kureka twambukye tuhikye Gibea.
en: And his master said unto him, We will not turn aside hither into the city of a stranger, that is not of the children of Israel; we will pass over to Gibeah.

rr: Yaagaruka yaagambira omugaragwa we ati: Ija tuhikye haihi na Gibea nari Raama, turaare omu rurembo rumwe ahari ezo.
en: And he said unto his servant, Come, and let us draw near to one of these places to lodge all night, in Gibeah, or in Ramah.

rr: Batyo baayogaho, baagyenda; ku baahikire haihi na Gibea eya Benyamiini, eizooba ryarenga.
en: And they passed on and went their way; and the sun went down upon them when they were by Gibeah, which belongeth to Benjamin.

rr: Baakiikamira aho, baaza Gibea kuraarayo. Ku yaahikireyo, yaashutama ahu emihanda y'omu rurembo erikuteeranira, ahakuba tiharabaireho owaikiriize kubaraaza.
en: And they turned aside thither, to go in and to lodge in Gibeah: and when he went in, he sat him down in a street of the city: for there was no man that took them into his house to lodging.

rr: Bwanyima omuri ogwo mwabazyo haija omugurusi naaruga omu musiri ei yaabaire naakora; omugurusi ogwo akaba ari ow'omu nsi y'ebibungo eya Efuraimu, owaabaire ashuhuukiire Gibea; kwonka ab'omuri orwo rurembo bakaba bari Ababenyamiini.
en: And, behold, there came an old man from his work out of the field at even, which was also of mount Ephraim; and he sojourned in Gibeah: but the men of the place were Benjamites.

rr: Ku yaanagire amaisho, yaareeba omugyenzi omu nguuto y'orwo rurembo. Ogwo mugurusi yaamubuuza ati: Nooruga hi, kandi nooza hi?
en: And when he had lifted up his eyes, he saw a wayfaring man in the street of the city: and the old man said, Whither goest thou? and whence comest thou?

rr: Yaamugarukamu ati: Nituruga Betelehemu-yuda, nituza enyima y'ensi y'ebibungo eya Efuraimu; niyo naarugire, ninza Betelehemu-yuda; mbwenu ninza omu nju ya MUKAMA, ahakuba tihariho owaikiriza kundaaza.
en: And he said unto him, We are passing from Beth-lehem-judah toward the side of mount Ephraim; from thence am I: and I went to Beth-lehem-judah, but I am now going to the house of the LORD ; and there is no man that receiveth me to house.

rr: Kwonka twine embuba n'eby'okurya by'endogoya zaitu; kandi twine omugaati na viinyo ahabwangye n'omuzaana waawe n'omutsigazi ou twine; titwine ki turikwetenga.
en: Yet there is both straw and provender for our asses; and there is bread and wine also for me, and for thy handmaid, and for the young man which is with thy servants: there is no want of any thing.

rr: Omugurusi yaagira ati: Huumura! niinyija kukukorera ebi orikwetenga byona; kwonka otaraara omu muhanda.
en: And the old man said, Peace be with thee; howsoever let all thy wants lie upon me; only lodge not in the street.

rr: Atyo yaabataasya omu ka ye, yaaha endogoya z'ogwo mushaija eby'okurya, baanaaba ebigyere, baarya, baanywa.
en: So he brought him into his house, and gave provender unto the asses: and they washed their feet, and did eat and drink.

rr: -8 ; . Ku baabaire nibakishemererwa, haija abantu b'abanyarurembo abataine mugasho, baayehinguririza egyo nju, baateera orwigi, baagambira ogwo mugurusi nyineeka, bati: Shohoza ogwo mushaija owaija omu nju yaawe, tumumanye.
en: Now as they were making their hearts merry, behold, the men of the city, certain sons of Belial, beset the house round about, and beat at the door, and spake to the master of the house, the old man, saying, Bring forth the man that came into thine house, that we may know him.

rr: Omushaija nyineeka yaashohora ahu baabaire bari, yaabagira ati: Beene waitu, murekye, naabeeshengyereza, mutakora ekibi ekirikwingana kityo; ogu mushaija yaataahire omu nju yangye, mutakora ekihagaro ekirikushusha kityo.
en: And the man, the master of the house, went out unto them, and said unto them, Nay, my brethren, nay , I pray you, do not so wickedly; seeing that this man is come into mine house, do not this folly.

rr: Reeba, hariho muhara wangye empangare, n'omukazi w'ogu mushaija; ka mbe nibo naashohoza hati, mubashiishe, mubagire nk'oku murikwenda; kwonka omushaija ogu mutamukoraho ekihagaro ekirikushusha kityo.
en: Behold, here is my daughter a maiden, and his concubine; them I will bring out now, and humble ye them, and do with them what seemeth good unto you: but unto this man do not so vile a thing.

rr: Abo bashaija baayanga kumuhurira; ogwo mushaija omugyenyi nikwo kukwata omukazi we w'ekinyanshunju, akamushohoza ahu bari, bakamumanya, bakamushiisha ekiro kyona okuhitsya omu kasheeshe; ku bwabaire nibutaagurikana, baamurekura.
en: But the men would not hearken to him: so the man took his concubine, and brought her forth unto them; and they knew her, and abused her all the night until the morning: and when the day began to spring, they let her go.

rr: Omukazi yaija nibusheesha, yaagwa aha rwigi rw'enju y'ogwo mushaija, omu mukama we yaabaire ari, okuhitsya obu bwaseesire.
en: Then came the woman in the dawning of the day, and fell down at the door of the man's house where her lord was , till it was light.

rr: Mukama we ku yaimukire omu kasheeshe, yaigura enyigi z'enju, naashohora kugyenda, yaashanga ogwo mukazi we w'ekinyanshunju agwire ahansi, engaro ze ziri omu kisasi.
en: And her lord rose up in the morning, and opened the doors of the house, and went out to go his way: and, behold, the woman his concubine was fallen down at the door of the house, and her hands were upon the threshold.

rr: Yaamugira ati: Imuka tugyende. Akateezo kaabura; bwanyima omushaija yaamuta aha ndogoya, yaimuka, yaaza owaabo.
en: And he said unto her, Up, and let us be going. But none answered. Then the man took her up upon an ass, and the man rose up, and gat him unto his place.

rr: Ku yaataahire omu nju ye, yaihayo omusyo, yaakwata omutumbi gw'omukazi we, yaagutemaatemera omu ngingo, yaagucwamu ebicweka ikumi na bibiri, yaabyohereza omu mashaza goona aga Israeli.
en: And when he was come into his house, he took a knife, and laid hold on his concubine, and divided her, together with her bones, into twelve pieces, and sent her into all the coasts of Israel.

rr: Abaakireebire boona baagira bati: Ekintu nk'eki tikikakorwaga, kandi tikikareebwaga, okwiha obu Abaisraeli baaruga omu nsi ya Misri n'okuhitsya hati. Mukiteekateekyeho, mukihanuureho, kandi mukigambeho. Currently Selected: Abaramuzi 19 : RR64 Highlight Share <
en: And it was so, that all that saw it said, There was no such deed done nor seen from the day that the children of Israel came up out of the land of Egypt unto this day: consider of it, take advice, and speak your minds . rr: -16 ; . Bwanyima Abaisraeli boona baaruga omu ndembo zaabo, baateeranira hamwe baine enaama emwe, okuruga ahari Daani okuhika Beeri-sheba, hamwe n'ab'ensi ya Gileadi, baateeranira Mizipa omu maisho ga MUKAMA.
en: Then all the children of Israel went out, and the congregation was gathered together as one man, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, with the land of Gilead, unto the LORD in Mizpeh.

rr: Abategyeki b'eihanga ryona ery'enganda za Israeli zoona, baayeyoreka omu mutwe gw'abantu ba Ruhanga, abashaija enkwata-rurara obusiriira buna abarikugyendesa ebigyere.
en: And the chief of all the people, even of all the tribes of Israel, presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God, four hundred thousand footmen that drew sword.

rr: (Kandi Ababenyamiini bakaba bahuriire ku Abaisraeli bainamukire Mizipa.) Abaisraeli baabuuza bati: Tugambire, ekibi ekyo kikakorwa kita?
en: (Now the children of Benjamin heard that the children of Israel were gone up to Mizpeh.) Then said the children of Israel, Tell us , how was this wickedness?

rr: Ogwo Muleevi, iba w'omukazi owaitsirwe, yaagarukamu naagira ati: Nyowe nkaija Gibea eya Benyamiini n'omukazi wangye w'ekinyanshunju kuraarayo.
en: And the Levite, the husband of the woman that was slain, answered and said, I came into Gibeah that belongeth to Benjamin, I and my concubine, to lodge.

rr: Abashaija ba Gibea bantaahirira, bankubira omu nju nyekiro; nyowe baayenda kuunyita, n'omukazi wangye baamuhamba n'amaani, yaafa.
en: And the men of Gibeah rose against me, and beset the house round about upon me by night, and thought to have slain me: and my concubine have they forced, that she is dead.

rr: Naakwata omukazi wangye, naamucwamu ebicweka, naabyohereza omu mashaza goona ag'obuhunguzi bwa Israeli; ahabw'okuba bakakora ekibi ky'obushambani, kandi ekihagaro omuri Israeli.
en: And I took my concubine, and cut her in pieces, and sent her throughout all the country of the inheritance of Israel: for they have committed lewdness and folly in Israel.

rr: Imwe Abaisraeli mwena, mureebe, mukihanuureho, mugambire aha ekishemereire kukorwa.
en: Behold, ye are all children of Israel; give here your advice and counsel.

rr: Abantu boona baimuka nk'omuntu omwe, nibagira bati: Tihaine n'omwe omuriitwe oraaze omu ihema rye, nari oraagarukye omu ka ye.
en: And all the people arose as one man, saying, We will not any of us go to his tent, neither will we any of us turn into his house.

rr: Kureka hati oku nikwo turaagire Gibea; nitwija kugiteera, twaheza kuteera enteenyu.
en: But now this shall be the thing which we will do to Gibeah; we will go up by lot against it;

rr: Kandi nitwija kutoorana abashaija ikumi omu bantu igana, na igana omu bantu rukumi, na rukumi omu bantu kakumi, nitubaiha omu nganda zoona eza Israeli, b'okuza kureetera engabo entanda, ezo ngabo ku ziraahikye Gibea eya Benyamiini, zibone kubakora nk'ebihagaro byona ebi baakozire omuri Israeli oku biri.
en: and we will take ten men of an hundred throughout all the tribes of Israel, and an hundred of a thousand, and a thousand out of ten thousand, to fetch victual for the people, that they may do, when they come to Gibeah of Benjamin, according to all the folly that they have wrought in Israel.

rr: Batyo Abaisraeli boona baateeranira hamwe, baine enaama emwe, kurwanisa orwo rurembo.
en: So all the men of Israel were gathered against the city, knit together as one man.

rr: -18 ; . Ab'enganda za Israeli baatuma entumwa omu ruganda rwona orwa Benyamiini, nizigira ziti: Eki ni kibi ki ekikozirwe omuriimwe?
en: And the tribes of Israel sent men through all the tribe of Benjamin, saying, What wickedness is this that is done among you?

rr: Mbwenu nu mutuhe abo bashaija ba Gibea abataine mugasho, tubaite, twihe ekibi omuri Israeli.
en: Now therefore deliver us the men, the children of Belial, which are in Gibeah, that we may put them to death, and put away evil from Israel.

rr: Kwonka Ababenyamiini baayanga kuhurira Abaisraeli beene waabo.
en: But the children of Benjamin would not hearken to the voice of their brethren the children of Israel:

rr: Ababenyamiini baaruga omu ndembo zaabo, baateeranira Gibea kurwanisa Abaisraeli.
en: but the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together out of the cities unto Gibeah, to go out to battle against the children of Israel.

rr: Eryo izooba baabara Ababenyamiini abarugire omu ndembo zaabo, abashaija enkwata-rurara obukumi bubiri n'enkumi mukaaga, otabariiremu ab'omuri Gibea, abashaija b'entoore magana mushanju.
en: And the children of Benjamin were numbered at that time out of the cities twenty and six thousand men that drew sword, beside the inhabitants of Gibeah, which were numbered seven hundred chosen men.

rr: Omuri abo bantu boona hakaba harimu abashaija b'entoore magana mushanju abarikutwara emosho; buri muntu omuribo akaba abaasa kurekyeza enjungu y'eibaare, n'akashokye akateera, atahembye.
en: Among all this people there were seven hundred chosen men lefthanded; every one could sling stones at an hair breadth , and not miss.

rr: N'Abaisraeli abaabazirwe, otabariiremu Ababenyamiini, bakaba bari obusiriira buna enkwata-rurara; kandi abo boona bakaba bari abarwani.
en: And the men of Israel, beside Benjamin, were numbered four hundred thousand men that drew sword: all these were men of war.

rr: Abaisraeli baimuka, baaza Beseeli, baabuuza Ruhanga obwengye, nibagira bati: Nibaahi omuriitwe abaraabanze kurwanisa Ababenyamiini?
en: And the children of Israel arose, and went up to the house of God, and asked counsel of God, and said, Which of us shall go up first to the battle against the children of Benjamin?

rr: MUKAMA yaagarukamu ati: Abayuda nibo baraabanzeyo.
en: And the LORD said, Judah shall go up first.

rr: Abaisraeli baimuka omu kasheeshe, baateera orusiisira kurwanisa Gibea
en: And the children of Israel rose up in the morning, and encamped against Gibeah.

rr: baahurura kuteera Ababenyamiini, baatenga orugamba kurwanira nabo Gibea.
en: And the men of Israel went out to battle against Benjamin; and the men of Israel put themselves in array to fight against them at Gibeah.

rr: Ababenyamiini baashohora, baita Abaisraeli, baabaraza nk'ebiti, haafa abantu obukumi bubiri n'enkumi ibiri.
en: And the children of Benjamin came forth out of Gibeah, and destroyed down to the ground of the Israelites that day twenty and two thousand men.

rr: Kwonka Abaisraeli baayezirika, baagaruka baatenga orugamba omu mwanya ogu baarutengyeiremu okubanza.
en: And the people the men of Israel encouraged themselves, and set their battle again in array in the place where they put themselves in array the first day.

rr: -36 ; . Abaisraeli bainamuka, baaririra omu maisho ga MUKAMA okuhitsya omu mwabazyo, baabuuza MUKAMA bati: Tugarukye turwane n'Ababenyamiini beene waitu? MUKAMA yaagarukamu ati: Nimwirooko mubateere.
en: (And the children of Israel went up and wept before the LORD until even, and asked counsel of the LORD , saying, Shall I go up again to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother? And the LORD said, Go up against him.)

rr: Batyo Abaisraeli bairirira Ababenyamiini kubarwanisa aha izooba rya kabiri.
en: And the children of Israel came near against the children of Benjamin the second day.

rr: Aha izooba eryo Ababenyamiini baaruga omuri Gibea, baabarwanisa, baagaruka baababingira kimwe, baabaitamu abantu kakumi n'enkumi munaana; kandi abo boona bakaba bari abashaija enkwata-rurara.
en: And Benjamin went forth against them out of Gibeah the second day, and destroyed down to the ground of the children of Israel again eighteen thousand men; all these drew the sword.

rr: Bwanyima Abaisraeli boona, engabo zoona, bainamuka, baaza Beseeli, baashutama omu maisho ga MUKAMA, baarira; eryo izooba baayesiibyakwo okuhitsya omu mwabazyo; baahonga ebitambo by'okwotsya n'empongano z'okusiima ahabw'obusingye omu maisho ga MUKAMA.
en: Then all the children of Israel, and all the people, went up, and came unto the house of God, and wept, and sat there before the LORD , and fasted that day until even, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD .

rr: Abaisraeli baabuuza MUKAMA, (ahakuba omuri ebyo biro eshanduukye y'endagaano ya MUKAMA niyo yaabaire eri
en: And the children of Israel enquired of the LORD , (for the ark of the covenant of God was there in those days,

rr: na Finehaasi mwene Eleazaari, mutabani wa Arooni niwe yaabaire aheereza MUKAMA omu maisho gaayo) nibagira bati: Tugarukye turwane n'Ababenyamiini beene waitu, nari turereere?
en: and Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, stood before it in those days,) saying, Shall I yet again go out to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother, or shall I cease?

rr: MUKAMA yaagarukamu ati: Nimwirooko; ahakuba nyencakare niinyija kubahayo omu mikono yaanyu.
en: And the LORD said, Go up; for to morrow I will deliver them into thine hand.

rr: Abaisraeli baataho ab'okugwera aha mbaju zoona eza Gibea.
en: And Israel set liers in wait round about Gibeah.

rr: Aha izooba rya kashatu Abaisraeli baahurura kuteera Ababenyamiini, baatenga orugamba kurwanira nabo Gibea, nk'oku babaire baarwaine nabo obundi.
en: And the children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day, and put themselves in array against Gibeah, as at other times.

rr: Ababenyamiini baashohora kubarwanisa, baabeihwabeihwa, baaruga omu rurembo; baatandika kuteera Abaisraeli n'okubaita nk'oku babaire baakozire obundi; baabaitira omu muhanda ogurikuza Beseeli n'ogurikuza Geeba, n'omu bwerere; baabaitamu abantu nka makumi ashatu.
en: And the children of Benjamin went out against the people, and were drawn away from the city; and they began to smite of the people, and kill, as at other times, in the highways, of which one goeth up to the house of God, and the other to Gibeah in the field, about thirty men of Israel.

rr: Ababenyamiini baagira bati: Twababinga nk'okubanza.
en: And the children of Benjamin said, They are smitten down before us, as at the first.

rr: Kwonka Abaisraeli baagira bati: Ka tuhungye, tubabeihabeihe, tubaihe omu rurembo tubahitsye omu mihanda.
en: But the children of Israel said, Let us flee, and draw them from the city unto the highways.

rr: Abaisraeli boona baimuka omu mwanya ogu babaire barimu, baatenga orugamba Baali-tamari; kandi abaabaire bagwereire baajumbutuka omu mwanya ogu babaire barimu Maaregeeba.
en: And all the men of Israel rose up out of their place, and put themselves in array at Baal-tamar: and the liers in wait of Israel came forth out of their places, even out of the meadows of Gibeah.

rr: Omu Baisraeli boona haarugamu abashaija entoore kakumi, baateera Gibea; orugamba rwahama; kwonka aba Gibea bakaba batamanyire ku bari omu kabi.
en: And there came against Gibeah ten thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and the battle was sore: but they knew not that evil was near them.

rr: MUKAMA yaasingura Ababenyamiini omu maisho g'Abaisraeli; eryo izooba Abaisraeli baacwekyereza omu Babenyamiini abantu obukumi bubiri n'enkumi itaano na igana; kandi abo boona bakaba bari abashaija enkwata-rurara.
en: And the LORD smote Benjamin before Israel: and the children of Israel destroyed of the Benjamites that day twenty and five thousand and an hundred men: all these drew the sword.

rr: Ababenyamiini baareeba Abaisraeli ku baabingwa, ahabw'okuba Abaisraeli bakabahunga ahabw'okwesiga abagwereire abu bataire haihi na Gibea.
en: So the children of Benjamin saw that they were smitten: for the men of Israel gave place to the Benjamites, because they trusted unto the liers in wait which they had set beside Gibeah.

rr: Abaabaire bagwereire baajumbutuka, baayetuura omuri Gibea, baacwekyereza orurembo rwona na rurara.
en: And the liers in wait hasted, and rushed upon Gibeah; and the liers in wait drew themselves along, and smote all the city with the edge of the sword.

rr: Kandi Abaisraeli boona bakaba baragaine akamanyiso n'abaabaire bagwereire, ngu ku baraacumbuutsye omwika mwingi nk'ekicu omu rurembo
en: Now there was an appointed sign between the men of Israel and the liers in wait, that they should make a great flame with smoke rise up out of the city.

rr: Abaisraeli bakubuukye, barwane. Obwo Ababenyamiini bakaba batandikire kubinga Abaisraeli n'okubaitamu abantu nka makumi ashatu; ahakuba bakagira bati: Buzimazima twababingira kimwe nk'okubanza.
en: And when the men of Israel retired in the battle, Benjamin began to smite and kill of the men of Israel about thirty persons: for they said, Surely they are smitten down before us, as in the first battle.

rr: Kwonka omwika ogurikushusha nk'enyomyo ku gwatandikire kucumbuuka omu rurembo, Ababenyamiini baareeba enyima, baashanga orurembo rwona nirucumbuuka omwika okuhika ahaiguru.
en: But when the flame began to arise up out of the city with a pillar of smoke, the Benjamites looked behind them, and, behold, the flame of the city ascended up to heaven.

rr: Abaisraeli baabahindukana, Ababenyamiini baashoberwa, ahakuba bakareeba akabi kaabahikaho.
en: And when the men of Israel turned again, the men of Benjamin were amazed: for they saw that evil was come upon them.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo baateera Abaisraeli amabega, baahunga nibatoora omu ihamba; kwonka engabo z'Abaisraeli zaabakurata zibahambize, kandi ezaarugire omu ndembo zaabatanga omumaisho, zaabacwekyereza.
en: Therefore they turned their backs before the men of Israel unto the way of the wilderness; but the battle overtook them; and them which came out of the cities they destroyed in the midst of them.

rr: Batyo baatangatanga Ababenyamiini embaju zoona, baababinga, baabaribatiirira okuruga ahari Noha, okuhika ahashungaine na Geeba oburugwa-izooba.
en: Thus they inclosed the Benjamites round about, and chased them, and trode them down with ease over against Gibeah toward the sunrising.

rr: Omu Babenyamiini haafamu abantu kakumi n'enkumi munaana, boona abaabaire bari amamanzi.
en: And there fell of Benjamin eighteen thousand men; all these were men of valour.

rr: Abaatsigaireho baahinduka, baahungira omu ihamba okuhika aha rukiri rwa Rimona; bakiri omu muhanda Abaisraeli baabaitamu abantu enkumi itaano; baagumizamu bababingire okuhika Gidomu, baitirayo abandi enkumi ibiri.
en: And they turned and fled toward the wilderness unto the rock of Rimmon: and they gleaned of them in the highways five thousand men; and pursued hard after them unto Gidom, and slew two thousand men of them.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo boona abaafiire omu Babenyamiini eryo izooba baahika obukumi bubiri n'enkumi itaano, abashaija enkwata-rurara kandi amamanzi.
en: So that all which fell that day of Benjamin were twenty and five thousand men that drew the sword; all these were men of valour.

rr: Kwonka abashaija magana mukaaga baahinduka, baahungira omu ihamba, baahika aha rukiri rwa Rimona, baagumayo okumara ameezi ana.
en: But six hundred men turned and fled to the wilderness unto the rock Rimmon, and abode in the rock Rimmon four months.

rr: Abaisraeli baagaruka baahindukana Ababenyamiini, baacwekyereza orurembo rwona na rurara, abantu n'amatungo n'ebi baashangiremu byona; kandi n'endembo zoona ezi baahikiremu baazootsya n'omuriro.
en: And the men of Israel turned again upon the children of Benjamin, and smote them with the edge of the sword, as well the men of every city, as the beast, and all that came to hand: also they set on fire all the cities that they came to.

rr: Kandi Abaisraeli bakaba barahiriire Mizipa bati: Tihariho muntu weena omuriitwe orihingira omu Babenyamiini muhara we.
en: Now the men of Israel had sworn in Mizpeh, saying, There shall not any of us give his daughter unto Benjamin to wife.

rr: Abantu baagaruka Beseeli, baaguma bashutami omu maisho ga Ruhanga okuhitsya omu mwabazyo, baarira nibaborooga munonga.
en: And the people came to the house of God, and abode there till even before God, and lifted up their voices, and wept sore;

rr: Baagira bati: Ai bambe MUKAMA, Ruhanga wa Israeli, eki kibeereireho ki, oruganda rumwe hati okubura omuri Israeli?
en: and said, O LORD God of Israel, why is this come to pass in Israel, that there should be to day one tribe lacking in Israel?

rr: Ku bwaseesire, abantu baimuka kare, baayombekayo eitambiro, baahonga ebitambo by'okwotsya n'empongano z'okusiima ahabw'obusingye.
en: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the people rose early, and built there an altar, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.

rr: Abaisraeli baabuuza bati: Omu nganda za Israeli otaizire mu iteeraniro ahari MUKAMA n'oha?
en: And the children of Israel said, Who is there among all the tribes of Israel that came not up with the congregation unto the LORD ?

rr: Ahakuba bakaba barahiire endahiro ehamire aha muntu weena oriba ataizire Mizipa ahari MUKAMA, nibagira bati: Buzimazima aryaitwa.
en: For they had made a great oath concerning him that came not up to the LORD to Mizpeh, saying, He shall surely be put to death.

rr: Abaisraeli baayefuuza ahabw'Ababenyamiini beene waabo, nibagira bati: Eri izooba hariho oruganda orucwirwe omuri Israeli.
en: And the children of Israel repented them for Benjamin their brother, and said, There is one tribe cut off from Israel this day.

rr: Mbwenu tugire tuta okusherurira abaahonokireho abakazi, ku turaabe twarahiire ngu tituribahingira bahara baitu?
en: How shall we do for wives for them that remain, seeing we have sworn by the LORD that we will not give them of our daughters to wives?

rr: Baagaruka baabuuza bati: Ni ruganda ki omu nganda za Israeli orutainamukire Mizipa ahari MUKAMA?
en: And they said, What one is there of the tribes of Israel that came not up to Mizpeh to the LORD ?

rr: Ku baagiire kwetegyereza, baashanga hataine n'omwe orugire Yabeshi-gileadi okwija omu rusiisira ahu bateeraniire
en: And, behold, there came none to the camp from Jabesh-gilead to the assembly.

rr: ahabw'okuba ku baabazire abantu, baashanga omu bantu ba Yabeshi-gileadi hatariho n'omwe.
en: For the people were numbered, and, behold, there were none of the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead there.

rr: Eiteeraniro ryona ryatumayo abashaija amamanzi, abarikukira abandi boona, kakumi n'enkumi ibiri, baabaragiira bati: Mugyende mucwekyereze aba Yabeshi-gileadi na rurara, n'abakazi baabo n'abaana baabo.
en: And the congregation sent thither twelve thousand men of the valiantest, and commanded them, saying, Go and smite the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead with the edge of the sword, with the women and the children.

rr: Eki mube nikyo mwakora; mucwekyerereze kimwe abashaija boona na buri mukazi weena oraraire n'omushaija.
en: And this is the thing that ye shall do, Ye shall utterly destroy every male, and every woman that hath lain by man.

rr: Omu ba Yabeshi-gileadi baashangayo abaishiki magana ana, abaabaire batakamanyaga bashaija; baabareeta omu rusiisira orwabaire ruri Shiilo omu nsi ya Kanaani.
en: And they found among the inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead four hundred young virgins, that had known no man by lying with any male: and they brought them unto the camp to Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.

rr: Eihanga ryona ryatuma aha Babenyamiini, abaabaire bari omu rukiri rwa Rimona, baabahuumuriza.
en: And the whole congregation sent some to speak to the children of Benjamin that were in the rock Rimmon, and to call peaceably unto them.

rr: Ababenyamiini baagaruka obwo; baabaha abo baishiki abu baakirize omu ba Yabeshi-gileadi; kwonka tibaabahika.
en: And Benjamin came again at that time; and they gave them wives which they had saved alive of the women of Jabesh-gilead: and yet so they sufficed them not.

rr: Abantu baagaruka baayefuuza ahabw'Ababenyamiini, ahabw'okuba MUKAMA akaba areetsire ekyasha omuri Israeli.
en: And the people repented them for Benjamin, because that the LORD had made a breach in the tribes of Israel.

rr: Bwanyima abakuru b'eihanga baagira bati: Mbwenu tugire tuta okusherurira abatsigaireho abakazi, abakazi ku baraabe bahweireho omuri Benyamiini?
en: Then the elders of the congregation said, How shall we do for wives for them that remain, seeing the women are destroyed out of Benjamin?

rr: Baagira bati: Ababenyamiini abahonokire aha icumu bashemereire kugira ab'okubahungurira, harekye kugira oruganda orwahwaho muri Israeli.
en: And they said, There must be an inheritance for them that be escaped of Benjamin, that a tribe be not destroyed out of Israel.

rr: Kwonka titurikubaasa kubahingira bahara baitu, ahabw'okuba Abaisraeli bakaba barahiire bati: Omuntu weena orihingira muhara we omu Babenyamiini akyenwe.
en: Howbeit we may not give them wives of our daughters: for the children of Israel have sworn, saying, Cursed be he that giveth a wife to Benjamin.

rr: Baagaruka baagira bati: Nimumanya ku habaho obugyenyi bwa MUKAMA buri mwaka omuri Shiilo, eri aha bukiizi-bwa-bumosho bwa Beseeli aha rubaju rw'oburugwa-izooba bw'omuhanda ogurikuruga Beseeli nigwinamuka Shekemu, kandi aha bukiizi-bwa-buryo bwa Lebona.
en: Then they said, Behold, there is a feast of the LORD in Shiloh yearly in a place which is on the north side of Beth-el, on the east side of the highway that goeth up from Beth-el to Shechem, and on the south of Lebonah.

rr: Baaragiira Ababenyamiini bati: Mwirooko muze omu misiri y'emizaabibu
en: Therefore they commanded the children of Benjamin, saying, Go and lie in wait in the vineyards;

rr: mugume mugwereire; abaishiki ba Shiilo ku baraabe nibaza kuzina, mugurukye omu misiri y'emizaabibu, buri muntu ayekwatire omukazi omuri abo baishiki ba Shiilo; bwanyima mugarukye omu nsi ya Benyamiini.
en: and see, and, behold, if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in dances, then come ye out of the vineyards, and catch you every man his wife of the daughters of Shiloh, and go to the land of Benjamin.

rr: Baishebo nari banyaanyabo ku baraije kututonganaho, nitwija kubagira tuti: Mubatuhe ahabw'embabazi, ahabw'okuba buri muntu tituramunyagiire mukazi omu rugamba; kandi naimwe timurababahaire; kuri niimwe mwababahaire, mukaagizire orubanja.
en: And it shall be, when their fathers or their brethren come unto us to complain, that we will say unto them, Be favourable unto them for our sakes: because we reserved not to each man his wife in the war: for ye did not give unto them at this time, that ye should be guilty.

rr: Ababenyamiini baakora batyo; baayekwatira abakazi omuri abo abaabaire nibaza kuzina, nk'oku abashaija baabaire nibaingana, baabatwara; bwanyima baagyenda, baagaruka omu buhunguzi bwabo, baayombeka endembo ezaabaire zisheenyirwe, baazituuramu.
en: And the children of Benjamin did so, and took them wives, according to their number, of them that danced, whom they caught: and they went and returned unto their inheritance, and repaired the cities, and dwelt in them.

rr: Kandi Abaisraeli baarugayo omu bunaku obwo, buri muntu yaagaruka omu ruganda rwe n'omuri beene waabo. Okuruga aho buri muntu yaaza omu buhunguzi bwe.
en: And the children of Israel departed thence at that time, every man to his tribe and to his family, and they went out from thence every man to his inheritance.

rr: Omu bunaku obwo hakaba hatariho mugabe omuri Israeli; kureka buri muntu akaba naayekorera nk'oku arikwenda.
en: In those days there was no king in Israel: every man did that which was right in his own eyes.

1 The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, of the priests that were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin:
2 to whom the word of the LORD came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.

3 It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, unto the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah king of Judah, unto the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.

rr: 4 Ekigambo kya MUKAMA kikanyijaho nikigira kiti
en: 4 Then the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
5 Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.
6 Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD ! behold, I cannot speak: for I am a child.

rr: 7 Kwonka MUKAMA yangira ati
en: 7 But the LORD said unto me, Say not, I am a child: for thou shalt go to all that I shall send thee, and whatsoever I command thee thou shalt speak.
8 Be not afraid of their faces: for I am with thee to deliver thee, saith the LORD .
9 Then the LORD put forth his hand, and touched my mouth. And the LORD said unto me, Behold, I have put my words in thy mouth.
10 See, I have this day set thee over the nations and over the kingdoms, to root out, and to pull down, and to destroy, and to throw down, to build, and to plant.
11 Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying, Jeremiah, what seest thou? And I said, I see a rod of an almond tree.

rr: 12 MUKAMA yangira ati: Waareeba gye; ahabw'okuba ntaire omutima aha kigambo kyangye kukihikiiriza.
en: 12 Then said the LORD unto me, Thou hast well seen: for I will hasten my word to perform it.
13 And the word of the LORD came unto me the second time, saying, What seest thou? And I said, I see a seething pot; and the face thereof is toward the north.

rr: 14 MUKAMA nikwo kungira ati: Akabi karyagwa aha batuuzi b'omu nsi egi boona nikaruga aha bukiizi-bwa-bumosho.
en: 14 Then the LORD said unto me, Out of the north an evil shall break forth upon all the inhabitants of the land.

15 For, lo, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north, saith the LORD ; and they shall come, and they shall set every one his throne at the entering of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all the walls thereof round about, and against all the cities of Judah.
16 And I will utter my judgments against them touching all their wickedness, who have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, and worshipped the works of their own hands.

rr: 17 Kwonka iwe, yezirikye, oimukye, obagambire ebi ndaakuragiire byona. Batakuhahaaza omutima, ntakaahahaaza ogwawe omu maisho gaabo.
en: 17 Thou therefore gird up thy loins, and arise, and speak unto them all that I command thee: be not dismayed at their faces, lest I confound thee before them.

18 For, behold, I have made thee this day a defenced city, and an iron pillar, and brasen walls against the whole land, against the kings of Judah, against the princes thereof, against the priests thereof, and against the people of the land.
19 And they shall fight against thee; but they shall not prevail against thee; for I am with thee, saith the LORD , to deliver thee.

rr: 1 Ekigambo kya MUKAMA kikanyijaho nikigira kiti
en: 1 Moreover the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

2 Go and cry in the ears of Jerusalem, saying, Thus saith the LORD ; I remember thee, the kindness of thy youth, the love of thine espousals, when thou wentest after me in the wilderness, in a land that was not sown.
3 Israel was holiness unto the LORD , and the firstfruits of his increase: all that devour him shall offend; evil shall come upon them, saith the LORD .

rr: 4 Imwe ab'enju ya Yakobo, naiwe enganda zoona ez'enju ya Israeli, muhurire ekigambo kya MUKAMA.
en: 4 Hear ye the word of the LORD , O house of Jacob, and all the families of the house of Israel:
5 thus saith the LORD , What iniquity have your fathers found in me, that they are gone far from me, and have walked after vanity, and are become vain?

6 Neither said they, Where is the LORD that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, that led us through the wilderness, through a land of deserts and of pits, through a land of drought, and of the shadow of death, through a land that no man passed through, and where no man dwelt?
7 And I brought you into a plentiful country, to eat the fruit thereof and the goodness thereof; but when ye entered, ye defiled my land, and made mine heritage an abomination.

8 The priests said not, Where is the LORD ? and they that handle the law knew me not: the pastors also transgressed against me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal, and walked after things that do not profit.
9 Wherefore I will yet plead with you, saith the LORD , and with your children's children will I plead.

rr: 10 Mwambukye muhikye aha birwa bya Kitimu, mureeba
en: 10 For pass over the isles of Chittim, and see; and send unto Kedar, and consider diligently, and see if there be such a thing.
11 Hath a nation changed their gods, which are yet no gods? but my people have changed their glory for that which doth not profit.
12 Be astonished, O ye heavens, at this, and be horribly afraid, be ye very desolate, saith the LORD .
13 For my people have committed two evils; they have forsaken me the fountain of living waters, and hewed them out cisterns, broken cisterns, that can hold no water.
14 Is Israel a servant? is he a homeborn slave? why is he spoiled?
15 The young lions roared upon him, and yelled, and they made his land waste: his cities are burned without inhabitant.
16 Also the children of Noph and Tahapanes have broken the crown of thy head.
17 Hast thou not procured this unto thyself, in that thou hast forsaken the LORD thy God, when he led thee by the way?
18 And now what hast thou to do in the way of Egypt, to drink the waters of Sihor? or what hast thou to do in the way of Assyria, to drink the waters of the river?
