18 Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will punish the king of Babylon and his land, as I have punished the king of Assyria.
19 And I will bring Israel again to his habitation, and he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan, and his soul shall be satisfied upon mount Ephraim and Gilead.

rr: 20 Omu biro ebyo n'omu bunaku obwo eby'okushiisha biryasherurwa omuri Israeli, biburel; kandi n'ekibi kiryasherurwa omuri Yuda, habure ekibi kyona ekyashangwamu; ahabw'okuba ndyasaasira abu nditsigamu abaatsigaireho; nikwo MUKAMA arikugira.
en: 20 In those days, and in that time, saith the LORD , the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for, and there shall be none; and the sins of Judah, and they shall not be found: for I will pardon them whom I reserve.

rr: 21 Inamuka, oteere ensi ya Merasaimu
en: 21 Go up against the land of Merathaim, even against it, and against the inhabitants of Pekod: waste and utterly destroy after them, saith the LORD , and do according to all that I have commanded thee.
22 A sound of battle is in the land, and of great destruction.
23 How is the hammer of the whole earth cut asunder and broken! how is Babylon become a desolation among the nations!
24 I have laid a snare for thee, and thou art also taken, O Babylon, and thou wast not aware: thou art found, and also caught, because thou hast striven against the LORD .
25 The LORD hath opened his armoury, and hath brought forth the weapons of his indignation: for this is the work of the Lord GOD of hosts in the land of the Chaldeans.

rr: 26 Nimwije, mugiteere, nimugireetwa embaju zoona
en: 26 Come against her from the utmost border, open her storehouses: cast her up as heaps, and destroy her utterly: let nothing of her be left.
27 Slay all her bullocks; let them go down to the slaughter: woe unto them! for their day is come, the time of their visitation.
28 The voice of them that flee and escape out of the land of Babylon, to declare in Zion the vengeance of the LORD our God, the vengeance of his temple.

29 Call together the archers against Babylon: all ye that bend the bow, camp against it round about; let none thereof escape: recompense her according to her work; according to all that she hath done, do unto her: for she hath been proud against the LORD , against the Holy One of Israel.
30 Therefore shall her young men fall in the streets, and all her men of war shall be cut off in that day, saith the LORD .

rr: 31 Mukama RUHANGA ow'amahe naagira ati
en: 31 Behold, I am against thee, O thou most proud, saith the Lord GOD of hosts: for thy day is come, the time that I will visit thee.

rr: 32 Omunyamaryo aryateera entsibo, agwe
en: 32 And the most proud shall stumble and fall, and none shall raise him up: and I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it shall devour all round about him.
33 Thus saith the LORD of hosts; The children of Israel and the children of Judah were oppressed together: and all that took them captives held them fast; they refused to let them go.
34 Their Redeemer is strong; The LORD of hosts is his name: he shall throughly plead their cause, that he may give rest to the land, and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon.
35 A sword is upon the Chaldeans, saith the LORD , and upon the inhabitants of Babylon, and upon her princes, and upon her wise men .
36 A sword is upon the liars; and they shall dote: a sword is upon her mighty men; and they shall be dismayed.

37 A sword is upon their horses, and upon their chariots, and upon all the mingled people that are in the midst of her; and they shall become as women: a sword is upon her treasures; and they shall be robbed.
38 A drought is upon her waters; and they shall be dried up: for it is the land of graven images, and they are mad upon their idols.

39 Therefore the wild beasts of the desert with the wild beasts of the islands shall dwell there , and the owls shall dwell therein: and it shall be no more inhabited for ever; neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation.
40 As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof, saith the LORD ; so shall no man abide there, neither shall any son of man dwell therein.
41 Behold, a people shall come from the north, and a great nation, and many kings shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.

rr: 42 Bakwaitse amata na'amacumu
en: 42 They shall hold the bow and the lance: they are cruel, and will not shew mercy: their voice shall roar like the sea, and they shall ride upon horses, every one put in array, like a man to the battle, against thee, O daughter of Babylon.

rr: 43 Omugabe wa Babulooni ahuriire enkuru yaabo
en: 43 The king of Babylon hath heard the report of them, and his hands waxed feeble: anguish took hold of him, and pangs as of a woman in travail.

44 Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan unto the habitation of the strong: but I will make them suddenly run away from her: and who is a chosen man, that I may appoint over her? for who is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me?

rr: 45 N'ahabw'ekyo nimuhurire enaama ei MUKAMA acumire kurwanisa Babulooni, n'ebi amaririire kukora kurwansia ensi y'Abakaludaaya. Buzimazima abaana b'entaama zaabo baryakururwa batwarwe, n'eka yaabo eshoberwe munong aahabw'ebiribabaho.
en: 45 Therefore hear ye the counsel of the LORD , that he hath taken against Babylon; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitation desolate with them.

rr: 46 Ensi eryatetemesibwa obwaku bw'okukwatwa kwa Babulooni, eiraka ry'okuborooga kwayo rihuririrwe omu mahanga.
en: 46 At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth is moved, and the cry is heard among the nations.
1 Thus saith the LORD ; Behold, I will raise up against Babylon, and against them that dwell in the midst of them that rise up against me, a destroying wind;
2 and will send unto Babylon fanners, that shall fan her, and shall empty her land: for in the day of trouble they shall be against her round about.

rr: 3 Omurasi arekye kunanuura obuta bwe
en: 3 Against him that bendeth let the archer bend his bow, and against him that lifteth himself up in his brigandine: and spare ye not her young men; destroy ye utterly all her host.

rr: 4 emitumbi yaayo eryarambirirana omu nsi y'Abakaludaaya
en: 4 Thus the slain shall fall in the land of the Chaldeans, and they that are thrust through in her streets.
5 For Israel hath not been forsaken, nor Judah of his God, of the LORD of hosts; though their land was filled with sin against the Holy One of Israel.
6 Flee out of the midst of Babylon, and deliver every man his soul: be not cut off in her iniquity; for this is the time of the LORD 's vengeance; he will render unto her a recompence.
7 Babylon hath been a golden cup in the LORD 's hand, that made all the earth drunken: the nations have drunken of her wine; therefore the nations are mad.
8 Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed: howl for her; take balm for her pain, if so be she may be healed.
9 We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed: forsake her, and let us go every one into his own country: for her judgment reacheth unto heaven, and is lifted up even to the skies.
10 The LORD hath brought forth our righteousness: come, and let us declare in Zion the work of the LORD our God.

11 Make bright the arrows; gather the shields: the LORD hath raised up the spirit of the kings of the Medes: for his device is against Babylon, to destroy it; because it is the vengeance of the LORD , the vengeance of his temple.

12 Set up the standard upon the walls of Babylon, make the watch strong, set up the watchmen, prepare the ambushes: for the LORD hath both devised and done that which he spake against the inhabitants of Babylon.
13 O thou that dwellest upon many waters, abundant in treasures, thine end is come, and the measure of thy covetousness.
14 The LORD of hosts hath sworn by himself, saying , Surely I will fill thee with men, as with caterpillers; and they shall lift up a shout against thee.
15 He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heaven by his understanding.

rr: 16 Ku agamba n'eiraka rye
en: 16 When he uttereth his voice, there is a multitude of waters in the heavens; and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth: he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures.

rr: 17 Buri muntu ni nk'enyamaishwa, taine bwengye
en: 17 Every man is brutish by his knowledge; every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.

rr: 18 Tibiine mugasho, n'omurimo gw'okubeihabeiha
en: 18 They are vanity, the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.

rr: 19 Ogwo ori omugabo gwa Yakobo ti nkabyo
en: 19 The portion of Jacob is not like them; for he is the former of all things: and Israel is the rod of his inheritance: the LORD of hosts is his name.
20 Thou art my battle axe and weapons of war: for with thee will I break in pieces the nations, and with thee will I destroy kingdoms;

rr: 21 Niiwe ncwagacwaguza embaraasi n'ogitembire
en: 21 and with thee will I break in pieces the horse and his rider; and with thee will I break in pieces the chariot and his rider;
22 with thee also will I break in pieces man and woman; and with thee will I break in pieces old and young; and with thee will I break in pieces the young man and the maid;

rr: 23 Niiwe ncwagacwaguza omuriisa n'ebusyo bwe
en: 23 I will also break in pieces with thee the shepherd and his flock; and with thee will I break in pieces the husbandman and his yoke of oxen; and with thee will I break in pieces captains and rulers.
24 And I will render unto Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Zion in your sight, saith the LORD .

25 Behold, I am against thee, O destroying mountain, saith the LORD , which destroyest all the earth: and I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and roll thee down from the rocks, and will make thee a burnt mountain.
26 And they shall not take of thee a stone for a corner, nor a stone for foundations; but thou shalt be desolate for ever, saith the LORD .

27 Set ye up a standard in the land, blow the trumpet among the nations, prepare the nations against her, call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashchenaz; appoint a captain against her; cause the horses to come up as the rough caterpillers.
28 Prepare against her the nations with the kings of the Medes, the captains thereof, and all the rulers thereof, and all the land of his dominion.

rr: 29 Mbwenu ensi neetetema, neeshamba ahabw'obusaasi
en: 29 And the land shall tremble and sorrow: for every purpose of the LORD shall be performed against Babylon, to make the land of Babylon a desolation without an inhabitant.
30 The mighty men of Babylon have forborn to fight, they have remained in their holds: their might hath failed; they became as women: they have burned her dwellingplaces; her bars are broken.
31 One post shall run to meet another, and one messenger to meet another, to shew the king of Babylon that his city is taken at one end,

rr: 32 Enyambukiro zikwatsirwe
en: 32 and that the passages are stopped, and the reeds they have burned with fire, and the men of war are affrighted.
33 For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; The daughter of Babylon is like a threshingfloor, it is time to thresh her: yet a little while, and the time of her harvest shall come.

rr: 34 Nebukadeneeza omugabe wa Babulooni akanshonshomera
en: 34 Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon hath devoured me, he hath crushed me, he hath made me an empty vessel, he hath swallowed me up like a dragon, he hath filled his belly with my delicates, he hath cast me out.

rr: 35 K'omutuuzi wa Saayuuni agire ati
en: 35 The violence done to me and to my flesh be upon Babylon, shall the inhabitant of Zion say; and my blood upon the inhabitants of Chaldea, shall Jerusalem say.

rr: 36 Nikyo MUKAMA arikugirira ati
en: 36 Therefore thus saith the LORD ; Behold, I will plead thy cause, and take vengeance for thee; and I will dry up her sea, and make her springs dry.
37 And Babylon shall become heaps, a dwellingplace for dragons, an astonishment, and an hissing, without an inhabitant.
38 They shall roar together like lions: they shall yell as lions' whelps.

rr: 39 Ku bariba bakiine ekiniga, ndyabateekyera obugyenyi
en: 39 In their heat I will make their feasts, and I will make them drunken, that they may rejoice, and sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, saith the LORD .

rr: 40 Ndyabashuumya omu ibaagiro nk'abaana b'entaama
en: 40 I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams with he goats.
41 How is Sheshach taken! and how is the praise of the whole earth surprised! how is Babylon become an astonishment among the nations!
42 The sea is come up upon Babylon: she is covered with the multitude of the waves thereof.

rr: 43 Endembo zaayo zihindukire ekirikutiinisa
en: 43 Her cities are a desolation, a dry land, and a wilderness, a land wherein no man dwelleth, neither doth any son of man pass thereby.

44 And I will punish Bel in Babylon, and I will bring forth out of his mouth that which he hath swallowed up: and the nations shall not flow together any more unto him: yea, the wall of Babylon shall fall.

rr: 45 Imwe bantu bangye 'mwe, nimugirugyemu!
en: 45 My people, go ye out of the midst of her, and deliver ye every man his soul from the fierce anger of the LORD .

46 And lest your heart faint, and ye fear for the rumour that shall be heard in the land; a rumour shall both come one year, and after that in another year shall come a rumour, and violence in the land, ruler against ruler.

rr: 47 N'ahabw'ekyo obuaku nibwija kuhika
en: 47 Therefore, behold, the days come, that I will do judgment upon the graven images of Babylon: and her whole land shall be confounded, and all her slain shall fall in the midst of her.
48 Then the heaven and the earth, and all that is therein, shall sing for Babylon: for the spoilers shall come unto her from the north, saith the LORD .

rr: 49 Babulooni eshemereire kwitwa, ekaturwa Abaisraeli abaitsirwe
en: 49 As Babylon hath caused the slain of Israel to fall, so at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth.
50 Ye that have escaped the sword, go away, stand not still: remember the LORD afar off, and let Jerusalem come into your mind.
51 We are confounded, because we have heard reproach: shame hath covered our faces: for strangers are come into the sanctuaries of the LORD 's house.
52 Wherefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD , that I will do judgment upon her graven images: and through all her land the wounded shall groan.
53 Though Babylon should mount up to heaven, and though she should fortify the height of her strength, yet from me shall spoilers come unto her, saith the LORD .

rr: 54 Nimuhurire! Okutaka nikuruga Babulooni!
en: 54 A sound of a cry cometh from Babylon, and great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans:

rr: 55 Ahakuba MUKAMA naahindura Babulooni amatongo
en: 55 because the LORD hath spoiled Babylon, and destroyed out of her the great voice; when her waves do roar like great waters, a noise of their voice is uttered:
56 because the spoiler is come upon her, even upon Babylon, and her mighty men are taken, every one of their bows is broken: for the LORD God of recompences shall surely requite.

rr: 57 Ndyasinza abanyiginya baayo, abanyabwengye baayo
en: 57 And I will make drunk her princes, and her wise men , her captains, and her rulers, and her mighty men: and they shall sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, saith the King, whose name is The LORD of hosts.

58 Thus saith the LORD of hosts; The broad walls of Babylon shall be utterly broken, and her high gates shall be burned with fire; and the people shall labour in vain, and the folk in the fire, and they shall be weary.

59 The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah into Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. And this Seraiah was a quiet prince.
60 So Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come upon Babylon, even all these words that are written against Babylon.

rr: 61 Yeremia yaagira Seraaya ati: Ku oraahikye Babulooni, otabura kushoma ebyo bigambo byona
en: 61 And Jeremiah said to Seraiah, When thou comest to Babylon, and shalt see, and shalt read all these words;

rr: 62 kandi ogire oti: Ai bambe MUKAMA, ogambire akabi aha mwanya ogu kuguherekyereza, ngu hatagira owaagutuuramu, yaaba bantu nari amatungo, kureka gube amatongo ebiro byona.
en: 62 then shalt thou say, O LORD , thou hast spoken against this place, to cut it off, that none shall remain in it, neither man nor beast, but that it shall be desolate for ever.
63 And it shall be, when thou hast made an end of reading this book, that thou shalt bind a stone to it, and cast it into the midst of Euphrates:

rr: 64 kandi ogire oti: Oku nikwo Babulooni erimirwa, etagarukye kutuuhuuka bundi ahabw'akabi aku ndigireetaho.
en: 64 and thou shalt say, Thus shall Babylon sink, and shall not rise from the evil that I will bring upon her: and they shall be weary.
1 Zedekiah was one and twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
2 And he did that which was evil in the eyes of the LORD , according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

rr: 3 Buzimazima ebyo byagwisa kubi MUKAMA; kandi hoona ebyo eby'omuri Yerusaalemu na Yuda byayeyongyera kuba kubi, okuhitsya obu MUKAMA yaababingire omu maisho ge.
en: 3 For through the anger of the LORD it came to pass in Jerusalem and Judah, till he had cast them out from his presence, that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

4 And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it, and built forts against it round about.

rr: 5 Rutyo orurembo rwagotwa okuhitsya omu mwaka gwa ikumi na gumwe ogw'omu butegyeki bw'omugabe Zedia.
en: 5 So the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.

rr: 6 Aha kiro kya mwenda eky'omu kwezi kwa kana, enjara yaaba nyingi omu rurembo, yaahebesereza, abantu b'omuri egyo nsi baabura eby'okurya.
en: 6 And in the fourth month, in the ninth day of the month, the famine was sore in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.

rr: 7 Bwanyima orugo rw'orurembo rwasheenywaho ah'okuraba, abarwani boona baacwa, baashohora nyekiro, baahunga, baaraba omu irembo ry'ahagati y'engo zombi, eirir aha musiri gw'omugabe, baatoora ogurikuza Araba; obwo Abakaludaaya bagotsire orurembo.
en: 7 Then the city was broken up, and all the men of war fled, and went forth out of the city by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king's garden; (now the Chaldeans were by the city round about:) and they went by the way of the plain.

rr: 8 Kwonka eihe ry'Abakaludaaya ryaza omugabe Zedekia omu kirari, ryamukwatira omu ruhita rwa Yeriko, engabo ze zoona zaamuhungaho, zaataataana.
en: 8 But the army of the Chaldeans pursued after the king, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.

rr: 9 Batyo baakwata omugabe Zedekia, baamutwara aha mugabe wa Babulooni Ribula omu nsi ya Hamasi, yaamucwera orubanja.
en: 9 Then they took the king, and carried him up unto the king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; where he gave judgment upon him.

rr: 10 Omugabe wa Babulooni yaamwitira abatabani omumaisho, n'abanyiginya ba Yuda boona yaabaitira Ribula.
en: 10 And the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes: he slew also all the princes of Judah in Riblah.
11 Then he put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him in chains, and carried him to Babylon, and put him in prison till the day of his death.

12 Now in the fifth month, in the tenth day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzar-adan, captain of the guard, which served the king of Babylon, into Jerusalem,

rr: 13 Yaayotsya enju ya MUKAMA, na nyaruju y'omugabe, n'amaju ga Yerusaalemu goona; eyetwa enju mpango yoona yaagyotsya.
en: 13 and burned the house of the LORD , and the king's house; and all the houses of Jerusalem, and all the houses of the great men , burned he with fire:

rr: 14 Eihe ryona ery'Abakaludaaya, eri ogwo mukru w'abarinzi yaabaire aine, ryasheenya engo zoona ezaabaire zeehinguriririize Yerusaalemu.
en: 14 and all the army of the Chaldeans, that were with the captain of the guard, brake down all the walls of Jerusalem round about.

15 Then Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard carried away captive certain of the poor of the people, and the residue of the people that remained in the city, and those that fell away, that fell to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the multitude.

rr: 16 Kwonka Nebuzaradaani ogwo omukuru w'abarinzi yaatsigamu abandi abarikukiza abandi obworo kuba ab'okurinda emizaabibu n'ab'okuhinga.
en: 16 But Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard left certain of the poor of the land for vinedressers and for husbandmen.

17 Also the pillars of brass that were in the house of the LORD , and the bases, and the brasen sea that was in the house of the LORD , the Chaldeans brake, and carried all the brass of them to Babylon.

rr: 18 Baatwara enyungu n'ebyoma eby'okuyooza eiju, na makansi, n'enyabya, n'enyabya z'obubaane, n'ebindi bintu by'emiringa byona ebyabaire bikoresibwa omu murimo gwa hekalu
en: 18 The caldrons also, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the bowls, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.

rr: 19 kandi n'enyabya nkye, n'eby'okuguhisa omuriro, n'enyabya mpango, n'enyungu, n'ebikondo by'etabaaza, n'eby'okutamu obubaane, n'enyabya z'empongano ez'ebirikushukwa. Ebintu ebyabaire bikozirwe omu zaabu, omukru w'abarinzi yaabitwara biri ezaabu, n'eby'efeeza yaabitwara biri efeeza.
en: 19 And the basons, and the firepans, and the bowls, and the caldrons, and the candlesticks, and the spoons, and the cups; that which was of gold in gold, and that which was of silver in silver, took the captain of the guard away.

rr: 20 Enyomyo ziri zombi, n'ekitanka, n'enimi z'miringa ikumi na ibiri, ezi ekyo kitanka kyabaire kitairweho, n'ebitebe by'ebinaabiro, ebi omugabe Sulemaani yaakozire kukoresa omu nju ya MUKAMA, emiringa yaabyo yoona ekaba etarikubaasa kupimwa.
en: 20 The two pillars, one sea, and twelve brasen bulls that were under the bases, which king Solomon had made in the house of the LORD : the brass of all these vessels was without weight.

rr: 21 Eby'ezo nyomyo, oburaingwa bw'emwe bukaba buri mikono ikumi na munaana, obuhango bwayo okugyehinguririza mikono ikumi n'ebiri, n'omuzimba gwayo enkumu ina, kandi omunda eri omurangara.
en: 21 And concerning the pillars, the height of one pillar was eighteen cubits; and a fillet of twelve cubits did compass it; and the thickness thereof was four fingers: it was hollow.

rr: 22 Aha mutwe gwayo ekaba eine omutwe gw'omikono etaano; hashobeekaineho ebiri nk'akatimba n'amakomamahanga, byona biri emiringa, okugwehinguririza.
en: 22 And a chapiter of brass was upon it; and the height of one chapiter was five cubits, with network and pomegranates upon the chapiters round about, all of brass.

rr: Enyomyo ya kabiri nayo ekaba eine ebirikushusha bityo hamwe n'amakomamahanga.
en: The second pillar also and the pomegranates were like unto these.

rr: 23 Omu mbaju zaayo hakaba harimu makomamahanga makumi mwenda na maukaaga; n'amakomamahanga goona agaabaire gari ahari ako katimba gakaba gari igana.
en: 23 And there were ninety and six pomegranates on a side; and all the pomegranates upon the network were an hundred round about.
24 And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:

rr: 25 kandi omu rurembo yaihamu omukuru w'engabo owaabaire naategyeka abaserukare, n'abashaija mushanju b'omu ishengyero ry'omugabe, abashangirwe omu rurembo, n'omuhandiiki w'omukuru w'eihe owaabaire ahandiika abantu b'omuri egyo nsi, kandi n'abashaija makumi mukaaga b'omuri egyo nsi abashangirwe omu rurembo.
en: 25 he took also out of the city an eunuch, which had the charge of the men of war; and seven men of them that were near the king's person, which were found in the city; and the principal scribe of the host, who mustered the people of the land; and threescore men of the people of the land, that were found in the midst of the city.

rr: 26 Yaabatwara, yaabahitsya omugabe wa Babulooni omuri Ribula.
en: 26 So Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.

rr: 27 Omugabe wa Babulooni yaabateera, yaabaitira Ribula omu nsi ya Hamasi.
en: 27 And the king of Babylon smote them, and put them to death in Riblah in the land of Hamath.

rr: Batyo Abayuda baihwa omu nsi yaabo, baatwarwa bari enkwata.
en: Thus Judah was carried away captive out of his own land.
28 This is the people whom Nebuchadrezzar carried away captive: in the seventh year three thousand Jews and three and twenty:

rr: 29 omu mwaka gwa ikumi na munaana yaiha omuri Yerusaalemu abantu magana munaana na makumi ashatu na babiri, yaabatwara bari enkwatwa
en: 29 in the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar he carried away captive from Jerusalem eight hundred thirty and two persons:

rr: 30 n'omu mwaka gwa makumi abiri n'eshatu ogw'omu busingye bwa Nebukadeneea, Nebuzaradaani omukuru w'abarinzi yaatwara Abayudaaya magana mushanju na makumi ana na bataano; abntu boona abaatwairwe bakahika enkumi ina na magana mukaaga.
en: 30 in the three and twentieth year of Nebuchadrezzar, Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the Jews seven hundred forty and five persons: all the persons were four thousand and six hundred.

31 And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, in the five and twentieth day of the month, that Evil-merodach king of Babylon in the first year of his reign lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah, and brought him forth out of prison,

rr: 32 yaagamba gye nawe, yaamuha ekitebe ekirikukira eby'abandi bagabe abaabaire bari hamwe nawe Babulooni.
en: 32 and spake kindly unto him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that were with him in Babylon,

rr: 33 Atyo Yehoyakiini yaajuura ebijwaro bye by'ekihome. Okuruga aho yaaguma naariira aha meeza y'omugabe ebiro byona ebi yaamazire.
en: 33 and changed his prison garments: and he did continually eat bread before him all the days of his life.

rr: 34 Kandi eby'okumutunga omugabe yaaguma naamuha omugabo ogutarikurugaho, nk'okwetenga kwe okwa buri izooba oku kwabaire kuri, ebiro byona ebi yaamazire okuhitsya obu yaafiire.
en: 34 And for his diet, there was a continual diet given him of the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.
1 In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
2 The same was in the beginning with God.
3 All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.
4 In him was life; and the life was the light of men.
5 And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.
6 There was a man sent from God, whose name was John.
7 The same came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light, that all men through him might believe.

rr: 8 We akaba atari Mushana ogwo; kwonka akaija kuhamya eby'Omushana.
en: 8 He was not that Light, but was sent to bear witness of that Light.

rr: 9 Hakaba hariho Omushana ogw'amazima, ogujwera abantu boona, ogwabaire nigwija omu nsi.
en: 9 That was the true Light, which lighteth every man that cometh into the world.

rr: 10 Akaba ari omu nsi, kandi ensi niwe yaagihangire, kwonka ensi teramumanyire.
en: 10 He was in the world, and the world was made by him, and the world knew him not.

rr: 11 Akaija owe, abaabaire bari abe tibaamwakiira
en: 11 He came unto his own, and his own received him not.
12 But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:
13 which were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
14 And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.
15 John bare witness of him, and cried, saying, This was he of whom I spake, He that cometh after me is preferred before me: for he was before me.
16 And of his fulness have all we received, and grace for grace.

rr: 17 Ahakuba Ebiragiro bikareetwa Musa; embabazi n'amazima byo byareetwa Yesu Kristo.
en: 17 For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ.
18 No man hath seen God at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him .

rr: 19 Oku nikwo kuhamya kwa Yohaana, obu Abayudaaya baamutumaho abanyamurwa n'Abaleevi abaarugire Yerusaalemu kumubuuza bati: Ori oha?
en: 19 And this is the record of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, Who art thou?

rr: 20 Yaabagambira butunu, atarikwehakana, naahamya ati: Nyowe tindi Kristo.
en: 20 And he confessed, and denied not; but confessed, I am not the Christ.
21 And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elias? And he saith, I am not. Art thou that prophet? And he answered, No.

rr: 22 Nikyo baamubuuriize bati: Iwe shi, ori oha, tubone kugarukamu abatutumire? Nooyegamba ota?
en: 22 Then said they unto him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?
23 He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said the prophet Esaias.

rr: 24 Abaatumirwe abo bakaba batumirwe Abafarisaayo.
en: 24 And they which were sent were of the Pharisees.

rr: 25 Baamubuuza bati: Ahabw'enki iwe noobatiza, ku oraabe otari Kristo, otari Eliya, nari shi nabi ori?
en: 25 And they asked him, and said unto him, Why baptizest thou then, if thou be not that Christ, nor Elias, neither that prophet?

rr: 26 Yohaana yaabagarukamu ati: Nyowe mbatiza n'amaizi; kwonka omuriimwe heemereiremu ou mutarikumanya
en: 26 John answered them, saying, I baptize with water: but there standeth one among you, whom ye know not;
27 he it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe's latchet I am not worthy to unloose.

rr: 28 Ebyo bikabaho omuri Besania seeri ya Yorudani, ahu Yohaana yaabaire naabatiriza.
en: 28 These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing.
29 The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.

rr: 30 Ogu niwe naagambireho nti: Enyima yangye nihaija omuntu orikunkira, ahabw'okuba akaba ariho ntakabaireho.
en: 30 This is he of whom I said, After me cometh a man which is preferred before me: for he was before me.

rr: 31 Kandi nyowe ahabwangye tindamumanyire; kwonka nkaija nimbatiza n'amaizi, ngu abone kushuuruurirwa Abaisraeli.
en: 31 And I knew him not: but that he should be made manifest to Israel, therefore am I come baptizing with water.
32 And John bare record, saying, I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and it abode upon him.

rr: 33 Nkaba ntamumanyire; kwonka Owantumire kubatiza n'amaizi, niwe yangambiire ati: Ou orireeba Omwoyo naashumaho, akamugumaho, Ogwo niwe abatiza n'Omwoyo Orikwera.
en: 33 And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize with water, the same said unto me, Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he which baptizeth with the Holy Ghost.

rr: 34 Naanye naareeba, naahamya nti, Ogwo n'Omwana wa Ruhanga.
en: 34 And I saw, and bare record that this is the Son of God.

rr: 35 Kandi ku bwaseesire, Yohaana akaba ayemereire n'abeegi be babiri
en: 35 Again the next day after John stood, and two of his disciples;

rr: 36 yaareeba Yesu naagyenda, yaagira ati: Reeba, Omwana gw'entaama wa Ruhanga!
en: 36 and looking upon Jesus as he walked, he saith, Behold the Lamb of God!

rr: 37 Abeegi abo bombi baamuhurira naagamba, baakuratira Yesu.
en: 37 And the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.

rr: 38 Yesu yaahinduka, yaareeba bamukaratiire, yaababuuza ati: Nimwenda ki?
en: 38 Then Jesus turned, and saw them following, and saith unto them, What seek ye?

rr: Baamugarukamu bati: Rabi, (amakuru gaakyo ngu, Mwegyesa,) nooraara hi?
en: They said unto him, Rabbi, (which is to say, being interpreted, Master,) where dwellest thou?

rr: 39 Yaabagira ati: Mwije muhareebe.
en: 39 He saith unto them, Come and see.

rr: Baija, baareeba ahu yaabaire naaraara, baaguma nawe ekyo kiro, ahakuba eshaaha zikaba ziri nka ikumi.
en: They came and saw where he dwelt, and abode with him that day: for it was about the tenth hour.
40 One of the two which heard John speak , and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter's brother.

rr: 41 Yaabanza kusherura mukuru we Simooni, yaamugira ati: Tureebire Mesia, (amakuru gaakyo ngu # 1:41 Kristo niwe Mesia, byombi nibimanyisa Owaashukirweho amajuta. Kristo).
en: 41 He first findeth his own brother Simon, and saith unto him, We have found the Messias, which is, being interpreted, the Christ.
42 And he brought him to Jesus. And when Jesus beheld him, he said, Thou art Simon the son of Jona: thou shalt be called Cephas, which is by interpretation, A stone.

rr: 43 Ku bwaseesire, Yesu yaayenda kurugayo kuza Galilaaya. Yaareeba Filipo, yaamugira ati: Nkurata.
en: 43 The day following Jesus would go forth into Galilee, and findeth Philip, and saith unto him, Follow me.

rr: 44 Kandi Filipo ogwo akaba ari owa Besesaida, tauni y'ow'aba Anderea na Petero.
en: 44 Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
45 Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith unto him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, did write, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.
46 And Nathanael said unto him, Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip saith unto him, Come and see.
47 Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and saith of him, Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!

rr: 48 Nasanaeli yaamugira ati: Wammanyisibwa ki?
en: 48 Nathanael saith unto him, Whence knowest thou me?

rr: Yesu yaamugarukamu ati: Filipo atakakwetsire, obu waaba ori ahansi y'omutiini, naakureeba.
en: Jesus answered and said unto him, Before that Philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig tree, I saw thee.
49 Nathanael answered and saith unto him, Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art the King of Israel.

rr: 50 Yesu yaamugarukamu ati: Ahabw'okukugambira nti, Naakureeba ahansi y'omutiini, nikyo waikiririza? Oryareeba ebikuru ebirikukira ebyo.
en: 50 Jesus answered and said unto him, Because I said unto thee, I saw thee under the fig tree, believest thou? thou shalt see greater things than these.
51 And he saith unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Hereafter ye shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man.

rr: 1 Aha kiro kya kashatu hakabaho obugyenyi bw'okushwera omuri Kaana eya Galilaaya, na nyina wa Yesu akaba ariyo.
en: 1 And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Jesus was there:

rr: 2 Yesu nawe akeetwa aha bugyenyi n'abeegi be.
en: 2 and both Jesus was called, and his disciples, to the marriage.

rr: 3 Bwanyima, viinyo ku yaahweire, nyina wa Yesu yaamugira ati: Tibaine viinyo.
en: 3 And when they wanted wine, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine.
4 Jesus saith unto her, Woman, what have I to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come.

rr: 5 Nyina yaagira abaheereza ati: Eki araabaragiire kyona, mukikore.
en: 5 His mother saith unto the servants, Whatsoever he saith unto you, do it .

rr: 6 Kandi hakaba hariho enyungu mpango mukaaga, ezibaizire omu mabaare, ezaabaire zihigikiirwe aho, zitairweho ahabw'okweyeza, nk'emigyenzo y'Abayudaaya oku eri; enyungu emwe ekaba ebamu enjoga ibiri nari ishatu.
en: 6 And there were set there six waterpots of stone, after the manner of the purifying of the Jews, containing two or three firkins apiece.

rr: 7 Yesu yaabaragiira ati: Mwijuze enyungu amaizi. Baaziijuriza kimwe.
en: 7 Jesus saith unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim.

rr: 8 Yaabagira ati: Mbwenu mutahe, mutwarire omukuru w'obugyenyi. Baamutwarira.
en: 8 And he saith unto them, Draw out now, and bear unto the governor of the feast. And they bare it .

rr: 9 Omukuru w'obugyenyi, ku yaarorize aha maizi agaahinduka viinyo, atarikumanya i yaaruga, (kwonka abaheereza abatahire amaizi bo nibakimanya) yaayeta kishwera
en: 9 When the ruler of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine, and knew not whence it was: (but the servants which drew the water knew;) the governor of the feast called the bridegroom,

rr: 10 yaamugira ati: Omuntu weena abanza kugabura viinyo enungi; bwanyima, abantu ku bahaaga, abaha viinyo etanuzire; kwonka iwe obiikire enungi okuhitsya hati.
en: 10 and saith unto him, Every man at the beginning doth set forth good wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: but thou hast kept the good wine until now.
11 This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.

rr: 12 Bwanyima y'ekyo, yaashuuma, yaaza Kaperenaumu na nyina n'abarumuna n'abeegi be; baamarayo ebiro bikye.
en: 12 After this he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, and his brethren, and his disciples: and they continued there not many days.

rr: 13 Okuhingurwaho kw'Abayudaaya kukaba kuri haihi kuhika; Yesu yainamuka Yerusaalemu.
en: 13 And the Jews' passover was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem,
14 and found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting:

rr: 15 Yaakwata emigoye, yaagigira nk'orukoba, yaababinga boona omuri hekalu, n'entaama n'ente zaabo; yaashuka ahansi empiiha z'abarikuhingisa, yaajuumika n'emeeza zaabo
en: 15 and when he had made a scourge of small cords, he drove them all out of the temple, and the sheep, and the oxen; and poured out the changers' money, and overthrew the tables;

rr: 16 n'abaabaire nibatunda enkombe yaabagira ati: Mwiheho ebi; enju ya Tata murekye kugigira enju y'abashuubuzi.
en: 16 and said unto them that sold doves, Take these things hence; make not my Father's house an house of merchandise.
17 And his disciples remembered that it was written, The zeal of thine house hath eaten me up.
18 Then answered the Jews and said unto him, What sign shewest thou unto us, seeing that thou doest these things?
19 Jesus answered and said unto them, Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.

rr: 20 Abayudaaya baagira bati: Hekalu egi ekamara emyaka makumi ana na mukaaga neeyombekwa; mbwenu iwe oryagiimutsya omu biro bishatu?
en: 20 Then said the Jews, Forty and six years was this temple in building, and wilt thou rear it up in three days?
21 But he spake of the temple of his body.

rr: 22 Bwanyima, ku yaazookire omu bafu, abeegi be baijuka ku yaagambire ekyo, baikiriza Ebyahandiikirwe, n'ekigambo eki Yesu yaagambire.
en: 22 When therefore he was risen from the dead, his disciples remembered that he had said this unto them; and they believed the scripture, and the word which Jesus had said.

rr: 23 Kandi ku yaabaire ari Yerusaalemu omu biro by'obugyenyi bw'Okuhingurwaho, baingi baikiriza eiziina rye, ku baareebire obumanyiso obu yaakozire.
en: 23 Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover, in the feast day , many believed in his name, when they saw the miracles which he did.

rr: 24 Kwonka Yesu tarabeesigire, ahakuba akaba naamanya abantu boona
en: 24 But Jesus did not commit himself unto them, because he knew all men ,

rr: 25 n'ahabw'ekyo tarenzire muntu weena kumumanyisa eby'abantu; ahakuba We akaba naamanya ebiri omu muntu.
en: 25 and needed not that any should testify of man: for he knew what was in man.
1 There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews:

rr: 2 Omushaija ogwo akaija ahari Yesu nyekiro, yaamugira ati: Rabi, nitumanya ku ori omwegyesa owaarugire ahari Ruhanga; ahakuba tihariho muntu orikubaasa kukora obumanyiso obu orikukora, kureka Ruhanga yaaguma nawe.
en: 2 the same came to Jesus by night, and said unto him, Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from God: for no man can do these miracles that thou doest, except God be with him.
3 Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.

rr: 4 Nikodemu yaamubuuza ati: Omuntu naabaasa ata kuzaarwa yaakuzire? Naabaasa kugaruka omu nda ya nyina, azaarwe?
en: 4 Nicodemus saith unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother's womb, and be born?
5 Jesus answered, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.
6 That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

rr: 7 Otatangaarira eki naakugambira nti: Mushemereire kuzaarwa obwa kabiri.
en: 7 Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born again.
8 The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.

rr: 9 Nikodemu yaamugarukamu ati: Ebyo nibibaasika bita?
en: 9 Nicodemus answered and said unto him, How can these things be?

rr: 10 Yesu yaagarukamu, naagira ati: Ori omwegyesa w'Abaisraeli, kandi torikumanya bigambo ebyo?
en: 10 Jesus answered and said unto him, Art thou a master of Israel, and knowest not these things?
11 Verily, verily, I say unto thee, We speak that we do know, and testify that we have seen; and ye receive not our witness.
12 If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?
13 And no man hath ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of man which is in heaven.
14 And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up:

rr: 15 ngu omuntu weena orikumwikiriza aheebwe amagara agatahwaho.
en: 15 that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

rr: 16 Ahakuba oku nikwo Ruhanga yaakunzire atyo ensi, akahayo Omwana we omwe nyamunegyere, ngu omuntu weena orikumwikiriza arekye kuhwerekyerera, kureka atungye amagara agatahwaho.
en: 16 For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
17 For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.
18 He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.

rr: 19 Kandi oru nirwo rubanja, omushana gwizire omu nsi, abantu baakunda omwirima okukira omushana; ahakuba emicwe yaabo ekaba eri mibi.
en: 19 And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.
20 For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither cometh to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved.

rr: 21 Kwonka okora eby'amazima aija aha mushana, ngu emicwe ye ereebekye butunu ku yaakoreirwe omuri Ruhanga.
en: 21 But he that doeth truth cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God.

rr: 22 Bwanyima y'ebyo Yesu n'abeegi be baataaha omu ishaza rya Buyudaaya; yaagumayo nabo, naabatiza.
en: 22 After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judæa; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.

rr: 23 Kandi na Yohaana akaba naabatiriza Enoni haihi na Salimu, ahabw'okuba aho niho amaizi maingi gaabaire gari; abantu baingi baija, baabatizibwa.
en: 23 And John also was baptizing in Ænon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.

rr: 24 Kandi obwo Yohaana akaba atakatairwe mu kihome.
en: 24 For John was not yet cast into prison.

rr: 25 Haabaho empaka ahagati y'abeegi ba Yohaana n'Omuyudaaya aha by'okweyeza.
en: 25 Then there arose a question between some of John's disciples and the Jews about purifying.
26 And they came unto John, and said unto him, Rabbi, he that was with thee beyond Jordan, to whom thou barest witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all men come to him.

rr: 27 Yohaana yaagarukamu naagira ati: Omuntu tabaasa kweha kintu kyona, kureka biri akihairwe okuruga omu iguru.
en: 27 John answered and said, A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven.
28 Ye yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Christ, but that I am sent before him.
29 He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom's voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.

rr: 30 We ashemereire kuguma naakura, naanye nkaguma ningaruka ahansi.
en: 30 He must increase, but I must decrease.

rr: 31 Orugire omu iguru naakira boona; ow'ensi aba ari ow'ensi, kandi agamba eby'ensi. Orugire omu iguru naakira boona
en: 31 He that cometh from above is above all: he that is of the earth is earthly, and speaketh of the earth: he that cometh from heaven is above all.

rr: 32 eki yaareebire n'eki yaahuriire, nibyo ahamya; kwonka tihariho muntu oikiriza ebi ahamya.
en: 32 And what he hath seen and heard, that he testifieth; and no man receiveth his testimony.

rr: 33 Oikiriza eby'okuhamya kwe, aba ahamize eki, ngu Ruhanga n'Ow'amazima.
en: 33 He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true.
34 For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him .
35 The Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things into his hand.
36 He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abideth on him.

rr: 1 Mukama waitu yaamanya ku Abafarisaayo bahuriire ngu naayegyesa kandi naabatiza abeegi baingi okukira Yohaana
en: 1 When therefore the Lord knew how the Pharisees had heard that Jesus made and baptized more disciples than John,
2 (though Jesus himself baptized not, but his disciples,)

rr: 3 Ahabw'ekyo yaaruga Buyudaaya, yaagaruka Galilaaya.
en: 3 he left Judæa, and departed again into Galilee.

rr: 4 Yaahurira ashemereire kuraba Samaria.
en: 4 And he must needs go through Samaria.
5 Then cometh he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.

rr: 6 Kandi aho hakaba hariho eiziba rya Yakobo.
en: 6 Now Jacob's well was there.

rr: Yesu ahabw'okuruhibwa orugyendo, yaashutama aha rubaju rw'eiziba; obwo eshaaha zikaba ziri nka mukaaga.
en: Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.

rr: 7 Haija Omusamariakazi kutaaha amaizi; Yesu yaamushaba ati: Mpa eky'okunywa.
en: 7 There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink.

rr: 8 Ahakuba abeegi be bakaba bagiire omuri tauni kugura eby'okurya.
en: 8 (For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat.)
9 Then saith the woman of Samaria unto him, How is it that thou, being a Jew, askest drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? for the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans.

rr: 10 Yesu yaamugarukamu ati: Kuri noomanya ekiconco kya Ruhanga, n'Ogu orikukushaba ati, Mpa eky'okunywa, naiwe okaamushabire, nawe akaakuhaire amaizi g'amagara.
en: 10 Jesus answered and said unto her, If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.

rr: 11 Omukazi yaamugira ati: Mukama wangye, toine ky'okutahisa, kandi n'eiziba ni riraingwa; mbwenu ago maizi g'amagara noogaiha hi?
en: 11 The woman saith unto him, Sir, thou hast nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: from whence then hast thou that living water?

rr: 12 Iwe nookira tatenkuriitwe Yakobo, owaatuhaire eiziba eri, eri yaabaire anywaho n'abaana be, akeesheraho n'amasyo ge?
en: 12 Art thou greater than our father Jacob, which gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his children, and his cattle?

rr: 13 Yesu yaamugarukamu ati: Omuntu weena orikunywa aha maizi aga, aryagaruka agire eiriho
en: 13 Jesus answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:
14 but whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.

rr: 15 Omukazi yaamugira ati: Mukama wangye, mpa amaizi ago, ndekye kugira eiriho n'obu kwakuba okugaruka aha kutaha.
en: 15 The woman saith unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.

rr: 16 Yesu yaamugira ati: Irooko oyete baro, ogarukye aha.
en: 16 Jesus saith unto her, Go, call thy husband, and come hither.

rr: 17 Omukazi yaamugarukamu ati: Tiinyine mushaija. Yesu yaamugira ati: Waagamba gye okugira ngu, toine mushaija
en: 17 The woman answered and said, I have no husband. Jesus said unto her, Thou hast well said, I have no husband:

rr: 18 ahabw'okuba okashwerwa abashaija bataano; n'ogwo ou oine hati ti baro; eki waagamba n'amazima.
en: 18 for thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: in that saidst thou truly.
19 The woman saith unto him, Sir, I perceive that thou art a prophet.
20 Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and ye say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.

rr: 21 Yesu yaamugira ati: Mukazi 'we, nyikiriza, obunaku nibwija kuhika, obu mutariramizamu Isheboona aha rushozi oru, n'obu haakuba omuri Yerusaalemu.
en: 21 Jesus saith unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.

rr: 22 Imwe muramya eki mutarikumanya; itwe turamya eki turikumanya, ahakuba okujunwa kuruga omu Bayudaaya.
en: 22 Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews.

rr: 23 Kwonka obunaku nibwija, kandi bwahikire, obu abaramya ab'amazima bariramizamu Isheboona omu mwoyo n'omu mazima; ahakuba Isheboona asherura abari nk'abo kumuramya.
en: 23 But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him.

rr: 24 Ruhanga n'Omwoyo; kandi abamuramya bashemereire kumuramiza omu Mwoyo n'omu mazima.
en: 24 God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.

rr: 25 Omukazi yaamugira ati: Nimmanya ngu Mesia orikwetwa Kristo aryaija; ku ariija, aryatushobororera byona.
en: 25 The woman saith unto him, I know that Messias cometh, which is called Christ: when he is come, he will tell us all things.
26 Jesus saith unto her, I that speak unto thee am he .

rr: 27 Omu mwanya ogwo abeegi be baija; baatangaara ahabw'okuba yaaba naagaaniira n'omukazi; kwonka tihaine waamubuurize ati: Nooyenda ki? Nari shi, ati: Ahabw'enki noogaaniira nawe?
en: 27 And upon this came his disciples, and marvelled that he talked with the woman: yet no man said, What seekest thou? or, Why talkest thou with her?

rr: 28 Atyo omukazi yaatsiga aho enyungu ye, yaagaruka omuri tauni, yaagambira abantu ati
en: 28 The woman then left her waterpot, and went her way into the city, and saith to the men,

rr: 29 Mwije mureebe omuntu owangambira ebi naakozire byona. Yaaba niwe Kristo? Shinta.
en: 29 Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Christ?

rr: 30 Baaruga omuri tauni, nibaza ei ari.
en: 30 Then they went out of the city, and came unto him.

rr: 31 Ku baabaire batakamuhikire, abeegi be baamweshengyereza bati: Rabi, eby'okurya mbibi, ryaho.
en: 31 In the mean while his disciples prayed him, saying, Master, eat.

rr: 32 Yaabagira ati: Nyine eby'okurya ebi mutarikumanya.
en: 32 But he said unto them, I have meat to eat that ye know not of.

rr: 33 Abeegi be nikwo kubuuzana bati: Beitu shi, hariho owaamureetera eby'okurya?
en: 33 Therefore said the disciples one to another, Hath any man brought him ought to eat?

rr: 34 Yesu yaabagira ati: Eby'okurya byangye nikwo kukora eki Owantumire akunda n'okuhikiiriza omurimo gwe.
en: 34 Jesus saith unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.
35 Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.

rr: 36 Omugyesi aheebwa ebihembo, ahsanguririza emyaka omu magara agatahwaho, ngu omubibi n'omugyesi bashemererwe hamwe.
en: 36 And he that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life eternal: that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together.

rr: 37 Ahakuba omuri ebi ekigambo eki nimwo kimanyirwa ku kiri eky'amazima, ngu: Habiba omwe, hagyesha ondiijo.
en: 37 And herein is that saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.

rr: 38 Nkabatuma kugyesha ebi mutarahendekyeire; abandi bakahendeka n'emirimo, imwe mwaija, mwahikira omu bi baafeereire kubi.
en: 38 I sent you to reap that whereon ye bestowed no labour: other men laboured, and ye are entered into their labours.

rr: 39 Abasamaria baingi ab'omuri tauni egyo baamwikiriza ahabw'ebigambo by'omukazi ebi yaagambire naahamya ati: Yangambira ebi naakozire byona.
en: 39 And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman, which testified, He told me all that ever I did.

rr: 40 N'ahabw'ekyo Abasamaria, ku baamuhikire, baamushaba ngu agume nabo; nawe nikwo kumarayo kabiri.
en: 40 So when the Samaritans were come unto him, they besought him that he would tarry with them: and he abode there two days.

rr: 41 Haikiriza abandi baingi abarikukira ab'okubanza, ahabw'ekigambo kye.
en: 41 And many more believed because of his own word;
42 and said unto the woman, Now we believe, not because of thy saying: for we have heard him ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Saviour of the world.

rr: 43 Ebyo biro bibiri ku byahweire, yaarugayo, yaaza Galilaaya.
en: 43 Now after two days he departed thence, and went into Galilee.

rr: 44 Ahakuba Yesu akahamya ati: Nabi tagira kitiinisa omu nsi y'owaabo.
en: 44 For Jesus himself testified, that a prophet hath no honour in his own country.
45 Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galilæans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.

rr: 46 Kandi yaagaruka, yaataaha Kaana eya Galilaaya, ahu yaahinduriire amaizi viinyo.
en: 46 So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine.

rr: Omuri Kaperenaumu hakaba harimu omukungu w'omugabe, owaabaire arwarize omutabani.
en: And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.

rr: 47 Ku yaahuriire ngu Yesu arugire Buyudaaya, yaaza Galilaaya, yaagyenda yaamushaba ngu ashuume akize omutabani, ahakuba akaba ari haihi kufa.
en: 47 When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judæa into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son: for he was at the point of death.
48 Then said Jesus unto him, Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will not believe.

rr: 49 Omukungu yaamushaba ati: Mukama wangye, shuuma oije, omwana wangye atakafiire.
en: 49 The nobleman saith unto him, Sir, come down ere my child die.

rr: 50 Yesu yaamugira ati: Irooko otaahe; omwana waawe ahuriire.
en: 50 Jesus saith unto him, Go thy way; thy son liveth.

rr: Omushaija ogwo yaikiriza ekigambo eki Yesu yaamugambira, yaagyenda.
en: And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken unto him, and he went his way.

rr: 51 Ku yaabaire naashuuma, abahuuku be baamubugana, baamugira bati: Omwana waawe ahuriire.
en: 51 And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told him , saying, Thy son liveth.

rr: 52 Yaababuuza eshaaha ei atandikiireho kubaho gye, baamugarukamu bati: Nyomwabazyo aha shaaha ya mushanju omushwija nibwo gumurugireho.
en: 52 Then enquired he of them the hour when he began to amend. And they said unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.
53 So the father knew that it was at the same hour, in the which Jesus said unto him, Thy son liveth : and himself believed, and his whole house.

rr: 54 Ako niko kamanyiso ka kabiri aku Yesu yaakozire, okwiha obu yaaruga Buyudaaya, naija Galilaaya.
en: 54 This is again the second miracle that Jesus did, when he was come out of Judæa into Galilee.

rr: 1 Bwanyima y'ebyo hakaba hariho obugyenyi bw'Abayudaaya; Yesu yainamuka Yerusaalemu.
en: 1 After this there was a feast of the Jews; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

rr: 2 Kandi omuri Yerusaalemu haihi n'eirembo ry'entaama, hakaba hariho ekiyanja, ekirikwetwa omu Ruheburaayo Beseseda, kiriho ebiju bitaano.
en: 2 Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.

rr: 3 Omwo nimwo baabaire bata abarwaire baingi munonga, empumi, abarema, n'abazingazingirwe, nibategyereza amaizi kubira
en: 3 In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered, waiting for the moving of the water.

rr: 4 ahakuba obundi n'obundi maraika akaba ashuuma aija omu kiyanja, abiza amaizi; owaabaire atangamu abandi, amaizi gaatandika kubira, akaba akira endwara yoona ei yaabaire aba arwaire.
en: 4 For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool, and troubled the water: whosoever then first after the troubling of the water stepped in was made whole of whatsoever disease he had.

rr: 5 Aho hakaba hariho omushaija owaabaire amazire emyaka makumi ashatu na munaana arwaire.
en: 5 And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years.

rr: 6 Yesu ku yaamureebire abyami, kandi yaamanya ngu amazire aho omwanya muhango, yaamubuuza ati: Nooyenda kukira?
en: 6 When Jesus saw him lie, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case , he saith unto him, Wilt thou be made whole?

rr: 7 Omurwaire yaamugarukamu ati: Mukama wangye, tingira muntu w'okunta omu kuyanja, amaizi gaaba nigatandika kubira; nyowe ku mba ninkiija, ondiijo antangamu.
en: 7 The impotent man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me.
8 Jesus saith unto him, Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.

rr: 9 Ahonaaho omushaija yaakira, yaagyenda. Kandi eizooba eryo ekaba eri Sabato.
en: 9 And immediately the man was made whole, and took up his bed, and walked: and on the same day was the sabbath.

rr: 10 Abayudaaya baagambira owaatambirwa bati: Hati ni Sabato; ebiragiro tibirikukwikiriza kwekorera kirago kyawe.
en: 10 The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for thee to carry thy bed.

rr: 11 Yaabagarukamu ati: Omushaija owantambira niwe yandagiira ati: Yekorere ekirago kyawe, ogyende.
en: 11 He answered them, He that made me whole, the same said unto me, Take up thy bed, and walk.

rr: 12 Baamubuuza bati: Ogwo mushija n'oha owaakuragiira ati: Yekorere ekirago kyawe, ogyende?
en: 12 Then asked they him, What man is that which said unto thee, Take up thy bed, and walk?

rr: 13 Kwonka owaatambiirwe tiyaamumanya, ahakuba Yesu akaba yaarugireho ahabw'omutwe muhango ogwabaire guriho.
en: 13 And he that was healed wist not who it was: for Jesus had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in that place.
14 Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee.

rr: 15 Omushaija yaagyenda, yaagambira Abayudaaya, ku Yesu niwe amukirize.
en: 15 The man departed, and told the Jews that it was Jesus, which had made him whole.
16 And therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus, and sought to slay him, because he had done these things on the sabbath day.

rr: 17 Yesu yaabagarukamu ati: Tata naakikora na hati, kandi naanye ninkora.
en: 17 But Jesus answered them, My Father worketh hitherto, and I work.
18 Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that God was his Father, making himself equal with God.

rr: 19 Yesu yaagarukamu naabagira ati: Buzimazima nimbagambira nti: Omwana tabaasa kukora kintu kyona ahabwe, kureka eki areeba Ishe naakora; mumanye ngu ebi Ruhanga akora byona, n'Omwana nawe nibyo akora
en: 19 Then answered Jesus and said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father do: for what things soever he doeth, these also doeth the Son likewise.
20 For the Father loveth the Son, and sheweth him all things that himself doeth: and he will shew him greater works than these, that ye may marvel.

rr: 21 Nk'oku Isheboona azoora abafu, akabaha amagara, nikwo n'Omwana aha amagara abu ayenda kugaha.
en: 21 For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickeneth them ; even so the Son quickeneth whom he will.
22 For the Father judgeth no man, but hath committed all judgment unto the Son:
23 that all men should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him.
24 Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.

rr: 25 Buzimazima nimbagambira nti: Obunaku nibwija, kandi buriho na hati mbwenu, abafu obu barihurira eiraka ry'Omwana wa Ruhanga; n'abo abaririhurira baryaba abahuriire.
en: 25 Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God: and they that hear shall live.

rr: 26 Ahakuba nk'oku Ishe aine amagara omuriwe wenka, nikwo yaahaire n'Omwana kugagira omuriwe wenka
en: 26 For as the Father hath life in himself; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself;

rr: 27 kandi akamuha obushoboorozi bw'okucwa emanja, ahabw'okuba niwe Mwana w'omuntu.
en: 27 and hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of man.

rr: 28 Mutatangaarira eki; ahakuba obunaku nibwija, abari omu bituuro boona obu barihurira eiraka rye
en: 28 Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,

rr: 29 bakarugamu, abo abaakozire gye, bakazookyera amagara; nabo abaakozire kubi, bakazookyera okucwerwa orubanja.
en: 29 and shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.
30 I can of mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which hath sent me.

rr: 31 Ku ndikwehamya nyenka, okwehamya kwangye nikuba kutari kw'amazima
en: 31 If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.
32 There is another that beareth witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true.

rr: 33 Imwe mukatuma ahari Yohaana, nawe yaabahamiza amazima.
en: 33 Ye sent unto John, and he bare witness unto the truth.

rr: 34 Okuhamibwa, oku ndikwegamira, tikurikuruga ha muntu; kwonka ebi nimbigamba, ngu imwe mujunwe.
en: 34 But I receive not testimony from man: but these things I say, that ye might be saved.

rr: 35 Yohaana ogwo akaba ari etabaaza erikwaka, ekamurika; naimwe mukamara akaanya kakye nimwikiriza kushemerererwa okumurika kwe.
en: 35 He was a burning and a shining light: and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light.

rr: Yoh 5:36
en: 36 But I have greater witness than that of John: for the works which the Father hath given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.
37 And the Father himself, which hath sent me, hath borne witness of me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.

rr: 38 kandi ekigambo kye tikituura muriimwe; ahabw'okuba timwikiriza u yaatumire.
en: 38 And ye have not his word abiding in you: for whom he hath sent, him ye believe not.
39 Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.

rr: 40 Kwonka mwanga kwija ahariinye, ngu muheebwe amagara.
en: 40 And ye will not come to me, that ye might have life.

rr: 41 Tindikwikiriza kitiinisa eki ndikuheebwa abantu.
en: 41 I receive not honour from men.

rr: 42 Ahakuba nimmanya imwe ku mutarikukunda Ruhanga omu mitima yaanyu.
en: 42 But I know you, that ye have not the love of God in you.

rr: 43 Nyizire omu iziina rya Tata, timwanyakiira; ondiijo ku ariija omu iziina rye wenka, we muryamwakiira.
en: 43 I am come in my Father's name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.
44 How can ye believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek not the honour that cometh from God only?
45 Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, even Moses, in whom ye trust.
46 For had ye believed Moses, ye would have believed me: for he wrote of me.
47 But if ye believe not his writings, how shall ye believe my words?
1 After these things Jesus went over the sea of Galilee, which is the sea of Tiberias.

rr: 2 Omutwe muhango gw'abantu gwamukuratira, ahakuba bakareeba obumanyiso obu yaakozire aha barwaire.
en: 2 And a great multitude followed him, because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased.

rr: 3 Yesu yaatemba omu bibungo, yaashutamayo n'abeegi be.
en: 3 And Jesus went up into a mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.

rr: 4 Kandi obugyenyi bw'Abayudaaya obw'Okuhingurwaho bukaba buri haihi.
en: 4 And the passover, a feast of the Jews, was nigh.

rr: 5 Yesu ku yaanagire amaisho, yaareeba omutwe gw'abantu baingi nigwija ah'ari, yaabuuza Filipo ati: Nitwija kugura hi emigaati, ei aba bantu baraarye?
en: 5 When Jesus then lifted up his eyes, and saw a great company come unto him, he saith unto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?

rr: 6 Akamubuuza atyo kumugyeza, ahakuba We akaba naamanya eki araakore.
en: 6 And this he said to prove him: for he himself knew what he would do.

rr: 7 Filipo yaamugarukamu ati: Emigaati erikugurwa edenaari magana abiri terikubahika, n'obu omuntu weena yaakuryaho kakye.
en: 7 Philip answered him, Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may take a little.

rr: 8 Omwe aha beegi be, Anderea murumuna wa Simooni Petero, yaamugira ati
en: 8 One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, saith unto him,

rr: 9 Aha hariho omwojo oine emigaati ya sayiri etaano n'eby'enyanja bibiri; kwonka ebyo nibigasira ki abantu abarikwinga bati?
en: 9 There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?

rr: 10 Yesu yaagira ati: Mushutamye abantu. Kandi aho hakaba hariho akacwamba kahango; abantu baashutama ahansi, bakaba bari nk'enkumi itaano.
en: 10 And Jesus said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.

rr: 11 Atyo Yesu yaayakiira egyo migaati; ku yaaherize kusiima, yaagigaburira abantu abaabaire bashutami; yaabaha n'eby'enyanja, nk'oku baayenzire.
en: 11 And Jesus took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.

rr: 12 Ku baahaagire, yaaragiira abeegi be ati: Mutorotoore oburagarika obwatsigaraho, hatagira akaaburaho.
en: 12 When they were filled, he said unto his disciples, Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing be lost.

rr: 13 Baabutorotoora, baijuza ebitenga ikumi na bibiri oburagarika obwashaagire aha migaati etaano ya sayiri, ei baariire.
en: 13 Therefore they gathered them together, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above unto them that had eaten.

rr: 14 Abantu ku baareebire akamanyiso aku yaakora, baagira bati: Buzima ogu niwe nabi ogwo orikwenda kwija omu nsi!
en: 14 Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did, said, This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world.
15 When Jesus therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force, to make him a king, he departed again into a mountain himself alone.
16 And when even was now come, his disciples went down unto the sea,

rr: 17 baaragara omu bwato, baatandika kwambuka egyo nyanja, bagyemire Kaperenaumu. Bukaba bwaizire, kandi na Yesu akaba atakabahikire.
en: 17 and entered into a ship, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Jesus was not come to them.

rr: 18 Enyanja yaahinduriza ahabw'omuyaga mwingi ogwabaire niguhuuha.
en: 18 And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew.

rr: 19 Ku baavugireho nka # 6:19 Omu Rugriika: ni sitadiyo 25 nari mahiro ishatu nari ina, baareeba Yesu naagyendera aha nyanja nairirira obwato, baatiina.
en: 19 So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they see Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the ship: and they were afraid.

rr: 20 We yaabahuumuriza naagira ati: Niinye; mutatiina.
en: 20 But he saith unto them, It is I; be not afraid.

rr: 21 N'ahabw'ekyo baikiriza obwato bwahika aha nkungu, ahu baabaire nibaza.
en: 21 Then they willingly received him into the ship: and immediately the ship was at the land whither they went.

rr: 22 Ku bwaseesire, abantu abaabaire batsigaire seeri y'enyanja, baijuka ku haabaire hariho obwato bumwe bwonka, kandi Yesu ku atabugyenziremu n'abeegi be, kureka ku baagyenzire bonka.
en: 22 The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one whereinto his disciples were entered, and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat, but that his disciples were gone away alone;

rr: 23 Agandi maato gaija nigaruga Tiberia, gaahika haihi n'omwanya, ahu baariiriire emigaati ei Mukama waitu Yesu yaasiimiire.
en: 23 (howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread, after that the Lord had given thanks:)

rr: 24 Batyo abantu abo, ku baareebire ngu Yesu tariyo, n'obu baakuba abeegi be, bo baaragara omu maato ago, baaza Kaperenaumu, nibamusherura.
en: 24 when the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Jesus.

rr: 25 Ku baamushangire seeri y'enyanja, baamubuuza bati: Rabi, aha oizireho ryari?
en: 25 And when they had found him on the other side of the sea, they said unto him, Rabbi, when camest thou hither?

rr: 26 Yesu yaabagarukamu ati: Buzimazima nimbagambira nti: Timurikunsherura ahabw'okuba mureebire obumanyiso, kureka ahabw'okuba muriire emigaati, mwaiguta.
en: 26 Jesus answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Ye seek me, not because ye saw the miracles, but because ye did eat of the loaves, and were filled.

rr: 27 Nutarihendekyera eby'okurya ebirikuhwaho, kureka eby'okurya ebirikugumaho okuhitsya aha magara agatahwaho, agu Omwana w'omuntu aribaha; ahakuba Ruhanga Ishe akamutaho akamanyiso.
en: 27 Labour not for the meat which perisheth, but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life, which the Son of man shall give unto you: for him hath God the Father sealed.

rr: 28 Baamubuuza bati: Tushemereire kukora ki, tukabona kukora emirimo ya Ruhanga?
en: 28 Then said they unto him, What shall we do, that we might work the works of God?
29 Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.

rr: 30 N'ahabw'ekyo baamubuuza bati: Mbwenu nookora kamanyiso ki, aku twakureeba, tukakwikiriza? Okora ki?
en: 30 They said therefore unto him, What sign shewest thou then, that we may see, and believe thee? what dost thou work?
31 Our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.

rr: 32 Yesu nikwo kubagira ati: Buzimazima nimbagambira nti: Musa tiwe yaabahaire omugaati ogwarugire omu iguru; kureka Tata niwe abaha omugaati gw'amazima oguruga omu iguru.
en: 32 Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Moses gave you not that bread from heaven; but my Father giveth you the true bread from heaven.
33 For the bread of God is he which cometh down from heaven, and giveth life unto the world.

rr: 34 Baamushaba bati: Mukama waitu ogume otuhe ogwo mugaati obutoosha.
en: 34 Then said they unto him, Lord, evermore give us this bread.
35 And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.

rr: 36 Kwonka nkabagambira nti: Mundeebire, kunu timwanyikiriza.
en: 36 But I said unto you, That ye also have seen me, and believe not.
37 All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.

rr: 38 Ahakuba tindarugire mu iguru kukora ebi ndikweyendera, kureka okukora ebi Owantumire akunda
en: 38 For I came down from heaven, not to do mine own will, but the will of him that sent me.
39 And this is the Father's will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.

rr: 40 Eki Tata akunda n'eki, ngu weena orikureeba Omwana, akamwikiriza, atungye amagara agatahwaho; naanye ndyamuzoora aha kiro ky'aha mperu.
en: 40 And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which seeth the Son, and believeth on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.

rr: 41 Ekyo nikyo kyareeteire Abayudaaya kumwetomboitera, ahabw'okuba akagira ati: Niinye mugaati ogwarugire omu iguru.
en: 41 The Jews then murmured at him, because he said, I am the bread which came down from heaven.

rr: 42 Baagira bati: Ogu tiwe Yesu mwene Yosefu, ou turikumanya ishe na nyina? Mbwenu naabaasa ata kugira ngu akaruga omu iguru?
en: 42 And they said, Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? how is it then that he saith, I came down from heaven?

rr: 43 Yesu yaabagarukamu ati: Muteetomboita mwenka.
en: 43 Jesus therefore answered and said unto them, Murmur not among yourselves.

rr: 44 Tihariho orikubaasa kwija ahariinye, Tata owantumire yaaba atamwiriize haihi; naanye ndyamuzoora aha kiro ky'aha mperu.
en: 44 No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.
45 It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God. Every man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned of the Father, cometh unto me.

rr: 46 Mutagira ngu hariho orareebire Tata, kureka Ogwo owaarugire ahari Ruhanga; niwe yaamureebire.
en: 46 Not that any man hath seen the Father, save he which is of God, he hath seen the Father.

rr: 47 Buzimazima nimbagambira nti: Orikwikiriza aine amagara agatahwaho.
en: 47 Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me hath everlasting life.

rr: 48 Niinye mugaati gw'amagara.
en: 48 I am that bread of life.
49 Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness, and are dead.

rr: 50 Ogu nigwo mugaati oguruga omu iguru buzima ogu omuntu aryaho, atafe.
en: 50 This is the bread which cometh down from heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.

rr: Yoh 6:51 . Ahakuba omugaati gwa Ruhanga nigwo gushuuma niguruga omu iguru, gukaha ensi amagara.
en: 51 I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.

rr: 52 N'ahabw'ekyo Abayudaaya baahakana bonka nibagira bati: Omushaija ogu naabaasa ata kutuha omubiri gwe kugurya?
en: 52 The Jews therefore strove among themselves, saying, How can this man give us his flesh to eat?

rr: 53 Yesu yaabagira ati: Buzimazima nimbagambira nti: Ku murikuba mutariire mubiri gw'Omwana w'omuntu, kandi mutanyweire shagama ye, timurikugira magara omuriimwe.
en: 53 Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink his blood, ye have no life in you.

rr: 54 Orikurya omubiri gwangye akanywa eshagama yangye, aine amagara agatahwaho, kandi ndyamuzoora aha kiro ky'aha mperu
en: 54 Whoso eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, hath eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.

rr: 55 ahakuba omubiri gwangye n'eky'okurya eky'amazima, kandi n'eshagama yangye n'eky'okunywa eky'amazima.
en: 55 For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.
56 He that eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, dwelleth in me, and I in him.

rr: 57 Nka Tata ohuriire oku yantumire, naanye nk'oku ndi ohuriire ahabwa Tata, nikwo n'orikundya ariba ohuriire ahabwangye.
en: 57 As the living Father hath sent me, and I live by the Father: so he that eateth me, even he shall live by me.

rr: 58 Ogu nigwo mugaati ogwarugire omu iguru, ti nk'ogu bashwenkuriimwe baariire bakafa; orikurya omugaati ogu aryagumaho ebiro byona.
en: 58 This is that bread which came down from heaven: not as your fathers did eat manna, and are dead: he that eateth of this bread shall live for ever.

rr: 59 Ebigambo ebyo akabigambira omuri # 6:59 sinagogi n'ekanisa y'ekiyudaaya. sinagogi, naayegyesa omuri Kaperenaumu.
en: 59 These things said he in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.

rr: 60 Baingi aha beegi be, ku baahuriire ekyo, baagira bati: Ekigambo eki nikiremeera; n'oha orikukibaasa?
en: 60 Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard this , said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?

rr: 61 Yesu, ku yaamanyire ngu abeegi be bakyetomboitera, yaababuuza ati: Ekyo nikyo kyabaremesa?
en: 61 When Jesus knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it, he said unto them, Doth this offend you?

rr: 62 Mbwenu shi, kiryaba kita, ku murireeba Omwana w'omuntu naatemba ei yaabaire ari bwambere?
en: 62 What and if ye shall see the Son of man ascend up where he was before?
63 It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.

rr: 64 Kwonka omuriimwe harimu abatarikwikiriza.
en: 64 But there are some of you that believe not.

rr: Ahakuba Yesu akaba naamanya okuruga karenakare abatarikumwikiriza, n'ogwo owaabaire naayenda kumureebya oku ari.
en: For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who should betray him.

rr: 65 Yaagira ati: Nikyo naabagambirira nti: Tihariho orikubaasa kwija ahariinye kureka biri yaakiheebwa Tata.
en: 65 And he said, Therefore said I unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it were given unto him of my Father.

rr: 66 Okuruga aho baingi aha beegi be baagaruka enyima, tibaagumizamu kugyenda nawe.
en: 66 From that time many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.

rr: 67 Yesu nikwo kubuuza bari ikumi na babiri ati: Naimwe nimwenda kwegyendera?
en: 67 Then said Jesus unto the twelve, Will ye also go away?

rr: 68 Simooni Petero yaamugarukamu ati: Mukama waitu, nituza ahari oha? Ka niiwe oine ebigambo by'amagara agatahwaho
en: 68 Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.
