69 And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ, the Son of the living God.

rr: 70 Yesu yaabagarukamu ati: Tiinye naabatooraine imwe ikumi na babiri? Kwonka omwe omuriimwe ni sitaane.
en: 70 Jesus answered them, Have not I chosen you twelve, and one of you is a devil?

rr: 71 Ekyo akakigamba ahari Yuda mwene Simooni Iskaryota, owaabaire naayenda kumureebya, omwe ahari ikumi na babiri.
en: 71 He spake of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon: for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.
1 After these things Jesus walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Jewry, because the Jews sought to kill him.
2 Now the Jews' feast of tabernacles was at hand.

rr: 3 Abarumuna baamugira bati: Ruga aha, oze Buyudaaya, abeegi baawe babone kureeba emirimo ei orikukora.
en: 3 His brethren therefore said unto him, Depart hence, and go into Judæa, that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest.

rr: 4 Ahakuba tihariho muntu oyenda kumanywa butunu, akakora omu mubonano.
en: 4 For there is no man that doeth any thing in secret, and he himself seeketh to be known openly.

rr: Ku oraabe nookora ebi, oyeyorekye ensi.
en: If thou do these things, shew thyself to the world.

rr: 5 Ahakuba na barumuna abo tibaramwikiriize.
en: 5 For neither did his brethren believe in him.

rr: 6 Yesu yaabagambira ati: obunaku bwangye tibukahikire; kwonka obwanyu n'obw'obutoosha.
en: 6 Then Jesus said unto them, My time is not yet come: but your time is alway ready.
7 The world cannot hate you; but me it hateth, because I testify of it, that the works thereof are evil.

rr: 8 Imwe mwinamukye aha bugyenyi; nyowe tinkabaire kuza ahari obwo bugyenyi, ahakuba obunaku bwangye tibukahikire.
en: 8 Go ye up unto this feast: I go not up yet unto this feast; for my time is not yet full come.

rr: 9 Ku yaaherize kubagambira ebyo, yaaguma Galilaaya.
en: 9 When he had said these words unto them, he abode still in Galilee.

rr: 10 Abarumuna ku baaherize kwinamuka aha bugyenyi, nawe yainamuka, kwonka tiyaagyenda naareebwa, kureka yaagyenda bwesherekye.
en: 10 But when his brethren were gone up, then went he also up unto the feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.

rr: 11 Abayudaaya baamusherura aha bugyenyi, nibabuuririza bati: Ari nkahi?
en: 11 Then the Jews sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?

rr: 12 Haabaho okumuhakanaho munonga omu bantu: abamwe nibagira bati: N'omushaija murungi; abandi bati: Ngaaha, naahabisa abantu.
en: 12 And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him: for some said, He is a good man: others said, Nay; but he deceiveth the people.
13 Howbeit no man spake openly of him for fear of the Jews.

rr: 14 Obugyenyi ku bwahikire ahagati, Yetu yainamuka omuri hekalu, yaayegyesa.
en: 14 Now about the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple, and taught.
15 And the Jews marvelled, saying, How knoweth this man letters, having never learned?

rr: 16 N'ahabw'ekyo Yesu yaabagarukamu ati: Okwegyesa oku nyegyesa ti kwangye, n'okw'Ogwo owantumire.
en: 16 Jesus answered them, and said, My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.

rr: 17 Omuntu weena, ku ayenda kukora ebi Ogwo akunda, niwe arimanya yaaba okwegyesa okwo kuruga ahari Ruhanga, nari shi ku nyegambira ahabwangye.
en: 17 If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or whether I speak of myself.

rr: 18 Orikwegambira ahabwe, naaba naayesherurira ekitiinisa; kwonka orikusherurira Owaamutumire ekitiinisa, niwe w'amazima, kandi omuriwe tiharimu kutahikiirira kwona.
en: 18 He that speaketh of himself seeketh his own glory: but he that seeketh his glory that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.
19 Did not Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keepeth the law? Why go ye about to kill me?
20 The people answered and said, Thou hast a devil: who goeth about to kill thee?

rr: 21 Yesu yaabagarukamu ati: Nkakora ekintu kimwe, mwena mwakitangaarira.
en: 21 Jesus answered and said unto them, I have done one work, and ye all marvel.
22 Moses therefore gave unto you circumcision; (not because it is of Moses, but of the fathers;) and ye on the sabbath day circumcise a man.

rr: 23 Mbwenu shi, omuntu ku araabe asharwa ahari Sabato, ngu ekiragiro kya Musa kitahendwa, nimungwererwa ki kubi ahabw'okukiriza kimwe omuntu ahari Sabato?
en: 23 If a man on the sabbath day receive circumcision, that the law of Moses should not be broken; are ye angry at me, because I have made a man every whit whole on the sabbath day?

rr: 24 Mutaricwa emanja nimwiha aha mireebekyere y'omuntu, mugume mucwe emanja z'oburyo.
en: 24 Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous judgment.

rr: 25 Kandi aha ba Yerusaalemu baagira bati: Omushaija ou barikusherura kwita tiwe ogu?
en: 25 Then said some of them of Jerusalem, Is not this he, whom they seek to kill?

rr: 26 Mbwenu ari aha, naagamba butunu, kandi tibaine ku baamugira! Ebyo, abakuru nibamanya buzima ku Ogu ari Kristo?
en: 26 But, lo, he speaketh boldly, and they say nothing unto him. Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Christ?

rr: 27 Itwe nitumanya omushaija ogu ei arikuruga; kwonka Kristo we ku ariija, tihariho n'omwe orimanya ahi arikuruga.
en: 27 Howbeit we know this man whence he is: but when Christ cometh, no man knoweth whence he is.

rr: 28 Nikyo Yesu yaagambiire n'eiraka rihango naayegyesa omuri hekalu ati: Nyowe nimummanya, kandi nimumanya n'ei naarugire. Tindaizire habwangye; Owantumire n'ow'amazima, kwonka We timurikumumanya.
en: 28 Then cried Jesus in the temple as he taught, saying, Ye both know me, and ye know whence I am: and I am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom ye know not.
29 But I know him: for I am from him, and he hath sent me.
30 Then they sought to take him: but no man laid hands on him, because his hour was not yet come.
31 And many of the people believed on him, and said, When Christ cometh, will he do more miracles than these which this man hath done?

rr: 32 Abafarisaayo baahurira abantu nibamugambaho mpora batyo; abanyamurwa abakuru n'Abafarisaayo nikwo kutuma abakuru b'abaserukare kumukwata.
en: 32 The Pharisees heard that the people murmured such things concerning him; and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take him.
33 Then said Jesus unto them, Yet a little while am I with you, and then I go unto him that sent me.
34 Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me : and where I am, thither ye cannot come.

rr: 35 Abayudaaya baabuuzana bati: Omushaija ogu naayenda kuza hi, ei tutarimubona? Naayenda kuza omu baataataaniire omu Bagriika, ayegyese n'Abagriika?
en: 35 Then said the Jews among themselves, Whither will he go, that we shall not find him? will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles, and teach the Gentiles?

rr: 36 Eki eki yaagamba n'enki, ati: Muryansherura, timurimbona, kandi ati: Ei ndi, timurikubaasa kwijayo?
en: 36 What manner of saying is this that he said, Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me : and where I am, thither ye cannot come?
37 In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.
38 He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.
39 (But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believe on him should receive: for the Holy Ghost was not yet given ; because that Jesus was not yet glorified.)
40 Many of the people therefore, when they heard this saying, said, Of a truth this is the Prophet.

rr: 41 Abandi baagira bati: Ogu ni Kristo. Kwonka abandi bati: Hoona Kristo n'ow'okuruga omuri Galilaaya?
en: 41 Others said, This is the Christ. But some said, Shall Christ come out of Galilee?
42 Hath not the scripture said, That Christ cometh of the seed of David, and out of the town of Bethlehem, where David was?

rr: 43 Okwo abantu nikwo baamuhakaineho batyo.
en: 43 So there was a division among the people because of him.

rr: 44 Abamwe aharibo bakenda kumukwata; kwonka tihaine waamutaireho engaro.
en: 44 And some of them would have taken him; but no man laid hands on him.

rr: 45 Abakuru b'abaserukare baagaruka aha banyamurwa abakuru n'Abafarisaayo; bo baababuuza bati: Ahanki mutaamureeta?
en: 45 Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said unto them, Why have ye not brought him?

rr: 46 Abakuru b'abaserukare baagarukamu bati: Tihakabahoga muntu orikugamba nk'ogu mushaija!
en: 46 The officers answered, Never man spake like this man.

rr: 47 Abafarisaayo baabagarukamu bati: Kandi shi naimwe yaabahabya?
en: 47 Then answered them the Pharisees, Are ye also deceived?
48 Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed on him?

rr: 49 Kureka abo bantu, abatamanya Biragiro, n'abakeyeenirwe.
en: 49 But this people who knoweth not the law are cursed.
50 Nicodemus saith unto them, (he that came to Jesus by night, being one of them,)

rr: 51 Beitu ebiragiro byaitu nibiikiriza kucwera omuntu orubanja, batabandize kuhurira eki arikwetonganira, n'obu kyakuba eki akozire?
en: 51 Doth our law judge any man, before it hear him, and know what he doeth?
52 They answered and said unto him, Art thou also of Galilee? Search, and look: for out of Galilee ariseth no prophet.

rr: 53 Baagyenda, buri muntu yaataaha owaabo.
en: 53 And every man went unto his own house.

rr: 1 Yesu yainamuka ekibungo kya Zeituuni.
en: 1 Jesus went unto the mount of Olives.

rr: 2 Omu kasheeshe munonga yaagaruka omuri hekalu, abantu boona baija ah'ari; yaashutama, yaabeegyesa.
en: 2 And early in the morning he came again into the temple, and all the people came unto him; and he sat down, and taught them.

rr: 3 Abahandiiki n'Abafarisaayo baareeta omukazi, okwatsirwe naashambana; baamuta ahagati
en: 3 And the scribes and Pharisees brought unto him a woman taken in adultery; and when they had set her in the midst,

rr: 4 baamugira bati: Mwegyesa, omukazi ogu akwatsirwe butunu, naashambana.
en: 4 they say unto him, Master, this woman was taken in adultery, in the very act.
5 Now Moses in the law commanded us, that such should be stoned: but what sayest thou?

rr: 6 Eki bakakigamba nibamutega, ngu babone eki baraamuregye.
en: 6 This they said, tempting him, that they might have to accuse him.

rr: Kwonka Yesu yainama, yaahandiika n'orukumu aha itaka.
en: But Jesus stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground, as though he heard them not .

rr: 7 Ku baagumiizemu nibamubuuza, yaajuumuuka, yaabagira ati: omuriimwe otakashiishaga, abe niwe yaabanza kumuteera eibaare.
en: 7 So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.

rr: 8 Yaagaruka, yainama, yaahandiika n'orukumu aha itaka.
en: 8 And again he stooped down, and wrote on the ground.
9 And they which heard it , being convicted by their own conscience, went out one by one, beginning at the eldest, even unto the last: and Jesus was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.

rr: 10 Yesu yaajuumuuka, yaamubuuza ati: Iwe mukazi 'we, bari nkahi? Tihariho n'omwe owaakucwera orubanja?
en: 10 When Jesus had lifted up himself, and saw none but the woman, he said unto her, Woman, where are those thine accusers? hath no man condemned thee?
11 She said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said unto her, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.
12 Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.

rr: 13 Abafarisaayo baamugira bati: Iwe nooyehamya; kwonka okwehamya kwawe ti kw'amazima.
en: 13 The Pharisees therefore said unto him, Thou bearest record of thyself; thy record is not true.
14 Jesus answered and said unto them, Though I bear record of myself, yet my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but ye cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.

rr: 15 Imwe mucwa orubanja nk'abantu-buntu; nyowe tihariho n'omwe ou nducwera.
en: 15 Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man.

rr: 16 Kandi nangwa n'obu naakurucwa, okucwa okwangye n'okw'amazima, ahabw'okuba nyowe tincwa nyenka, kureka nkwatanisa na Tata owantumire.
en: 16 And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.
17 It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is true.
18 I am one that bear witness of myself, and the Father that sent me beareth witness of me.

rr: 19 Nabo baamubuuza bati: Sho arahi?
en: 19 Then said they unto him, Where is thy Father?

rr: Yesu yaagarukamu ati: Timurikummanya n'obu yaakuba Tata; kuri nimummanya, na Tata mukaamumanyire.
en: Jesus answered, Ye neither know me, nor my Father: if ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also.

rr: 20 Ebigambo ebyo akabigambira omu ibiikiro, naayegyesa omuri hekalu; kandi tihaabaho n'omwe owaamukwata, ahakuba obunaku bwe bukaba butakahikire.
en: 20 These words spake Jesus in the treasury, as he taught in the temple: and no man laid hands on him; for his hour was not yet come.

rr: 21 Yaagaruka yaabagira ati: Nyowe ningyenda; imwe muryansherura, kandi muryafeera omu kibi kyanyu; ei ndikuza, timurikubaasa kwijayo.
en: 21 Then said Jesus again unto them, I go my way, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sins: whither I go, ye cannot come.
22 Then said the Jews, Will he kill himself? because he saith, Whither I go, ye cannot come.

rr: 23 Yaabagambira ati: Imwe muri ab'omu nsi, nyowe ndi ow'omu iguru; imwe muri ab'ensi egi, nyowe tindi w'ensi egi.
en: 23 And he said unto them, Ye are from beneath; I am from above: ye are of this world; I am not of this world.

rr: 24 Nikyo naabagambirira nti: Muryafeera omu bibi byanyu; kandi buzima muryafeera omu bibi byanyu, ku muriba mutaikiriize ku ndi We.
en: 24 I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for if ye believe not that I am he , ye shall die in your sins.

rr: 25 Baamubuuza bati: Beitu oba oha?
en: 25 Then said they unto him, Who art thou?

rr: Yesu yaabagarukamu ati: Nk'oku naabagambiire okuruga ira ryona.
en: And Jesus saith unto them, Even the same that I said unto you from the beginning.

rr: 26 Nyine bingi eby'okubagambaho, n'okubacwera orubanja; kwonka Ogwo owantumire n'ow'amazima, kandi ebi naahuriire ahariwe, nibyo ngambira ensi.
en: 26 I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.

rr: 27 Kwonka bo tibaramanyire ku arikubagambira Ishe.
en: 27 They understood not that he spake to them of the Father.
28 Then said Jesus unto them, When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am he , and that I do nothing of myself; but as my Father hath taught me, I speak these things.

rr: 29 Ogwo owantumire turi hamwe; takantsigahoga nyenka, ahabw'okuba obutoosha nkora ebimushemeza.
en: 29 And he that sent me is with me: the Father hath not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.

rr: 30 Ku yaagambire ebigambo ebyo, baingi baamwikiriza.
en: 30 As he spake these words, many believed on him.

rr: 31 Bwanyima Yesu yaagambira Abayudaaya abaamwikiriize ati: Ku muraahamire aha kigambo kyangye, nimuba muri abeegi bangye buzima
en: 31 Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed;

rr: 32 kandi muryamanya maazima, n'amazima garyabahindura ab'obusingye.
en: 32 and ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.
33 They answered him, We be Abraham's seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?
34 Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.
35 And the servant abideth not in the house for ever: but the Son abideth ever.
36 If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.

rr: 37 Nimmanya ku muri baijukuru ba Abrahamu; haza kunu nimwenda kuunyita, ahakuba ekigambo kyangye tikiine mwanya omuriimwe.
en: 37 I know that ye are Abraham's seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.

rr: 38 Nyowe ngamba ebi naareebire ahari Tata; naimwe mukora ebi mwahuriire ahari shoimwe.
en: 38 I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and ye do that which ye have seen with your father.

rr: 39 Baagarukamu nibamugira bati: Abrahamu niwe tataitwe.
en: 39 They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father.

rr: Yesu yaabagira ati: Kuri muri abaana ba Abrahamu, mukaatwarize nk'oku Abrahamu yaatwarize.
en: Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abraham's children, ye would do the works of Abraham.

rr: 40 Kwonka mbwenu nimwenda kuunyita, nyowe omuntu owaabagambira eby'amazima, ebi naahuriire ahari Ruhanga; haza kunu Abrahamu tarakozire atyo.
en: 40 But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which I have heard of God: this did not Abraham.

rr: 41 Imwe nimukora emirimo ya shoimwe. Baamugira bati: Tituri baana b'obushambani; twine Tataitwe omwe, ni Ruhanga.
en: 41 Ye do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, even God.

rr: 42 Yesu yaabagira ati: Kuri noogira ngu Ruhanga ni Shoimwe, mukaankunzire, ahakuba omu kwija nkaruga ahari Ruhanga; tindaizire habwangye, kureka Ogwo niwe yantumire.
en: 42 Jesus said unto them, If God were your Father, ye would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from God; neither came I of myself, but he sent me.
43 Why do ye not understand my speech? even because ye cannot hear my word.

44 Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

rr: 45 Kwonka nyowe ahabw'okugamba amazima, imwe timuunyikiriza.
en: 45 And because I tell you the truth, ye believe me not.
46 Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do ye not believe me?

rr: 47 Owa Ruhanga ahurira ebigambo bya Ruhanga; imwe eki mutabihuririra n'ahabw'okuba timuri ba Ruhanga.
en: 47 He that is of God heareth God's words: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of God.

rr: 48 Abayudaaya baamugarukamu bati: Tituhikire kukweta Omusamaria, kandi oriho daimoni?
en: 48 Then answered the Jews, and said unto him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a devil?

rr: 49 Yesu yaagarukamu ati: Tindiho daimoni; nimpa Tata ekitiinisa; kwonka imwe nimungaya.
en: 49 Jesus answered, I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, and ye do dishonour me.

rr: 50 Haza nyowe tiinyesherurira kitiinisa; hariho Omwe okinsherurira, kandi niwe Mucwi w'emanja.
en: 50 And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.
51 Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death.
52 Then said the Jews unto him, Now we know that thou hast a devil. Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and thou sayest, If a man keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.

rr: 53 Iwe shi, nookira tatenkuriitwe Abrahamu owaafiire, kandi na baanabi? Nooyeyeta oha?
en: 53 Art thou greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? and the prophets are dead: whom makest thou thyself?

rr: 54 Yesu yaagarukamu ati: Ku ndaabe niinyeha ekitiinisa, ekitiinisa kyangye ni busha. Tata, imwe ou mweta Ruhanga waanyu, niwe ampa ekitiinisa.
en: 54 Jesus answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God:

rr: 55 Imwe timukamumanyaga; kwonka nyowe nimmumanya; ku naakugira nti, Tindikumumanya, nkaaba omubeihi nkaimwe; kwonka nimmumanya, kandi nyorobera ekigambo kye.
en: 55 yet ye have not known him; but I know him: and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be a liar like unto you: but I know him, and keep his saying.

rr: 56 Shoimwe Abrahamu akashemererwa aine ekihika ky'okureeba ekiro kyangye; ku yaakireebire, yaayesiima munonga.
en: 56 Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw it , and was glad.

rr: 57 Abayudaaya nikwo kumugarukamu bati: Tokahikize myaka makumi ataano, haza oti, nkareeba Abrahamu?
en: 57 Then said the Jews unto him, Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?

rr: 58 Yesu yaabagira ati: Buzimazima nimbagambira nti: Abrahamu atakazairwe, nyowe Ndiho.
en: 58 Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.
59 Then took they up stones to cast at him: but Jesus hid himself, and went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.

rr: 1 Ku yaabaire naahingura, yaareeba omushaija owaazairwe ari empumi.
en: 1 And as Jesus passed by, he saw a man which was blind from his birth.

rr: 2 Abeegi be baamubuuza bati: Rabi, owaasiisire n'oha, n'omushaija ogu, nari n'abaamuzaire, nikyo yaazaariirwe ari empumi?
en: 2 And his disciples asked him, saying, Master, who did sin, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind?
3 Jesus answered, Neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents: but that the works of God should be made manifest in him.

rr: 4 Tushemereire kukora emiromo y'Ogwo owantumire, bukiri nyomushana; ekiro nikiija, eki omuntu ataribaasa kukoreramu.
en: 4 I must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.
5 As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.
6 When he had thus spoken, he spat on the ground, and made clay of the spittle, and he anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay,

rr: 7 yaamuragiira ati: Gyenda onaabe omu kiyanja kya Siloamu, (amakuru gaakyo ngu Otumirwe.) Yaagyenda, yaanaaba, yaagaruka naahweza.
en: 7 and said unto him, Go, wash in the pool of Siloam, (which is by interpretation, Sent.) He went his way therefore, and washed, and came seeing.

rr: 8 Bataahi be n'abaabaire bamureeba ira naasheega, baagira bati: Ogu t'omushaija owaabaire atuura naasheega?
en: 8 The neighbours therefore, and they which before had seen him that he was blind, said, Is not this he that sat and begged?

rr: 9 Abamwe baagira ntu, Niwe; abandi ngu, Ngaaha, kwonka nibashushana. We yaagira ati: Niinye.
en: 9 Some said, This is he: others said , He is like him: but he said, I am he .

rr: 10 Baamubuuza bati: Beitu shi, amaisho gaawe gaahumuuka gata?
en: 10 Therefore said they unto him, How were thine eyes opened?

rr: 11 Yaagarukamu ati: Omushaija orikwetwa Yesu yaatoba eitaka, yaarinsiiga omu maisho, yangira ati: Gyenda aha kiyanja Siloamu, onaabe; naanye naagyenda, naanaaba, naahweza.
en: 11 He answered and said, A man that is called Jesus made clay, and anointed mine eyes, and said unto me, Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash: and I went and washed, and I received sight.

rr: 12 Baamubuuza bati: Mbwenu we arahi? Yaagira ati: Tindikumanya.
en: 12 Then said they unto him, Where is he? He said, I know not.

rr: 13 Owaabaire ari empumi baamutwara, baamuhitsya Abafarisaayo.
en: 13 They brought to the Pharisees him that aforetime was blind.

rr: 14 Kandi eizooba eri Yesu yaatobeireho eitaka, akahumuura amaisho ge, rikaba riri erya Sabato.
en: 14 And it was the sabbath day when Jesus made the clay, and opened his eyes.

rr: 15 Abafarisaayo nabo baamubuuza oku yaahumuuka.
en: 15 Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight.

rr: Yaabaigira ati: Yansiiga eitaka omu maisho, naanaaba, naahweza.
en: He said unto them, He put clay upon mine eyes, and I washed, and do see.

16 Therefore said some of the Pharisees, This man is not of God, because he keepeth not the sabbath day. Others said, How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles? And there was a division among them.

rr: 17 Baagaruka baabuuza owaabaire ari empumi bati: Weeza iwe, nk'oku yaakuhumuura, noomugambaho ki? Yaagira ati: Ni nabi.
en: 17 They say unto the blind man again, What sayest thou of him, that he hath opened thine eyes? He said, He is a prophet.

rr: 18 Abayudaaya baayanga kwikiriza ku yaabaire ari empumi, akahumuuka, okuhitsya obu baayetsire abazaire be
en: 18 But the Jews did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and received his sight, until they called the parents of him that had received his sight.

rr: 19 bakababuuza nibagira bati: ogu ni mutabani waanyu, ou mugira ngu akazaarwa ari empumi? Mbwenu yaahumuuka ata?
en: 19 And they asked them, saying, Is this your son, who ye say was born blind? how then doth he now see?

rr: 20 Abazaire be baagarukamu bati: Nitumanya ngu ogu n'omwana waitu, kandi akazaarwa ahumire
en: 20 His parents answered them and said, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind:

rr: 21 kwonka oku yaahumuuka hati, titurikukumanya, kandi n'owaamuhumuura, titurikumumanya. Naimwe mumwebuurize; ni mukuru, ayegambire.
en: 21 but by what means he now seeth, we know not; or who hath opened his eyes, we know not: he is of age; ask him: he shall speak for himself.

rr: 22 Abazaire be eki baagambiire ebyo n'ahabw'okutiina Abayudaaya; ahabw'okuba Abayudaaya bakaba baragaine ngu omuntu weena origamba Yesu ku ari Kristo, abingwe omuri sinagogi.
en: 22 These words spake his parents, because they feared the Jews: for the Jews had agreed already, that if any man did confess that he was Christ, he should be put out of the synagogue.

rr: 23 Abazaire be nikyo baagiriire bati, Ni mukuru; mumwebuurize.
en: 23 Therefore said his parents, He is of age; ask him.

rr: 24 Omushaija ogwo owaabaire ari empumi, baamweta obwa kabiri, baamugira bati: Himbisa Ruhanga; itwe nitumanya ngu omushaija ogwo n'omusiisi.
en: 24 Then again called they the man that was blind, and said unto him, Give God the praise: we know that this man is a sinner.

rr: 25 Yaagarukamu ati: Ku araabe ari omusiisi, tindikumanya; eki ndikumanya ni kimwe; mbaire ndi empumi, mbwenu nimpweza.
en: 25 He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no , I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.

rr: 26 Baamubuuza bati: Yaakugira ata? Amaisho gaawe yaagahumuuza ki?
en: 26 Then said they to him again, What did he to thee? how opened he thine eyes?

rr: 27 Yaabagarukamu ati: Naaheza kubagambira, kwonka mwayanga kuhurira. Ahabw'enki nimwenda ngu nkigarukyemu? Naimwe nimwenda kuhinduka abeegi be?
en: 27 He answered them, I have told you already, and ye did not hear: wherefore would ye hear it again? will ye also be his disciples?

rr: 28 Baamujuma nibagira bati: Niiwe mwegi we, itwe turi aba Musa.
en: 28 Then they reviled him, and said, Thou art his disciple; but we are Moses' disciples.

rr: 29 Nitumanya ngu Ruhanga akagamba na Musa; kwonka omushaija ogwo titurikumanya i yaarugire.
en: 29 We know that God spake unto Moses: as for this fellow , we know not from whence he is.

rr: 30 Omushaija yaagarukamu naabagira ati: Ka n'eihano, imwe okutamanya i yaarugire, haza ahumwire amaisho gangye!
en: 30 The man answered and said unto them, Why herein is a marvellous thing, that ye know not from whence he is, and yet he hath opened mine eyes.

rr: Yoh 9:31
en: 31 Now we know that God heareth not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of God, and doeth his will, him he heareth.

rr: 32 Okuruga aha kuhangwa kw'ensi tikikahurirwaga ngu hariho orahumwire amaisho g'omuntu owaazairwe ari empumi.
en: 32 Since the world began was it not heard that any man opened the eyes of one that was born blind.

rr: Abamwe aha Bafarisaayo baagira bati: Ti wa Ruhanga, ahakuba tarinda Sabato. Kwonka abandi baagira bati: Omuntu omusiisi naabaasa ata kukora obumanyiso bukuru nk'obu? Okuruga aho tibaikirizana.
en: 33 If this man were not of God, he could do nothing.

rr: 34 Baamugarukamu bati: Iwe okazaarirwa omu bibi bisha; mbwenu naiwe nooyenda kutwegyesa? Baamubinga.
en: 34 They answered and said unto him, Thou wast altogether born in sins, and dost thou teach us? And they cast him out.

rr: 35 Yesu yaahurira ku baamubinga; yaamusherura; ku yaamuboine, yaamubuuza ati: Noikiriza Omwana wa Ruhanga?
en: 35 Jesus heard that they had cast him out; and when he had found him, he said unto him, Dost thou believe on the Son of God?

rr: 36 Yaamugarukamu ati: N'oha, Mukama wangye, nkamwikiriza?
en: 36 He answered and said, Who is he, Lord, that I might believe on him?
37 And Jesus said unto him, Thou hast both seen him, and it is he that talketh with thee.

rr: 38 Yaamugira ati: Mukama wangye, niinyikiriza. Yaamuramya.
en: 38 And he said, Lord, I believe. And he worshipped him.

rr: 39 Yesu yaagira ati: Okucwa emanja nikwo kwandeetsire omu nsi egi, ngu abatarikureeba bareebe, kandi abarikureeba bahindukye empumi.
en: 39 And Jesus said, For judgment I am come into this world, that they which see not might see; and that they which see might be made blind.
40 And some of the Pharisees which were with him heard these words, and said unto him, Are we blind also?
41 Jesus said unto them, If ye were blind, ye should have no sin: but now ye say, We see; therefore your sin remaineth.

rr: 1 Buzimazima nimbagambira nti: Orikutaaha omu itsibikiro ry'entaama atareetsirwe mu irembo, kureka akatembera ahandi, ogwo n'omushuma kandi omwambuzi
en: 1 Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that entereth not by the door into the sheepfold, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.

rr: 2 kwonka orikureetwa omu irembo niwe muriisa w'entaama.
en: 2 But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

rr: 3 We omurinzi w'eirembo amwiguriraho; n'entaama zijurira eiraka rye, ayetamu eze amaziina, azishohoza aheeru.
en: 3 To him the porter openeth; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.

rr: 4 Ku aheza kushohoza eze zoona, azeebembera, nazo zimukuratira; ahakuba zimanya eiraka rye.
en: 4 And when he putteth forth his own sheep, he goeth before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice.

rr: 5 Ou zitarikumanya tizimukuratira, zimuhunga; ahakuba tizirikumanya maraka g'abandi.
en: 5 And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him: for they know not the voice of strangers.
6 This parable spake Jesus unto them: but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them.
7 Then said Jesus unto them again, Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.
8 All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.

rr: 9 Niinye irembo; omuntu weena orikutaaha naaraba omuriinye, naajunwa; naataaha, naashohora, naabona eiriisizo.
en: 9 I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.

rr: 10 Omushuma tareetwa kindi kureka okwiba n'okwita n'okucwekyereza; nyowe nkaija ngu zigire amagara, kandi ngu zigire maingi munonga.
en: 10 The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.
11 I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.
12 But he that is an hireling, and not the shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, seeth the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth: and the wolf catcheth them, and scattereth the sheep.

rr: 13 Naahunga, ahabw'okuba n'oguriirwe, entaama tarikuzeetaho.
en: 13 The hireling fleeth, because he is an hireling, and careth not for the sheep.
14 I am the good shepherd, and know my sheep , and am known of mine.

rr: 15 nk'oku Tata arikummanya, naanye nkamanya Tata; kandi mpayo amagara gangye ahabw'ezo ntaama.
en: 15 As the Father knoweth me, even so know I the Father: and I lay down my life for the sheep.
16 And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.
17 Therefore doth my Father love me, because I lay down my life, that I might take it again.
18 No man taketh it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This commandment have I received of my Father.

rr: 19 Kandi Abayudaaya baagaruka kwebaganisamu ahabw'ebigambo ebyo.
en: 19 There was a division therefore again among the Jews for these sayings.

rr: 20 Baingi aharibo baagira bati: Ariho daimoni, agwire eiraro; nimumuhuririra ki?
en: 20 And many of them said, He hath a devil, and is mad; why hear ye him?

rr: 21 Abandi bati: Ebigambo ebi ti by'omuntu oriho daimoni. Nimugira ngu daimoni naabaasa kuhumuura amaisho g'empumi?
en: 21 Others said, These are not the words of him that hath a devil. Can a devil open the eyes of the blind?

rr: 22 Obwo bukaba buri obugyenyi # 10:22 Nikwo kweza hekalu, obu yaabaire esiisikaire omu ngamba z'aba Maccabees n'Omugabe Antiochus Epiphanes. bw'Okweza hekalu omuri Yerusaalemu
en: 22 And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication, and it was winter.

rr: 23 ebiro ebyo bikaba biri eby'embeho. Yesu yaagyendagyenda omuri hekalu omu kisasi kya Sulemaani.
en: 23 And Jesus walked in the temple in Solomon's porch.

rr: 24 Abayudaaya baamwehinguririza, baamubuuza bati: Oryahitsya hi okutubanganisisa?
en: 24 Then came the Jews round about him, and said unto him, How long dost thou make us to doubt?

rr: Ku oraabe ori Kristo, otugambirire kimwe.
en: If thou be the Christ, tell us plainly.

rr: 25 Yesu yaabagarukamu ati: Nkabagambira, kwonka timurikwikiriza. Emirimo ei ndikukora omu iziina rya Tata, niyo erikumpamya
en: 25 Jesus answered them, I told you, and ye believed not: the works that I do in my Father's name, they bear witness of me.

rr: 26 kwonka timurikwikiriza, ahakuba timuri b'omu ntaama zangye.
en: 26 But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep, as I said unto you.

rr: 27 Entaama zangye zihurira eiraka ryangye, naanye nzimanya, nazo zinkuratira
en: 27 My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:
28 and I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.

rr: 29 Tata, owaazimpaire, naakira boona, kandi tihaine orikubaasa kuzishahura mu mikono ye.
en: 29 My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Father's hand.

rr: 30 Nyowe na Tata tuba omwe.
en: 30 I and my Father are one.
31 Then the Jews took up stones again to stone him.

rr: 32 Yaabagarukamu ati: Nkabooreka emirimo mingi kandi mirungi eyaarugire ahari Tata; ni guuha omuriiyo ogurikubanteeresa amabaare?
en: 32 Jesus answered them, Many good works have I shewed you from my Father; for which of those works do ye stone me?
33 The Jews answered him, saying, For a good work we stone thee not; but for blasphemy; and because that thou, being a man, makest thyself God.
34 Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?

rr: 35 Abo abaziirwe ekigambo kya Ruhanga, ku araabe yaabeetsire baaruhanga, (kandi Ebyahandiikirwe tibibaasa kwihwaho,)
en: 35 If he called them gods, unto whom the word of God came, and the scripture cannot be broken;
36 say ye of him, whom the Father hath sanctified, and sent into the world, Thou blasphemest; because I said, I am the Son of God?

rr: 37 Ku ndaabe ntakora mirimo ya Tata, murekye kuunyikiriza
en: 37 If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.

rr: 38 kwonka ku ndaabe ngikora, n'obu muraabe mutarikuunyikiriza, mwikirize emirimo, obwo mukaashoborokyerwa, mumanya ku Tata ari omuriinye, naanye omuriwe.
en: 38 But if I do, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know, and believe, that the Father is in me, and I in him.

rr: 39 Baateeraho kugaruka kumukwata, yaabooga omu mikono.
en: 39 Therefore they sought again to take him: but he escaped out of their hand,

rr: 40 Yaagaruka yaayambuka Yorudani, ahu Yohaana yaabaire naabatiriza okubanza, yaagumayo.
en: 40 and went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized; and there he abode.

rr: 41 Baingi baija ah'ari; baagira bati: Yohaana tarakozire ky'okureeberaho, kwonka byona ebi yaagambire aha muntu ogu bikaba biri eby'amazima.
en: 41 And many resorted unto him, and said, John did no miracle: but all things that John spake of this man were true.

rr: 42 Baingi baamwikiririza okwo.
en: 42 And many believed on him there.
1 Now a certain man was sick, named Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.
2 (It was that Mary which anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)

rr: 3 Banyaanya abo bakatuma ahari Yesu, nibagira bati: Mukama waitu, ou okunda arwaire.
en: 3 Therefore his sisters sent unto him, saying, Lord, behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.
4 When Jesus heard that , he said, This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God might be glorified thereby.

rr: 5 Kandi Yesu akaba akunda Mariza n'omurumuna na Laazaaro.
en: 5 Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.

rr: 6 Ku yaahuriire ngu arwaire, yaamara kabiri ei yaabaire ari.
en: 6 When he had heard therefore that he was sick, he abode two days still in the same place where he was.

rr: 7 Bwanyima y'ebyo biro yaagira abeegi be ati: Ka tugarukye Buyudaaya.
en: 7 Then after that saith he to his disciples, Let us go into Judæa again.

rr: 8 Abeegi be baamugira bati: Rabi, ebiro ebi Abayudaaya babaire nibenda kukuteera amabaare, kandi ogarukyeyo?
en: 8 His disciples say unto him, Master, the Jews of late sought to stone thee; and goest thou thither again?
9 Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.

rr: 10 Kwonka omuntu ku agyenda nyekiro, ateera entsibo, ahakuba omushana guba gutari muriwe.
en: 10 But if a man walk in the night, he stumbleth, because there is no light in him.
11 These things said he: and after that he saith unto them, Our friend Lazarus sleepeth; but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep.

rr: 12 Abeegi nikwo kumugira bati: Mukama waitu, ku araabe agwejegyeire, naija kukira.
en: 12 Then said his disciples, Lord, if he sleep, he shall do well.

rr: 13 Kwonka Yesu akaba naagama aha kufa kwe; haza bo baateekateeka ngu naagamba aha kugwejegyera okw'oturo.
en: 13 Howbeit Jesus spake of his death: but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep.

rr: 14 Yesu yaabagambirira kimwe ati: Laazaaro afiire
en: 14 Then said Jesus unto them plainly, Lazarus is dead.

rr: 15 ahabwanyu nyowe niinyesiima okutabayo, mukaabona kwikiriza. Mbwenu ka tugyende ei ari.
en: 15 And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, to the intent ye may believe; nevertheless let us go unto him.
16 Then said Thomas, which is called Didymus, unto his fellowdisciples, Let us also go, that we may die with him.

rr: 17 Yesu ku yaahikireyo, yaashanga Laazaaro amazire kana omu kituuro.
en: 17 Then when Jesus came, he found that he had lain in the grave four days already.

rr: 18 Kandi Besania ekaba eri haihi na Yerusaalemu nka # 11:18 Mahiro ibiri omu Rugriika ni stadio ikumi na itaano. mahiro ibiri.
en: 18 Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off:

rr: 19 Abayudaaya baingi bakaba baizire kuyaagira Mariza na Mariamu ahabwa munyaanyabo.
en: 19 and many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary, to comfort them concerning their brother.

rr: 20 Mariza ku yaahuriire ngu Yesu naija, yaagyenda, yaamubugana; Mariamu we yaaguma ashutami omu nju.
en: 20 Then Martha, as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming, went and met him: but Mary sat still in the house.

rr: 21 Mariza yaagambira Yesu ati: Mukama wangye, kuri obaire ori aha, munyaanyazi takufiire.
en: 21 Then said Martha unto Jesus, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.

rr: 22 Hoona na hati nimmanya ngu eki oraashabe Ruhanga kyona, niaja kukikuha.
en: 22 But I know, that even now, whatsoever thou wilt ask of God, God will give it thee.

rr: 23 Yesu yaamugira ati: Munyaanyoko naija kuzooka.
en: 23 Jesus saith unto her, Thy brother shall rise again.
24 Martha saith unto him, I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day.

rr: 25 Yesu yaamugira ati: Niinye kuzooka n'amagara; orikuunyikiriza, n'obu yaakufa, aryaba ohuriire
en: 25 Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:
26 and whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?
27 She saith unto him, Yea, Lord: I believe that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, which should come into the world.

rr: 28 Ku yaaherize kugamba atyo, yaagyenda, yaayeta Mariamu omurumuna, yaamugambira mpora ati: Omwegyesa ari aha, naakweta.
en: 28 And when she had so said, she went her way, and called Mary her sister secretly, saying, The Master is come, and calleth for thee.

rr: 29 Onu ku yaakihuriire, ahonaaho yaimuka, yaagyenda ah'ari.
en: 29 As soon as she heard that , she arose quickly, and came unto him.

rr: 30 Kandi Yesu akaba atakahikire mu kirorero, akiri omu mwanya ahu Mariza yaamushangire.
en: 30 Now Jesus was not yet come into the town, but was in that place where Martha met him.

rr: 31 Abayudaaya abaabaire bari omu nju nibamuyaagira, ku baareebire Mariamu yaarahuka kwimuka yaashohora, baamukuratira nibateekateeka ngu naaza kuririra aha kituuro.
en: 31 The Jews then which were with her in the house, and comforted her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up hastily and went out, followed her, saying, She goeth unto the grave to weep there.

rr: 32 Mariamu ku yaahikire ahu Yesu ari, yaamureeba, yaamukwata amaguru, yaamugira ati: Mukama wangye, kuri obaire ori aha, munyaanyazi takufiire.
en: 32 Then when Mary was come where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.

rr: 33 Yesu ku yaamureebire naarira, n'Abayudaaya abaizire nawe nabo nibarira, yaatsinda omu mutima gwe, yaagira obusaasi.
en: 33 When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews also weeping which came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled,

rr: 34 Yaababuuza ati: Mumuziikire hi? Baamugira bati: Mukama waitu, ija oreebe.
en: 34 and said, Where have ye laid him? They said unto him, Lord, come and see.
35 Jesus wept.

rr: 36 Abayudaaya baagira bati: Eshi abaire naamukunda!
en: 36 Then said the Jews, Behold how he loved him!

rr: 37 Kwonka bamwe aharibo baagira bati: Beitu omushaija ogu, owaahumwire empumi, taakubaasize kuzibira n'omuntu ogwo kufa?
en: 37 And some of them said, Could not this man, which opened the eyes of the blind, have caused that even this man should not have died?

rr: 38 Yesu yaagaruka yaatsinda, yaahika aha kituuro; (kikaba kiri enyanga, ekingirweho eibaare.)
en: 38 Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave. It was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.

rr: 39 Yesu yaaragiira ati: Mwiheho eibaare.
en: 39 Jesus said, Take ye away the stone.

rr: Mariza munyaanya w'ogwo nyakufa yaamugira ati: Mukama wangye, hati yaanuukire, ahabw'okuba amazire kana afiire.
en: Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time he stinketh: for he hath been dead four days.

rr: 40 Yesu yaamugira ati: Tinaakugira nti, Ku oraikirize, noija kureeba ekitiinisa kya Ruhanga?
en: 40 Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God?

rr: 41 Batyo baihaho eibaare.
en: 41 Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid.

rr: Yesu yaimutsya amaisho ge, yaareeba ahaiguru, yaagira ati: Taata, ninkusiima, ahabw'okuba wampurira.
en: And Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me.

rr: 42 Kandi naamanya ku ompurira obutoosha; kwonka eki naakigamba ahabw'abantu aba abanyehinguririize, ngu baikirize ku niiwe wantumire.
en: 42 And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the people which stand by I said it , that they may believe that thou hast sent me.

rr: 43 Ku yaaherize kugamba ekyo, yaagamba n'eiraka rihango ati: Laazaaro, shohora, oije.
en: 43 And when he thus had spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.

rr: 44 Nyakufa yaashohora, azingazingirwe omu myenda emikono n'amaguru, n'omutanda gukomire aha maisho ge.
en: 44 And he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with graveclothes: and his face was bound about with a napkin.

rr: Yesu yaabaragiira ati: Mumukomorore, mumurekye agyende.
en: Jesus saith unto them, Loose him, and let him go.

rr: 45 Abayudaaya baingi, abaizire owa Mariamu, ku baareebire ebi Yesu yaakora, baamwikiriza
en: 45 Then many of the Jews which came to Mary, and had seen the things which Jesus did, believed on him.

rr: 46 kwonka abandi baagyenda aha Bafarisaayo, baabagambira ebi Yesu yaakora.
en: 46 But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees, and told them what things Jesus had done.

rr: 47 Abanyamurwa abakuru n'Abafarisaayo baateerana eishengyero, baagira bati: Tugire tuta? Ahakuba omushaija ogwo naakora obumanyiso bwingi.
en: 47 Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles.

rr: 48 Ku turaamurekye yaagumizamu atyo, boona nibaija kumwikiriza, kandi Abarooma baryaija batwakye omwanya gwaitu ogurikwera, batware n'eihanga ryaitu.
en: 48 If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.

rr: 49 Omwe aharibo, Kayaafa, owaabaire ari omunyamurwa omukuru omu mwaka ogwo, yaabagambira ati: Timweine ki murikumanya
en: 49 And one of them, named Caiaphas, being the high priest that same year, said unto them, Ye know nothing at all,
50 nor consider that it is expedient for us, that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation perish not.

rr: 51 Ekigambo ekyo tarakigambiise bwengye bwe wenka, kwonka ahabw'okuba omunyamurwa omukuru omu mwaka ogwo, karagura ku Yesu ashemereire kufeera eihanga eryo
en: 51 And this spake he not of himself: but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus should die for that nation;
52 and not for that nation only, but that also he should gather together in one the children of God that were scattered abroad.

rr: 53 Okuruga aha izooba eryo baaguma nibahanuura hamwe oku baraite Yesu.
en: 53 Then from that day forth they took counsel together for to put him to death.

rr: 54 Nikyo Yesu yaarekyeire kugyendagyenda naareebwa omu Bayudaaya; akarugayo akaza omu mwanya oguri haihi n'eihamba, omuri tauni erikwetwa Efuraimu; akaguma okwo n'abeegi be.
en: 54 Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews; but went thence unto a country near to the wilderness, into a city called Ephraim, and there continued with his disciples.
55 And the Jews' passover was nigh at hand: and many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the passover, to purify themselves.

rr: 56 Ku baahikireyo, baatandika kusherura Yesu, nibagambirana beemereire omuri hekalu bati: Nimuteekateeka muta? Nimugira ngu tarikwija aha bugyenyi?
en: 56 Then sought they for Jesus, and spake among themselves, as they stood in the temple, What think ye, that he will not come to the feast?

rr: 57 Kandi abanyamurwa abakuru n'Abafarisaayo bakaba bataireho ekiragiro ngu omuntu weena ku araamanye ei ari, aije abagambire, bamukwate.
en: 57 Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment, that, if any man knew where he were, he should shew it , that they might take him.
1 Then Jesus six days before the passover came to Bethany, where Lazarus was which had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.
2 There they made him a supper; and Martha served: but Lazarus was one of them that sat at the table with him.

rr: 3 Mariamu yaakwata eraatiri y'amajuta g'omugaju ag'obuguzi bwingi munonga; yaagasiiga aha bigyere bya Yesu, yaabisiisiriza eishokye rye, enju yoona yaataamirana emigaju.
en: 3 Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the odour of the ointment.

rr: 4 Kwonka Yuda Iskaryota, omwe aha beegi be, owaabaire naayenda kumureebya, yaagira ati
en: 4 Then saith one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, Simon's son , which should betray him,

rr: 5 Ahabw'enki amajuta aga gataatundwa gakarugamu edenaari magana ashatu, zikagabirwa abooro?
en: 5 Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence, and given to the poor?
6 This he said, not that he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and had the bag, and bare what was put therein.

rr: 7 Yesu yaagira ati: Mumurekye, agabiikire ekiro ky'okuziikwa kwangye.
en: 7 Then said Jesus, Let her alone: against the day of my burying hath she kept this.
8 For the poor always ye have with you; but me ye have not always.

rr: 9 Abantu baingi omu Bayudaaya ku baamanyire ngu ari okwo, bajayo, ti habwa Yesu wenka, kureka ngu bareebe na Laazaaro, ou yaazoire omu bafu.
en: 9 Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there: and they came not for Jesus' sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.

rr: 10 Abanyamurwa abakuru baahanuura kwita na Laazaaro
en: 10 But the chief priests consulted that they might put Lazarus also to death;

rr: 11 ahabw'okuba ahabwe baingi aha Bayudaaya bakabarugamu, baikiriza Yesu.
en: 11 because that by reason of him many of the Jews went away, and believed on Jesus.
12 On the next day much people that were come to the feast, when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,

rr: 13 baatwara amataagi g'enkindo, baaza kumubugana, nibeeshongora bati: Hosana! Orikwija omu iziina rya Mukama asiimwe, niwe Mugabe wa Israeli!
en: 13 took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna: Blessed is the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord.
14 And Jesus, when he had found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,

rr: 15 Otatiina, iwe Saayuuni, reeba Mukama waawe naija, atembire omwana gw'endogoya.
en: 15 Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass's colt.
16 These things understood not his disciples at the first: but when Jesus was glorified, then remembered they that these things were written of him, and that they had done these things unto him.

rr: 17 Kandi omutwe gw'abantu abaabaire bariho obu yaayeta Laazaaro okuruga omu kituuro, akamuzoora omu bafu, baabihamya.
en: 17 The people therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of his grave, and raised him from the dead, bare record.

rr: 18 N'ahabw'ekyo omutwe gw'abantu gwaza kumubugana, ahakuba bakaba bahuriire ku akozire akamanyiso ako.
en: 18 For this cause the people also met him, for that they heard that he had done this miracle.

rr: 19 Abafarisaayo nikwo kugambirana bati: Mureebe ku mutakiine ky'okukora; reeba, ensi yoona yaamukuratira.
en: 19 The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Perceive ye how ye prevail nothing? behold, the world is gone after him.

rr: 20 Kandi omuri abo abaizire aha bugyenyi kuramya, hakaba harimu Abagriika.
en: 20 And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast:
21 the same came therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.

rr: 22 Filipo yaija yaabigambira Anderea. Anderea yaija na Filipo, baabigambira Yesu.
en: 22 Philip cometh and telleth Andrew: and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus.

rr: 23 Yesu yaabagarukamu ati: Obunaku bwahika Omwana w'omuntu kuhimbisibwa.
en: 23 And Jesus answered them, saying, The hour is come, that the Son of man should be glorified.
24 Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.
25 He that loveth his life shall lose it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.
26 If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will my Father honour.
27 Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour: but for this cause came I unto this hour.
28 Father, glorify thy name. Then came there a voice from heaven, saying , I have both glorified it , and will glorify it again.

rr: 29 Abantu abaabaire beemereire aho, baarihurira, baagira bati, Eiguru ryahinda. Abandi bati: Ni maraika owaagamba nawe.
en: 29 The people therefore, that stood by, and heard it , said that it thundered: others said, An angel spake to him.

rr: 30 Yesu yaagarukamu naagira ati: Eiraka eri ryaija ahabwanyu, ti habwangye.
en: 30 Jesus answered and said, This voice came not because of me, but for your sakes.
31 Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.
32 And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.

rr: 33 Ekyo akakigamba kworeka okufa oku yaabaire naija kufa.
en: 33 This he said, signifying what death he should die.
34 The people answered him, We have heard out of the law that Christ abideth for ever: and how sayest thou, The Son of man must be lifted up? who is this Son of man?
35 Then Jesus said unto them, Yet a little while is the light with you. Walk while ye have the light, lest darkness come upon you: for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither he goeth.
36 While ye have light, believe in the light, that ye may be the children of light. These things spake Jesus, and departed, and did hide himself from them.

rr: 37 Kwonka n'obu araabe yaakozire obumanyiso bwingi omu maisho gaabo, hoona nabwo tibaramwikiriize
en: 37 But though he had done so many miracles before them, yet they believed not on him:
38 That the saying of Esaias the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spake,
39 Therefore they could not believe, because that Esaias said again,

rr: 40 Akabahumya amaisho, yaagangaaza emitima yaabo
en: 40 He hath blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart;
41 These things said Esaias, when he saw his glory, and spake of him.

rr: 42 Baingi nangwa n'abakuru baamwikiriza; kwonka ahabw'okutiina Abafarisaayo tibaakigamba, ngu batabingwa omuri sinagogi
en: 42 Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess him , lest they should be put out of the synagogue:
43 for they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God.

rr: 44 Yesu yaagamba n'eiraka rihangao ati: Orikuunyikiriza, tiinye arikuba aikiriize, kureka Ogwo owantumire.
en: 44 Jesus cried and said, He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.
45 And he that seeth me seeth him that sent me.

rr: 46 Nyowe nyizire omu nsi kuba omushana, ngu omuntu weena orikuunyikiriza arekye kuguma omu mwirima.
en: 46 I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness.
47 And if any man hear my words, and believe not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
48 He that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my words, hath one that judgeth him: the word that I have spoken, the same shall judge him in the last day.

rr: 49 Ahakuba tindagambire habwangye; Tata owantumire niwe yandagiire eky'okugamba, n'oku ndaakigambe.
en: 49 For I have not spoken of myself; but the Father which sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.

rr: 50 Nimmanya ngu ekiragiro kye n'amagara agatahwaho; n'ahabw'ekyo ebi ngamba, mbigamba nk'oku Tata yaabingambiire.
en: 50 And I know that his commandment is life everlasting: whatsoever I speak therefore, even as the Father said unto me, so I speak.

1 Now before the feast of the passover, when Jesus knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father, having loved his own which were in the world, he loved them unto the end.
2 And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon's son , to betray him;
3 Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he was come from God, and went to God;
4 he riseth from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a towel, and girded himself.

rr: 5 Yaashuka amaizi aha kinaabiro, yaatandika kunaabisa abeegi be ebigyere n'okubiragarisa ekitambaara eki yaabaire ayezirikiise.
en: 5 After that he poureth water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples' feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.
6 Then cometh he to Simon Peter: and Peter saith unto him, Lord, dost thou wash my feet?

rr: 7 Yesu yaagarukamu naamugira ati: Eki ndikukora torikukimanya; kwonka oryakimanya bwanyima.
en: 7 Jesus answered and said unto him, What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt know hereafter.

rr: 8 Petero yaamugira ati: Reka! Torommabosa bogyere ebiro byona. Yesu yaamugarukamu ati: Ku ndaabe ntakunaabiise, nituba tutakikwatanisa.
en: 8 Peter saith unto him, Thou shalt never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, If I wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.

rr: 9 Simooni Petero yaamugira ati: Mukama wangye, kyabaire kityo, otannaabisa ebigyere byonka, kureka n'emikono n'omu mutwe.
en: 9 Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.

rr: 10 Yesu yaamugira ati: Owaayogire, tashemereire kindi kureka okunaaba aha bigyere byonka; ahabw'okuba aba naayera weena; kandi imwe nimwera, kwonka ti mwena.
en: 10 Jesus saith to him, He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.
11 For he knew who should betray him; therefore said he, Ye are not all clean.

rr: 12 Ku yaaherize kubanaabisa ebigyere, yaajwara ebijwaro bye, yaagaruka omu mwanya gwe, yaababuuza ati: Nimumanya eki naabakorera?
en: 12 So after he had washed their feet, and had taken his garments, and was set down again, he said unto them, Know ye what I have done to you?
13 Ye call me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for so I am.
14 If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another's feet.
15 For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.

rr: 16 Buzimazima nimbagambira nti: Omuhuuku takira mukama we; kandi n'entumwa tekira ogitumire.
en: 16 Verily, verily, I say unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him.
17 If ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them.
18 I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me.

rr: 19 Nimbagambira eki hati, kitakabaireho, ngu ku kiriba kyabaireho, mwikirize ngu ndi Ogwo.
en: 19 Now I tell you before it come, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe that I am he .

rr: 20 Buzimazima nimbagambira nti: Oyakiira omuntu weena ou ntuma, biri niinye ayakiire; kandi onyakiira, biri ayakiire Ogwo owantumire.
en: 20 Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that receiveth whomsoever I send receiveth me; and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
21 When Jesus had thus said, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.

rr: 22 Abeegi baareebana, nibabanganisa aha u yaagambaho.
en: 22 Then the disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spake.

rr: 23 Kandi omwe aha beegi be ou Yesu yaabaire akunda, akaba amwegamiire omu kifuba, bari aha by'okurya.
en: 23 Now there was leaning on Jesus' bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.

rr: 24 Simooni Petero yaamwitira eriisho, yaamugira ati: Tugambire ou yaagambaho.
en: 24 Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, that he should ask who it should be of whom he spake.

rr: 25 Ogwo, nk'oku yaabaire ayegamiire Yesu omu kifuba, yaamubuuza ati: Mukama wangye, n'oha?
en: 25 He then lying on Jesus' breast saith unto him, Lord, who is it?

rr: 26 Yesu yaagarukamu ati: Ou ndaakoreze ekitongye, nkakimuha, niwe ogwo.
en: 26 Jesus answered, He it is, to whom I shall give a sop, when I have dipped it .

rr: Ku yaakorize ekitongye, yaakiha Yuda mwene Simooni Iskaryota.
en: And when he had dipped the sop, he gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon.

rr: 27 Ku yaaherize kuheebwa ekitongye, Sitaane yaamutaahamu. Nikyo Yesu yaamugiriire ati: Eki orikwenda kukora, kirahutsye.
en: 27 And after the sop Satan entered into him. Then said Jesus unto him, That thou doest, do quickly.

rr: 28 Omuri abo abaabaire bashutami aha by'okurya, tihariho n'omwe owaamanyire eki yaamugambiriire ekyo.
en: 28 Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him.
29 For some of them thought, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus had said unto him, Buy those things that we have need of against the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.

rr: 30 Yuda, ku yaaherize kwakiira ekitongye, ahonaaho yaashohora; kandi bukaba bwaizire.
en: 30 He then having received the sop went immediately out: and it was night.

rr: 31 Ku yaaherize kushohora, Yesu yaagira ati: Hati mbwenu Omwana w'omuntu yaahimbisibwa, na Ruhanga yaahimbisizibwa omuriwe
en: 31 Therefore, when he was gone out, Jesus said, Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him.
32 If God be glorified in him, God shall also glorify him in himself, and shall straightway glorify him.

rr: 33 Baana bato 'mwe, nkiri naimwe omwanya mukye; muryansherura; kandi nk'oku naagambiire Abayudaaya, naimwe nikwo ndikubagambira nti: Ei ndikuza, timurikubaasa kwijayo.
en: 33 Little children, yet a little while I am with you. Ye shall seek me: and as I said unto the Jews, Whither I go, ye cannot come; so now I say to you.
34 A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.

rr: 35 Ku muriguma nimukundana, nibwo abantu boona baribamanya ku muri abeegi bangye.
en: 35 By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
36 Simon Peter said unto him, Lord, whither goest thou? Jesus answered him, Whither I go, thou canst not follow me now; but thou shalt follow me afterwards.

rr: 37 Petero yaamugambira ati: Mukama wangye, n'enki ekirikunzibira kukukuratayo hati? Niinyija kuhayo amagara gangye ahabwawe.
en: 37 Peter said unto him, Lord, why cannot I follow thee now? I will lay down my life for thy sake.

rr: 38 Yesu yaamugarukamu ati: Noija kuhayo amagara gaawe ahabwangye?
en: 38 Jesus answered him, Wilt thou lay down thy life for my sake?

rr: Buzimazima ninkugambira nti: Enkoko terikwija kugamba, otakanyehakaine kashatu.
en: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, The cock shall not crow, till thou hast denied me thrice.

rr: 1 Emitima yaanyu etarishoberwa; mwikirize Ruhanga, naanye muunyikirize.
en: 1 Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.

rr: 2 Omu nju ya Tata harimu emyanya mingi ey'okutuuramu; kuri kitari kityo, nkaabagambiire; hati ninza kubashemereza omwanya.
en: 2 In my Father's house are many mansions: if it were not so , I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.
3 And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.

rr: 4 Kandi ei ndikuza, omuhanda nimugumanya.
en: 4 And whither I go ye know, and the way ye know.

rr: 5 Tomasi yaamubuuza ati: Mukama wangye, ka tutarikumanya i orikuza, omuhanda nitugumanya tuta?
en: 5 Thomas saith unto him, Lord, we know not whither thou goest; and how can we know the way?
6 Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.

rr: 7 Kuri mwammanyire, na Tata nawe mukaamumanyire. Okuruga hati nimumamanya, kandi mwamureeba.
en: 7 If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also: and from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.

rr: 8 Filipo yaamugira ati: Mukama wangye, tworekye Isheboona; ekyo nikitumara.
en: 8 Philip saith unto him, Lord, shew us the Father, and it sufficeth us.
9 Jesus saith unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; and how sayest thou then , Shew us the Father?

rr: 10 Torikwikiriza ku ndi omuri Tata, kandi na Tata ku ari omuriinye? Ebigambo ebi mbagambira timbyetuma, kureka Tata ori omuriinye niwe akora emirimo ye.
en: 10 Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself: but the Father that dwelleth in me, he doeth the works.
11 Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works' sake.

rr: 12 Buzimazima nimbagambira nti: Orikuunyikiriza, emirimo ei nkora erikukira eyangye obuhango, ahabw'okuba nyowe ningyenda ahari Tata.
en: 12 Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because I go unto my Father.
13 And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

rr: 14 Ku murishaba ekintu kyona omu iziina ryangye, ndyakikora.
en: 14 If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it .
15 If ye love me, keep my commandments.
16 And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;
17 even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.

rr: 18 Tindibatsiga muri efuuzi; ndyaija ahi muri.
en: 18 I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.
19 Yet a little while, and the world seeth me no more; but ye see me: because I live, ye shall live also.

rr: 20 Aha kiro ekyo muryamanya ku ndi omuri Tata, naimwe ku muri omuriinye, naanye omuriimwe.
en: 20 At that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.

rr: 21 Oine ebiragiro byangye akabyorobera niwe arikunkunda; kandi orikunkunda, aryakundwa Tata, naanye ndyamukunda, mmweyorekye.
en: 21 He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.

rr: 22 Yuda, otari Iskaryota, yaamubuuza ati: Mukama wangye, kibaire kita iwe okutweyoreka, oteeyorekye nsi?
en: 22 Judas saith unto him, not Iscariot, Lord, how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?
23 Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.

rr: 24 Otarikunkunda, tarinda bigambo byangye; kandi ekigambo eki muhurira ti kyangye; n'ekya Tata owantumire.
en: 24 He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father's which sent me.

rr: 25 Ebigambo ebi naabibagambira nkibaine.
en: 25 These things have I spoken unto you, being yet present with you.
26 But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.
27 Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
28 Ye have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come again unto you. If ye loved me, ye would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.

rr: 29 Hati naakibagambira kitakabaireho, ngu ku kiriba kyahikire, mukiikirize.
en: 29 And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye might believe.
30 Hereafter I will not talk much with you: for the prince of this world cometh, and hath nothing in me.

rr: 31 Nyowe nkora nk'oku Tata yandagiire, ngu ensi emanye ku mmukunda.
en: 31 But that the world may know that I love the Father; and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do.

rr: Mwimukye, turugye aha.
en: Arise, let us go hence.
1 I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.

rr: 2 Buri itaagi eriri omuriinye, eritaana byana, aritemaho; kandi buri itaagi eryana ebyana, arisharira ngu rikizeho kwana.
en: 2 Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away: and every branch that beareth fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.

rr: 3 Hati mwaheza kushemezibwa ahabw'ekigambo eki naabagambira.
en: 3 Now ye are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you.

rr: 4 Mugume omuriinye, naanye omuriimwe.
en: 4 Abide in me, and I in you.

rr: Nk'oku eitaagi ritabaasa kwana byana ryonka, ryaba ritagumire ha muzaabibu, nikwo naimwe mutarikubaasa, mwaba mutagumire muriinye.
en: As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.
5 I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.
6 If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.
7 If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you.

rr: 8 Ekihimbisisa Tata, kikahamya ku muri abeegi bangye, niimwe okwana ebyana bingi.
en: 8 Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; so shall ye be my disciples.

rr: 9 Nk'oku Tata yankunzire, naanye nikwo naabakunzire; mugume omu kukunda kwangye.
en: 9 As the Father hath loved me, so have I loved you: continue ye in my love.
10 If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father's commandments, and abide in his love.

rr: 11 Ebi naabibagambira, ngu okushemererwa kwangye kube omuriimwe, kandi ngu okushemererwa kwanyu kube okuhikire.
en: 11 These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.
12 This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you.
13 Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
14 Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you.

rr: 15 Tinkibeeta bahuuku, ahakuba omuhuuku tamanya ki mukama we akora; kureka mbeetsire banywani bangye, ahakuba byona ebi naagambiirwe Tata, mbibamanyiise.
en: 15 Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.

rr: 16 Timwe mwantooraine; niinye naabatooraine, nkabataho ngu mugyende mwane ebyana, kandi ngu ebyana byanyu bigumeho; n'ahabw'ekyo kyona eki murishaba Isheboona omu iziina ryangye, aryakibaha.
en: 16 Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.

rr: 17 Ebi nimbibaragiira ngu mukundane.
en: 17 These things I command you, that ye love one another.
18 If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before it hated you.
19 If ye were of the world, the world would love his own: but because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.
20 Remember the word that I said unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, they will keep your's also.
21 But all these things will they do unto you for my name's sake, because they know not him that sent me.

rr: 22 Kuri ntaraizire, nkagamba nabo, tibaakugizire kibi; kwonka hati tibaine ky'okwetonganira ahabw'ekibi kyabo.
en: 22 If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloke for their sin.
23 He that hateth me hateth my Father also.
24 If I had not done among them the works which none other man did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.
25 But this cometh to pass , that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.

rr: 26 Kwonka Omuhwezi ku ariija, ou ndibooherereza okuruga ahari Isheboona, Omwoyo ow'amazima orikuruga ahari Tata, ogwo aryahamya ebyangye
en: 26 But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall testify of me:
27 and ye also shall bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.

rr: 1 Ebi naabibagambira ngu mutarishoberwa.
en: 1 These things have I spoken unto you, that ye should not be offended.
2 They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time cometh, that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service.

rr: 3 Ekyo baryakikora, ahabw'okuba tibaramanyire Isheboona n'obu yaakuba nyowe.
en: 3 And these things will they do unto you, because they have not known the Father, nor me.

rr: 4 Ebi naabibagambira, ngu obunaku bwabyo ku buriba bwahikire, mwijukye ku naabibagambiire.
en: 4 But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, ye may remember that I told you of them.

rr: Ebigambo ebyo tindabibagambiire ha kutandika, ahabw'okuba nkaba nkibaine.
en: And these things I said not unto you at the beginning, because I was with you.

rr: 5 Mbwenu hati ningyenda ahari Ogwo owantumire; kwonka tihaine n'omwe omuriimwe orikumbuuza ati: Nooza hi?
en: 5 But now I go my way to him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, Whither goest thou?

rr: 6 Emitima yaanyu eijwire obusaasi, ahakuba naabagambira ebigambo ebi.
en: 6 But because I have said these things unto you, sorrow hath filled your heart.
7 Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you.
8 And when he is come, he will reprove the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:
9 of sin, because they believe not on me;
10 of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and ye see me no more;
11 of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.
12 I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.

rr: 13 Kureka Omwoyo ow'amazima ku ariija, aryabeebembera omu mazima goona, ahakuba taryetuma; kwonka byona ebi arihurira, nibyo arigamba, kandi aryabamanyisa ebiriija kubaho.
en: 13 Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.

rr: 14 Aryampimbisa, ahakuba aryaiha aha byangye, abibamanyise.
en: 14 He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall shew it unto you.

rr: 15 Ebi Tata aine byona n'ebyangye; nikyo naabagirira nti, Aryaiha aha byangye, abibamanyise.
en: 15 All things that the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew it unto you.

rr: 16 Hatsigaire omwanya mukye kutandeeba; kandi ogundi mukye, muryandeeba.
en: 16 A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me, because I go to the Father.

rr: 17 Bamwe aha beegi be baagambirana bati: Eki arikutugambira n'enki ati, Hatsigaire omwanya mukye kutandeeba; kandi ati, Ogundi mukye, muryandeeba; kandi ati: Ahakuba ningyenda ahari Isheboona?
en: 17 Then said some of his disciples among themselves, What is this that he saith unto us, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?

rr: 18 Baagaruka baagira bati: Eki arikugamba n'enki ati, Hatsigaire omwanya mukye? Titurikumanya ki arikugamba.
en: 18 They said therefore, What is this that he saith, A little while? we cannot tell what he saith.

rr: 19 Yesu yaamanya ku barikwenda kumubuuza, yaabagira ati: Nimubuuzana aha ki naabagira nti, Hatsigaire omwanya mukye, kutandeeba; kandi nti, Ogundi mukye, muryandeeba?
en: 19 Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him, and said unto them, Do ye enquire among yourselves of that I said, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me?

rr: 20 Buzimazima nimbagambira nti: Muryarira mucure, kwonka ensi eryashemererwa; muryagira obusaasi, kwonka obusaasi bwanyu buryahinduka okushemererwa.
en: 20 Verily, verily, I say unto you, That ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.

rr: 21 Omukazi, ku arumwa kuzaara, agira obusaasi, ahakuba obunaku bwe buba buhikire; kwonka ku aheza kuzaara, aba atakiijuka buri busaasi ahabw'okushemerererwa omwana ozairwe omu nsi.
en: 21 A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.
22 And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.
23 And in that day ye shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it you.
24 Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.

rr: 25 Ebyo naabibagambira omu nfumu; obunaku nibwija, obu ndiba ntakibagambira mu nfumu, kureka ndyabagambira ebya Tata bwerure.
en: 25 These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs: but the time cometh, when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs, but I shall shew you plainly of the Father.

rr: 26 Aha kiro ekyo muryashaba omu iziina ryangye; kandi tindikubagambira ku ndibashabira ahari Isheboona
en: 26 At that day ye shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you:
27 for the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came out from God.

rr: 28 Nkaruga ahri Isheboona, naija omu nsi; mbwenu ensi ningirugamu, ningaruka ahari isheboona.
en: 28 I came forth from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.

rr: 29 Abeegi be baagira bati: Mbwenu hati noogamba bwerure, tokigamba mu nfumu.
en: 29 His disciples said unto him, Lo, now speakest thou plainly, and speakest no proverb.

rr: 30 Hati twamanya ku omanya byona, kandi torikwetenga muntu weena kugira eki yaakubuuza; n'ahabw'ekyo nitwikiriza ku waarugire ahari Ruhanga.
en: 30 Now are we sure that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.

rr: 31 Yesu yaabagarukamu ati: Hati nimwikiriza?
en: 31 Jesus answered them, Do ye now believe?
32 Behold, the hour cometh, yea, is now come, that ye shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
33 These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.

rr: 1 Yesu ku yaaherize kugamba ebigambo ebyo, yainamura amaisho, yaareeba ahaiguru, yaagira ati: Taata, obunaku bwahika; himbisa Omwana waawe, n'Omwana abone kukuhimbisa
en: 1 These words spake Jesus, and lifted up his eyes to heaven, and said, Father, the hour is come; glorify thy Son, that thy Son also may glorify thee:

rr: 2 nk'oku waamuhaire obushoboorozi aha bantu boona, ngu abone kuha abu waamuhaire boona amagara agatahwaho.
en: 2 as thou hast given him power over all flesh, that he should give eternal life to as many as thou hast given him.
3 And this is life eternal, that they might know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent.
4 I have glorified thee on the earth: I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do.
5 And now, O Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.

rr: 6 Abashaija, abu wampaire omu nsi, nkabooreka eiziina ryawe; bakaba bari abaawe, waabampa, kandi barinzire ekigambo kyawe.
en: 6 I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them me; and they have kept thy word.

rr: 7 Hati bamanyire ngu byona ebi wampaire biruga ah'ori
en: 7 Now they have known that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are of thee.
