rr: 8 ahakuba ebigambo ebi wampaire mbibahaire, baabiikiriza, baamanya omu mazima ku naarugire ah'ori, kandi baikiriza ngu niiwe wantumire.
en: 8 For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me; and they have received them , and have known surely that I came out from thee, and they have believed that thou didst send me.
9 I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which thou hast given me; for they are thine.

rr: 10 abangye boona n'abaawe, n'abaawe n'abangye, kandi nimpimbisibwa omuribo.
en: 10 And all mine are thine, and thine are mine; and I am glorified in them.

rr: 11 Mbwenu hati tinkiri mu nsi, kwonka bo bari omu nsi, kandi niinyija ah'ori.
en: 11 And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to thee.

rr: Taata orikwera, obarindire omu iziina ryawe eri wampaire, babe bamwe nkaitwe oku turi bamwe.
en: Holy Father, keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me, that they may be one, as we are .
12 While I was with them in the world, I kept them in thy name: those that thou gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.
13 And now come I to thee; and these things I speak in the world, that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves.
14 I have given them thy word; and the world hath hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
15 I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil.

rr: 16 Ti b'ensi, nk'oku naanye ntari w'ensi.
en: 16 They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

rr: 17 Obeeze omu mazima; ekigambo kyawe nigo mazima.
en: 17 Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.
18 As thou hast sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them into the world.
19 And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they also might be sanctified through the truth.

rr: 20 Tindikushabira abo bonka, kureka n'abandi abariinyikiriza ahabw'ekigambo kyabo
en: 20 Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also which shall believe on me through their word;
21 that they all may be one; as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.

rr: 22 Ekitiinisa eki wampaire nkibahaire, ngu babe bamwe nkaitwe oku turi bamwe
en: 22 And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them; that they may be one, even as we are one:

rr: 23 nyowe omuribo, naiwe omuriinye, babeere kimwe bamwe, ab'ensi bamanye ku niiwe wantumire, okabakunda nk'oku wankunzire.
en: 23 I in them, and thou in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that thou hast sent me, and hast loved them, as thou hast loved me.
24 Father, I will that they also, whom thou hast given me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.

rr: 25 Taata ohikiriire, ensi terakumanyire; kwonka nyowe nkakumanya; kandi n'aba nibamanya ku niiwe wantumire.
en: 25 O righteous Father, the world hath not known thee: but I have known thee, and these have known that thou hast sent me.

rr: 26 Nkabamanyisa eiziina ryawe, kandi ndyarimanyisa, ngu okukunda, oku wankunzire, kube omuribo, naanye mbe omuribo.
en: 26 And I have declared unto them thy name, and will declare it : that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them, and I in them.
1 When Jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron, where was a garden, into the which he entered, and his disciples.

rr: 2 Kandi Yuda, owaamureebize, akaba naamanya ogwo mwanya; ahakuba Yesu kaingi akaba ateeranirayo n'abeegi be.
en: 2 And Judas also, which betrayed him, knew the place: for Jesus ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples.

rr: 3 Mpaho Yuda, ku yaaherize kutunga omutwe gw'abaserukare n'abakuru baabo, abu yaahairwe abanyamurwa abakuru n'Abafarisaayo, baazayo baine etabaaza n'emuri n'eby'okurwanisa.
en: 3 Judas then, having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.

rr: 4 Yesu, ku yaamanyire byona ebyaza kumubaho, yaarugayo yaababuuza ati: Nimusherura oha?
en: 4 Jesus therefore, knowing all things that should come upon him, went forth, and said unto them, Whom seek ye?

rr: 5 Baamugarukamu bati: Yesu owa Nazareesi.
en: 5 They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth.

rr: Yesu yaabagira ati: Niinye.
en: Jesus saith unto them, I am he .

rr: Yuda owaamureebize akaba ayemereire nabo.
en: And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them.

rr: 6 Ku yaabagizire ati, Niinye, baagarura ebigyere enyima, baagwa ahansi.
en: 6 As soon then as he had said unto them, I am he , they went backward, and fell to the ground.

rr: 7 Yaagaruka yaababuuza ati: Nimusherura oha? Baamugarukamu bati: Yesu owa Nazareesi.
en: 7 Then asked he them again, Whom seek ye? And they said, Jesus of Nazareth.

rr: 8 Yesu yaagira ati: Manya, naabagira nti: Niinye; n'ahabw'ekyo, ku muraabe nimunsherura, murekye aba bagyende.
en: 8 Jesus answered, I have told you that I am he : if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way:

rr: 9 Akagira atyo ngu ekigambo eki yaagambire kibekwo, eki yaagizire ati: Ahari abo abu wampaire, tihariho n'omwe orambuzireho.
en: 9 that the saying might be fulfilled, which he spake, Of them which thou gavest me have I lost none.

rr: 10 Simooni Petero, owaabaire aine rurara, yaagisyorayo, yaatema omuhuuku w'omunyamurwa omukuru, yaamucwaho okutu kwa buryo.
en: 10 Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priest's servant, and cut off his right ear.

rr: Eiziina ry'omuhuuku ogwo akaba ari Maliko.
en: The servant's name was Malchus.

rr: 11 Yesu yaaragiira Petero ati: Garura rurara yaawe omu kyobati kyayo. Ekikopo eki Tata ampaire tindikukinywa?
en: 11 Then said Jesus unto Peter, Put up thy sword into the sheath: the cup which my Father hath given me, shall I not drink it?
12 Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus, and bound him,

rr: 13 Baabanza kumutwara ahari Aana; ahakuba akaba ari ishe-zaara wa Kayaafa, owaabaire ari omunyamurwa omukuru omu mwaka ogwo.
en: 13 and led him away to Annas first; for he was father in law to Caiaphas, which was the high priest that same year.
14 Now Caiaphas was he, which gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.
15 And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple: that disciple was known unto the high priest, and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest.

rr: 16 kwonka Petero yaaguma ayemereire aheeru aha irembo.
en: 16 But Peter stood at the door without.

rr: Omwegi ogwo, owaabaire naamanywa omunyamurwa omukuru, yaashohora, yaagamba n'omwishiki owaabaire naakumiirira, yaataasya Petero.
en: Then went out that other disciple, which was known unto the high priest, and spake unto her that kept the door, and brought in Peter.

rr: 17 Omwishiki ogwo omukumiirizi yaabuuza Petero ati: Naiwe tori omwe aha beegi b'omushaija ogu?
en: 17 Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter, Art not thou also one of this man's disciples?

rr: Yaagira ati: Ngaaha, tindi mwegi we.
en: He saith, I am not.

rr: 18 Kandi abahuuku n'abambari bakaba niboota omuriro gw'amakara, ahakuba hakaba hariho embeho; beemereire aho, niboota; na Petero ayemereire nabo naayota.
en: 18 And the servants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; for it was cold: and they warmed themselves: and Peter stood with them, and warmed himself.

rr: 19 Omunyamurwa omukuru yaabuuza Yesu aha beegi be, n'eby'okwegyesa kwe.
en: 19 The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his doctrine.
20 Jesus answered him, I spake openly to the world; I ever taught in the synagogue, and in the temple, whither the Jews always resort; and in secret have I said nothing.

rr: 21 Mbwenu nombuuriza ki? Abo abaabaire bampurira, obe nibo waabuuza ebi naabagambiire; bo nibamanya ebi naagambire.
en: 21 Why askest thou me? ask them which heard me, what I have said unto them: behold, they know what I said.
22 And when he had thus spoken, one of the officers which stood by struck Jesus with the palm of his hand, saying, Answerest thou the high priest so?

rr: 23 Yesu yaamugarukamu ati: Ku ndaabe naagamba kubi, nyomesereza ekibi; mbwenu ku ndaabe naagamba gye, wanteerera ki?
en: 23 Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest thou me?

rr: 24 Bwanyima Aana yaamutwekyera Kayaafa omunyamurwa omukuru, abohirwe.
en: 24 Now Annas had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest.

rr: 25 Kandi Simooni Petero akaba ayemereire naayota.
en: 25 And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself.

rr: Baamubuuza bati: Naiwe tori omwe aha beegi be?
en: They said therefore unto him, Art not thou also one of his disciples?

rr: Yaayehakana ati: Ngaaha; tindi mwegi we.
en: He denied it , and said, I am not.

rr: 26 Omwe aha bahuuku b'omunyamurwa omukuru, ow'omu ruganda rw'ogwo ou Petero yacwireho okutu, yaabuuza ati: Tinkureebire nawe omu musiri?
en: 26 One of the servants of the high priest, being his kinsman whose ear Peter cut off, saith, Did not I see thee in the garden with him?

rr: 27 Petero yaagaruka yaakyehakana; ahonaaho enkoko yaagamba.
en: 27 Peter then denied again: and immediately the cock crew.

rr: 28 Bwanyima baamwiha owa Kayaafa, baamutwara omuri # 18:28 Puratorio n'enju y'Abarooma ey'okucweramu emanja. Puratorio kare nibutaagurikana. Bo tibaataaha muri Puratorio, ngu bateeshiisha, babone kurya Okuhingurwaho.
en: 28 Then led they Jesus from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment: and it was early; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall, lest they should be defiled; but that they might eat the passover.

rr: 29 Pilaato yaashohora, yaabashanga aheeru, yaababuuza ati: Omushaija ogu nimumutabaaririza ki?
en: 29 Pilate then went out unto them, and said, What accusation bring ye against this man?

rr: 30 Baamugarukamu bati: Omushaija ogu, kuri atari nkozi y'ebibi, titwakumukuhaire.
en: 30 They answered and said unto him, If he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up unto thee.

rr: 31 Pilaato yaabagira ati: Mumwetwarire, mumucwere orubanja nk'ebiragiro byanyu oku biri.
en: 31 Then said Pilate unto them, Take ye him, and judge him according to your law.

rr: Abayudaaya baamugira bati: Ebiragiro tibitwikiriza kwita muntu.
en: The Jews therefore said unto him, It is not lawful for us to put any man to death:
32 that the saying of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spake, signifying what death he should die.

rr: 33 Pilaato yaagaruka yaataaha omuri Puratorio, yaayeta Yesu, yaamubuuza ati: Weeza ori Omugabe w'Abayudaaya?
en: 33 Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again, and called Jesus, and said unto him, Art thou the King of the Jews?

rr: 34 Yesu yaamubuuza ati: Ekigambo ekyo nookigamba ahabwawe, nari shi okugambiirwe abandi?
en: 34 Jesus answered him, Sayest thou this thing of thyself, or did others tell it thee of me?
35 Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? Thine own nation and the chief priests have delivered thee unto me: what hast thou done?

rr: 36 Yesu yaagarukamu ati: Obugabe bwangye ti bw'ensi egi: kuri obugabe bwangye bwaba buri obw'ensi egi, engabo zangye zikaarwaine, ndeka kuheebwayo omu Bayudaaya; kwonka obugabe bwangye ti bw'ensi egi.
en: 36 Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.

37 Pilate therefore said unto him, Art thou a king then? Jesus answered, Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.

rr: 38 Pilaato yaamubuuza ati: Amazima n'enki? Ku yaaherize kukigamba, yaashohora, yaagaruka aha Bayudaaya, yaabagira ati: Tindikumureebaho rubanja.
en: 38 Pilate saith unto him, What is truth?

rr: 39 Kwonka mugira omucwe ngu nshemereire kubarekurira omuntu omwe aha Kuhingurwaho; mbwenu nimwenda ngu mbarekurire Omugabe w'Abayudaaya?
en: 39 But ye have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews?

rr: 40 Baagaruka baayomba, nibagira bati: T'ogu, kureka Barabba! Kandi Barabba ogwo akaba ari omwambuzi.
en: 40 Then cried they all again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.

rr: 1 Bwanyima Pilaato yaatwara Yesu, baamwasha.
en: 1 Then Pilate therefore took Jesus, and scourged him .

rr: 2 Ku baaherize, abaserukare baaruka ekirunga ky'amahwa, baakimujweka omu mutwe, baamujweka n'omwenda gwa bujwa
en: 2 And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,

rr: 3 baija ah'ari, baamutangirira nibagira bati: Osingire, Mugabe w'Abayudaaya! Baamuteera empi.
en: 3 and said, Hail, King of the Jews! and they smote him with their hands.

rr: 4 Pilaato yaagaruka yaashohora, yaabagira ati: Reeba, naaza kumubareetera, mumanye ku ntaamureebaho rubanja.
en: 4 Pilate therefore went forth again, and saith unto them, Behold, I bring him forth to you, that ye may know that I find no fault in him.

rr: 5 Atyo Yesu yaashohora, ajwaire ekirunga ky'amahwa, n'omwenda gwa bujwa. Pilaato yaabagira ati: Reeba omuntu ogu!
en: 5 Then came Jesus forth, wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. And Pilate saith unto them, Behold the man!

rr: 6 Abanyamurwa abakuru n'abambari, ku baamureebire, baayomba munonga, bati: Mubambe, mubambe aha musharaba!
en: 6 When the chief priests therefore and officers saw him, they cried out, saying, Crucify him , crucify him .

rr: Pilaato yaabagarukamu ati: Mumutware, mumwebambire, ahakuba tindikumureebaho rubanja.
en: Pilate saith unto them, Take ye him, and crucify him : for I find no fault in him.
7 The Jews answered him, We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.

rr: 8 Pilaato ku yaahuriire ebigambo ebyo, yaayeyongyera kutiina
en: 8 When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he was the more afraid;

rr: 9 yaagaruka omuri Puratorio, yaabuuza Yesu ati: Ori owa nkahi? Kwonka Yesu tiyaamugarukamu.
en: 9 and went again into the judgment hall, and saith unto Jesus, Whence art thou? But Jesus gave him no answer.

rr: 10 Pilaato nikwo kumugambira ati: Torikungarukamu? Torikumanya ku nyine obushoboorozi bw'okukurekura nari kukubamba?
en: 10 Then saith Pilate unto him, Speakest thou not unto me? knowest thou not that I have power to crucify thee, and have power to release thee?

rr: 11 Yesu yaamugarukamu ati: Tokungizireho bushoboorozi, kuri otarabuhairwe okuruga omu iguru; n'habw'ekyo owaakumpa niwe aine ekibi ekirikukira ekyawe.
en: 11 Jesus answered, Thou couldest have no power at all against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin.
12 And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If thou let this man go, thou art not Cæsar's friend: whosoever maketh himself a king speaketh against Cæsar.

rr: 13 Pilaato ku yaahuriire ebigambo ebyo, yaashohoza Yesu, yaashutama aha kitebe ky'eiramuriro omu mwanya ogurikwetwa Amabaare agaariire, omu Ruheburaayo, Gabasa.
en: 13 When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he brought Jesus forth, and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called the Pavement, but in the Hebrew, Gabbatha.

rr: 14 Eizooba eryo rikaba riri ery'Okweteguurira Okuhingurwaho, ziri nk'eshaaha mukaaga. Pilaato yaagambira Abayudaaya ati: Reeba Omugabe waanyu!
en: 14 And it was the preparation of the passover, and about the sixth hour: and he saith unto the Jews, Behold your King!

rr: 15 Baayomba munonga nibagira bati: Mwiheho! Mwiheho! Omubambe. Pilaato yaababuuza ati: Mbambe omugabe waanyu? Abanyamurwa abakuru baamugarukamu bati; Titwine mugabe kureka Kaisaari.
en: 15 But they cried out, Away with him , away with him , crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Cæsar.
16 Then delivered he him therefore unto them to be crucified.

rr: 17 Baatwara Yesu, yaagyenda ayekoreire omusharaba gwe, baahika aha mwanya ogurikwetwa Empanga y'omutwe, omu Ruheburaayo Gologosa.
en: 17 And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called the place of a skull, which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha:

rr: 18 Aho niho baamubambire, n'abandi babiri, omwe aha rubaju rumwe, n'ondi aha rundi, na Yesu ahagati.
en: 18 where they crucified him, and two other with him, on either side one, and Jesus in the midst.

rr: 19 Pilaato yaahandiika ekihandiiko; yaakita aha musharaba, nikigira kiti: YESU OWA NAZAREESI, OMUGABE W'ABAYUDAAYA.
en: 19 And Pilate wrote a title, and put it on the cross. And the writing was, JESUS OF NAZARETH THE KING OF THE JEWS.

rr: 20 Ekihandiiko ekyo kikashomwa Abayudaaya baingi; ahabw'okuba omwanya ogu Yesu yaabambirwemu gukaba guri haihi n'orurembo; kandi kikaba kihandiikirwe omu Ruheburaayo n'omu Rulatini n'omu Rugriika.
en: 20 This title then read many of the Jews: for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city: and it was written in Hebrew, and Greek, and Latin.

rr: 21 Abanyamurwa abakuru b'Abayudaaya baagambira Pilaato bati: otahandiika oti, Omugabe w'Abayudaaya, kureka oti, Akagira ati: Ndi Omugabe w'Abayudaaya.
en: 21 Then said the chief priests of the Jews to Pilate, Write not, The King of the Jews; but that he said, I am King of the Jews.

rr: 22 Pilaato yaagarukamu ati: Eki naahandiikire, naakihandiikire.
en: 22 Pilate answered, What I have written I have written.

rr: 23 Abaserukare ku baaherize kubamba Yesu, baatwara ebijwaro bye, baabibaganisa omu miteeko ena, buri muserukare yaatwara omuteeko gwe. Kwonka ekanzu ye ekaba etaine mubaziiro, ekaba erukirwe okuruga omu bitsya okuhika ahansi.
en: 23 Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments, and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also his coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.

24 They said therefore among themselves, Let us not rend it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled, which saith, They parted my raiment among them, and for my vesture they did cast lots. These things therefore the soldiers did.

rr: 25 Kandi haihi n'omusharaba gwa Yesu hakaba heemereireho nyina na nyinento, na Mariamu muka Kuleopa, na Mariamu Magadaleene.
en: 25 Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother's sister, Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.

rr: 26 Yesu ku yaareebire nyina, kandi n'omwegi ou yaabaire akunda ayemereire haihi, yaagambira nyina ati: Mukaikuru, reeba omwana waawe!
en: 26 When Jesus therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he loved, he saith unto his mother, Woman, behold thy son!

rr: 27 Kandi yaagambira omwegi ogwo ati: Reeba omukaikuru waawe! Okuruga aho omwegi ogwo yaamutwara omu ka ye.
en: 27 Then saith he to the disciple, Behold thy mother! And from that hour that disciple took her unto his own home .
28 After this, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, saith, I thirst.
29 Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar: and they filled a spunge with vinegar, and put it upon hyssop, and put it to his mouth.

rr: 30 Yesu ku yaaherize kukiheebwa, yaagira ati: Kyahwa! Yainika omutwe gwe, yaahayo amagara ge.
en: 30 When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.

31 The Jews therefore, because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day, (for that sabbath day was an high day,) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.

rr: 32 Abaserukare baija, baahenda amaguru g'ow'okubanza, n'ag'owa kabiri, abaabaire babambirwe nawe
en: 32 Then came the soldiers, and brake the legs of the first, and of the other which was crucified with him.

rr: 33 kwonka ku baahikire ahari Yesu, baashanga yaakabire; tibaamuhenda maguru.
en: 33 But when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was dead already, they brake not his legs:

rr: 34 Kwonka omwe aha baserukare yaamucumita eicumu omu rubaju, ahonaaho haarugamu eshagama n'amaizi.
en: 34 but one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and forthwith came there out blood and water.

rr: 35 Owaakireebire, niwe yaakihamize, n'okuhamya kwe n'okw'amazima; kandi naamanya ku agamba amazima, ngu naimwe mwikirize.
en: 35 And he that saw it bare record, and his record is true: and he knoweth that he saith true, that ye might believe.
36 For these things were done, that the scripture should be fulfilled, A bone of him shall not be broken.
37 And again another scripture saith, They shall look on him whom they pierced.

38 And after this Joseph of Arimathæa, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate gave him leave. He came therefore, and took the body of Jesus.
39 And there came also Nicodemus, which at the first came to Jesus by night, and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about an hundred pound weight .

rr: 40 Baatwara omutumbi gwa Yesu, baaguzinga omu myenda ya kitaani ei baatairemu eby'emigaju, nk'emicwe y'Abayudaaya ey'okuziika oku yaabaire eri.
en: 40 Then took they the body of Jesus, and wound it in linen clothes with the spices, as the manner of the Jews is to bury.

rr: 41 Kandi omu mwanya ogu yaabaire abambirwemu hakaba harimu omusiri; n'omu musiri omwo hakaba harimu ekituuro kisya ekitakazikwamuga muntu.
en: 41 Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden; and in the garden a new sepulchre, wherein was never man yet laid.

rr: 42 Omwo nimwo baaziikire Yesu, ahabw'okuba rikaba riri eizooba ry'Okweteguura kw'Abayudaaya, kandi ekituuro ekyo kikaba kiri haihi.
en: 42 There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews' preparation day ; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand.
1 The first day of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early, when it was yet dark, unto the sepulchre, and seeth the stone taken away from the sepulchre.

rr: 2 N'ahabw'ekyo yairuka, yaahika Simooni Petero n'omwegi ondiijo, ou Yesu yaabaire akunda, yaabagira ati: Baihire Mukama waitu omu kituuro, kandi titurikumanya hu bamutaire.
en: 2 Then she runneth, and cometh to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Jesus loved, and saith unto them, They have taken away the Lord out of the sepulchre, and we know not where they have laid him.

rr: 3 Petero yaashohora n'omwegi ogwo ondiijo kuza aha kituuro.
en: 3 Peter therefore went forth, and that other disciple, and came to the sepulchre.

rr: 4 Bombi bairuka; kwonka omwegi ogwo ondiijo yaatsiga Petero, yaamutanga aha kituuro
en: 4 So they ran both together: and the other disciple did outrun Peter, and came first to the sepulchre.

rr: 5 yainama, yaaringurizamu, yaareeba emyenda ya kitaani etairwe aho, kwonka tiyaatahamu.
en: 5 And he stooping down, and looking in , saw the linen clothes lying; yet went he not in.

rr: 6 Bwanyima Simooni Petero yaija amukuratiire, yaataaha omu kituuro; yaareeba emyenda ya kitaani etairwe aho
en: 6 Then cometh Simon Peter following him, and went into the sepulchre, and seeth the linen clothes lie,

rr: 7 n'omutanda, ogwabaire guri aha mutwe gwe, gutatairwe ha myenda egyo ya kitaani, kureka gukubirwe, gutairwe aha kwagwo gwonka.
en: 7 and the napkin, that was about his head, not lying with the linen clothes, but wrapped together in a place by itself.

rr: 8 Omwegi ogwo ondiijo, owaabandize aha kituuro, nawe yaataahamu, yaareeba, yaikiriza
en: 8 Then went in also that other disciple, which came first to the sepulchre, and he saw, and believed.
9 For as yet they knew not the scripture, that he must rise again from the dead.

rr: 10 Bwanyima abeegi abo baagaruka omu maka gaabo.
en: 10 Then the disciples went away again unto their own home.

rr: 11 Kwonka Mariamu Magadaleene yaaguma ayemereire aha kutuuro naarira; ku yaabaire naarira, yainama yaaringuriza omu kituuro
en: 11 But Mary stood without at the sepulchre weeping: and as she wept, she stooped down, and looked into the sepulchre,

rr: 12 yaareeba baamaraika babiri bajwaire ebirikwera, bashutami ahu omutumbi gwa Yesu gubaire gutairwe, omwe aha mushego, n'ondiijo aha mirambikirizo.
en: 12 and seeth two angels in white sitting, the one at the head, and the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.

rr: 13 Baamubuuza bati: Mukazi 'we, noorizibwa ki?
en: 13 And they say unto her, Woman, why weepest thou?

rr: Yaabagarukamu ati: Ahabw'eokuba batwaire Mukama wangye, kandi tindikumanya i bamutaire.
en: She saith unto them, Because they have taken away my Lord, and I know not where they have laid him.

rr: 14 Ku yaaherize kugamba atyo, yaahinduka, yaareeba Yesu ayemereire; kwonka tiyaamanya ku ari Yesu.
en: 14 And when she had thus said, she turned herself back, and saw Jesus standing, and knew not that it was Jesus.

rr: 15 Yesu yaamubuuza ati: Mukazi 'we, noorizibwa ki? Noosherura oha? Mariamu yaateekateeka ngu n'omuhingi w'ogwo musiri, yaamugira ati: Mukama wangye, ku oraabe niiwe omutwaire, ngambira ei omutaire, nze kumwihayo.
en: 15 Jesus saith unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou? She, supposing him to be the gardener, saith unto him, Sir, if thou have borne him hence, tell me where thou hast laid him, and I will take him away.

rr: 16 Yesu yaamugira ati: Mariamu. Yaahinduka, yaamugarukamu omu Ruheburaayo ati: Rabooni! (Amakuru gaakyo ngu Omwegyesa)
en: 16 Jesus saith unto her, Mary. She turned herself, and saith unto him, Rabboni; which is to say, Master.
17 Jesus saith unto her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father; and to my God, and your God.

rr: 18 Mariamu Magadaleene yaagyenda, yaagambira abeegi ati: Naareeba Mukama waitu. Yaabateekyerereza n'ebi yaamugambira.
en: 18 Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had spoken these things unto her.

19 Then the same day at evening, being the first day of the week, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews, came Jesus and stood in the midst, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.

rr: 20 Ku yaaherize kugamba atyo, yaabooreka engaro ze n'orubaju rwe.
en: 20 And when he had so said, he shewed unto them his hands and his side.

rr: Abeegi, ku baareebire Mukama waabo, baashemererwa.
en: Then were the disciples glad, when they saw the Lord.

rr: 21 Yesu yaagaruka yaabagira ati: Mugire obusingye! Nk'oku Tata yantumire, naanye nikwo ndikubatuma.
en: 21 Then said Jesus to them again, Peace be unto you: as my Father hath sent me, even so send I you.

rr: 22 Ku yaagambire keyo, yaabaikiza omwitsyo, ati: Mwakiire Omwoyo Orikwera.
en: 22 And when he had said this, he breathed on them , and saith unto them, Receive ye the Holy Ghost:
23 whose soever sins ye remit, they are remitted unto them; and whose soever sins ye retain, they are retained.
24 But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.

rr: 25 Abeegi abandi baamugira bati: Twareeba Mukama waitu.
en: 25 The other disciples therefore said unto him, We have seen the Lord.

rr: Kwonka we yaabagira ati: Ku ndaabe ntareebire nkojo z'emisumaari mu biganja bye, nkazitamu orukumu rwangye, nkata n'ekiganja kyangye omu rubaju rwe, tindiikiriza.
en: But he said unto them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into his side, I will not believe.

rr: 26 Ku haahingwireho ebiro munaana, nabwo abeegi be bari omu nju, kandi na Tomasi ari hamwe nabo. Yesu yaija enyigi zikingirwe, yaabeemerera ahagati, yaagira ati: Mugire obusingye.
en: 26 And after eight days again his disciples were within, and Thomas with them: then came Jesus, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace be unto you.

rr: 27 Yaagambira Tomasi ati: Reeta orukumu rwawe, n'ekiganja kyawe, okite omu rubaju rwangye; orekye kuba otaine kwikiriza, kureka oine okwikiriza.
en: 27 Then saith he to Thomas, Reach hither thy finger, and behold my hands; and reach hither thy hand, and thrust it into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.

rr: 28 Tomasi yaagarukamu yaamugira ati: Mukama wangye! Kandi Ruhanga wangye!
en: 28 And Thomas answered and said unto him, My Lord and my God.
29 Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.

rr: 30 Hariho n'eby'okureeberaho ebindi bingi, ebi Yesu yaakoreire omu maisho g'abeegi be, ebitahandiikirwe omu kitabo eki
en: 30 And many other signs truly did Jesus in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book:
31 but these are written, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name.

rr: 1 Bwanyima y'ebyo Yesu yaagaruka yaayeyoreka abeegi be aha nyanja ya Tiberia; kandi oku nikwo yaabeeyorekire.
en: 1 After these things Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and on this wise shewed he himself .

rr: 2 Simooni Petero, na Tomasi orikwetwa Didumo, na Nasanaeli owa Kaana eya Galilaaya, na beene Zebedaayo, n'abeegi be abandi babiri, bakaba bari hamwe.
en: 2 There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.

rr: 3 Simooni Petero yaabagira ati: Ninza kujuba eby'enyanja.
en: 3 Simon Peter saith unto them, I go a fishing.

rr: Baamugira bati: Naitwe nitugyenda naiwe.
en: They say unto him, We also go with thee.

rr: Baagyenda baaza omu bwato; kwonka ekiro ekyo tibaagira ki baakwata.
en: They went forth, and entered into a ship immediately; and that night they caught nothing.
4 But when the morning was now come, Jesus stood on the shore: but the disciples knew not that it was Jesus.

rr: 5 Yesu yaababuuza ati: Boojo, mwine eby'okurya? Baamugarukamu bati: Ngaaha!
en: 5 Then Jesus saith unto them, Children, have ye any meat? They answered him, No.
6 And he said unto them, Cast the net on the right side of the ship, and ye shall find. They cast therefore, and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes.

rr: 7 Omwegi ogwo, ou Yesu yaabaire akunda, yaagambira Petero ati: Ni Mukama waitu.
en: 7 Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter, It is the Lord.

rr: Simooni Petero, ku yaahuriire ngu ni Mukama waitu, yaajwara omwenda, ahakuba akaba ajwaire busha, yaayetuura omu nyanja.
en: Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt his fisher's coat unto him , (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea.

rr: 8 Abeegi abandi baija omu bwato, nibakurura akatimba kaijwire eby'enyanja; ahakuba bakaba batari hare na nkungu, nk'entambwe igana.
en: 8 And the other disciples came in a little ship; (for they were not far from land, but as it were two hundred cubits,) dragging the net with fishes.

rr: 9 Ku baahikire aha nkungu, baareebaho omuriro gw'amakara, guriho eby'enyanja, n'omugaati guri aha rubaju.
en: 9 As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.

rr: 10 Yesu yaabagira ati: Mureete aha eby'enyanja aha bi mwakwata hati.
en: 10 Jesus saith unto them, Bring of the fish which ye have now caught.

rr: 11 Simooni Petero yaaguruka omu bwato, yaakurura akatimba, yaakahitsya aha nkungu kaijwire eby'enyanja bihango igana na makumi ataano na bishatu; kwonka n'obu biraabe byabaire biri bingi bityo, akatimba tikaracwekire.
en: 11 Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land full of great fishes, an hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, yet was not the net broken.

rr: 12 Yesu yaabeeta ati: Mwije murye. Kandi tihariho n'omwe aha beegi be owaateireho kumubuuza ati: Ori oha? Ahakuba bakamanya ku ari Mukama waabo.
en: 12 Jesus saith unto them, Come and dine. And none of the disciples durst ask him, Who art thou? knowing that it was the Lord.

rr: 13 Yesu yaija, yaakwata omugaati, yaagubaha, kandi n'eby'enyanja atyo.
en: 13 Jesus then cometh, and taketh bread, and giveth them, and fish likewise.

rr: 14 Ogwo nigwo murundi gwa kashatu ogu Yesu yaareebekyeire abeegi be, aherize kuzooka omu bafu.
en: 14 This is now the third time that Jesus shewed himself to his disciples, after that he was risen from the dead.

rr: 15 Ku baaherize kurya, Yesu yaabuuza Simooni Petero ati: Simooni mwene Yohaana, onkunda okukira aba?
en: 15 So when they had dined, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these?

rr: Yaamugarukamu ati: Eego, Mukama wangye; noomanya ku nkukunda.
en: He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee.

rr: Yesu yaamugira ati: Riisa abaana b'entaama zangye.
en: He saith unto him, Feed my lambs.
16 He saith to him again the second time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my sheep.

rr: 17 Yaamubuuza obwa kashatu ati: Simooni, mwene Yohaana, onkunda?
en: 17 He saith unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me?

rr: Petero yaashaasha ahabw'okumubuuza obwa kashatu ati: Onkunda?
en: Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me?

rr: Yaamugira ati: Mukama wangye, iwe noomanya byona; noomanya ku nkukunda.
en: And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee.

rr: Yesu yaamugira ati: Riisa entaama zangye.
en: Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep.

rr: 18 Buzimazima ninkugambira nti: obu waabaire ori omutsigazi, okaba oyezirika, oza ei orikwenda yoona; kwonka ku oriba omugurusi, oryagorora emikono yaawe, ondiijo akuzirikye, akutware ei otarikwenda.
en: 18 Verily, verily, I say unto thee, When thou wast young, thou girdedst thyself, and walkedst whither thou wouldest: but when thou shalt be old, thou shalt stretch forth thy hands, and another shall gird thee, and carry thee whither thou wouldest not.
19 This spake he, signifying by what death he should glorify God. And when he had spoken this, he saith unto him, Follow me.

rr: 20 Petero, ku yaahindukire yaareeba omwegi ogwo, ou Yesu yaabaire akunda, abakuratiire; niwe owaabiare ayegamirie Yesu omu kufuba nibarya, obu yaamubuuza ati: Mukama wangye, n'oha orikuza kukureebya?
en: 20 Then Peter, turning about, seeth the disciple whom Jesus loved following; which also leaned on his breast at supper, and said, Lord, which is he that betrayeth thee?

rr: 21 Petero, ku yaamureebire, yaabuuza Yesu ati: Mukama wangye, ogu aryaba ata?
en: 21 Peter seeing him saith to Jesus, Lord, and what shall this man do ?

rr: 22 Yesu yaamugarukamu ati: Ku naakwenda ngu agumeho okuhitsya ahu ndiizira, noofa ki? Iwe nkuratira!
en: 22 Jesus saith unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee? follow thou me.

rr: 23 Ekigambo ekyo kyabuga omu b'eishe-emwe, ku omwegi ogwo atarifa; kwonka Yesu taramugambiire ku atarifa, kureka ati: Ku naakwenda ngu agumeho okuhitsya ahu ndiizira, noofa ki?
en: 23 Then went this saying abroad among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet Jesus said not unto him, He shall not die; but, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee?

rr: 24 Ogwo niwe mwegi orikuhamya ebyo, kandi niwe yaabihandiikire; kandi nitumanya ngu okuhamya kwe n'okw'amazima.
en: 24 This is the disciple which testifieth of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his testimony is true.

rr: 25 Kandi hariho n'ebindi bingi ebi Yesu yaakozire; kuri noogira ngu byona bikahandiikwa buri kimwe, ninteekateeka nti, ebitabo ebyakuhandiikirwe bikaashaagire omu nsi.
en: 25 And there are also many other things which Jesus did, the which, if they should be written every one, I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written. Amen.

rr: Omu nsi ya Uuzi hakaba harimu omushaija orikwetwa Yobu; ogwo mushaija akaba ari omuntu otaine kabara, kandi ohikiriire, owaabaire atiina Ruhanga, akeetantara ekibi.
en: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job; and that man was perfect and upright, and one that feared God, and eschewed evil.

rr: Akazaara aboojo mushanju n'abaishiki bashatu.
en: And there were born unto him seven sons and three daughters.

rr: Kandi akaba atungire entaama enkumi mushanju, engamira enkumi ishatu, enimi z'okuhingisa rukumi, ebuguma z'endogoya magana ataano, n'abahuuku baingi munonga. N'ahabw'ekyo ogwo mushaija akaba ari omushaija rugambwa orikukira abashaija boona ab'omu nsi z'oburugwa-izooba.
en: His substance also was seven thousand sheep, and three thousand camels, and five hundred yoke of oxen, and five hundred she asses, and a very great household; so that this man was the greatest of all the men of the east.

rr: Kandi abatabani bakaba bakunda kuriira obugyenyi omu nju ya buri omwe aha izooba rye, kandi batuma ahari banyaanyabo bonshatu kwija kurya n'okunywa nabo.
en: And his sons went and feasted in their houses, every one his day; and sent and called for their three sisters to eat and to drink with them.

rr: Bwanyima ebiro byabo eby'obugyenyi bikihwa, Yobu abatumaho kubeeza, aimuka kare omu kasheeshe, atamba ebitambo by'okwotsya ebirikwingana n'omubaro gwabo boona; ahabw'okuba Yobu akaba agira ati: Obundi abaana bangye bakaaba basiisire, bahemukire ahari Ruhanga omu mitima yaabo.
en: And it was so, when the days of their feasting were gone about, that Job sent and sanctified them, and rose up early in the morning, and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all: for Job said, It may be that my sons have sinned, and cursed God in their hearts.

rr: Okwo nikwo Yobu yaabaire atwaza obutoosha.
en: Thus did Job continually.

rr: Sitaane okugaya okuhikiirira kwa Yobu
en: Job's Character

rr: 1 Eizooba rimwe abaana ba Ruhanga bakaija kwemurika ahari MUKAMA, na Sitaane yaabaijamu.
en: Now there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the LORD , and Satan came also among them.

rr: MUKAMA yaabuuza Sitaane ati: Nooruga hi?
en: And the LORD said unto Satan, Whence comest thou?

rr: Sitaane yaamugarukamu ati: Ninduga kugyendagyenda omu nsi, n'okugizengyereramu.
en: Then Satan answered the LORD , and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.

rr: MUKAMA yaagaruka yaamubuuza ati: Ebyo waayetegyereza omwiru wangye Yobu, ku hataine mushaija orikumushusha omu nsi, ku ataine kabara kandi ku ahikiriire, omushaija orikuntiina, kandi orikwetantara ekibi?
en: And the LORD said unto Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth God, and escheweth evil?

rr: Sitaane yaagarukamu MUKAMA ati: Noogira ngu Yobu akutiinira busha?
en: Then Satan answered the LORD , and said, Doth Job fear God for nought?

rr: Tiiwe omurinda embaju zoona, we n'enju ye n'ebi atungire byona? Okaha omugisha ebi yaakozire n'emikono ye, kandi waakanyisa ebi atungire byona.
en: Hast not thou made an hedge about him, and about his house, and about all that he hath on every side? thou hast blessed the work of his hands, and his substance is increased in the land.

rr: Kwonka hati gorora omukono gwawe, okore aha bintu bye byona; naija kukwehakana butunu.
en: But put forth thine hand now, and touch all that he hath, and he will curse thee to thy face.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Sitaane ati: Reeba, ebi atungire byona biri omu bushoboorozi bwawe; kwonka we, otamukoraho.
en: And the LORD said unto Satan, Behold, all that he hath is in thy power; only upon himself put not forth thine hand.

rr: Atyo Sitaane yaaruga omu maisho ga MUKAMA.
en: So Satan went forth from the presence of the LORD .

rr: Yobu okumarwaho ebye, n'okufeerwa abaana be
en: His Afflictions

rr: Eizooba rimwe abatabani na bahara be bakaba nibarya nibanywera viinyo omu nju ya mukuru waabo
en: And there was a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother's house:

rr: entumwa yaija ahari Yobu, yaamubikira eti: Enimi zaaba nizihinga, n'endogoya niziriira aha rubaju rwazo
en: and there came a messenger unto Job, and said, The oxen were plowing, and the asses feeding beside them:

rr: ahonaaho aba Sabeya baazeeshukamu, baazinyaga, n'abariisa baazo baabaitsa rurara; niinye nyenka owaahonokaho, nkaija kubikubikira.
en: and the Sabeans fell upon them , and took them away; yea, they have slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.

rr: Ku yaabaire naakigamba, endiijo ntumwa yaija, yaagira eti: Omuriro gwa Ruhanga gwaruga omu iguru, gwayotsya entaama n'abariisa baazo, gwabicwekyereza; niinye nyenka owaahonokaho, nkaija kubikubikira.
en: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The fire of God is fallen from heaven, and hath burned up the sheep, and the servants, and consumed them; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.

rr: Nawe ku yaabaire naakigamba, haija ondiijo, yaagira ati: Abakaludaaya baija omu mitwe eshatu, baayeshuka omu ngamira, baazinyaga, n'abariisa baazo baabaitsa rurara; niinye nyenka owaahonokaho, nkaija kubikubikira.
en: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The Chaldeans made out three bands, and fell upon the camels, and have carried them away, yea, and slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.

rr: N'ogwo ku yaabaire naakigamba, haija ondiijo, yaagira ati: Batabani baawe na bahara baawe baaba nibarya, nibanywera viinyo omu nju ya mukuru waabo
en: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, Thy sons and thy daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother's house:

rr: omuyaga gw'amaani gwareetwa omu ihamba, gwateera embaju ina z'enju, enju yaagwera abo batsigazi, baafa; niinye nyenka owaahonokaho, nkaija kubikubikira.
en: and, behold, there came a great wind from the wilderness, and smote the four corners of the house, and it fell upon the young men, and they are dead; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.

rr: Yobu, ku yaabihuriire, yaimuka, yaataagura ekijwaro kye, yaamwa eishokye rye, yaajuumara ahansi, yaaramya, naagira ati
en: Then Job arose, and rent his mantle, and shaved his head, and fell down upon the ground, and worshipped,

rr: Nkaruga omu nda ya maawe ntaine ki njwaire, kandi nikwo ndigarukayo ntyo. MUKAMA akampa, mbwenu abiinyihireho. Eiziina rya MUKAMA risiimwe!
en: and said, Naked came I out of my mother's womb, and naked shall I return thither: the LORD gave, and the LORD hath taken away; blessed be the name of the LORD .

rr: Omuri ebyo byona Yobu tarakozire kibi, n'obu kwakuba okubarira Ruhanga okushobya.
en: In all this Job sinned not, nor charged God foolishly.

rr: Kandi aha izooba erindi abaana ba Ruhanga bakaija kwemurika ahari MUKAMA, na Sitaane yaabaijamu ngu nawe ayemurikye ahari MUKAMA.
en: Again there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the LORD , and Satan came also among them to present himself before the LORD .

rr: MUKAMA yaabuuza Sitaane ati: Nooruga hi?
en: And the LORD said unto Satan, From whence comest thou?

rr: Sitaane yaamugarukamu ati: Ninduga kugyendagyenda omu nsi, n'okugizengyereramu.
en: And Satan answered the LORD , and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.

rr: MUKAMA yaagaruka yaabuuza Sitaane ati: Ebyo oyetegyereize omwiru wangye Yobu, ku hataine mushaija orikumushusha omu nsi, ku ataine kabara, kandi ku ahikiriire, omushaija orinkutiina akeetantara ekibi? Na mbwenu, n'obu oraabe wandeeteire kumukora kubi, n'okumucwekyereza nimmutura busha, kwonka akihamiire aha kuhikiirira kwe.
en: And the LORD said unto Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth God, and escheweth evil? and still he holdeth fast his integrity, although thou movedst me against him, to destroy him without cause.

rr: Sitaane yaamugarukamu ati: Amagara gakira amagana. Ebi omuntu atungire byona, akaabihayo ahaw'amagara ge.
en: And Satan answered the LORD , and said, Skin for skin, yea, all that a man hath will he give for his life.

rr: Kwonka mbwenu gorora omukono gwawe, okore aha magufa ge n'aha mubiri gwe, naija kukwehakana butunu.
en: But put forth thine hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh, and he will curse thee to thy face.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Sitaane ati: Reeba, ari omu bushoboorozi bwawe; kwonka otamwita.
en: And the LORD said unto Satan, Behold, he is in thine hand; but save his life.

rr: Atyo Sitaane yaaruga omu maisho ga MUKAMA, yaarwaza Yobu ebihuute bibi, okuruga aha mara g'ebigyere okuhika aha kazingiro k'eishokye.
en: So went Satan forth from the presence of the LORD , and smote Job with sore boils from the sole of his foot unto his crown.

rr: Yobu yaayesherurira orugusyo rw'okweyaguza, yaashutama omu iju.
en: And he took him a potsherd to scrape himself withal; and he sat down among the ashes.

rr: Bwanyima omukazi we yaamugira ati: Beitu na hati okuhamiire aha kuhikiirira kwawe? Yehakane Ruhanga, ofe.
en: Then said his wife unto him, Dost thou still retain thine integrity? curse God, and die.

rr: Kwonka we yaamugarukamu ati: Noogamba nk'omukazi omushema.
en: But he said unto her, Thou speakest as one of the foolish women speaketh.

rr: Noogira ngu turyaheebwa ebirungi byonka omu mikono ya Ruhanga, tituriheebwa n'ebibi?
en: What? shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil?

rr: Omuri ebyo byona Yobu taracumwire na rurimi rwe.
en: In all this did not Job sin with his lips.

rr: Banywani ba Yobu okwija kumuyaagira
en: His Friends

rr: Bwanyima banywani ba Yobu bashatu, ku baahuriire ezo naku zoona ezimuhikireho, baija, buri muntu naaruga owe, Elifaazi Omutemaani, Biludaadi Omushuuhi, na Zofari Omunaamasi. Baaragaana kwija kumuyaagira n'okumugumya.
en: Now when Job's three friends heard of all this evil that was come upon him, they came every one from his own place; Eliphaz the Temanite, and Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite: for they had made an appointment together to come to mourn with him and to comfort him.

rr: Ku baamureebire bakiri hare, baamwebwa, baimutsya amaraka gaabo, baarira; baataagura ebijwaro byabo, baayeshuka eiju omu mutwe, kandi baarimiisha n'ahaiguru.
en: And when they lifted up their eyes afar off, and knew him not, they lifted up their voice, and wept; and they rent every one his mantle, and sprinkled dust upon their heads toward heaven.

rr: Bwanyima baashutama nawe ahansi okumara ebiro mushanju nyomushana na nyekiro; tihaagira n'omwe owaamugambira ekigambo, ahabw'okureeba obusaasi bwe burengyesereize.
en: So they sat down with him upon the ground seven days and seven nights, and none spake a word unto him: for they saw that his grief was very great.

rr: Currently Selected: Yobu 2 : RR64 Highlight Share <path d="M5 12a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h3a1 1 0 1 1 0 2H6a
Bwanyima y'byo Yobu yaayashamya akanwa ke, yaagamba, yaakyeena eizooba eri yaazaariirweho
en: After this opened Job his mouth, and cursed his day.

rr: naagira ati
en: And Job spake, and said,

rr: Nkaahenwa ki, eizooba eri naazaariirweho ricwekyerezibwa, N'ekiro eki baagambiireho ngu, Maawe abakira enda y'omwana w'omwojo.
en: Let the day perish wherein I was born, And the night in which it was said, There is a man child conceived.

rr: Eryo izooba rihinduka omwirima! Ruhanga ow'ahaiguru areka kuryetaho, Kandi rireka kujwerwa omushana
en: Let that day be darkness; Let not God regard it from above, Neither let the light shine upon it.

rr: Omwirima n'ekibunda kya rufu birihindura eryabyo, Ebicu birikondakondera, Obwira-kabiri bwona buritiinisa
en: Let darkness and the shadow of death stain it; Let a cloud dwell upon it; Let the blackness of the day terrify it.

rr: Ekyo kiro kikwatwa omwirima ndindindi, Kireka kushemererwa omu biro by'omwaka, N'obu kwakuba okubarirwa omu gandi meezi
en: As for that night, let darkness seize upon it; Let it not be joined unto the days of the year, Let it not come into the number of the months.

rr: Eego, ekyo kiro kiba engumba, Kireka kuhurirwamu akaari k'okushemererwa
en: Lo, let that night be solitary, Let no joyful voice come therein.

rr: Rikyeenwa abakyeena ebiro, Abarikumanya kwimutsya Leviasaani
en: Let them curse it that curse the day, Who are ready to raise up their mourning.

rr: Enyonyoozi z'omu buturuturu bwaryo zireka kujwa, Ritegyereza omushana, guriburira, Kandi ribura kureeba okujuguta kw'omushekye
en: Let the stars of the twilight thereof be dark; Let it look for light, but have none; Neither let it see the dawning of the day:

rr: Ahabw'okuba tiriragaize nda ya maawe, N'obu kwakuba okuzibira amaisho gangye kureeba obusaasi.
en: Because it shut not up the doors of my mother's womb, Nor hid sorrow from mine eyes.

rr: Ahabw'enki ntarafiire ninzaarwa, Nkabura kwitsya ninkishohora nti?
en: Why died I not from the womb? Why did I not give up the ghost When I came out of the belly?

rr: Ahabw'enki naashangire ebibero by'okukiikirwaho, N'amabeere g'okwonka?
en: Why did the knees prevent me? Or why the breasts that I should suck?

rr: Kuri kyabaire kityo, nkaabaire mbyami, mpunami; Nkaabaire ngwejegyeire, nyehuumuriire
en: For now should I have lain still and been quiet, I should have slept: then had I been at rest,

rr: Ndi hamwe n'abagabe b'ensi n'abahi b'obwengye baabo, Abaayeyombekyeire ebituuro by'ekitiinisa by'okuziikwamu
en: With kings and counsellors of the earth, Which built desolate places for themselves;

rr: Nari shi, n'abanyiginya abaabaire baine ezaabu, Baijwize amaka gaabo efeeza.
en: Or with princes that had gold, Who filled their houses with silver:

rr: Kuri naabaire nk'enda erugamu etamanyirwe, Nk'abeereere abatarareebire mushana
en: Or as an hidden untimely birth I had not been; As infants which never saw light.

rr: Okwo niyo abasiisi baba batakiitira kubi bantu, Kandi niyo abaruhire baruhuukira.
en: There the wicked cease from troubling; And there the weary be at rest.

rr: Niyo enkwatwa zihuumurira hamwe, zituurize, Zitakihurira iraka ry'orikuzikoresa kubi.
en: There the prisoners rest together; They hear not the voice of the oppressor.

rr: Omuto n'omukuru niyo bataaha, Kandi omuhuuku tategyekyerwayo mukama we.
en: The small and great are there; And the servant is free from his master.

rr: Ahabw'enki Ruhanga ajwisiza enshoberwa omushana, N'abaine entimba aha mutima akabagumyaho?
en: Wherefore is light given to him that is in misery, And life unto the bitter in soul;

rr: Ahabw'okuba beetenga rufu, tibagibona; Bagitimba okukira oku abantu batimba ezaabu esherekirwe.
en: Which long for death, but it cometh not; And dig for it more than for hid treasures;

rr: Ku bahika aha kituuro, bashemererwa munonga, beesiima.
en: Which rejoice exceedingly, And are glad, when they can find the grave?

rr: Ahabw'enki Ruhanga ajwisiza omuntu omushana, Otaine butooro, kandi ou akubiire hamwe?
en: Why is light given to a man whose way is hid, And whom God hath hedged in?

rr: Manya okutsinda kwangye kumbeereire eby'okurya, N'okuborooga kwangye nikweshuka nk'amaizi
en: For my sighing cometh before I eat, And my roarings are poured out like the waters.

rr: Ahabw'okuba eki ndikutiina, nikyo kirikumpikaho, Kandi ekirikuunyitsa obwoba nikyo kirikungwaho.
en: For the thing which I greatly feared is come upon me, And that which I was afraid of is come unto me.

rr: Tiinyine busingye, tintuurize, kandi tiinyine buhuumure, Kureka enaku nizo zirikuunyeshukyera.
en: I was not in safety, neither had I rest, neither was I quiet; Yet trouble came.

rr: Bwanyima Elifaazi Omutemaani yaagarukamu ati
en: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,

rr: Omuntu ku yaakuteeraho kugamba naiwe, okaaguubwa kubi? Beitu shi hoona n'oha orikubaasa kwezibira kugamba?
en: If we assay to commune with thee, wilt thou be grieved? But who can withhold himself from speaking?

rr: Reeba, okaba oyegyesa baingi, Kandi okaba ohamya emikono etaine maani.
en: Behold, thou hast instructed many, And thou hast strengthened the weak hands.

rr: Ebigambo byawe bikaba biramira orikwenda kugwa, Kandi okaba ohamya entegye ezirikubonda.
en: Thy words have upholden him that was falling, And thou hast strengthened the feeble knees.

rr: Kwonka mbwenu niiwe bihikireho, kandi tiwaagumisiriza! Bikukozireho, waahahaaza omutima!
en: But now it is come upon thee, and thou faintest; It toucheth thee, and thou art troubled.

rr: Obwesigye bwawe tiburi omu kutiina Ruhanga, Kandi amatsiko gaawe tigari omu kuhikiirira kw'emitwarize yaawe?
en: Is not this thy fear, thy confidence, Thy hope, and the uprightness of thy ways?

rr: Mbwenu ijuka; n'oha oracwekyereire ataine rubanja? Nari shi, abahikiriire baramazirweho?
en: Remember, I pray thee, who ever perished, being innocent? Or where were the righteous cut off?

rr: Nyowe nk'oku ndareebire, abahinga okutahikiirira, Bakabiba obubi, nibyo bagyesha.
en: Even as I have seen, they that plow iniquity, And sow wickedness, reap the same.

rr: Bacwekyerezibwa omwitsyo gwa Ruhanga, Bamarwaho okuhoorera kw'ekiniga kye.
en: By the blast of God they perish, And by the breath of his nostrils are they consumed.

rr: Okutsinda kw'entare, n'eiraka ry'entare enshaarizi bihunama, N'amaino g'emigunju y'entare gacweka.
en: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, And the teeth of the young lions, are broken.

rr: Ekisimba ky'entare kifa ahabw'okubura omuhiigo, Kandi n'obwana bw'entare enkazi butaataana.
en: The old lion perisheth for lack of prey, And the stout lion's whelps are scattered abroad.

rr: Mbwenu hariho ekigambo eki naagambiirwe bwesherekye, Okutu kwangye kukakihurira nikiij mpora
en: Now a thing was secretly brought to me, And mine ear received a little thereof.

rr: Omu biteekateeko ebyarugire omu kworekwa kwa nyekiro, Abantu baahirwayo.
en: In thoughts from the visions of the night, When deep sleep falleth on men,

rr: Naagira obwoba, naatetema, Kyareetera amagufa gangye goona kukomangana.
en: Fear came upon me, and trembling, Which made all my bones to shake.

rr: Omuzimu gwandaba omumaisho, Ekikoba kyampwa aha mutwe
en: Then a spirit passed before my face; The hair of my flesh stood up:

rr: Gwayemerera aho, kwonka tinaamanya oku gurikushusha; Omu maisho gangye haabamu waringa. Haaabaho akaceceko, bwanyima naahurira eiraka eririkugira riti
en: It stood still, But I could not discern the form thereof: An image was before mine eyes, There was silence, and I heard a voice, saying ,

rr: Omuntu ofa naabaasa kuba ohikiriire omu maisho ga Ruhanga? Naabaasa kuba oshugaine omu maisho g'Owaamuhangire?
en: Shall mortal man be more just than God? Shall a man be more pure than his maker?

rr: Nangwa n'abagaragwa be tabeesiga, Na baamaraika be aboomesereza ebishobyo
en: Behold, he put no trust in his servants; And his angels he charged with folly:

rr: Kaashwa abo abatuura omu maka g'eitaka, Agu omusingi gwago guri omu mucuucu; Abarikuribatwa bakatanga ekiyenje kubaruka.
en: How much less in them that dwell in houses of clay, Whose foundation is in the dust, Which are crushed before the moth?

rr: Bacwekyererera ahagati y'akasheeshe n'omwabazyo; Bahweraho kimwe, hataine okyetaireho.
en: They are destroyed from morning to evening: They perish for ever without any regarding it .

rr: Omurunga gw'eihema ryabo ku gubaihwamu, Tibafa, kandi bakafa bataine bwengye? Currently Selected: Yobu 4 : RR64 Highlight Share <div
en: Doth not their excellency which is in them go away? They die, even without wisdom. Currently Selected: Job 4 : KJV Highlight Share <path d="M5 12a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h3a1

rr: Hati taka; hariho n'omwe orikukugarukamu? Omu barikwera ou waakwagira n'oha?
en: Call now, if there be any that will answer thee; And to which of the saints wilt thou turn?

rr: Buzimazima ekiniga kiita omushema, Kandi eihari riita otaine bwengye.
en: For wrath killeth the foolish man, And envy slayeth the silly one.

rr: Nkareeba omushema naatsimba emizi, Kwonka omu mwanya mukye naakyeena obutaaho bwe
en: I have seen the foolish taking root: But suddenly I cursed his habitation.

rr: Abaana be obuhooro bubari hare, Basingyererwa omu marembo, Babura kijuna.
en: His children are far from safety, And they are crushed in the gate, Neither is there any to deliver them .

rr: Ebi ashaarwire biriibwa abaine enjara, Bagaruka batwara n'ebiri omu mahwa; Abaine eiriho bainiire ebintu bye ekyaka
en: Whose harvest the hungry eateth up, And taketh it even out of the thorns, And the robber swalloweth up their substance.

rr: Ahabw'okuba okubonabona tikuruga mu mucuucu, N'enaku tizimera mu itaka
en: Although affliction cometh not forth of the dust, Neither doth trouble spring out of the ground;

rr: Kwonka omuntu azaarirwa enaku Nk'oku esiriira zituumuuka omu mwanya.
en: Yet man is born unto trouble, As the sparks fly upward.

rr: Nyowe ahabwangye nkaasherwire Ruhanga, Kandi Ruhanga mba niwe naayegyekyera ebyangye.
en: I would seek unto God, And unto God would I commit my cause:

rr: Niwe akora eby'amaani ebitakareebwaga, N'eby'okutangaaza ebitarikubasa kubarwa.
en: Which doeth great things and unsearchable; Marvellous things without number:

rr: Niwe agwisiza ensi enjura, Akashandaaza amaizi omu misiri.
en: Who giveth rain upon the earth, And sendeth waters upon the fields:

rr: Niwe atunguura ab'ahansi, N'abarikuborooga akabaimutsya, bakaba buhooro.
en: To set up on high those that be low; That those which mourn may be exalted to safety.

rr: Ahindura busha enaama z'engobya, Ngu emikono yaazo eremwe kuhitsya eki zimaririire kukora.
en: He disappointeth the devices of the crafty, So that their hands cannot perform their enterprise.

rr: Akwatira abanyabwengye omu bugobya bwabo, N'enaama z'engobya zimarwaho juba.
en: He taketh the wise in their own craftiness: And the counsel of the froward is carried headlong.

rr: Babugaabugana n'omwirima nyomushana, Babandagira omu ihangwe nk'owa nyekiro.
en: They meet with darkness in the daytime, And grope in the noonday as in the night.

rr: Kwonka omworo amujuna omu kanwa kaabo, N'omukyene amwiha omu mikono y'ab'amaani.
en: But he saveth the poor from the sword, from their mouth, And from the hand of the mighty.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo omworo agira amatsiko, Kandi n'akanwa k'abatahikiriire kabumbwa.
en: So the poor hath hope, And iniquity stoppeth her mouth.

rr: Manya, omuntu ou Ruhanga ahana, aba ahiiriirwe, N'ahabw'ekyo otagaya okuhana kw'Ow'obushoboorozi bwona
en: Behold, happy is the man whom God correcteth: Therefore despise not thou the chastening of the Almighty:

rr: Ahabw'okuba ahutaaza, kwonka ashemba obuhuta, Ateera, kwonka engaro ze nizo zikiza.
en: For he maketh sore, and bindeth up: He woundeth, and his hands make whole.

rr: Aryakujuna obugwe mukaaga, Nangwa n'omu bugwe mushanju tihariho kibi ekirikuhikaho.
en: He shall deliver thee in six troubles: Yea, in seven there shall no evil touch thee.

rr: Omu biro by'enjara aryakucungura, orekye kufa; N'omu rugamba aryakukiza amaani ga rurara.
en: In famine he shall redeem thee from death: And in war from the power of the sword.

rr: Oryasherekwa orurimi rurikubambura, Kandi okuhwerekyerera ku kuriija, torikutiina.
en: Thou shalt be hid from the scourge of the tongue: Neither shalt thou be afraid of destruction when it cometh.

rr: Okuhwerekyerera n'enjara oryabishekyerera, Kandi toritiina nyamaishwa z'omu nsi
en: At destruction and famine thou shalt laugh: Neither shalt thou be afraid of the beasts of the earth.

rr: Ahabw'okuba oryaragaana n'amabaare g'omu bwerere, N'enyamaishwa z'omu ihamba ziryagira obusingye naiwe.
en: For thou shalt be in league with the stones of the field: And the beasts of the field shall be at peace with thee.

rr: Oryamanya ku eka yaawe eine obusingye, Oryaguma nooreeba engombe y'amatungo gaawe, oshangye hataine kibuziremu.
en: And thou shalt know that thy tabernacle shall be in peace; And thou shalt visit thy habitation, and shalt not sin.

rr: Nibwo orimanya ku oruzaaro rwawe rurikanya, Na baijukuru baawe bakaba nk'obunyaatsi bw'omu nsi.
en: Thou shalt know also that thy seed shall be great, And thine offspring as the grass of the earth.

rr: Oryataaha omu kituuro kyawe okuzire gye, Nk'ekiba ky'engano oku kihunikwa omu bunaku bwakyo.
en: Thou shalt come to thy grave in a full age, Like as a shock of corn cometh in in his season.

rr: Reeba, ebyo nibyo twacondoorize, tukashanga biri bityo; Obihurire, obyegyereho eky'okukugasira.
en: Lo this, we have searched it, so it is ; Hear it, and know thou it for thy good.

rr: Bwanyima Yobu yaagarukamu ati
en: But Job answered and said,

rr: Ai bambe! Nkaabaasibwa ki, obugwa kubi bwangye burengwa, Nari ebihikiirizi byangye byona biteebwa aha minzaani!
en: Oh that my grief were throughly weighed, And my calamity laid in the balances together!

rr: Bikaaremeera okukira omusheenyi ogw'omu nyanja. Nikyo kindeeteire kurahuka kugamba
en: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the sea: Therefore my words are swallowed up.

rr: Ahabw'okuba emyambi y'Ow'obushoboorozi bwona endi omunda, Amagara gangye niganywa obushegu bwayo, Eby'okutiinisa bya Ruhanga bitengire orugamba kundwanisa.
en: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me, The poison whereof drinketh up my spirit: The terrors of God do set themselves in array against me.

rr: Noogira ngu enturegye neekunga, eine obunyaatsi omu kanwa, Nari shi ente ejuga neerya?
en: Doth the wild ass bray when he hath grass? Or loweth the ox over his fodder?

rr: Ekitaine nsha kiriibwa kitarimu mwonyo, Nari omu maizi g'eihuri habamu akanuzi?
en: Can that which is unsavoury be eaten without salt? Or is there any taste in the white of an egg?

rr: Omutima gwangye tigurikwenda kubirozaho; Nibinsusira nk'eby'okurya birikunugwa.
en: The things that my soul refused to touch Are as my sorrowful meat.

rr: Nkaabaasibwa ki, ntunga eki ndikushaba, Ruhanga ampa eki ndikwetenga!
en: Oh that I might have my request; And that God would grant me the thing that I long for!

rr: Ruhanga aikiriza kunsingyera, Atayo omukono gwe, ampuhura.
en: Even that it would please God to destroy me; That he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!

rr: Obwo nkaatunga obuhuumure, Nangwa n'omu busaasi obutarikutuuza nkaayesiima, Ahabw'okuba tindikuhakanisa bi Orikwera arikugamba.
en: Then should I yet have comfort; Yea, I would harden myself in sorrow: let him not spare; For I have not concealed the words of the Holy One.

rr: Nyine maani ki g'okutegyereza? Omuheru gw'obusaasi bwangye n'enki, ngu mbone kugumisiriza?
en: What is my strength, that I should hope? And what is mine end, that I should prolong my life?

rr: Amaani gangye n'amaani g'amabaare, Nari omubiri gwangye n'omuringa?
en: Is my strength the strength of stones? Or is my flesh of brass?

rr: Buzimazima omuriinye tinkiinemu buhwezi, Kandi obundi buhwezi bwona buunyihirweho.
en: Is not my help in me? And is wisdom driven quite from me?

rr: Munywani w'omuntu orembire ashemereire kumugirira embabazi, Ngu atakaareka kutiina Ow'obushoboorozi bwona.
en: To him that is afflicted pity should be shewed from his friend; But he forsaketh the fear of the Almighty.

rr: Beene waitu n'endyarya, nk'otugyera, Nk'omukuru ogurikureetwamu omwegyemure, gukooma
en: My brethren have dealt deceitfully as a brook, And as the stream of brooks they pass away;

rr: Ogurikwiraguzibwa amaizi agakwatsire, Omu orubaare rweshereka.
en: Which are blackish by reason of the ice, And wherein the snow is hid:

rr: Hakibaho obutagatsi bikahwerera, Omushana gukijwa, bikaruga omu mwanya gwabyo.
en: What time they wax warm, they vanish: When it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.

rr: Emitwe y'abagyenzi eyaabaire eraba aha rubaju rw'ogwo mukura, eteishuka, Eza omu ihamba, egwayo.
en: The paths of their way are turned aside; They go to nothing, and perish.

rr: Emitwe y'Abateema eguma neesherura, N'abagyenzi ba Sheeba baguma bategyereize
en: The troops of Tema looked, The companies of Sheba waited for them.

rr: Bahwa amatsiko, ahabw'okuba bakaba bagira obwesigye, Bakihikayo, bashoberwa.
en: They were confounded because they had hoped; They came thither, and were ashamed.

rr: Okwo nikwo mumbeereire; Ku mureebire ebihikiirizi ebimpikireho, mwatiina.
en: For now ye are nothing; Ye see my casting down, and are afraid.

rr: Hariho obu naagizire nti: Mugire eki mwampa? Nari shi nti: Mumpe ekiconco aha bi mutungire?
en: Did I say, Bring unto me? Or, Give a reward for me of your substance?

rr: Nari nti: Munjune omu mikono y'omuzigu? Nari nti: Muncungure omu mikono y'abarikumpata?
en: Or, Deliver me from the enemy's hand? Or, Redeem me from the hand of the mighty?

rr: Muunyegyese, naanye niinyija kwetsiza; Mummanyise eki naashobize.
en: Teach me, and I will hold my tongue: And cause me to understand wherein I have erred.

rr: Ebigambo by'okuhikiirira ka n'eby'amaani! Mbwenu empaka zaanyu nizimpana ki?
en: How forcible are right words! But what doth your arguing reprove?

rr: Nimwenda kuhana ebigambo? Manya ebigambo by'owaayehweire amatsiko biri nk'omuyaga.
en: Do ye imagine to reprove words, And the speeches of one that is desperate, which are as wind?

rr: Buzima nimukunda kuteerera efuuzi enteenyu, N'okwiha ahari munywani waanyu enshaagi.
en: Yea, ye overwhelm the fatherless, And ye dig a pit for your friend.

rr: Mbwenu hati nimbeeshengyereza mundeebe; Ahabw'okuba buzima tindikubeiha, nk'oku murikundeeba.
en: Now therefore be content, look upon me; For it is evident unto you if I lie.

rr: Nimbeeshengyereza muhindukye, mutakora ebitari by'okuhikiirira. Eego muhindukye; ebyangye n'eby'oburyo.
en: Return, I pray you, let it not be iniquity; Yea, return again, my righteousness is in it.

rr: Nimugira ngu orurimi rwangye rwine oku ruri?
en: Is there iniquity in my tongue?

rr: Tirurikubaasa kumanya ekibi?
en: Cannot my taste discern perverse things?

rr: Omuntu okiri omu nsi tari aha rubu rw'okurwana orugamba? Ebiro bye ti nk'eby'orikukorera ebihembo?
en: Is there not an appointed time to man upon earth? Are not his days also like the days of an hireling?

rr: Nk'oku omuhuuku ayetenga ekicuucu, Kandi nk'oku orikukorera ebihembo abitegyereza
en: As a servant earnestly desireth the shadow, And as an hireling looketh for the reward of his work:

rr: Naanye nikwo naahairwe ameezi ga busha, Nkateerwaho ebiro birikurusya.
en: So am I made to possess months of vanity, And wearisome nights are appointed to me.

rr: Ku mbyama, ngira nti: Nibusheesha ryari, nkaimuka?
en: When I lie down, I say, When shall I arise, and the night be gone?

rr: Kwonka ekiro kigyenda ira; Ndaara niinyehindaguturana, burugaho busheesha.
en: And I am full of tossings to and fro unto the dawning of the day.

rr: Omubiri gwangye gushwekirwe enyogori n'ebikoko, Oruhu rwagwo nirugangaara, rugaruka rushatuka.
en: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust; My skin is broken, and become loathsome.

rr: Ebiro byangye nibyehuuta okukira eky'okurukisa ky'omuriki w'emyenda; Bihwaho ntaine matsiko.
en: My days are swifter than a weaver's shuttle, And are spent without hope.

rr: Ai bambe, ijuka amagara gangye, ku gari nk'omuyaga; Amaisho gangye tigarigaruka kureeba birungi.
en: O remember that my life is wind: Mine eye shall no more see good.

rr: Orikundeeba tarigaruka kundeeba bundi; Amaisho gaawe ku gariba nigakindeeba, ndyabura.
en: The eye of him that hath seen me shall see me no more: Thine eyes are upon me, and I am not.

rr: Nk'oku ekicu kiyaayuuka, kikabura, Nikwo orikushuuma okuzimu atarigaruka
en: As the cloud is consumed and vanisheth away: So he that goeth down to the grave shall come up no more .

rr: Tarigaruka mu ka ye obundi, Kandi omwanya gwe tigurigaruka kumumanya.
en: He shall return no more to his house, Neither shall his place know him any more.

rr: Nikyo ntarikubaasiza kwezibira kugamba; Niinyija kugambisibwa obusaasi bw'omu mutima gwangye, Nyetomboite ahabw'entimba y'omu magara gangye.
en: Therefore I will not refrain my mouth; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.

rr: Nyowe ndi enyanja, nari ndi omugoye, Waaza kuntaho ow'okundinda?
en: Am I a sea, or a whale, That thou settest a watch over me?

rr: Ku ndaagire nti: Ekitanda kyangye nikiija kumpuumuza, Ekitabo kyangye nikiija kutuubya aha busaasi bwangye
en: When I say, My bed shall comfort me, My couch shall ease my complaint;

rr: Obwo nonkangisa n'ebirooto, Ontiinisa n'ebi oyorekirwe
en: Then thou scarest me with dreams, And terrifiest me through visions:

rr: Ngu nyihemu okuteebwa aha munigo, nkafa, Okukira okuguma mpweire aha magufa.
en: So that my soul chooseth strangling, And death rather than my life.

rr: Omuntu ni kintu ki, Iwe okumutunguura, N'okumwetaho okamwetaho
en: What is man, that thou shouldest magnify him? And that thou shouldest set thine heart upon him?

rr: Okamutaayayira buri kasheeshe, Okamugyeza buri kaanya?
en: And that thou shouldest visit him every morning, And try him every moment?

rr: Oryahitsya hi okutaanyihao riisho, N'okutampa kaanya k'okumira amacwante?
en: How long wilt thou not depart from me, Nor let me alone till I swallow down my spittle?

rr: Ku ndaabe naasiisire, iwe Omurinzi w'abantu, nkwitsize ki? Ahabw'enki ompindwire ekimaasho? Ahanki nkubeereire omutwaro?
en: I have sinned; what shall I do unto thee, O thou preserver of men? Why hast thou set me as a mark against thee, So that I am a burden to myself?

rr: Bwanyima Biludaadi Omushuuhi yaamugarukamu ati
en: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

rr: Beitu oryahitsya hi okugamba otyo, Kandi ebigambo by'omu kanwa kaawe kuba nk'omuyaga gw'amaani?
en: How long wilt thou speak these things? And how long shall the words of thy mouth be like a strong wind?

rr: Noogira ngu Ruhanga asingisiriza, Nari Ow'obushoboorozi bwona aita emanja z'oburyo?
en: Doth God pervert judgment? Or doth the Almighty pervert justice?

rr: Abaana baawe ku baraabe baacumwire ahari Ruhanga, Akabahayo omu bushoboorozi bw'ekicumuro kyabo.
en: If thy children have sinned against him, And he have cast them away for their transgression;

rr: Kwonka iwe, ku oraayezirikye kusherura Ruhanga, Waayeshengyereza Ow'obushoboorozi bwona
en: If thou wouldest seek unto God betimes, And make thy supplication to the Almighty;

rr: Ku oraabe oshemeire kandi ohikiriire, Buzimazima Ruhanga naija kwimuka ahabwawe, Akugarurire eka yaawe eyaabaire ehikiriire.
en: If thou wert pure and upright; Surely now he would awake for thee, And make the habitation of thy righteousness prosperous.

rr: Kandi n'obu okutandika kwawe kuraabe kwabaire kuri kukye, Kwonka omu biro byawe ebya bwanyima ebyawe biryakanya munonga.
en: Though thy beginning was small, Yet thy latter end should greatly increase.

rr: Ninkweshengyereza, buuza eby'ebiro bya ire, Oyetegyereze eki baatatenkuriitwe baareebire
en: For enquire, I pray thee, of the former age, And prepare thyself to the search of their fathers:

rr: Ahabw'okuba itwe turi aba nyomwabazyo, titwine ki turikumanya, Kandi ebiro byaitu omu nsi ni nk'ekicuucu.
en: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, Because our days upon earth are a shadow:)

rr: Tibarikwija kukwegyesa, bakakugambire, Nibahamya ebigambo ebi barikumanya?
en: Shall not they teach thee, and tell thee, And utter words out of their heart?

rr: Orufunjo nirubaasa kumera ahataine byondo, Nari omubimbiri kumera ahataine maizi?
en: Can the rush grow up without mire? Can the flag grow without water?

rr: Ku biba bikiri bibisi, bitakatemirwe, Bibandiza ebindi binyaatsi byona kwoma.
en: Whilst it is yet in his greenness, and not cut down, It withereth before any other herb.

rr: Emihanda y'abarikwebwa Ruhanga boona nikwo eri, N'amatsiko g'otarikutiina Ruhanga garyahwaho.
en: So are the paths of all that forget God; And the hypocrite's hope shall perish:

rr: Eki arikwesiga kiryacuubwamu kabiri, N'obwesigye bwe ni nk'orububi rw'orutangura.
en: Whose hope shall be cut off, And whose trust shall be a spider's web.

rr: Aryayegamira enju ye, kwonka teryemerera; Aryagikwata, kwonka terigumaho.
en: He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand: He shall hold it fast, but it shall not endure.

rr: Naabengyeya aha mushana, N'omurubo gwe gubuga omusiri gwe
en: He is green before the sun, And his branch shooteth forth in his garden.

rr: Emizi ye neerandira aha mutuumo gw'amabaare, Atuura omu nkiri.
en: His roots are wrapped about the heap, And seeth the place of stones.

rr: Ku ariihwa ahu yaabaire ari, Haryamwehakana hati: Tinkakureebaga.
en: If he destroy him from his place, Then it shall deny him, saying , I have not seen thee.

rr: Reeba, okwo nikwo kushemererwa kw'omuhanda gwe, Kandi omu itaka haryameramu abandi.
en: Behold, this is the joy of his way, And out of the earth shall others grow.

rr: Reeba, tarinaga muntu ohikiriire, Kandi tariramira nkozi z'ebibi.
en: Behold, God will not cast away a perfect man, Neither will he help the evil doers:

rr: Kwonka obunaku butari obu aryaijuza akanwa kaawe esheko N'eminwa yaawe eteere akaari.
en: Till he fill thy mouth with laughing, And thy lips with rejoicing.

rr: Abaabaire nibakwanga, baryashwekwa enshoni, Kandi eihema ry'enkozi z'ebibi tiririgaruka kubaho.
en: They that hate thee shall be clothed with shame; And the dwelling place of the wicked shall come to nought.
