Bwanyima Yobu yaagarukamu ati
en: Then Job answered and said,

rr: N'amazima nimmanya ngu nikwo kiri; Beitu shi, omuntu akaabaasa ata kuba ohikiriire omu maisho ga Ruhanga?
en: I know it is so of a truth: But how should man be just with God?

rr: Omuntu ku yaakwenda kuhakana nawe, Takaabaasa kumugarukamu kigambo na kimwe omu bigambo rukumi.
en: If he will contend with him, He cannot answer him one of a thousand.

rr: Omutima gwe n'ogw'obwengye, kandi amaani ge ni maingi; (N'oha owaakumugangaarira, haza akaba gye?)
en: He is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: Who hath hardened himself against him, and hath prospered?

rr: Aihaho enshozi zitakimanyire, Ku aba naazijuumika n'ekiniga kye.
en: Which removeth the mountains, and they know not: Which overturneth them in his anger.

rr: Atengetsa ensi, agiiha omu mwanya gwayo, Enyomyo zaayo zitengyeta.
en: Which shaketh the earth out of her place, And the pillars thereof tremble.

rr: Aragiira eizooba, tirituruka, N'enyonyoozi azitwekyerera.
en: Which commandeth the sun, and it riseth not; And sealeth up the stars.

rr: Niwe wenka owaabambire eiguru, Akaribatiirira ebingonzi by'enyanja.
en: Which alone spreadeth out the heavens, And treadeth upon the waves of the sea.

rr: Akahanga enyonyoozi Dubu na Orioni, Na Kakaaga n'emyanya y'obukiizi-bwa-buryo.
en: Which maketh Arcturus, Orion, and Pleiades, And the chambers of the south.

rr: Akora ebikuru ebitarikubaasa kushoboororwa, N'eby'okutangaaza ebitarikubaasa kubarwa.
en: Which doeth great things past finding out; Yea, and wonders without number.

rr: Reeba, andabaho, kwonka timmureeba; Agumizamu, kwonka timmwetegyereza.
en: Lo, he goeth by me, and I see him not: He passeth on also, but I perceive him not.

rr: Reeba, anyaga; n'oha orikubaasa kumuzibira? N'oha owaakubaasa kumugira ati: Ekyo nookora ki?
en: Behold, he taketh away, who can hinder him? Who will say unto him, What doest thou?

rr: Ruhanga tariihaho kiniga kye; Nangwa n'abahwezi ba Rahabu bamwinamira.
en: If God will not withdraw his anger, The proud helpers do stoop under him.

rr: Mbwenu shi niinye naakumugarukamu, Nkeesherurira ebigambo by'okumuhakanisa?
en: How much less shall I answer him, And choose out my words to reason with him?

rr: N'obu naakuba ndi ohikiriire, tinkaamugarukamu, Kureka nkaamushaba kusaasirwa, ahakuba niwe arikunshinja.
en: Whom, though I were righteous, yet would I not answer, But I would make supplication to my judge.

rr: Nangwa n'obu naakumweta, akangarukamu, Tinkaikiriza ngu yampurira
en: If I had called, and he had answered me; Yet would I not believe that he had hearkened unto my voice.

rr: Ahabw'okuba ansingyeera n'eihunga, Akanyisa ebihuta byangye nantura busha.
en: For he breaketh me with a tempest, And multiplieth my wounds without cause.

rr: Tandeka ngu nyitsye, Kureka anyijuza obushaarizi.
en: He will not suffer me to take my breath, But filleth me with bitterness.

rr: Ku ndaagambe aha maani g'emanzi, Mukama waago ngugu! Ku biraabe biri eby'okucwa emanja, We naagira ati: N'oha oranteereho obunaku?
en: If I speak of strength, lo, he is strong: And if of judgment, who shall set me a time to plead?

rr: N'obu ndaabe ndi ohikiriire, akanwa kangye nikancwera orubanja; N'obu ndaabe ntaine kabara, nanshinja obugomi.
en: If I justify myself, mine own mouth shall condemn me: If I say , I am perfect, it shall also prove me perverse.

rr: Ndi ohikire! Tiinyine ki nyeteireho! Ntamirwe amagara gangye.
en: Though I were perfect, yet would I not know my soul: I would despise my life.

rr: Byona nikyo kimwe; nikyo ndikugirira nti: Acwekyereza abahikire n'ababi.
en: This is one thing , therefore I said it , He destroyeth the perfect and the wicked.

rr: Akagwe ku kagwa, kaakinura abantu, Ashekyeerera abataine rubanja baaguubwaho akabi.
en: If the scourge slay suddenly, He will laugh at the trial of the innocent.

rr: Ensi eheirweyo omu mikono y'ababi, Ashweka amaisho g'abaramuzi baayo; Ku araabe atari We, ondiijo n'oha?
en: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: He covereth the faces of the judges thereof; If not, where, and who is he?

rr: Ebiro byangye nibiiruka okukira matarisi, Nibihunga, kandi tibigira kirungi kyona eki bireeba
en: Now my days are swifter than a post: They flee away, they see no good.

rr: Nibihingura, nk'amaato ganguhi, Nk'oku empungu erahuka neeza kuteera eki ehiigire.
en: They are passed away as the swift ships: As the eagle that hasteth to the prey.

rr: Ku naakugira nti: Niinyija kwehuzya ekirikunsaasa, Ndekye kumanywa ku ngwirwe kubi, nyesiime
en: If I say, I will forget my complaint, I will leave off my heaviness, and comfort myself:

rr: Biri ntiinire obusaasi bwangye bwona; Ahabw'okuba nimmanya ngu torinteekateekaho nk'otaine rubanja.
en: I am afraid of all my sorrows, I know that thou wilt not hold me innocent.

rr: Ndyasingwa orubanja; Mbwenu niinyeruhiza ki?
en: If I be wicked, Why then labour I in vain?

rr: N'obu naakwoga amaizi g'ebirika, Nkanaaba engaro zangye n'esabuuni
en: If I wash myself with snow water, And make my hands never so clean;

rr: Nabwo noija kunnaga omu kiina, N'ebijwaro byangye ahabwangye bintamwe.
en: Yet shalt thou plunge me in the ditch, And mine own clothes shall abhor me.

rr: Ahabw'okuba Ogwo ti muntu nkaanye, ngu mmugarukyemu, Twemerere hamwe, tutongane
en: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, And we should come together in judgment.

rr: Tihariho w'okuturamura, Akatucura engaro omumaisho.
en: Neither is there any daysman betwixt us, That might lay his hand upon us both.

rr: Mbwenu anyiheho enkoni ye, N'okutiinisa kwe kurekye kuunyitsa obwoba
en: Let him take his rod away from me, And let not his fear terrify me:

rr: Haza obwo ngambe ntarikumutiina, Ahabw'okuba ahabwangye tindi w'okutiina.
en: Then would I speak, and not fear him; But it is not so with me.

rr: Ntamirwe amagara gangye; Tindikwija kwezibira kutaka; Niinyija kugamba ahabw'obusaasi bw'omu mutima gwangye.
en: My soul is weary of my life; I will leave my complaint upon myself; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.

rr: Ngambire Ruhanga nti: Otancwera orubanja kunsinga, Kureka onyorekye eki orikuntura.
en: I will say unto God, Do not condemn me; Shew me wherefore thou contendest with me.

rr: Nooyesiimira okuhata, Okugaya eki waahangire, N'okushemerererwa enaama z'enkozi z'ebibi?
en: Is it good unto thee that thou shouldest oppress, That thou shouldest despise the work of thine hands, And shine upon the counsel of the wicked?

rr: Amaisho gaawe n'ag'omubiri, Nari sho oreeba nk'oku abantu bareeba?
en: Hast thou eyes of flesh? Or seest thou as man seeth?

rr: Naiwe ebiro byawe ni nk'eby'abantu, Nari emyaka yaawe ni nk'ey'abantu
en: Are thy days as the days of man? Are thy years as man's days,

rr: Kikabona kukureetera kucondooza okutahikiirira kwangye, N'okucaaka ekibi kyangye
en: That thou enquirest after mine iniquity, And searchest after my sin?

rr: N'obu orikumanya ku ntaine rubanja, Kandi ku hatariho orikubaasa kujuna omuntu omu mikono yaawe?
en: Thou knowest that I am not wicked; And there is none that can deliver out of thine hand.

rr: Engaro zaawe nizo zambumbire, zikampanga, Mbwenu wampindukana, wancwekyereza.
en: Thine hands have made me and fashioned me Together round about; yet thou dost destroy me.

rr: Ijuka ku wambumbire nk'eibumba; Mbwenu nooyenda kugaruka kumpindura omucuucu?
en: Remember, I beseech thee, that thou hast made me as the clay; And wilt thou bring me into dust again?

rr: Okanshuka nk'amate, Wankamya nk'amajuta ga kiizi
en: Hast thou not poured me out as milk, And curdled me like cheese?

rr: Wanshweka oruhu n'enyama, Wanteeranisa amagufa n'emitsi
en: Thou hast clothed me with skin and flesh, And hast fenced me with bones and sinews.

rr: Wampa amagara n'obushongore, Okureeberera kwawe nikwo kungumizeho.
en: Thou hast granted me life and favour, And thy visitation hath preserved my spirit.

rr: Kwonka ebyo byona okabibiika omu mutima gwawe, Kandi nimmanya ebyo ku waabigyendereire.
en: And these things hast thou hid in thine heart: I know that this is with thee.

rr: Ku nshobya, ommanya, Kandi toonyihaho rubanja
en: If I sin, then thou markest me, And thou wilt not acquit me from mine iniquity.

rr: Ku mba mubi, ndeeba enaku; Ku mba ohikiriire, timbaasa kwimutsya mutwe; Ahabw'okuba mba nyijwire okuhemuka, Nindeeba okubonabona kwangye.
en: If I be wicked, woe unto me; And if I be righteous, yet will I not lift up my head. I am full of confusion; Therefore see thou mine affliction;

rr: Kandi n'obu naakwimutsya omutwe, okaampiiga nk'entare, Ogaruka onkoraho eby'amahano
en: For it increaseth. Thou huntest me as a fierce lion: And again thou shewest thyself marvellous upon me.

rr: Oimutsya busya baamushinja b'okunshinja, Oyongyera kungwerwa kubi, Kandi oguma noondeetera amahe masya g'okundwanisa.
en: Thou renewest thy witnesses against me, And increasest thine indignation upon me; Changes and war are against me.

rr: Mbwenu okaanyihira ki omu nda ya maawe? Nangwa kuri naafiire hatakagizire riisho ryona eryandeeba
en: Wherefore then hast thou brought me forth out of the womb? Oh that I had given up the ghost, and no eye had seen me!

rr: Oba Nkaba nk'otakabahoga, Nkaziikwa ninkiruga omu nda.
en: I should have been as though I had not been; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.

rr: Beitu ebiro by'amagara gangye ti bikye? Ndeka, nduhuukyeho kakye
en: Are not my days few? Cease then , And let me alone, that I may take comfort a little,

rr: Ntakagiire ei ntariruga, Omu nsi y'omwirima, kandi ey'ekibunda kya rufu
en: Before I go whence I shall not return, Even to the land of darkness and the shadow of death;

rr: Omu nsi y'omwirima etarimu buteeka, Ei omushana guba nk'omwirima.
en: A land of darkness, as darkness itself ; And of the shadow of death, without any order, And where the light is as darkness.

rr: Bwanyima Zofari Omunaamasi yaagarukamu ati
en: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,

rr: Ebigambo bingi bityo bitishemereire kugarukwamu? Nari shi, engambi y'amaingi eshemereire kwihwaho orubanja?
en: Should not the multitude of words be answered? And should a man full of talk be justified?

rr: Abantu bashemereire kuhunamisibwa emyehimbiso yaawe? Kandi ku oraateere enaku, tihariho orikukukwatsa enshoni?
en: Should thy lies make men hold their peace? And when thou mockest, shall no man make thee ashamed?

rr: Ahabw'okuba noogira oti: Ebi ndikwegyesa bihikire, Ndi mwere omu maisho ga Ruhanga.
en: For thou hast said, My doctrine is pure, And I am clean in thine eyes.

rr: Nkaabasibwa ki, Ruhanga agamba, Ayashamya akanwa ke, akwomesereza.
en: But oh that God would speak, And open his lips against thee;

rr: Akugambira emibonano y'obwengye, Ahabw'okuba n'obw'emiringo mingi.
en: And that he would shew thee the secrets of wisdom, That they are double to that which is!

rr: Mbwenu omanye ku Ruhanga atarikufubira, Nk'oku ebibi byawe biri.
en: Know therefore that God exacteth of thee less than thine iniquity deserveth .

rr: Noogira ngu okaabaasa kucondooza Ruhanga, omumanya? Okaabaasa kumanya Ow'obushoboorozi bwona, omumarayo?
en: Canst thou by searching find out God? Canst thou find out the Almighty unto perfection?

rr: Kiri ahaiguru okukira eiguru; nooyenda kukigira ota? Kiri okuzimu okukira owa Nyamuteza; nookimanya ota?
en: It is as high as heaven; what canst thou do? Deeper than hell; what canst thou know?

rr: Oburaingwa bwakyo nibukira ensi, N'obukiika bwakyo nibukira enyanja.
en: The measure thereof is longer than the earth, And broader than the sea.

rr: Ku yaakuraba omu nsi, yaata abantu omu kihome, Yaabeeta omu rubanja, n'oha owaakumuzibira?
en: If he cut off, and shut up, Or gather together, then who can hinder him?

rr: Ahabw'okuba naamanya abantu entakimazire; Ku araareebe okutahikiirira, noogira ngu naakwehuzya?
en: For he knoweth vain men: He seeth wickedness also; will he not then consider it?

rr: Enturegye ku yaakuzaara omuntu, Entakimazire akaagira obwengye.
en: For vain man would be wise, Though man be born like a wild ass's colt.

rr: Ku oraashemeze omutima gwawe, Omutegye emikono.
en: If thou prepare thine heart, And stretch out thine hands toward him;

rr: Ku haraabe hariho okutahikiirira omu ngaro zaawe, okute hare; Otaikiriza obubi kuguma omu ka yaawe.
en: If iniquity be in thine hand, put it far away, And let not wickedness dwell in thy tabernacles.

rr: Buzimazima obwo nibwo oriimutsya amaisho gaawe otaine kamogo, Oryahama, kandi toritiina.
en: For then shalt thou lift up thy face without spot; Yea, thou shalt be stedfast, and shalt not fear:

rr: Oryayebwa obujune bwawe, Obwijukye nk'amaizi agaheza kurabaho.
en: Because thou shalt forget thy misery, And remember it as waters that pass away:

rr: Amagara gaawe garyayaka okukira eihangwe; N'obu gariba garimu omwirima, garyaba nk'akasheeshe.
en: And thine age shall be clearer than the noonday; Thou shalt shine forth, thou shalt be as the morning.

rr: Oryagira obwesigye, ahabw'okugira amatsiko; Oryarindwa, ohuumure buhooro
en: And thou shalt be secure, because there is hope; Yea, thou shalt dig about thee, and thou shalt take thy rest in safety.

rr: Oryabyama, tiharigira owaakutiinisa; Eego, baingi baryakuhakwaho.
en: Also thou shalt lie down, and none shall make thee afraid; Yea, many shall make suit unto thee.

rr: Kwonka amaisho g'ababi garyabwerabwera, Baryabura obuhungiro, Kandi amatsiko gaabo garyaba okuhwamu omwitsyo.
en: But the eyes of the wicked shall fail, And they shall not escape, And their hope shall be as the giving up of the ghost.

rr: Bwanyima Yobu yaagarukamu ati
en: And Job answered and said,

rr: Eego, niimwe bantu mwenka; Kandi ku murifa, obwengye buryahwaho naimwe!
en: No doubt but ye are the people, And wisdom shall die with you.

rr: Kwonka naanye nyine obwengye nkaimwe; Timurikunkira. Mbwenu n'oha otarikumanya ebigambo nk'ebyo?
en: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you: Yea, who knoweth not such things as these?

rr: Ndi eky'okushekyererwa ahari bagyenzi bangye, Nyowe owaabaire atakira Ruhanga, akangarukamu, Omuntu ohikiriire, otaine kamogo; Mbwenu ndi ow'okushekyererwa.
en: I am as one mocked of his neighbour, Who calleth upon God, and he answereth him: The just upright man is laughed to scorn.

rr: Omu mutima gw'omuntu ogaramisiriize habamu okugaya abahikiriirwe. Ebihikiirizi bitegyereize abarikuterera.
en: He that is ready to slip with his feet Is as a lamp despised in the thought of him that is at ease.

rr: Amahema g'abambuzi gari gye; Abarikugwisa kubi Ruhanga bahamire, Abu emikono yaabo eba ruhanga waabo.
en: The tabernacles of robbers prosper, And they that provoke God are secure; Into whose hand God bringeth abundantly .

rr: Mbwenu buuza enyamaishwa, niziija kukwegyesa, N'enyonyi z'omu mwanya niziija kukugambira
en: But ask now the beasts, and they shall teach thee; And the fowls of the air, and they shall tell thee:

rr: Nari ogambire ensi, neija kukwegyesa, Kandi eby'omu nyanja nabyo nibiija kukumanyisa.
en: Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach thee: And the fishes of the sea shall declare unto thee.

rr: Omuri ebyo byona n'oha otarikumanya, Ku MUKAMA niwe yaakozire ekyo?
en: Who knoweth not in all these That the hand of the LORD hath wrought this?

rr: Omu mukono gwe nimwo amagara g'ekintu kyona ekihuriire gari, Kandi n'omwitsyo gw'abantu boona nimwo guri.
en: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, And the breath of all mankind.

rr: Okutu tikutaanisa ebigambo, Nk'oku akanwa kamanya eby'okurya?
en: Doth not the ear try words? And the mouth taste his meat?

rr: Abagurusi nibo bagira obwengye, N'abahikize emyaka mingi nibo beetegyereza.
en: With the ancient is wisdom; And in length of days understanding.

rr: Obwengye n'amaani biinwe Ruhanga, Niwe ahanuura, kandi aine okwetegyereza.
en: With him is wisdom and strength, He hath counsel and understanding.

rr: Ku asheenya, tihaine ogaruka kwombeka; Kandi ku akingirana omuntu, tihaine obaasa kwiguraho.
en: Behold, he breaketh down, and it cannot be built again: He shutteth up a man, and there can be no opening.

rr: -24 ; . Ku acungira amaizi, gooma; Kandi ku agaigurira, ensi etabaarwa.
en: Behold, he withholdeth the waters, and they dry up: Also he sendeth them out, and they overturn the earth.

rr: Niwe agira amaani n'obwengye; Abarikugobezibwa n'abarikugobya n'abe.
en: With him is strength and wisdom: The deceived and the deceiver are his.

rr: Atwara abahanuuzi banyagirwe, N'abaramuzi abahindura abashema.
en: He leadeth counsellors away spoiled, And maketh the judges fools.

rr: Abagabe abaihaho obushoboorozi Abazirika obutanda omunda.
en: He looseth the bond of kings, And girdeth their loins with a girdle.

rr: Abanyamurwa abatwara banyagirwe, N'ab'amaani abamaraho.
en: He leadeth princes away spoiled, And overthroweth the mighty.

rr: Abarikwesigwa ababuza ebigambo, Kandi abagurusi abaihaho okwetegyereza.
en: He removeth away the speech of the trusty, And taketh away the understanding of the aged.

rr: Ashuka aha banyiginya okugaywa, Ayuzya orukoba rw'ab'amaani.
en: He poureth contempt upon princes, And weakeneth the strength of the mighty.

rr: Ashuuruura ebisherekirwe omu mwirima, N'omwirima ndindindi agujwisiza omushana.
en: He discovereth deep things out of darkness, And bringeth out to light the shadow of death.

rr: Akanyisa amahanga, kandi agacwekyereza; Ahangusya amahanga, kandi agatuubya.
en: He increaseth the nations, and destroyeth them: He enlargeth the nations, and straiteneth them again .

rr: Abategyeki b'amahanga g'omu nsi abaihaho okwetegyereza, Abazengyereza omu ihamba eritarimu mihanda.
en: He taketh away the heart of the chief of the people of the earth, And causeth them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.

en: They grope in the dark without light, And he maketh them to stagger like a drunken man. rr: Reeba, eriisho ryangye rikareeba ebyo byona, N'okutu kwangye kwabihurira, naabimanya.
en: Lo, mine eye hath seen all this , Mine ear hath heard and understood it.

rr: Ebi murikumanya, naanye nimbimanya; Timwine ki murikunkiza.
en: What ye know, the same do I know also: I am not inferior unto you.

rr: Buzima nkaayenzire kugamba n'Ow'obushoboorozi bwona, Kandi n'okwetonganira ahari Ruhanga.
en: Surely I would speak to the Almighty, And I desire to reason with God.

rr: Imwe ahabwanyu muri abagunzi b'ebishuba, Mwena muri abafumu abataine mutambo.
en: But ye are forgers of lies, Ye are all physicians of no value.

rr: Nkaabaasibwa ki, muhunamira kimwe! Obwo nibwo mwakuba ab'obwengye.
en: O that ye would altogether hold your peace! And it should be your wisdom.

rr: Mbwenu muhurire ebi ndikufa, Mutegye amatu ebi ndikwetonganira.
en: Hear now my reasoning, And hearken to the pleadings of my lips.

rr: Nimwenda kutonganira Ruhanga nimubeiha, Kandi nimuryarya ahabwe?
en: Will ye speak wickedly for God? And talk deceitfully for him?

rr: Nimwija kugwera orubaju rwe? Nimwenda kurwanirira Ruhanga?
en: Will ye accept his person? Will ye contend for God?

rr: Mbwenu ku yaakubacaaka, bikaabagyendera gye? Nimubaasa kumuryarya, nk'oku omuntu aryarya mugyenzi we?
en: Is it good that he should search you out? Or as one man mocketh another, do ye so mock him?

rr: Buzimazima aryabahana, Ku murigira orubaju oru mwagwera bwesherekye.
en: He will surely reprove you, If ye do secretly accept persons.

rr: Ekitiinisa kye tikiribaitsa obwoba, N'okutiinisa kwe kukabagwaho?
en: Shall not his excellency make you afraid? And his dread fall upon you?

rr: Ebigambo ebi murikuhamya n'enfumu eziri nk'eiju; Ebi murikwerinza ni nk'eibumba.
en: Your remembrances are like unto ashes, Your bodies to bodies of clay.

rr: Nimuhuname, ngambe; Ekirambeho kimbeho!
en: Hold your peace, let me alone, that I may speak, And let come on me what will .

rr: N'obu byakuba bita, Niinyija kwoga amagara.
en: Wherefore do I take my flesh in my teeth, And put my life in mine hand?

rr: Ekyo nakyo kiryambeera okujunwa, Ahabw'okuba tihariho otatiina Ruhanga orihika omu maisho ge.
en: He also shall be my salvation: For an hypocrite shall not come before him.

rr: Mute omutima aha bigambo byangye, Mutegye amatu ebi ndikubagambira.
en: Hear diligently my speech, And my declaration with your ears.

rr: Oraatongane naanye n'oha? Ahabw'okuba ku akureebeka, nkaahunama, nfa.
en: Who is he that will plead with me? For now, if I hold my tongue, I shall give up the ghost.

rr: Onyikirize ebintu bibiri byonka; Obwo nibwo ntarikwija kukweshereka.
en: Only do not two things unto me: Then will I not hide myself from thee.

rr: Onyiheho omukono gwawe, gunze hare; Kandi okutiinisa kwawe kurekye kuunyitsa obwoba.
en: Withdraw thine hand far from me: And let not thy dread make me afraid.

rr: Bwanyima onyete, nkwetabe; Nari shi onyikirize, ngambe, naiwe ongarukyemu.
en: Then call thou, and I will answer: Or let me speak, and answer thou me.

rr: Ebicumuro byangye n'ebibi byangye ni bingahi? Mmanyisa okushiisha kwangye n'ekibi kyangye.
en: How many are mine iniquities and sins? Make me to know my transgression and my sin.

rr: Ahabw'enki noonyima amaisho, Okanteekateekaho nk'omuzigu waawe?
en: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, And holdest me for thine enemy?

rr: Nooyenda kutiinisa eibabi eririkutwarwa omuyaga, N'okuhiiga ebishushunga ebyomire?
en: Wilt thou break a leaf driven to and fro? And wilt thou pursue the dry stubble?

rr: Ahabw'okuba nompandikaho ebirikushaarira, Ongaruraho ebibi by'obutsigazi bwangye
en: For thou writest bitter things against me, And makest me to possess the iniquities of my youth.

rr: Otaire ebigyere byangye omu nkomo, Waagumya amaisho aha mihanda yangye yoona, Ebigyere byangye waabiteeraho obugarukiro.
en: Thou puttest my feet also in the stocks, And lookest narrowly unto all my paths; Thou settest a print upon the heels of my feet.

rr: Omuntu weena ahwaho nk'ekintu ekijunzire, Nk'ekijwaro ekiriirwe ebiyenje.
en: And he, as a rotten thing, consumeth, As a garment that is moth eaten.

rr: Omuntu ozairwe omukazi amara ebiro bikye, Aba ow'enaku nsha.
en: Man that is born of a woman Is of few days, and full of trouble.

rr: Arabya nk'ekirabyo, ayoma; Ahingura nk'ekicuucu, tagumaho.
en: He cometh forth like a flower, and is cut down: He fleeth also as a shadow, and continueth not.

rr: Mbwenu shi Iwe, omuntu ori otyo okaayerusya kumureeba, Nari nkaanye, okandeeta kutongana naiwe?
en: And dost thou open thine eyes upon such an one, And bringest me into judgment with thee?

rr: N'oha owaakubaasa kwiha ekirungi omu kibi? Tihariho n'omwe.
en: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? Not one.

rr: Nk'oku ebiro bye byamugyereirwe, Omubaro gw'ameezi ge okagumanya, Okamuteeraho obugarukiro, obu atarikubaasa kurenga
en: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months are with thee, Thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass;

rr: Omwiheho amaihso, abone kuhuumuraho, Okuhitsya obu ariheza ebiro bye, nk'orikukorera ebihembo.
en: Turn from him, that he may rest, Till he shall accomplish, as an hireling, his day.

rr: Manya, hariho amatsiko ngu, ekiti ku kitemwa, kitooka, Kandi ngu emitwe y'amataagi mato gaakyo egumizamu neekura.
en: For there is hope of a tree, If it be cut down, that it will sprout again, And that the tender branch thereof will not cease.

rr: N'obu emizi yaakyo yaakuguma omu itaka, ekakura, N'ekitsintsi kyakyo kikajundira aho
en: Though the root thereof wax old in the earth, And the stock thereof die in the ground;

rr: Kwonka ku kihurira okufukiirira kw'amaizi, kitooka, Kimera amataagi nk'ekiti kito.
en: Yet through the scent of water it will bud, And bring forth boughs like a plant.

rr: Kwonka omuntu we afa bwamperayo; Buzima omwitsyo gumuhwamu. Mbwenu obwo aba akirahi?
en: But man dieth, and wasteth away: Yea, man giveth up the ghost, and where is he?

rr: Nk'oku amaizi g'omu kiyanja gaijurururka, N'omugyera gukatuuba, gukooma
en: As the waters fail from the sea, And the flood decayeth and drieth up:

rr: Nikwo n'omuntu abyama ataimukye; Tariimuka, n'obu kwakuba lusisiimurwa, Okuhitsya obu eiguru ririba ritakiriho.
en: So man lieth down, and riseth not: Till the heavens be no more, they shall not awake, Nor be raised out of their sleep.

rr: Nkaabaasibwa ki, onshereka okuzimu, Ondindira omu mubonano, okuhitsya ahu ekiniga kyawe kirihwera, Onteeraho obunaku, onyijuka!
en: O that thou wouldest hide me in the grave, That thou wouldest keep me secret, until thy wrath be past, That thou wouldest appoint me a set time, and remember me!

rr: (Omuntu ku afa, agaruka abaho?) Ebiro byangye byona ebyanteereirweho nkaabigumisiririza, Ntegyereza obunaku bwangye bw'okurekurwa.
en: If a man die, shall he live again? All the days of my appointed time will I wait, Till my change come.

rr: Ku waakuunyeta, nkaakwetaba; Kandi naiwe okaayetenga kureeba eki emikono yaawe yaakozire
en: Thou shalt call, and I will answer thee: Thou wilt have a desire to the work of thine hands.

rr: Ahabw'okuba hati noobara entambwe zangye, Kandi otaire eriisho aha kibi kyangye.
en: For now thou numberest my steps: Dost thou not watch over my sin?

rr: Okushiisha kwangye kukomirwe omu nshaho, N'okutahikiirira kwangye kukomeirwe hamwe.
en: My transgression is sealed up in a bag, And thou sewest up mine iniquity.

rr: Kwonka orushozi orutuura nirugwa, ruguubwa rwahwaho; N'orukiri rwihwa omu mwanya gwarwo
en: And surely the mountain falling cometh to nought, And the rock is removed out of his place.

rr: Amaizi gagyenda nigarya amabaare, N'emitunga etwara eitaka ry'ensi; Naiwe nikwo omaraho amatsiko g'omuntu.
en: The waters wear the stones: Thou washest away the things which grow out of the dust of the earth; And thou destroyest the hope of man.

rr: Ebiro byona omusingura, nawe ahwaho; Aha maisho ge ohahindura okundi; omwohereza.
en: Thou prevailest for ever against him, and he passeth: Thou changest his countenance, and sendest him away.

rr: Abatabani batunga ekitiinisa, atakikimanya; Bagarurwa ahansi, kwonka tamanya byabo
en: His sons come to honour, and he knoweth it not; And they are brought low, but he perceiveth it not of them.

rr: Kureka obusaasi obu ahurira, n'obw'omubiri gwe; Kandi amaganya agu agira, gaba age wenka.
en: But his flesh upon him shall have pain, And his soul within him shall mourn.

rr: Bwanyima Elifaazi Omutemaani yaagarukamu ati
en: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,

rr: Noogira ngu omuntu w'obwengye ashemereire kugarukamu n'ebigambo ebitaine muhoho, N'okwijuza enda ye omuyaga gw'oburugwa-izooba?
en: Should a wise man utter vain knowledge, And fill his belly with the east wind?

rr: Ashemereire kuteera empaka n'ebigambo ebitaine buryo, Nari okugamba ebitaine ki birikugasira abandi?
en: Should he reason with unprofitable talk? Or with speeches wherewith he can do no good?

rr: Kwonka nooyenda kwihaho okutiina Ruhanga, N'okuzibira abantu kugira eki baateekateekaho bari omu maisho ge
en: Yea, thou castest off fear, And restrainest prayer before God.

rr: Ahabw'okuba okutahikiirira kwawe nikwo kwegyesa akanwa kaawe eby'okugamba, Naiwe okunda kugambisa orurimi r'obugobya.
en: For thy mouth uttereth thine iniquity, And thou choosest the tongue of the crafty.

rr: Akanwa kaawe niko karikukucwera orubanja, tiinye; N'eminwa yaawe yonka niyo erikukushinja.
en: Thine own mouth condemneth thee, and not I: Yea, thine own lips testify against thee.

rr: Niiwe waabandiize abandi kuzaarwa? Nari okazaarwa, enshozi zitakabaireho?
en: Art thou the first man that was born? Or wast thou made before the hills?

rr: Orashutamire omu naama za Ruhanga ez'omu mubonano? Nooyenda kuba niiwe waagira obwengye wenka?
en: Hast thou heard the secret of God? And dost thou restrain wisdom to thyself?

rr: Eki orikumanya, itwe eki tutarikumanya, niki? Nooyetegyereza ki, itwe eki tutarikushoborokyerwa?
en: What knowest thou, that we know not? What understandest thou, which is not in us?

rr: Omuriitwe harimu abamezire enju, N'abakuzire munonga abarikukira sho.
en: With us are both the grayheaded and very aged men, Much elder than thy father.

rr: Okuhuumuriza kwa Ruhanga ahabwawe ni kukye, N'ebigambo ebi ogambiirwe gye, noobigaya?
en: Are the consolations of God small with thee? Is there any secret thing with thee?

rr: Ahabw'enki omutima gwawe nigukubambaaza, Amaisho gakakutukura
en: Why doth thine heart carry thee away? And what do thy eyes wink at,

rr: Kikareetera omutima gwawe kurwanisa Ruhanga, Okagamba ebigambo nk'ebyo?
en: That thou turnest thy spirit against God, And lettest such words go out of thy mouth?

rr: -6 ; . Omuntu ni kintu ki, kuba oshemeire, N'owaazairwe omukazi, kuba ohikiriire?
en: What is man, that he should be clean? And he which is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?

rr: Reeba, Ruhanga tayesiga barikwera be, Nangwa n'eiguru tirishemeire mu maisho ge
en: Behold, he putteth no trust in his saints; Yea, the heavens are not clean in his sight.

rr: Kaashwa omuntu ekihagaro owaasiisikaire, Ogotomera okutahikiirira nk'amaizi.
en: How much more abominable and filthy is man, Which drinketh iniquity like water?

rr: Naaza kukushobororera, haza ompurire! Kandi ebi naareebire, nibyo ndikwija kukumanyisa
en: I will shew thee, hear me; And that which I have seen I will declare;

rr: (Ebyagambirwe abanyabwengye, Ebi baishebo batarasherekire
en: Which wise men have told From their fathers, and have not hid it:

rr: Abbaheirwe ensi bonka, Batagiibwemu munyamahanga weena)
en: Unto whom alone the earth was given, And no stranger passed among them.

rr: Omusiisi atuura n'obusaasi ebiro byona, Niyo myaka eyateereirweho abarikuhata.
en: The wicked man travaileth with pain all his days, And the number of years is hidden to the oppressor.

rr: Ebirikutiinisa biteerera enduuru omu matu ge; N'obu ariba ari omu kugogyera, Omuhwerekyerezi aryamugwaho.
en: A dreadful sound is in his ears: In prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him.

rr: Taikiriza ngu aryagaruka arugye omu mwirima, Kandi ateekateekyeirwe rurara.
en: He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness, And he is waited for of the sword.

rr: Azengyerera hoona naaza kushaka, naagira ati: Eby'okushaka birahi? Naamanya ku ekiro ky'omwirima kiri haihi kumuhikaho.
en: He wandereth abroad for bread, saying , Where is it? He knoweth that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.

rr: Enaku n'obusaasi bimutiinisa, Bimusingura nk'omugabe oyeteekateekyeire orugamba
en: Trouble and anguish shall make him afraid; They shall prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.

rr: Ahabw'okuba akabanga omukono kurwanisa Ruhanga, Yaahiga Ow'obushoboorozi bwona
en: For he stretcheth out his hand against God, And strengtheneth himself against the Almighty.

rr: Yaamwegyemera agangaize ebitsya, Akingire engabo eine eiromba rihango.
en: He runneth upon him, even on his neck, Upon the thick bosses of his bucklers:

rr: Ahabw'okuba omugomoko gukamushweka aha maisho, N'ebigojo byahingamirana aha nyugunyu ze
en: Because he covereth his face with his fatness, And maketh collops of fat on his flanks.

rr: Kandi yaatuura omu ndembo ezihindukire amatongo, N'omu maju agatashemereire kutaahwamu muntu, Agabaire gari haihi kuhinduka emungo z'amatongo.
en: And he dwelleth in desolate cities, And in houses which no man inhabiteth, Which are ready to become heaps.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo taritunga, n'eitungo rye tiririgumaho, Kandi taritsimba mizi omu itaka.
en: He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, Neither shall he prolong the perfection thereof upon the earth.

rr: Tarikira mwirima, Endimi z'omuriro ziryayomya amataagi ge, Atwarwe omwitsyo gwa Ruhaga.
en: He shall not depart out of darkness; The flame shall dry up his branches, And by the breath of his mouth shall he go away.

rr: Arekye kwesiga ebitaine mugasho, naayebeiha; ahakuba ebitaine mugasho nibyo arizimuurirwa.
en: Let not him that is deceived trust in vanity: For vanity shall be his recompence.

rr: Aryahembwa byona, obunaku bwe butakahikire, Amataagi agarikumutookaho gatakabaire kijubwe.
en: It shall be accomplished before his time, And his branch shall not be green.

rr: Aryaba nk'omuzaabibu, ogu ebijuma byagwo biragarika bitakahiisize, Abe nk'omuzeituuni ogurikuragaza orurabyo.
en: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, And shall cast off his flower as the olive.

rr: Ahabw'okuba omutwe gw'abatarikutiina Ruhanga guryaba engumba, Kandi omuriro guryamaraho amahema g'abarikurya enguzi.
en: For the congregation of hypocrites shall be desolate, And fire shall consume the tabernacles of bribery.

rr: Babaka enda z'eitima, bazaara obubi, N'emitima yaabo eteekateeka obugobya.
en: They conceive mischief, and bring forth vanity, And their belly prepareth deceit.

Bwanyima Yobu yaagarukamu ati
en: Then Job answered and said,

rr: Manya mpuriire bingi ebirikushusha bityo; Mwena muri abayaagi abarikurusya.
en: I have heard many such things: Miserable comforters are ye all.

rr: Ebigambo ebitaine mugasho biherera hi? Ekyakureetera kungarukamu niki?
en: Shall vain words have an end? Or what emboldeneth thee that thou answerest?

rr: Kuri noogira ngu niimwe muri nkaanye, Nkaabaasize kugamba nkaimwe; Nyungayunga ebigambo by'okubapaatiika, Mbazongoreza omutwe
en: I also could speak as ye do: If your soul were in my soul's stead, I could heap up words against you, And shake mine head at you.

rr: Kwonka nkaabagumize n'akanwa kangye, N'ebigambo by'orurimi rwangye bibatuubiza aha busaasi.
en: But I would strengthen you with my mouth, And the moving of my lips should asswage your grief .

rr: N'obu ndaagambe, obusaasi bwangye tiburikutuuba, Nari shi bwo ku ndaayegumey, niinyija kutuubizibwa ki?
en: Though I speak, my grief is not asswaged: And though I forbear, what am I eased?

rr: Mbwenu ho Ruhanga andembize, Ammazireho abangye boona.
en: But now he hath made me weary: Thou hast made desolate all my company.

rr: Ankwatsire; nikyo kirikunshinja, Okuhwa aha magufa kwangye kuunyimukiriire; Nikwo kurikuunyomesereza.
en: And thou hast filled me with wrinkles, which is a witness against me: And my leanness rising up in me beareth witness to my face.

rr: Antaanyagwize anyiniire ekiniga, yaanyita kubi; Anneneire amaino, Ogwo mubisha wangye anzooreire amaisho.
en: He teareth me in his wrath, who hateth me: He gnasheth upon me with his teeth; Mine enemy sharpeneth his eyes upon me.

rr: Abantu baanyashamiire, Banteera aha itama nibanjuma; Nibateeranira hamwe kunteera.
en: They have gaped upon me with their mouth; They have smitten me upon the cheek reproachfully; They have gathered themselves together against me.

rr: Ruhanga nampayo omu mikono y'abarikumutiina, Yannaga omu mikono y'enkozi z'ebibi.
en: God hath delivered me to the ungodly, And turned me over into the hands of the wicked.

rr: Nkaba ndi aho ngaramisiriize, yampendagura; Yankwata aha bitsya, yancwa obusaasingo; Bwanyima yangira ekimaasho kye.
en: I was at ease, but he hath broken me asunder: He hath also taken me by my neck, and shaken me to pieces, And set me up for his mark.

rr: Abarasi be bangotsire, Anteire aha ntsigo, zaashohora, tiyansaasira, Yaasheesha endurwe yangye aha nsi.
en: His archers compass me round about, He cleaveth my reins asunder, and doth not spare; He poureth out my gall upon the ground.

rr: Anfumagwire, Yaanyegyemera nk'emanzi.
en: He breaketh me with breach upon breach, He runneth upon me like a giant.

rr: Omubiri gwangye ngubaziireho ebiguniya, N'eihembe ryangye naaritabika omu itaka.
en: I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin, And defiled my horn in the dust.

rr: Amaisho gangye gahonoirwe okurira, N'ebitsigye byangye byeririmba
en: My face is foul with weeping, And on my eyelids is the shadow of death;

rr: N'obu engaro zangye ziraabe zitaine itima, N'okushaba kwangye kushemeire.
en: Not for any injustice in mine hands: Also my prayer is pure.

rr: Iwe nsi 'we, otataba eshagama yangye, Kandi okutaka kwangye kurekye kugira ahu kwatuuriza.
en: O earth, cover not thou my blood, And let my cry have no place.

rr: Na mbwenu, reeba, omujurizi wangye ari omu iguru, N'omwema wangye ari ahaiguru
en: Also now, behold, my witness is in heaven, And my record is on high.

rr: Banywani bangye nibangaya, amaisho gangye nigashuka amarira ahari Ruhanga
en: My friends scorn me: but mine eye poureth out tears unto God.

rr: Ngu aikirize omuntu kumwetonganiraho, Nk'omuntu na mutaahi we.
en: O that one might plead for a man with God, As a man pleadeth for his neighbour!

rr: Ahabw'okuba emyaka mikye ku erihwa, Ndyatoora omuhanda ogu ntarigaruka kureetwa.
en: When a few years are come, Then I shall go the way whence I shall not return.

rr: Omutima gwangye gucwekire, ebiro byangye bihwire, Ekituuro kintegyereize.
en: My breath is corrupt, my days are extinct, The graves are ready for me.

rr: Buzimazima nyehinguririziibwe abarikunteerera enaku; Eriisho ryangye nditaire aha bi barikundahuza.
en: Are there not mockers with me? And doth not mine eye continue in their provocation?

rr: Mbwenu taho omusingo, onyemererere; Ori aho orikwija kuunyemererrera n'oha?
en: Lay down now, put me in a surety with thee; Who is he that will strike hands with me?

rr: Nk'oku ozibiire emitima yaabo kwetegyereza, Nikyo otarikubaikiririza kusingura.
en: For thou hast hid their heart from understanding: Therefore shalt thou not exalt them .

rr: Orikurega banywani be, ngu abagane aha bintu byabo, Amaisho g'abaana be garyabwerabwera.
en: He that speaketh flattery to his friends, Even the eyes of his children shall fail.

rr: Ampindwire eky'okucweraho enfumu omu mahanga, Mpindukire ou abantu barikunuga butunu.
en: He hath made me also a byword of the people; And aforetime I was as a tabret.

rr: Ahabw'obusaasi amaisho gangye garimu oruho, N'engingo zangye zoona ziri nk'ekibunda.
en: Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow, And all my members are as a shadow.

rr: Abantu abagororokire nibakitangaarira, Kandi abatariho rubanja nibeezirika kurwanisa abatarikutiina Ruhanga
en: Upright men shall be astonied at this, And the innocent shall stir up himself against the hypocrite.

rr: Kwonka ohikiriire ahamiire omu muhanda gwe, Kandi oine engaro zishemeire naayeyongyera kugira amaani.
en: The righteous also shall hold on his way, And he that hath clean hands shall be stronger and stronger.

rr: Mbwenu imwe mwena, mugarukye mwije; Tihariho munyabwengye n'omwe ou ndikwija kushanga omuriimwe.
en: But as for you all, do ye return, and come now: For I cannot find one wise man among you.

rr: Ebiro byangye bihwire, Ebi mbaire niinyenda kukora bifiire, Nibyo byetengo by'omutima gwangye.
en: My days are past, my purposes are broken off, Even the thoughts of my heart.

rr: Ekiro nibakihindura nyomushana, Nibagira ngu omushana guri haihi kuba nk'omwirima.
en: They change the night into day: The light is short because of darkness.

rr: Ku naakwenda okuzimu ku eba eka yangye, Naayara ekitabo kyangye omu mwirima
en: If I wait, the grave is mine house: I have made my bed in the darkness.

rr: Naagira ekiina nti: Niiwe tata, N'enyogori nti: Ori maawe, nari munyaanyazi
en: I have said to corruption, Thou art my father: To the worm, Thou art my mother, and my sister.

rr: Mbwenu obwo amatsiko gangye gakaaba gakirahi? Kandi ago matsiko garyareebwa oha?
en: And where is now my hope? As for my hope, who shall see it?

rr: Bwanyima Biludaadi Omushuuhi yaagarukamu ati
en: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

rr: Muryahitsya hi okutegana n'empaka z'ebigambo? Nimuteekateekye, haza tubone kugamba.
en: How long will it be ere ye make an end of words? Mark, and afterwards we will speak.

rr: Ahabw'enki nitutwazibwa nk'ente, Okatuteekateekaho nk'abataine bwengye?
en: Wherefore are we counted as beasts, And reputed vile in your sight?

rr: Iwe orikwetaagura ahabw'ekiniga, Noogira ngu ensi neija kutsigwaho ahabwawe, Nari orukiri rwihwe omu mwanya gwarwo?
en: He teareth himself in his anger: Shall the earth be forsaken for thee? And shall the rock be removed out of his place?

rr: Eego, etabaaza y'omunyabibi eryaraazibwa, N'endimi z'omuriro gwe tiziryaka
en: Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, And the spark of his fire shall not shine.

rr: Okuhweza kw'omu nju ye kuryaba omwirima, N'etabaaza emuri ahaiguru eryaraazibwa.
en: The light shall be dark in his tabernacle, And his candle shall be put out with him.

rr: Entambwe ze endaingwa ziryahindurwa ngufu. N'enaama ze ziryamugwisa
en: The steps of his strength shall be straitened, And his own counsel shall cast him down.

rr: Ahabw'okuba ebigyere bye nibyo birumunaga omu kigoye, Akagyendera aha busya.
en: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, And he walketh upon a snare.

rr: Omuriiti guryamukwata ekitsintsino, N'omwiniko gumukwate, gumuhamye.
en: The gin shall take him by the heel, And the robber shall prevail against him.

rr: Aryategwa omurunga omu itaka, Omutego gumukwatire omu kahanda.
en: The snare is laid for him in the ground, And a trap for him in the way.

rr: Ebirikutiinisa biryamwitsa obwoba embaju zoona, Bimubingye bimuhambize.
en: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, And shall drive him to his feet.

rr: Amaani ge garyatuubibwa enjara; Ku ariza kuteera entsibo, aryashanga akagwe kamugwereire.
en: His strength shall be hungerbitten, And destruction shall be ready at his side.

rr: Omubiri gwe guryamirwa kwo; Eego, omujigaijo gwa rufu guryamira engingo ze.
en: It shall devour the strength of his skin: Even the firstborn of death shall devour his strength.

rr: Aryahuruuturwa omu ihema rye, eri yaabaire ayesiga, Atwarwe aha mukama w'ebirikutiinisa.
en: His confidence shall be rooted out of his tabernacle, And it shall bring him to the king of terrors.

rr: Abatari be baryatuura omu ihema rye; Obuganga buryabuga ahu atwire hoona
en: It shall dwell in his tabernacle, because it is none of his: Brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation.

rr: Emizi ye eyomere okuzimu, N'amataagi ge goomere eruguru.
en: His roots shall be dried up beneath, And above shall his branch be cut off.

rr: Aryayebera kimwe omu nsi, N'eiziina rye tiririgaruka kugambwa mu mihanda.
en: His remembrance shall perish from the earth, And he shall have no name in the street.

rr: Aryabingwa, arugye omu mushana, aze omu mwirima, Kandi acwerwe kimwe omu nsi.
en: He shall be driven from light into darkness, And chased out of the world.

rr: Tarigira mwana nari mwijukuru omu baabo, N'obu yaakuba emponoka y'okutsigara ahu yaabaire atwire.
en: He shall neither have son nor nephew among his people, Nor any remaining in his dwellings.

rr: Abarimukurata baryatangaarira ekiro kye, Nk'oku abaamubandiize baagizire obwoba.
en: They that come after him shall be astonied at his day, As they that went before were affrighted.

rr: Buzimazima obwo nibwo butaaho bw'abatahikiriire, Kandi ogwo nigwo mwanya gw'abatarikutiina Ruhanga.
en: Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked, And this is the place of him that knoweth not God.

rr: Bwanyima Yobu yaagarukamu ati
en: Then Job answered and said,

rr: Muryahitsya hi okuunyita kubi, N'okumpendagura n'ebigambo?
en: How long will ye vex my soul, And break me in pieces with words?

rr: Ogu n'omurundi gwa ikumi nimunjuma. Tikirikubaitsa enshoni kunkora kubi?
en: These ten times have ye reproached me: Ye are not ashamed that ye make yourselves strange to me.

rr: Hoona, n'obu naakubaire nsiisire, Ekicumuro kyangye niinye kyakubaireho.
en: And be it indeed that I have erred, Mine error remaineth with myself.

rr: Ku muraabe nimwenda kuunyehimbisizaho N'okuunyomesereza ahabw'enaku zangye
en: If indeed ye will magnify yourselves against me, And plead against me my reproach:

rr: Mumanye ngu Ruhanga niwe aitsire orubanja rwangye, akankubaakuba n'ekigoye kye.
en: Know now that God hath overthrown me, And hath compassed me with his net.

rr: Reeba, nintaka nti: Baanyita! Kwonka timpairwe mikono; Niinyeta munonga, kwonka mbura ow'okuncwera orubanja rw'oburyo.
en: Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard: I cry aloud, but there is no judgment.

rr: Aitsire omuhanda gwangye, tiinyine burabo, N'emihanda yangye yaagitamu omwirima.
en: He hath fenced up my way that I cannot pass, And he hath set darkness in my paths.

rr: Anjwire ekitiinisa kyangye, Yaanyiha ekirunga aha mutwe.
en: He hath stripped me of my glory, And taken the crown from my head.

rr: Ansheenyagwire embaju zoona, mpweireho, N'amatsiko gangye agarandwire nk'ekiti.
en: He hath destroyed me on every side, and I am gone: And mine hope hath he removed like a tree.

rr: Angiriire ekiniga kingi, Yanteekateekaho nk'omubisha we
en: He hath also kindled his wrath against me, And he counteth me unto him as one of his enemies.

rr: Engabo ze zihururiire hamwe, Zaarunda eby'okungotesa, Zaateera orusiisira okwehinguririza eihema ryangye.
en: His troops come together, And raise up their way against me, And encamp round about my tabernacle.

rr: Antaanise na bagyenzi bangye, N'abamanyi bambeera kimwe abanyamahanga
en: He hath put my brethren far from me, And mine acquaintance are verily estranged from me.

rr: Abaitu na banywani bangye bampemukireho
en: My kinsfolk have failed, and my familiar friends have forgotten me.

rr: Abagyenyi b'omu nju yangye baanyebirwe, Abazaana bangye nibanteekateekaho nk'omunyaihanga, Mbahindukiire omwijaija.
en: They that dwell in mine house, And my maids, count me for a stranger: I am an alien in their sight.

rr: Niinyeta omuheereza wangye, tarikuunyetaba, N'obu ndikumweshengyereza.
en: I called my servant, and he gave me no answer; I intreated him with my mouth.

rr: Ntamirwe omukazi wangye, N'abaana ba maawe nibannuga.
en: My breath is strange to my wife, Though I intreated for the children's sake of mine own body.

rr: Nangwa n'abaana bato nibangaya; Ku ndikwimuka, bangambuura.
en: Yea, young children despised me; I arose, and they spake against me.

rr: Banywani bangye boona ab'aha mara nibannyangira kimwe, N'abo abu mbaire ninkunda baanyehindukiriize.
en: All my inward friends abhorred me: And they whom I loved are turned against me.

rr: Amagufa gangye garamataine n'oruhu n'enyama, Ntsigaize amaino gonka.
en: My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh, And I am escaped with the skin of my teeth.

rr: Mungirire esaasi, imwe bagyenzi bangye; mungirire esaasi, Ahabw'okuba omukono gwa Ruhanga gumpikireho.
en: Have pity upon me, have pity upon me, O ye my friends; For the hand of God hath touched me.

rr: Nimumpiigira ki nka Ruhanga? Oku ndikushusha, tikurikubamara?
en: Why do ye persecute me as God, And are not satisfied with my flesh?

rr: Nangwa kuri ebigambo byangye bihandiikirwe, Bikahandiikwa omu kitabo!
en: Oh that my words were now written! Oh that they were printed in a book!

rr: Bikasharurwa aha rukiri n'akacumu k'ekyoma na rusasi, Bikagumaho ebiro byona!
en: That they were graven with an iron pen and lead In the rock for ever!

rr: Ahakuba nimmanya ku Omucunguzi wangye abaho, Kandi ku aryemera aha nsi aha muheru
en: For I know that my redeemer liveth, And that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:

rr: Omubiri gwangye ku guriba gwamazirweho gutyo, Bwanyima ndyareeba Ruhanga ntakigwine
en: And though after my skin worms destroy this body , Yet in my flesh shall I see God:

rr: Ou ndyereebera nyenka, Eriisho ryangye, eritari ry'ondiijo, rikamwetegyereza. Na mbwenu omutima gwangye nigugwa enshazi.
en: Whom I shall see for myself, And mine eyes shall behold, and not another; Though my reins be consumed within me.

rr: Ku muraabe nimugira ngu: Nitwija kumuhiiga, Kandi ngu, enaku ze niwe zaakomookireho
en: But ye should say, Why persecute we him, Seeing the root of the matter is found in me?

rr: Mwerinde rurara, Ahabw'okuba ekiniga kireeta ekifubiro kya rurara, Ngu mubone kuhamya ku hariho okucwa orubanja.
en: Be ye afraid of the sword: For wrath bringeth the punishments of the sword, That ye may know there is a judgment.

rr: Bwanyima Zofari Omunaamasi yaagarukamu ati
en: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,

rr: Mbwenu ebiteekateeko byangye nibingarukamu, Ahabw'obwire obu nyine
en: Therefore do my thoughts cause me to answer, And for this I make haste.

rr: Nimpurira okuhana okurikunkwatsa enshoni; Kwonka oku ndikureeba, hariho omwoyo ogurikungarukamu.
en: I have heard the check of my reproach, And the spirit of my understanding causeth me to answer.

rr: Torikumanya okuruga ira ryona, Omuntu yaaba kuteebwa aha nsi
en: Knowest thou not this of old, Since man was placed upon earth,

rr: Ngu okwesiima kw'ababi kuhwaho juba, N'okushemererwa kw'abatarikutiina Ruhanga kuba okw'akaanya kakye?
en: That the triumphing of the wicked is short, And the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment?

rr: Oba 3 , N'obu yaakutunguuka, akahika ahaiguru munonga, Omutwe gwe gukaza omubicu
en: Though his excellency mount up to the heavens, And his head reach unto the clouds;

rr: Kwonka aryacwekyererera kimwe nk'eishaazi rye, Abaamureebire baryagira bati: Mbwenu shi arahi?
en: Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung: They which have seen him shall say, Where is he?

rr: Aryagaruka nk'ekirooto, tarireebwa; Ahiigwe nk'okworekwa kwa nyekiro.
en: He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found: Yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.

rr: Eriisho eryamureebire tiririgaruka kumureeba, N'omwanya gwe tigurimureeba bundi.
en: The eye also which saw him shall see him no more; Neither shall his place any more behold him.

rr: Abaana be baryayekundisa abooro, N'engaro ze ziryagarura eitungo rye
en: His children shall seek to please the poor, And his hands shall restore their goods.

rr: Amagufa ge gaijwire amaani g'obutsigazi, Kwonka aryaziikwa nago omu mucuucu.
en: His bones are full of the sin of his youth, Which shall lie down with him in the dust.

rr: N'obu araabe naanurirwa obubi omu kanwa ke, Akaguma naabunuriiriza ahansi y'orurimi rwe
en: Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, Though he hide it under his tongue;

rr: Akanga kubureka, Kureka akaguma abuhunikire omu kanwa
en: Though he spare it, and forsake it not; But keep it still within his mouth:

rr: Kwonka omu nda ye eby'okurya bye biryahinduka, Bimubeere obushegu bw'encwera.
en: Yet his meat in his bowels is turned, It is the gall of asps within him.

rr: Amira obutungi, agaruka abutanaka, Ruhanga abwiha omu nda ye.
en: He hath swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again: God shall cast them out of his belly.

rr: Aryanyuunyuuta obushegu bw'encwera, Aitwe orurimi rw'empiri
en: He shall suck the poison of asps: The viper's tongue shall slay him.

rr: Tarireeba migyera, Nari otugyera otwijwire obwoki n'amakamo
en: He shall not see the rivers, The floods, the brooks of honey and butter.

rr: Ebi yaafeereire kubi aryabigarura, taribimira, amagoba g'obushuubuzi bwe tarigashemerererwa
en: That which he laboured for shall he restore, And shall not swallow it down: According to his substance shall the restitution be , and he shall not rejoice therein .

rr: Ahabw'okuba akaita kubi abooro, yaabatsigaho; Yaanyaga enju, ei atarombekire.
en: Because he hath oppressed and hath forsaken the poor; Because he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not;

rr: Ahabw'okugira omurur ogutarikuhwa, Tarirokora kintu na kimwe aha bi akunda.
en: Surely he shall not feel quietness in his belly, He shall not save of that which he desired.

rr: Ku yaariire, taine ki yatsigire; N'ahabw'ekyo okugogyera ke tikurigumaho.
en: There shall none of his meat be left; Therefore shall no man look for his goods.

rr: Omu bunaku obu ariba aijwize ebintu bingi ebirikumumara, aryakyena; Emikono y'abaine obujune boona eryamuteeraniraho.
en: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits: Every hand of the wicked shall come upon him.

rr: Ku ariba ari haihi kwigutsa enda ye, Ruhanga aryamushukaho ekiniga kye kingi, Akimugwiseho nk'enjura naarya.
en: When he is about to fill his belly, God shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him, And shall rain it upon him while he is eating.

rr: Aryahunga eky'okurwanisa ky'ekyoma, Omwambi gw'omuringa gumucumite, gumwogyemu
en: He shall flee from the iron weapon, And the bow of steel shall strike him through.

rr: Agwekuure, gumurugyemu, Omunwa gwagwo ogurikumurinkana gurugye omu ndurwe ye, Eby'okutiinisa bimuhikyeho.
en: It is drawn, and cometh out of the body; Yea, the glittering sword cometh out of his gall: Terrors are upon him.

rr: Obutungi bwe bubiikiirwe omwirima ndindindi, Omurimo ogutaakibwa bantu guryamumaraho, Kandi ebitsigaire omu ihema rye ryona gubitookyeze.
en: All darkness shall be hid in his secret places: A fire not blown shall consume him; It shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle.

rr: Eiguru riryashuuruura okutahikiirira kwe, N'ensi emwimukirire.
en: The heaven shall reveal his iniquity; And the earth shall rise up against him.

rr: Eby'omu nju ye biryanyagwa, Bitwarwe aha izooba ry'ekiniga kya Ruhanga.
en: The increase of his house shall depart, And his goods shall flow away in the day of his wrath.

rr: Ogwo nigwo mugabo gw'enkozi y'ebibi ogurikuruga ahari Ruhanga, N'obuhunguzi obu Ruhanga yaamuteereireho.
en: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, And the heritage appointed unto him by God.

rr: Bwanyima Yobu yaagarukamu ati
en: But Job answered and said,

rr: Nimuhuguukye, muhurire ebi ndikugamba, Haza obwo nimuba muunyaagiire.
en: Hear diligently my speech, And let this be your consolations.

rr: Mungumisiririze, naanye ngambe; Ku ndaaheze, mugumizemu nimusheka.
en: Suffer me that I may speak; And after that I have spoken, mock on.

rr: Nimugira ngu niinyetomboitera omuntu? Mbwenu ekyakunzibira kugumisiriza niki?
en: As for me, is my complaint to man? And if it were so , why should not my spirit be troubled?

rr: Mundeebe, mushoberwe, Engaro muzite aha munwa.
en: Mark me, and be astonished, And lay your hand upon your mouth.

rr: Ku ndikwijuka oku ndi, ngira obwoba, Omubiri gwangye gutetema.
en: Even when I remember I am afraid, And trembling taketh hold on my flesh.

rr: Ahabw'enki enkozi z'ebibi zigumaho, zikakura, Zikahika omu ngingo zaabukuru, Zikagira obushoboorozi bw'amaani?
en: Wherefore do the wicked live, Become old, yea, are mighty in power?

rr: Abaana baazo bahama zikiriho, N'oruzaaro rwazo rugumaho nizirureeba.
en: Their seed is established in their sight with them, And their offspring before their eyes.

rr: Amaka gaazo tigagira ki gatiina, N'enkoni ya Ruhanga tegahikaho.
en: Their houses are safe from fear, Neither is the rod of God upon them.

rr: Enimi yaabo eyemya, teremwa; Ente yaabo ezaara, tetorooga
en: Their bull gendereth, and faileth not; Their cow calveth, and casteth not her calf.

rr: Abaana baabo abato babaseetura nk'obusyo, N'abandi baana baabo bagyenda nibatara.
en: They send forth their little ones like a flock, And their children dance.

rr: Beeshongorera aha mataari n'endingiri. Bashemerererwa okugamba kw'emikuri.
en: They take the timbrel and harp, And rejoice at the sound of the organ.

rr: Ebiro byabo babimara omu kugogyeera, Bashuuma okuzimu bagwirwe gye.
en: They spend their days in wealth, And in a moment go down to the grave.

rr: Bagira Ruhanga bati: Turugyeho! Titurikwenda kumanya muhanda yaawe.
en: Therefore they say unto God, Depart from us; For we desire not the knowledge of thy ways.

rr: Ow'obushoboorozi bwona nikyo ki, itwe kumuheereza? Kandi ku turikumushaba, nikitugasira ki?
en: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? And what profit should we have, if we pray unto him?

rr: Reeba, okugwa gye kwabo tikuri mu mikono yaabo; Enaama z'enkozi z'ebibi zindi hare.
en: Lo, their good is not in their hand: The counsel of the wicked is far from me.

rr: Ni kangahi obu etabaaza y'ababi eraaziibwe, Bakaguubwaho akabi, Ruhanga akabaha obusaasi abainiire ekiniga?
en: How oft is the candle of the wicked put out! And how oft cometh their destruction upon them! God distributeth sorrows in his anger.

rr: Kandi ni kangahi obu babaire nk'ebinyaatsi birikutwarwa omuyaga, Nari nk'ebishushunga ebirikutwarwa akasooroora?
en: They are as stubble before the wind, And as chaff that the storm carrieth away.

rr: Imwe nimugira ngu Ruhanga abiikira abaana b'omusiisi ekifubiro ahabw'okutahikiirira kwe. Ka Ruhanga abe niwe yaahana, abone kumanya ekibi kye!
en: God layeth up his iniquity for his children: He rewardeth him, and he shall know it .

rr: Ka amaisho ge geereebere okucwekyerera kwe, Anywe ekiniga ky'Ow'obushoboorozi bwona!
en: His eyes shall see his destruction, And he shall drink of the wrath of the Almighty.

rr: Nimugira ngur, ebiriba aha b'enju ye abarimukurata aryaba naakibyetaho, Haza ebiro by'emyaka byacwirweho?
en: For what pleasure hath he in his house after him, When the number of his months is cut off in the midst?

rr: Hariho oryegyesa Ruhanga obwengye? Haza kunu niwe acwera ab'ekitiinisa emanja.
en: Shall any teach God knowledge? Seeing he judgeth those that are high.

rr: Omwe afa akiine amaani ge goona, Aine obusingye, agaramisiriize
en: One dieth in his full strength, Being wholly at ease and quiet.

rr: Omubiri gwe gugomokire, guriitiraine, N'omushokooro gw'omu magufa ge niguyagayaga.
en: His breasts are full of milk, And his bones are moistened with marrow.

rr: Ondiijo afa n'obusaasi bw'aha mutima, Atakarozaga ha kirungi
en: And another dieth in the bitterness of his soul, And never eateth with pleasure.

rr: Kwonka bombi babyama omu mucuucu, Bashwekwa enyogori.
en: They shall lie down alike in the dust, And the worms shall cover them.

rr: Reeba, nimmanya ebi murikuteekateeka, N'enaama mbi ezi muunyiniire
en: Behold, I know your thoughts, And the devices which ye wrongfully imagine against me.

rr: Ahakuba nimugira muti: Enju y'omunyiginya erahi? Enju ei abasiisi baabaire batuuramu erahi?
en: For ye say, Where is the house of the prince? And where are the dwelling places of the wicked?

rr: Beitu shi, timukabuuzaga abagyenzi, Kandi timurikwikiriza ebi bahamya
en: Have ye not asked them that go by the way? And do ye not know their tokens,

rr: Ku omusiisi ahonoka aha kiro ky'akabi, Akajunwa aha kiro ky'okugirirwaho ekiniga?
en: That the wicked is reserved to the day of destruction? They shall be brought forth to the day of wrath.

rr: N'oha owaakumugambira butunu omuhanda gwe? Kandi n'oha owaakumuzimuurira ebi yaakozire?
en: Who shall declare his way to his face? And who shall repay him what he hath done?

rr: Ku aritwarwa kuziikwa omu kiina, Ekituuro kye kiryarindwa
en: Yet shall he be brought to the grave, And shall remain in the tomb.

rr: Ebitsinde by'omu ruhanga biryamunurira, Abantu boona baryamukurata, Ahakuba abaamubandiize bakaba batarikubarwa.
en: The clods of the valley shall be sweet unto him, And every man shall draw after him, As there are innumerable before him.

rr: Mbwenu imwe nimubaasa muta kungumya n'ebitaine muhoho? Ahkuba tihaine kindi ekitsigaire omu kugarukamu kwanyu kureka ebishuba. rr: Bwanyima Elifaazi Omutemaani yaagarukamu ati
en: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,

rr: Omuntu aine eki yaakugasira Ruhanga? N'eky'amazima omunyabwengye obwengye bwe niwe bugasira.
en: Can a man be profitable unto God, As he that is wise may be profitable unto himself?

rr: Noogira ngu iwe okuba ohikiriire, kiine eki kirikushemeza Ow'obushoboorozi bwona, Nari shi okushemeza emitwarize yaawe kiine eki kirikumwongyeraho?
en: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that thou art righteous? Or is it gain to him , that thou makest thy ways perfect?

rr: Noogira ngu okumutiina kwawe nikwo kumureeteire kukuhana? Nikyo arikutonganira naiwe?
en: Will he reprove thee for fear of thee? Will he enter with thee into judgment?

rr: Ebibi byawe ti bingi? Eby'okutahikiirira byawe tibiine bugarukiro
en: Is not thy wickedness great? And thine iniquities infinite?

rr: Ahabw'okuba okaihira busha omukwato ahari beene waanyu; Otaine ki ajwaire, waamujuura akajwaro ke.
en: For thou hast taken a pledge from thy brother for nought, And stripped the naked of their clothing.

rr: Orikukooza okaba otamuha twizi tw'okunywa. N'oine enjara omwima eby'okurya.
en: Thou hast not given water to the weary to drink, And thou hast withholden bread from the hungry.

rr: Haza ow'obushoboorozi yaaba niwe yaatunga ensi, Kandi ow'ekitiinisa yaagituuramu.
en: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth; And the honourable man dwelt in it.

rr: Abafaakazi okababinga emikono misha, N'emikono y'abataine baishebo yaahendagurwa.
en: Thou hast sent widows away empty, And the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

rr: Nikyo emitego ekwehinguriririze, Ebihikiirizi ebirikutiinisa bikakutuntuza
en: Therefore snares are round about thee, And sudden fear troubleth thee;

rr: Okuhweza kwawe kuhindwirwe omwirima; nikyo otarikubaasiza kureeba, N'omwegyemure gw'amaizi gukushwekire.
en: Or darkness, that thou canst not see; And abundance of waters cover thee.

rr: Ruhanga tari omu iguru ahaiguru? Reeba, enyonyoozi z'ahaiguru munonga oku ziri hare omu rya nyakacu!
en: Is not God in the height of heaven? And behold the height of the stars, how high they are!

rr: Haza ogira oti: Ruhanga naamanya ki? Naabasa kucwa orubanja, naayozya amaisho omu mwirima ndindindi?
en: And thou sayest, How doth God know? Can he judge through the dark cloud?

rr: Oti: Ebicu ebikwaitse bimuturukire oku n'oku, byamuzibira kureeba, Kandi naagyendera aha iguru eriri ahaiguru y'ensi.
en: Thick clouds are a covering to him, that he seeth not; And he walketh in the circuit of heaven.

rr: Nooyenda kugumizamu omu muhanda ogwa ira, Ogu abantu babi baatoiremu?
en: Hast thou marked the old way Which wicked men have trodden?

rr: bakabakurwa, baatwarwa obunaku bwabo butakahikire, Omusingi gwabo gwatwarwa amaizi.
en: Which were cut down out of time, Whose foundation was overflown with a flood:

rr: Baagira Ruhanga bati: Turugyeho! Kandi bati: Ow'obushoboorozi bwona naabaasa kutugira ata?
en: Which said unto God, Depart from us: And what can the Almighty do for them?

rr: N'obu baraabe baagizire batyo, Ruhanga akaijuza amaju gaabo ebirungi, (Kwonka nyowe enaama z'ababi zindi hare!)
en: Yet he filled their houses with good things: But the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

rr: Abahikiriire babireeba, beesiima; Abataine rubanja babashekyerera, babagaya
en: The righteous see it , and are glad: And the innocent laugh them to scorn.

rr: Nibagira bati: Buzimazima ababisha baitu bacwekyereziibwe, Kandi n'ebi batsigireho omuriro gwabimaraho.
en: Whereas our substance is not cut down, But the remnant of them the fire consumeth.

rr: Garukana na Ruhanga, obone kugira obusingye; Obwo nibwo ebirungi biriija ahariiwe.
en: Acquaint now thyself with him, and be at peace: Thereby good shall come unto thee.

rr: Ikiriza okuhabura okurikuruga omu kanwa ke, N'ebigambo bye obigumye aha mutima.
en: Receive, I pray thee, the law from his mouth, And lay up his words in thine heart.

rr: Ku oraagarukire Ow'obushoboorozi bwona, waayecureeza, Waata okutahikiirira hare n'amahema gaawe
en: If thou return to the Almighty, thou shalt be built up, Thou shalt put away iniquity far from thy tabernacles.

rr: Kandi ku oraate eitungo ryawe omu mucuucu, N'ezaabu ya Ofiri waagita omu mabaare g'omu kagyera
en: Then shalt thou lay up gold as dust, And the gold of Ophir as the stones of the brooks.

rr: N'Ow'obushoboorozi bwona yaaba eitungo ryawe, Yaakubeera efeeza y'obuguzi bwingi
en: Yea, the Almighty shall be thy defence, And thou shalt have plenty of silver.

rr: Obwo nibwo orishemerererwa omu W'obushoboorozi bwona, Okaimutsya amaisho gaawe ahari Ruhanga.
en: For then shalt thou have thy delight in the Almighty, And shalt lift up thy face unto God.

rr: Oryamushaba, akuhurire, Kandi ohikiirize ebi waahigire nooraganisa
en: Thou shalt make thy prayer unto him, and he shall hear thee, And thou shalt pay thy vows.

rr: Oryagira eki waihamu kukora, kibe nk'oku orikwenda, N'omushana guryajwera emihanda yaawe.
en: Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee: And the light shall shine upon thy ways.

rr: Abantu ku barikugwisa, oryagira oti: Hariho orikuunyimutsya, Kandi omucureezi Ruhanga aryamujuna.
en: When men are cast down, then thou shalt say, there is lifting up; And he shall save the humble person.

rr: Aryajuna otaine rubanja, Kandi oryajunwa ahabw'okushemera kw'engaro zaawe.
en: He shall deliver the island of the innocent: And it is delivered by the pureness of thine hands.

Bwanyima Yobu yaagarukamu ati
en: Then Job answered and said,

rr: Na hati amaganya gangye n'obugomi, Okuteerwa kwangye nikuremeera okukira okutsinda kwangye
en: Even to day is my complaint bitter: My stroke is heavier than my groaning.

rr: Nangwa ku naakumanya ahu naakumushanga, Nkahika aha kitebe kye!
en: Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!

rr: Nkaata orubanja rwangye omu maisho ge, Nyijuza akanwa kangye eby'okwetonganira.
en: I would order my cause before him, And fill my mouth with arguments.

rr: Obwo mmanya eki arangarukyemu Nshoborokyerwa eki arangambire
en: I would know the words which he would answer me, And understand what he would say unto me.

rr: Akaantonganiise nk'omukuru ow'obushoboorozi bwingi? Ngaaha! kureka akaanyetaireho.
en: Will he plead against me with his great power? No; but he would put strength in me.

rr: Okwo niyo oine omutima ogugororokire yaakutonganira nawe; Orikuncwera orubanja akarucwa, nkarusingira kimwe.
en: There the righteous might dispute with him; So should I be delivered for ever from my judge.

rr: Reeba, ku ndikuza omumaisho, nshanga atariyo; Nkigaruka enyima, amburira
en: Behold, I go forward, but he is not there ; And backward, but I cannot perceive him:

rr: Nkitoora aha rubaju rwa bumosho ndemwa kumureeba; Nkihindukira aha rwa buryo, nabwo ndemwa kumubona.
en: On the left hand, where he doth work, but I cannot behold him: He hideth himself on the right hand, that I cannot see him:

rr: -3 , 24 ; . Kwonka We naamanya omuhanda ogu ndikutoora; Ku ariheza kungyeza, ndyarugamu ninshusha ezaabu.
en: But he knoweth the way that I take: When he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.

rr: Ekigyere kyangye kihamiire omu kirari kye, Omuhanda gwe ngugumiremu, tinaaguteishuka.
en: My foot hath held his steps, His way have I kept, and not declined.

rr: Tindagarukire nyima kuruga omu biragiro ebi yaaragiire, N'ebigambo by'omu kanwa ke mbikunzire okukira eby'okurya ebi ncumiirwe.
en: Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have esteemed the words of his mouth more than my necessary food .

rr: Kwonka We tahinduka. Owaakumuhindura n'oha? Eki ayenda, nikyo akora.
en: But he is in one mind , and who can turn him? And what his soul desireth, even that he doeth.

rr: Mbwenu naija kuhikiiriza eki anteekateekyeire, Kandi ebigambo bingi nk'ebyo abiine aha mutima.
en: For he performeth the thing that is appointed for me: And many such things are with him.

rr: Nikyo nyiniire obwoba omu maisho ge; Ku ndikuteekateeka, mmutiina.
en: Therefore am I troubled at his presence: When I consider, I am afraid of him.

rr: Ruhanga agwisize omutima gwangye enshazi, Ow'obushoboorozi bwona antuntwize
en: For God maketh my heart soft, And the Almighty troubleth me:

rr: Ahabw'okuba nyehinguririziibwe omwirima, Kandi omwirima ndindindi gwanshwenka ahamaisho.
en: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, Neither hath he covered the darkness from my face.

rr: Ahabw'enki Ow'obushoboorozi bwona tataho bunaku bw'okucweraho emanja? Kandi ahabw'enki abarikumumanya batabureeba?
en: Why, seeing times are not hidden from the Almighty, Do they that know him not see his days?

rr: Hariho abakuura ebiti by'emyatano, Bakanyagisa amaani amasyo, bakagariisa
en: Some remove the landmarks; They violently take away flocks, and feed thereof .

rr: Bakafunya endogoya y'abataine baishebo, N'ente y'omufaakazi bakagikwatiriza
en: They drive away the ass of the fatherless, They take the widow's ox for a pledge.

rr: Bakabinga abakyene omu muhanda, N'abooro b'omu nsi boona bakeeshereka.
en: They turn the needy out of the way: The poor of the earth hide themselves together.

rr: Reeba, ni nk'enturegye z'omu ihamba, bashohora, baza aha murimo, Nibasherura omu ihamba eky'okwita, kuba eby'okurya by'abaana baabo
en: Behold, as wild asses in the desert, Go they forth to their work; rising betimes for a prey: The wilderness yieldeth food for them and for their children.

rr: Batema obunyaatsi oburiibwa enyamaishwa omu ishwa, Bahumba omu musiri gw'emizaabibu y'omusiisi
en: They reap every one his corn in the field: And they gather the vintage of the wicked.

rr: Baraara batajwaire burugaho busheesha, Tibagira ky'okwefubika omu mbeho
en: They cause the naked to lodge without clothing, That they have no covering in the cold.

rr: Bajubibwa enjura y'omu bibungo, Beekinga omu mabaare babuzire obwegamo.
en: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, And embrace the rock for want of a shelter.

rr: Hariho abashahura abataine baishebo, bakabaiha aha mabeere, Bakakwatiriza omwereere w'omukyene
en: They pluck the fatherless from the breast, And take a pledge of the poor.

rr: Bagyendagyenda bataine ki bajwaire, Beekorera ebiba baine enjara
en: They cause him to go naked without clothing, And they take away the sheaf from the hungry;

rr: Banyuukira majuta g'emizeituuni omu misiri y'ababi, Banyuukira omu manyuukiro gaabo ga viinyo baine eiriho.
en: Which make oil within their walls, And tread their winepresses, and suffer thirst.

rr: Omu rurembo abarikuga batsinda, Nibataka ngu baheebwe emikono, Kwonka Ruhanga tayeta ha kutaka kwabo.
en: Men groan from out of the city, And the soul of the wounded crieth out: Yet God layeth not folly to them .

rr: Abo n'ab'omuri abo abagomera omushana, Tibamanya mihanda yaagwo, N'obu kwakuba okuguma omu tuhanda twagwo.
en: They are of those that rebel against the light; They know not the ways thereof, Nor abide in the paths thereof.

rr: Omwitsi aimuka omu kairima kwita omworo n'omukyene, Kandi nyekiro aba nk'omushuma.
en: The murderer rising with the light killeth the poor and needy, And in the night is as a thief.

rr: Eriisho ry'enshambani ritegyereza orwita-waabo, Neegira eti, tihaine orandeebe; Ayetwekyerera ahamaisho.
en: The eye also of the adulterer waiteth for the twilight, Saying, No eye shall see me: And disguiseth his face.

rr: Omu mwirima barimiirira amaju, Nyomushana beekingirana, tibamanya kashana.
en: In the dark they dig through houses, Which they had marked for themselves in the daytime: They know not the light.

rr: Ahabw'okuba aharibo omwirima ndindindi ni nk'akasheeshe, Kandi ebitiinisa abantu omu mwirima ndindindi bo bakabimanyiira.
en: For the morning is to them even as the shadow of death: If one know them, they are in the terrors of the shadow of death.

rr: Imwe nimugira ngu, Batwarwa juba omwegyemure gw'amaizi, Omugabo gwabo omu nsi n'omukyeeno, Tihariho munyuuki wa viinyo oza omu misiri yaabo y'emizaabibu.
en: He is swift as the waters; Their portion is cursed in the earth: He beholdeth not the way of the vineyards.

rr: Ekyanda n'omushana bimaraho amaizi g'ebirika, Kandi n'Okuzimu nikwo egira abasiisire.
en: Drought and heat consume the snow waters: So doth the grave those which have sinned.

rr: Enda eyaamuzire eryamwebwa, Enyogori zimurye nizimunuriiriza, Tarigaruka kwijukwa bundi; Okutahikiirira kwona kuryahendagurwa nk'ekiti.
en: The womb shall forget him; the worm shall feed sweetly on him; He shall be no more remembered; And wickedness shall be broken as a tree.

rr: Barya eby'engumba ezitakazaaraga, Tibagira ki bagasira abafaakazi.
en: He evil entreateth the barren that beareth not: And doeth not good to the widow.

rr: N'obu kiraabe kiri kityo, abo bantu b'amaani Ruhanga abagumyaho n'amaani ge; Ku baba beehweire amatsiko, abaimutsya
en: He draweth also the mighty with his power: He riseth up, and no man is sure of life.

rr: Abarinda baguma bari buhooro, bagira obwegamo, amaisho ge tigaruga ha mihanda yaabo.
en: Though it be given him to be in safety, whereon he resteth; Yet his eyes are upon their ways.

rr: Batunguurwa; ku hahwaho akaanya kakye, bahwaho; Bagarurwa ahansi, baihwa omu muhanda nk'abandi boona, Bagyeshwa nk'obushiisha bw'engano.
en: They are exalted for a little while, but are gone And brought low; they are taken out of the way as all other , And cut off as the tops of the ears of corn.

rr: Ku biraabe bitari kwo, n'oha oraanyomesereze ekishuba, akahamya ku ebi ndikugamba bitaine ku biri?
en: And if it be not so now, who will make me a liar, And make my speech nothing worth?

rr: Bwanyima Biludaadi Omushuuhi yaagarukamu ati
en: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

rr: Obutegyeki n'ekitiinisa biinwe Ruhanga, Kandi areeta obusingye omu myanya ye ey'omu iguru.
en: Dominion and fear are with him, He maketh peace in his high places.

rr: Amahe ge nigabaasa kubarwa? N'oha otajwerwa mushana gwe?
en: Is there any number of his armies? And upon whom doth not his light arise?

rr: omuntu naabaasa ata kuba ohikiriire omu maisho ga Ruhanga? Owaazairwe omukazi naabaasa ata kuba oshemeire?
en: How then can man be justified with God? Or how can he be clean that is born of a woman?

rr: Reeba, n'okwezi tikurikumurinkana, N'enyonyoozi tizishemeire mu maisho ge
en: Behold even to the moon, and it shineth not; Yea, the stars are not pure in his sight.

rr: Bwanyima Yobu yaagarukamu ati
en: But Job answered and said,

rr: Eshi waamanya kuhwera otaine bushoboorozi! Omukono ogutaine maani waamanya kugujuna!
en: How hast thou helped him that is without power? How savest thou the arm that hath no strength?

rr: Otaine bwengye waamanya kumuhabura, Kandi waagamba ebigambo bingi ebirimu okumanya okuhikire!
en: How hast thou counselled him that hath no wisdom? And how hast thou plentifully declared the thing as it is?

rr: Owaakugambisa ebyo bigambo n'oha? Kandi owmoyo ogwakugambisa n'ogw'oha?
en: To whom hast thou uttered words? And whose spirit came from thee?

rr: Abaafiire nibatetemera ahansi y'amaizi, Hamwe n'ebituurayo.
en: Dead things are formed From under the waters, and the inhabitants thereof.

rr: Okuzimu eri omu maisho ga Ruhanga ajwaire busha, Kandi n'owa nyamuteza taine ky'okweshweka.
en: Hell is naked before him, And destruction hath no covering.

rr: Akabamba obukiizi-bwa-bumosho omu mwanya kwonka, N'ensi yaagihanika ahari busha.
en: He stretcheth out the north over the empty place, And hangeth the earth upon nothing.

rr: Yaakoma amaizi omu bicu bikwataine, Ebiro tibyataaguka.
en: He bindeth up the waters in his thick clouds; And the cloud is not rent under them.

rr: Ekitebe kye atuura akikingiire, Akishwekire ekicu kye.
en: He holdeth back the face of his throne, And spreadeth his cloud upon it.

rr: -11 ; . Amaizi akagateeraho obugarukiro, Ahu omushana n'omwirima byatanira.
en: He hath compassed the waters with bounds, Until the day and night come to an end.

rr: Enyomyo z'eiguru zitetema, Zitangaarira okuhana kwe.
en: The pillars of heaven tremble And are astonished at his reproof.

rr: Ahabw'obushoboorozi bwe acureeza enyanja, N'ahabw'obwengye bwe akacumita 26:12 Rahabu amakuru, Omugoye ogutuura omu nyanja. Rahabu.
en: He divideth the sea with his power, And by his understanding he smiteth through the proud.

rr: Omwitsyo gwe gureetera eiguru entsya nungi, N'omukono gwe agucumitisa ekijoka ekirikuhunga.
en: By his spirit he hath garnished the heavens; His hand hath formed the crooked serpent.

rr: Reeba, ebyo nibyo, kwonka n'otw'aha rubaju omu mitwarize ye, Kandi n'ebi tumuhuriraho ni bikye munonga nk'okugambirana omu kutu; Kwonka okuhinda kw'obushoboorozi bwe n'oha orikubaasa kukwetegyereza? Currently Selected: Yobu 26 : RR64 Highlight
en: Lo, these are parts of his ways: But how little a portion is heard of him? But the thunder of his power who can understand? Currently Selected: Job 26 : KJV Highlight Share <div class="flex w-full items-center gap-1

rr: Bwanyima Yobu yaagumizamu naacwa enfumu ze naagira ati
en: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,

rr: Nindahira Ruhanga otahwaho, ogwo onyimire ebyabaire binshemereire, Ow'obushoboorozi bwona otuntwize amagara gangye
en: As God liveth, who hath taken away my judgment; And the Almighty, who hath vexed my soul;

rr: Nk'oku nkiri ohuriire, N'omwoyo gwa Ruhanga oku gukirikumpa okwitsya
en: All the while my breath is in me, And the spirit of God is in my nostrils;

rr: Eminwa yangye teribeiha, N'orurimi rwangye tiruriryarya.
en: My lips shall not speak wickedness, Nor my tongue utter deceit.

rr: Nikikabure nyowe okugira nti: Muhikire. Okuhitsya obu ndifa, tindireka kuguma ndi omwesigwa
en: God forbid that I should justify you: Till I die I will not remove mine integrity from me.

rr: Okuhikiirira kwangye nkuhamiireho, tindikwija kukurekura; Ahi naahika, omutima gwangye tigwine ki gurikunshinja omu bi ndakozire.
en: My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go: My heart shall not reproach me so long as I live.

rr: Omuzigu wangye abe nk'ababi, N'orikuunyimukiirira abe nk'abatahikiriire.
en: Let mine enemy be as the wicked, And he that riseth up against me as the unrighteous.

rr: Mbwenu amatsiko g'otarikutiina Ruhanga garahi, Ruhanga ku araabe ari ow'okumucwekyereza, akaihaho amagara ge?
en: For what is the hope of the hypocrite, though he hath gained, When God taketh away his soul?

rr: Enaku ku zirimuteera, Ruhanga aryahurira okutaka kwe?
en: Will God hear his cry When trouble cometh upon him?

rr: Aryashemerererwa omu W'obushoboorozi bwona, Agume naatakira Ruhanga ebiro byona?
en: Will he delight himself in the Almighty? Will he always call upon God?

rr: Niinyija kubeegyesa aha by'omukono gwa Ruhanga, Tindikwija kubashereka by'Ow'obushoboorozi bwona.
en: I will teach you by the hand of God: That which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.

rr: Reeba, mwena mukabyereebeera; Mbwenu shi, ahabw'enki mwena mubeereire kimwe abataine mugasho?
en: Behold, all ye yourselves have seen it ; Why then are ye thus altogether vain?

rr: Ogu nigwo mugabo ogu omubi aine ahari Ruhanga; Obu nibwo buhunguzi obu abarikuhata baheebwa Ow'obushoboorozi bwona.
en: This is the portion of a wicked man with God, And the heritage of oppressors, which they shall receive of the Almighty.

rr: Abaana be ku barikanya, baryakanyira rurara, Kandi oruzaaro rwe tiruritunga by'okurya eby'okuruhaazya.
en: If his children be multiplied, it is for the sword: And his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.

rr: Abarihonokaho, rufu eryabamira, N'abafaakazi be tibaribacurira.
en: Those that remain of him shall be buried in death: And his widows shall not weep.

rr: N'obu arirunda efeeza nk'omucuucu, Akeegirira ebijwaro ebirikwingana eitaka
en: Though he heap up silver as the dust, And prepare raiment as the clay;

rr: Abirunde, kwonak abahikiriire nibo baribijwara, N'efeeza ze ziryabaganwa abataine rubanja.
en: He may prepare it , but the just shall put it on, And the innocent shall divide the silver.

rr: . Enju ei arikwombeka ni nk'orububi rw'orutangura, Nk'akaju akasharabagwa omurinzi.
en: He buildeth his house as a moth, And as a booth that the keeper maketh.

rr: Aza kubyama ari omutungi, kwonka tariba atyo obundi; Ku aza kubuurura ati amaisho, ashanga obutungi bwe bwagyenzire.
en: The rich man shall lie down, but he shall not be gathered: He openeth his eyes, and he is not.

rr: Ebirikutiinisa bimweshukaho nk'omwegyemure, Akasooroora kamutwara nyekiro
en: Terrors take hold on him as waters, A tempest stealeth him away in the night.

rr: Omuyaga gw'oburugwa-izooba gumutuntumura, agyenderayo, Gumwihira kimwe ahu yaaba ari.
en: The east wind carrieth him away, and he departeth: And as a storm hurleth him out of his place.

rr: Ruhanga amuteera atarikumusaasira, N'obu yaakwenda kumwoga omu mikono kuhunga.
en: For God shall cast upon him, and not spare: He would fain flee out of his hand.

rr: Abantu baryamubinga nibamwemaamaatira, Nibeeshaanya ngu arugye omu ka ye.
en: Men shall clap their hands at him, And shall hiss him out of his place.
