rr: Buzimazima efeeza egira ekiina eki etimbwamu, N'ezaabu ei bashemeza egira omwanya gwayo
en: Surely there is a vein for the silver, And a place for gold where they fine it .

rr: Ekyoma kiihwa omu itaka, N'omuringa gyagibwa omu butare.
en: Iron is taken out of the earth, And brass is molten out of the stone.

rr: Abantu tibeeta ha mwirima, Bagwogamu, bahika aha muheru gwagwo, Nibasherura obutare omu mwirima gw'ekibunda kya rufu.
en: He setteth an end to darkness, And searcheth out all perfection: The stones of darkness, and the shadow of death.

rr: Batimba ebiina hare n'ahu abantu batwire; Beebwa abagyenzi, barereetera hare n'abantu, Beecunda nibakora oku n'oku.
en: The flood breaketh out from the inhabitant; Even the waters forgotten of the foot: They are dried up, they are gone away from men.

rr: Eitaka ryo rirugwamu eby'okurya, Kwonka okuzimu oshusha oti eitaka ryayo niritabuurwa omuriro.
en: As for the earth, out of it cometh bread: And under it is turned up as it were fire.

rr: Amabaare gaayo garugwamu safiro, Kandi egira ezaabu y'omucuucu.
en: The stones of it are the place of sapphires: And it hath dust of gold.

rr: Ogwo muhanda tigumanywa mpungu, N'eriisho ry'eishamba tirikagureebaga
en: There is a path which no fowl knoweth, And which the vulture's eye hath not seen:

rr: Enyamaishwa z'amaryo tizikaguribatamuga, N'entare enshaarizi tekagurabamuga.
en: The lion's whelps have not trodden it, Nor the fierce lion passed by it.

rr: Omuntu akununkirira eibaare ry'enkangabuye, Arimiirira emizi y'enshozi, azijuumika
en: He putteth forth his hand upon the rock; He overturneth the mountains by the roots.

rr: Acwa emikura omu nkiri, Kandi eriisho rye rireeba ekintu kyona eky'obuguzi bwingi
en: He cutteth out rivers among the rocks; And his eye seeth every precious thing.

rr: Aigarira amaizi ngu garekye kujwa, Kandi ekituura kisherekirwe, akiihayo kireebwa.
en: He bindeth the floods from overflowing; And the thing that is hid bringeth he forth to light.

rr: Mbwenu obwengye bukaazoorwa hi? Nari shi okwetegyereza kukaaboneka hi?
en: But where shall wisdom be found? And where is the place of understanding?

rr: Tihariho orikumanya omuhanda ogurikuza ei buri, Tibuzoorwa mu nsi y'abahuriire.
en: Man knoweth not the price thereof; Neither is it found in the land of the living.

rr: Okuzimu neegira eti: Tiburi muriinye, N'enyanja eti: Tiinye mbwine.
en: The depth saith, It is not in me: And the sea saith, It is not with me.

rr: Tiburikubaasa kutungwa ahabw'ezaabu, Kandi tihariho feeza erikupimwa ekahitsya obuguzi bwabwao.
en: It cannot be gotten for gold, Neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof.

rr: Tiburikubaasa kwinganisibwa na zaabu ya Ofiri, Nari shohamu ey'obuguzi bwingi, n'obu yaakuba safiro.
en: It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir, With the precious onyx, or the sapphire.

rr: Ezaabu n'ebirahuri tibirikwingana nabwo, Kandi tiburikubaasa kuhingisibwa bintu by'ezaabu eshemeziibwe
en: The gold and the crystal cannot equal it: And the exchange of it shall not be for jewels of fine gold.

rr: Korali na kristalo nabyo tibikaagambwaho, Obuguzi bwabwao nibukira obw'eruuru.
en: No mention shall be made of coral, or of pearls: For the price of wisdom is above rubies.

rr: Topazi ya Esiopia terikubaasa kugyeranisibwa nabwo, Kandi tiburikubaasa kwinganisibwa n'ezabu enungi.
en: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, Neither shall it be valued with pure gold.

rr: Mbwenu shi obwengye buruga hi? N'omwanya gw'okumanya gurahi?
en: Whence then cometh wisdom? And where is the place of understanding?

rr: Ahakuba busherekirwe abahuriire boona, Kandi bushwekirwe ngu enyonyi z'omu mwanya zitabureeba.
en: Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living, And kept close from the fowls of the air.

rr: Okuzimu na Rufu nibigira biti: Tuhuriire nibabugambaho.
en: Destruction and death say, We have heard the fame thereof with our ears.

rr: Ruhanga niwe arikumanya omuhanda ogurikuza ei buri, Kandi naamanya ahu butaaha
en: God understandeth the way thereof, And he knoweth the place thereof.

rr: Ahabw'okuba anaga amaisho aha muheru gw'ensi, Kandi ebiri ahansi y'eiguru byona abireeba.
en: For he looketh to the ends of the earth, And seeth under the whole heaven;

rr: Obu yaaha omuyaga ekiragiro, Akarengyesa amaizi endengo
en: To make the weight for the winds; And he weigheth the waters by measure.

rr: Obu yaateeraho enjura ekiragiro, Akateeraho emirabyo emihanda
en: When he made a decree for the rain, And a way for the lightning of the thunder:

rr: Obwo nibwo yaabureeba, akabumanyisa, Akabuhamya, akabucondooza
en: Then did he see it, and declare it; He prepared it, yea, and searched it out.

rr: Akagira omuntu ati: Reeba, okutiina MUKAMA nibwo bwengye, N'okutaana n'ekibi nikwo kwetegyereza.
en: And unto man he said, Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom; And to depart from evil is understanding.

rr: Bwanyima Yobu yaagumizamu naacwa enfumu ze, naagira ati
en: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,

rr: Nkaabaasibwa ki, mba nk'oku naabaire ndi omu meezi agaahingwire, Nk'omu biro ebi Ruhanga yaabaire andindiramu
en: Oh that I were as in months past, As in the days when God preserved me;

rr: Etabaaza ye neeyakira aha mutwe gwangye, Nindaba omu mwirima ahabw'okuhwezesa kwe
en: When his candle shined upon my head, And when by his light I walked through darkness;

rr: Nk'oku naabaire ndi, ndi omushaija waahamya, Obu Ruhanga yaabaire akiine omukago n'eka yangye.
en: As I was in the days of my youth, When the secret of God was upon my tabernacle;

rr: Obwo Ow'obushoboorozi bwona akaba ari hamwe naanye, Abaana bangye bankiikize
en: When the Almighty was yet with me, When my children were about me;

rr: Ebigyere byangye nibinaabisibwa n'amate, N'orukiri niruunyitururira emigyera y'amajuta.
en: When I washed my steps with butter, And the rock poured me out rivers of oil;

rr: Ku naabaire nza aha irembo ry'orurembo, Naata ekitebe kyange omu mbuga
en: When I went out to the gate through the city, When I prepared my seat in the street!

rr: Abatsigazi bakaba bandeeba, bampigiza, N'abagurusi baimuka, beemerera; q
en: The young men saw me, and hid themselves: And the aged arose, and stood up.

rr: Abanyiginya baceceka, bafa mamigye, Bataire engaro aha munwa
en: The princes refrained talking, And laid their hand on their mouth.

rr: Eiraka ry'abakungu rihunamisibwa, Endimi zibaramata omu nkanka.
en: The nobles held their peace, And their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth.

rr: Okutu kwona okwabaire kumpurira, kuunyeta ohiiriirwe, N'eriisho eryabaire rindeeba, rikihamya
en: When the ear heard me , then it blessed me; And when the eye saw me , it gave witness to me:

rr: Ahabw'okuba nkaba njuna omworo owaabaire ataka, N'efuuzi etaine kihwera
en: Because I delivered the poor that cried, And the fatherless, and him that had none to help him.

rr: Orikwenda kufa anshabira omugisha, Kandi nkaba ndeetera omutima gw'omufaakazi kweshongora ahabw'okushemererwa.
en: The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me: And I caused the widow's heart to sing for joy.

rr: Nkaba njwara okuhikiirira, kumpika; Obwinganisa bwangye bukaba buri nk'omunagiro n'ekikwemba.
en: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me: My judgment was as a robe and a diadem.

rr: Empumi nkaba nzibeera amaisho, N'ebirema mbibeera amaguru
en: I was eyes to the blind, And feet was I to the lame.

rr: Nkaba ndi ishe w'abooro, N'abu ntarikumanya, mbuuririza ekirikubasaasa
en: I was a father to the poor: And the cause which I knew not I searched out.

rr: Nkaba mpigura emba z'abasiisi, Mbanagisa ebi baine omu maino.
en: And I brake the jaws of the wicked, And plucked the spoil out of his teeth.

rr: Omu biro ebyo nkaba ngira nti: Ndyagwa omu kyashuri kyangye, Nkanyise ebiro byangye bibe nk'omusheenyi
en: Then I said, I shall die in my nest, And I shall multiply my days as the sand.

rr: Emizi yangye erandire omu maizi, N'amataagi gangye gatondweho orume, burugyeho busheeshe
en: My root was spread out by the waters, And the dew lay all night upon my branch.

rr: Ekitiinisa kyangye kigume kibe kisya, N'obuta bwangye bugume buri busya omu ngaro zangye.
en: My glory was fresh in me, And my bow was renewed in my hand.

rr: Obwo abantu bakaba bantega okutu, Batengyereza eki ndaahanuure bahunami.
en: Unto me men gave ear, and waited, And kept silence at my counsel.

rr: Ku naabaire mpeza kugamba, bakaba batagarukamu, Ebigambo byangye bibatoonyereraho.
en: After my words they spake not again; And my speech dropped upon them.

rr: Bakaba bantegyereza nk'abategyereize enjura, Baashama nk'abategyereize enjura ya katumba.
en: And they waited for me as for the rain; And they opened their mouth wide as for the latter rain.

rr: Nkaba mbasherekyera, beehweire amatsiko, Kandi bakaba batammaraho kushemuuka.
en: If I laughed on them, they believed it not; And the light of my countenance they cast not down.

rr: Nkaba mbaihiramu ebi baraakore, nshutama nabo nk'omukuru waabo, Mbatuuramu nk'omugabe omu ngabo ze, Kandi nk'orikugumya abarikucura.
en: I chose out their way, and sat chief, And dwelt as a king in the army, As one that comforteth the mourners.

rr: Kwonka mbwenu abu ndikukira obukuru, Abu naakugayire baishebo ngu batahika embwa ezirinda obusyo bwangye, Nibanteerera enaku.
en: But now they that are younger than I have me in derision, Whose fathers I would have disdained to have set with the dogs of my flock.

rr: Abo bantu abahweirwemu amaani, Emikono yaabo ekaangasira ki?
en: Yea, whereto might the strength of their hands profit me, In whom old age was perished?

rr: Bahweire aha magufa ahabw'obukyene n'enjara, Nibaguga eitaka ryomire ery'aha mbuga
en: For want and famine they were solitary; Fleeing into the wilderness in former time desolate and waste.

rr: Nibashoroma emifura n'amababi g'ebindi bishaka, N'enkonya z'ebinyagashani nibo by'okurya byabo.
en: Who cut up mallows by the bushes, And juniper roots for their meat.

rr: Nibacuubwa omu bantu, Enduuru neebajuga enyima nk'abashuma.
en: They were driven forth from among men , (They cried after them as after a thief;)

rr: Obutaaho bwabo n'ensa z'emitunga, N'amaaya g'omu itaka, n'enyanga z'omu mabaare.
en: To dwell in the cliffs of the valleys, in caves of the earth, and in the rocks.

rr: Nibaririra omu bishaka nk'endogoya, Beeteeranira omu bicuragyenyi
en: Among the bushes they brayed; Under the nettles they were gathered together.

rr: N'abaana ba'abashema, b'abantu abataine ku bari, Nibabingwa omu nsi n'enkoba.
en: They were children of fools, yea, children of base men: They were viler than the earth.

rr: Mbwenu hati mpindukire ekyeshongoro kyabo, Buzima mbabeereire eky'okucweraho enfumu
en: And now am I their song, Yea, I am their byword.

rr: Bantamirwe, baanyetantara, Kandi tibarikutiina kuncwera mumaisho
en: They abhor me, they flee far from me, And spare not to spit in my face.

rr: Ahabw'okuba Ruhanga ayugize omurunga gwangye, yancureeza. Tibakingirira kashoni.
en: Because he hath loosed my cord, and afflicted me, They have also let loose the bridle before me.

rr: Aha rubaju rwangye rwa buryo haimukire omutwe gw'abantu abataine ku bari, Bambinga, bamburabuza, Barunda eby'okutemberaho ngu bancwekyereze
en: Upon my right hand rise the youth; They push away my feet, And they raise up against me the ways of their destruction.

rr: Baita omuhanda gwangye, bakanyisa enaku zangye; Tihaine orikubazibira.
en: They mar my path, They set forward my calamity, They have no helper.

rr: Baija nk'abarikuraba ahasheenyukire ahahango, Baayekumbagariza aha rugo rugwire, bangwaho.
en: They came upon me as a wide breaking in of waters: In the desolation they rolled themselves upon me .

rr: Ebirikutiinisa biinyehindukiriize, Ekitiinisa kyangye kibingirwe nk'ekirikubingwa omuyaga; Okugogyera kwangye nikuyaayuuka nk'ekicu.
en: Terrors are turned upon me: They pursue my soul as the wind: And my welfare passeth away as a cloud.

rr: Kandi hati omutima gumpwire omunda, Ebiro by'obusaasi bimbumbatiire
en: And now my soul is poured out upon me; The days of affliction have taken hold upon me.

rr: Nyekiro amagufa gangye nigaanyogamu, Obuhuruzi oburikunsaasa tiburikutuuza
en: My bones are pierced in me in the night season: And my sinews take no rest.

rr: Ahabw'amaani gaabwo ekijwaro kyangye nikisiisikara, Nibunniga nk'ebitsya by'ekanzu.
en: By the great force of my disease is my garment changed: It bindeth me about as the collar of my coat.

rr: Ruhanga annagire omu byondo, Naahinduka nk'omucuucu n'eiju.
en: He hath cast me into the mire, And I am become like dust and ashes.

rr: Ninkutakira, torikungarukamu; Nyemereire, torikuunyetaho.
en: I cry unto thee, and thou dost not hear me: I stand up, and thou regardest me not .

rr: Ompindukiire enshaarizi, Nompiiga n'omukono gwawe ogw'amaani.
en: Thou art become cruel to me: With thy strong hand thou opposest thyself against me.

rr: Nontumuura n'omuyaga oguntembesaho, Onnaga oku n'oku n'eihunga ry'amaani
en: Thou liftest me up to the wind; thou causest me to ride upon it , And dissolvest my substance.

rr: Eego nimmanya ku orimpitsya ha kufa, N'omu nju eyaateereirweho abahuriire boona.
en: For I know that thou wilt bring me to death, And to the house appointed for all living.

rr: Beitu shi, omuntu obandamiirwe enju, tiamutsya omukono, N'omu kabi ke tateera enduuru?
en: Howbeit he will not stretch out his hand to the grave, Though they cry in his destruction.

rr: Tindariire owaabaire ari omu busaasi? Omutima gwangye tigurasaasiibwe omworo?
en: Did not I weep for him that was in trouble? Was not my soul grieved for the poor?

rr: Kwonka nyowe, ku naabaire ntegyereza ebirungi, haija ebibi; Nkitegyereza omushana, haija omwirima.
en: When I looked for good, then evil came unto me: And when I waited for light, there came darkness.

rr: Omutima gwangye nigurabanamu tigutuurize; Ebiro by'okubonabona byampikaho.
en: My bowels boiled, and rested not: The days of affliction prevented me.

rr: Ningyenda nyiragwire, ntairaguziibwe mushana, Nyemerera omu iteeraniro, ninteera enduuru.
en: I went mourning without the sun: I stood up, and I cried in the congregation.

rr: Ndi ishe-emwe na zaamuha, Mugyenzi wa zaamaaya.
en: I am a brother to dragons, And a companion to owls.

rr: Omubiri gwangye gwiragwire, gwayonoka, N'amagufa gangye gucumikirwemu omuriro.
en: My skin is black upon me, And my bones are burned with heat.

rr: Nikyo enanga yangye ehinduriirwe ey'okucura, N'omukuri gwangye gukateererwa abarikurira.
en: My harp also is turned to mourning, And my organ into the voice of them that weep.

rr: Nkaragaana endagaano n'amaisho gangye; Mbwenu nimbaasa nta kureeba omwishiki, nkamwetenga?
en: I made a covenant with mine eyes; Why then should I think upon a maid?

rr: Nkaatunga mugabo ki ahari Ruhanga? Kandi obuhunguzi bwangye oburikuruga aha W'obushoboorozi bwona ahaiguru bukaba ki?
en: For what portion of God is there from above? And what inheritance of the Almighty from on high?

rr: Ebihikiirizi tibigwera abatahikiriire, N'akagwe kakagwera enkozi z'ebibi?
en: Is not destruction to the wicked? And a strange punishment to the workers of iniquity?

rr: Ruhanga tarikureeba emihanda yangye, Akabara entambwe zangye zoona?
en: Doth not he see my ways, And count all my steps?

rr: Ku ndaabe ndagyenzire nimbeiha, Ebigyere byangye bikeehuuta kuza kugobya
en: If I have walked with vanity, Or if my foot hath hasted to deceit;

rr: (Ka mpimwe omu minzaani ey'amazima, Ruhanga amanye obwesigwa bwangye!)
en: Let me be weighed in an even balance, That God may know mine integrity.

rr: Ekigyere kyangye ku kiraabe kirateishukire omuhanda, N'omutima gwangye gukakurata ebi amaisho gangye geetenga, Nari engaro zangye ku ziraabe ziragiirweho akabara koona
en: If my step hath turned out of the way, And mine heart walked after mine eyes, And if any blot hath cleaved to mine hands;

rr: Ninkabibe, ondiijo akarya, N'ebi naahingire omu musiri gwangye bikakuurwamu.
en: Then let me sow, and let another eat; Yea, let my offspring be rooted out.

rr: Omutima gwangye ku guraabe guratwairwe omukazi, Nkagwera aha rwigi rwa mutaahi wangye
en: If mine heart have been deceived by a woman, Or if I have laid wait at my neighbour's door;

rr: Omukazi wangye naakaseere ondiijo, N'abandi bakamujuumarira
en: Then let my wife grind unto another, And let others bow down upon her.

rr: Ahabw'okuba ekyo kikaabaire ekicumuro kihango munonga; Eego, kikaabaire ekibi ky'okufubirwa abaramuzi.
en: For this is an heinous crime; Yea, it is an iniquity to be punished by the judges.

rr: ahakuba ekyo kibi n'omuriro ogurikwokyeza kimwe, gukamaraho, Kandi ekirikubaasa kurandura ebi mpingire byona.
en: For it is a fire that consumeth to destruction, And would root out all mine increase.

rr: Ku ndaabe ndagayire orubanja rw'omuhuuku wangye, nari orw'omuzaana wangye, Obu bantonganisa
en: If I did despise the cause of my manservant or of my maidservant, When they contended with me;

rr: Ndyagira nta, Ruhanga ku ariimuka? Nari shi, ku yaakubimbuuza, nkaamugarukamu ki?
en: What then shall I do when God riseth up? And when he visiteth, what shall I answer him?

rr: Owampangire omu nda ya maawe, tiwe yaahangire n'ogwo? Owaatuhangire omu nda t'omwe?
en: Did not he that made me in the womb make him? And did not one fashion us in the womb?

rr: Hariho obu ndaimire omworo eki arikwetenga, Nari shi, okumara amatsiko amaisho g'omufakaazi?
en: If I have withheld the poor from their desire, Or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail;

rr: Nari hariho obu ndariire ak'okurya kangye nyenka, Efuuzi etakaboneho?
en: Or have eaten my morsel myself alone, And the fatherless hath not eaten thereof;

rr: Kureka okuruga omu butsigazi bwangye nkarera ogwo mworo nka ihse, N'omufaakazi nkamureeberera, okwiha obu naaruga omu nda ya maawe.
en: (For from my youth he was brought up with me, as with a father, And I have guided her from my mother's womb;)

rr: Ku ndaabe ndareebire omuntu naafa ahabw'okubura ekijwaro, Nari enshoberwa ebuzire eky'okweshweka
en: If I have seen any perish for want of clothing, Or any poor without covering;

rr: Nari obwezirikiro bwe butaransiimire, Kandi atamarwe mbeho oruhu rw'entaama zangye
en: If his loins have not blessed me, And if he were not warmed with the fleece of my sheep;

rr: Ku ndaabe ndabangiire efuuzi omukono, Ahabw'okureeba aha irembo orikugwera orubaju rwangye
en: If I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, When I saw my help in the gate:

rr: Eibega ryangye nirikataane n'orwano, N'omukono gwangye gukanyukuka omu ngingo!
en: Then let mine arm fall from my shoulder blade, And mine arm be broken from the bone.

rr: Ahabw'okuba ebihikiirizi ebirikuruga ahari Ruhanga bikaba biinyitsa obwoba, Kandi ndemwa kugumisiririza ekitiinisa kye ekingi.
en: For destruction from God was a terror to me, And by reason of his highness I could not endure.

rr: Ku ndaabe ndahindwire ezaabu amatsiko gangye, Nkagira ezaabu eshemeziibwe nti, Niiwe bwesigye bwangye
en: If I have made gold my hope, Or have said to the fine gold, Thou art my confidence;

rr: Ku ndaabe ndeesiimire ahabw'okugira eitungo ringi, Nari ahabw'omukono gwangye kutunga bingi
en: If I rejoiced because my wealth was great, And because mine hand had gotten much;

rr: Ku ndaabe ndahangire eizooba amaisho niryaka, Nari okwezi nikugyenda nikumurinkana
en: If I beheld the sun when it shined, Or the moon walking in brightness;

rr: Kandi omutima gwangye gukabeihwabeihwa bwesherekye, Akanwa kangye kakanywegyera engaro zangye
en: And my heart hath been secretly enticed, Or my mouth hath kissed my hand:

rr: Ekyo nakyo kikaabaire ekibi eky'okufubirwa mpemukire ahari Ruhanga ow'ahaiguru munonga.
en: This also were an iniquity to be punished by the judge: For I should have denied the God that is above.

rr: Hariho obu ndashemerereirwe okucwekyerera kw'orikuunyanga, Nari shi nkeesiima habw'akagwe akaamugwaho?
en: If I rejoiced at the destruction of him that hated me, Or lifted up myself when evil found him:

rr: (Ngaaha! tindarekire kanwa kangye kucumura, Ngu mmushabire okufa nimmukyeena.)
en: Neither have I suffered my mouth to sin By wishing a curse to his soul.

rr: Hariho obu ab'omu ka yangye batagira bati: N'oha omuriimwe otaarya nyama, akahaaga?
en: If the men of my tabernacle said not, Oh that we had of his flesh! we cannot be satisfied.

rr: (Tihariho mushuhuuki ou ndaraarize omu muhanda; Kureka nkaba nyigurira omuhinguzi weena.)
en: The stranger did not lodge in the street: But I opened my doors to the traveller.

rr: Ku ndaabe ndasherekire abantu okushiisha kwangye, Nkashereka omu kifuba okutahikiirira kwangye
en: If I covered my transgressions as Adam, By hiding mine iniquity in my bosom:

rr: Ahabw'okutiina munonga omutwe muhango gw'abantu, N'okutiina okugaywa ab'emiryango yaitu, Kikandeetera kuhunama n'omkutashohora
en: Did I fear a great multitude, Or did the contempt of families terrify me, That I kept silence, and went not out of the door?

rr: Nkaabasibwa ki, hagira owampurira! (Reeba, akamanyiso kangye nkaka!
en: Oh that one would hear me!

rr: Ow'obushoboorozi bwona angarukyemu, Naanye ndeebe ebirego ebihandiikirwe omubisha wangye.)
en: Behold, my desire is, that the Almighty would answer me, And that mine adversary had written a book.

rr: Buzimazima nkaabiheeka aha mabega, Mbijwara nk'ekirunga
en: Surely I would take it upon my shoulder, And bind it as a crown to me.

rr: Nkaamumanyisa ebi naakozire byona omu mitwarize yangye, Mmuhika haihi nk'omunyiginya.
en: I would declare unto him the number of my steps; As a prince would I go near unto him.

rr: Ekyaro kyangye ku kiraabe kirantabaarize, Entabire zaakyo zikaririra hamwe
en: If my land cry against me, Or that the furrows likewise thereof complain;

rr: Ku ndaabe ndariire omweru gwakyo ntaine u mpaire ebihembo, Nari shi nkareetera bakama baakyo kufa
en: If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money, Or have caused the owners thereof to lose their life:

rr: Amatojo nigakamere omu mwanya gw'engano, N'orumbugu rukamera omuri sayiri.
en: Let thistles grow instead of wheat, And cockle instead of barley.

rr: Ebigambo bya Yobu byagarukira aha.
en: The words of Job are ended.

rr: Batyo abo bantu bonshatu baarekyera aho kugarukamu Yobu, ahabw'okuba akaba naayemanya ku ahikiriire.
en: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.

rr: Bwanyima Elihu mwene Barakeeli, Omubuuzi ow'omu muryango gwa Raamu, yaagira ekiniga. Yaagirira Yobu ekiniga ahabw'okweyeta ohikiriire okukira Ruhanga
en: Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the kindred of Ram: against Job was his wrath kindled, because he justified himself rather than God.

rr: kandi yaakigirira na bagyenzi ba Yobu abo bonshatu, ahabw'okubura eky'okumugarukamu, n'ou baraabe bahamize ku ari omusiisi.
en: Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.

rr: Kwonka Elihu akaba ategyereize kugamba na Yobu, ahabw'okuba abo bakaba nibamukira obukuru.
en: Now Elihu had waited till Job had spoken, because they were elder than he.

rr: Elihu ku yaareebire abo bonshatu baabura eky'okugarukamu, yaagira ekiniga.
en: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, then his wrath was kindled.

rr: Atyo Elihu mwene Barakeeli Omubuuzi yaagira ati: Ndi muto; imwe muri abagurusi; Nikyo kindeeteire kutiina, ntarahukye kubamanyisa eki ndikuteekateeka
en: And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I am young, and ye are very old; Wherefore I was afraid, and durst not shew you mine opinion.

rr: Nkagira nti: Ka hagambe abaine ebiro bingi, Abamazire emyaka mingi babe nibo baayegyesa obwengye.
en: I said, Days should speak, And multitude of years should teach wisdom.

rr: Kwonka ekihaisa omuntu okwetegyereza N'omwoyo oguri omuriwe, omwitsyo gw'Ow'obushoboorozi bwona.
en: But there is a spirit in man: And the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding.

rr: Abahikire omu ngingo zaabukuru tibo baine bwengye, N'abagurusi tibo barikumanya by'oburyo.
en: Great men are not always wise: Neither do the aged understand judgment.

rr: Nikyo ndikugirira nti: Muntegye amatu, Naanye mbagambire ebi ndikuteekateeka.
en: Therefore I said, Hearken to me; I also will shew mine opinion.

rr: Reeba, mbaire ntegyereize ebigambo byanyu; Obu mubaire nimuteekateeka eby'okugamba, Naagira ngu, mpurire ebi muraagambe.
en: Behold, I waited for your words; I gave ear to your reasons, Whilst ye searched out what to say.

rr: Buzimazima ntaireho omutima kubahurira, Kwonka tihariho n'omwe omuriimwe oyemeize Yobu, N'obu kwakuba okugarukamu ebigambo bye.
en: Yea, I attended unto you, And, behold, there was none of you that convinced Job, Or that answered his words:

rr: Mwerinde, mutakaayekwatsa mukagira ngu: Niitwe tuzoirwe obwengye; Tihariho muntu owaakumubaasa, kureka akaabaasibwa Ruhanga.
en: Lest ye should say, We have found out wisdom: God thrusteth him down, not man.

rr: Manya, ebi agambire, tiinye ahakaniise; Naanye tindikwija kumugarukisamu ebyanyu.
en: Now he hath not directed his words against me: Neither will I answer him with your speeches.

rr: Bashobeirwe, tibakigarukamu, Tibaine ky'okugamba.
en: They were amazed, they answered no more: They left off speaking.

rr: Mbwenu mpuname, ngu niho batakiine ky'okugamba, Kureka okwemerera aho, bakabura eky'okugarukamu?
en: When I had waited, (for they spake not, But stood still, and answered no more;)

rr: Naanye niinyija kugira eki naagarukamu, Ngambe eki ndikuteekateeka
en: I said , I will answer also my part, I also will shew mine opinion.

rr: Ahabw'okuba nyine bingi munonga eby'okugamba; Omwoyo oguri omuriinye nigwo gurikungyema.
en: For I am full of matter, The spirit within me constraineth me.

rr: Reeba, omutima gwangye nigushusha viinyo etaine bwikizo, Nigwenda kubaruka nk'efurebe za viinyo y'omutahe.
en: Behold, my belly is as wine which hath no vent; It is ready to burst like new bottles.

rr: Ka ngambe, nyitsye; Nyashame, mbone kugarukamu.
en: I will speak, that I may be refreshed: I will open my lips and answer.

rr: Tindikwija kugwera rubaju rw'omuntu weena, N'obu kwakuba okugira ou naashunga
en: Let me not, I pray you, accept any man's person, Neither let me give flattering titles unto man.

rr: Ahabw'okuba timmanya kushunga; ku naakukikora, Omuhangi wangye akaanyita kitaraariire.
en: For I know not to give flattering titles; In so doing my Maker would soon take me away.

rr: Mbwenu, Yobu, ninkweshengyereza, hurira ebi ndikugamba; Ote omutima aha bigambo byangye byona.
en: Wherefore, Job, I pray thee, hear my speeches, And hearken to all my words.

rr: Reeba naayashama, Orurimi rw'omu kanwa kangye nirugamba
en: Behold, now I have opened my mouth, My tongue hath spoken in my mouth.

rr: Ebigambo byangye nibyoreka ku omutima gwangye gugororokire, Kandi ebi ndikumanya nibyo eminwa yangye eraagambe etaine buryarya.
en: My words shall be of the uprightness of my heart: And my lips shall utter knowledge clearly.

rr: Omwoyo wa Ruhanga niwe yampangire, N'omwityso gw'Ow'obushoboorozi bwona nigwo gumpa amagara.
en: The Spirit of God hath made me, And the breath of the Almighty hath given me life.

rr: Ku oraabe noobaasa, ngarukamu; Tebeekanisa gye ebigambo byawe omu maisho gangye, oyemerere aho.
en: If thou canst answer me, Set thy words in order before me, stand up.

rr: Reeba, omu maisho ga Ruhanga nyowe naiwe nitwingana; Naanye nkahangwa omu itaka.
en: Behold, I am according to thy wish in God's stead: I also am formed out of the clay.

rr: Reeba, omuriinye tiharimu kirikutiinisa ekishemereire kukwitsa obwoba; Tindikwija kukurusya.
en: Behold, my terror shall not make thee afraid, Neither shall my hand be heavy upon thee.

rr: Buzimazima, ebi obaire noogamba, mbihuriire, N'eiraka ryabyo ryampika omu matu.
en: Surely thou hast spoken in mine hearing, And I have heard the voice of thy words, saying ,

rr: Noogira oti: Ndi mwere, tiinyine ki nshobize; Ndi oshemeire, kandi omuriinye tiharimu kutahikiirira
en: I am clean without transgression, I am innocent; neither is there iniquity in me.

rr: Kwonka Ruhanga aine ahu aihire kundwanisa, Nanteekateekaho nk'omuzigu we
en: Behold, he findeth occasions against me, He counteth me for his enemy,

rr: Ata ebigyere byangye omu nkomo, Aguma ataire eriisho aha mihanda yangye yoona.
en: He putteth my feet in the stocks, He marketh all my paths.

rr: Reeba, ka nkugarukyemu, omuri ebyo tohikire; ahakuba Ruhanga ni mukuru okukira omuntu.
en: Behold, in this thou art not just: I will answer thee, that God is greater than man.

rr: Ahabw'enki noomuhakanisa, noogira oti: Tarikwija kugarukamu kigambo kyangye na kimwe?
en: Why dost thou strive against him? For he giveth not account of any of his matters.

rr: Ahakuba Ruhanga agamba omu muringo gumwe nari ebiri, N'obu omuntu araabe atakyetaho
en: For God speaketh once, Yea twice, yet man perceiveth it not.

rr: Omu kirooto, omu kworekwa nyekiro, Abantu bahirwayo, bagwejegyereire omu bitanda byabo.
en: In a dream, in a vision of the night, When deep sleep falleth upon men, In slumberings upon the bed;

rr: Obwo nibwo aiguru amatu g'abantu, akabatiinisa naabahana
en: Then he openeth the ears of men, And sealeth their instruction,

rr: Ngu abone kuzibira omuntu ebi arikwenda kukoa, N'okumumaramu amaryo.
en: That he may withdraw man from his purpose, And hide pride from man.

rr: Ruhanga azibira omutima gwe kugwa omu Kiina, N'amagara ge kumarwaho rurara.
en: He keepeth back his soul from the pit, And his life from perishing by the sword.

rr: Kandi omuntu ahanwa obusaasi ari aha kitanda kye, N'omu magufa ge haguma harimu orugamba
en: He is chastened also with pain upon his bed, And the multitude of his bones with strong pain:

rr: Bireetera amagara ge kutamwa eby'okurya; N'obu byakuba ebirikunura munonga tabigirira ifa.
en: So that his life abhorreth bread, And his soul dainty meat.

rr: Enyama zimuhwa aha magufa, zibura kureebwa; N'amagufa ge, agaabaire gatarikureebwa, gatunama.
en: His flesh is consumed away, that it cannot be seen; And his bones that were not seen stick out.

rr: Omwoyo gwe gwiririra Ekiina, N'amagara ge gairirira abahwerekyerezi.
en: Yea, his soul draweth near unto the grave, And his life to the destroyers.

rr: Ku akubonekyerwa maraika w'okumutonganira, Nangwa omwe wenka omuri rukumi ow'okumumanyisa ebimushemereire
en: If there be a messenger with him, An interpreter, one among a thousand, To shew unto man his uprightness:

rr: Yaamugirira embabazi naagira ati: Mujune, atagwa omu Kiina; ndeebire, eky'okumucungura.
en: Then he is gracious unto him, and saith, Deliver him from going down to the pit: I have found a ransom.

rr: Omubiri gwe gugarukye gube muto nk'ogw'omwana, Agire amaani nk'agu yaabaire aine omu butsigazi bwe.
en: His flesh shall be fresher than a child's: He shall return to the days of his youth:

rr: -24 ; Obwo nibwo omuntu yaakushaba Ruhanga, akamwakiira, Akaija ah'ari n'okushemererwa, Akagambira abantu eby'okujuna kwe
en: He shall pray unto God, and he will be favourable unto him: And he shall see his face with joy: For he will render unto man his righteousness.

rr: Akeeshongorera omu maisho g'abantu, Akagira ati: Nkashiisha, naakiikamya ebyabaire bihikire, tinaabiturwa
en: He looketh upon men, and if any say, I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, And it profited me not;

rr: Kureka yaacungura omwoyo gwangye, tigwaza mu Kiina; N'amagara gangye garyareeba omushana.
en: He will deliver his soul from going into the pit, And his life shall see the light.

rr: Ngu abone kwiha omwoyo gwe omu Kiina, Ngu areebe omushana gw'amagara.
en: To bring back his soul from the pit, To be enlightened with the light of the living.

rr: Nyaabura 'we, Yobu, tega amatu, ompurire; Ohuname, ngambe.
en: Mark well, O Job, hearken unto me: Hold thy peace, and I will speak.

rr: Ku oraabe oine eki orikugamba, ngarukamu; Gamba; ahabw'okuba niinye nda kukwihaho orubanja.
en: If thou hast any thing to say, answer me: Speak, for I desire to justify thee.

rr: Ku oraabe otakiine, ntega okutu; Ohuname, nkuhabure obwengye.
en: If not, hearken unto me: Hold thy peace, and I shall teach thee wisdom.

rr: Bwanyima Elihu yaagaruka yaagira ati
en: Furthermore Elihu answered and said,

rr: Imwe banyabwengye 'mwe, nimuhurire ebigambo byangye; Imwe abaine okumanya, muntegye amatu
en: Hear my words, O ye wise men ; And give ear unto me, ye that have knowledge.

rr: Ahabw'okuba okutu kutaanisa ebigambo, Nk'oku orurimi rumanya eby'okurya.
en: For the ear trieth words, As the mouth tasteth meat.

rr: Ka tutoorane ebihikire, Tweyihiremu ekirungi
en: Let us choose to us judgment: Let us know among ourselves what is good.

rr: Ahakuba Yobu agizire ati: Ndi ohikiriire, Ruhanga anyihireho ebinshemereire.
en: For Job hath said, I am righteous: And God hath taken away my judgment.

rr: N'obu ndaabe mpikiriire, niinyetwa omunyakishuba, Obuhuta bwangye tiburikutambwa, n'obu ndaabe ntaine kicumuro.
en: Should I lie against my right? My wound is incurable without transgression.

rr: Ni muntu ki ori nka Yobu, Orikugotomera okugaya nk'amaizi
en: What man is like Job, Who drinketh up scorning like water?

rr: Akagyenda n'ebigombe by'enkozi z'ebibi, Naakwatanisa n'abantu babi.
en: Which goeth in company with the workers of iniquity, And walketh with wicked men.

rr: Ahakuba agizire ati: okushemerererwa omuri Ruhanga Tikwine ki kurikugasira omuntu.
en: For he hath said, It profiteth a man nothing That he should delight himself with God.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo mumpurire, imwe bantu abarikwetegyereza 'mwe, Nikikabure Ruhanga okukora ebitahikire, O'owobushoboorozi bwona okukora kubi!
en: Therefore hearken unto me, ye men of understanding: Far be it from God, that he should do wickedness; And from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.

rr: Ahakuba aryazimuurira omuntu, nk'oku emirimo ye eri, Kandi amareetere okuhikwaho ebishemereire emitwarize ye.
en: For the work of a man shall he render unto him, And cause every man to find according to his ways.

rr: Buzimazima Ruhanga tarikora kubi, O'wobushoboorozi bwona tariita manja.
en: Yea, surely God will not do wickedly, Neither will the Almighty pervert judgment.

rr: N'oha owaamukwatsize ensi kugitegyeka? Nari shi n'oha owaamwekoreize ensi yoona?
en: Who hath given him a charge over the earth? Or who hath disposed the whole world?

rr: Ku yaakwaka abantu omwoyo gwe, Yaayegarurira omwitsyo gwe
en: If he set his heart upon man, If he gather unto himself his spirit and his breath;

rr: Abaine omubiri boona bakaacwekererera hamwe, Omuntu agaruka omu mucuucu.
en: All flesh shall perish together, And man shall turn again unto dust.

rr: Ku oraabe nooyetegyereza, hurira eki, Otegye okutu eki ndikugamba.
en: If now thou hast understanding, hear this: Hearken to the voice of my words.

rr: Noogira ngu orikwanga obwinganisa, aryategyeka? Okaacwera Ohikiriire kandi Ow'obushoboorozi orubanja kumusinga
en: Shall even he that hateth right govern? And wilt thou condemn him that is most just?

rr: Kihikire okugira omugabe oti: Toine mugasho, N'abakungu oti: Muri babi!
en: Is it fit to say to a king, Thou art wicked? and to princes, Ye are ungodly?

rr: Otagwera orubaju rw'abanyiginya, N'obu kwakuba okweta aha batungi okukira abooro, Haza boona yaabahangire n'emikono ye?
en: How much less to him that accepteth not the persons of princes, Nor regardeth the rich more than the poor? For they all are the work of his hands.

rr: Bafa omu kaanya kakye, N'omu itumbi abantu batema, bagyenderayo, Ab'amaani baihwaho, bataihirweho mukono gw'omuntu.
en: In a moment shall they die, And the people shall be troubled at midnight, and pass away: And the mighty shall be taken away without hand.

rr: Manya, amaisho ge atuura agataire aha mitwarize y'omuntu, Kandi ayetegyereza emigyendere ye yoona.
en: For his eyes are upon the ways of man, And he seeth all his goings.

rr: Tihariho mwirima, n'obu kyakuba ekibunda kya rufu, Ahu enkozi z'ebibi zaakubaasa kweshereka.
en: There is no darkness, nor shadow of death, Where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.

rr: Ahabw'okuba Ruhanga tarikwetenga kugaruka kwetegyereza omuntu, Ataikaizire mu maisho ge kucwerwa orubanja.
en: For he will not lay upon man more than right ; That he should enter into judgment with God.

rr: Ahendagura ab'amaani atabuurize, Ata abandi omu myanya yaabo.
en: He shall break in pieces mighty men without number, And set others in their stead.

rr: Ahabw'okumanya atyo ebi barikukora, Abajuumika nyekiro, bacwekyerera.
en: Therefore he knoweth their works, And he overturneth them in the night, so that they are destroyed.

rr: Abateerera omu maisho g'abantu, Naabatura obubi bwabo
en: He striketh them as wicked men In the open sight of others;

rr: Ahabw'okuba bakateishuka, baareka kumukurata, Baayanga kuta omutima aha mihanda ye yoona.
en: Because they turned back from him, And would not consider any of his ways:

rr: Batyo baamuhitsyaho okutaka kw'abooro, Yaahurira okutaka kw'abarikubonabonesibwea.
en: So that they cause the cry of the poor to come unto him, And he heareth the cry of the afflicted.

rr: Ku yaakuha obusingye, n'oha owaakureeta okujagarara? Ku yaakushereka ah'amaisho ge, n'oha owaakumureeba, Yaaba ihanga, nari omuntu?
en: When he giveth quietness, who then can make trouble? And when he hideth his face, who then can behold him? Whether it be done against a nation, or against a man only:

rr: Ngu omuntu otarikutiina Ruhanga arekye kutegyeka, Akanaga abantu omu mutego.
en: That the hypocrite reign not, Lest the people be ensnared.

rr: Mbwenu hariho oragizire Ruhanga ati: Mpanirwe; tindigaruka kucumura
en: Surely it is meet to be said unto God, I have borne chastisement , I will not offend any more:

rr: Eki ntarikureeba, kiinyegyese; Ku ndaabe naakozire kubi, tindigarukira?
en: That which I see not teach thou me: If I have done iniquity, I will do no more.

rr: Noogira ngu ahabw'okwanga ekifubiro kya Ruhanga, Aryakuzimuurira nk'oku orikwenda? Manya niiwe oshemereire kwihamu eki orikwenda, tiinye. N'ahabw'ekyo gamba eki orikumanya.
en: Should it be according to thy mind? He will recompense it, whether thou refuse, Or whether thou choose; and not I: Therefore speak what thou knowest.

rr: Abantu abarikwetegyereza, n'omunyabwenge weena orikumpurira, Nabaija kugira bati
en: Let men of understanding tell me, And let a wise man hearken unto me.

rr: Yobu naagamba ebi atarikumanya, Ebigambo bye tibirimu bwengye.
en: Job hath spoken without knowledge, And his words were without wisdom.

rr: Nkaahenwa ki, Yobu agyezibwa okuhika aha muheru, Ahakuba naagarukamu nk'oku ababi bagarukamu.
en: My desire is that Job may be tried unto the end Because of his answers for wicked men.

rr: Ahabw'okuba naayongyera obugomi aha kibi kye, Atuteerera engaro naatuhena, Agamba ebigambo bingi eby'okuhakanisa Ruhanga.
en: For he addeth rebellion unto his sin, He clappeth his hands among us, And multiplieth his words against God.

rr: Elihu yaagaruka yaagira ati
en: Elihu spake moreover, and said,

rr: Noogira ngu ekigambo eki kihikire, Iwe okugira oti: Okuhikiirira kwangye nikukira okwa Ruhanga
en: Thinkest thou this to be right, That thou saidst, My righteousness is more than God's?

rr: N'okubuuza okabuuza oti: Nikingasira ki? Noogira ngu hati ndi gye okukira oku naakubaire ndi, kuri naasiisire?
en: For thou saidst, What advantage will it be unto thee? And , What profit shall I have, if I be cleansed from my sin?

rr: Naaza kukugarukamu hamwe na bagyenzi baawe.
en: I will answer thee, And thy companions with thee.

rr: Ta amaisho ahaiguru, oreebe, Oyetegyereze ebicu, ebiri ahaiguru munonga okukukira.
en: Look unto the heavens, and see; And behold the clouds which are higher than thou.

rr: Ku oraabe waasiisire, oine eki omwitsize? N'eby'okushiisha byawe, ku biraabe bikanyire, biine oku bimugizire?
en: If thou sinnest, what doest thou against him? Or if thy transgressions be multiplied, what doest thou unto him?

rr: Ku ohikiriire, omuhaire ki? Nari shi, ahairwe ki ekirugire omu ngaro zaawe?
en: If thou be righteous, what givest thou him? Or what receiveth he of thine hand?

rr: Ebibi byawe nibisaasa omuntu-buntu nkaiwe, Kandi okuhikiirira kwawe nikugasira omwana w'omuntu.
en: Thy wickedness may hurt a man as thou art ; And thy righteousness may profit the son of man.

rr: Abantu batakisibwa okwitwa kubi okurengyesereize, Bashaba kuheebwa emikono ahabw'okuhata ab'obushoboorozi.
en: By reason of the multitude of oppressions they make the oppressed to cry: They cry out by reason of the arm of the mighty.

rr: Kwonka tihariho orikugira ati: Ruhanga Omuhangi wangye arahi, Oreetera abantu kweshongora nyekiro
en: But none saith, Where is God my maker, Who giveth songs in the night;

rr: Otwegyesa bingi tukakira enyamaishwa z'omu nsi, Kandi otuha obwengye okukira enyonyi z'omu mwanya?
en: Who teacheth us more than the beasts of the earth, And maketh us wiser than the fowls of heaven?

rr: Okwo niyo batakira, kwonka atabagarukyemu, Ahabw'amaryo g'abantu babi.
en: There they cry, but none giveth answer, Because of the pride of evil men.

rr: N'ekya buzima Ruhanga tahurira barikurizibwa busha, Kandi Ow'obushoboorozi bwona tabyetaho
en: Surely God will not hear vanity, Neither will the Almighty regard it.

rr: Kaashwa iwe orikugira ngu tomureeba, Orubanja rwawe ruri omu maisho ge, Kandi ngu omutegyereize!
en: Although thou sayest thou shalt not see him, Yet judgment is before him; therefore trust thou in him.

rr: Mbwenu, nk'oku atahanisa kiniga, Kandi nk'oku ateeta ha banyamaryo
en: But now, because it is not so , he hath visited in his anger; Yet he knoweth it not in great extremity:

rr: Nikyo Yobu arikugambira busha, Akafukunkuka ebigambo bitarimu bwengye.
en: Therefore doth Job open his mouth in vain; He multiplieth words without knowledge.

rr: Currently Selected: Yobu 35 : RR64 Highlight Share <div class="flex w-full items-center gap-1 rtl:flex-row-reverse hover
Kandi Elihu yaagumizamu naagira ati
en: Elihu also proceeded, and said,

rr: Ngumisiririza kakye, nkworekye, Ahakuba nkiine ebi ndikwenda kugamba ahabwa Ruhanga.
en: Suffer me a little, and I will shew thee That I have yet to speak on God's behalf.

rr: Niinyija kureeta obwengye bwangye, mbwihe hare, Ngambe nimpamya ku Omuhangi wangye ahikiriire
en: I will fetch my knowledge from afar, And will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.

rr: Ahabw'okuba buzima ebigambo byangye ti bishuba; Oine okumanya okuhikire ari hamwe naiwe.
en: For truly my words shall not be false: He that is perfect in knowledge is with thee.

rr: Reeba, Ruhanga n'ow'amaani, kandi tagira u agaya; N'ow'obushoboorozi, kandi amaani ge gari omu kwetegyereza.
en: Behold, God is mighty, and despiseth not any : He is mighty in strength and wisdom.

rr: Tagumyaho mubi, Kwonka abarikubonabona abaha ebibashemereire.
en: He preserveth not the life of the wicked: But giveth right to the poor.

rr: Taiha maisho ge aha bahikiriire, Kureka abashutamya n'abagabe aha bitebe obutarugaho, batunguuka.
en: He withdraweth not his eyes from the righteous: But with kings are they on the throne; Yea, he doth establish them for ever, and they are exalted.

rr: Kandi ku bakomwa omu mihama, Baakwatwa emirunga y'okubonabona
en: And if they be bound in fetters, And be holden in cords of affliction;

rr: Atyo abooreka ebi baakozire n'ebicumuro byabo, Kuhamya ku baabikoreise amaryo.
en: Then he sheweth them their work, And their transgressions that they have exceeded.

rr: Aigura amatu gaabo, kuhurira ebirikwegyesibwa, Abaragiira kuruga omu kutahikiirira.
en: He openeth also their ear to discipline, And commandeth that they return from iniquity.

rr: Ku bamuhurira, baamuheereza, Bamara ebiro byabo omu kugogyera, N'emyaka yaabo bagimara bagwirwe gye.
en: If they obey and serve him , They shall spend their days in prosperity, And their years in pleasures.

rr: Kwonka ku banga kuhurira, bamarwaho na rurara, Bafa bataine kibamanyire.
en: But if they obey not, they shall perish by the sword, And they shall die without knowledge.

rr: Abatatiina Ruhanga mu mitima yaabo beebiikira ekiniga, Ku ababoha, tibataka ngu bahwerwe.
en: But the hypocrites in heart heap up wrath: They cry not when he bindeth them.

rr: Bafa bahenderwa omunyeeto, N'omuheru gw'amagara gaabo guba okuhemuka.
en: They die in youth, And their life is among the unclean.

rr: -28 ; . Ruhnaga ajuna abarikubonabonesibwa naaraba omu kubonaboona kwabo, Aigura amatu gaabo ahabw'okureeba enaku.
en: He delivereth the poor in his affliction, And openeth their ears in oppression.

rr: N'ekya buzima, akaabaire akwihire omu naku, Akutaire ahagarami ahatafunzire, Haza ebyakutairwe ahameeza yaawe biba eby'ebishaju.
en: Even so would he have removed thee out of the strait Into a broad place, where there is no straitness; And that which should be set on thy table should be full of fatness.

rr: Kwonka omutima gwawe tigubamu kindi kureka okucwera ababi emanja; Mbwenu orubanja rw'oburyo orukushemereire rwakukwata.
en: But thou hast fulfilled the judgment of the wicked: Judgment and justice take hold on thee .

rr: Oyerinde ekiniga kitakaakureetera okwemanya; 36:18 Nari, Ekicunguro kihango kikakuteishura omuhanga. Okubonabona kwawe kwingi kukakuteishura omuhanda.
en: Because there is wrath, beware lest he take thee away with his stroke: Then a great ransom cannot deliver thee.

rr: Noogira ngu obutungi bwawe n'obushoboorozi bw'amaani gaawe bwona Nibiija kukumara, bikuzibire kureeba enaku?
en: Will he esteem thy riches? no , not gold, Nor all the forces of strength.

rr: Oteetenga ekyo kiro kuhika, Eki amahanga gaihirwaho, gakacwekyerezibwa.
en: Desire not the night, When people are cut off in their place.

rr: Oyerinde, orekye kuta amaisho aha kutahikiirira; Ahakuba otooraine kutwaza otyo, okukira okubonabona.
en: Take heed, regard not iniquity: For this hast thou chosen rather than affliction.

rr: Reeba, Ruhanga ahimbisibwa ahabw'obushoboorozi bwe. N'oha oyegyesa nkawe?
en: Behold, God exalteth by his power: Who teacheth like him?

rr: N'oha oramuhabwire oku ashemereire kutwza? Nari shi n'oha owaakumugira ati: Waashobya.
en: Who hath enjoined him his way? Or who can say, Thou hast wrought iniquity?

rr: Ijuka kusingiza omurimo gwe, Ogu abantu baabaire beeshongoraho.
en: Remember that thou magnify his work, Which men behold.

rr: Abantu boona bakaba bagureeba, Omuntu agwetegyerereza hare.
en: Every man may see it; Man may behold it afar off.

rr: Reeba, Ruhanga ni mukuru, kwonka itwe titumumanya; Emyaka ye terikubaasa kubarwa
en: Behold, God is great, and we know him not, Neither can the number of his years be searched out.

rr: Ahakuba ainamura amatondo g'amaizi, gaba ekicu, Akihindura enjura
en: For he maketh small the drops of water: They pour down rain according to the vapour thereof:

rr: Ehiika ahaiguru, ekasheesheka ahansi, Ekateera abantu, ekagwa nyingi munonga.
en: Which the clouds do drop And distil upon man abundantly.

rr: Hariho owaakubaasa kumanya oku ebicu bibuga hoona, N'oku okuhinda kuhindira omu ihema rya Ruhanga?
en: Also can any understand the spreadings of the clouds, Or the noise of his tabernacle?

rr: Reeba, ashashaanura omushana, gumwehinguririza, Kandi ashweka emizi y'enyanja.
en: Behold, he spreadeth his light upon it, And covereth the bottom of the sea.

rr: Ahabw'okuba ebyo nibyo acwisa emanja z'amahanga, Kandi nibyo ahaisa abantu eby'okurya bingi munonga.
en: For by them judgeth he the people; He giveth meat in abundance.

rr: Engaro ze azishweka enkuba, Agiragiira; ahi yaagiragiira, ehateera.
en: With clouds he covereth the light; And commandeth it not to shine by the cloud that cometh betwixt.

rr: Okuhinda kwayo kumanyisa ebye, Kandi kumanyisa enyamaishwa ku eihunga ryaza kwija.
en: The noise thereof sheweth concerning it, The cattle also concerning the vapour.

rr: Kandi ebi nabyo bireetera omutima gwangye Kutetema n'okwesikura.
en: At this also my heart trembleth, And is moved out of his place.

rr: Yeimwe, nimuhurire okuhinda kw'eiraka rye, Okurikurigitira omu kanwa ke.
en: Hear attentively the noise of his voice, And the sound that goeth out of his mouth.

rr: Akwohereza kubuga eiguru ryona, N'okutyankana kw'emirabyo ye kuhika aha muheru gw'ensi.
en: He directeth it under the whole heaven, And his lightning unto the ends of the earth.

rr: -9 ; 68:33 . Bwanyima yaayo eiraka rye rihinda, Arigitsa eiraka ry'ekitiinisa kye, Eiraka rye ku rihurirwa, tazibira nkuba.
en: After it a voice roareth: He thundereth with the voice of his excellency; And he will not stay them when his voice is heard.

rr: Ruhanga ahindisa eiraka rye omu buryo bw'okutangaaza, Akora ebikuru ebi tutarikubaasa kushoboorora
en: God thundereth marvellously with his voice; Great things doeth he, which we cannot comprehend.

rr: Ahabw'okuba agambira ebirika ati: Gwa ahansi, Kandi agira orutoonyerera n'enjura ati: Mugire amaani.
en: For he saith to the snow, Be thou on the earth; Likewise to the small rain, And to the great rain of his strength.

rr: Azibira abantu kukora, Ngu boona bamanye ebi arikukora.
en: He sealeth up the hand of every man; That all men may know his work.

rr: Obwo enyamaishwa zitaaha omu bweshereko bwazo, Ziguma omu nyanga zaazo
en: Then the beasts go into dens, And remain in their places.

rr: Omuyaga gw'akasooroora gureetwa obukiizi-bwa-buryo, N'embeho eruga aha bukiizi-bwa-bumosho.
en: Out of the south cometh the whirlwind: And cold out of the north.

rr: Ahabw'omwitsyo gwa Ruhanga amaizi gakwata, N'ebiyanja bikwata okuhika ahi birikugarukira.
en: By the breath of God frost is given: And the breadth of the waters is straitened.

rr: Ekicu kikwaitse akiijuza amaizi, Abamba ebicu ebirimu enkuba ze.
en: Also by watering he wearieth the thick cloud: He scattereth his bright cloud:

rr: Biguma nibyehinguririza ahabw'okwebembera kwe, Ngu bibone kuhikiiriza eki arikubiragiira kukora kyona Omu nsi etuurwamu abantu.
en: And it is turned round about by his counsels: That they may do whatsoever he commandeth them Upon the face of the world in the earth.

rr: Eki abiikiririza kubaho, n'ahabw'okuhana, Nari ahabw'ensi ye, nari ahabw'embabazi ze.
en: He causeth it to come, whether for correction, or for his land, or for mercy.

rr: Iwe Yobu, hurira ebi; ba orekire, Obanze oteekateekye aha mirimo ya Ruhanga erikutangaaza.
en: Hearken unto this, O Job: Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.

rr: Noomanya oku Ruhanga ateeraho ebicu bye ebiragiro, Akaragiira omurabyo gwe kubityankaniramu?
en: Dost thou know when God disposed them, And caused the light of his cloud to shine?

rr: Nari shi noomanya okuzeereera kw'ebicu, Ku guri omurimo ogurikutangaaza ogw'Ogwo oine okumanya okuhikire
en: Dost thou know the balancings of the clouds, The wondrous works of him which is perfect in knowledge?

rr: Iwe, ou ebijwaro bitagata, Ensi ku egira obucureera ahabw'omuyaga gw'obukizi-bwa-buryo?
en: How thy garments are warm, When he quieteth the earth by the south wind?

rr: Noobaasa kubamba eiguru nkawe, Erigumire nk'endeeberwamu eheesirwe?
en: Hast thou with him spread out the sky, Which is strong, and as a molten looking glass?

rr: Twegyese ebi turaamugambire; Ahabw'okuba titurikubaasa kutebeekanisa bigambo byaitu ahabw'omwirima.
en: Teach us what we shall say unto him; For we cannot order our speech by reason of darkness.

rr: Akaagambirwa ku ndikwenda kugamba nawe? Hariho omuntu oyenda kumirirwa kimwe?
en: Shall it be told him that I speak? If a man speak, surely he shall be swallowed up.

rr: Kandi na hati abantu tibarikubaasa kureeba omushana ogurikumurinkana omu iguru Omuyaga gwaheza kuhinguraho, gwayeruuraho ebicu.
en: And now men see not the bright light Which is in the clouds: But the wind passeth, and cleanseth them.

rr: Aha bukiizi-bwa-bumosho harugayo okumurinkana nk'okw'ezaabu; Ruhanga ajwaire ekitiinisa kirikwitsa obwoba.
en: Fair weather cometh out of the north: With God is terrible majesty.

rr: Ow'obushoboorozi bwona titurikubaasa kumwetegyereza, Rugambwa omu bushoboorozi, taita manja, Kandi omu kuhikiirira kwe okuhikire taribonabonesa.
en: Touching the Almighty, we cannot find him out: He is excellent in power, and in judgment, And in plenty of justice: he will not afflict.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo abantu bamutiina; Kandi tayeta ha muntu weena orikweyeta omunyabwengye.
en: Men do therefore fear him: He respecteth not any that are wise of heart.

en: Currently Selected: Job 37 : KJV Highlight Share <path d="M5 12a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h3a1 1 0 1 1 0 2H6a1 1 0 0 1-1-1ZM5 15a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h3a1 1 0 1

rr: Bwanyima MUKAMA yaagarukamu Yobu omu muyaga mwingi gw'akasooroora ati
en: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said,

rr: Ogu n'oha orikugamba ebigambo ebitarimu bwengye, Ebirikushereka enaama?
en: Who is this that darkeneth counsel By words without knowledge?

rr: Yezirikye mashaija, Naaza kukubuuza, naiwe ongarukyemu.
en: Gird up now thy loins like a man; For I will demand of thee, and answer thou me.

rr: -29 ; 30:4 ; Obu naataho omusingi gw'ensi, okaba orahi? Ku oraabe nooyetegyereza, ngambira.
en: Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if thou hast understanding.

rr: N'oha owaataireho orugyero rwayo, ku oraabe noomumanya? Nari shi, owaagigyereise omugoye n'oha?
en: Who hath laid the measures thereof, if thou knowest? Or who hath stretched the line upon it?

rr: Omusingi gwayo gukabyarwa ahari ki, Nari shi, owaataireho eibaare ry'obuhamizo n'oha
en: Whereupon are the foundations thereof fastened? Or who laid the corner stone thereof;

rr: Obu enyonyoozi z'akasheeshe zaayeshongorera hamwe, N'abaana ba Ruhanga boona bakateera akaari k'okushemererwa?
en: When the morning stars sang together, And all the sons of God shouted for joy?

rr: N'oha owaacungiire enyanja n'enyigi, Obu yaatimbira omu nda y'ensi
en: Or who shut up the sea with doors, When it brake forth, as if it had issued out of the womb?

rr: Obu naakora ebicu kuba ekujwaro kyayo, N'omwirima ndindindi gukaba engozi yaayo
en: When I made the cloud the garment thereof, And thick darkness a swaddlingband for it,

rr: Nkagiteeraho obugarukiro, Nkataho empimbi n'enyigi
en: And brake up for it my decreed place , And set bars and doors,

rr: Kandi nkagira nti: Garukira aha, otariharenga; Aha niho ebingonzi byawe by'amaryo biricungirirwa?
en: And said, Hitherto shalt thou come, but no further: And here shall thy proud waves be stayed?

rr: Waaba kubaho, oraragiire akasheeshe, Kandi oramanyiise omushekye omwanya gwagwo
en: Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days; And caused the dayspring to know his place;

rr: Gukabona kukwata enshonda z'ensi, Okakunkumura ababi abagirimu?
en: That it might take hold of the ends of the earth, That the wicked might be shaken out of it?

rr: Ensi ehinduka, eba nk'eibumba eritairweho akamanyiso, N'ebintu byona bireebeka nk'ebijwaro byayo.
en: It is turned as clay to the seal; And they stand as a garment.

rr: -17 ; . Ababi baimwe omushana, N'emikono yaabo ebangire ehendeka.
en: And from the wicked their light is withholden, And the high arm shall be broken.

rr: Orahikire okuzimu omu nshuro z'enyanja, Nari oragyendeire okuzimu ahagati y'enyanja?
en: Hast thou entered into the springs of the sea? Or hast thou walked in the search of the depth?

rr: Orashuuruuriirwe amarembo ga rufu, Nari orareebire amarembo g'ekibunda kyayo?
en: Have the gates of death been opened unto thee? Or hast thou seen the doors of the shadow of death?

rr: Oramanyire obuhango bw'ensi? Ku oraabe noomanya ebyo byona, bigambe.
en: Hast thou perceived the breadth of the earth? Declare if thou knowest it all.

rr: Omuhanda ogurikuza ahu omushanga gutuura, gurahi, Kandi omwirima gwo gutaaha hi
en: Where is the way where light dwelleth? And as for darkness, where is the place thereof,

rr: Obone kugutwara omu nsi yaagwo, N'okumanya emihanda erikuza omu ka yaagwo?
en: That thou shouldest take it to the bound thereof, And that thou shouldest know the paths to the house thereof?

rr: Eego noobimanya, ahabw'okuba okaba waazairwe, N'ebiro byawe bikaba byabaire baingi!
en: Knowest thou it , because thou wast then born? Or because the number of thy days is great?

rr: Hariho obu orahikire omu mabiikiro g'ebirika? Nari shi, orareebire ahu orubaare rubiikwa
en: Hast thou entered into the treasures of the snow? Or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail,

rr: Oru naabiikiire ebiro by'enaku, Kurukoresa omu biro by'orugamba n'obweme?
en: Which I have reserved against the time of trouble, Against the day of battle and war?

rr: Omushana ku guba nigugyenda, gutoora muhanda ki? Nari shi, omuyaga gw'oburugwa-izooba guraba hi, niguza kutaataanira omu nsi?
en: By what way is the light parted, Which scattereth the east wind upon the earth?

rr: N'oha oracwereire enjura emikura, Akaha omurabyo gw'enkuba omuhanda
en: Who hath divided a watercourse for the overflowing of waters, Or a way for the lightning of thunder;

rr: Okugwisa enjura aha nsi etarimu bantu, Omu ihamba eritatuurwamu
en: To cause it to rain on the earth, where no man is ; On the wilderness, wherein there is no man;

rr: Okuhaazya eitaka ry'amatongo eririmu busha, Ngu ribone kumera obunyaatsi bw'oruhiira?
en: To satisfy the desolate and waste ground ; And to cause the bud of the tender herb to spring forth?

rr: Noogira ngu enjura egira isheyo, Nari n'oha owaazaire amatondo g'orume?
en: Hath the rain a father? Or who hath begotten the drops of dew?

rr: Amaizi gakwataine gakaruga omu nda y'oha? Kandi n'oha owaazaire embeho y'enyababa?
en: Out of whose womb came the ice? And the hoary frost of heaven, who hath gendered it?

rr: Amaizi gakwata gaba nk'eibaare, N'aha mutwe gw'amaizi hakwata.
en: The waters are hid as with a stone, And the face of the deep is frozen.

rr: Okaabaasa kuboherana enyonyoozi za Kakaaga n'enjegyere, Nari shi okuyuzya emirunga ya Orioni?
en: Canst thou bind the sweet influences of Pleiades, Or loose the bands of Orion?

rr: Noobasa kushohoza Mazaroosi omu bunaku bwazo, Nari shi noobaasa kwebembera Arukutuuro n'abaana baayo?
en: Canst thou bring forth Mazzaroth in his season? Or canst thou guide Arcturus with his sons?

rr: Noomaya ebiragiro ebirikutegyeka eiguru? Noobaasa kuhamya obutegyeki bwaryo aha nsi?
en: Knowest thou the ordinances of heaven? Canst thou set the dominion thereof in the earth?

rr: Noobaasa kwimutsya eiraka ryawe, rikahika omu bicu, Ngu amaizi gakweshukyera?
en: Canst thou lift up thy voice to the clouds, That abundance of waters may cover thee?

rr: Noobaasa kwohereza enkuba, ngu zigyende, Zikakwetaba zitakagyenzire ziti: Turi aha?
en: Canst thou send lightnings, that they may go, And say unto thee, Here we are?

rr: N'oha owaataire obwengye omu bicu, Nari owaahaire oruho okwetegyereza?
en: Who hath put wisdom in the inward parts? Or who hath given understanding to the heart?

rr: N'oha orikubaasa kubara ebicu ahabw'obwengye bwe? N'oha orikubaasa kushuka amaizi g'omu furebe z'ahaiguru
en: Who can number the clouds in wisdom? Or who can stay the bottles of heaven,

rr: Obu omucuucu guba ebyondo, N'ebitaka bikakwatana?
en: When the dust groweth into hardness, And the clods cleave fast together?

rr: Okaabaasa kugira eki waahiigira entare, Nari okumara emigunju y'entare eifa
en: Wilt thou hunt the prey for the lion? Or fill the appetite of the young lions,

rr: Zibyami omu maaya gaazo, Nari ziri omu myanya ei zigwereiremu?
en: When they couch in their dens, And abide in the covert to lie in wait?

rr: N'oha otungira ekikoona eby'okurya, Ebyana byakyo ku bitakira Ruhanga, Byazegyerera nibisherura eby'okurya? Currently Selected: Yobu 38 : RR64 Highlight
en: Who provideth for the raven his food? When his young ones cry unto God, They wander for lack of meat. Currently Selected: Job 38 : KJV Highlight Share <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000

rr: Noomanya ahu enzaza z'omu nshozi zizaarira? Nari noobaasa kureeba enuuma neezaara?
en: Knowest thou the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth? Or canst thou mark when the hinds do calve?

rr: Okaabaasa kumanya ameezi agu zimara zihakire, Nari shi noomanya obunaku obu zizaariramu
en: Canst thou number the months that they fulfil? Or knowest thou the time when they bring forth?

rr: Zihenda enkokora, zizaara abaana baazo, Zikira obusaasi?
en: They bow themselves, they bring forth their young ones, They cast out their sorrows.

rr: Abaana baazo bagira amaani, bakurira omu bwerere, Bacuuka, tibagaruka ahari zaanyinabo.
en: Their young ones are in good liking, they grow up with corn; They go forth, and return not unto them.

rr: Owaarekire enturegye kugyenda nk'oku zirikwenda n'oha? Kandi n'oha owaazitsibwire
en: Who hath sent out the wild ass free? Or who hath loosed the bands of the wild ass?

rr: Ezi naahaire eihamba ngu zituuremu, N'ensi y'engugo kuba obutaaho bwazo?
en: Whose house I have made the wilderness, And the barren land his dwellings.

rr: Zanga orwari rw'omu rurembo, Kandi tizihurira kwamira kw'orikuziseetura.
en: He scorneth the multitude of the city, Neither regardeth he the crying of the driver.

rr: Zitarangira omu nshozi ei ziriira, Nizisherura ekintu kyona ekibisi.
en: The range of the mountains is his pasture, And he searcheth after every green thing.

rr: Embogo neikiriza kukukorera, Nari shi okuraara omu kihongore kyawe?
en: Will the unicorn be willing to serve thee, Or abide by thy crib?

rr: Noobaasa kukomerana embogo n'omuguha, ekaguma omu minyarara neehinga? Neebaasa kwanjara eitaka ry'omu mpanga ekukuratiire?
en: Canst thou bind the unicorn with his band in the furrow? Or will he harrow the valleys after thee?

rr: Noija kugyesiga, ngu ahabw'okuba amaani gaayo ni maingi, Nari shi, noija kugirekyera omurimo gwawe?
en: Wilt thou trust him, because his strength is great? Or wilt thou leave thy labour to him?

rr: Noogyesiga ngu neija kugaruka, Kukureetera oburo bwawe aha mbuga?
en: Wilt thou believe him, that he will bring home thy seed, And gather it into thy barn?

rr: Amapapa ga maaya egateera n'amaryo; Beitu noogira ngur ago mapapa n'amooya gaayo gagira embabazi?
en: Gavest thou the goodly wings unto the peacocks? Or wings and feathers unto the ostrich?

rr: Ahabw'okuba amahuri gaayo egatsiga aha itaka, Gabumbatirwa omucuucu
en: Which leaveth her eggs in the earth, And warmeth them in dust,

rr: Eyebwa ku ekigyere kyakugaata, Nari enyamaishwa ku yaakubaasa kugaribatiirira.
en: And forgetteth that the foot may crush them, Or that the wild beast may break them.

rr: Eita kubi abaana nk'abatari baayo; N'obu eraabe ehendekyera busha, kwonka tetiina.
en: She is hardened against her young ones, as though they were not her's: Her labour is in vain without fear;

rr: Ahabw'okuba Ruhanga akagiima obwengye, Tiyaagiha kwetegyereza.
en: Because God hath deprived her of wisdom, Neither hath he imparted to her understanding.

rr: Ku eba neeyenda kuhunga, Egaya embaraasi n'ogitembire.
en: What time she lifteth up herself on high, She scorneth the horse and his rider.

rr: Niiwe oha embaraasi amaani gaayo? Niiwe waagihaire omugaara gw'okugijangarara omu bitsya?
en: Hast thou given the horse strength? Hast thou clothed his neck with thunder?

rr: Niiwe ogigurukisa nk'oruzigye? Ekitiinisa ky'okukanga kwayo kiitsa obwoba.
en: Canst thou make him afraid as a grasshopper? The glory of his nostrils is terrible.

rr: Erahiza omu ruhanga, neeyemanya amaani; Eshohora kubugaabugana n'engabo eziine eby'okurwanisa.
en: He paweth in the valley, and rejoiceth in his strength: He goeth on to meet the armed men.

rr: Eshekyerera obwoba; tegira ki etiina, Tehunga rurara.
en: He mocketh at fear, and is not affrighted; Neither turneth he back from the sword.

rr: Omutana, eicumu eririkutyanka n'emihunda Bigibomborekanira aha mugongo.
en: The quiver rattleth against him, The glittering spear and the shield.

rr: Ahabw'obushaarizi n'ekiniga emaraho ensi n'eiruka; Tebaasa kuhamira hamwe yaahurira eiraka ry'enzamba.
en: He swalloweth the ground with fierceness and rage: Neither believeth he that it is the sound of the trumpet.

rr: Ku ehurira eiraka ry'enzamba, egira eti: Otyo! Ekagira orugamba hare, endigito n'orwari eby'abakuru b'engabo.
en: He saith among the trumpets, Ha, ha; And he smelleth the battle afar off, The thunder of the captains, and the shouting.

rr: Akaca kashungyezibwa obwengye bwawe, Obu kajanjamura amapapa gaako, kagyemire obukiizi-bwa-buryo?
en: Doth the hawk fly by thy wisdom, And stretch her wings toward the south?

rr: Oba Eishamba ritumbiika eiguru ahabw'ekiragiro kyawe, Kandi nikyo kiryarikisa ahaiguru?
en: Doth the eagle mount up at thy command, And make her nest on high?

rr: Omu bibaare nimwo ritaaha, rikahagira eka yaaryo, N'omu bicokoromi by'amabaare.
en: She dwelleth and abideth on the rock, Upon the crag of the rock, and the strong place.

rr: Ryema okwo, riranzya eki riraateere; amaisho gaaryo gakireebera hare.
en: From thence she seeketh the prey, And her eyes behold afar off.

rr: Onwana bwaryo bunywa eshagama; Ahu omutumbi guri, niho riza.
en: Her young ones also suck up blood: And where the slain are , there is she.

rr: MUKAMA yaagaruka yaagira Yobu ati
en: Moreover the LORD answered Job, and said,

rr: Omuhakani naabaasa kuhakanisa Ow'obushoboorozi bwona? Orikuteera empaka na Ruhanga, naakigarukyemu.
en: Shall he that contendeth with the Almighty instruct him? He that reproveth God, let him answer it. Job's Reply

rr: Bwanyima Yobu yaagarukamu MUKAMA ati: Yobu okutandika kumanya ekibi kye
en: Then Job answered the LORD , and said,

rr: Reeba, nyowe tiinyine ku ndi. Mbwenu nkugarukyemu ki? Naata engaro aha munwa.
en: Behold, I am vile; what shall I answer thee? I will lay mine hand upon my mouth.

rr: Ngambire rimwe, tinkigarukamu; Eego nangwa ni kabiri, kwonka tinkyeyongyera.
en: Once have I spoken; but I will not answer: Yea, twice; but I will proceed no further. The Lord's Answer

rr: Bwanyima MUKAMA yaagarukamu Yobu omu muyaga mwingi gw'akasooroora ati
en: Then answered the LORD unto Job out of the whirlwind, and said,

rr: Yezirikye mashaija; Naaza kukubuuza, naiwe ongambire.
en: Gird up thy loins now like a man: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.

rr: Nooyenda kumpindura otahikire, N'okuncwera orubanja, ngu iwe obone kurwihwaho?
en: Wilt thou also disannul my judgment? Wilt thou condemn me, that thou mayest be righteous?

rr: Noinganisa na Ruhanga emikono? Noobasa kuhindisa eiraka nkawe?
en: Hast thou an arm like God? Or canst thou thunder with a voice like him?

rr: Yehunde obwanyakusinga n'obukuru; Yejwekye ekitiinisa n'okumurinkana kwakyo.
en: Deck thyself now with majesty and excellency; And array thyself with glory and beauty.

rr: Shuka omwegyemure g'ekiniga kyawe, Oreebe omuntu weena ow'amaryo, omucwe busha.
en: Cast abroad the rage of thy wrath: And behold every one that is proud, and abase him.

rr: Reeba ow'amaryo weena, omugarure ahansi; Kandi oribatiirire ababi ahu beemereire.
en: Look on every one that is proud, and bring him low; And tread down the wicked in their place.

rr: Boona obasherekye hamwe omu mucuucu, Obakome ahamaisho bari omu mwanya ogwekiikire.
en: Hide them in the dust together; And bind their faces in secret.

rr: Obwo nibwo ndikugambira, Ku omukono gwawe gwa buryo gurikubaasa kukujuna.
en: Then will I also confess unto thee That thine own right hand can save thee.

rr: Behemoosi n'enyamaishwa mpango erikushusha enjubu Behemoosi ei naahangire nkaiwe; Neerya obunyaatsi nk'ente.
en: Behold now behemoth, Which I made with thee; He eateth grass as an ox.

rr: Reeba amaani g'omu bishohoro byayo, N'amaani g'enyama z'ebikamba by'enda yaayo.
en: Lo now, his strength is in his loins, And his force is in the navel of his belly.

rr: Ehanika omukira gwayo nk'omwereezi; Emitsi y'omu kibero kyayo erabainemu.
en: He moveth his tail like a cedar: The sinews of his stones are wrapped together.

rr: Amagufa gaayo ni nk'enshekye z'emiringa; Amaguru gaayo ni nk'empimbi z'ebyoma.
en: His bones are as strong pieces of brass; His bones are like bars of iron.

rr: Omu byahangirwe Ruhanga niyo nyamaishwa rugambwa; Owaagihangirre wenka niwe arikubaasa kugiirira haihi na rurara.
en: He is the chief of the ways of God: He that made him can make his sword to approach unto him .

rr: Buzimazima ebibungo bigyeerera eby'okurya, Ei enyamaishwa z'omu ihamba zoona zikinira.
en: Surely the mountains bring him forth food, Where all the beasts of the field play.

rr: Eyebyamira ahansi y'amarebe, Omu mwanya ogwekiikire omu mubimbiri n'omu rufunjo.
en: He lieth under the shady trees, In the covert of the reed, and fens.

rr: Ebiti ebiine ekicuucu bigisangira; Emikinga y'aha mugyera egyehinguririza.
en: The shady trees cover him with their shadow; The willows of the brook compass him about.

rr: Reeba, omugyera ku guba gwijwire, tetiina; N'obu Yorudani yaakwijura ekaboogaboogyera omu kanwa kaayo, teine ki eyetaho.
en: Behold, he drinketh up a river, and hasteth not: He trusteth that he can draw up Jordan into his mouth.

rr: Noogira ngu hariho owaakugikwata neereeba, Nari akagirabya omurunga omu nyindo?
en: He taketh it with his eyes: His nose pierceth through snares.

rr: Mbwenu okaabaasa kukwata 41:1 Leviasaani n'enyamaishwa erikushusha enshambya. Leviasaani n'eirobo, ogiiha omu maizi, Nari okukomesa orurimi rwayo omurunga?
en: Canst thou draw out leviathan with an hook? Or his tongue with a cord which thou lettest down?

rr: Okaabaasa kurabya omuguha omu nyindo zaayo, Nari okufumura oruba rwayo n'eirobo?
en: Canst thou put an hook into his nose? Or bore his jaw through with a thorn?

rr: Noogira ngu neija kukweshengyereza, Nari okugamba gye naiwe?
en: Will he make many supplications unto thee? Will he speak soft words unto thee?

rr: Neija kuragaana naiwe endagaano, Ngu ebe omuhuuku waawe ebiro byona?
en: Will he make a covenant with thee? Wilt thou take him for a servant for ever?

rr: Okaagizaanisa nk'orikuzaanisa enyonyi, Nari okaagita aha nkomo kushetsya abazaana baawe?
en: Wilt thou play with him as with a bird? Or wilt thou bind him for thy maidens?

rr: Abajubi bakaacwererana obuguzi bwayo; Bakaagibaganisiza abashuubuzi?
en: Shall the companions make a banquet of him? Shall they part him among the merchants?

rr: Okaabaasa kwijuza oruhu rwayo eshando, Nari omutwe gwayo engobe?
en: Canst thou fill his skin with barbed irons? Or his head with fish spears?

rr: Gibangire omukono; kwonka oijukye ku ruri orugamba, Kandi torikigarukira.
en: Lay thine hand upon him, Remember the battle, do no more.

rr: Reeba, omuntu okugigiraho amatsiko n'okweruhiza busha; Ahakuba owaakugicwa ati eriisho, omutima gukaamuhwa omunda.
en: Behold, the hope of him is in vain: Shall not one be cast down even at the sight of him?

rr: Tihariho manzi eyaakwehanga kugiturukirira; Mbwenu shi n'oha owaakubaasa kuunyemerera omumaisho?
en: None is so fierce that dare stir him up: Who then is able to stand before me?

rr: N'oha oragizire eki yampa, ngu mmugarurire? Byona ebiri ahansi y'eiguru oku ringana n'ebyangye.
en: Who hath prevented me, that I should repay him? Whatsoever is under the whole heaven is mine.

rr: Tindikwija kureka kugamba aha ngingo zaayo, Nari aha maani gaayo amaingi, nari aha kyemerero kyayo ekirungi.
en: I will not conceal his parts, Nor his power, nor his comely proportion.

rr: N'oha owaakujuura ekijwaro kyayo eky'enyima? N'oha owaakwozya omu kooti zaayo ez'ekyoma?
en: Who can discover the face of his garment? Or who can come to him with his double bridle?

rr: N'oha owaakubaasa kugyashamura? Amaino gaayo oku gakiikiize goona nigaitsa obwoba.
en: Who can open the doors of his face? His teeth are terrible round about.

rr: Engamba zaayo ezigumire nizo eyehimbisizaho, Zitembekyeraine hamwe, zaaramatana.
en: His scales are his pride, Shut up together as with a close seal.

rr: Engamba emwe ekwataine n'endiijo, Kireetera embeho kutazirabamu.
en: One is so near to another, That no air can come between them.

rr: Zikwataine, tizirikubaasa kutaanisibwa.
en: They are joined one to another, They stick together, that they cannot be sundered.

rr: Ku eyetsyamura, orwoya rwayo rurabya nk'omushana; Kandi amaisho gaayo ni nk'ebitsigye by'omushekye gurikujuguta.
en: By his neesings a light doth shine, And his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.

rr: Omu kanwa kaayo harugamu emuri ezirikwaka, Ensasi z'omuriro zitaraaka.
en: Out of his mouth go burning lamps, And sparks of fire leap out.

rr: Omu nyindo zaayo hacumbuukamu omwika, Nk'ogw'enyungu erikutogota, nari nk'ekibingo ekirikusya.
en: Out of his nostrils goeth smoke, As out of a seething pot or caldron.

rr: Orwoya rwayo rwatsya amakara, Kandi omu kanwa kaayo harugamu endimi z'omurio.
en: His breath kindleth coals, And a flame goeth out of his mouth.

rr: Omu bitsya byayo nimwo amaani gaba, Okutiinisa kwayo kugyenda nikugigurukaguruka omumaisho.
en: In his neck remaineth strength, And sorrow is turned into joy before him.

rr: Enyama z'omubiri gwayo zihingamiraine, Zigihamiireho, tizirikubaasa kugirugaho.
en: The flakes of his flesh are joined together: They are firm in themselves; they cannot be moved.

rr: Omutima gwayo gugumire nk'eibaare; Buzimazima gugumire nk'orubengo.
en: His heart is as firm as a stone; Yea, as hard as a piece of the nether millstone .

rr: Ku eimuka, amamanzi gatiina, Ahabw'okukangarana kwayo gagwa eiraro.
en: When he raiseth up himself, the mighty are afraid: By reason of breakings they purify themselves.

rr: N'obu baakugiteera rurara, teine ki yaakugiitsa, N'obu ryakuba eicumu, nari endiga, nari omuhunda.
en: The sword of him that layeth at him cannot hold: The spear, the dart, nor the habergeon.

rr: Ebyoma ebireeba nk'ekumbwe, N'emiringa nk'ekiti kijunzire.
en: He esteemeth iron as straw, And brass as rotten wood.

rr: Emyambi tegibinga; Ahariyo amabaare g'enjungu ni nk'ebishushunga.
en: The arrow cannot make him flee: Slingstones are turned with him into stubble.

rr: Emihini ahariyo neeshusha nk'embuba, Eshekyerera okukomangana kw'emihunda.
en: Darts are counted as stubble: He laugheth at the shaking of a spear.

rr: Aha nda yaayo ni nk'engusyo z'obwogi; Ku erambira aha byondo, eba nk'ekyoma kirikuhuura.
en: Sharp stones are under him: He spreadeth sharp pointed things upon the mire.

rr: Ereetera amaizi g'okuzimu kutogota nk'enyungu, Ehindura enyanja nk'amajuta.
en: He maketh the deep to boil like a pot: He maketh the sea like a pot of ointment.

rr: Ahi yaaraba, ehatsiga ekirari kirikwengyengyeta; Omuntu akaateekateeka, ngu ahagati y'amaizi hamezire enju.
en: He maketh a path to shine after him; One would think the deep to be hoary.

rr: Omu nsi tiharimu erikugishusha, Ekihangirwe ekitagira bwoba.
en: Upon earth there is not his like, Who is made without fear.

rr: Ereeba ebiri ahaiguru byona, Niyo mukama w'ebinyamaryo byona.
en: He beholdeth all high things: He is a king over all the children of pride.

rr: Bwanyima Yobu yaagarukamu MUKAMA ati
en: Then Job answered the LORD , and said,

rr: Nimmanya ku orikubaasa byona, Kandi tihariho kirikubaasa kuzibira eki omaririire kukora.
en: I know that thou canst do every thing , And that no thought can be withholden from thee.

rr: Ogwo n'oha orikushereka enaama, haza ataine arikumanya?
en: Who is he that hideth counsel without knowledge?

rr: Nikyo kingambiise ebi ntarikushoborokyerwa, Ebirikutangaaza munonga ebindengire, Ebi mbaire ntarikumanya.
en: Therefore have I uttered that I understood not; Things too wonderful for me, which I knew not.

rr: Ogizire oti: Tega okutu, naaza kugamba; Nkubuuze, haza naiwe ongarukyemu.
en: Hear, I beseech thee, and I will speak: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.

rr: Nkaba nkuhuriza amatu, Kwonka hati eriisho ryangye ryakwereebera.
en: I have heard of thee by the hearing of the ear: But now mine eye seeth thee.

rr: Nikyo ndikwetamira, Nkeeteisiza omu mucuucu n'omu iju. Ruhanga okuhabura banywani ba Yobu
en: Wherefore I abhor myself , and repent In dust and ashes. The Epilogue

rr: MUKAMA ku yaaherize kugambira Yobu ebyo bigambo, yaagira Elifaazi Omutemaani ati: Nkugiriirre ekiniga kingi, iwe na bangyenzi baawe bombi, ahabw'okuba timungambireho bihikire, nk'omwiru wangye Yobu oku agizire.
en: And it was so , that after the LORD had spoken these words unto Job, the LORD said to Eliphaz the Temanite, My wrath is kindled against thee, and against thy two friends: for ye have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job hath .

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo hati mutware enimi mushanju n'empaya z'entaama mushanju, muze ow'omwiru wangye Yobu, mwetambirireyo ekitambo ky'okwotsya; bwanyima omwiru wangye Yobu naija kubashabira; ahabw'okuba niwe ndikwija kwikiriza, nkareka kubatwaza nk'obushema bwanyu oku buri; ahakuba timungambireho bihikire nk'omwiru wangye Yobu oku agizire.
en: Therefore take unto you now seven bullocks and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you: for him will I accept: lest I deal with you after your folly, in that ye have not spoken of me the thing which is right, like my servant Job.

rr: Elifaazi Omutemaani na Biludaadi Omushuuhi na Zofari Omunaamasi nikwo kugyenda, bakakora eki MUKAMA yaabaragiira, na MUKAMA akaikiriza okushaba kwa Yobu. Ruhanga okutambira Yobu n'okumushumbuusaha
en: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went, and did according as the LORD commanded them: the LORD also accepted Job.

rr: Yobu ku yaaherize kushabira bagyenzi be, MUKAMA yaamutambira enaku ze; yaamushumbuusha ebirikwingana kabiri n'ebi yaafeereirwe.
en: And the LORD turned the captivity of Job, when he prayed for his friends: also the LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.

rr: Bwanyima beene ishe boona na banyaanya, n'abaabaire nibamumanya baija ah'ari, baariira hamwe nawe omu nju ye, baamugirira esaasi, baamugumya ahabw'ebihikiirizi byona ebi MUKAMA yaamureetsireho; buri muntu yaamuha ekicweka ky'efeeza n'empeta y'ezaabu.
en: Then came there unto him all his brethren, and all his sisters, and all they that had been of his acquaintance before, and did eat bread with him in his house: and they bemoaned him, and comforted him over all the evil that the LORD had brought upon him: every man also gave him a piece of money, and every one an earring of gold.

rr: MUKAMA yaaha omugisha ebiro bya Yobu ebya bwanyima okukira eby'okubanza; yaatunga entaama kakumi n'enkumi ina, engamira enkumi mukaaga, enimi z'okuhingisa enkumi ibiri, n'ebuguma z'endogoya rukumi.
en: So the LORD blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning: for he had fourteen thousand sheep, and six thousand camels, and a thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand she asses.

rr: Kandi yaazaara aboojo mushanju n'baishiki bashatu.
en: He had also seven sons and three daughters.

rr: Omwishiki w'okubanza yaamweta Yemima, orikumukurata yaamweta Keeziya, n'owa kashatu yaamweta Kerenihapuki.
en: And he called the name of the first, Jemima; and the name of the second, Kezia; and the name of the third, Keren-happuch.

rr: Kandi omu nsi egyo hakaba hatarimu bakazi barungi nka bahara ba Yobu. Ishe yaabaraga ebye na banyaanyabo.
en: And in all the land were no women found so fair as the daughters of Job: and their father gave them inheritance among their brethren.

rr: Bwanyima y'ebyo yaamara emyaka igana na makumi ana, yaareeba abaijukuru n'abaijukuruza, okuhika aha ruzaaro rwa kana.
en: After this lived Job an hundred and forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons' sons, even four generations.

rr: Bwanyima Yobu yaafa, ari omugurusi amazire emyaka mingi.
