rr: 1 Eki n'ekigambo kya MUKAMA ekyaizire ahari Yoeli mwene Pesueli.
en: 1 The word of the LORD that came to Joel the son of Pethuel.
2 Hear this, ye old men, and give ear, all ye inhabitants of the land. Hath this been in your days, or even in the days of your fathers?
3 Tell ye your children of it, and let your children tell their children, and their children another generation.
4 That which the palmerworm hath left hath the locust eaten; and that which the locust hath left hath the cankerworm eaten; and that which the cankerworm hath left hath the caterpiller eaten.
5 Awake, ye drunkards, and weep; and howl, all ye drinkers of wine, because of the new wine; for it is cut off from your mouth.
6 For a nation is come up upon my land, strong, and without number, whose teeth are the teeth of a lion, and he hath the cheek teeth of a great lion.

rr: 7 Rimazireho emizaabibu yangye
en: 7 He hath laid my vine waste, and barked my fig tree: he hath made it clean bare, and cast it away; the branches thereof are made white.

rr: 8 Tonzya nk'omwishiki empangare oyezirikire ekiguniya
en: 8 Lament like a virgin girded with sackcloth for the husband of her youth.
9 The meat offering and the drink offering is cut off from the house of the LORD ; the priests, the LORD 's ministers, mourn.
10 The field is wasted, the land mourneth; for the corn is wasted: the new wine is dried up, the oil languisheth.
11 Be ye ashamed, O ye husbandmen; howl, O ye vinedressers, for the wheat and for the barley; because the harvest of the field is perished.

12 The vine is dried up, and the fig tree languisheth; the pomegranate tree, the palm tree also, and the apple tree, even all the trees of the field, are withered: because joy is withered away from the sons of men.

13 Gird yourselves, and lament, ye priests: howl, ye ministers of the altar: come, lie all night in sackcloth, ye ministers of my God: for the meat offering and the drink offering is withholden from the house of your God.
14 Sanctify ye a fast, call a solemn assembly, gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land into the house of the LORD your God, and cry unto the LORD ,
15 Alas for the day! for the day of the LORD is at hand, and as a destruction from the Almighty shall it come.
16 Is not the meat cut off before our eyes, yea , joy and gladness from the house of our God?

rr: 17 Embibo zigwire omu itaka
en: 17 The seed is rotten under their clods, the garners are laid desolate, the barns are broken down; for the corn is withered.
18 How do the beasts groan! the herds of cattle are perplexed, because they have no pasture; yea, the flocks of sheep are made desolate.
19 O LORD , to thee will I cry: for the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness, and the flame hath burned all the trees of the field.
20 The beasts of the field cry also unto thee: for the rivers of waters are dried up, and the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness.
1 Blow ye the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain: let all the inhabitants of the land tremble: for the day of the LORD cometh, for it is nigh at hand;

2 a day of darkness and of gloominess, a day of clouds and of thick darkness, as the morning spread upon the mountains: a great people and a strong; there hath not been ever the like, neither shall be any more after it, even to the years of many generations.
3 A fire devoureth before them; and behind them a flame burneth: the land is as the garden of Eden before them, and behind them a desolate wilderness; yea, and nothing shall escape them.
4 The appearance of them is as the appearance of horses; and as horsemen, so shall they run.
5 Like the noise of chariots on the tops of mountains shall they leap, like the noise of a flame of fire that devoureth the stubble, as a strong people set in battle array.
6 Before their face the people shall be much pained: all faces shall gather blackness.

rr: 7 Niziteera nk'abarwani
en: 7 They shall run like mighty men; they shall climb the wall like men of war; and they shall march every one on his ways, and they shall not break their ranks:
8 neither shall one thrust another; they shall walk every one in his path: and when they fall upon the sword, they shall not be wounded.
9 They shall run to and fro in the city; they shall run upon the wall, they shall climb up upon the houses; they shall enter in at the windows like a thief.
10 The earth shall quake before them; the heavens shall tremble: the sun and the moon shall be dark, and the stars shall withdraw their shining:
11 and the LORD shall utter his voice before his army: for his camp is very great: for he is strong that executeth his word: for the day of the LORD is great and very terrible; and who can abide it?
12 Therefore also now, saith the LORD , turn ye even to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning:
13 and rend your heart, and not your garments, and turn unto the LORD your God: for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repenteth him of the evil.
14 Who knoweth if he will return and repent, and leave a blessing behind him; even a meat offering and a drink offering unto the LORD your God?

rr: 2:15 . Muteerere enzamba omuri Saayuuni
en: 15 Blow the trumpet in Zion, sanctify a fast, call a solemn assembly:

16 gather the people, sanctify the congregation, assemble the elders, gather the children, and those that suck the breasts: let the bridegroom go forth of his chamber, and the bride out of her closet.

17 Let the priests, the ministers of the LORD , weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, Spare thy people, O LORD , and give not thine heritage to reproach, that the heathen should rule over them: wherefore should they say among the people, Where is their God?
18 Then will the LORD be jealous for his land, and pity his people.
19 Yea, the LORD will answer and say unto his people, Behold, I will send you corn, and wine, and oil, and ye shall be satisfied therewith: and I will no more make you a reproach among the heathen:

20 but I will remove far off from you the northern army , and will drive him into a land barren and desolate, with his face toward the east sea, and his hinder part toward the utmost sea, and his stink shall come up, and his ill savour shall come up, because he hath done great things.
21 Fear not, O land; be glad and rejoice: for the LORD will do great things.

rr: 22 Imwe nyamaishwa z'omu ishwa 'mwe, mutatiina
en: 22 Be not afraid, ye beasts of the field: for the pastures of the wilderness do spring, for the tree beareth her fruit, the fig tree and the vine do yield their strength.

23 Be glad then, ye children of Zion, and rejoice in the LORD your God: for he hath given you the former rain moderately, and he will cause to come down for you the rain, the former rain, and the latter rain in the first month .

rr: 24 Amahuuriro garyaijura engano
en: 24 And the floors shall be full of wheat, and the fats shall overflow with wine and oil.

rr: Yoel 2:25
en: 25 And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten, the cankerworm, and the caterpiller, and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you.
26 And ye shall eat in plenty, and be satisfied, and praise the name of the LORD your God, that hath dealt wondrously with you: and my people shall never be ashamed.
27 And ye shall know that I am in the midst of Israel, and that I am the LORD your God, and none else: and my people shall never be ashamed.

28 And it shall come to pass afterward, that I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your old men shall dream dreams, your young men shall see visions:
29 and also upon the servants and upon the handmaids in those days will I pour out my spirit.

rr: 30 Kandi ndyayoreka eb'amahano omu iguru n'omu nsi, eshagama n'omuriro n'okucumba kw'omwika.
en: 30 And I will shew wonders in the heavens and in the earth, blood, and fire, and pillars of smoke.
31 The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and the terrible day of the LORD come.

32 And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the LORD shall be delivered: for in mount Zion and in Jerusalem shall be deliverance, as the LORD hath said, and in the remnant whom the LORD shall call.
1 For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I shall bring again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem,

2 I will also gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat, and will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations, and parted my land.
3 And they have cast lots for my people; and have given a boy for an harlot, and sold a girl for wine, that they might drink.

4 Yea, and what have ye to do with me, O Tyre, and Zidon, and all the coasts of Palestine? will ye render me a recompence? and if ye recompense me, swiftly and speedily will I return your recompence upon your own head;
5 because ye have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried into your temples my goodly pleasant things:

rr: 6 Abayuda n'aba Yerusaalemu mwabaguza Abagriika, mwabatwara hare n'ensi yaabo y'obuzaarwa.
en: 6 the children also of Judah and the children of Jerusalem have ye sold unto the Grecians, that ye might remove them far from their border.

rr: 7 Kwonka hati niinyija kubaimutsya, mbaihe omu nsi ei mwabagurizemu, mbazimuurire ebi mwakozire.
en: 7 Behold, I will raise them out of the place whither ye have sold them, and will return your recompence upon your own head:

rr: 8 Abaana baanyu b'aboojo n'ab'abaishiki ndyabaguza Abayuda, nabo babaguze aba Sheeba, eihanga erya hare; ahabw'okuba MUKAMA niwe yaakigamba.
en: 8 and I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the children of Judah, and they shall sell them to the Sabeans, to a people far off: for the LORD hath spoken it .
9 Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles; Prepare war, wake up the mighty men, let all the men of war draw near; let them come up:
10 beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruninghooks into spears: let the weak say, I am strong.

rr: 11 Imwe mahanga 'mwe, agari aha mbaju zoona
en: 11 Assemble yourselves, and come, all ye heathen, and gather yourselves together round about: thither cause thy mighty ones to come down, O LORD .
12 Let the heathen be wakened, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat: for there will I sit to judge all the heathen round about.
13 Put ye in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe: come, get you down; for the press is full, the fats overflow; for their wickedness is great.
14 Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision: for the day of the LORD is near in the valley of decision.

rr: 15 Eizooba n'okwezi bishwekirwe omwirima
en: 15 The sun and the moon shall be darkened, and the stars shall withdraw their shining.

16 The LORD also shall roar out of Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth shall shake: but the LORD will be the hope of his people, and the strength of the children of Israel.
17 So shall ye know that I am the LORD your God dwelling in Zion, my holy mountain: then shall Jerusalem be holy, and there shall no strangers pass through her any more.

18 And it shall come to pass in that day, that the mountains shall drop down new wine, and the hills shall flow with milk, and all the rivers of Judah shall flow with waters, and a fountain shall come forth of the house of the LORD , and shall water the valley of Shittim.
19 Egypt shall be a desolation, and Edom shall be a desolate wilderness, for the violence against the children of Judah, because they have shed innocent blood in their land.
20 But Judah shall dwell for ever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.
21 For I will cleanse their blood that I have not cleansed: for the LORD dwelleth in Zion.
1 Now the word of the LORD came unto Jonah the son of Amittai, saying,
2 Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and cry against it; for their wickedness is come up before me.

3 But Jonah rose up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of the LORD , and went down to Joppa; and he found a ship going to Tarshish: so he paid the fare thereof, and went down into it, to go with them unto Tarshish from the presence of the LORD .
4 But the LORD sent out a great wind into the sea, and there was a mighty tempest in the sea, so that the ship was like to be broken.

5 Then the mariners were afraid, and cried every man unto his god, and cast forth the wares that were in the ship into the sea, to lighten it of them. But Jonah was gone down into the sides of the ship; and he lay, and was fast asleep.

rr: 6 Omukuru w'emeeri nikwo kwija ah'ari, akamugira ati: Obaire ota, iwe mugwejegyezi 'we? Imuka, otakire ruhanga waawe. Obundi ruhanga waawe akaatwijuka, tureka kucwekyerera.
en: 6 So the shipmaster came to him, and said unto him, What meanest thou, O sleeper? arise, call upon thy God, if so be that God will think upon us, that we perish not.

rr: 7 Bwanyima baagambirana bati: Nimwije tuteere enteenyu, tubone kumanya otureeteire aka kabi.
en: 7 And they said every one to his fellow, Come, and let us cast lots, that we may know for whose cause this evil is upon us.

rr: Batyo baateera enteenyu, yaakwata Yona.
en: So they cast lots, and the lot fell upon Jonah.

rr: 8 Baamubuuza bati: Tugambire otureeteire aka kabi. Okora murimo ki? Nooruga hi? Owaanyi ni nkahi? Kandi ori owa ihanga ki?
en: 8 Then said they unto him, Tell us, we pray thee, for whose cause this evil is upon us; What is thine occupation? and whence comest thou? what is thy country? and of what people art thou?
9 And he said unto them, I am an Hebrew; and I fear the LORD , the God of heaven, which hath made the sea and the dry land .

rr: 10 Okuruga aho baagira obwoba bwingi, baamubuuza bati: Beitu ekyo eki okozire niki?
en: 10 Then were the men exceedingly afraid, and said unto him, Why hast thou done this?

rr: Ahabw'okuba abo bashaija bakamanya ku yaabaire ahungire MUKAMA; ahakuba akaba yaabagambiire.
en: For the men knew that he fled from the presence of the LORD , because he had told them.

rr: 11 Baamubuuza bati: Mbwenu tukugire tuta, enyanja ekabona kutuuza, tukakira? Ahabw'okuba enyanja ekaba neeyeyongyera kuhinduriza.
en: 11 Then said they unto him, What shall we do unto thee, that the sea may be calm unto us? for the sea wrought, and was tempestuous.
12 And he said unto them, Take me up, and cast me forth into the sea; so shall the sea be calm unto you: for I know that for my sake this great tempest is upon you.

rr: 13 Kwonka abo bashaija baavuga munonga gu babone kuhitsya emeeri aha nkungu, baaremwa; ahabw'okuba enyanja ekaba neeyeyongyera kubatabangurira ebingonzi.
en: 13 Nevertheless the men rowed hard to bring it to the land; but they could not: for the sea wrought, and was tempestuous against them.

14 Wherefore they cried unto the LORD , and said, We beseech thee, O LORD , we beseech thee, let us not perish for this man's life, and lay not upon us innocent blood: for thou, O LORD , hast done as it pleased thee.
15 So they took up Jonah, and cast him forth into the sea: and the sea ceased from her raging.

rr: 16 Ahonaaho abo bashaija baatiina munonga MUKAMA, baamutambira ebitambo, baahiga nibarahira.
en: 16 Then the men feared the LORD exceedingly, and offered a sacrifice unto the LORD , and made vows.
17 Now the LORD had prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah. And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.

rr: 1 Bwanyima Yona yaashaba MUKAMA Ruhanga we, ari omu nda y'eky'enyanja, naagira ati
en: 1 Then Jonah prayed unto the LORD his God out of the fish's belly,
2 and said,
3 For thou hadst cast me into the deep, in the midst of the seas;
4 Then I said, I am cast out of thy sight;
5 The waters compassed me about, even to the soul:
6 I went down to the bottoms of the mountains;
7 When my soul fainted within me I remembered the LORD :
8 They that observe lying vanities
9 But I will sacrifice unto thee with the voice of thanksgiving;

rr: 10 Bwanyima MUKAMA yaaragiira ekyo ky'enyanja, kyatanaka Yona aha nkungu.
en: 10 And the LORD spake unto the fish, and it vomited out Jonah upon the dry land .

rr: 1 Bwanyima ekigambo kya MUKAMA kyagaruka kyaija ahari Yona obwa kabiri, nikigira kiti
en: 1 And the word of the LORD came unto Jonah the second time, saying,

rr: 2 Imuka, oze Nineeve, orurembo orwo oruhango, orugambire obutumwa obu ndikukutuma.
en: 2 Arise, go unto Nineveh, that great city, and preach unto it the preaching that I bid thee.

rr: 3 Atyo Yona yaimuka, yaaza Nineeve, nk'oku MUKAMA yaamugambira.
en: 3 So Jonah arose, and went unto Nineveh, according to the word of the LORD .

rr: Kandi Nineeve rukaba ruri orurembo ruhango munonga, oru obuhango bwarwo burikugyenderwa ebiro bishatu.
en: Now Nineveh was an exceeding great city of three days' journey.

rr: 4 Yona yaatandika kugyendagyenda omu rurembo, naagyenda orugyendo rw'eizooba rimwe; naagamba n'eiraka rihango ati: Hatsigaire ebiro makumi ana, Nineeve ecwekyerezibwe.
en: 4 And Jonah began to enter into the city a day's journey, and he cried, and said, Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown.
5 So the people of Nineveh believed God, and proclaimed a fast, and put on sackcloth, from the greatest of them even to the least of them.
6 For word came unto the king of Nineveh, and he arose from his throne, and he laid his robe from him, and covered him with sackcloth, and sat in ashes.

7 And he caused it to be proclaimed and published through Nineveh by the decree of the king and his nobles, saying, Let neither man nor beast, herd nor flock, taste any thing: let them not feed, nor drink water:
8 but let man and beast be covered with sackcloth, and cry mightily unto God: yea, let them turn every one from his evil way, and from the violence that is in their hands.
9 Who can tell if God will turn and repent, and turn away from his fierce anger, that we perish not?

rr: 10 Ruhanga ku yaareebire eki baakora, n'oku baahinduka kureka emihanda yaabo emibi, yaayegarukamu, yaareka akabi aku yaagambire kubareetaho; tiyaakabareetaho.
en: 10 And God saw their works, that they turned from their evil way; and God repented of the evil, that he had said that he would do unto them; and he did it not.

rr: 1 Kwonka ekyo kyagwisa kubi munonga Yona, yaagira ekiniga.
en: 1 But it displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he was very angry.

2 And he prayed unto the LORD , and said, I pray thee, O LORD , was not this my saying, when I was yet in my country? Therefore I fled before unto Tarshish: for I knew that thou art a gracious God, and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repentest thee of the evil.
3 Therefore now, O LORD , take, I beseech thee, my life from me; for it is better for me to die than to live.

rr: 4 MUKAMA yaamugarukamu ati: Ebyo waakora gye okugira ekiniga?
en: 4 Then said the LORD , Doest thou well to be angry?

rr: 5 Bwanyima Yona yaaruga omu rurembo, yaashutama aha rubaju rwarwo rw'oburugwa-izooba, yaayeyombekyerayo akaju, yaakahungiramu omushana, okuhitsya ahu arireebera oku orurembo ruriba.
en: 5 So Jonah went out of the city, and sat on the east side of the city, and there made him a booth, and sat under it in the shadow, till he might see what would become of the city.

rr: 6 Bwanyima MUKAMA Ruhanga yaaragiira omwongo kurandira ahu Yona yaabaire ari, gukamusangira aha mutwe kumutambira omushana ogwabaire nigumwita.
en: 6 And the LORD God prepared a gourd, and made it to come up over Jonah, that it might be a shadow over his head, to deliver him from his grief.

rr: Atyo Yona yaashemererwa munonga ahabw'ogwo mwongo.
en: So Jonah was exceeding glad of the gourd.

rr: 7 Kwonka omu kasheeshe omushekye ku gwajugutsire, Ruhanga yaaragiira akakooko, kaarya ogwo mwongo, gwayoma.
en: 7 But God prepared a worm when the morning rose the next day, and it smote the gourd that it withered.

8 And it came to pass, when the sun did arise, that God prepared a vehement east wind; and the sun beat upon the head of Jonah, that he fainted, and wished in himself to die, and said, It is better for me to die than to live.

rr: 9 Kwonka Ruhanga yaagira Yona ati: Ebyo waakora gye okugira ekiniga ahabw'omwongo? Onu ati: Eego, naakora gye okugira ekiniga, nangwa eky'okuunyita.
en: 9 And God said to Jonah, Doest thou well to be angry for the gourd? And he said, I do well to be angry, even unto death.

rr: 10 MUKAMA yaagira ati: Noosaasibwa omwongo, ogu otarahendekyeire, ogu otaramerize, ogwayemerize nyekiro, gukagaruka gukooma ekindi kiro.
en: 10 Then said the LORD , Thou hast had pity on the gourd, for the which thou hast not laboured, neither madest it grow; which came up in a night, and perished in a night:
11 and should not I spare Nineveh, that great city, wherein are more than sixscore thousand persons that cannot discern between their right hand and their left hand; and also much cattle?

rr: Bwanyima y'okufa kwa Musa omugaragwa wa MUKAMA, MUKAMA akagambira Yoshua mwene Nuuni, omuheereza wa Musa, ati
en: Now after the death of Moses the servant of the LORD it came to pass, that the LORD spake unto Joshua the son of Nun, Moses' minister, saying,

rr: Musa omugaragwa wangye afiire; n'ahabw'ekyo imuka, oyambukye omugyera ogu Yorudani, iwe n'eihanga eri ryona, mutaahe omu nsi ei ndikuha Abaisraeli.
en: Moses my servant is dead; now therefore arise, go over this Jordan, thou, and all this people, unto the land which I do give to them, even to the children of Israel.

rr: Omwanya gwona ogu muriribatamu, ngubahaire, nk'oku naagambiire Musa.
en: Every place that the sole of your foot shall tread upon, that have I given unto you, as I said unto Moses.

rr: Okuruga aha ihamba n'orushozi oru Lebanooni, okuhika aha mugyera omuhango Furaati, ensi yoona ey'Abahiiti, okuhika aha Nyanja empango ey'oburengyerwa-izooba, egyo niyo eriba emyatano yaanyu.
en: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even unto the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and unto the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your coast.

rr: Tihaine muntu weena oribaasa kukuza omu kaso ebiro byona eby'amagara gaawe; nk'oku naabaire ndi na Musa, nikwo ndiguma naiwe; tindikuhemukaho, kandi tindikutsigaho.
en: There shall not any man be able to stand before thee all the days of thy life: as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee: I will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.

rr: Ba ow'amaani, ogume omutima; ahakuba niiwe orihunguza eihanga eri ensi ei naarahiire kuha baishenkurubo.
en: Be strong and of a good courage: for unto this people shalt thou divide for an inheritance the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give them.

rr: Kwonka ba ow'amaani, ogumire kimwe omutima, kandi oyerinde ohitsye ebiragiro byona ebi Musa omugaragwa wangye yaakuragiire; otaribiteishukaho kutoora aha rubaju rwa buryo nari orwa bumosho, obone kubaasikirwa, ei oriza yoona.
en: Only be thou strong and very courageous, that thou mayest observe to do according to all the law, which Moses my servant commanded thee: turn not from it to the right hand or to the left, that thou mayest prosper whithersoever thou goest.

rr: Ekitabo eki eky'ebiragiro kitarikuruga omu kanwa; kureka ogume nookiteekateekaho nyomushana na nyekiro, obone kwerinda, ohitsye byona ebihandiikirwemu; obwo nibwo oriheebwa omugisha ei oriza yoona, okabaasa gye byona.
en: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.

rr: Tiinye naakuragiira? Ba ow'amaani, ogume omutima; otatiina, n'obu kwakuba okuhahaaza omutima; ahabw'okuba MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe aryaguma naiwe, ei oriza yoona. Yoshua okugambira abantu eby'okwambuka Yorudani
en: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.

rr: Ahonaaho Yoshua yaaragiira abatware b'abantu ati
en: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,

rr: Mugyende nimuraba omu rusiisira rwona, muragiire abantu muti: Mwekomere entanda, ahakuba omu biro bishatu nimwija kwambuka ogu mugyera Yorudani, kuza kukubuura ensi, ei MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu arikubaha kuba eyaanyu.
en: Pass through the host, and command the people, saying, Prepare you victuals; for within three days ye shall pass over this Jordan, to go in to possess the land, which the LORD your God giveth you to possess it.

rr: Kandi Abareubeeni n'Abagaadi n'ekicweka ky'oruganda rwa Manaase, Yoshua yaabagira ati
en: And to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to half the tribe of Manasseh, spake Joshua, saying,

rr: Mwijukye ekigambo eki Musa omugaragwa wa MUKAMA yaabaragiire naagira ati: MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu abahaire oburuhuukiro, kandi aryabaha ensi egi.
en: Remember the word which Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, saying, The LORD your God hath given you rest, and hath given you this land.

rr: Abakazi baanyu n'abaana baanyu n'amatungo gaanyu biryaguma omu nsi ei Musa yaabahaire seenu ya Yorudani; kwonka imwe mwena amamanzi nimwija kwambuka, mwebembeire beene waanyu, mwine eby'okurwanisa, mubahwere
en: Your wives, your little ones, and your cattle, shall remain in the land which Moses gave you on this side Jordan; but ye shall pass before your brethren armed, all the mighty men of valour, and help them;

rr: okuhitsya obu MUKAMA ariha beene waanyu oburuhuukiro, nk'oku naimwe yaabubahaire, nabo bakakubuura ensi ei MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu arikubaha. Bwanyima imwe muryagaruka omu nsi ei mwakubwire, mugirye, niyo nsi ei Musa omugaragwa wa MUKAMA yaabahaire seenu ya Yorudani aha bukiizi bw'oburugwa-izooba.
en: until the LORD have given your brethren rest, as he hath given you, and they also have possessed the land which the LORD your God giveth them: then ye shall return unto the land of your possession, and enjoy it, which Moses the LORD 's servant gave you on this side Jordan toward the sunrising.

rr: Baagarukamu Yoshua nibagira bati: Ebi waaturagiira byona turyabikora, kandi yoona ei oritutuma turyazayo.
en: And they answered Joshua, saying, All that thou commandest us we will do, and whithersoever thou sendest us, we will go.

rr: Nk'oku twayorobeire Musa omuri byona, naiwe nikwo turikworobera; kwonka MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe agume naiwe, nk'oku yaabaire ari na Musa.
en: According as we hearkened unto Moses in all things, so will we hearken unto thee: only the LORD thy God be with thee, as he was with Moses.

rr: Ku baabaire bari omuri Shitimu, Yoshua mwene Nuuni yaatuma abantu babiri omu mubonano kuza kutata, naagira ati: Mwirooko mwetegyereze ensi, muno-muno Yeriko.
en: And Joshua the son of Nun sent out of Shittim two men to spy secretly, saying, Go view the land, even Jericho.

rr: Baagyenda, baahikira omu nju ya maraaya orikweta Rahabu, baaraaramu.
en: And they went, and came into an harlot's house, named Rahab, and lodged there.

rr: Haabaho owaagambira omugabe wa Yeriko, naagira ati: Twahurira ngu abashaija babiri b'Abaisraeli baija kunu eki kiro kutata ensi.
en: And it was told the king of Jericho, saying, Behold, there came men in hither to night of the children of Israel to search out the country.

rr: Omugabe wa Yeriko yaatuma ahari Rahabu, ati: Shohoza abantu abaizire owaawe, bakataaha omu nju yaawe; ahakuba baizire kutata ensi yoona.
en: And the king of Jericho sent unto Rahab, saying, Bring forth the men that are come to thee, which are entered into thine house: for they be come to search out all the country.

rr: Kwonka ogwo mukazi akaba yaatwaire abo bashaija babiri, yaabasherekire-mbwenu yaagira ati: N'eky'amazima, haine abashaija baizire owangye; kwonka timmanyire ie babaire nibaruga
en: And the woman took the two men, and hid them, and said thus, There came men unto me, but I wist not whence they were:

rr: ku bwizire, bari haihi kukinga eirembo, abo bashaija baashohora; tindikumanya i batoire; murahukye kubakurata, nimwija kubakwata.
en: and it came to pass about the time of shutting of the gate, when it was dark, that the men went out: whither the men went I wot not: pursue after them quickly; for ye shall overtake them.

rr: Kwonka we akashangwa yaabatembize aha mutwe gw'enju, abasherekireyo, abashwekire furakisi ei yaabaire ayanikireyo.
en: But she had brought them up to the roof of the house, and hid them with the stalks of flax, which she had laid in order upon the roof.

rr: Abashaija b'omugabe nikwo kugyenda nibabasherura omu muhanda ogurikuza Yorudani okuhika aha nyambukiro; ahonaaho abarikubasherura ku baabaire baarugaho, eirembo ryakingwa. Endagaano ya Rahabu n'entatsi
en: And the men pursued after them the way to Jordan unto the fords: and as soon as they which pursued after them were gone out, they shut the gate.

rr: Ku baabaire batakabyamire, Rahabu yaatemba, yaabashanga aha mutwe gw'enju
en: And before they were laid down, she came up unto them upon the roof;

rr: yaabagira ati: Nimmanya ku Mukama abahaire egi nsi, tugizire obwoba bwingi ahabwanyu, kandi n'abatuuzi boona ab'omu nsi egi nibahwerera omu maisho gaanyu
en: and she said unto the men, I know that the LORD hath given you the land, and that your terror is fallen upon us, and that all the inhabitants of the land faint because of you.

rr: ahakuba tukahurira oku MUKAMA yaayomize amaizi g'Enyanja erikutukura omu maisho gaanyu, obu mwaruga Misri, kandi n'oku mwagizire abagabe b'Abaamori bombi, abaabaire bari seeri ya Yorudani, Sihooni na Ogi, abu mwacwekyerereize kimwe.
en: For we have heard how the LORD dried up the water of the Red sea for you, when ye came out of Egypt; and what ye did unto the two kings of the Amorites, that were on the other side Jordan, Sihon and Og, whom ye utterly destroyed.

rr: Ahonaaho ku twakihuriire, emitima yaatuhwa omunda, kandi tihaine muntu weena owaatsigairwe omutima omunda ahabwanyu; ahakuba MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu niwe Ruhanga ow'ahaiguru omu iguru, kandi ow'ahansi omu nsi.
en: And as soon as we had heard these things , our hearts did melt, neither did there remain any more courage in any man, because of you: for the LORD your God, he is God in heaven above, and in earth beneath.

rr: 1 N'ahabw'ekyo nimbeeshengyereza, nk'oku mbagiriire eby'embabazi, mundahire MUKAMA, naimwe ku murizigirira enju ya taata, haza mumpe akamanyiso kahamire
en: Now therefore, I pray you, swear unto me by the LORD , since I have shewed you kindness, that ye will also shew kindness unto my father's house, and give me a true token:

rr: kandi ku murirokora tata na maawe, banyaanyazi na barumuna bangye n'ebi baine byona, mukakiza amagara gaitu.
en: and that ye will save alive my father, and my mother, and my brethren, and my sisters, and all that they have, and deliver our lives from death.

rr: Abashaija baamugarukamu bati: Nk'oku mukirize amagara gaitu, turyakiza agaanyu; ku muraabe mutatwatiire naama, turyabagirira embabazi omu mazima, MUKAMA ku arituha ensi egi.
en: And the men answered her, Our life for your's, if ye utter not this our business.

rr: Entatsi okugarukayo n'okugambira Yoshua amakuru
en: And it shall be, when the LORD hath given us the land, that we will deal kindly and truly with thee.

rr: Bwanyima yaabashuumya n'omurunga naabarabya omu dirisa; ahakuba enju ye ekaba eyombekirwe aha mutwe gw'orugo rw'amabaare orw'orurembo, kandi niho yaabaire atuura.
en: Then she let them down by a cord through the window: for her house was upon the town wall, and she dwelt upon the wall.

rr: Yaabagira ati: Muhungire omu bibungo, abarikubasherura batakaababugana; mumareyo ebiro bishatu mwesherekire, okuhitsya abarikubasherura obu baraagarukye; bwanyima mubone kwegyendera.
en: And she said unto them, Get you to the mountain, lest the pursuers meet you; and hide yourselves there three days, until the pursuers be returned: and afterward may ye go your way.

rr: Abashaija baamugarukamu bati: Tituriturwa egi ndahiro ei waaturahiza.
en: And the men said unto her, We will be blameless of this thine oath which thou hast made us swear.

rr: Reeba, ku turiba twaizire omu nsi egi, oryakoma aka kagoye akarikutukura omu dirisa ei waaturabyamu, oteeranire omu nju yaawe sho na nyoko na banyaanyoko n'ab'omu ka ya sho boona.
en: Behold, when we come into the land, thou shalt bind this line of scarlet thread in the window which thou didst let us down by: and thou shalt bring thy father, and thy mother, and thy brethren, and all thy father's household, home unto thee.

rr: Omuntu weena oriba yaarugire omu nju, akaza omu nguuto, eshagama ye niwe eritukurira, kwonka itwe teritubaho; kandi ou oriba oine omu nju, yaagira ekyamubaho, eshagama ye niitwe eritukurira.
en: And it shall be, that whosoever shall go out of the doors of thy house into the street, his blood shall be upon his head, and we will be guiltless: and whosoever shall be with thee in the house, his blood shall be on our head, if any hand be upon him.

rr: Kwonka ku oritwatira enaama, titurigira rubanja rw'endahiro ei waaturahiza.
en: And if thou utter this our business, then we will be quit of thine oath which thou hast made us to swear.

rr: Yaagira ati: Kibe nk'oku mwagamba.
en: And she said, According unto your words, so be it.

rr: Atyo yaaboohereza, baagyenda; yaakoma akagoye karikutukura omu dirisa.
en: And she sent them away, and they departed: and she bound the scarlet line in the window.

rr: Baagyenda baaza omu bibungo, baamarayo kashatu, okuhitsya obu abaabaire nibabasherura baagarukireyo; ahabw'okuba bakabasherura omu muhanda gwona, baababurira.
en: And they went, and came unto the mountain, and abode there three days, until the pursuers were returned: and the pursuers sought them throughout all the way, but found them not.

rr: Bwanyima ezo entatsi zombi zaaruga omu bibungo, zaashuuma, zaayambuka; ku zaahikire ahari Yoshua mwene Nuuni, zaamuteekyerereza byona ebyazibaireho.
en: So the two men returned, and descended from the mountain, and passed over, and came to Joshua the son of Nun, and told him all things that befell them:

rr: Zaagira Yoshua ziti: N'eky'amazima, MUKAMA atuhaire ensi egi yoona, kandi n'abatuuzi baamwo boona nibahwerera omu maisho gaitu.
en: and they said unto Joshua, Truly the LORD hath delivered into our hands all the land; for even all the inhabitants of the country do faint because of us.

rr: Currently Selected: Yoshua 2 : RR64 Highlight Share <path d="M5 12a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h3a1 1 0 1 1 0 2H6a1 1 0 0 1-1-1ZM5 15a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h3a
Yoshua yaimuka kare omu kasheeshe; we n'Abaisraeli boona baaruga Shitimu, baahika Yorudani, baaraarayo batakambukire.
en: And Joshua rose early in the morning; and they removed from Shittim, and came to Jordan, he and all the children of Israel, and lodged there before they passed over.

rr: Bwanyima y'ebiro bishatu abatware baagyenda baaraba omu rusiisira
en: And it came to pass after three days, that the officers went through the host;

rr: nibaragiira abantu bati: Ku muraareebe eshanduukye y'endagaano ya MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu eyekoreirwe abanyamurwa Abaleevi, ahonaaho murugye ahu muri, mugikuratire
en: and they commanded the people, saying, When ye see the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, and the priests the Levites bearing it, then ye shall remove from your place, and go after it.

rr: mubone kumanya omuhanda ogu muraatoore, ahakuba timukagurabamuga. Kwonka mutsigye ahagati yaanyu nayo omwanya gwa mikono nk'enkumi ibiri; mutagiirira haihi.
en: Yet there shall be a space between you and it, about two thousand cubits by measure: come not near unto it, that ye may know the way by which ye must go: for ye have not passed this way heretofore.

rr: Yoshua yaagambira abantu ati: Mweyeze, ahabw'okuba nyencakare MUKAMA naija kukorera omuriimwe eby'okutangaaza.
en: And Joshua said unto the people, Sanctify yourselves: for to morrow the LORD will do wonders among you.

rr: Kandi Yoshua yaagambira abanyamurwa ati: Muheekye eshanduukye y'endagaano, mwambukye mwebembeire abantu.
en: And Joshua spake unto the priests, saying, Take up the ark of the covenant, and pass over before the people.

rr: Baaheeka eshanduukye y'endagaano, baayebembera abantu.
en: And they took up the ark of the covenant, and went before the people.

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Yoshua ati: Eri izooba niinyija kutandika kukuha ekitiinisa omu maisho g'Abaisraeli boona, bamanye ngu nk'oku naabaire ndi na Musa, nikwo ndikwija kuba naiwe.
en: And the LORD said unto Joshua, This day will I begin to magnify thee in the sight of all Israel, that they may know that, as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee.

rr: Noija kuragiira abanyamurwa abaheekire eshanduukye y'endagaano oti: Ku muraahikye aha nkungu y'amaizi ga Yorudani, muragaremu, mwemerere.
en: And thou shalt command the priests that bear the ark of the covenant, saying, When ye are come to the brink of the water of Jordan, ye shall stand still in Jordan.

rr: Yoshua yaagambira Abaisraeli ati: Muhikye aha, muhurire ebigambo bya MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu.
en: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, Come hither, and hear the words of the LORD your God.

rr: Yoshua yaagira ati: Eki nikyo muraamanyireho ku Ruhanga otahwaho ari omuriimwe kandi ku atariremwa kubinga Abanyakanaani omu maisho ganyu, Abahiiti, Abahiivi, Abaperizi, Abagirugashi, Abaamori n'Abayebusi.
en: And Joshua said, Hereby ye shall know that the living God is among you, and that he will without fail drive out from before you the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Hivites, and the Perizzites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Jebusites.

rr: Reeba, eshanduukye y'endagaano ya MUKAMA ow'ensi yoona neija kubabandiza kuza omuri Yorudani.
en: Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth passeth over before you into Jordan.

rr: Mbwenu mutoorane abantu ikumi na babiri omu nganda za Israeli, omuri buri ruganda mwihemu omuntu omwe.
en: Now therefore take you twelve men out of the tribes of Israel, out of every tribe a man.

rr: Ebigyere by'abanyamurwa abaheekire eshanduukye y'endagaano ya MUKAMA, Mukama ow'ensi yoona, ku biraahikye omu maizi ga Yorudani, amaizi ago agarikushuuma nigaruga eruguru nigaija kuzibirwa kugyenda, geemerere geerunzire hamwe. Abaisraeli okwambuka Yorudani
en: And it shall come to pass, as soon as the soles of the feet of the priests that bear the ark of the LORD , the Lord of all the earth, shall rest in the waters of Jordan, that the waters of Jordan shall be cut off from the waters that come down from above; and they shall stand upon an heap.

rr: Batyo abantu baaruga omu mahema gaabo kwambuka Yorudani, beebembeirwe abanyamurwa abaheekire eshanduukye y'endagaano
en: And it came to pass, when the people removed from their tents, to pass over Jordan, and the priests bearing the ark of the covenant before the people;

rr: ababaire bagiheekire, ku baahikire ahari Yorudani, baahitsya ebigyere byabo omu maizi, (omu igyesha amaizi ga Yorudani gaijura, garengyera aha nkungu zaayo zoona)
en: and as they that bare the ark were come unto Jordan, and the feet of the priests that bare the ark were dipped in the brim of the water, (for Jordan overfloweth all his banks all the time of harvest,)

rr: amaizi agaabaire nigashuuma, nigaruga eruguru, gaayemerera, gaayerunda hamwe hare munonga aha rurembo orurikwetwa Adamu aha rubaju rwa Zaretaani, n'agaabaire nigashuuma omu nyanja ya Araba, niyo Nyanja y'omwonyo, gaahweraho kimwe; abantu baayambuka bagyemire Yeriko.
en: that the waters which came down from above stood and rose up upon an heap very far from the city Adam, that is beside Zaretan: and those that came down toward the sea of the plain, even the salt sea, failed, and were cut off: and the people passed over right against Jericho.

rr: Abanyamurwa, abaabaire baheekire eshanduukye y'endagaano eya MUKAMA, baayemerera ahoomire batarikuterera ahagati ya Yorudani; n'Abaisraeli boona baayambukira ahoomire, okuhitsya obu eihanga ryona ryaherize kwambuka Yorudani.
en: And the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD stood firm on dry ground in the midst of Jordan, and all the Israelites passed over on dry ground, until all the people were passed clean over Jordan.

en: Currently Selected: Joshua 3 : KJV Highlight Share <path d="M5 12a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h3a1 1 0 1 1 0 2H6a1 1 0 0 1-1-1ZM5 15a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h3a1 1 0 1 1 0 2H6a1 1 0 0 1-1-1ZM5 9a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h3a1 1 0 0 1

rr: Eihanga ryona ku ryaherize kwambuka Yorudani, MUKAMA yaagambira Yoshua ati
en: And it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed over Jordan, that the LORD spake unto Joshua, saying,

rr: Iha abantu ikumi na babiri omu ihanga ryona, omuri buri ruganda oihemu omwe
en: Take you twelve men out of the people, out of every tribe a man,

rr: obaragiire oti: Mutorotoore amabaare ikumi n'abiri ahagati ya Yorudani, ahi ebigyere by'abanyamurwa byemereire, mugambukane, mugate ahu muraaraare eki kiro.
en: and command ye them, saying, Take you hence out of the midst of Jordan, out of the place where the priests' feet stood firm, twelve stones, and ye shall carry them over with you, and leave them in the lodging place, where ye shall lodge this night.

rr: Yoshua yaayeta abo bantu abu yaatooraine omu Baisraeli, omuntu omwe omuri buri ruganda
en: Then Joshua called the twelve men, whom he had prepared of the children of Israel, out of every tribe a man:

rr: yaabagira ati: Mwirooko mwebembere eshanduukye ya MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu okuhika ahagati ya Yorudani, buri muntu weena omuriimwe nk'oku enganda za Israeli zirikwingana, atorotoore eibaare, arite aha ibega
en: and Joshua said unto them, Pass over before the ark of the LORD your God into the midst of Jordan, and take you up every man of you a stone upon his shoulder, according unto the number of the tribes of the children of Israel:

rr: ako kabe akamanyiso omuriimwe, abaana baanyu ku baribabuuza omu biro ebiriija bati: Amabaare aga nigamanyisa ki?
en: that this may be a sign among you, that when your children ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What mean ye by these stones?

rr: naimwe muryabagira ngu amaizi ga Yorudani gakacuubwamu habiri omu maisho g'eshanduukye y'endagaano ya MUKAMA; obu yaayambuka Yorudani, amaizi gaayo gakacuubwamu habiri. Kandi amabaare aga garyaba ekiijutsyo ky'ebiro byona aha Baisraeli.
en: Then ye shall answer them, That the waters of Jordan were cut off before the ark of the covenant of the LORD ; when it passed over Jordan, the waters of Jordan were cut off: and these stones shall be for a memorial unto the children of Israel for ever.

rr: Abaisraeli baakora nk'oku Yoshua yaabaragiira, baatorotoora amabaare ikumi n'abiri ahagati ya Yorudani agarikwingana n'omubaro gw'enganda z'Abaisraeli, nk'oku MUKAMA agambiire Yoshua; baagambukana, baahika omu mwanya ahu baaraire, baagata aho.
en: And the children of Israel did so as Joshua commanded, and took up twelve stones out of the midst of Jordan, as the LORD spake unto Joshua, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel, and carried them over with them unto the place where they lodged, and laid them down there.

rr: Kandi Yoshua nawe yaabyara amabaare ikumi n'abiri ahagati ya Yorudani ahi ebigyere by'abanyamurwa abaabaire baheekire eshanduukye y'endagaano byayemereire; gakibaho n'okuhitsya hati. Abaisraeli okwambukira kimwe n'okugomberera Gilugaali
en: And Joshua set up twelve stones in the midst of Jordan, in the place where the feet of the priests which bare the ark of the covenant stood: and they are there unto this day.

rr: Abanyamurwa abaabaire baheekire eshanduukye baayemerera ahagati ya Yorudani, okuhitsya obu byona ebi MUKAMA yaagambiire Yoshua kumanyisa abantu byahweireyo, nk'ebi Musa yaaragiire Yoshua byona oku byabaire biri; abantu baayambuka nibeehuuta.
en: For the priests which bare the ark stood in the midst of Jordan, until every thing was finished that the LORD commanded Joshua to speak unto the people, according to all that Moses commanded Joshua: and the people hasted and passed over.

rr: Abantu boona ku baaherize kwambuka, eshanduukye ya MUKAMA nayo yaayambuka hamwe n'abanyamurwa, abantu nibabareeba.
en: And it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed over, that the ark of the LORD passed over, and the priests, in the presence of the people.

rr: Aba Reubeeni n'aba Gaadi n'ekicweka ky'oruganda rwa Manaase nabo baayambuka bakwaitse eby'okurwanisa, beebembeire Abaisraeli, nk'oku Musa yaabagambiire
en: And the children of Reuben, and the children of Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh, passed over armed before the children of Israel, as Moses spake unto them:

rr: bari nk'obukumi buna beeteekateekyeire orugamba, baayambuka omu maisho ga MUKAMA kurwanira omu mpita za Yeriko.
en: about forty thousand prepared for war passed over before the LORD unto battle, to the plains of Jericho.

rr: Aha izooba eryo MUKAMA yaaha Yoshua ekitiinisa omu maisho g'Abaisraeli boona; baaguma nibamutiina ebiro byona eby'amagara ge, nk'oku baabaire batiina Musa.
en: On that day the LORD magnified Joshua in the sight of all Israel; and they feared him, as they feared Moses, all the days of his life.

rr: Kandi MUKAMA yaagambira Yoshua ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Joshua, saying,

rr: Ragiira abanyamurwa abaheekire eshanduukye y'endagaano, bainamukye barugye omuri Yorudani.
en: Command the priests that bear the ark of the testimony, that they come up out of Jordan.

rr: Yoshua nikwo kuragiira abanyamurwa ati: Mwinamukye murugye omuri Yorudani.
en: Joshua therefore commanded the priests, saying, Come ye up out of Jordan.

rr: Kandi abanyamurwa abaabaire baheekire eshanduukye y'endagaano ya MUKAMA ku baarugire omuri Yorudani, ebigyere byabo byahika aha nkungu, amaizi ga Yorudani gaagaruka omu mwanya gwago, gaarengyera aha nkungu zaayo zoona, nk'oku gaabaire gari.
en: And it came to pass, when the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD were come up out of the midst of Jordan, and the soles of the priests' feet were lifted up unto the dry land, that the waters of Jordan returned unto their place, and flowed over all his banks, as they did before.

rr: Abantu baaruga omuri Yorudani aha kiro kya ikumi ky'okwezi kw'okubanza, baasiisira Gilugaali aha mwatano gwa Yeriko ogw'oburugwa-izooba.
en: And the people came up out of Jordan on the tenth day of the first month, and encamped in Gilgal, in the east border of Jericho.

rr: Kandi amabaare gari ikumi n'abiri agu baihire omuri Yorudani, Yoshua yaagabyara Gilugaali.
en: And those twelve stones, which they took out of Jordan, did Joshua pitch in Gilgal.

rr: Bwanyima yaagambira Abaisraeli ati: Abaana baanyu ku baribuuza baishebo omu biro ebiriija bati: Amabaare aga nigamanyisa ki?
en: And he spake unto the children of Israel, saying, When your children shall ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What mean these stones?

rr: obwo muryabashobororera muti: Abaisraeli bakambuka Yorudani egi eyomire.
en: Then ye shall let your children know, saying, Israel came over this Jordan on dry land.

rr: Ahabw'okuba MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu akoomya amaizi ga Yorudani omu maisho gaanyu, okuhitsya obu mwayambukire, nk'oku MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu yaagizire Enyanja erikutukura, ei yaayomize omu maisho gaitu, okuhitsya obu twayambukire
en: For the LORD your God dried up the waters of Jordan from before you, until ye were passed over, as the LORD your God did to the Red sea, which he dried up from before us, until we were gone over:

rr: 1 -29 ; ngu amahanga goona ag'ensi gabone kumanya omukono gwa MUKAMA ku guri ogw'amaani; kandi naimwe mubone kutiina MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu ebiro byona.
en: that all the people of the earth might know the hand of the LORD , that it is mighty: that ye might fear the LORD your God for ever.

en: Currently Selected: Joshua 4 : KJV Highlight Share <div class="text-text-light dark:t

rr: Abagabe b'Abaamori boona, abaabaire bari seeri ya Yorudani orubaju rw'oburengyerwa-izooba, n'abagabe b'Abanyakanaani boona, abaabaire batwire aha rubaju rw'enyanja, ku baahuriire ngu MUKAMA ayomize amaizi ga Yorudani omu maisho g'Abaisraeli, okuhitsya obu bambukire, emitima yaabahwa omunda, kandi tibaatsigarwamu mwoyo gwona ahabw'eihanga ry'Abaisraeli.
en: And it came to pass, when all the kings of the Amorites, which were on the side of Jordan westward, and all the kings of the Canaanites, which were by the sea, heard that the LORD had dried up the waters of Jordan from before the children of Israel, until we were passed over, that their heart melted, neither was there spirit in them any more, because of the children of Israel.

rr: Omu bunaku obwo MUKAMA akagambira Yoshua ati: Mwebaijere emisyo omu mabaare, oshare Abaisraeli obwa kabiri.
en: At that time the LORD said unto Joshua, Make thee sharp knives, and circumcise again the children of Israel the second time.

rr: Yoshua yaabaija emisyo omu mabaare, yaasharira Abaisraeli aha mugongo Aralooti.
en: And Joshua made him sharp knives, and circumcised the children of Israel at the hill of the foreskins.

rr: Kandi ekyareeteire Yoshua okubashara n'eki; abashaija boona abaarugire Misri bakaba baherize kugwa omu muhanda ogurikuraba omu ihamba, barimu abarwani boona abaarugire Misri.
en: And this is the cause why Joshua did circumcise: All the people that came out of Egypt, that were males, even all the men of war, died in the wilderness by the way, after they came out of Egypt.

rr: Abantu boona abaarugire Misri bakaba bashazirwe; kwonka boona abu baazaariire omu ihamba bakiri omu muhanda baarugire Misri, bo bakaba batakashazirwe.
en: Now all the people that came out were circumcised: but all the people that were born in the wilderness by the way as they came forth out of Egypt, them they had not circumcised.

rr: Ahakuba Abaisraeli bakamara emyaka makumi ana nibazengyerera omu ihamba, okuhitsya obu abashaija abarwani b'eihanga ryabo ryona baafiire bakahwaho ahabw'okutahurira iraka rya MUKAMA; kandi MUKAMA akaba yaabarahiire ku ataribaikiriza kureeba ensi ei yaaraganiise baishenkurubo kutuha, ensi ey'amate n'obwoki.
en: For the children of Israel walked forty years in the wilderness, till all the people that were men of war, which came out of Egypt, were consumed, because they obeyed not the voice of the LORD : unto whom the LORD sware that he would not shew them the land, which the LORD sware unto their fathers that he would give us, a land that floweth with milk and honey.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo abaana baabo abu MUKAMA yaagarwire omu mwanya gwabo, nibo Yoshua yaashazire; bakaba batashazirwe, ahabw'okuba tibarashazirwe bakiri omu muhanda.
en: And their children, whom he raised up in their stead, them Joshua circumcised: for they were uncircumcised, because they had not circumcised them by the way.

rr: Abashaija boona, ku baaherize kusharwa, baaguma omu myanya yaabo omu rusiisira, okuhitsya obu baakizire.
en: And it came to pass, when they had done circumcising all the people, that they abode in their places in the camp, till they were whole.

rr: Bwanyima MUKAMA yaagambira Yoshua ati: Eri izooba naabaihaho ekijumo eky'Abanyamisri.
en: And the LORD said unto Joshua, This day have I rolled away the reproach of Egypt from off you.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo omwanya ogwo gukeetwa Gilugaali n'okuhitsya hati.
en: Wherefore the name of the place is called Gilgal unto this day.

rr: Abaisraeli ku baabaire bakiri Gilugaali, baagira obugyenyi bw'okwijuka Okuhingurwaho aha kiro ky'okwezi ekya ikumi na bina omu mwabazyo omu mpita za Yeriko.
en: And the children of Israel encamped in Gilgal, and kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the month at even in the plains of Jericho.

rr: Omu kasheeshe akaakuratiire Okuhingurwaho aha izooba eryo baarya aha by'okurya by'egyo nsi, emigaati etatumbisiibwe n'ebicoori bikarangire.
en: And they did eat of the old corn of the land on the morrow after the passover, unleavened cakes, and parched corn in the selfsame day.

rr: Ku baaherize kurya eby'okurya by'egyo nsi, omu kasheeshe akandi emaanu tiyaaboneka; kandi Abaisraeli tibaagaruka kugitunga, kureka baaguma nibarya eby'okurya by'ensi ya Kanaani ogwo mwaka.
en: And the manna ceased on the morrow after they had eaten of the old corn of the land; neither had the children of Israel manna any more; but they did eat of the fruit of the land of Canaan that year.

rr: Yoshua okubugaabugana na maraika
en: Fall of Jericho

rr: Yoshua ku yaabaire ari haihi na Yeriko, yaimutsya amaisho, yaareeba omushaija amwemereire omumaisho, aine rurara esyoirweyo omu mukono gwe. Yoshua yaamuhikaho, yaamubuuza ati: Ori ow'orubaju rwaitu, nari orw'abazigu?
en: And it came to pass, when Joshua was by Jericho, that he lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, there stood a man over against him with his sword drawn in his hand: and Joshua went unto him, and said unto him, Art thou for us, or for our adversaries?

rr: Yaamugarukamu ati: Ngaaha! kureka naija kuba omukuru w'eihe rya MUKAMA.
en: And he said, Nay; but as captain of the host of the LORD am I now come.

rr: Yoshua yaagwa ahansi, yaajuumara, yaamuramya, yaamubuuza ati: Mukama wangye, nooragiira ki omwiru waawe?
en: And Joshua fell on his face to the earth, and did worship, and said unto him, What saith my lord unto his servant?

rr: Omukuru w'eihe rya MUKAMA yaagira Yoshua ati: Iha enkaito omu bigyere byawe; ahakuba omwanya ogu oyemereiremu n'ogurikwera.
en: And the captain of the LORD 's host said unto Joshua, Loose thy shoe from off thy foot; for the place whereon thou standest is holy.

rr: Yoshua yaakora atyo.
en: And Joshua did so.

rr: Yeriko ekaba ekingiirwe kimwe ahabw'okutiina Abaisraeli; tihaine waabaire naashohora n'obu kwakuba okutaaha.
en: Now Jericho was straitly shut up because of the children of Israel: none went out, and none came in.

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Yoshua ati: Reeba, nkuhaire Yeriko n'omugabe waayo n'abashaija baayo amamanzi g'amaani.
en: And the LORD said unto Joshua, See, I have given into thine hand Jericho, and the king thereof, and the mighty men of valour.

rr: Imwe mwena, abashaija abarwani, nimwija kweziguurutsya orurembo omurundi gumwe; mukore mutyo amazooba mukaaga.
en: And ye shall compass the city, all ye men of war, and go round about the city once. Thus shalt thou do six days.

rr: Kandi abanyamurwa mushanju nibaija kutwara enzamba mushanju z'amahembe g'empaya z'entaama, beebembere eshanduukye y'endagaano; aha izooba rya mushanju muziguurukye orurembo emirundi mushanju, obwo abanyamurwa nibateera enzamba.
en: And seven priests shall bear before the ark seven trumpets of rams' horns: and the seventh day ye shall compass the city seven times, and the priests shall blow with the trumpets.

rr: Ku baraateere enzamba y'akasirikiriro n'eihembe ry'empaya y'entaama, naimwe mwahurira eiraka ryayo, abantu boona bateerere hamwe orwari; ahonaaho orugo rw'amabaare rw'orurembo nirwija kukumbagara, rugwe ahansi, buri muntu arutembere ahu araabe yaahika.
en: And it shall come to pass, that when they make a long blast with the ram's horn, and when ye hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people shall shout with a great shout; and the wall of the city shall fall down flat, and the people shall ascend up every man straight before him.

rr: Bwanyima Yoshua mwene Nuuni yaayeta abanyamurwa, yaabagira ati: Muheekye eshanduukye y'endagaano, kandi n'abanyamurwa mushanju batware enzamba mushanju z'amahembe g'empaya z'entaama beebembere eshanduukye ya MUKAMA.
en: And Joshua the son of Nun called the priests, and said unto them, Take up the ark of the covenant, and let seven priests bear seven trumpets of rams' horns before the ark of the LORD .

rr: Kandi yaagambira abantu ati: Mwimukye, muziguurukye orurembo, abaine eby'okurwanisa barabeho beebembere eshanduukye ya MUKAMA.
en: And he said unto the people, Pass on, and compass the city, and let him that is armed pass on before the ark of the LORD .

rr: Yoshua ku yaaherize kugambira abantu, abanyamurwa mushanju abaabaire baine enzamba mushanju z'amahembe g'empaya z'entaama omu maisho ga Mukama baagyenda omu maisho, nibateera enzamba, eshanduukye y'endagaano ya MUKAMA ebakuratiire.
en: And it came to pass, when Joshua had spoken unto the people, that the seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams' horns passed on before the LORD , and blew with the trumpets: and the ark of the covenant of the LORD followed them.

rr: Abashaija abaabaire baine eby'okurwanisa baayebembera abanyamurwa abaabaire nibateera enzamba; ab'enyima baakuratira eshanduukye, obwo enzamba zigumiizemu nizigamba.
en: And the armed men went before the priests that blew with the trumpets, and the rereward came after the ark, the priests going on, and blowing with the trumpets.

rr: Yoshua yaaragiira abantu ati: Mutateera orwari, n'amaraka gaanyu gatahurirwa, kandi hatagira owaateeza, okuhitsya aha izooba eri ndaabaragiirireho kuteera orwari; obwo nibwo muraaruteere.
en: And Joshua had commanded the people, saying, Ye shall not shout, nor make any noise with your voice, neither shall any word proceed out of your mouth, until the day I bid you shout; then shall ye shout.

rr: Atyo yaaziguurutsya eshanduukye ya MUKAMA orurembo omurundi gumwe; baagaruka omu rusiisira, baaraaramu.
en: So the ark of the LORD compassed the city, going about it once: and they came into the camp, and lodged in the camp.

rr: Bwanyima Yoshua yaaguruka kare omu kasheeshe, abanyamurwa baaheeka eshanduukye ya MUKAMA.
en: And Joshua rose early in the morning, and the priests took up the ark of the LORD .

rr: N'abanyamurwa mushanju, abaabaire baine enzamba mushanju z'amahembe g'empaya z'entaama beebembeire eshanduukye ya MUKAMA, baarabaho, baagumizamu nibateera enzamba; n'abashaija abaabaire baine eby'okurwanisa baabeebembera, ab'enyima baakuratira eshanduukye ya MUKAMA, obwo enzamba nizigamba.
en: And seven priests bearing seven trumpets of rams' horns before the ark of the LORD went on continually, and blew with the trumpets: and the armed men went before them; but the rereward came after the ark of the LORD , the priests going on, and blowing with the trumpets.

rr: N'aha izooba rya kabiri baaziguuruka orurembo omurundi gumwe; baagaruka omu rusiisira rwabo. Baamara ebiro mukaaga nibakora batyo.
en: And the second day they compassed the city once, and returned into the camp: so they did six days.

rr: Aha izooba rya mushanju baimuka kare omushekye nigujuguta, baaziguuruka orurembo, nk'oku baabaire nibagira; kwonka aha izooba eryo baaruziguuruka emirundi mushanju.
en: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that they rose early about the dawning of the day, and compassed the city after the same manner seven times: only on that day they compassed the city seven times.

rr: Aha murundi gwa mushanju, abanyamurwa ku baateire enzamba, Yoshua yaagambira abantu ati: Muteere orwari! ahakuba orurembo MUKAMA yaarubaha.
en: And it came to pass at the seventh time, when the priests blew with the trumpets, Joshua said unto the people, Shout; for the LORD hath given you the city.

rr: Kandi orurembo n'ebirimu byona nibiija kubiikirwa MUKAMA, kureka Rahabu maraaya na boona abaraashangwe omu nju ye nibo baraakire, ahabw'okuba akashereka entumwa ezi twatumire.
en: And the city shall be accursed, even it, and all that are therein, to the LORD : only Rahab the harlot shall live, she and all that are with her in the house, because she hid the messengers that we sent.

rr: Kwonka imwe mwerindire kimwe ekintu kyona ekibiikiirwe MUKAMA; ku muraabe mwabibiikire, hatakaagira owaatwara kimwe aharibyo, akareetera orusiisira rw'Abaisraeli kuhwerekyerera n'okwitwa kubi.
en: And ye, in any wise keep yourselves from the accursed thing, lest ye make yourselves accursed, when ye take of the accursed thing, and make the camp of Israel a curse, and trouble it.

rr: Kwonka efeeza yoona n'ezaabu, ebintu eby'emiringa n'ebyoma n'ebirikwera ebitooraniirwe MUKAMA; bize omu ibiikiro rye.
en: But all the silver, and gold, and vessels of brass and iron, are consecrated unto the LORD : they shall come into the treasury of the LORD .

rr: Ahonaaho abantu baateera orwari, n'enzamba zaateerwa. Abantu ku baahuriire eiraka ry'enzamba, baateera munonga orwari, orugo rwakumbagara, rwagwa ahansi, batyo abantu baarutemberaho, baataaha omu rurembo, omuntu weena ahu yaabaire yaahika, baarukwata.
en: So the people shouted when the priests blew with the trumpets: and it came to pass, when the people heard the sound of the trumpet, and the people shouted with a great shout, that the wall fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city, every man straight before him, and they took the city.

rr: Baacwekyerereza kimwe ekintu kyona ekyabaire kirimu, abashaija n'abakazi, abato n'abakuru, ente n'entaama n'endogoya, baabiitsa rurara.
en: And they utterly destroyed all that was in the city, both man and woman, young and old, and ox, and sheep, and ass, with the edge of the sword.

rr: Bwanyima Yoshua yaagira abashaija bari ababiri abaatatsire ensi, ati: Mutaahe omu nju ya maraaya, mwihemu ogwo mukazi n'abe boona, nk'oku mwamuraganiise.
en: But Joshua had said unto the two men that had spied out the country, Go into the harlot's house, and bring out thence the woman, and all that she hath, as ye sware unto her.

rr: Batyo abo batsigazi abaatatsire baataahamu, baihamu Rahabu, na ishe, na nyina, na banyaanya n'ebye byona; kandi baihamu n'abu aine nabo obuzaare, baabata aheeru y'orusiisira rw'Abaisraeli.
en: And the young men that were spies went in, and brought out Rahab, and her father, and her mother, and her brethren, and all that she had; and they brought out all her kindred, and left them without the camp of Israel.

rr: Bwanyima baayotsya orurembo n'ebyabaire birimu byona; kwonka efeeza n'ezaabu n'ebintu by'emiringa n'ebyoma baabita omu ibiikiro ery'omu nju ya Mukama.
en: And they burnt the city with fire, and all that was therein: only the silver, and the gold, and the vessels of brass and of iron, they put into the treasury of the house of the LORD .

rr: Kwonka Rahabu maraaya, n'enju ya ishe n'abe boona Yoshua yaabarokora; Rahabu ogwo yaatuura omuri Israeli n'okuhitsya eri izooba, ahakuba akashereka entumwa ezi Yoshua yaatumire kutata Yeriko. Yoshua okukyeena Yeriko
en: And Joshua saved Rahab the harlot alive, and her father's household, and all that she had; and she dwelleth in Israel even unto this day; because she hid the messengers, which Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.

rr: Obwo Yoshua yaabeehanangiriza naarahira ati: Omuntu weena oriimuka, akagaruka kwombeka orurembo oru Yeriko, akyeenwe omu maisho ga MUKAMA. Omu bunaku obu ariba naayombekyeramu omusingi, omwana we w'omujigaijo aryafa; kandi ku ariba naabyara ebiti by'amarembo gaarwo, omwana wa bucuranda aryafa.
en: And Joshua adjured them at that time, saying, Cursed be the man before the LORD , that riseth up and buildeth this city Jericho: he shall lay the foundation thereof in his firstborn, and in his youngest son shall he set up the gates of it.

rr: Okwo nikwo MUKAMA yaagumire na Yoshua, n'okurangaanwa kwe kukabuga ensi yoona.
en: So the LORD was with Joshua; and his fame was noised throughout all the country.

rr: Kwonka Abaisraeli baacumura omu byabiikiirwe MUKAMA; ahakuba Akani, mwene Karumi, mwijukuru wa Zabudi, mwene Zeera, ow'omu ruganda rwa Yuda, akatwara aha bibiikirwe; MUKAMA yaagirira Abaisraeli ekiniga, kyayaka nk'omuriro.
en: But the children of Israel committed a trespass in the accursed thing: for Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took of the accursed thing: and the anger of the LORD was kindled against the children of Israel.

rr: Yoshua yaatuma abantu ari Yeriko kuza Ai haihi na Besaveeni, aha rubaju rw'oburugwa-izooba bwa Beseeli, naabagira ati: Mwinamukye mutate egyo nsi.
en: And Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is beside Beth-aven, on the east side of Beth-el, and spake unto them, saying, Go up and view the country.

rr: Abashaija abo baagyenda baatata Ai.
en: And the men went up and viewed Ai.

rr: Bwanyima baagaruka ahari Yoshua, baamugira bati: Abantu boona batazayo, kureka hagyende abantu nk'enkumi ibiri nari ishatu, babe nibo baateera Ai, otaruhiza busha abantu boona, ahabw'okuba abantu baayo ni bakye.
en: And they returned to Joshua, and said unto him, Let not all the people go up; but let about two or three thousand men go up and smite Ai; and make not all the people to labour thither; for they are but few.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo hainamukayo abantu nk'enkumi ishatu; ku baahikireyo, aba Ai baababinga.
en: So there went up thither of the people about three thousand men: and they fled before the men of Ai.

rr: Baabaitamu abantu nka makumi ashatu na mukaaga; baabaiha omu maisho g'amarembo gaabo, bababingire baabahitsya Shebariimu, baabaitira aha kashuumo. N'ahabw'ekyo emitima y'abantu yaayaga, yaaba nk'amaizi. Yoshua okutakira Mukama, n'okumubuuza ekyababingisa
en: And the men of Ai smote of them about thirty and six men: for they chased them from before the gate even unto Shebarim, and smote them in the going down: wherefore the hearts of the people melted, and became as water.

rr: -5 ; Yoshua ku yaakihuriire, yaataagura eby'okujwara bye, yaagwa ahansi, yaajuumara omu maisho ge'shanduukye ya MUKAMA okuhitsya omu mwabazyo, we n'abakuru b'Abaisraeli; baayeshuka eiju omu mutwe.
en: And Joshua rent his clothes, and fell to the earth upon his face before the ark of the LORD until the eventide, he and the elders of Israel, and put dust upon their heads.

rr: Yoshua nikwo kugira ati: Ai bambe, MUKAMA Ruhanga! aba bantu okabambukiza ki Yorudani okutuhayo omu mikono y'Abaamori kutuhwerekyereza? Haakiri kuri twagumire seeri ya Yorudani!
en: And Joshua said, Alas, O Lord GOD , wherefore hast thou at all brought this people over Jordan, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us? would to God we had been content, and dwelt on the other side Jordan!

rr: Ai MUKAMA, mbwenu ngambe ki, obu Abaisraeli baateire abazigu baabo amabega!
en: O Lord, what shall I say, when Israel turneth their backs before their enemies!

rr: Ahakuba Abanyakanaani n'abatwire omu nsi egi nibaija kukihurira, batukubire ahagati, bamare eiziina ryaitu omu nsi. Mbwenu oryakora ki ahabw'eiziina ryawe erikuru?
en: For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land shall hear of it , and shall environ us round, and cut off our name from the earth: and what wilt thou do unto thy great name?

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Yoshua ati: Imuka! N'enki ekikujuumaize ahansi?
en: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Get thee up; wherefore liest thou thus upon thy face?

rr: Abaisraeli bacumwire, baita endagaano yangye, ei naabahaire; baatwara aha bibiikirwe, baiba, kandi baaryaraya, baabita omu bintu byabo.
en: Israel hath sinned, and they have also transgressed my covenant which I commanded them: for they have even taken of the accursed thing, and have also stolen, and dissembled also, and they have put it even among their own stuff.

rr: Nikyo Abaisraeli batarikubaasiza kusyamirana n'abazigu baabo; nibabahunga ahabw'okuba bahindukire abakyeenirwe. Kandi tindiguma naimwe bundi, kureka biri mwahwerekyereza ebibiikiirwe MUKAMA ebiri omuriimwe.
en: Therefore the children of Israel could not stand before their enemies, but turned their backs before their enemies, because they were accursed: neither will I be with you any more, except ye destroy the accursed from among you.

rr: Imuka, oyeze abantu, kandi obagire oti; Mweyeze ahabw'eizooba rya nyencakare; ahakuba MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli naagira ati: Imwe Baisraeli 'mwe, omuriimwe harimu ebibiikiirwe MUKAMA; timurikubaasa kusyamirana n'abazigu baanyu, okuhitsya obu muraihe omuriimwe ebibiikirwe.
en: Up, sanctify the people, and say, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow: for thus saith the LORD God of Israel, There is an accursed thing in the midst of thee, O Israel: thou canst not stand before thine enemies, until ye take away the accursed thing from among you.

rr: 1 -21 ; N'ahabw'ekyo omu kasheeshe nimwija kureetwa haihi omu nganda zaanyu; kandi oruganda oru MUKAMA araatoorane nirwija kwija nk'emiryango yaarwo oku eri; kandi omuryango ogu MUKAMA araatoorane nigwija kwija nk'amaju gaagwo oku gari; kandi enju ei MUKAMA araatoorane hagume nihaija omuntu omwe-omwe.
en: In the morning therefore ye shall be brought according to your tribes: and it shall be, that the tribe which the LORD taketh shall come according to the families thereof ; and the family which the LORD shall take shall come by households; and the household which the LORD shall take shall come man by man.

rr: Kandi oraakwatwe aine ebintu ebibiikirwe naija kwokibwa n'ebi aine byona; ahakuba aitsire endagaano ya MUKAMA, yaakora ekirikuhemura omu Baisraeli. Akani okukwatwa n'okwitwa
en: And it shall be, that he that is taken with the accursed thing shall be burnt with fire, he and all that he hath: because he hath transgressed the covenant of the LORD , and because he hath wrought folly in Israel.

rr: Yoshua yaaguruka kare omu kasheeshe, yaateeranira hamwe Abaisraeli omu nganda zaabo; oruganda rwa Yuda rwatooranwa
en: So Joshua rose up early in the morning, and brought Israel by their tribes; and the tribe of Judah was taken:

rr: yairiza haihi emiryango ya Yuda, haatooranwamu omuryango gwa Zeera; yairiza haihi ab'enju ya Zeera omwe-omwe, Zabudi yaatooranwa
en: and he brought the family of Judah; and he took the family of the Zarhites: and he brought the family of the Zarhites man by man; and Zabdi was taken:

rr: yairiza haihi ab'enju ya Zabudi omwe-omwe, haatooranwa Akani mwene Karumi, mwijukuru wa Zabudi, mwene Zeera ow'omu ruganda rwa Yuda.
en: and he brought his household man by man; and Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was taken.

rr: Yoshua yaagira Akani ati: Mwana wangye, ninkweshengyereza, heereza MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli ekitiinisa, omwaturire; kandi ongambire hati mbwenu eki okozire, otakinshereka.
en: And Joshua said unto Achan, My son, give, I pray thee, glory to the LORD God of Israel, and make confession unto him; and tell me now what thou hast done; hide it not from me.

rr: Akani yaagarukamu Yoshua, naagira ati: N'eky'amazima ncumwire ahari MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli, kandi eki nikyo nkozire.
en: And Achan answered Joshua, and said, Indeed I have sinned against the LORD God of Israel, and thus and thus have I done:

rr: 2 -27 ; . Ku ndeebire omu minyago ekijwaro kirungi kya Shinaari na shekeli magana abiri z'efeeza kandi n'omuhimba gw'ezaabu ogwine oburemeezi bwa shekeli makumi ataano, naabyetenga, naabitwara; na mbwenu bisherekire omu itaka, biri omu ihema ryangye ahagati, n'efeeza eri ahansi yaabyo.
en: When I saw among the spoils a goodly Babylonish garment, and two hundred shekels of silver, and a wedge of gold of fifty shekels weight, then I coveted them, and took them; and, behold, they are hid in the earth in the midst of my tent, and the silver under it.

rr: Yoshua nikwo kutuma entumwa, zikairuka, zikataaha omu ihema, zikashanga besherekire omu ihema rye n'efeeza eri ahansi yaabyo
en: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran unto the tent; and, behold, it was hid in his tent, and the silver under it.

rr: bakabiihamu bakabireetera Yoshua n'Abaisraeli boona, bakabita ahansi omu maisho ga MUKAMA.
en: And they took them out of the midst of the tent, and brought them unto Joshua, and unto all the children of Israel, and laid them out before the LORD .

rr: Yoshua n'Abaisraeli boona baatwara Akani mutabani wa Zeera n'efeeza n'ekijwaro n'omuhimba gw'ezaabu n'abatabani na bahara be n'ente ze n'endogoya ze n'entaama ze n'eihema rye n'ebi yaabaire aine byona, baabishuumya omu ruhanga rwa Akori.
en: And Joshua, and all Israel with him, took Achan the son of Zerah, and the silver, and the garment, and the wedge of gold, and his sons, and his daughters, and his oxen, and his asses, and his sheep, and his tent, and all that he had: and they brought them unto the valley of Achor.

rr: Ku baahikireyo, Yoshua yaamubuuza ati: Otwitiire ki kubi? Naiwe MUKAMA yaaza kukwita kubi eri izooba. Abaisraeli boona baamuteera amabaare; ku baaherize kubateera amabaare, baabootsya n'omuriro.
en: And Joshua said, Why hast thou troubled us? the LORD shall trouble thee this day. And all Israel stoned him with stones, and burned them with fire, after they had stoned them with stones.

rr: Bwanyima baamurundaho omutuumo muhango gw'amabaare, ogukiriho n'eri izooba.
en: And they raised over him a great heap of stones unto this day.

rr: Okuruga obwo MUKAMA yaayegarukamu, yaareka ekiniga kye kingi.
en: So the LORD turned from the fierceness of his anger.

rr: Na mbwenu omwanya ogwo nigukyetwa Oruhanga rwa Akori n'okuhitsya hati.
en: Wherefore the name of that place was called, The valley of Achor, unto this day.
