rr: Bwanyima MUKAMA yaagambira Yoshua ati: Otatiina, n'obu kwakuba okuhahaaza omutima; twara abarwani boona, oimukye oinamukye oteere Ai; reeba, ntaire omugabe waayo n'abantu be n'orurembo rwe n'ensi ye omu mikono yaawe.
en: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Fear not, neither be thou dismayed: take all the people of war with thee, and arise, go up to Ai: see, I have given into thy hand the king of Ai, and his people, and his city, and his land:

rr: Noija kugira Ai n'omugabe waayo nk'oku waagizire Yeriko n'omugabe waayo; kwonka eminyago yaayo n'ente zaayo mubyetwarire, bibe eminyago yaanyu; mugwere enyima y'orurembo.
en: and thou shalt do to Ai and her king as thou didst unto Jericho and her king: only the spoil thereof, and the cattle thereof, shall ye take for a prey unto yourselves: lay thee an ambush for the city behind it.

rr: Yoshua nikwo kwimuka n'engabo ze zoona kuza kuteera Ai; akatoorana abashaija b'amaani amamanzi obukumi bushatu, akaboohereza nyekiro
en: So Joshua arose, and all the people of war, to go up against Ai: and Joshua chose out thirty thousand mighty men of valour, and sent them away by night.

rr: Kandi akabaragiira ati: Reeba, nimwija kugwera enyima y'orurembo; mutaruza hare munonga, kureka mugume mweteekateekire
en: And he commanded them, saying, Behold, ye shall lie in wait against the city, even behind the city: go not very far from the city, but be ye all ready:

rr: nyowe n'abantu abu nyine nitwija kwirira haihi n'orurembo; ku baraije kuturwanisa nk'okubanza, nitwija kubahunga
en: and I, and all the people that are with me, will approach unto the city: and it shall come to pass, when they come out against us, as at the first, that we will flee before them,

rr: nabo nibaija kwija batubingire, okuhitsya obu turaababeihabeihe tukabaiha omu rurembo; ahakuba nibaija kugira bati: Baatuhunga nk'okubanza; itwe nitwija kugumizamu kubahunga
en: (for they will come out after us) till we have drawn them from the city; for they will say, They flee before us, as at the first: therefore we will flee before them.

rr: haza imwe abaaba babagwereire mwimukye mukwate orurembo; ahakuba MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu naija kuruhayo omu mikono yaanyu.
en: Then ye shall rise up from the ambush, and seize upon the city: for the LORD your God will deliver it into your hand.

rr: Ku muraaheze kurukwata, murutwekyemu omuriro; mutwaze nk'oku MUKAMA yaabaragiire; ekyo nikyo naabaragiira.
en: And it shall be, when ye have taken the city, that ye shall set the city on fire: according to the commandment of the LORD shall ye do. See, I have commanded you.

rr: Yoshua yaaboohereza, baaza ahu barikuza kugwera, baaraara ahagati ya Beseeli na Ai aha rubaju rw'oburengyerwa-izooba bwa Ai; kwonka ekyo kiro Yoshua we yaaraara n'abatsigaireyo.
en: Joshua therefore sent them forth: and they went to lie in ambush, and abode between Beth-el and Ai, on the west side of Ai: but Joshua lodged that night among the people.

rr: Yaimuka kare omu kasheeshe, yaateerana abantu, yainamuka n'abakuru b'Abaisraeli, beebembeire abantu nibaza Ai.
en: And Joshua rose up early in the morning, and numbered the people, and went up, he and the elders of Israel, before the people to Ai.

rr: Abantu boona abarwani abu yaabaire aine bainamuka, baahika haihi omu maisho g'orurembo, baasiisira aha rubaju rwa bumosho orwa Ai; aho hakaba hariho oruhanga ahagati yaabo na Ai.
en: And all the people, even the people of war that were with him, went up, and drew nigh, and came before the city, and pitched on the north side of Ai: now there was a valley between them and Ai.

rr: Bwanyima yaatwara abantu nk'enkumi itaano, yaabaragiira kugwera ahagati ya Beseeli na Ai aha rubaju rw'oburengyerwa-izooba bw'orurembo.
en: And he took about five thousand men, and set them to lie in ambush between Beth-el and Ai, on the west side of the city.

rr: Okwo nikwo baatengire orugamba; eihe ry'amaani bakarita aha rubaju rwa bumosho rw'orurembo, n'abandi ab'okugwera, baabata aha rubaju rw'oburengyerwa-izooba; kwonka Yoshua ekyo kiro yaakiraara omu ruhanga.
en: And when they had set the people, even all the host that was on the north of the city, and their liers in wait on the west of the city, Joshua went that night into the midst of the valley.

rr: Omugabe wa Ai ku yaakireebire, we n'abantu be boona ab'omu rurembo baimuka kare n'obwira, baaza kurwanisa Abaisraeli aharikushuuma omu ruhita; kwonka tiyaamanya ku hariho abagwereire enyima y'orurembo.
en: And it came to pass, when the king of Ai saw it , that they hasted and rose up early, and the men of the city went out against Israel to battle, he and all his people, at a time appointed, before the plain; but he wist not that there were liers in ambush against him behind the city.

rr: Yoshua n'Abaisraeli boona baayehindura nk'abaabingwa omu maisho gaabo, baahunga nibatoora omu ihamba.
en: And Joshua and all Israel made as if they were beaten before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness.

rr: N'abantu boona abaabaire bari omu rurembo baayetwa kuteeranira hamwe kubakurata; ku baayeyongyeire kubinga Yoshua, baayeyongyera kuza hare n'orurembo.
en: And all the people that were in Ai were called together to pursue after them: and they pursued after Joshua, and were drawn away from the city.

rr: Tihaagira mushaija weena owaatsigara omuri Ai nari omuri Beseeli, otarashohoire kubinga Abaisraeli; baatsiga orurembo rurangaire, baakurata Abaisraeli.
en: And there was not a man left in Ai or Beth-el, that went not out after Israel: and they left the city open, and pursued after Israel.

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Yoshua ati: Imutsya eicumu ryawe eri okwaitse, oryorekye Ai; ahakuba naaza kugihayo omu mikono yaawe.
en: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Stretch out the spear that is in thy hand toward Ai; for I will give it into thine hand.

rr: Yoshua yaimutsya eicumu eri yaabaire akwaitse, yaaryoreka Ai.
en: And Joshua stretched out the spear that he had in his hand toward the city.

rr: Ku yaagoroire omukono gwe, abaabaire bagwereire ahonaaho baimuka ahu baabaire bari, bairuka, baataaha omu rurembo; baarukwata, baarahuka baarutwekamu omuriro.
en: And the ambush arose quickly out of their place, and they ran as soon as he had stretched out his hand: and they entered into the city, and took it, and hasted and set the city on fire.

rr: Aba Ai ku baanagire amaisho enyima, baareeba omwika nigutuumuuka ahaiguru, baabura agahungira oku nari kuriya, ahakuba abaabaire bahungiire omu ihamba bakahindukana abaabaire bababingire.
en: And when the men of Ai looked behind them, they saw, and, behold, the smoke of the city ascended up to heaven, and they had no power to flee this way or that way: and the people that fled to the wilderness turned back upon the pursuers.

rr: Yoshua n'ab'Abaisraeli boona ku baareebire abaabaire bagwereire baakwata orurembo, kandi baareeba n'omwika gw'omu rurembo nigutuumuuka ahaiguru, baagaruka, baita abantu ba Ai.
en: And when Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had taken the city, and that the smoke of the city ascended, then they turned again, and slew the men of Ai.

rr: N'abaakwatsire orurembo baashohora kubarwanisa; aba Ai nikwo kukubirwa ahagati y'Abaisraeli, bakabareetwa oku n'oku, bakabaita, hakabura owaahonoka aha icumu, n'obu kwakuba okuhunga.
en: And the other issued out of the city against them; so they were in the midst of Israel, some on this side, and some on that side: and they smote them, so that they let none of them remain or escape.

rr: Omugabe wa Ai we baamukwata ahuriire, baamureetera Yoshua.
en: And the king of Ai they took alive, and brought him to Joshua.

rr: Abaisraeli ku baaherize kwitira kimwe aba Ai boona omu bwerere omu irungu, ei baabaire babakuratiire, n'abandi boona baabaita na rurara, okuhitsya obu baabamariireho kimwe, baagaruka Ai, baagihwerekyereza na rurara.
en: And it came to pass, when Israel had made an end of slaying all the inhabitants of Ai in the field, in the wilderness wherein they chased them, and when they were all fallen on the edge of the sword, until they were consumed, that all the Israelites returned unto Ai, and smote it with the edge of the sword.

rr: Abantu boona aba Ai, abaafiire eryo izooba, abashaija n'abakazi, bakaba bari kakumi n'enkumi ibiri
en: And so it was, that all that fell that day, both of men and women, were twelve thousand, even all the men of Ai.

rr: ahakuba Yoshua taragwisize mukono gwe, ogwabaire gwimukize eicumu, okuhitsya obu yaaherize kucwekyerereza kimwe aba Ai boona.
en: For Joshua drew not his hand back, wherewith he stretched out the spear, until he had utterly destroyed all the inhabitants of Ai.

rr: Kureka ente n'eminyago eby'omuri orwo rurembo Abaisraeli bakabyetwarira, nk'oku MUKAMA yaagambiire Yoshua.
en: Only the cattle and the spoil of that city Israel took for a prey unto themselves, according unto the word of the LORD which he commanded Joshua.

rr: Yoshua yaayotsya Ai, yaagihindura amatongo agatarituurwamu ebiro byona, nk'oku kiri na hati.
en: And Joshua burnt Ai, and made it an heap for ever, even a desolation unto this day.

rr: Yaahanika omugabe wa Ai aha muti okuhitsya omu mwabazyo; kandi eizooba ku ryabaire nirirengarenga, Yoshua yaaragiira, baahanura omutumbi gwe, baagunaga omu maisho g'eirembo ry'orurembo, baagurundaho omutuumo muhango gw'amabaare, ogukiriho n'okuhitsya eri izooba. Yoshua okwombeka eitambiro n'okurihandiikaho ebiragiro
en: And the king of Ai he hanged on a tree until eventide: and as soon as the sun was down, Joshua commanded that they should take his carcase down from the tree, and cast it at the entering of the gate of the city, and raise thereon a great heap of stones, that remaineth unto this day.

rr: Bwanyima Yoshua yaayombekyera MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli eitambiro aha kabungo Ebali
en: Then Joshua built an altar unto the LORD God of Israel in mount Ebal,

rr: nk'oku Musa omugaragwa wa Mukama yaaragiire Abaisraeli, kandi nk'oku kyahandiikirwe omu kitabo eky'ebiragiro bya Musa, okuryombekyesa amabaare gatabaizire, agu omuntu weena atakatahoga kyoma; baaritambiriraho MUKAMA ebitambo ebyokize, baahayo empongano z'okusiima ahabw'obusingye.
en: as Moses the servant of the LORD commanded the children of Israel, as it is written in the book of the law of Moses, an altar of whole stones, over which no man hath lift up any iron: and they offered thereon burnt offerings unto the LORD , and sacrificed peace offerings.

rr: Kandi aho niho yaahandiikiire ahari ago mabaare omu maisho g'Abaisraeli ebiragiro ebi Musa yaahandiikire.
en: And he wrote there upon the stones a copy of the law of Moses, which he wrote in the presence of the children of Israel.

rr: 1 -13 ; . Abaisraeli boona, enzaarwa n'abanyamahanga, n'abakuru baabo n'abategyeki n'abaramuzi, baayemerera embaju zombi z'eshanduukye ya MUKAMA omu maisho g'abanyamurwa b'Abaleevi, abaabaire baheekire eshanduukye y'endagaano ya MUKAMA; ekicweka kimwe kyayemerera omu maisho g'akabungo Gerizimu, kandi ekindi kyayemerera omu maisho g'akabungo Ebali; nk'oku Musa omugaragwa wa MUKAMA yaaragiire okubanza, kushabira Abaisraeli omugisha.
en: And all Israel, and their elders, and officers, and their judges, stood on this side the ark and on that side before the priests the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD , as well the stranger, as he that was born among them; half of them over against mount Gerizim, and half of them over against mount Ebal; as Moses the servant of the LORD had commanded before, that they should bless the people of Israel.

rr: Bwanyima yaashoma ebigambo by'ebiragiro byona, eby'omugisha n'eby'emikyeeno, nk'oku byona byabaire bihandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'ebiragiro.
en: And afterward he read all the words of the law, the blessings and cursings, according to all that is written in the book of the law.

rr: Tihariho kigambo na kimwe ahari byona ebi Musa yaaragiire, eki Yoshua atarashomeire mu maisho g'Abaisraeli boona, obwo harimu abakazi n'abaana n'abanyamahanga abaabaire nibagyenda nabo.
en: There was not a word of all that Moses commanded, which Joshua read not before all the congregation of Israel, with the women, and the little ones, and the strangers that were conversant among them.

rr: Abagabe boona, owa Hiiti, owa Amori, owa Kanaani, owa Perizi, owa Hiivi n'owa Yebusi, abaabaire batwire seeri ya Yorudani, ab'omu nsi y'ebibungo n'omu mpita n'ab'aha rubaju rwona orw'Enyanja empango orurikureeba Lebanooni, ku baahuriire ebyo
en: And it came to pass, when all the kings which were on this side Jordan, in the hills, and in the valleys, and in all the coasts of the great sea over against Lebanon, the Hittite, and the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, heard thereof ;

rr: baayeteerana n'omutima gumwe kurwanisa Yoshua n'Abaisraeli.
en: that they gathered themselves together, to fight with Joshua and with Israel, with one accord. The Gibeonites

rr: Kwonka aba Gibeoni ku baahuriire oku Yoshua yaagizire Yeriko na Ai
en: And when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done unto Jericho and to Ai,

rr: baacwa obwengye, baayehindura entumwa, baakoma entanda, baatwara ebiguniya aha ndogoya zaabo n'efurebe za viinyo ezikuzire eziteire ebiremu
en: they did work wilily, and went and made as if they had been ambassadors, and took old sacks upon their asses, and wine bottles, old, and rent, and bound up;

rr: baajwara enkaito zikuzire, ezibambatikire ebiremu, n'emyenda y'obucancabari; kandi entanda zaabo zoona ez'emigaati zikaba zoomire kandi zihumbire.
en: and old shoes and clouted upon their feet, and old garments upon them; and all the bread of their provision was dry and mouldy.

rr: Baimuka, baashanga Yoshua n'Abaisraeli omu rusiisira Gilugaali, baabagira bati: Nituruga omu nsi ya hare; n'ahabw'ekyo muturaganise endagaano.
en: And they went to Joshua unto the camp at Gilgal, and said unto him, and to the men of Israel, We be come from a far country: now therefore make ye a league with us.

rr: Abaisraeli baagarukamu Abahiivi bati: Obundi mukaaba mutwire naitwe; mbwenu obwo nitubaasa tuta kukora naimwe endagaano?
en: And the men of Israel said unto the Hivites, Peradventure ye dwell among us; and how shall we make a league with you?

rr: Baagira Yoshua bati: Turi abairu baawe. Yoshua yaababuuza ati: Muri baahi? kandi nimuruga hi?
en: And they said unto Joshua, We are thy servants. And Joshua said unto them, Who are ye? and from whence come ye?

rr: Baamugarukamu bati: Itwe abairu baawe nituruga omu nsi ya hare; ekitureetsire aha n'eiziina rya MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe, ahakuba tukahurira okurangaanwa kwe n'ebi yaakozire omuri Misri byona
en: And they said unto him, From a very far country thy servants are come because of the name of the LORD thy God: for we have heard the fame of him, and all that he did in Egypt,

rr: kandi n'oku yaagizire abagabe b'Abaamori bombi aba seeri ya Yorudani, Sihooni omugabe wa Heshibooni, na Ogi omugabe wa Bashani, owaabaire atwire Ashitaroosi.
en: and all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites, that were beyond Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon, and to Og king of Bashan, which was at Ashtaroth.

rr: Mbwenu abakuru baitu n'abantu b'owaitu boona bakatugira ngu, Mutware entanda ahabw'orugyendo, mugyende mubabugane, mubagire muti: Turi abairu baanyu; mbwenu muturaganise endagaano.
en: Wherefore our elders and all the inhabitants of our country spake to us, saying, Take victuals with you for the journey, and go to meet them, and say unto them, We are your servants: therefore now make ye a league with us.

rr: Kandi entanda zaitu ezi tukazikomera omu maka gaitu nizikyotsya, aha izooba eri twaimukiireho nitwija kubareeba; mbwenu reeba, zaayomire, kandi zaahumbire.
en: This our bread we took hot for our provision out of our houses on the day we came forth to go unto you; but now, behold, it is dry, and it is mouldy:

rr: Kandi efurebe ezi tukaziijuza viinyo zikirinsya; mbwenu reeba, zifumagurukire. Ebijwaro n'enkaito bitukuriireho ahabw'orugyendo ruraingwa munonga.
en: and these bottles of wine, which we filled, were new; and, behold, they be rent: and these our garments and our shoes are become old by reason of the very long journey.

rr: Abaisraeli baikiriza ahabw'okureeba eby'okurya byabo, batabuurize MUKAMA.
en: And the men took of their victuals, and asked not counsel at the mouth of the LORD .

rr: Yoshua yaaragaana nabo endagaano y'obusingye, ku ataribaita; n'abakuru b'eihanga baabarahira.
en: And Joshua made peace with them, and made a league with them, to let them live: and the princes of the congregation sware unto them.

rr: Ku haahingwireho ebiro bishatu baherize kuragaana nabo, baahurira ku bari bataahi baabo, kandi ku batwire nabo.
en: And it came to pass at the end of three days after they had made a league with them, that they heard that they were their neighbours, and that they dwelt among them.

rr: Abaisraeli baagyenda, baahika aha ndembo zaabo aha kiro kya kashatu.
en: And the children of Israel journeyed, and came unto their cities on the third day.

rr: Endembo zaabo zikaba ziri Gibeoni, Kefira, Beeroosi na Kiryasi-yearimu.
en: Now their cities were Gibeon, and Chephirah, and Beeroth, and Kirjath-jearim.

rr: Kwonka Abaisraeli tibaabaita, ahakuba abakuru b'eihanga bakabarahira MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli.
en: And the children of Israel smote them not, because the princes of the congregation had sworn unto them by the LORD God of Israel.

rr: Eihanga ryona ryayetomboitera abakuru.
en: And all the congregation murmured against the princes.

rr: Kwonka abakuru boona baagambira eihanga ryona bati: Tubarahiire MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli; n'ahabw'ekyo titurikubaasa kubakoraho.
en: But all the princes said unto all the congregation, We have sworn unto them by the LORD God of Israel: now therefore we may not touch them.

rr: Eki turaakore nikwo kubareka bahuriire, tutakaahikwaho ekiniga ahabw'okwita endahiro ei tubarahiire.
en: This we will do to them; we will even let them live, lest wrath be upon us, because of the oath which we sware unto them.

rr: Kandi abakuru baabagira bati: Mubarekye bagumeho. Bwanyima baahinduka abasheenyi b'enku n'abatahi b'amaizi b'eihanga ryona, nk'oku abakuru baabagambiire.
en: And the princes said unto them, Let them live; but let them be hewers of wood and drawers of water unto all the congregation; as the princes had promised them.

rr: Kandi Yoshua yaabeeta, yaabagira ati: Mutubeiheire ki, nimugira muti: Tubari hare munonga; haza kunu mutwire naitwe?
en: And Joshua called for them, and he spake unto them, saying, Wherefore have ye beguiled us, saying, We are very far from you; when ye dwell among us?

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo mbwenu mwakyeenwa; kandi abamwe omuriimwe baryaba abahuuku b'okusheenya enku n'okutaha amaizi ahabw'enju ya Ruhanga wangye.
en: Now therefore ye are cursed, and there shall none of you be freed from being bondmen, and hewers of wood and drawers of water for the house of my God.

rr: Baagarukamu Yoshua bati: Manya itwe abairu baawe tukagambirirwa kimwe ku MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe yaaragiire Musa omugaragwa we kubaha ensi yoona n'okuhwerekyereza abagitwiremu boona, bakahweraho kimwe omu maisho gaanyu; nikyo twabatiiniire munonga ngu tutafa, tukakora tutyo.
en: And they answered Joshua, and said, Because it was certainly told thy servants, how that the LORD thy God commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land, and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you, therefore we were sore afraid of our lives because of you, and have done this thing.

rr: Mbwenu nu, reeba turi omu mikono yaawe; otukore kyona eki orikureeba ngu ni kirungi kandi kihikire omu maisho gaawe.
en: And now, behold, we are in thine hand: as it seemeth good and right unto thee to do unto us, do.

rr: Nikwo yaabagizire atyo; akabakiza omu mikono y'Abaisraeli, tibaabaita.
en: And so did he unto them, and delivered them out of the hand of the children of Israel, that they slew them not.

rr: Okuruga obwo Yoshua yaabahindura abasheenyi b'enku n'abatahi b'amaizi b'eihanga n'eitambiro rya MUKAMA omu mwanya gwona ogu yaabaire atoorana n'okuhitsya hati.
en: And Joshua made them that day hewers of wood and drawers of water for the congregation, and for the altar of the LORD , even unto this day, in the place which he should choose.

rr: Adoni-zedeki omugabe wa Yerusaalemu, ku yaahuriire ngu Yoshua akwatsire Ai yaagihwerekyerereza kimwe; kandi ngu nk'oku yaagizire Yeriko n'omugabe waayo, nikwo agizire Ai n'omugabe waayo; kandi n'oku aba Gibeoni baaragaine n'Abaisraeli eby'okuguma nabo n'obusingye, bakatuura nabo
en: Now it came to pass, when Adoni-zedec king of Jerusalem had heard how Joshua had taken Ai, and had utterly destroyed it; as he had done to Jericho and her king, so he had done to Ai and her king; and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel, and were among them;

rr: -16 ; yaatiina munonga, ahakuba Gibeoni rukaba ruri orurembo rw'amaani nk'endembo z'abagabe ezindi oku zaabaire ziri, nangwa rukaba nirukira na Ai, n'abashaija baayo bari amamanzi.
en: that they feared greatly, because Gibeon was a great city, as one of the royal cities, and because it was greater than Ai, and all the men thereof were mighty.

rr: Nikyo kyareeteire Adoni-zedeki omugabe wa Yerusaalemu kutuma ahari Hohamu omugabe wa Heburooni na Piramu omugabe wa Yaramuusi na Yafia omugabe wa Lakishi, na Debira omugabe wa Egulooni, naagira ati
en: Wherefore Adoni-zedec king of Jerusalem sent unto Hoham king of Hebron, and unto Piram king of Jarmuth, and unto Japhia king of Lachish, and unto Debir king of Eglon, saying,

rr: Mwinamukye, mumpe emikono, tuteere Gibeoni; ahakuba eragaine na Yoshua n'Abaisraeli eby'obusingye.
en: Come up unto me, and help me, that we may smite Gibeon: for it hath made peace with Joshua and with the children of Israel.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo abagabe bataano b'aba Amori, omugabe wa Yerusaalemu, omugabe wa Heburooni, omugabe wa Yaramuusi, omugabe wa Lakishi, n'omugabe wa Egulooni, baayeteeranira hamwe n'amahe gaabo goona, bainamuka, baasiisira ahari Gibeoni, baagirwanisa.
en: Therefore the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, the king of Eglon, gathered themselves together, and went up, they and all their hosts, and encamped before Gibeon, and made war against it.

rr: Aba Gibeoni baatuma ahari Yoshua omu rusiisira Gilugaali nibagira bati: Otahinya omukono gwawe kureka abairu baawe; rahuka otuhe emikono, otuhwere; ahakuba abagabe boona b'Abaamori abatwire omu nsi y'ebibungo beeteeraine kuturwanisa.
en: And the men of Gibeon sent unto Joshua to the camp to Gilgal, saying, Slack not thy hand from thy servants; come up to us quickly, and save us, and help us: for all the kings of the Amorites that dwell in the mountains are gathered together against us.

rr: Atyo Yoshua yainamuka naaruga Gilugaali, we n'engabo ze zoona, kandi n'abashaija boona ab'amaani amamanzi.
en: So Joshua ascended from Gilgal, he, and all the people of war with him, and all the mighty men of valour.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Yoshua ati: Otabatiina, ahakuba mbahaireyo omu mikono yaawe; kandi tihariho mushaija weena aharibo oraasyamirane naiwe.
en: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Fear them not: for I have delivered them into thine hand; there shall not a man of them stand before thee.

rr: Ahonaaho Yoshua yaabagwaho, ahabw'okuba akaija ekiro kyona, naaruga Gilugaali.
en: Joshua therefore came unto them suddenly, and went up from Gilgal all night.

rr: MUKAMA yaabahahaaza emitima omu maisho g'Abaisraeli, baabaitamu abantu baingi munonga omuri Gibeoni, abandi baababinga nibabatooza ogurikwinamuka Besi-horoni, baagyenda nibabaita okuhika Azeka na Makeda.
en: And the LORD discomfited them before Israel, and slew them with a great slaughter at Gibeon, and chased them along the way that goeth up to Beth-horon, and smote them to Azekah, and unto Makkedah.

rr: Ku baabaire nibahunga Abaisraeli nibashuuma kuruga Besi-horoni, MUKAMA yaabateeza emengo z'orubaare niziruga omu iguru, baagyenda nibafa okuhitsya obu baahikire Azeka; abaitsirwe orubaare baakira abu Abaisraeli baitsize rurara. Eizooba okutarenga ahabw'okushaba kwa Yoshua
en: And it came to pass, as they fled from before Israel, and were in the going down to Beth-horon, that the LORD cast down great stones from heaven upon them unto Azekah, and they died: they were more which died with hailstones than they whom the children of Israel slew with the sword.

rr: Aha izooba eri MUKAMA yaahereireyo Abaamori omu mikono y'Abaisraeli, Yoshua akagambirira MUKAMA omu maisho gaabo, ati: Iwe izooba 'we, yemerera ahaiguru ya Gibeoni, Naiwe kwezi 'we, yemerera ahaiguru y'oruhanga rwa Ayalooni.
en: Then spake Joshua to the LORD in the day when the LORD delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel, and he said in the sight of Israel, Sun, stand thou still upon Gibeon; And thou, Moon, in the valley of Ajalon.

rr: Eizooba ryayemerera, n'okwezi kwaguma aho, Okuhitsya obu eryo ihanga ryaherize kuhoora abazigu baaryo.
en: And the sun stood still, and the moon stayed, Until the people had avenged themselves upon their enemies.

rr: Timurikumanya ekyo ku kyahandiikirwe omu kitabo kya Yashari?
en: Is not this written in the book of Jasher?

rr: Eizooba ryayemerera ahagati y'eiguru, tiryarahuka kurenga, ryamara omwanya nk'ogw'eizooba ryona.
en: So the sun stood still in the midst of heaven, and hasted not to go down about a whole day.

rr: -29 ; . Tihariho izooba erirabaire nk'eryo omu gaaribandiize n'agaakuratsireho, obu MUKAMA yaahurira eiraka ry'omuntu; ahakuba MUKAMA akarwanirira Abaisraeli.
en: And there was no day like that before it or after it, that the LORD hearkened unto the voice of a man: for the LORD fought for Israel.

rr: Bwanyima Yoshua yaatabaaruka n'Abaisraeli boona, baagaruka omu rusiisira Gilugaali. Okwitwa kw'abagabe bataano
en: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.

rr: Abagabe bari abataano baahunga, baayeshereka omu nyanga eyaabaire eri Makeda.
en: But these five kings fled, and hid themselves in a cave at Makkedah.

rr: Yoshua yaagambirwa ku abo bagabe bataano baashangirwe beesherekire omu nyanga ya Makeda.
en: And it was told Joshua, saying, The five kings are found hid in a cave at Makkedah.

rr: Yoshua yaaragiira ati: Mukumbagaze amabaare mahango, mugate aha munwa gw'enyanga, muteho n'abashaija b'okubarinda
en: And Joshua said, Roll great stones upon the mouth of the cave, and set men by it for to keep them:

rr: kwonka mutasiibayo; kureka mukurate abazigu baanyu, mutandikire aha b'enyima, mubaite mutabaikiriza kutaaha omu ndembo zaabo; ahakuba MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu abahaireyo omu mikono yaanyu.
en: and stay ye not, but pursue after your enemies, and smite the hindmost of them; suffer them not to enter into their cities: for the LORD your God hath delivered them into your hand.

rr: Yoshua n'Abaisraeli ku baaherize kwitira kimwe baingi munonga omuribo, abaatsigaireho baahungira omu ndembo eziine engo zigumire
en: And it came to pass, when Joshua and the children of Israel had made an end of slaying them with a very great slaughter, till they were consumed, that the rest which remained of them entered into fenced cities.

rr: abantu boona baagaruka n'obusingye ahari Yoshua omu rusiisira Makeda; kandi tihaagira n'omwe owaagaruka kwimutsya orurimi kujuma Abaisraeli.
en: And all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace: none moved his tongue against any of the children of Israel.

rr: Bwanyima Yoshua yaaragiira ati: Mwigure enyanga, mushohoze abo bagabe bataano, mubandeetere.
en: Then said Joshua, Open the mouth of the cave, and bring out those five kings unto me out of the cave.

rr: Baakora batyo, baiha abo bagabe bataano omu nyanga, baabamureetera, omugabe wa Yerusaalemu, owa Heburooni, owa Yaramuusi, owa Lakishi, n'owa Egulooni.
en: And they did so, and brought forth those five kings unto him out of the cave, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.

rr: Ku baaherize kushohoza abo bagabe, baabamureetera, Yoshua yaayeta Abaisraeli boona, yaagambira abakuru b'engabo abaahurwire nawe, ati: Mwirire haihi, muribate aba bagabe aha bitsya.
en: And it came to pass, when they brought out those kings unto Joshua, that Joshua called for all the men of Israel, and said unto the captains of the men of war which went with him, Come near, put your feet upon the necks of these kings.

rr: Bairira haihi, baabaribata aha bitsya.
en: And they came near, and put their feet upon the necks of them.

rr: Yoshua yaabagambira ati: Mutatiina, kandi mutahahaaza emitima; mube ab'amaani, mugume emitima; ahabw'okuba nikwo MUKAMA arigira ati abazigu baanyu boona abu murirwanisa.
en: And Joshua said unto them, Fear not, nor be dismayed, be strong and of good courage: for thus shall the LORD do to all your enemies against whom ye fight.

rr: Bwanyima Yoshua yaabacumita, yaabaita, yaabahanika aha miti etaano; baaguma aha miti okuhitsya omu mwabazyo.
en: And afterward Joshua smote them, and slew them, and hanged them on five trees: and they were hanging upon the trees until the evening.

rr: Eizooba ku ryabaire nirirengarenga, Yoshua yaaragiira, baabahanura aha miti, baabanaga omu nyanga omu baabaire beesherekire, baarunda amabaare mahango aha munwa gwayo, n'okuhitsya eri izooba gakibaho.
en: And it came to pass at the time of the going down of the sun, that Joshua commanded, and they took them down off the trees, and cast them into the cave wherein they had been hid, and laid great stones in the cave's mouth, which remain until this very day.

rr: Yoshua okukubuura endembo zaabo
en: Completing the Conquest

rr: Eryo izooba Yoshua yaakwata Makeda; abantu baayo n'omugabe waayo yaabaitsa rurara; yaabacwekyerereza kimwe; tiyaatsigaho n'omwe ahari boona abaabaire barutwiremu. Kandi yaagira omugabe wa Makeda nk'oku yaagizire owa Yeriko.
en: And that day Joshua took Makkedah, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof he utterly destroyed, them, and all the souls that were therein; he let none remain: and he did to the king of Makkedah as he did unto the king of Jericho.

rr: Yoshua n'Abaisraeli boona baaruga Makeda, baateera Libuna, baagirwanisa
en: Then Joshua passed from Makkedah, and all Israel with him, unto Libnah, and fought against Libnah:

rr: nayo MUKAMA yaagihayo omu mikono y'Abaisraeli n'omugabe waayo; baabaitsa rurara, tibaatsigaho n'omwe ahari boona abaabaire barutwiremu. Yoshua yaagira omugabe waayo nk'oku yaagizire owa Yeriko.
en: and the LORD delivered it also, and the king thereof, into the hand of Israel; and he smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein; he let none remain in it; but did unto the king thereof as he did unto the king of Jericho.

rr: Bwanyima Yoshua yaaruga Libuna n'Abaisraeli boona, baahurura Lakishi, baateerayo orusiisira kugirwanisa.
en: And Joshua passed from Libnah, and all Israel with him, unto Lachish, and encamped against it, and fought against it:

rr: MUKAMA yaahayo Lakishi omu mikono y'Abaisraeli, baagikwata aha kiro kya kabiri, baagihwerekyereza na rurara, baita abantu boona abaabaire barimu, nk'oku baagizire Libuna omuri byona.
en: and the LORD delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel, which took it on the second day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein, according to all that he had done to Libnah.

rr: Bwanyima Horamu omugabe wa Gezeri yainamuka kuha aba Lakishi emikono. Yoshua yaamwita n'abantu be boona, okuhitsya obu yaabamazireho.
en: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua smote him and his people, until he had left him none remaining.

rr: Yoshua yaaruga Lakishi n'Abaisraeli boona, baahurura Egulooni, baateerayo orusiisira kugirwanisa.
en: And from Lachish Joshua passed unto Eglon, and all Israel with him; and they encamped against it, and fought against it:

rr: Baagikwata aha izooba eryo, baagihwerekyereza na rurara, n'abantu baamwo boona baabacwekyerereza kimwe eryo izooba, nk'oku yaagizire Lakishi omuri byona.
en: and they took it on that day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein he utterly destroyed that day, according to all that he had done to Lachish.

rr: Yoshua yaaruga Egulooni n'Abaisraeli boona, baaza Heburooni; baagiteera
en: And Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Israel with him, unto Hebron; and they fought against it:

rr: baagikwata, baagihwerekyereza na rurara, n'omugabe waayo n'endembo zaayo zoona, n'abantu baamwo boona; tiyaatsigaho muntu n'omwe, nk'oku yaagizire Egulooni omuri byona; kureka yaagicwekyerereza kimwe n'abantu baamwo boona.
en: and they took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof, and all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining, according to all that he had done to Eglon; but destroyed it utterly, and all the souls that were therein.

rr: Yoshua yaagaruka n'Abaisraeli boona, baahurura Debira, baagirwanisa
en: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to Debir; and fought against it:

rr: yaagikwata n'omugabe waayo n'endembo zaayo zoona; baagihwerekyereza na rurara, baacwekyereza abantu baayo boona; tiyaatsigaho n'omwe. Nk'oku yaagizire Heburooni, na Libuna n'omugabe waayo, nikwo yaagizire Debira n'omugabe waayo.
en: and he took it, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof; and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining: as he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir, and to the king thereof; as he had done also to Libnah, and to her king.

rr: Okwo nikwo Yoshua yaateire ensi egyo yoona, ey'ebibungo na Negebu n'ey'empita n'ey'enkiizi z'emigongo, n'abagabe baayo boona; taratsigireho muntu n'omwe, kureka akacwekyerereza kimwe boona abarikwitsya, nka MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli oku yaaragiire.
en: So Joshua smote all the country of the hills, and of the south, and of the vale, and of the springs, and all their kings: he left none remaining, but utterly destroyed all that breathed, as the LORD God of Israel commanded.

rr: Yoshua yaabaita okuruga Kadeshi-barunea okuhika Gaaza, n'ensi yoona eya Gosheni okuhika Gibeoni.
en: And Joshua smote them from Kadesh-barnea even unto Gaza, and all the country of Goshen, even unto Gibeon.

rr: Abo bagabe boona n'ensi yaabo Yoshua akabakwata omu hururu emwe; ahabw'okuba MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli akabarwanirira.
en: And all these kings and their land did Joshua take at one time, because the LORD God of Israel fought for Israel.

rr: Bwanyima Yoshua yaatabaaruka n'Abaisraeli boona, baagaruka omu rusiisira Gilugaali.
en: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.

rr: Yabini omugabe wa Hazori ku yaakihuriire, yaatuma ahari Yobabu omugabe wa Madoni, n'owa Shimirooni, n'owa Akisaafu
en: And it came to pass, when Jabin king of Hazor had heard those things , that he sent to Jobab king of Madon, and to the king of Shimron, and to the king of Achshaph,

rr: n'aha bagabe abaabaire batwire aha bukiizi-bwa-bumosho omu nsi y'ebibungo n'omuri Araba aha bukiizi-bwa-buryo obwa Kineroosi, omu mpita n'omu bibungo bya Doori aha rubaju rw'oburengyerwa-izooba
en: and to the kings that were on the north of the mountains, and of the plains south of Chinneroth, and in the valley, and in the borders of Dor on the west,

rr: n'ah'Abanyakanaani aha rubaju rw'oburugwa-izooba n'oburengyerwa-izooba, n'ah'Abaamori n'Abahiiti n'Abaperizi n'Abayebusi omu nsi y'ebibungo, n'ah'Abahiivi ahansi ya Herumooni omu nsi ya Mizipa.
en: and to the Canaanite on the east and on the west, and to the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Jebusite in the mountains, and to the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpeh.

rr: Baahurura n'amahe gaabo goona, engabo nyingi munonga ezirikwingana n'omusheenyi ogw'aha rubaju rw'enyanja, baine embaraasi n'ebigaari bingi munonga.
en: And they went out, they and all their hosts with them, much people, even as the sand that is upon the sea shore in multitude, with horses and chariots very many.

rr: Abo bagabe boona baayeteerana, baija baasiisira hamwe aha nyanja ya Meromu kurwanisa Abaisraeli.
en: And when all these kings were met together, they came and pitched together at the waters of Merom, to fight against Israel.

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Yoshua ati: Otabatiina, ahakuba boona niinyija kubahayo omu mikono y'Abaisraeli kubaita; embaraasi zaabo muziteme ebiteega, n'ebigaari byabo mubyotsye n'omuriro.
en: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Be not afraid because of them: for to morrow about this time will I deliver them up all slain before Israel: thou shalt hough their horses, and burn their chariots with fire.

rr: Yoshua nikwo kwija n'engabo ze zoona, bakabagwaho aha nyanja ya Meromu batakimanyire
en: So Joshua came, and all the people of war with him, against them by the waters of Merom suddenly; and they fell upon them.

rr: MUKAMA akabahayo omu mikono y'Abaisraeli, bakabaita, bakababinga, bakabahitsya Sidoni empango na Miserofoosi-maimu n'omu ruhanga rwa Mizipe aha rubaju rw'oburugwa-izooba; bakabaita, batatsigyeho n'omwe.
en: And the LORD delivered them into the hand of Israel, who smote them, and chased them unto great Zidon, and unto Misrephoth-maim, and unto the valley of Mizpeh eastward; and they smote them, until they left them none remaining.

rr: Kandi Yoshua yaabagira nk'oku MUKAMA yaamuragiire; yaatema ebiteega by'embaraasi zaabo, n'ebigaari byabo yaabyotsya.
en: And Joshua did unto them as the LORD bade him: he houghed their horses, and burnt their chariots with fire.

rr: Omu biro ebyo Yoshua yaakubuuka, yaakwata Hazori, yaitsa omugabe waayo rurara; ahakuba obunyakare Hazori ekaba eri omutwe gw'obugabe obwo bwona.
en: And Joshua at that time turned back, and took Hazor, and smote the king thereof with the sword: for Hazor beforetime was the head of all those kingdoms.

rr: Abaisraeli baitsa rurara boona abaabaire barimu, baabacwekyerereza kimwe; tihaatsigaraho n'omwe orikwitsya; n'orurembo Hazori baarwotsya.
en: And they smote all the souls that were therein with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying them: there was not any left to breathe: and he burnt Hazor with fire.

rr: Kandi endembo zoona ez'abo bagabe Yoshua yaazikwata, n'abagabe baazo boona yaabaitsa rurara, yaabacwekyerereza kimwe, nka Musa omugaragwa wa MUKAMA oku yaaragiire.
en: And all the cities of those kings, and all the kings of them, did Joshua take, and smote them with the edge of the sword, and he utterly destroyed them, as Moses the servant of the LORD commanded.

rr: Kwonka Abaisraeli tibarookize rurembo na rumwe ahari ezo ezaayombekirwe aha mituumo y'ezindi, kureka Hazori yonka; niyo Yoshua yaayokize.
en: But as for the cities that stood still in their strength, Israel burned none of them, save Hazor only; that did Joshua burn.

rr: Kandi eminyago yoona n'amatungo goona ebyarugire omu ndembo ezo Abaisraeli bakabyetwarira; kwonka abantu boona baabaitsa rurara, okuhitsya obu baabahwerekyerereize kimwe, batatsigyeho n'omwe orikwitsya.
en: And all the spoil of these cities, and the cattle, the children of Israel took for a prey unto themselves; but every man they smote with the edge of the sword, until they had destroyed them, neither left they any to breathe.

rr: Nk'oku MUKAMA yaaragiire Musa omugaragwa we, nikwo Musa yaaragiire Yoshua, na Yoshua nikwo yaatwarize; taine kyona eki yaatsigire kitakozirwe ahari byona ebi MUKAMA yaaragiire Musa. Yoshua okukubuura ensi yoona
en: As the LORD commanded Moses his servant, so did Moses command Joshua, and so did Joshua; he left nothing undone of all that the LORD commanded Moses.

rr: Okwo nikwo Yoshua yaakubwire egyo nsi yoona, ey'enshozi na Negebu yoona, n'ensi ya Gosheni yoona, n'ey'empita na Araba, n'ey'ebibungo bya Israeli n'empita zaayo
en: So Joshua took all that land, the hills, and all the south country, and all the land of Goshen, and the valley, and the plain, and the mountain of Israel, and the valley of the same;

rr: okwiha aha kibungo kya Halaki ekirikwinamuka Seiri, okuhitsya Baali-gaadi omu ruhanga rwa Lebanooni ahansi y'orushozi Herumooni. N'abagabe baayo boona yaabakwata, yaabacumita, yaabaita.
en: even from the mount Halak, that goeth up to Seir, even unto Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon under mount Hermon: and all their kings he took, and smote them, and slew them.

rr: Yoshua yaamara omwanya muhango naarwanisa abo bagabe boona.
en: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.

rr: Tihariho rurembo orwaragaine kugira n'Abaisraeli obusingye, kureka Abahiivi abaabaire batwire Gibeoni; ezindi zoona bakazirwanisa, baazikwata
en: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel, save the Hivites the inhabitants of Gibeon: all other they took in battle.

rr: ahakuba ekyo kikaruga ahari MUKAMA kugangaaza emitima yaabo, bakaza kurwanisa Abaisraeli, ngu abone kubahwerekyerereza kimwe, barekye kugirirwa embabazi, kureka bahwerekyerezibwe, nk'oku MUKAMA yaaragiire Musa.
en: For it was of the LORD to harden their hearts, that they should come against Israel in battle, that he might destroy them utterly, and that they might have no favour, but that he might destroy them, as the LORD commanded Moses.

rr: Kandi omu biro ebyo Yoshua yaija, yaamaraho aba Anaki omu nsi y'ebibungo, n'omuri Heburooni, n'omuri Debira, n'omuri Anabu, kandi n'omu nsi yoona ey'ebibungo bya Yuda, n'ey'ebibungo bya Israeli; Yoshua yaabahwerekyerereza kimwe n'endembo zaabo.
en: And at that time came Joshua, and cut off the Anakims from the mountains, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the mountains of Judah, and from all the mountains of Israel: Joshua destroyed them utterly with their cities.

rr: Tihaine Muanaki n'omwe owaatsigaireho omu nsi y'Abaisraeli; kureka omuri Gaaza na Gaasi na Ashidoodi nimwo haatsigaire bamwe.
en: There was none of the Anakims left in the land of the children of Israel: only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, there remained.

rr: Nikwo Yoshua yaakwatsire atyo ensi yoona, nk'ebi MUKAMA yaagambiire Musa byona oku byabaire biri, Yoshua yaagiha Abaisraeli kuba obuhunguzi bwabo, nk'oku enganda zaabo zaabaire ziri.
en: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that the LORD said unto Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance unto Israel according to their divisions by their tribes.

rr: Bwanyima ensi yaahuumura engamba.
en: And the land rested from war.

rr: Aba nibo bagabe b'ensi, abu Abaisraeli baitsire, bakakubuura ensi yaabo seeri ya Yorudani aha rubaju rw'oburugwa-izooba, okuruga omu ruhanga rwa Arunooni, okuhika aha rushozi Herumooni, na Araba yoona ey'oburugwa-izooba
en: Now these are the kings of the land, which the children of Israel smote, and possessed their land on the other side Jordan toward the rising of the sun, from the river Arnon unto mount Hermon, and all the plain on the east:

rr: Sihooni omugabe w'Abaamori, owaabaire atwire Heshibooni, naategyeka okuruga Aroeri aha rubaju rw'oruhanga rwa Arunooni n'ahagati omu ruhita, n'ekicweka kya Gileadi okuhitsya aha mugyera Yaboki, omu mwatano gw'Abaamoni
en: Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is upon the bank of the river Arnon, and from the middle of the river, and from half Gilead, even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;

rr: kandi okuruga Araba okuhitsya aha rubaju rw'oburugwa-izooba bw'enyanja Kineroosi n'aha muhanda ogurikuza Besi-yeshimoosi oburugwa-izooba bw'enyanja ya Araba, Enyanja y'omwonyo; kandi aha bukiizi-bwa-buryo okuhika ahansi y'akashuumo k'orushozi Pisiga.
en: and from the plain to the sea of Chinneroth on the east, and unto the sea of the plain, even the salt sea on the east, the way to Beth-jeshimoth; and from the south, under Ashdoth-pisgah:

rr: Kandi na Ogi omugabe wa Bashani, omwe aha baatsigaireho omu Bareefa, owaabaire atwire Ashitaroosi na Edurei
en: and the coast of Og king of Bashan, which was of the remnant of the giants, that dwelt at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,

rr: naategyeka orushozi Herumooni, na Saleka, na Bashani yoona okuhika aha mwatano gw'aba Geshuri n'aba Maaka, n'ekicweka kya Gileadi okuhika aha mwatano gwa Sihooni omugabe wa Heshibooni.
en: and reigned in mount Hermon, and in Salcah, and in all Bashan, unto the border of the Geshurites and the Maachathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.

rr: Abo nibo Musa omugaragwa wa MUKAMA n'Abaisraeli baitsire; kandi ensi yaabo Musa akagiha Abareubeeni n'Abagaadi n'ekicweka ky'oruganda rwa Manaase kuba eyaabo.
en: Them did Moses the servant of the LORD and the children of Israel smite: and Moses the servant of the LORD gave it for a possession unto the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh.

rr: Kandi aba nibo bagabe b'ensi abu Yoshua n'Abaisraeli baitsire seenu ya Yorudani aha rubaju rw'oburengyerwa-izooba okuruga Baali-gaadi omu ruhanga rwa Lebanooni okuhika aha kibungo Halaki ogurikwinamuka Seiri; kandi egyo nsi niyo Yoshua yaahaire enganda za Israeli kuba eyaabo, nk'oku baagibaganisiziibwe
en: And these are the kings of the country which Joshua and the children of Israel smote on this side Jordan on the west, from Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon even unto the mount Halak, that goeth up to Seir; which Joshua gave unto the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions;

rr: omu nsi y'ebibungo n'omu mpita n'omuri Araba n'omu nkiizi z'emigongo n'omu ihamba n'omuri Negebu, n'ensi y'Abahiiti n'ey'Abaamori n'ey'Abanyakanaani n'ey'Abaperizi n'ey'Abahiivi n'ey'Abayebusi.
en: in the mountains, and in the valleys, and in the plains, and in the springs, and in the wilderness, and in the south country; the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites:

rr: Omugabe wa Yeriko omwe; omugabe wa Ai eri aha rubaju rwa Beseeli omwe
en: the king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is beside Beth-el, one;

rr: omugabe wa Yerusaalemu omwe; omugabe wa Hebulooni omwe
en: the king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;

rr: omugabe wa Yaramuusi omwe; omugabe wa Lakishi omwe
en: the king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;

rr: omugabe wa Egulooni omwe; omugabe wa Gezeeri omwe
en: the king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;

rr: omugabe wa Debira omwe; omugabe wa Gederi omwe
en: the king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;

rr: omugabe wa Horuma omwe; omugabe wa Aradi omwe
en: the king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;

rr: omugabe wa Libuna omwe; omugabe wa Adulaamu omwe
en: the king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;

rr: omugabe wa Makeda omwe; omugabe wa Beseeli omwe
en: the king of Makkedah, one; the king of Beth-el, one;

rr: omugabe wa Tapua omwe; omugabe wa Heferi omwe
en: the king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;

rr: omugabe wa Afeki omwe; omugabe wa Lasharooni omwe
en: the king of Aphek, one; the king of Lasharon, one;

rr: omugabe wa Madoni omwe; omugabe wa Hazori omwe
en: the king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;

rr: omugabe wa Shimurooni-meroni omwe; omugabe wa Akishaafu omwe
en: the king of Shimron-meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;

rr: omugabe wa Tanaki omwe, omugabe wa Megido omwe
en: the king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;

rr: omugabe wa Kedeshi omwe, omugabe wa Yokineamu omuri Karumeeli omwe
en: the king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam of Carmel, one;

rr: omugabe wa Doora omu bibungo bya Doori omwe; omugabe wa Goimu omuri Galilaaya omwe
en: the king of Dor in the coast of Dor, one; the king of the nations of Gilgal, one;

rr: omugabe wa Tiruza omwe; abagabe boona makumi ashatu n'omwe.
en: the king of Tirzah, one: all the kings thirty and one.

rr: Yoshua ku yaakuzire, yaahika omu ngingo zaabukuru, MUKAMA yaamugira ati: okuzire, waahika omu ngingo zaabukuru; kwonka hakitsigaireyo ensi mpango munonga eshemereire kukubuurwa.
en: Now Joshua was old and stricken in years; and the LORD said unto him, Thou art old and stricken in years, and there remaineth yet very much land to be possessed.

rr: Ensi ekitsigaire n'egi; ebyanga byona eby'Abafilistia n'eby'aba Geshuri byona
en: This is the land that yet remaineth: all the borders of the Philistines, and all Geshuri,

rr: (okwiha Shihoori eri aha rubaju rw'oburugwa-izooba bwa Misri okuta aha bukiizi-bwa-bumosho aha mwatano gwa Ekurooni, n'ah'Abanyakanaani; kandi abategyeki bataano b'Abafilistia n'aba; owa Gaaza, owa Ashidoodi, owa Ashkelooni, owa Gaasi n'owa Ekurooni), n'eby'aba Avimu
en: from Sihor, which is before Egypt, even unto the borders of Ekron northward, which is counted to the Canaanite: five lords of the Philistines; the Gazathites, and the Ashdothites, the Eshkalonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites; also the Avites:

rr: kandi aha bukiizi-bwa-buryo, ensi yoona ey'Abanyakanaani, na Meara ey'aba Sidoni, okuhika Afeki aha mwatano gw'Abaamori
en: from the south, all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah that is beside the Sidonians, unto Aphek, to the borders of the Amorites:

rr: n'ensi y'aba Gebali na Lebanooni yoona aha rubaju rw'oburugwa-izooba, okuruga Baali-gaadi ahansi y'orushozi Herumooni okuhika ah'orikutaahira omuri Hamasi
en: and the land of the Giblites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrising, from Baal-gad under mount Hermon unto the entering into Hamath.

rr: n'abatwire omu nsi y'ebibungo boona okuruga Lebanooni okuhika Miserofoosi-maimu, n'aba Sidoni boona, ndyababinga omu maisho g'Abaisraeli; kwonka ogibaganisize Abaisraeli kuba obuhunguzi bwabo, nk'oku naakuragiire.
en: All the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon unto Misrephoth-maim, and all the Sidonians, them will I drive out from before the children of Israel: only divide thou it by lot unto the Israelites for an inheritance, as I have commanded thee.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo hati ensi egi ogibaganisize enganda mwenda n'ekicweka ky'oruganda rwa Manaase kuba obuhunguzi bwabo.
en: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance unto the nine tribes, and the half tribe of Manasseh,

rr: Abareubeeni n'Abagaadi n'ekindi kicweka ky'oruganda rwa Manaase bakaba bahairwe obuhunguzi bwabo seeri ya Yorudani aha rubaju rw'oburugwa-izooba, nka Musa omugaragwa wa MUKAMA oku yaabubahaire
en: with whom the Reubenites and the Gadites have received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond Jordan eastward, even as Moses the servant of the LORD gave them;

rr: okuruga Aroeri eri aha rubaju rw'oruhanga rwa Arunooni, n'orurembo oruri ahagati y'orwo ruhanga, n'omurambi gwona ogwa Medeba okuhika Diboni
en: from Aroer, that is upon the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain of Medeba unto Dibon;

rr: n'endembo zoona eza Sihooni omugabe w'Abaamoni owaategyekyeire Heshibooni, okuhika aha mwatano gw'Abaamoni
en: and all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, unto the border of the children of Ammon;

rr: na Gileadi n'omu myatano y'aba Geshuri n'aba Maaka, n'orushozi rwa Herumooni rwona, na Bashani okuhika Saleka
en: and Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maachathites, and all mount Hermon, and all Bashan unto Salcah;

rr: n'obugabe bwona obwa Ogi omuri Bashani, owaategyekyeire Ashitaroosi na Edurei, Ogi ogwo n'omwe ahari abo abaatsigaireho omu Bareefa; abo nibo Musa yaarwaine nabo akabinga.
en: all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, which reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei, who remained of the remnant of the giants: for these did Moses smite, and cast them out.

rr: Kwonka Abaisraeli bo tibarabingire ba Geshuri nari aba Maaka; kureka aba Geshuri n'aba Maaka bakituura nabo n'okuhitsya hati.
en: Nevertheless the children of Israel expelled not the Geshurites, nor the Maachathites: but the Geshurites and the Maachathites dwell among the Israelites until this day.

rr: Kwonka oruganda rwa Leevi rwo Musa tararuhaire buhunguzi, kureka ebitambo ebyokize eby'okuhayo ahari MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli nibwo buhunguzi bwabo, nk'oku MUKAMA yaagambiire Musa.
en: Only unto the tribe of Levi he gave none inheritance; the sacrifices of the LORD God of Israel made by fire are their inheritance, as he said unto them. In the East

rr: Musa yaaha oruganda rwa Reubeeni obuhunguzi bwabo, nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri.
en: And Moses gave unto the tribe of the children of Reuben inheritance according to their families.

rr: Ekyanga kyabo kikaba nikitandikira Aroeri aha rubaju rw'oruhanga rwa Arunooni, n'orurembo rw'ahagati yaarwo, n'omurambi gwona ogwa Medeba
en: And their coast was from Aroer, that is on the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain by Medeba;

rr: na Heshibooni n'endembo zaayo zoona eziri omu mirambi; na Diboni na Bamosi-baali na Besi-baali-meoni
en: Heshbon, and all her cities that are in the plain; Dibon, and Bamoth-baal, and Beth-baal-meon,

rr: na Yahazi na Kedemoosi na Mefaasi
en: and Jahaza, and Kedemoth, and Mephaath,

rr: na Kiryasaimu na Sibuma na Zeresi-shahaari aha kabungo akari omu ruhita
en: and Kirjathaim, and Sibmah, and Zareth-shahar in the mount of the valley,

rr: na Besi-peori n'enkiizi za Pisiga, na Besi-yeshimoosi
en: and Beth-peor, and Ashdoth-pisgah, and Beth-jeshimoth,

rr: ezo nizo ndembo zoona ez'omu mirambi; n'obugabe bwona bwa Sihooni omugabe w'aba Amori, owaategyekyeire Heshibooni, ou Musa yaitsire hamwe n'abategyeki ba Midiani Evi, Rekemu, Zuuri, Huuri na Reeba, abanyiginya ba Sihooni abaabaire batwire omu nsi egyo.
en: and all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses smote with the princes of Midian, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, which were dukes of Sihon, dwelling in the country.

rr: Kandi Balamu mwene Beori omufumu, Abaisraeli bakamwitsa rurara omuri abo abu baitsire.
en: Balaam also the son of Beor, the soothsayer, did the children of Israel slay with the sword among them that were slain by them.

rr: Kandi omwatano gw'aba Reubeeni gukaba guri Yorudani.
en: And the border of the children of Reuben was Jordan, and the border thereof .

rr: Obwo nibwo buhunguzi bw'aba Reubeeni, nk'oku emiryango yaabo n'endembo zaabo n'ebirorero byazo byabaire biri.
en: This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben after their families, the cities and the villages thereof.

rr: Kandi Musa yaaha oruganda rwa Gaadi obuhunguzi bwabo nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri.
en: And Moses gave inheritance unto the tribe of Gad, even unto the children of Gad according to their families.

rr: Ekyanga kyabo kikaba kiri Yazeri, n'endembo zoona eza Gileadi, n'ekicweka ky'ensi y'Abaamoni okuhitsya Aroeri aharikureebana na Rabba
en: And their coast was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, unto Aroer that is before Rabbah;

rr: kandi okuruga Heshibooni okuhika Ramasi-mizipe na Betonimu; kandi okuruga Mahanaimu okuhika aha mwatano gwa Debira
en: and from Heshbon unto Ramath-mizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim unto the border of Debir;

rr: n'endembo z'omu ruhita, Besi-haramu, Besi-nimura, Sukoosi na Zafooni, n'ekicweka ky'obugabe bwa Sihooni omugabe wa Heshibooni ekyabaire kitsigaireho, omwatano gukaba guri Yorudani okuhika aha isheeshero ry'enyanja ya Kinereesi oburugwa-izooba bwa Yorudani.
en: and in the valley, Beth-aram, and Beth-nimrah, and Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, Jordan and his border, even unto the edge of the sea of Chinnereth on the other side Jordan eastward.

rr: Obwo nibwo buhunguzi bw'aba Gaadi, nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri, n'endembo zaabo n'ebirorero byazo.
en: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad after their families, the cities, and their villages.

rr: Kandi Musa yaaha ab'ekicweka ku'oruganda rwa Manaase obuhunguzi bwabo, bwaba obw'ekicweka ky'oruganda rwa Manaase, nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri.
en: And Moses gave inheritance unto the half tribe of Manasseh: and this was the possession of the half tribe of the children of Manasseh by their families.

rr: Ekyanga kyabo kikaba kiri okuruga Mahanaimu na Bashani yoona n'obugabe bwa Ogi omugabe wa Bashani bwona, na tauni zoona eza Yairi eziri omuri Bashani, endembo makumi mukaaga
en: And their coast was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the towns of Jair, which are in Bashan, threescore cities:

rr: kandi ekicweka kya Gileadi na Ashitaroosi na Edurei, endembo z'omu bugabe bwa Ogi omuri Bashani bikaheebwa aba Makiri, mwene Manaase, ekicweka kya beene Makiri, nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri.
en: and half Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were pertaining unto the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even to the one half of the children of Machir by their families.

rr: Obwo nibwo buhunguzi obu Musa yaabaganiise omu mpita za Moabu seeri ya Yorudani, oburugwa-izooba bwa Yeriko.
en: These are the countries which Moses did distribute for inheritance in the plains of Moab, on the other side Jordan, by Jericho, eastward.

rr: Kwonka oruganda rwa Leevi rwo Musa tararuhaiire buhunguzi bwona; kureka MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli niwe buhunguzi bwabo, nk'oku yaabagambiire.
en: But unto the tribe of Levi Moses gave not any inheritance: the LORD God of Israel was their inheritance, as he said unto them.

rr: Kandi obu nibwo buhunguzi obu Abaisraeli baahairwe omu nsi ya Kanaani, obu baabaganisiziibwe Eleazaari omunyamurwa na Yoshua mwene Nuuni n'abakuru b'emiryango y'enganda z'Abaisraeli
en: And these are the countries which the children of Israel inherited in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance to them.

rr: obwo buhunguzi bwabo bakabubaganisiza enganda mwenda n'ekicweka n'enteenyu, nk'oku MUKAMA yaaragiire Musa.
en: By lot was their inheritance, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half tribe.

rr: Ahakuba Musa akaba yaahaire enganda ibiri n'ekicweka obuhunguzi bwazo seeri ya Yorudani; kwonka Abaleevi tarabahaire buhunguzi hamwe n'abo.
en: For Moses had given the inheritance of two tribes and an half tribe on the other side Jordan: but unto the Levites he gave none inheritance among them.

rr: Abaana ba Yosefu bakakomookwamu enganda ibiri, Manaase na Efuraimu; kandi tibarahaire Baleevi mugabo omu nsi, kureka endembo z'okutuuramu, n'emyanya eri haihi nazo ey'amariisizo g'ente zaabo n'ey'ebintu byabo.
en: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim: therefore they gave no part unto the Levites in the land, save cities to dwell in , with their suburbs for their cattle and for their substance.

rr: Nk'oku MUKAMA yaaragiire Musa, nikwo Abaisraeli baatwarize, bakabagana ensi. Kalebu okuheebwa Heburooni kuba obuhunguzi bwe
en: As the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did, and they divided the land.

rr: Bwanyima Abayuda baashanga Yoshua Gilugaali; Kalebu mwene Yefune Omukenizi yaamugira ati: Noomanya eki MUKAMA yaagambiire Musa omushaija wa Ruhanga ahariiwe naanye, turi Kadeshi-barunea.
en: Then the children of Judah came unto Joshua in Gilgal: and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite said unto him, Thou knowest the thing that the LORD said unto Moses the man of God concerning me and thee in Kadesh-barnea.

rr: Nkaba nyine emyaka makumi ana, obu Musa omugaragwa wa MUKAMA yantumira Kadeshi-barunea kutata ensi, kandi nkamureetera amakuru g'ebi naareebire nk'oku byabaire biri omu mutima gwangye.
en: Forty years old was I when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadesh-barnea to espy out the land; and I brought him word again as it was in mine heart.

rr: Beene waitu, abu nainamukire nabo, baahahaaza emitima y'abantu; kwonka nyowe naakuratirira kimwe MUKAMA Ruhanga wangye.
en: Nevertheless my brethren that went up with me made the heart of the people melt: but I wholly followed the LORD my God.

rr: Eryo izooba nibwo Musa yaarahira ati: Buzimazima ensi ei oribatsiremu eryaba obuhunguzi bwawe n'obw'abaana baawe ebiro byona, ahabw'okuba okakuratirira kimwe MUKAMA Ruhanga wangye.
en: And Moses sware on that day, saying, Surely the land whereon thy feet have trodden shall be thine inheritance, and thy children's for ever, because thou hast wholly followed the LORD my God.

rr: Kalebu yaagaruka yaagira ati: Mbwenu reeba, MUKAMA andinzire emyaka egi makumi ana n'etaano, nk'oku yaagambire, okuruga obu MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ekigambo ekyo, Abaisraeli nibakizengyerera omu ihamba; mbwenu reeba, hati mpikize emyaka makumi munaana n'etaano.
en: And now, behold, the LORD hath kept me alive, as he said, these forty and five years, even since the LORD spake this word unto Moses, while the children of Israel wandered in the wilderness: and now, lo, I am this day fourscore and five years old.

rr: Na hati nkiine amaani nk'agu naabaire nyine, obu Musa yantuma. Nk'amaani gangye oku gaabaire gari aha rugamba, nimpurura kandi nintabaaruka, na hati nikwo gakiri.
en: As yet I am as strong this day as I was in the day that Moses sent me: as my strength was then, even so is my strength now, for war, both to go out, and to come in.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo ompe ensi y'ebibungo, ei MUKAMA yaagambireho eryo izooba; ahakuba nk'oku waahuriire buri, na mbwenu Abaanaki bariyo, kandi baine endembo mpango ezeehinguririziibwe engo zigumire. Shana MUKAMA aryaguma naanye, mbabingye, nk'oku yaagambire.
en: Now therefore give me this mountain, whereof the LORD spake in that day; for thou heardest in that day how the Anakims were there, and that the cities were great and fenced: if so be the LORD will be with me, then I shall be able to drive them out, as the LORD said.

rr: Yoshua yaashabira Kalebu mwene Yefune omugisha, yaamuha Heburooni kuba obuhunguzi bwe.
en: And Joshua blessed him, and gave unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh Hebron for an inheritance.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo Heburooni yaahinduka obuhunguzi bwa Kalebu mwene Yefune Omukenizi n'okuhitsya hati, ahabw'okuba akakuratirira kimwe MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli.
en: Hebron therefore became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite unto this day, because that he wholly followed the LORD God of Israel.

rr: (Kandi obunyakare Heburooni ekaba neeyetwa Kiryasi-araba; Araba ogwo akaba ari omuntu mukuru rugambwa omu Baanaki.) Bwanyima ensi yaahuumura engamba. Currently Selected: Yoshua 14 : RR64 Highlight Share <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8 19c-2.828 0
en: And the name of Hebron before was Kirjath-arba; which Arba was a great man among the Anakims. And the land had rest from war. Currently Selected: Joshua 14 : KJV Highlight Share <path d="M5 12a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h3a1 1 0 1 1 0 2H6a1 1

rr: Ekyanga eki oruganda rw'Abayuda baabagaine, nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri, kikaba nikihika aha mwatano gwa Edomu, omu ihamba rya Ziini aha bukiizi-bwa-buryo, okuhikira kimwe aha muheru gw'orubaju orwo
en: This then was the lot of the tribe of the children of Judah by their families; even to the border of Edom the wilderness of Zin southward was the uttermost part of the south coast.

rr: kandi omwatano gwabo ogw'aha bukiizi-bwa-buryo gukaba niguruga aha muheru gw'Enyanja y'omwonyo, aha mukono gw'enyanja ogurikureeba aha bukiizi-bwa-buryo
en: And their south border was from the shore of the salt sea, from the bay that looketh southward:

rr: gwogamu guhika aha bukizi-bwa-buryo aharikwinamuka Akarabiimu, gugumizamu guhika Ziini, gwinamuka aha bukiizi-bwa-buryo bwa Kadeshi-barunea, guraba haihi na Hezirooni, gwinamuka guhika Adari, gukiikama guhika Karaka
en: and it went out to the south side to Maaleh-acrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and ascended up on the south side unto Kadesh-barnea, and passed along to Hezron, and went up to Adar, and fetched a compass to Karkaa:

rr: okuruga aho gugumizamu guhika Azimooni, gwogamu, gushuuma n'akagyera ka Misri, gugarukira aha nyanja; ogwo nigwo guriba omwatano gwanyu aha bukiizi-bwa-buryo.
en: from thence it passed toward Azmon, and went out unto the river of Egypt; and the goings out of that coast were at the sea: this shall be your south coast.

rr: Kandi omwatano gwabo ogw'oburugwa-izooba gukaba guri Enyanja y'omwonyo okuhika ahu Yorudani egishukiramu.
en: And the east border was the salt sea, even unto the end of Jordan.

rr: Kandi omwatano ogw'orubaju rw'obukiizi-bwa-bumosho guruga aha mukono gw'enyanja ahu Yorudani erikugishukiramu
en: And their border in the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the uttermost part of Jordan:

rr: omwatano ogwo gwinamuka guhika Besi-hogola, guraba aha bukiizi-bwa-bumosho bwa Besaraba; gugumizamu guhika aha ibaare rya Bohani mwene Reubeeni.
en: and the border went up to Beth-hogla, and passed along by the north of Beth-arabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben:

rr: Kandi gugumizamu niguruga omu ruhanga rwa Akori, guhika Debira, gutyo gutoora aha bukiizi-bwa-bumosho, nigureeba Gilugaali ahateegaine n'aharikwinamuka Adumimu, eri aha bukiizi-bwa-buryo obw'oruhanga; ogwo mwatano gugumizamu guraba aha maizi ga Enishemeshi, gugarukira Eni-rogeli
en: and the border went up toward Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that is before the going up to Adummim, which is on the south side of the river: and the border passed toward the waters of En-shemesh, and the goings out thereof were at En-rogel:

rr: okuruga aho omwatano gwinamuka, guraba omu ruhanga rwa mwene Hinoomu oruri aha bukiizi-bwa-buryo bw'ensi y'Abayebusi, (niyo Yerusaalemu); gwinamuka guhika aha mutwe gw'ekibungo ekiri omu maisho g'oruhanga rwa Hinoomu orubaju rw'oburengyerwa-izooba, kandi ekiri aha muheru gw'oruhanga rw'Abareefa aha bukiizi-bwa-bumosho
en: and the border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom unto the south side of the Jebusite; the same is Jerusalem: and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lieth before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the end of the valley of the giants northward:

rr: bwanyima omwatano guruga aha mutwe gw'ekyo kibungo okuhika aha nshuro y'amaizi ga Nefutoa, gwogamu guhika aha ndembo z'aha kibungo kya Efurooni; guhika Baala, niyo Kiryasi-yearimu
en: and the border was drawn from the top of the hill unto the fountain of the water of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of mount Ephron; and the border was drawn to Baalah, which is Kirjath-jearim:

rr: okuruga Baala omwatano gukiikama gutoora oburengyerwa-izooba, guhika aha kibungo Seiri, guraba aha rubaju rw'ekibungo Yearimu aha bukiizi-bwa-bumosho, niyo Kesalooni; gushuuma guhika Beti-shemeshi, gwogamu guraba aha rubaju rwa Timuna
en: and the border compassed from Baalah westward unto mount Seir, and passed along unto the side of mount Jearim, which is Chesalon, on the north side, and went down to Beth-shemesh, and passed on to Timnah:

rr: gugumizamu guhika aha rubaju rwa Ekurooni aha bukiizi-bwa-bumosho; guhika Shikerooni, gwogamu guhika aha kibungo Baala, gugumizamu guhika Yabuneeli; gugarukira aha nyanja.
en: and the border went out unto the side of Ekron northward: and the border was drawn to Shicron, and passed along to mount Baalah, and went out unto Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.

rr: Kandi n'omwatano ogw'oburengyerwa-izooba gukaba guri Enyanja empango. Ogwo nigwo mwatano gw'Abayuda nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri. Kalebu okukubuura ekyanga eki yaahairwe
en: And the west border was to the great sea, and the coast thereof . This is the coast of the children of Judah round about according to their families.

rr: Kandi Yoshua yaaha Kalebu mwene Yefune omugabo omu kyanga ky'Abayuda, nk'oku MUKAMA yaaragiire Yoshua, niyo Kiryasi-araba, erikwetwa Heburooni; (Araba ogwo niwe ishe wa Anaki).
en: And unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh he gave a part among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of the LORD to Joshua, even the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron.

rr: Kalebu ogwo yaabingamu batabani ba Anaki bashatu, Sheshai, Ahimaanu na Talumai, baijukuru ba Anaki.
en: And Caleb drove thence the three sons of Anak, Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.

rr: Okuruga aho yainamuka, yaateera aba Debira; kandi obunyakare eiziina rya Debira rikaba riri Kiryasi-seferi.
en: And he went up thence to the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before was Kirjath-sepher.

rr: Kandi Kalebu yaagira ati: Oraateere Kiryasi-seferi, akagikwata, niinyija kumuhingira muhara wangye Akisa.
en: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjath-sepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.

rr: Otinieli mwene Kenazi, murumuna wa Kalebu, yaagikwata; onu yaamuhingira muhara we Akisa.
en: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.

rr: Ku yaamutaahize, Akisa yaayeshengyereza iba kushaba ishe-zaara ekibanja; ku yaarugire aha ndogoya ye, Kalebu yaamubuuza ati: Nooyenda ki?
en: And it came to pass, as she came unto him , that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wouldest thou?

rr: Yaamugarukamu ati: Ontambire! Nk'oku ontaire omu nsi ya Negebu, ogarukye ompe ahaine enshuro z'amaizi. Kalebu nikwo kumuha enshuro z'eruguru n'eza ifo.
en: Who answered, Give me a blessing; for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And he gave her the upper springs, and the nether springs.

rr: Obwo nibwo buhunguzi bw'Abayuda nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri.
en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.

rr: Endembo z'oruganda rw'Abayuda eziri aha muheru gw'obukiizi-bwa-buryo, aha rubaju rw'omwatano gwa Edomu nizo ezi. Kabuzieli, Ederi, Yaguri
en: And the uttermost cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the coast of Edom southward were Kabzeel, and Eder, and Jagur,

rr: Kiina, Dimona, Adada
en: and Kinah, and Dimonah, and Adadah,

rr: Kedeshi, Hazori, Itunaanu
en: and Kedesh, and Hazor, and Ithnan,

rr: Ziifu, Telemu, Bealoosi
en: Ziph, and Telem, and Bealoth,

rr: Hazori-Hadata, Keriosi-hezirooni, niyo Hazori
en: and Hazor, Hadattah, and Kerioth, and Hezron, which is Hazor,

rr: Amamu, Sheema, Molada
en: Amam, and Shema, and Moladah,

rr: Hazari-gaada, Heshimooni, Besipeleeti
en: and Hazar-gaddah, and Heshmon, and Beth-palet,

rr: Hazari-shuali, Beeri-sheba, Bizyotia
en: and Hazar-shual, and Beer-sheba, and Bizjothjah,

rr: Baala, Iyimu, Ezeemu
en: Baalah, and Iim, and Azem,

rr: Elitolaadi, Kesili, Horuma
en: and Eltolad, and Chesil, and Hormah,

rr: Zikulaagi, Madimana, Sani-sana
en: and Ziklag, and Madmannah, and Sansannah,

rr: Lebaosi, Shilihimu, Aini na Rimoni; endembo zoona makumi abiri na mwenda n'ebirorero byazo.
en: and Lebaoth, and Shilhim, and Ain, and Rimmon: all the cities are twenty and nine, with their villages:

rr: N'ez'omu mpita, Eshitaoli, Zoora, Ashina
en: And in the valley, Eshtaol, and Zoreah, and Ashnah,

rr: Zanoa, Eniganimu, Tapua, Enamu
en: and Zanoah, and En-gannim, Tappuah, and Enam,

rr: Yaramusi, Adulaamu, Sooko, Azeka
en: Jarmuth, and Adullam, Socoh, and Azekah,

rr: Sharaimu, Aditaimu, Gedeerana, Gederosaimu, endembo ikumi na ina n'ebirorero byazo.
en: and Sharaim, and Adithaim, and Gederah, and Gederothaim; fourteen cities with their villages:

rr: Zenani, Hadasha, Migudaligadi
en: Zenan, and Hadashah, and Migdal-gad,

rr: Dileani, Mizipe, Yokiseeli
en: and Dilean, and Mizpeh, and Joktheel,

rr: Lakishi, Bozikaasi, Egulooni
en: Lachish, and Bozkath, and Eglon,

rr: Kaboni, Lahimani, Kitiliishi
en: and Cabbon, and Lahmam, and Kithlish,

rr: Gederoosi, Besidagoni, Naama, na Makeda, endembo ikumi na mukaaga n'ebirorero byazo.
en: and Gederoth, Beth-dagon, and Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages:

rr: Libuna, Eteeri, Ashani
en: Libnah, and Ether, and Ashan,

rr: Ifuta, Ashuna, Nezibu
en: and Jiphtah, and Ashnah, and Nezib,

rr: Keila, Akiziibuna, Mareesha, endembo mwenda n'ebirorero byazo.
en: and Keilah, and Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages:

rr: Ekurooni na tauni zaarwo n'ebirorero byarwo
en: Ekron, with her towns and her villages:

rr: okuruga aha Ekurooni okuhika aha Nyanja, endembo zoona ezaabaire ziri aha rubaju rwa Ashidoodi n'ebirorero byazo
en: from Ekron even unto the sea, all that lay near Ashdod, with their villages:

rr: na Ashidoodi na tauni zaarwo n'ebirorero byarwo; na Gaaza na tauni zaarwo n'ebirorero byarwo, okuhika aha kagyera ka Misri n'aha Nyanja empango.
en: Ashdod with her towns and her villages, Gaza with her towns and her villages, unto the river of Egypt, and the great sea, and the border thereof:

rr: N'ez'omu nsi y'enshozi, Shamira, Yatiri, Sooko
en: And in the mountains, Shamir, and Jattir, and Socoh,

rr: Daana, Kiryasi-sana, niyo Debira
en: and Dannah, and Kirjath-sannah, which is Debir,

rr: Anabu, Eshitemo, Animu
en: and Anab, and Eshtemoh, and Anim,

rr: Gosheni, Holoni, na Giilo; endembo ikumi na rumwe n'ebirorero byazo.
en: and Goshen, and Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages:

rr: Arabu, Duma, Eshani
en: Arab, and Dumah, and Eshean,

rr: Yanimu, Besi-tapua, Afeka
en: and Janum, and Beth-tappuah, and Aphekah,

rr: Humita, Kiryasi-araba, niyo Heburooni, na Ziori, endembo mwenda n'ebirorero byazo
en: and Humtah, and Kirjath-arba, which is Hebron, and Zior; nine cities with their villages:

rr: Maoni, Karumeeli, Ziifu, Yuta
en: Maon, Carmel, and Ziph, and Juttah,

rr: Yezereeli, Yokideamu, Zanoa
en: and Jezreel, and Jokdeam, and Zanoah,

rr: Kaini, Gibea, na Timuna; endembo ikumi n'ebirorero byazo
en: Cain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages:

rr: Halihuli, Besi-zuuri, Gedori
en: Halhul, Beth-zur, and Gedor,

rr: Maarasi, Besanoosi na Elitekoni; endembo mukaaga n'ebirorero byazo
en: and Maarath, and Beth-anoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages:

rr: Kiryasi-baali, niyo Kiryasi-yearimu, na Rabba; endembo ibiri n'ebirorero byazo.
en: Kirjath-baal, which is Kirjath-jearim, and Rabbah; two cities with their villages:

rr: N'ez'omu ihamba, Besaraba, Midudiini, Sekaaka
en: in the wilderness, Beth-arabah, Middin, and Secacah,

rr: Nibushani orurembo rw'omwonyo, na Eni-geedi; endembo mukaaga n'ebirorero byazo.
en: and Nibshan, and the city of Salt, and En-gedi; six cities with their villages.

rr: Kwonka Abayebusi abaabaire batwire Yerusaalemu, Abayuda tibarabaasize kubabinga; n'ahabw'ekyo Abayebusi bakatuura Yerusaalemu hamwe n'Abayuda n'okuhitsya eri izooba.
en: As for the Jebusites the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah could not drive them out: but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Judah at Jerusalem unto this day.

rr: Ekyanga eki baijukuru ba Yosefu baabagaine kikaba nikitandikira Yorudani haihi na Yeriko, aha maizi gaayo omu ihamba, omwatano guruga Yeriko, gwinamuka Beseeli niguraba omu nsi y'ebibungo
en: And the lot of the children of Joseph fell from Jordan by Jericho, unto the water of Jericho on the east, to the wilderness that goeth up from Jericho throughout mount Beth-el,

rr: guruga Beseeli, guza Luuzi, guraba aha mwatano gw'aba Aruki, guhika Ataroosi
en: and goeth out from Beth-el to Luz, and passeth along unto the borders of Archi to Ataroth,

rr: gushuuma oburengyerwa-izooba guhika aha mwatano gw'aba Yafileeti, kandi guhika aha mwatano gwa Besihoroni eya ifo, niyo Gezeri; gugarukira aha Nyanja.
en: and goeth down westward to the coast of Japhleti, unto the coast of Beth-horon the nether, and to Gezer: and the goings out thereof are at the sea.

rr: Baijukuru ba Yosefu, abaana ba Manaase na Efuraimu, baaheebwa obuhunguzi bwabo.
en: So the children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.

rr: Omwatano gw'ekyanga kya beene Efuraimu nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri, gukaba guri guti; omwatano gw'obuhunguzi bwabo oburugwa-izooba gukaba nigutandikira Ataroosi-adari, guhika Besi-horoni ey'eruguru
en: And the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families was thus: even the border of their inheritance on the east side was Ataroth-addar, unto Beth-horon the upper;

rr: ahari Mikemeesa aha bukiizi-bwa-bumosho gwogamu gutoora oburengyerwa-izooba; bwanyima gukiikama gutoora oburugwa-izooba, guhika Tanati-shiilo, gugiraba haihi aha rubaju rw'oburugwa-izooba okuhika Yanoa.
en: and the border went out toward the sea to Michmethah on the north side; and the border went about eastward unto Taanath-shiloh, and passed by it on the east to Janohah;

rr: Okuruga Yanoa gushuuma guza Ataroosi na Naara; guhika Yeriko, gugarukira Yorudani.
en: and it went down from Janohah to Ataroth, and to Naarath, and came to Jericho, and went out at Jordan.

rr: Kandi omwatano guruga Tapua gugumizamu oburengyerwa-izooba, guhika aha kagyera Kaana; gugarukira aha Nyanja.
en: The border went out from Tappuah westward unto the river Kanah; and the goings out thereof were at the sea.

rr: Obwo nibwo buhunguzi bw'Abaefuraimu, nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri
en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim by their families.

rr: hamwe n'endembo ezaabatooraniirwe omu kyanga ky'obuhunguzi bw'Abamanaase, endembo zoona n'ebirorero byazo.
en: And the separate cities for the children of Ephraim were among the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.

rr: Kwonka tibarabingiremu Abanyakanaani abaabaire batwire Gezeri; n'ahabw'ekyo Abanyakanaani bakatuura omu Baefuraimu n'okuhitsya eri izooba, kwonka baahinduka abahuuku b'okubakorera.
en: And they drave not out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer: but the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites unto this day, and serve under tribute.
