rr: Oku nikwo baabaganisiize oruganda rwa Manaase, ahabw'okuba omujigaijo gwa Yosefu. Kandi Makiri omujigaijo gwa Manaase, ishenkuru wa Gileadi, akaheebwa ebyanga bya Gileadi na Bashani, ahakuba akaba ari emanzi omu ngamba.
en: There was also a lot for the tribe of Manasseh; for he was the firstborn of Joseph; to wit , for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead: because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.

rr: Kandi baijukuru ba Manaase abaatsigaireho baababaganisiza, nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri; abo nibo, Abiezeeri, Heleki, Asirieli, Shekemu, Heferi, na Shemiida, batabani ba Manaase mwene Yosefu, nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri.
en: There was also a lot for the rest of the children of Manasseh by their families; for the children of Abiezer, and for the children of Helek, and for the children of Asriel, and for the children of Shechem, and for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida: these were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph by their families.

rr: Kwonka Zelofehaadi mwene Heferi, mwene Gileadi, mwene Makiri, mwene Manaase, tarazaire boojo, kureka abaishiki; kandi aga nigo maziina gaabo, Maala, Noa, Hogula, Milika na Tiruza.
en: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters: and these are the names of his daughters, Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

rr: Baimuka baashanga Eleazaari omunyamurwa, na Yoshua mwene Nuuni, n'abakuru b'eihanga, baagira bati: MUKAMA akaragiira Musa kutuha obuhunguzi na banyaanyaitwe.
en: And they came near before Eleazar the priest, and before Joshua the son of Nun, and before the princes, saying, The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brethren.

rr: Nikyo Yoshua yaabaheereire obuhunguzi na beene ishe, nk'ekiragiro kya MUKAMA oku kyabaire kiri.
en: Therefore according to the commandment of the LORD he gave them an inheritance among the brethren of their father.

rr: Abamanaase baaheebwa ebicweka ikumi, otabariiremu ebyanga bya Gileadi na Bashani seeri ya Yorudani
en: And there fell ten portions to Manasseh, beside the land of Gilead and Bashan, which were on the other side Jordan;

rr: ahabw'okuba bahara ba Manaase bakaheebwa obuhunguzi na baanyaanyabo; kandi Abamanaase abandi baaheebwa ekyanga kya Gileadi.
en: because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons: and the rest of Manasseh's sons had the land of Gilead.

rr: Omwatano gw'ekyanga ky'Abamanaase gukaba gutandikira Asheri, guhika Mikemeesa, eri kureeba Shekemu; gugumizamu aha bukiizi-bwa-buryo, guhika omu bantu abatwire Eni-tapua.
en: And the coast of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethah, that lieth before Shechem; and the border went along on the right hand unto the inhabitants of En-tappuah.

rr: Kandi ekyanga kya Tapua kikaba kiri ekya Manaase, kwonka Tapua aha mwatano gwa Manaase ekaba eri ey'Abaefuraimu.
en: Now Manasseh had the land of Tappuah: but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim;

rr: Gutyo omwatano gushuuma, guhika aha kagyera Kaana aha rubaju rwako rw'obukiizi-bwa-buryo; endembo ezo zikaba ziri ez'Abaefuraimu ahagati omu ndembo za Manaase; kandi omwatano gwa Manaase gukaba guri aha rubaju rw'obukiizi-bwa-bumosho bw'ako kagyera; nigugarukira aha Nyanja.
en: and the coast descended unto the river Kanah, southward of the river: these cities of Ephraim are among the cities of Manasseh: the coast of Manasseh also was on the north side of the river, and the outgoings of it were at the sea:

rr: Aha rubaju rw'obukiizi-bwa-buryo ekaba eri eya Efuraimu, kandi aha rubaju rw'obukiizi-bwa-bumosho eri eya Manaase; n'enyanja ekaba eri omwatano gwe; kandi aha bukiizi-bwa-bumosho baahika aha kyanga kya Asheri, kandi oburugwa-izooba bahika aha kya Isakaari.
en: southward it was Ephraim's, and northward it was Manasseh's, and the sea is his border; and they met together in Asher on the north, and in Issachar on the east.

rr: Kandi omu byanga bya Isakaari na Asheri, aba Manaase bakaheebwa Besi-sheani na tauni zaarwo, Ibuleamu na tauni zaarwo, n'abantu abatwire Doori na tauni zaarwo, n'abatwire Endoori na tauni zaarwo, n'abatwire Tanaki na tauni zaarwo, n'abatwire Megido na tauni zaarwo, nibyo bibungo bishatu.
en: And Manasseh had in Issachar and in Asher Beth-shean and her towns, and Ibleam and her towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and her towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns, even three countries.

rr: Kwonka aba Manaase tibarabaasize kubinga abantu abaabaire batwire omu ndembo ezo, kureka Abanyakanaani bakenda kuguma batwire omu nsi egyo.
en: Yet the children of Manasseh could not drive out the inhabitants of those cities; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.

rr: Kwonka Abaisraeli ku baaherize kuhama, baakoresa Abanyakanaani emirimo y'obuhuuku, tibaababingiramu kimwe.
en: Yet it came to pass, when the children of Israel were waxen strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute; but did not utterly drive them out.

rr: Baijukuru ba Yosefu baabuuza Yoshua bati: Ahabwe'enki otuhaire omugabo gw'ekyanga kimwe omu kicweka kimwe kuba obuhunguzi bwaitu; haza turi oruganda ruhango, kandi MUKAMA atuhaire omugisha n'okuhitsya hati?
en: And the children of Joseph spake unto Joshua, saying, Why hast thou given me but one lot and one portion to inherit, seeing I am a great people, forasmuch as the LORD hath blessed me hitherto?

rr: Yoshua yaabagarukamu ati: Ku muraabe muri oruganda ruhango, mwinamukye muze omu kibira ky'omu nsi y'Abaperizi n'aba Reefa, mukyetemere, mweshanze; ahabw'okuba ensi y'ebibungo eya Efuraimu efunzire munonga ahariimwe.
en: And Joshua answered them, If thou be a great people, then get thee up to the wood country , and cut down for thyself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the giants, if mount Ephraim be too narrow for thee.

rr: Aba Yosefu baagira bati: Ensi y'ebibungo terikutuhika; kandi Abanyakanaani boona abatwire omu nsi y'empita baine ebigaari by'ebyoma, nibo ba Besi-sheani na tauni zaarwo, n'abatwire omu ruhita rwa Yezereeli.
en: And the children of Joseph said, The hill is not enough for us: and all the Canaanites that dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both they who are of Beth-shean and her towns, and they who are of the valley of Jezreel.

rr: Yoshua nikwo kugambira ab'omuryango gwa Yosefu, nibo ba Efuraimu n'aba Manaase, ati: N'ekya buzima muri oruganda ruhango, kandi mwine amaani maingi; timushemereire kuheebwa omugabo gw'ekyanga kimwe kyonka
en: And Joshua spake unto the house of Joseph, even to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, Thou art a great people, and hast great power: thou shalt not have one lot only:

rr: -6 ; . kureka ensi y'ebibungo eryaba eyaanyu; n'obu eraabe eri ey'ekibira, muryakitema, mukikubuure okuhika aha muheru gwakyo; ahakuba Abanyakanaani, n'obu baraabe baine ebigaari by'ebyoma, kandi bari ab'amaani, muryababinga.
en: but the mountain shall be thine; for it is a wood, and thou shalt cut it down: and the outgoings of it shall be thine: for thou shalt drive out the Canaanites, though they have iron chariots, and though they be strong.

rr: -60 ; Eihanga ryona ry'Abaisraeli ryateeranira hamwe Shiilo; baimutsyayo Eihema ry'okuteeraniramu.
en: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled together at Shiloh, and set up the tabernacle of the congregation there.

rr: Ensi yaabagomookyera.
en: And the land was subdued before them.

rr: Kwonka omu Baisraeli hakaba hatsigaire enganda mushanju, ezaabaire zitakahairwe buhunguzi bwazo.
en: And there remained among the children of Israel seven tribes, which had not yet received their inheritance.

rr: Yoshua yaagambira Abaisraeli ati: Muryahitsya hi okweganda kuza kukubuura ensi, ei MUKAMA Ruhanga wa baashwenkuriimwe yaabahaire?
en: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, How long are ye slack to go to possess the land, which the LORD God of your fathers hath given you?

rr: Mbwenu mutoorane abashaija bashatu omuri buri ruganda; naanye ndyaboohereza, baimukye, bagyendagyende omu nsi, beetegyereze ensi y'obuhunguzi bwabo oku erikushusha, haza bagarukye ahariinye.
en: Give out from among you three men for each tribe: and I will send them, and they shall rise, and go through the land, and describe it according to the inheritance of them; and they shall come again to me.

rr: Kandi baryagibaganisa omu bicweka mushanju; Abayuda baryaguma omu kyanga kyabo aha bukiizi-bwa-buryo, n'aba Yosefu bagume omu kyabo aha bukiizi-bwa-bumosho.
en: And they shall divide it into seven parts: Judah shall abide in their coast on the south, and the house of Joseph shall abide in their coasts on the north.

rr: Muryabaganisa ensi omu bicweka mushanju, mubireete aha, mubinshobororere; naanye ndyagibabaganisiriza n'enteenyu omu maisho ga MUKAMA Ruhanga waitu.
en: Ye shall therefore describe the land into seven parts, and bring the description hither to me, that I may cast lots for you here before the LORD our God.

rr: Kwonka Abaleevi tibaine mugabo omuriimwe, ahakuba obunyamurwa bwa MUKAMA nibwo buhunguzi bwabo; n'Abagaadi n'Abareubeeni, n'ekicweka ky'oruganda rwa Manaase, baaherize kuheebwa obuhunguzi bwabo oburugwa-izooba seeri ya Yorudani, obu Musa omugaragwa wa MUKAMA yaabahaire.
en: But the Levites have no part among you; for the priesthood of the LORD is their inheritance: and Gad, and Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh, have received their inheritance beyond Jordan on the east, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave them.

rr: Abo bashaija ku baabaire nibaimuka kugyenda kushoboorora ensi, Yoshua yaabeehanangiriza ati: Mugyende omu nsi yoona, muhandikye emyatano yaayo, mugarukye ahi ndi; naanye ndyagibabaganisiriza aha Shiilo omu maisho ga MUKAMA.
en: And the men arose, and went away: and Joshua charged them that went to describe the land, saying, Go and walk through the land, and describe it, and come again to me, that I may here cast lots for you before the LORD in Shiloh.

rr: Abashaija abo baagyenda, baaraba omuri egyo nsi, baahandika ebicweka byayo mushanju omu kitabo, nibooreka n'endembo zaamwo; bwanyima baagaruka ahari Yoshua omu rusiisira Shiilo.
en: And the men went and passed through the land, and described it by cities into seven parts in a book, and came again to Joshua to the host at Shiloh.

rr: Yoshua yaabateerera enteenyu ari omuri Shiilo omu maisho ga MUKAMA. Aho niho Yoshua yaabaganisiriize Abaisraeli ensi, nk'enganda zaabo oku zaabaire ziri. Omugabo gw'ekyanga ky'aba Benyamiini
en: And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the LORD : and there Joshua divided the land unto the children of Israel according to their divisions.

rr: Omugabo gw'oruganda rwa Benyamiini gwaija nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri; kandi omwatano gw'ekyanga kyabo gukaba gutandikira ahagati y'eky'Abayuda n'eky'aba Yosefu.
en: And the lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families: and the coast of their lot came forth between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.

rr: Kandi omwatano gwabo aha bukiizi-bwa-bumosho, gukaba gutandikira Yorudani, gwinamuka, guraba aha rubaju rwa Yeriko aha bukiizi-bwa-bumosho, gugumizamu guraba omu nsi y'ebibungo oburengyerwa-izooba, gugarukira aha ihamba rya Besaveeni.
en: And their border on the north side was from Jordan; and the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north side, and went up through the mountains westward; and the goings out thereof were at the wilderness of Beth-aven.

rr: Okuruga aho guza Luuzi, niyo Beseeli, aha rubaju rwayo rw'obukiizi-bwa-buryo, gushuuma guhika Ataroosi-adari, haihi n'ekibungo ekiri aha bukiizi-bwa-buryo bwa Besi-horoni eya ifo.
en: And the border went over from thence toward Luz, to the side of Luz, which is Beth-el, southward; and the border descended to Ataroth-addar, near the hill that lieth on the south side of the nether Beth-horon.

rr: Aha rubaju rw'oburengyerwa-izooba gukiikama gutoora obukiizi-bwa-buryo, okuruga aha kibungo ekirikureeba Besi-horoni aha rubaju rwa buryo, gugarukira Kiryasi-baali, niyo Kiryasi-yearimu orurembo rw'Abayuda; orubaju orwo nirwo rw'oburengyerwa-izooba.
en: And the border was drawn thence , and compassed the corner of the sea southward, from the hill that lieth before Beth-horon southward; and the goings out thereof were at Kirjath-baal, which is Kirjath-jearim, a city of the children of Judah: this was the west quarter.

rr: Kandi orubaju rw'obukiizi-bwa-buryo gutandikira aha muheru gwa Kiryasi-yearimu, gutoora oburengyerwa-izooba, guhika aha nshuro z'amaizi za Nefutoa
en: And the south quarter was from the end of Kirjath-jearim, and the border went out on the west, and went out to the well of waters of Nephtoah:

rr: gushuuma, guhika aha muheru gw'ekibungo, ekirikureebana n'oruhanga rwa beene Hinoomu, kandi ekiri aha muheru gw'obukiizi-bwa-bumosho bw'oruhanga rwa Reefa; gushuuma omu ruhanga rwa Hinoomu, okuhika aha rubaju rw'Abayebusi aha bukiizi-bwa-buryo, gugumizamu gushuuma Eni-rogeli
en: and the border came down to the end of the mountain that lieth before the valley of the son of Hinnom, and which is in the valley of the giants on the north, and descended to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of Jebusi on the south, and descended to En-rogel,

rr: gukiikama, gutoora obukiizi-bwa-bumosho, guza Eni-shemeshi, gugumizamu guza Elilooti, erikureebana n'aharikwinamuka Adumimu; gushuuma guhika aha rukiri rwa Bohani mwene Reubeeni
en: and was drawn from the north, and went forth to En-shemesh, and went forth toward Geliloth, which is over against the going up of Adummim, and descended to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben,

rr: gugumizamu guraba aha rubaju rw'obukiizi-bwa-bumosho bwa Besaraba, gushuuma guhika Araba
en: and passed along toward the side over against Arabah northward, and went down unto Arabah:

rr: kandi gwogamu guhika aha rubaju rwa Besi-hogola aha bukiizi-bwa-bumosho, gugarukira aha mukono gw'Enyanja y'omwonyo, ogw'aha bukiizi-bwa-bumosho aha isheeshero rya Yorudani; ogwo nigwo mwatano gw'obukiizi-bwa-buryo.
en: and the border passed along to the side of Beth-hoglah northward: and the outgoings of the border were at the north bay of the salt sea at the south end of Jordan: this was the south coast.

rr: Kandi Yorudani niyo yaabaire eri omwatano gwayo aha rubaju rw'oburugwa-izooba.
en: And Jordan was the border of it on the east side.

rr: Ekyo nikyo kyanga ky'obuhunguzi bw'aba Benyamiini, nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri, n'emyatano yaakyo oku yaabaire eri aha mbaju zoona.
en: This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the coasts thereof round about, according to their families.

rr: Kandi endembo z'oruganda rwa Benyamiini, nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri, nizo ezi; Yeriko, Besi-hogola, Emekezizi
en: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, and Beth-hoglah, and the valley of Keziz,

rr: Besaraba, Zemaraimu, Beseeli
en: and Beth-arabah, and Zemaraim, and Beth-el,

rr: Avimu, Paara, Ofura
en: and Avim, and Parah, and Ophrah,

rr: Kefaramooni, Ofuni na Geeba; endembo ikumi na ibiri n'ebirorero byazo
en: and Chephar-haammonai, and Ophni, and Gaba; twelve cities with their villages:

rr: Gibeoni, Raama, Beerosi
en: Gibeon, and Ramah, and Beeroth,

rr: Mizipe, Kefira, Mooza
en: and Mizpeh, and Chephirah, and Mozah,

rr: Rekemu, Irupeeli, Tarala
en: and Rekem, and Irpeel, and Taralah,

rr: Zeela, Elefu na Yebusi, niyo Yerusaalemu, Gibeasi, na Kiryasi; endembo ikumi na ina n'ebirorero byazo.
en: and Zelah, Eleph, and Jebusi, which is Jerusalem, Gibeath, and Kirjath; fourteen cities with their villages.

rr: Obwo nibwo buhunguzi bw'Ababenyamiini nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri.
en: This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.

rr: Omugabo gwa kabiri gwaija guri ogwa Simeoni, nirwo ruganda rw'Abasimeoni nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri; ekyanga ky'obuhunguzi bwabo kikaba kiri ahagati y'eky'obuhunguzi bw'Abayuda.
en: And the second lot came forth to Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families: and their inheritance was within the inheritance of the children of Judah.

rr: Endembo ezi baahairwe kuba obuhunguzi bwabo nizo ezi; Beeri-sheba nari Sheba, Molada
en: And they had in their inheritance Beer-sheba, and Sheba, and Moladah,

rr: Hazari-shuali, Baala, Ezeemu
en: and Hazar-shual, and Balah, and Azem,

rr: Elitolaadi, Besuula, Horuma
en: and Eltolad, and Bethul, and Hormah,

rr: Zikulaagi, Besi-marikaboosi, Hazaari-suusa
en: and Ziklag, and Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susah,

rr: Besi-lebaosi, na Sharuheni; endembo ikumi na ishatu n'ebirorero byazo
en: and Beth-lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities and their villages:

rr: Aini, Rimona, Eteeri, na Ashani; endembo ina n'ebirorero byazo.
en: Ain, Remmon, and Ether, and Ashan; four cities and their villages:

rr: n'ebirorero byona ebyahinguririize ezo ndembo okuhika Baalasibeero, niyo Raama y'obukiizi-bwa-buryo.
en: and all the villages that were round about these cities to Baalath-beer, Ramath of the south.

rr: Obwo nibwo buhunguzi bw'oruganda rwa Simeoni, nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri.
en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.

rr: Obuhunguzi bw'Abasimeoni bukaihwa omu bw'Abayuda, ahakuba ekyanga ky'Abayuda kikaba kiri kihango munonga, nikibakira; nikyo kyareeteire oruganda rwa Simeoni kuheebwa obuhunguzi ahagati y'obw'Abayuda. Ekyanga ky'oruganda rwa Zebuluuni
en: Out of the portion of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon: for the part of the children of Judah was too much for them: therefore the children of Simeon had their inheritance within the inheritance of them.

rr: Omugabo gwa kashatu gwaija, guri ogw'oruganda rwa Zebuluuni, nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri. Omwatano gw'obuhunguzi bwabo gukaba guhika Sarida
en: And the third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families: and the border of their inheritance was unto Sarid:

rr: gwinamuka gutoora oburengyerwa-izooba, guhika Marala na Dabesheesi; gugumizamu guhika aha kagyera akari omu maisho ga Yokineamu
en: and their border went up toward the sea, and Maralah, and reached to Dabbasheth, and reached to the river that is before Jokneam;

rr: okuruga Sarida gukiikama gutoora oburugwa-izooba, guhika aha mwatano gwa Kisiloosi-tabora; guruga aho, guhika Daberaasi, gwinamuka guhika Yafia
en: and turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrising unto the border of Chisloth-tabor, and then goeth out to Daberath, and goeth up to Japhia,

rr: guruga aho guraba aha rubaju rw'oburugwa-izooba, guhika Gaasi-heferi na Eti-kaziini, gwogamu guhika Rimoni, gutoora Nea
en: and from thence passeth on along on the east to Gittah-hepher, to Ittah-kazin, and goeth out to Remmon-methoar to Neah;

rr: aha bukiizi-bwa-bumosho gukiikama gutoora Hanatooni, gugarukira omu ruhanga rwa Ifusaheeli
en: and the border compasseth it on the north side to Hannathon: and the outgoings thereof are in the valley of Jiphthah-el:

rr: kandi baheebwa Kataasi, Nahalaali, Shimirooni, Idala na Betelehemu; endembo ikumi na ibiri n'ebirorero byazo.
en: and Kattath, and Nahallal, and Shimron, and Idalah, and Beth-lehem: twelve cities with their villages.

rr: Obwo nibwo buhunguzi bw'Abazebuluuni, nizo ndembo n'ebirorero byazo, nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri. Ekyanga ky'oruganda rwa Isakaari
en: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.

rr: Omugabo gwa kana gwaija guri ogwa Isakaari, nirwo ruganda rw'Abaisakaari, nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri.
en: And the fourth lot came out to Issachar, for the children of Issachar according to their families.

rr: Ekyanga kyabo kikaba kirimu endembo ezi; Yezereeli, Kesuloosi, Shuneemu
en: And their border was toward Jezreel, and Chesulloth, and Shunem,

rr: Hafaraimu, Shioni, Anaharaasi
en: and Haphraim, and Shihon, and Anaharath,

rr: Rabisi, Kishioni, Ebeza
en: and Rabbith, and Kishion, and Abez,

rr: Remesi, Eni-ganimu, Eni-haada, na Besi-pazezi
en: and Remeth, and En-gannim, and En-haddah, and Beth-pazzez;

rr: kandi omwatano guhika Tabora, Shahazuma, na Beti-shemeshi, gugarukira Yorudani; endembo ikumi na mukaaga n'ebirorero byazo.
en: and the coast reacheth to Tabor, and Shahazimah, and Beth-shemesh; and the outgoings of their border were at Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.

rr: Obwo nibwo buhunguzi bw'oruganda rwa Isakaari, n'endembo zaabo n'ebirorero byazo, nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri. Ekyanga ky'oruganda rwa Asheri
en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities and their villages.

rr: Omugabo gwa kataano gwaija guri ogw'oruganda rwa Asheri, nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri.
en: And the fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.

rr: Ekyanga kyabo kikaba kirimu endembo ezi; Helukaasi, Haali, Beeteni, Akisaafu
en: And their border was Helkath, and Hali, and Beten, and Achshaph,

rr: Alameleki, Amadi, na Mishaali; kandi aha burengyerwa-izooba, omwatano guhika Karumeeli na Shihori-libunaasi
en: and Alammelech, and Amad, and Misheal; and reacheth to Carmel westward, and to Shihor-libnath;

rr: gukiikama gutoora oburugwa-izooba, guhika Besi-dagoni, gugumizamu guhika Zebuluuni, n'omu ruhanga rwa Ifusaheeli aha rubaju rw'obukiizi-bwa-bumosho, guhika Besi-emeki, na Neyeli; gugarukira Kaabuli aha rubaju rwa bumosho
en: and turneth toward the sunrising to Beth-dagon, and reacheth to Zebulun, and to the valley of Jiphthah-el toward the north side of Beth-emek, and Neiel, and goeth out to Cabul on the left hand,

rr: na Eburooni, Rehobu, Hamoni na Kaana, n'okuhika Sidoni empango
en: and Hebron, and Rehob, and Hammon, and Kanah, even unto great Zidon;

rr: bwanyima gukiikama gutoora Raama, guhika aha rurembo rw'orugo orugumire Turo; okuruga aho gukiikama gutoora Hoosa; gugarukira aha nyanja haihi na Akiziibu
en: and then the coast turneth to Ramah, and to the strong city Tyre; and the coast turneth to Hosah; and the outgoings thereof are at the sea from the coast to Achzib:

rr: kandi baheebwa Umma na Afeki na Rehobu; endembo makumi abiri na ibiri n'ebirorero byazo.
en: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty and two cities with their villages.

rr: Obwo nibwo buhunguzi bw'oruganda rwa Asheri, n'endembo zaabo n'ebirorero byazo, nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri. Ekyanga ky'oruganda rwa Nafutaali
en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.

rr: Omugabo gwa mukaaga gwaija guri ogw'oruganda rwa Nafutaali, nibo Banafutaali nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri.
en: The sixth lot came out to the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families.

rr: Omwatano gwabo gukaba gutandikira Helefi, aha muti ogurikwetwa omwela oguri Zaananimu, guraba Adami-nekebu, na Yabuneeli, guhika Lakumu, gugarukira Yorudani.
en: And their coast was from Heleph, from Allon to Zaanannim, and Adami, Nekeb, and Jabneel, unto Lakum; and the outgoings thereof were at Jordan:

rr: Aha rubaju rw'oburengyerwa-izooba gukiikama, guhika Azinoosi-tabora; okuruga aho guraba Hukooki, guhika Zebuluuni aha rubaju rw'obukiizi-bwa-buryo, kandi guhika Asheri aha rubaju rw'oburengyerwa-izooba, kandi aha rubaju rw'oburugwa-izooba guhika Yuda ahari Yorudani.
en: and then the coast turneth westward to Aznoth-tabor, and goeth out from thence to Hukkok, and reacheth to Zebulun on the south side, and reacheth to Asher on the west side, and to Judah upon Jordan toward the sunrising.

rr: Kandi endembo zaabo ez'engo ezigumire nizo ezi; Zidimu, Zeera, Hamasi, Rakasi, Kinereesi
en: And the fenced cities are Ziddim, Zer, and Hammath, Rakkath, and Chinnereth,

rr: Adama, Raama, Hazori
en: and Adamah, and Ramah, and Hazor,

rr: Kedeshi, Edurei, Enihazori
en: and Kedesh, and Edrei, and En-hazor,

rr: Irooni, Migudaleeli, Horemu, Besanaasi, na Besi-shemeshi; endembo ikumi na mwenda n'ebirorero byazo.
en: and Iron, and Migdal-el, Horem, and Beth-anath, and Beth-shemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.

rr: Obwo nibwo buhunguzi bw'oruganda rwa Nafutaali, n'endembo zaabo n'ebirorero byazo, nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri. Ekyanga ky'oruganda rwa Daani
en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities and their villages.

rr: Omugabo gwa mushanju gwaija guri ogw'oruganda rwa Daani, nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri.
en: And the seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.

rr: Ekyanga ky'obuhunguzi bwabo kikaba kirimu endembo ezi, Zoora, Eshitaoli, Irishemeshi
en: And the coast of their inheritance was Zorah, and Eshtaol, and Ir-shemesh,

rr: Shaalabiina, Ayalooni, Itula
en: and Shaalabbin, and Ajalon, and Jethlah,

rr: Eloni, Timuna, Ekurooni
en: and Elon, and Thimnathah, and Ekron,

rr: Eliteeke, Gibesooni, Baalasi
en: and Eltekeh, and Gibbethon, and Baalath,

rr: Yehudi, Beneberaaki, Gaasi-rimoni
en: and Jehud, and Bene-berak, and Gath-rimmon,

rr: Meyarikooni, na Rakooni, okuhika aha mwatano ogurikureeba Yoopa.
en: and Me-jarkon, and Rakkon, with the border before Japho.

rr: Ahabw'ekyanga ky'aba Daani kubabeera kikye, bakainamuka, baateera Leshemu, baagikwata, baagihwerekyereza na rurara, baagikubuura, baagituuramu. Leshemu egyo baagyeta Daani, nibagyeterera ishenkurubo Daani.
en: And the coast of the children of Dan went out too little for them: therefore the children of Dan went up to fight against Leshem, and took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and dwelt therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their father.

rr: Obwo nibwo buhunguzi bw'oruganda rwa Daani, n'endembo zaabo n'ebirorero byazo, nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri. Obuhunguzi bwa Yoshua mwene Nuuni
en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.

rr: Ku baaherize kubaganisa ensi omu bicweka byayo, nk'emyatano y'obuhunguzi bwabo oku eri, Abaisraeli baha Yoshua mwene Nuuni obuhunguzi ahagati yaabo
en: When they had made an end of dividing the land for inheritance by their coasts, the children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them:

rr: baamuha orurembo oru yaabashabire, orurikwetwa Timunaati-seera omu nsi y'ebibungo eya Efuraimu, nk'ekiragiro kya MUKAMA oku kyabaire kiri. Yaayombekayo orurembo, yaarutuuramu.
en: according to the word of the LORD they gave him the city which he asked, even Timnath-serah in mount Ephraim: and he built the city, and dwelt therein.

rr: Obwo nibwo buhunguzi, obu Eleazaari omunyamurwa, Yoshua mwene Nuuni n'abakuru b'emiryango y'enganda za Israeli, baabaganiise n'enteenyu, nibaziteerera Shiilo omu maisho ga MUKAMA, aha muryango gw'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu.
en: These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel, divided for an inheritance by lot in Shiloh before the LORD , at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

rr: Okwo nikwo baaherize batyo kubagana ensi.
en: So they made an end of dividing the country.

rr: Kandi MUKAMA yaagambira Yoshua ati
en: The LORD also spake unto Joshua, saying,

rr: -14 ; Gambira Abaisraeli oti: Mwetooranire endembo z'okuhungiramu, ezi naaragiire Musa kubagambira
en: Speak to the children of Israel, saying, Appoint out for you cities of refuge, whereof I spake unto you by the hand of Moses:

rr: ngu oriita omuntu weena atamwitsire nkana, nari atakimanyire ahungireyo; ziryaba obuhungiro bwanyu bw'okuhungiramu omuhoozi w'enzigu.
en: that the slayer that killeth any person unawares and unwittingly may flee thither: and they shall be your refuge from the avenger of blood.

rr: Omuntu ogwo aryahungira omuri rumwe aha ndembo ezo; ku arihikayo, ayemerere aha irembo ry'orwo rurembo, agambire abakuru baarwo eki akozire; nabo baryamutaasya omu rurembo, bamuhe omwanya, atuure nabo.
en: And when he that doth flee unto one of those cities shall stand at the entering of the gate of the city, and shall declare his cause in the ears of the elders of that city, they shall take him into the city unto them, and give him a place, that he may dwell among them.

rr: Omuhoozi ku arimukuratayo, batarimumuha kumuhoora, ahabw'okuba taraitsire mutaahi we nkana, kandi akashangwa atarikwangana nawe.
en: And if the avenger of blood pursue after him, then they shall not deliver the slayer up into his hand; because he smote his neighbour unwittingly, and hated him not beforetime.

rr: Aryaguma omuri orwo rurembo, okuhitsya obu aryemerera omu maisho g'omutwe gw'abantu kucwerwa orubanja, kandi hoona tarirugamu, okuhitsya obu omunyamurwa omukuru, oriba ariho omu bunaku obwo, arifa; bwanyima ogwo mwitsi nibwo arigaruka owaabo omu ka ye, omu rurembo oru yaacwiremu.
en: And he shall dwell in that city, until he stand before the congregation for judgment, and until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days: then shall the slayer return, and come unto his own city, and unto his own house, unto the city from whence he fled.

rr: Okuruga aho baayetooranira Kedeshi omuri Galilaaya omu nsi y'ebibungo eya Nafutaali, na Shekemu omu nsi y'ebibungo eya Efuraimu, na Kiryasi-araba, niyo Heburooni omu nsi y'ebibungo eya Yuda.
en: And they appointed Kedesh in Galilee in mount Naphtali, and Shechem in mount Ephraim, and Kirjath-arba, which is Hebron, in the mountain of Judah.

rr: Kandi seeri ya Yorudani aha rubaju rw'oburugwa-izooba bwa Yeriko, baatooranayo Bezeeri aha murambi gw'omu ihamba omu kyanga ky'oruganda rwa Reubeeni, na Ramosi omuri Gileadi omu kyanga ky'oruganda rwa Gaadi, na Golani omuri Bashani omu kyanga ky'oruganda rwa Manaase.
en: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness upon the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, and Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.

rr: Ezo nizo ndembo ezaatooraniirwe Abaisraeli boona n'abanyamahanga abaabaire babashuhuukiiremu, ngu omuntu weena oraite omuntu, atamwitsire nkana, ahungireyo, arekye kwitwa omuhoozi w'enzigu, okuhitsya obu aryemerera omu maisho g'omutwe gw'abantu.
en: These were the cities appointed for all the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them, that whosoever killeth any person at unawares might flee thither, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until he stood before the congregation.

rr: Bwanyima abakuru b'emiryango y'oruganda rwa Leevi baija ahari Eleazaari omunyamurwa na Yoshua mwene Nuuni n'abakuru b'emiryango y'enganda za Israeli
en: Then came near the heads of the fathers of the Levites unto Eleazar the priest, and unto Joshua the son of Nun, and unto the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel;

rr: -18 ; . baabagambirira Shiilo omu nsi ya Kanaani, bati: MUKAMA akaragiira Musa ku tuheebwa endembo z'okutuuramu n'amariisizo gaazo ahabw'amatungo gaitu.
en: and they spake unto them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, The LORD commanded by the hand of Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with the suburbs thereof for our cattle.

rr: Abaisraeli nikwo kuha Abaleevi endembo n'amariisizo gaazo ahari ezo ezi baahungwire, nk'oku MUKAMA yaaragiire.
en: And the children of Israel gave unto the Levites out of their inheritance, at the commandment of the LORD , these cities and their suburbs.

rr: Enteenyu yaakwata ab'emiryango y'aba Kohasi; Abaleevi baijukuru ba Arooni omunyamurwa bo baakwatwa enteenyu, baaheebwa endembo ikumi na ishatu omu ruganda rwa Yuda, n'omu rwa Simeoni n'omu rwa Benyamiini.
en: And the lot came out for the families of the Kohathites: and the children of Aaron the priest, which were of the Levites, had by lot out of the tribe of Judah, and out of the tribe of Simeon, and out of the tribe of Benjamin, thirteen cities.

rr: Baijukuru ba Kohasi abaatsigaire batahairwe, enteenyu yaabakwata, baaheebwa endembo ikumi omu ruganda rwa Efuraimu n'omu rwa Daani n'omu kicweka ky'orwa Manaase.
en: And the rest of the children of Kohath had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, and out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh, ten cities.

rr: Enteenyu yaakwata baijukuru ba Gereshoni, baaheebwa endembo ikumi na ishatu omu miryango y'oruganda rwa Isakaari, n'omu rwa Asheri, n'omu rwa Nafutaali, n'omu kicweka ky'orwa Manaase omuri Bashani.
en: And the children of Gershon had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

rr: Kandi na baijukuru ba Merari, nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri, baheebwa endembo ikumi na ibiri omu ruganda rwa Reubeeni, n'omu rwa Gaadi, n'omu rwa Zebuluuni.
en: The children of Merari by their families had out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

rr: Okwo nikwo Abaisraeli baahaire Abaleevi ezo ndembo n'amariisizo gaazo nibateera enteenyu, nk'oku MUKAMA yaaragiire Musa ku baziheebwa.
en: And the children of Israel gave by lot unto the Levites these cities with their suburbs, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.

rr: Omu ndembo z'oruganda rwa Yuda n'orwa Simeoni baabaha endembo ezi, ezi amaziina gaazo garikugambwaho ahaifo.
en: And they gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are here mentioned by name,

rr: Haabanza beene Arooni, ow'omu miryango y'aba Kohasi, ab'omuri baijukuru ba Leevi; ahabw'okuba omugabo gw'okubanza gukaba guri ogwabo.
en: which the children of Aaron, being of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi, had: for their's was the first lot.

rr: Baabaha Kiryasi-araba, orurembo rwa Araba, ishe wa Anaki, niyo Heburooni ey'omu nsi y'ebibungo bya Yuda n'amariisizo gaayo
en: And they gave them the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron, in the hill country of Judah, with the suburbs thereof round about it.

rr: kwonka emisiri yaarwo n'ebirorero byarwo bikaba byahairwe Kalebu mwene Yefune kuba obutaka bwe.
en: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, gave they to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.

rr: Beene Arooni omunyamurwa baabaha Heburooni n'amariisizo gaayo, nirwo rurembo rw'okuhungirwamu oitsire omuntu, na Libuna n'amariisizo gaayo
en: Thus they gave to the children of Aaron the priest Hebron with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Libnah with her suburbs,

rr: Yatiri n'amariisizo gaayo, Eshitemoa n'amariisizo gaayo
en: and Jattir with her suburbs, and Eshtemoa with her suburbs,

rr: Holoni n'amariisizo gaayo, Debira n'amariisizo gaayo
en: and Holon with her suburbs, and Debir with her suburbs,

rr: Aini n'amariisizo gaayo, Yuta n'amariisizo gaayo, na Beti-shemeshi n'amariisizo gaayo; endembo z'enganda ezo zombi zaaba mwenda.
en: and Ain with her suburbs, and Juttah with her suburbs, and Beth-shemesh with her suburbs; nine cities out of those two tribes.

rr: Kandi n'omu ruganda rwa Benyamiini, baabaha Gibeoni n'amariisizo gaayo, Geeba n'amariisizo gaayo
en: And out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with her suburbs, Geba with her suburbs,

rr: Anatoosi n'amariisizo gaayo, na Alumooni n'amariisizo gaayo, endembo ina.
en: Anathoth with her suburbs, and Almon with her suburbs; four cities.

rr: Endembo zoona eza beene Arooni abanyamurwa zaaba ikumi na ishatu n'amariisizo gaazo.
en: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their suburbs.

rr: Ab'emiryango ya beene Kohasi, b'aba Leevi, nibo baijukuru ba Kohasi abaatsigaire batahairwe, bo baaheebwa endembo z'omugabo gwabo omu z'oruganda rwa Efuraimu.
en: And the families of the children of Kohath, the Levites which remained of the children of Kohath, even they had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.

rr: Baabaha Shekemu n'amariisizo gaayo omu nsi y'ebibungo eya Efuraimu, nirwo rurembo rw'okuhungirwamu oitsire omuntu, na Gezeri n'amariisizo gaayo
en: For they gave them Shechem with her suburbs in mount Ephraim, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Gezer with her suburbs,

rr: Kibuzaimu n'amariisizo gaayo, na Besi-horoni n'amariisizo gaayo, endembo ina.
en: and Kibzaim with her suburbs, and Beth-horon with her suburbs; four cities.

rr: N'omu z'oruganda rwa Daani baabaha Eliteeke n'amariisizo gaayo, Gibesooni n'amariisizo gaayo
en: And out of the tribe of Dan, Eltekeh with her suburbs, Gibbethon with her suburbs,

rr: Ayalooni n'amariisizo gaayo, na Gaasi-rimoni n'amariisizo gaayo, endembo ina.
en: Aijalon with her suburbs, Gath-rimmon with her suburbs; four cities.

rr: Kandi omu z'ekicweka ky'oruganda rwa Manaase baabaha Tanaki n'amariisizo gaayo na Gaasi-rimoni n'amariisizo gaayo, endembo ibiri.
en: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh, Tanach with her suburbs, and Gath-rimmon with her suburbs; two cities.

rr: Endembo zoona ez'emiryango ya beene Kohasi, abaatsigaire batahairwe zaaba ikumi n'amariisizo gaazo.
en: All the cities were ten with their suburbs for the families of the children of Kohath that remained.

rr: Kandi beene Gereshoni, ab'omu miryango y'aba Leevi baabaha endembo ibiri ez'omu z'ekicweka ky'oruganda rwa Manaase, Golani ey'omuri Bashani, orurembo rw'okuhungirwamu oitsire omuntu, n'amariisizo gaayo, na Beshiteera n'amariisizo gaayo.
en: And unto the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the other half tribe of Manasseh they gave Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Beeshterah with her suburbs; two cities.

rr: N'omu z'oruganda rwa Isakaari baabaha Kishioni n'amariisizo gaayo, Deberaati n'amariisizo gaayo
en: And out of the tribe of Issachar, Kishon with her suburbs, Dabareh with her suburbs,

rr: Yaramuusi n'amariisizo gaayo, na Eni-ganimu n'amariisizo gaayo, endembo ina.
en: Jarmuth with her suburbs, En-gannim with her suburbs; four cities.

rr: N'omu z'oruganda rwa Asheri baabaha Mishaali n'amariisizo gaayo, Abudooni n'amariisizo gaayo
en: And out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal with her suburbs, Abdon with her suburbs,

rr: Helukaasi n'amariisizo gaayo, na Rehobu n'amariisizo gaayo; endembo ina.
en: Helkath with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs; four cities.

rr: Kandi n'omu z'oruganda rwa Nafutaali baabaha Kedeshi omuri Galilaaya n'amariisizo gaayo, orurembo rw'okuhungirwamu oitsire omuntu, Hamosi-doori n'amariisizo gaayo, na Karitaani n'amariisizo gaayo, endembo ishatu.
en: And out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Hammoth-dor with her suburbs, and Kartan with her suburbs; three cities.

rr: Endembo zoona z'aba Gereshoni, nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri, zaaba ikumi na ishatu n'amariisizo gaazo.
en: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their suburbs.

rr: Kandi ab'emiryango ya beene Merari, nibo ba Leevi abaatsigaire batahairwe, baaheebwa omu ndembo z'oruganda rwa Zebuluuni Yokineamu n'amariisizo gaayo, Karita n'amariisizo gaayo
en: And unto the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with her suburbs, and Kartah with her suburbs,

rr: Dimuna n'amariisizo gaayo, na Nahalaali n'amariisizo gaayo, endembo ina.
en: Dimnah with her suburbs, Nahalal with her suburbs; four cities.

rr: N'omu z'oruganda rwa Reubeeni, baabaha Bezeeri n'amariisizo gaayo, Yahazi n'amariisizo gaayo
en: And out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with her suburbs, and Jahazah with her suburbs,

rr: Kedemoosi n'amariisizo gaayo na Mefaasi n'amariisizo gaayo endembo ina.
en: Kedemoth with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs; four cities.

rr: Kandi n'omu z'oruganda rwa Gaadi baabaha Ramosi omuri Gileadi n'amariisizo gaayo, orurembo rw'okuhungirwamu oitsire omuntu, Mahanaimu n'amariisizo gaayo
en: And out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Mahanaim with her suburbs,

rr: Heshibooni n'amariisizo gaayo, na Yazeri n'amariisizo gaayo, zoona zaaba endembo ina.
en: Heshbon with her suburbs, Jazer with her suburbs; four cities in all.

rr: Endembo ezo zoona nizo zaabaire ziri eza beene Merari nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri, niyo miryango y'Abaleevi eyaatsigaire etahairwe; omugabo gwabo gukaba guri endembo ikumi na ibiri.
en: So all the cities for the children of Merari by their families, which were remaining of the families of the Levites, were by their lot twelve cities.

rr: Endembo zoona z'Abaleevi ezaabaire ziri ahagati omu butaka bw'Abaisraeli zikaba ziri makumi ana na munaana n'amariisizo gaazo.
en: All the cities of the Levites within the possession of the children of Israel were forty and eight cities with their suburbs.

rr: Ezo ndembo buri rumwe rukaba rwehinguririziibwe amariisizo gaarwo; kandi ezo ndembo zoona nikwo zaabaire ziri.
en: These cities were every one with their suburbs round about them: thus were all these cities. Rest and Peace

rr: Okwo nikwo MUKAMA yaahaire Abaisraeli ensi yoona ei yaarahiire kuha baishenkurubo; batyo baagikubuura, baagituuramu.
en: And the LORD gave unto Israel all the land which he sware to give unto their fathers; and they possessed it, and dwelt therein.

rr: MUKAMA yaabaha okuhuumura embaju zoona, nk'oku yaaraganiise baishenkurubo; omu bazigu baabo boona tihariho n'omwe owaayehangire kubaza omu kaso; kureka MUKAMA akabahayo boona omu mikono yaabo.
en: And the LORD gave them rest round about, according to all that he sware unto their fathers: and there stood not a man of all their enemies before them; the LORD delivered all their enemies into their hand.

rr: Omu bigambo byona ebirungi ebi MUKAMA yaagambiire ab'enju y'Abaisraeli, tihariho na kimwe ekyabuzire; byona bikaba kwo.
en: There failed not ought of any good thing which the LORD had spoken unto the house of Israel; all came to pass.

rr: Currently Selected: Yoshua 21 : RR64 Highlight Share <svg width="24" heig
Bwanyima Yoshua yaayeta Abareubeeni n'Abagaadi n'ekicweka ky'oruganda rwa Manaase
en: Then Joshua called the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh,

rr: yaabagira ati: Mukozire byona ebi Musa omugaragwa wa MUKAMA yaabaragiire; kandi omuri byona ebi naabaragiire, mukanyorobera.
en: and said unto them, Ye have kept all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, and have obeyed my voice in all that I commanded you:

rr: Ebiro ebi ebingi ebi mumazire, timukahemukaga ahari beene waanyu n'okuhitsya hati, kureka mworobeire ekiragiro eki MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu yaabaragiire.
en: ye have not left your brethren these many days unto this day, but have kept the charge of the commandment of the LORD your God.

rr: Mbwenu hati MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu ahuumwize beene waanyu, nk'oku yaabaraganiise; n'ahabw'ekyo mugarukyeyo, muze omu maka gaanyu omu nsi y'obutaka bwanyu ei Musa omugaragwa wa MUKAMA yaabahaire seeri ya Yorudani.
en: And now the LORD your God hath given rest unto your brethren, as he promised them: therefore now return ye, and get you unto your tents, and unto the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you on the other side Jordan.

rr: Kwonka muteho omutima munonga kworobera ebiragiro byona ebi Musa omugaragwa wa MUKAMA yaabaragiire, okukunda MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu, okugyendera omu mihanda ye yoona, okworobera ebiragiro bye, okumuhamiraho, n'okumuheereza n'omutima gwanyu gwona n'amagara gaanyu goona.
en: But take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law, which Moses the servant of the LORD charged you, to love the LORD your God, and to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and to cleave unto him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.

rr: Atyo Yoshua yaabashabira omugisha, yaaboohereza, baagaruka omu maka gaabo.
en: So Joshua blessed them, and sent them away: and they went unto their tents.

rr: Ekicweka kimwe eky'oruganda rwa Manaase Musa akaba yaabahaire obuhunguzi omuri Bashani; kwonka ekindi kicweka kyarwo Yoshua niwe yaabahaire obuhunguzi omuri beene waabo seenu ya Yorudani oburengyerwa-izooba.
en: Now to the one half of the tribe of Manasseh Moses had given possession in Bashan: but unto the other half thereof gave Joshua among their brethren on this side Jordan westward.

rr: Kandi Yoshua, ku yaaboohereize kugaruka omu maka gaabo, yaabashabira omugisha
en: And when Joshua sent them away also unto their tents, then he blessed them,

rr: yaabagira ati: Mugarukye omu maka gaanyu, mutware ebintu bingi, namatungo maingi munonga, efeeza, ezaabu, emiringa, ebyoma, n'ebijwaro bingi munonga; mubagane na beene waanyu eminyago y'abazigu baanyu. Enganda ibiri n'ekicweka okukora eitambiro ahari Yorudani; n'abandi okuzigwerwa kubi
en: and he spake unto them, saying, Return with much riches unto your tents, and with very much cattle, with silver, and with gold, and with brass, and with iron, and with very much raiment: divide the spoil of your enemies with your brethren.

rr: Abareubeeni n'Abagaadi n'ekicweka ky'oruganda rwa Manaase baagarukayo, baataana n'Abaisraeli okuruga Shiilo ey'omu nsi ya Kanaani, kuza omu nsi ya Gileadi ei baayekubuuriire, nk'ekigambo kya MUKAMA eki yaagambiire Musa oku kyabaire kiri.
en: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go unto the country of Gilead, to the land of their possession, whereof they were possessed, according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses. Altar of Witness

rr: Ku baahikire omu kyanga ekiri haihi na Yorudani omu nsi ya Kanaani, Abareubeeni n'Abagaadi n'ekicweka ky'oruganda rwa Manaase baakora eitambiro haihi na Yorudani, eitambiro rihango munonga.
en: And when they came unto the borders of Jordan, that are in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh built there an altar by Jordan, a great altar to see to.

rr: Abaisraeli baahurira abarikugira bati: Reeba Abareubeeni n'Abagaadi n'ekicweka ky'oruganda rwa Manaase bakozire eitambiro aha mwataho gw'ensi ya Kanaani, haihi na Yorudani, aha rubaju rw'Abaisraeli.
en: And the children of Israel heard say, Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh have built an altar over against the land of Canaan, in the borders of Jordan, at the passage of the children of Israel.

rr: Abaisraeli ku baakihuriire, omutwe gwona gw'Abaisraeli gwayeteeranira Shiilo kuza kubarwanisa.
en: And when the children of Israel heard of it , the whole congregation of the children of Israel gathered themselves together at Shiloh, to go up to war against them.

rr: Abaisraeli baatuma Finehaasi mwene Eleazaari omunyamurwa aha Bareubeeni n'Abagaadi n'ekicweka ky'oruganda rwa Manaase omu nsi ya Gileadi.
en: And the children of Israel sent unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest,

rr: Baamutuma n'abakuru ikumi, buri ruganda rwa Israeli omukuru omwe ow'omuryango gwa baishenkurubo, buri omwe omuribo akaba ari omukuru w'omuryango gwa baishenkurubo omu nganda za Israeli.
en: and with him ten princes, of each chief house a prince throughout all the tribes of Israel; and each one was an head of the house of their fathers among the thousands of Israel.

rr: Baija omu nsi ya Gileadi, baashangayo Abareubeeni n'Abagaadi n'ekicweka ky'oruganda rwa Manaase, baagamba nabo nibagira bati
en: And they came unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, unto the land of Gilead, and they spake with them, saying,

rr: Ab'eihanga ryona erya MUKAMA baatutuma ngu: Eki kicumuro ki mucumwire ahari Ruhanga wa Israeli mukikoreire ki, okureka kukuratira MUKAMA, mukeekorera eitambiro, mukamugomera?
en: Thus saith the whole congregation of the LORD , What trespass is this that ye have committed against the God of Israel, to turn away this day from following the LORD , in that ye have builded you an altar, that ye might rebel this day against the LORD ?

rr: Nimugira ngu ekicumuro eki twacumuriire omuri Peori kikatubeera kikye? timurikumanya na hati ku tutakakyetuuraga, n'obu orufu rwateire eihanga rya MUKAMA?
en: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we are not cleansed until this day, although there was a plague in the congregation of the LORD ,

rr: Mbwenu ekyo kikaabareeteire okuteishuka, mukareka kukuratira MUKAMA eri izooba? Ekiraabirugyemu ahabw'okugomera MUKAMA eri izooba, nyencakare naija kugirira eihanga ryona ery'Abaisraeli ekiniga kingi.
en: but that ye must turn away this day from following the LORD ? and it will be, seeing ye rebel to day against the LORD , that to morrow he will be wroth with the whole congregation of Israel.

rr: Ensi yaanyu ei mwakubwire ku eraabe esiisikaire, mwambukye mwije omu nsi ya MUKAMA, ei eihema rya MUKAMA riri, mutungye obutaka omuriitwe; kwonka mutagomera MUKAMA, kandi naitwe mutatugomera, mukeekorera erindi itambiro, eritari rya MUKAMA Ruhanga waitu.
en: Notwithstanding, if the land of your possession be unclean, then pass ye over unto the land of the possession of the LORD , wherein the LORD 's tabernacle dwelleth, and take possession among us: but rebel not against the LORD , nor rebel against us, in building you an altar beside the altar of the LORD our God.

rr: Timurikumanya Akani mwene Zeera ku yaacumwire akatwara aha byabiikiirwe MUKAMA, eihanga ryona erya Israeli rikahikwaho ekiniga kingi? Kandi ogwo mushaija taracwekyereire wenka ahabw'ekicumuro kye. Okwetonganira kw'enganda ezo
en: Did not Achan the son of Zerah commit a trespass in the accursed thing, and wrath fell on all the congregation of Israel? and that man perished not alone in his iniquity.

rr: Abareubeeni n'Abagaadi n'ekicweka ky'oruganda rwa Manaase baagarukamu nibagambira abakuru b'enganda za Israeli bati
en: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh answered, and said unto the heads of the thousands of Israel,

rr: MUKAMA Ruhanga Nyamuhanga! MUKAMA Ruhanga Nyamuhanga niwe arikukimanya, kandi n'Abaisraeli baryakimanya. Ku turaabe twakikozire ahabw'obugomi nari ahabw'okucumura ahari MUKAMA, eri izooba tutakira!
en: the LORD God of gods, the LORD God of gods, he knoweth, and Israel he shall know; if it be in rebellion, or if in transgression against the LORD , (save us not this day,)

rr: Ku turaabe twayekoreire eitambiro ngu tuteishukye, turekye kukuratira MUKAMA, nari ngu tutambireho ebitambo ebyokize, nari empongano z'eby'okurya, nari ez'okusiima ahabw'obusingye, MUKAMA wenka abe niwe yaabitutura
en: that we have built us an altar to turn from following the LORD , or if to offer thereon burnt offering or meat offering, or if to offer peace offerings thereon, let the LORD himself require it ;

rr: kureka tukikozire twine eki tukikoreire, ngu omu biro ebiriija abaana baanyu bataribuuza abaitu bati: Mwine kakwate ki na MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli?
en: and if we have not rather done it for fear of this thing, saying, In time to come your children might speak unto our children, saying, What have ye to do with the LORD God of Israel?

rr: Timurikumanya ngu MUKAMA akataho Yorudani kuba omwatano gwaitu naimwe, imwe Abareubeeni n'Abagaadi? Timwine mugabo ahari MUKAMA. N'ahabw'ekyo abaana baanyu baryazibira abaitu kutiina MUKAMA.
en: For the LORD hath made Jordan a border between us and you, ye children of Reuben and children of Gad; ye have no part in the LORD : so shall your children make our children cease from fearing the LORD .

rr: Nikyo kyatureeteire kugira tuti: Ka twekorere eitambiro, eritari ry'okutambiraho ebitambo ebyokize nari ebindi bitambo
en: Therefore we said, Let us now prepare to build us an altar, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice:

rr: kureka ribe eky'okuhamya ahagati yaitu naimwe, na baijukuru baitu abaritukurata, ku turi abantu abakora omurimo gwa MUKAMA nitutambira ebitambo ebyokize omu maisho ge n'ebindi bitambo n'empongano z'okusiima ahabw'obusingye, abaana baanyu nyentsya batarigira abaitu omu biro ebiriija bati: Timwine mugabo ahari MUKAMA.
en: but that it may be a witness between us, and you, and our generations after us, that we might do the service of the LORD before him with our burnt offerings, and with our sacrifices, and with our peace offerings; that your children may not say to our children in time to come, Ye have no part in the LORD .

rr: Nikyo twagiriire tuti: Ku baritugira batyo, nari baagira kwo baijukuru baitu omu biro ebiriija, itwe turyabagarukamu tuti: Reeba eitambiro eri tukozire, eririkushushana n'eitambiro eri baatatenkuriitwe baakozire, eritari ry'ebitambo ebyokize nari ebindi bitambo, kureka ery'okuhamya ahagati yaitu naimwe.
en: Therefore said we, that it shall be, when they should so say to us or to our generations in time to come, that we may say again , Behold the pattern of the altar of the LORD , which our fathers made, not for burnt offerings, nor for sacrifices; but it is a witness between us and you.

rr: Nikikabure itwe okugomera MUKAMA eri izooba, tukateishuka, tukareka kumukuratira, tukeekorera eitambiro ry'okwokyezaho ebitambo, nari ery'okuhongyeraho empongano z'eby'okurya, nari ebindi bitambo, ritari itambiro rya MUKAMA Ruhanga waitu eriri omu maisho g'eihema rye. Ezo nganda okugarukana n'Abaisraeli
en: God forbid that we should rebel against the LORD , and turn this day from following the LORD , to build an altar for burnt offerings, for meat offerings, or for sacrifices, beside the altar of the LORD our God that is before his tabernacle.

rr: Finehaasi omunyamurwa n'abakuru b'eihanga, nibo bakuru b'emiryango y'Abaisraeli abu yaabaire aine, ku baahuriire ebigambo by'Abareubeeni n'Abagaadi n'Abamanaase, baashemererwa munonga.
en: And when Phinehas the priest, and the princes of the congregation and heads of the thousands of Israel which were with him, heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spake, it pleased them.

rr: Kandi Finehaasi mwene Eleazaari omunyamurwa yaagambira Abareubeeni n'Abagaadi n'Abamanaase ati: Mbwenu eri izooba nibwo twamanya ku MUKAMA ari omuriitwe, ahakuba timurakozire kicumuro eki ahari MUKAMA; mbwenu mwakiza Abaisraeli okutaitwa mukono gwa MUKAMA.
en: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the children of Manasseh, This day we perceive that the LORD is among us, because ye have not committed this trespass against the LORD : now ye have delivered the children of Israel out of the hand of the LORD .

rr: Bwanyima Finehaasi mwene Eleazaari omunyamurwa n'abakuru baaruga omu nsi ya Gileadi; ei baashangire Abareubeeni n'Abagaadi, baagaruka omu nsi ya Kanaani aha Baisraeli, baabagambira ebyabaireho.
en: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the princes, returned from the children of Reuben, and from the children of Gad, out of the land of Gilead, unto the land of Canaan, to the children of Israel, and brought them word again.

rr: Ekyo kyashemeza Abaisraeli, baahimbisa Ruhanga, tibaagaruka kugamba by'okurwanisa Abareubeeni n'Abagaadi, n'okucwekyereza ensi ei batwiremu.
en: And the thing pleased the children of Israel; and the children of Israel blessed God, and did not intend to go up against them in battle, to destroy the land wherein the children of Reuben and Gad dwelt.

rr: Kandi eryo itambiro Abareubeeni n'Abagaadi baaryeta Edi; amakuru gaakyo, ngu eky'okuhamya ahagati yaitu naimwe ku MUKAMA ari Ruhanga.
en: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad called the altar Ed: for it shall be a witness between us that the LORD is God.

rr: Bwanyima y'ebiro bingi MUKAMA aherize kuha Abaisraeli okuhuumura engamba z'abazigu baabo boona abaabaire babeehinguririize, na Yoshua yaakuzire, yaahikire omu ngingo zaabukuru
en: And it came to pass a long time after that the LORD had given rest unto Israel from all their enemies round about, that Joshua waxed old and stricken in age.

rr: yaayeta Abaisraeli boona, n'abakuru baabo n'abategyeki n'abaramuzi n'abakuru b'engabo, yaabagira ati: Reeba hati nkuzire, mpikire omu ngingo zaabukuru
en: And Joshua called for all Israel, and for their elders, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers, and said unto them, I am old and stricken in age:

rr: kandi mukareeba byona ebi MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu yaakozire amahanga aga goona ahabwanyu; ahabw'okuba MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu niwe yaabarwaniriire.
en: and ye have seen all that the LORD your God hath done unto all these nations because of you; for the LORD your God is he that hath fought for you.

rr: Reeba, mperize kubabaganisiza amahanga aga agakitsigaireho kuba obuhunguzi bw'enganda zaanyu, hamwe n'amahanga goona agu naahwerekyereize okuruga Yorudani okuhika aha Nyanja empango aha rubaju rw'oburengyerwa-izooba.
en: Behold, I have divided unto you by lot these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even unto the great sea westward.

rr: MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu niwe aribabinga omu maisho gaanyu, akabatuntumura, mukabona kukubuura ensi yaabo nk'oku MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu yaabaraganiise.
en: And the LORD your God, he shall expel them from before you, and drive them from out of your sight; and ye shall possess their land, as the LORD your God hath promised unto you.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo muhamire kimwe mubone kwerinda n'okukora byona ebihandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'ebiragiro bya Musa, murekye kuteishuka mukabirugamu kutoora orubaju-rwa-buryo nari orwa-bumosho
en: Be ye therefore very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that ye turn not aside therefrom to the right hand or to the left;

rr: mutariteerana n'amahanga aga agatsigaire omuriimwe; mutarigamba aha maziina ga baaruhanga baabo, nari okubarahira nari okubakorera, n'obu kwakuba okubaramya
en: that ye come not among these nations, these that remain among you; neither make mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear by them , neither serve them, nor bow yourselves unto them:

rr: kureka muhamire ahari MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu, nk'oku mwakozire n'okuhitsya hati.
en: but cleave unto the LORD your God, as ye have done unto this day.

rr: Nimumanya ku MUKAMA yaabingire amahanga makuru kandi ag'amaani omu maisho gaanyu; kwonka imwe tihaine muntu weena orabagiire omu kaso n'okuhitsya hati.
en: For the LORD hath driven out from before you great nations and strong: but as for you, no man hath been able to stand before you unto this day.

rr: Omwe omuriimwe aryabinga rukumi; ahakuba MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu niwe aribarwanirira, nk'oku yaabagambiire.
en: One man of you shall chase a thousand: for the LORD your God, he it is that fighteth for you, as he hath promised you.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo muteho omutima munonga kukunda MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu.
en: Take good heed therefore unto yourselves, that ye love the LORD your God.

rr: Ahakuba ku murigaruka enyima omu muringo gwona, mwateerana n'amahanga aga agatsigaire omuriimwe, mwashwererana nago, kandi mwataahirana nago
en: Else if ye do in any wise go back, and cleave unto the remnant of these nations, even these that remain among you, and shall make marriages with them, and go in unto them, and they to you:

rr: mumanyire kimwe mutarikubanganisa ku MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu atarigaruka kubinga amahanga ago omu maisho gaanyu, kureka baryababeera obusya n'omutego, babe eky'okubaasha omu mbaju, n'amahwa omu maisho gaanyu, okuhitsya obu murihwerekyererera omu nsi egi enungi ei MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu yaabahaire, mukahwaho.
en: know for a certainty that the LORD your God will no more drive out any of these nations from before you; but they shall be snares and traps unto you, and scourges in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until ye perish from off this good land which the LORD your God hath given you.

rr: -7 ; . Kandi reeba, eri izooba naaza kugyenda, nk'oku ab'ensi boona bagyenda; kandi mwena nimumanya gye omu mitima yaanyu n'omu magara gaanyu, ku hatariho kintu na kimwe ekirabuzire aha birungi byona ebi MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu yaabaraganiise; byona bikabahikaho, tihariho kintu na kimwe ekitarabaireho.
en: And, behold, this day I am going the way of all the earth: and ye know in all your hearts and in all your souls, that not one thing hath failed of all the good things which the LORD your God spake concerning you; all are come to pass unto you, and not one thing hath failed thereof.

rr: Nk'oku mwatungire ebirungi byona ebi MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu yaabagambiire, nikwo MUKAMA aribareetaho ebibi byona, okuhitsya obu aribahwerekyerereza omu nsi egi enungi ei MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu yaabahaire, akabamaraho.
en: Therefore it shall come to pass, that as all good things are come upon you, which the LORD your God promised you; so shall the LORD bring upon you all evil things, until he have destroyed you from off this good land which the LORD your God hath given you.

rr: Ku muricumura, mwaita endagaano ei MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu yaabahaire, mwagyenda, mwaheereza baaruhanga abandi, mwabaramya, MUKAMA aryabagirira ekiniga kingi, muhwerekyererere juba omu nsi enungi ei MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu yaabahaire, muhweho.
en: When ye have transgressed the covenant of the LORD your God, which he commanded you, and have gone and served other gods, and bowed yourselves to them; then shall the anger of the LORD be kindled against you, and ye shall perish quickly from off the good land which he hath given unto you.

rr: Bwanyima Yoshua yaateeranira Shekemu enganda za Israeli zoona, yaayeta abakuru b'Abaisraeli n'abategyeki n'abaramuzi n'abakuru b'engabo; baija kweyoreka omu maisho ga Ruhanga.
en: And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and called for the elders of Israel, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before God.

rr: Yoshua yaagambira abantu boona ati: Oku nikwo MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli arikugamba naagira ati: Obunyakare baashwenkuriimwe bakaba batwire seeri y'omugyera Furaati, nangwa na Teera, ishe wa Abrahamu na Nahori; bakaba baheereza baaruhanga abandi.
en: And Joshua said unto all the people, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Your fathers dwelt on the other side of the flood in old time, even Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nachor: and they served other gods.

rr: Bwanyima naiha Abarahamu shwenkuriimwe seeri y'ogwo mugyera, naamurabya omu nsi yoona eya Kanaani, naakanyisa oruzaaro rwe, naamuha Isaaka.
en: And I took your father Abraham from the other side of the flood, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his seed, and gave him Isaac.

rr: Kandi Isaaka naamuha Yakobo na Esau; Esau naamuha ensi y'ebibungo ya Seiri kuba eye; kwonka Yakobo n'oruzaaro rwe baashuuma omu nsi ya Misri.
en: And I gave unto Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave unto Esau mount Seir, to possess it; but Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.

rr: —12:36. Bwanyima naatuma Musa na Arooni, naateeza Misri ebibonaboneso ebi naagireetsiremu; bwanyima yaabyo naabaihayo.
en: I sent Moses also and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them: and afterward I brought you out.

rr: Naiha baashwenkuriimwe Misri; naabahitsya aha Nyanja erikutukura; Abanyamisri baabakurata n'ebigaari n'ab'aha mbaraasi okuhika aha nyanja egyo.
en: And I brought your fathers out of Egypt: and ye came unto the sea; and the Egyptians pursued after your fathers with chariots and horsemen unto the Red sea.

rr: Ku baatakiire MUKAMA, yaata omwirima ahagati yaanyu n'aba Misri, yaagarura amaizi g'enyanja, gaabashweka; kandi n'amaisho gaanyu gakeerebera ebi naakozire omuri Misri; bwanyima mwamara ebiro bingi omu ihamba.
en: And when they cried unto the LORD , he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea upon them, and covered them; and your eyes have seen what I have done in Egypt: and ye dwelt in the wilderness a long season.

rr: Naabatwara omu nsi y'Abaamori, abaabaire batwire aha rundi rubaju rwa Yorudani; baabarwanisa, naabahayo omu mikono yaanyu, mwakubuura ensi yaabo, naabahwerekyerereza omu maisho gaanyu.
en: And I brought you into the land of the Amorites, which dwelt on the other side Jordan; and they fought with you: and I gave them into your hand, that ye might possess their land; and I destroyed them from before you.

rr: Na Balaki mwene Zipori omugabe wa Moabu yaimuka, yaarwanisa Abaisraeli yaatuma ahari Balamu mwene Beori, kwija kubakyeena
en: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and warred against Israel, and sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you:

rr: kwonka naayanga kuhurira Balamu; n'ahabw'ekyo Balamu yaabashabira omugisha; okwo nikwo naabakirize omu mikono ya Balaki.
en: but I would not hearken unto Balaam; therefore he blessed you still: so I delivered you out of his hand.

rr: Bwanyima mwayambuka Yorudani, mwahika Yeriko; abaayo baabarwanisa, nangwa n'Abaamori n'Abaperizi n'Abanyakanaani n'Abahiiti n'Abagirugashi n'Abahiivi n'Abayebusi; naabahayo omu mikono yaanyu.
en: And ye went over Jordan, and came unto Jericho: and the men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Girgashites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites; and I delivered them into your hand.

rr: Kandi naayohereza enwa kubeebembera, zaababinga omu maisho gaanyu, nangwa n'abagabe babiri b'Abaamori, tibarabingirwe zaarurara zaanyu n'amata gaanyu.
en: And I sent the hornet before you, which drave them out from before you, even the two kings of the Amorites; but not with thy sword, nor with thy bow.

rr: Naabaha ensi ei mutarahendekyeire, n'endembo ezi mutarombekire, mwazituuramu; kandi na hati nimurya aha mizaabibu n'emizeituuni ei mutarabyaire.
en: And I have given you a land for which ye did not labour, and cities which ye built not, and ye dwell in them; of the vineyards and oliveyards which ye planted not do ye eat.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo hati mutiine MUKAMA, mumuheereze omu mazima mutarikuryarya; kandi mwihireho kimwe baaruhanga abu baashwenkuriimwe baabaire nibaheerereza seeri y'omugyera Furaati n'omuri Misri; muheereze MUKAMA.
en: Now therefore fear the LORD , and serve him in sincerity and in truth: and put away the gods which your fathers served on the other side of the flood, and in Egypt; and serve ye the LORD .

rr: Kandi ku muraabe nimugira ngu ni kibi okuheereza MUKAMA, eri izooba mutoorane ou muraaheereze, yaaba baaruhanga abu baashwenkuriimwe baabaire nibaheereza seeri y'omugyera, nari baaruhanga b'Abaamori abu mutwire omu nsi yaabo; kwonka nyowe n'eka yangye nitwija kuguma nituheereza MUKAMA.
en: And if it seem evil unto you to serve the LORD , choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD .

rr: Abantu baagarukamu nibagira bati: Nikikabure itwe okwimuura MUKAMA, tukeehongyera baaruhanga abandi
en: And the people answered and said, God forbid that we should forsake the LORD , to serve other gods;

rr: ahakuba MUKAMA Ruhanga waitu niwe yaatwihire omuri Misri na baatatenkuriitwe omu nju y'obuhuuku, akakora eby'okureeberaho ebyo ebikuru, kandi akaturinda omu muhanda gwona n'omu bantu boona, ei twarabire.
en: for the LORD our God, he it is that brought us up and our fathers out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and which did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way wherein we went, and among all the people through whom we passed:

rr: Kandi MUKAMA akabinga amahanga goona omu maisho gaitu, Abaamori abaabaire batwire omu nsi egyo; nikyo naitwe turigumira nituheereza MUKAMA, ahabw'okuba niwe Ruhanga waitu.
en: and the LORD drave out from before us all the people, even the Amorites which dwelt in the land: therefore will we also serve the LORD ; for he is our God.

rr: -33 ; Kwonka Yoshua yaagambira abantu ati: Timurikubaasa kuheereza MUKAMA, ahabw'okuba ni Ruhanga orikwera, kandi Ruhanga ow'eihato; taribasaasira by'okushiisha byanyu n'ebibi byanyu.
en: And Joshua said unto the people, Ye cannot serve the LORD : for he is an holy God; he is a jealous God; he will not forgive your transgressions nor your sins.

rr: -15 ; 2 Ku muriimuura MUKAMA, mwayehongyera baaruhanga b'abanyamahanga, aryabahindukana, abakore kubi, abamareho, bwanyima y'okubakora gye.
en: If ye forsake the LORD , and serve strange gods, then he will turn and do you hurt, and consume you, after that he hath done you good.

rr: Abantu baagarukamu Yoshua bati: Ngaaha! kureka itwe turyaguma nituheereza MUKAMA.
en: And the people said unto Joshua, Nay; but we will serve the LORD .

rr: Yoshua yaabagira ati: Muri baakareebi abarikwehamiza ku mutooraine MUKAMA kuba niwe mwaheereza.
en: And Joshua said unto the people, Ye are witnesses against yourselves that ye have chosen you the LORD , to serve him.

rr: Baagarukamu bati: Turi baakareebi.
en: And they said, We are witnesses.

rr: Yoshua yaagira ati: Mbwenu nu nimwiheho baaruhanga b'abanyamahanga abari omuriimwe, mute emitima yaanyu ahari MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli.
en: Now therefore put away, said he , the strange gods which are among you, and incline your heart unto the LORD God of Israel.

rr: Abantu baagambira Yoshua bati: MUKAMA Ruhanga waitu niwe turiguma nituheereza, kandi n'eiraka rye niryo turihurira.
en: And the people said unto Joshua, The LORD our God will we serve, and his voice will we obey.

rr: Bwanyima Yoshua yaaragaana n'abantu eryo izooba, yaabateeraho ebiragiro n'ebyaragiirwe, bari Shekemu.
en: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and set them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.

rr: Kandi Yoshua yaahandiika ebigambo ebyo omu kitabo ky'ebiragiro bya Ruhanga; yaatwara eibaare rihango, yaaribyara ahansi y'omwela, ogwabaire guri haihi n'Omwanya gwa MUKAMA ogurikwera.
en: And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God, and took a great stone, and set it up there under an oak, that was by the sanctuary of the LORD .

rr: Yaagambira abantu boona ati: Reeba, eibaare eri riryaguma riri kareebi w'okutushinja, ahakuba ryahurira ebigambo byona ebi MUKAMA yaatugambira; n'ahabw'ekyo riryaguma riri kareebi waanyu, ngu mutaryehakana Ruhanga waanyu.
en: And Joshua said unto all the people, Behold, this stone shall be a witness unto us; for it hath heard all the words of the LORD which he spake unto us: it shall be therefore a witness unto you, lest ye deny your God.

rr: Okuruga aho Yoshua yaayohereza abantu, buri muntu okugaruka omu buhunguzi bwe. Okufa kwa Yoshua
en: So Joshua let the people depart, every man unto his inheritance.

rr: Bwanyima y'ebyo Yoshua mwene Nuuni omugaragwa wa MUKAMA yaafa, ahikize emyaka igana na ikumi
en: And it came to pass after these things, that Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD , died, being an hundred and ten years old.

rr: baamuziika omu kyanga ky'obuhunguzi bwe Timunaati-seera, omu nsi y'ebibungo eya Efuraimu aha bukiizi-bwa-bumosho bw'ekibungo kya Gaashi.
en: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath-serah, which is in mount Ephraim, on the north side of the hill of Gaash.

rr: Kandi Abaisraeli bakaheereza MUKAMA omu biro byona ebya Yoshua, n'omu biro byona eby'abakuru abaatsigaireho yaafiire, abaabaire nibamanya ebi MUKAMA yaakoreire Abaisraeli.
en: And Israel served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that overlived Joshua, and which had known all the works of the LORD , that he had done for Israel.

rr: Amagufa ga Yosefu, agu Abaisraeli baihire Misri, baagaziika Shekemu omu kibanja eki Yakobo yaaguzire ahari beene Hamori ishe wa Shekemu ebicweka igana by'efeeza; ekibanja ekyo kyaba obuhunguzi bwa baijukuru ba Yosefu.
en: And the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, buried they in Shechem, in a parcel of ground which Jacob bought of the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for an hundred pieces of silver: and it became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.

rr: Kandi Eleazaari mwene Arooni nawe yaafa; baamuziika aha kabungo aku Finehaasi omutabani yaahairwe omu nsi y'ebibungo eya Efuraimu.
en: And Eleazar the son of Aaron died; and they buried him in a hill that pertained to Phinehas his son, which was given him in mount Ephraim.

en: 1 Jude, the servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to them that are sanctified by God the Father, and preserved in Jesus Christ, and called:

rr: 2 embabazi n'obusingye n'okukunda byeyongyere omuriimwe.
en: 2 mercy unto you, and peace, and love, be multiplied.

rr: 3 Abarikukundwa, ku naabaire niinyezirika munonga kubahandiikira eby'okujunwa kwaitu twena, nkagyemwa kubahandiikira nimbeehanangiriza kurwanira munonga okwikiriza oku abarikwera baahairwe rimwe kikahwa.
en: 3 Beloved, when I gave all diligence to write unto you of the common salvation, it was needful for me to write unto you, and exhort you that ye should earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered unto the saints.

4 For there are certain men crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation, ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness, and denying the only Lord God, and our Lord Jesus Christ.
5 I will therefore put you in remembrance, though ye once knew this, how that the Lord, having saved the people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed them that believed not.
6 And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.

7 Even as Sodom and Gomorrha, and the cities about them in like manner, giving themselves over to fornication, and going after strange flesh, are set forth for an example, suffering the vengeance of eternal fire.
8 Likewise also these filthy dreamers defile the flesh, despise dominion, and speak evil of dignities.
9 Yet Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, The Lord rebuke thee.

rr: 10 Kwonka abashaija abo bajuma ebi batarikumanya; kandi ebi barikumanya, babimanyisibwa obuntu bwabo nk'enyamaishwa ezitaine bwengye, nibyo bakoresa okweshiisha.
en: 10 But these speak evil of those things which they know not: but what they know naturally, as brute beasts, in those things they corrupt themselves.
11 Woe unto them! for they have gone in the way of Cain, and ran greedily after the error of Balaam for reward, and perished in the gainsaying of Core.

rr: 12 Abo, ku baba nibarya naimwe, ni nk'amabara agarikushiisha amagyenyi gaanyu ag'okukundana; n'abariisa b'entaama abariisa enda zaabo batarikutiina; n'ebicu ebitarimu njura ebitwarwa omuyaga; n'ebiti ebitariho byana omu bunaku bw'ekyanda ebifiire kabiri, ebirimbwirwe n'emizi
en: 12 These are spots in your feasts of charity, when they feast with you, feeding themselves without fear: clouds they are without water, carried about of winds; trees whose fruit withereth, without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;
13 raging waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, to whom is reserved the blackness of darkness for ever.
14 And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam, prophesied of these, saying, Behold, the Lord cometh with ten thousands of his saints,

rr: 15 okucwera boona orubanja, n'okurusingisa boona abatatiina Ruhanga ahabw'eby'okutamutiina ebi baakozire bakamucumuraho, kandi n'ebigambo ebigumire byona ebi abasiisi abatatiina Ruhanga baamugambireho nibamurwanisa.
en: 15 to execute judgment upon all, and to convince all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have ungodly committed, and of all their hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.
16 These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their own lusts; and their mouth speaketh great swelling words , having men's persons in admiration because of advantage.

rr: 17 Kwonka imwe, abarikukundwa, mwijukye ebigambo ebyagambirwe ira entumwa za Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo
en: 17 But, beloved, remember ye the words which were spoken before of the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ;
18 how that they told you there should be mockers in the last time, who should walk after their own ungodly lusts.

rr: 19 Abo nibo bareeta okwetaanisamu, abantu-buntu abataine Mwoyo.
en: 19 These be they who separate themselves, sensual, having not the Spirit.
20 But ye, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Ghost,

rr: 21 Mwerindire omu kukunda kwa Ruhanga; mutegyereze okusaasira kwa Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo, okuribahitsya omu maara agatahwaho.
en: 21 keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life.

rr: 22 Kandi abamwe abarikubanganisa mubaikiririse
en: 22 And of some have compassion, making a difference:
23 and others save with fear, pulling them out of the fire; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh.
24 Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy,

rr: 25 Ruhanga ogwo omwe wenka, Omujuni waitu owaatujunire ahabwa Yesu Kristo Mukama waitu, aheebwe ekitiinisa eky'obukama bwe n'obutegyeki n'obushoboorozi, ebi yaabaire aine ira ryona, hati n'ebiro byona. Amiina.
en: 25 to the only wise God our Saviour, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.
1 How doth the city sit solitary,
2 She weepeth sore in the night,
3 Judah is gone into captivity because of affliction,
4 The ways of Zion do mourn,
5 Her adversaries are the chief,
6 And from the daughter of Zion
