en: And he shall bring the bullock unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD ; and shall lay his hand upon the bullock's head, and kill the bullock before the LORD .

rr: Omunyamurwa owaashukirweho amajuta atware aha shagama yaayo, agireete omu Ihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu
en: And the priest that is anointed shall take of the bullock's blood, and bring it to the tabernacle of the congregation:

rr: akoze orukumu omuri egyo shagama, agimiisiire emirundi mushanju omu maisho ga MUKAMA omu maisho g'omukingo ogukingiire Omwanya ogurikwera munonga
en: and the priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle of the blood seven times before the LORD , before the vail of the sanctuary.

rr: kandi atware ahari egyo shagama, agite aha mahembe g'ekyoterero ky'obubaane oburikutaamirana omu maisho ga MUKAMA ekiri omu Ihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu; kandi eshagama y'egyo nimi y'ekimasha eyaatsigaraho yoona agishukye ahansi aha kibunu ky'eitambiro ry'okwokyezaho ebitambo, eriri aha muryango gw'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu.
en: And the priest shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar of sweet incense before the LORD , which is in the tabernacle of the congregation; and shall pour all the blood of the bullock at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

rr: Kandi ebishaju byona by'egyo nimi ey'empongano y'ekibi abiiheho, ebishaju ebishwekire eby'omunda n'ebishaju byona ebibiriho
en: And he shall take off from it all the fat of the bullock for the sin offering; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,

rr: n'entsigo zombi eziri aha mugongo n'ebishaju byazo, n'ekishaabo eky'aha kitugu abitwarirane n'ezo ntsigo
en: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away,

rr: nk'oku babiiha aha nimi y'ekitambo ky'okusiima ahabw'obusingye; omunyamurwa abyokyeze aha itambiro ry'okwokyezaho ebitambo.
en: as it was taken off from the bullock of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall burn them upon the altar of the burnt offering.

rr: Kwonka oruhu rwayo n'enyama zaayo zoona n'omutwe gwayo n'amaguru gaayo n'eby'omunda byayo n'efa yaayo
en: And the skin of the bullock, and all his flesh, with his head, and with his legs, and his inwards, and his dung,

rr: eby'egyo nimi yoona abitware aheeru y'orusiisira omu mwanya murungi, ahu baata eiju ry'akashenda, abite aha nku, abyotsye; aho ahu baata eiju, bibe niho byayokyezibwa.
en: even the whole bullock shall he carry forth without the camp unto a clean place, where the ashes are poured out, and burn him on the wood with fire: where the ashes are poured out shall he be burnt.

rr: Eihanga ryona ery'Abaisraeli ku ririba niryo rikozire ekibi aha bi MUKAMA yaazibiire, ritakikozire nkana, haza kyasherekwa omutwe gw'abantu abateeraine, eihanga ryagiibwaho orubanja
en: And if the whole congregation of Israel sin through ignorance, and the thing be hid from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done somewhat against any of the commandments of the LORD concerning things which should not be done, and are guilty;

rr: bwanyima ekibi eki bakozire kyamanywa, eihanga ryona rihongye enimi y'ekimasha kuba empongano y'ekibi, bagireete omu maisho g'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu.
en: when the sin, which they have sinned against it, is known, then the congregation shall offer a young bullock for the sin, and bring him before the tabernacle of the congregation.

rr: Abakuru b'eihanga bate engaro zaabo aha mutwe gw'egyo nimi omu maisho ga MUKAMA, kandi eitirwe omu maisho ge
en: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands upon the head of the bullock before the LORD : and the bullock shall be killed before the LORD .

rr: omunyamurwa owaashukirweho amajuta areete aha shagama y'egyo nimi omu Ihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu
en: And the priest that is anointed shall bring of the bullock's blood to the tabernacle of the congregation:

rr: agikozemu orukumu, agimiisiire emirundi mushanju omu maisho ga MUKAMA omu maisho g'ogwo mukingo
en: and the priest shall dip his finger in some of the blood, and sprinkle it seven times before the LORD , even before the vail.

rr: kandi atware ahari egyo shagama, agite aha mahembe g'ekyoterero, ekiri omu maisho ga MUKAMA omu Ihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu; kandi eshagama y'egyo nimi eyaatsigaraho yoona agishukye ahansi aha kibunu ky'eitambiro ery'okwokyezaho ebitambo, eriri aha muryango gw'eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu
en: And he shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar which is before the LORD , that is in the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall pour out all the blood at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

rr: kandi ebishaju byayo byona abiiheho, abyokyeze aha itambiro.
en: And he shall take all his fat from him, and burn it upon the altar.

rr: Okwo abe nikwo yaatwaza egyo nimi; nk'oku atwarize enimi y'empongano y'ekibi, abe nikwo yaatwaza n'egi; omunyamurwa ahongye atyo eky'okubarihiirira, nabo baryasaasirwa.
en: And he shall do with the bullock as he did with the bullock for a sin offering, so shall he do with this: and the priest shall make an atonement for them, and it shall be forgiven them.

rr: Bwanyima atware egyo nimi aheeru y'orusiisira, agyotsye nk'oku ayokize ey'okubanza; egyo n'empongano y'ekibi ehongirwe ahabw'eihanga ryona.
en: And he shall carry forth the bullock without the camp, and burn him as he burned the first bullock: it is a sin offering for the congregation.

rr: Kandi omutegyeki ku arikora ekibi aha bi MUKAMA Ruhanga we yaazibiire, atakikozire nkana, yaagiibwaho orubanja
en: When a ruler hath sinned, and done somewhat through ignorance against any of the commandments of the LORD his God concerning things which should not be done, and is guilty;

rr: bwanyima yaamanyisibwa ekibi eki akozire, areete empaya y'embuzi etaine kamogo, agihongye
en: or if his sin, wherein he hath sinned, come to his knowledge; he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a male without blemish:

rr: ate engaro ze aha mutwe gw'egyo mbuzi, agiitire omu maisho ga MUKAMA ahu baitira ebitambo by'okwotsya; egyo n'empongano y'ekibi.
en: and he shall lay his hand upon the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before the LORD : it is a sin offering.

rr: Bwanyima omunyamurwa atware aha shagama y'egyo mpongano y'ekibi aha rukumu rwe, agite aha mahembe g'eitambiro ry'okwokyezaho ebitambo, endiijo shagama yoona agishukye ahansi aha kibunu ky'eryo itambiro.
en: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out his blood at the bottom of the altar of burnt offering.

rr: Ebishaju byayo byona abyokyeze aha itambiro, nk'oku bootsya ebishaju by'ebitambo by'okusiima ahabw'obusingye; omunyamurwa amuhongyerere empongano y'okurihiirira ekibi kye, nawe aryasaasirwa.
en: And he shall burn all his fat upon the altar, as the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall make an atonement for him as concerning his sin, and it shall be forgiven him.

rr: Kandi omuntu weena ow'omu bantu b'obutoosha ku arikora ekibi aha bi MUKAMA yaazibiire, atakikozire nkana, yaagiibwaho orubanja
en: And if any one of the common people sin through ignorance, while he doeth somewhat against any of the commandments of the LORD concerning things which ought not to be done, and be guilty;

rr: bwanyima yaamanyisibwa ekibi eki akozire, areete omwagazi gw'embuzi ogutaine kamogo, aguhongye ahabw'ekibi eki akozire.
en: or if his sin, which he hath sinned, come to his knowledge: then he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a female without blemish, for his sin which he hath sinned.

rr: Ate engaro ze aha mutwe gw'egyo mpongano y'ekibi, agiitire ahu baitira ebitambo by'okwotsya.
en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay the sin offering in the place of the burnt offering.

rr: Omunyamurwa atware aha shagama yaagwo aha rukumu rwe, agite aha mahembe g'eitambiro ery'okwokyezaho ebitambo; endiijo shagama yoona agishukye ahansi aha kibunu ky'eryo itambiro
en: And the priest shall take of the blood thereof with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar.

rr: kandi ebishaju byagwo byona abiiheho, nk'oku babiiha aha bitambo by'okusiima ahabw'obusingye; omunyamurwa abyokyeze aha itambiro kuba ekisooroora kirungi ahari MUKAMA; omunyamurwa amuhongyerere empongano y'okurihiirira ekibi kye, nawe aryasaasirwa.
en: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat is taken away from off the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour unto the LORD ; and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and it shall be forgiven him.

rr: Kandi ku arireeta omwana gw'entaama kuba empongano y'ekibi, areete omwagazi ogutaine kamogo
en: And if he bring a lamb for a sin offering, he shall bring it a female without blemish.

rr: ate engaro ze aha mutwe gw'egyo mpongano y'ekibi, agiitire ahu baitira ebitambo eby'okwotsya kuba empongano y'ekibi.
en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering.

rr: Omunyamurwa atware aha shagama y'egyo mpongano y'ekibi aha rukumu rwe, agite aha mahembe g'eitambiro ry'okwokyezaho ebitambo; endiijo shagama yaagwo agishukye ahansi aha kibunu ky'eryo itambiro
en: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar:

rr: ebishaju byagwo byona abiiheho, nk'oku babiiha aha mwana gw'entaama gw'ekitambo eky'okusiima ahabw'obusingye; omunyamurwa abyokyeze aha itambiro aha mpongano ezookiibwe omu muriro ahari MUKAMA, amuhongyerere empongano y'okurihiirira ekibi eki akozire; nawe aryasaasirwa.
en: and he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat of the lamb is taken away from the sacrifice of the peace offerings; and the priest shall burn them upon the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto the LORD : and the priest shall make an atonement for his sin that he hath committed, and it shall be forgiven him.

rr: Omuntu weena ku arirahizibwa, yaakora ekibi ky'okwanga kujurira eki areebire, nari eki arikumanya, aryagiibwaho orubanja rw'okutahikiirira.
en: And if a soul sin, and hear the voice of swearing, and is a witness, whether he hath seen or known of it ; if he do not utter it , then he shall bear his iniquity.

rr: Nari omuntu weena ku arikora aha kintu kyona ekirikuzira, yaaba omutumbi gw'enyamaishwa erikuzira, nari ogw'ekitungirwe ekirikuzira, nari ogw'ekirikugyendesa enda ekirikuzira, atakimanyire, yaasiisikara, aryagiibwaho orubanja.
en: Or if a soul touch any unclean thing, whether it be a carcase of an unclean beast, or a carcase of unclean cattle, or the carcase of unclean creeping things, and if it be hidden from him; he also shall be unclean, and guilty.

rr: Nari ku arikora aha kirikuzira ekirikuruga omu muntu ondiijo eky'omuringo gwona atakimanyire, ku arikimanya, aryagiibwaho orubanja.
en: Or if he touch the uncleanness of man, whatsoever uncleanness it be that a man shall be defiled withal, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth of it , then he shall be guilty.

rr: Nari omuntu ku arirahukwa aha rurimi, yaarahira kukora kubi nari kukora gye kyonakyona eki arirahuka kurahira atakimanyire, ku arikimanya aryagiibwaho orubanja rw'ekyo eki yaarahukire kurahira.
en: Or if a soul swear, pronouncing with his lips to do evil, or to do good, whatsoever it be that a man shall pronounce with an oath, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth of it , then he shall be guilty in one of these.

rr: Mbwenu omuntu ku arimanya ku aine orubanja rwa kimwe ahari ebyo, ayature ekyo kibi ki akozire
en: And it shall be, when he shall be guilty in one of these things , that he shall confess that he hath sinned in that thing:

rr: areetere MUKAMA omwagazi gw'entaama nari ogw'embuzi ogw'omu busyo kuba empongano ey'okumwihisaho orubanja rw'ekibi eki akozire; omunyamurwa amuhongyerere empongano y'okurihiirira ekibi kye; nawe aryasaasirwa.
en: and he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD for his sin which he hath sinned, a female from the flock, a lamb or a kid of the goats, for a sin offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his sin.

rr: Kwonka ku ariba ari omworo otarikubaasa kureeta omwana gw'entaama, areete obwiba bubiri nari enkombe nto ibiri, azihongyere MUKAMA kuba empongano y'okumwihisaho orubanja rw'ekibi eki akozire, emwe ebe empongano ey'ekibi, endiijo ebe empongano ey'okwotsya.
en: And if he be not able to bring a lamb, then he shall bring for his trespass, which he hath committed, two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, unto the LORD ; one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering.

rr: Azireetere omunyamurwa, nawe abanze kutamba ey'empongano y'ekibi, agihotore ebitsya, agicweho omutwe, kwonka atagibaganisamu habiri
en: And he shall bring them unto the priest, who shall offer that which is for the sin offering first, and wring off his head from his neck, but shall not divide it asunder:

rr: atware aha shagama y'egyo mpongano y'ekibi, agimiisiire aha rubaju rw'eitambiro; endiijo shagama yoona egikamuukyemu, neejwera ahansi aha kibunu ky'eitambiro; egyo n'empongano y'ekibi.
en: and he shall sprinkle of the blood of the sin offering upon the side of the altar; and the rest of the blood shall be wrung out at the bottom of the altar: it is a sin offering.

rr: Eya kabiri agihongye kuba empongano y'okwotsya, nk'omugyenzo ogwatairweho oku guri; omunyamurwa amuhongyerere empongano y'okurihiirira ekibi eki akozire, nawe aryasaasirwa.
en: And he shall offer the second for a burnt offering, according to the manner: and the priest shall make an atonement for him for his sin which he hath sinned, and it shall be forgiven him.

rr: Kwonka ku ariba ari omworo otarikubaasa kureeta obwiba bubiri nari enkombe nto ibiri, areete ekicweka kimwe kya ikumi kya eefa y'esaano y'obunono kuba empongano y'ekibi ey'okuhongyerera ekibi eki akozire; arekye kugitamu amajuta n'obu kwakuba okugimemeereraho obubaane bwa lebona; ahabw'okuba egyo n'empongano y'ekibi.
en: But if he be not able to bring two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, then he that sinned shall bring for his offering the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering; he shall put no oil upon it, neither shall he put any frankincense thereon: for it is a sin offering.

rr: Egyo saano agireetere omunyamurwa, ogwo munyamurwa agiiheho oruhi kuba ekiijutsyo kyayo, agyokyeze aha itambiro ahaiguru y'empongano ehongyeirwe MUKAMA eyokiibwe omu muriro; egyo n'empongano y'ekibi.
en: Then shall he bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it, even a memorial thereof, and burn it on the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto the LORD : it is a sin offering.

rr: Atyo omunyamurwa amuhongyerere empongano y'okurihiirira ekibi kyona eki akozire omuri ebyo byona, nawe aryasaasirwa.
en: And the priest shall make an atonement for him as touching his sin that he hath sinned in one of these, and it shall be forgiven him: and the remnant shall be the priest's, as a meat offering.

rr: Esaano eritsigaraho ebe ey'omunyamurwa, nk'empongano y'esaano oku etwazibwa.
en: The Trespass Offering

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Omuntu ku arishobya ekintu kimwe omu birikwera ebya MUKAMA, yaakora ekibi atakimanyire, areetere MUKAMA empongano y'okumwihisaho orubanja ey'empaya y'entaama ey'omu busyo etaine kamogo, obariirire obuguzi bwayo omu shekeli z'efeeza, nka shekeli ey'Omwanya ogurikwera oku eri, kuba empongano y'okwihaho orubanja
en: If a soul commit a trespass, and sin through ignorance, in the holy things of the LORD ; then he shall bring for his trespass unto the LORD a ram without blemish out of the flocks, with thy estimation by shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering:

rr: kandi arihe eki asiisire ahari ekyo kintu ekirikwera, akyongyereho ekicweka kimwe kya kataano kyakyo, abihe omunyamurwa; bwanyima omunyamurwa amuhongyerere empongano y'egyo mpaya y'entaama ey'okwihaho orubanja, ebe empongano ey'okumurihiirira; kandi aryasaasirwa.
en: and he shall make amends for the harm that he hath done in the holy thing, and shall add the fifth part thereto, and give it unto the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering, and it shall be forgiven him.

rr: Kandi omuntu weena ku arishiisha, yaagira eki yaakora omu bi MUKAMA yaazibiire, n'obu ariba atakimanyire, aryaba aine orubanja, kandi okutahikiirira kwe kuryamugumaho.
en: And if a soul sin, and commit any of these things which are forbidden to be done by the commandments of the LORD ; though he wist it not, yet is he guilty, and shall bear his iniquity.

rr: Aryaiha omu busyo empaya y'entaama etaine kamogo, nk'oku oribariirira obuguzi bwayo, kuba empongano y'okwihaho orubanja, agireetere omunyamurwa; omunyamurwa amuhongyerere kurihiirira eki ashobize atamanyire, nawe aryasaasirwa.
en: And he shall bring a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his ignorance wherein he erred and wist it not, and it shall be forgiven him.

rr: Egyo n'empongano ey'okwihaho orubanja; ahakuba buzima naaba aine orubanja omu maisho ga MUKAMA.
en: It is a trespass offering: he hath certainly trespassed against the LORD .

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Omuntu weena ku arishiisha, yaacumura ahari MUKAMA omu kuryangatanisa ebi mutaahi we amubiikize, nari ebi ayemerereire, nari omu kumunyaga nari omu kumuhata
en: If a soul sin, and commit a trespass against the LORD , and lie unto his neighbour in that which was delivered him to keep, or in fellowship, or in a thing taken away by violence, or hath deceived his neighbour;

rr: nari okugwa aha kibuzire, akakiryangatanisa naarahira ebishuba, nari ekintu kyona omu bi abantu bakora bakabisiisiramu, biryatwazibwa biti
en: or have found that which was lost, and lieth concerning it, and sweareth falsely; in any of all these that a man doeth, sinning therein:

rr: omuntu ku arikikora, yaagiibwaho orubanja, aryariha eki aibire, nari eki anyagiise eishaija, nari eki aryangataniise bamubiikize, nari eki atorotoire kibuzire
en: then it shall be, because he hath sinned, and is guilty, that he shall restore that which he took violently away, or the thing which he hath deceitfully gotten, or that which was delivered him to keep, or the lost thing which he found,

rr: nari ekintu kyona eki ayehakaine naarahira ebishuba, aryabigarura byona, kandi abyongyereho ekicweka kimwe kya kataano, abihe mukama waabyo aha izooba eri arihongyeraho empongano y'okwihaho orubanja
en: or all that about which he hath sworn falsely; he shall even restore it in the principal, and shall add the fifth part more thereto, and give it unto him to whom it appertaineth, in the day of his trespass offering.

rr: bwanyima areetere omunyamurwa empongano egyo, ei ahongyeire MUKAMA kumwihaho orubanja, empaya y'entaama etaine kamogo, nk'oku oribariirira obuguzi bwayo, kuba empongano y'okumwihaho orubanja
en: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD , a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest:

rr: omunyamurwa amuhongyerere empongano y'okumurihiirira omu maisho ga MUKAMA; nawe aryasaasirwa eki ariba akozire kyona ekyamureeteire orwo rubanja.
en: and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD : and it shall be forgiven him for any thing of all that he hath done in trespassing therein.

rr: Ekiragiro ky'empongano z'okwotsya
en: Directions to Priests

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Ragiira Arooni n'abatabani oti: Eki nikyo kiragiro ky'ebitambo by'okwotsya. Ekitambo ky'okwotsya kiryaguma kiteebwe aha nku z'aha itambiro, kiraareho okuhitsya omu kasheeshe, kandi omuriro gw'aha itambiro gugume nigwaka.
en: Command Aaron and his sons, saying, This is the law of the burnt offering: It is the burnt offering, because of the burning upon the altar all night unto the morning, and the fire of the altar shall be burning in it.

rr: Omunyamurwa ajware ekanzu ye ya bafuta, n'empare ye ya kitaani, ayoore eiju ry'ekitambo ekyokize, ekyokiibwe omu muriro aha itambiro, arite aha rubaju rw'eitambiro
en: And the priest shall put on his linen garment, and his linen breeches shall he put upon his flesh, and take up the ashes which the fire hath consumed with the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.

rr: bwanyima ajuure ebyo bijwaro, ajware ebindi, atware eiju aheeru y'orusiisira, aryate omu mwanya murungi.
en: And he shall put off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry forth the ashes without the camp unto a clean place.

rr: Omuriro gw'aha itambiro guryaguma nigwaka, gutariraara; omunyamurwa agume agutemu enku buri kasheeshe, ariteho gye ekitambo ky'okwotsya, ayotsyeho ebishaju by'empongano z'okusiima ahabw'obusingye.
en: And the fire upon the altar shall be burning in it; it shall not be put out: and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning, and lay the burnt offering in order upon it; and he shall burn thereon the fat of the peace offerings.

rr: Ogwo muriro gugume nigwaka aha itambiro obutoosha, gutariraara. Ekiragiro ky'empongano y'esaano
en: The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar; it shall never go out.

rr: Eki nikyo kiragiro ky'empongano y'esaano. Batabani ba Arooni baryaguma bagihongye omu maisho ga MUKAMA omu maisho g'eitambiro.
en: And this is the law of the meat offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before the LORD , before the altar.

rr: Omunyamurwa agiiheho oruhi rw'esaano y'obunono n'amajuta gaayo n'obubaane bwa lebona bwona obugimemeereirweho, abyokyeze aha itambiro kuba ekiijutsyo kyayo ky'ekisooroora kirungi ahari MUKAMA.
en: And he shall take of it his handful, of the flour of the meat offering, and of the oil thereof, and all the frankincense which is upon the meat offering, and shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour, even the memorial of it, unto the LORD .

en: and the vulture, and the kite after his kind;

rr: ekikoona kyona n'oruganda rwakyo
en: every raven after his kind;

rr: maaya, ekishoma-bwire, enyangi, akaca n'oruganda rwako
en: and the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk after his kind,

rr: ekihihizi, ekiyoyo, enyawaawa
en: and the little owl, and the cormorant, and the great owl,

rr: enkoko y'omu maizi, nyamunyonyi, ekihuhura-bahuta
en: and the swan, and the pelican, and the gier eagle,

rr: enkongoro, oruyongoyongo n'oruganda rwarwo, enkooherwa, n'orubaka.
en: and the stork, the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.

rr: Ebikooko byona ebiine amapapa, ebirikugyendesa amaguru magufu ana n'eby'okunugwa ahariimwe
en: All fowls that creep, going upon all four, shall be an abomination unto you.

rr: kwonka omu bikooko ebiine amapapa, ebirikugyendesa amaguru ana magufu, nimwikirizibwa kurya ebiine amaguru maraingwa ageehinyire ahaiguru y'ebigyere byabyo ag'okugurukisa ahansi
en: Yet these may ye eat of every flying creeping thing that goeth upon all four, which have legs above their feet, to leap withal upon the earth;

rr: ahari ebyo ebi nibyo murikwikirizibwa kurya; enzigye n'oruganda rwazo, ebiharara n'oruganda rwabyo, ejerere n'oruganda rwazo, n'eseenene n'oruganda rwazo.
en: even these of them ye may eat; the locust after his kind, and the bald locust after his kind, and the beetle after his kind, and the grasshopper after his kind.

rr: Kwonka ebikooko ebindi byona ebiine amapapa, ebirikugyendesa amaguru magufu ana n'ebirikunugwa ahariimwe.
en: But all other flying creeping things, which have four feet, shall be an abomination unto you.

rr: Ebyo biryabahindura abasiisikaire; omuntu weena orikora aha mutumbi gwabyo aryaba osiisikaire okuhitsya omu mwabazyo.
en: And for these ye shall be unclean: whosoever toucheth the carcase of them shall be unclean until the even.

rr: Weena oryekorera ekicweka kyona eky'omutumbi gwabyo, ashemereire kwozya ebijwaro bye, n'okuguma ari osiisikaire okuhitsya omu mwabazyo.
en: And whosoever beareth ought of the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.

rr: Enyamaishwa yoona eyaatsizemu ebyara, kwonka etaine bigyere by'ebyara bibiri, kandi etarikwekuuma, n'erikuzira ahariimwe; omuntu weena origikoraho aryaba osiisikaire.
en: The carcases of every beast which divideth the hoof, and is not clovenfooted, nor cheweth the cud, are unclean unto you: every one that toucheth them shall be unclean.

rr: Enyamaishwa yoona erikuribatisa ebiganja omu nyamaishwa zoona ezirikugyendesa amaguru ana, n'erikuzira ahariimwe; weena orikora aha mutumbi gwayo aryaba osiisikaire okuhitsya omu mwabazyo
en: And whatsoever goeth upon his paws, among all manner of beasts that go on all four, those are unclean unto you: whoso toucheth their carcase shall be unclean until the even.

rr: kandi oryekorera omutumbi gw'emwe aharizo, ashemereire kwozya ebijwaro bye, n'okuguma ari osiisikaire okuhitsya omu mwabazyo; ezo n'ezirikuzira ahariimwe.
en: And he that beareth the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: they are unclean unto you.

rr: Ebi nibyo birikuzira ahariimwe omu birikugyendera ahansi ebiine amaguru magufu; akakorwa, embeba, entsigira-muteete n'oruganda rwayo
en: These also shall be unclean unto you among the creeping things that creep upon the earth; the weasel, and the mouse, and the tortoise after his kind,

rr: ekihangare, engamba, ekinya, akanyarugondo n'enyaruju.
en: and the ferret, and the chameleon, and the lizard, and the snail, and the mole.

rr: Ebyo nibyo ebirikuzira ahariimwe omu birikugyendera ahansi byona ebiine amaguru magufu; omuntu weena oribikoraho bifiire, aryaba osiisikaire okuhitsya omu mwabazyo.
en: These are unclean to you among all that creep: whosoever doth touch them, when they be dead, shall be unclean until the even.

rr: Ekintu kyona eki omutumbi gwabyo gurigwaho, kiryaba ekisiisikaire; n'obu kiriba kiri ekintu ekibaizirwe omu kiti, nari ekijwaro, nari oruhu, nari ekiguniya, nari ekintu kyona ekirikukoresibwa omurimo gwona, kishemereire kuteebwa omu maizi, n'okuguma kiri ekisiisikaire okuhitsya omu mwabazyo; bwanyima kibe ekishemeire.
en: And upon whatsoever any of them, when they are dead, doth fall, it shall be unclean; whether it be any vessel of wood, or raiment, or skin, or sack, whatsoever vessel it be , wherein any work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the even; so it shall be cleansed.

rr: Kandi kimwe aharibyo ku kirigwa omu kintu ky'eibumba, kyona ekiriba kiri omuri ekyo kintu kiryaba ekisiisikaire, kandi ekintu ekyo muryakyata.
en: And every earthen vessel, whereinto any of them falleth, whatsoever is in it shall be unclean; and ye shall break it.

rr: Eby'okurya byona ebikirimu ebirikugiibwamu amaizi, biryaba ebisiisikaire; nari eby'okunywa byona ebirikunywebwa ebiriba biri omuri ekyo kintu biryaba ebisiisikaire.
en: Of all meat which may be eaten, that on which such water cometh shall be unclean: and all drink that may be drunk in every such vessel shall be unclean.

rr: Ekintu kyona ekiriguubwaho ekicweka ky'omutumbi gwabyo kiryaba ekisiisikaire, n'obu kiriba kiri eiteekyero ry'eby'okurya, nari amahega kyatagurwe; ebintu ebyo biryaba bisiisikaire, kandi biri ebisiisikaire ahariimwe.
en: And every thing whereupon any part of their carcase falleth shall be unclean; whether it be oven, or ranges for pots, they shall be broken down: for they are unclean, and shall be unclean unto you.

rr: Kureka enshuro nari ekiina ekyarimiirwe amaizi, omu garikuteeranira, nikyo kiriba kitasiisikaire; kwonka ekiriihamu omutumbi gwabyo kiryaba ekisiisikaire.
en: Nevertheless a fountain or pit, wherein there is plenty of water, shall be clean: but that which toucheth their carcase shall be unclean.

rr: Kandi ekicweka kyona eky'omutumbi gwabyo ku kirigwa aha mbibo yoona ey'okubibwa, embibo egyo eryaba etasiisikaire
en: And if any part of their carcase fall upon any sowing seed which is to be sown, it shall be clean.

rr: kwonka ezo mbibo ku ziriba zitumbikire omu maizi, zaaguubwaho ekicweka kyona eky'omutumbi gwabyo, ziryaba ezisiisikaire ahariimwe.
en: But if any water be put upon the seed, and any part of their carcase fall thereon, it shall be unclean unto you.

rr: Enyamaishwa yoona ei murikwikirizibwa kurya, ku erifa, orikora aha mutumbi gwayo, aryaba osiisikaire okuhitsya omu mwabazyo.
en: And if any beast, of which ye may eat, die; he that toucheth the carcase thereof shall be unclean until the even.

rr: Kandi orirya aha mutumbi gwayo, aryayozya ebijwaro bye, agume ari osiisikaire okuhitsya omu mwabazyo; kandi n'oryekorera omutumbi gwayo, aryayozya ebijwaro bye, agume ari osiisikaire okuhitsya omu mwabazyo.
en: And he that eateth of the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: he also that beareth the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.

rr: Ekirikugyendera ahansi kyona, n'ekirikunugwa; kitaririibwa.
en: And every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth shall be an abomination; it shall not be eaten.

rr: Ebirikugyendera ahansi byona, yaaba ebirikugyendesa enda, yaaba eby'amaguru ana, nari eby'amaguru maingi, mutaribirya; ahakuba n'ebirikunugwa.
en: Whatsoever goeth upon the belly, and whatsoever goeth upon all four, or whatsoever hath more feet among all creeping things that creep upon the earth, them ye shall not eat; for they are an abomination.

rr: Mutaryehindura abarikunugwa ahabw'ekintu kyona ekirikugyendera ahansi, kandi mutaribyesiisisa, bikabashiisha.
en: Ye shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creepeth, neither shall ye make yourselves unclean with them, that ye should be defiled thereby.

rr: Mumanye ku ndi MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu; n'ahabw'ekyo mweyeze, mube abarikwera; ahabw'okuba ndi Orikwera; kandi mutaryeshiisha n'ekintu ky'omuringo gwona ekirikugyendera ahansi
en: For I am the LORD your God: ye shall therefore sanctify yourselves, and ye shall be holy; for I am holy: neither shall ye defile yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.

rr: ahakuba niinye MUKAMA owaabaihire omu nsi ya Misri kuba Ruhanga waanyu; n'ahabw'ekyo mube abarikwera, ahakuba ndi Orikwera.
en: For I am the LORD that bringeth you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: ye shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.

rr: Ebyo nibyo biragiro by'enyamaishwa n'ebirikuguruka n'ebiine amagara byona ebirikugyendera omu maizi na buri kihangirwe kyona ekirikugyendera ahansi
en: This is the law of the beasts, and of the fowl, and of every living creature that moveth in the waters, and of every creature that creepeth upon the earth:

rr: ebitairweho kutaanisa ebirikuzira n'ebitarikuzira, n'ebiine amagara ebirikwikirizibwa kuriibwa n'ebitarikwikirizibwa.
en: to make a difference between the unclean and the clean, and between the beast that may be eaten and the beast that may not be eaten.

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Gambira Abaisraeli oti: Omukazi ku arigira enda, yaazaara omwana w'omwojo, aryamara ebiro mushanju atashemeire; nk'oku aba ari omubiro bye by'okuza omu kwezi, nikwo ariguma ari otashemeire.
en: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a woman have conceived seed, and born a man child: then she shall be unclean seven days; according to the days of the separation for her infirmity shall she be unclean.

rr: Aha kiro kya munaana omwana ogwo aryasharwa ekishushu ky'omubiri gwe.
en: And in the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.

rr: Kandi nyina aryagumizamu ari omu shagama y'ekizaire, amare ebiro makumi ashatu na bishatu naashemezibwa; atarikora aha kintu kyona ekyeziibwe, n'obu kwakuba okuza omu Mwanya ogurikwera ebiro by'okutashemera kwe bitakahweire.
en: And she shall then continue in the blood of her purifying three and thirty days; she shall touch no hallowed thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying be fulfilled.

rr: Kwonka ku arizaara omwishiki, obwo aryamara ebiro ikumi na bina ari otashemeire nk'omu biro bye by'okuza omu kwezi; agumizemu ari omu shagama y'ekizaire, amare ebiro makumi mukaaga na mukaaga, naashemezibwa.
en: But if she bear a maid child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her separation: and she shall continue in the blood of her purifying threescore and six days.

rr: Ebiro by'okutashemera kwe ku birihwa, yaaba by'omwojo nari eby'omwishiki, aryareeta omwana gw'entaama oguhikize omwaka kuba ekitambo ky'okwotsya, n'enkombe nto nari akaiba kuba empongano y'ekibi, abireetere omunyamurwa aha muryango gw'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu
en: And when the days of her purifying are fulfilled, for a son, or for a daughter, she shall bring a lamb of the first year for a burnt offering, and a young pigeon, or a turtledove, for a sin offering, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest:

rr: omunyamurwa abihongyere omu maisho ga MUKAMA, amurihiirire; ogwo mukazi abone kushemezibwa omu by'eshagama y'obuzaire bwe.
en: who shall offer it before the LORD , and make an atonement for her; and she shall be cleansed from the issue of her blood.

rr: Ekyo nikyo kiragiro ky'omukazi ozaire omwana w'omwojo nari ow'omwishiki.
en: This is the law for her that hath born a male or a female.

rr: Kwonka ku ariba ari omworo, atarikubaasa kureeta mwana gw'entaama, areete obwiba bubiri nari enkombe nto ibiri, emwe kuba ey'ekitambo ky'okwotsya, n'endiijo kuba ey'empongano y'ekibi; omunyamurwa amurihiirire, abe oshemeziibwe.
en: And if she be not able to bring a lamb, then she shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons; the one for the burnt offering, and the other for a sin offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for her, and she shall be clean.

MUKAMA yaagambira Musa na Arooni ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron, saying,

rr: Omuntu ku arigira aha mubiri gwe ekizimba nari ekiseera nari eibara, kyahinduka aha mubiri gwe nk'endwara y'ebibembe, bamureetere Arooni omunyamurwa nari omwe ahari batabani be abanyamurwa
en: When a man shall have in the skin of his flesh a rising, a scab, or bright spot, and it be in the skin of his flesh like the plague of leprosy; then he shall be brought unto Aaron the priest, or unto one of his sons the priests:

rr: omunyamurwa ashwijume endwara ey'aha ruhu rw'omubiri gwe; ku arishanga obwoya obw'ahu endwara eri buhindukire nibwera, kandi eibara ryogire omu ruhu rw'omubiri, egyo ndwara eryaba eri ebibembe; omunyamurwa amwetegyereze, amurangye ku asiisikaire.
en: and the priest shall look on the plague in the skin of the flesh: and when the hair in the plague is turned white, and the plague in sight be deeper than the skin of his flesh, it is a plague of leprosy: and the priest shall look on him, and pronounce him unclean.

rr: Kwonka ku arireeba eibara ry'aha ruhu rw'omubiri gwe niryera, kandi ritoogire mu ruhu, n'obwoya bwaho butahindukire kuba oburikwera, obwo omunyamurwa aryakingirana ogwo muntu orwaire okumara ebiro mushanju
en: If the bright spot be white in the skin of his flesh, and in sight be not deeper than the skin, and the hair thereof be not turned white; then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague seven days:

rr: aha kiro kya mushanju omunyamurwa agarukye amushwijume; ku arireeba egyo ndwara egumire nk'oku ebaire eri, etabugire mubiri, obwo omunyamurwa aryagaruka amukingirane ebindi biro mushanju
en: and the priest shall look on him the seventh day: and, behold, if the plague in his sight be at a stay, and the plague spread not in the skin; then the priest shall shut him up seven days more:

rr: aha kiro kya mushanju ekindi omunyamurwa agarukye amushwijume; ku arishanga eibara ry'endwara ritakireebeka munonga, ritabugire mubiri, obwo amurangye ku atasiisikaire; biri n'ekiseera; ogwo muntu ayozye ebijwaro bye, abe otasiisikaire.
en: and the priest shall look on him again the seventh day: and, behold, if the plague be somewhat dark, and the plague spread not in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him clean: it is but a scab: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.

rr: Kwonka ebiseera ku birimubuga omubiri, aherize kweyoreka omunyamurwa ahabw'okushemezibwa, aryagaruka ayeyorekye omunyamurwa
en: But if the scab spread much abroad in the skin, after that he hath been seen of the priest for his cleansing, he shall be seen of the priest again:

rr: omunyamurwa amushwijume; ku ari reeba ebiseera bimubugira omubiri, amurangye ku asiisikaire; biri n'ebibembe.
en: and if the priest see that, behold, the scab spreadeth in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a leprosy.

rr: Omuntu ku arikwatwa endwara y'ebibembe, bamutwarire omunyamurwa
en: When the plague of leprosy is in a man, then he shall be brought unto the priest;

rr: omunyamurwa amushwijume; ku arishanga aine ekizimba kirikwera omu ruhu, kihindwire obwoya bwaho kuba oburikwera, kandi hacwekire ekironda
en: and the priest shall see him: and, behold, if the rising be white in the skin, and it have turned the hair white, and there be quick raw flesh in the rising;

rr: biri n'ebibembe ebitwire aha mubiri gwe; omunyamurwa amurangye ku asiisikaire; atarimukingirana, ahabw'okuba asiisikaire.
en: it is an old leprosy in the skin of his flesh, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean, and shall not shut him up: for he is unclean.

rr: Ebibembe ku biri musheesha aha mubiri, byashweka omubiri gwe gwona kwiha aha mutwe kuta aha bigyere, aha bicweka ebi omunyamurwa arireeba
en: And if a leprosy break out abroad in the skin, and the leprosy cover all the skin of him that hath the plague from his head even to his foot, wheresoever the priest looketh;

rr: omunyamurwa amushwijume; ku arireeba ebibembe bishwekire omubiri gwe gwona, amurangye ku atasiisikaire ahabw'endwara egyo; omubiri gwe gwona nigwera; tasiisikaire.
en: then the priest shall consider: and, behold, if the leprosy have covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague: it is all turned white: he is clean.

rr: Kwonka ahu ekironda kirimureebekyeraho, aryaba osiisikaire.
en: But when raw flesh appeareth in him, he shall be unclean.

rr: Omunyamurwa aryashwijuma ekyo kironda, amurangye ku asiisikaire; ekyo kironda kisiisikaire; n'ebibembe.
en: And the priest shall see the raw flesh, and pronounce him to be unclean: for the raw flesh is unclean: it is a leprosy.

rr: Nari ekyo kironda ku kirigaruka kyaba ekirikwera, agarukye aha munyamurwa
en: Or if the raw flesh turn again, and be changed unto white, he shall come unto the priest;

rr: omunyamurwa amushwijume; ku arishanga endwara ehindukire neeyera, obwo omunyamurwa amurangye ku atasiisikaire; biri tasiisikaire.
en: and the priest shall see him: and, behold, if the plague be turned into white; then the priest shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague: he is clean.

rr: Omuntu ku ariba aine aha mubiri gwe enkojo y'ekihuute ekikizire
en: The flesh also, in which, even in the skin thereof, was a boil, and is healed,

rr: omu nkojo y'ekyo kihuute haazimbamu ekizimba kirikwera, nari haijamu eibara eririkutukaatukura, obwo kiryayorekwa omunyamurwa, omunyamurwa akishwijume
en: and in the place of the boil there be a white rising, or a bright spot, white, and somewhat reddish, and it be shewed to the priest;

rr: ku arishanga kyogire omu ruhu rw'omubiri, n'obwoya bwaho buhindukire oburikwera, obwo omunyamurwa amurangye ku asiisikaire; biri n'endwara y'ebibembe, ebarukire omu nkojo y'ekihuute.
en: and if, when the priest seeth it, behold, it be in sight lower than the skin, and the hair thereof be turned white; the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a plague of leprosy broken out of the boil.

rr: Kwonka omunyamurwa ku arikishwijuma, yaashanga hatariho bwoya burikwera, kitoogire mu ruhu rw'omubiri, kandi kitarikureebeka munonga, omunyamurwa amukingirane okumara ebiro mushanju
en: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hairs therein, and if it be not lower than the skin, but be somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:

rr: kandi ku kirimubuga omubiri, omunyamurwa amurangye ku asiisikaire; biri n'endwara y'ebibembe.
en: and if it spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a plague.

rr: Kwonka eryo ibara ku ririgumira ahu ribaire riri, ritaayeyongyera, biri n'enkojo ya kiri kihuute; omunyamurwa amurangye ku atasiisikaire.
en: But if the bright spot stay in his place, and spread not, it is a burning boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

rr: Nari shi, omuntu ku arigira amasya aha ruhu rw'omubiri gwe, aho ahahiire haagira eibara eririkutukaatukura nari eririkwera
en: Or if there be any flesh, in the skin whereof there is a hot burning, and the quick flesh that burneth have a white bright spot, somewhat reddish, or white;

rr: omunyamurwa ahashwijume; ku arishanga obwoya oburi omuri eryo ibara buhindukire oburikwera, kandi eibara riri nk'eryogire omu ruhu rw'omubiri, biri n'ebibembe ebibarukire omuri ago masya; omunyamurwa amurangye ku asiisikaire; biri n'endwara y'ebibembe.
en: then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, if the hair in the bright spot be turned white, and it be in sight deeper than the skin; it is a leprosy broken out of the burning: wherefore the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.

rr: Kwonka omunyamurwa ku arihashwijuma, yaashanga obwoya bw'omuri eryo ibara butarikwera, kandi ritoogire mu ruhu rw'omubiri, kandi ritarikureebeka munonga, omunyamurwa amukingirane okumara ebiro mushanju.
en: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hair in the bright spot, and it be no lower than the other skin, but be somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:

rr: Aha kiro kya mushanju amushwijume; ku arishanga rimubugire omubiri, amurangye ku asiisikaire; biri n'endwara y'ebibembe.
en: and the priest shall look upon him the seventh day: and if it be spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.

rr: Kwonka eryo ibara ku ririgumira ahuribaire riri, ritaabuga mubiri, kandi ritaareebeka munonga, biri n'ekizimba ekizimbire ahaabaire hahiire; omunyamurwa amurangye ku atasiisikaire; ku ziri enkojo z'omu masya ezihiriitsire.
en: And if the bright spot stay in his place, and spread not in the skin, but it be somewhat dark; it is a rising of the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him clean: for it is an inflammation of the burning.

rr: Omushaija nari omukazi ku arigira endwara omu mutwe nari omu bireju
en: If a man or woman have a plague upon the head or the beard;

rr: omunyamurwa ashwijume egyo ndwara; ku arishanga endwara eyogire omu ruhu, obwoya bwamwo nibushusha obw'orwaire mutuku, obwo omunyamurwa amurangye ku asiisikaire; biri n'ekiguuna, n'ebibembe by'omu mutwe nari omu bireju.
en: then the priest shall see the plague: and, behold, if it be in sight deeper than the skin; and there be in it a yellow thin hair; then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a dry scall, even a leprosy upon the head or beard.

rr: Omunyamurwa ku arishwijuma egyo ndwara y'ekiguuna, yaashanga etoogire omu ruhu, hatarimu ishokye nari obwoya burikwiragura, omunyamurwa amukingirane okumara ebiro mushanju
en: And if the priest look on the plague of the scall, and, behold, it be not in sight deeper than the skin, and that there is no black hair in it; then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague of the scall seven days:

rr: aha kiro kya mushanju omunyamurwa ashwijume egyo ndwara; ku arishanga ekiguuna kiteeyongyeire, kandi kitarimu obwo bwoya obwa mutuku, kandi kitarikureebeka kyogire omu ruhu
en: and in the seventh day the priest shall look on the plague: and, behold, if the scall spread not, and there be in it no yellow hair, and the scall be not in sight deeper than the skin;

rr: bamwe eishokye, kwonka ahu ekiguuna kiri batarihamwa; omunyamurwa amukingirane okumara ebindi biro mushanju.
en: he shall be shaven, but the scall shall he not shave; and the priest shall shut up him that hath the scall seven days more:

rr: Aha kiro kya mushanju ekindi, omunyamurwa ashwijume ekyo kiguuna; ku arishanga kitabugire mubiri, kandi kitarikureebeka kyogire omu ruhu, obwo omunyamurwa amurangye ku atasiisikaire; ayozye ebijwaro bye, abe oshemeire.
en: and in the seventh day the priest shall look on the scall: and, behold, if the scall be not spread in the skin, nor be in sight deeper than the skin; then the priest shall pronounce him clean: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.

rr: Kwonka ekiguuna ku kirimubuga omubiri, aherize kushemezibwa
en: But if the scall spread much in the skin after his cleansing;

rr: obwo omunyamurwa aryamushwijuma; ku arishanga ekiguuna kimubugire omubiri, ataryerusya kusherura obwoya bwa mutuku; biri asiisikaire.
en: then the priest shall look on him: and, behold, if the scall be spread in the skin, the priest shall not seek for yellow hair; he is unclean.

rr: Kwonka ku arireeba ekiguuna kigumiire ahu kibaire kiri, hameziremu eishokye nari obwoya burikwiragura, biri ekyo kiguuna kikizire, omuntu ogwo aryaba atasiisikaire; omunyamurwa amurangye ku atasiisikaire.
en: But if the scall be in his sight at a stay, and that there is black hair grown up therein; the scall is healed, he is clean: and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

rr: Kandi omushaija nari omukazi ku arigira amabara aha ruhu rw'omubiri gwe, ago mabara gaaba agarikwera
en: If a man also or a woman have in the skin of their flesh bright spots, even white bright spots;

rr: omunyamurwa agashwijume; ku arishanga ago mabara g'aha ruhu rw'omubiri gwe gatarikwera munonga, biri n'amazomba kwonka agaseesire aha mubiri; aryaba atasiisikaire.
en: then the priest shall look: and, behold, if the bright spots in the skin of their flesh be darkish white; it is a freckled spot that groweth in the skin; he is clean.

rr: Omuntu ku ariba ahweirwe eishokye aha mutwe, aryaba aine oruhara, kwonka atasiisikaire
en: And the man whose hair is fallen off his head, he is bald; yet is he clean.

rr: omuntu ku arihwa eishokye aha bwekorerero, aryaba aine oruhara aha bwekorerero; aryaba atasiisikaire.
en: And he that hath his hair fallen off from the part of his head toward his face, he is forehead bald: yet is he clean.

rr: Kwonka omuntu ku arigira endwara y'eibara eririkutukaatukura omu ruhara orw'aha mutwe gwona, nari omu ruhara orw'aha bwekorerero, biri n'ebibembe ebirikwera omu ruhara rwe, nari omu ruhara rw'aha bwekorerero bwe.
en: And if there be in the bald head, or bald forehead, a white reddish sore; it is a leprosy sprung up in his bald head, or his bald forehead.

rr: Omunyamurwa aryamushwijuma; ku arishanga egyo ndwara y'omu ruhara rwe, nari omu ruhara rw'aha bwekorerero, kiri ekizimba ekirikutukaatukura, ekirikushusha ebibembe ebiri aha ruhu rw'omubiri
en: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, if the rising of the sore be white reddish in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, as the leprosy appeareth in the skin of the flesh;

rr: biri n'omubembe, aryaba asiisikaire; omunyamurwa amurangye ku asiisikaire; n'endwara ye emuri omu mutwe.
en: he is a leprous man, he is unclean: the priest shall pronounce him utterly unclean; his plague is in his head.

rr: Omubembe orwaire egyo ndwara aryajwara ebijwaro ebitaagukire, agyende azingurwire eishokye, ashembire obureju bwe bwa ruguru, agyende naagamba n'eiraka rihango ati: Nsiisikaire! Nsiisikaire!
en: And the leper in whom the plague is , his clothes shall be rent, and his head bare, and he shall put a covering upon his upper lip, and shall cry, Unclean, unclean.

rr: Ebiro byona ebi arimara aine egyo ndwara, aryaguma ari osiisikaire; n'osiisikaire, ashemereire kuguma wenka omu nganyo aheeru y'orusiisira.
en: All the days wherein the plague shall be in him he shall be defiled; he is unclean: he shall dwell alone; without the camp shall his habitation be .

rr: Ekijwaro ku kiriba kiine endwara y'ebibembe, yaaba ky'ebyoya by'entaama, nari kya kitaani
en: The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, whether it be a woollen garment, or a linen garment;

rr: yaaba mu huuzi za bukiika nari za bwemi, eza kitaani nari ez'obwoya bw'entaama, nari omu ruhu, nari omu kintu kyona ekikozire omu ruhu
en: whether it be in the warp, or woof; of linen, or of woollen; whether in a skin, or in any thing made of skin;

rr: endwara egyo ku eriba eine erangi ya kijubwe nari erikutukaatukura, yaareebeka omu kijwaro nari omu ruhu, nari omu huuzi ezirukire bukiika nari bwemi, nari omu kintu kyona ekikozirwe omu ruhu, eryaba eri ebibembe, eshemereire kworekwa omunyamurwa
en: and if the plague be greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the skin, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it is a plague of leprosy, and shall be shewed unto the priest:

rr: omunyamurwa ashwijume egyo ndwara, akingirane ekyo kintu ekigiine okumara ebiro mushanju.
en: and the priest shall look upon the plague, and shut up it that hath the plague seven days:

rr: Aha kiro kya mushanju ashwijume egyo ndwara; ku arishanga eyeyongyeire omuri ekyo kijwaro, yaaba mu huuzi ezirukire bukiika nari bwemi, nari omu ruhu orurikukoresibwa omurimo gwona, egyo ndwara eryaba eri ebibembe ebirikurya; ekyo kintu kiryaba kisiisikaire.
en: and he shall look on the plague on the seventh day: if the plague be spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in a skin, or in any work that is made of skin; the plague is a fretting leprosy; it is unclean.

rr: Ayotsye ekyo kijwaro ekiine endwara omu huuzi ezirukire bukiika nari bwemi, yaaba ky'obwoya bw'entaama nari ekya kitaani, nari ekintu kyona ekikozirwe omu ruhu; ahakuba kiine endwara y'ebibembe erikurya; kishemereire kwokibwa omu muriro.
en: He shall therefore burn that garment, whether warp or woof, in woollen or in linen, or any thing of skin, wherein the plague is: for it is a fretting leprosy; it shall be burnt in the fire.

rr: Omunyamurwa ku arishwijuma, yaashanga endwara eteeyongyeire muri ekyo kijwaro omu huuzi ezirukire bukiika nari bwemi, nari omu kintu kyona ekikozirwe omu ruhu
en: And if the priest shall look, and, behold, the plague be not spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin;

rr: obwo omunyamurwa aryaragiira boozye ekintu ekirimu egyo ndwara, akikingirane okumara ebindi biro mushanju
en: then the priest shall command that they wash the thing wherein the plague is , and he shall shut it up seven days more:

rr: kandi omunyamurwa ashwijume ekyo kintu ekibaire kirimu endwara, kiherize kwogibwa; ku arishanga egyo ndwara etahindwire ibara, kandi eteeyongyeire, biri kisiisikaire; oryaba oshemereire kukyotsya; biri n'endwara erikurya, n'obu eibara ry'endwara egyo ryakuba riri enyima nari omunda.
en: and the priest shall look on the plague, after that it is washed: and, behold, if the plague have not changed his colour, and the plague be not spread; it is unclean; thou shalt burn it in the fire; it is fret inward, whether it be bare within or without.

rr: Kwonka omunyamurwa ku arishwijuma ahu endwara ebaire eri, yaashanga etarikureebeka munonga, haherize kwogibwa, ataagure eibara omu kijwaro, nari omu ruhu, nari omu huuzi ezirukire bukiika nari bwemi
en: And if the priest look, and, behold, the plague be somewhat dark after the washing of it; then he shall rend it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof:

rr: egyo ndwara ku erireebeka ekiri omuri ekyo kijwaro, yaaba mu huuzi ezirukire bukiika nari bwemi, nari omu kintu kyona eky'oruhu, biri neekyeyongyera, oshemereire kwotsya ekyo kintu ki erimu.
en: and if it appear still in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it is a spreading plague: thou shalt burn that wherein the plague is with fire.

rr: Kandi ekijwaro, yaaba ky'ehuuzi ekirukire bukiika nari bwemi nari ekintu kyona eky'oruhu ekirirugwamu endwara oherize kukyozya, kiryagaruka kyogibwe, kibe ekishemeire.
en: And the garment, either warp, or woof, or whatsoever thing of skin it be , which thou shalt wash, if the plague be departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and shall be clean.

rr: Ebyo nibyo biragiro by'endwara y'ebibembe omu kijwaro ky'obwoya bw'entaama nari ekya kitaani, omu huuzi ezirukire bukiika nari bwemi, nari ekintu kyona eky'oruhu, ebirikuhamya ku kitasiisikaire nari ku kisiisikaire.
en: This is the law of the plague of leprosy in a garment of woollen or linen, either in the warp, or woof, or any thing of skins, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Ebi nibyo biragiro by'omubembe aha izooba ry'okushemezibwa kwe. Aryareetwa aha munyamurwa
en: This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: He shall be brought unto the priest:

rr: omunyamurwa ashohore aheeru y'orusiisira, ashwijume ogwo mubembe; ku arishanga akizire endwara y'ebibembe
en: and the priest shall go forth out of the camp; and the priest shall look, and, behold, if the plague of leprosy be healed in the leper;

rr: aragiire bareete enyonyi ibiri ezitarikuzira, ezihuriire, n'ekiti ky'omwereezi, n'akenda ka karari, n'enganda y'enyaweera ahabw'orikwenda kushemezibwa
en: then shall the priest command to take for him that is to be cleansed two birds alive and clean, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:

rr: omunyamurwa aragiire kwitira emwe ahari ezo nyonyi omu rwabya rw'eibumba ahaiguru y'amaizi agarikugyenda
en: and the priest shall command that one of the birds be killed in an earthen vessel over running water:

rr: atware enyonyi ehuriire n'ekyo kiti ky'omwereezi n'akenda ka karari n'enganda y'enyaweera, abijabikye hamwe n'enyonyi ehuriire omu shagama y'enyonyi ei baitira ahaiguru y'amaizi agarikugyenda
en: as for the living bird, he shall take it, and the cedar wood, and the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water:

rr: bwanyima agimiisiire orikuza kushemezibwaho ebibembe emirundi mushanju, amurangye ku ashemeziibwe, bwanyima arekure egyo nyonyi ehuriire, eze omu ishwa.
en: and he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird loose into the open field.

rr: Orikushemezibwa ayozye emyenda ye, amwe omubiri gwe gwona, ayogye omu maizi, abe oshemeziibwe; bwanyima y'ebyo agarukye omu rusiisira, kwonka amare ebiro mushanju aheeru y'eihema rye.
en: And he that is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and wash himself in water, that he may be clean: and after that he shall come into the camp, and shall tarry abroad out of his tent seven days.

rr: Aha kiro kya mushanju amwe eishokye rye ryona n'ebireju bye na bahungu n'obundi bwoya bwe bwona, kandi ayozye emyenda ye, ayogye omubiri gwe omu maizi, abe oshemeziibwe.
en: But it shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows, even all his hair he shall shave off: and he shall wash his clothes, also he shall wash his flesh in water, and he shall be clean.

rr: Kandi aha kiro kya munaana atware abaana b'entaama babiri b'empaya, abataine kamogo n'omwagazi gw'entaama oguhikize omwaka, ogutaine kamogo, hamwe n'ebicweka bishatu bya ikumi bya eefa y'esaano y'obunono ejwangize n'amajuta kuba empongano y'esaano na 14:10 logi emwe neingana na painta. logi emwe y'amajuta g'emizeituuni.
en: And on the eighth day he shall take two he lambs without blemish, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish, and three tenth deals of fine flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and one log of oil.

rr: Omunyamurwa orikumushemeza atware omushaija orikushemezibwa n'ebintu ebyo omu maisho ga MUKAMA aha muryango gw'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu.
en: And the priest that maketh him clean shall present the man that is to be made clean, and those things, before the LORD , at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:

rr: Bwanyima omunyamurwa atware emwe ahari ezo mpaya nto z'entaama, agihongye kuba empongano y'okwihaho orubanja, hamwe na logi y'amajuta, abizongazonzye kuba empongano ezongazongiibwe omu maisho ga MUKAMA
en: and the priest shall take one he lamb, and offer him for a trespass offering, and the log of oil, and wave them for a wave offering before the LORD :

rr: bwanyima aitire egyo mpaya nto omu mwanya ogu baitiramu empongano y'ekibi n'ekitambo ky'okwotsya omu mwanya gw'Aharikwera; ahakuba nk'oku empongano y'ekibi eri ey'omunyamurwa, nikwo n'empongano y'okwihaho orubanja eri; n'erikwera munonga.
en: and he shall slay the lamb in the place where he shall kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the holy place: for as the sin offering is the priest's, so is the trespass offering: it is most holy:

rr: Omunyamurwa atware ah shagama y'empongano y'okwihaho rubanga, agite aha nshonga y'okutu kwa buryo kw'orikushemezibwa, n'aha kikumu kishaija eky'engaro ye ya buryo, kandi n'aha kikumu kishaija eky'ekigyere kye kya buryo
en: and the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:

rr: kandi omunyamurwa atware ahari logi y'amajuta, agashukye aha kiganja kye kya bumosho
en: and the priest shall take some of the log of oil, and pour it into the palm of his own left hand:

rr: akoze orukumu rwe rwa buryo omu majuta agari aha kiganja kye kya bumosho, arumiisiize ago majuta emirundi mushanju omu maisho ga MUKAMA
en: and the priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand, and shall sprinkle of the oil with his finger seven times before the LORD :

rr: amajuta agaatsigara aha kiganja kye omunyamurwa agate aha nshonga y'okutu kwa buryo kw'orukushemezibwa n'aha kikumu kishaija eky'engaro ye ya buryo, n'aha kikumu kishaija eky'ekigyere kye kya buryo, ahu yaata eshagama y'empongano y'okwihaho orubanja.
en: and of the rest of the oil that is in his hand shall the priest put upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the trespass offering:

rr: Agandi majuta agaatsigara aha kiganja ky'omunyamurwa agasiigye aha mutwe gw'orikushemezibwa; omu nyamurwa amurihiirire omu maisho ga MUKAMA.
en: and the remnant of the oil that is in the priest's hand he shall pour upon the head of him that is to be cleansed: and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD .

rr: Kandi omunyamurwa ahongye empongano y'ekibi, arihiirire owaashemezibwaho okusiisikara; bwanyima aite ekitambo ky'okwotsya
en: And the priest shall offer the sin offering, and make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed from his uncleanness; and afterward he shall kill the burnt offering:

rr: ahongyere aha itambiro ekyo kitambo ky'okwotsya n'empongano y'esaano; amurihiirire, abe oshemeziibwe.
en: and the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meat offering upon the altar: and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and he shall be clean.

rr: Kwonka ku ariba ari omworo, otarikubaasa ebyo byona, areete empaya nto y'entaama kuba empongano y'okwihaho orubanja, ey'okuzongazongibwa, ahabw'okumurihiirira, n'empongano y'esaano y'ekicweka kimwe kya ikumi kya eefa y'esaano y'obunono ejwangize n'amajuta na logi y'amajuta g'emizeituuni
en: And if he be poor, and cannot get so much; then he shall take one lamb for a trespass offering to be waved, to make an atonement for him, and one tenth deal of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering, and a log of oil;

rr: kandi n'obwiba bubiri nari enkombe nto ibiri ebi arikubaasa kutunga; emwe ahari ezo ebe empongano y'ekibi, endiijo ebe ekitambo ky'okwotsya.
en: and two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, such as he is able to get; and the one shall be a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering.

rr: Aha kiro kya munaana abitwarire omunyamurwa aha muryango gw'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu omu maisho ga MUKAMA, kushemezibwa.
en: And he shall bring them on the eighth day for his cleansing unto the priest, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, before the LORD .

rr: Omunyamurwa atware ogwo mwana gw'entaama gw'empongano y'okwihaho orubanja, na logi ya majuta, abizongazongyeze omu maisho ga MUKAMA, kuba empongano ezongazongiibwe
en: And the priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD :

rr: aite ogwo mwana gw'entaama gw'empongano y'okwihaho orubanja, atware aha shagama yaagwo, agite aha nshonga y'okutu kwa buryo kw'orikushemezibwa, n'aha kikumu kishaija eky'engaro ye ya buryo, n'aha kikumu kishaija eky'ekigyere kye kya buryo
en: and he shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering, and the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:

rr: kandi omunyamurwa ashukye ahari ago majuta aha kiganja kye eky'engaro ya bumosho
en: and the priest shall pour of the oil into the palm of his own left hand:

rr: amiisiire ahari ago majuta gari aha kiganja kye n'orukumu rwe rwa buryo emirundi mushanju omu maisho ga MUKAMA
en: and the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before the LORD :

rr: omunyamurwa akore ahari ago majuta, agate aha nshonga y'okutu kwa buryo kw'orikushemezibwa, n'aha kikumu kishaija eky'engaro ye ya buryo, n'aha kikumu kishaija eky'ekigyere kye kya buryo, ahu yaata eshagama y'empongano y'okwihaho orubanja
en: and the priest shall put of the oil that is in his hand upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the place of the blood of the trespass offering:

rr: kandi amajuta agaatsigara aha kiganja ky'omunyamurwa, agasiigye aha mutwe gw'orikushemezibwa, kumurihiirira omu maisho ga MUKAMA.
en: and the rest of the oil that is in the priest's hand he shall put upon the head of him that is to be cleansed, to make an atonement for him before the LORD .

rr: Bwanyima ahongye kamwe ahari obwo bwiba, nari ahari ezo nkombe nto, ezi abaasize kutunga
en: And he shall offer the one of the turtledoves, or of the young pigeons, such as he can get;

rr: emwe ebe empongano y'ekibi, endiijo ebe ekitambo ky'okwotsya hamwe n'empongano y'esaano; omunyamurwa arihiirire orikushemezibwa omu maisho ga MUKAMA.
en: even such as he is able to get, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, with the meat offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed before the LORD .

rr: Ebyo nibyo biragiro ahabw'omuntu orwaire endwara y'ebibembe otarikubaasa kutunga empongano ezaatairweho ahabw'okushemezibwa kwe. Ebiragiro by'enju ekwatsirwe ebibembe
en: This is the law of him in whom is the plague of leprosy, whose hand is not able to get that which pertaineth to his cleansing.

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Musa na Arooni ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

rr: Ku murihika omu nsi ya Kanaani, ei mbahaire kuba eyaanyu, naareeta endwara y'ebibembe aha nju ey'omuri egyo nsi
en: When ye be come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put the plague of leprosy in a house of the land of your possession;

rr: mukama w'egyo nju agyende agambire omunyamurwa, ati: Nooshusha oti enju yangye etaahirwemu endwara.
en: and he that owneth the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, It seemeth to me there is as it were a plague in the house:

rr: Omunyamurwa aragiire baihe omuri egyo nju ebirimu byona, atakataahiremu kushwijuma endwara, ebintu byona eby'omuri egyo nju birekye kurangwa ku bisiisikaire; bwanyima y'okubiihamu omunyamurwa ataahemu agireebe
en: then the priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest go into it to see the plague, that all that is in the house be not made unclean: and afterward the priest shall go in to see the house:

rr: ashwijume egyo ndwara; ku arishanga endwara eri aha bisiika by'enju, eri ey'eibara rya kijubwe nari eririkutukaatukura, kandi yaareebeka etaahire omu kisiika
en: and he shall look on the plague, and, behold, if the plague be in the walls of the house with hollow strakes, greenish or reddish, which in sight are lower than the wall;

rr: obwo omunyamurwa arugye omuri egyo nju; ku arihika aha muryango, agikingye okumara ebiro mushanju
en: then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days:

rr: aha kiro kya mushanju agarukye agishwijume; ku araashangye egyo ndwara ebugire ebisiika by'enju
en: and the priest shall come again the seventh day, and shall look: and, behold, if the plague be spread in the walls of the house;

rr: aragiire baihe omuri ekyo kisiika amabaare agarimu egyo ndwara, baganagye ahatashemeire aheeru y'orurembo
en: then the priest shall command that they take away the stones in which the plague is , and they shall cast them into an unclean place without the city:

rr: kandi aragiire baharagate egyo nju yoona omunda; ebi baraaharagatemu babyate aheeru y'orurembo omu mwanya gutashemeire
en: and he shall cause the house to be scraped within round about, and they shall pour out the dust that they scrape off without the city into an unclean place:

rr: bwanyima bareete agandi mabaare, bagagarure omu mwanya gwa gari, areete ogundi musheenyi, agisiigirize.
en: and they shall take other stones, and put them in the place of those stones; and he shall take other morter, and shall plaister the house.

rr: Kandi orekwire egyo mbuzi ahabwa Azazeeli, ayozye ebijwaro bye, ayogye n'omubiri gwe, abone kugaruka omu rusiisira.
en: And he that let go the goat for the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward come into the camp.

rr: Reero egyo nimi y'empongano y'ekibi n'egyo embuzi y'empongano y'ekibi, ebi eshagama yaabyo yaataahibwa Aharikwera kukora eby'okurihiirira ebibi, babyekorere, babitware aheeru y'orusiisira, bootsye empu zaabyo n'enyama zaabyo n'efa yaabyo omu muriro.
en: And the bullock for the sin offering, and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place , shall one carry forth without the camp; and they shall burn in the fire their skins, and their flesh, and their dung.

rr: Oraaheze kubyotsya ayozye ebijwaro bye, ayogye omubiri gwe, bwanyima agarukye omu rusiisira.
en: And he that burneth them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.

rr: Ekyo kigume kiri ekiragiro ekibateereirweho ekitahwaho; omu kwezi kwa mushanju aha kiro kya ikumi eky'okwo kwezi, muryaguma mwebonabonese, mutarikikoreraho omurimo gwona, n'obu yaakuba omuntu enzaarwa, nari omunyaihanga oshuhuukiire omuriimwe
en: And this shall be a statute for ever unto you: that in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, ye shall afflict your souls, and do no work at all, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger that sojourneth among you:

rr: ahakuba aha kiro ekyo nikyo muriguma nimurihiiririrwaho kushemezibwa; obwo muryaba abashemeziibweho ebibi byanyu byona omu maisho ga MUKAMA.
en: for on that day shall the priest make an atonement for you, to cleanse you, that ye may be clean from all your sins before the LORD .

rr: Eizooba eryo riryababeera sabato ey'okuruhuukiraho, muryayebonabonesa; n'ekiragiro ekitairweho okuhitsya ebiro byona.
en: It shall be a sabbath of rest unto you, and ye shall afflict your souls, by a statute for ever.

rr: Kandi omunyamurwa oriba waashukirweho amajuta, akashoroorwa kuba omunyamurwa omu mwanya gwa ishe, niwe ariguma naabarihiirira, ajwaire ebyo bijwaro birikwera bya bafuta
en: And the priest, whom he shall anoint, and whom he shall consecrate to minister in the priest's office in his father's stead, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen clothes, even the holy garments:

rr: kandi arihiirire Omwanya ogurikwera, arihiirire Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu n'eitambiro; kandi arihiirire abanyamurwa n'abantu b'eihanga boona.
en: and he shall make an atonement for the holy sanctuary, and he shall make an atonement for the tabernacle of the congregation, and for the altar, and he shall make an atonement for the priests, and for all the people of the congregation.

rr: Kandi eki kibabeere ekiragiro ekitairweho ekitarihwaho, Abaisraeli kuguma nibarihiirirwa ahabw'ebibi byabo byona rimwe omu mwaka.
en: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make an atonement for the children of Israel for all their sins once a year.

rr: Musa yaakora nk'oku MUKAMA yaamuragiire.
en: And he did as the LORD commanded Moses.

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Gambira Arooni n'abatabani n'Abaisraeli boona oti: Eki nikyo MUKAMA yaaragiira naagira ati
en: Speak unto Aaron, and unto his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them; Sacrifices This is the thing which the LORD hath commanded, saying,

rr: Omuntu weena ow'omunju ya Israeli oribaagira ente nari omwana gw'entaama nari embuzi omu rusiisira, nari origibaagira aheeru yaarwo
en: What man soever there be of the house of Israel, that killeth an ox, or lamb, or goat, in the camp, or that killeth it out of the camp,

rr: atagitware ha muryango gw'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu, kugihongyera MUKAMA omu maisho g'obutaaho bwe, ogwo muntu aryakwatwa orubanja rw'egyo shagama; n'omuntu oseesire eshagama; kandi omuntu ogwo aryacuubwa omu ihanga rye
en: and bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer an offering unto the LORD before the tabernacle of the LORD ; blood shall be imputed unto that man; he hath shed blood; and that man shall be cut off from among his people:

rr: ebyo byaragiirwa ngu ebitambo ebi Abaisraeli baraagume baitira omu ishwa, babireetere MUKAMA aha muryango gw'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu, babiheereze omunyamurwa, abitambe, bibe empongano z'okusiima MUKAMA ahabw'obusingye.
en: to the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they offer in the open field, even that they may bring them unto the LORD , unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest, and offer them for peace offerings unto the LORD .

rr: Obwo omunyamurwa amiisire eshagama yaabyo aha itambiro rya MUKAMA aha muryango gw'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganriamu, ayotsye ebishaju, bibe ekisooroora kirungi ahari MUKAMA.
en: And the priest shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar of the LORD at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and burn the fat for a sweet savour unto the LORD .

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo batarigaruka kuhongyera baadaimoni ebitambo byabo, abu barikwenda kukurata kuraaya nabo.
en: And they shall no more offer their sacrifices unto devils, after whom they have gone a whoring.

rr: Ekyo kibe ekiragiro ekibateereirweho ebiro byona omu busingye bwabo bwona.
en: This shall be a statute for ever unto them throughout their generations.

rr: Kandi obagire oti: Omuntu weena ow'omu nju ya Israeli nari ow'omu banyamahanga ababashuhuukiiremu, oritamba ekitambo eky'okwotsya nari ekindi
en: And thou shalt say unto them, Whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers which sojourn among you, that offereth a burnt offering or sacrifice,

rr: atakireetsire ha muryango gw'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu kukitambira MUKAMA, ogwo muntu aryacuubwa omu ihanga rye. Ebiragiro by'eshagama
en: and bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer it unto the LORD ; even that man shall be cut off from among his people.

rr: Omuntu weena ow'omu nju ya Israeli nari ow'omu banyamahanga obashuhuukiiremu, orirya eshagama yoona, ndyamuta aha kaso, mmucwe omu ihanga rye.
en: And whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, that eateth any manner of blood; I will even set my face against that soul that eateth blood, and will cut him off from among his people.

rr: Mumanye ngu amagara g'omubiri gaba omu shagama; nikyo naagibaheera kushukwa aha itambiro ngu erihiirire amagara gaanyu; eshagama niyo erihiirira ahabw'okuba erimu amagara.
en: For the life of the flesh is in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul.

rr: Nikyo naagambirira Abaisraeli nti: Hatarigira omuntu weena omuriimwe owaarya eshagama, n'obu yaakuba omunyaihanga obashuhuukiiremu.
en: Therefore I said unto the children of Israel, No soul of you shall eat blood, neither shall any stranger that sojourneth among you eat blood.

rr: Kandi omuntu weena omu Baisraeli nari ow'omu banyamahanga obashuhuukiiremu, oriita enyamaishwa erikuriibwa nari enyonyi ahiigire, ayate eshagama yaayo ahansi, agishwekye eiju
en: And whatsoever man there be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, which hunteth and catcheth any beast or fowl that may be eaten; he shall even pour out the blood thereof, and cover it with dust.

rr: ahabw'okuba amagara g'ekihangirwe kyona gaba omu shagama yaakyo; nikyo ngiriire Abaisraeli nti: Mutarirya eshagama y'ekihangirwe kyona; ahakuba amagara g'ekihangirwe kyona gaba omu shagama yaakyo; origirya weena, aryacuubwa.
en: For it is the life of all flesh; the blood of it is for the life thereof; therefore I said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh: for the life of all flesh is the blood thereof: whosoever eateth it shall be cut off.

rr: Kandi omuntu weena orirya ekintu kyona ekyefeereire, nari ekiitsirwe enyamaishwa, yaaba muntu enzaarwa nari omunyaihanga, aryayozya ebijwaro bye, ayogye omu maizi, kandi agume ari otashemeire okuhitsya omu mwabazyo; obwo aryaba oshemeire.
en: And every soul that eateth that which died of itself , or that which was torn with beasts, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger, he shall both wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even: then shall he be clean.

rr: Kwonka ku ariba atabyogize, nawe akooga, orubanja rw'okutahikiirira ruryamugumaho.
en: But if he wash them not, nor bathe his flesh; then he shall bear his iniquity.
