MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Gambira Abaisraeli ebi ndikugamba ningira nti: Niinye MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu.
en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, I am the LORD your God.

rr: Mutarikora nk'oku Abanyamisri bakora omu nsi yaabo ei mwabaire mutwiremu; kandi mutarikora nk'oku Abanyakanaani barikukora omu nsi yaabo ei ndikubatwaramu. Buzima mutarikuratira ebiragiro byabo.
en: After the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein ye dwelt, shall ye not do: and after the doings of the land of Canaan, whither I bring you, shall ye not do: neither shall ye walk in their ordinances.

rr: Ebi ndikubaragiira mube nibyo mwahurira, ebiragiro byangye mubyorobere mubigyenderemu. Niinye MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu.
en: Ye shall do my judgments, and keep mine ordinances, to walk therein: I am the LORD your God.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo mugume mworobere ebiragiro byangye n'ebi ndikuragiira; oribyorobera biryamuhaisa amagara. Niinye MUKAMA. Abu omushaija arikuzibirwa kubyama nabo
en: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes, and my judgments: which if a man do, he shall live in them: I am the LORD .

rr: Hatarigira owaahika omunyabuzaare weena omuri haihi kumujweka busha. Niinye MUKAMA.
en: None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him, to uncover their nakedness: I am the LORD .

rr: Otarijweka sho busha, ahakuba enjuuro ya sho nikyo kimwe n'eya nyoko; niwe nyoko; otarimujweka busha.
en: The nakedness of thy father, or the nakedness of thy mother, shalt thou not uncover: she is thy mother; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

rr: Otarijweka busha muka sho; ahakuba n'enjuuro ya sho.
en: The nakedness of thy father's wife shalt thou not uncover: it is thy father's nakedness.

rr: Otarijweka busha munyaanyoko, owa sho nari owa nyoko, yaaba azairwe omuka nari ahandi.
en: The nakedness of thy sister, the daughter of thy father, or daughter of thy mother, whether she be born at home, or born abroad, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover.

rr: Otarijweka busha muhara wa mutabani waawe, nari muhara wa muhara waawe; ahakuba enjuuro yaabo niyo yaawe.
en: The nakedness of thy son's daughter, or of thy daughter's daughter, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover: for their's is thine own nakedness.

rr: Otarijweka busha muhara wa muka sho, ozairwe sho, ahakuba ni munyaanyoko.
en: The nakedness of thy father's wife's daughter, begotten of thy father, she is thy sister, thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

rr: Otarijweka busha shwenkazi; ahakuba aine obuzaare bwa haihi na sho.
en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's sister: she is thy father's near kinswoman.

rr: Otarijweka busha nyokwento, ahakuba aine obuzaare bwa haihi na nyoko.
en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister: for she is thy mother's near kinswoman.

rr: Otarijweka busha shwento, nikwo kuhika omukazi we; ahakuba ni muka shwento.
en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's brother, thou shalt not approach to his wife: she is thine aunt.

rr: Otarijweka busha muka mwana waawe; ahakuba ni muka mutabani waawe, otarimujweka busha.
en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter in law: she is thy son's wife; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

rr: Otarijweka busha muka mwene sho, ahakuba enjuuro ye n'eya mwene sho.
en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother's wife: it is thy brother's nakedness.

rr: Otarijweka busha omukazi na muhara we, kandi otaritwara muhara wa mutabani we nari owa muhara we, okabajweka busha; ahabw'okuba baine obuzaare bwa haihi n'omukazi waawe; ekyo n'ekibi kihango.
en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, neither shalt thou take her son's daughter, or her daughter's daughter, to uncover her nakedness; for they are her near kinswomen: it is wickedness.

rr: Otarishwera omukazi na mwene nyina kumumuharika, okamujweka busha, mwene nyina akiriho.
en: Neither shalt thou take a wife to her sister, to vex her , to uncover her nakedness, beside the other in her life time .

rr: Otarijweka busha omukazi akiri omu kwezi, atakashemeire.
en: Also thou shalt not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is put apart for her uncleanness.

rr: Otaribyama na muka mutaahi waawe, okamwesiisisa.
en: Moreover thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbour's wife, to defile thyself with her.

rr: Otarihayo n'omwe omu ruzaaro rwawe kumutambira Moleki, okajumisa eiziina rya Ruhanga waawe. Niinye MUKAMA.
en: And thou shalt not let any of thy seed pass through the fire to Molech, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the LORD .

rr: Otarigira omushaija omukazi; ahabw'okuba n'ekihagaro.
en: Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it is abomination.

rr: Otaribyama n'enyamaishwa yoona okagyesiisisa; nari omukazi weena otaryeha enyamaishwa kubyama nayo; n'okukora ebitari by'obuhangwa.
en: Neither shalt thou lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith: neither shall any woman stand before a beast to lie down thereto: it is confusion.

rr: Mutarigira eki mwayesiisisa ahari ebyo byona; ahakuba ebi nibyo amahanga gu ndikubinga omu maisho gaanyu gaayesiisiise
en: Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out before you:

rr: ensi yaabo ekasiisikara; nikyo ndikugitura ahabw'okutahikiirira kwayo, ekatanaka abagitwiremu.
en: and the land is defiled: therefore I do visit the iniquity thereof upon it, and the land itself vomiteth out her inhabitants.

rr: Kwonka imwe mugume mworobere ebiragiro byangye n'ebi naataireho, kandi mutakora na kimwe aha bihagaro ebyo byona, yaaba muntu enzaarwa nari omunyaihanga obashuhuukiiremu
en: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes and my judgments, and shall not commit any of these abominations; neither any of your own nation, nor any stranger that sojourneth among you:

rr: (ahakuba ebyo bihagaro nibyo abantu b'ensi egi abababandiize baakozire, ensi ekasiisikara)
en: (for all these abominations have the men of the land done, which were before you, and the land is defiled;)

rr: naimwe ensi ekabatanaka ahabw'okugishiisha, nk'oku yaatanakire eihanga eryababandiize.
en: that the land spue not you out also, when ye defile it, as it spued out the nations that were before you.

rr: Ahabw'okuba omuntu weena orikora ekihagaro kyona ahari ebyo, abantu abaribikora baryacuubwa omu ihanga ryabo.
en: For whosoever shall commit any of these abominations, even the souls that commit them shall be cut off from among their people.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo mworobere ebi ndikubaragiira; mutarikora emicwe egyo yoona erikunugwa, ei abababandiize baakozire, mukabyesiisisa. Niinye MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu. Currently Selected: Abaleevi 18 : RR64 Highlight Share <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8 19c-

rr: Kandi MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Gambira eihanga ry'Abaisraeli ryona ebi ndikugamba ningira nti: Mushemereire kuba abarikwera; ahakuba Nyowe MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu ndi orikwera.
en: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say unto them, Ye shall be holy: for I the LORD your God am holy.

rr: Omuntu weena omuriimwe ashemereire kutiina nyina na ishe; kandi mugume murinde sabato zangye. Niinye MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu.
en: Ye shall fear every man his mother, and his father, and keep my sabbaths: I am the LORD your God.

rr: Mutarihindukira ebishushani ebirikuramibwa, n'obu kwakuba okweheeshera baaruhanga b'ebishushani. Niinye MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu.
en: Turn ye not unto idols, nor make to yourselves molten gods: I am the LORD your God.

rr: Ku muritambira MUKAMA ebitambo by'empongano y'okusiima ahabw'obusingye, muryaguma mubihongye omu buryo obu murikubaasa kwikiririzibwamu.
en: And if ye offer a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD , ye shall offer it at your own will.

rr: Ekyo kitambo kiriibwe aha izooba eri murikihongyeraho, n'eririkurataho; ekiriba kyatsigaireho okuhitsya aha izooba rya kashatu, kyokibwe omu muriro.
en: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it, and on the morrow: and if ought remain until the third day, it shall be burnt in the fire.

rr: Ku kiririibwaho aha izooba rya kashatu, kiryaba ekirikunugwa; tikiriikirizibwa
en: And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it is abominable; it shall not be accepted.

rr: kandi omuntu weena orikiryaho, orubanja rw'okutahikiirira ruryamugumaho, ahabw'okuba aryaba asiisire ekintu kya MUKAMA ekirikwera; ogwo muntu aryacuubwa omu ihanga rye.
en: Therefore every one that eateth it shall bear his iniquity, because he hath profaned the hallowed thing of the LORD : and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

rr: Ku murishaaruura emyaka y'omu nsi yaanyu, mutarishaaruurira kimwe n'ey'aha mbibi, n'obu kwakuba okuhumba ebitsigairemu bwanyima y'okugyesha.
en: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest.

rr: Otarishoroma emizaabibu yaawe okagiherezamu kimwe, n'obu kwakuba okutorotoora eragarikire; ogitsigire enshoberwa n'omushuhuuki. Niinye MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu.
en: And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gather every grape of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and stranger: I am the LORD your God.

rr: Mutariiba, mutarigobya, kandi mutaribeihana.
en: Ye shall not steal, neither deal falsely, neither lie one to another.

rr: Mutarirahirira busha eiziina ryangye, mukajumisa eiziina rya Ruhanga waanyu. Niinye MUKAMA.
en: And ye shall not swear by my name falsely, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the LORD .

rr: Otariita kubi mugyenzi waawe nari kumunyaga. Otariraara n'ebihembo ebi omukozi akoreire okuhitsya omu kasheeshe.
en: Thou shalt not defraud thy neighbour, neither rob him: the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.

rr: Otarikyeena ekifa-matu, kandi otaritega empumi eky'okugiteeza entsibo, kureka ogume otiine Ruhanga waawe. Niinye MUKAMA.
en: Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind, but shalt fear thy God: I am the LORD .

rr: Otarikora ebitari by'oburyo omu kucwa emanja; otarigwera orubaju rw'omworo, n'obu kwakuba okweta aha kitiinisa ky'omukuru; kureka ocwere mutaahi waawe orubanja rw'oburyo.
en: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: thou shalt not respect the person of the poor, nor honour the person of the mighty: but in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbour.

rr: Otarigyendagyenda noogambuura abantu omu bantu b'owaanyu; kandi otariba mushinja w'ebishuba kwitisa mutaahi waawe. Niinye MUKAMA.
en: Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour: I am the LORD .

rr: Otaryangira mwene waanyu aha mutima, kureka oshemereire kuhana mutaahi waawe, otakaagiibwaho orubanja ahabwe.
en: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart: thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him.

rr: Otarihoora abantu b'eihanga ryawe, n'obu kwakuba okubagiraho enziika; kureka okunde mutaahi waawe, nk'oku oyekunda. Niinye MUKAMA.
en: Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am the LORD .

rr: Mugume mworobere ebiragiro byangye.
en: Ye shall keep my statutes.

rr: Otaryemesa amatungo gaawe aha nyamaishwa ezitari z'oruganda rwago; otaribiba omu musiri gwawe embibo z'emiringo ebiri; kandi otarijwara ekijwaro kibaziire omu myenda y'emiringo ebiri.
en: Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind: thou shalt not sow thy field with mingled seed: neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woollen come upon thee.

rr: Omuntu ku aribyama n'omuzaana, orikugambwa ondiijo mushaija obugyenyi, omuzaana ogwo atakacungwirwe nari atakarekwirwe, ebyabo biryayetegyerezibwa, kwonka tibariitwa, ahabw'okuba omukazi abaire atakarekwirwe.
en: And whosoever lieth carnally with a woman, that is a bondmaid, betrothed to an husband, and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; she shall be scourged; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.

rr: Kwonka ogwo mushaija areetere MUKAMA empongano y'okwihaho orubanja aha muryango gw'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu, empaya y'entaama kuba empongano y'okwihaho orubanja
en: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD , unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, even a ram for a trespass offering.

rr: omunyamurwa amurihiirire omu maisho ga MUKAMA empaya y'entaama kuba empongano y'okwihaho orubanja rw'ekibi eki akozire, nawe aryasaasirwa ekyo kibi ki akozire.
en: And the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the LORD for his sin which he hath done: and the sin which he hath done shall be forgiven him.

rr: Ku murihika omu nsi egyo, mwabyara emiti y'emiringo yoona ahabw'ebyokurya, mubanze mutwaze ebijuma byayo nk'ebitarikwikirizibwa kuriibwa; muryamara emyaka eshatu mutarikubiikirizibwa; bitaririibwaho.
en: And when ye shall come into the land, and shall have planted all manner of trees for food, then ye shall count the fruit thereof as uncircumcised: three years shall it be as uncircumcised unto you: it shall not be eaten of.

rr: Kandi omu mwaka gwa kana ebijuma byayo byona biryaba ebirikwera, empongano y'okuhimbisa MUKAMA.
en: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy to praise the LORD withal .

rr: Kwonka omu mwaka gwa kataano muryaikirizibwa kurya aha bijuma byayo, egyo miti ebone kuguma neebeerera munonga. Niinye MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu.
en: And in the fifth year shall ye eat of the fruit thereof, that it may yield unto you the increase thereof: I am the LORD your God.

rr: Mutarirya ekintu kyona n'eshagama yaakyo; mutariroga n'obu kwakuba okuragura.
en: Ye shall not eat any thing with the blood: neither shall ye use enchantment, nor observe times.

rr: Mutaritega ebyeyera, mutarishiisha omu mbaju z'ebireju byanyu.
en: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard.

rr: Mutarishara emibiri yaanyu ahabw'okuba omu rufu, kandi mutaricwa engondo. Niinye MUKAMA.
en: Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you: I am the LORD .

rr: Otarishiisha muhara waawe, okamuhindura maraaya, ensi erekye kwohokyera omu bushambani, ekaijura obubi.
en: Do not prostitute thy daughter, to cause her to be a whore; lest the land fall to whoredom, and the land become full of wickedness.

rr: Mugume murinde sabato zangye, muhe ekitiinisa Omwanya gwangye ogurikwera. Niinye MUKAMA.
en: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the LORD .

rr: Mutariimuurira aha barikubandwa emizimu n'obu baakuba abarogi; mutaribasherura, bakabashiisha. Niinye MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu.
en: Regard not them that have familiar spirits, neither seek after wizards, to be defiled by them: I am the LORD your God.

rr: Ogume oimukire ow'enju, n'omugurusi omuhe ekitiinisa, kandi otiine Ruhanga waawe. Niinye MUKAMA.
en: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honour the face of the old man, and fear thy God: I am the LORD .

rr: Omunyaihanga ku arishuhuukira owaanyu omu nsi yaanyu, otarimwita kubi
en: And if a stranger sojourn with thee in your land, ye shall not vex him.

rr: omunyaihanga oribashuhuukiramu abe nk'enzaarwa omuriimwe, omukunde nk'oku oyekunda; ahabw'okuba naimwe mukaba muri abanyaihanga omu nsi ya Misri. Niinye MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu.
en: But the stranger that dwelleth with you shall be unto you as one born among you, and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.

rr: Mutarikora ebitari by'oburyo omu kucwa emanja, omu kugyera oburaingwa, nari oburemeezi, nari obwingi.
en: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in meteyard, in weight, or in measure.

rr: Mugire eminzaani ehikire, amabaare gahikire, eefa ehikire na hiini ehikire. Niinye MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu owaabaihire omu nsi ya Misri.
en: Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall ye have: I am the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Garuka ogambire Abaisraeli ebigambo ebi: Omuntu weena ow'omu Baisraeli nari ow'omu banyamahanga abarikubashuhuukiramu, oritambira Moleki omwe aha b'omu ruzaaro rwe, ashemereire kwitwa, ab'omuri egyo nsi bakamuteera amabaare.
en: Again, thou shalt say to the children of Israel, Whosoever he be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that giveth any of his seed unto Molech; he shall surely be put to death: the people of the land shall stone him with stones.

rr: Naanye ndyareeba kubi ogwo mushaija, mmucwe omu ihanga rye, nimmutura okuha Moleki omwe aha b'omu ruzaaro rwe, n'okushiisha Omwanya gwangye ogurikwera, akajumisa eiziina ryangye eririkwera.
en: And I will set my face against that man, and will cut him off from among his people; because he hath given of his seed unto Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.

rr: Abantu b'omu nsi egyo ku baryehuzya ogwo mushaija, ohaire Moleki omwe aha b'omu ruzaaro rwe, bataamwita
en: And if the people of the land do any ways hide their eyes from the man, when he giveth of his seed unto Molech, and kill him not:

rr: ndyaguma nindeeba kubi ogwo mushaija hamwe n'ab'omu ka ye, mmucwe omu ihanga ryabo hamwe n'abandi boona abarikumukuratira, bakeehongyera Moleki, bakamuramya nk'abarikuraaya.
en: then I will set my face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that go a whoring after him, to commit whoredom with Molech, from among their people.

rr: Kandi omuntu oriimuurira aha bantu abarikubandwa emizimu n'abarogi, abarikubakuratira nk'abarikuraaya, ndyareeba kubi ogwo muntu, mmucwe omu ihanga rye.
en: And the soul that turneth after such as have familiar spirits, and after wizards, to go a whoring after them, I will even set my face against that soul, and will cut him off from among his people.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo mweyeze, mube abarikwera; ahakuba Niinye MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu.
en: Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be ye holy: for I am the LORD your God.

rr: Mugume mworobere ebiragiro byangye, kandi mukore ebi naataireho. Niinye MUKAMA orikubeeza.
en: And ye shall keep my statutes, and do them: I am the LORD which sanctify you.

rr: Omuntu weena orikyeena ishe nari nyina aitwe; ahabw'okukyeena ishe nari nyina, orubanja rw'eshagama ye rube ahariwe.
en: For every one that curseth his father or his mother shall be surely put to death: he hath cursed his father or his mother; his blood shall be upon him.

rr: Omuntu ku arishambana na muka mutaahi we, bombi kishambana na kishambanisibwa, baitwe.
en: And the man that committeth adultery with another man's wife, even he that committeth adultery with his neighbour's wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.

rr: Omushaija ku aribyama na muka ishe, aryaba ajwekire ishe busha; bombi baitwe; orubanja rw'eshagama yaabo rubabeho.
en: And the man that lieth with his father's wife hath uncovered his father's nakedness: both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

rr: Omuntu ku aribyama n'omukaamwana, bombi baitwe; baryaba bakozire ekitakorwa; orubanja rw'eshagama yaabo rubabeho.
en: And if a man lie with his daughter in law, both of them shall surely be put to death: they have wrought confusion; their blood shall be upon them.

rr: Omushaija ku arihindura mugyenzi we omukazi, bombi baryaba bakozire ekihagaro, baitwe; orubanja rw'eshagama yaabo rubabeho.
en: If a man also lie with mankind, as he lieth with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

rr: Omushaija ku arishwera omukazi na nyina, kiryaba kiri ekibi kihango, we nabo bookibwe, ekibi kyona kirekye kuba omuriimwe.
en: And if a man take a wife and her mother, it is wickedness: they shall be burnt with fire, both he and they; that there be no wickedness among you.

rr: Omushaija ku aribyama n'enyamaishwa, aitwe, kandi mwite n'egyo nyamaishwa.
en: And if a man lie with a beast, he shall surely be put to death: and ye shall slay the beast.

rr: Omukazi ku arihika enyamaishwa, yaabyama nayo, mwite ogwo mukazi n'egyo nyamaishwa; buzima bishemereire kwitwa; kandi orubanja rw'eshagama yaabyo rukabibaho.
en: And if a woman approach unto any beast, and lie down thereto, thou shalt kill the woman, and the beast: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

rr: Omuntu ku aritwara munyaanya, owa ishe nari owa nyina, baareebana bajwaire busha, kiryaba ekihemu; babacwere omu maisho g'eihanga ryabo; ahakuba ajwekire busha munyaanya; orubanja rw'okutahikiirira ruryamugumaho.
en: And if a man shall take his sister, his father's daughter, or his mother's daughter, and see her nakedness, and she see his nakedness; it is a wicked thing; and they shall be cut off in the sight of their people: he hath uncovered his sister's nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.

rr: Omushaija ku aribyama n'omukazi ori omu kwezi, yaamujweka busha, aryaba ajwekire busha okujwa kwe, n'omukazi nawe aryaba ajwekire busha okujwa kwe; bombi bacuubwe omu ihanga ryabo.
en: And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness, and shall uncover her nakedness; he hath discovered her fountain, and she hath uncovered the fountain of her blood: and both of them shall be cut off from among their people.

rr: Otarijweka busha nyokwento nari shwenkazi; ahabw'okuba okwo n'okujweka busha ow'obuzaare bwa haihi; mwembi orubanja rw'okutahikiirira ruryabagumaho.
en: And thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister, nor of thy father's sister: for he uncovereth his near kin: they shall bear their iniquity.

rr: Omushaija ku aribyama na muka ishento, aryaba ajwekire busha ishento; baryagiibwaho ekibi kyabo, bafe bucwekye.
en: And if a man shall lie with his uncle's wife, he hath uncovered his uncle's nakedness: they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.

rr: Omushaija ku aritwara muka mwene ishe, kiryaba kiri okweshiisha; aryaba ajwekire busha mwene ishe; baryafa bucwekye. Omutaano gw'Abaisraeli n'abandi
en: And if a man shall take his brother's wife, it is an unclean thing: he hath uncovered his brother's nakedness; they shall be childless.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo mugume mworobere ebiragiro byangye byona n'emigyenzo ei naataireho yoona, mubikore, ensi ei ndikubatwara kutuuramu erekye kubatanaka.
en: Ye shall therefore keep all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: that the land, whither I bring you to dwell therein, spue you not out.

rr: Mutaritooreza emicwe y'eihanga eri ndikubinga omu maisho gaanyu; ahakuba ebyo byona nibyo baakozire, bikandeetera okubangira kimwe.
en: And ye shall not walk in the manners of the nation, which I cast out before you: for they committed all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.

rr: Kwonka imwe nkabagira nti: Muryahungura ensi yaabo, ngibahe, ebe eyaanyu, ensi ey'amate n'obwoki. Niinye MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu owaabataaniise n'agandi mahanga.
en: But I have said unto you, Ye shall inherit their land, and I will give it unto you to possess it, a land that floweth with milk and honey: I am the LORD your God, which have separated you from other people.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo mushemereire kutaanisa omu nyamaishwa ezitarikuzira n'ezirikuzira, n'enyonyi ezitarikuzira n'ezirikuzira; mutaryesiisisa enyamaishwa nari enyonyi nari ekintu kyona ekirikugyendera ahansi, eki naabataaniise nakyo, ngu kigume kiri ekirikuzira ahariimwe.
en: Ye shall therefore put difference between clean beasts and unclean, and between unclean fowls and clean: and ye shall not make your souls abominable by beast, or by fowl, or by any manner of living thing that creepeth on the ground, which I have separated from you as unclean.

rr: Muryaba abarikwera ahariinye; ahabw'okuba Nyowe MUKAMA ndi orikwera, kandi nkabataanisa n'amahanga agandi, ngu mubone kuba abantu bangye.
en: And ye shall be holy unto me: for I the LORD am holy, and have severed you from other people, that ye should be mine.

rr: Omushaija nari omukazi orikubandwa emizimu nari orikuroga, aitwe; babateere amabaare; orubanja rw'eshagama yaabo rubabeho.
en: A man also or woman that hath a familiar spirit, or that is a wizard, shall surely be put to death: they shall stone them with stones: their blood shall be upon them.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati: Gambira abanyamurwa batabani ba Arooni, noobagira oti: Hatarigira omuntu omuriimwe owaayeshiisha ahabw'omuntu ofiire omu ruganda rwe
en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Speak unto the priests the sons of Aaron, and say unto them, There shall none be defiled for the dead among his people:

rr: kureka ahabw'ow'obuzaare obumuri haihi munonga, nka nyina, ishe, omutabani muhara we, mwene ishe
en: but for his kin, that is near unto him, that is , for his mother, and for his father, and for his son, and for his daughter, and for his brother,

rr: nari munyaanya otakamanyaga mushaija, (omuri haihi, ahakuba takashweirwe; ahabw'ogwo naikirizibwa kweshiisha).
en: and for his sister a virgin, that is nigh unto him, which hath had no husband; for her may he be defiled.

rr: Ataryeshiisha, akeegayisa, ahabw'okuba n'omuntu mukuru omu ihanga rye.
en: But he shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.

rr: Bataryemwa eishokye aha kazingiro, bataritega omu mbaju z'ebireju byabo, n'obu kwakuba okwecwa engondo.
en: They shall not make baldness upon their head, neither shall they shave off the corner of their beard, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.

rr: Babe abeereziibwe Ruhanga waabo, barekye kujumisa eiziina rye; ahakuba nibo bahongyera MUKAMA empongano z'okwotsya n'omuriro, nibyo by'okurya bya Ruhanga waabo; n'ahabw'ekyo bashemereire kuba abarikwera.
en: They shall be holy unto their God, and not profane the name of their God: for the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and the bread of their God, they do offer: therefore they shall be holy.

rr: Batarishwera maraaya nari omukazi osiisirwe, nari oshenzirwe iba; ahakuba omunyamurwa n'orikwera ahari Ruhanga we.
en: They shall not take a wife that is a whore, or profane; neither shall they take a woman put away from her husband: for he is holy unto his God.

rr: Nikyo orimwereza, ahakuba niwe ahonga eby'okurya bya Ruhanga waawe; aryaguma ari orikwera ahariiwe; ahabw'okuba nyowe MUKAMA orikubeeza ndi orikwera.
en: Thou shalt sanctify him therefore; for he offereth the bread of thy God: he shall be holy unto thee: for I the LORD , which sanctify you, am holy.

rr: Kandi muhara w'omunyamurwa weena, ku aryeshiisha, yaaba maraaya, biri ajumiise ishe; ayokibwe omu muriro.
en: And the daughter of any priest, if she profane herself by playing the whore, she profaneth her father: she shall be burnt with fire.

rr: Oriba ari omunyamurwa omukuru omuri beene ishe, owaashukirwe amajuta aha mutwe, akeezibwa kujwara ebyo bijwaro by'obunyamurwa bukuru, atarizingurura eishokye rye, n'obu kwakuba okutaagura ebijwaro bye
en: And he that is the high priest among his brethren, upon whose head the anointing oil was poured, and that is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not uncover his head, nor rend his clothes;

rr: atarihika aha mutumbi gwona, kandi ataryeshiisha n'omutumbi gwa ishe nari ogwa nyina.
en: neither shall he go in to any dead body, nor defile himself for his father, or for his mother;

rr: Atarishohora kuruga omu Mwanya ogurikwera gwa Ruhanga we, n'obu kwakuba okugushiisha; ahabw'okuba okushoroorwa, oku yaashoroirwe naashukwaho amajuta ga Ruhanga we, kumuriho. Niinye MUKAMA.
en: neither shall he go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him: I am the LORD .

rr: Kandi ashemereire kushwera omwishiki otakamanyaga mushaija
en: And he shall take a wife in her virginity.

rr: atarishwera omufaakazi, nari oshenzirwe, nari osiisirwe, nari maraaya; kureka ashwere omwishiki w'eihanga rye otakamanyaga mushaija
en: A widow, or a divorced woman, or profane, or an harlot, these shall he not take: but he shall take a virgin of his own people to wife.

rr: arekye kujumisa abaana be omu ihanga rye; ahakuba niinye MUKAMA orikumweza.
en: Neither shall he profane his seed among his people: for I the LORD do sanctify him.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Gambira Arooni oti: Omuntu weena ow'omu ruzaaro rwawe omu busingye bwabo bwona oine akamogo, atariikirizibwa kuhika haihi, kuhongyera Ruhanga we eby'okurya
en: Speak unto Aaron, saying, Whosoever he be of thy seed in their generations that hath any blemish, let him not approach to offer the bread of his God.

rr: ahakuba omuntu weena oine akamogo tarikwikirizibwa kwirira haihi, yaaba ari empumi nari ekirema nari okokoire enyindo, nari ekimuga
en: For whatsoever man he be that hath a blemish, he shall not approach: a blind man, or a lame, or he that hath a flat nose, or any thing superfluous,

rr: nari owaahendekire ekigyere nari engaro
en: or a man that is brokenfooted, or brokenhanded,

rr: nari ow'eibango nari ekipimpiri, nari oine eshongo, nari orwaire obuhere, nari ebiseera, nari oyatikire amagosi.
en: or crookbackt, or a dwarf, or that hath a blemish in his eye, or be scurvy, or scabbed, or hath his stones broken;

rr: Hatarigira ow'omu ruzaaro rwa Arooni omunyamurwa oine akamogo owaahika haihi kuhongyera MUKAMA empongano ez'okwotsya omu muriro; ahakuba aine akamogo tariirira haihi kuhongyera Ruhanga we eby'okurya.
en: no man that hath a blemish of the seed of Aaron the priest shall come nigh to offer the offerings of the LORD made by fire: he hath a blemish; he shall not come nigh to offer the bread of his God.

rr: Aryaguma arye eby'okurya bya Ruhanga we, ebirikwera munonga n'ebirikwera
en: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy.

rr: kwonka taritaaha kuhika aha mukingo, nari okuhika aha itambiro, ahakuba aine akamogo; arekye kushiisha emyanya yangye erikwera, ahabw'okuba niinye MUKAMA orikubeeza.
en: Only he shall not go in unto the vail, nor come nigh unto the altar, because he hath a blemish; that he profane not my sanctuaries: for I the LORD do sanctify them.

rr: Atyo Musa yaabigambira Arooni n'abatabani n'eihanga ryona ery'Abaisraeli.
en: And Moses told it unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel.

MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Gambira Arooni n'abatabani beetantare ebintu ebirikwera, ebi Abaisraeli barikuunyereza, barekye kujumisa eiziina ryangye eririkwera. Niinye MUKAMA.
en: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, and that they profane not my holy name in those things which they hallow unto me: I am the LORD .

rr: Obagambire ebigambo byangye ebi ndikugamba ningira nti: Omuntu weena ow'omu ruzaaro rwanyu omu busingye bwanyu bwona orihika aha bintu birikwera ebi Abaisraeli barikwereza MUKAMA akisiisikaire, omuntu ogwo aryacuubwa omu maisho gangye. Niinye MUKAMA.
en: Say unto them, Whosoever he be of all your seed among your generations, that goeth unto the holy things, which the children of Israel hallow unto the LORD , having his uncleanness upon him, that soul shall be cut off from my presence: I am the LORD .

rr: Weena ow'omu ruzaaro rwa Arooni obembire, nari orikureeta amahira, atarirya aha bintu ebirikwera okuhitsya obu ariba oshemeire.
en: What man soever of the seed of Aaron is a leper, or hath a running issue; he shall not eat of the holy things, until he be clean.

rr: Omuntu weena orikora aha kintu kyona ekisiisikaire ahabw'okuhika aha mutumbi, nari orikureeta amahira
en: And whoso toucheth any thing that is unclean by the dead, or a man whose seed goeth from him;

rr: nari orikora aha kintu kyona ekirikugyendera ahansi ekirikubaasa kumuhindura otashemeire, nari omuntu ondiijo ou yaihaho okutashemera okw'omuringo gwona
en: or whosoever toucheth any creeping thing, whereby he may be made unclean, or a man of whom he may take uncleanness, whatsoever uncleanness he hath;

rr: omuntu orikora aha kintu ekirikushusha kityo, aryaba otashemeire okuhitsya omu mwabazyo, kandi tariikirizibwa kurya aha bintu birikwera, atabandize kwoga omubiri gwe omu maizi.
en: the soul which hath touched any such shall be unclean until even, and shall not eat of the holy things, unless he wash his flesh with water.

rr: Eizooba ku ririrenga, aryaba oshemeire; bwanyima abone kurya aha bintu ebirikwera; ahabw'okuba ebyo n'eby'okurya bye.
en: And when the sun is down, he shall be clean, and shall afterward eat of the holy things; because it is his food.

rr: Atarirya ekyefeereire nari ekiitsirwe enyamaishwa okukyesiisisa. Niinye MUKAMA.
en: That which dieth of itself, or is torn with beasts , he shall not eat to defile himself therewith: I am the LORD .

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo bashemereire kworobera eki ndikubaragiira, batakaagiibwaho orubanja rw'ekibi, bakakifeeramu ahabw'okushiisha ekiragiro ekyo. Niinye MUKAMA orikubeeza.
en: They shall therefore keep mine ordinance, lest they bear sin for it, and die therefore, if they profane it: I the LORD do sanctify them.

rr: Hatarigira otari w'omu banyamurwa weena owaarya aha kintu ekirikwera; omushuhuuki w'omunyamurwa nari omupakasi orikumukorera taribiryaho.
en: There shall no stranger eat of the holy thing: a sojourner of the priest, or an hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.

rr: Kwonka omunyamurwa ku arigura omuntu n'empiiha ze, ogwo aryabiryaho; kandi n'abo abazaariirwe omu ka ye, baryarya aha by'okurya bye.
en: But if the priest buy any soul with his money, he shall eat of it, and he that is born in his house: they shall eat of his meat.

rr: Muhara w'omunyamurwa ku arishwerwa otari w'omu banyamurwa, atarirya aha mpongano z'ebintu ebirikwera
en: If the priest's daughter also be married unto a stranger, she may not eat of an offering of the holy things.

rr: kwonka muhara w'omunyamurwa ku ariba ari omufaakazi nari oshenzirwe, ataine mwana, yaagaruka aha mahega ga ishe, nk'oku yaabaire ari akiri omwishiki, aryaikirizibwa kurya aha by'okurya bya ishe; kwonka tihariho otari w'omu banyamurwa weena oribiryaho.
en: But if the priest's daughter be a widow, or divorced, and have no child, and is returned unto her father's house, as in her youth, she shall eat of her father's meat: but there shall no stranger eat thereof.

rr: Kandi omuntu ku arirya aha kintu kirikwera atakimanyire, akirihe omunyamurwa, kandi ayongyereho ekicweka kimwe kya kataano eky'obuguzi bwakyo.
en: And if a man eat of the holy thing unwittingly, then he shall put the fifth part thereof unto it, and shall give it unto the priest with the holy thing.

rr: Abanyamurwa batarishiisha ebintu ebirikwera ebi Abaisraeli bahongyera MUKAMA
en: And they shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer unto the LORD ;

rr: bakabareetera kugiibwaho okutahikiirira n'orubanja ahabw'okurya ebintu byabo ebirikwera; ahabw'okuba niinye MUKAMA orikubeeza.
en: or suffer them to bear the iniquity of trespass, when they eat their holy things: for I the LORD do sanctify them.

rr: Kandi MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Gambira Arooni n'abatabani n'eihanga ryona ery'Abaisraeli oti: Omuntu weena ow'omu nju ya Israeli nari ow'omu babashuhuukiiremu ku arireeta empongano ye, yaaba y'okuhikiiriza eki yaaraganiise nari eki yaatoizire ahabw'okweyendera, kuba empongano ehongyeirwe MUKAMA ey'ekitambo ky'okwotsya
en: Speak unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them, Whatsoever he be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers in Israel, that will offer his oblation for all his vows, and for all his freewill offerings, which they will offer unto the LORD for a burnt offering;

rr: ahabw'okwenda ngu eikirizibwe, mushemereire kuhonga enimi nari empaya y'entaama nari ey'embuzi etaine kamogo
en: ye shall offer at your own will a male without blemish, of the beeves, of the sheep, or of the goats.

rr: kwonka ekiine akamogo mutarikihonga, ahabw'okuba tikiritoorwa habwanyu.
en: But whatsoever hath a blemish, that shall ye not offer: for it shall not be acceptable for you.

rr: Kandi omuntu weena oritambira MUKAMA ekitambo ky'empongano z'okusiima ahabw'obusingye, okuhikiiriza eki yaaraganiise nari eki atoizire ahabw'okweyendera, naakiiha omu masyo g'ente nari ag'entaama, kyaza kwikirizibwa kishemereire kuba ekishugaine, kitainemu kamogo koona.
en: And whosoever offereth a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD to accomplish his vow, or a freewill offering in beeves or sheep, it shall be perfect to be accepted; there shall be no blemish therein.

rr: Enyamaishwa ehumire nari ehendekire nari ebuzireho orugingo nari erikureeta amahira nari erwaire orukamba nari akanyamutinda, mutaribihongyera MUKAMA, n'obu kwakuba okubitamba mukabyokyeza MUKAMA aha itambiro.
en: Blind, or broken, or maimed, or having a wen, or scurvy, or scabbed, ye shall not offer these unto the LORD , nor make an offering by fire of them upon the altar unto the LORD .

rr: Enimi nari omwana gw'entaama ebiine ebicweka ebirikukiraakirana, nimwikirizibwa kukihonga kuba omutoijo gw'okweyendera; kwonka tibirikwikirizibwa kuba empongano y'okuhikiiriza eki mwaraganiise.
en: Either a bullock or a lamb that hath any thing superfluous or lacking in his parts, that mayest thou offer for a freewill offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.

rr: Enyamaishwa eine amagosi gahonokire nari gahonzire nari gataagukire nari gashaahwirwe, mutarigitoijera MUKAMA n'obu kwakuba okugimutambira omu nsi yaanyu.
en: Ye shall not offer unto the LORD that which is bruised, or crushed, or broken, or cut; neither shall ye make any offering thereof in your land.

rr: Kandi mutaryakiira ezirikushusha nk'ezo okuruga omu mikono y'omunyaihanga kuba eby'okurya eby'okuhongyera Ruhanga waanyu; ahabw'okuba ziine obumogo; ahabw'obumogo bwazo tiziritoorwa habwanyu.
en: Neither from a stranger's hand shall ye offer the bread of your God of any of these; because their corruption is in them, and blemishes be in them: they shall not be accepted for you.

rr: Kandi MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Enimi nari entaama nari embuzi ku erizaarwa, eryamara ebiro mushanju na nyinayo; okuruga aha kiro kya munaana eryaikirizibwa kuhongyerwa MUKAMA kuba empongano eyokiibwe omu muriro.
en: When a bullock, or a sheep, or a goat, is brought forth, then it shall be seven days under the dam; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for an offering made by fire unto the LORD .

rr: Nyinayo, ku eriba eri ente nari entaama, otarigiita hamwe n'omwana gwayo aha izooba rimwe.
en: And whether it be cow or ewe, ye shall not kill it and her young both in one day.

rr: Ku muritambira MUKAMA ekitambo ky'okusiima, mukitambe omu muringo ogu murikubaasa kwikiririzibwamu
en: And when ye will offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving unto the LORD , offer it at your own will.

rr: kiriibwe aha izooba eryo eri kyatambirwaho; mutarigira eki mwatsigaho okuhitsya omu kasheeshe. Niinye MUKAMA.
en: On the same day it shall be eaten up; ye shall leave none of it until the morrow: I am the LORD .

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo muryaguma mworobere ebiragiro byangye, mukore ebi naataireho. Niinye MUKAMA.
en: Therefore shall ye keep my commandments, and do them: I am the LORD .

rr: Kandi mutarijumisa eiziina ryangye eririkwera; kureka ndyaguma nyezibwe omu ihanga rya Israeli. Niinye MUKAMA orikubeeza
en: Neither shall ye profane my holy name; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel: I am the LORD which hallow you,

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Gambira Abaisraeli ebi ndikugamba ningira nti: Aga nigo magyenyi ga MUKAMA agu naataireho, agu oshemereire kuranga kuba okuteerana okurikwera.
en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, Concerning the feasts of the LORD , which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my feasts.

rr: Omu biro mukaaga emirimo ebe nimwo yaakorerwa; kwonka ekiro kya mushanju ni sabato y'okuhuumuriraho ey'okuteerana okurikwera; mutarigikoreraho omurimo gwona; ni sabato ahari MUKAMA omu maka gaanyu goona.
en: Six days shall work be done: but the seventh day is the sabbath of rest, an holy convocation; ye shall do no work therein: it is the sabbath of the LORD in all your dwellings.

rr: Aga nigo magyenyi ga MUKAMA agaatairweho ag'okuteerana okurikwera, agu oshemereire kuranga omu bunaku bwago obwatairweho.
en: These are the feasts of the LORD , even holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their seasons.

rr: Omu kwezi kw'okubanza aha kiro kya ikumi na bina omu mwabazyo, nikwo kuhinguraho kwa MUKAMA.
en: In the fourteenth day of the first month at even is the LORD 's passover.

rr: Aha kiro kya ikumi na bitaano eky'okwezi okwo n'obugyenyi bw'emigaati etatumbisiibwe ahari MUKAMA; muryaguma mumare ebiro mushanju nimurya emigaati etatumbisiibwe.
en: And on the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread unto the LORD : seven days ye must eat unleavened bread.

rr: Aha kiro ky'okutandikiraho obwo bugyenyi muryagira okuteerana kurikwera; mutarikikoreraho omurimo gwona ogurikurusya
en: In the first day ye shall have an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.

rr: kwonka muryaguma nimureeta empongano y'okuhongyera MUKAMA ey'okwotsya omu muriro okumara ebiro mushanju; aha kiro kya mushanju haryabaho okuteerana okurikwera; mutarikikoreraho omurimo gwona ogurikurusya.
en: But ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD seven days: in the seventh day is an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein .

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Gambira Abaisraeli ebi ndikuragiira ningira nti: Ku murihika omu nsi ei ndikubaha, mwashaaruura emyaka yaayo, muryareetera omunyamurwa ekiba ky'omuganuro gw'ebi mwerize
en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land which I give unto you, and shall reap the harvest thereof, then ye shall bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest unto the priest:

rr: nawe azongazonzye ekyo kiba omu maisho ga MUKAMA, kiikirizibwe ahabwanyu; aha izooba eririkurata sabato niryo omunyamurwa arikizongazongyezaho
en: and he shall wave the sheaf before the LORD , to be accepted for you: on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.

rr: kandi aha izooba eryo eri murizongazongyezaho ekyo kiba, muryahonga empaya nto y'entaama etaine kamogo ehikize omwaka, kuba ekitambo ky'okwotsya ekihongyeirwe MUKAMA.
en: And ye shall offer that day when ye wave the sheaf an he lamb without blemish of the first year for a burnt offering unto the LORD .

rr: Kandi empongano y'esaano ey'okuhongwa nakyo eryaguma ebe ebicweka bibiri bya ikumi bya eefa y'esaano y'obunono ejwangize n'amajuta, ebe empongano ey'okuhongyera MUKAMA ey'okwotsya omu muriro kuba ekisooroora kirungi; empongano y'eby'okunywa ey'okuhongwa nakyo eryaguma ebe ekicweka kimwe kya kana kya hiini ya viinyo.
en: And the meat offering thereof shall be two tenth deals of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering made by fire unto the LORD for a sweet savour: and the drink offering thereof shall be of wine, the fourth part of an hin.

rr: Mutarirya omugaati gwona nari enjuma y'ekintu kyona ekarangire nari embisi eryo izooba eri muriheeraho empongano ahari Ruhanga waanyu ritakahikire. Ekyo n'ekiragiro ekitarihwaho omu busingye bwanyu bwona n'omu maka gaanyu goona.
en: And ye shall eat neither bread, nor parched corn, nor green ears, until the selfsame day that ye have brought an offering unto your God: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

rr: Kandi muryayebarira ebiro okwiha aha izooba eririkurata sabato, eri muriba mureeteireho ekiba ky'empongano ey'okuzongazonzya; ebyo biro bihikye sabato mushanju eziijwire
en: And ye shall count unto you from the morrow after the sabbath, from the day that ye brought the sheaf of the wave offering; seven sabbaths shall be complete:

rr: nimubara ebiro makumi ataano okuhitsya aha izooba eririkukurata sabato ya mushanju; obwo muryareeta empongano y'esaano y'omwaka musya y'okuhongyera MUKAMA.
en: even unto the morrow after the seventh sabbath shall ye number fifty days; and ye shall offer a new meat offering unto the LORD .

rr: Mwihe omu maka gaanyu emigaati ebiri ekozirwe omu bicweka bibiri bya ikumi bya eefa kuba empongano y'okuzongazonzya, eteekwe omu saano y'obunono, bagiteekyerane n'ekitumbisa kuganurirwa MUKAMA.
en: Ye shall bring out of your habitations two wave loaves of two tenth deals: they shall be of fine flour; they shall be baken with leaven; they are the firstfruits unto the LORD .

rr: Hamwe n'egyo migaati mureete abaana b'entaama mushanju abataine kamogo, abahikize omwaka, n'enimi nto emwe n'empaya z'entaama ibiri; bibe ekitambo ky'okwotsya eky'okutambirwa MUKAMA, n'empongano y'esaano ereetsirwe nabyo, n'ez'eby'okunywa ezireetsirwe nabyo, kuba empongano ey'okwotsya omu muriro y'ekisooroora kirungi ahari MUKAMA.
en: And ye shall offer with the bread seven lambs without blemish of the first year, and one young bullock, and two rams: they shall be for a burnt offering unto the LORD , with their meat offering, and their drink offerings, even an offering made by fire, of sweet savour unto the LORD .

rr: Kandi muhongye empaya y'embuzi kuba empongano y'ekibi, n'empaya nto ibiri z'entaama ezihikize omwaka kuba ekitambo ky'empongano z'okusiima ahabw'obusingye.
en: Then ye shall sacrifice one kid of the goats for a sin offering, and two lambs of the first year for a sacrifice of peace offerings.

rr: Omunyamurwa abizongazonzye hamwe n'emigaati y'omuganuro kuba empongano ezongazongiibwe omu maisho ga MUKAMA hamwe n'abo baana b'entaama bombi, bibe ebyereziibwe MUKAMA, bitwarwe omunyamurwa.
en: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the firstfruits for a wave offering before the LORD , with the two lambs: they shall be holy to the LORD for the priest.

rr: Eryo izooba murangye ku murigira okuteerana okurikwera; mutaririkoreraho omurimo gwona ogurikurusya. Ekyo n'ekiragiro ekitarihwaho omu maka gaanyu goona n'omu busingye bwanyu bwona.
en: And ye shall proclaim on the selfsame day, that it may be an holy convocation unto you: ye shall do no servile work therein: it shall be a statute for ever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.

rr: Ku muriba nimushaaruura emyaka y'omu misiri yaanyu, mutarimariramu kimwe n'ey'aha mbibi, n'obu kwakuba okuhumba ebitsigairemu; kureka mubitsigire abooro n'abanyamahanga. Niinye MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu.
en: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not make clean riddance of the corners of thy field when thou reapest, neither shalt thou gather any gleaning of thy harvest: thou shalt leave them unto the poor, and to the stranger: I am the LORD your God.

rr: Kandi MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Gambira Abaisraeli oti: Omu kwezi kwa mushanju, ekiro ky'okubanza ky'okwo kwezi murykigira eizooba eririkwera ery'okuhuumuriraho, ery'ekiijutsyo eki muriranga nimuteera enzamba, kuba okweteerana okurikwera.
en: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, In the seventh month, in the first day of the month, shall ye have a sabbath, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, an holy convocation.

rr: Mutaririkoreraho omurimo gwona ogurikurusya; kureka muryahongyera MUKAMA empongano y'okwotsya omu muriro.
en: Ye shall do no servile work therein: but ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD .

rr: Kandi MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Kwonka ekiro kya ikumi eky'okwo kwezi kwa mushanju kiryaba eizooba ry'okurihiiriraho; riryababeera eizooba ry'okuteerana okurikwera; muryabonabonesa amagara gaanyu, muhongyere MUKAMA empongano y'okwotsya omu muriro.
en: Also on the tenth day of this seventh month there shall be a day of atonement: it shall be an holy convocation unto you; and ye shall afflict your souls, and offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD .

rr: Aha kiro ekyo mutarikora omurimo gwona, ahakuba n'eizooba ry'okurihiiriraho, okubarihiirira omu maisho ga MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu.
en: And ye shall do no work in that same day: for it is a day of atonement, to make an atonement for you before the LORD your God.

rr: Ahakuba omuntu oriba atabonaboneise magara ge eryo izooba, aryacuubwa omu ihanga rye
en: For whatsoever soul it be that shall not be afflicted in that same day, he shall be cut off from among his people.

rr: n'omuntu weena orikora omurimo gwona ahari eryo izooba, ndyamuhwerekyereza, mmwihe omu ihanga rye.
en: And whatsoever soul it be that doeth any work in that same day, the same soul will I destroy from among his people.

rr: Mutarigira omurimo gwona ogu mwakora. Ekyo n'ekiragiro ekitarihwaho omu maka gaanyu goona n'omu busingye bwanyu bwona.
en: Ye shall do no manner of work: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

rr: Eryo izooba riryababeera sabato erikwera ey'okuhuumuriraho, mubonabonese amagara gaanyu; aha kiro kya mwenda eky'okwezi okwo okwiha omu mwabazyo muryarinda sabato yaanyu okuhitsya omu mwabazyo ogundi.
en: It shall be unto you a sabbath of rest, and ye shall afflict your souls: in the ninth day of the month at even, from even unto even, shall ye celebrate your sabbath.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Gambira Abaisraeli oti: Aha kiro kya ikumi na bitaano eky'okwo kwezi kwa mushanju haryabaho obugyenyi bw'Ensiisira ahari MUKAMA okumara ebiro mushanju.
en: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, The fifteenth day of this seventh month shall be the feast of tabernacles for seven days unto the LORD .

rr: Aha izooba ry'okubanza haryabaho okuteerana okurikwera; mutaririkoreraho omurimo gwona ogurikurusya.
en: On the first day shall be an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein .

rr: Muryaguma nimureeta empongano y'okuhongyera MUKAMA y'okwotsya omu muriro okumara ebiro mushanju; aha kiro kya munaana muryagira okuteerana okurikwera, mureete empongano y'okuhongyera MUKAMA y'okwotsya omu muriro; eryo izooba n'ery'okuteerana okurikwera; mutaririkoreraho omurimo gwona ogurikurusya.
en: Seven days ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD : on the eighth day shall be an holy convocation unto you; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD : it is a solemn assembly; and ye shall do no servile work therein .

rr: Ago nigo magyenyi ga MUKAMA agaatairweho agu muriranga kuba ag'okuteerana okurikwera, mukabona kureetera MUKAMA empongano z'okwotsya omu muriro, n'ekitambo ky'okwotsya, n'empongano y'esaano, n'ebindi bitambo, n'empongano z'eby'okunywa, buri kimwe aha izooba ryakyo
en: These are the feasts of the LORD , which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD , a burnt offering, and a meat offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, every thing upon his day:

rr: mutaihiremu sabato za MUKAMA, n'emitoijo yaanyu, n'ebi muraganisa nimuhiga byona, n'ebi mutoija ahabw'okweyendera ebi mutoijera MUKAMA.
en: beside the sabbaths of the LORD , and beside your gifts, and beside all your vows, and beside all your freewill offerings, which ye give unto the LORD .

rr: Aha kiro ky aikumi na bitaano eky'okwezi kwa mushanju, ku muriheza kushaaruura emyaka y'omu misiri, muryagira obugyenyi bw'ebiro bikuru ahari MUKAMA okumara ebiro mushanju; haryabaho okuhuumura okurikwera aha izooba ry'okutandikiraho obwo bugyenyi, kandi n'aha izooba ryabwo rya munaana.
en: Also in the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when ye have gathered in the fruit of the land, ye shall keep a feast unto the LORD seven days: on the first day shall be a sabbath, and on the eighth day shall be a sabbath.

rr: Ahari eryo izooba ry'okutandikiraho muryatwara ebijuma by'emiti emirungi, n'amataagi g'enkindo, n'amataagi g'emiti eyumbize, n'emiti y'aha migyera; muryamara ebiro mushanju nimushemerererwa omu maisho ga MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu.
en: And ye shall take you on the first day the boughs of goodly trees, branches of palm trees, and the boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and ye shall rejoice before the LORD your God seven days.

rr: Kandi muryaguma mugire obwo bugyenyi bw'ebiro mushanju ahari MUKAMA buri mwaka. Ekyo n'ekiragiro ekitarihwaho omu busingye bwanyu bwona. Muryaguma mubugire omu kwezi kwa mushanju.
en: And ye shall keep it a feast unto the LORD seven days in the year. It shall be a statute for ever in your generations: ye shall celebrate it in the seventh month.

rr: Muryamara ebiro mushanju nimuraara omu nsiisira; Abaisraeli enzaarwa boona bagume omu nsiisira
en: Ye shall dwell in booths seven days; all that are Israelites born shall dwell in booths:

rr: ab'obusingye bwona oburibakurata bamanye ku naaraarize Abaisraeli omu nsiisira, obu naabaiha omu nsi ya Misri. Niinye MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu.
en: that your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in booths, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.

rr: Okwo nikwo Musa yaarangiire Abaisraeli amagyenyi ga MUKAMA agaatairweho.
en: And Moses declared unto the children of Israel the feasts of the LORD .

en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Ragiira Abaisraeli bakureetere amajuta marungi g'emizeituuni eshekwirwe ag'okuhemba, amatabaaza gabone kuguma nigaaka obutoosha.
en: Command the children of Israel, that they bring unto thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamps to burn continually.

rr: Enyima y'omukingo ogurikukingira Ebirikuhamya, omu Ihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu, Arooni abe niho yaaguma naagashemereza obutoosha, gabone kuguma nigaakira omu maisho ga MUKAMA okuruga omu mwabazyo okuhitsya omu kasheeshe. Ekyo kibe ekiragiro ekitarihwaho omu busingye bwanyu bwona.
en: Without the vail of the testimony, in the tabernacle of the congregation, shall Aaron order it from the evening unto the morning before the LORD continually: it shall be a statute for ever in your generations.

rr: Arooni agume ashemereze ago matabaaza aha kikondo kyago eky'ezaabu eshemeziibwe, gaakire omu maisho ga MUKAMA.
en: He shall order the lamps upon the pure candlestick before the LORD continually.

rr: Kandi oryatwara esaano y'obunono, ogiteekyemu obugaati bwa keeki ikumi na bubiri, ebicweka bibiri bya ikumi bya eefa birugwemu akagaati kamwe
en: And thou shalt take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes thereof: two tenth deals shall be in one cake.

rr: obute aha meeza y'ezaabu eshemeziibwe omu mishorongo ebiri ey'obugaati mukaaga-mukaaga omu maisho ga MUKAMA.
en: And thou shalt set them in two rows, six on a row, upon the pure table before the LORD .

rr: Kandi aha mishorongo yombi oteho obubaane burungi oburikwetwa lebona, bubone kuheebwayo hamwe n'emigaati nk'ekiijutsyo eky'empongano ey'okuhongyera MUKAMA ey'okwotsya omu muriro.
en: And thou shalt put pure frankincense upon each row, that it may be on the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire unto the LORD .

rr: Buri sabato Arooni agite omu maisho ga MUKAMA obutoosha ahabw'Abaisraeli, kuba endagaano etarihwaho.
en: Every sabbath he shall set it in order before the LORD continually, being taken from the children of Israel by an everlasting covenant.

rr: Kandi egyo migaati egume ebe eya Arooni n'abatabani bagiriire omu mwanya gurikwera, ahakuba n'erikwera munonga ahariwe omu mpongano ezihongyerwa MUKAMA ezokiibwe omu muriro; n'omugabo gwe ogw'ebiro byona. Orubanja rw'abarikurogota aha iziina rya MUKAMA
en: And it shall be Aaron's and his sons'; and they shall eat it in the holy place: for it is most holy unto him of the offerings of the LORD made by fire by a perpetual statute.

rr: Hakaba hariho omwojo, mutabani w'Omwisraelikazi, ou yaazairweho Omunyamisri, owaizire n'Abaisraeli; omwojo ogwo akatonganira omu rusiisira n'omushaija Omwisraeli
en: And the son of an Israelitish woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel: and this son of the Israelitish woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp;

rr: mutabani w'Omwisraelikazi yaarogota aha Iziina eryo, naakyeena; baamureeta ahari Musa. (Kandi nyina akaba naayetwa Shelomiisi muhara wa Diburi, ow'omu ruganda rwa Daani.)
en: and the Israelitish woman's son blasphemed the name of the LORD , and cursed. And they brought him unto Moses: (and his mother's name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan:)

rr: Baamukingirana okuhitsya obunaku obu baraagambirirweho eki MUKAMA arikuragiira.
en: and they put him in ward, that the mind of the LORD might be shewed them.

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Shohoza ogwo okyeenire aheeru y'orusiisira, abamuhuriire boona bamute engaro aha mutwe, abantu boona bamuteere amabaare.
en: Bring forth him that hath cursed without the camp; and let all that heard him lay their hands upon his head, and let all the congregation stone him.

rr: Kandi ogambire Abaisraeli oti: Omuntu weena orikyeena Ruhanga we aryagiibwaho orubanja rw'ekyo kibi
en: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Whosoever curseth his God shall bear his sin.

rr: kandi orirogota aha Iziina rya MUKAMA, aitwe; ab'eihanga ryona bamuteere amabaare; n'omunyaihanga nawe nk'omuntu enzaarwa, orirogota aha Iziina eryo, aitwe.
en: And he that blasphemeth the name of the LORD , he shall surely be put to death, and all the congregation shall certainly stone him: as well the stranger, as he that is born in the land, when he blasphemeth the name of the LORD , shall be put to death.

rr: Oriita omuntu, aitwe.
en: And he that killeth any man shall surely be put to death.

rr: Oriita enyamaishwa etungirwe, agirihe; amagara garihwe agandi.
en: And he that killeth a beast shall make it good; beast for beast.

rr: Omuntu oriremaza mutaahi we, nawe aihurwe eki amukozire
en: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbour; as he hath done, so shall it be done to him;

rr: obuhuta burihwe obundi; eriisho ririhwe erindi; eriino ririhwe erindi; nk'oku omuntu ariba aremaize ondiijo, nawe abe nikwo yaihurwa.
en: breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth: as he hath caused a blemish in a man, so shall it be done to him again .

rr: Oriita enyamaishwa etungirwe, agirihe; n'oriita omuntu, aitwe.
en: And he that killeth a beast, he shall restore it: and he that killeth a man, he shall be put to death.

rr: Omunyaihanga n'enzaarwa bagire ekiragiro kimwe. Niinye MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu.
en: Ye shall have one manner of law, as well for the stranger, as for one of your own country: for I am the LORD your God.

rr: Musa yaaragiira Abaisraeli, baatwara ogwo owaakyeenire aheeru y'orusiisira, baamwitsa amabaare.
en: And Moses spake to the children of Israel, that they should bring forth him that had cursed out of the camp, and stone him with stones.

rr: Okwo nikwo Abaisraeli baakozire nk'oku MUKAMA yaaragiire Musa.
en: And the children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses.

rr: MUKAMA yaagambirira Musa aha rushozi Sinai ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses in mount Sinai, saying,

rr: Gambira Abaisraeli ebi ndikugamba ningira nti: Ku murihika omu nsi ei ndikubaha, egyo nsi eryaguma egire sabato ahabwa MUKAMA.
en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land which I give you, then shall the land keep a sabbath unto the LORD .

rr: Oryamara emyaka mukaaga noohinga emisiri yaawe, noosharira emizaabibu yaawe, nooshaaruura emyaka yaabyo.
en: Six years thou shalt sow thy field, and six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard, and gather in the fruit thereof;

rr: Kwonka omwaka gwa mushanju guryaba sabato y'okuraariza kimwe emisiri; ni sabato ahabwa MUKAMA; otarihinga emisiri yaawe, n'obu kwakuba okusharira emizaabibu yaawe.
en: but in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of rest unto the land, a sabbath for the LORD : thou shalt neither sow thy field, nor prune thy vineyard.

rr: Ebyemerize otaribigyesha, kandi ebijuma by'emizaabibu yaawe etashariire otaribicwa; omwaka ogwo guryaba ogw'okuhuumura kw'ensi okurikwera.
en: That which groweth of its own accord of thy harvest thou shalt not reap, neither gather the grapes of thy vine undressed: for it is a year of rest unto the land.

rr: Sabato egyo ey'ensi niyo eriba eby'okurya byanyu, iwe n'omuhuuku waawe n'omuzaana waawe n'omupakasi waawe n'omunyaihanga owaakushuhuukiireho
en: And the sabbath of the land shall be meat for you; for thee, and for thy servant, and for thy maid, and for thy hired servant, and for thy stranger that sojourneth with thee,

rr: n'amatungo gaawe n'enyamaishwa ez'omu nsi yaawe, byona ebi ensi eryeza nibyo biriba eby'okurya. Omwaka gwa Jubili
en: and for thy cattle, and for the beast that are in thy land, shall all the increase thereof be meat.

rr: Kandi oryayebarira sabato mushanju z'emyaka, niyo myaka mushanju emirundi mushanju; n'ahabw'ekyo obunaku bwa sabato ezo mushanju z'emyaka buryababeera emyaka makumi ana na mwenda.
en: And thou shalt number seven sabbaths of years unto thee, seven times seven years; and the space of the seven sabbaths of years shall be unto thee forty and nine years.

rr: Reero aha kiro kya ikumi ky'okwezi kwa mushanju oryatwara enzamba erikugamba munonga; ahari eryo izooba ry'okurihiirira niryo oriteereraho enzamba omu nsi yaawe yoona.
en: Then shalt thou cause the trumpet of the jubile to sound on the tenth day of the seventh month, in the day of atonement shall ye make the trumpet sound throughout all your land.

rr: Mweze omwaka gwa makumi ataano, murangye omu nsi yoona abagitwiremu boona, ku baine obusingye; guryababeera jubili; omuntu weena omuriimwe agarukye omu butaka bwe n'omu baabo.
en: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout all the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubile unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.

rr: Ogwo mwaka gwa makumi ataano guryababeera jubili; mutariguhingiramu, mutarigushaaruuriramu ebyemerize, n'obu kwakuba okugucweramu ebijuma by'emizaabibu etashariire
en: A jubile shall that fiftieth year be unto you: ye shall not sow, neither reap that which groweth of itself in it, nor gather the grapes in it of thy vine undressed.

rr: ahabw'okuba ni jubili; guryababeera ogurikwera; muryaguma nimurya ebyezire omu ishwa omuri ogwo mwaka.
en: For it is the jubile; it shall be holy unto you: ye shall eat the increase thereof out of the field.

rr: Omuri ogwo mwaka gwa jubili omuntu weena omuriimwe aryagaruka omu butaka bwe.
en: In the year of this jubile ye shall return every man unto his possession.

rr: Kandi ku origira eki waaguza mutaahi waawe, nari eki waamuguraho, mutariinyagana.
en: And if thou sell ought unto thy neighbour, or buyest ought of thy neighbour's hand, ye shall not oppress one another:

rr: Nk'emyaka erikurata jubili oku eriba eri, obe nikwo waagura ahari mutaahi waawe, kandi nawe akuguze nk'emyaka y'ebihingirwe oku eriba eri.
en: according to the number of years after the jubile thou shalt buy of thy neighbour, and according unto the number of years of the fruits he shall sell unto thee:

rr: Emyaka ku eriba mingi, oyongyere obuguzi; kandi emyaka ku eriba mikye, otuubye aha buguzi; ahabw'okuba omu kukuguza aryakurata obwingi bw'emyaka ei orishaaruura.
en: according to the multitude of years thou shalt increase the price thereof, and according to the fewness of years thou shalt diminish the price of it: for according to the number of the years of the fruits doth he sell unto thee.

rr: Mutariinyagana, kureka mutiine Ruhanga waanyu; ahakuba niinye MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu.
en: Ye shall not therefore oppress one another; but thou shalt fear thy God: for I am the LORD your God.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo muhurire ebiragiro byangye, mworobere emigyenzo ei naataireho, mugikore; obwo nibwo murituura omu nsi buhooro.
en: Wherefore ye shall do my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them; and ye shall dwell in the land in safety.

rr: Ensi eryayeza emyaka yaayo, naimwe murye, muhaagye, mugituuremu buhooro.
en: And the land shall yield her fruit, and ye shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.

rr: Kandi ku murigira muti: Beitu shi turyatungwa ki omu mwaka gwa mushanju? Ku turiba tutahingire kandi tutashaarwire!
en: And if ye shall say, What shall we eat the seventh year? behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase:

rr: mumanye ku ndiragiira omugisha gukabaijaho omu mwaka gwa mukaaga, ogwo mwak gukeera eby'okurya by'emyaka eshatu.
en: then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth fruit for three years.

rr: Omu mwaka gwa munaana muryahinga; kwonka muryaguma nimurya ahari ebyo ebi muhunikire ira, okuhitsya omu mwaka gwa mwenda, obu ebi mwabibire biryera.
en: And ye shall sow the eighth year, and eat yet of old fruit until the ninth year; until her fruits come in ye shall eat of the old store .

rr: Eitaka ritaritundirwa kimwe; ahakuba niinye mukama waaryo; naimwe muri abanyaihanga abanshuhuukiireho.
en: The land shall not be sold for ever: for the land is mine; for ye are strangers and sojourners with me.

rr: Kandi ensi yoona eriba yaabaire obutaka bwanyu, muryaguma mwikirize eitaka ricungurwe.
en: And in all the land of your possession ye shall grant a redemption for the land.

rr: Mwene waanyu ku ariba omworo, yaatunda aha butaka bwe, owaabo omuri haihi omu buzaare aryaija acungure eki mwene waabo atunzire.
en: If thy brother be waxen poor, and hath sold away some of his possession, and if any of his kin come to redeem it, then shall he redeem that which his brother sold.

rr: Omuntu ku aribura ow'okubucungura, bwanyima yaatunga, yaagira eby'okubucungura
en: And if the man have none to redeem it, and himself be able to redeem it;

rr: abare emyaka ehingwire okwiha obu yaabutunda, agarurire owaabuguzire eby'emyaka eriba etsigaireyo, abone kugaruka omu butaka bwe.
en: then let him count the years of the sale thereof, and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it; that he may return unto his possession.

rr: Kwonka ku ariba atarikubaasa kubwecungurira, obutaka obu yaatunzire buryagumanwa owaabuguzire okuhitsya aha mwaka gwa jubili; omu mwaka ogwo buryarekurwa, mukama waabwo abugarukyemu.
en: But if he be not able to restore it to him, then that which is sold shall remain in the hand of him that hath bought it until the year of jubile: and in the jubile it shall go out, and he shall return unto his possession.

rr: Omuntu ku aritunda enju ye omu rurembo orwehinguririziibwe orugo rw'amabaare, aryaikirizibwa kugicungura omwaka gutakahweireho okuruga obu yaagitunda; aryamara omwaka gwona aine obushoboorozi bw'okugicungura.
en: And if a man sell a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it is sold; within a full year may he redeem it.

rr: Kwonka ku eriba etacungwirwe omwaka ogwo gutakahweire, enju egyo eri omu rurembo orwehinguririziibwe orugo rw'amabaare eryahamibwa kubeera kimwe ey'ogwo owaagiguzire ebiro bye byona n'eby'abarimukurata; n'omu mwaka gwa jubili tericungurwa.
en: And if it be not redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be established for ever to him that bought it throughout his generations: it shall not go out in the jubile.

rr: Kwonka amaju g'omu birorero ebiteehinguririziibwe rugo rw'amabaare nigabarwa nk'emisiri y'omu ishwa; nigabaasa kucungurwa; kandi omu mwaka gwa jubili garyarekurwa.
en: But the houses of the villages which have no wall round about them shall be counted as the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall go out in the jubile.

rr: Kwonka omu ndembo z'Abaleevi amaju g'omu butaka bwabo nibaikirizibwa kugacungura omu bunaku bwona.
en: Notwithstanding the cities of the Levites, and the houses of the cities of their possession, may the Levites redeem at any time.

rr: Kandi Omuleevi ku ariba atacungwire nju ye, egyo nju eyaatunzirwe omu rurembo rw'obutaka bwabo, eryarekurwa omuri jubili; ahabw'okuba amaju g'omu ndembo z'Abaleevi n'agaabo g'obutaka obu baabagaine omu Baisraeli.
en: And if a man purchase of the Levites, then the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, shall go out in the year of jubile: for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.

rr: Kwonka emisiri ehereraine n'endembo z'Abaleevi teritundwa, ahakuba n'obutaka bwabo bw'ebiro byona.
en: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it is their perpetual possession.

rr: Mwene waanyu otwire naiwe ku ariba omworo, atakibaasa kwetunga, iwe oryamutunga, agume naiwe nk'omunyaihanga kandi omushuhuuki.
en: And if thy brother be waxen poor, and fallen in decay with thee; then thou shalt relieve him: yea, though he be a stranger, or a sojourner; that he may live with thee.

rr: Otarimushaba enshaagi nari ebirengyesereize; kureka otiine Ruhanga waawe, mwene waanyu abone kuguma atwire naiwe.
en: Take thou no usury of him, or increase: but fear thy God; that thy brother may live with thee.

rr: Otarimuguza empiiha ahabw'enshaagi, n'obu kwakuba okumuha eby'okurya ngu akweshumbizeho.
en: Thou shalt not give him thy money upon usury, nor lend him thy victuals for increase.

rr: Niinye MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu, owaabaihire omu nsi ya Misri kubaha ensi ya Kanaani, ngu mbe Ruhanga waanyu.
en: I am the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.

rr: Kandi mwene waanyu otwire naiwe ku ariba omworo, yaayetunda kuba owaawe, otarimukoresa nk'omuhuuku
en: And if thy brother that dwelleth by thee be waxen poor, and be sold unto thee; thou shalt not compel him to serve as a bondservant:

rr: kureka agume naiwe nk'omupakasi kandi nk'omushuhuuki; akukorere okuhitsya omu mwaka gwa jubili.
en: but as an hired servant, and as a sojourner, he shall be with thee, and shall serve thee unto the year of jubile:

rr: Obwo aryakurugaho, we n'abaana be, agarukye omuri beene waabo n'omu butaka bwa baishenkuru
en: and then shall he depart from thee, both he and his children with him, and shall return unto his own family, and unto the possession of his fathers shall he return.

rr: ahakuba n'abairu bangye abu naihire omu nsi ya Misri; bataritundwa nk'abahuuku.
en: For they are my servants, which I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: they shall not be sold as bondmen.

rr: Otarimutegyekyesa eikama, kureka otiine Ruhanga waawe.
en: Thou shalt not rule over him with rigour; but shalt fear thy God.

rr: Kandi eby'abahuuku baawe n'abazaana baawe, abu oriba oine, noikirizibwa kubagura omu mahanga agabeehinguririize
en: Both thy bondmen, and thy bondmaids, which thou shalt have, shall be of the heathen that are round about you; of them shall ye buy bondmen and bondmaids.

rr: kandi nimwikirizibwa kubagura omu baana b'abanyamahanga abaabashuhuukiiremu, n'abaijukuru baabo abu barizaarira omu nsi yaanyu; bo baryaba abaanyu.
en: Moreover of the children of the strangers that do sojourn among you, of them shall ye buy, and of their families that are with you, which they begat in your land: and they shall be your possession.

rr: Kandi nimwikirizibwa kubaraga abaana baanyu abaribakurata, babe abaabo ebiro byona. Bo muryaguma mubagire abahuuku ebiro byona; kwonka beene waanyu Abaisraeli mutaribaikiriza omuntu kutegyekyesa mutaahi we amaani.
en: And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit them for a possession; they shall be your bondmen for ever: but over your brethren the children of Israel, ye shall not rule one over another with rigour.

rr: Omunyaihanga nari omushuhuuki okushuhuukiireho ku ariba omutungi, na mwene waanyu otwire nawe yaaba omworo yaayetunda ahari ogwo munyaihanga nari omushuhuuki okushuhuukiireho, nari ahari omwe ow'omuri beene waabo
en: And if a sojourner or stranger wax rich by thee, and thy brother that dwelleth by him wax poor, and sell himself unto the stranger or sojourner by thee, or to the stock of the stranger's family:

rr: bwanyima y'okutundwa naabaasa kucungurwa; omwe ahari beene waabo naabaasa kumucungura
en: after that he is sold he may be redeemed again; one of his brethren may redeem him:

rr: yaaba ishento nari omwana wa ishento, nari mwene waabo weena ow'obuzaare bwa haihi, naabaasa kumucungura; nari shi we wenka, yaatunga, nabaasa kwecungura.
en: either his uncle, or his uncle's son, may redeem him, or any that is nigh of kin unto him of his family may redeem him; or if he be able, he may redeem himself.

rr: Aryabara emyaka n'owaamuguzire okwiha aha mwaka ogu yaamwetundiiremu okuhitsya aha mwaka gwa jubili; empiiha z'okumucungura ziingane n'egyo myaka; ebiro ebi ariba amazire naakorera mukama we biryabariirirwa, biihurwe nk'oku baihura omupakasi.
en: And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he was sold to him unto the year of jubile: and the price of his sale shall be according unto the number of years, according to the time of an hired servant shall it be with him.

rr: Emyaka ku eriba ekitsigaire mingi okuhitsya ahari jubili, oku eriba eri, nikwo arigarurira mukama we empiiha z'okumucungura, naaziitsya ahari ezo ezi yaaguzirwe.
en: If there be yet many years behind , according unto them he shall give again the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.

rr: Emyaka ku eriba etsigaire mikye, aryabara emyaka na mukama we; oku egyo myaka eriba eri, abe nikwo yaamugarurira empiiha z'okwecungura.
en: And if there remain but few years unto the year of jubile, then he shall count with him, and according unto his years shall he give him again the price of his redemption.

rr: Aryaguma nawe nk'omupakasi orikukorera ebihembo buri mwaka; atarimutwaza eikama, noomureeba.
en: And as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him: and the other shall not rule with rigour over him in thy sight.

rr: Ku ariba atacungwirwe omu buryo obwo, omu mwaka gwa jubili aryarekurwa n'abaana be
en: And if he be not redeemed in these years , then he shall go out in the year of jubile, both he, and his children with him.

en: Ye shall make you no idols nor graven image, neither rear you up a standing image, neither shall ye set up any image of stone in your land, to bow down unto it: for I am the LORD your God.

rr: Muryaguma murinde sabato zangye, muhe ekitiinisa Omwanya gwangye ogurikwera. Niinye MUKAMA. Emigisha erikuruga omu kworobera Ruhanga
en: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the LORD . Promises

rr: Ku muriguma nimukuratira ebi naataireho, mwahurira ebiragiro byangye, mwabyorobera
en: If ye walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, and do them;

rr: ndyaguma mbagwisize enjura omu bunaku bwayo, ensi egire omweru n'emiti y'omu misiri eyane ebyana.
en: then I will give you rain in due season, and the land shall yield her increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.
