en: And your threshing shall reach unto the vintage, and the vintage shall reach unto the sowing time: and ye shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.

rr: Kandi ndyareeta obusingye omu nsi; muryabyama, kandi tihaine oribatiinisa. Ndyamara enyamaishwa mbi omu nsi, na rurara teriraba mu nsi yaanyu yoona.
en: And I will give peace in the land, and ye shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid: and I will rid evil beasts out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.

rr: Muryabinga abazigu baanyu, zaarurara zibagwise omu maisho gaanyu.
en: And ye shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.

rr: Bataano omuriimwe baryabinga igana, na igana omuriimwe baryabinga kakumi; abazigu baanyu baryaitwa zaarurara.
en: And five of you shall chase an hundred, and an hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight: and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.

rr: Ndyabataho omutima, mbahe okuzaara munonga, mbakanyise, mpamye endagaano yangye naimwe.
en: For I will have respect unto you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and establish my covenant with you.

rr: Muryarya eby'okurya ebitwire omu bitara, muhununure ebikuru, muhunikye ebisya.
en: And ye shall eat old store, and bring forth the old because of the new.

rr: Ndyata obutaaho bwangye ahagati yaanyu; omutima gwangye tiguribatamwa.
en: And I will set my tabernacle among you: and my soul shall not abhor you.

rr: Ndyagyendera omuriimwe, mbe Ruhanga waanyu, naimwe mube abantu bangye.
en: And I will walk among you, and will be your God, and ye shall be my people.

rr: Niinye MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu owaabaihire omu nsi ya Misri, ngu murekye kuba abahuuku baabo; naabaihaho emigamba eyaabaire yaabainikire, naabagyendesa bwemi.
en: I am the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, that ye should not be their bondmen; and I have broken the bands of your yoke, and made you go upright.

rr: Ebifubiro by'okutoorobera Ruhanga
en: Warnings

rr: Ku muryanga kumpurira, kandi mutaayorobera ebyo biragiro byona
en: But if ye will not hearken unto me, and will not do all these commandments;

rr: ku murigaya ebi naataireho, emitima yaanyu yaayangira kimwe emigyenzo ei naataireho, kyabareetera kutoorobera biragiro byangye byona, kureka mwaita endagaano yangye
en: and if ye shall despise my statutes, or if your soul abhor my judgments, so that ye will not do all my commandments, but that ye break my covenant:

rr: naanye ndyabagira nti; ndyabareetera ebirikutiinisa, n'omunywengyerero, n'omushwija ogurukugwisa amaisho omunda, gukareetera amagara okugyenda nigahwerera. Muryabibira busha, ahakuba ebi muribiba abazigu baanyu baryabirya.
en: I also will do this unto you; I will even appoint over you terror, consumption, and the burning ague, that shall consume the eyes, and cause sorrow of heart: and ye shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.

rr: Ndyabata omu kaso, mbarwanise, mubingwe abazigu baanyu; abarikubanga babe nibo baabategyeka; muryahunga, hataine obabingire.
en: And I will set my face against you, and ye shall be slain before your enemies: they that hate you shall reign over you; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you.

rr: Hoona nabwo ku muryanga kumpurira, ndyayeyongyera kubahana emirundi mushanju ahabw'ebibi byanyu
en: And if ye will not yet for all this hearken unto me, then I will punish you seven times more for your sins.

rr: ndyabacwa amaryo, mbamare eishaija; eiguru ryanyu ndihindure ribe nk'ekyoma, n'ensi yaanyu ebe nk'omuringa
en: And I will break the pride of your power; and I will make your heaven as iron, and your earth as brass:

rr: muryahendekyera busha, ahakuba ensi yaanyu teryeza myaka, kandi emiti y'ensi yaanyu teryana bijuma.
en: and your strength shall be spent in vain: for your land shall not yield her increase, neither shall the trees of the land yield their fruits.

rr: Ku muritwaza okwanyu, mutaikirizana naanye, mwayanga kumpurira, ndyabareetera ebindi bibonaboneso, ebirikwingana n'ebibi byanyu emirundi mushanju.
en: And if ye walk contrary unto me, and will not hearken unto me; I will bring seven times more plagues upon you according to your sins.

rr: Kandi ndyabarekurira enyamaishwa z'omu ihamba, zibaakye abaana, zicwekyereze amatungo gaanyu, zibatuubye, n'emihanda yaanyu etsibe.
en: I will also send wild beasts among you, which shall rob you of your children, and destroy your cattle, and make you few in number; and your high ways shall be desolate.

rr: Ebyo bifubiro ku biriba bitabareeteire kungarukira, mwagumizamu nimutwaza okwanyu, mutaikirizana naanye
en: And if ye will not be reformed by me by these things, but will walk contrary unto me;

rr: naanye ndyatwaza okwangye, ndekye kwikirizana naimwe; kandi nyowe ndyabeeteerera emirundi mushanju, nimbatura ebibi byanyu.
en: then will I also walk contrary unto you, and will punish you yet seven times for your sins.

rr: Ndyabareetaho rurara, ehoore enzigu y'okwita endagaano yangye; kandi ku murihungira omu ndembo zaanyu, ndyabooherereza orufu, mbaheyo omu mikono y'abazigu.
en: And I will bring a sword upon you, that shall avenge the quarrel of my covenant: and when ye are gathered together within your cities, I will send the pestilence among you; and ye shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.

rr: Ku ndihenda enkoni ei mwegamiire, nibyo by'okurya byanyu, abakazi ikumi baryateeka eby'okurya byanyu omu nyungu emwe babibarengyera; muryarya, kwonka timurihaaga.
en: And when I have broken the staff of your bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver you your bread again by weight: and ye shall eat, and not be satisfied.

rr: Ebyo byona ku biriba bitabareeterire kumpurira, mwagumizamu nimutwaza okwanyu, mutaikirizana naanye
en: And if ye will not for all this hearken unto me, but walk contrary unto me;

rr: naanye ndyatwaza okwangye mbainiire ekiniga, mbabonabonese emirundi mushanju, nimbatura ebibi byanyu.
en: then I will walk contrary unto you also in fury; and I, even I, will chastise you seven times for your sins.

rr: Muryarya batabani baanyu na bahara baanyu.
en: And ye shall eat the flesh of your sons, and the flesh of your daughters shall ye eat.

rr: Kandi ndyacwekyereza emyanya yaanyu mikuru ey'okuramizamu, nteme ebyoterero byanyu by'obubaane, mbiiheho, nnagye emitumbi yaanyu aha mitumbi y'ebishushani byanyu; kandi omutima gwangye guryabatamirwa kimwe.
en: And I will destroy your high places, and cut down your images, and cast your carcases upon the carcases of your idols, and my soul shall abhor you.

rr: Endembo zaanyu ndyazihindura amatongo, n'emyanya yaanyu erikwera ngihindure emishaka; tindihurira kutaamirana k'emigaju yaanyu.
en: And I will make your cities waste, and bring your sanctuaries unto desolation, and I will not smell the savour of your sweet odours.

rr: Ndyahindura ensi yaanyu amatongo, kitangaaze abazigu baanyu abariba bagitwiremu.
en: And I will bring the land into desolation: and your enemies which dwell therein shall be astonished at it.

rr: Ndyabataataanisiza omu mahanga, nsyoreyo rurara, ngibakuratse, ensi yaanyu eryaba amatongo, n'endembo zaanyu zibe emishaka.
en: And I will scatter you among the heathen, and will draw out a sword after you: and your land shall be desolate, and your cities waste.

rr: Obunaku bwona obu egyo nsi erimara eri amatongo, eryashemerererwa sabato zaayo, mukiri omu nsi y'abazigu; obwo nibwo ensi eriruhuuka, ekashemerererwa sabato zaayo.
en: Then shall the land enjoy her sabbaths, as long as it lieth desolate, and ye be in your enemies' land; even then shall the land rest, and enjoy her sabbaths.

rr: Obunaku bwona obu erimara eri amatongo, eryahuumura, okuhuumura oku etaratungiire mu sabato zaanyu mukigirimu.
en: As long as it lieth desolate it shall rest; because it did not rest in your sabbaths, when ye dwelt upon it.

rr: -11 ; . Abariba baahonokireho omuriimwe, ndyabahahaariza emitima omu nsi y'abazigu baabo; baryakangwa ekibabi ekirikuhuuhwa omuyaga, bahungye, nk'oku omuntu ahunga rurara; bagwe hataine obabingire.
en: And upon them that are left alive of you I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies; and the sound of a shaken leaf shall chase them; and they shall flee, as fleeing from a sword; and they shall fall when none pursueth.

rr: Baryagwa nibaribatiirirana, nk'abarikuhunga rurara, haza hataine obabingire; timurigira garwanisa bazigu baanyu.
en: And they shall fall one upon another, as it were before a sword, when none pursueth: and ye shall have no power to stand before your enemies.

rr: Muryahwerekyererera omu mahanga; ensi y'abazigu baanyu ebamareho.
en: And ye shall perish among the heathen, and the land of your enemies shall eat you up.

rr: Abariba baahonokireho omuriimwe baryahwererera omu nsi y'abazigu baanyu ahabw'okutahikiirira kwabo; kandi ahabw'okutahikiirira kwa baishenkurubo, baryahwerera nkabo.
en: And they that are left of you shall pine away in their iniquity in your enemies' lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers shall they pine away with them.

rr: Kwonka ku baryatura okutahikiirira kwabo n'okwa baishenkurubo omu kucumura oku bancumwireho, bakaikiriza emitwarize yaabo ku etaraikirizaine n'eyangye
en: If they shall confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, with their trespass which they trespassed against me, and that also they have walked contrary unto me;

rr: ku nikyo kyandeeteire kutwaza okwangye nkabarwanisa, nkabareeta omu nsi y'abazigu baabo; omu bunaku obwo emitima yaabo etashazirwe ku eryecureeza, baikiriza ekifubiro ky'okutahikiirira kwabo
en: and that I also have walked contrary unto them, and have brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised hearts be humbled, and they then accept of the punishment of their iniquity:

rr: naanye obwo ndyaijuka endagaano yaangye na Yakobo, n'ei naaragaine na Isaaka, kandi n'ei naaragaine na Abrahamu; n'egyo nsi ndyagiijuka.
en: then will I remember my covenant with Jacob, and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham will I remember; and I will remember the land.

rr: Kwonka ensi yaabo baryaba batagirimu, eshemerererwe sabato zaayo, omu bunaku bwona obu erimara eri amatongo batagirimu; baikirize ekifubiro ky'okutahikiirira kwabo, ahabw'okuba bakanga emigyenzo yangye ei naataireho, n'emitima yaabo yaayangira kimwe ebiragiro byangye.
en: The land also shall be left of them, and shall enjoy her sabbaths, while she lieth desolate without them: and they shall accept of the punishment of their iniquity: because, even because they despised my judgments, and because their soul abhorred my statutes.

rr: Kwonka n'obu kiriba kiri kityo, ku bariba bari omu nsi y'abazigu baabo, tindibanaga, kandi tindibangira kimwe kubacwekyereza nkabamaraho, nkaita endagaano yangye nabo; ahakuba ndi MUKAMA Ruhanga waabo
en: And yet for all that, when they be in the land of their enemies, I will not cast them away, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break my covenant with them: for I am the LORD their God.

rr: kureka ahabwabo ndyaijuka endagaano ei naaragaine na baishenkurubo, abu naihire omu nsi ya Misri omu maisho g'amahanga, kuba Ruhanga waabo. Niinye MUKAMA.
en: But I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the heathen, that I might be their God: I am the LORD .

rr: Ebyo nibyo biragiro ebyatairweho n'emigyenzo n'ebindi biragiro ebi MUKAMA yaataire ahagati ye n'Abaisraeli, naabigambira aha rushozi Sinai, naaraba omuri Musa.
en: These are the statutes and judgments and laws, which the LORD made between him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai by the hand of Moses.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Gambira Abaisraeli ebigambo ebi. Omuntu ku ariraganisa kuhongyera MUKAMA empongano y'omutaano yaahonga abantu, abo bantu baryaba aba MUKAMA nk'oku oribabariirira
en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When a man shall make a singular vow, the persons shall be for the LORD by thy estimation.

rr: obariirire omushaija okuruga aha myaka makumi abiri okuhika ahari makumi mukaaga, omucwe shekeli z'efeeza makumi ataano, nka shekeli ey'Omwanya ogurikwera oku eri.
en: And thy estimation shall be of the male from twenty years old even unto sixty years old, even thy estimation shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.

rr: Ku ariba ari omukazi, omucwe shekeli makumi ashatu.
en: And if it be a female, then thy estimation shall be thirty shekels.

rr: Ku ariba ari omwana ow'emyaka etaano okuhika ahari makumi abiri, yaaba ari omwojo omucwe shekeli makumi abiri; ku ariba ari omwishiki, omucwe ikumi.
en: And if it be from five years old even unto twenty years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.

rr: Ku ariba ari omwana muto ow'okwezi kumwe okuhika aha myaka etaano, yaaba ari omwojo omucwe shekeli z'efeeza itaano; ku ariba ari omwishiki, omucwe shekeli z'efeeza ishatu.
en: And if it be from a month old even unto five years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male five shekels of silver, and for the female thy estimation shall be three shekels of silver.

rr: Kandi ku ariba ahikize emyaka makumi mukaaga n'okukiraho, yaaba ari omushaija, omucwe shekeli ikumi na itaano; ku ariba ari omukazi omucwe shekeli ikumi.
en: And if it be from sixty years old and above; if it be a male, then thy estimation shall be fifteen shekels, and for the female ten shekels.

rr: -4 ; Kwonka kiraganisa ku ariba ari omworo, otarikubaasa kuha eki acwereirwe, aryareeta empongano aha munyamurwa, nawe amucwere; omunyamurwa amucwere nk'oku kiraganisa arikubaasa kuha.
en: But if he be poorer than thy estimation, then he shall present himself before the priest, and the priest shall value him; according to his ability that vowed shall the priest value him.

rr: Eki yaaraganisa ku kiriba kiri enyamaishwa ey'omu nganda ezihongyerwa MUKAMA, yoona ey'omuri ezo nganda ei omuntu ahongyera MUKAMA, eryaba erikwera.
en: And if it be a beast, whereof men bring an offering unto the LORD , all that any man giveth of such unto the LORD shall be holy.

rr: Atarigira ekindi kyona eki yaaha omu mwanya gwayo, n'obu kwakuba okugihingisa, enungi omu mwanya gw'embi, nari embi omu mwanya gw'enungi; ku arigihingisa enyamaishwa ngyenzi yaayo, ei araganiise, n'ei yaagihinga, zombi ziryaba ezirikwera.
en: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good: and if he shall at all change beast for beast, then it and the exchange thereof shall be holy.

rr: Ku ariba araganiise enyamaishwa erikuzira, etari y'omu nganda ezihongyerwa MUKAMA, kiraganisa agitwarire omunyamurwa
en: And if it be any unclean beast, of which they do not offer a sacrifice unto the LORD , then he shall present the beast before the priest:

rr: omunyamurwa agicwere obuguzi nk'oburungi nari obubi bwayo oku buri; nk'oku iwe omunyamurwa origicwera, obuguzi bwayo nikwo buriba.
en: and the priest shall value it, whether it be good or bad: as thou valuest it, who art the priest, so shall it be.

rr: Kwonka kiraganisa ku aryenda kugicungura, ayongyere aha buguzi obu ecwereirwe ekicweka kimwe kya kataano.
en: But if he will at all redeem it, then he shall add a fifth part thereof unto thy estimation.

rr: Omuntu ku arihayo enju ye kuba eyereziibwe MUKAMA, omunyamurwa agicwere obuguzi nk'oburungi bwayo nari obubi bwayo oku buri; nk'oku omunyamurwa arigicwera, obuguzi bwayo nikwo buriba.
en: And when a man shall sanctify his house to be holy unto the LORD , then the priest shall estimate it, whether it be good or bad: as the priest shall estimate it, so shall it stand.

rr: Kandi ogihaireyo ku aryenda kugyecungurira, ayongyereho ekicweka kimwe kya kataano eky'obuguzi obu ecwereirwe, ebone kuba eye.
en: And if he that sanctified it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be his.

rr: Omuntu ku arihayo ahari MUKAMA ekicweka ky'eitaka ery'omu butaka bwe, oricwere obuguzi noihirira aha bwingi bw'embibo za sayiri ezishemereire kuhingwamu; homeri y'embibo za sayiri ecwerwe shekeli z'efeeza makumi ataano.
en: And if a man shall sanctify unto the LORD some part of a field of his possession, then thy estimation shall be according to the seed thereof: an homer of barley seed shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.

rr: Ku arihayo omusiri gwe ahari MUKAMA, atandikire aha mwaka gwa jubili, obuguzi bw'omusiri ogwo buryaba nk'oku ogucwereire.
en: If he sanctify his field from the year of jubile, according to thy estimation it shall stand.

rr: Kwonka ku ariguhayo bwanyima ya jubili, omunyamurwa abariirire obuguzi bwagwo, naihirira aha myaka eriba etsigaireyo okuhitsya aha gundi mwaka gwa jubili; bacwe aha buguzi bwagwo nk'oku oribariirira.
en: But if he sanctify his field after the jubile, then the priest shall reckon unto him the money according to the years that remain, even unto the year of the jubile, and it shall be abated from thy estimation.

rr: Kandi oriba ahaireyo omusiri ku aryenda kugwecungurira, ayongyereho ekicweka kimwe kya kataano eky'obuguzi obu ogucwereire, gubone kuba ogwe buzima.
en: And if he that sanctified the field will in any wise redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be assured to him.

rr: Kwonka ku ariba atarikwenda kwecungurira ogwo musiri, nari ku ariba yaagugurize ondiijo, guryaba a gutakicungurwa bundi.
en: And if he will not redeem the field, or if he have sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more.

rr: Kwonka ogwo musiri ku gurirekurwa omu mwaka gwa jubili, guryaguma guri ogwereziibwe MUKAMA, nk'omusiri oguhairweyo; kandi omunyamurwa abe niwe yaagutwara.
en: But the field, when it goeth out in the jubile, shall be holy unto the LORD , as a field devoted; the possession thereof shall be the priest's.

rr: Omuntu ku arihayo omusiri ogu yaaguzire ogutari gw'omu butaka bwe
en: And if a man sanctify unto the LORD a field which he hath bought, which is not of the fields of his possession;

rr: omunyamurwa abariirire obuguzi bwagwo okuhitsya aha mwaka gwa jubili; omuntu ogwo ahe obuguzi obu gucwereirwe aha izooba eryo, gube ekintu ekyereziibwe MUKAMA.
en: then the priest shall reckon unto him the worth of thy estimation, even unto the year of the jubile: and he shall give thine estimation in that day, as a holy thing unto the LORD .

rr: Omu mwaka gwa jubili omusiri ogwo guryagarukira ou baaguguzireho, ou gwashangirwe guri omu butaka bwe obw'empungurirano.
en: In the year of the jubile the field shall return unto him of whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land did belong .

rr: Obuguzi bwona obu oricwa buryabarwa omuri shekeli ez'Omwanya ogurikwera; kandi shekeli emwe neingana geera makumi abiri.
en: And all thy estimations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs shall be the shekel.

rr: Kwonka emijigaijo y'enyamaishwa, eshangwa eba eya MUKAMA, ahakuba n'emijigaijo, hatarigira omuntu owaagihayo; yaaba nte, yaaba ntaama, n'eya MUKAMA.
en: Only the firstling of the beasts, which should be the LORD 's firstling, no man shall sanctify it; whether it be ox, or sheep: it is the LORD 's.

rr: Ku guriba guri ogw'enyamaishwa erikuzira, agucunguze obuguzi obu oricwa, ayongyereho ekicweka kyabwo kimwe kya kataano; nari ku eriba etacungwirwe, etundwe nk'obuguzi bwayo obu oricwa oku buri.
en: And if it be of an unclean beast, then he shall redeem it according to thine estimation, and shall add a fifth part of it thereto: or if it be not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to thy estimation.

rr: Kwonka tihariho kintu ekihairweyo kyona eki omuntu arihayo ahari MUKAMA, ahari byona ebi aine, yaaba muntu, nari enyamaishwa, nari ekibanja kye ky'empungurirano, ekiritundwa, nari ekiricungurwa; ekintu kyona ekihairweyo n'ekyeziibwe munonga ahabwa MUKAMA.
en: Notwithstanding no devoted thing, that a man shall devote unto the LORD of all that he hath, both of man and beast, and of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed: every devoted thing is most holy unto the LORD .

rr: Hatarigira omuntu weena ohairweyo ahabw'okucwerwa abantu orubanja rw'okufa, owaacungurwa, kureka aitwe. Ebiragiro by'ekicweka kimwe kya ikumi
en: None devoted, which shall be devoted of men, shall be redeemed; but shall surely be put to death.

rr: Aha bimezire omu itaka, yaaba myaka y'omu misiri, nari ebijuma by'emiti, ekicweka kimwe kya ikumi kyona ekyabyo n'ekya MUKAMA; n'ebyereziibwe MUKAMA.
en: And all the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land, or of the fruit of the tree, is the LORD 's: it is holy unto the LORD .

rr: Omuntu ku aryenda kugira eki yaacungura omuri ebyo bicweka bya ikumi, ayongyereho ekicweka kimwe kya kataano ky'obuguzi bwabyo.
en: And if a man will at all redeem ought of his tithes, he shall add thereto the fifth part thereof.

rr: Ekicweka kimwe kya ikumi ky'amasyo g'ente nari ag'entaama, buri nyamaishwa ya ikumi ahari ezo eziriba niziraba ahansi y'enkoni y'omuriisa, eryaba eyereziibwe MUKAMA.
en: And concerning the tithe of the herd, or of the flock, even of whatsoever passeth under the rod, the tenth shall be holy unto the LORD .

rr: Omuntu ataryetegyereza kureeba yaaba eri nungi nari mbi, kandi atarigihingisa; kwonka ku arigihingisa, eyaahingwa n'eyaahingisibwa, zombi ziryaba ezirikwera; zitaricungurwa.
en: He shall not search whether it be good or bad, neither shall he change it: and if he change it at all, then both it and the change thereof shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.

rr: Ebyo nibyo biragiro ebi MUKAMA yaaragiriire Musa aha rushozi Sinai kubigambira Abaisraeli.
en: These are the commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses for the children of Israel in mount Sinai.

rr: 1 Abantu baingi bakateeraho kuhandiika ebyabaireho ebyakozirwe omuriitwe
en: 1 Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us,

rr: 2 nk'oku twabigambiirwe abaabyereebeire butunu, bari abaheereza b'ekigambo kya Ruhanga okuruga obu byatandika.
en: 2 even as they delivered them unto us, which from the beginning were eyewitnesses, and ministers of the word;
3 it seemed good to me also, having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first, to write unto thee in order, most excellent Theophilus,

rr: 4 ngu obone kumanya gye amazima g'ebyo ebi waayegyesiibwe.
en: 4 that thou mightest know the certainty of those things, wherein thou hast been instructed.

rr: 5 Omu busingye bwa Heroode omugabe w'Abayudaaya hakaba hariho omunyamurwa, eiziina rye Zaakaria, ow'omu kicweka kya Abiya; kandi akaba aine omukazi ow'omu baijurukuru ba Arooni, eiziina rye Elizaabeesi.
en: 5 There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judæa, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the course of Abia: and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elisabeth.

rr: 6 Kandi bombi bakaba bari abahikiriire omu maisho ga Ruhanga, nibagyendera omu biragiro byona n'omu migyenzo yoona ebya Mukama bataine kamogo.
en: 6 And they were both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless.

rr: 7 Kwonka bakaba bataine mwana, ahakuba Elizaabeesi akaba ari engumba, kandi bombi bakaba bakuzire munonga.
en: 7 And they had no child, because that Elisabeth was barren, and they both were now well stricken in years.

rr: 8 Ku yaabaire naakora omurimo gw'obunyamurwa omu maisho ga Ruhanga omu rubu rw'ekicweka kye
en: 8 And it came to pass, that while he executed the priest's office before God in the order of his course,

rr: 9 nk'emicwe y'obunayamurwa oku yaabaire eri, yaakwatwa enteenyu kuza kwotera # 1:9 Obubaane n'amababi agu booteza, gakataamirana gye. obubaane omuri hekalu.
en: 9 according to the custom of the priest's office, his lot was to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord.

rr: 10 Kandi omutwe gw'abantu gwona gukaba nigushabira aheeru omu shaaha egye ey'okwotereramu obubaane.
en: 10 And the whole multitude of the people were praying without at the time of incense.

rr: 11 Maraika wa Mukama yaamweyoreka, ayemereire aha rubaju rwa buryo rw'eitambiro ry'okwotereraho obubaane.
en: 11 And there appeared unto him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense.

rr: 12 Zaakaria ku yaamureebire, yaayekanga, yaatiina munonga.
en: 12 And when Zacharias saw him , he was troubled, and fear fell upon him.

rr: 13 Kwonka maraika yaamuhuumuriza, ati: Zaakaria, otatiina, ahakuba okushaba kwawe kuhuriirwe, Elizaabeesi omukazi waawe aryakuzaarira omwana w'omwojo, kandi oryamweta eiziina Yohaana.
en: 13 But the angel said unto him, Fear not, Zacharias: for thy prayer is heard; and thy wife Elisabeth shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name John.

rr: 14 Oryashemererwa oyesiime
en: 14 And thou shalt have joy and gladness; and many shall rejoice at his birth.
15 For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink; and he shall be filled with the Holy Ghost, even from his mother's womb.

rr: 16 Baingi omu Baisraeli aryabahindura, abagarure ahari Mukama Ruhanga waabo.
en: 16 And many of the children of Israel shall he turn to the Lord their God.

17 And he shall go before him in the spirit and power of Elias, to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to make ready a people prepared for the Lord.

rr: 18 Zaakaria yaabuuza maraika ati: Ekyo ndyakimanya nta ku kiri eky'amazima; ahabw'okuba ndi omugurusi, kandi n'omukazi wangye n'omukaikuru munonga.
en: 18 And Zacharias said unto the angel, Whereby shall I know this? for I am an old man, and my wife well stricken in years.
19 And the angel answering said unto him, I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of God; and am sent to speak unto thee, and to shew thee these glad tidings.

rr: 20 Mbwenu noija kuhunama, toribaasa kugamba, okuhitsya obu ebigambo ebi biribaho; ahabw'okuba tiwaikiriza ebi naakugambira, ebirihikiirizibwa omu bunaku bwabyo.
en: 20 And, behold, thou shalt be dumb, and not able to speak, until the day that these things shall be performed, because thou believest not my words, which shall be fulfilled in their season.

rr: 21 Kandi abantu abaabaire bategyereize Zaakaria, baatangaarira oku yaasiiba omuri hekalu.
en: 21 And the people waited for Zacharias, and marvelled that he tarried so long in the temple.

rr: 22 Ku yaashohoire, tiyaabaasa kugamba nabo; baamanya ku yaareeba okworekwa omuri hekalu; yaaguma naabagambisisa engaro, agobirwe orurimi.
en: 22 And when he came out, he could not speak unto them: and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple: for he beckoned unto them, and remained speechless.

rr: 23 Obunaku bw'okuheereza kwe ku bahweire, yaagaruka omuka.
en: 23 And it came to pass, that, as soon as the days of his ministration were accomplished, he departed to his own house.

rr: 24 Ebiro ebyo ku byahingwireho, Elizaabeesi yaagira enda, yaamara ameezi ataano ayesherekire, naagira ati
en: 24 And after those days his wife Elisabeth conceived, and hid herself five months, saying,
25 Thus hath the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on me , to take away my reproach among men.

rr: 26 Omu kwezi kwa mukaaga maraika Gaburieli akatumwa Ruhanga omuri tauni ya Galilaaya erikwetwa Nazareesi
en: 26 And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,
27 to a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David; and the virgin's name was Mary.

rr: 28 Gaburieli yaija ah'ari, yaamugambira ati: Shemererwa, iwe orikukundwa munonga! Mukama ari naiwe.
en: 28 And the angel came in unto her, and said, Hail, thou that art highly favoured, the Lord is with thee: blessed art thou among women.

rr: 29 We yaayekanga munonga ahabw'ekigambo ekyo, naateekateeka okuramutsya okwo oku kuri.
en: 29 And when she saw him , she was troubled at his saying, and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be.

rr: 30 Maraika yaamuhuumuriza naagira ati: Otatiina, Mariamu, ahabw'okuba otungire obuganzi ahari Ruhanga.
en: 30 And the angel said unto her, Fear not, Mary: for thou hast found favour with God.
31 And, behold, thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a son, and shalt call his name JESUS.
32 He shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Highest: and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David:
33 and he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever; and of his kingdom there shall be no end.

rr: 34 Mariamu yaabuuza maraika ati: Ekyo kiryabaasika kita, ka ntaine mushaija?
en: 34 Then said Mary unto the angel, How shall this be, seeing I know not a man?

rr: 35 Maraika yaamugarukamu ati
en: 35 And the angel answered and said unto her, The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee: therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God.

rr: 36 Kandi reeba, muhara waanyu Elizaabeesi nawe aine enda y'omwana w'omwojo omu bukaikuru bwe; owaabaire naayetwa engumba hati aine ameezi mukaaga.
en: 36 And, behold, thy cousin Elisabeth, she hath also conceived a son in her old age: and this is the sixth month with her, who was called barren.

rr: 37 # 1:37 nari: Ahabw'okuba tihariho kigambo kya Ruhanga ekibura amaani. Ahabw'okuba tihariho ekirema Ruhanga.
en: 37 For with God nothing shall be impossible.

rr: 38 Mariamu yaagira ati: Reeba, ndi omuzaana wa Mukama; kimbeho nk'oku waagamba. Maraika yaamutsigaho, yaagyenda.
en: 38 And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.

rr: 39 Omu biro ebyo Mariamu yaimuka, yaayehuuta, yaaza omu nsi y'ebibungo omuri tauni ya Buyudaaya
en: 39 And Mary arose in those days, and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Juda;

rr: 40 yaataaha owa Zaakaria, yaaramutsya Elizaabeesi.
en: 40 and entered into the house of Zacharias, and saluted Elisabeth.

rr: 41 Elizaabeesi, ku yaahuriire okuramutsya kwa Mariamu, omwana yaagurukaguruka omu nda ye; Elizaabeesi yaijura Omwoyo Orikwera
en: 41 And it came to pass, that, when Elisabeth heard the salutation of Mary, the babe leaped in her womb; and Elisabeth was filled with the Holy Ghost:

rr: 42 yaagamba n'eiraka rihango ati: Omu bakazi boona niiwe ohairwe omugisha, n'omwa w'omu nda yaawe ahairwe omugisha!
en: 42 and she spake out with a loud voice, and said, Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb.

rr: 43 Nyowe eki kyandugira hi nyina wa Mukama wangye okuntaayaayira?
en: 43 And whence is this to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

rr: 44 Reeba ku naahurira eiraka ry'okuramutsya kwawe, omwana yaagurukaguruka omu nda yangye ahabw'okushemererwa.
en: 44 For, lo, as soon as the voice of thy salutation sounded in mine ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy.

rr: 45 Kandi ohairwe omugisha, iwe owaikiriize ku ebi waagambiirwe Mukama birihikiirizibwa.
en: 45 And blessed is she that believed: for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord.
46 And Mary said,

rr: 47 N'omutima gwangye nigushemerererwa Ruhanga Omujuni wangye
en: 47 And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.

rr: 48 Ahabw'okuba areebire obucureezi bw'omuzaana we.
en: 48 For he hath regarded the low estate of his handmaiden:

rr: 49 Ahakuba Ow'obushoboorozi ankoreire bikuru
en: 49 For he that is mighty hath done to me great things;
50 And his mercy is on them that fear him
51 He hath shewed strength with his arm;
52 He hath put down the mighty from their seats,
53 He hath filled the hungry with good things;

rr: 54 Ahwereire Israeli omugaragwa we
en: 54 He hath holpen his servant Israel,

rr: 55 Ezi yaaraganiise Abrahamu n'oruzaaro rwe ebiro n'ebiro
en: 55 As he spake to our fathers,

rr: 56 Okuruga aho Mariamu yaamara ameezi nk'ashatu na Elizaabeesi; bwanyima yaagaruka owaabo.
en: 56 And Mary abode with her about three months, and returned to her own house.

rr: 57 Obunaku bwa Elizaabeesi bw'okuzaara bwahika, yaazaara omwana w'omwojo.
en: 57 Now Elisabeth's full time came that she should be delivered; and she brought forth a son.

rr: 58 Batabani be na beene waabo baahurira ku Mukama amugiriire embabazi, baashemererwa hamwe nawe.
en: 58 And her neighbours and her cousins heard how the Lord had shewed great mercy upon her; and they rejoiced with her.

rr: 59 Aha kiro kya munaana baija kushara omwana; bakaba nibenda kumweta Zaakaria, nibamweterera ishe
en: 59 And it came to pass, that on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child; and they called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.

rr: 60 kwonka nyina yaayanga, naagira ati: Tikwo; ayetwe Yohaana.
en: 60 And his mother answered and said, Not so ; but he shall be called John.

rr: 61 Baamugarukamu bati: Omuri beene waanyu tihariho n'omwe orikwetwa eiziina eryo.
en: 61 And they said unto her, There is none of thy kindred that is called by this name.

rr: 62 Baabuuzisa ishe engaro oku arikwenda kumweta.
en: 62 And they made signs to his father, how he would have him called.

rr: 63 Yaashaba eky'okuhandiikaho; yaahandiika ati, Eiziina rye ni Yohaana. Boona baatangaara.
en: 63 And he asked for a writing table, and wrote, saying, His name is John. And they marvelled all.

rr: 64 Ahonaaho akanwa ke kaiguka, n'orurimi rwe rwakomoroka, yaagamba naahimbisa Ruhanga.
en: 64 And his mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue loosed , and he spake, and praised God.

rr: 65 Bataahi baabo boona baagira obwoba; n'ebigambo ebyo byona byabuga omu nsi y'ebibungo ebya Buyudaaya.
en: 65 And fear came on all that dwelt round about them: and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judæa.

rr: 66 Abaabihuriire boona baabitaasya omu mitima yaabo, nibeebuuza bati: Mbwenu omwana ogu aryaba ata?
en: 66 And all they that heard them laid them up in their hearts, saying, What manner of child shall this be!

rr: Ahakuba buzima omukono gwa Mukama gukaba guri hamwe nawe.
en: And the hand of the Lord was with him.

rr: 67 Bwanyima Zaakaria ishe yaijura Omwoyo Orikwera, yaahanuura naagira ati
en: 67 And his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Ghost, and prophesied, saying,

rr: 68 Mukama Ruhanga wa Israeli ahimbisibwe
en: 68 Blessed be the Lord God of Israel;
69 And hath raised up an horn of salvation for us

rr: 70 (Nk'oku yaagambire naaraba omuri baanabi be abarikwera
en: 70 As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets, which have been since the world began:

rr: 71 Okutujuna abazigu baitu
en: 71 That we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us;
72 To perform the mercy promised to our fathers,
73 The oath which he sware to our father Abraham,
74 That he would grant unto us, that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies

rr: 75 Turi abarikwera kandi abahikiriire omu maisho ge
en: 75 In holiness and righteousness before him, all the days of our life.
76 And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest:
77 To give knowledge of salvation unto his people
78 Through the tender mercy of our God;
79 To give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death,

rr: 80 Bwanyima omwana yaakura, yaayeyongyera amaani omu mutima; kandi yaaguma omu ihamba okuhitsya aha kiro eki yaayorekyeirweho Abaisraeli.
en: 80 And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, and was in the deserts till the day of his shewing unto Israel.

rr: 1 Omu biro ebyo ekiragiro kikaruga ahari Kaisaari Augusto, nikiragiira ab'omu nsi yoona okwehandiikisa.
en: 1 And it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from Cæsar Augustus, that all the world should be taxed.

rr: 2 Okuhandiikwa okwo nikwo kw'okubanza okwabaireho, Kureenio naategyeka Siria.
en: 2 ( And this taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria.)

rr: 3 Abantu boona baaza kwehandiikisa, buri muntu omuri tauni y'owaabo.
en: 3 And all went to be taxed, every one into his own city.

rr: 4 Na Yosefu yaaruga Galilaaya omuri tauni ya Nazareesi, yaataaha Buyudaaya omu rurembo rwa Daudi orurikwetwa Betelehemu, ahabw'okuba akaba ari ow'omuryango gw'oruganda rwa Daudi
en: 4 And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judæa, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:)

rr: 5 yaaza kwehandiikisa na Mariamu, ou yaabaire naagamba obugyenyi, aine enda.
en: 5 to be taxed with Mary his espoused wife, being great with child.

rr: 6 Ku baabaire bakiri okwo, obunaku bwe bw'okuzaara bwahika
en: 6 And so it was, that, while they were there, the days were accomplished that she should be delivered.
7 And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.

rr: 8 Omu nsi egyo hakaba harimu abariisa abaabaire batuura omu ishwa, nibarinda amasyo gaabo nyekiro.
en: 8 And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.

rr: 9 Haija maraika wa Mukama, yaayemerera haihi nabo, ekitiinisa kya Mukama kyabeehinguririza nikimurinkana, baatiina munonga.
en: 9 And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.

rr: 10 Maraika yaabagira ati: Mutatiina; ahakuba mbareeteire ebigambo birungi eby'okushemererwa kwingi, okurihika aha bantu boona
en: 10 And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.

rr: 11 ahabw'okuba eki kiro Omujuni yaabazaarirwa omu rurembo rwa Daudi, niwe Kristo Mukama waitu.
en: 11 For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.

rr: 12 Aha niho muraabimanyire; nimwija kushanga omwana w'omwereere, ashwekirwe omu twenda tw'obwereere, abyamiibwe omu kihongore.
en: 12 And this shall be a sign unto you; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.

rr: 13 Ahonaaho hamwe na maraika ogwo haabaho omutwe gw'engabo z'omu iguru, nizihimbisa Ruhanga, nizigira ziti
en: 13 And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God, and saying,
14 Glory to God in the highest,

rr: 15 Bwanyima baamaraika ku baarugireho, baagaruka omu iguru, abariisa baagambirana bati: Mwije tuze Betelehemu, tureebe ekibaireyo, eki Mukama yaatumanyisa.
en: 15 And it came to pass, as the angels were gone away from them into heaven, the shepherds said one to another, Let us now go even unto Bethlehem, and see this thing which is come to pass, which the Lord hath made known unto us.

rr: 16 Baagyenda nibeehuuta, baashanga Mariamu na Yosefu, n'omwana w'omwereere abyami omu kihongore.
en: 16 And they came with haste, and found Mary, and Joseph, and the babe lying in a manger.

rr: 17 Ku baamureebire, baabateekyerereza ebi baagambirwa aha mwana ogwo.
en: 17 And when they had seen it , they made known abroad the saying which was told them concerning this child.

rr: 18 Abaabihuriire boona baatangaarira ebi baagambirwa abariisa.
en: 18 And all they that heard it wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds.
19 But Mary kept all these things, and pondered them in her heart.

rr: 20 Abariisa baagarukayo, nibahimbisa Ruhanga, nibamusiimira ebigambo byona ebi baahurira, n'ebi baareeba, nk'oku baabigambirwa.
en: 20 And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told unto them.

rr: 21 Ebiro munaana ku byahingwireho, yaashwarwa, yaayetwa eiziina Yesu, riri eryagambirwe maraika, nyina atakagizire nda ye.
en: 21 And when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child, his name was called JESUS, which was so named of the angel before he was conceived in the womb.
22 And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were accomplished, they brought him to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord;
23 (as it is written in the law of the Lord, Every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the Lord;)
24 and to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.
25 And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Ghost was upon him.

rr: 26 Akaba ashuuruuriirwe Omwoyo Orikwera ku atarifa atakareebire Kristo wa Mukama.
en: 26 And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Ghost, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord's Christ.

rr: 27 Yaatwarwa Omwoyo omuri hekalu; abazaire ba Yesu ku baamutaahizemu, ngu bamukorere nk'emigyenzo y'Ebiragiro oku eri
en: 27 And he came by the Spirit into the temple: and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, to do for him after the custom of the law,

rr: 28 Simeoni ogwo yaamukiikira omu mikono ye, yaahimbisa Ruhanga naagira ati
en: 28 then took he him up in his arms, and blessed God, and said,

rr: 29 Mukama wangye, mbwenu waaza kureka omwiru waawe agyende n'obusingye
en: 29 Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace,

rr: 30 Ahakuba amaisho gangye gaareeba okujuna kwawe
en: 30 For mine eyes have seen thy salvation,

rr: 31 Oku waateekateekyeire omu maisho g'abantu boona
en: 31 Which thou hast prepared before the face of all people;
32 A light to lighten the Gentiles,

rr: 33 Ishe na nyina baatangaarira ebyamugambwaho
en: 33 And Joseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken of him.
34 And Simeon blessed them, and said unto Mary his mother, Behold, this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel; and for a sign which shall be spoken against;

rr: 35 ngu ebiteekateeko by'omu mitima ya baingi bishuuruurwe; (naiwe rurara eryakucumita omu mutima.)
en: 35 (yea, a sword shall pierce through thy own soul also,) that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.

rr: 36 Kandi hakaba hariho n'omukazi nabi, eiziina rye Anaa, muhara wa Fanueli, ow'omu ruganda rwa Asheri, owaabaire ari omukaikuru munonga; ku yaashweirwe, yaamara na iba emyaka mushanju
en: 36 And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser: she was of a great age, and had lived with an husband seven years from her virginity;

rr: 37 bwanyima yaamara endiijo myaka makumi munaana n'ena ari omufaakazi. Omukazi ogwo akaba ataruga omuri hakalu, aramya Ruhanga, naayesiibyakwo, kandi naashaba nyomushana na nyekoro.
en: 37 and she was a widow of about fourscore and four years, which departed not from the temple, but served God with fastings and prayers night and day.
38 And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord, and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem.

rr: 39 Abazaire ba Yesu, ku baaherize kuhikiiriza byona eby'omu biragiro bya Mukama, baagaruka Galilaaya omuri tauni y'owaabo Nazareesi.
en: 39 And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.

rr: 40 Omwana yaakura, yaaguma naayeyongyera amaani, naijura obwengye, kandi embabazi za Ruhanga zaamugumaho.
en: 40 And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him.
41 Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover.

rr: 42 Ku yaahikize emyaka ikumi n'ebiri y'obukuru, bainamukayo, nk'omucwe gw'obugyenyi oku gwabaire guri.
en: 42 And when he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast.

rr: 43 Bwanyima y'ebiro by'obugyenyi, ku baabaire nibagarukayo, omwana ogwo Yesu yaatsigara Yerusaalemu.
en: 43 And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother knew not of it .

rr: 44 Abazaire be tibaakimanya; kwonka ahabw'okuteekateeka ngu yaagyenda n'omutwe gw'abo abu baabaire nibagaruka nabo, baagyenda orugyendo rw'eizooba ryona, bwanyima baamusherurira omuri beene waabo na bataahi baabo
en: 44 But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day's journey; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance.

rr: 45 ku yaababuriire, baagaruka Yerusaalemu, nibamusherura.
en: 45 And when they found him not, they turned back again to Jerusalem, seeking him.

rr: 46 Bwanyima y'ebiro bishatu, baamushanga omuri hekalu, ashutami ahagati y'abeegyesa, naabahurira, kandi naababuuza ebibuuzo
en: 46 And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.

rr: 47 abaamuhuriire boona, baatangaarira obwengye bwe n'ebi yaabaire naabagarukamu.
en: 47 And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers.

rr: 48 Abazaire be ku baamureebire, baatangaara; nyina yaamubuuza ati: Mwana wangye, ahanki otugizire oti? Reeba, nyowe na sho tukushwerwire twine obusaasi.
en: 48 And when they saw him, they were amazed: and his mother said unto him, Son, why hast thou thus dealt with us? behold, thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing.
49 And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? wist ye not that I must be about my Father's business?

rr: 50 Kwonka bo tibaashoborokyerwa kigambo ekyo eki yaabagambira.
en: 50 And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them.

rr: Luk 2:51 . Kwonka Mariamu yaarinda ebyo byona, yaaguma naabiteekateeka omu mutima.
en: 51 And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them: but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.
52 And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man.

rr: 1 Omu mwaka gwa ikumi n'etaano ogw'omu busingye bwa Tiberio Kaisaari, Pntio Pilaato obu yaabaire ari omutegyeki wa Buyudaaya, na Heroode ari ow'eishaza rya Galilaaya, n'omurumuna Filipo ari ow'eishaza rya Iturea na Tirakoniiti, na Lusania ari ow'eishaza rya Abileene
en: 1 Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Cæsar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judæa, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituræa and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene,

rr: 2 kandi Ana na Kayaafa bari abanyamurwa abakuru, ekigambo kya Ruhanga kikaizira Yohaana mwene Zaakaria omu ihamba
en: 2 Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests, the word of God came unto John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.
3 And he came into all the country about Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins;
4 as it is written in the book of the words of Esaias the prophet, saying,

rr: 5 Empanga zoona ziryaijuzibwa
en: 5 Every valley shall be filled,

rr: 6 Kandi abantu boona baryareeba okujuna kwa Ruhanga.
en: 6 And all flesh shall see the salvation of God.
7 Then said he to the multitude that came forth to be baptized of him, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

rr: 8 Mbwenu mwane ebyana ebishemereire abeeteisize, mutatandika kugamba omu mitima yaanyu ngu, Twine Abrahamu, niwe tatenkuriitwe. Ahakuba nyowe nimbagambira nti: Ruhanga naabaasa amabaare aga kugaihiramu Abrahamu abaijukuru.
en: 8 Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, That God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.

rr: 9 Na mbwenu empango etairwe aha bitsintsi by'emiti; omuti gwona ogutarikwana byana birungi guryatemwa gunagwe omu muriro.
en: 9 And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: every tree therefore which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.

rr: 10 Abantu baamubuuza bati: Mbwenu shi, tugire tuta?
en: 10 And the people asked him, saying, What shall we do then?

rr: 11 Yaabagarukamu ati: Oine amakanzu abiri, aheho otagiine; n'oine eby'okurya, nawe atwaze atyo.
en: 11 He answereth and saith unto them, He that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath meat, let him do likewise.

rr: 12 Abhooza nabo baija kubatizibwa, baamubuuza bati: Mwegyesa, itwe tugire tuta?
en: 12 Then came also publicans to be baptized, and said unto him, Master, what shall we do?

rr: 13 Yaabagarukamu ati: Mutarihooza ebirikukira ebi mwaragiirwe.
en: 13 And he said unto them, Exact no more than that which is appointed you.

rr: 14 N'abaserukare baamubuuza bati: Kandi shi itwe, tugire tuta?
en: 14 And the soldiers likewise demanded of him, saying, And what shall we do?

rr: Yaabagarukamu ati: Mutarinyaga omuntu weena ahabw'okumutwaza amaani, nari okumutabaariza eby'ebishuba; ekindi mumarwe ebihembo byanyu.
en: And he said unto them, Do violence to no man, neither accuse any falsely; and be content with your wages.
15 And as the people were in expectation, and all men mused in their hearts of John, whether he were the Christ, or not;

rr: 16 Yohaana yaabagarukamu boona naabagira ati: Buzima nyowe nimbabatiza n'amaizi: kwonka nihaija kwija Orikunkiza amaani, kandi tinshemereire n'okuyuzya orukoba rw'enkaito ze; Ogwo aryababatiza n'Omwoyo Orikwera n'omuriro.
en: 16 John answered, saying unto them all, I indeed baptize you with water; but one mightier than I cometh, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire:

rr: 17 Orugari rwe ruri omu mukono gwe, aryayeyerera gye embuga ye, ahunikye oburo omu kitara kye, kandi ebishushunga abyotsye omu muriro ogutaraara.
en: 17 whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and will gather the wheat into his garner; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable.

rr: 18 Kandi yaagaruka yaabahana ebindi bingi, naabuurira abantu ebigambo birungi.
en: 18 And many other things in his exhortation preached he unto the people.

rr: 19 Kwonka oweishaza Heroode, ku yaateisiibwe Yohaana ahabwa Herodia muka mwene ishe, n'ahabw'ebibi byona ebi Heroode yaabaire akozire
en: 19 But Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias his brother Philip's wife, and for all the evils which Herod had done,

rr: 20 ahari ebyo byona yaayongyeraho n'eki, yaata Yohaana omu kihome.
en: 20 added yet this above all, that he shut up John in prison.
21 Now when all the people were baptized, it came to pass, that Jesus also being baptized, and praying, the heaven was opened,
22 and the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.
23 And Jesus himself began to be about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) the son of Joseph, which was the son of Heli,

rr: 24 owa Mataati, owa Leevi, owa Meleki, owa Yanai, owa Yosefu
en: 24 which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi, which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Janna, which was the son of Joseph,

rr: 25 owa Matatia, owa Amosi, owa Nahumu, owa Esili, owa Nagai
en: 25 which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Amos, which was the son of Naum, which was the son of Esli, which was the son of Nagge,

rr: 26 owa Maati, owa Matatia, owa Semei, owa Yoseka, owa Yoda
en: 26 which was the son of Maath, which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Semei, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Juda,

rr: 27 owa Yohanaani, owa Reesa, owa Zerubabeeli, owa Shealatieli, owa Neri
en: 27 which was the son of Joanna, which was the son of Rhesa, which was the son of Zorobabel, which was the son of Salathiel, which was the son of Neri,

rr: 28 owa Meleki, owa Adi, owa Kosamu, owa Elemadamu, owa Eri
en: 28 which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Addi, which was the son of Cosam, which was the son of Elmodam, which was the son of Er,

rr: 29 owa Yesu, owa Elieza, owa Yorimu, owa Mataati, owa Leevi
en: 29 which was the son of Jose, which was the son of Eliezer, which was the son of Jorim, which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi,

rr: 30 owa Simeoni, owa Yuda, owa Yosefu, owa Yonamu, owa Eliakimu
en: 30 which was the son of Simeon, which was the son of Juda, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Jonan, which was the son of Eliakim,

rr: 31 owa Meleya, owa Mena, owa Matata, owa Nasani, owa Daudi
en: 31 which was the son of Melea, which was the son of Menan, which was the son of Mattatha, which was the son of Nathan, which was the son of David,
32 which was the son of Jesse, which was the son of Obed, which was the son of Booz, which was the son of Salmon, which was the son of Naasson,

rr: 33 owa Aminadabu, owa Arani, owa Hezirooni, owa Pereezi, owa Yuda
en: 33 which was the son of Aminadab, which was the son of Aram, which was the son of Esrom, which was the son of Phares, which was the son of Juda,

rr: 34 owa Yakobo, owa Isaaka, owa Abrahamu, owa Teera, owa Nahori
en: 34 which was the son of Jacob, which was the son of Isaac, which was the son of Abraham, which was the son of Thara, which was the son of Nachor,

rr: 35 owa Serugi, owa Reu, owa Pelegi, owa Eberi, owa Seela
en: 35 which was the son of Saruch, which was the son of Ragau, which was the son of Phalec, which was the son of Heber, which was the son of Sala,

rr: 36 owa Kainani, owa Arufakisaadi, owa Sheemu, owa Noa, owa Lameki
en: 36 which was the son of Cainan, which was the son of Arphaxad, which was the son of Sem, which was the son of Noe, which was the son of Lamech,

rr: 37 owa Mesuseela, owa Enoka, owa Yaredi, owa Mahalaleeli, owa Kainani
en: 37 which was the son of Mathusala, which was the son of Enoch, which was the son of Jared, which was the son of Maleleel, which was the son of Cainan,
38 which was the son of Enos, which was the son of Seth, which was the son of Adam, which was the son of God.
1 And Jesus being full of the Holy Ghost returned from Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness,

rr: 2 yaamarayo ebiro makumi ana, naayohibwa Sitaane, atarikurya ky'okurya kyona omu biro ebyo; ku byahweireho, yaagira enjara.
en: 2 being forty days tempted of the devil. And in those days he did eat nothing: and when they were ended, he afterward hungered.

rr: 3 Omwohi nikwo kumugambira ati: Ku oraabe ori Omwana wa Ruhanga, gambira eibaare eri rihindukye eby'okurya.
en: 3 And the devil said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, command this stone that it be made bread.
4 And Jesus answered him, saying, It is written, That man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.

rr: 5 Omwohi yaagaruka yaamutembya, yaamworeka obugabe bwona obw'omu nsi yoona omu mwanya mukye
en: 5 And the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.

rr: 6 yaamugira ati: Niinyija kukuha obushoboorozi obu bwona n'ekitiinisa kyabwo; ahakuba nkabuheebwa, kandi mbuheereza ou ndkunda weena.
en: 6 And the devil said unto him, All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.

rr: 7 N'ahabw'ekyo, ku oriname wandamya, bwona nibuba obwawe.
en: 7 If thou therefore wilt worship me, all shall be thine.
8 And Jesus answered and said unto him, Get thee behind me, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.

rr: 9 Bwanyima yaamwinamura Yerusaalemu, yaamuta aha itungu rya hekalu, yaamugambira ati: Ku oraabe ori Omwana wa Ruhanga, ruga aha, ogurukye oyetsimbe ahansi
en: 9 And he brought him to Jerusalem, and set him on a pinnacle of the temple, and said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down from hence:
10 for it is written, He shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee:

rr: 11 kandi ngu: Baryakukwatirira omu mikono yaabo, ngu otakaahikiza ekigyere kyawe aha ibaare.
en: 11 And in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.
12 And Jesus answering said unto him, It is said, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.
13 And when the devil had ended all the temptation, he departed from him for a season.
14 And Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee: and there went out a fame of him through all the region round about.

rr: 15 yaayegyesa omuri sinagogi zaabo, boona baamusiima.
en: 15 And he taught in their synagogues, being glorified of all.
16 And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up for to read.
17 And there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet Esaias. And when he had opened the book, he found the place where it was written,

rr: 18 Omwoyo wa Mukama ari ahariinye
en: 18 The Spirit of the Lord is upon me,

rr: 19 N'okurangira abantu omwaka gwa Mukama ogw'embabazi.
en: 19 To preach the acceptable year of the Lord .

rr: 20 Ku yaaherize kushoma, yaateerana ekitabo, yaakigarurira omuheereza, yaashutama; ab'omuri sinagogi boona baamugumyaho amaisho.
en: 20 And he closed the book, and he gave it again to the minister, and sat down. And the eyes of all them that were in the synagogue were fastened on him.

rr: 21 Yaatandika kubagambira ati: Eri izooba ebyahandiikirwe ebi byahikiirizibwa omu matu gaanyu.
en: 21 And he began to say unto them, This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears.
22 And all bare him witness, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth. And they said, Is not this Joseph's son?

rr: 23 Yaabagira ati: Timuribura kuncwera enfumu egi muti: Iwe mufumu 'we, oyetambire! Byona ebi twahuriire ngu okakorera Kaperenaumu, bikorere n'aha omu nsi yaanyu.
en: 23 And he said unto them, Ye will surely say unto me this proverb, Physician, heal thyself: whatsoever we have heard done in Capernaum, do also here in thy country.

rr: 24 Yaabagira ati: Buzimazima nimbagambira nti: Tihariho nabi oikirizibwa omu nsi y'owaabo.
en: 24 And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is accepted in his own country.
25 But I tell you of a truth, many widows were in Israel in the days of Elias, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when great famine was throughout all the land;

rr: 26 kwonka Eliya taratumirwe nangwa na hari omwe omuribo, kureka akatumwa aha mukazi omufaakazi owa Zarefaasi omu ishaza rya Sidoni.
en: 26 but unto none of them was Elias sent, save unto Sarepta, a city of Sidon, unto a woman that was a widow .
27 And many lepers were in Israel in the time of Eliseus the prophet; and none of them was cleansed, saving Naaman the Syrian.

rr: 28 Ab'omuri sinagogi boona, ku baakihuriire, baagira ekiniga kingi
en: 28 And all they in the synagogue, when they heard these things, were filled with wrath,

rr: 29 baimuka, baamubinga omuri tauni, baamutwara nibamukurubana, baamuhitsya aha nengo y'ekibungo eki baabaire bombekireho tauni yaabo, ngu bamurengyezeho, abanzeyo omutwe.
en: 29 And rose up, and thrust him out of the city, and led him unto the brow of the hill whereon their city was built, that they might cast him down headlong.

rr: 30 Kwonka We yaaboogamu, yaagyenda.
en: 30 But he passing through the midst of them went his way,
31 and came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and taught them on the sabbath days.
32 And they were astonished at his doctrine: for his word was with power.

rr: 33 Kandi omuri sinagogi egyo hakaba harimu omuntu owaabaire ariho daimoni; yaaborooga n'eiraka rihango ati
en: 33 And in the synagogue there was a man, which had a spirit of an unclean devil, and cried out with a loud voice,

rr: 34 Ai bambe! Noofa ki naitwe, iwe Yesu owa Nazareesi; oizire kutucwekyereza? Ninkumanya; ori Orikwera wa Ruhanga.
en: 34 saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art; the Holy One of God.

rr: 35 Yesu yaamugambira kubi, naagira ati: Hunama, murugyeho!
en: 35 And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him.

rr: Daimoni ku yaamuteire ahansi ahagati yaabo, yaamurugaho, ataine ki amwitsize.
en: And when the devil had thrown him in the midst, he came out of him, and hurt him not.

rr: 36 Boona baatangaara, nibabuuzana bati: Eki ni kigambo ki? Naaragiira baadaimoni n'obushoboorozi n'amaani, baarugamu.
en: 36 And they were all amazed, and spake among themselves, saying, What a word is this! for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits, and they come out.

rr: 37 Okurangaanwa kwe kwahika omu myanya yoona ehikaine n'ensi egyo.
en: 37 And the fame of him went out into every place of the country round about.
38 And he arose out of the synagogue, and entered into Simon's house. And Simon's wife's mother was taken with a great fever; and they besought him for her.

rr: 39 Yaamwemerera aha rubaju, yaakabukira omushwija, gwamurugaho; ahonaaho yaimuka, yaabaheereza.
en: 39 And he stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her: and immediately she arose and ministered unto them.

rr: 40 Eizooba ku ryabaire nirirengarenga, boona abaabaire barwarize abarwaire endwara zitari zimwe, baabamureetera; yaabataho engaro boona, yaabakiza.
en: 40 Now when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.
41 And devils also came out of many, crying out, and saying, Thou art Christ the Son of God. And he rebuking them suffered them not to speak: for they knew that he was Christ.

rr: 42 Kandi ku bwaseesire, yaarugayo, yaaza omu mwanya ogwenagire. Abantu baamusherura, baija ah'ari, baayenda kumuzibira ngu atabarugaho
en: 42 And when it was day, he departed and went into a desert place: and the people sought him, and came unto him, and stayed him, that he should not depart from them.

rr: 43 kwonka yaabagira ati: Nshemereire kubuurira ebigambo ebirungi by'obukama bwa Ruhanga omuri tauni ezindi nazo; ahabw'okuba nikyo naatumiirwe.
en: 43 And he said unto them, I must preach the kingdom of God to other cities also: for therefore am I sent.

rr: 44 Yaaguma naabuurira engiri omuri sinagogi za Galilaaya.
en: 44 And he preached in the synagogues of Galilee.
1 And it came to pass, that, as the people pressed upon him to hear the word of God, he stood by the lake of Gennesaret,

rr: 2 Yaareeba amaato abiri gari aha nkungu y'enyanja; kwonka abajubi bagarugiremu niboozya obutimba bwabo.
en: 2 and saw two ships standing by the lake: but the fishermen were gone out of them, and were washing their nets.

rr: 3 Yaaza omuri bumwe obwabaire buri obwa Simooni, yaamushaba kubwirizayo hakye okuruga aha nkungu.
en: 3 And he entered into one of the ships, which was Simon's, and prayed him that he would thrust out a little from the land.

rr: Yaabushutamamu, yaayegyesa abantu.
en: And he sat down, and taught the people out of the ship.
4 Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.

rr: 5 Simooni yaamugarukamu ati: Mwegyesa, turaire nitutega ekiro kyona, twabura eki twakwatsa. Kwonka ahabw'ekigambo kyawe, ka ntegye obutimba.
en: 5 And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net.

rr: 6 Ku baakozire ekyo, baakwatsa eby'enyanja bingi munonga, obutimba bwabo bwayenda kucweka
en: 6 And when they had this done, they inclosed a great multitude of fishes: and their net brake.

rr: 7 nikwo kwetesa bagyenzi baabo engaro bari omu bundi bwato ngu baije babahwere.
en: 7 And they beckoned unto their partners, which were in the other ship, that they should come and help them.

rr: Baija, baijuza amaato gombi, gaayenda kumirwa.
en: And they came, and filled both the ships, so that they began to sink.

rr: 8 Simooni Petero ku yaakireebire, yainama aha maju ga Yesu, yaagira ati: Ndugaho, Mukama wangye, ahabw'okuba ndi omusiisi.
en: 8 When Simon Peter saw it , he fell down at Jesus' knees, saying, Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O Lord.

rr: 9 Ahakuba we na bagyenzi be boona bakatangaara ahabw'eby'enyanja bingi ebi baakwatsire.
en: 9 For he was astonished, and all that were with him, at the draught of the fishes which they had taken:

rr: 10 Kandi Yakobo na Yohaana, beene Zebedaayo, abaabaire bakwataniise na Simooni, nabo baatangaara.
en: 10 and so was also James, and John, the sons of Zebedee, which were partners with Simon.

rr: Yesu yaagambira Simooni ati: Otatiina, okuruga hati oryajuba abantu.
en: And Jesus said unto Simon, Fear not; from henceforth thou shalt catch men.
11 And when they had brought their ships to land, they forsook all, and followed him.
12 And it came to pass, when he was in a certain city, behold a man full of leprosy: who seeing Jesus fell on his face, and besought him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.

rr: 13 Yesu yaagorora omukono, yaamukoraho, naagira ati: Ninkunda; shemera.
en: 13 And he put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will: be thou clean.

rr: Ahonaaho ebibembe byamurugaho.
en: And immediately the leprosy departed from him.
14 And he charged him to tell no man: but go, and shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing, according as Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.

rr: 15 Kwonka okurangaanwa kwe kwayeyongyera okukiraho kubuga hoona; n'emitwe mingi y'abantu yaateerana kuhurira n'okutambirwa endwara zaabo.
en: 15 But so much the more went there a fame abroad of him: and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by him of their infirmities.
16 And he withdrew himself into the wilderness, and prayed.

17 And it came to pass on a certain day, as he was teaching, that there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, which were come out of every town of Galilee, and Judæa, and Jerusalem: and the power of the Lord was present to heal them.

rr: 18 Ahonaaho haija abantu bareetsire omushaija ozingazingirwe, bamuheekire omu nogzi; baasherura oku baraamutaasye omu nju, bakamurambika omu maisho ga Yesu.
en: 18 And, behold, men brought in a bed a man which was taken with a palsy: and they sought means to bring him in, and to lay him before him.

rr: 19 Ku baabuzire ah'okumurabya ahabw'omutwe gw'abantu, baatemba ahaiguru y'enju, baamurabya omu mategura, baamushuumiza omu ngozi ahagati y'abantu omu maisho ga Yesu.
en: 19 And when they could not find by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went upon the housetop, and let him down through the tiling with his couch into the midst before Jesus.

rr: 20 Ku yaareebire okwikiriza kwabo, yaagira ati: Mushaija 'we, ebibi byawe byakusaasirwa.
en: 20 And when he saw their faith, he said unto him, Man, thy sins are forgiven thee.
21 And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is this which speaketh blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?

rr: 22 Yesu ku yaamanyire okwetomboita kwabo, yaababuuza ati: Nimwetomboitera ki omu mitima yaanyu?
en: 22 But when Jesus perceived their thoughts, he answering said unto them, What reason ye in your hearts?

rr: 23 Ekirikurahuka kirahi, okugira nti, Ebibi byawe byakusaasirwa; nari okugira nti, Imuka, ogyende?
en: 23 Whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Rise up and walk?

rr: 24 Mbwenu mumanye ngu, Omwana w'omuntu aine obushoboorozi aha nsi okusaasira ebibi, yaagambira ozingazingirwe ati: Ninkuragiira nti: Imuka, oyekorere engozi yaawe, otaahe.
en: 24 But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power upon earth to forgive sins, (he said unto the sick of the palsy,) I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy couch, and go into thine house.

rr: 25 Ahonaaho yaimuka omu maisho gaabo, yaayekorera eki yaabaire abyamiho, yaataaha omuka naahimbisa Ruhanga.
en: 25 And immediately he rose up before them, and took up that whereon he lay, and departed to his own house, glorifying God.

rr: 26 Kyabatangaaza boona, baahimbisa Ruhanga, baine obwoba bwingi, nibagira bati: Eri izooba twareeba eby'okutangaaza.
en: 26 And they were all amazed, and they glorified God, and were filled with fear, saying, We have seen strange things to day.
27 And after these things he went forth, and saw a publican, named Levi, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he said unto him, Follow me.

rr: 28 Yaatsigaho byona, yaimuka, yaamukuratira.
en: 28 And he left all, rose up, and followed him.

rr: 29 Leevi ogwo yaamuteekyera obugyenyi bwingi omu nju ye; kandi hakaba hariho omutwe mwingi gw'abahooza n'abandi bashutami nabo aha by'okurya.
en: 29 And Levi made him a great feast in his own house: and there was a great company of publicans and of others that sat down with them.

rr: 30 Abafarisaayo n'abahandiiki baabo baayetomboitera abeegi be nibagira bati: Ahabw'enki nimurya kandi nimunywa n'abahooza n'abasiisi?
en: 30 But their scribes and Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, Why do ye eat and drink with publicans and sinners?

rr: 31 Yesu yaabagarukamu ati: Abahuriire tibeetenga mufumu, kureka abarwaire.
en: 31 And Jesus answering said unto them, They that are whole need not a physician; but they that are sick.

rr: 32 Tindaizire kweta bahikiriire kureka abasiisi ngu beeteise.
en: 32 I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
33 And they said unto him, Why do the disciples of John fast often, and make prayers, and likewise the disciples of the Pharisees; but thine eat and drink?

rr: 34 Yesu yaababuuza ati: Nimubaasa muta kusiibyakwo abakwe, bakiine kishwera?
en: 34 And he said unto them, Can ye make the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them?

rr: 35 Obunaku buryahika, kishwera abaihweho; omu biro ebyo baryayesiibyakwo.
en: 35 But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.

rr: 36 Kandi yaabacwera enfumu, ati: Tihariho muntu otaagura ekiremu aha kijwaro kisya, akakiteera aha kujwaro kikuru; ku yaakukora atyo, akaataagura ekyo kijwaro kisya, kandi ekiremu eki yaataagura aha kisya tikikaashushana n'ekijwaro ekikuru.
en: 36 And he spake also a parable unto them; No man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old; if otherwise, then both the new maketh a rent, and the piece that was taken out of the new agreeth not with the old.

rr: 37 Kandi tihariho muntu oshuka viinyo nsya omu furebe z'empu nkuru; ku yaakukora atyo, viinyo ekaabarura efurebe, viinyo egyo eyatika, n'efurebe zisiisikara.
en: 37 And no man putteth new wine into old bottles; else the new wine will burst the bottles, and be spilled, and the bottles shall perish.

rr: 38 Kureka viinyo nsya eshemereire kushukwa omu furebe nsya.
en: 38 But new wine must be put into new bottles; and both are preserved.

rr: 39 Kandi tihariho muntu owaanyweire ahari viinyo nkuru, akakunda ensya; ahakuba naagira ati: Enkuru niyo nungi.
en: 39 No man also having drunk old wine straightway desireth new: for he saith, The old is better.
1 And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first, that he went through the corn fields; and his disciples plucked the ears of corn, and did eat, rubbing them in their hands.

rr: 2 Kwonka abamwe aha Bafarisaayo baabuuza bati: Ahabw'enki nimukora ekirikuzira, okucwa obushiisha ahari Sabato?
en: 2 And certain of the Pharisees said unto them, Why do ye that which is not lawful to do on the sabbath days?
3 And Jesus answering them said, Have ye not read so much as this, what David did, when himself was an hungred, and they which were with him;
4 how he went into the house of God, and did take and eat the shewbread, and gave also to them that were with him; which it is not lawful to eat but for the priests alone?

rr: 5 Yaabagira ati: Omwana w'omuntu niwe Mukama wa Sabato.
en: 5 And he said unto them, That the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.
6 And it came to pass also on another sabbath, that he entered into the synagogue and taught: and there was a man whose right hand was withered.
7 And the scribes and Pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the sabbath day; that they might find an accusation against him.

rr: 8 Kwonka yaamanya ebiteekateeko byabo, yaagambira omuntu ogwo, owaabaire akokootsire omukono, ati: Imuka oyemerere aha.
en: 8 But he knew their thoughts, and said to the man which had the withered hand, Rise up, and stand forth in the midst.

rr: Yimuka, yaayemerera aho.
en: And he arose and stood forth.

rr: 9 Yesu yaabagira ati: Nimbabuuza, ahari Sabato Ebiragiro biikiriza okukora gye nari okukora kubi, okukiza amagara g'omuntu nari okugahwerekyereza?
en: 9 Then said Jesus unto them, I will ask you one thing; Is it lawful on the sabbath days to do good, or to do evil? to save life, or to destroy it ?

rr: 10 Yaabuzya amaisho omuri boona, yaamuragiira ati: Nanuura omukono gwawe.
en: 10 And looking round about upon them all, he said unto the man, Stretch forth thy hand.

rr: Yaagunanuura, omukono gwe gwakira.
en: And he did so: and his hand was restored whole as the other.

rr: 11 Abafarisaayo baagwa eiraro, baahanuura bonka oku baraakore Yesu.
en: 11 And they were filled with madness; and communed one with another what they might do to Jesus.
12 And it came to pass in those days, that he went out into a mountain to pray, and continued all night in prayer to God.
13 And when it was day, he called unto him his disciples: and of them he chose twelve, whom also he named apostles;

rr: 14 Simooni ou yaayetsire Petero, Anderea omurumuna, Yakobo, Yohaana, Filipo, Batolomayo
en: 14 Simon, (whom he also named Peter,) and Andrew his brother, James and John, Philip and Bartholomew,

rr: 15 Matayo, Tomasi, Yakobo mwene Alifaayo, Simooni orikwetwa Zelote
en: 15 Matthew and Thomas, James the son of Alphæus, and Simon called Zelotes,

rr: 16 Yuda mwene Yakobo, na Yuda Iskaryota owaamureebize.
en: 16 and Judas the brother of James, and Judas Iscariot, which also was the traitor.

17 And he came down with them, and stood in the plain, and the company of his disciples, and a great multitude of people out of all Judæa and Jerusalem, and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, which came to hear him, and to be healed of their diseases;

rr: 18 n'abaabaire bariho baadaimoni baakizibwa.
en: 18 and they that were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed.

rr: 19 Ab'omu mitwe egyo boona baayenda ngu bamukoreho, ahabw'okuba amaani gakamurugamu, gaabakiza boona.
en: 19 And the whole multitude sought to touch him: for there went virtue out of him, and healed them all.
20 And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, Blessed be ye poor: for your's is the kingdom of God.
21 Blessed are ye that hunger now: for ye shall be filled. Blessed are ye that weep now: for ye shall laugh.
22 Blessed are ye, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you from their company , and shall reproach you , and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of man's sake.

rr: 23 Aha kiro ekyo mushemererwe, mugurukye ahabw'okwesiima; ahabw'okuba ebihembo byanyu ni bingi omu iguru; ahakuba nikwo baishenkurubo baagizire batyo baanabi.
en: 23 Rejoice ye in that day, and leap for joy: for, behold, your reward is great in heaven: for in the like manner did their fathers unto the prophets.
24 But woe unto you that are rich! for ye have received your consolation.

rr: 25 Muryakareeba, imwe abahaagire hati mbwenu, ahabw'okuba muryagira enjara.
en: 25 Woe unto you that are full! for ye shall hunger. Woe unto you that laugh now! for ye shall mourn and weep.
26 Woe unto you, when all men shall speak well of you! for so did their fathers to the false prophets.
27 But I say unto you which hear, Love your enemies, do good to them which hate you,

rr: 28 mushabire omugisha abarikubakyeena, mushabire abarikubaitsa omwaga.
en: 28 bless them that curse you, and pray for them which despitefully use you.

rr: 29 Orikuteera oruhi rw'omushaya, omuhindurire ogundi; n'orikwaka ekanzu yaawe, n'omunagiro gwawe otarigumwima.
en: 29 And unto him that smiteth thee on the one cheek offer also the other; and him that taketh away thy cloke forbid not to take thy coat also.

rr: 30 Orikushaba weena, omuhe; n'orinyaga ebintu byawe, otarigaruka kubimushaba.
en: 30 Give to every man that asketh of thee; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask them not again.
31 And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.

rr: 32 Mbwenu ku muraabe nimukunda abarikubakunda, nimusiimwaho ki? Ahakuba abasiisi nabo bakunda ababakunda.
en: 32 For if ye love them which love you, what thank have ye? for sinners also love those that love them.

rr: 33 Kandi ku muraakorere gye ababakorera gye, nimusiimwaho ki? Ahakuba n'abasiisi nikwo bakora.
en: 33 And if ye do good to them which do good to you, what thank have ye? for sinners also do even the same.

rr: 34 Kandi ku muraabe nimuguza abo, abu mwineho amatsiko, ngu nyentsya naimwe babahe, nimusiimwaho ki? N'abasiisi baguza abasiisi, ngu baihurwe ebirikwingana n'ebi baagurize.
en: 34 And if ye lend to them of whom ye hope to receive, what thank have ye? for sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much again.

rr: 35 Kureka mukunde abazigu baanyu, mubakorere gye, mubaguze mutaineyo matsiko; obwo ebihembo byanyu biryaba bingi, kandi muryaba abaana ba Rukira-boona; ahabw'okuba We akorera gye abatasiima n'ababi.
en: 35 But love ye your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil.

rr: 36 Mugire embabazi, nka Shoimwe oku agira embabazi.
en: 36 Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.
37 Judge not, and ye shall not be judged: condemn not, and ye shall not be condemned: forgive, and ye shall be forgiven:

rr: 38 Muhe, naimwe muryaheebwa; endengo enungi, eigatiirwe, ecugutsiibwe, erikusheeshekara, niyo murirengyerwa omu bifuba byanyu, ahabw'okuba endengo ei murengamu naimwe niyo murirengyerwamu.
en: 38 give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.
39 And he spake a parable unto them, Can the blind lead the blind? shall they not both fall into the ditch?
40 The disciple is not above his master: but every one that is perfect shall be as his master.

rr: 41 Ahabw'enki nooreeba akatokoozi akari omu riisho rya mugyenzi waawe, haza empimbi eri omu riisho ryawe otagyeteho?
en: 41 And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but perceivest not the beam that is in thine own eye?

rr: 42 Nari shi, noobaasa ota kugambira mugyenzi waawe oti: Mugyenzi wangye, ka nkutokoore akantu akari omu riisho ryawe, haza obwo bwona otarikureeba empimbi eri omu riisho ryawe?
en: 42 Either how canst thou say to thy brother, Brother, let me pull out the mote that is in thine eye, when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thine own eye?

rr: Iwe ndyarya 'we, banza oihe empimbi omu riisho ryawe, obwo nibwo oraareebe gye, okatokoora akantu akari omu riihso rya mugyenzi waawe.
en: Thou hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thine own eye, and then shalt thou see clearly to pull out the mote that is in thy brother's eye.

rr: 43 Tihariho muti murungi ogwana ebyana bibi; kandi tihariho muti mubi ogwana ebyana birungi.
en: 43 For a good tree bringeth not forth corrupt fruit; neither doth a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.

rr: 44 Omuti gwona gumanyirwa aha byana byagwo.
en: 44 For every tree is known by his own fruit.

rr: Nimumanya ngu abantu tibashoroma mtiini aha minyinya, n'obu yaakuba emizaabibu aha matojo.
en: For of thorns men do not gather figs, nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes.
