45 A good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is evil: for of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaketh.
46 And why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?

rr: 47 Omuntu weena orikwija ahi ndi, akahurira ebigambo byangye, akabihikiiriza, naaza kubooreka ou arikushusha
en: 47 Whosoever cometh to me, and heareth my sayings, and doeth them, I will shew you to whom he is like:

rr: 48 naashusha omuntu owaayombekire enju, akarima hare munonga, akata omusingi aha rukiri; amaizi gaateera enju egyo, tigaabaasa kugitegyetsa, ahabw'okuba ekombekwa gye.
en: 48 he is like a man which built an house, and digged deep, and laid the foundation on a rock: and when the flood arose, the stream beat vehemently upon that house, and could not shake it: for it was founded upon a rock.

rr: 49 Kwonka orikuhurira, akanga kukora, naashusha omuntu owaayombekire enju aha itaka, atarimire musingi; amaizi gakagiteera, ahonaaho yaagwa; n'okugwa kw'enju egyo kwaba kuhango.
en: 49 But he that heareth, and doeth not, is like a man that without a foundation built an house upon the earth; against which the stream did beat vehemently, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.
1 Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people, he entered into Capernaum.

rr: 2 Okwo hakaba hariyo omukuru w'abaserukare, owaabaire aine omuhuuku ou arikukunda munonga; omuhuuku ogwo akaba arwaire, ari haihi n'okufa.
en: 2 And a certain centurion's servant, who was dear unto him, was sick, and ready to die.

rr: 3 Ku yaahuriire ebya Yesu, yaamutumaho abakuru b'Abayudaaya, naamushaba kwija kukiza omuhuuku we.
en: 3 And when he heard of Jesus, he sent unto him the elders of the Jews, beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant.

rr: 4 Abatumirwe, ku baahikire ahari Yesu, baamweshengyereza munonga, bati: Omuntu ogwo ashemereire kukorerwa ekyo
en: 4 And when they came to Jesus, they besought him instantly, saying, That he was worthy for whom he should do this:

rr: 5 ahabw'okuba akunda eihanga ryaitu, kandi niwe yaatwombekyeire sinagigi yaitu.
en: 5 for he loveth our nation, and he hath built us a synagogue.

rr: 7 n'ahabw'ekyo naareeba ngu tinshemereire kweizira; haakiri ogambe ekigambo kwonka, omuhuuku wangye abone kukira.
en: 7 wherefore neither thought I myself worthy to come unto thee: but say in a word, and my servant shall be healed.

rr: 8 Kandi ati: Manya naanye ndi omuntu orikutwarwa, kandi nyine abaserukare abu ndikutegyeka. Ku ndagiira omwe nti, Gyenda, agyenda; n'ondiijo nti, Ija, aija; n'omuhuuku wangye nti, Kora eki, akikora.
en: 8 For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers, and I say unto one, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it .

rr: 9 Yesu ku yaakihuriire, yaamutangaarira, yaahindukira omutwe gw'abantu abamukuratiire, yaabagira ati: Nimbagambira nti: Tinkareebaga kwikiriza okurikwingana kuti, n'obu haakuba omuri Israeli.
en: 9 When Jesus heard these things, he marvelled at him, and turned him about, and said unto the people that followed him, I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.

rr: 10 Abo abatumirwe, ku baagarukire omuka, baashanga ogwo muhuuku yaakizire.
en: 10 And they that were sent, returning to the house, found the servant whole that had been sick.

rr: 11 Ku haahingwireho omwanya mukye, yaagyenda omuri tauni erikwetwa Naini, ari hamwe n'abeegi be n'omutwe muhango gw'abantu.
en: 11 And it came to pass the day after, that he went into a city called Nain; and many of his disciples went with him, and much people.

rr: 12 Ku yairiire haihi n'eirembo rya tauni, yaabugana abarikushohoza omutumbi gw'omwojo ofiire, ou nyina yaazaire ari omwe nyamunegyere, kandi nyina akaba ari omufaakazi; abantu abaingi ab'omuri tauni bakaba bari hamwe nawe.
en: 12 Now when he came nigh to the gate of the city, behold, there was a dead man carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow: and much people of the city was with her.

rr: 13 Mukama waitu ku yaamureebire, yaamugirira esaasi, yaamugira ati: Otarira.
en: 13 And when the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said unto her, Weep not.

rr: 14 Yairira haihi, yaakora aha katanda, abeekorezi baayemerera. Yaagira ati: Mwojo 'we, ninkugira nti: Imuka.
en: 14 And he came and touched the bier: and they that bare him stood still. And he said, Young man, I say unto thee, Arise.
15 And he that was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he delivered him to his mother.

rr: 16 Boona baakwatwa obwoba, baahimbisa Ruhanga nibagira bati: Nabi omukuru aimukire omuriitwe. Kandi bati: Ruhanga ataayaayiire abantu be.
en: 16 And there came a fear on all: and they glorified God, saying, That a great prophet is risen up among us; and, That God hath visited his people.

rr: 17 Okurangaanwa kw'ekyo eki yaakozire kwabuga Buyudaaya yoona n'ebyanga byona ebigyehinguririize.
en: 17 And this rumour of him went forth throughout all Judæa, and throughout all the region round about.
18 And the disciples of John shewed him of all these things.
19 And John calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to Jesus, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?

rr: 20 Abashaija abo ku baamuhikire, baagira bati: Yohaana Omubatizi yaatutuma kukubuuza, naagira ati: Niiwe Ogwo orikwenda kwija, nari tutegyereze ondiijo?
en: 20 When the men were come unto him, they said, John Baptist hath sent us unto thee, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?

rr: 21 Omu shaaha egyo yaakiza baingi endwara n'enaku na baadaimoni; kandi n'empumi nyingi yaazihumuura.
en: 21 And in that same hour he cured many of their infirmities and plagues, and of evil spirits; and unto many that were blind he gave sight.

22 Then Jesus answering said unto them, Go your way, and tell John what things ye have seen and heard; how that the blind see, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, to the poor the gospel is preached.

rr: 23 Kandi otarikumbanganisaho aine omugisha.
en: 23 And blessed is he , whosoever shall not be offended in me.

rr: 24 Bwanyima, entumwa za Yohaana ku zaaherize kugarukayo, Yesu yaatandika kugambira emitwe y'abantu ebya Yohaana, ati: Omu ihamba mukaza kureebayo ki?
en: 24 And when the messengers of John were departed, he began to speak unto the people concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness for to see?

rr: Orubingo orurikutengyetsibwa omuyaga?
en: A reed shaken with the wind?

rr: 25 Beitu mukaza kureeba ki?
en: 25 But what went ye out for to see?

rr: Omuntu ojwaire emyenda erikuterera?
en: A man clothed in soft raiment?

rr: Manya abajwara ebijwaro ebirikwengyengyeta, bakeegira gye, baba omu bikaari by'abagabe.
en: Behold, they which are gorgeously apparelled, and live delicately, are in kings' courts.

rr: 26 Beitu mukaza kureebayo ki? Nabi? Eego, nimbagambira nti: N'okukira naakirira kimwe nabi.
en: 26 But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? Yea, I say unto you, and much more than a prophet.
27 This is he , of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.

rr: 28 Nimbagambira nti: Omuri abo abaazairwe abakazi tiharimu n'omwe orikukira Yohaana Omubatizi obukuru; kwonka omuto omu bukama bwa Ruhanga naamukira.
en: 28 For I say unto you, Among those that are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist: but he that is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he.
29 And all the people that heard him , and the publicans, justified God, being baptized with the baptism of John.
30 But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of God against themselves, being not baptized of him.

rr: 31 Mbwenu abantu ab'ebiro ebi mbagyeranise na ki? Kandi nibashusha ki?
en: 31 And the Lord said, Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation? and to what are they like?

rr: 32 Nibashusha nk'abaana abato abashutami omu katare, nibeetana bati: Tubateereire esheegu, timwazina; twacura, timwarira!
en: 32 They are like unto children sitting in the marketplace, and calling one to another, and saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned to you, and ye have not wept.

rr: 33 Ahakuba Yohaana Omubatizi akaija atarikurya mugaati, n'obu kwakuba okunywa viinyo; mwagira ntu, Ariho daimoni.
en: 33 For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine; and ye say, He hath a devil.

rr: 34 Kwonka Omwana w'omuntu we ku yaizire naarya, kandi naanywa, mwagira ngu, Reeba omunyamururu kandi omusinzi, munywani w'abahooza n'abasiisi.
en: 34 The Son of man is come eating and drinking; and ye say, Behold a gluttonous man, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners!

rr: 35 Kwonka obwengye buhamibwa abaana baabwo boona ku buhikire.
en: 35 But wisdom is justified of all her children.
36 And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him. And he went into the Pharisee's house, and sat down to meat.

rr: 37 Omukazi omusiisi w'omuri tauni egyo, ku yaamanyire ngu ari aha by'okurya omw'Omufarisaayo, yaareeta eihembe ry'amajuta ag'omugaju
en: 37 And, behold, a woman in the city, which was a sinner, when she knew that Jesus sat at meat in the Pharisee's house, brought an alabaster box of ointment,
38 and stood at his feet behind him weeping, and began to wash his feet with tears, and did wipe them with the hairs of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.

rr: 39 Omufarisaayo owaamwetsire, ku yaakireebire, yaateekateeka ati: Omuntu ogu, kuri yaaba ari nabi, akaamanyire omukazi ogu orikumukoraho oku ari, ku ari omusiisi.
en: 39 Now when the Pharisee which had bidden him saw it , he spake within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have known who and what manner of woman this is that toucheth him: for she is a sinner.

rr: 40 Yesu yaagarukamu naamugira ati: Simooni, nyine eki ndikwenda kukugambira. Yaagira ati: ngambira, Mwegyesa.
en: 40 And Jesus answering said unto him, Simon, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And he saith, Master, say on.

rr: 41 Yesu yaamugira ati: Hakaba hariho omuntu owaabaire aguza; akaba aine abu yaagurize babiri, omwe naamwihuza edenaari magana ataano, n'ondi makumi ataano.
en: 41 There was a certain creditor which had two debtors: the one owed five hundred pence, and the other fifty.

rr: 42 Ku baabuzire eby'okumwihura, yaabasaasira bombi. Mbwenu ahari abo bombi, owaakizire kumukunda n'oha?
en: 42 And when they had nothing to pay, he frankly forgave them both. Tell me therefore, which of them will love him most?

rr: 43 Simooni yaagarukamu naagira ati: Ningira ngu, n'ogwo ou yaasaasiire bingi. Yesu yaamugira ati: Waagarukamu gye.
en: 43 Simon answered and said, I suppose that he , to whom he forgave most. And he said unto him, Thou hast rightly judged.

rr: 44 Yesu yaahinduka, yaareeba omukazi, yaagira Simooni ati: Nooreeba omukazi ogu?
en: 44 And he turned to the woman, and said unto Simon, Seest thou this woman?

rr: Naataaha omu nju yaawe, tiwampa maizi g'okunaaba ebigyere byangye, kwonka we yaajubya ebigyere byangye n'amarira ge, yaabisiisiriza n'eishokye rye.
en: I entered into thine house, thou gavest me no water for my feet: but she hath washed my feet with tears, and wiped them with the hairs of her head.

rr: 45 Iwe tiwaanywegyera, kwonka we, okwiha obu naahika aha, takarekire kunywegyera bigyere byangye
en: 45 Thou gavest me no kiss: but this woman since the time I came in hath not ceased to kiss my feet.

rr: 46 tiwansiiga majuta aha mutwe, kwonka we yaasiiga bigyere byangye amajuta.
en: 46 My head with oil thou didst not anoint: but this woman hath anointed my feet with ointment.

rr: 47 N'ahabw'ekyo ninkugambira nti: Ebibi bye bingi yaabisaasirwa, ahabw'okuba okukunda kwe ni kwingi; kwonka osaasirwa ebikye, okukunda kwe ni kukye.
en: 47 Wherefore I say unto thee, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven; for she loved much: but to whom little is forgiven, the same loveth little.

rr: 48 Yaagira ogwo mukazi ati: Ebibi byawe byakusaasirwa.
en: 48 And he said unto her, Thy sins are forgiven.

rr: 49 Abaabaire bashutami nibarya nawe baatandika kubuuzana bati: Ogu n'oha kandi orikusaasira ebibi?
en: 49 And they that sat at meat with him began to say within themselves, Who is this that forgiveth sins also?
50 And he said to the woman, Thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace.

rr: 1 Ku haahingwireho omwanya mukye, yaagyendagyenda omuri tauni n'birorero naabuurira kandi naagamba ebigambo ebirungi by'obukama bwa Ruhanga. Obwo akaba aine bari ikumi na babiri
en: 1 And it came to pass afterward, that he went throughout every city and village, preaching and shewing the glad tidings of the kingdom of God: and the twelve were with him,
2 and certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven devils,

rr: 3 na Yoana muka Cuuza omubiiki wa Heroode, na Susaana, n'abandi baingi abaabaire nibabahwera n'ebintu byabo.
en: 3 and Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod's steward, and Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance.
4 And when much people were gathered together, and were come to him out of every city, he spake by a parable:

rr: 5 Omubibi akashohora kubiba; ku yaabaire naabiba, embibo zimwe zaagwa omu muhanda, zaaribatiirirwa, enyonyi z'omu mwanya zaazirya.
en: 5 A sower went out to sow his seed: and as he sowed, some fell by the way side; and it was trodden down, and the fowls of the air devoured it.

rr: 6 Ezindi zaagwa aha rukiri; ku zaamezire, zaahonga, ahabw'okubura amaizi.
en: 6 And some fell upon a rock; and as soon as it was sprung up, it withered away, because it lacked moisture.

rr: 7 Ezindi zaagwa omu mahwa; amahwa gaakura nazo, gaazinyuruza.
en: 7 And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprang up with it, and choked it.

rr: 8 Ezindi zaagwa omu itaka rirungi, zaamera, zaayera emirundi igana.
en: 8 And other fell on good ground, and sprang up, and bare fruit an hundredfold.

rr: Ku yaaherize kugira atyo, yaagamba n'eiraka rihango ati: Oine amatu agarikuhurira, ahurire.
en: And when he had said these things, he cried, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

rr: 9 Abeegi ku baamubuurize amakuru g'enfumu egyo
en: 9 And his disciples asked him, saying, What might this parable be?
10 And he said, Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God: but to others in parables; that seeing they might not see, and hearing they might not understand.
11 Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.

rr: 12 Ez'omu muhanda, abo nibo bahurira; bwanyima Sitaane akiija, akaiha ekigambo omu mitima yaabo, ngu bataikiriza bakajunwa.
en: 12 Those by the way side are they that hear; then cometh the devil, and taketh away the word out of their hearts, lest they should believe and be saved.

rr: 13 Ez'aha rukiri, abo nibo bahurira ekigambo, bakakiikiriza n'okushemererwa; kwonka bataine mizi, bakaikiriza omwanya mukye, kandi omu biro eby'okwohibwa bakagaruka enyima.
en: 13 They on the rock are they , which, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, which for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.

rr: 14 Ezaagwire omu mahwa, abo nibo bahurira; kwonka bakiba bari omu muhanda bakanyuruzibwa amaganya g'ensi, n'obutungi n'okweshemeza okw'amagara g'ensi egi, ebyana byabo biteere.
en: 14 And that which fell among thorns are they, which, when they have heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life, and bring no fruit to perfection.
15 But that on the good ground are they, which in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, keep it , and bring forth fruit with patience.
16 No man, when he hath lighted a candle, covereth it with a vessel, or putteth it under a bed; but setteth it on a candlestick, that they which enter in may see the light.

rr: 17 Ahakuba tihariho kyasherekirwe ekitarishuuruurwa, nari eky'omubonano ekitarimanywa kikareebwa butunu.
en: 17 For nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest; neither any thing hid, that shall not be known and come abroad.
18 Take heed therefore how ye hear: for whosoever hath, to him shall be given; and whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he seemeth to have.
19 Then came to him his mother and his brethren, and could not come at him for the press.

rr: 20 Abaabaire bari aho baamugira bati: Nyoko na barumuna baawe beemereire aheeru, nibenda kukureeba.
en: 20 And it was told him by certain which said, Thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to see thee.

rr: 21 We yaabagarukamu naagira ati: Maawe na barumuna bangye n'abo abahurira ekigambo kya Ruhanga, bakakyorobera.
en: 21 And he answered and said unto them, My mother and my brethren are these which hear the word of God, and do it.
22 Now it came to pass on a certain day, that he went into a ship with his disciples: and he said unto them, Let us go over unto the other side of the lake. And they launched forth.

rr: 23 Ku baabaire nibagyenda, yaagwejegyera. Eihunga ringi ryabatangira aha nyanja, obwato bwayenda kwijura amaizi, baaba omu kabi.
en: 23 But as they sailed he fell asleep: and there came down a storm of wind on the lake; and they were filled with water , and were in jeopardy.

rr: 24 Baija baamusisiimura, nibagira bati: Mwegyesa, Mwegyesa, twafa!
en: 24 And they came to him, and awoke him, saying, Master, master, we perish.

rr: Yaasisiimuka, yaakabukira eihunga n'okuhoorera kw'amaizi; byacureera, haabaho obucureera bwingi.
en: Then he arose, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water: and they ceased, and there was a calm.

rr: 25 Yaababuuza ati: okwikiriza kwanyu kuri nkahi?
en: 25 And he said unto them, Where is your faith?

rr: Baatiina, baatangaara, baagambira bati: Ogu ni muntu ki, orikuragiira eihunga n'enyanja, bikamuhurira!
en: And they being afraid wondered, saying one to another, What manner of man is this! for he commandeth even the winds and water, and they obey him.
26 And they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is over against Galilee.

rr: 27 Ku yaatambuukiire ati aha nkungu, yaabuganwa omushaija ow'omuri tauni yaaho, owaabaire ariho daimoni. Omushaija ogwo akaba amazire ebiro bingi atakijwara kantu, kandi atakiraara mu nju kureka omu bituuro.
en: 27 And when he went forth to land, there met him out of the city a certain man, which had devils long time, and ware no clothes, neither abode in any house, but in the tombs.

rr: 28 Ku yaareebire Yesu, yaayamuza, yaamugwa omumaisho, yaagamba n'eiraka rihango ati: Noofa ki naanye, Yesu Omwana wa Ruhanga Rukira-boona?
en: 28 When he saw Jesus, he cried out, and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God most high?

rr: Ninkweshengyereza, otaanyita kubi
en: I beseech thee, torment me not.

rr: 29 ahabw'okuba Yesu akaba yaaragiire daimoni kuruga aha muntu ogwo. (Kandi kaingi daimoni ku yaabaire amukwata, abantu bamubohesa emihama n'emirunga ngu bamurinde; acwa ebimubohire, daimoni amurariza omu ihamba.)
en: 29 (For he had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For oftentimes it had caught him: and he was kept bound with chains and in fetters; and he brake the bands, and was driven of the devil into the wilderness.)

rr: 30 Yesu yaamubuuza ati: Eiziina ryawe ori oha? Yaamugarukamu ati: ndi Legioni; ahakuba baadaimoni baingi bakaba bamutaahiremu.
en: 30 And Jesus asked him, saying, What is thy name? And he said, Legion: because many devils were entered into him.

rr: 31 Baamweshengyereza kutabaragiira kukyengera okuzimu.
en: 31 And they besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep.

rr: 32 Kandi aho omu rukiizi hakaba hariiriireyo omukumbi gw'empunu nyingi; baamweshengyereza kuba nizo baataahamu.
en: 32 And there was there an herd of many swine feeding on the mountain: and they besought him that he would suffer them to enter into them.

rr: Yaabaikiriza.
en: And he suffered them.

rr: 33 Baadaimoni nikwo kuruga omu muntu ogwo, bakataaha omu mpunu; empunu ezo zoona zikashuuma ibanga niziiruka, zikahwera omu nyanja.
en: 33 Then went the devils out of the man, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake, and were choked.

rr: 34 Abariisa baazo ku baareebire ekyabaho, bairuka, baabigambira ab'omuri tauni n'ab'omu byaro.
en: 34 When they that fed them saw what was done, they fled, and went and told it in the city and in the country.

rr: 35 Abantu baahurura kureeba ebyabaho; ku baahikire ahari Yesu, baashanga omushaija owaarugwaho baadaimoni ashutami aha bigyere bya Yesu, ajwaire gye, aine obwengye; baatiina.
en: 35 Then they went out to see what was done; and came to Jesus, and found the man, out of whom the devils were departed, sitting at the feet of Jesus, clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.

rr: 36 Abariisa abaabireeba, baabateekyerereza oku owaabaire ariho baadaimoni yaakizibwa.
en: 36 They also which saw it told them by what means he that was possessed of the devils was healed.

rr: 37 Abantu boona ab'omu nsi egyo ey'Abageraseene baamushaba kubarugamu; ahabw'okuba bakakwatwa obwoba bwingi; atyo Yesu yaaza omu bwato, yaagarukayo.
en: 37 Then the whole multitude of the country of the Gadarenes round about besought him to depart from them; for they were taken with great fear; and he went up into the ship, and returned back again.

rr: 38 Atakagyenzire, omushaija owaarugwaho baadaimoni yaamweshengyereza ngu agume nawe; kwonka Yesu yaamwohereza, naagira ati
en: 38 Now the man out of whom the devils were departed besought him that he might be with him: but Jesus sent him away, saying,

rr: 39 Garuka omu ka yaawe, ogambe ebi Ruhanga yaakukorera oku biri bikuru.
en: 39 Return to thine own house, and shew how great things God hath done unto thee.

rr: Yaagyenda naabuzya omuri tauni yoona ebikuru ebi Yesu amukoreire.
en: And he went his way, and published throughout the whole city how great things Jesus had done unto him.
40 And it came to pass, that, when Jesus was returned, the people gladly received him: for they were all waiting for him.

rr: 41 Haija omushaija eiziina rye Yairo, owaabaire ari omukuru wa sinagogi; yaakwata Yesu amaguru, naamweshengyereza kuza omu nju ye
en: 41 And, behold, there came a man named Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue: and he fell down at Jesus' feet, and besought him that he would come into his house:

rr: 42 ahabw'okuba akaba aine omwishiki omwe wenka ohikize emyaka ikumi n'ebiri, kandi akaba ari haihi n'okufa.
en: 42 for he had one only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she lay a dying. But as he went the people thronged him.

rr: 43 Haija omukazi owaabaire amazire emyaka ikumi n'ebiri arwaire ekyejwiso; kandi akaba yaamariire ebintu bye byona omu bafumu, kwonka hatariho n'omwe owaabaasize kumutambira.
en: 43 And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years, which had spent all her living upon physicians, neither could be healed of any,

rr: 44 Yaamuturuka enyima, yaakora aha mukugiro gw'ekijwaro kye; ahonaaho ekyejwiso kye kyakira.
en: 44 came behind him , and touched the border of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stanched.

rr: 45 Yesu yaabuuza ati: N'oha owankoraho?
en: 45 And Jesus said, Who touched me?

rr: Boona ku baayehakaine, Petero na bagyenzi be baamugira bati: Mwegyesa, emitwe ekwehinguririize, neekumigisiriza!
en: When all denied, Peter and they that were with him said, Master, the multitude throng thee and press thee , and sayest thou, Who touched me?

rr: 46 Yesu yaagira ati: Haine owankoraho, ahabw'okuba naahurira amaani gandugamu.
en: 46 And Jesus said, Somebody hath touched me: for I perceive that virtue is gone out of me.

rr: 47 Omukazi ku yamanyire ngu tasherekirwe, yaija naatetema, yaajuunara omu maisho ge, yaagambira omu maisho ga boona ekyamumukoresaho, kandi n'oku yaakira ahonaaho.
en: 47 And when the woman saw that she was not hid, she came trembling, and falling down before him, she declared unto him before all the people for what cause she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.

rr: 48 Yesu yaamugira ati: Mwana wangye, okwikiriza kwawe nikwo kwakukiza; gyenda n'obusingye.
en: 48 And he said unto her, Daughter, be of good comfort: thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace.

rr: 49 Ku yaabaire naakigamba, haija omuntu owaaruga ow'omukuru wa sinagogi, yaagira ati: Muhara waawe yaakaba; otarusya Omwegyesa.
en: 49 While he yet spake, there cometh one from the ruler of the synagogue's house , saying to him, Thy daughter is dead: trouble not the Master.

rr: 50 Kwonka Yesu ku yaakihuriire, yaamugambira ati: Otatiina; ikiriza kwonka, naija kukira.
en: 50 But when Jesus heard it , he answered him, saying, Fear not: believe only, and she shall be made whole.

rr: 51 Ku yaahikire aha nju, tiyaikiriza muntu weena kutaahamu nawe, kureka Petero na Yohaana na Yakobo na ishe w'omwishiki na nyina.
en: 51 And when he came into the house, he suffered no man to go in, save Peter, and James, and John, and the father and the mother of the maiden.

rr: 52 Kandi boona bakaba nibarira nibamucurira; kwonka Yesu yaabagira ati: Mutarira; ahabw'okuba tafiire, agwejegyeire.
en: 52 And all wept, and bewailed her: but he said, Weep not; she is not dead, but sleepeth.

rr: 53 Bamushekyerera munonga, ahabw'okuba bakamanya ku afiire.
en: 53 And they laughed him to scorn, knowing that she was dead.

rr: 54 We yaamukwata aha mukono, yaamweta ati: Mwishiki 'we, imuka.
en: 54 And he put them all out, and took her by the hand, and called, saying, Maid, arise.

rr: 55 Amagara ge gaamugarukamu, ahonaaho yaimuka; Yesu yaaragiira ngu bamuhe eky'okurya.
en: 55 And her spirit came again, and she arose straightway: and he commanded to give her meat.

rr: 56 Abazaire be baatangaara munonga; kwonka yaabeehanangiriza kutagira u baagambira ebyabaho.
en: 56 And her parents were astonished: but he charged them that they should tell no man what was done.
1 Then he called his twelve disciples together, and gave them power and authority over all devils, and to cure diseases.

rr: 2 Yaabatuma kugamba eby'obukama bwa Ruhanga n'okukiza abarwaire.
en: 2 And he sent them to preach the kingdom of God, and to heal the sick.

rr: 3 Yaabaragiira ati: Mutagira eki mwagyendana, n'obu yaakuba enkoni, nari enshaho, nari eby'okurya, nari empiiha; kandi mutatwara amakanzu abiri.
en: 3 And he said unto them, Take nothing for your journey, neither staves, nor scrip, neither bread, neither money; neither have two coats apiece.
4 And whatsoever house ye enter into, there abide, and thence depart.

rr: 5 Kandi ahu bataribaakiira hoona, ku muriba nimuruga omuri tauni egyo, mukunkumure omucuucu gw'omu bigyere byanyu okuba mushinja aharibo.
en: 5 And whosoever will not receive you, when ye go out of that city, shake off the very dust from your feet for a testimony against them.

rr: 6 Batyo baagyenda, baaraba omu birorero, nibabuuriria engiri, nibatambira abantu hoonahoona.
en: 6 And they departed, and went through the towns, preaching the gospel, and healing every where.
7 Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him: and he was perplexed, because that it was said of some, that John was risen from the dead;

rr: 8 abandi ngu, Eliya areebeikire; n'abandi ngu, omwe ahari baanabi aba ira azookire
en: 8 and of some, that Elias had appeared; and of others, that one of the old prophets was risen again.
9 And Herod said, John have I beheaded: but who is this, of whom I hear such things? And he desired to see him.
10 And the apostles, when they were returned, told him all that they had done. And he took them, and went aside privately into a desert place belonging to the city called Bethsaida.

rr: 11 Emitwe y'abantu ku yaakimanyire, baamukurata; yaabaakiira n'okushemererwa, yaabagambira eby'obukama bwa Ruhanga, n'abaabaire nibenda kutambirwa yaabakiza.
en: 11 And the people, when they knew it , followed him: and he received them, and spake unto them of the kingdom of God, and healed them that had need of healing.

rr: 12 Ku bwatandikire kwira, bari ikumi na babiri baija baamushaba nibagira bati: Raga abantu bagyende omu birorero n'omu byaro, baronde oburaaro n'eby'okurya; ahabw'okuba aha turi omu ihamba.
en: 12 And when the day began to wear away, then came the twelve, and said unto him, Send the multitude away, that they may go into the towns and country round about, and lodge, and get victuals: for we are here in a desert place.

rr: 13 Kwonka We yaabaragiira ati: Mube niimwe mwabaha eby'okurya.
en: 13 But he said unto them, Give ye them to eat.

rr: Baagira bati: Ebi twine n'emigaati etaano n'eby'enyanja bibiri kwonka, kureka tugyende tugure eby'okurya ahabw'aba bantu boona.
en: And they said, We have no more but five loaves and two fishes; except we should go and buy meat for all this people.

rr: 14 Ahakuba bakaba bari abashaija nk'enkumi itaano. Yaaragiira abeegi be ati: Mubashutamye omu mitwe, nk'ey'ataano ataano.
en: 14 For they were about five thousand men. And he said to his disciples, Make them sit down by fifties in a company.

rr: 15 Baagira batyo, baabashutamya boona.
en: 15 And they did so, and made them all sit down.

rr: 16 Yaakwata egyo migaati etaano n'eby'enyanja bibiri, yaareeba ahaiguru, yaasiima, yaabicwamu, yaabiha abeegi be ngu babite omu maisho g'abantu.
en: 16 Then he took the five loaves and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed them, and brake, and gave to the disciples to set before the multitude.

rr: 17 Boona baarya, baahaaga. Bwanyima baatorotoora oburagarika obwatsigaireho, bwaba ebitenga ikumi na bibiri.
en: 17 And they did eat, and were all filled: and there was taken up of fragments that remained to them twelve baskets.
18 And it came to pass, as he was alone praying, his disciples were with him: and he asked them, saying, Whom say the people that I am?

rr: 19 Baamugarukamu bati: Yohaana Omubatizi; abandi ngu, Eliya; kandi abandi ngu Omwe ahari baanabi aba ira azookire.
en: 19 They answering said, John the Baptist; but some say , Elias; and others say , that one of the old prophets is risen again.
20 He said unto them, But whom say ye that I am? Peter answering said, The Christ of God.

rr: 21 Yaabeehanangiriza naabaragiira kutagira u baakigambira
en: 21 And he straitly charged them, and commanded them to tell no man that thing;

rr: 22 naagira ati: Omwana w'omuntu ashemereire kubonabonesibwa omuri bingi, n'okwangwa abakuru n'abanyamurwa abakuru n'abahandiiki, n'okwitwa, kandi n'okuzooka aha kiro kya kashatu.
en: 22 saying, The Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be slain, and be raised the third day.

rr: 23 Kandi yaagambira boona ati: Omuntu weena oraayende kunkuratira, ayeyangise, ayekorere omusharaba gwe obutoosha, ankuratire.
en: 23 And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.
24 For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: but whosoever will lose his life for my sake, the same shall save it.

rr: 25 Mbwenu omuntu kiryamugasira ki okutunga ensi yoona, akahwerekyerera, nari akaferwa amagara ge?
en: 25 For what is a man advantaged, if he gain the whole world, and lose himself, or be cast away?
26 For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words, of him shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he shall come in his own glory, and in his Father's, and of the holy angels.

rr: 27 Buzimazima nimbagambira nti: Omuri aba abeemereire aha, hariho bamwe abarireeba obukama bwa Ruhanga, batakafiire.
en: 27 But I tell you of a truth, there be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the kingdom of God.
28 And it came to pass about an eight days after these sayings, he took Peter and John and James, and went up into a mountain to pray.

rr: 29 Ku yaabaire naashaba, enshusha y'ahamaisho ge yaahindurwa, ebijwaro bye byayera nibimurinkana.
en: 29 And as he prayed, the fashion of his countenance was altered, and his raiment was white and glistering.

rr: 30 Kandi reeba abashaija babiri Musa na Eliya baagaaniira nawe
en: 30 And, behold, there talked with him two men, which were Moses and Elias:

rr: 31 baareebeka baine ekitiinisa, baagamba aha kufa kwe, oku ariija kuhikiiririza Yerusaalemu.
en: 31 who appeared in glory, and spake of his decease which he should accomplish at Jerusalem.
32 But Peter and they that were with him were heavy with sleep: and when they were awake, they saw his glory, and the two men that stood with him.

rr: 33 Abashaija abo ku baabaire nibataana nawe, Petero yaagambira Yesu ati: Mwegyesa, ni kirungi obu turi aha; twombekye obuju bushatu, akamwe kabe akaawe, akandi kabe aka Muksa, n'akandi aka Eliya; ahakuba akaba atarikumanya ki arikugamba.
en: 33 And it came to pass, as they departed from him, Peter said unto Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias: not knowing what he said.

rr: 34 Ku yaabaire naakigamba, ekicu kyaija, kyabasangira; ku baataahire omu kicu, baatiina.
en: 34 While he thus spake, there came a cloud, and overshadowed them: and they feared as they entered into the cloud.

rr: 35 Eiraka ryayema omu kicu, nirigira riti: Ogu n'Omwana wangye ou ntooraine; mumuhurire!
en: 35 And there came a voice out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.

rr: 36 Eiraka eryo ku ryaherize kugamba, baashanga Yesu ari wenka.
en: 36 And when the voice was past, Jesus was found alone.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo omu biro ebyo bakahunama, tibaagambiraho muntu weena kigambo na kimwe ahari ebyo ebi baareebire.
en: And they kept it close, and told no man in those days any of those things which they had seen.
37 And it came to pass, that on the next day, when they were come down from the hill, much people met him.

rr: 38 Reeba omushaija ow'omu mutwe ogwo yaagamba n'eiraka rihango ati: Mwegyesa, ninkweshengyereza, ndeebera omwana wangye w'omwojo; ahakuba niwe naazaire wenka.
en: 38 And, behold, a man of the company cried out, saying, Master, I beseech thee, look upon my son: for he is mine only child.

rr: 39 Daimoni ku amukwata, ahonaaho ayamuza; amutetemya, areeta eifuro; amuhendagura, amurugaho yaamunogize.
en: 39 And, lo, a spirit taketh him, and he suddenly crieth out; and it teareth him that he foameth again, and bruising him hardly departeth from him.

rr: 40 Kandi naayeshengyereza abeegi baawe kumubinga, tibaabaasa.
en: 40 And I besought thy disciples to cast him out; and they could not.

rr: 41 Yesu yaagambira abeegi be ati: Ab'obusingye obutarikwikiriza, abarikwehabagiza, ndyaherera hi okuguma naimwe, n'okubagumisiririza?
en: 41 And Jesus answering said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you, and suffer you?

rr: Ndeetera mutabani waawe.
en: Bring thy son hither.

rr: 42 Omwana ku yaabaire nakiija, daimoni yaamuteera ahansi, yaamutaagura munonga.
en: 42 And as he was yet a coming, the devil threw him down, and tare him .

rr: Yesu yaagambira kubi daimoni, yaatambira omwana, yaamugarurira ishe.
en: And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the child, and delivered him again to his father.

rr: 43 Boona baatangaarira ekitiinisa kya Ruhanga.
en: 43 And they were all amazed at the mighty power of God. But while they wondered every one at all things which Jesus did, he said unto his disciples,

rr: 44 Ebigambo ebi mubihurire gye n'amatu gaanyu; ahakuba Omwana w'omuntu naija kuheebwayo omu mikono y'abantu.
en: 44 Let these sayings sink down into your ears: for the Son of man shall be delivered into the hands of men.

rr: 45 Kwonka tibarashoborokyeirwe ki yaabagambiire, kikaba kibakingiirwe, ngu batakyetegyereza; kandi batiina kukimubuuza.
en: 45 But they understood not this saying, and it was hid from them, that they perceived it not: and they feared to ask him of that saying.
46 Then there arose a reasoning among them, which of them should be greatest.

rr: 47 Yesu ku yaamanyire ebiteekateeko by'omu mitima yaabo, yaakwata omwana muto, yaamwemereza aha rubaju rwe
en: 47 And Jesus, perceiving the thought of their heart, took a child, and set him by him,

rr: 48 yaabagira ati: Weena orikwakira omwana ogu omuto omu iziina ryangye, biri niinye ayakiire; kandi weena orikuunyakiira, biri ayakiire Owantumire; ahakuba omuto omuriimwe mwena, ogwo niwe mukuru.
en: 48 and said unto them, Whosoever shall receive this child in my name receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me receiveth him that sent me: for he that is least among you all, the same shall be great.

rr: 49 Yohaana yaagarukamu naagira ati: Mwegyesa, tureebire omuntu naabinga baadaimoni omu iziina ryawe, twamuzibira, ahabw'okutakwatanisa naitwe.
en: 49 And John answered and said, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name; and we forbad him, because he followeth not with us.
50 And Jesus said unto him, Forbid him not: for he that is not against us is for us.

rr: 51 Ebiro bye eby'okutemba omu iguru ku byabaire nibyenda kuhika, amaisho ge yaagateera kimwe aha kuza Yerusaalemu. Yaatuma entumwa kumwebembera
en: 51 And it came to pass, when the time was come that he should be received up, he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem,

rr: 52 zaagyenda, zaataaha omu kirorero ky'Abasamaria, kumuteguurira oburaaro.
en: 52 and sent messengers before his face: and they went, and entered into a village of the Samaritans, to make ready for him.
53 And they did not receive him, because his face was as though he would go to Jerusalem.
54 And when his disciples James and John saw this , they said, Lord, wilt thou that we command fire to come down from heaven, and consume them, even as Elias did?

rr: 55 We yaahinduka, yaabahana, ati: Timurikumanya mutima ogu mwine oku guri
en: 55 But he turned, and rebuked them, and said, Ye know not what manner of spirit ye are of.

rr: 56 ahabw'okuba Omwana w'omuntu taraizire kucwekyereza amagara g'abantu, kureka okubajuna. Baagumizamu, baataaha omu kirorero ekindi.
en: 56 For the Son of man is not come to destroy men's lives, but to save them . And they went to another village.
57 And it came to pass, that, as they went in the way, a certain man said unto him, Lord, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.

rr: 58 Yesu yaamugambira ati: Zaamuha ziine ebiina, n'enyonyi z'omu mwanaya ziine ebyashuri; kwonka Omwana w'omuntu taine na h'okuta omutwe.
en: 58 And Jesus said unto him, Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.

rr: 59 Yaagambira ondiijo ati: Nkuratira! We yaagira ati: Mukama wangye, reka mbanze ngyende, nziikye tata.
en: 59 And he said unto another, Follow me. But he said, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.

rr: 60 Yesu yaamugira ati: Reka abafu baziikye abafu baabo; kwonka iwe, ogyende obuzye hoona obukama bwa Ruhanga.
en: 60 Jesus said unto him, Let the dead bury their dead: but go thou and preach the kingdom of God.
61 And another also said, Lord, I will follow thee; but let me first go bid them farewell, which are at home at my house.

rr: 62 Yesu yaamugarukamu ati: Tihariho muntu ovuga ekyoma ekirikuhinga, akareeba enyima, oshemereire obukama bwa Ruhanga.
en: 62 And Jesus said unto him, No man, having put his hand to the plough, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.
1 After these things the Lord appointed other seventy also, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, whither he himself would come.
2 Therefore said he unto them, The harvest truly is great, but the labourers are few: pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he would send forth labourers into his harvest.

rr: 3 Mugyende; reeba, nimbatuma muri nk'entaama ahagati y'emishega.
en: 3 Go your ways: behold, I send you forth as lambs among wolves.

rr: 4 Mutatwara enshaho z'empiiha, n'obu zaakuba efurebe, nari enkaito; kandi mutagira ou mwaramutsya omu muhanda.
en: 4 Carry neither purse, nor scrip, nor shoes: and salute no man by the way.

rr: 5 Enju yoona ei muraataahemu, mubanze mugire muti: Obusingye bugume omu nju egi!
en: 5 And into whatsoever house ye enter, first say, Peace be to this house.

rr: 6 Ku muraashangyemu omwana w'obusingye, obusingye bwanyu nibwija kuguma ahariwe; kwonka ku kiraabe kitari kityo, obusingye bwanyu nibwija kubagarukira.
en: 6 And if the son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon it: if not, it shall turn to you again.
7 And in the same house remain, eating and drinking such things as they give: for the labourer is worthy of his hire. Go not from house to house.
8 And into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you, eat such things as are set before you:

rr: 9 Mukize abarwaire baamwo, mubagambire muti: Obukama bwa Ruhanga bubairiire haihi.
en: 9 and heal the sick that are therein, and say unto them, The kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.

rr: 10 Kwonka ku muraataahe omuri tauni yoona, bataabaakiira, mushohore omu nguuto zaayo, nimugira muti
en: 10 But into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you not, go your ways out into the streets of the same, and say,
11 Even the very dust of your city, which cleaveth on us, we do wipe off against you: notwithstanding be ye sure of this, that the kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.

rr: 12 Nimbagambira nti: Aha kiro ekyo ekifubiro kya Sodoma kiryaba ekirikubaasa kwemerwa okukira ekya tauni egyo.
en: 12 But I say unto you, that it shall be more tolerable in that day for Sodom, than for that city.

13 Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon, which have been done in you, they had a great while ago repented, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.

rr: 14 Mumanye ngu aha kiro ky'okucwa orubanja ekifubiro kya Tuuro na Sidoni kiryaba ekirikubaasa kwemerwa okukira ekyanyu.
en: 14 But it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment, than for you.

rr: 15 Naiwe Kaperenaumu, nooyeraata ngu oryakuzibwa ohikye omu iguru? Ngaaha, oryagarurwa ahansi ohikye Okuzimu.
en: 15 And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted to heaven, shalt be thrust down to hell.
16 He that heareth you heareth me; and he that despiseth you despiseth me; and he that despiseth me despiseth him that sent me.

rr: 17 Abo beegi be makumi mushaju baagaruka n'okushemererwa, nibagira bati: Mukama waitu, na baadaimoni nibatworobera omu iziina ryawe.
en: 17 And the seventy returned again with joy, saying, Lord, even the devils are subject unto us through thy name.
18 And he said unto them, I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven.
19 Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.
20 Notwithstanding in this rejoice not, that the spirits are subject unto you; but rather rejoice, because your names are written in heaven.

21 In that hour Jesus rejoiced in spirit, and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes: even so, Father; for so it seemed good in thy sight.

rr: 22 Ebintu byona nkabiheebwa Tata; kandi tihariho orikumanya Omwana oku ari kureka Ishe, n'obu yaakuba orikumanya Ishe oku ari kureka Omwana, n'omuntu weena ou Omwana aikiriza kumumushuuruurira.
en: 22 All things are delivered to me of my Father: and no man knoweth who the Son is, but the Father; and who the Father is, but the Son, and he to whom the Son will reveal him .
23 And he turned him unto his disciples, and said privately, Blessed are the eyes which see the things that ye see:

rr: 24 Nimbagambira nti: Baanabi n'abagabe baingi bakeetenga kureeba ebi murikureeba, tibaabireeba, kandi n'okuhurira ebi murikuhurira, tibaabihurira.
en: 24 for I tell you, that many prophets and kings have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them ; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them .
25 And, behold, a certain lawyer stood up, and tempted him, saying, Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?

rr: 26 Yesu yaamugarukamu ati: N'enki ekihandiikirwe omu Biragiro? Oshoma ota?
en: 26 He said unto him, What is written in the law? how readest thou?
27 And he answering said, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy strength, and with all thy mind; and thy neighbour as thyself.

rr: 28 Yesu yaamugira ati: Waagarukamu gye; kora otyo, noija kugira amagara.
en: 28 And he said unto him, Thou hast answered right: this do, and thou shalt live.

rr: 29 Kwonka ahabw'okwenda kweyoreka nk'ohikiriire, yaabuuza Yesu ati: Mutaahi wangye n'oha?
en: 29 But he, willing to justify himself, said unto Jesus, And who is my neighbour?

rr: 30 Yesu yaamugarukamu ati: Omushaija akaba naaruga Yerusaalemu naashuma Yeriko; yaagwa omu bambuzi; baamujuura ebijwaro, baamuteera, baatsiga naayenda kufa.
en: 30 And Jesus answering said, A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among thieves, which stripped him of his raiment, and wounded him , and departed, leaving him half dead.

rr: 31 Kandi omunyamurwa omwe akaba naashuuma omu muhanda ogwo, yaamugwaho atakimanyire; ku yaamureebire, yaamwetantara, yaaraba aha rundi rubaju, yaagumizamu.
en: 31 And by chance there came down a certain priest that way: and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.

rr: 32 N'Omuleevi atyo, ku yaahikire aha mwanya ogwo, yaamureeba, yaaraba aha rundi rubaju.
en: 32 And likewise a Levite, when he was at the place, came and looked on him , and passed by on the other side.

rr: 33 Kwonka Omusamaria, owaabaire ari omu rugyendo rwe, ku yaizire, yaahika ahu yaabaire ari; ku yaamureebire, yaamugirira esaasi
en: 33 But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he had compassion on him ,

rr: 34 yaamuhikaho, yaashuka amajuta na viinyo omu buhuta bwe, yaamushemba; bwanyima yaamutembya aha ndogoya ye, yaamuhitsya omu nju y'abagyenzi, yaamurwaza.
en: 34 and went to him , and bound up his wounds, pouring in oil and wine, and set him on his own beast, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.

rr: 35 Omu kasheeshe yaihayo edenaari ibiri, yaaziha mukama w'egyo nju, naagira ati: Omurwaze; ezi oraakorese okurenga aha zi nkutsigire, ku ndigaruka, ndyazikwihura.
en: 35 And on the morrow when he departed, he took out two pence, and gave them to the host, and said unto him, Take care of him; and whatsoever thou spendest more, when I come again, I will repay thee.

rr: 36 Nooteekateeka, n'oha ahari abo abashatu owaabaire mutaahi w'ogwo owaagwire omu bambuzi?
en: 36 Which now of these three, thinkest thou, was neighbour unto him that fell among the thieves?

rr: 37 Yaagira ati: N'ogwo owaamugiriire esaasi. Yesu yaamugira ati: Gyenda, naiwe okore otyo.
en: 37 And he said, He that shewed mercy on him. Then said Jesus unto him, Go, and do thou likewise.
38 Now it came to pass, as they went, that he entered into a certain village: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.

rr: 39 Kandi akaba aine omurumuna orikwetwa Mariamu; we yaashutama aha bigyere bya Mukama waitu, naahurira ebigambo bye.
en: 39 And she had a sister called Mary, which also sat at Jesus' feet, and heard his word.

rr: 40 Kwonka Mariza akaba ayemereize omutima ahabw'emirimo mingi y'okuheereza; yaija ahari Yesu, yaamubuuza ati: Mukama wangye, tikirikukusaasa, murumuna wangye okumpenza emirimo? Mugambire ampwere.
en: 40 But Martha was cumbered about much serving, and came to him, and said, Lord, dost thou not care that my sister hath left me to serve alone? bid her therefore that she help me.

rr: 41 Mukama waitu yaamugarukamu ati: Mariza, Mariza, oyemereize omutima, noofa kubi n'ebintu bingi
en: 41 And Jesus answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things:
42 but one thing is needful: and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.

rr: 1 Yesu akaba ari omu mwanya gumwe naashaba; ku yaaherize, omwe aha beegi be yaamugira ati: Mukama waitu, twegyese okushaba, nk'oku Yohaana yaayegyeise abeegi be.
en: 1 And it came to pass, that, as he was praying in a certain place, when he ceased, one of his disciples said unto him, Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.
2 And he said unto them, When ye pray, say, Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done, as in heaven, so in earth.

rr: 3 ogume otuhe eby'okurya byaitu ebya buri izooba
en: 3 Give us day by day our daily bread.

rr: 4 otusaasire eby'okushiisha byaitu, ahakuba naitwe tusaasira omuntu weena oine eibanja ryaitu; kandi otatutwara omu kwohibwa.
en: 4 And forgive us our sins; for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us. And lead us not into temptation; but deliver us from evil.

rr: 5 Yaabagambira ati: N'oha omuriimwe oine munywani we, owaakuza owe omu itumbi, akamugira ati: Munywani wangye, nguza emigaati eshatu
en: 5 And he said unto them, Which of you shall have a friend, and shall go unto him at midnight, and say unto him, Friend, lend me three loaves;

rr: 6 ahabw'okuba munywani wangye ondiijo yaija naaruga omu rugyendo, tiinyine ky'okumugaburira
en: 6 for a friend of mine in his journey is come to me, and I have nothing to set before him?

rr: 7 we akeema omu nju, akamugira ati: Reka kundusya! Naakingire, kandi nyowe n'abaana bangye twabyamire; tindikubaasa kwimuka kugira eki naakuha.
en: 7 And he from within shall answer and say, Trouble me not: the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give thee.

rr: 8 Nimbagambira nti: N'obu yaakuba ataimukire kugimuheereza ahabw'okuba munywani we; kwonka ahabw'okugumizamu naamurusya, naija kwimuka amuhe ebi arikwenda byona.
en: 8 I say unto you, Though he will not rise and give him, because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will rise and give him as many as he needeth.
9 And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.

rr: 10 ahakuba omuntu weena oshaba aheebwa, osherura azoora, kandi oiguza aigurirwaho.
en: 10 For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.

rr: 11 Ni muzaire ki omuriimwe, ou omwana we yaakushaba omugaati, akamuha eibaare; nari eky'enyanja, akamuha enjoka omu mwanya gwakyo?
en: 11 If a son shall ask bread of any of you that is a father, will he give him a stone? or if he ask a fish, will he for a fish give him a serpent?

rr: 12 Nari shi, ku yaakumushaba eihuri, akaamuha skorupio?
en: 12 Or if he shall ask an egg, will he offer him a scorpion?

rr: 13 Imwe ku muraabe nimumanya kuha abaana baanyu ebiconco ebirungi, haza muri babi, mbwenu Shoimwe w'omu iguru tarikizaho kuha Omwoyo Orikwera abo abamushaba?
en: 13 If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children: how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him?
14 And he was casting out a devil, and it was dumb. And it came to pass, when the devil was gone out, the dumb spake; and the people wondered.

rr: 15 Kwonka abandi baagira bati: Omushaija ogu baadaimoni naababingisa Belezebuli mukama waabo.
en: 15 But some of them said, He casteth out devils through Beelzebub the chief of the devils.
16 And others, tempting him , sought of him a sign from heaven.

rr: 17 Yesu, ku yaamanyire ebiteekateeko byabo, yaabagira ati: Obugabe bwona ku bwebaganisamu, buhwerekyerezibwa; n'enju ku eyebaganisamu, egwa.
en: 17 But he, knowing their thoughts, said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house divided against an house falleth.

rr: 18 Mbwenu Sitaane, ku araabe naayebaganisamu wenka, obukama bwe buryagumaho buta? Ahabw'okuba mugira ngu, baadaimoni mbabingisa Belezebuli.
en: 18 If Satan also be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? because ye say that I cast out devils through Beelzebub.

rr: 19 Mbwenu nyowe baadaimoni ku ndaabe mbabingisa Belezebuli, abaana baanyu bo bababingisa oha? N'ahabw'ekyo abo nibo baribasingisa orubanja.
en: 19 And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your sons cast them out? therefore shall they be your judges.

rr: 20 Kwonka ku ndaabe mbingisa baadaimoni orukumu rwa Ruhanga, mumanye ngu obukama bwa Ruhanga bubahikireho.
en: 20 But if I with the finger of God cast out devils, no doubt the kingdom of God is come upon you.

rr: 21 Omuntu ow'amaani oine eby'okurwanisa bye, ku arinda eka ye, ebintu bye biguma omu busingye.
en: 21 When a strong man armed keepeth his palace, his goods are in peace:
22 but when a stronger than he shall come upon him, and overcome him, he taketh from him all his armour wherein he trusted, and divideth his spoils.

rr: 23 Obu tutakwatanisa, n'omuzigu wangye; kandi otataaruura hamwe naanye, ataataanisa.
en: 23 He that is not with me is against me: and he that gathereth not with me scattereth.

rr: 24 Daimoni, ku aruga omu muntu, araba omu mpita ezitarimu maizi, naasherura oburuhuukiro; ku bumuburira, agira ati: Ka ngarukye omu nju yangye omu naarugire.
en: 24 When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he saith, I will return unto my house whence I came out.

rr: 25 Daimoni ku agaruka, ashanga eyeyereire, eboneziibwe.
en: 25 And when he cometh, he findeth it swept and garnished.
26 Then goeth he, and taketh to him seven other spirits more wicked than himself; and they enter in, and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first.

rr: 27 Ku yaabaire naagamba ebyo, omukazi owaabaire ari omu bateeraniire aho yaagamba n'eiraka rihango, naamugira ati: Enda eyaakuzaire n'amabeere agu waayonkire biine omugisha!
en: 27 And it came to pass, as he spake these things, a certain woman of the company lifted up her voice, and said unto him, Blessed is the womb that bare thee, and the paps which thou hast sucked.

rr: 28 Yesu yaagarukamu ati: Okukira, abaine omugisha, n'abahurira ekigambo kya Ruhanga, bakakyorobera.
en: 28 But he said, Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word of God, and keep it.
29 And when the people were gathered thick together, he began to say, This is an evil generation: they seek a sign; and there shall no sign be given it, but the sign of Jonas the prophet.

rr: 30 Nk'oku Yona yaabaire akamanyiso aha ba Nineeve, nikwo n'Omwana w'omuntu ariba aha b'obusingye obu.
en: 30 For as Jonas was a sign unto the Ninevites, so shall also the Son of man be to this generation.

31 The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and condemn them: for she came from the utmost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
32 The men of Nineve shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.
33 No man, when he hath lighted a candle, putteth it in a secret place, neither under a bushel, but on a candlestick, that they which come in may see the light.
34 The light of the body is the eye: therefore when thine eye is single, thy whole body also is full of light; but when thine eye is evil, thy body also is full of darkness.

rr: 35 N'ahabw'ekyo oyerinde, omushana oguri omuriiwe gutaba omwirima.
en: 35 Take heed therefore that the light which is in thee be not darkness.

rr: 36 Ahakuba omubiri gwawe gwona ku gurikuba gwijwire omushana, gutaine kacweka na kamwe ak'omwirima, guryabeera kimwe omushana, nk'oku etabaaza ekumurikira n'okwaka kwayo.
en: 36 If thy whole body therefore be full of light, having no part dark, the whole shall be full of light, as when the bright shining of a candle doth give thee light.
37 And as he spake, a certain Pharisee besought him to dine with him: and he went in, and sat down to meat.
38 And when the Pharisee saw it , he marvelled that he had not first washed before dinner.
39 And the Lord said unto him, Now do ye Pharisees make clean the outside of the cup and the platter; but your inward part is full of ravening and wickedness.

rr: 40 Imwe bashema 'mwe, Ogwo owaahangire eby'aharuguru, tiwe yaahangire n'eby'omunda?
en: 40 Ye fools, did not he that made that which is without make that which is within also?

rr: 41 N'ahabw'ekyo ebiri omu nda zaanyu mube nibyo mwagabira abooro n'embabazi, haza obwo byona bibone kubabeera ebishemeziibwe.
en: 41 But rather give alms of such things as ye have; and, behold, all things are clean unto you.

rr: 42 Imwe Bafarisaayo 'mwe, muryakareeba! Ahabw'okuba muganura kimwe kya ikumi ky'enshogi, n'eshwiga, n'emboga zoona, kwonka mwehuzya okucwa emanja z'oburyo n'okukunda Ruhanga; ebyo mukaashemereire kubikora, kandi na biri okutabireka.
en: 42 But woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye tithe mint and rue and all manner of herbs, and pass over judgment and the love of God: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
43 Woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye love the uppermost seats in the synagogues, and greetings in the markets.

rr: 44 Muryakareeba, ahakuba nimushusha nk'ebituuro ebitarikureebwa, ebi abantu baribataho batamanyire.
en: 44 Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are as graves which appear not, and the men that walk over them are not aware of them .

rr: 45 Omwe aha beegyesa b'Ebiragiro yaamugambira ati: Mwegyesa, ku orikugira otyo, naitwe nooba otujumire.
en: 45 Then answered one of the lawyers, and said unto him, Master, thus saying thou reproachest us also.

rr: 46 Yesu yaagira ati: Imwe abeegyesa b'Ebiragiro, naimwe muryakareeba! Ahabw'okuba mukorera abantu emitwaro etarikubaasa kwekorerwa, haza kunu mutarikugikoraho na rukumu rwanyu.
en: 46 And he said, Woe unto you also, ye lawyers! for ye lade men with burdens grievous to be borne, and ye yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers.

rr: 47 Muryakareeba! Ahabw'okuba mwombeka ebituuro bya baanabi, abu baashwenkuriimwe baitsire.
en: 47 Woe unto you! for ye build the sepulchres of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.

rr: 48 Mutyo muhamya ebi baashwenkuriimwe baakozire kandi mubisiima; ahakuba bo bakaita baanabi, kandi imwe mwombeka ebituuro byabo.
en: 48 Truly ye bear witness that ye allow the deeds of your fathers: for they indeed killed them, and ye build their sepulchres.

rr: 49 N'ahabw'ekyo Obwengye bwa Ruhanga bukagamba buti: Ndyabatumaho baanabi n'entumwa; abamwe aharibo baryabaita, abandi baryabahiiga
en: 49 Therefore also said the wisdom of God, I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they shall slay and persecute:

rr: 50 eshagama ya baanabi boona eyaasheeshekire okuruga aha kuhangwa kw'ensi etukurie ab'obusingye obu
en: 50 that the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;
51 from the blood of Abel unto the blood of Zacharias, which perished between the altar and the temple: verily I say unto you, It shall be required of this generation.

rr: 52 Muryakareeba, imwe abeegyesa b'Ebiragiro! Ahabw'okuba mukaihaho ekishumuruzo ky'obwengye; imwe ahabwanyu timwataahamu, kandi n'abo abaabaire nibataahamu, mwabazibira.
en: 52 Woe unto you, lawyers! for ye have taken away the key of knowledge: ye entered not in yourselves, and them that were entering in ye hindered.

rr: 53 Ku yaarugireyo, abahandiiki n'Abafarisaayo baatandika kumumigisiriza n'amaani n'okumwegyenzaho, ngu bamugambise bingi
en: 53 And as he said these things unto them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to urge him vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things:
54 laying wait for him, and seeking to catch something out of his mouth, that they might accuse him.

rr: 1 Omu biro ebyo, abantu enkumi n'enkumi bakateerana, baaribatiirirana; yaatandikira aha beegi be kubagambira ati: Mwerinde ekitumbisa ky'Abafarisaayo, nibwo buryarya.
en: 1 In the mean time, when there were gathered together an innumerable multitude of people, insomuch that they trode one upon another, he began to say unto his disciples first of all, Beware ye of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
2 For there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; neither hid, that shall not be known.

rr: 3 Eki mwagambiire omu mwirima kyona kiryahuririrwa omu mushana; n'eki mwagambiire omu kutu, muri omu kishengye, kiryagambirwa aha mutwe gw'enju.
en: 3 Therefore whatsoever ye have spoken in darkness shall be heard in the light; and that which ye have spoken in the ear in closets shall be proclaimed upon the housetops.

rr: 4 Kandi nimbagambira, imwe banywani bangye, mutatiina abo abarikwita omubiri, bwanyima bataine kindi ki barikubaasa kukora.
en: 4 And I say unto you my friends, Be not afraid of them that kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.

rr: 5 Kwonka nimbahabura ou muraatiine; mutiine Ogwo, oine obushoboorozi bw'okunaga omuntu omuri Gehena yaaheza kumwita; eego, nimbagambira nti: Mutiine Ogwo.
en: 5 But I will forewarn you whom ye shall fear: Fear him, which after he hath killed hath power to cast into hell; yea, I say unto you, Fear him.

rr: 6 Ebiteera-nkumba bitaano tibigurwa sente ibiri? Kwonka tihariho na kimwe aharibyo ekyeba omu maisho ga Ruhanga.
en: 6 Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, and not one of them is forgotten before God?

rr: 7 Nangwa n'eishokye ry'aha mitwe yaanyu ribazirwe ryona. Mutatiina; muri ab'obuguzi okukira ebiteera-nkumba bingi.
en: 7 But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not therefore: ye are of more value than many sparrows.

rr: 8 Kandi nimbagambira nti: Omuntu weena orimpamya omu maisho g'abantu, Omwana w'omuntu nawe aryamuhamya omu maisho ga baamaraika ba Ruhanga
en: 8 Also I say unto you, Whosoever shall confess me before men, him shall the Son of man also confess before the angels of God:
9 but he that denieth me before men shall be denied before the angels of God.
10 And whosoever shall speak a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but unto him that blasphemeth against the Holy Ghost it shall not be forgiven.
11 And when they bring you unto the synagogues, and unto magistrates, and powers, take ye no thought how or what thing ye shall answer, or what ye shall say:

rr: 12 ahakuba Omwoyo Orikwera aryabeegyesa omuri egyo shaaha eki mushemereire kugamba.
en: 12 for the Holy Ghost shall teach you in the same hour what ye ought to say.

rr: 13 Omuntu owaabaire ari omu mutwe ogwo yaamushaba ati: Mwegyesa, ragiira mwene tata tubagane obuhunguzi bwaitu.
en: 13 And one of the company said unto him, Master, speak to my brother, that he divide the inheritance with me.

rr: 14 Yesu yaamugira ati: Iwe mushaija 'we, n'oha owantaireho kubacwera orubanja, nari shi okuba ow'okubabaganisiza?
en: 14 And he said unto him, Man, who made me a judge or a divider over you?
15 And he said unto them, Take heed, and beware of covetousness: for a man's life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.

rr: 16 Yaabacwera enfumu ati: Hakaba hariho omutungi owaabaire aine emisiri eyezire munonga.
en: 16 And he spake a parable unto them, saying, The ground of a certain rich man brought forth plentifully:

rr: 17 Yaayebuuza omu mutima gwe ati: Ngire nta; ahakuba tiinyine h'okuhunika emyaka yangye?
en: 17 and he thought within himself, saying, What shall I do, because I have no room where to bestow my fruits?

rr: 18 Yaagira ati: Eki ndaakore n'eki; niinyija kusheenya ebitara byangye, nyombekye ebirikukira obuhango; omwo nimwo ndaahunikye emyaka yangye yoona
en: 18 And he said, This will I do: I will pull down my barns, and build greater; and there will I bestow all my fruits and my goods.

rr: 19 obwo ndyagambira omutima gwangye nti: Mutima gwangye, oine ebintu bingi ebibiikirwe eby'okumara emyaka mingi; mbwenu huumura, orye, onywe, oshemererwe.
en: 19 And I will say to my soul, Soul, thou hast much goods laid up for many years; take thine ease, eat, drink, and be merry.
20 But God said unto him, Thou fool, this night thy soul shall be required of thee: then whose shall those things be, which thou hast provided?

rr: 21 Nikwo omuntu ashusha atyo, oyebiikira obutungi, haza atari mutungi ahari Ruhanga.
en: 21 So is he that layeth up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.
22 And he said unto his disciples, Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat; neither for the body, what ye shall put on.

rr: 23 Ahakuba amagara nigakira eby'okurya, n'omubiri nigukira ebijwaro.
en: 23 The life is more than meat, and the body is more than raiment.
24 Consider the ravens: for they neither sow nor reap; which neither have storehouse nor barn; and God feedeth them: how much more are ye better than the fowls?

rr: 25 N'oha omuriimwe, orikubaasa kwongyera # 12:25 nari: aha rugyero rwe ekita na kimwe. ekiro na kimwe aha rugyero rw'emyaka y'obukuru bwe ahabw'okwemereza omutima?
en: 25 And which of you with taking thought can add to his stature one cubit?

rr: 26 Mbwenu ku muraabe mutarikubaasa kukora ekintu kikye nk'ekyo, nimwemerereza ki emitima ahabw'ebindi?
en: 26 If ye then be not able to do that thing which is least, why take ye thought for the rest?

rr: 27 Muteekateekye aha birabyo oku bimera; tibigira murimo, tibiruka myenda; kwonka nimbagabmira nti: Nangwana Sulemaani omu kitiinisa kye kyona taraizihiirwe nka kimwe aharibyo.
en: 27 Consider the lilies how they grow: they toil not, they spin not; and yet I say unto you, that Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

rr: 28 Mbwenu Ruhanga, ku araabe ajweka atyo obunyaatsi bw'omu ishwa, oburiho eri izooba, nyencakare bukanagwa omu mahega, taribajweka okubukira imwe abaine okwikiriza kukye?
en: 28 If then God so clothe the grass, which is to day in the field, and to morrow is cast into the oven; how much more will he clothe you, O ye of little faith?

rr: 29 Mutarisherura eki muraarye nari eki muraanywe, kandi mutaryemereza emitima.
en: 29 And seek not ye what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink, neither be ye of doubtful mind.

rr: 30 Nimumanya ngu ebyo byona amahanga goona ag'omu nsi nibyo gasherura; kandi Shoimwe naamanya ku mubikyenire.
en: 30 For all these things do the nations of the world seek after: and your Father knoweth that ye have need of these things.

rr: 31 Kureka musherure obukama bwa Ruhanga, n'ebyo nabyo muryabyongyerwa.
en: 31 But rather seek ye the kingdom of God; and all these things shall be added unto you.

rr: 32 Mutatiina, imwe obusyo obukye, ahabw'okuba Shoimwe naasiima munonga kubaha obukama.
en: 32 Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father's good pleasure to give you the kingdom.
33 Sell that ye have, and give alms; provide yourselves bags which wax not old, a treasure in the heavens that faileth not, where no thief approacheth, neither moth corrupteth.

rr: 34 Ahakuba ahu eitungo ryanyu riri, n'omutima gwanyu niho guba.
en: 34 For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
35 Let your loins be girded about, and your lights burning;
36 and ye yourselves like unto men that wait for their lord, when he will return from the wedding; that when he cometh and knocketh, they may open unto him immediately.

37 Blessed are those servants, whom the lord when he cometh shall find watching: verily I say unto you, that he shall gird himself, and make them to sit down to meat, and will come forth and serve them.

rr: 38 # 12:38 Omu Rugriika: ku ariija omu bunaku bw'abarinzi ba kabiri nari aba kashatu. Ku ariija abantu bahirwayo, nari omu itumbi, yaashanga abahuuku abo bari batyo, baryaba baine omugisha.
en: 38 And if he shall come in the second watch, or come in the third watch, and find them so, blessed are those servants.
39 And this know, that if the goodman of the house had known what hour the thief would come, he would have watched, and not have suffered his house to be broken through.

rr: 40 Naimwe mugume mweteekateekire; ahabw'okuba omu shaaha ei muteeteekateekyeiremu Omwana w'omuntu niyo ariiziramu.
en: 40 Be ye therefore ready also: for the Son of man cometh at an hour when ye think not.

rr: 41 Petero yaamubuuza ati: Mukama wangye, enfumu egi ei waacwa, niitwe waagicwera, nari waagicwera n'abandi boona?
en: 41 Then Peter said unto him, Lord, speakest thou this parable unto us, or even to all?
42 And the Lord said, Who then is that faithful and wise steward, whom his lord shall make ruler over his household, to give them their portion of meat in due season?

rr: 43 Aine omugisha, omugaragwa ogwo, ou mukama we ariija, akashanga naakora atyo.
en: 43 Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.

rr: 44 Buzimazima nimbagambira nti: Aryamukwatsa ebi atungire byona.
en: 44 Of a truth I say unto you, that he will make him ruler over all that he hath.

rr: 45 Kwonka omugaragwa ogwo, ku arigira omu mutima gwe ati: Mukama wangye atwireyo, yaatandika kuteera abahuuku n'abazaana, kandi n'okurya n'okunywa n'okusinda
en: 45 But and if that servant say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming; and shall begin to beat the menservants and maidens, and to eat and drink, and to be drunken;

rr: 46 mukama w'omugaragwa ogwo aryaija aha kiro eki atarikumuteekateekyeraho, n'omu shaaha ei atarikumanya, aryamwasha, amuhe omugabo gwe hamwe n'abatarikwesigwa.
en: 46 the lord of that servant will come in a day when he looketh not for him , and at an hour when he is not aware, and will cut him in sunder, and will appoint him his portion with the unbelievers.
47 And that servant, which knew his lord's will, and prepared not himself , neither did according to his will, shall be beaten with many stripes .

rr: 48 kwonka otarabimanyire, akakora ebishemereire kumuteeza, aryateerwa nkye.
en: 48 But he that knew not, and did commit things worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few stripes .

rr: Omuntu weena orikuheebwa bingi, aryabuuzibwa bingi; n'ogwo orikwatsibwa bingi, niwe barikira kwenza bingi.
en: For unto whomsoever much is given, of him shall be much required: and to whom men have committed much, of him they will ask the more.

rr: 49 Nkaija kunaga omuriro aha nsi, kandi ku guraabe gwakwatsire, ekindi niinyenda ki?
en: 49 I am come to send fire on the earth; and what will I, if it be already kindled?
50 But I have a baptism to be baptized with; and how am I straitened till it be accomplished!
51 Suppose ye that I am come to give peace on earth? I tell you, Nay; but rather division:

rr: 52 Okuruga hati omu nju emwe haryabamu bataano bataanukaine, abashatu n'ababiri, n'ababiri n'abashatu batakwataniise.
en: 52 for from henceforth there shall be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.

53 The father shall be divided against the son, and the son against the father; the mother against the daughter, and the daughter against the mother; the mother in law against her daughter in law, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.
54 And he said also to the people, When ye see a cloud rise out of the west, straightway ye say, There cometh a shower; and so it is.

rr: 55 Ku mureeba omuyaga nigwiha omu bukiizi-bwa-buryo, mugira ngu nihaija kujwa omushana mwingi; kandi nikwo kiba.
en: 55 And when ye see the south wind blow, ye say, There will be heat; and it cometh to pass.

rr: 56 Imwe ndyarya 'mwe, mumanya kukyenga enshusha y'ensi n'eiguru; beitu ahabw'enki mutamanya kukyenga obunaku obu?
en: 56 Ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky and of the earth; but how is it that ye do not discern this time?

rr: 57 Kandi ahanki imwe ahabwanyu mutamanya ekihikire?
en: 57 Yea, and why even of yourselves judge ye not what is right?

58 When thou goest with thine adversary to the magistrate, as thou art in the way, give diligence that thou mayest be delivered from him; lest he hale thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and the officer cast thee into prison.

rr: 59 Ninkugambira nti: Torirugamu okuhitsya obu oriihura eibanja ryona, otatsigyeyo nangwa na sente emwe.
en: 59 I tell thee, thou shalt not depart thence, till thou hast paid the very last mite.
1 There were present at that season some that told him of the Galilæans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.

rr: 2 Yaabagarukamu ati: Nimugira ngu Abanyagalilaaya abo bakaba bari abasiisi okukira abandi Banyagalilaaya boona, nikyo baitiirwe kubi batyo?
en: 2 And Jesus answering said unto them, Suppose ye that these Galilæans were sinners above all the Galilæans, because they suffered such things?

rr: 3 Nimbagambira nti: Tikwo kiri; mumanye ngu naimwe, ku muraabe muteeteisize, muryahwerekyerera mwena nkabo.
en: 3 I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.

rr: 4 Nari shi, abantu abo ikumi na munaana, abu omunaara gw'omuri Siloamu gwagwereire, gukabaita, nimugira ngu bakaba bari abasiisi okukira abandi boona abaabaire batuura Yerusaalemu?
en: 4 Or those eighteen, upon whom the tower in Siloam fell, and slew them, think ye that they were sinners above all men that dwelt in Jerusalem?

rr: 5 Nimbagambira nti: Tikwo kiri; mumanye ngu naimwe ku muraabe muteeteisize, muryahwerekyerera mwena nkabo.
en: 5 I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.
6 He spake also this parable; A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard; and he came and sought fruit thereon, and found none.

rr: 7 Yaagira omuhingi w'emizaabibu ati: Reeba, mmazire emyaka egi eshatu niinyija kusherura ebyana aha mutiini ogu, nibimburira. Guteme; nigwitira ki omwanya?
en: 7 Then said he unto the dresser of his vineyard, Behold, these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree, and find none: cut it down; why cumbereth it the ground?
8 And he answering said unto him, Lord, let it alone this year also, till I shall dig about it, and dung it :

rr: 9 Bwanyima ku guryana, kiryaba gye; ku guriba gutaanire, oryagutema.
en: 9 and if it bear fruit, well : and if not, then after that thou shalt cut it down.

rr: 10 Ku yaabaire naayegyesa omuri sinagogi emwe aha izooba rya Sabato
en: 10 And he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath.

rr: 11 hakaba harimu omukazi omazire emyaka ikumi na munaana ariho daimoni orikumuzya; akaba ainami, atarikubaasa kwinamuka.
en: 11 And, behold, there was a woman which had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and was bowed together, and could in no wise lift up herself .

rr: 12 Yesu ku yaamureebire, yaamweta, yaamugira ati: Mukazi 'we, waabohoororwa omu bumuga bwawe.
en: 12 And when Jesus saw her, he called her to him , and said unto her, Woman, thou art loosed from thine infirmity.

rr: 13 Yaamutaho engaro; ahonaaho yaagororoka, yaahimbisa Ruhanga.
en: 13 And he laid his hands on her: and immediately she was made straight, and glorified God.

rr: 14 Kwonka omukuru wa sinagogi yaagira ekiniga ahabw'okuba Yesu yaatamba ahari Sabato, yaagambira abantu ati: Hariho ebiro mukaaga, ebishemereire kukorerwamu emirimo; n'ahabw'ekyo mube nibyo mwaguma nimwiziramu kutambirwa, kwonka ti hari Sabato.
en: 14 And the ruler of the synagogue answered with indignation, because that Jesus had healed on the sabbath day, and said unto the people, There are six days in which men ought to work: in them therefore come and be healed, and not on the sabbath day.
15 The Lord then answered him, and said, Thou hypocrite, doth not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or his ass from the stall, and lead him away to watering?

rr: 16 N'omukazi ogu, muhara wa Abrahamu, ou Sitaane yaabohire emyaka ikumi na munaana, tashemereire kubohororwa omu bumuga obu aha izooba rya Sabato?
en: 16 And ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan hath bound, lo, these eighteen years, be loosed from this bond on the sabbath day?

rr: 17 Ku yaagambire ebyo, abazigu be boona baakwatwa enshoni; abantu boona baashemrererwa eby'ekitiinisa byona ebi yaakozire.
en: 17 And when he had said these things, all his adversaries were ashamed: and all the people rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.
18 Then said he, Unto what is the kingdom of God like? and whereunto shall I resemble it?

rr: 19 Nibushusha nk'akajuma ka sinaapi, aku omuntu yaatwaire, akakabiba omu musiri gwe; bwanyima kakakura, kakaba omuti; enyonyi z'omu mwanya zikaarika omu mataagi gaagwo.
en: 19 It is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and cast into his garden; and it grew, and waxed a great tree; and the fowls of the air lodged in the branches of it.

rr: 20 Yaagaruka yaagira ati: Obukama bwa Ruhanga mbugyeranise na ki!
en: 20 And again he said, Whereunto shall I liken the kingdom of God?

rr: 21 Nibushusha nk'ekitumbisa eki omukazi yaatwaire, akakishereka omu ncuro z'esaano ishatu, okuhitsya obu zoona zaatumbisiibwe.
en: 21 It is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.

rr: 22 Yaagumizamu yaaraba omuri tauni n'ebirorero, naayegyesa, ari omu muhanda naaza Yerusaalemu.
en: 22 And he went through the cities and villages, teaching, and journeying toward Jerusalem.

rr: 23 Omwe yaamubuuza ati: Mukama wangye, biri abarikujunwa ni bakye? Yesu yaabagira ati
en: 23 Then said one unto him, Lord, are there few that be saved? And he said unto them,
24 Strive to enter in at the strait gate: for many, I say unto you, will seek to enter in, and shall not be able.

25 When once the master of the house is risen up, and hath shut to the door, and ye begin to stand without, and to knock at the door, saying, Lord, Lord, open unto us; and he shall answer and say unto you, I know you not whence ye are:

rr: 26 Naimwe muryatandika kugira muti: Tukaba turiira kandi tunywera omu maisho gaawe, kandi naiwe okaba oyegyesa omu mihanda y'owaitu.
en: 26 then shall ye begin to say, We have eaten and drunk in thy presence, and thou hast taught in our streets.

rr: 27 Kwonka aryabagarukamu ati: Nimbagambira nti: Tindikumanya i murikuruga; mundugye omumaisho, imwe enkozi z'ebibi.
en: 27 But he shall say, I tell you, I know you not whence ye are; depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity.
28 There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth, when ye shall see Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, and all the prophets, in the kingdom of God, and you yourselves thrust out.
29 And they shall come from the east, and from the west, and from the north, and from the south, and shall sit down in the kingdom of God.

rr: 30 Kandi reeba, hariho ab'enyima abariba ab'okubanza, n'ab'okubanza abariba ab'enyima.
en: 30 And, behold, there are last which shall be first, and there are first which shall be last.

rr: 31 Omu shaaha egyo bamwe aha Bafarisaayo baija baamugira bati: Ruga aha, ogyende; ahabw'okuba Heroode naayenda kukwita.
en: 31 The same day there came certain of the Pharisees, saying unto him, Get thee out, and depart hence: for Herod will kill thee.

rr: 32 Yaabagira ati: Mugyende mugambire muha egyo, muti: Reeba, naabinga baadaimoni, naakiza endwara eri izooba na nyencakare; kimwe eki yaiziriire.
en: 32 And he said unto them, Go ye, and tell that fox, Behold, I cast out devils, and I do cures to day and to morrow, and the third day I shall be perfected.

rr: 33 Kwonka nshemereire kugumizamu eri izooba na nyencakare na bwasheesha; ahakuba tikirikubaasika nabi kuhwerekyererera ahandi, kureka Yerusaalemu.
en: 33 Nevertheless I must walk to day, and to morrow, and the day following: for it cannot be that a prophet perish out of Jerusalem.

34 O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, which killest the prophets, and stonest them that are sent unto thee; how often would I have gathered thy children together, as a hen doth gather her brood under her wings, and ye would not!
