35 Behold, your house is left unto you desolate: and verily I say unto you, Ye shall not see me, until the time come when ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
1 And it came to pass, as he went into the house of one of the chief Pharisees to eat bread on the sabbath day, that they watched him.

rr: 2 Kandi omu maisho ge hakaba hariho omushaija orwaire orusimba.
en: 2 And, behold, there was a certain man before him which had the dropsy.

rr: 3 Yesu yaabuuza abeegyesa b'Ebiragiro n'Abafarisaayo ati: Ebiragiro nibiikiriza okukiza ahari Sabato nari hsi tikwo?
en: 3 And Jesus answering spake unto the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath day?

rr: 4 Baahunama. Yesu yaamukwata, yaamukiza, yaamwohereza.
en: 4 And they held their peace. And he took him , and healed him, and let him go;
5 and answered them, saying, Which of you shall have an ass or an ox fallen into a pit, and will not straightway pull him out on the sabbath day?

rr: 6 Baabura eky'okumugarukamu ahari ekyo.
en: 6 And they could not answer him again to these things.
7 And he put forth a parable to those which were bidden, when he marked how they chose out the chief rooms; saying unto them,
8 When thou art bidden of any man to a wedding, sit not down in the highest room; lest a more honourable man than thou be bidden of him;

rr: 9 obeetsire mwembi akaija, akakugira ati: Heereza ogu omwanya, okatandika kugaruka omu mwanya gw'enyima y'endiijo yoona noobwerabwera.
en: 9 and he that bade thee and him come and say to thee, Give this man place; and thou begin with shame to take the lowest room.

rr: 10 Kwonka ku oryetwa aha bugyenyi, ogyende oshutame omu mwanya gw'enyima y'endiijo yoona, okwetsire ku araije, akugira ati: Munywani wangye, irira omumaisho; obwo oryagira ekitiinisa omu maisho gaabo boona abu oshutami nabo aha by'okurya.
en: 10 But when thou art bidden, go and sit down in the lowest room; that when he that bade thee cometh, he may say unto thee, Friend, go up higher: then shalt thou have worship in the presence of them that sit at meat with thee.

rr: 11 Ahakuba weena orikwetunguura aryagarurwa ahansi; kandi orikwegarura ahansi, aryatunguurwa.
en: 11 For whosoever exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.

rr: 12 Kandi yaagambira n'ogwo omwetsire ati: KU oriba waateekyeire abantu eby'okurya nyomushana nari nyekiro, otaryeta banywani baawe, nari beene sho, nari beene waanyu, n'obu baakuba bataahi baawe abantungi, nabo obundi batakaakweta nk'oku waabeetsire, bakakwihura.
en: 12 Then said he also to him that bade him, When thou makest a dinner or a supper, call not thy friends, nor thy brethren, neither thy kinsmen, nor thy rich neighbours; lest they also bid thee again, and a recompence be made thee.

rr: 13 Kwonka, ku oriba waateekire eby'okurya, oyete abooro, ebimuga, ebirema, n'empumi
en: 13 But when thou makest a feast, call the poor, the maimed, the lame, the blind:
14 and thou shalt be blessed; for they cannot recompense thee: for thou shalt be recompensed at the resurrection of the just.

rr: 15 Omwe ahari abo abaabaire bashutami nawe aha by'okurya, ku yaahuriire ebyo, yaamugira ati: Oririira eby'okurya omu bukama bwa Ruhanga aine omugisha!
en: 15 And when one of them that sat at meat with him heard these things, he said unto him, Blessed is he that shall eat bread in the kingdom of God.
16 Then said he unto him, A certain man made a great supper, and bade many:

rr: 17 Obunaku bw'okurya ku bwahikire, yaatuma omuhuuku kugambira abeetsirwe, ati: Mwije; ahakuba byona byatebeekanisiibwe.
en: 17 and sent his servant at supper time to say to them that were bidden, Come; for all things are now ready.

rr: 18 Boona baatandika kwekwatsakwatsa nk'abaragaine. Ow'okubanza yaamugira ati: Nguzire ekibanja, nshemereire kugyenda nkireebe. Naakweshengyereza, ondereere.
en: 18 And they all with one consent began to make excuse. The first said unto him, I have bought a piece of ground, and I must needs go and see it: I pray thee have me excused.

rr: 19 Ondiijo yaagira ati: Nguzire enimi ikumi z'okuhingisa; ninza kuzigyeza; naakweshengyereza, ondereere.
en: 19 And another said, I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I go to prove them: I pray thee have me excused.

rr: 20 Ondiijo yaagira ati: Ntaahize omukazi, n'ahabw'ekyo tindikubaasa kwija.
en: 20 And another said, I have married a wife, and therefore I cannot come.

rr: 21 Omuhuuku yaagaruka, yaabitekyerereza mukama we.
en: 21 So that servant came, and shewed his lord these things.

rr: Nyineeka nikwo kukwatwa ekiniga, akagira omuhuuku we ati: Irooko oze omu nguuto n'omu mihanda omuri tauni, oreete abooro n'ebimuga n'empumi n'abarikucumbagira.
en: Then the master of the house being angry said to his servant, Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in hither the poor, and the maimed, and the halt, and the blind.

rr: 22 Bwanyima omuhuuku yaamugira ati: Mukama wangye, ei waaragiira kyakorwa; kwonka hakiriho omwanya.
en: 22 And the servant said, Lord, it is done as thou hast commanded, and yet there is room.

rr: 23 Mukama we yaagira omuhuuku we ati: Gyenda omu mihanda n'omu buhanda oburikuraba omu bikaari, ogyeme abantu baije, enju yangye eijure.
en: 23 And the lord said unto the servant, Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.

rr: 24 Ahakuba nimbagambira nti: Tihariho n'omwe ahari abo abeetsirwe, oraatamire aha by'okurya ebi mbateekyeire.
en: 24 For I say unto you, That none of those men which were bidden shall taste of my supper.

rr: 25 Emitwe y'abantu baingi yaamukuratira; Yesu yaabahindukira, yaabagira ati
en: 25 And there went great multitudes with him: and he turned, and said unto them,
26 If any man come to me, and hate not his father, and mother, and wife, and children, and brethren, and sisters, yea, and his own life also, he cannot be my disciple.
27 And whosoever doth not bear his cross, and come after me, cannot be my disciple.

rr: 28 N'oha omuriimwe, owaakuba naayenda kwombeka omunaara, atabanze kushutama akabariirira eby'emirimo yaagwo, akamanya ku araabe aine eby'okuguheza
en: 28 For which of you, intending to build a tower, sitteth not down first, and counteth the cost, whether he have sufficient to finish it ?

rr: 29 ku yaakuba atatwarize atyo, akiba yaaheza omusingi, akaremerwa aho, abarikukireeba boona bakaatandika kumushekyerera
en: 29 Lest haply, after he hath laid the foundation, and is not able to finish it , all that behold it begin to mock him,

rr: 30 nibagira bati: Omushaija ogu akatandika kwombeka, tiyaabaasa kuheza.
en: 30 saying, This man began to build, and was not able to finish.

rr: 31 Kandi ni mugabe ki, owaakuza kurwana n'ondi, atabanze kushutama, akeehanuuza ku araabe naabaasa kuhurura n'engabo ze kakumi, ngu abone kurwanisa ogwo oizire kumuteera n'engabo obukumi bubiri?
en: 31 Or what king, going to make war against another king, sitteth not down first, and consulteth whether he be able with ten thousand to meet him that cometh against him with twenty thousand?

rr: 32 Ku areeba atarikubaasa, atuma ahari oriya entumwa, akiri hare munonga amubuuza eki yaakumuhongyera, ngu bagire obusingye.
en: 32 Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sendeth an ambassage, and desireth conditions of peace .

rr: 33 N'ahabw'ekyo omuntu weena omuriimwe tarikubaasa kuba mwegi wangye, yaaba atatsigire bi aine byona.
en: 33 So likewise, whosoever he be of you that forsaketh not all that he hath, he cannot be my disciple.
34 Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be seasoned?

rr: 35 Niguba gutakishemererera musiri, n'obu rwakuba orubungo; bafa okugunaga.
en: 35 It is neither fit for the land, nor yet for the dunghill; but men cast it out.

rr: Oine amatu agarikuhurira, ahurire.
en: He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

rr: 1 Abahooza n'abasiisi bakaba nibamwirira haihi kumuhurira.
en: 1 Then drew near unto him all the publicans and sinners for to hear him.
2 And the Pharisees and scribes murmured, saying, This man receiveth sinners, and eateth with them.

rr: 3 Yesu nikwo kubacwera enfumu egi ati
en: 3 And he spake this parable unto them, saying,
4 What man of you, having an hundred sheep, if he lose one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he find it?

rr: 5 Ku agibona, agiheeka aha mabega ge, ashemereirwe.
en: 5 And when he hath found it , he layeth it on his shoulders, rejoicing.

rr: 6 Ku ahika omuka, ayeta banywani be na bataahi be, naabagira ati: Mushemererwe naanye, ahabw'okuba mboine entaama yangye ebaire ebuzire.
en: 6 And when he cometh home, he calleth together his friends and neighbours, saying unto them, Rejoice with me; for I have found my sheep which was lost.

rr: 7 Nimbagambira nti: Nikwo n'omu iguru barishemerererwa batyo omusiisi omwe orikweteisa, okukira abahikiriire makumi mwenda na mwenda abatarikwetenga kweteisa.
en: 7 I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.

rr: 8 Nari shi ni mukazi ki, oine empiiha z'efeeza ikumi, ku haakuburaho # 15:8 rupiiha omu Rugriika ni drachma. rupiiha emwe, otakaakongyeza etabaaza, akeeyerera enju, akeezirika kusherura okuhitsya ahu arigibonera?
en: 8 Either what woman having ten pieces of silver, if she lose one piece, doth not light a candle, and sweep the house, and seek diligently till she find it ?

rr: 9 Ku agibona, ayeta banywani be na bataahi be, naagira ati: Mushemererwe naanye, ahabw'okuba mboine rupiiha yangye ebaire ebuzire.
en: 9 And when she hath found it , she calleth her friends and her neighbours together, saying, Rejoice with me; for I have found the piece which I had lost.

rr: 10 Nimbagira nti: Nikwo hariho okushemererwa omu maisho ga baamaraika ba Ruhanga ahabw'omusiisi omwe orikweteisa.
en: 10 Likewise, I say unto you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth.

rr: 11 Kandi yaagira ati: Hakaba hariho omushaija owaabaire aine abatabani babiri.
en: 11 And he said, A certain man had two sons:

rr: 12 Omuto yaashaba ishe ati: Taata, mpa omugabo gw'ebintu ebi waakundagire.
en: 12 and the younger of them said to his father, Father, give me the portion of goods that falleth to me .

rr: Ishe yaababaganisiza eitungo rye.
en: And he divided unto them his living.
13 And not many days after the younger son gathered all together, and took his journey into a far country, and there wasted his substance with riotous living.

rr: 14 Ku yaabiherizeho, haabaho enjara nyingi omu nsi egyo; yaaconcoboza.
en: 14 And when he had spent all, there arose a mighty famine in that land; and he began to be in want.

rr: 15 Ahabw'ekyo yaagyenda, yaashumba aha muntu ow'omu nsi egyo; omushaija ogwo yaamwoherezaomu mariisizo ge kuriisa empunu.
en: 15 And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine.

rr: 16 Yaayetenga kurya ebishushu ebi empunu zaabaire zirya, kandi tihariho waabaire amuha ekintu kyona.
en: 16 And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat: and no man gave unto him.

rr: 17 Ku yaayegarukiremu, yaayebuuza ati: Abapakasi ni bangahi abarikukorera tata, abarya eby'okurya bakaremwa; haza nyowe enjara neenyitira aha!
en: 17 And when he came to himself, he said, How many hired servants of my father's have bread enough and to spare, and I perish with hunger!
18 I will arise and go to my father, and will say unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and before thee,

rr: 19 tinshemereire kwetwa omwana waawe; ongire nk'omwe aha bapakasi baawe abakorera ebihembo.
en: 19 and am no more worthy to be called thy son: make me as one of thy hired servants.

rr: 20 Yaimuka kuza owa ishe.
en: 20 And he arose, and came to his father.

rr: Ku yaabaire akiri hare munonga, ishe yaamureeba, yaakwatwa embabazi, yairuka, yaamugwa omudna, yaamunywegyera.
en: But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him, and had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.

rr: 21 Omwana yaamugira ati: Taata, nkacumura aha W'omu iguru, kandi n'omu maisho gaawe, tinkiri w'okwetwa omwana waawe.
en: 21 And the son said unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in thy sight, and am no more worthy to be called thy son.

rr: 22 Kwonka ishe yaaragiira abahuuku be ati: Mwehuute mureete ekijwaro ekirikukira oburungi, mukumujwekye, n'empeta omu rukumu, n'enkaito omu bigyere
en: 22 But the father said to his servants, Bring forth the best robe, and put it on him; and put a ring on his hand, and shoes on his feet:

rr: 23 mureete enyana y'ebishaju, mugiite, turye, tushemererwe
en: 23 and bring hither the fatted calf, and kill it ; and let us eat, and be merry:
24 for this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found. And they began to be merry.

rr: 25 Obwo mukuru we akaba ari omu musiri; ku yaarugireyo, yairira haihi n'eka, yaahurira emikuri n'okuzina.
en: 25 Now his elder son was in the field: and as he came and drew nigh to the house, he heard musick and dancing.

rr: 26 Yaayeta omwe aha bahuuku, yaamubuuza ebyo oku biri.
en: 26 And he called one of the servants, and asked what these things meant.

rr: 27 We yaamugarukamu ati: Murumuna waawe yaija; kandi sho yaamubaagira enyana y'ebishaju, ahabw'okumubona akihuriire.
en: 27 And he said unto him, Thy brother is come; and thy father hath killed the fatted calf, because he hath received him safe and sound.
28 And he was angry, and would not go in: therefore came his father out, and intreated him.

rr: 29 omwojo ogwo yaagarukamu ishe ati: Reeba, mmazire emyaka mingi ninkuheereza, tinkagomeraga kiragiro kyawe kyona; kwonka tokampaga kabuzi, ngu naanye nshemererwe n'abanywani bangye.
en: 29 And he answering said to his father, Lo, these many years do I serve thee, neither transgressed I at any time thy commandment: and yet thou never gavest me a kid, that I might make merry with my friends:

rr: 30 Mbwenu omwana waawe ogu, owaamariire obutungi bwawe omuri baamaraaya, ku yaija, waamubaagira enyana y'ebishaju.
en: 30 but as soon as this thy son was come, which hath devoured thy living with harlots, thou hast killed for him the fatted calf.

rr: 31 Ishe yaamugira ati: Mwana wangye, otuura naanye ebiro byona, kandi ebyangye byona n'ebyawe.
en: 31 And he said unto him, Son, thou art ever with me, and all that I have is thine.

rr: 32 Kwonka eky'okwesiima n'okushemererwa kyaba kihikire; ahabw'okuba murumuna waawe ogu akaba afiire, hati yaazooka; akaba azaahire, mbwenu yaazaahuuka.
en: 32 It was meet that we should make merry, and be glad: for this thy brother was dead, and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.

rr: 1 Yesu yaagaruka yaagira abeegi be ati: Hakaba hariho omuntu omutungi, owaabaire aine omubiiki; baamumuregaho ku arikushiisha ebintu bye.
en: 1 And he said also unto his disciples, There was a certain rich man, which had a steward; and the same was accused unto him that he had wasted his goods.

rr: 2 Yaamweta, yaamubuuza ati: Eki, eki ndikukuhuriraho, n'enki? Nyoeka oku waatwarize eby'obubiiki bwawe; ahakuba tokishemerera kuba mubiiki wangye.
en: 2 And he called him, and said unto him, How is it that I hear this of thee? give an account of thy stewardship; for thou mayest be no longer steward.

rr: 3 Omubiiki yaayebuuza ati: Ngire nta, ahabw'okuba mukama wangye yaaza kumbinga omu tubiiki? Tiinyine maani g'okuhinga, kandi n'okushabiriza nikuunyitsa enshoni.
en: 3 Then the steward said within himself, What shall I do? for my lord taketh away from me the stewardship: I cannot dig; to beg I am ashamed.

rr: 4 Mbwenu naamanya eki ndaakore, kikantaasya omu maka g'abantu, ku ndaabingwe omu bubiiki.
en: 4 I am resolved what to do, that, when I am put out of the stewardship, they may receive me into their houses.

rr: 5 Yaayeta weena oine eibanja rya mukama we, yaabuuza ow'okubanza ati: Mukama wangye naakwihuza ki?
en: 5 So he called every one of his lord's debtors unto him , and said unto the first, How much owest thou unto my lord?

rr: 6 Yaamugarukamu ati: Encuro z'amajuta igana. Omubiiki yaamugira ati: Kwata orupapura rwawe oru orikwihurizibwaho, orahukye kushutama, ohandiikyeho makumi ataano.
en: 6 And he said, An hundred measures of oil. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and sit down quickly, and write fifty.

rr: 7 Yaabuuza ondiijo ati: Iwe naakwihuza ki?
en: 7 Then said he to another, And how much owest thou?

rr: Onu yaamugira ati: Ebitenga by'engano igana.
en: And he said, An hundred measures of wheat.

rr: Yaamugira ati: Kwata orupapura rwawe oru orikwihurizibwaho, ohandiikyeho makumi munaana.
en: And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and write fourscore.
8 And the lord commended the unjust steward, because he had done wisely: for the children of this world are in their generation wiser than the children of light.
9 And I say unto you, Make to yourselves friends of the mammon of unrighteousness; that, when ye fail, they may receive you into everlasting habitations.

rr: 10 Oyesigwa omu bikye munonga, niwe ayesigwa n'omu bingi; kandi oteesigwa mu bikye munonga, niwe ateesigwa na mu bingi.
en: 10 He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much: and he that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much.

rr: 11 Ku muraabe mubaire mutari beesigwa mu butungi obutari bw'okuhikiirira, n'oha oribakwatsa obutungi bw'amazima?
en: 11 If therefore ye have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches ?

rr: 12 Kandi ku muraabe mubaire mutari beesigwa mu by'abandi, n'oha oribaha ebyanyu eby'okwetegyekyera?
en: 12 And if ye have not been faithful in that which is another man's, who shall give you that which is your own?
13 No servant can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.

rr: 14 Abafarisaayo, abaabaire bari abakunzi b'empiiha, ku baahuriire ebyo byona, baamushekyerera.
en: 14 And the Pharisees also, who were covetous, heard all these things: and they derided him.
15 And he said unto them, Ye are they which justify yourselves before men; but God knoweth your hearts: for that which is highly esteemed among men is abomination in the sight of God.
16 The law and the prophets were until John: since that time the kingdom of God is preached, and every man presseth into it.

rr: 17 Nikirahuka eiguru n'ensi okuhwaho okukira akatoonyezi kamwe k'omu Biragiro okuhwaho.
en: 17 And it is easier for heaven and earth to pass, than one tittle of the law to fail.
18 Whosoever putteth away his wife, and marrieth another, committeth adultery: and whosoever marrieth her that is put away from her husband committeth adultery.

rr: 19 Hakaba hariho omutungi, owaabaire ajwara ebijwaro bya bujwa n'emyenda ya bafuta emirungi, kandi ebiro byona akaba asiiba ajarami, naarya gye.
en: 19 There was a certain rich man, which was clothed in purple and fine linen, and fared sumptuously every day:

rr: 20 Kandi hakaba hariho n'omworo, owaabaire naayetwa Laazaaro, ou baabaire babyamya aha irembo ry'omutungi ogwo, omubiri gwe gwijwire ebironda.
en: 20 and there was a certain beggar named Lazarus, which was laid at his gate, full of sores,
21 and desiring to be fed with the crumbs which fell from the rich man's table: moreover the dogs came and licked his sores.

rr: 22 Bwanyima omworo ogwo yaafa, yaatwarwa baamaraika omu kifuba kya Abrahamu. Omutungi ogwo nawe yaafa, yaaziikwa.
en: 22 And it came to pass, that the beggar died, and was carried by the angels into Abraham's bosom: the rich man also died, and was buried;

rr: 23 Ku yaahikire okuzimu, yainamura amaisho ge naahururwa, yaareeba Abrahamu hare na Laazaaro ari omu kifuba kye.
en: 23 and in hell he lift up his eyes, being in torments, and seeth Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in his bosom.

rr: 24 Yaayeta munonga naagira ati: Taata Abrahamu, nsaasira, otume Laazaaro akoze enshonga y'orukumu rwe omu maizi, afukiirize orurimi rwangye; ahabw'okuba nimpururwa omu muriro ogu.
en: 24 And he cried and said, Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water, and cool my tongue; for I am tormented in this flame.

rr: 25 Kwonka Abrahamu yaagira ati: Mwana wangye, ijuka oku waahairwe ebirungi byawe okiri omu nsi, na Laazaaro nikwo yaahairwe ebibi; mbwenu hati ari aha, ari gye, iwe noohururwa.
en: 25 But Abraham said, Son, remember that thou in thy lifetime receivedst thy good things, and likewise Lazarus evil things: but now he is comforted, and thou art tormented.

rr: 26 Kandi t'ekyo kyonka, ahagati yaitu naimwe hariho orusa ruhango orwataireho, ngu ruremese abarikwenda kuruga aha kuza ei muri, kandi ngu ruzibire omuntu weena kuruga okwo kwija ahu turi.
en: 26 And beside all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed: so that they which would pass from hence to you cannot; neither can they pass to us, that would come from thence.

rr: 27 Omutungi yaagira ati: Mbwenu ninkweshengyereza, Taata, omutume owa tata
en: 27 Then he said, I pray thee therefore, father, that thou wouldest send him to my father's house:

rr: 28 ahakuba nyineyo barumuna bangye bataano, abahabure, nabo barekye kwija omu mwanya ogu ogurimu okuhururwa munonga.
en: 28 for I have five brethren; that he may testify unto them, lest they also come into this place of torment.
29 Abraham saith unto him, They have Moses and the prophets; let them hear them.

rr: 30 Omutungi yaagira ati: Ngaaha, Taata Abrahamu; ku haraazeyo ozookire omu bafu, baryayeteisa.
en: 30 And he said, Nay, father Abraham: but if one went unto them from the dead, they will repent.
31 And he said unto him, If they hear not Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded, though one rose from the dead.

rr: 1 Yesu yaagira abeegi be ati: Ebirikugwisa tibiribura kwija; kwonka oribireeta aryakareeba.
en: 1 Then said he unto the disciples, It is impossible but that offences will come: but woe unto him , through whom they come!
2 It were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he cast into the sea, than that he should offend one of these little ones.
3 Take heed to yourselves: If thy brother trespass against thee, rebuke him; and if he repent, forgive him.

rr: 4 ku araakukore kubi eizooba rimwe emirundi mushanju, yaakuhindukira emirundi mushanju naagira ati: Nyeteisize; omusaasire.
en: 4 And if he trespass against thee seven times in a day, and seven times in a day turn again to thee, saying, I repent; thou shalt forgive him.

rr: 5 Entumwa zaagira Mukama waitu ziti: Twongyereho okwikiriza?
en: 5 And the apostles said unto the Lord, Increase our faith.
6 And the Lord said, If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye might say unto this sycamine tree, Be thou plucked up by the root, and be thou planted in the sea; and it should obey you.

rr: 7 N'oha omuriimwe oine omuhuuku orikuhinga, nari orikuriisa entaama, ou yaakugambira naakiruga aha murimo, ati: Rahuka oije, oshutame, orye?
en: 7 But which of you, having a servant plowing or feeding cattle, will say unto him by and by, when he is come from the field, Go and sit down to meat?

rr: 8 Omu mwanya gw'okumigira ati: Ihura eby'okurya, oyezirikye, ompeereze, okuhitsya obu ndaaheze kurya n'okunywa; bwanyima obone kurya n'okunywa?
en: 8 And will not rather say unto him, Make ready wherewith I may sup, and gird thyself, and serve me, till I have eaten and drunken; and afterward thou shalt eat and drink?

rr: 9 Nimugira ngu naasiima omuhuuku ogwo ahabw'okukora eki yaaragiirwa?
en: 9 Doth he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded him? I trow not.

rr: 10 Muutyo naimwe, ku muraagume mwaheza kukora byona ebi muragiirwe, mugire muti: Turi abahuuku abataine mugasho; ebi twakora nibyo ebyo ebi tushemereire kukora.
en: 10 So likewise ye, when ye shall have done all those things which are commanded you, say, We are unprofitable servants: we have done that which was our duty to do.

rr: 11 Ku baabaire nibaza Yerusaalemu, yaaraba ahagati ya Samaria na Galilaaya.
en: 11 And it came to pass, as he went to Jerusalem, that he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee.
12 And as he entered into a certain village, there met him ten men that were lepers, which stood afar off:

rr: 13 baagamba n'eiraka rihango bati: Yesu Mmwegyesa, otugirire embabazi.
en: 13 and they lifted up their voices, and said, Jesus, Master, have mercy on us.
14 And when he saw them , he said unto them, Go shew yourselves unto the priests. And it came to pass, that, as they went, they were cleansed.

rr: 15 Omwe aharibo, ku yaareebire yaakira, yaakuba, yaagaruka naahimbisa Ruhanga n'eiraka rihango
en: 15 And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, and with a loud voice glorified God,

rr: 16 yaajuumara aha bigyere bya Yesu, yaamusiima. Kandi ogwo akaba ari Omusamaria.
en: 16 and fell down on his face at his feet, giving him thanks: and he was a Samaritan.

rr: 17 Yesu yaabuuza ati: Abaashemezibwa t'ikumi? Omwenda barahi?
en: 17 And Jesus answering said, Were there not ten cleansed? but where are the nine?

rr: 18 Tihariho n'omwe owaagaruka kuhimbisa Ruhaga, kureka omunyaihanga ogu?
en: 18 There are not found that returned to give glory to God, save this stranger .

rr: 19 Yaamugira ati: Imuka oyegyendere; okwikiriza kwawe nikwo kwakukiza.
en: 19 And he said unto him, Arise, go thy way: thy faith hath made thee whole.
20 And when he was demanded of the Pharisees, when the kingdom of God should come, he answered them and said, The kingdom of God cometh not with observation:

rr: 21 kandi tibarigira ngu, Reeba mbubu! Nari, mburiya! Ahakuba obukama bwa Ruhanga buri omuriimwe.
en: 21 neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there! for, behold, the kingdom of God is within you.

rr: 22 Yaagira abeegi be ati: Ebiro biryahika obu muryetenga kureeba ekiro kimwe aha biro by'Omwana w'omuntu, haza mutakireebe.
en: 22 And he said unto the disciples, The days will come, when ye shall desire to see one of the days of the Son of man, and ye shall not see it .
23 And they shall say to you, See here; or, see there: go not after them , nor follow them .
24 For as the lightning, that lighteneth out of the one part under heaven, shineth unto the other part under heaven; so shall also the Son of man be in his day.

rr: 25 Kwonka ashemereire kubanza kubonabonesibwa omuri bingi, n'okwangwa ab'obusingye obu.
en: 25 But first must he suffer many things, and be rejected of this generation.
26 And as it was in the days of Noe, so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man.
27 They did eat, they drank, they married wives, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.
28 Likewise also as it was in the days of Lot; they did eat, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they builded;
29 but the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed them all.

rr: 30 Nikwo kiriba kityo n'aha kiro eki Omwana w'omuntu arishuuruurirwaho.
en: 30 Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man is revealed.
31 In that day, he which shall be upon the housetop, and his stuff in the house, let him not come down to take it away: and he that is in the field, let him likewise not return back.

rr: 32 Mwijukye muka Looti.
en: 32 Remember Lot's wife.

rr: 33 Omuntu weena orikwenda kukiza amagara ge, aryagabuza; kandi orikubuza amagara ge, aryagakiza.
en: 33 Whosoever shall seek to save his life shall lose it; and whosoever shall lose his life shall preserve it.

rr: 34 Nimbagambira nti: Aha kiro ekyo abashaija babiri baryaba bari aha kitabo kimwe; omwe aryatwarwa, ondiijo atsigweho.
en: 34 I tell you, in that night there shall be two men in one bed; the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.
35 Two women shall be grinding together; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

rr: 36 Abashaija babiri baryaba bari omu musiri, omwe aryatwarwa, ondiijo atsigweho.
en: 36 Two men shall be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
37 And they answered and said unto him, Where, Lord? And he said unto them, Wheresoever the body is , thither will the eagles be gathered together.
1 And he spake a parable unto them to this end , that men ought always to pray, and not to faint;

rr: 2 Yaabagira ati: Omuri tauni emwe hakaba harimu omuramuzi owaabaire atatiina Ruhanga, n'obu kwakuba okweta aha bantu.
en: 2 saying, There was in a city a judge, which feared not God, neither regarded man:

rr: 3 Kandi omuri tauni egyo hakaba harimu omufaakazi owaabaire aija obutoosha naamugambira ati: Nshoboorora n'omuzigu wangye.
en: 3 and there was a widow in that city; and she came unto him, saying, Avenge me of mine adversary.

rr: 4 Ogwo muramuzi yaamara omwanya ayangire; kwonka bwanyima yaagira omu mutima gwe ati: N'obu ndaabe ntatiina Ruhanga, nari okweta aha bantu
en: 4 And he would not for a while: but afterward he said within himself, Though I fear not God, nor regard man;

rr: 5 kwonka omufaakazi ogu ahabw'okundusya, naaza kumushoboorora, arekye kuguma naija obutoosha kundusya.
en: 5 yet because this widow troubleth me, I will avenge her, lest by her continual coming she weary me.

rr: 6 Mukama waitu yaagira ati: Muhurire omuramuzi otahikiriire ei arikugamba.
en: 6 And the Lord said, Hear what the unjust judge saith.

rr: 7 Nimugira ngu Ruhanga tarishoboorora entoore ze, ezimutakira nyomushana na nyekiro? Aryazituuzaho?
en: 7 And shall not God avenge his own elect, which cry day and night unto him, though he bear long with them?

rr: 8 Imbagambira nti: Aryarahuka kubashoboorora.
en: 8 I tell you that he will avenge them speedily.

rr: Beitu Omwana w'omuntu ku ariija, ebyo aryashanga okwikiriza omu nsi?
en: Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth?

rr: 9 Kandi yaacwera enfumu egi abantu bamwe abaabaire nibeemanya ngu bahikiriire, haza nibagaya abandi.
en: 9 And he spake this parable unto certain which trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and despised others:

rr: 10 Ati: Abantu babiri bakainamuka omuri hekalu kushaba, omwe akaba ari Omufarisaayo n'ondiijo ari omuhooza.
en: 10 Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a publican.
11 The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, God, I thank thee, that I am not as other men are , extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican.
12 I fast twice in the week, I give tithes of all that I possess.
13 And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner.
14 I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other: for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.
15 And they brought unto him also infants, that he would touch them: but when his disciples saw it , they rebuked them.

rr: 16 Kwonka Yesu yaabeeta ah'ari, naagira ati: Murekye abaana bato baije ahariinye, mutabazibira, ahabw'okuba obukama bwa Ruhanga n'obw'abari nk'abo.
en: 16 But Jesus called them unto him , and said, Suffer little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.
17 Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child shall in no wise enter therein.
18 And a certain ruler asked him, saying, Good Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?

rr: 19 Yesu yaamugira ati: Noonyetera ki omurungi? Tihariho murungi, kureka omwe wenka, niwe Ruhanga.
en: 19 And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? none is good, save one, that is , God.

rr: 20 Noomanya ebiragiro, Otarishambana, Otariita, Otariiba, Otaribeiherera ondiijo, Otiine sho na nyoko.
en: 20 Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honour thy father and thy mother.

rr: 21 Yaagira ati: Ebyo byona nkabyerinda okuruga omu buto bwangye.
en: 21 And he said, All these have I kept from my youth up.

rr: 22 Yesu ku yaakihuriire, yaamugira ati: Mbwenu nooburwaho kimwe; tunda ebi otungire byona, obihe abooro, oryatunga eitungo omu iguru; haza oije, onkuratire.
en: 22 Now when Jesus heard these things, he said unto him, Yet lackest thou one thing: sell all that thou hast, and distribute unto the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.

rr: 23 Ku yaabihuriire, yaagira enaku nyingi, ahabw'okuba akaba ari omutungi munonga.
en: 23 And when he heard this, he was very sorrowful: for he was very rich.

rr: 24 Yesu ku yaamwetegyereize, yaagira ati: Ka nikiremeera abantungi kutaaha omu bukama bwa Ruhanga!
en: 24 And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful, he said, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!

rr: 25 Nikirahuka engamira kuraba omu nyindo y'empitirizo, okukira omutungi kutaaha omu bukama bwa Ruhanga.
en: 25 For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

rr: 26 Abaakihuriire baagira bati: Mbwenu shi hoona, n'oha orikubaasa kujunwa?
en: 26 And they that heard it said, Who then can be saved?

rr: 27 Yaabagira ati: Ekitarikubaasika ha bantu nikibaasika ahari Ruhanga.
en: 27 And he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.

rr: 28 Petero yaamugira ati: Reeba, itwe tukatsiga ebyaitu, twakukuratira.
en: 28 Then Peter said, Lo, we have left all, and followed thee.

rr: 29 Yesu yaabagira ati: Buzimazima nimbagambira ati: Buzimazima nimbagambira nti: Tihariho muntu owaatsigire enju, nari omukazi, nari beene ishe, nari abazaire be, nari abaana be, ahabw'okubukama bwa Ruhanga
en: 29 And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or parents, or brethren, or wife, or children, for the kingdom of God's sake,

rr: 30 otariheebwa bingi okukiraho omu biro ebi, kandi omu busingye oburiija akaheebwa amagara agatahwaho.
en: 30 who shall not receive manifold more in this present time, and in the world to come life everlasting.
31 Then he took unto him the twelve, and said unto them, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem, and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of man shall be accomplished.

rr: 32 Aryaheebwayo aha Banyamahanga, baryamushungisa, bamugire kubi, bamucwere amacwante
en: 32 For he shall be delivered unto the Gentiles, and shall be mocked, and spitefully entreated, and spitted on:

rr: 33 baryamwasha, baryamwita, kandi aha kiro kya kashatu aryazooka.
en: 33 and they shall scourge him , and put him to death: and the third day he shall rise again.

rr: 34 Kwonka tibaashoborokyerwa kigambo na kimwe ahari ebyo, ahabw'okuba ekigambo ekyo kikaba kibasherekirwe, tibaamanya bi baagambirwa.
en: 34 And they understood none of these things: and this saying was hid from them, neither knew they the things which were spoken.
35 And it came to pass, that as he was come nigh unto Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the way side begging:

rr: 36 Ku yaahuriire omutwe gw'abantu nigurabaho, egyo mpumi yaabuuza eti: N'enki ekyo?
en: 36 and hearing the multitude pass by, he asked what it meant.

rr: 37 Baagigira bati: Yesu owa Nazareesi niwe arikuhingura.
en: 37 And they told him, that Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.

rr: 38 Yaayeta munonga ati: Yesu, Omwana wa Daudi, ngirira embabazi.
en: 38 And he cried, saying, Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.

rr: 39 Abaabaire beebembeire baagigambira kubi, nibagicureeza; kwonka yo yaakizaho kweta munonga eti: Iwe Mwana wa Daudi, ngirira embabazi!
en: 39 And they which went before rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried so much the more, Thou Son of David, have mercy on me.

rr: 40 Yesu yaayemerera, yaaragiira ku bagimureetera; ku yaamuhikire, yaagibuuza ati
en: 40 And Jesus stood, and commanded him to be brought unto him: and when he was come near, he asked him,

rr: 41 Nooyenda ngu nkukorere ki? Yaagira eti: Mukama wangye, niinyenda ngu mpumuukye.
en: 41 saying, What wilt thou that I shall do unto thee? And he said, Lord, that I may receive my sight.

rr: 42 Yesu yaagigira ati: Humuuka; okwikiriza kwawe nikwo kwakukiza.
en: 42 And Jesus said unto him, Receive thy sight: thy faith hath saved thee.

rr: 43 Ahonaaho yaahumuuka, yaamukuratira naahimbisa Ruhanga; n'abantu boona ku baakireebire, baasiima Ruhanga.
en: 43 And immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God: and all the people, when they saw it , gave praise unto God.

rr: 1 Yaataaha omuri Yeriko, yaagumizamu naahingura.
en: 1 And Jesus entered and passed through Jericho.

rr: 2 Kandi hakaba hariho omushaija orikwetwa Zakaayo omuhooza mukuru, kandi omutungi.
en: 2 And, behold, there was a man named Zacchæus, which was the chief among the publicans, and he was rich.

rr: 3 Yaayenda kureeba oku Yesu arikushusha; kwonka tiyaabaasa ahabw'omutwe gw'abantu, kandi n'ahabw'okuba mugufu.
en: 3 And he sought to see Jesus who he was; and could not for the press, because he was little of stature.

rr: 4 N'ahabw'ekyo yairuka, yaaza omumaisho, yaatemba omuri gw'omusikamoori, ngu amureebe; ahakuba akaba naija kuraba aho.
en: 4 And he ran before, and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him: for he was to pass that way .

rr: 5 Yesu ku yaahikire omu mwanya ogwo, yaareeba ahaigur, yaamugira ati: Zakaayo, rahuka, temburuka; ahabw'okuba erizooba nshemereire kusiiba omu nju yaawe.
en: 5 And when Jesus came to the place, he looked up, and saw him, and said unto him, Zacchæus, make haste, and come down; for to day I must abide at thy house.

rr: 6 Yaarahuka kutemburuka, yaamutaasya owe ashemereirwe.
en: 6 And he made haste, and came down, and received him joyfully.
7 And when they saw it , they all murmured, saying, That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner.
8 And Zacchæus stood, and said unto the Lord; Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him fourfold.
9 And Jesus said unto him, This day is salvation come to this house, forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham.
10 For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.
11 And as they heard these things, he added and spake a parable, because he was nigh to Jerusalem, and because they thought that the kingdom of God should immediately appear.

rr: 12 Nikyo yaagiriire ati: Omunyiginya omwe akagyenda omu nsi ya hare kuheebwa obugabe ngu bwanyima agarukye.
en: 12 He said therefore, A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.

rr: 13 Yaayeta # 19:13 Omu Rugriika n'omuhuuku. abambari be ikumi, ati: Muzishuuuze, okuhitsya obu ndigaruka.
en: 13 And he called his ten servants, and delivered them ten pounds, and said unto them, Occupy till I come.
14 But his citizens hated him, and sent a message after him, saying, We will not have this man to reign over us.

rr: 15 Ku yaagarukire, aheirwe obugabe, yaaragiira kumwetera abambari abo abu yaahaire empiiha, ngu amanye enshaagi ezi baihire omu kushuubura kwabo.
en: 15 And it came to pass, that when he was returned, having received the kingdom, then he commanded these servants to be called unto him, to whom he had given the money, that he might know how much every man had gained by trading.

rr: 16 Ow'okubanza yaija omu maisho ge, yaagira ati: Mukama wangye, miina yaawe eshaagizemu ezindi miina ikumi.
en: 16 Then came the first, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained ten pounds.
17 And he said unto him, Well, thou good servant: because thou hast been faithful in a very little, have thou authority over ten cities.

rr: 18 N'owa kabiri yaija, yaagira ati: Mukama wangye, miina yaawe eshaagizemu ezindi miina itaano.
en: 18 And the second came, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained five pounds.

rr: 19 Yaamugira ati: Naiwe otegyekye endembo itaano.
en: 19 And he said likewise to him, Be thou also over five cities.

rr: 20 N'ondiijo yaija, yaagira ati: Mukama wangye, miina yaawe ngigi! Nkagibiika omu kiremu.
en: 20 And another came, saying, Lord, behold, here is thy pound, which I have kept laid up in a napkin:

rr: 21 Ahakuba nkakutiina, ahabw'okuba oba omuntu ogumire; oyaanura ebi otaanikire; ogyesha ebi otabibire.
en: 21 for I feared thee, because thou art an austere man: thou takest up that thou layedst not down, and reapest that thou didst not sow.

rr: 22 Yaamugira ati: Iwe mwambari 'we omubi, ninkucwera orubanja, niinyiha aha bi waagamba.
en: 22 And he saith unto him, Out of thine own mouth will I judge thee, thou wicked servant.

rr: Okamanya ku ndi omuntu ogumire, ku nyanura ebi ntaanikire, nkagyesha ebi ntabibire.
en: Thou knewest that I was an austere man, taking up that I laid not down, and reaping that I did not sow:

rr: 23 Mbwenu n'enki ekyakuzibiire kuha empiiha zangye abazibiika kuzishuubuza, naanye ku naakugarukire, nkaaziihireyo n'enshaagi?
en: 23 wherefore then gavest not thou my money into the bank, that at my coming I might have required mine own with usury?

rr: 24 Yaagambira abaabaire beemereire aho ati: Mumwakye miina egyo, mugihe oine miina ikumi.
en: 24 And he said unto them that stood by, Take from him the pound, and give it to him that hath ten pounds.

rr: 25 Baamugira bati: Mukama waitu, ka aine ezindi kumi!
en: 25 (And they said unto him, Lord, he hath ten pounds.)
26 For I say unto you, That unto every one which hath shall be given; and from him that hath not, even that he hath shall be taken away from him.

rr: 27 Kandi abo bazigu bangye abatarenzire ku mbategyeka, mubareete aha, mubaitire omu maisho gangye.
en: 27 But those mine enemies, which would not that I should reign over them, bring hither, and slay them before me.

rr: 28 Ku yaaherize kugamba ebyo, yaagumizamu kwinamuka Yerusaalemu.
en: 28 And when he had thus spoken, he went before, ascending up to Jerusalem.
29 And it came to pass, when he was come nigh to Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount called the mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples,

rr: 30 Mugyende omu kirorero ekibari omumaisho; ku muraabe nimutaahamu, nimwija kushanga omwana gw'endogoya gutisbikire, ogutakatembwahoga muntu; mugutsibure, mugureete aha.
en: 30 saying, Go ye into the village over against you ; in the which at your entering ye shall find a colt tied, whereon yet never man sat: loose him, and bring him hither .

rr: 31 Omuntu weena, ku araababuuze ati: Nimugutsiburira ki? Mugarukyemu muti: Mukama waitu naagwenda.
en: 31 And if any man ask you, Why do ye loose him ? thus shall ye say unto him, Because the Lord hath need of him.

rr: 32 Abo abatumirwe baagyenda, baashanga kiri nk'oku yaabagambira.
en: 32 And they that were sent went their way, and found even as he had said unto them.

rr: 33 Ku baabaire nibatsibura omwana gw'endogoya, bakama baagwo baababuuza bati: Nimutsiburira ki omwana gw'endogoya?
en: 33 And as they were loosing the colt, the owners thereof said unto them, Why loose ye the colt?

rr: 34 Baabagarukamu bati: Mukama waitu naagwenda.
en: 34 And they said, The Lord hath need of him.

rr: 35 Baagureetera Yesu, baagutaho ebijwaro byabo, baagumushutamyaho.
en: 35 And they brought him to Jesus: and they cast their garments upon the colt, and they set Jesus thereon.

rr: 36 Ku yaabaire naagyenda, baayara ebijwaro byabo omu nguuto.
en: 36 And as he went, they spread their clothes in the way.

rr: 37 KU yairiire haihi, yaahika aha kashuumo k'ekibungo kya Zituuni, omutwe gwona gw'abeegi be gwatandika kushemererwa n'okuhimbisa Ruhang n'eiraka rihango ahabw'eby'okutangaaza ebi baareebire
en: 37 And when he was come nigh, even now at the descent of the mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works that they had seen;
38 saying, Blessed be the King that cometh in the name of the Lord: peace in heaven, and glory in the highest.

rr: 39 Bamwe aha Bafarisaayo abaabaire bari omu mutwe ogwo, baamugira bati: Mwegyesa, hana abeegi baawe.
en: 39 And some of the Pharisees from among the multitude said unto him, Master, rebuke thy disciples.

rr: 40 Yaabagarukamu ati: Nimbagambira nti: Aba ku baakuhunama, amabaare gakaagamba munonga.
en: 40 And he answered and said unto them, I tell you that, if these should hold their peace, the stones would immediately cry out.
41 And when he was come near, he beheld the city, and wept over it,
42 saying, If thou hadst known, even thou, at least in this thy day, the things which belong unto thy peace! but now they are hid from thine eyes.

rr: 43 Ahakuba ebiro biryakwizira, abazigu baawe bakuzitireho orugo, bakwehinguririze, bakutangatangye embaju zoona
en: 43 For the days shall come upon thee, that thine enemies shall cast a trench about thee, and compass thee round, and keep thee in on every side,
44 and shall lay thee even with the ground, and thy children within thee; and they shall not leave in thee one stone upon another; because thou knewest not the time of thy visitation.
45 And he went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold therein, and them that bought;
46 saying unto them, It is written, My house is the house of prayer; but ye have made it a den of thieves.
47 And he taught daily in the temple. But the chief priests and the scribes and the chief of the people sought to destroy him,

rr: 48 baabura eki baraakore, ahakuba abantu boona bakata omutima munonga aha bigambo bye.
en: 48 and could not find what they might do: for all the people were very attentive to hear him.
1 And it came to pass, that on one of those days, as he taught the people in the temple, and preached the gospel, the chief priests and the scribes came upon him with the elders,

rr: 2 baamugira bati: tugambire, ni bushoboorozi ki oburikukukoresa ebi, kandi n'oha owaakuhaire obushoboorozi obu?
en: 2 and spake unto him, saying, Tell us, by what authority doest thou these things? or who is he that gave thee this authority?

rr: 3 Yaabagarukamu ati: Reka naanye mbabuuze ekigambo kimwe, haza mungarukyemu.
en: 3 And he answered and said unto them, I will also ask you one thing; and answer me:

rr: 4 Okubatiza kwa Yohaana kukaruga omu iguru nari omu bantu?
en: 4 The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men?

rr: 5 Baahanuura bonka nibagira bati: Ku turaagire tuti, Kukaruga omu iguru, naatugarukamu ati, Kandi shi, n'enki ekyabazibiire kumwikiriza?
en: 5 And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then believed ye him not?

rr: 6 Kandi ku turaagire tuti, Kukaruga omu bantu, abantu boona nibaija kututeera amabaare, ahakuba nibahamiza kimwe ngu Yohaana akaba ari nabi.
en: 6 But and if we say, Of men; all the people will stone us: for they be persuaded that John was a prophet.

rr: 7 Baagarukamu ngu tibarikumanya ei kwarugire.
en: 7 And they answered, that they could not tell whence it was .

rr: 8 Yesu nikwo kubagira ati: Naanye tindikwija kubagambira bushoboorozi oburikunkoresa ebi.
en: 8 And Jesus said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.
9 Then began he to speak to the people this parable; A certain man planted a vineyard, and let it forth to husbandmen, and went into a far country for a long time.
10 And at the season he sent a servant to the husbandmen, that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard: but the husbandmen beat him, and sent him away empty.

rr: 11 Yaagaruka yaabatumaho ondiijo muhuuku, nawe baamuteera, baamuhemangura, baamubinga, yaagarukayo engaro nsha.
en: 11 And again he sent another servant: and they beat him also, and entreated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.

rr: 12 Nabwo yaagaruka yaabatumaho owa kashatu; ogwo baamuhutaaza, baamunaga aheeru.
en: 12 And again he sent a third: and they wounded him also, and cast him out.

rr: 13 Mukama w'omusiri gw'emizaabiru yaagira ati: Ngire nta?
en: 13 Then said the lord of the vineyard, What shall I do?

rr: Niinyija kutuma omwana wangye ou ndikukunda; shana baryamuha ekitiinisa.
en: I will send my beloved son: it may be they will reverence him when they see him.

rr: 14 Kwonka abahingi abo ku baamureebire, baacuma enaama bonka, nibagira bati: Ogu niwe muhunguzi; murekye tumwite, obuhunguzi bube obwaitu.
en: 14 But when the husbandmen saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, This is the heir: come, let us kill him, that the inheritance may be our's.

rr: 15 Baamubinga omu musiri gw'emizaabibu, baamwita. Mbwenu mukama w'ogwo musiri aryabagira ata?
en: 15 So they cast him out of the vineyard, and killed him . What therefore shall the lord of the vineyard do unto them?

rr: 16 Aryaija, acwekyereze abo bahingi, n'ogwo musiri gw'emizaabibu aguhe abandi.
en: 16 He shall come and destroy these husbandmen, and shall give the vineyard to others.

rr: Ku baakihuriire, baagira bati; Nikikabure!
en: And when they heard it , they said, God forbid.
17 And he beheld them, and said, What is this then that is written,
18 Whosoever shall fall upon that stone shall be broken; but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.

rr: 19 Omu mwanya ogwo abhandiiki n'abanyamurwa abakuru baacwa obwengye kumukwata, kwonka baatiina abantu; ahabw'okuba bakamanya ngu nibo yaarengyeza.
en: 19 And the chief priests and the scribes the same hour sought to lay hands on him; and they feared the people: for they perceived that he had spoken this parable against them.

20 And they watched him , and sent forth spies, which should feign themselves just men, that they might take hold of his words, that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor.

rr: 21 Baamubuuza bati: Mwegyesa, nitumanya ngu ogamba kandi oyegyesa omuhanda gwa Ruhanga omu mazima.
en: 21 And they asked him, saying, Master, we know that thou sayest and teachest rightly, neither acceptest thou the person of any , but teachest the way of God truly:

rr: 22 Ebiragiro nibiikiriza okuha Kaisaari omushoro, nari tikwo?
en: 22 Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Cæsar, or no?

rr: 23 Ku yaamanyire oburyarya bwabo, yaabagira ati
en: 23 But he perceived their craftiness, and said unto them, Why tempt ye me?

rr: 24 Muunyorekye edenaari. Ekishushani n'ebihandiikirweho n'eby'oha? Baagira bati: N'ebya Kaisaari.
en: 24 Shew me a penny. Whose image and superscription hath it? They answered and said, Cæsar's.

rr: 25 Yaabagira ati: Mbwenu nu ebya Kaisaari mubihe Kaisaari, n'ebya Ruhanga mubihe Ruhanga.
en: 25 And he said unto them, Render therefore unto Cæsar the things which be Cæsar's, and unto God the things which be God's.

rr: 26 Tibaabaasa kumwihaho kigambo omuri ebyo omu maisho g'abantu; baatangaarira okugarukamu kwe, baahunama.
en: 26 And they could not take hold of his words before the people: and they marvelled at his answer, and held their peace.
27 Then came to him certain of the Sadducees, which deny that there is any resurrection; and they asked him,
28 saying, Master, Moses wrote unto us, If any man's brother die, having a wife, and he die without children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

rr: 29 Mbwenu hakaba hariho enyineemwe mushanju; mukuru waabo yaashwera omukazi, yaafa atakamuzaireho mwana
en: 29 There were therefore seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and died without children.

rr: 30 n'owa kabiri nikwo
en: 30 And the second took her to wife, and he died childless.

rr: 31 n'owa kashatu yaamuhungura, okuhitsya boona mushanju obu bahweireho batamuzaireho baana.
en: 31 And the third took her; and in like manner the seven also: and they left no children, and died.

rr: 32 Bwanyima omukazi nawe yaabakurata, yaafa.
en: 32 Last of all the woman died also.

rr: 33 Mbwenu omu kuzooka aryaba muka oha? Ahabw'okuba boona mushanju bakamushwera.
en: 33 Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them is she? for seven had her to wife.

rr: 34 Yesu yaabagira ati: Abaana b'obusingye obu bashwera kandi bahingirwa
en: 34 And Jesus answering said unto them, The children of this world marry, and are given in marriage:

rr: 35 kwonka abarikuteekateekwa ku bashemereire kuhika omu busingye obwo n'aha kuzooka kw'abafu, tibarishwera, kandi tibarihingirwa.
en: 35 but they which shall be accounted worthy to obtain that world, and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage:

rr: 36 Tibaribaasa kufa bwa kabiri, ahakuba baryashusha nka baamaraika; kandi n'abaana ba Ruhanga, ahabw'okuba n'abaana b'okuzooka.
en: 36 neither can they die any more: for they are equal unto the angels; and are the children of God, being the children of the resurrection.
37 Now that the dead are raised, even Moses shewed at the bush, when he calleth the Lord the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.

rr: 38 Ruhanga ti Ruhanga w'abafu, kureka ow'abahuriire; ahakuba omu maisho ge boona baba abahuriire.
en: 38 For he is not a God of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him.

rr: 39 Bamwe aha bahandiiki baagarukamu bati: Mwegyesa, waagamba gye.
en: 39 Then certain of the scribes answering said, Master, thou hast well said.

rr: 40 Okuruga aho tihaine waagarukire kumuturukirira kumubuuza ekindi.
en: 40 And after that they durst not ask him any question at all .
41 And he said unto them, How say they that Christ is David's son?
42 And David himself saith in the book of Psalms,

rr: 43 Okuhitsya obu ndigira abazigu baawe
en: 43 Till I make thine enemies thy footstool.

rr: 44 Ahabw'ekyo Daudi, ku araabe amweta Mukama we, naabaasa ata kuba omwana we?
en: 44 David therefore calleth him Lord, how is he then his son?
45 Then in the audience of all the people he said unto his disciples,

rr: 46 Mwerinde abahandiiki, abakunda kugyenda bajwaire ebijwaro biraingwa, n'okutangarirwa omu katare, n'ebitege by'ekitiinisa omuri sinagogi, n'emyanya y'ekitiinisa omu magyenyi
en: 46 Beware of the scribes, which desire to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the markets, and the highest seats in the synagogues, and the chief rooms at feasts;

rr: 47 abanyaga enju z'abafaakazi, kandi abarandagatana omu kushaba, haza nibaryarya; abo baryacwerwa orubanja orurikukira obuhango.
en: 47 which devour widows' houses, and for a shew make long prayers: the same shall receive greater damnation.
1 And he looked up, and saw the rich men casting their gifts into the treasury.

rr: 2 Kandi yaareba n'omufaakazi omworo naatamu obusente bubiri.
en: 2 And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites.
3 And he said, Of a truth I say unto you, that this poor widow hath cast in more than they all:

rr: 4 ahakuba bo baatamu aha bibashaagire; kwonka omufaakazi oriya omu bworo bwe yaatamu ebi aine byona, kandi niryo itungo rye heza.
en: 4 for all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of God: but she of her penury hath cast in all the living that she had.
5 And as some spake of the temple, how it was adorned with goodly stones and gifts, he said,
6 As for these things which ye behold, the days will come, in the which there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

rr: 7 Baamubuuza bati: Mwegyesa, beitu ebyo biryabaho ryari? Kandi ni kamanyiso ki akaryoreka obunaku obu ebyo byona biribeeraho?
en: 7 And they asked him, saying, Master, but when shall these things be? and what sign will there be when these things shall come to pass?

rr: 8 Yaagira ati: Mwerinde, mutarihabisibwa; ahabw'okuba baingi baryaija omu iziina ryangye, nibagira bati: Niinye Kristo! Kandi bati: Obunaku buri haihi! Mutaribakuratira.
en: 8 And he said, Take heed that ye be not deceived: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ ; and the time draweth near: go ye not therefore after them.

rr: 9 Kandi ku murihurira engamba n'okujagarara, mutaritiina; ahabw'okuba ebyo bishemereire kubanza kubaho; kwonka emperu terihika ahonaaho.
en: 9 But when ye shall hear of wars and commotions, be not terrified: for these things must first come to pass; but the end is not by and by.

rr: 10 Yaagaruka yaabagira ati: Eihanga riryateera erindi ihanga n'obugabe buryateera obundi
en: 10 Then said he unto them, Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom:

rr: 11 haryabaho emitsitsa y'amaani, n'enjara n'orufu omu myanya mingi; haryabaho ebirikutiinisa n'obumanyiso bukuru oburikuruga omu iguru.
en: 11 and great earthquakes shall be in divers places, and famines, and pestilences; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven.
12 But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you, and persecute you , delivering you up to the synagogues, and into prisons, being brought before kings and rulers for my name's sake.

rr: 13 Obwo buryaba obunaku bwanyu bw'okuba abajurizi.
en: 13 And it shall turn to you for a testimony.
14 Settle it therefore in your hearts, not to meditate before what ye shall answer:
15 for I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist.

rr: 16 Muryaheebwayo abazaire baanyu, na beene shoimwe, n'abanyaruganda, n'abanywani baanyu; baryabaitisa bamwe ahariimwe
en: 16 And ye shall be betrayed both by parents, and brethren, and kinsfolks, and friends; and some of you shall they cause to be put to death.

rr: 17 muryayangwa abantu boona ahabw'eiziina ryangye.
en: 17 And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake.
18 But there shall not an hair of your head perish.
19 In your patience possess ye your souls.

rr: 20 Ku murireeba Yerusaalemu eyehinguririziibwe engabo, obwo muryamanya ngu okuhwerekyerera kwayo kuri haihi.
en: 20 And when ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies, then know that the desolation thereof is nigh.

rr: 21 Obwo abari Buyudaaya bahungire aha nshozi, n'abariba bari omu rurembo bashohore; n'abariba bari omu byaro batarirutaahamu.
en: 21 Then let them which are in Judæa flee to the mountains; and let them which are in the midst of it depart out; and let not them that are in the countries enter thereinto.
22 For these be the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.
23 But woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck, in those days! for there shall be great distress in the land, and wrath upon this people.
24 And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.
25 And there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring;
26 men's hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be shaken.
27 And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

rr: 28 Kandi ebi ku biritandika kubaho, mureebe ahaiguru, mwimutsye emitwe yaanyu, ahakuba okucungurwa kwanyu kuryaba kuri haihi.
en: 28 And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh.
29 And he spake to them a parable; Behold the fig tree, and all the trees;

rr: 30 ku etooka amababi, mwagareeba, mumanya ku obunaku bw'okugyesha buri haihi.
en: 30 when they now shoot forth, ye see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand.

rr: 31 N'ahabw'ekyo naimwe ku murireeba ebyo nibibaho, mumanye ngu obukama bwa Ruhanga buri haihi.
en: 31 So likewise ye, when ye see these things come to pass, know ye that the kingdom of God is nigh at hand.

rr: 32 Buzimazima nimbagambira nti: Obusingye obu tiburihwaho, ebyo byona bitakabaireho.
en: 32 Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, till all be fulfilled.

rr: 33 Eiguru n'ensi biryahwaho, kwonka ebigambo byangye tibirihwaho.
en: 33 Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
34 And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and so that day come upon you unawares.
35 For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of the whole earth.
36 Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.

rr: 37 Kandi buri izooba akaba ayegyesa omuri hekalu; omu mwabazyo araara omu kibungo kya Zeituuni
en: 37 And in the day time he was teaching in the temple; and at night he went out, and abode in the mount that is called the mount of Olives.

rr: 38 omu kasheeshe munonga abantu boona bamushanga omuri hekalu kumuhurira.
en: 38 And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple, for to hear him.
1 Now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh, which is called the Passover.

rr: 2 Abanyamurwa abakuru n'abahandiiki baacwa obwengye oku baramwite, ahakuba bakaba nibatiina abantu
en: 2 And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill him; for they feared the people.
3 Then entered Satan into Judas surnamed Iscariot, being of the number of the twelve.

rr: 4 Yaagyenda yaahanuura n'abanyamurwa abakuru n'abaserukare, oku araamubareebeze.
en: 4 And he went his way, and communed with the chief priests and captains, how he might betray him unto them.

rr: 5 Baahsemererwa, baaraganisa kumuha empiiha.
en: 5 And they were glad, and covenanted to give him money.

rr: 6 Yaikiriza, yaasherura oburyo bw'okumubareebeza, ahu omutwe gw'abantu gutari.
en: 6 And he promised, and sought opportunity to betray him unto them in the absence of the multitude.
7 Then came the day of unleavened bread, when the passover must be killed.

rr: 8 Yesu yaatuma Petero na Yohaana naagira ati: Mugyende, mututebeekanisize Okuhingurwaho, turye.
en: 8 And he sent Peter and John, saying, Go and prepare us the passover, that we may eat.

rr: 9 Baamubuuza bati: Nooyenda ngu tukutebeekanisize nkahi?
en: 9 And they said unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare?

rr: 10 Yaabagira ati: Reeba, ku muraataahe omu rurembo, nimwija kubuganwa omushaija oyekoreire enjoga y'amaizi; mumukurate omu nju ei araataahemu.
en: 10 And he said unto them, Behold, when ye are entered into the city, there shall a man meet you, bearing a pitcher of water; follow him into the house where he entereth in.

rr: 11 Mugire nyineeka muti: Omwegyesa yaakutumaho, naakubuuza ngu; Ekishengye ky'abagyenyi kirahi, omu araariire Okuhingurwaho n'abeegi be?
en: 11 And ye shall say unto the goodman of the house, The Master saith unto thee, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?

rr: 12 Naija kubooreka ekishengye kihango eky'ahaiguru ekicumirwe; mutubonereze omwo.
en: 12 And he shall shew you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.

rr: 13 Baagyenda, baashanga biri nk'oku yaabambira; baatebeekanisa Okuhingurwaho.
en: 13 And they went, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.

rr: 14 Eshaaha ku zaahikire, yaashutama aha by'okurya hamwe n'entumwa.
en: 14 And when the hour was come, he sat down, and the twelve apostles with him.

rr: 15 Yaabagira ati: Nyetengire munonga kuriira hamwe naimwe Okuhingurwaho oku, ntakabonabonesiibwe
en: 15 And he said unto them, With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer:

rr: 16 ahakuba nimbagambira nti: Tindirya Kuhingurwaho okundi, okuhitsya obu kurihikiirizibwa omu bukama bwa Ruhanga.
en: 16 for I say unto you, I will not any more eat thereof, until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God.

rr: 17 Yaakwata ekikopo; yaaherize kusiima, yaagira ati: Mukwate eki, mukibagane
en: 17 And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and said, Take this, and divide it among yourselves:

rr: 18 ahakuba nimbagambira nti: Tindinywa aha byana by'emizaabibu, okuruga hati okuhitsya obu obukama bwa Ruhanga buriija.
en: 18 for I say unto you, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine, until the kingdom of God shall come.
19 And he took bread, and gave thanks, and brake it , and gave unto them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.
20 Likewise also the cup after supper, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood, which is shed for you.
21 But, behold, the hand of him that betrayeth me is with me on the table.

rr: 22 buzimazima Omwana w'omuntu naagyenda, nk'oku kyamuteekateekyeirwe; kwonka orikumureebya aryareeba enaku!
en: 22 And truly the Son of man goeth, as it was determined: but woe unto that man by whom he is betrayed!

rr: 23 Baatandika kubuuzana bonka ngu, N'oha aharibo orikwenda kukora ekyo.
en: 23 And they began to enquire among themselves, which of them it was that should do this thing.
24 And there was also a strife among them, which of them should be accounted the greatest.
25 And he said unto them, The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and they that exercise authority upon them are called benefactors.

rr: 26 Kwonka imwe mutariba mutyo; omukuru omuriimwe abe nk'omuto; kandi orikutegyeka abe nk'orikuheereza.
en: 26 But ye shall not be so: but he that is greatest among you, let him be as the younger; and he that is chief, as he that doth serve.
27 For whether is greater, he that sitteth at meat, or he that serveth? is not he that sitteth at meat? but I am among you as he that serveth.

rr: 28 Kandi niimwe abaagumisiriize naanye omu bi naagyeziibwe
en: 28 Ye are they which have continued with me in my temptations.
29 And I appoint unto you a kingdom, as my Father hath appointed unto me;
30 that ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
31 And the Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired to have you, that he may sift you as wheat:
32 but I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren.

rr: 33 Yaamugarukamu ati: Mukama wangye, nyeteekateekire kugyenda naiwe omu kihome, n'omu kufa.
en: 33 And he said unto him, Lord, I am ready to go with thee, both into prison, and to death.

rr: 34 Yesu yaagira ati: Ninkugambira iwe Petero, eri izooba enkoko terikwija kugamba, otakeehakanie kashatu ku otarikummanya.
en: 34 And he said, I tell thee, Peter, the cock shall not crow this day, before that thou shalt thrice deny that thou knowest me.
35 And he said unto them, When I sent you without purse, and scrip, and shoes, lacked ye any thing? And they said, Nothing.

rr: 36 Yaabagira ati: Mbwenu hati, oine enshaho y'empiiha, agihagatire, n'oine efurebe atyo; kandi otabiine, atunde omunagiro gwe, agure rurara.
en: 36 Then said he unto them, But now, he that hath a purse, let him take it , and likewise his scrip: and he that hath no sword, let him sell his garment, and buy one.
37 For I say unto you, that this that is written must yet be accomplished in me, And he was reckoned among the transgressors: for the things concerning me have an end.

rr: 38 Baamugira bati: Mukama waitu, reeba zaarurara ibiri nzizi! Yaabagira ati: Ka bihwere aho!
en: 38 And they said, Lord, behold, here are two swords. And he said unto them, It is enough.
39 And he came out, and went, as he was wont, to the mount of Olives; and his disciples also followed him.

rr: 40 Ku yaahikire okwo, yaabagira ati: Mushabe murekye kuza omu kwohibwa.
en: 40 And when he was at the place, he said unto them, Pray that ye enter not into temptation.

rr: 41 Yaabeeshorooramu hakye nk'aharikurekyerwa eibaare; yaatsimba amaju, yaashaba ati
en: 41 And he was withdrawn from them about a stone's cast, and kneeled down, and prayed,

rr: 42 Taata, ku oraabe noikiriza, onyiheho ekikopo eki; kwonka kirekye kuba nk'oku ndikwenda, kureka nka Iwe oku orikwenda.
en: 42 saying, Father, if thou be willing, remove this cup from me: nevertheless not my will, but thine, be done.
43 And there appeared an angel unto him from heaven, strengthening him.

rr: 44 Ku yaasaasire munonga, yaayezirika kushaba; etuutu ye yaashusha nk'amatondo mahango g'eshagama omu kuragarika ahansi.
en: 44 And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly: and his sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground.

rr: 45 Ku yaaherize kushaba, yaimuka, yaija aha beegi be, yaashanga bagwejegyeire ahabw'okuganya
en: 45 And when he rose up from prayer, and was come to his disciples, he found them sleeping for sorrow,

rr: 46 yaababuuza ati: Ahabw'enki mugwejegyeire? Mwimukye, mushabe, murekye kuza omu kwohibwa.
en: 46 and said unto them, Why sleep ye? rise and pray, lest ye enter into temptation.
47 And while he yet spake, behold a multitude, and he that was called Judas, one of the twelve, went before them, and drew near unto Jesus to kiss him.

rr: 48 Yesu yaamubuuza ati: Yuda, noorebya Omwana w'omuntu n'okunywegyera?
en: 48 But Jesus said unto him, Judas, betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss?

rr: 49 Abaabaire bamuhereire, ku baareebire ebyaza kubaho, baabuuza bati: Mukama waitu, tubateme na zaarurara?
en: 49 When they which were about him saw what would follow, they said unto him, Lord, shall we smite with the sword?

rr: 50 Omwe aharibo yaatema omuhuuku w'omunyamurwa omukuru, yaamucwaho okutu kwa buryo.
en: 50 And one of them smote the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.

rr: 51 Yesu yaagira ati: Murekyere aho! Yaamukora aha kutu, yaamukiza.
en: 51 And Jesus answered and said, Suffer ye thus far. And he touched his ear, and healed him.

rr: 52 Yesu yaabuuza abanyamurwa abakuru n'abakuru b'abaserukare ba hekalu, n'abandi bakuru, abamuhururiire, ati: Mukampururiire nk'oku bahururira omwambuzi na zaarurara n'ebikoni?
en: 52 Then Jesus said unto the chief priests, and captains of the temple, and the elders, which were come to him, Be ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and staves?
53 When I was daily with you in the temple, ye stretched forth no hands against me: but this is your hour, and the power of darkness.
54 Then took they him, and led him , and brought him into the high priest's house. And Peter followed afar off.

rr: 55 Ku baaherize kuhemba omuriro omu kibuga ahagati, baashutama hamwe ahansi, na Petero yaashutama ahagati yaabo.
en: 55 And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the hall, and were set down together, Peter sat down among them.

rr: 56 Omuzaana yaamureeba ashutami aharikuhweza; ku yaamwetegyereize, yaagira ati: Omushaija ogu nawe abaire ari hamwe na Yesu.
en: 56 But a certain maid beheld him as he sat by the fire, and earnestly looked upon him, and said, This man was also with him.

rr: 57 Petero yaayehakana naagira ati: Mukazi 'we, tindikumumanya.
en: 57 And he denied him, saying, Woman, I know him not.

rr: 58 Ku hahingwireho akaanya kakye, ondiijo yaamureeba, yaagira ati: Naiwe ori owaabo. Petero yaagira ati: Mushaija 'we, tindi waabo.
en: 58 And after a little while another saw him, and said, Thou art also of them. And Peter said, Man, I am not.

rr: 59 Kandi bwanyima y'eshaaha nk'emwe n'ondiijo yaamwomesereza ati: Buzima omushaija ogu yaaba ari hamwe nawe; ahabw'okuba n'Omunyagalilaya.
en: 59 And about the space of one hour after another confidently affirmed, saying, Of a truth this fellow also was with him: for he is a Galilæan.

rr: 60 Kwonka Petero yaagira ati: Mushaija 'we, tindikumanya ki orikugamba. Ahonaaho, ku yaabaire naakigamba, enkoko yaagamba.
en: 60 And Peter said, Man, I know not what thou sayest. And immediately, while he yet spake, the cock crew.

rr: 61 Mukama waitu yaahinduka, yaareeba Petero, Petero yaijuka ekigambo kya Mukama waitu, oku amugizire ati: Enkoko etakagambire, noija kuunyehankana kashatu.
en: 61 And the Lord turned, and looked upon Peter. And Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how he had said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.

rr: 62 Yaashohora aheeru, yaarira munonga.
en: 62 And Peter went out, and wept bitterly.
63 And the men that held Jesus mocked him, and smote him .

rr: 64 Baamukoma aha maisho, baamugira bati: Gamba; owaakuteera n'oha?
en: 64 And when they had blindfolded him, they struck him on the face, and asked him, saying, Prophesy, who is it that smote thee?

rr: 65 Baamugambaho n'ebindi bingi, nibamujuma.
en: 65 And many other things blasphemously spake they against him.
66 And as soon as it was day, the elders of the people and the chief priests and the scribes came together, and led him into their council, saying,
67 Art thou the Christ? tell us. And he said unto them, If I tell you, ye will not believe:

rr: 68 kandi n'obu naakubabuuza, timukangarukamu.
en: 68 and if I also ask you , ye will not answer me, nor let me go.
69 Hereafter shall the Son of man sit on the right hand of the power of God.

rr: 70 Boona baamubuuza bati: Iwe shi, ori Omwana wa Ruhanga? Yaabagarukamu ati: Ndi We nk'oku mwagamba.
en: 70 Then said they all, Art thou then the Son of God? And he said unto them, Ye say that I am.

rr: 71 Baagira bati: Kandi nitukyendera ki obwamushinja obundi? Ahabw'okuba itwe twayehuririra ebyaruga omu kanwa ke.
en: 71 And they said, What need we any further witness? for we ourselves have heard of his own mouth.
1 And the whole multitude of them arose, and led him unto Pilate.

rr: 2 Baatandika kumutabaariza, nibagira bati: omuntu ogu tukamureeba naahabisa eihanga ryaitu, naazibira abantu kushorera Kaisaari, naayehamya ku ari Kristo Omukama.
en: 2 And they began to accuse him, saying, We found this fellow perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Cæsar, saying that he himself is Christ a King.
3 And Pilate asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answered him and said, Thou sayest it .

rr: 4 Pilaato yaagira abanyamurwa abakuru n'omutwe gw'abantu ati: Tindikureeba rubanja aha mushaija ogu.
en: 4 Then said Pilate to the chief priests and to the people, I find no fault in this man.

rr: 5 Kwonka bo baayeyongyera kuhamisiriza, nibagira bati: Naagomesa abantu, naayegyesa omuri Buyudaaya yoona, okuruga Galilaaya nangwa n'okuhika omu mwanya ogu.
en: 5 And they were the more fierce, saying, He stirreth up the people, teaching throughout all Jewry, beginning from Galilee to this place.

rr: 6 Pilaato ku yaahuriire atyo, yaababuuza omushaija ogwo ku araabe ari owa Galilaaya.
en: 6 When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked whether the man were a Galilæan.
7 And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod's jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time.
8 And when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceeding glad: for he was desirous to see him of a long season , because he had heard many things of him; and he hoped to have seen some miracle done by him.

rr: 9 Yaamubuuza ebigambo bingi; kwonka We tiyaamugarukamu.
en: 9 Then he questioned with him in many words; but he answered him nothing.

rr: 10 Abanyamurwa abakuru n'abahandiiki baayemerera aho, nibamutabaariza n'amaani.
en: 10 And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused him.

rr: 11 Heroose n'abaserukare be baamugaya, baamuteerera enaku, baamujweka ebijwaro ebirikwengyengyeta, yaamugarurira Pilaato.
en: 11 And Herod with his men of war set him at nought, and mocked him , and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe, and sent him again to Pilate.

rr: 12 Ahari ekyo kiro Heroode na Pilaato baihaho omukago, ahabw'okuba kare bakaba nibangana.
en: 12 And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together: for before they were at enmity between themselves.

rr: 13 Pilaato nikwo kuteerana abanyamurwa abakuru n'abategyeki n'abandi bantu
en: 13 And Pilate, when he had called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,

rr: 14 akabagira ati: Mwandeetera omushaija ogu, ngu ahabisa abantu; nyowe ahabwangye ku naamubuuriza munonga omu maisho gaanyu, tinaamureebaho rubanja omuri ebyo ebi mumutabaaririize
en: 14 said unto them, Ye have brought this man unto me, as one that perverteth the people: and, behold, I, having examined him before you, have found no fault in this man touching those things whereof ye accuse him:

rr: 15 nangwa n'obu yaakuba Heroode, ahakuba nawe yaamutugarurira. Nimureeba ku atakozire ekishemereire kumwitsa.
en: 15 No, nor yet Herod: for I sent you to him; and, lo, nothing worthy of death is done unto him.

rr: 16 N'ahabw'ekyo naaza kumuteera, mmurekure. [
en: 16 I will therefore chastise him, and release him .

rr: 17 Ekyo akakigamba, ahabw'okuba akaba ashemereire kubabohoororera embohe emwe aha bugyenyi obwo.]
en: 17 (For of necessity he must release one unto them at the feast.)

rr: 18 Boona baayombera hamwe, bati: Ihaho omushaija ogu, oturekurire Barabba.
en: 18 And they cried out all at once, saying, Away with this man , and release unto us Barabbas:

rr: 19 (Niwe mushaija owaabaire atairwe omu kihome, atuzirwe obugomi obwabaire buri omu rurembo, kandi n'obwitsi)
en: 19 (who for a certain sedition made in the city, and for murder, was cast into prison.)

rr: 20 Pilaato, ahabw'okwenda kurekura Yesu, yaagaruka yaagamba nabo
en: 20 Pilate therefore, willing to release Jesus, spake again to them.

rr: 21 kwonka baayomba munonga, nibagira bati: Mubambe, omubambe aha musharaba!
en: 21 But they cried, saying, Crucify him , crucify him.

rr: 22 Yaabagambira obwa kashatu, naabagira ati: Ahanki? Ni kicumuro ki omuntu ogu eki acumwire? Tinaamureebaho rubanja orushemereire kumwitsa; n'ahabw'ekyo naaza kumuteera, mmurekure.
en: 22 And he said unto them the third time, Why, what evil hath he done? I have found no cause of death in him: I will therefore chastise him, and let him go.

rr: 23 Baamugyemesereza nibayomba munonga, nibamushaba ngu abambwe; amaraka gaabo gaarugaho gaamuremesa.
en: 23 And they were instant with loud voices, requiring that he might be crucified. And the voices of them and of the chief priests prevailed.

rr: 24 Pilaato nikwo kucwa orubanja ngu eki barikufa kibe nikyo kyakorwa.
en: 24 And Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they required.

rr: 25 Yaarekura omushaija ou bamushabire, owaabaire atairwe omu kihome ahabw'obugomi n'obwitsi; kandi yaahayo Yesu, ku bamukora nk'oku barikwenda.
en: 25 And he released unto them him that for sedition and murder was cast into prison, whom they had desired; but he delivered Jesus to their will.
26 And as they led him away, they laid hold upon one Simon, a Cyrenian, coming out of the country, and on him they laid the cross, that he might bear it after Jesus.

rr: 27 Kandi omutwe muhango gw'abantu gwamukuratira; gurimu n'abakazi nibamucurira, nibeemaamaata.
en: 27 And there followed him a great company of people, and of women, which also bewailed and lamented him.

rr: 28 Yesu yaabahindukira, yaagira ati: Imwe abaishiki ba Yerusaalemu, mutandirira, kureka mweririre n'abaana baanyu.
en: 28 But Jesus turning unto them said, Daughters of Jerusalem, weep not for me, but weep for yourselves, and for your children.
29 For, behold, the days are coming, in the which they shall say, Blessed are the barren, and the wombs that never bare, and the paps which never gave suck.
30 Then shall they begin to say to the mountains, Fall on us; and to the hills, Cover us.
31 For if they do these things in a green tree, what shall be done in the dry?

rr: 32 Kandi hakaba hariho abandi babiri, abaabaire bari enkozi z'ebibi, abaatwairwe kwitwa nawe.
en: 32 And there were also two other, malefactors, led with him to be put to death.
33 And when they were come to the place, which is called Calvary, there they crucified him, and the malefactors, one on the right hand, and the other on the left.
34 Then said Jesus, Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do. And they parted his raiment, and cast lots.
35 And the people stood beholding. And the rulers also with them derided him , saying, He saved others; let him save himself, if he be Christ, the chosen of God.
36 And the soldiers also mocked him, coming to him, and offering him vinegar,
