22 And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that endureth to the end shall be saved.

rr: 23 Ku baribahiiga omuri tauni emwe, muhungire omu ndijo; buzimazima nimbagambira nti: Timuribuga tauni za Israeli zoona, Omwana w'omuntu atakaizire.
en: 23 But when they persecute you in this city, flee ye into another: for verily I say unto you, Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Israel, till the Son of man be come.
24 The disciple is not above his master, nor the servant above his lord.

rr: 25 ekyakubaire gye aha mwegi n'okuba nk'omwegyesa we n'omuhuuku akaba nka mukama we. Ku baraabe beetsire nyineeka # 10:25 Belezebuli: n'eiziina ry'orikwetwa “Omutegyeki w'ensi egi,” niwe Sitaane. Belezebuli, kaashwa ab'omu ka ye.
en: 25 It is enough for the disciple that he be as his master, and the servant as his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more shall they call them of his household?
26 Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.

rr: 27 Eki mbagambirira omu mwirima, mugume mukigambire omu mushana; eki murihurira ikgambiirwe omu kutu, mukigambire aha mutwe gw'enju.
en: 27 What I tell you in darkness, that speak ye in light: and what ye hear in the ear, that preach ye upon the housetops.

rr: 28 Kandi mutaritiina abarikwita omubiri, kwonka tibarikubaasa kwita magara; kureka mutiine Orikubaasa kuhwerekyereza byombi, amagara n'omubiri, omuri Gehena.
en: 28 And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.

rr: 29 Ebiteera-nkumba bibiri tibigura sente emwe? Kwonka tihariho na kimwe ekigwa ahansi Shoimwe atakimanyire.
en: 29 Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.

rr: 30 Nangwa n'eishokye ery'aha mitwe yaanyu ribazirwe ryona.
en: 30 But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
31 Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.

rr: 32 Kandi buri munta orimpamya omu maisho g'abantu, naanye ndyamuhamya omu maisho ga Tata ori omu iguru.
en: 32 Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven.
33 But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven.
34 Think not that I am come to send peace on earth: I came not to send peace, but a sword.

rr: 35 Ahabw'okuba nkaija kutaanisa omwojo na ishe, omwishiki na nyina, omukazi na nyinazaara
en: 35 For I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.

rr: 36 abazigu b'omuntu baryaba ab'omu ka ye.
en: 36 And a man's foes shall be they of his own household.
37 He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me: and he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.
38 And he that taketh not his cross, and followeth after me, is not worthy of me.
39 He that findeth his life shall lose it: and he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it.
40 He that receiveth you receiveth me, and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.

rr: 41 Orikwikiriza nabi ahabw'okuba nabi, aryatunga ebihembo bya nabi; kandi orikwikiriza ohikiriire ahabw'okuba ohikiriire.
en: 41 He that receiveth a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet's reward; and he that receiveth a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man's reward.
42 And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple, verily I say unto you, he shall in no wise lose his reward.

rr: 1 Bwanyima Yesu ku yaaherize kwegyesa abeegi ikumi na babiri, yaarugayo, yaaza kwegyesa n'okubuurira omuri tauni zaabo.
en: 1 And it came to pass, when Jesus had made an end of commanding his twelve disciples, he departed thence to teach and to preach in their cities.
2 Now when John had heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples,

rr: 3 ati: Niiwe ogwo orikwenda kwija, nari tutegyereze ondiijo?
en: 3 and said unto him, Art thou he that should come, or do we look for another?

rr: 4 Yesu yaabagarukamu ati: Mugarukyeyo mugambire Yohaana ebi mwahurira, n'ebi mwareeba
en: 4 Jesus answered and said unto them, Go and shew John again those things which ye do hear and see:
5 the blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them.
6 And blessed is he , whosoever shall not be offended in me.

rr: 7 Ku baagyenzire, Yesu yaatandika kugambira emitwe y'abantu aha bya Yohaana, naagira ati: Omu ihamba mukaza kureebayo ki?
en: 7 And as they departed, Jesus began to say unto the multitudes concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness to see?

rr: Orubingo orurikutengyetsibwa omuyaga?
en: A reed shaken with the wind?

rr: 8 Beitu mukaza kureeba ki? Omuntu ojwaire emyenda erikuterera? Manya abajwara ebirikuterera baba omu bikaari by'abagabe.
en: 8 But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? behold, they that wear soft clothing are in kings' houses.
9 But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? yea, I say unto you, and more than a prophet.
10 For this is he , of whom it is written,

rr: 11 Buzimazima nimbagambira nti: Omuri boona abaazairwe abakazi tihakabahoga n'omwe orikukira Yohaana Omubatizi obukuru; kwonka omuto omu bukama bw'omu iguru naamukira.
en: 11 Verily I say unto you, Among them that are born of women there hath not risen a greater than John the Baptist: notwithstanding he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
12 And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force.

rr: 13 Ahakuba baanabi boona n'ebiragiro bikaba nibiranga okuhitsya omu biro bya Yohaana
en: 13 For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.
14 And if ye will receive it , this is Elias, which was for to come.

rr: 15 Oine amatu agarikuhurira, ahurire.
en: 15 He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

rr: 16 Mbwenu ab'ebiro ebi mbashushanise ki?
en: 16 But whereunto shall I liken this generation?

rr: Nibashusha nk'abaana bato abashutami omu katare, bakeeta bagyenzi baabo bati
en: It is like unto children sitting in the markets, and calling unto their fellows,

rr: 17 Tubateereire emikuri, timwazina; twacura timwaganya.
en: 17 and saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned unto you, and ye have not lamented.

rr: 18 Ahakuba Yohaana akaija atarikurya n'obu kwakuba okunywa, baagira ngu, Ariho daimoni.
en: 18 For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, He hath a devil.
19 The Son of man came eating and drinking, and they say, Behold a man gluttonous, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners. But wisdom is justified of her children.
20 Then began he to upbraid the cities wherein most of his mighty works were done, because they repented not:

rr: 21 Ati: Iwe Koraziini, oryakareeba! Naiwe, Besesaida, oryakareeba, ahabw'okuba eby'okutangaaza ebyakoreirwe omuriimwe, kuri noogira ngu bikakorerwa Tuuro na Sidoni, bakaabaire beeteisize kare, bajwaire ebiguniya, beeshukyeire eiju rya kashenda.
en: 21 Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works, which were done in you, had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.

rr: 22 Kandi nimbagambira nti: Aha kito ky'okucwa orubanja, ekifubiro ky'okucwa orubanja, ekifubiro kya Tuuro na Sidoni kiryaba ekirikubaasa kwemerwa okukira ekyanyu.
en: 22 But I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the day of judgment, than for you.

23 And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted unto heaven, shalt be brought down to hell: for if the mighty works, which have been done in thee, had been done in Sodom, it would have remained until this day.

rr: 24 Hoona nimbagambira nti: Aha kiro ky'okucwa orubanja, ekifubiro kya Sodoma kiryaba ekirikubaasa kwemerwa okukira ekyanyu.
en: 24 But I say unto you, That it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment, than for thee.
25 At that time Jesus answered and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes.

rr: 26 Eego, Taata, ahabw'okuba ekyo nikyo waasiimire.
en: 26 Even so, Father: for so it seemed good in thy sight.
27 All things are delivered unto me of my Father: and no man knoweth the Son, but the Father; neither knoweth any man the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him .
28 Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.

rr: 29 Mwekorere omugamba gwangye, muunyegyereho; ahabw'okuba nintwaza gye, kandi ndi omucureezi omu mutima; naimwe muryatunga okuhuumura omu mitima yaanyu
en: 29 Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.

rr: 30 ahakuba omugamba gwangye tigurikuremeera, n'omutwaro gwangye gwanguhi.
en: 30 For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
1 At that time Jesus went on the sabbath day through the corn; and his disciples were an hungred, and began to pluck the ears of corn, and to eat.

rr: 2 Abafarisaayo ku baakireebire, baamugira bati: Reeba, abeegi baawe nibakora ekirikuzira, okucwa obushiisha ahari Sabato.
en: 2 But when the Pharisees saw it , they said unto him, Behold, thy disciples do that which is not lawful to do upon the sabbath day.
3 But he said unto them, Have ye not read what David did, when he was an hungred, and they that were with him;
4 how he entered into the house of God, and did eat the shewbread, which was not lawful for him to eat, neither for them which were with him, but only for the priests?

rr: 5 Nari shi timukashomaga omu Biragiro abanyamurwa omuri hekalu oku baabaire bashobya Sabato, haza batagire rubanja?
en: 5 Or have ye not read in the law, how that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are blameless?

rr: 6 Kwonka nyowe nimbagambira nti: Orikukira hekalu ari aha.
en: 6 But I say unto you, That in this place is one greater than the temple.
7 But if ye had known what this meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice, ye would not have condemned the guiltless.

rr: 8 Ahakuba Omwana w'omuntu niwe Mukama wa Sabato.
en: 8 For the Son of man is Lord even of the sabbath day.
9 And when he was departed thence, he went into their synagogue:

rr: 10 yaashangamu omushaija okokootsire omukono. Baamubuuza bati: Ebiragiro nibiikiriza okutambira omuntu ahari Sabato? Bakamubuuza batyo ngu babone kumutabaariza.
en: 10 and, behold, there was a man which had his hand withered. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days? that they might accuse him.

rr: 11 Yaabagarukamu ati: N'oha omuriimwe owaakuba aine entaama ye emwe, ekagwa omu kiina aha izooba rya Sabato, atagikwate akagiihamu?
en: 11 And he said unto them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out?
12 How much then is a man better than a sheep? Wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days.

rr: 13 Ahonaaho yaaragiira omushaija ogwo ati: Nanuura omukono gwawe.
en: 13 Then saith he to the man, Stretch forth thine hand.

rr: Yaagunanuura, gwakira, gwaba nk'ogundi.
en: And he stretched it forth; and it was restored whole, like as the other.
14 Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him.

rr: 15 Yesu ku yaabimanyire, yaarugayo. Abantu baingi baamukuratira, yaabakiza boona
en: 15 But when Jesus knew it , he withdrew himself from thence: and great multitudes followed him, and he healed them all;

rr: 16 yaabeehanangiriza ngu, batamurangaana.
en: 16 and charged them that they should not make him known:
17 that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,

rr: 18 Reeba omuheereza wangye ou nkunda, ou naatooraine
en: 18 Behold my servant, whom I have chosen;

rr: 19 Taritongana, tariyomba
en: 19 He shall not strive, nor cry;

rr: 20 Orubingo orushatukire tariruhenda
en: 20 A bruised reed shall he not break,

rr: 21 Kandi abanyamahanga baryagira amatsiko aha iziina rye.
en: 21 And in his name shall the Gentiles trust.
22 Then was brought unto him one possessed with a devil, blind, and dumb: and he healed him, insomuch that the blind and dumb both spake and saw.

rr: 23 Abantu boona baatangaara, baayebuuza nibagira bati: Beitu ogu takaaba Omwana wa wa Daudi?
en: 23 And all the people were amazed, and said, Is not this the son of David?
24 But when the Pharisees heard it , they said, This fellow doth not cast out devils, but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils.

rr: 25 Yesu ku yaamanyire ebiteekateeko byabo, yaabagambira ati: Obugabe bwona ku bwebaganisamu, buhwerekyerezibwa; n'orurembo rwona nari enju yoona, ku byebaganisamu, tibigumaho.
en: 25 And Jesus knew their thoughts, and said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand:

rr: 26 Na Sitaane ku araabe naabinga Sitaane, biri ayebaganiisemu. Obukama bwe buryagumaho buta?
en: 26 and if Satan cast out Satan, he is divided against himself; how shall then his kingdom stand?

rr: 27 Nyowe, ku ndaabe nimbingisa baadaimoni Belezebuli, abaana baanyu bo nibamubingisa oha? N'ahabw'ekyo abo nibo baribasingisa orubanja.
en: 27 And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your children cast them out? therefore they shall be your judges.

rr: 28 Kwonka ky ndaabe nimbingisa baadaimoni Omwoyo wa Ruhanga, mumanye ngu obukama bwa Ruhanga bubahikireho.
en: 28 But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God is come unto you.
29 Or else how can one enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.
30 He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth abroad.
31 Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not be forgiven unto men.

32 And whosoever speaketh a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but whosoever speaketh against the Holy Ghost, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the world to come.
33 Either make the tree good, and his fruit good; or else make the tree corrupt, and his fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by his fruit.

rr: 34 Imwe baana b'enjoka 'mwe, nimubaasa muta kugamba ebigambo birungi, haza muri babi? Ebiijwire omutima, akanwa nibyo kagamba.
en: 34 O generation of vipers, how can ye, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh.
35 A good man out of the good treasure of the heart bringeth forth good things: and an evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth evil things.

rr: 36 Kandi nimbagambira nti: Ekigambo ekitaine buryo kyona eki abantu barigamba, baryakyetonganira aha kiro ky'okucwa orubanja.
en: 36 But I say unto you, That every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.

rr: 37 Ebigambo byawe ebi ogamba nibyo birikwihisaho orubanja, nari shi nibyo birikusingisa orubanja.
en: 37 For by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned.
38 Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered, saying, Master, we would see a sign from thee.

rr: 39 Nawe yaabagarukamu ati: Abantu b'obusingye obu obubi obw'obushambani nibenda kamanyiso; kwonak tibarikaheebwa kureka akamanyiso ka nabi Yona.
en: 39 But he answered and said unto them, An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas:
40 for as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale's belly; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
41 The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.

42 The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.

rr: 43 Daimoni, ku aruga omu muntu, araba omu mpita ezitarimu maizi, naasherura oburuhuukiro, bumuburira.
en: 43 When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest, and findeth none.

rr: 44 Agira ati: Ka ngarukey omu nju yangye omu naarugire. Ku ahikayo, ashanga harimu busha, eyeyereire, eboneziibwe.
en: 44 Then he saith, I will return into my house from whence I came out; and when he is come, he findeth it empty, swept, and garnished.

45 Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.
46 While he yet talked to the people, behold,

rr: 47 Omuntu yaamugambira ati: Reeba, nyoko na barumuna baawe beemereire aheeru, nibenda kugamba naiwe.
en: 47 Then one said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to speak with thee.
48 But he answered and said unto him that told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brethren?

rr: 49 Yaagorora omukono naagworekyeza abeegi be, naagira ati: Reeba, maawe na barumuna bangye n'aba!
en: 49 And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!
50 For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.
1 The same day went Jesus out of the house, and sat by the sea side.

rr: 2 Omutwe gw'abantu baingi baateeranira ah'ari; atyo yaaza omu bwato, yaabushutamamu; abantu abo boona baayemerera aha rubaju rw'enyanja.
en: 2 And great multitudes were gathered together unto him, so that he went into a ship, and sat; and the whole multitude stood on the shore.

rr: 3 Yaabeegyesa bingi omu nfumu, naagira ati: Omubibi akashohora kubiba.
en: 3 And he spake many things unto them in parables, saying, Behold, a sower went forth to sow;

rr: 4 Ku yaabaire naabiba, embibo ezimwe zaagwa omu muhanda, enyonyi zaija, zaazitorotoora.
en: 4 and when he sowed, some seeds fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them up:

rr: 5 Embibo ezindi zaagwa aha rukiri, ahataine itaka ringi; ahonaaho zaamera; ahabw'eitaka kutaba ringi
en: 5 some fell upon stony places, where they had not much earth: and forthwith they sprung up, because they had no deepness of earth:

rr: 6 eizooba ku ryajwire, omushana gwaziteera, zaahonga; kandi ahabw'okutagira mizi, zaayoma.
en: 6 and when the sun was up, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered away.

rr: 7 Ezindi zaagwa omu mahwa; amahwa gaamera, gaazinyuruza.
en: 7 And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprung up, and choked them:

rr: 8 Ezindi zaagwa omu itaka rirungi; zaayera, ezimwe zaahitsya igana, ezindi makumi mukaaga, n'ezindi makumi ashatu.
en: 8 but other fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some an hundredfold, some sixtyfold, some thirtyfold.

rr: 9 Oine amatu, ahurire.
en: 9 Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.

rr: 10 Abeegi be baija ah'ari, baamubuuza bati: Ahabw'enki noobeetyesa omu nfumu?
en: 10 And the disciples came, and said unto him, Why speakest thou unto them in parables?

rr: 11 Yaabagarukamu ati: Imwe muhairwe okumanya emibonano y'obukama bw'omu iguru, kwonka bo tibahairwe.
en: 11 He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.
12 For whosoever hath, to him shall be given, and he shall have more abundance: but whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken away even that he hath.

rr: 13 Eki ndikubeegyeseza omu nfumu nikyo eki: ahakuba okureeba tibareeba, kandi n'okuhurira tibahurira, n'obu kwakuba okwetegyereza.
en: 13 Therefore speak I to them in parables: because they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.
14 And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias, which saith,

rr: 15 Ahakuba emitima y'abantu aba ehindukire ebitsire
en: 15 For this people's heart is waxed gross ,

rr: 16 Kwonka amaisho gaanyu gaine omugisha, ahabw'okuba nigareeba, n'amatu gaanyu, ahabw'okuba nigahurira.
en: 16 But blessed are your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.

rr: 17 Kandi nimbagambira amazima nti: Baanabi baingi n'abantu abahikiriire baingi bakeetenga kureeba ebi murikureeba, tibaabireeba, n'okuhurira ebi murikuhurira, tibaabihurira.
en: 17 For verily I say unto you, That many prophets and righteous men have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them ; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them .

rr: 18 Mbwenu nu, imwe muhurire enfumu y'omubibi.
en: 18 Hear ye therefore the parable of the sower.

rr: 19 Weena ohurira ekigambo ky'obukama, atakyetegyereze, Omubi aija, ashahura ekyabibwa omu mutima gwe; ebyo nibishoboorora amakuru g'embibo eyaagwire omu muhanda.
en: 19 When any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth it not, then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.

rr: 20 Eby'embibo ezaabibirwe aha rukiri, amakuru gaabyo n'omuntu ohurira ekigambo, akarahuka kukiikiriza ashemereirwe
en: 20 But he that received the seed into stony places, the same is he that heareth the word, and anon with joy receiveth it;

rr: 21 kwonka we ahabwe ataine mizi, akeehangaana omwanya mukye; hakibaho obusaasi nari okuhiigwa naaturwa ekyo kigambo, ahonaaho bikamugwisa.
en: 21 yet hath he not root in himself, but dureth for a while: for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, by and by he is offended.
22 He also that received seed among the thorns is he that heareth the word; and the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becometh unfruitful.

rr: 23 Eby'ezaabibirwe omu itaka rirungi, ekigambo, akakimanya; buzima ogwo niwe ayana ebyana, omwe igana, ondiijo makumi mukaaga, n'ondiijo makumi ashatu.
en: 23 But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word, and understandeth it ; which also beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some an hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.

rr: 24 Kandi akabacwera endiijo nfumu, naabagira ati: Obukama bw'omu iguru nibushushanisibwa n'omuntu owaabibire embibo nungi omu musiri gwe
en: 24 Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man which sowed good seed in his field:

rr: 25 kandi abantu ku baabaire bagwejegyeire, omuzigu we yaija, yaabiba enkyenzi omu # 13:25 omu Rugriika n'engano. buro, yaayegyendera.
en: 25 but while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.

rr: 26 Oburo ku bwamezire, bwaba obushiisha, enkyenzi nazo zaareebeka.
en: 26 But when the blade was sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.

rr: 27 Abahuuku baija, baagambira mukama waabo bati: Mukama waitu, torabibire embibo nungi omu musiri gwawe? Mbwenu kandi enkyenzi zirugire hi?
en: 27 So the servants of the householder came and said unto him, Sir, didst not thou sow good seed in thy field? from whence then hath it tares?

rr: 28 Yaabagarukamu ati: Ekyo kikakorwa omuzigu. Abahuuku baamubuuza bati: Mbwenu shi, nooyenda ngu tugyende tuzikuuremu?
en: 28 He said unto them, An enemy hath done this. The servants said unto him, Wilt thou then that we go and gather them up?

rr: 29 Yaabagira ati: Ngaaha! obundi mukaaba nimukuuramu enkyenzi, mukuuriranamu oburo.
en: 29 But he said, Nay; lest while ye gather up the tares, ye root up also the wheat with them.

30 Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather ye together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them: but gather the wheat into my barn.
31 Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:
32 which indeed is the least of all seeds: but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof.
33 Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.

rr: 34 Ebigambo ebyo byona Yesu akabyegyesa abantu omu nfumu; kandi tihariho ki yaabeegyeise kyona, atakirabize mu nfumu
en: 34 All these things spake Jesus unto the multitude in parables; and without a parable spake he not unto them:
35 That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying,

rr: 36 Bwanyima yaaraga emitwe y'abantu, yaataaha omu nju. Abeegi be baamwirira haihi, baamubuuza bati: Otushobororere amakuru g'enkyenzi z'omu musiri.
en: 36 Then Jesus sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field.

rr: 37 Yaabagarukamu ati: Owaabibire embibo nungi n'Omwana w'omuntu
en: 37 He answered and said unto them, He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man;

rr: 38 omusiri n'ensi; embibo enungi nibo baana b'obukama; enkyenzi n'abaana b'Omubi
en: 38 the field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;

rr: 39 omuzigu owaazibibire ni Sitaane; eigyesha niyo mperu y'obusingye obu; n'abagyesi ni baamaraika.
en: 39 the enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.
40 As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world.
41 The Son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;
42 and shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
43 Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
44 Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.

rr: 45 Kandi obukama bw'omu iguru nibushusha nk'omushuubuzi orikusherura eruuru enungi
en: 45 Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:
46 who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.
47 Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:

rr: 48 Ku kaijwire, baakakurura, baakahitsya aha nkungu, baashutama, baatooranamu ebirungi, baabita omu bintu byabo, ebibi baabinaga.
en: 48 which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast the bad away.
49 So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just,

rr: 50 babanagye omu kikoomi ky'omuriro; omwo nimwo bariririra, bakanena enshaya.
en: 50 and shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth .

rr: 51 Mwayetegyereza ebigambo ebyo byona? Baamugarukamu bati, Eego.
en: 51 Jesus saith unto them, Have ye understood all these things? They say unto him, Yea, Lord.

rr: 52 Yaagaruka yaabagira ati: N'ahabw'ekyo omuhandiiki weena oyegyesiibwe eby'obukama bw'omu iguru naashushanisibwa na nyineeka, oiha omu ibiikiro rye ebintu ebisya n'ebya ira.
en: 52 Then said he unto them, Therefore every scribe which is instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which bringeth forth out of his treasure things new and old.
53 And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed thence.

rr: 54 ku yaahikire omu nsi y'owaabo, yaatandika kubeegyeseza omuri sinagogi yaabo; n'ahabw'ekyo baatangaara nibagira bati: Obwengye obu n'eby'okutangaaza ebi ogu akabiiha hi?
en: 54 And when he was come into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, insomuch that they were astonished, and said, Whence hath this man this wisdom, and these mighty works?

rr: 55 Beitu ogu t'omwana w'omubaizi, na nyina tarikwetwa Mariamu? N'abarumuna ti Yakobo, Yosefu, Simooni na Yuda?
en: 55 Is not this the carpenter's son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?
56 And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then hath this man all these things?

rr: 57 Yesu yaabagira ati: Nabi tabura kitiinisa kureka omu ihanga ryabo kandi n'omu ka ye.
en: 57 And they were offended in him. But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, save in his own country, and in his own house.

rr: 58 Okwo Yesu tiyaakorayo by'okutangaaza bingi ahabw'okutaikiriza kwabo.
en: 58 And he did not many mighty works there because of their unbelief.
1 At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Jesus,

rr: 2 yaagambira abagaragwa be ati: Ogwo ni Yohaana Omubatizi azookire omu bafu; nikyo kirikumukoresa eby'okutangaaza ebyo.
en: 2 and said unto his servants, This is John the Baptist; he is risen from the dead; and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.

rr: 3 Ahakuba ebyo bitakabaireho, Heroode akakwata Yohaana, yaamuboha, yaamuta omu kihome ahabwa Herodia, muka Filipo mwene ishe
en: 3 For Herod had laid hold on John, and bound him, and put him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife.

rr: 4 ahabw'okuba Yohaana akateisa Heroode ati: Ebiragiro tibirikukwikiriza kumugira omukazi waawe.
en: 4 For John said unto him, It is not lawful for thee to have her.

rr: 5 Ku yaabaire naayenda kumwita, yaatiina abantu, ahabw'okuba abantu bakaba nibahamya ku Yohaana ari nabi.
en: 5 And when he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.

rr: 6 Kwonka ekiro ky'okwijuka okuzaarwa kwa Heroode ku kyahikire, muhara wa Herodia yaazinira omu maisho g'abangyenyi, yaashemeza Heroode.
en: 6 But when Herod's birthday was kept, the daughter of Herodias danced before them, and pleased Herod.

rr: 7 N'ahabw'ekyo yaamuraganisa, naarahira ku arikwija kumuha eki araamushabe kyona.
en: 7 Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatsoever she would ask.

rr: 8 Omwihsiki yaamushaba ati: Mpeera aha omutwe gwa Yohaana Omubatizi omu rucuba.
en: 8 And she, being before instructed of her mother, said, Give me here John Baptist's head in a charger.

rr: 9 Ekyo kyasaasa omugabe; kwonka ahabw'okushangwa yaarahiire omu maisho g'abagyenyi be, yaaragiira kugumuha.
en: 9 And the king was sorry: nevertheless for the oath's sake, and them which sat with him at meat, he commanded it to be given her .

rr: 10 Yaatuma, baatemaho Yohaana omutwe omu kihome.
en: 10 And he sent, and beheaded John in the prison.

rr: 11 Baareeta omutwe omu rucuba, baaguha omwishiki, nawe yaagutwarira nyina.
en: 11 And his head was brought in a charger, and given to the damsel: and she brought it to her mother.

rr: 12 Abeegi be baija, baatwara omutumbi gwe baaguziika, baagyenda baamubikira Yesu.
en: 12 And his disciples came, and took up the body, and buried it, and went and told Jesus.
13 When Jesus heard of it , he departed thence by ship into a desert place apart: and when the people had heard thereof , they followed him on foot out of the cities.

rr: 14 Ku yaayambukire, yaashangayo emitwe mingi y'abantu, yaabagirira embabazi, yaatambira abarwaire baabo.
en: 14 And Jesus went forth, and saw a great multitude, and was moved with compassion toward them, and he healed their sick.

rr: 15 Ku bwaizire, abeegi be baija ah'ari, baamugira bati: Aha n'eihamba; kandi bwizire. Raga abantu bagyende omu birorero, beeshakire eby'okurya.
en: 15 And when it was evening, his disciples came to him, saying, This is a desert place, and the time is now past; send the multitude away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves victuals.

rr: 16 Kwonka Yesu yaabagarukamu ati: Tihariho kirikubatwara; mubagaburire.
en: 16 But Jesus said unto them, They need not depart; give ye them to eat.

rr: 17 Baamugarukamu bati: Eki twine aha n'emigaati etaano n'eby'enyanja bibiri kwonka.
en: 17 And they say unto him, We have here but five loaves, and two fishes.

rr: 18 Yaabagira ati: Mubindeetere.
en: 18 He said, Bring them hither to me.

rr: 19 Yaaragiira emitwe y'abantu kushutama omu kacwamba; yaayakiira egyo migaati etaano n'eby'enyanja bibiri, yaareeba ahaiguru, yaasiima, yaabega emigaati, yaagiha abeegi be, nabo baagaburira abantu.
en: 19 And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the grass, and took the five loaves, and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake, and gave the loaves to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
20 And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full.

rr: 21 Abo abaariire bakaba bari abashaija enkumi itaano, otabariiremu bakazi n'abaana.
en: 21 And they that had eaten were about five thousand men, beside women and children.
22 And straightway Jesus constrained his disciples to get into a ship, and to go before him unto the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.
23 And when he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into a mountain apart to pray: and when the evening was come, he was there alone.

rr: 24 kwonka obwo, obwato bukaba buri ahagati y'enyanja, nibuzongibwa ebingonzi; ahabw'okuba omuyaga gukaba gubaturukire omumaisho.
en: 24 But the ship was now in the midst of the sea, tossed with waves: for the wind was contrary.

rr: 25 # 14:25 Omu Rugriika ngu: omu bunaku bw'abarinzi ba kana. Enkoku ku zaabiare nizigamba, yaabaizira naagyendesa amaguru aha nyanja.
en: 25 And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went unto them, walking on the sea.

rr: 26 Abeegi be ku baamureebire naagyendera aha nyanja, baayemereza emitima, baataka ahabw'obwoba, nibagira bati: N'omuzimu!
en: 26 And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a spirit; and they cried out for fear.

rr: 27 Ahonaaho Yesu yaabahuumuriza, naagira ati: muhuumure! Niinye, mutatiina.
en: 27 But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.

rr: 28 Petero yaamugarukamu ati: Mukama wangye, ku oraabe ori iwe, ndagiira, nyije aho ningyendera aha maizi.
en: 28 And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it be thou, bid me come unto thee on the water.

rr: 29 Yaamwikiriza ati: Ija. Petero yaaruga omu bwato, yaagyendera aha maizi kushanga Yesu.
en: 29 And he said, Come. And when Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the water, to go to Jesus.

rr: 30 Kwonka ku yaareebire omuyaga gwaba mwingi, yaatiina; ku yaatandikire kutobera, yaataka ati: Mukama wangye, njuna.
en: 30 But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.

rr: 31 Ahonaaho Yesu yaagorora omukono gwe, yaamukwata, yaamugira ati: Iwe oine okwikiriza kukye, ahanki noobanganisa?
en: 31 And immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand, and caught him, and said unto him, O thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt?

rr: 32 Ku baagiire omu bwato, omuyaga gwatuuza.
en: 32 And when they were come into the ship, the wind ceased.

rr: 33 Abaabaire bari omu bwato baamuramya nibagira bati: Buzimazima ori Omwana wa Ruhanga.
en: 33 Then they that were in the ship came and worshipped him, saying, Of a truth thou art the Son of God.

rr: 34 Ku baaherize kwambuka, baahika seeri aharikwetwa Genesareeti.
en: 34 And when they were gone over, they came into the land of Gennesaret.

rr: 35 Abantu bayo, ku baamumanyire, baagaba ebirari aho hoona, baamureetera boona abaabaire barwaire
en: 35 And when the men of that place had knowledge of him, they sent out into all that country round about, and brought unto him all that were diseased;

rr: 36 baamweshengyereza ngu nangwa bakore aha mukugiro gw'ekaanzu ye kwonka; boona abaagukozireho, oku baingana, baakirira kimwe.
en: 36 and besought him that they might only touch the hem of his garment: and as many as touched were made perfectly whole.
1 Then came to Jesus scribes and Pharisees, which were of Jerusalem, saying,
2 Why do thy disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? for they wash not their hands when they eat bread.

rr: 3 Yaabagaarukamu naababuuza ati: Ahabw'enki imwe mushobya ebiragiro bya Ruhanga ahabw'emigyenzo yaanyu?
en: 3 But he answered and said unto them, Why do ye also transgress the commandment of God by your tradition?
4 For God commanded, saying, Honour thy father and mother: and, He that curseth father or mother, let him die the death.

rr: 5 Kwonka imwe nimugira muti: Omuntu orikugambira ishe nari nyina ati: Kyona eki naakukuhaire kukuhwera, nkihongyeire Ruhanga, ogwo aba atakigyemwa kutiina ishe.
en: 5 But ye say, Whosoever shall say to his father or his mother, It is a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me;

rr: 6 Omu buryo obwo ekigambo kya Ruhanga mukihindura busha, ngu mugumye emigyenzo yaanyu.
en: 6 and honour not his father or his mother, he shall be free . Thus have ye made the commandment of God of none effect by your tradition.
7 Ye hypocrites, well did Esaias prophesy of you, saying,

rr: 8 Ab'eihanga eri nibampa ekitiinisa ky'aha minwa
en: 8 This people draweth nigh unto me with their mouth, and honoureth me with their lips;

rr: 9 Bandamiza busha
en: 9 But in vain they do worship me,

rr: 10 Yaayeta omutwe gw'abantu, yaabagambira ati: muhurire, kandi mwetegyereze.
en: 10 And he called the multitude, and said unto them, Hear, and understand:

rr: 11 Ekitaaha omu kanwa tikyo kishiisha omuntu; kureka ekiruga omu kanwa, nikyo kishiisha omuntu.
en: 11 not that which goeth into the mouth defileth a man; but that which cometh out of the mouth, this defileth a man.

rr: 12 Bwanyima abeegi be baija baamugira bati: Noomanya ku Abafarisaayo baaguubwa kubi ahabw'okuhurira ebyo ebi waagamba?
en: 12 Then came his disciples, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the Pharisees were offended, after they heard this saying?
13 But he answered and said, Every plant, which my heavenly Father hath not planted, shall be rooted up.
14 Let them alone: they be blind leaders of the blind. And if the blind lead the blind, both shall fall into the ditch.

rr: 15 Petero yaamushaba ati: Tishobororere amakuru g'egyo nfumu.
en: 15 Then answered Peter and said unto him, Declare unto us this parable.

rr: 16 Yesu yaamugarukamu ati: Biri shi naimwe timukashoborokyeirwe?
en: 16 And Jesus said, Are ye also yet without understanding?

rr: 17 Timurikumanya ngu, ekintu ku kitaaha omu kanwa, kiza omu nda, bwanyima kishohora?
en: 17 Do not ye yet understand, that whatsoever entereth in at the mouth goeth into the belly, and is cast out into the draught?

rr: 18 Kwonka ebiruga omu kanwa biba nibiruga omu mutima; ebyo nibyo bishiisha omuntu.
en: 18 But those things which proceed out of the mouth come forth from the heart; and they defile the man.
19 For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, blasphemies:

rr: 20 ebyo nibyo bishiisha omuntu; kwonka okuriisa engaro zitajabikire mu maizi, ekyo tikishiisha muntu.
en: 20 these are the things which defile a man: but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not a man.
21 Then Jesus went thence, and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon.

rr: 22 Haija Omunyakanaanikazi ow'omu kyanga ekyo, yaamweshengyereza naagira ati: mukama wangye, Mwana wa Daudi, ngirira embabazi! Muhara wangye ariho daimoni, naamwita kubi munonga.
en: 22 And, behold, a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts, and cried unto him, saying, Have mercy on me, O Lord, thou Son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil.

rr: 23 Kwonka Yesu tiyaagira ki yaamugarukamu.
en: 23 But he answered her not a word.

rr: Abeegi be baija, bamweshengyereza nibagira bati: Muragiire, agyende, ahabw'okuba naatuyomberera.
en: And his disciples came and besought him, saying, Send her away; for she crieth after us.

rr: 24 We yaagarukamu ati: Tindatumirwe ha bandi kureka aha ntaama z'oruganda rwa Israeli ezaabuzire.
en: 24 But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

rr: 25 Omukazi yaagaruka yaamuramya naagira ati: Mukama wangye, mpwera.
en: 25 Then came she and worshipped him, saying, Lord, help me.

rr: 26 Yaamugarukamu ati: Ti kirungi omuntu kwaka abaana eby'okurya, akabitambikira embwa.
en: 26 But he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast it to dogs.

rr: 27 Omukazi yaamwikiriza ati: Eego, Mukama wangye, kwonka embwa nazo zirya oburagarika oburagara niburuga aha meeza ya mukama waazo.
en: 27 And she said, Truth, Lord: yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters' table.
28 Then Jesus answered and said unto her, O woman, great is thy faith: be it unto thee even as thou wilt. And her daughter was made whole from that very hour.

rr: 29 Yesu yaarugayo, yaaraba aha rubaju rw'enyanja ya Galilaaya; yainamuka omu migongo, yaashutamayo.
en: 29 And Jesus departed from thence, and came nigh unto the sea of Galilee; and went up into a mountain, and sat down there.

rr: 30 Emitwe y'abantu baingi baamushangayo, bamureeteire ebirema n'empumi n'ebitera n'ebimuga n'abandi baingi, baabata aha bigyere bye, yaabatambira
en: 30 And great multitudes came unto him, having with them those that were lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others, and cast them down at Jesus' feet; and he healed them:

rr: 31 n'ahabw'ekyo abantu baatangaara, ku baareebire ebiteta nibigamba, ebimuga nibikira, ebirema nibigyenda, n'empumi nizireeba; baahimbisa Ruhanga wa Israeli.
en: 31 insomuch that the multitude wondered, when they saw the dumb to speak, the maimed to be whole, the lame to walk, and the blind to see: and they glorified the God of Israel.

32 Then Jesus called his disciples unto him , and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days, and have nothing to eat: and I will not send them away fasting, lest they faint in the way.

rr: 33 Abeegi be baamubuuza bati: Omuri eri ihamba nitwiha hi emigaati erikubaasa kuhaazya abantu abarikwingana bati?
en: 33 And his disciples say unto him, Whence should we have so much bread in the wilderness, as to fill so great a multitude?

rr: 34 Yesu yaababuuza ati: Mwine emigaati engahi? Banu bati: Ni mushanju n'obw'enyanja bukye.
en: 34 And Jesus saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven, and a few little fishes.

rr: 35 Yaaragiira abantu kushutama ahansi
en: 35 And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground.

rr: 36 yaakwata egyo migaati mushanju n'obw'enyanja; ku yaabisiimiire, yaabega emigaati, yaagiha abeegi be, nabo baagaburira abantu.
en: 36 And he took the seven loaves and the fishes, and gave thanks, and brake them , and gave to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.

rr: 37 Boona baarya, baahaaga, baatorotoora oburagarika obwatsigaireho, baijuza ebiibo mushanju.
en: 37 And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full.

rr: 38 Boona abaariire bakaba bari enkumi ina, otabariiremu bakzi n'abaana.
en: 38 And they that did eat were four thousand men, beside women and children.

rr: 39 Yaabaraga, yaaza omu bwato, yaataaha omu ishaza rya Magadani.
en: 39 And he sent away the multitude, and took ship, and came into the coasts of Magdala.
1 The Pharisees also with the Sadducees came, and tempting desired him that he would shew them a sign from heaven.
2 He answered and said unto them, When it is evening, ye say, It will be fair weather: for the sky is red.

rr: 3 Kandi omu kasheeshe mugira ngu eri izooba nihaija kuba habi, ahabw'okuba ebicu nibitukura kandi nibikondakonda.
en: 3 And in the morning, It will be foul weather to day: for the sky is red and lowring.

rr: Nimumanya kukyenga enshusha y'eiguru, kwonka timurikubaasa kukyenga obumanyiso bw'obunaku.
en: O ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky; but can ye not discern the signs of the times?
4 A wicked and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given unto it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas. And he left them, and departed.

rr: 5 Abeegi be ku baahikire seeri, baijuka ku beebirwe kwereetera emigaati.
en: 5 And when his disciples were come to the other side, they had forgotten to take bread.

rr: 6 Yesu yaabahabura ati: Reeba, mwerinde ekitumbisa ky'Abafarisaayo n'Abasadukaayo.
en: 6 Then Jesus said unto them, Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.

rr: 7 Baagambirana bati: Eki arikufa n'ahabw'okuba titwareeta migaati.
en: 7 And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have taken no bread.

rr: 8 Yesu ku yaabimanyire, yaababuuza ati: Imwe abaine okwikiriza kukye, nimufa ki aha by'emigaati?
en: 8 Which when Jesus perceived, he said unto them, O ye of little faith, why reason ye among yourselves, because ye have brought no bread?
9 Do ye not yet understand, neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
10 Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?

rr: 11 N'enki ekibazibiire kumanya ku ntarikugamba ha by'emigaati? Mwerinde ekitumbisa ky'Abafarisaayo n'Abasadukaayo.
en: 11 How is it that ye do not understand that I spake it not to you concerning bread, that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees?

rr: 12 Okuruga aho baamanya ku atabagambiire kwerinda ekitumbisa eky'emigaati, kureka enyegyesa y'Abafarisaayo n'Abasadukaayo.
en: 12 Then understood they how that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.
13 When Jesus came into the coasts of Cæsarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Whom do men say that I the Son of man am?

rr: 14 Baamugira bati: Abamwe nibagira ngu, Ori Yohaana Omubatizi, abandi ngu, Ori Eliya, kandi abandi ngu, Ori Yeremia nari omwe ahari baanabi.
en: 14 And they said, Some say that thou art John the Baptist: some, Elias; and others, Jeremias, or one of the prophets.

rr: 15 Yaababuuza ati: Mbwenu shi imwe, mugira ngu mba oha?
en: 15 He saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am?
16 And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.
17 And Jesus answered and said unto him, Blessed art thou, Simon Bar-jona: for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven.
18 And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.
19 And I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.

rr: 20 Bwanyima yaayehanangiriza abeegi be kutagira ou baagambira ku ari Kristo.
en: 20 Then charged he his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Jesus the Christ.

21 From that time forth began Jesus to shew unto his disciples, how that he must go unto Jerusalem, and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised again the third day.

rr: 22 Petero yaamuta aha rubaju, yaatandika kumuteisa, naamugira ati: Nikikabure, Mukama wangye! ekyo tikirikwija kukubaho na kakye.
en: 22 Then Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall not be unto thee.

rr: 23 Yesu yaahinduka, yaagira Petero ati: Garuka enyima yangye, Sitaane! Wambeera enkongi, ahabw'okuba torikuteekateeka bya Ruhanga, kureka eby'abantu.
en: 23 But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art an offence unto me: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but those that be of men.
24 Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

rr: 25 Omuntu weena orikwenda kukiza amagara ge, aryagabuza; kandi weena orikubuza amagara ge ahabwangye, aryagakiza.
en: 25 For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it.
26 For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
27 For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he shall reward every man according to his works.

rr: 28 Buzima nimbagambira nti: Omuri aba abeemereire aha, hariho bamwe abarireeba Omwana w'omuntu naija omu bukama bwe batakafiire.
en: 28 Verily I say unto you, There be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom.
1 And after six days Jesus taketh Peter, James, and John his brother, and bringeth them up into an high mountain apart,
2 and was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.

rr: 3 Kandi Musa na Eliya baareebeka omu maisho gaabo, nibagaaniira nawe.
en: 3 And, behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elias talking with him.

rr: 4 Petero yaagambira Yesu ati: Mukama wangye, ni kirungi obu turi aha; ku oraabe nookunda, twombekye obuju bushatu, akamwe kabe akaawe, akandi kabe aka Musa, n'akandi aka Eliya.
en: 4 Then answered Peter, and said unto Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, let us make here three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.
5 While he yet spake, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold a voice out of the cloud, which said, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him.

rr: 6 Abeegi ku baarihuriire, baagwa bajuumaire, batiinire munonga.
en: 6 And when the disciples heard it , they fell on their face, and were sore afraid.

rr: 7 Yesu yaija, yaabakoraho, yaabagambira ati: Mwimukye, mutatiina.
en: 7 And Jesus came and touched them, and said, Arise, and be not afraid.

rr: 8 Ku baajuumwire amaisho, tibareeba muntu weena kureka Yesu wenka.
en: 8 And when they had lifted up their eyes, they saw no man, save Jesus only.

rr: 9 Bwanyima ku baabaire nibashuuma nibaruga aha rushozi, Yesu yaabeehanangiriza ati: Mutagira ou mwagambira ebi mworekirwe, okuhitsya obu Omwana w'omuntu arizooka omu bafu.
en: 9 And as they came down from the mountain, Jesus charged them, saying, Tell the vision to no man, until the Son of man be risen again from the dead.
10 And his disciples asked him, saying, Why then say the scribes that Elias must first come?

rr: 11 Yaabagarukamu ati: N'eky'amazima; Eliya aryaija, ashemeze byona
en: 11 And Jesus answered and said unto them, Elias truly shall first come, and restore all things.
12 But I say unto you, That Elias is come already, and they knew him not, but have done unto him whatsoever they listed. Likewise shall also the Son of man suffer of them.

rr: 13 Aho niho abeegi be baihire kumanya ku arikubagambira ahari Yohaana Omubatizi.
en: 13 Then the disciples understood that he spake unto them of John the Baptist.
14 And when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a certain man, kneeling down to him, and saying,

rr: 15 Mukama wangye, saasira omwana wangye; ahabw'okuba naagwa entsimbo, kandi zimukabya munonga; kaingi agwa omu muriro, kandi obundi agwa omu maizi.
en: 15 Lord, have mercy on my son: for he is lunatick, and sore vexed: for ofttimes he falleth into the fire, and oft into the water.

rr: 16 Naamureetera abeegi baawe, baaremwa kumukiza.
en: 16 And I brought him to thy disciples, and they could not cure him.

rr: 17 Yesu yaagarukamu ati: Imwe ab'obusingye obu obutarikwikiriza, oburikwehabagiza, ndyahitsya hi okuguma naimwe? Ndyahitsya hi okubagumisiririza? Mumundeetere!
en: 17 Then Jesus answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him hither to me.

rr: 18 Yaagambira kubi daimoni; yaamurugaho, omwana ogwo yaakirira aho omuri ako kaanya.
en: 18 And Jesus rebuked the devil; and he departed out of him: and the child was cured from that very hour.
19 Then came the disciples to Jesus apart, and said, Why could not we cast him out?

20 And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.

rr: 21 Kwonka daimoni ow'omuringo nk'ogu tarikubingwa kindi kureka okushaba n'okwesiibyakwo.
en: 21 Howbeit this kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting.
22 And while they abode in Galilee, Jesus said unto them, The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men:

rr: 23 baryamwita, kandi aha kiro kya kashatu aryazooka. Baaganya munonga.
en: 23 and they shall kill him, and the third day he shall be raised again. And they were exceeding sorry.
24 And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received tribute money came to Peter, and said, Doth not your master pay tribute?

rr: 25 Yaabagarukamu ati: Naashora. Ku yaataahire omu nju, Yesu yaaba niwe yaabanza kumubuuza ati: Nooteekateeka ota, Simooni? Abagabe b'ensi ehoozi n'omushoro babiheebwa bantu ki? Abaana baabo nari abantu abandi?
en: 25 He saith, Yes. And when he was come into the house, Jesus prevented him, saying, What thinkest thou, Simon? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute? of their own children, or of strangers?

rr: 26 Ku yaamugarukiremu ati, Abandi, Yesu yaamugambira ati: Mbwenu abaana baabo baine obusingye.
en: 26 Peter saith unto him, Of strangers. Jesus saith unto him, Then are the children free.

rr: 27 Kwonka itwe tutabagwisa kubi, ogyende aha nyanja, otegyese eirobo, eky'enyanja eki oraabanze kukwata, okyashamure, omu kanwa kaakyo noija kushangamu sitateeri; obe niyo waabaha ahabwangye n'ahabwawe.
en: 27 Notwithstanding, lest we should offend them, go thou to the sea, and cast an hook, and take up the fish that first cometh up; and when thou hast opened his mouth, thou shalt find a piece of money: that take, and give unto them for me and thee.
1 At the same time came the disciples unto Jesus, saying, Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?

rr: 2 Yaayeta omwana muto, yaamwemereza ahagati yaabo
en: 2 And Jesus called a little child unto him, and set him in the midst of them,
3 and said, Verily I say unto you, Except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.

rr: 4 Omuntu weena, orikwecureeza nk'omwana ogu omuto, niwe mukuru omu bukama bw'omu iguru.
en: 4 Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
5 And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me.
6 But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.

rr: 7 Ensi eryakareeba ahabw'ebirikugwisa abantu. Ebirikugwisa tibiribura kwija; kwonka origwisa abandi, aryakareeba.
en: 7 Woe unto the world because of offences! for it must needs be that offences come; but woe to that man by whom the offence cometh!

rr: 8 Omukono gwawe nari shi ekigyere kyawe ku kiraakureetere kukora ekibi, okitemeho, okinagye hare; haakiri iwe okutaaha omu magara, ori ekirema nari noocumbagira, okukira okunagwa omu muriro ogutaraara oine emikono yombi nari ebigyere byombi.
en: 8 Wherefore if thy hand or thy foot offend thee, cut them off, and cast them from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life halt or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire.

rr: 9 Kandi n'eriisho ryawe ku riraakureetere kukora ekibi, oriihemu orinagye hare; haakiri iwe okutaaha omu magara oine eriisho rimwe, okukira okunagwa omuri Gehena ey'omuriro oine amaisho gombi.
en: 9 And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire.
10 Take heed that ye despise not one of these little ones; for I say unto you, That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven.

rr: 11 Ahabw'okuba Omwana w'omuntu akaija kujuna ekyabaire kibuzire.
en: 11 For the Son of man is come to save that which was lost.
12 How think ye? if a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine, and goeth into the mountains, and seeketh that which is gone astray?

rr: 13 Kandi ku agibona, buzimazima nimbagambira nti: Agishemerererwa okukira ziri makumi mwenda na mwenda ezaaba zitarazire.
en: 13 And if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoiceth more of that sheep , than of the ninety and nine which went not astray.

rr: 14 Nikwo na Tata ori omu iguru atarikwenda omwe ahari aba bato kuhwerekyerera.
en: 14 Even so it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.
15 Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee, go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone: if he shall hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.
16 But if he will not hear thee, then take with thee one or two more, that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.
17 And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell it unto the church: but if he neglect to hear the church, let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican.
18 Verily I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.

rr: 19 Kandi nimbagambira nti: Babiri ahariimwe ku barikwatansia omu nsi, baashaba ekintu kyona, kiryabakorerwa Tata ori omu iguru.
en: 19 Again I say unto you, That if two of you shall agree on earth as touching any thing that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my Father which is in heaven.
20 For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.

rr: 21 Bwanyima Petero yaija, yaamubuuza ati: Mukama wangye, mugyenzi wangye ku araagume nanshaagiza, mmusaasire kangahi? Mpitsye emirundi mushanju?
en: 21 Then came Peter to him, and said, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times?
22 Jesus saith unto him, I say not unto thee, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven.

rr: 23 N'ahabw'ekyo obukama bw'omu iguru nibushushanisibwa n'omugabe owaayenzire kubara # 18:23 Omu Rugriika n'omuhuuku. n'abambari be ebintu ebi yaabaire ababiikize.
en: 23 Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened unto a certain king, which would take account of his servants.

rr: 24 Ku yaatandikire kubara, baamureetera omwe owaabaire aine eibanja rye ery'etalanta kakumi.
en: 24 And when he had begun to reckon, one was brought unto him, which owed him ten thousand talents.

rr: 25 Ku yaabuzire eky'okwihura, makama we yaaragiira ku bamutunda, we n'omukazi we n'abaana be n'ebi yaabaire aine byona, ngu abone kumara eibanja.
en: 25 But forasmuch as he had not to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.

rr: 26 # 18:26 Omu Rugriika n'omuhuuku. Omwambari ogwo nikwo kumukwata amaguru akamweshengyereza, naagira ati: Mukama wangye, nyihuza mpora, naanye ndyakwihura byona.
en: 26 The servant therefore fell down, and worshipped him, saying, Lord, have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.

rr: 27 Mukama # 18:27 Omu Rugriika n'omuhuuku. w'omwambari ogwo ahabw'embabazi ze yaamurekura, yaamusaasira eibanja eryo.
en: 27 Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion, and loosed him, and forgave him the debt.

rr: 28 Kwonka omwambari ogwo, ku yaashohoire, yaabugana omwambari mugyenzi we, owaabaire aine eibanja rye ery'edenaari igana; yaamukwata, yaamutq aha munigo, naagira ati: Nyihura eibanja ryangye.
en: 28 But the same servant went out, and found one of his fellowservants, which owed him an hundred pence: and he laid hands on him, and took him by the throat, saying, Pay me that thou owest.

rr: 29 Ogwo mwambari mugyenzi we yaamukwata amaguru, yaamweshengyereza ati: Nyihuza mpora, niinyija kukwihura.
en: 29 And his fellowservant fell down at his feet, and besought him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.

rr: 30 We yaayanga, yaagyenda, yaamuta omu kihome, okuhitsya obu araaheze eibanja.
en: 30 And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should pay the debt.

rr: 31 Mbwenu abambari bagyenzi be, ku baareebire ebyabaho, baamugwerwa kubi munonga; baagyenda baabigambira mukama waabo byona.
en: 31 So when his fellowservants saw what was done, they were very sorry, and came and told unto their lord all that was done.

rr: 32 Mukama waabo nikwo kumutuma, akamujuukirira ati: iwe mwambari 'we omubi, nkusaasiire eibanja eryo ryona ahabw'okuunyeshengyereza
en: 32 Then his lord, after that he had called him, said unto him, O thou wicked servant, I forgave thee all that debt, because thou desiredst me:

rr: 33 naiwe toshemereire kusaasira omwambari mugyenzi waawe, nk'oku nkusaasiire?
en: 33 shouldest not thou also have had compassion on thy fellowservant, even as I had pity on thee?
34 And his lord was wroth, and delivered him to the tormentors, till he should pay all that was due unto him.
35 So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you, if ye from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses.
1 And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these sayings, he departed from Galilee, and came into the coasts of Judæa beyond Jordan;

rr: 2 emitwe y'abantu baingi yaamukuratira, yaabakirizayo.
en: 2 And great multitudes followed him; and he healed them there.
3 The Pharisees also came unto him, tempting him, and saying unto him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?

rr: 4 Yaabagarukamu ati: Timukashomaga ngu, Owaabahangire bwa mbere na mbere, akahanga omushaija n'omukazi?
en: 4 And he answered and said unto them, Have ye not read, that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female,
5 and said, For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they twain shall be one flesh?
6 Wherefore they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
7 They say unto him, Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement, and to put her away?

rr: 8 Yaabagarukamu ati: Ahabw'obugangaazi bw'emitima yaanyu Musa nikyo yaikiririize ku mutaana n'abakazi baanyu, kwonka bwa mbere na mbere kikaba kitari kityo.
en: 8 He saith unto them, Moses because of the hardness of your hearts suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it was not so.
9 And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except it be for fornication, and shall marry another, committeth adultery: and whoso marrieth her which is put away doth commit adultery.

rr: 10 Abeegi be baamugira bati: Eby'omushaija n'omukazi ku biraabe nikwo biri, ti kirungi kushwera.
en: 10 His disciples say unto him, If the case of the man be so with his wife, it is not good to marry.
11 But he said unto them, All men cannot receive this saying, save they to whom it is given.

rr: 12 Nimumanya ngu hariho abakonwa abaazairwe batyo okuruga omu nda za baanyinabo; hariho n'abakonwa abaakonirwe abantu; kandi hariho abakonwa abaayekonire ahabw'obukama bw'omu iguru.
en: 12 For there are some eunuchs, which were so born from their mother's womb: and there are some eunuchs, which were made eunuchs of men: and there be eunuchs, which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven's sake.

rr: Orikubaasa kwemera ekyo, akyemere.
en: He that is able to receive it , let him receive it .
13 Then were there brought unto him little children, that he should put his hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.

rr: 14 Kwonka Yesu yaabagira ati: Murekye abaana bato baije ahariinye, mutabazibira; ahabw'okuba obukama bw'omu iguru n'obw'abari nk'aba.
en: 14 But Jesus said, Suffer little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.

rr: 15 Yaabataho engaro, yaarugayo.
en: 15 And he laid his hands on them, and departed thence.
16 And, behold, one came and said unto him, Good Master, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?
17 And he said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is , God: but if thou wilt enter into life, keep the commandments.

rr: 18 Onu yaamubuuza ati: Nibiiha?
en: 18 He saith unto him, Which?

rr: Yesu ati: Otariita, Otarishambana, Otariiba, Otaribeiherera abandi
en: Jesus said, Thou shalt do no murder, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness,
19 Honour thy father and thy mother: and, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

rr: 20 Omutsigazi ogwo yaamugarukamu ati: Ebyo byona nkabyorobera; ekindi ekimbuzireho niki?
en: 20 The young man saith unto him, All these things have I kept from my youth up: what lack I yet?
21 Jesus said unto him, If thou wilt be perfect, go and sell that thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come and follow me.
22 But when the young man heard that saying, he went away sorrowful: for he had great possessions.

rr: 23 Yesu yaagambira abeegi be ati: Buzimazima nimbagambira nti: Kigumire omutungi okutaaha omu bukama bw'omu iguru.
en: 23 Then said Jesus unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.

rr: 24 Kandi nimbagambira nti: Nikirahuka engamira kuraba omu nyindo y'empitirizo, okukira omutungi kutaaha omu bukama bwa Ruhanga.
en: 24 And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

rr: 25 Abeegi be, ku baakihuriire, baatangaara munonga, baamubuuza bati: Mbwenu shi hoona, n'oha orikubaasa kujunwa?
en: 25 When his disciples heard it , they were exceedingly amazed, saying, Who then can be saved?
26 But Jesus beheld them , and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.

rr: 27 Petero nikwo kumugambira ati: Reeba itwe tukatsigaho byona, twakukuratira. Mbwenu turyatunga ki?
en: 27 Then answered Peter and said unto him, Behold, we have forsaken all, and followed thee; what shall we have therefore?

28 And Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

29 And every one that hath forsaken houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name's sake, shall receive an hundredfold, and shall inherit everlasting life.
30 But many that are first shall be last; and the last shall be first .

rr: 1 Ahakuba obukama bw'omu iguru nibushusha nk'omushaija nyineeka, owaimukire kare omu kasheeshe kugurira ab'okuhinga omu musiri gwe gw'emizaabibu.
en: 1 For the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard.

rr: 2 Ku yaaherize kuragaana nabo edenaari emwe ahabw'eizooba rimwe, yaaboohereza omu musiri gwe gw'emizaabibu.
en: 2 And when he had agreed with the labourers for a penny a day, he sent them into his vineyard.

rr: 3 Aha shaaha ya kashatu yaashohora, yaareeba abandi beemereire omu katare, bataine ki barikukora
en: 3 And he went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace,

rr: 4 yaabagambira ati: Naimwe mugyende omu musiri gw'emizaabibu, niinyija kubaha ekibashemereire. Baagyenda.
en: 4 and said unto them; Go ye also into the vineyard, and whatsoever is right I will give you. And they went their way.

rr: 5 Yaayongyera yaashohora aha shaaha ya mukaaga n'aha ya mwenda, naatwaza atyo.
en: 5 Again he went out about the sixth and ninth hour, and did likewise.

rr: 6 Haihi n'eshaaha ya ikumi n'emwe yaashohora, yaashanga abandi beemereire, yaababuuza ati: N'enki ekibeemereize aho eizooba ryona, mutaine ki murikukora?
en: 6 And about the eleventh hour he went out, and found others standing idle, and saith unto them, Why stand ye here all the day idle?

rr: 7 Baamugarukamu bati: Ahabw'okuba tihaine owaatuha omurimo.
en: 7 They say unto him, Because no man hath hired us.

rr: Yaabagira ati: Naimwe mwirooko muze omu musiri gw'emizaabibu.
en: He saith unto them, Go ye also into the vineyard; and whatsoever is right, that shall ye receive.

rr: 8 Ku bwaizire, mukama w'omusiri gw'emizaabibu yaagira omunyampara we ati: Yeta abakozi, obahe ebihembo byabo, obandize aha ba bwanyima, okuhitsya aha baabanza.
en: 8 So when even was come, the lord of the vineyard saith unto his steward, Call the labourers, and give them their hire, beginning from the last unto the first.

rr: 9 Abaatandikire eshaaha ya ikumi n'emwe ku baizire, baihurwa edenaari emwe buri omwe.
en: 9 And when they came that were hired about the eleventh hour, they received every man a penny.

rr: 10 Kandi abaabandize ku baizire, baagira ngu nibaija kwihurwa okukiraho; kwonka nabo baihurwa edenaari emwe buri omwe.
en: 10 But when the first came, they supposed that they should have received more; and they likewise received every man a penny.

rr: 11 Ku baagihairwe, baayetomboitera nyineeka
en: 11 And when they had received it , they murmured against the goodman of the house,

rr: 12 nibagira bati: Aba aba bwanyima baakora eshaaha emwe yonka, mbwenu waabainganisa naitwe abaahendeka eizooba ryona, tukaitwa omushana?
en: 12 saying, These last have wrought but one hour, and thou hast made them equal unto us, which have borne the burden and heat of the day.

rr: 13 We yaagarukamu, naagira omwe aharibo ati: Mugyenzi wangye, tiinyine ki naakushaagiza. Torikumanya ku twaragaana edenaari emwe?
en: 13 But he answered one of them, and said, Friend, I do thee no wrong: didst not thou agree with me for a penny?

rr: 14 Twara eyaawe, ogyende; n'owa bwanyima naasiima kumuha nkaimwe.
en: 14 Take that thine is , and go thy way: I will give unto this last, even as unto thee.
15 Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own? Is thine eye evil, because I am good?

rr: 16 Nikwo aba bwanyima bariba ab'okubanza, n'ab'okubanza bakaba aba bwanyima.
en: 16 So the last shall be first, and the first last: for many be called, but few chosen.
17 And Jesus going up to Jerusalem took the twelve disciples apart in the way, and said unto them,
18 Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be betrayed unto the chief priests and unto the scribes, and they shall condemn him to death,

rr: 19 kandi bamuheyo aha banyamahanga kumushungisa, n'okumwasha, n'okumubamba aha musharaba; kandi aha kiro kya kashatu aryazooka.
en: 19 and shall deliver him to the Gentiles to mock, and to scourge, and to crucify him : and the third day he shall rise again.
20 Then came to him the mother of Zebedee's children with her sons, worshipping him , and desiring a certain thing of him.
21 And he said unto her, What wilt thou? She saith unto him, Grant that these my two sons may sit, the one on thy right hand, and the other on the left, in thy kingdom.

22 But Jesus answered and said, Ye know not what ye ask. Are ye able to drink of the cup that I shall drink of, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with? They say unto him, We are able.

rr: 23 Yaabagira ati: Ekikopo kyangye kyo muryakinywaho buzima; kwonka okunshutama aha rubaju rwa buryo, nari shi orwa bumosho, tiinye nkuha, kureka kuryaheebwa abo, abu Tata yaakucumiire.
en: 23 And he saith unto them, Ye shall drink indeed of my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with: but to sit on my right hand, and on my left, is not mine to give, but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared of my Father.
24 And when the ten heard it , they were moved with indignation against the two brethren.

rr: 25 Yesu yaabeeta, yaabagira ati: Nimumanya abakuru b'abanyamahanga ku babategyekyesa eikama, n'abakuru baabo bakabaragiiza obushoboorozi
en: 25 But Jesus called them unto him , and said, Ye know that the princes of the Gentiles exercise dominion over them, and they that are great exercise authority upon them.
26 But it shall not be so among you: but whosoever will be great among you, let him be your minister;

rr: 27 n'orikwenda kuba ow'okubanza omuriimwe ashemereire kuba omuhuuku waanyu
en: 27 and whosoever will be chief among you, let him be your servant:
28 even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
29 And as they departed from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.

rr: 30 Kandi empumi ibiri zikaba zishutami aha rubaju rw'omuhanda. Ku zaahuriire ngu Yesu naahingura, zaayeta nizigira ziti: Mukama waitu, Mwana wa Daudi, otugirire embabazi!
en: 30 And, behold, two blind men sitting by the way side, when they heard that Jesus passed by, cried out, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou Son of David.

rr: 31 Ab'omu mutwe baaziteisa ngu zicureere
en: 31 And the multitude rebuked them, because they should hold their peace: but they cried the more, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou Son of David.

rr: 32 kwonka zo zaagumizamu nizeeta munonga ziti: Mukama waitu, Mwana wa Daudi, otugirire embabazi!
en: 32 And Jesus stood still, and called them, and said, What will ye that I shall do unto you?

rr: 33 Yesu nikwo kwemerera, akazeeta, akazibuuza ati: Nimwenda ngu mbakorere ki?
en: 33 They say unto him, Lord, that our eyes may be opened.

rr: 34 Zikamugarukamu ziti: Mukama waitu, nitwenda ngu amaisho gaitu gahumuukye.
en: 34 So Jesus had compassion on them , and touched their eyes: and immediately their eyes received sight, and they followed him.
1 And when they drew nigh unto Jerusalem, and were come to Bethphage, unto the mount of Olives, then sent Jesus two disciples,

rr: 2 yaabagira ati: Mugyende omu kirorero ekibari omumaisho; ahonaaho nimwija kushangamu endogoya etsibikire n'omwana gwayo; muzitsibure, muzindeetere.
en: 2 saying unto them, Go into the village over against you, and straightway ye shall find an ass tied, and a colt with her: loose them , and bring them unto me.

rr: 3 Omuntu weena ku araababuuze, mumugarukyemu muti: Mukama waitu naazenda. Ahonnaaho mukama waazo naija kuzoohereza.
en: 3 And if any man say ought unto you, ye shall say, The Lord hath need of them; and straightway he will send them.

rr: 4 Eki kikabaho okuhikiiriza ekyagambirwe nabi ati
en: 4 All this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying,
5 Tell ye the daughter of Sion,

rr: 6 Abeegi be baagyenda, baakora nk'oku Yesu yaabaragiira
en: 6 And the disciples went, and did as Jesus commanded them,

rr: 7 baareeta endogoya n'omwana gwayo, baazaaraho ebijwaro byabo; yaabishutamaho.
en: 7 and brought the ass, and the colt, and put on them their clothes, and they set him thereon.

rr: 8 Abaingi baayarira ebijwaro byabo omu nguuto, abandi baatema amababi g'ebiti, baagariira omu nguuto.
en: 8 And a very great multitude spread their garments in the way; others cut down branches from the trees, and strawed them in the way.

rr: 9 Abaamushendekyereize bamwebembeire, n'abandi bamuri enyima nibagyenda nibeeshongora n'eiraka rihango, nibagira bati: Hosana aha Mwana wa Daudi! Orikwija omu iziina rya Mukama asiimwe! Hosana ahaiguru ya byona!
en: 9 And the multitudes that went before, and that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna to the son of David: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.

rr: 10 Ku yaataahire Yerusaalemu, orurembo rwona rwajagarara, abantu baabuuzana bati: Ogu n'oha?
en: 10 And when he was come into Jerusalem, all the city was moved, saying, Who is this?

rr: 11 Abaizire nawe baagarukamu bati: Ni nabi Yesu owaarugire Nazareesi eya Galilaaya.
en: 11 And the multitude said, This is Jesus the prophet of Nazareth of Galilee.
12 And Jesus went into the temple of God, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves,
13 and said unto them, It is written, My house shall be called the house of prayer; but ye have made it a den of thieves.

rr: 14 Kandi empumi n'abarikucumbagira baija baamushanga omuri hekalu, yaabakiza.
en: 14 And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple; and he healed them.

rr: 15 Abanyamurwa abakuru n'abahandiiki ku baareebire eby'okutangaaza ebi yaakozire, baahurira n'abaana nibeeshongorera omuri hekalu bati: Hosana aha Mwana wa Daudi, baaguubw akubi munonga
en: 15 And when the chief priests and scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children crying in the temple, and saying, Hosanna to the son of David; they were sore displeased,
16 and said unto him, Hearest thou what these say? And Jesus saith unto them, Yea; have ye never read, Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings thou hast perfected praise?

rr: 17 Yaabatsigaho, yaashohora omu rurembo, yaataaha Besania, yaaraarayo.
en: 17 And he left them, and went out of the city into Bethany; and he lodged there.

rr: 18 Omu kasheeshe ku yaabaire naagaruka omu rurembo, yaagira enjara.
en: 18 Now in the morning as he returned into the city, he hungered.

19 And when he saw a fig tree in the way, he came to it, and found nothing thereon, but leaves only, and said unto it, Let no fruit grow on thee henceforward for ever. And presently the fig tree withered away.

rr: 20 Abeegi ku baakireebire, baatangaara nibagira bati: Omutiini gwarahuka guta kwoma?
en: 20 And when the disciples saw it , they marvelled, saying, How soon is the fig tree withered away!

21 Jesus answered and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, If ye have faith, and doubt not, ye shall not only do this which is done to the fig tree, but also if ye shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; it shall be done.

rr: 22 Byona ebi muryenda omu kashaba kwanyu, mwabishaba mwine okwikiriza, muryabiheebwa.
en: 22 And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.

23 And when he was come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came unto him as he was teaching, and said, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority?

rr: 24 Yesu yaabagarukamu ati: Reka naanye mbabuuze ekigambo kimwe; ku murangarukyemu, naanye niinyija kubashobororera obushoboorozi obunkoresa ebi.
en: 24 And Jesus answered and said unto them, I also will ask you one thing, which if ye tell me, I in like wise will tell you by what authority I do these things.

rr: 25 Okubatiza kwa Yohaana kukaruga nkahi? Omu iguru nari omu bantu? Baayegarukanamu bonka, nibagira bati: Ku turaagire tuti, Kukaruga omu iguru, naatugarukamu ati, Kandi shi, n'enki ekyabazibiire kumwikiriza?
en: 25 The baptism of John, whence was it? from heaven, or of men? And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say unto us, Why did ye not then believe him?
26 But if we shall say, Of men; we fear the people; for all hold John as a prophet.

rr: 27 Baamugarukamu bati: Titurikuhamanya.
en: 27 And they answered Jesus, and said, We cannot tell.
