rr: Yesu nikwo kubagira ati: Naanye tindikubagambira bushoborozi oburikunkoresa ebi.
en: And he said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.

rr: 28 Mbwenu nimuteekateeka muta ahari ebyo?
en: 28 But what think ye?

rr: Omushaija akaba aine abatabani babiri; yaaragiira ow'omujigaijo ati: Mwana wangye, irooko okore omu musiri gwangye ogw'emizaabibu eri izooba.
en: A certain man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, Son, go work to day in my vineyard.
29 He answered and said, I will not: but afterward he repented, and went.

rr: 30 Yaaza aha murumuna, nawe yaamuragiira nk'ebyo; yaamwikiriza ati: Eego Taata, ka ngyende; kwonka tiyaazayo.
en: 30 And he came to the second, and said likewise. And he answered and said, I go , sir: and went not.

31 Whether of them twain did the will of his father? They say unto him, The first. Jesus saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you.

rr: 32 Ahabw'okuba Yohaana akaija ahariimwe arabire omu muhanda gw'okuhikiirira, timwamwikiriza; kwonka abahooza na baamaraaaya bakamwikiriza; naimwe, n'obu mwabireebire mutyo, bwanyima timureefurize, mukamizikiriza.
en: 32 For John came unto you in the way of righteousness, and ye believed him not: but the publicans and the harlots believed him: and ye, when ye had seen it , repented not afterward, that ye might believe him.

33 Hear another parable: There was a certain householder, which planted a vineyard, and hedged it round about, and digged a winepress in it, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country:

rr: 34 Mbwenu obunaku bw'okwera ku bwahikire, yaatuma abahuuku be ahari abo bahingi, ngu bamutwekyere aha byana by'emizaabibu ye.
en: 34 and when the time of the fruit drew near, he sent his servants to the husbandmen, that they might receive the fruits of it.

rr: 35 Abahingi baakwata abo bahuuku be, omwe baamuteera, ondiijo baamwita, n'ondiijo baamuteera amabaare.
en: 35 And the husbandmen took his servants, and beat one, and killed another, and stoned another.

rr: 36 Yaagaruka yaatuma abandi bahuuku baingi okukira ab'okubanza; nabo baabatwaza batyo.
en: 36 Again, he sent other servants more than the first: and they did unto them likewise.

rr: 37 Bwanyima yaabatumaho omwana we, naagira ati: Omwana wangye baryamuha ekitiinisa.
en: 37 But last of all he sent unto them his son, saying, They will reverence my son.

rr: 38 Kwonka abahingi ku baareebire omwana we, baagambirana bati: Ogu niwe muhunguzi; murekye tumwite, tutungye obuhunguzi bwe.
en: 38 But when the husbandmen saw the son, they said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and let us seize on his inheritance.

rr: 39 Baamukwata, baamubinga omu musiri gw'emizaabibu, baamwita.
en: 39 And they caught him, and cast him out of the vineyard, and slew him .

rr: 40 Mbwenu mukama w'emizaabibu, ku ariija, aryagira ata abo bahingi?
en: 40 When the lord therefore of the vineyard cometh, what will he do unto those husbandmen?

rr: 41 Baamugarukamu bati: Abagomi abo aryabaita kubi, n'emizaabibu ye aryagitsigamu abandi bahingi, abariguma nibamutwekyera ebyana byayo omu bunaku bwabyo.
en: 41 They say unto him, He will miserably destroy those wicked men, and will let out his vineyard unto other husbandmen, which shall render him the fruits in their seasons.
42 Jesus saith unto them, Did ye never read in the scriptures,

rr: 43 Nikyo ndikubagirira nti: Obukama bwa Ruhanga buryabaakwa, buheebwe eihanga eririkwana ebyana byabwo.
en: 43 Therefore say I unto you, The kingdom of God shall be taken from you, and given to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof.

rr: 44 Omuntu weena origwa aha ibaare eryo aryacwagurika; kwonka ou ririgwera, riryamucwa obusaasingo.
en: 44 And whosoever shall fall on this stone shall be broken: but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.

rr: 45 Abanyamurwa abakuru n'Abafarisaayo, ku baahuriire enfumu ze, baamanya ku nibo arikurengyeza.
en: 45 And when the chief priests and Pharisees had heard his parables, they perceived that he spake of them.

rr: 46 Baayenda kumukwata; kwonka baatiina abantu, ahabw'okuba abantu bakaba nibahamya ku ari nabi.
en: 46 But when they sought to lay hands on him, they feared the multitude, because they took him for a prophet.

rr: 1 Kandi Yesu yaagaruka yaabacwera enfumu naagira ati
en: 1 And Jesus answered and spake unto them again by parables, and said,
2 The kingdom of heaven is like unto a certain king, which made a marriage for his son,

rr: 3 Obugyenyi ku bwahikire, yaatuma abahuuku be kweta abeetsirwe, baayanga kwija.
en: 3 and sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the wedding: and they would not come.

rr: 4 Yaagaruka yaatuma abandi bahuuku, yaabagira ati: Mwirooko mungirire abeetsirwe muti: Reeba nteekateekire eby'okugabura, enimi n'enyana z'ebishaju zangye ziitsirwe, byona byatebeekaine, mwije mutaahe obugyenyi.
en: 4 Again, he sent forth other servants, saying, Tell them which are bidden, Behold, I have prepared my dinner: my oxen and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready: come unto the marriage.

rr: 5 Kwonka tibaabitaho mutima, baayegyendera, omwe omu kibanja kye, ondiijo omu mirimo ye
en: 5 But they made light of it , and went their ways, one to his farm, another to his merchandise:

rr: 6 n'abaatsigaireho baakwata abahuuku be, baabahemangura, baabaita.
en: 6 and the remnant took his servants, and entreated them spitefully, and slew them .

rr: 7 Omugabe yaakwatwa ekiniga, yaayohereza engabo ze, yaahwerekyereza abaitsi abo, yaayotsya orurembo rwabo.
en: 7 But when the king heard thereof , he was wroth: and he sent forth his armies, and destroyed those murderers, and burned up their city.

rr: 8 Bwanyima yaagira abahuuku be ati: Obugyenyi bwatebeekaine, kwonka abeetsirwe tibabushemereire.
en: 8 Then saith he to his servants, The wedding is ready, but they which were bidden were not worthy.

rr: 9 Mbwenu mugyende ahu emihanda y'omu rurembo erikuteeranira; abu muraareebeyo boona mubeete baije bataahe obugyenyi.
en: 9 Go ye therefore into the highways, and as many as ye shall find, bid to the marriage.

rr: 10 N'abahuuku abo baaza omuri egyo mihanda, baayeta boona abu baareebire, ababi n'abarungi; enju yaijura abagyenyi.
en: 10 So those servants went out into the highways, and gathered together all as many as they found, both bad and good: and the wedding was furnished with guests.

rr: 11 Omugabe ku yaizire kureeba abagyenyi, yaashangamu omushaija otajwaire kijwaro ky'obugyenyi.
en: 11 And when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man which had not on a wedding garment:

rr: 12 Yaamubuuza ati: Mugyenzi wangye, waija ota aha otajwaire kijwaro ky'obugyenyi. Yaabura eky'okumugarukamu.
en: 12 and he saith unto him, Friend, how camest thou in hither not having a wedding garment? And he was speechless.
13 Then said the king to the servants, Bind him hand and foot, and take him away, and cast him into outer darkness; there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

rr: 14 Ahakuba abeetwa ni baingi, kwonka abatooranwa ni bakye.
en: 14 For many are called, but few are chosen.
15 Then went the Pharisees, and took counsel how they might entangle him in his talk.

rr: 16 Batyo baamutumaho abeegi baabo hamwe n'aba Heroode, baamugira bati: Mwegyesa, nitumanya ku ori ow'amazima, ku oyegyesa omuhanda gwa Ruhanga omu mazima, kandi ku otagwera urbaju rw'omuntuw eena orutahikire, ahakuba totiinisibwa kitiinisa ky'omuntu.
en: 16 And they sent out unto him their disciples with the Herodians, saying, Master, we know that thou art true, and teachest the way of God in truth, neither carest thou for any man : for thou regardest not the person of men.

rr: 17 Mbwenu otugambire eki orikuteekateeka. Ebiragiro nibiikiriza kuha Kaisaari omushoro, nari tikwo?
en: 17 Tell us therefore, What thinkest thou? Is it lawful to give tribute unto Cæsar, or not?

rr: 18 Kwonka Yesu ku yaamanyire obugobya bwabyo, yaagira ati: Nimuntegyera ki, imwe ndyarya 'mwe?
en: 18 But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, Why tempt ye me, ye hypocrites?

rr: 19 Muunyorekye empiiha ei mushora. Baamureetera edenaari.
en: 19 Shew me the tribute money. And they brought unto him a penny.

rr: 20 Yaababuuza ati: Ekishushani eki n'ebihandiikirweho n'eby'oha?
en: 20 And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription?
21 They say unto him, Cæsar's. Then saith he unto them, Render therefore unto Cæsar the things which are Cæsar's; and unto God the things that are God's.

rr: 22 Ku baabihuriire, baatangaara, baamurugaho, baagyenda.
en: 22 When they had heard these words , they marvelled, and left him, and went their way.
23 The same day came to him the Sadducees, which say that there is no resurrection, and asked him,

rr: 24 Mwegyesa, Musa akagira ati: Omuntu ku arifa atakazaire, omurumuna ashemereire kuhungura omufaakazi ogwo, amumuzaarireho abaana.
en: 24 saying, Master, Moses said, If a man die, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

rr: 25 Mbwenu owaitu hakaba hariyo enyineemwe mushanju. Ow'okubanza akashwera omukazi, yaafa; ahabw'okufa atakazaire, omukazi we yaamuraga owa kabiri.
en: 25 Now there were with us seven brethren: and the first, when he had married a wife, deceased, and, having no issue, left his wife unto his brother:

rr: 26 Nikwo batyo owa kabiri n'owa kashatu, okuhika aha mushanju.
en: 26 likewise the second also, and the third, unto the seventh.

rr: 27 Boona ku baahweireho, omukazi nawe yaafa.
en: 27 And last of all the woman died also.

rr: 28 Mbwenu omu kuzooka aryaba muka oha ahari abo mushanju? Ahabw'okuba boona omushanju akabaho omukazi waabo.
en: 28 Therefore in the resurrection whose wife shall she be of the seven? for they all had her.

rr: 29 Yesu yaabagarukamu naabagira ati: Muhabire, ahabw'okutamanya Ebyahandiikirwe n'obu gaakuba amaani ga Ruhanga.
en: 29 Jesus answered and said unto them, Ye do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of God.

rr: 30 Mumanye ngu omu kuzooka tibarishwera, kandi tibarishwerwa, kureka baryaba nka baamaraika b'omu iguru.
en: 30 For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels of God in heaven.

rr: 31 Ebirikukwata aha by'okuzooka kw'abafu, timukashomaga eki Ruhanga yaabagambiire ati
en: 31 But as touching the resurrection of the dead, have ye not read that which was spoken unto you by God, saying,
32 I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.

rr: 33 Abantu ku bakihuriire, baatangaarira okwegyesa kwe.
en: 33 And when the multitude heard this , they were astonished at his doctrine.
34 But when the Pharisees had heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence, they were gathered together.

rr: 35 Omwe aharibo, omwegyesa w'Ebiragiro, yaamubuuza naamutega ati
en: 35 Then one of them, which was a lawyer, asked him a question , tempting him, and saying,

rr: 36 Mwegyesa, ekiragiro ekikuru omu biragiro nikiiha?
en: 36 Master, which is the great commandment in the law?
37 Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.

rr: 38 Eki nikyo kiragiro kikuru kandi eky'okubanza.
en: 38 This is the first and great commandment.
39 And the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
40 On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets.
41 While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them,

rr: 42 Kristo nimumuteekateekaho muta? N'Omwana w'oha? Baamugarukamu bati: N'Omwana wa Daudi.
en: 42 saying, What think ye of Christ? whose son is he? They say unto him, The son of David.

rr: 43 Yaagaruka yaababuuza ati: Kandi shi ahanki Daudi, obu yaagambisibwa Omwoyo Orikwera, akamweta Mukama we ati
en: 43 He saith unto them, How then doth David in spirit call him Lord, saying,
44 The LORD said unto my Lord,

rr: 45 Beitu shi, Daudi ku araabe yaayetsire Kristo Mukama we, kandi Kristo ogwo naabaasa ata kuba Omwana we?
en: 45 If David then call him Lord, how is he his son?

rr: 46 Kandi tihariho n'omwe owaabaasize kumugarukamu ekigambo; n'okuruga aha kiro ekyo tihaine waayehangire kumubuuza ebindi bibuuzo.
en: 46 And no man was able to answer him a word, neither durst any man from that day forth ask him any more questions .
1 Then spake Jesus to the multitude, and to his disciples,

rr: 2 Abahandiiki n'Abafarisaayo bashutama aha kitebe kya Musa.
en: 2 saying, The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses' seat:
3 all therefore whatsoever they bid you observe, that observe and do; but do not ye after their works: for they say, and do not.

rr: 4 Bakoma emitwaro erikuremeera, etarikubaasa kwekorerwa, bagyekoreza abantu aha mabega; kwonka bo tibenda kugitenzyaho n'orukumu rwabo.
en: 4 For they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne, and lay them on men's shoulders; but they themselves will not move them with one of their fingers.
5 But all their works they do for to be seen of men: they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders of their garments,
6 and love the uppermost rooms at feasts, and the chief seats in the synagogues,

rr: 7 n'okutangirirwa omu katare, n'okwetwa abantu Rabi.
en: 7 and greetings in the markets, and to be called of men, Rabbi, Rabbi.

rr: 8 Kwonka imwe mutaryetwa Rabi, ahabw'okuba Omwegyesa waanyu n'omwe, kandi naimwe mwena muri eishe-emwe.
en: 8 But be not ye called Rabbi: for one is your Master, even Christ; and all ye are brethren.

rr: 9 Kandi mutaryeta omuntu weena ow'omu nsi Shoimwe; ahabw'okuba mwine Shoimwe omwe ori omu iguru.
en: 9 And call no man your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, which is in heaven.

rr: 10 Kandi mutaryetwa abakama, ahabw'okuba mwine Omukama omwe, niwe Kristo.
en: 10 Neither be ye called masters: for one is your Master, even Christ.

rr: 11 Orikukira obukuru omuriimwe aryaba omuheereza waanyu
en: 11 But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant.
12 And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be abased; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted.

rr: 13 Kwonka muryakareeba, imwe Abahandiiki n'Abafarisaayo, endyarya! ahabw'okuba mukinga obukama bw'omu iguru, ngu abantu batabutaahamu; imwe mwenka timubutaahamu, kandi abarikwenda kubutaahamu, timubaikiriza.
en: 13 But woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye shut up the kingdom of heaven against men: for ye neither go in yourselves , neither suffer ye them that are entering to go in.

rr: 14 Muryakareeba, imwe Abahandiiki n'Abafarisaayo, endyarya; ahabw'okuba munyaga enju z'abafaakazi, kandi murandagatana omu kushaba, haza kunu nimuryarya; n'ahabw'ekyo muryacwerwa orubanja orurikukira obuhango.
en: 14 Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayer: therefore ye shall receive the greater damnation.

rr: 15 Muryakareeba, imwe Abahandiiki n'Abafarisaayo, endyarya! ahabw'okuba mwambuka enyanja, mugyendagyenda n'omu mahanga kuhindura omuntu omwe, ngu aikirize ediini yaanyu; kandi ku mumubona, mumuhindura omwana wa Gehena okukira emwe kabiri.
en: 15 Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.
16 Woe unto you, ye blind guides, which say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor!

rr: 17 Imwe bashema 'mwe kandi empumi! ekirikukira obukuru n'enki, n'ezaabu, nari ni hkalu erikweza ezaabu?
en: 17 Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifieth the gold?

rr: 18 Kandi nimugira ngu, Orikurahira eitambiro, ti rubanja; kureka ngu Orikurahira empongano eri aha itambiro, ashemereire kuhikiiriza eki yaarahiire kukora.
en: 18 And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever sweareth by the gift that is upon it, he is guilty.

rr: 19 Imwe mpumi 'mwe! ekirikukira obukuru n'enki, n'empongano, nari n'eitambiro eririkweza empongano?
en: 19 Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifieth the gift?

rr: 20 Mumanye ngu orikurahira eitambiro, biri arirahiire n'ebiririho byona
en: 20 Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar, sweareth by it, and by all things thereon.

rr: 21 kandi orikurahira hakalu biri agirahiire n'Ogwo ogituuramu.
en: 21 And whoso shall swear by the temple, sweareth by it, and by him that dwelleth therein.
22 And he that shall swear by heaven, sweareth by the throne of God, and by him that sitteth thereon.

23 Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.

rr: 24 Imwe abeebembezi empumi, abagyegyena omubu, mukamira engamira!
en: 24 Ye blind guides, which strain at a gnat, and swallow a camel.
25 Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excess.

rr: 26 Iwe Omufarisaayo empumi, banza oyozye omunda y'enkyeka n'orwabya, aharuguru yaabyo habone kushemera.
en: 26 Thou blind Pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.

rr: 27 Muryakareeba, imwe abahandiiki n'Abafarisaayo, endyarya! ahabw'okuba nimushusha nk'ebituuro ebisiigire einoni; aharuguru bikareebeka nk'ebishemeire, haza omunda biijwire amagufa n'oburofa bwona.
en: 27 Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead men's bones, and of all uncleanness.

rr: 28 Nikwo naimwe omu by'aharuguru mureebeka nka'abahikiriire omu maisho g'abantu, kwonka omunda mwijwire oburyarya n'obugomi.
en: 28 Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men, but within ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.

rr: 29 Muryakareeba, imwe abahandiiki n'Abafarisaayo, endyarya! ahabw'okuba mwombeka ebituuro bya baanabi, musharura ebiijutsyo by'abahikiriire
en: 29 Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because ye build the tombs of the prophets, and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous,

rr: 30 nimugira ngu, Kuri twabaire turiho omu biro bya baatatenkuriitwe, titwakukwataniise nabo omu kusheesha eshagama ya baanabi.
en: 30 and say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.
31 Wherefore ye be witnesses unto yourselves, that ye are the children of them which killed the prophets.

rr: 32 Mbwenu nu nimwijuze orugyero rwa baashwenkuriimwe.
en: 32 Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers.

rr: 33 Imwe enjoka kandi abaana b'encwera, muryakira muta orubanja rwa Gehena?
en: 33 Ye serpents, ye generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of hell?

34 Wherefore, behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: and some of them ye shall kill and crucify; and some of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues, and persecute them from city to city:
35 that upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom ye slew between the temple and the altar.

rr: 36 Buzimazima nimbagambira nti: Ebyo byona biryahika aha bantu b'obusingye obu.
en: 36 Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation.

37 O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, thou that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto thee, how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not!

rr: 38 Reeba, enju yaanyu etsigirweho n'omushaka.
en: 38 Behold, your house is left unto you desolate.
39 For I say unto you, Ye shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
1 And Jesus went out, and departed from the temple: and his disciples came to him for to shew him the buildings of the temple.

rr: 2 We yaabagarukamu, naagira ati: Timurikureeba ebi byona? Buzimazima nimbagambira nti: Tihariho ibaare eriritsigara riri aha rindi eritarinagwa ahansi.
en: 2 And Jesus said unto them, See ye not all these things? verily I say unto you, There shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

rr: 3 Ku yaabaire ashutami omu kibungo kya Zeituuni, abeegi be baija aha'ari omu mubonano, baamubuuza bati: Tugambire ebi ahu biribeeraho, n'akamanyiso k'okwija kwawe oku kariba, n'ak'obunaku obu ensi egi erihweraho.
en: 3 And as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?

rr: 4 Yesu yaabagarukamu ati: Mwerinde, omuntu weena ataribahabisa
en: 4 And Jesus answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man deceive you.
5 For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.

rr: 6 Kandi muryahurira engamba n'okurangaanwa kwazo; mwerinde, mutaryemereza emitima, ahakuba ebyo byona tibiribura kwija; kwonka emperu yo eryaba etakahikire.
en: 6 And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.
7 For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.

rr: 8 Ebyo byona niyo ntandikiro y'obusaasi.
en: 8 All these are the beginning of sorrows.
9 Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name's sake.

rr: 10 Omu biro ebyo baingi baryagwa, bareebyane, bangane.
en: 10 And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.
11 And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many.
12 And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.

rr: 13 Kwonka origumisiriza okuhitsya aha muheru, niwe arijunwa.
en: 13 But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.

rr: 14 Kandi engiri egi ey'obukama eryagambwa omu nsi zoona okuba eky'okuhamya aha mahanga goona; obwo nibwo emperu erihika.
en: 14 And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.
15 When ye therefore shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place, (whoso readeth, let him understand:)

rr: 16 abo abariba bari Buyudaaya omu bunaku obwo bahungire aha nshozi
en: 16 then let them which be in Judæa flee into the mountains:
17 let him which is on the house top not come down to take any thing out of his house:

rr: 18 n'oriba ari omu misiri atarigarukayo kwenda ekijwaro kye.
en: 18 neither let him which is in the field return back to take his clothes.

rr: 19 Abariba baine enda n'abarikwontsya omu biro ebyo bayrakareeba!
en: 19 And woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!

rr: 20 Mushabe okuhunga kwanyu kutaribaho omu biro by'embeho nari ahari Sabato
en: 20 But pray ye that your flight be not in the winter, neither on the sabbath day:
21 for then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.

rr: 22 Ebiro ebyo kuri bitaracwireho, tihaakurokokireho muntu n'omwe; kwonka ahabw'entoore ebiro ebyo biryacuubwaho.
en: 22 And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect's sake those days shall be shortened.

rr: 23 Omu biro ebyo omuntu weena ku aribagira ati: Reeba, Kristo ari aha! nari shi, ari hariya, mutarimwikiriza
en: 23 Then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here is Christ, or there; believe it not.
24 For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.

rr: 25 Reeba naabibagambira bitakahikire.
en: 25 Behold, I have told you before.

rr: 26 N'ahabw'ekyo ku baribagira bati: Reeba, ari omu ihamba, mutarizayo; nari ngu, ari omu kishengye, mutarikiikiriza.
en: 26 Wherefore if they shall say unto you, Behold, he is in the desert; go not forth: behold, he is in the secret chambers; believe it not.

rr: 27 Nk'oku omurabyo gurabiza oburugwa-izooba gukahika oburengyerwa-izooba, nikwo n'okwija kw'Omwana w'omuntu kuriba.
en: 27 For as the lightning cometh out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.

rr: 28 Ahu omutumbi guri hoona, niho amahungu gateeranira.
en: 28 For wheresoever the carcase is, there will the eagles be gathered together.

29 Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken:

30 and then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
31 And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.

rr: 32 N'ahabw'ekyo mwegyere aha mutiini nk'eky'okureeberaho; eitaagi ryagwo ku ryoroba, ryatooka amababi, mumanya ku omwaka guri haihi.
en: 32 Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When his branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is nigh:

rr: 33 Mutyo naimwe ku murireeba ebyo byona, mumanye ku ari haihi, ku yaahikire n'aha rwigi.
en: 33 so likewise ye, when ye shall see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.

rr: 34 Buzimazima nimbagambira nti: Obusingye obu tiburihwaho, okuhitsya obu ebi byona biribaho.
en: 34 Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass, till all these things be fulfilled.
35 Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.

rr: 36 Kwonka eby'ekyo kiro n'obwo bunaku tihaine orikubimanya, n'obu baakuba baamaraika b'omu iguru, n'obu yaakuba Omwana, kureka Isheboona wenka.
en: 36 But of that day and hour knoweth no man , no, not the angels of heaven, but my Father only.
37 But as the days of Noe were , so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
38 For as in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark,

rr: 39 bakaba bari aho bataine ki barikumanya, okuhitsya obu omwegyemure gw'amaizi gwaizire, gukabatwara boona; n'okwija kw'Omwana w'omuntu nikwo kuriba kutyo.
en: 39 and knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
40 Then shall two be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

rr: 41 Abakazi babiri baryaba nibasa aha rubengo; omwe aryatwarwa, ondiijo atsigweho.
en: 41 Two women shall be grinding at the mill; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

rr: 42 N'ahabw'ekyo mugume nimureeba, ahakuba timurikumanya kiro eki Mukama waanyu ariiziraho.
en: 42 Watch therefore: for ye know not what hour your Lord doth come.
43 But know this, that if the goodman of the house had known in what watch the thief would come, he would have watched, and would not have suffered his house to be broken up.

rr: 44 N'ahabw'ekyo naimwe mweteguure, ahabw'okuba obunaku obu mutarikuteekateeka, nibwo Omwana w'omuntu ariiziramu.
en: 44 Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.

rr: 45 Ni # 24:45 Omu Rugriika n'omuhuuku. mwambari ki ow'okwesigwa kandi ow'obwengye, ou mukama we yaatsigiire ab'omu ka ye kubagaburira omu bunaku obuhikire?
en: 45 Who then is a faithful and wise servant, whom his lord hath made ruler over his household, to give them meat in due season?

rr: 46 Aine omugisha omwambari ogwo, ou mukama we arigaruka akashanga naakora atyo.
en: 46 Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.
47 Verily I say unto you, That he shall make him ruler over all his goods.
48 But and if that evil servant shall say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming;

rr: 49 akatandika kuteera abambari bagyenzi be, akarya kandi akanywa n'abasinzi
en: 49 and shall begin to smite his fellowservants, and to eat and drink with the drunken;

rr: 50 mukama w'omwambari ogwo aryaija aha izooba eri atamutegyerereizeho, n'obunaku obu atarikumanya
en: 50 the lord of that servant shall come in a day when he looketh not for him , and in an hour that he is not aware of,

rr: 51 aryamutemamu habiri, amuhe omugabo gwe n'endyarya; okwo niyo abantu bariririra, bakanena enshaya.
en: 51 and shall cut him asunder, and appoint him his portion with the hypocrites: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
1 Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.

rr: 2 Bataano aharibo bakaba bari abashema, n'abandi bataano bari ab'obwengye
en: 2 And five of them were wise, and five were foolish.

rr: 3 ahakuba abashema ku baatwaire etabaaza zaabo, tibaatwara gandi majuta
en: 3 They that were foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them:

rr: 4 kwonka ab'obwengye baatwara amajuta omu cupa hamwe n'etabaaza zaabo.
en: 4 but the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.

rr: 5 Kandi kishwera ku yairiirweyo, boona baahungira, baagwejegyera.
en: 5 While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.

rr: 6 Bwanyima nyekiro omu itumbi haabaho orwari ngu: Reeba, kishwera yaija! mushohore tumubugane.
en: 6 And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him.

rr: 7 Abaishiki abo baimuka, baashemeza etabaaza zaabo.
en: 7 Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.

rr: 8 Abashema baashaba ab'obwengye bati: Mutuhe aha majuta gaanyu, ahakuba etabaaza zaitu zaaza kuraara.
en: 8 And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out.

rr: 9 Ab'obwengye baagarukamu bati: Nooshusha oti, tigarikutumarira twena; kureka mugyende ahu barikugatundira; mwegurire.
en: 9 But the wise answered, saying, Not so ; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.

rr: 10 Ku baabaire bagiire kugura, kishwera yaija; abaabaire beeteekateekire baataaha nawe, omu nju omu bugyenyi bw'okushwera; orwigi rwakingwa.
en: 10 And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut.
11 Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.

rr: 12 We yaabagarukamu ati: Buzimazima nimbagambira nti: Tindikubamanya.
en: 12 But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.

rr: 13 N'ahabw'ekyo mugume nimureeba, ahabw'okuba timurikumanya kiro n'obu yaakuba eshaaha.
en: 13 Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh.
14 For the kingdom of heaven is as a man travelling into a far country, who called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods.
15 And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one; to every man according to his several ability; and straightway took his journey.

rr: 16 Owaahairwe etalanta itaano ahonaaho yaagyenda, yaazishuubuza, yaashaazyamu ezindi itaano.
en: 16 Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same, and made them other five talents.

rr: 17 N'owaahairwe ibiri nawe yaashaazyamu atyo ezindi ibiri.
en: 17 And likewise he that had received two, he also gained other two.

rr: 18 Kwonka owaahairwe emwe yaagyenda, yaatimba omu itaka, yaasherekamu etalanta ya mukama we.
en: 18 But he that had received one went and digged in the earth, and hid his lord's money.

rr: 19 Ebiro bingi ku byahingwireho, mukama w'abambari abo yaagaruka, yaabara nabo ebi yaabatsigiire.
en: 19 After a long time the lord of those servants cometh, and reckoneth with them.

rr: 20 Owaahairwe etalanta itaano, yaija yaareeta ezindi itaano, yaagira ati: Mukama wangye, okantsigira etalanta itaano; reeba nshaagizemu ezindi itaano.
en: 20 And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me five talents: behold, I have gained beside them five talents more.
21 His lord said unto him, Well done, thou good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.

rr: 22 Owaahairwe etalanta ibiri nawe yaija, yaagira ati: Mukama wangye, okantsigira etalanta ibiri; reeba nshaagizemu ezindi ibiri.
en: 22 He also that had received two talents came and said, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me two talents: behold, I have gained two other talents beside them.

rr: 23 Mukama we yaagira ati: Kazaare, iwe omwambari omurungi orikwesigwa! obaire omwesigwa omuri bikye; ndyakuha obushoboorozi kutegyeka bingi; taaha omu kushemererwa kwa mukama waawe.
en: 23 His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant; thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.

rr: 24 Kandi n'ogwo owaahairwe etalanta emwe yaija, yaagira ati: Mukama wangye, nkamanya ku ori omuntu ogumire, ogyesha ahu otarabibire, kandi ohunika ebi otaraheheerize
en: 24 Then he which had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art an hard man, reaping where thou hast not sown, and gathering where thou hast not strawed:

rr: 25 n'ahabw'ekyo nkatiina, naagyenda naashereka etalanta yaawe omu itaka. Reeba ngigi, ogigarukane.
en: 25 and I was afraid, and went and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, there thou hast that is thine.

rr: 26 Mukama we nikwo kumugarukamu ati: Iwe omwambari omubi kandi omweremwa! okamanya ku ngyesha ahu ntarabibire, nkahunika ebi ntaraheheerize.
en: 26 His lord answered and said unto him, Thou wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I have not strawed:

rr: 27 N'ahabw'ekyo okaba oshemereire kuha etaanta yangye ababiiki b'empiiha, naanye ku naakwizire, nkaagigaruriirwe n'enshaagi yaayo.
en: 27 thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers, and then at my coming I should have received mine own with usury.

rr: 28 Mbwenu mugimwakye, mugihe oine etalanta ikumi.
en: 28 Take therefore the talent from him, and give it unto him which hath ten talents.
29 For unto every one that hath shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but from him that hath not shall be taken away even that which he hath.

rr: 30 N'omwambari ogwo otaine mugasho, mumunagye aheeru omu mwirima; okwo niyo abantu bariririra, bakanena enshaya.
en: 30 And cast ye the unprofitable servant into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
31 When the Son of man shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:
32 and before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divideth his sheep from the goats:

rr: 33 Entaama aryazita aha rubaju rwe rwa buryo, kwonka embuzi aryazita aha rwa bumosho.
en: 33 and he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.

rr: 34 Obwo Mukama aryagira ab'aha rubaju rwa buryo ati: Mwije, imwe abu Tata yaahaire omugisha, muhungure obukama obwabateekateekyeirwe okuruga aha kuhangwa kw'ensi
en: 34 Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand, Come, ye blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:
35 for I was an hungred, and ye gave me meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink: I was a stranger, and ye took me in:

rr: 36 nkaba njwaire busha, mwanjweka; nkaba ndwaire, mwaija kundeeba; nkaba ndi omu kihome, mwantaayaayira.
en: 36 naked, and ye clothed me: I was sick, and ye visited me: I was in prison, and ye came unto me.

rr: 37 Abahikiriire baryamubuuza bati: Mukama waitu, tukakureeba ryari oine enjara, tukakuha eby'okurya, nari oine eiriho tukakuha eky'okunywa?
en: 37 Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, and fed thee ? or thirsty, and gave thee drink?

rr: 38 Tukakureeba ryari ori omugyenyi tukakukunira, nari ojwaire busha tukakujweka?
en: 38 When saw we thee a stranger, and took thee in? or naked, and clothed thee ?

rr: 39 Tukakureeba ryari orwaire, nari ori omu kihome tukaija kukureeba?
en: 39 Or when saw we thee sick, or in prison, and came unto thee?

rr: 40 Mukama aryabagarukamu ati: Buzimazima nimbagambira nti: Nk'oku mwabikoreire omwe ahari beene Tata abo abato okukira abandi, biri niinye mwabikoreire.
en: 40 And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.
41 Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:

rr: 42 ahakuba nkaba nyine enjara, timwampa by'okurya; nyine eiriho, timwampa ky'okunywa
en: 42 for I was an hungred, and ye gave me no meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me no drink:

rr: 43 nkaba ndi omugyenyi, timwankunira; njwaire busha, timwanjweka; ndwaire kandi ndi oomu kihome, timwaija kundeeba.
en: 43 I was a stranger, and ye took me not in: naked, and ye clothed me not: sick, and in prison, and ye visited me not.

rr: 44 Nabo baryamugarukamu bati: Mukama waitu, tukakureeba ryari oine enjara, nari oine eiriho, nari ori omugyenyi, nari ojwaire busha, nari orwaire, nari ori omu kihome, tukabura eki twakukorera?
en: 44 Then shall they also answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, or athirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister unto thee?

rr: 45 Nawe aryabagarukamu ati: Nk'oku mutarabikoreire omwe ahari abo abato okukira abandi, biri naanye timurabinkoreire.
en: 45 Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did it not to one of the least of these, ye did it not to me.
46 And these shall go away into everlasting punishment: but the righteous into life eternal.

rr: 1 Yesu ku yaaherize kugamba ebyo byona, yaagira abeegi be ati
en: 1 And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished all these sayings, he said unto his disciples,
2 Ye know that after two days is the feast of the passover, and the Son of man is betrayed to be crucified.

rr: 3 Omu biro ebyo abanyamurwa abakuru n'abakuru b'eihanga eryo bakateeranira omu ka y'omunyamurwa omukuru, owaabaire naayetwa Kayaafa
en: 3 Then assembled together the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders of the people, unto the palace of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas,

rr: 4 baahanuura ahamwe oku baraakwate Yesu omu bwengye, bakamwita.
en: 4 and consulted that they might take Jesus by subtilty, and kill him .

rr: 5 kwonka baagira bati: Haza tutamukwatira omu biro by'obugyenyi, hatabaho okurabanamu omu bantu.
en: 5 But they said, Not on the feast day , lest there be an uproar among the people.
6 Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,

rr: 7 haija omukazi oine eihembe ry'amajuta ag'obuguzi bwingi munonga, yaagashuka aha mutwe gwe ashutami naarya.
en: 7 there came unto him a woman having an alabaster box of very precious ointment, and poured it on his head, as he sat at meat.

rr: 8 Abeegi be, ku baakireebire, baaguubwa kubi nibagira bati: Amajuta aga gaafa ki?
en: 8 But when his disciples saw it , they had indignation, saying, To what purpose is this waste?

rr: 9 Nangwa kuru gaguzirwemu bingi, bikagabirwa abooro!
en: 9 For this ointment might have been sold for much, and given to the poor.

rr: 10 Kwonka Yesu, ku yaabimanyire, yaabagira ati: Nimugwisiza ki kubi omukazi ogu? Ahakuba eki yankorera ni kirungi.
en: 10 When Jesus understood it , he said unto them, Why trouble ye the woman? for she hath wrought a good work upon me.

rr: 11 Ahabw'okuba abooro mutuura nabo obutoosha; kwonka nyowe timuriguma naanye obutoosha.
en: 11 For ye have the poor always with you; but me ye have not always.

rr: 12 Omu kushuka amajuta aga aha mubiri gwangye, yaakikora ahabw'okunteekateekyera okuziikwa.
en: 12 For in that she hath poured this ointment on my body, she did it for my burial.

rr: 13 Buzimazima nimbagambira nti: Ahu engiri erigambwa hoona omu nsi zoona, n'eki omukazi ogu yaakora kiryagambwayo kumwijuka.
en: 13 Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, there shall also this, that this woman hath done, be told for a memorial of her.
14 Then one of the twelve, called Judas Iscariot, went unto the chief priests,
15 and said unto them , What will ye give me, and I will deliver him unto you? And they covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver.
16 And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him.
17 Now the first day of the feast of unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus, saying unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare for thee to eat the passover?

rr: 18 Yaabaragiira ati: Mwirooko mugyende omu rurembo owa nanka, mumugire muti: Omwegyesa naagira ati: Obunaku bwangye nibwenda kuhika; omu nju yaawe nimwo ndaariire Okuhingurwaho hamwe n'abeebi bangye.
en: 18 And he said, Go into the city to such a man, and say unto him, The Master saith, My time is at hand; I will keep the passover at thy house with my disciples.

rr: 19 Abeegi abo baakora nk'oku Yesu yaabagambira; baatebeekanisa Okuhingurwaho.
en: 19 And the disciples did as Jesus had appointed them; and they made ready the passover.
20 Now when the even was come, he sat down with the twelve.

rr: 21 Ku baabaire nibarya, yaabagira ati: Buzimazima nimbagambira nti: Omwe ahariimwe naija kundeebya.
en: 21 And as they did eat, he said, Verily I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.

rr: 22 Baashaasha munonga bashobeirwe, baatandika kumubuuza omwe omwe bati: Mukama wangye, niinye?
en: 22 And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began every one of them to say unto him, Lord, is it I?

rr: 23 Yaabagarukamu ati: Owaaba naakoza naanye omu rwabya, niwe arikwija kundeebya.
en: 23 And he answered and said, He that dippeth his hand with me in the dish, the same shall betray me.

rr: 24 Omwana w'omuntu naagyenda, nk'oku kyamuhandiikirweho; kwonka orikumureebya aryakareeba. Kikaabaire kirungi nangwa omuntu ogwo kuri atarazairwe.
en: 24 The Son of man goeth as it is written of him: but woe unto that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! it had been good for that man if he had not been born.

rr: 25 Yuda owaamureebize yaamubuuza ati: Mwegyesa, niinye? Yaamugarukau ati: Eki waagamba nikwo kiri.
en: 25 Then Judas, which betrayed him, answered and said, Master, is it I? He said unto him, Thou hast said.
26 And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed it , and brake it , and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.

rr: 27 Yaakwata ekikopo; ku yaaherize kusiima, yaakibaha naagira ati: Munyweho mwena
en: 27 And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and gave it to them, saying, Drink ye all of it;
28 for this is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many for the remission of sins.

rr: 29 Nimbagambira nti: Tindinywa hari viinyo y'ebyana by'omuzaabibu okwiha hati okuhitsya aha kiro ekyo, obu ndinywa naimwe viinyo nsya omu mbukama bwa Tata.
en: 29 But I say unto you, I will not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father's kingdom.
30 And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.
31 Then saith Jesus unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad.

rr: 32 Kwonka ku ndiheza kuzooka, ndyababandiza Galilaaya.
en: 32 But after I am risen again, I will go before you into Galilee.

rr: 33 Petero yaahiga naagira ati: N'obu abandi boona baraagwe bakakuhemukaho, nyowe tindikwija kuhemukaho na kakye.
en: 33 Peter answered and said unto him, Though all men shall be offended because of thee, yet will I never be offended.
34 Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this night, before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.

rr: 35 Petero yaamugarukamu ati: N'obu ndaabe ow'okwitwa naiwe, tindikwija kukwehakana. N'abandi boona baahiga batyo.
en: 35 Peter said unto him, Though I should die with thee, yet will I not deny thee. Likewise also said all the disciples.
36 Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto the disciples, Sit ye here, while I go and pray yonder.
37 And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and very heavy.

rr: 38 Yaabagira ati: Omutima gwangye gwine obusaasi bwingi, nibwija kuunyita; mugume aha, nimureeba naanye.
en: 38 Then saith he unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: tarry ye here, and watch with me.

rr: 39 Yairirira kakye omumaisho, yaajuumara ahansi, yaashata ati: Ai bambe Taata, ekikopo eki kimpingure, ku kiraabe nikibaasika; kwonka kitaba nk'oku ndikwenda, kureka nkaiwe oku orikwenda.
en: 39 And he went a little further, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt .

rr: 40 Yaagaruka aha beegi be, yaashanga bagwejegyeiire; yaabuuza Petero ati: Ebyo mwaremwa kwehangaana kureeba naanye nangwa n'eshaaha emwe?
en: 40 And he cometh unto the disciples, and findeth them asleep, and saith unto Peter, What, could ye not watch with me one hour?
41 Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.

rr: 42 Yaagarukayo obwa kabiri, yaashaba ati: Ai bambe Taata, ekikopo eki ku kiraabe kitarikubaasa kundabaho ntakinyweire, eki orikwenda kibe nikyo kyakorwa.
en: 42 He went away again the second time, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if this cup may not pass away from me, except I drink it, thy will be done.

rr: 43 Yaagaruka yaija, nabwo yaashanga bagwejegyeire, ahabw'okuba amaisho gaabo gakaba nigahungira.
en: 43 And he came and found them asleep again: for their eyes were heavy.

rr: 44 Nikwo kubareka, akagarukayo kushaba obwa kashatu, akashaba ebigambo bimwe nk'eby'okubanza.
en: 44 And he left them, and went away again, and prayed the third time, saying the same words.

rr: 45 Bwanyima yaagaruka aha beegi be, yaabaigra ati: Na hati mukigwejegyeire, mukihuumwire? Reeba, obunaku bwairira haihi, Omwa w'omuntu yaaheebwayo omu mikono y'abasiisi.
en: 45 Then cometh he to his disciples, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

rr: 46 Mwimukye, tugyende; reeba, orikundeebya ari haihi.
en: 46 Rise, let us be going: behold, he is at hand that doth betray me.
47 And while he yet spake, lo, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and elders of the people.

rr: 48 Kandi ogwo owaabaire naamureebya, akaba abahaire akamanyiso, naagira ati: ou ndaanywegyere, niwe ogwo; mumukwate.
en: 48 Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he: hold him fast.

rr: 49 Ahonaaho yaija ahari Yesu, yaamuramutsya ati: Osingire, Mwegyesa! yaamunywegyera.
en: 49 And forthwith he came to Jesus, and said, Hail, master; and kissed him.

rr: 50 Yesu yaamugira ati: Mugyenzi wangye, kora eki oiziriire. Ahonaaho baija baamugurukira, baamukwata.
en: 50 And Jesus said unto him, Friend, wherefore art thou come? Then came they, and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.

rr: 51 Kandi reeba, omwe ahari abo abaabaire bari na Yesu, yaatayo omukono, yaasyorayo rurara ye, yaatema omuhuuku w'omunyamurwa omukuru, yaamucwaho okutu.
en: 51 And, behold, one of them which were with Jesus stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and struck a servant of the high priest's, and smote off his ear.
52 Then said Jesus unto him, Put up again thy sword into his place: for all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword.

rr: 53 Naari shi, noogira ngu, tindikubaasa kushaba Tata, akaanyoherereza ahonaaho baamaraika abarikukira # 26:53 Legioni n'omutwe gw'engabo nka legioni ikumi na ibiri?
en: 53 Thinkest thou that I cannot now pray to my Father, and he shall presently give me more than twelve legions of angels?

rr: 54 Mbwenu ku kyakubaire kitabaire kityo, Ebyahandiikirwe bihikiirira ryari, haza kandi nikwo kishemereire kuba?
en: 54 But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled, that thus it must be?

rr: 55 Omu shaaha egyo Yesu yaagira emitwe y'abantu ati: Mwampururira kunkwata ana zaarurara n'ebikoni, nk'oku bahururira omwambuzi?
en: 55 In that same hour said Jesus to the multitudes, Are ye come out as against a thief with swords and staves for to take me?

rr: Ebiro byona nkaba ntuura omuri hekalu niinyegyesa, timurankwatsire.
en: I sat daily with you teaching in the temple, and ye laid no hold on me.

rr: 56 Kwonka ebi byona byabaho, ngu ebyahandiikirwe baanabi bihikiirire.
en: 56 But all this was done, that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled.

rr: Okuruga aho abeegi be boona baamuhungaho, bairuka.
en: Then all the disciples forsook him, and fled.
57 And they that had laid hold on Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were assembled.

rr: 58 Kandi Petero yaamukuratira naamugyenda hare okuhika omu kibuga ky'omunyamurwa omukuru; ku yaataahiremu, yaashutama n'abambari kureeba ahu biraaherere.
en: 58 But Peter followed him afar off unto the high priest's palace, and went in, and sat with the servants, to see the end.

rr: 59 Kandi abanyamurwa abakuru n'ab'omu ishengyero boona baasherura obwamushinja bw'ebishuba kubeiherera Yesu ngu bamwite
en: 59 Now the chief priests, and elders, and all the council, sought false witness against Jesus, to put him to death;

rr: 60 tibaabubona, n'obu haraabe haizire baamushinja baingi b'ebishuba.
en: 60 but found none: yea, though many false witnesses came, yet found they none. At the last came two false witnesses,
61 and said, This fellow said, I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.

rr: 62 Omunyamurwa omukuru yaayemerera, yaamubuuza ati: Toine ki orikwetonganira na kakye? Aba nibakwomesereza ki?
en: 62 And the high priest arose, and said unto him, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?

rr: 63 Yesu yaabeetsiza.
en: 63 But Jesus held his peace.

rr: Omunyamurwa omukuru yaamugira ati: Ninkurahiza Ruhanga.
en: And the high priest answered and said unto him, I adjure thee by the living God, that thou tell us whether thou be the Christ, the Son of God.
64 Jesus saith unto him, Thou hast said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall ye see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
65 Then the high priest rent his clothes, saying, He hath spoken blasphemy; what further need have we of witnesses? behold, now ye have heard his blasphemy.
66 What think ye? They answered and said, He is guilty of death.
67 Then did they spit in his face, and buffeted him; and others smote him with the palms of their hands,

rr: 68 nibagira bati: Iwe Kristo, ragura, otugambire owaakuteera.
en: 68 saying, Prophesy unto us, thou Christ, Who is he that smote thee?

rr: 69 Kandi Petero akaba ashutami aheeru omu kibuga. Omuzaana yaija ah'ari, yaamigira ati: Naiwe obaire ori hamwe na Yesu owa Galilaaya.
en: 69 Now Peter sat without in the palace: and a damsel came unto him, saying, Thou also wast with Jesus of Galilee.

rr: 70 Kwonka we yaayehakanira omu maisho ga boona, ati: Tindikumanya ki orikugamba.
en: 70 But he denied before them all, saying, I know not what thou sayest.

rr: 71 Ku yaabaire naashohora, yaahika aha irembo, omuzaana ondiijo yaamureeba, yaagambira abandi abaabaire bari aho, ati: Omushaija ogu nawe abaire ari hamwe na Yesu owa Nazareesi.
en: 71 And when he was gone out into the porch, another maid saw him, and said unto them that were there, This fellow was also with Jesus of Nazareth.

rr: 72 Yaagaruka yaayehakana naarahira ati: Omuntu ogwo tindikumumanya.
en: 72 And again he denied with an oath, I do not know the man.

rr: 73 Ku haahingwireho akaanya kakye, abaabaire beemereire aho baija baagambira Petero bati: Buzimazima naiwe ori omwe aharibo, ahabw'okuba emigambire yaawe neekumanyisa.
en: 73 And after a while came unto him they that stood by, and said to Peter, Surely thou also art one of them; for thy speech bewrayeth thee.

rr: 74 Obwo yaatandika kukyeena n'okurahira, naagira ati: Omushaija ogwo tindikumumanya. Ahonaaho enkoko yaagamba.
en: 74 Then began he to curse and to swear, saying , I know not the man. And immediately the cock crew.

rr: 75 Petero yaijuka ekigambo eki Yesu amugambiire ati: Enkoko etakagambire, noija kuunyehakana kashatu.
en: 75 And Peter remembered the word of Jesus, which said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.

rr: Yaashohora aheeru, yaarira munonga.
en: And he went out, and wept bitterly.

rr: 1 Ku bwaseesire, abanyamurwa abakuru boona n'abakuru b'eihanga baahanuura hamwe oku baraite Yesu.
en: 1 When the morning was come, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death:

rr: 2 Baamuboha, baamutwara, baamuhayo ahari Pilaato omutegyeki.
en: 2 and when they had bound him, they led him away, and delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor.

rr: 3 Kandi Yuda owaamureebize, ku yaareebire orubanja rwasinga Yesu, yaayefuuza, yaagarurira abanyamurwa abakuru n'abakuru b'abantu ebyo bicweka by'efeeza makumi ashatu
en: 3 Then Judas, which had betrayed him, when he saw that he was condemned, repented himself, and brought again the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,

rr: 4 naagira ati: Nsiisire okureebya eshagama etaine rubanja.
en: 4 saying, I have sinned in that I have betrayed the innocent blood.

rr: Kwonka bo baagarukamu bati: Ebyo shi n'ebyaitu? n'orubanja rwawe.
en: And they said, What is that to us? see thou to that .
5 And he cast down the pieces of silver in the temple, and departed, and went and hanged himself.

rr: 6 Abanyamurwa abakuru baatorotoora ebyo bicweka by'efeeza, nibagira bati: Ebiragiro tibirikwikiriza kubita omu ibiikiro, ahabw'okuba n'obuguzi bw'eshagama.
en: 6 And the chief priests took the silver pieces, and said, It is not lawful for to put them into the treasury, because it is the price of blood.

rr: 7 Baahanuura, baabiguramu ekibanja ky'omubumbi kuguma nibaziikamu abahinguzi.
en: 7 And they took counsel, and bought with them the potter's field, to bury strangers in.

rr: 8 N'ahabw'ekyo ekibanja ekyo kyayetwa Ekibanja, ky'eshagama okuruga obwo n'okuhitsya hati.
en: 8 Wherefore that field was called, The field of blood, unto this day.
9 Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying, And they took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him that was valued, whom they of the children of Israel did value;

rr: 10 baabiguramu ekibanja ky'omubumbi, nk'oku Mukama yandagiire.
en: 10 and gave them for the potter's field, as the Lord appointed me.
11 And Jesus stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And Jesus said unto him, Thou sayest.
12 And when he was accused of the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.

rr: 13 Pilaato nikwo kumubuuza ati: Tohuriire ebi byona ebi barikukushinja ku biri bingi?
en: 13 Then said Pilate unto him, Hearest thou not how many things they witness against thee?
14 And he answered him to never a word; insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly.
15 Now at that feast the governor was wont to release unto the people a prisoner, whom they would.

rr: 16 Omu biro ebyo bakaba baine embohe erangainwe ahabw'obubi erikwetwa Barabba.
en: 16 And they had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.

rr: 17 Boona ku baaherize kuteerana, Pilaato yaababuuza ati: Nimwenda ngu mbarekurire oha?
en: 17 Therefore when they were gathered together, Pilate said unto them, Whom will ye that I release unto you?

rr: Barabba nari Yesu orikwetwa Kristo?
en: Barabbas, or Jesus which is called Christ?
18 For he knew that for envy they had delivered him.

rr: 19 Ku yaashutamire aha kitebe ky'okucweraho emanja, omukazi we yaamutumaho naagira ati: Oyetantare ebigambo by'omushaija ogwo ohikiriire; ahakuba ebi mmurootsireho nyekiro binsaasize munonga.
en: 19 When he was set down on the judgment seat, his wife sent unto him, saying, Have thou nothing to do with that just man: for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him.

rr: 20 Kwonka abanyamurwa abakuru n'abakuru baayosya abantu ngu bashabe Barabba, baite Yesu.
en: 20 But the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitude that they should ask Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.

rr: 21 Omutegyeki yaagaruka yaababuuza ati: Ahari abo bombi nimwenda ku mbarekurira oha? Baamugarukamu bati; Barabba.
en: 21 The governor answered and said unto them, Whether of the twain will ye that I release unto you? They said, Barabbas.

rr: 22 Pilaato yaababuuza ati: Mbwenu shi, ngire nta Yesu orikwetwa Kristo?
en: 22 Pilate saith unto them, What shall I do then with Jesus which is called Christ?

rr: Boona baagarukamu bati: Abambwe aha musharaba.
en: They all say unto him, Let him be crucified.

rr: 23 Yaababuuza ati: Ahanki? Ni kibi ki eki akozire? Baayeyongyera kuyomba nibagira bati: Abambwe!
en: 23 And the governor said, Why, what evil hath he done? But they cried out the more, saying, Let him be crucified.

rr: 24 Pilaato ku yaareebire naayeruhiriza busha, kandi yaareeba ngu haza kubaho okurabanamu, yaayakiira amaizi, yaanaaba omu ngaro omu maisho g'abantu, naagira ati: Tiinyine rubanja ahabw'eshagama y'omuntu ogu ohikiriire; mubyemarire.
en: 24 When Pilate saw that he could prevail nothing, but that rather a tumult was made, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this just person: see ye to it .
25 Then answered all the people, and said, His blood be on us, and on our children.

rr: 26 Pilaato nikwo kubarekurira Barabba. Kandi ku yaaherize kwasha Yesu, yaamuhayo kubambwa.
en: 26 Then released he Barabbas unto them: and when he had scourged Jesus, he delivered him to be crucified.
27 Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the common hall, and gathered unto him the whole band of soldiers .

rr: 28 Baamujuura ebijwaro bye, baamujweka omwenda gwa karari.
en: 28 And they stripped him, and put on him a scarlet robe.

rr: 29 Ku baaherize kuruka ekirunga ky'amahwa, baakimujweka omu mutwe, baamukwatsa ekibingo omu mukono gwe gwa buryo, baamutsimbira amaju, baamuteerera enaku nibagira bati: Singa, Mugabe w'Abayudaaya!
en: 29 And when they had platted a crown of thorns, they put it upon his head, and a reed in his right hand: and they bowed the knee before him, and mocked him, saying, Hail, King of the Jews!
30 And they spit upon him, and took the reed, and smote him on the head.
31 And after that they had mocked him, they took the robe off from him, and put his own raiment on him, and led him away to crucify him .

rr: 32 Ku baabaire nibashohora, baabugana omushaija wa Kureene orikwetwa Simooni; ogwo baamugyema kwekorera omusharaba gwa Yesu.
en: 32 And as they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name: him they compelled to bear his cross.

rr: 33 Ku baahikire aharikwetwa Gologosa, amakuru gaakyo ngu Omwanya gw'empanga y'omuntu
en: 33 And when they were come unto a place called Golgotha, that is to say, a place of a skull,
34 they gave him vinegar to drink mingled with gall: and when he had tasted thereof , he would not drink.

35 And they crucified him, and parted his garments, casting lots: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, They parted my garments among them, and upon my vesture did they cast lots.

rr: 36 Baashutama ahansi, baaguma nibamureeba.
en: 36 And sitting down they watched him there;

rr: 37 Baahanika ebigambo ebi baamutabaariza ahaigur y'omutwe gwe, ebyabaire bihandiikirwe biti: OGU NI YESU, OMUGABE W'ABAYUDAAYA.
en: 37 and set up over his head his accusation written, THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
38 Then were there two thieves crucified with him, one on the right hand, and another on the left.
39 And they that passed by reviled him, wagging their heads,
40 and saying, Thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days, save thyself. If thou be the Son of God, come down from the cross.

rr: 41 Abanyamurwa abakuru n'abahandiiki n'abakuru b'abantu nabo baamutsyorera batyo nibagira bati
en: 41 Likewise also the chief priests mocking him , with the scribes and elders, said,

rr: 42 Akajuna abandi; tarikubaasa kwejuna. Ngu, N'omugabe w'Abaisraeli! Naahanukye, arugye aha musharaba hati, naitwe tumwikirize.
en: 42 He saved others; himself he cannot save. If he be the King of Israel, let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him.
43 He trusted in God; let him deliver him now, if he will have him: for he said, I am the Son of God.

rr: 44 Kandi n'abambuzi abaabaire babambirwe nawe nabo nikwo baamuteerera enaku batyo.
en: 44 The thieves also, which were crucified with him, cast the same in his teeth.

rr: 45 Okuruga aha shaaha ya mukaaga okuhitsya aha ya mwenda omwirima gwashweka ensi yoona.
en: 45 Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land unto the ninth hour.
46 And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is to say, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?

rr: 47 Bamwe aha baabaire beemereire aho, ku baakihuriire, baagira bati: Omushaija ogu naayeta Eliya.
en: 47 Some of them that stood there, when they heard that , said, This man calleth for Elias.
48 And straightway one of them ran, and took a spunge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink.

rr: 49 Abandi baagira bati: Reka tureebe Eliya ku araabe naija kumujuna.
en: 49 The rest said, Let be, let us see whether Elias will come to save him.

rr: 50 Bwanyima Yesu yaagaruka yaagamba n'eiraka rihango, yaahayo amagara ge.
en: 50 Jesus, when he had cried again with a loud voice, yielded up the ghost.
51 And, behold, the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom; and the earth did quake, and the rocks rent;

rr: 52 ebituuro byaiguka; emitumbi mingi y'abahikiriire abaabaire bagwejegyeire yaazoorwa
en: 52 and the graves were opened; and many bodies of the saints which slept arose,

rr: 53 baaruga omu bituuro bwanyima y'okuzooka kwe, baataaha omu rurembo orurikwera, baareebwa baingi.
en: 53 and came out of the graves after his resurrection, and went into the holy city, and appeared unto many.

rr: 54 Omukuru w'abaserukare n'abu yaabaire aine nibarinda Yesu, ku baareebire omutsitsa n'ebindi byabaho, baatiina munonga, nibagira bati: Buzima kwo ogu abaire ari Omwana wa Ruhanga.
en: 54 Now when the centurion, and they that were with him, watching Jesus, saw the earthquake, and those things that were done, they feared greatly, saying, Truly this was the Son of God.

rr: 55 Hakaba hariho n'abakazi baingi beemereire nibareebera hangahari; abo nibo baarugire Galilaaya bamukuratiire nibamuheereza
en: 55 And many women were there beholding afar off, which followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering unto him:

rr: 56 omuri abo hakaba harimu Mariamu Magadaleene na Mariamu nyina wa Yakobo na Yose, kandi na nyina wa beene Zebedaayo.
en: 56 among which was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedee's children.
57 When the even was come, there came a rich man of Arimathæa, named Joseph, who also himself was Jesus' disciple:

rr: 58 Omushaija ogwo yaaza owa Pilaato, yaashaba omutumbi gwa Yesu. Pilaato yaaragiira kugumuha.
en: 58 he went to Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded the body to be delivered.

rr: 59 Yosefu yaatwara omutumbi, yaaguzinga omu mwenda gwa kitaani ogurikwera
en: 59 And when Joseph had taken the body, he wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
60 and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had hewn out in the rock: and he rolled a great stone to the door of the sepulchre, and departed.

rr: 61 Kandi Mariamu Magadaleene na Mariamu ondiijo bakaba bariho, bashutami nibareeba ekyo kituuro.
en: 61 And there was Mary Magdalene, and the other Mary, sitting over against the sepulchre.

rr: 62 Ku bwaseesire aha izooba eryakuratiire ekiro ky'Okweteguura, abanyamurwa abakuru n'Abafarisaayo baateeranira owa Pilaato
en: 62 Now the next day, that followed the day of the preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees came together unto Pilate,

rr: 63 baamugira bati: Mukama waitu, nitwijuka eki omubeihi ori yaagambire akiriho, ati: Ndyazooka bwanyima y'ebiro bishatu.
en: 63 saying, Sir, we remember that that deceiver said, while he was yet alive, After three days I will rise again.

rr: 64 Mbwenu ragiira barindire kimwe ekituuro okuhitsya aha kiro kya kashatu, abeegi be batakaija bakamwiba, haza bakagambira abantu ngu, Azookire omu bafu; kandi okuhaba okurirugamu kuryaba kubi okukira okw'okubanza.
en: 64 Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third day, lest his disciples come by night, and steal him away, and say unto the people, He is risen from the dead: so the last error shall be worse than the first.

rr: 65 Pilaato yaabagarukau ati: Mwine abarinzi b'abaserukare; mugyende, mukirindire kimwe, nk'oku murikubaasa.
en: 65 Pilate said unto them, Ye have a watch: go your way, make it as sure as ye can.

rr: 66 Nabo baagyenda, baahamisa eryo ibaare akamanyiso, baataho n'abarinzi, ngu ekituuro kutaigurwa
en: 66 So they went, and made the sepulchre sure, sealing the stone, and setting a watch.
1 In the end of the sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre.

rr: 2 Haabaho omutsitsa gw'amaani; ahabw'okuba maraika wa Mukama akaruga omu iguru, yaija, yaakumbagaza eibaare, yaarishutamaho.
en: 2 And, behold, there was a great earthquake: for the angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone from the door, and sat upon it.

rr: 3 Enshusha ye akaba naamurinkana nk'omurabyo, n'ebijwaro bye bikaba nibyera nk'orubaare.
en: 3 His countenance was like lightning, and his raiment white as snow:

rr: 4 Abarinzi ahaw'okutiina batetema, baahinduka nk'abafiire.
en: 4 and for fear of him the keepers did shake, and became as dead men .

rr: 5 Kwonka maraika yaagambira abakazi ati: Imwe, mutatiina; ahakuba nimmanya ku murikusherura Yesu obambirwe.
en: 5 And the angel answered and said unto the women, Fear not ye: for I know that ye seek Jesus, which was crucified.

rr: 6 Tari aha; ahabw'okuba azookire, nk'oku yaagambire. Mwije mureebe omwanya ahu abaire abyami.
en: 6 He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.

rr: 7 Haza mwehuute, mugambire abeegi be ku azookire omu bafu, kandi ku arikwija kubabandiza Galilaaya; okwo niyo muraamureebere. Reeba naabagambira.
en: 7 And go quickly, and tell his disciples that he is risen from the dead; and, behold, he goeth before you into Galilee; there shall ye see him: lo, I have told you.

rr: 8 Baaruga aha kituuro, nibeehuuta baine obwoba n'okushemererwa kwingi, bairuka kugambira abeegi be.
en: 8 And they departed quickly from the sepulchre with fear and great joy; and did run to bring his disciples word.

rr: 9 Yweu yaababugana, yaabagira ati: Mushemererwe!
en: 9 And as they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, All hail.

rr: Baamwirira haihi, baamukwata aha bigyere, baamuramya.
en: And they came and held him by the feet, and worshipped him.
10 Then said Jesus unto them, Be not afraid: go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee, and there shall they see me.

rr: 11 Ku baabaire nibagyenda, abamwe ahari abo barinzi baija omu rurembo, baagambira abanyamurwa abakuru byona ebyabaho.
en: 11 Now when they were going, behold, some of the watch came into the city, and shewed unto the chief priests all the things that were done.

rr: 12 Abanyamurwa nikwo kuteerana abakuru b'abantu, bakahanuura hamwe; ku baaherize, baaha abaserukare empiiha nyingi
en: 12 And when they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave large money unto the soldiers,

rr: 13 baabagambira bati: Mugume mugire muti: Abeegi be baizire nyekiro, baamwiba itwe tugwejegyeire.
en: 13 saying, Say ye, His disciples came by night, and stole him away while we slept.

rr: 14 Omutegyeki ku araabimanye, nitwija kumwikiririsa, tubaiheho orubanja.
en: 14 And if this come to the governor's ears, we will persuade him, and secure you.

rr: 15 Abaserukare baayakiira empiiha, baakora nk'oku baahabwirwe; ekigambo ekyo kyabuga omuri Buyudaaya n'okuhitsya hati.
en: 15 So they took the money, and did as they were taught: and this saying is commonly reported among the Jews until this day.

rr: 16 Bwanyima abeegi be ikumi n'omwe baaza Galilaaya, aha rushozi oru Yesu abaragiire.
en: 16 Then the eleven disciples went away into Galilee, into a mountain where Jesus had appointed them.

rr: 17 Ku baamureebire, baamuramya; kwonka abandi baabanganisa.
en: 17 And when they saw him, they worshipped him: but some doubted.
18 And Jesus came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.
19 Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:
20 teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen.
1 The word of the LORD that came to Micah the Morasthite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.
2 Hear, all ye people; hearken, O earth, and all that therein is: and let the Lord GOD be witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.
3 For, behold, the LORD cometh forth out of his place, and will come down, and tread upon the high places of the earth.
4 And the mountains shall be molten under him, and the valleys shall be cleft, as wax before the fire, and as the waters that are poured down a steep place.

5 For the transgression of Jacob is all this, and for the sins of the house of Israel. What is the transgression of Jacob? is it not Samaria? and what are the high places of Judah? are they not Jerusalem?
6 Therefore I will make Samaria as an heap of the field, and as plantings of a vineyard: and I will pour down the stones thereof into the valley, and I will discover the foundations thereof.

7 And all the graven images thereof shall be beaten to pieces, and all the hires thereof shall be burned with the fire, and all the idols thereof will I lay desolate: for she gathered it of the hire of an harlot, and they shall return to the hire of an harlot.
8 Therefore I will wail and howl, I will go stripped and naked: I will make a wailing like the dragons, and mourning as the owls.
9 For her wound is incurable; for it is come unto Judah; he is come unto the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.
10 Declare ye it not at Gath, weep ye not at all: in the house of Aphrah roll thyself in the dust.

rr: 11 Imwe batuuzi ba Shafiri 'mwe
en: 11 Pass ye away, thou inhabitant of Saphir, having thy shame naked: the inhabitant of Zaanan came not forth in the mourning of Beth-ezel; he shall receive of you his standing.
12 For the inhabitant of Maroth waited carefully for good: but evil came down from the LORD unto the gate of Jerusalem.
13 O thou inhabitant of Lachish, bind the chariot to the swift beast: she is the beginning of the sin to the daughter of Zion: for the transgressions of Israel were found in thee.

rr: 14 Nikyo oriheera Moresheeti-gaasi
en: 14 Therefore shalt thou give presents to Moresheth-gath: the houses of Achzib shall be a lie to the kings of Israel.

rr: 15 Naimwe batuuzi ba Mareesha 'mwe
en: 15 Yet will I bring an heir unto thee, O inhabitant of Mareshah: he shall come unto Adullam the glory of Israel.
16 Make thee bald, and poll thee for thy delicate children; enlarge thy baldness as the eagle; for they are gone into captivity from thee.
1 Woe to them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds! when the morning is light, they practise it, because it is in the power of their hand.
2 And they covet fields, and take them by violence; and houses, and take them away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.
3 Therefore thus saith the LORD ; Behold, against this family do I devise an evil, from which ye shall not remove your necks; neither shall ye go haughtily: for this time is evil.

4 In that day shall one take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful lamentation, and say, We be utterly spoiled: he hath changed the portion of my people: how hath he removed it from me! turning away he hath divided our fields.

rr: 5 Nikyo muriburira ow'okubaganisisa omugoye
en: 5 Therefore thou shalt have none that shall cast a cord by lot in the congregation of the LORD .
6 Prophesy ye not, say they to them that prophesy: they shall not prophesy to them, that they shall not take shame.

rr: 7 Iwe nju ya Yakobo 'we, eki kikaagambirwe?
en: 7 O thou that art named the house of Jacob, is the spirit of the LORD straitened? are these his doings? do not my words do good to him that walketh uprightly?
8 Even of late my people is risen up as an enemy: ye pull off the robe with the garment from them that pass by securely as men averse from war.

rr: 9 Abakazi b'abantu bangye mubabinga
en: 9 The women of my people have ye cast out from their pleasant houses; from their children have ye taken away my glory for ever.
10 Arise ye, and depart; for this is not your rest: because it is polluted, it shall destroy you , even with a sore destruction.
11 If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying , I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people.

12 I will surely assemble, O Jacob, all of thee; I will surely gather the remnant of Israel; I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, as the flock in the midst of their fold: they shall make great noise by reason of the multitude of men.
13 The breaker is come up before them: they have broken up, and have passed through the gate, and are gone out by it: and their king shall pass before them, and the LORD on the head of them.
1 And I said, Hear, I pray you, O heads of Jacob, and ye princes of the house of Israel; Is it not for you to know judgment?
2 Who hate the good, and love the evil; who pluck off their skin from off them, and their flesh from off their bones;
3 who also eat the flesh of my people, and flay their skin from off them; and they break their bones, and chop them in pieces, as for the pot, and as flesh within the caldron.
4 Then shall they cry unto the LORD , but he will not hear them: he will even hide his face from them at that time, as they have behaved themselves ill in their doings.
5 Thus saith the LORD concerning the prophets that make my people err, that bite with their teeth, and cry, Peace; and he that putteth not into their mouths, they even prepare war against him.

6 Therefore night shall be unto you, that ye shall not have a vision; and it shall be dark unto you, that ye shall not divine; and the sun shall go down over the prophets, and the day shall be dark over them.
7 Then shall the seers be ashamed, and the diviners confounded: yea, they shall all cover their lips; for there is no answer of God.
8 But truly I am full of power by the spirit of the LORD , and of judgment, and of might, to declare unto Jacob his transgression, and to Israel his sin.

rr: 9 Nimuhurire eki, imwe bakuru b'enju ya Yakobo 'mwe
en: 9 Hear this, I pray you, ye heads of the house of Jacob, and princes of the house of Israel, that abhor judgment, and pervert all equity.
10 They build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.

11 The heads thereof judge for reward, and the priests thereof teach for hire, and the prophets thereof divine for money: yet will they lean upon the LORD , and say, Is not the LORD among us? none evil can come upon us.
12 Therefore shall Zion for your sake be plowed as a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of the forest.

1 But in the last days it shall come to pass, that the mountain of the house of the LORD shall be established in the top of the mountains, and it shall be exalted above the hills; and people shall flow unto it.

rr: 2 N'amahanga maingi garyaija gagire gati
en: 2 And many nations shall come, and say, Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD , and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall go forth of Zion, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.

3 And he shall judge among many people, and rebuke strong nations afar off; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up a sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
4 But they shall sit every man under his vine and under his fig tree; and none shall make them afraid: for the mouth of the LORD of hosts hath spoken it .
5 For all people will walk every one in the name of his god, and we will walk in the name of the LORD our God for ever and ever.
6 In that day, saith the LORD , will I assemble her that halteth, and I will gather her that is driven out, and her that I have afflicted;
7 and I will make her that halted a remnant, and her that was cast far off a strong nation: and the LORD shall reign over them in mount Zion from henceforth, even for ever.

rr: 8 Kandi naiwe, munaara gw'obusyo 'we
en: 8 And thou, O tower of the flock, the strong hold of the daughter of Zion, unto thee shall it come, even the first dominion; the kingdom shall come to the daughter of Jerusalem.
9 Now why dost thou cry out aloud? is there no king in thee? is thy counsellor perished? for pangs have taken thee as a woman in travail.

10 Be in pain, and labour to bring forth, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail: for now shalt thou go forth out of the city, and thou shalt dwell in the field, and thou shalt go even to Babylon; there shalt thou be delivered; there the LORD shall redeem thee from the hand of thine enemies.
11 Now also many nations are gathered against thee, that say, Let her be defiled, and let our eye look upon Zion.
12 But they know not the thoughts of the LORD , neither understand they his counsel: for he shall gather them as the sheaves into the floor.

13 Arise and thresh, O daughter of Zion: for I will make thine horn iron, and I will make thy hoofs brass: and thou shalt beat in pieces many people: and I will consecrate their gain unto the LORD , and their substance unto the Lord of the whole earth.

rr: 1 Mbwenu oyehinguririziibwe orugo rw'amabaare
en: 1 Now gather thyself in troops, O daughter of troops: he hath laid siege against us: they shall smite the judge of Israel with a rod upon the cheek.

2 But thou, Beth-lehem Ephratah, though thou be little among the thousands of Judah, yet out of thee shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting.
3 Therefore will he give them up, until the time that she which travaileth hath brought forth: then the remnant of his brethren shall return unto the children of Israel.
