4 And he shall stand and feed in the strength of the LORD , in the majesty of the name of the LORD his God; and they shall abide: for now shall he be great unto the ends of the earth.
5 And this man shall be the peace, when the Assyrian shall come into our land: and when he shall tread in our palaces, then shall we raise against him seven shepherds, and eight principal men.

6 And they shall waste the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod in the entrances thereof: thus shall he deliver us from the Assyrian, when he cometh into our land, and when he treadeth within our borders.

rr: 7 Batyo aba Yakobo abariba batsigaireho
en: 7 And the remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many people as a dew from the LORD , as the showers upon the grass, that tarrieth not for man, nor waiteth for the sons of men.

8 And the remnant of Jacob shall be among the Gentiles in the midst of many people as a lion among the beasts of the forest, as a young lion among the flocks of sheep: who, if he go through, both treadeth down, and teareth in pieces, and none can deliver.
9 Thine hand shall be lifted up upon thine adversaries, and all thine enemies shall be cut off.
10 And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD , that I will cut off thy horses out of the midst of thee, and I will destroy thy chariots:
11 and I will cut off the cities of thy land, and throw down all thy strong holds:
12 and I will cut off witchcrafts out of thine hand; and thou shalt have no more soothsayers:
13 thy graven images also will I cut off, and thy standing images out of the midst of thee; and thou shalt no more worship the work of thine hands.
14 And I will pluck up thy groves out of the midst of thee: so will I destroy thy cities.
15 And I will execute vengeance in anger and fury upon the heathen, such as they have not heard.

rr: 1 Mbwenu nimuhurire eki MUKAMA arikugamba
en: 1 Hear ye now what the LORD saith; Arise, contend thou before the mountains, and let the hills hear thy voice.
2 Hear ye, O mountains, the LORD 's controversy, and ye strong foundations of the earth: for the LORD hath a controversy with his people, and he will plead with Israel.
3 O my people, what have I done unto thee? and wherein have I wearied thee? testify against me.
4 For I brought thee up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed thee out of the house of servants; and I sent before thee Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
5 O my people, remember now what Balak king of Moab consulted, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim unto Gilgal; that ye may know the righteousness of the LORD .
6 Wherewith shall I come before the LORD , and bow myself before the high God? shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves of a year old?
7 Will the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams, or with ten thousands of rivers of oil? shall I give my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
8 He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?
9 The LORD 's voice crieth unto the city, and the man of wisdom shall see thy name: hear ye the rod, and who hath appointed it.

rr: 10 Nimugira ngu nkaabaasa kwebwa eitungo ry'obubi
en: 10 Are there yet the treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and the scant measure that is abominable?
11 Shall I count them pure with the wicked balances, and with the bag of deceitful weights?
12 For the rich men thereof are full of violence, and the inhabitants thereof have spoken lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their mouth.

rr: 13 Nikyo ntandikiire kubateera
en: 13 Therefore also will I make thee sick in smiting thee, in making thee desolate because of thy sins.

14 Thou shalt eat, but not be satisfied; and thy casting down shall be in the midst of thee; and thou shalt take hold, but shalt not deliver; and that which thou deliverest will I give up to the sword.
15 Thou shalt sow, but thou shalt not reap; thou shalt tread the olives, but thou shalt not anoint thee with oil; and sweet wine, but shalt not drink wine.

16 For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of the house of Ahab, and ye walk in their counsels; that I should make thee a desolation, and the inhabitants thereof an hissing: therefore ye shall bear the reproach of my people.
1 Woe is me! for I am as when they have gathered the summer fruits, as the grapegleanings of the vintage: there is no cluster to eat: my soul desired the firstripe fruit.
2 The good man is perished out of the earth: and there is none upright among men: they all lie in wait for blood; they hunt every man his brother with a net.
3 That they may do evil with both hands earnestly, the prince asketh, and the judge asketh for a reward; and the great man , he uttereth his mischievous desire: so they wrap it up.
4 The best of them is as a brier: the most upright is sharper than a thorn hedge: the day of thy watchmen and thy visitation cometh; now shall be their perplexity.
5 Trust ye not in a friend, put ye not confidence in a guide: keep the doors of thy mouth from her that lieth in thy bosom.
6 For the son dishonoureth the father, the daughter riseth up against her mother, the daughter in law against her mother in law; a man's enemies are the men of his own house.
7 Therefore I will look unto the LORD ; I will wait for the God of my salvation: my God will hear me.
8 Rejoice not against me, O mine enemy: when I fall, I shall arise; when I sit in darkness, the LORD shall be a light unto me.

9 I will bear the indignation of the LORD , because I have sinned against him, until he plead my cause, and execute judgment for me: he will bring me forth to the light, and I shall behold his righteousness.

10 Then she that is mine enemy shall see it , and shame shall cover her which said unto me, Where is the LORD thy God? mine eyes shall behold her: now shall she be trodden down as the mire of the streets.
11 In the day that thy walls are to be built, in that day shall the decree be far removed.
12 In that day also he shall come even to thee from Assyria, and from the fortified cities, and from the fortress even to the river, and from sea to sea, and from mountain to mountain.
13 Notwithstanding the land shall be desolate because of them that dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings.
14 Feed thy people with thy rod, the flock of thine heritage, which dwell solitarily in the wood, in the midst of Carmel: let them feed in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.
15 According to the days of thy coming out of the land of Egypt will I shew unto him marvellous things .
16 The nations shall see and be confounded at all their might: they shall lay their hand upon their mouth, their ears shall be deaf.
17 They shall lick the dust like a serpent, they shall move out of their holes like worms of the earth: they shall be afraid of the LORD our God, and shall fear because of thee.
18 Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in mercy.
19 He will turn again, he will have compassion upon us; he will subdue our iniquities; and thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.
20 Thou wilt perform the truth to Jacob, and the mercy to Abraham, which thou hast sworn unto our fathers from the days of old.

rr: 1 Okutandika kw'engiri ya Yesu Kristo, Omwana wa Ruhanga
en: 1 The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God;
2 As it is written in the prophets,
3 The voice of one crying in the wilderness,

rr: 4 Yohaana akaija naabatiza omu ihamba, naabuurira okubatizibwa kw'okweteisa ahabw'okwihwaho ebibi.
en: 4 John did baptize in the wilderness, and preach the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins.

rr: 5 Abantu b'omu ishaza rya Buyudaaya ryona n'aba Yerusaalemu boona baaruga owaabo, baamushangayo; yaababatiriza omu mugyera Yorudani, nibaatura ebibi byabo.
en: 5 And there went out unto him all the land of Judæa, and they of Jerusalem, and were all baptized of him in the river of Jordan, confessing their sins.
6 And John was clothed with camel's hair, and with a girdle of a skin about his loins; and he did eat locusts and wild honey;

rr: 7 Yaabagambira, naagira ati: orikwija enyima yangye nankiza obushoboorozi; tinshemereire kwinama kuyuzya enkoba z'enkaito ze.
en: 7 and preached, saying, There cometh one mightier than I after me, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose.

rr: 8 Nyowe naababatiza n'amaizi, kwonka We aryababatiza n'Omwoyo Orikwera.
en: 8 I indeed have baptized you with water: but he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost.
9 And it came to pass in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized of John in Jordan.

rr: 10 Ahonaaho ku yaabaire naaruga omu maizi, yaareeba eiguru rikinguukire, n'Omwoyo naamushuumaho nk'enkombe
en: 10 And straightway coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens opened, and the Spirit like a dove descending upon him:
11 and there came a voice from heaven, saying , Thou art my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
12 And immediately the Spirit driveth him into the wilderness.

rr: 13 yaamarayo ebiro makumi ana, naayohibwa Sitaane; yaaguma hamwe n'enyamaishwa, baamaraika nibamuheereza.
en: 13 And he was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted of Satan; and was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered unto him.
14 Now after that John was put in prison, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God,

rr: 15 Obunaku buhikire; obukama bwa Ruhanga bwiriire haihi; mweteise, mwikiriza engiri.
en: 15 and saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe the gospel.
16 Now as he walked by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.

rr: 17 Yesu yaabagira ati: Mwije munkuratire, naanye ndyabahindura abajubi b'abantu.
en: 17 And Jesus said unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.

rr: 18 Ahonaaho baatsigaho obutimba bwabo, baamukuratira.
en: 18 And straightway they forsook their nets, and followed him.

rr: 19 Ku yairiire omumaisho hakye, yaareeba Yakobo mwene Zebedaayo na Yohaana omurumuna, abaabaire bari omu bwato, nibashumikanisa obutimba.
en: 19 And when he had gone a little farther thence, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the ship mending their nets.

rr: 20 Ahonaaho yaabeeta; baatsiga ishebo Zebedaayo omu bwato hamwe n'abapakasi, baamukuratira.
en: 20 And straightway he called them: and they left their father Zebedee in the ship with the hired servants, and went after him.
21 And they went into Capernaum; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue, and taught.

rr: 22 Baatangaarira okwegyesa kwe, ahakuba akabeegyesa nk'oine obushoboorozi weena, kunu ti nk'abahandiiki.
en: 22 And they were astonished at his doctrine: for he taught them as one that had authority, and not as the scribes.

rr: 23 Omuri egyo sinagogi hakaba harimu omuntu owaabaire ariho daimoni; ahonaaho yaaborooga naagira ati
en: 23 And there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; and he cried out,
24 saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of God.

rr: 25 Yesu yaamugambira kubi, naagira ati: Hunama! murugyeho.
en: 25 And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him.
26 And when the unclean spirit had torn him, and cried with a loud voice, he came out of him.

rr: 27 Boona baatangaara, nibabuuzana bati: Eki n'enki? Oku n'okwegyesa kusya! Naaragiira baadaimoni n'obushoboorozi, nabo bamuhurira.
en: 27 And they were all amazed, insomuch that they questioned among themselves, saying, What thing is this? what new doctrine is this? for with authority commandeth he even the unclean spirits, and they do obey him.

rr: 28 Ahonaaho okurangaanwa kwe kwahika hoonahoona embaju zoona eziri haihi na Galilaaya.
en: 28 And immediately his fame spread abroad throughout all the region round about Galilee.
29 And forthwith, when they were come out of the synagogue, they entered into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

rr: 30 kandi nyinazaara wa Simooni akaba abyami arwaire omushwija; ahonaaho baamugambira oku ari
en: 30 But Simon's wife's mother lay sick of a fever, and anon they tell him of her.

rr: 31 yaija, yaamukwata aha mukono, yaamwimutsya, omushwija gwamurugaho, yaimuka, yaabaheereza.
en: 31 And he came and took her by the hand, and lifted her up; and immediately the fever left her, and she ministered unto them.

rr: 32 Omu mwabazyo ogwo, eizooba nirirengarenga, baamureetera boona abaabaire barwaire n'abandi abaabaire bariho baadaimoni.
en: 32 And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto him all that were diseased, and them that were possessed with devils.

rr: 33 Abantu boona ab'omuri tauni baateeranira omu irembo.
en: 33 And all the city was gathered together at the door.
34 And he healed many that were sick of divers diseases, and cast out many devils; and suffered not the devils to speak, because they knew him.
35 And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed.

rr: 36 Simooni na bagyenzi be baamukurata.
en: 36 And Simon and they that were with him followed after him.

rr: 37 Ku baamuboine, baamugira bati: Abantu boona nibakusherura.
en: 37 And when they had found him, they said unto him, All men seek for thee.

rr: 38 Yaabagarukamu ati: Tugyende ahandi omuri tauni eziri haihi, nayo mbuurireyo; ahakuba nikyo naiziriire.
en: 38 And he said unto them, Let us go into the next towns, that I may preach there also: for therefore came I forth.

rr: 39 Yaagyenda omuri Galilaaya yoona, naabuurira omuri sinagogi zaabo, kandi naabinga baadaimoni.
en: 39 And he preached in their synagogues throughout all Galilee, and cast out devils.
40 And there came a leper to him, beseeching him, and kneeling down to him, and saying unto him, If thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.

rr: 41 Yaamusaasira, yaagorora omukono gwe, yaamukoraho, yaamugira ati: Ninkunda; shemera!
en: 41 And Jesus, moved with compassion, put forth his hand, and touched him, and saith unto him, I will; be thou clean.

rr: 42 Ahonaaho ebibembe byamurugaho, yaashemezibwa.
en: 42 And as soon as he had spoken, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was cleansed.

rr: 43 Yaamwohereza ahonaaho, naamwehanangiriza munonga
en: 43 And he straitly charged him, and forthwith sent him away;
44 and saith unto him, See thou say nothing to any man: but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing those things which Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.

rr: 45 Kwonka we ku yaashohoire, yaatandika kubigamba, naabibuzya omu bantu; okuruga aho Yesu tarabaasize kugaruka omuri tauni butunu, yaaguma omu ihamba; abantu baaruga oku n'oku, baamushangayo.
en: 45 But he went out, and began to publish it much, and to blaze abroad the matter, insomuch that Jesus could no more openly enter into the city, but was without in desert places: and they came to him from every quarter.
1 And again he entered into Capernaum after some days; and it was noised that he was in the house.

rr: 2 Abantu baingi baateeranira omu nju, baagiijura, omwanya gwabura nangwa n'aha muryango; yaabagambira ekigambo kya Ruhanga.
en: 2 And straightway many were gathered together, insomuch that there was no room to receive them , no, not so much as about the door: and he preached the word unto them.

rr: 3 Ku yaabaire naakigamba, haija abantu bana bamureeteire omuntu ozingazingirwe, bamuheekire omu ngozi.
en: 3 And they come unto him, bringing one sick of the palsy, which was borne of four.

rr: 4 Ku baabuzire ah'okuraba kuhika ahari Yesu ahabw'omutwe gw'abantu, baakambura aha mutwe gw'enju aharinganiire n'ahu Yesu yaabaire ari; ku baaherize kuhakambura, baashuumizaho ozingazingirwe omu ngozi, ei yaabaire arimu.
en: 4 And when they could not come nigh unto him for the press, they uncovered the roof where he was: and when they had broken it up, they let down the bed wherein the sick of the palsy lay.

rr: 5 Yesu ku yaareebire okwikiriza kwabo, yaagira ozingazingirwe ati: Mwana wangye, ebibi byawe byakusaasirwa.
en: 5 When Jesus saw their faith, he said unto the sick of the palsy, Son, thy sins be forgiven thee.

rr: 6 Kwonka aha rubaju hakaba hashutamiho abamwe aha bahandiiki, baatandika kwetomboita nibeebuuza omu mitima yaabo bati
en: 6 But there were certain of the scribes sitting there, and reasoning in their hearts,

rr: 7 Beitu shi, omuntu ogu ekirikumugambisa kityo n'enki? Naarogota! N'oha orikubaasa kusaasira ebibi kureka Ruhanga wenka?
en: 7 Why doth this man thus speak blasphemies? who can forgive sins but God only?

rr: 8 Ahonaaho Yesu, ku yaamanyire omu mwoyo gwe okwetomboita kw'omu mitima yaabo, yaababuuza ati: Nimwetomboitera ki mutyo omu mitima yaanyu?
en: 8 And immediately when Jesus perceived in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, he said unto them, Why reason ye these things in your hearts?

rr: 9 Ekirikurahuka ni kiiha, okugira ozingazingirwe nti, Ebibi byawe byakusaasirwa; nari okugira nti, Imuka oyekorere engozi yaawe, ogyende?
en: 9 Whether is it easier to say to the sick of the palsy, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and take up thy bed, and walk?

rr: 10 Kwonka mumanye ngu Omwana w'omuntu aine obushoboorozi aha nsi okusaasira ebibi, yaahindukira ozingazingirwe yaamugira ati
en: 10 But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (he saith to the sick of the palsy,)

rr: 11 Ninkuragiira nti: Imuka oyekorere engozi yaawe, otaahe.
en: 11 I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy bed, and go thy way into thine house.

rr: 12 Yaimuka, ahonaaho yaayekorera engozi ye, yaashohora omu maisho gaabo boona; kyabatangaaza boona, baahimbisa Ruhanga nibagira bati: Eki tikikareebwaga!
en: 12 And immediately he arose, took up the bed, and went forth before them all; insomuch that they were all amazed, and glorified God, saying, We never saw it on this fashion.
13 And he went forth again by the sea side; and all the multitude resorted unto him, and he taught them.

rr: 14 Bwanyima yaagumizamu, yaareeba Leevi mwene Alifaayo, ashutami omu ihoorezo, yaamugira ati: Nkuratira!
en: 14 And as he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphæus sitting at the receipt of custom, and said unto him, Follow me.

rr: Yaimuka, yaamukuratira.
en: And he arose and followed him.

rr: 15 Kandi Yesu ku yaabaire ashutami omwa Leevi naarya, abahooza baingi n'abasiisi baashutama hamwe nawe n'abeegi be; ahakuba abaabaire bamukuratiire bakaba bari baingi.
en: 15 And it came to pass, that, as Jesus sat at meat in his house, many publicans and sinners sat also together with Jesus and his disciples: for there were many, and they followed him.

rr: 16 Abahandiiki b'Abafarisaayo, ku baareebire naarya n'abahooza n'abasiisi, baabuuza abeegi be bati: Ahabw'enki naarya kandi naanywa n'abahooza n'abasiisi?
en: 16 And when the scribes and Pharisees saw him eat with publicans and sinners, they said unto his disciples, How is it that he eateth and drinketh with publicans and sinners?

rr: 17 Yesu ku yaabihuriire, yaabagarukamu ati: Abahuriire tibeetenga mufumu, kureka abarwaire; tindaizire kweta bahikiriire, kureka abasiisi.
en: 17 When Jesus heard it , he saith unto them, They that are whole have no need of the physician, but they that are sick: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
18 And the disciples of John and of the Pharisees used to fast: and they come and say unto him, Why do the disciples of John and of the Pharisees fast, but thy disciples fast not?

rr: 19 Yesu yaabagarukamu ati: Abakwe babaasa bata kwesiibyakwo bakiine kishwera? Ku baba bakiri hamwe nawe, tibeesiibyakwo.
en: 19 And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them? as long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.

rr: 20 Kwonka obunaku buryahika, kishwera aryabaihwaho; obwo nibwo baryesiibyakwo.
en: 20 But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.

rr: 21 Tihariho muntu oteera ekiremu ky'omwenda musya aha mwenda ogukuzire; ku yaakukora atyo, ekiremu ekisya kikaataagura omwenda omukuru, n'ekifumuka kihanguha.
en: 21 No man also seweth a piece of new cloth on an old garment: else the new piece that filled it up taketh away from the old, and the rent is made worse.

rr: 22 Kandi tihariho muntu oshuka viinyo y'omutahe omu furebe z'empu ezikuzire; ku yaakukora atyo, viinyo ekaabarura efurebe, viinyo egyo eyatika, n'efurebe zisiisikara; kureka viinyo y'omutahe eshukwa omu furebe nsya.
en: 22 And no man putteth new wine into old bottles: else the new wine doth burst the bottles, and the wine is spilled, and the bottles will be marred: but new wine must be put into new bottles.
23 And it came to pass, that he went through the corn fields on the sabbath day; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of corn.

rr: 24 Abafarisaayo baamubuuza bati: Reeba, ahabw'enki abeegi baawe nibakora ekirikuzira, okucwa obushiisha aha izooba rya Sabato?
en: 24 And the Pharisees said unto him, Behold, why do they on the sabbath day that which is not lawful?

rr: 25 Yaabagarukamu ati: Beitu shi, timukashomaga eki Daudi yaakozire, obu yaabaire ashobeirwe, aine enjara, we n'abu yaabiare aine?
en: 25 And he said unto them, Have ye never read what David did, when he had need, and was an hungred, he, and they that were with him?
26 How he went into the house of God in the days of Abiathar the high priest, and did eat the shewbread, which is not lawful to eat but for the priests, and gave also to them which were with him?

rr: 27 Yaabagambira ati: Sabato ekateebwaho ahabw'abantu; kwonka ti bantu ahabwa Sabato.
en: 27 And he said unto them, The sabbath was made for man, and not man for the sabbath:

rr: 28 N'ahabw'ekyo Omwana w'omuntu niwe Mukama wa Sabato nayo.
en: 28 therefore the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.
1 And he entered again into the synagogue; and there was a man there which had a withered hand.

rr: 2 Baaguma bamutaireho amaisho kureeba yaaba araamukize ahari Sabato, ngu baihe aho bamuregye.
en: 2 And they watched him, whether he would heal him on the sabbath day; that they might accuse him.

rr: 3 Yaaragiira omushaija owaabaire akokootsire omukono, ati: Yemerera ahagati aho.
en: 3 And he saith unto the man which had the withered hand, Stand forth.

rr: 4 Yaababuuza ati: N'eky'Ebiragiro okukora gye ahari Sabato, nari okukora kubi? Okukiza amagara g'omuntu, nari okugahwerekyereza? Baahunama kwonka.
en: 4 And he saith unto them, Is it lawful to do good on the sabbath days, or to do evil? to save life, or to kill? But they held their peace.

5 And when he had looked round about on them with anger, being grieved for the hardness of their hearts, he saith unto the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it out: and his hand was restored whole as the other.
6 And the Pharisees went forth, and straightway took counsel with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.
7 But Jesus withdrew himself with his disciples to the sea: and a great multitude from Galilee followed him, and from Judæa,

rr: 8 n'aba Yerusaalemu, n'aba Idumaaya, n'aba seeri ya Yorudani, n'abaabaire batwire haihi na Tuuro na Sidoni, ku baahuriire byona ebi yaakozire, baija ah'ari.
en: 8 and from Jerusalem, and from Idumæa, and from beyond Jordan; and they about Tyre and Sidon, a great multitude, when they had heard what great things he did, came unto him.

rr: 9 Yaagambira abeegi be kumureetera obwato haihi ahabw'omutwe gw'abantu, ngu barekye kumufunza
en: 9 And he spake to his disciples, that a small ship should wait on him because of the multitude, lest they should throng him.

rr: 10 ahakuba akaba akirize baingi, n'ahabw'ekyo boona abaabaire baine endwara baamigana ngu bakaamukoraho, bakira.
en: 10 For he had healed many; insomuch that they pressed upon him for to touch him, as many as had plagues.

rr: 11 Kandi na baadaimoni, ku baabaire bamureeba, bagwa omu maisho ge, nibaborooga, nibagira bati: Ori Omwana wa Ruhanga.
en: 11 And unclean spirits, when they saw him, fell down before him, and cried, saying, Thou art the Son of God.

rr: 12 Kwonka We yaabeehanangiriza ku bareka kumubuzya omu bantu.
en: 12 And he straitly charged them that they should not make him known.
13 And he goeth up into a mountain, and calleth unto him whom he would: and they came unto him.

rr: 14 Yaihamu ikumi na babiri kuguma nawe, ngu agume abatume kubuurira engiri
en: 14 And he ordained twelve, that they should be with him, and that he might send them forth to preach,

rr: 15 kandi ngu abahe obushoboorozi bw'okubinga baadaimoni
en: 15 and to have power to heal sicknesses, and to cast out devils:

rr: 16 Simooni yaamweta eiziina Petero
en: 16 and Simon he surnamed Peter;

rr: 17 na Yakobo mwene Zebedaayo na Yohaana murumuna wa Yakobo, yaabeeta Boanerege, amakuru gaaryo ngu Abaana b'okuhinda
en: 17 and James the son of Zebedee, and John the brother of James; and he surnamed them Boanerges, which is, The sons of thunder:

rr: 18 na Anderea, Filipo Batolomaayo na Matayo, Tomasi, Yakobo mwene Alifaayo, Tadaayo, Simooni Omukananaayo
en: 18 and Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James the son of Alphæus, and Thaddæus, and Simon the Canaanite,

rr: 19 na Yuda Iskaryota owaamureebize.
en: 19 and Judas Iscariot, which also betrayed him: and they went into an house.

rr: 20 Bwanyima yaataaha owaabo; omutwe gw'abantu gwayeyongyera kuteerana, n'ahabw'ekyo Yesu n'abeegi be tibaabaasa n'okurya.
en: 20 And the multitude cometh together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.
21 And when his friends heard of it , they went out to lay hold on him: for they said, He is beside himself.
22 And the scribes which came down from Jerusalem said, He hath Beelzebub, and by the prince of the devils casteth he out devils.

rr: 23 Yaabeeta, yaabacwera enfumu, ati: Sitaane naabaasa ata kubinga Sitaane?
en: 23 And he called them unto him , and said unto them in parables, How can Satan cast out Satan?

rr: 24 Obugabe bwona, ku bwebaganisamu, obugabe obwo tibubaasa kugumaho.
en: 24 And if a kingdom be divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.

rr: 25 N'enju yoona ku eyebaganisamu, enju egyo teebaasa kugumaho.
en: 25 And if a house be divided against itself, that house cannot stand.

rr: 26 Kandi na Sitaane ku araabe naayerwanisa, akeebaganisamu, tarikubaasa kugumaho, kureka naahwaho.
en: 26 And if Satan rise up against himself, and be divided, he cannot stand, but hath an end.

rr: 27 Hoona tihariho muntu orikubaasa kutaaha omu nju y'ondi ow'amaani kunyaga ebintu bye, atabandize kuboha ogwo ow'amaani, bwanyima akabona kunyaga eby'omu nju ye.
en: 27 No man can enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.

rr: 28 Buzimazima nimbagambira nti: Abantu baryasaasirwa ebibi byabo byona, na buri kurogota kwona
en: 28 Verily I say unto you, All sins shall be forgiven unto the sons of men, and blasphemies wherewith soever they shall blaspheme:

rr: 29 kwonak weena orirogota aha Mwoyo Orikwera tarisaasirwa na kakye, ahakuba aryaba akwatsirwe orubanja rw'ekibi ky'ebiro n'ebiro.
en: 29 but he that shall blaspheme against the Holy Ghost hath never forgiveness, but is in danger of eternal damnation:

rr: 30 Eki yaabagambiriire atyo, n'ahabw'okuba bakagira ntu, Ariho daimoni.
en: 30 because they said, He hath an unclean spirit.
31 There came then his brethren and his mother, and, standing without, sent unto him, calling him.

rr: 32 Omutwe gw'abantu abaabaire bashutami bamwehinguririize, baamugira bati: Reeba, nyoko na beene waanyu bari aheeru nibakweta.
en: 32 And the multitude sat about him, and they said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren without seek for thee.

rr: 33 Yaabagarukamu ati: Maawe na beene waitu nibaahi?
en: 33 And he answered them, saying, Who is my mother, or my brethren?

rr: 34 Yaabuzya amaisho omuri abo abaabaire bashutami bamwehinguririize, naagira ati: Reeba, maawe na beene waitu n'aba bari aha!
en: 34 And he looked round about on them which sat about him, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!

rr: 35 Weena okora ebi Ruhanga akunda, niwe murumuna wangye, niwe munyaanyazi, kandi niwe maawe.
en: 35 For whosoever shall do the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.

1 And he began again to teach by the sea side: and there was gathered unto him a great multitude, so that he entered into a ship, and sat in the sea; and the whole multitude was by the sea on the land.

rr: 2 Yaabeegyesa bingi omu nfumu omu kwegyesa kwe, yaabagambira naagira ati
en: 2 And he taught them many things by parables, and said unto them in his doctrine,

rr: 3 Mutegye amatu, muhurire!
en: 3 Hearken; Behold, there went out a sower to sow:

rr: 4 Omubibi akashohora kubiba. Ku yaabaire naabiba, embibo ezimwe zaagwa omu muhanda; enyonyi zaija zaazitorotoora.
en: 4 and it came to pass, as he sowed, some fell by the way side, and the fowls of the air came and devoured it up.

rr: 5 Embibo ezindi zaagwa aha rukiri ahataine itaka ringi; ahonaaho zaamera, ahabw'eitaka kutaba ringi
en: 5 And some fell on stony ground, where it had not much earth; and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of earth:

rr: 6 eizooba ku ryajwire, omushana gwaziteera, zaahonga; kandi ahabw'okutagira mizi, zaayoma.
en: 6 but when the sun was up, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.

rr: 7 Embibo ezindi zaagwa omu mahwa; amahwa gaamera, gaazinyuruza, tizaayera.
en: 7 And some fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up, and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.

rr: 8 Embibo ezindi zaagwa omu itaka rirungi; ku zaaherize kumera, zaakura gye, zaakanya, zaayera, ezimwe zaahitsya makumi ashatu, ezindi makumi mukaaga, n'ezindi igana.
en: 8 And other fell on good ground, and did yield fruit that sprang up and increased; and brought forth, some thirty, and some sixty, and some an hundred.

rr: 9 Kandi yaagira ati: Oine amatu agarikuhurira, ahurire.
en: 9 And he said unto them, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

rr: 10 Kandi ku yaabaire ati wenka, abo abaabaire bamwehinguririize hamwe na bari ikumi na babiri baamubuuza aha nfumu egyo.
en: 10 And when he was alone, they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parable.

rr: 11 Yaabagira ati: Imwe muhairwe okumanya emibonano y'obukama bwa Ruhanga, kwonka ab'aheeru bo byona babicwerwa omu nfumu
en: 11 And he said unto them, Unto you it is given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God: but unto them that are without, all these things are done in parables:
12 that seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest at any time they should be converted, and their sins should be forgiven them.

rr: 13 Yaabagira ati: Timurikumanya enfumu egi? Mbwenu shi, muryamanya muta enfumu zoona?
en: 13 And he said unto them, Know ye not this parable? and how then will ye know all parables?

rr: 14 Omubibi abiba ekigambo.
en: 14 The sower soweth the word.

rr: 15 Embibo ez'omu muhanda, ahi ekigambo kyabibirwe, abo nibo baheza kuhurira, ahonaaho Sitaane akaija, akabaihamu ekigambo ekyabibwa omuribo.
en: 15 And these are they by the way side, where the word is sown; but when they have heard, Satan cometh immediately, and taketh away the word that was sown in their hearts.

rr: 16 Kandi ezaabibirwe aha rukiri, abo nibo bahurira ekigambo, bakarahuka kukiikiriza n'okushemererwa
en: 16 And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground; who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with gladness;

rr: 17 ahabw'okushangwa bataine mizi ehamire, beehangaana omwanya mukye; bwanyima hakibaho obusaasi n'okuhiigwa nibaturwa ekyo kigambo, ahonaaho bagwa.
en: 17 and have no root in themselves, and so endure but for a time: afterward, when affliction or persecution ariseth for the word's sake, immediately they are offended.

rr: 18 N'ezo ezaagwire omu mahwa, nibo bahurira ekigambo
en: 18 And these are they which are sown among thorns; such as hear the word,
19 and the cares of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in, choke the word, and it becometh unfruitful.

rr: 20 Kwonka ezaabibirwe aha itaka rirungi, abo nibo bahurira ekigambo, bakakiikiriza, bakaana ebyana emirundi makumi ashatu, makumi mukaaga, na igana.
en: 20 And these are they which are sown on good ground; such as hear the word, and receive it , and bring forth fruit, some thirtyfold, some sixty, and some an hundred.
21 And he said unto them, Is a candle brought to be put under a bushel, or under a bed? and not to be set on a candlestick?
22 For there is nothing hid, which shall not be manifested; neither was any thing kept secret, but that it should come abroad.

rr: 23 Oine amatu agarikuhurira, ahurire.
en: 23 If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.
24 And he said unto them, Take heed what ye hear: with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you: and unto you that hear shall more be given.

rr: 25 Ahakuba oine niwe aryongyerwa; kandi otaine aryayakwa n'ekyo eki aine.
en: 25 For he that hath, to him shall be given: and he that hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he hath.

rr: 26 Kandi yaagira ati: Obukama bwa Ruhanga nibushusha nk'oku omuntu abiba embibo omu itaka
en: 26 And he said, So is the kingdom of God, as if a man should cast seed into the ground;

rr: 27 akabyama kandi akaimuka nyomushana na nyekiro; embibo zikamera, zikakura, atamanyire oku zikuzire.
en: 27 and should sleep, and rise night and day, and the seed should spring and grow up, he knoweth not how.

rr: 28 Eitaka niryo rimeza ryonak; habanza akababi, hataho obushiisha, na bwanyima enjuma nkuru.
en: 28 For the earth bringeth forth fruit of herself; first the blade, then the ear, after that the full corn in the ear.
29 But when the fruit is brought forth, immediately he putteth in the sickle, because the harvest is come.
30 And he said, Whereunto shall we liken the kingdom of God? or with what comparison shall we compare it?

rr: 31 Nibushusha nk'akajuma ka # 4:31 Sinaapi reeba Mat. 13:31. sinaapi. Ku kabibwa omu itaka, kaba kari kakye okukira embibo zoona eziri omu nsi
en: 31 It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, is less than all the seeds that be in the earth:
32 but when it is sown, it groweth up, and becometh greater than all herbs, and shooteth out great branches; so that the fowls of the air may lodge under the shadow of it.

rr: 33 Akaba abagambira ekigambo omu nfumu nyingi, nk'oku baabaire babaasa kushoborokyerwa
en: 33 And with many such parables spake he the word unto them, as they were able to hear it .

rr: 34 tarabaasize kubeegyesa atabirabize mu nfumu; kureka abeegi be nibo yaabaire ashobororera byona omu mubonano.
en: 34 But without a parable spake he not unto them: and when they were alone, he expounded all things to his disciples.
35 And the same day, when the even was come, he saith unto them, Let us pass over unto the other side.

rr: 36 Ku baaherize kuraga omutwe gw'abantu, baamutwara omu bwato nk'oku yaabaire ari; kandi hakaba hariho n'agandi maato.
en: 36 And when they had sent away the multitude, they took him even as he was in the ship. And there were also with him other little ships.

rr: 37 Eihunga ringi ryaija, ebingonzi byateera obwato, amaizi gaabusheeshekamu, bwaba haihi kwijura
en: 37 And there arose a great storm of wind, and the waves beat into the ship, so that it was now full.

rr: 38 kwonka We akaba agwejegyeire, ayeeshegwire omushego enyima omu bwato. Baamusisiimura, baamugira bati: Mwegyesa, torikututaho mutima? Reeba twafa!
en: 38 And he was in the hinder part of the ship, asleep on a pillow: and they awake him, and say unto him, Master, carest thou not that we perish?

rr: 39 Yaasisiimuka, yaakabukira eihunga, yaagambira enyanja ati: Reka, cureera!
en: 39 And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still.

rr: Eihunga ryacureera; haabaho obucureera bwingi.
en: And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.

rr: 40 Yaababuuza ati: N'enki ekirikubatiinisa? Timukagizire kwikiriza?
en: 40 And he said unto them, Why are ye so fearful? how is it that ye have no faith?

rr: 41 Baatiina munonga, baagambirana bati: Bantu 'mwe, ogu ni muntu ki, orikuragiira eihunga n'enyanja, bikamuhurira!
en: 41 And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, What manner of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?
1 And they came over unto the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.

rr: 2 Ku yaarugire ati omu bwato, yaabuganwa omuntu owaabaire naaruga omu bituuro ariho daimoni.
en: 2 And when he was come out of the ship, immediately there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit,

rr: 3 Omushaija ogwo akaba atuura omu bituuro, kandi tihariho muntu owaabaire naakibaasa kumuboha, nangwa n'obu yaakuba n'emihama
en: 3 who had his dwelling among the tombs; and no man could bind him, no, not with chains:

rr: 4 ahakuba emirundi mingi bakaba bamubohesa emirunga n'emihama; emihama agihendagura, n'emirunga agicwa; tihaine muntu owaabaire agira amaani g'okumucureeza.
en: 4 because that he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been plucked asunder by him, and the fetters broken in pieces: neither could any man tame him.

rr: 5 Obutwire bwona nyomushana na nyekiro akaba ayamuriza omu bituuro n'omu bibungo naayeshaza amabaare.
en: 5 And always, night and day, he was in the mountains, and in the tombs, crying, and cutting himself with stones.

rr: 6 Ku yaareebire Yesu akiri hare, yairuka yaamuramya
en: 6 But when he saw Jesus afar off, he ran and worshipped him,

rr: 7 naayamuza n'eiraka rihango, naagira ati: Noofa ki naanye, Yesu Omwana wa Ruhanga Rukira-boona?
en: 7 and cried with a loud voice, and said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of the most high God?

rr: Ninkurahiza Ruhanga, otaanyita kubi!
en: I adjure thee by God, that thou torment me not.

rr: 8 Ahakuba Yesu akaba yaamuragiira ati: Murugyeho, iwe daimoni!
en: 8 For he said unto him, Come out of the man, thou unclean spirit.

rr: 9 Yesu yaamubuuza ati: Eiziina ryawe ori oha? Yaamugarukamu ati: Eiziina ryangye niinye # 5:9 Ekigambo Legioni nikimanyisa omubaro mwingi munonga. Legioni, ahabw'okuba turi baingi.
en: 9 And he asked him, What is thy name? And he answered, saying, My name is Legion: for we are many.

rr: 10 Yaamweshengyereza munonga, ngu atababinga omu nsi omwo.
en: 10 And he besought him much that he would not send them away out of the country.

rr: 11 Kandi omu rukiizi hakaba hariiriireyo omukumbi gw'empunu nyingi
en: 11 Now there was there nigh unto the mountains a great herd of swine feeding.

rr: 12 baadaimoni baamweshengyereza bati: Twohereze omu mpunu, tube nizo twataahamu.
en: 12 And all the devils besought him, saying, Send us into the swine, that we may enter into them.

rr: 13 Yaabaikiriza.
en: 13 And forthwith Jesus gave them leave.

rr: Baadaimoni baamurugaho, baazitaahamu; empunu ezo zikaba ziri nk'enkumi ibiri zaashuumira aha ibanga niziiruka, zaahwera omu nyanja.
en: And the unclean spirits went out, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea, (they were about two thousand;) and were choked in the sea.

rr: 14 Abariisa baazo bairuka, baabigambira ab'omuri tauni n'ab'omu maka; abantu baahurura, baija kureeba ekyabaho.
en: 14 And they that fed the swine fled, and told it in the city, and in the country. And they went out to see what it was that was done.

rr: 15 Ku baahikire ahari Yesu, baashangaho owaabaire ariho baadaimoni ashutami, ajwaire gye, aine obwengye bwe; baatiina.
en: 15 And they come to Jesus, and see him that was possessed with the devil, and had the legion, sitting, and clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.

rr: 16 Abariisa abaabireebire baabashobororera ebyaba ahari ogwo owaabaire ariho baadaimoni hamwe n'eby'empunu.
en: 16 And they that saw it told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil, and also concerning the swine.

rr: 17 Baatandika kweshengyereza Yesu kubarugira omu nsi.
en: 17 And they began to pray him to depart out of their coasts.

rr: 18 Kandi ku yaabaire naagaruka omu bwato, owaabaire ariho baadaimoni yaamweshengyereza kuguma nawe.
en: 18 And when he was come into the ship, he that had been possessed with the devil prayed him that he might be with him.

rr: 19 We yaamwangira, yaamugira ati: Irooko otaahe owaanyu omuri bagyenzi baawe, obagambire ebi Mukama akukoreire ku biri bikuru, n'oku akusaasiire.
en: 19 Howbeit Jesus suffered him not, but saith unto him, Go home to thy friends, and tell them how great things the Lord hath done for thee, and hath had compassion on thee.
20 And he departed, and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Jesus had done for him: and all men did marvel.

rr: 21 Yesu ku yaagarukire, yaayambukira omu bwato, yaahika seeri. Omutwe gw'abantu baingi gwateeranira ah'ari; kandi akaba ari haihi n'enyanja.
en: 21 And when Jesus was passed over again by ship unto the other side, much people gathered unto him: and he was nigh unto the sea.
22 And, behold, there cometh one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name; and when he saw him, he fell at his feet,

rr: 23 yaamweshengyereza, naagira ati: Kahara kangye naatsiga niguhiriita. Ija okateho engaro, kakire, kagire amagara.
en: 23 and besought him greatly, saying, My little daughter lieth at the point of death: I pray thee , come and lay thy hands on her, that she may be healed; and she shall live.

rr: 24 Yaagyenda nawe. Abantu baingi baamukuratira, baagyenda bamushagatiire.
en: 24 And Jesus went with him; and much people followed him, and thronged him.

rr: 25 Kandi hakaba hariho omukazi owaabaire amazire emyaka ikumi n'ebiri arwaire ekyejwiso
en: 25 And a certain woman, which had an issue of blood twelve years,

rr: 26 naafa kubi munonga naaraguza omu bafumu baingi, yaamariireyo ebintu bye byona, kwonka atarikukira, kureka okweyongyera kurwara.
en: 26 and had suffered many things of many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was nothing bettered, but rather grew worse,

rr: 27 Ku yaahuriire ebya Yesu, yaija enyima ye omu mutwe gw'abantu, yaakora aha kijwaro kye
en: 27 when she had heard of Jesus, came in the press behind, and touched his garment.

rr: 28 ahakuba akahamya naagira ati: N'obu naakukora aha bijwaro bye, nkaakira.
en: 28 For she said, If I may touch but his clothes, I shall be whole.

rr: 29 Ahonaaho ekyejwiso kye kyayoma; yaayehurira omu mubiri gwe ku yaakirira kimwe endwara ye.
en: 29 And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague.
30 And Jesus, immediately knowing in himself that virtue had gone out of him, turned him about in the press, and said, Who touched my clothes?

rr: 31 Abeegi be baamugira bati: Nooreeba abantu baingi nibakumigisiriza, oti, Owankoraho n'oha!
en: 31 And his disciples said unto him, Thou seest the multitude thronging thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?

rr: 32 Yaababunzyamu amaisho kureeba owaakora ekyo.
en: 32 And he looked round about to see her that had done this thing.

rr: 33 Kwonka omukazi, ahabw'okumanya eki yaakorerwa, yaija aine obwoba naatetema, yaagwa ahansi omu maisho ge, yaamugambira amazima goona.
en: 33 But the woman fearing and trembling, knowing what was done in her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.

rr: 34 Yesu yaamugarukamu ati: Mwana wangye, okwikiriza kwawe nikwo kwakukiza, yegyendere n'obusingye, okirire kimwe endwara yaawe.
en: 34 And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.

rr: 35 KU yaabaire naakigamba, haija abaaruga omu ka y'omukuru wa sinagogi, nibagira bati: Muhara waawe yaakaba; nooruhiza ki omwegyesa?
en: 35 While he yet spake, there came from the ruler of the synagogue's house certain which said, Thy daughter is dead: why troublest thou the Master any further?

rr: 36 Kwonka Yesu tiyaata mutima aha ki baagamba, yaagambira omukuru wa sinagogi ati: Otatiina, ikiriza kwonka.
en: 36 As soon as Jesus heard the word that was spoken, he saith unto the ruler of the synagogue, Be not afraid, only believe.

rr: 37 Kandi tiyaikiriza muntu weena kugyenda nawe, kureka Petero na Yakobo na Yohaana murumuna wa Yakobo.
en: 37 And he suffered no man to follow him, save Peter, and James, and John the brother of James.

rr: 38 Ku baahikire aha nju y'omukuru wa sinagogi, yaashangaho okucura, abantu nibarira nibaborooga.
en: 38 And he cometh to the house of the ruler of the synagogue, and seeth the tumult, and them that wept and wailed greatly.
39 And when he was come in, he saith unto them, Why make ye this ado, and weep? the damsel is not dead, but sleepeth.

rr: 40 Baamushekyerera munonga.
en: 40 And they laughed him to scorn.

rr: Kwonka ku yaaherize kubashohoza boona, yaatwara ishe w'omwishiki na nyina n'abu yaabaire aine, yaataahamu, yaahika ahu omwishiki yaabaire ari.
en: But when he had put them all out, he taketh the father and the mother of the damsel, and them that were with him, and entereth in where the damsel was lying.
41 And he took the damsel by the hand, and said unto her, Talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, Damsel, I say unto thee, arise.

rr: 42 Ahonaaho omwishiki ogwo yaimuka, yaagyenda; ahakuba akaba ahikize emyaka ikumi n'ebiri.
en: 42 And straightway the damsel arose, and walked; for she was of the age of twelve years.

rr: Ahonaaho baagira okutangaara kwingi munonga.
en: And they were astonished with a great astonishment.

rr: 43 Yaabeehanangiriza munonga, ngu hatagira owaakimanya; yaaragiira ku bamuha eby'okurya.
en: 43 And he charged them straitly that no man should know it; and commanded that something should be given her to eat.
1 And he went out from thence, and came into his own country; and his disciples follow him.

rr: 2 Sabato ku yaahikire, yaatandika kwegyesa omuri sinagogi; baingi ku baamuhuriire, baatangaara, nibagira bati: omushaija ogu akaiha hi ebi byona? Ni bwengye ki ogu obu yaahairwe? Ebi arikukora ka n'eby'okutangaaza!
en: 2 And when the sabbath day was come, he began to teach in the synagogue: and many hearing him were astonished, saying, From whence hath this man these things? and what wisdom is this which is given unto him, that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands?

rr: 3 Beitu ngu t'omubaizi, omwana wa Mariamu, mukuru wa Yakobo na Yose na Yuda na Simooni? Na banyaanya tibari owaitu? Ebye byabashobera.
en: 3 Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James, and Joses, and of Juda, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were offended at him.

rr: 4 Yesu yaabagira ati: Nabi weena tabura kitiinisa, kureka omu ihanga ryabo, n'omu ruganda rwabo, n'omu ka ye.
en: 4 But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.

rr: 5 N'ahabw'ekyo tarabaasize kukorerayo ky'okutangaaza kyona, kureka akata engaro aha barwaire bakye, yaabakiza.
en: 5 And he could there do no mighty work, save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed them .

rr: 6 Yaatangaara ahabw'okutaikiriza kwabo.
en: 6 And he marvelled because of their unbelief. And he went round about the villages, teaching.
7 And he called unto him the twelve, and began to send them forth by two and two; and gave them power over unclean spirits;

rr: 8 Yaabaragiira kutagira ki baagyendana, kureka enkoni yonka; kutakoma ntanda, kutatwara furebe, n'obu zaakuba empiiha omu nshaho zaabo
en: 8 and commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, save a staff only; no scrip, no bread, no money in their purse:

rr: 9 kureka bagyende bajwaire enkaito; kandi n'okutatwara makanzu abiri.
en: 9 but be shod with sandals; and not put on two coats.

rr: 10 Kandi yaabaragiira ati: Enju yoona, ei muraataahemu, mube niyo mwagumamu okuhitsya obu murirugayo.
en: 10 And he said unto them, In what place soever ye enter into an house, there abide till ye depart from that place.

rr: 11 Kandi hoonahoona ahu batariikiriza kubaraaza, bakanga n'okubahurira, ku muriba nimurugayo, mutsigye mwabakunkumurira omucuucu gw'omu bigyere byanyu okuba eky'okushinja.
en: 11 And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear you, when ye depart thence, shake off the dust under your feet for a testimony against them. Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.

rr: 12 Batyo baagyenda nibabuurira ku abantu bashemereire kweteisa.
en: 12 And they went out, and preached that men should repent.
13 And they cast out many devils, and anointed with oil many that were sick, and healed them .
14 And king Herod heard of him ; (for his name was spread abroad:) and he said, That John the Baptist was risen from the dead, and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.

rr: 15 Kwonka abandi baagira bati: N'Eliya; abandi bati: Ni nabi nk'omwe ahari baanabi aba ira.
en: 15 Others said, That it is Elias. And others said, That it is a prophet, or as one of the prophets.

rr: 16 Kwonka Heroode ku yaabihuriire, yaagira ati: Ni Yohaana ou naatemire omutwe, azookire.
en: 16 But when Herod heard thereof , he said, It is John, whom I beheaded: he is risen from the dead.

rr: 17 Ahakuba ebyo bitakabaireho, Heroode akatuma, baakwata Yohaana, baamuboha, baamuta omu kihome ahabwa Herodia, muka Filipo mwene ishe; ahabw'okuba Heroode akaba amuhindwire omukazi we.
en: 17 For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John, and bound him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife: for he had married her.

rr: 18 Yohaana ku yaabimanyire, yaateisa Heroode, ati: Ebiragiro tibirikukwikiriza kushwera muka mwene sho.
en: 18 For John had said unto Herod, It is not lawful for thee to have thy brother's wife.

rr: 19 Herodia nikyo yaamwangiire, akenda kumwita; kwonka atabaase
en: 19 Therefore Herodias had a quarrel against him, and would have killed him; but she could not:

rr: 20 ahabw'okuba Heroode akaba naatiina Yohaana ahabw'okumumanya ku ari omuntu ohikiriire, kandi orikwera; yaamurinda. Kandi ku yaabaire agambira Yohaana, # 6:20 Nari: omuri bingi akaba amworobera, ashemereirwe. bikaba bimushobera, kwonka akaba amuhurira ashemereirwe.
en: 20 for Herod feared John, knowing that he was a just man and an holy, and observed him; and when he heard him, he did many things, and heard him gladly.

rr: 21 Bwanyima oburyo bwaboneka aha kiro ky'okwijuka okuzaarwa kwa Heroode, Heroode yaateekyera abaami be na'abakuru b'abaserukare n'abakungu ba Galilaaya obugyenyi.
en: 21 And when a convenient day was come, that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords, high captains, and chief estates of Galilee;

rr: 22 Omwishiki wa Herodia yaija, yaazina, yaashemeza Heroode n'abagyenzi be. Omugabe nikwo kugira omwishiki ati: Nshaba eki orikwenda kyona, niinyija kukikuha.
en: 22 and when the daughter of the said Herodias came in, and danced, and pleased Herod and them that sat with him, the king said unto the damsel, Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt, and I will give it thee.

rr: 23 Yaarahira naamugira ati: Kyona kyona eki oranshabe, ninkikuha, n'obu kyakuba ekicweka ky'obugabe bwangye.
en: 23 And he sware unto her, Whatsoever thou shalt ask of me, I will give it thee, unto the half of my kingdom.

rr: 24 Omwishiki yaashohora, yaabuuza nyina ati: Mbwenu iwe, okaayenzire ngu mmushabe ki? Yaamugarukamu ati: Omutwe gwa Yohaana Omubatizi.
en: 24 And she went forth, and said unto her mother, What shall I ask? And she said, The head of John the Baptist.

rr: 25 Ahonaaho omwishiki yaarahuka, yaagaruka aha mugabe, yaamushaba ati: Niinyenda hati mbwenu ompe omutwe gwa Yohana Omubatizi omu rucuba.
en: 25 And she came in straightway with haste unto the king, and asked, saying, I will that thou give me by and by in a charger the head of John the Baptist.

rr: 26 Omugabe yaashaasha munonga; kwonka ahabw'okushangwa yaarahiire omu maisho g'abagyenyi be, yaashoberwa kumubeiha.
en: 26 And the king was exceeding sorry; yet for his oath's sake, and for their sakes which sat with him, he would not reject her.

rr: 27 Ahonaaho omugabe yaatuma omuserukare, yaamuragiira kumutemaho omutwe n'okugureeta. Omuserukare yaagyenda omu kihome, yaamutemaho omutwe
en: 27 And immediately the king sent an executioner, and commanded his head to be brought: and he went and beheaded him in the prison,

rr: 28 yaagureeta omu rucuba, yaaguha omwishiki, omwishiki yaagutwarira nyina.
en: 28 and brought his head in a charger, and gave it to the damsel: and the damsel gave it to her mother.

rr: 29 Abeegi ba Yohaana ku baakihuriire, baija, baatwara omutimbi gwe, baaguziika.
en: 29 And when his disciples heard of it , they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.
30 And the apostles gathered themselves together unto Jesus, and told him all things, both what they had done, and what they had taught.

rr: 31 Yaazigira ati: Mwije aheekiikire twehereere, muhuumureho; ahakuba hakaba hariho baingi abaabaire nibaija kandi nibagyenda; n'ahabw'ekyo Yesu n'abeegi be baabura omwanya nangwa n'ogw'okurya.
en: 31 And he said unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
32 And they departed into a desert place by ship privately.

rr: 33 Kwonka abantu baingi baabareeba nibagyenda, baabamanya; baaruga omuri tauni zoona, nibairukanga, baaraba ogw'ebigyere, baabatangayo.
en: 33 And the people saw them departing, and many knew him, and ran afoot thither out of all cities, and outwent them, and came together unto him.
34 And Jesus, when he came out, saw much people, and was moved with compassion toward them, because they were as sheep not having a shepherd: and he began to teach them many things.
35 And when the day was now far spent, his disciples came unto him, and said, This is a desert place, and now the time is far passed:

rr: 36 Raga abantu bagyende omu byaro n'omu birorero ebiri haihi, beegurire eby'okurya.
en: 36 send them away, that they may go into the country round about, and into the villages, and buy themselves bread: for they have nothing to eat.

rr: 37 We yaabagarukamu ati: Mube niimwe mwabagaburira.
en: 37 He answered and said unto them, Give ye them to eat.

rr: Baamugira bati: Mbwenu shi, tugyende tugure emigaati y'edenaari magana abiri, tube niyo twabagaburira?
en: And they say unto him, Shall we go and buy two hundred pennyworth of bread, and give them to eat?

rr: 38 Yaababuuza ati: Imwe mwineho engahi? Mugyende mwetegyereze. Ku baamanyire, baagira bati: Hariho etaano n'eby'enyanja bibiri.
en: 38 He saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? go and see. And when they knew, they say, Five, and two fishes.

rr: 39 Yaabaragiira kubashutamya boona omu kacwamba omu miteeko.
en: 39 And he commanded them to make all sit down by companies upon the green grass.

rr: 40 Baashutama omu mitwe ya igana-igana, kandi n'eya makumi ataano-ataano.
en: 40 And they sat down in ranks, by hundreds, and by fifties.

rr: 41 Yaakwata egyo migaati etaano n'eby'enyanja bibiri, yaareeba ahaiguru, yaasiima, yaabega emigaati, yaaheereza abeegi be ngu bagite omu maisho g'abantu; n'eby'enyanja ebyo byombi yaabibaha boona.
en: 41 And when he had taken the five loaves and the two fishes, he looked up to heaven, and blessed, and brake the loaves, and gave them to his disciples to set before them; and the two fishes divided he among them all.

rr: 42 Boona baarya, baahaaga.
en: 42 And they did all eat, and were filled.

rr: 43 Bwanyima baatorotoora oburagarika bw'emigaati n'eby'enyanja, baijuza ebitenga ikumi na bibiri.
en: 43 And they took up twelve baskets full of the fragments, and of the fishes.

rr: 44 Abo abaariire bakaba bari abashaija enkumi itaano.
en: 44 And they that did eat of the loaves were about five thousand men.
45 And straightway he constrained his disciples to get into the ship, and to go to the other side before unto Bethsaida, while he sent away the people.

rr: 46 Ku yaaherize kubaraga, yaatemba ekibungo, yaaza kushaba.
en: 46 And when he had sent them away, he departed into a mountain to pray.

rr: 47 Kandi ku bwabaire nibwira, obwato bwahika ahagati y'enyanja, We akiri omu kibungo wenka.
en: 47 And when even was come, the ship was in the midst of the sea, and he alone on the land.

rr: 48 Yaareeba nibabuvuga baremesiibwe omuyaga gubaturukire omumaisho. Omu kusisiimuka kwa kana yaabaizira naagyendesa amaguru aha nyanja, yaashusha nk'orikwenda kubahinguraho.
en: 48 And he saw them toiling in rowing; for the wind was contrary unto them: and about the fourth watch of the night he cometh unto them, walking upon the sea, and would have passed by them.

rr: 49 Ku baamureebire naagyendesa amaguru aha nyanja, baateekateeka ngu n'omuzimu, baayamuza
en: 49 But when they saw him walking upon the sea, they supposed it had been a spirit, and cried out:

rr: 50 ahakuba boona bakamureeba baatiina.
en: 50 for they all saw him, and were troubled.

rr: Ahonaaho yaagamba nabo, yaabahuumuriza, ati: Muhuumure, niinye, mutatiina.
en: And immediately he talked with them, and saith unto them, Be of good cheer: it is I; be not afraid.
51 And he went up unto them into the ship; and the wind ceased: and they were sore amazed in themselves beyond measure, and wondered.

rr: 52 kwonka tibarashoborokyeirwe by'emigaati, ahabw'okuba emitima yaabo ekaba egangaire.
en: 52 For they considered not the miracle of the loaves: for their heart was hardened.

rr: 53 Ku baayambukire, baahika omu nsi ya Genesareeti, baakoma obwato aha nkungu.
en: 53 And when they had passed over, they came into the land of Gennesaret, and drew to the shore.

rr: 54 Ku baarugire omu bwato, ahonaaho abantu baamumanya
en: 54 And when they were come out of the ship, straightway they knew him,

rr: 55 bairuka baayegaba ebirari aho hoona, baatandika kuheeka abarwaire aha bitanda byabo, baabamushangisa ahu baabaire bahurira ari hoona.
en: 55 and ran through that whole region round about, and began to carry about in beds those that were sick, where they heard he was.

56 And whithersoever he entered, into villages, or cities, or country, they laid the sick in the streets, and besought him that they might touch if it were but the border of his garment: and as many as touched him were made whole.
1 Then came together unto him the Pharisees, and certain of the scribes, which came from Jerusalem.
2 And when they saw some of his disciples eat bread with defiled, that is to say, with unwashen, hands, they found fault.

rr: 3 Ahakuba Abafarisaayo n'Abayudaaya boona tibarya ku baba batajabikire gye ngaro zaabo omu maizi, nibakuratira emigyenzo ya baishenkurubo.
en: 3 For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, except they wash their hands oft, eat not, holding the tradition of the elders.

rr: 4 Kandi ku baba nibaruga omu katare, tibarya batabandize kwoga.
en: 4 And when they come from the market, except they wash, they eat not.

rr: Kandi hariho n'endiijo migyenzo mingi, ei baaragiirwe kurinda, nk'okwozya ebikopo n'enyabya n'ebintu by'emiringa.
en: And many other things there be, which they have received to hold, as the washing of cups, and pots, brasen vessels, and of tables.

rr: 5 Abafarisaayo n'abahandiiki baamubuuza bati: Ahabw'enki abeegi baawe batakurata migyenzo ya baishenkurubo, bafa okuriisa engaro zisiisikaire?
en: 5 Then the Pharisees and scribes asked him, Why walk not thy disciples according to the tradition of the elders, but eat bread with unwashen hands?
6 He answered and said unto them, Well hath Esaias prophesied of you hypocrites, as it is written,

rr: 7 Bandamiza busha
en: 7 Howbeit in vain do they worship me,

rr: 8 Nimureka ekiragiro kya Ruhanga, ngu mugumye emigyenzo y'abantu.
en: 8 For laying aside the commandment of God, ye hold the tradition of men, as the washing of pots and cups: and many other such like things ye do.

rr: 9 yaabagambira ati: Imwe mwine obwengye burungi obw'okwangiramu ebiragiro bya Ruhanga, ngu mubone kuhamira aha migyenzo yaanyu!
en: 9 And he said unto them, Full well ye reject the commandment of God, that ye may keep your own tradition.

rr: 10 Ahakuba Musa akagira ati: Otiine sho na nyoko; kandi ati: Orijuma ishe nari nyina, buzimazima aitwe.
en: 10 For Moses said, Honour thy father and thy mother; and, Whoso curseth father or mother, let him die the death:

rr: 11 Kwonka imwe nimugira muti: Omuntu ku araagambire ishe nari nyina ati: Eki naakukuhaire ni Koribaani, amakuru gaakyo ngu, N'ekihongyeirwe Ruhanga
en: 11 but ye say, If a man shall say to his father or mother, It is Corban, that is to say, a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me; he shall be free .

rr: 12 muba mutakimwikiriza kugira eki yaakorera ishe nari nyina.
en: 12 And ye suffer him no more to do ought for his father or his mother;

rr: 13 Omu buryo obwo ekigambo kya Ruhanga mukihindura busha ahabw'emigyenzo yaanyu eyaahindukire akarande. Kandi mukora n'ebindi bingi nk'ebyo.
en: 13 making the word of God of none effect through your tradition, which ye have delivered: and many such like things do ye.

rr: 14 Kandi yaagaruka yaayeta abantu, yaabagira ati: Mumpurire mwena, mwetegyereze.
en: 14 And when he had called all the people unto him , he said unto them, Hearken unto me every one of you , and understand:
15 there is nothing from without a man, that entering into him can defile him: but the things which come out of him, those are they that defile the man.

rr: 16 Omuntu oine amatu agarikuhurira, ahurire.
en: 16 If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.

rr: 17 Ku yaarugire omu bantu, yaataaha omu nju; abeegi be baamubuuza amakuru g'enfumu egyo.
en: 17 And when he was entered into the house from the people, his disciples asked him concerning the parable.

rr: 18 Yaababuuza ati: Biri shi naimwe timwine bwengye?
en: 18 And he saith unto them, Are ye so without understanding also?

rr: Timurikumanya ngu kyona ekiruga aheeru, kikataaha omu muntu, tikibaasa kumushiisha?
en: Do ye not perceive, that whatsoever thing from without entereth into the man, it cannot defile him;

rr: 19 Ahabw'okuba tikimutaaha mu mutima, kureka omu nda, kandi namwo kigaruka kyogamu, kishohora. (Akagamba atyo, naahamya ku hatariho kiriibwa kyona ekrikuzira.)
en: 19 because it entereth not into his heart, but into the belly, and goeth out into the draught, purging all meats?

rr: 20 Yaagaruka yaagira ati: Ekiruga omu muntu nikyo kimushiisha
en: 20 And he said, That which cometh out of the man, that defileth the man.

rr: 21 ahakuba omunda omu mitima y'abantu nimwo haruga ebiteekateeko bibi, okushambana, okwiba, okwita
en: 21 For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders,

rr: 22 okwetenga okubi, okukora kubi, okuryarya, okurigira okubi, eitima, okubeiherera abandi, amaryo, n'okwefiisa omutima.
en: 22 thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness:

rr: 23 Ebibi ebyo byona biruga omu muntu, kandi nibyo bimushiisha.
en: 23 all these evil things come from within, and defile the man.
24 And from thence he arose, and went into the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and entered into an house, and would have no man know it : but he could not be hid.

rr: 25 Ahonaaho omukazi, owaabaire aine akaishiki akaabaire kariho daimoni, ku yaamuhuriire, yaija, yaamukwata amaguru.
en: 25 For a certain woman, whose young daughter had an unclean spirit, heard of him, and came and fell at his feet:

rr: 26 Kandi omukazi ogwo akaba ari Omugriika, oruganda rwe ari Omusirofoiniiki. Yaamweshengyereza kubinga daimoni aha mwana we.
en: 26 the woman was a Greek, a Syrophenician by nation; and she besought him that he would cast forth the devil out of her daughter.

rr: 27 Yesu yaamugambira ati: Reka abaana baabanze bahaagye; ahakuba ti kirungi kwaka abaana eby'okurya, okabitambikira embwa.
en: 27 But Jesus said unto her, Let the children first be filled: for it is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast it unto the dogs.

rr: 28 Omukazi ogwo yaamwikiriza ati: Eego, Mukama wangye; kwonka embwa nazo, eziri ahansi y'emeeza, zirya oburagarika bw'abaana.
en: 28 And she answered and said unto him, Yes, Lord: yet the dogs under the table eat of the children's crumbs.

rr: 29 Yesu yaamugira ati: Ahabw'ekigambo ekyo yegyendere; omwana waawe daimoni yaamurugaho.
en: 29 And he said unto her, For this saying go thy way; the devil is gone out of thy daughter.

rr: 30 Omukazi yaagaruka omu ka ye, yaashanga omwana arambiire aha kitanda, daimoni yaamurugireho.
en: 30 And when she was come to her house, she found the devil gone out, and her daughter laid upon the bed.

rr: 31 Bwanyima yaagaruka naaruga omu ishaza rya Tuuro, yaaraba Sidoni; ku yaarabire omu ishaza rya Dekapooli, yaahika aha nyanja ya Galilaaya.
en: 31 And again, departing from the coasts of Tyre and Sidon, he came unto the sea of Galilee, through the midst of the coasts of Decapolis.

rr: 32 Baamureetera ekiteta ky'ekifa-matu; bamweshengyereza ngu amuteho engaro.
en: 32 And they bring unto him one that was deaf, and had an impediment in his speech; and they beseech him to put his hand upon him.

rr: 33 Yaamwiha omu mutwe gw'abantu, yaamwekiikana, yaamuta enkumu omu matu, kandi yaacwera amacwante, yaamukora aha rurimi
en: 33 And he took him aside from the multitude, and put his fingers into his ears, and he spit, and touched his tongue;

rr: 34 yaareeba ahaiguru omu iguru, omwitsyo gwamuruga hare, yaamugambira ati: Efasa! amakuru gaakyo ngu, Iguka.
en: 34 and looking up to heaven, he sighed, and saith unto him, Ephphatha, that is, Be opened.

rr: 35 Amatu ge gaiguka, n'engata y'orurimi rwe yaakomooroka, yaagamba gye.
en: 35 And straightway his ears were opened, and the string of his tongue was loosed, and he spake plain.

rr: 36 Kandi yaabeehanangiriza kutagira u baakigambira; kwonka ahi yaagarukiire kubeehanangiriza, bakakizaho kukirangaana.
en: 36 And he charged them that they should tell no man: but the more he charged them, so much the more a great deal they published it ;

rr: 37 Baatangaara munonga barengyesereza, baagira bati: Byona yaabikora gye; yaahuriza ekifa-matu, kandi yaagambisa ekitete.
en: 37 and were beyond measure astonished, saying, He hath done all things well: he maketh both the deaf to hear, and the dumb to speak.
1 In those days the multitude being very great, and having nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples unto him , and saith unto them,
2 I have compassion on the multitude, because they have now been with me three days, and have nothing to eat:

rr: 3 Ku ndaaboohereze kugaruka owaabo basiibirekwo, nibaija kugwera enshazi omu muhanda; kandi mumanye ngu abamwe omuribo barugire hare.
en: 3 and if I send them away fasting to their own houses, they will faint by the way: for divers of them came from far.

rr: 4 Abeegi be baamugarukamu bati: Mbwenu omuntu naabaasa ata kugaburira aba bantu aha omu ihamba?
en: 4 And his disciples answered him, From whence can a man satisfy these men with bread here in the wilderness?

rr: 5 Yaababuuza ati: Hari mwine emigaati engahi? Baamugarukamu bati: Ni mushanju.
en: 5 And he asked them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven.

rr: 6 Yaaragiira abantu kushutama ahansi; ku yaaherize kusiima yaagibega, yaagiha abeegi be kugiha abantu; nabo baagibata omumaisho.
en: 6 And he commanded the people to sit down on the ground: and he took the seven loaves, and gave thanks, and brake, and gave to his disciples to set before them ; and they did set them before the people.

rr: 7 Kandi bakaba baine eby'enyanja bikye; ku yaaherize kubishabira omugisha, yaaragiira ngu nabyo babibate omumaisho.
en: 7 And they had a few small fishes: and he blessed, and commanded to set them also before them .

rr: 8 Baarya baahaaga; baatorotoora oburagarika obwatsigaireho, baijuza ebiibo mushanju.
en: 8 So they did eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets.

rr: 9 Abantu bakaba bari nk'enkumi ina.
en: 9 And they that had eaten were about four thousand: and he sent them away.

rr: 10 Yaabaraga; ahonaaho yaagaruka omu bwato n'abeegi be, yaayambuka, naaza omu kyanga kya Dalmanusa.
en: 10 And straightway he entered into a ship with his disciples, and came into the parts of Dalmanutha.
11 And the Pharisees came forth, and began to question with him, seeking of him a sign from heaven, tempting him.

rr: 12 Omwitsyo gwamuruga hare, yaagira ati: Ab'obusingye obu nibendera ki akamanyiso? Buzimazima nimbagambira nti: Ab'obusingye obu tibarireeba kamanyiso.
en: 12 And he sighed deeply in his spirit, and saith, Why doth this generation seek after a sign? verily I say unto you, There shall no sign be given unto this generation.

rr: 13 Yaabatsigaho, yaaza omu bwato, yaayambuka seeri.
en: 13 And he left them, and entering into the ship again departed to the other side.

rr: 14 Kwonka bakaba beebirwe kukoma entanda, kandi omu bwato bakaba baine omugaati gumwe gwonka.
en: 14 Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, neither had they in the ship with them more than one loaf.
15 And he charged them, saying, Take heed, beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, and of the leaven of Herod.

rr: 16 Baagambirana bati: Eki arikufa n'ahabw'okuba titwine migaati.
en: 16 And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have no bread.

rr: 17 Yesu ku yaabimanyire, yaababuuza ati: Nimufa ki aha by'emigaati? Timukamanyire n'obu kwakuba okushoborokyerwa? Mukiine emitima egangaire?
en: 17 And when Jesus knew it , he saith unto them, Why reason ye, because ye have no bread? perceive ye not yet, neither understand? have ye your heart yet hardened?
18 Having eyes, see ye not? and having ears, hear ye not? and do ye not remember?

rr: 19 Ku naagaburiire abantu enkumi itaano emigaati etaano, mukatorotoora ebitenga bingahi ebiijwire oburagarika?
en: 19 When I brake the five loaves among five thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up?

rr: Baamugarukamu bati: Ikumi na bibiri.
en: They say unto him, Twelve.

rr: 20 Kandi shi, ku naagaburiire enkumi ina emigaati mushanju, bwo mukatorotoora ebiibo biijwire bingahi? Baamugarukamu bati: Ni mushanju.
en: 20 And when the seven among four thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? And they said, Seven.

rr: 21 Yaabagira ati: Timukashoborokyeirwe?
en: 21 And he said unto them, How is it that ye do not understand?

rr: 22 Baagarukayo, baahika Besesaida. Baamureetera empumi, baamweshengyereza ngu agikoreho.
en: 22 And he cometh to Bethsaida; and they bring a blind man unto him, and besought him to touch him.
23 And he took the blind man by the hand, and led him out of the town; and when he had spit on his eyes, and put his hands upon him, he asked him if he saw ought.

rr: 24 Yaabuuruura amaisho, yaagira ati: Nindeeba abantu; kwonka nibansusira nk'emiti baaba nibagyenda.
en: 24 And he looked up, and said, I see men as trees, walking.

rr: 25 Yesu yaagaruka, yaamuta engaro aha maisho, empumi egyo yaayetegyereza, yaakira, yaareeba byona kurungi.
en: 25 After that he put his hands again upon his eyes, and made him look up: and he was restored, and saw every man clearly.
26 And he sent him away to his house, saying, Neither go into the town, nor tell it to any in the town.

rr: 27 Yesu yaagumizamu n'abeegi be, baataaha omu birorero bya Kaisarea-Filipi. Ku baabaire nibakigyenda, yaabuuza abeegi be ati: Beitu abantu bagirqa ngu mba oha?
en: 27 And Jesus went out, and his disciples, into the towns of Cæsarea Philippi: and by the way he asked his disciples, saying unto them, Whom do men say that I am?

rr: 28 Baamugarukamu bati: Abamwe nibagira ntu, ori Yohaana Omubatizi; abandi ngu: Ori Eliya; kandi abandi ngu: Ori omwe ahari baanabi.
en: 28 And they answered, John the Baptist: but some say , Elias; and others, One of the prophets.
29 And he saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am? And Peter answereth and saith unto him, Thou art the Christ.

rr: 30 Yesu yaabeehanangiriza kutakigambiraho ondiijo.
en: 30 And he charged them that they should tell no man of him.

rr: 31 Yaiha aho, yaatandika kubeegyesa ku Omwana w'omuntu ashemereire kubonabonesibwa omuri bingi, n'okwangwa abakuru n'abanyamurwa abakuru n'abahandiiki, n'okwitwa, kandi n'okuzooka bwanyima y'ebiro bishatu.
en: 31 And he began to teach them, that the Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders, and of the chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.

rr: 32 Ekigambo ekyo akakigamba butunu. Bwanyima Petero yaamuta aha rubaju, yaamuteisa.
en: 32 And he spake that saying openly. And Peter took him, and began to rebuke him.

rr: 33 Yesu yaahinduka, yaareeba abeegi be, yaahana Petero, naagira ati: Garuka enyima yangye, Sitaane; ahakuba torikuteekateeka bya Ruhanga, kureka eby'abantu.
en: 33 But when he had turned about and looked on his disciples, he rebuked Peter, saying, Get thee behind me, Satan: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but the things that be of men .

rr: 34 Yaayeta emitwe y'abantu n'abeegi be, yaabagira ati: Omuntu weena ku araayende kunkuratira, ayeyangise, ayekorere omusharaba gwe, ankuratire.
en: 34 And when he had called the people unto him with his disciples also, he said unto them, Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
35 For whosoever will save his life shall lose it; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel's, the same shall save it.

rr: 36 Mbwenu omuntu kiryamugasira ki okutunga ensi yoona, haza akafeerwa amagara ge?
en: 36 For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?

rr: 37 Nari shi, omuntu akaahaireyo ki okucungura amagara ge?
en: 37 Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?

38 Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation; of him also shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he cometh in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.

rr: 1 Yaabagira ati: Buzimazima nimbagambira nti: Omuri aba abeemereire aha, hariho bambwe abarireeba obukama bwa Ruhanga nibwija n'amaani, batakafiire.
en: 1 And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That there be some of them that stand here, which shall not taste of death, till they have seen the kingdom of God come with power.
2 And after six days Jesus taketh with him Peter, and James, and John, and leadeth them up into an high mountain apart by themselves: and he was transfigured before them.

rr: 3 ebijwaro bye bayamurinkana, byayera tiitiiti, kandi tihariho mwozi omu nsi owaakubaasize kubyeza atyo.
en: 3 And his raiment became shining, exceeding white as snow; so as no fuller on earth can white them.

rr: 4 Kandi Eliya na Musa baababonekyera, nibagaaniira na Yesu.
en: 4 And there appeared unto them Elias with Moses: and they were talking with Jesus.

rr: 5 Petero yaagira Yesu ati: Mwegyesa, ni kirungi obu turi aha; twombekye obuju bushatu, akamwe kabe akaawe, akandi kabe aka Musa, n'akandi aka Eliya.
en: 5 And Peter answered and said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.

rr: 6 Akaba atarikumanya eki ashemereire kugamba, ahabw'okuba bakaba batiinire munonga.
en: 6 For he wist not what to say; for they were sore afraid.
7 And there was a cloud that overshadowed them: and a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.

rr: 8 Ahonaaho ku baamagamagire, tibaareebaho muntu ondiijo, kureka Yesu wenka.
en: 8 And suddenly, when they had looked round about, they saw no man any more, save Jesus only with themselves.

rr: 9 Ku baabaire nibashuuma, nibaruga aha rushozi, Yesu yaabeehanangiriza kutagira u baagambira ahari byona ebi baareebire, okuhitsya obu Omwana w'omuntu arizooka omu bafu.
en: 9 And as they came down from the mountain, he charged them that they should tell no man what things they had seen, till the Son of man were risen from the dead.

rr: 10 Baakyerinda, nibeebuuza bonka bati: Okuzooka omu bafu n'enki?
en: 10 And they kept that saying with themselves, questioning one with another what the rising from the dead should mean.

rr: 11 Kadi baamubuuza bati: Ahabw'enki abahandiiki bagira ngu, Eliya ashemereire kubanza kwija?
en: 11 And they asked him, saying, Why say the scribes that Elias must first come?
12 And he answered and told them, Elias verily cometh first, and restoreth all things; and how it is written of the Son of man, that he must suffer many things, and be set at nought.

rr: 13 Kwonka nyowe nimbagambira nti: Eliya araizire, kandi bakamutwaza nk'oku baayenzire, nk'oku kyamuhandiikirweho.
en: 13 But I say unto you, That Elias is indeed come, and they have done unto him whatsoever they listed, as it is written of him.
14 And when he came to his disciples, he saw a great multitude about them, and the scribes questioning with them.

rr: 15 Ahonaaho abantu boona ku baamureebire, baatangaara muonga, bairuka baaza kumuramutsya.
en: 15 And straightway all the people, when they beheld him, were greatly amazed, and running to him saluted him.

rr: 16 Yaababuuza ati: Mwaba nimuhakana ki?
en: 16 And he asked the scribes, What question ye with them?

rr: 17 Omwe ahari abo bantu yaamugarukamu ati: Mwegyesa, nkureeteire omwana wangye, ahakuba ariho daimoni otarikugamba.
en: 17 And one of the multitude answered and said, Master, I have brought unto thee my son, which hath a dumb spirit;

rr: 18 Ahu amukwatira hoona, amuteera ahansi; omwana areeta eifuro, anena amaino, agangaara; naashaba abeegi baawe kumubinga, baaremwa.
en: 18 and wheresoever he taketh him, he teareth him: and he foameth, and gnasheth with his teeth, and pineth away: and I spake to thy disciples that they should cast him out; and they could not.

rr: 19 Yesu yaagambira abeegi be ati: Imwe abatarikwikiriza, ndyahitsya hi okuguma naimwe; ndyahitsya hi okubagumisiririza? Mumundeetere!
en: 19 He answereth him, and saith, O faithless generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him unto me.

rr: 20 Baamumureetera. Daimoni ku yaamureebire, ahonaaho yaatetemya omwana, omwana yaagwa ahansi, yaayekuringa, yaareeta eifuro.
en: 20 And they brought him unto him: and when he saw him, straightway the spirit tare him; and he fell on the ground, and wallowed foaming.

rr: 21 Yesu yaabuuza ishe ati: Akakwatwa ryari endwara egi? Ishe ati: Akakwatwa akiri muto.
en: 21 And he asked his father, How long is it ago since this came unto him? And he said, Of a child.

rr: 22 Kaingi amutuura omu muriro n'omu maizi kumwita; ku oraabe noobaasa endwara egi, otugirire embabazi, otuhwere.
en: 22 And ofttimes it hath cast him into the fire, and into the waters, to destroy him: but if thou canst do any thing, have compassion on us, and help us.

rr: 23 Yesu yaamugira ati: Wangira ngu, Ku ndaabe nimbaasa! Eego, byona nibibaasika ahari ogwo orikwikiriza.
en: 23 Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.
24 And straightway the father of the child cried out, and said with tears, Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.
