rr: 25 Yesu ku yaareebire abantu baingi nibairuka nibamwizira, yaagambira kubi daimoni, yaamugira ati: Iwe daimoni otarikugamba, otarikuhurira, naakuragiira, murugyeho, otarimugarukaho obundi.
en: 25 When Jesus saw that the people came running together, he rebuked the foul spirit, saying unto him, Thou dumb and deaf spirit, I charge thee, come out of him, and enter no more into him.

rr: 26 Daimoni yaayamuza, yaamutetemya munonga, yaamurugaho; omwana yaaba nk'ofiire; abangi baagira ngu, yaafa.
en: 26 And the spirit cried, and rent him sore, and came out of him: and he was as one dead; insomuch that many said, He is dead.

rr: 27 Kwonka Yesu yaamukwata aha mukono, yaamwimutsya; omwana yaayemerera.
en: 27 But Jesus took him by the hand, and lifted him up; and he arose.

rr: 28 Ku baataahire omu nju, abeegi be baamubuuza omu mubonano, bati: Itwe ahanki tutaabaasa kumubinga?
en: 28 And when he was come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, Why could not we cast him out?

rr: 29 Yaabagarukamu ati: Daimoni ow'omuringo nk'ogu tarikubingwa kindi kureka okushaba n'okwesiibyakwo.
en: 29 And he said unto them, This kind can come forth by nothing, but by prayer and fasting.
30 And they departed thence, and passed through Galilee; and he would not that any man should know it .

rr: 31 ahakuba akaba naayegyesa abeegi be ati: Omwana w'omuntu aryaheebwayo omu mikono y'abantu, bamwite; kandi ku ariheza kwitwa, aryazooka bwanyima y'ebiro bishatu.
en: 31 For he taught his disciples, and said unto them, The Son of man is delivered into the hands of men, and they shall kill him; and after that he is killed, he shall rise the third day.

rr: 32 Kwonka tibaramanyire ki arikugamba; n'okutiina baatiina kumubuuza.
en: 32 But they understood not that saying, and were afraid to ask him.
33 And he came to Capernaum: and being in the house he asked them, What was it that ye disputed among yourselves by the way?

rr: 34 Baahunama kwonka, ahabw'okuba ku baabaire bari omu muhanda, baahakana bonka ngu, N'oha oriba omukuru omuribo?
en: 34 But they held their peace: for by the way they had disputed among themselves, who should be the greatest.
35 And he sat down, and called the twelve, and saith unto them, If any man desire to be first, the same shall be last of all, and servant of all.

rr: 36 Yaakwata omwana muto, yaamuta ahagati yaabo, yaamukiikira omu mikono, yaabagira ati
en: 36 And he took a child, and set him in the midst of them: and when he had taken him in his arms, he said unto them,
37 Whosoever shall receive one of such children in my name, receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me, receiveth not me, but him that sent me.
38 And John answered him, saying, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name, and he followeth not us: and we forbad him, because he followeth not us.

rr: 39 Yesu yaamugarukamu ati: Mutamuzibira; ahakuba tihaine muntu weena okora eky'okutangaaza omu iziina ryangye, oribaasa kuhinduka juba, akangamba kubi
en: 39 But Jesus said, Forbid him not: for there is no man which shall do a miracle in my name, that can lightly speak evil of me.
40 For he that is not against us is on our part.
41 For whosoever shall give you a cup of water to drink in my name, because ye belong to Christ, verily I say unto you, he shall not lose his reward.

rr: 42 Omuntu weena orireetera omwe ahari abo bato abarikuunyikiriza kukora ekibi, haakiri ogwo okubohwa orubengo omu bitsya, akanagwa omu nyanja.
en: 42 And whosoever shall offend one of these little ones that believe in me, it is better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he were cast into the sea.

rr: 43 Omukono gwawe ku guraabe nigukureetera kukora ekibi, ogutemeho; haakiri iwe okutaaha omu magara ori ekimuga, okukira okuza Gehena omu muriro ogutaraara, oine emikono yombi
en: 43 And if thy hand offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter into life maimed, than having two hands to go into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:

rr: 44 ahu enyogori zaabo zitafa, n'ahu omuriro gutaraara.
en: 44 where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.

rr: 45 N'ekigyere kyawe ku kiraabe nikikureetera kukora ekibi, okitemeho; haakiri iwe okutaaha omu magara ori ekimuga, okukira okuza Gehena oine ebigyere byombi
en: 45 And if thy foot offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter halt into life, than having two feet to be cast into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:

rr: 46 ahu enyogori zaabo zitafa, n'ahu omuriro gutaraara.
en: 46 where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.
47 And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out: it is better for thee to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye, than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire:
48 where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.

rr: 49 Buri muntu aryabugwamu omuriro nk'oku omwonyo guhika omu by'okurya.
en: 49 For every one shall be salted with fire, and every sacrifice shall be salted with salt.
50 Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his saltness, wherewith will ye season it? Have salt in yourselves, and have peace one with another.
1 And he arose from thence, and cometh into the coasts of Judæa by the farther side of Jordan: and the people resort unto him again; and, as he was wont, he taught them again.

rr: 2 Kandi Abafarisaayo baija ah'ari, baamubuuza nibamutega bati: Beitu Ebiragiro biikiriza omuntu kushenda omukazi we?
en: 2 And the Pharisees came to him, and asked him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife? tempting him.

rr: 3 Yaabagarukamu ati: Musa akabaragiira ata?
en: 3 And he answered and said unto them, What did Moses command you?
4 And they said, Moses suffered to write a bill of divorcement, and to put her away.

rr: 5 Yesu yaabagira ati: Eki yaabahereire ekiragiro ekyo n'ahabw'obugangaazi bw'omu mitima yaanyu
en: 5 And Jesus answered and said unto them, For the hardness of your heart he wrote you this precept.

rr: 6 kwonka okuruga aha kuhangwa kw'ensi, Ruhanga akahanga omushaija n'omukazi.
en: 6 But from the beginning of the creation God made them male and female.
7 For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and cleave to his wife;

rr: 8 n'abo bombi bakahinduka omuntu omwe; baba batakiri babiri kureka omwe.
en: 8 and they twain shall be one flesh: so then they are no more twain, but one flesh.

rr: 9 N'ahabw'ekyo eki Ruhanga yaateeraine hamwe, omuntu atarikitaanisa.
en: 9 What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.

rr: 10 Ku baabaire bari omu nju, abeegi be baagaruka baamubuuza aha kigambo ekyo.
en: 10 And in the house his disciples asked him again of the same matter .
11 And he saith unto them, Whosoever shall put away his wife, and marry another, committeth adultery against her.

rr: 12 n'omukazi ku aritaana na iba, yaashwerwa ondi, biri ashambaine.
en: 12 And if a woman shall put away her husband, and be married to another, she committeth adultery.
13 And they brought young children to him, that he should touch them: and his disciples rebuked those that brought them .

rr: 14 Kwonka Yesu ku yaakireebire, yaabagwerwa kubi, yaabagira ati: Murekye abaana bato baije ahariinye, mutabazibira; ahabw'okuba obukama bwa Ruhanga n'obw'abari nk'abo.
en: 14 But when Jesus saw it , he was much displeased, and said unto them, Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.
15 Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child, he shall not enter therein.

rr: 16 yaabakiikira, yaabaha omugisha, abataireho engaro.
en: 16 And he took them up in his arms, put his hands upon them, and blessed them.
17 And when he was gone forth into the way, there came one running, and kneeled to him, and asked him, Good Master, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?

rr: 18 Yesu yaamugarukamu ati: Noonyetera ki omurungi? Tihariho murungi, kureka Ruhanga wenka.
en: 18 And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is , God.

rr: 19 Noomanya ebiragiro, Otariita, Otarishambana, Otariiba, Otaribeiherera ondiijo, Otarigobya, Otiine sho na nyoko.
en: 19 Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Defraud not, Honour thy father and mother.

rr: 20 Omushaija yaamugarukamu ati: Mwegyesa, ebyo byona nkabyerinda okuruga omu buto bwangye.
en: 20 And he answered and said unto him, Master, all these have I observed from my youth.

21 Then Jesus beholding him loved him, and said unto him, One thing thou lackest: go thy way, sell whatsoever thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, take up the cross, and follow me.

rr: 22 Ku yaahuriire ebyo, yaahinduriza ahamaisho, yaagyenda aine enaku nying, ahabw'okuba akaba aine eitungo ringi.
en: 22 And he was sad at that saying, and went away grieved: for he had great possessions.

rr: 23 Yesu nikwo kubabuzyamu amaisho, akagira abeegi be ati: Ka nikiremeera abatungi okutaaha omu bukama bwa Ruhanga!
en: 23 And Jesus looked round about, and saith unto his disciples, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!
24 And the disciples were astonished at his words. But Jesus answereth again, and saith unto them, Children, how hard is it for them that trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of God!

rr: 25 Nikirahuka engamira okuraba omu nyindo y'empitirizo, okukira omuntungi okutaaha omu bukama bwa Ruhanga.
en: 25 It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

rr: 26 Baatangaara munonga, baamubuuza bati: Mbwenu shi hoona, n'oha orikubaasa kujunwa?
en: 26 And they were astonished out of measure, saying among themselves, Who then can be saved?
27 And Jesus looking upon them saith, With men it is impossible, but not with God: for with God all things are possible.

rr: 28 Petero nikwo kumugambira ati: Reeba itwe tukatsigaho byona, twakukuratira!
en: 28 Then Peter began to say unto him, Lo, we have left all, and have followed thee.

rr: 29 Yesu yaamugarukamu ati: Buzimazima nimbagambira nti: Tihaine muntu owaatsigireho enju, beene ishe, banyaanya, nyina, ishe, abaana, nari ekibanja kye ahabwangye n'ahabw'engiri
en: 29 And Jesus answered and said, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my sake, and the gospel's,

rr: 30 otariheebwa omu biro bya hati ebirikukira ebyo emirungi igana, enju, beene ishe, banyaanya, baanyina, abaana, ebibanja, hamwe n'okuhiigwa, kandi omu biro bya bwanyima akaheebwa amagara agatahwaho.
en: 30 but he shall receive an hundredfold now in this time, houses, and brethren, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and lands, with persecutions; and in the world to come eternal life.

rr: 31 Kwonka baingi ab'okubanza baryaba aba bwanyima, n'aba bwanyima baryaba ab'okubanza.
en: 31 But many that are first shall be last; and the last first.

32 And they were in the way going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus went before them: and they were amazed; and as they followed, they were afraid. And he took again the twelve, and began to tell them what things should happen unto him,

rr: 33 ati: Reeba, nitwinamuka Yerusaalemu; Omwana w'omuntu aryaheebwayo aha banyamaurwa abakuru n'abahandiiki; baryamucwera orubanja rw'okumwita, bamuheyo aha Banyamahanga
en: 33 saying , Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be delivered unto the chief priests, and unto the scribes; and they shall condemn him to death, and shall deliver him to the Gentiles:

rr: 34 baryamushungisa, bamucwere amacwante; baryamwasha, baryamwita; kandi aryazooka bwanyima y'ebiro bishatu.
en: 34 and they shall mock him, and shall scourge him, and shall spit upon him, and shall kill him: and the third day he shall rise again.
35 And James and John, the sons of Zebedee, come unto him, saying, Master, we would that thou shouldest do for us whatsoever we shall desire.

rr: 36 Yaabagarukamu ati: Nimwenda ngu mbakorere ki?
en: 36 And he said unto them, What would ye that I should do for you?

rr: 37 Baamugarukamu bati: Twikirize omwe ashutame aha rubaju rwawe rwa buryo, n'ondi aha rwa bumohso omu kitiinisa kyawe.
en: 37 They said unto him, Grant unto us that we may sit, one on thy right hand, and the other on thy left hand, in thy glory.
38 But Jesus said unto them, Ye know not what ye ask: can ye drink of the cup that I drink of? and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?
39 And they said unto him, We can. And Jesus said unto them, Ye shall indeed drink of the cup that I drink of; and with the baptism that I am baptized withal shall ye be baptized:

rr: 40 Kwonka okushutama aha rubaju rwangye rwa buryo nari shi aha rwa bumohso, tiinye nkuha; kureka n'okwabo abaakucumiirwe.
en: 40 but to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give; but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared.

rr: 41 Kandi eikumi ku baakihuriire, baatandika kugwerwa kubi Yakobo na Yohaana.
en: 41 And when the ten heard it , they began to be much displeased with James and John.
42 But Jesus called them to him , and saith unto them, Ye know that they which are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and their great ones exercise authority upon them.

rr: 43 Kwonka omuriimwe tikwo kiriba; weena oryenda kuba omukuru omuriimwe, ashemereire kuba omuheereza waanyu
en: 43 But so shall it not be among you: but whosoever will be great among you, shall be your minister:

rr: 44 n'oryenda kuba ow'okubanza omuriimwe, ashemereire kuba omuhuuku wa boona.
en: 44 and whosoever of you will be the chiefest, shall be servant of all.

rr: 45 Ahabw'okuba omu mazima Omwana w'omuntu taraizire kuheerezibwa, kureka okuheereza abandi, n'okuhayo amagara ge okucungura baingi.
en: 45 For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
46 And they came to Jericho: and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people, blind Bartimæus, the son of Timæus, sat by the highway side begging.

rr: 47 Ku yaahuriire ngu orikwija ni Yesu owa Nazareesi, yaatandika kwamuza n'eiraka rihango, naagira ati: Yesu, omwana wa Daudi, ongirire embabazi!
en: 47 And when he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out, and say, Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.

rr: 48 Kandi baingi baamuteisa, ngu acureere; kwonka we yaagumizamu naagamba munonga ati: Mwana wa Daudi, ongirire embabazi!
en: 48 And many charged him that he should hold his peace: but he cried the more a great deal, Thou Son of David, have mercy on me.

rr: 49 Yesu yaayemerera, yaagira ati: Nimumwete.
en: 49 And Jesus stood still, and commanded him to be called.

rr: Baamweta, baamugambira bati: Huumura; imuka, naakweta.
en: And they call the blind man, saying unto him, Be of good comfort, rise; he calleth thee.

rr: 50 Nawe yaanaga omwenda gwe, yaabandatuka, yaija ahari Yesu.
en: 50 And he, casting away his garment, rose, and came to Jesus.

rr: 51 Yesu yaamubuuza ati: Nooyenda ngu nkukorere ki? Ogwo mushaija yaamugarukamu ati: # 10:51 Rabooni, amakuru ngu, Mwegyesa. Rabooni, niinyenda ngu mpumuukye.
en: 51 And Jesus answered and said unto him, What wilt thou that I should do unto thee? The blind man said unto him, Lord, that I might receive my sight.

rr: 52 Yesu yaamwikiriza ati: Irooko, okwikiriza kwawe nikwo kwakukiza.
en: 52 And Jesus said unto him, Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole.

rr: Ahonaaho yaahumuuka, yaamukuratira omu muhanda.
en: And immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus in the way.
1 And when they came nigh to Jerusalem, unto Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount of Olives, he sendeth forth two of his disciples,

rr: 2 yaabagira ati: Mugyende omu kirorero ekibari omumaisho; ahonaaho ku muraataahemu, nimwija kushangamu omwana gw'endogoya gutsibikire, ogutakatembwahoga muntu; mugutsibure, mugundeetere.
en: 2 and saith unto them, Go your way into the village over against you: and as soon as ye be entered into it, ye shall find a colt tied, whereon never man sat; loose him, and bring him .

rr: 3 Omuntu weena, ku araababuuze ati: Nimugutsiburira ki? imwe mugarukyemu muti, Mukama waitu naagwenda, kandi naija kugugarura juba.
en: 3 And if any man say unto you, Why do ye this? say ye that the Lord hath need of him; and straightway he will send him hither.

rr: 4 Batyo baagyenda, baashanga omwana gw'endogoya gutsibikire aha irembo aha rubaju rw'omuhanda; baagutsibura.
en: 4 And they went their way, and found the colt tied by the door without in a place where two ways met; and they loose him.

rr: 5 Kandi bamwe aha baabaire beemereire aho, baababuza bati: Nimukora ki okutsibura omwana gw'endogoya?
en: 5 And certain of them that stood there said unto them, What do ye, loosing the colt?

rr: 6 Baabagarukamu nk'oku Yesu yaabagambira; baabareka.
en: 6 And they said unto them even as Jesus had commanded: and they let them go.

rr: 7 Baareetera Yesu omwana gw'endogoya, baagutaho ebijwaro byabo; Yesu yaagutembaho.
en: 7 And they brought the colt to Jesus, and cast their garments on him; and he sat upon him.

rr: 8 Baingi baayarira ebijwaro byabo omu nguuto, abandi amababi agu baihire omu misiri.
en: 8 And many spread their garments in the way: and others cut down branches off the trees, and strawed them in the way.
9 And they that went before, and they that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna; Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord:

rr: 10 Obugabe oburikwija obwa tatenkuriitwe Daudi busiimwe! Hosana ahaiguru munonga!
en: 10 Blessed be the kingdom of our father David, that cometh in the name of the Lord: Hosanna in the highest.
11 And Jesus entered into Jerusalem, and into the temple: and when he had looked round about upon all things, and now the eventide was come, he went out unto Bethany with the twelve.

rr: 12 Omu kasheeshe, ku baabaire bahika omu muhanda nibaruga Besania, yaagira enjara.
en: 12 And on the morrow, when they were come from Bethany, he was hungry:

rr: 13 Ku yaareebire hangahari omutiini oguriho amababi, yaagyenda yaaguhikaho, ngu akaagira eki yaagushangaho. Kwonka ku yaaguhikireho, tiyaashangaho kantu kureka omubengyeyo gw'amababi, ahabw'okuba bukaba butari bunaku bw'okwana.
en: 13 and seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came, if haply he might find any thing thereon: and when he came to it, he found nothing but leaves; for the time of figs was not yet .

rr: 14 Yaagugira ati: Okuruga hati okuhitsya ebiro byona hatarigira omuntu owaarya aha byana byawe. N'abeegi be baakihurira.
en: 14 And Jesus answered and said unto it, No man eat fruit of thee hereafter for ever. And his disciples heard it .

15 And they come to Jerusalem: and Jesus went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves;

rr: 16 kandi tiyaikiriza muntu weena kurabya omuri hekalu eikintu akyekoreire.
en: 16 and would not suffer that any man should carry any vessel through the temple.
17 And he taught, saying unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer? but ye have made it a den of thieves.

rr: 18 Abanyamurwa abakuru n'abahandiiki, ku baakihuriire, baacwa obwengye oku baraamwite; kwonka baamutiina, ahabw'okuba abantu boona bakaba nibatangaarira okwegyesa kwe.
en: 18 And the scribes and chief priests heard it , and sought how they might destroy him: for they feared him, because all the people was astonished at his doctrine.

rr: 19 Kandi ku bwabaire bwira, aruga omu rurembo.
en: 19 And when even was come, he went out of the city.

rr: 20 Kandi ku baabaire nibahingura omu kasheeshe akandi, baareeba ogwo mutiini gwomire okwiha omu mizi.
en: 20 And in the morning, as they passed by, they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots.

rr: 21 Petero yaijuka ekibaireho, yaagira Yesu ati: Rabi, reeba omutiini ogu okyeenire gwomire!
en: 21 And Peter calling to remembrance saith unto him, Master, behold, the fig tree which thou cursedst is withered away.

rr: 22 Yesu yaabagarukamu naagira ati: Mwesigye Ruhanga!
en: 22 And Jesus answering saith unto them, Have faith in God.

23 For verily I say unto you, That whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass; he shall have whatsoever he saith.
24 Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them , and ye shall have them .

rr: 25 Obutoosha ku muraagume mwayemerera nimushaba, mwaba mwine ekigambo aha muntu weena, mumusaasire; na Shoimwe ori omu iguru abone kubasaasira eby'okushiisha byanyu.
en: 25 And when ye stand praying, forgive, if ye have ought against any: that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.
26 But if ye do not forgive, neither will your Father which is in heaven forgive your trespasses.
27 And they come again to Jerusalem: and as he was walking in the temple, there come to him the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders,

rr: 28 baamubuuza bati: Ni bushoboorozi ki oburikukukoresa ebi, nari shi n'oha owaakuhaire obushoboorozi obu kubikora?
en: 28 and say unto him, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority to do these things?

rr: 29 Yesu yaabagarukamu ati: Reka naanye mbabuuze ekigambo kimwe; haza mungarukyemu, naanye mbone kubahsobororera obushoboorozi oburikunkoresa ebi.
en: 29 And Jesus answered and said unto them, I will also ask of you one question, and answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.

rr: 30 Okubatiza kwa Yohaana kukaruga omu iguru nari omu bantu? Mungarukyemu.
en: 30 The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men? answer me.

rr: 31 Baayegarukanamu nibagira bati: Ku turaagire tuti, Kukaruga omu iguru, naatugarukamu ati: Kandi shi, n'enki ekyabazibiire kumwikiriza?
en: 31 And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then did ye not believe him?

rr: 32 Tugire tuti, Kukaruga omu bantu? –baatiina abantu, ahakuba abantu boona bakaba nibahamya ngu Yohaana ni nabi buzima.
en: 32 But if we shall say, Of men; they feared the people: for all men counted John, that he was a prophet indeed.

rr: 33 Baamugarukamu bati: Titurikuhamanya.
en: 33 And they answered and said unto Jesus, We cannot tell.

rr: Yesu nikwo kubagira ati: Naanye tindikubagambira bushoboorozi oburikunkoresa ebi.
en: And Jesus answering saith unto them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.

1 And he began to speak unto them by parables. A certain man planted a vineyard, and set an hedge about it , and digged a place for the winefat, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country.

rr: 2 Mbwenu obunaku bw'okwera ku bwahikire, yaatuma omuhuuku we ahari abo bahingi, ngu bamutwekyere aha byana by'emizaabibu.
en: 2 And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant, that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard.

rr: 3 Abahingi baamukwata, baamuteera, baamubinga, yaagarukayo atabiine.
en: 3 And they caught him , and beat him, and sent him away empty.

rr: 4 Yaagaruka yaabatumaho ondiijo muhuuku; ogwo baamuhutaaza omutwe, baamuhemangura.
en: 4 And again he sent unto them another servant; and at him they cast stones, and wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully handled.

rr: 5 Nabwo yaagaruka yaabatumaho ondiijo, ogwo baamwita; n'abandi baingi, abamwe baabateera, abandi baabaita.
en: 5 And again he sent another; and him they killed, and many others; beating some, and killing some.

rr: 6 Kwonka akaba atsigaize omutabani ou arikukunda; yaamubatumaho bwanyima, naagira ati: Omwana wangye baryamuha ekitiinisa.
en: 6 Having yet therefore one son, his wellbeloved, he sent him also last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.

rr: 7 Kwonka abo bahingi baagambirana bonka nibagira bati: ogu niwe muhunguzi; murekye tumwite, n'obuhunguzi buryaba obwaitu.
en: 7 But those husbandmen said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be our's.
8 And they took him, and killed him , and cast him out of the vineyard.

rr: 9 Mbwenu mukama w'emizaabibu aryakora ki? Aryaija, acwekyereze abo bahingi, n'omusiri gw'emizaabibu aguheereze abandi.
en: 9 What shall therefore the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others.
10 And have ye not read this scripture;

rr: 11 Ekyo kikaruga ahari Mukama
en: 11 This was the Lord's doing,

rr: 12 Baacwa obwengye oku baraamukwate, ahakuba bakamanya ku nibo yaaba naaregyeza omu kucwa enfumu egyo; kwonka baatiina abantu, baamureka, baagyenda.
en: 12 And they sought to lay hold on him, but feared the people: for they knew that he had spoken the parable against them: and they left him, and went their way.
13 And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, to catch him in his words.

rr: 14 Baija baamugira bati: Mwegyesa, nitumanya ku ori ow'amazima, kandi togwera rubaju rw'omuntu weeena orutahikire, ahabw'okuba totiinisibwa kitiinisa ky'omuntu, kureka oyegyesa omuhanda gwa Ruhanga omu mazima. Ebiragiro nibiikiriza kuha Kaisaari omushoro, nari tikwo?
en: 14 And when they were come, they say unto him, Master, we know that thou art true, and carest for no man: for thou regardest not the person of men, but teachest the way of God in truth: Is it lawful to give tribute to Cæsar, or not?

rr: 15 Tushore, nari turereere? Kwonka ku yaamanyire oburyarya bwabo, yaabagira ati: Nimuntegyera ki? Mundeetere edenaari, ngireebe.
en: 15 Shall we give, or shall we not give? But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said unto them, Why tempt ye me? bring me a penny, that I may see it .

rr: 16 Baagireeta.
en: 16 And they brought it .

rr: Yaababuuza ati: Ekishishani eki n'ebihandiikirweho n'eby'oha?
en: And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription?

rr: Baamugarukamu bati: N'ebya Kaisaari.
en: And they said unto him, Cæsar's.
17 And Jesus answering said unto them, Render to Cæsar the things that are Cæsar's, and to God the things that are God's. And they marvelled at him.
18 Then come unto him the Sadducees, which say there is no resurrection; and they asked him, saying,
19 Master, Moses wrote unto us, If a man's brother die, and leave his wife behind him , and leave no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

rr: 20 Mbwenu hakaba hariho enyine-emwe mushanju; mukuru waabo akashwera omukazi; yaafa atakazaire nawe.
en: 20 Now there were seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed.

rr: 21 Omurumuna yaamuhungura, nawe yaafa atakazaire; n'owa kashatu atyo.
en: 21 And the second took her, and died, neither left he any seed: and the third likewise.

rr: 22 Boona omushanju baafa batakazaire nawe. Bwanyima omukazi ogwo nawe yaabakurata, yaafa.
en: 22 And the seven had her, and left no seed: last of all the woman died also.

rr: 23 Mbwenu omu kuzooka aryaba muka oha? Ahakuba boona omushanju bakamushwera.
en: 23 In the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise, whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.

rr: 24 Yesu yaabagarukamu ati: Ekibahabisa t'okutamanya Byahandiikirwe, n'obu gaakuba amaani ga Ruhanga?
en: 24 And Jesus answering said unto them, Do ye not therefore err, because ye know not the scriptures, neither the power of God?

rr: 25 Ahakuba omu kuzooka tibarishwera, kandi tibarishwerwa, kureka baryaba nka baamaraika ab'omu iguru.
en: 25 For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as the angels which are in heaven.
26 And as touching the dead, that they rise: have ye not read in the book of Moses, how in the bush God spake unto him, saying, I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?

rr: 27 Ruhanga ti Ruhanga w'abafu, kureka ow'abahuriire. Muhabire munonga.
en: 27 He is not the God of the dead, but the God of the living: ye therefore do greatly err.
28 And one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, and perceiving that he had answered them well, asked him, Which is the first commandment of all?
29 And Jesus answered him, The first of all the commandments is , Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God is one Lord:

rr: 30 okunda Mukama Ruhanga waawe n'omutima gwawe gwona, n'amagara gaawe goona, n'obwengye bwawe bwona, kandi n'amaani gaawe goona.
en: 30 and thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this is the first commandment.
31 And the second is like, namely this, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.

rr: 32 Omuhandiiki yaamugarukamu ati: Haza kwo, Mwegyesa, waagamba gye okugira oti, n'Omwe, kandi oti, Tihariho ondiijo kureka We wenka
en: 32 And the scribe said unto him, Well, Master, thou hast said the truth: for there is one God; and there is none other but he:

33 and to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbour as himself, is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.

rr: 34 Yesu ku yaahuriire yaamugarukamu n'okwetegyereza, yaamugira ati: Tori hare n'obukama bwa Ruhanga.
en: 34 And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly, he said unto him, Thou art not far from the kingdom of God.

rr: Okuruga aho tihaine owaagarukire kumuturukirira kumubuuza.
en: And no man after that durst ask him any question .
35 And Jesus answered and said, while he taught in the temple, How say the scribes that Christ is the son of David?
36 For David himself said by the Holy Ghost,

rr: 37 Beitu shi, Daudi we wenka ku araabe amweta Mukama we, kandi naabaasa ata kuba omwana we? Omutwe gw'abantu ab'obutoosha gwamuhurira gushemereirwe.
en: 37 David therefore himself calleth him Lord; and whence is he then his son? And the common people heard him gladly.
38 And he said unto them in his doctrine, Beware of the scribes, which love to go in long clothing, and love salutations in the marketplaces,

rr: 39 n'okushutama aha bitebe by'ekitiinisa omuri sinagogi, n'emyanya y'ekitiinisa omu magyenyi
en: 39 and the chief seats in the synagogues, and the uppermost rooms at feasts:

rr: 40 kandi abanyaga enju z'abafaakazi, bakarandagatana omu kushaba, haza nibaryarya. Abo baryacwerwa orubanja rorurikukira obuhango.
en: 40 which devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater damnation.
41 And Jesus sat over against the treasury, and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.

rr: 42 Bwanyima haija omufaakazi omworo, yaatamu obwoma bubiri oburikwingana sente ibiri.
en: 42 And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two mites, which make a farthing.

rr: 43 Yesu yaayeta abeegi be, yaabagira ati: Buzimazima nimbagambira nti: Omufaakazi oriya omworo yaatamu bingi okukira bariya boona abaheereza ebiconco.
en: 43 And he called unto him his disciples, and saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor widow hath cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury:
44 for all they did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, even all her living.
1 And as he went out of the temple, one of his disciples saith unto him, Master, see what manner of stones and what buildings are here!

rr: 2 Yesu yaamugira ati: Nooreeba ebyombeko ebi ku biri bihango? Kwonka tihariho ibaare eriritsigara riri aha rindi eritarinagwa hansi.
en: 2 And Jesus answering said unto him, Seest thou these great buildings? there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

rr: 3 Ku yaabaire ashutami omu kibungo kya Zeituuni ahashungaine na hekalu, Petero na Yakobo na Yohaana na Anderea baamubuuza omu mubonano, nibagira bati
en: 3 And as he sat upon the mount of Olives over against the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately,

rr: 4 Tugambire ebi ahu biribeeraho, kandi ni kamanyiso ki akaryoreka obunaku obu ebi byona birihikiirizibwamu?
en: 4 Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled?

rr: 5 Yesu yaatandika kubagarukamu ati: Mwerinde hatarigira omuntu weena owaabahabisa.
en: 5 And Jesus answering them began to say, Take heed lest any man deceive you:

rr: 6 Baingi baryaija omu iziina ryangye nibagira bati: Niinye Kristo! Kandi baryahabisa baingi.
en: 6 for many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ ; and shall deceive many.

rr: 7 Ku murihurira engamba n'okurangaanwa kwazo, mutaritiina; ebyo bishemereire kubaho; kwonka emperu yo eryaba etakahikire.
en: 7 And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars, be ye not troubled: for such things must needs be; but the end shall not be yet.
8 For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be famines and troubles: these are the beginnings of sorrows.

9 But take heed to yourselves: for they shall deliver you up to councils; and in the synagogues ye shall be beaten: and ye shall be brought before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them.

rr: 10 Kandi engiri eshemereire kubanza kubuurirwa omu mahanga goona.
en: 10 And the gospel must first be published among all nations.

rr: 11 Ku bariba nibabatwara omu manja, baabahayo, mutaryeremeza omutima ahabw'ebi murigamba; ahakuba tiimwe muryegambisa kureka Omwoyo Orikwera.
en: 11 But when they shall lead you , and deliver you up, take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak, neither do ye premeditate: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak ye: for it is not ye that speak, but the Holy Ghost.
12 Now the brother shall betray the brother to death, and the father the son; and children shall rise up against their parents, and shall cause them to be put to death.

rr: 13 kandi muryayangwa abantu boona nibabatura eiziina ryangye. Kwonka origumisiriza okuhitsya aha muheru, niwe arijunwa.
en: 13 And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.

14 But when ye shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not, (let him that readeth understand,) then let them that be in Judæa flee to the mountains:

rr: 15 n'ori aha mutwe gw'enju ataritemburuka, n'obu kuriba okutaahamu, ngu agire eki yaihamu
en: 15 and let him that is on the housetop not go down into the house, neither enter therein , to take any thing out of his house:

rr: 16 n'oriba ari omu misiri atarigarukayo kwenda omwenda gwe.
en: 16 and let him that is in the field not turn back again for to take up his garment.

rr: 17 Abariba baine enda n'abarikwontsya omu biro ebyo baryakareeba!
en: 17 But woe to them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!

rr: 18 Mushabe bitarihika mu biro by'embeho.
en: 18 And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter.
19 For in those days shall be affliction, such as was not from the beginning of the creation which God created unto this time, neither shall be.

rr: 20 Kuri Mukama ataracwire ha biro ebyo, tihaakurokokireho muntu weena; kwonka ahabw'entoore ezi yaatooraine akatuubya aha biro ebyo.
en: 20 And except that the Lord had shortened those days, no flesh should be saved: but for the elect's sake, whom he hath chosen, he hath shortened the days.

rr: 21 Omu biro ebyo omuntu weena ku aribagambira ati: Reeba, Kristo ari aha! nari shi, ari hariya! mutarimwikiriza
en: 21 And then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here is Christ; or, lo, he is there; believe him not:

rr: 22 ahakuba haryaimuka abarikweyeta Kristo na baanabi b'ebishuba, baryakora eby'okureeberaho n'eby'okutangaaza, babone kuhabisa n'entoore, kyaba nikibaasika.
en: 22 for false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall shew signs and wonders, to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.

rr: 23 Kwonka imwe mwerinde; naabagambira byona bitakahikire.
en: 23 But take ye heed: behold, I have foretold you all things.
24 But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,
25 and the stars of heaven shall fall, and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken.
26 And then shall they see the Son of man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.

rr: 27 Kandi aryatuma baamaraika be, ateerane entoore ze okuruga omu mbaju ina aha muheru gw'ensi, okuhika aha muheru gw'eiguru.
en: 27 And then shall he send his angels, and shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven.

rr: 28 Mbwenu mwegyere aha mutiini nk'eky'okureeberaho; eitaagi ryagwo, ku ryoroba, ryatooka amababi, mumanya omwaka ku guri haihi.
en: 28 Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When her branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is near:

rr: 29 Nikwo naimwe, ku murireeba ebyo byagyenda nibibaho, mumanye ku ari haihi, ku yaahikire n'aha rwigi.
en: 29 so ye in like manner, when ye shall see these things come to pass, know that it is nigh, even at the doors.

rr: 30 Buzimazima nibmagambira nti: Obusingye obu tiburihwaho okuhitsya obu ebi byona biribaho.
en: 30 Verily I say unto you, that this generation shall not pass, till all these things be done.

rr: 31 Eiguru n'ensi biryahwaho, kwonka ebigambo byangye tibirihwaho.
en: 31 Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.

rr: 32 Kwonka eby'ekiro ekyo n'obunaku obwo tihaine orikubimanya, n'obu baakuba baamaraika ab'omu iguru, n'obu yaakuba Omwana, kureka Ishe wenka.
en: 32 But of that day and that hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels which are in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.

rr: 33 Mwerinde, mugume nimureeba, kandi mushabe, ahakuba timurikumanya ahu obunaku obwo burihikira.
en: 33 Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.
34 For the Son of man is as a man taking a far journey, who left his house, and gave authority to his servants, and to every man his work, and commanded the porter to watch.

rr: 35 N'ahabw'ekyo mugume nimureeba, ahabw'okuba timurikumanya bunaku obu mukama w'eka ariiziramu, yaaba mu mwabazyo, nari omu itumbi, nari enkoko nizigamba, nari omu kasheeshe
en: 35 Watch ye therefore: for ye know not when the master of the house cometh, at even, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the morning:

rr: 36 atakaija kitaraariire, akashanga mugwejegyeire.
en: 36 lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping.

rr: 37 Eki ndikubagambira imwe, nikyo ngambira boona, nti: Mugume nimureeba!
en: 37 And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.
1 After two days was the feast of the passover, and of unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him by craft, and put him to death.

rr: 2 kwonka baagira bati: Turekye kumukwatira omu bugyenyi, hatabaho okwimukirira omu bantu.
en: 2 But they said, Not on the feast day , lest there be an uproar of the people.

3 And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at meat, there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of spikenard very precious; and she brake the box, and poured it on his head.

rr: 4 Abamwe aha baabaire bariho baaguubwa kubi, nibagira bati: Amajuta aga gaafa ki?
en: 4 And there were some that had indignation within themselves, and said, Why was this waste of the ointment made?

rr: 5 Nangwa kuri gaagurwamu edenaari ezirikushaaga magana ashatu, zikagabirwa abooro!
en: 5 For it might have been sold for more than three hundred pence, and have been given to the poor.

rr: Baamwetomboitera.
en: And they murmured against her.

rr: 6 Kwonka Yesu yaagira ati: Mumurekye; nimumugwisiza ki kubi? Eki yankorera ni kirungi
en: 6 And Jesus said, Let her alone; why trouble ye her? she hath wrought a good work on me.

rr: 7 ahabw'okuba abooro mutuura nabo obutoosha; nimubaasa kubakorera gye, mwaba nimwenda; kwonka nyowe timuriguma naanye obutoosha.
en: 7 For ye have the poor with you always, and whensoever ye will ye may do them good: but me ye have not always.

rr: 8 Yaakora nk'oku arikubaasa; yaabanza kunsiiga amajuta kuteekateeka omubiri gwangye, ntakaziikirwe.
en: 8 She hath done what she could: she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying.

rr: 9 Buzimazima nimbagambira nti: Engiri ei erigambwa hoona omu nsi yoona, n'eki omukazi ogu yaakora kiryagambwayo kumwijuka.
en: 9 Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world, this also that she hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.
10 And Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went unto the chief priests, to betray him unto them.

rr: 11 Ku baakihuriire, baashemererwa, baaraganisa kumuha empiiha.
en: 11 And when they heard it , they were glad, and promised to give him money.

rr: Nawe yaasherura oburyo bw'okumureebya.
en: And he sought how he might conveniently betray him.
12 And the first day of unleavened bread, when they killed the passover, his disciples said unto him, Where wilt thou that we go and prepare that thou mayest eat the passover?

rr: 13 Yaatuma babiri aha beegi be, yaabagira ati: Mwirooko muze omu rurembo, okwo nimwija kubuganayo omushaija, ayekoreire enjoga y'amaizi; mumukuratire
en: 13 And he sendeth forth two of his disciples, and saith unto them, Go ye into the city, and there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water: follow him.

rr: 14 enju ei araataahemu yoona, mugambire nyineeka muti: Omwegyesa yaakutumaho, naakubuuza ngu, Ekishengye ky'abagyenyi kiri nkahi, omu araariire Okuhingurwaho n'abeegi be?
en: 14 And wheresoever he shall go in, say ye to the goodman of the house, The Master saith, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?

rr: 15 Naija kubooreka ekishengye kihango eky'ahaiguru ekicumirwe, ekirimu byona; mube nimwo mwatuteguurira.
en: 15 And he will shew you a large upper room furnished and prepared: there make ready for us.

rr: 16 Batyo abeegi baagyenda, baataaha omu rurembo, baashanga biri nk'oku yaabagambira; baatebeekanisa Okuhinguraho.
en: 16 And his disciples went forth, and came into the city, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
17 And in the evening he cometh with the twelve.
18 And as they sat and did eat, Jesus said, Verily I say unto you, One of you which eateth with me shall betray me.

rr: 19 Baatandika kushaasha bashobeirwe, baamubuuza omwe omwe nibagira bati: Niinye?
en: 19 And they began to be sorrowful, and to say unto him one by one, Is it I? and another said, Is it I?

rr: 20 Yaabagarukamu ati: N'omwe ahari aba ikumi na babiri orikukoza naanye omu rwabya.
en: 20 And he answered and said unto them, It is one of the twelve, that dippeth with me in the dish.

rr: 21 Omwana w'omuntu naija kugyenda, nk'oku kyamuhandiikirweho, kwonka orikumureebya aryakareeba. Kikaabaire kirungi nangwa kuri atarazairwe.
en: 21 The Son of man indeed goeth, as it is written of him: but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! good were it for that man if he had never been born.
22 And as they did eat, Jesus took bread, and blessed, and brake it , and gave to them, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.

rr: 23 Yaakwata ekikopo; ku yaaherize kusiima, yaakibaha, boona baanywaho.
en: 23 And he took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them: and they all drank of it.
24 And he said unto them, This is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many.

rr: 25 Buzimazima nimbagambira nti: Tindinywa ha byana by'emizaabibu okuhitsya aha kiro ekyo, obu ndibinywa biri bisya omu bukama bwa Ruhanga.
en: 25 Verily I say unto you, I will drink no more of the fruit of the vine, until that day that I drink it new in the kingdom of God.
26 And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.
27 And Jesus saith unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered.

rr: 28 Kwonka ku ndiheza kuzooka, ndyababandiza Galilaaya.
en: 28 But after that I am risen, I will go before you into Galilee.

rr: 29 Petero yaahiga naamugira ati: N'obu abandi boona baraakuhemukyeho, kwonka nyowe tindikwija kukuhemukaho.
en: 29 But Peter said unto him, Although all shall be offended, yet will not I.
30 And Jesus saith unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this day, even in this night, before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice.

rr: 31 Kwonka Petero yaayeyongyera kuhigira kimwe ati: N'obu naakuba ow'okwitwa naiwe, tindikwija kukwehakana na kakye.
en: 31 But he spake the more vehemently, If I should die with thee, I will not deny thee in any wise.

rr: N'abandi boona baagira batyo.
en: Likewise also said they all.
32 And they came to a place which was named Gethsemane: and he saith to his disciples, Sit ye here, while I shall pray.

rr: 33 Yaatwara Petero na Yakobo na Yohaana; yaatandika kugira obusaasi bwingi n'okushoberwa munonga.
en: 33 And he taketh with him Peter and James and John, and began to be sore amazed, and to be very heavy;
34 and saith unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death: tarry ye here, and watch.

rr: 35 Yairiraho kakye omumaisho, yaajuumara ahansi, yaashaba ngu, ku kiraabe nikibaasika, eshaaha egyo emuhingure.
en: 35 And he went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass from him.

rr: 36 Yaagira ati: # 14:36 Abba, amakuru gaakyo ngu, Taata. Abba, Taata, byona nibikubaasikira; onyiheho ekikopo eki; kwonka kitaba nk'oku nyowe ndikwenda, kureka nk'oku Iwe orikwenda.
en: 36 And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.

rr: 37 Yaagaruka, yaashanga bagwejegyeire, yaabuuza Petero ati: Simooni, ogwejegyeire? Waaremwa kwehangaana kureeba nangwa n'eshaaha emwe?
en: 37 And he cometh, and findeth them sleeping, and saith unto Peter, Simon, sleepest thou? couldest not thou watch one hour?

rr: 38 Mureebe mushabe, murekye kugwa omu kwohibwa; omutima gwo nigukunda, kwonka omubiri n'omweremwa.
en: 38 Watch ye and pray, lest ye enter into temptation. The spirit truly is ready, but the flesh is weak.

rr: 39 Yaakuba yaagarukayo, yaashaba ebigambo bimwe n'eby'okubanza.
en: 39 And again he went away, and prayed, and spake the same words.

rr: 40 Yaagaruka obwa kabiri, nabwo yaashanga bagwejegyeire, ahabw'okuba amaisho gaabo gakaba nigahungira, kandi tabaramanyire ki baraamugarukyemu.
en: 40 And when he returned, he found them asleep again, (for their eyes were heavy,) neither wist they what to answer him.

rr: 41 Yaagaruka omurindi gwa kashatu, yaabagira ati: Na hati mukigwejegyeire, muhuumwire? Okwo nikumara; obunaku bwahika, Omwana w'omuntu, yaaza kuheebwayo omu mikono y'abasiisi.
en: 41 And he cometh the third time, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: it is enough, the hour is come; behold, the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

rr: 42 Mwimukye, turugye aha; reba orikundeebya ari haihi.
en: 42 Rise up, let us go; lo, he that betrayeth me is at hand.
43 And immediately, while he yet spake, cometh Judas, one of the twelve, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders.

rr: 44 Kandi obwo owaabaire naamureebya akaba abahaire akamanyiso naagira ati: Ou ndaanywegyere, niwe ogwo, mumukwate, mumutware nimumurinda.
en: 44 And he that betrayed him had given them a token, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he; take him, and lead him away safely.

rr: 45 Ku yaizire, ahonaaho yaamuhikaho, yaagira ati: # 14:45 Rabbi: amakuru gaakyo ngu Mwegyesa. Rabi! Yaamunywegyera.
en: 45 And as soon as he was come, he goeth straightway to him, and saith, Master, master; and kissed him.

rr: 46 Baamugurukira, baamukwata.
en: 46 And they laid their hands on him, and took him.

rr: 47 Omwe aha baabaire beemereire aho yaasyorayo rurara ye, yaatema omuhuuku w'omunyamurwa omukuru, yaamucwaho okutu.
en: 47 And one of them that stood by drew a sword, and smote a servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

rr: 48 Yesu yaababuuza ati: Mwampururira kunkwata na zaarurara n'ebikoni, nk'oku bahururira omwambuzi?
en: 48 And Jesus answered and said unto them, Are ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and with staves to take me?

rr: 49 Ebiro byona nkaba ntuura naimwe, nimbeegyesa omuri hekalu, timurankwatsire. Kwonka eki kyabaho, ngu Ebyahandiikirwe bihikiirire.
en: 49 I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and ye took me not: but the scriptures must be fulfilled.

rr: 50 Okuruga aho abeegi be boona baamuhungaho, bairuka.
en: 50 And they all forsook him, and fled.

rr: 51 Kandi omutsigazi omwe yaamukuratira ajwaire omwenda gwa kitaani gwonka; nawe baamukwata
en: 51 And there followed him a certain young man, having a linen cloth cast about his naked body ; and the young men laid hold on him:

rr: 52 yaatsiga ogwo mwenda gwa kitaani, yaahunga ajwaire busha.
en: 52 and he left the linen cloth, and fled from them naked.

rr: 53 Okuruga aho baatwara Yesu aha munyamurwa omukuru; baashanga abanyamurwa abakuru n'abakuru b'abantu n'abahandiiki bateeraniireyo.
en: 53 And they led Jesus away to the high priest: and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.

rr: 54 Obwo Petero akaba amukuratiire naamugyenda hare, yaataaha omu kibuga ky'omunyamurwa omukuru, yaashutama n'abarinzi, yaayota omuriro.
en: 54 And Peter followed him afar off, even into the palace of the high priest: and he sat with the servants, and warmed himself at the fire.
55 And the chief priests and all the council sought for witness against Jesus to put him to death; and found none.

rr: 56 N'obu abaamubeihereire baabaire bari baingi, kwonka obwamushinja bwabo tiburashushaine.
en: 56 For many bare false witness against him, but their witness agreed not together.

rr: 57 Abamwe baimuka, baamubeiherera nibagira bati
en: 57 And there arose certain, and bare false witness against him, saying,
58 We heard him say, I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and within three days I will build another made without hands.

rr: 59 Obwamushinja bwabo obwo nabwo tibwashushana.
en: 59 But neither so did their witness agree together.

rr: 60 Omunyamurwa omukuru nikwo kwemerera ahagati yaabo, akabuuza Yesu ati: Toine ki orikwetonganira na kakye? Aba nibakwomesereza ki?
en: 60 And the high priest stood up in the midst, and asked Jesus, saying, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?
61 But he held his peace, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, and said unto him, Art thou the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?

rr: 62 Yesu yaagarukamu ati: Ndi We; naimwe muryareeba Omwana w'omuntu ashutami aha rubaju rwa buryo rw'Obushoboorozi, naizira omu bicu by'omu iguru.
en: 62 And Jesus said, I am: and ye shall see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.

rr: 63 Omunyamurwa omukuru yaataagura ebijwaro bye naagira ati: Kandi nitukyendera ki baamushinja abandi?
en: 63 Then the high priest rent his clothes, and saith, What need we any further witnesses?
64 Ye have heard the blasphemy: what think ye? And they all condemned him to be guilty of death.

rr: 65 Abamwe baatandika kumucwera amacwante, n'okumushweka omwenda aha maisho, n'okumuteera entomi, nibamugira bati: Ragura owaakuteera! N'abambari baamwakiira, bamuhikize aha mpi.
en: 65 And some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to buffet him, and to say unto him, Prophesy: and the servants did strike him with the palms of their hands.
66 And as Peter was beneath in the palace, there cometh one of the maids of the high priest:

rr: 67 yaareeba Petero naayota; yaamwetegyereza, yaamugira ati: Naiwe obaire ori hamwe na Yesu owa Nazareesi.
en: 67 and when she saw Peter warming himself, she looked upon him, and said, And thou also wast with Jesus of Nazareth.

rr: 68 Yaayehakana naagira ati: Tindikumanya ki orikugamba, n'obu kwakuba okukyetegyereza.
en: 68 But he denied, saying, I know not, neither understand I what thou sayest.

rr: Yaarugayo, yaaza omu irembo.
en: And he went out into the porch; and the cock crew.

rr: 69 Omuzaana ogwo yaamureeba, yaagaruka yaagambira abaabaire beemereireho ati: Omushaija ogwo n'omwe aharibo.
en: 69 And a maid saw him again, and began to say to them that stood by, This is one of them.

rr: 70 Petero yaagaruka yaayehakana.
en: 70 And he denied it again.

rr: Ku haahingwireho akaanya kakye, abaabaire beemereire aho baagauka baagira Petero bati: Buzima kwo ori omwe aharibo, ahabw'okuba ori Omunyagalilaaya.
en: And a little after, they that stood by said again to Peter, Surely thou art one of them: for thou art a Galilæan, and thy speech agreeth thereto .

rr: 71 We yaatandika kukyeena n'okurahira, naagira ati: Omuntu ogwo ou murikungambaho, tindikumumanya.
en: 71 But he began to curse and to swear, saying , I know not this man of whom ye speak.

rr: 72 Ahonaaho enkoko yaashubiira.
en: 72 And the second time the cock crew.

rr: Petero yaijuka ekigambo eki Yesu amugambiire ati: Enkoko etakashubiire, noija kuunyehakana kashatu.
en: And Peter called to mind the word that Jesus said unto him, Before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice.

rr: Ku yaijukire ekyo, yaarira.
en: And when he thought thereon, he wept.

rr: 1 Kandi ku bwabaire nibutaagurikana, abanyamurwa abakuru hamwe n'abakuru b'abantu n'abahandiiki n'ab'omu ishengyero boona, baaza omu naama; bwanyima baaboha Yesu, baamutwara, baamuhayo ahari Pilaato.
en: 1 And straightway in the morning the chief priests held a consultation with the elders and scribes and the whole council, and bound Jesus, and carried him away, and delivered him to Pilate.
2 And Pilate asked him, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answering said unto him, Thou sayest it .

rr: 3 Abanyamurwa abakuru baamutabaariza bingi.
en: 3 And the chief priests accused him of many things: but he answered nothing.

rr: 4 Pilaato yaagaruka yaamubuuza ati: Toine ki orikwetonganira na kakye? Ka baakutabaariza bingi!
en: 4 And Pilate asked him again, saying, Answerest thou nothing? behold how many things they witness against thee.

rr: 5 Nabwo Yesu tiyaagarukamu; n'ahabw'ekyo Pilaato yaatangaara.
en: 5 But Jesus yet answered nothing; so that Pilate marvelled.

rr: 6 Kandi aha bugyenyi nk'obwo akaba amanyiire kubarekurira embohe yoona ei baabaire bamushaba.
en: 6 Now at that feast he released unto them one prisoner, whomsoever they desired.

rr: 7 Kandi omu baagomire bakaita abantu, abaabaire babohirwe omu ikhome ahabw'obugomi obwo, hakaba harimu omushaija orikwetwa Barabba.
en: 7 And there was one named Barabbas, which lay bound with them that had made insurrection with him, who had committed murder in the insurrection.

rr: 8 Abantu baingi baija baatandika kushaba Pilaato kubagirira nk'oku ashangwa abagirira.
en: 8 And the multitude crying aloud began to desire him to do as he had ever done unto them.

rr: 9 Yaabagarukamu ati: Nimwenda ngu mbarekurire Omugabe w'Abayudaaya?
en: 9 But Pilate answered them, saying, Will ye that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
10 For he knew that the chief priests had delivered him for envy.

rr: 11 Kwonka abanyamurwa abakuru baashunika engabo z'abantu kugamba bati: Haakiri Barabba obe niwe waaturekurira.
en: 11 But the chief priests moved the people, that he should rather release Barabbas unto them.

rr: 12 Pilaato yaagaruka yaababuuza ati: Mbwenu shi, ngire nta Ogu ou murikweta Omugabe w'Abayudaaya?
en: 12 And Pilate answered and said again unto them, What will ye then that I shall do unto him whom ye call the King of the Jews?

rr: 13 Baagaruka baayomba munonga bati: Mubambe aha musharaba!
en: 13 And they cried out again, Crucify him.

rr: 14 Pilaato yaababuuza ati: Ahanki? ni kibi ki eki akozire? Baayeyongyera kuyomba munonga bati: Mubambe!
en: 14 Then Pilate said unto them, Why, what evil hath he done? And they cried out the more exceedingly, Crucify him.

rr: 15 Pilaato ahabw'okwenda kunanura ezo ngabo, yaabarekurira Barabba; ku yaaherize kwasha Yesu, yaamuhayo kubambwa.
en: 15 And so Pilate, willing to content the people, released Barabbas unto them, and delivered Jesus, when he had scourged him , to be crucified.

rr: 16 Bwanyima abaserukare baamutwara, baamutaasya omu kibuga ekirikwetwa Puratorio; baayeta omutwe gwona gwabaserukare.
en: 16 And the soldiers led him away into the hall, called Prætorium; and they call together the whole band.

rr: 17 Baamujweka omwenda gwa bujwa, baaruka ekirunga ky'amahwa, baakimujweka.
en: 17 And they clothed him with purple, and platted a crown of thorns, and put it about his head ,

rr: 18 Baatandika kumutangirira nibagira bati: Singa, Mugabe w'Abayudaaya!
en: 18 and began to salute him, Hail, King of the Jews!

rr: 19 Baamuhondesa ekibingo omu mutwe, baamucwera amacwante, baamutsimbira amaju nibamuramya.
en: 19 And they smote him on the head with a reed, and did spit upon him, and bowing their knees worshipped him.
20 And when they had mocked him, they took off the purple from him, and put his own clothes on him, and led him out to crucify him.
21 And they compel one Simon a Cyrenian, who passed by, coming out of the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to bear his cross.

rr: 22 Baatwara Yesu aharikwetwa Gologosa, (ekirikumanyisa ngu, Omwanya gw'empanga y'omutwe).
en: 22 And they bring him unto the place Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, The place of a skull.
23 And they gave him to drink wine mingled with myrrh: but he received it not.
24 And when they had crucified him, they parted his garments, casting lots upon them, what every man should take.

rr: 25 Baamubamba aha shaaha ya kashatu.
en: 25 And it was the third hour, and they crucified him.

rr: 26 Ekirangiriro ky'ebi baamurega baakihanika ahaiguru ye, ekihandiikirwe ngu, OMUGABE W'ABAYUDAAYA.
en: 26 And the superscription of his accusation was written over, THE KING OF THE JEWS.

rr: 27 Kandi baamubamba hamwe n'abambuzi babiri, omwe aha rubaju rwe rwa buryo, n'ondiijo aha rwa bumohso.
en: 27 And with him they crucify two thieves; the one on his right hand, and the other on his left.

rr: 28 Nikwo Ebyahandiikirwe byahikiriziibwe bityo ebirikugira ngu, Akabarirwa hamwe n'abasiisi.
en: 28 And the scripture was fulfilled, which saith, And he was numbered with the transgressors.
29 And they that passed by railed on him, wagging their heads, and saying, Ah, thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days,

rr: 30 yejune, ohanukye orugye aha musharaba.
en: 30 save thyself, and come down from the cross.

rr: 31 Kandi n'abanyamurwa abakuru nikwo baamuteereire batyo enaku, nibagambirana n'abahandiiki bati: Akajuna abandi; tarikubaasa kwejuna.
en: 31 Likewise also the chief priests mocking said among themselves with the scribes, He saved others; himself he cannot save.

rr: 32 Kristo, Omugabe wa Israeli, naarugye hati mbwenu aha musharaba, tukireebe twikirize.
en: 32 Let Christ the King of Israel descend now from the cross, that we may see and believe.

rr: Kandi abaabambiirwe hamwe nawe nabo baamuteeerera enaku.
en: And they that were crucified with him reviled him.
33 And when the sixth hour was come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.
34 And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?

rr: 35 Kandi abamwe aha baabaire beemereire aho, ku baakihuriire, baagira bati: Hurira, naayeta Eliya!
en: 35 And some of them that stood by, when they heard it , said, Behold, he calleth Elias.
36 And one ran and filled a spunge full of vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink, saying, Let alone; let us see whether Elias will come to take him down.

rr: 37 Yesu yaagamba n'eiraka rihango, yaahayo amagara ge.
en: 37 And Jesus cried with a loud voice, and gave up the ghost.

rr: 38 Omukingo gw'omuri hekalu gwataagukamu ebicweka bibiri okuruga aha mutwe gwagwo okuhika ahansi.
en: 38 And the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom.

rr: 39 Kandi omukuru w'abaserukare akaba ayemereire naamureeba; ku yaareebire yaahayo amagara ge atyo, yaagira ati: Buzima kwo omuntu ogu yaaba ori Omwana wa Ruhanga.
en: 39 And when the centurion, which stood over against him, saw that he so cried out, and gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.

rr: 40 Hakaba hariho n'abakazi beemereire nibareebera hangahari; omuri abo hakaba harimu Mariamu Magadaleene, na Mariamu nyina wa Yakobo omuto na Yose, na Saalome
en: 40 There were also women looking on afar off: among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;

rr: 41 abo nibo baabaire bamukuratira, nibamuheereza, akiri Galilaaya; kandi hakaba hariho n'abandi bakazi baingi abaagyenzire nawe Yerusaalemu.
en: 41 (who also, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and ministered unto him;) and many other women which came up with him unto Jerusalem.
42 And now when the even was come, because it was the preparation, that is, the day before the sabbath,

rr: 43 Yosefu owa Arimasaaya, omuhanuuzi w'ekitiinisa omu ishengyero, kandi owaabaire atuura ategyereize obukama bwa Ruhanga, yaatiinuuka, yaataaha owa Pilaato, yaashaba omutumbi gwa Yesu.
en: 43 Joseph of Arimathæa, an honourable counsellor, which also waited for the kingdom of God, came, and went in boldly unto Pilate, and craved the body of Jesus.

rr: 44 Pilaato yaatangaarira oku yaarahuka kukaba; yaatuma kweta omukuru w'abaserukare, yaamubuuza ku araabe yaakabire.
en: 44 And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead: and calling unto him the centurion, he asked him whether he had been any while dead.

rr: 45 Ku yaahamiziibwe omukuru w'abaserukare ku yaaheza kukaba, yaikiriza kuha Yosefu omutumbi.
en: 45 And when he knew it of the centurion, he gave the body to Joseph.

rr: 46 Yosefu yaagura omwenda gwa bafuta, yaahanura omutumbi, yaaguzinga omu mwenda ogwo gwa bafuta, yaaguta omu kituuro, ekyatimbirwe omu rukiri; yaakumbagaza eibaare, yaarikingisa omuryango gw'ekituuro.
en: 46 And he bought fine linen, and took him down, and wrapped him in the linen, and laid him in a sepulchre which was hewn out of a rock, and rolled a stone unto the door of the sepulchre.

rr: 47 Kandi Mariamu Magadaleene na Mariamu nyina wa Yose baayetegyereza ahu omutumbi gwe gwateebwa.
en: 47 And Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses beheld where he was laid.
1 And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, had bought sweet spices, that they might come and anoint him.

rr: 2 Omu kasheeshe munonga aha kiro ky'okubanza omu saabiiti baahika aha kituuro, eizooba ryaturukire
en: 2 And very early in the morning the first day of the week, they came unto the sepulchre at the rising of the sun.

rr: 3 nibabuuzana bati: N'oha oraatukumbagarize eibaare okuruga aha muryango gw'ekituuro?
en: 3 And they said among themselves, Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the sepulchre?

rr: 4 Ku baanagire amaisho, baareeba eibaare rikumbagaziibwe hangahari; ahakuba rikaba riri rihango munonga.
en: 4 And when they looked, they saw that the stone was rolled away: for it was very great.

rr: 5 Ku baataahire omu kituuro, baareeba omutsigazi ashutami aha rubaju rwa buryo, ajwaire omwenda gurikwera; baatangaara.
en: 5 And entering into the sepulchre, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, clothed in a long white garment; and they were affrighted.

rr: 6 Yaabagambira ati: Mutatangaara; nimusherura Yesu owa Nazareesi obambirwe. Yaazooka, tari aha; mureebe n'omwanya ahu babare bamutaire.
en: 6 And he saith unto them, Be not affrighted: Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth, which was crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold the place where they laid him.

rr: 7 Mbwenu mwirooko mugyende, mugambire abeegi be na Petero ngu, abeebembeire kuza Galilaaya; okwo niyo muraamushangye, nk'oku yaabagambiire.
en: 7 But go your way, tell his disciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee: there shall ye see him, as he said unto you.

rr: 8 Baashohora, baaruga aha kituuro nibahunga, ahakuba bakakwatwa orutetema n'okutangaara; kandi tibaine u bakigambiire, ahabw'okuba bakaba batiinire.
en: 8 And they went out quickly, and fled from the sepulchre; for they trembled and were amazed: neither said they any thing to any man ; for they were afraid.
9 Now when Jesus was risen early the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had cast seven devils.

rr: 10 We yaagyenda, yaagambira abu Yesu yaabaire atuura nabo, yaashanga nibaganya, nibarira.
en: 10 And she went and told them that had been with him, as they mourned and wept.

rr: 11 Kandi ku baagambiirwe ngu ariho ahuriire, kandi ngu yaareebwa Mariamu, tibaakiikiriza.
en: 11 And they, when they had heard that he was alive, and had been seen of her, believed not.
12 After that he appeared in another form unto two of them, as they walked, and went into the country.

rr: 13 Abo nabo baagaruka Yerusaalemu, baabigambira abeegi abandi; nabo tibaabaikiriza.
en: 13 And they went and told it unto the residue: neither believed they them.
14 Afterward he appeared unto the eleven as they sat at meat, and upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they believed not them which had seen him after he was risen.

rr: 15 Yaabagira ati: Mugyende omu nsi zoona, mubuurire engiri ebihangirwe byona.
en: 15 And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
16 He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that believeth not shall be damned.
17 And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall they cast out devils; they shall speak with new tongues;
18 they shall take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it shall not hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall recover.
19 So then after the Lord had spoken unto them, he was received up into heaven, and sat on the right hand of God.

rr: 20 Nabo baashohora, baagyenda hoona hoona nibabuurira ekigambo kya Ruhanga, Mukama waitu ari hamwe nabo naabakwatsa, kandi naahamya ekigambo ekyo n'obumanyiso obwabaire bukikomookaho.
en: 20 And they went forth, and preached every where, the Lord working with them , and confirming the word with signs following. Amen.
1 The burden of Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.
2 God is jealous, and the LORD revengeth; the LORD revengeth, and is furious; the LORD will take vengeance on his adversaries, and he reserveth wrath for his enemies.
3 The LORD is slow to anger, and great in power, and will not at all acquit the wicked: the LORD hath his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.
4 He rebuketh the sea, and maketh it dry, and drieth up all the rivers: Bashan languisheth, and Carmel, and the flower of Lebanon languisheth.
5 The mountains quake at him, and the hills melt, and the earth is burned at his presence, yea, the world, and all that dwell therein.
6 Who can stand before his indignation? and who can abide in the fierceness of his anger? his fury is poured out like fire, and the rocks are thrown down by him.
7 The LORD is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.
8 But with an overrunning flood he will make an utter end of the place thereof, and darkness shall pursue his enemies.
9 What do ye imagine against the LORD ? he will make an utter end: affliction shall not rise up the second time.
10 For while they be folden together as thorns, and while they are drunken as drunkards, they shall be devoured as stubble fully dry.
11 There is one come out of thee, that imagineth evil against the LORD , a wicked counsellor.
12 Thus saith the LORD ; Though they be quiet, and likewise many, yet thus shall they be cut down, when he shall pass through. Though I have afflicted thee, I will afflict thee no more.
13 For now will I break his yoke from off thee, and will burst thy bonds in sunder.

14 And the LORD hath given a commandment concerning thee, that no more of thy name be sown: out of the house of thy gods will I cut off the graven image and the molten image: I will make thy grave; for thou art vile.

15 Behold upon the mountains the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace! O Judah, keep thy solemn feasts, perform thy vows: for the wicked shall no more pass through thee; he is utterly cut off.
1 He that dasheth in pieces is come up before thy face: keep the munition, watch the way, make thy loins strong, fortify thy power mightily.
2 For the LORD hath turned away the excellency of Jacob, as the excellency of Israel: for the emptiers have emptied them out, and marred their vine branches.

rr: 3 Engabo z'amamanzi ge nizitukurikana
en: 3 The shield of his mighty men is made red, the valiant men are in scarlet: the chariots shall be with flaming torches in the day of his preparation, and the fir trees shall be terribly shaken.
4 The chariots shall rage in the streets, they shall justle one against another in the broad ways: they shall seem like torches, they shall run like the lightnings.
5 He shall recount his worthies: they shall stumble in their walk; they shall make haste to the wall thereof, and the defence shall be prepared.
6 The gates of the rivers shall be opened, and the palace shall be dissolved.
7 And Huzzab shall be led away captive, she shall be brought up, and her maids shall lead her as with the voice of doves, tabering upon their breasts.
8 But Nineveh is of old like a pool of water: yet they shall flee away. Stand, stand, shall they cry ; but none shall look back.

rr: 9 Nimunyagye efeeza, munyagye n'ezaabu!
en: 9 Take ye the spoil of silver, take the spoil of gold: for there is none end of the store and glory out of all the pleasant furniture.
10 She is empty, and void, and waste: and the heart melteth, and the knees smite together, and much pain is in all loins, and the faces of them all gather blackness.
11 Where is the dwelling of the lions, and the feedingplace of the young lions, where the lion, even the old lion, walked, and the lion's whelp, and none made them afraid?
12 The lion did tear in pieces enough for his whelps, and strangled for his lionesses, and filled his holes with prey, and his dens with ravin.

13 Behold, I am against thee, saith the LORD of hosts, and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword shall devour thy young lions: and I will cut off thy prey from the earth, and the voice of thy messengers shall no more be heard.
1 Woe to the bloody city! it is all full of lies and robbery; the prey departeth not;
2 the noise of a whip, and the noise of the rattling of the wheels, and of the pransing horses, and of the jumping chariots.

rr: 3 Abarikugyendera aha mbaraasi nibeeroha omu rugamba
en: 3 The horseman lifteth up both the bright sword and the glittering spear: and there is a multitude of slain, and a great number of carcases; and there is none end of their corpses; they stumble upon their corpses:
4 because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot, the mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations through her whoredoms, and families through her witchcrafts.
5 Behold, I am against thee, saith the LORD of hosts; and I will discover thy skirts upon thy face, and I will shew the nations thy nakedness, and the kingdoms thy shame.
6 And I will cast abominable filth upon thee, and make thee vile, and will set thee as a gazingstock.
7 And it shall come to pass, that all they that look upon thee shall flee from thee, and say, Nineveh is laid waste: who will bemoan her? whence shall I seek comforters for thee?
8 Art thou better than populous No, that was situate among the rivers, that had the waters round about it, whose rampart was the sea, and her wall was from the sea?
9 Ethiopia and Egypt were her strength, and it was infinite; Put and Lubim were thy helpers.

10 Yet was she carried away, she went into captivity: her young children also were dashed in pieces at the top of all the streets: and they cast lots for her honourable men, and all her great men were bound in chains.
11 Thou also shalt be drunken: thou shalt be hid, thou also shalt seek strength because of the enemy.
12 All thy strong holds shall be like fig trees with the firstripe figs: if they be shaken, they shall even fall into the mouth of the eater.
13 Behold, thy people in the midst of thee are women: the gates of thy land shall be set wide open unto thine enemies: the fire shall devour thy bars.
14 Draw thee waters for the siege, fortify thy strong holds: go into clay, and tread the morter, make strong the brickkiln.
15 There shall the fire devour thee; the sword shall cut thee off, it shall eat thee up like the cankerworm: make thyself many as the cankerworm, make thyself many as the locusts.

rr: 16 Okakanyisa abashuubuzi baawe
en: 16 Thou hast multiplied thy merchants above the stars of heaven: the cankerworm spoileth, and fleeth away.

17 Thy crowned are as the locusts, and thy captains as the great grasshoppers, which camp in the hedges in the cold day, but when the sun ariseth they flee away, and their place is not known where they are .
18 Thy shepherds slumber, O king of Assyria: thy nobles shall dwell in the dust: thy people is scattered upon the mountains, and no man gathereth them .
19 There is no healing of thy bruise; thy wound is grievous: all that hear the bruit of thee shall clap the hands over thee: for upon whom hath not thy wickedness passed continually?

rr: Ebigambo bya Nehemia, mwene Hakalia.
en: The words of Nehemiah the son of Hachaliah.

rr: Eizooba rimwe omu kwezi kwa Kisileevi omu mwaka gwa makumi abiri, nkaba ndi omu rurembo Suusa
en: And it came to pass in the month Chisleu, in the twentieth year, as I was in Shushan the palace,

rr: Hanaani, omwe ahari beene waitu, yaija n'abashaija nibaruga Yuda; naababuuza eby'Abayudaaya, abaahonokire batatwarwe omu bukwatwa, n'ebya Yerusaalemu.
en: that Hanani, one of my brethren, came, he and certain men of Judah; and I asked them concerning the Jews that had escaped, which were left of the captivity, and concerning Jerusalem.

rr: Bangira bati: Abaahonokire batatwarwe omu bukwatwa, abari omuri eryo ishaza, bari omu busaasi bwingi, n'omu kuhemuka kuhango; orugo rw'amabaare orwa Yerusaalemu rusheenyirwe, n'amarembo gaayo gacwekyereziibwe n'omuriro.
en: And they said unto me, The remnant that are left of the captivity there in the province are in great affliction and reproach: the wall of Jerusalem also is broken down, and the gates thereof are burned with fire.

rr: Ku naahuriire ebigambo ebyo, naashutama ahansi, naarira, naamara ebiro ninganya; naaguma niinyesiibyakwo, kandi ninshaba omu maisho ga Ruhanga w'eiguru.
en: And it came to pass, when I heard these words, that I sat down and wept, and mourned certain days, and fasted, and prayed before the God of heaven,

rr: Naagira nti: Ai MUKAMA, Ruhanga w'eiguru, ori Ruhanga Nyamuhanga orikutiinwa, orinda endagaano kandi ogirira embabazi abakukunda, bakoorobera ebiragiro byawe
en: and said, I beseech thee, O LORD God of heaven, the great and terrible God, that keepeth covenant and mercy for them that love him and observe his commandments:

rr: tega okutu, kandi oreebe n'amaisho, ohurire okushaba kw'omwiru waawe, oku ndikushaba omu maisho gaawe nyomushana na nyekiro ahabw'Abaisraeli abairu baawe, niinyatura ebibi byabo, ebi twakucumwireho. N'ekya buzima, nyowe n'enju ya tata tukacumura.
en: let thine ear now be attentive, and thine eyes open, that thou mayest hear the prayer of thy servant, which I pray before thee now, day and night, for the children of Israel thy servants, and confess the sins of the children of Israel, which we have sinned against thee: both I and my father's house have sinned.

rr: -27 ; 28:64 . Tukakora ebitahikire ahariiwe, titwayorobera biragiro, ebyatairweho n'eby'emigyenzo ebi waaragiire omugaragwa waawe Musa.
en: We have dealt very corruptly against thee, and have not kept the commandments, nor the statutes, nor the judgments, which thou commandedst thy servant Moses.

rr: Ijuka ekigambo eki waaragiire omugaragwa waawe ogwo, noogira oti: Ku muricumura, ndyabataataanisiza omu mahanga
en: Remember, I beseech thee, the word that thou commandedst thy servant Moses, saying, If ye transgress, I will scatter you abroad among the nations:

rr: kwonka ku muringarukira, mwayorobera ebiragiro byangye, mwabikora, n'obu muriba mutaataanisiziibwe okwo hare aha muheru gw'ensi, ndyabateeranira hamwe, mbaiheyo, mbareete omu nsi ei naatooraine kugumyamu eiziina ryangye.
en: but if ye turn unto me, and keep my commandments, and do them; though there were of you cast out unto the uttermost part of the heaven, yet will I gather them from thence, and will bring them unto the place that I have chosen to set my name there.

rr: N'abairu baawe, kandi abantu baawe, abu waacungwire n'amaani gaawe amaingi, kandi n'omukono gwawe ogw'amaani.
en: Now these are thy servants and thy people, whom thou hast redeemed by thy great power, and by thy strong hand.

rr: Ai MUKAMA, tega okutu kwawe, ohurire okushaba kw'omwiru waawe, n'okw'abairu baawe, abashemerererwa okutiina eiziina ryawe; ohe omwiru waawe omugisha eri izooba, agirirwe embabazi omu maisho g'omushaija ogu. (Omu bunaku obwo nkaba ndi omuheereza wa viinyo y'omugabe.) Currently Selected: Nehemia 1 : RR64 Highlight Share <div class="text-text-light dark:text-text-d
en: O Lord, I beseech thee, let now thine ear be attentive to the prayer of thy servant, and to the prayer of thy servants, who desire to fear thy name: and prosper, I pray thee, thy servant this day, and grant him mercy in the sight of this man. For I was the king's cupbearer.
