rr: Omu kwezi kwa Nisani omu mwaka gwa makumi abiri ogw'omu busingye bwa Aruta-gizakiseesi, eizooba rimwe viinyo ekaba eri omu maisho g'omugabe naagiihaho, naagimuha.
en: And it came to pass in the month Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king, that wine was before him: and I took up the wine, and gave it unto the king.

rr: Obundi bwona nkaba ntakaguubwaga nti kubi omu maisho ge.
en: Now I had not been beforetime sad in his presence.

rr: Omugabe yambuuza ati: Ahabw'enki nooreebeka ogwirwe kubi, haza otarwaire? Ekyo ti kindi, kureka n'obusaasi bw'aha mutima. Ku naakihuriire, naatiina munonga.
en: Wherefore the king said unto me, Why is thy countenance sad, seeing thou art not sick? this is nothing else but sorrow of heart. Then I was very sore afraid,

rr: Naagira omugabe nti: Karamaare, Nyakusinga! Ekyakunzibiire kuguubwa kubi niki, haza kunu orurembo orurimu ebituuro bya baatatenkuru, rwabaire amatongo, n'amarembo gaarwo gaacwekyereziibwe n'omuriro?
en: and said unto the king, Let the king live for ever: why should not my countenance be sad, when the city, the place of my fathers' sepulchres, lieth waste, and the gates thereof are consumed with fire?

rr: Bwanyima omugabe yangira ati: Mbwenu nooshaba ki? Ntyo naashaba Ruhanga w'eiguru.
en: Then the king said unto me, For what dost thou make request? So I prayed to the God of heaven.

rr: Bwanyima naagira omugabe nti: Nyakusinga omugabe, ku oraabe nookisiima, kandi nyowe omwiru waawe nyine obushongore omu maisho gaawe, nyohereza Yuda, omu rurembo rw'ebituuro bya baatatenkuru, ngarukye ndwombekye.
en: And I said unto the king, If it please the king, and if thy servant have found favour in thy sight, that thou wouldest send me unto Judah, unto the city of my fathers' sepulchres, that I may build it.

rr: Omugabe, omwigarire amushutami aha rubaju, yangira ati: Noija kumarayo mwanya ki, kandi oryagaruka ryari?
en: And the king said unto me, (the queen also sitting by him,) For how long shall thy journey be? and when wilt thou return?

rr: Atyo omugabe yaasiima kuunyohereza; naanye naaragaana nawe obunaku.
en: So it pleased the king to send me; and I set him a time.

rr: Bwanyima naagira omugabe nti: ku oraabe nookisiima, Nyakusinga, bampe amabaruha g'okutwarira abamashaza ba seeri y'Omugyera, baanyikirize kurabamu kuhika Yuda
en: Moreover I said unto the king, If it please the king, let letters be given me to the governors beyond the river, that they may convey me over till I come into Judah;

rr: kandi mpeebwe n'ebaruha y'okutwarira Asafu, omurinzi w'ekibira ky'omugabe, abone kumpa emiti y'okwihamu enkingi z'amarembo g'ekigo kya hekalu, n'ey'orugo rw'orurembo, kandi n'ey'enju ei ndaataahemu.
en: and a letter unto Asaph the keeper of the king's forest, that he may give me timber to make beams for the gates of the palace which appertained to the house, and for the wall of the city, and for the house that I shall enter into.

rr: Omugabe yaanyikiriza ebi naashaba; ahakuba omukono gwa Ruhanga wangye omurungi gukaba gundiho.
en: And the king granted me, according to the good hand of my God upon me.

rr: Bwanyima naaza aha bamashaza ba seeri y'Omugyera, naabaha amabaruha g'omugabe.
en: Then I came to the governors beyond the river, and gave them the king's letters.

rr: Kandi omugabe akaba ayohereize abakuru b'engabo n'ab'aha mbaraasi kunshagara.
en: Now the king had sent captains of the army and horsemen with me.

rr: Kwonka Sanibalati Omuhoroni na Tobia omuhuuku Omuamoni, ku baahuriire ngu hariho oizire kukorera Abaisraeli ebirungi, kyabagwisa kubi mononga.
en: When Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, heard of it grieved them exceedingly that there was come a man to seek the welfare of the children of Israel.

rr: Ntyo naaza Yerusaalemu, naamarayo ebiro bishatu.
en: So I came to Jerusalem, and was there three days. Surveys Jerusalem

rr: Bwanyima naimuka nyekiro n'abantu bakye; kandi tinaagambira muntu weena eki Ruhanga wangye antaire aha mutima kukorera Yerusaalemu. Kandi nkaba ntaine ndiijo mbaraasi kureka ei naagyendeireho.
en: And I arose in the night, I and some few men with me; neither told I any man what my God had put in my heart to do at Jerusalem: neither was there any beast with me, save the beast that I rode upon.

rr: Ekyo kiro naashohora, naaraba omu irembo ry'omu ruhanga, naahika aha iziba ry'Ekijoka, n'aha irembo ry'orubungo, naayetegyereza engo za Yerusaalemu, ezaabaire zisheenyukire, n'amarembo gaarwo agaabaire gacwekyereziibwe n'omuriro.
en: And I went out by night by the gate of the valley, even before the dragon well, and to the dung port, and viewed the walls of Jerusalem, which were broken down, and the gates thereof were consumed with fire.

rr: Ntyo naagumizamu naahika aha irembo ry'enshuro, n'aha kiyanja ky'omugabe, kwonka naabura ah'okurabya embaraasi ei naabaire ntembire.
en: Then I went on to the gate of the fountain, and to the king's pool: but there was no place for the beast that was under me to pass.

rr: Bwanyima ekyo kiro nainamuka orwo ruhanga, naayetegyereza orwo rugo; bwanyima naakuba, naaraba omu irembo ry'oruhanga, naagarukayo.
en: Then went I up in the night by the brook, and viewed the wall, and turned back, and entered by the gate of the valley, and so returned.

rr: Kandi abategyeki tibaamanya i naaba ngiire, nari eki naaba ninkora; kandi nkaba ntakagambiire Bayudaaya, abanyamurwa, abakungu, abatware, nari abandi abaabaire bari ab'okukora omurimo.
en: And the rulers knew not whither I went, or what I did; neither had I as yet told it to the Jews, nor to the priests, nor to the nobles, nor to the rulers, nor to the rest that did the work.

rr: Bwanyima naabagira nti: Nimureeba akabi aku turimu, Yerusaalemu oku ebaire amatongo, n'amarembo gaayo oku gahiire. Mwije twombekye orugo rwa Yerusaalemu, turekye kuguma nitushekyererwa.
en: Then said I unto them, Ye see the distress that we are in, how Jerusalem lieth waste, and the gates thereof are burned with fire: come, and let us build up the wall of Jerusalem, that we be no more a reproach.

rr: Kandi naabateekyerereza oku omukono gwa Ruhanga wangye gwambereire murungi, kandi n'ebi omugabe yangambiire. Baagira bati: Ka twimukye, twombekye. Batyo baayeteera ebinyomyo kukora omurimo ogwo omurungi.
en: Then I told them of the hand of my God which was good upon me; as also the king's words that he had spoken unto me. And they said, Let us rise up and build. So they strengthened their hands for this good work . Meets Opposition

rr: Kwonka Sanibalati Omuhoroni na Tobila omuhuuku Omuamoni, na Geshemu Omuharabu, ku baakihuriire, baatushekyerera, baatugaya nibagira bati: Mbwenu eki nimukora ki? Nimwenda kugomera omugabe?
en: But when Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, and Geshem the Arabian, heard it , they laughed us to scorn, and despised us, and said, What is this thing that ye do? will ye rebel against the king?

rr: Bwanyima Eliashibu omunyamurwa omukuru yaimuka na beene ishe abanyamurwa, baayombeka eirembo ry'entaama. Baarishoroora, baaritamu enyigi. Bwanyima baashoroora orugo okuhika aha munaara gwa Hamea, n'okuhika aha munaara gwa Hananeeli.
en: Then Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brethren the priests, and they builded the sheep gate; they sanctified it, and set up the doors of it; even unto the tower of Meah they sanctified it, unto the tower of Hananeel.

rr: Haakurataho aba Yeriko; nabo baakuratwa Zakuri mwene Imuri omu kwombeka.
en: And next unto him builded the men of Jericho. And next to them builded Zaccur the son of Imri.

rr: Batabani ba Hasena baayombeka eirembo ry'eby'enyanja; baabyara enkingi zaaryo, baatamu enyigi zaaryo, ebyoma bayryo by'okurikingisa, n'empimbi zaaryo.
en: But the fish gate did the sons of Hassenaah build, who also laid the beams thereof, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.

rr: Baakuratwa Meremoosi mwene Uriya mwijukuru wa Hakozi, yaahunduuza; haataho Meshulaamu mwene Berekia, mwijukuru wa Meshezabeeli, yaahunduuza; haataho Zadoki mwene Baana, yaahunduuza.
en: And next unto them repaired Meremoth the son of Urijah, the son of Koz. And next unto them repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabeel. And next unto them repaired Zadok the son of Baana.

rr: Haataho aba Tekoa, baahunduuza; kwonka abakungu baabo tibarataire mutima ha murimo gwa mukama waabo.
en: And next unto them the Tekoites repaired; but their nobles put not their necks to the work of their Lord.

rr: Yoyada mwene Pasea, na Meshulaamu mwene Besodeia baahunduuza eirembo erya ira; baabyara enkingi zaaryo, baatamu enyigi zaaryo, ebyoma byaryo by'okurikingisa, n'empimbi zaaryo.
en: Moreover the old gate repaired Jehoiada the son of Paseah, and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah; they laid the beams thereof, and set up the doors thereof, and the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.

rr: Haataho Melatia owa Gibeoni, yaahunduuza na Yadoni owa Meronoosi, abashaija ba Gibeoni na Mizipa, abaabaire bari omu butegyeki bw'omutegyeki w'ensi eya seeri y'Omugyera.
en: And next unto them repaired Melatiah the Gibeonite, and Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon, and of Mizpah, unto the throne of the governor on this side the river.

rr: Haataho Uzieli, mwene Haruhaaya, ow'omu baheesi b'ezaabu, yaahunduuza. Haataho Hanania, omwe aha barikujwanzya emigaju, yaahunduuza. Bo baagaruraho orugo rwa Yerusaalemu okuhika aha Rugo orugango.
en: Next unto him repaired Uzziel the son of Harhaiah, of the goldsmiths. Next unto him also repaired Hananiah the son of one of the apothecaries, and they fortified Jerusalem unto the broad wall.

rr: Haataho Refaaya mwene Huuri, omutegyeki w'ekicweka kya Yerusaalemu; yaahunduuza.
en: And next unto them repaired Rephaiah the son of Hur, the ruler of the half part of Jerusalem.

rr: Haataho Yedaaya mwene Harumaafu, yaahunduuza ahashungaine n'enju ye; haataho Hatushi mwene Hashabuneia, yaahunduuza.
en: And next unto them repaired Jedaiah the son of Harumaph, even over against his house. And next unto him repaired Hattush the son of Hashabniah.

rr: Malakiya mwene Harimu na Hashubu mwene Pahasi-moabu baahunduuza ekicweka ky'orugo, n'omunaara gw'amateekyero.
en: Malchijah the son of Harim, and Hashub the son of Pahath-moab, repaired the other piece, and the tower of the furnaces.

rr: Haataho Shalumu mwene Haloheeshi, omutegyeki w'ekicweka kya Yerusaalemu, yaahunduuza, we na bahara be.
en: And next unto him repaired Shallum the son of Halohesh, the ruler of the half part of Jerusalem, he and his daughters.

rr: Hanuuni n'abatuuzi ba Zanoa baahunduuza eirembo ry'Oruhanga; baaryombeka, baatamu enyigi zaaryo, ebyoma byaryo ey'okurikingisa, n'empimbi zaaryo; kandi baahunduuza ekicweka ky'orugo kya mikono rukumi okuhika aha irembo ry'orubungo.
en: The valley gate repaired Hanun, and the inhabitants of Zanoah; they built it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof, and a thousand cubits on the wall unto the dung gate.

rr: Malakiya mwene Rekabu, omutware w'eishaza rya Besi-hakeremu, yaahunduuza eryo irembo ry'orubungo; yaaryombeka, yaatamu enyigi zaaryo, ebyoma byaryo eby'okurikingisa, n'empimbi zaaryo.
en: But the dung gate repaired Malchiah the son of Rechab, the ruler of part of Beth-haccerem; he built it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.

rr: Shalumu mwene Koluhoze, omutware w'eishaza rya Mizipa, yaahunduuza eirembo ry'enshuro; yaaryombeka, yaarishweka, yaatamu enyigi zaaryo, ebyoma byaryo eby'okurikingisa, n'empimbi zaaryo; kandi yaayombeka orugo rw'ekiyanja kya Sheela, ekyabaire kiri omu musiri gw'omugabe, okuhika aha matembero, agarikushuuma nigaruga omu rurembo rwa Daudi.
en: But the gate of the fountain repaired Shallun the son of Col-hozeh, the ruler of part of Mizpah; he built it, and covered it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof, and the wall of the pool of Siloah by the king's garden, and unto the stairs that go down from the city of David.

rr: Haataho Nehemia mwene Azubuuki, omutware w'ekicweka ky'eishaza rya Besi-zuuri, yaahunduuza okuhika aharikureebana n'ebituuro bya Daudi, aha biyanja ebi baatibire, n'aha nju y'amamanzi.
en: After him repaired Nehemiah the son of Azbuk, the ruler of the half part of Beth-zur, unto the place over against the sepulchres of David, and to the pool that was made, and unto the house of the mighty.

rr: Yaakuratwa Abaleevi; Rehumu mwene Baani, haataho Hashabia, omutware w'ekicweka ky'eishaza rya Keila, yaahunduuza ahabw'eishaza rye.
en: After him repaired the Levites, Rehum the son of Bani. Next unto him repaired Hashabiah, the ruler of the half part of Keilah, in his part.

rr: Haataho beene waabo, baahunduuza; Bavai mwene Henadaadi omutware w'ekicweka ky'eishaza rya Keila
en: After him repaired their brethren, Bavai the son of Henadad, the ruler of the half part of Keilah.

rr: haataho Ezeri mwene Yehsua, omutware wa Mizipa, yaahunduuza ekindi kicweka, ekirikureebana n'ah'orikwinamukira nooza omu ibiikiro ry'eby'okurwanisa aha Keekubo.
en: And next to him repaired Ezer the son of Jeshua, the ruler of Mizpah, another piece over against the going up to the armoury at the turning of the wall .

rr: Haataho Baruki mwene Zabai, yaahunduuza ekindi kicweka, okwiha aha Keekubo okuhika aha rwigi rw'enju ya Eliashibu omunyamurwa omukuru.
en: After him Baruch the son of Zabbai earnestly repaired the other piece, from the turning of the wall unto the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest.

rr: Yaakuratwa abanyamurwa, ab'omu ruhita, baahunduuza.
en: And after him repaired the priests, the men of the plain.

rr: Haataho Benyamiini na Hashubu, baahunduuza ahashungaine n'enju yaabo.
en: After him repaired Benjamin and Hashub over against their house.

rr: Haataho Azaria mwene Maaseya, mwijukuru wa Anania, yaahunduuza aha rubaju rw'enju ye.
en: After him repaired Azariah the son of Maaseiah the son of Ananiah by his house.

rr: Yaakuratwa Benui, mwene Henadaadi, yaahunduuza ekindi kicweka, okuruga aha nju ya Azaria okuhika aha Keekubo.
en: After him repaired Binnui the son of Henadad another piece, from the house of Azariah unto the turning of the wall , even unto the corner.

rr: Palali mwene Uzai yaahunduuza aharikureebana n'Akeekubo, n'aha munaara ogukwataine n'enju y'omugabe ey'aharuguru, omu kibuga ky'abarinzi.
en: Palal the son of Uzai, over against the turning of the wall , and the tower which lieth out from the king's high house, that was by the court of the prison. After him Pedaiah the son of Parosh.

rr: Yaakuratwa Pedaya mwene Paroshi n'abaheereza b'omuri hekalu, abaabaire batwire Ofeli, baahunduuza okuhika ahashungaine n'eirembo ry'amaizi aha rubaju rw'oburugwa-izooba, n'omunaara ogukwataine n'orwo rugo.
en: Moreover the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel, unto the place over against the water gate toward the east, and the tower that lieth out.

rr: Aharuguru y'eirembo ry'embaraasi abanyamurwa baahahunduuza, buri omwe yaahunduuza ahashungaine n'enju ye.
en: From above the horse gate repaired the priests, every one over against his house.

rr: Baakuratwa Zadoki mwene Imeri; yaahunduuza aharikureebana n'enju ye.
en: After them repaired Zadok the son of Immer over against his house.

rr: Haataho Shemaaya, mwene Shekania, omurinzi w'eirembo ry'oburugwa-izooba, nawe yaahunduuza.
en: After him repaired also Shemaiah the son of Shechaniah, the keeper of the east gate.

rr: Yaakuratwa Malukiya, omwe aha baheesi b'ezaabu; yaahunduuza okuhika aha nju y'abaheereza by'omuri hekalu, n'ey'abashuubuzi, aharikureebana n'eirembo ry'eiteeraniro, n'okuhika aha kishengye kya ruguru eky'aha Keekubo.
en: After him repaired Malchiah the goldsmith's son unto the place of the Nethinims, and of the merchants, over against the gate Miphkad, and to the going up of the corner.

rr: Kandi abaheesi b'ezaabu n'abashubuuzi baahunduuza ahagati y'ekyo kishengye ekya ruguru eky'aha keekubo n'eirembo ry'entaama.
en: And between the going up of the corner unto the sheep gate repaired the goldsmiths and the merchants.

rr: Sanibalati ku yaahuriire ngu nitwombeka orugo rw'amabaare, yaaguubwa kubi, yaagira ekiniga kingi, yaateerera Abayudaaya enaku.
en: But it came to pass, that when Sanballat heard that we builded the wall, he was wroth, and took great indignation, and mocked the Jews.

rr: Yaagambira omu maisho ga beene ishe, n'omu maisho g'eihe rya Samaria, ati: Ziriya ntakimazire z'Abayudaaya nizikora ki? Nibenda kweyombekyera ekigo? Nibenda kutamba ebitambo? nibenda kwombeka ngu baherezeho? Nibabaasa kutabuura emabaare omu mituumo y'ebyasheenyukire, haza gaabaire gaahiire?
en: And he spake before his brethren and the army of Samaria, and said, What do these feeble Jews? will they fortify themselves? will they sacrifice? will they make an end in a day? will they revive the stones out of the heaps of the rubbish which are burned?

rr: Reero Tobia, owaabaire amuri aha rubaju, nawe yaagira ati: N'ekya buzima! Orwo rugo rwabo rw'amabaare, oru barikwombeka, muha ku ekurwemereraho, ekaarubandika ahansi.
en: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, and he said, Even that which they build, if a fox go up, he shall even break down their stone wall.

rr: Ntyo naashaba ningira nti: Ai Ruhanga waitu, hurira; ahabw'okuba tugayirwe. Ebijumo ebi batujumire, obibagarureho, kandi obaheyo, batwarwe omu ndiijo nsi bari enkwatwa, banyagirweyo.
en: Hear, O our God; for we are despised: and turn their reproach upon their own head, and give them for a prey in the land of captivity:

rr: Otashwekyerera orubanja rwabo, kandi n'ekibi kyabo kitaragazibwa omu maisho gaawe; ahakuba bakugwisiize kubi omu maisho g'abombeki.
en: and cover not their iniquity, and let not their sin be blotted out from before thee: for they have provoked thee to anger before the builders.

rr: Tutyo twayombeka orugo, twaruteerana rwona, rwahika rwagati; ahabw'okuba abantu bakeezirika baakora.
en: So built we the wall; and all the wall was joined together unto the half thereof: for the people had a mind to work.

rr: Kwonka Sanibalati na Tobia n'Abaharabu n'Abaamoni n'aba Ashidoodi ku baahuriire ngu omurimo gw'okuhunduuza engo za Yerusaalemu nigugyenda omumaisho, kandi ngu ahaasheenyukire hatandikire kuteeranwa, baagira ekiniga kingi
en: But it came to pass, that when Sanballat, and Tobiah, and the Arabians, and the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites, heard that the walls of Jerusalem were made up, and that the breaches began to be stopped, then they were very wroth,

rr: boona baagira enaama y'okuza kurwanisa Yerusaalemu, n'okugirabanisamu.
en: and conspired all of them together to come and to fight against Jerusalem, and to hinder it. Nehemiah's Response

rr: Kwonka itwe twashaba Ruhanga waitu, twataho abarinzi b'okurinda nyomushana na nyekiro. Okwombeka beeteekateekire kurwana
en: Nevertheless we made our prayer unto our God, and set a watch against them day and night, because of them.

rr: Bwanyima Abayuda baagira bati: Abarikwekorera baahwa amaani, kandi ebisheenyuka bikiri bingi; n'ahabw'ekyo titurikubaasa kwombeka rugo.
en: And Judah said, The strength of the bearers of burdens is decayed, and there is much rubbish; so that we are not able to build the wall.

rr: Abazigu baitu baagira bati: Tibarikwija kukimanya, n'obu kwakuba okutureeba, okuhitsya obu turaabahikye ahagati, tukabaita, tukabazibira kukora.
en: And our adversaries said, They shall not know, neither see, till we come in the midst among them, and slay them, and cause the work to cease.

rr: Abayudaaya abaabaire batwire n'abo bazigu baitu ku baizire, baaguma nibatugambira, nangwa baahitsya emirundi ikumi, nibagira ngu abo bazigu nibaija kuruga hoona-hoona ahu batwire, batuteere.
en: And it came to pass, that when the Jews which dwelt by them came, they said unto us ten times, From all places whence ye shall return unto us they will be upon you .

rr: Nikyo naateereire abantu omu buhanga enyima y'orugo, n'aha mitwe y'obubungo, nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri, baine zaarurara n'amacumu n'amata.
en: Therefore set I in the lower places behind the wall, and on the higher places, I even set the people after their families with their swords, their spears, and their bows.

rr: Ku naayetegyereize, naimuka, naagambira abakungu n'abatware n'abandi boona nti: Mutabatiina. Mwijukye Mukama, omukuru kandi orikutiinisa, murwanirire beene waanyu, batabani baanyu, bahara baanyu, abakazi baanyu n'amaka gaanyu.
en: And I looked, and rose up, and said unto the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, Be not ye afraid of them: remember the Lord, which is great and terrible, and fight for your brethren, your sons, and your daughters, your wives, and your houses.

rr: Abazigu baitu ku baahuriire ngu tukimanyire, kandi ngu Ruhanga acwire busha enaama yaabo, twena twagaruka aha rugo, buri muntu aha murimo gwe.
en: And it came to pass, when our enemies heard that it was known unto us, and God had brought their counsel to nought, that we returned all of us to the wall, every one unto his work.

rr: Okuruga ahari eryo izooba, ekicweka kime kya kabiri ky'abashaija bangye kyaguma aha murimo gw'okwombeka, kimwe kya kabiri ekindi kyakwata amacumu, engabo, amata n'ebijwaro by'ebyoma eby'okurwanisa; kandi abeebembezi baayemerera enyima y'ab'enju ya Yuda boona.
en: And it came to pass from that time forth, that the half of my servants wrought in the work, and the other half of them held both the spears, the shields, and the bows, and the habergeons; and the rulers were behind all the house of Judah.

rr: Abaabaire nibombeka orugo, n'abaabaire nibeekorera ebintu, buri muntu akaba akoresa omukono gumwe, ogundi guguma gukwaitse eby'okurwanisa.
en: They which builded on the wall, and they that bare burdens, with those that laded, every one with one of his hands wrought in the work, and with the other hand held a weapon.

rr: Buri mwombeki weena akaba ayombeka, ahagatiire rurara ye; kandi ow'okuteera eikondere anguma aha rubaju.
en: For the builders, every one had his sword girded by his side, and so builded. And he that sounded the trumpet was by me.

rr: Kandi naagmbira abakungu n'abatware n'abandi boona nti: Omurimo ni muhango, guhikire hare, kandi itwe twenaganagire aha rugo, buri muntu ari hare na mugyenzi we.
en: And I said unto the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, The work is great and large, and we are separated upon the wall, one far from another.

rr: Ei muraahurire eiraka ry'enzamba yoona, mube niyo mwairukira, mutushangye. Ruhanga waitu naija kuturwanirira.
en: In what place therefore ye hear the sound of the trumpet, resort ye thither unto us: our God shall fight for us.

rr: Okwo nikwo twabaire tukora omurimo, ekicweka kyabo kimwe kikwata amacumu, okwiha omu kasheeshe nibutaagurikana okuhitsya omu mwabazyo, ahu enyonyoozi zireebekyera.
en: So we laboured in the work: and half of them held the spears from the rising of the morning till the stars appeared.

rr: Omuri obwo bunaku naagaruka naagmbira abantu nti: Buri muntu n'omuhuuku we bagume baraare omuri Yerusaalemu, babone kuturinda nyekiro, n'okukora nyomushana.
en: Likewise at the same time said I unto the people, Let every one with his servant lodge within Jerusalem, that in the night they may be a guard to us, and labour on the day.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo tihariho n'omwe omuriitwe owaabaire ajuura ebijwaro bye, yaaba nyowe, nari beene tata, nari abashaija bangye, n'obu baakuba abarinzi abaabaire bangyenda enyima; buri muntu akaba aza kutaha amaizi, aine eky'okurwanisa kye omu ngaro.
en: So neither I, nor my brethren, nor my servants, nor the men of the guard which followed me, none of us put off our clothes, saving that every one put them off for washing.

rr: Bwanyima bamwe aha Bayudaaya n'abakazi baabo baayetomboitera beene waabo Abayudaaya
en: And there was a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brethren the Jews.

rr: ahakuba abamwe bakagira bati: Itwe na batabani baitu na bahara baitu turi baingi; ka tuze kushaka eby'okututunga.
en: For there were that said, We, our sons, and our daughters, are many: therefore we take up corn for them , that we may eat, and live.

rr: Kandi abandi baagira bati: Nitukwatiriza emisiri yaitu, n'emizaabibu yaitu, n'amaju gaitu, ahabw'enjara, ngu tubone eby'okurya.
en: Some also there were that said, We have mortgaged our lands, vineyards, and houses, that we might buy corn, because of the dearth.

rr: N'abandi baagira bati: Tugurize empiiha, twakwatiriza emisiri yaitu n'emizaabibu yaitu kuha omushoro gw'omugabe.
en: There were also that said, We have borrowed money for the king's tribute, and that upon our lands and vineyards.

rr: Haza itwe na beene waitu turi omubiri gumwe, n'abaana baitu nikyo kimwe n'abaabo; mbwenu batabani baitu na bahara baitu nitubagyema kuba abahuuku n'abazaana; nangwa n'abamwe ahari bahara baitu babeereire kimwe abazaana, kandi titwine ky'okukora, ngu tubacungure, ahabw'okuba emisiri yaitu n'emizaabibu yaitu biinwe abandi.
en: Yet now our flesh is as the flesh of our brethren, our children as their children: and, lo, we bring into bondage our sons and our daughters to be servants, and some of our daughters are brought unto bondage already: neither is it in our power to redeem them ; for other men have our lands and vineyards.

rr: Ku naahuriire okwetomboita kwabo n'ebigambo ebyo, naagira ekiniga kingi munonga.
en: And I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words.

rr: Naagira enaama n'omutima gwangye, bwanyima naatonganisa abakungu n'abatware, naabagira nti: Nimwiha hari beene waanyu ekiteebwamu, buri muntu ahari mwene waabo.
en: Then I consulted with myself, and I rebuked the nobles, and the rulers, and said unto them, Ye exact usury, every one of his brother. And I set a great assembly against them.

rr: Naateerana omutwe gw'abantu baingi kukibeemeza, naabagira nti: Itwe tukakora eki turikubaasa, twacungura beene waitu Abayudaaya, abaabaire baguzirwe abanyamahanga; mbwenu imwe nimwenda kutunda beene waanyu; nimugira ngu, kihikire itwe kubagura?
en: And I said unto them, We after our ability have redeemed our brethren the Jews, which were sold unto the heathen; and will ye even sell your brethren? or shall they be sold unto us?

rr: Baahunama, baabura eky'okugarukamu.
en: Then held they their peace, and found nothing to answer .

rr: Naagaruka naagira nti: Eki murikukora ti kirungi. Ekirungi t'okugyendera omu kutiina Ruhanga waitu, mukareka kwejumisa omu banyamahanga abazigu baitu?
en: Also I said, It is not good that ye do: ought ye not to walk in the fear of our God because of the reproach of the heathen our enemies?

rr: Kandi nyowe na beene waitu n'abashaija bangye nitubaguza empiiha n'eby'okurya; kwonka ka turekye kubashaba ekiteebwamu.
en: I likewise, and my brethren, and my servants, might exact of them money and corn: I pray you, let us leave off this usury.

rr: Na mbwenu eri izooba mubagarurire emisiri yaabo, emizaabibu yaabo, emizeituuni yaabo, n'amaju gaabo, kandi tubagarurire na kimwe kya igana eky'empiiha, engano, viinyo n'eky'amajuta, ebi mubaire nimubahaisa.
en: Restore, I pray you, to them, even this day, their lands, their vineyards, their oliveyards, and their houses, also the hundredth part of the money, and of the corn, the wine, and the oil, that ye exact of them.

rr: Baagarukamu nibagira bati: Twaza kubibagarurira, kandi titurikwija kugira ki twabahaisa. Nitwija kukora nk'oku waagamba. Ntyo naayeta abanyamurwa, naabarahiriza omu maisho g'abo bantu kuguma nibakora nk'oku baarahira.
en: Then said they, We will restore them , and will require nothing of them; so will we do as thou sayest. Then I called the priests, and took an oath of them, that they should do according to this promise.

rr: Kandi naakunkumura omunagiro ogu naabaire nnagiire, naagira nti: Omuntu weena, oraabe atahikiriize egi ndagaano, Ruhanga amukunkumure atyo, amwihe omu nju ye n'omu murimo gwe. Abe nikwo yaakunkumurwa atyo, akahwaho. Omutwe gw'abantu abaabaire bateeraine baagira bati: Amiina, baahimbisa MUKAMA. Bwanyima abantu baakora nk'oku baaraganisa. Oku Nehemia yaategyekire abantu
en: Also I shook my lap, and said, So God shake out every man from his house, and from his labour, that performeth not this promise, even thus be he shaken out, and emptied. And all the congregation said, Amen, and praised the LORD . And the people did according to this promise.

rr: Kandi okuruga omu bunaku obu naatandikiiremu kuba omutegyeki w'abantu omuri Yuda, okwiha aha mwaka gwa makumi abiri okuhitsya aha gwa makumi ashatu n'ebiri ogw'omu busingye bw'omugabe Aruta-gizakiseesi, omuri egyo myaka ikumi n'ebiri, nyowe na gbeene tata titurariire ha by'okurya by'emitoijo y'obutegyeki.
en: Moreover from the time that I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year even unto the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes the king, that is , twelve years, I and my brethren have not eaten the bread of the governor.

rr: Kwonka abategyeki abambandiize bakaita kubi abantu, nibabatoijesa eby'okurya na viinyo, otabariireho shekeli z'efeeza makumi ana. Nangwa n'abagaragwa baabo bakaba batwaza abantu eikama. Kwonka nyowe tindatwarize ntyo ahabw'okutiina Ruhanga.
en: But the former governors that had been before me were chargeable unto the people, and had taken of them bread and wine, beside forty shekels of silver; yea, even their servants bare rule over the people: but so did not I, because of the fear of God.

rr: Kureka nkaba nyezirika kukora hari orwo rugo, kandi tihariho itaka ryona eri naatwaire; n'abashaija bangye boona bakaba bateeranirayo, bareetsirwe ogwo murimo.
en: Yea, also I continued in the work of this wall, neither bought we any land: and all my servants were gathered thither unto the work.

rr: Kandi aha meeza yangye hakaba hariiraho abashaija igana na makumi ataano, Abayudaaya n'abatware, otabariireho abaabaire baija ahariitwe, nibaruga omu mahanga agatwehinguririize.
en: Moreover there were at my table an hundred and fifty of the Jews and rulers, beside those that came unto us from among the heathen that are about us.

rr: Ebago y'eizooba rimwe ekaba eba ente emwe, n'entaama mukaaga ezitoorainwe; banteekyera n'enkoko, kandi buri biro ikumi efurebe za viinyo y'emiringo mingi; kwonka ebyo byona nkaba ntabitoijesa bantu nk'omutegyeki; ahabw'okuba obuhuuku bukaba bubaruhize.
en: Now that which was prepared for me daily was one ox and six choice sheep; also fowls were prepared for me, and once in ten days store of all sorts of wine: yet for all this required not I the bread of the governor, because the bondage was heavy upon this people.

rr: Ai Ruhanga wangye, oijukye ebi naakoreire aba bantu byona, onzimuurire ebirungi.
en: Think upon me, my God, for good, according to all that I have done for this people.

rr: Currently Selected: Nehemia 5 : RR64 Highlight Share <path d="M5 12a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h3a1 1 0 1 1 0 2H6a1 1 0 0 1-1-1ZM5 15a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h

Ku haahingwireho ebiro, baagambira Sanibalati na Tobia na Geshemu Omuharabu n'abandi bazigu baitu, ku nyombekire orugo, kandi ku hatakiriho hasheenyukire, (n'obu ndaabe naabaire ntakataire nyigi mu marembo.)
en: Now it came to pass, when Sanballat, and Tobiah, and Geshem the Arabian, and the rest of our enemies, heard that I had builded the wall, and that there was no breach left therein; (though at that time I had not set up the doors upon the gates;)

rr: Sanibalati na Geshemu, ku baakihuriire bantumaho nigabira bati: Ija tubugaabuganire omu kirorero kimwe omu ruhita rwa Ono.
en: that Sanballat and Geshem sent unto me, saying, Come, let us meet together in some one of the villages in the plain of Ono.

rr: Kwonka bakaba nibenda kuunyita.
en: But they thought to do me mischief.

rr: Naanye nikwo kubatumaho entumwa, nkabagira nti: Ndi aha murimo muhango; tindikubaasa kushuuma okwo. Mbwenu omurimo gwemerere ngu nyizire okwo?
en: And I sent messengers unto them, saying, I am doing a great work, so that I cannot come down: why should the work cease, whilst I leave it, and come down to you?

rr: Bantumaho batyo kana, naanye nimbagarukamu ntyo.
en: Yet they sent unto me four times after this sort; and I answered them after the same manner.

rr: Bwanyima Sanibalati yaagaruka yantumaho omuheereza we omurundi gwa kataano omu muringo ogwo, aine ebaruha eshashaanire omu ngaro ze.
en: Then sent Sanballat his servant unto me in like manner the fifth time with an open letter in his hand;

rr: Egyo baruha ekaba ehandiikirwemu ebigambo ebirikugira biti: Nikigambwa omu mahanga, kandi na Geshemu naakigamba, ngu iwe n'Abayudaaya nimwenda kugoma; ngu nikyo murikwobekyera orugo; kandi ngu, nooyenda kuba omugabe waabo, nk'oku kirikugambwa.
en: wherein was written, It is reported among the heathen, and Gashmu saith it, that thou and the Jews think to rebel: for which cause thou buildest the wall, that thou mayest be their king, according to these words.

rr: Kandi ngu, otaireho na baanabi b'okubuzya ebyawe omuri Yerusaalemu, ngu, Omuri Yuda harimu omugabe.
en: And thou hast also appointed prophets to preach of thee at Jerusalem, saying, There is a king in Judah: and now shall it be reported to the king according to these words.

rr: Mbenu oije tuhanuure, ahabw'okuba ebyo bigambo tibiribura kugambirwa mugabe.
en: Come now therefore, and let us take counsel together.

rr: Naanye naamutumaho, nimmugira nti: Ebyo ebi waagamba tibikabahoga; kureka niiwe waabyegunzira omu mutima gwawe.
en: Then I sent unto him, saying, There are no such things done as thou sayest, but thou feignest them out of thine own heart.

rr: Boona bakaba nibagira batyo, ngu batutiinise, nibateekateeka ngu emikono yaitu neija kutentebuka, omurimo nigureka kukorwa.
en: For they all made us afraid, saying, Their hands shall be weakened from the work, that it be not done.

rr: Kwonak ai Ruhanga, gumya emikono yangye.
en: Now therefore, O God , strengthen my hands.

rr: Bwanyima naaza owa Shemaaya mwene Delaaya, mwijukuru wa Mehetabeeli, owaabaire akomirwe; yangira ati: Ija tubugaabuganire omu nju ya Ruhanga omuri hekalu, tukingye enyigi zaayo; ahabw'okuba nibaija kukwita, eego, nibaija kukwita nyekiro.
en: Afterward I came unto the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah the son of Mehetabeel, who was shut up; and he said, Let us meet together in the house of God, within the temple, and let us shut the doors of the temple: for they will come to slay thee; yea, in the night will they come to slay thee.

rr: Naamugarukamu nti: Omushaija nkaanye nimbaasa kuhunga? ni mushaija ki nkaanye orikubaasa kuhungira omuri hekalu, ngu akire?
en: And I said, Should such a man as I flee? and who is there , that, being as I am , would go into the temple to save his life?

rr: Tindikuzamu.
en: I will not go in.

rr: Ku naayetegyereize, naamanya ku atatumirwe Ruhanga, kureka ku yandaguraho atyo, ahabw'okuguriirirwa Tobia na Sanibalati.
en: And, lo, I perceived that God had not sent him; but that he pronounced this prophecy against me: for Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.

rr: Eki baamuguriririire, bakenda ngu antiinise, haza naanye nkore ntyo, nshiishe, ekiraarugyemu bangambeho kubi, banshekyerere.
en: Therefore was he hired, that I should be afraid, and do so, and sin, and that they might have matter for an evil report, that they might reproach me.

rr: Ai Ruhanga wangye, ijuka Tobia na Sanibalati, n'ebyo byona ebi barikukora, oijukye na nabikazi Noadia, na baanabi abandi boona, ababaire nibenda kuntiinisa.
en: My God, think thou upon Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works, and on the prophetess Noadiah, and the rest of the prophets, that would have put me in fear.

rr: Okuhwa kw'orugo
en: The Wall Finished

rr: Rutyo orugo rwahwa aha kiro kya makumi abiri na bitaano ky'okwezi Eluli omu biro makumi ataano na bibiri.
en: So the wall was finished in the twenty and fifth day of the month Elul, in fifty and two days.

rr: Bwanyima abazigu baitu boona ku baakihuriire, n'amahanga goona agatwehinguririize gaakireeba, baatiina, baahwera kimwe eishaija, ahabw'okuba bakareeba ngu ogwo murimo gukozirwe ahabw'okuhwerwa Ruhanga waitu.
en: And it came to pass, that when all our enemies heard thereof , and all the heathen that were about us saw these things , they were much cast down in their own eyes: for they perceived that this work was wrought of our God.

rr: Kandi omu biro ebyo abakungu b'Abayudaaya bakatwekyera Tobia ebaruha nyingi, n'eza Tobia zaabahikaho.
en: Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters unto Tobiah, and the letters of Tobiah came unto them.

rr: Ahabw'eokuba baingi omuri Yuda bakaragaana nawe endagaano ahabw'okuba mukwe wa Shekania mwene Aara, kandi n'omutabani Yehohanani akaba ashweire muhara wa Meshulaamu mwene Berekia.
en: For there were many in Judah sworn unto him, because he was the son in law of Shechaniah the son of Arah; and his son Johanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah.

rr: Kandi baagambira omu maisho gangye ebirungi ebi akora, baagaruka baamugambira n'ebigambo byangye.
en: Also they reported his good deeds before me, and uttered my words to him.

rr: Atyo Tobia yaaguma nantwekyera ebaruha z'okuntiinisa.
en: And Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear.

rr: Currently Selected: Nehemia 6 : RR64 Highlight Share <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8 19c-2.828 0-4
Bwanyima orugo ku rwahweire, naaheza kutaho enyigi, n'okutaho abakumiirizi, abeeshongozi n'Abaleevi
en: Now it came to pass, when the wall was built, and I had set up the doors, and the porters and the singers and the Levites were appointed,

rr: naaha mwene tata Hanani na Hanania omukuru w'ekigo obukuru bw'okutegyeka Yerusaalemu, ahabw'okuba akaba ari omuntu orikwesigwa kandi orikutiina Ruhanga okukira abandi baingi.
en: that I gave my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the ruler of the palace, charge over Jerusalem: for he was a faithful man, and feared God above many.

rr: Bwanyima naabagira nti: Enyigi za Yerusaalemu zigume zirekye kwigurwa, omushana gutakajwire; bagume bazikingye, abarizi bakyemereireho, baziteho empimbi; kandi mugum muteho abarinzi b'omu bantu ba Yerusaalemu, buri muntu mumute omu mwanya gwe, aharikureebana n'enju ye.
en: And I said unto them, Let not the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun be hot; and while they stand by, let them shut the doors, and bar them: and appoint watches of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, every one in his watch, and every one to be over against his house.

rr: Orurembo rukaba ruri ruhango kandi rugarami, kwonka abantu baamwo bakaba bari bakye, n'amaju gaarwo gatakombekirwe.
en: Now the city was large and great: but the people were few therein, and the houses were not builded.

rr: Amaziina g'abaarugire omu bukwatwa
en: Register of the Exiles

rr: Bwanyima Ruhanga wangye yantamu ekiteekateeko ky'okuteerana abakungu n'abategyeki n'abanei bantu, ngu babarwe nk'okukuratana kw'oruzaaro rwabo oku kwabairie kuri.
en: And my God put into mine heart to gather together the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, that they might be reckoned by genealogy.

rr: Naazoora ekitambo ekirimu abaabandize kwija, nk'okukuratana kw'oruzaaro oku kwabaire kuri; kandi naashanga kihandiikirwemu kiti
en: And I found a register of the genealogy of them which came up at the first, and found written therein,

rr: —3:1. Aba nibo bantu b'eryo ihanga abaarugire omu bantu, abu Nebukadeneeza omugabe wa Babulooni yaatwaire bari enkwatwa, bakagaruka Yerusaalemu na Yuda, buri muntu omu rurembo rwabo.
en: These are the children of the province, that went up out of the captivity, of those that had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away, and came again to Jerusalem and to Judah, every one unto his city;

rr: Bakaija na Zerubabeeli, Yehsua, Nehemia, Azaria, Raamia, Nahamaani, Morodekai, Bilushaani, Biguvai, Nehumu na Baana.
en: who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah.

rr: Omubaro gw'abashaija b'Abaisraeli nigwo ogu
en: The number, I say , of the men of the people of Israel was this ;

rr: beene Paroshi enkumi ibiri na igana na makumi mushanju na babiri.
en: the children of Parosh, two thousand an hundred seventy and two.

rr: Beene Shefatia, magana mushanju na makumi mushanju na babiri.
en: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred seventy and two.

rr: Beene Aara, magana mukaaga na makumi ataano na babiri.
en: The children of Arah, six hundred fifty and two.

rr: Beene Pehasi-moabu, nibo beene Yeshua na Yoabu, enkumi ibiri na magana munaana na ikumi na munaana.
en: The children of Pahath-moab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand and eight hundred and eighteen.

rr: Beene Elamu, rukumi na magana abiri na makumi ataano na bana.
en: The children of Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.

rr: Beene Zaatu, magana munaana na makumi ana na bataano.
en: The children of Zattu, eight hundred forty and five.

rr: Beene Zekai, magana mushanju na makumi mukaaga.
en: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred and threescore.

rr: Beene Binui, magana mukaaga na makumi ana na munaana.
en: The children of Binnui, six hundred forty and eight.

rr: Beene Bebai, magana mukaaga na makumi abiri na munaana.
en: The children of Bebai, six hundred twenty and eight.

rr: Beene Azigaadi, enkumi ibiri na magana ashatu na makumi abiri na babiri.
en: The children of Azgad, two thousand three hundred twenty and two.

rr: Beene Adoni-kaamu, magana mukaaga na makumi mukaaga na mushanju.
en: The children of Adonikam, six hundred threescore and seven.

rr: Beene Viguvai, enkumi ibiri na makumi mukaaga na mushanju.
en: The children of Bigvai, two thousand threescore and seven.

rr: Beene Adini, magana mukaaga na makumi ataano na bataano.
en: The children of Adin, six hundred fifty and five.

rr: Beene Ateeri, nibo ba Hezekia, makumi mwenda na munaana.
en: The children of Ater of Hezekiah, ninety and eight.

rr: Beene Hashumu, magana ashatu na makumi abiri na munaana.
en: The children of Hashum, three hundred twenty and eight.

rr: Beene Bezai, magana ashatu na makumi abiri na bana.
en: The children of Bezai, three hundred twenty and four.

rr: Beene Harifu, igana na ikumi na babiri.
en: The children of Hariph, an hundred and twelve.

rr: Beene Gibeoni, makumi mwenda na bataano.
en: The children of Gibeon, ninety and five.

rr: Abashaija ba Betelehemu na Netofa, igana na makumi munaana na munaana.
en: The men of Beth-lehem and Netophah, an hundred fourscore and eight.

rr: Abashaija ba Anatoosi, igana na makumi abiri na munaana.
en: The men of Anathoth, an hundred twenty and eight.

rr: Abashaija ba Besi-azimaveesi, makumi ana na babiri.
en: The men of Beth-azmaveth, forty and two.

rr: Abashaija ba Kirayasi-yarimu, Kefira na Beeroosi, magana mushanju na makumi ana na bashatu.
en: The men of Kirjath-jearim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred forty and three.

rr: Abashaija ba Raama na Geeba, magana mukaaga na makumi abiri n'omwe.
en: The men of Ramah and Gaba, six hundred twenty and one.

rr: Beene Mikimaasi, igana na makumi abiri na babiri.
en: The men of Michmas, an hundred and twenty and two.

rr: Abashaija ba Beseeli na Ai, igana na makumi abiri na bashatu.
en: The men of Beth-el and Ai, an hundred twenty and three.

rr: Abashaija ba Neebo endiijo, makumi ataano na babiri.
en: The men of the other Nebo, fifty and two.

rr: Beene Harimu, magana ashatu na makumi abiri.
en: The children of Harim, three hundred and twenty.

rr: Beene Yeriko magana ashatu na makumi ana na bataano.
en: The children of Jericho, three hundred forty and five.

rr: Beene Loodi, Hadidi na Ono, magana mushanju na makumi abiri n'omwe.
en: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred twenty and one.

rr: Beene Senaha, enkumi ishatu na magana mwenda na makumi ashatu.
en: The children of Senaah, three thousand nine hundred and thirty.

rr: Abanyamurwa n'aba: beene Yedaaya ab'omu nju ya Yeshua, magana mwenda na makumi mushanju na bashatu.
en: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy and three.

rr: Beene Imeri, rukumi na magana ataano na babiri.
en: The children of Immer, a thousand fifty and two.

rr: Beene Pashihuuri, rukumi na magana abiri na makumi ana na mushanju.
en: The children of Pashur, a thousand two hundred forty and seven.

rr: Beene Harimu, rukumi na ikumi na mushanju.
en: The children of Harim, a thousand and seventeen.

rr: Abaleevi n'aba: beene Yeshua ba Kadimieli ow'omuri beene Hodeva, makumi mushanju na bana.
en: The Levites: the children of Jeshua, of Kadmiel, and of the children of Hodevah, seventy and four.

rr: Abeeshongozi beene Asafu, igana na makumi ana na munaana.
en: The singers: the children of Asaph, an hundred forty and eight.

rr: Abakumiirizi: beene Shalumu, beene Ateeri, beene Talumooni, beene Akubu, beene Hatita na beene Shobai, igana na makumi ashatu na munaana.
en: The porters: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, an hundred thirty and eight.

rr: Abaheereza b'omuri hekalu bakaba bari aba: beene Ziiha, beene Hasufa, beene Tabaosi
en: The Nethinims: the children of Ziha, the children of Hashupha, the children of Tabbaoth,

rr: beene Kerosi, beene Siaha, beene Padoni
en: the children of Keros, the children of Sia, the children of Padon,

rr: beene Lebana, beene Hagaba, beene Shalumai
en: the children of Lebana, the children of Hagaba, the children of Shalmai,

rr: beene Hanani, beene Gideli, beene Gahaari
en: the children of Hanan, the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar,

rr: beene Reaya, beene Rezini, beene Nekoda
en: the children of Reaiah, the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda,

rr: beene Gazamu, beene Uzza, beene Pasea
en: the children of Gazzam, the children of Uzza, the children of Phaseah,

rr: beene Besai, beene Meunimu, beene Nefushesimu
en: the children of Besai, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephishesim,

rr: beene Bakibuki, beene Hakufa, beene Harihuri
en: the children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,

rr: beene Baziluusi, beene Mehida, beene Harisha
en: the children of Bazlith, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,

rr: beene Barikoosi, beene Sisera, beene Teema
en: the children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Tamah,

rr: beene Nezia, na beene Hatifa.
en: the children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.

rr: Batabani b'abagaragwa ba Sulemaani: beene Sotai, beene Soferesi, beene Perida
en: The children of Solomon's servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Perida,

rr: beene Yaala, beene Darikoni, beene Gideli
en: the children of Jaala, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,

rr: beene Shefatia, beene Hatili, beene Pokeresi-hazebaimu, na beene Amoni.
en: the children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth of Zebaim, the children of Amon.

rr: Abaheereza b'omuri hekalu boona na batabani b'abagaragwa ba Sulemaani bakaba bari magana ashatu na makumi mwenda na babiri.
en: All the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon's servants, were three hundred ninety and two.

rr: Kandi aba nibo baarugire Telimeela, Teliharasha, Kerubu, Adoni na Imeri, kwonak tibarabaasize kworeka maju ga baishenkurubo, nari obukomooko bwabo, kuhamya ku bari Abaisraeli buzima
en: And these were they which went up also from Tel-melah, Tel-haresha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer: but they could not shew their father's house, nor their seed, whether they were of Israel.

rr: beene Delaaya, beene Tobia, na beene Nekoda, magana mukaaga na makumi ana na babiri.
en: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred forty and two.

rr: Kandi ab'omu banyamurwa; beene Hobaaya, beene Hakozi, na beene Baruzilai, owaashweire omukazi ow'omuri bahara ba Baruzilai owa Gileadi, akeetererwa eiziina ryabo.
en: And of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Koz, the children of Barzillai, which took one of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite to wife, and was called after their name.

rr: Abo bakasheura amaziina gaabo omu baahandiikirwe nk'okukuratana kw'oruzaaro rwa baishenkurubo oku kwabaire kuri, kwonka tigaareebgekamu; nikyo baateekateekyeirwe kuba abatashemeire, bakazibirwa kukora omurimo gw'obunyamurwa
en: These sought their register among those that were reckoned by genealogy, but it was not found: therefore were they, as polluted, put from the priesthood.

rr: omutegyeki omukuru yaabaragiira ngu barekye kurya aha by'okurya ebirikwera, okuhitsya obu haribaho omunyamurwa oine Urimu na Tumimu.
en: And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and Thummim.

rr: Omutwe gw'abo bantu boona gukaba guri obukumi buna n'enkumi ibiri na magana ashatu na makumi mukaaga
en: The whole congregation together was forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore,

rr: otabariiremu abahuuku baabo n'abazaana baabo, abu omubaro gwabo gwabaire guri enkumi mushanju na magana ashatu na makumi ashatu na mushanju; kandi bakaba baine abeeshongozi, abashaija n'abakazi, magana abiri na makumi ana na bataano.
en: beside their manservants and their maidservants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven: and they had two hundred forty and five singing men and singing women.

rr: Embaraasi zaabo zikaba ziri magana mushanju na makumi ashatu na mukaaga, enyumbu magana abiri na makumi ana na itaano
en: Their horses, seven hundred thirty and six: their mules, two hundred forty and five:

rr: engamira magana ana na makumi ashatu na itaano, n'endogoya enkumi mukaaga na magana mushanju na makumi abiri.
en: their camels, four hundred thirty and five: six thousand seven hundred and twenty asses.

rr: Kandi bamwe ab'omu bakuru b'amaju ga baishenkurubo baahayo eby'okuhwera omurimo.
en: And some of the chief of the fathers gave unto the work.

rr: Omutegyeki yaata omu ibiikiro dariki z'ezaabu rukumi, enyabya makumi ataano, n'ebijwaro by'abanyamurwa magana ataano na makumi ashatu.
en: The Tirshatha gave to the treasure a thousand drams of gold, fifty basons, five hundred and thirty priests' garments.

rr: N'abamwe ab'omu bakuru b'amaju ga baishenkurubo baata omu ibiikiro ry'empiiha z'omurimo dariki z'ezaabu obukumi bubiri, na miina z'efeeza enkumi ibiri na magana abiri.
en: And some of the chief of the fathers gave to the treasure of the work twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand and two hundred pound of silver.

rr: Ebi abandi bantu baahaireyo bikaba biri dariki z'ezaabu obukumi bubiri, miina z'efeeza enkumi ibiri, n'ebijwaro by'abanyamurwa makumi mukaaga na mushanju.
en: And that which the rest of the people gave was twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand pound of silver, and threescore and seven priests' garments.

rr: Batyo abanyamurwa, Abaleevi, abakumirizi, abeeshongozi, abamwe omu bantu, abaheerea b'omuri hekalu, n'Abaisraeli boona, baatuura omu ndembo zaabo. Okwezi kwa mushanju ku kwahikire, Abaisraeli baashangwa batwire omu ndembo zaabo. en: So the priests, and the Levites, and the porters, and the singers, and some of the people, and the Nethinims, and all Israel, dwelt in their cities; and when the seventh month came, the children of Israel were in their cities. rr: Bwanyima abantu baateeranira hamwe nk'omuntu omwe omu kubuga ekiri omu maisho g'eirembo ry'Amaizi, baagambira Ezera omuhandiiki kureeta ekitabo ky'Ebiragiro bya Musa, ebi Ruhanga yaahaire Abaisraeli.
en: And all the people gathered themselves together as one man into the street that was before the water gate; and they spake unto Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which the LORD had commanded to Israel.

rr: Aha kiro ky'okubanza ky'okwezi kwa mushanju Ezera omunyamurwa yaareeta ekyo kitabo ky'Ebiragiro omu maisho g'omutwe gw'abashaija n'abakazi, boona abaabaire nibabaasa kuhurira, bakeetegyereza.
en: And Ezra the priest brought the law before the congregation both of men and women, and all that could hear with understanding, upon the first day of the seventh month.

rr: Yaashoma ebirimu, ayorekyeire ekibuga ekiri omu maisho g'eirembo ry'Amaizi, okwiha omu kasheeshe kare okuhitsya omu ihangwe, abashaija n'abakazi n'abandi abrikubaasa kwetegyereza bariho; kandi abantu boona baatega amatu kuhurira eby'omuri ekyo kitabo ky'Ebiragiro.
en: And he read therein before the street that was before the water gate from the morning until midday, before the men and the women, and those that could understand; and the ears of all the people were attentive unto the book of the law.

rr: Kandi Ezera omuhandiiki yaayemerera aha kituuti ky'embaaho, eki baabaire bakozire ahabw'ogwo murimo; aha rubaju rwe rwa buryo haayemereraho Matisia, Sheema, Anaya, Uriya, Hilukia na Maaseya; n'aha rwa bumosho, Pedaaya, Mishaeli, Malikiya, Hashumu, Hashibadana, Zekaria na Meshulaamu.
en: And Ezra the scribe stood upon a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, and Shema, and Anaiah, and Urijah, and Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, and Mishael, and Malchiah, and Hashum, and Hashbadana, Zechariah, and Meshullam.

rr: Atyo Ezera yaashuuruurira ekitabo omu maisho g'abantu boona, ahakuba akaba ari ahatunguukire naabeeshumba; ku yaakishuurwire, abantu boona baayemerera.
en: And Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people; (for he was above all the people;) and when he opened it, all the people stood up:

rr: Ezera yaasiima MUKAMA Ruhanga omukuru, n'abantu boona baikiriza nibaimutsya emikono yaabo, nibagira bati: Amiina, Amiina; bainika emitwe yaabo, baaramya MUKAMA bajuumaire ahansi.
en: and Ezra blessed the LORD , the great God. And all the people answered, Amen, Amen, with lifting up their hands: and they bowed their heads, and worshipped the LORD with their faces to the ground.

rr: Kandi Yeshua, Baani, Sherebia, Yamiina, Akubu, Shabetai, Hodia, Maaseya, Kelita, Azaria, Yozabaadi, Hanani, Pelaaya, Abaleevi, baahwera abantu kwetegyereza Ebiragiro; obwo abantu boona bari omu myanya yaabo.
en: Also Jeshua, and Bani, and Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodijah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites, caused the people to understand the law: and the people stood in their place.

rr: Baashoma omu kitabo ky'Ebiragiro bya Ruhanga omu iraka eririkuhurirwa gye, baabishoboorora; n'ahabw'ekyo abantu baayetegyereza ebyashomwa.
en: So they read in the book in the law of God distinctly, and gave the sense, and caused them to understand the reading.

rr: Kandi Nehemia, owaabaire ari omutegyeki, na Ezera omunyamurwa kandi omuhandiiki, n'Abaleevi abaabaire nibeegyesa abantu, baagambira abantu boona bati: Eizooba eri n'eririkwera ahari MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu; murekye kuganya, nari kurira.
en: And Nehemiah, which is the Tirshatha, and Ezra the priest the scribe, and the Levites that taught the people, said unto all the people, This day is holy unto the LORD your God; mourn not, nor weep.

rr: Ahabw'okuba abantu boona ku baahuriire ebigambo by'Ebiragiro, baarira.
en: For all the people wept, when they heard the words of the law.

rr: Bwanyima yaabagira ati: Mwirooko murye ez'ebishaju, munywe ebirikunuriirira, mutwekyere abataine obabisiire egabo; ahakuba eri izooba n'eryereziibwe Mukama waitu; kandi murekye kushaasha, ahabw'eokuba okushemerererwa omuri MUKAMA nigo maani gaanyu.
en: Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our Lord: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the LORD is your strength.

rr: Batyo Abaalevi baahunamya abantu boona nibagira bati: Mucureere, ahakuba eizooba eri n'eririkwera; murekye kushaasha.
en: So the Levites stilled all the people, saying, Hold your peace, for the day is holy; neither be ye grieved.

rr: Bwanyima abantu boona baayaabuuka, baaza kurya n'okunywa kandi n'okutwekyera bagyenzi baabo egabo, n'okushemererwa munonga, ahabw'okushoborokyerwa ebigambo ebi baagambirwa. Okugaruraho obugyenyi bw'Ensiisira
en: And all the people went their way to eat, and to drink, and to send portions, and to make great mirth, because they had understood the words that were declared unto them.

rr: Aha kiro kya kabiri abakuru b'amaju ga baishenkuru ab'eihanga ryona, hamwe n'abanyamurwa n'Abaleevi, baateeranira ahari Ezera omuhandiiki kuhurira ebigambo by'omu Biragiro.
en: And on the second day were gathered together the chief of the fathers of all the people, the priests, and the Levites, unto Ezra the scribe, even to understand the words of the law.

rr: Baashanga bihandiikirwe omu Biragiro, ebi MUKAMA yaaragiire naaraba omuri Musa, ngu Abaisraeli baryaguma nibaraara omu nsiisira omu bugyenyi bw'okwezi kwa mushanju
en: And they found written in the law which the LORD had commanded by Moses, that the children of Israel should dwell in booths in the feast of the seventh month:

rr: kandi baryaguma babirangye, babibuzye omu ndembo zaabo zoona n'omuri Yerusaalemu, nibagira bati: Mwirooko muze omu bibungo, mureete amataagi g'emizeituuni, n'ag'emizeituuni ey'omu ishwa, n'ag'emikadasi, n'ag'emikindo, n'ag'ebiti by'amababi gashakambire, mukore ensiisira, nk'oku kyahandiikirwe.
en: and that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities, and in Jerusalem, saying, Go forth unto the mount, and fetch olive branches, and pine branches, and myrtle branches, and palm branches, and branches of thick trees, to make booths, as it is written.

rr: Batyo abantu baagyenda, baareeta amataagi, baayeyombekyera ensiisira, buri muntu aha mutwe gw'enju ye, n'omu bibuga byabo, n'omu bikaari by'enju ya Ruhanga, n'omu kibuga ky'aha Irembo ry'Amaizi, kandi n'omu kibuga ky'aha irembo rya Efuraimu.
en: So the people went forth, and brought them , and made themselves booths, every one upon the roof of his house, and in their courts, and in the courts of the house of God, and in the street of the water gate, and in the street of the gate of Ephraim.

rr: Omutwe gwona ogw'abaarugire omu bukwatwa baayombeka ensiisira, baaziraaramu; ahakub aokwiha omu biro bya Yoshua mwene Nuuni okuhitsya ahari eryo izooba Abaisraeli bakaba batakakitwazaga batyo.
en: And all the congregation of them that were come again out of the captivity made booths, and sat under the booths: for since the days of Jeshua the son of Nun unto that day had not the children of Israel done so.

rr: Haabaho okushemererwa kwingi munonga.
en: And there was very great gladness.

rr: Kandi okwiha aha kiro ky'okubanza okuhitsya aha ky'aha muheru, Ezera akaba ashoma ekitabo ky'Ebiragiro bya Ruhanga buri izooba.
en: Also day by day, from the first day unto the last day, he read in the book of the law of God.

rr: Batyo baamara ebiro mushanju omuri obwo bugyenyi; aha kya munaana haabaho okuteerana okurikwera, nk'oku ekiragiro kyabaire kiri.
en: And they kept the feast seven days; and on the eighth day was a solemn assembly, according unto the manner.

rr: Bwanyima aha kiro kya makumi abiri na bina ky'okwo kwezi Abaisraeli baateerana, baayesiibyakwo bajwaire ebiguniya, beeshukyeire eiju omu mutwe.
en: Now in the twenty and fourth day of this month the children of Israel were assembled with fasting, and with sackclothes, and earth upon them.

rr: Kandi Abaisraeli baayetaanisa n'abanyamahanga boona, baayemerera, baayatura ebibi byabo, n'eby'okushisha bya baishenkurubo.
en: And the seed of Israel separated themselves from all strangers, and stood and confessed their sins, and the iniquities of their fathers.

rr: Baayemerera omu mwanya gwabo, baamara ekicweka kimwe kya kana ky'eizooba nibasho ekitabo ky'Ebiragiro bya MUKAMA Ruhanga waabo; kandi ekindi kicweka kimwe kya kana baakimara nibaatura ebibi byabo, nibaramya MUKAMA Ruhanga waabo.
en: And they stood up in their place, and read in the book of the law of the LORD their God one fourth part of the day; and another fourth part they confessed, and worshipped the LORD their God.

rr: Bwanyima Yeshua, Baani, Kadimieli, Sebania, Buuni, Sherebia, Baani na Kenani, baayemerera aha matembero g'Abaleevi, baatakira MUKAMA Ruhanga waabo n'eiraka rihango.
en: Then stood up upon the stairs, of the Levites, Jeshua, and Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani, and cried with a loud voice unto the LORD their God. The Confession

rr: Bwanyima Abaleevi, Yeshua, Kadimieli, Baani, Hashabuneya, Sherebia, Hodia, Shebania na Pesahia, baagira bati: Mwimukye, musiime MUKAMA, oba Ruhanga waanyu okwiha ira ryona okuhitsya ebiro byona, nimugira muti: Eiziina ryawe ery'ekitiinisa, eririkukira okusiimwa kwona n'okusingizibwa kwona, rihimbisibwe.
en: Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabniah, Sherebiah, Hodijah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah, said, Stand up and bless the LORD your God for ever and ever: and blessed be thy glorious name, which is exalted above all blessing and praise.

rr: Kandi Ezera yaagira ati: niiwe MUKAMA, niiwe wenka, owaahangire eiguru n'eiguru eririkweshumba agandi, n'eihe ryaryo ryona, ensi n'ebigirimu byona, n'amayanja n'ebigarimu byona; kandi niiwe obibaisaho byona; n'amahe g'omu iguru goona gakuramya.
en: Thou, even thou, art LORD alone; thou hast made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their host, the earth, and all things that are therein, the seas, and all that is therein, and thou preservest them all; and the host of heaven worshippeth thee.

rr: Niiwe MUKAMA, Ruhanga owaatooraine Abramu, okamwiha omuri Uuri ey'Abakaludaaya, okamweta eiziina Abrahamu
en: Thou art the LORD the God, who didst choose Abram, and broughtest him forth out of Ur of the Chaldees, and gavest him the name of Abraham;

rr: -21 ; 17:7-9 ; . okashanga aine omutima ogurikwesigwa omu maisho gaawe, okaragaana nawe endagaano y'okuha abaijukuru ensi y'Abanyakanaani, ey'Abahiiti, ey'Abaamori, ey'Abaperizi, ey'Abayebusi n'ey'Abagirugashi; kandi ebyo ebi waaraganiise okabihikiiriza, ahabw'okuba ori ohikiriire.
en: and foundest his heart faithful before thee, and madest a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Jebusites, and the Girgashites, to give it, I say , to his seed, and hast performed thy words; for thou art righteous:

rr: Bwanyima waareeba okubonabonesibwa kwa baatatenkuriitwe bari Misri, waahurira okutaka kwabo bari aha Nyanja erikutukura
en: and didst see the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heardest their cry by the Red sea;

rr: -6 ; 9:16 ; 18:11 ; . waayoreka obumanyiso n'eby'okutangaaza ebi waakozire ahari Faraho n'abagaragwa be n'abantu b'omu nsi ye boona; ahabw'okuba okamanya oku baagizire baatatenkuriitwe n'amaryo; ekyarugiremu waayetungira eiziina rugambwa, nk'oku kiri na hati.
en: and shewedst signs and wonders upon Pharaoh, and on all his servants, and on all the people of his land: for thou knewest that they dealt proudly against them. So didst thou get thee a name, as it is this day.

rr: Bwanyima waataanisamu enyanja habiri omu maisho gaabo, baaraba ahagati yaayo hoomire, kwonka abaabaire babakuratiire waabanaga ahagati y'amaizi, baatobera omu maiszi maingi nk'eibaare.
en: And thou didst divide the sea before them, so that they went through the midst of the sea on the dry land; and their persecutors thou threwest into the deeps, as a stone into the mighty waters.

rr: Kandi nyomushana okaba obeebembera n'enyomyo y'ekicu, na nyekiro obeebembera n'enyomyo y'omuriro, kubamurikira omuhanda ogu bashemereire kutoora.
en: Moreover thou leddest them in the day by a cloudy pillar; and in the night by a pillar of fire, to give them light in the way wherein they should go.

rr: -17 ; . Okashuuma aha rushozi Sinai, waagamba nabo nooyema omu iguru, waabateeraho emigyenzo ehikire n'ebiragiro by'amazima, ebyatairweho ebirungi, n'ebyaragiirwe
en: Thou camest down also upon mount Sinai, and spakest with them from heaven, and gavest them right judgments, and true laws, good statutes and commandments:

rr: -11 ; 31:13-17 ; . waabamanyisa sabato yaawe erikwera, waabaragiira nooraba omu mwiru waawe Musa ebiragiro n'ebyatairweho, byaba ebiragiro byawe.
en: and madest known unto them thy holy sabbath, and commandedst them precepts, statutes, and laws, by the hand of Moses thy servant:

rr: -16 , 24 , 25 ; 105:40 , 41 ; . Ku baagizire enjara, waabaha eby'okurya ebirikuruga omu iguru; ku baagizire eiriho, waabaihira amaizi omu rukiri, waabaragiira kuza omu nsi ei waarahiire kubaha, ngu bagikubuure.
en: and gavest them bread from heaven for their hunger, and broughtest forth water for them out of the rock for their thirst, and promisedst them that they should go in to possess the land which thou hadst sworn to give them.

rr: Kwonka bo na baatatenkuriitwe baagira amaryo, baagangaaza ebitsya byabo, tibaayorobera biragiro byawe
en: But they and our fathers dealt proudly, and hardened their necks, and hearkened not to thy commandments,

rr: baayanga kuhurira, kandi tibaijuka by'okutangaaza, ebi waakoreire omuribo; kureka baagangaaza ebitsya byabo, kandi ahabw'obugomi bwabo baayeteeraho omwebembezi, ngu bagarukye Misri omu buhuuku bwabo. Kwonka Iwe ori Ruhanga oyeteekateekire kusaasira, oine embabazi n'esaasi, otarahuka kuguubwa kubi, kureka ogira okukunda okutaruga ha rugyero; torabarekire.
en: and refused to obey, neither were mindful of thy wonders that thou didst among them; but hardened their necks, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage: but thou art a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and forsookest them not.

rr: Nangwa n'obu baayeheeshera ekishushani ky'enyana bakagira bati: Ogu niwe Ruhanga waanyu, owaabaihire omu nsi ya Misri, bakakora ebirikukugwisa kubi ebirengyesereize
en: Yea, when they had made them a molten calf, and said, This is thy God that brought thee up out of Egypt, and had wrought great provocations;

rr: kwonka Iwe ahabw'embabazi zaawe nyingi torabatsigireho bari omu ihamba; enyomyo y'ekicu ey'okubeebembera omu muhanda nyomushana ekaba etabaruga mumaisho, n'obu yaakuba ey'omuriro kubamurikira nyekiro kubooreka ei baraatoore.
en: yet thou in thy manifold mercies forsookest them not in the wilderness: the pillar of the cloud departed not from them by day, to lead them in the way; neither the pillar of fire by night, to shew them light, and the way wherein they should go.

rr: Waabaha Omwoyo waawe omurungi kubeegyesa, kandi tiwaabaima maanu yaawe kubura eky'okurya, waabaha amaizi kubatambira eiriho.
en: Thou gavest also thy good spirit to instruct them, and withheldest not thy manna from their mouth, and gavest them water for their thirst.

rr: Waabatungira omu ihamba okumara emyka makumi ana, tibaagira ki baakyena; ebijwaro byabo tibyakura, n'ebigyere byabo tibyazimba.
en: Yea, forty years didst thou sustain them in the wilderness, so that they lacked nothing; their clothes waxed not old, and their feet swelled not.

rr: -31 ; 33:35 . Waabaha ensi z'abagabe, n'amahanga nk'oku emigabo yaabo yaabaire eri; batyo baakubuura ensi ya Sihooni omugabe wa Heshibooni, n'eya Ogi omugabe wa Bashani.
en: Moreover thou gavest them kingdoms and nations, and didst divide them into corners: so they possessed the land of Sihon, and the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.

rr: Waakanyisa oruzaaro rwabo, rwaba nk'enyonyoozi z'omu iguru, waabahitsya omu nsi, ei waagambiire baishenkurubo ku barigizamu, bakagikubuura.
en: Their children also multipliedst thou as the stars of heaven, and broughtest them into the land, concerning which thou hadst promised to their fathers, that they should go in to possess it .

rr: Batyo baijukuru baabo baaza omuri egyo nsi, baagikubuura; Abanyakanaani abatuuzi b'omuri egyo nsi, waabasingurira omu maisho gaabo, waabahayo omu mikono yaabo hamwe n'abagabe baabo n'abantu baamwo, kubagira nk'oku barikwenda.
en: So the children went in and possessed the land, and thou subduedst before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and gavest them into their hands, with their kings, and the people of the land, that they might do with them as they would.

rr: Bwanyima baakwata endembo ezeehinguririziibwe engo z'amabaare, n'ensi ezirikweza munonga, baakubuura amaju agaijwire ebintu byona ebirungi, n'amaziba agafukwire, n'emisiri y'emizaabibu n'ey'emizeituuni n'ey'ebiti bingi ebirikwana ebijuma; batyo baarya, baahaaga, baagomoka, baashemerererwa omu burungi bwawe bwingi.
en: And they took strong cities, and a fat land, and possessed houses full of all goods, wells digged, vineyards, and oliveyards, and fruit trees in abundance: so they did eat, and were filled, and became fat, and delighted themselves in thy great goodness.

rr: Nikyo waabaheereireyo omu mikono y'abazigu baabo, bakabaita kubi; kwonka omu biro by'obusaasi bakaba bakutakira, obahurira oyemi omu iguru, kandi nk'oku embabazi zaawe ziba nyingi, obaha ab'okubajuna, babaiha omu mikono y'abazigu baabo.
en: Therefore thou deliveredst them into the hand of their enemies, who vexed them: and in the time of their trouble, when they cried unto thee, thou heardest them from heaven; and according to thy manifold mercies thou gavest them saviours, who saved them out of the hand of their enemies.

rr: Kwonka ku baabaire bamara ebiro baagira obusingye, bagaruka bakora ebi orikwanga; nikyo waabaire obarekyera omu mikono y'abazigu baabo, bakabatwara; kwonka ku baabaire bahinduka, baakutakira, obahurira oyemi omu iguru, emirundi mingi obajuna, nk'oku embabazi zaawe ziri.
en: But after they had rest, they did evil again before thee: therefore leftest thou them in the hand of their enemies, so that they had the dominion over them: yet when they returned, and cried unto thee, thou heardest them from heaven; and many times didst thou deliver them according to thy mercies;

rr: Okaba obateisa, ngu obone kubagarura, boorobere ebiragiro byawe. Kwonka bagira amaryo, banga kubyorobera, bashiisha ebiragiro ebi waaragiire, haza biri ebi omuntu yaakukozire, bikamubaisaho, batunika amabega gaabo, bagangaaza ebitsya, banga kuhurira.
en: and testifiedst against them, that thou mightest bring them again unto thy law: yet they dealt proudly, and hearkened not unto thy commandments, but sinned against thy judgments, (which if a man do, he shall live in them;) and withdrew the shoulder, and hardened their neck, and would not hear.

rr: Obagumisiririza emyaka mingi, obateisa n'Omwoyo waawe noogambira omuri baanabi baawe; kwonka banga kutega amatu kuhurira. Nikyo waabaire obaheerayo omu mikono y'amahanga g'omu nsi ezo.
en: Yet many years didst thou forbear them, and testifiedst against them by thy spirit in thy prophets: yet would they not give ear: therefore gavest thou them into the hand of the people of the lands.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo, ai Ruhanga waitu, Ruhanga Nyamuhanga ow'amaani kandi orikutiinwa, otaita ndagaano, kandi ow'okukunda okutaruga ha rugyero, noomanya enaku zoona ezi twareebire, itwe n'abagabe baitu, abanyiginya baitu, abanyamurwa baitu, baanabi baitu, baatatenkuriitwe, n'abantu baawe boona, okwiha omu busingye bw'abagabe ba Asiria n'okuhitsya hati, ezo naku orekye kuzeeta busha.
en: Now therefore, our God, the great, the mighty, and the terrible God, who keepest covenant and mercy, let not all the trouble seem little before thee, that hath come upon us, on our kings, on our princes, and on our priests, and on our prophets, and on our fathers, and on all thy people, since the time of the kings of Assyria unto this day.

rr: Kwonka omuri ebyo byona ebyatubaireho, okaguma ori ow'amazima; ahakuba Iwe okakora eby'obwesigwa, haza itwe twakora kubi.
en: Howbeit thou art just in all that is brought upon us; for thou hast done right, but we have done wickedly:

rr: Abagabe baitu, abanyiginya baitu, abanyamurwa baitu, na baatatenkuriitwe tibaroorobeire biragiro byawe, n'obu kwakuba okweta aha bi waaragiire n'ebi waabaire obateisa.
en: neither have our kings, our princes, our priests, nor our fathers, kept thy law, nor hearkened unto thy commandments and thy testimonies, wherewith thou didst testify against them.

rr: Mbwenu reeba, turi abahuuku na hati; turi abahuuku omu nsi ei waahaire baatatenkuriitwe kurya ebijuma byamwo n'ebirungi byamweo byona.
en: Behold, we are servants this day, and for the land that thou gavest unto our fathers to eat the fruit thereof and the good thereof, behold, we are servants in it:

rr: Emyaka yaamwo etungisa munonga abagabe abu waataireho kututegyeka ahabw'ebibi byaitu; kandi abo bagabe baine obushoboorozi aha mibiri yaitu n'aha matungo gaitu, kubikora nk'oku barikwenda; turi omu busaasi bwingi munonga.
en: and it yieldeth much increase unto the kings whom thou hast set over us because of our sins: also they have dominion over our bodies, and over our cattle, at their pleasure, and we are in great distress.

rr: Ahabw'ebyo byona twaza kuragaana endagaano, tugihandiikye, abakuru baitu, Abaleevi baitu n'abanyamurwa baitu, bagiteho akamanyiso kaabo.
en: And because of all this we make a sure covenant , and write it ; and our princes, Levites, and priests, seal unto it .

rr: N'abandi bantu boona, abanyamurwa, Abaleevi, abakumiirizi, abeeshongozi, abaheereza b'omuri hekalu, na boona abaabaire beetaaniise n'amahanga g'omuri egyo nsi, bakoorobera ebiragiro bya Ruhanga, hamwe n'abakazi baabo, batabani baabo, bahara baabo, na boona abaabaire baine obwengye n'okwetegyereza
en: And the rest of the people, the priests, the Levites, the porters, the singers, the Nethinims, and all they that had separated themselves from the people of the lands unto the law of God, their wives, their sons, and their daughters, every one having knowledge, and having understanding;

rr: baakwatanisa na beene waabo n'abakungu baabo, baikiriza eby'omukyeeno n'endahiro, kugyendera omu biragiro bya Ruhanga, ebyahairwe Musa omugaragwa we, n'okworobera ebi MUKAMA, Mukama waitu, yaaragiire byona n'okubihikiiriza, hamwe n'emigyenzo n'eby'oburyo ebi yaataireho.
en: they clave to their brethren, their nobles, and entered into a curse, and into an oath, to walk in God's law, which was given by Moses the servant of God, and to observe and do all the commandments of the LORD our Lord, and his judgments and his statutes;

rr: Kandi baagira bati: Titurishwererana na mahanga ag'omuri egi nsi
en: and that we would not give our daughters unto the people of the land, nor take their daughters for our sons:

rr: kandi abanyamahnga b'omuri egi nsi, ku barireeta ebintu nari eby'okurya byona kubitunda aha kiro kya sabato, tituribigura ha kiro kya sabato, nari aha kiro kikuru kyona; kandi omu mwaka gwa mushanju turyaraaza ensi, turekye kugihinga, n'obu kwakuba okwihuza omuntu weena eibanja.
en: and if the people of the land bring ware or any victuals on the sabbath day to sell, that we would not buy it of them on the sabbath, or on the holy day: and that we would leave the seventh year, and the exaction of every debt.

rr: Kandi twayeteeraho ebiragiro by'okuguma kuha ekicweka kimwe kya kashatu kya shekeli buri mwaka, ahabw'okukora omurimo gw'enju ya Ruhanga waitu
en: Also we made ordinances for us, to charge ourselves yearly with the third part of a shekel for the service of the house of our God;

rr: emigaati y'okumurikwa, empongano z'esaano ezihongwa obutoosha, ebitambo by'okwotsya ebitambwa buri izooba, eby'amasabato, eby'emboneko z'ameezi, eby'ebiro bikuru ebyatairweho, eby'ebintu ebirikwera, eby'empongano z'okwihaho ekibi ez'okurihiirira Abaisraeli, n'eby'emirimo yoona ey'omu nju ya Ruhanga waitu.
en: for the shewbread, and for the continual meat offering, and for the continual burnt offering, of the sabbaths, of the new moons, for the set feasts, and for the holy things , and for the sin offerings to make an atonement for Israel, and for all the work of the house of our God.

rr: Kandi twateerera enteenyu abanyamurwa, Abaleevi n'abandi bantu, okumanya oku baraagume nibareeta enku omu nju ya Ruhanga waitu nk'omutoijo, nk'oku amaju aga baatatenkuriitwe gaabaire gari, omu bunaku obwatairweho buri mwaka, kuba ez'okuhemba aha itambiro rya MUKAMA Ruhanga waitu, nk'oku kihandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'Ebiragiro.
en: And we cast the lots among the priests, the Levites, and the people, for the wood offering, to bring it into the house of our God, after the houses of our fathers, at times appointed year by year, to burn upon the altar of the LORD our God, as it is written in the law:

rr: Kandi twayemera kureeta emiganuro y'emisiri yaitu, n'ey'ebijuma byona ebya buri muti ebirikuriibwa, omu nju ya MUKAMA buri mwaka
en: and to bring the firstfruits of our ground, and the firstfruits of all fruit of all trees, year by year, unto the house of the LORD :

rr: n'okureeta emijigaijo ya batabani baitu n'ey'amatungo gaitu, nk'oku kihandiikirwe omu kitabo ky'Ebiragiro, emijigaijo y'ente zaitu n'ey'entaama zaitu, kugireeta omu nju ya Ruhanga waitu, n'okugiha abanyamurwa abarikukorera omuri egyo nju omurimo gw'obuheereza
en: also the firstborn of our sons, and of our cattle, as it is written in the law, and the firstlings of our herds and of our flocks, to bring to the house of our God, unto the priests that minister in the house of our God:

rr: kandi n'okuguma nitureeta omuganuro gw'ebiihuro byaitu, n'empongano ezizongazongiibwe, n'ebijuma ebirikuriibwa eby'aha miti ebirikuriibwa byona, na viinyo n'amajuta, nitubireetera abanyamurwa omu bishengye by'enju ya Ruhanga waitu, n'okuha Abaleevi ekicweka kimwe kya ikumi ky'ebyezire omu misiri yaitu; ahabw'okuba Abaleevi nibo batwara kimwe kya ikumi ky'emisiri y'endembo zaitu zoona.
en: and that we should bring the firstfruits of our dough, and our offerings, and the fruit of all manner of trees, of wine and of oil, unto the priests, to the chambers of the house of our God; and the tithes of our ground unto the Levites, that the same Levites might have the tithes in all the cities of our tillage.

rr: Kandi Abaleevi ku bariba nibaheebwa kimwe kya ikumi, omunyamurwa, mwene Arooni, agume abeh; bwanyima Abaleevi nabo bareete kimwe kya ikumi ky'ebyo ebi baaheebwa omu nju ya Ruhanga waitu, babite omu bishengye by'enju y'eibiikiro.
en: And the priest the son of Aaron shall be with the Levites, when the Levites take tithes: and the Levites shall bring up the tithe of the tithes unto the house of our God, to the chambers, into the treasure house.

rr: Ahabw'okuba Abaisraeli n'Abaleevi baryaguma bareete empongano z'engano, viinyo n'amajuta, babite omu bishengye, ebirimu ebintu by'Omwanya ogurikwera, bibe eby'abanyamurwa abarikuheereza n'abakumiirizi n'abeeshongozi. Titurireka kuta omutima aha nju ya Ruhanga waitu. Currently Selected: Nehemia 10 : RR64 Highlight Share <div class="flex w-full items-center gap-1 rtl:flex-row-reverse hover:cursor-pointer
en: For the children of Israel and the children of Levi shall bring the offering of the corn, of the new wine, and the oil, unto the chambers, where are the vessels of the sanctuary, and the priests that minister, and the porters, and the singers: and we will not forsake the house of our God.
