rr: Omu biro ebyo abeebembezi b'eihanga bakaguma batwire omuri Yerusaalemu, kwonka abandi bantu baateera enteenyu okwiha omuntu omwe ahari buri ikumi kutuura omuri Yerusaalemu orurembo orurikwera, kandi abandi boona abaatsigaireho baaza omu zindi ndembo.
en: And the rulers of the people dwelt at Jerusalem: the rest of the people also cast lots, to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem the holy city, and nine parts to dwell in other cities.

rr: Abantu baasiima abashaija boona abaayehaireyo n'omutima gwekundiire kutuura Yerusaalemu.
en: And the people blessed all the men, that willingly offered themselves to dwell at Jerusalem.

rr: 1 -34 ; . Abo nibo bategyeki b'amashaza abaabaire batwire Yerusaalemu; kwonka omu ndembo za Yuda buri muntu akaba atwire omu kibanja kye omu rurembo rw'owaabo, Abaisraeli, abanyamurwa, Abaleevi, abaheereza b'omuri hekalu, na baijukuru b'abagaragwa ba Sulemaani.
en: Now these are the chief of the province that dwelt in Jerusalem: but in the cities of Judah dwelt every one in his possession in their cities, to wit , Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon's servants.

rr: Omuri Yerusaalemu hakaba harimu bamwe omu Bayuda n'omu Babenyamiini.
en: And at Jerusalem dwelt certain of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin.

rr: Omuri beene Yuda, Ataaya mwene Uziya, mwijukuru wa Zekaria, Zekaria ya Amaria, Amaria ya Shefatia, Shefatia ya Mehalaleeli, ow'omuri beene Pereezi
en: Of the children of Judah; Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalaleel, of the children of Perez;

rr: na Maaseya mwene Baruki, mwijukuru wa Kolihoze, Kolihoze ya Hazaaya, Hazaaya ya Adaaya, Adaaya ya Yoyaribu, Yoyaribu ya Zekaria owa Shiilo.
en: and Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Col-hozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of Shiloni.

rr: Beene Pereezi boona abaabaire batwire Yerusaalemu bakaba bari abashaija amamanzi magana ana na makumi mukaaga na munaana.
en: All the sons of Perez that dwelt at Jerusalem were four hundred threescore and eight valiant men.

rr: Kandi aba nibo beene Benyamiini: Saalu mwene Meshulaamu mwijukuru wa Yoedi, Yoedi ya Pedaaya, Pedaaya ya Kolaaya, Kolaaya ya Maaseya, Maaseya ya Ityeli, Ityeli ya Yeshaaya
en: And these are the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jesaiah.

rr: Yaakuratwa Gabai, na Salai, boona magana mwenda na makumi abiri na munaana.
en: And after him Gabbai, Sallai, nine hundred twenty and eight.

rr: Yoeli mwene Zikuri akaba ari omureeberezi waabo; kandi Yuda mwene Hasenua ari owa kabiri omu bategyeki b'orurembo.
en: And Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer: and Judah the son of Senuah was second over the city.

rr: Omu banyamurwa: Yedaaya mwene Yoyaribu, Yakiini
en: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin.

rr: Seraya mwene Hilukia, mwijukuru wa Meshulaamu, Meshulaamu ya Zadoki, Zadoki ya Merayosi, Merayosi ya Ahitubu, omutegyeki w'enju ya Ruhanga
en: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, was the ruler of the house of God.

rr: hamwe na beene waabo abaabaire nibakora omurimo gw'enju, boona magana abiri na makumi abiri na babiri; kandi na Adaya mwene Yerohaamu, mwijukuru wa Pelalia, Pelalia ya Amuzi, Amuzi ya Zekaria, Zekaria ya Pashihuuri, Pashihuuri ya Malukiya.
en: And their brethren that did the work of the house were eight hundred twenty and two: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchiah,

rr: hamwe na beene ishe, abategyeki b'amaju ga baishenkurubo, boona magana abiri na makumi ana na babiri; kandi na Amashisai mwene Azareeli, mwijukuru wa Ahazai, Ahazai ya Mehsilemoosi, Meshilemoosi ya Imeri
en: and his brethren, chief of the fathers, two hundred forty and two: and Amashai the son of Azareel, the son of Ahasai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,

rr: hamwe na beene ishe, abashaija b'amaani amamanzi igana na makumi abiri na munaana; kandi omureeberezi waabo akaba ari Zabudieli mwene Hagedolimu.
en: and their brethren, mighty men of valour, an hundred twenty and eight: and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of one of the great men.

rr: Kandi omu Baleevi: Shemaaya mwene Hashubu, mwijukuru wa Azurikaamu, Azurikaamu ya Hashabia, Hashabia ya Buuni
en: Also of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hashub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;

rr: kandi na Shebatai na Yoazabaadi ab'omu bategyeki ba'omu Baleevi, abaabaire bareeberera emirimo y'enju ya Ruhanga ey'aheeru
en: and Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chief of the Levites, had the oversight of the outward business of the house of God.

rr: kandi na Matania mwene Miika, mwijukuru wa Zabudi, Zabudi ya Asafu, owaabaire ari omutegyeki w'okwebembera abarikuhimbisa omu kushaba, na Bakibukia owaabaire ari owa kabiri ahari beene ishe, na Abuda mwene Shamua, mwijukuru wa Galali, Galali ya Yedusuuni.
en: And Mattaniah the son of Micha, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, was the principal to begin the thanksgiving in prayer: and Bakbukiah the second among his brethren, and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.

rr: Kandi abakumiirizi Akubu, Talumooni na beene waabo, abaabaire barinda amarembo, boona bakaba bari igana na makumi mushanju na babiri.
en: Moreover the porters, Akkub, Talmon, and their brethren that kept the gates, were an hundred seventy and two. In Other Cities

rr: Abandi Baisraeli boona n'abandi banyamurwa n'Abaleevi, bakaba batwire omu ndembo za Yuda zoona buri muntu omu buhunguzi bwe.
en: And the residue of Israel, of the priests, and the Levites, were in all the cities of Judah, every one in his inheritance.

rr: Kwonka abaheereza b'omuri hekalu bakaba batwire Ofeli, nibareebererwa Ziiha na Gishupa.
en: But the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel: and Ziha and Gispa were over the Nethinims.

rr: Omureeberezi w'Abaleevi omuri Yerusaalemu akaba ari Uuzi mwene Baani, mwijukuru wa Hashabia, Hashabia ya Matania, Matania ya Miika ow'omuri beene Asafu, abeeshongozi, abaabaire bareeberera omurimo gw'enju ya Ruhanga.
en: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micha. Of the sons of Asaph, the singers were over the business of the house of God.

rr: Ahabw'okuba omugabe akaba aragiire ebyabo, kandi agyereire abeeshongozi egabo ya buri izooba.
en: For it was the king's commandment concerning them, that a certain portion should be for the singers, due for every day.

rr: Kandi Pesahia mwene Meshezabeeli, ow'omuri beene Zeera, mwene Yuda, akaba ari omuntu w'omugabe owaabaire amuhwera omuri byona ebirikufa aha bantu.
en: And Pethahiah the son of Meshezabeel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, was at the king's hand in all matters concerning the people.

rr: Kandi aha birikukwata aha birorero n'emisiri yaabyo, abamwe aha Bayuda bakaba batwire Kiryasi-araba n'omu birorero byayo, Diboni n'omu birorero byayo, Yekabuzeeli n'omu birorero byayo
en: And for the villages, with their fields, some of the children of Judah dwelt at Kirjath-arba, and in the villages thereof, and at Dibon, and in the villages thereof, and at Jekabzeel, and in the villages thereof,

rr: Yeshua, Molada, Besi-peleti
en: and at Jeshua, and at Moladah, and at Beth-phelet,

rr: Hazarishuali, Beeri-sheba n'omu birorero byayo
en: and at Hazar-shual, and at Beer-sheba, and in the villages thereof,

rr: Zikulaagi, Mekona n'omu birorero byayo
en: and at Ziklag, and at Mekonah, and in the villages thereof,

rr: Enirimooni, Zoora, Yaramuusi
en: and at En-rimmon, and at Zareah, and at Jarmuth,

rr: Zanoa, Adulaamu n'omu birorero byayo, Lakishi n'emisiri yaayo, na Azaka n'omu birorero byayo.
en: Zanoah, Adullam, and in their villages, at Lachish, and the fields thereof, at Azekah, and in the villages thereof.

rr: Nikwo bateire batyo ensiisira okuruga Beeri-sheba okuhika omu ruhanga rwa Hinoomu.
en: And they dwelt from Beer-sheba unto the valley of Hinnom.

rr: Ababenyamiini bakatuura okuruga Geeba n'okweyongyera omumaihso, Mikimaashi, Aiya, Beseeli n'omu birorero byayo
en: The children also of Benjamin from Geba dwelt at Michmash, and Aija, and Beth-el, and in their villages,

rr: Anatoosi, Noobu, Anania
en: and at Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,

rr: Hazora, Raama, Gitaimu
en: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,

rr: Hadidi, Zeboimu, Nebalaati
en: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,

rr: Loodi, na Ono, oruhanga rw'abanyamyoga.
en: Lod, and Ono, the valley of craftsmen.

rr: Kandi ebicweka bimwe by'Abaleevi omuri Yuda bakateeranwa na Benyamiini.
en: And of the Levites were divisions in Judah, and in Benjamin.

rr: -8 ; 12:12-21 . Aba nibo banyamurwa n'Abaleevi abaizire na Zerubabeeli mwene Shealutieli, na Yeshua: Seraya, Yeremia, Ezera
en: Now these are the priests and the Levites that went up with Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,

rr: Amaria, Maluki, Hatushi
en: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,

rr: Shekani, a Rehumu, Meremoosi
en: Shechaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,

rr: Ido, Ginesooni, Abiya
en: Iddo, Ginnetho, Abijah,

rr: Miyamiini, Maadia, Biliga
en: Miamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,

rr: Shemaaya, Yoyaribu, Yedaaya
en: Shemaiah, and Joiarib, Jedaiah,

rr: Saalu, Amoki, Hilukia, na Yedaaya. Abo nibo baabaire bari bakuru omu banyamurwa n'omuri beene waabo omu biro bya Yeshua.
en: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, Jedaiah. These were the chief of the priests and of their brethren in the days of Jeshua.

rr: Kandi Abaleevi n'aba: Yeshua, Binui, Kadimieli, Sherebia, Yuda, na Matania, owaabaire naakwatanisa na beene ishe kwebembera ebyeshongoro by'okuhimbisa.
en: Moreover the Levites: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah, which was over the thanksgiving, he and his brethren.

rr: Kandi Bakibukia na Uuno beene waabo bakaba beemerera nibareebana omu kushaba.
en: Also Bakbukiah and Unni, their brethren, were over against them in the watches.

rr: Yeshua akazaara Yoyakimu, Yoyakimu yaazaara Eliashibu, Eliashibu yaazaara Yoyada
en: And Jeshua begat Joiakim, Joiakim also begat Eliashib, and Eliashib begat Joiada,

rr: Yoyada yaazaara Yonasaani, na Yona saani yaazaara Yadua.
en: and Joiada begat Jonathan, and Jonathan begat Jaddua.

rr: Abanyamurwa b'omu biro bya Yoyakimu abaabaire bari bakuru b'amaju ga baishenkurubo, n'aba: ow'enju ya Seraaya akaba ari Meraaya, ow'eya Yeremia, ari Hanania
en: And in the days of Joiakim were priests, the chief of the fathers: of Seraiah, Meraiah; of Jeremiah, Hananiah;

rr: ow'eya Ezera, ari Meshulaamu, ow'eya Amaria ari Yehohanani
en: of Ezra, Meshullam; of Amariah, Jehohanan;

rr: ow'eya Maluki ari Yonasaani, ow'eya Shebania ari Yosefu
en: of Melicu, Jonathan; of Shebaniah, Joseph;

rr: ow'eya Harimu ari Aduna, ow'eya Merayosi ari Helekai
en: of Harim, Adna; of Meraioth, Helkai;

rr: ow'eya Ido ari Zekaria, ow'eya Ginesooni ari Meshulaamu
en: of Iddo, Zechariah; of Ginnethon, Meshullam;

rr: ow'eya Biya ari Zikiri, ow'eya Minyamiini owa Moadia, ari Pilutai
en: of Abijah, Zichri; of Miniamin, of Moadiah, Piltai;

rr: ow'eya Biliga ari Shamua, ow'eya Shemaaya ari Yehonasani
en: of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;

rr: ow'eya Yoyaribu ari Matenai, ow'eya Yedaaya ari Uuzi
en: and of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi;

rr: ow'eya Salai ari Kalai, ow'eya Amoki ari Eberi
en: of Sallai, Kallai; of Amok, Eber;

rr: ow'eya Hilukia ari Hashabia, n'ow'eya Yedaaya ari Netaneeli.
en: of Hilkiah, Hashabiah; of Jedaiah, Nethaneel.

rr: Omu biro bya Eliashibu, Yoyada, Yohanaani na Yadua, Abaleevi n'abanyamurwa bakaba bahandiikwa omu kitabo ky'amaziina g'abakuru ba'maju ga baishenkurubo, okuhitsya omu busingye bwa Dario Omuperisi.
en: The Levites in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, and Johanan, and Jaddua, were recorded chief of the fathers: also the priests, to the reign of Darius the Persian.

rr: 1 -16 ; Na beene Leevi, abakuru b'amaju ga baishenkurubo bakaba bahandiikwa omu kitabo ky'eb'omu busingye okuhitsya omu biro bya Yohanaani mwene Eliashibu.
en: The sons of Levi, the chief of the fathers, were written in the book of the chronicles, even until the days of Johanan the son of Eliashib.

rr: Kandi Matania, Bakibukia, Obadia, Mehsulaamu, Talumooni na Akubu bakaba bari abakumiirizi, abaabaire barinda amaju g'amabiikiro g'aha marembo.
en: Mattaniah, and Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, Akkub, were porters keeping the ward at the thresholds of the gates.

rr: Abo nibo baabaire bariho omu biryo bya Yoyakimu mwene Yeshua, mwijukuru wa Yozadaaki, n'omu biro bya Nehemia omutegyeki na Ezera omunyamurwa, kandi omuhandiiki.
en: These were in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor, and of Ezra the priest, the scribe.

rr: Obugyenyi bw'okweza orugo rw'amabaare rwa Yerusaalemu
en: At the Dedication

rr: Ku baabaire nibenda kweza orugo rw'amabaare rwa Yerusaalemu, bakasherura Abaleevi ahu baabaire batwire hoona, kubareeta Yerusaalemu aha bugyenyi bw'okurweza baine okushemererwa, nibahimbisa n'ebyenshongoro, baine ebitaasa n'endingiri n'enanga.
en: And at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem they sought the Levites out of all their places, to bring them to Jerusalem, to keep the dedication with gladness, both with thanksgivings, and with singing, with cymbals, psalteries, and with harps.

rr: Kandi abaana b'abeeshongozi baateeranira hamwe nibaruga omu mpita ezeehinguririize Yerusaalemu n'omu birorero by'Abanetofa
en: And the sons of the singers gathered themselves together, both out of the plain country round about Jerusalem, and from the villages of Netophathi;

rr: na Besi-gilugaali n'omu byaro bya Geeba na Azimavesi; ahabw'okuba abeeshongozi bakaba beeyombekyeire ebirorero embaju zoona eza Yerusaalemu.
en: also from the house of Gilgal, and out of the fields of Geba and Azmaveth: for the singers had builded them villages round about Jerusalem.

rr: Kandi abanyamurwa n'Abaleevi baayeyeza, baayeza na'bantu n'amarembo n'orwo rugo rw'amabaare.
en: And the priests and the Levites purified themselves, and purified the people, and the gates, and the wall.

rr: Bwanyima naatembya abakuru ba Yuda aha mutwe gw'orwo rugo, naabaganisa abantu omu mitwe ebiri mihango okugyenda aha mutwe gw'orugo bakurataine nibahimbisa. Omutwe gumwe gwatoora aha rubaju rwa buryo, gugyemire ow'Eirembo ry'orubungo
en: Then I brought up the princes of Judah upon the wall, and appointed two great companies of them that gave thanks, whereof one went on the right hand upon the wall toward the dung gate:

rr: baakuratwa Hoshaaya n'ekicweka ky'abakuru ba Yuda
en: and after them went Hoshaiah, and half of the princes of Judah,

rr: na Azaria, Ezera, Meshulaamu
en: and Azariah, Ezra, and Meshullam,

rr: Yuda, Benyamiini, Shemaaya, Yeremia
en: Judah, and Benjamin, and Shemaiah, and Jeremiah,

rr: na batabani b'abanyamurwa abamwe baine amakondere, Zekaria, mwene Yonasaani, mwijukuru wa Shemaaya, Shemaaya ya Matania, Matania ya Mikaaya, Mikaaya ya Zikuri, mwene Asafu
en: and certain of the priests' sons with trumpets; namely , Zechariah the son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Michaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph:

rr: na beene waabo Shemaaya, Azareeli, Yuda na Hanani, baine ebirikugamba bya Daudi omushaija wa Ruhanga, beebembeirwe Ezera omuhandiiki.
en: and his brethren, Shemaiah, and Azarael, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethaneel, and Judah, Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God, and Ezra the scribe before them.

rr: Ku baahikire aha Irembo ry'enshuro, bainamuka bagyemire omu maihso gaabo, baatembera aha matembero agarikuza omu rurembo rwa Daudi, ahu orugo rwabiare nirwinamukira aharuguru y'enju ya Daudi, baahika aha Irembo ry'amaizi ery'oburugwa-izooba.
en: And at the fountain gate, which was over against them, they went up by the stairs of the city of David, at the going up of the wall, above the house of David, even unto the water gate eastward.

rr: Ogundi mutwe gw'abarikugyenda nibahimbisa gwatoora aha rubaju rwa bumosho, naanye naagyenda mbakuratiire aha mutwe gw'orugo, nyine ekicweka ky'abantu, twatoora aha rubaju rw'omunaara gw'ebikoomi, twahika aha rugo ruhanga
en: And the other company of them that gave thanks went over against them , and I after them, and the half of the people upon the wall, from beyond the tower of the furnaces even unto the broad wall;

rr: bwanyima twaraba aha Irembo rya Efuraimu, n'aha Irembo rya ira, n'aha Irembo ry'eby'enyanja, n'aha munaara gwa Hananeeli, n'aha gwa Hameeya, twahika aha Irembo ry'entaama, twayemerera aha Irembo ry'abakumiirizi.
en: and from above the gate of Ephraim, and above the old gate, and above the fish gate, and the tower of Hananeel, and the tower of Meah, even unto the sheep gate: and they stood still in the prison gate.

rr: Etyo egyo mitwe yombi y'abantu abarikusiima yaayemerera omu nju ya Ruhanga, hamwe naanye n'ekicweka ky'abatware abu naabaire nyine
en: So stood the two companies of them that gave thanks in the house of God, and I, and the half of the rulers with me:

rr: n'abanyamurwa Eliakimu, Maaseya, Minyamiini, Mikaaya, Elio-enai, Zekaria na Hanania baine amakondere
en: and the priests; Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Michaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, with trumpets;

rr: kandi na Maaseya, Shemaaya, Eleazaari, Uuzi, Yehohanani, Malikiya, Elamu na Ezeri.
en: and Maaseiah, and Shemaiah, and Eleazar, and Uzzi, and Jehohanan, and Malchijah, and Elam, and Ezer.

rr: Kandi abeeshongozi baayeshongora n'amaraka mahango, nibeebemberwa Yezerahia.
en: And the singers sang loud, with Jezrahiah their overseer.

rr: Eryo izooba baatabma ebitambo bingi nibashemererwa; ahabw'okuba Ruhanga akaba abahaire okushemererwa kwingi; kandi abakazi n'abaana bato nabo baashemererwa. Kyareetera akaari k'okushemererwa kw'omuri Yerusaalemu kuhuririrwa hare.
en: Also that day they offered great sacrifices, and rejoiced: for God had made them rejoice with great joy: the wives also and the children rejoiced: so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard even afar off.

rr: Bwanyima eryo izooba baatoorana abantu b'okureeberera ebishengye by'amabiikiro, agarikubiikwamu emitoijo, n'emiganuro, n'ebicweka bya kimwe kya ikumi, n'okuteeraniramu emigabo y'abanyamurwa n'Abaleevi nk'ebiragiro oku birikuragiira, nk'oku emisiri y'endembo zaabo yaabaire eri; ahabw'okuba Abayuda bakashemererwa ahabw'okureeba abanyamurwa n'Abaleevi bari ha mirimo yaabo
en: And at that time were some appointed over the chambers for the treasures, for the offerings, for the firstfruits, and for the tithes, to gather into them out of the fields of the cities the portions of the law for the priests and Levites: for Judah rejoiced for the priests and for the Levites that waited.

rr: nibakora emirimo ya Ruhanga waabo n'okuhikiiriza eby'okweyeza; kandi abeeshongozi n'abakumiirizi nabo nikwo baabaire nibatwaza, nibakuratira ekiragiro kya Daudi n'eky'omutabani Sulemaani.
en: And both the singers and the porters kept the ward of their God, and the ward of the purification, according to the commandment of David, and of Solomon his son.

rr: Ahabw'okuba ira omu biro bya Daudi na Asafu hakaba hariho omwebembezi w'abeeshongozi, n'ebyenshongoro by'okuhimbisa Ruhanga n'okumusiima.
en: For in the days of David and Asaph of old there were chief of the singers, and songs of praise and thanksgiving unto God.

rr: -28 ; . Kandi omu biro bya Zerubabeeli n'omu bya Nehemia Abaisraeli boona bakaba bahayo emigabo ya buri izooba ahabw'abeeshongozi n'abakumiirizi; kandi baihaho eby'okubiikira Abaleevi, n'Abaleevi baihaho eby'okubiikira beene Arooni. en: And all Israel in the days of Zerubbabel, and in the days of Nehemiah, gave the portions of the singers and the porters, every day his portion: and they sanctified holy things unto the Levites; and the Levites sanctified them unto the children of Aaron. rr: Kandi eryo izooba bakashomera abantu eby'omu kitabo kya Musa, baashanga hahandiikirwemu ku hatariho Muamoni nari Omumoabu orikwikirizibwa kuza omu kuteerana kw'abantu ba Ruhanga ebiro byona
en: On that day they read in the book of Moses in the audience of the people; and therein was found written, that the Ammonite and the Moabite should not come into the congregation of God for ever;

rr: ahabw'okuba tibarabuganiise Baisraeli by'okurya na maizi, kureka bakaguriirira Balamu ngu abakyeene; kwona Ruhanga witu yaahindura ogwo mukyeeno kuba omugisha.
en: because they met not the children of Israel with bread and with water, but hired Balaam against them, that he should curse them: howbeit our God turned the curse into a blessing.

rr: Abantu ku baahuriire Ebiragiro, baiha omu Baisraeli ekijwangye kyona ekirikukomooka omu banyamahanga.
en: Now it came to pass, when they had heard the law, that they separated from Israel all the mixed multitude.

rr: Kwonka ebyo bitakabaireho, Eliashibu omunyamurwa, owaatairweho kutegyeka enju ya Ruhanga waitu, ahabw'okugira obuzaare na Tobia
en: And before this, Eliashib the priest, having the oversight of the chamber of the house of our God, was allied unto Tobiah:

rr: akaba amushemereize ekishengye kihango, ekyabaire kibiikwamu ira empongano z'esaano, obubaane, ebirikukoresibwa, ebicweka bya kimwe kya ikumi eby'eby'okurya na viinyo n'amajuta, ebyabaire biragiirwa kuheebwa Abaleevi, abeeshongozi n'abakumiirizi, hamwe n'emitoijo erikutoijwa ahabw'abanyamurwa.
en: and he had prepared for him a great chamber, where aforetime they laid the meat offerings, the frankincense, and the vessels, and the tithes of the corn, the new wine, and the oil, which was commanded to be given to the Levites, and the singers, and the porters; and the offerings of the priests.

rr: Kwonka obu ebyo byakorwa, nkaba ntari Yerusaalemu; ahabw'okuba omu mwaka gwa makumi ashatu n'ebiri ogw'omu busingye bwa Aruta-gizakiseesi omugabe wa Babulooni, nkaba ngiire ow'omugabe. Bwanyima ku haahingwireho ebiro, naashaba omugabe ngu anyohereze
en: But in all this time was not I at Jerusalem: for in the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon came I unto the king, and after certain days obtained I leave of the king:

rr: naagaruka Yerusaalemu; ku naahikireyo, naamanya ekibi eki Eliashibu yaakozire ahabw'okushemereza Tobia ekishengye omu bikaari by'enju ya Ruhanga.
en: and I came to Jerusalem, and understood of the evil that Eliashib did for Tobiah, in preparing him a chamber in the courts of the house of God.

rr: Naagira ekiniga kingi, naahuruutura ebintu bya Tobia byona omuri ekyo kishengye, naabinaga aheeru.
en: And it grieved me sore: therefore I cast forth all the household stuff of Tobiah out of the chamber.

rr: Ntyo naaragiira ku bashemeza ebyo bishengye; bwanyima naagaruramu ebintu by'enju ya Ruhanga, hamwe n'empongano z'esaano n'obubaane.
en: Then I commanded, and they cleansed the chambers: and thither brought I again the vessels of the house of God, with the meat offering and the frankincense.

rr: Kandi naamanya ku Abaleevi batarahairwe migabo yaabo; n'ahabw'ekyo Abaleevi n'abeeshongozi, abaabaire bakora emirimo, bakaba bahungire, buri muntu agarukire omu kibanja kye.
en: And I perceived that the portions of the Levites had not been given them: for the Levites and the singers, that did the work, were fled every one to his field.

rr: Ntyo naahana abatware ningira nti: N'enki ekyareeteire enju ya Ruhanga kutsigwaho?
en: Then contended I with the rulers, and said, Why is the house of God forsaken?

rr: Ahonaaho naateerana Abaleevi, naabagarura omu myanya yaabo.
en: And I gathered them together, and set them in their place.

rr: Bwanyima aba Yuda boona baareeta kimwe kya ikumi ky'eby'okurya na viinyo n'amajuta, baabita omu mabiikiro.
en: Then brought all Judah the tithe of the corn and the new wine and the oil unto the treasuries.

rr: Bwanyima naataho ababiiki aba kurinda amabiikiro, Shelemia omunyamurwa, Zadoki omuhandiiki na Pedaaya ow'omu Baleevi, nibahwerwa Hanani mwene Zakuri, mwijukuru wa Matania, ahakuba bakaba nibateekateekwa kuba abeesigwa; omurimo gwabo gukaba guri ogw'okugaburira beene waabo.
en: And I made treasurers over the treasuries, Shelemiah the priest, and Zadok the scribe, and of the Levites, Pedaiah: and next to them was Hanan the son of Zaccur, the son of Mattaniah: for they were counted faithful, and their office was to distribute unto their brethren.

rr: Ai Ruhanga wangye, onyijukye ahabw'ekyo, kandi otaragaza emirimo yangye emirungi ei nkoreire enju ya Ruhanga wangye, kandi n'omurimo ogurikukorerwa omuriyo.
en: Remember me, O my God, concerning this, and wipe not out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God, and for the offices thereof.

rr: Nehemia okushemeza emigyenzo ya sabato
en: Keeping the Sabbath

rr: Omu biro ebyo nkareeba omuri Yuda abashaija nibanyuukira emizaabibu omu inyuukiro ahari sabato, abandi nibareeta ebiba, nibabyekoreza endogoya zaabo; naareeba na viinyo n'emizaabibu n'ebijuma by'emitiini n'emitwaro y'emiringo yoona, ei baabaire bareeta Yerusaalemu aha izooba rya sabato; naabateiseza aha izooba eri baabaire nibatundiraho eby'okurya.
en: In those days saw I in Judah some treading wine presses on the sabbath, and bringing in sheaves, and lading asses; as also wine, grapes, and figs, and all manner of burdens, which they brought into Jerusalem on the sabbath day: and I testified against them in the day wherein they sold victuals.

rr: Kandi n'abashaija ba Tuuro, abaabaire batwire omu rurembo, bakaba bareeta eby'enyanja, n'ebintu by'emiringo yoona, babiguza aba Yuda n'aba Yerusaalemu ahari sabato.
en: There dwelt men of Tyre also therein, which brought fish, and all manner of ware, and sold on the sabbath unto the children of Judah, and in Jerusalem.

rr: Ku naabireebire, naatonganisa abakungu ba Yuda, naabagira nti: Ahabw'enki nimukora ekibi ekirikushusha kiti, kushiisha eizooba rya sabato?
en: Then I contended with the nobles of Judah, and said unto them, What evil thing is this that ye do, and profane the sabbath day?

rr: Na baashwenkuriimwe tikwo baakozire batyo, kikareetera Ruhanga waitu okutureetaho akabi aka koona, n'aha rurembo oru? Mbwenu imwe nimweyongyera kureeta ahari Israeli ekiniga ahabw'okushiisha sabato.
en: Did not your fathers thus, and did not our God bring all this evil upon us, and upon this city? yet ye bring more wrath upon Israel by profaning the sabbath.

rr: Aha izooba eririkukuratwa sabato omu mwabazyo nibutandika kwira, ku naabaire ndi aha irembo rya Yerusaalemu, naaragiira kukinga amarembo, kandi kutagaruka kwigurwa okuhitsya obu sabato eraahwe. Kandi naataho bamwe aha bashaija bangye kurinda amarembo, ngu hatagira omutwaro gwona ogu baataasyamu aha izooba rya sabato.
en: And it came to pass, that when the gates of Jerusalem began to be dark before the sabbath, I commanded that the gates should be shut, and charged that they should not be opened till after the sabbath: and some of my servants set I at the gates, that there should no burden be brought in on the sabbath day.

rr: Bwanyima abashuubuzi n'abarikutunda ebintu by'emiringo yoona baaraara enyima ya Yerusaalemu ekiro kimwe nari bibiri.
en: So the merchants and sellers of all kind of ware lodged without Jerusalem once or twice.

rr: Ku naabareebire, naabahana nimbagira nti: N'enki ekibaraarize enyima y'orugo? Ku muraagarukire, niinyija kubakwata. Okuruga obwo tibaagaruka kwija ahari sabato.
en: Then I testified against them, and said unto them, Why lodge ye about the wall? if ye do so again, I will lay hands on you. From that time forth came they no more on the sabbath.

rr: Kandi naaragiira Abaleevi kweyeza, ngu babone kwija kurinda amarembo, eizooba rya sabato rirekye kusiisikara. Ai Ruhanga wangye, onyijukye n'ahabw'ekyo, kandi onsaasire nk'embabazi zaawe nyingi oku ziri. Nehemia okuhana abarikushwererana n'abanyamahanga
en: And I commanded the Levites that they should cleanse themselves, and that they should come and keep the gates, to sanctify the sabbath day. Remember me, O my God, concerning this also, and spare me according to the greatness of thy mercy.

rr: Kandi omuri ebyo biro naareeba Abayudaaya abaashweire abakazi b'omuri Ashidoodi, n'Abaamonikazi, n'Abamoabukazi
en: In those days also saw I Jews that had married wives of Ashdod, of Ammon, and of Moab:

rr: kandi abaana baabo bakaba bagamba orurimi rwabo nibarujwanzya n'orurimi rw'aba Ashidoodi, batarikubaasa kugamba gye ruyudaaya, kureka bagambaho rumwe ahari ezo.
en: and their children spake half in the speech of Ashdod, and could not speak in the Jews' language, but according to the language of each people.

rr: Ntyo naabatonganisa nimbajuma, nangwa na bamwe omuribo naabateera, naabamaanyura eishokye, naabarahiza omu iziina rya Ruhanga, nti: Mutarihingirana nabo, kandi naimwe mutaribasheramu.
en: And I contended with them, and cursed them, and smote certain of them, and plucked off their hair, and made them swear by God, saying , Ye shall not give your daughters unto their sons, nor take their daughters unto your sons, or for yourselves.

rr: 2 Timurikumanya ku Sulemaani omugabe wa Israeli yaasiisire ahabw'abakazi nk'aba? N'obu haraabe hatarabaireho mugabe ondiijo owaashushaine nawe omu mahanga maingi, kandi Ruhanga we yaamukunzire, akamugira omugabe wa Israeli yoona, kwonak nawe abanyamahangakazi bakamusiisisa.
en: Did not Solomon king of Israel sin by these things? yet among many nations was there no king like him, who was beloved of his God, and God made him king over all Israel: nevertheless even him did outlandish women cause to sin.

rr: Mbwenu nimugira ngu nitwija kwikiria ebyanyu, tukore ekibi ekirikwingana kiti, kushwera abanyamahangakazi?
en: Shall we then hearken unto you to do all this great evil, to transgress against our God in marrying strange wives?

rr: Kandi omwe ahari batabani ba Yehoyada mwene Eliashibu omunyamurwa omukuru, akaba ari mukwe wa Sanibalati Omuhoroni; nikyo naamubingiire omu maisho gangye.
en: And one of the sons of Joiada, the son of Eliashib the high priest, was son in law to Sanballat the Horonite: therefore I chased him from me.

rr: Ai Ruhanga wangye, ogume obaijukye, ahabw'okuba bakashiisha obunyamurwa, n'endagaano y'obunyamurwa n'ey'Abaleevi.
en: Remember them, O my God, because they have defiled the priesthood, and the covenant of the priesthood, and of the Levites.

rr: Okwo nikwo naabashemeize, nkabamaramu abanyamahanga boona, nkataho embu z'abanyamurwa n'ez'Abaleevi, buri muntu kukora omurimo gwe
en: Thus cleansed I them from all strangers, and appointed the wards of the priests and the Levites, every one in his business;

rr: Kandi nkaragiira eby'okureeta emitoijo y'enku omu bunaku obutairweho, n'eby'emiganuro.
en: and for the wood offering, at times appointed, and for the firstfruits.

rr: Ai Ruhanga wangye, ogume onyijukye, onzimuurire ebirungi.
en: Remember me, O my God, for good.

rr: MUKAMA akagambirira Musa omu ihamba rya Sinai, ari omu Ihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu, aha kiro ky'okubanza eky'okwezi kwa kabiri omu mwaka gwa kabiri barugire omu nsi ya Misri, ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tabernacle of the congregation, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

rr: -4 ; Mubare eihanga ryona ery'Abaisraeli, nk'oku enganda zaabo ziri n'emiryango ya baishenkurubo oku eri, mubare abashaija boona, omwe omwe, nk'amaziina gaabo oku gari
en: Take ye the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, after their families, by the house of their fathers, with the number of their names, every male by their polls;

rr: abahikize emyaka makumi abiri n'okukiraho, ab'omuri Israeli abarikubaasa kuhurura; iwe na Arooni mubabare nk'emitwe y'engabo zaabo oku eri.
en: from twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go forth to war in Israel: thou and Aaron shall number them by their armies.

rr: Mukwatanise n'omuntu omwe omuri buri ruganda, omukuru w'omuryango gwa baishenkuru.
en: And with you there shall be a man of every tribe; every one head of the house of his fathers.

rr: Aga nigo maziina g'abashaija abaraakwatanise naimwe. Omu ruganda rwa Reubeeni, Elizuuri mwene Shedeuri
en: And these are the names of the men that shall stand with you: of the tribe of Reuben; Elizur the son of Shedeur.

rr: omu rwa Simeoni, Shelumieli mwene Zuri-Shadai
en: Of Simeon; Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

rr: omu rwa Yuda, Nahashooni mwene Aminadabu
en: Of Judah; Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

rr: omu rwa Isakaari, Netaneeli mwene Zuari
en: Of Issachar; Nethaneel the son of Zuar.

rr: omu rwa Zebuluuni, Eliabu mwene Heloni
en: Of Zebulun; Eliab the son of Helon.

rr: omuri beene Yosefu, ow'omu rwa Efuraimu, Elishaama mwene Amihuudi; omu rwa Manaase, Gamalieli mwene Pedazuuri
en: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim; Elishama the son of Ammihud: of Manasseh; Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

rr: omu rwa Benyamiini, Abidaani mwene Gideoni
en: Of Benjamin; Abidan the son of Gideoni.

rr: omu rwa Daani, Ahiezeeri mwene Ami-shadai
en: Of Dan; Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

rr: omu rwa Asheri, Pagieli mwene Okiraani
en: Of Asher; Pagiel the son of Ocran.

rr: omu rwa Gaadi, Eliasaafu mwene Deueli
en: Of Gad; Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

rr: omu rwa Nafutaali, Ahiira mwene Enani.
en: Of Naphtali; Ahira the son of Enan.

rr: Abo nibo baatoorainwe omu ihanga ryona, abaabaire bari abeebembezi b'enganda za baishenkurubo, kandi abakuru b'emiryango y'Abaisraeli. Eby'oruganda rw'Abaleevi okutabarirwa hamwe n'ezindi
en: These were the renowned of the congregation, princes of the tribes of their fathers, heads of thousands in Israel.

rr: Musa na Arooni baatwara abantu abo abu amaziina gaabo gaagambwaho
en: And Moses and Aaron took these men which are expressed by their names:

rr: baateerana eihanga ryona aha kiro ky'okubanza eky'okwezi kwa kabiri, baayehandiikisa nk'enganda zaabo oku zaabaire ziri n'emiryango ya baishenkurubo oku yaabaire eri, baabara amaziina gaabo omwe omwe, abahikize emyaka makumi abiri n'okukiraho.
en: and they assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month, and they declared their pedigrees after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, by their polls.

rr: Nk'oku MUKAMA yaaragiire Musa, nikwo yaababariire omu ihamba rya Sinai.
en: As the LORD commanded Moses, so he numbered them in the wilderness of Sinai.

rr: Baahandiika oruzaaro rwa Reubeeni, omujigaijo gwa Israeli, nk'emiryango yaabo oku eri, n'amaju ga baishenkurubo oku gaabaire gari, nibabara amaziina g'abashaija boona omwe omwe, abahikize emyaka makumi abiri n'okukiraho, boona abarikubaasa kuhurura.
en: And the children of Reuben, Israel's eldest son, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

rr: Ab'omu ruganda rwa Reubeeni abaabazirwe baaba obukumi buna n'enkumi mukaaga na magana ataano.
en: those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Reuben, were forty and six thousand and five hundred.

rr: Baahandiika oruzaaro rwa Simeoni nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri n'amaju ga baishenkurubo oku gaabaire gari, nibabara amaziina g'abashaija boona omwe omwe abahikize emyaka makumi abiri n'okukiraho, boona abarikubaasa kuhurura.
en: Of the children of Simeon, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, those that were numbered of them, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

rr: Ab'omu ruganda rwa Simeoni abaabazirwe baaba obukumi butaano n'enkumi mwenda na magana ashatu.
en: those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.

rr: Baahandiika oruzaaro rwa Gaadi, nk'emiryango yaabo oku yaabaire eri, n'amaju ga baishenkurubo oku gaabaire gari, nibabara amaziina g'abashaija boona omwe omwe abahikize emyaka makumi abiri n'okukiraho, boona abarikubaasa kuhurura.
en: Of the children of Gad, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

rr: Ab'omu ruganda rwa Gaadi abaabazirwe baaba obukumi buna n'enkumi itaano na magana mukaaga na makumi ataano.
en: those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Gad, were forty and five thousand six hundred and fifty.

rr: Baahandiika oruzaaro rwa Yuda, nk'emiryango yaabo oku yaabaire eri, n'amaju ga baishenkurubo oku gaabaire gari, nibabara amaziina g'abashaija boona omwe omwe abahikize emyaka makumi abiri n'okukiraho, boona abarikubaasa kuhurura.
en: Of the children of Judah, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

rr: Ab'omu ruganda rwa Yuda abaabazirwe baaba obukumi mushanju n'enkumi ina na magana mukaaga.
en: those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Judah, were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.

rr: Baahandiika oruzaaro rwa Isakaari, nk'emiryango yaabo oku yaabaire eri, n'amaju ga baishenkurubo oku gaabaire gari, nibabara amaziina g'abashaija boona omwe omwe abahikize emyaka makumi abiri n'okukiraho, boona abarikubaasa kuhurura.
en: Of the children of Issachar, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

rr: Ab'omu ruganda rwa Isakaari abaabazirwe baaba obukumi butaano n'enkumi ina na magana ana.
en: those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred.

rr: Baahandiika oruzaaro rwa Zebuluuni, nk'emiryango yaabo oku yaabaire eri, n'amaju ga baishenkurubo oku gaabaire gari, nibabara amaziina g'abashaija boona omwe omwe abahikize emyaka makumi abiri n'okukiraho, boona abarikubaasa kuhurura.
en: Of the children of Zebulun, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

rr: Ab'omu ruganda rwa Zebuluuni abaabazirwe baaba obukumi butaano n'enkumi mushanju na magana ana.
en: those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.

rr: Omuri batabani ba Yosefu baahandiika oruzaaro rwa Efuraimu, nk'emiryango yaabo oku yaabaire eri, n'amaju ga baishenkurubo oku gaabaire gari, nibabara amaziina g'abashaija boona omwe omwe abahikize emyaka makumi abiri n'okukiraho, boona abarikubaasa kuhurura.
en: Of the children of Joseph, namely , of the children of Ephraim, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

rr: Ab'omu ruganda rwa Efuraimu abaabazirwe baaba obukumi buna na magana ataano.
en: those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand and five hundred.

rr: Baahandiika oruzaaro rwa Manaase nk'emiryango yaabo oku yaabaire eri, n'amaju ga baishenkurubo oku gaabaire gari, nibabara amaziina g'abashaija boona omwe omwe abahikize emyaka makumi abiri n'okukiraho, boona abarikubaasa kuhurura.
en: Of the children of Manasseh, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

rr: Ab'omu ruganda rwa Manaase abaabazirwe baaba obukumi bushatu n'enkumi ibiri na magana abiri.
en: those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.

rr: Baahandiika oruzaaro rwa Benyamiini, nk'emiryango yaabo oku yaabaire eri, n'amaju ga baishenkurubo oku gaabaire gari, nibabara amaziina g'abashaija boona omwe omwe abahikize emyaka makumi abiri n'okukiraho, boona abarikubaasa kuhurura.
en: Of the children of Benjamin, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

rr: Ab'omu ruganda rwa Benyamiini abaabazirwe baaba obukumi bushatu n'enkumi itaano na magana ana.
en: those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.

rr: Baahandiika oruzaaro rwa Daani, nk'emiryango yaabo oku yaabaire eri, n'amaju ga baishenkurubo oku gaabaire gari, nibabara amaziina g'abashaija boona omwe omwe abahikize emyaka makumi abiri n'okukiraho, boona abarikubaasa kuhurura.
en: Of the children of Dan, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

rr: Ab'omu ruganda rwa Daani abaabazirwe baaba obukumi mukaaga n'enkumi ibiri na magana mushanju.
en: those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Dan, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.

rr: Baahandiika oruzaaro rwa Asheri, nk'emiryango yaabo oku yaabaire eri, n'amaju ga baishenkurubo oku gaabaire gari, nibabara amaziina g'abashaija boona omwe omwe abahikize emyaka makumi abiri n'okukiraho, boona abarikubaasa kuhurura.
en: Of the children of Asher, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

rr: Ab'omu ruganda rwa Asheri abaabazirwe baaba obukumi buna na rukumi na magana ataano.
en: those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Asher, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.

rr: Baahandiika oruzaaro rwa Nafutaali, nk'emiryango yaabo oku yaabaire eri, n'amaju ga baishenkurubo oku gaabaire gari, nibabara amaziina g'abashaija boona omwe omwe abahikize emyaka makumi abiri n'okukiraho, boona abarikubaasa kuhurura.
en: Of the children of Naphtali, throughout their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

rr: Ab'omu ruganda rwa Nafutaali abaabazirwe baaba obukumi butaano n'enkumi ishatu na magana ana.
en: those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.

rr: Abo nibo baabazirwe, abu Musa na Arooni baabazire, nibahwerwa abeebembezi ba Israeli, abashaija ikumi na babiri, buri omwe ahabw'enju ya baishenkuru.
en: These are those that were numbered, which Moses and Aaron numbered, and the princes of Israel, being twelve men: each one was for the house of his fathers.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo abaabazirwe boona omu Baisraeli nk'amaju ga baishenkurubo oku gaabaire gari, abaabaire bahikize emyaka makumi abiri n'okukiraho, kandi boona abaabaire nibabaasa kuhurura
en: So were all those that were numbered of the children of Israel, by the house of their fathers, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war in Israel;

rr: abaabazirwe boona baaba obusiriira mukaaga n'enkumi ishatu na magana ataano na makumi ataano.
en: even all they that were numbered were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.

rr: Kwonka Abaleevi nk'oruganda rwa baishenkurubo oku rwabaire ruri tibaabarwa hamwe nabo
en: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not numbered among them.

rr: ahabw'okuba MUKAMA akagira Musa ati
en: For the LORD had spoken unto Moses, saying,

rr: Oruganda rwa Leevi rwo otarirubara, n'obu kwakuba okubabarira hamwe n'Abaisraeli abandi
en: Only thou shalt not number the tribe of Levi, neither take the sum of them among the children of Israel:

rr: kureka Abaleevi obagire ab'okutegyeka Obutaaho bw'Ebirikuhamya, n'ebintu byamwo byona, n'ebintu byabwo byona; nibo bariguma nibatwara obwo Butaaho n'ebintu byamwo byona; nibo bariguma nibabukoramu emirimo y'obuheereza, kandi baryaguma bateere amahema gaabo okubwehinguririza.
en: but thou shalt appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of testimony, and over all the vessels thereof, and over all things that belong to it: they shall bear the tabernacle, and all the vessels thereof; and they shall minister unto it, and shall encamp round about the tabernacle.

rr: Kandi Obutaaho ku buriba nibwimuka kugyenda, Abaleevi babe nibo baabukuura; kandi ku buriba nibuza kuteerwa, Abaleevi babe nibo baabuteera. Otari Muleevi weena ku aribuhika haihi, aitwe.
en: And when the tabernacle setteth forward, the Levites shall take it down: and when the tabernacle is to be pitched, the Levites shall set it up: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

rr: Abaisraeli baryaguma bateere amahema gaabo, buri muntu omu rusiisira rw'owaabo aha rurango rwabo, nk'oku emitwe yaabo eri.
en: And the children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, throughout their hosts.

rr: Kwonka Abaleevi bo baryateera amahema gaabo nibeehinguririza Obutaaho bw'Ebirikuhamya, eihanga ry'Abaisreli rirekye kugirirwa ekiniga; kandi Abaleevi nibo bariguma nibarinda Obutaaho bw'Ebirikuhamya.
en: But the Levites shall pitch round about the tabernacle of testimony, that there be no wrath upon the congregation of the children of Israel: and the Levites shall keep the charge of the tabernacle of testimony.

rr: Okwo nikwo Abaisraeli baakozire, bakakora nk'oku MUKAMA yaaragiire Musa.
en: And the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.

MUKAMA yaagambira Musa na Arooni ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

rr: Abaisraeli bagume bateere amahema gaabo, buri muntu aha rurango rw'owaabo, n'aha turango tw'amaju ga baishenkurubo; bagateere nigareeba Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu aha mbaju zaaryo zoona.
en: Every man of the children of Israel shall pitch by his own standard, with the ensign of their father's house: far off about the tabernacle of the congregation shall they pitch.

rr: Abaraateere amahema gaabo aha rubaju rwaryo orw'oburugwa-izooba bagume babe ab'orusiisira rwa Yuda, nk'oku emitwe yaabo eri, baine orurango rw'oruganda rwabo; kandi omwebembezi w'Abayuda abe Nahashooni mwene Abinadabu.
en: And on the east side toward the rising of the sun shall they of the standard of the camp of Judah pitch throughout their armies: and Nahshon the son of Amminadab shall be captain of the children of Judah.

rr: Eihe rye rikaba ririmu abashaija obukumi mushanju n'enkumi ina na magana mukaaga, nk'oku baabazirwe.
en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.

rr: Ab'oruganda rwa Isakaari nibo baraateere orusiisira okubahereera; omwebembezi waabo abe Netaneeli mwene Zuari.
en: And those that do pitch next unto him shall be the tribe of Issachar: and Nethaneel the son of Zuar shall be captain of the children of Issachar.

rr: Eihe rye rikaba ririmu abashaija obukumi butaano n'enkumi ina na magana ana, nk'oku baabazirwe.
en: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred.

rr: Hakurateho oruganda rwa Zebuluuni, omwebembezi waabo abe Eliabu mwene Heloohi
en: Then the tribe of Zebulun: and Eliab the son of Helon shall be captain of the children of Zebulun.

rr: eihe rye rikaba ririmu abashaija obukumi butaano n'enkumi mushanju na magana ana, nk'oku baabazirwe.
en: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.

rr: Boona abaabazirwe omu kicweka kya Yuda bakaba bari abashaija akasiriira n'obukumi munaana n'enkumi mukaaga na magana ana, nk'oku amahe gaabo gaabaire gari.
en: All that were numbered in the camp of Judah were an hundred thousand and fourscore thousand and six thousand and four hundred, throughout their armies.

rr: Abo babe nibo baaguma nibabanza kwimutsya orugyendo.
en: These shall first set forth.

rr: Aha bukiizi-bwa-buryo hagume hazeho orurango rw'orusiisira rw'oruganda rwa Reubeeni, nk'oku emitwe yaabo eri; omwebembezi waabo abe Elizuuri mwene Shedeuri.
en: On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their armies: and the captain of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.

rr: Eihe rye rikaba ririmu abashaija obukumi buna n'enkumi mukaaga na magana ataano, nk'oku baabazirwe.
en: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were forty and six thousand and five hundred.

rr: Abaraateere orusiisira okubahereera babe ab'oruganda rwa Simeoni; omwebembezi waabo abe Shelumieli mwene Zuri-shadai
en: And those which pitch by him shall be the tribe of Simeon: and the captain of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

rr: eihe rye rikaba ririmu abashaija obukumi butaano n'enkumi mwenda na magana ashatu, nk'oku baabazirwe.
en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.

rr: Hakurateho oruganda rwa Gaadi; omwebembezi waabo abe Eliasaafu mwene Reueli
en: Then the tribe of Gad: and the captain of the sons of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.

rr: eihe rye rikaba ririmu abashaija obukumi buna n'enkumi itaano na magana mukaaga na makumi ataano.
en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and five thousand and six hundred and fifty.

rr: Boona abaabazirwe omu kicweka kya Reubeeni bakaba bari abashaija akasiriira n'obukumi butaano na rukumi na magana ana na makumi ataano, nk'oku amahe gaabo gaabaire gari.
en: All that were numbered in the camp of Reuben were an hundred thousand and fifty and one thousand and four hundred and fifty, throughout their armies.

rr: Abo babe nibo baaba aba kabiri omu kwimutsya orugyendo.
en: And they shall set forth in the second rank.

rr: Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu rigume riimukize hamwe n'orusiisira rw'Abaleevi ahagati y'ensiisira ezindi; nk'oku barikusiisira, babe nikwo baaguma nibaimutsya orugyendo, buri ruganda omu mwanya gwarwo, nk'oku endango zaabo ziri.
en: Then the tabernacle of the congregation shall set forward with the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camp: as they encamp, so shall they set forward, every man in his place by their standards.

rr: Aha rubaju rw'oburengyerwa izooba hagume hazeho orurango rw'orusiisira rw'oruganda rwa Efuraimu, nk'oku emitwe yaabo eri; omwebembezi waabo abe Elishaama mwene Amihuudi.
en: On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their armies: and the captain of the sons of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.

rr: Eihe rye rikaba ririmu abashaija obukumi buna na magana ataano, nk'oku baabazirwe.
en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty thousand and five hundred.

rr: Ab'oruganda rwa Manaase babe nibo baabahereera; omwebembezi waabo abe Gamalieli mwene Pedazuuri
en: And by him shall be the tribe of Manasseh: and the captain of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

rr: eihe rye rikaba ririmu abashaija obukumi bushatu n'enkumi ibiri na magana abiri, nk'oku baabazirwe.
en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.

rr: Hakurateho oruganda rwa Benyamiini; omwebembezi waabo abe Abidaani mwene Gideoni
en: Then the tribe of Benjamin: and the captain of the sons of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.

rr: eihe rye rikaba ririmu abashaija obukumi bushatu n'enkumi itaano na magana ana, nk'oku baabazirwe.
en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.

rr: Boona abaabazirwe omu kicweka kya Efuraimu bakaba bari abashaija akasiriira n'enkumi munaana na igana, nk'oku amahe gaabo gaabaire gari.
en: All that were numbered of the camp of Ephraim were an hundred thousand and eight thousand and an hundred, throughout their armies.

rr: Abo babe nibo baaba aba kashatu omu kwimutsya orugyendo.
en: And they shall go forward in the third rank.

rr: Aha bukiizi-bwa-bumosho hagume hazeho orurango rw'orusiisira rw'oruganda rwa Daani nk'oku emitwe yaabo eri; omwebembezi waabo abe Ahiezeeri mwene Ami-shadai.
en: The standard of the camp of Dan shall be on the north side by their armies: and the captain of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

rr: Eihe rye rikaba ririmu abashaija obukumi mukaaga n'enkumi ibiri na magana mushanju, nk'oku baabazirwe.
en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.

rr: Ab'oruganda rwa Ashera babe nibo baabahereera; omwebembezi waabo abe Pagieli mwene Okiraani
en: And those that encamp by him shall be the tribe of Asher: and the captain of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ocran.

rr: eihe rye rikaba ririmu abashaija obukumi buna na rukumi na magana ataano, nk'oku baabazirwe.
en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.

rr: Hakurateho oruganda rwa Nafutaali; omwebembezi waabo abe Ahiira mwene Enani
en: Then the tribe of Naphtali: and the captain of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.

rr: eihe rye rikaba ririmu abashaija obukumi butaano n'enkumi ishatu na magana ana, nk'oku baabazirwe.
en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.

rr: Boona abaabazirwe omu kicweka kya Daani bakaba bari abashaija akasiriira n'obukumi butaano n'enkumi mushanju na magana mukaaga.
en: All they that were numbered in the camp of Dan were an hundred thousand and fifty and seven thousand and six hundred.

rr: Abo babe nibo baaguma nibahereeruka, nk'endango zaabo oku ziri.
en: They shall go hindmost with their standards.

rr: Abo nibo Baisraeli abaabazirwe nk'oku amaju ga baishenkurubo gaabaire gari; ab'omu nsiisira boona abaabazirwe nk'amahe gaabo oku gaabaire gari, bakaba bari abashaija obusiriira mukaaga n'enkumi ishatu na magana ataano na makumi ataano.
en: These are those which were numbered of the children of Israel by the house of their fathers: all those that were numbered of the camps throughout their hosts were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.

rr: Kwonka omu kubara Abaisraeli Abaleevi bo tibarabazirwe, nk'oku MUKAMA yaaragiire Musa.
en: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses.

rr: Okwo nikwo Abaisraeli baakozire, nk'ebi MUKAMA yaaragiire Musa byona oku byabaire biri. Nikwo baagumire nibateera amahema gaabo nk'endango zaabo oku zaabaire ziri, kandi nikwo baabaire baimutsya orugyendo, buri muntu omu ruganda rwe, n'omu muryango gwa baishenkuru. rr: Oru nirwo ruzaaro rwa Arooni na Musa omu bunaku obu MUKAMA yaagambiiremu na Musa aha rushozi Sinai.
en: These also are the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that the LORD spake with Moses in mount Sinai.

rr: Aga nigo maziina ga beene Arooni; omujigaijo gwe ni Nadabu, abandi ni Abihu, Eleazaari na Itamaari.
en: And these are the names of the sons of Aaron; Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

rr: Ago nigo maziina ga beene Arooni, abanyamurwa abaashukirweho amajuta, abu yaashoroire kuheereza omu mirimo y'abanyamurwa.
en: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests which were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest's office.

rr: Nadabu na Abihu bakafeera omu maisho ga MUKAMA, obu baayoteza omu maisho ga MUKAMA omuriro ogundi ogutararagiirwe kwoteza, bari omu ihamba rya Sinai kandi bakaba batakagizire baana. Kwonka Eleazaari na Itamaari baaguma nibaheereza omu murimo gw'obunyamurwa omu maisho ga Arooni ishebo.
en: And Nadab and Abihu died before the LORD , when they offered strange fire before the LORD , in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children: and Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest's office in the sight of Aaron their father.

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Reeta oruganda rwa Leevi, oruhitsye omu maisho ga Arooni omunyamurwa, babone kuguma nibamuheereza.
en: Bring the tribe of Levi near, and present them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister unto him.

rr: Bagume nibamukorera omurimo, bakorere n'eihanga ryona omu maisho g'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu, nibakora omurimo gw'Obutaaho.
en: And they shall keep his charge, and the charge of the whole congregation before the tabernacle of the congregation, to do the service of the tabernacle.

rr: Babe nibo baarinda ebintu byona eby'omu Ihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu, beezirikye kukora emirimo y'okuheereza omu by'Obutaaho ahabw'Abaisraeli.
en: And they shall keep all the instruments of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.

rr: Oheyo Abaleevi ahari Arooni n'abatabani; bamuheerwe kimwe ahabw'Abaisraeli.
en: And thou shalt give the Levites unto Aaron and to his sons: they are wholly given unto him out of the children of Israel.

rr: Kandi oryataho Arooni n'abatabani, beezirikye kukora omurimo gwabo gw'obunyamurwa; kwonka otari w'omuribo orihika haihi, akabyetaasyamu, aitwe.
en: And thou shalt appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall wait on their priest's office: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

rr: Kandi MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Reeba, nyetooraniire Abaleevi omu Baisraeli omu mwanya gw'emijigaijo yoona ey'Abaisraeli. Abaleevi n'abangye
en: And I, behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn that openeth the matrix among the children of Israel: therefore the Levites shall be mine;

rr: ahabw'okuba emijigaijo yoona n'eyangye; aha izooba eri naitiireho emijigaijo yoona ey'omu nsi ya Misri, nibwo naayeyereza emijigaijo yoona omuri Israeli, ey'abantu n'ey'amatungo. Emijigaijo yoona eryaguma ebe eyangye. Niinye MUKAMA.
en: because all the firstborn are mine; for on the day that I smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I hallowed unto me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and beast: mine shall they be: I am the LORD .

rr: Kandi MUKAMA yaagambirira Musa omu ihamba rya Sinai, ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,

rr: Bara Abaleevi, nk'oku amaju ga baishenkurubo gari, n'emiryango yaabo oku eri; obare oyetwa omushaija weena, okwiha aha beereere abahikize okwezi.
en: Number the children of Levi after the house of their fathers, by their families: every male from a month old and upward shalt thou number them.

rr: Musa yaayorobera ekigambo kya MUKAMA, yaababara nk'oku yaaragiirwe.
en: And Moses numbered them according to the word of the LORD , as he was commanded.

rr: Aga nigo maziina ga batabani ba Leevi, Gereshoni, Kohasi na Merari.
en: And these were the sons of Levi by their names; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.

rr: Kandi aga nigo maziina ga beene Gereshoni, nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri, Libuni na Shimei.
en: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families; Libni, and Shimei.

rr: Kandi aba nibo beene Kohasi nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri, Amuraamu, Izuhaari, Heburooni na Uzieli.
en: And the sons of Kohath by their families; Amram, and Izehar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

rr: Na beene Merari nk'oku emiryango yaabo yaabaire eri nibo aba; Mahili na Muushi.
en: And the sons of Merari by their families; Mahli, and Mushi.

rr: Egyo niyo miryango y'Abaleevi, nk'oku amaju ga baishenkurubo gaabaire gari.
en: These are the families of the Levites according to the house of their fathers.

rr: Omuri Gereshoni nimwo haakomookire omuryango gw'aba Libuni n'ogw'aba Shimei; egyo niyo miryango y'aba Gereshoni.
en: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimites: these are the families of the Gershonites.

rr: Omubaro gw'abarikwetwa abashaija boona okwiha aha beereere abahikize okwezi kumwe gukaba guri enkumi mushanju na magana ataano.
en: Those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, even those that were numbered of them were seven thousand and five hundred.

rr: Emiryango y'aba Gereshoni egume eteere amahema gaayo enyima y'Obutaaho aha rubaju rw'oburengyerwa-izooba.
en: The families of the Gershonites shall pitch behind the tabernacle westward.

rr: Kandi omwebembezi w'enju ya baishenkuru b'aba Gereshoni abe Eliasaafu mwene Laeli.
en: And the chief of the house of the father of the Gershonites shall be Eliasaph the son of Lael.

rr: Eby'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu ebiraakwatsibwe beene Gereshoni, bibe Obutaaho n'Eihema, eby'okurishakaara, omukingo gw'okukinga aha muryango gw'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu
en: And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation shall be the tabernacle, and the tent, the covering thereof, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,

rr: emikingo y'orugo, n'omukingo ogw'aha irembo ry'orwo rugo orwehinguririize Obutaaho n'eitambiro, n'emirunga yaarwo, kandi n'emirimo yoona ey'ebyo bintu.
en: and the hangings of the court, and the curtain for the door of the court, which is by the tabernacle, and by the altar round about, and the cords of it for all the service thereof.

rr: Omuri Kohasi nimwo haakomookire omuryango gw'aba Amuraamu, n'ogw'aba Izuhaari, n'ogw'aba Heburooni, n'ogw'aba Uzieli; egyo niyo miryango y'aba Kohasi.
en: And of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izeharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these are the families of the Kohathites.

rr: Abeetwa abashaija boona okwiha aha beereere abahikize okwezi kumwe bakaba bari enkumi munaana na magana mukaaga, abaakwatsiibwe eby'Omwanya ogurikwera.
en: In the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were eight thousand and six hundred, keeping the charge of the sanctuary.

rr: Emiryango ya beene Kohasi egume eteere amahema gaayo aha rubaju rw'Obutaaho orw'obukiizi-bwa-buryo.
en: The families of the sons of Kohath shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle southward.

rr: Kandi omwebembezi w'enju ya baishenkurubo omu miryango y'aba Kohasi abe Elizafaani mwene Uzieli.
en: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.

rr: Ebi baraakwatsibwe bibe eshanduukye y'endagaano, emeeza, ekikondo ky'amatabaaza, n'amatambiro, n'ebintu by'Omwanya ogurikwera ebirikukoresibwa abanyamurwa n'omukingo gwaho, kandi n'emirimo yaabyo yoona.
en: And their charge shall be the ark, and the table, and the candlestick, and the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary wherewith they minister, and the hanging, and all the service thereof.

rr: Kandi Eleazaari mwene Arooni omunyamurwa abe niwe yaaba omukuru w'abeebembezi b'Abaleevi, areeberere abakwatsiibwe eby'Omwanya ogurikwera.
en: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be chief over the chief of the Levites, and have the oversight of them that keep the charge of the sanctuary.

rr: Omuri Merari nimwo haakomookire omuryango gw'aba Mahili, n'ogw'aba Muushi; egyo niyo miryango y'aba Merari.
en: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites: these are the families of Merari.

rr: Ab'omuribo abarikwetwa abashaija boona okwiha aha beereere abahikize okwezi kumwe bakaba bari enkumi mukaaga na magana abiri.
en: And those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were six thousand and two hundred.

rr: Omukuru w'enju ya baishenkurubo omu miryango ya Merari akaba ari Zurieli mwene Abihaili; abo bagume bateere amahema gaabo aha rubaju rw'Obutaaho orw'obukiizi-bwa-bumosho.
en: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail: these shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle northward.

rr: Ebi beene Merari baraakwatsibwe bibe embaaho z'Obutaaho n'embazi zaazo n'enyomyo zaabwo n'ebiina byazo n'ebintu byabyo byona, kandi n'emirimo yaabyo yoona
en: And under the custody and charge of the sons of Merari shall be the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof, and all the vessels thereof, and all that serveth thereto,

rr: kandi n'enyomyo z'orugo orwehinguririize ekibuga, n'ebiina byazo n'enkondo zaazo n'emirunga yaazo.
en: and the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords.

rr: Abaraagume nibateera amahema aha rubaju rw'Obutaaho orw'oburugwa-izooba, omu maisho g'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu, aharikureeba ei eizooba rireetwa, ni Musa na Arooni n'abatabani, abaakwatsiibwe omurimo gw'Omwanya ogurikwera, ogurikukorwa ahabw'Abaisraeli; otari w'omuribo ku arihika haihi yaabyetaasyamu, aitwe.
en: But those that encamp before the tabernacle toward the east, even before the tabernacle of the congregation eastward, shall be Moses, and Aaron and his sons, keeping the charge of the sanctuary for the charge of the children of Israel; and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

rr: Abaleevi boona abaabazirwe, abu Musa na Arooni baabazire ahabw'ekiragiro kya MUKAMA, nk'emiryango yaabo oku eri, abeetwa abashaija boona okwiha aha beereere abahikize okwezi kumwe, bakaba bari obukumi bubiri n'enkumi ibiri.
en: All that were numbered of the Levites, which Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of the LORD , throughout their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty and two thousand.

rr: Kandi MUKAMA yaaragiira Musa ati: Bara abeetwa abashaija boona ab'emijigaijo omu Baisraeli okwiha aha beereere abahikize okwezi kumwe, ohandiikye omubaro gw'amaziina gaabo.
en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Number all the firstborn of the males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.

rr: Ontooranire Abaleevi niinye MUKAMA omu mwanya gw'emijigaijo yoona ey'Abaisraeli; ompe n'amatungo g'Abaleevi omu mwanya gw'emijigaijo yoona ey'amatungo g'Abaisraeli.
en: And thou shalt take the Levites for me (I am the LORD ) instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites instead of all the firstlings among the cattle of the children of Israel.

rr: Musa yaabara emijigaijo yoona ey'Abaisraeli, nk'oku MUKAMA yaamuragiire.
en: And Moses numbered, as the LORD commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

rr: Abeetwa abashaija boona ab'emijigaijo okwiha aha beereere abahikize okwezi, omubaro gw'amaziina gaabo gwaba obukumi bubiri n'enkumi ibiri na magana abiri na makumi mushanju na bashatu.
en: And all the firstborn males by the number of names, from a month old and upward, of those that were numbered of them, were twenty and two thousand two hundred and threescore and thirteen.

rr: Kandi MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Twara Abaleevi omu mwanya gw'emijigaijo yoona ey'Abaisraeli, otware n'amatungo g'Abaleevi omu mwanya gw'emijigaijo y'amatungo gaabo, Abaleevi babe abangye; niinye MUKAMA.
en: Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle; and the Levites shall be mine: I am the LORD .

rr: Kandi ahabw'okucungura emijigaijo y'Abaisraeli magana abiri na makumi mushanju na bashatu abaashaagire aha mubaro gw'Abaleevi
en: And for those that are to be redeemed of the two hundred and threescore and thirteen of the firstborn of the children of Israel, which are more than the Levites;

rr: otware shekeli itaano za buri omwe ahari egyo mijigaijo, otware eziri nka shekeli ey'Omwanya ogurikwera oku eri; (shekeli emwe erimu geera makumi abiri)
en: thou shalt even take five shekels apiece by the poll, after the shekel of the sanctuary shalt thou take them: (the shekel is twenty gerahs:)

rr: ohe Arooni n'abatabani ezo feeza z'okucungura egyo mijigaijo eshaagire.
en: and thou shalt give the money, wherewith the odd number of them is to be redeemed, unto Aaron and to his sons.

rr: Ahari abo abaashaagire aha baacungwirwe Abaleevi, Musa yaabaihaho efeeza z'okubacungura
en: And Moses took the redemption money of them that were over and above them that were redeemed by the Levites:

rr: efeeza ezi yaihire ahari egyo mijigaijo y'Abaisraeli zaaba shekeli rukumi na magana ashatu na makumi mukaaga na itaano, nka shekeli ey'Omwanya ogurikwera oku eri.
en: of the firstborn of the children of Israel took he the money; a thousand three hundred and threescore and five shekels , after the shekel of the sanctuary:

rr: Musa yaaha Arooni n'abatabani ezo feeza z'okucungura, nk'ekigambo eki MUKAMA yaaragiire oku kyabaire kiri.
en: and Moses gave the money of them that were redeemed unto Aaron and to his sons, according to the word of the LORD , as the LORD commanded Moses.
