rr: Kandi MUKAMA yaagambira Musa na Arooni ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

rr: Mubare beene Kohasi, mubashoroore omu Baleevi, mubabare nk'emiryango yaabo oku eri, n'amaju ga baishenkurubo oku gari
en: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, after their families, by the house of their fathers,

rr: okwiha aha bahikize emyaka makumi ashatu, abatakarengize myaka makumi ataano, boona abarikubaasa kuza omu buheereza obwo, kukora omurimo gw'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu.
en: from thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all that enter into the host, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.

rr: Ogu nigwo murimo gwa beene Kohasi, ogu bashemereire kukora omu Ihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu; ogwo murimo n'ogw'ebintu birikwera munonga.
en: This shall be the service of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation, about the most holy things:

rr: Ab'omu rusiisira ku baryenda kwimutsya orugyendo, Arooni n'abatabani bataahemu, bahanure omukingo ogukingiire Aharikwera munonga, bagushwekye eshanduukye erimu Ebirikuhamya
en: and when the camp setteth forward, Aaron shall come, and his sons, and they shall take down the covering vail, and cover the ark of testimony with it:

rr: bashwekyeho eky'okushweka ky'empu z'engongi, nakyo bakiteho omwenda gwa bururu gwonka, bwanyima bate emigamba omu bifunga byayo.
en: and shall put thereon the covering of badgers' skins, and shall spread over it a cloth wholly of blue, and shall put in the staves thereof.

rr: Kandi aha meeza y'emigaati y'okumurika bateho omwenda gwa bururu, baguteho enyabya n'ebikopo n'ebakuri n'emidumo y'okushukisa empongano z'eby'okunywa; kandi emigaati y'obutoosha nayo ebeho
en: And upon the table of shewbread they shall spread a cloth of blue, and put thereon the dishes, and the spoons, and the bowls, and covers to cover withal: and the continual bread shall be thereon:

rr: babishwekye omwenda gurikutukura, nagwo baguteho eky'okushweka ky'empu z'engongi, bate emigamba omu bifunga byayo.
en: and they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, and cover the same with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put in the staves thereof.

rr: Kandi batware omwenda gwa bururu, bagushwekye ekikondo ky'etabaaza n'amatabaaza gaakyo n'empana zaakyo n'otusohaani twago, n'ebintu byakyo eby'okushukisa amajuta, ebi barikukoresa omurimo gwakyo
en: And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover the candlestick of the light, and his lamps, and his tongs, and his snuffdishes, and all the oil vessels thereof, wherewith they minister unto it:

rr: bakikomerane n'ebintu byakyo byona omu ky'okushweka ky'empu z'engongi, babite aha biti by'okubiheekyesa.
en: and they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put it upon a bar.

rr: Kandi ekyoterero ky'ezaabu bakishwekye omwenda gwa bururu, baguteho eky'okushweka ky'empu z'engongi, bate emigamba omu bifunga byakyo.
en: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue, and cover it with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put to the staves thereof:

rr: Kandi bareete ebintu ebi barikukoresa byona, ebiri kukoresibwa omu Mwanya ogurikwera, babikome omu mwenda gwa bururu, babishwekye eky'okushweka ky'empu z'engongi, babite aha biti by'okubiheekyesa.
en: and they shall take all the instruments of ministry, wherewith they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put them on a bar:

rr: Kandi bayoore eiju aha itambiro, bariteho omwenda gwa bujwa
en: and they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth thereon:

rr: bariteho n'ebintu byaryo byona, ebi barikukoresa emirimo yaaryo, n'eby'okuguhisa omuriro gw'amakara n'eby'okwihuza enyama, n'eby'okuyooreraho eiju, n'eby'okuriyooresa, n'enyabya, ebintu eby'eitambiro byona; babishwekye eky'okushweka ky'empu z'engongi, bate emigamba omu bifunga byaryo.
en: and they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof, wherewith they minister about it, even the censers, the fleshhooks, and the shovels, and the basons, all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread upon it a covering of badgers' skins, and put to the staves of it.

rr: Arooni n'abatabani ku bariguma baaheza kushweka eby'Omwanya ogurikwera n'ebirikukoresibwaho byona, ab'omu rusiisira baaba nibenda kwimutsya orugyendo, bwanyima beene Kohasi babone kwija kubiheeka; kwonka batarikora aha birikwera, batakaafa.
en: And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary, and all the vessels of the sanctuary, as the camp is to set forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to bear it: but they shall not touch any holy thing, lest they die.

rr: Ebyo nibyo bintu by'omu Ihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu ebiriheekwa beene Kohasi.
en: These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation.

rr: Kandi Eleazaari mwene Arooni omunyamurwa akwatsibwe amajuta g'okuhemba, n'obubaane burikutaamirana, n'empongano y'esaano y'obutoosha, n'amajuta ag'okushukaho ahabw'okushoroora; kandi akwatsibwe n'Obutaaho bwona n'ebirimu byona, n'Omwanya ogurikwera n'ebintu byaho.
en: And to the office of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest pertaineth the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the daily meat offering, and the anointing oil, and the oversight of all the tabernacle, and of all that therein is , in the sanctuary, and in the vessels thereof.

rr: Kandi MUKAMA yaagambira Musa na Arooni ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

rr: Mutareka omuryango gw'aba Kohasi kuhwerekyerezibwa, bakahwaho omu Baleevi
en: Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites:

rr: oku mube nikwo mwabatwaza, babone kugumaho, barekye kufa baahika aha bintu ebirikwera munonga. Arooni n'abatabani bagume bataahemu, baragiire buri omwe omurimo gwe n'eki ashemereire kutwara
en: but thus do unto them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach unto the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden:

rr: kwonka bataritaahamu bakareeba Aharikwera, n'obu kaakuba akaanya akarikwingana busha, batakaafa.
en: but they shall not go in to see when the holy things are covered, lest they die.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Kandi obare beene Gereshomu nabo, nk'amaju ga baishenkurubo oku gari, n'emiryango yaabo oku eri
en: Take also the sum of the sons of Gershon, throughout the houses of their fathers, by their families;

rr: obare boona abahikize emyaka makumi ashatu, abatakarengize makumi ataano, boona abarikubaasa kuza omu buheereza obwo kukora omurimo gw'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu.
en: from thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them; all that enter in to perform the service, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.

rr: Ogu nigwo murimo gw'emiryango y'aba Gereshoni omu kuheereza n'omu kuheeka ebintu
en: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, to serve, and for burdens:

rr: baryaguma baheekye emikingo y'Obutaaho, n'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu, n'eby'okurishakaara, n'eky'okushwekaho eky'empu z'engongi ekibishwekire, n'omukingo gw'omuryango gw'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu
en: and they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tabernacle of the congregation, his covering, and the covering of the badgers' skins that is above upon it, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,

rr: n'emikingo y'orugo, n'omukingo ogurikukinga eirembo ry'orugo orwehinguririize ekibuga ekirimu Obutaaho n'eitambiro, n'emirunga yaayo n'ebintu ebirikukoresibwa byona; babe nibo baakora emirimo yaabyo yoona.
en: and the hangings of the court, and the hanging for the door of the gate of the court, which is by the tabernacle and by the altar round about, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and all that is made for them: so shall they serve.

rr: Arooni n'abatabani nibo bariguma nibaragiira beene Gereshoni emirimo yaabo yoona omu bi bariba nibaheeka byona, n'omu kuheereza kwabo kwona; mubakwatse ebi bashemereire kuheeka byona.
en: At the appointment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burdens, and in all their service: and ye shall appoint unto them in charge all their burdens.

rr: Obwo nibwo buheereza bw'emiryango ya beene Gereshoni omu by'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu; omu mirimo yaabo baryaguma nibareebererwa Itamaari mwene Arooni omunyamurwa.
en: This is the service of the families of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation: and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

rr: Ebya beene Merari, oryababara nk'emiryango yaabo oku eri n'amaju ga baishenkurubo oku gari
en: As for the sons of Merari, thou shalt number them after their families, by the house of their fathers;

rr: obare boona abahikize emyaka makumi ashatu, abatakarengize makumi ataano, boona abarikubaasa kuza omu buheereza obwo kukora omurimo gw'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu.
en: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old shalt thou number them, every one that entereth into the service, to do the work of the tabernacle of the congregation.

rr: Ebi babe nibyo baakwatsibwa kuheeka omu buheereza bwabo bwona obw'omu by'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu; embaaho z'Obutaaho, embazi zaazo, n'enyomyo zaazo n'ebiina byazo
en: And this is the charge of their burden, according to all their service in the tabernacle of the congregation; the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and sockets thereof,

rr: kandi n'enyomyo z'orugo orwehinguririize obwo Butaaho n'ebiina byazo n'enkondo zaazo n'emirunga yaazo, n'ebintu byabyo byona ebirikukoresibwa omu buheereza bwabo bwona; kandi mugambe amaziina g'ebintu ebi omuntu weena ashemereire kuheeka.
en: and the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service: and by name ye shall reckon the instruments of the charge of their burden.

rr: Obwo nibwo buheereza bw'emiryango ya beene Merari, nk'emirimo yaabo yoona oku eri omu by'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu, nibareebererwa Itamaari mwene Arooni omunyamurwa.
en: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the tabernacle of the congregation, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

rr: Musa na Arooni n'abakuru b'eihanga ryona baabara beene Kohasi nk'emiryango yaabo oku eri, n'amaju ga baishenkurubo oku gari
en: And Moses and Aaron and the chief of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites after their families, and after the house of their fathers,

rr: baabara abahikize emyaka makumi ashatu abatakarengize makumi ataano, boona abarikubaasa kuza omu buheereza obwo kukora omurimo gw'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu.
en: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation:

rr: Abaabazirwe omuribo nk'emiryango yaabo oku eri baaba enkumi ibiri na magana mushanju na makumi ataano.
en: and those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.

rr: Abo nibo baabazirwe omu miryango y'aba Kohasi, boona abaabaire nibakora omurimo gw'eby'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu, abu Musa na Arooni baabazire, nk'oku MUKAMA yaaragiire naaraba omuri Musa.
en: These were they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, which Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

rr: Kandi abaabazirwe ahari beene Gereshoni, nk'emiryango yaabo oku yaabaire eri, n'amaju ga baishenkurubo oku gaabaire gari
en: And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon, throughout their families, and by the house of their fathers,

en: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,

rr: abaabazirwe aharibo nk'emiryango yaabo oku yaabaire eri, n'amaju ga baishenkurubo oku gaabaire gari, baaba enkumi ibiri na magana mukaaga na makumi ashatu.
en: even those that were numbered of them, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers, were two thousand and six hundred and thirty.

rr: Abo nibo baabazirwe omu miryango ya beene Gereshoni, boona abaabaire bakora omurimo gw'eby'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu, abu Musa na Arooni baabazire, nk'oku MUKAMA yaaragiire.
en: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, of all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, whom Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the LORD .

rr: Kandi abaabazirwe omu miryango ya beene Merari, nk'emiryango yaabo oku yaabaire eri, n'amaju ga baishenkurubo oku gaabaire gari
en: And those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers,

rr: abahikize emyaka makumi ashatu, abatakarengize makumi ataano, boona abarikubaasa kuza omu buheereza obwo kukora omurimo gw'eby'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu
en: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,

rr: abaabazirwe nk'emiryango yaabo oku yaabaire eri, baaba enkumi ishatu na magana abiri.
en: even those that were numbered of them after their families, were three thousand and two hundred.

rr: Abo nibo baabazirwe omu miryango ya beene Merari, abu Musa na Arooni baabazire nk'oku MUKAMA yaaragiire naaraba omuri Musa.
en: These be those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

en: All those that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the chief of Israel numbered, after their families, and after the house of their fathers,

en: from thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that came to do the service of the ministry, and the service of the burden in the tabernacle of the congregation,

en: Command the children of Israel, that they put out of the camp every leper, and every one that hath an issue, and whosoever is defiled by the dead:

en: both male and female shall ye put out, without the camp shall ye put them; that they defile not their camps, in the midst whereof I dwell.

en: And the children of Israel did so, and put them out without the camp: as the LORD spake unto Moses, so did the children of Israel.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Gambira Abaisraeli oti: Omushaija nari omukazi ku arikora ekibi kyona eki abantu bakora, bakacumura ahari MUKAMA, yaagiibwaho orubanja
en: Speak unto the children of Israel, When a man or woman shall commit any sin that men commit, to do a trespass against the LORD , and that person be guilty;

rr: ayature ekibi eki akozire, arihe ekimureeteire orubanja ataine ki atsigireyo, akihe ou akozire kubi, kandi akyongyereho ekicweka kyakyo kya kataano.
en: then they shall confess their sin which they have done: and he shall recompense his trespass with the principal thereof, and add unto it the fifth part thereof, and give it unto him against whom he hath trespassed.

rr: Kwonka ogwo ou akozire kubi, ku ariba ataine waabo ow'okurihwa, egyo ndihano erihwe MUKAMA, ebe ey'omunyamurwa, kandi eyongyerweho empaya y'entaama ey'okurihiirira, ei baraamurihiirire.
en: But if the man have no kinsman to recompense the trespass unto, let the trespass be recompensed unto the LORD , even to the priest; beside the ram of the atonement, whereby an atonement shall be made for him.

rr: Kandi buri mpongano y'ebintu ebirikwera ebi Abaisraeli barireetera omunyamurwa eryaba eye.
en: And every offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they bring unto the priest, shall be his.

rr: Ebirikwera byona ebi omuntu ashoroire biryaba eby'omunyamurwa; eki omuntu ariha omunyamurwa kyona, kiryaba ekye. Emitwarize ey'okushoora omukazi ou barikuteekateekaho ngu ashambaine
en: And every man's hallowed things shall be his: whatsoever any man giveth the priest, it shall be his.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Gambira Abaisraeli oti: Muka mushaija ku aryekiika aha rubaju, yaakora ekitari ky'obwesigwa ahari iba
en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man's wife go aside, and commit a trespass against him,

rr: omushaija ondi yaabyama nawe, kyasherekwa iba ataakimanya, ogwo mukazi yaasiisikara, hataine orikumushinja ahabw'okutagira omukwatsire naakikora
en: and a man lie with her carnally, and it be hid from the eyes of her husband, and be kept close, and she be defiled, and there be no witness against her, neither she be taken with the manner ;

rr: iba yaagira omutima gw'obufuuhi, yaafuuhira omukazi we, n'obu yaakuba atasiisire
en: and the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be defiled: or if the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be not defiled;

rr: obwo ogwo mushaija aryatwara omukazi we aha munyamurwa, ayereetere empongano, ey'ekicweka kimwe kya ikumi ekya eefa y'esaano ya sayiri; atarigishukaho amajuta n'obu bwakuba obubaane bwa lebona, ahabw'okuba n'empongano y'esaano ahabw'obufuuhi, empongano y'esaano ey'ekiijutsyo eky'okwijutsya okutahikiirira.
en: then shall the man bring his wife unto the priest, and he shall bring her offering for her, the tenth part of an ephah of barley meal; he shall pour no oil upon it, nor put frankincense thereon; for it is an offering of jealousy, an offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to remembrance.

rr: Omunyamurwa airize haihi ogwo mukazi, amute omu maisho ga MUKAMA
en: And the priest shall bring her near, and set her before the LORD :

rr: omunyamurwa atware amaizi garikwera omu rwabya rw'eibumba, atware aha mucuucu gw'ahansi omu Butaaho, agute omuri ago maizi
en: and the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and of the dust that is in the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take, and put it into the water:

rr: kandi ate ogwo mukazi omu maisho ga MUKAMA, azingurure eishokye ry'aha mutwe gwe, amute omu ngaro egyo mpongano y'ekiijutsyo, empongano y'esaano ahabw'obufuuho; kandi omunyamurwa akwate omu ngaro ago maizi garikushaarira, agari kureeta omukyeeno.
en: and the priest shall set the woman before the LORD , and uncover the woman's head, and put the offering of memorial in her hands, which is the jealousy offering: and the priest shall have in his hand the bitter water that causeth the curse:

rr: Bwanyima arahize ogwo mukazi, naamugira ati: Ku oraabe otaine mushaija ou oshambaine nawe, oteekiikire okeeshiisha, haza nookitegyekwa baro, aga maizi garikushaarira, agarikureeta omukyeeno, garekye kugira eki gaakukoraho.
en: and the priest shall charge her by an oath, and say unto the woman, If no man have lain with thee, and if thou hast not gone aside to uncleanness with another instead of thy husband, be thou free from this bitter water that causeth the curse:

rr: Kwonka ku oraabe oyekiikire nookitegyekwa baro, okeeshiisha, okabyama n'ondiijo mushaija otari baro
en: but if thou hast gone aside to another instead of thy husband, and if thou be defiled, and some man have lain with thee beside thine husband:

rr: omunyamurwa arahize ogwo mukazi endahiro y'okukyeenwa, amugire ati: MUKAMA akuhindure eky'okukyeenwa kandi eky'okurahira omu ihanga ryawe, ku araanyuunyuure ekibero kyawe, yaakuhazya enda
en: then the priest shall charge the woman with an oath of cursing, and the priest shall say unto the woman, The LORD make thee a curse and an oath among thy people, when the LORD doth make thy thigh to rot, and thy belly to swell;

rr: kandi amaizi aga agarikureeta omukyeeno nigaija kukuza omu mara, gakuhazye enda, gakunyuunyuure ekibero. Ogwo mukazi aikirize ati: 5:22 Amiina, amakuru gaakyo ngu: Kibe kityo. Amiina! Amiina.
en: and this water that causeth the curse shall go into thy bowels, to make thy belly to swell, and thy thigh to rot: And the woman shall say, Amen, amen.

rr: Bwanyima ogwo munyamurwa ahandiikye ebigambo by'egyo mikyeeno omu kitabo, abyozye n'amaizi, gaze omuri ago agarikushaarira
en: And the priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall blot them out with the bitter water:

rr: anywaise ogwo mukazi ago maizi garikushaarira agarikureeta omukyeeno; ago maizi agarikureeta omukyeeno gamuze omu nda, gaamushaarire.
en: and he shall cause the woman to drink the bitter water that causeth the curse: and the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter.

rr: Omunyamurwa aihe omu ngaro z'ogwo mukazi egyo mpongano y'esaano ahabw'obufuuhi, agizongazonzye omu maisho ga MUKAMA, agitware aha itambiro
en: Then the priest shall take the jealousy offering out of the woman's hand, and shall wave the offering before the LORD , and offer it upon the altar:

rr: aihe ahari egyo mpongano oruhi rwayo, rube ekiijutsyo kyayo, orwo ruhi rw'esaano arwokyeze aha itambiro, abone kunywaisa ogwo mukazi ago maizi.
en: and the priest shall take an handful of the offering, even the memorial thereof, and burn it upon the altar, and afterward shall cause the woman to drink the water.

rr: Ku ariheza kugamunywaisa, biryaba biti: ku ariba ayesiisire, akozire ebitari by'obwesigwa ahari iba, ago maizi agarikureeta omukyeeno garyamuza omu nda, gamushaarire, ahagye enda, ekibero kye kinyuunyuukye; ogwo mukazi ahindukye eky'okukyeenwa omu ihanga rye.
en: And when he hath made her to drink the water, then it shall come to pass, that , if she be defiled, and have done trespass against her husband, that the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter, and her belly shall swell, and her thigh shall rot: and the woman shall be a curse among her people.

rr: Kwonka ku ariba ateesiisire, yaashangwa ari oshemeire, tihaine kirimubaho; aryarekurwa, azaare abaana.
en: And if the woman be not defiled, but be clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive seed.

rr: Ekyo nikyo kiragiro ky'obufuuhi aha mukazi oine iba orikwekiika, akeeshiisha
en: This is the law of jealousies, when a wife goeth aside to another instead of her husband, and is defiled;

rr: n'aha mushaija owaagira omutima gw'obufuuhi, akafuuhira omukazi we; obwo aryareeta omukazi we omu maisho ga MUKAMA, omunyamurwa amukorere eby'emigyenzo y'ekyo kiragiro byona.
en: or when the spirit of jealousy cometh upon him, and he be jealous over his wife, and shall set the woman before the LORD , and the priest shall execute upon her all this law.

rr: Omushaija aryaihwaho okutahikiirira kwe, kwonka omukazi okutahikiirira kuryamugumaho.
en: Then shall the man be guiltless from iniquity, and this woman shall bear her iniquity.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Gambira Abaisraeli oti: Omushaija nari omukazi ku arihiga okuhiga okutari kw'obutoosha okw'Omunaziiri, naaraganisa kweshoroorera MUKAMA
en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When either man or woman shall separate themselves to vow a vow of a Nazarite, to separate themselves unto the LORD :

rr: ayetaanise na viinyo n'eky'okunywa ky'amaani, atarinywa viinyo erikushaarira, nari eky'okunywa ky'amaani kyona ekirikushaarira, n'obu kwakuba okunywa eky'okunywa kyona ekirikuruga omu mizaabibu, nari okurya ebijuma byayo ebibisi nari ebyomire.
en: he shall separate himself from wine and strong drink, and shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any liquor of grapes, nor eat moist grapes, or dried.

rr: Ebiro byona ebi arimara omu bunaziiri atarirya ekintu kyona ekirikuruga omu muzaabibu, okuruga aha mbibo zaayo okuhika aha kishushu kyayo.
en: All the days of his separation shall he eat nothing that is made of the vine tree, from the kernels even to the husk.

rr: Ebiro byona ebi arimara omu bunaziiri, orumweiso rutarimuraba aha mutwe; aryaba orikwera, arekye obutsibo bw'eishokye rye bukure, okuhitsya obu ebiro by'okweshoroora kwe ahari MUKAMA birihwaho.
en: All the days of the vow of his separation there shall no razor come upon his head: until the days be fulfilled, in the which he separateth himself unto the LORD , he shall be holy, and shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow.

rr: Ebiro byona eby'okweshoroora kwe ahari MUKAMA atarihika aha mutumbi.
en: All the days that he separateth himself unto the LORD he shall come at no dead body.

rr: Ishe nari nyina nari mwene nyina nari munyaanya, ku arifa, ataryeshiisha ahabw'orufu rwabo, ahabw'okuba okweshoroora kwe ahari Ruhanga kuri aha mutwe gwe.
en: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die: because the consecration of his God is upon his head.

rr: Ebiro byona ebi arimara omu bunaziiri aryaba oyereziibwe MUKAMA.
en: All the days of his separation he is holy unto the LORD .

rr: Ku harigira omuntu yaamukinukira aha rubaju, yaashiisha omutwe gw'obunaziiri bwe, aryamwa eishokye rye aha izooba ry'okushemezibwa kwe; aha kiro kya mushanju niho aririmwera.
en: And if any man die very suddenly by him, and he hath defiled the head of his consecration; then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing, on the seventh day shall he shave it.

rr: Kandi aha kiro kya munana aryareeta obwiba bubiri nari enkombe nto ibiri, abiheere omunyamurwa aha muryango gw'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu
en: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons, to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:

rr: omunyamurwa ahongyeho emwe kuba ekitambo ky'ekibi, n'endi okuba ekitambo eky'okwotsya, amurihiirire, ahabw'okuba asiisire ahabw'omufu. Bwanyima ahari eryo izooba ayeze omutwe gwe
en: and the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make an atonement for him, for that he sinned by the dead, and shall hallow his head that same day.

rr: ayeshoroore ahari MUKAMA okumara ebiro byona eby'obunaziiri bwe, areete empaya nto y'entaama ehikize omwaka kuba ekitambo ky'okwihaho orubanja; ahakuba ebiro bye eby'okubanza biryaba bifiire busha, ahabw'okuba obunaziiri bwe busiisikaire.
en: And he shall consecrate unto the LORD the days of his separation, and shall bring a lamb of the first year for a trespass offering: but the days that were before shall be lost, because his separation was defiled.

rr: Eki nikyo kiragiro ky'Omunaziiri, ebiro by'obunaziiri bwe ku birihwa. Aryareetwa aha muryango gw'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu
en: And this is the law of the Nazarite, when the days of his separation are fulfilled: he shall be brought unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:

rr: ahongyere MUKAMA empongano ze, empaya nto y'entaama emwe ehikize omwaka etaine kamogo kuba ekitambo ky'okwotsya, omwagazi gw'entaama gumwe oguhikize omwaka ogutaine kamogo kuba ekitambo ky'ekibi, empaya y'embuzi emwe etaine kamogo kuba ekitambo ky'okusiima ahabw'obusingye
en: and he shall offer his offering unto the LORD , one he lamb of the first year without blemish for a burnt offering, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish for a sin offering, and one ram without blemish for peace offerings,

rr: ekiibo ky'emigaati etatumbisiibwe otukeeki tw'esaano y'obunono ejwangize n'amajuta, na capati ezitatumbisiibwe ezisiigirwe amajuta, hamwe n'empongano zaabyo z'esaano n'ez'eby'okunywa.
en: and a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, and wafers of unleavened bread anointed with oil, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings.

rr: Omunyamurwa abimurikye omu maisho ga MUKAMA, amuhongyerere ekitambo kye ky'ekibi n'eky'okwotsya
en: And the priest shall bring them before the LORD , and shall offer his sin offering, and his burnt offering:

rr: kandi ahongyere MUKAMA egyo mpaya y'entaama kuba ekitambo ky'empongano z'okusiima ahabw'obusingye, abihongye n'ekiibo ky'egyo migaati etatumbisiibwe; kandi omunyamurwa ahongye empongano zaabyo ez'esaano n'ez'eby'okunywa.
en: and he shall offer the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD , with the basket of unleavened bread: the priest shall offer also his meat offering, and his drink offering.

rr: Obwo ogwo Munaziiri amwe eishokye aha mutwe gwe ogw'obunaziiri, arimwere aha muryango gw'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu, atware eryo ishokye ry'aha mutwe gwe ogw'obunaziri, arite aha muriro oguri ahansi y'ekitambo ky'empongano z'okusiima ahabw'obusingye.
en: And the Nazarite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall take the hair of the head of his separation, and put it in the fire which is under the sacrifice of the peace offerings.

rr: Omunyamurwa atware ekivune ky'omukono ky'egyo mpaya y'entaama kiteekire, aihe akakeeki kamwe akatatumbisiibwe omuri ekyo kiibo, na capati emwe etatumbisiibwe, abite omu ngaro z'ogwo Munaziiri, yaaheza kumwa eishokye ry'aha mutwe gwe ogw'obunaziiri
en: And the priest shall take the sodden shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them upon the hands of the Nazarite, after the hair of his separation is shaven:

rr: omunyamurwa abizongazonzye omu maisho ga MUKAMA; bibe omugabo gw'omunyamurwa ogurikwera, hamwe n'enkoro ezongazongiibwe n'ekivune ky'okuguru ekihongirwe. Ebyo ku birihwa, Omunaziiri abone kunywa viinyo.
en: and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD : this is holy for the priest, with the wave breast and heave shoulder: and after that the Nazarite may drink wine.

rr: Ekyo nikyo kiragiro ky'Omunaziiri orikuhiga, n'eky'empongano ezi arihongyera MUKAMA ahabw'obunaziiri bwe, otabariiremu ebi arikubaasa kuhonga ahabw'okweyendera; okuhiga oku yaahigire akuhikiirize, nk'ekiragiro ky'obunaziiri bwe oku kiri. Omugisha ogu abanyamurwa baabaire bashabira Abaisraeli
en: This is the law of the Nazarite who hath vowed, and of his offering unto the LORD for his separation, beside that his hand shall get: according to the vow which he vowed, so he must do after the law of his separation.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Gambira Arooni n'abatabani oti: Oku nikwo muriguma nimushabira Abaisraeli omugisha, nimugira muti
en: Speak unto Aaron and unto his sons, saying, On this wise ye shall bless the children of Israel, saying unto them,

rr: MUKAMA akuhe omugisha, akurinde
en: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee:

rr: MUKAMA akwakize omushana gw'amaisho ge, akugirire embabazi
en: The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee:

rr: MUKAMA akwimukize amaisho ge, akuhe obusingye.
en: The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.

rr: Okwo nikwo bariguma nibata eiziina ryangye aha Baisraeli; naanye ndyaguma mbahe omugisha.
en: And they shall put my name upon the children of Israel; and I will bless them.

rr: Musa ku yaaherize kwimutsya Obutaaho, n'okubushukaho amajuta g'okubushoroora, n'okubweza n'ebintu byabwo byona, n'eitambiro n'ebintu byaryo byona, nabyo yaaheza kubishukaho amajuta g'okubishoroora, n'okubyeza
en: And it came to pass on the day that Moses had fully set up the tabernacle, and had anointed it, and sanctified it, and all the instruments thereof, both the altar and all the vessels thereof, and had anointed them, and sanctified them;

rr: 2 ahari eryo izooba abeebembezi ba Israeli, abakuru b'amaju ga baishenkurubo, nabo baahonga empongano; abo nibo beebembezi b'enganda, abaabaire nibategyeka abaabazirwe
en: that the princes of Israel, heads of the house of their fathers, who were the princes of the tribes, and were over them that were numbered, offered:

rr: baareeta empongano zaabo omu maisho ga MUKAMA, ebigaari mukaaga ebiine ekisanga ahaiguru n'enimi ikumi na ibiri, ekigaari kimwe ahabw'abeebembezi babiri, n'enimi emwe ahabwa buri mwebembezi; baabimurika omu maisho g'Obutaaho.
en: and they brought their offering before the LORD , six covered wagons, and twelve oxen; a wagon for two of the princes, and for each one an ox: and they brought them before the tabernacle.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Ikiriza ebi, ebi baahonga, bibe eby'okukoresibwa emirimo y'eby'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu, obihe Abaleevi, nk'obuheereza bwa buri muntu oku buri.
en: Take it of them, that they may be to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; and thou shalt give them unto the Levites, to every man according to his service.

rr: Musa nikwo kwakiira ebyo bigaari n'ezo nimi, akabiha Abaleevi.
en: And Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them unto the Levites.

rr: Ebigaari bibiri n'enimi ina yaabiha beene Gereshoni, nk'obuheereza bwabo oku buri
en: Two wagons and four oxen he gave unto the sons of Gershon, according to their service:

rr: ebigaari bina n'enimi munaana yaabiha beene Merari, nk'obuheereza bwabo oku buri, okureebererwa Itamaari mwene Arooni omunyamurwa.
en: and four wagons and eight oxen he gave unto the sons of Merari, according unto their service, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

rr: Kwonka beene Kohasi tiyaagira ki yaabaha, ahabw'okuba bakakwatsibwa obuheereza bw'eby'Omwanya ogurikwera kuguma nibabiheeka aha mabega.
en: But unto the sons of Kohath he gave none: because the service of the sanctuary belonging unto them was that they should bear upon their shoulders.

rr: Kandi abo beebembezi baahonga empongano z'okweza eitambiro aha izooba eri ryashukiirweho amajuta g'okurishoroora, baazihongyera omu maisho gaaryo.
en: And the princes offered for dedicating of the altar in the day that it was anointed, even the princes offered their offering before the altar.

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira musa ati: Bagume bareete empongano zaabo z'okweza eitambiro, buri mwebembezi aha izooba rye.
en: And the LORD said unto Moses, They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedicating of the altar.

rr: Owaareetsire empongano ye aha kiro ky'okubanza ni Nahashooni mwene Aminadabu ow'omu ruganda rwa Yuda.
en: And he that offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah:

rr: Empongano ye ekaba eri eshohaani y'efeeza, oburemeezi bwayo shekeli igana na makumi ashatu, n'orwabya rw'efeeza, oburemeezi bwarwo shekeli makumi mushanju, nka shekeli ey'Omwanya ogurikwera oku eri, byombi biijwire esaano y'obunono ejwangize n'amajuta kuba empongano y'esaano
en: and his offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels , one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them were full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

rr: n'ekikopo ky'ezaabu ekiine oburemeezi bwa shekeli ikumi, kiijwire obubaane
en: one spoon of ten shekels of gold, full of incense:

rr: enimi y'ekimasha emwe, empaya y'entaama emwe, n'empaya nto y'entaama ehikize omwaka gumwe, kuba ekitambo ky'okwotsya
en: one young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:

rr: n'empaya y'embuzi emwe kuba ekitambo ky'ekibi
en: one kid of the goats for a sin offering:

rr: kandi enimi ibiri, empaya z'entaama itaano, ez'embuzi itaano, n'empaya nto z'entaama itaano ezihikize omwaka gumwe kuba ekitambo ky'empongano z'okusiima ahabw'obusingye; ezo nizo mpongano za Nahashooni mwene Aminadabu.
en: and for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

rr: Aha kiro kya kabiri Netaneeli mwene Zuari omwebembezi w'Abaisakaari yaaba niwe yaahonga
en: On the second day Nethaneel the son of Zuar, prince of Issachar, did offer:

rr: empongano ye ei yaahongire, ekaba eri eshohaani y'efeeza, oburemeezi bwayo shekeli igana na makumi ashatu, n'orwabya rw'efeeza, oburemeezi bwarwo shekeli makumi mushanju, nka shekeli ey'Omwanya ogurikwera oku eri, byombi biijwire esaano y'obunono ejwangize n'amajuta kuba empongano y'esaano
en: he offered for his offering one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels , one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

rr: n'ekikopo ky'ezaabu ekiine oburemeezi bwa shekeli ikumi, kiijwire obubaane
en: one spoon of gold of ten shekels , full of incense:

rr: Ezi nizo mpongano zoona abeebembezi b'Abaisraeli ezi baahongire ahabw'okweza eitambiro, aha izooba eri ryashukiirweho amajuta g'okurishoroora, eshohaani z'efeeza ikumi na ibiri, enyabya z'efeeza ikumi na ibiri, n'ebikopo by'ezaabu ikumi na bibiri
en: This was the dedication of the altar, in the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve chargers of silver, twelve silver bowls, twelve spoons of gold:

rr: oburemeezi bwa buri shohaani y'efeeza bukaba buri shekeli igana na makumi ashatu, na buri rwabya shekeli makumi mushanju; efeeza z'ebyo bintu byona zaagira oburemeezi bwa shekeli enkumi ibiri na magana ana, nk'efeeza y'Omwanya ogurikwera oku eri
en: each charger of silver weighing an hundred and thirty shekels , each bowl seventy: all the silver vessels weighed two thousand and four hundred shekels , after the shekel of the sanctuary:

rr: kandi ebikopo by'ezaabu ikumi na bibiri ebiijwire obubaane, buri kimwe kikaba kiine oburemeezi bwa shekeli ikumi, nka shekeli ey'Omwanya ogurikwera oku eri, ezaabu yoona ey'ebyo bikopo yaagira oburemeezi bwa shekeli igana na makumi abiri
en: the golden spoons were twelve, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, after the shekel of the sanctuary: all the gold of the spoons was an hundred and twenty shekels .

rr: kandi amatungo goona ag'ebitambo by'okwotsya, enimi z'ebimasha ikumi na ibiri, empaya z'entaama ikumi na ibiri, n'empaya nto z'entaama ezihikize omwaka ikumi na ibiri hamwe n'empongano zaabyo z'esaano; n'empaya z'embuzi z'ekitambo ky'ekibi ikumi na ibiri
en: All the oxen for the burnt offering were twelve bullocks, the rams twelve, the lambs of the first year twelve, with their meat offering: and the kids of the goats for sin offering twelve.

rr: n'amatungo goona ag'ebitambo by'empongano z'okusiima ahabw'obusingye, enimi makumi abiri na ina, empaya z'entaama makumi mukaaga, n'ez'embuzi makumi mukaaga, n'empaya nto z'entaama ezihikize omwaka makumi mukaaga.
en: And all the oxen for the sacrifice of the peace offerings were twenty and four bullocks, the rams sixty, the he goats sixty, the lambs of the first year sixty.

rr: Ezo nizo zaabaire ziri empongano z'okweza eitambiro, ryaheza kushukwaho amajuta g'okurishoroora.
en: This was the dedication of the altar, after that it was anointed.

rr: Musa ku yaataahire omu Ihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu kugamba na MUKAMA, yaahurira eiraka eririkugamba nawe, niriruga ahaiguru y'ekitebe ky'okusaasira, ekyabaire kiri aha shanduukye y'Ebirikuhamya ahagati ya baakerubi bombi; eryo iraka ryagamba nawe.
en: And when Moses was gone into the tabernacle of the congregation to speak with him, then he heard the voice of one speaking unto him from off the mercy seat that was upon the ark of testimony, from between the two cherubims: and he spake unto him.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Gambira Arooni oti: Ku origuma waahemba etabaaza, ago matabaaza mushanju gagume gaakye, gahwezese omwanya oguri omu maisho g'ekikondo kyago.
en: Speak unto Aaron, and say unto him, When thou lightest the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light over against the candlestick.

rr: Arooni yaakora atyo; yaahemba ago mataabaza ngu gaakye, gahwezese omwanya oguri omu maisho g'ekikondo kyago, nk'oku MUKAMA yaaragiire Musa.
en: And Aaron did so; he lighted the lamps thereof over against the candlestick, as the LORD commanded Moses.

rr: Oku nikwo ekikondo ky'amatabaaza kyaheesirwe, kikaheeshwa omu zaabu; okuruga aha kibunu kyakyo okuhika aha birabyo byakyo kyona kikaba kiheesirwe; nk'eky'okureeberaho, eki MUKAMA yaayorekire Musa, oku kyabaire kiri, nikwo yaaheesire ekyo kikondo ky'amatabaaza.
en: And this work of the candlestick was of beaten gold, unto the shaft thereof, unto the flowers thereof, was beaten work: according unto the pattern which the LORD had shewed Moses, so he made the candlestick.

rr: Okushoroorwa kw'Abaleevi n'obuheereza bwabo
en: The Levites

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Iha Abaleevi omu Baisraeli, obashemeze.
en: Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.

rr: Oku nikwo oraabashemeze; obamiisiire amaizi ag'okubaihaho ekibi, bamwe emibiri yaabo yoona, boozye emyenda yaabo, beeshemeze.
en: And thus shalt thou do unto them, to cleanse them: Sprinkle water of purifying upon them, and let them shave all their flesh, and let them wash their clothes, and so make themselves clean.

rr: Bwanyima batware enimi y'ekimasha n'empongano yaayo y'esaano y'obunono ejwangize n'amajuta; kandi naiwe otware endiijo nimi y'ekimasha kuba ekitambo ky'ekibi.
en: Then let them take a young bullock with his meat offering, even fine flour mingled with oil, and another young bullock shalt thou take for a sin offering.

rr: Oreete Abaleevi omu maisho g'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu, oteeranire hamwe eihanga ryona erya Israeli
en: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt gather the whole assembly of the children of Israel together:

rr: omurikye Abaleevi omu maisho ga MUKAMA, Abaisraeli babateho engaro
en: and thou shalt bring the Levites before the LORD : and the children of Israel shall put their hands upon the Levites:

rr: Arooni ahongye Abaleevi omu maisho ga MUKAMA kuba empongano ezongazongiibwe omu mwanya gw'Abaisraeli, babe ab'okukora omurimo gw'okuheereza MUKAMA.
en: and Aaron shall offer the Levites before the LORD for an offering of the children of Israel, that they may execute the service of the LORD .

rr: Bwanyima Abaleevi bate engaro zaabo aha mitwe y'ezo nimi, emwe ogihongye kuba ekitambo ky'ekibi, endi kuba ekitambo ky'okwotsya ekihongyeirwe MUKAMA okurihiirira Abaleevi.
en: And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the bullocks: and thou shalt offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, unto the LORD , to make an atonement for the Levites.

rr: Ote Abaleevi omu maisho ga Arooni n'abatabani, obahongyere MUKAMA kuba empongano ezongazongiibwe.
en: And thou shalt set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them for an offering unto the LORD . Their Service

rr: Okwo obe nikwo waashoroora Abaleevi omu Baisraeli abandi; Abaleevi babe abangye.
en: Thus shalt thou separate the Levites from among the children of Israel: and the Levites shall be mine.

rr: Bwanyima y'okubeeza n'okubahonga kuba empongano ezongazongiibwe, Abaleevi bataahe bakore omurimo gw'obuheereza omu by'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu.
en: And after that shall the Levites go in to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt cleanse them, and offer them for an offering.

rr: Ahakuba mbaheereirwe kimwe kuruga omu Baisraeli; mbeetooraniire kuza omu mwanya gw'emijigaijo yoona ey'Abaisraeli
en: For they are wholly given unto me from among the children of Israel; instead of such as open every womb, even instead of the firstborn of all the children of Israel, have I taken them unto me.

rr: ahabw'okuba emijigaijo y'Abaisraeli yoona n'eyangye, ey'abantu n'ey'amatungo; nkagyeyereza aha izooba eri naitiireho emijigaijo yoona ey'omu nsi ya Misri.
en: For all the firstborn of the children of Israel are mine, both man and beast: on the day that I smote every firstborn in the land of Egypt I sanctified them for myself.

rr: Mbwenu ntooraine Abaleevi omu mwanya gw'emijigaijo yoona ey'Abaisraeli.
en: And I have taken the Levites for all the firstborn of the children of Israel.

rr: Kandi abo Baleevi mbaihire omu Baisraeli, naabaha Arooni n'abatabani nk'ekiconco, okukora omurimo gw'obuheereza omu by'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu ahabw'Abaisraeli, n'okubarihiirira, ngu hataribaho orufu omu Baisraeli, ku bariba baahikire haihi n'Omwanya ogurikwera.
en: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the tabernacle of the congregation, and to make an atonement for the children of Israel: that there be no plague among the children of Israel, when the children of Israel come nigh unto the sanctuary. Their Consecration

rr: Okwo nikwo Musa na Arooni n'eihanga ryona ery'Abaisraeli baatwarize Abaleevi; nk'oku MUKAMA yaaragiire Musa aha by'Abaleevi byona, Abaisraeli baaba nikwo baabatwaza.
en: And Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel, did to the Levites according unto all that the LORD commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did the children of Israel unto them.

rr: Abaleevi baayeshemezaho ekibi, baayozya emyenda yaabo, Arooni yaabahonga omu maisho ga MUKAMA kuba empongano ezongazongiibwe, yaabarihiirira kubashemeza.
en: And the Levites were purified, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them as an offering before the LORD ; and Aaron made an atonement for them to cleanse them.

rr: Bwanyima y'ebyo Abaleevi baabona kutaaha kukora omurimo gw'obuheereza omu by'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu omu maisho ga Arooni n'abatabani; nk'oku MUKAMA yaabair aragiire Musa aha by'Abaleevi, baaba nikwo baabatwaza.
en: And after that went the Levites in to do their service in the tabernacle of the congregation before Aaron, and before his sons: as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did they unto them. Period of Service

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Ebi ndikukugambira aha Baleevi n'ebi; baryatandika kutaaha omu buheereza bw'okukora omurimo gw'eby'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu, bahikize emyaka makumi abiri n'etaano n'okukiraho
en: This is it that belongeth unto the Levites: from twenty and five years old and upward they shall go in to wait upon the service of the tabernacle of the congregation:

rr: kandi ku barihitsya emyaka makumi ataano, barekyere aho kukora omurimo gw'obwo buheereza ogurikurusya, barekye kugaruka kuheereza
en: and from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting upon the service thereof , and shall serve no more:

rr: kwonka bagume bahwere beene waabo omu by'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu, okurinda ebi bakwatsiibwe, kwonka barekye kukora eby'obuheereza.
en: but shall minister with their brethren in the tabernacle of the congregation, to keep the charge, and shall do no service.

rr: Okwo obe nikwo waatwaza Abaleevi aha by'ebi bakwatsiibwe.
en: Thus shalt thou do unto the Levites touching their charge.

rr: MUKAMA yaagambirira Musa omu ihamba rya Sinai omu kwezi kw'okubanza okw'omu mwaka gwa kabiri, barugire omu nsi ya Misri, ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

rr: Abaisraeli bagume barinde Okuhingurwaho omu bunaku bwakwo obwatairweho.
en: Let the children of Israel also keep the passover at his appointed season.

rr: Aha kiro kya ikumi na bina eky'okwezi oku omu mwabazyo, mube nibwo mwakurinda nk'obunaku bwakwo obwatairweho oku buri; mukurinde nk'ebiragiro byakwo byona n'emigyenzo yaakwo yoona oku biri.
en: In the fourteenth day of this month, at even, ye shall keep it in his appointed season: according to all the rites of it, and according to all the ceremonies thereof, shall ye keep it.

rr: Musa yaagambira Abaisraeli kurinda Okuhingurwaho.
en: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, that they should keep the passover.

rr: Baakurinda omu kwezi kw'okubanza aha kiro kya ikumi na bina omu mwabazyo, bari omu ihamba rya Sinai; nk'ebi MUKAMA yaaragiire Musa byona oku byabaire biri, Abaisraeli baaba nikwo baatwaza.
en: And they kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month at even in the wilderness of Sinai: according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did the children of Israel.

rr: Kandi hakaba hariho abashaija abasiisirwe omutumbi gw'omuntu, tibaabaasa kurinda Okuhingurwaho eryo izooba; baija ahari Musa na Arooni ahari eryo izooba
en: And there were certain men, who were defiled by the dead body of a man, that they could not keep the passover on that day: and they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day:

rr: baamugira bati: Tusiisirwe omutumbi gw'omuntu; n'enki ekirikutuzibira kuhongyera MUKAMA empongano omu bunaku bwayo hamwe n'Abaisraeli abandi?
en: and those men said unto him, We are defiled by the dead body of a man: wherefore are we kept back, that we may not offer an offering of the LORD in his appointed season among the children of Israel?

rr: Musa yaabagarukamu ati: Mube murekire, mbanze mpurire eki MUKAMA araaragiire aha byanyu.
en: And Moses said unto them, Stand still, and I will hear what the LORD will command concerning you. Special Cases

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Gambira Abaisraeli oti: Omuntu weena omuriimwe nari omu ruzaaro rwanyu, ku arishiishwa omutumbi, nari ku ariba ari omu rugyendo rwa hare, n'obu kiriba kiri kityo, arinde Okuhingurwaho ahari MUKAMA
en: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If any man of you or of your posterity shall be unclean by reason of a dead body, or be in a journey afar off, yet he shall keep the passover unto the LORD .

rr: omu kwezi kwa kabiri aha kiro kya ikumi na bina omu mwabazyo, babe nibwo baakurinda; omwana gw'entaama gw'Okuhingurwaho baguriise emigaati etatumbisiibwe n'emboga ezirikushaarira
en: The fourteenth day of the second month at even they shall keep it, and eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs .

rr: batarigira eki baatsigaho okuhitsya omu kasheeshe, kandi batarihenda eigufa ryagwo na rimwe; nk'ebiragiro by'Okuhingurwaho byona oku biri, babe nikwo baakurinda.
en: They shall leave none of it unto the morning, nor break any bone of it: according to all the ordinances of the passover they shall keep it.

rr: Kwonka omuntu otasiisikaire, kandi otari mu rugyendo, ku arireka kurinda Okuhingurwaho, aryacuubwa omu ihanga rye; ahabw'okuba tahongyeire MUKAMA empongano omu bunaku bwayo obwatairweho, omuntu ogwo okutahikiirira kwe kuryamugumaho.
en: But the man that is clean, and is not in a journey, and forbeareth to keep the passover, even the same soul shall be cut off from among his people: because he brought not the offering of the LORD in his appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.

rr: Kandi omunyamahanga obashuhuukiiremu, ku aryenda kurinda Okuhingurwaho ahari MUKAMA, aryatwaza nk'ebiragiro byakwo n'emigyenzo yaakwo oku biri; omunyamahanga n'enzaarwa baryagira ekiragiro kimwe.
en: And if a stranger shall sojourn among you, and will keep the passover unto the LORD ; according to the ordinance of the passover, and according to the manner thereof, so shall he do: ye shall have one ordinance, both for the stranger, and for him that was born in the land.

rr: Eby'ekicu ekyabaire kihabura Abaisraeli omuhanda
en: Leaving Sinai

rr: Aha izooba eri baimukiizeho Obutaaho, ekicu kikasangira obwo Butaaho, niryo Ihema ry'Ebirikuhamya; kandi omu mwabazyo kyaguma ahaiguru y'Obutaaho nikishusha nk'omuriro okuhitsya omu kasheeshe.
en: And on the day that the tabernacle was reared up the cloud covered the tabernacle, namely , the tent of the testimony: and at even there was upon the tabernacle as it were the appearance of fire, until the morning.

rr: Okwo nikwo byabaire biba obutoosha; ekicu kikaba kibusangira nyomushana, nyekiro kishusha nk'omuriro.
en: So it was alway: the cloud covered it by day , and the appearance of fire by night.

rr: Ekyo kicu ku kyabaire kiihwa ahaiguru y'Eihema, Abaisraeli babona kugyenda; kandi ahu kyabaire kyemerera, Abaisraeli niho baabaire bateera amahema.
en: And when the cloud was taken up from the tabernacle, then after that the children of Israel journeyed: and in the place where the cloud abode, there the children of Israel pitched their tents.

rr: Abaisraeli bakaba bagyenda ahabw'ekiragiro kya MUKAMA, kandi basiisira ahabw'ekiragiro kya MUKAMA; omwanya gwona ogu ekicu kyabaire kimara ahaiguru y'Obutaaho, bakaba baguma omu rusiisira.
en: At the commandment of the LORD the children of Israel journeyed, and at the commandment of the LORD they pitched: as long as the cloud abode upon the tabernacle they rested in their tents.

rr: N'obu ekicu kyabaire kimara ebiro bingi ahaiguru y'obwo Butaaho, nabwo Abaisraeli bakaba boorobera ekiragiro kya MUKAMA, bareka kugyenda.
en: And when the cloud tarried long upon the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept the charge of the LORD , and journeyed not.

rr: Obundi ekicu kikaba kimara ebiro bikye ahaiguru y'Obutaaho; baguma omu rusiisira nk'ekiragiro kya MUKAMA oku kiri; kandi bwanyima nk'ekiragiro kya MUKAMA oku kiri, baimutsya orugyendo.
en: And so it was, when the cloud was a few days upon the tabernacle; according to the commandment of the LORD they abode in their tents, and according to the commandment of the LORD they journeyed.

rr: Obundi ekicu kigumaho okwiha omu mwabazyo okuhitsya omu kasheeshe; ekicu kikiihwa aha Butaaho omu kasheeshe, baimutsya orugyendo; nari shi ku kyabaire kisiibaho, kyaraaraho, bwanyima kikiihwaho, baimutsya orugyendo.
en: And so it was, when the cloud abode from even unto the morning, and that the cloud was taken up in the morning, then they journeyed: whether it was by day or by night that the cloud was taken up, they journeyed.

rr: N'obu ekicu kyabaire kimara ebiro bibiri nari okwezi nari omwaka kiri ahaiguru y'obwo Butaaho, Abaisraeli bakaba baguma omu rusiisira, bareka kugyenda; kwonka ku kyabaire kiihwaho, bagyenda.
en: Or whether it were two days, or a month, or a year, that the cloud tarried upon the tabernacle, remaining thereon, the children of Israel abode in their tents, and journeyed not: but when it was taken up, they journeyed.

rr: Bakaba bateera amahema ahabw'ekiragiro kya MUKAMA; kandi bagyenda ahabw'ekiragiro kye; baguma niboorobera ekiragiro kya MUKAMA, nk'oku yaabaragiire naaraba omuri Musa.
en: At the commandment of the LORD they rested in the tents, and at the commandment of the LORD they journeyed: they kept the charge of the LORD , at the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Heesha enzamba ibiri omu feeza; ozikore omu feeza eheesire; ogume ozeetese eihanga ryona, n'okuziimukisa abari omu rusiisira kugyenda.
en: Make thee two trumpets of silver; of a whole piece shalt thou make them: that thou mayest use them for the calling of the assembly, and for the journeying of the camps.

rr: Ku bariziteera zombi, eihanga ryona rikuteeranireho aha muryango gw'Eihema ry'okubaabuganiramu.
en: And when they shall blow with them, all the assembly shall assemble themselves to thee at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

rr: Ku bariteera emwe yonka, abeebembezi, abakuru b'enganda z'Abaisraeli, bagume bakuteeranireho.
en: And if they blow but with one trumpet , then the princes, which are heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves unto thee.

rr: Ku muriteera ey'akasirikiriro, ab'omu nsiisira eziri aha rubaju rw'oburugwa-izooba bagume baimutsye orugyendo.
en: When ye blow an alarm, then the camps that lie on the east parts shall go forward.

rr: Ku murigaruka mwateera ey'akasirikiriro, ab'omu nsiisira ez'aha rubaju rw'obukiizi-bwa-buryo bagume baimutsye orugyendo; ku bariba nibenda kwimutsya orugyendo, bagume bateere ey'akasirikiriro.
en: When ye blow an alarm the second time, then the camps that lie on the south side shall take their journey: they shall blow an alarm for their journeys.

rr: Ku muryenda kuteerana eihanga ryona, mugume muteere ezo nzamba, kwonka mutariteera ez'akasirikiriro.
en: But when the congregation is to be gathered together, ye shall blow, but ye shall not sound an alarm.

rr: Batabani ba Arooni abanyamurwa babe nibo baaguma nibateera ezo nzamba. Okwo kuteera enzamba kubabeere ekiragiro ekitarihwaho omu busingye bwanyu bwona.
en: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow with the trumpets; and they shall be to you for an ordinance for ever throughout your generations.

rr: Ku murihurura kurwanisa abazigu baanyu abarikubaita kubi omu nsi yaanyu, mugume muteere ezo nzamba z'akasirikiriro, mubone kwijukwa MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu, n'okujunwa omu bazigu baanyu.
en: And if ye go to war in your land against the enemy that oppresseth you, then ye shall blow an alarm with the trumpets; and ye shall be remembered before the LORD your God, and ye shall be saved from your enemies.

rr: Kandi omu biro by'okushemererwa kwanyu n'omu magyenyi gaanyu agatairweho n'omu kuboneka kw'ameezi gaanyu, mugume muteere ezo nzamba nimutamba ebitamba, by'okwotsya, n'eby'empongano zaanyu z'okusiima ahabw'obusingye, zibabeere ekiijutsyo ky'okwijukirwaho Ruhanga waanyu; niinye MUKAMA Ruhanga waanyu. Orugyendo rw'Abaisraeli okuruga Sinai okuhika Parani
en: Also in the day of your gladness, and in your solemn days, and in the beginnings of your months, ye shall blow with the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; that they may be to you for a memorial before your God: I am the LORD your God.

rr: Omu mwaka gwa kabiri, omu kwezi kwa kabiri aha kiro kyakwo kya makumi abiri, ekicu kiri kikaihwa aha Butaaho bw'ebirikuhamya.
en: And it came to pass on the twentieth day of the second month, in the second year, that the cloud was taken up from off the tabernacle of the testimony.

rr: Abaisraeli baimutsya orugyendo, baaruga omu ihamba rya Sinai, nk'oku orugyendo rwabo rwabaire nirukuratana; ekyo kicu kyayemerera omu ihamba rya Parani.
en: And the children of Israel took their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud rested in the wilderness of Paran.

rr: Okwo nikwo kwimutsya orugyendo kwabo okw'okubanza, nibagyenda nk'oku MUKAMA yaabaragiire naaraba omuri Musa.
en: And they first took their journey according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses. Order of the March

rr: Haabanza kwimutsya orurango rw'orusiisira rw'Abayuda, nk'oku amahe gaabo gaabaire gari; omwebembezi w'eihe ry'Abayuda akaba ari Nahashooni mwene Aminadabu.
en: In the first place went the standard of the camp of the children of Judah according to their armies: and over his host was Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

rr: Omwebembezi w'eihe ry'Abaisakaari akaba ari Netaneeli mwene Zuari
en: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Issachar was Nethaneel the son of Zuar.

rr: kandi omwebembezi w'eihe ry'Abazebuluuni akaba ari Eliabu mwene Helooni.
en: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Zebulun was Eliab the son of Helon.

rr: Ku baaherize kukuura Obutaaho, beene Gereshoni na beene Merari ababwekorera baimutsya orugyendo.
en: And the tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari set forward, bearing the tabernacle.

rr: Orurango rw'orusiisira rw'Abareubeeni rwaimutsya orugyendo, nk'oku amahe gaabo gaabaire gari; omukuru w'eihe ryabo akaba ari Elizuuri mwene Shedeuri.
en: And the standard of the camp of Reuben set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elizur the son of Shedeur.

rr: Omukuru w'eihe ry'oruganda rw'Abasimeoni akaba ari Shelumieli mwene Zuri-shadai
en: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Simeon was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

rr: kandi omukuru w'eihe ry'oruganda rw'Abagaadi akaba ari Eliasaafu mwene Deueli.
en: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Gad was Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

rr: Bwanyima aba Kohasi baimutsya orugyendo, baheekire ebintu eby'Omwanya ogurikwera; baashanga Obutaaho bwaherize kuteerwa.
en: And the Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary: and the other did set up the tabernacle against they came.

rr: Orurango rw'orusiisira rw'Abaefuraimu rwaimutsya orugyendo, nk'oku amahe gaabo gaabaire gari; omukuru w'eihe ryabo akaba ari Elishaama mwene Amihuudi
en: And the standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elishama the son of Ammihud.

rr: omukuru w'eihe ry'oruganda rw'Abamanaase akaba ari Gamalieli mwene Pedazuuri
en: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Manasseh was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

rr: kandi omukuru w'eihe ry'oruganda rw'Ababenyamiini akaba ari Abidaani mwene Gideoni.
en: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Benjamin was Abidan the son of Gideoni.

rr: Orurango rw'orusiisira rw'Abadaani orwabaire ruri enyima y'ezindi nsiisira zoona, rwaimutsya orugyendo, nk'oku amahe gaabo gaabaire gari; omukuru w'eihe ryabo akaba ari Ahiezeeri mwene Ami-shadai
en: And the standard of the camp of the children of Dan set forward, which was the rereward of all the camps throughout their hosts: and over his host was Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

rr: omukuru w'eihe ry'oruganda rw'Abaasheri akaba ari Pagieli mwene Okiraane
en: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Asher was Pagiel the son of Ocran.

rr: kandi omukuru w'eihe ry'oruganda rw'Abanafutaali akaba ari Ahiira mwene Enani.
en: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Naphtali was Ahira the son of Enan.

rr: Okwo nikwo Abaisraeli baakurataine omu ngyendo zaabo, obu baimutsya orugyendo, nk'oku amahe gaabo gaabaire gari. Musa okushaba ishe-zaara kugyenda nabo
en: Thus were the journeyings of the children of Israel according to their armies, when they set forward.

rr: Musa yaagambira Hobabu, mwene Reueli Omunyamidiani ishezaara wa Musa, ati: Nitwimutsya orugyendo kuza omu nsi ei MUKAMA yaagambire kutuha. Ija tugyendane; nitwija kukukorera gye; ahakuba MUKAMA akaraganisa kukorera Abaisraeli ebirungi.
en: And Moses said unto Hobab, the son of Raguel the Midianite, Moses' father in law, We are journeying unto the place of which the LORD said, I will give it you: come thou with us, and we will do thee good: for the LORD hath spoken good concerning Israel.

rr: Yaamugarukamu ati: Tindikwija kugyenda naimwe, kureka niinyija kugaruka omu nsi yaitu omuri beene waitu.
en: And he said unto him, I will not go; but I will depart to mine own land, and to my kindred.

rr: Musa yaamugira ati: Ninkweshengyereza, otatutsigaho; ahabw'okuba noomanya omuringo ogu tushemereire kusiisiramu omu ihamba, niiwe orikwija kuba amaisho gaitu.
en: And he said, Leave us not, I pray thee; forasmuch as thou knowest how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and thou mayest be to us instead of eyes.

rr: Kandi ku oraagyende naitwe, ebirungi byona ebi MUKAMA aritukorera, naitwe turyabikukorera.
en: And it shall be, if thou go with us, yea, it shall be, that what goodness the LORD shall do unto us, the same will we do unto thee.

rr: Baimuka, baaruga aha rushozi rwa MUKAMA, baagyenda orugyendo rw'ebiro bishatu; eshanduukye y'endagaano ya MUKAMA yaabeebembera omuri orwo rugyendo rw'ebiro bishatu, neebasherurira omwanya gw'okuhuumuriramu.
en: And they departed from the mount of the LORD three days' journey: and the ark of the covenant of the LORD went before them in the three days' journey, to search out a resting place for them.

rr: Ku baabaire baimutsya orugyendo kuruga omu rusiisira, ekicu kya MUKAMA kiguma kiri ahaiguru yaabo nyomushana.
en: And the cloud of the LORD was upon them by day, when they went out of the camp.

rr: Kandi egyo shanduukye ku yaabaire eimutsya orugyendo, Musa agira ati: Ai MUKAMA, imuka, abazigu baawe bataataane, n'abarikukwanga bakuhungye.
en: And it came to pass, when the ark set forward, that Moses said, Rise up, LORD , and let thine enemies be scattered; and let them that hate thee flee before thee.

rr: Kandi ku yaabaire ahuumura, agira ati: Ai MUKAMA, garuka aha bukumi n'obukumi bw'Abaisraeli.
en: And when it rested, he said, Return, O LORD , unto the many thousands of Israel.

Bwanyima abantu baayetomboita ahabw'ebibabaireho, MUKAMA yaabihurira; ku yaabihuriire, yaabagirira ekiniga kingi; omuriro gwa MUKAMA gwabaakamu, gwayotsya ebicweka bimwe ebirikuhereerukayo omu rusiisira.
en: And when the people complained, it displeased the LORD : and the LORD heard it ; and his anger was kindled; and the fire of the LORD burnt among them, and consumed them that were in the uttermost parts of the camp.

rr: Abantu baatakira Musa; Musa yaashaba MUKAMA; omuriro gwaraara.
en: And the people cried unto Moses; and when Moses prayed unto the LORD , the fire was quenched.

rr: Omwanya ogwo gwayetwa Tabera, ahabw'okuba omuriro gwa MUKAMA gukabaakamu.
en: And he called the name of the place Taberah: because the fire of the LORD burnt among them.

rr: Omutwe gw'ebijwangye by'abanyamahanga abaabaire bari omuribo baatandika kwetenga; Abaisraeli nabo baagaruka baarira, nibagira bati: N'oha oraatuhe enyama y'okurya?
en: And the mixt multitude that was among them fell a lusting: and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, Who shall give us flesh to eat?

rr: -34 ; . Twaijuka eby'enyanja, ebi twabaire turiira busha, tukiri omuri Misri, emyongo, ebihaaza, obutunguru bw'ebibabi n'obw'ebitakuri, na katunguricumu
en: We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt freely; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlick:

rr: mbwenu twomire, titwine kindi kyona eki turikureeba kureka emaanu egi yonka.
en: but now our soul is dried away: there is nothing at all, beside this manna, before our eyes.

rr: Kandi egyo maanu ekaba neeshusha otujuma tw'obunyaatsi oburikwetwa gaadi; enshusha yaayo ekaba eri nk'amakanca g'ebiti agarikwetwa budola.
en: And the manna was as coriander seed, and the colour thereof as the colour of bdellium.

rr: Abantu bakaba bagyenda, bagitorotoora, bagisa aha mengo, nari bagishekura omu shekuro, bagiteeka omu nyungu, bagikoramu twakeeki; okunura kwayo kukaba kuri nk'okw'otukeeki otukozirwe n'amajuta.
en: And the people went about, and gathered it , and ground it in mills, or beat it in a mortar, and baked it in pans, and made cakes of it: and the taste of it was as the taste of fresh oil.

rr: Orume ku rwabaire rutonda omu rusiisira nyekiro, emaanu erutondaho.
en: And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night, the manna fell upon it.

rr: Musa ku yaahuriire abantu nibarira, buri muntu n'ab'eka ye nibaririra aha miryango y'amahema gaabo, MUKAMA yaagira ekiniga kingi munonga, Musa nawe yaaguubwa kubi.
en: Then Moses heard the people weep throughout their families, every man in the door of his tent: and the anger of the LORD was kindled greatly; Moses also was displeased.

rr: -18 ; Musa yaagambira MUKAMA ati: Ahabw'enki oitsire kubi omwiru waawe? Ahabw'enki onkoreire oburemeezi bw'aba bantu boona, okanga kungirira embabazi?
en: And Moses said unto the LORD , Wherefore hast thou afflicted thy servant? and wherefore have I not found favour in thy sight, that thou layest the burden of all this people upon me?

rr: Niinye naatwaire enda y'aba bantu boona? Niinye naabazaire, waaza kungira oti: Obatwarire omu kifuba, nk'omurezi oku akiikira omwana orikwonka, obahitsye omu nsi ei naaraganiise baishenkurubo?
en: Have I conceived all this people? have I begotten them, that thou shouldest say unto me, Carry them in thy bosom, as a nursing father beareth the sucking child, unto the land which thou swarest unto their fathers?

rr: Nkaihire hi enyama y'okugaburira aba bantu boona? Ahakuba nibandirira omu maisho nibagira bati: Tuhe enyama y'okurya.
en: Whence should I have flesh to give unto all this people? for they weep unto me, saying, Give us flesh, that we may eat.

rr: Tindikubaasa kuheeka aba bantu boona nyenka, ahabw'okuba n'omutwaro gurikundema.
en: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.

rr: Ku oraabe nooyenda kuntwaza otyo, ninkweshengyereza, nyita ndugyeho, ku oraabe nongirira embabazi, ndekye kureeba enaku ezirimbaho. MUKAMA okuha Musa abahwezi makumi mushanju
en: And if thou deal thus with me, kill me, I pray thee, out of hand, if I have found favour in thy sight; and let me not see my wretchedness.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati: Nteeranira abantu makumi mushanju omu bakuru b'Abaisraeli, abu orikumanya ngu n'abakuru b'abantu, n'abategyeki baabo, obareete aha Ihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu, beemerereho naiwe.
en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Gather unto me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom thou knowest to be the elders of the people, and officers over them; and bring them unto the tabernacle of the congregation, that they may stand there with thee.

rr: Naanye niinyija kushuuma, ngambireyo naiwe; nyihe aha mwoyo oguri ahariiwe, ngubateho; nabo bagume baheekye naiwe omutwaro gw'abo bantu, orekye kuguheeka wenka.
en: And I will come down and talk with thee there: and I will take of the spirit which is upon thee, and will put it upon them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with thee, that thou bear it not thyself alone.

rr: Kandi ogambire abantu oti: Mweyeze ahabw'eizooba rya nyencakare, nimwija kurya enyama; ahakuba muririire omu matu ga MUKAMA, nimugira muti: N'oha oraatuhe enyama y'okurya? Ahakuba tukaba turi gye omuri Misri. N'ahabw'ekyo MUKAMA naija kubaha enyama, nimugirya.
en: And say thou unto the people, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow, and ye shall eat flesh: for ye have wept in the ears of the LORD , saying, Who shall give us flesh to eat? for it was well with us in Egypt: therefore the LORD will give you flesh, and ye shall eat.

rr: Timurigirya izooba rimwe, nari amazooba abiri, nari ataano nari ikumi nari makumi abiri
en: Ye shall not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days;

rr: kureka nimwija kugirya okwezi kwona, okuhitsya obu eribareetwa omu nyindo, ekabatama; ahabw'okuba mugayire MUKAMA ori omuriimwe, mwamuririra omumaisho nimugira muti: Tukaba twarugira ki Misri?
en: but even a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it be loathsome unto you: because that ye have despised the LORD which is among you, and have wept before him, saying, Why came we forth out of Egypt?

rr: Musa yaagira ati: Abantu abu ntuuramu n'abashaija obusiriira mukaaga abarikugyendesa ebigyere; kandi waagira oti: Niinyija kubaha enyama, bagirye okumara okwezi kwona.
en: And Moses said, The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand footmen; and thou hast said, I will give them flesh, that they may eat a whole month.

rr: Nibaija kubaagirwa amasyo g'entaama n'ag'ente g'okubahaazya? Nari shi eby'enyanja byona nibiija kuteeranirwa hamwe ahabw'abo kubahaazya?
en: Shall the flocks and the herds be slain for them, to suffice them? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to suffice them?

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati: Noogira ngu omukono gwa MUKAMA gubaire mugufu? Mbwenu noija kureeba ekigambo kyangye ku kiraabe nikiija kuhikiirira ahabwawe nari kitarikwija kubakwo.
en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Is the LORD 's hand waxed short? thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not.

rr: Musa yaashohora, yaagambira abantu ebi MUKAMA yaamugambira; bwanyima yaateerana abashaija makumi mushanju ab'omu bakuru b'abantu, yaabata omu myanya okwehinguririza Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu.
en: And Moses went out, and told the people the words of the LORD , and gathered the seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them round about the tabernacle.

rr: MUKAMA yaashuumira omu kicu, yaagamba na Musa, yaiha aha mwoyo ogwabaire gumuriho, yaaguta ahari abo bakuru makumi mushanju; omwoyo ku gwabagiireho, baaragura; kwonka tibaagaruka kukora batyo obundi.
en: And the LORD came down in a cloud, and spake unto him, and took of the spirit that was upon him, and gave it unto the seventy elders: and it came to pass, that, when the spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, and did not cease.

rr: Kwonka omu rusiisira hakaba hatsigaramu abashaija babiri, omwe orikwetwa Eludaadi n'ondi orikwetwa Medadi; ogwo mwoyo gwabazaho; kandi bakaba bari omu mubaro gw'abahandiikirwe, kwonka batarugire aho kuza aha Ihema; baaragurira aho omu rusiisira.
en: But there remained two of the men in the camp, the name of the one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad: and the spirit rested upon them; and they were of them that were written, but went not out unto the tabernacle: and they prophesied in the camp.

rr: Omutsigazi yaagyenda nairuka, yaagambira Musa ati: Eludaadi na Medadi nibaragurira omu rusiisira.
en: And there ran a young man, and told Moses, and said, Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp.

rr: Yoshua mwene Nuuni omuheereza wa Musa, omwe aha bashaija be b'entoore, yaamugira ati: Mukama wangye Musa, bazibire.
en: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his young men, answered and said, My lord Moses, forbid them.

rr: Musa yaamugarukamu ati: Waagira eihari aha bwangye? Nkaabaasibwa ki abantu ba MUKAMA boona baba baanabi, MUKAMA abaha omwoyo gwe.
en: And Moses said unto him, Enviest thou for my sake? would God that all the LORD 's people were prophets, and that the LORD would put his spirit upon them!

rr: Musa yaagaruka omu rusiisira, we n'abo bakuru b'Abaisraeli. MUKAMA okubareetera endahi n'okubaitamu baingi
en: And Moses gat him into the camp, he and the elders of Israel. Quails from the Sea

rr: Omuyaga gwaruga ahari MUKAMA, gwareeta endahi zaaruga aha nyanja, zaagwa haihi n'orusiisira okurwehinguririza, zaahitsya omwanya ogu omuntu arikubaasa kugyenda eizooba ryona buri rubaju, nizigyendera omu mwanya nk'ogwa mikono ebiri okuruga ahansi.
en: And there went forth a wind from the LORD , and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, as it were a day's journey on this side, and as it were a day's journey on the other side, round about the camp, and as it were two cubits high upon the face of the earth.

rr: Abantu baimuka, baarenzya eryo izooba, baaseesa ekiro, baarenzya erindi izooba nibazikwata; owaakwatsire enkye, yaakwata homeri ikumi, baazeeyanikira embaju zoona ez'orusiisira.
en: And the people stood up all that day, and all that night, and all the next day, and they gathered the quails: he that gathered least gathered ten homers: and they spread them all abroad for themselves round about the camp.

rr: Enyama ku yaabaire ekibari omu kanwa, batakagimizire, MUKAMA yaabagirira ekiniga kingi, yaajuumikiza abantu orufu rwingi munonga.
en: And while the flesh was yet between their teeth, ere it was chewed, the wrath of the LORD was kindled against the people, and the LORD smote the people with a very great plague.

rr: Omwanya ogwo gwayetwa Kibiroosi-hatava, ahabw'okuba niho baaziikire abantu abaayetengire.
en: And he called the name of that place Kibroth-hattaavah: because there they buried the people that lusted.

rr: Abantu baimuka Kibiroosi-hatava, baaza Hazeroosi; baamarayo ebiro.
en: And the people journeyed from Kibroth-hattaavah unto Hazeroth; and abode at Hazeroth.

rr: Miriamu na Arooni baagambuura Musa ahabw'Omukuushikazi ou yaabaire ashweire; ahabw'okuba akashwera Omukuushikazi.
en: And Miriam and Aaron spake against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman whom he had married: for he had married an Ethiopian woman.

rr: Baagira bati: N'eky'amazima MUKAMA agambira omuri Musa wenka? Itwe tatugambiramu? MUKAMA yaakihurira.
en: And they said, Hath the LORD indeed spoken only by Moses? hath he not spoken also by us? And the LORD heard it .

rr: Kandi ogwo mushaija Musa akaba ari omucureezi, okukira abantu boona ab'omu nsi.
en: (Now the man Moses was very meek, above all the men which were upon the face of the earth.)

rr: Ahonaaho MUKAMA yaagambira Musa na Arooni na Miriamu ati: Mushohore mwenshatu, mwije aha Ihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu.
en: And the LORD spake suddenly unto Moses, and unto Aaron, and unto Miriam, Come out ye three unto the tabernacle of the congregation.

rr: Bonshatu baashohora.
en: And they three came out.

rr: MUKAMA yaashuumira omu nyomyo y'ekicu, yaayemerera aha muryango gw'Eihema, yaayeta Arooni na Miriamu, bombi baija
en: And the LORD came down in the pillar of the cloud, and stood in the door of the tabernacle, and called Aaron and Miriam: and they both came forth.

rr: yaabagira ati: Nimuhurire ebigambo byangye. Omuriimwe ku haraabe harimu nabi, omu kworekwa nimwo nyowe MUKAMA ndimwemanyisiza, kandi n'omu kirooto nimwo ndigambira nawe.
en: And he said, Hear now my words: If there be a prophet among you, I the LORD will make myself known unto him in a vision, and will speak unto him in a dream.

rr: Kwonka omugaragwa wangye Musa tikwo mmutwaza; n'omwesigwa omu nju yangye yoona.
en: My servant Moses is not so, who is faithful in all mine house.

rr: We ngamba nawe butunu nitureebana, ntarikugamba nawe mu nfumu, kandi n'enshusha yangye agireeba. Mbwenu ahabw'enki timutiinire kugamba kubi aha mugaragwa wangye Musa?
en: With him will I speak mouth to mouth, even apparently, and not in dark speeches; and the similitude of the LORD shall he behold: wherefore then were ye not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?

rr: MUKAMA yaabagirira ekiniga kingi, yaagyenda.
en: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against them; and he departed.

rr: Ekicu ku kyarugire ahaiguru y'Eihema baareeba Miriamu aseesire ebibembe ebirikwera nk'orubaare. Arooni ku yaareebire Miriamu, yaashanga aseesire ebibembe.
en: And the cloud departed from off the tabernacle; and, behold, Miriam became leprous, white as snow: and Aaron looked upon Miriam, and, behold, she was leprous.

rr: Arooni yaagira Musa ati: Ai bambe Mukama wangye, otatuha ekifubiro ahabw'ekibi eki tukoresiibwe obushema.
en: And Aaron said unto Moses, Alas, my lord, I beseech thee, lay not the sin upon us, wherein we have done foolishly, and wherein we have sinned.

rr: Ninkweshengyereza arekye kushusha nk'ekizairwe kifiire kijunzire orubaju rumwe.
en: Let her not be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he cometh out of his mother's womb.

rr: Musa yaatakira MUKAMA ati: Ai Ruhanga, naakweshengyereza mutambire.
en: And Moses cried unto the LORD , saying, Heal her now, O God, I beseech thee.

rr: MUKAMA yaagarukamu Musa ati: Kuri noogira ngu ishe amucweire amacwante bucwante omumaisho, takugizire nshoni okumara ebiro mushanju? Reka amare ebiro mushanju akomeirwe aheeru y'orusiisira, bwanyima abone kurugarurwamu.
en: And the LORD said unto Moses, If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be ashamed seven days? let her be shut out from the camp seven days, and after that let her be received in again .

rr: Atyo Miriamu yaakomerwa aheeru y'orusiisira okumara ebiro mushanju; abantu tibaimutsya rugyendo okuhitsya obu yaagarwirwe omu rusiisira.
en: And Miriam was shut out from the camp seven days: and the people journeyed not till Miriam was brought in again .

rr: Bwanyima abantu baimutsya orugyendo, baaruga Hazeroosi, baateera orusiisira omu ihamba rya Parani.
en: And afterward the people removed from Hazeroth, and pitched in the wilderness of Paran.
