rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Tuma abantu batate ensi ya Kanaani, ei ndikuha Abaisraeli; mwihe omuntu omwe omuri buri ruganda rwa baishenkurubo, buri omwe aharibo abe ari omwebembezi.
en: Send thou men, that they may search the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel: of every tribe of their fathers shall ye send a man, every one a ruler among them.

rr: Musa yaabatuma ari omu ihamba rya Parani nk'oku MUKAMA yaaragiire; abu yaatumire boona bakaba bari abakuru b'Abaisraeli.
en: And Moses by the commandment of the LORD sent them from the wilderness of Paran: all those men were heads of the children of Israel.

rr: Aga nigo maziina gaabo. Omu ruganda rwa Reubeeni baatuma Sahamua mwene Zakura
en: And these were their names: of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.

rr: omu rwa Simeoni Shafati mwene Hoori
en: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.

rr: omu rwa Yuda, Kalebu mwene Yefune
en: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

rr: omu rwa Isakaari, Igali mwene Yosefu
en: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.

rr: omu rwa Efuraimu, Hoshea mwene Nuuni
en: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Oshea the son of Nun.

rr: omu rwa Benyamiini, Paluti mwene Raafu
en: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.

rr: omu rwa Zebuluuni, Gadieli, mwene Soodi
en: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.

rr: omu rwa Yosefu nirwo ruganda rwa Manaase Gaadi mwene Suusi
en: Of the tribe of Joseph, namely , of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.

rr: omu rwa Daani, Amieli mwene Gemali
en: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.

rr: omu rwa Asheri, Seeturi mwene Mikaeli
en: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.

rr: omu rwa Nafutaali, Nahibi mwene Vofisi
en: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.

rr: omu rwa Gaadi, Geueli mwene Maaki.
en: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.

rr: Ago nigo maziina g'abantu abu Musa yaatumire kutata egyo nsi. Musa yaayeta Hoshea mwene Nuuni Yoshua.
en: These are the names of the men which Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Oshea the son of Nun Jehoshua.

rr: Musa yaabatuma kutata ensi ya Kanaani, yaabagira ati: Mutoore omuhanda ogurikuraba Negebu, mwinamukye omu nsi y'ebibungo
en: And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said unto them, Get you up this way southward, and go up into the mountain:

rr: mutate ensi, mumanye oku eri, n'abantu abagitwiremu mumanye ku baraabe baine amaani nari batagaine, nari shi ku baraabe bari bakye nari baingi
en: and see the land, what it is ; and the people that dwelleth therein, whether they be strong or weak, few or many;

rr: n'ensi ei batwiremu ku eraabe eri nungi nari eri mbi; n'endembo ezi batwiremu oku ziri, ku baraabe nibataaha omu nsiisira, nari omu ngo zigumire
en: and what the land is that they dwell in, whether it be good or bad; and what cities they be that they dwell in, whether in tents, or in strong holds;

rr: kandi mureebe eitaka ryayo ku riraabe niryeza nari ritarikweza, n'ensi ku eraabe erimu ebiti nari bitarimu.
en: and what the land is , whether it be fat or lean, whether there be wood therein, or not.

rr: Mutatiina, mureete aha bijuma by'omuri egyo nsi.
en: And be ye of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land.

rr: Kandi obunaku obwo bukaba buri eitogyera ry'emizaabibu.
en: Now the time was the time of the firstripe grapes.

rr: Batyo baagyenda, baatata ensi okuruga omu ihamba rya Ziini okuhika Rehobu, ahu orikutaahira nooza Hamasi.
en: So they went up, and searched the land from the wilderness of Zin unto Rehob, as men come to Hamath.

rr: Bainamuka Negebu, baahika Heburooni; kandi obwo Ahimaanu na Sheshai na Talumai beene Anaki bakaba bari okwo. (Heburooni egyo ekaba emazire emyaka mushanju eyombekire, Zoani ey'omuri Misri etakombekirwe.)
en: And they ascended by the south, and came unto Hebron; where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were . (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

rr: Baahika omu ruhanga rwa Eshikooli, baatemayo omutsita gw'ebijuma by'emizaabibu, abantu babiri baaguheeka aha mugamba; kandi baareeta n'amakomamahanga n'ebijuma by'emitiini.
en: And they came unto the brook of Eshcol, and cut down from thence a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bare it between two upon a staff; and they brought of the pomegranates, and of the figs.

rr: Omwanya ogwo gwayetwa oruhanga rwa Eshikooli ahabw'omutsitsa gw'ebijuma by'emizaabibu, ogu Abaisraeli baatemireyo.
en: The place was called the brook Eshcol, because of the cluster of grapes which the children of Israel cut down from thence.

rr: Ku baamazire ebiro makumi ana nibatata egyo nsi, baagaruka. Entatsi ikumi okugaruka n'enkuru mbi
en: And they returned from searching of the land after forty days.

rr: Ku baizire, baashanga Musa na Arooni n'eihanga ry'Abaisraeli ryona Kadeshi omu ihamba rya Parani, baabagambira hamwe n'eihanga ryona ebi baareebire, kandi baabooreka n'ebijuma ebi baihire omu nsi egyo.
en: And they went and came to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word unto them, and unto all the congregation, and shewed them the fruit of the land.

rr: Baagira Musa bati: Tukahika omu nsi ei waatutumiremu, n'ekya buzima n'ensi y'amate n'obwoki; kandi n'ebijuma byayo mbibi.
en: And they told him, and said, We came unto the land whither thou sentest us, and surely it floweth with milk and honey; and this is the fruit of it.

rr: Kwonka abantu abagitwiremu n'ab'amaani, n'endembo zaabo zizitiize engo z'amabaare, kandi ni mpango munonga; tukareebayo na beene Anaki.
en: Nevertheless the people be strong that dwell in the land, and the cities are walled, and very great: and moreover we saw the children of Anak there.

rr: Abaamaleki batwire omu nsi ya Negebu, Abahiiti n'Abayebusi n'Abaamori batwire omu nsi y'ebibungo; n'Abanyakanaani batwire aha nyanja n'omu mpita za Yorudani.
en: The Amalekites dwell in the land of the south: and the Hittites, and the Jebusites, and the Amorites, dwell in the mountains: and the Canaanites dwell by the sea, and by the coast of Jordan.

rr: Kalebu yaacureeza abantu omu maisho ga Musa naagira ati: Twinamukye ahonaaho, tugikubuure; ahakuba buzima nitubaasa kugisingura.
en: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.

rr: Kwonka abantu abaabaire bagyenzire nawe baagira bati: Titurikubaasa kwinamukayo kurwana na bari bantu, ahabw'okuba nibatukiza amaani.
en: But the men that went up with him said, We be not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.

rr: Baagambira Abaisraeli enkuru mbi z'ensi ei baagiire kutata, nibagira bati: Ensi ei twarabiremu kutata, n'ensi erikurya abagitwiremu; n'abantu boona abu twareebireyo ni baraingwa munonga.
en: And they brought up an evil report of the land which they had searched unto the children of Israel, saying, The land, through which we have gone to search it, is a land that eateth up the inhabitants thereof; and all the people that we saw in it are men of a great stature.

rr: Eihanga ry'abantu boona baimutsya amaraka gaabo, baaborooga; ekyo kiro baaraara nibarira.
en: And all the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.

rr: Abaisraeli boona baayetomboitera Musa na Arooni, eihanga ryona ryagira riti: Kuri nangwa twagwire omu nsi ya Misri! Nari tukaahenwa ki, tugwa omuri eri ihamba!
en: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron: and the whole congregation said unto them, Would God that we had died in the land of Egypt! or would God we had died in this wilderness!

rr: MUKAMA naatutwarira ki omuri egyo nsi kumarirwayo rurara? Abakazi baitu n'abaana baitu abato nibaija kuba eminyago. Ekirikukira t'okwegarukira Misri?
en: And wherefore hath the LORD brought us unto this land, to fall by the sword, that our wives and our children should be a prey? were it not better for us to return into Egypt?

rr: Baagambirana bati: Ka tweteereho omwebembezi, tugarukye Misri.
en: And they said one to another, Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt.

rr: Musa na Arooni baajuumara omu maisho g'omutwe gwona ogw'eihanga ry'Abaisraeli boona.
en: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.

rr: Bwanyima Yoshua mwene Nuuni na Kalebu mwene Yefune, bamwe ahari abo abaatatsire ensi, baataagura ebijwaro byabo.
en: And Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of them that searched the land, rent their clothes:

rr: Baagambira eihanga ry'Abaisraeli ryona bati: Ensi ei twarabiremu kutata ni nungi munonga.
en: and they spake unto all the company of the children of Israel, saying, The land, which we passed through to search it, is an exceeding good land.

rr: MUKAMA ku araabe naatusiima, aryagituhitsyamu, agituhe; n'ensi y'amate n'obwoki.
en: If the LORD delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it us; a land which floweth with milk and honey.

rr: Kwonka murekye kugomera MUKAMA, kandi mutatiina abantu b'omu nsi egyo, ahakuba n'eby'okurya ahariitwe; ekibaire kibakingiire kibaihirweho, kandi MUKAMA ari hamwe naitwe; mutabatiina.
en: Only rebel not ye against the LORD , neither fear ye the people of the land; for they are bread for us: their defence is departed from them, and the LORD is with us: fear them not.

rr: Kwonka eihanga ryona ryagira riti: Tubateere amabaare.
en: But all the congregation bade stone them with stones.

rr: Ahonaaho ekitiinisa kya MUKAMA kyabonekyera Abaisraeli boona omu Ihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu.
en: And the glory of the LORD appeared in the tabernacle of the congregation before all the children of Israel.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati: Abantu aba baryahitsya hi okungaya? Baryahitsya hi okutanyikiriza, haza kunu naakozire obumanyiso obwo bwona omuribo?
en: And the LORD said unto Moses, How long will this people provoke me? and how long will it be ere they believe me, for all the signs which I have shewed among them?

rr: Niinyija kubaitsa orufu, mbaiheho obuhunguzi bwabo, haza nkuhindure eihanga eririkubakira obwingi n'amaani.
en: I will smite them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of thee a greater nation and mightier than they.

rr: Musa okweshengyerereza abantu ahari Ruhanga
en: Moses' Intercession

rr: Musa yaagambira MUKAMA ati: Ku oraagire otyo, Abanyamisri nibaija kubihurira; ahakuba okaiha aba bantu omuribo n'amaani gaawe
en: And Moses said unto the LORD , Then the Egyptians shall hear it , (for thou broughtest up this people in thy might from among them;)

rr: bakigambire abatwire omu nsi egi, haza baabaire baahuriire ngu iwe MUKAMA otuura omuri aba bantu; ahakuba iwe MUKAMA oreebwa n'amaisho butunu, kandi ekicu kyawe kyemerera ahaiguru yaabo, kandi ogyenda obeebembeire, ori omu nyomyo y'ekicu nyomushana, n'omu nyomyo y'omuriro nyekiro.
en: and they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land: for they have heard that thou LORD art among this people, that thou LORD art seen face to face, and that thy cloud standeth over them, and that thou goest before them, by day time in a pillar of a cloud, and in a pillar of fire by night.

rr: Mbwenu ku oraite aba bantu nk'omuntu omwe, amahanga agaahuriire okurangaanwa kwawe, garyagira gati
en: Now if thou shalt kill all this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of thee will speak, saying,

rr: MUKAMA aremirwe kuhitsya abo bantu omu nsi ei yaarahiire naaraganisa kubaha, nikyo abacwekyererereize omu ihamba.
en: Because the LORD was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them, therefore he hath slain them in the wilderness.

rr: Mbwenu ninkweshengyereza amaani ga MUKAMA gabe maingi, nk'oku waagambire noogira oti
en: And now, I beseech thee, let the power of my LORD be great, according as thou hast spoken, saying,

rr: MUKAMA tarahuka kuguubwa kubi, n'ow'embabazi nyingi, asaasira eby'okutahikiirira n'eby'okushiisha, tasingisiriza abaine orubanja na kakye; atura abaana okutahikiirira kwa baishebo, okuhitsya aha baijukuru n'abaijukuruza.
en: The LORD is longsuffering, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression, and by no means clearing the guilty , visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation .

rr: Ninkweshengyereza saasira okutahikiirira kw'abantu aba, nk'embabazi zaawe nyingi oku ziri, nk'oku oshangwa obasaasira okwiha obu baaruga Misri n'okuhitsya hati.
en: Pardon, I beseech thee, the iniquity of this people according unto the greatness of thy mercy, and as thou hast forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.

rr: Okufubirwa kwabo ahabw'obugomi
en: God's Judgement

rr: MUKAMA yaamugira ati: Naabasaasira nk'oku wanshaba
en: And the LORD said, I have pardoned according to thy word:

rr: kwonka niinyerahira nti, nk'oku ensi eriijura ekitiinisa kya MUKAMA
en: but as truly as I live, all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the LORD .

rr: aha bantu abo boona, abaareebire ekitiinisa kyangye n'obumanyiso obu naakoreire Misri n'omu ihamba, bakangyeza emirundi egi yoona ikumi, batarikworobera iraka ryangye
en: Because all those men which have seen my glory, and my miracles, which I did in Egypt and in the wilderness, and have tempted me now these ten times, and have not hearkened to my voice;

rr: tihariho n'omwe aharibo orireeba ensi ei naarahiire kuha baishenkurubo; kandi tihariho n'omwe ahari abo abangayire origireeba
en: surely they shall not see the land which I sware unto their fathers, neither shall any of them that provoked me see it:

rr: kureka omwiru wangye Kalebu, ahabw'okuba aine omutima ogundi, ogutari nk'ogwabo, akankuratirira kimwe; ogwo ndyamuhitsya omu nsi ei yaagiiremu; n'oruzaaro rwe ruryagihungura.
en: but my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me fully, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.

rr: Mbwenu, nk'oku Abaamaleki n'Abanyakanaani batwire omu mpanga, nyencakare muhindukye, mugarukye omu ihamba, mutoore omuhanda ogurikuza aha Nyanja erikutukura.
en: (Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwelt in the valley.) To morrow turn you, and get you into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.

rr: Kandi MUKAMA yaagambira Musa na Arooni ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

rr: Eihanga eri eribi riryahitsya hi okuunyetomboitera?
en: How long shall I bear with this evil congregation, which murmur against me?

rr: Mpuriire okwetomboita oku Abaisraeli barikuunyetomboitera.
en: I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against me.

rr: Bagambire oti: MUKAMA naagira ati: Buzimazima niinyerahira nti, nk'oku mpuriire nimugamba, nikwo ndibagira
en: Say unto them, As truly as I live, saith the LORD , as ye have spoken in mine ears, so will I do to you:

rr: emitumbi yaanyu eryagwa omuri eri ihamba; abaabazirwe mwena, nk'omubaro gwanyu gwona ogw'abahikize emyaka makumi abiri n'okukiraho oku guri, mwena abaanyetomboitere
en: your carcases shall fall in this wilderness; and all that were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, which have murmured against me,

en: doubtless ye shall not come into the land, concerning which I sware to make you dwell therein, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

rr: Kwonka abaana baanyu abato, abu mugizire ngu baryaba eminyago, nibo ndigihitsyamu, bakamanya ensi ei mwangire.
en: But your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which ye have despised.

rr: Kwonka imwe, emitumbi yaanyu eryagwa omuri eri ihamba
en: But as for you, your carcases, they shall fall in this wilderness.

rr: kandi abaana baanyu baryamara emyaka makumi ana nibarizengyereramu nibariisa, nibaturwa obuteesigwa bwanyu, okuhitsya obu emitumbi yaanyu yoona eriziikwa omu ihamba.
en: And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years, and bear your whoredoms, until your carcases be wasted in the wilderness.

rr: Nk'ebiro makumi ana ebi mwatatiiremu egyo nsi oku birikwingana, ekiro kimwe kiryaingana omwaka, mumare emyaka makumi ana mwine orubanja rw'okutahikiirira, kandi muryamanya ku mbagwereirwe kubi.
en: After the number of the days in which ye searched the land, even forty days, each day for a year, shall ye bear your iniquities, even forty years, and ye shall know my breach of promise.

rr: Niinye MUKAMA owaakigamba; buzimazima eki nikyo ndikora aha ihanga eri ryona eribi, eriteeraine kundwanisa; baryahwera omuri eri ihamba, kandi nimwo barifeera.
en: I the LORD have said, I will surely do it unto all this evil congregation, that are gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.

rr: Kandi abo bashaija abu Musa yaatumire kutata ensi, kandi abaagarukire, bakareetera eihanga ryona kumwetomboitera ahabw'okugamba kubi ahari egyo nsi
en: And the men, which Moses sent to search the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up a slander upon the land,

rr: abo bashaija abaagambire kubi ahari egyo nsi baitirwa orufu omu maisho ga MUKAMA.
en: even those men that did bring up the evil report upon the land, died by the plague before the LORD .

rr: Kwonka Yoshua mwene Nuuni na Kalebu mwene Yefune, bamwe ahari abo abaagiire kutata ensi, baaba nibo baahonokaho. Abaisraeli okuteeraho kuteera Kanaani n'okubingwa kwabo
en: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of the men that went to search the land, lived still .

rr: Musa ku yaagambiire Abaisraeli ebyo bigambo, abantu baashaasha munonga.
en: And Moses told these sayings unto all the children of Israel: and the people mourned greatly. Selfwilled People

rr: Baimuka kare omu kasheeshe, bainamuka kuza omu kibungo nibagira bati: Reeba turi aha, nitwinamuka kuza omu nsi ei MUKAMA yaaraganiise kutuha; ahakuba tusiisire.
en: And they rose up early in the morning, and gat them up into the top of the mountain, saying, Lo, we be here , and will go up unto the place which the LORD hath promised: for we have sinned.

rr: Musa yaabagira ati: Ahabw'enki nimushobya ekiragiro kya MUKAMA? Eki murikukora tikirikwija kuba gye.
en: And Moses said, Wherefore now do ye transgress the commandment of the LORD ? but it shall not prosper.

rr: Mutainamuka, mukasingurwa abazigu baanyu; ahabw'okuba MUKAMA tari muriimwe.
en: Go not up, for the LORD is not among you; that ye be not smitten before your enemies.

rr: Mumanye ngu omu maisho gaanyu harimu Abaamaleki n'Abanyakanaani, nimwija kwitwa rurara, ahakuba muteishukire mwareka kukuratira MUKAMA; n'ahabw'ekyo tarikwija kuguma naimwe.
en: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you, and ye shall fall by the sword: because ye are turned away from the LORD , therefore the LORD will not be with you.

rr: Kwonka bo baabigaya, baagumizamu bainamuka omu kibungo; kwonka eshanduukye y'endagaano ya MUKAMA tiyaaruga mu rusiisira, n'obu yaakuba Musa.
en: But they presumed to go up unto the hill top: nevertheless the ark of the covenant of the LORD , and Moses, departed not out of the camp.

rr: Bwanyima Abaamaleki n'Abanyakanaani abaabaire batwire omuri ekyo kibungo baashuuma, baabateera, baababinga, baabahitsya Horuma.
en: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites which dwelt in that hill, and smote them, and discomfited them, even unto Hormah.

en: and will make an offering by fire unto the LORD , a burnt offering, or a sacrifice in performing a vow, or in a freewill offering, or in your solemn feasts, to make a sweet savour unto the LORD , of the herd, or of the flock:

en: then shall he that offereth his offering unto the LORD bring a meat offering of a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of oil.

en: And the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering shalt thou prepare with the burnt offering or sacrifice, for one lamb.

en: And for a drink offering thou shalt offer the third part of an hin of wine, for a sweet savour unto the LORD .

en: And when thou preparest a bullock for a burnt offering, or for a sacrifice in performing a vow, or peace offerings unto the LORD :

en: then shall he bring with a bullock a meat offering of three tenth deals of flour mingled with half an hin of oil.

en: And thou shalt bring for a drink offering half an hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD .

rr: Okwo bibe nikwo byaguma nibikorwa ahari buri nimi, nari buri mpaya, nari ahari buri mpaya nto y'entaama nari ey'embuzi.
en: Thus shall it be done for one bullock, or for one ram, or for a lamb, or a kid.

rr: Nk'ebitambo ebi muriteekateeka oku birikwingana, mube nikwo mwakora ahabwa buri kimwe nk'omubaro gwabyo oku guri.
en: According to the number that ye shall prepare, so shall ye do to every one according to their number.

rr: Enzaarwa zoona ziryaguma zikore ebyo zityo, ku ziriba nizihonga empongano ez'okwotsya omu muriro ez'ekisooroora kirungi ekirikushemeza MUKAMA.
en: All that are born of the country shall do these things after this manner, in offering an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD .

rr: Kandi omunyaihanga ku ariba abashuhuukiiremu nari omuntu weena oriba atwire naimwe omu busingye bwanyu bwona, yaayenda kuhonga empongano ey'okwotsya omu muriro, ey'ekisooroora kirungi ekirikushemeza MUKAMA, nk'oku mutwaza, abe nikwo yaatwaza.
en: And if a stranger sojourn with you, or whosoever be among you in your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD ; as ye do, so he shall do.

rr: Ahabw'eihanga haryabaho ekiragiro kimwe ekitairweho ahabwanyu n'ahabw'omunyaihanga obashuhuukiiremu, ekiragiro ekitarihwaho omu busingye bwanyu bwona; nkaimwe oku muri, n'omunyaihanga nikwo ariba omu maisho ga MUKAMA.
en: One ordinance shall be both for you of the congregation, and also for the stranger that sojourneth with you , an ordinance for ever in your generations: as ye are , so shall the stranger be before the LORD .

rr: Muryagira ekiragiro kimwe n'omugyenzo gumwe hamwe n'omunyaihanga obashuhuukiiremu.
en: One law and one manner shall be for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth with you.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

en: Ye shall offer up a cake of the first of your dough for an heave offering: as ye do the heave offering of the threshingfloor, so shall ye heave it.

rr: Aha saano ei muribanza kusa muryaihaho empongano y'okuhongyera MUKAMA omu busingye bwanyu bwona.

en: And if ye have erred, and not observed all these commandments, which the LORD hath spoken unto Moses,

en: even all that the LORD hath commanded you by the hand of Moses, from the day that the LORD commanded Moses , and henceforward among your generations;

rr: kumuriba mutakikozire nkana, kandi kitaamanywa ihanga, eihanga ryona riryahonga enimi nto kuba ekitambo ky'okwotsya, eky'ekisooroora kirungi ekihongyeirwe MUKAMA, hamwe n'empongano y'esaano yaakyo n'empongano y'eby'okunywa byakyo, nk'emigyenzo yaabyo oku eri, kandi n'empaya y'embuzi kuba ekitambo ky'ekibi.
en: then it shall be, if ought be committed by ignorance without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bullock for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour unto the LORD , with his meat offering, and his drink offering, according to the manner, and one kid of the goats for a sin offering.

en: And the priest shall make an atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and it shall be forgiven them; for it is ignorance: and they shall bring their offering, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD , and their sin offering before the LORD , for their ignorance:

en: and it shall be forgiven all the congregation of the children of Israel, and the stranger that sojourneth among them; seeing all the people were in ignorance.

en: And if any soul sin through ignorance, then he shall bring a she goat of the first year for a sin offering.

rr: Omunyamurwa arihiirire ogwo oriba ashobize, akakora ekibi omu maisho ga MUKAMA, atakikozire nkana; ku ariheza kumurihiirira, ogwo muntu aryasaasirwa.
en: And the priest shall make an atonement for the soul that sinneth ignorantly, when he sinneth by ignorance before the LORD , to make an atonement for him; and it shall be forgiven him.

rr: Muryagira ekiragiro kimwe aha bw'omuntu weena okozire ekibi, atakikozire nkana, yaaba nzaarwa y'omu Baisraeli nari omunyaihanga oriba abashuhuukiiremu.
en: Ye shall have one law for him that sinneth through ignorance, both for him that is born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them.

rr: Kwonka omuntu weena orikora ekibi nkana n'amaryo, yaaba nzaarwa nari omunyaihanga, ogwo muntu aryaba ajumire MUKAMA, kandi aryacuubwa omu ihanga rye.
en: But the soul that doeth ought presumptuously, whether he be born in the land, or a stranger, the same reproacheth the LORD ; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

rr: Ahabw'okugaya ekigambo kya MUKAMA n'okushobya ekiragiro kye, ogwo muntu aryacwerwa kimwe, okutahikiirira kumugumeho.
en: Because he hath despised the word of the LORD , and hath broken his commandment, that soul shall utterly be cut off; his iniquity shall be upon him.

rr: Abaisraeli ku baabaire bakiri omu ihamba, baashanga omuntu naatorotoora enku ahari sabato.
en: And while the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man that gathered sticks upon the sabbath day.

en: And they that found him gathering sticks brought him unto Moses and Aaron, and unto all the congregation.

en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put upon the fringe of the borders a ribband of blue:

en: and it shall be unto you for a fringe, that ye may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of the LORD , and do them; and that ye seek not after your own heart and your own eyes, after which ye use to go a whoring:

en: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, and Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took men:

en: and they rose up before Moses, with certain of the children of Israel, two hundred and fifty princes of the assembly, famous in the congregation, men of renown:

en: and they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said unto them, Ye take too much upon you, seeing all the congregation are holy, every one of them, and the LORD is among them: wherefore then lift ye up yourselves above the congregation of the LORD ?

rr: Musa ku yaakihuriire, yaajuumara ahansi
en: And when Moses heard it , he fell upon his face:

en: and he spake unto Korah and unto all his company, saying, Even to morrow the LORD will shew who are his, and who is holy; and will cause him to come near unto him: even him whom he hath chosen will he cause to come near unto him.

rr: Mukore muti; iwe Koora n'omutwe gwawe gwona, mutware ebyoterero
en: This do; Take you censers, Korah, and all his company;

en: and put fire therein, and put incense in them before the LORD to morrow: and it shall be that the man whom the LORD doth choose, he shall be holy: ye take too much upon you, ye sons of Levi.

rr: Musa yaagaruka yaagira Koora ati: Imwe beene Leevi, muhurire!
en: And Moses said unto Korah, Hear, I pray you, ye sons of Levi:

rr: Imwe nimugira ngu n'ekigambo kikye Ruhanga wa Israeli okubashoroora omu ihanga rya Israeli, akabeehitsya haihi kukora omurimo gw'omu Butaaho bwa MUKAMA, n'okuguma nimwemerera omu maisho g'eihanga ryona okuriheereza
en: seemeth it but a small thing unto you, that the God of Israel hath separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself to do the service of the tabernacle of the LORD , and to stand before the congregation to minister unto them?

rr: kandi naiwe okukwiriza haihi hamwe na bagyenzi baawe boona beene Leevi; mbwenu nimwenda n'obunyamurwa?
en: And he hath brought thee near to him , and all thy brethren the sons of Levi with thee: and seek ye the priesthood also?

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo mumanye ngu iwe n'omutwe gwawe gwona, ou mweteeraine kurwanisa ni MUKAMA; kandi Arooni niwe oha, imwe kumwetomboitera?
en: For which cause both thou and all thy company are gathered together against the LORD : and what is Aaron, that ye murmur against him?

rr: Bwanyima Musa yaatuma kweta Dasani na Abiraamu, beene Eliabu; baagira bati: Titurikwija kwinamukayo
en: And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab: which said, We will not come up:

rr: noogira ngu n'ekintu kikye iwe okutwiha omu nsi y'amate n'obwoki, okatwinamura omu ihamba kutwitiramu, haza n'okwehindura okatwehinduraho omukama?
en: is it a small thing that thou hast brought us up out of a land that floweth with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, except thou make thyself altogether a prince over us?

rr: Kandi otatureetsire omu nsi y'amate n'obwoki, n'obu kwakuba okutuha obuhunguzi bw'obutaka n'emisiri y'emizaabibu. Nooyenda kwihamu abantu aba amaisho? Titurikwija kwinamukayo.
en: Moreover thou hast not brought us into a land that floweth with milk and honey, or given us inheritance of fields and vineyards: wilt thou put out the eyes of these men? we will not come up.

rr: Musa yaagira ekiniga kingi, yaagambira MUKAMA ati: Otaikiriza empongano yaabo. Tinkabanyagaga n'obu yaakuba endogoya n'emwe; kandi tihariho n'omwe muribo ou ndakozire kubi.
en: And Moses was very wroth, and said unto the LORD , Respect not thou their offering: I have not taken one ass from them, neither have I hurt one of them.

rr: Musa yaagira Koora ati: Nyencakare iwe n'omutwe gwawe gwona mwije na Arooni, muhikye omu maisho ga MUKAMA.
en: And Moses said unto Korah, Be thou and all thy company before the LORD , thou, and they, and Aaron, to morrow:

rr: buri muntu omuriimwe areete ekyoterero kye, akiteho obubaane, mubireete omu maisho ga MUKAMA, buri muntu ayereetere ekye, ebyoterero byona magana abiri na makumi ataano; naiwe na Arooni mureete ebyanyu.
en: and take every man his censer, and put incense in them, and bring ye before the LORD every man his censer, two hundred and fifty censers; thou also, and Aaron, each of you his censer.

rr: Buri muntu omuribo yaatwara ekyoterero kye, boona baabitaho omuriro, baataho n'obubaane, baayemerera aha muryango gw'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu hamwe na Musa na Arooni.
en: And they took every man his censer, and put fire in them, and laid incense thereon, and stood in the door of the tabernacle of the congregation with Moses and Aaron.

rr: Koora yaateerana abantu b'eihanga ryona, baabaza omumaisho aha muryango gw'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu; ekitiinisa kya MUKAMA kyabonekyera eihanga ryona.
en: And Korah gathered all the congregation against them unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto all the congregation.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa na Arooni ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

rr: Mwetaanise n'omutwe ogu, mbone kubacwekyereza omuri aka kaanya.
en: Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment.

rr: Baajuumara ahansi nibagira bati: Ai Ruhanga, Ruhanga w'emyoyo y'abantu boona, omuntu omwe ku araashiishe, noogirira ekiniga eihanga ryona?
en: And they fell upon their faces, and said, O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and wilt thou be wroth with all the congregation?

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Gambira abantu oti: Mwimukye, murugye aha mahema g'aba Koora, Dasani na Abiraamu.
en: Speak unto the congregation, saying, Get you up from about the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.

rr: Musa yaimuka, yaaza owa Dasani na Abiraamu; abakuru b'Abaisraeli baagyenda bamukuratiire.
en: And Moses rose up and went unto Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.

rr: Yaagambira omutwe gwona ati: Nimbeeshengyereza, murugye aha mahema g'aba bantu babi, kandi mutagira ekintu kyabo kyona eki mwakoraho, mutakaacwekyerezibwa nabo omu kifubiro ky'ebibi byabo.
en: And he spake unto the congregation, saying, Depart, I pray you, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of their's, lest ye be consumed in all their sins.

rr: Abantu nikwo kwimuka, bakaruga aha mbaju zoona ez'amahema g'aba Koora, Dasani na Abiraamu. Bwanyima Dasani na Abiraamu baashohora, baayemerera aha miryango y'amahema gaabo hamwe n'abakazi baabo na batabani baabo n'abaana baabo abato.
en: So they gat up from the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side: and Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood in the door of their tents, and their wives, and their sons, and their little children.

rr: Musa yaagira ati: Aha niho muraamanyire MUKAMA ku niwe yantumire kukora emirimo egi yoona; kandi ku ntaragikozire ahabwangye.
en: And Moses said, Hereby ye shall know that the LORD hath sent me to do all these works; for I have not done them of mine own mind.

rr: Abantu aba ku baraafe orufu orwita abandi boona, nari shi ku baraaguubweho ebigwa aha bandi boona, biri MUKAMA tarantumire.
en: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they be visited after the visitation of all men; then the LORD hath not sent me.

rr: Kwonka MUKAMA ku araakore ekitakareebwaga, eitaka okwashama, rikabamira hamwe n'ebyabo byona, bakashuuma okuzimu bahuriire, niho muraamanyire abantu aba ku bagayire MUKAMA.
en: But if the LORD make a new thing, and the earth open her mouth, and swallow them up, with all that appertain unto them, and they go down quick into the pit; then ye shall understand that these men have provoked the LORD .

rr: Ku yaabaire naakiheza kugamba ebigambo ebyo byona, eitaka eri beemereireho ryagangabuka
en: And it came to pass, as he had made an end of speaking all these words, that the ground clave asunder that was under them:

rr: ensi yaayashama, yaabamira n'amaka gaabo, hamwe n'aba Koora boona n'ebintu byabo byona.
en: and the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their houses, and all the men that appertained unto Korah, and all their goods.

rr: Batyo bo n'abaabo boona baashuuma okuzimu bahuriire, eitaka ryabashweka, baacwekyerera, baihwa omu ihanga.
en: They, and all that appertained to them, went down alive into the pit, and the earth closed upon them: and they perished from among the congregation.

rr: Abaisraeli boona abaabaire babeehinguririize baahunga ahabw'okuborooga kwabo, nibagira bati: Tuhungye, naitwe ensi etakaatumira.
en: And all Israel that were round about them fled at the cry of them: for they said, Lest the earth swallow us up also .

rr: Ahonaaho omuriro gwaruga ahari MUKAMA, gwayokyeza kimwe abo bashaija magana abiri na makumi ataano abaabaire nibootera obubaane.
en: And there came out a fire from the LORD , and consumed the two hundred and fifty men that offered incense.

rr: Bwanyima MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Gambira Eleazaari mwene Arooni omunyamurwa ashahure ebyo byoterero omu muriro, kandi naiwe ogutaataanise, ahabw'okuba n'ebirikwera.
en: Speak unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter thou the fire yonder; for they are hallowed.

rr: Ebyoterero by'abo basiisi, abasiisire bakafa, babiheeshemu ebyoma eby'okushweka eitambiro; ahakuba babihongyeire MUKAMA, n'ahabw'ekyo n'ebirikwera; kandi biryaguma biri eky'okureeberaho aha Baisraeli.
en: The censers of these sinners against their own souls, let them make them broad plates for a covering of the altar: for they offered them before the LORD , therefore they are hallowed: and they shall be a sign unto the children of Israel.

rr: Eleazaari omunyamurwa nikwo kutwara ebyo byoterero by'emiringa, ebi abookiibwe babaire bahongire, bakabiheeshamu eky'okushweka eitambiro
en: And Eleazar the priest took the brasen censers, wherewith they that were burnt had offered; and they were made broad plates for a covering of the altar:

rr: -7 ; kandi n'okuba ekiijutsyo aha Baisraeli, ngu hatarigira omuntu otari w'omu ruzaaro rwa Arooni owairira haihi kwotera obubaane omu maisho ga MUKAMA, akaba nka Koora n'ab'ekigombe kye; yaabikora nk'oku MUKAMA yaamugambiire naaraba omuri Musa.
en: to be a memorial unto the children of Israel, that no stranger, which is not of the seed of Aaron, come near to offer incense before the LORD ; that he be not as Korah, and as his company: as the LORD said to him by the hand of Moses.

rr: Kwonka omu kasheeshe eihanga ry'Abaisraeli ryona ryayetomboitera Musa na Arooni riti: Mwitsire abantu ba MUKAMA.
en: But on the morrow all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron, saying, Ye have killed the people of the LORD .

rr: Abantu ku baayeteeraine kugomera Musa na Arooni, baanaga amaisho ei Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu riri, baareeba ekicu kiri kirishwekire, kandi ekitiinisa kya MUKAMA kyareebeka.
en: And it came to pass, when the congregation was gathered against Moses and against Aaron, that they looked toward the tabernacle of the congregation: and, behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of the LORD appeared.

rr: Musa na Arooni baaza omu maisho g'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu.
en: And Moses and Aaron came before the tabernacle of the congregation.

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Mwimukye murugye omuri aba bantu, mbone kubacwekyereza omuri aka kaanya. Baajuumara ahansi.
en: Get you up from among this congregation, that I may consume them as in a moment. And they fell upon their faces.

rr: Musa yaagira Arooni ati: Twara ekyoterero kyawe, okiteho omuriro ogw'aha itambiro, oteho n'obubaane, okitware ahonaaho omu bantu, obarihiirire; ahabw'okuba ekiniga kyaruga ahari MUKAMA, orufu rwatandika.
en: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a censer, and put fire therein from off the altar, and put on incense, and go quickly unto the congregation, and make an atonement for them: for there is wrath gone out from the LORD ; the plague is begun.

rr: Arooni yaakitwara nk'oku Musa yaamuragiire, yairuka yaaza ahagati y'abantu abaabaire beeteeraine, yaashanga orufu rwatandikire omu bantu; yaakitaho obubaane, yaarihiirira abantu.
en: And Aaron took as Moses commanded, and ran into the midst of the congregation; and, behold, the plague was begun among the people: and he put on incense, and made an atonement for the people.

rr: Yaayemerera ahagati y'abafiire n'abahuriire; orufu rwazibirwa.
en: And he stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.

rr: Abaitsirwe orwo rufu bakaba bari abantu kakumi n'enkumi ina na magana mushanju, otabariiremu abafiire ahabw'ebya Koora.
en: Now they that died in the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, beside them that died about the matter of Korah.

rr: Arooni yaagaruka ahari Musa aha muryango gw'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu, orufu rwaheza kuzibirwa.
en: And Aaron returned unto Moses unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the plague was stayed.

en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and take of every one of them a rod according to the house of their fathers, of all their princes according to the house of their fathers twelve rods: write thou every man's name upon his rod.

rr: Enkoni y'omushaija ou ndaatoorane neija kutooka, ntyo mmareho okwetomboita omu maisho gangye oku Abaisraeli barikubeetomboitera.
en: And it shall come to pass, that the man's rod, whom I shall choose, shall blossom: and I will make to cease from me the murmurings of the children of Israel, whereby they murmur against you.

rr: Musa yaabigambira Abaisraeli, abeebembezi baabo boona baamuha enkoni, buri mwebembezi yaamuha emwe, nk'enganda za baishenkurubo oku zaabaire ziri, enkoni zoona ikumi na ibiri; kandi n'enkoni ya Arooni yaaziteebwamu.
en: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, and every one of their princes gave him a rod apiece, for each prince one, according to their fathers' houses, even twelve rods: and the rod of Aaron was among their rods.

rr: Musa yaazita omu maisho ga MUKAMA omu Ihema ry'Ebirikuhamya.
en: And Moses laid up the rods before the LORD in the tabernacle of witness.

rr: Omu kasheeshe Musa ku yaataahire omu Ihema ry'Ebirikuhamya, yaashanga enkoni ya Arooni, ey'oruganda rwa Leevi, etookire, erabize kandi ereetsire enjuma zihiisize ezirikwetwa endozi.
en: And it came to pass, that on the morrow Moses went into the tabernacle of witness; and, behold, the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded, and brought forth buds, and bloomed blossoms, and yielded almonds.

rr: Musa yaashohoza enkoni zoona, naaziiha omu maisho ga MUKAMA, yaazireetera Abaisraeli boona, abo bakuru baazireeba, buri muntu yaatwara eye.
en: And Moses brought out all the rods from before the LORD unto all the children of Israel: and they looked, and took every man his rod.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati: Garura enkoni ya Arooni omu maisho g'Ebirikuhamya, ebiikwe kuba akamanyiso k'okwomesereza abagomi, obone kumaraho okwetomboita oku barikuunyetomboitera, barekye kufa.
en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Bring Aaron's rod again before the testimony, to be kept for a token against the rebels; and thou shalt quite take away their murmurings from me, that they die not.

rr: Okwo nikwo Musa yaakozire; nk'oku MUKAMA yaamuragiire, yaaba nikwo yaakora.
en: And Moses did so: as the LORD commanded him, so did he.

rr: Abaisraeli baagira Musa bati: Reeba, nituhwerekyerera, twahwaho, twahwaho twena.
en: And the children of Israel spake unto Moses, saying, Behold, we die, we perish, we all perish.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Arooni ati: Iwe na batabani baawe n'eka ya sho muryabuuzibwa byona ebiriba byashobire omu by'Omwanya ogurikwera; iwe na batabani baawe niimwe muribuuzibwa ebiriba byashobire omu bunyamurwa bwanyu.
en: And the LORD said unto Aaron, Thou and thy sons and thy father's house with thee shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary: and thou and thy sons with thee shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.

en: And thy brethren also of the tribe of Levi, the tribe of thy father, bring thou with thee, that they may be joined unto thee, and minister unto thee: but thou and thy sons with thee shall minister before the tabernacle of witness.

rr: Bagume nibooroobera ebi orikubaragiira, kandi bakwatsibwe eby'Eihema byona, kwonka batariirira haihi n'ebintu by'Omwanya ogurikwera n'eitambiro, imwe nabo mutakaafa.
en: And they shall keep thy charge, and the charge of all the tabernacle: only they shall not come nigh the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar, that neither they, nor ye also, die.

rr: Bakwatanise naiwe, kandi bakwatsibwe eby'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu ahabw'omurimo gw'obuheereza bwaryo bwona; otari w'omuribo atariirira haihi naimwe.
en: And they shall be joined unto thee, and keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, for all the service of the tabernacle: and a stranger shall not come nigh unto you.

rr: Niimwe mwakwatsibwa eby'Omwanya ogurikwera n'eitambiro, Abaisraeli barekye kugaruka kugirirwa ekiniga.
en: And ye shall keep the charge of the sanctuary, and the charge of the altar: that there be no wrath any more upon the children of Israel.

rr: Kandi reeba, nyihire beene waanyu Abaleevi omu Baisraeli; ahariimwe n'ekiconco ekihairwe MUKAMA okukora omurimo gw'obuheereza omu Ihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu.
en: And I, behold, I have taken your brethren the Levites from among the children of Israel: to you they are given as a gift for the LORD , to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.

rr: Kwonka iwe na batabani baawe mugume nimukora omurimo gw'obunyamurwa ogurikukwata aha buri kintu kyona eky'aha itambiro, n'ahari byona ebiri omunda y'omukingo; egyo niyo mirimo ei muraagume nimukora. Naabaha obunyamurwa nk'ekiconco; otari w'omuriimwe oribyetaasyamu, aryaitwa. Eby'okutunga abanyamurwa n'Abaleevi
en: Therefore thou and thy sons with thee shall keep your priest's office for every thing of the altar, and within the vail; and ye shall serve: I have given your priest's office unto you as a service of gift: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Arooni ati: Nyowe nyenka naakukwatsa eby'empongano byona ebibiikirwe, ebi mpongyeirwe, byona ebi Abaisraeli baanyereza; naabikuha kuba omugabo gwawe na batabani baawe okuba ekiragiro ky'ebiro byona.
en: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, Behold, I also have given thee the charge of mine heave offerings of all the hallowed things of the children of Israel; unto thee have I given them by reason of the anointing, and to thy sons, by an ordinance for ever.

rr: Ebi ebitarikwokibwa aha birikwera munonga bibe ebyawe; buri mpongano yaabo yoona, buri mpongano yaabo ey'esaano, buri kitambo kyabo eky'ekibi, na buri kitambo kyabo eky'okubaihisaho orubanja rw'ekibi, ebi barimpongyera, biryaba ebirikwera munonga ahabwawe na batabani baawe.
en: This shall be thine of the most holy things, reserved from the fire: every oblation of their's, every meat offering of their's, and every sin offering of their's, and every trespass offering of their's, which they shall render unto me, shall be most holy for thee and for thy sons.

rr: Ogume obiriire aharikwera munonga, orikwetwa omushaija weena omuriimwe abe niwe yaabiryaho; biryakubeera ebirikwera.
en: In the most holy place shalt thou eat it; every male shall eat it: it shall be holy unto thee.

rr: -34 ; . Kandi ebi nabyo n'ebyawe; empongano zaabo ezi bahayo ahabw'okweyendera, empongano zoona ezizongazongiibwe ez'Abaisraeli, naazikuha na batabani baawe na bahara baawe kuba omugabo gwanyu ogw'ebiro byona; buri muntu weena ow'omu ka yaawe oshemeire aryaguma aziryeho.
en: And this is thine; the heave offering of their gift, with all the wave offerings of the children of Israel: I have given them unto thee, and to thy sons and to thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: every one that is clean in thy house shall eat of it.

rr: Kandi amajuta agarikukira oburungi goona, na viinyo erikukira oburungi yoona, n'engano ezirikukira oburungi zoona, n'emiganuro yaabyo ei bariguma nibareetera MUKAMA, niiwe naabiha.
en: All the best of the oil, and all the best of the wine, and of the wheat, the firstfruits of them which they shall offer unto the LORD , them have I given thee.

rr: Ebijuma byona ebiriguma nibibanza kwera omu nsi yaabo, ebi bareetera MUKAMA, biryaba ebyawe; buri muntu weena ow'omu ka yaawe oshemeire aryaguma abiryeho.
en: And whatsoever is first ripe in the land, which they shall bring unto the LORD , shall be thine; every one that is clean in thine house shall eat of it.

rr: Ekintu kyona ekiriheerwayo kimwe omuri Israeli kiryaba ekyawe.
en: Every thing devoted in Israel shall be thine.

rr: Emijigaijo yoona ey'ebiine omubiri byona ebi bahongyera MUKAMA, yaaba y'abantu nari ey'enyamaishwa, egume ebe eyaawe; kwonka emijigaijo y'abantu otaribura kugicungura, kandi emijigaijo y'enyamaishwa ezirikuzira nayo oryagicungura.
en: Every thing that openeth the matrix in all flesh, which they bring unto the LORD , whether it be of men or beasts, shall be thine: nevertheless the firstborn of man shalt thou surely redeem, and the firstling of unclean beasts shalt thou redeem.

rr: Ebishemereire kucungurwa aharibyo okutandikira aha bihikize okwezi, bicungurwe obuguzi bwa shekeli itaano obu oricwa, nka shekeli ey'Omwanya ogurikwera oku eri, (nizo geera makumi abiri).
en: And those that are to be redeemed from a month old shalt thou redeem, according to thine estimation, for the money of five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, which is twenty gerahs.

rr: Kwonka emijigaijo y'ente nari ey'entaama nari ey'embuzi otarigicungura; emijigaijo yaazo n'erikwera; oryaguma oshukyere eitambiro eshagama yaayo, oyotsye ebishaju byayo kuba empongano eyokiibwe omu muriro, ey'ekisooroora kirungi ahari MUKAMA.
en: But the firstling of a cow, or the firstling of a sheep, or the firstling of a goat, thou shalt not redeem; they are holy: thou shalt sprinkle their blood upon the altar, and shalt burn their fat for an offering made by fire, for a sweet savour unto the LORD .

rr: Kwonka enyama yaayo ey'enkoro ezongazongiibwe, n'ey'ekivune ky'okuguru kwa buryo eryaguma ebe eyaawe.
en: And the flesh of them shall be thine, as the wave breast and as the right shoulder are thine.

rr: Empongano zoona ezirikwera ezi Abaisraeli bahongyera MUKAMA, naazikuha na batabani baawe, kuba omugabo gwanyu ogw'ebiro byona; n'endagaano ey'ebiro byona eraganisibwa omwonyo omu maisho ga MUKAMA ahariiwe n'oruzaaro rwawe.
en: All the heave offerings of the holy things, which the children of Israel offer unto the LORD , have I given thee, and thy sons and thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: it is a covenant of salt for ever before the LORD unto thee and to thy seed with thee.

rr: Kandi MUKAMA yaagira Arooni ati: Iwe torigira buhunguzi omu nsi y'Abaisraeli, n'obu gwakuba omugabo gwona omuribo; niinye mugabo gwawe n'obuhunguzi bwawe omu Baisraeli.
en: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, Thou shalt have no inheritance in their land, neither shalt thou have any part among them: I am thy part and thine inheritance among the children of Israel.

rr: Kandi Abaleevi naabaha ebicweka byona ebya kimwe kya ikumi ebi Abaisraeli barikuha kuba obuhunguzi bwabo ahabw'omurimo gwabo gw'obuheereza, ogu barikukora omu Ihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu.
en: And, behold, I have given the children of Levi all the tenth in Israel for an inheritance, for their service which they serve, even the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.

rr: Kandi okuruga hati Abaisraeli batariirira haihi n'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu, bakagiibwaho ekibi, bakafa.
en: Neither must the children of Israel henceforth come nigh the tabernacle of the congregation, lest they bear sin, and die.

rr: Kureka Abaleevi babe nibo baakora omurimo gw'obuheereza ogw'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu, kandi babe nibo baagumwaho orubanja rw'okutahikiirira. Kibe ekiragiro ekitarihwaho ebiro byona omu busingye bwanyu bwona; kandi batarigira obuhunguzi omu Baisraeli.
en: But the Levites shall do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they shall bear their iniquity: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations, that among the children of Israel they have no inheritance.

rr: Ahabw'okuba ebicweka bya kimwe kya ikumi ebi Abaisraeli barireeta kuhongyera MUKAMA, naabiha Abaleevi kub obuhunguzi bwabo; nikyo naabagambirira ku batarigira buhunguzi omu Baisraeli. Abaleevi okuha kimwe kya ikumi
en: But the tithes of the children of Israel, which they offer as an heave offering unto the LORD , I have given to the Levites to inherit: therefore I have said unto them, Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Kandi ogambire Abaleevi oti: Ku muriiha aha Baisraeli kimwe kya ikumi, eki mbahaire kuba obuhunguzi bwanyu, naimwe mugume mukiiheho kimwe kya ikumi kuba empongano y'okuhongyera MUKAMA.
en: Thus speak unto the Levites, and say unto them, When ye take of the children of Israel the tithes which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then ye shall offer up an heave offering of it for the LORD , even a tenth part of the tithe.

rr: Egyo mpongano eryababarirwa nk'ey'engano erugire aha mbuga y'okuhuuriraho, kandi nk'eya viinyo enyuukirwe omu icwa ryona ery'emizaabibu.
en: And this your heave offering shall be reckoned unto you, as though it were the corn of the threshingfloor, and as the fulness of the winepress.

rr: Okwo mube nikwo mwaguma nimuhongyera MUKAMA empongano ezi mwihire aha bicweka byanyu byona ebya kimwe kya ikumi eki muriiha aha Baisraeli. Kandi aharibyo mugume mwiheho empongano y'okuhongyera MUKAMA, mugihe Arooni omunyamurwa.
en: Thus ye also shall offer an heave offering unto the LORD of all your tithes, which ye receive of the children of Israel; and ye shall give thereof the LORD 's heave offering to Aaron the priest.

rr: Aha biconco byona ebi muriheebwa, mugume muheyo empongano eshemereire kuhongyerwa MUKAMA, nimugiiha aha birikukira oburungi, nimuhayo ebicweka byabyo ebyeziibwe.
en: Out of all your gifts ye shall offer every heave offering of the LORD , of all the best thereof, even the hallowed part thereof out of it.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo obagire oti: Ku muriguma mwaheza kuhonga ebicweka byabyo ebirikukira oburungi, ebiritsigaraho biryabarirwa Abaleevi nk'ekirugire aha mbuga ey'okuhuuriraho, kandi nka viinyo erugire omu inyuukiro
en: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, When ye have heaved the best thereof from it, then it shall be counted unto the Levites as the increase of the threshingfloor, and as the increase of the winepress.

rr: muryaguma mubiriire ahu murikwenda hoona, imwe n'ab'omu maka gaanyu; ahabw'okuba n'ebihembo byanyu ebi murikuheebwa ahabw'omurimo gwanyu ogu murikukora omu Ihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu.
en: And ye shall eat it in every place, ye and your households: for it is your reward for your service in the tabernacle of the congregation.

rr: Kandi timurigira rubanja rw'ekibi ahabwabyo, ku muriheza kubiihaho ebirikukira oburungi, mwabihonga; kandi mutarishiisha ebintu by'Abaisraeli ebirikwera, mukafa.
en: And ye shall bear no sin by reason of it, when ye have heaved from it the best of it: neither shall ye pollute the holy things of the children of Israel, lest ye die.

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Musa na Arooni ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

rr: Ebi nibyo bigambo by'ekiragiro eki MUKAMA yaaragiire, naagira ati: Gambira Abaisraeli bakureetere enyana y'eruutsi kahogo etaine ibara, n'obu kaakuba akamogo, ei batakahingisaga.
en: This is the ordinance of the law which the LORD hath commanded, saying, Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring thee a red heifer without spot, wherein is no blemish, and upon which never came yoke:

rr: Mugihe Eleazaari omunyamurwa, agishohoze aheeru y'orusiisira, bagiitire omu maisho ge.
en: and ye shall give her unto Eleazar the priest, that he may bring her forth without the camp, and one shall slay her before his face:

rr: Eleazaari omunyamurwa aihe aha shagama yaayo n'orukumu, agimiisiire emirundi mushanju naatooza ei Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu riri
en: and Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle of her blood directly before the tabernacle of the congregation seven times:

rr: egyo nyana bagyokyeze omu maisho ge; bootyse oruhu rwayo n'enyama yaayo n'eshagama yaayo n'efa yaayo.
en: and one shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her flesh, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn:

rr: Omunyamurwa atware ekiti ky'omwereezi n'enyaweera n'akenda ka karari, abinagye omu muriro ogurikwotsya egyo nyana.
en: and the priest shall take cedar wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the midst of the burning of the heifer.

rr: Bwanyima omunyamurwa ayozye ebijwaro bye, ayogye omubiri gwe omu maizi, abone kugaruka omu rusiisira, kwonka asiibe ari osiisikaire okuhitsya omu mwabazyo.
en: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the even.

rr: Owaagyotsya ayozye ebijwaro bye, ayogye omubiri omu maizi, asiibe ari osiisikaire okuhitsya omu mwabazyo.
en: And he that burneth her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the even.

rr: Omuntu oshemeire ayoore eiju ry'egyo nyana, arishukye omu mwanya gushemeire aheeru y'orusiisira, ribiikwe ahabw'eihanga ry'Abaisraeli okurijwanzya n'amaizi, gabe amaizi g'okweza n'okwihaho ebibi.
en: And a man that is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up without the camp in a clean place, and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for a water of separation: it is a purification for sin.

rr: Owaayoora eiju rye'gyo nyana ayozye ebijwaro bye, agume ari osiisikaire okuhitsya omu mwabazyo.
en: And he that gathereth the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: and it shall be unto the children of Israel, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among them, for a statute for ever.

rr: Ekyo kigume kiri ekiragiro ekitarihwaho aha Baisraeli n'abanyamahanga abariba babashuhuukiiremu.
en: Purification

rr: Orikora aha mutumbi gw'omuntu weena aryamara ebiro mushanju ari osiisikaire.
en: He that toucheth the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.

rr: Ogwo muntu aryayeyeza n'ago maizi aha kiro kya kashatu, n'ekya mushanju abone kuba oshemeire; kwonka ku ariba ateeyerize aha kiro kya kashatu, n'ekya mushanju, tariba oshemeire.
en: He shall purify himself with it on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean: but if he purify not himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.

rr: Orikora aha mutumbi gw'omuntu weena ofiire, akanga kweyeza, aryaba asiisire Obutaaho bwa MUKAMA; ogwo muntu acuubwe omu Baisraeli; ahakuba tamiisiirweho ago maizi g'okweza, aryaguma ari osiisikaire; okusiisikara kwe kuryaba kukimuriho.
en: Whosoever toucheth the dead body of any man that is dead, and purifieth not himself, defileth the tabernacle of the LORD ; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel: because the water of separation was not sprinkled upon him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness is yet upon him.

rr: Eki n'ekiragiro ky'omuntu ofeereire omu ihema; oriritaahamu weena n'oriba aririmu weena, baryamara ebiro mushanju bari abasiisikaire.
en: This is the law, when a man dieth in a tent: all that come into the tent, and all that is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.

rr: Kandi ekintu kyona ekyashami, ekitaine kifundikizo ekikihamiireho, kiryaba ekisiisikaire.
en: And every open vessel, which hath no covering bound upon it, is unclean.

rr: Kandi omuntu weena oriba ari omu ishwa, akakora aha mutumbi gw'omuntu oitsirwe rurara, nari aha gundi mutumbi, nari aha igufa ry'omuntu, nari aha kituuro, aryamara ebiro mushanju ari osiisikaire.
en: And whosoever toucheth one that is slain with a sword in the open fields, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.

rr: Ahabw'ogwo muntu osiisikaire baryatwara aha iju ry'egyo nyana y'ekitambo ky'ekibi, barite omu kintu, barishukyemu amaizi g'omugyera
en: And for an unclean person they shall take of the ashes of the burnt heifer of purification for sin, and running water shall be put thereto in a vessel:

rr: omuntu oshemeire atware enyaweera, agijabikye omuri ago maizi, agamiisiire aha ihema n'aha bintu byona n'abantu abaririmu n'ahari ogwo okozire aha igufa nari aha muntu oitsirwe nari aha mutumbi ogundi nari aha kituuro.
en: and a clean person shall take hyssop, and dip it in the water, and sprinkle it upon the tent, and upon all the vessels, and upon the persons that were there, and upon him that touched a bone, or one slain, or one dead, or a grave:

rr: Kandi ogwo muntu oshemeire amiisiire osiisikaire aha kiro kya kashatu n'ekya mushanju; aha kiro kya mushanju amushemeze; nawe ayozye ebijwaro bye, ayogye omubiri omu maizi, abone kuba oshemeire omu mwabazyo.
en: and the clean person shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day: and on the seventh day he shall purify himself, and wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at even.

rr: -41 ; . Kwonka omuntu oriba asiisikaire, akanga kweyeza, aryacuubwa, aihwe omu ihanga, ahabw'okuba aryaba asiisire Omwanya ogurikwera gwa MUKAMA; ahabw'okutamiisiirwaho maizi ag'okweza, aryaba akiri osiisikaire.
en: But the man that shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the congregation, because he hath defiled the sanctuary of the LORD : the water of separation hath not been sprinkled upon him; he is unclean.

rr: Ekyo kiryababeera ekiragiro ekitarihwaho. Kandi orimiisiira ago maizi g'okweza, aryayozya ebijwaro bye; n'origakoraho aryaba osiisikaire okuhitsya omu mwabazyo.
en: And it shall be a perpetual statute unto them, that he that sprinkleth the water of separation shall wash his clothes; and he that toucheth the water of separation shall be unclean until even.

rr: Kandi ekintu kyona eki omuntu osiisikaire arikoraho kiryaba ekisiisikaire, n'omuntu orikikoraho aryaba osiisikaire okuhitsya omu mwabazyo.
en: And whatsoever the unclean person toucheth shall be unclean; and the soul that toucheth it shall be unclean until even.

rr: Eihanga ryona ery'Abaisraeli ryahika omu ihamba rya Ziini omu kwezi kw'okubanza; abantu baaguma Kadeshi; Miriamu yaagwa okwo, baaba niyo baamuziika.
en: Then came the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, into the desert of Zin in the first month: and the people abode in Kadesh; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.

rr: Ekibi eki Musa na Arooni baakoreire aha maizi ga Meriba
en: Water from the Rock

rr: Bwanyima eihanga ryona ryabura amaizi; abantu baayeteerana, baayetomboitera Musa na Arooni.
en: And there was no water for the congregation: and they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.

rr: Baatonganisa Musa nibagira bati: Nangwa kuri twafiire obu beene waitu baagwa omu maisho ga MUKAMA!
en: And the people chode with Moses, and spake, saying, Would God that we had died when our brethren died before the LORD !

rr: Mbwenu mukareetera ki eihanga rya MUKAMA omuri eri ihamba kufeeramu n'amatungo gaitu?
en: And why have ye brought up the congregation of the LORD into this wilderness, that we and our cattle should die there?

rr: Mukatwihira ki Misri kutureeta omu mwanya ogu omubi? Ti mwanya ogurikuhingwamu engano nari emitiini nari emizaabibu n'obu gaakuba amakomamahanga; kandi tiharimu maizi g'okunywa.
en: And wherefore have ye made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in unto this evil place? it is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water to drink.

rr: Musa na Arooni baaruga omu maisho g'abo bantu abeeteeraine, baaza aha muryango gw'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu, baajuumara ahansi; ekitiinisa kya MUKAMA kyababonekyera.
en: And Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they fell upon their faces: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto them.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Twara enkoni eri, oteerane eihanga ryona, iwe na Arooni mukuru waawe, mugambirire orukiri omu maisho gaabo, rureete amaizi gaarwo, obaihire amaizi omuri orwo rukiri; obone kunywaisa eihanga ryona n'amatungo gaaryo.
en: Take the rod, and gather thou the assembly together, thou, and Aaron thy brother, and speak ye unto the rock before their eyes; and it shall give forth his water, and thou shalt bring forth to them water out of the rock: so thou shalt give the congregation and their beasts drink.

rr: Musa yaiha egyo nkoni omu maisho ga MUKAMA, nk'oku yaamuragiira.
en: And Moses took the rod from before the LORD , as he commanded him.

rr: Musa na Arooni baateeranira eihanga omu maisho g'orwo rukiri, Musa yaagira abantu ati: Muhurire, imwe bagomi 'mwe; tubaihire amaizi omuri oru rukiri?
en: And Moses and Aaron gathered the congregation together before the rock, and he said unto them, Hear now, ye rebels; must we fetch you water out of this rock?

rr: Musa yaimutsya omukono gwe, yaatera orwo rukiri kabiri n'enkoni ye, haarugamu amaizi maingi; abantu boona baanywa hamwe n'amatungo gaabo.
en: And Moses lifted up his hand, and with his rod he smote the rock twice: and the water came out abundantly, and the congregation drank, and their beasts also .

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa na Arooni ati: Ahabw'okuba timuunyikiriize, mukampaisa ekitiinisa omu maisho g'Abaisraeli, timurihitsya eri ihanga omu nsi ei mbahaire.
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron, Because ye believed me not, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore ye shall not bring this congregation into the land which I have given them.

rr: Ago nigo maizi ga Meriba, ahabw'okuba Abaisraeli bakahakanisa MUKAMA, yaayeyoreka omuribo ku ari Orikwera.
en: This is the water of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with the LORD , and he was sanctified in them.

rr: Abanyaedomu okwangira Abaisraeli kuraba omu nsi yaabo
en: Israel and Edom

rr: Musa ku yaabaire ari Kadeshi, yaatuma entumwa aha mugabe wa Edomu, naagira ati: Oku nikwo Israeli mwene sho arikugira. Noomanya enaku zoona ezi twareebire
en: And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh unto the king of Edom, Thus saith thy brother Israel, Thou knowest all the travail that hath befallen us:

rr: baatatenkuriitwe bakashuuma, baaza Misri, twatuurayo omwanya muraingwa; Abanyamisri baatwita kubi na baatatenkuriitwe.
en: how our fathers went down into Egypt, and we have dwelt in Egypt a long time; and the Egyptians vexed us, and our fathers:

rr: Ku twatakiire MUKAMA, yaahurira okutaka kwaitu, yaatuma maraika, yaatwiha omuri Misri; mbwenu reeba turi Kadeshi, orurembo oruri aha mwatano gw'ensi yaawe.
en: and when we cried unto the LORD , he heard our voice, and sent an angel, and hath brought us forth out of Egypt: and, behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the uttermost of thy border:

rr: Nitukweshengyereza, reka turabe omu nsi yaawe; titurikwija kuraba omu misiri n'obu kwakuba okuraba omu misiri y'emizaabibu, kandi titurikwija kunywa maizi g'omu maziba; nitwija kuraba omu nguuto y'omugabe, turekye kukiikama aha rubaju rwa buryo nari orwa bumosho, okuhitsya obu turaarugire kimwe omu nsi yaawe.
en: let us pass, I pray thee, through thy country: we will not pass through the fields, or through the vineyards, neither will we drink of the water of the wells: we will go by the king's high way, we will not turn to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed thy borders.

rr: Kwonka omugabe wa Edomu yaamugarukamu ati: Torikwija kuraba mu nsi yangye, ntakaahurura nkakurwanisa na rurara.
en: And Edom said unto him, Thou shalt not pass by me, lest I come out against thee with the sword.

rr: Abaisraeli baamugira bati: Nitwija kuraba omu nguuto empango; kandi itwe n'amatungo gaitu ku turaanywe aha maizi gaawe, nitwija kugaihurira. Ka turabemu n'ebigyere kwonka, titwine kindi ki turikwija kukora.
en: And the children of Israel said unto him, We will go by the high way: and if I and my cattle drink of thy water, then I will pay for it: I will only, without doing any thing else , go through on my feet.

rr: Yaagarukamu ati: Timurikwija kurabamu. Ogwo mugabe wa Edomu yaija n'engabo nyingi kumurwanisa n'amaani maingi.
en: And he said, Thou shalt not go through. And Edom came out against him with much people, and with a strong hand.

rr: Okwo nikwo Abanyaedomu baayangiire Abaisraeli kuraba omu nsi yaabo; nikyo Abaisraeli baahindukiire bakabarugaho. Okufa kwa Arooni
en: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border: wherefore Israel turned away from him. Death of Aaron

rr: Eihanga ryona ery'Abaisraeli ryaruga Kadeshi, ryahika aha rushozi Hoori.
en: And the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, journeyed from Kadesh, and came unto mount Hor.

rr: MUKAMA yaagambirira Musa na Arooni ahari orwo rushozi Hoori orw'aha mwatano gw'ensi ya Edomu, ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron in mount Hor, by the coast of the land of Edom, saying,

rr: Arooni yaaza kukurata abaabo, ahakuba tarihika mu nsi ei naahaire Abaisraeli, ahabw'okuba mukagomera ekiragiro kyangye aha maizi ga Meriba.
en: Aaron shall be gathered unto his people: for he shall not enter into the land which I have given unto the children of Israel, because ye rebelled against my word at the water of Meribah.

rr: Twara Arooni na Eleazaari omutabani obainamure aha rushozi Hoori
en: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up unto mount Hor:

rr: ojuure Arooni ebijwaro bye, obijwekye Eleazaari omutabani; bwanyima Arooni naija kufeerayo, akurate abaabo.
en: and strip Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son: and Aaron shall be gathered unto his people , and shall die there.

rr: Musa yaakora nk'oku MUKAMA yaaragiira; bainamuka aha rushozi Hoori, eihanga ryona niribareeba.
en: And Moses did as the LORD commanded: and they went up into mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.

rr: Musa yaajuura Arooni ebijwaro bye, yaabijweka Eleazaari omutabani; Arooni yaafeera aho, aha mutwe gw'orwo rushozi; Musa na Eleazaari baashuuma, baarugayo.
en: And Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son; and Aaron died there in the top of the mount: and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mount.

rr: Eihanga ryona, nibo b'enju ya Israeli boona, ku baareebire Arooni yaafa, baamara ebiro makumi ashatu nibamucurira.
en: And when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they mourned for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.

rr: Currently Selected: Okubara 20 : RR64 Highlight Share <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8 19c-2.828 0-4.243 0-5.121-.879C2 17.243 2 15.828
Omugabe wa Aradi Omunyakanaani, owaabaire atwire Negebu, ku yaahuriire ngu Abaisraeli nibaija bareetsirwe omu muhanda gwa Asarimu, yaabarwanisa, yaakwatamu bamwe.
en: And when king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south, heard tell that Israel came by the way of the spies; then he fought against Israel, and took some of them prisoners.

rr: Abaisraeli baahiga ahari MUKAMA nibagira bati: Ku oraaheyo eri ihanga omu mikono yaitu, nitwija kusheenyera kimwe endembo zaabo n'okuzicwekyereza.
en: And Israel vowed a vow unto the LORD , and said, If thou wilt indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.

rr: MUKAMA yaahurira Abaisraeli, yaahayo Abanyakanaani; Abaisraeli baabacwekyerereza kimwe hamwe n'endembo zaabo; ogwo mwanya baagweta Horuma.
en: And the LORD hearkened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities: and he called the name of the place Hormah. Brasen Serpent

rr: Baimutsya orugyendo okuruga aha rushozi Hoori, baatoora omuhanda ogurikuza aha Nyanja erikutukura, ngu beehinguririze ensi ya Edomu; emitima y'abantu yaafoobeera munonga ahabw'orugyendo
en: And they journeyed from mount Hor by the way of the Red sea, to compass the land of Edom: and the soul of the people was much discouraged because of the way.

rr: baagamba kubi ahari Ruhanga n'ahari Musa, nibagira bati: Mukatwihira ki Misri okutureeta omuri eri ihamba kugwamu; ahakuba tiharimu by'okurya n'obu gaakuba amaizi, kandi tutamirwe eby'okurya ebi ebitaine ku biri.
en: And the people spake against God, and against Moses, Wherefore have ye brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? for there is no bread, neither is there any water; and our soul loatheth this light bread.

rr: MUKAMA yaayohereza omu bantu enjoka z'obushegu oburikubabiirira, zaabaruma; abantu baingi omu Baisraeli baafa.
en: And the LORD sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and much people of Israel died.

rr: Baayetuurira Musa, baagira bati: Tucumwire, ahabw'okuba tugambire kubi ahari MUKAMA n'ahariiwe; shaba MUKAMA atwiheho ezi njoka.
en: Therefore the people came to Moses, and said, We have sinned, for we have spoken against the LORD , and against thee; pray unto the LORD , that he take away the serpents from us.

rr: Musa yaabashabira.
en: And Moses prayed for the people.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati: Heesha enjoka ey'obushegu oburikubabiirira, ogihanikye aha muti; bwanyima oraarumwe enjoka weena, ku araagireebe, naakira.
en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Make thee a fiery serpent, and set it upon a pole: and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, when he looketh upon it, shall live.

rr: Musa yaaheesha enjoka y'omuringa, yaagihanika aha muti; bwanyima omuntu weena owaabaire arumwa enjoka, ku yaabaire areeba ahari egyo njoka y'omuringa, akira.
en: And Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a pole, and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived. To the Plains of Moab

rr: Abaisraeli baimutsya orugyendo, baateera orusiisira Obosi
en: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in Oboth.

rr: baaruga Obosi, baateera orusiisira Iye-abariimu omu ihamba eririkureebana na Moabu aha rubaju rw'oburugwa-izooba.
en: And they journeyed from Oboth, and pitched at Ije-abarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrising.

rr: Okuruga aho baimutsya orugyendo, baateera orusiisira omu ruhanga rwa Zeredi
en: From thence they removed, and pitched in the valley of Zared.

rr: baarugayo baateera orusiisira seeri y'omugyera Arunooni, oguri omu ihamba ogurikuruga omu nsi y'Abaamori; ahakuba omugyera Arunooni gukaba guri omwatano gwa Moabu, ogurikutaanisa Moabu n'Abaamori.
en: From thence they removed, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, which is in the wilderness that cometh out of the coasts of the Amorites: for Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.

rr: Nikyo kirikugambirwa omu kitabo ky'Engamba za MUKAMA ngu, Wahebu omuri Suufa n'empanga za Arunooni
en: Wherefore it is said in the book of the wars of the LORD , What he did in the Red sea, And in the brooks of Arnon,

rr: Aharikushuuma omu mpanga Hakahika aha mwanya ogu Aari atuuramu, Ogwegamiire omwatano gwa Moabu
en: And at the stream of the brooks That goeth down to the dwelling of Ar, And lieth upon the border of Moab.

rr: Baarugayo, baaza Beeri; eryo niryo iziba eri MUKAMA yaagambiireho Musa, obu yaamugira ati: Teerana hamwe abantu, mbahe amaizi.
en: And from thence they went to Beer: that is the well whereof the LORD spake unto Moses, Gather the people together, and I will give them water.

rr: Bwanyima Abaisraeli nikwo kweshongora ekyeshongoro eki: Imuka, oijure, iwe iziba 'we; muryeshongorere
en: Then Israel sang this song, Spring up, O well; sing ye unto it:

rr: Eiziba eryatimbirwe abanyiginya, Eri abakuru b'abantu baafukwize enkoni y'ekitiinisa N'ebikoni byabo.
en: The princes digged the well, The nobles of the people digged it, By the direction of the lawgiver, with their staves.

rr: Baaruga omu ihamba, baaza Matana
en: And from the wilderness they went to Mattanah:

rr: baarugayo, baaza Nahalieli; baarugayo, baaza Bamosi.
en: and from Mattanah to Nahaliel: and from Nahaliel to Bamoth:

rr: Baaruga Bamosi, baaza omu ruhanga omu nsi ya Moabu, baahika aha mutwe gwa Pisiga aharikurengyera omu ihamba. Abaisraeli okusingura Sihooni na Ogi
en: and from Bamoth in the valley, that is in the country of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looketh toward Jeshimon.

rr: Abaisraeli baatuma entumwa ahari Sihooni omugabe w'Abaamori, nibagira bati
en: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,

rr: Ka turabe omu nsi yaawe; titurikwija kuraba omu misiri, n'obu kwakuba okuraba omu misiri y'emizaabibu; kandi titurikwija kunywa amaizi g'omu maziba, kureka nitwija kuraba omu nguuto y'omugabe okuhitsya obu turaarugire kimwe omu nsi yaawe.
en: Let me pass through thy land: we will not turn into the fields, or into the vineyards; we will not drink of the waters of the well: but we will go along by the king's high way, until we be past thy borders.

rr: Sihooni tiyaikiriza Abaisraeli kuraba omu nsi ye, kureka yaahuruza engabo ze zoona, yaaza omu ihamba kubarwanisa; yaahika Yahazi, yaarwanirayo nabo.
en: And Sihon would not suffer Israel to pass through his border: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness: and he came to Jahaz, and fought against Israel.

rr: Abaisraeli baamusinguza rurara, baakubuura ensi ye okutandikira ahari Arunooni okuhika Yaboki, aha mwatano gw'Abaamoni; ahabw'okuba omwatano gw'Abaamoni gukaba guri ogw'amaani.
en: And Israel smote him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from Arnon unto Jabbok, even unto the children of Ammon: for the border of the children of Ammon was strong.

rr: Abaisraeli baakwata ezo ndembo zoona, baatuura omuri ezo ndembo z'Abaamori, n'omuri Heshibooni n'omu birorero byayo byona.
en: And Israel took all these cities: and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all the villages thereof.

rr: Ahakuba Heshibooni rukaba ruri orurembo rwa Sihooni omugabe w'Abaamori, owaarwaniise omugabe wa Moabu owa ira, akanyaga ensi ye yoona okuhitsya Arunooni.
en: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even unto Arnon.

rr: Nikyo abeeshongozi b'ebyeshongoro by'ebihimbano bagirira bati: Nimwije Heshibooni, Orurembo rwa Sihooni rwombekwe, ruhame.
en: Wherefore they that speak in proverbs say, Come into Heshbon, Let the city of Sihon be built and prepared:

rr: Ahabw'okuba omuriro gurugire Heshibooni, Endimi z'omuriro zaaruga omu rurembo rwa Sihooni; Zaayotsya Aari ey'omuri Moabu. N'abakama b'ebibungo bya Arunooni.
en: For there is a fire gone out of Heshbon, A flame from the city of Sihon: It hath consumed Ar of Moab, And the lords of the high places of Arnon.

rr: Oryareeba enaku, iwe Moabu! Mwahwa, imwe abantu ba Kemoshi! Areeteire batabani be kuhunga, Na bahara be kuba enkwatwa Z'omugabe Sihooni ow'Abaamori.
en: Woe to thee, Moab! Thou art undone, O people of Chemosh: He hath given his sons that escaped, And his daughters, into captivity Unto Sihon king of the Amorites.

rr: Tubarasire; Heshibooni yaacwekyerera okuhika Diboni, Twahwerekyereza ensi okuhika Noofa Okuhitsya obu omuriro guhikire Medeba.
en: We have shot at them; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon, And we have laid them waste even unto Nophah, Which reacheth unto Medeba.

rr: Batyo Abaisraeli baatuura omu nsi y'Abaamori.
en: Thus Israel dwelt in the land of the Amorites.

rr: Musa yaatuma ab'okutata Yazeri, baakwata ebirorero byayo, baabingamu Abaamori abaabaire batwiremu.
en: And Moses sent to spy out Jaazer, and they took the villages thereof, and drove out the Amorites that were there.

rr: Baakuba, baatoora omuhanda ogurikuza Bashani; Ogi omugabe wa Bashani yaabahururira n'engabo ze zoona, yaarwanira nabo Edurei.
en: And they turned and went up by the way of Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he, and all his people, to the battle at Edrei.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati: Otamutiina; ahakuba mmuhaireyo omu mikono yaawe n'abantu be boona n'ensi ye; omugire nk'oku waagizire Sihooni omugabe w'Abaamori, owaabaire atwire Heshibooni.
en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Fear him not: for I have delivered him into thy hand, and all his people, and his land; and thou shalt do to him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.

rr: Baamucwekyereza n'abatabani n'abantu be boona, okuhitsya obu hataratsigaireho n'omwe; n'ensi ye baagikubuura.
en: So they smote him, and his sons, and all his people, until there was none left him alive: and they possessed his land.
