rr: Abaisraeli baimutsya orugyendo, baateera orusiisira omu mpita za Moabu seeri ya Yorudani ahashungaine na Yeriko.
en: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in the plains of Moab on this side Jordan by Jericho. Balak and Balaam

rr: Balaki mwene Zipori yaareeba byona ebi Abaisraeli baakozire Abaamori
en: And Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.

rr: Abamoabu baatiina munonga Abaisraeli; ahakuba bakaba bari baingi munonga; emitima yaabahwa omunda ahabw'abo.
en: And Moab was sore afraid of the people, because they were many: and Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.

rr: Abamoabu baagambira abakuru ba Midiani bati: Egi nyanja y'abantu neija kumaraho ebitwehinguririize byona, nk'oku ente emara obunyaatsi omu iriisizo.
en: And Moab said unto the elders of Midian, Now shall this company lick up all that are round about us, as the ox licketh up the grass of the field.

rr: Kandi omu biro ebyo Balaki mwene Zipori niwe yaabaire ari omugabe wa Moabu.
en: And Balak the son of Zippor was king of the Moabites at that time.

rr: Yaatuma entumwa ahari Balamu mwene Beori, owaabaire atwire Pesori aha mugyera Furaati omu nsi y'abantu b'eihanga rye, kumweta, naagira ati: Hariho abantu barugire Misri; reeba, bashwekire ensi, batwire aharikureebana naitwe.
en: He sent messengers therefore unto Balaam the son of Beor to Pethor, which is by the river of the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, Behold, there is a people come out from Egypt: behold, they cover the face of the earth, and they abide over against me:

rr: Mbwenu ninkweshengyereza, ija onkyeenere aba bantu; ahabw'okuba nibankiza amaani; obundi nkaabaasa kubasingura, mbabingira kimwe omu nsi; ahakuba nimmanya ngu ou oshabira omugisha aguheebwa, kandi ou okyeena akyeenwa.
en: come now therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people; for they are too mighty for me: peradventure I shall prevail, that we may smite them, and that I may drive them out of the land: for I wot that he whom thou blessest is blessed, and he whom thou cursest is cursed.

rr: Abakuru ba Moabu n'Abamidiani baagyenda n'emikimbo omu ngaro; baahika ahari Balamu, baamugambira ebi Balaki abatumire.
en: And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand; and they came unto Balaam, and spake unto him the words of Balak.

rr: Yaabagira ati: Muraare aha eki kiro; niinyija kubagambira nk'oku MUKAMA arangambire. Abanyiginya ba Moabu baaraara owa Balamu.
en: And he said unto them, Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as the LORD shall speak unto me: and the princes of Moab abode with Balaam.

rr: Ruhanga yaija ahari Balamu, yaamubuuza ati: Abo bashaija abari hamwe naiwe nibaahi?
en: And God came unto Balaam, and said, What men are these with thee?

rr: Balamu yaagarukamu Ruhanga ati: Balaki mwene Zipori omugabe wa Moabu antumireho ati
en: And Balaam said unto God, Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, hath sent unto me, saying ,

rr: Reeba, hariho abantu barugire Misri, baashweka ensi; mbwenu ija obankyeenere; obundi nkaabaasa kubarwanisa, mbabinga.
en: Behold, there is a people come out of Egypt, which covereth the face of the earth: come now, curse me them; peradventure I shall be able to overcome them, and drive them out.

rr: Ruhanga yaagira Balamu ati: Otagyenda nabo, otarikyeena abo bantu, ahakuba bahairwe omugisha.
en: And God said unto Balaam, Thou shalt not go with them; thou shalt not curse the people: for they are blessed.

rr: Balamu yaimuka omu kasheeshe, yaagambira abanyiginya ba Balaki ati: Mwirooko mugarukye owaanyu, ahabw'okuba MUKAMA taanyikiriize kugyenda naimwe.
en: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and said unto the princes of Balak, Get you into your land: for the LORD refuseth to give me leave to go with you.

rr: Abanyiginya ba Moabu baimuka, baagaruka ahari Balaki, baamugira bati: Balamu ayangire kwija naitwe.
en: And the princes of Moab rose up, and they went unto Balak, and said, Balaam refuseth to come with us.

rr: Balaki yaagaruka yaatuma abandi banyiginya abarikukira bari obwingi n'ekitiinisa.
en: And Balak sent yet again princes, more, and more honourable than they.

rr: Baija ahari Balamu, baamugira bati: Balaki mwene Zipori atutumire naagira ngu, hatagira ekyakuzibira kwija
en: And they came to Balaam, and said to him, Thus saith Balak the son of Zippor, Let nothing, I pray thee, hinder thee from coming unto me:

rr: ahakuba naija kukukuza, akuhindure omuntu w'ekitiinisa kingi; kandi ngu, eki orimugambira kyona, aryakikora; n'ahabw'ekyo ngu oije omukyeenere abo bantu.
en: for I will promote thee unto very great honour, and I will do whatsoever thou sayest unto me: come therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people.

rr: Balamu yaagarukamu abagaragwa ba Balaki ati: N'obu Balaki yaakumpa enju ye eijwire efeeza n'ezaabu, tinkaabaasa kuhingura aha kigambo kya MUKAMA Ruhanga wangye, kukicwaho nari okukyongyeraho.
en: And Balaam answered and said unto the servants of Balak, If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the word of the LORD my God, to do less or more.

rr: Mbwenu nimbeeshengyereza, naimwe muraare aha eki kiro, ndeebe eki MUKAMA araagarukye kungambira.
en: Now therefore, I pray you, tarry ye also here this night, that I may know what the LORD will say unto me more.

rr: Ruhanga yaija ahari Balamu ekyo kiro, yaamugira ati: Aba bashaija ku baraabe baizire kukweta, imuka ogyende nabo; kwonka eki ndaakuragiire, obe nikyo waakora. Ruhanga okuhanisa Balamu endogoya
en: And God came unto Balaam at night, and said unto him, If the men come to call thee, rise up, and go with them; but yet the word which I shall say unto thee, that shalt thou do.

rr: Balamu yaimuka omu kasheeshe, yaatandiika endogoya ye, yaagyenda n'abanyiginya ba Moabu.
en: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his ass, and went with the princes of Moab.

rr: Kwonka Ruhanga yaamugirira ekiniga ahabw'okugyenda; maraika wa MUKAMA yaayemerera omu muhanda kumutanga; obwo Balamu akaba atembire endogoya ye, kandi aine abaheereza be bombi.
en: And God's anger was kindled because he went: and the angel of the LORD stood in the way for an adversary against him. Now he was riding upon his ass, and his two servants were with him.

rr: Endogoya yaareeba maraika wa MUKAMA ayemereire omu muhanda, aine rurara omu ngaro; endogoya yaaruga omu muhanda, yaakiikama yaaza omu kishaka; Balamu yaagiteera kugigarura omu muhanda.
en: And the ass saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and the ass turned aside out of the way, and went into the field: and Balaam smote the ass, to turn her into the way.

rr: Bwanyima maraika wa MUKAMA yaayemerera omu kahanda kafunzire, akarikuraba ahagati y'emisiri y'emizaabibu, orugo rumuri oku n'oku.
en: But the angel of the LORD stood in a path of the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.

rr: Egyo ndogoya ku yaareebire maraika wa MUKAMA, yaayemigisiriza aha rugo, yaarumigiraho ekigyere kya Balamu; Balamu yaagaruka yaagiteera.
en: And when the ass saw the angel of the LORD , she thrust herself unto the wall, and crushed Balaam's foot against the wall: and he smote her again.

rr: Maraika wa MUKAMA yaagaruka enyima, yaayemerera ahafunzire munonga, ahataine buhindukiro aha rubaju rwa buryo nari orwa bumosho.
en: And the angel of the LORD went further, and stood in a narrow place, where was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.

rr: Endogoya ku yaareebire maraika wa MUKAMA, yaabyama omu maguru ga Balamu; Balamu yaagira ekiniga kingi, yaagiteera enkoni.
en: And when the ass saw the angel of the LORD , she fell down under Balaam: and Balaam's anger was kindled, and he smote the ass with a staff.

rr: MUKAMA yaayashamya akanwa k'egyo ndogoya, yaabuuza Balamu eti: Wantura ki okunteera egi mirundi yonshatu?
en: And the LORD opened the mouth of the ass, and she said unto Balaam, What have I done unto thee, that thou hast smitten me these three times?

rr: Balamu yaagigarukamu ati: Naakutura okungaya. Kuri naaba nyine rurara mu ngaro, naaba ninkwita.
en: And Balaam said unto the ass, Because thou hast mocked me: I would there were a sword in mine hand, for now would I kill thee.

rr: Endogoya yaabuuza Balamu eti: Tiinye endogoya yaawe, ei otuura nootemba obutoosha n'okuhitsya eri izooba? Hariho obu ndakugizire nti? Onu ati: Ngaaha!
en: And the ass said unto Balaam, Am not I thine ass, upon which thou hast ridden ever since I was thine unto this day? was I ever wont to do so unto thee? And he said, Nay.

rr: Bwanyima MUKAMA yaahwezesa amaisho ga Balamu, yaareeba maraika wa MUKAMA ayemereire omu muhanda, aine rurara omu ngaro; yainama, yaajuumara.
en: Then the LORD opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and he bowed down his head, and fell flat on his face.

rr: Maraika wa MUKAMA yaamubuuza ati: Waateerera ki endogoya yaawe egi mirundi yonshatu? Reeba, naija kukutanga omu maisho, ahabw'okuba orugyendo oru orimu n'orw'obugomi omu maisho gangye
en: And the angel of the LORD said unto him, Wherefore hast thou smitten thine ass these three times? behold, I went out to withstand thee, because thy way is perverse before me:

rr: endogoya yaawe ku yandeeba, yampigiza egyo mirundi eshatu; kuri etampigiza, buzimazima hati kuri naakwitsire, yo ngireka ehuriire.

rr: Kandi ogwo Mwisraeli owaitsirwe n'ogwo Mumidianikazi akaba naayetwa Zimuri mwene Saalu, omukuru w'enju ya baishenkuru omu ruganda rwa Simeoni
en: Now the name of the Israelite that was slain, even that was slain with the Midianitish woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a chief house among the Simeonites.

rr: kandi ogwo Mumidianikazi owaitsirwe akaba naayetwa Kozibi muhara wa Zuuri; nawe akaba ari omukuru w'omutwe gw'ab'enju ya baishenkuru omu Bamidiani.
en: And the name of the Midianitish woman that was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur; he was head over a people, and of a chief house in Midian.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Tuntuza Abamidiani, obaite
en: Vex the Midianites, and smite them:

rr: ahabw'okuba babatuntwize n'oburyarya bwabo, obu baababeihabeihiise omu bya Peori, n'omu bya Kozibi muhara w'omukuru w'Abamidiani, munyaanyabo oitsirwe aha izooba ry'orufu orureetsirwe ebya Peori.
en: for they vex you with their wiles, wherewith they have beguiled you in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of a prince of Midian, their sister, which was slain in the day of the plague for Peor's sake.

rr: Currently Selected: Okubara 25 : RR64 Highlight Share <path fill-rule="ev
Bwanyima y'orwo rufu MUKAMA yaagambira Musa na Eleazaari mwene Arooni omunyamurwa, ati
en: And it came to pass after the plague, that the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,

rr: Mubare eihanga ry'Abaisraeli ryona, abahikize emyaka makumi abiri n'okukiraho, nk'emiryango ya baishenkurubo oku eri, ab'omu Baisraeli boona abarikubaasa kuhurura.
en: Take the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, throughout their fathers' house, all that are able to go to war in Israel.

rr: Musa na Eleazaari omunyamurwa baagamba nabo bari omu mpita za Moabu, haihi na Yorudani, ahashungaine na Yeriko, nibagira bati
en: And Moses and Eleazar the priest spake with them in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,

rr: Mubare abantu abahikize emyaka makumi abiri n'okukiraho, nk'oku MUKAMA aragiire Musa. Abaisraeli abaarugire omu nsi ya Misri nibo aba
en: Take the sum of the people , from twenty years old and upward; as the LORD commanded Moses and the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt.

rr: Reubeeni omujigaijo gwa Israeli; beene Reubeeni, abaazairwe Hanoki, omuryango gw'aba Hanoki; abaazairwe Palu, omuryango gw'aba Palu
en: Reuben, the eldest son of Israel: the children of Reuben; Hanoch, of whom cometh the family of the Hanochites: of Pallu, the family of the Palluites:

rr: abaazairwe Hezirooni, omuryango gw'aba Hezirooni; abaazairwe Karumi, omuryango gw'aba Karumi.
en: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.

rr: Egyo niyo miryango y'Abareubeeni; abaabazirwe omuribo bakaba bari obukumi buna n'enkumi ishatu na magana mushanju na makumi ashatu.
en: These are the families of the Reubenites: and they that were numbered of them were forty and three thousand and seven hundred and thirty.

rr: Omuri beene Palu, Eliabu.
en: And the sons of Pallu; Eliab.

rr: Beene Eliabu Nemueli, Dasani na Abiraamu, Dasani na Abiraamu abo nibo baatoorainwe omu ihanga, bakahakanisa Musa na Arooni bakwataniise na Koora, obu baahakanisa MUKAMA
en: And the sons of Eliab; Nemuel, and Dathan, and Abiram. This is that Dathan and Abiram, which were famous in the congregation, who strove against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah, when they strove against the LORD :

rr: ensi ekaashamya akanwa, ekabamira hamwe na Koora, obu ekigombe kye ekyo kyafa, omuriro gukootsya abashaija magana abiri na makumi ataano, bakahinduka eky'okureeberaho.
en: and the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah, when that company died, what time the fire devoured two hundred and fifty men: and they became a sign.

rr: Kwonka beene Koora tibarafiire.
en: Notwithstanding the children of Korah died not.

rr: Beene Simeoni nk'emiryango yaabo oku yaabaire eri; abaazairwe Nemueli, omuryango gw'aba N'emueli; abaazairwe Yamini, omuryango gw'aba Yamini; abaazairwe Yakini, omuryango gw'aba Yakini
en: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites: of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites: of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites:

rr: abaazairwe Zeera, omuryango gw'aba Zeera; abaazairwe Shauli, omuryango gw'aba Shauli.
en: of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites: of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.

rr: Egyo niyo miryango y'Abasimeoni, abashaija obukumi bubiri n'enkumi ibiri na magana abiri.
en: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty and two thousand and two hundred.

rr: Beene Gaadi nk'emiryango yaabo oku yaabaire eri; abaazairwe Zefoni, omuryango gw'aba Zefoni; abaazairwe Haagi, omuryango gw'aba Haagi; abaazairwe Shuuni, omuryango gw'aba Shuuni
en: The children of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites: of Haggi, the family of the Haggites: of Shuni, the family of the Shunites:

rr: abaazairwe Ozini, omuryango gw'aba Ozini; abaazairwe Eeri, omuryango gw'aba Eeri
en: of Ozni, the family of the Oznites: of Eri, the family of the Erites:

rr: abaazairwe Arodi, omuryango gw'aba Arodi; abaazairwe Areeli, omuryango gw'aba Areeli.
en: of Arod, the family of the Arodites: of Areli, the family of the Arelites.

rr: Egyo niyo miryango y'Abagaadi, nk'abo abaabazirwe aharibo oku baabaire bari, obukumi buna na magana ataano.
en: These are the families of the children of Gad according to those that were numbered of them, forty thousand and five hundred.

rr: Beene Yuda Eeri na Onani; Eeri na Onani abo bakagwa omu nsi ya Kanaani.
en: The sons of Judah were Er and Onan: and Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.

rr: Beene Yuda nk'emiryango yaabo oku yaabaire eri, abaazairwe Sheela, omuryango gw'aba Sheela; abaazairwe Pereezi, omuryango gw'aba Pereezi, abaazairwe Zeera, omuryango gw'aba Zeera.
en: And the sons of Judah after their families were; of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites: of Pharez, the family of the Pharzites: of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites.

rr: Beene Pereezi nibo aba; abaazairwe Hezirooni, omuryango gw'aba Hezirooni; abaazairwe Hamuli, omuryango gw'aba Hamuli.
en: And the sons of Pharez were; of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.

rr: Egyo niyo miryango ya Yuda, nk'abo abaabazirwe aharibo, obukumi mushanju n'enkumi mukaaga na magana ataano.
en: These are the families of Judah according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and sixteen thousand and five hundred.

rr: Beene Isakaari nk'emiryango yaabo oku yaabaire eri; abaazairwe Toola, omuryango gw'aba Toola; abaazairwe Puuva, omuryango gw'aba Puuna
en: Of the sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites: of Pua, the family of the Punites:

rr: abaazairwe Yashubu, omuryango gw'aba Yashubu; abaazairwe Shimirooni, omuryango gw'aba Shimirooni.
en: of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites: of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.

rr: Egyo niyo miryango ya Isakaari, nk'abo abaabazirwe oku baabaire bari, obukumi mukaaga n'enkumi ina na magana ashatu.
en: These are the families of Issachar according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and four thousand and three hundred.

rr: Beene Zebuluuni nk'emiryango yaabo oku yaabaire eri; abaazairwe Seredi, omuryango gw'aba Seredi; abaazairwe Eloni, omuryango gw'aba Eloni; abaazairwe Yahaleeli, omuryango gw'aba Yahaleeli.
en: Of the sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Sardites: of Elon, the family of the Elonites: of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.

rr: Egyo niyo miryango y'Abazebuluuni, nk'abo abaabazirwe aharibo oku baabaire bari, obukumi mukaaga na magana ataano.
en: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those that were numbered of them, threescore thousand and five hundred.

rr: Beene Yosefu nk'emiryango yaabo oku yaabaire eri; Manaase na Efuraimu.
en: The sons of Joseph after their families were Manasseh and Ephraim.

rr: Beene Manaase, abaazairwe Makiri, omuryango gw'aba Makiri; kandi Makiri akazaara Gileadi; abaazairwe Gileadi, omuryango gw'aba Gileadi.
en: Of the sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites: and Machir begat Gilead: of Gilead come the family of the Gileadites.

rr: Kandi aba nibo beene Gileadi, abaazairwe Yezeri, omuryango gw'aba Yezeri; abaazairwe Heleki, omuryango gw'aba Heleki
en: These are the sons of Gilead: of Jeezer, the family of the Jeezerites: of Helek, the family of the Helekites:

rr: abaazairwe Asirieli, omuryango gw'aba Asirieli; abaazairwe Shekemu, omuryango gw'aba Shekemu
en: and of Asriel, the family of the Asrielites: and of Shechem, the family of the Shechemites:

rr: abaazairwe Shemida, omuryango gw'aba Shemida; abaazairwe Heferi, omuryango gw'aba Heferi.
en: and of Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites: and of Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.

rr: -11 ; . Zelofehaadi mwene Heferi tarazaire boojo, kureka abaishiki; amaziina ga bahara ba Zelofehaadi ni Maala na Noa, Hogula, Milika na Tiruza.
en: And Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

rr: Egyo niyo miryango ya Manaase; abaabazirwe aharibo bakaba bari obukumi butaano n'enkumi ibiri na magana mushanju.
en: These are the families of Manasseh, and those that were numbered of them, fifty and two thousand and seven hundred.

rr: Aba nibo beene Efuraimu nk'emiryango yaabo oku yaabaire eri; abaazairwe Shuseela, omuryango gw'aba Shuseela; abaazairwe Bekeri, omuryango gw'aba Bekeri; abaazairwe Tahani, omuryango gw'aba Tahani.
en: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthalhites: of Becher, the family of the Bachrites: of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.

rr: Kandi nibo beene Shuseela; abaazairwe Erani, omuryango gw'aba Erani.
en: And these are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.

rr: Egyo niyo miryango y'Abaefuraimu, nk'abo abaabazirwe aharibo oku baabaire bari, obukumi bushatu n'enkumi ibiri na magana ataano.
en: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those that were numbered of them, thirty and two thousand and five hundred.

rr: Abo nibo beene Yosefu nk'emiryango yaabo oku yaabaire eri.
en: These are the sons of Joseph after their families.

rr: Beene Benyamiini nk'emiryango yaabo oku yaabaire eri; abaazairwe Beela, omuryango gw'aba Beela; abaazairwe Ashubeeli, omuryango gw'aba Ashubeeli; abaazairwe Ahiraamu, omuryango gw'aba Ahiraamu
en: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites: of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites: of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites:

rr: abaazairwe Shufaamu, omuryango gw'aba Shufaamu; abaazairwe Hufaamu, omuryango gw'aba Hufaamu.
en: of Shupham, the family of the Shuphamites: of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.

rr: Kandi beene Beela bakaba bari Arudi na Naamani; abaazairwe Arudi, omuryango gw'aba Arudi; abaazairwe Naamani, omuryango gw'aba Naamani.
en: And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: of Ard , the family of the Ardites: and of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.

rr: Abo nibo beene Benyamiini nk'emiryango yaabo oku yaabaire eri; abaabazirwe aharibo bakaba bari obukumi buna n'enkumi itaano na magana mukaaga.
en: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and six hundred.

rr: Aba nibo beene Daani nk'emiryango yaabo oku yaabaire eri; abaazairwe Shuhaamu, omuryango gw'aba Shuhaamu; egyo niyo miryango y'Abadaani.
en: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.

rr: Emiryango yoona ey'aba Shuhaamu, nk'abo abaabazirwe aharibo oku baabaire bari, n'obukumi mukaaga n'enkumi ina na magana ana.
en: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those that were numbered of them, were threescore and four thousand and four hundred.

rr: Beene Asheri nk'emiryango yaabo oku yaabaire eri; abaazairwe Imuna, omuryango gw'aba Imuna; abaazairwe Ishuvi, omuryango gw'aba Ishuvi; abaazairwe Beria, omuryango gw'aba Beeri
en: Of the children of Asher after their families: of Jimna, the family of the Jimnites: of Jesui, the family of the Jesuites: of Beriah, the family of the Beriites.

rr: omuri beene Beria, abaazairwe Heberi, omuryango gw'aba Heberi; abaazairwe Malikieli, omuryango gw'aba Malikieli
en: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites: of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.

rr: kandi muhara wa Asheri akaba naayetwa Seera.
en: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Sarah.

rr: Egyo niyo miryango y'Abaasheri, nk'abo abaabazirwe aharibo oku baabaire bari, obukumi butaano n'enkumi ishatu na magana ana.
en: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those that were numbered of them; who were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.

rr: Beene Nafutaali nk'emiryango yaabo oku yaabaire eri; abaazairwe Yahazeeli, omuryango gw'aba Yahazeeli; abaazairwe Guuni, omuryango gw'aba Guuni
en: Of the sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites: of Guni, the family of the Gunites:

rr: abaazairwe Yezeri, omuryango gw'aba Yezeri; abaazairwe Shileemu, omuryango gw'aba Shileemu.
en: of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites: of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.

rr: Egyo niyo miryango ya Nafutaali nk'emiryango yaabo oku yaabaire eri; abaabazirwe aharibo bakaba bari obukumi buna n'enkumi itaano na magana ana.
en: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and four hundred.

rr: Abo nibo baabazirwe aha Baisraeli, boona bakaba bari obusiriira mukaaga na rukumi na magana mushanju na makumi ashatu.
en: These were the numbered of the children of Israel, six hundred thousand and a thousand seven hundred and thirty.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Abo nibo baribaganisizibwa ensi kuba obuhunguzi, nk'omubaro gw'amaziina gaabo oku guri.
en: Unto these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.

rr: Abaingi oryabaha obuhunguzi bwingi, kandi abakye obahe obuhunguzi bukye; buri ruganda ruheebwe obuhunguzi nk'omubaro gw'abantu baarwo abaabazirwe oku guri.
en: To many thou shalt give the more inheritance, and to few thou shalt give the less inheritance: to every one shall his inheritance be given according to those that were numbered of him.

rr: Kwonka ensi eryabaganisibwa n'enteenyu; baryagihungura nk'amaziina g'enganda za baishenkurubo oku gari.
en: Notwithstanding the land shall be divided by lot: according to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.

rr: Nk'oku enteenyu eriba, nikwo n'obuhunguzi buribaganisizibwa abaingi n'abakye.
en: According to the lot shall the possession thereof be divided between many and few.

rr: Aba nibo baabazirwe omu Baleevi, nk'emiryango yaabo oku yaabaire eri; abaazairwe Gereshoni, omuryango gw'aba Gereshoni; abaazairwe Kohasi, omuryango gw'aba Kohasi; abaazairwe Merari, omuryango gw'aba Merari.
en: And these are they that were numbered of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites: of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites: of Merari, the family of the Merarites.

rr: Egyo niyo miryango ya Leevi, omuryango gw'aba Libuni, omuryango gw'aba Heburooni, n'ogw'aba Mahili n'ogw'aba Muushi, n'ogw'aba Koora.
en: These are the families of the Levites: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korathites.

rr: Kandi Kohasi niwe yaazaire Amuraamu.
en: And Kohath begat Amram.

rr: Kandi muka Amuraamu akaba naayetwa Yokebedi, muhara wa Leevi, ou Leevi yaazaariire Misri; yaazaara na Amuraamu, Arooni na Musa, na Miriamu munyaanyabo.
en: And the name of Amram's wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, whom her mother bare to Levi in Egypt: and she bare unto Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.

rr: Na Arooni yaazaara Nadabu, Abihu, Eleazaari na Itamaari.
en: And unto Aaron was born Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

rr: Kwonka Nadabu na Abihu bakafa, obu baayoteza omuriro ogundi ogutararagiirwe kwoteza omu maisho ga MUKAMA.
en: And Nadab and Abihu died, when they offered strange fire before the LORD .

rr: Abaleevi abaabazirwe, oyetwa omushaija weena okwiha aha mwana ohikize okwezi bakaba bari obukumi bubiri n'enkumi ishatu; kandi tibarabazirwe na Baisraeli abandi, ahabw'okuba tibarahairwe buhunguzi hamwe nabo.
en: And those that were numbered of them were twenty and three thousand, all males from a month old and upward: for they were not numbered among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.

rr: Abo nibo baabazirwe Musa na Eleazaari omunyamurwa, abaabariire Abaisraeli omu mpita za Moabu haihi na Yorudani ahashungaine na Yeriko.
en: These are they that were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.

rr: Kwonka omuri abo hakaba hatarimu n'omwe omu baabazirwe Musa na Arooni omunyamurwa, abaabariire Abaisraeli omu ihamba rya Sinai.
en: But among these there was not a man of them whom Moses and Aaron the priest numbered, when they numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.

rr: Ahakuba MUKAMA akabagambaho, naagira ati: Buzimazima baryafeera omu ihamba.
en: For the LORD had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness.

rr: Tihariho n'omwe aharibo owaatsigaireho kureka Kalebu mwene Yefune na Yoshua mwene Nuuni.
en: And there was not left a man of them, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

rr: Bwanyima haija bahara ba Zelofehaadi, mwene Heferi ya Gileadi, ya Makiri, ya Manaase ab'emiryango ya Manaase ab'emiryango ya Manaase mwene Yosefu; bahara be bakaba nibeetwa Maala, Noa, Hogula, Milika na Tiruza
en: Then came the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph: and these are the names of his daughters; Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.

rr: baayemerera omu maisho ga Musa na Eleazaari omunyamurwa n'abeebembezi n'eihanga ryona aha muryango gw'Eihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu; baagira bati
en: And they stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,

rr: Tataitwe akagwa omu ihamba; kandi akaba atari mu mutwe gw'abaayeteeraine kugomera MUKAMA omu kigombe kya Koora; akafeera omu bibi bye wenka, kandi akaba atazaire boojo.
en: Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not in the company of them that gathered themselves together against the LORD in the company of Korah; but died in his own sin, and had no sons.

rr: N'enki ekirikwihisa eiziina rya tataitwe omu b'omuryango gwe, ngu ahabw'okuba tarazaire mwojo?
en: Why should the name of our father be done away from among his family, because he hath no son?

rr: Otuhe obutaka omu b'oruganda rwa tataitwe.
en: Give unto us therefore a possession among the brethren of our father.

rr: Musa yaatwarira MUKAMA ebigambo byabo.
en: And Moses brought their cause before the LORD .

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Ebi bahara ba Zelofehaadi barikufa n'eby'amazima; buzimazima otaribura kubaha obutaka omu b'omuryango gwa ishebo; obarekye bahungure obuhunguzi bwe.
en: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right: thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father's brethren; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them.

rr: Kandi ogambire Abaisraeli oti: Omuntu ku arifa, atatsigire mwana w'omwojo, muryareka obuhunguzi bwe bube obwa muhara we.
en: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a man die, and have no son, then ye shall cause his inheritance to pass unto his daughter.

rr: Ku ariba atatsigire muhara, obuhunguzi mubuhe beene ishe.
en: And if he have no daughter, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his brethren.

rr: Ku ariba ataine beene ishe, mubuhe baishento.
en: And if he have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his father's brethren.

rr: Kwonka ishe ku ariba ataine bakuru be nari abarumuna, obuhunguzi mubuhe omunyaruganda omuri haihi, abuhungure. Ekyo kibe ekiragiro ky'okucweraho emanja z'obuhunguzi omu Baisraeli, nk'oku MUKAMA yaaragiire Musa. MUKAMA okugambira Musa eby'okufa kwe, n'okutoorana Yoshua kumuhungurira
en: And if his father have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his kinsman that is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it: and it shall be unto the children of Israel a statute of judgment, as the LORD commanded Moses. Moses and Joshua

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati: Oryainamuka ahari oru rushozi rwa Abariimu, oreebe ensi ei mpaire Abaisraeli.
en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Get thee up into this mount Abarim, and see the land which I have given unto the children of Israel.

rr: Ku oriheza kugireeba, naiwe oryafa, okurate abaanyu, nka Arooni mukuru waawe oku yaabakuratsire
en: And when thou hast seen it, thou also shalt be gathered unto thy people, as Aaron thy brother was gathered.

rr: ahabw'okuba mukagomera ekiragiro kyangye omu ihamba rya Ziini, obu eihanga ryampakanisa, mukanga kumpaisa ekitiinisa omu maisho gaaryo aha maizi. Ago nigo maizi ga Meriba omuri Kadeshi omu ihamba rya Ziini.
en: For ye rebelled against my commandment in the desert of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify me at the water before their eyes: that is the water of Meribah in Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.

rr: Musa yaagira MUKAMA ati
en: And Moses spake unto the LORD , saying,

rr: MUKAMA Ruhanga w'emyoyo y'abantu boona atoorane omushaija w'okutegyeka eri ihanga
en: Let the LORD , the God of the spirits of all flesh, set a man over the congregation,

rr: ow'okubeebembera nibashohora, kandi nibataaha, oraabashohoze, kandi akabataasya, eihanga rya MUKAMA rirekye kuba nk'entaama ezitaine muriisa.

en: And thou shalt put some of thine honour upon him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient.

rr: Aryaguma ayemerere omu maisho ga Eleazaari omunyamurwa, nawe aije omu maisho gangye amubuurize ahariinye naakoresa Urimu; ahabw'okuragiira kwa Eleazaari baryaguma bashohore, kandi bataahe ahabw'okuragiira kwe, Yoshua hamwe n'Abaisraeli boona, niryo ihanga ryona.
en: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall ask counsel for him after the judgment of Urim before the LORD : at his word shall they go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.

rr: Musa yaakora nk'oku MUKAMA yaamuragiira; yaatwara Yoshua, yaamwemereza omu maisho ga Eleazaari omunyamurwa n'eihanga ryona
en: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him: and he took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation:

en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Ragiira Abaisraeli, obagambire ebi ndikugamba ningira nti: Ebi mpongyeirwe, eby'okurya ebi murikumpongyera ebyokiibwe omu muriro, eby'ekisoroora ekirikunshemeza, mugume mwijukye kubimpongyera omu bunaku bwabyo obwatairweho.
en: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, My offering, and my bread for my sacrifices made by fire, for a sweet savour unto me, shall ye observe to offer unto me in their due season.

rr: Obagire oti: Egi niyo mpongano y'okwotsya omu muriro, ei muriguma nimuhongyera MUKAMA; buri izooba muhongye empaya nto z'entaama ibiri ezitaine kamogo, kuba ekitambo ky'okwotsya eky'obutoosha.
en: And thou shalt say unto them, This is the offering made by fire which ye shall offer unto the LORD ; two lambs of the first year without spot day by day, for a continual burnt offering.

rr: Ogume ohongye omwana gw'entaama gumwe omu kasheeshe, n'ogundi omu mwabazyo
en: The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning, and the other lamb shalt thou offer at even;

en: and a tenth part of an ephah of flour for a meat offering, mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil.

rr: Egyo n'empongano y'okwotsya ey'obutoosha, eyaaragiriirwe aha rushozi Sinai kuba ey'ekisoroora kirungi, empongano eyokiibwe omu muriro ehongyeirwe MUKAMA.
en: It is a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD .

rr: Kandi empongano y'eby'okunywa ey'okuhongwa n'omwana gw'entaama gumwe, eryaba ekicweka kimwe kya kana kya hiini. Omu mwanya ogurikwera nimwo origuma nooshuka empongano ya viinyo y'amaani, ebirikuhongyerwa MUKAMA.
en: And the drink offering thereof shall be the fourth part of an hin for the one lamb: in the holy place shalt thou cause the strong wine to be poured unto the LORD for a drink offering.

rr: Ogundi mwana gw'entaama oguhongye omu mwabazyo; oguhongye n'empongano yaagwo y'esaano n'ey'eby'okunywa nk'eby'omu kasheeshe, kuba empongano eyokiibwe omu muriro ey'ekisoroora ekirikushemeza MUKAMA.
en: And the other lamb shalt thou offer at even: as the meat offering of the morning, and as the drink offering thereof, thou shalt offer it , a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD .

rr: Aha izooba rya sabato muhongye empaya nto z'entaama ibiri, ezihikize omwaka ezitaine kamogo, hamwe n'ebicweka bibiri bya ikumi ebya eefa y'esaano y'obunono ejwangizemu amajuta n'empongano yaayo y'eby'okunywa
en: And on the sabbath day two lambs of the first year without spot, and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and the drink offering thereof:

en: this is the burnt offering of every sabbath, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.

rr: Aha kutandika kwa buri kwezi mugume muhongyere MUKAMA empongano y'okwotsya enimi z'ebimasha ibiri, n'empaya y'entaama emwe, kandi n'empaya nto z'entaama mushanju ezihikize omwaka ezitaine kamogo

rr: Omu kwezi kw'okubanza aha kiro kya ikumi na bina n'ekiro ky'Okuhinguraho kwa MUKAMA.
en: And in the fourteenth day of the first month is the passover of the LORD .

rr: mubihongye n'empongano zaabyo z'esaano n'ez'eby'okunywa ahabw'ezo nimi n'ezo mpaya z'entaama kandi n'abo baana b'entaama, nk'omubaro gwabyo oku guri, kandi nk'oku ebiragiro byabyo biri
en: and their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:

rr: kandi muhongye empaya y'embuzi kuba ekitambo ky'ekibi, mutabariireho kitambo ky'okwotsya eky'obutoosha n'empongano yaakyo y'esaano n'ez'eby'okunywa.
en: and one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.

rr: Aha kiro kya munaana mugume mugire okuteerana kw'okwecureeza; mutarikikoreraho omurimo gwona ogurikurusya
en: On the eighth day ye shall have a solemn assembly: ye shall do no servile work therein:

rr: kureka muhongye ekitambo ky'okwotsya, kuba empongano eyokiibwe omu muriro, ey'ekisooroora kirungi ahari MUKAMA; muhongye enimi emwe n'empaya y'entaama emwe, kandi n'empaya nto z'entaama mushanju ezihikize omwaka ezitaine kamogo
en: but ye shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD : one bullock, one ram, seven lambs of the first year without blemish:

rr: mubihongye n'empongano zaabyo z'esaano n'ez'eby'okunywa ahabw'egyo nimi n'egyo mpaya y'entaama, kandi n'abo baana b'entaama, nk'omubaro gwabyo oku guri, nk'oku ebiragiro byabyo biri
en: their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullock, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:

rr: kandi muhongye empaya y'embuzi kuba ekitambo ky'ekibi, mutabariireho ekyo kitambo ky'okwotsya eky'obutoosha n'empongano yaakyo ey'esaano n'ez'eby'okunywa.
en: and one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.

rr: Ebyo nibyo muriguma nimuhongyera MUKAMA omu biro by'amagyenyi gaanyu agaatairweho, kuba ebitambo byanyu by'okwotsya, n'empongano zaanyu z'esaano n'ez'eby'okunywa, kandi n'empongano zaanyu z'okusiima ahabw'obusingye, mutabariireho bi muhonga ahabw'ebi mwaraganiise n'ebi mutoija ahabw'okweyendera.
en: These things ye shall do unto the LORD in your set feasts, beside your vows, and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings, and for your meat offerings, and for your drink offerings, and for your peace offerings.

rr: Bwanyima Musa yaagambira Abaisraeli byona, nk'oku MUKAMA yaamuragiire.
en: And Moses told the children of Israel according to all that the LORD commanded Moses.

rr: Musa yaagambira abakuru b'enganda z'Abaisraeli ati: Eki nikyo kiragiro eki MUKAMA yaaragiira.
en: And Moses spake unto the heads of the tribes concerning the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the LORD hath commanded.

rr: Omuntu ku arihiga omu maisho ga MUKAMA, nari shi ku arirahira, yaayekwatiriza, atariita egyo ndahiro ye, kureka ahikiirize ekyamurugire omu kanwa kyona.
en: If a man vow a vow unto the LORD , or swear an oath to bind his soul with a bond; he shall not break his word, he shall do according to all that proceedeth out of his mouth.

rr: Kandi omwishiki ku arihiga omuhigo omu maisho ga MUKAMA, yaayekwatiriza, akiri omu ka ya ishe omu buhangare bwe
en: If a woman also vow a vow unto the LORD , and bind herself by a bond, being in her father's house in her youth;

rr: ishe yaahurira okuhiga kwe, n'okwekwatiriza kwe, yaamwetsiza, okuhiga kwe kwona n'okwekwatiriza kwe kwona n'endahiro biryahama.
en: and her father hear her vow, and her bond wherewith she hath bound her soul, and her father shall hold his peace at her: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand.

rr: Kwonka ishe ku aryanga ebi arikurahira aha izooba eri yaabihuririraho, ebi yaahiga byona, n'okwekwatiriza kwe tibirihama; kandi MUKAMA aryamusaasira, ahabw'okuba ishe yaamwangira.
en: But if her father disallow her in the day that he heareth; not any of her vows, or of her bonds wherewith she hath bound her soul, shall stand: and the LORD shall forgive her, because her father disallowed her.

rr: Kandi ku arishwerwa omushaija naakitegyekwa ebi yaahigire, nari shi akibohirwe endahiro ei yaarahiriire eryo
en: And if she had at all an husband, when she vowed, or uttered ought out of her lips, wherewith she bound her soul;

rr: iba yaabihurira, yaamwetsiza aha izooba eri yaabihuririraho, ebi yaahigire biryahama, n'ebi yaarahiire naayekwatiriza nabyo bihame.
en: and her husband heard it , and held his peace at her in the day that he heard it: then her vows shall stand, and her bonds wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.

rr: Kwonka iba ku arimwangira aha izooba eri yaabihuririraho, aryaba aihireho okuhiga kwe oku yaahigire, n'endahiro ei yaarahiriire eryo kurahira naayesinga; kandi MUKAMA aryamusaasira.
en: But if her husband disallowed her on the day that he heard it ; then he shall make her vow which she vowed, and that which she uttered with her lips, wherewith she bound her soul, of none effect: and the LORD shall forgive her.

rr: Kwonka omufaakazi nari omukazi oshenzirwe ku arihiga, eki yaahigire kyona, akarahira endahiro, naayekwatiriza, kiryamutukurira.
en: But every vow of a widow, and of her that is divorced, wherewith they have bound their souls, shall stand against her.

rr: Kandi ku ariba ahigiire omwa iba, nari ku ariba arahiire naayekwatiriza
en: And if she vowed in her husband's house, or bound her soul by a bond with an oath;

rr: iba yaabihurira, yaamwetsiza, ataamwangira, ebi yaahigire byona biryahama, n'ebi yaarahiire naayekwatiriza byona nabyo bihame.
en: and her husband heard it , and held his peace at her, and disallowed her not: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.

rr: Kwonka iba ku aribiihaho, yaabyanga aha izooba eri yaabihuririraho, ebyarugire omu kanwa ke naahiga, nari shi ebi yaarahiire naayekwatiriza, tibirihama, ahakuba iba aryaba abiihireho; kandi MUKAMA aryamusaasira.
en: But if her husband hath utterly made them void on the day he heard them; then whatsoever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand: her husband hath made them void; and the LORD shall forgive her.

rr: Okuhiga kwona n'endahiro yoona ei ogwo mukazi arirahira kwebonabonesa, iba aine obushoboorozi bw'okugihamya nari kugiihaho.
en: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.

rr: Kwonka iba ku arimara ebiro naamwetsiza, biri ahamize emihigo ye yoona n'endahiro ze zoona ezi yaarahiire naayekwatiriza; iba aryaba abihamize, ahakuba akamwetsiza aha izooba eri yaabihuririireho.
en: But if her husband altogether hold his peace at her from day to day; then he establisheth all her vows, or all her bonds, which are upon her: he confirmeth them, because he held his peace at her in the day that he heard them .

rr: Kwonka ku aribiihaho, amazire ebiro naabihurira, aryagiibwaho okutahikiirira kw'omukazi we.
en: But if he shall any ways make them void after that he hath heard them ; then he shall bear her iniquity.

rr: Ebyo nibyo biragiro ebi MUKAMA yaaragiire Musa, aha mushaija n'omukazi we, n'aha mushaija na muhara we, okiri empangare omu ka ya ishe.
en: These are the statutes, which the LORD commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between the father and his daughter, being yet in her youth in her father's house.

rr: MUKAMA yaagambira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Hoora Abamidiani, obahoorere Abaisraeli; bwanyima oryafa okurate abaanyu.
en: Avenge the children of Israel of the Midianites: afterward shalt thou be gathered unto thy people.

rr: Musa yaagambira abantu ati: Mutoorane abantu omuriimwe, mubahe eby'okurwanisa, bateere Midiani, babahoore enzigu ahabwa MUKAMA.
en: And Moses spake unto the people, saying, Arm some of yourselves unto the war, and let them go against the Midianites, and avenge the LORD of Midian.

rr: Omuri buri ruganda rw'enganda zoona eza Israeli mwihemu engabo rukumi, muzoohereze aha rugamba.
en: Of every tribe a thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, shall ye send to the war.

rr: Batyo omu nkumi z'Abaisraeli baatooranamu engabo rukumi-rukumi omuri buri ruganda, baihamu engabo kakumi n'enkumi ibiri eziine eby'okurwanisa.
en: So there were delivered out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.

rr: Musa yaaboohereza aha rugamba, rukumi omuri buri ruganda, hamwe na Finehaasi mwene Eleazaari omunyamurwa, baine ebintu by'Aharikwera n'enzamba z'okuhuruza.
en: And Moses sent them to the war, a thousand of every tribe, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the holy instruments, and the trumpets to blow in his hand.

rr: Baarwanisa Abamidiani, nk'oku MUKAMA yaaragiire Musa, baita abashaija boona.
en: And they warred against the Midianites, as the LORD commanded Moses; and they slew all the males.

rr: Kandi hamwe n'abo abaitsirwe, baitiranamu abagabe bataano ba Midiani, Evi, Rekemu, Zuuri, Huuri na Reeba, kandi na Balamu mwene Beori baamwitsa rurara.
en: And they slew the kings of Midian, beside the rest of them that were slain; namely , Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword.

rr: Abaisraeli baanyaga abakazi b'Abamidiani n'abaana baabo abato; n'ente zaabo zoona n'amasyo gaabo goona ag'entaama n'embuzi, n'ebintu byabo byona nabyo baabinyaga.
en: And the children of Israel took all the women of Midian captives, and their little ones, and took the spoil of all their cattle, and all their flocks, and all their goods.

rr: Kandi endembo zaabo zoona omu myanya ei baabaire batwiremu, n'ensiisira zaabo zoona baabyotsya.
en: And they burnt all their cities wherein they dwelt, and all their goodly castles, with fire.

rr: Baatabaarukana ebi baanyagire byona, abantu n'amatungo.
en: And they took all the spoil, and all the prey, both of men and of beasts.

rr: Enkwatwa n'eminyago n'ebintu baabireetera Musa na Eleazaari omunyamurwa n'eihanga ryona ery'Abaisraeli, ahu baabaire basiisiire omu mpita za Moabu haihi na Yorudani ahashungaine na Yeriko.
en: And they brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, unto Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and unto the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by Jordan near Jericho.

rr: Musa na Eleazaari n'abeebembezi boona ab'eihanga baashohora kubabugana aheeru y'orusiisira.
en: And Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went forth to meet them without the camp.

rr: Musa yaagwerwa kubi abakuru b'eihe, abeebembezi b'engabo rukumi-rukumi, n'aba igana-igana, abaabaire nibatabaaruka.
en: And Moses was wroth with the officers of the host, with the captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, which came from the battle.

rr: Musa yaababuuza ati: Abakazi boona mubarekire, timwabaita?
en: And Moses said unto them, Have ye saved all the women alive?

rr: Nimumanya ngu abo nibo baacumwize Abaisraeli ahari MUKAMA omu bya Peori, ahabw'okuhaburwa Balamu, kikareeta orufu omu ihanga rya MUKAMA.
en: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the LORD in the matter of Peor, and there was a plague among the congregation of the LORD .

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo hati mwite omwojo weena omu baana, na buri mukazi weena orabyamire n'omushaija.
en: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman that hath known man by lying with him.

rr: Kwonka abaishiki boona abatakabyamaga na bashaija, mubeetsigireho.
en: But all the women children, that have not known a man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.

rr: Bwanyima muteere amahema gaanyu aheeru y'orusiisira, mumareyo ebiro mushanju; oitsire omuntu weena, n'okozire aha muntu oitsirwe weena, mweshemeze aha kiro kya kashatu n'aha kya mushanju, imwe n'enkwatwa zaanyu.
en: And do ye abide without the camp seven days: whosoever hath killed any person, and whosoever hath touched any slain, purify both yourselves and your captives on the third day, and on the seventh day.

rr: Kandi mushemeze buri kijwaro kyona, n'ekintu kyona ekikozirwe omu mpu n'omu bwoya bw'embuzi, n'ekibaizire kyona.
en: And purify all your raiment, and all that is made of skins, and all work of goats' hair , and all things made of wood.

rr: Eleazaari omunyamurwa yaagambira engabo ezitabaarukire ati: Eki nikyo kiragiro eki MUKAMA aragiire Musa
en: And Eleazar the priest said unto the men of war which went to the battle, This is the ordinance of the law which the LORD commanded Moses;

rr: kwonka ezaabu, n'efeeza, n'emiringa, n'ebyoma, n'amabaati na rusasi
en: only the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,

rr: ekintu kyona ekitarikubaasa kusya, mukirabye omu muriro, kibone kushemera; kwonka kandi mukishemeze n'amaizi gari ag'okweza; kandi ekintu kyona ekirikubaasa kusya, mukirabye omuri ago maizi.
en: every thing that may abide the fire, ye shall make it go through the fire, and it shall be clean: nevertheless it shall be purified with the water of separation: and all that abideth not the fire ye shall make go through the water.

rr: Bwanyima aha kiro kya mushanju mwozye ebijwaro byanyu, mubone kushemera, mugarukye omu rusiisira.
en: And ye shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and ye shall be clean, and afterward ye shall come into the camp.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Iwe na Eleazaari omunyamurwa n'abakuru b'amaju ga baishenkuru b'eryo ihanga mubare eminyago enyagirwe, ey'abantu n'ey'amatungo
en: Take the sum of the prey that was taken, both of man and of beast, thou, and Eleazar the priest, and the chief fathers of the congregation:

rr: mubaganise egyo minyago omu bicweka bibiri, ekimwe mukihe abarwani abagiire aha rugamba, n'ekindi mukihe eihanga ryona.
en: and divide the prey into two parts; between them that took the war upon them, who went out to battle, and between all the congregation:

rr: Mwihe aha barwani abagiire omu rugamba ebi muraabacwere kuha MUKAMA, kimwe kya ikumi ahari magana ataano, eky'abantu, eky'ente, eky'endogoya, n'eky'amasho g'entaama
en: and levy a tribute unto the LORD of the men of war which went out to battle: one soul of five hundred, both of the persons, and of the beeves, and of the asses, and of the sheep:

rr: mubiihe aha mugabo gwabo, mubihe Eleazaari omunyamurwa kuba empongano ehongyeirwe MUKAMA.
en: take it of their half, and give it unto Eleazar the priest, for an heave offering of the LORD .

rr: Kandi aha mugabo gw'Abaisraeli mwiheho kimwe kya makumi ataano, eky'abantu, eky'ente, eky'endogoya, n'eky'amasyo g'entaama, nigo matungo goona, mubihe Abaleevi abarikurinda Obutaaho bwa MUKAMA.
en: And of the children of Israel's half, thou shalt take one portion of fifty, of the persons, of the beeves, of the asses, and of the flocks, of all manner of beasts, and give them unto the Levites, which keep the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD .

rr: Musa na Eleazaari omunyamurwa baakora nk'oku MUKAMA yaaragiire Musa.
en: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD commanded Moses.

rr: Eminyago eyaatsigaire ahari byona ebi abarwani baanyagire, ekaba eri entaama obusiriira mukaaga n'obukumi mushanju n'enkumi itaano
en: And the booty, being the rest of the prey which the men of war had caught, was six hundred thousand and seventy thousand and five thousand sheep,

rr: n'ente obukumi mushanju n'enkumi ibiri
en: and threescore and twelve thousand beeves,

rr: n'endogoya obukumi mukaaga na rukumi
en: and threescore and one thousand asses,

rr: kandi abaishiki boona abaabaire batakabyamaga n'abashaija bakaba bari obukumi bushatu n'enkumi ibiri.
en: and thirty and two thousand persons in all, of women that had not known man by lying with him.

rr: Ekicweka kyabyo, nigwo mugabo gw'abaagiire aha rugamba, kikaba kiri entaama obusiriira bushatu n'obukumi bushatu n'enkumi mushanju na magana ataano
en: And the half, which was the portion of them that went out to war, was in number three hundred thousand and seven and thirty thousand and five hundred sheep:

rr: ahari ezo ntaama, ekicweka ekyaihirweho kuba ekya MUKAMA, zikaba ziri entaama magana mukaaga na makumi mushanju na itaano.
en: and the LORD 's tribute of the sheep was six hundred and threescore and fifteen.

rr: Ente zikaba ziri obukumi bushatu n'enkumi mukaaga; ahari ezo ezaihirweho kuba eza MUKAMA zikaba ziri makumi mushanju na ibiri.
en: And the beeves were thirty and six thousand; of which the LORD 's tribute was threescore and twelve.

rr: Endogoya zikaba ziri obukumi bushatu na magana ataano; ahari ezo ezaihirweho kuba eza MUKAMA zikaba ziri makumi mukaaga n'emwe.
en: And the asses were thirty thousand and five hundred; of which the LORD 's tribute was threescore and one.

rr: Kandi n'abantu bakaba bari kakumi n'enkumi mukaaga; ahari abo abaihirweho kuba aba MUKAMA bakaba bari makumi ashatu na babiri.
en: And the persons were sixteen thousand; of which the LORD 's tribute was thirty and two persons.

rr: Musa yaaha Eleazaari omunyamurwa ebyo ebyaihirweho kuba empongano ehongyeirwe MUKAMA, nk'oku MUKAMA yaaragiire Musa.
en: And Moses gave the tribute, which was the LORD 's heave offering, unto Eleazar the priest, as the LORD commanded Moses.

rr: Ekicweka kyabyo eky'Abaisraeli, eki Musa yaihire aha by'abantu abaagiire omu rugamba
en: And of the children of Israel's half, which Moses divided from the men that warred,

rr: (Kandi omugabo gw'eihanga zikaba ziri entaama obusiriira bushatu n'obukumi bushatu n'enkumi mushanju na magana ataano
en: (now the half that pertained unto the congregation was three hundred thousand and thirty thousand and seven thousand and five hundred sheep,

rr: ente obukumi bushatu n'enkumi mukaaga
en: and thirty and six thousand beeves,

rr: n'endogoya obukumi bushatu na magana ataano
en: and thirty thousand asses and five hundred,

rr: kandi n'abantu kakumi n'enkumi mukaaga.)
en: and sixteen thousand persons;)

rr: ahari ogwo mugabo gw'Abaisraeli Musa yaihaho kimwe kya makumi ataano ky'abantu n'amatungo, yaabiha Abaleevi, abaabaire barinda Obutaaho bwa MUKAMA, nk'oku MUKAMA yaaragiire Musa.
en: even of the children of Israel's half, Moses took one portion of fifty, both of man and of beast, and gave them unto the Levites, which kept the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD ; as the LORD commanded Moses.

rr: Bwanyima abakuru abaabaire nibategyeka enkumi ez'omu ihe, n'abeebembezi ba rukumi-rukumi, n'aba igana-igana, baija ahari Musa, baamugira bati
en: And the officers which were over thousands of the host, the captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, came near unto Moses:

rr: -9 ; . Itwe abairu baawe, twabara engabo ezi turikutegyeka, twashanga hataine obuzire n'omwe.
en: and they said unto Moses, Thy servants have taken the sum of the men of war which are under our charge, and there lacketh not one man of us.

rr: Mbwenu tureeteire MUKAMA empongano aha bi buri muntu anyagire, ebintu by'obuguzi eby'ezaabu, emikuufu y'aha maguru, n'engoro z'aha mikono, n'empeta z'obumanyiso, n'ez'omu matu, kandi n'enkwanzi, eby'okurihiirira amagara gaitu omu maisho ga MUKAMA.
en: We have therefore brought an oblation for the LORD , what every man hath gotten, of jewels of gold, chains, and bracelets, rings, earrings, and tablets, to make an atonement for our souls before the LORD .

rr: Musa na Eleazaari omunyamurwa baayakiira ebyo bintu byona ebiheesirwe omu zaabu.
en: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of them, even all wrought jewels.

rr: Ezo zaabu zoona ez'empongano ei baahongyeire MUKAMA, ezaahongirwe abeebembezi b'engabo rukumi-rukumi, na igana-igana, zikaba ziri shekeli kakumi n'enkumi mukaaga na magana mushanju na makumi ataano.
en: And all the gold of the offering that they offered up to the LORD , of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels.

rr: (Ahabw'okuba buri murwani akaba aine ebi yaayenyagiire.)
en: ( For the men of war had taken spoil, every man for himself.)

rr: Musa na Eleazaari omunyamurwa baayakiira ezaabu z'abo beebembezi b'engabo rukumi-rukumi, na igana-igana, baazitwara omu Ihema ry'okubugaabuganiramu kuba ekiijutsyo ky'Abaisraeli omumaisho ga MUKAMA.
en: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tabernacle of the congregation, for a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD .

rr: Abareubeeni n'Abagaadi bakaba baine amatungo maingi munonga; ku baareebire ensi ya Yazeri n'ensi ya Gileadi ziri ensi z'amatungo
en: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that, behold, the place was a place for cattle;

rr: Abagaadi n'Abareubeeni baija, baagambira Musa na Eleazaari omunyamurwa n'abeebembezi b'eihanga bati
en: the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spake unto Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and unto the princes of the congregation, saying,

rr: Ataroosi, Diboni, Yazeri, Nimura, Heshibooni, Eleale, Shebamu, Neebo na Beoni
en: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Shebam, and Nebo, and Beon,

rr: ensi ei MUKAMA yaasingwire omu maisho g'Abaisraeli, n'ensi y'amatungo, kandi itwe abairu baawe tugaine.
en: even the country which the LORD smote before the congregation of Israel, is a land for cattle, and thy servants have cattle:

rr: Baagaruka baagira bati: Ku oraabe nootugirira embabazi, itwe abairu baawe tuheebwe egi nsi ebe eyaitu, otatwambutsya Yorudani.
en: wherefore, said they, if we have found grace in thy sight, let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession, and bring us not over Jordan.

rr: Musa yaabuuza Abagaadi n'Abareubeeni ati: Beene waanyu nibaija kuhurura, imwe mugume aha?
en: And Moses said unto the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben, Shall your brethren go to war, and shall ye sit here?

rr: Nimuhahaariza ki Abaisraeli emitima, ngu batambuka kuza omu nsi ei MUKAMA yaabahaire?
en: And wherefore discourage ye the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the LORD hath given them?

rr: Okwo nikwo baashoimwe baagizire, obu naabatuma kutata egyo nsi, tukiri Kadeshi-barunea
en: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to see the land.

rr: ahakuba, ku bainamukire omu ruhanga rwa Eshikooli, baareeba egyo nsi, baahahaaza Abaisraeli emitima, ngu bataza omu nsi ei MUKAMA yaabahaire.
en: For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the LORD had given them.

rr: MUKAMA yaabagirira ekiniga ekirikwaka nk'omuriro eryo izooba, yaarahira naagira ati
en: And the LORD 's anger was kindled the same time, and he sware, saying,

rr: Buzimazima tihariho n'omwe omuri aba bashaija abaarugire Misri, abahikize emyaka makumi abiri n'okukiraho, orireeba ensi ei naarahiire kuha Abrahamu na Isaaka na Yakobo; ahabw'okuba tibankuratiriire kimwe
en: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me:

rr: kureka Kalebu mwene Yefune Omukenizi, na Yoshua mwene Nuuni, ahakuba bo bankuratiriire kimwe.
en: save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, and Joshua the son of Nun: for they have wholly followed the LORD .

rr: MUKAMA yaagirira Abaisraeli ekiniga, yaabazengyereza omu ihamba okumara emyaka makumi ana, okuhitsya obu ab'obusingye obwo bwona, abaakozire ebirikwangwa MUKAMA, baahweireho.
en: And the LORD 's anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, that had done evil in the sight of the LORD , was consumed.

rr: Mbwenu reeba, naimwe mugarukire omu mwanya gwa baashoimwe, oruzaaro rw'enkozi z'ebibi, kugaruka kwongyera ekiniga kya MUKAMA, ku kiba kingi munonga aha Baisraeli.
en: And, behold, ye are risen up in your fathers' stead, an increase of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of the LORD toward Israel.

rr: Ahabw'okuba ku muraamurugyeho, mwayanga kumukuratira, naija kugaruka abatsigye omuri eri ihamba; haza naimwe mureetere eihanga eri ryona kucwekyerera.
en: For if ye turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and ye shall destroy all this people.

rr: Baamwirira haihi, baamugira bati: Nitwija kuzitirira amasyo gaitu, twombekyere abaana baitu endembo
en: And they came near unto him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones:

rr: Kwonka itwe twenka nitwija kukwata eby'okurwanisa, twebembere Abaisraeli, okuhitsya obu turibahitsya omu nsi yaabo; kandi abaana baitu baryaguma omuri ezi ndembo ezeehinguririziibwe engo z'amabaare ahabw'okwerinda abatwire omuri egi nsi.
en: but we ourselves will go ready armed before the children of Israel, until we have brought them unto their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fenced cities because of the inhabitants of the land.

rr: Titurigaruka mu maka gaitu, buri muntu omu Baisraeli atakatungire buhunguzi bwe
en: We will not return unto our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance.

rr: ahakuba tituriheebwa buhunguzi hamwe nabo seeri ya Yorudani kandi n'okweyongyerayo; ahabw'okuba obuhunguzi bwaitu tubuhairwe seenu ya Yorudani aha rubaju rw'oburugwa-izooba.
en: For we will not inherit with them on yonder side Jordan, or forward; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side Jordan eastward.

rr: Musa yaabagarukamu ati: Ku murikora ekyo, mwatwara eby'okurwanisa, mwahurura mwebembeire MUKAMA
en: And Moses said unto them, If ye will do this thing, if ye will go armed before the LORD to war,

rr: abashaija boona omuriimwe abaine eby'okurwanisa ku baryambuka Yorudani omu maisho ga MUKAMA, okuhitsya obu aribingira kimwe abazigu be omu maisho ge
en: and will go all of you armed over Jordan before the LORD , until he hath driven out his enemies from before him,

rr: ensi ekagomoorerwa MUKAMA, bwanyima muryagaruka mutaine rubanja omu maisho ga MUKAMA n'omu maisho g'Abaisraeli; kandi ensi egi eryaba eyaanyu omu maisho ga MUKAMA.
en: and the land be subdued before the LORD : then afterward ye shall return, and be guiltless before the LORD , and before Israel; and this land shall be your possession before the LORD .

rr: Kwonka ku muriba mutakozire mutyo, muryaba mucumwire ahari MUKAMA; kandi mumanyire kimwe ngu ekibi kyanyu kiryabahindukana.
en: But if ye will not do so, behold, ye have sinned against the LORD : and be sure your sin will find you out.

rr: Mbwenu mwombekyere abaana baanyu endembo, muzitirire entaama zaanyu, mukore ekyo eki mwagamba.
en: Build you cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth.

rr: Abagaadi n'Abareubeeni baagira Musa bati: Itwe abairu baawe turyakora nk'oku waaturagiira, mukama waitu.
en: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spake unto Moses, saying, Thy servants will do as my lord commandeth.

rr: Abaana baitu n'abakazi baitu n'entaama zaitu, kandi n'ente zaitu zoona biryaguma omu ndembo za Gileadi
en: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead:

rr: kwonka itwe twena abairu baawe abaine eby'okurwanisa turyayambuka, tuhurure twebembeire MUKAMA, nk'oku waagamba, mukama waitu.
en: but thy servants will pass over, every man armed for war, before the LORD to battle, as my lord saith.

rr: Bwanyima ebyabo Musa yaabiragiira Eleazaari omunyamurwa na Yoshua mwene Nuuni n'abakuru b'amaju ga baishenkuru b'enganda z'Abaisraeli.
en: So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel:

rr: Yaabagira ati: Abagaadi n'Abareubeeni ku baryambuka Yorudani naimwe, beebembeire MUKAMA kuhurura, buri muntu aine eby'okurwanisa bye, ensi yaagomoorwa omu maisho gaanyu, bwanyima muryabaha ensi ya Gileadi ebe eyaabo.
en: and Moses said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan, every man armed to battle, before the LORD , and the land shall be subdued before you; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:

rr: Kwonka ku bariba batambukire naimwe baine eby'okurwanisa, baryaheebwa naimwe obutaka omu nsi ya Kanaani.
en: but if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.

rr: Abagaadi n'Abareubeeni baagarukamu nibagira bati: Oku MUKAMA yaaragiira abairu baawe, nikwo turikora.
en: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As the LORD hath said unto thy servants, so will we do.

rr: Turyayambuka twine eby'okurwanisa, tuze omu nsi ya Kanaani twebembeire MUKAMA, obutaka bwaitu tugume nabwo seenu ya Yorudani.
en: We will pass over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan, that the possession of our inheritance on this side Jordan may be our's.

rr: Abagaadi n'Abareubeeni n'ekicweka ky'oruganda rwa Manaase mwene Yosefu, Musa yaabaha obugabe bwa Sihooni omugabe w'Abaamori, n'obwa Ogi omugabe wa Bashani, ensi n'endembo zaayo hamwe n'ebyanga ebihereraine nazo, endembo eziri omu nsi egyo yoona.
en: And Moses gave unto them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and unto half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, with the cities thereof in the coasts, even the cities of the country round about.

rr: Abagaadi baayombeka Diboni, Ataroosi, Aroeri
en: And the children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,

rr: Atiroosi-shofani, Yazeri, Yogibeha
en: and Atroth, Shophan, and Jaazer, and Jogbehah,

rr: Besi-nimura na Besi-harani; ezo ndembo baazeehinguririza engo z'amabaare, kandi baazitirira entaama zaabo.
en: and Beth-nimrah, and Beth-haran, fenced cities: and folds for sheep.

rr: Abareubeeni baayombeka Heshibooni, Eleale, Kiryasaimu
en: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kirjathaim,

rr: Neebo, Baalimeoni (baahindura amaziina gaazo) na Sibuma; endembo ezi baayombekire baazeeta agandi maziina.
en: and Nebo, and Baal-meon, (their names being changed,) and Shibmah: and gave other names unto the cities which they builded.

rr: Aba Makiri mwene Manaase baaza Gileadi, baagikwata, baabingamu Abaamori abaabaire batwiremu.
en: And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it, and dispossessed the Amorite which was in it.

rr: Musa yaaha Makiri mwene Manaase Gileadi, yaagituuramu.
en: And Moses gave Gilead unto Machir the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt therein.

rr: Na Yairi mwene Manaase yaakwata ebirorero byayo, yaabyeta Havosi-yairi.
en: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the small towns thereof, and called them Havoth-jair.

rr: Kandi na Nooba yaagyenda, yaakwata Kenaasi n'ebirorero byayo, yaagyeterera eiziina rye Nooba.
en: And Nobah went and took Kenath, and the villages thereof, and called it Nobah, after his own name.
