rr: Ezi nizo ndaariro z'Abaisraeli, obu baaruga Misri, nk'amahe gaabo oku gaabaire gari, beebembeirwe Musa na Arooni.
en: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt with their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.

rr: Musa yaahandiika endaariro zaabo, nk'oku zaabaire nizikuratana omu ngyendo zaabo naaragiirwa MUKAMA; mbwenu ezi nizo ndaariro zaabo nk'oku baagyenzire.
en: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of the LORD : and these are their journeys according to their goings out.

rr: Aha kiro kya ikumi na bitaano omu kwezi kw'okubanza bakaimutsya orugyendo, baaruga Rameseesi; Okuhingurwaho kuraire kuhweire, Abaisraeli baarugayo nibeemurika omu maisho g'Abanyamisri
en: And they departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the morrow after the passover the children of Israel went out with an high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians.

rr: baatsiga banu nibakiziika emijigaijo yaabo yoona, ei MUKAMA yaabaire abaitsiremu; kandi na baaruhanga baabo MUKAMA akaba abacwereire orubanja.
en: For the Egyptians buried all their firstborn, which the LORD had smitten among them: upon their gods also the LORD executed judgments.

rr: Abaisraeli baaruga Rameseesi, baasiisira Sukoosi.
en: And the children of Israel removed from Rameses, and pitched in Succoth.

rr: Baaruga Sukoosi, baasiisira Etamu eri aha rubaju rw'eihamba.
en: And they departed from Succoth, and pitched in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.

rr: Baaruga Etamu, baagaruka enyima, baaza Pihahiroosi, aharikureebana na Baali-zefooni, baasiisira omu maisho ga Migidooli.
en: And they removed from Etham, and turned again unto Pi-hahiroth, which is before Baal-zephon: and they pitched before Migdol.

rr: Baaruga ahu baabaire bari omu maisho ga Hahiroosi, baaraba omu nyanja, baahika omu ihamba; baagyenda orugyendo rw'ebiro bishatu omu ihamba rya Etamu, baasiisira Maara.
en: And they departed from before Pi-hahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, and went three days' journey in the wilderness of Etham, and pitched in Marah.

rr: Baaruga Maara, baahika Elimu; omuri Elimu hakaba harimu enshuro z'amaizi ikumi na ibiri, n'emikindo makumi mushanju; baasiisirayo.
en: And they removed from Marah, and came unto Elim: and in Elim were twelve fountains of water, and threescore and ten palm trees; and they pitched there.

rr: Baaruga Elimu, baasiisira aha rubaju rw'Enyanja erikutukura.
en: And they removed from Elim, and encamped by the Red sea.

rr: Baaruga aha Nyanja erikutukura, baasiisira omu ihamba rya Siini.
en: And they removed from the Red sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.

rr: Baaruga omu ihamba rya Siini, baasiisira Dofika.
en: And they took their journey out of the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.

rr: Baaruga Dofika, baasiisira Alushi.
en: And they departed from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.

rr: Baaruga Alushi, baasiisira Refidimu, ahu abantu baaburiire amaizi g'okunywa.
en: And they removed from Alush, and encamped at Rephidim, where was no water for the people to drink.

rr: Baaruga Refidimu, baasiisira omu ihamba rya Sinai.
en: And they departed from Rephidim, and pitched in the wilderness of Sinai.

rr: Baaruga omu ihamba rya Sinai, baasiisira Kibiroosi-hatava.
en: And they removed from the desert of Sinai, and pitched at Kibroth-hattaavah.

rr: Baaruga Kibiroosi-hatava, baasiisira Hazeroosi.
en: And they departed from Kibroth-hattaavah, and encamped at Hazeroth.

rr: Baaruga Hazeroosi, baasiisira Risima.
en: And they departed from Hazeroth, and pitched in Rithmah.

rr: Baaruga Risimai baasiisira Rimoni-pereezi.
en: And they departed from Rithmah, and pitched at Rimmon-parez.

rr: Baaruga Rimoni-pereezi, baasiisira Libuna.
en: And they departed from Rimmon-parez, and pitched in Libnah.

rr: Baaruga Libuna, baasiisira Risa.
en: And they removed from Libnah, and pitched at Rissah.

rr: Baaruga Risa, baasiisira Kehelaasa.
en: And they journeyed from Rissah, and pitched in Kehelathah.

rr: Baaruga Kehelaasa, baasiisira omu kibungo kya Sheferi.
en: And they went from Kehelathah, and pitched in mount Shapher.

rr: Baaruga omu kibungo kya Sheferi, baasiisira Harada.
en: And they removed from mount Shapher, and encamped in Haradah.

rr: Baaruga Harada, baasiisira Maki-heloosi.
en: And they removed from Haradah, and pitched in Makheloth.

rr: Baaruga Maki-heloosi, baasiisira Tahasi.
en: And they removed from Makheloth, and encamped at Tahath.

rr: Baaruga Tahasi, baasiisira Teera.
en: And they departed from Tahath, and pitched at Tarah.

rr: Baaruga Teera, baasiisira Misika.
en: And they removed from Tarah, and pitched in Mithcah.

rr: Baaruga Misika, baasiisira Hashimoona.
en: And they went from Mithcah, and pitched in Hashmonah.

rr: Baaruga Hashi-moona, baasiisira Moseroosi.
en: And they departed from Hashmonah, and encamped at Moseroth.

rr: Baaruga Moseroosi, baasiisira Bene-yakani.
en: And they departed from Moseroth, and pitched in Bene-jaakan.

rr: Baaruga Bene-yakani, baasiisira Hori-hagidigadi.
en: And they removed from Bene-jaakan, and encamped at Hor-hagidgad.

rr: Baaruga Hori-hagidigadi, baasiisira Yotibaasa.
en: And they went from Hor-hagidgad, and pitched in Jotbathah.

rr: Baaruga Yotibaasa, baasiisira Abiroona.
en: And they removed from Jotbathah, and encamped at Ebronah.

rr: Baaruga Abiroona, baasiisira Ezioni-geberi.
en: And they departed from Ebronah, and encamped at Ezion-geber.

rr: Baaruga Ezioni-geberi, baasiisira omu ihamba rya Ziini, niyo Kadeshi.
en: And they removed from Ezion-geber, and pitched in the wilderness of Zin, which is Kadesh.

rr: Baaruga Kadeshi, baasiisira aha rushozi Hoori aha mwatano gw'ensi ya Edomu.
en: And they removed from Kadesh, and pitched in mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.

rr: Arooni omunyamurwa yainamuka aha rushozi Hoori ahabw'ekiragiro kya MUKAMA, yaafeerayo omu mwaka gwa makumi ana Abaisraeli barugire omu nsi ya Misri, omu kwezi kwa kataano aha kiro ky'okubanza.
en: And Aaron the priest went up into mount Hor at the commandment of the LORD , and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the first day of the fifth month.

rr: Kandi Arooni akaba ahikize emyaka igana na makumi abiri n'eshatu, obu yaagwa aha rushozi Hoori.
en: And Aaron was an hundred and twenty and three years old when he died in mount Hor.

rr: Omunyakanaani omugabe wa Aradi, owaabaire atwire Negebu omu nsi ya Kanaani, yaahurira ngu Abaisraeli baizire.
en: And king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.

rr: Baaruga aha rushozi Hoori, baasiisira Zalumoona.
en: And they departed from mount Hor, and pitched in Zalmonah.

rr: Baaruga Zalumoona, baasiisira Punooni.
en: And they departed from Zalmonah, and pitched in Punon.

rr: Baaruga Punooni, baasiisira Obosi.
en: And they departed from Punon, and pitched in Oboth.

rr: Baaruga Obosi, baasiisira Iye-abariimu eri omu mwatano gwa Moabu.
en: And they departed from Oboth, and pitched in Ije-abarim, in the border of Moab.

rr: Baaruga Iyimu, baasiisira Diboni-gaadi.
en: And they departed from Iim, and pitched in Dibon-gad.

rr: Baaruga Diboni-gaadi, baasiisira Alimoni-dibulasaimu.
en: And they removed from Dibon-gad, and encamped in Almon-diblathaim.

rr: Baaruga Alimoni-dibulasaimu, baasiisira omu nshozi za Abariimu omu maisho ga Neebo.
en: And they removed from Almon-diblathaim, and pitched in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.

rr: Baaruga omu nshozi za Abariimu, baasiisira omu mpita za Moabu haihi na Yorudani ahashungaine na Yeriko.
en: And they departed from the mountains of Abarim, and pitched in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.

rr: Bwanyima baasiisira haihi na Yorudani okuruga Besi-yeshimooseveni okuhika Abeeli-shitimu omu mpita za Moabu. Ruhanga okuragiira Abaisraeli kubinga Abanyakanaani n'okumaraho ebishushani byabo ebirikuramibwa
en: And they pitched by Jordan, from Beth-jeshimoth even unto Abel-shittim in the plains of Moab. Division of Canaan

rr: MUKAMA yaagambirira Musa omu mpita za Moabu, haihi na Yorudani ahashungaine na Yeriko, ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,

rr: Gambira Abaisraeli oti: Ku muryambuka Yorudani, mwahika omu nsi ya Kanaani
en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye are passed over Jordan into the land of Canaan;

rr: -5 , 25 , 26 ; . mubingye abatuuzi boona ab'omuri egyo nsi, babarugye omumaisho, mucwekyereze ebishushani byabo byona ebibaizirwe omu mabaare, n'ebishushani byabo byona ebiheesire, kandi musheenye emyanya yaabo yoona emikuru ey'okuramizamu
en: then ye shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their pictures, and destroy all their molten images, and quite pluck down all their high places:

rr: mukubuure ensi, mugituuremu; ahabw'okuba niimwe ngihaire kuba eyaanyu.
en: and ye shall dispossess the inhabitants of the land, and dwell therein: for I have given you the land to possess it.

rr: Ensi egyo muryagihungura nimugiteerera enteenyu, nk'emiryango yaanyu oku eri; abaingi muryabaha obuhunguzi bwingi, n'abakye mubahe bukye; ahu enteenyu erikwatira omuntu, niho hariba ahakwe; muryagihungura nk'enganda za bashwenkuriimwe oku ziri.
en: And ye shall divide the land by lot for an inheritance among your families: and to the more ye shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer ye shall give the less inheritance: every man's inheritance shall be in the place where his lot falleth; according to the tribes of your fathers ye shall inherit.

rr: Kwonka ku muriba mutabingire abagitwiremu, mukabaiha omu maisho gaanyu, abumuritsigamu baryababeera ebirikucumita omu maisho, n'amahwa omu mbaju, babatuntuze omuri egyo nsi ei muriba mutwiremu.
en: But if ye will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you; then it shall come to pass, that those which ye let remain of them shall be pricks in your eyes, and thorns in your sides, and shall vex you in the land wherein ye dwell.

rr: Kandi oku naabaire niinyenda kubagira, naimwe nikwo ndibagira.
en: Moreover it shall come to pass, that I shall do unto you, as I thought to do unto them.

rr: Currently Selected: Okubara 33 : RR64 Highlight Share <path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M8 19c-2.828 0-4.243 0-5.121-.879C2 17.243 2 15.828 2 13v-2c0-2.828 0-4.243.879-5.121C3.757 5 5.172 5 8
MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Ragiira Abaisraeli oti: Ku murihika omu nsi ya Kanaani, (niyo nsi ei muriheebwa kuba obuhunguzi, nk'emyatano yaayo oku eri)
en: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land of Canaan; (this is the land that shall fall unto you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan with the coasts thereof:)

rr: ekicweka kyanyu eky'aha bukiizi-bwa-buryo kiryaruga aha ihamba rya Ziini, kirabe aha rubaju rwa Edomu, kandi omwatano gwanyu ogw'aha bukiizi-bwa-buryo guryatandikira aha Nyanja y'Omwonyo okwiha aha muheru gwayo aha bukiizi bw'oburugwa-izooba
en: then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the coast of Edom, and your south border shall be the outmost coast of the salt sea eastward:

rr: ogwo mwatano gwanyu gukiikame gutoore aha bukiizi-bwa-buryo aharikwinamuka Akarabiimu, gwogyemu guhikye Ziini, gugarukire aha rubaju rwa Kadeshi-barunea aha bukiizi bwayo obwa-buryo; gugumizemu, guhikye Hazari-adaari, gwogyemu guhikye Azimooni.
en: and your border shall turn from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass on to Zin: and the going forth thereof shall be from the south to Kadesh-barnea, and shall go on to Hazar-addar, and pass on to Azmon:

rr: Bwanyima gurugye Azimooni, gukiikame, guhikye aha kagyera ka Misri, gugarukire aha Nyanja Empango.
en: and the border shall fetch a compass from Azmon unto the river of Egypt, and the goings out of it shall be at the sea.

rr: Omwatano gwayo ogw'aha burengyerwa-izooba guryaba Enyanja Empango n'embaju zaayo; ogwo nigwo guriba omwatano gwanyu aha rubaju rw'oburengyerwa-izooba.
en: And as for the western border, ye shall even have the great sea for a border: this shall be your west border.

rr: N'ogu nigwo guriba omwatano gwanyu aha rubaju r'obukiizi-bwa-bumosho; okwiha aha Nyanja Empango muryataho omwatano guhikye aha rushozi Hoori.
en: And this shall be your north border: from the great sea ye shall point out for you mount Hor:

rr: Okuruga aha rushozi Hoori muteho omwatano guhikye ahu orikutaahira nooza Hamasi, gugarukire Zedadi.
en: from mount Hor ye shall point out your border unto the entrance of Hamath; and the goings forth of the border shall be to Zedad:

rr: Bwanyima omwatano gugumizemu guhikye Zifurooni, gugarukire Hazari-enani; ogwo gube nigwo gwaba omwatano gwanyu ogw'aha bukiizi-bwa-bumosho.
en: and the border shall go on to Ziphron, and the goings out of it shall be at Hazar-enan: this shall be your north border.

rr: Kandi muryataho omwatano gwanyu aha rubaju rw'oburugwa-izooba okuruga Hazari-enani okuhika Shefamu.
en: And ye shall point out your east border from Hazar-enan to Shepham:

rr: Gurugye Shefamu, gushuume, guhikye Ribula aha rubaju rwa Aini orw'oburugwa-izooba; gugumizemu gushuume, guhikye aha rubaju rw'enyanja ya Kinereesi oburugwa-izooba
en: and the coast shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall descend, and shall reach unto the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward:

rr: gugumizemu gushuume guhikye Yorudani, gugarukire aha Nyanja y'Omwonyo; egyo niyo eriba ensi yaanyu, nk'emyatano yaayo egyehinguririize oku eri.
en: and the border shall go down to Jordan, and the goings out of it shall be at the salt sea: this shall be your land with the coasts thereof round about.

rr: Musa yaaragiira Abaisraeli ati: Egi niyo nsi ei murihungura nimugiteerera enteenyu ei MUKAMA yaaragiire kuha enganda mwenda n'ekicweka
en: And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, This is the land which ye shall inherit by lot, which the LORD commanded to give unto the nine tribes, and to the half tribe:

rr: ahabw'okuba oruganda rwa Reubeeni nk'emiryango ya baishenkurubo oku eri, n'oruganda rwa Gaadi nk'emiryango ya baishenkurubo oku eri, n'ekicweka ky'oruganda rwa Manaase, baherize kuheebwa obuhunguzi bwabo.
en: for the tribe of the children of Reuben according to the house of their fathers, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to the house of their fathers, have received their inheritance ; and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance:

rr: Ezo nganda ibiri n'ekicweka ziherize kuheebwa obuhunguzi bwazo seenu ya Yorudani ahashungaine na Yeriko aha rubaju rw'oburugwa-izooba.
en: the two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side Jordan near Jericho eastward, toward the sunrising.

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Aga nigo maziina g'abantu abaribabaganisiza ensi kuba obuhunguzi bwanyu; Eleazaari omunyamurwa na Yoshua mwene Nuuni.
en: These are the names of the men which shall divide the land unto you: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.

rr: Kandi muryatoorana omwebembezi omwe omuri buri ruganda, babaganise ensi kuba obuhunguzi.
en: And ye shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land by inheritance.

rr: Amaziina gaabo n'aga; ow'oruganda rwa Yuda, Kalebu mwene Yefune
en: And the names of the men are these: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

rr: ow'oruganda rwa Simeoni, Shemueli mwene Amihuudi
en: And of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.

rr: ow'oruganda rwa Benyamiini Elidaadi mwene Kisilooni
en: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.

rr: ow'oruganda rwa Daani omwebembezi Buuki mwene Yogili
en: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Dan, Bukki the son of Jogli.

rr: owa beene Yosefu, ow'oruganda rwa Manaase, omwebembezi Hanieli mwene Efodi
en: The prince of the children of Joseph, for the tribe of the children of Manasseh, Hanniel the son of Ephod.

rr: ow'oruganda rwa Efuraimu omwebembezi Kemueli mwene Shifitaani
en: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Ephraim, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.

rr: ow'oruganda rwa Zebuluuni omwebembezi Elizafaani mwene Parinaaki
en: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Zebulun, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.

rr: ow'oruganda rwa Isakaari omwebembezi Palitieli mwene Azaani
en: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Issachar, Paltiel the son of Azzan.

rr: ow'oruganda rwa Asheri omwebembezi Ahihuudi mwene Shelomi
en: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Asher, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.

rr: ow'oruganda rwa Nafutaali omwebembezi Pedaheli mwene Amihuudi.
en: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Naphtali, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.

rr: Abo nibo MUKAMA yaaragiire kubaganisiza Abaisraeli obuhunguzi bwabo omu nsi ya Kanaani.
en: These are they whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance unto the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.

rr: MUKAMA yaagambirira Musa omu mpita za Moabu haihi na Yorudani ahashungaine na Yeriko, ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,

rr: Ragiira Abaisraeli bahe Abaleevi endembo z'okutuuramu, nibaziiha aha nsi yaabo ei bahungwire; kandi mubahe amariisizo ageehinguririize ezo ndembo.
en: Command the children of Israel, that they give unto the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in; and ye shall give also unto the Levites suburbs for the cities round about them.

rr: Ezo ndembo zibe ezaabo z'okutuuramu, n'amariisizo gabe ag'ente zaabo n'ebintu byabo, n'amatungo gaabo goona.
en: And the cities shall they have to dwell in; and the suburbs of them shall be for their cattle, and for their goods, and for all their beasts.

rr: Amariisizo ag'aha ndembo agu muriha Abaleevi, gatandikire aha ngo z'endembo, gahitsye entambwe magana ataano embaju zoona.
en: And the suburbs of the cities, which ye shall give unto the Levites, shall reach from the wall of the city and outward a thousand cubits round about.

rr: Aheeru y'orurembo aha rubaju rw'oburugwa-izooba mugyere entambwe rukumi, aha rubaju rw'obukiizi-bwa-buryo entambwe rukumi, aha rubaju rw'oburengyerwa-izooba entambwe rukumi, kandi n'aha rubaju rw'obukiizi-bwa-bumosho entambwe rukumi, orurembo rugume ahagati. Ago gabe nigo gaaba mariisizo g'aha ndembo zaabo.
en: And ye shall measure from without the city on the east side two thousand cubits, and on the south side two thousand cubits, and on the west side two thousand cubits, and on the north side two thousand cubits; and the city shall be in the midst: this shall be to them the suburbs of the cities.

rr: Endembo ezi muriha Abaleevi zibe endembo mukaaga ez'okuhungiramu, oriita omuntu weena azihungiremu; kandi ahari ezo mukaaga mwongyereho ezindi makumi ana na ibiri.
en: And among the cities which ye shall give unto the Levites there shall be six cities for refuge, which ye shall appoint for the manslayer, that he may flee thither: and to them ye shall add forty and two cities.

rr: Endembo zoona ezi muriha Abaleevi zibe makumi ana na munaana; muzibahe hamwe n'amariisizo gaazo.
en: So all the cities which ye shall give to the Levites shall be forty and eight cities: them shall ye give with their suburbs.

rr: Endembo ezi muriiha aha butaka bw'Abaisraeli kuha Abaleevi, abaingi muryabaihaho nyingi, n'abakye mubaiheho nkye. Buri ruganda nk'obuhunguzi bwarwo oku buri, nikwo ruribaha aha ndembo zaarwo. Endembo z'okuhungiramu
en: And the cities which ye shall give shall be of the possession of the children of Israel: from them that have many ye shall give many; but from them that have few ye shall give few: every one shall give of his cities unto the Levites according to his inheritance which he inheriteth. Cities of Refuge

rr: MUKAMA yaagira Musa ati
en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

rr: Gambira Abaisraeli oti: Ku muryambuka Yorudani, mwahika omu nsi ya Kanaani
en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come over Jordan into the land of Canaan;

rr: muryayetooranira endembo zibe ezaanyu z'okuhungiramu, oitsire omuntu weena, atamwitsire nkana, ahungiremu.
en: then ye shall appoint you cities to be cities of refuge for you; that the slayer may flee thither, which killeth any person at unawares.

rr: Ezo ndembo ziryababeera obuhungiro bw'okukiriramu omuhoozi w'enzigu, oriba aitsire omuntu arekye kufa, atakeemereire mu maisho g'omutwe gw'abakuru kucwerwa orubanja.
en: And they shall be unto you cities for refuge from the avenger; that the manslayer die not, until he stand before the congregation in judgment.

rr: Kandi ezo ndembo ezi muriha, nizo ziriba endembo zaanyu mukaaga ez'okuhungiramu.
en: And of these cities which ye shall give six cities shall ye have for refuge.

rr: Muryaha endembo ishatu seenu ya Yorudani, n'ezindi ishatu omu nsi ya Kanaani, zibe endembo z'okuhungiramu.
en: Ye shall give three cities on this side Jordan, and three cities shall ye give in the land of Canaan, which shall be cities of refuge.

rr: Ezo ndembo zoona mukaaga ziryaba obuhungiro bw'Abaisraeli n'obw'abanyamahanga n'obw'abariba babashuhuukiiremu, oriita omuntu weena, atamwitsire nkana, ahungiremu.
en: These six cities shall be a refuge, both for the children of Israel, and for the stranger, and for the sojourner among them: that every one that killeth any person unawares may flee thither.

rr: Kwonka ku arimuteeza ekyoma, yaafa, biri n'omwitsi; kandi omwitsi ataribura kwitwa.
en: And if he smite him with an instrument of iron, so that he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

rr: Nari ku arimuteera eibaare, eri aine omu ngaro, eririkubaasa kwita omuntu, yaafa, biri n'omwitsi; kandi omwitsi ataribura kwitwa.
en: And if he smite him with throwing a stone, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

rr: Nari shi, ku arimuteeza ekiti kibaizire eki akwaitse omu ngaro, ekirikubaasa kwita omuntu, yaafa, biri n'omwitsi; kandi omwitsi ataribura kwitwa.
en: Or if he smite him with an hand weapon of wood, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

rr: Orikuhoorera nyakufa niwe ariyeitira oitsire omuntu; ku arimureeba, amwite.
en: The revenger of blood himself shall slay the murderer: when he meeteth him, he shall slay him.

rr: 2 Kandi oitsire omuntu, ku ariba amucumitsire ahabw'okumwanga, nari aine eki yaamurekyeire, akamuteera amugwereire, akafa
en: But if he thrust him of hatred, or hurl at him by laying of wait, that he die;

rr: nari shi amuteire entomi ahabw'okumwanga, yaagwa ahansi, yaafa, owaamuteire ataribura kwitwa; biri n'omwitsi; orikuhoorera nyakufa aite ogwo mwitsi, ku arimureeba.
en: or in enmity smite him with his hand, that he die: he that smote him shall surely be put to death; for he is a murderer: the revenger of blood shall slay the murderer, when he meeteth him.

rr: Kwonka ku arihikiirirwa, yaacumita omuntu atamwineho rwango, nari yaagira eki yaamuteera, atamugwereire
en: But if he thrust him suddenly without enmity, or have cast upon him any thing without laying of wait,

rr: nari shi ku arimuteera eibaare eririkubaasa kwita omuntu atamureebire, yaarimuteera, yaafa, kandi ashangirwe atari muzigu we, kandi atarikwenda kumukora kubi
en: or with any stone, wherewith a man may die, seeing him not, and cast it upon him, that he die, and was not his enemy, neither sought his harm:

rr: obwo omutwe gw'abakuru guryacwera omwitsi n'orikuhoorera eshagama orubanja, nk'ebiragiro ebyo oku biri
en: then the congregation shall judge between the slayer and the revenger of blood according to these judgments:

rr: abo bakuru bakize oitsire omuntu orikumuhoorera nyakufa, bamugarure omu rurembo rw'obuhungiro, oru abaire ahungiiremu, arugumemu okuhitsya obu omunyamurwa omukuru, owaashukirweho amajuta g'okushoroora, arifa.
en: and the congregation shall deliver the slayer out of the hand of the revenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to the city of his refuge, whither he was fled: and he shall abide in it unto the death of the high priest, which was anointed with the holy oil.

rr: Kwonka ogwo muntu oitsire ondiijo ku arirenga omwatano gw'orurembo rw'obuhungiro, oru ahungiiremu
en: But if the slayer shall at any time come without the border of the city of his refuge, whither he was fled;

rr: orikuhoorera eshagama yaamushanga aheeru y'orwo rurembo rw'obuhungiro, yaamwita, tarigiibwaho rubanja rw'eshagama ye
en: and the revenger of blood find him without the borders of the city of his refuge, and the revenger of blood kill the slayer; he shall not be guilty of blood:

rr: ahakuba ogwo akaabaire agumire omu rurembo rw'obuhungiro bwe, okuhitsya ahu omunyamurwa omukuru arifeera; kwonka omunyamurwa omukuru ku ariheza kufa, ogwo oitsire omuntu agarukye omu butaka bwe.
en: because he should have remained in the city of his refuge until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the slayer shall return into the land of his possession.

rr: Ebyo bigume bibabeere ebiragiro n'emitwarize ebitairweho omu busingye bwanyu bwona n'omu maka gaanyu goona.
en: So these things shall be for a statute of judgment unto you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

rr: Oriita omuntu weena aryaitwa ahabwa baamushinja, kwonka atariitwa ahabwa mushinja omwe.
en: Whoso killeth any person, the murderer shall be put to death by the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any person to cause him to die.

rr: Kandi mutaryakiira eky'okucungura oitsire omuntu, oshemereire kwitwa; kureka omuntu ogwo buzimazima aryaitwa.
en: Moreover ye shall take no satisfaction for the life of a murderer, which is guilty of death: but he shall be surely put to death.

rr: Kandi mutariikiriza ekarabo y'omuntu ohungiire omu rurembo rw'obuhungiro, ngu agarukye kutuura omu nsi, omunyamurwa omukuru atakafiire.
en: And ye shall take no satisfaction for him that is fled to the city of his refuge, that he should come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.

rr: -12 ; 9:6 ; . Ku muritwaza mutyo, timurishiisha nsi ei murituuramu; ahabw'okuba eshagama niyo eshiisha ensi, kandi tihariho ky'okurihiirira ensi, ahabw'eshagama eyaagisheeshekireho, kureka eshagama y'ogwo owaagijwisize.
en: So ye shall not pollute the land wherein ye are: for blood it defileth the land: and the land cannot be cleansed of the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it.

rr: Mutarishiisha ensi ei mutwiremu, ei ntuuramu ahagati; ahabw'okuba nyowe MUKAMA ntuura ahagati y'Abaisraeli.
en: Defile not therefore the land which ye shall inhabit, wherein I dwell: for I the LORD dwell among the children of Israel.

rr: Currently Selected: Okubara 35 : RR64 Highlight Share <path d="M5 12a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h3a1 1 0 1 1 0 2H6a1 1 0 0 1-1-1ZM5 15a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h3a1 1 0 1 1 0 2H6a1 1

Abakuru b'amaju ga baishenkurubo ag'emiryango ya beene Gileadi mwene Makiri, mwene Manaase, ab'omu miryango ya beene Yosefu, bairira haihi, baagambira omu maisho ga Musa n'abeebembezi n'abakuru b'amaju ga baishenkuru b'Abaisraeli
en: And the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spake before Moses, and before the princes, the chief fathers of the children of Israel:

rr: nibagira bati: MUKAMA akakuragiira, iwe mukama waitu, kubaganisa ensi n'enteenyu noogiha Abaisraeli kuba obuhunguzi; kandi, mukama waitu, okaragiirwa MUKAMA kuha bahara ba Zelofehaadi mwene waitu obuhunguzi bwe.
en: and they said, The LORD commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel: and my lord was commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters.

rr: Kwonka ku barishwerwa abuntu b'omu nganda ezindi ez'Abaisraeli, obuhunguzi bwabo buryaihwa aha buhunguzi bwa baatatenkuriitwe, bwongyerwe aha buhunguzi bw'enganda ezi barishwerwamu; n'ahabw'ekyo buryaba bwihirwe aha mugabo gw'obuhunguzi bwaitu.
en: And if they be married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers, and shall be put to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall it be taken from the lot of our inheritance.

rr: Kandi omwaka gwa jubili y'Abaisraeli ku gurihika, obuhunguzi buryayongyerwa aha buhunguzi bw'oruganda oru baashweirwemu; n'ahabw'ekyo obuhunguzi bwabo buryaihirwa kimwe aha buhunguzi bw'oruganda rwa baatatenkuriitwe.
en: And when the jubile of the children of Israel shall be, then shall their inheritance be put unto the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.

rr: Musa yaaragiira Abaisraeli nk'ekigambo kya MUKAMA oku kyabaire kiri, naagira ati: Ebi oruganda rwa beene Yosefu rurikufa n'eby'amazima.
en: And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of the LORD , saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph hath said well.

rr: Eki nikyo MUKAMA arikuragiira aha bya bahara ba Zelofehaadi, ati: Mubarekye bagume bashwerwe abu barisiima; kwonka bashwerwe omu muryango gw'oruganda rwa baishenkurubo.
en: This is the thing which the LORD doth command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them marry to whom they think best; only to the family of the tribe of their father shall they marry.

rr: Hatarigira obuhunguzi bw'Abaisraeli obwaruga omu ruganda bukaza omurundi; kureka buri muntu omu Baisraeli agume omu buhunguzi bw'oruganda rwa baishenkuru.
en: So shall not the inheritance of the children of Israel remove from tribe to tribe: for every one of the children of Israel shall keep himself to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.

rr: Kandi omwishiki weena, oriheebwa obuhunguzi omu ruganda rw'Abaisraeli, ashwerwe ow'omu muryango gw'oruganda rwa baishenkuru, buri muntu ow'omu Baisraeli abone kuheebwa obuhunguzi bwa baishenkuru.
en: And every daughter, that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel, shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may enjoy every man the inheritance of his fathers.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo tiharibaho buhunguzi obwaruga omu ruganda bukaza omu rundi; ahakuba buri ruganda omu nganda z'Abaisraeli ruryagumya obuhunguzi bwarwo.
en: Neither shall the inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe; but every one of the tribes of the children of Israel shall keep himself to his own inheritance.

rr: Bwanyima bahara ba Zelofehaadi baakora, nk'oku MUKAMA yaaragiira Musa
en: Even as the LORD commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad:

rr: ahakuba Maala, Tiruza, Hogula, Milika na Noa, bahara ba Zelofehaadi, bakashwerwa batabani ba baishentobo.
en: for Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married unto their father's brothers' sons:

rr: Baashwerwa ab'omu miryango ya beene Manaase, mwene Yosefu; obuhunguzi bwabo bwaguma omu ruganda rw'omuryango gwa ishebo.
en: and they were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.

rr: Ebyo nibyo biragiro n'emitwarize ebyatairweho, ebi MUKAMA yaaragiire Abaisraeli naaraba omuri Musa, bari omu mpita za Moabu haihi na Yorudani, ahashungaine na Yeriko.
en: These are the commandments and the judgments, which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses unto the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.

1 The vision of Obadiah. Thus saith the Lord GOD concerning Edom; We have heard a rumour from the LORD , and an ambassador is sent among the heathen, Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle.

rr: 2 Reeba, niinyija kukugira mukye omu mahanga
en: 2 Behold, I have made thee small among the heathen: thou art greatly despised.

rr: 3 Amaryo g'omu mutima gwawe gakubeihire
en: 3 The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee, thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high; that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?

rr: 4 N'obu oraatumbiikye eiguru nk'eishamba
en: 4 Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle, and though thou set thy nest among the stars, thence will I bring thee down, saith the LORD .
5 If thieves came to thee, if robbers by night, (how art thou cut off!) would they not have stolen till they had enough? if the grapegatherers came to thee, would they not leave some grapes?

rr: 6 Eshi Esau anyagirwe
en: 6 How are the things of Esau searched out! how are his hidden things sought up!

7 All the men of thy confederacy have brought thee even to the border: the men that were at peace with thee have deceived thee, and prevailed against thee; they that eat thy bread have laid a wound under thee: there is none understanding in him.
8 Shall I not in that day, saith the LORD , even destroy the wise men out of Edom, and understanding out of the mount of Esau?
9 And thy mighty men , O Teman, shall be dismayed, to the end that every one of the mount of Esau may be cut off by slaughter.
10 For thy violence against thy brother Jacob shame shall cover thee, and thou shalt be cut off for ever.

11 In the day that thou stoodest on the other side, in the day that the strangers carried away captive his forces, and foreigners entered into his gates, and cast lots upon Jerusalem, even thou wast as one of them.

12 But thou shouldest not have looked on the day of thy brother in the day that he became a stranger; neither shouldest thou have rejoiced over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction; neither shouldest thou have spoken proudly in the day of distress.

rr: 13 Okaba otashemereire kutaaha omu irembo ry'abantu bangye
en: 13 Thou shouldest not have entered into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity; yea, thou shouldest not have looked on their affliction in the day of their calamity, nor have laid hands on their substance in the day of their calamity;

rr: 14 Okaba otashemereire kwemerera omu ntaaniro z'emihanda
en: 14 neither shouldest thou have stood in the crossway, to cut off those of his that did escape; neither shouldest thou have delivered up those of his that did remain in the day of distress.
15 For the day of the LORD is near upon all the heathen: as thou hast done, it shall be done unto thee: thy reward shall return upon thine own head.
16 For as ye have drunk upon my holy mountain, so shall all the heathen drink continually, yea, they shall drink, and they shall swallow down, and they shall be as though they had not been.
17 But upon mount Zion shall be deliverance, and there shall be holiness; and the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions.

18 And the house of Jacob shall be a fire, and the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble, and they shall kindle in them, and devour them; and there shall not be any remaining of the house of Esau; for the LORD hath spoken it .

19 And they of the south shall possess the mount of Esau; and they of the plain the Philistines: and they shall possess the fields of Ephraim, and the fields of Samaria: and Benjamin shall possess Gilead.

20 And the captivity of this host of the children of Israel shall possess that of the Canaanites, even unto Zarephath; and the captivity of Jerusalem, which is in Sepharad, shall possess the cities of the south.
21 And saviours shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau; and the kingdom shall be the LORD 's.

rr: 1 Nyowe Paulo, embohe ahabwa Kristo Yesu na Timoseo ow'eishe-emwe, twakuhandiikira, iwe Filemooni omukozi mugyenzi waitu orikukundwa
en: 1 Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy our brother, unto Philemon our dearly beloved, and fellowlabourer,
2 and to our beloved Apphia, and Archippus our fellowsoldier, and to the church in thy house:

rr: 3 nitubendeza embabazi n'obusingye ebirikuruga ahari Ruhanga Tataitwe na Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo.
en: 3 grace to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

rr: 4 Obutoosha nsiima Ruhanga wangye, ku nkwijuka omu kushaba kwangye
en: 4 I thank my God, making mention of thee always in my prayers,

rr: 5 ahabw'okuhurira okukunda kwawe oku oine aha barikwera boona, n'okwikiriza oku oine ahari Mukama waitu Yesu
en: 5 hearing of thy love and faith, which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all saints;

rr: 6 kandi nkushabira ngu okukwatanisa n'abandi eby'okwikiriza kwawe kwongyere omuribo okuhsoborokyerwa ebirungi byona ebi twine omuri Kristo.
en: 6 that the communication of thy faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus.
7 For we have great joy and consolation in thy love, because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by thee, brother.

rr: 8 N'ahabw'ekyo, n'obu ndaabe nyine obumanzi bwingi omuri Kristo kukuragiira kukora ekihikire
en: 8 Wherefore, though I might be much bold in Christ to enjoin thee that which is convenient,

rr: 9 kwonka ahabwa rukundo naihamu kukweshengyereza, nyowe Paulo omugurusi kandi hati embohe ahabwa Kristo Yesu.
en: 9 yet for love's sake I rather beseech thee , being such an one as Paul the aged, and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.
10 I beseech thee for my son Onesimus, whom I have begotten in my bonds:

rr: 11 Ira akaba atakwiniire mugasho, kwonka hati n'ow'omugasho buzima ahariiwe n'ahariinye.
en: 11 which in time past was to thee unprofitable, but now profitable to thee and to me:

rr: 12 Naamukugarurira, nk'owaakugarurira orura rwangye buzima.
en: 12 whom I have sent again: thou therefore receive him, that is, mine own bowels:
13 whom I would have retained with me, that in thy stead he might have ministered unto me in the bonds of the gospel:
14 but without thy mind would I do nothing; that thy benefit should not be as it were of necessity, but willingly.

rr: 15 Shana akaaba yaakurugireho omwanya mukye, ngu abone kugaruka kuguma naiwe ebiro byona
en: 15 For perhaps he therefore departed for a season, that thou shouldest receive him for ever;
16 not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much more unto thee, both in the flesh, and in the Lord?

rr: 17 N'ahabw'ekyo ku oraabe noonyenta mugyenzi waawe, omwakiire nk'oku waakuunyakiire.
en: 17 If thou count me therefore a partner, receive him as myself.

rr: 18 Kandi ku araabe yaakushaagiize, nari aine eibanja ryawe, obe niinye waihuza.
en: 18 If he hath wronged thee, or oweth thee ought, put that on mine account;

rr: 19 Nyowe, Paulo, niinye naahandiika ebi n'omukono gwangye, nti, Ndyariihura; ndekye kusiiba ninkugambira nti, naiwe oine eibanja ryangye; eibanja ryangye eryo n'amagara gaawe.
en: 19 I Paul have written it with mine own hand, I will repay it : albeit I do not say to thee how thou owest unto me even thine own self besides.

rr: 20 Eego Ow'eishe-emwe, ka ntungye okushemererwa ahariiwe omuri Mukama. Oruhuure omutima gwangye omuri Kristo.
en: 20 Yea, brother, let me have joy of thee in the Lord: refresh my bowels in the Lord.

rr: 21 Naakuhandiikira nyesigire okworoba kwawe, kandi nimmanya ngu nangwa oryakora ebirikukira ebi naagamba.
en: 21 Having confidence in thy obedience I wrote unto thee, knowing that thou wilt also do more than I say.

rr: 22 Kandi ekindi onteguurire aha'okuraara, ahabw'okuba nyine amatsiko ngu nimwija kundeeba ahabw'okushaba kwanyu.
en: 22 But withal prepare me also a lodging: for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you.
23 There salute thee Epaphras, my fellowprisoner in Christ Jesus;

rr: 24 kandi na Mako, Aristariiko, Deema na Luka, abakozi bagyenzi bangye.
en: 24 Marcus, Aristarchus, Demas, Lucas, my fellowlabourers.

rr: 25 Embabazi za Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo zigume n'emyoyo yaanyu.
en: 25 The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.

rr: 1 Nyowe Paulo na Timoseo, abahuuku ba Kristo Yesu, twabahandiikira, imwe abarikwera boona omuri Kristo Yesu, abatwire Filipi hamwe n'abareeberezi n'abadiikoni
en: 1 Paul and Timotheus, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:

rr: 2 nitubendeza ahari Ruhanga Tataitwe na Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo.
en: 2 grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
3 I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,

rr: 4 kandi omu kushaba kwangye kwona okw'obutoosha mbashabira mwena n'okushemererwa
en: 4 always in every prayer of mine for you all making request with joy,

rr: 5 ahabw'okuba mukakwatanisa naanye omu kubuzya engiri okwiha ahu mwatandikiire n'okuhitsya hati.
en: 5 for your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now;
6 being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:

rr: 7 Kandi kinshemereire kubateekateekaho ntyo mwena, ahakuba muntuura aha mutima, kandi mwena mukwataniise naanye omu mbabazi za Ruhanga, omu kubohwa kandi n'omu kurwanirira engiri kwangye n'okugihamya.
en: 7 even as it is meet for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart; inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, ye all are partakers of my grace.
8 For God is my record, how greatly I long after you all in the bowels of Jesus Christ.

rr: 9 Kandi eki ndikubashabira n'eki, ngu okukunda kwanyu kugume kweyongyere kikanya omu kumanya n'okwetegyereza kwona
en: 9 And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment;
10 that ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ;
11 being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by Jesus Christ, unto the glory and praise of God.

rr: 12 Niinyenda kubamanyisa, B'eishe-emwe, ngu ebyambaireho bikaija kwongyera kubuzya engiri
en: 12 But I would ye should understand, brethren, that the things which happened unto me have fallen out rather unto the furtherance of the gospel;
13 so that my bonds in Christ are manifest in all the palace, and in all other places ;

rr: 14 kandi ab'eishe-emwe abarikukira obwingi kyabareetera kuhama omuri Mukama ahabw'okubohwa kwangye, baayeyongyera kugira obumanzi bw'okugamba ekigambo kya Ruhanga bataine bwoba.
en: 14 and many of the brethren in the Lord, waxing confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.

rr: 15 N'ekya buzima abamwe nibagamba Kristo ahabw'eihari n'empaka, kwonka abandi nibamugamba n'omutima murungi
en: 15 Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife; and some also of good will:

rr: 16 abo babuurira Kristo ahabw'okukunda, nibamanya ngu ndi aha ahabw'okurwana aha ngiri
en: 16 the one preach Christ of contention, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to my bonds:

rr: 17 kwonka abandi tibarikumugamba mu mazima, kureka okurwanira orubaju rwabo, nibagira ngu nibaija kuunyongyera obusaasi omu kubohwa kwangye.
en: 17 but the other of love, knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel.

rr: 18 Mbwenu ninfa ki? Kizima omu buryo bwona, yaaba mu buryarya, yaaba omu mazima, Kristo naagambwa; ekyo nikyo ndikushemerererwa, kandi ndyakishemerererwa.
en: 18 What then? notwithstanding, every way, whether in pretence, or in truth, Christ is preached; and I therein do rejoice, yea, and will rejoice.

rr: 19 Ahakuba nimmanya ngu, ahabw'okushaba kwanyu n'okuhwerwa Omwoyo wa Yesu Kristo ekyo kiryandugiramu okujunwa
en: 19 For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer, and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

20 according to my earnest expectation and my hope, that in nothing I shall be ashamed, but that with all boldness, as always, so now also Christ shall be magnified in my body, whether it be by life, or by death.

rr: 21 ahakuba ahariinye okugumaho ni Kristo, n'okufa n'enshaagi
en: 21 For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

rr: 22 kwonka ebyangye yaaba kugumaho omu mubiri, nikyo kirikanyisa ebyana omu murimo gwangye. Nyowe tindikumanya ki nshemereire kutooranaho.
en: 22 But if I live in the flesh, this is the fruit of my labour: yet what I shall choose I wot not.
23 For I am in a strait betwixt two, having a desire to depart, and to be with Christ; which is far better:

rr: 24 Kwonka shi ahabwanyu okugumaho omu mubiri nikyo kirikwetengwa.
en: 24 nevertheless to abide in the flesh is more needful for you.

rr: 25 Ahabw'okwetegyereza ekyo, nimmanya ngu niinyija kugumaho, ntuure naimwe mwena, mubone kweyongyera omumaisho omu kwikiriza kandi n'okukushemerererwamu
en: 25 And having this confidence, I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith;

rr: 26 okwehimbisa kwanyu kubone kukanya omuri Kristo Yesu ahabwangye, ku ndiba naagarukire owaanyu.
en: 26 that your rejoicing may be more abundant in Jesus Christ for me by my coming to you again.

27 Only let your conversation be as it becometh the gospel of Christ: that whether I come and see you, or else be absent, I may hear of your affairs, that ye stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel;

rr: 28 kandi mutarikutiinisibwa bazigu omu kigambo kyona; ekyo n'akamanyiso k'okuhwerekyerera aharibo akarikumanywa, kwonka ahariimwe n'ak'okujunwa kwanyu akarikuruga ahari Ruhanga.
en: 28 and in nothing terrified by your adversaries: which is to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that of God.

rr: 29 Ahakuba timurahairwe kwikiriza Kristo kwonka, kureka n'okubonabonesibwa ahabwe
en: 29 For unto you it is given in the behalf of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer for his sake;
30 having the same conflict which ye saw in me, and now hear to be in me.

rr: 1 Ku haraabe hariho okugumibwa omuri Kristo, nari lihuumurizana okurikuruga omuri rukundo, nari okukwatanisa omu Mwoyo, nari embabazi n'esaasi
en: 1 If there be therefore any consolation in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any bowels and mercies,

rr: 2 muhikiirize okushemererwa kwangye ahabw'okugira omutima gumwe omu kukundana, nimwikirizana n'omutima gumwe.
en: 2 fulfil ye my joy, that ye be likeminded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind.
3 Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.
4 Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.

rr: 5 Mugire omutima guri ogwabaire guri omuri Kristo Yesu.
en: 5 Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:
6 who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God:
7 but made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:
8 and being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross.
9 Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:
10 that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth;

rr: 11 kandi endimi zoona zaature ku Yesu Kristo ari Mukama, Ruhanga Tataitwe ahimbisibwe.
en: 11 and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

rr: 12 N'ahabw'ekyo, abarikukundwa, nk'oku mwabaire mworoba obutoosha, na mbwenu mube nikwo mwahikiiriza okujunwa kwanyu mwine obwoba n'okutetema, t'obu ndiho bwonka, kureka okukira munonga n'obu ntariho
en: 12 Wherefore, my beloved, as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.

rr: 13 ahakuba Ruhanga niwe akorera omuriimwe, akabaha okukunda ebi asiima n'okubikora.
en: 13 For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.

rr: 14 Mukore byona mutarikwetomboita, mutaine mpaka
en: 14 Do all things without murmurings and disputings:
15 that ye may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom ye shine as lights in the world;
16 holding forth the word of life; that I may rejoice in the day of Christ, that I have not run in vain, neither laboured in vain.
17 Yea, and if I be offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy, and rejoice with you all.
18 For the same cause also do ye joy, and rejoice with me.

rr: 19 Nyine amatsiko omuri Mukama waitu Yesu kubatumaho juba Timoseo, naanye nkaagarukwa omutima omunda, naamanya eby'owaanyu.
en: 19 But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timotheus shortly unto you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state.

rr: 20 Ahakuba tiinyine ondiijo nkawe, orita omutima munonga aha byanyu.
en: 20 For I have no man likeminded, who will naturally care for your state.
21 For all seek their own, not the things which are Jesus Christ's.

rr: 22 kwonka omugasho gwa Timoseo nimugumanya; nk'oku omwana akorera ishe, nikwo yaakozire naanye omu kubuzya engiri.
en: 22 But ye know the proof of him, that, as a son with the father, he hath served with me in the gospel.

rr: 23 N'ahabw'ekyo ogwo niwe nyine amatsiko kwohereza ahonaaho, naaheza kureeba ebyangye oku byaba
en: 23 Him therefore I hope to send presently, so soon as I shall see how it will go with me.

rr: 24 kandi niinyesiga Mukama ngu naanye niinyija kwija juba.
en: 24 But I trust in the Lord that I also myself shall come shortly.
25 Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, and companion in labour, and fellowsoldier, but your messenger, and he that ministered to my wants.

rr: 26 ahabw'okuba kabagirira orushusho mwena; kandi yaashaasha ahabw'okuba mukahurira ku yaabaire arwaire.
en: 26 For he longed after you all, and was full of heaviness, because that ye had heard that he had been sick.

rr: 27 Kandi n'ekya buzima akaba arwaire, ari haihi kufa. Kwonka Ruhanga akamugirira embabazi, kandi tiwe yaazigiriire wenka, naanye akazingirira, ngu obusaasi burekye kuntembekyeranaho.
en: 27 For indeed he was sick nigh unto death: but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.

rr: 28 Nikyo nteereireho omutima kumubooherereza, ngu mushemererwe ahabw'okugaruka kumureeba, kandi naanye obusaasi bwangye butuube.
en: 28 I sent him therefore the more carefully, that, when ye see him again, ye may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.
29 Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness; and hold such in reputation:

rr: 30 ahakuba kaba ari haihi kufa ahabw'omurimo gwa Kristo, ayogire amagara ge, ngu abone kuhikiiriza eby'okumpwera kwanyu.
en: 30 because for the work of Christ he was nigh unto death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward me.
1 Finally, my brethren, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not grievous, but for you it is safe.
2 Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision.
3 For we are the circumcision, which worship God in the spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh.
4 Though I might also have confidence in the flesh. If any other man thinketh that he hath whereof he might trust in the flesh, I more:

rr: 5 Nkasharwa aha kiro kya munaana, ndi ow'omu ihanga rya Israeli, ow'omu ruganda rwa Benyamiini, Omuheburaayo enzaarwa, omu by'Ebiragiro ndi Omufarisaayo
en: 5 circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, an Hebrew of the Hebrews; as touching the law, a Pharisee;

rr: 6 omu by'obweziriki nkahiiga ekanisa; omu kuhikiirira okw'okukwata Ebiragiro nkaba ntaine ki ndikugaywaho.
en: 6 concerning zeal, persecuting the church; touching the righteousness which is in the law, blameless.
7 But what things were gain to me, those I counted loss for Christ.

rr: 8 kandi buzima byona nimbibara nke'bifiire, ahabw'okuba okumanya Kristo Yesu Mukama wangye nikubikira munonga. Ahabw'Ogwo nkafeerwa byona, naabibara nk'eshaabo, ngu mbone kutunga Kristo
en: 8 Yea doubtless, and I count all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them but dung, that I may win Christ,
9 and be found in him, not having mine own righteousness, which is of the law, but that which is through the faith of Christ, the righteousness which is of God by faith:
10 that I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, being made conformable unto his death;
11 if by any means I might attain unto the resurrection of the dead.

rr: 12 Tindikugira ngu mperize kukitunga, nari shi ngu mperize kuhikiirizibwa; kwonka ningumizamu, ngu naanye nkwate ekyo eki Kristo Yesu yankwatiire.
en: 12 Not as though I had already attained, either were already perfect: but I follow after, if that I may apprehend that for which also I am apprehended of Christ Jesus.

rr: 13 B'eishe-emwe, tindikweteekateekaho ngu naaherize kukikwata; kureka eki ndikukora ni kimwe; niinyebwa eby'enyima, ninkununkirira eby'omumaisho
en: 13 Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do , forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before,
14 I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

rr: 15 N'ahabw'ekyo itwe abahikiriire twena oku turikwingana, tuteekateekye tutyo; kandi ku muraateekateekye okundi aha kintu kyona, nakyo Ruhanga aryakibashuuruurira.
en: 15 Let us therefore, as many as be perfect, be thus minded: and if in any thing ye be otherwise minded, God shall reveal even this unto you.

rr: 16 Kwonka amazima agu tuhikiremu, tube nigo twagyenderamu.
en: 16 Nevertheless, whereto we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule, let us mind the same thing.
17 Brethren, be followers together of me, and mark them which walk so as ye have us for an ensample.

rr: 18 Ahakuba hariho baingi, abu naabagambiireho kaingi, na mbwenu ningaruka kubagambira nindira, nti, batuura bari abazigu b'omusharaba gwa Kristo
en: 18 (For many walk, of whom I have told you often, and now tell you even weeping, that they are the enemies of the cross of Christ:

rr: 19 emperu yaabo n'okuhwerekyerera, ruhanga waabo n'enda yaabo, nibeehimbisiza omu birikuhemura, emitima yaabo bagitaire aha by'ensi.
en: 19 whose end is destruction, whose God is their belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things.)
20 For our conversation is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ:
21 who shall change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto his glorious body, according to the working whereby he is able even to subdue all things unto himself.
1 Therefore, my brethren dearly beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand fast in the Lord, my dearly beloved.

rr: 2 Ninteisa Eodia, kandi ninteisa na Suntuke, ngu baikirizane omuri Mukama.
en: 2 I beseech Euodias, and beseech Syntyche, that they be of the same mind in the Lord.
3 And I intreat thee also, true yokefellow, help those women which laboured with me in the gospel, with Clement also, and with other my fellowlabourers, whose names are in the book of life.

rr: 4 Mushemererwe obutoosha omuri Mukama; kandi ningaruka kugira nti: Mugume mushemererwe.
en: 4 Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.
5 Let your moderation be known unto all men. The Lord is at hand.
6 Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
7 And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.

rr: 8 Eky'aha muheru, B'eishe-emwe, byona eby'amazima, byona ebishemereire kuheebwa ekitiinisa, byona eby'oburyo, byona ebishemeire, byona ebirikushemeza, byona ebirikusiimwa, ku haraabe hariho oburungi, ku haraabe hariho ebishemereire kuhimbisibwa, mube nibyo mwateekateekaho.
en: 8 Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.
9 Those things, which ye have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you.

rr: 10 Ninshemererwa munonga omuri Mukama, ahakuba mbwenu aha muheru gwa byona mugarukire kuunyijuka; kandi n'ekya buzima mukaba nimuunyijuka, kwonka mukabura omwanya.
en: 10 But I rejoiced in the Lord greatly, that now at the last your care of me hath flourished again; wherein ye were also careful, but ye lacked opportunity.
11 Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content.
12 I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.
13 I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.

rr: 14 Kwonka mukakora gye kukwatanisa naanye omu busaasi bwangye.
en: 14 Notwithstanding ye have well done, that ye did communicate with my affliction.
15 Now ye Philippians know also, that in the beginning of the gospel, when I departed from Macedonia, no church communicated with me as concerning giving and receiving, but ye only.

rr: 16 Ahakuba n'omuri Tesalonika mukantwekyera eby'okumpwera, kandi ti rimwe, ni kabiri.
en: 16 For even in Thessalonica ye sent once and again unto my necessity.

rr: 17 Ti kugira ngu ninkunda ebiconco, kureka niinyenda ngu ebyana byanyu byeyongyere, kandi bibabariwe.
en: 17 Not because I desire a gift: but I desire fruit that may abound to your account.
18 But I have all, and abound: I am full, having received of Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you, an odour of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, wellpleasing to God.

rr: 19 Kandi Ruhanga wangye aryamara obukyene bwanyu bwona, nk'obutungi bw'ekitiinisa kye omuri Kristo Yesu oku buri.
en: 19 But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.

rr: 20 Ruhanga waitu Tataitwe aheebwe ekitiinisa ebiro n'ebiro. Amiina.
en: 20 Now unto God and our Father be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

rr: 21 Muramutsye orikwera weena omuri Kristo Yesu. Ab'eishe-emwe abari kunu baabaramutsya.
en: 21 Salute every saint in Christ Jesus. The brethren which are with me greet you.

rr: 22 Abarikwera boona, okukira munonga ab'omu kikaari kya Kaisaari, baabaramutsya.
en: 22 All the saints salute you, chiefly they that are of Cæsar's household.

rr: 23 Embabazi za Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo zigume n'emyoyo yaanyu.
en: 23 The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
1 The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel;

rr: 2 Ez'okumanyisa obwengye n'okuhabura
en: 2 To know wisdom and instruction;
3 To receive the instruction of wisdom,

rr: 4 Okuhaisa otaine bwengye okwerinda
en: 4 To give subtilty to the simple,

rr: 5 Ngu omunyabwengye ahurire, ayeyongyere kwega
en: 5 A wise man will hear, and will increase learning;
6 To understand a proverb, and the interpretation;
7 The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge:

rr: 8 Mwana wangye, guma ohurire ebi sho arikukuhabura
en: 8 My son, hear the instruction of thy father,
9 For they shall be an ornament of grace unto thy head,

rr: 10 Mwana wangye, abasiisi ku barikubeihabeiha
en: 10 My son, if sinners entice thee,

rr: 11 Ku barigira ngu, Ija tugyendane, tugwere ab'okwita
en: 11 If they say, Come with us, let us lay wait for blood,
12 Let us swallow them up alive as the grave;

rr: 13 Turyagwa aha bintu by'obuguzi bwingi
en: 13 We shall find all precious substance,

rr: 14 Mbwenu kwatanisa naitwe
en: 14 Cast in thy lot among us;
15 My son, walk not thou in the way with them;
16 For their feet run to evil,

rr: 17 Manya, okutega omutego enyonyi neegureeba
en: 17 Surely in vain the net is spread

rr: 18 Kwonka abo bantu baba nibagwera eshagama yaabo bonak
en: 18 And they lay wait for their own blood;

rr: 19 Niyo mihanda y'abo boona abagira omururu gw'amagoba
en: 19 So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain;
20 Wisdom crieth without;

rr: 21 Naayetera aha mutwe gw'engo z'amabaare z'orurembo
en: 21 She crieth in the chief place of concourse, in the openings of the gates:

rr: 22 Imwe abataine bwengye, muryahitsya hi okukunda okutagira bwengye?
en: 22 How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity?
23 Turn you at my reproof:
24 Because I have called, and ye refused;
25 But ye have set at nought all my counsel,
26 I also will laugh at your calamity;

rr: 27 Ekirikubatiinisa ku kiriija nk'eihunga
en: 27 When your fear cometh as desolation,
28 Then shall they call upon me, but I will not answer;
29 For that they hated knowledge,
30 They would none of my counsel:
31 Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way,
32 For the turning away of the simple shall slay them,
33 But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely,

rr: 1 Mwana wangye, ku oraikirize ebigambo byangye
en: 1 My son, if thou wilt receive my words,

rr: 2 Waatega okutu kwawe obwengye
en: 2 So that thou incline thine ear unto wisdom,

rr: 3 Eego, ku oriririra obwengye bw'okukyenga
en: 3 Yea, if thou criest after knowledge,

rr: 4 Waakusherura nk'efeeza
en: 4 If thou seekest her as silver,

rr: 5 Obwo nibwo orishoborokyerwa okutiina MUKAMA
en: 5 Then shalt thou understand the fear of the LORD ,
6 For the LORD giveth wisdom:
7 He layeth up sound wisdom for the righteous:
8 He keepeth the paths of judgment,

rr: 9 Obwo oryamanya okuhikiirira n'eby'oburyo
en: 9 Then shalt thou understand righteousness, and judgment,

rr: 10 Ahabw'okuba obwengye buryataaha omu mutima gwawe
en: 10 When wisdom entereth into thine heart,
11 Discretion shall preserve thee,

rr: 12 Kukwihe omu mihanda y'obubi
en: 12 To deliver thee from the way of the evil man ,
13 Who leave the paths of uprightness,
14 Who rejoice to do evil,
15 Whose ways are crooked,
16 To deliver thee from the strange woman,
17 Which forsaketh the guide of her youth,
18 For her house inclineth unto death,

rr: 19 Abaza owe tibagaruka
en: 19 None that go unto her return again,

rr: 20 N'ahabw'ekyo oshemereire kugyendera omu mihanda y'abarungi
en: 20 That thou mayest walk in the way of good men ,
21 For the upright shall dwell in the land,
22 But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth,
1 My son, forget not my law;
2 For length of days, and long life,
3 Let not mercy and truth forsake thee:
4 So shalt thou find favour and good understanding
5 Trust in the LORD with all thine heart;
6 In all thy ways acknowledge him,
7 Be not wise in thine own eyes:

rr: 8 Kiryaba eky'okutambira omubiri gwawe
en: 8 It shall be health to thy navel,
9 Honour the LORD with thy substance,
10 So shall thy barns be filled with plenty,
11 My son, despise not the chastening of the LORD ;

rr: 12 Ahakuba ou MUKAMA akunda, amuhana
en: 12 For whom the LORD loveth he correcteth;

rr: 13 Ohiiriirwe n'omuntu ozoora obwengye
en: 13 Happy is the man that findeth wisdom,
14 For the merchandise of it is better than the merchandise of silver,

rr: 15 N'obw'obuguzi bwingi okukira amabaare g'omuhendo
en: 15 She is more precious than rubies:
16 Length of days is in her right hand;

rr: 17 Emihanda yaabwo n'emihanda erikugwisa gye
en: 17 Her ways are ways of pleasantness,
18 She is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her:
19 The LORD by wisdom hath founded the earth;
20 By his knowledge the depths are broken up,

rr: 21 Mwana wangye, guma n'obwengye obuhikire, n'okwerinda
en: 21 My son, let not them depart from thine eyes:
22 So shall they be life unto thy soul,
23 Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely,
24 When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid:
25 Be not afraid of sudden fear,

rr: 26 Ahabw'okuba MUKAMA aryaba obwesigye bwawe
en: 26 For the LORD shall be thy confidence,
27 Withhold not good from them to whom it is due,
28 Say not unto thy neighbour, Go, and come again,

rr: 29 Otarigirira mutaahi waawe enaama mbi
en: 29 Devise not evil against thy neighbour,

rr: 30 Otaritonganisiza busha omuntu weean
en: 30 Strive not with a man without cause,
31 Envy thou not the oppressor,
32 For the froward is abomination to the LORD :
33 The curse of the LORD is in the house of the wicked:
34 Surely he scorneth the scorners:
35 The wise shall inherit glory:

rr: 1 Baana bangye, mugume mutegye amatu okwegyesa kwa shoimwe
en: 1 Hear, ye children, the instruction of a father,

rr: 2 Ahabw'okuba nimbaha ebiragiro birungi
en: 2 For I give you good doctrine,

rr: 3 Ku naabaire ndi omwana, ndi hamwe na tata
en: 3 For I was my father's son,
4 He taught me also, and said unto me,
5 Get wisdom, get understanding:
6 Forsake her not, and she shall preserve thee:

rr: 7 Obwengye n'ekintu kikuru; gira obwengye
en: 7 Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom:
8 Exalt her, and she shall promote thee:
9 She shall give to thine head an ornament of grace:

rr: 10 Mwana wangye, hurira ebigambo byangye, kandi obiikirize
en: 10 Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings;

rr: 11 Nkakwegyesa oku oraatungye obwengye
en: 11 I have taught thee in the way of wisdom;
12 When thou goest, thy steps shall not be straitened;

rr: 13 Hamya ebi oyegyesiibwe, otaribireka
en: 13 Take fast hold of instruction; let her not go:
14 Enter not into the path of the wicked,

rr: 15 Ogume ogwetantare, orekye kugurabamu
en: 15 Avoid it, pass not by it,
16 For they sleep not, except they have done mischief;

rr: 17 Ahabw'okuba barya eby'okurya by'obubi
en: 17 For they eat the bread of wickedness,
18 But the path of the just is as the shining light,
19 The way of the wicked is as darkness:

rr: 20 Mwana wangye, ta omutima aha bigambo byangye
en: 20 My son, attend to my words;

rr: 21 Otaribireka bikakuruga omumaisho
en: 21 Let them not depart from thine eyes;
22 For they are life unto those that find them,
23 Keep thy heart with all diligence;

rr: 24 Yete hare akanwa akarikugamba eby'okwehabagiza
en: 24 Put away from thee a froward mouth,
25 Let thine eyes look right on,
26 Ponder the path of thy feet,
27 Turn not to the right hand nor to the left:

rr: 1 Mwana wangye, ta omutima aha bwengye bwangye
en: 1 My son, attend unto my wisdom,
2 That thou mayest regard discretion,
3 For the lips of a strange woman drop as an honeycomb,
4 But her end is bitter as wormwood,
5 Her feet go down to death;

rr: 6 Tayeta ha muhanda gw'amagara.
en: 6 Lest thou shouldest ponder the path of life,

rr: 7 Mbwenu baana bangye, mumpurire
en: 7 Hear me now therefore, O ye children,

rr: 8 Mwetantarire hare
en: 8 Remove thy way far from her,

rr: 9 Otakaaha ekitiniisa kyawe abandi
en: 9 Lest thou give thine honour unto others,

rr: 10 Abanyamahanga batakaakumaramu amaani
en: 10 Lest strangers be filled with thy wealth;

rr: 11 Kandi aha muheru gw'amagara gaawe okaborooga
en: 11 And thou mourn at the last,
12 And say, How have I hated instruction,

rr: 13 Tindahuriire bi abashomesa bangye bangambiire
en: 13 And have not obeyed the voice of my teachers,

rr: 14 Nkaba ndi haihi kufeera kimwe
en: 14 I was almost in all evil
15 Drink waters out of thine own cistern,

rr: 16 Beitu shi, enshuro zaawe zishemereire kumaamagizibwa oku n'oku
en: 16 Let thy fountains be dispersed abroad,
17 Let them be only thine own,
18 Let thy fountain be blessed:
19 Let her be as the loving hind and pleasant roe;
20 And why wilt thou, my son, be ravished with a strange woman,
21 For the ways of man are before the eyes of the LORD ,
22 His own iniquities shall take the wicked himself,
23 He shall die without instruction;
1 My son, if thou be surety for thy friend,

rr: 2 Bwanyima waashanga ogwire omu mutego omu bi ogambire
en: 2 Thou art snared with the words of thy mouth,
3 Do this now, my son, and deliver thyself,
4 Give not sleep to thine eyes,
5 Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand of the hunter ,
6 Go to the ant, thou sluggard;
7 Which having no guide,
8 Provideth her meat in the summer,

rr: 9 Iwe mweremwa 'we, oryabyama ohitsye hi?
en: 9 How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard?
10 Yet a little sleep, a little slumber,

rr: 11 Kwonka omanye obworo ku burikwizira nk'omunyagi
en: 11 So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth,

rr: 12 Omuntu otaine mugasho, omuntu omubi
en: 12 A naughty person, a wicked man,
13 He winketh with his eyes, he speaketh with his feet,

rr: 14 Ateekateeka enaama mbi omu mutima ogurikwehabagiza
en: 14 Frowardness is in his heart, he deviseth mischief continually;
15 Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly;

rr: 16 Hariho ebintu mukaaga, nangwa ni mushanju
en: 16 These six things doth the LORD hate:
17 A proud look, a lying tongue,
18 An heart that deviseth wicked imaginations,
19 A false witness that speaketh lies,

rr: 20 Mwana wangye, ogume oyorobere ebiragiro bya sho
en: 20 My son, keep thy father's commandment,
21 Bind them continually upon thine heart,
22 When thou goest, it shall lead thee;
23 For the commandment is a lamp; and the law is light;

rr: 24 Okukurinda omukazi mubi
en: 24 To keep thee from the evil woman,
25 Lust not after her beauty in thine heart;
26 For by means of a whorish woman a man is brought to a piece of bread:
27 Can a man take fire in his bosom,

rr: 28 Nari omuntu akaabaasa kugyendera aha makara garikwotsya
en: 28 Can one go upon hot coals,

rr: 29 Nikwo ari atyo oza ahari muka mutaahi we
en: 29 So he that goeth in to his neighbour's wife;

rr: 30 Abantu tibagaya mushuma
en: 30 Men do not despise a thief, if he steal
31 But if he be found, he shall restore sevenfold;
32 But whoso committeth adultery with a woman lacketh understanding:

rr: 33 Eki aihayo n'obuhuta n'okuhemuka
en: 33 A wound and dishonour shall he get;
34 For jealousy is the rage of a man:

rr: 35 Taikiriza kuhongyerwa kwona
en: 35 He will not regard any ransom;

rr: 1 Mwana wangye, rinda ebigambo byangye
en: 1 My son, keep my words,
2 Keep my commandments, and live;
3 Bind them upon thy fingers,

rr: 4 Gira Bwengye oti: Niiwe munyaanyazi
en: 4 Say unto wisdom, Thou art my sister;
5 That they may keep thee from the strange woman,

rr: 6 Ahakuba nkaringuririza
en: 6 For at the window of my house
7 And beheld among the simple ones,

rr: 8 Naaraba omu nguuto eririkuraba haihi n'akeekubo k'aha nju y'ogwo mukazi
en: 8 Passing through the street near her corner;
9 In the twilight, in the evening,

rr: 10 Kandi reeba ogwo mukazi yaamubugana
en: 10 And, behold, there met him a woman
11 (She is loud and stubborn;

rr: 12 Obumwe aza omu nguuto, obundi omu katare
en: 12 Now is she without, now in the streets,

rr: 13 Ku yamureebire, yaamukwata, yaamunywegyera
en: 13 So she caught him, and kissed him,
14 I have peace offerings with me;

rr: 15 Nikyo naizira hati kukubugana
en: 15 Therefore came I forth to meet thee,
16 I have decked my bed with coverings of tapestry,
17 I have perfumed my bed

rr: 18 Ija tuhikiirize okukundana kwaitu, burugyeho busheeshe
en: 18 Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning:

rr: 19 Ahakuba ibanye tarimu
en: 19 For the goodman is not at home,

rr: 20 Atwaire enshaho y'empiiha
en: 20 He hath taken a bag of money with him,
21 With her much fair speech she caused him to yield,

rr: 22 Ahonaaho yaamukurata
en: 22 He goeth after her straightway,
23 Till a dart strike through his liver;

rr: 24 Mbwenu baana bangye, mutegye amatu
en: 24 Hearken unto me now therefore, O ye children,

rr: 25 Otaikiriza omutima gwawe kuhungutukira omu mihanda ye
en: 25 Let not thine heart decline to her ways,
26 For she hath cast down many wounded:
27 Her house is the way to hell,
1 Doth not wisdom cry?

rr: 2 Ayemereire aha mutwe gw'ebibungo
en: 2 She standeth in the top of high places, by the way

rr: 3 Aha rubaju rw'amarembo omu maisho g'orurembo
en: 3 She crieth at the gates, at the entry of the city,

rr: 4 Imwe bashaija 'mwe, manya niimwe ndikweta
en: 4 Unto you, O men, I call;

rr: 5 Imwe abataine bwengye, mwegye okwerinda
en: 5 O ye simple, understand wisdom:

rr: 6 Muhurire, ahabw'okuba ebi naaza kubagambira ni bikuru
en: 6 Hear; for I will speak of excellent things;
7 For my mouth shall speak truth;

rr: 8 Ebigambo by'omu kanwa kangye byona bihikiriire
en: 8 All the words of my mouth are in righteousness;
9 They are all plain to him that understandeth,
10 Receive my instruction, and not silver;

rr: 11 Ahabw'okuba obwengye nibukira amabaare g'obuguzi bwingi
en: 11 For wisdom is better than rubies;

rr: 12 Nyowe Bwengye, okwerinda nkakugira obutaaho bwangye
en: 12 I wisdom dwell with prudence,
13 The fear of the LORD is to hate evil:
14 Counsel is mine, and sound wisdom:
15 By me kings reign,

rr: 16 Ahabwangye abanyiginya bategyeka
en: 16 By me princes rule,
17 I love them that love me;
18 Riches and honour are with me;
19 My fruit is better than gold, yea, than fine gold;

rr: 20 Ngyendera omu mihanda y'okuhikiirira
en: 20 I lead in the way of righteousness,

rr: 21 Ngu mbone kutungisa abarikunkunda
en: 21 That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance;
22 The LORD possessed me in the beginning of his way,
23 I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning,

rr: 24 Okuzimu etakabaireho nkoorekwa butunu
en: 24 When there were no depths, I was brought forth;

rr: 25 Enshozi zitakahangirwe
en: 25 Before the mountains were settled,

rr: 26 Ruhanga atakahangire nsi n'obwerere
en: 26 While as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields,

rr: 27 Obu yaataho eiguru, nkaba ndiho
en: 27 When he prepared the heavens, I was there:
28 When he established the clouds above:
29 When he gave to the sea his decree,
30 Then I was by him, as one brought up with him:
31 Rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth;
32 Now therefore hearken unto me, O ye children:

rr: 33 Muhurire ebi ndikubahabura
en: 33 Hear instruction, and be wise,
34 Blessed is the man that heareth me,
35 For whoso findeth me findeth life,
36 But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul:
1 Wisdom hath builded her house,
2 She hath killed her beasts; she hath mingled her wine;
3 She hath sent forth her maidens: she crieth
4 Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither:
5 Come, eat of my bread,

rr: 6 Murekye obushema, mubone kugumaho
en: 6 Forsake the foolish, and live;
7 He that reproveth a scorner getteth to himself shame:

rr: 8 Otarihana omugayi, nyentsya akakwanga
en: 8 Reprove not a scorner, lest he hate thee:
9 Give instruction to a wise man , and he will be yet wiser:
10 The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom:
11 For by me thy days shall be multiplied,
12 If thou be wise, thou shalt be wise for thyself:
13 A foolish woman is clamorous:

rr: 14 Ashutama aha muryango gw'enju ye
en: 14 For she sitteth at the door of her house,

rr: 15 Kweta abarikuhingura
en: 15 To call passengers
16 Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither:
17 Stolen waters are sweet,
18 But he knoweth not that the dead are there;
1 The proverbs of Solomon.
2 Treasures of wickedness profit nothing:
3 The LORD will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish:
4 He becometh poor that dealeth with a slack hand:
5 He that gathereth in summer is a wise son:

rr: 6 Emigisha eba aha mutwe gw'ohikiriire
en: 6 Blessings are upon the head of the just:
7 The memory of the just is blessed:
8 The wise in heart will receive commandments:
9 He that walketh uprightly walketh surely:
10 He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow:
11 The mouth of a righteous man is a well of life:
12 Hatred stirreth up strifes:
13 In the lips of him that hath understanding wisdom is found:

rr: 14 Abanyabwengye babiika okumanya
en: 14 Wise men lay up knowledge:
15 The rich man's wealth is his strong city:
16 The labour of the righteous tendeth to life:
17 He is in the way of life that keepeth instruction:

rr: 18 Oshereka orwango, agira eminwa y'ebishuba
en: 18 He that hideth hatred with lying lips,
19 In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin:

rr: 20 Orurimi rw'ohikiriire n'efeeza etoorainwe
en: 20 The tongue of the just is as choice silver:

rr: 21 Eminwa y'ohikiriire egaburira baingi
en: 21 The lips of the righteous feed many:
22 The blessing of the LORD , it maketh rich,

rr: 23 Aha mushema, okukora kubi ni nk'omuzaano
en: 23 It is as sport to a fool to do mischief:
24 The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him:

rr: 25 Omuyaga gw'akasooroora ku gurabaho, omubi ahwaho
en: 25 As the whirlwind passeth, so is the wicked no more:

rr: 26 Nk'oku viinyo erikushaarira ereeta amangigina
en: 26 As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes,
27 The fear of the LORD prolongeth days:
28 The hope of the righteous shall be gladness:
29 The way of the LORD is strength to the upright:
30 The righteous shall never be removed:
31 The mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom:
32 The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable:
1 A false balance is abomination to the LORD :
2 When pride cometh, then cometh shame:
3 The integrity of the upright shall guide them:
4 Riches profit not in the day of wrath:

rr: 5 Okuhikiirira kw'otaine kamogo kumushorongyeza omuhanda
en: 5 The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way:
6 The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them:
7 When a wicked man dieth, his expectation shall perish:
8 The righteous is delivered out of trouble,

rr: 9 Otarikutiina Ruhanga acwekyereza mutaahi we n'akanwa ke
en: 9 An hypocrite with his mouth destroyeth his neighbour:
10 When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth:

rr: 11 Orurembo rutunguurwa omugisha gw'ow'omutima ogugororokire
en: 11 By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted:
12 He that is void of wisdom despiseth his neighbour:
13 A talebearer revealeth secrets:
14 Where no counsel is , the people fall:
15 He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it:

rr: 16 Omukazi w'embabazi aheebwa ekitiinisa
en: 16 A gracious woman retaineth honour:
17 The merciful man doeth good to his own soul:
18 The wicked worketh a deceitful work:
19 As righteousness tendeth to life:
20 They that are of a froward heart are abomination to the LORD :
21 Though hand join in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished:

rr: 22 Omukazi murungi otaine mutima
en: 22 As a jewel of gold in a swine's snout,
23 The desire of the righteous is only good:
24 There is that scattereth, and yet increaseth;
25 The liberal soul shall be made fat:

rr: 26 Orikwima abantu engano, aryajumwa boona
en: 26 He that withholdeth corn, the people shall curse him:
27 He that diligently seeketh good procureth favour:
28 He that trusteth in his riches shall fall:
29 He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind:
30 The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life;
31 Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth:
1 Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge:
2 A good man obtaineth favour of the LORD :
3 A man shall not be established by wickedness:
4 A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband:
5 The thoughts of the righteous are right:
6 The words of the wicked are to lie in wait for blood:
7 The wicked are overthrown, and are not:

rr: 8 Omuntu asiimwa nk'oku obwengye bwe buri
en: 8 A man shall be commended according to his wisdom:

rr: 9 Omuntu otaine kitiinisa, orikwekorera
en: 9 He that is despised, and hath a servant, is better
10 A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast:
11 He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread:

rr: 12 Omunaara gugumire ogw'ababi gusheenyagurika
en: 12 The wicked desireth the net of evil men:
13 The wicked is snared by the transgression of his lips:
14 A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth:
