15 The way of a fool is right in his own eyes:

rr: 16 Okuguubwa kubi kw'omushema kumanywa ahonaaho
en: 16 A fool's wrath is presently known:
17 He that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness:
18 There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword:

rr: 19 Eminwa egamba amazima egumaho ebiro byona
en: 19 The lip of truth shall be established for ever:

rr: 20 Obugobya buba omu mitima y'abaza omu naama z'obubi
en: 20 Deceit is in the heart of them that imagine evil:
21 There shall no evil happen to the just:
22 Lying lips are abomination to the LORD :

rr: 23 Omuntu orikwerinda ashereka okumanya kwe
en: 23 A prudent man concealeth knowledge:

rr: 24 Omukono gw'omweziriki guryategyeka
en: 24 The hand of the diligent shall bear rule:
25 Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop:

rr: 26 Omuntu ohikiriire ayebembera mutaahi we
en: 26 The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour:

rr: 27 Omweremwa takwata ki ahiigire
en: 27 The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting:
28 In the way of righteousness is life;
1 A wise son heareth his father's instruction:
2 A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth:
3 He that keepeth his mouth keepeth his life:
4 The soul of the sluggard desireth, and hath nothing:

rr: 5 Omuntu ohikiriire ayanga ebishuba
en: 5 A righteous man hateth lying:
6 Righteousness keepeth him that is upright in the way:
7 There is that maketh himself rich, yet hath nothing:

rr: 8 Amagara g'omuntu gacungurwa eitungo rye
en: 8 The ransom of a man's life are his riches:
9 The light of the righteous rejoiceth:

rr: 10 Amaryo gareeta entongane zonka
en: 10 Only by pride cometh contention:
11 Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished:
12 Hope deferred maketh the heart sick:
13 Whoso despiseth the word shall be destroyed:
14 The law of the wise is a fountain of life,

rr: 15 Okumanya okuhikire kureeta obushongore
en: 15 Good understanding giveth favour:
16 Every prudent man dealeth with knowledge:
17 A wicked messenger falleth into mischief:
18 Poverty and shame shall be to him that refuseth instruction:

rr: 19 Ebirikwetengwa ku bihikiirizibwa, bishemeza omutima
en: 19 The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul:

rr: 20 Ogyenda n'abanyabwengye, nawe ahinduka omunyabwengye
en: 20 He that walketh with wise men shall be wise:
21 Evil pursueth sinners:
22 A good man leaveth an inheritance to his children's children:

rr: 23 Emisiri y'abooro eyeza bingi
en: 23 Much food is in the tillage of the poor:
24 He that spareth his rod hateth his son:

rr: 25 Ohikiriire agira ebirikumuhaazya
en: 25 The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul:
1 Every wise woman buildeth her house:
2 He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the LORD :
3 In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride:

rr: 4 Ahu ente z'okuhingisa zitari, tihagira bihunikirwe
en: 4 Where no oxen are , the crib is clean:
5 A faithful witness will not lie:
6 A scorner seeketh wisdom, and findeth it not:

rr: 7 Ruga aha mushema
en: 7 Go from the presence of a foolish man,

rr: 8 Obwengye bw'omwerinzi n'okumanya omuhanda gwe
en: 8 The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way:
9 Fools make a mock at sin:

rr: 10 Obusaasi bumanywa omutima ogu burimu
en: 10 The heart knoweth his own bitterness;
11 The house of the wicked shall be overthrown:
12 There is a way which seemeth right unto a man,
13 Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful;
14 The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways:

rr: 15 Otaine bwengye aikiririza eryo
en: 15 The simple believeth every word:
16 A wise man feareth, and departeth from evil:

rr: 17 Orahuka kugira ekiniga, akora eby'obushema
en: 17 He that is soon angry dealeth foolishly:

rr: 18 Abataine bwengye batunga obushema
en: 18 The simple inherit folly:
19 The evil bow before the good;
20 The poor is hated even of his own neighbour:
21 He that despiseth his neighbour sinneth:

rr: 22 Abagira enaama mbi, baba batahabire?
en: 22 Do they not err that devise evil?

rr: 23 Omu kufa kubi okw'emiringo yoona habamu omugasho
en: 23 In all labour there is profit:

rr: 24 Ekirunga ky'abanyabwengye n'obutungi bwabo
en: 24 The crown of the wise is their riches:
25 A true witness delivereth souls:
26 In the fear of the LORD is strong confidence:
27 The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life,
28 In the multitude of people is the king's honour:
29 He that is slow to wrath is of great understanding:
30 A sound heart is the life of the flesh:
31 He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker:
32 The wicked is driven away in his wickedness:

rr: 33 Obwengye butuura omu mutima gw'orikwetegyereza
en: 33 Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding:

rr: 34 Okuhikiirira kuhimbisisa eihanga
en: 34 Righteousness exalteth a nation:
35 The king's favour is toward a wise servant:
1 A soft answer turneth away wrath:
2 The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright:
3 The eyes of the LORD are in every place,
4 A wholesome tongue is a tree of life:
5 A fool despiseth his father's instruction:

rr: 6 Omu nju y'ohikiriire habamu obutungi bwingi
en: 6 In the house of the righteous is much treasure:
7 The lips of the wise disperse knowledge:
8 The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD :
9 The way of the wicked is an abomination unto the LORD :
10 Correction is grievous unto him that forsaketh the way:
11 Hell and destruction are before the LORD :

rr: 12 Omugayi takunda kuhanwa
en: 12 A scorner loveth not one that reproveth him:
13 A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance:
14 The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge:

rr: 15 Ebiro by'abarikubonabona byona ni bibi
en: 15 All the days of the afflicted are evil:
16 Better is little with the fear of the LORD
17 Better is a dinner of herbs where love is,
18 A wrathful man stirreth up strife:

rr: 19 Omuhanda gw'omweremwa gufa ahabw'okumerwamu amahwa
en: 19 The way of the slothful man is as an hedge of thorns:
20 A wise son maketh a glad father:
21 Folly is joy to him that is destitute of wisdom:
22 Without counsel purposes are disappointed:

rr: 23 Okugarukamu gye kureetera omuntu kushemererwa
en: 23 A man hath joy by the answer of his mouth:
24 The way of life is above to the wise,
25 The LORD will destroy the house of the proud:

rr: 26 Ebiteekateeko by'ababi n'ekirikunugwa ahari MUKAMA
en: 26 The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to the LORD :
27 He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house;
28 The heart of the righteous studieth to answer:
29 The LORD is far from the wicked:

rr: 30 Amaisho gashemuukire gashemeza omutima
en: 30 The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart:

rr: 31 Orikutega okutu okuhana kurungi
en: 31 The ear that heareth the reproof of life
32 He that refuseth instruction despiseth his own soul:
33 The fear of the LORD is the instruction of wisdom;
1 The preparations of the heart in man,
2 All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes;
3 Commit thy works unto the LORD ,
4 The LORD hath made all things for himself:
5 Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD :
6 By mercy and truth iniquity is purged:
7 When a man's ways please the LORD ,
8 Better is a little with righteousness
9 A man's heart deviseth his way:
10 A divine sentence is in the lips of the king:
11 A just weight and balance are the LORD 's:
12 It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness:
13 Righteous lips are the delight of kings;
14 The wrath of a king is as messengers of death:

rr: 15 Omugabe ku ashemuuka ahamaisho, kireeta amagara
en: 15 In the light of the king's countenance is life;
16 How much better is it to get wisdom than gold!
17 The highway of the upright is to depart from evil:
18 Pride goeth before destruction,

rr: 19 Ni kirungi okugira omutima gworobi, okakwatanisa n'abooro
en: 19 Better it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly,
20 He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good:

rr: 21 Oine omutima gw'obwengye ayetwa omuntu orikukyenga
en: 21 The wise in heart shall be called prudent:
22 Understanding is a wellspring of life unto him that hath it:
23 The heart of the wise teacheth his mouth,
24 Pleasant words are as an honeycomb,
25 There is a way that seemeth right unto a man,
26 He that laboureth laboureth for himself;
27 An ungodly man diggeth up evil:
28 A froward man soweth strife:

rr: 29 Omunyaitima abeihabeiha mutaahi we
en: 29 A violent man enticeth his neighbour,

rr: 30 Oitira abandi eriisho, aba naahanuura enaama zikiikami
en: 30 He shutteth his eyes to devise froward things:
31 The hoary head is a crown of glory,
32 He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty;
33 The lot is cast into the lap;
1 Better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith,

rr: 2 Omuhuuku orikukoresa obwengye
en: 2 A wise servant shall have rule over a son that causeth shame,
3 The fining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold:

rr: 4 Enkozi y'ebibi ehurira emigambire y'obubi
en: 4 A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips;
5 Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker:

rr: 6 Abaijukuru n'ekirunga ky'abagurusi
en: 6 Children's children are the crown of old men;

rr: 7 Emigambire ehikire teizihira mushema
en: 7 Excellent speech becometh not a fool:

rr: 8 Enguzi aha muntu ogihaire ni nk'eibaare eririkukora eby'okutangaaza
en: 8 A gift is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it:
9 He that covereth a transgression seeketh love;

rr: 10 Okuhanwa kuhika omunyabwengye aha mutima
en: 10 A reproof entereth more into a wise man
11 An evil man seeketh only rebellion:
12 Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man,
13 Whoso rewardeth evil for good,
14 The beginning of strife is as when one letteth out water:
15 He that justifieth the wicked, and he that condemneth the just,

rr: 16 Ahabw'enki omushema agira empiiha omu ngaro ngu agure obwengye
en: 16 Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool to get wisdom,
17 A friend loveth at all times,
18 A man void of understanding striketh hands,
19 He loveth transgression that loveth strife:

rr: 20 Oine omutima ogurikwehabagiza, taribona kirungi
en: 20 He that hath a froward heart findeth no good:
21 He that begetteth a fool doeth it to his sorrow:
22 A merry heart doeth good like a medicine:
23 A wicked man taketh a gift out of the bosom
24 Wisdom is before him that hath understanding;
25 A foolish son is a grief to his father,

rr: 26 Okubonabonesa ohikiriire ti kirungi
en: 26 Also to punish the just is not good,
27 He that hath knowledge spareth his words:

rr: 28 Nangwa n'omushema ku ahunama, bateekateeka ngu n'omunyabwengye
en: 28 Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise:

rr: 1 Oyetaanisa n'abandi, aba naasherura ebye wenka
en: 1 Through desire a man, having separated himself, seeketh
2 A fool hath no delight in understanding,

rr: 3 Ku haija obubi, n'okugaya kwija
en: 3 When the wicked cometh, then cometh also contempt,
4 The words of a man's mouth are as deep waters,
5 It is not good to accept the person of the wicked,

rr: 6 Ebigambo by'omushema bireeta entongane
en: 6 A fool's lips enter into contention,
7 A fool's mouth is his destruction,
8 The words of a talebearer are as wounds,

rr: 9 Orikweganda aha murimo gwe
en: 9 He also that is slothful in his work
10 The name of the LORD is a strong tower:
11 The rich man's wealth is his strong city,
12 Before destruction the heart of man is haughty,

rr: 13 Ogarukamu atabandize kuhurira
en: 13 He that answereth a matter before he heareth it ,

rr: 14 Omutima guhamire gugumya omuntu omu ndwara ye
en: 14 The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity;

rr: 15 Omutima gw'omwerinzi gutunga okumanya
en: 15 The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge;
16 A man's gift maketh room for him,

rr: 17 Omu rubanja, obanza kutongana oshusha oti, ebye nibyo bihikire
en: 17 He that is first in his own cause seemeth just;

rr: 18 Enteenyu emara empaka
en: 18 The lot causeth contentions to cease,

rr: 19 Okugarukana n'ow'eishe-mwe ogwisiibwe kubi kugumire okukira okwata orurembo rw'amaani
en: 19 A brother offended is harder to be won than a strong city:
20 A man's belly shall be satisfied with the fruit of his mouth;

rr: 21 Orurimi rugira obushooborozi bw'okwita n'obw'okukiza
en: 21 Death and life are in the power of the tongue:
22 Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing ,
23 The poor useth intreaties;
24 A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly:
1 Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity,

rr: 2 Omuntu okubaho otaine bwengye ti kirungi
en: 2 Also, that the soul be without knowledge, it is not good;
3 The foolishness of man perverteth his way:
4 Wealth maketh many friends;
5 A false witness shall not be unpunished,

rr: 6 Baingi basherura obuhakwa ha muntu efura
en: 6 Many will intreat the favour of the prince:
7 All the brethren of the poor do hate him:

rr: 8 Owaagira obwengye, akunda amagara ge
en: 8 He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul:

rr: 9 Kareebi ow'ebishuba taribura kufubirwa
en: 9 A false witness shall not be unpunished,
10 Delight is not seemly for a fool;
11 The discretion of a man deferreth his anger;
12 The king's wrath is as the roaring of a lion;
13 A foolish son is the calamity of his father:
14 House and riches are the inheritance of fathers:
15 Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep;
16 He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his own soul;
17 He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the LORD ;
18 Chasten thy son while there is hope,

rr: 19 Ow'ekiniga kingi aryakizira
en: 19 A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment:

rr: 20 Guma ohurire enaama, oikirize okuhaburwa
en: 20 Hear counsel, and receive instruction,
21 There are many devices in a man's heart;

rr: 22 Embabazi z'omuntu nizo zimureetera kukundwa
en: 22 The desire of a man is his kindness:
23 The fear of the LORD tendeth to life:
24 A slothful man hideth his hand in his bosom,
25 Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware:

rr: 26 Oshiisha ebya ishe, akabinga nyina
en: 26 He that wasteth his father, and chaseth away his mother,
27 Cease, my son, to hear the instruction
28 An ungodly witness scorneth judgment:
29 Judgments are prepared for scorners,
1 Wine is a mocker, strong drink is raging:
2 The fear of a king is as the roaring of a lion:
3 It is an honour for a man to cease from strife:
4 The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold;
5 Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water;
6 Most men will proclaim every one his own goodness:
7 The just man walketh in his integrity:
8 A king that sitteth in the throne of judgment
9 Who can say, I have made my heart clean,
10 Divers weights, and divers measures,
11 Even a child is known by his doings,
12 The hearing ear, and the seeing eye,
13 Love not sleep, lest thou come to poverty;

rr: 14 Orikugura, acamura eki arikugura ati: Ni kibi! Ni kibi!
en: 14 It is naught, it is naught, saith the buyer:
15 There is gold, and a multitude of rubies:
16 Take his garment that is surety for a stranger:
17 Bread of deceit is sweet to a man;
18 Every purpose is established by counsel:
19 He that goeth about as a talebearer revealeth secrets:
20 Whoso curseth his father or his mother,
21 An inheritance may be gotten hastily at the beginning;
22 Say not thou, I will recompense evil;
23 Divers weights are an abomination unto the LORD ;
24 Man's goings are of the LORD ;
25 It is a snare to the man who devoureth that which is holy,

rr: 26 Omugabe w'obwengye ashungura ababi
en: 26 A wise king scattereth the wicked,
27 The spirit of man is the candle of the LORD ,
28 Mercy and truth preserve the king:
29 The glory of young men is their strength:

rr: 30 Okwasha omuntu na kibooko kumaraho ebibi
en: 30 The blueness of a wound cleanseth away evil:
1 The king's heart is in the hand of the LORD ,
2 Every way of a man is right in his own eyes:
3 To do justice and judgment
4 An high look, and a proud heart,
5 The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness;

rr: 6 Obutungi obu omuntu atunga ahabw'okubeiha, n'omuyaayuuko
en: 6 The getting of treasures by a lying tongue

rr: 7 Eitima ry'ababi riryabamaraho
en: 7 The robbery of the wicked shall destroy them;
8 The way of man is froward and strange:
9 It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop,

rr: 10 Omutima gw'omubi gwetenga ebibi
en: 10 The soul of the wicked desireth evil:
11 When the scorner is punished, the simple is made wise:
12 The righteous man wisely considereth the house of the wicked:
13 Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor,

rr: 14 Ekiconco ky'omu mubonano kiikaikanisa okuguubwa kubi
en: 14 A gift in secret pacifieth anger:
15 It is joy to the just to do judgment:

rr: 16 Omuntu orikuhaba, akaruga omu muhanda gw'okwetegyereza
en: 16 The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding

rr: 17 Orikukunda eby'okweshemeza aryaba omworo
en: 17 He that loveth pleasure shall be a poor man:
18 The wicked shall be a ransom for the righteous,

rr: 19 Haakiri okutuura omu nsi etatuurwamu bantu
en: 19 It is better to dwell in the wilderness,
20 There is treasure to be desired and oil in the dwelling of the wise;
21 He that followeth after righteousness and mercy
22 A wise man scaleth the city of the mighty,
23 Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue

rr: 24 Omunyamaryo kandi ow'ekiziizi ayetwa omugayi
en: 24 Proud and haughty scorner is his name,
25 The desire of the slothful killeth him;
26 He coveteth greedily all the day long:
27 The sacrifice of the wicked is abomination:
28 A false witness shall perish:

rr: 29 Omubi ayoma ahamaisho
en: 29 A wicked man hardeneth his face:
30 There is no wisdom nor understanding
31 The horse is prepared against the day of battle:
1 A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches,
2 The rich and poor meet together:
3 A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself:
4 By humility and the fear of the LORD
5 Thorns and snares are in the way of the froward:
6 Train up a child in the way he should go:

rr: 7 Omutungi ategyeka omworo
en: 7 The rich ruleth over the poor,
8 He that soweth iniquity shall reap vanity:
9 He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed;
10 Cast out the scorner, and contention shall go out;
11 He that loveth pureness of heart,

rr: 12 Amaisho ga MUKAMA garinda oine okumanya
en: 12 The eyes of the LORD preserve knowledge,
13 The slothful man saith, There is a lion without,
14 The mouth of strange women is a deep pit:
15 Foolishness is bound in the heart of a child;
16 He that oppresseth the poor to increase his riches ,

rr: 17 Tega okutu, ohurire ebigambo by'abanyabwengye
en: 17 Bow down thine ear, and hear the words of the wise,

rr: 18 Ahabw'okuba kiryaba kirungi, waabigumya omu mutima gwawe
en: 18 For it is a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee;

rr: 19 Nikyo naabikumanyisiza eri izooba, iwe wenka
en: 19 That thy trust may be in the LORD ,

rr: 20 Tinaakuhandiikira ebigambo ebirikukira oburungi
en: 20 Have not I written to thee excellent things
21 That I might make thee know the certainty of the words of truth;
22 Rob not the poor, because he is poor:
23 For the LORD will plead their cause,

rr: 24 Otarinywana n'omuntu orikurahuka kuguubwa kubi
en: 24 Make no friendship with an angry man;

rr: 25 Nyentsya otakaayega emitwarize ye
en: 25 Lest thou learn his ways,
26 Be not thou one of them that strike hands,

rr: 27 Ku oraabe otaine ky'okumwihurira
en: 27 If thou hast nothing to pay,
28 Remove not the ancient landmark,
29 Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings;

rr: 1 Ku orishutama kurya n'omutegyeki
en: 1 When thou sittest to eat with a ruler,

rr: 2 Ku oraabe noomanya ngu ori omunyamururu
en: 2 And put a knife to thy throat,

rr: 3 Otaryetenga eby'okurya bye ebinuzire
en: 3 Be not desirous of his dainties:
4 Labour not to be rich:
5 Wilt thou set thine eyes upon that which is not?
6 Eat thou not the bread of him that hath an evil eye,
7 For as he thinketh in his heart, so is he:

rr: 8 Ekitongye eki oriba waamira, oryakitanaka
en: 8 The morsel which thou hast eaten shalt thou vomit up,

rr: 9 Otarigira eki waagamba, omushema akuhuriire
en: 9 Speak not in the ears of a fool:
10 Remove not the old landmark;
11 For their redeemer is mighty;

rr: 12 Omutima gwawe ogute aha kuhaburwa
en: 12 Apply thine heart unto instruction,
13 Withhold not correction from the child:

rr: 14 Ku orimuteera omunyaafu
en: 14 Thou shalt beat him with the rod,
15 My son, if thine heart be wise,

rr: 16 Ku origuma noogamba ebihikire
en: 16 Yea, my reins shall rejoice,
17 Let not thine heart envy sinners:
18 For surely there is an end;
19 Hear thou, my son, and be wise,
20 Be not among winebibbers;
21 For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty:
22 Hearken unto thy father that begat thee,
23 Buy the truth, and sell it not;

rr: 24 Ishe w'ohikiriire aryashemererwa munonga
en: 24 The father of the righteous shall greatly rejoice:

rr: 25 Ka sho na nyoko bashemererwe
en: 25 Thy father and thy mother shall be glad,

rr: 26 Mwana wangye, mpa omutima gwawe
en: 26 My son, give me thine heart,
27 For a whore is a deep ditch;
28 She also lieth in wait as for a prey,
29 Who hath woe? Who hath sorrow?
30 They that tarry long at the wine;

rr: 31 Otareeba viinyo ngu niho erikutukura
en: 31 Look not thou upon the wine when it is red,
32 At the last it biteth like a serpent,

rr: 33 Amaisho gareeba ensi neegyenda
en: 33 Thine eyes shall behold strange women,

rr: 34 Oshusha nk'obyami ahagati y'enyanja
en: 34 Yea, thou shalt be as he that lieth down in the midst of the sea,
35 They have stricken me, shalt thou say, and I was not sick;
1 Be not thou envious against evil men,
2 For their heart studieth destruction,
3 Through wisdom is an house builded;
4 And by knowledge shall the chambers be filled
5 A wise man is strong;
6 For by wise counsel thou shalt make thy war:

rr: 7 Obwengye n'obw'ahaiguru, omushema tarikubaasa kubuhika
en: 7 Wisdom is too high for a fool:

rr: 8 Ogira enaama ez'okukora kubi
en: 8 He that deviseth to do evil
9 The thought of foolishness is sin:
10 If thou faint in the day of adversity,
11 If thou forbear to deliver them that are drawn unto death,
12 If thou sayest, Behold, we knew it not;
13 My son, eat thou honey, because it is good;
14 So shall the knowledge of wisdom be unto thy soul:
15 Lay not wait, O wicked man , against the dwelling of the righteous;
16 For a just man falleth seven times, and riseth up again:
17 Rejoice not when thine enemy falleth,

rr: 18 MUKAMA atakaakireeba, kikamusaasa
en: 18 Lest the LORD see it , and it displease him,
19 Fret not thyself because of evil men ,
20 For there shall be no reward to the evil man ;
21 My son, fear thou the LORD and the king:

rr: 22 Ahabw'okuba akabi nikaija kubarugaho kitaraariire.
en: 22 For their calamity shall rise suddenly;
23 These things also belong to the wise.
24 He that saith unto the wicked, Thou art righteous;

rr: 25 Kwonka abarikuhana omubi baryashemererwa
en: 25 But to them that rebuke him shall be delight,

rr: 26 Ogarukamu ebihikire, aba anywegyeire eminwa.
en: 26 Every man shall kiss his lips

rr: 27 Banza otebeekanise ebi orikwija kukora aheeru
en: 27 Prepare thy work without,
28 Be not a witness against thy neighbour without cause;
29 Say not, I will do so to him as he hath done to me:

rr: 30 Nkaraba aha musiri gw'omweremwa
en: 30 I went by the field of the slothful,
31 And, lo, it was all grown over with thorns,

rr: 32 Ku naabireebire, naabiteekateekaho munonga
en: 32 Then I saw, and considered it well:
33 Yet a little sleep, a little slumber,

rr: 34 Obwo, obworo buryakwizira nk'omunyagi
en: 34 So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth;
1 These are also proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.
2 It is the glory of God to conceal a thing:

rr: 3 Nk'oku eiguru riri ahaiguru munonga, kandi nk'oku ensi ehikire hare okuzimu
en: 3 The heaven for height, and the earth for depth,
4 Take away the dross from the silver,
5 Take away the wicked from before the king,
6 Put not forth thyself in the presence of the king,

rr: 7 Ahakuba ekirungi n'okwetwa ngu, Garuka aha!
en: 7 For better it is that it be said unto thee, Come up hither;
8 Go not forth hastily to strive,
9 Debate thy cause with thy neighbour himself ;

rr: 10 Owaakihurira akakugaya
en: 10 Lest he that heareth it put thee to shame,
11 A word fitly spoken
12 As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold,
13 As the cold of snow in the time of harvest,
14 Whoso boasteth himself of a false gift
15 By long forbearing is a prince persuaded,

rr: 16 Ku oraabe waagwire aha bwoki, oryeho oburikukuhaazya
en: 16 Hast thou found honey? eat so much as is sufficient for thee,

rr: 17 Orekye kwitsa omwa mutaahi waawe akaribatiiriro
en: 17 Withdraw thy foot from thy neighbour's house;
18 A man that beareth false witness against his neighbour

rr: 19 Okwesiga otarikwesigwa omu bunaku bw'akabi
en: 19 Confidence in an unfaithful man in time of trouble

rr: 20 Orikweshongorera ow'omutima ogweshobeire
en: 20 As he that taketh away a garment in cold weather, and as vinegar upon nitre,
21 If thine enemy be hungry, give him bread to eat;

rr: 22 Ahabw'okuba oryaba omurunzire amakara g'omuriro aha mutwe
en: 22 For thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head,

rr: 23 Omuyaga gw'obukiizi-bwa-bumosho gureeta enjura
en: 23 The north wind driveth away rain:
24 It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop,

rr: 25 Nk'amaizi agarikufuka oku gaba aha muntu oine ekyaka
en: 25 As cold waters to a thirsty soul,

rr: 26 Ohikiriire orikuhigiza omubi
en: 26 A righteous man falling down before the wicked
27 It is not good to eat much honey:

rr: 28 Omuntu otarikubaasa kwezibira
en: 28 He that hath no rule over his own spirit
1 As snow in summer, and as rain in harvest,
2 As the bird by wandering, as the swallow by flying,
3 A whip for the horse, a bridle for the ass,
4 Answer not a fool according to his folly,
5 Answer a fool according to his folly,

rr: 6 Otuma omushema aba naayehenda amaguru
en: 6 He that sendeth a message by the hand of a fool

rr: 7 Nk'oku amaguru g'ebirema gatuura nigaregyeijana
en: 7 The legs of the lame are not equal:

rr: 8 Okuha omushema ekitiinisa
en: 8 As he that bindeth a stone in a sling,

rr: 9 Nk'oku eihwa ricumita engaro y'omusinzi, rikagihweramu
en: 9 As a thorn goeth up into the hand of a drunkard,

rr: 10 Nk'oku omurasi arasha weena ou yaabanda
en: 10 The great God that formed all things
11 As a dog returneth to his vomit,
12 Seest thou a man wise in his own conceit?
13 The slothful man saith, There is a lion in the way;

rr: 14 Nk'oku orwigi rwecundira aha pata zaarwo
en: 14 As the door turneth upon his hinges,
15 The slothful hideth his hand in his bosom;
16 The sluggard is wiser in his own conceit

rr: 17 Orikwetaasya omu ntongane zitari ze
en: 17 He that passeth by, and meddleth with strife belonging not to him,

rr: 18 Omuntu ogobeza mutaahi we, akagira ati: Naaba ninteera obuyaga!
en: 18 As a mad man who casteth firebrands,

rr: 19 Ni nk'omugwa-iraro orikurekyera ebikongyezo n'emyambi na rufu.
en: 19 So is the man that deceiveth his neighbour,

rr: 20 Ahu enku zibura, omuriro guraara
en: 20 Where no wood is, there the fire goeth out:
21 As coals are to burning coals, and wood to fire;
22 The words of a talebearer are as wounds,

rr: 23 Omuntu orikugamba eby'okukunda, haza aine omutima mubi
en: 23 Burning lips and a wicked heart

rr: 24 Omwangani aryarya n'eminwa ye
en: 24 He that hateth dissembleth with his lips,
25 When he speaketh fair, believe him not:

rr: 26 N'obu yaakushweka rwango ye n'oburyarya
en: 26 Whose hatred is covered by deceit,
27 Whoso diggeth a pit shall fall therein:

rr: 28 Orurimi rurikubeiha rwanga abu rwahutaize
en: 28 A lying tongue hateth those that are afflicted by it;
1 Boast not thyself of to morrow;
2 Let another man praise thee, and not thine own mouth;
3 A stone is heavy, and the sand weighty;
4 Wrath is cruel, and anger is outrageous;
5 Open rebuke is better
6 Faithful are the wounds of a friend;
7 The full soul loatheth an honeycomb;
8 As a bird that wandereth from her nest,

rr: 9 Nk'oku amajuta g'omugaju gashemeza omutima
en: 9 Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart:
10 Thine own friend, and thy father's friend, forsake not;
11 My son, be wise, and make my heart glad,
12 A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself;
13 Take his garment that is surety for a stranger,

rr: 14 Oimuka kare akaza kwendeza mutaahi we omugisha naayomba
en: 14 He that blesseth his friend with a loud voice, rising early in the morning,
15 A continual dropping in a very rainy day

rr: 16 Orikwenda kumuzibira ni nk'owaakwenda kuzibira omuyaga
en: 16 Whosoever hideth her hideth the wind,

rr: 17 Nk'oku ekyoma kityaza ekindi
en: 17 Iron sharpeneth iron;
18 Whoso keepeth the fig tree shall eat the fruit thereof:

rr: 19 Nk'oku amaisho g'omuntu geereebera omu maizi
en: 19 As in water face answereth to face,
20 Hell and destruction are never full;
21 As the fining pot for silver, and the furnace for gold;
22 Though thou shouldest bray a fool in a mortar among wheat with a pestle,

rr: 23 Yezirikye kumanya amatungo gaawe oku gari
en: 23 Be thou diligent to know the state of thy flocks,
24 For riches are not for ever:
25 The hay appeareth, and the tender grass sheweth itself,
26 The lambs are for thy clothing,

rr: 27 Amahenehene garyaba eky'okurya kyawe
en: 27 And thou shalt have goats' milk enough for thy food, for the food of thy household,
1 The wicked flee when no man pursueth:
2 For the transgression of a land many are the princes thereof:
3 A poor man that oppresseth the poor
4 They that forsake the law praise the wicked:
5 Evil men understand not judgment:
6 Better is the poor that walketh in his uprightness,
7 Whoso keepeth the law is a wise son:
8 He that by usury and unjust gain increaseth his substance,
9 He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law,
10 Whoso causeth the righteous to go astray in an evil way,

rr: 11 Omuntungi ayeyeta omunyabwengye
en: 11 The rich man is wise in his own conceit;
12 When righteous men do rejoice, there is great glory:
13 He that covereth his sins shall not prosper:

rr: 14 Omuntu orikutiina MUKAMA obutoosha aine omugisha
en: 14 Happy is the man that feareth alway:
15 As a roaring lion, and a ranging bear;

rr: 16 Omutegyeki otaine kwetegyereza abonabonesa abantu munonga
en: 16 The prince that wanteth understanding is also a great oppressor:

rr: 17 Omuntu otukuriirwe eshagama y'ou aitsire
en: 17 A man that doeth violence to the blood of any person
18 Whoso walketh uprightly shall be saved:
19 He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread:
20 A faithful man shall abound with blessings:
21 To have respect of persons is not good:

rr: 22 Omuntu engumya asheruza eitungo obwira
en: 22 He that hasteth to be rich hath an evil eye,
23 He that rebuketh a man afterwards shall find more favour

rr: 24 Oiba ishe nari nyina, akagira ati: Tiinyine ki naashobya
en: 24 Whoso robbeth his father or his mother, and saith, It is no transgression;
25 He that is of a proud heart stirreth up strife:
26 He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool:
27 He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack:

rr: 28:28 . Abahikiriire ku basingura, habaho ekitiinisa kingi
en: 28 When the wicked rise, men hide themselves:
1 He, that being often reproved hardeneth his neck,
2 When the righteous are in authority, the people rejoice:
3 Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father:

rr: 4 Omugabe ocwera ensi ye emanja z'oburyo, agihamya
en: 4 The king by judgment establisheth the land:
5 A man that flattereth his neighbour
6 In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare:
7 The righteous considereth the cause of the poor:

rr: 8 Abagayi bajagaraza orurembo
en: 8 Scornful men bring a city into a snare:

rr: 9 Ow'obwengye ku ahakana n'omushema
en: 9 If a wise man contendeth with a foolish man,
10 The bloodthirsty hate the upright:

rr: 11 Omushema ayoreka butunu ekiniga kye kyona
en: 11 A fool uttereth all his mind:

rr: 12 Omutegyeki ku arikutega amatu enkuru z'ebishuba
en: 12 If a ruler hearken to lies,
13 The poor and the deceitful man meet together:
14 The king that faithfully judgeth the poor,
15 The rod and reproof give wisdom:
16 When the wicked are multiplied, transgression increaseth:
17 Correct thy son, and he shall give thee rest;
18 Where there is no vision, the people perish:

rr: 19 Omuheereza tategyekwa bigambo byonka
en: 19 A servant will not be corrected by words:
20 Seest thou a man that is hasty in his words?

rr: 21 Omuhuuku orikwiha omu buto naatetsibwa mukama we
en: 21 He that delicately bringeth up his servant from a child
22 An angry man stirreth up strife,
23 A man's pride shall bring him low:
24 Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul:
25 The fear of man bringeth a snare:
26 Many seek the ruler's favour;

rr: 27 Otahikiriire n'ekirikunugwa aha bahikiriire
en: 27 An unjust man is an abomination to the just:
1 The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, even the prophecy:
2 Surely I am more brutish than any man,

rr: 3 Tindeegire bwengye, kandi tindikumanya Orikwera.
en: 3 I neither learned wisdom,
4 Who hath ascended up into heaven, or descended?
5 Every word of God is pure:
6 Add thou not unto his words,

rr: 7 Ninkushaba ebintu bibiri, otabiinyima ntakafiire.
en: 7 Two things have I required of thee;
8 Remove far from me vanity and lies:
9 Lest I be full, and deny thee , and say,
10 Accuse not a servant unto his master,
11 There is a generation that curseth their father,
12 There is a generation that are pure in their own eyes,
13 There is a generation, O how lofty are their eyes!
14 There is a generation, whose teeth are as swords, and their jaw teeth as knives,

rr: 15 Omushundo gwine bahara baagwo babiri
en: 15 The horseleach hath two daughters, crying , Give, give.
16 The grave; and the barren womb;
17 The eye that mocketh at his father,

rr: 18 Hariho ebintu bishatu ebikira kuntangaaza
en: 18 There be three things which are too wonderful for me,

rr: 19 Nibyo ebi: Emizeereerere y'empungu omu mwanya
en: 19 The way of an eagle in the air;

rr: 20 Nikwo n'emitwarize y'omukazi enshambani eba.
en: 20 Such is the way of an adulterous woman;

rr: 21 Hariho ebintu bishatu ebitengyetsa ensi
en: 21 For three things the earth is disquieted,
22 For a servant when he reigneth;

rr: 23 Omwishiki owaabengirwe kushwerwa
en: 23 For an odious woman when she is married;

rr: 24 Aha nsi hariho ebintu bina, n'obu biraabe biba bikye
en: 24 There be four things which are little upon the earth,
25 The ants are a people not strong,
26 The conies are but a feeble folk,
27 The locusts have no king,

rr: 28 N'ekinya n'ekintu eki orikubaasa kutwara omu ngaro
en: 28 The spider taketh hold with her hands,

rr: 29 Hariho ebintu bishatu nangwa ni bina
en: 29 There be three things which go well,

rr: 30 Nibyo ebi: Entare egira amaani okukira ezindi nyamaishwa
en: 30 A lion which is strongest among beasts,

rr: 31 Embaraasi y'aha rugamba, empaya y'embuzi
en: 31 An greyhound; an he goat also;
32 If thou hast done foolishly in lifting up thyself,

rr: 33 Ahabw'okuba okucunda amate kujwisa amajuta
en: 33 Surely the churning of milk bringeth forth butter,
1 The words of king Lemuel, the prophecy that his mother taught him.

rr: 2 N'enki, mwana wangye, ou naayezaariire?
en: 2 What, my son? and what, the son of my womb?
3 Give not thy strength unto women,
4 It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine;
5 Lest they drink, and forget the law,

rr: 6 Ekirikusinza okihe orikwenda kufa
en: 6 Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish,
7 Let him drink, and forget his poverty,
8 Open thy mouth for the dumb
9 Open thy mouth, judge righteously,
10 Who can find a virtuous woman?

rr: 11 Omutima gwa iba gumwesiga
en: 11 The heart of her husband doth safely trust in her,

rr: 12 Ebiro byona eby'amagara ge
en: 12 She will do him good and not evil

rr: 13 Ayezirika kutunga ebyoya by'entaama na furakisi
en: 13 She seeketh wool, and flax,

rr: 14 Omukazi ogwo ni nk'amaato g'abashuubuzi
en: 14 She is like the merchants' ships;
15 She riseth also while it is yet night,

rr: 16 Ayetegyereza omusiri, agugura
en: 16 She considereth a field, and buyeth it:

rr: 17 Ayezirika amaani nk'omweko, kandi ahamya emikono ye.
en: 17 She girdeth her loins with strength,

rr: 18 Amanya ebi arikukora ku bimwiniire omugasho
en: 18 She perceiveth that her merchandise is good:

rr: 19 Emikono ye agita aha kiti ky'ebyoya by'entaama
en: 19 She layeth her hands to the spindle,

rr: 20 Ashashaanurira abooro engaro
en: 20 She stretcheth out her hand to the poor;

rr: 21 Tatiinirira b'omu ka ye biro by'embeho
en: 21 She is not afraid of the snow for her household:

rr: 22 Ayebaziirira eby'okwefubika
en: 22 She maketh herself coverings of tapestry;
23 Her husband is known in the gates,

rr: 24 Abaziira ebijwaro bya kitaani, kandi abitunda
en: 24 She maketh fine linen, and selleth it ;

rr: 25 Amaani n'ekitiinisa nibyo bijwaro bye
en: 25 Strength and honour are her clothing;

rr: 26 Akanwa ke kagamba eby'obwengye
en: 26 She openeth her mouth with wisdom;

rr: 27 Areeberera gye emicwe y'ab'omu ka ye
en: 27 She looketh well to the ways of her household,

rr: 28 Abaana be baimuka, bamweta ow'omugisha
en: 28 Her children arise up, and call her blessed;

rr: 29 Abakazi baingi batwaza gye, kwonka iwe obakira boona.
en: 29 Many daughters have done virtuously,
30 Favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain:

rr: 31 Mumusiime ahabw'ebi emikono ye ekozire
en: 31 Give her of the fruit of her hands;

rr: Aine omugisha omuntu otakuratira naama z'ababi, Nari okwemerera omu muhanda gw'abasisi, N'obu kwakuba okushutama aha bitebe by'abarikugaya
en: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, Nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.

rr: Kureka oshemerererwa Ebiragiro bya MUKAMA, Kandi Ebiragiro ebyo nibyo ateekateekaho nyomushana na nyekioro.
en: But his delight is in the law of the LORD ; And in his law doth he meditate day and night.

rr: Ari nk'omuti ogubyairwe aha rubaju rw'amaizi, Ogwana ebyana byagwo omu bunaku bwabyo, N'amababi gaagwo tigahotoka; Ebi akora byona bigyenda gye.
en: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, That bringeth forth his fruit in his season; His leaf also shall not wither; And whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.

rr: Kwonka ababi tikwo baba, Kureka bashusha nk'ebishushunga ebirikutwarwa omuyaga.
en: The ungodly are not so: But are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.

rr: Nikyo ababi bataribaasiza kwemerera mu rubanja, N'obu baakuba abasiisi omu kuteerana kw'abahikiriire
en: Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, Nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

rr: Ahakuba MUKAMA naamanya omuhanda gw'abahikiriire, Kwonka omuhanda gw'ababi guryabura.
en: For the LORD knoweth the way of the righteous: But the way of the ungodly shall perish.

rr: N'enki ekiteeraine hamwe amahanga? Ahabw'enki abanyamahanga nibaza omu naama za busha?
en: Why do the heathen rage, And the people imagine a vain thing?

rr: Abagabe b'ensi bategnire orugamba, N'abategyeki nibahanuura hamwe, Okurwanisa MUKAMA n'ou yaashukireho amajuta, ni bagira bati
en: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, Against the LORD , and against his anointed, saying ,

rr: Ka tucwe enjegyere zaabo, Tunagye hare emirunga yaabo.
en: Let us break their bands asunder, And cast away their cords from us.

rr: Oshutami omu iguru naasheka; MUKAMA naabateerera enaku.
en: He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh: The Lord shall have them in derision.

rr: Aryabagambira abagwereirwe kubi, Abatiinise n'ekiniga kingi, ati
en: Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath, And vex them in his sore displeasure.

rr: Nyowe nemekire omugabe wangye Aha rushozi rwangye orurikwera Saayuni.
en: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.

rr: Niinyija kuranga ekiragiro kya MUKAMA; Yangira ati: Ori Omwana wangye, Eri izooba naakuzaara.
en: I will declare the decree: the LORD hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; this day have I begotten thee.

rr: Nshaba, ndyakuha amahanga gabe obutaka bwawe, N'embaju zoona ez'ensi zibe eitungo ryawe.
en: Ask of me, and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance, And the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.

rr: Oryabacoocoora n'enkoni y'ekyoma, Obaatagure nk'enyungu y'omubumbi.
en: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; Thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo, imwe bagabe 'mwe, mugire obwengye, Naimwe abategyeki b'ensi, mwikirize kuhaburwa.
en: Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: Be instructed, ye judges of the earth.

rr: Muheereze MUKAMA n'okutiina, Mushemererwa n'okutetema.
en: Serve the LORD with fear, And rejoice with trembling.

rr: Munywegyere Omwana, atakaabagirira ekiniga, Mukahwerekyererera omu muhanda; Ahakuba ekiniga kye nikiija kurahuka kwaka.
en: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish from the way, When his wrath is kindled but a little.

rr: Boona abamuhungiraho baine omugisha.
en: Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.

rr: MUKAMA wangye, abazigu bangye ka ni baingi! Baingi baanyimukiriire
en: LORD , how are they increased that trouble me! Many are they that rise up against me.

rr: Bainti nibangambaho bati: Taine kuhwerwa kwona ahari Ruhanga.
en: Many there be which say of my soul, There is no help for him in God. Selah.

rr: Kwonka Iwe MUKAMA, ori engabo enyehinguririize; Niiwe ndikwehimbisizaho, kandi niiwe oimukize omutwe gwangye.
en: But thou, O LORD , art a shield for me; My glory, and the lifter up of mine head.

rr: Ntakira MUKAMA n'eiraka ryangye, Nawe angarukamu naayema aha rushozi rwe orurikwera.
en: I cried unto the LORD with my voice, And he heard me out of his holy hill. Selah.

rr: Nkabyama, naagwejegyera, Kandi naasisiimuka, ahakuba MUKAMA niwe andamira.
en: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the LORD sustained me.

rr: Tinditiina bukumi bw'abantu Abankubire kundwanisa.
en: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, That have set themselves against me round about.

rr: Ai bambe MUKAMA, imuka; Ruhanga wangye, njuna; Ahakuba okateera abazigu bangye boona aha mushaya, Waacwa amaino g'ababi.
en: Arise, O LORD ; save me, O my God: For thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheek bone; Thou hast broken the teeth of the ungodly.

rr: Okujuna n'okwa MUKAMA; Omugisha gwawe gube aha bantu baawe. Currently Selected: Zaaburi 3 : RR64 Highlight Share <div class="flex w
en: Salvation belongeth unto the LORD : Thy blessing is upon thy people. Selah. Currently Selected: Psalm 3 : KJV Highlight

rr: Ai Ruhanga, omanya okuhikiirira kwangye; Ku ndaagume naakweta, onyetabe. Ku naabaire nfunziibwe, wampa omwanya, naayeshanja. Ongirire embabazi, ohurire okushaba kwangye.
en: Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness: Thou hast enlarged me when I was in distress; Have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.

rr: Imwe bantu 'mwe, muryahitsya hi okuhemura ekitiinisa kyangye? Muryahitsya hi okukunda ebitaine mugasho, n'okukuratira ebishuba?
en: O ye sons of men, how long will ye turn my glory into shame? How long will ye love vanity, and seek after leasing? Selah.

rr: Kwonka mumanye ngu MUKAMA ayetooraniire orikumutiina; MUKAMA ampurira, ku mmutakira.
en: But know that the LORD hath set apart him that is godly for himself: The LORD will hear when I call unto him.

rr: Mugire ekiniga, kwonka murekye kushiisha; Muhanuure n'emitima yaanyu mubyami, mucecekye.
en: Stand in awe, and sin not: Commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah.

rr: Muheyo ebitambo ebihikire, Kandi mwesigye MUKAMA.
en: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, And put your trust in the LORD .

rr: Hariho baingi abarikubuuza bati: N'oha oraatworekye ebirungi? ai MUKAMA, otwakize omushana gw'amaisho gaawe.
en: There be many that say, Who will shew us any good? LORD , lift thou up The light of thy countenance upon us.

rr: Otaire okushemererwa omu mutima gwangye Okurikukira oku bagira omu biro by'omweru n'eby'emihiiso ya viinyo.
en: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, More than in the time that their corn and their wine increased.

rr: Niinyija kubyama ntaine ki ndikwekyenga, ngwejegyere, Ahakuba niiwe wenaka, MUKAMA, ondinda nkagira obusingye.
en: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: For thou, LORD , only makest me dwell in safety.

rr: Currently Selected: Zaaburi 4 : RR64 Highlight Share <div class="text-text-light dark:text-text-dark rtl:-
en: Currently Selected: Psalm 4 : KJV Highlight Share <path d="M5 12a1 1 0 0 1

rr: Ai MUKAMA, tega amatu, ohurire ebigambo byangye, Ote omutima aha kuteekateeka kwangye.
en: Give ear to my words, O LORD , Consider my meditation.

rr: Hurira eiraka ry'okutaka kwangye, Mukama wangye, kandi Ruhanga wangye, Ahakuba niiwe ndikushaba.
en: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God: For unto thee will I pray.

rr: Ai MUKAMA, buri kasheeshe noija kuguma noohurira eiraka ryangye, Buri kasheeshe nintebeekanisa eby'okukuhongyera, ngume nindeeba.
en: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD ; In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.

rr: Ahakuba tori Ruhanga orikushemerererwa obubi, Ekibi tikiriguma h'ori.
en: For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: Neither shall evil dwell with thee.

rr: Abarikwehimbisa tibaryemerera mu maisho gaawe; Oyanga boona abakora ebibi.
en: The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: Thou hatest all workers of iniquity.

rr: Ababeihi oryabahwerekyereza; MUKAMA ayangira kimwe omwitsi w'abantu, n'engobya.
en: Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing: The LORD will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.

rr: Kwonka nyowe, ahabw'embabazi zaawe nyingi Ndyataaha omu nju yaawe; Ndamye ntaire amaisho ahari hekalu yaawe erikwera ninkuha ekitiinisa.
en: But as for me, I will come into thy house in the multitude of thy mercy: And in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.

rr: Ahabw'abantu abangwereire, ai MUKAMA, onyebembere omu kuhikiirira kwawe; Onshemereze omuhanda gwawe omu maisho gangye.
en: Lead me, O LORD , in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; Make thy way straight before my face.

rr: Ahakuba omu kanwa kaabo tiharimu mazima, Emitama yaabo n'obubi busha, Emimiro yaabo n'ekituuro kirangaire, Bashunga abantu n'endimi zaabo.
en: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; Their inward part is very wickedness; Their throat is an open sepulchre; They flatter with their tongue.

rr: Obasingise orubanja, ai Ruhanga; Bagwe ahabw'enaama zaabo; Obabingye ahabw'eby'okushiisha byabo bingi, ahakuba bakugomeire.
en: Destroy thou them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; Cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against thee.

rr: Kwonka boona abarikukuhungiraho bashemererwe; Bagume bateere akaari ahabw'okunanuka; ahakuba niiwe obarinda, Kandi n'abakunda eiziina ryawe bashemerererwe omuriiwe.
en: But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: Let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.

rr: Ahakuba Iwe MUKAMA, oryaha omugisha abahikiriire, Obakingize embabazi nk'engabo.
en: For thou, LORD , wilt bless the righteous; With favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield.

rr: Currently Selected: Zaaburi 5 : RR64 Highlight Share <svg wid
en: Currently Selected: Psalm 5 : KJV Highlight Share <div class="text-text-light dark:text-text-dark rtl:-scal

rr: Ai MUKAMA, otanteisa ongwereirwe kubi, N'obu kwakuba okumpana n'ekiniga kyawe kingi.
en: O LORD , rebuke me not in thine anger, Neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

rr: Ongirire embabazi, ai MUKAMA, ahakuba nyomeire kimwe; Ontambire, MUKAMA, ahakuba amagufa gangye nigajegajega
en: Have mercy upon me, O LORD ; for I am weak: O LORD , heal me; for my bones are vexed.

rr: Kandi n'omutima gwangye nigutetema munonga. Beitu Iwe, ai MUKAMA, oryandeka okuhitsya ryari?
en: My soul is also sore vexed: But thou, O LORD , how long?

rr: Ai MUKAMA, garuka ojune amagara gangye, Onkize ahabw'embabazi zaawe
en: Return, O LORD , deliver my soul: Oh save me for thy mercies' sake.

rr: -12 ; 115:17 ; . Ahakuba ofiire aba atakikwijuka. n'oha orikubaasa kukuhimbisiza okuzimu?
en: For in death there is no remembrance of thee: In the grave who shall give thee thanks?

rr: Okutsinda kunkabize; Buri kiro ndirira aha kitabo kyangye; Ekitanda kyangye nkijubya n'amarira.
en: I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.

rr: Amaisho gampwereire ahabw'amaganya; Gakambire ahabw'abazigu bangye boona.
en: Mine eye is consumed because of grief; It waxeth old because of all mine enemies.

rr: Imwe mwena enkozi z'ebibi, mundugyeho, Ahakuba MUKAMA ahuriire eiraka ry'okurira kwangye
en: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; For the LORD hath heard the voice of my weeping.

rr: MUKAMA ahuriire okweshengyereza kwangye; MUKAMA naikiriza okushaba kwangye.
en: The LORD hath heard my supplication; The LORD will receive my prayer.

rr: Abazigu bangye boona baryakwatwa enshoni, bateteme munonga; Baryagaruka enyima, bahemukye omuri ako kaanya.
en: Let all mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: Let them return and be ashamed suddenly.

rr: Currently Selected: Zaaburi 6 : RR64 Highlight Share <div class="text-text-light dark:text-text-dark r
en: Currently Selected: Psalm 6 : KJV Highlight Share <path d="M5 12a1 1 0 0 1

rr: Ai MUKAMA Ruhanga wangye, niiwe ndikwesiga; Njuna boona abarikumpiiga, kandi onkize
en: O LORD my God, in thee do I put my trust: Save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:

rr: Barekye kuntaagataagura nk'entare, Nibantwara ntaine kijuna.
en: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending it in pieces, While there is none to deliver.

rr: Ai MUKAMA Ruhanga wangye, ku ndaabe nyine eki naakozire, Emikono yangye ku eraabe yaakozire ekibi
en: O LORD my God, if I have done this; If there be iniquity in my hands;

rr: Ku ndaabe naakozire kubi owaabaire atuura gye naanye, Ku ndaabe naatuzire busha omuzigu wangye
en: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (Yea, I have delivered him that without cause is mine enemy:)

rr: Orekye omuzigu wangye ampiigye, ankwate, Aribatiirire amagara gangye, N'ekitiinisa kyangye akite omu mucuucu.
en: Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take it ; Yea, let him tread down my life upon the earth, and lay mine honour in the dust. Selah.

rr: Imuka, ai MUKAMA, n'ekiniga kyawe, Oyemerere ogungire abazigu bangye abaanyiniire ekiniga kingi; Sisiimuka, Ruhanga wangye; ahakuba niiwe waaragiire kucwa orubanja.
en: Arise, O LORD , in thine anger, lift up thyself because of the rage of mine enemies: And awake for me to the judgment that thou hast commanded.

rr: K'emitwe y'amahanga ekwehinguririze, Naiwe obategyekye, oshutami aha kitebe kyawe eky'ahaiguru.
en: So shall the congregation of the people compass thee about: For their sakes therefore return thou on high.

rr: MUKAMA acwera amahanga emanja; Ai MUKAMA, oncwere orubanja nk'okuhikiirira kwangye oku kuri, N'amazima agari omuriinye oku gari.
en: The LORD shall judge the people: Judge me, O LORD , According to my righteousness, and according to mine integrity that is in me.

rr: Ai bambe Ruhanga ohikiriire, ogyeza emitima n'ebiteekateeko, Reka obubi bw'ababi buhweho, Kwonka abahikiriire obagumye. Oku Ruhanga ahindura busha enaama z'ababi
en: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: For the righteous God Trieth the hearts and reins.

rr: Engabo yangye ni Ruhanga Okiza abaine emitima egororokire.
en: My defence is of God, Which saveth the upright in heart.

rr: Ruhanga n'Omucwi w'emanja ohikiriire, Ogwerwa kubi ababi obutoosha.
en: God judgeth the righteous, And God is angry with the wicked every day.

rr: Omuntu ku ayanga kweteisa, Ruhanga atyaza rurara ye; Areegire obuta bwe, Yaabuteekateeka.
en: If he turn not, he will whet his sword; He hath bent his bow, and made it ready.

rr: Atimbire ekiina, yaakiihamu eitaka, Kandi yaagwa omu busya obu atimbire.
en: He made a pit, and digged it, And is fallen into the ditch which he made.

rr: Eitima rye riryamugarukira; Omwaga ogu agirira abandi guryamugwisiza akagwe.
en: His mischief shall return upon his own head, And his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.

rr: Ndyasiima MUKAMA okusiima okushemereire okuhikiirira kwe; Ndyayeshongora, mpimbise eiziina rya MUKAMA Rukira-boona.
en: I will praise the LORD according to his righteousness: And will sing praise to the name of the LORD most high.

en: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thine enemies, That thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.

en: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? And the son of man, that thou visitest him?

en: The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea, And whatsoever passeth through the paths of the seas.

en: O LORD our Lord, How excellent is thy name in all the earth!

en: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou Most High. ב Bet

en: When mine enemies are turned back, They shall fall and perish at thy presence.

rr: Ahakuba okandwanaho, naasinga orubanja omu mazima; Oshutami aha kitebe kyawe eky'obukama, noocwa emanja omu buryo.
en: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; Thou satest in the throne judging right. ג Gimel

rr: Okahana amahanga, waacwekyereza ababi; Waamariraho kimwe amaziina gaabo ebiro n'ebiro.
en: Thou hast rebuked the heathen, thou hast destroyed the wicked, Thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.

rr: Abazigu bahweireho, bacwekyerereziibwe kimwe; Endembo zaabo ozisheenyire, n'okwijukwa tizaakiijukwa.
en: O thou enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: And thou hast destroyed cities; Their memorial is perished with them. ה He

rr: Kwonka MUKAMA atuura aha ngoma obutwire bwona, Ateekateekire ekitebe kye kucwa emanja

rr: Kandi aryacwera ensi yoona orubanja omu kuhikiirira, Acwere abantu boona orubanja omu mazima.
en: And he shall judge the world in righteousness, He shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness. ו Waw

rr: MUKAMA n'obuhungiro bw'abarikuburabuzibwa, Obu bahungiramu omu biro by'obusaasi.
en: The LORD also will be a refuge for the oppressed, A refuge in times of trouble.

rr: Abo abarikumanya eiiina ryawe baryakwesiga, Ahakuba iwe, MUKAMA, tokahemukaga ha bakusherura.
en: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: For thou, LORD , hast not forsaken them that seek thee. ז Zain

rr: Mweshongore eby'okuhimbisa Mukama otuura omuri Saayuuni; Kandi mumanyisa abantu boona ebi akora
en: Sing praises to the LORD , which dwelleth in Zion: Declare among the people his doings.

rr: -19 ; . Ahakuba Ogwo ohoorera eshagama abataho omutima, Kandi tayebwa kutaka kw'abari omu busaasi.
en: When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: He forgetteth not the cry of the humble. ח Het

rr: Ai MUKAMA, ongirire embabazi! Reeba okubonabona oku ndikubonabonesibwa abarikuunyanga, Iwe onyimutsya okanyiha aha marembo ga rufu

rr: Ngu mbone kumanyisa okuhimbisibwa kwawe kwona; Kandi ndyashemerererwa okujuna kwawe Omu marembo ga Saayuuni.
en: That I may shew forth all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in thy salvation. ט Tet

rr: Abanyamahanga bagwire omu busya obu batimbire; Ebigyere byabo byakwatwa ekigoye eki bategire.
en: The heathen are sunk down in the pit that they made: In the net which they hid is their own foot taken.

rr: MUKAMA akeeyoreka, yaacwa orubanja; Ababi bakwatirwa omutego omu bi bakozire n'emikono yaabo. Higayoni.
en: The LORD is known by the judgment which he executeth: The wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah. י Yod

rr: Ababi baryagaruka okuzimu; Nigo mahanga goona ageebwa Ruhanga.
en: The wicked shall be turned into hell, And all the nations that forget God. כ Kaph

rr: Abakyene tibariguma nibeeba, Kandi amatsiko g'abooro tigarihwaho ebiro n'ebiro.
en: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten: The expectation of the poor shall not perish for ever.

rr: Imuka, ai MUKAMA! otaikiriza abantu kusingura; Amahanga gacwerwe orubanja omu maisho gaawe.
en: Arise, O LORD ; let not man prevail: Let the heathen be judged in thy sight.

rr: Obatiinise, ai MUKAMA!

rr: Amahanga gamanye ku bari abantu-buntu.
en: Selah.

rr: Ahabw'enki oyemereire hare, ai MUKAMA? Ahanki nooyeshereka omu biro by'obusaasi?
en: Why standest thou afar off, O LORD ? Why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble?

rr: Ahabw'amaryo omubi ahiiga munonga omworo; Ka bagwe omu naama ezi baagizire.
en: The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor: Let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined. (מ Mem)

rr: Ahakuba omubi ayehimbisa ahabw'ebi omutima gwe gwetenga; N'omwetengi w'ensaagi ayehakana MUKAMA, kandi amugaya.

en: The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek after God: God is not in all his thoughts.

rr: Ahiirwa omu mihanda ye obutoosha bwona; Okucwa emanja kwawe kumuri hare ahu atarikureeba; Abazigu be boona abeeshaanya.
en: His ways are always grievous; Thy judgments are far above out of his sight: As for all his enemies, he puffeth at them.

rr: Agira omu mutima gwe ati: Tindiihwa hu ndi; Ebiro byona tindigira by'okunnyangaraza.
en: He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: For I shall never be in adversity. (ס Samek) פ Pe

rr: Akanwa ke kaijwire okukyeena n'obugobya n'okubonabonesa; Ahansi y'orurimi rwe hariho eitima n'okutahikiirira.
en: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: Under his tongue is mischief and vanity.

rr: Agwera omu birorero; Omu myanya eyekiikire nimwo aitira abataine kabi; Amaisho ge agata aha bataine kihwera omu mubonano.
en: He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: ע Ain In the secret places doth he murder the innocent: His eyes are privily set against the poor.

rr: Agwera ayesherekire nk'entare eri omu ryaya ryayo; Agwera omuntu enshoberwa kumukwata; Kandi kwo amukwata, amukuruza ekigoye kye.
en: He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: He lieth in wait to catch the poor: (צ Zade) He doth catch the poor, when he draweth him into his net.

rr: Egyo nshoberwa eshekurwa, einama, Kandi ebandama ahabw'amaani ge.
en: He croucheth, and humbleth himself, That the poor may fall by his strong ones.

rr: Agira omu mutima gwe ati: Ruhanga ayebirwe, Akyehugize; tarikireeba.
en: He hath said in his heart, God hath forgotten: He hideth his face; he will never see it . ק Qoph

rr: Imuka, ari MUKAMA; imutsya omukono gwawe, ai Ruhanga; Oteebwa abari omu busaasi.
en: Arise, O LORD ; O God, lift up thine hand: Forget not the humble.

rr: Omubi agayira ki Ruhanga. Akagira omu mutima gwe ati: Tarikimbuuza?
en: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God? He hath said in his heart, Thou wilt not require it . ר Resh

rr: Okireebire; ahakuba oyetegyereza eitima n'okushaazya, Ngu obone kubikoraho n'omukono gwawe; Omuntu enshoberwa ayeta omu mikono yaawe; Ahakuba niiwe oshangwa oba omuhwezi w'efuuzi.
en: Thou hast seen it ; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite it with thy hand: The poor committeth himself unto thee; Thou art the helper of the fatherless. ש Shin

en: Break thou the arm of the wicked And the evil man: seek out his wickedness till thou find none.

rr: MUKAMA niwe Mugabe ebiro n'ebiro; Abanyamahanga baryahwera kimwe omu nsi ye.
en: The LORD is King for ever and ever: The heathen are perished out of his land. ת Taw

en: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, That the man of the earth may no more oppress.

en: But I have trusted in thy mercy; My heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.

en: I will sing unto the LORD , because he hath dealt bountifully with me.

-6 ; Omushema agira omu mutima gwe ati: Ruhanga tabaho.

en: They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, There is none that doeth good.

en: There were they in great fear: For God is in the generation of the righteous.

en: Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, Because the LORD is his refuge.

en: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion!

en: When the LORD bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

en: He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, and speaketh the truth in his heart.

en: But to the saints that are in the earth, And to the excellent, in whom is all my delight.

en: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten after another god: Their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, Nor take up their names into my lips.

en: The LORD is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: Thou maintainest my lot.

en: For thou wilt not leave my soul in hell; Neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.

en: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: In thy presence is fulness of joy; At thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.

rr: Omu by'emirimo y'abantu, ahabw'ekigambo ky'eminwa yaawe Nyetantaire emihanda y'abanyamwaga.
en: Concerning the works of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept me from the paths of the destroyer.

rr: Tinkarugaga mu mihanda yaawe, N'ebigyere byangye tibikateereraga.
en: Hold up my goings in thy paths, that my footsteps slip not.

rr: Ai Ruhanga, nkutakiire, ahakuba nimmanya ngu noija kungarukamu. Ontegye okutu, ohurire ebigambo byangye.
en: I have called upon thee, for thou wilt hear me, O God: Incline thine ear unto me, and hear my speech.

rr: Oyorekye embabazi zaawe ez'okutangaaza, Iwe Omujuni w'abo abasherura obuhungiro aha rubaju rwawe rwa buryo, Nibahunga abazigu baabo.
en: Shew thy marvellous lovingkindness, O thou that savest by thy right hand them which put their trust in thee From those that rise up against them .

rr: Ondinde nk'embone y'eriisho, Ombumbatire n'amapapa gaawe
en: Keep me as the apple of the eye, Hide me under the shadow of thy wings,

rr: Onkize ababi abannyaga, Nibo bazigu bangye abanyehinguririize, abarikwenda kuunyita.
en: From the wicked that oppress me, From my deadly enemies, who compass me about.

rr: Emitima yaabo terikwenda kusaasira; Akanwa kaabo kagamba eby'amaryo.
en: They are inclosed in their own fat: With their mouth they speak proudly.

rr: Bantangatangire, bambuza obutooro; Banzooreire amaisho kunteera ahansi.
en: They have now compassed us in our steps: They have set their eyes bowing down to the earth;

rr: Nibashusha nk'entare eine amairu g'eki erikwenda kwita, Nk'ekitsigazi ky'entare ekigwereire aheekiikire.
en: Like as a lion that is greedy of his prey, And as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.

rr: Imuka, ai MUKAMA, obatangye omumaisho, obatuure ahansi! Okize amagara gangye ababi na rurara yaawe
en: Arise, O LORD , disappoint him, cast him down: Deliver my soul from the wicked, which is thy sword:

rr: -11 ; . Ai MUKAMA, onjune abantu babi n'omukono gwawe, Abu omugabo gwabo guri ogw'ensi egi. Oijuze enda zaabo ebi waababiikiire, N'abaana baabo babihaagye, Kandi nabo babitsigire n'abeereere baabo.
en: From men which are thy hand, O LORD , from men of the world, Which have their portion in this life, and whose belly thou fillest with thy hid treasure: They are full of children, And leave the rest of their substance to their babes.

rr: Kwonka nyowe ndyakureeba aha maisho ndi ohikiriire; Ku ndisisiimuka, ndyamarwa okureeba oku orikushusha.
en: As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with thy likeness.

rr: Currently Selected: Zaaburi 17 : RR64 Highlight Share <div class="flex items-center justify-between p-[
Ninkukunda, ai MUKAMA, maani gangye.
en: I will love thee, O LORD , my strength.

rr: 2 MUKAMA n'orukiri rwangye, orugo rwangye orugumire, kandi Omujuni wangye; Ruhanga wangye, orukiri rwangye orugumire oru mpungiramu, Engabo yangye, eihembe ry'okujunwa kwangye, Kandi omunaara gwangye omuraingwa.
en: The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; My God, my strength, in whom I will trust; My buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.

rr: Ndyatakira MUKAMA oshemereire kuhimbisibwa; Obwo nibwo ndikira abazigu bangye.
en: I will call upon the LORD , who is worthy to be praised: So shall I be saved from mine enemies.

rr: Emigoye ya Rufu ekanzingazinga, N'emyegyemure y'okuhwerekyerera yantiinisa
en: The sorrows of death compassed me, And the floods of ungodly men made me afraid.

rr: Emigoye y'Okuzimu ekanzingazinga; Emitego ya Rufu yantanga omumaisho.
en: The sorrows of hell compassed me about: The snares of death prevented me.

rr: Omu busaasi bwangye naayeta MUKAMA, Naatakira Ruhanga wangye kumpa emikono; Yaahurira eiraka ryangye ari omuri hekalu ye, N'okurira kwangye kwahika omu matu ge.
en: In my distress I called upon the LORD , And cried unto my God: He heard my voice out of his temple, And my cry came before him, even into his ears.

rr: Bwanyima ensi yaatengyeta, yaatetema; N'emisingi y'ebibungo yaanyiganyiga, Yaatengyetsibwa ekiniga kye.
en: Then the earth shook and trembled; The foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was wroth.

rr: Omwika gukaruga omu nyindo ze, N'omu kanwa ke haarugamu omuriro ogurikurya busha, Gwayatsya amakara.
en: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, And fire out of his mouth devoured: Coals were kindled by it.

rr: Kandi akainamya eiguru, yaashuuma, Omwirima ndindindi guri ahansi y'ebigyere bye
en: He bowed the heavens also, and came down: And darkness was under his feet.

rr: Yaagaruka aheekirwe kerubi, Yaija naarahuka ari aha mapapa g'omuyaga.
en: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: Yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.

rr: Akahindura omwirima obweshereko nk'eihema erimwehinguririize, N'ebicu ebikwaitse, ebitimbire omwirima mwingi gw'enjura, Yaabigira eky'okumusangira.
en: He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him Were dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.

rr: Omu kumurinkana okwabaire kuri omu maisho ge Haarugamu orubaare n'amakara garikwaka nibiruga omu bicu bye.
en: At the brightness that was before him his thick clouds passed, Hail stones and coals of fire.

rr: 1 -9 ; . MUKAMA yaahindira omu iguru, Rukira-boona yaagamba n'eiraka rye, Haija orubaare n'amakara agarikwaka
en: The LORD also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave his voice; Hail stones and coals of fire.

rr: Yaarasha emyambi ye, yaabataataanisa, Niyo mirabyo ye mingi, yaababinga.
en: Yea, he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; And he shot out lightnings, and discomfited them.

rr: Obwo nibwo emikura y'amaizi yaareebwa, N'emisingi y'ensi ekashuuruuka Ahabw'okuhuuha kw'amaani okw'omwitsyo gw'omu nyindo zaawe.
en: Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered at thy rebuke, O LORD , At the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.

rr: Yankununkirira ari ahaiguru, yankwata, Yaanyiha omu maizi maingi
en: He sent from above, he took me, He drew me out of many waters.

rr: Yankiza omuzigu wangye ow'amaani, N'abo abaabaire nibaanyanga, ahakuba bakaba nibankiza amaani.
en: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them which hated me: For they were too strong for me.

rr: Bakampurira aha izooba ry'okureeberaho enaku; Kwonka MUKAMA yaaba obwegamo bwangye.
en: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: But the LORD was my stay.

rr: Taaziinyihamu, yanta omu mwanya ogugarami; Yanjuna, ahabw'okuba akaba nanshemerererwa.
en: He brought me forth also into a large place; He delivered me, because he delighted in me.

rr: MUKAMA akampa ebihembo nk'okuhikiirira kwangye oku kuri, Yanzimuurira nk'okushemera kw'emikono yangye oku kuri
en: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness; According to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.

rr: ahakuba nkagumira omu mihanda ya MUKAMA, Kandi tinkacumuraga kuruga ahari Ruhanga wangye.
en: For I have kept the ways of the LORD , And have not wickedly departed from my God.

rr: Ebiragiro bye byona bikaba biri omu maisho gangye, Tinkeetantaraga bi yaaragiire.
en: For all his judgments were before me, And I did not put away his statutes from me.

rr: Nkaba ntaine ky'okuhanwa omu maisho ge, Kandi nkeerinda okushiisha
en: I was also upright before him, And I kept myself from mine iniquity.

rr: Nikyo MUKAMA yaanyihuriire, nk'okuhikiirira kwangye oku kuri, Kandi akanzimuurira ebishemereire okushemera kw'emikono yangye omu maisho ge.
en: Therefore hath the LORD recompensed me according to my righteousness, According to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.

rr: Aha munyambabazi oyeyoreka ori ow'embabazi; Ahari ohikire oyeyoreka ori ohikire
en: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful; With an upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright;

rr: Ahari oshemeire oyeyoreka ori oshemeire; Aha mugomi oyeyoreka ogumire.
en: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; And with the froward thou wilt shew thyself froward.

rr: Ahakuba ojuna abacureezi; Konka ab'amaisho g'amaryo obagarura ahansi.
en: For thou wilt save the afflicted people; But wilt bring down high looks.

rr: Eego, niiwe okongyeza etabaaza yangye; MUKAMA Ruhanga wangye niwe ayakira omwirima gwangye.
en: For thou wilt light my candle: The LORD my God will enlighten my darkness.

rr: Eego, ahabwawe nimbaasa kurwanisa omutwe gw'engabo, Ahabw'okuhwerwa Ruhanga wangye nimbaasa kuguruka orugo.
en: For by thee I have run through a troop; And by my God have I leaped over a wall.
As for God, his way is perfect: The word of the LORD is tried: He is a buckler to all those that trust in him.

rr: Niwe Ruhanga onzirika amaani, Akashemeza omuhanda gwangye.
en: It is God that girdeth me with strength, And maketh my way perfect.

rr: Agira ebigyere byangye nk'eby'empara, Anyemereza aha nengo mpamire.
en: He maketh my feet like hinds' feet , And setteth me upon my high places.

rr: Ayegyesa engaro zangye okurwana, Ngu emikono yangye ebaase kureega obuta bw'omuringa.
en: He teacheth my hands to war, So that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.

rr: Ompaire engabo y'okujuna kwawe, N'omukono gwawe gwa buryo gumbangiire, Okutwaza gye kwawe kunkurize.
en: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: And thy right hand hath holden me up, and thy gentleness hath made me great.

rr: Ompanguhiize ah'okuraba, Ebigyere byangye tibyaterera.
en: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, That my feet did not slip.

rr: Nkakurata abazigu bangye, naabahika, Kandi tindagarukire okuhitsya obu baahweireho
en: I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken them: Neither did I turn again till they were consumed.

rr: Naabacumita, tibaabaasa kwimuka, Baagwa ahansi y'ebigyere byangye
en: I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: They are fallen under my feet.

rr: Ahakuba okanzirika amaani g'okurwana, Waagomoora abaabaire nibaija kundwanisa.
en: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle: Thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.

rr: Okareetera abazigu bangye kumpunga, Kandi n'abaabaire nibanyanga naabacwekyereza.
en: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies; That I might destroy them that hate me.

rr: Baataka, kwonka baabura kijuna; Baatakira MUKAMA, tiyaabagarukamu.
en: They cried, but there was none to save them: Even unto the LORD , but he answered them not.

rr: Naabateera, naabatuntumura nk'oku omuyaga gugira omucuucu; Naabanaga nk'ebyondo by'omu nguuto.
en: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind: I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets.

rr: -14 ; 19:9 , Okankiza okurwana n'amahanga, Wampindura omukuru waago; Naaheerezibwa abantu abu ntakamanyaga.
en: Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people; And thou hast made me the head of the heathen: A people whom I have not known shall serve me.

rr: Ahonaaho abanyamahanga, ku bampuriirre, Baanyorobera, baanyehongyera.
en: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: The strangers shall submit themselves unto me.

rr: Abo banyamahanga bakeehwa amatsiko, Baaruga omu bigo byabo nibatetema.
en: The strangers shall fade away, And be afraid out of their close places.

rr: MUKAMA n'ohuriire; Rukiri rwangye ahimbisibwe! Ruhanga ow'okujunwa kwangye aheebwe ekitiinisa.
en: The LORD liveth; and blessed be my rock; And let the God of my salvation be exalted.

rr: Niwe Ruhanga owampooreire, Akangomoorera amahanga
en: It is God that avengeth me, And subdueth the people under me.

rr: Akankiza abazigu; Eego, okanta ahaiguru y'abarikundwanisa, Waanyiha omu mikono y'abanyamwaga.
en: He delivereth me from mine enemies: Yea, thou liftest me up above those that rise up against me: Thou hast delivered me from the violent man.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo, ai MUKAMA, ndyakusiimira omu mahanga, Kandi nyeshongore eby'okuhimbisa eiziina ryawe.
en: Therefore will I give thanks unto thee, O LORD , among the heathen, And sing praises unto thy name.

rr: Omugabe ou yaataireho amuha obusinguzi bwingi, Kandi ayoreka ou yaashukireho amajuta embabazi, Niwe Daudi n'abaijukuru ebiro n'ebiro.
en: Great deliverance giveth he to his king; And sheweth mercy to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.
