rr: Eiguru rimanyisa ekitiinisa kya Ruhanga, N'omwanya gw'ahaiguru gworeka emirimo y'emikono ye.
en: The heavens declare the glory of God; And the firmament sheweth his handywork.

rr: Nyomushana egambira nyomushana endiijo ebigambo, N'ekiro kimanyisa ekindi kiro obwengye.
en: Day unto day uttereth speech, And night unto night sheweth knowledge.

rr: Tihariho rurimi, n'obu byakuba ebigambo; Amaraka gaabyo tigahurirwa.
en: There is no speech nor language, Where their voice is not heard.

rr: Kwonka eiraka ryabyo ribuga ensi yoona, Kandi n'ebigambo byabyo bihika aha muheru gw'ensi.
en: Their line is gone out through all the earth, And their words to the end of the world.

rr: Omuribyo nimwo yaateire eihema ahabw'eizooba
en: In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun,

rr: Riri nka kishwera oku ashohora omu kishengye kye, Rishemererwa nk'ow'amaani, niriraba omu rugyendo rwaryo.
en: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, and rejoiceth as a strong man to run a race.

rr: Riruga aha muheru gw'eiguru, Ryehinguririza, rihika aha gundi; Tihariho kisherekwa okwotsya kwaryo.
en: His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it: And there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.

rr: Ekiragiro kya MUKAMA kihikire, Kigarura omutima omunda; n'eby'okwesigwa, Biha obwengye otabwine
en: The law of the LORD is perfect, converting the soul: The testimony of the LORD is sure, making wise the simple.

rr: Eby'okwegyesa bya MUKAMA bihikire, Bigwisa gye omutima; Ekiragiro kya MUKAMA kishemeire, Kihwezesa amaisho
en: The statutes of the LORD are right, rejoicing the heart: The commandment of the LORD is pure, enlightening the eyes.

rr: Okutiina MUKAMA ni kurungi, Kugumaho ebiro byona; Ebi MUKAMA aragiira n'eby'amazima, Kandi n'eby'okuhikiirira buzima.
en: The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring for ever: The judgments of the LORD are true and righteous altogether.

rr: Bishemereire kwetengwa okukira ezaabu, Nangwa n'ezaabu enungi munonga; Binuzire okukira obwoki, Oburikutoonya niburuga omu ngabo yaabwo.
en: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold: Sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.

rr: Kandi nibyo bihabura omwiru waawe, N'omu kubyorobera harimu ebihembo bingi.
en: Moreover by them is thy servant warned: And in keeping of them there is great reward.

rr: N'oha orikubaasa kumanya ebishobyo bye? Onshemezeho ebibi ebisherekirwe.
en: Who can understand his errors? Cleanse thou me from secret faults .

rr: Kandi ozibire omwiru waawe kukora ebibi nkana; Otabiikiriza kuntegyeka! Obwo ndyaba otaine ky'okuhanwa, Kandi tindigira rubanja rw'okushiisha okuhinguraine.
en: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous sins ; Let them not have dominion over me: Then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.

rr: Ebigambo by'omu kanwa kangye, N'okuteekateeka kw'omu mutima gwangye Bisiimwe omu maisho gaawe, Ai MUKAMA, orukiri rwangye, kandi omucunguzi wangye.
en: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD , my strength, and my redeemer.

rr: MUKAMA akugarukyemu aha izooba ry'okureeberaho enaku, Eiziina rya Ruhanga wa Yakobo rikurinde!
en: The LORD hear thee in the day of trouble; The name of the God of Jacob defend thee;

rr: Akutwekyere okuhwera okurikuruga omu Mwanya ogurikwera, Akuhe amaani agarikuruga omuri Saayuuni.
en: Send thee help from the sanctuary, And strengthen thee out of Zion;

rr: Aijukye empongano zaawe zoona, aikirize ebitambo byawe ebyokize!
en: Remember all thy offerings, And accept thy burnt sacrifice; Selah.

rr: Akuhe eki omutima gwawe gurikwetenga, Kandi ahikiirize enaama zaawe zoona!
en: Grant thee according to thine own heart, And fulfil all thy counsel.

rr: Turyateera akaari k'okushemerererwa okusingura kwawe, Kandi omu iziina rya Ruhanga waitu turyaimutsya endango zaitu. MUKAMA ahikiirize ebi orikushaba byona!
en: We will rejoice in thy salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up our banners: The LORD fulfil all thy petitions.

rr: Mbwenu nimmanyira kimwe ngu MUKAMA aryahwera ou yaashukireho amajuta, Amugarukyemu, naayema omu iguru rye eririkwera, N'obusinguzi bw'amaani g'omukono gwe gwa buryo.
en: Now know I that the LORD saveth his anointed; He will hear him from his holy heaven With the saving strength of his right hand.

rr: Abamwe beesiga ebigaari by'okurwanisa, n'abandi beesiga embaraasi, Kwonka itwe twesiga eiziina rya MUKAMA Ruhanga waitu.
en: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: But we will remember the name of the LORD our God.

rr: Bo baryainama, bagwe; Kwonka itwe turyaimuka, twemerere tuhamire.
en: They are brought down and fallen: But we are risen, and stand upright.

rr: Ai MUKAMA, ohe omugabe okusingura; Kandi ku turaakutakire, otuhurire.
en: Save, LORD : Let the king hear us when we call.
Currently Selected: Psalm 20 : KJV Highlight Share <path d="M5 12a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h3a1 1 0 1 1 0 2H6a1 1 0 0 1-1-1ZM5 15a

rr: Ai MUKAMA, omugabe naayesiimira amaani gaawe; Eshi okuhwera kwawe naakushemerererwa munonga!
en: The king shall joy in thy strength, O LORD ; And in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!

rr: Omuhaire eki omutima gwe gurikwetenga, Kandi tomwimire ki eminwa ye eshabire.
en: Thou hast given him his heart's desire, And hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.

rr: Ahakuba omubuganiise eby'emigisha ebirungi, Waamujweka ekirunga ky'ezaabu enungi aha mutwe.
en: For thou preventest him with the blessings of goodness: Thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head.

rr: Akakushaba amagara, waagamuha, Nikwo kumereera ebiro n'ebiro.
en: He asked life of thee, and thou gavest it him, Even length of days for ever and ever.

rr: Ekitiinisa kye ni kingi ahabw'okuhwera kwawe, Kandi omujwekire okusiimwa n'obukuru.
en: His glory is great in thy salvation: Honour and majesty hast thou laid upon him.

rr: Omuhaire emigisha mingi ebiro byona, Kandi omunanwire n'okushemererwa ahabw'okuguma omu maisho gaawe
en: For thou hast made him most blessed for ever: Thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance.

rr: Ahakuba omugabe ayesiga MUKAMA; Kandi ahabw'embabazi za Rukira-boona taritengyetsibwa.
en: For the king trusteth in the LORD , And through the mercy of the Most High he shall not be moved.

rr: Omukono gwawe guryagwa aha bazigu baawe boona, Omukono gwawe gwa buryo guryakwata abarikukwanga.
en: Thine hand shall find out all thine enemies: Thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.

rr: Oryabagira nk'ekikoomi ekirikubuguma omu biro by'ekiniga kyawe; MUKAMA aryabamira n'ekiniga kye, Kandi omuriro guryabamaraho.
en: Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger: The LORD shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.

rr: Oruzaaro rwabo oryarumara omu nsi, Na baijukuru baabo obamare omu baana b'abantu.
en: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, And their seed from among the children of men.

rr: N'obu barihanuura kukukora kubi, Bakakugiraho enaama mbi, tibaribaasa.
en: For they intended evil against thee: They imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform .

rr: Oryababinga bakuhungye, Otaire emyambi yaawe omu buta ogyorekyeize aha maisho gaabo.
en: Therefore shalt thou make them turn their back, When thou shalt make ready thine arrows upon thy strings against the face of them.

rr: Ohimbisibwe, ai MUKAMA, omu maani gaawe; Naitwe turyayeshongora tusingize obushoboorozi bwawe.
en: Be thou exalted, LORD , in thine own strength: So will we sing and praise thy power.

rr: Ruhanga wangye, Ruhanga wangye, n'enki ekyakuntsigisaho? ahabw'enki ori hare, otarikumpwera, kandi otarikuhurira bigambo by'okutsinda kwangye?
en: My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? Why art thou so far from helping me, and from the words of my roaring?

rr: Ai bambe Ruhanga wangye, nkutakira nyomushana, tongarukamu; Kandi na nyekiro, timpunama.
en: O my God, I cry in the daytime, but thou hearest not; And in the night season, and am not silent.

rr: Kwonka Iwe ori Orikwera, Iwe otuura aha kitebe ky'okuhimbisa kwa Israeli.
en: But thou art holy, O thou that inhabitest the praises of Israel.

rr: Baatatenkuriitwe bakakwesiga; Ku baakwesigire, waabajuna.
en: Our fathers trusted in thee: They trusted, and thou didst deliver them.

rr: Bakakutakira, waabakiza; Bakakwesiga, tibaayefuuza.
en: They cried unto thee, and were delivered: They trusted in thee, and were not confounded.

rr: Kwonka nyowe ndi omunyongororwa, tindi muntu, Ou abantu bajuma, kandi ogaywa boona.
en: But I am a worm, and no man; A reproach of men, and despised of the people.

rr: Boona abandeeba banshekyerera, Banteerera enaku n'eminwa yaabo, nibazongoza emitwe
en: All they that see me laugh me to scorn: They shoot out the lip, they shake the head, saying ,

rr: Nibagira bati: Akeesiga Ruhanga; mbwenu naamujune; Amukize, ahakuba amushemerererwa.
en: He trusted on the LORD that he would deliver him: Let him deliver him, seeing he delighted in him.

rr: Kwonka niiwe waanyihire omu nda ya maawe, Kandi okandinda nkiri aha mabeere.
en: But thou art he that took me out of the womb: Thou didst make me hope when I was upon my mother's breasts.

rr: Okwiha obu naazarwa, niiwe nyegamira; Okwiha obu maawe yanzaara, niiwe oba Ruhanga wangye.
en: I was cast upon thee from the womb: Thou art my God from my mother's belly.

rr: Otanza hare, ahakuba akabi kari haihi; Kandi tiinyine kihwera.
en: Be not far from me; for trouble is near; For there is none to help.

rr: Enimi nyingi ziinyehinguririize; Enimi z'amaani eza Bashani zintangatangire
en: Many bulls have compassed me: Strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.

rr: Ziinyashamiire, Nk'entare esheegire, erikutsinda.
en: They gaped upon me with their mouths, As a ravening and a roaring lion.

rr: Nyatikire nk'amaizi, Amagufa gangye goona gataine; Omutima gwangye guri nk'entsinda, Niguyagira omu kifuba kyangye.
en: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: My heart is like wax; It is melted in the midst of my bowels.

rr: Amaani gampweiremu, nyomire nk'orugusyo, Orurimi rundamatiire aha nkanka; Ontaire omu mucuucu gw'okufa.
en: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; And my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; And thou hast brought me into the dust of death.

rr: Embwa ziinyehinguririize, Omutwe gw'enkozi z'ebibi guntaire ahagati; Banfumwire ebiganja n'ebigyere.
en: For dogs have compassed me: The assembly of the wicked have inclosed me: They pierced my hands and my feet.

rr: Nimbaasa kubara amagufa gangye goona; Banteireho amaisho nibanshamaarira
en: I may tell all my bones: They look and stare upon me.

rr: Baabagana eby'okujwara byangye, Baateerera enteenyu ekijwaro kyangye.
en: They part my garments among them, And cast lots upon my vesture.

rr: Kwonka ai MUKAMA, otaza hare! Iwe omuhwezi wangye, rahuka ompe emikono!
en: But be not thou far from me, O LORD : O my strength, haste thee to help me.

rr: Onkize rurara, Amagara gangye ogaihe omu maani g'embwa!
en: Deliver my soul from the sword; My darling from the power of the dog.

rr: Onjune omu kanwa k'entare, N'amagara gangye agarikubonabona ogaihe omu mahembe g'embogo!
en: Save me from the lion's mouth: For thou hast heard me from the horns of the unicorns.

rr: Ndyagambira ab'eishe-emwe eiziina ryawe; Nkuhimbisize ahagati omu mutwe gw'abantu.
en: I will declare thy name unto my brethren: In the midst of the congregation will I praise thee.

rr: Imwe abatiina MUKAMA, mumuhimbise! Naimwe oruzaaro rwa Yakobo, mumuhe ekitiinisa, Kandi imwe baijukuru ba Israeli mwena, mumutiine!
en: Ye that fear the LORD , praise him; All ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him; And fear him, all ye the seed of Israel.

rr: Ahakuba takagayaga n'obu kwakuba okunuga Okubonabona kw'orikubonabonesibwa; Kandi takamwimaga maisho, Kureka ku yaamutakiire, yaamuhurira.
en: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; Neither hath he hid his face from him; But when he cried unto him, he heard.

rr: Ahariiwe niho okuhimbisa kwangye kuruga, oku nkuhimbisiza omu mutwe muhango gw'abantu; Ndyahikiiriza okuhiga kwangye omu maisho g'abarikumutiina.
en: My praise shall be of thee in the great congregation: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.

rr: Abacureezi baryarya, bahaagye, N'abasherura MUKAMA baryamuhimbisa. Emitima yaanyu emereere ebiro byona.
en: The meek shall eat and be satisfied: They shall praise the LORD that seek him: Your heart shall live for ever.

rr: Ab'embaju zoona ez'ensi baryaijuka, Bahindukire MUKAMA; N'enganda zoona ez'amahanga ziryaramiza omu maisho ge
en: All the ends of the world shall remember and turn unto the LORD : And all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before thee.

rr: Oba 21 ; . Ahakuba obutegyeki n'obwa MUKAMA, Kandi niwe ategyeka amahanga.
en: For the kingdom is the LORD 's: And he is the governor among the nations.

rr: Eego, abanyamaryo boona ab'omu nsi baryamwinamira, N'abashuuma omu mucuucu boona baryainama omu maisho ge, Omuntu weena otarikubaasa kuzibira amagara ge kufa.
en: All they that be fat upon earth shall eat and worship: All they that go down to the dust shall bow before him: And none can keep alive his own soul.

rr: Abaijukuru baryamuheereza, Abantu bayragambira ab'obusingye oburikurataho ebya MUKAMA
en: A seed shall serve him; It shall be accounted to the LORD for a generation.

rr: Bamanyise abantu abarizaarwa okuhikiirira kwe, Ku niwe yaakikozire.
en: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness Unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done this .

rr: MUKAMA niwe muriisa wangye, tindikyena kintu kyona.
en: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

rr: Ambyamya omu iriisizo ry'obunyaatsi buto, Antwara aha rubaju rw'amaizi agarikusheneneka
en: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: He leadeth me beside the still waters.

rr: Agarura amaani omu magara gangye. Anyebembera omu mihanda y'okuhikiirira ahabw'eiziina rye.
en: He restoreth my soul: He leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.

rr: N'obu ndiraba omu ruhanga rw'ekibunda ky'okufa, Tinditiina kabi koona, Ahabw'okuba ori hamwe naanye; Oruga rwawe n'enkoni yaawe bimpuumuza.
en: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; Thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.

rr: Ontebeekanisiza emeeza omu maisho g'abazigu bangye, Onshuka amajuta aha mutwe, Ekikopo kyangye kiijwire nikisheesheka.
en: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: Thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.

rr: Buzimazima oburungi n'embabazi biryaguma naanye Ebiro byona eby'amagara gangye; Naanye ndyaguma omu nju ya MUKAMA Ebiro n'ebiro.
en: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: And I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.

rr: Ensi n'eya MUKAMA n'ebirimu byona, Ensi yoona n'abagituuramu
en: The earth is the LORD 's, and the fulness thereof; The world, and they that dwell therein.

rr: Ahakuba akata emisingi yaayo aha nyanja, Yaagihamiza aha migyera y'amaizi maingi.
en: For he hath founded it upon the seas, And established it upon the floods.

rr: N'oha oritemba aha kibungo kya MUKAMA? Kandi oryemerera omu mwanya gwe ogurikwera n'oha?
en: Who shall ascend into the hill of the LORD ? Or who shall stand in his holy place?

rr: Nogwo oine engaro ezishemeziibwe n'omutima ogushemeire, Otata mutima gwe ha by'ebishuba, Kandi otarahira by'obubobya.
en: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; Who hath not lifted up his soul unto vanity, nor sworn deceitfully.

rr: Ogwo niwe ariheebwa omugisha kuruga ahari MUKAMA, N'okuhikiirira kuruga ahari Ruhanga ow'okujunwa kwe.
en: He shall receive the blessing from the LORD , And righteousness from the God of his salvation.

rr: Abamusherura n'abari nk'ogwo, Abenda kureeba amaisho ga Ruhanga wa Yakobo.
en: This is the generation of them that seek him, That seek thy face, O Jacob. Selah.

rr: Imwe marembo 'mwe, nimwimutsye emitwe yaanyu, Naimwe enyigi eza ira, mwimukye, Mukama w'ekitiinisa abone kutaahamu.
en: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; And be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors; And the King of glory shall come in.

rr: Ogwo Mukama w'ekitiinisa n'oha? Ni MUKAMA ow'amaani, ow'obushoboorozi, MUKAMA ow'obushboorozi omu kurwana.
en: Who is this King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.

rr: Imwe marembo 'mwe, nimwimutsye emitwe yaanyu, Naimwe enyigi eza ira, mwimukye, MUKAMA w'ekitiinisa abone kutaahamu.
en: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; even lift them up, ye everlasting doors; And the King of glory shall come in.

rr: Ai MUKAMA, niiwe nyimukiza omutima.
en: Unto thee, O LORD , do I lift up my soul.

rr: Ai Ruhanga wangye, niiwe nyesiga; Otandeka kwitwa enshoni, Otaikiriza abazigu bangye kuunyehimbisizaho.
en: O my God, I trust in thee: ב Bet Let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me. ג Gimel

rr: Eego, otaikiriza weena orikukutegyereza kwitwa enshoni; Abareebeza abandi busha bakwatwe enshoni.
en: Yea, let none that wait on thee be ashamed: Let them be ashamed which transgress without cause. ד Dalet

rr: Ompabure emihanda yaawe, ai MUKAMA; Kandi onyegyese emitwarize yaawe.
en: Shew me thy ways, O LORD ; Teach me thy paths. ה He

rr: Onyebembere omu mazima gaawe, kandi onyegyese, ahakuba niiwe Ruhanga w'okujunwa kwangye; Niiwe ntegyereza eizooba ryona.
en: Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: (ו Waw) For thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day. ז Zain

rr: Ai MUKAMA, ijuka okusaasira kwawe n'embabazi zaawe, Ahakuba bikaba biriho okuruga ira ryona.
en: Remember, O LORD , thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindnesses; For they have been ever of old. ח Het

rr: Otaijuka ebibi by'obutsigazi bwangye, n'obu byakuba eby'okushiisha byangye; Onyijukye nk'embabazi zaawe oku ziri, Ahabw'oburungi bwawe, ai MUKAMA.
en: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: According to thy mercy remember thou me for thy goodness' sake, O LORD . ט Tet

rr: MUKAMA ni murungi kandi ow'amazima; Nikyo ahaburira abasiisi omuhanda.
en: Good and upright is the LORD : Therefore will he teach sinners in the way. י Yod

rr: Abacureezi abeebembera omu by'oburyo, Kandi abeegyesa omuhanda gwe.
en: The meek will he guide in judgment: And the meek will he teach his way. כ Kaph

rr: Emihanda yoona eya MUKAMA n'embabazi n'amazima Ahari abo abarinda endagaano ye n'ebi yahamize.
en: All the paths of the LORD are mercy and truth Unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies. ל Lamed

rr: Ahabw'eiziina ryawe, ai MUKAMA, Saasira okushiisha kwangye, ahabw'okuba ni kwingi.
en: For thy name's sake, O LORD , Pardon mine iniquity; for it is great. מ Mem

rr: Omuntu orikutiina MUKAMA n'oha? Ogwo niwe aryegyesa omuhanda ogu ashemereire kutoora.
en: What man is he that feareth the LORD ? Him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose. נ Nun

rr: Amagara ge garyaguma omu busingye, Kandi abaana be baryahungura ensi.
en: His soul shall dwell at ease; And his seed shall inherit the earth. ס Samek

rr: Emibonano ya MUKAMA emanywa abarikumutiina, Kandi aryabooreka endagaano ze.
en: The secret of the LORD is with them that fear him; And he will shew them his covenant. ע Ain

rr: Amaisho gangye ntuura ngahangire MUKAMA, Ahakuba niwe ariiha ebigyere byangye omu mutego.
en: Mine eyes are ever toward the LORD ; For he shall pluck my feet out of the net. פ Pe

rr: Ompindukire, ongirire embabazi, Ahakuba tiinyine ifo na ruguru, kandi nimbonabona.
en: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; For I am desolate and afflicted. צ Zade

rr: Otuubye enaku z'omu mutima gwangye, Onyihe omu busaasi bwangye.
en: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: O bring thou me out of my distresses. (ק Qoph)

rr: Reeba okubonabona kwangye n'enaku zangye, Onsaasire ebibi byangye byona.
en: Look upon mine affliction and my pain; And forgive all my sins. ר Resh

rr: Reeba abazigu bangye ku bari baingi, Kandi ku barikuunyanga okwanga okubi.
en: Consider mine enemies; for they are many; And they hate me with cruel hatred. ש Shin

rr: Okuhikiirira n'amazima bindinde, Ahabw'okuba nkutegyereize.
en: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; For I wait on thee.

rr: Ai Ruhanga, cungura Israeli, Omwihe omu naku ze zoona.
en: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.

rr: Oncwere orubanja, ai MUKAMA, Ahakuba okuhikiirira kwangye nikwo ngyendeiremu, Kandi nyesigire MUKAMA ntarikubanganisa.
en: Judge me, O LORD ; for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in the LORD ; therefore I shall not slide.

rr: Onshwijume, ai MUKAMA, ongyeze; Orengye omutima gwangye n'obwengye bwangye.
en: Examine me, O LORD , and prove me; Try my reins and my heart.

rr: Ahakuba embabazi zaawe ziri omu maisho gangye, Kandi ngyendeire omu mazima gaawe.
en: For thy lovingkindness is before mine eyes: And I have walked in thy truth.

rr: Tinshutama na bantu bataine mugasho, Kandi tinkwatanisa na ndyarya.
en: I have not sat with vain persons, Neither will I go in with dissemblers.

rr: Nyanga omutwe gw'enkozi z'ebibi, Kandi tindishutama na basiisi.
en: I have hated the congregation of evil doers; And will not sit with the wicked.

rr: Nnaabisa engaro zangye ntaine rubanja, Ngu mbone kwehinguririza eitambiro ryawe, ai MUKAMA
en: I will wash mine hands in innocency: So will I compass thine altar, O LORD :

rr: Niinyeshongora munonga eby'okusiima, Nimaamnyisa emirimo yaawe yoona erikutangaaza.
en: That I may publish with the voice of thanksgiving, And tell of all thy wondrous works.

rr: MUKAMA, nkunda oburaaro bw'omu nju yaawe, N'ahi ekitiinisa kyawe kituura.
en: LORD , I have loved the habitation of thy house, And the place where thine honour dwelleth.

rr: Otampwerekyereza n'abanyabibi, N'obu gaakuba amagara gangye n'abasheesha eshagama
en: Gather not my soul with sinners, Nor my life with bloody men:

rr: Abu emikono yaabo eine eitima, Kandi abu emikono yaabo eya buryo eijwire enguzi.
en: In whose hands is mischief, And their right hand is full of bribes.

rr: Kwonka nyowe ndyagyendera omu kuhikiirira kwangye; Oncungure, ongirire embabazi.
en: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: Redeem me, and be merciful unto me.

rr: MUKAMA niwe mushana gwangye kandi okujunwa kwangye; N'oha ou nditiina?
en: The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear?

rr: MUKAMA niwe maani g'amagara gangye; Orintiinisa n'oha?
en: The LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

rr: Enkozi z'ebibi ku zampururiire kummira, Nibo bazigu bangye n'abarikuunyanga, Bakateera entsibo, baagwa.
en: When the wicked, even mine enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my flesh, They stumbled and fell.

rr: N'obu engabo zaakuteeka enteeko kundwanisa, Omutima gwangye tigukaatiina; N'obu orugamba rwakumbaho, hoona nabwo nkaaguma omutima.
en: Though an host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear: Though war should rise against me, in this will I be confident.

rr: Ekigambo eki nshabire MUKAMA ni kimwe, Kandi nikyo ndiguma ninsherura; Nikwo kuguma omu nju ya MUKAMA ebiro byona eby'amagara gangye, Okureeba oburungi bwa MUKAMA, n'okwehanuuza omuri hekalu ye.
en: One thing have I desired of the LORD , that will I seek after; That I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, To behold the beauty of the LORD , and to enquire in his temple.

rr: Ahakuba aha izooba ry'okureeberaho enaku aryandindira omu mubonano omu kibanda kye, Omu bweshereko bw'eihema rye nimwo arinshereka, Akanyimutsya, akanyemereza aha rukiri.
en: For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion: In the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me; he shall set me up upon a rock.

rr: Na mbwenu hati omutwe gwangye nigwija kutunguurwa, Gube ahiguru y'abazigu bangye abandi embaju zoona; Ndyahonga ebitambo omu ihema rye n'okwesiima, Nyeshongore; eego nyeshongorere MUKAMA eby'okumuhimbisa.
en: And now shall mine head be lifted up, Above mine enemies round about me: Therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto the LORD .

rr: Hurira, ai MUKAMA, ku ndaakutakire n'eiraka rihango, Ongirire embabazi, kandi ongarukyemu.
en: Hear, O LORD , when I cry with my voice: Have mercy also upon me, and answer me.

rr: Ku waagizire oti: Musherure amaisho gangye, Omutima gwangye gwakugarukamu guti: Ai MUKAMA, amaisho gaawe nigo ndiguma ninsherura.
en: When thou saidst , Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, LORD , will I seek.

rr: Otanyima amaisho, otabinga omwiru waawe n'ekiniga; Niiwe waabaire ori Omuhwezi wangye; Otannaga, n'obu kwakub aokuntsigaho, Ai Ruhanga ow'okujunwa kwangye.
en: Hide not thy face far from me; Put not thy servant away in anger: Thou hast been my help; Leave me not, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.

rr: Tata na maawe bantsigireho, Kwonka MUKAMA naija kuunyanduura.
en: When my father and my mother forsake me, Then the LORD will take me up.

rr: Onyegyese omuhanda gwawe, ai MUKAMA, Onyebembere omu muhanda ogutarikuhabya ahabw'abazigu bangye.
en: Teach me thy way, O LORD , And lead me in a plain path, because of mine enemies.

rr: Otareka ababisha bangye kunkora eki barikwenda, Ahakuba baakareebi b'ebishuba baanyimukiriire, Nibagamba n'amaani eby'okuntiinisa.
en: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine enemies: For false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out cruelty.

rr: Nkaagwire enshazi, kuri ntaraikiriize kureeba oburungi bwa MUKAMA Omu nsi y'abahuriire
en: I had fainted , Unless I had believed to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.

rr: Ai MUKAMA, niiwe ndikutakira; Iwe Rukiri rwangye, otaanyetsiza; Ahakuba ku waakuunyetsiza, Nkaaba nk'abarikushuuma omu Kiina.
en: Unto thee will I cry, O LORD my rock; be not silent to me: Lest, if thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.

rr: Ohurire eiraka ry'okweshengyereza kwangye, Ku ndaakutakire niinyimutsya emikono yangye, Ngyorekyeize Omwanya gwawe ogurikwera munonga.
en: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, When I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle.

rr: Otantwarirana n'abasiisi n'enkozi z'ebibi, Abagamba gye na bataahi baabo, Kwonka baine eitima omu mitima yaabo.
en: Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, Which speak peace to their neighbours, but mischief is in their hearts.

rr: Obazimuurire ebishemereire emirimo yaabo, Kandi nk'obubi bw'emicwe yaabo oku buri; Obahe nk'ebi bakozire n'engaro zaabo oku biri, Obaihure ebibashemereire.
en: Give them according to their deeds, And according to the wickedness of their endeavours: Give them after the work of their hands; Render to them their desert.

rr: Ahakuba tibata mutima ha mirimo ya MUKAMA, Nari aha bi emikono ye ekora; Aryabasheenya, taribombeka bundi.
en: Because they regard not the works of the LORD , nor the operation of his hands, He shall destroy them, and not build them up.

rr: MUKAMA ahimbisibwe, Ahakuba ahuriire eiraka ry'okweshengyereza kwangye.
en: Blessed be the LORD , Because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.

rr: MUKAMA niwe maani gangye, kandi engabo yangye; Omutima gwangye gumwesigire, naahwerwa; Nikyo omutima gwangye gushemerererwa munonga, Nkamusingiza n'ekyeshongoro kyangye.
en: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: Therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.

rr: MUKAMA n'amaani g'abantu be, Niwe buhungiro oburikujuna ou yaashukireho amajuta.
en: The LORD is their strength, And he is the saving strength of his anointed.

rr: Juna abantu baawe, n'obuhunguzi bwawe obuhe omugisha; Obe omuriisa waabo, kandi obaramire ebiro byona.
en: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: Feed them also, and lift them up for ever.

en: Give unto the LORD , O ye mighty, give unto the LORD glory and strength.

rr: Muhe MUKAMA ekitiinisa ekishemereire eiziina rye; Muramye MUKAMA, mujwaire eby'okuhikiirira.
en: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name; Worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.

rr: Eiraka rya MUKAMA rigambira aha maizi, Ruhanga ow'ekitiinisa ahinda, Niwe MUKAMA ohindira aha maizi maingi.
en: The voice of the LORD is upon the waters: The God of glory thundereth: The LORD is upon many waters.

rr: Eiraka rya MUKAMA n'ery'amaani, Eiraka rya MUKAMA riijwire ekitiinisa.
en: The voice of the LORD is powerful; The voice of the LORD is full of majesty.

rr: Eiraka rya MUKAMA rihenda ebiti by'emyereezi; Eego, MUKAMA ahenda ebiti bya Lebanooni eby'emyereezi.
en: The voice of the LORD breaketh the cedars; Yea, the LORD breaketh the cedars of Lebanon.

rr: Akinisa Lebanooni nk'enyana, Na Sirioni nk'enyana y'embogo.
en: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.

rr: Eiraka rya MUKAMA ribaganisa endimi z'omuriro.
en: The voice of the LORD divideth the flames of fire.

rr: Eiraka rya MUKAMA ritengyetsa eihamba, MUKAMA atengyetsa eihamba rya Kadeshi.
en: The voice of the LORD shaketh the wilderness; the LORD shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.

rr: Eiraka rya MUKAMA ritoroozya empara, rikonkobora ebibira; Kandi omuri hekalu ye byona bigira biti: Oheebwe ekitiinisa.
en: The voice of the LORD maketh the hinds to calve, and discovereth the forests: And in his temple doth every one speak of his glory.

rr: MUKAMA akashutama aha kitebe ky'obukama bwe ha mwegyemure gw'amaizi; Eego, MUKAMA atuura ari Omukama ebiro byona.
en: The LORD sitteth upon the flood; Yea, the LORD sitteth King for ever.

rr: MUKAMA aryaha abantu be amaani; MUKAMA aryaha abantu be omugisha gw'obusingye.
en: The LORD will give strength unto his people; The LORD will bless his people with peace.

en: I will extol thee, O LORD ; for thou hast lifted me up, And hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.

rr: Ai MUKAMA Ruhanga wangye, Nkakutakira, wankiza.
en: O LORD my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.

en: O LORD , thou hast brought up my soul from the grave: Thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

rr: Imwe abarikwera be, mweshongorere MUKAMA eby'okuhimbisa, Kandi musiime eiziina rye eririkwera.
en: Sing unto the LORD , O ye saints of his, And give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.

rr: Ahakuba ekiniga kye n'eky'akaanya kakye, Kwonka embabazi ze zigumaho ebiro byona eby'amagara g'omuntu. Okurira kukaaraarira omuntu nyekiro, Kwonka okushemererwa kwija omu kasheeshe.
en: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: Weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.

rr: Nyowe omu biro by'okuhiirwa kwangye nkagira nti: Tinditengyetsibwa ebiro byona.
en: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.

rr: Iwe MUKAMA, ahabw'embabazi zaawe okangumya nk'ekibungo; Ku wanyimire amaisho naaburaburirwa
en: LORD , by thy favour thou hast made my mountain to stand strong: Thou didst hide thy face, and I was troubled.

rr: Naakutakira, ai MUKAMA; Kandi niiwe naayeshengyereza, nkeebuuza nti
en: I cried to thee, O LORD ; And unto the LORD I made supplication.

rr: Ku ndishuuma omu Kiina, eshagama yangye eryangasira ki? Omucuucu guryakuhimbisa, nari gumanyise amazima gaawe?
en: What profit is there in my blood, When I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? Shall it declare thy truth?

rr: Hurira, ai MUKAMA, ongirire embabazi! MUKAMA, ogume ori Omuhwezi wangye!
en: Hear, O LORD , and have mercy upon me: LORD , be thou my helper.

rr: Okucura kwangye okakuhindura okuzina; Okanzirikuurura ekiguniya, wanzirika okushemererwa
en: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: Thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;

rr: Ngu amagara gangye gakuhimbise, garekye kuhunama.
en: To the end that my glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent.

rr: Ai MUKAMA Ruhanga wangye, ndyakusiima ebiro byona.
en: O LORD my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.

rr: Ai MUKAMA, niiwe ndikwesiga, otarindeka kuhemuka ebiro byona; Onjune ahabw'okuhikiirira kwawe.
en: In thee, O LORD , do I put my trust; Let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy righteousness.

rr: Ontegye okutu, orahukye kunjuna; Ombeere orukiri rw'okuhungiramu, kandi orugo rugumire orw'okunjuna.
en: Bow down thine ear to me; deliver me speedily: Be thou my strong rock, for an house of defence to save me.

rr: Eego niiwe rukiri rwangye, kandi orugo rwangye orugumire; Ahabw'eiziina ryawe onyebembere, kandi ompabure
en: For thou art my rock and my fortress; Therefore for thy name's sake lead me, and guide me.

rr: Onyihe omu mutego ogu bantegire, Ahakuba niiwe buhungiro bwangye.
en: Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: For thou art my strength.

rr: Ninta omwoyo gwangye omu mikono yaawe; Okancungura, ai MUKAMA, iwe Ruhanga orikwesigwa.
en: Into thine hand I commit my spirit: Thou hast redeemed me, O LORD God of truth.

rr: Nyanga abata omutima aha bishushani ebirikuramibwa ebitaine mugasho; Kandi nyesiga MUKAMA.
en: I have hated them that regard lying vanities: But I trust in the LORD .

rr: Ndyashemererwa, nyesiime ahabw'embabazi zaawe; Ahakuba okareeba obusaasi bwangye, Waamanya enaku zangye
en: I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy: For thou hast considered my trouble; thou hast known my soul in adversities;

rr: Kandi tokampayoga mu mikono y'abazigu; Okata ebigyere byangye omu mwanya ogugarami.
en: And hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: Thou hast set my feet in a large room.

rr: Ongirire embabazi, ai MUKAMA, ahakuba nyine obusaasi; Eriisho ringwire omunda, amagara gangye n'omubiri gwangye binyangaraire ahabw'obusaasi.
en: Have mercy upon me, O LORD , for I am in trouble: Mine eye is consumed with grief, yea , my soul and my belly.

rr: Ahakuba ebiro byangye byona mbimazire nyine enaku, N'emyaka yangye ngimazire nintsinda; Mpweirwemu amaani ahabw'okushiisha kwangye, N'amagufa gangye goomire.
en: For my life is spent with grief, And my years with sighing: My strength faileth because of mine iniquity, And my bones are consumed.

rr: Aha bazigu bangye boona mpindukira ekujumo, N'okukira munonga ahari bataahi bangye, Kandi ahari bagyenzi bangye mbaire ekirikutiinisa; Abarikumbugana omu muhanda, nibampunga.
en: I was a reproach among all mine enemies, but especially among my neighbours, And a fear to mine acquaintance: they that did see me without fled from me.

rr: Nyebire nk'ofiire otakiijukwa, Ndi nk'orwabya orwatikire.
en: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.

rr: 2 -4 ; . Eego, nimpurira baingi nibambeiherera; Obwoba bunturukire embaju zoona, Nibangiira omu naama, kusherura obwengye bw'okuunyita.
en: For I have heard the slander of many: Fear was on every side: while they took counsel together against me, They devised to take away my life.

rr: Kwonka niiwe ndikwesiga, ai MUKAMA, Ningira nti: Niiwe Ruhanga wangye.
en: But I trusted in thee, O LORD : I said, Thou art my God.

rr: Ebiro byangye biri omu mikono yaawe; Onyihe omu mikono y'abazigu bangye n'abarikumpiiga.
en: My times are in thy hand: Deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.

rr: Oyakize omwiru waawe omushana gw'amaisho gaawe; Onjune ahabw'embabazi zaawe enyingi.
en: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: Save me for thy mercies' sake.

rr: Abarikubeiha bagobwe endimi, Abarikugamba kubi aha bahikiriire, Baine amaryo n'okwemanya n'okugaya.
en: Let the lying lips be put to silence; Which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.

rr: Oburungi bwawe ka ni bwingi, obu waabiikiire abarikukutiina, Obu waagiriire abarikukwesiga omu maisho g'abantu!
en: Oh how great is thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee; Which thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee before the sons of men!

rr: Omu bweshereko ahu otuura niho oribashereka enaama mbi z'abantu, Oryabarindira omu kibanda kyawe, bakire empaka z'endimi.
en: Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: Thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.

rr: MUKAMA ahimbisibwe, Ahakuba akanyoreka embabazi ze ez'okutangaaza omu rurembo rw'amaani.
en: Blessed be the LORD : For he hath shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city.

rr: Nkagambisa obwoba nti: Ncwirwe omu maisho gaawe; Kwonka ku naakutakiire, waahurira okweshengyereza kwangye.
en: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: Nevertheless thou heardest the voice of My supplications when I cried unto thee.

rr: Mukunde MUKAMA, imwe abarikwera be boona! MUKAMA arinda abeesigwa, Kwonka orikukoresa emyekunikon, amuzimuurira bingi ebimushemereire.
en: O love the LORD , all ye his saints: For the LORD preserveth the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.

rr: Mugira amaani, mugume omutima, Imwe mwena abategyereza MUKAMA.
en: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, All ye that hope in the LORD .

en: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, Whose sin is covered.

rr: Aine omugisha omuntu ou MUKAMA atabarira kutahikiirira, Ou omutima gwe gutarimu bugobya.
en: Blessed is the man unto whom the LORD imputeth not iniquity, And in whose spirit there is no guile.

rr: Ku naayangire kwatura ekibi kyangye, naahwa aha magufa Ahabw'okurenzya eizooba nintsinda.
en: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old Through my roaring all the day long.

rr: Ahabw'okuba omukono gwawe gukaba gumpingamira nyomushana na nyekiro, Amagara gangye gaayoma nk'oku omuntu ayomibwa omushana gw'ekyanda.
en: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: My moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.

rr: Nkakugambira ekibi kyangye, Tinaakushereka kutahikiirira kwangye; Naagira nti: Naaza kwaturira MUKAMA eby'okushiisha byangye. Naiwe nikwo kunsaasira orubanja rw'ekibi kyangye.
en: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, And mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the LORD ; And thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo orikutiina Ruhanga weena akushabe omu biro by'obusaasi, Kandi omwegyemure gw'amaizi maingi tigurimuhikaho.
en: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: Surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him.

rr: -31 ; Niiwe bweshereko bwangye, oryandinda ndekye kureeba enaku; Oryanyehinguririza n'ebyeshongoro by'okujunwa.
en: Thou art my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; Thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.

rr: Ndyakwegyesa, nkuhabure omuhanda ogu oritoora; Ndyakuha obwengye, nkutaireho eriisho.
en: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.

rr: Mutariba nk'embaraasi nari enyumbu, ezitaine bwengye, Ezishemereire kutegyekyesibwa ekyoma ky'omu kanwa, n'enkoba z'omu bitsya, Ahatari ebyo, tizaakugumire naiwe.
en: Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding: Whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto thee.

rr: Ababi baryareeba obusaasi bwingi; Kwonka oyesiga MUKAMA, embabazi ziryamwehinguririza.
en: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked: But he that trusteth in the LORD , mercy shall compass him about.

rr: Mushemerererwe omuri MUKAMA, mwesiime, imwe abahikiriire; Muteere akaari k'okushemererwa, imwe mwena abaine emitima egororokire.
en: Be glad in the LORD , and rejoice, ye righteous: And shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.

rr: Imwe abahikiriire, mushemerererwe omuri MUKAMA, Okuhimbisa kushemereire ab'amazima.
en: Rejoice in the LORD , O ye righteous: For praise is comely for the upright.

rr: Muhimbise MUKAMA n'enanga; Mumuteerere enanga ey'emirya ikumi!
en: Praise the LORD with harp: Sing unto him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings.

rr: Mumweshongorere ekyeshongoro kisya; Mugiteere gye, mugijumeeze.
en: Sing unto him a new song; Play skilfully with a loud noise.

rr: Ahakuba ekigambo kya MUKAMA kihikire; Kandi emirimo ye yoona agikora n'obwesigwa.
en: For the word of the LORD is right; And all his works are done in truth.

rr: Akunda okuhikiirira n'eby'oburyo; Ensi eijwire embabazi za MUKAMA.
en: He loveth righteousness and judgment: The earth is full of the goodness of the LORD .

rr: -3 ; . Ekigambo kya MUKAMA nikyo kyahangire eiguru; N'omwitsyo gw'omu kanwa ke nigwo gwahangire amahe gaamwo goona.
en: By the word of the LORD were the heavens made; And all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.

rr: Akarundaana amaizi g'omu nyanja nk'agari omu cupa; Yaabiika eby'okuzimu omu bitara bye.
en: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap: He layeth up the depth in storehouses.

rr: Ensi yoona ehe MUKAMA ekitiinisa, N'abagituuramu boona bamutiine!
en: Let all the earth fear the LORD : Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

rr: Ahakuba akagamba, kyabakwo; Yaaragiira, kyahama.
en: For he spake, and it was done ; He commanded, and it stood fast.

rr: MUKAMA ahindura busha enaama mbi z'amahanga, Azibira ebi abantu bateekateeka kukora.
en: The LORD bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought: He maketh the devices of the people of none effect.

rr: Enaama za MUKAMA zihamire ebiro byona, Ebiteekateeko by'omu mutima gwe bigumaho okuhitsya obusingye bwona.
en: The counsel of the LORD standeth for ever, The thoughts of his heart to all generations.

rr: Riine omugisha eihanga eri MUKAMA ari Ruhanga waaryo, Abantu abu yaatooraine kuba obuhunguzi bwe.
en: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD ; And the people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance.

rr: MUKAMA anaga amaisho ari omu iguru, Areeba abantu boona
en: The LORD looketh from heaven; he beholdeth all the sons of men.

rr: Areeba abatuura omu nsi boona Ashutami aha kitebe kye ky'obukama.
en: From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth.

rr: Niwe abumba emitima y'abo boona, qaketegyereza ebi bakora byona.
en: He fashioneth their hearts alike; He considereth all their works.

rr: Omugabe tajunwa ngabo ze nyingi; Emanzi tekira habw'amaani gaayo amaingi.
en: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host: A mighty man is not delivered by much strength.

rr: Embaraasi n'ekintu ekitarikubaasa kureeta businguzi, N'obu kwakuba okujuna omuntu ahabw'amaani gaayo amaingi.
en: An horse is a vain thing for safety: Neither shall he deliver any by his great strength.

rr: Reeba, eriisho rya MUKAMA riguma aha barikumutiina, Abagira amatsiko omu mbabazi ze
en: Behold, the eye of the LORD is upon them that fear him, Upon them that hope in his mercy;

rr: Ngu akize amagara gaabo okufa. Kandi abarinde okutaitwa njara.
en: To deliver their soul from death, And to keep them alive in famine.

rr: -11 ; . Amagara gaitu gategyereza MUKAMA; Niwe Muhwezi waitu kandi engabo yaitu.
en: Our soul waiteth for the LORD : He is our help and our shield.

rr: Eego, emitima yaitu eshemerererwa omuriwe. Ahakuba twesiga eiziina rye eririkwera.
en: For our heart shall rejoice in him, Because we have trusted in his holy name.

rr: Embabazi zaawe, ai MUKAMA, zigume naitwe, Nk'oku turikukwesiga.
en: Let thy mercy, O LORD , be upon us, According as we hope in thee.

en: My soul shall make her boast in the LORD : The humble shall hear thereof , and be glad. ג Gimel

en: O fear the LORD , ye his saints: For there is no want to them that fear him. כ Kaph

en: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: But they that seek the LORD shall not want any good thing . ל Lamed

en: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the LORD . מ Mem

en: What man is he that desireth life, And loveth many days, that he may see good? נ Nun

en: The righteous cry, and the LORD heareth, And delivereth them out of all their troubles. ק Qoph

en: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; And saveth such as be of a contrite spirit. ר Resh

en: Many are the afflictions of the righteous: But the LORD delivereth him out of them all. ש Shin

en: He keepeth all his bones: Not one of them is broken. ת Taw

en: Evil shall slay the wicked: And they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.

en: The LORD redeemeth the soul of his servants: And none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.

rr: Ai MUKAMA, tongana n'abarikuntonganisa; Orwane n'abarikundwanisa.
en: Plead my cause , O LORD , with them that strive with me: Fight against them that fight against me.

rr: Kwata engabo n'akagabo, Oimukye, ompe emikono!
en: Take hold of shield and buckler, And stand up for mine help.

rr: Ihayo eicumu, okumiirire abambingire; Ogire amagara gangye oti: Niinye kujunwa kwawe.
en: Draw out also the spear, and stop the way against them that persecute me: Say unto my soul, I am thy salvation.

rr: -28 ; 109:6-15 . Haza abarikwenda kuunyita Bahemurwe, baihweho ekitiinisa! Abangiriire enaama mbi Bagarurwe enyima, bagaywe!
en: Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul: Let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.

rr: Babe nk'ebishushunga ebitwarwa omuyaga, Na maraika wa MUKAMA ababingye.
en: Let them be as chaff before the wind: And let the angel of the LORD chase them .

rr: Omuhanda gwabo gugire omwirima n'obuterezi, Obwo maraika wa MUKAMA ababingire.
en: Let their way be dark and slippery: And let the angel of the LORD persecute them.

rr: Ahakuba bantegire omutego, Amagara gangye bagategire obusya, nibantura busha.
en: For without cause have they hid for me their net in a pit, Which without cause they have digged for my soul.

rr: Okucwekyerera kubagweho batakimanyire, Omutego ogu bategire gube nibo gwakwata, Bagugwemu, bacwekyerere.
en: Let destruction come upon him at unawares; and let his net that he hath hid catch himself: Into that very destruction let him fall.

rr: Obwo nibwo amagara gangye garishemerererwa omuri MUKAMA, Nigeesiimira okujuna kwe.
en: And my soul shall be joyful in the LORD : It shall rejoice in his salvation.

rr: Amagufa gangye goona garyagira gati: Ai MUKAMA, n'oha orikushushana naiwe, Iwe oiha otaine maani Omu mikono y'orikumukiza amaani, Okakiza otaine maani kandi enshoberwa Omu mikono y'orikumunyaga.
en: All my bones shall say, LORD , who is like unto thee, which deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, Yea, the poor and the needy from him that spoileth him?

rr: Baamushinja b'ebishuba baimuka, Bantabaaririza ebi ntarikumanya
en: False witnesses did rise up; They laid to my charge things that I knew not.

rr: Baanyihura ebibi ahabw'ebirungi, Baareetera amagara gangye okushoberwa.
en: They rewarded me evil for good To the spoiling of my soul.

rr: Haza bo, ku baabaire barwaire, Naajwara ebiguniya, naayebonabonesa niinyesiibyakwo, Naashaba ncurikire omutwe omu kifuba kyangye
en: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth: I humbled my soul with fasting; And my prayer returned into mine own bosom.

rr: Nk'orikusaasibwa munywani we nari mwene ishe; Naagyendagyenda nk'orikucurira nyina, Nyinami n'amaganya maingi.
en: I behaved myself as though he had been my friend or brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourneth for his mother.

rr: Kwonka nyowe, ku naagwire, baayesiima, Baayeteerana kundwanisa; N'abataine ku bari, abu naabaire ntarikumanya, Baaguma nibannyaanyaata
en: But in mine adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: Yea , the abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew it not; they did tear me , and ceased not:

rr: Baagumizamu nibanteerera enaku, Nibannenera amaino baine ekiniga, Nk'abatatiina Ruhanga oku bagira.
en: With hypocritical mockers in feasts, They gnashed upon me with their teeth.

rr: Ai MUKAMA, oryahitsya hi okufa okundeeba? Onjune batampwerekyereza, Okize amagara gangye entare.
en: Lord, how long wilt thou look on? Rescue my soul from their destructions, my darling from the lions.

rr: Naanye ndyakusiimira omu mutwe muhango gw'abantu, Nkuhimbisize omu bantu baingi.
en: I will give thee thanks in the great congregation: I will praise thee among much people.

rr: Otaikiriza abazigu bangye abarikuunyangira ebitahikire kuunyehimbisizaho; N'abanyanigira busha barekye kuunyitiranira amaisho.
en: Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: Neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.

rr: Ahakuba tibagamba by'obusingye, Kureka bateekateeka enaama z'ebishuba kurwanisa abatuurize omu nsi.
en: For they speak not peace: But they devise deceitful matters against them that are quiet in the land.

rr: Baanyashamiire munonga, nibagira bati: Otyo! Otyo! Mbwenu twakyereebera!
en: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me, And said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen it .

rr: Ai MUKAMA, waakireeba; otahunama! Ai MUKAMA, otamba hare!
en: This thou hast seen, O LORD : keep not silence: O Lord, be not far from me.

rr: Ruhanga wangye, kandi MUKAMA wangye, Sisiimuka, oimukye oncwere orubanja omu buryo.
en: Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment, Even unto my cause, my God and my Lord.

rr: Oncwere orubanja, ai MUKAMA Ruhanga wangye, Nk'okuhikiirira kwawe oku kuri; Otabareka kuunyehimbisizaho.
en: Judge me, O LORD my God, according to thy righteousness; And let them not rejoice over me.

rr: Barekye kugira omu mitima yaabo bati: Otyo! ekyo nikyo twabaire nitwenda. Barekye kugira bati: Mbwenu ho, twamumirira kimwe.
en: Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so would we have it: Let them not say, We have swallowed him up.

rr: Abarikuunyendeza okusinga omu mazima Bateere akaari k'okushemererwa, beesiime! Eego, bagume bagire bati: MUKAMA orikwesiimira omwiru we kuba gye, Aheebwe ekitiinisa.
en: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause: Yea, let them say continually, Let the LORD be magnified, which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.

rr: Kandi orurimi rwangye ruryagamba aha by'okuhikiirira kwawe, N'aha kuhimbisibwa kwawe eizooba ryona.
en: And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness And of thy praise all the day long.

rr: Currently Selected: Zaaburi 35 : RR64 Highlight Share
en: Currently Selected: Psalm 35 : KJV Highlight Share <path d="M5 12a1 1 0 0 1

rr: Ekibi kigamba n'omusiisi omu mutima gwe hare, Kandi okutiina Ruhanga tikuba mu maisho ge
en: The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, That there is no fear of God before his eyes.

rr: Ahakuba omu kwebeiha kwe agira ngu, Eby'okutahikiirira bye tibirireebwa, bikangwa.
en: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful.

rr: Ebigambo ebi agamba birimu eitima n'obugobya, Takikoresa bwengye, kandi takikora gye.
en: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: He hath left off to be wise, and to do good.

rr: Ateekateeka enaama z'okukora kubi, ari aha kitabo kye; Ayeta omu muhanda ogutari murungi, tayangira kimwe kibi.
en: He deviseth mischief upon his bed; He setteth himself in a way that is not good; He abhorreth not evil.

rr: Embabazi zaawe, ai MUKAMA, ni nyingi, zihika omu iguru, N'okwesigwa kwawe kuhika omu bicu.
en: Thy mercy, O LORD , is in the heavens; And thy faithfulness reacheth unto the clouds.

rr: Okuhikiirira kwawe ni nk'enshozi za Ruhanga, Emicwere yaawe eri hare nk'okuzimu. Ai MUKAMA, niiwe orinda abantu n'enyamaishwa.
en: Thy righteousness is like the great mountains; Thy judgments are a great deep: O LORD , thou preservest man and beast.

rr: Ai Ruhanga, embabazi zaawe ka n'ez'obuguzi bwingi! N'ahabw'ekyo abantu bahungira omu mapapa gaawe.
en: How excellent is thy lovingkindness, O God! Therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings.

rr: Baryagutira kimwe ebishaagaine eby'omu nju yaawe; Kandi oryabanywaisa aha mugyera gw'eby'okushemererwa byawe.
en: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; And thou shalt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.

rr: Ahakuba ah'ori niho enshuro y'amagara eri; Omu mushana gwawe nimwo turireebera omushana.
en: For with thee is the fountain of life: In thy light shall we see light.

rr: Guma ogirire abarikukukunda embabazi nyingi; Kandi oyorekye abaine emitima egororokire okuhikiirira kwawe.
en: O continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee; And thy righteousness to the upright in heart.

rr: Otaikiriza ekigyere ky'ab'amaryo kumpikaho, N'obu gwakuba omukono gw'omubi kumbinga.
en: Let not the foot of pride come against me, And let not the hand of the wicked remove me.

rr: Okwo niyo abakozi b'ebibi bagwire; Batwirwe ahansi, kandi tibaribaasa kwimuka.
en: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: They are cast down, and shall not be able to rise.

rr: Currently Selected: Zaaburi 36 : RR64 Highlight Share <svg width="2
Otaryemereza omutima ahabw'abai, N'obu kwakuba okugirira enkozi z'ebibi eihari.
en: Fret not thyself because of evildoers, Neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.

rr: Ahakuba baryarahuka kutemwa nk'obunyaatsi, Bahotokye nk'amababi.
en: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, And wither as the green herb. ב Bet

rr: Oyesigye MUKAMA, okore ebirungi, Obwo nibwo orituura omu nsi, nooriira omu mariisizo n'obusingye.
en: Trust in the LORD , and do good; So shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.

rr: Kandi oshemerererwe omuri MUKAMA, Nawe aryakuha ebi omutima gwawe gurikwetenga.
en: Delight thyself also in the LORD ; And he shall give thee the desires of thine heart. ג Gimel

rr: Orugyendo rwawe orwegyekyerere MUKAMA; Kandi omwesigye; nawe aryaruhikiiriza.
en: Commit thy way unto the LORD ; Trust also in him; And he shall bring it to pass.

rr: Aryayoreka okuhikiirira kwawe nk'omushana, N'amazima gaawe nk'eihangwe.
en: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, And thy judgment as the noonday. ד Dalet

rr: Huumurira omuri MUKAMA, omutegyereze n'okugumisiriza; Oteemereza omutima ahabw'omuntu orikuhiirwa omu muhanda gwawe, Akahikiiriza enaama ze embi.
en: Rest in the LORD , and wait patiently for him: Fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass. ה He

rr: Reka kuguubwa kubi, ruga omu kiniga; Oteemereza omutima; ahakuba ekirugamu n'okukora ekibi.
en: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: Fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.

rr: Mumanye ngu ababi baryacwekyerezibwa; Kwonka abategyereza MUKAMA baryahungura ensi.
en: For evildoers shall be cut off: But those that wait upon the LORD , they shall inherit the earth. ו Waw

rr: Bwanyima y'akaanya kakye omubi aryaba atakiriho; Buzima oryamusherura aha mwanya gwe, oshangye atariho.
en: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: Yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and it shall not be .

rr: Kwonka abacureezi baryahungura ensi, Beesiime ahabw'okugira obusingye bwingi.
en: But the meek shall inherit the earth; And shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace. ז Zain

rr: Omubi agiira ohikiriire omu naama mbi, Kandi amunenera amaino.
en: The wicked plotteth against the just, And gnasheth upon him with his teeth.

rr: Kwonka Mukama ashekyerera omubi, Ahakuba areeba eizooba rye riri haihi.
en: The Lord shall laugh at him: For he seeth that his day is coming. ח Het

rr: Ababi baasyoireyo zaarurara zaabo, batamikire emyambi omu mata gaabo, Kuteera ahansi enshoberwa n'abakyene, N'okwita abagyenda baine emitima egororokire.
en: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, To cast down the poor and needy, and to slay such as be of upright conversation.

rr: Zaarurara zaabo nibo zirirezya emitima, Kandi amata gaabo garyahendwa.
en: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, And their bows shall be broken. ט Tet

rr: Ebikye ebi ohikiriire aine Bikira ebishaagire eby'ababi baingi
en: A little that a righteous man hath is better Than the riches of many wicked.

rr: Ahakuba emikono y'ababi eryahendeka, Kwonka MUKAMA akwatirira abahikiriire.
en: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: But the LORD upholdeth the righteous. י Yod

rr: MUKAMA amanya ebiro ebi abashugaine barimara, N'obuhunguzi bwabo buryagumaho ebiro byona
en: The LORD knoweth the days of the upright: And their inheritance shall be for ever.

rr: Omu biro by'okureeba enaku tibariitwa nshoni, Kandi omu biro by'enjara baryaiguta.
en: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: And in the days of famine they shall be satisfied. כ Kaph

rr: Kwonka ababi baryahwerekyerera, Abazigu ba MUKAMA baryaba nk'obunyaatsi burungi obw'omu iriisizo; Baryahwerekyerera, bahweho nk'omwika.
en: But the wicked shall perish, And the enemies of the LORD shall be as the fat of lambs: They shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away. ל Lamed

rr: Omubi ayeguza, taihura; Kwonka ohikiriire aba efura, kandi agaba.
en: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: But the righteous sheweth mercy, and giveth.

rr: Ahakuba abu MUKAMA aha omugisah baryahungura ensi, Kwonka abu akyeenire baracwekyerera.
en: For such as be blessed of him shall inherit the earth; And they that be cursed of him shall be cut off. מ Mem

rr: Orugyendo rw'omuntu ku ruhamibwa MUKAMA, Yaasiima emihanda ye
en: The steps of a good man are ordered by the LORD : And he delighteth in his way.

rr: N'obu agwa, tagwera kimwe, Ahakuba MUKAMA amuramira n'omukono gwe.
en: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: For the LORD upholdeth him with his hand. נ Nun

rr: Nkaba ndi omutisgazi, mbwenu ndi omurugurusi; Kwonka tinkareebaga ohikiriire atsigirweho, N'obu baakuba abaana be nibashaba ak'okurya.
en: I have been young, and now am old; Yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.

rr: Obutoosha agaba n'obufura, kandi aguza abandi, N'abaana be baryaheebwa omugisha.
en: He is ever merciful, and lendeth; And his seed is blessed. ס Samek

rr: Ruga omu bibi, okore ebirungi, Naiwe obwo oryagumaho ebiro byona
en: Depart from evil, and do good; And dwell for evermore.

rr: Ahakuba MUKAMA akunda eby'oburyo, Taritsigaho barikwera be. Baryarindwa ebiro byona; Kwonka oruzaaro rw'ababi ruryacwekyerezibwa.
en: For the LORD loveth judgment, ע Ain And forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: But the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.

rr: Abahikiriire baryahungura ensi, Bagituuremu ebiro byona.
en: The righteous shall inherit the land, And dwell therein for ever. פ Pe

rr: Akanwa k'ohikiriire kagamba eby'obwengye, N'orurimi rwe rugamba eby'oburyo
en: The mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, And his tongue talketh of judgment.

rr: Ebiragiro bya Ruhanga biba omu mutima gwe; Ebigyere bye tibiterera.
en: The law of his God is in his heart; None of his steps shall slide. צ Zade

rr: Omubi agyenza ohikiriire, Naasherura oku araamwitwe.
en: The wicked watcheth the righteous, And seeketh to slay him.

rr: MUKAMA tarimutsiga mu mikono ye, N'obu kwakuba okumusingisa emanja.
en: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, Nor condemn him when he is judged. ק Qoph

rr: Tegyereza MUKAMA, ogume omu muhanda gwe; Niwe arikutunguura, okahungura ensi; Oryareeba okuhwerekyerera kw'abasiisi.
en: Wait on the LORD , and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: When the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it . ר Resh

rr: Nkareeba omubi aine obushoboorozi bwingi, Agaire nk'omwereezi gwa Lebanooni.
en: I have seen the wicked in great power, And spreading himself like a green bay tree.

rr: Naagaruka, naarabaho; kwonka eky'okutangaaza, akaba atakiriho; N'obu ndaabe naamusherwire, tarabonekire.
en: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he was not: Yea, I sought him, but he could not be found. ש Shin

rr: Yetegyereze omuntu oshugaine, kandi oreebe ow'amazima; ahakuba omuheru gw'omuntu ogwo n'obusingye
en: Mark the perfect man , and behold the upright: For the end of that man is peace.

rr: Kwonka abasiisi baryahwerekyererezibwa kimwe, Kandi omuheru gw'omubi n'okucwekyerezibwa.
en: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: The end of the wicked shall be cut off. ת Taw

rr: Okujunwa kw'abahikiriire kuruga ahari MUKAMA; Niwe buhungiro bwabo omu biro by'okureeba enaku.
en: But the salvation of the righteous is of the LORD : He is their strength in the time of trouble.

rr: MUKAMA abahwera, kandi abakiza; Abaiha omu mikono y'ababi, kandi abajuna, Ahabw'okuba bamuhungiraho.
en: And the LORD shall help them, and deliver them: He shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.

en: Currently Selected: Psalm 37 : KJV Highlight Share <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www

rr: Ai MUKAMA, otanteisa onyiniire ekiniga, N'obu kwakuba okumpana ongwereirwe kubi munonga
en: O LORD , rebuke me not in thy wrath: Neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

rr: Ahakuba emyambi yaawe empwereiremu, N'omukono gwawe gumpingamiire munonga.
en: For thine arrows stick fast in me, And thy hand presseth me sore.

rr: Tihariho hahuriire omu mubiri gwangye ahabw'ekiniga kyawe; N'amagufa gangye tigari gye ahabw'ekibi kyangye.
en: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine anger; Neither is there any rest in my bones because of my sin.

rr: Ahakuba eby'okushiisha byangye bindengyeire aha mutwe, Bindemire nk'omutwaro guremeire.
en: For mine iniquities are gone over mine head: As an heavy burden they are too heavy for me.

rr: Obuhuta bwangye nibunuuka, bujunzire, ahabw'obushema bwangye.
en: My wounds stink and are corrupt Because of my foolishness.

rr: Mpetami omugongo, nyeinamiriire; Ngyendagyenda nincura okurenzya eizooba
en: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.

rr: Ahakuba nimbabiirirwa munonga omu manyaanya; Kandi omu mubiri gwangye tiharimu hahuriire.
en: For my loins are filled with a loathsome disease: And there is no soundness in my flesh.

rr: Ninkabaakaba mpendagurikire; Nintsinda ahabw'omutima gwangye kutatuuza.
en: I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.

rr: Ai MUKAMA, noomanya ebi nyetenga byona, Kandi tosherekirwe kutsinda kwangye.
en: Lord, all my desire is before thee; And my groaning is not hid from thee.

rr: Omutima gwangye niguteera munonga enkuratima, amaani gampweiremu; amaisho gangye nago tigakihweza.
en: My heart panteth, my strength faileth me: As for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.

rr: Banywani bangye na bagyenzi bangye nibanyetantara ahabw'okubonabona kwangye, N'abanyaruganda baanyemereire hare.
en: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; And my kinsmen stand afar off.

rr: Kandi abarikwenda kuunyita nibantega emitego; N'abarikwenda kunkora kubi nibagamba eby'okumpwerekyereza, Kandi bateekateeka eby'okundeebya eizooba ryona.
en: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me: And they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.

rr: Kwonka nyowe ndi nk'ekifa-matu, tindikuhurira; Ndi nk'ekiteta ekitarikugamba.
en: But I, as a deaf man , heard not; And I was as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.

rr: Eego, ndi nk'omuntu otarikuhurira, Otaine bigambo by'okuteisa abandi.
en: Thus I was as a man that heareth not, And in whose mouth are no reproofs.

rr: Kandi ai MUKAMA, niiwe ndikutegyereza; Oryangarukamu, Mukama Ruhanga wangye.
en: For in thee, O LORD , do I hope: Thou wilt hear, O Lord my God.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo ninkushaba, otaikiriza abarikwesiimira okuterera kwangye Kuunyehimbisizaho.
en: For I said, Hear me , lest otherwise they should rejoice over me: When my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.

rr: Ndaariire kugwa, Kandi obusaasi bwangye tindikubaasa kubwehuzya obutoosha.
en: For I am ready to halt, And my sorrow is continually before me.

rr: Ahakuba niinyatura eby'okushiisha bayngye, Ninshaasha ahabw'ekibi kyangye.
en: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.

rr: Kwonka abazigu bangye abanyangira busha baine amaani; N'abanyangira ebitahikire bakanyire.
en: But mine enemies are lively, and they are strong: And they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.

rr: Abazimuurira ekibi ahabw'ekirungi nabo n'abazigu bangye, ahakuba ninkuratira ebirungi.
en: They also that render evil for good Are mine adversaries; because I follow the thing that good is .

rr: Otantsigaho, ai MUKAMA; Ruhanga wangye, otanza hare!
en: Forsake me not, O LORD : O my God, be not far from me.

rr: Rahuka kumpwera, ai Mukama, okujunwa kwangye.
en: Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation.

rr: Currently Selected: Zaaburi 38 : RR64 Highlight Share <path d="M5 12a1 1 0 0 1 1-
Nkagira nti: Ndyarinda emitwarize yangye, Ndekye kushiisha n'orurimi rwangye; Kandi ndyabumba akanwa kangye, omubi akiri omu maisho gangye.
en: I said, I will take heed to my ways, That I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, While the wicked is before me.

rr: Naahunama nk'ekiteta, Naacureera, kyabura eki kyangasira. Okuganya kwangye kwayeyongyera.
en: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, even from good; And my sorrow was stirred.

rr: Omutima gwangye gwabugumwamu omuriro; Ku naateekateekire, gwayaka, Ahonaaho naagamba.
en: My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned: Then spake I with my tongue.

rr: MUKAMA, ommanyise omuheru gwangye, N'obunaku bw'ebiro byangye oku burikwingana; Ommanyise ku ndi ow'okuhwaho juba.
en: LORD , make me to know mine end, and the measure of my days, what it is ; That I may know how frail I am .

rr: Reeba, ohindwire ebiro byangye nk'ebita bikye, N'emyaka yangye omu maisho gaawe ni busha; buzimazima omuntu weena, n'obu yaakuba agumire ata, n'omwitsyo.
en: Behold, thou hast made my days as an handbreadth; And mine age is as nothing before thee: Verily every man at his best state is altogether vanity. Selah.

rr: Buzima omuntu weena agyenda ari nk'ekinyimanyimi, Buzima bahendekyera busha; Omuntu ashanguruza ebintu, atarikumanya oribitwara.
en: Surely every man walketh in a vain shew: Surely they are disquieted in vain: He heapeth up riches , and knoweth not who shall gather them.

rr: Mbwenu Mukama, ntegyereize ki? amaisho gangye goona gari omuriiwe.
en: And now, Lord, what wait I for? My hope is in thee.

rr: Onjune eby'okushiisha byangye byona, Otampindura ekirikugaywa abashema.
en: Deliver me from all my transgressions: Make me not the reproach of the foolish.

rr: Mpunamire, tinaagira ky'okugamba, ahakuba niiwe okikozire.
en: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; Because thou didst it .

rr: Onyiheho enkoni yaawe; Ahakuba empi zaawe zaanyita.
en: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thine hand.

rr: Ku ohana omuntu, noomuteisa ahabw'okushiisha kwe, Omumariramu kimwe oburungi bwe, nk'oku ebiyenje bigira.
en: When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity, Thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: Surely every man is vanity.

rr: Buzima kwo, omuntu weena ni nk'omwitsyo!
en: Selah.

rr: Ai MUKAMA, hurira okushaba kwangye, Otegye okutu okutaka kwangye, Oteetsiza okurira kwangye; Ahakuba ahariiwe ndi omugyenyi, Kandi omuhinguzi, nka baatatenkuriitwe boona.
en: Hear my prayer, O LORD , and give ear unto my cry; Hold not thy peace at my tears: For I am a stranger with thee, And a sojourner, as all my fathers were .

rr: Ongirire embabazi, mbone kugarukwamu amaani, Ntakarugire aha kubura.
en: O spare me, that I may recover strength, Before I go hence, and be no more.

rr: Currently Selected: Zaaburi 39 : RR64 Highlight Share <div class="flex w-full items-center gap-1
Nkategyereza MUKAMA n'okugumisiriza; Yantega okutu, yaahurira okutaka kwangye.
en: I waited patiently for the LORD ; And he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.

rr: Yaanyiha omu kiina ky'okuhwerekyereramu omu byondo; Yaayemereza ebigyere byangye aha rukiri, Yaahamya entegye zangye
en: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, And set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.

rr: Taanyegyesa ekyeshongoro kisya eky'okuhimbisa Ruhanga waitu; Baingi baryakireeba, batiine, Kandi beesigye MUKAMA.
en: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: Many shall see it , and fear, And shall trust in the LORD .

rr: Aine omugisha omuntu, ou MUKAMA aba obwesigye bwe, Otakubuukira banyamaryo, N'obu baakuba abahabisibwa baaruhanga ab'ebishuba.
en: Blessed is that man that maketh the LORD his trust, And respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.

rr: Ai MUKAMA Ruhanga wangye, eby'okutangaaza, ebi waakozire, N'ebiteekateeko ebi otuteekateekaho ka ni bingi! Tihariho orikwingana naiwe. Ku naakwenda kubigamba n'okubitondoora, Ni bingi, tibirikubaasa kubarwa.
en: Many, O LORD my God, Are thy wonderful works which thou hast done, And thy thoughts which are to us-ward: They cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee: If I would declare and speak of them , They are more than can be numbered.

rr: Ebitambo n'empongano tobishemerererwa; Amatu gangye ogaigwire; Ebitambo eby'okwokyeza kimwe n'ebitambo by'ebibi torabyenzire
en: Sacrifice and offering thou didst not desire; Mine ears hast thou opened: Burnt offering and sin offering hast thou not required.

rr: Naanye nikwo kugira nti: Reeba, naija! Nk'oku kyampandiikirweho omu muzingo gw'ekitabo
en: Then said I, Lo, I come: In the volume of the book it is written of me,

rr: Ninshemerererwa okukiora ebi okunda, ai Ruhanga wangye; Ebiragiro byawe biri omu mutima gwangye.
en: I delight to do thy will, O my God: Yea, thy law is within my heart.

rr: Mbwenu eby'okuhikiirira omu mutwe muhango gw'abantu; Reebam tindekire kugamba; Naiwe nookimanya, ai MUKAMA.
en: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: Lo, I have not refrained my lips, O LORD , thou knowest.

rr: Tinsherekire by'okuhikiirira kwawwe omu mutima gwangye; Ngambire eby'okwesigwa kwawe n'okujuna kwawe; Embabazi zaawe n'amazima gaawe timbisherekire mutwe muhango gw'abantu.
en: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy lovingkindness, And thy truth from the great congregation.

rr: Ai MUKAMA, otaanyima okusaasira kwawe kwingi; Embabazi zaawe n'amazima gaawe bigume bindinde.
en: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O LORD : Let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.

rr: Ahakuba obubi bwingi obuhinguraine bunyehinguririize; Eby'okutahikiirira byangye bimpikireho, Byanzibira kwimutsya amaisho; Ni bingi okukira eishokye ry'aha mutwe gwangye; Omutima gwampwa omunda.
en: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: Mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; They are more than the hairs of mine head: Therefore my heart faileth me.

rr: Ai MUKAMA, ikiriza kunjuna; Orahukye kumpwera, MUKAMA wangye!
en: Be pleased, O LORD , to deliver me: O LORD , make haste to help me.

rr: Abarikwenda kuhwerekyereza amagara gangye Bakwatwe enshoni, boona bashoberwe; Abarikwesiimira enaku zangye, bagarurwe enyima, bagaywe.
en: Let them be ashamed and confounded together That seek after my soul to destroy it; Let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.

rr: Abarikunteerera enaku, nibagira bati: Otyo! Otyo! Bashobererwe kimwe ahabw'enshoni zaabo.
en: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame That say unto me, Aha, aha.

rr: Boona abakusherura bashemererwe, bananukire omuriiwe; Abarikukunda okujuna kwawe bagume bagire bati: MUKAMA aheebwe ekitiinisa!

en: The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive; and he shall be blessed upon the earth: And thou wilt not deliver him unto the will of his enemies.

rr: MUKAMA aryamweyegamiza, arembeire aha kitabo kye; Niiwe orimwarira arwaire.
en: The LORD will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: Thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness.

en: And if he come to see me , he speaketh vanity: His heart gathereth iniquity to itself; When he goeth abroad, he telleth it .

en: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, Which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up his heel against me.

rr: Kwonka iwe ai MUKAMA, ongirire embabazi, Onyimutsye, mbone kubahoora.
en: But thou, O LORD , be merciful unto me, And raise me up, that I may requite them.

rr: Ekyo nikyo kirikummanyisa ku onshemerererwa, ahakuba omuzigu wangye tansingwire.
en: By this I know that thou favourest me, Because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.

rr: Kwonka nyowe omu bwesigwa bwangye onkwatiriire, Wanta omu maisho gaawe, okuguma naiwe ebiro byona.
en: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, And settest me before thy face for ever.

rr: Nk'oku empara egira ekyaka neeyenda amaizi, N'omutima gwangye nikwo gugira ekyaka ahabwawe, ai Ruhanga.
en: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, So panteth my soul after thee, O God.

rr: Amagara gangye gagirira Ruhanga eiriho, Ruhanga ohuriire; Ndyaija ryari, nkareebwa omu maisho ga Ruhanga?
en: My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God: When shall I come and appear before God?

rr: Amarira gangye gambeereire eby'okurya nyomushana na nyekiro, Abantu nibanteerera enaku obutoosha, Nibagira bati: Ruhanga waawe arahi?
en: My tears have been my meat day and night, While they continually say unto me, Where is thy God?

rr: Ku mba ningamba naamara omu kashansha, Nyijuka oku naabaire ngyenda n'abantu baingi, Nkabeebembera kuza omu nju ya Ruhanga, Nituteera akaari k'okushemererwa n'ebyeshongoro, Turi omutwe muhango gw'abantu abarikwijuka ekiro kikuru.
en: When I remember these things , I pour out my soul in me: For I had gone with the multitude, I went with them to the house of God, With the voice of joy and praise, With a multitude that kept holyday.

rr: Ahabw'enki oyehweire amatsiko, iwe magara gangye? ahabw'enki oyemereize omutima omunda yangye? Ta amatsiko ahari Ruhanga; ahakuba ndyagaruka mmuhimbise, Niwe Muhwezi wangye kandi Ruhanga wangye.
en: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? And why art thou disquieted in me? Hope thou in God: For I shall yet praise him For the help of his countenance.

rr: Ai Ruhanga wangye, amagara gangye geehweire amatsiko; Nikyo ndikwijukira, ndi omu nsi ya Yorudani na Herumooni, N'aha kabungo ka Mizaari.
en: O my God, my soul is cast down within me: Therefore will I remember thee from the land of Jordan, and of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar.

rr: Amaizi agaijwire geetana n'agandi, ahabw'okuhoorera kw'obururuma bwawe. Ebingonzi byawe n'emijumba yaawe byona bindengyeireho.
en: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterspouts: All thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.

rr: MUKAMA antwekyera embabazi ze nyomushana, Na nyekiro ekyeshongoro kye kiba kiri omu kanwa kangye, Nikwo kushaba Ruhanga ow'amagara gangye.
en: Yet the LORD will command his lovingkindness in the daytime, And in the night his song shall be with me, and my prayer unto the God of my life.

rr: Niinyija kubuuza Ruhanga orukiri rwangye nti: Onyebeirwe ki? ahabw'enki ninguma n'amaganya ahabw'okubonabonesibwa abazigu?
en: I will say unto God my rock, why hast thou forgotten me? Why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

rr: Ababisha bangye ni nka rurara omu magufa gangye, Nibanteerera enaku obutoosha, Nibagira bati: Ruhanga waawe arahi?
en: As with a sword in my bones, Mine enemies reproach me; While they say daily unto me, Where is thy God?

rr: Ahabw'enki oyehweire amatsiko iwe magara gangye?
en: Why art thou cast down, O my soul?

rr: Ahabw'enki oyemereize omutima omunda yangye?
en: And why art thou disquieted within me?

rr: Ta amatsiko ahari Ruhanga; ahakuba ndyagaruka mmuhimbise, Niwe Muhwezi wangye kandi Ruhanga wangye.
en: Hope thou in God; For I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.
