rr: Iwe ensi yoona, teerera Ruhanga akaari k'okushemererwa
en: Make a joyful noise unto God, all ye lands:

rr: Oyeshongore eby'okuhimbisa eiziina rye, N'okuhimbisibwa kwe okuhe ekitiinisa.
en: Sing forth the honour of his name: Make his praise glorious.

rr: Ogire Ruhanga oti: Emirimo yaawe ka n'ey'okutiinisa!
en: Say unto God, How terrible art thou in thy works!

rr: Ahabw'amaani gaawe maingi abazigu baawe bayrakugomokyera.
en: Through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto thee.

rr: Ab'ensi yoona baryakuramya, bakweshongorere, Beeshongore eby'okuhimbisa eiziina ryawe.
en: All the earth shall worship thee, And shall sing unto thee; They shall sing to thy name. Selah.

rr: Mwija mureebe emirimo ya Ruhanga; N'ow'okutiinisa omu bi akorera abantu.
en: Come and see the works of God: He is terrible in his doing toward the children of men.

rr: Akahindura enyanja ensi eyomire, Abantu baaraba omu mugyera n'ebigyere; Okwo niyo twamusiimiire munonga.
en: He turned the sea into dry land: They went through the flood on foot: There did we rejoice in him.

rr: Ategyekyesa obushoboorozi ebiro byona; Amaisho ge agatuuza aha mahanga. Abagomi beerinde, barekye kwetunguura.
en: He ruleth by his power for ever; His eyes behold the nations: Let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.

rr: Imwe mahanga 'mwe, muhe Ruhanga waitu ekitiinisa, Amaraka agarikumuhimbisa gahurirwe
en: O bless our God, ye people, And make the voice of his praise to be heard:

rr: Ahakuba aturinda tuguma turi abahuriire, Kandi taikiriza bigyere byaitu kuterera.
en: Which holdeth our soul in life, And suffereth not our feet to be moved.

rr: Iwe Ruhanga, okatugyeza, Waaturabya omu iziiko, nk'oku bagira efeeza.
en: For thou, O God, hast proved us: Thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.

rr: Okatutooza ekigoye; Waatuhatisa ebirikutusaasa omu manyaanya.
en: Thou broughtest us into the net; Thou laidst affliction upon our loins.

rr: Waikiriza abantu kuturibatiirira, batembire embaraasi; Tukaraba omu muriro n'omu maizi, Kwonka waatuhitsya omu mwanya ogwine obweshanziro.
en: Thou hast caused men to ride over our heads; We went through fire and through water: But thou broughtest us out into a wealthy place .

rr: Niinyija kutaaha omu nju yaawe n'ebitambo ebyokize, Mpikiirize ebi naaraganiise nindahira
en: I will go into thy house with burnt offerings: I will pay thee my vows,

rr: Ebi eminwa yangye yaagambire, N'ebi akanwa kangye kaaraganiise, obu naareeba enaku.
en: which my lips have uttered, and my mouth hath spoken, when I was in trouble.

rr: Niinyija kukuha ebitambo byokize eby'ebishaju, N'ekisooroora ky'ebitambo by'empaya y'entaama, Nkuhongyere enimi n'embuzi.
en: I will offer unto thee burnt sacrifices of fatlings, with the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah.

rr: Imwe abatiina Ruhanga, mwije muhurire, Mbagambire ebi yaakoreire amagara gangye.
en: Come and hear, all ye that fear God, And I will declare what he hath done for my soul.

rr: Nkamutakira munonga n'akanwa kangye, N'orurimi rwangye rwamuhimbisa.
en: I cried unto him with my mouth, And he was extolled with my tongue.

rr: Kuri naataire omutima aha by'okutahikiirira, Mukama takumpuriire.
en: If I regard iniquity in my heart, The Lord will not hear me:

rr: Kwonka buzima Ruhanga akahurira, Yaata omutima aha iraka ry'okushaba kwangye.
en: But verily God hath heard me ; He hath attended to the voice of my prayer.

rr: Ruhanga asiimwe, ahakuba tayangire kuhurira kushaba kwangye, Kandi taanyihireho kukunda kwe.
en: Blessed be God, which hath not turned away my prayer, Nor his mercy from me.

rr: Ruhanga atugirire embabazi, atuhe omugisha, Atwakize amaisho ge
en: God be merciful unto us, and bless us; And cause his face to shine upon us; Selah.

rr: -32 ; . Omuhanda gwawe gubone kumanywa omu nsi, N'amaani gaawe agarikujuna gamanywe omu mahanga goona.
en: That thy way may be known upon earth, Thy saving health among all nations.

rr: Abantu bakuhimbise, ai Ruhanga; K'abantu boona bakuhimbise!
en: Let the people praise thee, O God; Let all the people praise thee.

rr: Amahanga geesiime, geeshongore ahabw'okushemererwa; Ahabw'okuba ocwera abantu emanja omu bwinganisa, Kandi oyebembera amahanga agari omu nsi.
en: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: For thou shalt judge the people righteously, and govern the nations upon earth. Selah.

rr: Abantu bakuhimbise, ai Ruhanga; K'abantu boona bakuhimbise!
en: Let the people praise thee, O God; Let all the people praise thee.

rr: Ensi ereetsire omweru gwayo, Ruhanga, Ruhanga waitu, atuhaire omugisha.
en: Then shall the earth yield her increase; And God, even our own God, shall bless us.

rr: Ruhanga aryatuha omugisha; Kandi boona ab'aha muheru gw'ensi baryamutiina.
en: God shall bless us; And all the ends of the earth shall fear him.

rr: Currently Selected: Zaaburi 67 : RR64 Highlight Share <svg width="24"
Ka Ruhanga aimukye, abazigu be bataataane! N'abarikumwanga bamuhungye.
en: Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered: Let them also that hate him flee before him.

rr: Obatuntumure nk'omwika; Ababi bahwerekyererere omu maisho ga Ruhanga, Nk'oku entsinda eyagira aha muriro
en: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: As wax melteth before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

rr: Kwonka abahikiriire bo bananukye; Beesime munonga omu maisho ge; Eego, bashemererwe n'okunanuka.
en: But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before God: Yea, let them exceedingly rejoice.

rr: Mweshongorere Ruhanga, mweshongore eby'okuhimbisa eiziina rye; Mwimutsye amaraka, mweshongorere Ogwo ogyendera aha bicu; Eiziina rye ni Yehova; mwesiimire munonga omu maisho ge!
en: Sing unto God, Sing praises to his name: Extol him that rideth upon the heavens By his name JAH, and rejoice before him.

rr: Ruhanga omu mwanya gwe ogurikwera ogu atuuramu N'ishe w'efuuzi kandi omucwi w'emanja w'abafaakazi.
en: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, Is God in his holy habitation.

rr: Ruhanga aha amaka abataine ifo na ruguru; Abohoorora embohe, ngu zitungye ebirungi, Kwonka abagomi batuura omu nsi eyomire.
en: God setteth the solitary in families: He bringeth out those which are bound with chains: But the rebellious dwell in a dry land .

rr: Ai Ruhanga, obu waayebembera abantu baawe, Nooraba omu ihamba
en: O God, when thou wentest forth before thy people, When thou didst march through the wilderness; Selah:

rr: Ensi ekatengyeta, eiguru ryagwisa enjura habw'okwija kwawe, Na Sinai yaatengyeta ahabw'okwija kwawe, iwe Ruhanga wa Israeli.
en: The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God: Even Sinai itself was moved At the presence of God, the God of Israel.

rr: Ai Ruhanga, okagwisa enjura y'omugisha aha buhunguzi bwawe, Waabugaruramu amaani buruhire.
en: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, whereby thou didst confirm thine inheritance, When it was weary.

rr: Abantu baawe baabubonamu obutaaho; Omu burungi bwawe, ai Ruhanga, waatungira abakyene eby'okubahwera.
en: Thy congregation hath dwelt therein: Thou, O God, hast prepared of thy goodness for the poor.

rr: Mukama aha ekiragiro, Abakazi abarikutwara amakuru n'eihe rihango.
en: The Lord gave the word: Great was the company of those that published it .

rr: Abagabe b'amahe bahunga, eego bahunga; Abakazi abatsigara omuka babagana eminyago.
en: Kings of armies did flee apace: And she that tarried at home divided the spoil.

rr: Ahabw'enki muraara omu kibuga ky'entaama, Nk'amapapa g'enkombe agashwekirwe efeeza, N'ebyoya byayo ebishwekirwe ezaabu?
en: Though ye have lien among the pots, yet shall ye be as the wings of a dove Covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold.

rr: Obu Ow'obushoboorozi bwona yaabinga abakama baabo, bakataataana, Orubaare rukaba nirugwa ahari Salumooni.
en: When the Almighty scattered kings in it, It was white as snow in Salmon.

rr: Iwe orushozi rw'amaani, orushozi rwa Bashani, Iwe orushozi rwa Bashani orwine emitwe mingi
en: The hill of God is as the hill of Bashan; An high hill as the hill of Bashan.

rr: Imwe enshozi ndaingwa, ahabw'enki mureebesa eihari Orushozi oru Ruhanga yaasiimire kutuuraho? N'ekya buzima, MUKAMA aryarutuuraho ebiro byona.
en: Why leap ye, ye high hills? This is the hill which God desireth to dwell in; Yea, the LORD will dwell in it for ever.

rr: Ebigaari bya Ruhanga n'obukumi bubiri, Enkumi n'enkumi; Mukama akaija omu Mwanya ogurikwera, naaruga Sinai.
en: The chariots of God are twenty thousand, even thousands of angels: The Lord is among them, as in Sinai, in the holy place .

rr: Okatemba orushozi ruraingwa, Nootwara abu waanyagire bakukuratiire, N'abandi bantu baakureetera emitoijo, Nangwa n'omu bagomi nabo, Ngu MUKAMA Ruhanga abone kutuura omuribo.
en: Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led captivity captive: Thou hast received gifts for men; Yea, for the rebellious also, that the Lord GOD might dwell among them .

rr: Mukama asiimwe, otwekorerera emitwaro obutoosha, Ruhanga ow'okujunwa kwaitu.
en: Blessed be the Lord, Who daily loadeth us with benefits , even the God of our salvation. Selah.

rr: Ruhanga waitu ni Ruhanga orikujuna; Ahari Yehova Mukama niho haruga okukira okufa.
en: He that is our God is the God of salvation; And unto GOD the Lord belong the issues from death.

rr: Kwonka Ruhanga aryayatagura emitwe y'abazigu be, Kandi ahutaaze ekikoba ky'omutwe gw'ogwo orikugumira omu kushobya kwe.
en: But God shall wound the head of his enemies, And the hairy scalp of such an one as goeth on still in his trespasses.

rr: Mukama akagira ati: Ndyabagarura barugye Bashani, Ndyabagarura mbaihe okuzimu ahagati y'enyanja
en: The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring my people again from the depths of the sea:

rr: Ngu obone kwozya ebigyere byawe omu shagama, Kandi ngu endimi z'embwa zaawe zitungye omugabo gwazo omu bazigu.
en: That thy foot may be dipped in the blood of thine enemies, And the tongue of thy dogs in the same.

rr: Bareebire emigyendere yaawe, ai Ruhanga, Ruhanga wangye kandi Mukama wangye, Okuratiirwe abantu baawe nootaaha omu Mwanya ogurikwera
en: They have seen thy goings, O God; Even the goings of my God, my King, in the sanctuary.

rr: Abeeshongozi beebembeire, abateezi b'enanga bari enyima; N'ahagati yaabo hariho abaishiki nibateera ebitaasa.
en: The singers went before, the players on instruments followed after; Among them were the damsels playing with timbrels.

rr: Muhimbise Ruhanga omu iteeraniro rihango ry'abantu; Muhimbise MUKAMA, imwe abaakomookire omu ihanga rya Israeli!
en: Bless ye God in the congregations, Even the Lord, from the fountain of Israel.

rr: Benyamiini bucuracuriro abari omu mutwe, Abanyiginya ba Yuda n'omutwe muhango, Abanyiginya ba Zebuluuni, abanyiginya ba Nafutaali.
en: There is little Benjamin with their ruler, the princes of Judah and their council, The princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.

rr: Ragiira amaani gaawe, ai Ruhanga; Ohamye ebi waatukoreire.
en: Thy God hath commanded thy strength: Strengthen, O God, that which thou hast wrought for us.

rr: Abagabe bakureetera emitoijo, ahabwa hekalu yaawe, eri omuri Yerusaalemu
en: Because of thy temple at Jerusalem Shall kings bring presents unto thee.

rr: Hana n'amaani enyamaishwa z'omu rufunjo, Eigana ry'enimi n'enyana z'amahanga; Oribatiirire abantu abaine omururu gw'okutoijesa agandi mahanga; Otaataanise amahanga agakunda kurwana.
en: Rebuke the company of spearmen, The multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the people, Till every one submit himself with pieces of silver: Scatter thou the people that delight in war.

rr: Abanyiginya baryaruga Misiri; Na Esiopia eryarahuka kutega Ruhanga emikono.
en: Princes shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall soon stretch out her hands unto God.

rr: Imwe obugabe bwona obw'ensi, mweshongorere Ruhanga, Mweshongore eby'okuhimbisa Mukama
en: Sing unto God, ye kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises unto the Lord; Selah:

rr: Orikutemba ahaiguru y'eiguru omu iguru erya ira. Reeba, naagamba n'eiraka rihango, n'eiraka rye ery'amaani.
en: To him that rideth upon the heavens of heavens, which were of old; Lo, he doth send out his voice, and that a mighty voice.

rr: Mugambe ku Ruhanga aine amaani; Ategyeka Israeli omu kitiinisa ky'obukama bwe, Kandi amaani ge gari omu bicu.
en: Ascribe ye strength unto God: His excellency is over Israel, And his strength is in the clouds.

rr: Ruhanga n'Ow'okutiinisa omu Mwanya gwe ogurikwera; Ruhanga wa Israeli niwe aha abantu be obushoboorozi n'amaani.
en: O God, thou art terrible out of thy holy places: The God of Israel is he that giveth strength and power unto his people.

rr: Ruhanga asiimwe!
en: Blessed be God.

rr: Currently Selected: Zaaburi 68 : RR64 Highlight Share <di
Njuna, ai Ruhanga; Ahakuba amaizi nigenda kuunyita
en: Save me, O God; For the waters are come in unto my soul.

rr: Ninshaaya omu byondo bingi, Ebi ntarikubaasa kuhamyamu bigyere; Naahika omu maizi maraingwa, Ahi amaizi agaijwire garikummirira.
en: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

rr: Okurira kunduhize; amaraka ganzindaire; Amaisho gangye gahotokire ahabw'okutegyereza Ruhanga wangye.
en: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: Mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.

rr: Abarikuunyangira busha ni baingi okukira eishokye ry'aha mutwe gwangye; Abazigu bangye abarikwenda kuunyitira busha n'ab'amaani. Nshemereire kuriha ebi ntaraibire?
en: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of mine head: They that would destroy me, being mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: Then I restored that which I took not away.

rr: Ai Ruhanga, noomanya obushema bwangye; N'ebibi byangye tibikusherekirwe.
en: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; And my sins are not hid from thee.

rr: Abarikukwesiga, Mukama RUHANGA ow'amahe, Barekye kukwatwa enshoni ahabwangye; Abarikukusherura, ai Ruhanga wa israeli, Batahemurwa ahabwangye.
en: Let not them that wait on thee, O Lord GOD of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: Let not those that seek thee be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel.

rr: Ahakuba ahabwawe nyemeire okujumwa, N'enshoni zinshwekire ahamaisho.
en: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; Shame hath covered my face.

rr: Mpindukire otarikumanywa ahari beene tata, N'omunyaihanga aha baana ba maawe.
en: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, And an alien unto my mother's children.

rr: Okusaasibwa enju yaawe kummazireho, Kandi ebijumo ebi barikukujuma niinye bigweireire.
en: For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; And the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.

rr: Ku naarizire, naayeburabuza niinyesiibyakwo, Kyampindukira ekijumo.
en: When I wept, and chastened my soul with fasting, That was to my reproach.

rr: Ku naahindwire ekiguniya eky'okujwara, Bampindura eky'okucweraho enfumu.
en: I made sackcloth also my garment; And I became a proverb to them.

rr: Ndi ekigaaniiro ky'abashutama aha irembo, Kandi ekyeshongoro ky'abasinzi.
en: They that sit in the gate speak against me; And I was the song of the drunkards.

rr: Kwonka nyowe, ai MUKAMA, niiwe nshaba. Omu bunaku oburikwikiririzibwamu, ai Ruhanga, ahabw'embabazi zaawe nyingi ongarukyemu.
en: But as for me, my prayer Is unto thee, O LORD , in an acceptable time: O God, in the multitude of thy mercy Hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.

rr: Ahabw'okuhwera kwawe okurikwesigwa onjune, Ntashaayira omu byondo; Nkire abarikuunyanga, kandi ndugye omu maizi maraingwa.
en: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: Let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.

rr: Otaikiriza omwegyemure kuntwara, N'obu kwakuba okumirirwa ahagati y'amaizi maingi; Kandi otaikiriza Ekiina kunkingirana omu kanwa kaakyo.
en: Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, And let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.

rr: Ongarukyemu, ai MUKAMA ahabw'okuba embabazi zaawe ni nungi; ahabw'okusaasira kwawe kwingi ompindukire
en: Hear me, O LORD ; for thy lovingkindness is good: Turn unto me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies.

rr: Kandi otaanyima amaisho gaawe, nyowe omwiru waawe; ahakuba ndi omu kabi, orahukye kungarukamu.
en: And hide not thy face from thy servant; For I am in trouble: Hear me speedily.

rr: Onyirire haihi, oncungure; Onyihe omu mikono y'abazigu bangye.
en: Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it: Deliver me because of mine enemies.

rr: Noomanya okujumwa kwangye, enshoni zangye, n'okuhemuka kwangye; Ababisha bangye boona noobamanya.
en: Thou hast known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: Mine adversaries are all before thee.

rr: Ebijumo bincwire omutima, ninshaasha munonga; Nsherwire ow'okunsaasira, yaabura; Kandi naasherura ab'okumpuumuriza, nabo bamburira.
en: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: And I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; And for comforters, but I found none.

rr: Bampa ebirikushaarira kubirya; N'ahabw'eiriho bampa viinyo erikushaarira kuginywa.
en: They gave me also gall for my meat; And in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

rr: -8 ; 109:6-15 . Emeeza yaabo ebabeere omutego, N'okugira obusingye kubabeere orugogo.
en: Let their table become a snare before them: And that which should have been for their welfare, let it become a trap.

rr: Amaisho gaabo gashwekwe oruho, barekye kureeba; Otetemye enyugunyu zaabo obutoosha.
en: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; And make their loins continually to shake.

rr: Obashukyeho okuguubwa kubi kwawe, Kandi ekiniga kyawe kingi kibahikyeho
en: Pour out thine indignation upon them, And let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.

rr: Eka yaabo ehindukye eitongo; Hatagira owaatuura omu mahema gaabo.
en: Let their habitation be desolate; And let none dwell in their tents.

rr: Ahakuba nibahiiga ou waateire, Nibagambirana eby'obusaasi bw'ogwo ou waahutaize.
en: For they persecute him whom thou hast smitten; And they talk to the grief of those whom thou hast wounded.

rr: Oyongyere ebiheneso aha biheneso byabo, Hatagira owaasinga orubanja omu maisho gaawe.
en: Add iniquity unto their iniquity: And let them not come into thy righteousness.

rr: amaziina gaabo gaihwe omu kitabo ky'amagara; Barekye kuhandiikwa n'abahikiriire.
en: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, And not be written with the righteous.

rr: Kwonka nyowe ndi omworo, kandi ow'obusaasi; Okujuna kwawe, ai Ruhanga, kuntunguure.
en: But I am poor and sorrowful: Let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.

rr: Ndyahimbisa eiziina rya Ruhanga n'ekyeshongoro, Mmuhe ekitiinisa n'eby'okumusiima.
en: I will praise the name of God with a song, And will magnify him with thanksgiving.

rr: Ebyo biryagwisa gye MUKAMA okukira enimi, Nari enimi y'ekimasha eine emahembe n'ebyara.
en: This also shall please the LORD Better than an ox or bullock that hath horns and hoofs.

rr: Abarikubonabonesibwa bakireebe, bashemererwe; Imwe abarikusherura Ruhanga, emitima yaanyu ehimbuukye!
en: The humble shall see this, and be glad: And your heart shall live that seek God.

rr: Ahakuba MUKAMA ahurira abakyene, Kandi tagaya bantu be abari omu kihome.
en: For the LORD heareth the poor, And despiseth not his prisoners.

rr: Eiguru n'ensi bimuhimbise, N'enyanja n'ebirikugyenderamu byona.
en: Let the heaven and earth praise him, The seas, and every thing that moveth therein.

rr: Ahakuba Ruhanga aryajuna Saayuuni, Agarukye ayombekye endembo za Yuda, Abantu be baryagituuramu, ebe eyaabo
en: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah: That they may dwell there, and have it in possession.

rr: Abaana b'abairu be baryagihungura, N'abakunda eiziina rye baryagituuramu.
en: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: And they that love his name shall dwell therein.

rr: Currently Selected: Zaaburi 69 : RR64 Highlight Share <svg width="24"
Ikiriza kunjuna, ai Ruhanga! Ai MUKAMA orahukye kumpwera!
en: Make haste , O God, to deliver me; Make haste to help me, O LORD .

rr: Abarikwenda kuunyita Bahemurwe, bashoberwe; N'abarikwesiima naakorwa kubi bagarurwe enyima, bagaywe.
en: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: Let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.

rr: Abarikunteerera enaku, nibagira bati: Otyo! Otyo! Batsigweho ahabw'enshoni zaabo.
en: Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame That say, Aha, aha.

rr: Boona abarikukusherura bashemererwe, bananukire omuriiwe! Abarikukunda okujuna kwawe bagume bagire bati: Ruhanga aheebwe ekitiinisa!
en: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: And let such as love thy salvation say continually, let God be magnified.

rr: Kwonka ndi omworo kandi omukyene; Rahuka kumpikaho, ai Ruhanga; Niiwe Muhwezi wangye, kandi Omujuni wangye; Ai MUKAMA otaikarayo!
en: But I am poor and needy; Make haste unto me, O God: Thou art my help and my deliverer; O LORD , make no tarrying.

rr: Ai MUKAMA, niiwe mpungiraho; Otandeka kuhemurwa!
en: In thee, O LORD , do I put my trust: Let me never be put to confusion.

rr: Onjune ahabw'okuhikiirira kwawe, onkize; Ontegye okutu, onjune!
en: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and cause me to escape: Incline thine ear unto me, and save me.

rr: Ombeere orukiri rw'okutuuramu, Omu ndaabaase kuguma nimpungira. Okaragiira kunjuna; ahakuba niiwe rukiri rwangye, kandi orugo rwangye orugumire.
en: Be thou my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: Thou hast given commandment to save me; For thou art my rock and my fortress.

rr: Ai Ruhanga wangye, onyihe omu mikono y'omubi, Onsikure omu mikono y'omuntu enshaarizi otahikiriire.
en: Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, Out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

rr: Ahakuba niiwe matsiko gangye, ai Mukama RUHANGA. Ou naayesigire okwiha omu buto bwangye.
en: For thou art my hope, O Lord GOD : Thou art my trust from my youth.

rr: Niiwe nyegamira okwiha obu naazaarwa; Niiwe waanyihire omu nda ya maawe. Niiwe ndiguma nimpimbisa.
en: By thee have I been holden up from the womb: Thou art he that took me out of my mother's bowels: My praise shall be continually of thee.

rr: Ndi nk'eihano eririkutangaaza baingi, Kwonka Iwe ori obuhungiro bwangye obugumire.
en: I am as a wonder unto many; But thou art my strong refuge.

rr: Akanwa kangye kaijura eby'okukuhimbisa, N'eby'okukuha ekitiinisa eizooba ryona.
en: Let my mouth be filled with thy praise And with thy honour all the day.

rr: Ku ndiba naabaire omugurusi, otarinnaga; Kandi ku ndihwamu amaani, otarintisigaho!
en: Cast me not off in the time of old age; Forsake me not when my strength faileth.

rr: Ahakuba abazigu bangye nibangambaho, Abagwereire amagara gangye nibahanuura hamwe
en: For mine enemies speak against me; And they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together,

rr: Nibagira bati: Ruhanga amutsigireho; Mumukurate, mumukwate; Ahakuba taine kijuna.
en: saying, God hath forsaken him: Persecute and take him; for there is none to deliver him .

rr: Ai Ruhanga, otanza hare, Ruhanga wangye, rahuka kumpwera.
en: O God, be not far from me: O my God, make haste for my help.

rr: Ababisha b'amagara gangye bakwatwe enshoni, bamarweho; Abarikwenda kunkora kubi bahindukye ekijumo, bagaywe.
en: Let them be confounded and consumed that are adversaries to my soul; Let them be covered with reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt.

rr: Kwonka nyowe ndyaguma n'amatsiko obutoosha, Nyeyongyere kukuhimbisa buri izooba.
en: But I will hope continually, And will yet praise thee more and more.

rr: Akanwa kangye karyamanyisa eby'okuhikiirira kwawe, N'eby'okujuna kwawe eizooba ryona; ahakuba ni bingi, tindikubaasa kubibara.
en: My mouth shall shew forth thy righteousness and thy salvation all the day; For I know not the numbers thereof .

rr: Ndyaija ngambe ebikuru ebi Mukama RUHANGA yaakozire; Ndyahimbisa okuhikiirira kwawe wenka.
en: I will go in the strength of the Lord GOD : I will make mention of thy righteousness, even of thine only.

rr: Ai Ruhanga, okanyegyesa okwiha omu buto bwangye, Kandi ninkigamba eby'okutangaaza ebi waakozire n'okuhitsya hati.
en: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth: And hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works.

rr: N'obu ndikura naamera enju, ai Ruhanga, otarintsigaho, Okuhitsya obu ndimanyisa amaani gaawe ab'obusingye bwona oburikurataho.
en: Now also when I am old and greyheaded, O God, forsake me not; Until I have shewed thy strength unto this generation, and thy power to every one that is to come.

rr: Kandi n'okuhikiirira kwawe, ai Ruhanga, kuri ahaiguru munonga; Iwe Ruhanga owaakozire ebikuru, n'oha orikushushana naiwe?
en: Thy righteousness also, O God, is very high, Who hast done great things: O God, who is like unto thee!

rr: Iwe owaanyikiriize nkareeba enaku nyingi, Oryagaruka, ompe amagara; Onzoore, onyihe okuzimu.
en: Thou , which hast shewed me great and sore troubles, shalt quicken me again, And shalt bring me up again from the depths of the earth.

rr: Oryanyongyeraho ekitiinisa, Kandi ogarukye ompuumuze omutima.
en: Thou shalt increase my greatness, And comfort me on every side.

rr: Naanye ndyakuhimbisa n'enanga, ahabw'okwesigwa kwawe, Ruhanga wangye; Ndyayeshongora eby'okukuhimbisa n'endingiri, Iwe Orikwera wa Israeli.
en: I will also praise thee with the psaltery, even thy truth, O my God: Unto thee will I sing with the harp, O thou Holy One of Israel.

rr: Ku ndyeshongora eby'okukuhimbisa, eminwa yangye eryateera akaari k'okushemererwa, Kandi n'amagara gangye agu waacungwire.
en: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto thee; And my soul, which thou hast redeemed.

rr: N'orurimi rwangye ruryagamba eby'okuhikiirira kwawe eizooba ryona; ahakuba abarikwenda kunkora kubi bakwatsiibwe enshoni, baahemurwa.
en: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long: For they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.

rr: Ohe omugabe okucwa emanja omu buryo bwawe, ai Ruhanga, N'omwana we omuhe okuhikiirira kwawe.
en: Give the king thy judgments, O God, And thy righteousness unto the king's son.

rr: Aryacwera abantu baawe emanja omu kuhikiirira, N'abooro baawe omu buryo.
en: He shall judge thy people with righteousness, And thy poor with judgment.

rr: Ebibungo n'otubungo biryareetera abantu obusingye omu kuhikiirira.
en: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, And the little hills, by righteousness.

rr: Aryacwera abooro b'omu bantu emanja, Ajune abaana b'abakyene, Kandi acwanyagure orikubonabonesa.
en: He shall judge the poor of the people, He shall save the children of the needy, And shall break in pieces the oppressor.

rr: Baryakutiina obusingye bwona, Eizooba n'okwezi bikiriho.
en: They shall fear thee as long as the sun and moon endure, Throughout all generations.

rr: Aryaija nk'enjura erikugwa aha bunyaatsi butemire, Nk'orutoonyerera orurikutoonyerera aha itaka.
en: He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: As showers that water the earth.

rr: Omu biro bye abahikiriire baryagogyeera, Bagire obusingye bwingi okuhitsya obu okwezi kuriburira kimwe.
en: In his days shall the righteous flourish; And abundance of peace so long as the moon endureth.

rr: Aryategyeka okuruga aha nyanja okuhika aha nyanja, N'okuruga aha Mugyera omukuru okuhika aha muheru gw'ensi.
en: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, And from the river unto the ends of the earth.

rr: Abatuura omu ihamba baryamwinamira; N'abazigu be baryarigatsa omucuucu.
en: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; And his enemies shall lick the dust.

rr: Abagabe ba Tarushiishi n'ab'omu birwa baryamutoijera; N'abagabe ba Sheeba na Seeba baryamureetera ebiconco.
en: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents: The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

rr: Eego abagabe boona baryagwa, bajuumare omu maisho ge, N'amahanga goona gamuheereze
en: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him: All nations shall serve him.

rr: Ahakuba aryajuna omukyene, ku arimutakira, N'omworo otaine kihwera.
en: For he shall deliver the needy when he crieth; The poor also, and him that hath no helper.

rr: Aryasaasira abooro n'abakyene, Kandi amagara g'enshoberwa agajune.
en: He shall spare the poor and needy, And shall save the souls of the needy.

rr: Aryacungura amagara gaabo, agaihe omu kubonabonesibwa n'omu mwaga, Kandi eshagama yaabo eryamubeera ey'obuguzi bwingi.
en: He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence: And precious shall their blood be in his sight.

rr: Aryagumaho; kandi baryamureetera ezaabu ya Sheeba; N'abantu baryaguma nibamushabira, Bamushabire omugisha eizooba ryona.
en: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: Prayer also shall be made for him continually; and daily shall he be praised.

rr: Haryabaho omweru mwingi omu nsi, Emyaka eryakondakonda omu misiri omu bibungo; Nk'ebiti bya Lebanooni. N'abantu b'omu rurembo baryaba nk'obunyaatsi bw'omu ishwa oburabize.
en: There shall be an handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the mountains; The fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: And they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.

rr: Eiziina rye riryagumaho ebiro byona, N'okurangaanwa kwe kuryagumaho, eizooba ku ririba rikiriho; Kandi omuriwe abantu boona nimwo bariheerwa omugisha; Amahanga goona garyamweta Oine omugisha.
en: His name shall endure for ever: His name shall be continued as long as the sun: And men shall be blessed in him: All nations shall call him blessed.

rr: MUKAMA asiimwe, niwe Ruhanga wa Israeli; We wenka akora eby'okutangaaza.
en: Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, Who only doeth wondrous things.

rr: Kandi eiziina rye ery'ekitiinisa risiimwe ebiro byona; Ekitiinisa kye kiijure ensi yoona. Amiina, kandi Amiina!
en: And blessed be his glorious name for ever: And let the whole earth be filled with his glory; Amen, and Amen.

rr: Eby'okushaba bya Daudi mwene Yese byagarukira aha.
en: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.

rr: Buzimazima Ruhanga ni murungi aha Baisraeli Abaine emitima eshemeire.
en: Truly God is good to Israel, Even to such as are of a clean heart.

rr: Kwonka nyowe, ebigyere byangye bikaba byatereire, Nkaba ndi haihi kugwa
en: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; My steps had well nigh slipped.

rr: Ahakuba ku naareebire okugogyeera kw'ababi, Naagirira abanyamaryo eihari.
en: For I was envious at the foolish, When I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

rr: Ku baba nibafa, tibashaasha, Batuura bari gye, kandi bagomokire.
en: For there are no bands in their death: But their strength is firm.

rr: Tibareeba naku nk'abandi, N'obu kwakuba okugwerwa akagwe nkabo.
en: They are not in trouble as other men; Neither are they plagued like other men.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo amaryo gaba nk'orukwanzi omu bitsya byabo; N'omwaga gubashweka nk'eky'okujwara.
en: Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain; Violence covereth them as a garment.

rr: Amaisho gabahwererera omu mutwe ahabw'okugomoka; N'emitima yaabo egira ebiteekateeko by'obushema ebirengyesereize.
en: Their eyes stand out with fatness: They have more than heart could wish.

rr: Bashekyerera abandi, bagamba eby'eitima, Omu maryo gaabo bakangisa abantu ku barikwija kubabonabonesa.
en: They are corrupt, and speak wickedly concerning oppression: They speak loftily.

rr: Akanwa kaabo kagamba eby'okujuma eiguru, N'orurimi rwabo rugyendagyenda omu nsi nirugamba eby'okwehimbisa.
en: They set their mouth against the heavens, And their tongue walketh through the earth.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo abantu bahinduka, babasiima, Babura ekibi ki babareebamu
en: Therefore his people return hither: And waters of a full cup are wrung out to them.

rr: Kandi bagira bati: Ruhanga naakimanya ata? rukira-boona aine eki arikumanya?
en: And they say, How doth God know? And is there knowledge in the most High?

rr: Reeba, ababi n'aba; Kandi ahabw'okugira obusingye obutoosha, beeyongyera kugira obutungi.
en: Behold, these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase in riches.

rr: Nkeeruhiza busha kushemeza omutima gwangye, N'okunaabisa engaro zangye omu kutashiisha
en: Verily I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocency.

rr: ahakuba ndenzya eizooba nimbonabonesibwa, Kandi buri kasheeshe mpeebwa ebiheneso.
en: For all the day long have I been plagued, And chastened every morning.

rr: Kuri naagizire nti: Ka ngambe ntyo, Nkaagobeize ab'obusingye bw'abaana baawe.
en: If I say, I will speak thus; Behold, I should offend against the generation of thy children.

rr: Ku naateekateekire oku ndaashoborokyerwe ekyo, Kikandusya, kyandema
en: When I thought to know this, It was too painful for me;

rr: Okuhitsya obu naagiire omu Mwanya gwa Ruhanga ogurikwera; Nkateekateeka ebiribabaho aha muheru.
en: Until I went into the sanctuary of God; Then understood I their end.

rr: Buzimazima obata aharikuterera, Obagwisa, bahwrekyerera.
en: Surely thou didst set them in slippery places: Thou castedst them down into destruction.

rr: Ka bahindukire eitongo omu mwanya mukye! Ebirikutiinisa bibamariireho kimwe.
en: How are they brought into desolation, as in a moment! They are utterly consumed with terrors.

rr: Nk'oku ekirooto kiba omuntu yaasisiimuka, Ku oriimuka, ai Mukama, Nikwo origaya otyo ebiteekateeko ebitariho.
en: As a dream when one awaketh; So , O Lord, when thou awakest, thou shalt despise their image.

rr: Ahakuba omutima gwangye gukagwisibwa kubi, Naacumitwa omunda yangye
en: Thus my heart was grieved, And I was pricked in my reins.

rr: Naaba omushema, otaine ki arikumanya, Naaba nk'enyamaishwa omu maisho gaawe.
en: So foolish was I, and ignorant: I was as a beast before thee.

rr: Kwonka nyowe ndi hamwe naiwe obutoosha; Okwaitse omukono gwangye gwa buryo.
en: Nevertheless I am continually with thee: Thou hast holden me by my right hand.

rr: Oryampabura n'obwengye bwawe, Kandi aha muheru oryantaasya omu kitiinisa.
en: Thou shalt guide me with thy counsel, And afterward receive me to glory.

rr: N'oha ou nyine omu iguru kureka Iwe? Tihariho ondiijo weena aha nsi ou nyiniire orushusho kureka Iwe.
en: Whom have I in heaven but thee? And there is none upon earth that I desire beside thee.

rr: omubiri gwangye n'omutima gwangye n'obu byakuhwaho, Kwonka Ruhanga niwe rukiri oru omutima gwangye guhungiraho, Kandi niwe omugabo gwangye ebiro n'ebiro.
en: My flesh and my heart faileth: But God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.

rr: Abakuza hare baryahwerekyerera; Omariraho kimwe abakutsigaho, bakeegyendera.
en: For, lo, they that are far from thee shall perish: Thou hast destroyed all them that go a whoring from thee.

rr: Kwonka ekirungi ahariinye n'okwirira haihi Ruhanga; Mukama RUHANGA mmuhindwire obweshereko bwangye, Mbone kumanyisa abantu ebi waakozire byona.
en: But it is good for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord GOD , That I may declare all thy works.

rr: Ai Ruhanga, ahabw'enki otunagire ebiro byona? Ahanki ekiniga kyawe nikibuguma aha ntaama z'omu iriisizo ryawe?
en: O God, why hast thou cast us off for ever? Why doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?

rr: Ijuka omutwe gw'abantu baawe abu waaguzire ira, Abu waacungwire kuba oruganda rw'obuhunguzi bwawe, N'orushozi Saayuuni oru waatwireho.
en: Remember thy congregation, which thou hast purchased of old; The rod of thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed; This mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt.

rr: Imuka oze omu mwanya ogwahindukiire kimwe amatongo, Oreebe obubi bwona obu abazigu baakozire omu Mwanya ogurikwera.
en: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual desolations; Even all that the enemy hath done wickedly in the sanctuary.

rr: Ababisha baawe bakatontomera ahagati y'enju yaawe ey'okuteeraniramu; Baahanika endango zaabo kuba obumanyiso.
en: Thine enemies roar in the midst of thy congregations; They set up their ensigns for signs.

rr: Aha irembo rya ruguru baatemagura Orugo rw'obubaaho bwogainemu n'empango zaabo.
en: A man was famous according as he had lifted up axes upon the thick trees.

rr: 1 Nk'abantu abakwaitse empango nibatema emiti y'omu kibira, Nikwo baashatagwire n'empango n'enyondo ebintu ebisharwire
en: But now they break down the carved work Thereof at once with axes and hammers.

rr: Baayotsya Omwanya gwawe ogurikwera, Kandi ahi Eiziina ryawe rituura baahashiihsa nibahasheenyagura.
en: They have cast fire into thy sanctuary, They have defiled by casting down the dwelling place of thy name to the ground.

rr: Baagira omu mitima yaabo bati: Ka tubahwerekyerereze kimwe! Baayotsya sinagogi za Ruhanga zoona omu nsi.
en: They said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: They have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land.

rr: Titukireeba bumanyiso bwaitu; Tihaakiriho nabi n'omwe, Kandi tihariho n'omwe ahariitwe orikumanya ahi ebi birigarukira.
en: We see not our signs: There is no more any prophet: Neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.

rr: Ai Ruhanga, ababisha baryahitsya hi okutujuma? Abazigu baryaguma barogote aha Iziina ryawe ebiro byona?
en: O God, how long shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?

rr: Ahabw'enki ohinyire omukono gwawe, omukono gwawe gwa buryo? Gwihe omu kifuba kyawe, obahwerekyereze.
en: Why withdrawest thou thy hand, even thy right hand? Pluck it out of thy bosom.

rr: Kwonka Ruhanga niwe Mukama wangye okwiha ira ryona, Otuura naakora eby'okujuna omu nsi.
en: For God is my King of old, Working salvation in the midst of the earth.

rr: Okabaganisa enyanja n'amaani gaawe, Waayatagurira kimwe emitwe y'ebijoka omu maizi
en: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: Thou brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters.

rr: Niiwe waayatagwire emitwe ya Leviasaani, Okagiha enyamaishwa z'omu ihamba kugirya.
en: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, And gavest him to be meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.

rr: Okaigura enshuro n'obugyera, Waayomya emigyera etooma.
en: Thou didst cleave the fountain and the flood: Thou driedst up mighty rivers.

rr: Nyomushana n'eyaawe, kandi na nyekiro n'eyaawe; Niiwe waataireho omushana n'eizooba.
en: The day is thine, the night also is thine: Thou hast prepared the light and the sun.

rr: Niiwe waataireho emyatano yoona ey'ensi. Kandi okataho ekyanda n'eitumba.
en: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: Thou hast made summer and winter.

rr: Ijuka eki, ai Ruhanga, oku abazigu barikukujuma, Nk'oku abantu abashema barikurogota aha Iziina ryawe.
en: Remember this, that the enemy hath reproached, O LORD , And that the foolish people have blasphemed thy name.

rr: Otaha enyamaishwa amagara g'enkombe yaawe; Oteebwa amagara g'abooro baawe ebiro byona.
en: O deliver not the soul of thy turtledove unto the multitude of the wicked: Forget not the congregation of thy poor for ever.

rr: Ta omutima aha ndagaano yaawe; ahabw'okuba emyanya y'omwirima omu nsi eijwire obutaaho bw'abanyamwaga.
en: Have respect unto the covenant: For the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty.

rr: Otaikiriza abarikubonabonesibwa kuhemurwa; Abooro n'abakyene bahimbise Eiziina ryawe.
en: O let not the oppressed return ashamed: Let the poor and needy praise thy name.

rr: Imuka, ai Ruhanga, oyetonganire; Oijukye oku abashema barikukujuma okurenzya eizooba.
en: Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: Remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee daily.

rr: Oteebwa orwari rw'abazigu baawe, N'okujagarara kw'abakugomeire oku baimutsya obutoosha.
en: Forget not the voice of thine enemies: The tumult of those that rise up against thee increaseth continually.

rr: Nitukusiima, ai Ruhanga; nitukusiima; ahakuba eiziina ryawe riri haihi; Abantu nibagamba eby'okutangaaza ebi waakozire.
en: Unto thee, O God, do we give thanks, Unto thee do we give thanks: For that thy name is near Thy wondrous works declare.

rr: Omu bunaku obu nditaho, Ndyacwa emanja omu mazima.
en: When I shall receive the congregation I will judge uprightly.

rr: Ensi n'abagituuramu n'obu biraabe nibitengatenga kugwa, Kwonka niinye mpamya enyomyo zaayo.
en: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I bear up the pillars of it. Selah.

rr: Nkagambira abanyamaryo nti: Mutagira amaryo; N'ababi nti: Mutaimutsya amahembe gaanyu.
en: I said unto the fools, Deal not foolishly: And to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:

rr: Mutaimutsya amahembe gaanyu; mutagamba mugangaize ebitsya.
en: Lift not up your horn on high: Speak not with a stiff neck.

rr: Mumanye ngu okukuzibwa tikuruga burugwa-izooba, Nari oburengyerwa-izooba, n'obu bwakuba obukiizi-bwa-buryo
en: For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west, Nor from the south.

rr: Kureka Ruhanga niwe mucwi w'emanja, Ogarura ahansi omwe, akatunguura ondiijo.
en: But God is the judge: He putteth down one, and setteth up another.

rr: Ahakuba omu mikono gwa MUKAMA harimu ekikopo, Ekirimu viinyo etimbwire erikubira; aryagishuka; Buzima ababi boona ab'omu nsi baryaginywa, bagimaremu, Bacence n'ebikanja byayo.
en: For in the hand of the LORD there is a cup, and the wine is red; It is full of mixture; and he poureth out of the same: But the dregs thereof, All the wicked of the earth shall wring them out, and drink them .

rr: Kwonka nyowe ndyashemererwa ebiro byona; Nyeshongore eby'okuhimbisa Ruhanga wa Yakobo.
en: But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

rr: Amahembe goona ag'ababi aryagatemaho, Kwonka amahembe g'abahikiriire garyaheebwa ekitiinisa.
en: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; But the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.

rr: Omuri Yuda Ruhanga naamanywa; Eiziina rye ni rukuru omuri Israeli.
en: In Judah is God known: His name is great in Israel.

rr: Eihema rye riri omuri Saalemu, Kandi atuura omuri Saayuuni.
en: In Salem also is his tabernacle, And his dwelling place in Zion.

rr: Okwo niyo yaahendeire emyambi y'obuta, Engabo, na rurara, n'eby'okurwanisa omu rugamba.
en: There brake he the arrows of the bow, The shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah.

rr: Ori ow'ekitiinisa, kandi ori murungi okukira boona, Otabaarukire aha bibungo ebiriho eminyago.
en: Thou art more glorious and excellent Than the mountains of prey.

rr: Ab'omutima gw'obumanzi banyagirwe, Bagwejegyeire obutasisiimuka, Abarwani boona tibabaasize kwerwanaho n'emikono yaabo.
en: The stouthearted are spoiled, they have slept their sleep: And none of the men of might have found their hands.

rr: Ahabw'okuhana kwawe, ai Ruhanga wa Yakobo, Embaraasi n'abarikuzigyenderaho bagwejengyeire obutaimutsya mutwe.
en: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, Both the chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.

rr: Kwonka Iwe ori ow'okutiinisa! N'oha orikubaasa kukwemerera omumaisho waagira ekiniga?
en: Thou, even thou, art to be feared: And who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry?

rr: Okeema omu iguru, waamanyisa oku waacwire orubanja, Ensi yaatiina, yaacureera
en: Thou didst cause judgment to be heard from heaven; The earth feared, and was still,

rr: Ruhanga ku yaimukire kucwa orubanja, N'okujuna boona abarikubonabonesibwa omu nsi.
en: When God arose to judgment, To save all the meek of the earth. Selah.

rr: Buzimazima ekingia ky'abantu kiryakuhimbisa, N'ekiniga ekiritsigaraho oryakizibira.
en: Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee: The remainder of wrath shalt thou restrain.

rr: Ohigye ahari MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe, kandi ohikiirize okuhiga kwawe; Boona abamwehinguririize bareete emitoijo ahari Ogwo oshemereire kutiinwa
en: Vow, and pay unto the LORD your God: Let all that be round about him Bring presents unto him that ought to be feared.

rr: Niwe ahwerekyereza amagara g'abanyiginya, Kandi otiinisa abagabe b'ensi.
en: He shall cut off the spirit of princes: He is terrible to the kings of the earth.

en: Currently Selected: Psalm 76 : KJV Highlight Share <path d="M5 12a1 1 0 0 1 1

rr: Ka ntakire Ruhanga n'eiraka ryangye, Ka mmutakire n'eiraka rihango, naija kumpurira.
en: I Cried unto God with my voice, Even unto God with my voice; and he gave ear unto me.

rr: Aha izooba eri naareebeireho enaku, nkasherura Mukama; Naimutsya emikono yangye nyekiro, tinaaruha; amagara gangye gaayanga kuhuumuzibwa.
en: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord: My sore ran in the night, and ceased not: My soul refused to be comforted.

rr: Ku nyijuka Ruhanga, nyemereza omutima, Ngira amaganya, omutima gwangye gugwa enshazi.
en: I remembered God, and was troubled: I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah.

rr: Ozibira amaisho gangye kuteerana; Nyine enaku; tindikubaasa kugamba.
en: Thou holdest mine eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.

rr: Nteekateekire ebiro ebya ira, N'emyaka eya iranaira.
en: I have considered the days of old, The years of ancient times.

rr: Naijuka ekyeshongoro kyangye kya nyekiro; Naateekateeka munonga, omutima gwangye gwayezirika kwecaaka.
en: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart: And my spirit made diligent search.

rr: Mukama aryanagira kimwe? Tarigaruka kugira embabazi obundi?
en: Will the Lord cast off for ever? And will he be favourable no more?

rr: Okusaasira kwe kuhwereireho kimwe ebiro byona? Ebi yaaraganiise biryaguma bibuzire obutwire bwona?
en: Is his mercy clean gone for ever? Doth his promise fail for evermore?

rr: Ruhanga ayebirwe okugira embabazi? Aimire embabazi ze nyingi ahabw'ekiniga?
en: Hath God forgotten to be gracious? Hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah.

rr: Bwanyima naagira nti: Ebyo nibiruga omu bweremwa bwangye; Okuteekateeka ngu omukono gwa buryo ogwa Rukira-boona niguginduka!
en: And I said, This is my infirmity: But I will remember the years of the right hand of the Most High.

rr: Ndyaijutsya abantu ebi MUKAMA yaakozire. Kandi ndyaijuka eby'okutangaaza byawe ebya ira.
en: I will remember the works of the LORD : Surely I will remember thy wonders of old.

rr: Ndyateekateeka munonga aha murimo gwawe gwona, Ngumye ebiteekateeko byangye aha bikuru ebi waakozire.
en: I will meditate also of all thy work, And talk of thy doings.

rr: Omuhanga gwawe, ai Ruhanga, nigwera. N'oha ruhanga omukuru orukwingana na Ruhanga waitu?
en: Thy way, O God, is in the sanctuary: Who is so great a God as our God?

rr: Niiwe wenak Ruhanga okora eby'okutangaaza; Okooreka amaani gaawe omu mahanga
en: Thou art the God that doest wonders: Thou hast declared thy strength among the people.

rr: Waacungura abantu baawe n'omukono gwawe, Nibo baana ba Yakobo na Yosefu.
en: Thou hast with thine arm redeemed thy people, The sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.

rr: Amaizi gakakureeba, ai Ruhanga; Ku gaakureebire, gaatiina; ahagati omu maizi maingi haatetema.
en: The waters saw thee, O God, the waters saw thee; they were afraid: The depths also were troubled.

rr: Ebicu byashuka amaizi, eiguru ryahinda; Emyambi yaawe yamurinkana hoona
en: The clouds poured out water: The skies sent out a sound: Thine arrows also went abroad.

rr: Eiraka ry'okuhinda kwawe ryaizira omu kasooroora; Emirabyo yaawe yaamurika ensi yoona; Ensi yaatetema, yaatengyeta.
en: The voice of thy thunder was in the heaven: The lightnings lightened the world: The earth trembled and shook.

rr: Omuhanda gwawe gukaba guri omu nyanja, N'otuhanda twawe nituraba omu maizi maingi; Ahi ebigyere byawe byarabire, tiharamanyirwe.
en: Thy way is in the sea, and thy path in the great waters, And thy footsteps are not known.

rr: Ahabw'omukono gwa Musa na Arooni Okeeebembera abantu baawe nk'obusyo bw'entaama.
en: Thou leddest thy people like a flock By the hand of Moses and Aaron.

rr: Currently Selected: Zaaburi 77 : RR64 Highlight Share <div class="flex w-full items-center gap-1 rtl:fle
Imwe bantu bangye 'mwe, nimuhurire okwegyesa kwangye, Mutege amatu ebigambo, ebirikuruga omu kanwa kangye.
en: Give ear, O my people, to my law: Incline your ears to the words of my mouth.

rr: Ndyayashamya akanwa kangye, ncwe enfumu; Ngambe ebitarikushobooroka ebya ira
en: I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old:

rr: Ebi twahuriire tukamanya, Ebi baatatenkuriitwe baatugambiire.
en: Which we have heard and known, And our fathers have told us.

rr: Tituribishereka baana baabo, Kureka turyagambira ab'obusingye oburiija Eby'ekitiinisa ebi MUKAMA yaakozire n'amaani ge, N'eby'okutangaaza ebi yaakazire.
en: We will not hide them from their children, shewing to the generation to come, The praises of the LORD , and his strength, and his wonderful works that he hath done.

rr: Ahakuba akataho eby'okumuhamya omuri Yakobo, Yaaragiira ekiragiro omuri Israeli, Ebi yaaragiire baatatenkuriitwe kwegyesa abaana baabo
en: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, Which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:

rr: Ngu ab'obusingye oburiija babimanye, nibo baana abarizaarwa, Bakaimuka, bakabigambira abaana baabo
en: That the generation to come might know them , Even the children which should be born; Who should arise And declare them to their children:

rr: Ngu babone kwesiga Ruhanga, n'okuteebwa mirimo ye, Kureka boorobere ebiragiro bye
en: That they might set their hope in God, And not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:

rr: Kandi barekye kuba nka baishenkurubo Ab'obusingye obugangaire obw'obugomi, Abaabaire baine emitima etahamiire hamwe, Kandi abaagizire omwoyo ogutarikwesigwa ahari Ruhanga.
en: And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; A generation that set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not stedfast with God.

rr: Abefuraimu, abaabaire bahagatiire amata, Bakahunga aha izooba ry'orugamba.
en: The children of Ephraim, being armed, and carrying bows, Turned back in the day of battle.

rr: Tibararinzire ndagaano ya Ruhanga, Bakanga kugyenda nk'oku ebiragiro bye biri.
en: They kept not the covenant of God, And refused to walk in his law;

rr: Baayebwa ebi yaakozire, N'eby'okutangaaza ebi yaaboorekire.
en: And forgat his works, And his wonders that he had shewed them.

rr: —12:32. Akakora eby'okutangaaza omu maisho ga baishenkurubo, Omu nsi ya Misri n'omu mariisizo ga Zoani.
en: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, In the field of Zoan.

rr: Yaabaganisa enyanja, yaagibarabyamu, Yaayemereza amaizi, gaaba nk'omugongo.
en: He divided the sea, and caused them to pass through; And he made the waters to stand as an heap.

rr: Nyomushana abeebembeza ekicu, Kandi nyekiro abeebembeza omuriro gurikwaka.
en: In the daytime also he led them with a cloud, And all the night with a light of fire.

rr: Akaata enkiri omu ihamba, aabanywaisa amaizi maingi nk'agarikuruga aha nshuro z'okuzimu.
en: He clave the rocks in the wilderness, And gave them drink as out of the great depths.

rr: Akaigura enshuro omu rukiri, amaizi gaahimintika nigashuuma nk'emigyera.
en: He brought streams also out of the rock, And caused waters to run down like rivers.

rr: Kwonka baayeyongyera kumucumuraho, Nibagomera Rukira-boona bari omu ihamba.
en: And they sinned yet more against him By provoking the most High in the wilderness.

rr: Baagyeza Ruhanga omu mitima yaabo, Nibamushaba eby'okurya ebi baayetengire.
en: And they tempted God in their heart By asking meat for their lust.

rr: Baagamba nibagaya Ruhanga, nibagira bati: Ebyo Ruhanga naabaasa kutugaburira eby'okurya omu ihamba?
en: Yea, they spake against God; They said, Can God furnish a table in the wilderness?

rr: N'eky'amazima akateera orukiri, amaizi gaahimintika, emigyera yaashandaara, Beitu naabaasa kuha abantu be eby'okurya, abahe n'enyama?
en: Behold, he smote the rock, that the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed; Can he give bread also? Can he provide flesh for his people?

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo MUKAMA ku yaakihuriire, yaakwatwa ekiniga; Omuriro gwahembwa kwotsya Yakobo, Ekiniga kyacumbuukira israeli
en: Therefore the LORD heard this , and was wroth: So a fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also came up against Israel;

rr: Ahabw'okuba tibaraikiriize Ruhanga, n'obu kwakuba okwesiga okujuna kwe.
en: Because they believed not in God, And trusted not in his salvation:

rr: Kwonka yaaragiira ebicu by'omu iguru, Yaigura enyigi z'eiguru
en: Though he had commanded the clouds from above, And opened the doors of heaven,

rr: Taabagwisiza emaanu ey'okurya, Taaguma naabaha engano z'eiguru.
en: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, And had given them of the corn of heaven.

rr: Abantu baarya aha mugaati gw'ekinyamaraika, Yaabagaburira, baahaaga.
en: Man did eat angels' food: He sent them meat to the full.

rr: -20 , Yaareeta omuyaga gw'oburugwa-izooba, gwahuuha omu iguru, Ahabw'amaani ge yaahabura omuyaga gw'obukiizi-bwa-buryo
en: He caused an east wind to blow in the heaven: And by his power he brought in the south wind.

rr: Taabagwisiza enyama nyingi nk'omucuucu, Endahi ezirikwingana nk'omusheenyi gw'omu nyanja
en: He rained flesh also upon them as dust, And feathered fowls like as the sand of the sea:

rr: Taazigwisa ahagati omu nsiisira zaabo Embaju zoona ez'amahema gaabo
en: And he let it fall in the midst of their camp, Round about their habitations.

rr: Batyo baarya, baahaagira kimwe; Ahjakuba akabaha eki baayetengire
en: So they did eat, and were well filled: For he gave them their own desire;

rr: Kwonka ku baabaire batakahweire kwetenga, N'enyama zikiri omu kanwa kaabo
en: They were not estranged from their lust. But while their meat was yet in their mouths,

rr: Ekiniga kya Ruhanga kyabagwaho, Kyabitamu ab'amaani, Kyahwerekyereza abatsigazi ba Israeli.
en: The wrath of God came upon them, and slew the fattest of them, And smote down the chosen men of Israel.

rr: -4 , Kwonka ebyo byona n'obu biraabe byabaireho, bakaguma nibashiisha, Tibaikiriza by'okutangaaza ebi yaakozire.
en: For all this they sinned still, And believed not for his wondrous works.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo yaafiisa ebiro byabo busha, N'emyaka yaabo baagimara baine obwoba.
en: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, And their years in trouble.

rr: Ku yaabaire abaita, bamusherura; Beeteisa, beezirika kusherura Ruhanga.
en: When he slew them, then they sought him: And they returned and enquired early after God.

rr: Kandi baijuka ku Ruhanga ari orukiri rwabo, Ruhanga Rukira-boona ku ari Omucunguzi waabo.
en: And they remembered that God was their rock, And the high God their redeemer.

rr: Kwonka bamuha ekitiinisa ky'aha minwa, Nibamubiha n'endimi zaabo
en: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouth, And they lied unto him with their tongues.

rr: ahakuba emitima yaabo ekaba etamuhamiireho, Kandi batari beesigwa ha ndagaano ye.
en: For their heart was not right with him, Neither were they stedfast in his covenant.

rr: Kwonka We ahabw'embabazi ze nyingi Taabasaasira okutahikiirira kwabo, Tiyaabahwerekyereza; Kaingi akaba ayezibira kubagwerwa kubi, Areka kubamariraho ekiniga kye kyona.
en: But he, being full of compassion, Forgave their iniquity, and destroyed them not: Yea, many a time turned he his anger away, And did not stir up all his wrath.

rr: Aijuka ku bari abantu-buntu, Nk'omuyaga oguhingura, gutagarukye.
en: For he remembered that they were but flesh; A wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.

rr: Ka ni kaingi obu baamugomera omu ihamba, Bakamugwisiza kubi ahatatuurwa bantu!
en: How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, And grieve him in the desert!

rr: Bakaguma nibamugyeza, Baakwatsa ekiniga Orikwera wa Israeli.
en: Yea, they turned back and tempted God, And limited the Holy One of Israel.

rr: Tibaijuka bushoboorozi bwe, N'obu ryakuba eizooba eri yaabakiriizeho abazigu baabo
en: They remembered not his hand, Nor the day when he delivered them from the enemy.

rr: Obu yaakora obumanyiso omuri Misri, N'eby'okutangaaza omu mariisizo ga Zoani.
en: How he had wrought his signs in Egypt, And his wonders in the field of Zoan:

rr: Akahindura emigyera yaabo eshagama, Tibaabaasa kunywa maizi gaayo.
en: And had turned their rivers into blood; And their floods, that they could not drink.

rr: -14 , 21-24 . Taabateeza emizinga y'enshohera, zaabaruma, N'ebikyere ebyabahwerekyereize.
en: He sent divers sorts of flies among them, which devoured them; And frogs, which destroyed them.

rr: Yaariisa emisiri yaabo kanyananga, N'ebi baahingire yaabiriisa enzigye.
en: He gave also their increase unto the caterpiller, And their labour unto the locust.

rr: Yaateeza emizaabubu yaabo orubaare, N'emisikamoori yaabo yaagiitsa embeho y'enyababa.
en: He destroyed their vines with hail, And their sycomore trees with frost.

rr: Yaareka ente zaabo, zaateerwa orubaare, N'asyo gaabo gaateerwa enkuba.
en: He gave up their cattle also to the hail, And their flocks to hot thunderbolts.

rr: Taabashukaho ekiniga kye kingi, Okuguubwa kubi, okutamwa, n'enaku, Nigwo mutwe gwa baamaraika abarikuhwerekyereza.
en: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and trouble, By sending evil angels among them .

rr: akacwera ekiniga kye ekirarai, Tiyaabakiza kufa, kureka yaahayo amagara gaabo kubonabonesibwa.
en: He made a way to his anger; He spared not their soul from death, But gave their life over to the pestilence;

rr: Yaita emijigaijo yoona omuri Misri, Abaana b'amaani gaabo ag'okubanza omu mahema ga Haamu.
en: And smote all the firstborn in Egypt; The chief of their strength in the tabernacles of Ham:

rr: Kwonka abantu be yaabeebembera nk'entaama, naabashohoza, Yaabahabura, naabarabya omu ihamba nk'amasyo g'entaama.
en: But made his own people to go forth like sheep, And guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

rr: Yaabeebembera gye, tibaatiina; Kwonak enyanja yaamira abazigu baabo.
en: And he led them on safely, so that they feared not: But the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

rr: Taabahitsya aha mwatano gw'ensi ye erikwera, N'aha kibungo, eki yaakubwire n'omukono gwe gwa buryo.
en: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, Even to this mountain, which his right hand had purchased.

rr: Yaabingamu amahanga, gaabahunga; Yaagibabaganisiza kuba obuhunguzi bwabo, Yaata enganda za Israeli omu mahema gaabo.
en: He cast out the heathen also before them, And divided them an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

rr: Kwonka baagyeza Ruhanga Rukira-boona, baamugomera, Tibaata mutima aha bi yaahamize
en: Yet they tempted and provoked the most high God, And kept not his testimonies:

rr: Kureka baagaruka enyima, baagobya nka baishenkurubo; Baategama nk'obuta obureebya nyinabwo
en: But turned back, and dealt unfaithfully like their fathers: They were turned aside like a deceitful bow.

rr: Ahabw'okuba bakamukwatsa ekiniga n'emyanya yaabo mikuru ey'okuramizamu, Baamwitsya eihari n'ebishushani byabo ebibaizire.
en: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, And moved him to jealousy with their graven images.

rr: Ruhanga ku yaakihuriire, yaagira ekiniga kingi, Yaayangira kimwe Israeli
en: When God heard this , he was wroth, And greatly abhorred Israel:

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo yaatsigaho eihema rye omuri Shiilo, Eri yaabaire atuuramu omu bantu
en: So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, The tent which he placed among men;

rr: Yaahayo eshanduukye y'amaani ge kunyagwa, Kandi ey'ekitiinisa kye omu mikono y'abazigu.
en: And delivered his strength into captivity, And his glory into the enemy's hand.

rr: Yaareka abantu be kwitwa rurara, Yaagirira obuhunguzi bwe ekiniga.
en: He gave his people over also unto the sword; And was wroth with his inheritance.

rr: Omuriro gwayokyeza kimwe abatsigazi baabo, N'abaishiki baabo tibaagaruka kweshongorera ha bugyenyi.
en: The fire consumed their young men; And their maidens were not given to marriage.

rr: Abanyamurwa baabo baitwa rurara, N'abafaakzi baabo tibaabacurira.
en: Their priests fell by the sword; And their widows made no lamentation.

rr: Bwanyima Mukama yaasisiimuka nk'owaaba agwejegyeire, Nk'omushaija ow'amaani orikuyombesibwa viinyo
en: Then the Lord awaked as one out of sleep, And like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.

rr: Yaateera abazigu be, yaabagarura enyima, Yaabataho ekihemu eky'ebiro n'ebiro.
en: And he smote his enemies in the hinder parts: He put them to a perpetual reproach.

rr: Kandi yaayanga eihema rya Yosefu, Tiyaatoorana ruganda rwa Efuraimu
en: Moreover he refused the tabernacle of Joseph, And chose not the tribe of Ephraim:

rr: Kureka yaatoorana orwa Yuda, N'ekibungo Saayuuni eki akunda.
en: But chose the tribe of Judah, The mount Zion which he loved.

rr: 1 Yaayombeka Omwanya gwe ogurikwera gwaba nk'enshozi ndaingwa, Kandi gwaguma nk'ensi ei yaahamiize kimwe.
en: And he built his sanctuary like high palaces , Like the earth which he hath established for ever.

rr: 1 Yaatoorana Daudi omwiru we, Yaamwiha omu ntaama
en: He chose David also his servant, And took him from the sheepfolds:

rr: 2 Omu kuriisa ebuguma ezirikwontsya Ngu ariise Yakobo abantu be, na Israeli obuhunguzi bwe.
en: From following the ewes great with young he brought him To feed Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance.

rr: Yaabariisa n'omutima gw'amazima, Yaabeebembeza obwengye bw'emikono ye.
en: So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; And guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.

rr: Currently Selected: Zaaburi 78 : RR64 Highlight Share <div class="text-text-light
Ai Ruhanga, abanyamahanga bataahire omu buhunguzi bwawe, Baashiisha hekalu yaawe erikwera, Baashenya Yerusaalemu, baagihindura omutuumo.
en: O God, the heathen are come into thine inheritance; Thy holy temple have they defiled; They have laid Jerusalem on heaps.

rr: Emitumbi y'abairu baawe bagihaire enyonyi z'omu mwanya kugirya, Baagaburira enyamaishwa z'omu nsi emibiri y'abarikwera baawe.
en: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given to be meat unto the fowls of the heaven, The flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.

rr: Baseesire eshagama yaabo nk'amaizi okwkehinguririza Yerusaalemu; Kandi tibaine kiziika.
en: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem; And there was none to bury them .

rr: Ahari bataahi baitu tuhindukire ekijumo, Kandi abatwehinuririize nibatushekyerera, nibatugaya.
en: We are become a reproach to our neighbours, A scorn and derision to them that are round about us.

rr: Oryahitsya hi, ai MUKAMA okutugirira ekiniga ebiro byona? Eihari ryawe riryayaka nk'omuriro?
en: How long, LORD ? Wilt thou be angry for ever? Shall thy jealousy burn like fire?

rr: Shuka ekiniga kyawe aha mahanga agatarikukumanya, N'aha bugabe obutatakira iziina ryawe
en: Pour out thy wrath upon the heathen that have not known thee, And upon the kingdoms that have not called upon thy name.

rr: Ahabw'okuba bamizire Yakobo, N'ahu atwire baahahindura eitongo.
en: For they have devoured Jacob, And laid waste his dwelling place.

rr: Otaijuka eby'okutahikiirira bya baatatenkuriitwe, okabitutura; Okusaasira kwawe kurahukye kutuhikaho, Ahabw'okuba tugarwirwe ahansi munonga.
en: O remember not against us former iniquities: Let thy tender mercies speedily prevent us: For we are brought very low.

rr: Ai Ruhanga ow'okujunwa kwaitu, otuhwere Ahabw'ekitiinisa ky'eiziina ryawe; Otujune, oshwekye ebibi byaitu ahabw'eiziina ryawe.
en: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of thy name: And deliver us, and purge away our sins, for thy name's sake.

rr: Ahabw'enki abanyamahanga nibagira bati: Ruhanga waabo arahi?
en: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is their God?

rr: Okuhoora enzigu ahabw'eshagama y'abairu baawe eyaasheeshekire Kumanywe omu banyamahanga, naitwe tukireebe.
en: Let him be known among the heathen in our sight By the revenging of the blood of thy servants which is shed.

rr: Okutsinda kw'embohe kukuhikyeho; Ahabw'amaani gaawe maingi okize abateekateekyeirwe okufa.
en: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee; According to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to die;

rr: Oihure bataahi baitu emirundi mushanju ebijumo Ebi baakujumire, ai Mukama!
en: And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom Their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.

rr: Naitwe abantu baawe, entaama z'omu iriisizo ryawe, Turyakusiima ebiro byona, Tumanyise ab'obusingye bwona okuhimbisibwa kwawe.
en: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture will give thee thanks for ever: We will shew forth thy praise to all generations.

rr: Tega okutu, Iwe Omuriisa wa Israeli, Oyebembera Yosefu nk'obusyo! Iwe oshutama aha kitebe ahagati ya baakerubi, jwisa omushana gwawe!
en: Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; Thou that dwellest between the cherubims, shine forth.

rr: Omu maisho ga Efuraimu, Benyamiini na Manaase Sisimura amaani gaawe, oije otujune!
en: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up thy strength, And come and save us.

rr: Otugarure aha buteeka, ai Ruhanga, Otwakize amaisho gaawe, tubone kujunwa!
en: Turn us again, O God, And cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

rr: Ai MUKAMA Ruhanga ow'amahe, Oryahitsya hi okugwerwa kubi okushaba kw'abantu baawe?
en: O LORD God of hosts, How long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?

rr: Obagaburiire okurira nk'eby'okurya, Waabanywaisa amarira maingi munonga.
en: Thou feedest them with the bread of tears; And givest them tears to drink in great measure.

rr: Otuhindwire eki bataahi baitu barikurwanira; Abazigu baitu nibeeshekyera.
en: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbours: And our enemies laugh among themselves.

rr: Ai Ruhanga omuzaabibu omuri Misri, Waabinga amahanga, waagubyara.
en: Turn us again, O God of hosts, And cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

rr: Okaiha omuzaabibu omuri Misri, Waabinga amahanga, waagubyara.
en: Thou hast brought a vine out of Egypt: Thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted it.

rr: Waaguhingirira, gwahitsya emizi okuzimu, Gwabuga ensi.
en: Thou preparedst room before it, And didst cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.

rr: Gwarandira aha bibungo byona, N'amataagi gaagwo gaasheka emyereezi mihango
en: The hills were covered with the shadow of it, And the boughs thereof were like the goodly cedars.

rr: Gwanaga amataagi, gaahika aha Nyanja, Gwazaara abaana, baahika aha Mugyera mukuru.
en: She sent out her boughs unto the sea, And her branches unto the river.

rr: Mbwenu ahabw'enki osheenyire orugo rwagwo, Ngu abahinguzi boona bagucweho?
en: Why hast thou then broken down her hedges, So that all they which pass by the way do pluck her?

rr: Engiri z'omu ihamba nizigushiisha, Enyamaishwa z'omu ishwa nizigwona.
en: The boar out of the wood doth waste it, And the wild beast of the field doth devour it.

rr: Ai Ruhanga ow'amahe, nitukweshengyereza otugarure aha buteeka, Oyeme omu iguru, oreebe oyetegyereze, Ote omutima ahari ogu muzaabibu
en: Return, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: Look down from heaven, And behold, and visit this vine;

rr: Ekitsintsi kyawe eki waayebyariire, Kandi eitaagi eri waayehamiize.
en: And the vineyard which thy right hand hath planted, And the branch that thou madest strong for thyself.

rr: Bagwokize n'omuriro, baagutema. Nkaahenwa ki bahwerekyerezibwa okuhana kw'ekitsyori kyawe!
en: It is burned with fire, it is cut down: They perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.

rr: Kwonka omukono gwawe gugume aha muntu waawe 80:17 Omuntu waawe empika, omu Ruheburayo n'omuntu ow'omukono gwawe gwa buryo. empika, Aha mwana w'omuntu ou waahaire amaani kukugasira.
en: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, Upon the son of man whom thou madest strong for thyself.

rr: Mbwenu obwo naitwe titurigaruka enyima, tukakutsigaho; Otuhe amagara, tugume tutakire eiziina ryawe!
en: So will not we go back from thee: Quicken us, and we will call upon thy name.

rr: Ai MUKAMA Ruhanga ow'amahe, otugarure aha buteeka, Otwakize amaisho gaawe, tubone kujunwa!
en: Turn us again, O LORD God of hosts, Cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

rr: Mweshongorere Ruhanga amaani gaitu n'eiraka rihango, Muteerere Ruhanga wa Yakobo akaari k'okushemererwa!
en: Sing aloud unto God our strength: Make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob.

rr: Mwimutsye ekyeshongoro, muteere ebitaasa, N'enanga nungi n'endingiri.
en: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, The pleasant harp with the psaltery.

rr: Muteere amakondere okwezi kubonekire, kandi mugateere kukuzire, aha izooba ryaitu ry'obugyenyi erikuru.
en: Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, In the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.

rr: Ahakuba n'ekiragiro ahabw'Abaisraeli, Ekyaragiirwe Ruhanga wa Yakobo
en: For this was a statute for Israel, And a law of the God of Jacob.

rr: Akakitaho kuba eky'okureeberaho omu ba Yosefu, Obu yaaraba omu nsi ya Misri, Ei naahuririire orurimi oru ntarikumanya.
en: This he ordained in Joseph for a testimony, When he went out through the land of Egypt: Where I heard a language that I understood not.

rr: Nkabaiha omutwaro aha mabega, Engaro zaanyu zaarekura ekiibo.
en: I removed his shoulder from the burden: His hands were delivered from the pots.

rr: Ku mwatakire muri omu busaasi, naabakiza; Naabagarukamu ndi omu mwanya gw'enkuba ogutarikumanywa; Naabagyereza aha maizi ga Meriba.
en: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder: I proved thee At the waters of Meribah.

rr: Sela.
en: Selah.

rr: Bantu bangye, muhurire ebi ndikubahana; Iwe Israeli, nkaabaasibwa ki, ompurira!
en: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wilt hearken unto me;

rr: Mutarigira ruhanga w'abanyamahanga omuriimwe, N'obu kwakuba okumaramya.
en: There shall no strange god be in thee; Neither shalt thou worship any strange god.

rr: Niinye MUKAMA Ruhanga waawe, Owaakwihire omu nsi ya Misri; Yashamya munonga akanwa kaawe, nkaijuze.
en: I am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt: Open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.

rr: Kwonka abantu bangye tibarahuriire iraka ryangye, Kandi Israeli tarankunzire na kakye
en: But my people would not hearken to my voice; And Israel would none of me.

rr: Nikwo kubareka, bakaguma baine emitima egangaire, Bakakurata obwengye bwabo ahabwabo.
en: So I gave them up unto their own hearts' lust: And they walked in their own counsels.

rr: Nkaabaasibwa ki, abantu bangye bampurira, Abaisraeli bagyendera omu mihanda yangye!
en: Oh that my people had hearkened unto me, And Israel had walked in my ways!

rr: Naanye ndahuka kugomoora abazigu baabo, Ndwanisa ababisha baabo.
en: I should soon have subdued their enemies, And turned my hand against their adversaries.

rr: Abangi ba MUKAMA bamugomookyera, Kandi n'ebiro byabo tibyakuhweireho ebiro byona.
en: The haters of the LORD should have submitted themselves unto him: But their time should have endured for ever.

rr: Nkaabagaburiire engano nungi munonga, Mbaigutsa obwoki oburikuruga omu rukiri.
en: He should have fed them also with the finest of the wheat: And with honey out of the rock should I have satisfied thee.
