en: 13 For I speak to you Gentiles, inasmuch as I am the apostle of the Gentiles, I magnify mine office:

rr: 14 ngu nkaakwatsa beene waitu Abayudaaya eihari, abamwe omuribo bajunwa.
en: 14 if by any means I may provoke to emulation them which are my flesh, and might save some of them.

rr: 15 Okucuubwa kwabo ku kuraabe nikureetera ab'ensi zoona kugarukana na Ruhanga, okugarurwa kwabo kuryareeta ki? Tikurireeta okuzooka omu bafu?
en: 15 For if the casting away of them be the reconciling of the world, what shall the receiving of them be , but life from the dead?

rr: 16 Esaano y'omuganuro ku eba eri erikwera, n'ekiihuro kyona nikwo kiba; kandi ekitsitsa ku kiba kiri ekirikwera, n'amataagi nikwo gaba.
en: 16 For if the firstfruit be holy, the lump is also holy : and if the root be holy, so are the branches.
17 And if some of the branches be broken off, and thou, being a wild olive tree, wert graffed in among them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree;

rr: 18 oteehimbisiza aha mataagi. Ku oraabe nooyehimbisa, oikukye ngu tiiwe ekitsitsa kimezireho, kureka niiwe omezire aha kitsitsa.
en: 18 boast not against the branches. But if thou boast, thou bearest not the root, but the root thee.

rr: 19 Obundi okaagira oti: Amataagi gakahagurwa ngu nyowe mbyarwemu.
en: 19 Thou wilt say then, The branches were broken off, that I might be graffed in.
20 Well; because of unbelief they were broken off, and thou standest by faith. Be not highminded, but fear:

rr: 21 ahakuba Ruhanga ku araabe atarasaasiire mataagi agahangiirweho, naiwe tarikusaasira.
en: 21 for if God spared not the natural branches, take heed lest he also spare not thee.
22 Behold therefore the goodness and severity of God: on them which fell, severity; but toward thee, goodness, if thou continue in his goodness: otherwise thou also shalt be cut off.

rr: 23 Kandi nabo, ku bariba batagumiire mu butaikiriza bwabo, baryabyarwmau, ahakuba Ruhanga aine obushoboorozi kugaruka kubabyaramu.
en: 23 And they also, if they abide not still in unbelief, shall be graffed in: for God is able to graff them in again.

rr: 24 Omanyenngu ku oraabe waahagwirwe aha muzeituuni ogw'omu ishwa omu buhangwa, okabyarwa omu muzeituuni omurungi, ogu waabaire otaine buzaare nagwo, amataagi gari agaabaire gari ag'obuhangwa tigarikira munonga kugaruka kubyarwa aha muzeituuni gwago?
en: 24 For if thou wert cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature, and wert graffed contrary to nature into a good olive tree: how much more shall these, which be the natural branches , be graffed into their own olive tree?

25 For I would not, brethren, that ye should be ignorant of this mystery, lest ye should be wise in your own conceits; that blindness in part is happened to Israel, until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in.
26 And so all Israel shall be saved: as it is written,
27 For this is my covenant unto them,

rr: 28 Omu by'engiri bo n'abazigu ba Ruhanga ahabwanyu; kwonka omu by'okutooranwa Ruhanga n'abarikukundwa ahabwa baishenkurubo.
en: 28 As concerning the gospel, they are enemies for your sakes: but as touching the election, they are beloved for the fathers' sakes.

rr: 29 Mumanye ngu ebi Ruhanga agaba n'okweta kwe tabyefuuza.
en: 29 For the gifts and calling of God are without repentance.

rr: 30 Nk'oku ira mwabaire mugomeire Ruhanga, kwonka hati musaasiirwe ahabw'obugomi bwabo
en: 30 For as ye in times past have not believed God, yet have now obtained mercy through their unbelief:

rr: 31 nikwo nabo hati bagomire, ngu embabazi ezi mwagiriirwe zibareetere okusaasirwa
en: 31 even so have these also now not believed, that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy.
32 For God hath concluded them all in unbelief, that he might have mercy upon all.

rr: 33 Yeimwe! Obutungi bwa Ruhanga, obwengye bwe n'okumanya kwe ka bitaine bugarukiro! Emicwere ye n'emitwarize ye tibirikubaasa kumanywa.
en: 33 O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!
34 For who hath known the mind of the Lord? or who hath been his counsellor?

rr: 35 Nari n'oha orabandize kumuha ekintu
en: 35 Or who hath first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again?

rr: 36 Ahakuba byona niwe bikomookaho, kandi bibaho ahabwe, kandi niwe mukama waabyo; aheebwe ekitiinisa ebiro byona. Amiina.
en: 36 For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to whom be glory for ever. Amen.
1 I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.
2 And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.

3 For I say, through the grace given unto me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think soberly, according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith.
4 For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office:
5 so we, being many, are one body in Christ, and every one members one of another.
6 Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith;
7 or ministry, let us wait on our ministering: or he that teacheth, on teaching;
8 or he that exhorteth, on exhortation: he that giveth, let him do it with simplicity; he that ruleth, with diligence; he that sheweth mercy, with cheerfulness.

rr: 9 Okukunda kwanyu kutabamu oburyarya. Mwangire kimwe ekibi, muhamire aha kirungi
en: 9 Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.
10 Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another;
11 not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;

rr: 12 Mushemererwe mwine amatsiko; mugumisirize omu busaasi; mugumizemu kushaba muhamire.
en: 12 rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
13 distributing to the necessity of saints; given to hospitality.
14 Bless them which persecute you: bless, and curse not.

rr: 15 Mushemererwe hamwe n'abarikushemererwa; murire hamwe n'abarikurira.
en: 15 Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.
16 Be of the same mind one toward another. Mind not high things, but condescend to men of low estate. Be not wise in your own conceits.
17 Recompense to no man evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men.
18 If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.
19 Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.
20 Therefore if thine enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him drink: for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire on his head.

rr: 21 Otasingurwa ekibi, kureka ekibi okisinguze ekirungi.
en: 21 Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.
1 Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. For there is no power but of God: the powers that be are ordained of God.

rr: 2 N'ahabw'ekyo orikugomera obutegyeki, naaba agomeire eki Ruhanga yaataireho; kandi abarikugoma beereetera orubanja.
en: 2 Whosoever therefore resisteth the power, resisteth the ordinance of God: and they that resist shall receive to themselves damnation.
3 For rulers are not a terror to good works, but to the evil. Wilt thou then not be afraid of the power? do that which is good, and thou shalt have praise of the same:

rr: 4 ahabw'okuba we n'omuheereza wa Ruhanga ow'okukuhaisa ebirungi.
en: 4 for he is the minister of God to thee for good.

rr: Kwonka ku oraabe nookora kubi, otiine; ahakuba takwatira busha rurara; kureka n'omuheereza wa Ruhanga, ohoora enzigu aha muntu okora kubi.
en: But if thou do that which is evil, be afraid; for he beareth not the sword in vain: for he is the minister of God, a revenger to execute wrath upon him that doeth evil.

rr: 5 N'ahabw'ekyo mushemereire kuboorobera, ti habw'okutiina kiniga ekyo kwonka, kureka n'ahabw'eiraka ry'omwoyo.
en: 5 Wherefore ye must needs be subject, not only for wrath, but also for conscience sake.

rr: 6 Kandi nikyo muheera omushoro, ahakuba abakama abo n'abaheereza ba Ruhanga abeezirika kukora omurimo ogwo obutoosha.
en: 6 For for this cause pay ye tribute also: for they are God's ministers, attending continually upon this very thing.
7 Render therefore to all their dues: tribute to whom tribute is due ; custom to whom custom; fear to whom fear; honour to whom honour.
8 Owe no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law.

rr: 9 Ahabw'okuba ebi ngu, Otarishambana, otariita, Otariiba, Otaryetenga eby'abandi, n'ebindi biragiro byona, biteeranira omu kigambo eki ngu: Kunda mutaahi waawe nk'oku oyekunda.
en: 9 For this, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not kill, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness, Thou shalt not covet; and if there be any other commandment, it is briefly comprehended in this saying, namely, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
10 Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.

rr: 11 Kandi mugume mukore mutyo, ahakuba nimumanya ngu obunaku buhikire imwe kusisiimuka omu turo; ahabw'okuba okujunwa kutwiriire haihi okukira obu twatandika kwikiriza.
en: 11 And that, knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of sleep: for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.
12 The night is far spent, the day is at hand: let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armour of light.
13 Let us walk honestly, as in the day; not in rioting and drunkenness, not in chambering and wantonness, not in strife and envying.
14 But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfil the lusts thereof .
1 Him that is weak in the faith receive ye, but not to doubtful disputations.

rr: 2 Omuntu omwe aine okwikiriza okurikumubaasisa kurya byona; kwonka otaine maani, arya emboga zonka.
en: 2 For one believeth that he may eat all things: another, who is weak, eateth herbs.

rr: 3 Orikurya byona arekye kugaya otarikubirya; kandi otarikubirya arekye kucwera orikubirya orubanja; ahabw'okuba Ruhanga akamwakiira.
en: 3 Let not him that eateth despise him that eateth not; and let not him which eateth not judge him that eateth: for God hath received him.
4 Who art thou that judgest another man's servant? to his own master he standeth or falleth. Yea, he shall be holden up: for God is able to make him stand.
5 One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day alike . Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind.

rr: 6 Orinda ekiro akirinda ahabwa Mukama; n'orya byona, nawe abirya ahabwa Mukama, ahabw'okuba asiima Ruhanga; kandi obyanga abyanga ahabwa Mukama, kandi nawe asiima Ruhanga.
en: 6 He that regardeth the day, regardeth it unto the Lord; and he that regardeth not the day, to the Lord he doth not regard it . He that eateth, eateth to the Lord, for he giveth God thanks; and he that eateth not, to the Lord he eateth not, and giveth God thanks.

rr: 7 Ahakuba omuriitwe tihariho obaho ahabwe wenka, kandi tihariho ofa ahabwe wenka.
en: 7 For none of us liveth to himself, and no man dieth to himself.
8 For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; and whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lord's.

rr: 9 Ekyo nikyo Kristo yaafeereire kandi akazooka, ngu abone kuba Mukama w'abafiire n'abahuriire.
en: 9 For to this end Christ both died, and rose, and revived, that he might be Lord both of the dead and living.
10 But why dost thou judge thy brother? or why dost thou set at nought thy brother? for we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.
11 For it is written,

rr: 12 Nikwo buri omwe omuriitwe aryagambira, naayetonganira ahari Ruhanga.
en: 12 So then every one of us shall give account of himself to God.

rr: 13 N'ahabw'ekyo okuruga hati turekye kucwererana emanja; kureka buri muntu omuriitwe ahamize kimwe okutateeza mwene Ishe ntsibo, nari okukora ekirikumugwisa.
en: 13 Let us not therefore judge one another any more: but judge this rather, that no man put a stumblingblock or an occasion to fall in his brother's way.
14 I know, and am persuaded by the Lord Jesus, that there is nothing unclean of itself: but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
15 But if thy brother be grieved with thy meat, now walkest thou not charitably. Destroy not him with thy meat, for whom Christ died.

rr: 16 N'ahabw'ekyo otajumisa ekirungi kyawe.
en: 16 Let not then your good be evil spoken of:

rr: 17 Manya, obukama bwa Ruhanga ti by'okurya, nari eby'okunywa, kureka okuhikiirira n'obusingye n'okushemererwa omu Mwoyo Orikwera.
en: 17 for the kingdom of God is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Holy Ghost.

rr: 18 Ahakuba oheereza atyo Kristo, niwe ashemeza Ruhanga, kandi asiimwe n'abantu.
en: 18 For he that in these things serveth Christ is acceptable to God, and approved of men.
19 Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace, and things wherewith one may edify another.

rr: 20 Mutashiisha omurimo gwa Ruhanga ahabw'eby'okurya.
en: 20 For meat destroy not the work of God.

rr: Omu mazima byona bishemeire; kwonka ni kibi omuntu kugwisa abandi ahabw'ebi arikurya.
en: All things indeed are pure; but it is evil for that man who eateth with offence.

rr: 21 Ni kirungi okutarya nyama, nari okunywa viinyo, nari okukora ekintu kyona ekirikuteeza mwene Sho entsibo, nari okumugwisa nari okumumaramu amaani.
en: 21 It is good neither to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor any thing whereby thy brother stumbleth, or is offended, or is made weak.

rr: 22 Okwikiriza oku oine, ogume nakwo omu mutima gwawe omu maisho ga Ruhanga.
en: 22 Hast thou faith? have it to thyself before God.

rr: Otarikwecwera rubanja omu bi arikwikiriza ahiiriirwe.
en: Happy is he that condemneth not himself in that thing which he alloweth.

rr: 23 Kwonka ogwo orikubanganisa, ku arya, asingwa orubanja, ahabw'okuba tiyaarya aikiriize; kandi kyona ekitaruga mu kwikiriza, kiba kibi.
en: 23 And he that doubteth is damned if he eat, because he eateth not of faith: for whatsoever is not of faith is sin.

rr: 1 Itwe abaine amaani tushemereire kwekorera obweremwa bw'abatagaine, tureky kweshemeza twenka.
en: 1 We then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
2 Let every one of us please his neighbour for his good to edification.
3 For even Christ pleased not himself; but, as it is written, The reproaches of them that reproached thee fell on me.
4 For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.

rr: 5 Mbwenu, Ruhanga mukama w'okugumisiriza n'okuhuumuza abahe okukwatanisa omu biteekateeko byanyu, nk'oku Kristo Yesu akunda
en: 5 Now the God of patience and consolation grant you to be likeminded one toward another according to Christ Jesus:

rr: 6 mubone kuhimbisa Ruhanga Ishe wa Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo n'omutima gumwe n'akanwa kamwe.
en: 6 that ye may with one mind and one mouth glorify God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

rr: 7 N'habw'ekyo mwakiirane, nk'oku Kristo yaabaakiire, Ruhanga abone kuhimbisibwa.
en: 7 Wherefore receive ye one another, as Christ also received us to the glory of God.

rr: 8 Eki ndikugamba n'eki nti: Kristo akahinduka omuheereza w'abashazirwe ow'okubooreka amazima ga Ruhanga, ngu abone kuhamya ebi baishenkurubo baaraganisiibwe
en: 8 Now I say that Jesus Christ was a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God, to confirm the promises made unto the fathers:
9 and that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy; as it is written,

rr: 10 Kandi ngu
en: 10 And again he saith,

rr: 11 Kandi ahandi ngu
en: 11 And again,
12 And again, Esaias saith,

rr: 13 Ruhanga mukama w'amatsiko abaijuze okushemererwa kwona n'obusingye omu kwikiriza, amatsiko gaanyu gakanyisibwe amaani g'Omwoyo Orikwera.
en: 13 Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.

rr: 14 Beene Tata, nimmanya gye ebyanyu ntarikubanganisa, ku mwijwire emicwe mirungi n'okwetegyereza kwona, kandi ku murikubaasa kuhuguurana.
en: 14 And I myself also am persuaded of you, my brethren, that ye also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.

rr: 15 Kwonka ebimwe omu baruha egi naabibahandiikira n'obumanzi, nimbaijutsya, oku Ruhanga yaangiriire embabazi
en: 15 Nevertheless, brethren, I have written the more boldly unto you in some sort, as putting you in mind, because of the grace that is given to me of God,
16 that I should be the minister of Jesus Christ to the Gentiles, ministering the gospel of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be acceptable, being sanctified by the Holy Ghost.

rr: 17 N'ahabw'ekyo, omuri Kristo Yesu nyine eby'okwehimbisizaho omu murimo ogu nkoreire Ruhanga.
en: 17 I have therefore whereof I may glory through Jesus Christ in those things which pertain to God.

rr: 18 Tinkaayehanga kugamba aha bindi kureka aha bi naakoresiibwe Kristo kworobya Abanyamahanga, omu kugamba n'omu kukora
en: 18 For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Christ hath not wrought by me, to make the Gentiles obedient, by word and deed,

rr: 19 ahabw'amaani g'obumanyiso n'eby'okutangaaza, nimbukoresibwa Omwoyo Orikwera; okuruga Yerusaalemu, okwehinguririza okuhika Iluriko, nkabuurira hoona engiri ya Kristo.
en: 19 through mighty signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit of God; so that from Jerusalem, and round about unto Illyricum, I have fully preached the gospel of Christ.
20 Yea, so have I strived to preach the gospel, not where Christ was named, lest I should build upon another man's foundation:

rr: 21 kibone kuba nk'oku kyahandiikirwe ngu
en: 21 But as it is written,

rr: 22 Nikyo naagiriire ebirikunzibira kaingi kwija owaanyu
en: 22 For which cause also I have been much hindered from coming to you.

rr: 23 kwonka hati, nk'oku ntakiine hatsigaire omu mahanga aga, kandi mmazire emyaka mingi niinyetenga kwija owaanyu
en: 23 But now having no more place in these parts, and having a great desire these many years to come unto you;

rr: 24 ku ndiba ninza Spania, nyine amatsiko kubarabaho nkabareeba; kandi ku ndimara naimwe ebiro bikye, naabahwa orushusho, mubone kunshendekyereza omu rugyendo rwangye.
en: 24 whensoever I take my journey into Spain, I will come to you: for I trust to see you in my journey, and to be brought on my way thitherward by you, if first I be somewhat filled with your company .

rr: 25 Kwonka hati ninza Yerusaalemu nintwara eby'okuhwera abarikwera
en: 25 But now I go unto Jerusalem to minister unto the saints.
26 For it hath pleased them of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor saints which are at Jerusalem.
27 It hath pleased them verily; and their debtors they are. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, their duty is also to minister unto them in carnal things.

rr: 28 N'ahabw'ekyo, ku ndiheza kubahitsya ebiconco ebyo, ndyabarabaho ninza Spania.
en: 28 When therefore I have performed this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will come by you into Spain.
29 And I am sure that, when I come unto you, I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of the gospel of Christ.
30 Now I beseech you, brethren, for the Lord Jesus Christ's sake, and for the love of the Spirit, that ye strive together with me in your prayers to God for me;

rr: 31 mbone kukira ab'omu Bayudaaya abatarikwikiriza, kandi n'eby'obuhwezi ebi ndikutwara Yerusaalemu bisiimwe abarikwera
en: 31 that I may be delivered from them that do not believe in Judæa; and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be accepted of the saints;

rr: 32 ntyo naanye Ruhanga ku araasiime, mbone kwija owaanyu nshemereirwe, turuhuukire hamwe.
en: 32 that I may come unto you with joy by the will of God, and may with you be refreshed.

rr: 33 Ruhanga mukama w'obusingye agume naimwe mwena. Amiina.
en: 33 Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.

rr: 1 Nimbasiimira munyaanyaitwe Foibe omudiikonikazi w'ekanisa ya Kenkerea
en: 1 I commend unto you Phebe our sister, which is a servant of the church which is at Cenchrea:

rr: 2 mumwakiire omuri Mukama waitu, nk'oku kishemereire abarikwera, kandi mumuhwere omuri byona ebi aryatenga ahariimwe; ahabw'okuba abaire naahwera baingi, naanye ntababuziremu.
en: 2 that ye receive her in the Lord, as becometh saints, and that ye assist her in whatsoever business she hath need of you: for she hath been a succourer of many, and of myself also.

rr: 3 Mundamukize Priska na Akula, abakozi bagyenzi bangye omuri Kristo Yesu
en: 3 Greet Priscilla and Aquila my helpers in Christ Jesus:

rr: 4 abaabaire beehaireyo kucuubwaho ebitsya ahabw'amagara gangye. Tiinye nyenka orikubasiima, kureka n'amakanisa goona ag'Abanyamahanga
en: 4 who have for my life laid down their own necks: unto whom not only I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles.

rr: 5 kandi muramutsye ekanisa ey'omu ka yaabo.
en: 5 Likewise greet the church that is in their house.

rr: Muramutsye na munywani wangye Epaineeto, owaabandize kuhindukira Kristo omuri Asia.
en: Salute my wellbeloved Epænetus, who is the firstfruits of Achaia unto Christ.

rr: 6 Muramutsye Mariamu owaabakoreire munonga.
en: 6 Greet Mary, who bestowed much labour on us.

rr: 7 Muramutsye Anderoniiko na Yuniasi, ab'omuryango gwangye, abu naabohirwe nabo, abashaija rugambwa omu ntumwa, kandi abambandiize omuri Kristo.
en: 7 Salute Andronicus and Junia, my kinsmen, and my fellowprisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.

rr: 8 Muramutsye Ampuliato, munywani wangye omuri Mukama.
en: 8 Greet Amplias my beloved in the Lord.

rr: 9 Muramutsye Urubano, omukozi mugyenzi waitu omuri Kristo hamwe na Staako munywani wangye.
en: 9 Salute Urbane, our helper in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.

rr: 10 Muramutsye Apele, orikusiimwa omuri Kristo. Muramutsye n'ab'omuka ya Aristobulo.
en: 10 Salute Apelles approved in Christ. Salute them which are of Aristobulus' household .

rr: 11 Muramutsye Herodioni ow'omuryango gwangye. Muramutsye abo abari omuri Mukama ab'omu ka ya Nakiso.
en: 11 Salute Herodion my kinsman. Greet them that be of the household of Narcissus, which are in the Lord.

rr: 12 Muramutsye Trufaina na Trufoosa abarikukorera omuri Mukama. Muramutsye Peresi orikukundwa, owaayezirikire kukorera omuri Mukama.
en: 12 Salute Tryphena and Tryphosa, who labour in the Lord. Salute the beloved Persis, which laboured much in the Lord.

rr: 13 Muramutsye Rufo owaatoorainwe omuri Mukama, kandi na nyina naanye ou nyeta maawe.
en: 13 Salute Rufus chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.

rr: 14 Muramutwey Asunkuriito, Fulegoni, Herume, Patiroba, Heruma n'ab'eishe-emwe abatwire nabo.
en: 14 Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, and the brethren which are with them.

rr: 15 Muramutsye Filologo, Yulia, Nereu na munyaanya, na Olumpa n'abarikwera boona abatwire nabo.
en: 15 Salute Philologus, and Julia, Nereus, and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints which are with them.

rr: 16 Muramukansie okunywegyerana okurikwera. Amakanisa ga Kristo goona gaabaramutsya.
en: 16 Salute one another with an holy kiss. The churches of Christ salute you.

rr: 17 Kandi nimbeeshengyereza, B'eishe-emwe, mwetegyereze abo abarikureeta eby'okubataanisa n'eby'okubateeza entsibo, ebitaanuukaine n'enyegyesa ei mwayegire; mubeetantare
en: 17 Now I beseech you, brethren, mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which ye have learned; and avoid them.
18 For they that are such serve not our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the simple.
19 For your obedience is come abroad unto all men . I am glad therefore on your behalf: but yet I would have you wise unto that which is good, and simple concerning evil.
20 And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly.

rr: 21 Timoseo, omukozi mugyenzi wangye, yaabaramutsya; kandi Lukio, Yasooni na Sosipateeri ab'omuryango gwangye nabo baabaramutsya.
en: 21 Timotheus my workfellow, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen, salute you.

rr: 22 Nyowe Teretio, omuhandiiki w'ebaruha egi, nimbaramutsya omuri Mukama.
en: 22 I Tertius, who wrote this epistle, salute you in the Lord.
23 Gaius mine host, and of the whole church, saluteth you. Erastus the chamberlain of the city saluteth you, and Quartus a brother.

rr: 24 Embabazi za Mukama waitu Yesu Kristo zigume naimwe mwena. Amiina.
en: 24 The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
25 Now to him that is of power to stablish you according to my gospel, and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery, which was kept secret since the world began,
26 but now is made manifest, and by the scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the everlasting God, made known to all nations for the obedience of faith:

rr: 27 Ruhanga ow'obwengye omwe wenka aheebwe ekitiinisa ebiro byona ahabwa Yesu Kristo. Amiina.
en: 27 to God only wise, be glory through Jesus Christ for ever. Amen.

rr: Omu biro by'okutegyeka kw'abaramuzi, hakabaho enjara omu nsi.
en: Now it came to pass in the days when the judges ruled, that there was a famine in the land.

rr: Omushaija wa Betelehemu-Yuda yaashuhuukira omu nsi ya Moabu, we n'omukazi we n'abatabani bombi.
en: And a certain man of Beth-lehem-judah went to sojourn in the country of Moab, he, and his wife, and his two sons.

rr: Ogwo mushaija akaba naayetwa Elimeleki, n'omukazi we naayetwa Naomi, n'amaziina g'abatabani gakaba gari Mahalooni na Kilioni; bakaba bari aba Efuraata, aba Betelehemu-Yuda.
en: And the name of the man was Elimelech, and the name of his wife Naomi, and the name of his two sons Mahlon and Chilion, Ephrathites of Beth-lehem-judah.

rr: Ku baahikire omu nsi ya Moabu, baatuurayo.
en: And they came into the country of Moab, and continued there.

rr: Bwanyima Elimeleki iba wa Naomi yaafa; Naomi yaatsigara n'abatabani bombi.
en: And Elimelech Naomi's husband died; and she was left, and her two sons.

rr: Baashwera Abamoabukazi, omwe akaba naayetwa Orupa, n'ondi Ruusi; baamarayo emyaka nka ikumi.
en: And they took them wives of the women of Moab; the name of the one was Orpah, and the name of the other Ruth: and they dwelled there about ten years.

rr: Bwanyima Mahalooni na Kilioni bombi baafa; Naomi ogwo yaafeerwa iba n'abatabani bombi. Ruusi okwanga kutaana na nyinazaara
en: And Mahlon and Chilion died also both of them; and the woman was left of her two sons and her husband.

rr: Bwanyima yaimuka n'abakaamwana kugarukayo naaruga omu nsi ya Moabu; ahakuba akaba yaahuririire omu nsi ya Moabu, ku MUKAMA ataayaayiire abantu be, akabaha eby'okurya.
en: Then she arose with her daughters in law, that she might return from the country of Moab: for she had heard in the country of Moab how that the LORD had visited his people in giving them bread.

rr: Yaaruga ahu yaabaire ari hamwe n'abakaamwana bombi, baakwata omuhanda kugaruka omu nsi ya Yuda.
en: Wherefore she went forth out of the place where she was, and her two daughters in law with her; and they went on the way to return unto the land of Judah.

rr: Naomi yaagira abakaamwana ati: Mwirooko, buri omwe agarukye omu nju ya nyina. MUKAMA abakorere eby'embabazi, nk'oku mwabinkoreire na baanyakufa.
en: And Naomi said unto her two daughters in law, Go, return each to her mother's house: the LORD deal kindly with you, as ye have dealt with the dead, and with me.

rr: MUKAMA abahe obuhuumure, buri omwe omu ka ya iba.
en: The LORD grant you that ye may find rest, each of you in the house of her husband.

rr: Yaabanywegyera, baimutsya amaraka, baarira.
en: Then she kissed them; and they lifted up their voice, and wept.

rr: Baamugarukamu bati: Ngaaha, kureka nitwija kugarukayo naiwe omu bantu b'owaanyu.
en: And they said unto her, Surely we will return with thee unto thy people.

rr: Naomi yaabagira ati: Baana bangye, mugarukyeyo; nimwendera ki kugyenda naanye? Nimugira ngu nkiine abandi baana omunda, ngu nyentsya babe abashaija baanyu?
en: And Naomi said, Turn again, my daughters: why will ye go with me? are there yet any more sons in my womb, that they may be your husbands?

rr: Baana bangye, mwegyendere, mugarukyeyo, ahakuba nkuzire, tinkiri w'okushwerwa.
en: Turn again, my daughters, go your way ; for I am too old to have an husband.

rr: Nangwa n'obu naakugira nti, nyine amatsiko, nari n'obu naakushwerwa omushaija eki kiro, naazaara abaana b'aboojo
en: If I should say, I have hope, if I should have an husband also to night, and should also bear sons;

rr: ebyo mukaabategyereza, okuhitsya ahu barikurira? Haza ekyo kibazibira kushwerwa? Ngaaha, baana bangye; ninshaasha munonga ahabwanyu, ahakuba MUKAMA abangire omukono gwe kundwanisa.
en: would ye tarry for them till they were grown? would ye stay for them from having husbands? nay, my daughters; for it grieveth me much for your sakes that the hand of the LORD is gone out against me.

en: And Ruth the Moabitess said unto Naomi, Let me now go to the field, and glean ears of corn after him in whose sight I shall find grace.

en: And she went, and came, and gleaned in the field after the reapers: and her hap was to light on a part of the field belonging unto Boaz, who was of the kindred of Elimelech.

rr: Nabo baamugarukamu bati: MUKAMA akuhe omugisha.

rr: Bwanyima Boazi yaabuuza omunyampara w'abagyesi ati: Omwishiki ogu n'ow'oha?
en: Then said Boaz unto his servant that was set over the reapers, Whose damsel is this?

rr: Omunyampara ogwo yaagarukamu ati: N'omwishiki w'Omumoabu owaagarukire na Naomi okuruga omu nsi ya Moabu.
en: And the servant that was set over the reapers answered and said, It is the Moabitish damsel that came back with Naomi out of the country of Moab:

en: and she said, I pray you, let me glean and gather after the reapers among the sheaves: so she came, and hath continued even from the morning until now, that she tarried a little in the house.

rr: Bwanyima Boazi yaagira Ruusi ati: Hurira, mwana wangye!

en: let thine eyes be on the field that they do reap, and go thou after them: have I not charged the young men that they shall not touch thee? and when thou art athirst, go unto the vessels, and drink of that which the young men have drawn.

rr: Boazi yaamugarukamu ati: Banshobororeire gye byona ebi waakoreire nyokozaara okwiha obu baro yaafa, kandi n'oku waatsigireho sho na nyoko n'ensi yaanyu, okaija omu bantu abu waabaire otakamanyaga.
en: And Boaz answered and said unto her, It hath fully been shewed me, all that thou hast done unto thy mother in law since the death of thine husband: and how thou hast left thy father and thy mother, and the land of thy nativity, and art come unto a people which thou knewest not heretofore.

rr: MUKAMA akuzimuurire ahabw'ebi waakozire; MUKAMA Ruhanga wa Israeli; ou waahungiire omu mapapa ge, akuhe ebihembo byawe byona bitacwirweho.
en: The LORD recompense thy work, and a full reward be given thee of the LORD God of Israel, under whose wings thou art come to trust.

rr: Ruusi yaagira ati: Mukama wangye, wangirira embabazi nyingi, ahabw'okuba wampuumuriza, kandi waagamba gye n'omuzaana waawe, n'obu ndaabe ntari nk'omwe aha bazaana baawe.
en: Then she said, Let me find favour in thy sight, my lord; for that thou hast comforted me, and for that thou hast spoken friendly unto thine handmaid, though I be not like unto one of thine handmaidens.

en: And she sat beside the reapers: and he reached her parched corn , and she did eat, and was sufficed, and left.

rr: Kandi mumwihire ezindi omu biba, muzitsigye aho, azihumbe, mutamugambaho.
en: and let fall also some of the handfuls of purpose for her, and leave them , that she may glean them , and rebuke her not.

en: And she took it up, and went into the city: and her mother in law saw what she had gleaned: and she brought forth, and gave to her that she had reserved after she was sufficed.

en: And her mother in law said unto her, Where hast thou gleaned to day? and where wroughtest thou? blessed be he that did take knowledge of thee. And she shewed her mother in law with whom she had wrought, and said, The man's name with whom I wrought to day is Boaz.

rr: Naomi yaagira omukaamwana ati: Ogwo mushaija aheebwe omugisha ahari MUKAMA, otarekire kugirira mbabazi abakiriho na baanyakufa.
en: And Naomi said unto her daughter in law, Blessed be he of the LORD , who hath not left off his kindness to the living and to the dead.

rr: Naomi yaagaruka yaamugira ati: Ogwo mushaija ni mwene waitu ow'obuzaare bwa haihi, omwe ah'abashemereire kutucungura.
en: And Naomi said unto her, The man is near of kin unto us, one of our next kinsmen.

en: And now, my daughter, fear not; I will do to thee all that thou requirest: for all the city of my people doth know that thou art a virtuous woman.

en: Tarry this night, and it shall be in the morning, that if he will perform unto thee the part of a kinsman, well; let him do the kinsman's part: but if he will not do the part of a kinsman to thee, then will I do the part of a kinsman to thee, as the LORD liveth: lie down until the morning.

en: And she lay at his feet until the morning: and she rose up before one could know another. And he said, Let it not be known that a woman came into the floor.

en: Also he said, Bring the vail that thou hast upon thee, and hold it.

en: And when she came to her mother in law, she said, Who art thou, my daughter?

en: And she said, These six measures of barley gave he me; for he said to me, Go not empty unto thy mother in law.

en: Then said she, Sit still, my daughter, until thou know how the matter will fall: for the man will not be in rest, until he have finished the thing this day.

en: Then went Boaz up to the gate, and sat him down there: and, behold, the kinsman of whom Boaz spake came by; unto whom he said, Ho, such a one! turn aside, sit down here. And he turned aside, and sat down.

en: And he took ten men of the elders of the city, and said, Sit ye down here. And they sat down.

en: And he said unto the kinsman, Naomi, that is come again out of the country of Moab, selleth a parcel of land, which was our brother Elimelech's:

en: and I thought to advertise thee, saying, Buy it before the inhabitants, and before the elders of my people.

rr: Ku oraabe nooyenda kukicungura, okucungure; nari ku oraabe otarikwenda, nabwo ongambire, nkimanye; ahabw'okuba tihariho ondiijo ow'okukicungura kureka iwe, naanye orikukukurata.
en: If thou wilt redeem it , redeem it: but if thou wilt not redeem it, then tell me, that I may know: for there is none to redeem it beside thee; and I am after thee.

rr: Onu yaagira ati: Niinyija kukicungura.
en: And he said, I will redeem it .

rr: Bwanyima Boazi yaagira ati: Eizooba eri oraagurireho ekyo kibanja na Naomi, omanye ku oshemereire kukigura n'ahari Ruusi Omumoabukazi, muka nyakufa, okugaruraho eiziina rya nyakufa omu buhunguzi bwe.
en: Then said Boaz, What day thou buyest the field of the hand of Naomi, thou must buy it also of Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of the dead, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance.

rr: Ogwo munyabuzaare bwa haihi yaagarukamu ati: Nyowe tindikubaasa kukicungura, ntakaashisha obuhunguzi bwangye. Okicungure omu mwanya gwangye, ahakuba tindikubaasa kukicungura.
en: And the kinsman said, I cannot redeem it for myself, lest I mar mine own inheritance: redeem thou my right to thyself; for I cannot redeem it .

rr: Kandi obunyakare ogu nigwo gwabaire guba omucwe omuri Israeli omu by'okucungura n'eby'okuhingisa; ku baabaire benda kuhamya eki baakora, omwe akaba ajuura enkaito, agiha mugyenzi we; okwo nikwo Abaisraeli baabaire bahamya endagaano.
en: Now this was the manner in former time in Israel concerning redeeming and concerning changing, for to confirm all things; a man plucked off his shoe, and gave it to his neighbour: and this was a testimony in Israel.

rr: N'ahabw'ekyo ogwo munyabuzaare bwa haihi, ku yaagambiire Boazi ati: Okicungure, yaajuura enkaito ye.
en: Therefore the kinsman said unto Boaz, Buy it for thee. So he drew off his shoe.

rr: Bwanyima Boazi yaagambira abakuru n'abantu boona ati: Eri izooba muri baakareebi b'okuhamya ku naagura na Naomi byona ebyabaire biri ebya Elimeleki n'ebya Kilioni byona n'ebya Mahalooni byona.
en: And Boaz said unto the elders, and unto all the people, Ye are witnesses this day, that I have bought all that was Elimelech's, and all that was Chilion's and Mahlon's, of the hand of Naomi.

rr: Kandi Ruusi Omumoabukazi owaabaire ari muka Mahalooni, nawe naamugura kuba omukazi wangye, mbone kugaruraho eiziina rya nyakufa omu buhunguzi bwe, eiziina rya nyakufa rirekye kweba omuri beene waabo n'omu irembo ry'eka ye. Muri baakareebi eri izooba.
en: Moreover Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of Mahlon, have I purchased to be my wife, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance, that the name of the dead be not cut off from among his brethren, and from the gate of his place: ye are witnesses this day.

rr: Abantu boona abaabaire bari omu irembo n'abakuru baagira bati: Turi baakareebi.
en: And all the people that were in the gate, and the elders, said, We are witnesses.

rr: Ogu mukazi owaaza omu nju yaawe MUKAMA amugire nka Rakeeli na Lea oku baakwataniise bombi kwimutsya enju ya Israeli; naiwe okore ebishemeire omuri Efuraata, kandi orangaanwe omuri Betelehemu
en: The LORD make the woman that is come into thine house like Rachel and like Leah, which two did build the house of Israel: and do thou worthily in Ephratah, and be famous in Beth-lehem:

rr: kandi enju yaawe ebe nk'eya Pereezi, ou Tamari yaazaariire Yuda, ahabw'abaana abu MUKAMA arikuha omuri ogwo mukazi muto. Ruusi okuzaara Obedi ishenkuru wa Daudi
en: and let thy house be like the house of Pharez, whom Tamar bare unto Judah, of the seed which the LORD shall give thee of this young woman.

rr: Atyo Boazi yaatwara Ruusi, yaaba omukazi we; yaamuta aha mukono, MUKAMA yaamuha enda, yaazaara omwana w'omwojo.
en: So Boaz took Ruth, and she was his wife: and when he went in unto her, the LORD gave her conception, and she bare a son.

rr: Abakazi baagira Naomi bati: MUKAMA asiimwe ahabw'okutakureka otaine w'obuzaare bwa haihi; kandi eiziina rye rirangaanwe omuri Israeli.
en: And the women said unto Naomi, Blessed be the LORD , which hath not left thee this day without a kinsman, that his name may be famous in Israel.

rr: Aryaba ow'okukugaruramu amagara, kandi ow'okukuriisa omu bukaikuru bwawe; ahabw'okuba mukaamwana waawe, orikukukunda, kandi orikukukirira abaana b'aboojo mushanju, niwe amuzaire.
en: And he shall be unto thee a restorer of thy life, and a nourisher of thine old age: for thy daughter in law, which loveth thee, which is better to thee than seven sons, hath born him.

rr: Naomi yaakwata omwana, yaamukiikira, yaaba omurezi we.
en: And Naomi took the child, and laid it in her bosom, and became nurse unto it.

rr: Kandi abakazi bataahi be baamweta eiziina, nibagira bati: Omwana w'omwojo azaariirwe Naomi. Baamweta Obedi; niwe ishe wa Yese, ishe wa Daudi.
en: And the women her neighbours gave it a name, saying, There is a son born to Naomi; and they called his name Obed: he is the father of Jesse, the father of David.

rr: Kandi oru nirwo ruzaaro rwa Pereezi; Pereezi akazaara Hezirooni
en: Now these are the generations of Pharez: Pharez begat Hezron,

rr: Hezirooni yaazaara Raamu; Raamu yaazaara Aminadabu
en: and Hezron begat Ram, and Ram begat Amminadab,

rr: Aminadabu yaazaara Nahashooni; Nahashooni yaazaara Salumooni
en: and Amminadab begat Nahshon, and Nahshon begat Salmon,

rr: Salumooni yaazaara Boazi; Boazi yaazaara Obedi
en: and Salmon begat Boaz, and Boaz begat Obed,

rr: Obedi yaazaara Yese, na Yese yaazaara Daudi.
en: and Obed begat Jesse, and Jesse begat David.
